text: IN THE beginning God created heauen and earth.
label: Genesis

text: And the earth was voide & vacant, and darkenes was vpon the face of the deapth: and the Spirite of God moued ouer the waters.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſaid: Be light made. And light was made.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſaw the light that it was good: & he diuided the light from the darkenes.
label: Genesis

text: And he called the light, Day, and the darkenes, Night: and there was euening & morning, that made one day.
label: Genesis

text: God alſo ſaid: Be a firmament made amidſt the waters: and let it diuide betwene waters & waters.
label: Genesis

text: And God made a firmament, and diuided the waters, that were vnder the firmament, from thoſe, that were aboue the firmament. And it was ſo done.
label: Genesis

text: And God called the firmament, Heauen: and there was euening & morning that made the ſecond day.
label: Genesis

text: God alſo ſaid: Let the waters that are vnder the heauen, be gathered together into one place: and let the drie land appeare. And it was ſo done.
label: Genesis

text: And God called the drie land, Earth: and the gathering of waters together, he called Seas. And God ſawe that it was good.
label: Genesis

text: And ſaid: Let the earth ſhootforth grene herbes, and ſuch as may ſeede, & fruite trees yelding fruit after his kinde, ſuch as may haue ſeede in it ſelfe vpon the earth. And it was ſo done.
label: Genesis

text: And the earth brought forth grene herbe, ſuch as ſeedeth according to his kinde, and tree that beareth fruite, hauing ſeede eche one according to his kinde. And God ſaw that it was good.
label: Genesis

text: And there was euening and morning that made the third day.
label: Genesis

text: Againe God ſaid: Be there lightes made in the firmament of heauen, to diuide the day & the night, and let them be for ſignes & ſeaſons, and dayes and yeares:
label: Genesis

text: to shine in the firmament of heauen, & to giue light vpon the earth. And it was ſo done.
label: Genesis

text: And God made two great lights: a greater light, to gouerne the day: and a leſſer light to gouerne the night: and ſtarres.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſet them in the firmament of heauen, to ſhine vpon the earth.
label: Genesis

text: and to gouerne the day & the night, and to diuide the light & the darkenes. And God ſawe that it was good.
label: Genesis

text: And there was euening and morning that made the fourth day.
label: Genesis

text: God alſo ſaid: Let the waters bring forth creeping creature hauing life, and flying foule, ouer the earth vnder the firmament of heauen.
label: Genesis

text: And God created huge whales, and al liuing & mouing creature, that the waters brought forth, according to eche ſorte, & al foule according to their kinde. And God ſawe that it was good.
label: Genesis

text: And he bleſſed them ſaying: Increaſe and multiplie, and repleniſh the waters of the ſea: and let the birds be multiplied vpon the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And there was euening & morning that made the fifth day.
label: Genesis

text: God ſaid moreouer: Let the earth bring forth liuing creature, in his kind, cattle, and ſuch as creepe, & beaſtes of the earth according to their kindes: and it was ſo done.
label: Genesis

text: And God made the beaſtes of the earth according to their kindes, and cattle, & al that crepeth on the earth in his kind. And God ſaw that it was good,
label: Genesis

text: and he ſaid Let vs make Man to our image, & likenes: and let him haue dominion ouer the fishes of the ſea, and the foules of the ayre, and the beaſtes, and the whole earth, and al creeping creature, that moueth vpon the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And God created man, to his owne image: to the image of God he created him, male & female he created them.
label: Genesis

text: And God bleſſed them, and ſaith: Increaſe and multiplie, & replenish the earth, and ſubdew it, and rule ouer the fishes of the ſea, and foules of the ayre, & al liuing creatures, that moue vpon the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſaid: Behold I haue giuen you al maner of hearbe that ſeedeth vpon the earth, and al trees that haue in them ſelues ſeede of their owne kinde, to be your meate:
label: Genesis

text: and to al beaſtes of the earth, and to euerie foule of the ayre, & to al that moue vpon the earth, and wherein there is life, that they may haue to feede vpon. And it was ſo done.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſawe al things that he had made, and they were very good. And there was euening & morning that made the ſixt day.
label: Genesis

text: THE heauens therfore & the earth were fully finiſhed, and al the furniture of them.
label: Genesis

text: And the ſeuenth day God ended his woorke which he had made: & reſted the ſeuenth day, from al woorke that he had done.
label: Genesis

text: And he bleſſed the ſeuenth day and ſanctified it: becauſe in it he had ceaſed from al his woorke which God created to make.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe are the generations of heauen & earth, when they were created in the day, when our Lord God made the heauen, and the earth.
label: Genesis

text: and euery plant of the filde, before it shot vp in the earth. And euerie herbe of the ground before it ſprang: for our Lord God had not rayned vpon the earth: and man was not to til the earth:
label: Genesis

text: But a ſpring roſe out of the earth, watering al the ouermoſt part of the earth.
label: Genesis

text: Our Lord God therfore formed man of the ſlyme of the earth: and breathed into his face the breath of life, & man became a liuing ſoule.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord God had planted a Paradiſe of pleaſure from the beginning: wherin he placed man whom he had formed.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord God brought forth of the ground al maner of trees, fayre to behold: and pleaſant to eate of: the tree of life alſo in the middle of Paradiſe: and the tree of knowledge of good & euil.
label: Genesis

text: And a riuer iſſued out of the place of pleaſure to water Paradiſe, which from thence is diuided into four heades.
label: Genesis

text: The name of the one is Phiſon: that is it which compaſſeth al the land of Heuilath, where gold groweth.
label: Genesis

text: And the gold of that land is very good: there is found bdelium, & the ſtone onyx.
label: Genesis

text: And the name of the ſecond riuer is Gehon: that is it which compaſſeth al the land of Ethiopia.
label: Genesis

text: And the name of the third riuer is Tygris: that ſame paſſeth along by the Aſſirians. And the fourth riuer, the ſame is Euphrates.
label: Genesis

text: Our Lord God therfore tooke man, & put him in the Paradiſe of pleaſure, to woorke, & keepe it.
label: Genesis

text: And he commanded him ſaying: Of euerie tree of Paradiſe eate thou:
label: Genesis

text: But of the tree of knowledge of good & euil eate thou not. For in what day ſoeuer thou ſhalt eate of it, thou ſhalt dye the death.
label: Genesis

text: Our Lord God alſo ſaid: It is not good for man to be alone: let vs make him a helpe like vnto him ſelfe.
label: Genesis

text: Our Lord God therfore hauing formed of clay al beaſtes of the earth, and foules of the ayre, brought them to Adam that he might ſee what to cal them: for al that Adam called any liuing creature, the ſame is his name.
label: Genesis

text: And Adam called al beaſtes by their names, and al foules of the ayre, and al cattel of the filde: but vnto Adam there was not found an helper like him ſelfe.
label: Genesis

text: Our Lord God therfore caſt a dead ſleepe vpon Adam: and when he was faſt aſleepe, he tooke one of his ribbes, & filled vp fleſh for it.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord God built the ribbe which he tooke of Adam into a woman: and brought her to Adam.
label: Genesis

text: And Adam ſaid: This now, is bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: ſhe ſhal be called woman, becauſe she was taken out of man.
label: Genesis

text: Wherfore man shal leaue his father & mother, & shal cleaue to his wife, & they ſhal be two in one flesh.
label: Genesis

text: And they were both naked; to wit Adam & his wife: and were not aſhamed.
label: Genesis

text: BVT the ſerpent alſo was more ſubtile then al the beaſts of the earth, which our Lord God had made. Which ſaid to the woman: Why hath God commanded you, that you ſhould not eate of euerie tree of Paradiſe?
label: Genesis

text: To whom the woman anſwered: Of the fruite of the trees that are in paradiſe, we doe eate:
label: Genesis

text: but of the fruite of the tree which is in the middes of paradiſe, God hath commanded vs that we should not eate: and that we ſhould not touch it, leſt perhapes we die.
label: Genesis

text: And the ſerpent ſaid to the woman: No you shal not dye the death.
label: Genesis

text: For God doth know that in what day ſoeuer you shal eate therof, your eyes shal be opened: and you shal be as gods, knowing good & euil.
label: Genesis

text: The woman therfore ſawe that the tree was good to eate, and fayre to the eyes, and delectable to behold: and ſhe tooke of the fruite therof, and did eate, and gaue to her huſband, who did eate.
label: Genesis

text: And the eyes of them both were opened: and when they perceiued themſelues to be naked, they ſowed togeather leaues of a figge tree, and made themſelues aprons.
label: Genesis

text: And hearing the voice of our Lord God walking in paradiſe at the after none ayre: Adam hid himſelfe and ſo did his wife from the face of our Lord God, amidſt the trees of paradiſe.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord God called Adam, and ſaid to him: Where art thou?
label: Genesis

text: Who ſaid: I heard thy voice in paradiſe: and I feared, becauſe I was naked, and I hid me.
label: Genesis

text: To whom he ſaid: And who hath told thee that thou waſt naked, but that thou haſt eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou ſhouldeſt not eate?
label: Genesis

text: And Adam ſaid: The woman, which thou gaueſt me to be my felow companion, gaue me of the tree, and I did eate.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord God ſaid to the woman: Why haſt thou done this? who anſwered: The ſerpent deceiued me, & I did eate.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord God ſaid to the ſerpent: Becauſe thou haſt done this thing, accurſed art thou among al catle, & beaſts of the earth: vpon thy breſt shalt thou goe, & earth shalt thou eate al the dayes of thy life.
label: Genesis

text: I wil put enmyties betwen thee & the woman, and thy ſeed and the ſeed of her: ſhe shal bruiſe thy head in peeces, & thou shalt lye in waite of her heele.
label: Genesis

text: To the woman alſo he ſaid: I wil multiplie thy trauailes, and thy child bearinges: in trauaile shalt thou bring forth children, and thou shalt be vnder thy huſbands power, and he shal haue dominion ouer thee.
label: Genesis

text: And to Adam he ſaid: Becauſe thou haſt heard the voice of thy wife, and haſt eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee, that thou ſhouldeſt not eate, curſed is the earth in thy woorke: with much toyling ſhalt thou eate thereof al the dayes of thy life.
label: Genesis

text: Thornes and thyſtles shal it bring forth to thee, & thou shalt eate the herbes of the earth.
label: Genesis

text: In the ſweat of thy face shalt thou eate bread, til thou returne to earth, of which thou waſt taken: becauſe duſt thou art, and into duſt thou shalt returne.
label: Genesis

text: And Adam called the name of his wife, Eue: for becauſe ſhe was mother of al the liuing.
label: Genesis

text: Our Lord God alſo made for Adam and his wife garments of skynnes, and clothed them.
label: Genesis

text: And ſaid: Loe Adam is become as it were one of vs, knowing good & euil: now therfore leſt perhapes he reach forth his hand, and take alſo of the tree of life, & eate, and liue for euer.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord God ſent him out of the paradiſe of pleaſure, to worke the earth of which he was taken.
label: Genesis

text: And he caſt out Adam: and placed before the paradiſe of pleaſure Cherubins, & a flaming, and a turning ſworde, for to keepe the way of the tree of life.
label: Genesis

text: AND Adam knewe Eue his wife: who conceiued and brought forth Cain, ſaying: I haue gotten a man through God.
label: Genesis

text: And againe she brought forth his brother Abel. And Abel was a shepehard, & Cain a huſbandman.
label: Genesis

text: And it befel after manie dayes that Cain offred of the fruites of the earth giftes to our Lord.
label: Genesis

text: Abel alſo offred of the firſt begotten of his flocke, and of their fat: and our Lord had reſpect to Abel, & to his giftes.
label: Genesis

text: But to Cain, and to his giftes he had not reſpect: & Cain was exceeding angrie, and his countenance abated.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord ſaid to him: Why art thou angrie? and why is thy countinance fallen?
label: Genesis

text: If thou doe wel, shalt thou not receiue againe: but if thou doeſt il, shal not thy ſinne forthwith be preſent at the dore? but the luſt therof shal be vnder thee, and thou shalt haue dominion ouer it.
label: Genesis

text: And Caine ſaid to Abel his brother: Let vs goe forth abroad. And when they were in the filde, Caine roſe vp againſt his brother Abel, and ſlewe him.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord ſaid to Cain: Where is Abel thy brother? who anſwered: I know not: am I my brothers keper?
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid to him: What haſt thou done? the voice of thy brothers bloud crieth to me out of the earth.
label: Genesis

text: Now therfore curſed shalt thou be vpon the earth, which hath opened her mouth, & receiued the bloud of thy brother at thy hand.
label: Genesis

text: When thou shalt til it, it shal not yeld to thee her fruite: a roag and vagabound shalt thou be vpon the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And Cain ſaid to our Lord: Myne iniquitie is greater, then that I may deſerue pardon.
label: Genesis

text: Loe thou doeſt caſt me out this day from the face of the earth, and from thy face shal I be hid, and I shal be a vagabound & fugitiue on the earth: euerie one therfore that findeth me, ſhal kil me.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord ſaid to him: No, it shal not ſo be: but whoſoeuer shal kil Cain, shalbe punished ſeauen fould. And our Lord put a marke on Cain, that whoſoeuer found him should not kil him.
label: Genesis

text: And Cain went forth from the face of our Lord, and dwelt as a fugitiue on the earth at the eaſt ſide of Eden.
label: Genesis

text: And Cain knewe his wife, who conceiued, and brought forth Enoch: And he built a citie, & called the name therof by the name of his ſonne, Enoch.
label: Genesis

text: Moreouer Enoch begat Irad, and Irad begat Mauiael, and Mauiael begat Mathuſael, and Mathuſael begat Lamech.
label: Genesis

text: Who tooke two wiues, the name of the one was Ada, and the name of the other Sella.
label: Genesis

text: And Ada brought forth Iabel, who was the father of them that dwel in tents, and of heardſmen.
label: Genesis

text: And his brothers name was Iubal: he was the father of them that ſing on harpe & organes.
label: Genesis

text: Sella alſo brought forth Tubalcain, who was a hammerer & worker in al worke of braſſe & iron. And the ſiſter of Tubalcain was Noema.
label: Genesis

text: And Lamech ſaid to his wiues Ada and Sella: Heare my voice ye wiues of Lamech, harken to my talke: for I haue ſlaine a man to the wounding of my ſelfe, and a ſtripeling to mine owne drie blowe brewſing.
label: Genesis

text: Seuenfould vengeance shal be taken of Cain: but of Lamech ſeuentie times ſeuen fould.
label: Genesis

text: Adam alſo knewe his wife again: and she brought forth a ſonne, and called his name Seth, ſaying: God hath giuen me other ſeede for Abel, whom Cain ſlewe.
label: Genesis

text: But to Seth alſo was borne a ſonne, whom he called Enos, this man began to inuocate the name of our Lord.
label: Genesis

text: THIS is the booke of the generation of Adam. In the day, when God created man, to the likenes of God made he him.
label: Genesis

text: Male and female created he them; and bleſſed them: and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
label: Genesis

text: And Adam liued a hundred and thirtie yeares; and begat to his owne image and likenes, and called his name Seth.
label: Genesis

text: And the dayes of Adam, after he begat Seth, came to eight hundred yeares: and he begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And al the time that Adam liued, came to nine hundred and thirtie yeares, and he died.
label: Genesis

text: Seth alſo liued a hundred fiue yeares, and begat Enos.
label: Genesis

text: And Seth liued after he begat Enos, eight hundred and ſeuen yeares, and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And al the dayes of Seth came to nine hundred & twelue yeares, and he died.
label: Genesis

text: And Enos liued nintie yeares, and begat Cainan.
label: Genesis

text: After whoſe birth he liued eight hundred & fiftene yeares, and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And al the dayes of Enos came to nine hundred and fiue yeares, and he died.
label: Genesis

text: Cainan alſo liued ſeuentie yeares, & begat Malaleel.
label: Genesis

text: And Cainan liued after he begat Malaleel, eight hundred & fourtie yeares, and begat ſonnes & daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And al the dayes of Cainan came to nine hundred and ten yeares, and he died.
label: Genesis

text: And Malaleel liued ſixtie fiue yeares, and begat Iared.
label: Genesis

text: And Malaleel liued after he begat Iared, eight hundred and thirtie yeares, and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And al the dayes of Malaleel came to eight hundred nyntie fiue yeares, & he died.
label: Genesis

text: And Iared liued a hundred ſixtie two yeares, and begat Enoch.
label: Genesis

text: And Iared liued after he begat Enoch eight hundred yeares, and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And al the dayes of Iared came to nine hundred ſixtie two yeares, & he died.
label: Genesis

text: Moreouer Enoch liued ſixtie fiue yeares, & begat Mathuſala.
label: Genesis

text: And Enoch walked with God: & liued after he begat Mathuſala, three hundred yeares, and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And al the dayes of Enoch came to three hundred ſixtie fiue yeares.
label: Genesis

text: And he walked with God, and was ſeene no more: becauſe God tooke him.
label: Genesis

text: Mathuſala alſo liued a hundred eightie ſeuen yeares, & begat Lamech.
label: Genesis

text: And Mathuſala liued, after he begat Lamech, ſeuen hundred eightie two yeares, and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And al the dayes of Mathuſala came to nyne hundred ſixtie nine yeares, & he died.
label: Genesis

text: And Lamech liued a hundred eightie two yeares, and begat a ſonne:
label: Genesis

text: and he called his name Noe, ſaying: This ſonne shal comfort vs from the workes & labours of our handes on the earth, which our Lord curſed.
label: Genesis

text: And Lamech liued, after he begat Noe, fiue hundred nintie fiue yeares, and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And al the dayes of Lamech came to ſeuen hundred ſeuentie ſeuen yeares, and he died. And ª Noe when he was fiue hundred yeares olde, begat Sem, Cham, and Iaphat.
label: Genesis

text: AND after that men began to be multiplied vpon the earth, & had procreation of daughters:
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of God ſeing the daughters of men, that they were faire, tooke to them ſelues wiues out of al, which they had choſen.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſaid: My ſpirit shal not remaine in man for euer, becauſe he is flesh: & his dayes shal be an hũdred & twentie yeares.
label: Genesis

text: And Giants were vpon the earth in thoſe dayes. For after the ſonnes of God did companie with the daughters of men, and they brought forth children, theſe be the mightie of the olde world, famous men.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſeing the malice of men was much on the earth, and that al the cogitation of their hart was bent to euil at al times,
label: Genesis

text: it repented him that he had made man on the earth. And touched inwardly with ſorrowe of hart,
label: Genesis

text: I wil, ſaith he, cleane take away man, whom I haue created, from the face of the earth, from man euen to beaſtes, from that which creepeth euen vnto the foules of the ayre. for it repenteth me that I haue made them.
label: Genesis

text: But Noe found grace before our Lord.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe are the generations of Noe: Noe was a iuſt and perfect man in his generations, he did walke with God.
label: Genesis

text: And he begat three ſonnes, Sem, Cham, & Iapheth.
label: Genesis

text: And the earth was corrupted before God, and was replenished with iniquitie.
label: Genesis

text: And when God had perceiued that the earth was corrupted (for al flesh had corrupted his way vpon the earth)
label: Genesis

text: he ſaid to Noe: The end of al flesh is come before me, the earth is replenished with iniquitie from the face of them, & I wil deſtroy them with the earth.
label: Genesis

text: Make thee an arke of timber planke: cabinets ſhalt thou make in the arke, and ſhalt pitch it within, and without with bitume.
label: Genesis

text: And thus shalt thou make it. The length of the Arke shal be three hundred cubitts: fiftie cubitts the breadth, and thirtie cubitts the height of it.
label: Genesis

text: Thou shalt make a windowe in the arke, and in a cubit finish the toppe of it: and the dore of the arke thou shalt ſet at the ſide belowe, middle chambers, and third loftes shalt thou make in it.
label: Genesis

text: Behold I wil bring the waters of a great floud vpon the earth, that I may deſtroy al flesh, wherin there is breath of life vnder heauen. Al thinges that are in the earth, shal be conſumed.
label: Genesis

text: And I wil eſtablish my couenant with thee: and thou shalt enter into the arke, thou and thy ſonnes, and thy wife, and the wiues of thy ſonnes with thee.
label: Genesis

text: And of al liuing creatures of al flesh, thou shalt bring payres into the arke, that they may liue with thee: of the male ſexe, and the female.
label: Genesis

text: Of foules according to their kind, and of beaſtes in their kind, & of al that creepeth on the earth according to their kind: payres of al ſortes shal enter in with thee, that they may liue.
label: Genesis

text: Thou shalt take therfore with thee of al meates, that may be eaten, and thou ſhalt lay them vp with thee: and they ſhal be meate for thee and them.
label: Genesis

text: Noe therfore did al thinges, which God commanded him.
label: Genesis

text: AND our Lord ſaid to him: Get thee in, thou and al thy houſe into the arke: for I haue ſene thee iuſt in my ſight in this generation.
label: Genesis

text: Of al beaſts that are cleane, thou shalt take ſeauen, and ſeauen, male & female:
label: Genesis

text: but of the beaſts that are vncleane two and two, male & female. Yea and of the foules alſo of the ayre ſeauen & ſeauen, male and female: that ſeede may be ſaued vpon the face of the whole earth.
label: Genesis

text: For yet a while, and after ſeauen dayes, I wil rayne vpon the earth fourtie dayes and fourtie nights: and I wil cleane deſtroy al ſubſtance, that I haue made, from the face of the earth.
label: Genesis

text: Noe therfore did al thinges, which our Lord had commanded him.
label: Genesis

text: And he was ſix hundred yeares old, when the waters of the floud flowed ouer the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And Noe entred and his ſonnes, his wife and the wiues of of his ſonnes with him into the arke, becauſe of the waters of the floud.
label: Genesis

text: Of beaſts alſo the cleane and the vncleane, & of foules, and of al that moueth vpon the earth,
label: Genesis

text: two & two went to Noe into the arke, male and female, as our Lord had commanded Noe.
label: Genesis

text: And after the ſeauen dayes were paſſed, the waters of the floud flowed ouer the earth.
label: Genesis

text: In the ſix hundred yeare of the life of Noe, in the ſecond moneth, in the ſeauententh day of the moneth, al the fountaines of the greate deapth were broken vp, and the floudgates of heauen were opened:
label: Genesis

text: and the raine fel vpon the earth fourtie dayes and fourtie nights.
label: Genesis

text: In the verie point of that day entred Noe, and Sem, and Cham, & Iapheth his ſonnes: and his wife, and the three wiues of his ſonnes with them into the arke:
label: Genesis

text: they and euerie beaſt according to their kind, and al cattle in their kinde, and al that moueth vpon the earth according to their kind, and al foule according to their kind, al birds, and al that fly
label: Genesis

text: went to Noe into the arke, two and two of al flesh, wherin there was breath of life.
label: Genesis

text: And ſuch as entred in, male and female of al flesh did enter in, as God had commanded him: and our Lord ſhut him in on the out ſide.
label: Genesis

text: And the floud grew fourtie daies vpon the earth: and the waters increaſed, and lifted vp the arke on high from the earth.
label: Genesis

text: For they ouerflowed excedingly: and filled al on the face of the earth: moreouer the arke fleeted vpon the waters.
label: Genesis

text: And the waters preuailed out of meaſure vpon the earth: and al the hiegh mountaines vnder the whole heauen were couered.
label: Genesis

text: Fiftene cubites higher was the water aboue the mountaines, which it couered.
label: Genesis

text: And al flesh was conſumed that moued vpon the earth, of foule, of cattle, of beaſts, and of al creepers, that creepe vpon the earth: al men,
label: Genesis

text: and al things, wherin there is breath of life on the earth, died.
label: Genesis

text: And he cleane deſtroied al ſubſtance, that was vpon the earth, from man euen to beaſt, as wel it that creepeth, as the foules of the ayre: and they were deſtroied from of the earth: but onlie Noe remained, and they that were with him in the arke.
label: Genesis

text: And the waters held on aboue the earth an hundred fiftie dayes.
label: Genesis

text: AND God remembred Noe, and al the beaſts, and al the cattle, which were with him in the arke, and brought a winde vpon the earth, and the waters decreaſed.
label: Genesis

text: And the fountaines of the depth, and the floud gates of heauen, were shut vp: and the rayne from heauen was ſtayd.
label: Genesis

text: And the waters returned from the earth going & comming: and they begane to decreaſe after a hundred fiftie dayes.
label: Genesis

text: And the arke reſted the ſeauenth moneth, the ſeauen & twentith day of the moneth vpon the mountaines of Armenia.
label: Genesis

text: But the waters for al that were going and decreaſing vntil the tenth moneth: for in the tenth moneth, the firſt day of the moneth, the topps of the mountaines appeared.
label: Genesis

text: And after that fourtie dayes were paſſed, Noe opening the windowe of the arke, which he had made, let forth a crowe:
label: Genesis

text: which went forth, and did not returne, til the waters were dried vpon the earth.
label: Genesis

text: He ſent forth alſo a doue after him, to ſee if the waters were ceaſed yet vpon the face of the earth.
label: Genesis

text: Which finding not where her foote might reſt, returned to him into the arke: for the waters were vpon the whole earth: and he ſtretched forth his hand, and caught her, and brought her into the arke.
label: Genesis

text: And hauing expected yet ſeauen moe dayes, againe he let forth a doue out of the arke.
label: Genesis

text: But she came to him at euentide, carrying a bough of an oliue tree, that had greene leaues in her mouth. Noe therfore vnderſtood that the waters were ceaſed vpon the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And he expected yet neuertheles other ſeauen dayes: and he ſent forth a doue, which returned not any more vnto him.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore in the ſixt hundred and one yeare, the firſt moneth, the firſt day of the moneth the waters were cleane diminished vpon the earth: and Noe opening the roofe of the arke, looked, and ſawe that the face of the earth was dried.
label: Genesis

text: In the ſecond moneth, the ſeuen & twentyth day of the moneth the earth was dried.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſpake to Noe, ſaying:
label: Genesis

text: Goe forth of the arke, thou & thy wife, thy ſonnes and the wiues of thy ſonnes with thee.
label: Genesis

text: Al cattle, that are with thee of al flesh, as wel in foules, as in beaſtes, & al creepers, that creepe vpon the earth, bring out with thee, & goe yee vpon the earth: increaſe and multiplie vpon it.
label: Genesis

text: Noe therfore went forth, and his ſonnes: his wife, and the wiues of his ſonnes with him.
label: Genesis

text: Yea and al cattle, beaſtes, and creepers that crepe vpon the earth, according to their kinde, went forth out of the arke.
label: Genesis

text: And Noe built an Altar to our Lord: and taking of al cattle and foules that were cleane, offered Holocauſts vpon the Altar.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord ſmelled a ſweete ſauour, and ſaid: I wil no more curſe the earth for men: for the ſenſe and cogitation of mans hart are prone to euil from their youth: I wil no more therfore ſtrike euerie liuing ſoule as I haue done.
label: Genesis

text: Al the dayes of the earth, ſeedtime and harueſt, cold and heate, ſommer and winter, night and day ſhal not reſt.
label: Genesis

text: AND God bleſſed Noe and his ſonnes. And he ſaid to them: Increaſe, & multiplie, and replenish the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And your terror and dread be it vpon al the beaſts of the earth, and vpon al the foules of the ayre, with al that moue vpon the earth: al the fishes of the ſea are deliuered to your hand.
label: Genesis

text: And al that moueth, and liueth shal be yours for meat: euen as the grene herbes haue I deliuered al to you.
label: Genesis

text: Sauing that flesh with bloud you shal not eate.
label: Genesis

text: For I wil require the bloud of your ſoules at the hands of al beaſts: and at the hand of man, at the hand of eech man, and of his brother, wil I require the ſoule of man.
label: Genesis

text: Who ſoeuer shal ſheed mans bloud, his bloud shal be shed: for to the image of God man was made.
label: Genesis

text: But increaſe you and multiplie, and goe vpon the earth, and fil it.
label: Genesis

text: Thus alſo ſaid God to Noe, and to his ſonnes with him:
label: Genesis

text: Behold I wil eſtablish my couenant with you, and with your ſeede after you:
label: Genesis

text: and with euerie liuing ſoule, that is with you, as wel in al foules as in cattle & beaſts of the earth that are come forth out of the arke, and in al beaſts of the earth.
label: Genesis

text: I wil eſtablish my couenant with you, and al flesh ſhal be no more deſtroyed with the waters of a floud, neither shal there be from henceforth a floud to waſt the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſaid: This is the ſigne of the couenant which I geue betwen me and you, and betwen euerie liuing ſoule, that is with you, for perpetual generations:
label: Genesis

text: my bowe wil I ſet in the clouds, and it shal be the ſigne of a couenant betwen me and betwen the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And when I shal couer the element with cloudes, my bowe shal appeare in the cloudes:
label: Genesis

text: and I shal remember my couenant with you, and with euerie liuing ſoule that beareth flesh: and there ſhal no more be waters of a floud, to diſtroy al flesh.
label: Genesis

text: And my bowe shal be in the cloudes, and I shal ſee it, and I shal remember the euerlaſting couenant, that was made betwen God and euerie liuing ſoule of al flesh which is vpon the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſaid to Noe: This shal be the ſigne of the couenant, which I eſtablished, betwen me & al flesh of the earth.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes therfore of Noe, that came out of the arke, were Sem, Cham, and Iaphet: and Cham he is the father of Chanaan.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe three are the ſonnes of Noe: and of theſe was al mankind ſpred ouer the whole earth.
label: Genesis

text: And Noe a huſbandman began to til the grounde, and planted a vineyard.
label: Genesis

text: And drinking of the wine was made drunke, and naked in his tabernacle.
label: Genesis

text: Which when Cham the father of Chanaan, had ſeene, to wit that his fathers priuities were bare, he told it to his two bretheren abroad.
label: Genesis

text: But in dede Sem and Iapheth put a cloake vpon their shoulders, and going backward, couered the priuities of their father: and their faces were turned away, and they ſawe not their fathers priuities.
label: Genesis

text: And Noe awaking from the wine, when he had learned what his younger ſonne had done to him,
label: Genesis

text: he ſaid: Curſed be Chanaan, a ſeruant of ſeruantes shal he be vnto his bretheren.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid: Bleſſed be the Lord God of Sem, Chanaan be his ſeruant.
label: Genesis

text: God enlarge Iapheth, and dwel he in the tabernacles of Sem, and Chanaan be his ſeruant.
label: Genesis

text: And Noe liued after the floud three hundred fiftie yeares.
label: Genesis

text: And al his dayes were in the whole nyne hundred fiftie yeares: and he died.
label: Genesis

text: THESE are the generations of the ſonnes of Noe, Sem, Cham, and Iapheth: and children were borne to them after the floud.
label: Genesis

text: The children of Iapheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Iauan, and Thubal, and Moſoch, and Thiras.
label: Genesis

text: Moreouer the children of Gomer: Aſcenez and Riphath and Thogorma.
label: Genesis

text: And the ſonnes of Iauan: Eliſa and Tharſis, the Cetims and the Dodanims.
label: Genesis

text: Of theſe were diuided the Iles of Nations in their countries, ech one according to his tongue and their families in their nations.
label: Genesis

text: And the ſonnes of Cham: Chus, and Meſraim, and Phut, and Chanaan.
label: Genesis

text: And the ſonnes of Chus: Saba, and Heuila, & Sabatha, and Regma, & Sabathaca. The ſonnes of Regma: Saba, and Dadan.
label: Genesis

text: Moreouer Chus begat Nemrod: he began to be mightie in the earth,
label: Genesis

text: and he was a valiaunt hunter before our Lord. Therof roſe a prouerbe: As it were Nemrod the valiaunt hunter before our Lord.
label: Genesis

text: And the beginning of his kingdome was Babylon, and Arach, and Achad, and Chalanne in the land of Sennaar.
label: Genesis

text: Out of that land came forth Aſſur, and builded Niniue, and the ſtreets of the citie, and Chale.
label: Genesis

text: Reſen alſo betwen Niniue and Chale: this is the great citie.
label: Genesis

text: But Meſraim alſo begat the Ludims, & the Anamims, & the Laabims, the Nephthuims,
label: Genesis

text: and the Phetruſims, and the Caſluims: of whom came forth the Philiſtims & the Caphtorims.
label: Genesis

text: And Canaan begat Sidon his firſt begotten, Hethæus,
label: Genesis

text: and Iebuſæus, and Amorrhæus, and Gergeſæus,
label: Genesis

text: Heuæus and Aracæus: Sinæus,
label: Genesis

text: and Aradius, Samaræus, and Hamathæus: and afterwardes were ſpred the people of the Chananits.
label: Genesis

text: And the limitts of Chanaan were from Sidon as we come to Gerara euen to Gaza, vntil thou enter to Sodoma & Gomorrha, and Adama, & Seboim euen to Leſa.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe are the children of Cham in their kinreds, and tongues, and generations & lands, and nations.
label: Genesis

text: Of Sem alſo father of al the children of Herber, the elder brother of Iapheth were borne.
label: Genesis

text: The children of Sem: Ælam and Aſſur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
label: Genesis

text: The children of Aram: Vs, and Hul, and Gether, and Mes.
label: Genesis

text: And Arphaxad alſo begat Sale, of whom was borne Heber.
label: Genesis

text: And to Heber were borne two ſonnes: the name of the one was Phaleg, becauſe that in his dayes was the earth diuided: and his brothers name was Iectan.
label: Genesis

text: The which Iectan begat Elmodad and Saleph, and Aſarmoth, Iare,
label: Genesis

text: and Aduram, and Vzal, and Decla,
label: Genesis

text: and Ebal, and Abimael, Saba,
label: Genesis

text: and Ophir, and Heuila, and Iobab. al theſe were the children of Iectan.
label: Genesis

text: And their dwelling was from Meſſa as we goe on as far as Sephar a mountaine in the eaſt.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe are the children of Sem according to their kinred and tongues, and countries in their nations.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe are the families of Noe, according to their peoples & nations. Of theſe were the nations diuided on the earth after the floud.
label: Genesis

text: AND the earth was of one tongue, and al one ſpeach.
label: Genesis

text: And when they remoued from the eaſt, they found a plaine in the land of Sennaar, and dwelt in it.
label: Genesis

text: And eech one ſaid to his neighboure: Come, let vs make bricke, and bake them with fire. And they had bricke in ſteed of ſtone, and bitume in ſteed of morter:
label: Genesis

text: and they ſaid: Come, let vs make vs a citie and a towre, the toppe wherof may reach to heauen: and let vs renowne our name before we be diſperſed into al lands.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord deſcended to ſee the citie and the towre, which the children of Adam builded,
label: Genesis

text: and he ſaid: Behold, it is one people, and one tongue is to al: and they haue begunne to doe this, neyther wil they leaue of from their determinations, til they accomplish them indede.
label: Genesis

text: Come ye therfore, let vs goe downe, and there confound their tongue, that none may heare is neighbours voice.
label: Genesis

text: And ſo our Lord diſperſed them from that place into al lands, and they ceaſed to build the citie.
label: Genesis

text: And therfore the name therof was called Babel, becauſe there the tongue of the whole earth was confounded: and from thence our Lord diſperſed them vpon the face of al countries.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe are the generations of Sem: Sem was an hundred yeares old when he begat Arphaxad, two yeares after the floud.
label: Genesis

text: And Sem liued after he begat Arphaxad, fiue hundred yeares: and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: Moreouer Arphaxad liued thirtie fiue yeares, and begat Sale.
label: Genesis

text: And Arphaxad liued after he begat Sale, three hundred three yeares: and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: Sale alſo liued thirtie yeares, and begat Heber.
label: Genesis

text: And Sale liued after he begat Heber, foure hundred three yeares: and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And Heber liued thirtie foure yeares, and begat Phaleg.
label: Genesis

text: And Heber liued after he begat Phaleg, foure hundred thirtie yeares: and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: Phaleg alſo liued thirtie yeares, and begat Reu.
label: Genesis

text: And Phaleg liued after he begat Reu, two hundred nine yeares, and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And Reu liued thirtie two yeares, and begat Sarug.
label: Genesis

text: Reu liued alſo after he begat Sarug, two hundred ſeauen yeares: and begat ſonnes & daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And Sarug liued thirtie yeares, and begat Nachor.
label: Genesis

text: And Sarug liued after he begat Nachor, two hundred yeares: and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And Nachor liued nine and twentie yeares, and begat Thare.
label: Genesis

text: And Nachor liued after he begot Thare, an hundred and nintene yeares: and begat ſonnes and daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And Thare liued ſeauentie yeares, and begat Abram, and Nachor, and Aran.
label: Genesis

text: And theſe are the generations of Thare: Thare begat Abram, Nachor, & Aran. Moreouer Aran begat Lot.
label: Genesis

text: And Aran died before Thare his father, in the land of his natiuitie in Vr of the Chaldees.
label: Genesis

text: And Abram & Nachor maried wiues: the name of Abram his wife was Sarai: and the name of Nachor his Wife, Melcha the daughter of Aran the father of Melcha, and the father of Ieſcha.
label: Genesis

text: And Sarai was barren, neither had she children.
label: Genesis

text: Thare therfore tooke Abram his ſonne, and Lot the ſonne of Aran, his ſonnes ſonne, & Sarai his daughter in law, the wife of Abram his ſonne, and brought them out of Vr of the Chaldees, for to goe into the land of Chanaan: and they came as farre as Haran, and dwelled there.
label: Genesis

text: And the dayes of Thare came to two hundred fiue yeares, and died in Haran.
label: Genesis

text: AND our Lord ſaid to Abram: Goe forth of thy countrie, and out of thy kinred, and out of thy fathers houſe, and come into a land, which I wil shew thee.
label: Genesis

text: And I wil make thee into a great nation, and I wil bleſſe thee, and magnifie thy name, and thou shalt be bleſſed.
label: Genesis

text: I wil bleſſe them and bleſſe thee, and curſſe them that curſſe thee, and IN THEE ſhal al the kindreds of the earth be bleſſed.
label: Genesis

text: Abram therfore went out as our Lord had commanded him, and with him went Lot: ſeauentie fiue yeares old was Abram when he went forth out of Haran.
label: Genesis

text: And he tooke Sarai his wife, and Lot his brothers ſonne, and al the ſubſtance which they had poſſeſſed, and the ſoules which they had gotten in Haran: and went forth to goe into the land of Chanaan. And when they were come into it,
label: Genesis

text: Abram paſſed through the countrie vnto the place Sichem, as farre as the noble vale: and the Cananite was at that time in the countrie.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord appeared to Abram, and ſaid to him: To thy ſeed wil I giue this land. Who builded there an altar to our Lord, that had appeared to him.
label: Genesis

text: And marching on from thence to a mountaine, that was on the eaſt ſide of Bethel, there he pitched his tent, hauing Bethel on the weſt, and Hay on the eaſt: he builded there alſo an altar to our Lord, and called vpon his name.
label: Genesis

text: And Abram went forward going, and proceding on to the ſouth.
label: Genesis

text: And there came a famine in the countrie: and Abram deſcended into Ægypt, to be as a pilgrime there: for the famine was very ſore in the land.
label: Genesis

text: And when he was nere to enter into Ægypt, he ſaid to Sarai his wife: I know that thou art a fayre woman:
label: Genesis

text: and that when the Ægyptians shal ſee thee, they wil ſay: She is his wife: and they wil til me, and reſerue thee.
label: Genesis

text: Say therfore, I pray thee, that thou art my ſiſter: that I may be wel vſed for thee, and that my ſoule may liue for thy ſake.
label: Genesis

text: When Abram therfore was entred into Ægypt, the Ægiptians ſawe the woman that she was paſſing beautiful.
label: Genesis

text: And the princes told Pharao, and praiſed her to him: and the woman was taken into the houſe of Pharao.
label: Genesis

text: And they vſed Abram wel for her ſake. And he had ſheepe and oxen and he aſſes, and men ſeruants, and maid ſeruants, and shee aſſes, and Cammels.
label: Genesis

text: But our Lord ſcourged Pharao with very ſore plagues, and his houſe for Sarai Abrams wife.
label: Genesis

text: And Pharao called Abram, and ſaid to him: What is this that thou haſt done to me? Why didſt thou not tel me that she was thy wife?
label: Genesis

text: For what cauſe didſt thou ſay, she was thy ſiſter, that I might take her to my wife? Now therfore there is thy wife, take her, and goe thy ways.
label: Genesis

text: And Pharao gaue certaine men commandment in the behalfe of Abram: and they conducted him, and his wife, and al that he had.
label: Genesis

text: ABRAM therfore aſcended out of Ægypt, he and his wife, and al that he had, and Lot with him to the ſouth coaſt.
label: Genesis

text: And he was very rich in poſſeſſion of gold and ſiluer.
label: Genesis

text: And he returned by the way, that he came, from the ſouth vnto Bethel, euen to the place where before he had pitched a tabernacle betwen Bethel and Hay:
label: Genesis

text: in the place of the altar which he had made before, and there he called vpon the name of our Lord.
label: Genesis

text: But Lot alſo that was with Abram, had flocks of sheepe, and heards of beaſts, and tents.
label: Genesis

text: Neyther was the land able to receiue them, for to dwel togeather: for their ſubſtance was much, and they could not dwel togeather.
label: Genesis

text: Wherupon alſo there aroſe ſtrife amongſt the heardſmen of Abram and of Lot. And that time the Chananite and the Pheriſite dwelled in that countrie.
label: Genesis

text: Abram therfore ſaid to Lot: Let there be no brawle I beſeech thee betwen me and thee, and betwen my heardſmen, and thy heardſmen: for we be brethren.
label: Genesis

text: Behold the whole land is before thee: goe aparte from me, I pray thee: if thou wilt goe to the left hand, I wil take the right: if thou chooſe the right hand, I wil paſſe to the left.
label: Genesis

text: Lot therfore lifting vp his eyes, ſawe al the countrie about Iordaine, which was watered through out before that our Lord ſubuerted Sodome and Gomorre, as the paradiſe of our Lord, and like as Ægypt as men come vnto Segor.
label: Genesis

text: And Lot choſe vnto him the countrie about Iordaine, and he departed from the Eaſt: and they were ſeperated either brother from the other.
label: Genesis

text: Abram dwelt in the land of Chanaan: and Lot abode in the townes, that were about Iordaine, and dwelt in Sodome.
label: Genesis

text: And the men of Sodome were verie wicked, and ſinners before the face of our Lord out of meaſure.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord ſaid to Abram, after that Lot was ſeperated from him: Lyft vp thyn eyes, and looke from the place, wherin thou now art, to the north and ſouth, to the eaſt and weſt.
label: Genesis

text: Al the land, which thou ſeeſt, wil I geue to thee, & to thy ſeed for euer.
label: Genesis

text: And I wil make thy ſeede as the duſt of the earth: if any man be able to number the duſt of the earth, thy ſeede alſo shal he be able to number.
label: Genesis

text: Ariſe and walke through the land in the length, and in the breath therof: for I wil geue it to thee.
label: Genesis

text: Abram therfore remouing his tent, came, and dwelt beſide the vale of Mambre, which is in Hebron: and he builded there an altar to our Lord.
label: Genesis

text: AND it came to paſſe in that time, that Amraphel the king of Sennaar, and Arioch the king of Pontus, and Chodorlahomor king of the Elamyts, and Thadal the king of nacions
label: Genesis

text: made warre againſt Barra the king of Sodome, and againſt Berſa the king of Gomorra, and againſt Sennaab the king of Adama, and againſt Semebar the king of Seboim, and againſt the king of Bala, the ſame is Segor.
label: Genesis

text: Al theſe came together into the Woodland vale, which now is the ſalt ſea.
label: Genesis

text: For they had ſerued Chodorlamor twelue yeares, and the thirtenth yeare they reuolted from him.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore in the fourtenth yeare came Chodorlahomor, and the king that were with him: and they ſtroke Raphaim in Aſtarothcarnaim, and Suſim with them, and Emim in Sauee of Cariathaim,
label: Genesis

text: and the Corrheans in the mountains of Seir, euen to the Champion countrie of Pharan, which is in the wildernes.
label: Genesis

text: And they returned, and came as farre as the fountaine of Miſphat, the ſame is Cades: and they ſtroke al the countrie of the Ameleichites, and of the Amorheans, that dwel in Aſſaſonthamar.
label: Genesis

text: And they went forth the king of Sodome, and the king of Gomorra, and the king of Adama, and the king of Seboim, moreouer alſo the king of Bala, which is Segor: and they ſet themſelues againſt them in battaile aray in the Woodland vale:
label: Genesis

text: to wit againſt Chodorlahomor king of the Elamites, and Chadal king of nacions, and Amraphel king of Sennaar, and Arioch king of Pontus: foure kings againſt fiue.
label: Genesis

text: But the Woodland vale had many pitts of bitume. Therfore the king of Sodome, and of Gomorra turned their backes, and were ouerthrowne there: and they that remained fled to the mountaine.
label: Genesis

text: And they tooke al the ſubſtance of the Sodomites, and Gomorrheans, and tooke al kind of victuales, and went their way:
label: Genesis

text: and Lot alſo and his ſubſtance, the ſonne of Abrams brother, who dwelled in Sodom.
label: Genesis

text: And behold one, that had eſcaped, told Abram the Hebrew, that dwelt in the vale of Mambre, the Amorrean brother of Eſchol, and the brother of Aner: for theſe had made a league with Abram.
label: Genesis

text: Which when Abram had heard, to witt, that his brother Lot was taken, he numbred of the ſeruantes borne in his houſe, wel appointed three hundred and eightene: and purſued them vnto Dan.
label: Genesis

text: And diuiding his companie, he ranne vpon them in the night: and ſtroke them, and purſued them vnto Hoba, which is on the left hand of Damaſcus.
label: Genesis

text: And he brought backe al the ſubſtance, and Lot his brother with his ſubſtance, the wemen alſo and the people.
label: Genesis

text: And the king of Sodom went forth to meete them, after he returned from the ſlaughter of Chodorlahomor, and of the kinges that were with him in the vale Sauee, which is the kings vale.
label: Genesis

text: But Melcheſidech the king of Salem, bringing forth bread and wine, for he was the Prieſt of God moſt highe,
label: Genesis

text: bleſſed him, and ſaid: Bleſſed be Abram to God the higheſt, which created heauen and earth:
label: Genesis

text: and bleſſed be God the higheſt, by whoſe protection, the enemyes are in thy hands. And he gaue him the tythes of al.
label: Genesis

text: And the king of Sodom ſaid to Abram: Geue me the ſoules, and the reſt take to thee.
label: Genesis

text: Who anſwered him: I lift vp my hand to my Lord God moſt hiegh poſſeſſor of heauen and earth,
label: Genesis

text: that from the very woofe-thread vnto the ſhoe latchet, I wil not take of al that are thine: leſt thou ſay: I haue enriched Abram:
label: Genesis

text: except ſuch thinges, as the young men haue eaten, and the shares of the men, that came with me, Aner, Eſchol, and Mambre: theſe shal take their shares.
label: Genesis

text: WHEN theſe things therfore were done, the word of our Lord was made to Abram by a viſion ſaying: Feare not Abram, I am thy protector, & thy reward exceding great.
label: Genesis

text: And Abram ſaid: Lord God, what wilt thou geue me? I shal goe without children: and the ſonne of the ſtuard of my houſe is this Damaſcus Eliezer.
label: Genesis

text: And Abram added: But to me thou haſt not geuen ſeede: and loe my ſeruant borne in my houſe, shal be myn heire.
label: Genesis

text: And immediatly the word of our Lord came to him ſaying: He ſhal not be thy heyre: but he that shal come out of thy wombe, him shalt thou haue thin heire.
label: Genesis

text: And he brought him forth abroad, and ſaid to him: Looke vp to heauen, and number the ſtarres, if thou canſt. And he ſaid to him: So shal thy ſeed be.
label: Genesis

text: Abram beleued God, and it was reputed to him vnto iuſtice.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid to him: I am the Lord that brought thee out from Vr of the Chaldees for to giue thee this land, and that thou mighteſt poſſeſſe it.
label: Genesis

text: But he ſaid: Lord God, how may I know that I shal poſſeſſe it?
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord anſwered, and ſaid: Take me a cowe of three yeares old, and a shee goat of three yeares, and a ramme of three yeares, a turtle alſo, and a pigeon.
label: Genesis

text: Who taking al theſe, diuided them by the mydes, and laid ech two peeces arowe one againſt the other: but the birdes he diuided not.
label: Genesis

text: And the foules lighted vpon the carcaſſes, and Abram droue them away.
label: Genesis

text: And when the ſunne was ſetting, a deepe ſleepe fel vpon Abram, and a great and darkeſome horrour inuaded him.
label: Genesis

text: And it was ſaid vnto him: Know and foreknow that a pilgrime shal thy ſeede be in a land not their owne (and they shal bring them vnder bondage, and afflict them) foure hundred yeares.
label: Genesis

text: But the nation, whom they shal ſerue, I wil iudge: and after this they shal goe forth with great ſubſtance.
label: Genesis

text: And thou shalt goe to thy fathers in peace, buried in a good old age.
label: Genesis

text: But in the fourth generation they shal returne hither: for as yet the iniquities of the Amorrheanes are not at the ful vntil this preſent time.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore when the ſunne was ſet, there aroſe a darke miſt, and there appeared a fornace ſmoking, and a flake of fire paſſing betwene thoſe diuiſions.
label: Genesis

text: That day God made a couenant with Abram, ſaying: To thy ſeede wil I geue this land from the riuer of Ægypt euen to the great riuer Euphrates,
label: Genesis

text: the Cineans, & Cenezites, the Cedmonites,
label: Genesis

text: and the Hethits, and the Pherezits, the Raphaims alſo,
label: Genesis

text: and the Amorreans & the Cananites, and the Gargaſites, and the Iebuſites.
label: Genesis

text: SARAI therfore, the wife of Abram, had brought forth no children: but hauing an handmaid an Ægyptian named Agar,
label: Genesis

text: she ſaid to her huſband: Behold, our Lord hath cloſed me, that I might not beare: Goe in vnto my handmaid, if happely of her at the leaſt I may haue children. And when he agreed to her in this requeſt,
label: Genesis

text: she toke Agar the Ægyptian her handmaid tenne yeares after that they firſt dwelled in the land of Chanaan: and gaue her vnto her huſband to wife.
label: Genesis

text: Who did companie with her, but she perceauing that she was with childe, deſpiſed her miſtreſſe.
label: Genesis

text: And Sarai ſaid to Abram: Thou doeſt vniuſtly againſt me: I gaue my handmaid into thy boſome, who perceauing herſelf to be with child, deſpiſeth me. Our Lord iudge betwen me and thee.
label: Genesis

text: To whom Abram making anſwere: Behold, ſaith he, thy handmaid is in thine owne hand, vſe her as it pleaſeth thee. When Sarai therfore did afflict her, she ranne away.
label: Genesis

text: And an angel of our Lord hauing found her, beſide a fountaine of water in the wilderneſſe, which is in the way to Sur in the deſert,
label: Genesis

text: he ſaid to her: Agar, the handmaid of Sarai, whence comeſt thou? and whither goeſt thou? who anſwered: From the face of Sarai my miſtreſſe doe I flye.
label: Genesis

text: And the angel of our Lord ſaid to her: Returne to thy miſtreſſe, and humble thy ſelfe vnder her hand.
label: Genesis

text: And again: Multiplying, ſayth he, wil I multiplie thy ſeed, and it shal not be numbred for the multitude therof.
label: Genesis

text: And againe after that: Behold, ſaith he, thou art with child, and thou shalt bring forth a ſonne: and thou shalt cal his name Iſmael, becauſe the Lord hath heard thin affliction.
label: Genesis

text: He shal be a wild man: his hand shal be againſt al men, and al mens hands againſt him: and ouer againſt al his bretheren shal he pitch his tents.
label: Genesis

text: And she called the name of our Lord that ſpake vnto her: Thou the God which haſt ſene me. For she ſaid: verily here haue I ſene the backe partes of him that hath ſene me.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore she called that wel, the Wel of him that liueth and ſeeth me. The ſame is betwen Cadeſſe, and Barad.
label: Genesis

text: And Agar brought forth a ſonne to Abram: who called his name Iſmael.
label: Genesis

text: Eightie and ſixe yeares old was Abram when Agar brought him forth Iſmael.
label: Genesis

text: AND after that he beganne to be nyntie and nyne yeares old, our Lord appeared vnto him: and ſaid vnto him: I am the God almightie: walke before me, and be perfect.
label: Genesis

text: And I wil make my couenant betwen me and thee: and I wil multiplie thee exceadingly.
label: Genesis

text: Abram fel flat on his face.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſaid to him: I am, and my couenant is with thee, & thou shalt be a father of manie nations.
label: Genesis

text: Neyther shal thy name be called any more Abram: but thou shalt be called Abraham: becauſe a father of many nations I haue made thee.
label: Genesis

text: And I wil make thee encreaſe excedingly, and I wil make thee into nations, and kinges shal come forth of thee.
label: Genesis

text: And I wil eſtablish my couenant betwen me and thee, and betwen thy ſeede after thee in their generations by a perpetual couenant: to be thy God, and thy ſedes after thee.
label: Genesis

text: And I wil geue to thee, and to thy ſeed the land of thy peregrination, al the land of Chanaan for a perpetual poſſeſſion, and I wil be their God.
label: Genesis

text: Againe God ſaid to Abraham: And thou therfore shalt keepe my couenant, and thy ſeed after thee in their generations.
label: Genesis

text: This is my couenant which you shal obſerue betwen me and you, and thy ſeede after thee: Al the malekind of you shal be circumciſed:
label: Genesis

text: and you shal circumciſe the flesh of your prepuce, that it may be for a ſigne of the couenant betwen me and you.
label: Genesis

text: An infant of eight daies shalbe circumciſed among you, al malekind in your generations: aſwel the homebred shal be circumciſed, as the bought ſeruant of whoſoeuer he is, not of your ſtocke:
label: Genesis

text: and my couenant shal be in your flesh for a perpetual couenant.
label: Genesis

text: The male, whoſe flesh of his prepuce shal not be circumciſed, that ſoule shalbe deſtroied out of his people: becauſe he hath broken my couenant.
label: Genesis

text: God ſaid alſo to Abraham: Sarai thy wife thou shalt not cal Sarai, but Sara.
label: Genesis

text: And I wil bleſſe her, and of her I wil giue thee a ſonne, whom I wil bleſſe, and he shalbe into nations, and kings of peoples shal ſpring of him.
label: Genesis

text: Abraham fel vpon his face, & laughed, ſaying in his hart: Shal troweſt thou to him that is an hundred yeare old a ſonne be borne? and Sara that is nyntie yeares old shal she beare?
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid to God: I would that Iſmael may liue before thee.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſaid to Abraham: Sara thy wife shal beare thee a ſonne, and thou shalt cal his name Iſaac, and I wil eſtablish my couenant to him for a perpetual couenant, and to his ſeed after him.
label: Genesis

text: Concerning Iſmael alſo I haue heard thee. behold, I wil bleſſe him, and encreaſe, and multiplie him exceadingly: twelue dukes shal he beget, and I wil make him into a great nation.
label: Genesis

text: But my couenant I wil eſtablish with Iſaac, whom Sara shal bring forth to thee at this time an other yeare.
label: Genesis

text: And when he had leaft of ſpeaking with him, God aſcended from Abraham.
label: Genesis

text: And Abraham tooke Iſmael his ſonne, and al the homebred of his houſe: and al whom he had bought, al the males of al the men of his houſe: and he circumciſed the flesh of their prepuce forthwith the very ſame day, as God had commanded him.
label: Genesis

text: Abraham was nyntie and nyne yeares old, when he circumciſed the flesh of his prepuce.
label: Genesis

text: And Iſmael his ſonne was ful thirtene yeares old at the time of his circumciſion.
label: Genesis

text: The ſelfſame day was Abraham circumciſed and Iſmael his ſonne.
label: Genesis

text: And al the men of his houſe, as wel the homebred, as the bought ſeruantes and ſtrangers were circumciſed togeather.
label: Genesis

text: AND God appeared to him in the vale of mambre as he ſat in the dore of his tent, in the verie heat of the day.
label: Genesis

text: And when he had lifted vp his eyes, there appeared to him three men ſtanding nere vnto him: whom after he had ſene, he ranne to meete them from the dore of his tent, and adored to the ground.
label: Genesis

text: And He ſaid Lord, if I haue found grace in thy ſight, goe not paſt thy ſeruant:
label: Genesis

text: but I wil fetch a little water, and wash ye your feete, and reſt ye vnder the tree.
label: Genesis

text: And I wil ſet a morſel of bread, and ſtrengthen your hart, afterward you ſhal paſſe: for therfore are you come aſide to your ſeruāt. Who ſaid: Do as thou haſt ſpoken:
label: Genesis

text: Abraham made haſt into the tent to Sara, and ſaid to her: Make haſt, temper togeather three meaſures of floure, and make harth cakes.
label: Genesis

text: But him ſelfe ranne to the heard, and tooke from thence a calfe verie tender and verie good, and gaue it to a young man: who made haſt and boiled it.
label: Genesis

text: He tooke alſo butter and mylke, and the calfe which he had boyled, and ſet before them: but him ſelfe did ſtand beſide them vnder the tree.
label: Genesis

text: And when they had eaten, they ſaid to him: Where is Sara thy wife? He anſwered: Loe she is in the tent.
label: Genesis

text: To whom he ſaid: Returning I wil come to thee at this time, life accompaning, and Sara thy wife ſhal haue a ſonne. Which when Sara heard, she laughed behind the dore of the tent.
label: Genesis

text: And they were both aged, and farre entred in yeares, and it ceaſed to be with Sara after the maner of wemen.
label: Genesis

text: Who laughed ſecreatly ſaying: After I am waxen old, & my Lord is an old one, shal I geue my ſelfe to pleaſure?
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord ſaid to Abraham: Why did Sara laugh, ſaying: Shal I an old woman beare a child in deed?
label: Genesis

text: Is there any thing hard to God? According to appointment I wil returne to thee this verie ſelfe ſame time, life accompaynig, and Sara ſhal haue a ſonne.
label: Genesis

text: Sara denied, ſaying: I laughed not: being much afraid. But our Lord: It is not ſo, ſaith he: but thou didſt laugh.
label: Genesis

text: When the men therfore were riſen vp from thence, they turned their eyes againſt Sodome: and Abraham did goe with them, bringing them on the way.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord ſaid: Can I conceale from Abraham the things which I wil doe:
label: Genesis

text: wheras he shal be into a nation great, and verie ſtrong, and in him are TO BE BLESSED al the nations of the earth?
label: Genesis

text: For I know that he wil commande his children, and his houſe after him that they kepe the way of the Lord, and doe iudgement and iuſtice: that for Abrahams ſake the Lord may bring to effect al the things that he hath ſpoken vnto him. Therfore ſaid our Lord.
label: Genesis

text: The crye of Sodome, and Gomorre is multiplied, and their ſinne is aggrauated excedingly.
label: Genesis

text: I wil deſcend, and ſee whether they haue in acte accomplished the crye that is come to me: or whether it be not ſo, that I may know.
label: Genesis

text: And they turned them ſelues from thence, and went their way to Sodome: but Abraham as yet ſtood before our Lord.
label: Genesis

text: And approching he ſaid: what! wilt thou deſtroy the iuſt with the wicked?
label: Genesis

text: If there ſhalbe fiftie iuſt perſons in the citie, shal they perish withal? and wilt thou ſpare that place for fiftie iuſt, if they be therin?
label: Genesis

text: Be it farre from thee, that thou doe this thing, and that thou kil the iuſt with the wicked, and that the iuſt be in like caſe as the wicked, this is not beſeeming thee: which iudgeſt al the earth, no thou wilt not do this iudgement.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord ſaid to him: If I shal find in Sodome fiftie iuſt perſons within the citie, I wil ſpare the whole place for their ſake.
label: Genesis

text: And Abraham anſwered, and ſaid: Becauſe I haue once begunne, I wil ſpeake to my Lord, wheras I am duſt and ashes.
label: Genesis

text: What if there shal be fiue leſſe then fiftie iuſt perſons? wilt thou for fortie fiue deſtroy the whole citie? And he ſaid: I wil not deſtroy it, if I shal finde fiue and fourtie.
label: Genesis

text: And againe he ſaid vnto him: But if fourtie shalbe found there, what wilt thou doe? He ſaid: I wil not ſtrike it for fourties ſake.
label: Genesis

text: Lord, ſaith he, be not angrie I beſech thee, if I ſpeake: what if thirtie shal be found there? He anſwered: I wil not doe it, if I shal find thirtie there.
label: Genesis

text: Becauſe, ſaith he, I haue once begunne, I wil ſpeake to my Lord: What if twentie shalbe founde there? He ſaid: I wil not deſtroy it for twenties ſake.
label: Genesis

text: I beſeech thee, ſaith he, be not angrie Lord, if I ſpeake yet once more: What if tenne shalbe found there? And he ſaid: I wil not deſtroy it for tennes ſake.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord departed after that he ceaſed to ſpeake vnto Abraham: and Abraham returned into his place.
label: Genesis

text: AND the two angels came to Sodome at euen, and Lot ſitting in the gates of the citie. Who when he had ſene them, roſe vp and went to meete them: and adored proſtrate vnto the ground,
label: Genesis

text: and ſaid: I beſech you, my Lords, turne into the houſe of your ſeruant, and lodge there: wash your feet, and in the morning you shal go forth on your way. Who ſaid: No, but we wil abide in the ſtreat.
label: Genesis

text: He compelled them earneſtly to turne in vnto him: and when they were entred into his houſe, he made them a banquet, and baked vnleauened bread, and they did eate.
label: Genesis

text: And before they went to bed, the men of the citie beſet the houſe from young to old, al the people togeather.
label: Genesis

text: And they called Lot, and ſaid to him: Where are the men that came in to thee at night? bring them forth hither that we may know them.
label: Genesis

text: Lot going forth to them, and shutting the dore after him, ſaid:
label: Genesis

text: Doe not ſo, I beſech you, my brethren, doe not commit this euil.
label: Genesis

text: I haue two daughters, which as yet haue not knowen man: I wil bring them forth to you, and abuſe you them as it shal pleaſe you, ſo that you do no euil to theſe men, becauſe they are entred vnder the shadowe of my roofe.
label: Genesis

text: But they ſaid: Get thee backe thither. And againe: Thou cameſt in, ſaid they, as a ſtranger, what to be a iudge? Thy ſelfe therfore we wil afflict more then theſe. And they did violence to Lot exceadingly: and it was euen nowe at the point that they would break the dores.
label: Genesis

text: And behold the men put forth their hand, and drew in Lot vnto them, and shut the dore:
label: Genesis

text: and them, that were without, they ſtroke with blyndnes from the leaſt to the greateſt, ſo that they could not find the dore.
label: Genesis

text: And they ſaid to Lot: Haſt thou here anie of thine? ſonne in law, or ſonnes, or daughters, al that are thine, bring them out of this citie:
label: Genesis

text: for we wil deſtroy this place, for that their crye is waxen lowde before our Lord, who hath ſent vs to deſtroy them.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore Lot went forth, and ſpake to his ſonnes in lawe that were to take his daughters, and ſaid: Ariſe: get you forth out of this place, becauſe our Lord wil deſtroy this citie. And he ſemed vnto them to ſpeake as it were in ieſt.
label: Genesis

text: And when it was morning, the angels vrged him, ſaying: Ariſe, take thy wife, and the two daughters which thou haſt: leaſt thou alſo perish withal in the wickednes of the citie.
label: Genesis

text: He lingring, they tooke his hand, and the hand of his wife, and of his two daughters, becauſe our Lord ſpared him.
label: Genesis

text: And they led him forth, and ſet him without the citie: and there they ſpake to him, ſaying: Saue thy life: looke not backe, neither ſtay thou in al the countrie about: but ſaue thy ſelfe in the mountaine, leſt thou alſo perish withal.
label: Genesis

text: And Lot ſaid to them: I beſeech thee my Lord,
label: Genesis

text: becauſe thy ſeruant hath fonnd grace before thee, and thou haſt magnified thy mercie, which thou haſt wrought with me, in that thou wouldeſt ſaue my life, and ſafe I can not be in the mountaine, leſt perhaps the euil catch me, and I dye.
label: Genesis

text: There is this citie hereby at hand, wherunto I may flee, a little one, and I ſhalbe ſafe in it: is it not a little one, and my life shalbe ſaued?
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid to him: Behold alſo in this point I haue heard thy prayers, not to ouerthrow the citie for which thou haſt ſpoken.
label: Genesis

text: Make haſt, and be ſaued there: becauſe I can not doe any thing til thou enter in thither. Therfore the name of that citie was called Segor.
label: Genesis

text: The ſunne was riſen vpon the earth, & Lot entred into Segor.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore our Lord rained vpon Sodome and Gomorre brimſtone & fire from our Lord out of heauen:
label: Genesis

text: and he ſubuerted theſe cities, and al the countrie about, al the inhabitants of the cities, and al things that ſpring of the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And his wife looking behind her, was turned into a ſtatua of ſalt.
label: Genesis

text: And Abraham getting vp early in the morning, there where before he had ſtood with our Lord,
label: Genesis

text: beheld Sodome & Gomorre, and the whole land of that countrie: and he ſaw the cinders riſe vp from the earth as it were the ſmoke of a fornace.
label: Genesis

text: For when God ſubuerted the citties of that countrie, he remenbring Abraham, deliuered Lot out of the ſubuerſion of the cities wherein he had dwelt.
label: Genesis

text: And Lot aſcended out of Segor, and abode in the mountaine, his two daughters alſo with him (for he was afraid to abide in Segor) and he abode in a caue him ſelfe, and his two daughters with him.
label: Genesis

text: And the elder ſaid to the younger: Our father is old, and there is no man left on the earth, that may companie with vs after the maner of the whole earth.
label: Genesis

text: Come, let vs make him drunke with wine, and let vs lie with him, that we may preſerue ſeed of our father.
label: Genesis

text: They therfore made their father to drinke wine that night: and the elder went in, and lay with her father: but he perceaued not, neyther when his daughter lay downe, nor when she roſe vp.
label: Genesis

text: The next day alſo the elder ſaid to the younger: Behold I lay yeſternight with my father, let vs make him drinke wine alſo this night, and thou shalt lye with him, that we may ſaue ſeed of our father.
label: Genesis

text: They made their father drinke wine that night alſo, and the younger daughter went in, and lay with him: and neyther then truly did he perceaue when she lay downe, or when ſhe roſe vp.
label: Genesis

text: The two daughters therfore of Lot were with child by their father.
label: Genesis

text: And the elder bare a ſonne and ſhe called his name Moab: he is, the father of the Moabites euen to this preſent day.
label: Genesis

text: The younger alſo bare a ſonne, and ſhe called his name Ammon, that is the ſonne of my people: he is the father of the Ammonites euen to this day.
label: Genesis

text: ABRAHAM remoued from thence into the ſouth countrie, and dwelt betwene Cades, and Sur: and he liued as a pilgrime in Gerara.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid of Sara his wife: She is my ſiſter. Abimelech therfore the king of Gerara ſent, and tooke her.
label: Genesis

text: And God came to Abimelech in a dreame by night, and ſaid to him: Loe thou shalt dye for the woman that thou haſt taken: for she hath a huſband.
label: Genesis

text: But Abimelech had not touched her, and he ſaid: Lord wilt thou kil a nation that is ignorant and iuſt?
label: Genesis

text: Did not he ſay to me: She is my ſiſter: and she ſay, He is my brother? in ſimplicitie of my hart, and cleanenes of my hands haue I done this.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſaid to him: And I do know that thou dideſt it with a ſincere hart: and therfore I kept thee that thou shouldeſt not ſinne againſt me, and I permitted not that thou shouldeſt touch her.
label: Genesis

text: Now therfore reſtore the wife to her huſband, becauſe he is a prophet: and he ſhal pray for thee, and thou ſhalt liue: but if thou wilt not reſtore her, know thou that dying thou shalt dye, thou and al things that are thine.
label: Genesis

text: And Abimelech forthwith riſing vp in the night, called al his ſeruantes: and he ſpake al theſe words to their eares, and al the men were ſore afraid.
label: Genesis

text: And Abimelech called alſo for Abraham, and ſaid to him: What haſt thou done to vs? what haue we offended againſt thee, that thou haſt brought vpon me and vpon my kingdom a great ſinne? that which thou oughteſt not to doe, thou haſt done to vs.
label: Genesis

text: And again expoſtulating, he ſaid: What ſaweſt thou, that thou dideſt this?
label: Genesis

text: Abraham anſwered: I thought with my ſelfe, ſaying: Perhaps there is not the feare of God in this place: and they wil kil me for my wife:
label: Genesis

text: howbeit otherwiſe alſo in verie deed she is my ſiſter, the daughter of my father, and not the daughter of my mother, and I tooke her to wife.
label: Genesis

text: And after that God brought me out of my fathers houſe, I ſaid to her: This mercie thou shalt doe with me: In euerie place, which we shal come vnto, thou shalt ſay that I am thy brother.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore Abimelech tooke ſhepe & oxen, and ſeruants, and handmayds, and gaue to Abraham: and reſtored to him Sara his wife,
label: Genesis

text: and ſaid: The land is before you, dwel wherſoeuer it shal pleaſe thee.
label: Genesis

text: And to Sara he ſaid: Behold I haue geuen thy brother a thouſand peeces of ſiluer, this shal ſerue thee for a veile of thine eyes to al that are with thee, and whither ſoeuer thou shalt goe, remenber alſo thou waſt taken.
label: Genesis

text: And Abraham praying, God healed Abimelech and his wife, and his handmaids, and they bare children:
label: Genesis

text: for our Lord had cloſed vp euerie matrice of the houſe of Abimelech for Sara Abrahams wife.
label: Genesis

text: AND our Lord viſited Sara, as he had promiſed: and fulfilled the things which he ſpake.
label: Genesis

text: And she conceaued and bare a ſonne in her old age, at the time that God had foretold her.
label: Genesis

text: And Abraham called the name of his ſonne, which Sara bare him, Iſaac:
label: Genesis

text: and he circumciſed him the eight day, as God had commanded him,
label: Genesis

text: when he was an hundred yeares old: for at this age of his father, was Iſaac borne.
label: Genesis

text: And Sara ſaid: Laughter God hath made to me: whoſoeuer shal heare of it, wil laugh with me.
label: Genesis

text: And again she ſaid: Who that shal heare of it would beleue Abraham, that Sara gaue ſucke to a ſonne, which she bare him now being an old man?
label: Genesis

text: The child therfore grewe, and was weined: and Abraham made a great feaſt in the day of his weining.
label: Genesis

text: And when Sara had ſenne the ſonne of Agar the Ægyptian playing with Iſaac her ſonne, she ſaid to Abraham:
label: Genesis

text: Caſt out this handmaid, and her ſonne: for the ſonne of the handmaid shal not be heire with my ſonne Iſaac.
label: Genesis

text: Abraham tooke this greuouſly for his ſonne.
label: Genesis

text: To whom God ſaid: Let it not ſeme greuous to thee for the boy, and for thy handmaid: al things that Sara shal ſay to thee, heare her voice: becauſe in Iſaac shal ſeed de called to thee.
label: Genesis

text: But the ſonne alſo of the handmaid I wil make into a great nation, becauſe he is thy ſeede.
label: Genesis

text: Abraham therfore roſe vp in the morning, and taking bread and a bottle of water, put it vpon her shoulder, and deliuered the boy and diſmiſt her. Who went away, and wandred in the wilderneſſe of Berſabee.
label: Genesis

text: And when the water in the bottle was ſpent, ſhe caſt the boy vnder one of the trees, that were there.
label: Genesis

text: And ſhe went her way, and ſate ouer againſt a great way of as farre as a bowe can caſt. for she ſaid: I wil no ſee the child dying: and ſitting ouer againſt, she lifted vp her voice and wept.
label: Genesis

text: And God heard the voice of the boy: and an angel of God called Agar from heauen, ſaying: What doeſt thou Agar? feare not: for God hath heard the voice of the boy, from the place wherin he is.
label: Genesis

text: Ariſe, take vp the boy, and hold his hand: for into a great nation wil I make him.
label: Genesis

text: And God opened her eyes: who ſeing a wel of water, went, and filled the bottle, and gaue the boy to drinke.
label: Genesis

text: And God was with him: who grew, and abode in the wildernes, and became a young man archer.
label: Genesis

text: And he dwelt in the wildernes of Pharan, and his mother tooke a wife for him out of the land of Ægypt.
label: Genesis

text: The ſame time ſaid Abimelech, and Phicol the general of his armie to Abraham: God is with thee in al things which thou doeſt.
label: Genesis

text: Sweare therfore by God, not to hurt me, and my poſteritie, and my ſtocke: but according to the mercie, that I haue done thee, thou shalt doe to me, and to the land wherin thou haſt liued a ſtranger.
label: Genesis

text: And Abraham ſaid: I wil ſweare.
label: Genesis

text: And he rebuked Abimelech for the wel of water, which his ſeruants had taken away by force.
label: Genesis

text: And Abimelech anſwered: I knew not who did this thing: yea and thy ſelfe dideſt not tel me, and I heard not of it but to day.
label: Genesis

text: Abraham therfore tooke sheepe and oxen, and gaue to Abimelech: and both of them made a league.
label: Genesis

text: And Abraham ſet ſeuen ewe lambes of the flocke apart.
label: Genesis

text: To whom Abimelech ſaid: What meane theſe ſeuen ewe lambes, which thou haſt made to ſtand apart?
label: Genesis

text: But he ſaid: Seuen ewe lambes shalt thou take at my hand: that they may be a teſtimonie for me, that I digged this wel.
label: Genesis

text: Therfor was that place called Berſabee: becauſe there both did ſweare.
label: Genesis

text: And they made a league for the wel of oath.
label: Genesis

text: And Abimelech aroſe, and Phicol the general of his armie, and they returned to the land of the Paleſtines. But Abraham planted a groue in Berſabee, and called therupon the name of our Lord God eternal.
label: Genesis

text: And he was a ſeiorner in the land of the Paleſtines manie dayes.
label: Genesis

text: WHICH things being done, God tempted Abraham, and ſaid to him; Abraham, Abraham. But he anſwered: Here I am.
label: Genesis

text: He ſaid to him: Take thy only begotten ſonne, whom thou loueſt, Iſaac, and goe into the Land of viſion: and there thou ſhalt offer him for an holocauſt vpon one of the mountaines which I wil shew thee.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore Abraham riſing vp in the night, ſadled his aſſe: taking with him two young men, and Iſaac his ſonne: and when he had cut wood for the holocauſt, he went his way to the place which God had commanded him.
label: Genesis

text: And the third day, lifting vp his eyes, he ſawe the place afarre of:
label: Genesis

text: and he ſaid to his young men: Tarie you here with the aſſe: I and the boy going with ſpede as farre as yonder, after we haue adored, wil returne to you.
label: Genesis

text: He tooke alſo the wood of the holocauſt, and laid it vpon Iſaac his ſonne: and himſelfe caried in his hands fire and a ſword. And as they went on together,
label: Genesis

text: Iſaac ſaid to his father: My father. And he anſwered: What wilt thou ſonne? Behold, ſaith he, fire & wood: where is the victime of the holocauſt?
label: Genesis

text: And Abraham ſaid: God wil prouide vnto himſelfe the victime of the holocauſt, my ſonne. They went on therfore together:
label: Genesis
