text: and they came to the place which God had shewed him, wherin he builed an altar, and laid the wood in order vpon it: and when he had bound Iſaac his ſonne, he laid him on the altar vpon the pile of wood.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſtretched forth his hand, and caught the ſword, for to ſacrifice his ſonne.
label: Genesis

text: And behold an angel of our Lord from heauen cried, ſaying: Abraham, Abraham. Who anſwered: Here I am.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid to him: Stretch not forth thy hand vpon the boy, neither doe thou any thing to him: now haue I knowen that thou feareſt God, and haſt not ſpared thine onlie begotten ſonne for my ſake.
label: Genesis

text: Abraham lifted vp his eyes, and ſaw behind his backe a ramme amongſt the briers ſticking faſt by the hornes, which he tooke and offered an holocauſt in ſtede of his ſonne.
label: Genesis

text: And he called the name of that place, Our Lord ſeeth. Wherupon euen to this day it is ſaid, In the mountaine our Lord wil ſee.
label: Genesis

text: And the angel of our Lord called Abraham the ſecond time from heauen, ſaying:
label: Genesis

text: By my owne ſelfe haue I ſworne, ſaith the Lord: becauſe thou haſt done this thing, and haſt not ſpared thine onlie begotten ſonne for my ſake:
label: Genesis

text: I wil bleſſe thee, and I wil multiplie thy ſede as the ſtarres of heauen, and as the ſand that is by the ſea shore: thy ſede ſhal poſſeſſe the gates of his enemies,
label: Genesis

text: and in thy ſede SHAL BE BLESSED al the nations of the earth, becauſe thou haſt obeyed my voice.
label: Genesis

text: Abraham returned to his young men; and they went to Berſabee together, and he dwelt there.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe things ſo being done, it was told Abraham that Melca alſo had borne children to Nachor his brother,
label: Genesis

text: Hus the firſtbegotten, & Buz his brother, and Camuel the father of the Sirians,
label: Genesis

text: and Caſed, and Azau. Pheldas alſo & Iedlaph,
label: Genesis

text: and Bathuel, of whom was borne Rebecca: theſe eight did Melcha beare, to Nachor Abrahams brother.
label: Genesis

text: And his concubine, named Roma, bare Tabee, and Gaham, and Tahas, and Maacha.
label: Genesis

text: AND Sara liued an hundred twentie ſeuen yeares.
label: Genesis

text: And she died in the citie of Arbee which is Hebron, in the land of Chanaan: And Abraham came to mourne, and weepe for her.
label: Genesis

text: And after that he was riſen vp from the funeral obſequies, he ſpake to the children of Heth, ſaying:
label: Genesis

text: I am a ſtranger and pilgrime among you: geue me the right of a ſepulchre with you, that I may burie my dead.
label: Genesis

text: The children of Heth anſwered, ſaying:
label: Genesis

text: My lord heare vs, thou art a prince of God among vs: in our principal ſepulchres burie thou thy dead: and no man can let thee but that in his owne monument thou mayeſt burie thy dead.
label: Genesis

text: Abraham roſe vp, and adored the people of the land, to wit the children of Heth:
label: Genesis

text: and he ſaid to them: If it pleaſe your ſoule that I burie my dead, heare me, and be interceſſors for me to Ephron the ſonne of Seor:
label: Genesis

text: that he geue me the duble caue, which he hath in the vttermoſt part of his field: for money to the worth therof let him deliuer it to me before you for poſſeſſion of a ſepulchre.
label: Genesis

text: And Ephron dwelt in the middeſt of the children of Heth. And Ephron made anſwer to Abraham in the hearing of al that went in at the gate of the citie, ſaying:
label: Genesis

text: No, it shal not be ſo, my lord, but thou rather harken to that which I doe ſay: The field I deliuer to thee, and the caue that is therin, in the preſence of the children of my people, burie thy dead.
label: Genesis

text: Abraham adored before the people of the land.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſpoke to Ephron, his people ſtanding round about: I beſeech thee to heare me: I wil geue money for the field: take it, and ſo I wil burie my dead in it.
label: Genesis

text: And Ephron anſwered:
label: Genesis

text: My lord, heare me. The ground which thou deſireſt, is worth foure hundred ſicles of ſiluer: this is the price betwen me and thee: but how much is this? burie thy dead.
label: Genesis

text: Which when Abraham had heard, he weyed the money, that Ephron had asked, in the hearing of the children of Heth, foure hundred ſicles of ſiluer of common currant money.
label: Genesis

text: And the field that before time was Ephrons, wherin was the duble caue, looking towards Mambre, aſwel it, as the caue, and al the trees therof in al the lymits therof round about:
label: Genesis

text: was made ſure to Abraham for a poſſeſſion, in the ſight of the children of Heth, and of al that went in at the gate of his citie.
label: Genesis

text: And ſo Abraham buried Sara his wife in the duble caue of the field, that looked towards Mambre, this is Hebron in the land of Chanaan.
label: Genesis

text: And the field was made ſure to Abraham, and the caue, that was in it, for a poſſeſſion to burie in, of the Children of Heth.
label: Genesis

text: AND Abraham was old, and of manie dayes: and our Lord had bleſſed him in al things.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid to the elder ſeruant of his houſe, which was ruler ouer al that he had: Put thy hand vnder my thighe,
label: Genesis

text: that I may adiure thee by our Lord, God of heauen and earth, that thou take not a wife for my ſonne, of the daughters of the Cananites, among whom I dwel:
label: Genesis

text: but that thou goe vnto myne owne countrie and kindred, and thence take a wife for my ſonne Iſaac.
label: Genesis

text: The ſeruant anſwered: If the woman wil not come with me into this land, whether muſt I bring thy ſonne backe againe to the place, from whence thou dideſt come forth?
label: Genesis

text: And Abraham ſaid: Beware thou neuer bring my ſonne backe againe thither.
label: Genesis

text: Our Lord God of heauen, which tooke me out of my fathers houſe, and out of my natiue countrie, which ſpake to me, and ſware to me, ſaying: To thy ſede wil I geue this land: he shal ſend his angel before thee, and thou shalt take from thence a wife for my ſonne:
label: Genesis

text: but if the woman wil not folow thee, thou shalt not be bound by the oath: only bring not my ſonne thither againe.
label: Genesis

text: The ſeruant therfore put his hand vnder the thigh of Abraham his lord, and ſware to him vpon this worde.
label: Genesis

text: And he tooke tenne camels of his lords heard, and departed, of al his goods carying ſomething with him; and ſetting forward went on into Meſopotamia to the citie of Nachor.
label: Genesis

text: And when he had made the camels lye downe without the towne beſide a wel of water at euen, at the time when women are wont to come forth to drawe water, he ſaid:
label: Genesis

text: O Lord God of my lord Abraham, mete me to day, I beſeech thee, and doe mercifully with my maiſter Abraham.
label: Genesis

text: Behold I ſtand nigh to the fountaine of water, and the daughters of the inhabiters of this citie, wil come forth to drawe water.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore the maid, to whom I shal ſay: Bowe downe thy tankard that I may drinke: and she shal anſwere, Drinke, yea to thy camels alſo wil I geue drinke: she it is, whom thou haſt prouided for thy ſeruant Iſaac: and by this I shal vnderſtand, that thou haſt delt mercifully with my maiſter.
label: Genesis

text: Neyther had he yet ended theſe wordes within him ſelfe, & behold Rebecca came forth, the daughter of Bathuel, the ſonne of Melcha wife to Nachor the brother of Abraham, hauing a tankard on her shoulder:
label: Genesis

text: a paſſing comely maide, & moſt beautiful virgin, & not knowen to man: and she was gone downe to the fountaine, and had filled her tankard, and came backe.
label: Genesis

text: And the ſeruant ranne to mete her, and ſaid: Geue me a little water to drinke of thy tankard.
label: Genesis

text: Who anſwered: Drinke my lord. And quickly she let downe the tankard vpon her arme, and gaue him drinke.
label: Genesis

text: And when he had druncke, she added: but for thy camels alſo I wil drawe water, til al doe drinke.
label: Genesis

text: And powring out the tankard into the troughes, she ranne backe to the wel to drawe water: and being drawen gaue it to al the camels.
label: Genesis

text: But he muſing beheld her with ſilence, deſirous to know whether our Lord had made his iourney proſperous, or not.
label: Genesis

text: And after that the camels had drunck, the man plucked forth golden earelettes, weying two ſicles: and as manie braceletts of tenne ſicles weight.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid to her: whoſe daughter art thou? shew me: is there anie place in thy fathers houſe to lodge?
label: Genesis

text: Who anſwered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the ſonne of Melcha, whom she bare to Nachor.
label: Genesis

text: And she added, ſaying: Of ſtrawe alſo and hay we haue good ſtore, and a large place to lodge in.
label: Genesis

text: The man bowed himſelfe, and adored our Lord,
label: Genesis

text: ſaying: Bleſſed be the Lord God of my lord Abraham, that hath not taken away his mercie & truth from my lord, and hath brought me the ſtreight way into the houſe of my lords brother.
label: Genesis

text: The maide therfore ranne, and reported into her mothers houſe al things that she had heard.
label: Genesis

text: And Rebecca had a brother named Laban, who in al haiſt went forth to the man, where the fountaine was.
label: Genesis

text: And when he had ſeene the eareletts and braceletts in his ſiſters hands, and had heard al her words reporting: Theſe words ſpake the man vnto me: he came to the man which ſtoode beſide the camels, and nighe to the fountaine of water:
label: Genesis

text: and ſaid to him: Come in, thou bleſſed of our Lord: Why ſtandeſt thou without? I haue prepared the houſe, and a place for the camels.
label: Genesis

text: And he brought him in into his lodging: and he vnharneſſed the camels, and gaue ſtrawe and hay, and water to wash his feet, and of the men that were come with him.
label: Genesis

text: And bread was ſet before him. Who ſaid: I wil not eate, til I ſpeake my meſſage. He anſwered him: Speake.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid: I am the ſeruant of Abraham:
label: Genesis

text: and our Lord hath bleſſed my lord wonderfully, and he is magnified: and he hath geuen him sheepe, and oxen, ſiluer and gold, men ſeruants and wemen ſeruants, camels, and aſſes.
label: Genesis

text: And Sara my lordes wife hath borne my lord a ſonne in her old age, and he hath geuen him al things that he had.
label: Genesis

text: And my lord adiured me ſaying: Thou ſhalt not take a wife for my ſonne of the Chananites, in whoſe land I dwel:
label: Genesis

text: but thou shalt goe to my fathers houſe, and of mine owne kinred shalt thou take a wife for my ſonne:
label: Genesis

text: but I anſwered my Lord: What if the woman wil not come with me?
label: Genesis

text: Our Lord, ſaith he, in whoſe ſight I walke, wil ſend his angel with thee, and wil direct thy way: and thou shalt take a wife for my ſonne of myne owne kinred, and of my fathers houſe.
label: Genesis

text: Thou shalt be innocent from my curſe, when thou shalt come to my kinne, and they wil not geue her thee.
label: Genesis

text: I came therfore to day to the wel of water, and ſaid: O Lord God of my lord Abraham, if thou haſt directed my way, wherin I now walke,
label: Genesis

text: behold I ſtand beſides the wel of water, and the virgin, that shal come forth to drawe water, when she shal heare me ſay: Geue me a litle water to drinke of thy tankard:
label: Genesis

text: and ſhe shal ſay to me: Drinke both thou and for thy camels I wil drawe alſo: that is the woman, which our Lord hath prepared for my maiſters ſonne.
label: Genesis

text: And whileſt I pondered theſe things ſecretly with my ſelfe, Rebecca appeared comming with a tankard, which she caried vpon her shoulder: and she went downe to the fountaine, & drew water. And I ſaid to her: Geue me a litle to drinke.
label: Genesis

text: Who ſpedelie let downe the tankard from her shoulder, and ſaid to me: Drinke both thou, and to thy camels I wil geue drinke. I dranke, and ſhe watered the cammels.
label: Genesis

text: And I asked her, and ſaid: Whoſe daughter art thou? who anſwered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the ſonne of Nachor, whom Melcha bare him. I hoong therfore earelettes to adorne her face, and I put braceletts vpon her hands.
label: Genesis

text: And proſtrate I adored our Lord, bleſſing the Lord God of my lord Abraham, who hath brought me the ſtraight way to take the daughter of my lords brother for his ſonne.
label: Genesis

text: Wherfore if you doe according to mercie and truth with my lord, shew me: but if it pleaſe you otherwiſe, that alſo tel me, that I may goe to the right hand, or to the left.
label: Genesis

text: And Laban and Bathuel anſwered: From our Lord the word hath proceded: we can not ſpeake any other thing with thee beſides his pleaſure.
label: Genesis

text: Behold Rebecca is before thee, take her and goe thy waies, and let her be the wife of thy lords ſonne, as our Lord hath ſpoken.
label: Genesis

text: Which when Abrahams ſeruant heard, falling downe he adored our Lord to the grounde.
label: Genesis

text: And taking forth veſſel of ſiluer, and gold, and garments, gaue them to Rebecca for a preſent. To her brothers alſo, and to her mother he offred giftes.
label: Genesis

text: A banket was made, and eating and drinking togeather they lodged there. And in the morning, the ſeruant aroſe, and ſaid: Diſmiſſe me, that I may goe to my lord.
label: Genesis

text: And her brother, and mother anſwered: Let the maide tarie at the leaſt tenne days with vs, and after she shal depart.
label: Genesis

text: Stay me not, ſaid he, becauſe our Lord hath directed my way: diſmiſſe me that I may goe on to my lord.
label: Genesis

text: And they ſaid: Let vs cal the maid, and aske her wil.
label: Genesis

text: And being called, when she was come, they asked: Wilt thou goe with this man? who ſaid: I wil goe.
label: Genesis

text: They diſmiſſed her therfore, and her nurce, and Abrahams ſeruant, and his companie,
label: Genesis

text: wishing proſperitie to their ſiſter, and ſaying: Thou art our ſiſter, encreaſe thou into thouſand thouſands, and thy ſeed poſſeſſe the gates of their enemies.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore Rebecca, and her maides being ſet vpon camels, folowed the man: who with ſpeed returned vnto his lord; and
label: Genesis

text: the ſame time Iſaac walked along the way, that leadeth to the wel of the Liuing and the ſeing, ſo called: for he dwelt in the ſouth countrie;
label: Genesis

text: and he was gone forth to meditate in the field, the day nowe being wel ſpent: and when he had caſt vp his eyes, he ſaw camels coming a farre of.
label: Genesis

text: Rebecca alſo, when she ſaw Iſaac, lighted of the camel,
label: Genesis

text: and ſaid to the ſeruant: Who is that man which cometh towards vs along the field? And he ſaid to her. The ſame is my lord. But she quickly taking her cloake, couered her ſelfe.
label: Genesis

text: And the ſeruant told Iſaac al things that he hed done.
label: Genesis

text: Who brought her into the tent of Sara his mother, and tooke her to wife: and he loued her ſo much, that it did moderate the ſorrowe, which was chanced of his mothers death.
label: Genesis

text: AND Abraham maried an other wife named Cethura:
label: Genesis

text: which bare him Zamran, and Iecſan, and Madan, and Madian, and Ieſboc, and Sue.
label: Genesis

text: Iecſan alſo begat Saba and Dadan. The Children of Dadan were Aſſurim, and Latuſim, and Loomim.
label: Genesis

text: But alſo of Madian was borne Epha, and Opher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaa: al theſe were the children of Cetura.
label: Genesis

text: And Abraham gaue al his poſſeſſions to Iſaac:
label: Genesis

text: and to the children of his concubines he gaue gifts, and ſeparated them from Iſaac his ſonne, whileſt himſelfe yet liued, to the eaſt countrie.
label: Genesis

text: And the days of Abrahams life were a hundred ſeuentie and fiue yeares.
label: Genesis

text: And decaying dyed in a good old age, and hauing liued a great time, and being ful of days: and was gethered to his people.
label: Genesis

text: And there buried him Iſaac and Iſmael his ſonnes in the duble caue, which was ſituated in the field of Ephron the ſonne of Seor the Hethite, ouer againſt Mambre,
label: Genesis

text: which he had bought of the children of Heth: there was he buried, and Sara his wife.
label: Genesis

text: And after his death God bleſſed Iſaac his ſonne, who dwelled beſide the wel of the Liuing and ſeing ſo named.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe are the generations of Iſmael the ſonne of Abraham, whom Agar the Ægyptian bare him, Saraes ſeruant: and
label: Genesis

text: theſe are the names of his children according to their calling and generations. The firſt begotten of Iſmael Nabaioth, then Cedar, and Adbeel, and Mabſam,
label: Genesis

text: Maſma alſo, and Duma, and Maſſa,
label: Genesis

text: Hadar, and Thema, and Iethur, and Naphis, and Cedma.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe are the ſonnes of Iſmael: and theſe are their names by their caſtles and townes, twelue princes of their tribes.
label: Genesis

text: And the yeares of Iſmaels life came to an hundred thirtie ſeauen, and decaying died, and was put vnto his people.
label: Genesis

text: And he dwelt from Heuila euen to Sur, which looketh towards Ægypt, as they enter to the Aſſirians, before the face of al his bretheren died he.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe alſo are the generations of Iſaac the ſonne of Abraham: Abraham begat Iſaac:
label: Genesis

text: who when he was fortie yeares old, tooke to wife Rebecca the daughter of Bathuel the Syrian of Meſopotamia, ſiſter to Laban.
label: Genesis

text: And Iſaac beſought our Lord for his wife, becauſe she was barren: who heard him, and made Rebecca to conceaue.
label: Genesis

text: But the little ones ſtrugled in her wombe; who ſaid: If it ſhould be ſo with me, what nede was there to conceaue? And she went to conſult our Lord.
label: Genesis

text: Who anſwering ſaid: Two nations are in thy wombe, and two peoples shal be diuided out of thy wombe, and one people shal ouercome the other, and the elder shal ſerue the younger.
label: Genesis

text: Now her time was come to be deliuered, and behold twinnes were found in her wombe.
label: Genesis

text: He that came forth firſt, was read, and al hearie in manner of a skinne: and his name was called Eſau. Immediatly the other coming forth, held his brothers plant in his hand: and therfore he called him Iacob.
label: Genesis

text: Threeſcore yeares old was Iſaac, when the litle ones were borne vnto him.
label: Genesis

text: Who being growne vp, Eſau became a man cunning in hunting, and a huſband man: but Iacob a plaine man dwelled in tents.
label: Genesis

text: Iſaac loued Eſau, becauſe he did eate of his hunting: and Rebecca loued Iacob.
label: Genesis

text: And Iacob boyled broth: to whom Eſau being come faynt out of the field,
label: Genesis

text: ſaid: Geue me of this read broth, becauſe I am exceeding faint. For which cauſe his name was called Edom.
label: Genesis

text: To whom Iacob ſaid: Sel me thy firſt-birth-right.
label: Genesis

text: He anſwered, Loe I dye, what wil the firſt birth right auaile me?
label: Genesis

text: Iacob ſaid: Sweare therfore to me. Eſau ſware to him, and ſould his firſt-birth-right.
label: Genesis

text: And ſo taking bread and the rice broth, did eate, and drinke, and went his way; little eſteeming that he had ſold his firſt birth right.
label: Genesis

text: AND when a famine was riſen in the land, after that ſterilitie, that had chanced in the dayes of Abraham, Iſaac went to Abimelech king of the Paleſtines into Gerara.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord appeared to him, and ſaid: Goe not downe into Egypt, but reſt in the land which I shal tel thee.
label: Genesis

text: And ſeiourne in it, and I wil be with thee, and wil bleſſe thee: for to thee and to thy ſeed, I wil geue al theſe countries, accomplishing the oath which I ſware to Abraham thy father.
label: Genesis

text: And I wil multiplie thy ſeed as the ſtarres of heauen: and I wil geue to thy poſteritie al theſe countries: and in thy ſeed SHAL BE BLESSED al the nations of the earth,
label: Genesis

text: for becauſe Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my preceptes and commandements, and obſerued my ceremonies & lawes.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore Iſaac abode in Gerara.
label: Genesis

text: Who when he was asked by the men of that place, concerning his wife, anſwered: She is my ſiſter. for he was afraid to confeſſe that ſhe was married to him, thinking leſt peraduenture they would kil him becauſe of her beautie.
label: Genesis

text: And when verie manie days were paſſed, and he abode there, Abimelech the king of the Paleſtines looking forth through a windowe, ſawe him ſporting with Rebecca his wife.
label: Genesis

text: And calling for him, he ſaid: It is euident that she is thy wife: why dideſt thou faine her to be thy ſiſter? He anſwered: I feared leſt I should die for her.
label: Genesis

text: And Abimelech ſaid: Why haſt thou deceaued vs? ſome man of the people might haue lyen with thy wife, & thou haddeſt brought vpon vs a great ſinne. And he commanded al the people, ſaying:
label: Genesis

text: He that ſhal touch this mans wife, dying shal dye.
label: Genesis

text: And Iſaac ſowed in that land, and he found that ſame yeare an hundred fold: and our Lord bleſſed him.
label: Genesis

text: And the man was made rich, and he went proſpering and encreaſing, til he was made exceeding great:
label: Genesis

text: and he had alſo poſſeſſions of sheep and of heards, and a verie great familie. For this the Paleſtines enuying him,
label: Genesis

text: ſtopped at that time al the welles, that the ſeruants of his father Abraham had digged; filling them vp with water:
label: Genesis

text: in ſo much that Abimelech himſelfe ſaid to Iſaac: Depart from vs, becauſe thou art become mightier then we a great deale.
label: Genesis

text: And departing, to come to the Torrent of Gerara, and to dwel there:
label: Genesis

text: againe he digged other welles, which the ſeruants of his father Abraham had digged, and which, after his death, the Philiſtines had ſtopped vp of old: and he called them by the ſame names, which his father before had called them.
label: Genesis

text: And they digged in the Torrent, and found liuing water:
label: Genesis

text: but there alſo the paſtors of Gerara made a brawle againſt the paſtors of Iſaac, ſaying: It is our water. for which cauſe he called the name of the wel, by occaſion of that which had hapned, Calumnie.
label: Genesis

text: And they digged alſo an other: & for that they brawled likewiſe, and he called the name of it, Enmitie.
label: Genesis

text: Going foreward from thence he digged an other wel, for which they contended not: therfore he called the name therof, Latitude, ſaying: Now hath our Lord dilated vs, and made vs to encreaſe vpon the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And he went vp from that place vnto Berſabee,
label: Genesis

text: where our Lord appeared to him that ſame night, ſaying: I am the God of Abraham thy father, do not feare, becauſe I am with thee: I wil bleſſe thee, and multiplie thy ſeed for my ſeruant Abrahams ſake.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore he builded there an altar: and hauing called vpon the name of our Lord, he pitched his tent: and commanded his ſeruants that they ſhould digge a wel.
label: Genesis

text: To the which place when there were come from Gerara Abimelech, and Ocozath his freind, and Phicol chieffe captaine of his ſouldiers,
label: Genesis

text: Iſaac ſpake to them: Why are ye come to me a man whom you hated, and haue thruſt our from you?
label: Genesis

text: Who anſwered: We ſaw that the Lord is with thee, and therfore we ſaid: Let there be an oath betwen vs, and let vs make a league,
label: Genesis

text: that thou do vs no harme, as we alſo haue touched nothing of thine, neither haue we done that which might hurt thee: but with peace haue we diſmiſt thee encreaſed with the bleſſing of the Lord.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore he made them a feaſt, and after they had eaten and drunken
label: Genesis

text: ariſing in the morning, they ſware one to an other: and Iſaac diſmiſſed them peaceably into their place.
label: Genesis

text: And behold the ſame day came the ſeruants of Iſaac telling him of a wel, which they had digged, and ſaying: We haue found water.
label: Genesis

text: Wherupon he called it Abundance: and the name of the citie was geuen Berſabee, euen vnto this preſent day.
label: Genesis

text: But Eſau being fourtie yeares old married wiues, Iudith the daughter of Beeri the Hethite, and Baſemath the daughter of Elon of the ſame place:
label: Genesis

text: both which had offended the mind of Iſaac and Rebecca.
label: Genesis

text: AND Iſaac was old, and his eyes were dimme, and he could not ſee: and he called Eſau his elder ſonne, and ſaid to him: my ſonne? Who anſwered Here I am.
label: Genesis

text: To whom his father: Thou ſeeſt, quoth he, that I am old, and know not the day of my death.
label: Genesis

text: Take thy inſtruments, thy quiuer, and bowe, and goe abrode: and when thou haſt taken any thing by hunting,
label: Genesis

text: make me broth therof, as thou knoweſt I like, and bring that I may eate: and my ſoule may bleſſe thee before I dye.
label: Genesis

text: Which when Rebecca had heard, and he was gone into the field to fulfil his fathers commandement,
label: Genesis

text: she ſaid to her ſonne Iacob: I heard thy father talking with Eſau thy brother, and ſaying to him:
label: Genesis

text: Bring me of thy hunting, and make me meates that I may eate, and bleſſe thee in the ſight of our Lord before I dye.
label: Genesis

text: Now therfore my ſonne, aſſent to my counſel:
label: Genesis

text: and go thy way to the flocke, bring me two kiddes of the beſt, that I may make of them meat for thy father, ſuch as he gladly eateth:
label: Genesis

text: which when thou haſt brought in, and he hath eaten, he may bleſſe thee before he dye.
label: Genesis

text: To whom he anſwered: Thou knoweſt that Eſau my brother is an hearie man, and I am ſmooth:
label: Genesis

text: if my father shal feele me, and perceaue it, I feare leſt he wil thinke I would haue deluded him, and I shal bring vpon me a curſe for a bleſſing.
label: Genesis

text: To whom his mother ſaid: This curſe, my ſonne, light vpon me: only heare thou my voice, and go, fetch me the things which I haue ſaid.
label: Genesis

text: He went, and brought, and gaue them to his mother. She dreſſed meats, euen as she knew his father liked.
label: Genesis

text: And she did on him the garments of Eſau verie good, which she had at home with her:
label: Genesis

text: and the litle skinnes of the kidds she put about his hands, and couered the bare of his necke.
label: Genesis

text: And she gaue him the broth, and deliuered him bread that she had baked.
label: Genesis

text: Which when he had caried in, he ſaid: My father? But he anſwered: I heare. Who art thou my ſonne?
label: Genesis

text: And Iacob ſaid: I am thy firſt begotten Eſau: I haue done as thou dideſt command me: ariſe, ſit, and eate of my hunting, that thy ſoule may bleſſe me.
label: Genesis

text: And againe Iſaac to his ſonne: How couldeſt thou, ſaid he, find it ſo quickly, my ſonne? Who anſwered: It was the wil of God that that which I would came quickly in my way:
label: Genesis

text: And Iſaac ſaid: Come hither, that I may feele thee my ſonne, and may proue whether thou be my ſonne Eſau, or no.
label: Genesis

text: He came nere to his father, and when he had felt him, Iſaac ſaid: The voice verely, is the voice of Iacob: but the hands, are the hands of Eſau.
label: Genesis

text: And he knew him not, becauſe his hearie hands had made him like vnto the elder. Bleſſing him therfore,
label: Genesis

text: he ſaid: Art thou my ſonne Eſau? He anſwered: I am.
label: Genesis

text: But he ſaid: Bring me the meats of thy hunting, my ſonne, that my ſoule may bleſſe thee. Which when they were brought and he had eaten, he offred him wine alſo, which after he had drunke,
label: Genesis

text: he ſaid to him: Come nere me, and geue me a kiſſe, my ſonne.
label: Genesis

text: He came nere, and kiſſed him. And immediatly as he felt the fragrant ſauoure of his garments, bleſſing him, he ſaid: Behold the ſauoure of my ſonne is as the ſauoure of a plentiful field, which our Lord hath bleſſed.
label: Genesis

text: God geue thee of the deaw of heauen, and of the fatnes of the earth abundance of corne and wine.
label: Genesis

text: And let peoples ſerue thee, and tribes adore thee: be thou lord of thy brethren, and thy mothers children bowe they before thee. He that shal curſe thee, be he curſed: and he that shal bleſſe thee, be he replenished with bleſſings.
label: Genesis

text: Iſaac had ſcarce ended his wordes, and Iacob now gone forth abroad, but Eſau came,
label: Genesis

text: and brought in to his father meates made of his hunting, ſaying: Ariſe my father, and eate of thy ſonnes hunting: that thy ſoule may bleſſe me.
label: Genesis

text: And Iſaac ſaid to him: Why! who arth thou? Who anſwered: I am thy firſt begotten ſonne Eſau.
label: Genesis

text: Iſaac was amazed and aſtonied cxceadingly: and marueling more then a man can beleue, ſaid: Who is he then that euen now brought me veniſon that he had taken, and I did eate of al thinges before thou cameſt? and I haue bleſſed him, and he shal be bleſſed.
label: Genesis

text: Eſau hauing heard his fathers wordes, roared out with a great crye: and being diſmaied, ſaid: Bleſſe me alſo, my father.
label: Genesis

text: Who ſaid: Thy brother came deceiptfully and tooke thy bleſſing.
label: Genesis

text: But he ſaid again: Rightly is his name called Iacob: for he hath ſupplanted me loe the ſecond time: my firſt-birth-right he tooke before, and now the ſecond time he hath ſtollen my bleſſing. And againe to his father he ſaid: Haſt thou not reſerued me alſo a bleſſing?
label: Genesis

text: Iſaac anſwered: I haue appointed him thy Lord, and al his brethren I haue made ſubiect to his ſeruice: with corne and wine I haue eſtablished him, and for thee, my ſonne, what ſhal I doe more after this?
label: Genesis

text: To whom Eſau ſaid: Haſt thou one only bleſſing, father? I beſech thee bleſſe me alſo. And when he wept that he howled againe,
label: Genesis

text: Iſaac being moued, ſaid to him: In the fat of the earth, and in the deaw of heauen from aboue,
label: Genesis

text: shal thy bleſſing be. Thou shalt liue by the ſworde, and shalt ſerue thy brother: and the time ſhal come, when thou ſhalt shake of, and looſe his yoake from thy necke.
label: Genesis

text: Eſau therfore alwaies hated Iacob for the bleſſing wherwith his father had bleſſed him: and he ſaid in his hart: The daies wil come of the mourning of my father, and I wil kil Iacob my brother.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe things were told to Rebecca: who ſending & calling Iacob her ſonne, ſaid to him: Behold Eſau thy brother threatneth to kil thee.
label: Genesis

text: Now therfore, my ſonne, heare my voice, and get thee vp and flye to Laban my brother into Haran:
label: Genesis

text: and thou shalt dwel with him a few daies, til the furie of thy brother be aſſwaged,
label: Genesis

text: and his indignation ceaſe, and he forget thoſe things, which thou haſt done to him: afterward I wil ſend, and bring thee from thence hither. Why shal I be depriued of both ſonnes in one day?
label: Genesis

text: And Rebecca ſaid to Iſaac: I am wearie of my life for the daughters of Heth: if Iacob take a wife of the ſtocke of this land, I liſt not liue.
label: Genesis

text: ISAAC therfore called Iacob, and bleſſed him, and commanded him ſaying: Take not a wife of the ſtocke of Chanaan:
label: Genesis

text: but goe, and make a iourney into Meſopotamia of Syria; to the houſe of Bathuel thy mothers father, and take thee a wife thence of the daughters of Laban thin vncle.
label: Genesis

text: And God almightie bleſſe thee, and make thee encreaſe, and multiplie thee: that thou maieſt be into multitudes of peoples.
label: Genesis

text: And geue he thee the bleſſings of Abraham, and to thy ſeed after thee: that thou mayeſt poſſeſſe the land of thy perigrination, which he promiſed to thy grandfather.
label: Genesis

text: And when Iſaac had diſmiſt him, taking his iourney he came to Meſopotamia of Syria to Laban the ſonne of Bathuel the Syrian, brother to Rebecca his mother.
label: Genesis

text: And Eſau ſeing that his father had bleſſed Iacob, and had ſent him into Meſopotamia of Syria, to marry a wife thence; and that after the bleſſing he had commanded him, ſaying: Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Chanaan:
label: Genesis

text: and that Iacob obeying his parents was gone into Syria:
label: Genesis

text: hauing tryal alſo that his father did not willingly ſee the daughters of Canaan:
label: Genesis

text: he went to Iſmael, and tooke to wife beſides them, which he had before, Maheleth the daughter of Iſmael Abrahams ſonne, ſiſter to Nabaioth.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore Iacob being departed from Berſabee, went on to Haran.
label: Genesis

text: And when he was come to a certaine place, and would reſt in it after ſunne ſet, he tooke one of the ſtones that lay there, and putting it vnder his head, ſlept in the ſame place.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaw in his ſleepe a ladder ſtanding vpon the earth, and the top therof tooching heauen: the angels alſo of God aſcending and deſcending by it,
label: Genesis

text: and our Lord leyning vpon the ladder ſaying to him: I am the Lord God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Iſaac: the Land, wherin thou ſleepeſt, I wil geue to thee and to thy ſeed.
label: Genesis

text: And thy ſeed shal be as the duſt of the earth: thou ſhalt be dilated to the Weſt, and to the Eaſt, & to the North, and to the South: and IN THEE and thy ſeed al the tribes of the earth SHAL BE BLESSED.
label: Genesis

text: And I wil be thy keeper whither ſo euer thou goeſt, and wil bring thee backe into this land: neither wil I leaue thee, til I ſhal haue accomplished al things which I haue ſaid.
label: Genesis

text: And when Iacob was awaked out of ſleepe, he ſaid: In dede our Lord is in this place, and I wiſt not.
label: Genesis

text: And trembling he ſaid: How terrible is this place! this is none other but the houſe of God, and the gate of heauen.
label: Genesis

text: And Iacob ariſing in the morning; tooke the ſtone, which he had laid vnder his head, and erected it for a title, powring oyle vpon the toppe.
label: Genesis

text: And he called the name of the citie Bethel, which before was called Luza.
label: Genesis

text: And he vowed a vowe, ſaying: If God shal be with me, and shal keepe me in the way, by the which I walke, and shal geue me bread to eate, and rayment to put on,
label: Genesis

text: and I shal be returned proſperouſly to my fathers houſe, the Lord ſhal be my God,
label: Genesis

text: and this ſtone, which I haue erected for a title, shal be called the Houſe of God: and of al things that thou ſhalt geue to me, I wil offer tithes to thee.
label: Genesis

text: IACOB therfore going on his iourney, came into the Eaſt countrie.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſawe a wel in the field, and three flockes of sheepe lying beſide it: for of it the beaſts were watered, and the mouth therof was cloſed with a great ſtone.
label: Genesis

text: And the maner was when al the sheepe were geathered togeather they did rowle of the ſtone, and after the sheepe were refreshed they put it on the mouth of the wel againe.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid to the sheperds: Brethren, whence are you? Who anſwered: Of Haran.
label: Genesis

text: And he asked them, ſaying: Know you Laban the ſonne of Nachor? They ſaid: We do knowe him.
label: Genesis

text: Is he in health? quoth he: He is in health, ſay they: And behold Rachel his daughter cometh with his flocke.
label: Genesis

text: And Iacob ſaid: There is yet much day remaining, neither is it time to bring the flockes into the foulds againe: firſt geue the sheep drinke, and ſo bring them backe to feede.
label: Genesis

text: Who anſwered: We can not, til al the cattel be gethered together: and we remoue the ſtone from the wels mouth, that we may water the flocks.
label: Genesis

text: They were yet ſpeaking, and behold Rachel came with her fathers ſheepe: for she fed the flocke.
label: Genesis

text: whom when Iacob had ſeene, and knew her to be his coſen germaine, and that they were the sheepe of Laban his vncle: he remoued the ſtone, wherwith the wel was cloſed.
label: Genesis

text: And hauing watered the flocke, he kiſſed her: and lifting vp his voice wept,
label: Genesis

label: Genesis

text: And caſting vp his eyes, he ſaw the wemen and their litle ones, and ſaid: What meane theſe? And do they perteyne to thee? He anſwered: They are the litle ones which God hath geuen to me thy ſeruant.
label: Genesis

text: And the handmaides and their children coming nere, bowed themſelues.
label: Genesis

text: Lia alſo with her children came nere: and when they had adored in like maner, laſt Ioſeph and Rachel adored.
label: Genesis

text: And Eſau ſaid: What are the troupes that I did mete? He anſwered: That I might find grace before my lord.
label: Genesis

text: But he ſaid: I haue plentie, my brother, be thy things to thy ſelfe.
label: Genesis

text: And Iacob ſaid: Do not ſo I beſech thee, but if I haue found grace in thin eyes, take a litle preſent at my hands: for ſo haue I ſeene thy face, as if I should haue ſeene the countenance of God: be gracious to me,
label: Genesis

text: and take the bleſſing, which I haue brought thee, and which God hath geuen me, who geueth al thinges. Scarſe at his brothers great inſtance, taking it,
label: Genesis

text: he ſaid: Let vs march on together, and I wil accompanie thee in thy iourney.
label: Genesis

text: And Iacob ſaid: My lord thou knoweſt that I haue with me litle ones, and ſheepe, and kine with young: which if I cauſe to ouerlaboure themſelues in going, in one day al the flockes wil die.
label: Genesis

text: It may pleaſe my lord to goe before his ſeruant: and I wil folow ſoftly after him, as I ſhal ſee my litle ones to be able, vntil I come to my lord in Seir.
label: Genesis

text: Eſau anſwered: I beſech thee, that of my people at the leaſtwiſe, which is with me, there may remaine ſome to accompanie thee in the way. It is not needful, ſaid he, this only I haue nede of, that I may finde grace (my lord) in thy ſight.
label: Genesis

text: Eſau therfore returned that day the ſame way, that he came into Seir.
label: Genesis

text: And Iacob cometh into Socoth: where hauing built a houſe, and pitched his tents, he called the name of that place Socoth, that is, Tabernacles.
label: Genesis

text: And he paſſed into Salem a citie of the Sichimites, which is in the land of Chanaan, after he returned from Meſopotamia of Siria: and he dwelt beſide the towne.
label: Genesis

text: And he bought that part of the field, wherin he had pitched his tents, of the children of Hemor, the father fo Sichem for an hundred lambes.
label: Genesis

text: And erecting an altar there, on it he called vpon the moſt mightie God of Iſrael.
label: Genesis

text: AND Dina the daughter of Lia went forth to ſee the wemen of that countrie.
label: Genesis

text: whom when Sichem had ſeene the ſonne of Hemor the Heuite, the prince of that land, he was in loue with her: and he tooke her away, and lay with her, by force rauishing the virgin.
label: Genesis

text: And his ſoule was faſt kint vnto her, and whereas she was ſad, he comforted her with ſweete wordes.
label: Genesis

text: And going to Hemor his father, he ſaid: Take me this wench to be my wife.
label: Genesis

text: Which when Iacob had heard, his ſonnes being abſent, and occupied in feeding of the cattle, he held his peace til they returned.
label: Genesis

text: And when Hemor Sichems father was come forth to ſpeake vnto Iacob,
label: Genesis

text: behold his ſonnes came out of the field: and hearing what had paſſed, they were paſſing wrath, becauſe he had done a foule thing in Iſrael, and committed an vnlawful fact, in rauishing Iacobs daughter.
label: Genesis

text: Hemor therfore ſpake to them: The ſoule of my ſonne Sichem is faſtned to your daughter; Geue her vnto him to wife:
label: Genesis

text: and let vs contract mariages one with an other: geue vs your daughters, and take you our daughters.
label: Genesis

text: And dwel with vs: the land is at your commandement, tille, occupie, and poſſeſſe it.
label: Genesis

text: Yea and Sichem alſo ſaid to her father and to her brethren: Let me finde grace in your ſight: and what ſoeuer you shal appointe I wil geue:
label: Genesis

text: raiſe the dowrie, and require giftes, and I shal gladly geue, what you shal demande: only geue me this wench to wife.
label: Genesis

text: Iacobs ſonnes anſwered Sichem & his father in guile, being wrath for the deflouring of their ſiſter:
label: Genesis

text: We can not doe that which you demande, nor geue our ſiſter to an vncircumciſed perſon: which with vs is an vnlawful & abhominable thing.
label: Genesis

text: But in this order we may be confederate, if you wil be like to vs, and al the man ſex among you be circumciſed:
label: Genesis

text: then wil we geue and take mutually your daughters, and ours: and we wil dwel with you, and wil be one people:
label: Genesis

text: but if you wil not be circumciſed, we wil take our daughter, and depart.
label: Genesis

text: The offer pleaſed Hemor, and Sichem his ſonne:
label: Genesis

text: neither did the young man make delay, but forthwith fulfilled that which was demanded: for he loued the wench exceedingly, and he was the greateſt man in al his fathers houſe.
label: Genesis

text: And going into the gate of the citie, they ſpake to the people:
label: Genesis

text: Theſe men are men of peace, and are willing to dwel with vs: let them occupie in the land, and til it, which being large and wide doth lacke men to tille it: their daughters we shal take to wife, and ours we wil geue to them.
label: Genesis

text: One thing there is for the which ſo great a good is differred: If we circumciſe our men ſexe, folowing the rite of the nation.
label: Genesis

text: And their ſubſtance, and cattle, and al things that they poſſeſſe, shal be ours: only in this let vs condeſcend, and dwelling togeather, we shal make one people.
label: Genesis

text: And they al aſſented, and circumciſed al the man ſex.
label: Genesis

text: And behold the third day, when the griefe of the woundes is moſt paineful: Iacobs two ſonnes, Simeon and Leui the brothers of Dina, taking their ſwordes, entred into the citie boldly: and killing al the man ſex,
label: Genesis

text: murdred withal Hemor and Sichem, taking away Dina their ſiſter out of Sichems houſe.
label: Genesis

text: When they were gone forth, the other ſonnes of Iacob ranne in vpon them that were ſlaine: and ſpoiled the citie in reuenge of the rape.
label: Genesis

text: And waſting al things that were in their houſes, and fildes, their ſheepe and heardes, and aſſes,
label: Genesis

text: their little ones alſo, and their wiues they led away captiue.
label: Genesis

text: Which things when they had boldly atcheiued, Iacob ſaid to Simeon and Leui: You haue trubled me, and made me odious to the Chananites, and Pherezites the inhabiters of this land. we are few: they being gethered together wil ſtrike me; and I, and my houſe ſhal be deſtroyed.
label: Genesis

text: They anſwered: What ſhould they abuſe our ſiſter as a ſtrumpet?
label: Genesis

text: IN THE meane time God ſpake to Iacob: Ariſe, and goe vp to Bethel, and dwel there, and make an altar to God that appeared to thee when thou diddeſt flie from Eſau thy brother.
label: Genesis

text: And Iacob hauing called together al his houſe, ſaid: Caſt away the ſtrange goddes that are among you, and be clenſed and change your garments.
label: Genesis

text: Ariſe, and let vs goe vp into Bethel, that we may make there an altar vnto God: who heard me in the day of my tribulation, and accompained me in my iourney.
label: Genesis

text: They gaue to him therfore al the ſtrange goddes that they had, and the earelets which were in their eares: but he buried them vnder the terebinth, that is behind the citie of Sichem.
label: Genesis

text: And when they were departed, the terror of God inuaded al the cities rounde about, and they durſt not purſew them going away.
label: Genesis

text: And Iacob came to Luza, which is in the land of Chanaan, ſurnamed Bethel: he and al the people that was with him.
label: Genesis

text: And he builded there an altar, and called the name of that place, The houſe of God: for there God appeared to him when he fled from his brother.
label: Genesis

text: The ſame time died Debora the nurſe of Rebecca, and was buried at the foote of Bethel vnder an oke: and the name of that place was called, The oke of weeping.
label: Genesis

text: And God appeared again to Iacob after he returned from Meſopotamia of Siria, and he bleſſed him,
label: Genesis

text: ſaying: Thou shalt not be called any more Iacob, but Iſrael shal be thy name. And he called him Iſrael,
label: Genesis

text: and ſaid to him: I am God almightie, encreaſe thou and multiplie: Of thee shal be nations and peoples of nations, kinges shal come forth of thy loynes.
label: Genesis

text: And the land which I gaue to Abraham and Iſaac, I wil geue to thee, and to thy ſeede after thee.
label: Genesis

text: And he departed from him.
label: Genesis

text: But he erected a title of ſtone, in the place where God had ſpoken vnto him: offering vpon it liquide offeringes, and powring oile on it:
label: Genesis

text: and calling the name of that place, Bethel.
label: Genesis

text: And being gone forth from thence, he came in the ſpring time to the land which leadeth to Ephrata: wherin when Rachel was in trauaile,
label: Genesis

text: becauſe of difficultie in her trauaile, ſhe beganne to be in danger, and the midwife ſaid vnto her: Feare not, for thou shalt haue alſo this a ſonne.
label: Genesis

text: And her ſoule departing for paine, and death now at hand, she called the name of her ſonne Benoni, that is the ſonne of my paine: but his father called him Beniamin, that is the ſonne of the right hand.
label: Genesis

text: Rachel therfore died, and was buried in the hye way that leadeth to Ephrata, this ſame is Bethleem.
label: Genesis

text: And Iacob erected a title ouer her ſepulchre: This is the litle of Rachels monument, vntil this preſent day.
label: Genesis

text: Departing thence, he pitched his tent beyond the Flocke tower.
label: Genesis

text: And when he dwelt in that countrie: Ruben went, and ſlept with Bala his fathers concubine: which thing he was not ignorant of. And the ſonnes of Iacob were twelue.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Lia: Ruben the firſt begotten, and Simeon, and Leui, and Iudas, and Iſſachar, and Zabulon.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Rachel: Ioſeph and Beniamin.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Bala Rachels handmaid: Dan and Nepthali.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Zelpha Lias handmaid: Gad and Aſer: theſe are the ſonnes of Iacob, that were borne to him in Meſopotamia of Siria.
label: Genesis

text: He came alſo to Iſaac his father in Mambre, the citie of Arbee, this is Hebron: wherin Abraham and Iſaac ſoiourned.
label: Genesis

text: And the dayes of Iſaac were complete an hundred eyghtie yeares.
label: Genesis

text: And ſpent with age he died, and was put to his people, being old and ful of dayes: and Eſau and Iacob his ſonnes buryed him.
label: Genesis

text: AND theſe are the generations of Eſau, the ſame is Edom.
label: Genesis

text: Eſau tooke wiues of the daughters of Chanaan: Ada the daughter of Elon the Hetheite, and Oolibama the daughter of Ana daughter of Sebeon the Heueite:
label: Genesis

text: Baſemath alſo the daughter of Iſmael ſiſter of Nabaioth.
label: Genesis

text: And Ada bare Eliphaz: Baſemath bare Rahuel:
label: Genesis

text: Oolibama bare Iehus and Ihelon and Coree. theſe are the ſonnes of Eſau, that were borne to him in the land of Chanaan.
label: Genesis

text: And Eſau tooke his wiues and ſonnes and daughters, and euerie ſoule of his houſe, and his ſubſtance, and catle, and al that he could haue in the land of Chanaan: and he went into an other countrie, and departed from his brother Iacob.
label: Genesis

text: For they were exceding rich, and could not dwel together: neither was the land of their peregrination able to beare them, for the multitude of flockes.
label: Genesis

text: And Eſau dwelt in Mount Seir, he is Edom.
label: Genesis

text: And theſe are the generations of Eſau the father of Edom in mount Seir,
label: Genesis

text: and theſe are the names of his ſonnes: Eliphaz the ſonne of Ada the wife of Eſau: Rahuel alſo the ſonne of Baſemath his wife.
label: Genesis

text: And Eliphas had ſonnes: Theman, Omar, Sepho, and Gathan, and Cenes.
label: Genesis

text: And Thamna was the concubine of Eliphas the ſonne of Eſau: which bare to him Amalech. theſe are the ſonnes of Ada the wife of Eſau.
label: Genesis

text: And the ſonnes of Rahuel: were Nahath & Zara, Samma and Meza. theſe were the ſonnes of Baſemath the wife of Eſau.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe alſo were the ſonnes of Oolibama, the daughter of Ana, the daughter of Sebeon, the wife of Eſau, which ſhe bare to him, Iehus, and Ihelon, and Coree.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe were dukes of the ſonnes of Eſau: the ſonnes of Eliphaz the firſt-begotten of Eſau: duke Theman, duke Omar, duke Sepho, duke Cenes,
label: Genesis

text: duke Coree, duke Gatham, duke Amalech, theſe are the ſonnes of Eliphaz in the land of Edom, and theſe are the ſonnes of Ada.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe alſo were the ſonnes of Rahuel, the ſonne of Eſau: duke Nahath, duke Zara, duke Zamma, duke Meza. and theſe are be the dukes of Rahuel, in the Land of Edom: theſe be the ſonnes of Baſemath the wife of Eſau.
label: Genesis

text: And theſe were the ſonnes of Oolibama the wife of Eſau: duke Iehus, duke Ihelon, euke Coree. theſe be the dukes of Oolibama, the daughter of Ana, and wife of Eſau.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe are the ſonnes of Eſau, and theſe are the dukes of them: the ſame is Edom.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe are the ſonnes of Seir the horreite, the inhabiters of the land: Lotan, and Sobal, and Sebeon, and Ana,
label: Genesis

text: and Diſon, and Eſer, and Diſan. Theſe are dukes of the Horreite, the ſonnes of Seir in the Land of Edom.
label: Genesis

text: And Lotan had ſonnes: Hori and Heman. and the ſiſter of Lotan, was Thamna.
label: Genesis

text: And theſe were the ſonnes of Sobal: Aluan and Manahat, and Ebal, and Sepho and Onam.
label: Genesis

text: And theſe were the ſonnes of Sebeon: Aia and Ana. This is Ana that found the hot waters in the wildernes, when he fed the aſſes of Sebeon his father:
label: Genesis

text: and he had a ſonne Diſon, and a daughter Oolibama.
label: Genesis

text: And theſe were the ſonnes of Diſon: Hamdan, and Eſeban, and Iethram, and Charan.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe alſo were the ſonnes of Eſer: Balaan, and Zauan, and Acan.
label: Genesis

text: And Diſan had ſonnes: Hus, and Aram.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe were dukes of the Horreites: duke Lotan, duke Sobal, duke Sebeon, duke Ana,
label: Genesis

text: duke Diſon, duke Eſer, duke Diſan: theſe were dukes of the Horreites that ruled in the Land Seir.
label: Genesis

text: And the Kinges that ruled in the land of Edom, before that the children of Iſrael had a king, were theſe:
label: Genesis

text: Bela the ſonne of Beor, and the name of his citie Denaba.
label: Genesis

text: And Bela died, and Iobab the ſonnne of Zara of Boſra reigned in his ſteed.
label: Genesis

text: And when Iobab was dead, Huſam of the land of the Themans reigned in his ſteed.
label: Genesis

text: He alſo being dead, there reigned in his ſteed Adad the ſonne of Badad, that ſtroke Madian in the countrie of Moab: and the name of his citie was Auith.
label: Genesis

text: And when Adad was dead, there reigned for him Semla of Maſreca.
label: Genesis

text: He alſo being dead, Saul of the riuer Rohoboth, reigned in his ſteed.
label: Genesis

text: And when he alſo was dead, Balanan the ſonne of Achobor ſucceeded into the kingdome.
label: Genesis

text: This man alſo being dead Adar reigned in his place, and the name of his citie was Phau: and his wife was called Meetabel, the daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezaab.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe therfore be the names of the dukes of Eſau in their kinreds, and places, and callings: duke Thamna, duke Alua, duke Ietheth,
label: Genesis

text: duke Oolibama, duke Ela, duke Phinon,
label: Genesis

text: duke Cenez, duke Theman, duke Mabſer,
label: Genesis

text: duke Magdiel, duke Hiram: theſe are the dukes of Edom dwelling in the land of their empire, the ſame is Eſau the father of the Idumeians.
label: Genesis

text: AND Iacob dwelt in the land of Chanaan, wherin his father ſoiourned.
label: Genesis

text: And theſe are his generations: Ioſeph when he was ſixtene yeares old, fed the flock with his brethren being yet a boy: and he was with the ſonnes of Bala and Zelpha his fathers wiues: and he accuſed his brethren to his father of a moſt wicked crime.
label: Genesis

text: And Iſrael loued Ioſeph aboue al his ſonnes, becauſe he had begotten him in his old age: and he made him a coate of diuers coloures.
label: Genesis

text: And his brethren ſeing that he was loued of his father, more then al his ſonnes, they hated him, neither could they ſpeake any thing to him peaceably.
label: Genesis

text: It chanced alſo that he reported to his brethren a dreame, that he had ſeene: which occaſion was the ſeed of greater hatred.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid to them: Heare my dreame which I haue ſeene:
label: Genesis

text: I thought we bounde ſheaues in the field: and my ſheafe aroſe as it were, and ſtood, and your sheaues ſtanding about did adore my sheafe.
label: Genesis

text: His brethren anſwered: What shalt thou be our king? or shal we be ſubiect to thy dominion? This occaſion of his dreames and wordes miniſtred nourishment to the enuie and hatred.
label: Genesis

text: He ſawe alſo an other dreame, which telling his brethren, he ſaid: I ſawe in a dreame, as it were the ſunne, and the moone, and eleuen ſtarres adore me.
label: Genesis

text: Which when he had reported to his father, and brethren, his father rebuked him, and ſaid: What meaneth this dreame that thou haſt ſeene? why ſhal I and thy mother, and thy brethren adore thee vpon the earth?
label: Genesis

text: His brethren therfore enuyed him: but his father conſidered the thing with himſelfe.
label: Genesis

text: And when his brethren abode in Sichem, feeding their fathers flockes,
label: Genesis

text: Iſrael ſaid to him: Thy brethren feed sheepe in Sichem: come, I wil ſend thee to them. Who anſwering,
label: Genesis

text: I am readie; he ſaid to him: Goe, and ſee if al things be wel with thy brethren, and the sheepe: and bring me word againe what they doe. Being ſent therfore from the Vale of Hebron, he came to Sichem:
label: Genesis

text: and a man found him there wandring in the field, and asked what he ſought.
label: Genesis

text: But he anſwered: I ſeeke my brethren, ſhew me where they fede the flockes.
label: Genesis

text: And the man ſaid to him: They are departed from this place: for I heard them ſay: Let vs goe into Dothain. Ioſeph therfore went forward after his brethren, and found them in Dothain.
label: Genesis

text: Who when they had ſeene him a farre of, before he came nighe them, they deuiſed to kil him:
label: Genesis

text: and ſpake among them ſelues: Behold the dreamer commeth,
label: Genesis

text: come, let vs kil him, and caſt him into an old ceſterne: and we wil ſay A naughtie wild beaſt hath deuoured him: and then it shal appeare what his dreames doe profite him.
label: Genesis

text: And Ruben hearing this, endeuored to deliuer him out of their hands, and ſaid:
label: Genesis

text: Do not take away his life, neyther sheed ye blood: but caſt him into this ceſterne, that is in the wilderneſſe, and keepe your handes harmeles: and he ſaid this, deſirous to deliuer him out of their handes, and to reſtore him to his father.
label: Genesis

text: As ſoone therfore as he came vnto his brethren, forthwith they ſtripped him out of his ſide coate, and of diuers colours.
label: Genesis

text: And caſt him into the old ceſterne, that had not water.
label: Genesis

text: And ſitting to eate bread, they ſaw Iſmaelites wayfaring men coming from Galaad, and their camels carying ſpices, and roſen, and mirrh into Ægypt.
label: Genesis

text: Iudas therfore ſaid to his brethren: What auaileth it vs if we kil our brother, and conceale his bloode?
label: Genesis

text: It is better that he be ſold to the Iſmaelites, and that our handes be not polluted: for he is our brother and our flesh. His brethren aſſented to his wordes.
label: Genesis

text: And when the Madianite marchants paſſed by, they drawing him out of the ceſterne, ſold him to the Iſmaelites, for twentie peeces of ſiluer, who brought him into Ægypt.
label: Genesis

text: And Ruben returning to the ceſterne, findeth not the boy:
label: Genesis

text: and renting his garments went to his brethren, and ſaid: The boy doth not appeare, and whither shal I goe?
label: Genesis

text: And they tooke his coate, and dipped it in the blood of a kidde, which they had killed:
label: Genesis

text: ſending ſome that should carie it to their father, and should ſay: This we haue founde: ſee whether it be thy ſonnes coate, or no.
label: Genesis

text: Which when the father acknowledged, he ſaid: It is my ſonnes coate, a naughtie wild beaſt hath eaten him, a beaſt hath deuoured Ioſeph.
label: Genesis

text: And tearing his garments, did on ſackcloth, mourning his ſonne a great time.
label: Genesis

text: And al his children being gethered together to aſwage their fathers ſorowe, he would not take comforte, but ſaid: I wil deſcend vnto my ſonne into hel, mourning. And whileſt he perſeuered in weeping,
label: Genesis

text: the Madianites ſold Ioſeph in Ægypt to Phutiphar an Eunuch of Pharoes maiſter of the ſouldiars.
label: Genesis

text: THE ſame time Iudas going downe from his brethren, turned in to a man an Odollamite, named Hiras.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſawe there the daughter of a man of Chanaan, called Sue: and taking her to wife, he did companie with her.
label: Genesis

text: Who conceaued, and bare a ſonne, and called his name Her.
label: Genesis

text: And conceauing a childe againe, she called her ſonne after he was borne, Onan.
label: Genesis

text: She bare alſo the third: whom she called Sela. after whoſe birth, she ceaſed to beare any more.
label: Genesis

text: And Iudas gaue a wife to Her his firſt begotten, named Thamar.
label: Genesis

text: Alſo Her the firſt begotten of Iudas, was wicked in the ſight of our Lord: and was ſlaine of him.
label: Genesis

text: Iudas therfore ſaid to Onan his ſonne: companie with thy brothers wife, and be ioyned to her, that thou mayeſt rayſe ſeede to thy brother.
label: Genesis

text: He knowing that the children should not be borne to himſelfe, companying with his brothers wife, shed his ſeede vpon the ground, leſt children might be borne in his brothers name.
label: Genesis

text: And therfore our Lord ſtroke him, becauſe he did a deteſtable thing.
label: Genesis

text: For the which cauſe Iudas ſaid to Thamar his daughter in lawe: Be a widowe in thy fathers houſe, til Sela my ſonne growe vp: for he feared leſt he alſo might dye, as his brethren. Who went her way and dwelt in her fathers houſe.
label: Genesis

text: And after many dayes were come and gone: the daughter of Sue the wife of Iudas died: who after his mourning hauing receiued conſolation, went vp to the shearers of his sheepe, himſelfe and Hiras his shepheard of his flocke, the Odolamite, into Thamnas.
label: Genesis

text: And it was told Thamar that her father in law came vp into Thamnas to sheare his sheepe.
label: Genesis

text: Who putting of the garments of her widowhood, tooke a veile: and changing her habite, ſate in the croſſe way, that leadeth to Thamnas: becauſe Sela was growne, and she had not taken him to her huſband.
label: Genesis

text: Whom when Iudas had ſeene, he ſuppoſed her to be an harlot: for she had couered her face, leſt she should be knowen.
label: Genesis

text: And going vnto her, he ſaid: Suffer me to lye with thee: for he knew her not to be his daughter in law. Who anſwering: What wilt thou geue me that thou maieſt enioy my companie?
label: Genesis

text: He ſaid: I wil ſend thee a kid out of the flockes. And when she ſaid againe: I wil ſuffer that thou wilt, if thou geue me a pledge, til thou ſend that which thou doeſt promiſe;
label: Genesis

text: Iudas ſaid: What wilt thou to be geuen thee for a pledge? She anſwered: Thy ring, and bracelet, and ſtaffe which thou holdeſt in thy hand. The woman therfore by once companying conceaued,
label: Genesis

text: and riſing she went her way: and putting of the apparel which she had taken, put on the garments of her widowhood.
label: Genesis

text: And Iudas ſent a kid by his shephard the Odolamite, that he might receiue the pledge againe, which he had geuen to the woman: who when he had not found her,
label: Genesis

text: he asked the men of that place: Where is the woman that ſate in the croſſe way? Al making anſwere: There was no harlot in this place.
label: Genesis

text: He returned to Iudas, and ſaid to him: I haue not found her: yea the men alſo of that place ſaid vnto me, that there neuer ſate harlot there.
label: Genesis

text: Iudas ſaid: Let her take it to her, ſurely she can not charge vs with a lye, I ſent the kid which I promiſed: and thou dideſt not find her.
label: Genesis

text: And behold after three moneths they told Iudas, ſaying: Thamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot, and her bellie ſemeth to ſwel. And Iudas ſaid: Bring her forth that she may be burnt.
label: Genesis

text: Who when she was led to execution, she ſent to her father in law, ſaying: By that man, whoſe theſe things are, haue I conceaued: looke whoſe the ring is, and the bracelet, and the ſtaffe.
label: Genesis

text: Who acknowledging the giftes, ſaid: She is iuſter then I: becauſe I did not geue her to Sela my ſonne. But he knew her no more.
label: Genesis

text: And when she was readie to be brought to bed, there appeared twinnes in her bellie: and in the verie deliuerie of the infants, one put forth the hand, wherin the midwife tyed a ſkarlet ſtring, ſaying:
label: Genesis

text: This shal come forth the former.
label: Genesis

text: But he drawing backe his hand, the other came forth: and the woman ſaid: Why is the partition diuided for thee? and for this cauſe called his name Phares.
label: Genesis

text: Afterward his brother came forth, in whoſe hand was the ſkarelet ſtring: whom she called Zara.
label: Genesis

text: THERFORE Ioſeph was brought into Ægypt, and Putiphar an Eunuch of Pharao, prince of his armie, a man of Ægypt bought him, at the hand of the Iſmaelites, by whom he was brought.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord was with him, and he was a man, that in al things did proſperouſly: and he dwelt in his maiſters houſe,
label: Genesis

text: who knewe verie wel that our Lord was with him, and that al thinges which he did, were directed by him in his hand.
label: Genesis

text: And Ioſeph found grace before his maiſter, and miniſtred to him: by whom being made ruler ouer al his thinges, he gouerned the houſe committed to him, and al thinges that were deliuered vnto him:
label: Genesis

text: and our Lord bleſſed the houſe of the Ægyptian for Ioſephes ſake, and multiplied as wel in houſes, as in landes al his ſubſtance.
label: Genesis

text: Neither knew he any other thing, but the bread which he did eate. And Ioſeph was of beautiful countenance, and comely fauored to behold.
label: Genesis

text: After manie dayes therfore his maiſtreſſe caſt her eyes on Ioſeph, and ſaid: Sleepe with me.
label: Genesis

text: Who in no wiſe aſſenting to that wicked act, ſaid to her: Behold, my maiſter hauing deliuered al thinges vnto me, knoweth not what he hath in his owne houſe:
label: Genesis

text: neither is there any thing which is not in my power, or that he hath not deliuered to me, beſide thee, that art his wife: how therfore can I do this wicked thing, and ſinne againſt my God?
label: Genesis

text: With theſe kinde of wordes day by day both the woman was importune vpon the young man: and he refuſed the aduoutrie.
label: Genesis

text: And it chanced on a certaine day, that Ioſeph went into the houſe, and did ſome buſineſſe without anie man with him:
label: Genesis

text: and she catching the ſkirte of his garment, ſaid: Sleepe with me. who leauing the cloke in her hand, fled, and went forth abroad.
label: Genesis

text: And when the woman ſawe the garment in her handes, and her ſelfe to be contemned,
label: Genesis

text: she called to her the men of her houſe, and ſaid to them: See he hath brought in an Hebrew, to delude vs: he came vpon me, for to lie with me: and when I had cried out,
label: Genesis

text: and he heard my voice, he left the cloake that I held, and fled forth.
label: Genesis

text: For an argument therfore of her credite, she reſerued the cloake, and shewed it to her huſband returning home,
label: Genesis

text: and ſaid: There came vnto me the Hebrew ſeruant, whom thou dideſt bring hither, for to delude me:
label: Genesis

text: and when he heard me crie, he left the cloke which I held, and fled forth.
label: Genesis

text: His maiſter hearing theſe thinges, and geuing ouer light credite to his wiues wordes, was very wrath:
label: Genesis

text: and deliuered Ioſeph into priſon, where the kinges priſoners were kept, and he was there shut vp.
label: Genesis

text: And our Lord was with Ioſeph, and hauing mercie vpon him gaue him grace in the ſight of the chiefe of the priſon.
label: Genesis

text: Who deliuered in his hand al the priſoners that were kept in cuſtodie: and whatſoeuer was done, was vnder him.
label: Genesis

text: Neyther did himſelfe knowe any thing, hauing committed al things to him: for our Lord was with him, and directed al his workes.
label: Genesis

text: THESE thinges being ſo done, it chanced that two Eunuches, the cupbearer of the king of Ægypt, and his baker, offended againſt their lord.
label: Genesis

text: And Pharao being wrath againſt them (for the one was chiefe of the cupbearers, the other chiefe baker)
label: Genesis

text: he ſent them into the priſon of the captaine of the ſouldiers, in the which Ioſeph alſo was priſoner.
label: Genesis

text: But the keeper of the priſon deliuered them to Ioſeph, who alſo miniſtred to them: ſome litle time was paſſed, and they were kept in cuſtodie.
label: Genesis

text: And they ſawe ech of them both a dreame in one night, according to an interpretation agreing to them ſelues:
label: Genesis

text: to whom when Ioſeph was entred in the morning, and ſaw them ſad,
label: Genesis

text: he asked them, ſaying: Why is your countenance ſadder to day then it was woont?
label: Genesis

text: Who anſwered: We haue ſeene a dreame, & there is no bodie to interprete it to vs. And Ioſeph ſaid to them: Why doth not interpretation belong to God? Tel me what you haue ſeene.
label: Genesis

text: The chiefe of the cupbearers firſt told his dreame: I ſaw before me a vine,
label: Genesis

text: wherin were three branches, growing by litle and litle into buddes, and after the bloſſomes the grapes waxed ripe:
label: Genesis

text: and the cup of Pharao in my hand: and I tooke the grapes, and wrong them into the cup which I held, and I gaue the cup to Pharao.
label: Genesis

text: Ioſeph anſwered: This is the interpretation of the dreame: The three branches, are yet three dayes:
label: Genesis

text: after the which Pharao wil remember thy ſeruice, and wil reſtore thee to thy old degree: and thou shalt geue him the cup according to thyne office, as before thou haddeſt wont to doe.
label: Genesis

text: Only remember me, when it shal be wel with thee, and doe me this mercie: to put Pharao in mind that he take me out of this priſon:
label: Genesis

text: becauſe I was taken away by ſtealth, out of the land of the hebrewes, and here an innocent was I caſt into the lake.
label: Genesis

text: The maiſter of the bakers ſeing that he had wiſely reſolued the dreame, he ſaid: And I alſo ſaw a dreame, That I had three baskettes of meale vpon my head:
label: Genesis

text: and that in one basket that was the higher, I caried al meates that are made by the art of baking, and that the birds did eate out of it.
label: Genesis

text: Ioſeph anſwered: This is the interpretation of the dreame: The three basketts, are yet three dayes:
label: Genesis

text: after the which Pharao wil take thy head from thee, and hang thee on the croſſe, and the foules shal teare thy flesh.
label: Genesis

text: The third day after this was the birth day of Pharao: who making a great feaſt to his ſeruantes, at the banket he remembred the maiſter of the cupbearers, and the chiefe of the bakers.
label: Genesis

text: And he reſtored the one into his place, to reach him the cuppe,
label: Genesis

text: the other he hanged on a gibbet, that the truth of the interpreter might be approued.
label: Genesis

text: And yet notwithſtanding the chiefe of the cupbearers, proſperous thinges ſucceeding, forgat his interpreter.
label: Genesis

text: AFTER two yeares Pharao ſaw a dreame. He thought he ſtood vpon a riuer,
label: Genesis

text: out of the which came vp ſeuen kine, faire and fat exceedingly: and they fed in marish places.
label: Genesis

text: Other ſeuen alſo came vp out of the riuer, foule, and caryan leane: and they fed on the very banke of the riuer, in grene places:
label: Genesis

text: and they deuoured them, that had the marueylous beautie and good ſtate of bodies. Pharao after he waked,
label: Genesis

text: ſlept againe, and ſaw an other dreame: Seuen eares of corne grew forth vpon one ſtalke ful and faire:
label: Genesis

text: there ſprang alſo other eares as many, thinne and blaſted with aduſtion,
label: Genesis

text: deuouring al the beautie of the former. Pharao awaking vp after his reſt,
label: Genesis

text: and when morning was come, being frighted with feare, he ſent to al the interpreters of Ægypt, and to al the wiſe men: and they being called for, told them his dreame, neither was there anie that could interprete it.
label: Genesis

text: Then at length the maiſter of the cupbearers remembring himſelfe, ſaid: I confeſſe my ſinne:
label: Genesis

text: The king being angrie with his ſeruantes, commanded me and the chiefe of the bakers to be caſt into the priſon of the captaine of the ſouldiers:
label: Genesis

text: where in one night both of vs ſaw a dreame portending things to come.
label: Genesis

text: There was there a young man an hebrew, ſeruant to the ſame captaine of the ſouldiers: to whom telling our dreames,
label: Genesis

text: we heard whatſoeuer afterward the euent of the thing proued to be ſo. for I was reſtored to my office: and he was hanged vpon a gibbet.
label: Genesis

text: Forthwith at the kinges commandment, Ioſeph being brought out of the priſon they polled him: and changing his apparel, brought him vnto him.
label: Genesis

text: To whom he ſaid: I haue ſeene dreames, and there is not anie that can expound them: which I haue heard, thou doeſt moſt wiſely interprete.
label: Genesis

text: Ioſeph anſwered: Without me, God shal anſwere proſperous thinges to Pharao.
label: Genesis

text: Pharao therfore told that he had ſeene: Me thought I ſtoode vpon the banke of the riuer,
label: Genesis

text: and ſeuen kine came vp out of the banke of the riuer, exceeding faire, and ful of flesh: which grazed on greene places in a marish paſture.
label: Genesis

text: And behold, there folowed theſe, other ſeuen kine, ſo paſſing il fauored and leane, that I neuer ſaw the like in the land of Ægypt,
label: Genesis

text: which hauing deuoured and conſumed the former,
label: Genesis

text: gaue no token of their fulnes: but with the like leanenes and deformitie, looked heauelie. Awaking, and fallen againe into a deepe ſleepe,
label: Genesis

text: I ſawe a dreame: Seuen eares of corne grew forth vpon one ſtalke, ful and verie faire.
label: Genesis

text: Other ſeuen alſo thinne and blasted, with aduſtion, ſprang of the ſtalke:
label: Genesis

text: which deuoured the beautie of the former: I told the dreame to the coniecturers, and there is no man that can declare it.
label: Genesis

text: Ioſeph anſwered: The kinges dreame is one: God hath shewed to Pharao the thinges that he wil doe.
label: Genesis

text: The ſeuen faire kine, and the ſeuen ful eares: be ſeuen yeres of plentifulnes: and both conteine the ſelfe ſame meaning of the dreame.
label: Genesis

text: Alſo the ſeuen leane and thinne kine, that came vp after them, and the ſeuen thinne eares, and blaſted with the burning winde: are ſeuen yeares of famine to come.
label: Genesis

text: Which ſhal be fulfilled in this order.
label: Genesis

text: Behold there shal come ſeuen yeares of great fertilitie in the whole Land of Ægypt:
label: Genesis

text: after which shal folowe other ſeuen yeares of ſo great ſterilitie, that al the abundance before shal be forgotten: for the famine shal conſume al the land,
label: Genesis

text: and the greatnes of the ſcarſitie, shal deſtroy the greatnes of the plentie.
label: Genesis

text: And in that thou dideſt ſee the ſecond time a dreame perteining to the ſame thing: it is a token of the certeintie, for that the worde of God shal come topaſſe, and be fulfilled ſpedely.
label: Genesis

text: Now therfore let the king prouide a wiſe man and induſtrious, and make him ruler ouer the Land of Ægypt:
label: Genesis

text: that he may appointe ouerſeers ouer al countries: and gether into barnes the fifth part of the fruites, during the ſeuen yeares of the fertilitie,
label: Genesis

text: that now preſently shal enſewe: and let al the corne be laid vp, vnder Pharaoes handes, and let it be reſerued in the cities.
label: Genesis

text: And let it be in a readines, againſt the famine of ſeuen yeares to come, which shal oppreſſe Ægypt, and the land shal not be conſumed with ſcarſitie.
label: Genesis

text: The counſel pleaſed Pharao, and al his ſeruants:
label: Genesis

text: and he ſpake to them: Can we find ſuch an other man, that is ful of the ſpirite of God?
label: Genesis

text: He ſaid therfore to Ioſeph: Becauſe God hath shewed thee al things that thou haſt ſpoken, can I find a wiſer and one like vnto thee?
label: Genesis

text: Thou shalt be ouer my houſe, and at the commandment of thy mouth al the people shal obey: only in the throne of the kingdome I wil goe before thee.
label: Genesis

text: And againe Pharao ſaid to Ioſeph: Behold, I haue appointed thee ouer the whole land of Ægypt.
label: Genesis

text: And he tooke his ring from his owne hand, and gaue it into his hand: and he put vpon him a ſilke roabe, and put a chaine of gold about his necke.
label: Genesis

text: And he made him goe vp into his ſecond chariot, the cryer proclayming that al should bowe their knee before him, and that they should know he was made gouernour ouer the whole Land of Ægypt.
label: Genesis

text: And the king ſaid to Ioſeph: I am Pharao: without thy commandment no man shal moue hand or foote in al the land of Ægypt.
label: Genesis

text: And he turned his name, and called him in the Ægyptian togue the Sauiour of the world. And he gaue him to wife Aſeneth the daughter of Putiphar prieſt of Heliopolis. Ioſeph therfore went forth to the land of Ægypt
label: Genesis

text: (and he was thirtie yeares old when he ſtood in the ſight of king Pharao) and did circuite al the countries of Ægypt.
label: Genesis

text: And the fertilitie of the ſeuen yeares came: and the corne being bound vp into ſheaues was gethered togeather into the barnes of Ægypt.
label: Genesis

text: Al the abundance alſo of graine was laid vp in euerie citie.
label: Genesis

text: And there was ſo great abundance of wheat, that it became equal to the ſand of the ſea, and the plentie exceeded meaſure.
label: Genesis

text: And there were borne vnto Ioſeph two ſonnes before the famine came: whom Aſeneth the daughter of Putiphar prieſt of Heliopolis bare him.
label: Genesis

text: And he called the name of the firſt begotten Manaſſes, ſaing: God made me to forget al my labours, & my fathers houſe.
label: Genesis

text: The name alſo of the ſecond he called Ephraim, ſaing: God hath made me to encreaſe in the land of my pouertie.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore when the ſeuen yeares of the plentifulnes, that had bene in Ægypt were paſſed:
label: Genesis

text: the ſeuen yeares of ſcarſitie beganne to come, which Ioſeph foretold: and in the whole world the famine preuailed, but in al the land of Ægypt there was bread.
label: Genesis

text: The which being in hunger, the people cried to Pharao, deſiring foode. To whom he anſwered: Goe ye to Ioſeph: and whatſoeuer he ſhal ſay to you, that doe ye.
label: Genesis

text: And the famine dayly encreaſed in al the land: and Ioſeph opened al the barnes, and ſold to the Ægyptians: for them alſo the famine had opreſſed.
label: Genesis

text: And al prouinces came into Ægypt, to buy victuales, and to moderate the miſerie of the ſcarſitie.
label: Genesis

text: AND Iacob hearing, that victuales were ſold in Ægypt, he ſaid to his ſonnes: Why neglect ye?
label: Genesis

text: I haue heard that wheat is ſold in Ægypt: Goe ye downe, and bye vs neceſſaries, that we may liue, and not be conſumed with lacke.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore the tenne brethren of Ioſeph going downe, to bye corne in Ægypt,
label: Genesis

text: Beniamin being kept at home by Iacob, who ſaid to his brethren: Leſt perhaps he take any harme in the iourney:
label: Genesis

text: entred into the land of Ægypt with others that went to bye. for the famine was in the land of Chanaan.
label: Genesis

text: And Ioſeph was prince in the land of Ægypt, and at his pleaſure corne was ſold to the people. And when his brethren had adored him,
label: Genesis

text: and he knewe them, he ſpake as it were to ſtrangers ſomewhat roughly, asking them: From whence came you? Who anſwered: From the Land of chanaan, that we may bye neceſſaries to liue.
label: Genesis

text: And yet himſelfe knowing his brethren, was not knowen of them.
label: Genesis

text: And remembring the dreames, which ſome times he had ſeene, he ſaid to them: You are ſpies: to view the weaker parts of the land you are come.
label: Genesis

text: Who ſaid: It is not ſo, my lord, but thy ſeruantes are come to bye victuals.
label: Genesis

text: We are al the ſonnes of one man: we are come as men of peace, neither do thy ſeruantes goe about anie euil.
label: Genesis

text: To whom he anſwered: It is otherwiſe: you came to conſider the vndefenſed partes of this land.
label: Genesis

text: But they: We thy ſeruantes, ſay they, are twelue brethren, the ſonnes of one man in the Land of Chanaan: the youngeſt is with our father, the other is not liuing.
label: Genesis

text: This is it, quoth he, that I ſaid: You are ſpies.
label: Genesis
