text: Now preſently I wil take a trial of you: by the health of Pharao you shal not depart hence, vntil your youngeſt brother do come.
label: Genesis

text: Send you one of you to bring him: and you shal be in priſon, til the thinges be proued which you haue ſaid, whether they be true or falſe: otherwiſe by the health of Pharao you are ſpies.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore he put them in priſon three dayes.
label: Genesis

text: And the third day bringing them out of priſon, he ſaid: Doe as I haue ſaid, and you shal liue: for I feare God.
label: Genesis

text: If you be men of peace, let one of your brethren be bounde in priſon: and goe ye your wayes, and carie the corne that you haue bought, vnto your houſes,
label: Genesis

text: and bring your youngeſt brother to me, that I may proue your ſayings to be true, and that you die not. They did as he had ſaid,
label: Genesis

text: and they talked one to an other: Worthely do we ſuffer theſe thinges, becauſe we haue ſinned againſt our brother, ſeing the diſtreſſe of his ſoule, whileſt he beſought vs, and we heard not: therfore is this tribulation come vpon vs.
label: Genesis

text: Among whom Ruben one of them, ſaid: Why, did not I ſay to you: Sinne not againſt the boy: and you heard me not? Loe his blood is required.
label: Genesis

text: And they knew not that Ioſeph vnderſtood: becauſe he ſpake to them by an interpreter.
label: Genesis

text: And he turned away himſelfe a litle while, and wept: and returning he ſpake to them.
label: Genesis

text: And taking Simeon, and binding him in their preſence, he commanded his ſeruantes that they ſhould fil vp their ſackes with wheat, and put euerie mans money againe in their bagges, geuing them beſides for to eate on the way: who did ſo.
label: Genesis

text: But they carying their corne vpon their aſſes, tooke their iourney.
label: Genesis

text: And one of them opening his ſacke, to geue his beaſt prouender in the inne, beholding the money in the ſackes mouth,
label: Genesis

text: he ſaid to his brethren: My money is geuen me againe, behold it is in the ſacke. And being aſtonyed, and trubled amongeſt themſelues, they ſaid: What is this, that God hath done vnto vs?
label: Genesis

text: And they came to Iacob their father into the land of Chanaan, and they told him al thinges that had chanced vnto them, ſaying:
label: Genesis

text: The lord of the land ſpake to vs roughly, and thought vs to be ſpies of the prouince,
label: Genesis

text: to whom we anſwered: We are men of peace, neither do we attempt any treachery.
label: Genesis

text: We are twelue brethren borne of one father: one is not liuing, the youngeſt is with our father in the Land of Chanaan.
label: Genesis

text: Who ſaid to vs: Thus shal I trie that you be men of peace: Leaue one of your brethren with me, and take ye prouiſion neceſſarie for your houſes, and goe your wayes,
label: Genesis

text: and bring your youngeſt brother to me, that I may know you are not ſpies: and you may receiue this felowe againe, that is kept in priſon: and afterwardes may haue licence to bye what thinges you wil.
label: Genesis

text: This being ſaid, when they powred out their corne, euerie man found his money tied in the mouth of the ſackes: and al being aſtonyed together,
label: Genesis

text: their father Iacob ſaid: You haue made me to be without children, Ioſeph is not liuing, Simeon is kept in bondes, and Beniamin you wil take away: al theſe euils are fallen vpon me.
label: Genesis

text: To whom Ruben anſwered: Kil my two ſonnes, if I bring him not againe to thee: deliuer him into my hand, and I wil reſtore him vnto thee.
label: Genesis

text: But he ſaid: My ſonne shal not go downe with you: his brother is dead, and he alone is remayning: if any aduerſitie shal chance to him in the land to the which you goe, you shal bring downe my hoare heares with ſorowe vnto hel.
label: Genesis

text: IN THE meane time the famine did oppreſſe al the land very ſore.
label: Genesis

text: And the prouiſion being ſpent, which they had bronght out of Ægypt, Iacob ſaid to his ſonnes: Goe againe, and by vs a little victual.
label: Genesis

text: Iudas anſwered: That ſame man denounced vnto vs vnder atteſtation of an oath, ſaing: You shal not ſee my face, vnleſſe you bring your youngeſt brother with you.
label: Genesis

text: If therfore thou wilt ſend him with vs, we wil goe forward together, and wil bye neceſſaries for thee:
label: Genesis

text: but if thou wilt not, we wil not goe: for the man, as we haue often ſaid, denounced vnto vs ſaing: You shal not ſee my face without your youngeſt brother.
label: Genesis

text: Iſrael ſaid to them: You haue done this to my miſerie, in that you told him that you had an other brother alſo.
label: Genesis

text: But they anſwered: The man asked vs in order our progenie: if our father liued: if we had a brother: and we anſwered him conſequently to that which he demanded: could we know that he would ſay: Bring hither your brother with you?
label: Genesis

text: Iudas alſo ſaid to his father: Send the boy with me, that we may ſet forwarde, and may liue: leſt we and our litle ones die.
label: Genesis

text: I take vpon me the boy: require him of my hand, vnleſſe I bring him againe, and reſtore him to thee, I wil be guiltie of ſinne againſt thee for euer.
label: Genesis

text: If delay had not bene made, we had bene come now the ſecond time.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore Iſrael their father ſaid to them: If it muſt nedes be ſo; do that you wil: take of the beſt fruites of the land in your veſſels, and carie to the man for preſents, a courteſie of roſen, and of honey, and of incenſe, of mirhe, of terebinth, and of almondes.
label: Genesis

text: Duble money alſo carie with you: and recarie that you founde in your ſackes, leſt perhaps it was done by an errour:
label: Genesis

text: but take alſo your brother, and goe to the man.
label: Genesis

text: And my God almightie make him fauorable vnto you: and ſend backe with you your brother, whom he keepeth, and this Beniamin: as for me I shal be deſolate without children.
label: Genesis

text: The men therfore tooke the preſentes, and the duble money, and Beniamin: and went downe inro Ægypt, and ſtood before Ioſeph.
label: Genesis

text: Whom when he had ſeene, and Beniamin withal, he commanded the ſteward of his houſe; ſaing: Bring in the men into the houſe, and kil victimes, and prepare a feaſt: becauſe they ſhal eate with me at noone.
label: Genesis

text: He did that which was commanded him, and brought the men into the houſe.
label: Genesis

text: And there being ſore afraied, they ſaid one to an other: becauſe of the money, which we caried backe the firſt time in our ſackes, we are brought in: that he may turne vpon vs a falſe accuſation, and forceibly bring both vs, and our aſſes into bondage.
label: Genesis

text: Wherfore in the verie dore ſtepping to the ſteward of the houſe,
label: Genesis

text: they ſpake: Sir we deſire thee to heare vs. Now once before we came downe to bye prouiſion:
label: Genesis

text: which being bought, when we were come to the Inne, we opened our ſackes, and found our money in the mouthes of the ſackes: which we haue now brought againe in the ſame weight.
label: Genesis

text: But we haue brought other money beſides, to bye the thinges that are neceſſarie for vs: our conſcience is not priuie, who put it in our bagges.
label: Genesis

text: But he anſwered: Peace be with you, feare you not: your God, and the God of your father hath geuen you treaſures in your ſackes. for the money, which you gaue me, I haue for good. And he brought forth Simeon vnto them.
label: Genesis

text: And being brought into the houſe, he fetched water, and they waſhed their feete, and he gaue prouender to their aſſes.
label: Genesis

text: But they made readie the preſentes, til Ioſeph should come in at noone: for they had heard that they should eate bread there.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore Ioſeph came in to his houſe, and they offered him preſentes holding them in their handes, and they adored proſtrate to the ground.
label: Genesis

text: But he curteouſly reſaluting them, asked them ſaying: Is the old man your father in health, of whom you told me? Is he yet liuing?
label: Genesis

text: Who anſwered: Thy ſeruant our father is in health, he is yet liuing. And bowing themſelues, they adored him.
label: Genesis

text: And Ioſeph lifting vp his eyes, ſawe Beniamin his brother of the ſame mother, and ſaid: Is this your young brother, of whom you told me? And againe: God, ſaith he, be merciful vnto thee my ſonne.
label: Genesis

text: And he made haſt becauſe his hart was moued vpon his brother, and teares brake forth: and entring into his chamber he wept.
label: Genesis

text: And when he had washed his face, comming forth againe, he refrained himſelfe, and ſaid: Set bread on the table.
label: Genesis

text: Which being ſet downe, to Ioſeph apart, and to his brethren apart, to the Ægyptians alſo that did eate with him apart (for it is vnlawful for the Ægyptians to eate with the Hebrewes, and they thinke ſuch a feaſt prophane),
label: Genesis

text: they ſate before him, the firſt begotten according to his firſt-birth, and the youngeſt according to his age. And they maruailed out of meaſure,
label: Genesis

text: taking the portions that they receiued of him: and the greater portion came to Beniamin, ſo that it exceeded by fiue partes. And they dranke and were inebriated with him.
label: Genesis

text: AND Ioſeph commanded the ſteward of his houſe, ſaing: Fil their ſackes with corne, as much as they can hold: and put the money of euerie one in the top of his ſack.
label: Genesis

text: And in the ſackes mouth of the younger put my ſiluer cup, and the price which he gaue for the wheat. And it was ſo done.
label: Genesis

text: And when the morning roſe, they were diſmiſt with their aſſes.
label: Genesis

text: And they were now departed out of the citie, and had gone forward a little way: then Ioſeph ſending for the ſteward of his houſe, ſaid: Ariſe, quoth he, and purſew the men: and ouertaking them ſay to them: Why haue you rendred euil for good?
label: Genesis

text: The cup which you haue ſtollen, is that wherin my lord doth drinke, and wherin he is wont to diuine: you haue done a verie euil thing.
label: Genesis

text: He did as he had commanded. And hauing ouertaken them, he ſpake to them in the ſame order.
label: Genesis

text: Who anſwered: Why doth our lord ſpeake ſo, as though thy ſeruautes had committed ſo haynous a fact?
label: Genesis

text: The money, that we found in the top of our ſackes, we recaried to thee from the land of Chanaan: and how foloweth it, that we haue ſtollen out of thy lordes houſe, gold or ſiluer?
label: Genesis

text: With whom ſoeuer of thy ſeruantes that shal be found, which thou ſeekeſt, let him die, and we wil be the bondmen of our lord.
label: Genesis

text: Who ſaid to them: Be it done according to your ſentence: with whom ſoeuer it shal be found, be he my bondman, and you shal be guiltles.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore in haſte taking downe their ſackes vpon the ground, euerie man opened.
label: Genesis

text: Which when he had ſearched, beginning from the elder euen to the youngeſt, he found the cup in Beniamins ſack.
label: Genesis

text: But they renting their garments, and loading their aſſes againe, returned into the towne.
label: Genesis

text: And Iudas foremoſt with his brethren entred in to Ioſeph (for he was not yet gone out of the place) and they fel togeather before him on the ground.
label: Genesis

text: To whom he ſaid: Why would you doe ſoe? know you not that there is not the like to me in the ſcience of diuining.
label: Genesis

text: To whom Iudas ſaid: What shal we anſwere, my lord? or what shal we ſpeake, or be able iuſtly to pretend? God hath found the iniquitie of thy ſeruantes: loe we are al bondmen to my lord, both we, & he, with whom the cup was found.
label: Genesis

text: Ioſeph anſwered: God forbid that I should ſo doe: he that ſtole the cup, the ſame be my bondman: and goe you free vnto your father.
label: Genesis

text: And Iudas approching nearer, ſaid boldly: I beſeech thee my lord, let thy ſeruant ſpeake a word in thine eares, and be not angrie with thy ſeruant: for after Pharao thou art,
label: Genesis

text: my lord. Thou dideſt aske thy ſeruantes the firſt time: Haue you a father or a brother?
label: Genesis

text: and we anſwered thee my lord: We haue a father an old man, and a little boy, that was borne in his old age; whoſe brother by the mother is dead: and his mother hath him only, and his father loueth him tenderly.
label: Genesis

text: And thou ſaidſt to thy ſeruants: Bring him hither to me, and I wil ſet myn eyes on him.
label: Genesis

text: We ſuggeſted to my lord: The boy can not leaue his father: for if he leaue him, he wil die.
label: Genesis

text: And thou ſaideſt to thy ſeruants: Vnleſſe your youngeſt brother come with you, you shal no more ſee my face.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore when we were gone vp to thy ſeruant our father, we told him al things that my lord did ſpeake.
label: Genesis

text: And our father ſaid: Goe againe, and bye vs a litle wheate.
label: Genesis

text: To whom we ſaid: We can not goe: if our youngeſt brother shal goe downe with vs, we wil ſet forward together: otherwiſe he being abſent, we dare not ſee the mans face.
label: Genesis

text: Wherunto he anſwered: You know that my wife bare me two.
label: Genesis

text: One went forth, and you ſaid: A beaſt did deuour him: and hitherto he appeareth not.
label: Genesis

text: If you take this alſo, and ought befal him in the way, you shal bring downe my hoare hayres with ſorow vnto hel.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore if I shal enter to thy ſeruant our father, and the boy be wanting (wheras his life dependeth vpon the life of him)
label: Genesis

text: and he shal ſee that he is not with vs, he wil dye, & thy ſeruants shal bring downe his hoare hayres with ſorow vnto hel.
label: Genesis

text: Let me be thy proper ſeruant, that did take him into my protection and promiſed ſaying: Vnleſſe I bring him againe I wil be guilty of ſinne againſt my father for euer.
label: Genesis

text: I therfore thy ſeruant wil tary in ſteed of the childe in the ſeruice of my lord, and let the childe goe vp with his brethren.
label: Genesis

text: For I can not returne to my father, the childe being abſent; leſt I ſtand by a witnes of the calamitie, that shal oppreſſe my father.
label: Genesis

text: IOSEPH could no longer refrayne manie ſtanding by in preſence: wherupon he commanded that al should goe forth, and no ſtranger should be preſent at their acknowledging one of another.
label: Genesis

text: And he lifted vp his voice with weeping, which the Ægyptians heard, and al the houſe of Pharao.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid to his Brethren: I am Ioſeph: is my father yet liuing? His brethren could not anſwer him being teribly aſtonyed out of meaſure.
label: Genesis

text: To whom gently he ſaid: Come hither to me. And when they were come nere him, I am, quoth he, Ioſeph, your brother, whom you ſolde into Ægypt.
label: Genesis

text: Be not affraid, neither let it ſeeme to you a hard caſe that you did ſel me into theſe countries: for God ſent me before you into Ægypt for your preſeruation.
label: Genesis

text: For it is two yeares ſince the famin begain to be vpon the earth, and yet fiue yeares remaine, wherin there can be neither earing nor reaping.
label: Genesis

text: And God ſent me before, that you may be preſerued vpon the earth, and may haue victuals to liue.
label: Genesis

text: Not by your counſail, but by the wil of God was I ſent hither: who hath made me as it were a father to Pharao, and lord of his whole houſe, and prince in al the land of Ægypt.
label: Genesis

text: Make haſt and get ye vp to my father, and you shal ſay to him: Thy ſonne Ioſeph willeth thus: God hath made me lord of the whole land of Ægypt: come downe to me, tary not.
label: Genesis

text: And thou shalt dwel in the land of Geſſen: and thou shalt be nere me thou and thy ſonnes, and thy ſonnes children, thy shepe, and thy heardes. and al things that thou doſt poſſeſſe.
label: Genesis

text: And there I wil fede thee (for yet there are fiue yeares of famine remayning) leſt both thou perish, and thy houſe, & al things that thou doſt poſſeſſe.
label: Genesis

text: Behold, your eyes, and the eyes of my brother Beniamin doe ſee, that it is my mouth that ſpeaketh vnto you.
label: Genesis

text: Report to my father my whole glorie and al things that you haue ſeene in Ægypt: make haſt, and bring him to me.
label: Genesis

text: And falling vpon the neck of his brother Beniamin, embracing him he wept: he alſo in like maner weeping vpon his neck.
label: Genesis

text: And Ioſeph kiſſed al his brethren, and wept vpon euerie one: after which things they were bold to ſpeake vnto him.
label: Genesis

text: And it was heard of, and very famouſly reported abrode in the kings courte: The brethren of Ioſeph are come: and Pharao was glad, and al his familie.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſpake to Ioſeph that he should command his brethren, ſaying: Loading your beaſts goe into the Land of Chanaan,
label: Genesis

text: and take thence your father and kinne, and come to me: and I wil geue you al the good things of Ægypt, that you may eate the marow of the land.
label: Genesis

text: Geue commandement alſo that they take waynes out of the land of Ægypt, for the carage of their litle ones and wyues: and ſay: Take vp your father, and make haſt to come with al ſpede.
label: Genesis

text: Neither doe you leaue any thing of your houshould ſtuffe: for al the riches of Ægypt, shal be yours.
label: Genesis

text: And the ſonnes of Iſrael did as it was commanded them. To whom Ioſeph gaue waynes according to Pharaos commandement: and victuals for the way.
label: Genesis

text: He bad alſo to be brought vp for euery one two robes: but to Beniamin he gaue three hundred peeces of ſiluer with fiue robes of the beſt:
label: Genesis

text: ſending to his father as much money and rayment, adding beſides them he aſſes that should carie of al the riches of Ægypt, and as many shee aſſes, carying wheat for the iourney and bread.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore he diſmiſſed his brethren, and when they were departing he ſaid to them: Be not angrie in the way.
label: Genesis

text: Who going vp out of Ægypt, came into the land of Chanaan to their father Iacob.
label: Genesis

text: And they told him ſaying: Ioſeph thy ſonne is liuing: and he ruleth in al the Land of Ægypt. Which when Iacob heard, awaking as it were out of a heauie ſleepe, notwithſtanding did not beleeue them.
label: Genesis

text: They on the contrarie ſide reported the whole order of the thing. And when he ſawe the waynes and al things that he had ſent, his ſpirit reuiued,
label: Genesis

text: and he ſaid: It ſufficeth me if Ioſeph my ſonne be liuing yet: I wil goe, and ſee him before I dye.
label: Genesis

text: AND Iſrael taking his iourney, with al things that he had, came to the wel of the oath, and killing there victimes to the God of his father Iſaac.
label: Genesis

text: He heard him by a viſion of the night calling him, and ſaying vnto him: Iacob, Iacob. To whom he anſwered: Loe here I am.
label: Genesis

text: God ſaid to him: I am the moſt mightie God of thy father: feare not, goe downe into Ægipt, for into a great nation wil I make thee there.
label: Genesis

text: I wil goe downe with thee thither, and thence wil I bring thee returning: Ioſeph alſo shal put his handes vpon thine eyes.
label: Genesis

text: And Iacob roſe vp from the wel of the oath: and his ſonnes tooke him vp, with their little ones and wiues in the waynes, which Pharao had ſent to carie the old man,
label: Genesis

text: and al that he had poſſeſſed in the Land of Chanaan: and he came into Ægypt with al his ſede,
label: Genesis

text: his ſonnes, and nephewes, daughters, and al his progenie together.
label: Genesis

text: And theſe are the names of the children of Iſrael, that entred into Ægypt, him ſelfe with his children. His firſt-begotten Ruben.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Ruben: Henoch and Phallu and Heſron and Charmi.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Simeon: Iamuel and Iamin and Ahod, and Iachin and Sohar, and Saul the ſonne of Chananiteſſe.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Leui: Gerſon and Caath and Merari.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Iuda: Her and Onan & Sela and Phares and Zara. And Her and Onan died in the land of Chanaan. And there were ſonnes borne to Phares: Heſron and Hamul.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Iſſachar: Thola and Phua and Iob and Semron.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Zabulon: Sared & Elon and Iahelel.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe are the ſonnes of Lia, which she bare in Meſopotamia of Syria with Dina his daughter. Al the ſoules of his ſonnes and daughters, are thirtie three.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Gad: Sephion and Haggi and Siuni and Eſebon and Heri and Arodi and Areli.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Aſer: Iamne and Ieſua and Ieſſui and Beria, Sara alſo their ſiſter. The ſonnes of Beria: Heber and Melchiel.
label: Genesis

text: theſe be the ſonnes of Zelpha, whom Laban gaue to Lia his daughter. and theſe she bare to Iacob ſixtene ſoules.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Rachel Iacobs wife: Ioſeph and Beniamin.
label: Genesis

text: And there were ſonnes borne to Ioſeph, in the Land of Ægypt, which Aſeneth the daughter of Putiphar prieſt of Heliopolis bare to him: Manaſſes and Ephraim.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Beniamin: Bela and Bechor and Aſbel and Gera and Naaman and Echi and Ros and Mophim and Ophim and Ared.
label: Genesis

text: theſe be the ſonnes of Rachel, which ſhe bare to Iacob: al the ſoules, fourtene.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Dan: Huſim.
label: Genesis

text: The ſonnes of Nepthali: Iaziel and Guni and Ieſer and Sallem.
label: Genesis

text: Theſe be the ſonnes of Bala, whom Laban gaue to Rachel his daughter: and theſe she bare to Iacob: al the ſoules, ſeuen.
label: Genesis

text: Al the ſoules, that entred with Iacob into Ægypt, and that came out of his thighe, beſides his ſonnes wiues, ſixtie ſix.
label: Genesis

text: And the ſonnes of Ioſeph, that were borne to him in the land of Ægypt, two ſoules. Al the ſoules of the houſe of Iacob, that entred into Ægypt, were ſeuentie.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſent Iudas before him to Ioſeph, that he ſhould tel him, and he should come into Geſſen to meete him.
label: Genesis

text: Whither when he was come, Ioſeph adreſſing his chariot went vp to mete his father, vnto the ſame place: and ſeing him fel vpon his neck, and as they embraced he wept
label: Genesis

text: And his father ſaid to Ioſeph: Now wil I die with ioy, becauſe I haue ſeene thy face, and do leaue thee aliue.
label: Genesis

text: But he ſpake to his brethren, and to al his fathers houſe: I wil goe vp, and wil tel Pharao, and wil ſay to him: My brethren, and my fathers houſe, that were in the Land of Chanaan, are come to me:
label: Genesis

text: and the men are paſtours of sheepe, and their trade is to feede flockes: their cattel, and heardes, and al that they could haue, they haue brought with them.
label: Genesis

text: And when he shal cal you, and shal ſay: What is your trade?
label: Genesis

text: You shal anſwer; We thy ſernantes are paſtours, from our infancie vntil this preſent, both we and our fathers. And this you shal ſay, that you may dwel in the Land of Geſſen, becauſe he Ægyptians deteſt al paſtours of sheepe.
label: Genesis

text: IOSEPH therfore going in told Pharao, ſaing: My father & brethren, their sheepe and heardes, & al thinges that they poſſeſſe, are come out of the Land of Chanaan: & behold they ſtay in the Land of Geſſen.
label: Genesis

text: The vtmoſt alſo of his brethren fiue perſons he preſented before the king:
label: Genesis

text: whom he asked: What trade haue you? They anſwered: We thy ſeruantes are paſtours of sheepe, both we, and our fathers.
label: Genesis

text: We are come to ſoiourne in the land, becauſe there is no graſſe for thy ſeruantes flockes, the famine being very ſore in the land of Chanaan: and we deſire thee to command that we thy ſeruantes may be in the Land of Geſſen.
label: Genesis

text: And the King therfore ſaid to Ioſeph: Thy father and thy brethren are come to thee.
label: Genesis

text: The Land of Ægypt, is in thy ſight: make them to dwel in the beſt place, and deliuer them the Land of Geſſen. And if ſo be thou knowe that there are induſtrious men among them, appoint them maiſters of my cattel.
label: Genesis

text: After this Ioſeph brought in his father to the King, and ſet him before him: who bleſſing him,
label: Genesis

text: and being asked of him: How manie be the dayes of the yeares of thy life?
label: Genesis

text: He anſwered: The dayes of the pilgrimage of my life are an hundred thirtie yeares, few, and euil, and they are not come to the dayes of my fathers, in which they were pilgrimes.
label: Genesis

text: And bleſſing the king, he went forth.
label: Genesis

text: But Ioſeph gaue poſſeſſion to his father and his brethren in Ægypt, in the beſt place of the land, in Rhameſſes, as Pharao had commanded.
label: Genesis

text: And he nourished them, and al his fathers houſe, alowing victuales to euerie one.
label: Genesis

text: For in the whole world there wanted bread, and famine oppreſſed the land, eſpecially of Ægypt and Chanaan.
label: Genesis

text: Out of which he gethered together al the money for the ſelling of corne, and brought it in vnto the kings treaſure.
label: Genesis

text: And when the byers wanted money, al Ægypt came to Ioſeph, ſaying: Geue vs bread: why die we before thee, our money failing?
label: Genesis

text: To whom he anſwered: Bring your cattel, and for them I wil geue you victuales, if you haue not to pay.
label: Genesis

text: Which when they had brought, he gaue them ſuſtenance for horſes, and sheepe, and oxen, and aſſes: and he ſuſtayned them that yeare for the exchange of the cattel.
label: Genesis

text: And they came the ſecond yeare, and ſaid to him: We wil not conceale from our lord, that our money fayling, our cattel withal haue fayled: neither art thou ignorant, that we haue nothing beſides our bodies and land.
label: Genesis

text: Why therfore shal we die in thy ſight? both we and our land wil be thyne: bye vs to be the kings bondmen, and geue vs ſede, leſt for default of tillers the land be turned into a wildernes.
label: Genesis

text: Ioſeph therfore bought al the Land of Ægypt, euerie man ſelling his poſſeſſions for the greatnes of the famine. And he brought it vnder Pharaos handes,
label: Genesis

text: and al the people therof from the fardeſt ends of Ægypt, euen to the vttermoſt coaſts therof,
label: Genesis

text: ſauing the land of the Prieſts, which the king had deliuered them: to whom alſo a certaine alowance of victuals was geuen out of the cōmon barnes, and therfore they were not driuen to ſel their poſſeſſions.
label: Genesis

text: Ioſeph therfore ſaid to the people: Behold as you ſee, Pharao poſſeſſeth both you and your land: take ſede, and ſowe the fields,
label: Genesis

text: that you may haue corne. The fifth part you shal geue to the king: the other foure I am content you shal haue for ſede, and for foode to your families and your children.
label: Genesis

text: Who anſwered: Our life is in thy hand: only let our lord haue a reſpect vnto vs, and we wil gladly ſerue the king.
label: Genesis

text: From that time vntil this preſent day in the whole land of Ægypt, the fifth part is paied to the kings, and it became as it were a lawe, ſauing the land of the prieſts, which was free from this condition.
label: Genesis

text: Iſrael therfore dwelt in Ægypt, that is, in the Land of Geſſen, and poſſeſſed it: and was increaſed, and multiplied exceedingly.
label: Genesis

text: And he liued in it ſeuenteene yeares: and al the dayes of his life came to an hundred fourtie ſeuen yeares.
label: Genesis

text: And when he ſawe that the day of his death approched, he called his ſonne Ioſeph, and ſaid to him: If I haue found grace in thy ſight, put thy hand vnder my thigh: and thou ſhalt doe me this mercie and truth, not to bury me in Ægypt:
label: Genesis

text: but I wil ſleepe with my fathers, and take me away out of this land, and burie me in the ſepulchre of my anceſters. To whom Ioſeph anſwered: I wil doe that thou haſt commanded.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid: Sweate then to me. Who ſwearing, Iſrael adored God, turning to the beds head.
label: Genesis

text: THESE things being ſo done, it was told Ioſeph that his father was ſicke: who, taking his two ſonnes Manaſſes and Ephraim, went forward.
label: Genesis

text: And it was told the old man: Behold thy ſonne Ioſeph cometh to thee. Who being ſtrengthned ſate on his bed.
label: Genesis

text: And Ioſeph being entred in to him, he ſaid: God almightie appeared to me in Luza, which is in the Land of Chanaan: and He bleſſed me,
label: Genesis

text: and ſayd: I wil increaſe, and multiplie thee, and make thee into multitudes of peoples: and I wil geue thee this land, and to thy ſede after thee for an euerlaſting poſſeſſion.
label: Genesis

text: Thy two ſonnes therfore, which were borne to thee in the Land of Ægypt before I came hither to thee, ſhalbe myne: Ephraim and Manaſſes, as Ruben and Simeon ſhalbe reputed to me.
label: Genesis

text: But the reſt begotten of thee after them, shalbe thyne, and shal be called by the name of their brethren in their poſſeſſions.
label: Genesis

text: For vnto me, when I came out of Meſopotamia, Rachel dyed in the land of Chanaan in the very iourney, and it was ſpring time: and I entered into Ephrata, and buried her by the way ſide to Ephrata, which by an other name is called Bethleem.
label: Genesis

text: And ſeeing his ſonnes he ſaid to him: Who are theiſe?
label: Genesis

text: He anſweted: They are my ſonnes, whom God hath geuen me in this place. Bring them, quoth he, to me, that I may bleſſe them.
label: Genesis

text: For Iſraels eyes were dymme by reaſon of very great age, and he could not ſee clearly. And when they were ſet beſide him, kiſſing and embracing them,
label: Genesis

text: he ſaid to his ſonne: I am not defrauded of thy ſight: moreouer God hath shewed me thy ſede.
label: Genesis

text: And when Ioſeph had taken them from his fathers lappe, he adored proſtrate vnto the ground.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſet Ephraim on his right hand, that is, on the left hand of Iſrael: but Manaſſes on his owne left hand, to wit, on his fathers right hand, and put them nere to him.
label: Genesis

text: Who ſtretching forth his right hand, put it vpon the head of Ephraim the younger brother: and the left vpon the head of Manaſſes, that was the elder, changing handes.
label: Genesis

text: And Iacob bleſſed the ſonnes of Ioſeph, and ſaid: God, in whoſe ſight my fathers Abraham and Iſaac haue walked, God that feedeth me from my youth vntil this preſent day:
label: Genesis

text: The Angel that deliuereth me from al euils, bleſſe theſe children: and be my name called vpon them, the names alſo of my fathers Abraham, and Iſaac, and grow they into a multitude vpon the earth.
label: Genesis

text: And Ioſeph ſeing that his father had put his right hand vpon the head of Ephraim, tooke it heauily: and taking his fathers hand he went about to lift it from Ephraims head, and to remoue it vpon the head of Manaſſes.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid to his father; It is not conuenient father ſo to be: becauſe this is the firſt begotten put thy right hand vpon his head.
label: Genesis

text: Who refuſing, ſaid: I know my ſonne, I know: and this ſame in dede shal be into peoples, and shal be multiplied: but his younger brother ſhal be greater then he: and his ſede shal growe into nations.
label: Genesis

text: And he bleſſed them at that time, ſaying: In thee shal Iſrael be bleſſed, and it shalbe ſaid: God do vnto thee as vnto Ephraim, and as vnto Manaſſes. And he ſette Ephraim before Manaſſes.
label: Genesis

text: And he ſaid to Ioſeph his ſonne: Behold I dye, and God wil be with you, and wil bring you backe into the land of your fathers.
label: Genesis

text: I doe geue thee one portion aboue thy brethren, which I tooke out of the hand of the Amorrhean with my ſword and bowe.
label: Genesis

text: AND Iacob called his ſonnes, and ſaid to them: Come together, that I may shew you the things that shal come to you in the laſt dayes.
label: Genesis

text: Come together, and heare you ſonnes of Iacob, heare ye Iſrael your father:
label: Genesis

text: Ruben my firſt begotten, thou art my ſtrength, and the begining of my ſorow: former in giftes, greater in empyre.
label: Genesis

text: Thou art poured out as water, encreaſe thou not: becauſe thou diddeſt aſcend thy fathers bed, and diddeſt defile his coutch.
label: Genesis

text: Simeon and Leui brethren: veſſels of iniquitie warring.
label: Genesis

text: Into their counſel come not my ſoule, and in their congregation be not my glorie: becauſe in their furie they ſlew a man, and in their wilfulnes they vndermined a wall.
label: Genesis

text: Curſed be their furie, becauſe it is ſtubborne: and their indignation, becauſe it is hard: I wil diuide them in Iacob, and wil diſperſe them in Iſrael.
label: Genesis

text: Iudas, thee thy brethren shal praiſe: thy hand shalbe in the neck of thyne enemies: thy fathers children shal adore thee.
label: Genesis

text: A lions whelp Iudas: to the pray my ſonne thou didſt aſcend: taking thy reſt thou didſt lye as a lion, and as it were a lyoneſſe, who shal raiſe him vp?
label: Genesis

text: The ſcepter shal not BE TAKEN away from Iudas, and a duke out of his thigh, til he doe come that is to be ſent, and the ſame shal be the expectation of the gentiles.
label: Genesis

text: Tying to the vineyard his colt, and to the vine, o my ſonne, his the aſſe. He shal wash his ſtole in wine, and in the bloud of the grape his cloke.
label: Genesis

text: His eyes are more beautiful then wine, and his teeth whiter then milke.
label: Genesis

text: Zabulon shal dwel in the shore of the ſea, and in the road of shippes reaching as farre as Sidon.
label: Genesis

text: Iſſachar a ſtrong aſſe lying at reſt betwen the borders.
label: Genesis

text: He ſaw reſt that it was good: and the earth that it was very good: and he put vnder his shoulder to cary, and became ſeruing vnder tributes.
label: Genesis

text: Dan shal iudge his owne people as alſo an other tribe in Iſrael.
label: Genesis

text: Be Dan a ſnake in the way, a ſerpent in the path, byting the hooſſes of the horſe, that his ryder may fal backward.
label: Genesis

text: I wil expect THY SALVATION o Lord.
label: Genesis

text: Gad, the gyrded shal fight before him: and himſelf shal be gyrded backward.
label: Genesis

text: Aſer, his bread is fat, and he shal geue daynties to kinges.
label: Genesis

text: Nepthali, a hart let forth, & geuing ſpeeches of beautie.
label: Genesis

text: Ioſeph a child encreaſing, encreaſing and comelie to behold: the daughters courſed to and for vpon the wall.
label: Genesis

text: But the dart men did exaſperate him, & brawled, and enuied him.
label: Genesis

text: His bowe ſate vpon the ſtrong, & the bands of his armes and his handes were diſſolued, by the handes of the mightie of Iacob: thence came forth a paſtour, the ſtone of Iſrael.
label: Genesis

text: The God of thy father shal be thy helper, & the Almightie shal bleſſe thee with the bleſſinges of heauen from aboue, with the bleſſinges of the deapth that lieth beneath, with the bleſſings of the pappes and of the wombe.
label: Genesis

text: The bleſſinges of thy father were ſtrengthned with the bleſſings of his fathers: vntil the deſire of the eternal hilles came: be they vpon the head of Ioſeph, & vpon the crowne of the Nazarite among his brethren.
label: Genesis

text: Beniamin a rauening woolfe, in the morning shal eate the pray, and in the euening shal diuide the ſpoile.
label: Genesis

text: Al theſe in the tribes of Iſrael twelue: theſe things ſpake their father to them, and he bleſſed euerie one, with their proper bleſſings
label: Genesis

text: And he commanded them, ſaying: I am geathered vnto my people: burie you me with my fathers in the duble caue, which is in the field of Ephron the Hethite,
label: Genesis

text: againſt Mambre in the Land of Chanaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hethite for a poſſeſſion to burie in.
label: Genesis

text: There they buried him, & Sara his wife: there was Iſaac buried with Rebecca his wife: there alſo Lia doth lie buried.
label: Genesis

text: And when he had finished the precepts wherwith he inſtructed his ſonnes, he plucked vp his feet vpon the bed, and died: & he was put vnto his people.
label: Genesis

text: WHICH Ioſeph ſeeing, fel vpon his fathers face weeping and kiſſing him.
label: Genesis

text: And he commanded his ſeruantes the phyſitians, that they should embawme his father with ſpices.
label: Genesis

text: Who fufilling his commandements, there paſſed fourtie dayes: for this was the maner of corſes embawmed, and Ægypt mourned him ſeuentie daies.
label: Genesis

text: And the mourning-time being expired, Ioſeph ſpake to the familie of Pharao: If I haue found grace in your ſight, ſpeake in the eares of Pharao:
label: Genesis

text: for ſo much as my father did adiure me, ſaing: Behold I die, in my ſepulchre which I digged for my ſelfe in the land of Chanaan, thou shalt burie me. I wil goe vp therfore, and burie my father, and returne.
label: Genesis

text: And Pharao ſaid to him: Goe vp and burie thy father as thou waſt adiured.
label: Genesis

text: Who going vp, there went with him al the ancients of Pharaos houſe, and al the elders of the Land of Ægypt:
label: Genesis

text: the houſe of Ioſeph with his brethren, ſauing their little ones, and the flockes and heards, which they had left in the Land of Geſſen.
label: Genesis

text: He had alſo in his traine chariotts and horſemen: and it became no ſmal multitude.
label: Genesis

text: And they came to the floore of Atad, which is ſituate beyond Iordaine: where celebrating the exequies with great and vehement mourning, they ſpent ful ſeuen dayes.
label: Genesis

text: Which when the Inhabiters of the Land of Chanaan had ſeene, they ſaid: This is a great mourning vnto the Ægyptians. And therfore the name of that place was called, The mourning of Ægypt.
label: Genesis

text: Therfore the ſonnes of Iacob did as he commanded them:
label: Genesis

text: and carying him into the Land of Chanaan, they buried him in the duble caue, which Abraham had bought with the field for a poſſeſſion to burie in of Ephron the Hethite againſt Mambre.
label: Genesis

text: And Ioſeph returned into Ægypt with his brethren, and with al the traine, his father being buried.
label: Genesis

text: After whoſe death, his brethren fearing, and talking one with an other: Leſt perhaps he be mindful of the iniurie which he ſuffered, and requite vs al the euil that we haue done,
label: Genesis

text: they aduertiſed him ſaing: Thy father commanded vs before he died,
label: Genesis

text: that we ſhould ſay thus much to thee in his wordes: I beſech that thou forget the wicked fact of thy brethren, and the ſinne & malice which they haue exerciſed againſt thee: we alſo deſire thee, that to the ſeruants of the God of thy father thou remit this iniquitie. Whom when Ioſeph had heard he wept.
label: Genesis

text: And his brethren came to him: and adoring proſtrate on the ground they ſaid: We are thy ſeruantes.
label: Genesis

text: To whom he anſwered: Feare not: can we reſiſt the wil of God?
label: Genesis

text: You thought euil againſt me: but God turned that into good, that he might exalt me, as preſently you ſee, and might ſaue many peoples.
label: Genesis

text: Feare not: I wil feed you & your litle ones, and he comforted them, and ſpake gently & mildly.
label: Genesis

text: And he dwelt in Ægypt, with al his fathers houſe: and liued an hundred and tenne yeares. And he ſawe the children of Ephraim vnto the third generation. Alſo the children of Machir the ſonne of Manaſſes were borne in Ioſephs knees
label: Genesis

text: Which thinges being done, he ſpake to his brethren: After my death God wil viſite you, and wil make you goe vp out of this land, to the land which he ſware to Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob.
label: Genesis

text: And when he had adiured them and ſaid: God wil viſite you, carie my bones with you out of this place:
label: Genesis

text: he died, being an hundred and tenne yeares old. And being embawmed with ſpices, was put in a coffin in Ægypt.
label: Genesis

text: THESE be the names of the children of Iſrael, that entred into Ægypt with Iacob: they did enter in euerie one with their houſes,
label: Exodus

text: Ruben, Simeon, Leui, Iudas,
label: Exodus

text: Iſſachar, Zabulon, and Beniamin,
label: Exodus

text: Dan, and Neptali, Gad, and Aſer.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore al the ſoules that came out of Iacobs thigh, were ſeuentie: and Ioſeph was in Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: Who being dead, and al his brethren, and al that generation,
label: Exodus

text: the children of Iſrael increaſed, and as it were ſpringing vp did multiplie: and growing ſtrong exceedingly, filled the land.
label: Exodus

text: In the meane time there aroſe a new king ouer Ægypt, that knew not Ioſeph:
label: Exodus

text: and he ſaid to his people: Behold the people of the children of Iſrael is much, and ſtronger then we.
label: Exodus

text: Come, let vs wiſely oppreſſe the ſame, leſt perhaps it multiplie: and if there shal be anie warre againſt vs, it ioyne with our enemies, and we being ouerthrowne, they depart out of the land.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore he ſet ouer them maiſters of the workes, to afflict them with burdens: and they built vnto Pharao cities of tabernacles, Phithom, and Rameſſes.
label: Exodus

text: And the more they did oppreſſe them, ſo much the more they multiplied, and increaſed:
label: Exodus

text: and the Ægyptians hated the children of Iſraël, and deriding afflicted them:
label: Exodus

text: and they brought their life into bitternes with the hard workes of clay, and bricke, and with al ſeruice, wherewith they were preſſed in the workes of the earth.
label: Exodus

text: And the King of Ægypt ſaid to the midwiues of the Hebrewes: of whom one was called Sephora, the other Phua,
label: Exodus

text: commanding them: When you shal be midwiues to the Hebrew wemen, and the time of deliuerie is come: if it be a manchild, kil it: if a woman, reſerue her.
label: Exodus

text: But the midwiues feared God, and did not according to the commandement of the king of Ægypt, but preſerued the menchildren.
label: Exodus

text: To whom being called vnto him, the king ſaid: What is this that you ment to do, that you would ſaue the men-children?
label: Exodus

text: Who anſwered: The Hebrew wemem are not as the Ægyptian wemen: for they haue the knowledge to play the mindwife them ſelues, and before we come to them, they are deliuered.
label: Exodus

text: God therfore did wel to the midwiues: and the people encreaſed, and became ſtrong exceedingly.
label: Exodus

text: And becauſe the midwiues feared God, he built them houſes
label: Exodus

text: Pharao therfore commanded al his people, ſaying: Whatſoeuer shal be borne of the male ſex, caſt it into the riuer: whatſoeuer of the female, reſerue it.
label: Exodus

text: AFTER theſe thinges there came forth a man of the houſe of Leui: and he tooke a wife of his owne ſtocke.
label: Exodus

text: Who conceaued, and bare a ſonne: and ſeing him a goodlie one, hid him three monethes.
label: Exodus

text: And when now she could not conceale him, ſhe tooke a basket made of bulrishes, and dawbed it with bitume and pitch: and put with in it the litle infant, and laid him in a ſedgie place by the riuers brinke,
label: Exodus

text: his ſiſter ſtanding a farre of, and conſidering the euent of the thing.
label: Exodus

text: And behold the daughter of Pharao came downe to be washed in the riuer: and her maides walked by the riuers brinke. Who when she ſaw the basket in the ſedges, she ſent one of her handmaides: and when it was brought
label: Exodus

text: opening it, and ſeeing within it an infant crying, hauing pitty on it, ſaid: This is one of the infantes of the Hebtewes.
label: Exodus

text: To whom the childes ſiſter ſaid: Wilt thou that I goe, & cal to thee an Hebrew woman, that may nurſe the litle infant?
label: Exodus

text: She anſwered: Goe. The maid went and called her mother.
label: Exodus

text: To whom Pharaos daughter ſpeaking: Take, quoth ſhe, this child, and nurſe him for me: I wil geue thee thy hyre. The woman tooke, and nurſed the child: and when he was growen, deliuered him to Pharaos daughter.
label: Exodus

text: Whom ſhe adopted into the place of a ſonne, and called him Moyſes, ſaying: Becauſe from the water I did take him.
label: Exodus

text: In thoſe dayes after that Moyſes was growen, he went forth to his brethren: and he ſaw their affliction, and a man that was an Ægyptian ſtriking one of the Hebrewes his brethren.
label: Exodus

text: And when he had looked about hither & thither, and ſaw no man preſent, he ſtroke the Ægyptian, and hid him in the ſand.
label: Exodus

text: And going forth an other day, he ſaw two Hebrewes brawling: and he ſaid to him that did the wrong: Why ſtrikeſt thou thy neighbour?
label: Exodus

text: Who anſwered: Who hath appointed thee prince & iudge ouer vs? Wilt thou kil me, as yeſterday thou dideſt the Ægyptian? Moyſes feared, and ſaid: How is this thing come abroad?
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao heard of this talke, and ſought to kil Moyſes: who fleeing from his ſight, abode in the Land of Madian, and ſate beſide a wel.
label: Exodus

text: And the prieſt of Madian had ſeuen daughters, which were come to draw water: and when the troughes were filled, they deſired to water their fathers flockes.
label: Exodus

text: The shepeheardes came vpon them, and droue them away: and Moyſes aroſe, and defending the maides, watered their sheepe.
label: Exodus

text: Who being returned to Raguel their father, he ſaid to them: Why are you come ſooner then you were woont?
label: Exodus

text: They anſwered: A certaine man an Ægyptian deliuered vs from the hand of the shepheardes: moreouer alſo he drew water with vs, and gaue the sheepe to drinke.
label: Exodus

text: But he ſaid: Where is he? Why haue you let the man goe? cal him that he may eate bread.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore Moyſes ſware that he would dwel with him. And he tooke Sephora his daughter to wife:
label: Exodus

text: who bare him a ſonne, whom he called Gerſam, ſaying: I haue bene a ſtranger in a forren countrey. And she bare an other, whom he called Eliezer, ſaying: for the God of my father my helper hath deliuered me out of the hand of Pharao.
label: Exodus

text: But after much time the king of Ægypt died: and the children of Iſrael groning, cried out becauſe of the workes: and their crie aſcended vnto God from the workes.
label: Exodus

text: And he heard their groning, & remembred the couenant which he made with Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord looked vpon the children of Iſrael and knew them.
label: Exodus

text: AND Moyſes fed the sheepe of Iethro his father in law the prieſt of Madian: and hauing driuen the flock to the inner partes of the deſert, he came to the mountaine of God, Horeb.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middes of a bush: and he ſaw that the bush was on fire, and was not burnt.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes therfore ſaid: I wil goe, and ſee this great viſion, why the bush is not burnt.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſeeing that he went forward to ſee, he called him out of the middes of the bush, and ſaid: Moyſes, Moyſes. Who anſwered: Here I am.
label: Exodus

text: But he ſaid: Approch not hither, looſe of thy shoe from thy feete: for the place, wherin thou ſtandeſt, is holie ground.
label: Exodus

text: And he ſaid: I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Iſaac, and the God of Iacob. Moyſes hid his face: for he durſt not looke againſt God.
label: Exodus

text: To whom our Lord ſaid: I haue ſene the affliction of my people in Ægypt, and I haue heard their crye becauſe of their rigour that ouerſee the workes:
label: Exodus

text: and knowing their ſorow, I am deſcended to deliuer them out of the handes of the Ægyptians, and to bring them out of that land into a land good, and large, into a land that floweth with milke and honie, to the places of the Chananeite, and Hetheite, and Amorrheite, and Pherezeite, and Heueite, and Iebuſeite.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore the crye of the children of Iſrael is come vnto me: and I haue ſene their affliction, wherwith they are oppreſſed by the Ægyptians.
label: Exodus

text: But come, and I wil ſend thee to Pharao, that thou mayeſt being forth my people, the children of Iſrael out of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And moyſes ſaid to God: Who am I that I shal goe to Pharao, and bring forth the children of Iſrael out of Ægypt?
label: Exodus

text: Who ſaid to him: I wil be with thee: and this thou shalt haue for a ſigne, that I haue ſent thee: When thou shalt haue brought my people out of Ægypt, thou shalt ſacrifice to God vpon this mountaine.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes ſaid to God: Loe I shal goe to the children of Iſrael, and ſay to them: The God of your fathers hath ſent me to you. If they shal ſay to me: What is his name? What shal I ſay to them?
label: Exodus

text: God ſaid to Moyſes: I AM WHICH AM. He ſaid: Thus shalt thou ſay to the children of Iſrael: HE WHICH IS, hath ſent me to you.
label: Exodus

text: And God ſaid againe to Moyſes: Theſe thinges shalt thou ſay to the children of Iſrael: The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Iſaac, and the God of Iacob hath ſent me to you: this is my name for euer, and this is my memorial into generation and to generation.
label: Exodus

text: Goe, and geather together the ancients of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: The Lord God of your fathers hath appeared to me, the God of Abraham, the God of Iſaac, and the God of Iacob, ſaying: Viſiting I haue viſited you: and I haue ſene al thinges that haue chanced to you in Ægypt:
label: Exodus

text: and I haue ſaid the word to bring you forth out of the affliction of Ægypt, into the land of the Chananeite, and Hetheite, and Amorrheite, and Pherezeite, and Heueite, and Iebuſeite, to a Land that floweth with milke & honie.
label: Exodus

text: And they shal heare thy voice: and thou ſhalt enter in, thou and the ancientes of Iſrael to the king of Ægypt, and thou shalt ſay to him: The Lord God of the Hebrewes hath called vs: We wil goe three dayes iourney into the wildernes, to ſacrifice vnto the Lord our God.
label: Exodus

text: But I know that the king of Ægypt wil not diſmiſſe you to goe but by mightie hand.
label: Exodus

text: For I wil ſtretch forth my hand, and wil ſtrike Ægypt in al my marueils, which I wil doe in the middes of them: after theſe he wil diſmiſſe you.
label: Exodus

text: And I wil geue grace to this people, in the ſight of the Ægyptians: and when you ſhal goe forth, you shal not depart emptie:
label: Exodus

text: but ech woman ſhal aske of her neighbour and of her that is in houſe with her, veſſels of ſiluer and of gold, and rayment: and you ſhal lay it vpon your ſonnes and daughters, and ſhal ſpoyle Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: MOYSES anſwering ſaid: They wil not beleue me, nor heare my voice, but they wil ſay: Our Lord hath not appeared to thee.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore he ſayd to him: What is that thou holdeſt in thy hand? He anſwered: A rodde.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſayd: Caſt it vpon the ground. He did caſt it, and it was turned into a ſerpent, ſo that Moyſes fled.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſayd: Sretch thy hand, and catch the tayle therof. He ſtretched it forth, & tooke hold of it, and it was turned into a rodde.
label: Exodus

text: That they may beleue, quoth he, that the Lord God of their fathers hath appeared to thee, the God of Abraham, the God of Iſaac, & the God of Iacob.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſayd agayne: Put thy hand into thy boſome. Which when he had put into his boſome, he brought it forth ful of leproſie like ſnow.
label: Exodus

text: Draw backe, quoth he, thy hand into thy boſome. He drew it backe, and brought it forth agayne, & it was like the other flesh.
label: Exodus

text: If they wil not beleue thee, quoth he, nor heare the word of the former ſigne, they wil beleue the word of the ſigne folowing.
label: Exodus

text: And if ſo be they wil beleue neither of theſe two ſignes, nor heare thy voice: take water of the riuer, & powre it out vpon the drie land, and whatſoeuer thou draweſt of the riuer, ſhal be turned into bloud.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes ſayd: I beſeech thee, Lord, I am not eloquent from yeſterday and the day before: and ſince thou haſt ſpoken to thy ſeruant, I haue more impediment & ſlownes of tongue.
label: Exodus

text: Our Lord ſayd to him: Who made the mouth of man? or who framed the dumme and deafe, the ſeeing and the blinde? did not I?
label: Exodus

text: Goe on therfore, and I wil be in thy mouth: & wil teach thee what thou shalt ſpeake.
label: Exodus

text: But he ſayd: I beſech thee, Lord, ſend whom thou wilt ſend.
label: Exodus

text: Our Lord being angrie at Moyſes, ſayd: Aaron thy brother the leuite, I know that he is eloquent: behold he cometh forth to meete thee, & ſeeing thee shal be glad at the hart.
label: Exodus

text: Speake to him, and put my wordes in his mouth: & I wil be in thy mouth, and in his mouth, and wil shew you what yee muſt doe.
label: Exodus

text: He shal ſpeake in thy ſteed to the people, and shal be thy mouth: but thou shalt be to him in thoſe thinges that perteine to God.
label: Exodus

text: This rodde alſo take in thy hand, wherwith thou shalt doe the ſignes.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes went his way, & returned to Iethro his father in law, and ſayd to him: I wil goe and returne to my brethren into Ægypt, that I may ſee if they be yet aliue. To whom Iethro ſayd: Goe in peace:
label: Exodus

text: Therfore our Lord ſayd to Moyſes in Madian: Goe, and returne into Ægypt: for they are al dead that ſought thy life.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes therfore tooke his wife, & his children, and ſet them vpon an aſſe: and returned into Ægypt, carying the rodde of God in his hand.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to him returning into Ægypt: See that thou doe al the wonders, which I haue put in thy hand, before Pharao: I wil indurate his hart, and he wil not diſmiſſe the people.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt ſay to him: This ſayth the Lord: My firſt begotten ſonne is Iſrael.
label: Exodus

text: I ſayd to thee: diſmiſſe my ſonne that he may ſerue me, & thou wouldeſt not diſmiſſe him: behold I wil kil thy firſt-begotten-ſonne.
label: Exodus

text: And when he was in his iourney, in the Inne, our Lord mette him, and would haue killed him.
label: Exodus

text: Sephora by & by tooke a very sharp ſtone, and circumcided the prepuce of her ſonne, & touched his feete, and ſayd: A blouddie ſpouſe thou art to me.
label: Exodus

text: And he let him goe after she had ſaid, A blouddie ſpouſe thou art to me, becauſe of the circumciſion.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Aaron: Goe to Moyſes into the deſert. Who went forth to mete him vnto the Mountaine of God, and kiſſed him.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes told Aaron al the wordes of our Lord, by which he had ſent him, & the ſignes that he had commanded.
label: Exodus

text: And they came together, and gathered together al the ancientes of the children of Iſrael.
label: Exodus

text: And Aaron ſpake al the wordes which our Lord had ſaid to Moyſes: and he wrought the ſignes before the people,
label: Exodus

text: and the people beleued. And they heard that our Lord had viſited the children of Iſrael, and that he had looked vpon their affliction: & they adored proſtrate.
label: Exodus

text: AFTER theſe things Moyſes and Aaron went in, and ſaid to Pharao: This ſaith the Lord God of Iſrael: diſmiſſe my people that they may ſacrifice to me in the deſert.
label: Exodus

text: But he anſwered: Who is the Lord, that I should heare his voice, and diſmiſſe Iſrael? I know not the Lord, and Iſrael I wil not diſmiſſe.
label: Exodus

text: And they ſaid: The God of the Hebrewes hath called vs, to goe three daies iourney into the wilderneſſe, and to ſacrifice to the Lord our God: leſt perhappes there chance to vs peſtilence or ſword.
label: Exodus

text: The king of Ægypt ſaid to them: Why do you Moyſes and Aaron ſolicite the people from their workes? Goe you to your burdens.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao ſaid: The people of the land is much: you ſee that the multitude is ſecretly increaſed: how much more if you geue them reſt from their workes?
label: Exodus

text: Therefore he commanded in that day the ouerſeers of the workes and the exactores of the people, ſaying:
label: Exodus

text: You shal no more geue ſtraw to the people for to make brickes, as before: but let themſelues goe and geather ſtraw.
label: Exodus

text: And the taske of brickes, which they did before, you shal put vpon them, neither shal you diminish any thing: for they are idle, and therfore they crie, ſaying: Let vs goe, and ſacrifice to our God.
label: Exodus

text: Let them be oppreſſed with workes, and let them accomplish them: that they hearken not to lying wordes.
label: Exodus

text: Therefore the ouerſeers of the workes and the exactors going forth ſaid vnto the people: Thus ſaith Pharao: I allow you no ſtraw:
label: Exodus

text: goe, and geather if you can find any where: neither shal anie thing of your worke be diminished.
label: Exodus

text: And the people was diſperſed through al the Land of Ægypt to geather ſtraw.
label: Exodus

text: And the ouerſeers of the workes were inſtant, ſaying: Finiſh your worke euerie day, as before you were wont to doe when ſtraw was geuen vnto you.
label: Exodus

text: And the ouerſeers of the workes of the children of Iſrael were ſcourged of Pharaos exactors, ſaying: Why do you not make vp the taske of brickes as before, neither yeſterday, nor to day?
label: Exodus

text: And the ouerſeers of the children of Iſrael came, and cried out to Pharao, ſaying: Why dealeſt thou ſo againſt thy ſeruantes?
label: Exodus

text: Straw is not geuen vs, and brickes are commanded vs in like ſorte: behold we thy ſeruantes are beaten with whippes, and thy people is vniuſtly dealt withal.
label: Exodus

text: Who ſaid: You are idle, and therefore you ſay: Let vs goe and ſacrifice to our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: Goe therfore, and worke: ſtraw shal not be geuen you, and you shal geue vp the accuſtomed number of brickes.
label: Exodus

text: And the ouerſeers of the children of Iſrael ſaw them ſelues in hard caſe, becauſe it was ſaid vnto them: There shal not a whitte be diminished of the brickes for euerie day.
label: Exodus

text: And they mette Moyſes and Aaron, who ſtood ouer againſt them, coming forth from Pharao:
label: Exodus

text: and they ſaid to them: Our Lord ſee and iudge, becauſe you haue made our ſauour to ſtinke before Pharao and his ſeruantes, and you haue geuen him a ſword, for to kil vs.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes returned to our Lord, and ſaid: Lord why haſt thou afflicted this people? wherfore haſt thou ſent me?
label: Exodus

text: For ſince the time that I entered in to Pharao to ſpeake in thy name, he hath afflicted thy people: and thou haſt not deliuered them.
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Now thou shalt ſee what thinges I wil doe to Pharao: for by a mightie hand shal he diſmiſſe them, and in a ſtrong hand shal he caſt them out of his land.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying: I am the Lord,
label: Exodus

text: that appeared to Abraham, to Iſaac and to Iacob, as God almightie: and my name ADONAI I did not shew them.
label: Exodus

text: And I made a couenant with them, to geue them the Land of Chanaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were ſtrangers.
label: Exodus

text: And I haue heard the groning of the children of Iſrael, wherwith the Ægyptians haue oppreſſed them: and I haue remembred my couenant.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore ſay to the children of Iſrael: I the Lord who wil bring you forth out of the worke-priſon of the Ægyptians, & wil deliuer you from ſeruitude: and redeme you in a high arme, and great iudgements.
label: Exodus

text: And I wil take you to me for my people, and I wil be your God: and you shal know that I am the Lord your God, that brought you forth out of the worke-priſon of the Ægyptians:
label: Exodus

text: and brought you into the land, ouer which I lifted vp my hand to geue it to Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob: and I wil geue it you to poſſeſſe, I the Lord.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes then told al to the children of Iſrael: who did not hearken vnto him, for anguish of ſpirit, and moſt painful worke.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Exodus

text: Goe in; and ſpeake to Pharao the king of Ægypt, that he diſmiſſe the children of Iſrael out of his land.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes anſwered before our Lord: Behold the children of Iſrael heare me not: and how wil Pharao heare, eſpecially wheras I am of vncircumciſed lippes?
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes and Aaron, and he gaue them commandement vnto the children of Iſrael, & vnto Pharao the king of Ægypt, that they should bring forth the children of Iſrael out of the land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: Theſe are Princes of their houſes by their families. The ſonnes of Ruben the firſt begotten of Iſrael: Henoch and Phallu, Heſron and Charmi.
label: Exodus

text: Theſe are the kindreds of Ruben. The ſonnes of Simeon: Iamuel and Iamin, and Ahod, and Iachin, and Soar, and Saul the ſonnes of the Chananiteſſe, theſe are the progenies of Simeon.
label: Exodus

text: And theſe are the names of the ſonnes of Leui by their kindreds: Gerſon and Caath and Merari. And the yeares of the life of Leui were an hundred thirtie ſeuen.
label: Exodus

text: The ſonnes of Gerſon: Lobni and Semi, by their kindreds.
label: Exodus

text: The ſonnes of Caath: Amram, and Iſaar, and Hebron and Oziel. the yeares alſo of Caaths life, were an hnndred thirtie three.
label: Exodus

text: The ſonnes of Merari: Moholi and Muſi. theſe be the kindreds of Leui by their families.
label: Exodus

text: And Amram tooke to wife Iocabed his aunt by the fathers ſide: who bare him Aaron and Moyſes. And the yeares of Amrams life were an hundred thirtie ſeuen.
label: Exodus

text: The ſonnes alſo of Iſaar: Coree, and Nepheg, and Zechri.
label: Exodus

text: The ſonnes alſo of Oziel: Mizael, and Elizaphan, and Sethi.
label: Exodus

text: And Aaron tooke to wife Elizabeth the daughter of Aminadab, ſiſter of Nahaſon, who bare him Nadab, and Abiu, and Eleazar, and Ithamar.
label: Exodus

text: The ſonnes alſo of Core: Aſer, and Elcana, & Abiaſaph. theſe be the kindreds of the Corites.
label: Exodus

text: But Eleazar the ſonne of Aaron tooke a wife of the daughters of Phutiel: who bare him Phinees. theſe are the heads of the Leuitical families by their kindreds.
label: Exodus

text: This is Aaron and Moyſes, whom our Lord commanded that they ſhould bring forth the children of Iſrael out of the land of Ægypt by their troupes.
label: Exodus

text: Theſe are they that ſpake to Pharao the king of Ægypt, that they might bring forth the children of Iſrael out of Ægypt: this is Moyſes, and Aaron,
label: Exodus

text: in the day when our Lord ſpake to Moyſes in the land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying: I the Lord: ſpeake to Pharao the king of Ægypt, al thinges which I ſpeake to thee.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid before our Lord: Loe I am of vncircumciſed lippes, how wil Pharao heare me?
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Behold I haue appointed thee the God of Pharao: and Aaron thy brother shal be thy prophet.
label: Exodus

text: Thou ſhalt ſpeake to him al thinges that I command thee: and he shal ſpeake to Pharao, that he diſmiſſe the children of Iſrael out of his land.
label: Exodus

text: But I wil indurate his hart, and wil multiplie my ſignes and wonders in the Land of Ægypt,
label: Exodus

text: and he wil not heare you: and I wil put in my hand vpon Ægypt, and wil bring forth my armie and people the children of Iſrael out of the Land of Ægypt, by very great iudgements.
label: Exodus

text: And the Ægyptians shal know that I am the Lord, which haue ſtretched forth my hand vpon Ægypt, and haue brought forth the children of Iſrael out of the middes of them
label: Exodus

text: Therfore Moyſes and Aaron did as our Lord had commanded: ſo did they.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes was eightie yeares old, and Aaron eightie three, when they ſpake to Pharao.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes and Aaron:
label: Exodus

text: When Pharao shal ſay vnto you, Shew ſignes: thou shalt ſay to Aaron: Take thy rodde, and caſt it before Pharao, and it shal be turned into a ſerpent.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore Moyſes and Aaron going in vnto Pharao, did as our Lord had commanded. And Aaron tooke the rodde before Pharao and his ſeruantes, the which was turned into a ſerpent.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao called the wiſe men and the enchanters: and they alſo by Ægyptian enchantments and certaine ſecrecies did in like maner.
label: Exodus

text: And euery one did caſt forth their roddes, the which were turned into dragons: but Aarons rodde deuoured their roddes.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharaos hart was indurate, and he heard them not, as our Lord had commanded.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Pharaoes hart is aggrauated, he wil not diſmiſſe the people.
label: Exodus

text: Goe to him in the morning, behold he wil goe forth to the waters: and thou ſhalt ſtand to meete him vpon the banke of the riuer: and the rodde that was turned into a dragon, thou ſhalt take in thy hand.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt ſay to him: The Lord God of the Hebrewes ſent me to thee, ſaying: Diſmiſſe my people to ſacrifice vnto me in the deſert: and vntil this preſent thou wouldeſt not heare.
label: Exodus

text: This therfore ſaith our Lord: In this thou shalt know that I am the Lord: behold I wil ſtrike with the rodde, that is in my hand, the water of the riuer, and it shal be turned into bloud.
label: Exodus

text: The fishes alſo, that are in the riuer, shal dye, and the waters shal putrifie, and the Ægyptians shal be afflicted drinking the water of the riuer.
label: Exodus

text: Our Lord alſo ſaid to Moyſes: Say vnto Aaron, Take thy rodde, and ſtretch forth thy hand vpon the waters of Ægypt, and vpon their floudes, and riuers and pooles, and al the lakes of waters, that they may be turned into bloud: and be there bloud in al the Land of Ægypt, as wel in the veſſels of wood as of ſtone.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes and Aaron did as our Lord had commanded: and lifting vp the rodde he ſtroke the water of the riuer before Pharao and his ſeruantes: which was turned into bloud.
label: Exodus

text: And the fishes, that were in the riuer, died: and the riuer, putrified, and the Ægyptians could not drincke the water of the riuer, and there was bloud in the whole Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And the enchaunters of the Ægyptians with their enchantments did in like maner: and Pharaoes hart was indurate, neither did he heare them, as our Lord had commaunded.
label: Exodus

text: And he turned away him ſelfe, and went into his houſe, neither did he yet ſet his hart to it this time alſo.
label: Exodus

text: And al the Ægyptians digged round about the riuer for water to drinke: for they could not drinke of the water of the riuer.
label: Exodus

text: And ſeuen dayes were fully ended, after that our Lord ſtroke the riuer.
label: Exodus

text: OVR Lord alſo ſaid to Moyſes: Goe in to Pharo, and thou shalt ſay vnto him: This ſaith the Lord: Diſmiſſe my people, for to ſacrifice vnto me.
label: Exodus

text: but if thou wilt not diſmiſſe them, behold I wil ſtrike al thy coaſtes with frogges.
label: Exodus

text: And the riuer shal bubble with frogges: which shal come vp, and enter into thy houſe, and thy bed chamber, and vpon thy bedde, and into the houſes of thy ſeruantes, and vnto thy people, and into thy ouens, and into the remaines of thy meates:
label: Exodus

text: and vnto thee, & to thy people, and to al thy ſeruantes shal the frogges enter.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Say vnto Aaron: Stretch forth thy hand vpon the floudes, and vpon the riuers and the pooles, and bring forth frogges vpon the Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And Aaron ſtretched forth his hand vpon the waters of Ægypt, and the frogges came vp, and couered the Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And the enchanters alſo by their enchantments did in like maner, and they brought forth frogges vpon the Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao called Moyſes & Aaron, and ſaid to them: Pray ye to the Lord to take away the frogges from me & from my people: and I wil diſmiſſe the people to ſacrifice vnto the Lord.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid to Pharao: Appoint me when I shal pray for thee, and for thy ſeruantes, and for thy people, that the frogges may be driuen away from thee and from thy houſe, and from thy ſeruantes, and from thy people: and may remaine only in the riuer.
label: Exodus

text: Who anſwered: To morow. But he ſaid: According to thy word wil I doe: that thou maiſt know that there is not the like to the Lord our God.
label: Exodus

text: And the frogges shal depart from thee, and from thy houſe, and from thy ſeruantes, and from thy people: and ſhal remaine only in the riuer.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes and Aaron went forth from Pharao: and Moyſes cried to our Lord for the promiſe, concerning the frogges, which he had agreed to Pharao.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord did according to the word of Moyſes: and the frogges dyed out of the houſes, and out of the villages, and out of the fieldes:
label: Exodus

text: and they gathered them together into huge heapes, and the earth did rotte.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao ſeing that reſt was geuen he hardned his owne hart; and heard them not, as our Lord had commanded.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Speake to Aaron: Stretch forth thy rodde, and ſtrike the duſt of the earth: and be there Sciniphes in the whole Lord of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And they did ſo. And Aaron ſtreched forth his hand, holding the rodde: and he ſtroke the duſt of the earth, and there were made ſciniphes on men and on beaſtes: al the duſt of the earth was turned into ſciniphes through the whole Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And the enchaunters with their enchauntmentes practiſed in like maner, to bring forth ſciniphes, and they could not: and there were ſciniphes aswel on men as on beaſtes.
label: Exodus

text: And the enchaunters ſaid to Pharao: This is the finger of God. And Pharaoes hart was indurate, and he heard them not as our Lord had commanded.
label: Exodus

text: Our Lord alſo ſaid to Moyſes: Ariſe early, and ſtand before Pharao: for he wil goe forth to the waters: and thou shalt ſay to him: This ſaith our Lord: Diſmiſſe my people to ſacrifice vnto me.
label: Exodus

text: And if thou wilt not diſmiſſe them, behold I wil ſend in vpon thee, and vpon thy ſeruantes, and vpon thy people, and vpon thy houſes al kind of flies: and the houſes of Ægypt shal be filled with flies of diuers kindes, and the whole land wherein they shal be.
label: Exodus

text: And I wil make the Land of Geſſen merueilous in that day, wherin my people is, ſo that flies shal not be there: and thou ſhalt know that I am the Lord in the middes of the earth.
label: Exodus

text: And I wil put a diuiſion betwene my people & thy people: to morow shal this ſigne be.
label: Exodus

text: And Our Lord did ſo. And there came a very greuious flie into the houſes of Pharao and of his ſeruantes, and into al the Land of Ægypt: and the Land was corrupted by ſuch kind of flies.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao called Moyſes and Aaron, and ſaid to them. Goe and ſacrifice to your God in this land.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid: It can not ſo be done: for if we shal offer the abominations of the Ægyptians to the Lord our God: and we kil thoſe thinges which the Ægyptians doe worshippe before them: they wil beate vs downe with ſtones.
label: Exodus

text: We wil goe forth three dayes iourney into the wildernes: and we wil ſacrifice vnto the Lord our God, as he hath commanded vs.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao ſaid: I wil diſmiſſe you to ſacrifice to the Lord your God in the deſert: but goe noe farder: pray for me.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid: Being gone forth from thee, I wil pray to our Lord: and the flie shal depart from Pharao, and from his ſeruantes, and from his people to morow: but deceiue no more ſo, that thou wilt not diſmiſſe the people to ſacrifice vnto our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes being gone forth from Pharao, prayed our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: Who did according to his word: and he tooke away the flies from Pharao, and from his ſeruants, and from his people: there was left not ſo much as one.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharaoes hart was hardned, ſo that neither this time would he diſmiſſe the people.
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Goe in to Pharao, and ſpeake to him: This ſaith our Lord, the God of the Hebrewes: diſmiſſe my people to ſacrifice vnto me.
label: Exodus

text: And if thou refuſe, and holdeſt them:
label: Exodus

text: behold my hand shal be vpon thy fieldes: and vpon thy horſes, and aſſes, and camels, and oxen, and sheepe, a verie ſore peſtilence.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord wil make a merueile betwene the poſſeſſions of Iſrael & the poſſeſſions of the Ægyptians, that nothing at al perish of thoſe thinges that pertaine to the children of Iſrael.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord hath appointed a time, ſaying: To morow wil our Lord doe this thing in the land.
label: Exodus

text: Our Lord therfore did this thing the next day: and al the beaſtes of the Ægyptians dyed, but of the beaſtes of the children of Iſrael nothing at al perished.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao ſent to ſee: neither was there any thing dead of that which Iſrael poſſeſſed. And Pharaoes hart was hardned, and he did not diſmiſſe the people.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes, & Aaron: Take your handes ful of ashes out of the chimney, and let Moyſes ſprinkle it into the ayre before Pharao.
label: Exodus

text: And be there duſt vpon al the Land of Ægypt: for there shal be in men, & beaſtes boyles, and ſwelling bladders in the whole land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And they tooke ashes out of the chimney, and ſtoode before Pharao, and Moyſes ſprinkled it into the ayre: and there were made boyles of ſwelling bladders in men and beaſtes.
label: Exodus

text: neither could the enchanters ſtand before Moyſes for boyles that were vpon them, and in al the Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord did indurate Pharaoes hart, & he heard them not, as our Lord ſpake to Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: In the morning ariſe, and ſtand before Pharao, & thou shalt ſay to him: This ſaith the Lord, the God of the Hebrewes: Diſmiſſe my people to ſacrifice vnto me.
label: Exodus

text: Becauſe this time I wil ſend al my plagues vpon thy hart, and vpon thy ſeruantes, and vpon thy people: that thou mayeſt know there is not the like to me in al the earth.
label: Exodus

text: For now ſtretching forth my hand I wil ſtrike thee, and thy people with peſtilence, and thou shalt perish from the earth.
label: Exodus

text: And therfore haue I ſet thee, that in thee I may shew my might, and my name may be told in al the earth.
label: Exodus

text: Doeſt thou yet hold backe my people: and wilt thou not diſmiſſe them?
label: Exodus

text: Behold I wil raine to morow this very houre haile exceeding much: ſuch as was not in Ægypt from the day that it was founded, vntil this preſent time.
label: Exodus

text: Send therfore now preſently, and gather together thy cattle, and al thinges that thou haſt in the field: for men & beaſtes, and al thinges that shal be found abroad, and not gathered together out of the fieldes, and the haile fal vpon them, shal die.
label: Exodus

text: He that feared the word of our Lord of Pharaoes ſeruantes, made his ſeruantes to flie, and his beaſtes into houſes:
label: Exodus

text: but he that neglected the word of our Lord, let alone his ſeruantes, and his beaſtes in the fieldes.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Stretch forth thy hand towards heauen, that there may be haile in the whole Land of Ægypt vpon men, and vpon beaſtes, & vpon euerie herbe of the field in the Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſtretched forth his rodde toward heauen, and our Lord gaue thunders, and haile and running lightenings on the land: and our Lord rained haile vpon the Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And the haile and fire mixt together did driue: and it was of ſo great bignes, as neuer before appeared in the whole Land of Ægypt ſince that nation was made
label: Exodus

text: And the haile ſmote in al the Land of Ægypt al thinges that were in the fieldes, from man euen vnto beaſt: and euerie herbe of the field did the haile ſtrike, and euerie tree of the countrie it did breake.
label: Exodus

text: Only in the Land of Geſſen, where the children of Iſrael were, the haile fel not.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao ſent, and called Moyſes and Aaron, ſaying to them: I haue ſinned now alſo, the Lord is iuſt: I and my people, impious.
label: Exodus

text: Pray ye the Lord that the thunders may ceaſe, and the haile: that I may diſmiſſe you, and ye tarie not here any longer.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes ſaid: When I shal be gone forth out of the citie, I wil ſtretch forth my handes to our Lord, and the thunders shal ceaſe, and the haile ſhal not be: that thou maiſt know that the earth is our Lords:
label: Exodus

text: but I know that neither thou, nor thy ſeruantes do yet feare the Lord God.
label: Exodus

text: The flaxe therfore, and the barley were hurt, becauſe the barley came vp grene, and the flaxe now was boulled:
label: Exodus

text: but the wheate, and other winter corne were not hurt, becauſe they were lateward.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes going forth from Pharao out of the citie, ſtretched forth his handes to our Lord: and the thunders & haile ceaſed, neither did there droppe raine any more vpon the earth.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao ſeing that the raine, and the haile and thunders were ceaſed, he increaſed his ſinne:
label: Exodus

text: and his hart was aggrauated, and the hart of his ſeruantes, and indurate exceedingly: neither did he diſmiſſe the children of Iſrael, as our Lord had commanded by the hand of Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Goe in to Pharao: for I haue indurate his hart, and the hart of his ſeruantes: that I may worke theſe my ſignes in him,
label: Exodus

text: and thou maiſt tel in the eares of thy ſonne, and of thy nephewes, how often I haue broken the Ægyptians, & wrought my ſignes in them: and you may know that I am the Lord.
label: Exodus
