text: Moyſes therfore and Aaron went in to Pharao, and ſaid to him: Thus ſaith the Lord the God of the Hebrewes: Til when wilt thou not be ſubiect to me? diſmiſſe my people, to ſacrifice vnto me.
label: Exodus

text: But if thou reſiſt, and wilt not diſmiſſe them: behold I wil bring in to morow the locuſt into thy coaſtes:
label: Exodus

text: which may couer the face of the earth, that nothing therof appeare, but that which the haile hath left may be eaten: for it shal gnawe al trees that ſpring in the fieldes.
label: Exodus

text: And they shal fil thy houſes, and the houſes of thy ſeruantes, and of al the Ægyptians: ſuch a number as thy fathers haue not ſeene, nor grand-fathers, ſince they aroſe vpon the earth, vntil this preſent day. And he turned him ſelfe away, and went forth from Pharao.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharaoes ſeruantes ſaid to him: How long ſhal we endure this ſcandal? Diſmiſſe the men, to ſacrifice to the Lord their God. Doeſt thou not ſee, that Ægypt is vndone?
label: Exodus

text: And they called back Moyſes, and Aaron vnto Pharao: who ſaid to them: Goe, ſacrifice to the Lord your God: who are they that shal goe?
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes ſaid: With our young and old we wil goe, with our ſonnes and daughters, with our sheepe and heardes: for it is the ſolemnitie of the Lord our God.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao anſwered: So be the Lord with you, as I shal diſmiſſe you, and your litle ones: who doubteth but that you intend very wickedly?
label: Exodus

text: It shal not ſo be: but goe ye men only, and ſacrifice to the Lord: for this your ſelues alſo deſired. And immediatly they were caſt out from Pharaoes ſight.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Strech forth thy hand vpon the Land of Ægypt vnto the locuſt, that it come vpon it, and deuoure euerie herbe that remained after the haile.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſtretched forth his rodde vpon the Land of Ægypt: and our Lord brought in a burning wind al that day, & night: and when it was morning, the burning winde raiſed the locuſtes:
label: Exodus

text: which came vp ouer the whole Land of Ægypt: and ſate in al the coaſtes of the Ægyptians innumerable, the like as had not bene before that time, nor shal be afterward.
label: Exodus

text: And they couered the whole face of the earth, waſting al thinges. Therfore the graſſe of the earth was deuoured, and what fruites ſoeuer on the trees, which the haile had left: there was alſo nothing at al left that was greene in the trees, and in the herbes of the earth, in al Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: For the which cauſe Pharao in haſt called Moyſes and Aaron, and ſaid to them: I haue ſinned againſt the Lord your God, and againſt you.
label: Exodus

text: But now forgeue me my ſinne this time alſo, and pray to the Lord your God, that he take away from me this death.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes going forth from Pharaoes ſight, prayed to our Lord:
label: Exodus

text: who made a very vehement wind to blow from the weſt, and taking the locuſtes it threw them into the Red ſea: there remained not ſo much as one in al the coaſtes of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord did indurate Pharaoes hart, neither did he diſmiſſe the children of Iſrael.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Stretch for thy hand toward heauen: and be there darkeneſſe vpon the Land of Ægypt ſo thicke, that it be palpable.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſtretched forth his hand toward heauen: and there was made horrible darkeneſſe in the whole Land of Ægypt three dayes.
label: Exodus

text: No man ſaw his brother, nor moued himſelfe out of the place where he was: but whereſoeuer the children of Iſrael dwelt, there was light.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao called Moyſes and Aaron, and ſaid to them: Goe ſacrifice to the Lord: let your sheepe only, and heardes remaine, let your litle ones goe with you.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes ſaid: Hoſtes alſo & holocauſtes thou shalt geue to vs, which we may offer to the Lord our God.
label: Exodus

text: Al the flockes shal goe with vs: there shal not a hoofe remaine of them: the which are neceſſarie vnto the ſeruice of the Lord our God: eſpecially wheras we know not what muſt be offered, til we come to the very place.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord did indurate Pharaoes hart, and he would not diſmiſſe them.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharro ſaid to Moyſes: Getre thee from me, and beware thou ſee not my face any more: in what day ſoeuer thou shalt come in my ſight, thou shalt dye.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes anſwered: So shal it be as thou haſt ſpoken, I wil not ſee thy face any more.
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Yet with one plague more wil I touch Pharao & Ægypt, and after this he shal diſmiſſe you, and compel you to goe forth.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt ſay therfore to al the people that euerie man aske of his frend, & euery woman of her neighbour veſſels of ſiluer, & of gold.
label: Exodus

text: And the Lord wil geue grace to his people in the ſight of the Ægyptians. And Moyſes was a very great man in the Land of Ægypt, in the ſight of Pharaoes ſeruantes, & of al the people.
label: Exodus

text: And he ſaid: This ſaith our Lord: At midnight I wil enter into Ægypt:
label: Exodus

text: and euerie firſt-begotten in the Land of the Ægyptians shal dye, from the firſt-begotten of Pharao who ſitteth in his throne, euen to the firſt-begotten of the handmaid that is at the mil, & al the firſt-begotten of beaſtes.
label: Exodus

text: And there shal be a great crie in the whole Land of Ægypt, ſuch as neither hath bene before, nor shal be afterward.
label: Exodus

text: But with al the children of Iſrael there shal not a dogge mutter, from man euen to beaſt: that you may know with how great a miracle our Lord doth diuide the Ægyptians & Iſrael.
label: Exodus

text: And al theſe thy ſeruantes shal come downe to me, and shal adore me, ſaying: Goe forth thou, & al the people that is vnder thee: after this we shal goe forth.
label: Exodus

text: And he departed from Pharao exceeding angrie. And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Pharao wil not heare you that manie ſignes may be done in the Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes and Aaron did al the wonders that are written, before Pharao. And our Lord hardned Pharaoes hart, neither did he diſmiſſe the children of Iſrael out of his Land.
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſaid to Moyſes, and Aaron in the Land of Ægypt:
label: Exodus

text: This moneth, shal be to you the beginning of monethes: it shal be the firſt in the monethes of the yeare.
label: Exodus

text: Speake yee to the whole aſſemblie of the children of Iſrael, & ſay to them: The tenth day of this moneth let euerie man take a lambe by their families and houſes.
label: Exodus

text: But if the number be leſſe then may ſuffice to eate the lambe, he shal take vnto him his neighbour that ioyneth to his houſe, according to the number of ſoules which may ſuffice to the eating of the lambe.
label: Exodus

text: And it shal be a lambe without ſpotte, a male, of a yeare old: according alſo to which rite you shal take a kidde.
label: Exodus

text: And you shal kepe him vntil the fourtenth day of this moneth: and the whole multitude of the children of Iſrael shal ſacrifice him at euen.
label: Exodus

text: And they shal take of the bloud therof, and put vpon both the poſtes, and on the vpper dore-poſtes of the houſes, wherin they shal eate him.
label: Exodus

text: And they shal eate the flesh that night roſted at the fire, and vnleauened bread with wilde lettice.
label: Exodus

text: You shal not eate therof any thing raw, nor boyled in water, but only roſted at the fire: the head with the feete and entralles therof you shal deuoure.
label: Exodus

text: Neither shal there remaine any thing of him vntil morning. If there be any thing left, you shal burne it with fire.
label: Exodus

text: And thus you shal eate him: you shal gird your reynes, and you shal haue shoes on your feete, holding ſtaues in your handes, and you shal eate ſpeedely: for it is the Phaſe (that is the Paſſage) of the Lord.
label: Exodus

text: And I wil paſſe through the Land of Ægypt that night, and wil ſtrike euery firſt begotten in the Land of Ægypt from man euen vnto beaſt: and in al the goddes of Ægypt I wil doe iudgements, I the Lord.
label: Exodus

text: And the bloud shal be vnto you for a ſigne in the houſes where you shal be: and I shal ſee the bloud, and shal paſſe ouer you: neither shal there be among you a deſtroying plague when I shal ſtrike the Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And you shal haue this day for a moniment: and you shal celebrate it ſolemne to the Lord in your generations with an euerlaſting obſeruation.
label: Exodus

text: Seuen dayes shal you eate azimes: in the firſt day there shal be noe leauen in your houſes: whoſoeuer shal eate leauen, that ſoule shal perish out of Iſrael, from the firſt day vntil the ſeuenth day.
label: Exodus

text: The firſt day shal be holie and ſolemne, and the ſeuenth day with the like feſtiuitie shal be venerable: no worke shal you doe in them, except thoſe thinges, that pertaine to eating.
label: Exodus

text: And you shal obſerue the azymes: for in the ſelfe ſame day I wil bring forth your armie out of the Land of Ægypt, and you shal keepe this day vnto your generations with a perpetual rite.
label: Exodus

text: The firſt moneth, the fourtenth day of the moneth at euen you shal eate azymes vntil the one and twentith day of the ſame moneth at euen.
label: Exodus

text: Seuen dayes there shal not be fonnd leauened in your houſes: he that shal eate leauened, his ſoule shal perish out of the aſſemblie of Iſrael, as wel of ſtrangers as of them that are borne in the land
label: Exodus

text: Nothing leauened shal you eate: in al your habitations you shal eate azymes.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes called al the Ancients of the children of Iſael, and ſaid to them: Goe take a lambe by your families, and ſacrifice the Phaſe.
label: Exodus

text: And dippe a bunche of hyſſope in the blould that is at the doore, and ſprinkle the vppertranſome of the doore therwith, and both the doore cheekes: let none of you goe out of the doore of his houſe til morning.
label: Exodus

text: For our Lord wil paſſe ſtriking the Ægyptians: and when he shal ſee the bloud on the vpperſil, and on both the poſtes, he wil paſſe ouer the doore of the houſe, and not ſuffer the ſtriker to enter your houſes and to hurt.
label: Exodus

text: Keepe this thing as a law to thee and thy children for euer.
label: Exodus

text: And when you are entred into the Land, which our Lord wil geue you as he hath promiſed, you shal obſerue theſe ceremonies.
label: Exodus

text: And when your children ſhal ſay to you: What is this religion?
label: Exodus

text: you shal ſay to them: It is the victime of our Lords paſſage, when he paſſed ouer the houſes of the chidlren of Iſrael in Ægypt ſtriking the Ægyptians, and deliuering our houſes. And the people bowing them ſelues adored.
label: Exodus

text: And the children of Iſrael going forth did as our Lord had commanded Moyſes and Aaron.
label: Exodus

text: And it came to paſſe at midnight, our Lord ſtroke euerie firſt-begotten in the Land of Ægypt, from the firſt-begotten of Pharao, who ſate in his throne, vnto the firſt-begotten of the captiue woman that was in the priſon, and euerie firſt-begotten of beaſtes.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao aroſe in the night, and al his ſeruantes, and al Ægypt: and there aroſe a great crie in Ægypt: for neither was there a houſe wherin there lay not a dead one.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao calling Moyſes and Aaron, in the night, ſaid: Ariſe and goe forth from my people, you and the children of Iſrael: goe, ſacrifice to the Lord as you ſay.
label: Exodus

text: Your sheepe and heardes take you as you demanded, and departing bleſſe me.
label: Exodus

text: And the Ægyptians vrged the people to goe forth out of the land quickly, ſaying: We shal al die.
label: Exodus

text: The people therfore tooke dough before it was leauened: and tying it in their clokes, put it vpon their ſhoulders.
label: Exodus

text: And the children of Iſrael did as Moyſes had commanded: and they asked of the Ægyptians veſſels of ſiluer and gold, and very much rayment.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord gaue grace to the people before the Ægyptians that they did lend them: and they ſpoyled the Ægyptians.
label: Exodus

text: And the children of Iſrael ſette forward from Rameſſe into Socoth, almoſt ſix hundred thouſand of foote men, beſide litle ones.
label: Exodus

text: But alſo the common people of al ſortes innumerable went vp with them, sheepe and heardes and beaſtes of diuerſe kindes exceding manie.
label: Exodus

text: And they baked the meale, which a litle before they had taken out of Ægypt tempered: and made hearth cakes vnleauened: for it could not be leauened the Ægyptians vrging them to depart, & not ſuffering them to make any tarriance: neither did they thinke vpon preparing any meate.
label: Exodus

text: And the dwelling of the children of Iſrael that they abode in Ægypt, was foure hundred thirty yeares.
label: Exodus

text: The which being expired, the ſame day al the armie of our Lord went forth out of the Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: This is the obſeruable night of our Lord, when he brought them forth out of the Land of Ægypt: this night al the children of Iſrael muſt obſerue in their generations
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes and Aaron: This is the religion of the Phaſe: No aliene shal eate of it.
label: Exodus

text: And euerie bought ſeruant shal be circumciſed, and ſo shal eate.
label: Exodus

text: The ſtranger and the hireling shal not eate therof.
label: Exodus

text: In one houſe shal it be eaten, neither shal you carrie forth of the flesh therof out of the houſe, neither shal you breake a bone therof.
label: Exodus

text: Al the aſſemblie of the children of Iſrael shal make it.
label: Exodus

text: And if any of the ſoiourners be willing to dwel among you, and make the Phaſe of the Lord, firſt al the male that he hath shal be circumciſed, and then shal he celebrate it according to the rite: & he shal be as he that is borne in the land: but if there be any man vncircumciſed, he shal not eate therof.
label: Exodus

text: Al one law shal be to him that is borne in the land and to the proſelyte that ſoiourneth with you.
label: Exodus

text: And al the children of Iſrael did as our Lord had commanded Moyſes and Aaron.
label: Exodus

text: And the ſame day our Lord brought forth the children of Iſrael out of the Land of Ægypt by their troupes.
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaing:
label: Exodus

text: Sanctifie vnto me euerie firſt borne that openeth the matrice in the children of Iſrael, as wel of men as of beaſtes: for they are al mine.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid to the people: Remember this day in the which you went forth out of Ægypt, and out of the houſe of ſeruitude, becauſe with a ſtrong hand hath our Lord brought you forth out of this place: that you eate not leauened bread.
label: Exodus

text: This day you goe forth in the moneth of new corne.
label: Exodus

text: And when our Lord ſhal haue brought thee into the Land of Chananeite and Hetheite and Amorrheite and Heueite and Iebuſeite, which he ſware to thy fathers that he would geue thee, a land that floweth with milke and honie, thou shalt celebrate this maner of ſacred rites in this moneth
label: Exodus

text: Seuen daies shalt thou eate azimes: and in the ſeuenth day shal be the ſolemnitie of our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: Azimes shal you eate ſeuen dayes: there shal not be ſeene anie leauened thing with thee, nor in al thy coaſtes.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt tel thy ſonne in that day, ſaying: This is that which our Lord did to me when I came forth out of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And it ſhal be as a ſigne in thy hand, and as a moniment before thine eyes: and that the law of our Lord be alwayes in the mouth, for in a ſtrong hand our Lord hath brought thee out of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt keepe this obſeruation at the ſette time from dayes to dayes.
label: Exodus

text: And when our Lord shal haue brought thee into the Land of the Chananeite, as he ſware to thee and thy fathers, and shal geue it thee:
label: Exodus

text: thou shalt ſeparate al that openeth the matrice vnto our Lord, and al that is brought forth in thy cattel: whatſoeuer thou shalt haue of male ſexe thou ſhalt conſecrate to our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: The firſt borne of an aſſe thou shal change for a sheepe: and if thou doe not redeeme it, thou shalt kil it. And euerie firſt borne of men among thy children, thou shalt redemne with a price.
label: Exodus

text: And when thy ſonne shal aske thee to morow, ſaying: What is this? thou shalt anſwere him: With a ſtrong hand did our Lord bring vs forth out of the land of Ægypt, out of the houſe of ſeruitude.
label: Exodus

text: For when Pharaoes hart was indurate, and would not diſmiſſe vs, our Lord ſlew euerie firſt-borne in the Land of Ægypt, from the firſt-borne of man to the firſt borne of beaſtes: therfore I ſacrifice to our Lord al that openeth the matrice of the male ſixe, and al the firſt-borne of my ſonnes I doe redeme.
label: Exodus

text: It shal be therfore as a ſigne in thy hand, and as a thing hanged before thine eyes, for a remembrance: becauſe our Lord by a ſtrong hand hath brought vs forth out of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore when Pharao had ſent forth the people, our Lord ledde them not by the way of the Philiſthijns countrie which is neere: thinking leſt perhappes it would repent them, if they should ſee warres ariſe againſt them, and would returne into Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: But he ledde them about by the way of the deſert, which is beſides the Red-ſea: and the children of Iſrael went vp out of the Land of Ægypt armed.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes alſo tooke Ioſephes bones with him: becauſe he had adiured the children of Iſrael, ſaying: God shal viſite you, carrie out my bones from hence with you.
label: Exodus

text: And marching from Socoth they camped in Etham in the vtmoſt coaſtes of the wilderneſſe.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord went before them to shew the way by day in a piller of a cloude, and by night in a piller of fire: that he might be the guide of their iourney both times.
label: Exodus

text: There neuer failed the piller of the cloude by day, nor the piller of fire by night, before the people.
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Exodus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael: Let them returne and campe ouer againſt Phihahiroth which is betwene Magdal and the ſea againſt Beelſephon: in the ſight therof you shal campe vpon the ſea.
label: Exodus

text: And Pharao wil ſay concerning the children of Iſrael: They are ſtraitened in the land, the deſert hath shute them in.
label: Exodus

text: And I wil indurate his hart, and he wil purſew you: and I wil be glorified in Pharao, and in al his armie: and the Ægyptians shal know that I am the Lord. And they did ſo.
label: Exodus

text: And it was told the king of Ægyptians that the people was fled: and the hart of Pharao and of his ſeruantes was changed toward the people, and they ſaid: What meant we to doe, that we diſmiſſed Iſrael from ſeruing vs?
label: Exodus

text: Therfore he made readie his chariotte, and tooke al his people with him.
label: Exodus

text: And he tooke ſix hundred choſen chariottes, and al the chariottes that were in Ægypt: and captaines of the whole armie.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord hardned Pharaoes hart the king of Ægypt, and he purſewed the children of Iſrael: but they went forth in a mightie hand.
label: Exodus

text: And when the Ægyptians purſewed their ſteppes going before, they found them encamped at the ſea ſide: al Pharaoes horſe and chariottes, and the whole armie were in Phihahiroth againſt Beelſephon.
label: Exodus

text: And when Pharao approched, the children of Iſrael lifting vp their eies, ſaw the Ægyptians behind them: and they feared exceedingly, and cried to our Lord,
label: Exodus

text: and ſaid to Moyſes: Perhappes there were no graues in Ægypt, therfore thou haſt taken vs thence to die in the wildernes: why wouldeſt thou doe this, in bringing vs out of Ægypt?
label: Exodus

text: Is not this the word that we ſpake to thee in Ægypt, ſaying: Depart from vs, that we may ſerue the Ægyptians? for it was much better to ſerue them, then to die in the wildernes.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaied to the people. Feare not: ſtand, and ſee the great wonders of our Lord that he wil doe this day: for the Ægyptians, whom now you ſee, you shal no more ſee for euer.
label: Exodus

text: Our Lord wil fight for you, and you shal hold your peace.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Why crieſt thou to me? ſpeake to the children of Iſrael that they goe forward.
label: Exodus

text: But thou lift vp thy rodde, and ſtretch forth thy hand vpon the ſea, & diuide it: that the children of Iſrael may goe in the middes of the ſea by drie ground.
label: Exodus

text: And I wil indurate the hart of the Ægyptians to purſew you: and I wil be glorified in Pharao, and in al his hoſte, and in his chariottes and in his horſemen.
label: Exodus

text: And the Ægyptians shal know that I am the Lord when I shal be glorified in Pharao, and in his chariottes & in his horſemen.
label: Exodus

text: And the Angel of God, that went before the campe of Iſrael, remouing him ſelfe, went behind them: and together with him the piller of the cloude, leauing the foreward,
label: Exodus

text: ſtode behind, betwen the Ægyptians campe and the campe of Iſrael: & it was a darke cloud, and lightening the night, ſo that they could not come to ech other the whole night time.
label: Exodus

text: And when Moyſes had ſtretched forth his hand vpon the ſea, our Lord tooke it away, a vehement and burning winde blowing al the night, and turned it into drie ground: and the water was diuided.
label: Exodus

text: And the children of Iſrael went through the middes of the drie ſea: for the water was as it were a wal on their right hand & their left.
label: Exodus

text: And the Ægyptians purſewing went in after them, and al Pharaoes horſes, his chariottes and horſemen through the middes of the ſea.
label: Exodus

text: And now the morning watch was come, and behold our Lord looking vpon the Ægyptians campe through the piller of fire & the cloude, ſlew their armie:
label: Exodus

text: and ouerthrew the wheeles of the chariottes, and they were borne into the depth. The Ægyptians therfore ſaid: Let vs flee from Iſrael: for the Lord fighteth for them againſt vs.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Stretch forth thy hand vpon the ſea, that the waters may returne to the Ægyptians vpon their chariottes and horſemen.
label: Exodus

text: And when Moyſes had ſtretched forth his hand againſt the ſea, it returned in the firſt breake of day to the former place: and the Ægyptians fleeing away, the waters came vpon them, and our Lord enwrapt them in the middes of the waues.
label: Exodus

text: And the waters returned, and ouerwhelmed the chariottes and the horſemen of al Pharaoes armie, who folowing were entred into the ſea, neither did there ſo much as one of them remaine.
label: Exodus

text: But the children of Iſrael marched through the middes of the drie ſea, & the waters were vnto them as in ſtede of a wal on the right hand and on the left:
label: Exodus

text: and our Lord deliuered Iſrael in that day out of the hand of the Ægyptians.
label: Exodus

text: And they ſaw the Ægyptians dead vpon the ſea ſhore, and the mightie hand that our Lord had exerciſed againſt them: and the people feared our Lord, & they beleued our Lord, & Moyſes his ſeruant.
label: Exodus

text: THEN ſang Moyſes and the children of Iſrael this ſong to our Lord, and ſaid: Let vs ſing to our Lord: for he is glouriouſly magnified, the horſe and the rider he hath throwen into the ſea.
label: Exodus

text: My ſtrength, and my praiſe is our Lord, and he is made vnto me a ſaluation: this is my God, and I wil glorifie him: the God of my father, and I wil exalt him.
label: Exodus

text: Our Lord is a man of warre, omnipotent is his name.
label: Exodus

text: Pharaoes chariottes and his armie he hath caſt into the ſea: his choſen princes are drowned in the red ſea.
label: Exodus

text: The depthes haue ouerwhelmed them, they are ſonke into the botome like a ſtone.
label: Exodus

text: Thy right hand ô Lord is magnified in ſtrength: thy right hand, ô Lord, hath ſtriken the enimie.
label: Exodus

text: And in the multitude of thy glorie thou haſt put downe thy aduerſaries: thou haſt ſent thy wrath, which hath deuoured them like ſtuble.
label: Exodus

text: And in the ſpirite of thy furie were the waters gathered together: the flowing water ſtoode, the depthes were gathered together in the middes of the ſea.
label: Exodus

text: The enimie ſaid: I wil purſew and ouertake, I wil diuide the ſpoiles, my ſoule shal haue his fil: I wil draw forth my ſword, my hand shal kil them.
label: Exodus

text: The ſpirit blewe and the ſea ouerwhelmed them: they ſanke as lead in the vehement waters.
label: Exodus

text: Who is like to thee, among the ſtrong ô Lord? who is like to thee, magnifical in ſanctitie, terrible and laudable, doing meruailes?
label: Exodus

text: Thou didſt ſtretch forth thy hand, and the earth deuoured them.
label: Exodus

text: Thou haſt in thy mercie bene a guide to the people which thou haſt redemed: and in thy ſtrength thou haſt caried them vnto thy holie habitation.
label: Exodus

text: Nations roſe vp, and were angrie: ſorowes poſſeſſed the inhabiters of Philiſthijm.
label: Exodus

text: Then were the princes of Edom trubled, trembling ceazed on the ſturdie of Moab: al the inhabiters of Chanaan were ſtarke.
label: Exodus

text: Let feare and dread fal vpon them, in the greatnes of thy arme: let them become vnmoueable as a ſtone, vntil thy people ô Lord shal paſſe, vntil thy people shal paſſe, this which thou haſt poſſeſſed.
label: Exodus

text: Thou ſhalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountaine of thy inheritance, in thy moſt firme habitation, which thou haſt wrought ô Lord: thy ſanctuarie Lord, which thy handes haue confirmed.
label: Exodus

text: Our Lord shal reigne for euer and euermore.
label: Exodus

text: For Pharao on horſebake entred in with his chariottes and horſemen into the ſea: and our Lord brought backe vpon them the waters of the ſea: but the children of Iſrael walked on drie ground in the middes therof.
label: Exodus

text: Marie therfore the propheteſſe, Aarons ſiſter, tooke a tymbrel in her hand: and al the wemen went forth after her with tymbrels and daunces,
label: Exodus

text: to whom she beganne the ſong, ſaying: Let vs ſing to our Lord, for he is gloriouſly magnified, the horſe and his rider he hath caſt into the ſea.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes remoued Iſrael from the red ſea, and they went forth into the deſert Sur: and they walked three dayes through the wilderneſſe, and found not water.
label: Exodus

text: And they came into Mara, neither could they drinke the waters of Mara, becauſe they were bitter: wherupon he gaue a name alſo agreable to the place, calling it Mara, that is, bitterneſſe.
label: Exodus

text: And the people murmured againſt Moyſes, ſaying: What shal we drinke?
label: Exodus

text: But he cried to our Lord. who did shew him a peece of woode: which when he had caſt into the waters, they were turned into ſweteneſſe. There he appointed him precepts, and iudgements, and there he proued him,
label: Exodus

text: ſaying: If thou wilt heare the voice of the Lord thy God, and doe that is right before him, and obey his commandementes, and keepe al his preceptes, none of the maladies, that I layd vpon Ægypt, wil I bring vpon thee: for I am the Lord God thy curer.
label: Exodus

text: And the children of Iſrael came into Elim, where there were twelue fountaines of water, & ſeuentie palme trees: and they camped byſide the waters.
label: Exodus

text: AND they ſette forward from Elim, and al the multitude of the children of Iſrael came into the deſert Sin, which is betwene Elim & Sinay: the fiftenth day of the ſecond moneth, after they came forth out of the Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: And al the aſſemblie of the children of Iſrael murmured againſt Moyſes and Aaron in the wilderneſſe.
label: Exodus

text: And the children of Iſrael ſaid to them: Would to God we had died by the hand of our Lord in the Land of Ægypt, when we ſate ouer the flesh pottes, and did eate bread our fill: why haue you brought vs into this deſert, that you might kil al the multitude with famine?
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Behold I wil raine you bread from heauen: let the people goe forth, and gather that ſufficeth for euerie day: that I may proue them whether they wil walke in my law, or no.
label: Exodus

text: But the ſixt day let them prouide for to bring in: and let it be duble to that they were wont to gather euerie daie.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes and Aaron ſaid to al the children of Iſrael: At euen you ſhal know that our Lord hath brought you forth out of the land of Ægypt:
label: Exodus

text: and in the morning you ſhal ſee the glorie of our Lord: for he hath heard your murmuring againſt our Lord: but as for vs, what are we, that you mutter againſt vs?
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid: At euen our Lord wil geue you flesh to eate, and in the morning bread your fill: for he hath heard your murmuringes, which you haue murmured againſt him, for what are we? neither is your murmuring againſt vs, but againſt our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes alſo ſaid to Aaron: Say to the whole aſſemblie of the children of Iſrael: Approch you before our Lord: for he hath heard your murmuring.
label: Exodus

text: And when Aaron ſpake to al the aſſemblie of the children of Iſrael, they looked toward the wilderneſſe: and behold the glorie of our Lord appeared in a cloud.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Exodus

text: I haue heard the murmuringes of the children of Iſrael, ſay to them: At euen you shal eate flesh, and in the morning you shal haue your fil of bread: and you shal know that I am the Lord your God.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore it came to paſſe at euen, and the quaile roſe, and couered the campe: in the morning alſo a dew lay round about the campe.
label: Exodus

text: And when it had couered the face of the earth, it appeared in the wilderneſſe ſmal, and as it were beaten with a peſtil like vnto the hoare froſt on the ground.
label: Exodus

text: Which when the children of Iſrael had ſeene, they ſaid one to an other: Man-hu! which ſignifieth: What is this! for they knew not what it was. To whom Moyſes ſaid: This is the bread, which our Lord hath geuen you to eate.
label: Exodus

text: This is the word, that our Lord hath commanded: Let euerie one gather of it ſo much as ſufficeth to eate: a gomor euerie man, according to the number of your ſoules that dwel in a tent ſo shal you take vp.
label: Exodus

text: And the children of Iſrael did ſo: and they gathered, one more, an other leſſe.
label: Exodus

text: And they meaſured by the meaſure of a gomor: neither he that gathered more, had aboue: nor he that prouided leſſe, found vnder: but euerie one gathered, according to that which they were able to eate.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid to them: Let no man leaue therof til the morning.
label: Exodus

text: Who heard him not, but certaine of them left vntil the morning, and it beganne to be ful of wormes, and it putrified. and Moyſes was angrie againſt them.
label: Exodus

text: And euerie one of them gathered in the morning, ſo much as might ſuffice to eate: and after the ſunne waxed hotte, it melted.
label: Exodus

text: But in the ſixt day they gathered duble portions, that is, two gomors euerie man: and al the princes of the multitude came, and told Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: Who ſaid to them: This is it which our Lord hath ſpoken: The Sabbathes reſt is ſanctified vnto our Lord to morow. Whatſoeuer is to be wrought, doe it: and the meates that are to be made readie, make them readie: and whatſoeuer shal remaine, lay it vp vntil the morning.
label: Exodus

text: And they did ſo as Moyſes had commanded, and it putrified not, neither was there worme found in it.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid: Eate it to day, becauſe it is the Sabbath of our Lord: to day it shal not be found in the field.
label: Exodus

text: Gather it ſix dayes: but in the ſeuenth day is the Sabbath of our Lord, therfore it shal not be found.
label: Exodus

text: And the ſeuenth day came: and ſome of the people going forth to gather, found not.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: How long wil you not keepe my commandementes, and my law?
label: Exodus

text: See that our Lord hath geuen you a Sabbath, and for this cauſe on the ſixt day he geueth you duble portions: let each man tarie with himſelfe, and let none goe forth out of his place the ſeuenth day.
label: Exodus

text: And the people kept the Sabbath on the ſeuenth day.
label: Exodus

text: And the houſe of Iſrael called the name therof Manna: which was as it were coriander ſeede white, and the taiſt therof like to flowre with honie.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſayd: This is the word, which our Lord hath commanded: Fil a gomor of it, and let it be kept vnto the generations to come hereafter: that they may know the bread, wherwith I fed you in the wildernes, when you were brought forth out of the Land of Æhypt.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſayd to Aaron: Take one veſſel, and put Manna into it, ſo much as a gomor can hold: and lay it vp before our Lord to keepe vnto your generations:
label: Exodus

text: as our Lord commanded Moyſes. And Aaron put it in the tabernacle to be reſerued.
label: Exodus

text: And the children of Iſrael did eate Manna fourtie yeares, til they came into the habitable land: with this meate were they fed, vntil they touched the borders of the land of Chanaan.
label: Exodus

text: And a gomor is the tenth part of an ephi.
label: Exodus

text: THERFORE al the multitude of the children of Iſrael ſetting forward from the deſert Sin, by their manſions, according to the word of our Lord, camped in Raphidim, where there was no water for the people to drinke.
label: Exodus

text: Who chiding againſt Moyſes, ſaid: Geue vs water, that we may drinke. To whom Moyſes anſwered: Why chide you againſt me? Wherfore doe you tempt our Lord?
label: Exodus

text: The people therfore was thirſtie there for lacke of water, and murmured againſt Moyſes, ſaying: Why didſt thou make vs goe forth out of Ægypt, to kil vs, and our children, and our beaſtes with thirſt?
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes cried to our Lord, ſaying: What ſhal I doe to this people? Yet a litle while, and they wil ſtone me.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Goe before the people, and take with thee of the ancients of Iſrael: and the rodde wherwith thou didſt ſtrike the riuer, take in thy hand, and goe.
label: Exodus

text: Behold I wil ſtand there before thee, vpon the rocke Horeb: and thou ſhalt ſtrike the rocke, and water shal goe out therof, that the people may drinke. Moyſes did ſo before the ancientes of Iſrael:
label: Exodus

text: and he called the name of that place, Temptation, becauſe of the chiding of the children of Iſrael, and for that they tempted our Lord, ſaying: Is the Lord amongſt vs or not?
label: Exodus

text: And Amalec came, and fought againſt Iſrael in Raphidim.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſayd to Ioſue: Chooſe out men: and goe forth and fight againſt Amalec: to morow I wil ſtand in the toppe of the hil, hauing the rodde of God in my hand.
label: Exodus

text: Ioſue did as Moyſes had ſpoken, and he fought againſt Amalec: but Moyſes and Aaron and Hur went vp vpon the toppe of the hil.
label: Exodus

text: And when Moyſes lifted vp his hands, Iſrael ouercame: but if he did lette them downe a little, Amalec ouercame.
label: Exodus

text: And the handes of Moyſes were heauie: therfore they tooke a ſtone, and putte vnder him, wherupon he ſate: and Aaron and Hur ſtaied vp his handes on both ſides. And it came to paſſe that his handes were not wearie vntil ſunne ſette.
label: Exodus

text: And Ioſue put Amalec to flight, & his people by the edge of the ſword.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Write this for a monument in a booke, & deliuer it to the eares of Ioſue: for I wil deſtroy the memorie of Amalec from vnder heauen.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes builded an Altar: and called the name therof, Our Lord my exaltation, ſaying:
label: Exodus

text: Becauſe the hand of our Lords throne, and the warre of our Lord shal be againſt Amalec, from generation vnto generation.
label: Exodus

text: AND when Iethro the prieſt of Madian, the allied of Moyſes, had heard al the thinges, that God had done to Moyſes, and to Iſrael his people, and that our Lord had brought forth Iſrael out of Ægypt:
label: Exodus

text: he tooke Sephora the wife of Moyſes whom he had ſent backe:
label: Exodus

text: and her two ſonnes, of which one was called Gerſam, his father ſaying: I haue bene a ſtranger in a forren countrie.
label: Exodus

text: And the other Eliezer: for the God of my father, quoth he, is my helper, and hath deliuered me from Pharaoes ſword.
label: Exodus

text: Iethro therfore the allied of Moyſes came and his ſonnes, and his wife to Moyſes into the deſert, where he was camped beſide the mountayne of God
label: Exodus

text: And he ſent word to Moyſes, ſaying: I Iethro thy allied come to thee, and thy wife, and thy two children with her.
label: Exodus

text: Who going forth to mete his allied, adored, and kiſſed him: and they ſaluted on an other with wordes of peace. And when he was entred into the tent,
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes told his allied al thinges that our Lord had done to Pharao, and the Ægyptians for Iſrael: and the whole trauaile which had chanced to them in the iourney, and that our Lord had deliuered them.
label: Exodus

text: And Iethro reioyced for al the good thinges, that our Lord had done to Iſrael, becauſe he had deliuered them out of the handes of the Ægyptians,
label: Exodus

text: and he ſaid: Bleſſed is the Lord, that hath deliuered you out of the hand of the Ægyptians, and out of the hand of Pharao, that hath deliuered his people out of the hand of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: Now doe I know, that the Lord is great aboue al goddes: for becauſe they dealt proudely againſt them.
label: Exodus

text: Iethro therfore the allied of Moyſes offered holocauſtes and hoſtes to God: and Aaron and al the ancientes of Iſrael came, to eate bread with him before God.
label: Exodus

text: And the next day Moyſes ſate to iudge the people, who ſtoode by Moyſes from morning vntil night.
label: Exodus

text: Which thing when his allied had ſeene, to witte, al thinges that he did in the people, he ſaid: What is this that thou doeſt in the people? Why ſitteſt thou alone, and al the people attendeth from morning vntil night?
label: Exodus

text: To whom Moyſes anſwered: The people cometh to me ſeeking the ſentence of God.
label: Exodus

text: And when anie controuerſie chanceth among them, they come vnto me to iudge betwene them, and to ſhew the preceptes of God, and his lawes.
label: Exodus

text: But he ſaid: Thou doeſt not wel:
label: Exodus

text: thou art tyred with foolish labour, both thou, and this people that is with thee, the buſines is aboue thy ſtrength, thou alone canſt not ſuſteyne it.
label: Exodus

text: But heare my wordes and counſeils, and God ſhal be with thee. Be thou to the people in thoſe thinges that pertaine to God, to report their wordes vnto him:
label: Exodus

text: and to shew to the people the ceremonies and rite of worshipping, and the way wherin they ought to walke, and the worke that they ought to doe.
label: Exodus

text: And prouide out of al the people men that are wiſe, and doe feare God, in whom there is truth, and that doe hate auarice, and appointe of them tribunes, and centurions, and quinquagenarians, and deanes,
label: Exodus

text: which may iudge the people at al tymes: and what great matter ſoeuer shal fal out, let them referre it to thee, and let them iudge the leſſe matters only: and ſo it may be lighter for thee, the burden being imparted vnto others.
label: Exodus

text: If thou doeſt this, thou shalt fulfil the commandment of God, and shalt be able to beare his preceptes: and al this people shal returne to their places with peace.
label: Exodus

text: Which thinges when Moyſes heard he did al thinges that he had ſuggeſted vnto him.
label: Exodus

text: And chooſing ſubſtantial men out of al Iſrael, he appointed them princes of the people, tribunes, and centurions, and quinquagenarians, and deanes.
label: Exodus

text: Who iudged the people at al time: and whatſoeuer was of greater difficultie they referred to him, themſelues iudging the eaſier caſes only.
label: Exodus

text: And he diſmiſſed his allied: who returning went into his countrie.
label: Exodus

text: IN the third moneth of the depature of Iſrael out of the Land of Ægypt, this day they came into the wilderneſſe of Sinai,
label: Exodus

text: For departing out of Raphidim, and coming to the deſert of Sinai, they camped in the ſame place, and there Iſrael pitched their tentes ouer againſt the mountaine.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes went vp to God: and our Lord called him from the mountaine, and ſaid: This shalt thou ſay to the houſe of Iacob, and shalt tel the children of Iſrael:
label: Exodus

text: Your ſelues haue ſene what I haue done to the Ægyptians, how I haue carried you vpon the winges of eagles, and haue taken you vnto me.
label: Exodus

text: If therfore you wil heare my voice, and keepe my couenant, you ſhal be my peculiar of al peoples: for al the earth is myne.
label: Exodus

text: And you shal be vnto me a prieſtlie kingdome, and a holie nation: theſe are the wordes that thou ſhalt ſpeake to the children of Iſrael.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes came: and calling together the nations of the people, he declared al the wordes which our Lord had commanded him.
label: Exodus

text: And al the people anſwered together Al thinges that our Lord hath ſpoken, we wil doe. And when Moyſes had reported the peoples wordes to our Lord,
label: Exodus

text: our Lord ſaid to him: Now preſently wil I come to thee in the darkeneſſe of a cloude, that the people may heare me ſpeaking to thee, and may beleue thee for euer. Moyſes therfore told the peoples wordes to our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: Who ſaid to him: Goe to the people, and ſanctifie them to day, and to morow, and let them wash their garmentes.
label: Exodus

text: And let them be readie againſt the third day: for in the third day the Lord wil deſcend in the ſight of al the people vpon the mount Sinai.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt appoynt certaine limites to the people in circuite, and shalt ſay to them: Beware ye aſcend not into the mount, and that you touch not the endes therof: euerie one that toucheth the mount, dying shal dye.
label: Exodus

text: Handes shal not touch him, but he shal be ſtoned to death, or shal be shot through with arrowes: whether it be beaſt, or man, it shal not liue. When the trumpet shal beginne to ſound, then let them aſcend into the mount.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes came downe from the mount to the people, and ſanctified them. And when they had washed their garments,
label: Exodus

text: he ſaid to them: Be readie againſt the third day, and come not neere your wiues.
label: Exodus

text: And now the third day was come, and the morning appeared: and behold thunders deganne to be heard, and lightenings to flash, and a verie thicke cloude to couer the mount, and the noyſe of the trumpet ſounded exceedingly: and the people, that was in the campe, feared.
label: Exodus

text: And when Moyſes had brought them forth to mete with God from the place of the campe, they ſtoode at the botome of the mount.
label: Exodus

text: And al the mount Sinai ſmoked: for becauſe our Lord was deſcended vpon it in fyre, and the ſmoke aroſe from it as out of a fornace: and al the mount was terrible.
label: Exodus

text: And the ſound of the trumpet grew lowder by litle and litle, and was drawen out a length: Moyſes ſpake, and God anſwered him.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord deſcended vpon the mount Sinai in the very toppe of the mount, and he called Moyſes into the toppe therof. Whither when he was aſcended,
label: Exodus

text: he ſaid vnto him: Goe downe, and charge the people: leſt perhaps they wil paſſe their limittes to ſee the Lord, and a very great multitude of them perish.
label: Exodus

text: The prieſtes alſo that come to the Lord, let them be ſanctified, leſt he ſtrike them.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid to our Lord: The comon people can not aſcend into the mount Sinai: for thou didſt charge, and command, ſaying: Put limittes about the mount, and ſanctifie it.
label: Exodus

text: To whom our Lord ſaid: Goe, gette thee downe and thou shalt come vp, & Aaron with thee: but the prieſts and the people let them not paſſe the limittes, nor aſcend to the Lord, leſt perhappes he kil them.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes went downe to the people, and told them al.
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſpake al theſe wordes:
label: Exodus

text: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee forth out of the Land of Ægypt, out of the houſe of ſeruitude.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not haue ſtrange goddes before me.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not make to thee a grauen thing, nor any ſimilitude that is in heauen aboue, & that is in the earth beneth, neither of thoſe thinges that are in the waters vnder the earth.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not adore them, nor ſerue them: I am the Lord thy God mightie, ielous, viſiting the iniquitie of the fathers vpon the children, vpon the third and fourth generation of them that hate me:
label: Exodus

text: and doing mercie vpon thouſandes to them that loue me, and keepe my preceptes.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vaine. for the Lord wil not hold him innocent that shal take the name of the Lord his God vainly.
label: Exodus

text: Remember that thou ſanctifie the ſabbath day.
label: Exodus

text: Six dayes shalt thou worke, and shalt doe al thy workes.
label: Exodus

text: But on the ſeuenth day is the ſabbath of the Lord thy God: thou shalt doe no worke in it, thou, and thy ſonne, and thy daughter, thy man ſeruant, and thy woman ſeruant, thy beaſt, and the ſtranger that is with in thy gates.
label: Exodus

text: For ſix dayes the Lord made heauen and earth, and the ſea, and al thinges that are in in them, and reſted in the ſeuenth day, therfore the Lord bleſſed the ſabbath day, and ſanctified it.
label: Exodus

text: Honour thy father and thy mother, that thou mayſt be long liude vpon the earth, which the Lord thy God wil geue thee.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not murder.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not committe aduoutrie.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not ſteale.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not ſpeake againſt thy neighbour falſe teſtimonie.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not couet thy neigbours houſe: neither shalt thou deſire his wife, nor ſeruant, nor handmaide, nor oxe, nor aſſe, nor any thing that is his.
label: Exodus

text: And al the people ſaw the voices and the flames, and the ſound of the trumpet, and the mount ſmoking: and being frighted and ſtroken with feare they ſtoode a farre of,
label: Exodus

text: ſaying to Moyſes: Speake thou to vs, and we wil heare: let not our Lord ſpeake to vs, leſt perhappes we die.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid to the people: Feare not: for God came to proue you, and that his terrour might be in you, and you should not ſinne.
label: Exodus

text: And the people ſtoode a farre of. But Moyſes went vnto the darke cloud wherein God was.
label: Exodus

text: Our Lord ſaid moreouer to Moyſes: This shalt thou ſay to the children of Iſrael: You haue ſeene that from heauen I haue ſpoken to you.
label: Exodus

text: You ſhal not make goddes of ſiluer, nor goddes of gold shal you make to you.
label: Exodus

text: An Altar of earth you shal make to me, and you shal offer vpon it your holocaſtes and pacifiques, your sheepe and oxen in euerie place where the memorie of my name shal be: I wil come to thee, and wil bleſſe thee.
label: Exodus

text: And if thou make an Altar of ſtone vnto me, thou shalt not build it of hewed ſtones: for if thou lift vp thy knife ouer it, it shal be polluted.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not goe vp by grieſes vnto myne Altar, leſt thy turpitude be diſcouered.
label: Exodus

text: THESE are the iudgements which thou shalt propoſe to them.
label: Exodus

text: If thou bye an Hebrew ſeruant, ſix yeares shal he ſerue thee: in the ſeuenth he shal goe out freegratis.
label: Exodus

text: With what rayment he entred in, with the like let him goe out: if hauing a wife, his wife alſo shal goe out with him.
label: Exodus

text: But if his lord geue him a wife, and she beare ſonnes & daughters: the woman and her children shal be her lordes: but himſelfe shal goe out with his rayment.
label: Exodus

text: And if the ſeruant ſay: I loue my lord and wife & children, I wil not goe out free:
label: Exodus

text: his lord shal preſent him to the goddes, and he shal be ſette to the dore and the poſtes, and he shal bore his eare through with an awle: and he shal be his bond man for euer.
label: Exodus

text: If any man ſel his daughter to be a ſeruant, she shal not goe out, as bondweman are wont to goe out.
label: Exodus

text: If she miſlike the eyes of her maiſter to whom she was deliuered, he shal diſmiſſe her: but he shal not haue authoritie to ſel her vnto a ſtrange people, if he deſpiſe her.
label: Exodus

text: But if he deſpouſe her to his ſonne, he shal doe to her after the maner of daughters.
label: Exodus

text: And if he take an other wife for him, he shal prouide her a mariage, and rayment, and the price of her chaſtitie he shal not denie.
label: Exodus

text: If he doe not theſe three thinges, she shal goe out gratis without monie.
label: Exodus

text: He that ſtriketh a man wilfully to kil him, dying let him die.
label: Exodus

text: But he that did not lye in waite for him, but God deliuered him into his handes: I wil appoint thee a place whereunto he ought to flee.
label: Exodus

text: If a man of ſette purpoſe kil his neighbour, and by lying in waite for him: thou shalt plucke him out from mine Altare, that he may die.
label: Exodus

text: He that ſtriketh his farher or mother, dying let him die.
label: Exodus

text: He that shal ſteale a man, and ſel him, being conuicted of the treſpaſſe, dying let him die.
label: Exodus

text: He that curſeth his father, or mother, dying let him die.
label: Exodus

text: If men fal at wordes, and the one ſtrike his neighbour with a ſtone or with his fiſt, and he die not, but lye in his bedde:
label: Exodus

text: if he riſe, and walke abrode vpon his ſtafe, he that did ſtrike shal be quitte, yet ſo that he make reſtitution for his worke, and for his expenſes vpon the phiſicians.
label: Exodus

text: He that ſtriketh his man or mayde ſeruant with a rodde, and they die in his handes, he shal be guiltie of the crime.
label: Exodus

text: But if the partie remayne aliue a day or two, he shal not be ſubiect to punishment, becauſe it is his money.
label: Exodus

text: If certaine fal at wordes, and one ſtrike a woman with child, and she in deede aborte, but her ſelfe liue: he shal be ſubiect to ſo much damage as the womans huſband shal require, and as arbiters shal award.
label: Exodus

text: But if her death doe enſue thereupon, he shal render life for life,
label: Exodus

text: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foote for foote,
label: Exodus

text: aduſtion for aduſtion, wound for wound, ſtripe for ſtripe.
label: Exodus

text: If any man ſtrike the eye of his manſeruant or maidſeruant, and leaue them but one eye, he shal make them free for the eye which he put out.
label: Exodus

text: Alſo if he ſtrike out a tooth of his manſeruant or maydſeruant he shal in like maner make them free.
label: Exodus

text: If an oxe with his horne ſtrike a man or a woman, and they die, he shal be ſtoned: and his flesh shal not be eaten, the owner alſo of the oxe shal be quitte.
label: Exodus

text: But if the oxe were wont to ſtrike from yeſterday and the day before, and they warned his maiſter, neither did he shutte him vp, and he kil a man or a woman: both the oxe shal be ſtoned, and they shal put to death his owner alſo.
label: Exodus

text: And if they ſette a price vpon him, he shal geue for his life whatſoeuer he is asked.
label: Exodus

text: Alſo if with his horne he ſtrike a ſonne, or a daughter, he shal be ſubiect to the like ſentence.
label: Exodus

text: If he inuade a bondman or bondwoman, he shal geue thirtie ſicles of ſiluer to their maiſter, but the oxe shal be ſtoned.
label: Exodus

text: If a man open a ceſterne, and digge one, and doe not couer it, an oxe or an aſſe fal into it,
label: Exodus

text: the owner of the ceſterne shal pay the price of the beaſtes: and that which died, shal be his owne.
label: Exodus

text: If one mans oxe gore an other mans oxe, and he die: they shal ſel the oxe that liueth, and shal diuide the price, and the carcaſſe of that which died they shal parte betwen them.
label: Exodus

text: But if he knew that his oxe was wont to ſtrike from yeſterday and the day before, and his maiſter did not keepe him in: he shal render oxe for oxe, and shal take the carcaſſe whole.
label: Exodus

text: IF any man ſteale an oxe or a sheepe, and kil or ſel it: he shal reſtore fiue oxen for one oxe, and foure sheepe for one sheepe.
label: Exodus

text: If the theefe be found breaking vp the houſe or vndermining it, and taking a wound die: the ſtriker shal not be guiltie of bloud.
label: Exodus

text: But if he doe this when the ſunne is riſen, he hath cōmitted manſlaughter, and himſelf shal die. If he haue not wherwith to make reſtitution for the theft, himſelfe shal be ſold.
label: Exodus

text: If that which he ſtole, be found with him, aliue, either oxe, or aſſe, or sheepe: he shal reſtore duble.
label: Exodus

text: If anie man hurt a field or a vineyard, and let goe his beaſt to feede vpon that which is other mens: the beſt of whatſoeuer he hath in his owne field, or in his vineyard, he shal reſtore according to the eſtimation of the damage.
label: Exodus

text: If fire breaking forth light vpon the thornes, and catch ſtackes of corne, or corne ſtanding in the fieldes, he shal render the damage that kindled the fire.
label: Exodus

text: If a man committe money, or veſſel vnto his frend to keepe, and they be ſtolen away from him, that receaued them: if the theefe be found, he shal reſtore duble:
label: Exodus

text: if the theefe be not knowen, the maiſter of the houſe shal be brought to the goddes, and shal ſweare that he did not extend his hand vpon his neighbours good,
label: Exodus

text: to doe any fraud, as wel in oxe as in aſſe, and sheepe and rayment, and whatſoeuer may bring damage: the cauſe of both parties shal come to the goddes: and if they geue iudgement, he shal reſtore duble to his neighbour.
label: Exodus

text: If a man committe aſſe, oxe, sheepe, or any beaſt, to his neigbours cuſtodie, and it die, or be hurt, or be taken of enemies, and no man ſaw:
label: Exodus

text: there shal be an oath betwen them, that he did not put forth his hand to his neighbours good: and the owner shal admitte the oath, and he shal not be compelled to make reſtitution.
label: Exodus

text: But if it were taken away by ſtelth, he shal reſtore the damage to the owner.
label: Exodus

text: If it were eaten of a beaſt, let him bring vnto him that which was ſlaine, and he shal not make reſtitution.
label: Exodus

text: He that asketh of his neighbour to borow any of theſe thinges, and it be hurt or dead the owner being not preſent, he shal be compelled to make reſtitution.
label: Exodus

text: But if the owner be preſent, he shal not make reſtitution, eſpecially if it were hired and came for the hire of the ſame.
label: Exodus

text: If a man ſeduce a virgin being not yet deſpouſed, and lie with her: he shal endowe her, and haue her to wife.
label: Exodus

text: If the virgins father wil not geue her, he shal geue money according to the maner of the dowrie, which virgins are wont to receaue.
label: Exodus

text: Inchanters thou shalt not ſuffer to liue.
label: Exodus

text: He that lieth with a brute beaſt, dying let him die.
label: Exodus

text: He that ſacrificeth to goddes, ſhal be put to death, but to the Lord only.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not moleſt a ſtranger, nor afflict him: for your ſelues alſo were ſtrangers in the Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: A widow and an orphane you shal not hurt.
label: Exodus

text: If you hurt them, they wil crie out to me, and I wil heare their crie:
label: Exodus

text: and my furie shal take indignation, and I wil ſtrike you with the ſword, and your wiues shal be widowes, and your children orphanes.
label: Exodus

text: If thou lend money to my people being poore, that dwelleth with thee, thou shalt not vrge them as an exactour, nor oppreſſe them with vſuries.
label: Exodus

text: If thou take of thy neighbour a garment in pledge, thou shalt geue it him againe before ſunne ſette.
label: Exodus

text: For that ſame is the onlie thing, wherwith he is couered, the clothing of his bodie, neither hath he other to ſleepe in: if he crie to me, I wil heare him, becauſe I am merciful.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not detract from the goddes, and the prince of thy people thou shalt not curſe.
label: Exodus

text: Thy tithes and thy firſt fruites thou shalt not ſlacke to pay, the firſt-borne of thy ſonnes thou shalt geue me.
label: Exodus

text: Of thy oxen alſo & sheepe thou shalt doe in like maner: ſeuen dayes let it be with the damme, the eight day thou shalt render it to me.
label: Exodus

text: Holie men you shal be to me: the flesh that beaſtes haue taſted of before, you shal not eate, but shal caſt it to the dogges.
label: Exodus

text: THOV shalt not admitte a lying voice: neither shalt thou ioyne thy hand to ſay falſe teſtimonie for a wicked perſon.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not folow the multitude to doe euil: neither shalt thou in iudgement, argree to the ſentence of the moſt part, to ſtray from the truth.
label: Exodus

text: The poore man alſo thou shalt not pitie in iudgement.
label: Exodus

text: If thou meete thy enemies oxe, or aſſe going aſtray, bring it backe to him.
label: Exodus

text: If thou ſee the aſſe of him that hateth thee lye vnderneth his burden, thou shalt not paſſe by, but shalt lift him vp with the ſame.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not decline the poore mans iudgement.
label: Exodus

text: A lye thou shalt auoide. The innocent and iuſt perſon thou shal not put to death: becauſe I abhorre the impious man.
label: Exodus

text: Neither shalt thou take bribes, which doe blind alſo the wiſe, and peruert the wordes of the iuſt.
label: Exodus

text: The ſtranger thou shalt not moleſt. for you know the hartes of ſtrangers: becauſe your ſelues alſo were ſtrangers in the Land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: Six yeares thou shalt ſow thy ground, and shalt gather the corne therof.
label: Exodus

text: But the ſeuenth yeare thou shalt let it alone, and make it to reſt, that the poore of thy people may eate, and whatſoeuer shal be leift, let the beaſtes of the field eate it: ſo shalt thou doe in thy vineyard and thy oliuete.
label: Exodus

text: Six dayes thou shalt worke: the ſeuenth day thou shalt ceaſe, that thy oxe may reſt and thine aſſe: and the ſonne of thy handmaide may be refreshed, and the ſtranger.
label: Exodus

text: Kepe al thinges that I haue ſaid to you. And by the name of foren goddes you shal not ſweare, neither shal it be heard out of your mouth.
label: Exodus

text: Three times euerie yeare you shal celebrate feaſtes to me.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt keepe the ſolemnitie of Azymes. Seuen dayes shalt thou eate azymes, as I commanded thee, in the time of the moneth of new corne, when thou didſt come forth out of Ægypt: thou shalt not appeare in my ſight emptie.
label: Exodus

text: And the ſolemnitie of the harueſt of the firſt fruites of thy worke, whatſoeuer thou didſt ſow in the field. The ſolemnitie alſo in the end of the yeare, when thou haſt gathered al thy corne out of the field.
label: Exodus

text: Thriſe a yeare shal al thy male ſexe appeare before the Lord thy God
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not ſacrifice the bloud of my victime vpon leuen, neither shal the fatte of my ſolemnitie remaine vntil the morning.
label: Exodus

text: The firſt fruites of the corne of thy ground thou shalt carrie into the houſe of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not boyle a kidde in the milke of his damme.
label: Exodus

text: Behold I wil ſend myne Angel, which shal goe before thee, and keepe thee in thy iourney, and bring thee into the place that I haue prepared.
label: Exodus

text: Obſerue him, and heare his voice, neither doe thou thinke him one to be contemned: for he wil not forgeue when thou haſt ſinned, and my name is in him.
label: Exodus

text: But if thou wilt heare his voice, and doe al that I ſpeake, I wil be enemie to thyne enemies, & wil afflict them that afflict thee.
label: Exodus

text: And myne Angel shal goe before thee, and shal bring thee in vnto the Amorrheite, and Hetheite, and Pherezeite, and Chananeite, and Heucite, and Iebuzeite, whom I wil deſtroy.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not adore their goddes, nor ſerue them. Thou shalt not doe their workes, but shalt deſtroy them, and breake their ſtatues.
label: Exodus

text: And you shal ſetue the Lord your God, that I may bleſſe your bread & waters, and may take away infirmitie from the middes of thee.
label: Exodus

text: There shal not be a fruitleſſe nor barren bodie in thy land: I wil fil the number of thy dayes.
label: Exodus

text: I wil ſend my terrour to runne before thee, and wil kil al people, to whom thou shalt enter: and wil turne the backes of al thyne enemies before thee:
label: Exodus

text: ſending forth hornets before, that shal chaſe away the Herueite, and Chananeite, and Hetheite, before thou enter.
label: Exodus

text: I wil not caſt them out from thy face in one yeare: leſt the land be brought into a wilderneſſe, and beaſtes encreaſe againſt thee.
label: Exodus

text: By litle and litle I wil expel them from thy ſight, til thou be increaſed, and doſt poſſeſſe the Land.
label: Exodus

text: And I wil ſette thy boundes from the Redde ſea vnto the ſea of the Paleſtines, and from the deſert vnto the riuer: I wil deliuer the inhabitantes of the Land in your handes, and wil caſt them out from your ſight.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not enter league with them, nor with their goddes.
label: Exodus

text: Let them not dwel in thy land, leſt perhapes they make thee to ſinne againſt me, if thou ſerue their goddes: which vndoubtedly wil be a ſcandal to thee.
label: Exodus

text: TO Moyſes alſo he ſaid: Goe vp to the Lord, thou, and Aaron, Nadab and Abiu, and ſeuentie Ancientes of Iſrael, and you shal adore a farre of.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes onlie shal aſcend to the Lord, and they shal not approach: neither shal the people aſcend with him.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes therfore came and told the people al the wordes of our Lord, and the iudgementes: and al the people anſwered with one voice: Al the wordes of our Lord, which he hath ſpoken we wil doe.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes wrote al the wordes of our Lord: and riſing in the morning he builded an Altar at the foote of the mount, & twelue titles according the twelue tribes of Iſrael.
label: Exodus

text: And he ſent young men of the children of Iſrael, and they offered holocauſtes, and ſacrificed pacifique victimes to our Lord, calues.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes therfore tooke the halfe part of the bloud, and put it into bowles: and the reſidue he powred vpon the Altar.
label: Exodus

text: And taking the volume of the couenant, he reade the people hearing it: Who ſaid: Al thinges that our Lord hath ſpoken, we wil doe, and we wil be obedient.
label: Exodus

text: And he tooke the bloud, and ſprinkled it vpon the people, and ſaid: This is the bloud of the Couenant which our Lord hath made with you vpon al theſe wordes.
label: Exodus

text: And there went vp Moyſes and Aaron, Nadab and Abiu, and ſeuentie of the ancientes of Iſrael:
label: Exodus

text: and they ſaw the God of Iſrael: and vnder his feete as it were a worke of ſapphirſtone, and as the heauen, when it is clere.
label: Exodus

text: Neither did he ſet his hand vpon thoſe of the children of Iſrael, that retired farre of, and they ſaw God, and did eate, and drinke.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Come vp to me into the mount, and be there: and I wil geue thee tables of ſtone, and the law, and the commandementes which I haue written: that thou maiſt teach them.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes roſe vp, and his miniſter Ioſue: and Moyſes aſcending into the mount of God,
label: Exodus

text: ſaid to the Ancientes: Expect here til we returne to you, you haue Aaron and Hur with you: If anie queſtion shal riſe, you shal referre it to them.
label: Exodus

text: And when Moyſes was aſcended, a cloud couered the mount,
label: Exodus

text: and the glorie of our Lord dwelt vpon Sinai, couering it with a cloud ſix dayes, and the ſeuenth day he called him out of the middes of the darkeneſſe.
label: Exodus

text: And the forme of the glorie of our Lord, was as it were fire burning vpon the toppe of the mount, in the ſight of the children of Iſrael.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes entring into the middes of the cloude, aſcended into the mount: and he was there fourtie dayes, and fourtie nightes.
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Exodus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, that they take firſt fruites for me of euerie man that offereth of his owne accord, you shal take them.
label: Exodus

text: And theſe are the thinges which you muſt take: Gold, and ſiluer, and braſſe,
label: Exodus

text: hyacinth and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, and ſilke, and the haire of goates,
label: Exodus

text: and rammes skinnes died redde, and ianthin skinnes, and the wood ſetim:
label: Exodus

text: oyle to make lightes: ſpices for oyntement, and for incenſe of good ſauour:
label: Exodus

text: Onyx ſtones, and pretious ſtones to adorne the ephod, and rationale.
label: Exodus

text: And they shal make me a ſanctuarie, and I wil dwel in the middes of them:
label: Exodus

text: according to al the ſimilitude of the tabernacle which I wil shew thee, & of al rhe veſſel to the ſeruice therof: & rhus you shal make it:
label: Exodus

text: frame an arke of the wood ſetim, the length wherof shal haue two cubites & an halfe: the bredth, a cubite and an halfe: the height, likewiſe a cubite and an halfe.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt plate it with moſt pure gold within and without: and ouer it thou shalt make a golden crowne round about:
label: Exodus

text: and foure golden ringes, which thou shalt put at the foure corners of the arke: let two ringes be on the one ſide, and two on the other.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make barres alſo of the wood ſetim, and shalt couer them with gold.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt put them in through the ringes that are in the ſides of rhe arke, that it may be caried on them:
label: Exodus

text: the which shal be alwayes in the ringes, neither shal they at anie time be drawen out of them.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt put in the arke the teſtification which I wil geue thee.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make a Propitiatorie of moſt pure gold: the length therof shal hold two cubites and an halfe, and the bredth a cubite & an halfe.
label: Exodus

text: Two Cherubims alſo thou shalt make of beaten gold, on both ſides of the oracle.
label: Exodus

text: Let one Cherub be on the one ſide, and the other on the other.
label: Exodus

text: Let them couer both ſides of the Propitiatorie ſpreading their winges, and couering the oracle, and let them looke one towards the other, their faces turned vnto the Propitiatorie wherwith the arke is to be couered,
label: Exodus

text: wherein thou shalt put the teſtimony that I wil geue thee.
label: Exodus

text: Thence wil I command, and wil ſpeake to thee ouer the propitiatorie & from the middes of the two Cherubims which shal be vpon the arke of teſtimonie, al thinges which I wil command the children of Iſrael by thee.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make a table alſo of the wood ſetim, hauing two cubites in length, and in bredth a cubite, and in height a cubite and an halfe.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt plate it with moſt pure gold: & thou shalt make to it a golden ledge round about,
label: Exodus

text: and to the ledge it ſelfe a crowne enterpolished, foure fingers high: and vpon the ſame, an other golden crowne.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt prepare alſo foure golden ringes, and shalt put them in the foure corners of the ſame table at euerie foote.
label: Exodus

text: Vnder the crowne shal the golden ringes be, that the barres may be put through them, and the table may be carried.
label: Exodus

text: The barres alſo them ſelues thou shalt make of the wood ſetim, and shalt compaſſe them with gold to beare vp the table.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt prepare alſo ſawcers, and phials, cenſers, and goblettes, wherein the libamentes are to be offered, of moſt pure gold.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt ſette vpon the table loaues of propoſition in my ſight alwaies.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo a candleſticke beaten of moſt pure gold, the shaft therof, and branches, cuppes, and boules, and lilies proceding from the ſame.
label: Exodus

text: Six branches shal goe forth of the ſides, three out of one ſide, and three out of the other.
label: Exodus

text: Three cuppes as it were in maner of a nutte on euerie branch, and a boule withal, and a lilie: and three cuppes likewiſe of the fashion of a nutte in an other branch, and a boule withal, and a lilie. This shal be the worke of the ſix branches, that are to be drawen forth from the shaft:
label: Exodus

text: and in the candleſticke it ſelfe shal be foure cuppes in maner of a nutte, and at euerie one boules and lilies.
label: Exodus

text: Boules vnder two branches in three places, which together make ſix comnig forth out of one shaft.
label: Exodus

text: Both the boules therfore and the branches shal be out of it, al the whole beaten of moſt pure gold.
label: Exodus

text: Thou thalt make alſo ſeuen lampes, and shalt ſette them vpon the candleſticke, for to geue light ouer againſt.
label: Exodus

text: The ſnuffers alſo and where the ſnuffinges shal be put out, let them be made of moſt pure gold.
label: Exodus

text: The whole weight of the candleſticke with al the furniture therof shal haue a talent of moſt pure gold.
label: Exodus

text: Looke, and make it according to the paterne, that was shewed thee in the mount.
label: Exodus

text: AND the tabernacle thou shalt make thus: Tenne curtines shalt thou make of twiſted ſilke, and hyacinth, and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, varied with imbrodered worke.
label: Exodus

text: The length of one curtine shal haue twentie eight cubites: the bredth, shal be of foure cubites. Al the curtines shal be of one meaſure.
label: Exodus

text: Fiue curtines shal be ioyned one to an other, and the other fiue shal hang together with the connexion.
label: Exodus

text: Loupes of hyacinth thou shalt make in the ſides and toppes of the certines, that they may be compled one to an other.
label: Exodus

text: Fiftie loupes shal euerie curtine haue on both ſides, ſo ſet on, that one loupe may be againſt another loupe, and one may be fitted to the other.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo fiftie circles of gold wherwith the veiles of the curtines are to be ioyned, that it may be made one tabernacle.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo eleuen curtines of haire, to couer the toppe of the tabernacle.
label: Exodus

text: The length of one haire curtine shal haue thirtie cubites: and the bredth, foure: the meaſure of al the curtines shal be equal.
label: Exodus

text: Of the which, fiue thou shalt ioyne apart, and the ſix thou shalt couple one to an other, ſo that the ſixt curtine in the front of the roofe thou shalt duble.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo fiftie loupes in the edge of one curtine, that it may be ioyned with the other: and fiftie loupes in the edge of the other curtine, that it may be coupled with his felow.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo fiftie buckles of braſſe, wherwith the loups may be ioyned, that of al there may be made one couering.
label: Exodus

text: And that which shal remaine in the curtines, that are prepared for the roofe, to witte, one curtine that is ouerplus, with the halfe therof thou shalt couer the backeſide of the tabernacle.
label: Exodus

text: And there shal hang downe a cubite on the one ſide, and an other on the other ſide, which is the ouerplus in the length of the curtines, fenſing both ſides of the tabernacle.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo an other couer to the roofe of ramnes skinnes died redde: and ouer that againe an other couer of ianthine skinnes.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo the bordes of the tabernacle ſtanding vpright of the wood ſetim,
label: Exodus

text: of the which let euerie one haue ten cubites in length, and in bredth one and an halfe a peece.
label: Exodus

text: In the ſides of the borde, shal be made two morteſes, wherby one borde may be ioyned to an other borde: and after this maner shal al the bordes be prepared.
label: Exodus

text: Of the which twentie shal be in the ſouth ſide that tendeth Southward.
label: Exodus

text: For the which thou shalt caſt fourtie feete of ſiluer, that there may two feete be put vnder euerie borde at the two corners.
label: Exodus

text: In the ſecond ſide alſo of the tabernacle that looketh to the North, there shal be twentie bordes,
label: Exodus

text: hauing fourtie feete of ſiluer, two feete shal be put vnder euerie borde.
label: Exodus

text: But on the weſt quarter of the tabernacle thou shalt make ſix bordes,
label: Exodus

text: and againe other two which shal be erected in the corners at the backe of the tabernacle.
label: Exodus

text: And they shal be ioyned together from beneth vnto the toppe, and one ioynture shal hold them al. The like ioynture shal be kept for the two bordes alſo that are to be put in the corners.
label: Exodus

text: And they shal be in al eight bordes, their ſiluer feete ſixtene, two feete accounted for euerie borde.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo fiue barres of the wood ſetim, to hold together the bordes on the one ſide of the tabernacle,
label: Exodus

text: and fiue others on the other ſide, and as manie at the weſt ſide:
label: Exodus

text: which shal be put along by the middes of the bordes from one end to the other.
label: Exodus

text: The bordes alſo them ſelues thou shalt plate with gold, and shalt caſt ringes of gold to be ſette vpon them, through which the barres may hold together the bordeworke: the which thou shalt couer with plates of gold.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt erect the tabernacle according to the paterne that was ſhewed thee in the Mount.
label: Exodus

text: Thou ſhalt make alſo a veile of hyacinth, and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, and twiſted ſilke, wrought with imbrodered worke and goodlie varietie:
label: Exodus

text: which thou shalt hang before foure pillers of the wood ſetim, the which themſelues alſo shal be plated with gold, and shal haue foure heades of gold, but feete of ſiluer.
label: Exodus

text: And the veile shal be hanged on with ringes, within the which thou shalt put the arke of teſtimonie, with the which alſo the Sanctuarie, and the ſanctuaries of the Sanctuarie, shal be diuided.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt ſet alſo the Propitiatorie vpon the arke of teſtimonie in the Sancta ſanctorum:
label: Exodus

text: and the table without the veile: and ouer againſt the table the candleſticke in the ſouth ſide of the tabernacle: for the table shal ſtand in the north ſide.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo a hanging in the entring of the tabernacle of hyacinth, and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, and twiſted ſilke, with imbrodered worke.
label: Exodus

text: And fiue pillers of the wood ſetim thou shalt plate with gold, before the which the hanging shal be drawen; whoſe heades shal be of gold, and feete of braſſe.
label: Exodus

text: THOV shalt make alſo an Altar of the wood ſetim, which shal haue fiue cubites in length, and as manie in bredth, that is, foure ſquare, and three cubites in height.
label: Exodus

text: And there shal be at the foure corners hornes of the ſame: and thou shalt couer it with braſſe.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt make for the vſes therof pannes for to take the ashes, and tongues and fleshhookes, and fire pannes. al the veſſel thou shalt make of braſſe.
label: Exodus

text: And a grare in maner of a nette of braſſe: at the foure corners wherof shal be foure ringes of braſſe,
label: Exodus

text: which thou shalt put vnder the hearth of the Altar: and the grate shal be vnto the middes of the Altar.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo two barres for the Altar of the wood ſetim, which thou shalt couer with plates of braſſe:
label: Exodus

text: and thou shalt drawe them through ringes, and they shal be on both ſides of the Altar to carrie it.
label: Exodus

text: Not maſſie, but emptie and hollow in the inſide ſhalt thou make it, as it was shewed thee in the Mount.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo the court of the tabernacle, in the ſouth part wherof againſt the ſouth there shal be hanginges of twiſted ſilke: one ſide shal hold in length an hundred cubites.
label: Exodus

text: And twentie pillers with as manie feete of braſſe, which shal haue heades with their engrauinges of ſiluer.
label: Exodus

text: In like maner alſo on the north ſide there shal be in length hanginges of an hundred cubites, twentie pillers, and feete of braſſe as manie, and their heades with their engrauinges of ſiluer.
label: Exodus

text: But in the bredth of the court, that looketh to the weſt, there shal be hanginges of fiftie cubites, and ten pillers, and as manie feete.
label: Exodus

text: In that bredth alſo of the court, which looketh to the eaſt, there shal be fiftie cubites.
label: Exodus

text: in the which there shal be deputed to one ſide hanginges of fiftene cubites, and three pillers and as manie feete:
label: Exodus

text: and in the other ſide there shal be hanginges conteyning fiftene cubites, three pillers, and as manie feete.
label: Exodus

text: And in the entring of the court there shal be made an hanging of twentie cubites of hyacinth and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, and twiſted ſilke, with embrodered worke: it shal haue foure pillers, with as manie feete.
label: Exodus

text: Al the pillers of the court round about shal be garnished with plates of ſiluer, ſiluer heades, and feete of braſſe.
label: Exodus

text: In length the court shal occupie an hundred cubites, in bredth fiftie, the height shal be of fiue cubites. and it shal be made of twiſted ſilke, and shal haue feete of braſſe.
label: Exodus
