text: Al the veſſel of the tabernacle for al vſes and ceremonies, the pinnes as wel of it as of the court, thou shalt make of braſſe.
label: Exodus

text: Command the children of Iſrael that they bring thee oyle of the oliuetrees the pureſt, and beaten with a peſtil: that a lampe may burne alwayes
label: Exodus

text: in the tabernacle of the teſtimonie, without the veile that is drawen before the teſtimonie. And Aaron and his ſonnes shal place it, that it may geue light before the Lord vntil the morning. It shal be a perpetual obſeruance through out their ſuccceſſions before the children of Iſrael.
label: Exodus

text: TAKE vnto thee alſo Aaron thy brother with his ſonnes, from among the children of Iſrael; that they may doe the function of prieſthoode vnto me: Aaron, Nadab, and Abiu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
label: Exodus

text: And thou ſhalt make an holie veſture to Aaron thy brother for glorie and bewtie.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt ſpeake to al the wiſe of hart, whom I haue replenished with the ſpirit of wiſdome, that they make Aarons veſtures, wherin he being ſanctified may miniſter to me.
label: Exodus

text: And theſe shal be the veſtments that they shal make: Rationale and an Ephod, a tunike and a ſtraite linnen garment, a mitre and a girdle. They shal make the holie veſtments for thy brother Aaron and his ſonnes, that they may doe the function of prieſthood vnto me.
label: Exodus

text: And they shal take gold, and hyacinth, and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, and ſilke.
label: Exodus

text: And they shal make the Ephod of gold and hyacinth and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, and twiſted ſilke, embrodered with diuers colours.
label: Exodus

text: It shal haue two edges ioyned in the toppe on both ſides, that they may be cloſed together.
label: Exodus

text: The verie Workemanship alſo and al the varietie of the worke shal be of gold and hyacinth, and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, and twiſted ſilke.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt take two Onyx ſtones, and shalt graue in them the names of the children of Iſrael:
label: Exodus

text: ſix names in one ſtone, and the other ſix in the other, according to the order of their natiuitie.
label: Exodus

text: After the worke of a grauer and the grauing of a lapidarie, thou shalt graue them with the names of the children of Iſrael, ſette in gold and compaſſed about:
label: Exodus

text: and thou shalt put them in both ſides of the Ephod, a memorial for the children of Iſrael. And Aaron shal beare their names before the Lord vpon both shoulders, for a remembrance.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo hookes of gold,
label: Exodus

text: and two litle cheynes of moſt pure gold linked one to an other, which thou shalt put into the hookes
label: Exodus

text: The Rationale of iudgement alſo thou shalt make with embrodered worke of diuers colours, according to the workmanship of the Ephod of gold, hyacinth, and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, and twiſted ſilke.
label: Exodus

text: It shal be foure ſquare and duble: it shal haue the meaſure of a palme aſwel in length as in bredth.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt ſet in it foure rewes of ſtones: In the firſt rew shal be the ſtone ſardius, and topazius, and the emeraud:
label: Exodus

text: in the ſecond the carbuncle, the ſapphire, and the iaſper:
label: Exodus

text: in the third a ligurius, an achates, an amethyſt:
label: Exodus

text: in the fourth a chryſolith, an onyx, and beryllus. they shal be ſet in gold by their rewes.
label: Exodus

text: And they shal haue the names of the children of Iſrael: with twelue names shal they be grauen, euerie ſtone with the names of euerie one according to the twelue tribes.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make in the Rationale cheynes linked one to an other of the pureſt gold:
label: Exodus

text: and two ringes of gold, which thou shalt put in both the toppes of the Rationale:
label: Exodus

text: and the golden cheynes thou shalt ioyne to the ringes, that are in the edges therof:
label: Exodus

text: and the endes of the cheynes them ſelues thou shalt couple with two hookes on both ſides of the Ephod, which is toward the Rationale.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo two ringes of gold which thou shalt pnt in the toppes of the Rationale, in the brimmes, that are ouer againſt the Ephod, & looke toward the backe partes therof.
label: Exodus

text: Moreouer alſo other two ringes of gold, which are to be ſet on both ſides of the Ephod beneath, that looketh toward the nether ioyning, that the Rationale may be fitted with the Ephod,
label: Exodus

text: and may be faſtened by the ringes therof vnto the ringes of the Ephod with a lace of hyacinth, that the ioyning artificially wrought may continew, and the Rationale and Ephod may not be ſeparated one from the other.
label: Exodus

text: And Aaron shal beare the names of the children of Iſrael in the Rationale of iudgement vpon his breſt, when he shal enter into the Sanctuarie, a memorial before the Lord for euer.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt put in the Rationale of iudgement Doctrine, and Veritie, which shal be on Aarons breſt, when he shal goe in before the Lord: and he shal beare the iudgement of the children of Iſrael on his breſt, in the ſight of the Lord alwayes.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt make the tunike of the Ephod al of hyacinth,
label: Exodus

text: in the middes wherof aboue shal be a hole for the head, and a border round about it wouen, as is wont to be made in the vtmoſt partes of garments, that it may not eaſely be broken.
label: Exodus

text: And beneath at the feete of the ſame tunike, round about, thou shalt make as it were pomegranates, of hyacinth, and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, litle belles interpoſed betwen,
label: Exodus

text: ſo that there be a bel of gold and a pomegranate: and againe an other bel of gold and a pomegranate.
label: Exodus

text: And Aaron shal be veſted with it in the office of his miniſterie, that the ſound may be heard, when he goeth in and cometh out of the Sanctuarie, in the ſight of the Lord, and that he die not.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo a plate of the pureſt gold: wherin thou shalt graue after the worke of a grauer, Holie to the Lord.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt tie it with a lace of hyacinth, and it shal be vpon the mitre,
label: Exodus

text: hanging ouer the forehead of the high Prieſt. And Aaron shal carie the iniquities of thoſe thinges, which the children of Iſrael haue offered and ſanctified, in al their giftes and donaries. And the plate shal be alwayes in his forehead, that the Lord may be wel pleaſed with them.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt gird the tunike with ſilke, and thou shalt make a ſilken mitre, and a bawdrike of embrodered worke.
label: Exodus

text: Moreouer for the ſonnes of Aaron thou shalt prepare linnen tunikes, and bawdrikes and mitres for glorie and bewtie:
label: Exodus

text: And with al theſe thinges thou shalt veſt Aaron thy brother, and his ſonnes with him. And thou shalt conſecrate the handes of them al, and shalt ſanctifie them, that they may doe the function of prieſthood vnto me.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo linnen breches, to couer the flesh of their turpitude from the reynes vnto the thighes:
label: Exodus

text: and Aaron and his ſonnes shal vſe them when they shal enter into the tarberbernacle of teſtimonie, or when they approch to the Altar to miniſter in the Sanctuarie, leſt guiltie of iniquitie they die. It shal be a law for euer to Aaron, and to his ſeede after him.
label: Exodus

text: BVT this alſo shalt thou doe, that they may be conſecrated to me in prieſthood. Take a calfe from the heard, and two rammes without ſpotte,
label: Exodus

text: and vnleuened bread, and a cake without leuen, tempered with oile, wafers alſo vnleauened anoynted with oile: of wheaten flowre thou shalt make al.
label: Exodus

text: And being put in a basket thou shalt offer them: and the calfe and the two rammes.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his ſonnes to the doore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie. And when thou haſt washed the father with his ſonnes in water,
label: Exodus

text: thou shalt veſt Aaron with his veſtments, that is, with the linnen garment and the tunicke, and the Ephod and the Rationale, which thou shalt gird with the baudrike.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt put the mitre vpon his head, and the holie plate vpon the mitre,
label: Exodus

text: and thou shalt powre the oile of vnction vpon his head: and by this rite shal he be conſecrated.
label: Exodus

text: His ſonnes alſo thou shalt bring, and shalt inueſt them with the linnen tunickes, and gird them with a bawdrike,
label: Exodus

text: to witte, Aaron and his children, and thou shalt put mitres vpon them: and they shal be prieſtes to me by a perpetual religion. After that thou shalt haue conſecrated their handes,
label: Exodus

text: thou shalt preſent alſo the calfe before the tabernacle of teſtimonie. And Aaron and his ſonnes shal lay their handes vpon his head,
label: Exodus

text: and thou shalt kil him in the ſight of the Lord, beſide the doore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie.
label: Exodus

text: And that which thou takeſt of the bloud of the calfe, thou shalt put vpon the hornes of the Altar with thy finger, and the reſt of the bloud thou shalt powre at the botome therof.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt take alſo the whole fatte that couereth the entralles, and the caule of the liuer, and the two kidneys, and the fatte that is vpon them, and shalt offer a burnt ſacrifice vpon the Altar:
label: Exodus

text: but the flesh of the calfe and the hide and the dung, thou shalt burne abrode without the campe, becauſe it is for ſinne.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt take alſo one ramme, vpon the head wherof Aaron & his ſonnes shal lay their handes.
label: Exodus

text: Which when thou haſt killed, thou shalt take of the bloud therof, and powre round about the Altar.
label: Exodus

text: And the ramme it ſelfe thou shalt cut into peeces, and his entralles and feete being washed, thou shalt put vpon the flesh cut in peeces, and vpon his head.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt offer the whole ramme for a burnt ſacrifice vpon the Altar: it is an oblation to the Lord, a moſt ſweete ſauoure of the victime of the Lord.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt take alſo the other ramme, vpon whoſe head Aaron and his ſonnes shal lay their handes.
label: Exodus

text: Which when thou haſt immolated, thou shalt take of his bloud, and put vpon the tippe of the right eare of Aaron and of his ſonnes, and vpon the thumbes and great toes of their right hand and foote, and thou shalt powre the bloud vpon the Altar round about.
label: Exodus

text: And when thou haſt taken of the bloud that is vpon the Altar, and of the oile of vnction, thou shalt ſprinkle Aaron and his veſture, his ſonnes & their veſtmentes. And after they and their veſtmentes are conſecrated,
label: Exodus

text: thou shalt take the fatte of the ramme, and the tayle & the talow, that couereth the lunges, and the caule of the liuer, and the two kidneies, and the fatte, that is vpon them, and the right shoulder, becauſe it is the ramme of conſecration:
label: Exodus

text: and a peece of one loafe, a cake tempered with oile, a wafer out of the basket of azymes, which is ſette in the ſight of the Lord:
label: Exodus

text: and thou shalt put al vpon the handes of Aaron and of his ſonnes, and shalt ſanctifie them eleuating before the Lord.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt take al from their handes: and shalt burne them vpon the Altar for an holocauſte, a moſt ſweete ſauour in the ſight of the Lord, becauſe it is his oblation.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt take alſo the breſt of the ramme, wherwith Aaron was conſecrated, and eleuating it thou shalt ſanctifie it before the Lord, and it shal fal to thy part.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt ſanctifie both the conſecrated breſt, and the shoulder that thou didſt ſeparate of the ramme,
label: Exodus

text: wherwith Aaron was conſecrated and his ſonnes, and they shal fal to Aarons part and his ſonnes by a perpetual right from the children of Iſrael: becauſe they are the primitiues and beginninges of their pacifique victimes which they offer to the Lord.
label: Exodus

text: And the holie veſture, which Aaron shal vſe, his ſonnes shal haue after him, that they may be anoynted, and their handes conſecrated in it.
label: Exodus

text: He of his ſonnes that shal be appoynted high prieſt in his ſteede, & that shal enter into the tabernacle of teſtimonie to miniſter in the Sanctuarie, shal weare it ſeuen dayes.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt take the ramme of the conſecration, and shalt boyle the flesh therof in a holie place;
label: Exodus

text: which Aaron shal eate and his ſonnes. The loaues alſo, that are in the basket, they shal eate in the entrie of the tabernacle of teſtimonie,
label: Exodus

text: that it may be a placable ſacrifice, and the handes of the offerers may be ſanctified. A ſtranger shal not eate of them, becauſe they are holie.
label: Exodus

text: And if there remaine of the conſecrated flesh, or of the bread til the morning, thou shalt burne the remaynes with fire: they shal not be eaten, becauſe they are ſanctified.
label: Exodus

text: Al, that I haue commanded thee, thou shalt doe vpon Aaron and his ſonnes. Seuen dayes shalt thou conſecrate their handes:
label: Exodus

text: and thou shalt offer a calfe for ſinne euerie day for expiation. And thou shalt cleanſe the Altar when thou haſt offered the hoſte of expiation, and shalt anoynt it vnto ſanctification.
label: Exodus

text: Seuen dayes shalt thou expiate the altar & ſanctifie it, and it shal be moſt Holie. euerie one, that shal touch it, shal be ſanctified.
label: Exodus

text: This is it which thou ſhalt doe vpon the Altar: Two lambes of a yeare old euerie day continually,
label: Exodus

text: one lambe in the morning, & an other at euen,
label: Exodus

text: the tenth part of flowre tempered with oile beaten, which shal haue in meaſure the fourth part of an hin, and wine for libation of the ſame meaſure to one lambe.
label: Exodus

text: And the other lambe thou ſhalt offer at euen, according to the rite of the morning oblation, and according to that which we haue ſaid, for a ſauour of ſweetneſſe:
label: Exodus

text: it is a ſacrifice to the Lord, by perpetual oblation vnto your generations, at the doore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie before the Lord, where I wil appoint to ſpeake vnto thee.
label: Exodus

text: And there wil I command the children of Iſrael, and the Altar shal be ſanctified in my glorie.
label: Exodus

text: I wil ſanctifie alſo the tabarnacle of teſtimonie with the Altar, and Aaron with his ſonnes, to doe the function of prieſthood vnto me.
label: Exodus

text: And I wil dwel in the middes of the children of Iſrael, and wil be their God,
label: Exodus

text: and they shal know that I am the Lord their God, that haue brought them out of the Land of Ægypt, that I might abide among them, I the Lord their God.
label: Exodus

text: THOV shalt make alſo an Altar to burne incenſe, of the wood ſetim,
label: Exodus

text: hauing a cubite of length, and an other of bredth, that is, foure ſquare, and two cubites in height. The hornes shal procede out of the ſame.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt plate it with the pureſt gold, as wel the grate therof, as the walles round about, and the hornes. And thou shalt make to it a crowne of gold round about,
label: Exodus

text: and two golden ringes vnder the crowne on either ſide, that the barres may be put into them, and the Altar may be caried.
label: Exodus

text: The barres alſo them ſelues thou shalt make of the wood ſetim, and shalt plate them with gold.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt ſet the Altar againſt the veile, that hangeth before the arke of teſtimonie before the propitiatorie wherwith the teſtimonie is couered, where I wil ſpeake to thee.
label: Exodus

text: And Aaron shal burne incenſe vpon it, ſwetely fragrant, in the morning. When he shal dreſſe the lampes, he shal burne it:
label: Exodus

text: and when he shal place them at euen, he shal burne incenſe euerlaſting before the Lord through your generations.
label: Exodus

text: You shal not offer vpon it incenſe of an other compoſition, nor oblation, and victime, neitheir ſhal you offer libamentes.
label: Exodus

text: And Aaron shal pray vpon the hornes therof once a yeare, with the bloud of that which was offered for ſinne, and shal pacifie vpon it in your generations. It shal be moſt Holie to the Lord.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Exodus

text: When thou shalt take the ſumme of the children of Iſrael according to their number, euerie one of them shal giue a price for their ſoules to the Lord, and there shal be no ſcourge among them, when they shal be reckened.
label: Exodus

text: And this shal euerie one giue that paſſeth to the naming, halfe a ſicle according to the meaſure of the temple. A ſicle hath twentee aboles. The halfe part of a ſicle shal be offered to the Lord.
label: Exodus

text: He that is accounted in the number, for twentie yeares and vpward, shal giue price.
label: Exodus

text: The rich man shal not adde to halfe a ſicle, and the poore man shal diminish nothing.
label: Exodus

text: And the money being receiued, which was contributed of the children of Iſrael, thou shalt deliuer vnto the vſes of the tabernacle of teſtimonie, that it may be a monument of them before the Lord, and he may be propitious to their ſoules.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt make alſo a lauer with his foote of braſſe, to wash in: and thou shalt ſet it betwen the tabernacle of the teſtimonie and the Altar. And water being put into it,
label: Exodus

text: Aaron and his ſonnes shal wash therin their handes and feete,
label: Exodus

text: when they are going into the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and when they are to come vnto the Altar, to offer on it incenſe to the Lord,
label: Exodus

text: leſt perhappes they die. it shal be an euerlaſting law to him, and to his ſeede by ſucceſſions.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes,
label: Exodus

text: ſaying: Take ſpices, of principal and choſen myrrh fiue hundred ſicles, and of cinnamon halfe ſo much, that is, two hundred fiftie ſicles, of calamus in like maner two hundred fiftie,
label: Exodus

text: and of caſia fiue hundred ſicles after the weight of the Sanctuarie, of oile of oliues the meaſure hin:
label: Exodus

text: and thou shalt make the holie oile of vnction, an ointment compounded by the art of an vnguentarie,
label: Exodus

text: and therof thou shalt anoynt the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and the arke of the teſtament,
label: Exodus

text: and the table with the veſſel therof, the candleſticke, and the furniture therof, the Altars of incenſe,
label: Exodus

text: and of holocauſte, and al the furniture that perteyneth to the ſeruice of them.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt ſanctifie al, and they shal be moſt Holie: he that shal touch them, shal be ſanctified.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt anoynt Aaron and his ſonnes, and shalt ſanctifie them, that they may doe the function of prieſthood vnto me.
label: Exodus

text: To the children of Iſrael alſo thou shalt ſay: This oile of vnction shal be holie vnto me through your generations.
label: Exodus

text: The flesh of man shal not be anoynted therewith, and you shal make none other after the compoſition of it, becauſe it is ſanctified, and shal be holie vnto you.
label: Exodus

text: What man ſoeuer shal compound ſuch, and shal giue therof to a ſtranger, shal be abandoned out of his people.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Take vnto thee ſpices, ſtactee, and onycha, galbanum of ſwete ſauour, and the cleareſt frankincenſe, al shal be of equal weight:
label: Exodus

text: and thou shalt make incenſe compounded by the worke of an vnguentarie, exactly tempered, and pure, and moſt worthie of ſanctification.
label: Exodus

text: And when thou haſt beaten al into verie ſmal pouder, thou shalt ſet of it before the tabernacle of teſtimonie, in the place where I wil appeare to thee. Moſt Holie shal the incenſe be vnto you.
label: Exodus

text: Such confection you shal not make vnto your owne vſes, becauſe it is holie to the Lord.
label: Exodus

text: What man ſoeuer shal make the like, to enioy the ſmel therof, shal perish out of his people.
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Exodus

text: Behold, I haue called by name Beſeleel the ſonne of Vri the ſonne of Hur of the tribe of Iuda,
label: Exodus

text: and I haue replenished him with the ſpirit of God, with wiſdome, & vnderſtanding, and knowledge in al worke,
label: Exodus

text: to deuiſe whatſoeuer may be artificially made of gold, and ſiluer, and braſſe,
label: Exodus

text: of marble, and precious ſtones, and diuerſitie of wood.
label: Exodus

text: And I haue geuen him for his felow Ooliab the ſonne of Achiſamech of the tribe of Dan. And in the hart of euerie skilful man haue I put wiſdome: that they may make al things which I haue commanded thee,
label: Exodus

text: the tabernacle of couenant, and the arke of teſtimonie, and the propitiatorie, that is ouer it, and al the veſſel of the tabernacle,
label: Exodus

text: and the table and the veſſel therof, the candleſticke moſt pure with the veſſel therof, and the Altares of incenſe,
label: Exodus

text: and of holocauſte, and al their veſſel, the lauer with his foote,
label: Exodus

text: the holie veſtments in the miniſterie for Aaron the prieſt, and for his ſonnes, that they may execute their office, about the ſacred things:
label: Exodus

text: the oile of vnction, and the incenſe of ſpices in the Sanctuarie, al thinges which I haue commanded thee, shal they make.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Exodus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: See that you keepe my ſabbath: becauſe it is a ſigne betwen me and you in your generations: that you may know that I am the Lord, which ſanctifie you.
label: Exodus

text: Keepe you my ſabbath: for it is holie vnto you: he that shal pollute it, dying shal die: he that shal doe worke in it, his ſoule shal perish out of the middes of his people.
label: Exodus

text: Six dayes shal you doe worke: in the ſeuenth day is the ſabbath, the holie reſt to the Lord. Euerie one that shal doe any worke in this day, shal die.
label: Exodus

text: Let the children of Iſrael keepe the Sabbath, and celebrate it in their generations. It is an euerlaſting couenant
label: Exodus

text: betwen me and the children of Iſrael, and a ſigne perpetual. for in ſix dayes the Lord made heauen and earth, and in the ſeuenth he ceaſed from worke.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord, when he had ended ſuch ſpeaches in mount Sinai, gaue vnto Moyſes two ſtone tables of teſtimonie, written with the finger of God.
label: Exodus

text: AND the people ſeeing that Moyſes made tariance ere he came downe from the mount, being aſſembled againſt Aaron, they ſayd: Ariſe, make vs goddes, that may goe before vs: for what hath chanced to this Moyſes the man that brought vs out of the Land of Ægypt, we know not.
label: Exodus

text: And Aaron ſayd to them: Take the golden earlettes from the eares of your wiues, and ſonnes and daughters, & bring them to me.
label: Exodus

text: And the people did that he had cõmanded, bringing the earlettes to Aaron.
label: Exodus

text: Which when he had receiued, he formed them by founders worke, and made of them a molten calfe. And they ſayd: Theſe are thy goddes Iſrael, that haue brought thee out of the land of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: Which when Aaron had ſenne, he builded an altar before it, and by a cryers voice proclaimed ſaying: To morow is the ſolemnitie of the Lord.
label: Exodus

text: And ryſing in the morning, they offered holocauſtes, and pacifique hoſtes, and the people ſate downe to eate, and to drinke, and they roſe vp to play.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying: Goe, get thee downe: thy people, which thou haſt brought out of the Land of Ægypt, hath ſinned.
label: Exodus

text: They haue quickly reuolted from the way, that thou didſt shew them: and they haue made to them ſelues a molten calfe, and haue adored, and immolating hoſtes vnto it, haue ſayd: Theſe are thy goddes Iſrael, that haue brought thee out of the Land of Ægypt
label: Exodus

text: And againe our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: I ſee that this people is ſtiffenecked:
label: Exodus

text: ſuffer me, that my furie may be angrie againſt them, and that I may deſtroy them, and I wil make thee into a great nation.
label: Exodus

text: But Moyſes beſought the Lord his God, ſaying: Why Lord, is thy furie angrie againſt thy people, whom thou haſt brought forth of the Land of Ægypt, in great power, and in a ſtrong hand?
label: Exodus

text: Let not the Ægyptians ſay I beſeech thee: He hath craftely brought them forth, that he might kil them in the mountaynes, and deſtroy them from the earth: let thyne anger ceaſe, and be pacified vpon the wickednes of thy people.
label: Exodus

text: Remenber Abraham, Iſaac, and Iſrael thy ſeruantes, to whom thou ſwareſt by thine owne ſelf, ſaying: I wil multiplie your ſeed as the ſtarres of heauen: and this whole land, wherof I haue ſpoken, I wil giue to your ſeed, and you shal poſſeſſe it alwayes.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord was pacified from doing the euil which he had ſpoken againſt his people.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes returned from the mount, carying the two tables of teſtimonie in his hand, written on both ſides,
label: Exodus

text: and made by the worke of God: the writing alſo of God was grauen in the tables.
label: Exodus

text: And Ioſue hearing the tumult of the people crying out, ſaid to Moyſes: The noyſe of battaile is heard in the campe.
label: Exodus

text: Who anſwered: It is not the crie of men encouraging of fight, nor the ſhoute of men compelling to flee: but I doe heare the voice of ſingers.
label: Exodus

text: And when he approched to the campe, he ſaw the calfe, and the daunces: and being very wrath, he threw the tables out of his hand, and brake them at the foote of the mount.
label: Exodus

text: and catching the calfe which they had made, he burnt it, and bette it into powder, which he ſtrawed into water, and gaue thereof drinke to the children of Iſrael.
label: Exodus

text: And he ſaid to Aaron: What hath this people done to thee, that thou shouldeſt bring vpon them an heinous ſinne?
label: Exodus

text: To whom he anſwered: Let not my lord be offended: for thou knoweſt this people, that it is prone to euil:
label: Exodus

text: they ſaid to me: Make vs goddes, that may goe before vs: for vnto this ſame Moyſes, that brought vs forth out of the Land of Ægypt, we know not what is chanced.
label: Exodus

text: To whom I ſaid: Which of you hath gold? They tooke, and brought to me: and I caſt it into the fire, and this calfe came forth.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes therfore ſeeing the people that they were made naked (for Aaron had ſpoiled them for the ignominie of filth, and had ſet them naked among their enemies)
label: Exodus

text: and ſtanding in the gate of the campe, he ſaid: If any man be our Lords, let him ioyne to me. And there gathered vnto him al the ſonnes of Leui:
label: Exodus

text: to whom he ſaid: This ſaith the Lord God of Iſrael: Put euerie man his ſword vpon his thigh: goe, & returne from gate to gate through the middes of the campe, and euerie man kil his brother, and frend, and neighbour.
label: Exodus

text: And the ſonnes of Leui did according to the ſaying of Moyſes, and there were ſlaine in that day about three thouſand men.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid: You haue conſecrated your handes this day to our Lord, euerie man in his ſonne & in his brother, that bleſſing may be giuen to you
label: Exodus

text: And when the next day was come, Moyſes ſpake to the people: You haue ſinned a verie great ſinne: I wil goe vp to our Lord, if by anie meanes I may be able to intreate him for your ſinful fact.
label: Exodus

text: And returning to our Lord, he ſaid: I beſeech thee: this people hath ſinned a heinous ſinne, and they haue made to them ſelues goddes of gold: either forgiue them this treſpaſſe,
label: Exodus

text: or if thou doe not, ſtrike me out of the booke that thou haſt written.
label: Exodus

text: To whom our Lord anſwered: He that hath ſinned to me, him wil I ſtrike out of my booke:
label: Exodus

text: but goe thou, and leade this people whither I haue told thee: myne Angel shal goe before thee. And I in the day of reuenge wil viſite this ſinne alſo of theirs.
label: Exodus

text: Our Lord therfore ſmote the people for the fault concerning the calfe, which Aaron had made.
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying: Goe, get thee vp from this place, thou and thy people which thou haſt brought out of the Land of Ægypt, into the land wherof I ſware to Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob, ſaying: To thy ſeede I wil giue it:
label: Exodus

text: and I wil ſend an Angel thy precuſor, that I may caſt out the Chananeite, and Amorrheite, and Hetheite, and Pherezeite, and Heueite, and Iebuſeite,
label: Exodus

text: and thou maieſt enter into the land that floweth with milke and honey: for I wil not goe vp with thee, becauſe thou art a ſtiffenecked people: leſt perhappes I deſtroie thee in the way.
label: Exodus

text: And the people hearing this verie il ſaying, mourned: and no man put on his ornamentes after the cuſtome.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſayd to Moyſes: Speake to the children of Iſrael: Thou art a ſtiffenecked people, once I shal goe vp in the middes of thee, and shal deſtroy thee. Now preſently lay away thy ornamentes, that I may know what to doe vnto thee.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore the children of Iſrael layd away their ornamentes from mount Horeb.
label: Exodus

text: Moyſes alſo taking the tabernacle, pitched it without the campe a farre of, and called the name thereof, The Tabernacle of couenant. And al the people, that had anie queſtion, went forth to the Tabernacle of couenant, without the campe.
label: Exodus

text: And when Moyſes went forth to the tabernacle, al the people roſe vp, and euerie one ſtoode in the dore of his pauilion, and they beheld the backe of Moyſes, til he entred into the tabernacle.
label: Exodus

text: And when he was entred into the Tabernacle of couenant, the piller of the cloude came downe, and ſtoode at the doore, and he ſpake with Moyſes,
label: Exodus

text: al they beholding that the piller of the cloud ſtoode at the doore of the Tabernacle. And they ſtoode, and adored at the doores of their tabernacles.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſpake vnto Moyſes face to face, as a man is wont to ſpeake to his frend. And when he returned into the campe, his miniſter Ioſue the ſõne of Nun, a yong man, departed not from the Tabernacle.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid to our Lord: Thou commandeſt me to leade forth this people: and doeſt not shew me whom thou wilt ſend with me, eſpecially wheras thou haſt ſaid: I know thee by name, and thou haſt found grace in my ſight.
label: Exodus

text: If therfore I haue found grace in thy ſight, shew me thy face, that I may know thee, and may find grace before thine eyes, looke vpon thy people this nation.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid: My face shal goe before thee, and I wil giue thee reſt.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſayd: If thy ſelfe doeſt not goe before, bring vs not out of this place.
label: Exodus

text: For whereby shal we be able to know I and thy people, that we haue found grace in thy ſight, vnles thou walke with vs, that we may be glorified of al peoples, that dwel vpon the earth?
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: This word alſo, which thou haſt ſpoken, wil I doe: for thou haſt found grace before me, and thy ſelfe I haue knowen by name.
label: Exodus

text: Who ſaid: Shew me thy glorie.
label: Exodus

text: He anſwered: I wil shew thee al good, and wil cal in the name of the Lord before thee: and I wil haue mercie on whom I wil, and I wil be merciful to whom it shal pleaſe me.
label: Exodus

text: And againe he ſayd: Thou canſt not ſee my face: for man shal not ſee me, and liue.
label: Exodus

text: And againe: Behold, quoth he, there is a place with me, and thou shalt ſtand vpon the rocke.
label: Exodus

text: And when my glorie shal paſſe, I wil ſette thee in a hole of the rocke, and protect thee with my right hand, vntil I paſſe:
label: Exodus

text: and I wil take away my hand, and thou shalt ſee my backe-partes: but my face thou canſt not ſee.
label: Exodus

text: AND after this he ſaid: Cut thee two tables of ſtone like vnto the former, and I wil write vpon them the wordes, which the tables had, which thou haſt broken.
label: Exodus

text: Be readie in the morning, that thou maieſt forwith go vp into the mount Sinai, and thou shalt ſtand with me vpon the toppe of the mount.
label: Exodus

text: Let no man go vp with thee, neither let anie man be ſene throughout the whole mount: the oxen alſo and the sheepe let them not feede ouer againſt.
label: Exodus

text: He cut out therfore two tables of ſtone, ſuch as had bene before: aud riſing very early he went vp into mount Sinai, as our Lord had commanded him, carying with him the tables.
label: Exodus

text: And when our Lord was deſcended in a cloude, Moyſes ſtoode with him, calling vpon the name of our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: Who paſſing before him, he ſaid: Dominatour Lord God, merciful and clement, patient and of much compaſſion, and true,
label: Exodus

text: Which keepeſt mercie vnto thouſandes: which takeſt away iniquitie, and wicked factes, and ſinnes, and no man of him ſelfe is innocent before thee. Which doeſt render the iniquitie of the fathers to the children, and to the nephewes vnto the third and fourth generation.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes making haſt, bowed flatte vnto the earth, and adoring
label: Exodus

text: he ſaid: If I haue found grace in thy ſight o Lord, I beſeech thee that thou wilt goe with vs (for it is a ſtiffe necked people) and take away our iniquities and ſinnes, and poſſeſſe vs.
label: Exodus

text: Our Lord anſwered: I wil make a couenant in the ſight of al, I wil do ſignes that were neuer ſene vpon the earth, nor in anie nations: that this people may ſee, in the middes of whom thou art, the terrible worke of the Lord which I wil doe.
label: Exodus

text: Obſerue al thinges which this day I command thee: I my ſelf wil caſt out before thy face the Amorrheite, and Chananeite, and Hetheite, the Pherezeite alſo, and Heueite, and Iebuſeite.
label: Exodus

text: Beware thou neuer ioyne amitie with the inhabitants of that land, which may be thy ruine:
label: Exodus

text: but deſtroy their altars, breake their ſtatues, and cut downe their groues:
label: Exodus

text: adore not a ſtrange God. The Lord his name is Ielouſe, God is an emulatour.
label: Exodus

text: Enter no traffick with the men of thoſe regions: leſt, when they haue fornicated with their goddes, and haue adored their idols, ſome man cal thee to eate of the thinges immolated.
label: Exodus

text: Neither shalt thou take a wife for thy ſonnes of their daughters: leſt after them ſelues haue fornicated, they make thy ſonnes alſo to fornicate with their goddes.
label: Exodus

text: Molten goddes thou shalt not make to thee.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt keepe the ſolemnitie of the azymes. Seuen dayes ſhalt thou eate azymes, as I haue commanded thee, in the time of the moneth of new corne: for in the moneth of ſpring time thou didſt goe out of Ægypt.
label: Exodus

text: Al of the male kind, that openeth the matrice, shal be mine. Of al beaſtes as wel oxen as of sheepe, it shal be mine.
label: Exodus

text: The firſtborne of an aſſe thou shalt redeeme with a sheepe: but if thou wilt not giue a price for it, it shal be ſlaine. The firſtborne of thy ſonnes thou shalt redeeme: neither shalt thou appeare emptie in my ſight.
label: Exodus

text: Six dayes shalt thou worke, the ſeuenth day thou shalt ceaſe to eare, and reape.
label: Exodus

text: The ſolemnitie of weekes thou shalt make to thee, in the firſt fruites of corne of thy wheate harueſt, and the ſolemnitie, when the time of the yeare returneth that al thinges are laid vp
label: Exodus

text: Three tymes of the yeare al thy male shal appeare in the ſight of the omnipotent Lord God of Iſrael.
label: Exodus

text: For when I ſhal haue taken away the nations from thy face, and shal haue dilated thy borders, no man shal lie in wayte againſt thy land, when thou doeſt goe vp, and appeare in the ſight of the Lord thy God thriſe in a yeare.
label: Exodus

text: Thou shalt not immolate the bloud of my hoſte vpon leauen: neither shal there remaine in the morning of the victime of the ſolemnitie of the Phaſe.
label: Exodus

text: The firſt of the fruites of thy ground thou shalt offer in the houſe of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not boile a kidde in the milke of his damme.
label: Exodus

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Write thee theſe wordes, in which I haue made a couenant both with thee and with Iſrael.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore he was there with our Lord fourtie dayes and fourtie nightes: he did not eate bread, and he dronke no water, and he wrote in the tables the wordes of the couenant, tenne
label: Exodus

text: And when Moyſes came downe from the mount Sinai, he held the two tables of teſtimonie, and he knew not that his face was horned by the conuerſation of the talke of our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: And Aaron and the children of Iſrael ſeing the face of Moyſes horned, they were afraid to come neere.
label: Exodus

text: And being called of him, they returned as wel Aaron as the princes of the ſynagogue. And after that he ſpake to them,
label: Exodus

text: al the children of Iſrael alſo came to him: whom he commanded al thinges that he had heard of our Lord in mount Sinai.
label: Exodus

text: And hauing ended his talke, he put a veile vpon his face.
label: Exodus

text: Which going in to our Lord, and ſpeaking with him, he toke away vntil he went forth, and then he ſpake to the children of Iſrael al thinges that had bene commanded him.
label: Exodus

text: Who ſaw that the face of Moyſes coming forth was horned, but he couered his face againe, if at anie time he ſpake to them.
label: Exodus

text: THERFORE al the multitude of the children of Iſrael being gathered together, he ſaid to them: Theſe are the thinges which our Lord hath commanded to be done.
label: Exodus

text: Six dayes you shal do worke: the ſeuenth day shal be holie vnto you, the ſabbath, and reſt of our Lord: he that shal do anie worke in it, shal be ſlaine.
label: Exodus

text: You shal not kindle fire in al your habitations on the ſabbath day.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid to al the aſſemblie of the children of Iſrael: This is the word that our Lord hath commanded, ſaying:
label: Exodus

text: Separate with you firſt fruites to the Lord. Let euerie one that is willing and hath a readie hart, offer them to the Lord: gold and ſiluer, and braſſe,
label: Exodus

text: hyacinth and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, and ſilke, the haire of goates,
label: Exodus

text: and rammes skinnes died redde, and ianthin skinnes, the wood ſetim,
label: Exodus

text: and oile to maintaine lightes, and to make ointment, and moſt ſweete incenſe,
label: Exodus

text: Onyx ſtones, and pretious ſtones, for the adorning of the Ephod and the Rationale.
label: Exodus

text: Whoſoeuer of you is wiſe, let him come, and make that which our Lord hath commanded:
label: Exodus

text: to wit, the Tabernacle, and the roofe therof, and the couer, the ringes, and the bordeworke with the barres, the pinnes and the feete:
label: Exodus

text: the Arke and the ſtaues, the propitiatorie, and the veile, that is drawen before it:
label: Exodus

text: the Table with the barres and the veſſel, and the loaues of propoſition:
label: Exodus

text: the Candleſticke to beare vp the lightes, the veſſel therof and the lampes, and the oile to the nourishing of fires:
label: Exodus

text: the Altar of incenſe, and the barres, and the oile of vnction and the incenſe of ſpices: the Hanging at the doore of the tabernacle:
label: Exodus

text: the Altar of holocauſte, and his grate of braſſe, with the barres and veſſel therof: the Lauer and his feete:
label: Exodus

text: the Curtines of the court with the pillers and the feete, the hanging in the doores of the entrie,
label: Exodus

text: the pinnes of the tabernacle and of the court with their litle cordes:
label: Exodus

text: the Veſtimentes, that are to be vſed in the miniſterie of the ſanctuarie, the veſture of Aaron the high Prieſt, and of his ſonnes, to do the function of Prieſthood vnto me.
label: Exodus

text: And al the multitude of the children of Iſrael going forth from the ſight of Moyſes,
label: Exodus

text: offered firſt fruites to our Lord with a moſt prompt and deuoute minde, to make the worke of the tabernacle of the teſtimonie. Whatſoeuer was neceſſarie to the ſeruice therof and to the holie veſtiments,

text: both men and wemen did giue, tablettes and earlettes, ringes and bracelettes: euerie veſſel of gold was ſeparated for the donaries of our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: If anie man had hyacinth, and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died redde, and ianthin skinnes,
label: Exodus

label: Exodus

text: But the skilful wemen alſo gaue ſuch thinges as they had ſponne, hyacinth, purple, and ſcarlet, and ſilke,

text: But the princes offered onyx ſtones, and pretious ſtones, for the Ephod and the Rationale,

label: Exodus

text: Al men and wemen with deuoute mind offered donaries, that the workes might be made which our Lord had comanded by the hand of Moyſes. Al the children of Iſrael did dedicate voluntarie thinges to our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes ſaid to the children of Iſrael: Behold, our Lord hath called by name Beſeleel the ſonne of Vri the ſonne of Hur of the tribe of Iuda.
label: Exodus

text: And hath filled him with the ſpirit of God, with, wiſdome and intelligence, and ſcience and al learning
label: Exodus

text: to deuiſe and to make worke in gold and ſiluer, and braſſe,
label: Exodus

text: and in grauing ſtones, and in carpenters worke, Whatſoeuer can be deuiſed artificially,
label: Exodus

text: he hath giuen in his hart: Ooliab alſo the ſonne of Achiſamech of the tribe of Dan:
label: Exodus

text: both hath he inſtructed with wiſedome, to make the workes of a carpenter, a tapeſter, an embroderer of hyacinth and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, and ſilke, and to weaue al thinges, and to inuent al new things.
label: Exodus

text: BESELEEL therfore, and Ooliab, and euerie wiſe man, to whom our Lord gaue wiſedome and vnderſtanding, to know how to worke artificially, made the thinges that are neceſſarie for the vſes of the Sanctuarie, and which our Lord did command.
label: Exodus

text: And when Moyſes had called them, and euerie cunning man, to whom our Lord had geuen wiſedome, and ſuch as of their owne accord had offered them ſelues to the making of the worke,

label: Exodus

text: Whereupon the arſtificers being conſtrained to come,
label: Exodus

label: Exodus

text: becauſe the thinges that were offered did ſuffice and were ouer much.
