label: Exodus

text: and two other at ech corner of the tabernacle behind:
label: Exodus

text: which were alſo ioyned from beneth vnto the toppe, & they grew together into one connexion. So he made on either ſide at the corners
label: Exodus

text: that there were in al eight bordes, and had ſixteene feete of ſiluer, to witte, two feete vnder euerie borde.
label: Exodus

text: He made alſo barres of the wood ſetim, fiue to hold together the bordes of one ſide of the tabernacle,
label: Exodus

text: and fiue other to ioyne together the bordes of the other ſide: and beſides theſe, fiue other barres at the weſt ſide of the tabernacle againſt the ſea.
label: Exodus

text: He made alſo an other barre, that might come by the middes of the bordes from corner vnto corner.
label: Exodus

text: And the bordeworke it ſelfe he plated with gold. And their ringes he made of gold, through which the barres might be drawen: the which alſo themſelues he couered with plates of gold.
label: Exodus

text: He made alſo a veile of hiacinth, and purple, ſcarlette, and twiſted ſilke, with embrodered worke, varied and diſtinguished:
label: Exodus

text: and foure pillers of the wood ſetim, which with their heades he plated with gold, caſting their feete of ſiluer.
label: Exodus

text: He made alſo a hanging in the entrie of the tabernacle of hyacinth, purple, ſcarlet, and twiſted ſilke, with the worke of an embroderer:
label: Exodus

text: and fiue pillers with their heades, which he couered with gold, and their feete he did caſt of braſſe.
label: Exodus

text: AND Beſeleel made alſo the arke of the wood ſetim, hauing two cubites and an halfe in length, and a cubite and an halfe in bredth, the height alſo was of one cubite and an halfe: and he plated it with the pureſt gold within and without.
label: Exodus

text: And he made to it a crowne of gold round about,
label: Exodus

text: caſting foure ringes of gold at the foure corners thereof: two ringes in the one ſide, and two in the other.
label: Exodus

text: Barres alſo he made of the wood ſetim, which he plated with gold,
label: Exodus

text: and which he put into the ringes, that were at the ſides of the arke to carie it.
label: Exodus

text: He made alſo the Propititorie, that is, the Oracle, of the pureſt gold, two cubites and an halfe in length, and a cubite and an halfe in bredth.
label: Exodus

text: Two Cherubins alſo of beaten gold, which he ſette on either ſide of the Propitiatorie:
label: Exodus

text: One Cherub in the toppe of one ſide, and the other Cherub in the toppe of the other ſide: two Cherubins in each toppe of the Propitirtorie,
label: Exodus

text: ſpreading their winges, and couering the Propitiatorie, and looking one toward the other and toward it.
label: Exodus

text: He made alſo the table of the wood ſetim in length two cubites, and in bredth one cubite, which had in height a cubite & an halfe.
label: Exodus

text: and he did compaſſe it with the fineſt gold, and he made to it a golden ledge round about,
label: Exodus

text: and to the ledge it ſelfe a golden crowne enterpolished of foure fingers, and vpon the ſame an other golden crowne.
label: Exodus

text: And he caſt foure ringes of gold, which he put in the foure corners at euerie foote of the table
label: Exodus

text: againſt the crowne: and he put the barres into them, that the table might be caried.
label: Exodus

text: The barres alſo them ſelues he made of the wood ſetim, and compaſſed them with gold.
label: Exodus

text: And the veſſel for the diuers vſes of the table, ſawcers, phiales, and goblettes, and cenſars, of pure gold, wherein the libamentes are to be offered.
label: Exodus

text: He made alſo the candleſticke beaten of the fineſt gold. From the shaft wherof the branches, cuppes, and boules and lilies did proceede:
label: Exodus

text: ſix on both ſides, three branches on one ſide, and three on the other:
label: Exodus

text: three cuppes in maner of a nutte on euerie branch, and boules withal and lilies: and three cuppes of the fashion of a nutte in an other branch, and boules withal and lilies. The worke of the ſix branches, that proceded from the shaft of the candleſticke, equal
label: Exodus

text: And in the shaft it ſelfe were foure cuppes after the maner of a nutte, and boules withal at euerie one and lilies:
label: Exodus

text: and boules vnder two branches in three places, which together make ſix branches proceding from one shaft.
label: Exodus

text: both the boules therfore, & the branches were out of it, al beaten of the pureſt gold.
label: Exodus

text: He made alſo the ſeuen lampes with their ſnuffers, and the veſſel, where the ſnuffings ſhould be put out, of moſt pure gold.
label: Exodus

text: The candleſticke withal the veſſel therof did weigh a talent of gold.
label: Exodus

text: He made alſo the altar of incenſe of the wood ſetim, hauing a cubite euerie way foure ſquare, and in height two: from the corners wherof the hornes did procede.
label: Exodus

text: And he plated it with the pureſt gold, with the grate and the walles and the hornes.
label: Exodus

text: And he made to it a crowne of gold round about, and two golden ringes vnder the crowne at either ſide, that the barres may be put into them, and the altar may be caried.
label: Exodus

text: And the barres them ſelues he made alſo of the wood ſetim, and couered them with plates of gold.
label: Exodus

text: He compounded alſo oile for the ointment of ſanctification, and incenſe of the pureſt ſpices with the worke of a pigmentarie.
label: Exodus

text: HE MADE alſo the Altar of Holocauſte of the wood ſetim, fiue cubites foure ſquare, and three in height:
label: Exodus

text: the hornes wherof did procede from the corners, and he couered it with plates of braſſe.
label: Exodus

text: And for the vſes therof he prepared of braſſe diuers veſſels, cauldrons, tonges, flesh-hookes, pothookes, & firepannes.
label: Exodus

text: And the grate therof in maner of nette he made of braſſe, and vnder it in the middes of the altar an hearth,
label: Exodus

text: caſting foure ringes at as manie toppes of the nette, to put in barres to carie it:
label: Exodus

text: the which themſelues alſo he made of the wood ſetim, and couered them with plates of braſſe:
label: Exodus

text: and he drew them through the ringes, that ſtoode out in the ſides of the altar. And the altar it ſelfe was not maſſie, but holow of bordes, and within emptie.
label: Exodus

text: He made alſo the lauer of braſſe, with the foote therof, of wemens glaſſes, that watched in the doore of the tabernacle.
label: Exodus

text: He made alſo the court, in the ſouth ſide wherof were hanginges of twiſted ſilke, of an hundred cubites,
label: Exodus

text: twentie pillers of braſſe with their feete, the heades of the pillers, & the whole grauing of the worke, of ſiluer.
label: Exodus

text: In like maner at the north ſide the hanginges, pillers, and feete and the heades of the pillers were of the ſame meaſure, and worke and metal.
label: Exodus

text: But on that ſide that looketh to the Weſt, there were hanginges of fiftie cubites, ten braſen pillers with their feete, and the heades of the pillers, and al the grauing of the worke, of ſiluer.
label: Exodus

text: Moreouer againſt the Eaſt he prepared haginges of fiftie cubites:
label: Exodus

text: of the which, one ſide conteyned fiſtene cubites of three pillers, with their feete:
label: Exodus

text: and on the other ſide (becauſe betwen both he made the entrie of the tabernacle) there were hanginges equally of fiftene cubites, and three pillers, and feete as manie.
label: Exodus

text: Al the hanginges of the court were wouen of twiſted ſilke.
label: Exodus

text: The feete of the pillers were of braſſe, and their heades with al their grauinges of ſiluer: but the pillers alſo of the court them ſelues he plated with ſiluer.
label: Exodus

text: And in the entrie therof he made with embrodered worke a hanging of hyacinth, purple, ſcarlet, and twiſted ſilke, that had twentie cubites in length, but the height was fiue cubites according to the meaſure, which al the hanginges of the court had.
label: Exodus

text: And the pillers in the entrie were foure with feete of braſſe, and their heades and grauinges of ſiluer.
label: Exodus

text: The pinnes alſo of the tabernacle and of tpe court round about he made of braſſe.
label: Exodus

text: Theſe are the iuſtrumentes of the taberbacle of teſtimonie, which were numbred according to the precept of Moyſes, in the ceremonies of the Leuites by the hand of Ithamar the ſonne of Aaron the prieſt:
label: Exodus

text: which Beſeleel the ſonne of Vri, the ſonne of Hur, of the tribe of Iuda had accomplished, as our Lord commanded by Moyſes,
label: Exodus

text: hauing ioyned to him ſelfe for his compagnion Ooliab the ſonne of Achiſamech of the tribe of Dan: who was himſelf alſo an egregious artificer in wood, and a tapiſter and embroderer of hyacinth, purple, ſcarlet, and ſilke.
label: Exodus

text: Al the gold that was ſpent in the worke of the Sanctuarie, and that was offered in donaries, was nine and twentie talentes, and ſeuen hundred thirtie ſicles according to the meaſure of the Sanctuarie.
label: Exodus

text: And it was offered of them that paſſed to the number, from twentie yeares and vpward, of ſix hundred three thouſand, and fiue hundred fiftie, able men to beare armes.
label: Exodus

text: There were moreouer an hundred talentes of ſiluer, wherof were caſt the feete of the Sanctuarie, and of the entrie where the veile hangeth.
label: Exodus

text: An hundred feete were made of an hundred talentes, one talent being accoũted for euerie foote.
label: Exodus

text: And of the thouſand ſeuen hundred, and ſeuentie fiue he made the heades of the pillers, which them ſelues he alſo plated with ſiluer.
label: Exodus

text: Of braſſe alſo there were offered ſeuentie two thouſand talentes, and foure hundred ſicles beſides,
label: Exodus

text: of the which were caſt the feete in the entrie of the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and the altar of braſſe with the grate therof, and al the veſſel, that pertayne to the vſe therof,
label: Exodus

text: and the feete of the court aſwel in the circuite as in the entrie therof, and the pinnes of the tabernacle and of the court, round about.
label: Exodus

text: MOREOVER of hyacinth and purple, ſcarlet and ſilke he made the veſtures, that Aaron should weare when he miniſtred in the holie places, as our lord commanded Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: He made therfore an Ephod of gold, hyacinth, and purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, and twiſted ſilke,
label: Exodus

text: with embrodered worke, and he did cut thinne plates of gold, and drew them ſmal into threedes, that they might be twiſted with the woufe of the former colours,
label: Exodus

text: and two edges coupled one to the other in the toppe on either ſide,
label: Exodus

text: and a bawdrike of the ſame colours, as our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: He prepared alſo two Onyx ſtones, faſt ſette and cloſed in gold, and grauen by the art of a lapidarie, with the names of the children of Iſrael:
label: Exodus

text: and he ſet them in the ſides of the Ephod for a moniment of the children of Iſrael, as our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: He made alſo a Rationale with embrodered worke according to the worke of the Ephod, of gold, hyacinth, purple, and ſcarlet twiſe died, and twiſted ſilke:
label: Exodus

text: foure ſquare, duble, of the meaſure of a palme.
label: Exodus

text: And he ſet foure rewes of precious ſtones. In the firſt rewe was ſardius, topazius, an emeraud.
label: Exodus

text: In the ſecond, a carbuncle, a ſaphire, and a iaſper.
label: Exodus

text: In the third, a ligurius, an achates, and an amethiſt.
label: Exodus

text: In the fourth a chryſolith, an onyx, and beryllus, compaſſed and encloſed in gold by their rewes.
label: Exodus

text: And the twelue ſtones them ſelues, were grauen with the names of the twelue tribes of Iſrael, euerie one with his ſeueral name.
label: Exodus

text: They made alſo in the rationale litle cheynes linked one to an other of the pureſt gold,
label: Exodus

text: and two hookes, and as manie ringes of gold. Moreouer the ringes they ſet on either ſide of the Rationale,
label: Exodus

text: on the which the two golden cheynes should hang, which they put into the hookes, that ſtoode out in the corners of the Ephod.
label: Exodus

text: Theſe both before and behind did ſo agree with them ſelues, that the Ephod and the Rationale might be knit one to the other,
label: Exodus

text: tyed to the bawdrike and with ringes ſtrongly coupled, which a lace of hyacinth ioyned, leſt they should flagge looſely, and be moued one from the other, as our Lord commanded Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: They made alſo the tunike of the Ephod al of hyacinth,
label: Exodus

text: and a hole for the head in the vpper part againſt the middes, and the border of the hole round about wouen:
label: Exodus

text: and beneth at the feete pomegranates of hyacinth, purple, ſcarlet, and twiſted ſilke:
label: Exodus

text: and litle belles of the pureſt gold, which they did put betwen the pomegranates in the vtmoſt part of the tunike round about:
label: Exodus

text: to witte, a bel of gold, and a pomegranate, wherwith the high prieſt went adorned, when he executed his miniſterie, as our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: They made alſo ſilken tunikes with wouen worke for Aaron and his ſonnes:
label: Exodus

text: and mitres with their litle crownes of ſilke:
label: Exodus

text: linnen breeches alſo, of fine line:
label: Exodus

text: and a girdle of twiſted ſilke, hyacinth, purple, & ſcarlet twiſe died, with the art of embrodering, as our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: They made alſo the plate of ſacred veneration of moſt pure gold, and they wrote in it with the worke of a lapidarie: The Holie of our Lord:
label: Exodus

text: and they tyed it to the mitre with a lace of hyacinth, as our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore al the worke of the tabernacle & of the roofe of teſtimonie was perfited: and the children of Iſrael did al thinges which our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: And they offered the tabernacle and the roofe and the whole furniture, ringes, bordes, barres, pillers and their feete,
label: Exodus

text: the couer of rammes skinnes died redde, and the other couer of ianthin skinnes,
label: Exodus

text: the veile, the arke, the barres, the propitiatorie,
label: Exodus

text: the table with the veſſel therof and the loaues of propoſition:
label: Exodus

text: the candleſticke, the lampes, and the furniture of them with the oyle:
label: Exodus

text: the altar of gold, and the ointment, and the incenſe of ſpices:
label: Exodus

text: and the hanging in the entrie of the tabernacle:
label: Exodus

text: the altar of braſſe, the grate, the barres, and al the veſſel therof: the lauer with the foote therof: the hanginges of the court, and the pillers with their feete:
label: Exodus

text: the hanging in the entrie of the court, and the litle cordes, and the pinnes therof. Nothing wanted of the veſſel, that was commanded to be made for the miniſterie of the tabernacle, and for the roofe of couenant.
label: Exodus

text: The veſtimentes alſo, which the prieſtes vſe in the Sanctuarie, to witte, Aaron and his ſonnes,
label: Exodus

text: the children of Iſrael offered, as our Lord had commanded.
label: Exodus

text: Which thinges after that Moyſes ſaw al finished, he bleſſed them.
label: Exodus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Exodus

text: The firſt moneth, the firſt day of the moneth, thou ſhalt erect the tabernacle of the teſtimonie,
label: Exodus

text: and shalt put in it the arke, and shalt let downe before it the veile:
label: Exodus

text: and bringing in the table, thou shalt ſet vpon it the thinges that are commanded after the rite. The candleſticke shal ſtand with the lampes therof,
label: Exodus

text: and the altar of gold whereon the incenſe is burned, before the arke of teſtimonie. Thou shalt put the hanging in the entrie of the tabernacle,
label: Exodus

text: and before it the altar of holocauſte:
label: Exodus

text: the lauer betwen the altar and the tabernacle, which thou shalt fil with water.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt compaſſe about the court with hanginges, and the entrie therof.
label: Exodus

text: And taking the oile of vnction thou shalt anoynte the tabernacle with the veſſel therof, that they may be ſanctified:
label: Exodus

text: the altar of holocauſte and al the veſſel therof:
label: Exodus

text: the lauer with the foote therof; al shalt thou conſecrate with the oile of vnction, that they may be moſt Holie.
label: Exodus

text: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his ſonnes to the doore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and hauing washed them with water,
label: Exodus

text: thou shalt reueſt them with the ſacred veſtimentes, that they may miniſter to me, and the vnction of them may proſper to an euerlaſting prieſthood.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes did al thinges which our Lord had commanded.
label: Exodus

text: Therfore the firſt moneth of the ſecond yeare, the firſt day of the moneth, the tabernacle was placed.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes erected, it, and put the bordes and feete and barres, and reared the pillers,
label: Exodus

text: and ſpred the roofe ouer the tabernacle, putting ouer it a couer, as our Lord had commanded.
label: Exodus

text: He put alſo the teſtimonie in the arke, thruſting barres vnderneth, and the oracle aboue.
label: Exodus

text: And when he had brought the arke into the tabernacle, he drew before it the veile to fulfil the commandement of our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: He ſette the table alſo in the tabernacle of teſtimonie at the north ſide without the veile,
label: Exodus

text: ordering the bread of propoſition before it, as our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: He ſette the candleſticke alſo in the tabernacle of teſtimonie ouer againſt the table on the ſouth ſide,
label: Exodus

text: placing the lampes in order, according to the precept of our Lord.
label: Exodus

text: He ſet alſo the altar of gold vnder the roofe of teſtimonie againſt the veile,
label: Exodus

text: and burned vpon it the incenſe of ſpices, as our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: He put alſo the hanging in the entrie of the tabernacle of teſtimonie,
label: Exodus

text: and the altar of holocauſte in the entrie of the teſtimonie, offering on it the holocauſte, and the ſacrifices, as our Lord had commanded.
label: Exodus

text: The lauer alſo he ſet betwen the tabernacle of teſtimonie and the altar, filling it with water.
label: Exodus

text: And Moyſes and Aaron, and his ſonnes washed their handes and feete,
label: Exodus

text: when they entred the roofe of couenant, and went to the altar, as our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Exodus

text: He erected alſo the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, drawing the hanging in the entrie therof. After al thinges were perfited,
label: Exodus

text: the cloude couered the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and the glorie of our Lord filled it.
label: Exodus

text: Neither could Moyſes enter the roofe of couenant, the cloude couering al thinges, and the maieſtie of our Lord shining, becauſe the cloude had couered al thinges.
label: Exodus

text: If at anie time the cloud did leaue the tabernacle, the children of Iſrael went forward by their troupes:
label: Exodus

text: If it hong ouer, they remained in the ſame place.
label: Exodus

text: For the cloude of our Lord honge ouer the tabernacle by day, and a fire by night, in the ſight of al the children of Iſrael throughout al their manſions.
label: Exodus

text: AND OVR LORD called Moyſes, and ſpake to him out of the tabernacle of teſtimony, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael; & thou shalt ſay to them: The man of you, that shal offer an hoſte to our Lord, of beaſtes, that is of oxen & sheepe, offering victimes
label: Leviticus

text: if his oblation be an holocauſte, and of the heard; he shal offer a male, without ſpotte, at the dore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie, to propitiate our Lord vnto him:
label: Leviticus

text: and he shal put his handes vpon the heade of the hoſte, and it shal be acceptable, and profitable to his expiation.
label: Leviticus

text: And he shal immolate the calfe before our Lord, and the children of Aaron the prieſtes shal offer the bloud therof, powring it in the circuite of the altar, which is before the dore of the tabernacle:
label: Leviticus

text: And the skinne of the hoſte being plucked of, the ioyntes they shal cut into peeces,
label: Leviticus

text: and shal put fire vnderneth in the altar, hauing before laid a pyle of wood in order:
label: Leviticus

text: and the ioyntes that are cut out, laying in order thereupon, to wit, the head, & al thinges that cleaue to the liuer,
label: Leviticus

text: the entralles and feete being washed with water, and the prieſt shal burne them vpon the altar for an holocauſte, and ſweete ſauoure to our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: And if the oblation be of flockes, an holocauſte of sheepe or of goates, a lambe of a yeare old without ſpot shal he offer:
label: Leviticus

text: and he shal immolate it at the ſide of the altar that looketh to the North, before our Lord: but the bloud therof the ſonnes of Aaron shal poure vpon the altar round about:
label: Leviticus

text: and they shal diuide the ioyntes, the head, and al that cleaue to the lyuer: and shal lay them vpon the wood, vnder which the fire is to be put:
label: Leviticus

text: but the entrales and the feete they shal wash with water. And the whole the prieſt shal offer, and burne vpon the altar for an holocauſt, and moſt ſweete ſauoure to our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: But if the oblation of holocauſt to our Lord be of birdes, of turtles and young pigions,
label: Leviticus

text: the prieſt shal offer it at the altar: and writhing the head to the necke, and breaking the place of the wound, he shal make the bloud to runne downe vpon the brimme of the altar:
label: Leviticus

text: but the croppe of the throate, and the fethers he shal caſt nigh to the altar at the eaſt ſide, in the place where the ashes are wount to be powred out,
label: Leviticus

text: and he shal breake the pinnions therof, and shal not cut, nor diuide it with a knife, and shal burne it vpon the altar, putting fire vnder the wood. It is an holocauſt and oblation of moſt ſweete ſauoure to our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: VVHEN a ſoule shal offer an oblation of ſacrifice to our Lord, fine flowre shal be his oblation. and he shal poure oyle vpon it, and put franckincenſe,
label: Leviticus

text: and ſhal carie it to the ſonnes of Aaron the prieſts: of whom one ſhal take a handful of the flowre, and the oile, and al the franckincenſe, and shal put it a memorial vpon the Altar for a moſt ſweete ſauour to our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: And that which shal be left of the ſacrifice, shal be Aarons, and his ſonnes, Holie of holies among the oblations of our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: But when thou offereſt a ſacrifice baked in the ouen: of flowre, to wit, loaues without leauen, tempered with oyle, and wafers vnleauened layd ouer with oyle.
label: Leviticus

text: If thine oblation be of the frying panne, of flowre tempered with oyle, and without leuen,
label: Leviticus

text: thou shalt diuide it in litle peeces, and shalt poure oyle vpon it.
label: Leviticus

text: And if the ſacrifice be from the gridiron, in like maner the flowre shal be tempered with oyle,
label: Leviticus

text: which offering to our Lord, thou shalt deliuer to the handes of the prieſt.
label: Leviticus

text: Who hauing offered it, shal take a memorie of the ſacrifice, and burne vpon the altar for a ſwete ſauour to our Lord,
label: Leviticus

text: and whatſoeuer is left, shal be Aarons, and his ſonnes, Holie of holies among the oblations of our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Euerie oblation, that is offered to our Lord, shal be made without leauen, neyther shal any leauen and honie be burned in the ſacrifice of our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: The firſt fruites only of them and the giftes you shal offer: but vpon the altar they shal not be put, for a ſauour of ſwetenes.
label: Leviticus

text: What ſacrifice ſoeuer thou offereſt, thou ſhalt ſeaſon it with ſalt neither shalt thou take away the ſalt of the couenant of thy God from thy ſacrifice. In euerie oblation thou shalt offer ſalt.
label: Leviticus

text: But if thou offer a gyfte of the firſt fruites of thy corne to our Lord, of the eares being yet greene, thou shalt drie it at the fire, and bruiſe it in maner of meale, and ſo ſhalt thou offer thy firſt fruites to our Lord,
label: Leviticus

text: powring oyle vpon it, and putting on franckincenſe, becauſe it is the oblation of our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Wherof the prieſt shal burne for memorie of the gift, part of the meale bruiſed, and of the oile, and al the frankincenſe.
label: Leviticus

text: AND if his oblation be an hoſte of pacifiques, and he wil offer of beues, male or female, without ſpot shal he offer them before our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: And he shal lay his hand vpon the head of his victime, which shal be immolated in the entrie of the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and the ſonnes of Aaron the prieſt shal poure the bloud in the circuite of the altar.
label: Leviticus

text: And they shal offer of the hoſt of pacifiques, for an oblation to our Lord, the fatt that couereth the entralles, and whatſoeuer fatt is within:
label: Leviticus

text: the two kidneys with the fat wherwith the guttes are couered, and the caule of the liuer with the two little kydneys.
label: Leviticus

text: And they shal burne them vpon the altar, for an holocauſt, putting fire vnder the wood: for an oblation of moſt ſwete ſauour to our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: But if his oblation, and the hoſte of pacifiques be of flocks, whether he offer male, or female, they shal be without ſpot.
label: Leviticus

text: If he offer a lambe before our Lord,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal put his hand vpon the head of his victime; which shal be immolated in the entrie of the tabernacle of teſtimonie: and the ſonnes of Aaron shal powre the bloud therof in the circuite of the altar.
label: Leviticus

text: And they shal offer of the hoſte of pacifiques, a ſacrifice to our Lord: the fat and the whole rumpe,
label: Leviticus

text: with the kidneys, and the fatt that couereth the bellie and al the vital partes, and both little kydneys, with the fatt that is about the guttes, and the caule of the liuer with the two little kidneys.
label: Leviticus

text: And the prieſt shal burne them vpon the altar, to the foode of the fire, and of the oblation of our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: If his oblation be a goate, and he offer it to our Lord,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal put his hand vpon the head therof: and shal immolate it in the entrie of the tabernacle of teſtimonie. And the ſonnes of Aaron shal poure the bloude therof in the circuite of the altar.
label: Leviticus

text: And they shal take of it to the foode of our Lords fire, the fatt that couereth the bellie, and that couereth al the vital partes:
label: Leviticus

text: the two little kydneys with the caule, that is vpon them about the guttes, and the tallowe of the liuer with the little kidneys:
label: Leviticus

text: and the prieſt shal burne them vpon the altar, to the food of the fire, and of a moſt ſweete ſauour. Al the fatt shal be our Lordes
label: Leviticus

text: by a perpetual right in your generations, and in al your habitations: you shal eate no bloude nor fat at al.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael: The ſoule that ſinneth by ignorance, and doth anie thing of al the commandmentes of our Lord, which he commanded not to be done.
label: Leviticus

text: If the prieſt that is anointed ſinne, making the people to offend, he shal offer for his ſinne, a calfe without ſpott to our Lord:
label: Leviticus

text: and he shal bring it to the dore of teſtimonie before our Lord, and shal put his hand vpon the head therof, and shal immolate it to our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: He shal drawe alſo of the bloud of the calfe, carying it into the tabernacle of teſtimonie.
label: Leviticus

text: And when he hath dipped his finger in the bloud he shal ſprinckle it ſeuen times before our Lord, againſt the veile of the Sanctuarie.
label: Leviticus

text: and of the ſame bloud he shal put vpon the hornes of the altar of incenſe moſt acceptable to our Lord, which is in the tabernacle of teſtimonie. And al the reſt of the bloud he shal powre at the foote of the altar of holocauſte in the entrie of the tabernacle.
label: Leviticus

text: And the fatt of the calfe he shal take away for the ſinne, aſwel that which couereth the entralles, as al the partes that are within.
label: Leviticus

text: The two little kidneys, and the caule that is vpon them beſide the guttes, and the fatt of the liuer with the two litle kidneis,
label: Leviticus

text: as is taken away from the calfe which is an hoſt of pacifiques, and he shal burne them vpon the altar of holocauſte.
label: Leviticus

text: But the skinne and al the flesh with the heade and feete and boweles and dung,
label: Leviticus

text: and the reſt of the bodie he shal carie forth without the campe into a cleane place, where the ashes are wount to be powred out: and he shal burne them vpon a pyle of wood, which shal be burnt in the place where the ashes are powred out.
label: Leviticus

text: And if al the multitude of Iſrael be ignorant, and through ignorance do that which is againſt the commandement of our Lord,
label: Leviticus

text: and afterward vnderſtand their ſinne, they shal offer for their ſinne a calfe, and shal bring it to the dore of the tabernacle.
label: Leviticus

text: And the ancientes of the people shal put their handes vpon the head therof before our Lord. And the calfe being immolated in the ſight of our Lord,
label: Leviticus

text: the prieſt that is anoynted, shal carie of the bloud into the tabernacle of teſtimonie,
label: Leviticus

text: dipping his finger, and ſprinkling ſeuen times againſt the veile.
label: Leviticus

text: and he shal put of the ſame bloud on the hornes of the altar, that is before our Lord, in the tabernacle of teſtimonie: and the reſt of the bloud, he shal poure at the foote of the altar of holocauſte, which is at the dore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie.
label: Leviticus

text: And al the fatte therof he shal take vp, & shal burne it vpon the altar:
label: Leviticus

text: doing ſo with this calfe, as he did alſo before: and the prieſt praying for them, our Lord wil be propitious vnto them.
label: Leviticus

text: But the calfe it ſelfe he shal carie forth without the campe, and shal burne it like as the former calfe: becauſe it is for the ſinne of the multitude.
label: Leviticus

text: If a Prince ſinne, and by ignorance do of manie thinges one, that by the law of our Lord is forbidden:
label: Leviticus

text: and afterward vnderſtandeth his ſinne, he shal offer an hoſte to our Lord, a bucke of the goates without ſpotte.
label: Leviticus

text: And he shal put his hand vpon the head therof: and when he hath immolated it in the place where holocauſt is wont to be ſlaine before our Lord, becauſe it is for ſinne,
label: Leviticus

text: the prieſt shal dippe his finger in the bloud of the hoſte for ſinne, touching the hornes of the altar of holocauſte, and the reſt powring at the foote therof.
label: Leviticus

text: But the fatt he shal burne vpon it, as is wont to be done in the victimes of pacifiques: and the prieſt shal pray for him, and for his ſinne, and it shal be forgiuen him.
label: Leviticus

text: And if a ſoule of the people of the land shal ſinne through ignorance, doing anie of thoſe thinges, that by the law of our Lord are forbidden, and offending,
label: Leviticus

text: and knoweth his ſinne, he shal offer a she goate without ſpotte.
label: Leviticus

text: And he shal put his hand vpon the head of the hoſt that is for ſinne, and shal immolate it in the place of holocauſt.
label: Leviticus

text: And the prieſt shal take vp of the bloud with his finger: and touching the hornes of the altar of holocauſt, the reſt he shal powre out at the foote therof.
label: Leviticus

text: But taking away al the fatt, as is wont to be taken away of the victimes of pacifiques, he shal burne it vpon the altar, for a ſwete ſauour to our Lord; and he shal pray for him, and it shal be forgeuen him.
label: Leviticus

text: But if he offer of the flocke a victime, for his ſinne, to wit, an ewe without ſpotte;
label: Leviticus

text: he ſhal put his hand vpon the head therof, and shal immolate it in the place where the hoſtes of holocauſts are wont to be ſlayne.
label: Leviticus

text: And the prieſt shal take of the bloud therof with his finger, and touching the hornes of the altar of holocauſt, the reſt he shal powre at the foote therof.
label: Leviticus

text: Al the fatte alſo he shal take away, as the fatte of the ramme, that is offered for pacifiques, is wont to be taken away: and shal burne it vpon the altar, a burnt ſacrifice of our Lord: and he shal pray for him, and for his ſinne, and it shal be forgiuen him.
label: Leviticus

text: IF a ſoule ſinne, and heare the voice of one ſwearing, and be witnes becauſe either he him ſelfe ſawe, or is priuie to it: vnleſſe he vtter it, he shal beare his iniquitie.
label: Leviticus

text: The ſoule that toucheth anie vncleane thing, either that which was killed of a beaſt, or died of it ſelfe, or anie other thing that creepeth: and forgeteth his vncleannes is guiltie, and hath offended:
label: Leviticus

text: and if he touch anie thing of the vncleanneſſe of man, according to anie impuritie wherwith he is wount to be polluted, & hauing forgotten, doe knowe it afterward, he shal be guiltie of an offence.
label: Leviticus

text: The ſoule that ſweareth, and vttereth with his lippes, that he would doe either il; or wel, and bindeth the ſame with an oathe, and his word, & hauing forgotten afterward vnderſtandeth his offence,
label: Leviticus

text: let him do penance for his ſinne,
label: Leviticus

text: and offer of the flockes an ewe lambe, or a shee goate, and the prieſt shal pray for him, and for his ſinne:
label: Leviticus

text: but if he be not able to offer a beaſt, let him offer two turtles, or two young pigions to our Lord, one for ſinne, and the other for an holocauſt,
label: Leviticus

text: and he shal geue them to the prieſt: who offering the firſt for ſinne, shal wryth backe the heade therof to the litle pinions, ſo that it ſticke to the necke, and be not altogeather broken of.
label: Leviticus

text: And of the bloud therof he shal ſprinckle the wall of the altar, and whatſoeuer is left, he shal make it diſtil to the bottome therof, becauſe it is for ſinne.
label: Leviticus

text: And the other he shal burne for an holocauſte, as is wount to be done: and the prieſt shal pray for him, and for his ſinne, and it shal be forgeuen him.
label: Leviticus

text: And if his hand be not able to offer two turtles, or two young pigions, he shal offer for his ſinne, of floure the tenth part of an ephi. He shal not put oyle vpon it, nor caſt anie frankincenſe theron, becauſe it is for ſinne,
label: Leviticus

text: and he shal deliuer it to the prieſt: who taking therof a ful handful, shal burne it vpon the altar for a moniment, of him that did offer it:
label: Leviticus

text: praying for him and making expiation, but the part that is left, him ſelfe shal haue for a gifte.
label: Leviticus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: If a ſoule tranſgreſſing the ceremonies, by errour shal ſinne in thoſe thinges that are ſanctified to our Lord, he shal offer for his offence a ramme, without ſpotte out of the flockes, that may be bought for two ſicles, according to the weight of the Sanctuarie:
label: Leviticus

text: and the damage it ſelfe which he did, he shal reſtore, and the fift part he shal adde beſides, deliuering it to the prieſt, who shal pray for him, offering the ramme, and it shal be forgeuen him.
label: Leviticus

text: If a ſoule ſinne by ignorance, and doe one of thoſe thinges which by the lawe of the Lord are forbidden, and being guiltie of ſinne, vnderſtand his iniquitie,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal offer a ramme without ſpotte of the flockes to the prieſt, according to the meaſure, and eſtimation of the ſinne: who shal pray for him, becauſe he did it vnwitting: and it shal be forgiuen him,
label: Leviticus

text: becauſe by errour he offended againſt the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: OVR Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: The ſoule that shal ſinne, and contemning the Lord, shal denie vnto his neighbour the thing deliuered to his cuſtodie, which was committed to his credite, or shal by force extort anie thing, or do oppreſſion,
label: Leviticus

text: or shal finde a thing loſt, and denying it, be alſo foreſworne, and shal doe anie other thing of manie, wherein men are wount to ſinne,
label: Leviticus

text: being conuicted of the offence,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal render al thinges which by fraude, he would haue obteyned, whole, and the fift part beſides to the owner vnto whom he did the damage.
label: Leviticus

text: But for his ſinne he shal offer a ramme without ſpott out of the flocke, and shal geue it to the prieſt, according to the eſtimation, and meaſure of the offence:
label: Leviticus

text: who shal pray for him before the Lord, and he shal haue forgeuenes for euerie thing that in doing he ſinned.
label: Leviticus

text: And Our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Command Aaron and his ſonnes: This is the Law of an holocauſt: It shal be burnt vpon the altar, al night vntil morning: the fire shal be vpon the ſame altar.
label: Leviticus

text: The prieſt shal be reueſted with the tunike and the linnen femoralles: and he shal take vp the ashes, which the deuouring fire burned, and putting them beſides the altar,
label: Leviticus

text: shal be vnueſted of his former veſtments, and being clothed with others, shal carie them forth without the campe, and in a moſt cleane place shal cauſe them to be conſumed vnto duſt.
label: Leviticus

text: And the fire on the altar shal alwaies burne, which the prieſt shal nourish, putting wood vnderneth, in the morning euerie day, and laying on the holocauſt, therupon shal burne the fatte of the pacifiques.
label: Leviticus

text: This fire is continual which shal neuer faile on the altar.
label: Leviticus

text: This is the Law of the ſacrifice and libamentes, which the children of Aaron shal offer before the Lord, and before the altar.
label: Leviticus

text: The prieſt shal take vp a handful of the floure, that is tempered with oyle, and al the frankincenſe, that is put vpon the floure: and he shal burne it on the altar for a moniment of moſt ſweete odour to the Lord:
label: Leviticus

text: and the part of the floure that is left, shal Aaron eate with his ſonnes, without leauen: and he shal eate it in the Holie place of the court of the tabernacle.
label: Leviticus

text: And therefore it shal not be leauened, becauſe part therof is offered for the burnt ſacrifice of the Lord. It shal be moſt Holie, as that for ſinne, and for offence.
label: Leviticus

text: The males onlie of Aarons ſtocke shal eate it. It shal be an ordinance and euerlaſting in your generations of the ſacrifices of the Lord. Euerie one that toucheth them, shal be ſanctified.
label: Leviticus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: This is the oblation of Aaron, and of his ſonnes, which they muſt offer to the Lord, in the day of their vnction. The tenth part of an ephi of floure shal they offer in a ſacrifice for euer, halfe therof in the morning, and halfe therof at euen:
label: Leviticus

text: which being tempered with oile shal be fried in a frying panne.
label: Leviticus

text: And the prieſt that by right ſucceedeth his father, shal offer it hote, for a moſt ſwete odour to the Lord, and it shal wholy be burnt on the altar.
label: Leviticus

text: For euerie ſacrifice of the prieſt shal be conſumed with fire, neither shal anie man eate therof.
label: Leviticus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to Aaron and his ſonnes: This is the law of the hoſte for ſinne. In the place where the holocauſt is offered, shal it be immolated before our Lord It is Holie of holies.
label: Leviticus

text: The prieſt that doth offer it, shal eate it in a holie place, in the courte of the tabernacle.
label: Leviticus

text: Whatſoeuer shal touch the flesh therof, shal be ſanctified. If of the bloud therof a garment be ſprinkled, it shal be washed in a holie place.
label: Leviticus

text: And the earthen veſſel, wherein it was ſodden, shal be broken but if the veſſel be of braſſe, it shal be ſcoured, and washed with water.
label: Leviticus

text: Euerie male of the prieſtlie race shal eate of the flesh therof, becauſe it is Holie of holies.
label: Leviticus

text: For the hoſte that is ſlaine for ſinne, whoſe bloud is caried into the tabernacle of teſtimonie to make expiation in the Sanctuarie, shal not be eaten, but shal be burnt with fire.
label: Leviticus

text: THIS alſo is the lawe of an hoſte for an offence, the moſt Holie:
label: Leviticus

text: therfore where the holocauſt is immolated, the victime alſo for an offence shal be ſlaine: the bloud therof shal be poured round about the altar.
label: Leviticus

text: They shal offer therof the rumpe and the fatte that couereth the entralles:
label: Leviticus

text: the two little kidneys, and the fatte that is beſide the guttes, and the caule of the lyuer with the two litle kidneys.
label: Leviticus

text: And the prieſt shal burne them vpon the altar: it is the burnt ſacrifice of our Lord for an offence.
label: Leviticus

text: Euerie male of the prieſts ſtocke, in a holie place shal eate this flesh, becauſe it is moſt Holie.
label: Leviticus

text: As the hoſte for ſinne is offered, ſo alſo that for an offence: the lawe of both hoſtes shal be one: to the prieſt that offereth it, it shal pertaine.
label: Leviticus

text: The prieſt that offereth the victime of holocauſt, shal haue the skinne therof.
label: Leviticus

text: And euerie ſacrifice of flowre, that is baked in the ouen, & whatſoeuer is prepared vpon the grediron, or in the frying panne, it shal be that prieſtes by whom it is offered.
label: Leviticus

text: Whether they be tempered with oyle, or drie, to al the ſonnes of Aaron equal meaſure shal be diuided to euerie one.
label: Leviticus

text: This is the law of the hoſte of pacifiques that is offered to our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: If the oblation be for thankes geuing, they shal offer loaues without leauen tempered with oyle, and wafers vnleauened laid ouer with oyle, and fryed floure, and manchets tempered with the mingling of oyle:
label: Leviticus

text: loaues alſo leauened with the hoſte of thankes, which is offered for pacifiques:
label: Leviticus

text: wherof one for firſt fruites shal be offered to our Lord, and shal be the prieſts that shal poure out the bloud of the hoſte.

text: the flesh wherof shal be eaten the ſame day, neither shal anie of it remaine vntil morning.
label: Leviticus

text: If anie man by vowe, or of his owne accorde offer an hoſte, it shal in like maner be eaten the ſame day: but if ought remaine vntil the morrow, it is lawful to eate it:
label: Leviticus

text: but whatſoeuer the third day shal find, fire shal conſume it.
label: Leviticus

text: If anie man eate of the flesh of the victime of pacifiques the third day, the oblation shal be of none effect, neither shal it profite the offerer: yea rather whatſoeuer ſoule shal defile it ſelfe with ſuch meate, shal be guiltie of preuarication.
label: Leviticus

text: The flesh that hath touched any vncleane thing, shal not be eaten, but shal be burnt with fire: he that is cleane, shal eate therof.
label: Leviticus

text: A ſoule being polluted that eateth of the flesh of the hoſte of pacifiques, which is offered to our Lord, shal perish from his people.
label: Leviticus

text: And that which hath touched the vncleannes of man, or of beaſt, or of anie thing that can pollute, and eateth of ſuch kind of flesh, shal perish from his people.
label: Leviticus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus
