label: Leviticus

text: The fatte of the carcaſſe of cartaine, and of the beaſt, that was caught of an other beaſt, you shal haue for diuers vſes.
label: Leviticus

text: If anie man eate the fatte, that should be offered for the burnt ſacrifice of our Lord, he shal perish out of his people,
label: Leviticus

text: The bloud alſo of whatſoeuer beaſt you shal not take in meate, as wel of birdes as of cattel.
label: Leviticus

text: Euerie ſoule that eateth bloud, shal perish out of his people.
label: Leviticus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, ſaing: He that offereth a victime of pacifiques to our Lord, let him offer therwith a ſacrifice alſo, that is, the libaments therof.
label: Leviticus

text: He shal hold in his handes the fatte of the hoſte, and the breſt: and when he hath offered and conſecrated both to our Lord, he shal deliuer them to the prieſt,
label: Leviticus

text: who shal burne the fatte vpon the altar, but the breaſt shal be Aarons, and his ſonnes.
label: Leviticus

text: The right shoulder alſo of the pacifique hoſtes shal fal for firſt fruites of the prieſt.
label: Leviticus

text: He of the ſonnes of Aaron, that offereth the bloud, and the fatte, him ſelfe shal haue the right shoulder alſo for his portion.
label: Leviticus

text: For the breſt of eleuation and the shoulder of ſeperation I haue taken of the children of Iſrael, from their pacifique hoſtes, and haue geuen them to Aaron the prieſt, and to his ſonnes, by a lawe for euer, of al the people of Iſrael.
label: Leviticus

text: This is the anoynting of Aaron and his ſonnes, in the ceremonies of our Lord, in the day when Moyſes offered them, that they might doe the function of prieſthood,
label: Leviticus

text: and the thinges that our Lord commanded to be geuen them of the children of Iſrael, by a perpetual religion in their generations.
label: Leviticus

text: This is the lawe of holocauſte, and of the ſacrifice for ſinne, and for an offence, and for conſecration, and the victimes of pacifiques:
label: Leviticus

text: Which our Lord apointed to Moyſes in mount Synai when he commanded the children of Iſrael, that they should offer their oblations to our Lord in the deſert of Synai.
label: Leviticus

text: AND Our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Take Aaron with his ſonnes, their veſtimentes, and the oyle of vnction, a calfe for ſinne, two Rammes, a basket with azymes,
label: Leviticus

text: and thou shalt gather al the aſſemblie to the dore of the tabernacle.
label: Leviticus

text: And Moyſes did as our Lord had commaunded. And al the multitude being gathered before the dore of the tabernacle,
label: Leviticus

text: he ſaid: This is the word, that our Lord hath commanded to be done.
label: Leviticus

text: And immediatly he offered Aaron & his ſonnes: and when he had washed them,
label: Leviticus

text: he reueſted the high prieſt, with the ſtrait linnen garment, girding him with a bawdrike, and reueſting him with the tunike of hyacinth, and ouer it he put the Ephod,
label: Leviticus

text: which he ſtraitening with the girdle, fitted it to the Rationale, wherin was Doctrine and Veritie,
label: Leviticus

text: with the mitre alſo he couered his head: and vpon it, againſt the forehead, he put the plate of gold conſecrated in ſanctification, as our Lord had commanded him.
label: Leviticus

text: He tooke alſo the oyle of vnction, wherwith he anoynted the tabernacle, with al the furniture therof.
label: Leviticus

text: And ſanctifying them, and hauing ſprinkled the altar ſeuen times, he anoynted it, and al the veſſel therof, and the lauer with the foote therof he ſanctified with the oyle.
label: Leviticus

text: The which pouring vpon Aarons head, he anoynted, and conſecrated him:
label: Leviticus

text: his ſonnes alſo after he had offered them, he reueſted with linnen tunikes, and girded them with bawdrikes, and put mitres on them, as our Lord had commanded.
label: Leviticus

text: He offered alſo the calfe for ſinne: and when Aaron and his ſonnes had put their handes vpon the head therof,
label: Leviticus

text: he did immolate it: drawing the bloud, and dipping his finger, touched the hornes of the altar round about. Which being expiated, and ſanctified, he poured the reſt of the bloud at the botome therof.
label: Leviticus

text: But the fatte that was vpon the entralles, and the caule of the liuer, and the two little kidneys, with their little tallow he burnt vpon the altar:
label: Leviticus

text: the calfe with the skinne, and the flesh, and the dung, he burnt without the campe, as our Lord had commanded.
label: Leviticus

text: He offered alſo a ramme for an holocauſt: vpon the head wherof when Aaron and his ſonnes had put their handes,
label: Leviticus

text: he did immolate it, and poured the bloud therof in the circuite of the altar.
label: Leviticus

text: And cutting the ramme it ſelfe into peeces, the head therof, and the ioyntes, and the fatte he burnt with fire,
label: Leviticus

text: hauing firſt washed the entralles, and the feete. and the whole ramme together he burnt vpon the altar, becauſe it was an holocauſt of moſt ſwete odour to our Lord, as he had commanded him.
label: Leviticus

text: He offered alſo the ſecond ramme, for the conſecration of prieſts: and Aaron, and his ſonnes did putte their handes vpon the head therof:
label: Leviticus

text: which when Moyſes had immolated, taking of the bloud therof, he touched the tippe of Aarons right eare, and the thumbe of his right hand, in like maner alſo of his foote.
label: Leviticus

text: He offered alſo the ſonnes of Aaron: and when of the bloud of the ramme, being immolated, he had touched the tippe of the right eare of euerie one, and the thumbes of the right hand and foote, the reſt he poured on the altar, round about:
label: Leviticus

text: but the fatte, and the rump, and al the fatte that couereth the entralles, and the caule of the liuer, and the two kidneies with their fatte, & with the right shoulder, he ſeperated.
label: Leviticus

text: And taking out of the basket of azymes, which was before our Lord, a loafe without leauen, and a manchet tempered with oile, and a wafer he put them vpon the fatte, and the right shoulder,
label: Leviticus

text: deliuering al to Aaron, and to his ſonnes. Who hauing lifted them vp before our Lord,
label: Leviticus

text: he tooke them againe of their handes, and burnt them vpon the altar of holocauſt, becauſe it was the oblation of conſecration, for a ſwete odoure, of the ſacrifice to our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: And he tooke of the ramme of conſecration, the breſt for his portion, eleuating it before our Lord, as our Lord had commanded him.
label: Leviticus

text: And taking the oyntment, and the bloud that was vpon the altar, he ſprinkled it vpon Aaron, and his veſtiments, & vpon his ſonnes and their veſtiments.
label: Leviticus

text: And when he had ſanctified them in their veſtiments, he commanded them, ſaying: Boile the flesh before the dore of the tabernacle, and there eate it. Eate ye alſo the loaues of conſecration, that are laid in the basket, as our Lord commanded me, ſaying: Aaron and his ſonnes shal eate them:
label: Leviticus

text: and whatſoeuer shal be left of the flesh, and the loaues, fire shal conſume.
label: Leviticus

text: Out of the dore alſo of the tabernacle you shal not goe forth ſeuen daies, vntil the day wherein the time of your conſecration shal be expired. for in ſeuen dayes the conſecration is finished:
label: Leviticus

text: as at this preſent it hath bene done, that the rite of the ſacrifice might be accomplished.
label: Leviticus

text: Day & night shal you tarie in the tabernacle obſeruing the watches of our Lord, leſt you die: for ſo it hath bene commanded me.
label: Leviticus

text: And Aaron, and his ſonnes dld al thinges which our Lord ſpake by the hand of Moyſes.
label: Leviticus

text: AND when the eight day was come, Moyſes called Aaron and his ſonnes, and the ancients of Iſrael, and ſaid to Aaron:
label: Leviticus

text: Take of the heard a calfe for ſinne, and a ramme for an holocauſt, both without ſpot, and offer them before our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: And to the children of Iſrael thou shalt ſpeake: Take ye a bucke goate for ſinne, and a calfe, and a lambe, of a yeare old, & without ſpot for an holocauſt,
label: Leviticus

text: an oxe and a ramme for pacifiques: and immolate them before our Lord, offering in the ſacrifice of euerie one, flowre tempered with oile; for to day our Lord wil appeare to you.
label: Leviticus

text: They tooke therfore al thinges that Moyſes had cōmanded before the dore of the tabernacle: where when al the multitude ſtood,
label: Leviticus

text: Moyſes ſaid: This is the word, which our Lord hath commanded: doe it, and his glorie wil appeare to you.
label: Leviticus

text: And he ſaid to Aaron: Approch to the altar, & immolate for thy ſinne: offer the holocauſt, and pray for thy ſelf and for the people, and when thou haſt ſlaine the peoples hoſte, pray for them, as our Lord hath cōmanded.
label: Leviticus

text: And forthwith Aaron approching to the altar, immolated the calfe for his ſinne:
label: Leviticus

text: the bloud whetof his ſonnes brought to him: wherin dipping his finger, he touched the hotnes of the altar, and poured the reſt at the foote therof.
label: Leviticus

text: And the fatte, and the litle kidneis, and the caule of the liuer, which are for ſinne, he burnt vpon the altar, as our Lord had commanded Moyſes:
label: Leviticus

text: but the flesh and skinne therof he burnt with fire without the campe.
label: Leviticus

text: He immolated alſo the victime of holocauſt: and his ſonnes brought him the bloud therof, which he poured in the circuite of the altar.
label: Leviticus

text: The hoſte alſo it ſelfe being cut into peeces, they brought with the head and euerie member. Al which he burnt with fire vpon the altar,
label: Leviticus

text: hauing firſt washed the entralles and the feete with water.
label: Leviticus

text: And offering for the ſinne of the people, he ſlew the bucke goat: and expiating the altar:
label: Leviticus

text: he made the holocauſt,
label: Leviticus

text: adding in the ſacrifice the libaments, which are offered withal, and burning them vpon the altar, beſide the ceremonies of the morning holocauſt.
label: Leviticus

text: He immolated alſo the oxe, and the ramme, the pacifique hoſtes of the people: and his ſonnes brought him the bloud, which he poured vpon the altar round about.
label: Leviticus

text: The fatte alſo of the oxe, and the rump of the ramme, and the two little kindneis with their fatte, and the caule of the liuer
label: Leviticus

text: they put vpon the breſts. and after the fatte was burnt vpon the altar,
label: Leviticus

text: their breſts, and the right shoulders, Aaron did ſeperate, eleuating them before our Lord, as Moyſes had commanded.
label: Leviticus

text: And ſtretching forth his hand to the people, he bleſſed them. And ſo the hoſtes for ſinne, and the holocauſtes, and the pacifiques being finished, he deſcended.
label: Leviticus

text: And Moyſes and Aaron going into the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and afterward comming forth, bleſſed the people. And the glorie of our Lord appeared to al the multitude:
label: Leviticus

text: and behold a fire coming forth from our Lord, deuoured the holocauſt, and the fatte that was vpon the altar: Which thing, when the multitude had ſenne, they praiſed our Lord, falling on their faces.
label: Leviticus

text: AND Nadab, and Abiu the ſonnes of Aaron catching cenſors, did put in fire, and incenſe therupon, offering before our Lord ſtrange fire: which was not commanded them.
label: Leviticus

text: And fire comming forth from our Lord, deuoured them, and they dyed before our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: And Moyſes ſaid to Aaron: This is it which our Lord hath ſpoken: I wil be ſanctified in them, that approch to me, and in tbe ſight of al the people I wil be glorified. Which Aaron hearing held his peace.
label: Leviticus

text: And Moyſes calling Miſael, and Eliſaphan the ſonnes of Oziel, the vncle of Aaron, ſaid to them: Goe and take away your bretheren from the ſight of the Sanctuarie, and carie them without the campe.
label: Leviticus

text: And going forthwith they tooke them as they lay, reueſted with linnen tunikes, & did caſt them forth, as it had bene commanded them.
label: Leviticus

text: And Moyſes ſpake to Aaron, & to Eleazar, and Ithamar his ſonnes: Vncouer not your heades, and rent not your veſtiments, leſt perhaps you die, and indignation come vpon al the aſſemblie. Let your brethren, and al the houſe of Iſrael, lament the burning that our Lord hath raiſed,
label: Leviticus

text: and your ſelues shal not goe out of the dore of the tabernacle, otherwiſe you shal perish: for the oyle of holie vnction is vpon you. Who did al thinges according to the precept of Moyſes.
label: Leviticus

text: Our Lord alſo ſaid to Aaron:
label: Leviticus

text: Wine, and anie thing that may make drunke, you shal not drinke, thou and thy ſonnes, when you enter into the tabernacle of teſtimonie, leſt you die: becauſe it is an euerlaſting precept through your generations.
label: Leviticus

text: And that you may haue knowledge to diſcerne betwen the holie and prophane, betwen the polluted and cleane:
label: Leviticus

text: and may teach the children of Iſrael al my ordinances, which the Lord hath ſpoken to them by the hand of Moyſes.
label: Leviticus

text: And Moyſes ſpake to Aaron and to Eleazar, and Ithamar his ſonnes, that were left: Take the ſacrifice, that is remayning of the oblation of our Lord, and eate it without leauen beſide the altar, becauſe it is Holie of holies.
label: Leviticus

text: And you shal eate it in a holie place: which is giuen to thee and thy ſonnes of the oblations of our Lord, as it hath bene commanded me.
label: Leviticus

text: The breſt alſo that is offered, and the shoulder that is ſeperated, you shal eate in a moſt cleane place thou and thy ſonnes, and thy daughters with thee. For they are laid apart for thee and thy children, of the healthful hoſtes of the children of Iſrael:
label: Leviticus

text: becauſe the ſhoulder and the breſt, and the fatte that is burnt on the altar, they haue eleuated before our Lord, and they pertaine to thee, and to thy ſonues by a perpetual lawe, as our Lord hath commanded.
label: Leviticus

text: Among theſe thinges, when Moyſes ſought for the bucke goate, that had bene offered for ſinne, he found it burnt: and being angrie againſt Eleazar, and Ithamar the ſonnes of Aaron that remained, he ſaid:
label: Leviticus

text: Why did you not eate the hoſte for ſinne, in a holie place, which is moſt Holie, and geuen to you, that you may beare the iniquitie of the multitude, and may pray for it in the ſight of our Lord,
label: Leviticus

text: eſpecially wheras of the bloud therof, there hath not bene caried within the holie places, and you ought to haue eaten it in the Sanctuarie, as it was commanded me?
label: Leviticus

text: Aaron anſwered: This day hath bene offered the victime for ſinne, and the holocauſt before our Lord: and to me that is chanced which thou ſeeſt. how could I eate it, or pleaſe our Lord in ceremonies hauing a ſorowful hart?
label: Leviticus

text: Which when Moyſes had heard, he was ſatisfied with his anſwere.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes and Aaron, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Say to the children of Iſrael: Theſe are the beaſts which you ought to eate of al the liuing things of the earth.
label: Leviticus

text: Euerie one that hath the hoofe diuided, and cheweth the cudde among the cattel, you shal eate.
label: Leviticus

text: But whatſoeuer in dede cheweth the cudde, and hath an hoofe, but diuideth it not, as the camel, and others, that you shal not eate, and among the vncleane you shal repute it.
label: Leviticus

text: Cherogril which cheweth the cudde, and diuideth not the hoofe, is vncleane.
label: Leviticus

text: The hare alſo: for that alſo cheweth the cudde, but diuideth not the hoofe.
label: Leviticus

text: And the ſwine: which though it diuideth the hoofe, cheweth not the cudde.
label: Leviticus

text: The flesh of theſe you shal not eate, nor touch their carcaſſes, becauſe they are vncleane to you.
label: Leviticus

text: Theſe are the thinges that brede in the waters, and which it is lawful to eate. Al that hath finnes, and ſcales, aſwel in the ſea, as in the riuers, and the pooles, you shal eate.
label: Leviticus

text: But whatſoeuer hath not finnes and ſcales, of thoſe that moue and liue in the waters, ſhalbe vnto you abhominable,
label: Leviticus

text: and execrable, their flesh you shal not eate, and their carcaſſes you shal auoide.
label: Leviticus

text: Al that haue not finnes and ſcales in the waters, shal be polluted.
label: Leviticus

text: Of birdes theſe are they which you muſt not eate, and are to be auoided of you: The Eagle, and the griffon, and the oſprey,
label: Leviticus

text: and the kite, and the vulture according to his kinde,
label: Leviticus

text: and euerie one of the rauens kinde, according to their ſimilitude,
label: Leviticus

text: the oſtrich, and the owle, and the ſterne, and the hauke according to his kinde.
label: Leviticus

text: the ſcritchowle, and the diuer, and the ſtorke,
label: Leviticus

text: and the ſwanne, and the onocratal, and the porphirion,
label: Leviticus

text: the herodian, and the charadrion accotding to his kind, the lapwing alſo, and the batte.
label: Leviticus

text: Of foules euerie one that goeth vpon foure feete, shal be abhominable to you.
label: Leviticus

text: And whatſoeuer walketh vpon foure feete, but hath the legges behind longer, wherwith he hoppeth vpon the earth,
label: Leviticus

text: that you shal eate, as is the bruke in his kind, the attake, and the ophiomach, and the locuſt, euerie one according to their kinde.
label: Leviticus

text: But of foule whatſoeuer hath foure feete onlie, shal be execrable to you:
label: Leviticus

text: and whatſoeuer ſhal touch the carcaſſes of them, shal be polluted, and shal be vncleane vntil euen:
label: Leviticus

text: and if it be neceſſarie that he carie anie of theſe that be dead, he shal wash his clothes, and shal be vncleane vntil ſunne ſette.
label: Leviticus

text: Euerie beaſt that hath a hoofe, but diuideth it not, neither cheweth the cudde, shal be vncleane: and whatſoeuer toucheth it, shal be defiled.
label: Leviticus

text: That which walketh vpon hands of al beaſts, which goe on foure feete, shal be vncleane: he that toucheth their carcaſſes, shal be polluted vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: And he that carieth ſuch carcaſſes, shal wash his clothes, and shal be vncleane vntil euen: becauſe al theſe thinges are vncleane to you.
label: Leviticus

text: Theſe alſo shal be reputed among polluted thinges, of al that moue vpon the earth, the weeſel and the mouſe and the crocadile, euerie one according to their kinde,
label: Leviticus

text: the migale, and the camelean, and the ſtellion, and the lizard, and the moule:
label: Leviticus

text: al theſe are vncleane. He that toucheth their carcaſſes, shal be vncleane vntil euen:
label: Leviticus

text: and that wherupon anie thing of their carcaſſes falleth, shal be poluted aſwel veſſel of wood and rayment, as skinnes and haireclothes: and in whatſoeuer veſſel anie worke is done, they shal be dipped in water, and shal be polluted vntil euen, and ſo afterward shal be cleane.
label: Leviticus

text: But the earthen veſſel, wherinto anie of theſe falleth within it, shal be polluted, and therfore is to be broken.
label: Leviticus

text: Al meate, which you shal eate, if the water be poured vpon it, shal be vncleane; and al liquor that is dronke of al veſſel, shal be vncleane.
label: Leviticus

text: And vpon whatſoeuer ought of ſuch carcaſſes falleth, it shal be vncleane: whether ouens, or pottes with feete, they shal be diſtroyed, and shal be vncleane.
label: Leviticus

text: But the fountaines and the ceſternes, and al collection of waters shal be cleane. He that toucheth their carcaſſe, shal be polluted.
label: Leviticus

text: If it fal vpon ſeede corne it shal not pollute it.
label: Leviticus

text: But if any man poure water vpon the ſeede, and afterward it be touched with the carcaſſes, it shal be forthwith polluted.
label: Leviticus

text: If a beaſt be dead, of which it is lawful for you to eate, he that toucheth the carcaſſe therof, shal be vncleane vntil euen:
label: Leviticus

text: and he that eateth or carieth anie thing therof; shal wash his clothes, and shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: Al that creepeth vpon the earth, shal be abhominable, neither shal it be taken for meate.
label: Leviticus

text: Whatſoeuer goeth vpon the breſt on foure feete, and hath manie feete, or traileth on the earth, you shal not eate, becauſe it is abhominable.
label: Leviticus

text: Doe not contaminate your ſoules, nor touch ought therof, leſt you be vncleane.
label: Leviticus

text: For I am the Lord your God: be holie, becauſe I am holie. Pollute not your ſoules in anie creeping beaſt, that moueth vpon the earth.
label: Leviticus

text: For I am the Lord, that brought you out of the Land of Ægypt, that I might be your God. You shal be holie becauſe I am holie.
label: Leviticus

text: This is the lawe of beaſts and foules, and of euerie liuing ſoule, that moueth in the waters, and creepeth on the earth,
label: Leviticus

text: that you may know the differences of the cleane, and the vncleane, and know what you ought to eate, and what to refuſe.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: A woman, if receauing ſeede ſhe beare a man child, shal be vncleane ſeuen daies, according to the daies of the ſeparation of her floures.
label: Leviticus

text: And the eight day the litle infant shal be circumciſed:
label: Leviticus

text: but her ſelf shal remaine three & thirtie daies in the bloud of her purification: No holie thing shal she touch, neither shal she enter into the Sanctuarie, vntil the daies of her purification be expired.
label: Leviticus

text: But if she beare a woman child, she shal be vncleane two weekes, according to the cuſtome of the fluxe of her flowers, and ſixtie ſix daies she shal remaine in the bloud of her purification.
label: Leviticus

text: And when the daies of her purification are expired, for a ſonne, or for a daughter, she shal bring a lambe of a yeare old for an holocauſt, and a young pigeon or a turtle for ſinne, to the dore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and shal deliuer them to the prieſt,
label: Leviticus

text: who shal offer them before our Lord, and shal pray for her, and ſo she shal be cleanſed from the fluxe of her bloud. this is the lawe for her that beareth a man child or woman child.
label: Leviticus

text: And if her hand finde not, neither is able to offer a lambe, she shal take two turtles, or two young pigeons, one for an holocauſt, and an other for ſinne. and the prieſt shal pray for her, and ſo she shal be cleanſed.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, and Aaron, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: The man, in whoſe skinne and flesh shal ariſe a diuers colour or a bliſter, or any thing as it were shyning, that is to ſay the plague of the leproſie, shal be brought to Aaron the prieſt, or any one of his ſonnes.
label: Leviticus

text: Who ſeing the leproſie in his skinne, & the heare turned into a white colour, and the forme it ſelf of the leproſie lower then the skinne, and the other flesh: it is the plague of the leproſie, and at his arbitrement he shal be ſeperated.
label: Leviticus

text: But if there be a shining whiteneſſe in the skinne, and not lower then the other flesh, and the heare of the old colour, the prieſt shal shut him vp ſeuen daies,
label: Leviticus

text: and the ſeuenth day he shal vew him: and if the leproſie be growne no farder, nor hath paſſed the former limites in the skinne, againe he shal shut him vp other ſeuen daies.
label: Leviticus

text: And the ſeuenth day he shal behold: if the leproſie be ſomewhat obſcure, and not growne in the skinne, he shal cleanſe him, becauſe it is a ſcabbe: and the man shal wash his clothes, and shal be cleane.
label: Leviticus

text: And if the leproſie grow againe, after that he was ſene of the prieſt and reſtored to cleanneſſe; he shal he brought vnto him,
label: Leviticus

text: and shal be condemned of vncleanneſſe.
label: Leviticus

text: If the plague of the leproſie be in a man, he shal be brought to the prieſt,
label: Leviticus

text: and he shal view him. And when there is a white colour in the skinne, and hath changed the looke of the heare, and the flesh alſo it ſelfe appeare quicke:
label: Leviticus

text: it shal be iudged a verie old leproſie, and growne into the skinne. The prieſt therfore shal contaminate him, and shal not shut him vp, becauſe he is vncleane euidently.
label: Leviticus

text: But if the leproſie ſpring forth running about in the skinne, and couer al the flesh from the head to the feete, whatſoeuer falleth vnder the ſight of the eies,
label: Leviticus

text: the prieſt shal vew him, and shal iudge that he is taken with a moſt cleane leproſie: for that it is al turned into whitneſſe, and therfore the man shal be cleane.
label: Leviticus

text: But when there shal appeare in him quicke flesh,
label: Leviticus

text: then by the iudgement of the prieſt he shal be polluted, and shal be reputed among the vncleane. for quick flesh if it be ſpotted with leproſie, is vncleane.
label: Leviticus

text: And if againe it be turned into whiteneſſe, and couer al the man,
label: Leviticus

text: the prieſt shal vew him, and shal iudge him to be cleane.
label: Leviticus

text: And the flesh and the skinne wherin a boile is riſen, and healed,
label: Leviticus

text: and in the place of the boile, there appeare a white ſcarre, or ſomewhat redde, the man shal be brought to the prieſt:
label: Leviticus

text: and when he shal ſee the place of the leproſie lower then the other flesh, and the heare turned into whitenes, he shal contaminate him: for the plague of leproſie is riſen in the boile.
label: Leviticus

text: But if the heare be of the old colour, and the ſcarre ſomewhat obſcure, & be not lower then the next flesh, he shal shut him vp ſeuen dayes.
label: Leviticus

text: And if it be growne farder, he shal iudge him to haue the leproſie,
label: Leviticus

text: but if it ſtay in his place, it is the ſcarre of a boile, and the man shal be cleane.
label: Leviticus

text: And the flesh and skinne, that fire hath burnt, and being healed hath a white or a reade ſcarre,
label: Leviticus

text: the prieſt shal conſider it, and loe it is turned into whiteneſſe, and the place therof is lower then the other skinne: he shal contaminate him, becauſe the plague of leproſie is riſen in the ſcarre.
label: Leviticus

text: But if the colour of the heare be not changed, nor the blemish lower then the other flesh, and the forme it ſelf of the leproſie be ſomewhat obſcure, he shal shut him vp ſeuen dais,
label: Leviticus

text: and the ſeuente day he shal behold him: if the leproſie be growne farder in the skinne, he shal contaminate him,
label: Leviticus

text: but if the whitnes ſtay in his place, not very cleare, it is the plague of a burning, and therfore he shal be cleanſed, becauſe it is the ſcarre of a burning.
label: Leviticus

text: Man, or woman, in whoſe head or beard the leproſie riſeth, the prieſt shal ſee them.
label: Leviticus

text: and if the place be lower then the other flesh, and the heare yelow, and thinner then it was wont; he shal contaminate them, becauſe it is the leproſie of the heade and the beard.
label: Leviticus

text: But if he perceiue the place of the ſpotte equal with the flesh neere vnto it, and the heare blacke: he shal shut him vp ſeuen daies,
label: Leviticus

text: and in the ſeuenth day he shal looke vpon it. If the ſpotte be not growne, and the heare be of his owne colour, and the place of the plague euen with the other flesh:
label: Leviticus

text: the man shal be shauen ſauing the place of the ſpotte, and shal be shut vp orher ſeuen daies.
label: Leviticus

text: If the ſeuenth day the plague ſeeme to haue ſtaid in his place, & not lower then the other flesh, he shal cleanſe him, and his clothes being washed he shal be cleane.
label: Leviticus

text: But if after his clenſing the ſpotte be growne againe in the skinne,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal no more ſeeke whether the heare be changed into a yelow colour, becauſe he is euidently vncleane.
label: Leviticus

text: Moreouer if the ſpotte be ſtaid, & the heare be blacke, let him know that the man is healed, and let him boldly pronounce him cleane.
label: Leviticus

text: Man, or woman, in whoſe skinne appeareth whiteneſſe,
label: Leviticus

text: the prieſt shal vew them. If he find that whitneſſe ſomewhat obſcure shineth in the skinne, let him know that it is not the leproſie, but a ſpotte of white colour, and that the man is cleane.
label: Leviticus

text: The man whoſe heare falleth of from his head, is bald and cleane:
label: Leviticus

text: and if the heare fal from his forehead, he is bald before and cleane.
label: Leviticus

text: But if in the baldneſſe or in the baldneſſe before there be riſen a white or reddish colour,
label: Leviticus

text: and the prieſt perceiue this, he shal condemne him vndoubtedly of leproſie, which is riſen in the baldneſſe.
label: Leviticus

text: Whoſoeuer therfote shal be defiled with leproſie & is ſeparated at the arbitrement of the prieſt,
label: Leviticus

text: shal haue his clothes hanging looſe, his head bare, his mouth couered with a cloth, he shal crie him ſelf polluted and vncleane.
label: Leviticus

text: Al the time that he is a lepre & vncleane, he shal dwel alone without the campe.
label: Leviticus

text: A wollen or linnen garment, that shal haue the leproſie
label: Leviticus

text: in the warpe, and the woufe, or els a skinne, or whatſoeuer is made of a skinne,
label: Leviticus

text: if it be a white or reddish ſpott, it shal be reputed infected with leproſie, and shal be shewed to the prieſt.
label: Leviticus

text: Who hauing conſidered it shal shut it vp ſeuen daies:
label: Leviticus

text: and the ſeuenth day againe beholding it, if he find that it is growne, it is a leproſie that continueth: he shal iudge the garment polluted, and euerie thing wherin it shal be found,
label: Leviticus

text: and therfore it shal be burnt with fire.
label: Leviticus

text: But if he ſee that it is not growne,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal command, and they shal wash that, wherin the leproſie is, and he shal shut it vp other ſeuen daies.
label: Leviticus

text: And when he shal ſee that the old shape is not returned, neither yet that the leproſie is growen furder, he shal iudge it vncleane, and burne it with fire, for that the leproſie is ſpred in the outſide of the garment or through the whole.
label: Leviticus

text: But if the place of the leproſie be ſomewhat obſcure, after that the garment is washed, he shal breake it of, and diuide it from that which is founde.
label: Leviticus

text: And if beſides in thoſe places, that before were without ſpotte, there appeare a flying and wandring leproſie: it muſt be burnt with fire:
label: Leviticus

text: if it be ceaſed, he shal wash with water the partes, that be pure, the ſecond time, & they shal be cleane.
label: Leviticus

text: This is the law of the leproſie of a wollen and linnen garment, of the warpe and the woufe, and of al ſtuffe of skinnes, how it ought to be clenſed, or contaminated.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: This is the rite of a lepre, when he is to be cleanſed.
label: Leviticus

text: He shal be brought to the prieſt: who going out of the campe, when he shal finde that the leproſie is cleanſed,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal command him, that is purified, that he offer for him ſelfe two liue ſparowes, which it is lawful to eate, and cedar wood, and ſcarlet & hyſſope.
label: Leviticus

text: and he shal command that one of the ſparowes be immolated in an earthen veſſel ouer liuing water:
label: Leviticus

text: but the other being aliue with the cedar wood, and ſcarlet and the hyſſope he shal dippe in the bloud of the ſparow that is immolated,
label: Leviticus

text: wherwith he shal ſprinckle him, that is to be cleanſed, ſeuen times, that he may be rightly purged: and he shal let goe the liue ſparow, that it flie into the field.
label: Leviticus

text: And when the man hath washed his clothes, he shal shaue al the heare of his bodie, and shal be washed with water: and being purified he shal enter into the campe, yet ſo for al that, that he tarie without his owne tent ſeuen daies,
label: Leviticus

text: and the ſeuenth day he shal shaue the heare of his head, and his beard and eye browes, and the heare of his whole bodie. And hauing washed againe his clothes, and his bodie,
label: Leviticus

text: the eight day he ſhal take two lambes without ſpotte, and an ewe of a yeare old without ſpotte, and three tenths of floure tempered with oyle for a ſacrifice, and a ſextarie of oyle apart.
label: Leviticus

text: And when the prieſt that purifieth the man, hath ſet him, and al theſe things before the Lord in the dore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal take a lambe, and offer it for offence, & the ſextarie of oyle. and hauing offered al before the Lord,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal immolate the lambe, where the hoſte for ſinne is wont to be immolated, and the holocauſt, that is, in a holie place. For as for ſinne, ſo alſo the hoſte for offence pertaineth to the prieſt: it is Holie of holies.
label: Leviticus

text: And the prieſt taking of the bloud of the hoſte, that was immolated for offence, shal put it vpon the tippe of the right eare of him that is cleanſed, and vpon the thumbes of his right hand and foote:
label: Leviticus

text: and of the ſextarie of oile he shal poure into his owne left hand,
label: Leviticus

text: and shal dippe his right finger in it and shal ſprinckle before the Lord ſeuen times.
label: Leviticus

text: and the reſidue of the oile in his left hand, he shal poure vpon the tippe of the right eare of him that is cleanſed, and vpon the thumbes of his right hand and foote, and vpon the bloud that was ſhed for offence,
label: Leviticus

text: and vpon his head.
label: Leviticus

text: And he shal pray for him before the Lord, and shal make the ſacrifice for ſinne: then shal he immolate the holocauſt,
label: Leviticus

text: and put it on the altar with the libaments therof, and the man shal orderly be cleanſed.
label: Leviticus

text: But if he be poore, and his hand can not finde the thinges aforeſaid, for offence he shal take a lambe for an oblation, that the prieſt may pray for him, and a tenth part of floure tempered with oile for a ſacrifice, and of oile a ſextarie,
label: Leviticus

text: and two turtles or two young pigeons, of the which let one be for ſinne, and the other for an holocauſt:
label: Leviticus

text: and he shal offer them the eight day of his purification to the prieſt, at the dore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie before the Lord:
label: Leviticus

text: who receiuing the lambe for offence, and the ſextarie of oile, shal eleuate them together:
label: Leviticus

text: and the lambe being immolated, of the bloud therof he shal put vpon the tippe of the right eare of him that is cleanſed, and vpon the thumbes of his right hand and foote:
label: Leviticus

text: but part of the oile he shal poure into his owne left hand,
label: Leviticus

text: wherin dipping the finger of his right hand, he shal ſprinckle it ſeuen times before the Lord:
label: Leviticus

text: and he shal touch the tippe of the right eare of him that is cleanſed, and the thumbes of his right hand & foote, in the place of the bloud that was shed for offence:
label: Leviticus

text: and the other part of the oyle, that is in his left hand, he shal poure vpon the head of the purified perſon, that he may propitiate the Lord for him:
label: Leviticus

text: and a turtle, or yong pigeon he shal offer,
label: Leviticus

text: one for offence, and the other for an holocauſt, with their libaments.
label: Leviticus

text: This is the ſacrifice of a lepre, that is not able to haue al thinges for the cleanſing of him ſelf.
label: Leviticus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes and Aaron, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: When you shal be entred into the Land of Chanaan, which I wil geue you in poſſeſſion, if there be the plague of leproſie in a houſe,
label: Leviticus

text: he whoſe houſe it is, shal goe & tel the prieſt, ſaying: It ſemeth to me, that there is as it were the plague of leproſie in my houſe.
label: Leviticus

text: But he shal command, that they carie forth al thinges out of the houſe, before he goe into it, and ſee whether it haue the leproſie, leſt al thinges become vncleane that are in the houſe. And afterward he shal goe in to conſider the leproſie of the houſe:
label: Leviticus

text: & if he ſee in the walles therof as it were litle dintes, disfigured with paleneſſe or redneſſe, and lower then al the reſt,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal goe out of the dore of the houſe, and forthwith shut it ſeuen daies.
label: Leviticus

text: And returning the ſeuenth day, he shal conſider it. If he finde that the leproſie is growne,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal command, the ſtones wherein the leproſie is, to be plucked out, and to be throwen without the citie into an vncleane place:
label: Leviticus

text: & the houſe it ſelf to be ſcraped on the inſide round about, and the duſt of the ſcraping to be diſperſed without the citie into an vncleane place,
label: Leviticus

text: and other ſtones to be laid in their places, that were taken away, and the houſe to be playſtered with other morter.
label: Leviticus

text: But if after the ſtones be plucked out, & the duſt ſcraped of, and it playſtered with other earth,
label: Leviticus

text: the prieſt going in perceiue that the leproſie is returned, and the walles ful of ſpottes, it is a laſting leproſie, and the houſe vncleane:
label: Leviticus

text: the which forthwith they shal deſtroy, and the ſtones and timber therof, and al the duſt they shal caſt without the towne into an vncleane place.
label: Leviticus

text: He that entreth into the houſe when it is shut, shal be vncleane vntil euen:
label: Leviticus

text: and he that ſleepeth in it, and eateth any thing, shal wash his clothes.
label: Leviticus

text: But if the prieſt going in perceiue that the leproſie is not growne farder in the houſe, after it was playſtred againe, he shal purifie it being made whole againe:
label: Leviticus

text: and for the purification therof he shal take two ſparowes, and cedrewood, and ſcarlet and hyſſope:
label: Leviticus

text: and when one ſparow is immolated in an earthen veſſel ouer liuing waters,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal take the ceder wood, and the hyſſope, and the ſcarlet, and the liue ſparowe, and shal dippe al in the bloud of the ſparowe that is immolated, and in the liuing water, and he shal ſprinckle the houſe ſeuen times,
label: Leviticus

text: and shal purifie it as wel with the bloud of the ſparow, as with the liuing water and with the liue ſparow, and with the cedrewoode and the hyſſope and the ſcarlet.
label: Leviticus

text: And when he hath let goe the ſparow to flie freely away into the field, he shal pray for the houſe, and it shal be rightly cleanſed.
label: Leviticus

text: This is the law of al leproſie and percuſſion,
label: Leviticus

text: of the leproſie of garments and houſes,
label: Leviticus

text: of a ſcarre and of bliſters breaking forth, of a shining ſpotte, and when the colours are changed into diuers kindes,
label: Leviticus

text: that it may be knowen at what time anie thing is cleane, or vncleane.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes and Aaron, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and ſay to them; The man that hath a fluxe of ſede, shal be vncleane.
label: Leviticus

text: And then he shal be iudged ſubiect to this fault, when the filthie humour at euerie moment, cleaueth to his flesh, and is congealed.
label: Leviticus

text: Euerie bedde wheron he ſleepeth, shal be vncleane, and where ſoeuer he ſitteth.
label: Leviticus

text: If anie man touch his bedde, he shal wash his clothes: and him ſelf being washed with water, shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: If he ſitte where that man had ſitten, he alſo shal wash his clothes: and being washed with water, shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: he that toucheth his flesh, shal wash his clothes: and him ſelf being washed with water shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: If ſuch a man caſt his ſpittle vpon him that is cleane, he shal wash his clothes: and being washed with water he shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: The padde wherupon he ſitteth shal be vncleane:
label: Leviticus

text: and whatſoeuer hath bene vnder him, that hath the fluxe of ſeede, shal be polluted vntil euen. He that carieth any of theſe thinges, shal wash his clothes: and him ſelf being washed with water, shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: Euerie one, whom he toucheth that is ſuch an one, hauing not washed his handes before, shal wash his clothes, and being washed with water, shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: The earthen veſſel that he toucheth shal be broken: but the wodden veſſel shal be washed with water.
label: Leviticus

text: If he be healed that hath ſuch a diſeaſe, he shal number ſeuen daies after his cleanſing, and hauing washed his clothes, and al his bodie, in liuing water, he shal be cleane.
label: Leviticus

text: And the eight day he shal take two turtles, or two yong pigeons, and he shal come into the ſight of our Lord, to the dore fo the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and shal geue them to the prieſt.
label: Leviticus

text: who shal make one for ſinne, and the other for an holocauſt, and he shal pray for him before our Lord, that he may be cleanſed of the fluxe of his ſeede.
label: Leviticus

text: The man from whom iſſueth the ſeede of copulation, shal wash with water al his bodie: and he shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: The garment and skinne, that he weareth, he shal wash with water, and it shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: The woman with whom he compaineth shal be washed with water and shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: The woman that monthly hath the fluxe of bloud, shal be ſeparated ſeuen daies.
label: Leviticus

text: Euerie one that toucheth her, shal be vncleane vntil euen:
label: Leviticus

text: and that whereon she ſleepeth or ſitteh in the daies of her ſeparation shal be polluted.
label: Leviticus

text: He that toucheth her bedde shal wash his clothes: and him ſelf being washed with water, shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: Whoſoeuer shal touch any veſſel wherupon she ſitteth, he shal wash his clothes: and him ſelf being washed with water shal be polluted vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: If a man companie with her in the time of her menſtrual bloud, he shal be vncleane ſeuen daies: and euerie bedde wheron he ſleepeth shal be polluted.
label: Leviticus

text: The woman that hath a fluxe of bloud many daies not in her menſtrual time, or that ceaſeth not to haue a fluxe, after the menſtrual bloud, as long as she is ſubiect to this diſeaſe, she shal be vncleane, as if she were in her menſtrual time.
label: Leviticus

text: Euerie bedde, whereupon she ſleepeth, and veſſel wheron she ſitteth, shal be polluted.
label: Leviticus

text: Whoſoeuer toucheth them shal wash his clothes: and him ſelf being washed with water, shal be vncleane, vntil euen.
label: Leviticus

text: If the bloud ſtay and ceaſe to runne, she shal count the ſeuen daies of her purification:
label: Leviticus

text: and the eight day she shal offer for her ſelfe to the prieſt, two turtles, or two young pigeons, at the dore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie:
label: Leviticus

text: who shal make one for ſinne, and the other for an holocauſt, and he shal pray for her before our Lord, and for the fluxe of her vncleanneſſe.
label: Leviticus

text: You shal teach therfore the children of Iſrael, that they take heede of vncleanneſſe, and die not in their filthineſſe, when they shal pollute my tabernacle that is among them.
label: Leviticus

text: This is the law of him that hath the fluxe of ſede and that is polluted by copulation,
label: Leviticus

text: and the woman that is ſeparated in her menſtrual times, or that hath a continual fluxe of bloud, and of the man, that ſleepeth with her.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, after the death of the two ſonnes of Aaron, when they were ſlaine offering ſtrange fire:
label: Leviticus

text: and he commanded him, ſaying: Speake to Aaron thy brother, that he enter not at al times into the Sanctuarie, that is within the veile before the propitiatorie, wherwith the arke is couered, leſt he die (for in a cloude wil I appeare ouer the oracle)
label: Leviticus

text: vnleſſe he doe theſe thinges before: He shal offer a calfe for ſinne, and a ramme for an holocauſt.
label: Leviticus

text: He shal be reueſted with a linnen tunike, he shal hide his priuities with linnen femoralles: he shal be girded with a linnen girdle, a linnen mitre shal he put vpon his head: for theſe are holie veſtmentes: withal which, when he is washed, he shal be reueſted.
label: Leviticus

text: And he shal receiue of the whole multitude of the children of Iſrael two bucke goates for ſinne, and one ramme for an holocauſt.
label: Leviticus

text: And when he hath offered the calfe, and praied for him ſelf, and for his owne houſe,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal make the two bucke goates to ſtand before the Lord in the dore of the tabernacle of teſtimoſtimonie:
label: Leviticus

text: and caſting lottes vpon both, one for the Lord, & an other for the goate of dimiſſion:
label: Leviticus

text: that, whoſe lotte fel to the Lord, he shal offer for ſinne:
label: Leviticus

text: but that, whoſe lotte was to be the goate of dimiſſion, he shal ſet aliue before the Lord, that he may poure out prayers vpon him, and diſmiſſe him into the wilderneſſe.
label: Leviticus

text: After that theſe thinges be duly celebtated, he shal offer the calfe, and praying for him ſelf and for his houſe, he shal immolate it:
label: Leviticus

text: and taking the thurible, which he hath filled of the burning coales of the altar, and taking vp with his hand of the compounded perſume for incenſe, he shal goe in beyond the veile into the Holie place:
label: Leviticus

text: that when the incenſe is put vpon the fire, the cloude therof and the vapour may couer the oracle, which is ouer the teſtimonie, and he die not.
label: Leviticus

text: He shal take alſo of the bloud of the calfe, and ſprinckle with his finger ſeuen times againſt the propitiatorie to the eaſt.
label: Leviticus

text: And when he hath killed the bucke goate for the ſinne of the people, he shal carie in the bloud therof within the veile, as hath bene commanded of the bloud of the calfe, that he may ſprinckle it againſt the oracle,
label: Leviticus

text: and expiate the Sanctuarie from the vncleanneſſe of the children of Iſrael, and from their preuarications, and al their ſinnes. According to this rite shal he doe to the tabernacle of teſtimonie, which is fixed among them in the middeſt of the filth of their habitation.
label: Leviticus

text: Let no man be in the tabernacle when the high prieſt goeth into the Sanctuarie, to pray for him ſelf and for his houſe, & for the whole aſſemblie of Iſrael, vntil he come forth.
label: Leviticus

text: And when he is come forth to the altar that is before the Lord, let him pray for him ſelf, and taking the bloud of the calfe, and of the bucke goate, let him poure it vpon the hornes therof round about;
label: Leviticus

text: and ſprinckling with his finger ſeuen times, let him expiate, and ſanctifie it from the vncleanneſſe of the children of Iſrael.
label: Leviticus

text: After he hath clenſed the Sanctuarie, and the tabernacle, and the altar, then let him offer the liue goate;
label: Leviticus

text: and putting both handes vpon his head, let him confeſſe al the iniquities of the children of Iſrael, and al their offences and ſinnes: which praying to light on his head, he shal ſend him forth by a man ready therto, into the deſert.
label: Leviticus

text: And when the goat hath caried al their iniquities into the ſolitarie ground, and shal be let goe into the deſert,
label: Leviticus

text: Aaron shal returne into the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and putting of the veſtiments, which he had on him before when he entred into the Sanctuarie, and leauing them there,
label: Leviticus

text: he shal wash his flesh in a holie place, and shal be clothed with his owne garments. And after that he hath gone forth and offered his owne holocauſt, and the peoples, he shal pray as wel for him ſelf, as for the people:
label: Leviticus

text: and the fatte, that is offered for ſinnes, he shal burne vpon the altar.
label: Leviticus

text: but he, that hath let goe the goate of dimiſſion, shal wash his clothes, and bodie with water, and ſo shal enter into the campe.
label: Leviticus

text: But the calfe & the bucke goate, that were immolated for ſinne, and whoſe bloud was caried into the Sanctuarie, to accomplish the expiation, they shal carie forth without the campe, and shal burne with fire aſwel the skinnes as their flesh, and the dung:
label: Leviticus

text: and whoſoeuer burneth them, shal wash his clothes, and his flesh with water, and ſo shal enter into the campe.
label: Leviticus

text: And this shal be to you an euerlaſting ordinance: The ſeuenth moneth, the tenth day of the moneth you shal afflict your ſoules, and no worke shal you doe, whether he be of the ſame countrie, or a ſtranger that ſoiourneth among you.
label: Leviticus

text: Vpon this day shal be the expiation of you, and clenſing from al your ſinnes: before the Lord you shal be clenſen.
label: Leviticus

text: for it is a ſabath of reſt, and you shal afflict your ſoules by a perpetual religion.
label: Leviticus

text: And the prieſt shal expiate, that is annoynted, and whoſe handes are conſecrated to do the function of prieſthood for his father: and he shal be reueſted with the linnen ſtole and the holie veſtments,
label: Leviticus

text: and he shal expiate the Sanctuarie and the tabernecle of teſtimonie and the altar, the prieſtes alſo and al the people.
label: Leviticus

text: And this shal be an ordinance for euer, that you pray for the children of Iſrael, and for al their ſinnes once in a yeare. He did therfore as our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to Aaron and his ſonnes, and to al the children of Iſrael, ſaying to them: This is the word, which our Lord hath commanded, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Anie man whoſoeuer of the houſe of Iſrael, if he kil an oxe or a sheepe, or a goate in the campe or without the campe,
label: Leviticus

text: and offer it not at the dore of the tabernacle an oblation to the Lord, shal be guiltie of bloud: as if he had shed bloud, ſo shal he perish out of the middes of his people.
label: Leviticus

text: Therfore shal the children of Iſrael bring to the prieſt their hoſtes, which they kil in the filde, that they may be ſanctified to our Lord before the dore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie, & they may immolate them pacifique hoſtes to our Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: And the prieſt shal poure the bloud vpon the altar of our Lord, at the dore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and shal burne the fatte for a ſwete odour to our Lord:
label: Leviticus

text: and they shal no more immolate their hoſtes to diuels, with whom they haue committed fornication. It shal be an ordinance for euer to them and to their poſteritie.
label: Leviticus

text: And to them thou shalt ſay: The man of the houſe of Iſrael, and of the ſtrangers, which ſeiourne with you, that offereth an holocauſt or victime,
label: Leviticus

text: and bringeth it not to the dore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie, that it may be offered to our Lord, shal perish out of his people.
label: Leviticus

text: Anie man whoſoeuer of the houſe of Iſrael, and of the ſtrangers, that ſeiourne among them, if he eate bloud, I wil ſette my face againſt his life, and wil deſtroy it out of his people,
label: Leviticus

text: becauſe the life of the flesh is in the bloud: and I haue geuen it to you, that vpon the altar you may make expiation with it for your ſoules, and the bloud may be fot an expiation of the ſoule.
label: Leviticus

text: Therfore haue I ſaid to the children of Iſrael: No ſoule of you shal eate bloud, nor of the ſtrangers, that ſeiourne with you.
label: Leviticus

text: Anie man whoſoeuer of the children of Iſrael, and of the ſtrangers that ſeiourne with you, if by hunting or fowling, he take wild beaſt or foule, which it is lawful to eate, let him poure out the bloud therof, and couer it with earth.
label: Leviticus

text: For the life of al flesh is in the bloud: wherupon I ſaid to the children of Iſrael: The bloud of no flesh shal you eate, becauſe the life of the flesh is in the bloud: and whoſoeuer eateth it, ſhal die.
label: Leviticus

text: The ſoule that eateth carraine, or that which is taken of a beaſt, aſwel of them of the ſame countrie as of ſtrangers, shal wash his clothes, and him ſelf with water, and shal be contaminated vntil euen: and in this order he ſhal be made cleane.
label: Leviticus

text: And if he doe not wash his clothes, and his bodie, he shal beare his iniquitie.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: I the Lord your God,
label: Leviticus

text: According to the cuſtome of the Land of Ægypt, wherin you haue dwelt, you shal not doe: and according to the maner of the Countrie of Chanaan, into the which I wil bring you, you shal not doe, nor walke in their ordinances.
label: Leviticus

text: You shal doe my iudgements, and shal obſerue my precepts, and shal walke in them. I the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: Keepe my lawes and iudgmentes, which a man doing, shal liue in them. I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: No man shal approch to her that is next of his bloud, to reueale her turpitude. I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: The turpitude of thy father, and the turpitude of thy mother thou shalt not diſcouer: she is thy mother thou shalt not reueale her turpitude.
label: Leviticus

text: The turpitude of thy fathers wife thou shalt not diſcouer: for it is the turpitude of thy father.
label: Leviticus

text: The turpitude of thy ſiſter by father, or by mother, which was borne at home or abroad, thou shalt not reueale.
label: Leviticus

text: The turpitude of thy ſonnes daughter or of thy neece by thy daughter, thou shalt not reueale: becauſe it is thy turpitude.
label: Leviticus

text: The turpitude of thy fathers wiues daughter, which she bare to thy father, and is thy ſiſter, thou shal not reueale.
label: Leviticus

text: The turpitude of thy fathers ſiſter thou shalt not diſcouer: becauſe she is the flesh of thy father.
label: Leviticus

text: The turpitude of thy mothers ſiſter thou shalt not reueale, becauſe she is of the flesh of thy mother.
label: Leviticus

text: The turpitude of thy fathers brother thou shalt not reueale, neither shalt thou approch to his wife, who is ioyned to thee by affinitie.
label: Leviticus

text: The turpitude of thy daughter in law thou shalt not reueale, becauſe she is thy ſonnes wife, neither shalt thou diſcouer her ignominie.
label: Leviticus

text: The turpitude of thy brothers wife thou shalt not reueale: becauſe it is the turpitude of thy brother.
label: Leviticus

text: The turpitude of thy wife, and her daughter thou shalt not reueale. Her ſonnes daughter, and her daughters daughter, thou shalt not take, to reueale her ignominie: becauſe they are her flesh, and ſuch copulation is inceſt.
label: Leviticus

text: Thou shalt not take thy wiues ſiſter for an harlote, to vexe her withal, neither shalt thou reueale her turpitude, whiles she is yet liuing.
label: Leviticus

text: To a woman, hauing her flowers, thou shalt not approch, neither shalt thou reueale her turpitude.
label: Leviticus

text: With thy neighbours wife thou shalt not companie, nor be polluted with commixtion of ſeede.
label: Leviticus

text: Of thy ſeede thou shalt not geue to be conſecrated to the idol Moloch, nor pollute the name of thy God: I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Companie not with mankind, as with womankind, becauſe it is abomination.
label: Leviticus

text: With no beaſt shalt thou companie, neither shalt thou be polluted with it. A woman shal not lie downe to a beaſt, nor companie with it: becauſe it is an hainous fact.
label: Leviticus

text: Neither be ye polluted in anie of the thinges wherwith al the nations haue bene contaminated, which I wil caſt out before your ſight,
label: Leviticus

text: and wherwith the land is polluted: whoſe abominations I wil viſite, that it vomite out the inhabitants therof.
label: Leviticus

text: Keepe my ordinances and iudgements, and doe not any of theſe abominations, as wel the ſame countrieman as the ſtranger, that ſeiourneth with you.
label: Leviticus

text: For al theſe execrable thinges did the inhabitants of the land, that haue bene before you, and haue polluted it.
label: Leviticus

text: Beware therfore leſt in like maner it vomite out you alſo, when you shal doe the like thinges, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
label: Leviticus

text: Euerie ſoule, that shal doe anie of theſe abominations, shal perish from the middes of his people.
label: Leviticus

text: Keepe my commandements. Doe not the thinges which they haue done, that haue bene before you, and be not polluted in them: I the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: OVR Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to al the aſſemblie of the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: Be ye holie, becauſe I the Lord your God am holie.
label: Leviticus

text: Let euerie one feare his father, and mother. Keepe my Sabbathes. I the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: Turne not your ſelues to idols, neither make you to your ſelues molten goddes. I the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: If ye immolate an hoſte of pacifiques to the Lord, that it may be placable,
label: Leviticus

text: that day wherin it is immolated, shal you eate it, and the next day: and whatſoeuer shal be left vntil the third day, you shal burne with fire.
label: Leviticus

text: if after two daies anie man eate therof, he shal be profane, and guiltie of impietie:
label: Leviticus

text: and shal beare his iniquitie, becauſe he hath polluted the holie of the Lord, and that ſoule shal perish out of his people.
label: Leviticus

text: And when thou reapeſt the corne of thy lande, thou shalt not sheare the face of the earth to the verie ground: neither shalt thou gather the eares that remaine.
label: Leviticus

text: Neither in thy vineyard shalt thou gather the cluſters, and grapes that fal downe, but shalt leaue them to the poore, and the ſtrangers to take. I the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: You shal not committe theft. You shal not lie, neither shal anie man deceaue his neighbour.
label: Leviticus

text: Thou shalt not forſweare thy ſelf in my name, nor pollute the name of thy God. I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Thou shalt not calumniate thy neighbour, nor oppreſſe him by violence. The worke of thy hireling shal not abide with thee vntil morning.
label: Leviticus

text: Thou shalt not ſpeake euil of the deafe man, nor put a ſtumbling blocke before the blinde: but thou shalt feare the Lord thy God, becauſe I am the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Thou shalt not doe that which is vniuſt, nor iudge vniuſtly. Conſider not the perſon of a poore man, neither honour thou the countenance of him that is mightie. Iudge iuſtly to thy neighbour.
label: Leviticus

text: Thou shalt not be a criminatour, nor a whiſperer among the people. Thou shalt not ſtand againſt the bloud of thy neighbour. I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy hart, but controwle him openly, leſt thou incurre ſinne through him.
label: Leviticus

text: Seeke not reuenge, nor be mindeful of the iniurie of thy citizens. Thou shalt loue thy freind as thy ſelf. I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Keepe ye my lawes. Thou shalt not make thy cattel to gender with the beaſts of an other kinde. Thy field thou shalt not ſowe with diuers ſeede. A garment, that is wouen of two ſortes, thou shalt not put on.
label: Leviticus

text: If a man lie with a woman by carnal copulation, that is a bondwoman alſo mariable, and yet not redemed with a price, nor made free, both shal be beaten, and they shal not die, becauſe she was not free.
label: Leviticus

text: And for his offence he shal offer to the Lord, at the dore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie a ramme:
label: Leviticus

text: and the prieſt shal pray for him, and for his ſinne before the Lord, and he shal become propitious to him againe, and the ſinne shal be forgeuen.
label: Leviticus

text: When you shal be entred into the land, and haue planted in it fruite trees, you shal take away the prepuces of them: the fruite, that come forth shal be vncleane to you, neither shal you eate of them.
label: Leviticus

text: But in the fourth yeare, al their fruite shal be ſanctified, laudable to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: And the fifth yeare you shal eate the fruites, gathering the offſpring, that they bring forth. I the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: You shal not eate with bloud. You shal not diuine, nor obſerue dreames.
label: Leviticus

text: Neither shal you cut your heare roundwiſe: nor shaue your beard.
label: Leviticus

text: And for the dead you shal not cut your flesh, neither shal you make in your ſelues any figures or markes, I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Make not thy daughter a common ſtrumpet, leſt the land be contamined, and filled with wickedneſſe.
label: Leviticus

text: Keepe ye my Sabbathes, and feare my Sanctuarie. I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Decline not to magicians, neither aske any thing of ſoothſayers, to be polluted by them. I the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: Before the hoare head riſe vp, and honour the perſon of an old man: and feare the Lord thy God. I am the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: If a ſtranger dwel in your land, and abide among you, doe not vpbraid him:
label: Leviticus

text: but let him be among you as the ſame countrie man: and you shal loue him as your ſelues: for you alſo haue bene ſtrangers in the Land of Ægypt. I the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: Do not anie vniuſt thing in iudgement, in rule, in weight, or meaſure.
label: Leviticus

text: Let the balance be iuſt, and the weightes equal, the bushel iuſt, and the ſextarie equal. I the Lord your God, that brought you out of the Land of Ægypt.
label: Leviticus

text: Keepe al my preceptes, and al my iudgements, & doe them. I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Theſe thinges thou shalt ſpeake to the children of Iſrael: If anie man of the children of Iſrael, and of the ſtrangers, that dwel in Iſrael, geue of his ſeede to the idol Moloch, dying let him die: the people of the land shal ſtone him.
label: Leviticus

text: And I wil ſet my face againſt him: and wil cut him of from the middes of his people, becauſe he hath geuen of his ſeede to Moloch, and hath contaminated my Sanctuarie, and polluted my holy name.
label: Leviticus

text: And if the people of the land neglecting, and as it were litle eſteming my commandement, let alone the man that hath geuen of his ſeede to Moloch, and wil not kil him:
label: Leviticus

text: I wil ſette my face vpon that man, and his kinred, and wil cut of both him, and al that conſented with him, to commit fornication with Moloch, out of the middes of their people.
label: Leviticus

text: The ſoule, that shal decline to Magitians, and ſouth ſayers, and shal committe fornication with them, I wil ſette my face againſt it, and deſtroy it out of the middes of his people.
label: Leviticus

text: Sanctifie your ſelues, and be holie, becauſe I am the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: Keepe my precepts, and doe them. I the Lord that ſanctifie you.
label: Leviticus

text: He that curſeth his father, or mother, dying let him die: he hath curſed father, and mother, his bloud be vpon him.
label: Leviticus

text: If any man commit adulterie with an other mans wife, and commit aduontrie with his neighbours wife, dying let them die, both the adulterer and the aduoutreſſe.
label: Leviticus

text: He that lieth with his ſtepmother, and reuealeth the ignominie of his father, dying let both die: their bloud be vpon them.
label: Leviticus

text: If anie man lie with his daughter in law, let both die, becauſe they haue done an heinous fact: their bloud be vpon them.
label: Leviticus

text: He that lieth with man as if he should companie with woman, both haue committed abomination dying let them die: their bloud be vpon them.
label: Leviticus

text: He that beſides his wife the daughter, marieth her mother, hath done wickednes: he shal burne aliue with them, neither shal there ſo great abomination remaine in the middes of you.
label: Leviticus

text: He that shal companie with beaſt and cattel, dying let him die: the beaſt alſo doe ye kil.
label: Leviticus

text: The woman that shal lie vnder anie beaſt, shal be killed together with the ſame: their bloud be vpon them.
label: Leviticus

text: He that taketh his ſiſter the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother, and ſeeth her turpitude, and she beholdeth her brothers ignominie: they haue committed a ſhameful thing: they shal be ſlaine; in the ſight of their people, becauſe they haue reuealed one an others turpitude, and they shal beare their iniquitie.
label: Leviticus

text: He that compaineth with a woman in her menſtrual fluxe, and reuealeth her turpitude, and she openeth the fountaine of her bloud, both shal be deſtroyed out of the middes of their people.
label: Leviticus

text: The turpitude of thy aunt by thy mother, and of thy aunt by thy father, thou shalt not diſcouer: he that doeth this, hath diſcloſed the ignominie of his flesh, both shal beare their iniquitie.
label: Leviticus

text: He that compaineth with the wife of his vncle by the father, or of his vncle by the mother, and reuealeth the ignominie of his kinred, both shal beare their ſinne: without children they shal die.
label: Leviticus

text: He that marieth his brothers wife, doth an vnlawful thing, he hath reuealed his brothers turpitude: they shal be without children.
label: Leviticus

text: Keepe my lawes, and iudgementes, and doe them: leſt the land which you shal enter into and inhabite, vomite out you alſo.
label: Leviticus

text: Walke not in the ordinances of the nations, which I wil expel before you. For al theſe thinges haue they done, and I haue abhorred them.
label: Leviticus

text: But to you I ſpeake: Poſſeſſe their land, which I wil geue you for an inheritance, a land flowing with milke and honie. I the Lord your God, that haue ſeperated you from other peoples.
label: Leviticus

text: Therfore doe you alſo ſeperate the cleane beaſt, from the vncleane, and the cleane foule from the vncleane: pollute not your ſoules, in beaſtes, and birdes, and al thinges that moue on the earth, and which I haue shewed vnto you, to be polluted.
label: Leviticus

text: You shal be holie vnto me, becauſe I the Lord am holie, and I haue ſeparated you from other peoples, that you should be mine.
label: Leviticus

text: Man, or woman, in whom is a pithonical or diuining ſpirite, dying let them die, they shal ſtone them: their bloud be vpon them.
label: Leviticus

text: OVR Lord ſaid alſo to Moyſes: Speake to the prieſtes the ſonnes of Aaron, and thou shalt ſay to them: Let not a prieſt be contaminated in the deathes of his citizens,
label: Leviticus

text: but onlie in his kinne, and nigh of bloud, that is to ſay, vpon his father and mother, and ſonne, and daughter, brother alſo,
label: Leviticus

label: Leviticus

label: Leviticus

label: Leviticus

text: Moyſes therfore ſpake to Aaron, and to his ſonnes and to al Iſrael, al thinges that had bene commanded him.
label: Leviticus

text: OVR Lord alſo ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to Aaron and to his ſonnes, that they beware of thoſe that are the conſecrated thinges of the children of Iſrael, and contaninate not the name of the thinges ſanctified to me, which they offer. I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Say to them, and to their poſteritie: Euerie man of your ſtocke, that approcheth to thoſe thinges that are conſecrated, and which the children of Iſrael haue offered to the Lord, in whom there is vncleaneſſe, shal perish before the Lord. I am the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: The man of the ſeede of Aaron, that is a leper, or hath a fluxe of ſeede, shal not eate of thoſe thinges that are ſanctified to me vntil he be healed. He that toucheth a thing vncleane by occaſion of that is dead, and he from whom iſſueth ſeede as it were of copulation,

text: Carrien and that which was taken of a beaſt, they shal not eate, nor be polluted in them. I am the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Let them keepe my preceptes, that they be not ſubiect to ſinne, and die in the Sanctuarie, when they shal haue polluted it. I the Lord that ſanctifie them.
label: Leviticus

text: No ſtranger shal eate of the ſanctified thinges, the prieſtes gueſt, and hireling shal not eate of them.

label: Leviticus

text: He that eateth of the ſanctified thinges by ignorance, shal adde the fifth part with that which he did eate, and shal geue it to the prieſt into the Sanctuarie.
