text: leſt perhappes they ſuſtaine the iniquitie of their offence, when they shal haue eaten the ſanctified thinges. I the Lord that ſanctifie them.
label: Leviticus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to Aaron, and to his ſonnes, and to al the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: The man of the houſe of Iſrael, and of the ſtrangers which dwel with you, that offereth his oblation, either paying his vowes, or offering of his owne accord, whatſoeuer that be which he preſenteth for an holocauſt of the Lord,
label: Leviticus

text: to be offered by you, it shal be a male without ſpotte of beefes, and muttons, & of goates.
label: Leviticus

text: If it haue a blemish, you shal not offer it, neither shal it be acceptable.
label: Leviticus

text: The man that offereth a victime of pacifiques to the Lord, either paying his vowes, or offering of his owne accorde, aſwel of beefes as of muttons, shal offer it without blemish that it may be acceptable: there shal be no blemish in it.
label: Leviticus

text: If it be blind, if it be broken, if it haue a ſcarre, if bliſters, or a ſcabbe, or a drie ſcurfe: you shal not offer them to the Lord, nor burne of them vpon the Lordes altar.
label: Leviticus

text: An oxe and a sheepe, hauing the eare and the taile cut of, thou maieſt offer voluntarily, but a vow can not be paid of them.
label: Leviticus

text: No beaſt that hath the ſtones bruiſed, or crushed, or cut and taken away, shal you offer to the Lord, and in your land make not this at al.
label: Leviticus

text: Of the hand of a ſtranger you shal not offer breades to your God, and what other thing ſoeuer he would geue: becauſe they are al corrupted, and blemished: you shal not receiue them.
label: Leviticus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: An oxe, a sheepe, and a goate, when they are brought forth, shal be ſeuen daies vnder the vdder of their damme: but the eight day, and ſo forward they may be offered to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Whether it be a beefe, or a sheepe, they shal not be immolated in one day with their young ones.
label: Leviticus

text: If you immolate an hoſte for thankes giuing to the Lord, that he may be placable,
label: Leviticus

text: the ſame day you shal eate it, there shal not ought remaine vntil the morning of the next day. I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Keepe my commandementes, and doe them. I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Pollute not my holie name, that I may be ſanctified in the middes of the children of Iſrael. I the Lord that ſanctifie you,
label: Leviticus

text: and brought you out of the Land of Ægypt, that I might be your God. I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: Theſe are the feſtiuities of our Lord, which you shal cal holie.
label: Leviticus

text: Six daies ye shal doe worke: the ſeuenth day, becauſe it is the reſt of the ſabbath, shal be called holie. No worke shal you doe in it: it is the Sabbath of the Lord in al your habitations.
label: Leviticus

text: Theſe therfore are the holie feſtiuities of the Lord, which you muſt celebrate in their times.
label: Leviticus

text: The firſt moneth, the fourteenth day of the moneth at euen, is the Phaſe of the Lord:
label: Leviticus

text: and the fifteenth day of this moneth is the ſolemnitie of the Azymes of the Lord. Seuen daies shal you eate azymes.
label: Leviticus

text: The firſt day shal be moſt ſolemne vnto you, and holie: no ſeruile worke shal you doe in it:
label: Leviticus

text: but you shal offer ſacrifice in fire to the Lord ſeuen daies. but the ſeuenth day shal be more ſolemne, and more holie: and you shal doe no ſeruile worke in it.
label: Leviticus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them. When you shal be entred into the land, which I wil geue you, and shal reape your corne, you shal bring sheaues of eares, the firſt fruites of your harueſt to the prieſt:
label: Leviticus

text: who shal eleuate the bundle before the Lord, the next day after the Sabbath, that it may be acceptable for you, and shal ſanctifie it.
label: Leviticus

text: And in the ſelf ſame day that the sheafe is conſecrated, shal be killed a lambe without ſpotte of a yeare old for an holocauſt of the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: And the libaments shal be offered with it, two tenthes of floure tempered with oile, for a burnt ſacrifice of the Lord, and a moſt ſweete odour: libaments alſo of wine, the fourth part of an hin.
label: Leviticus

text: Bread, and fried barlie, and frumentie, you shal not eate of the corne, vntil the day that you offer therof to your God. It is a precept for euer in your generations, and al your habitations.
label: Leviticus

text: You shal number therfore from the morow after the Sabbath, wherin you did offer the sheafe of the firſt fruites, ſeuen ful weekes,
label: Leviticus

text: vnto the morow after the ſeuenth weeke be expired, that is to ſay fiftie daies, and ſo you shal offer a new ſacrifice to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: out of al your habitations, two loaues of firſt fruites, of two tenthes of floure leauened, the which you shal bake for the firſt fruites of the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: And you shal offer with the breades ſeuen lambes without ſpotte of a yeare old, and one calfe from the heard, and two rammes, and they shal be for an holocauſt with their libamentes, for a moſt ſweete odour to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: You shal make a bucke goate alſo for ſinne, and two lambes of a yeare old for hoſtes of pacifiques.
label: Leviticus

text: And when the prieſt hath eleuated them with the breades of the firſt fruites before the Lord, they shal turne to his vſe.
label: Leviticus

text: And you shal cal this day moſt ſolemne, and moſt holie: no ſeruile worke shal you doe in it. It shal be an euerlaſting ordinance in al your habitations, and generations.
label: Leviticus

text: And after you reape the corne of your land, you shal not cut it to the verie ground: neither shal you gather the eares that remaine, but you shal let them alone for the poore and for ſtrangers. I am the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael: The ſeuenth moneth, on the firſt day of the moneth, shal be a Sabbath, a memorial, by ſounding of trumpettes, and shal be called holie:
label: Leviticus

text: no ſeruile worke shal you doe in it, and you shal offer holocauſt to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: vpon the tenth day of this ſeuenth moneth shal be the day of expiations moſt ſolemne, and it shal be called holie: and you shal afflict your ſoules in it, and shal offer holocauſt to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: No ſeruile worke shal you doe the time of this day: becauſe it is a day of propitiation, that the Lord your God may become propitious vnto you.
label: Leviticus

text: Euerie ſoule, that is not afflicted this day, shal perish out of his people:
label: Leviticus

text: and which shal doe anie worke, the ſame wil I deſtroy out of his people.
label: Leviticus

text: No worke therfore shal you doe in it: it shal be an euerlaſting odinance vnto you in al your generations, and habitations.
label: Leviticus

text: It is a Sabbath of reſting, and you shal afflict your ſoules the ninth day of the moneth: from euen vntil euen you shal celebrate your ſabbathes.
label: Leviticus

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaing:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael: From the fiftenth day of this ſeuenth moneth, shal be the feſtiuitie of tabernacles ſeuen daies to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: The firſt day shal be called moſt ſolemne and moſt holie: no ſeruile worke shal you doe in it. And ſeuen daies you shal offer holocauſtes to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: The eight day alſo shal be moſt ſolemne and moſt holie, and you shal offer holocauſtes to the Lord: for it is of aſſemblie and collection: no ſeruile worke shal you doe in it.
label: Leviticus

text: Theſe are the feſtiuities of the Lord, which you shal cal moſt ſolemne and moſt holie, and shal offer in them oblations to the Lord, holocauſts and libaments according to the rite of euerie day:
label: Leviticus

text: beſide the ſabbathes of the Lord, and your giftes, and thoſe that you shal offer by vow, or which you shal giue to the Lord voluntarily.
label: Leviticus

text: Therfore from the fiftenth day of the ſeuenth moneth, when you shal haue gathered al the fruites of your land, you shal celebrate the feſtiuitie of the Lord ſeuen daies, on the firſt day and the eight shal be a ſabbath, that is reſt.
label: Leviticus

text: And you shal take to you the firſt day the fruites of a moſt faire tree, and the branches of palmes, and boughes of the tree with thicke leaues, and willowes of the brooke, and you shal reioice before the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: And you shal celebrate the ſolemnitie therof ſeuen daies in the yeare. It shal be an euerlaſting ordinance in your generations. The ſeuenth moneth shal you celebrate the feſtiuitie,
label: Leviticus

text: and shal dwel in bowres ſeuen daies. euerie one, that is of the ſtocke of Iſrael, shal abide in tabernacles:
label: Leviticus

text: that your poſteritie may learne that I made the children of Iſrael, to dwel in tabernacles, when I brought them out of the Land of Ægypt. I the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: And Moyſes ſpake concerning the ſolemnities of our Lord to the children of Iſrael.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Command the children of Iſrael, that they bring vnto thee: oyle of oliues moſt pure, and cleare, to furnish the lampes continually,
label: Leviticus

text: without the veile of the teſtimonie in the tabernacle of couenant. And Aaron shal ſette them from euen vntil morning before the Lord, by a perpetual ſeruice and rite in your generations.
label: Leviticus

text: Vpon the candleſticke moſt cleane shal they be putte alwaies in the ſight of the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Thou shalt take alſo floure, and shalt bake therof twelue breades, which shal haue euerie one two tenthes:
label: Leviticus

text: which thou shalt ſette ſix one againſt an other vpon the moſt cleane table before the Lord,
label: Leviticus

label: Leviticus

text: Euerie ſabbath they shal be changed before the Lord, receiued of the children of Iſrael by an euerlaſting couenant:
label: Leviticus

text: and they shal be Aarons and his ſonnes, that they may eate them in a holie place: becauſe it is moſt Holie of the ſacrifices of the Lord by a perpetual righr.
label: Leviticus

text: And behold there went forth the ſonne of a woman of Iſrael, whom she had borne of an Ægyptian among the children of Iſrael, and fel at wordes in the campe with a man of Iſrael.
label: Leviticus

text: And when he had blaſphemed the name, and had curſed it, he was brought to Moyſes: (And his mother was called Salumith, the daughter of Dabri of the tribe of Dan.)
label: Leviticus

text: And they did caſt him into priſon, til they might know what our Lord would command.
label: Leviticus

text: Who ſpake to Moyſes,
label: Leviticus

label: Leviticus

text: And to the children of Iſrael thou shalt ſpeake: The man that curſeth his God, shal beare his ſinne:
label: Leviticus

text: and he that blaſphemeth the name of the Lord, dying let him dye: al the multitude of the people shal ſtone him, whether he be a natural, or ſtranger. He that blaſphemeth the name of the Lord, dying let him dye.
label: Leviticus

text: He that ſtriketh, and killeth a man, dying let him dye.
label: Leviticus

text: He that ſtriketh a beaſt, shal render one for it, that is to ſay, ſoule for ſoule,
label: Leviticus

text: He that giueth anie of his neighbours a blemish as he did, ſo shal it be done to him:
label: Leviticus

label: Leviticus

text: He that ſtriketh a beaſt, ſhal render an other. He that ſtriketh a man, shal be punished.
label: Leviticus

text: Let there be equal iudgement among you, whether a ſtranger, or a natural ſinne: becauſe I am the Lord, your God.
label: Leviticus

text: And Moyſes ſpake to the children of Iſrael: and they brought him forth that had blaſphemed, without the campe, and they ſtoned him. And the children of Iſrael did as our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes in the mount Sinai, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: When you shal be entred to the land which I wil geue you, thou shalt ſabbatize the ſabbath to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: Six yeares thou shalt ſowe thy field, and ſix yeares thou shalt cut thy vineyard, and shalt gather the fruites therof:
label: Leviticus

text: but in the ſeuenth yeare a ſabbath shal be to the earth, of the reſting of the Lord: the field thou shalt not ſowe, and the vineyard thou shalt not cut.
label: Leviticus

text: The thinges that the ground shal bring forth of it ſelf, thou shalt not reape: and the grapes of thy firſt fruites thou shalt not gather as a vintage: for it is a yeare of the reſting of the earth:
label: Leviticus

text: but they shal be vnto you for meate, to thee and thy manſeruant, to thy woman ſeruant and hyreling, and to the ſtranger that ſoiourneth with thee:
label: Leviticus

text: to thy beaſtes and cattel al thinges that grow shal giue meate.
label: Leviticus

text: Thou shalt number thee alſo ſeuen weekes of yeares, that is to ſay, ſeuen times ſeuen, which together make fourtie nine, yeares:
label: Leviticus

text: and thou shalt ſound with the trumpet the ſeuenth moneth, the tenth day of the moneth, in the time of propitiation in al your land.
label: Leviticus

text: Thou shalt ſanctifie the fifteth yeare, and shalt proclaime remiſſion to al the inhabitantes of thy land: for it is the yeare of Iubilie. Euerie man shal returne to his poſſeſſion, and euerie one shal goe backe to his old familie:
label: Leviticus

text: becauſe it is the Iubilie and the fifteth yeare. You shal not ſowe nor teape the thinges that growe in the field of their owne accord, and the firſt fruites of vintage you shal not gather,
label: Leviticus

text: becauſe of the ſanctification of the Iubilie, but forthwith as they grow you shal eate them.
label: Leviticus

text: In the yeare of Iubilie al shal returne to their poſſeſſions.
label: Leviticus

text: When thou shalt ſel anie thing to thy neighbour, or shalt buy of him, preſſe not thy brother, but according to the number of the yeares of Iubilie thou shalt buy of him,
label: Leviticus

text: and according to the ſupputation of the fruites he shal ſel to thee.
label: Leviticus

text: The moe yeares remaine after the Iubilie, ſo much more shal the price increaſe: and the leſſe time that thou shal account, ſo much the leſſe shal the purchaſe: be valued. for the time of the fruites he shal ſel to thee,
label: Leviticus

text: Doe not afflict your contrimen, but let euerie one feare his God, becauſe I the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: Do my preceptes, and keepe my iudgementes, and fulfil them: that you may dwel in the land without anie feare,
label: Leviticus

text: and the ground may yeld you her fruites, which you may eate vnto your fil, fearing no mans inuaſion.
label: Leviticus

text: But if you ſay: What shal we eate the ſeuenth yeare, if we ſowe not, nor gather our fruites?
label: Leviticus

text: I wil geue you my benediction the ſixt yeare, and it shal yeld the fruites of three yeares:
label: Leviticus

text: and the eight yeare you shal ſowe, and shal eate of the old fruites, vntil the ninth yeare: til new be growne, you shal eate the old.
label: Leviticus

text: The land alſo shal not be ſould for euer: becauſe it is mine, and you are my ſtrangers and ſeiourners.
label: Leviticus

text: For the which cauſe al the countrie of your poſſeſſion shal be ſould vnder the condition of redemption.
label: Leviticus

text: If thy brother impouerished ſel his litle poſſeſſion, and his kinſeman wil, he may redeme that which he had ſould.
label: Leviticus

text: But if he haue no kinſeman, and him ſelf can finde the price to redeme it:
label: Leviticus

text: the fruites shal be accounted from that time when he ſould it: and the reſidue he shal reſtore to the buier, and ſo he shal receiue his poſſeſſion againe.
label: Leviticus

text: but if his hand finde not to repay the price, the buier shal haue that he bought, vntil the yeare of Iubilie. For in it al ſale shal returne to the owner, and to the old poſſeſſour.
label: Leviticus

text: He that ſelleth a houſe within the walles of a citie, shal haue licence to redeme it, vntil one yeare be expired,
label: Leviticus

text: if he redeme it not, and the compaſſe of the yeare be fully out, the buier shal poſſeſſe it, and his poſteritie for euer, and it can not be redemed, no not in the Iubilie.
label: Leviticus

text: But if the houſe be in a village, that hath not walles, it shal be ſould according to the law of fieldes. if it be not redemed before, in the Iubilie it shal returne to the owner.
label: Leviticus

text: The houſes of Leuites, which are in cities, may alwaies be redemed:
label: Leviticus

text: if they be not redemed, in the Iubilie they shal returne to the owners, becauſe the houſes of the cities of the Leuites are for poſſeſſions among the children of Iſrael.
label: Leviticus

text: But let not their ſuburbes be ſould, becauſe it is a perpetual poſſeſſion.
label: Leviticus

text: If thy brother be empouerished, and weake of hand, and thou receiue him as a ſtranger and ſeiourner, and he liue with thee,
label: Leviticus

text: take not vſuries of him, nor more then thou gaueſt. feare thy God, that thy brother may liue with thee.
label: Leviticus

text: Thou shalt not geue him thy money to vſurie, and an ouerplus of the fruites thou shalt not exact of him.
label: Leviticus

text: I the Lord your God, that brought you out of the Land of Ægygt, that I might geue you the Land of Chanaan, and might be your God.
label: Leviticus

text: If thy brother conſtrained by pouertie, ſel him ſelf to thee, thou shalt not oppreſſe him with the ſeruitude of ſeruants,
label: Leviticus

text: but he shal be as an hireling, and a ſeiourner: vntil the yeare of Iubilee he shal worke with thee,
label: Leviticus

text: and afterward he shal goe out with his children, and shal returne to his kinred and to the poſſeſſion of his fathers,
label: Leviticus

text: for they are my ſeruantes, and I brought them out of the Land of Ægypt. let them not be ſould by the condition of ſeruantes:
label: Leviticus

text: afflict him not by might, but feare thy God.
label: Leviticus

text: Let your man ſeruant, and woman ſeruant, be of the nations that are round about you.
label: Leviticus

text: And of the ſtrangers, that ſoiourne with you, or that were borne of them in your land, theſe you ſhal haue for ſeruantes:
label: Leviticus

text: and by right of inheritance shal leaue them to your poſteritie, and shal poſſeſſe them for euer. but your brethren the children of Iſrael doe ye not oppreſſe by might.
label: Leviticus

text: If the hand of a ſtranger or ſeiourner grow ſtrong among you, and thy brother empouerished ſel him ſelf to him, or to any of his ſtocke:
label: Leviticus

text: after the ſale he may be redeemed. He that wil of his brethren shal redeme him,
label: Leviticus

text: both the vncle by father, and the vncles ſonne, and the kinſman, and the allied. But and if him ſelf be able alſo, he shal redeme him ſelfe,
label: Leviticus

text: accounting onlie the yeares from the time of his ſelling vnto the yeare of Iubilee: and accounting the money, that he was ſould for, according to the number of the yeares and the reckning of an hyreling.
label: Leviticus

text: If they be more yeares that remaine vntil the Iubilee, according to theſe alſo shal he repay the price.
label: Leviticus

text: if few, he shal make the reckning with him according to the number of the yeares, and shal repay to the buyer for that which remaineth of the yeares,
label: Leviticus

text: his wages being allowed for the which he ſerued before: he shal not afflict him violently in thy ſight.
label: Leviticus

text: And if by theſe meanes he can not be redemed, in the yeare of Iubilee he shal goe out with his children.
label: Leviticus

text: For the children of Iſrael are my ſeruantes, whom I brought forth out of the Land of Ægypt.
label: Leviticus

text: I THE Lord your God: you shal not make to your ſelues an idol and thing grauen, neither shal you erect titles, nor ſet a notorious ſtone in your land, for to adore it. for I am the Lord your God.
label: Leviticus

text: Keepe my ſabbathes, and dread my Sanctuarie. I the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: If you walke in my preceptes, and keepe my commandementes, and doe them, I wil geue you raine in their ſeaſons,
label: Leviticus

text: and the earth shal bring forth her ſpring, and the trees shal be replenished with fruites.
label: Leviticus

text: The threshing of your harueſt shal reach vnto vintage, and the vintage shal reach vnto ſowing time: and you shal eate your bread to your fil, and without feare shal you dwel in your land.
label: Leviticus

text: I wil geue peace in your coaſtes: you shal ſleepe, and there shal be none to make you afraid. I wil take away euil beaſtes: and the ſword shal not paſſe through your quarters.
label: Leviticus

text: You shal purſue your enemies, and they shal fal before you.
label: Leviticus

text: fiue of yours shal purſue an hundred ſtrangers, and an hundred of you tenne thouſand: your enemies shal fal by the ſword in your ſight.
label: Leviticus

text: I wil reſpect you, and make you encreaſe: you shal be multiplied, and I wil eſtablish my couenant with you.
label: Leviticus

text: You shal eate the eldeſt of the old ſtore, and new coming vpon it you shal caſt forth the old.
label: Leviticus

text: I wil ſette my tabernacle in the middes of you, and my ſoule shal not caſt you of.
label: Leviticus

text: I wil walke among you, and wil be your God, and you shal be my people.
label: Leviticus

text: I the Lord your God: that haue brought you out of the Land of the Ægyptians, that you should not ſerue them, and that haue broken the chaines of your neckes, that you might goe vpright.
label: Leviticus

text: But if you wil not heare me, nor doe al my commandements,
label: Leviticus

text: if you diſpiſe my lawes, and contemne my iudgementes that you do not thoſe thinges which are appointed by me, and bring my couenant to nothing worth:
label: Leviticus

text: I alſo wil do theſe thinges to you: I shal quickly viſite you with pouertie, and burning heat, which shal waiſt your eies, and conſume your liues. you shal ſowe your ſeede in vaine, which ſhal be deuoured of the enemies.
label: Leviticus

text: I wil ſette my face againſt you, and you shal fal downe before your enemies, and shal be made ſubiect to them that hate you. you shal flee, when no man purſueth you.
label: Leviticus

text: But if you wil not obey me ſo neither, I wil increaſe your chaſtiſementes ſeuen fould for your ſinnes,
label: Leviticus

text: and wil breake the pride of your ſtubburneſſe. and I wil make to you the heauen, from aboue as iron, and the earth as braſſe.
label: Leviticus

text: Your labour shal be ſpēt in vaine, the earth shal not bring forth her ſpring, nor the trees yeld their fruites.
label: Leviticus

text: If you walke contrarie to me, and wil not heare me, I wil increaſe your plagues vntil ſeuen fould for your ſinnes:
label: Leviticus

text: and I wil ſend in vpon you the beaſtes of the field, which may conſume you, and your cattaile, and may bring al thinges to a ſmal number, and that your waies may be made deſert.
label: Leviticus

text: And if you wil neither ſo receiue diſcipline, but walke rather contrarie to me:
label: Leviticus

text: I alſo wil goe oppoſite againſt you, and wil ſtrike you ſeuen times for your ſinnes.
label: Leviticus

text: and I wil bring in vpon you the ſword a reuenger of my couenant. And when you shal flee into the cities, I wil ſend the peſtilence in the middeſt of you, and you shal be deliuered in the handes of the enemies,
label: Leviticus

text: after I shal haue broken the ſtaffe of your bread: ſo that tenne wemen shal bake your breades in one ouen, and ſhal render them by weight: and you shal eate, and shal not be filled.
label: Leviticus

text: But if you wil neither by theſe meanes heare me, but walke againſt me:
label: Leviticus

text: I alſo wil goe againſt you in contrarie furie, and wil chaſtice you with ſeuen plagues for your ſinnes,
label: Leviticus

text: ſo that you shal eate the flesh of your ſonnes and of your daughters.
label: Leviticus

text: I wil deſtroy your excelſes, and breake your idols. You shal fal among the ruines of your idols and my ſoule shal abhorre you,
label: Leviticus

text: in ſo much that I wil bring your cities into a wilderneſſe, and I wil make your Sanctuaries deſert, neither wil I receiue any more the moſt ſweete odour.
label: Leviticus

text: And I wil diſtroy your land, and your enemies shal be aſtonied vpon it, when they shal be inhabitants therof.
label: Leviticus

text: And you I wil diſperſe into the Gentiles, and wil draw out the ſword after you, and your land shal be deſert, and your cities deſtroied.
label: Leviticus

text: Then shal the land take pleaſure in her ſabbathes al the daies of her deſolation: when you shal be
label: Leviticus

text: in the enemies land, she shal ſabbatize, and reſt in the ſabbathes of her deſolation, becauſe she did not reſt in your ſabbathes when you dwelt in it.
label: Leviticus

text: And they that shal remaine of you, I wil put feare in their hartes in the countries of their enemies, the ſound of a flying leafe shal terrifie them, and they shal flie it as it were a ſword: they shal fal, when no man purſueth,
label: Leviticus

text: and they shal euerie one fal vpon their brethren, as flying from warres, none of you shal be ſo hardie as to reſiſt your enemies.
label: Leviticus

text: You shal perish among the Gentiles, and the enemies land shal conſume you.
label: Leviticus

text: And if of them alſo ſome remaine, they shal pine away in their iniquities, in the land of their enemies, and for the ſinnes of their fathers, and their owne they shal be afflicted:
label: Leviticus

text: vntil they confeſſe their owne and their auncetours iniquities, wherby they haue preuaricated againſt me, and walked contrarie vnto me.
label: Leviticus

text: I alſo therfore wil walke againſt them, and bring them into their enemies land, vntil their vncircumciſed mind be ashamed: then shal they pray for their impieties.
label: Leviticus

text: And I wil remember my couenant, that I made with Iacob, and Iſaac, and Abraham. Of the land alſo I wil be mindful:
label: Leviticus

text: which when it shal be left of them, shal take pleaſure in her ſabbathes, being deſolate for them. But they shal pray for their ſinnes, for that they reiected my iudgementes, and diſpiſed my lawes.
label: Leviticus

text: Howbeit euen when they were in the land of their enemies, I did not caſt them of altogether, neither did I ſo diſpiſe them, that they should be conſumed, and I should make my couenant with them fruſtrate. For I am the Lord their God,
label: Leviticus

text: and I wil remember mine old couenant, when I brought them out of the Land of Ægypt, in the ſight of the Gentiles, for to be their God. I the Lord. Theſe are the iudgementes, and precepts, and lawes, which our Lord gaue betwen him ſelf and the children of Iſrael in Monnt Sinai by the hand of Moyſes.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Leviticus

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: The man that shal haue made a vow, and bound his ſoule to God, by eſtimation he shal geue the price.
label: Leviticus

text: If it be a man from the twenteth yeare vntil three ſcore, he shal geue fiftie ſicles of ſiluer, after the meaſure of the Sanctuarie:
label: Leviticus

text: if a woman, thirtie.
label: Leviticus

text: But from the fift yeare vntil the twenteth, a man shal geue twentie ſicles: a woman tenne.
label: Leviticus

text: From one moneth vntil the fift yeare, for a man shal be geuen fiue ſicles: for a woman three.
label: Leviticus

text: One that is three ſcore and aboue a man shal geue fiftene ſicles: a woman tenne.
label: Leviticus

text: if he be poore, and not able to pay the eſtimation he shal ſtand before the prieſt: and as much as he shal eſteme, and ſee him able to pay, ſo much shal he geue.
label: Leviticus

text: But the beaſt, that may be immolated to the Lord, if a man doe vow it, shal be holie,
label: Leviticus

text: and can not be changed, that is to ſay, neither a better for a bad, nor a worſe for a good. and if he change it: both it ſelf that was changed, and that for the which it was changed, ſhal be conſecrated to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: The vncleane beaſt, which can not be immolated to the Lord, if anie man vow it shal be brought before the prieſt.
label: Leviticus

text: Who iudgeing whether it be good or euel, shal ſet the price.
label: Leviticus

text: which if he that offereth wil geue, he shal adde aboue the eſtimation the fift part.
label: Leviticus

text: If a man vow his houſe, and ſanctifie it to the Lord, the prieſt shal conſider it, whether it be good or bad, and according to the price, which he shal appoint, it shal be ſold.
label: Leviticus

text: But if he that had vowed, wil redeme it, he shal geue the fift part of the eſtimation beſides, and shal haue the houſe.
label: Leviticus

text: And if he vow the field of his poſſeſſion, and conſecrate it to the Lord, the price shal be eſtemed according to the meaſure of the ſeede. If the ground be ſowed with thirtie bushels of barly, let it be ſolde for fiftie ſicles of ſiluer.
label: Leviticus

text: If he vow his field immediatly from the yeare of Iubilee, that is beginning, how much it can be worth, at ſo much it shal be eſtemed:
label: Leviticus

text: but if ſometime after: the prieſt shal account the money according to the number of yeares, that remaine vntil the Iubilee, and there shal be diminished of the price.
label: Leviticus

text: And if he that had vowed, wil redeme his field, he shal adde the fift part of the eſtemed money, and shal poſſeſſe it.
label: Leviticus

text: And if he wil not redeme it, but it be ſould to any other man, he that had vowed it, can redeme it no more:
label: Leviticus

text: for when the day of Iubilee commeth, it shal be ſanctified to the Lord, and the poſſeſſion conſecrated pertaineth to the right of the prieſtes.
label: Leviticus

text: If the field be bought, and being not of his auncetors poſſeſſion be ſanctified to the Lord,
label: Leviticus

text: the prieſt shal account the price according to the number of yeares, vnto the iubilee: and he that had vowed, shal geue that to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: but in the Iubilee, it shal returne to the former owner, that ſould it, and had it in the lotte of his poſſeſſion.
label: Leviticus

text: Al eſtimation shal be weighed by the ſicle of the ſanctuarie. A ſicle hath twentie oboles.
label: Leviticus

text: The firſt borne, which pertaine to the Lord, no man may ſanctifie and vow: whether it be oxe, or sheepe, they are the Lordes.
label: Leviticus

text: And if it be an vncleane beaſt, he that offereth it shal redeme it, according to thy eſtimatimation, and shal adde the fift part of the price. If he wil not redeme it, it shal be ſould to an other for how much ſoeuer it was eſtemed by thee.
label: Leviticus

text: Anie thing that is conſecrated to the Lord, whether it be man, or beaſt, or field, shal not be ſould, neither can it be redemed. Whatſoeuer is once conſecrated, shal be holie of holies to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: And any conſecration, that is offered of a man, shal not be redemed, but dying shal die.
label: Leviticus

text: Al tithes of the land, whether of corne, or of the fruites of trees, are the Lordes, and are ſanctified to him.
label: Leviticus

text: And if anie man wil redeme his tithes, he shal adde the fift part of them.
label: Leviticus

text: Of al the tithes of oxen, and sheepe and goates, that paſſe vnder the sheepheardes rodde, euerie tenth that commeth shal be ſanctified to the Lord.
label: Leviticus

text: It shal not be choſen neither good nor bad, neither shal it be changed for an other. If anie man change it: both that which was changed, and that for the which it was changed, shal be ſanctified to the Lord, and shal not be redeemed.
label: Leviticus

text: Theſe are the precepts, which our Lord commanded Moyſes vnto the children of Iſrael in the mount Sinai.
label: Leviticus

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes in the deſert of Sinai in the tabernacle of couenant, the firſt day of the ſecond moneth, the ſecond yeare of their going out of Ægypt, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Take the ſumme of the whole aſſemblie of the children of Iſrael by their kinredes, & houſes, and the names of euerie one, whatſoeuer of the male ſexe,
label: Numbers

text: from the twentith yeare and vpward, of al the ſtrong men of Iſrael, and you shal number them by their troupes, thou and Aaron.
label: Numbers

text: And there shal be with you the princes of the tribes, and of the houſes in their kinredes,
label: Numbers

text: whoſe names are theſe: Of Ruben, Elizur the ſonne of Sedeur.
label: Numbers

text: Of Simeon, Salamiel the ſonne of Suriſaddai.
label: Numbers

text: Of Iuda, Nahaſſon, the ſonne of Aminadab.
label: Numbers

text: Of Iſſachar, Nathanael the ſonne of Suar.
label: Numbers

text: Of Zabulon Eliab the ſonne of Helon.
label: Numbers

text: And of the ſonnes of Ioſeph, of Ephraim, Eliſama the ſonne of Ammiud. of Manaſſes, Gamaliel, the ſonne of Phadaſſur.
label: Numbers

text: of Beniamin, Abidan the ſonne of Gedeon.
label: Numbers

text: of Dan, Ahiezer the ſonne of Ammiſaddai.
label: Numbers

text: of Aſer, Phegiel the ſonne of Ochran.
label: Numbers

text: Of Gad, Eliazaph the ſonne of Duel.
label: Numbers

text: Of Nephthali, Ahira the ſonne of Enan.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are the moſt noble princes of the multitude by their tribes and kinredes, and the heades of the hoſte of Iſrael:
label: Numbers

text: whom Moyſes and Aaron tooke with al the multitude of the common people:
label: Numbers

text: and aſſembled them the firſt day of the ſecond moneth, reckening them by the kinredes, and houſes, and families, and heades, and names of euerie one from the twentith yeare and vpwarde,
label: Numbers

text: as our Lord had comanded Moyſes. And they were numbered in the deſert of Sinai.
label: Numbers

text: Of Ruben the firſt begotten of Iſrael, by their generations and families and houſes, and names of euerie heade, al that is of the male ſexe, from twentith yeare and vpwarde, of them that goe forth to warre,
label: Numbers

text: fourtie ſix thouſand fiue hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Of the ſonnes of Simeon by the generations and families, and houſes of their kinredes were reckened by the names and heades of euerie one, al that is of the male ſexe, from twentith yeare and vpward, of them that goe forth to warre,
label: Numbers

text: fiftie nine thouſand three hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Of the ſonnes of Gad, by the generations and families and houſes of their kinredes were reckned by the names of euerie one from twentie yeares and vpwarde, al that went forth to warre,
label: Numbers

text: fourtie fiue thouſand ſix hundred fiftie.
label: Numbers

text: Of the ſonnes to Iuda by the generations and families and houſes of their kinredes, by the names of euerie one from the twentith yeare and vpward, al that could goe forth to warre,
label: Numbers

text: were reckned ſeuentie foure thouſand ſix hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Of the ſonnes of Iſſachar, by the generations and families and houſes of their kinredes, by the names of euerie one from the twentith yeare and vpward, al that went forth to warre,
label: Numbers

text: were reckened fiftie foure thouſand foure hũdred.
label: Numbers

text: Of the ſonnes of Zabulon, by the generations and families and houſes of their kinredes, were reckened by names of euerie one from the twentith yeare and vpwatd, al that could goe fotth to warre,
label: Numbers

text: fiftie ſeuen thouſand foure hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Of the ſonnes of Ioſeph, namely of the ſonnes of Ephraim by the generations families and houſes of their kinredes were reckened by the names of euerie one, from the twentith yeare and vpward, al that could goe forth to warre,
label: Numbers

text: fourtie thouſand fiue hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Moreouer of the ſonnes of Manaſſes, by the generations and families and houſes of their kinredes, were reckened by the names of euerie one from twentie yeares and vpward, al that could goe forth to warre,
label: Numbers

text: thirtie two thouſand two hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Of the ſonnes of Beniamin by the generations and families and houſes of their kinredes were reckened by names of euerie one from the twentith yeare and vpward, al that could goe forth to warre,
label: Numbers

text: thirtie fiue thouſand foure hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Of the ſonnes of Dan, by the generations and families, and houſes of their kinredes were reckened by the names of euerie one from twentie yeares and vpward, al that could goe forth to warre,
label: Numbers

text: ſixtie two thouſand ſeuen hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Of the ſonnes of Aſer, by the generations and families and houſes of their kinredes were reckened by the names of euerie one from the twentith yeare and vpward, al that could goe forth to warre,
label: Numbers

text: fourtie thouſand and a thouſand fiue hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Of the ſonnes of Nephthali, by the generations, and families, and houſes of their kinredes were reckened by the names of euerie one from the twentith yeare and vpward, al that could goe forth to warre,
label: Numbers

text: fiftie three thouſand foure hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are they, whom Moyſes and Aaron numbered, and the twelue princes of Iſrael, euerie one by the houſes of their kinredes.
label: Numbers

text: And the whole number of the children of Iſrael by their houſes and families, from the twentith yeare and vpward, that could goe to warre,
label: Numbers

text: Were ſix hundred three thouſand men fiue hundred fiftie.
label: Numbers

text: But the Leuites in the tribe of their families were not numbered with them.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Number not the tribe of Leui, neither shalt thou put the ſumme of them with the children of Iſrael:
label: Numbers

text: but appoint them ouer the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and al the veſſel therof, and whatſoeuer pertaineth to the ceremonies. They shal carie the tabernacle and al the furniture therof: and they shal be in the miniſterie, and shal pitch round about the tabernacle.
label: Numbers

text: When you are to goe forward, the Leuites shal take downe the tabernacle: when you are to campe, they shal ſet it vp. what ſtranger ſoeuer cometh to it, he shal be ſlaine.
label: Numbers

text: And the children of Iſrael shal campe euerie man by his troupes and bands and hoſte.
label: Numbers

text: Moreouer the Leuites shal pitch their tents round about the tabernacle, leſt there come indignation vpon the multitude of the children of Iſrael, and they shal watch in the cuſtodies of the tabernacle of teſtimonie.
label: Numbers

text: The children of Iſrael therfore did according to al thinges which our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Numbers

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes and Aaron ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Euerie one of the children of Iſrael by the troupes, enſignes, and ſtanderts, and houſes of their kinredes shal campe, round about the tabernacle of couenant.
label: Numbers

text: On the eaſt Iudas shal pitche his tents by the troupes of his bande: and the prince of his ſonnes shal be Nahaſſon the ſonne of Aminadab.
label: Numbers

text: And the whole ſumme of the warriers of his ſtocke, ſeuentie foure thouſand ſix hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Beſide him camped they of the tribe of Iſſachar, whoſe prince was Nathanael the ſonne of Suar.
label: Numbers

text: and al the number of his warriers fiftie foure thouſand foure hundred.
label: Numbers

text: In the tribe of Zabulon the prince was Eliab the ſonne of Helon
label: Numbers

text: and al the hoſte of warriers of his ſtocke, fiftie ſeuen thouſand foure hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Al that were numbered in the campe of Iudas, were an hundred eightie ſix thouſand foure hundred: and they by their troupes shal march firſt.
label: Numbers

text: In the campe of the ſonnes of Ruben on the ſouth ſide the prince shal be Eliſur the ſonne of Sedeur:
label: Numbers

text: and the whole hoſte of his warriers, that were numbred, fourtie ſix thouſand fiue hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Beſide him camped they of the tribe of Simeon: whoſe prince was Salamiel the ſonne of Suriſaddai.
label: Numbers

text: and the whole hoſte of his warriers, that were numbred, fiftie nine thouſand three hundred.
label: Numbers

text: In the tribe of Gad, the prince was Eliaſaph the ſonne of Duel.
label: Numbers

text: and the whole hoſte of his warriers, that were numbred, fourtie fiue thouſand ſix hundred fiftie.
label: Numbers

text: Al that were reckened in the campe of Ruben, an hundred fiftie thouſand and a thouſand foure hundred fiftie by their troupes: they shal march in the ſecond place.
label: Numbers

text: But the tabernacle of teſtimonie shal be lifted vp by the offices of the Leuites and their troupes. As it shal be ſette vp, ſo shal it be taken downe. Euerie one shal march by their places, and orders.
label: Numbers

text: On the weſt ſide shal be the campe of the ſonnes of Ephraim, whoſe prince was Eliſama the ſonne of Ammiud.
label: Numbers

text: the whole hoſte of his warriers, that were numbered, fourtie thouſand fiue hundred.
label: Numbers

text: And with them the tribes of the ſonnes of Manaſſes, whoſe prince was Gamaliel the ſonne of Phadaſſur.
label: Numbers

text: and the whole hoſte of his warriers, that were numbered, thirtie two thouſand two hundred.
label: Numbers

text: In the tribe of the ſonnes of Beniamin the prince was Abidan the ſonne of Gedeon.
label: Numbers

text: and the whole hoſt of his warriers, that were reckened, thirtie fiue thouſand foure hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Al that were numbered in the campe of Ephraim, an hundred eight thouſand one hundred by their troupes: they shal march the third.
label: Numbers

text: On the north part camped the ſonnes of Dan: whoſe prince was Ahiezar the ſonne of Ammiſaddai.
label: Numbers

text: the whole hoſte of his warriers, that were numbered, ſixtie two thouſand ſeuen hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Beſides him they of the tribe of Aſer pitched their tents: whoſe prince was Phegiel the ſonne of Ochran:
label: Numbers

text: the whole hoſte of his warriers, that were numbered, fourtie thouſand and a thouſand fiue hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of the ſonnes of Nephthali the prince was Ahira the ſonne of Enan.
label: Numbers

text: the whole hoſte of his warriers, fiftie three thouſand foure hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Al that were numbered in the campe of Dan, were an hundred fiftie ſeuen thouſand ſix hundred: and they shal march laſt.
label: Numbers

text: This is the number of the children of Iſrael, by the houſes of their kinredes and troupes of the hoſte being diuided, ſix hundred three thouſand fiue hundred fiftie.
label: Numbers

text: And the Leuites were not numbered among the children of Iſrael: for ſo our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Numbers

text: And the children of Iſrael did according to al thinges, that our Lord had commanded. They camped by their troupes, and marched by their families and houſes of their fathers.
label: Numbers

text: THESE are the generations of Aaron and Moyſes in the day that our Lord ſpake to Moyſes in Mount Sinai.
label: Numbers

text: And theſe be the names of the ſonnes of Aaron: his firſt begotten Nadab, then Abiu, and Eleazar, and Ithamar.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are the names of the ſonnes of Aaron the prieſts that were anointed, and whoſe handes were filled and cõſecrated, to doe the function of prieſthood.
label: Numbers

text: For Nadab and Abiu died, when they offered the ſtrange fire in the ſight of our Lord, in the deſert of Sinai, without children: and Eleazar and Ithamar did the function of prieſthood in the preſence of Aaron their father.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Bring the tribe of Leui, and make them ſtand in the ſight of Aaron the prieſt to miniſter vnto him, and let them watch,
label: Numbers

text: and obſerue whatſoeuer pertaineth to the ſeruice of the multitude before the tabernacle of teſtimonie,
label: Numbers

text: and let them keepe the veſſel of the tabernacle, ſeruing in the miniſterie therof.
label: Numbers

text: And thou shalt geue the Leuites for a gift,
label: Numbers

text: to Aaron and to his ſonnes, to whom they are deliuered of the children of Iſrael. But Aaron and his ſonnes thou shalt appoint ouer the ſeruice of prieſthood. The ſtranger, that approcheth to miniſter, shal die.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: I haue taken the Leuites from the children of Iſrael, for euerie firſt borne, that openeth the matrice among the children of Iſrael, and the Leuites shal be mine.
label: Numbers

text: For the firſt borne is mine: ſince I ſtroke the firſt borne in the Land of Ægypt: I haue ſanctified to me, whatſoeuer is firſt borne in Iſrael from man vnto beaſt, they are mine: I the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to moyſes in the deſert of Sinai, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Number the ſonnes of Leui by the houſes of their fathers and their families, euerie male from one moneth and vpward.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes numbered, as our Lord had commanded,
label: Numbers

text: and there were found the ſonnes of Leui by their names, Gerſon and Caath and Merari.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Gerſon: Lebni and Semei.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Caath: Amram, and Ieſaar, Hebron and Oziel.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Merari: Moholi and Muſi.
label: Numbers

text: Of Gerſon were two families, the Lebnitical, and Semeitical:
label: Numbers

text: of whom were numbered the people of male ſexe from one moneth and vpward, ſeuen thouſand fiue hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe shal pitch behind the tabernacle on the Weſt.
label: Numbers

text: vnder their prince Heliaſaph, the ſonne of Lael.
label: Numbers

text: And their charge shal be in the tabernacle of couenãt,
label: Numbers

text: the tabernacle it ſelfe and the couer therof, the hanging that is drawne before the dores of the roofe of couenant, and the curtines of the court: the hanging alſo that is hanged in the entrie of the court of the tabernacle, and whatſoeuer pertaineth to the rite of the altar, the cordes of the tabernacle, and al the furniture therof.
label: Numbers

text: The kinred of Caath shal haue the peoples of the Amramites, and Ieſaarites, and Hebronites, and Ozielites. Theſe are the families of the Caithites reckened by their names:
label: Numbers

text: al of the male ſexe from one moneth and vpward, eight thouſand ſix hundred, they shal haue the gard of the Sanctuarie,
label: Numbers

text: and shal campe on the ſouth ſide.
label: Numbers

text: And their prince shal be Elizaphan the ſonne of Oziel:
label: Numbers

text: and they shal keepe the arke, and table and the candleſticke, the altars, and the veſſel of the Sanctuarie, wherin the miniſtration is, and the veile, and al ſuch kind of implementes.
label: Numbers

text: And the prince of the princes of the Leuites, Eleazar, the ſonne of Aaron the prieſt, shal be ouer them that watch for the cuſtodie of the Sanctuarie.
label: Numbers

text: But of Merari shal be the peoples of the Moholites, and Muſites, reckened by their names:
label: Numbers

text: al of the male kind from one moneth and vpward, ſix thouſand two hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Their prince Suriel the ſonne of Abihaiel: they shal campe on the north ſide.
label: Numbers

text: Vnder their cuſtodie shal be the bordes of the tabernacle, and the barres, and the pillers and their feete, and al thinges that pertaine to this kind of ſeruice:
label: Numbers

text: and the pillers of the court round about with their feete, and the pinnes with the cordes.
label: Numbers

text: Before the tabernacle of couenant, that is to ſay, on the eaſt ſide, shal Moyſes and Aaron campe, with their ſonnes, hauing the cuſtodie of the Sanctuarie, in the middes of the children of Iſrael. what ſtranger ſoeuer cometh therto, shal die.
label: Numbers

text: Al the Leuites, that Moyſes and Aaron numbered, according to the precept of our Lord by their families in the male kinde from one moneth and vpward, were twentie two thouſand.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Number the firſt borne of the male ſex of the children of Iſrael, from one moneth and vpward, and thou shalt haue the ſumme of them.
label: Numbers

text: And thou shalt take the Leuites vnto me for al the firſt borne of the children of Iſrael, I am the Lord: and their cattel for al the firſt borne of the cattel of the children of Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes reckened, as our Lord had commanded, the firſt borne of the children of Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: and the males by their names, from one moneth and vpward, were twentie two thouſand two hundred ſeuentie three.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Take the Leuites for the firſt borne of the children of Iſrael, and the cattel of the Leuites for their cattel, and the Leuites shal be mine. I am the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: But for the price of two hundred ſeuentie three, of the firſt borne of the children of Iſrael, that exceede the number of the Leuites,
label: Numbers

text: thou shalt take fiue ſicles for euerie head, after the meaſure of the Sãctuarie. A ſicle hath twentie oboles.
label: Numbers

text: And thou shalt giue the money to Aaron and to his ſonnes the price of them that are aboue.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore tooke their money, that were aboue, and whom he redemed of the Leuites,
label: Numbers

text: for the firſt borne of the children of Iſrael, a thouſand three hundred ſixtie fiue ſicles, according to the weight of the Sanctuarie,
label: Numbers

text: and gaue it to Aaron and his ſonnes, according to the word that our Lord had commanded him.
label: Numbers

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, and Aaron, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Take the ſumme of the ſonnes of Caath out of the middes of the Leuites, by their houſes and families,
label: Numbers

text: from the thirtith yeare & vpward, vnto the fiftith yeare, of al that goe in to ſtand and to miniſter in the tabernacle of couenant.
label: Numbers

text: This is the ſeruice of the ſonnes of Caath:
label: Numbers

text: when the campe is to remoue, Aaron and his ſonnes shal enter into the tabernacle of couenant, and Sanctum ſanctorum, and ſhal take downe the veile that hangeth before the dore, and shal wrappe in it the arke of teſtimonie,
label: Numbers

text: and shal couer it agayne with a couer of Ianthine skinnes, and shal ſpread ouer it a cloth al of hyacinth, and shal draw in the barres.
label: Numbers

text: The tabel alſo of propoſition they shal wrappe in a cloth of hiacinth, and shal put with it the cenſers and litle morters, the goblettes and cuppes to powre the libaments: the breades shal be alwayes on it:
label: Numbers

text: and they shal ſpread ouer it a cloth of ſcarlet, which againe they shal couer with a veile of ianthine skinnes, and shal put in the barres.
label: Numbers

text: They shal take alſo a cloth of hiacinth wherwith they shal couer the candleſtick with the lampes and tongs therof and ſnuffers and al the veſſels of oyle, which are neceſſarie for the dreſſing of the lampes:
label: Numbers

text: and ouer al they shal put a couer of ianthine skinnes, and put in the barres.
label: Numbers

text: Moreouer the golden altar alſo they shal wrappe in a cloth of hyacinth, and shal ſpreade ouer it a couer of ianthine skinnes, and put in the barres.
label: Numbers

text: Al the veſſel wherwith the miniſtration is done in the Sanctuarie, they shal wrappe in a cloth of hiacinth and shal ſpread ouer it a couer of ianthine skinnes, and put in barres.
label: Numbers

text: But the altar alſo they shal make cleane from the aſhes, and shal wrappe it in a purple cloth,
label: Numbers

text: and shal put with it al the veſſel, that they vſe in the miniſterie therof, that is to ſay, fire pannes, fleshhookes and forkes, pothookes and shouels. Al the veſſel of the altar together they shal couer with a veile of ianthine skinnes, and shal put in the barres.
label: Numbers

text: And when Aaron & his ſonnes haue wrapped vp the Sanctuarie and the veſſel therof in the remouing of the campe, then shal the ſonnes of Caath enter in to carie the thinges wrapped vp: and they shal not touch the veſſel of the Sanctuarie, leſt they die. Theſe are the burdens of the ſonnes of Caath in the tabernacle of couenant:
label: Numbers

text: ouer whom shal be Eleazar the ſonne of Aaron the prieſt, to whoſe charge perteyneth the oyle to dreſſe the lampes, and the incenſe of compoſition, and the ſacrifice, that is alwayes offered, and the oyle of vnction, and whatſoeuer perteyneth to the ſeruice of the tabernacle, and of al the veſſel, that are in the Sanctuarie.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake vnto Moyſes and Aaron, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Deſtroy not the people of Caath out of the middes of the Leuites:
label: Numbers

text: but doe this to them, that they may liue, and not die, if they touch Sancta ſanctorum. Aaron and his ſonnes shal enter, and they shal diſpoſe the charges of euerie one, and shal diuide what euerie one muſt carie.
label: Numbers

text: Let others by no curioſitie ſee the thinges that are in the Sanctuarie before they be wrapped vp, otherwiſe they shal die.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Take the ſumme of the ſonnes of Gerſon alſo by their houſes and families and kinredes,
label: Numbers

text: from thirtie yeares and vpward, vnto fiftie yeares. Number them al that goe in and miniſter in the tabernacle of couenant.
label: Numbers

text: This is the office of the familie of the Gerſonites,
label: Numbers

text: for to carie the curtines of the tabernacle, and the roofe of the couenant the other couer, and ouer al the ianthine couer, and the hanging that hangeth in the entrie of the tabernacle of couenant,
label: Numbers

text: the curtines of the court, and the veile in the entrie that is before the tabernacle. Al thinges that pertayne to the altar, the cordes, and veſſel of the miniſterie,
label: Numbers

text: shal the ſonnes of Gerſon carie, by the commandment of Aaron & his ſonnes: and euerie one shal knowe to what burden they muſt be aſſigned.
label: Numbers

text: This is the ſeruice of the familie of the Gerſonites in the tabernacle of couenant, and they shal be vnder the hand of Ithamar the ſonne of Aaron the prieſt.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Merari alſo by the families and houſes of their fathers thou shalt recken,
label: Numbers

text: from thirtie yeares and vpward, vntil fiftie yeares, al that enter in to the office of their miniſterie, and to the ſeruice of the couenant of teſtimonie.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are their burdens: They shal carie the bordes of the tabernacle and the barres therof, the pillers and the feete of them,
label: Numbers

text: the pillers alſo of the court round about, with their feete and pinnes and cordes. Al the veſſel and implementes they shal receiue by account, and ſo shal carie them.
label: Numbers

text: This is the office of the familie of the Merarites, and their miniſterie in the tabernacle of couenant: and they shal be vnder the hand of Ithamar the ſonne of Aaron the prieſt.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore and Aaron and the princes of the ſynagogue reckened the ſonnes of Caath, by their kinredes and houſes of their fathers,
label: Numbers

text: from thirtie yeares and vpward, vnto the fiftith yeare, al that enter in to the miniſterie of the tabernacle of couenant:
label: Numbers

text: and they were found two thouſand ſeuen hnndred fiftie.
label: Numbers

text: This is the number of the people of Caath that enter into the tabernacle of couenant: theſe did Moyſes and Aaron number according to the word of our Lord by the hand of Moyſes.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Gerſon alſo were numbered by the kinredes and houſes of their fathers,
label: Numbers

text: from thirtie yeares and vpward, vnto the fiftith yeare, al that enter in to miniſter in the tabernacle of couenant:
label: Numbers

text: and they were found two thouſand ſix hundred thirtie.
label: Numbers

text: This is the people of the Gerſonites, whom Moyſes and Aaron numbered according to the word of our Lord.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Merari alſo were numbered by the kinredes and houſes of their fathers,
label: Numbers

text: from thirtie yeares and vpward, vnto the fiftith yeare, al that enter in to accomplish the rites of the tabernacle of couenant:
label: Numbers

text: and they were found three thouſand two hundred.
label: Numbers

text: this is the number of the ſonnes of Merari, whom Moyſes, and Aaron reckened according to the commandment of our Lord by the hand of Moyſes.
label: Numbers

text: Al that were reckened of the Leuites, and whom Moyſes and Aaron and the princes of Iſrael tooke by name, by the kinredes and houſes of their fathers,
label: Numbers

text: from thirtie yeares and vpward, vnto the fiftith yeare, entring in to the miniſterie of the tabernacle, and to carie the burdens,
label: Numbers

text: were in al eight thouſand fiue hundred eightie.
label: Numbers

text: According to the word of our Lord did Moyſes recken them, euerie one according to their office and burdens, as our Lord had commanded him.
label: Numbers

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Command the children of Iſrael, that they caſt out of the campe euerie leper, and whoſoeuer hath a fluxe of ſeede, and is polluted vpon the dead:
label: Numbers

text: as wel man as woman caſt yee out of the campe, leſt when they shal dwel with you, they contaminate it.
label: Numbers

text: And the children of Iſrael did ſo, and they did caſt them forth without the campe, as our Lord had ſpoken to Moyſes.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael: man, or woman, when they shal do any of al the ſinnes, that are wont to chance to men, and by negligence haue tranſgreſſed the commandement of the Lord, and haue offended,
label: Numbers

text: they shal confeſſe their ſinne, and reſtore the principal it ſelf, and the fifth part ouer to him, againſt whom they ſinned.
label: Numbers

text: But if there be none to receiue it, they shal geue it to the Lord, and it shal be the prieſtes, the ramme excepted, that is offered for expiation, to be a placable hoſte.
label: Numbers

text: Al the firſt fruites alſo, which the children of Iſrael doe offer, pertaine to the prieſt:
label: Numbers

text: and whatſoeuer is offered into the Sanctuarie of euerie one, and is deliuered to the handes of the prieſt, it shal be his.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: The man, whoſe wife erreth, and contemning her husband
label: Numbers

text: hath ſlept with an other man, and her husband could not find it, but the adulterie is ſecrete, and can not be proued by witneſſes, becauſe ſhe was not found in the adulterous fact:
label: Numbers

text: if the ſpirit of ielouſie ſtirre vp the husband againſt his wife, which either is polluted, or is charged with falſe ſuſpition,
label: Numbers

text: he shal bring her to the prieſt, and shal offer an oblation for her the tenth part of a ſatum of barley meale: he shal not powre oile theron, nor put frankincenſe vpon it: becauſe it is a ſacrifice of ielouſie, and an oblation ſearching out adulterie.
label: Numbers

text: The prieſt therfore shal offer it, and ſet it before the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: And he shal take holie water in an earthen veſſel, and he shal caſt a little grauel of the pauement of the tabernacle into it.
label: Numbers

text: And when the woman shal ſtand in the ſight of the Lord, he shal vncouer her head, and shal put vpon her handes the ſacrifice of recordation, and the oblation of ielouſie: and him ſelfe shal hold the moſt bitter waters, wheron he heaped curſes with execration.
label: Numbers

text: and he shal adiure her, and shal ſay: If an other man hath not ſlept with thee, and if thou be not polluted by forſaking thy husbandes bedde, theſe moſt bitter waters shal not hurt thee, wherupon I haue heaped curſes.
label: Numbers

text: But if thou haſt declined from thy husband, & art polluted, and haſt lien with an other man:
label: Numbers

text: thou shalt be ſubiect to theſe maledictions: Our Lord geue thee for a malediction, and an example of al among his people: make he thy thigh to rotte, and bellie ſwelling burſt aſunder.
label: Numbers

text: the curſed water enter into thy bellie, and thy wombe being ſwolne let thy thigh rotte. And the woman shal anſwer, Amen, amen.
label: Numbers

text: And the prieſt shal write theſe curſes in a booke, and shal wash them out with the moſt bitter waters, wherupon he heaped the curſes,
label: Numbers

text: and he shal geue them her to drinke. Which when she hath drunke vp,
label: Numbers

text: the prieſt shal take of her hand the ſacrifice of ielouſie, and shal eleuate it before the Lord, and shal put it vpon the altar: yet ſo notwithſtanding that firſt,
label: Numbers

text: he take a handful of the ſacrifice of that, which is offered, & burne it vpon the altar: and ſo geue the moſt bitter waters to the woman to drinke.
label: Numbers

text: Which when she hath drunke, if she be polluted, and by contempt of her husband guiltie of adulterie, the waters of malediction shal goe through her, and her bellie being puft vp her thigh shal totte withal: and the woman shal be for a malediction, and an example to al the people.
label: Numbers

text: But if she be not polluted, she shal be blameleſſe, and shal beare children.
label: Numbers

text: This is the law of ielouſie. If the woman decline from her husband, and if she be polluted,
label: Numbers

text: and the huſband ſtirred with the ſpirit of ielouſie brought her in the ſight of the Lord, and the prieſt haue done to her according to al thinges that are written:
label: Numbers

text: the huſband shal be without fault, and she shal beare her iniquitie.
label: Numbers

text: AND our Lord ſpake vnto Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and thou shal ſay to them: Man, or woman, when they shal make a vow to be ſanctified, and wil conſecrate them ſelues to the Lord:
label: Numbers

text: they shal abſteine from wine, & euerie thing, that can make one drunke, vineger of wine, and of any other potion, and whatſoeuer is preſſed out of the grape, they shal not drinke: new grapes and drie they shal not eate
label: Numbers

text: al the daies wherin they are by vow cōſecrated to the Lord: whatſoeuer may be of the vineyard, from the reiſen to the kernel they shal not eate.
label: Numbers

text: Al the time of his ſeparation a raſour shal not paſſe ouer his head vntil the day be expired, that he is conſecrated to the Lord. He shal be holie, whiles the bush of haire on his head doth grow.
label: Numbers

text: Al the time of his conſecration he shal not enter in to the dead,
label: Numbers

text: neither shal he be contaminated no not on his fathers and mothers and brothers and ſiſters corps, becauſe the conſecration of his God is vpon his head.
label: Numbers

text: Al the daies of his ſeparation he shal be holie to the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: But if anie man die ſodenly before him, the head of his conſecration shal be polluted: which he shal shaue forthwith in the ſame day of his purgation, and againe the ſeuenth day.
label: Numbers

text: and in the eight day he shal bring two turtles, or two young pigeons to the prieſt in the entrie of the couenant of teſtimonie.
label: Numbers

text: and the prieſt shal offer one for ſinne, and the other for an holocauſt, and shal pray for him, becauſe he hath ſinned by occaſion of the dead: and he shal ſanctifie his head that day:
label: Numbers

text: and shal conſecrate to the Lord the daies of his ſeparation, offering a lambe of a yeare old for ſinne: yet ſo that the former daies be made fruſtrate, becauſe his ſanctification was polluted.
label: Numbers

text: This is the law of conſecration. When the daies, that by vow he had determined, shal be expired: he shal bring him to the doore of the tabernacle of couenant,
label: Numbers

text: and shal offer his oblation to the Lord, a male lambe of a yeare old without ſpotte for an holocauſt, and an ewe lambe of a yeare old without ſpotte for ſinne, and a ramme without ſpotte, for a pacifique hoſte,

label: Numbers

text: But the ramme he shal immolate for a pacifique hoſte to the Lord, offering withal the baskette of azymes, and the libamentes that by cuſtome are dew.

text: Then shal the Nazareite be shauen before the dore of the tabernacle of couenant, from the bush of the haire of his conſecration: and he shal take his haires, and lay them vpon the fire, that is put vnder the ſacrifice of pacifiques.
label: Numbers

text: And a shoulder of the ramme boyled, and one cake without leuen out of the baskette, and one wafer vnleuened, and he shal deliuer them into the handes of the Nazareite, after that his head be shauen.

text: And receiuing them againe from him, he shal eleuate them in the ſight of the Lord: and being ſanctified they shal be the prieſtes, as the breaſt, which was commanded to be ſeparated, and the shoulder. after theſe thinges the Nazareite may drinke wine.

text: And when Moyſes entred into the tabernacle of couenant, to conſult the oracle, he heard the voice of him that ſpake to him from the propitiatorie, that was ouer the arke betwen the two Cherubs, from whence alſo he ſpake to him.

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Take the Leuites out of the middes of the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt purifie them,

text: according to this rite: Let them be ſprinkled with the water of luſtration, & shaue al the haires of their flesh. And when they haue washed their garmentes, and are cleanſed,
label: Numbers

text: they shal take an oxe out of the heardes, and his libament flowre tempered with oyle: and an other oxe out of the heard thou shalt take for ſinne:

text: And thou shalt ſette the Leuites in the ſight of Aaron and of his ſonnes, and being offered shal conſecrate them to the Lord,

text: And afterward they shal enter into the tabernacle of couenant, to ſerue me. And thou shalt ſo purifie and conſecrate them for an oblation of the Lord: becauſe they were geuen me for a gift of the children of Iſrael.

text: For the firſt borne that open euerie matrice in Iſrael, I haue taken them.

text: For mine are al the firſt borne of the children of Iſrael, as wel of men as of beaſtes. From the day that I ſmote euerie firſt borne in the Land of Ægypt, haue I ſanctified them to me:

text: and I haue taken the Leuites for al the firſt borne of the children of Iſrael:

text: and haue deliuered them for a gift to Aaron and his ſonnes out of the middes of the people, to ſerue me for Iſrael in the tabernacle of couenant, and to pray for them that there be no plague among the people, if they should preſume to approch vnto my Sanctuarie.

label: Numbers

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael: The man that shal be vncleane vpon a ſoule, or in his iourney farre of in your nation, let him make the Phaſe to the Lord
label: Numbers

text: in the ſecond moneth, the fourtenth day of the moneth at euen: with azymes and wilde lettiſe shal they eate it:
label: Numbers

text: they shal not leaue anie thing therof vntil morning, and a bone therof they shal not breake, al the rite of the Phaſe they shal obſerue.
label: Numbers

text: but if anie man both be cleane, and was not in his iourney, and yet did not make the Phaſe, that ſoule shal be deſtroyed out from among his peoples, becauſe he offered not ſacrifice to the Lord in his dew time: he shal beare his ſinne.
label: Numbers

text: The ſeiourner alſo and ſtranger if they be with you, shal make the Phaſe to the Lord, according to the ceremonies and iuſtifications therof. The ſelfe ſame precept shal be among you aſwel to the ſtranger, as to him that is borne in the countrie.
label: Numbers

text: Therfore the day that the tabernacle was erected, a cloude couered it. And from euening ouer the tabernacle there was as it were the likeneſſe of fire vntil morning.
label: Numbers

text: So was it done alwaies: by day the cloude couered it, and by night as it were the likeneſſe of fire.
label: Numbers

text: And when the cloude that protected the tabernacle, had bene taken away, then the children of Iſrael marched: and in the place where the cloude had ſtoode, there they camped.
label: Numbers

text: At the commandment of our Lord they marched, and at his commandment they pitched the tabernacle. Al the daies that the cloude ſtoode ouer the tabernacle, they remained in the ſame place:
label: Numbers

text: and if it chanced that it did continew ouer it a long time, the children of Iſrael were in the watches of our Lord, and marched not
label: Numbers

text: for as manie daies ſoeuer as the cloude had bene ouer the tabernacle. At the commandment of our Lord they pitched their tentes, and at his commandement they tooke them downe.
label: Numbers

text: If the cloude had bene from euen vntil morning, and immediatly at day breake had forſaken the tabernacle, they marched: and if it had departed after a day and a night, they tooke downe their tentes.
label: Numbers

text: But if for two daies or one moneth or a longer time it had bene ouer the tabernacle, the children of Iſrael remained in the ſame place, and marched not: but immediatly as it had departed, they remoued the campe.
label: Numbers

text: By the word of the Lord they pitched their tentes, and by his word they marched: and were in the watches of our Lord according to his commandment by the hand of Moyſes.
label: Numbers

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Make thee two trumpettes of beaten ſiluer, wherwith thou maieſt cal togeather the multitude when the campe is to be remoued,
label: Numbers

text: And when thou shalt ſound with the trumpettes, al the multitude shal gather vnto thee to the doore of the tabernacle of couenant.
label: Numbers

text: If thou ſound but once, the princes ſhal come to thee, and the heades of the multitude of Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: But if the trumpeting ſound in length and with a broken tune, they shal moue their campe firſt that are on the eaſt ſide.
label: Numbers

text: And at the ſecond ſound and the like noyſe of the trumpet, they shal take vp their tentes that dwel toward the ſouth. and after this maner shal the reſt doe, when the trumpettes shal ſound to the marching.
label: Numbers

text: But when the people is to be gathered together, the ſound of the trumpet shal be plaine, and they shal not make a broken ſound.
label: Numbers

text: And the ſonnes of Aaron the prieſtes shal ſound with the trumpettes: and this shal be an ordinance for euer in your generations.
label: Numbers

text: If you goe forth to warre out of your land againſt the enimies that fight againſt you, you shal ſound with trumpettes in length, and there shal be a remembrance of you before the Lord your God, that you may be deliuered out of the handes of your enemies.
label: Numbers

text: If at anie time you shal haue a banket, and feſtiual daies, and Calendes, you shal ſound with trumpettes ouer the holocauſtes, and pacifique victimes, that they may be vnto you for a remembrance of your God. I the Lord your God.
label: Numbers

text: The ſecond yeare, in the ſecond moneth, the twentith day of the moneth was the cloude lifted vp from the tabernacle of couenant.
label: Numbers

text: and the children of Iſrael marched by their troupes from the deſert of Sinai, and the cloud reſted in the wilderneſſe of Pharan.
label: Numbers

text: And the firſt moued their campe according to the cōmandement of our Lord by the hand of Moyſes.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Iudas by their troupes: whoſe prince was Nahaſſon the ſonne of Aminadab.
label: Numbers

text: In the tribe of the ſonnes of Iſſachar, the prince was Nathanael the ſonne of Suar.
label: Numbers

text: In the tribe of Zabulon, the prince was Eliab the ſonne of Helon.
label: Numbers

text: And the tabernacle was taken downe, which the ſonnes of Gerſon and Merari carying, marched.
label: Numbers

text: And the ſonnes of Ruben alſo marched, by their troupes and order, whoſe prince was Heliſur the ſonne of Sedeur.
label: Numbers

text: And in the tribe of Simeon, the prince was Salamiel the ſonne of Suriſaddai.
label: Numbers

text: Moreouer in the tribe of Gad, the prince was Eliaſaph the ſonne of Duel.
label: Numbers

text: And the Caathites alſo marched carying the Sanctuarie. So long was the tabernacle caried, til they came to the place of erecting it.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Ephraim alſo moued their campe by their troupes, in whoſe hoſte the prince was Eliſama the ſonne of Ammiud.
label: Numbers

text: And in the tribe of the ſonnes of Manaſſes, the prince was Gamaliel the ſonne of Phadaſſur.
label: Numbers

text: And in the tribe of Beniamin the prince was Abidan the ſonne of Gedeon.
label: Numbers

text: The laſt of al the campe marched the ſonnes of Dan by their troupes, in whoſe hoſte the prince was Ahiezer the ſonne of Ammiſaddai.
label: Numbers

text: And in the tribe of the ſonnes of Aſer, the prince was Phegiel the ſonne of Ochran.
label: Numbers

text: And in the tribe of the ſonnes of Nephthali the prince was Ahira the ſonne of Enan.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are the campes, and the marchinges of the children of Iſrael by their troupes when they marched
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes ſaid to Hobab the ſonne of Raguel the Madianite, his allied: We march toward the place, which our Lord wil geue vs: come with vs, that we may do thee good: for our Lord hath promiſed good thinges to Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: To whom he anſwered: I wil not goe with thee, but I wil returne to my countrie, wherein I was borne.
label: Numbers

text: And he ſaid: Doe not forſake vs: for thou knoweſt in what places through the deſert we may campe, and thou shalt be our guide.
label: Numbers

text: And when thou comeſt with vs, whatſoeuer shal be beſt of the riches, which our Lord shal deliuer vs, we wil geue thee.
label: Numbers

text: They marched therfore from the Mount of our Lord three daies iourney, and the arke of the couenant of out Lord went before them, for three daies prouiding a place for the campe.
label: Numbers

text: The cloude alſo of our Lord was ouer them by day when they marched.
label: Numbers

text: And when the arke was lifted vp, Moyſes ſaid: Ariſe Lord, and be thyne enemies diſperſed, and let them flee that hate thee, from thy face.
label: Numbers

text: And when it was ſette downe, he ſaid: Returne Lord to the multitude of the hoſte of Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: IN the meane time there aroſe a murmuring of the people, as it were repyning for labour, againſt our Lord. Which when our Lord had heard, he was angrie. And the fire of our Lord being kinled againſt them, deuoured the vttermoſt part of the campe.
label: Numbers

text: And when the people had cried to Moyſes, Moyſes prayed to our Lord, and the fire was quenched.
label: Numbers

text: And he called the name of that place, Kindling: for that the fire of our Lord had bene kindled againſt them.
label: Numbers

text: For the common vulgar people, that came vp with them, burned with deſire, ſitting and weeping, the children of Iſrael being ioyned together with them, and ſaid: Who shal geue vs flesh to eate?
label: Numbers

text: We remember the fishes that we did eate in Ægypt gratis: the cucumbers come vnto our minde, and the melons, and leekes and onions and garlike.
label: Numbers

text: Our ſoule is drie, our eies behold nothing els but Manna.
label: Numbers

text: And the Manna was as it were the ſeede of Coriander, of the colour of bdellion.
label: Numbers

text: And the people went about, & gathering it, grounde it in a milne, or braied it in a morter, boyling it in a potte, and making cakes therof of the taiſt as it were of oyled bread.
label: Numbers

text: And when the dew fel in the night vpon the campe, the Manna alſo fel withal.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore heard the people weeping by their families, euerie one at the doores of his tent. And the furie of our Lord was exceding wrath: but to Moyſes alſo it ſemed an intolerable thing.
label: Numbers

text: and he ſaid to our Lord: Why haſt thou afflicted thy ſeruant? wherfore do I not finde grace before thee? and why haſt thou laid the weight of al this people vpon me?
label: Numbers

text: Haue I conceaued al this multitude, or begotten them, that thou shouldeſt ſay to me: Carie them in thy boſome as the nource is wont to carie the litle infant, and beare them into the land, for the which thou haſt ſworne to their fathers?
label: Numbers

text: Whence shal I haue flesh to geue to ſo great a multitude? they whine againſt me, ſaying: Geue vs flesh that we may eate.
label: Numbers

text: I alone can not ſuſtaine al this people, becauſe it is heauie for me.
label: Numbers

text: But if it ſeme vnto thee otherwiſe, I beſeche thee to kil me, and let me finde grace in thine eies, that I be not moleſted with ſo great euils.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Gather me ſeuentie men of the ancientes of Iſrael, whom thou knoweſt. to be the ancientes of the people and maiſters: and thou shalt bring them to the doore of the tabernacle of couenant, and shalt make them to ſtand there with thee,
label: Numbers

text: that I may deſcend and ſpeake to thee: and I wil take of thy ſpirit, and wil deliuer to them, that they may ſuſtaine with thee, the burden of the people, and thou onlie be not burdened.
label: Numbers

text: To the people alſo thou shalt ſay: Be ſanctified: to morrow you ſhal eate flesh? for I haue heard you ſay: Who shal geue vs meates of flesh? it was wel with vs in Ægypt. That the Lord may geue you flesh, and you may eate:
label: Numbers

text: not one day, nor two, or fiue or ten, no nor twentie,
label: Numbers

text: but euen to a moneth of daies, til it goe out a your noſethrils, and be turned to lothſomenes, becauſe you haue reiected the Lord, who is in the middes of you, and haue whyned before him, ſaying: Wherfore came we out of Ægypt?
label: Numbers
