text: And Moyſes ſaid: There are ſix hundred thouſand footemen of this people, & ſayeſt thou: I wil geue them flesh to eate a whole moneth?
label: Numbers

text: Why, shal a multitude of ſheepe and oxen be killed, that it may ſuffiſe for meate? or shal al the fishes of the ſea be gathered togeather, for to fil them?
label: Numbers

text: To whom our Lord anſwered: Why, is the hand of the Lord vnable? Now preſently thou shalt ſee whether my word shal be accomplished in deede.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore came, and told the people the wordes of our Lord, aſſembling ſeuentie men of the ancientes of Iſrael, whom he cauſed to ſtand about the tabernacle.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord deſcended in a cloude, and ſpake to him, taking away of the ſpirit that was in Moyſes, and geuing to the ſeuentie men. And when the ſpirit had reſted on them, they prophecied, neither ceaſed they any more.
label: Numbers

text: And there had remained in the campe two men, of the which one was called Eldad, and the other Medad, vpon whom the ſpirit reſted. for they alſo had bene enrolled, and were not gone forth to the tabernacle.
label: Numbers

text: And when they prophecied in the campe, there ran a boy, and told Moyſes, ſaying: Eldad and Medad do prophecie in the campe.
label: Numbers

text: Forthwith Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, the miniſter of Moyſes, and choſen of manie, ſaid: My Lord Moyſes forbid them.
label: Numbers

text: But he ſaid: Why haſt thou emulation for me? O that al the people might prophecie, and that our Lord would geue them his ſpirit?
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes returned, and the ancientes of Iſrael into the campe.
label: Numbers

text: And a winde coming forth from our Lord, taking quailes ouer the ſea brought them, and let them fal into the campe the ſpace of one daies iourney, on euerie ſide of the campe round about, and they did flie in the ayre two cubites high ouer the earth.
label: Numbers

text: The people therfore riſing vp al that day, and the night, and the next day, gathered togeather a multitude of quailes, he that did leaſt, ten cores: and they dried them round about the campe.
label: Numbers

text: As yet the flesh was in their teeth, neither had that kind of meate failed: and behold the furie of our Lord being prouoked againſt the people, ſtroke them with an exceding great plague.
label: Numbers

text: And that place was called, The Sepulchres of concupiſcence: for there they buried the people that had luſted. And departing from the Sepulchres of concupiſcence, they came vnto Haſeroth, and taried there.
label: Numbers

text: AND Marie and Aaron ſpake againſt Moyſes, for his wife the Æthiopian,
label: Numbers

text: and they ſaid: hath our Lord ſpoken by Moyſes onlie? hath he not ſpoken to vs alſo in like manner? Which when our Lord had heard,
label: Numbers

text: ( For Moyſes was the mildeſt man aboue al men, that dwelt vpon the earth)
label: Numbers

text: immediatly he ſpake to him, and to Aaron and Marie: Goe forth you three onlie to the tabernacle of couenant. And when they were come forth,
label: Numbers

text: our Lord deſcended in the piller of a cloude, and ſtoode in the entrie of the tabernacle calling Aaron and Marie. Who going vnto him,
label: Numbers

text: he ſaid to them: Heare my wordes: If there shal be among you a prophete of the Lord, in viſion wil I appeare to him, or in ſleepe I wil ſpeake ho him.
label: Numbers

text: But my ſeruant Moyſes is not ſuch an one, who in al my houſe is moſt faythful:
label: Numbers

text: for mouth to mouth I ſpeake to him: and plainely, and not by riddels and figures doth he ſee the Lord. Why therfore did you not feare to detract from my ſeruant Moyſes?
label: Numbers

text: And being wrath againſt them, he went away:
label: Numbers

text: the cloude alſo departed that was ouer the tabernacle: and behold Marie appeared white with leproſie as it were ſnow. And when Aaron had looked on her, and ſaw her wholy couered with leproſie,
label: Numbers

text: he ſaid to Moyſes: I beſech thee my Lord, lay not vpon vs this ſinne which we haue foolishly committed,
label: Numbers

text: let not this woman be as it were dead, and as an abortiue that is caſt forth of the mothers wombe. Lo now the one halfe of her flesh is deuoured with the leproſie.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes cried to our Lord, ſaying: God, I beſech thee, heale her.
label: Numbers

text: To whom our Lord anſwered: If her father had ſpitte vpon her face, ought she not to haue bene ashamed ſeuen daies at the leaſt? Let her be ſeparated ſeuen daies without the campe, and afterwards she shal be called againe.
label: Numbers

text: Marie therfore was shut forth without the campe ſeuen daies: and the people moued not from that place, vntil Marie was called againe.
label: Numbers

text: AND the people marched from Haſeroth pitching their tentes in the deſert of Pharan.
label: Numbers

text: And there our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying;
label: Numbers

text: Send men, that may view the Land of Chanaan, which I wil geue to the children of Iſrael, one of euerie tribe, of the princes.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes did that which our Lord had commanded, from the deſert of Pharan ſending principal men, whoſe names be theſe.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Ruben, Samua the ſonne of Zechur.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Simeon, Saphat the ſonne of Huri.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Iuda, Caleb the ſonne of Iephone.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Iſſachar, Igal the ſonne of Ioſeph.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oſee the ſonne of Nun.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Beniamin, Phalti the ſonne of Raphu.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Zabulon, Geddiel the ſonne of Sodi.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Ioſeph, of the ſcepter of Manaſſes Gaddi, the ſonne of Suſi.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the ſonne of Gemalli.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Aſer, Sthur the ſonne of Michael.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Nephthali, Nahabi the ſonne of Vapſi.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Gad, Guel the ſonne of Machi.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are the names of the men, whom moyſes ſent to view the Land: and he called Oſee the ſonne of Nun, Ioſue.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore ſent them to view the Land of Chanaan, and ſaid to them: Goe vp by the ſouth ſide. And when you shal come to the mountaines,
label: Numbers

text: view the Land, what it is: and the people that are the inhabitantes therof, whether they be ſtrong or weake: few in number or manie:
label: Numbers

text: the land it ſelf, whether it be good or badde: what manner of cities, walled or without walles:
label: Numbers

text: the ground, fatte or barren, wooddie or without trees. Be of good courage, and bring vs of the fruites of the Land. And it was the time when now the firſt ripe grapes are to be eaten.
label: Numbers

text: And when they were gone vp, they viewed the Land from the deſert of Sin, vnto Rohob as you enter to Emath.
label: Numbers

text: And they went vp at the ſouth ſide, and came to Hebron, where were Achiman and Siſai and Tholmai the ſonnes of Enac. for Hebron was built ſeuen yeares before Tanis the citie of Ægypt.
label: Numbers

text: And going forward as farre as the Torrent of cluſter, they cutte of a branch with the grapes therof, which two men carried vpon a leauer. They tooke of the pomegranates alſo and of the figges of that place:
label: Numbers

text: which was called Neheleſcol, that is to ſay, the Torrent of cluſter, for that thence the children of Iſrael had caried a cluſter.
label: Numbers

text: And the diſcouerers of the Land returning after fourtie daies, hauing circuted al the countrie,
label: Numbers

text: came to Moyſes & Aaron and to al the aſſemblie of the children of Iſrael into the deſert of Pharan, which is in Cades. And ſpeaking to them & to al the multitude they shewed the fruites of the Land:
label: Numbers

text: and reported, ſaying: We came into the Land to which thou didſt ſend vs, which in very deede floweth with milke and honie, as by theſe fruites may be knowen:
label: Numbers

text: but it hath very ſtrong inhabitantes, and cities great and walled. The ſtocke of Enac we ſaw there.
label: Numbers

text: Amalec dwelleth in the ſouth, the Hetheite and the Iebuſeite and the Amorrheite in the mountaines: but the Chananeite abideth beſide the ſea and about the ſtreames of Iordan.
label: Numbers

text: Among theſe thinges Caleb appeaſing the murmuring of the people that roſe againſt Moyſes, ſaid: Let vs goe vp and poſſeſſe the Land, becauſe we may obtaine it.
label: Numbers

text: But the others, that had bene with him, ſaid: No, we are not able to goe vp to this people, becauſe it is ſtronger then we.
label: Numbers

text: And they detracted from the Land, which they had viewed, before the children of Iſrael, ſaying: The Land, which we haue viewed, deuoureth her inhabitantes: the people, that we beheld, is of a tall ſtature.
label: Numbers

text: There we ſaw certaine monſters of the ſonnes of Enac, of the gyantes kind: to whom being compared, we ſeemed as it were locuſtes.
label: Numbers

text: THERFORE al the multitude crying out wept that night,
label: Numbers

text: and al the children of Iſrael murmured againſt Moyſes and Aaron, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Would God we had died in Ægypt: and in this vaſte wilderneſſe would God we might die, and that our Lord would not bring vs into this Land, leſt we fal by the ſword, and our wiues and children be ledde captiue. Is it not better to returne into Ægypt?
label: Numbers

text: And one ſaid to an other: Let vs appoint a captaine, and let vs returne into Ægypt.
label: Numbers

text: Which Moyſes and Aaron hearing fel flatte vpon the ground before al the multitude of the children of Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: But Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, and Caleb the ſonne of Iephone, who them ſelues alſo had viewed the land, rent their garmentes,
label: Numbers

text: and ſpake to al the multitude of the children of Iſrael: The Land, which we haue circuted, is very good.
label: Numbers

text: If our Lord be propitious, he ſhal bring vs into it, and deliuer vs a ground flowing with milke and honie.
label: Numbers

text: Be not rebellious againſt our Lord: neither feare ye the people of this land, for euen as bread ſo we may deuoure them. al aide is gone from them: our Lord is with vs, feare ye not.
label: Numbers

text: And when al the multitude cried, and would haue ſtoned them, the glorie of our Lord appeared ouer the roofe of couenant in the ſight of al the children of Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: How long wil this people detract me? How long wil they not beleue me in al the ſignes, that I haue done before them?
label: Numbers

text: I wil ſtrike them therfore with peſtilence, and wil conſume them: but thee I wil make prince ouer a great nation, and a ſtronger then this is.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes ſaid to our Lord: That the Ægyptians, from the middes of whom thou haſt brought forth this people,
label: Numbers

text: and the inhabitantes of this Land, which haue heard that thou Lord art among this people, and art ſene face to face, and thy cloude protecteth them, and in a piller of a cloude thou goeſt before them by day, and in a piller of fire by night:)
label: Numbers

text: may heare that thou haſt killed ſo great a multitude as it were one man, and may ſay:
label: Numbers

text: He could not bring in the people into the Land, for which he had ſworne: therfore did he kil them in the wilderneſſe.
label: Numbers

text: Let therfore the ſtrength of our Lord be magnified as thou haſt ſworne, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: The Lord is patient and ful of mercie, taking away iniquitie and wicked deedes, & leauing no man innocent, which viſiteſt the ſinnes of the fathers vpon the children vnto the third and fourth generation.
label: Numbers

text: Forgeue, I beſech thee, the ſinne of this thy people, according to the greatnes of thy mercie, as thou haſt bene propitious to them ſince their going out of Ægypt vnto this place.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid: I haue forgeuen it according to thy word.
label: Numbers

text: Liue I: and the whole earth shal be replenished with the glorie of the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: But yet al the men that haue ſene my maieſtie, and the ſignes that I haue done in Ægypt, and in the wilderneſſe, and haue tempred me now ten times, neither haue obeied my voice,
label: Numbers

text: they shal not ſee the Land for the which I ſware to their fathers, neither shal any of them that hath detracted me, behold it.
label: Numbers

text: My ſeruant Caleb, who being ful of an other ſpirit hath folowed me, wil I bring in vnto this Land which he hath circuted: and his ſeede shal poſſeſſe it.
label: Numbers

text: Becauſe the Amalecite and the Cananeite dwel in the valleis. To morrow remoue the campe, and returne into the wilderneſſe by the way of the Redde ſea.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes and Aaron, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: How long doth this vngratious multitude murmur againſt me? I haue heard the complaintes of the children of Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: Say therfore to them: liue I, ſayeth our Lord: According as you haue ſpoken I hearing it, ſo wil I do to you.
label: Numbers

text: In this wilderneſſe shal your carcaſſes lie. Al you that are numbered from twentie yeares & vpward, and haue murmured againſt me,
label: Numbers

text: you shal not enter into the Land, ouer the which I haue lifted vp my hand to make you inhabite it, except Caleb the ſonne of Iephone, and Ioſue the ſonne of Nun.
label: Numbers

text: But your litle ones, of whom you ſaid, that they should be a pray to the enemies, wil I bring in: that they may ſee the Land, that hath miſliked you.
label: Numbers

text: Your carcaſſes shal lie in the wilderneſſe.
label: Numbers

text: Your children shal wander in the deſert fourtie yeares, and shal beare your fornication, vntil the carcaſſes of their fathers be conſumed in the deſert,
label: Numbers

text: according to the number of the fourtie daies, wherein you viewed the Land: a yeare shal be reputed for a day. And fourtie yeares you shal receiue your iniquities, and shal know my reuenge:
label: Numbers

text: for as I haue ſpoken, ſo wil I doe to al this wicked multitude, that hath riſen togeather againſt me: in this wilderneſſe shal it faile, and die.
label: Numbers

text: Therfore al the men, whom Moyſes had ſent to view the Land, and which returning had made al the multitude to murmur againſt him, detracting from the Land that it was naught,
label: Numbers

text: died and were ſtroken in the ſight of our Lord.
label: Numbers

text: But Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, and Caleb the ſonne of Iephone liued of al them, that had gone to view the Land.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes ſpake al theſe wordes to al the children of Iſrael, and the people mourned excedingly.
label: Numbers

text: And behold very early in the morning riſing they went vp to the toppe of the mountaine, and ſaid: We are readie to goe vp to the place, wherof our Lord hath ſpoken: for we haue ſinned.
label: Numbers

text: To whom Moyſes ſaid: Why tranſgreſſe you the word of our Lord, which shal not ſuceede proſperouſely with you?
label: Numbers

text: Goe not vp, for our Lord is not with you: leſt you fal before your enemies.
label: Numbers

text: The Amalecite and the Chananeite are before you, by whoſe ſword you shal fal, for that you would not conſent to our Lord, neither wil our Lord be with you.
label: Numbers

text: But they being blinded went vp to the toppe of the mountaine. But the arke of the teſtament of our Lord & Moyſes departed not from the campe.
label: Numbers

text: And the Amalecite came downe and the Cananeite, that dwelt in the mountaine: and ſtriking and hewing them, purſewed them as farre as Horma.
label: Numbers

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: When you shal be entred into the Land of your habitation, which I wil geue you,
label: Numbers

text: and shal make oblation to the Lord for an holocauſt, or victime, paying vowes, or voluntarily offering giftes, or in your ſolemnities burning a ſweete ſauour vnto the Lord, of oxen or of sheepe:
label: Numbers

text: whoſoeuer immolateth the victime, shal offer a ſacrifice of flowre, the tenth part of an ephi tempered with oyle, which shal haue in meaſure the fourth part of an hin:
label: Numbers

text: and wine of the ſame meaſure to powre the libamentes shal he geue for the holocauſt or for the victime. For euerie lambe
label: Numbers

text: and ramme there shal be a ſacrifice of flowre of two tenthes, which shal be tempered with oile the third part of an hin:
label: Numbers

text: and wine for the libamente, the third part of the ſame meaſure, shal he offer for a ſweete ſauour to the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: But when thou makeſt an holocauſt or hoſte of oxen, to fulfil thy vow or for pacifique victimes,
label: Numbers

text: thou shalt geue for euerie oxe three tenthes of flowre tempered with oile, which shal haue halfe the meaſure of a hin:
label: Numbers

text: and wine to powre libamentes of the ſame meaſure for an oblation of moſt ſweete ſauour to the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: So shalt thou doe
label: Numbers

text: for euerie oxe and ramme and lambe and buckegoate.
label: Numbers

text: As wel they that are borne in the countrie as the ſtrangers
label: Numbers

text: after one rite shal offer ſacrifices.
label: Numbers

text: There shal be al one precept and iudgement as wel to your ſelues as to the ſtrangers of the land.
label: Numbers

text: Our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them:
label: Numbers

text: When you are come into the land, which I wil geue you,
label: Numbers

text: and shal eate of the breades of that countrie, you shal ſeparate firſt fruites to the Lord
label: Numbers

text: of your meates. As of your barne floores you ſeparate firſt fruites,
label: Numbers

text: ſo of your paſtes shal you geue firſt fruites to the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: And if through ignorance you omitte any of theſe thinges, which the Lord hath ſpoken to Moyſes,
label: Numbers

text: and by him hath commanded you, from the day that he beganne to command and ſo forward,
label: Numbers

text: and the multitude haue forgotten to do it: they shal offer a calfe out of the heard, an holocauſte for a moſt ſweete ſauour to the Lord, and the ſacrifice and libamentes therof, as the ceremonies require, and a buckegoate for ſinne:
label: Numbers

text: and the prieſt shal pray for al the multitude of the children of Iſrael: and it shal be forgeuen them, becauſe they ſinned not wittingly, offering notwithſtanding burnt ſacrifice to the Lord for them ſelues and for their ſinne and errour:
label: Numbers

text: and it shal be forgeuen al the people of the children of Iſrael, and the ſtrangers, that ſeiourne among them: becauſe it is the fault of al the people through ignorance.
label: Numbers

text: But if one ſoule shal ſinne vnwitting, he shal offer a she goate of a yeare old for his ſinne:
label: Numbers

text: and the prieſt shal pray for him, becauſe he ſinned vnwitting before the Lord: and he shal obteine him pardon, and it shal be forgeuen him.
label: Numbers

text: As wel to them that are borne in the countrie as to the ſtrangers one law shal be for al, that ſinne by ignorance.
label: Numbers

text: But the ſoule, that through pride committeth any thing, whether he be borne in the countrie, or a ſtranger, (becauſe he hath bene rebellious againſt the Lord) shal perish out of his people:
label: Numbers

text: for he hath contemned the word of the Lord, and made his precept of no effect: therfore shal he be deſtroyed, and shal beare his iniquitie.
label: Numbers

text: And it came to paſſe, when the children of Iſrael were in the wilderneſſe, and had found a man gathering ſtickes on the Sabbath day,
label: Numbers

text: they preſented him to Moyſes and Aaron and the whole multitude.
label: Numbers

text: Who shut him into priſon, not knowing what they should doe with him.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes, dying let this man die, let al the multitude ſtone him without the campe.
label: Numbers

text: And when they had brought him out, they ſtoned him, and he died as our Lord had commanded.
label: Numbers

text: Our Lord alſo ſaid to moyſes:
label: Numbers

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them, that they make them ſelues fringes in the corners of their garmentes, putting in them ribandes of hyacinth:
label: Numbers

text: which when they shal ſee, they may remẽber al the commandements of the Lord, and not folow their owne cogitations and eies fornicating after diuers thinges,
label: Numbers

text: but rather mindful of the preceptes of the Lord may do them, and be holie to their God.
label: Numbers

text: I the Lord your God, that brought you out of the Land of Ægypt, that I might be your God.
label: Numbers

text: AND behold Core the ſonne of Iſaar, the ſonne of Caath, the ſonne of Leui, and Dathan and Abiron the ſonnes of Eliab, Hon alſo the ſonne of Pheleth of the children of Ruben,
label: Numbers

text: roſe againſt Moyſes, and other of the children of Iſrael two hundred fiftie men, princes of the ſynagogue, and which in the time of aſſemblie were called by name.
label: Numbers

text: And when they had ſtoode vp againſt Moyſes and Aaron, they ſaid: Let it ſuffice you, that al the multitude conſiſteth of holie ones, and our Lord is among them: Why lift you vp your ſelues aboue the people of our Lord?
label: Numbers

text: Which when Moyſes had heard, he fel flatte on his face:
label: Numbers

text: and ſpeaking to Core and al the multitude, he ſaid: In the morning our Lord wil make it knowne who pertaine to him, and the holie the wil ioyne to him ſelfe: and whom he shal chooſe, they shal approch to him.
label: Numbers

text: This do therfore: Take euerie man their cenſars, thou Core, and al thy councel:
label: Numbers

text: and taking fire in them to morrow, put vpon it incenſe before our Lord: and whom ſoeuer he shal chooſe, the ſame shal be holie: you do much exalt your ſelues ye ſonnes of Leui.
label: Numbers

text: And he ſaid againe to Core: Heare ye ſonnes of Leui,
label: Numbers

text: Is it a ſmal thing vnto you, that the God of Iſrael hath ſeparated you from al the people, and ioyned you to him ſelfe, that you should ſerue him in the ſeruice of the tabernacle, and should ſtand before the ful aſſemblie of the people, and should miniſter to him?
label: Numbers

text: did he therfore make thee and al thy brethren the ſonnes of Leui to approch vnto him, that you should chalenge vnto you the prieſthood alſo,
label: Numbers

text: and al thy companie should ſtand againſt our Lord? for what is Aaron that you murmur againſt him?
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore ſent to cal Dathan and Abiron the ſonnes of Eliab. Who anſwered: We come not.
label: Numbers

text: Why, is it a ſmal matter to thee that thou haſt brought vs out of a land, that folowed with milke and honie, to kil vs in the deſert, vnles thou rule alſo like a lord ouer vs?
label: Numbers

text: In deede haſt thou brought vs into a land, that floweth with riuers of milke and honie, & haſt thou geuen vs poſſeſſions of fieldes & vineyardes? What, wilt thou plucke out our eies alſo? We come not.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore being very wrath, ſaid to our Lord: Reſpect not their ſacrifices: thou knoweſt that I haue not taken of them ſo much as a little aſſe at anie time, neither haue afflicted anie of them.
label: Numbers

text: And he ſaid to Core: Thou, and al thy congregation ſtand ye apart before our Lord, and Aaron to morrow apart.
label: Numbers

text: Take euerie one your cenſars, and put incenſe vpon them, offering to our Lord two hundred fiftie cenſars: Let Aaron alſo hold his cenſar.
label: Numbers

text: Which when they had done, Moyſes and Aaron ſtanding,
label: Numbers

text: and had heaped together al the multitude againſt them to the dore of the tabernacle, the glorie of our Lord appeared to them al.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpeaking to Moyſes and Aaron, ſaid:
label: Numbers

text: Separate your ſelues from the middes of this congregation, that I may ſodenly deſtroy them.
label: Numbers

text: Who fel flatte on their face, and ſaid: Moſt mightie God of the ſpirites of al flesh, when one ſinneth, shal thy wrath rage againſt al?
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes:
label: Numbers

text: Command the whole people that they ſeparate them ſelues from the tabernacles of Core and Dathan and Abiron.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes aroſe, and went to Dathan and Abiron: and the ancientes of Iſrael folowing him,
label: Numbers

text: he ſaid to the multitude: Depart from the tabernacles of the impious men, and touch not the thinges that pertaine to them, leſt you be wrapped in their ſinnes.
label: Numbers

text: And when they were departed from their tentes round about, Dathan and Abiron coming forth ſtood in the entrie of their pauilions with their wiues and children, and al the multitude.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes ſaid: In this you shal know that our Lord hath ſent me to do al thinges that you ſee, and that I haue not forged them of my owne mind:
label: Numbers

text: If they die the accuſtomed death of men, and if the plague, wherwith others alſo are wont to be viſited, do viſite them, our Lord did not ſend me:
label: Numbers

text: but if our Lord do a new thing, that the earth opening her mouth ſwallow them downe, & al thinges that pertaine to them, and they deſcend quicke into hel, you shal know that they haue blaſphemed our Lord.
label: Numbers

text: Immediatly therfore as he ceaſed to ſpeake, the earth brake inſunder vnder their feete:
label: Numbers

text: and opening her mouth, deuoured them with their tabernacles & al their ſubſtance.
label: Numbers

text: and they went downe into hel quicke couered with the ground, and perished out of the middes of the multitude.
label: Numbers

text: But al Iſrael, that ſtoode round about, fled at the crie of them that perished, ſaying: Leſt perhappes the earth ſwallow vs alſo.
label: Numbers

text: But a fire alſo coming forth from our Lord, ſlew the two hundred fiftie men, that offered the incenſe.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Command Elezar the ſonne of Aaron the prieſt that he take vp the cenſars that lie in the burning fire, and that he ſprinkle the fire hither and thither: becauſe they be ſanctified
label: Numbers

text: in the deathes of the ſinners: and let him beate them into plates, and faſten them to the altar, becauſe there hath bene offered incenſe in them to the Lord, and they are ſanctified, that the children of Iſrael may ſee them for a ſigne and a monument.
label: Numbers

text: Eleazar therfore the prieſt tooke the braſen cenſars, wherin they had offered, whom the burning fire deuoured, and bette them into plates, faſtening them to the altar:
label: Numbers

text: that the children of Iſrael afterward might haue, wherwith to be admonished, that no ſtranger approch, and he that is not of the ſeede of Aaron, to offer incenſe to our Lord, leſt he ſuffer as Core hath ſuffered, and al his congregation, according as our Lord ſpake to Moyſes.
label: Numbers

text: And al the multitude of the children of Iſrael murmured the day folowing againſt Moyſes and Aaron, ſaying: You haue killed the people of our Lord.
label: Numbers

text: And when there roſe a ſedition, and the tumult grew farder,
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes and Aaron fled to the tabernacle of couenant.. Which after they were entred the cloude couered it, and the glorie of our Lord appeared.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes:
label: Numbers

text: Depart from the middes of this multitude, euen now wil I deſtroy them. And as they lay vpon the ground,
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes ſaid to Aaron: Take the cenſar, and drawing fire from the altar, put incenſe vpon it, going quickly to the people to pray for them: for euen now is the wrath come forth from our Lord, and the plague rageth.
label: Numbers

text: Which when Aaron had done, and had runne to the middes of the multitude, which now the burning fire did waſte, he offered the incenſe:
label: Numbers

text: and ſtanding betwen the deade and the liuing, he prayed for the people, and the plague ceaſed.
label: Numbers

text: And there were, that were ſtrooken, fourtene thouſand and ſeuen hundred men, beſide them that had perished in the ſedition of Core.
label: Numbers

text: And Aaron returned to Moyſes vnto the doore of the tabernacle of couenant after that the deſtruction was ceaſed.
label: Numbers

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and take a rodde of euerie one of their kinredes, of al the princes of their tribes, twelue roddes, and the name of euerie one thou shalt write vpon his rodde.
label: Numbers

text: and the name of Aaron shal be in the tribe of Leui, and one rodde shal conteine al their families:
label: Numbers

text: and thou shalt lay them in the tabernacle of couenant before the teſtimonie, where I wil ſpeake to thee.
label: Numbers

text: Whomſoeuer of theſe I shal chooſe, his rodde shal bloſſome: and I shal ſtay from me the grudginges of the children of Iſrael, wherwith they murmur againſt you.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes ſpake to the children of Iſrael: and al the princes gaue him roddes by euerie tribe: and they were twelue roddes beſides Aarons rodde.
label: Numbers

text: Which when Moyſes had laid before our Lord in the tabernacle of teſtimonie:
label: Numbers

text: returning the day folowing he found that Aarons rodde in the houſe of Leui was budded: and the buddes therof ſwelling, the bloſſomes were shotte forth, which ſpredding the leaues, were fashioned into almondes.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore brought forth al the roddes from the ſight of our Lord to al the children of Iſrael: and they ſaw and euerie one receiued their roddes.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Carie backe Aarons rodde into the tabernacle of teſtimonie, that it may be kept there for a ſigne of the rebellious children of Iſrael, and let their complaintes ceaſe from me, leſt they die.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes did as our Lord had commanded.
label: Numbers

text: And the children of Iſrael ſaid to Moyſes: Behold we are conſumed, we are al perished.
label: Numbers

text: Whoſoeuer approcheth to the tabernacle of our Lord, he dieth. Are we al to be deſtroyed vnto vtter conſumption?
label: Numbers

text: AND our Lord ſaid to Aaron: Thou, and thy ſonnes, and the houſe of thy father with thee shal beare the iniquitie of the Sanctuarie: both thou & thy ſonnes together shal beare the ſinnes of your prieſthood.
label: Numbers

text: but thy brethren alſo of the tribe of Leui, and the ſcepter of thy father take with thee, and let them be readie at hand, and miniſter to thee: but thou and thy ſonnes shal miniſter in the tabernacle of teſtimonie.
label: Numbers

text: And the Leuites shal watch vpon thy preceptes, and vpon al the workes of the tabernacle: ſo notwithſtanding, that they approch not to the veſſel of the Sanctuarie and to the altar, leſt both they die, and you perish withal.
label: Numbers

text: but let them be with thee, and watch in the cuſtodies of the tabernacle, and in al the ceremonies therof. A ſtranger shal not ioyne with you.
label: Numbers

text: Watch in the cuſtodie of the Sanctuarie, and in the miniſterie of the altar: leſt indignation riſe vpon the children of Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: I haue geuen you your brethren the Leuites out of the middes of the children of Iſrael, and haue deliuered them a gifte to the Lord, to ſerue in the miniſteries of his tabernacle.
label: Numbers

text: And thou and thy ſonnes looke to your prieſthood: and al thinges that perteyne to the ſeruice of the altar, and that are within the vele, shal be executed by the prieſtes. if anie ſtranger approch, he ſhal be ſlaine.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Aaron, behold I haue geuen thee the cuſtodie of my firſt fruites. Al thinges that are ſanctified of the children of Iſrael, haue I deliuered to thee and to thy ſonnes for the prieſtlie office, as euerlaſting ordinances.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe thinges therfore shalt thou take of thoſe, that are ſanctified, and are offered to the Lord. Al oblation, and ſacrifice, and whatſoeuer is rendred to me for ſinne and offence, & becometh Holie of holies, shal be thine, and thy ſonnes.
label: Numbers

text: In the Sanctuarie shalt thou eate it: males onlie shal eate therof, becauſe it is to thee a cōſecrated thing.
label: Numbers

text: But the firſt fruites, which the children of Iſrael shal vow and offer, I haue geuen thee, and thy ſonnes, and thy daughters for a perpetual right. he that is cleane in thy houſe, shal eate them.
label: Numbers

text: Al the beſt of oile, and wine, and corne, whatſoeuer firſt fruites they offer to the Lord, I haue geuen them to thee.
label: Numbers

text: Of fruites al the firſt, that the ground bringeth forth, and are brought to the Lord, shal turne to thy vſes: he that is cleane in thy houſe, shal eate them.
label: Numbers

text: Euerie thing that the children of Iſrael render by vow, shal be thine.
label: Numbers

text: Whatſoeuer firſt breaketh forth from the matrice of al flesh, which they offer to the Lord, whether it be of men, or of beaſtes, shal be thy right: yet ſo, that for the firſt borne of man thou take a price, and euerie beaſt that is vncleane thou cauſe to be redemed,
label: Numbers

text: whoſe redemption shal be after one moneth, for fiue ſicles of ſiluer, by the weight of the Sanctuarie. A ſicle hath twentie oboles.
label: Numbers

text: But the firſt borne of beefe and ſheepe and goate thou shalt not cauſe to be redemed, becauſe they are ſanctified to the Lord. onlie the bloud of them thou shalt powre vpon the altar, and the fatte thou shalt burne for a moſt ſweete odour to the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: But the flesh shal turne to thy vſe, as the conſecrated breſt, and the right shoulder, shal be thine.
label: Numbers

text: Al the firſt fruites of the Sanctuarie which the children of Iſrael offer to the Lord, haue I geuen thee and thy ſonnes, and daughters for a perpetual right. A couenant of ſalt is it for euer before the Lord, to thee and to thy ſonnes.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Aaron: In their land you shal poſſeſſe nothing, neither shal you haue a portion among them: I am thy portion and inheritance in the middes of the children of Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: And to the ſonnes of Leui I haue geuen al the tithes of Iſrael in poſſeſſion for the miniſterie wherwith they ſerue me in the tabernacle of couenant:
label: Numbers

text: that the children of Iſrael approch not any more to the tabernacle, nor committe deadlie ſinne,
label: Numbers

text: onlie the ſonnes of Leui ſeruing me in the tabernacle, and bearing the ſinnes of the people. it shal be an euerlaſting ordinance in your generations. No other thing shal they poſſeſſe,
label: Numbers

text: being content with the oblation of tithes, which I haue ſeparated for their vſes and neceſſaries.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Command the Leuites, and denounce vnto them: When you shal receiue of the children of Iſrael the tithes, which I haue geuen you, offer firſt fruites of them to the Lord, that is to ſay, the tenth part of the tenth:
label: Numbers

text: that it may be reputed to you for an oblation of fitſt fruites, as wel of the barne floores as of the preſſes,
label: Numbers

text: and of al thinges wherof you receiue tithes, the firſt fruites offer to the Lord, and geue them to Aaron the prieſt.
label: Numbers

text: Al thinges that you shal offer of the tithes, and shal ſeparate for the giftes of the Lord, they shal be the beſt and choſen thinges.
label: Numbers

text: And thou shalt ſay to them: If you offer al the goodlie and the better thinges of the tithes, it shal be reputed to you as if you had geuen firſt fruites of the barne floore and the preſſe:
label: Numbers

text: and you shal eate them in al your places, as wel you as your families: becauſe it is the reward for the miniſterie, wherwith you ſerue in the tabernacle of teſtimonie.
label: Numbers

text: And you shal not ſinne in this point, reſeruing the principal and fatte thinges to your ſelues leſt you pollute the oblations of the children of Iſrael, and die.
label: Numbers

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes and Aaron, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: This is the religion of the victime, which the Lord hath appointed. Command the children of Iſraael, that they bring vnto thee a redde cow of ful age, wherin is no blemish, and that hath not caried yoke:
label: Numbers

text: and you shal deliuer her to Eleazar the prieſt. who bringing her forth without the campe, shal immolate her in the ſight of al:
label: Numbers

text: and dipping his finger in her bloud, shal ſprinkle it againſt the doores of the tabernacle ſeuen times,
label: Numbers

text: and shal burne her in the ſight of al, committing aſwel her skinne and the flesh as the bloud, and the dong to the fire.
label: Numbers

text: Wood alſo of the cedar, and hyſſope, and ſcarlet twiſe died shal the prieſt caſt into the flame, that waſteth the cow.
label: Numbers

text: And then at length washing his garmentes, and his bodie, he shal enter into the campe, and shal be polluted vntil euen.
label: Numbers

text: But he alſo that burneth her, shal wash his garmentes and his bodie, and shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Numbers

text: And a man that is cleane shal gather the ashes of the cow, and shal powre them out without the campe in a moſt cleane place, that they may be reſerued for the multitude of the children of Iſrael, and for water of aſperſion: becauſe the cowe was burnt for ſinne.
label: Numbers

text: And when he that caried the ashes of the cow, hath washed his garmentes, he shal be vncleane vntil euen. The children of Iſrael, and the ſtrangers that dwel among them, shal haue this for a holie thing by a perpetual ordinance.
label: Numbers

text: He that toucheth the dead corps of a man, and is vncleane therfore ſeuen daies:
label: Numbers

text: shal be ſprinkled of this water the third day, and the ſeuenth, and ſo shal be cleanſed. If he were not ſprinkled, the third day the ſeuenth day he can not be clenſed.
label: Numbers

text: Euerie one that toucheth the dead corps of mans ſoule, and is not ſprinkled with this commiſtion, shal pollute the tabernacle of the Lord, and shal perish out of Iſrael: becauſe he was not ſprinkled with the water of expiation, he shal be vncleane, and his filthineſſe shal remaine vpon him.
label: Numbers

text: This is the law of the man that dieth in a tabernacle: Al that enter into his tent, and al the veſſel that are there, shal be polluted ſeuen daies.
label: Numbers

text: The veſſel, that hath no couer, nor bynding ouer it, shal be vncleane.
label: Numbers

text: If any man in the field touch the corps of a man that was ſlaine, or that died of himſelf, or his bone, or graue, he shal be vncleane ſeuen daies.
label: Numbers

text: And they shal take of the ashes of combuſtion and of ſinne, and shal powre liuing water vpon them into a veſſel:
label: Numbers

text: in the which when a man that is cleane hath dipped hyſſope, he shal ſprinkle therwith al the tent, and al the implementes, and the men polluted with ſuch contagion:
label: Numbers

text: and in this maner he that is cleane shal purge the vncleane the third and ſeuenth day. And being expiated the ſenenth day, he shal wash both himſelf and his garmentes, and be vncleane vntil euening.
label: Numbers

text: If anie man be not expiated after this rite, his ſoule shal perish out of the middes of the Church: becauſe he hath polluted the Lordes Sanctuarie, and is not ſprinkled with water of luſtration.
label: Numbers

text: This precept shal be an ordinance for euer. He alſo that ſprinkleth the waters, shal wash his garmentes: euerie one that toucheth the waters of expiation, shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Numbers

text: Whatſoeuer he toucheth that is vncleane, he shal make it vncleane: and the ſoule, that toucheth anie of theſe thinges, shal be vncleane vntil euen.
label: Numbers

text: AND the children of Iſrael, and al the multitude came into the deſert Sin, the firſt moneth: and the people abode in Cades. And Marie died there, and was buried in the ſame place.
label: Numbers

text: And when the people lacked water, they came together againſt Moyſes and Aaron:
label: Numbers

text: and being turned into ſedition, ſaid: Would God we had perished among our brethren before our Lord.
label: Numbers

text: Why haue you brought forth the Church of our Lord into the wilderneſſe, that both we and our cattel ſhould die?
label: Numbers

text: Why did you make vs aſcend out of Ægypt, and haue brought vs into this exceding naughtie place which can not be ſowed, which bringeth forth neither figge, nor vines, nor pomegranates, moreouer alſo hath no water for to drinke?
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes and Aaron, the multitude being diſmiſſed, entring into the tabernacle of couenant, fel flatte vpon the ground, and cried to our Lord, and ſaid: Lord God heare the crie of this people, and open vnto them thy treaſure the fountaine of liuing water, that being ſatisfied, their murmuring may ceaſe. And the glorie of our Lord appeared ouer them.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Take the rodde, and aſſemble the people together, thou and Aaron thy brother, and ſpeake to the rocke before them, and it shal geue waters. And when thou haſt brought forth water out of the rocke, al the multitude shal drinke and their cattel.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore tooke the rodde, which was in the ſight of our Lord, as he commanded him,
label: Numbers

text: the multitude being aſſembled before the rocke, and he ſaid to them: Heare ye rebellious and incredulous: Can we out of this rocke bring you forth water?
label: Numbers

text: And when Moyſes had lifted vp his hand ſtricking the rocke, twiſe with the rodde, there came forth great plentie of water, ſo that the people drunke and theit cattel.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes and Aaron: Becauſe you haue not beleued me, to ſanctifie me before the children of Iſrael, you shal not bring in theſe peoples into the land, which I wil geue them.
label: Numbers

text: This is the water of contradiction, where the children of Iſrael quarelled againſt our Lord, and he was ſanctified in them.
label: Numbers

text: In the meane time Moyſes ſent meſſengers from Cades to the King of Edom, which should ſay: Thus thy brother Iſrael biddeth vs to ſay: Thou knoweſt al the labour, that hath taken vs,
label: Numbers

text: in what maner our fathers went downe into Ægypt, and there we dwelt a great time, and the Ægyptians afflicted vs, and our fathers:
label: Numbers

text: and in what maner we cried to our Lord, and he heard vs, and ſent an Angel, that hath brought vs out of Ægypt. Loe being preſently in the citie of Cades, which is in thy vttermoſt borders,
label: Numbers

text: we beſech thee that we may haue licence to paſſe through thy countrie. We wil not goe through the fieldes, nor through the vineyardes, we wil not drinke the waters of thy welles, but we wil goe the common high way, declining neither to the right hand, nor to the left, til we be paſt thy borders.
label: Numbers

text: To whom Edom anſwered: Thou shalt not paſſe by me, otherwiſe I wil come armed againſt thee.
label: Numbers

text: And the children of Iſrael ſaid: We wil goe by the beaten way: and if we and the cattel drinke thy waters, we wil geue thee that which is iuſt: there shal be no difficultie in the price, only let vs paſſe ſpeedely.
label: Numbers

text: But he anſwered: Thou shalt not paſſe: And immediatly he came forth to meete them with an infinitie multitude, and a ſtrong hand,
label: Numbers

text: neither would he condeſcend to them deſiring to grant them paſſage through his borders. For the which cauſe Iſrael turned an other way from him.
label: Numbers

text: And when they had remoued the campe from Cades, they came into the mountaine Hor, which is in the borders of the land of Edom:
label: Numbers

text: Where our Lord ſpake to Moyſes:
label: Numbers

text: Let Aaron, ſayeth he, goe to his people: for he shal not enter to the Land, which I haue geuen the children of Iſrael, for that he was incredulous to my mouth, at the Waters of contradiction.
label: Numbers

text: Take Aaron and his ſonne with him, and thou shalt bring them into the mountaine Hor.
label: Numbers

text: And when thou haſt vnueſted the father of his veſture, thou shalt reueſt therewith Eleazar his ſonne: Aaron shal be gathered, and die there.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes did as our Lord had commanded: and they went vp into the mountaine Hor before al the multitude.
label: Numbers

text: And when he had ſpoyled Aaron of his veſtimentes, he reueſted Eleazar his ſonne with them.
label: Numbers

text: After that he was dead in the toppe of the mountaine, he went downe with Eleazar.
label: Numbers

text: And al the multitude ſeeing that Aaron was dead, mourned vpon him thirtie daies throughout al their families.
label: Numbers

text: VVHICH when the Chananeite king of Arad, who dwelt toward the ſouth, had heard, to wit, that Iſrael was come by the way of the ſpies, he fought againſt them, and being victour, he tooke the pray of them.
label: Numbers

text: But Iſrael binding himſelf, by vow to our Lord, ſaid: If thou wilt deliuer this people into my hand, I wil deſtroy their cities.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord heard the prayers of Iſrael, and deliuered the Chananeite, whom they ſlew ouerthrowing their cities: and they called the name of that place Horma, that is to ſay, Anathema.
label: Numbers

text: And they marched alſo from the mountaine Hor, by the way that leadeth to the Redde ſea, that they might compaſſe the land of Edom. And the people began to be wearie of the iourney and labour:
label: Numbers

text: and ſpeaking againſt God and Moyſes, they ſaid: Why didſt thou bring vs out of Ægypt, to die in the wilderneſſe? There wanteth bread, waters there are none: our ſoule now lotheth at this moſt light meate.
label: Numbers

text: Wherfore our Lord ſent vpon the people firie ſerpentes, at whoſe plagues and the deathes of verie manie,
label: Numbers

text: they came to Moyſes, and ſaid: We haue ſinned, becauſe we haue ſpoken againſt our Lord and thee: Pray that he take from vs the ſerpentes. And Moyſes prayed for the people,
label: Numbers

text: and our Lord ſpake to him: Make a braſen ſerpent, and ſette it for a ſigne: he that being ſtriken looketh on it, shal liue.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore made A BRASEN SERPENT, and ſet it for a ſigne: whom when they that were ſtriken, looked on, they were healed.
label: Numbers

text: And the children of Iſrael marching camped in Oboth.
label: Numbers

text: Whence departing they pitched their tentes in Ieabarim, in the wilderneſſe, that looketh toward Moab againſt the eaſt part.
label: Numbers

text: And remouing from thence, they came to the Torrent Zared.
label: Numbers

text: Which they forſaking camped againſt Arnon, which is in the deſert, & ſtandeth out in the borders of the Amorrheite. For Arnon is the border of Moab, diuiding the Moabites & the Amorrheites.
label: Numbers

text: Wherof it is ſaid in the booke of the warres of our Lord: As he did in the Redde ſea, ſo wil he doe in the ſtreames of Arnon.
label: Numbers

text: The rockes of the torrentes were bowed, that they might reſt in Ar, and lie in the borders of the Moabites.
label: Numbers

text: From that place appeared the wel, wherof our Lord ſpake to Moyſes: Gather the people together, and I wil geue them water.
label: Numbers

text: Then Iſrael ſang this verſe: Ariſe the wel. They ſang therto:
label: Numbers

text: The wel, which the princes digged, and the captaines of the multitude prepared in the lawgeuer, and in their ſtaues. And they marched from the wilderneſſe to Mathana.
label: Numbers

text: From Mathana vnto Nahaliel: from Nahaliel vnto Bamoth.
label: Numbers

text: From Bamoth is a valley in the countrie of Moab, in the toppe of Phaſga, which looketh toward the deſert.
label: Numbers

text: And Iſrael ſent meſſengers to Sehon king of the Amorrheites, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: I beſech thee that I may haue licence to paſſe through thy land: we wil not goe aſide into the fieldes and the vineyardes, we wil not drinke waters of the welles, we wil goe the kinges high way, til we be paſt thy borders.
label: Numbers

text: Who would not grant that Iſrael ſhould paſſe by his borders: but rather gathering an armie, went forth to meete them in the deſert, and came vnto Iaſa, and fought againſt them.
label: Numbers

text: Of whom he was ſtrooken in the edge of the ſword, and his land was poſſeſſed ftom Arnon vnto Ieboc, and to the children of Ammon: for the borders of the Ammonites were kept with a ſtrong garriſon.
label: Numbers

text: Iſrael therfore tooke al his cities, and dwelt in the cities of the Amorrheite, to wit, in Heſebon, and the villages therof.
label: Numbers

text: The citie Heſebon was Sehons the king of the Amorrheite, who fought againſt the king of Moab: and tooke al the land, that had bene of his dominion, as farre as Arnon.
label: Numbers

text: Therfore it is ſaid in the prouerbe: Come into Heſebon, let the citie of Sehon be built and erected:
label: Numbers

text: A fire went forth from Heſebon, a flame from the towne of Sehon, and deuoured Ar of the Moabites, and the inhabitantes of the high places of Arnon.
label: Numbers

text: Wo to thee Moab, thou art vndone people of Chamos. He hath geuen his ſonnes into flight, and his daughters into captiuitie to Sehon the King of the Amorrheites.
label: Numbers

text: Their yoke is perished from Heſebon vnto Dibon, they came wearie into Nophe, and vnto Medaba.
label: Numbers

text: Iſrael therfore dwelt in the Land of the Amorrheite.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes ſent ſome to take a view of Iazer: Whoſe villages they tooke, and poſſeſſed the inhabitantes.
label: Numbers

text: And they turned them ſelues, and went vp by the way of Baſan, and Og the King of Baſan came againſt them with al his people, to fight iu Edrai.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Feare him not, for into thy hand I haue deliuered him, and al his people, and land: and thou shalt doe to him as thou didſt to Sehon the King of the Amorrheites, the inhabiter of Heſebon.
label: Numbers

text: They therfore ſmote him alſo With his ſonnes, and al his people vnto vtter deſtruction, and they poſſeſſed his land.
label: Numbers

text: AND marching forward they camped in the champion countrie of Moab, where Iericho is ſituated beyond Iordan.
label: Numbers

text: And Balac the ſonne of Sephor ſeeing al thinges that Iſrael had done to the Amorrheite,
label: Numbers

text: and that the Moabites were in greate feare of him, and could not ſuſteyne his aſſault,
label: Numbers

text: he ſaid to the eidets of Madian: So wil this people deſtroy al that dwel in our coaſtes, as the oxe is wont to eate the graſſe vnto the verie rootes. And he was at the ſame time King in Moab.
label: Numbers

text: He ſent therfote meſſengers to Balaam the ſonne of Behor a Southſayer, who dwelt vpon the riuer of the land of the children of Ammon, to cal him, and to ſay: Behold a people is come out of Ægypt, that hath couered the face of the earth, ſitting againſt me.
label: Numbers

text: Come therfore, and curſe this people, becauſe it is mightier then I: if by any meanes I may ſtrike them and caſt them out of my land. for I know that he is bleſſed whom thou shalt bleſſe, and curſed vpon whom thou ſhalt heape curſes.
label: Numbers

text: And the ancientes of Moab went, and the elders of Madian, hauing the price of diuination in their handes. And when they were come to Balaam, and had told him al the wordes of Balac:
label: Numbers

text: he anſwered: Tarie here this night, and I wil anſwer whatſoeuer the Lord shal ſay to me. And whiles they ſtayed with Balaam, God came, and ſaid to him:
label: Numbers

text: What would theſe men that are with thee?
label: Numbers

text: He anſwered: Balac the ſonne of Sephor king of the Moabites hath ſent to me,
label: Numbers

text: ſaying: Behold a people that is come out of Ægypt, hath couered the face of the land: come, and curſe them, if by any meanes fighting I may driue them away.
label: Numbers

text: And God ſaid to Balaam: Goe not with them, neither doe thou curſe the people: becauſe it is bleſſed.
label: Numbers

text: Who in the morning ariſing ſaid to the princes: Goe into your countrie, becauſe the Lord hath forbid me to come with you.
label: Numbers

text: The princes returning, ſaid to Balac: Balaam would not come with vs.
label: Numbers

text: Againe he ſent many moe and more noble, then he had ſent before.
label: Numbers

text: Who when they were come to Balaam, ſaid: Thus ſayeth Balac the ſonne of Sephor: Slacke not to come to me:
label: Numbers

text: for I am readie to honour thee, and whatſoeuer thou wilt I wil geue thee: Come, and curſe this people.
label: Numbers

text: Balaam anſwered: If Balac would geue me his houſe ful of ſiluer and gold, I can not change the word of the Lord my God, to ſpeake either more, or leſſe.
label: Numbers

text: I beſech you that you wil alſo tarie here this night, and I may know what the Lord wil anſwer me once more.
label: Numbers

text: God therfore came to Balaam in the night, and ſaid to him: If theſe men be come to cal thee, ariſe and goe with them: yet ſo, that thou doe that which I shal command thee.
label: Numbers

text: Balaam aroſe in the morning, and ſadling his aſſe went with them.
label: Numbers

text: And God was angrie. And an Angel of our Lord ſtoode in the way againſt Balaam, who ſate vpon the aſſe, and had two ſeruantes with him.
label: Numbers

text: The aſſe ſeeing the Angel ſtanding in the way, with a drawen ſword, turned her ſelf out of the way, and went by the field. Whom when Balaam had bette, and had brought her againe to the beaten way,
label: Numbers

text: the Angel ſtoode in the ſtreicttes of two walles, wherwith vineyardes were incloſed.
label: Numbers

text: Whom the aſſe ſeeing, ioyned her ſelfe cloſe to the wal, and bruſed the foote of him that ridde. But he beate her againe:
label: Numbers

text: and neuertheleſſe the Angel paſſing to a narrow place, where there could be no going a ſide neither to the right hand nor to the left, ſtoode to meete him.
label: Numbers

text: And when the aſſe had ſeene the Angel ſtanding, she fel vnder the feete of the rider. Who being angrie, bette her ſides with a ſtaffe more vehemently.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord opened the mouth of the aſſe, and she ſpake: What haue I done to thee? why ſtrikeſt thou me? loe now the third time?
label: Numbers

text: Balaam anſwered: Becauſe thou haſt deſerued, and haſt abuſed me: I would I had a ſword, that I might kil thee.
label: Numbers

text: The aſſe ſaid: Am not I thy beaſt, on which thou haſt beene alwayes accuſtomed to ride vntil this preſent day? tel me what like thing did I euer to thee. But he ſaid: Neuer.
label: Numbers

text: Forthwith our Lord opened the eies of Balaam, and he ſaw the Angel ſtanding in the way with a drawen ſword, and he adored him flatte to the ground.
label: Numbers

text: To whom the Angel ſaid: Why beateſt thou thy aſſe the third time? I am come to withſtand thee, becauſe thy way is peruerſe, and contrarie to me:
label: Numbers

text: and vnleſſe the aſſe had turned out of the way, geuing place to me reſiſting thee, I had ſlaine thee, and she should haue liued.
label: Numbers

text: Balaam ſaid: I haue ſinned, not knowing that thou didſt ſtand againſt me: and now if it diſpleaſe thee that I goe, I wil returne.
label: Numbers

text: The Angel ſaid: Goe with theſe men, and ſee thou ſpeake no other thing then I shal command thee. He went therfore with the princes.
label: Numbers

text: Which when Balac heard, he came forth to meete him in a towne of the Moabites, that is ſituated in the vttermoſt borders of Arnon.
label: Numbers

text: And he ſaid to Balaam: I ſent meſſengers to cal thee, why didſt thou not come immediatly vnto me? was it becauſe I can not reward thy coming?
label: Numbers

text: To whom he anſwered: Loe here I am: Shal I be able to ſpeake any other thing, but that which God shal put in my mouth?
label: Numbers

text: They therfore went on together, and came into a citie, that was in the vttermoſt borders of his kingdome.
label: Numbers

text: And when Balac had killed oxen, & sheepe, he ſent therof to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him, preſentes.
label: Numbers

text: And when morning was come, he brought him to the excelſes of Baal, and he beheld the vttermoſt part of the people.
label: Numbers

text: AND Balaam ſaid to Balac: Build me here ſeuen altares, and prepare as manie calues, and rammes of the ſame number.
label: Numbers

text: And when he had done according to the word of Balaam, they together laid a calfe and a ramme vpon an altar.
label: Numbers

text: And Balaam ſaid to Balac: Stand a while beſide thy holocauſte, vntil I goe, if happely the Lord wil meete me, and whatſoeuer he shal command, I wil ſpeake to thee.
label: Numbers

text: And when he was gone in haſt, God mette him. And Balaam ſpeaking to him, ſaid: I haue erected ſeuen altares, and haue laid thereon a calfe and a ramme.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord put a word in his mouth, and ſaid: Retutne to Balac, and thus shalt thou ſpeake.
label: Numbers

text: Returning he found Balac ſtanding beſide his holocauſte, and al the princes of the Moabites:
label: Numbers

text: and taking vp his parable, he ſaid: From Aram hath Balac King of the Moabites brought me, from the mountaines of the Eaſt: Come, quoth he, and curſe Iacob: make haſt, and deteſt Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: How shal I curſe, whom God hath not curſed? By what meanes may I deteſt, whom the Lord deteſteth not?
label: Numbers

text: From the higheſt flintes shal I ſee him, and from the hilles shal I view him. The people shal dwel alone, and among the Gentiles shal not be accounted.
label: Numbers

text: Who may be able to number the duſt of Iacob, and to know the number of the ſtocke of Iſrael? My ſoule die the death of the iuſt, and my laſt endes be made like to them.
label: Numbers

text: And Balac ſaid to Balaam: What is this that thou doeſt? That thou shouldeſt curſe mine enemies I called thee: and thou contrariewiſe bleſſeſt them.
label: Numbers

text: To whom he anſwered: Can I ſpeake ought els, but that which the Lord commandeth?
label: Numbers

text: Balac therfore ſaid: Come with me into an other place, whence thou mayeſt ſee part of Iſrael, and canſt not ſee the whole, from thence curſe them.
label: Numbers

text: And when he had brought him into a high place, vpon the toppe of the mountaine Phaſga, Balaam builded ſeuen altares, & laying thereon calues and rammes,
label: Numbers

text: he ſaid to Balac: Stand here beſide thy holocauſt, whiles I goe to meete him.
label: Numbers

text: Whom when our Lord had mette, and had put the word in his mouth, he ſaid: Returne to Balac and thus thou shalt ſpeake to him.
label: Numbers

text: Returning he found him ſtanding beſide his holocauſte, and the princes of the Moabites with him. To whom Balac ſaid: What hath the Lord ſpoken?
label: Numbers

text: But he taking vp his parable, ſaid: Stand Balac, and harken, heare thou ſonne of Sephor:
label: Numbers

text: God is not as man, that he may lie, nor as the ſonne of man, that he may be changed. Hath he ſaid then, and wil he not doe? hath he ſpoken, and wil he not fulfil?
label: Numbers

text: I was brought to bleſſe, the bleſſing I am not able to ſtay.
label: Numbers

text: There is no Idol in Iacob, neither is there ſimulachre to be ſeene in Iſrael. The Lord his God is with him, and the ſound of the victorie of the king in him.
label: Numbers

text: God hath brought him out of Ægypt, whoſe ſtrength is like to the vnicorne.
label: Numbers

text: There is no Southſaying in Iacob, nor diuination in Iſrael. In their times it shal be ſaid to Iacob and Iſrael what God hath wrought.
label: Numbers

text: Behold the people shal riſe vp as a lioneſſe, and as a lion shal raiſe it ſelf: It shal not lie downe til it deuoure the pray, and drinke the bloud of the ſlaine.
label: Numbers

text: And Balac ſaid to Balaam: neither curſe, nor bleſſe him.
label: Numbers

text: And he ſaid: Did I not tel thee, that whatſoeuer God should command me, that would I doe?
label: Numbers

text: And Balac ſaid to him: Come, and I wil bring thee to an other place: if happely it pleaſe God that thence thou mayeſt curſe them.
label: Numbers

text: And when he had brought him vpon the toppe of the mountaine Phogor, which looketh to the wilderneſſe,
label: Numbers

text: Balaam ſaid to him: Build me here ſeuen altares, and prepare as manie calues, and rammes of the ſame number.
label: Numbers

text: Balac did as Balaam had ſaid: and he laide the calues and the rammes on euerie altar.
label: Numbers

text: AND when Balaam had ſeene that it pleaſed our Lord that he should bleſſe Iſrael, he went not as before he had gone, to ſeeke Southſaying: but directing his countenance againſt the deſert,
label: Numbers

text: and lifting vp his eies, he ſaw Iſrael abiding in their tentes by their tribes: and the ſpirit of God coming vehemently vpon him,
label: Numbers

text: taking vp his parable he ſaid: Balaam the ſonne of Beor hath ſaid: The man hath ſaid: whoſe eye is ſtopped:
label: Numbers

text: The hearer of the wordes of God hath ſaid, he that hath beholden the viſion of the Omnipotent, he that falleth, and ſo his eies are opened:
label: Numbers

text: How beautiful are thy tabernacles ô Iacob, and thy tentes ô Iſrael!
label: Numbers

text: As wooddie valleis, as watered gardens beſide the riuers, as tabernacles which the Lord hath pitched, as cedres by the waters ſide.
label: Numbers

text: Water shal flow out of his bucket, and his ſeede shal be into manie waters. For Agag shal his king be taken away, and his kingdom shal be taken away.
label: Numbers

text: God hath brought him out of Ægypt, whoſe ſtrẽgth is like to the rhinocerote. They shal deuoure nations his enimies, and breake their bones, and pearce them with arrowes.
label: Numbers

text: Lying he hath ſlept as a lion, and as a lioneſſe, whom none shal be bold to rayſe vp. He that bleſſeth thee, him ſelf alſo shal be bleſſed: he that curſeth thee, shal be reputed accurſt.
label: Numbers

text: And Balac being angrie againſt Balaam, clapping his handes together ſaid: To curſe mine enemies I called thee, whom thou contrariewiſe haſt bleſſed the third time:
label: Numbers

text: returne to thy place. I was determined verily to honour thee magnifically, but the Lord hath depriued thee of the honour appointed.
label: Numbers

text: Balaam made anſwer to Balac: did I not ſay to thy meſſengers, whom thou didſt ſend to me:
label: Numbers

text: If Balac would geue me his houſe ful of ſiluer and gold, I can not paſſe the word of the Lord my God, to vtter of my owne minde either any good, or euil: but whatſoeuer the Lord shal ſay, that wil I ſpeake?
label: Numbers

text: But yet going to my people, I wll geue thee counſel, what thy people shal doe to this people in the laſt time.
label: Numbers

text: Therfore taking vp his parable, againe he ſaid: Balaam the ſonne of Beor hath ſaid: The man whoſe eye is ſtopped, hath ſaid:
label: Numbers

text: the hearer of the wordes of God hath ſaid, who knoweth the doctrine of the Higheſt, and ſeeth the viſions of the Omnipotent, who falling hath his eies opened.
label: Numbers

text: I shal ſee him, but not now: I shal behold him but not neere. A STARRE SHAL RISE out of Iacob, and a rodde shal ariſe from Iſrael: and shal ſtrike the dukes of Moab, and shal waiſt al the children of Seth.
label: Numbers

text: And Idumea shal be his poſſeſſion: the inheritance of Seir shal come to their enemies: but Iſrael shal doe manfully.
label: Numbers

text: Of Iacob shal he be that shal rule, and shal deſtroy the remaines of the citie.
label: Numbers

text: And when he had ſeene Amalec, taking vp his parable, he ſaid: Amalec the beginning of Gentiles, whoſe latter endes shal be deſtroyed.
label: Numbers

text: He ſaw alſo the Cineite: and taking vp his parable, he ſaid: Thy habitation in deede is ſtrong: but if thou build thy neſt in a rocke,
label: Numbers

text: and thou be choſen of the ſtocke of Cin, how long shalt thou be able to continew? For Aſſur shal take thee.
label: Numbers

text: And taking vp his parable againe he ſpake: Alas, who shal liue, when God shal doe theſe thinges?
label: Numbers

text: They shal come in galleies from Italie, they shal ouercome the Aſſyrians, and shal waiſt the Hebrewes, and at the laſt them ſelues alſo shal perish.
label: Numbers

text: And Balaam roſe, and returned into his place: Balac alſo returned the way that he came.
label: Numbers

text: AND Iſrael at that time abode in Settim, and the people fornicated with the daughters of Moab,
label: Numbers

text: who called them to their ſacriſices. And they did eate and adore their goddes.
label: Numbers

text: And Iſrael was profeſſed to Beelphegor, and our Lord being angtie,
label: Numbers

text: ſaid to Moyſes: Take al the princes of the people, and hang them vp againſt the ſunne on gibbettes: that my furie may be auerted from Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes ſaid to the Iudges of Iſrael: Kil euerie man his neighbours, that are profeſſed to Beelphegor.
label: Numbers

text: And behold one of the children of Iſrael entred in before the face of his brethren to a whore a Madianite in the ſight of Moyſes, and of al the multitude of the children of Iſrael, who wept before the doores of the tabernacle.
label: Numbers

text: Which thing when Phinees had ſene the ſonne of Eleazar the ſonne of Aaron the prieſt, he aroſe out of the middes of the multitude, and catching a dagger,
label: Numbers

text: went in after the man of Iſrael into the brothel houſe, and thruſt them through both together, to witte, the man and the woman in the genitalles. And the plague ceaſed from the children of Iſrael,
label: Numbers

text: and there were ſlaine fowre and twentie thowſand men.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes:
label: Numbers

text: Phinees the ſonne of Eleazar the ſonne of Aaron the prieſt hath auerted my wrath from the children of Iſrael: becauſe he was moued with my zele againſt them, that my ſelf might not deſtroy the children of Iſrael in mine owne zele.
label: Numbers

text: Therfore ſpeake to him: Behold I geue him the peace of my couenant,
label: Numbers

text: and there shal be as wel to him as to his ſeede the couenant of prieſthood for euer, becauſe he hath bene zelous for his God, and hath expiated the wicked fact of the children of Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: And the name of the man of Iſrael, that was ſlaine with the woman of Madian, was Zambri the ſonne of Salu, a prince of the kinred and tribe of Simeon.
label: Numbers

text: Moreouer the Madianeſſe, that was ſlaine with him, was called Cozbi the daughter of Sur a moſt noble prince of the Madianites.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Let the Madianites finde you their enemies, and ſtrike you them:
label: Numbers

text: Becauſe they alſo haue done like enemies againſt you, and haue guilfully deceiued you by the Idol Phogor, and Cozbi the daughter of the duke of Madian their ſiſter, who was ſtrooken in the day of the plague for the ſacrilege of Phogor.
label: Numbers

text: AFTER the bloud of the offenders was shed, our Lord ſaid to Moyſes and Eleazar the ſonne of Aaron, the prieſt:
label: Numbers

text: Number the whole ſumme of the children of Iſrael from twentie yeares and vpward, by their houſes and kinredes, al that can goe forth to warres.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore and Eleazar the prieſt ſpake, in the champion countrie of Moab vpon Iordan againſt Iericho, to them that were
label: Numbers

text: from twentie yeares and vpward, as our Lord had commanded, of whom this is the number:
label: Numbers

text: Ruben the firſt borne of Iſrael, his ſonne, Henoch, of whom is the familie of the Henochites: and Phallu, of whom is the familie of the Phalluites:
label: Numbers

text: and Heſron, of whom is the familie of the Heſronites: and Charmi, of whom is the familie of the Charmites.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are the families of the ſtocke of Ruben: whoſe number was found fourtie three thouſand, and ſeuen hundred thirtie.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonne of Phallu, Eliab.
label: Numbers

text: his ſonnes, Namuel and Dathan and Abiron. Theſe are Dathan and Abiron the princes of the people, that roſe againſt Moyſes and Aaron in the ſedition of Core, when they rebelled againſt our Lord:
label: Numbers

text: and the earth opening her mouth deuoured Core, verie manie dying, when the fire burnt two hundred fiftie men. And there was a great miracle done,
label: Numbers

text: that Core perishing, his ſonnes perished not.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Simeon by their kinredes: Namuel, of him is the familie of the Namuelites: Iamin, of him is the familie of the Iaminites: Iachin, of him is the familie of Iachinites:
label: Numbers

text: Zare, of him is the familie of the Zareites: Saul, of him is the familie of the Saulites.
label: Numbers

text: theſe are the families of the ſtocke of Simeon, of which the whole number was two and twentie thouſand two hundred.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Gad by their kintedes: Sephon, of him is the familie of the Sephonites: Aggi of him is the familie of the Aggites: Suni, of him is the familie of the Sunites:
label: Numbers

text: Ozni, of him is the famile of the Oznites: Her, of him is the familie of the Herites:
label: Numbers

text: Arod of him is the familie of the Arodites: Ariel, of him is the familie of the Arielites.
label: Numbers

text: theſe are the families of Gad, of which the whole number was fourtie thouſand fiue hundred.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Iudas, Her, and Onan, who died both in the land of Chanaan.
label: Numbers

text: And the ſonnes of Iudas by their kinredes were: Sela, of whom is the familie of the Selaites: Phares, of whom is the familie of the Phareſites: Zare, of whom is the familie of the Zareites.
label: Numbers

text: Moreouer the ſonnes of Phares: Heſron, of whom is the familie of the Heſronites: and hamul, of whom is the familie of the Hamulites.
label: Numbers

text: theſe are the families of Iudas, of which the whole number was ſeuentie ſix thouſand fiue hundred.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Iſſachar, by their kinredes: Thola, of whom is the familie of the Tholaites: Phua, of whom is the familie of the Phuaites:
label: Numbers

text: Iaſub, of whom is the familie of the Iaſubites: Semran, of whom is the familie of the Semranites.
label: Numbers

text: theſe are the kinredes of Iſſachar, whoſe number ſixtie fowre thouſand three hundred.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Zabulon by their kinredes: Sared, of whom is the familie of the Saredites: Elon of whom is the familie of the Elonites: Ialel, of whom is the familie of Ialelites.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are the kinredes of Zabulon, whoſe number was ſixtie thouſand fiue hundred.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Ioſeph by their kinredes, Manaſſes and Ephraim.
label: Numbers

text: Of Manaſſes was borne Machir, of whom is the familie of the Machirites. Machir begat Galaad, of whom is the familie of the Galaadites.
label: Numbers

text: Galaad had ſonnes: Iezer, of whom is the familie of the Iezerites: and Helec, of whom is the familie of the Helecites:
label: Numbers

text: and Aſriel, of whom is the familie of the Aſrielites: and Sechem, of whom is the familie of the Sechemites.
label: Numbers

text: and Semida, of whom is the familie of the Semidaites: and Hepher, of whom is the familie of the Hepherites.
label: Numbers

text: And Hepher was the father of Salphaad, who had no ſonnes, but onlie daughters, whoſe names are theſe: Maala, and Noa, and Hegla, and Melcha, and Terſa.
label: Numbers

text: theſe are the families of Manaſſes, and the number of them is fiftie two thouſand ſeuen hundred.
label: Numbers

text: And the ſonnes of Ephraim by their kinredes were theſe: Suthala, of whom is the familie of the Suthalaites: Becher, of whom is the familie of the Becherites: Thehen, of whom is the familie of the Thehenites.
label: Numbers

text: Moreouer the ſonne of Suthala was Heran, of whom is the familie of the Heranites.
label: Numbers

text: rheſe are the kinredes of the ſonnes of Ephraim: whoſe number was thirtie two thouſand fiue hundred.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are the ſonnes of Ioſeph by their families. The ſonnes of Beniamin in their kinredes: Bela, of whom is the familie of the Belaites: Aſbel, of whom is the familie of the Asbelites: Ahiram, of whom is the familie of the Ahiramites:
label: Numbers

text: Supham, of whom is the familie of the Suphamites: Hupham, of whom is the familie of the Huphamites.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Bela: Hered, and Noeman. Of Hered, the familie of the Heredites: of Noeman, the familie of the Noemanites.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are the ſonnes of Beniamin by their kinredes, whoſe number was fourtie fiue thouſand ſix hundred.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Dan by their kinredes: Suham, of whom is the familie of the Suhamites: theſe are the kinredes of Dan by their families.
label: Numbers

text: al were Suhamites, whoſe number was ſixtie foure thouſand foure hundred.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Aſer by their kinredes: Iemna, of whom is the familie of the Iemnaites: Ieſſui, of whom is the familie of the Ieſſuites: Brie, of whom is the familie of the Brieites.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Brie: Heber, of whom is the familie of the Heberites: and Melchiel, of whom is the familie of the Melchielites.
label: Numbers

text: And the name of the daughter of Aſer, was Sara.
label: Numbers

text: theſe are the kinredes of the ſonnes of Aſer, and their number fiftie three thouſand foure hundred.
label: Numbers

text: The ſonnes of Nephthali by their kinredes: Ieſiel, of whom is the familie of the Ieſielites: Guni, of whom is the familie of the Gunites,
label: Numbers

text: Ieſer, of whom is the familie of the Ieſerites: Sellem, of whom is the familie of the Sellemites.
label: Numbers

text: theſe are the kinredes of the ſonnes of Nephthali by their families: whoſe number was fourtie fiue thouſand foure hundred.
label: Numbers

text: This is the ſumme of the children of Iſrael, that wete reckened, ſix hundred thouſand, and a thouſand ſeuen hundred thirtie.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: To theſe shal the land be diuided according to the number of names for their poſſeſſions.
label: Numbers

text: To the greater number thou shalt geue a greater portion, and to the fewer a leſſe: to euerie one, as they haue now beene reckened, shal poſſeſſion be deliuered:
label: Numbers

text: yet ſo that lotte doe diuide the Land to the tribes and the families.
label: Numbers

text: Whatſoeuer shal chance by lotte, that let either the more take, or the fewer.
label: Numbers

text: This alſo is the number of the ſonnes of Leui by their families: Gerſon, of whom the familie of the Gerſonites: Caath, of whom the familie of the Caathites: Merari, of whom the familie of the Merarites.
label: Numbers

text: theſe are the families of Leui: The familie of Lobni, the familie of Hebroni, the familie of Moholi, the familie of Muſi, the familie of Core. Howbeit Caath begatte Amram:
label: Numbers

text: who had to wife Iochabed the daughter of Leui, who was borne to him in Ægypt. She bare to Amram her husband ſonnes, Aaron and Moyſes, and Marie their ſiſter.
label: Numbers

text: Of Aaron were borne Nadab and Abiu, and Eleazar and Ithamar:
label: Numbers

text: of the which Nadab and Abiu died, when they had offered the ſtrange fyre before our Lord.
label: Numbers

text: And al that were numbred, were twentie three thouſand of the male kind from one moneth and vpward: who were not reckened among the children of Iſrael, neither was their poſſeſſion geuen with the reſt.
label: Numbers

text: This is the number of the children of Iſrael, that were enrolled by Moyſes and Eleazar the prieſt, in the champion countrie of Moab vpon Iordan againſt Iericho.
label: Numbers

text: Among whom there was none of them that were numbered before by Moyſes and Aaron in the deſert of Sinai.
label: Numbers

text: For our Lord had foretold that al should die in the wilderneſſe And none remained of them, but Caleb the ſonne of Iephone, and Ioſue the ſonne of Nun.
label: Numbers

text: AND there came the daughters of Salphaad, the ſonne of Hepher, the ſonne of Galaad, rhe ſonne of Machir, the ſonne of Manaſſes, who was the ſonne of Ioſeph: whoſe names are, Malaa, and Noa, and Hegla, and Melcha, and Therſa.
label: Numbers

text: And they ſtood before Moyſes and Eleazar the prieſt, and al the princes of the people at the doore of the tabernacle of couenant, and ſaid:
label: Numbers

text: Our father died in the deſert, neither was he in the ſedition, that was raiſed againſt our Lord vnder Core, but he died in his owne ſinne: he had no men children. Why is his name taken away out of his familie, becauſe he hath not a ſonne? Geue vs poſſeſſion among the kinne of our father.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes referred their cauſe to the iudgement of our Lord.
label: Numbers

text: Who ſaid to him:
label: Numbers

text: The Daughters of Salphaad require a iuſt thing: geue them poſſeſſion among their fathers kinne, and let them ſuccede him in the inheritance.
label: Numbers

text: And to the children of Iſrael thou ſhalt ſpeake theſe thinges:
label: Numbers

text: When a man dieth without a ſonne, his inheritance shal paſſe to his daughter.
label: Numbers

text: If he haue no daughter, he ſhal haue his brethren his ſucceſſours.
label: Numbers

text: And if he haue no brethren neither, you shal geue the inheritance to his fathers brethren.
label: Numbers

text: but if he haue no ſuch vncles by the father neither, the inheritance ſhal be geuen to them thar are the next of kinne. and this shal be to the children of Iſrael a holie ordinance by a perpetual law, as the Lord hath commanded Moyſes.
label: Numbers

text: Our Lord alſo ſaid to Moyſes: Goe vp into this mountaine Abarim, and view from thence the Land which I wil geue to the children of Iſrael:
label: Numbers

text: and when thou ſhalt haue ſeene it, thou alſo shalt goe to thy people, as thy brothet Aaron is gone:
label: Numbers

text: becauſe you did offend me in the deſert Sin in the contradiction of the multitude, neither would you ſanctifie me before them vpon the waters. theſe are the waters of contradiction in Cades of the deſert Sin.
label: Numbers

text: To whom Moyſes anſwered:
label: Numbers

text: Our Lord the God of the ſpirites of al flesh prouide a man, that may be ouer this multitude:
label: Numbers
