text: and may goe out and enter in before them, and bring them out, or bring them in: leſt the people of our Lord be as sheepe without a paſtor.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to him: Take Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and put thy hand vpon him.
label: Numbers

text: Who shal ſtand before Eleazar the prieſt and al the multitude:
label: Numbers

text: and thou shalt geue him preceptes in the ſight of al, and part of thy glorie, that al the ſynagogue of the children of Iſrael may heare him.
label: Numbers

text: For him, if anie thing be to be done, Eleazar the prieſt shal conſult the Lord. At his word shal he goe out and shal goe in, and al the children of Iſrael with him, and the reſt of the multitude.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes did as out Lord had commanded. And when he had taken Ioſue, he ſette him before Eleazar the prieſt, and al the aſſemblie of the people.
label: Numbers

text: And impoſing his handes on his head, he repeted al thinges that our Lord had commanded.
label: Numbers

text: OVR Lord alſo ſaid to Moyſes:
label: Numbers

text: Command the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: My oblation and breades, and burnt ſacrifice of moſt ſweete odour offer ye in their times.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are the ſacrifices which you muſt offer: Two lambes of a yeare old without blemish daily for the euerlaſting holocauſt:
label: Numbers

text: one you shal offer in the morning, and the other at euen:
label: Numbers

text: the tenth part of an ephi of floure, which shal be tempered with the pureſt oile, and shal haue the fourth part of an hin.
label: Numbers

text: It is the continual holocauſt which you offered in Mount Sinai for a moſt ſweete odour of the burnt ſacrifice of the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: and for a libament you shal offer of wine the fourth part of an hin for euerie lambe in the Sanctuarie of the Lotd.
label: Numbers

text: And the other lambe in like maner you shal offer at euen according to al the rite of the morning ſacrifice, and of the libamentes therof, an oblation of moſt ſweete odour to the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: And on the day of the Sabbath, you shal offer two lambes of a yeare old without blemish, and two tenthes of flowre tempered with oile in ſacrifice, and the libamentes
label: Numbers

text: which are ritely powred euerie Sabbath for an euerlaſting holocauſt.
label: Numbers

text: And in the Calendes you shal offer an holocauſte ro the Lord, two calues of the heard, one ramme, ſeuen lambes of a yeare old without blemish,
label: Numbers

text: and three tenthes of flowre tempered with oile in ſacrifice for euerie calfe: and two tenthes of flowre tempered with oile to euerie ramme:
label: Numbers

text: and the tenth part of a tenth of flowre tempered with oile in ſacrifice to euerie lambe. it is an holocauſt of moſt ſweete odour and burnt ſacrifice to the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: And the libamentes of wine, that are to be powred for euerie victime, shal be theſe: The halfe part of an hin for euerie calfe, the third to a ramme, the fourth to a lambe. this shal be the holocauſt through al monethes, that ſuccede one an other as the yeare turneth about.
label: Numbers

text: A bucke goate alſo shal be offered to the Lord for ſinnes an euerlaſting holocauſt with his libamentes.
label: Numbers

text: And in the firſt moneth, the fourtenth day of the moneth shal be the Phaſe of the Lord,
label: Numbers

text: and the fiftenth day the ſolemnitie: ſeuen daies shal they eate azymes.
label: Numbers

text: Of rhe which the firſt day shal be venerable and holie: no ſeruile worke shal you doe therein.
label: Numbers

text: And you shal offer burnt ſacrifice an holocauſt to the Lord, two calues of the heard, one ramme, ſeuen lambes of a yeare old without blemish:
label: Numbers

text: and the ſacrifice of euerie one of flowre which shal be tempered with oile, three tenthes to euerie calfe, and two tenthes to euerie ramme,
label: Numbers

text: and the tenth part of a tenth, to euerie lambe, that is to ſay, to the ſeuen lambes.
label: Numbers

text: And one bucke goate for ſinne, that expiation may be made for you,
label: Numbers

text: beſide the morning holocauſt which you shal alwaies offer.
label: Numbers

text: So shal you do euerie day of the ſeuen daies for a foode of the fire, and for a moſt ſweee odour to the Lord, which shal riſe of the holocauſt, and of the libamentes of euerie one.
label: Numbers

text: The ſeuenth day alſo shal be moſt ſolemne and holie vnto you: no ſeruile worke shal you doe therein.
label: Numbers

text: The day alſo of firſt fruites when you shal offer new fruites to the Lord, after that the weekes be accomplished, shal be venerable and holie: no ſeruile worke shal you doe therein.
label: Numbers

text: And you shal offer an holocauſt for a moſt ſweete odour to the Lord, two calues of the heard, one ramme, and ſeuen Lambes of a yeare old without blemish:
label: Numbers

text: and in the ſacrifices of them three tenthes of flowre tempered with oile to euerie calfe, to euerie ramme two,
label: Numbers

text: euerie lambe the tenth part of a tenth, which together are ſeuen lambes. a goate alſo
label: Numbers

text: which is ſlaine for expiation: beſide the euerlaſting holocauſt and the libamentes therof.
label: Numbers

text: Al shal you offer without blemish with their libamentes.
label: Numbers

text: THE firſt day alſo of the ſeuenth moneth shal be venerable and holie vnto you. no ſeruile worke shal you doe therein, becauſe it is the day of ſounding and of trumpetes.
label: Numbers

text: And you shal offer an holocauſt for a moſt ſweete odour to the Lord, one calfe of the heard one ramme, and ſeuen lambes of a yeare old without blemish:
label: Numbers

text: and in their ſacrifices of floure tempered with oile three tenthes to euerie calfe, two tenthes to a ramme,
label: Numbers

text: one tenth to a lambe, which together are ſeuen lambes:
label: Numbers

text: and a bucke goate for ſinne, which is offered for the expiation of the people,
label: Numbers

text: beſides the holocauſt of the Calendes with the ſacrifices therof, and the euerlaſting holocauſt with the accuſtomed libamentes. With the ſame ceremonies shal you offer burnt ſacrifice for a moſt ſweete odour to the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: The tenth day alſo of this ſeuenth moneth shal be holie and venerable vnto you, and you shal afflict your ſoules: no ſeruile worke shal you doe therein.
label: Numbers

text: And you shal offer an holocauſt to the Lord for a moſt ſweete odour, one calfe of the heard, one ramme, ſeuen Lambes of a yeare old without blemish:
label: Numbers

text: and in their ſacrifices of floure tempered with oile three tenthes to euerie calfe, two tenthes to the ramme,
label: Numbers

text: the tenth part of a tenth to euerie lambe, which are in al ſeuen lambes:
label: Numbers

text: and a bucke goate for ſinne, beſides theſe thinges that are wont to be offered for offence vnto expiation, and for the euerlaſting holocauſt with their ſacrifice & libamentes.
label: Numbers

text: But the fiftenth day of the ſeuenth moneth, which shal be vnto you holie and venerable, no ſeruile worke shal you doe therein, but you shal celebrate the ſolemnitie to the Lord ſeuen daies.
label: Numbers

text: and you shal offer an holocauſt for a moſt ſweete odour to the Lord, calues of the heard thirtene, rammes two, lambes of a yeare old without blemish fourtene:
label: Numbers

text: & in their libamentes of flowre tempered with oile three tenthes to euerie calfe, which are together thirtene calues: and two tenthes to euerie ramme, that is; together to two rammes,
label: Numbers

text: and the tenth part of a tenth to euerie lambe, which are together fourtene lambes:
label: Numbers

text: and a bucke goate for ſinne, beſide the euerlaſting holocauſte, and the ſacrifice, and the libament therof.
label: Numbers

text: The next day you shal offer calues of the heard twelue, two rammes, lambes a yeare old without blemish fourtene:
label: Numbers

text: and the ſacrifices and libamentes of euerie one to the calues and the rammes and the lambes you shal ritely celebrate:
label: Numbers

text: and a bucke goate for ſinne, beſide the euerlaſting holocauſte, and the ſacrifiee and libament therof.
label: Numbers

text: The third day you shal offer eleuen calues, two rammes, lambes of a yeare old without blemish fourtene:
label: Numbers

text: and the ſacrifices and the libamentes of euerie one to the calues and the rammes and the lambes you shal ritely celebrate:
label: Numbers

text: and a bucke goate for ſinne, beſide the euerlaſting holocauſte, and the ſacrifice, and libament therof.
label: Numbers

text: The fourth day you shal offer ten calues, two rammes, lambes a yeare old without blemish fourtene:
label: Numbers

text: and the ſacrifices and the libamentes of euerie one to the calues and the rammes and the lambes you shal titely celebrate.
label: Numbers

text: and a bucke goate for ſinne, beſide the euerlaſting holocauſte, and the ſacrifice therof and libament.
label: Numbers

text: The fifth day you shal offer nine calues, two rammes, lambes of a yeare old without blemish fourtene:
label: Numbers

text: and the ſacrifices and the libamentes of euerie one to the calues and the rammes and the lambes you shal ritely celebrate:
label: Numbers

text: and a bucke goate for ſinne, beſide the euerlaſting holocauſte, and the ſacrifices therof and libament.
label: Numbers

text: The ſixt day you shal offer eight calues, two rãmes, lambes of a yeare old without blemish fourtene:
label: Numbers

text: and the ſacrifices and the libamentes of euerie one to the calues and the rammes and the lambes you shal ritely celebrate:
label: Numbers

text: and a bucke goate for ſinne; beſide the euerlaſting holocauſte, and the ſacrifice therof and libament.
label: Numbers

text: The ſeuenth day you shal offer ſeuen calues, and two rammes, lambes of a yeare old without blemish fourtene:
label: Numbers

text: and the ſacrifices and the libamentes of euerie one to the calues and the rammes and the lambes you shal ritely celebrate:
label: Numbers

text: and a bucke goate for ſinne, beſide the euerlaſting holocauſte and the ſacrifice therof and libament.
label: Numbers

text: The eight day, which is moſt ſolemne, no ſeruile you doe therin,
label: Numbers

text: offering an holocauſte for a moſt ſweete odour to the Lord, one calfe, one ramme, lambes of a yeare old with out blemish ſeuen.
label: Numbers

text: and the ſacrifices and the libamentes of euerie one to the calues and the rammes and the lambes you shal ritely celebrate:
label: Numbers

text: and a bucke goate for ſinne, beſides the euerlaſting holocauſte, and the ſacrifice therof and libament.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe thinges shal you offer to the Lord in your ſolemnites: beſides your vowes and voluntarie oblations in holocauſte, in ſacrifice, in libament, and in pacifique hoſtes.
label: Numbers

text: AND Moyſes told the children of Iſrael al thinges that our Lord had commanded him:
label: Numbers

text: and he ſpake to the princes of the ttibes of the children of Iſrael: This is the word that our Lord hath commanded:
label: Numbers

text: If any man make a vowe to our Lord, or binde him ſelf by an oath: he shal not make his word fruſtrate, but al that he promiſed he shal fulfil.
label: Numbers

text: If a woman vowe any thing, and binde her ſelf with an oath, ſhe that is in her fathers houſe, and as yet in maydens age: if her father know the vowe that she promiſed, and the oath wherwith she bound her ſoule, and hold his peace, she shal be bound to the vowe:
label: Numbers

text: Whatſoeuer she promiſed and ſware, she shal fulfil in deede.
label: Numbers

text: but if immediatly as he heareth it, her father do gaine ſay it, both her vowes and her othes shal be fruſtrate, neither shal she be bound to the promiſſe, for that her father hath gaineſaid it.
label: Numbers

text: If she haue a husband, and vowe any thing, and the word once going out of her mouth binde her ſoule by an oath:
label: Numbers

text: the day that her husband heareth it, and doth not gaine ſay it, she shal be bound to the vowe, and shal render whatſoeuer she promiſed.
label: Numbers

text: but if as ſowne as he heareth he gaine ſay it, and make her promiſes fruſtrate, and the wordes wherwith she had bound her ſoule: our Lord wil be propitious to her.
label: Numbers

text: The widowe, and she that is deuorced whatſoeuer they vowe, they shal render.
label: Numbers

text: The wife in the houſe of her husband, when she hath bound her ſelf by vowe and by oath,
label: Numbers

text: if her husband heare, and hold his peace, neither doe gayneſay the promiſſe, she shal render whatſoeuer she had promiſſed.
label: Numbers

text: but if forthwith he gayneſay it, she shal not be holden bound to the promiſſe: becauſe her husband gayneſaid it, and our Lord wil be propitious to her.
label: Numbers

text: If she vowe and binde her ſelfe by oath, to afflict her ſoule by faſting, or abſtinence from other thinges, it shal be in the arbitrement of her huſband, whether she shal do it, or not do it.
label: Numbers

text: and if the huſband hearing it hold his peace, and differre ſentence til an other day: whatſoeuer she had vowed and promiſed, she shal render: becauſe immediatly as he heard it, he held his peace.
label: Numbers

text: but if he gayneſay it after that he knew it, him ſelfe shal beare her iniquitie.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are the lawes, which our Lord appointed to Moyſes betwen the husband and the wife, betwene the father and the daughter, that is as yet in maidens age, or that abideth in her fathers houſe.
label: Numbers

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Reuenge firſt the children of Iſrael on the Madianites, and ſo thou shalt be gathered to thy people.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes forthwith ſaid: Arme of you men to fight, which may take the reuenge of our Lord on the Madianites.
label: Numbers

text: Let a thouſand men of euerie tribe be choſen of Iſrael to be ſent to the warre.
label: Numbers

text: And they gaue a thouſand of euerie tribe, that is to ſay, twelue thouſand wel appointed to fight:
label: Numbers

text: whom Moyſes ſent with Phinees the ſonne of Eleazar the prieſt, and the holie veſſel, and the trumpettes to ſound he deliuered to him.
label: Numbers

text: And when they had fought againſt the Madianites and had ouercome, al the men they ſlew,
label: Numbers

text: and their kinges Eui, and Recem, and Sur, and Hur, and Rebe, fiue princes of the Nation: Balaam alſo the ſonne of Beor they killed with the ſword.
label: Numbers

text: And they tooke their wiues, and litle ones, and al their goodes: whatſoeuer they had bene able to make, they ſpoiled:
label: Numbers

text: as wel cities as townes and caſtels the fire did conſume.
label: Numbers

text: And they tooke the praye, and al thinges that they had taken as wel of men as of beaſtes,
label: Numbers

text: and they brought them to Moyſes, and Eleazar the prieſt, and to al the multitude of the children of Iſrael. but the reſt of the implementes they caried to the campe in the champion countries of Moab, beſide Iordan againſt Iericho.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes and Eleazar the prieſt went forth, and al the princes of the ſynagogue to meete them without the campe.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes being angrie with the princes of the hoſte, the tribunes, and the centurions that were come from the battle,
label: Numbers

text: ſaid: Why haue you reſerued the wemen?
label: Numbers

text: Are not theſe they, that deceiued the children of Iſrael at the ſuggeſtion of Balaam, and made you preuaricate againſt our Lord vpon the ſinne of Phogor, whereupon alſo the people was ſtroken?
label: Numbers

text: Therfore kil al whatſoeuer is of the male ſexe, among the litle ones alſo: and the wemen; that haue knowne men in carnal copulation, ſlea ye:
label: Numbers

text: but the gyrles and al the wemen that are virgins reſerue to you:
label: Numbers

text: and tarying without the campe ſeuen dayes. He that hath killed a man, or touched him that is killed, shal be expiated the third day and the ſeuenth.
label: Numbers

text: And of al the praye, whether it be garment, or veſſel, and ſome thing prepared for implementes, of goates skinnes, and heare, and wood shal be expiated.
label: Numbers

text: Eleazar alſo the prieſt ſpake to the hoſte, that had fought, in this maner: This is the precept of the law, which our Lord hath commanded Moyſes:
label: Numbers

text: Gold, and ſiluer, and braſſe, and yron, and leade, and tinne,
label: Numbers

text: and al that may paſſe through the fyre, shal be purged by fyre, but whatſoeuer can not abide the fire, shal be ſanctified with the water of expiation:
label: Numbers

text: and you shal wash your garmentes the ſeuenth day, and being purified, afterward you shal enter into the campe.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes:
label: Numbers

text: Take the ſumme of thoſe thinges, that were taken from man vnto beaſt, thou and Eleazar the prieſt and the princes of the multitude:
label: Numbers

text: and thou shalt diuide the praye equally betwene them, that fought & went forth to the warre, and betwen the reſt of the multitude.
label: Numbers

text: and thou shalt ſeparate a portion to the Lord from them, that fought and were in the battle, one ſoule of fiue hundred as wel of mankind as of oxen and aſſes and sheepe,
label: Numbers

text: and thou shalt geue it to Eleazar the prieſt, becauſe they are the firſt fruites of the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: Out of the halfe part alſo of the children of Iſrael thou shalt take the fiftith head of mankind, and of oxen, and aſſes, and sheepe, and of al beaſtes, and thou shalt geue them to the Leuites, that watch in the cuſtodies of the tabernacle of the Lord.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes and Eleazar did, as our Lord commanded.
label: Numbers

text: And the praye which the hoſte had taken, was of sheepe ſix hundred ſeuentie fiue thouſand,
label: Numbers

text: of oxen ſeuentie two thouſand,
label: Numbers

text: of aſſes ſixtie one thouſand.
label: Numbers

text: The ſoules of the folkes of the female ſexe, that had not knowne men, thirtie two thouſand.
label: Numbers

text: And the halfe part was geuen to them, that had bene in the battle, of sheepe three hundred thirtie ſeuen thouſand fiue hundred:
label: Numbers

text: of the which for the portion of our Lord were reckened sheepe ſix hundred ſeuentie fiue.
label: Numbers

text: And of the thirtie ſix thouſand oxen, oxen ſeuentie and two:
label: Numbers

text: of the thirtie thouſand fiue hundred aſſes, aſſes ſixtie one:
label: Numbers

text: of the ſoules of mankind ſixtene thouſand, there fel to the portion of our Lord thirtie two ſoules.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes deliuered the number of the firſt fruites of our Lord to Eleazar the prieſt, as it had bene commanded him,
label: Numbers

text: of the halfe part of the children of Iſrael, which he had ſeparated to them, that had bene in the battle.
label: Numbers

text: But of the halfe part that had chanced to the reſt of the multitude, that is to ſay, of the three hundred thirtie ſeuen thouſand fiue hundred sheepe,
label: Numbers

text: and of the thirtie ſix thouſand oxen,
label: Numbers

text: and of the thirtie thouſand fiue hundred aſſes,
label: Numbers

text: and of the ſixtene thouſand of mankind,
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes tooke the fiftith head, and gaue it to the Leuites, that watched in the tabernacle of our Lord, as our Lord had commanded.
label: Numbers

text: And when the princes of the hoſte were come to Moyſes, and the tribunes, and centurions, they ſaid:
label: Numbers

text: We thy ſeruantes haue reckened the number of the warryers, which we had vnder our hand: and not ſo much as one verily was lacking.
label: Numbers

text: For this cauſe we offer in the donaries of our Lord euerie one that which we could finde in the praye of gold, garters and tablettes, ringes and braceletes, and cheynes, that thou maieſt pray to our Lord for vs.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes and Eleazar the prieſt receiued al the gold in diuerſe formes,
label: Numbers

text: in weight ſixtene thouſand, ſeuen hundred fiftie ſicles of the tribunes and of the centurions.
label: Numbers

text: For that which euerie one had ſpoiled in the praye, was his owne.
label: Numbers

text: And that which was receiued they brought into the tabernacle of teſtimonie, for a monument of the children of Iſrael before our Lord.
label: Numbers

text: AND the children of Ruben and Gad had much cattel, and they had in beaſtes an infinite ſubſtance. And when they had ſeene Iazer and Galaad fitte countries for to feede cattel,
label: Numbers

text: they came to Moyſes and Eleazar the prieſt, and the princes of the multitude, and ſaid:
label: Numbers

text: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Iazer, and Nemra, Heſebon, and Eleale, and Sabam, and Nebo, and Beon,
label: Numbers

text: the land, which our Lord ſmote in the ſight of the children of Iſrael, is of a verie plentiful ſoile for the feeding of beaſtes: and we thy ſeruantes haue very much cattel:
label: Numbers

text: and we pray thee if we haue found grace before thee, that thou geue vs thy ſeruantes the ſame in poſſeſſion, and make vs not paſſe ouer Iordan
label: Numbers

text: To whom Moyſes anſwered: Why shal your brethren goe to fight, and wil you ſitte here?
label: Numbers

text: Why ſubuert you the mindes of the children of Iſrael, that they may not be bold to paſſe into the place, which our Lord wil geue them?
label: Numbers

text: Did not your fathers ſo, when I ſent from Cadesbarne to view the Land?
label: Numbers

text: And when they were come as farre as the Valley of cluſter, hauing viewed al the countrie, they ſubuerted the hart of the children of Iſrael, that they should not enter the coaſtes, which our Lord gaue them.
label: Numbers

text: Who being wrath ſware, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: If theſe men, that came vp out of Ægypt, from twentie yeares and vpward, shal ſee the land, which vnder othe I promiſed to Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob: and they would not folow me,
label: Numbers

text: except Caleb the ſonne of Iephone the Cenezeite, and Ioſue the ſonne of Nun: theſe haue fulfilled my wil.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord being wrath agaynſt Iſrael, led him about through the deſert fourtie yeares, vntil the whole generation was conſumed, that had done euil in his ſight.
label: Numbers

text: And behold, quoth he, you are riſen vp in ſteed of your fathers, the offſpring and diſciples of ſinful men, to augment the furie of our Lord agaynſt Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: But if you wil not folow him, he wil leaue the people in the wilderneſſe, and you shal be the cauſe of the death of al.
label: Numbers

text: But they coming nere, ſaid: We wil make shepcottes, and ſtalles for our cattel, for our litle ones alſo fenſed cities:
label: Numbers

text: and we our ſelues armed and girded wil march on to battle before the children of Iſrael, vntil we bring them in vnto their places. Our litle ones and whatſoeuer we can haue, shal be in walled cities, becauſe of the lying of wayte of the inhabitantes.
label: Numbers

text: We wil not returne into our houſes, vntil the children of Iſrael poſſeſſe their inheritance:
label: Numbers

text: neither wil we ſeeke any thing beyound Iordan, becauſe already we haue our poſſeſſion on the eaſt ſide therof.
label: Numbers

text: To whom Moyſes ſaid: If you doe that you promiſſe, march on wel appointed before our Lord to fight:
label: Numbers

text: and let euerie man of warre paſſe ouer Iordan, vntil our Lord ſubuert his enemies,
label: Numbers

text: and al the Land be ſubdued to him: then shal you be blameleſſe before our Lord and before Iſrael, and you shal obteyne the countries that you would in the ſight of our Lord.
label: Numbers

text: But if you doe not, that which you ſay, no man can doubt but you ſinne againſt God: and know ye that your ſinne shal apprehend you.
label: Numbers

text: Build therfore cities for your litle ones, and sheepecotes and ſtalles for your sheepe and cattel: and accomplish that which you haue promiſed.
label: Numbers

text: And the children of Gad and Ruben ſaid to Moyſes: We are thy ſeruantes, we wil do that which our lord commandeth.
label: Numbers

text: We wil leaue our litle ones, and our wiues, and sheepe, and cattel in the cities of Galaad:
label: Numbers

text: and we thy ſeruantes al wel appoynted wil march on to the warre, as thou my lord ſpeakeſt.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore commanded Eleazar the prieſt, and Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, and the princes of the families by the tribes of Iſrael, and he ſaid to them:
label: Numbers

text: If the children of Gad, and the children of Ruben paſſe with you ouer Iordan al armed to the warre before our Lord, and the Land be ſubdued to you: geue them Galaad in poſſeſſion.
label: Numbers

text: But if they wil not paſſe armed with you into the Land of Chanaan, let them take places to dwel in among you.
label: Numbers

text: And the children of Gad, and the children of Ruben anſwered: As our lord hath ſpoken to his ſeruantes, ſo Wil we doe:
label: Numbers

text: our ſelues atmed wil march before our Lord into the Land of Chanaan, and we confeſſe that we haue already receiued our poſſeſſion beyond Iordan.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore gaue to the children of Gad and Ruben, and to the halfe tribe of Manaſſes the ſonne of Ioſeph, the kingdome of Sehon king of the Amorrheite, and the kingdome of Og king of Baſan, and their land and the cities therof round about.
label: Numbers

text: Therfore the ſonnes of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
label: Numbers

text: and Etroth, and Sophan, and Iazar, and Iegbaa,
label: Numbers

text: and Bethnemra, and Betharan, cities fenſed, and sheepecotes for their sheepe.
label: Numbers

text: But the children of Ruben builded Heſebon, and Eleale, and Cariathaim,
label: Numbers

text: and Nabo, and Baalmeon changing their names, Sabama alſo: geuing names to the cities, which they had built.
label: Numbers

text: Moreouer the children of Machir, the ſonne of Manaſſes went into Galaad, and waſted it killing the Amorrheite the inhabiter therof.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes therfore gaue the land of Galaad to Machir the ſonne of Manaſſes, who dwelt in it.
label: Numbers

text: And Iair the ſonne of Manaſſes went, and tooke the villages therof, whieh he called Hauoth Iair, that is tho ſay, the Villages of Iair.
label: Numbers

text: Nobe alſo went, and tooke Canath with the villages therof: and he called it by his owne name Nobe.
label: Numbers

text: THESE are the manſions of the children of Iſrael, that went out of Ægypt by their troupes in the hand of Moyſes and Aaron,
label: Numbers

text: which Moyſes deſcribed according to the places of the campe, which by our Lords commandement they changed.
label: Numbers

text: The children of Iſrael therfore departing from Rameſſes the firſt moneth, the fiftenth day of the firſt moneth, the morow after they made the Phaſe, in a mightie hand, al the Ægyptians ſeeing them,
label: Numbers

text: and burying their firſt borne, which our Lord had ſtrooken (yea and on their goddes alſo he had exerciſed vengeance)
label: Numbers

text: they camped in Soccoth.
label: Numbers

text: And from Soccoth they came into Etham, which is in the vttermoſt borders of the wilderneſſe.
label: Numbers

text: Departing thence they came ouer againſt Phihahiroth, which looketh toward Beelſephon, and camped before Magdal.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Phihahiroth, they paſſed through the middes of the ſea into the wilderneſſe: and walking three dayes through the deſert Etham, they camped in Mara.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Mara, they came into Elim, where there were the twelue fountaines of waters, and the ſeuentie palme trees: and there they camped
label: Numbers

text: But departing thence alſo, they pitched their tentes vpon the Redde ſea. And departing from the Redde ſea,
label: Numbers

text: they camped in the deſert Sin.
label: Numbers

text: From whence departing, they came into Daphca.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Daphca, they camped in Alus.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Alus, they pitched their tentes in Raphidim, where the people wanted water to drinke.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Raphidim, they camped in the deſert of Sinai.
label: Numbers

text: But departing alſo from the deſert Sinai, they came to the Sepulchres of concupiſcence,
label: Numbers

text: And departing from the Sepulchres of concupiſcence, they camped in Haſeroth.
label: Numbers

text: And from Haſeroth they came into Rethma.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Rethma, they camped in Remmonphares.
label: Numbers

text: Whence departing they came into Lebna.
label: Numbers

text: From Lebna they camped in Reſſa.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Reſſa, they came into Ceelatha.
label: Numbers

text: Whence departing, they camped in the mountayne Sepher.
label: Numbers

text: Departing from the mountayne Sepher, they came into Harada.
label: Numbers

text: Thence departing, they camped in Maceloth.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Maceloth, they came into Thahath.
label: Numbers

text: From Thahath they camped in Thare.
label: Numbers

text: Whence departing, they pitched their tentes in Methca.
label: Numbers

text: And from Methca they camped in Heſmona.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Heſmona, they came into Moſeroth
label: Numbers

text: And from Moſeroth they camped in Beneiaacan.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Beneiaacan, they came into the mount Gadgad.
label: Numbers

text: Whence departing, they camped in Ietebatha.
label: Numbers

text: And from Ietebatha they came into Hebrona.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Hebrona, they camped in Aſiongaber.
label: Numbers

text: Thence departing, they came into the deſert Sin, this is Cades.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Cades, they camped in the mount Hor, in the vttermoſt borders of the Land of Edom.
label: Numbers

text: And Aaron the prieſt went vp into the mountayne Hor at the commandement of our Lord: and there he died the fourtith yeare of the coming forth af the children of Iſrael out of Ægypt, the fifth moneth, the firſt day of the moneth,
label: Numbers

text: when he was an hundred three and twentie yeares old.
label: Numbers

text: And the Chananeite king of Arad, who dwelt toward the ſouth. heard that the children of Iſrael were come into the Land of Chanaan.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from the mountayne Hor, rhey camped in Salmona,
label: Numbers

text: Whence departing, they came into Phunon.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Phunon, they camped in Oboth.
label: Numbers

text: And from Oboth they came into Iieabarim, which is in the borders of the Moabites.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Iieabarim they pitched their tentes in Dibongad.
label: Numbers

text: Whence departing, they camped in Helmondeblathaim.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from Helmondeblathaim, they came to the mountaynes Abarim againſt Nabo.
label: Numbers

text: And departing from the mountaines Abarim, they paſſed to the champion countries of Moab, von Iordan, againſt Iericho.
label: Numbers

text: And there they camped from Bethſimoth vnto Abelſatim in the plainer places of the Moabites,
label: Numbers

text: where our Lord ſpake to Moyſes:
label: Numbers

text: Command the children of Iſrael, and ſay to them: When you shal haue paſſed Iordan, entring the Land of Chanaan,
label: Numbers

text: deſtroy al the inhabitants of that Land: breake their titles, and burſt to fitters their ſtatues, and waſt al their excelſes,
label: Numbers

text: cleanſing the Land, and dwelling in it. for I haue geuen it you in poſſeſſion,
label: Numbers

text: which you shal diuide among you by lotte. To the moe you shal geue the larger, and to the fewer the ſtraiter. To euerie one as the lotte shal fall, ſo shal the inheritance be geuen. By the tribes and the families the poſſeſſion shal be diuided.
label: Numbers

text: But if you wil not kil the inhabitantes of the Land: they that remaine, shal be vnto you as it were nailes in your eyes, and ſpeares in your ſides, and they shal be your aduerſaries in the Land of your habitation:
label: Numbers

text: and whatſoeuer I had thought to do to them, I wil do to you.
label: Numbers

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, ſaying:
label: Numbers

text: Command the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to them: When you are entred into the Land of Chanaan, and it shal be fallen vnto you by lotte in poſſeſſion, it shal be limited by theſe borders:
label: Numbers

text: The ſouthſide shal beginne from the wilderneſſe Sin, which is beſide Edom: and it shal haue toward the Eaſt the moſt ſalt ſea for the limites.
label: Numbers

text: The which shal compaſſe the ſouth ſide by the aſcending of the Scorpion, ſo that they shal paſſe into Senna, and reach toward the South as farre as Cadesbarne, from whence the frontiers shal goe forth to the towne named Adar, and shal reach as farre as Aſemona.
label: Numbers

text: And the border shal goe round about from Aſemona to the Torrent of Ægypt, and shal end in the shore of the great ſea.
label: Numbers

text: And the weſt ſide shal beginne from the great ſea, and the ſame shal be the limite therof.
label: Numbers

text: Moreouer toward the North part the borders shal beginne from the greate ſea, reaching vnto the moſt high mountaine,
label: Numbers

text: from he which they shal come vnto Emath as farre as the borders of Sedada:
label: Numbers

text: and the frontiers shal goe as farre as Sephorna, and the towne Enan. Theſe shal be the borders in the North part.
label: Numbers

text: From thence they shal marke out the boundes toward the Eaſt ſide from the village Enan vnto Sephama,
label: Numbers

text: and from Sephama the boundes shal goe downe vnto Rebla againſt the fountaine Daphnim: from thence they shal come eaſtward to the ſea Cenereth,
label: Numbers

text: and shal reach as farre as Iordan, and at the laſt shal be cloſed in by the moſt ſalt ſea. This you shal haue for your Land by the boundes therof round about.
label: Numbers

text: And Moyſes commanded the children of Iſrael, ſaying: This shal be the Land, which you shal poſſeſſe by lotte, and which our Lord hath commanded to be geuen to the nine tribes, and to the halfe tribe.
label: Numbers

text: For the tribe of the children of Ruben by their families, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the number of their kinredes, the halfe alſo of the tribe of Manaſſes,
label: Numbers

text: that is, two tribes and an halfe, haue taken their portion beyond Iordan againſt Iericho at the eaſt ſide.
label: Numbers

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes:
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are the names of the men, that shal diuide the Land vnto you, Eleazar the prieſt, and Ioſue the ſonne of Nun,
label: Numbers

text: and one prince of euerie tribe,
label: Numbers

text: whoſe names are theſe: Of the tribe of Iuda, Caleb the ſonne of Iephone.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Simeon, Samuel the ſonne of Ammiud.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Beniamin Elidad the ſonne of Chaſelon.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bocci the ſonne of Iogli.
label: Numbers

text: Of the children of Ioſeph of the tribe of Manaſſes, Haniel the ſonne of Ephod.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Camuel the ſonne of Sephthan.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Zabulon, Eliſaphan the ſonne of Pharnach.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Iſſachar, duke Phaltiel the ſonne of Ozan.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Aſer, Ahiud the ſonne of Salomi.
label: Numbers

text: Of the tribe of Nephthali: Phedael the ſonne of Ammiud.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are they whom our Lord commanded to diuide the Land of Chanaan to the children of Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: THESE thinges alſo ſpake our Lord to Moyſes in the champion countries of Moab vpon Iordan, againſt Iericho:
label: Numbers

text: Command the children of Iſrael that they geue vnto the Leuites of their poſſeſſions
label: Numbers

text: cities to dwel in, and their ſuburbes round about: that them ſelues may abide in the townes, and the ſuburbes may be for their cattel and beaſtes:
label: Numbers

text: which from the walles of the cities outward, round about, shal reach the ſpace of a thouſand paces.
label: Numbers

text: Toward the Eaſt shal be two thouſand cubites: and toward the South in like manner ſhal be two thouſand: toward the ſea alſo, which looketh to the Weſt, ſhal be the ſame meaſure: and the North part shal be limitted with equal boundes. And the cities shal be in the middes, and the ſuburbes without.
label: Numbers

text: And of the ſame townes, which you shal geue to the Leuites, ſix ſhal be ſeparated for the ayde of fugitiues, that he may flee to them which hath shed bloud: and beſide theſe other fourtie two townes,
label: Numbers

text: that is, in al fourtie eight with their ſuburbes.
label: Numbers

text: And thoſe cities, that shal be geuen of the poſſeſſions of the children of Iſrael, from them that haue more, moe shal be taken away: and that haue leſſe, fewer. Eache shal geue townes to the Leuites according to the meaſure of their inheritance.
label: Numbers

text: Our Lord ſaid to Moyſes:
label: Numbers

text: Speake to the children of Iſrael, & thou shalt ſay to them: When you shal haue paſſed ouer Iordan into the Land of Chanaan,
label: Numbers

text: determine what cities shal be for the ſuccour of fugitiues, that haue not voluntaryly shed bloud:
label: Numbers

text: in which when the fugitiue shal be, the kinſeman of him that is killed can not kil him, vntil he ſtand in the ſight of the multitude, and his cauſe be iudged.
label: Numbers

text: And of thoſe cities, that are ſeparated for refuge of the fugitiues,
label: Numbers

text: three shal be beyond Iordan, and three in the Land of Chanaan,
label: Numbers

text: as wel for the children of Iſrael as for ſtrangers and ſoiouners, that he may flee to them, which hath not voluntaryly shed bloud.
label: Numbers

text: If any man ſtrike with yron, and he die that was ſtrooken, he shal be guiltie of murder, and him ſelf shal die.
label: Numbers

text: If he caſt a ſtone, and he that is ſtrooken die: he shal be punished in like manner.
label: Numbers

text: If he that is ſtrooken with wood die, he shal be reuenged by the ſtrikers bloud.
label: Numbers

text: The kinſman of him that is ſlaine, shal kil the murderer, as ſowne as he apprehendeth him, he shal kil him.
label: Numbers

text: If through hatred one push a man, or caſt any thing at him by ſtratageme:
label: Numbers

text: or being his enemie, ſtrike him with his hand, and he die: the ſtriker shal be guiltie of murder. the kinſeman of him that is ſlaine as ſowne as he findeth him, shal kil him.
label: Numbers

text: But if by chance medlie, and without hatred,
label: Numbers

text: and enemitie, he do any of theſe thinges,
label: Numbers

text: and this be proued in the hearing of the people, and the queſtion debated betwen him that ſtroke, & the next of bloud:
label: Numbers

text: the innocent shal be deliuered from the hand of the reuenger, & by ſentence shal be brought backe into the citie, to which he had fled, and he shal tarie there, vntil the High prieſt, that is anointed with the holie oile, do die.
label: Numbers

text: If the murderer be found without the limites of the cities, that are deputed to the banished,
label: Numbers

text: and be ſtrooken of him that is the reuenger of bloud: he shal be guiltles that killed him.
label: Numbers

text: For the fugitiue ought to haue ſtayed in the citie vntil the death of the High prieſt. And after he is dead, then shal the murderer returne into his countrie.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe thinges shal be perpetual, and for an ordinance in al your habitations.
label: Numbers

text: The murderer shal be punished by witneſſes: none shal be condemned, at the teſtimonie of one man.
label: Numbers

text: You shal not take a price of him, that is guiltie of bloud, he alſo shal die forthwith.
label: Numbers

text: The banished and fugitiues before the death of the High prieſt may by no meanes returne into their owne cities.
label: Numbers

text: Pollute not the land of your habitation, which is polluted with the bloud of innocentes: neither can it otherwiſe be expiated, but by his bloud, that shedeth an other mans bloud.
label: Numbers

text: And ſo shal your poſſeſſion be cleanſed my ſelf abyding with you. For I am the Lord that dwel among the children of Iſrael.
label: Numbers

text: AND the princes alſo of the families of Galaad, the ſonne of Machir, the ſonne of Manaſſes of the ſtocke of the children of Ioſeph came: and ſpake to Moyſes before the princes of Iſrael, and ſaid:
label: Numbers

text: Our Lord hath commanded thee our lord that thou shouldeſt by lotte diuide the Land to the children of Iſrael, and that to the daughters of Salphaad our brother thou shouldeſt geue the poſſeſſion dew to their father:
label: Numbers

text: Whom if men of an other tribe take to wiues, their poſſeſſion shal folow, and being tranſlated to an other tribe, it shal be a diminishing of our inheritance.
label: Numbers

text: And ſo it shal come to paſſe, that when the Iubilee, that is the fiftith yeare of remiſſion is come, the diſtribution of the lottes shal be confounded, and the poſſeſſion of one shal paſſe to others.
label: Numbers

text: Moyſes anſwered the children of Iſrael, and as our Lord commanded, ſaid: The tribe of the children of Ioſeph hath ſpoken rightly.
label: Numbers

text: And this law is promulgated of our Lord touching the daughters of Salphaad: Let them marrie to whom they wil, onlie that it be to the men of their owne tribe:
label: Numbers

text: leſt the poſſeſſion of the children of Iſrael be mingled from tribe into tribe. For al men shal marrie wiues of their owne tribe and kinred:
label: Numbers

text: and al wemen shal take huſbandes of the ſame tribe: that the inheritance may remaine in the families,
label: Numbers

text: and that the tribes be not mingled among themſelues, but remaine ſo
label: Numbers

text: as they were ſeparated by our Lord. And the daughters of Salphaad did as it had beene commanded:
label: Numbers

text: and Maala, and Therſa, and Hegla, and Melcha, and Noa were married to the ſonnes of their vncle by their father
label: Numbers

text: of the familie of Manaſſes, who was the ſonne of Ioſeph: and the poſſeſſion, that had beene allotted to them, remained in the tribe and familie of their father.
label: Numbers

text: Theſe are the commandementes and iudgementes, which our Lord commanded by the hand of Moyſes to the children of Iſrael, in the champion countries of Moab vpon Iordan againſt Iericho.
label: Numbers

text: THESE are the wordes, which Moyſes ſpake to al Iſrael beyond Iordan, in the champion wilderneſſe, againſt the Read ſea, betwen Pharan and Thophel and Laban and Haſeroth, where there is verie much gold:
label: Deuteronomy

text: eleuen daies from Horeb by the way of mount Seir to Cadesbarne.
label: Deuteronomy

text: fourtith yeare, the eleuenth moneth, the firſt day of the moneth Moyſes ſpake to the children of Iſrael al thinges that our Lord had commanded him to ſay vnto them:
label: Deuteronomy

text: after that he had ſtroke Sehon king of the Amorrheites, which dwelt in Heſebon: and Og the king of Baſan which abode in Aſeroth, and in Edrai,
label: Deuteronomy

text: beyond Iordan in the Land of Moab. And Moyſes began to expound the law, and to ſay:
label: Deuteronomy

text: The Lord our God ſpake to vs in Horeb, ſaying: It is ſufficient for you that you haue ſtayed in this mountaine:
label: Deuteronomy

text: returne, and come to the mountaine of the Amorrheites, and to the reſt that are next to it champion and hillie and lower places againſt the South, and beſide the shore of the ſea, the Land of the Chananeites, and of Libanus vnto the greate riuer Euphrates.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Behold (quoth he) I haue deliuered it to you: enter in and poſſeſſe it, vpon the which our Lord ſware to your fathers Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob, that he would geue it to them, and to their ſeede after them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And I ſaid to you at that time:
label: Deuteronomy

text: I alone can not ſuſteyne you: becauſe the Lord your God hath multiplied you, and you are this day as the ſtarres of heauen, verie manie.
label: Deuteronomy

text: (The Lord God of your fathers adde to this number manie thouſandes, and bleſſe you as he hath ſpoken.)
label: Deuteronomy

text: I alone am not able to ſuſteyne your buſineſſes, and the charge of you and your quareles.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Geue from among you wiſe and skilful men, and ſuch whoſe conuerſation is approued in your tribes, that I may appoint them your princes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Then you anſwered me: The thing is good which thou meaneſt to do.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And I tooke of your tribes men wiſe and noble, and appointed them princes, tribunes, and centurions, and quinquagenarians, and deanes, that might teach you al thinges.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And I commanded them, ſaying: Heare them, and iudge that which is iuſt: whether he be the ſame countrie man, or a ſtranger.
label: Deuteronomy

text: There shal be no difference of perſons, ſo shal you heare the litle as the great: neither shal you accept any mans perſon, becauſe it is the iudgement of God. And if any thing ſeme hard to you, referre it to me, and I wil heare it.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And I commanded al thinges that you ought to do.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And departing from Horeb, we paſſed through the rerrible and huge wilderneſſe, which you ſaw, by the way of the mountaine of the Amorrheite, as the Lord our God had commanded vs. And when we were come into Cadesbarne,
label: Deuteronomy

text: I ſaid to you: You are come to the mountaine of the Amorrheite, which the Lord our God wil geue to vs.
label: Deuteronomy

text: See the Land which the Lord thy God geueth thee: goe vp and poſſeſſe it, as the Lord our God hath ſpoken to thy fathers: feare not, neither dread you any thing.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And you came al vnto me, and ſaid: Let vs ſend men that may view the Land: and may bring vs word what way we shal aſcend, and to what cities to goe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And becauſe the ſaying pleaſed me, I ſent of you twelue men, one of euerie tribe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Who when they had gone, and were aſcended into the mountaines, they came as farre as the Valley of cluſter: and the Land being viewed,
label: Deuteronomy

text: taking of the fruites therof, to shew the fruitfulneſſe, they brought vnto vs, and ſaid: The Land is good, which the Lord our God wil geue vs.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And you would not goe vp, but being incredulous at the wotd of the Lord our God,
label: Deuteronomy

text: you murmured in your tabernacles, and ſaid: Our Lord hateth vs, and therfore hath brought vs out of the Land of Ægypt, that he might deliuer vs into the hand of the Amorrheite, and deſtroy vs.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Whither ſhal we goe vp? the meſſengers haue feared our hart, ſaying: The multitude is verie great, and taller of ſtature then we: the cities greate, and fenſed euen vnto heauen, the ſonnes of the Enacims we haue ſeene there.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And I ſaid to you: Feare not, neither be ye afrayd of them:
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord God, which is your conductour, him ſelf wil fight for you, as he did in Ægypt in the ſight of al.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And in the wilderneſſe (thy ſelfe haſte ſeene) the Lord thy God hath caried thee, as a man is wont to beare his litle ſonne, al the way, that you haue walked, vntil you came to this place.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And neither ſo did you beleue the Lord your God,
label: Deuteronomy

text: who went before you in the way, and marked out the place, wherein you ſhould pitch your tentes, in the night shewing you the way by fyre, and in the day by the piller of a clowde.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when our Lord had heard the voice of your wordes, being wrath he ſware and ſaid:
label: Deuteronomy

text: There shal not any of the men of this wicked generation ſee the good Land, which by oath I promiſed to your fathers:
label: Deuteronomy

text: beſide Caleb the ſonne of Iephone. For he shal ſee it, and to him I wil geue the Land, that he hath troden, and to his children, becauſe he hath folowed the Lord.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Neither is his indignation againſt the people to be merueiled at, wheras our Lord being angrie with me alſo for you, ſaid: Neither shalt thou enter in thither.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But Ioſue the ſonne of Nun thy miniſter, he shal enter for thee: exhort and ſtrenghen him, and he shal by lotte diuide the Land to Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Your litle ones, of whom you ſaid that they should be ledde captiues, and your ſonnes that this day know not the difference of good and euil, they shal enter in: and to them I wil geue the Land, and they shal poſſeſſe it.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But returne you and goe into the wilderneſſe by the way of the Reddeſea.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And you anſwered me: We haue ſinned to our Lord: we wil goe vp and fight, as the Lord our God hath commanded. And when you readie armed went vnto the mountaine,
label: Deuteronomy

text: our Lord ſaid to me: Say to them: Goe not vp, and fight not, for I am not with you: leſt you fal before your enemies.
label: Deuteronomy

text: I ſpake, and you heard not: but reſiſting the commandement of our Lord, and ſwelling with pride you went vp into the mountaine.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Therfore the Amorrheite that dwelt in the mountaines iſſuing forth, and coming to meete you, purſewed you, as bees are wont to purſew: and ſmote you from Seir as farre as Horma.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when returning you wept before our Lord, he heard you not, neither would he condeſcend to your voice.
label: Deuteronomy

text: You abode therfore in Cadesbarne a great time.
label: Deuteronomy

text: ANd departing thence we came into the wilderneſſe, that leadeth to the Redde ſea, as our Lord had ſaid to me: and we compaſſed the mountaine Seir a long time.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord ſaid to me:
label: Deuteronomy

text: It is ſufficient for you to haue compaſſed this mountaine: goe toward the North.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And command thou the people, ſaying: You shal paſſe by the borders of your brethren the children of Eſau, which dwel in Seir, and they wil be affraid of you.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Looke diligently therfore that you ſturre not againſt them. For I wil not geue you of their land ſo much as the ſteppe of one foote can treade, becauſe I haue geuen the mountaine Seir to be the poſſeſſion of Eſau.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Meates you shal bie of them with money, and shal eate: bought water shal you draw, and drinke.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The Lord thy God hath bleſſed thee in euerie worke of thy handes: he knoweth thy iourney, how thou haſt paſſed this great wilderneſſe, for fourtie yeares the Lord thy God dwelling with thee, & thou haſt wanted nothing.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when we had paſſed by our brethren the children of Eſau, that dwelt in Seir, by the champion way from Elath & from Aſiongaber, we came to the way, that leadeth into the deſert of Moab.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord ſaid to me: Fight not againſt the Moabites, neither make battel againſt them: for I wil not geue thee any of their land, becauſe I haue geuen Ar to the children of Lot in poſſeſſion.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Emim firſt were the inhabiters therof, a great people, and valiant, and ſo tall that they were thought,
label: Deuteronomy

text: as it were giantes, of the Enacims ſtocke, & were like the children of the Enacims. Moreouer the Moabites cal them Emim.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But in Seir before dwelt the Horrins: who being expelled and deſtroyed, the children of Eſau did inhabite it, as Iſrael did in the land of his poſſeſſion, which our Lord gaue him.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Ryſing vp therfore to paſſe the Torrent Zared, we came to it.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And the time, that we walked from Cadeſbarne vnto the paſſage of the torrent Zared, was thirtie and eight yeares: vntil al the generation of the men that were warriers was conſumed out of the campe, as our Lord had ſworne:
label: Deuteronomy

text: whoſe hand was againſt them, that they should perish from among the campe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And after al the warryers were dead,
label: Deuteronomy

text: our Lord ſpake to me, ſaying:
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt paſſe this day the borders of Moab, the citie named Ar:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and approching vnto the frontiers of the children of Ammon, beware thou fight not againſt them, neither once moue to battel: for I wil not geue thee of the land of the children of Ammon, becauſe I haue geuen it to the children of Lot in poſſeſſion.
label: Deuteronomy

text: It was reputed the land of giantes: and giantes in old time dwelt in it, whom the Ammonites cal Zomzommim,
label: Deuteronomy

text: a great and huge people, and of long ſtature, as the Enacims whom our Lord deſtroyed before their face: and he made them to dwel in their ſteede,
label: Deuteronomy

text: as he had done to the children of Eſau, that dwelt in Seir, deſtroying the Horrheites, and deliuering their land to them, which they poſſeſſe vntil this preſent.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The Heueites alſo, that dwelt in Haſerim as farre as Gaza, the Capadocians expelled: who iſſuing out of Capadocia, deſtroyed them, and dwelt in their ſteede.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Ariſe ye, and paſſe the torrent Arnon: behold I haue deliuered in thy hand Sehon king of Heſebon the Amorrheite, and beginne to poſſeſſe his land, and make warre againſt him.
label: Deuteronomy

text: This day wil I beginne to ſend thy terrour and feare vpon the peoples, that dwel vnder the whole heauen: that hearing thy name they may quake, and tremble after the manner of women in trauel, and be pinched with ſorow.
label: Deuteronomy

text: I ſent therfore meſſengers from the wildernes of Cademoth to Sehon the king of Heſebon with peaceable wordes, ſaying:
label: Deuteronomy

text: We wil paſſe through thy land, we wil goe the common high way: we wil not decline neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Sel vs meates for money, that we may eate: Geue vs water for money, and ſo we wil drinke. Onlie this that thou wilt graunt vs paſſage,
label: Deuteronomy

text: as the children of Eſau haue done, that dwel in Seir, and the Moabites, that abide in Ar: vntil we come to Iordan, and paſſe to the Land, which the Lord our God wil geue vs.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And Sehon the king of Heſebon would not geue vs paſſage: becauſe the Lord thy God had indurated his ſpirit, and hardened his hart, that he might be deliuered into thy handes, as now thou ſeeſt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord ſaid to me: Behold I haue begunne to deliuer Sehon vnto thee, and his land, beginne to poſſeſſe it.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And Sehon came forth to meete vs with al his people to battel in Iaſa.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And the Lord our God deliuered him to vs: and we ſmote him with his ſonnes and al his people.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And al his cities we tooke at that time, killing the inhabiters therof, men and women and litle ones. we left nothing among them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Except the cattel, which came to their portion that tooke prayes: and the ſpoyles of the cities, which we tooke
label: Deuteronomy

text: from Aroer, which is vpon the banke of the torrent Arnon, a towne that is ſituated in a valley, as farre as Galaad. There was not a village or citie, that eſcaped our handes: the Lord our God deliuered al vnto vs.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Except the land of the children of Ammon, to the which we approched not: and al that adioyne to the torrent Ieboc, and the cities on the mountaine, and al the places, from which the Lord our God prohibited vs.
label: Deuteronomy

text: THERFORE turning we went vp by the way of Baſan: and Og the king of Baſan came forth to meete vs with his people to fight in Edrai.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord ſaid to me: Feare him not: becauſe he is deliuered into thy hand with al his people and his land: and thou ſhalt doe to him as thou haſt done to Sehon king of the Amorrheites, that dwelt in Heſebon.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Therfore the Lord our God deliuered into our handes Og alſo the king of Baſan, and al his people: and we ſtroke them to vtter deſtruction,
label: Deuteronomy

text: waiſting al his cities at one time. there was not a towne that eſcaped vs: ſixtie cities, al the countrie of Argob the kingdome of Og in Baſan.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Al the cities were fenſed with verie high walles, and with gates and barres, beſide innumerable townes that had no walles.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And we deſtroyed them, as we had done to Sehon the king of Heſebon, deſtroying euerie citie, and men and wemen and children:
label: Deuteronomy

text: but the cattel, and the ſpoyles of the cities we tooke for our praye.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And we tooke at that time the land out of the hand of two kinges of the Amorrheites, that were beyond Iordan: from the torrent Arnon vnto the mountaine Hermon,
label: Deuteronomy

text: which the Sidonians cal Sarion, and the Amorrheites Sanir:
label: Deuteronomy

text: al the cities, that are ſituated in the plaine, and al the Land of Galaad and Baſan as farre as Selcha, and Edrai cities of the kingdome of Og in Baſan.
label: Deuteronomy

text: For onlie Og the king of Baſan remayned of the ſtocke of giantes. his bed of yron is shewed, which is in Rabbath of the children of Ammon, hauing nine cubites in length, and foure in breadth after the meaſure of the cubite of a mans hand.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And we poſſeſſed the Land at that time from Aroer, which is vpon the banke of the torrent Arnon, vnto the halfe part of mount Galaad: and the cities therof I gaue to Ruben and Gad.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And the other part of Galaad, and al Baſan of the kingdome of Og, I deliuered to the halfe tribe of Manaſſes, al the countrie of Argob: and al Baſan is called the Land of giantes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Iair the ſonne of Manaſſes poſſeſſed al the countrie of Argob vnto the borders of Geſſuri, and Machati. And he called Baſan by his owne name, Hauoth Iair, that is to ſay, the townes of Iair, vntil this preſent day.
label: Deuteronomy

text: To Machir alſo I gaue Galaad.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And to the tribes of Ruben and Gad I gaue of the Land of Galaad as farre as the Torrent Arnon, halfe of the torrent, and the confines vnto the torrent Ieboc, which is the border of the children of Ammon:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and the plaine of the wilderneſſe, and Iordan, and the borders of Cenereth vnto the ſea of the deſert, which is moſt ſalt, at the foote of mount Phaſga againſt the eaſt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And I commãded you at that time, ſaying: The Lord your God geueth you this land for an inheritance, goe wel appointed before your brethren the children of Iſrael al you ſtrong men:
label: Deuteronomy

text: except your wiues, and litle ones and your cattel. For I know you haue much cattel, & they muſt remaine in the cities, which I haue deliuered you,
label: Deuteronomy

text: vntil our Lord geue reſt to your brethren, as he hath geuen to you: and they alſo poſſeſſe the Land, which he wil geue them beyond Iordan: then shal euerie man returne to his poſſeſſion, which I haue geuen you.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Ioſue alſo at that time I commanded, ſaying: Thyne eyes haue ſeene what the Lord your God hath done to theſe two kinges: ſo wil he doe to al the kingdomes, to the which thou shalt paſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Feare them not: for the Lord your God wil fight for you.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And I prayed our Lord at that time, ſaying:
label: Deuteronomy

text: Lord God thou haſt begonne to shew vnto thy ſeruant thy greatnes, and moſt mightie hand. for neither is there other God either in heauen, or in earth, that is able to doe thy workes, and to be compared to thy ſtrength.
label: Deuteronomy

text: I wil paſſe ouer therfore, and wil ſee this excellent Land beyond Iordan, and this goodlie mountaine, and Libanus.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord was angrie with me for you, and heard me not, but ſaid to me: It ſufficeth thee: ſpeake no more to me of this matter.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Goe vp to the toppe of Phaſga, and caſt thine eies round about to the weſt, and to the north, and the ſouth, and the eaſt, and behold it. for thou shalt not paſſe this Iordan.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Command Ioſue, and encourage and ſtrenghen him: for he shal goe before this people, and shal diuide vnto them the Land, which thou shalt ſee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And we abode in the valley againſt the temple of Phogor.
label: Deuteronomy

text: AND now Iſrael heare the preceptes and iudgementes, which I teach thee: that doing them, thou mayeſt liue, and entring in mayeſt poſſeſſe the Land, which the Lord the God of your fathers wil geue you.
label: Deuteronomy

text: You shal not adde to the word, that I ſpeake to you, neither shal you take away from it: keepe the commandment of the Lord your God which I command you.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Your eyes haue ſeene al thinges that our Lord hath done againſt Beelphegor, how he hath deſtroyed al his worshippers out of the middes of you.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But you that cleaue to the Lord your God, liue al vntil this preſent day.
label: Deuteronomy

text: You know that I haue taught you preceptes and iuſtices, as the Lord my God hath commanded me: ſo shal you do them in the Land, which you shal poſſeſſe:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and you shal obſerue, and fulfil them in worke. For this is your wiſedome, and vnderſtanding before peoples, that hearing al theſe preceptes, may ſay: Behold a people ful of wiſedome and vnderſtanding, a great nation.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Neither is there other nation ſo great, that hath goddes approching vnto them, as our God is preſent at al our petitions.
label: Deuteronomy

text: For what other nation is there ſo renowmed that hath the ceremonies, and iuſt iudgementes, and the whole law, which I wil ſette forth this day before your eyes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Keepe thy ſelfe therfore, and thy ſoule carefully. Forget not the wordes, that thyne eyes haue ſeene, and let them not fal out of thy hart al the daies of thy life. Thou shalt teach them thy ſonnes and thy nephewes,
label: Deuteronomy

text: the day wherin thou didſt ſtand before the Lord thy God in Horeb, when our Lord ſpake to me, ſaying: Aſſemble vnto me the people, that they may heare my wordes, and may learne to feare me al the time that they liue on the earth, and may teach their children.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And you came to the foote of the mount, which burned euen vnto heauen: and there was in it darkenes, and a clould and miſt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord ſpake to you from the middes of the fyre. The voice of his wordes you heard, and forme you ſaw not at al.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And he shewed you his couenant, which he commanded you to do, and the tenne wordes, that he wrote in two tables of ſtone.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And he cōmanded me at that time that I should teach you the ceremonies and iudgementes, which you should doe in the Land, that you shal poſſeſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Keepe therfore your ſoules carefully. You ſaw not any ſimilitude in the day, that our Lord ſpake to you in Horeb from the middes of the fire:
label: Deuteronomy

text: leſt perhaps deceiued you might make you a grauen ſimilitude, or image of male or female,
label: Deuteronomy

text: the ſimilitude of al cattel, that are vpon the earth, or of birdes, that flie vnder heauen,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and of creeping beaſtes, that moue on the earth, or of fishes, that vnder the earth abide in the waters:
label: Deuteronomy

text: leſt perhapes lifting vp thyne eies to heauen, thou ſee the Sunne and the Moone, and al the ſtarres of heauen, and deceiued by errour thou adore and ſerue them, which the Lord thy God created to ſerue al nations, that are vnder heauen.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But you our Lord hath taken, and brought out of the yron furnace of Ægypt, to haue you his people by inheritance, as it is this preſent day.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord was angrie with me for your wordes, and he ſware that I ſhould not paſſe ouer Iordan, nor enter into the excellent Land, which he wil geue you.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Behold I die in this ground, I shal not paſſe ouer Iordan: you shal paſſe, and poſſeſſe the goodlie Land.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Beware leſt at any time thou forget the couenant of the Lord thy God, which he hath made with thee: and make to thee a grauen ſimilitude of thoſe thinges, which our Lord hath prohibited to be made:
label: Deuteronomy

text: becauſe the Lord thy God is a conſuming fyre, ielouſe God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If you shal begette ſonnes and nephewes, and abide in the Land, and being deceiued make to you ſome ſimilitude, committing euil before the Lord your God, to prouoke him to wrarh:
label: Deuteronomy

text: I cal this day heauen and earth witneſſes, that you shal quikly perish from out of the Land, which being paſſed ouer Iordan you shal poſſeſſe. You shal not dwel therin long time, but our Lotd wil deſtroy you,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and diſperſe you into al nations, and you shal remaine a few among the nations, to the which our Lord wil lead you.
label: Deuteronomy

text: and there you shal ſerue goddes, that were framed with mens hand, wood and ſtone that ſee not, nor heare, nor eate, nor ſmel.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when thou shalt ſeeke there the Lord thy God, thou shalt finde him: yet ſo, if thou ſeeke him with al thy hart, and al tribulation of thy ſoule.
label: Deuteronomy

text: After that al the thinges aforeſaid shal finde thee, and in the latter time thou shalt returne to the Lord thy God, and shalt heare his voice.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Becauſe the Lord thy God is a merciful God: he wil not leaue thee, nor altogether deſtroy thee, nor forget the couenant, wherein he ſware to thy fathers.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Aske of the dayes of old, that haue bene before thy time from the day that God created man vpon the earth, from one end of heauen to the other end therof, if euer there was done the like thing, or it hath beene knowen at any time,

text: that a people should heare the voice of God ſpeaking out of the middes of fyre, as thou haſt heard, and liued:
label: Deuteronomy

text: if God ſo did that he went in, and tooke vnto him a Nation out of the middes of nations, by temptations, ſignes, and wonders, by fight and ſtrong hand, and ſtretched out arme, and horrible viſions according to al thinges, that the Lord your God did for you in Ægypt, thine eies ſeeing it:

text: that thou mighteſt know that our Lord, he is God, and there is none other beſide him,
label: Deuteronomy

text: from heauen he made thee to heare his voice, that he might teach thee. And in earth he shewed thee his fyre, verie greate, and thou didſt heare his wordes out of the middes of the fyre,

label: Deuteronomy

text: Know therfore this day, and thinke in thy hart that our Lord he is God in heauen aboue, and in the earth beneth, and there is none other.
label: Deuteronomy

label: Deuteronomy

text: from Aroer, which is ſituated vpon the banke of the torrent Arnon, vnto the mountaine Sion, which is alſo Hermon,

label: Deuteronomy

label: Deuteronomy

label: Deuteronomy
