label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not haue ſtrange goddes in my ſight.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not make to thee a thing grauen, nor the ſimilitude of any thinges, that are in heauen aboue, and that are in the earth beneath, and that abide in the waters vnder the earth.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not adore them, and thou ſhalt not ſerue them. For I am the Lord thy God, a Iealouſe God, rendering the iniquitie of the fathers vpon the children vnto the third and fourth generation to them that hate me,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and doing mercie vpon manie thouſandes to them that loue me, and keepe my preceptes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not vſurpe the name of the Lord thy God in vaine: for he shal not be vnpunished that taketh his name vpon a vaine thing.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Obſerue the day of the Sabbath, to ſanctifie it, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Six dayes shalt thou worke, and shalt doe al thy workes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The ſeuenth is the day of the Sabbath, that is, the reſt of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not doe any worke therin, thou, and thy ſonne and daughter, man ſeruant and woman ſeruant, and oxe, and aſſe, and al thy cattel, and the ſtranger that is within thy gates: that thy man ſeruant may reſt, and thy woman ſeruant, euen as thy ſelfe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Remember that thou alſo dideſt ſerue in Ægypt, and the Lord thy God brought thee out from thence in a ſtrong hand, and ſtretched out arme. Therfore hath he commanded thee that thou shouldeſt obſerue the Sabbath.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Honour thy father and mother, as our Lord thy God hath commanded thee, that thou mayſt liue a long time, and it may be wel with thee in the Land, which the Lord thy God wil geue thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not murder.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Neither shalt thou committe aduoutrie.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And thou shal not ſteale.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Neither shalt thou ſpeake againſt thy neighbour falſe teſtimonie.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not couet thy neighbours wife: Nor houſe, nor field, nor man ſeruant, nor woman ſeruant, nor oxe, nor aſſe, and al thinges that are his.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Theſe wordes ſpake our Lord to al your multitude in the mount, out of the middes of the fire and the cloude, and the darkenes, with a loude voice, adding nothing more: and he wrote them in the two tables of ſtone, which he deliuered vnto me.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And you after you heard the voice out of the middes of the darkenes, and ſaw the mount burne, came to me al the princes of the tribes and the elders, and you ſaid:
label: Deuteronomy

text: Behold the Lord our God hath shewed vs his maieſtie and greatnes, for we haue heard his voice out of the middes of the fire, and haue proued this day that God ſpeaking with man, man hath liued.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Why shal we die therfore, and this exceding great fire deuoure vs? For if we heare the voice of the Lord our God any more, we shal die.
label: Deuteronomy

text: What is al flesh, that it should heare the voice of the liuing God, who ſpeaketh out of the middes of the fire as we haue heard, and may liue?
label: Deuteronomy

text: Approche thou rather: and heare al thinges that the Lord our God shal ſay to thee: and thou shalt ſpeake to vs, and we hearing wil doe them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Which when our Lord had heard, he ſaid to me: I haue heard the voice of the wordes of this people, which they ſpake to thee: they haue ſpoken al thinges wel.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Who shal geue them to haue ſuch a minde, that they would feare me, and keepe al my commandementes at al time, that it may be wel with them and with their children for euer?
label: Deuteronomy

text: Goe and ſay to them: Returne into your tentes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But thou ſtand here with me, and I wil ſpeake to thee al my commandementes, and ceremonies and iudgementes: which thou shalt teach them, that they may doe them in the Land, which I wil geue them in poſſeſſion.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Keepe therfore and doe the thinges which our Lord God hath commanded you: you shal not decline neither to the right hand, nor to the left:
label: Deuteronomy

text: but the way that the Lord your God hath commanded shal you walke, that you may liue, and it may be wel with you, and your daies may be prolonged in the land of your poſſeſſion.
label: Deuteronomy

text: THESE are the preceptes, and ceremonies, and iudgementes, which the Lord your God commanded that I should teach you, and you should doe them in the Land, whereunto you paſſe ouer to poſſeſſe it:
label: Deuteronomy

text: that thou mayeſt feare the Lord thy God, and keepe his commandementes and preceptes, which I command thee, and thy ſonnes, and nephewes, al the dayes of thy life, that thy dayes may be prolonged.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Heare Iſrael, and obſerue that thou doe the thinges which our Lord hath commanded thee, and it may be wel with thee, and thou mayeſt be greately multiplied, as the Lord God of thy fathers hath promiſed thee a land flowĩg with milke and honie.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Heare Iſrael, The Lord our God, is one Lord.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt loue the Lord thy God with thy whole hart, and with thy whole ſoule, and with thy whole ſtrength.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And theſe wordes, which I command thee this day, shal be in thy hart:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou shalt tel them to thy children, and thou shalt meditate ſitting in thy houſe, and walking on thy iourney, ſleeping, and ryſing.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And thou shalt bind them as a ſigne on thy hand, and they shal be & shal moue betwen thine eies,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou shalt write them in the entrie, and on the doores of thy houſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when the Lord thy God shal haue brought thee into the Land, for the which he ſware to thy fathers Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob: and shal haue geuen thee great and goodlie cities, which thou didſt not build,
label: Deuteronomy

text: houſes ful of al riches, which thou didſt not erect, ceſternes which thou didſt not digge, vineyardes and oliueyardes, which thou didſt not plant,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou shalt haue eaten and be ful:
label: Deuteronomy

text: take heede diligently leſt thou forget our Lord, that brought thee out of the Land of Ægypt, out of the houſe of ſeuitude. Thou shalt feare the Lord thy God, and him onelie shalt thou ſerue, and by his name shalt thou ſweare.
label: Deuteronomy

text: You shal not goe after the ſtrange goddes of al Nations, that are round about you:
label: Deuteronomy

text: becauſe the Lord thy God is a Iealouſe God in the middes of thee: leſt ſometime the furie of the Lord thy God be wrath againſt thee, and take thee away from the face of the earth.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God, as thou didſt tempt him in the place of tentation.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Keepe the preceptes of the Lord thy God, and the teſtimonies and ceremonies, which he hath commanded thee:
label: Deuteronomy

text: And doe that which is pleaſant and good in the ſight of our Lord, that it may be wel with thee: and entring in thou mayeſt poſſeſſe the goodlie Land, wherof our Lord ſware to thy fathers,
label: Deuteronomy

text: that he would deſtroy al thy enemies before thee, as he hath ſpoken.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when thy ſonne shal aske thee to morrow, ſaying: What meane theſe teſtimonies, and ceremonies, and iudgementes, which the Lord our God hath commanded vs?
label: Deuteronomy

text: thou shalt ſay to him: We were the bondmen of Pharao in Ægypt, and our Lord brought vs out of Ægypt in a ſtrong hand:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and he did ſignes & wonders great and verie ſore in Ægypt againſt Pharao, and al his houſe, in our ſight,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and he brought vs out from thence, that being brought in he might geue vs the Land, wherupon he ſware to our fathers.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord commanded that we should doe al theſe ordinances, and should feare the Lord our God, that it might be wel with vs al the daies of our life, as it is at this day.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And he wil be merciful to vs, if we keepe and doe al his preceptes before the Lord our God, as he commanded vs.
label: Deuteronomy

text: WHEN the Lord thy God shal haue brought thee into the land, which thou doeſt enter in to poſſeſſe, and shal haue deſtroyed manie Nations before thee, the Hetheite, and the Gergezeite, and the Amorrheite, and the Chananeite, and the Pherezeite, and the Heueite, and the Iebuſeite, ſeuen nations of much greater number then thou art, and ſtronger then thou:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and the Lord thy God shal haue deliuered them to thee, thou shalt ſtrike them vnto vtter deſtruction. Thou shalt not make league with them, nor pitie them,
label: Deuteronomy

text: nor make mariages with them. Thy daughter thou shalt not geue to his ſonne, nor take his daughter for thy ſonne:
label: Deuteronomy

text: for he wil ſeduce thy ſonne, that he folow not me, and that he rather ſerue ſtrange goddes, and the furie of our Lord wil be wrath, and shal quickly deſtroy thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But theſe thinges rather you shal doe to them: Ouerthrow their altares, and breake their ſtatuees, and cutte downe their groues, and burne their ſculptiles.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Becauſe thou art a holie people to the Lord thy God. The Lord thy God hath choſen thee, to be his peculiar people of al peoples, that are vpon the earth.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Not becauſe you paſſed al nations in number, is our Lord ioyned vnto you, and hath choſen you, wheras you are fewer then al peoples:
label: Deuteronomy

text: but becauſe our Lord hath loued you, and hath kept the oath, which he ſware to your fathers: and hath brought you forth in a ſtrong hand, and redemed you from the houſe of ſeruitude, out of the hand of Pharao the king of Ægypt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And thou shalt know that the Lord thy God, he is a ſtrong and faithful God, keping his couenant and mercie to them that loue him, and to them that keepe his preceptes, vnto a thouſand generations:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and rendring forthwith to them that hate him, ſo that he deſtroyeth them, and differreth no longer, immediatly rendering to them that they deſerue.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Keepe therfore the preceptes and ceremonies and iudgementes, which I command thee this day to doe them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If after thou haſt heard theſe iudgementes, thou keepe and doe them, the Lord alſo thy God wil keepe the couenant vnto thee, and the mercie which he ſware to thy fathers:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and he wil loue and multiplie thee, and wil bleſſe the fruite of thy wombe, and the fruite of thy land, thy corne, and vintage, oile, and heardes, the flockes of thy sheepe vpon the Land, for the which he ſware to thy fathers that he would geue it thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Bleſſed ſhalt thou be among al peoples. There shal be none barren with thee of neither ſexe, as wel in men as in thy flockes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord wil take away from thee al diſeaſe: and the ſore infirmities of Ægypt, which thou knoweſt, he wil not bring vpon thee, but vpon al thyne enemies.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt deuoure al the peoples, which the Lord thy God wil gene thee. Thyn eye shal not ſpare them, neither shalt thou ſerue their goddes, leſt they be the ruine of thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If thou ſay in thy hart: Theſe nations are moe then I, how shal I be able to deſtroy them?
label: Deuteronomy

text: Feare not, but remember what the Lord thy God did to Pharao and to al the Ægyptians,
label: Deuteronomy

text: the exceding great plagues, which thyne eies ſaw, and the ſignes and wonders, and the ſtrong hand, and the ſtretched out arme, that the Lord thy God might bring thee forth: ſo wil he doe to al peoples, whom thou feareſt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Moreouer hornettes alſo wil the Lord thy God ſend vpon them, vntil he deſtroy and conſume al that eſcaped thee, and can hide them ſelues.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not feare them, becauſe the Lord thy God is in the middes of thee, a mightie God and terrible:
label: Deuteronomy

text: he wil conſume theſe nations in thy ſight by litle and litle and by partes. Thou mayeſt not deſtroy them al together: leſt perhappes the beaſtes of the earth multiplie againſt thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And the Lord thy God wil geue them in thy ſight: and wil kil them vntil they be vtterly deſtroyed.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And he wil deliuer their kinges into thy handes, and thou shalt deſtroy their names vnder heauen: no man shal be able to reſiſt thee, vntil thou deſtroy them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Their ſculptiles thou shalt burne with fyre: thou shalt not couet the ſiluer and gold, wherof they were made, neither shalt thou take to thee any thing therof, leſt thou offend, becauſe it is the abomination of the Lord thy God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Neither shalt thou bring in ought of the Idol into thy houſe, leſt thou become anathema, as alſo that is. As filthines thou shalt deteſt it, and as vncleannes and filth thou shalt account it abominable, becauſe it is anathema.
label: Deuteronomy

text: EVERIE commandement, that I command thee this day, take diligent heede that thou doe it: that you may liue, and be multiplied, and entring in may poſſeſſe the Land, for the which our Lord ſware to your fathers.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And thou shalt remember al the iourney, through the which the Lord thy God hath brought thee fourtie yeares by the deſert, that he might afflict and proue thee, and that the thinges that were in thy hart might be made knowen, whether thou wouldeſt keepe his commandementes or not.
label: Deuteronomy

text: He afflicted thee with penurie, and gaue thee for meate Manna, which thou kneweſt not nor thy fathers: for to shew vnto thee that not in bread onlie a man liue, but in euerie word that procedeth from the mouth of God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thy rayment, wherwith thou waſt couered, hath not decayed for age, and thy foote is not worne, loe this is the fourtith yeare.
label: Deuteronomy

text: That thou mayeſt recount in thy hart, that as a man diſciplineth his ſonne, ſo the Lord thy God hath diſciplined thee,
label: Deuteronomy

text: that thou shouldeſt keepe the cōmandementes of the Lord thy God, & walke in his wayes, and feare him.
label: Deuteronomy

text: For the Lord thy God wil bring thee in vnto a good land, a land of riuers & waters and of fountaynes: in the plains wherof and mountaynes deepe floudes gush out:
label: Deuteronomy

text: a land of wheate, of barley & vineyardes, wherein figge trees and pomegranates, and oliueyardes doe grow: a land of oyle and honie.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Where without any penurie thou shalt eate thy bread, and enioy abundance of al thinges: whoſe ſtones are yron, and out of the mountaynes therof are digged metalles of braſſe:
label: Deuteronomy

text: that when thou haſt eaten, and art ful, thou mayeſt bleſſe the Lord thy God for the excellent land, which he hath geuen thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Obſerue, and beware leſt at any time thou forget the Lord thy God, and neglect his commandementes and iudgementes and ceremonies, which I command thee this day:
label: Deuteronomy

text: leſt after thou haſt eaten and art filled, haſt built goodlie houſes, and dwelled in them,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and shalt haue heardes of oxen and flockes of sheepe, of gold and ſiluer, and of al thinges plentie,
label: Deuteronomy

text: thy hart be lifted vp, and thou remember not the Lord thy God, that brought thee out of the Land of Ægypt, out of the houſe of ſeruitude:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and was thy conductor in the huge and terrible wilderneſſe, wherein was the ſerpent burning with his breath, and the ſcorpion and the dipſas, and no waters at al: who brought forth riuers out of the hardeſt rocke,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and fed thee with Manna in the wilderneſſe, which thy fathers knew not. And after he had afflicted and proued thee, at the laſt he had mercie vpon thee,
label: Deuteronomy

text: leſt thou shouldeſt ſay in thy hart: Myne owne force, and the ſtrength of myne owne hand, haue achieued al theſe thinges for me.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But remember the Lord thy God, that he hath geuen thee ſtrength, that he might fulfil his couenant, concerning which he ſware to thy fathers, as this preſent day sheweth.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But if forgetting the Lord thy God, thou shalt folow ſtrange goddes, and shalt ſerue and adore them: behold now I foretel thee that thou shalt perish vtterly.
label: Deuteronomy

text: As the Nations, which our Lord deſtroyed at thyne entrie, ſo shal you alſo perish, if you be diſobedient to the voice of the Lord your God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: HEARE Iſrael: Thou shalt goe ouer Iordan this day; to poſſeſſe verie greate nations and ſtronger then thy ſelfe, huge cities, and walled euen vnto heauen,
label: Deuteronomy

text: a great people and tal, the ſonnes of the Enacims, whom thou haſt ſeene, and heard, againſt whom no man is able to reſiſt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt know therfore this day that the Lord thy God him ſelfe wil paſſe ouer before thee, a deuouring and conſuming fyre, who shal deſtroy and abolish and bring them to nothing before thy face quickly, as he hath ſpoken to thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Say not in thy hart, when the Lord thy God shal haue deſtroyed them in thy ſight: For my iuſtice hath our Lord brought me in to poſſeſſe this land, wheras theſe nations were deſtroyed for their impieties.
label: Deuteronomy

text: For not becauſe of thy iuſtices, and equitie of thy hart doeſt thou enter in to poſſeſſe their landes: but becauſe they haue done impiouſly, at thy entring in they are deſtroyed: and that our Lord might accomplish his word, which by oath he promiſed to thy fathers Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Know therfore that not for thy iuſtices hath the Lord thy God geuen thee this excellent land in poſſeſſion, wheras thou art a verie ſtiffe necked people.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Remember, and forget not how thou didſt prouoke the Lord thy God to wrath in the wilderneſſe. From the ſame day, that thou cameſt out of Ægypt vnto this place, thou haſt alwayes contended againſt our Lord.
label: Deuteronomy

text: For in Horeb alſo thou didſt prouoke him, and being wrath he would haue deſtroyed thee,
label: Deuteronomy

text: when I went vp into the mounte, to receiue the tables of ſtone, of the couenant which our Lord made with you: and I continewed in the mounte fourtie daies and nightes, not eating bread, nor drinking water.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord gaue me two tables of ſtone written with the finger of God, and conteyning al the wordes that he ſpake to you in the mounte from the middes of the fyre, when the aſſemblie of the people was gathered.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when fourtie dayes were paſſed, and as manie nightes, our Lord gaue me the two tables of ſtone, the tables of couenant,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and he ſaid to me, Ariſe, and goe downe from hence quickly: for thy people, which thou didſt bring out of Ægypt, haue quickly forſaken the way, that thou haſt shewed them, and haue made them a molten idol.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And againe our Lord ſaid to me: I ſee that this people is ſtiffe necked:
label: Deuteronomy

text: ſuffer me that I may deſtroy them, and abolish their name from vnder heauen, and may ſet thee ouer a Nation, that is greater and ſtronger then this.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when I came downe from the burning mounte, and held the two tables of couenant with both handes,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and ſaw that you had ſinned to the Lord your God, and had made you a molten calfe, and had quickly forſaken his way, which he had shewed you:
label: Deuteronomy

text: I caſt the tables out of my handes, and brake them in your ſight.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And I fel downe before our Lord as before, fourtie dayes and nightes not eating bread, nor drinking water, for al your ſinnes, which you committed againſt our Lord, and prouoked him to wrath:
label: Deuteronomy

text: for I feared his indignation and anger, wherwith being moued agaynſt you, he would haue deſtroyed you. And our Lord heard me this time alſo.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Againſt Aaron alſo being exceeding angrie, he would haue deſtroyed him, and for him, in like maner did I pray.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And your ſinne that you had committed, that is, the calfe, I tooke, and burnt it with fyre, and breaking it into peeces, and bringing it wholy into duſt, I threw it into the torrent, that deſcendeth from the mount.
label: Deuteronomy

text: In the burning alſo and in the tentation, and in the Sepulchres of concupiſcence you prouoked our Lord:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and when he ſent you from Cadeſbarne, ſaying. Goe vp, and poſſeſſe the Land, that I haue geuen you, and you contemned the commandement of your Lord God, and did not beleue him, neither would you heare his voice:
label: Deuteronomy

text: but were alwaies rebellious from the day that I beganne to know you.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And I lay before our Lord fourtie dayes and nightes, in the which I humbly beſought him, that he would not deſtroy you as he had threatened:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and praying I ſaid: Lord God, deſtroy not thy people, and thyne inheritance, which thou haſt redemed in thy greatnes, whom thou didſt bring out of Ægypt in a ſtrong hand.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Remember thy ſeruantes Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob: regard not the ſtubbournes of this people, and his impietie and ſinne:
label: Deuteronomy

text: leſt perhappes the inhabitantes of the land, out of which thou haſt brought vs, ſay; The Lord could not bring them in vnto the Land, that he promiſed them, and he hated them: therfore did he bring them forth, that he might kil them in the wildernes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Which are thy people and thyne inheritance, whom thou didſt bring forth in thy great ſtrength, and in thy ſtretched out arme.
label: Deuteronomy

text: AT that time our Lord ſaid to me: Hewe thee two tables of ſtone, as the former were, and come vp to me into the mounte: and thou shalt make an arke of wood,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and I wil write in the tables the wordes that were in them, which before thou didſt breake, and thou shalt put them in the arke.
label: Deuteronomy

text: I made therfore an arke of the wood Settim. And when I had hewed two tables of ſtone like to the former, I went vp into the mount, hauing them in my handes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And he wrote in the tables, according as he had written before, the ten wordes, which our Lord ſpake to you in the mount from the middes of the fyre, when the people was gathered: and he gaue them to me.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And returning from the mount, I came downe, and put the tables into the arke, that I had made, which are there til this preſent, as our Lord commanded me.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And the children of Iſrael remoued their campe from Beroth of the children of Iacan into Moſera, where Aaron died and was buried, for whom, Eleazar his ſoone did the function of prieſthood.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thence they came into Gadgad: from the which place departing, they camped in Ietebatha, in a Land of waters and torrentes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: At that time he ſeparated the tribe of Leui, to carie the arke of the couenant of our Lord, and to ſtand before him in the miniſterie, and to bleſſe in his name vntil this preſent day.
label: Deuteronomy

text: For the which cauſe Leui had no part, nor poſſeſſion with his brethren: becauſe our Lord him ſelf is his poſſeſſion, as the Lord thy God promiſed him.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And I ſtoode in the mount, as before, fourtie daies and nightes: and our Lord heard me this time alſo, and would not deſtroy thee.
label: Deuteronomy

label: Deuteronomy

text: And you shal eate there in the ſight of the Lord your God: and you shal reioyce in al thinges, whereunto you shal put your hand, you and your houſe, wherein the Lord your God hath bleſſed you.

text: You shal not doe there the thinges, that we doe here this day euerie man that which ſeemeth good to him ſelf.

label: Deuteronomy

text: You shal paſſe ouer Iordan, and shal dwel in the Land, which the Lord your God wil geue you, that you may haue reſt from al enemies round about: and may dwel without al feare,

text: only without eating of the bloud, which thou shalt power out vpon the earth as water.

label: Deuteronomy

text: thou shalt take an awle, and bore through his eare in the dore of thy houſe, and he shal ſerue thee for euer. to thy woman ſeruant alſo thou shalt doe in like maner.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Turne not away thine eies from them, when thou makeſt them free: becauſe he hath ſerued thee ſix yeares after the wages of an hireling: that our Lord thy God may bleſſe thee in al the workes that thou doeſt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Of the firſt borne, that come forth in thy heardes and sheepe, whatſoeuer is of the male ſexe, thou shalt ſanctifie to our Lord thy God. Thou shalt not worke with the firſt borne of an oxe, and thou shalt not sheare the firſt borne of thy sheepe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: In the ſight of our Lord thy God shalt thou eate them euerie yeare in the place, that our Lord shal chooſe, thou and thy houſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But if it haue blemish, and be either lame, or blind, or in any part diſfigured or feeble, it shal not be immolated to our Lord thy God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: but within the gates of thy citie shalt thou eate it: as wel the cleane as the vncleane in like maner shal eate them as the doa, and the hart.
label: Deuteronomy

text: This onlie shalt thou obſerue, that their bloud thou eate not, but power it out on the earth as water.
label: Deuteronomy

text: OBSERVE the moneth of new corne, and the firſt of the ſpring time, that thou mayeſt make the Phaſe to our Lord thy God: becauſe in this moneth our Lord thy God, brought thee out of Ægypt by night.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And thou shalt immolate the Phaſe to our Lord thy God, of sheepe, and of oxen in the place, which our Lord thy God shal chooſe, that his name may dwel there.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not eate in it leuened bread: Seuen daies shalt thou eate without leuen, the bread of affliction, becauſe in feare didſt thou come out of Ægypt: that thou mayeſt remember the day of thy comming out of Ægypt, al the dayes of thy life.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Leuened shal not appeare in al thy coaſtes for ſeuen daies, and there shal not remayne of the flesh of that which was immolated at euen the firſt day vntil morning.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou canſt not immolate the Phaſe in euerie one of thy cities, which our Lord thy God wil geue thee;
label: Deuteronomy

text: but in the place, which our Lord thy God shal chooſe, that his name may dwel there: thou shalt immolate the Phaſe at euen at the going downe of the ſunne, when thou cameſt out of Ægypt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And thou shalt boyle, and eate it in the place, which our Lord thy God shal chooſe, and in the morning ryſing vp thou shalt goe into thy tentes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Six daies shalt thou eate azymes: and in the ſeuenth day, becauſe it is the collection of our Lord thy God, thou shalt doe no worke.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Seuen weekes shalt thou number thee from that day wherein thou didſt put the ſickle to the corne,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou shalt celebrate the feſtiual day of weekes to our Lord thy God, a voluntarie oblation of thy hand, which thou shalt offer according to the bleſſing of our Lord thy God:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou shalt feaſt before our Lord thy God, thou, & thy ſonne, and thy daughter, and thy man ſeruant, and thy woman ſeruant, and the Leuite that is within thy gates, and the ſtranger and pupil and widow, which abide with you: in the place which our Lord thy God shal chooſe, that his name may dwel there:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou shalt remember that thou waſt a ſeruant in Ægypt: and thou shalt keepe and doe the thinges that are commanded.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The ſolemnitie alſo of Tabernacles thou shalt celebrate ſeuen daies, when thou haſt gathered thy fruite of the barne floore and the preſſe:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou shalt feaſt in the feſtiuitie, thou, thy ſonne, and thy daughter, thy man ſeruant and woman ſeruant, the Leuite alſo and ſtranger, and pupil and widow that are within thy gates.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Seuen daies shalt thou celebrate the feaſtes to our Lord thy God in the place, which our Lord shal chooſe: and our Lord thy God wil bleſſe thee in al thy fruites, and in euerie worke of thy handes, and thou shalt be in ioye.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Three times in a yeare shal al thy male appeare in the ſight of our Lord thy God in the place which he shal chooſe: in the ſolemnitie of Azymes, in the ſolemnitie of weekes, and in the ſolemnitie of Tabernacles. There shal not appeare before our Lord any emptie:
label: Deuteronomy

text: but euerie one shal offer according to that he hath, according to the bleſſing of our Lord his God, which he shal geue him.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Iudges and maiſters shalt thou appoynt in al thy gates, which our Lord thy God shal geue thee, in euerie of thy tribes: that they may iudge the people with iuſt iudgement,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and not decline to either part. Thou shalt not accept perſon, nor giftes: becauſe that giftes blinde the eies of the wiſe, and change the wordes of the iuſt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Iuſtly shalt thou purſew that which is iuſt: that thou mayeſt liue and poſſeſſe the Land, which our Lord thy God shal geue thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt plante no groue, nor any tree neere the altar of our Lord thy God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Neither shalt thou make nor ſette to thy ſelf a ſtatue: which thing our Lord thy God hateth.
label: Deuteronomy

text: THOV shalt not immolate to our Lord thy God a sheepe, and an oxe, wherein there is blemish, or any fault: becauſe it is abomination to our Lord thy God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When there shal be found with thee within one of thy gates, which our Lord thy God shal geue thee, man or woman that do euil in the ſight of our Lord thy God, and tranſgreſſe his couenant,
label: Deuteronomy

text: that they goe and ſerue ſtrange goddes, and adore them, the ſunne and the moone, and al the hoſte of heauen, which thinges I commanded not:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and this is told thee, and hearing it thou haſt inquired diligently, and found it to be true, and the abomination is committed in Iſrael:
label: Deuteronomy

text: thou shalt bring forth the man and the woman, that haue committed that moſt heynous thing, to the gates of thy citie, and they shal be ſtoned.
label: Deuteronomy

text: At the mouth of two, or three witneſſes shal he perish that is to be ſlaine. Let no man be killed, one onlie geuing teſtimonie againſt him.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The hand of the witneſſes shal be firſt to kil him, and the hand of the reſt of the people shal be layd on laſt: that thou mayeſt take away the euil out of the middes of thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If thou perceiue that the iudgement with thee be hard and doubtful betwen bloud and bloud, cauſe and cauſe, leproſie and not leproſie: and thou ſee that the wordes of the iudges within thy gates doe varye: ariſe, and goe vp to the place, which our Lord thy God shal chooſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And thou shalt come to the prieſtes of the Leuitical ſtocke, and to the iudge, that shal be at that time: and thou shalt aske of them, who shal shew thee the truth of the iudgment.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And thou ſhalt do whatſoeuer they, that are preſidentes of the place, which our Lord shal chooſe, shal ſay and teach thee,
label: Deuteronomy

text: according to his law; and thou shalt folow their ſentence: neither shalt thou decline to the right hand nor to the left hand.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But he that shal be proude, refuſing to obey the commandement of the Prieſt, which at that time miniſtreth to our Lord thy God, and the decree of the iudge, that man shal die, and thou shalt take away the euil out of Iſrael:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and the whole people hearing shal feare, that none afterward ſwel in pride.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When thou art entred the Land, which our Lord thy God wil geue thee, and doeſt poſſeſſe it, and dwelleſt in it, and ſayeſt: I wil ſette a king ouer me, as al nations haue round about:
label: Deuteronomy

text: him shalt thou ſette, whom our Lord thy God shal chooſe of the number of thy brethren. A man of an other nation that is not thy brother, thou canſt not make king.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when he is made, he shal not multiplie to him ſelfe horſes, nor lead backe the people into Ægypt, taking high courage for the number of his horſemen, eſpecially whereas our Lord hath commanded you that in no caſe you returne any more the ſame way.
label: Deuteronomy

text: He shal not haue manie wiues, that may allure his minde, nor huge weightes of ſiluer and gold.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And after he shal ſitte in the throne of his kingdome, he shal copie to him ſelfe the Deuteronomie of this Law in a volume, taking the copie of the prieſtes of the Leuitical tribe,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and he shal haue it with him, and shal reade it al the dayes of his life, that he may learne to feare our Lord his God, and keepe his wordes and ceremonies, that are commanded in the law.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And that his hart be not lifted vp into pride ouer his brethren, nor decline to the right ſide or the left ſide, that he may reigne a long time, and his ſonnes ouer Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: THE prieſtes and Leuites, and al that are of the ſame tribe, shal haue no part nor inheritance with the reſt of Iſrael, becauſe they shal eate the ſacrifices of our Lord, and his oblations,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and nothing els shal they receiue of the poſſeſſion of their brethren: for our Lord him ſelfe is their inheritance, as he hath ſpoken to them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: This shal be the right of the prieſtes from the people, and from them that offer victimes: whether they immolate oxe, or sheepe, they shal geue to the prieſt the shoulder and the mawe;
label: Deuteronomy

text: the firſt fruites of corne, of wine, and oile, and a part of the woolle of their sheepe shearing.
label: Deuteronomy

text: For him hath our Lord choſen of al thy tribes, that he might ſtand, and miniſter to our Lord he and his ſonnes for euer.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If a Leuite goe out of one of thy cities of al Iſrael in the which he dwelleth, and would come deſiring the place which our Lord shal chooſe,
label: Deuteronomy

text: he shal miniſter in the name of our Lord his God, as al his brethren the Leuites, that shal ſtand at that time before our Lord.
label: Deuteronomy

text: He shal receiue the ſame portion of meates, that the reſt doe: beſide that, which in his owne citie is dew to him by ſucceſſion from his fathers.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When thou art entred the Land, which our Lord thy God shal geue thee, beware thou be not willing to imitate the abominations of thoſe nations.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Neither let there be found in thee any that shal expiate his ſonne, or daughter, making them to paſſe through the fyre: or that demandeth of ſouthſayers, and obſerueth dreames and diuinations, neither let there be a ſorcerer,
label: Deuteronomy

text: nor inchanter, nor that conſulteth with pithone, or diuiners, and ſeeketh the truth of the dead.
label: Deuteronomy

text: for al theſe thinges our Lord abhorreth, and for theſe abominations wil he deſtroy them at thy entring in.
label: Deuteronomy

text: thou shalt be perfect, and without ſpotte with our Lord thy God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Theſe nations, whoſe land thou shalt poſſeſſe, heare ſouthſayers and diuiners: but thou art otherwiſe inſtructed of our Lord thy God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: A PROPHET of thy nation and of thy brethren like vnto me, wil our Lord thy God raiſe vp to thee: him thou shalt heare,
label: Deuteronomy

text: as thou didſt requeſt of our Lord thy God in Horeb, when the aſſemblie was gathered, and ſaidſt: I wil no more heare the voice of our Lord my God, and this exceding great fire I wil ſee no more, leſt I die.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord ſaid to mie; They haue ſpoken al thinges wel.
label: Deuteronomy

text: A prophete wil I rayſe vp to them out of the middes of their brethren like to thee: and I wil put my wordes in his mouth, and he shal ſpeake al thinges that I shal command him.
label: Deuteronomy

text: but he that wil not heare his wordes, which he shal ſpeake in my name, I wil be the reuenger.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And the prophet that being depraued with arrogancie wil ſpeake in my name, the thinges that I did not command him to ſay, or in the name of ſtrange goddes, shal be ſlaine.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And if in ſecrete cogitation thou anſwer: How shal I vnderſtand the word, that our Lord ſpake not?
label: Deuteronomy

text: This ſigne thou shalt haue: That which the ſame prophete foretelleth, in the name of the Lord and cometh not to paſſe: that our Lord hath not ſpoken, but by the arrogancie of his minde the prophet hath forged it: and therfore thou shalt not feare him.
label: Deuteronomy

text: VVHEN our Lord thy God hath deſtroyed the nations, whoſe land he wil deliuer to thee, and thou doeſt poſſeſſe it, and dwelleſt in the cities and houſes therof:
label: Deuteronomy

text: three cities shalt thou ſeparate to thee in the middes of the Land, which our Lord thy God wil geue thee in poſſeſſion,
label: Deuteronomy

text: preparing diligently the way: and thou shalt diuide the whole prouince of thy Land equally into three partes: that he which for murder is a fugitiue, may haue neere at hand, whither to eſcape.
label: Deuteronomy

text: This shal be the law of the murderer that fleeth, whoſe life is to be ſaued: He that ſtriketh his neighbour vnwitting, and that is proued yeſterday and the day before to haue had no hatred againſt him:
label: Deuteronomy

text: but to haue gone with him ſimply vnto the wood to cutte wood, and in cutting the wood of axe ſlipped out of his hand, and the yron falling from the handle ſtrooke his freind, and killed him: he shal flee to one of the cities aforeſaid, and liue:
label: Deuteronomy

text: leſt perhaps the next kinſeman of him, whoſe bloud was shed, pricked with ſorow, purſew, and apprehend him if the way be too long, and ſtricke his life, that is not guiltie of death, becauſe he is proued to haue had no hatred before, againſt him that was ſlaine.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Therfore I command thee, that thou ſeparat three cities of equal diſtance one from an other.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when our Lord thy God shal haue dilated thy borders, as he ſware to thy fathers, and shal geue thee al the Land, that he promiſed them,
label: Deuteronomy

text: ( yet ſo, if thou keepe his commandementes, and do the thinges which I command thee this day, that thou loue our Lord thy God, and walke in his wayes at al time ) thou shalt adde to thee other three cities, and shalt duble the number of the three cities aforeſaid:
label: Deuteronomy

text: that innocent bloud be not shed in the middes of the Land, which our Lord thy God wil geue thee to poſſeſſe, leſt thou be guiltie of bloud.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But if any man hating his neighbour, lie in wayte for his life, and riſe and ſtrike him, and he die, and he flee to one of the cities aforeſaid,
label: Deuteronomy

text: the ancientes of his citie shal ſend, acd take him out of the place of refuge, and shal deliuer him into the hand of the kinſeman of him, whoſe bloud was ſhed, and he shal die.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not pitie him, and thou ſhalt take away the guiltie bloud out of Iſrael, that it may be wel with thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not take, and transferre thy neighbours boundes, which thy predeceſſours did ſette in thy poſſeſſion, which our Lord thy God wil geue thee in the Land, that thou shalt receiue to poſſeſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: One witneſſe shal not ſtand againſt any man, whatſoeuer ſinne, or wickedneſſe it be: but in the mouth of two or three witneſſes shal euerie word ſtand.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If a lying witneſſe ſtand againſt a man, accuſing him of preuarication,
label: Deuteronomy

text: both of them, whoſe the cauſe is, shal ſtand before our Lord in the ſight of the prieſtes and the iudges that shal be in thoſe daies.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when ſearching moſt diligently, they shal finde that the falſe witnes hath ſaid a lie againſt his brother:
label: Deuteronomy

text: they shal render to him as he meant to doe to his brother, and thou shalt take away the euil out of the middes of thee:
label: Deuteronomy

text: that others hearing may haue feare, and may not be bold to doe ſuch things.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not pitie him, but life for life, eie for eie, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foote for foote shalt thou exacte.
label: Deuteronomy

text: IF thou goe forth to warre againſt thyne enemies, and ſee the horſe men and chariottes, and the multitude of the aduerſaries hoſte greater then thou haſt, thou shalt not feare them: becauſe the Lord thy God is with thee, which brought thee out of the Land of Ægypt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when the battel is now at hand, the prieſt shal ſtand before the armie, and shal ſpeake to the people thus:
label: Deuteronomy

text: Heare Iſrael, you this day ioyne battel againſt your enemies, let not your hart feare, be not affrayd, retire not, neither dread them:
label: Deuteronomy

text: becauſe out Lord your God is in the middes of you, and wil fight for you againſt your aduerſaries, to deliuer you from danger.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The Captaines alſo through euerie bande in the hearing of the hoſte shal proclaime: what man is there, that hath built a new houſe, and hath not dedicated it? let him goe, and returne into his houſe, leſt perhaps he die in the battel, and an other dedicate it.
label: Deuteronomy

text: What man is there that hath planted a vine-yard, and hath not as yet made it to be common, wherof al men may lawfully eate? let him goe, and returne into his houſe: leſt perhaps he die in the battel, and an other man execute his office.
label: Deuteronomy

text: What man is there, that hath deſpouſed a wife, and not taken her? let him goe, and returne into his houſe, leſt perhaps he die in the warre, and an other take her.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Theſe thinges being ſaid they shal adde the reſt, and shal ſpeake to the people: What man is there feareful, and fainte harted? let him goe, and returne into his houſe, leſt he make the hartes of his brethren to feare, as him ſelfe is frighted with feare.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when the Captaines of the hoſt shal hold their peace, and make an end of ſpeaking, euerie man shal prepare their bandes to fight.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If at anie time thou come to winne a citie, thou shalt firſt offer peace.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If they receiue it, and open the gates to thee, al the people that is therein, shal be ſaued, and shal ſerue thee vnder tribute.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But if they wil not make peace, and shal beginne battel againſt thee, thou shalt aſſalt it.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when our Lord thy God shal deliuer it into thy hand, thou shalt ſtrike al, that is therein of the male ſexe, in the edge of the ſword,
label: Deuteronomy

text: excepting wemen and children, the cattel and other thinges, that are in the citie. Al the praye thou shalt diuide to the armie, and thou shalt eate of the ſpoiles of thine enemies, which our Lord thy God shal geue thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: So shalt thou doe to al cities, that be verie farre from thee, and be not of theſe cities, which thou shalt receiue in poſſeſſion.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But of thoſe cities, that shal be geuen thee, thou shalt ſuffer none at al to liue:
label: Deuteronomy

text: but shalt kil them in the edge of the ſword, to witte, the Hetheite, and Amorrheite, and Chananeite, the Pherezeite, and Heueite, and Iebuſeite, as our Lord thy God hath commanded thee:
label: Deuteronomy

text: leſt perhaps they teach you to doe al the abominations, which them ſelues did worke to their goddes: and you ſinne againſt our Lord your God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When thou haſt beſieged a citie a long time, and haſt compaſſed it with munition to winne it, thou shalt not cutte downe the trees, that may be eaten of, neither shalt thou ſpoile the countrie round about with axes: becauſe it is a tree, and not a man, neither can it increaſe the number of warryers againſt thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But if there be any trees not fruitful, but wilde, and apt for other vſes, cutte them downe, and make engines, vntil thou take the citie, which fighteth againſt thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: VVHEN there shal be found in the Land, which our Lord thy God wil geue thee, the corps of a man ſlaine, and he that is guiltie of the murder is not knowne
label: Deuteronomy

text: thy ancientes, and iudges shal goe forth, and meaſure from the place of the corps the diſtance of euerie citie round about:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and which they shal perceiue to be neerer then the reſt, the ancientes of that citie shal take an heifer out of the heard, that hath not drawen yoke, nor ploughed the ground,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and shal bring her to a rough and ſtonie valley, that neuer was ploughed, nor receiued ſeede: and in it they shal ſtrike of the necke of the heifer:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and the prieſtes the ſonnes of Leui shal come, whom our Lord thy God hath choſen to miniſter to him, and to bleſſe in his name, and at their word euerie matter dependeth, and whatſoeuer is cleane or vncleane muſt be iudged.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And the ancientes of that citie shal come to the ſlaine perſon, and shal wash their handes ouer the heifer, that was ſtrooken in the valley,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and shal ſay: Our handes did not ſheede this bloud, nor our eies ſee it.
label: Deuteronomy

text: be merciful to thy people Iſrael, whom thou haſt redemed o Lord, and impute not innocent bloud in the middes of thy people Iſrael. And the guilte of bloud shal be taken from them:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou shalt be free from the innocents bloud, that was ſhed, when thou shalt haue done that which our Lord hath commanded thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If thou goe forth to fight againſt thyne enemies, and our Lord thy God deliuer them in thy hande and thou leade them away captiue,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and ſeeſt in the number of the captiues a beautiful woman, and loueſt her, and wilt haue her to wife,
label: Deuteronomy

text: thou shalt bring her into thy houſe: who shal shaue of her hare, and payre her nailes,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and put of the rayment, wherein she was taken: and ſitting in thy houſe, shal mourne her father and mother one moneth: and afterward thou shalt enter vnto her, and shalt ſleepe with her, and she shal be thy wife.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But if afterward she content not thy mynde, thou shalt let her goe free, neither canſt thou ſel her for money, nor oppreſſe her by might: becauſe thou haſt humbled her.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If a man haue two wiues, one beloued, and the other hated, and they haue begotten children by him, and the ſonne of the hated be the firſtborne,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and he meaneth to diuide his ſubſtance among his ſonnes: he can not make the ſonne of the beloued the firſt borne, and preferre him before the ſonne of the hated,
label: Deuteronomy

text: but the ſonne of the hated he shal acknowledge for the firſt borne, and shal geue to him of thoſe thinges, which he hath, al duble: for this is the beginning of his children, & to this are dew the firſt brith rightes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If a man begette a ſtubbourne and froward ſonne, that wil not heare the commandementes of his father and mother, and being chaſtened, contemneth to be obedient:
label: Deuteronomy

text: they shal take him, and bring him to the ancientes of his citie, and to the gate of iudgement,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and shal ſay to them: This our ſonne is froward and ſtubborne, he contemneth to heare our admonitions, he geueth himſelf to comeſſation, and to ryote and banketinges:
label: Deuteronomy

text: the people of the citie shal ſtone him: and he shal die, that you may take away the euil out of the middes of you, and al Iſiael hearing it may be afrayde.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When a man hath offended ſo that he is to be punished by death, and being condemned to die is hanged on a gybbet:
label: Deuteronomy

text: his bodie shal not remaine vpon the tree, but the ſame day shal be buried: becauſe he is accurſed of God that hangeth on a tree: and thou shalt not contaminate thy Land, which our Lord thy God geueth thee in poſſeſſion.
label: Deuteronomy

text: THOV shalt not ſee thy brothers oxe, or ſheepe ſtraying, and paſſe by: but ſhalt bring it backe to thy brother,
label: Deuteronomy

text: although thy brother be not nigh, and thou know him not: thou shalt bring them vnto thy houſe, and they shal be with thee vntil thy brother ſeeke them, and receiue them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: In like manner shalt thou doe with his aſſe, and with his rayment, and with euerie thing of thy brothers, that shal be loſt: if thou finde it, neglect it nor as perteyning to an other.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If thou ſee thy brothers aſſe or oxe to be fallen in the way, thou shalt not contemne it, but shalt lift it vp with him.
label: Deuteronomy

text: A woman shal not be clothed with mans apparel, neither shal a man vſe womans apparel: for he is abominable before God that doeth theſe thinges.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If walking by the way thou finde a birdes neſt in a tree or on the ground, and the damme ſitting vpon the young or the egges: thou shalt not hold her with her young,
label: Deuteronomy

text: but shalt let her goe, taking the young and holding them: that it may be wel with thee, and thou mayeſt liue a long time.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When thou buildeſt a new houſe, thou shalt make a batlement to the roofe round about: leſt bloud be shed in thy houſe, and thou be guiltie an other ſlipping, and falling headlong.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not ſowe thy vineyard with diuerſe ſeede: leſt both the ſeede which thou didſt ſow, and the thinges that grow of the vineyard, be ſanctified together.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou ſhalt not plough with an oxe and aſſe together.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not weare a garment that is wouen of wolle and linnen.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt make litle cordes in the hemme at the foure corners of thy cloke, wherwith thou shalt be couered.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If a man marrie a wife, and afterward hate her,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and ſeeke occaſions to put her away, obiecting vnto her a verie il name, and ſay: I tooke this wife, and compayning with her: I found her not a virgin:
label: Deuteronomy

text: her father and mother shal take her, and shal carie with them the ſignes of her virginitie to the ancientes of the citie that are in the gate:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and the father shal ſay: I gaue my daughter vnto this man to wife: whom becauſe he hateth,
label: Deuteronomy

text: he layeth vnto her a verie il name, ſo that he ſayeth: I found not thy daughter a virgin: and behold theſe are the ſignes of my daughters virginitie. they shal ſpread the veſture before the ancientes of the citie:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and the ancientes of that citie shal take the man, and beate him,
label: Deuteronomy

text: condemning him beſides in a hundred ſicles of ſiluer, which he shal geue to the wenches father, becauſe he hath infamouſely ſpred a verie il name vpon a virgin of Iſrael: and he shal haue her to wife, and can not put her away al the daies of his life.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But if it be true which he obiected, and virginitie be not found in the wench:
label: Deuteronomy

text: they shal caſt her forth without the doores of her fathers houſe, and the men of her citie shal ſtone her to death, and she ſhal die: becauſe she hath done wickednes in Iſrael, to fornicate in her fathers houſe: and thou shalt take away the euil out of the middes of thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If a man lie with an others mans wife, both shal die, that is to ſay, the aduouterer and the aduoutereſſe: and thou shalt take away the euil out of Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If a man haue deſpouſed a maide that is a virgine, and ſome man finde her in the citie, and lie with her,
label: Deuteronomy

text: thou shalt bring forh both of them to the gate of that citie, and they shal be ſtoned: the maide, becauſe she cried not, being in the citie: the man, becauſe he hath humbled his neighbours wife. and thou shalt take away the euil from the middes of thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But if the man finde the maide that is deſpouſed, in the field, and taking her, lie with her, he alone shal die:
label: Deuteronomy

text: the maide shal ſuffer nothing, neither is she guiltie of death: for as a theefe ryſeth againſt his brother, and taketh away his life, ſo alſo did the maide ſuffer.
label: Deuteronomy

text: she was alone in the field: she cried, and there was no man to deliuer her.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If a man finde a maide that is a virgin, which hath not a ſpouſe, and taking her lie with her, and the matter come into iudgement:
label: Deuteronomy

text: he that lay with her, shal geue to the father of the maide fiftie ſicles of ſiluer, and shal haue her to wife, becauſe he hath humbled her: he can not put her away al the daies of his life.
label: Deuteronomy

text: No man shal take his fathers wife, nor reuele his couering.
label: Deuteronomy

text: AN eunuch that hath his ſtones broken, or cutte of, & his yeard cutte away, shal not enter into the church of our Lord.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Mamzer, that is to ſay, one borne of a common woman, shal not enter into the church of our Lord, vntil the tenth generation.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The Ammonite, and the Moabite yea after the tenth generation shal not enter into the church of our Lord, for euer:
label: Deuteronomy

text: becauſe they would not meete you with bread and water in the way, when you came out of Ægypt: and becauſe they hyred againſt thee Balaam, the ſonne of Beor of Meſopotamia in Syria, to curſe thee:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and our Lord thy God would not heare Balaam, and he turned his curſing into thy bleſſing, for that he loued thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not make peace with them, neither doe thou ſeeke their good al the daies of thy life for euer.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not abhorre the Idumeite, becauſe he is thy brother: nor the Ægyptian, becauſe thou waſt a ſtranger in his land.
label: Deuteronomy

text: They that are borne of them, in the third generation shal enter into the church of our Lord.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When thou goeſt forth againſt thyne enemies to battel, thou shalt keepe thy ſelf from al euil thing.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If there be among you a man, that is polluted in a dreame by night, he shal goe forth without the campe,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and shal not returne, before he be washed with water at euen: and after ſunne ſette he shal returne into the campe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt haue a place without the campe, whither thou mayeſt goe to the neceſſities of nature,
label: Deuteronomy

text: carying on thy girdle a piked inſtrument. & when thou ſitteſt downe, thou shalt digge round about, and with the earth that is digged vp shal couer
label: Deuteronomy

text: that which thou art eaſed of (for our Lord thy God walketh in the middes of thy campe, to deliuer thee, and to geue thyne enemies vnto thee) and let thy campe be holie, and let no filthines appeare therein, leſt he forſake thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not deliuer the ſeruant to his Maiſter, that is fled to thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: he shal dwel with thee in the place, that shal pleaſe him, and in one of thy cities shal he reſt: vexe him not.
label: Deuteronomy

text: There shal be no whoore of the daughters of Iſrael, nor whooremonger of the ſonnes of Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not offer the hire of a ſtrompet, nor the price of a dogge, in the houſe of our Lord thy God, whatſoeuer it be that thou haſt vowed: becauſe both is abomination before our Lord thy God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not lend to thy brother money to vſurie, nor corne, nor any other thing:
label: Deuteronomy

text: but to the ſtrãger. And to thy brother thou shalt lend, that which he needeth without vſurie: that our Lord thy God may bleſſe thee in al thy worke in the Land, which thou shalt enter to poſſeſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When thou haſt vowed a vow to our Lord thy God, thou shalt not ſlacke to pay it: becauſe our Lord thy God wil require it. and if thou delay, it shal be reputed to thee for ſinne.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If thou wilt not promiſe, thou shalt be without ſinne.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But that which is once gone out of thy lippes, thou shalt obſerue, and shalt doe as thou haſt promiſed to our Lord thy God, and haſt ſpoken with thy proper wil and thyne owne mouth.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Entring into thy neighbours vineyarde, eate grapes as much as shal pleaſe thee: but carrie none out with thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If thou enter into thy freindes corne, thou shalt breake the eares, and rubbe them in thy hand: but with a ſikcle thou shalt not reape.
label: Deuteronomy

text: IF a man take a wife, and haue her, and she finde not grace before his eies for ſonne lothſomenes: he shal write a bil of diuorce, and shal geue it in her hand, and dimiſſe her out of his houſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And being departed when she shal haue maried an other husband,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and he alſo hateth her, and hath geuen her a bil of diuorce, and hath dimiſſed her out of his houſe, or is deade:
label: Deuteronomy

text: the former husband can not take her againe to wife: becauſe she is polluted, and is made abominable before our Lord: leſt thou make thy Land to ſinne, which our Lord thy God shal deliuer thee to poſſeſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When a man hath lately taken a wife, he shal not goe fotth to battel, neither shal any publique neceſſitie be inioyned him, but he shal attend to his owne houſe without fault, that one yeare he may reioyce with his wife.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not take for a pledge the nether, or the vpper milſtone: becauſe he hath pledged his life to thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If any man be taken ſoliciting his brother of the children of Iſrael, and ſelling him take a price, he shal be ſlaine, and thou shalt take away the euil from the middes of thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Obſerue diligently that thou incurre not the plague of leproſie, but thou shalt doe whatſoeuer the prieſtes of the Leuitical ſtocke shal teach thee, according to that, which I haue commanded them, and fulfil thou it carefully.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Remember what our Lord your God did to Marie, in the way when you came out of Ægypt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When thou shalt require of thy neighbour any thing, that he oweth thee, thou shalt not enter into his houſe to take away a pledge:
label: Deuteronomy

text: but thou shalt ſtand without, and he shal bring forth to thee that which he hath.
label: Deuteronomy

text: but if he be poore, the pledge shal not lodge with thee that night,
label: Deuteronomy

text: but forthwith thou shalt reſtore it to him before the going downe of the ſunne: that ſleeping in his rayment, he may bleſſe thee, & thou mayeſt haue iuſtice before our Lord thy God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not denie the hyre of the needie, and poore man thy brother, or the ſtranger, that dwelleth with thee in the land, and is within thy gates:
label: Deuteronomy

text: but the ſame day thou shalt pay him the price of his labour, before the going downe of the ſunne, becauſe he is poore, and there withal ſuſteyneth his life: leſt he crie againſt thee to our Lord, and it be reputed to thee for a ſinne.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The fathers shal not be ſlaine for the children, nor the children for the fathers, but euerie one shal die for his owne ſinne.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not peruert the iudgement of the ſtranger and the pupil, neither shalt thou take away the widowes rayment for a pledge.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Remember that thou didſt ſerue in Ægypt, and our Lord thy God deliuered thee from thence. Therfore I command thee that thou doe this thing.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When thou haſt reaped the corne in thy field, and forgetting haſt left a sheafe, thou shalt not returne to take it away: but thou shalt ſuffer the ſtranger, and the pupil, and the widow to take it away, that our Lord thy God may bleſſe thee in al the worke of thy handes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If thou haue gathered the fruites of thy oliue trees, whatſoeuer remaineth on the trees, thou shalt not returne to gather it: but shalt leaue it to the ſtranger, the pupil, and the widow.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If thou make vintage of thy vineyard, thou shalt not gather the cluſters that remaine, but they shal goe to the vſes of the ſtranger, the pupil, and the widow.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Remember that thou alſo didſt ſerue in Ægypt, and therfore I command thee that thou doe this thing.
label: Deuteronomy

text: IF there be a controuerſie betwen ſome, and they cal vpon the iudges: whom they shal perceiue to be iuſt, to him they shal geue the price of iuſtice: whom impious, him they shal condemne of impietie.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And if they ſee that the offender be worthie of ſtripes: they shal caſt him downe, & shal cauſe him to be beaten before them. According to the meaſure of the ſinne shal the meaſure alſo of the ſtripes be:
label: Deuteronomy

text: yet ſo, that they exceede not the number of fourtie: leſt thy brother depart fowly torne before thyne eies.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not mooſel the mouth of the oxe that treadeth out thy corne in the flore.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When brethren shal dwel together, & one of them die without children, the wife of the deceaſed ſhal not marie to an other: but his brother shal take her, and rayſe vp the ſeede of his brother:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and the firſt borne ſonne of her he shal cal by his name, that his name be not abolished out of Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But if he wil not take his brothers wife, that by law is dew to him, the woman shal goe to the gate of the citie, and cal vpon the ancientes, and ſay: My husbandes brother wil not rayſe vp his brothers ſeede in Iſrael: nor take me to his wife.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And forthwith they shal cauſe him to be ſent for, and shal aske him. If he anſwer: I wil not take her to wife:
label: Deuteronomy

text: the woman shal come to him before the ancientes, and shal take of his shoe from his foote, and ſpitte in his face, and ſay: So shal it be done to the man, that buildeth not his brothers houſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And his name shal be called in Iſrael The houſe of the vnshodde.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If two men fal at wordes betwixt them ſelues, and one beginne to brawle againſt the other, and the wife of the one willing to deliuer her husband out of the hand of the ſtronger, put forth her hand, and take his priuities:
label: Deuteronomy

text: thou shalt cutte of her hand, neither shalt thou be moued with any pitie vpon her.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt not haue diuerſe weightes in thy bagge, a greater and a leſſe:
label: Deuteronomy

text: neither shal there be in thy houſe a greater bushel and a leſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt haue a weight iuſt and true, and thy bushel shal be equal and true: that thou mayeſt liue a long time vpon the Land, which our Lord thy God shal geue thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: For thy Lord abhorreth him, that doth theſe thinges, and deteſteth al iniuſtice.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Remember what Amalec did to thee in the way when thou cameſt out of Ægypt:
label: Deuteronomy

text: how he mette thee: & ſtroke the hindemoſt of thy armie, which being wearie reſted them ſelues, when thou waſt ſpent with famine and labour, and he feared not God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Therfore when our Lord thy God shal geue thee reſt, and ſubdewe al nations round about in the Land, which he hath promiſed thee: thou shalt deſtroy his name vnder heauen. Beware thou forget it not.
label: Deuteronomy

text: AND when thou art entred into the Land, which our Lord thy God wil geue thee to poſſeſſe, and haſt obteyned it, and dwelleſt in it:
label: Deuteronomy

text: thou shalt take firſt of al thy fruites, and put them in a maunde, and ſhalt goe to the place, which our Lord thy God shal chooſe, that his name may be inuocated there:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou shalt goe to the prieſt, that shal be in thoſe daies, and ſay to him: I profeſſe this day before our Lord thy God, that I am entred into the Land, for the which he ſware to our fathers, that he would geue it vs.
label: Deuteronomy

text: and the prieſt taking the maund at his hand, shal ſette it before the altar of our Lord thy God:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou shalt ſpeake in the ſight of our Lord God: The Syrian perſecuted my father, who deſcended into Ægypt, and ſeiourned there in a verie ſmale number and grew into a nation greate and ſtrong and of an infinite multitude.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And the Ægyptians afflicted vs, and perſecuted vs laying on moſt grieuous burdens:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and we cried to our Lord the God of our fathers: who heard vs, and reſpected our affliction, and labour, and diſtreſſe:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and brought vs out of Ægypt in a ſtrong hand, a ſtretched out arme, in great terrour, in ſignes and wonders:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and brought vs into this place, and deliuered to vs this Land flowing with milke and honie.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And therfore now I offer firſt fruites of the Land, which our Lord hath geuen me. And thou shalt leaue them in the ſight of our Lord thy God, adoring our Lord thy God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And thou shalt feaſt in al the good thinges, which our Lord thy God hath geuen to thee, and thy houſe, thou and the Leuite, and the ſtranger that is with thee
label: Deuteronomy

text: When thou haſt finished the tithe of al thy fruites, in the third yeare of tithes thou shalt geue to the Leuite, and the ſtranger, and the pupil, and the widow, that they may eate within thy gates, and be filled:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou ſhalt ſpeake in the ſight of our Lord thy God: I haue brought that which is ſanctified out of my houſe, and haue geuen it to the Leuite and the ſtranger, and the pupil and the widow, as thou haſt commanded me: I haue not tranſgreſſed thy commandements nor forgotten thy preceptes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: I haue not eaten of them in my mourning, nor ſeparated them in any vncleannes, nor ſpent of them any thing in funerals. I haue obeyed the voice of our Lord my God, and haue done al thinges as thou didſt command me.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Looke from thy ſanctuarie, and thy high habitation of heauen, and bleſſe thy people Iſrael, and the Land, which thou haſt geuen vs, as thou ſwareſt to our fathers, a land flowing with milke and honie.
label: Deuteronomy

text: This day our Lord thy God hath commanded thee to doe theſe commandmentes and iudgementes: that thou keepe and fulfil them with al thy hart, and with al thy ſoule.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou haſt choſen our Lord this day, to be thy God, and to walke in his waies, and keepe his ceremonies, and preceptes and iudgementes, and obey his commandement.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord hath choſen thee this day, that thou shouldeſt be his peculiar people, as he hath ſpoken to thee, and thou shouldeſt keepe al his commandementes:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and make thee higher then al nations which he created, to his prayſe, and name, and glorie: that thou mayeſt be a holie people of our Lord thy God, as he hath ſpoken.
label: Deuteronomy

text: AND Moyſes and the ancientes of Iſrael commanded the people, ſaying: Keepe euerie commandment that I command you this day.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when you are paſſed ouer Iordan into the Land, which our Lord thy God wil geue thee, thou shalt erect great ſtones, and shalt polish them with plaſter,
label: Deuteronomy

text: that thou mayeſt write on them al the wordes of this law, when thou haſt paſſed ouer Iordan: that thou mayeſt enter into the Land, which our Lord thy God wil geue thee, a land flowing with milke and honie, as he ſware to thy fathers.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When therfore you are paſſed Iordan, erect the ſtones which I command you this day in mount Hebal, and thou shalt polish them with plaſter:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou ſhalt build there an altar to our Lord thy God of ſtones, which yron hath not touched,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and of ſtones not fashioned nor polished: and thou shalt put vpon it holocauſtes to our Lord thy God,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and shalt immolate pacifique hoſtes, and eate there, and feaſte there before our Lord thy God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And thou shalt write vpon the ſtones al the wordes of this law plainely and cleerly.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And Moyſes and the prieſtes of the Leuitical ſtocke ſaid to al Iſrael: Attend, and heare Iſrael: This day thou art made the people of our Lord thy God:
label: Deuteronomy

text: thou shalt heare his voice, and doe the commandementes and iuſtices, which I command thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And Moyſes commanded the people in that day, ſaying:
label: Deuteronomy

text: Theſe shal ſtand to bleſſe the people, vpon mount Garizim, when you are paſt Iordan: Simeon, Leui, Iudas, Iſſachar, Ioſeph, and Beniamin.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And ouer againſt them theſe shal ſtand to curſe on mount Hebal. Ruben, Gad, and Aſer, and Zabulon, Dan and Nephthali:
label: Deuteronomy

text: And the Leuites shal pronounce, and ſay to al the men of Iſrael with a high voice:
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed be the man that maketh a grauen and molten thing, the abomination of our Lord, the worke of the handes of artificers, and shal put it in ſecrete. and al the people shal anſwer, and ſay: Amen.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed be he that honoureth not his father and mother. and al the people shal ſay: Amen.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed be he that remoueth his neighbours boundes. and al the people shal ſay: Amen.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed be he that maketh the blinde to goe amiſſe in his iourney. and al the people shal ſay: Amen.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed be he that peruerteth the iudgement of the ſtranger, of the pupil and the widow. and al the people shal ſay: Amen.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed be he that ſleepeth with his fathers wife, and reuealeth the couer of his bedde. and al the people shal ſay: Amen.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed be he that lyeth with any beaſt. and al the people shal ſay: Amen.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed be he that ſleepeth with his ſiſter, the daughter of his father, or of his mother. and al the people shal ſay: Amen.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed be he that ſleepeth with his mother in law. and al the people shal ſay: Amen.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed be he that ſecretely ſtriketh his neighbour. and al the people shal ſay: Amen.
label: Deuteronomy

label: Deuteronomy

text: Gurſed be he that obydeth not in the wordes of this law, and fulfilleth them not in worke. and al the people shal ſay: Amen.
label: Deuteronomy

text: BVT if thou wilt heare the voice of our Lord thy God, that thou doe and keepe al his commandementes, which I command thee this day, our Lord thy God wil make thee higher then al nations, that be on the earth
label: Deuteronomy

text: And al theſe bleſſinges shal come vpon thee, and ouertake thee: yet ſo if thou heare his preceptes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Bleſſed shalt thou be in the citie, and bleſſed in the field.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Bleſſed shal be the fruite of thy wombe, and the fruite of thy ground, and the fruite of thy cattel, the troupes of thy heardes, & the foldes of thy sheepe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Bleſſed shal thy barnes be, and bleſſed thy remaines.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Bleſſed shalt thou be comming in and going out.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord wil geue thyne enemies, that riſe vp againſt thee, to fal downe in thy ſight: one way they shal comme againſt thee, and ſeuen wayes they shal flee from thy face.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord wil ſend forth bleſſing vpon thy cellars, and vpon al the workes of thy handes: and wil bleſſe thee in the land, that thou shalt receiue.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord wil rayſe thee vp vnto him ſelf to be a holie people, as he ſware to thee: If thou keepe the commandmentes of our Lord thy God, and walke in his waies.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And al the people of the earth shal ſee that the name of our Lord is inuocated vpon thee, and they shal feare thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord wil make thee abound with al goodes, with the fruite of thy wombe, and the fruite of thy cattel, with the fruite of thy land, which our Lord ſware to thy fathers that he would geue thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord wil open his moſt excellent treaſure, the heauen, that it may geue rayne to thy land in due ſeaſon: and wil bleſſe al the workes of thy handes. And thou shalt lend to many nations, and thy ſelf shalt take lone of no man.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord shal make thee the heade, and not thr taile: and thou shalt be alwaies aboue, and not vnder: yet ſo, if thou wilt heare the commandmentes of our Lord thy God which I command thec rhis day, and keepe and doe them,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and decline not from them neither to the right hand, nor to the left, nor folow ſtrange goddes, nor ſerue them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But if thou wilt not heare the voice of our Lord thy God, to keepe, and doe al his commandmentes and ceremonies, which I command thee this day, al theſe curſes shal come vpon thee, and ouertake thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed shalt thou be in the citie, curſed in the field.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed shal thy barne be, and curſed thy remaines.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed shal be the fruite of thy wombe, and the fruite of thy ground, the heardes of thy oxen, and the flockes of thy sheepe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Curſed shalt thou be comming in, and curſed going out.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord shal ſend vpon thee famine & hunger, and rebuke vpon al the workes, which thou shalt doe: vntil he conſume, and deſtroy thee quickly, for thy moſt wicked inuentions, wherein thou haſt forſaken me.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord ſette the peſtilence vpon thee, vntil he conſume thee out of the land, which thou shalt enter in to poſſeſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord ſtrike thee with pouertie, with the feuer and cold, with burning and heate, and with corrupt ayre and blaſting, and purſew thee til thou perish.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Be the heauen, that is ouer thee, of braſſe: and the ground, that thou treadeſt, of yron.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord geue duſt for rayne vpon thy land, and ashes deſcend from heauen vpon thee, til thou be conſumed.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord deliuer thee to fal downe before thyne enemies. one way goe thou forth againſt them, and flee ſeuen, and be thou diſperſed through out al the kingdomes of the earth.
label: Deuteronomy

text: and be thy carcaſſe meate to al the fowles of the ayre, and beaſtes of the earth, and be there none to driue them away.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord ſtrike thee with the boile of Ægypt, and the part of thy bodie, by the which dung is caſt out, with ſcabbe alſo and itche: ſo that thou canſt not be cured:
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord ſtrike thee with madnes & blindnes and furie of minde,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and grope thou at midday as the blinde is wont to grope in the darke, and direct not thy wayes. And at al times ſuſteyne thou wrong, and be thou oppreſſed with violence, neither haue thou any to deliuer thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Take thou a wife, and an other ſleepe with her. Build thou a houſe, and dwel not therin. Plant thou a vineyard, and take not the vintage there of.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Be thy oxe immolated beforre thee, and thou not eate therof. Be thy aſſe taken away in thy ſight, and not reſtored to thee. Be thy sheepe geuen to thyne enemies, and be there none to helpe thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Be thy ſonnes and thy daughters deliuered to an other people, thyne eies ſeing, and daſeling at the ſight of them al the day, and be there no ſtrength in thy hand.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The fruites of thy land, and al thy laboures let a people eate, which thou knoweſt not: and be thou alwaies ſuſteyning calumnie, and oppreſſed al dayes,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and aſtonished at the terrour of thoſe thinges, which thyne eies shal ſee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord ſtrike thee with a verie ſore botche in the knees and shankes, and be thou vncurable from the ſole of the foote vnto the toppe of thy head.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord shal bring thee, and thy King, whom thou shalt appoint ouer thee, vnto a nation, which thou and thy fathers know not: and there thou shalt ſerue ſtrange goddes, wood and ſtone.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And thou shalt be deſtroyed for a prouerbe and fable to al peoples, vnto whom our Lord shal bring thee in.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt caſt much ſeede into the ground, and gather litle: becauſe the locuſtes shal deuoure al thinges.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt plant a vineyard, and digge, and the wine thou shalt not drinke, nor gather any thing therof: becauſe it shal be waſted with wormes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt haue oliues in al thy borders, and shalt not be anointed with the oyle: becauſe they shal droppe away, & perish.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt begette ſonnes and daughters, and shalt not enioy them: becauſe they shal be ledde into captiuitie.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Al thy trees and the fruites of thy ground the blaſting shal conſume.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The ſtranger that liueth with thee in the Land, shal aſcend ouer thee, and shal be higher: and thou shalt deſcend downeward, and be inferior.
label: Deuteronomy

text: He shal lend thee, and thou shalt not lend him. He shal be as the head, and thou shalt be the tayle.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And al theſe curſes shal come vpon thee, and purſewing shal ouertake thee, til thou perish: becauſe thou heard not the voice of our Lord thy God, nor kept his commandmentes and ceremonies which he commanded thee.
label: Deuteronomy
