text: And they shal be in thee as ſignes and wonders, and in thy ſeede for euer:
label: Deuteronomy

text: becauſe thou didſt not ſerue our Lord thy God in ioy, and gladnes of hart, for the abundance of al thinges.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thou shalt ſerue thine enemie, whom our Lord wil ſend vpon thee, in hunger, and thirſt, and nakednes, and al penurie: and he shal put an yron yoke vpon thy necke, til he conſume thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord wil bring vpon thee a Nation from a farre, and from the vttermoſt endes of the earth, in likenes of an eagle that flieth with vehemencie: whoſe tongue thou canſt not vnderſtand:
label: Deuteronomy

text: a verie malapert Nation, that wil attribute nothing to the ancient, nor haue pitie on the litle one,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and wil deuoure the fruite of thy cattel, and the fruites of thy Land: vntil thou perish, and wil not leaue thee wheate, wine, and oile, heardes of oxen, and flockes of sheepe: vntil it deſtroy thee,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and conſume thee in al thy cities, and thy ſtrong and highe walles be deſtroyed, wherin that hadſt confidence in al thy Land. Thou shalt be beſieged within thy gates in al thy Land, which our Lord thy God wil geue thee:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thou shalt eate the fruite of thy wombe, and the flesh of thy ſonnes and of thy daughters, which our Lord thy God ſhal geue thee, in the diſtreſſe and vaſtation wherwith thyne enemie shal oppreſſe thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The man that is delicate in thee, and very riotious, shal much enuie his owne brother, and his wife, that lieth in his boſome,
label: Deuteronomy

text: ſo that he shal not geue them of the flesh of his children, which he wil eate: becauſe he hath nothing els in the ſiege and penurie, wherwith thine enemies shal waſte thee within al thy gates.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The tender and delicate woman, that could not goe vpon the ground, nor ſette downe her foote for ouer much nicenes and tendernes, wil enuie her husband, that lyeth in her boſome, vpon the flesh of her ſonne, and daughter,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and the filthines of the after birthes, that come forth from the middes of her thighes, and vpon the children that are borne the ſame howre. for they shal eate them ſecretely becauſe of the penurie of al thinges, in the ſiege and vaſtation, wherwith thine enemie shal oppreſſe thee within thy gates.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Vnleſſe thou keepe, and doe al the wordes of this law, that be written in this volume, and feare his name glorious and terrible, that is. Our Lord thy God:
label: Deuteronomy

text: our Lord shal increaſe thy plagues, and the plagues of thy ſeede, greate plagues and continuing, ſore infirmities and perpetual.
label: Deuteronomy

text: and he shal turne vpon thee al the afflictions of Ægypt, which thou didſt feare, and they shal cleaue to thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Moreouer alſo al the diſeaſes, and plagues, that be not written in the volume of this law, our Lord wil bring vpon thee, til he conſume thee:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and you shal remaine few in number, which before was as the ſtarres of heauen for multitude, becauſe thou heardſt not the voice of our Lord thy God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And as before our Lord reioyced vpon you, doing good to you, and multiplying you: ſo he shal reioyſe deſtroying and ſubuerting you, ſo that you may be taken away from the Land, which thou shalt enter to poſſeſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord shal diſperſe thee into al peoples, from the fartheſt partes of the earth to the endes therof: and there thou shalt ſerue ſtrange goddes, which thou art ignorant of and thy fathers, woode and ſtone.
label: Deuteronomy

text: In thoſe nations alſo thou shalt not be quiet, neither shal there be reſting for the ſteppe of thy foote. For our Lord wil geue thee a feareful hart, and daſeling eies, and a ſoule conſumed with penſifenes:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and thy life shal be as it were hanging before thee. Thou shalt feare night and day, and thou shalt not truſt in thy life.
label: Deuteronomy

text: In the morning thou shalt ſay: Who wil graunt me euening? and at euening: Who wil grant me morning? for the fearefulnes of thy hart, wherwith thou shalt be terrified, and for thoſe thinges, which thou shalt ſee with thine eies.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord shal bring thee againe with shippes into Ægypt by the way, wherof he ſaid to thee that thou shouldeſt ſee it no more. There shalt thou be ſould to thine enemies for bondmen and bondweomen, and no man shal bye you.
label: Deuteronomy

text: THESE are the wordes of the couenant which our Lord commanded Moyſes to make with the children of Iſrael in the Land of Moab: beſide that couenant which he made with them in Horeb.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And Moyſes called al Iſrael, and ſaid to them: you ſaw al thinges, that our Lord did before you in the Land of Ægypt to Pharao, and to al his ſeruantes, and to his whole land,
label: Deuteronomy

text: the great tentations, which thine eies haue ſeene, thoſe mightie ſignes, and wonders,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and our Lord hath not geuen you a hart to vnderſtand, and eies to ſee, and eares that can heare, vnto this preſent day.
label: Deuteronomy

text: He hath brought you fourtie yeares by the deſert: your garmentes are not worne out, neither are the shoes of your feete conſumed with age.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Breade you haue not eaten, wine and ſicer you haue not drunke: that you might know that I am the Lord your God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And you came to this place: and there came forth Sehon the King of Heſebon, and Og the King of Baſan, meeting vs to fight. And we ſtroke them,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and tooke their land, and deliuered it in poſſeſſion to Ruben and Gad, and the half tribe of Manaſſes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Keepe therfore the wordes of this couenant, and fulfil them: that you may vnderſtand al thinges that you doe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: You ſtand this day al before our Lord your God, your princes, and tribes, and ancientes, and doctors, al the people of Iſrael,
label: Deuteronomy

text: your children and your wiues, and the ſtrangers that abide with thee in the campe, beſides the cutters of wood, and them, that carie water:
label: Deuteronomy

text: that thou mayeſt paſſe in the couenant of our Lord thy God, and in the oath which in this day our Lord thy God maketh with thee:
label: Deuteronomy

text: that he may rayſe thee vp a people to him ſelfe, and he be thy God as he hath ſpoken to thee, and as he ſware to thy fathers, Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Neither with you onlie doe I make this couenant, and confirme theſe oathes,
label: Deuteronomy

text: but with al that be preſent and abſent.
label: Deuteronomy

text: For you know how we dwelt in the Land of Ægypt, and how we haue paſſed through the middes of nations, which paſſing through
label: Deuteronomy

text: you haue ſeene their abominations and filth, that is to ſay, their Idols, wood and ſtone, ſiluer and gold, which they worshipped.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Leſt perhaps there be among you man or woman, familie or tribe, whoſe hart is turned away this day from our Lord God, to goe and ſerue the goddes of thoſe Nations: and there be among you a roote bringing forth gal and bitternes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And when he shal heare the wordes of this oath, he bleſſe him ſelfe in his hart, ſaying: I shal haue place, and walke in the prauitie of my hart: and the drunken take to her the thirſtie,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and our Lord forgeue him not: but then his furie moſt ſpecially fume, and his zeale againſt that man, and al the curſes ſitte vpon him, that be written in this volume: and our Lord abolish his name vnder heauen,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and conſume him vnto perdition out of al the tribes of Iſrael, according to the curſes, that are conteyned in the Booke of this law and couenant.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And the generation folowing shal ſay, and the children that shal be borne from thence forth, and the ſtrangers, that shal come from a farre, ſeeing the plagues of that Land, and the infirmities, wherwith our Lord hath afflicted it,
label: Deuteronomy

text: burning it with brimſtone, and heate of the ſalt, ſo that it can no more be ſowen, nor any grene thing ſpring therof, after the example of the ſubuerſion of Sodom and Gomorrha, Adama, and Seboim, which our Lord ſubuerted in his wrath and furie.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And al the Nations shal ſay: Why hath the Lord done thus to this Land? what is this exceding wrath of his furie?
label: Deuteronomy

text: And they shal anſwer: Becauſe they forſooke the couenant of the Lord, which he made with their fathers, when he brought them out of the Land of Ægypt:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and they haue ſerued ſtrange goddes, and adored them, whom they knew not, and to whom they had not beene deſigned:
label: Deuteronomy

text: therfore the furie of the Lord was wrath againſt this Land, to bring vpon it al the curſes, that are written in this volume:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and he hath caſt them out of their land, in wrath and furie, and in verie great indignation, and hath throwen them into a ſtrange land, as this day it is proued.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Thinges hidden, to our Lord God: which are manifeſt, to vs and to our children for euer, that we may doe al the words of this Law.
label: Deuteronomy

text: THERFORE when al theſe wordes shal be come vpon thee, the bleſſing or curſing, which I haue ſette forth before thee: & thou be touched with repentance of thy hart in al nations, into which our Lord thy God diſperſed thee,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and shalt returne to him, and obey his commandmentes, as I this day command thee, with thy children, in al thy hart, and in al thy ſoule:
label: Deuteronomy

text: our Lord thy God wil bring thee againe from thy captiuitie, and haue mercie vpon thee, and gather thee againe out of al the peoples, into which he diſperſed thee before.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If thou be diſperſed as farre as the poles of heauen, thence wil our Lord thy God draw thee backe,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and wil take thee to him, and bring thee into the Land, which thy fathers poſſeſſed, and thou shalt obteyne it: and bleſſing thee, wil make thee to be of a greater number,
label: Deuteronomy

text: then were thy fathers. Our Lord thy God wil circumciſe thy hart, and the hart of thy ſeede: that thou mayeſt loue oure Lord thy God in al thy hart, and in al thy ſoule, that thou mayeſt liue.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And al theſe curſes he wil turne vpon thine enemies, and them that hate and perſecute thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But thou shalt returne, and heare the voice of our Lord thy God, and shalt doe al the commandmentes which I command thee this day:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and our Lord wil make thee abound in al the workes of thy handes, in the iſſue of thy wombe, and in the fruite of thy cattel, in the fertilitie of thy ground, and in the plentie of al thinges. For our Lord wil returne to reioyſe vpon thee in al riches, as he reioyced in thy fathers:
label: Deuteronomy

text: yet ſo, if thou heare the voice of our Lord thy God, and keepe his preceptes and ceremonies, which are written in this law: and returne to our Lord thy God in al thy hart, and in al thy ſoule.
label: Deuteronomy

text: This commandment, that I command thee this daie, is not aboue thee, nor ſo farre of,
label: Deuteronomy

text: nor ſituated in heauen that thou maieſt ſay: Which of vs is able to aſcend vnto heauen to bring it to vs, that we may heare and fulfil it in worke?
label: Deuteronomy

text: Nor placed beyond the ſea: that thou mayeſt pretend, and ſay: Which of vs can paſſe ouer the ſea, and bring it euen vnto vs: that we way heare, and doe that which is commanded?
label: Deuteronomy

text: But the word is very neere thee, in thy mouth and in thy hart, to doe it.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Conſider that I haue ſet before thee this day life and good, and contrariewiſe death and euil:
label: Deuteronomy

text: that thou mayeſt loue our Lord thy God, and walke in his waies, and keepe his commandmentes and ceremonies and iudgementes: and thou mayeſt liue, and he multiplie thee, and bleſſe thee in the Land, which thou shalt enter to poſſeſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But if thy hart be auerted, and thou wilt not heare, and deceaued with errour thou adore ſtrange goddes, and ſerue them:
label: Deuteronomy

text: I foretel thee this day that thou shalt perish, and abide a litle time in the Land, which paſſing ouer Iordan, thou shalt enter to poſſeſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: I cal for witneſſes this day heauen and earth, that I haue propoſed to you life and death, bleſſing and curſing. Chooſe therfore life, that both thou mayeſt liue, and thy ſeede:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and mayeſt loue our Lord thy God, and obey his voice, and cleaue to him (for he is thy life, and the length of thy daies) that thou mayeſt liue in the Land, for the which our Lord ſware to thy fathers, Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob, that he would geue it them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: MOYSES therfore went, and ſpake al theſe wordes to al Iſrael,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and ſaid to them: I am this day a hundred and twentie yeares old, I can not goe out and come in any longer, eſpecially wheras our Lord alſo hath ſaid to me: Thou shalt not paſſe ouer this Iordan.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord therfore thy God wil paſſe ouer before thee: he wil deſtroy al theſe nations in thy ſight, and thou shalt poſſeſſe them: and this Ioſue shal paſſe ouer before thee, as our Lord hath ſpoken.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord shal doe to them as he did to Sehon and Og the kinges of the Ammorheites, and to their land, and ſhal deſtroy them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Therfore when our Lord shal haue deliuered theſe alſo to you, you shal doe in like manner to them as I haue commanded you.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Doe manfully, and be ſtrengthned: feare not, neither tremble ye at their ſight: becauſe our Lord thy God him ſelfe is thy conductor, and wil not leaue, nor forſake thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And Moyſes called Ioſue, and ſaid to him before al Iſrael: Take courage, and be ſtrong: for thou shalt bring in this people into the Land, which our Lord ſware that he would geue to their fathers, and thou shalt diuide it by lotte.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord that is your conductor, him ſelfe wil be with thee: he wil not leaue, nor forſake thee: feare not, neither dread thou.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Moyſes therfore wrote this law, and deliuered it to the prieſtes the ſonnes of Leui, which caried the arke of the couenant of our Lord, and to al the ancientes of Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And he commanded them ſaying: After ſeuen yeares, in the yeare of remiſſion, in the ſolemnitie of tabernacles,
label: Deuteronomy

text: when al come together out of Iſrael, to appeare in the ſight of our Lord thy God in the place, which our Lord shal chooſe, thou shalt read the wordes of this law before al Iſrael, they hearing,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and the people being aſſembled together, as wel men as women, children, and ſtrangers, that are within thy gates: that hearing they may learne, and feare our Lord your God, and keepe, and fulfil al the wordes of this law.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Their children alſo who now are ignorant; that they may heare, and feare our Lord their God, al the daies that they liue in the Land, which paſſing ouer Iordan you goe to obteyne.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Behold the daies of thy death are nigh: cal Ioſue, and ſtand ye in the tabernacle of teſtimonie, that I may command him. Moyſes therfore and Ioſue went, and ſtoode in the tabernacle of teſtimonie,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and our Lord appeared there in the piller of a cloude: which ſtood in the entring of the tabernacle.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord ſaid to Moyſes: Behold thou shalt ſleepe with thy fathers, and this people ryſing vp wil fornicate after ſtrange goddes in the Land, to the which it entreth to dwel therein: there wil they forſake me, and wil make the couenant, which I haue made with them, of none effect.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And my furie shal be wrath againſt them in that day: and I wil forſake them, and wil hide my face from them, and they shal be deuoured: al euils and afflictions shal finde them, ſo that they shal ſay in that day: In truth becauſe God is not with me, theſe euils haue found me.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But I wil hide, and keepe cloſe my face in that day, for al the euils, which they haue done, becauſe they haue folowed ſtrange goddes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Now therfore write vnto you this canticle, and teach the children of Iſrael: that they know it by hart, and ſing it by mouth, and this ſong be vnto me for a teſtimonie among the children of Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: For I wil bring them into the Land, for the which I ſware to their fathers, flowing with milke and honie. And when they haue eaten, and are ful, and fatte, they wil turne away to ſtrange goddes, and ſerue them: and wil detract from me, and make my couenant of none effect.
label: Deuteronomy

text: After that manie euils and afflictions shal haue found them, this canticle shal anſwer them for a teſtimonie, which no obliuion shal take away out of the mouth of their ſeede. For I know their cogitations, what thinges they are about to doe this day, before that I bring them into the Land, which I haue promiſed them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Moyſes therfore wrote the canticle, and taught it the children of Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord commanded Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, and ſaid: Take courage, and be ſtrong: for thou shalt bring the children of Iſrael into the Land, which I haue promiſed, and I wil be with thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Therfore after that Moyſes wrote the wordes of this law in a volume, and finished it:
label: Deuteronomy

text: he commanded the Leuites, that caried the arke of the couenant of our Lord, ſaying:
label: Deuteronomy

text: Take this booke, and put it in the ſide of the arke of the couenant of our Lord your God: that it may be for a teſtimonie againſt thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: For I know thy contention, and thy moſt ſtiffe necke. Whiles I yet liue and goe in with you, you haue done alwayes contenciouſly againſt our Lord: how much more when I shal be dead?
label: Deuteronomy

text: Gather to me al the ancientes by your tribes, and your doctors, and I wil ſpeake theſe wordes in their hearing, and wil inuocate againſt them heauen and earth.
label: Deuteronomy

text: For I know that after my death you wil doe wickedly, and wil decline quickly from the way, that I haue commanded you: and euils shal come vpon you in the later times, when you shal doe euil in the ſight of our Lord, to prouoke him by the workes of your handes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Moyſes therfore ſpake, in the hearing of the whole aſſemblie of Iſrael, the wordes of this ſong, and finished it euen to the end.
label: Deuteronomy

text: HEARE ye heauens what thinges I ſpeake, the earth heare the wordes of my mouth.
label: Deuteronomy

text: My doctrine grow together as raine, my ſpeach flow as the dew, as it were a shower vpon the herbe, and as it were droppes vpon the graſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Becauſe I wil inuocate the name of our Lord: geue magnificence to our God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The workes of God be perfect, and al his waies iudgementes: God is faithful, and without any iniquitie, iuſt and right.
label: Deuteronomy

text: They haue ſinned to him, and not his children in filthines: a froward and peruerſe generation.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Theſe thinges doeſt thou render to our Lord thou foolish and vnwiſe people? Is not he thy father, that hath poſſeſſed thee, and made, and created thee?
label: Deuteronomy

text: Remember the old daies, thinke vpon euerie generation: aske thy father, and he wil declare to thee: thy elders, and they wil tel thee.
label: Deuteronomy

text: When the higheſt diuided the nations: when he ſeparated the ſonnes of Adam, he appointed the limites of people according to the number of the children of Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But our Lords part, is his people: Iacob the corde of his inheritance.
label: Deuteronomy

text: He found him in a deſert land, in a place of horrour, and of waſt wildernes: he ledde him about, and taught him: and kept him as the apple of his eye.
label: Deuteronomy

text: As the eagle prouoking her young to flie, and houering ouer them, hath he ſpred his winges, and he hath taken him, and caried him on his shoulders.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord onlie was his guide: and there was not with him a ſtrange God.
label: Deuteronomy

text: He placed him ouer an high land: that he might eate the fruites of the fieldes, that he might ſucke honie out of the rocke, and oile out of the hardeſt ſtone.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Butter from the heard, and milke of the ſheepe with the fatte of lambes, and of rammes the ſonnes of Baſan: and bucke goates with the marow of wheate, and might drinke the bloud of the grape moſt pure.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The beloued was made groſſe, and ſpurned: made groſſe, fatted, dilated, he left God his maker, and departed from God his ſaluation.
label: Deuteronomy

text: They prouoked him in ſtrange goddes, and in abominations ſtirred him to anger.
label: Deuteronomy

text: They immolated to diuels and not to God, to goddes, which they knew not: there came new & fresh ones, whom their fathers worshipped not.
label: Deuteronomy

text: God that begatte thee thou haſt forſaken, and haſt forgotten our Lord thy creatour.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord ſaw, and was moued to wrath: becauſe his ſonnes and daughters prouoked him.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And he ſaid: I wil hide my face from them, and wil conſider their laſt: for it is a peruerſe generation, and vnfaithful children.
label: Deuteronomy

text: They haue prouoked me in that, which was no God, and haue angred me in their vanities: and I wil prouoke them in that, which is no people, and in a foolish nation wil I anger them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: A fyre is kindled in my wrath, and shal burne euen to the loweſt partes of hel: and shal deuoure the earth with her ſpring, and shal burne the foundations of mountaines.
label: Deuteronomy

text: I wil heape euils vpon them, and myne arrowes I wil ſpend in them.
label: Deuteronomy

text: They shal be conſumed with famine, and birdes shal deuoure them with moſt bitter biting: the teeth of beaſtes wil I ſend vpon them, with the furie of thoſe that traile vpon the ground, and creepe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Without shal the ſword deuoure them, & within fearfulnes, the young man and the virgin together, the ſucking child with the old man.
label: Deuteronomy

text: I ſaid: Where are they? I wil make their memorie to ceaſe from among men.
label: Deuteronomy

text: But for the wrath of the enemies I haue differred: leſt perhaps their enemies might be proude, and would ſay: Our mightie hand, and not the Lord, hath done al theſe thinges.
label: Deuteronomy

text: A nation without counſel is it, and without wiſedome.
label: Deuteronomy

text: O that they were wiſe, and vnderſtoode, and would prouide for their laſt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: How should one purſew a thouſand, and two put ten thouſand to flight? was it not therfore, becauſe their God ſold them, and our Lord incloſed them?
label: Deuteronomy

text: For our Lord is not as their goddes: our enemies alſo are iudges.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Of the vineyard of Sodom, is their vineyard, and of the ſuburbes of Gomorrha: their grape the grape of gall, and the cluſters moſt bitter.
label: Deuteronomy

text: The gall of dragons their wine, and the venime of Aſpes vncurable.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Are not theſe thinges laid vp with me, and ſigned in my treaſures?
label: Deuteronomy

text: Reuenge is myne, and I wil repay them in time, that their foote may ſlide: the day of perdition is at hand, and the times make haſt to be preſent.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Our Lord wil iudge his people, and wil haue mercie on his ſeruantes: he shal ſee that their hand is weakened, and the shut vp alſo haue fayled, and the reſidew be conſumed.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And he shal ſay: Where are their goddes, in whom they had confidence.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Of whoſe victimes they did eate fatte, and dranke the wine of their libamentes: Let them ariſe, and help you, and protect you in neceſſitie.
label: Deuteronomy

text: See ye that I am onlie, and there is no other God beſides me: I wil kil, and I wil make to liue: I wil ſtrike, and I wil heale, and there is none that can deliuer out of my hand.
label: Deuteronomy

text: I wil lift vp my hand to heauen, and wil ſay: I liue for euer.
label: Deuteronomy

text: If I shal whette my ſword as the lightening, and my hand take iudgement: I wil repay vengeance to myne enemies, and them that hate me wil I requite.
label: Deuteronomy

text: I wil embrew my arrowes with bloud, and my ſword shal deuoure flesh, of the bloud of the ſlaine and of captiuitie, of the bare head of the enemies.
label: Deuteronomy

text: You gentiles prayſe his people, becauſe he wil reuenge the bloud of his ſeruantes: and wil repay vengeance vpon their enemies, and wil be propitious to the land of his people.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Moyſes therfore came and ſpake al the wordes of this canticle in the eares of the people, he and Ioſue the ſonne of Nun.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And he finished al theſe wordes, ſpeaking to the children of Iſrael:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and he ſaid to them: Sette your hartes on al the wordes, which I teſtifie to you this day: that you command them to your children to keepe and to doe, and to fulfil al thinges of this law that are written:
label: Deuteronomy

text: for not in vaine are they commanded you, but that euerie one should liue in them: which doing you may continew a long time in the Land, which paſſing ouer Iordan you enter to poſſeſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord ſpake to Moyſes in the ſame day, ſaying:
label: Deuteronomy

text: Goe vp into this mount Abarim, that is to ſay, of paſſages, into mount Nebo, which is in the Land of Moab againſt Iericho: and ſee the Land of Chanaan, which I wil deliuer to the children of Iſrael to obteyne, and die thou in the mount.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Which going vp vnto thou shalt be ioyned to thy peoples, as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was layd to his people:
label: Deuteronomy

text: becauſe you did preuaricate againſt me in the middes of the children of Iſrael at the Waters of contradiction in Cades of the deſert of Sin: and you did not ſanctifie me among the children of Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Ouer againſt shalt thou ſee the Land, and shalt not enter into it, which I wil geue to the children of Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: THIS is the bleſſing, wherwith Moyſes the man of God bleſſed the children of Iſrael, before his death.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And he ſaid: Our Lord came from Sinai, and from Seir he is riſen to vs: he hath appeared from mount Pharan, and with him thousādes of Sainctes. In his right hand a fyrie law.
label: Deuteronomy

text: He hath loued the peoples, al the ſaintes are in his hand: and they that approch to his feete, shal receiue of his doctrine.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Moyſes commanded vs a law, the inheritance of the multitude of Iacob.
label: Deuteronomy

text: He shal be king with the moſt right, the princes of the people being aſſembled with the tribes of Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Liue Ruben, and die he not, and be he litle in number.
label: Deuteronomy

text: This is the bleſſing of Iudas: Heare Lord the voice of Iudas, and bring him in vnto his people: his handes shal fight for him, and he shal be his helper againſt his aduerſaries.
label: Deuteronomy

text: To Leui alſo he ſaid: Thy perfection, and thy doctrine be to thy holie man, whom thou haſt proued in tentation, and iudged at the Waters of contradiction.
label: Deuteronomy

text: He that ſaid to his father, and to his mother: I know you not; and to his brethren: I know you not: & they knew not their children. Theſe kept thy word, and obſerued thy couenant,
label: Deuteronomy

text: thy iudgementes o Iacob, and thy law o Iſrael: they shal put incenſe in thy furie, and holocauſt vpon thyne altar.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Bleſſe Lord his ſtrength, and receiue the workes of his handes. Strike the backes of his enemies, and they that hate him, let them not riſe vp.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And to Beniamin he ſaid: The beſt beloued of our Lord shal dwel confidently in him: as in a bride chamber al the day shal he abide, and betwen his shoulders shal he reſt.
label: Deuteronomy

text: To Ioſeph alſo he ſaid: Of the bleſſing of our Lord be his land, of the fruites of heauen, and the dew, & the depth lying vnderneth.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Of the pomes of the fruites of the ſunne and moone,
label: Deuteronomy

text: of the toppes of the old mountaynes, of the pomes of the eternal hilles:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and of the fruites of the earth, and of the fulnes therof. The bleſſing of him, that appeared in the bush, come vpon the head of Ioſeph, and vpon the crowne of the nazarite among his brethren.
label: Deuteronomy

text: His beautie as of the firſt borne of an oxe, his hornes the hornes of an vnicorne: in them shal he winow the Nations euen to the endes of the earth. theſe are the multitudes of Ephraim, and theſe the thouſandes of Manaſſes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And to Zabulon he ſaid: Reioyſe Zabulon in thy going out, and Iſſachar in thy tabernacles.
label: Deuteronomy

text: They shal cal the peoples to the mountaine: there shal they immolate the victimes of iuſtice. Who shal ſucke the inundation of the ſea as milke, and the hidden treaſures of the ſandes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And to Gad he ſaid: Bleſſed be Gad in breadth: as a lion hath he reſted, and taken the arme and the toppe of the head.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And he ſaw his principalitie, that in his part the doctor was repoſed: which was with the princes of the people, and did the iuſtices of our Lord, and his iudgement with Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: To Dan alſo he ſaid: Dan a lions whelpe, he shal flow largely from Baſan.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And to Nephthali he ſaid: Nephthali shal enioy abundance, and shal be ful of the bleſſinges of our Lord: the ſea and the ſouth he shal poſſeſſe.
label: Deuteronomy

text: To Aſer alſo he ſaid: Bleſſed be Aſer in children, be he acceptable to his brethren, and dippe he in oile his foote.
label: Deuteronomy

text: His shoe yron and braſſe. As the daies of thy youth, ſo alſo thy old age.
label: Deuteronomy

text: There is no other God as the God of the righteſt: the mounter of heauen is thy helper. By his magnificence the cloudes runne hither and thither,
label: Deuteronomy

text: his habitation is aboue, and vnder the euerlaſting armes: he shal caſt out the enemie from thy face, and shal ſay: Be deſtroyed.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Iſrael shal dwel confidently, and alone. The eie of Iacob in the land of corne and wine, and the heauens shal be miſtie with dew.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Bleſſed art thou Iſrael: who is like to thee o people, that art ſaued in our Lord? the shield of thy helpe, and the ſword of thy glorie: thy enemies shal denie thee, and thou shalt treade their neckes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: MOYSES therfore went vp from the champion of Moab vpon mount Nebo, into the toppe of Phaſga againſt Iericho: and our Lord shewed him al the land of Galaad as farre as Dan,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and al Nephthali, and the land of Ephraim and Manaſſes, and al the Land of Iuda vnto the vtmoſt ſea,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and the ſouth part, and the bredth of the plaine of Iericho a citie of palmetrees as farre as Segor.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And our Lord ſaid to him: This is the Land, for the which I ſware to Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob, ſaying: To thy ſeede wil I geue it. Thou haſt ſeene it with thyne eies, and shalt not paſſe ouer to it.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord died there, in the land of Moab, our Lord commanding it:
label: Deuteronomy

text: and he buried him in the valley of the Land of Moab, againſt Phogor: and no man hath knowne his ſepulchre vntil this preſent day.
label: Deuteronomy

text: Moyſes was an hundred and twentie yeares old when he died: his eie was not dimme, neither were his teeth moued.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And the children of Iſrael mourned him in the champion countrie of Moab thirtie daies: and the daies of their mourning that mourned for Moyſes were accomplished.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And Ioſue the ſonne of Nun was replenished with the ſpirit of wiſedome, becauſe Moyſes did put his handes vpon him. And the children of Iſrael obeied him, and did as our Lord commanded Moyſes.
label: Deuteronomy

text: And thete roſe no more a prophete in Iſrael as Moyſes, whom our Lord had knowen face to face,
label: Deuteronomy

text: in al ſignes and wonders, which he ſent by him, to doe in the Land of Ægypt to Pharao, and to al his ſeruantes, and to his whole Land,
label: Deuteronomy

text: and al the ſtrong hand, and great meruailes, which Moyſes did before al Iſrael.
label: Deuteronomy

text: AND it came to paſſe after the death of Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord, that our Lord ſpake to Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, the miniſter of Moyſes, and ſaid to him:
label: Josue

text: Moyſes my ſeruant is deade: ariſe, and paſſe ouer this Iordan thou and al the people with thee, into the Land, which I wil geue to the children of Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: Euerie place, the ſteppe of your foote shal treade, wil I deliuer to you, as I haue ſpoken to Moyſes.
label: Josue

text: From the deſert and Libanus vnto the great riuer Euphrates, al the land of the Hetheites vnto the great ſea againſt the going downe of the ſunne, shal be your border.
label: Josue

text: No man shal be able to reſiſt you al the daies of thy life: as I haue beene with Moyſes, ſo wil I be with thee: I wil not leaue, nor forſake thee,
label: Josue

text: Take courage, and be ſtrong: for thou shalt by lotte diuide to this people the Land, for the which I ſware to their fathers, that I would deliuer it to them.
label: Josue

text: Take courage therfore, and be very ſtrong: that thou keepe and doe al the Law, which Moyſes my ſeruant hath commanded thee: decline not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayeſt vnderſtand al thinges which thou doeſt.
label: Josue

text: Let not the volume of this law depart from thy mouth: but thou shalt meditate in it daies and nightes, that thou maieſt keepe and doe al thinges that be written in it: then shalt thou direct thy way, and vnderſtand it.
label: Josue

text: Behold I command thee, take courage, and be ſtrong. Feare not, and dreade not: becauſe the Lord thy God is with thee in al the thinges to whatſoeuer thou shalt goe.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue commanded the princes of the people, ſaying: Paſſe through the middes of the campe, and command the people, and ſay:
label: Josue

text: Prepare for your ſelues victuals: for after the third day you shal paſſe ouer Iordan, and shal enter to poſſeſſe the Land, which our Lord your God wil geue you.
label: Josue

text: To the Rubenites alſo and Gaddites, and halfe tribe of Manaſſes he ſaid:
label: Josue

text: Remember the word, which Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord commanded you, ſaying: Our Lord your God hath geuen you reſt, and al this Land.
label: Josue

text: Your wiues, and children, and cattel shal tarie in the Land, which Moyſes deliuered to you beyond Iordan: but paſſe you ouer armed before your brethren, al that are ſtrong of hand, & fight for them,
label: Josue

text: vntil our Lord geue reſt to your brethren as to you alſo he hath geuen, and they alſo poſſeſſe the Land which our Lord your God wil geue them: and ſo returne into the Land of your poſſeſſion, and you shal dwel in it, which Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord gaue you beyond Iordan, againſt the ryſing of the ſunne.
label: Josue

text: And they made anſwer to Ioſue, and ſaid: Al thinges, that thou haſt commanded vs we wil doe: and whither ſoeuer thou shalt ſend vs, we wil goe.
label: Josue

text: As we obeyed Moyſes in al thinges, ſo wil we obey thee alſo: only be our Lord thy God with thee, as he was with Moyſes.
label: Josue

text: He that shal gaineſay thy mouth, and not obey al thy wordes, that thou shalt command him, let him die. thou only take courage, and doe manfully.
label: Josue

text: THERFORE Ioſue the ſonne of Nun ſent from Setim two men, to ſpie in ſecrete: and ſaid to them: Goe, and view the Land, and the citie of Iericho. Who going entred into the houſe of a woman a harlot, named Rahab, and reſted with her.
label: Josue

text: And it was told the king of Iericho, and ſaid: Behold there are men come in hither by night of the children of Iſrael, to ſpie the Land.
label: Josue

text: And the king of Iericho ſent to Rahab, ſaying: Bring forth the men, that came to thee, and are entred into thy houſe: for they be ſpies, and are come to view al the Land.
label: Josue

text: And the woman taking the men, hid them, and ſaid: I confeſſe they came to me, but I knew not whence they were:
label: Josue

text: and when the gate was a shutting in the darke, and they withal went out, I know not whither they be gone: purſew quickly, and you shal ouertake them.
label: Josue

text: But she made the men to goe vp into the roofe of her houſe, and couered them with the ſtalke of flaxe, which was there.
label: Josue

text: And they that were ſent, folowed them, the way that leadeth to the ford of Iordan: and they being gone out the gate forwith was shutte.
label: Josue

text: Neither were they yer a ſleepe that lay hidde, and behold the woman went vp to them, and ſaid:
label: Josue

text: I know that the Lord hath geuen this Land to you: for your terrour is fallen vpon vs, and al the inhabitantes of the Land are become fainte.
label: Josue

text: We haue heard that the Lord dried vp the water of the Redſea at your entring, when you came out of Ægypt: and what thinges you did to the two kinges of the Amorrheites, that were beyond Iordan: Sehon and Og, whom you ſlew.
label: Josue

text: And hearing theſe thinges we greatly feared, and our hart fainted, neither did there remaine ſpirite in vs at your entring in: for the Lord your God he is God in heauen aboue, & in the earth beneth.
label: Josue

text: Now therfore ſweare to me by the Lord, that as I haue done mercie with you, ſo you alſo doe with my fathers houſe: and you geue me a true ſigne,
label: Josue

text: that you ſaue my father and mother, my brethren and ſiſters, and al thinges that he theirs, and deliuer our ſoules from death.
label: Josue

text: Who anſwered her: Be our liues for you vnto death, only if thou betray vs not. And when our Lord shal haue deliuered vs the land, we wil doe in thee mercie and truth
label: Josue

text: She therfore did let them downe by a corde out of a window: for her houſe ioyned faſt to the wall.
label: Josue

text: And she ſaid to them: Goe vp to the mountaines, leſt perhaps they meete you returning: and there lie hid three daies, til they returne, and ſo you shal goe on your way.
label: Josue

text: Who ſaid to her: We shal be quitte from this oath, wherwith thou haſt ſworne vs:
label: Josue

text: if we entring the Land, there be this purple corde a ſigne, and thou tie it in the window, by the which thou haſt let vs downe: and gather thy father and mother, and brethren and al thy kindred into thy houſe.
label: Josue

text: He that shal goe forth of the doore of thy houſe, his bloud ſhal be vpon his head, and we shal be quitte. But the bloud of al, that shal be with thee in the houſe, shal redound vpon our head, if any man touch them.
label: Josue

text: But if thou wilt betray vs, and vtter this talke abroade, we shal be quitte from this oath, wherwith thou haſt adiured vs.
label: Josue

text: And she anſwered: As you haue ſpoken, ſo be it done, and diſmiſſing them to goe, she hong the purple corde in the window.
label: Josue

text: But they walking came to the mountaines, and taried there three dayes, til they returned that purſewed them: for ſeeking euerie way, they found them not.
label: Josue

text: Who being entred into the citie, the diſcouerers returned, and came downe from the mountaine: and paſſing ouer Iordan, they came to Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, and told him al thinges that had chanced to them,
label: Josue

text: and ſaid: Our Lord hath deliuered al this land into our handes, and al the inhabitantes therof are ouerthrowen with feare.
label: Josue

text: IOSVE therfore ryſing vp in the night, remoued the campe: and departing from Setim, they came to Iordan, he, and al the children of Iſrael, and abode there for three dayes.
label: Josue

text: Which being paſſed, the herauldes went through the middes of the campe,
label: Josue

text: and beganne to proclaime: When you shal ſee the arke of couenant of our Lord your God, and the prieſtes of the Leuitical ſtocke carying it, ryſe you alſo, and folow them going before:
label: Josue

text: and let there be betwen you and the arke the ſpace of two thouſand cubites: that you may ſee it a farre of, and know which way you may goe: becauſe you haue not walked by it before: and beware you approch not to the arke.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue ſaid to the people: Be ſanctified: for to morrow our Lord wil doe among you merueilous thinges.
label: Josue

text: And he ſaid to the prieſtes: Take vp the arke of the couenant, & goe before the people. Who fulfilling his commandementes, tooke it, and walked before them.
label: Josue

text: And our Lord ſaid to Ioſue: This day wil I beginne to exalt thee before al Iſrael: that they may know as I was with Moyſes, ſo am I with thee alſo.
label: Josue

text: And doe thou command the prieſtes, that carie the arke of the teſtament, and ſay to them: When you shal be entred into part of the water of Iordan, ſtand in it.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue ſaid to the children of Iſrael: Come hither, and heare the word of our Lord your God.
label: Josue

text: And againe he ſaid: In this you shal know that our Lord the liuing God is in the middes of you, and shal deſtroy in your ſight the Chananeite and Hetheite, the Heueite and Pherezeite, the Gergeſeite alſo and the Iebuſeite, and the Amorrheite.
label: Josue

text: Behold the arke of the couenant of the Lord of al the earth shal goe before you into Iordan.
label: Josue

text: Prepare twelue men of the tribes of Iſrael, one of euerie tribe.
label: Josue

text: And when the prieſtes that carie the arke of the Lord of the whole earth shal ſette the ſteppes of their feete in the waters of Iordan, the waters, that are beneath, shal runne downe and decay: and thoſe that come from aboue, shal ſtand together in one heape.
label: Josue

text: Therfore the people went out of their tabernacles, to paſſe ouer Iordan: and the prieſtes, that caried the arke of the couenant, went on before them.
label: Josue

text: And they being entered into Iordan, and their feete dipped in part of the water (and Iordan in the harueſt time had filled the bankes of his chanel)
label: Josue

text: the waters that came downeward ſtoode in one place, and like a mountaine ſwelling vp appeared farre from the citie, that is called Adom to the place of Sarthan: but thoſe that were beneth, ranne downe into the Sea of the wildernes (which now is called the dead ſea) vntil they wholy dacayed.
label: Josue

text: And the people went againſt Iericho: and the prieſtes that caried the arke of the couenant of our Lord, ſtoode girded vpon the drie ground in the middes of Iordan, and al the people paſſed ouer through the drie chanel.
label: Josue

text: VVHo being paſſed ouer, our Lord ſaid to Ioſue:
label: Josue

text: Chooſe twelue men one in euerie tribe:
label: Josue

text: and command them that they take vp out of the middes of the chanel of Iordā, where the feete of the prieſtes ſtoode, twelue moſt hard ſtones, which you shal put in the place of the campe, where you shal pitch tentes this night.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue called twelue men, whom he had choſen out of the children of Iſrael, one of euerie tribe,
label: Josue

text: and he ſaid to them: Goe before the arke of our Lord your God to the middes of Iordan, and carrie from thence euerie man a ſtone on your ſhoulders, according to the number of the children of Iſrael,
label: Josue

text: that it may be a ſigne among you: and when your children shal aske you to morrow, ſaying: What meane theſe ſtones?
label: Josue

text: You shal anſwer them: The waters of Iordan decayed before the arke of the couenant of our Lord, when it paſſed ouer the ſame: therfore were theſe ſtones ſette for a monument of the children of Iſrael for euer.
label: Josue

text: The children of Iſrael therfore did as Ioſue commanded them, carying out of the chanel of Iordan twelue ſtones, as our Lord had commanded him, according to the number of the children of Iſrael, vnto the place, wherein they camped, and there they ſette them.
label: Josue

text: Other twelue ſtones alſo Ioſue put in the middes of the chanel of Iordan, where the prieſtes ſtoode, that caried the arke of the couenant: and they be there vntil this preſent day.
label: Josue

text: But the prieſtes that caried the arke, ſtoode in the middes of Iordan, til al thinges were accomplished, which our Lord had commanded Ioſue, to ſpeake to the people, and Moyſes had ſaid to him. And the people made haſt, and paſſed ouer.
label: Josue

text: And when they had al paſſed ouer, the arke alſo of our Lord paſſed ouer, the prieſtes alſo went before the people.
label: Josue

text: The children of Ruben alſo and Gad, and the half tribe of Manaſſes, went armed before the children of Iſrael, as Moyſes had commanded them:
label: Josue

text: and fourtie thouſand fighting men by troupes, and bandes, marched through the plaine and champion countrie of the citie of Iericho.
label: Josue

text: In that day our Lord magnified Ioſue before al Iſrael, that they should feare him, as they had feared Moyſes, whiles he yet liued.
label: Josue

text: And he ſaid to him:
label: Josue

text: Command the prieſtes, that carie the arke of the couenant, that they comme vp out of Iordan.
label: Josue

text: Who commanded them, ſaying: Come ye vp out of Iordan.
label: Josue

text: And when they that caried the arke of the couenant of our Lord, were come vp, and began to treade on the drie ground, the waters returned into their chanel, and ranne as they were wont before.
label: Josue

text: And the people came vp out of Iordan, the tenth day of the firſt moneth, and camped in Galgal againſt the Eaſt ſide of the citie of Iericho.
label: Josue

text: The twelue ſtones alſo, which they had taken out of the chanel of Iordan, Ioſue ſette in Galgal,
label: Josue

text: and ſaid to the children of Iſrael: When your children shal aske their fathers to morrow, and shal ſay to them: What meane theſe ſtones:
label: Josue

text: You shal teach them, and ſay: By the drie chanel did Iſrael paſſe ouer this Iordan,
label: Josue

text: your Lord God drying the waters therof in your ſight, vntil you paſſed ouer:
label: Josue

text: as he had done before in the readſea, which he dried til we paſſed throuh:
label: Josue

text: that al the people of the earth may learne the moſt ſtrong hand of our Lord, that you alſo may feare our Lord your God.
label: Josue

text: THERFORE after that al the kinges of the Ammorrheites, which dwelt beyond Iordan at the weſt ſide, and al the kinges of Chanaan, which poſſeſſed the places nigh to the great ſea, had heard that our Lord had dried the ſtreames of Iordan before the children of Iſrael, til they paſſed ouer, their hart failed, and there remained no ſpirit in them, fearing the entring of the children of Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: At that time our Lord ſaid to Ioſue: Make thee kniues of ſtone, and circumciſe the ſecond time the children of Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: He did that which our Lord had commanded, and he circumciſed the children of Iſrael in the hil of the prepuces.
label: Josue

text: And this is the cauſe of the ſecond circumciſion: Al the people, that came out of Ægypt of the malekinde, al the fighting men, died in the deſert by the long circuites of the way,
label: Josue

text: who were al circumciſed. But the people that was borne in the deſert,
label: Josue

text: during the fourtie yeares of the iourney in the wide wildernes was incircumciſed: til they were conſumed that had not heard the voice of our Lord, and to whom he had ſworne before, that he would not shew them a land flowing with milke and honie.
label: Josue

text: The children of theſe ſucceded in the place of the fathers, and were circumciſed of Ioſue: for they were in the prepuce euen as they were borne, neither had any circumciſed them in the way.
label: Josue

text: And after that they were al circumciſed, they abode in the ſame place of the campe, vntil they were whole.
label: Josue

text: And our Lord ſaid to Ioſue: This day haue I taken away the reproch of Ægypt from you. And the name of that place was called Galgal, vntil this preſent day.
label: Josue

text: And the children of Iſrael abode in Galgal, & they made the Phaſe, the fourteenth day of the moneth at euen, in the champion of Iericho:
label: Josue

text: and they did eate of the corne of the Land the next day, azyme loaues and polēt of the ſame yeare.
label: Josue

text: And Manna failed after they did eate of the corne of the Land, neither did the children of Iſrael vſe that meate any more, but they did eate of the corne of the preſent Land of Chanaan.
label: Josue

text: And when Ioſue was in the field of the citie of Iericho, he lifted vp his eies, and ſaw a man ſtanding againſt him, holding a drawen ſword, and he went to him, and ſaid: Art thou ours, or our aduerſaries?
label: Josue

text: Who anſwered: No: but I am a prince of the hoſt of our Lord, and now I come.
label: Josue

text: Ioſue fel flatte on the ground. And adoring he ſaid: What ſpeaketh my Lord to his ſeruant?
label: Josue

text: Looſe, ſayth he, thy ſhoe from thy feete: for the place wherein thou doſt ſtand, is holie. And Ioſue did as it was commanded him.
label: Josue

text: AND Iericho was shut and fenſed, for feare of the children of Iſrael, and no man durſt goe out or come in.
label: Josue

text: And our Lord ſaid to Ioſue: Behold I haue geuen into thy handes Iericho, and the king therof, and al the valiant men.
label: Josue

text: Goe round about the citie al you that be men of warre once a day: ſo shal you doe ſix daies.
label: Josue

text: And the ſeuenth day the prieſtes shal take vp the ſeuen trumpettes, which are vſed in the Iubilee, and shal goe before the arke of the couenant: and you shal goe about the citie ſeuen times, and the prieſtes shal ſound with trumpetes.
label: Josue

text: And when the voice of the trumpet shal ſound in length and with a broken tune, and shal ſound in your eares, al the people shal crie together with a verie greate shoote, and the walles of the citie shal fall to the ground, and they shal enter in euerie one at the place againſt which they shal ſtād.
label: Josue

text: Ioſue therfore the ſonne of Nun called the prieſtes, and ſaid to them: Take vp the arke of the couenant: and let ſeuen other prieſtes take vp the ſeuen trūpettes of the iubilees, and march before the arke of our Lord.
label: Josue

text: To the people alſo he ſaid: Goe, and cōpaſſe the citie, the armed going before the arke of our Lord.
label: Josue

text: And when Ioſue had ended his wordes, and the ſeuen prieſtes ſounded with ſeuen trumpettes before the arke of the couenant of our Lord,
label: Josue

text: and al the armed hoſte went before, the reſt of the commō people folowed the arke, and al places ſounded with the trumpettes.
label: Josue

text: But Ioſue had commanded the people, ſaying: You shal not crie, neither shal your voice be heard, nor any word goe out of your mouth: vntil the day come wherin I shal ſay to you: Crie, and shoote.
label: Josue

text: Therfore the arke of our Lord went about the citie once a day, and returning into the campe, abode there.
label: Josue

text: Ioſue therfore ryſing in the night, the prieſtes tooke the arke of our Lord,
label: Josue

text: and ſeuen of them ſeuen trumpettes, which are vſed in the iubilee: and they went before the arke of our Lord walking and ſounding: and the armed people went before them, and the reſt of the common people folowed the arke, and they ſounded with trumpettes.
label: Josue

text: And they went round about the citie the ſecond day once, and returned into the campe. So did they ſix daies.
label: Josue

text: But the ſeuenth day, ryſing vp early, they went about the citie, as it was ordained, ſeuen times.
label: Josue

text: And when in the ſeuenth going about the prieſtes ſounded with the trumpettes, Ioſue ſaid to al Iſrael: Make a shoote: for our Lord hath deliuered to you the citie:
label: Josue

text: and let this citie be anathema: and al thinges that are in it, to our Lord. onlie Rahab the harlot let her liue, with al that be with her in the houſe: for she hidde the meſſengers whom we ſent.
label: Josue

text: But you beware you touch not ought of thoſe rhinges, that are commanded, and be guiltie of preuarication, and al the campe of Iſrael be vnder ſinne, and be trubled.
label: Josue

text: But whatſoeuer gold or ſiluer there shal be, and of braſen veſſels and yron, let it be conſecrated to our Lord, layd vp in his treaſures.
label: Josue

text: Therfore al the people making a shoote, and the trumpettes ſounding, after that the voice and the ſound thundred in the eares of the multitude, the walles forthwith fell: and euerie man went vp by the place, that was againſt him: and they tooke the citie,
label: Josue

text: and killed al thinges that were in it, from man to woman, from the infant to the old man. The oxen alſo and sheepe, and the aſſes they ſtroke in the edge of the ſword.
label: Josue

text: But to the two men that had bene ſent for ſpies, Ioſue ſaid: Goe into the houſe of the woman the harlotte, and bring her forth, and al thinges that be hers, as you aſſured her by oath.
label: Josue

text: And the young men going in, brought out Rahab, and her parentes, her brethren alſo and al her ſtuffe and kinred, and made them to tarie without the campe.
label: Josue

text: But the citie, and al thinges, that were found therein they burnt; except the gold and ſiluer, and braſen veſſels, and yron, which they conſecrated vnto the treaſurie of our Lord.
label: Josue

text: But Rahab the harlotte and the houſe of her father, and al that she had, Ioſue cauſed to liue, and they dwelt in the middes of Iſrael vntil this preſent day: for that she hidde the meſſengers, which he had ſent to view Iericho. At that time, Ioſue pronounced a curſe, ſaying:
label: Josue

text: Curſed be the man before our Lord, that shal rayſe vp and build the citie of Iericho. In his firſt borne lay he the fundations therof, and in the laſt of his children ſette he vp the gates therof.
label: Josue

text: Our Lord therfore was with Ioſue, and his name was bruited in al the earth.
label: Josue

text: BVT the children of Iſrael tranſgreſſed the commandment, & vſurped of the anathema. For Achan the ſonne of Charmi, the ſonne of Zabdi, the ſonne of Zare of the tribe of Iuda, tooke ſomewhat of the anathema: and our Lord was angrie againſt the children of Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: And when Ioſue ſent from Iericho men againſt Hai, which is beſide Bethauen, at the Eaſt ſide of the towne of Bethel, he ſaid to them: Goe vp, and view the Land: who accomplishing his commandmentes, viewed Hai.
label: Josue

text: And returning they ſaid to him: Let not al the people goe vp, but let two or three thouſand men goe, and deſtroy the citie: why shal al the people be vexed in vaine againſt verie few enemies?
label: Josue

text: There went vp therfore three thouſand fighting men. Who immediatly turning their backes,
label: Josue

text: were ſtrooken of the men of the citie of Hai, and there fel of them ſix and thirtie men: and the aduerſaries purſewed them from the gate as farre as Sabarim, and they ſtricke them flying away by the deſcent: and the hart of the people was much afrayd, and melted like vnto water.
label: Josue

text: But Ioſue rent his garmentes, and fel flatte on the ground before the arke of our Lord vntil euening, as wel he as al the ancientes of Iſrael: and they caſt duſt vpon their heades,
label: Josue

text: and Ioſue ſaid: Alas ô Lord God, why wouldeſt thou bring this people ouer the riuer of Iordan, to deliuer vs into the handes of the Amorrheite, and to deſtroy vs, would God as we beganne, we had taried beyond Iordan.
label: Josue

text: My Lord God what shal I ſay, ſeeing Iſrael turning their backes to their enemies?
label: Josue

text: The Chananeites shal heare of it, and al the inhabitantes of the Land, and being gathered together in a plumpe shal compaſſe vs about, & shal deſtroy our name from the earth: and what wilt thou doe to thy greate name?
label: Josue

text: And our Lord ſaid to Ioſue: Ariſe, why lieſt thou flatte on the ground?
label: Josue

text: Iſrael hath ſinned, and tranſgreſſed my couenant: and they haue taken of the anathema, and haue ſtolen and lyed, and haue hid it among their veſſel.
label: Josue

text: Neither can Iſrael ſtand before his enemies, and he shal flee them: becauſe he is polluted with the anathema. I wil be no more with you, til you diſpatch him, that is guiltie of this wicked fact.
label: Josue

text: Ariſe, ſanctifie the people, and ſay to them: Be ſanctified againſt to morrow: for thus ſaith our Lord God of Iſrael: There is anathema in the middes of thee ô Iſrael: thou canſt not ſtand before thyne enemies, til he be deſtroyed out of thee that is contaminated with this wicked fact.
label: Josue

text: And you shal come in the morning euerie one by your tribes: and what tribe ſoeuer the lote shal finde, it shal come by the kindredes therof, the kinred by the houſes, and the houſe by the men.
label: Josue

text: And whoſoeuer he be that shal be taken in this fact, he ſhal be burnt in the fyre with al his ſubſtance, becauſe he hath tranſgreſſed the couenāt of our Lord, and hath done abomination in Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: Ioſue therfore ryſing in the morning, made Iſrael to come by their tribes, and it was found the tribe of Iuda.
label: Josue

text: Which being preſented by the families therof, it was found the familie of Zare. Preſenting that alſo by the houſes, he found it Zabdi:
label: Josue

text: whoſe houſe diuiding into euerie man, he found Achan the ſonne of Charmi, the ſonne of Zabdi: the ſonne of Zare of the tribe of Iuda.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue ſaid to Achan: My ſonne, geue glorie to our Lord God of Iſrael, and confeſſe, and tel me what thou haſt done, hide it not.
label: Josue

text: And Achan anſwered Ioſue, and ſaid to him: In deede I haue ſinned to our Lord the God of Iſrael, and thus and thus haue I done.
label: Josue

text: For I ſaw among the ſpoiles a cloke of ſcarlet verie good, and two hundred ſicles of ſiluer, and a golden rule of fiftie ſicles: and coueting I tooke it away, and hid it in the ground againſt the middes of my tabernacle, and the ſiluer I couered with the earth digged vp.
label: Josue

text: Ioſue therfore ſent miniſters: who running to his tabernacle, found al thinges hid in the ſame place, and the ſiluer withal.
label: Josue

text: And taking it away out of the tent, brought it to Ioſue, and to al the children of Iſrael, and threw it before our Lord.
label: Josue

text: Ioſue therfore taking Achan the ſonne of Zare, and the ſiluer and the cloke, and the golden rule, his ſonnes alſo and daughters, his oxen, and aſſes, and sheepe, and the tabernacle it ſelf, and al the ſtuffe: (and al Iſrael with him) they brought them to the valley of Achor:
label: Josue

text: where Ioſue ſaid: Becauſe thou haſt diſturbed vs, our Lord diſturbe thee in this day. And al Iſrael ſtoned him: and al thinges that were his, were conſumed with fyre.
label: Josue

text: And gathered together vpon him a greate heape of ſtones, which remaineth vntil this preſent day. And the furie of our Lord was auerted from them. And the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, vntil this day.
label: Josue

text: AND our Lord ſaid to Ioſue: Feare not, neither doe thou dread: take with thee al the multitude of fighting men, and ryſing goe vp vnto the towne of Hai. behold I haue deliuered into thy hand the King therof, & the people, and the citie and the land.
label: Josue

text: And thou shalt do to the citie of Hai, and to the King therof, as thou haſt done to Iericho, and to the King therof: but the praye and al the cattel you shal ſpoyle for your ſelues: lay ambushmentes to the citie behind it.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue aroſe, and al the hoſte of the men of warre with him, to goe vp into Hai: and thirtie thouſand choſen valiant men he ſent in the night,
label: Josue

text: and commanded them, ſaying: Lay ambushmentes behinde the citie: neither retyre you farre of: and you shal al be readie.
label: Josue

text: But I and the reſt of the multitude, which is with me, wil goe vp on the contrarie ſide againſt the citie. And when they shal iſſue out againſt vs, as we did before, we wil flee, and turne our backes:
label: Josue

text: til purſewing they be drawen forward farre from the citie: for they wil thinck that we flee as before.
label: Josue

text: We therfore fleeing, and they purſewing, you shal riſe out of the ambushmentes, and shal waiſt the citie: and our Lord your God wil deliuer it into your handes.
label: Josue

text: And when you shal take it, burne it, and you shal doe al thinges ſo, as I haue commanded.
label: Josue

text: And he diſmiſſed them away, and they went on to the place of the ambushment, and ſate betwen Bethel and Hai, at the Weſt ſide of the citie of Hai. But Ioſue that night ſtayed in the middes of the people,
label: Josue

text: and ryſing early he muſtered his ſoldiars, and went vp with the ancientes in the fronte of the hoſte, enuironed with the ayde of the fighting men.
label: Josue

text: And when they were come, and were gone vp directly againſt the citie, they ſtoode on the North ſide of the citie, betwen which and them was a valley in the middes.
label: Josue

text: And fiue thouſand men had he choſen, and ſette in the embushmentes betwen Bethel and Hai on the Weſt ſide of the ſame citie:
label: Josue

text: but al the reſt of the hoſte went in battel aray on the North ſide, ſo that the laſt of the multitude did reach to the Weſt ſide of the citie. Ioſue therfore went that night, and ſtoode in the middes of the valley.
label: Josue

text: Which when the King of Hai had ſeene, he made haſt in the mourning, and iſſued forth with al the hoſt of the citie, and bent his armie toward the deſert, being ignorant that there lay embushmentes ſecretly behind his backe.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue, and al Iſrael gaue backe, feyning feare, and fleeing by the way of the wildernes.
label: Josue

text: But they cried alowde together, and encouraging one an other, purſewed them. And when they were gone from the citie,
label: Josue

text: and not one remained in the citie of Hai and Bethel, that purſewed not Iſrael (euen as they had rushed out leauing the townes open,)
label: Josue

text: our Lord ſaid to Ioſue: Lift vp the shield, that is in thy hand, againſt the citie of Hai, for I wil deliuer it to thee.
label: Josue

text: And when he had lifted vp his shield againſt the citie, the embushementes, that lay hidde, roſe vp immediatly: and going to the citie, tooke and burnt it.
label: Josue

text: And the men of the citie, that purſewed Ioſue, looking backe and ſeeing the ſmoke of the citie riſe vp euen to heauen, they could no more flee hither and thither: eſpecially whereas they, that had feyned running away, and went toward the wildernes, moſt valiantly reſiſted againſt the purſewers.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue and al Iſrael ſeeing that the citie was taken, and the ſmoke of the citie roſe vp, returning he ſtroke the men of Hai.
label: Josue

text: For they alſo that had taken and burnt the citie, iſſuing out of the citie againſt their owne men, beganne to ſtrike the enemies in the middes of them. When the aduerſaries therfore were ſlaine on both ſides, ſo that none of ſo great a multitude was ſaued,
label: Josue

text: they tooke the King of the citie of Hai aliue, and preſented him to Ioſue.
label: Josue

text: Therfore al being ſlaine, that had purſewed Iſrael fleeing to the deſertes, and falling by the ſword in the ſame place, the children of Iſrael returning ſtoke the citie.
label: Josue

text: And there were that fel that ſame day from man vnto woman, twelue thouſand men, al of the citie of Hai.
label: Josue

text: But Ioſue plucked not in his hand, which he had ſtrethched forth on high, holding the shield til al the inhabitantes of Hai were ſlaine.
label: Josue

text: And the cattel and the praye of the citie the children of Iſrael diuided among them, as our Lord had commanded Ioſue.
label: Josue

text: Who burnt the citie, and made it a heape for euer:
label: Josue

text: the king alſo therof he hong on a gibbet vntil euening and the going downe of the ſunne. And he commanded, and they tooke downe his corps from the gibbet: and threw it in the verie entring of the citie, heaping vpon it a great heape of ſtones, which remaineth vntil this preſent day.
label: Josue

text: Then Ioſue built an altar to our Lord the God of Iſrael in mount Hebal,
label: Josue

text: as Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord had commanded the children of Iſrael, and it is written in the volume of the law of Moyſes: an Altar of vnhewed ſtones which yron hath not touched; and he offered vpon it holocauſtes to our Lord, and immolated pacifique victimes.
label: Josue

text: And he wrote vpon ſtones the Deuterenomie of the law of Moyſes, which he had ordered before the children of Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: And al the people, and the ancientes, and the princes and iudges ſtoode on both ſides of the arke, in the ſight of the prieſtes that caried the arke of the couenant of our Lord, as wel the ſtranger as alſo the man of the ſame countrie. the half part of them beſide mount Garizim, and halfe beſide mount Hebal, as Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord had commanded. And firſt in deede he bleſſed the people of Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: After this he reade al the wordes of the bleſſing & the curſing, and al thinges that were written in the volume of the law.
label: Josue

text: Nothing of thoſe thinges, which Moyſes had commanded, did he leaue vntouched, but he repeated al thinges before al the multitude of Iſrael, the wemen and children and ſtrangers, that dwelt among them.
label: Josue

text: VVHICH thinges being heard, al the kinges beyond Iordan, that dwelt in the mountaines and champion countries, in the places by the ſea ſide and the shore of the great ſea, they alſo that dwelt beſide Libanus, the Hetheite and Amorreite, the Chananeite, the Pherezeite, and the Heueite, and the Iebuſeite,
label: Josue

text: were gathered, to fight againſt Ioſue and Iſrael with one minde, and one ſentence.
label: Josue

text: But they that dwelt in Gabaon, hearing al thinges that Ioſue had done to Iericho and Hai:
label: Josue

text: ſubtelly deuiſing tooke prouiſion for them ſelues, laying old ſackes vpon their aſſes, and bottels of wine rent and ſowed againe,
label: Josue

text: and shoes very old which for a shew of oldeneſſe were clouted with ſpeckes, putting on them old garmentes: the loaues alſo, which they caried for prouiſion by the way, were heard, and broken into peeces:
label: Josue

text: and they went on to Ioſue, who then abode in the campe at Galgal, and ſaid to him, and withal to al Iſrael: We are come from a farre countrie, deſirous to make peace with you. And the children of Iſrael anſwered them, and ſaid:
label: Josue

text: Leſt perhaps you dwel in the Land which is dew to vs by lotte, and we can not enter a league with you.
label: Josue

text: But they ſaid to Ioſue: We are thy ſeruantes. To whom Ioſue ſaid: Who are you? and whence came you?
label: Josue

text: they anſwered: From a very farre countrie are thy ſeruantes come in the name of the Lord thy God. For we haue heard the fame of his might, al thinges that he did in Ægypt,
label: Josue

text: and to the two kinges of the Amorrheites that were beyond Iordan, Sehon the king of Heſebon, and Og the king of Baſan, that were in Aſtaroth:
label: Josue

text: and our ancientes, and al the inhabitantes of our Land ſaid to vs: Take in your handes victuals for a very long way, and goe meete them, and ſay: We are your ſeruantes, enter a league with vs.
label: Josue

text: Behold, theſe loaues we tooke hotte, when we departed from our houſes to come to you, now they are become drie, and broken for ouer-much oldeneſſe.
label: Josue

text: the bottels of wine we filled being new, now they are burſt & diſſolued. The garmentes and ſhoes that we haue vpon vs, and which we haue on our feete, for the length of the long way are worne, and almoſt conſumed.
label: Josue

text: They tooke therfore of their victuals, and asked not the mouth of our Lord.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue made peace with them, and entring a league promiſed that they should not be ſlaine: the princes alſo of the multitude ſware to them.
label: Josue

text: But three daies after that the league was made, they heard that they dwelt nigh, and they should be among them.
label: Josue

text: And the children of Iſrael remoued the campe, and came into their cities the third day, whoſe names are theſe, Gabaon, and Chaphira, and Beroth, and Chariathiarim.
label: Josue

text: And they ſtroke them not, becauſe the princes of the multitude had ſworne in the name of our Lord the God of Iſrael. Therfore al the common people murmured againſt the princes.
label: Josue

text: Who anſwered them: We haue ſworne to them in the name of our Lord the God of Iſrael, and therfore we may not touch them.
label: Josue

text: But this we wil doe to them: Let them be reſerued in dede aliue, leſt the wrath of God be ſtirred againſt vs, if we shal be forſworne:
label: Josue

text: but ſo let them liue, that for the vſes of the whole multitude they hew wood, and carie in water. Who ſpeaking theſe thinges,
label: Josue

text: Ioſue called the Gabaonites, and ſaid to them: Why would you deceiue vs by fraude to ſay: We dwel very farre of from you, wheras you are in the middes of vs?
label: Josue

text: Therfore you shal be vnder a curſe, and there shal not faile of your ſtocke a hewer of wood, and a carier of water into the houſe of my God.
label: Josue

text: Who anſwered: It was told vs thy ſeruantes, that the Lord thy God had promiſed Moyſes his ſeruant, that he would deliuer you al the Land, and would deſtroy al the inhabitantes therof. Therfore we feared excedingly and prouided for our liues, cōpelled by your terrour, and we tooke this counſel.
label: Josue

text: And now we are in thy hand: that which ſeemeth vnto thee good and right, doe to vs.
label: Josue

text: Ioſue therfore did as he had ſaid, and deliuered them from the hand of the children of Iſrael, that they should not be ſlaine.
label: Josue

text: And he decreed in that day, that they should be in the miniſterie of al the people, and of the altar of our Lord, hewing wood, and carying water, vntil this preſent time, in the place which our Lord hath choſen.
label: Josue

text: VVHICH thinges when Adoniſedec king of Ieruſalem had heard, to witte, that Ioſue had taken Hai, and had ſubuerted it (for as he had done to Iericho & the king therof, ſo did he to Hai, & their king) and that the Gabaonites were fled to Iſrael, and were their confederates,
label: Josue

text: he was ſore afrayd. For Gabaon was a great cititie, and one of the kinglie cities, and greater then the towne of Hai, and al their men of warre moſt valiant.
label: Josue

text: Therfore Adoniſedec king of Ieruſalem ſent to Oham king of Hebron, and to Pharam king of Ierimoth, to Iaphia alſo king of Lachis, and to Dabir king of Eglon, ſaying:
label: Josue

text: Come vp to me, and bring ayde, that we may ouercome Gabaon, becauſe it reuolted to Ioſue, & to the children of Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: Therfore the fiue kinges of the Amorrheites being aſſembled went vp: the king of Ieruſulem, the king of Hebron, the king of Ierimoth, the king of Lachis, the king of Eglon, together with their hoſtes, & camped about Gabaon, aſſaulting it.
label: Josue

text: But the inhabitantes of the citie Gabaon which was beſieged, ſent to Ioſue, who then abode in the campe at Galgal, & ſaid to him: withdraw not thy handes from the helpe of thy ſeruantes: come vp quickly and deliuer vs, and bring ayde: for there are aſſembled againſt vs al the kinges of the Ammorrheites, which dwel in the mountaines.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue went vp from Galgal, and al the hoſte of the men of warre with him moſt valiant men.
label: Josue

text: And our Lord ſaid to Ioſue: Feare them not: for I haue deliuered them into thy handes: none of them shal be able to reſiſt thee.
label: Josue

text: Ioſue therfore came in vpon them ſodenly, going vp al the night from Galgal.
label: Josue

text: And our Lord trubled them at the ſight of Iſrael: and deſtroyed them with a greate ſlaugher in Gabaon, and purſewed them by the way of the aſcent to Bethoron, and ſtroke them vnto Azeca and Maceda
label: Josue

text: And when they fled the children of Iſrael, and were in the deſcent of Bethhoron, our Lord ſent vpon them greate ſtones from heauen as farre as Azeca: and there died farre more with the ſtones of haile, then they whom the children of Iſrael had ſtrooken with the ſword.
label: Josue

text: Then ſpake Ioſue to our Lord in the day, that he deliuered the Amorreite in the ſight of Iſrael, and ſaid before them: Thou Sunne againſt Gabaon moue not, and thou Moone againſt the valley of Aialon.
label: Josue

text: And the Sunne and Moone ſtoode ſtil, til the people reuenged themſelues of their enemies. Is not this written in the booke of the iuſt? The Sunne therfore ſtood ſtil in the middes of heauen, and haſtened not to goe downe the ſpace of one day.
label: Josue

text: There was not before nor after ſo long a day, our Lord obeying the voice of a man, and fighting for Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue returned with al Iſrael into the campe of Galgal.
label: Josue

text: For the fiue kinges were fled, and had hid themſelues in a caue of the citie of Maceda.
label: Josue

text: And it was told Ioſue that the fiue kinges were found lying hid in a caue of the citie of Maceda.
label: Josue

text: Who commanded them ſaying: Rowle great ſtones into the mouth of the caue, and ſette induſtrious men, which may keepe them shut in:
label: Josue

text: and ſtand not you ſtil, but purſew the enemies, and kil al the hindermoſt of them that flee, neither let them enter into the fortes of their cities, whom our Lord God hath deliuered into your handes.
label: Josue

text: The aduerſaries therfore being ſlaine with a great ſlaughter, and almoſt conſumed to vtter deſtruction, they that could eſcape from Iſrael, entered into fenſed cities.
label: Josue

text: And al the hoſte returned to Ioſue in Maceda, where then the campe was, ſafe and the ful number: and no man durſt once mutter againſt the children of Iſrael?
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue commanded, ſaying: Open the mouth of the caue, & bring forth to me the fiue kinges, that lie hid therin.
label: Josue

text: And the miniſters did as it was commanded them: and they brought to him the fiue kinges out of the caue, the king of Ieruſalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Ierimoth, the king of Lachis, the king of Eglon.
label: Josue

text: And when they were brought forth to him, he called al the men of Iſrael, and ſaid to the princes of the hoſte that were with him: Goe, and ſette your feete vpon the neckes of theſe kinges. Who when they had gone, and troden with their feete the neckes of them lying vnder,
label: Josue

text: againe he ſaid to them: Feare ye not, neither dread, take courage and be ſtrong: for ſo wil our Lord doe to al your enemies, againſt whom you fight.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue ſtroke, and ſlew them, and hanged them vpon fiue gibbettes: & they hung vntil euening.
label: Josue

text: And when the ſunne was downe, he commanded the ſoldiars to take them downe from the gibbettes. Who caſt them being taken downe into the caue, wherin they had lyen hid, & put on the mouth therof great ſtones, which continew vntil this preſent.
label: Josue

text: The ſame day Ioſue tooke Maceda and ſtroke it in the edge of the ſword, & killed the king & al the inhabitantes therof: he left not in it ſo much as ſmale reliques. And he did to the king of Maceda, as he had done to the king of Iericho.
label: Josue

text: and he paſſed with al Iſrael from Maceda vnto Lebna, and fought againſt it:
label: Josue

text: which our Lord deliuered with the king therof into the handes of Iſrael: and they ſtroke the citie in the edge of the ſword, and al the inhabitantes therof. they left not in it anie remaines. And they did to the king of Lebna, as they had done to the king of Iericho.
label: Josue

text: From Lebna he paſſed vnto Lachis with al Iſrael: and placing the hoſte round about aſſaulted it.
label: Josue

text: And our Lord deliuered Lachis into the handes of Iſrael, and he tooke it the day folowing, and ſtroke it in the edge of the ſword, and euerie ſoule, that was in it, as he had done to Lebna.
label: Josue

text: At that time went vp Horam the king of Gazer, to ayde Lachis: whom Ioſue ſtroke with al his people to vtter deſtruction.
label: Josue

text: And he paſſed from Lachis vnto Eglon, and compaſſed it,
label: Josue

text: and wonne it the ſame day: & ſtroke in the edge of the ſword al the ſoules, that were in it according to al thinges that he had done to Lachis
label: Josue

text: He went vp alſo with al Iſrael from Eglon vnto Hebron, and fought againſt it:
label: Josue

text: tooke it, and ſtroke it in the edge of the ſword, the king alſo therof, and al townes of that countrie, & al the ſoules, that remained in it: he left not therein anie remaynes: as he had done to Eglon, ſo did he alſo to Hebron, al thinges that he found in it conſumning with the ſword.
label: Josue

text: Thence returning vnto Dabir,
label: Josue

text: he tooke it, and waſted it: the king alſo therof and al the townes round about he ſtroke in the edge of the ſword: he left not in it anie remaines: as he had done to Hebron and Lebna and to their kinges, ſo did he to Dabir and the king therof.
label: Josue

text: Ioſue therfore ſtroke al the hillie countrie and ſouth and champaine, and Aſedoth with their kinges: he left not in it anie reliques, but euerie thing that could breath he ſlew, as our Lord the God of Iſrael had commanded him,
label: Josue

text: from Cadesbarne vnto Gaza. Al the Land of Goſen vnto Gabaon,
label: Josue

text: and al their kinges, and countries he tooke and waſted at one aſſault: for our Lord the God of Iſrael fought for him.
label: Josue

text: And he returned with al Iſrael to the place of the campe in Galgal.
label: Josue
