text: VVHICH thinges when Iabin the king of Aſor had heard, he ſent to Iobab the king of Madon, and to the king of Semeron, and to the king of Achſaph:
label: Josue

text: to the kinges alſo of the North, that dwelt in the mountaines and in the plaine againſt the ſouth ſide of Ceneroth, in the champaine alſo and countries of Dor by the ſea ſide:
label: Josue

text: the Chananeite alſo on the Eaſt and Weſt, and the Amorrheite and Hetheite and Pherezeite & Iebuſeite in the mountaines: the Heueite alſo which dwelt at the foote of Hermon in the Land of Maſpha.
label: Josue

text: And they iſſued forth al with their troupes, a people exceeding manie as the ſand, that is in the ſhore of the ſea, their horſes alſo and chariottes of paſſing great multitude.
label: Josue

text: And al theſe kinges aſſembled together in one at the Waters of Merom, to fight againſt Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: And our Lord ſaid to Ioſue: Feare them not: for to morrow this ſelfe ſame houre wil I deliuer al theſe to be wounded in the ſight of Iſrael: their horſes thou shalt hoghſinew, and their chariottes thou shalt burne with fire.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue came, and al the hoſte with him againſt them to the Waters of Merom ſodenly, and ranne in vpon them,
label: Josue

text: and our Lord deliuered them into the handes of Iſrael. Who ſtroke them, and purſewed them as farre as great Sidon, and the Waters of Maſerephoth, and the field of Maſphe, which is on the Eaſt ſide therof. Therfore he ſtroke al, ſo that he left no reliques
label: Josue

text: of them: and he did as our Lord had commanded him, their horſes he hoghſinewed, and their chariottes he burnt.
label: Josue

text: And returning immediatly he tooke Aſor: and the king therof he ſtroke with the ſword. For Aſor in old time among al theſe kingdomes held the principalitie.
label: Josue

text: And he ſtroke al the ſoules, that abode there: he left not in it anie remaines, but to vtter deſtruction he waſted al thinges, and the citie it ſelfe he deſtroyed with fyre.
label: Josue

text: And al the cities round about, their kinges alſo he tooke, ſtroke & deſtroyed, as Moyſes the ſeruant of God had commanded him.
label: Josue

text: Except the cities, that were ſituated on hilles and higher ground, the reſt Iſrael burnt: one onlie Aſor verie wel fenſed he conſumed with fyre.
label: Josue

text: And al the praye of theſe cities and the cattel the children of Iſrael diuided among them ſelues, al the men being ſlaine.
label: Josue

text: As our Lord had commanded Moyſes his ſeruant, ſo did Moyſes command Ioſue, and he accomplished al thinges: he ommitted not of al the commandementes, not ſo much as one word, which our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Josue

text: Ioſue therfore tooke al the hillie countrie, and ſouth, and the land of Goſen, and plaine, and the Weſt quarter, and the mountaine of Iſrael, and the champaine countrie therof:
label: Josue

text: and the part of the mountaine, that goeth vp to Seir as farre as Baalgad by the plaine of Libanus vnder mount Hermon: al their kinges he tooke, ſtroke, and ſlew.
label: Josue

text: A great time did Ioſue fight againſt theſe kinges.
label: Josue

text: There was not a citie that did deliuer it ſelfe to the children of Iſrael, except the Heueite, which dwelt in Gabaon: for he tooke al by fight.
label: Josue

text: For it was the ſentence of our Lord, that their hartes should be indurate, and they should fight againſt Iſrael, and fall, and should not deſerue anie clemencie, and should perish, as our Lord had commanded Moyſes.
label: Josue

text: At that time Ioſue came, and ſlew the Enacimes of the mountaines, of Hebron, and Dabir, and Anab, and from al the mountaine of Iuda and Iſrael, and deſtroyed their cities.
label: Josue

text: He leift not any of the ſtocke of Enacimes, in the Land of the children of Iſrael: ſauing the cities of Gaza, and Geth, and Azotus, in the which onlie they were leift.
label: Josue

text: Ioſue therfore tooke al the Land, as our Lord ſpake to Moyſes, and deliuered it in poſſeſſion to the children of Iſrael, according to their partes and tribes. and the Land reſted from battels.
label: Josue

text: THESE are the kinges, which the children of Iſrael ſtroke, and poſſeſſed, their Land beyond Iordan toward the ryſing of the ſunne, from the torrent Arnon vnto mount Hermon, and al the Eaſt part, that looketh toward the wildernes.
label: Josue

text: Sehon the king of the Amorrheites, which dwelt in Heſebon, had dominion from Aroer, which is ſituated vpon the banke of the torrent Arnon, and of the middel part in the valley, and of halfe Galaad, as farre as the torrent Iaboc, which is the border of the children of Ammon.
label: Josue

text: and from the wildernes vnto the ſea of Ceneroth againſt the Eaſt, and vnto the Sea of the wildernes, which is the moſt ſalt ſea, on the Eaſt ſide by the way that leadeth to Beſimoth: and on the South ſide, which lyeth vnder Aſedoth, as farre as Phaſga.
label: Josue

text: The border of Og the king of Baſan, of the remnant of the Raphaims who dwelt in Aſtaroth, and in Edrai, and had dominion in mount Hermon, and in Salecha, and in al Baſan, vnto the borders
label: Josue

text: of Geſſuri, and Machati, and of the halfe part of Galaad: the borders of Sehon the king of Heſebon.
label: Josue

text: Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord, and the children of Iſrael ſtroke them, and Moyſes deliuered their Land in poſſeſſion to the Rubenites, and Gadites, and the half tribe of Manaſſes.
label: Josue

text: Theſe are the Kinges of the Land, whom Ioſue ſtroke and the children of Iſrael beyond Iordan on the Weſt ſide, from Balaalgad in the field of Libanus, vnto the mount, part wherof goeth vp into Seir: and Ioſue deliuered it in poſſeſſion to the tribes of Iſrael, to euerie one their portions,
label: Josue

text: as wel in the mountaines as in the plaine and champaine countries. In Aſedoth, and in the wildernes, and in the ſouth was the Hetheite and the Amorrheite, the Chananeite, and the Pherezeite, the Heueite, and the Iebuſeite.
label: Josue

text: The king of Iericho one: the king of Hai, which is on the ſide of Bethel, one:
label: Josue

text: the king of Ieruſalem one, the king of Hebron one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Ierimoth one, the King of Lachis one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Eglon one, the King of Gazer one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Dabir one, the King of Gader one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Herma one, the King of Hered one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Lebna one, the King of Adullam one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Maceda one, the King of Bethel one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Taphua one, the King of Opher one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Aphec one, the King of Saron one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Madon one, the King of Aſor one
label: Josue

text: the King of Semeron one, the King of Acſaph one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Thenac one, the King of Mageddo one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Cades one, the King of Iachanan one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Carmel one, the King of Dor, and of the prouince of Dor one, the King of the nations of Galgal one,
label: Josue

text: the King of Therſa one: al the Kinges thirtie one.
label: Josue

text: IOSVE was old, and ſtriken in age, and our Lord ſaid to him: Thou art old, and of a great age, and there is a verie large countrie left, which is not yet diuided by lotte:
label: Josue

text: to witte, al Galilee, Philiſthijm, and al Geſſuri.
label: Josue

text: From the trubled riuer, that watereth Ægypt, vnto the borders of Accaron againſt the North: the Land of Chanaan, which is diuided vnto fiue Lordes of the Philiſthiimes, the Gazeites, the Azotians, the Aſcalonites, the Getheites, and the Accaronites.
label: Josue

text: But on the South ſide are the Heueites, al the Land of Chanaan, and Maara of the Sidonians as farre as Apheca, and the borders of the Amorrheite,
label: Josue

text: and his confines. The countrie alſo of Libanus againſt the Eaſt from Baalgad vnder mount Hermon, til thou enter into Emath.
label: Josue

text: Of al that dwel in the mountaine from Libanus, vnto the Waters Maſerephoth, and al the Sidonians. I am he that wil deſtroy them from the face of the children of Iſrael. Let it come therfore into a portion of the inheritance of Iſrael, as I haue commanded thee.
label: Josue

text: And now diuide the Land in poſſeſſion to the nine tribes, and to the half tribe of Manaſſes,
label: Josue

text: with the which Ruben & Gad haue poſſeſſed the Land, which Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord deliuered to them beyond the ſtreames of Iordan, on the eaſt ſide.
label: Josue

text: From Aroer, which is ſituate on the banke of the torrent Arnon, and in the middes of the valley, and al the champayne of Medaba, as farre as Dibon:
label: Josue

text: and al the cities of Cehon, the King of the Amorrheite, which reigned in Heſebon vnto the borders of the children of Ammon.
label: Josue

text: And Galaad, and the border of Geſſuri and Maccati, and al mount Hermon, and al Baſan, as farre as Salecha,
label: Josue

text: al the Kingdome of Og in Baſan, which reigned in Aſtaroth and Edrai, he was of the reliques of the Raphaims: and Moyſes ſtroke, and deſtroyed them.
label: Josue

text: And the children of Iſrael would not deſtroy Geſſuri and Machati: and they haue dwelt in the middes of Iſrael vntil this preſent day.
label: Josue

text: But to the tribe of Leui he gaue no poſſeſſion: but the ſacrifices and victimes of our Lord the God of Iſrael, that is his inheritance, as he ſpake to him.
label: Josue

text: Moyſes therfore gaue poſſeſſion to the children of Ruben according to their kinredes.
label: Josue

text: And their border was from Aroer, which is ſituate on the banke of the torrent Arnon, and in the middes of the valley of the ſame torrent: al the plaine, that leadeth to Medaba,
label: Josue

text: and Heſebon, and al their villages, which are in the champayne. Dibon alſo, and Bamothbaal, and the towne
label: Josue

text: Baalmaon, and Iaſſa, and Cedimoth, and Mephaath,
label: Josue

text: and Cariathaim, and Sabama, and Sarathaſar in the mountaine of the Valley.
label: Josue

text: Bethfogor and Aſedoth, Phaſga and Bethieſimoth,
label: Josue

text: and al the champayne cities, and al the Kingdomes of Sehon the King of the Amorrheite, that reigned in Heſebon, whom Moyſes ſtroke with the princes of Madian: the Heueite, & Recem, and Sur, and Hur, and Rebe Dukes of Sehon inhabitantes of the Land.
label: Josue

text: And Balaam the ſonne of Beor the ſoothſayer, did the children of Iſrael kil by the ſword with the reſt that were ſlayne.
label: Josue

text: And the riuer of Iordan was made the border of the children of Ruben. This is the poſſeſſion of the Rubenites by their kinredes of cities and villages.
label: Josue

text: And Moyſes gaue to the tribe of Gad and to his children poſſeſſion by their kinredes, the diuiſion wherof is this.
label: Josue

text: The border of Iaſer, and al the cities of Galaad, and the half part of the Land of the children of Ammon as farre as Aroer, which is againſt Rabba:
label: Josue

text: and from Heſebon vnto Ramoth, Maſphe and Betonim: and from Manaim vnto the borders of Dabir.
label: Josue

text: In the valley alo Bethhara, and Bethnemra, and Socoth, and Saphon the other part of the Kingdom of Sehon the King of Heſebon: the end of this alſo is Iordan, vnto the vttermoſt part of the ſea Cenereth beyond Iordan on the eaſt ſide.
label: Josue

text: This is the poſſeſſion of the children of Gad by their families, their cities, and villages.
label: Josue

text: He gaue alſo to the half tribe of Manaſſes, and their children poſſeſſion according to their kinredes,
label: Josue

text: the beginning wherof is this: from Manaim al Baſan, and al the kingdoms of Og the King of Baſan, and al the villages of Iair, which are in Baſan, threeſcore townes.
label: Josue

text: And the half part of Galaad, and Aſtaroth, and Edrai, cities of the kingdom of Og in Baſan: to the children of Machir, the ſonne of Manaſſes to the half patt of the children of Machir according to their kinredes.
label: Josue

text: This poſſeſſiō diuided Moyſes in the champayne countries of Moab, beyond Iordan, againſt Iericho on the Eaſt ſide.
label: Josue

text: But to the tribe of Leui he gaue no poſſeſſion: becauſe our Lord the God of Iſrael him ſelf is their poſſeſſion, as he ſpake to them.
label: Josue

text: THIS is it, which the children of Iſrael poſſeſſed in the Land of Chanaan, which Eleazar the prieſt, and Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, & the princes of the families by the tribes of Iſrael gaue to them:
label: Josue

text: diuiding al thinges by lotte, as our Lord had commanded in the hand of Moyſes, to the nine tribes, and the half tribe.
label: Josue

text: For to two tribes and a half Moyſes had geuen poſſeſſion beyond Iordan: beſides the Leuites, which receiued no land among their brethren:
label: Josue

text: but into their place ſucceeded the children of Ioſeph diuided into two tribes, of Manaſſes and Ephraim: neither did the Leuites receiue other portion in the Land, but cities to inhabite, and their ſuburbes to feede their beaſtes and cattel.
label: Josue

text: As our Lord had commanded Moyſes, ſo did the children of Iſrael, and they diuided the Land.
label: Josue

text: Therfore the children of Iuda came to Ioſue in Galgal, and Caleb the ſonne of Iephone the Cenezeite ſpake to him: Thou knoweſt what our Lord ſpake to Moyſes the man of God concerning me & thee in Cadesbarne.
label: Josue

text: Fourtie yeares old was I when Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord ſent me from Cadesbarne, to view the Land, and I reported to him that which to me ſemed true.
label: Josue

text: But my brethren, that had gone vp with me, diſcouraged the hart of the people: and I neuertheles folowed our Lord my God.
label: Josue

text: And Moyſes ſware in that day, ſaying: The Land, which thy foote hath troden, shal be thy poſſeſſion, and thy childrens for euer, becauſe thou haſt folowed our Lord my God.
label: Josue

text: Our Lord therfore hath granted me life, as he promiſed vntil this preſent day. It is fourtie and fiue yeares, ſince our Lord ſpake this worde to Moyſes, when Iſrael walked through the wildernes: this day am I eightie and fiue yeares old
label: Josue

text: ſo luſtie, as I was at that time when I was ſent to view: the ſtrength of that time contineweth in me vntil this day, as wel to fight as to goe.
label: Josue

text: Geue me therfore this mountaine, which our Lord promiſed, thy ſelfe alſo hearing it, wherein are the Enacims, and great cities and fenſed: if perhaps our Lord be with me, and I shal be able to deſtroy them, as he promiſed me.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue bleſſed him, and deliuered to him Hebron in poſſeſſion
label: Josue

text: And from thence forth Hebron belonged to Caleb the ſonne of Iephone the Cenezeite, vntil this preſent day: becauſe he folowed our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: The name of Hebron before was called Cariath Arbe: Adam the greateſt among the Enacims was layd there: and the Land ceaſed from battels.
label: Josue

text: THERFORE the lotte of the children of Iudas by their kinredes was this: From the border of Edom, vnto the deſert of Sin againſt the South, and vnto the vttermoſt part of the ſouth coaſte.
label: Josue

text: the beginning therof was from the toppe of the moſt ſalt ſea, and from the brinke therof, that looketh to the South.
label: Josue

text: And it goeth forth againſt the Aſcent of the Scorpion, and paſſeth through into Sina: and ryſeth vp into Cadesbarne, & reacheth into Eſron, aſcending to Addar, and cōpaſſing Carcaa,
label: Josue

text: and thence paſſing through into Aſemona, and reaching to the Torrent of Ægypt: and the borders therof shal be the great ſea. this ſhal be the end of the ſouth coaſt.
label: Josue

text: But on the Eaſt ſide the beginning shal be the moſt ſalt ſea vnto the vtmoſt partes of Iordan: and thoſe places that looke to the North from the brinke of the ſea vnto the ſame riuer of Iordan.
label: Josue

text: And the border goeth vp into Beth hagla, and paſſeth from the north into Beth Araba: aſcending to the ſtone of Bohen the ſonne of Ruben.
label: Josue

text: And reaching as farre as the borders of Debera from the Valley of Achor, againſt the North looking toward Galgal, which is oppoſite to the Aſcent of Adommim, on the ſouth ſide of the torrent: and paſſeth the waters, that are called The Fountayne of the ſunne: and the endes therof shal be to the Fountayne rogel.
label: Josue

text: And it aſcendeth by the valley of the ſunne of Ennom on the ſide of the Iebuſeite toward the South, this is Ieruſalem: and thence rearing it ſelf to the toppe of the mountayne, which is againſt Geennom toward the Weſt in the toppe of the Valley of Raphaim againſt the North.
label: Josue

text: And it paſſeth through from the toppe of the mountaine to the fountaine of the water Nephtoa: and reacheth to the townes of mount Ephron: and bendeth into Baala, which is Cariathiarim, that is to ſay, a citie of wooddes.
label: Josue

text: And it compaſſeth from Baala againſt the Weſt, vnto mount Seir: and paſſeth by the ſide of mount Iarim toward the North into Cheſlon: and goeth downe into Bethſames, and paſſeth into Thamna.
label: Josue

text: And it reacheth toward the North coaſt of a part of Accaron at the ſide: and bendeth to Sechrona, and paſſeth mount Baala: and cometh into Iebneel, and is shut vp with the end of the great ſea toward the Weſt.
label: Josue

text: Theſe are the borders of the children of Iudas in circuite in their kinredes.
label: Josue

text: But to Caleb the ſonne of Iephone he gaue a portion in the middes of the children of Iudas, as our Lord had commanded him: Cariath Arbe the father of Enac, that is Hebron.
label: Josue

text: And Caleb deſtroyed out of it the three ſonnes of Enac, Seſai and Ahiman & Tholmai of the ſtocke of Enac.
label: Josue

text: And from thence going vp he came to the inhabitantes of Dabir, which before was called Cariath ſepher, that is to ſay, a citie of letters.
label: Josue

text: And Caleb ſaid: He that shal ſtrike Cariath-ſepher, and take it, I wil geue him Axa my daughter to wife.
label: Josue

text: And Othoniel the ſonne of Cenez, the yonger brother of Caleb tooke it: and he gaue him Axa his daughter to wife
label: Josue

text: Who going together, she was moued by her husband to aske a field of her father, and ſhe ſighed as she ſate on her aſſe. To whom Calcb ſaid: What aileth thee?
label: Josue

text: But she anſwered: Geue me a bleſſing: a South and drie Land thou haſt geuen me, ioyne alſo a waterie. Caleb therfore gaue her a waterie ground aboue & beneath.
label: Josue

text: This is the poſſeſſion of the tribe of the children of Iudas by their kinredes.
label: Josue

text: And the cities from the vttermoſt partes of the children of Iudas by the borders of Edom on the South: were Gabſeel and Eder and Iagur,
label: Josue

text: and Cina and Dimona and Adada,
label: Josue

text: and Cades, and Aſor, and Iethnan,
label: Josue

text: Ziph and Telem and Baloth,
label: Josue

text: Aſor the new and Carioth, Heſron, this is Aſor.
label: Josue

text: Amam, Sama, and Molada,
label: Josue

text: and Aſergadda and Haſſemon and Bethphelet,
label: Josue

text: and Haſerſual and Berſabee and Baziothia
label: Josue

text: and Baala and Iim an Eſem,
label: Josue

text: and Eltholad and Ceſil and Harma
label: Josue

text: and Siceleg, and Medemena and Senſenna,
label: Josue

text: Labaoth and Selim and Aen and Remon. al the cities twentie nine, and their villages.
label: Josue

text: But in the champayne countries: Eſtaol and Sarea and Aſena,
label: Josue

text: and Sanoe & Engannim and Taphua and Enaim,
label: Josue

text: and Ierimoth, and Adullam, Socho and Azeca,
label: Josue

text: and Saraim and Adithaim and Gedera and Gederothaim: fourteene cities, and their villages.
label: Josue

text: Sanan and Hadaſta and Magdalgad,
label: Josue

text: Delean and Maſepha and Iecthel,
label: Josue

text: Lachis and Baſcath and Eglon,
label: Josue

text: Chebbon and Leheman and Cethlis
label: Josue

text: and Gideroth and Bethdagon and Naama and Maceda: ſixtene cities, and their villages.
label: Josue

text: Labana and Ether and Aſan,
label: Josue

text: Iephtha and Eſna and Neſib,
label: Josue

text: and Ceila and Achzib and Mareza: nine cities, and their villages.
label: Josue

text: Accaron with the townes and villages therof.
label: Josue

text: From Accaron vnto the ſea: al places that bend toward Azotus and the villages therof.
label: Josue

text: Azotus with the townes and villages therof. Gaza with the townes and villages therof, vnto the torrent of Ægypt, and the great ſea is the border therof.
label: Josue

text: And in the mountayne: Samir and Iether and Socoth
label: Josue

text: and Danna and Cariath ſenna, this is Dabir:
label: Josue

text: Anab and Iſtemo and Anim,
label: Josue

text: Goſen and Olon and Gilo: eleuen cities and their villages.
label: Josue

text: Arab and Ruma and Eſaan,
label: Josue

text: and Ianum and Beth thaphua and Apheca,
label: Josue

text: Athmatha and Cariath-arbe, this is Hebron, and Sior: nine cities and their villages.
label: Josue

text: Maon and Carmel and Ziph and Iota,
label: Josue

text: Iezrael and Iucadam and Zanoe,
label: Josue

text: Accain, Gabaa and Thamna: ten cities and their villages.
label: Josue

text: Halhul, and Bethſur, and Gedor,
label: Josue

text: Mareth, and Beth-anoth, & Eltecon: ſix cities and their villages.
label: Josue

text: Cariathbaal, this is Cariathiarim the citie of wooddes, and Arebba: two cities and their villages.
label: Josue

text: In the deſert Beth-araba, meddin, and Sachacha,
label: Josue

text: and Nebſan, and the citie of ſalt, and Engaddi: ſix cities, and their villages.
label: Josue

text: But the Iebuſeite the inhabitant of Ieruſalem the children of Iudas could not deſtroy: and the Iebuſeite dwelt with the children of Iudas in Ieruſalem vntil this preſent day.
label: Josue

text: THE lotte alſo of the children of Ioſeph fel from Iordan againſt Iericho and the Waters therof, on the eaſt: the wildernes which goeth vp from Iericho to the mountaine of Bethel:
label: Josue

text: and goeth out from Bethel to Luza: and paſſeth the border of Archia, to Atharoth.
label: Josue

text: And deſcendeth Weſtward, by the border of Iephleti, vnto the borders of Beth horon the lower, and to Gazer: and their countries are ended by the great ſea:
label: Josue

text: and Manaſſes and Ephraim the children of Ioſeph poſſeſſed it.
label: Josue

text: And the border of the children of Ephraim was made according to their kinredes: and their poſſeſſion toward the Eaſt was Ataroth addar vnto Beth-horon the higher.
label: Josue

text: And the confines goe out vnto the ſea: but Machmethath looketh to the North, and it compaſſeth the borders againſt the Eaſt into Thanath-ſelo: and paſſeth through on the Eaſt ſide to Ianoe.
label: Josue

text: and it goeth downe from Ianoe into Ataroth & Naaratha: and it cometh into Iericho, and goeth out to Iordan.
label: Josue

text: From Taphua it paſſeth through againſt the ſea into the Valley of reedes, and the iſſues therof are into the moſt ſalt ſea. this is the poſſeſſion of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
label: Josue

text: And cities with their villages were ſeparated to the children of Ephraim in the middes of the poſſeſſion of the children of Manaſſes,
label: Josue

text: and the children of Ephraim ſlew not the Chananeite, which dwelt in Gazer: and the Chananeite dwelt in the middes of Ephraim vntil this day tributarie.
label: Josue

text: AND this lotte fel to the tribe of Manaſſes (for he is the firſt borne of Ioſeph) to Machir the firſt borne of Manaſſes the father of Galaad, who was a warlike man, and had for poſſeſſion Galaad and Baſan:
label: Josue

text: and to the reſt of the children of Manaſſes according to their families, to the children of Abiezer, and to the children of Helec, and to the children of Eſriel, and to the children of Sechem, and to the children of Hepher, and to the children of Semida. theſe are the children of Manaſſes the ſonne of Ioſeph, males by their kinredes.
label: Josue

text: But Salphaad the ſonne of Hepher the ſonne of Galaad the ſonne of Machir the ſonne of Manaſſes had no ſonnes, but onlie daughters: whoſe names be theſe, Maala, and Noa and Hegla and Melcha and Therſa.
label: Josue

text: And they came in the preſence of Eleazar the prieſt, and of Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, and of the princes, ſaying: Our Lord commanded by the hand of Moyſes, that a poſſeſſion should be geuen vs in the middes of our brethren. And he gaue them according to the commandement of our Lord a poſſeſſion in the middes of their fathers brethren.
label: Josue

text: And the cordes fel to Manaſſes ten, beſide the Land of Galaad and Baſan beyond Iordan.
label: Josue

text: For the daughters of Manaſſes poſſeſſed inheritance in the middes of his ſonnes. And the Land of Galaad fel to the lotte of the children of Manaſſes that remayned.
label: Josue

text: And the border of Manaſſes from Aſer, was Machmathath which looketh to Sichem: and goeth out on the right hand beſide the inhabitantes of the Fountaine of Taphua.
label: Josue

text: For in the lotte of Manaſſes was fallen the Land of Taphua, which is beſide the borders of Manaſſes, the childrens of Ephraim.
label: Josue

text: And the border of the Reede valley went downe into the ſouth of the torrent of the cities of Ephraim, which are in the middes of the cities of Manaſſes: the border of Manaſſes on the North of the torrent, and the iſſue therof goeth to the ſea:
label: Josue

text: ſo that the poſſeſſion of Ephraim is on the South, and on the North of Manaſſes, and the ſea incloſeth both, and they be ioyned one to an other in the tribe of Aſer on the Noth, and in the tribe of Iſſachar on the Eaſt.
label: Josue

text: And the inheritance of Manaſſes in Iſſachar and in Aſer was Bethſan and the villages therof, and Ieblaam with the villages therof, and the inhabitantes of Dor, with the townes therof, the inhabitantes alſo of Endor with the townes therof. and in like maner the inhabitantes of Thenac with the townes therof, and the inhabitantes of Mageddo with the townes therof, and the third part of the citie of Nopheth.
label: Josue

text: Neither could the children of Manaſſes ouerthrow the cities, but the Chananeite began to dwel in his Land.
label: Josue

text: But after that the children of Iſrael grew to be ſtrong, they ſubdewed the Chananeites, and made them their tributaries, neither did they kil them.
label: Josue

text: And the children of Ioſeph ſpake to Ioſue, and ſaid: Why haſt thou geuen me the poſſeſſion of one lotte and corde, wheras I am of ſo great a multitude, and our Lord hath bleſſed me?
label: Josue

text: To whom Ioſue ſaid: If thou be a great people, goe vp into the wood, and cutte thee roome in the Land of the Pherezeite and Raphaims: becauſe the poſſeſſion of mount Ephraim is narrow for thee.
label: Josue

text: To whom the children of Ioſeph anſwered: We can not goe vp to the mountaines, wheras the Chananeite that dwel in the champayne countrie, wherein are ſituated Bethſan with the townes therof, and Iezrael poſſeſſing the middes of the valley, vſe yron chariottes.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue ſaid to the houſe of Ioſeph, of Ephraim and Manaſſes: Thou art a great people, and of great ſtrength, thou shalt not haue one lotte,
label: Josue

text: but thou shalt paſſe to the mountaine, and shalt cutte and make glades for thee to inhabite: and mayeſt procede farder, when thou haſt ſubuerted the Chananeite, whom thou ſayeſt to haue yron chariotes, and to be very ſtrong.
label: Josue

text: AND al the children of Iſrael were aſſembled in Silo, and there they pitched the tabernacle of the teſtimony, and the Land was ſubdewed to them.
label: Josue

text: But there remained ſeuen tribes of the children of Iſrael, which as yet had not receiued their poſſeſſions.
label: Josue

text: To whom Ioſue ſaid: How long are you ſlack with cowardenes, and enter not to poſſeſſe the Land, which our Lord the God of your fathers hath geuen you?
label: Josue

text: Chooſe of euerie tribe three men, that I may ſend them, and they may goe and circuite the Land, and marke it out according to the number of euerie multitude: and report vnto me that which they haue marked out.
label: Josue

text: Diuide vnto you the Land into ſeuen partes: let Iudas be in his boundes on the ſouth quarter, and the houſe of Ioſeph on the North.
label: Josue

text: the Land in the middes betwen theſe marke out into ſeuen partes: and you shal come hither to me, that before our Lord your God I may caſt the lotte for you:
label: Josue

text: for the Leuites part is not among you, but the prieſthood of our Lord is their inheritance. And Gad and Ruben, and the half tribe of Manaſſes had now receiued their poſſeſſions beyond Iordan at the Eaſt ſide: which Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord gaue them.
label: Josue

text: And when the men were ryſen vp, that they might goe to marke out the land, Ioſue commanded them, ſaying: Circuite the Land and marke it out, and returne to me: that here before our Lord, in Silo I may caſt the lotte for you
label: Josue

text: They therfore went on: and going ouer it, diuided it into ſeuen partes, writing it in a volume. And they returned to Ioſue into the campe in Silo.
label: Josue

text: Who did caſt lottes before our Lord in Silo, and diuided the Land to the children of Iſrael into ſeuen partes.
label: Josue

text: And firſt came vp the lotte of the children of Beniamin by their families, to poſſeſſe the Land betwen the children of Iudas and the children of Ioſeph.
label: Josue

text: And their border was againſt the North from Iordan: going forward by the ſide of Iericho on the north quarter, and thence Weſtward ryſing vp vnto the mountaines, and reaching to the wildernes of Bethauen,
label: Josue

text: & paſſing through by Luza to the South, the ſame is Bethel: and goeth downe into Ataroth addar vnto the mountaine, that is on the South of Bethhoron the lower.
label: Josue

text: And it bendeth compaſſing againſt the ſea, Southward of the mountaine that looketh to Bethhoron againſt the South: and the iſſues therof are into Cariathbaal, which is called alſo Cariathbaal which is called alſo Cariathiarim, a citie of the children of Iudas. This is their coaſt againſt the ſea, toward the Weſt.
label: Josue

text: But on the South from part of Cariathiarim the border iſſueth forth againſt the ſea, and cometh to the fountaine of the waters of Nephtoa.
label: Josue

text: And it goeth downe into part of the mountaine that looketh toward the Valley of the children of Ennom: and is againſt the north quarter in the vttermoſt part of the Valley raphaim, And it goeth downe into Gehennom (that is, the valley of Ennom) by the ſide of the Iebuſeite to the South: and cometh to the Fountaine of Rogel,
label: Josue

text: paſſing to the north, and going forth to Enſemes, that is to ſay, the fountaine of the ſunne:
label: Josue

text: and it paſſeth vnto the litle hilles, that are againſt the aſcent of Adommim: and goeth downe to Abenboen, that is, the ſtone of Boen the ſonne of Ruben: and it paſſeth on the north ſide to the champaine countries: and goeth downe into the playne,
label: Josue

text: and paſſeth by againſt the North of Bethagla: and the iſſues therof are againſt the brincke of the moſt ſalt ſea on the North in the end of Iordan to the ſouth quarter:
label: Josue

text: which is the border therof on the Eaſt. This is the poſſeſſion of the children of Beniamin by their borders round about, and their families.
label: Josue

text: And their cities were, Iericho and Bethhagla and Vallis Caſis,
label: Josue

text: Beth Araba and Samaraim and Bethel,
label: Josue

text: and Auim and Aphara and Ophera,
label: Josue

text: Towne Emona and Ophni and Gabee: twelue cities, & their townes.
label: Josue

text: Gabaon and Rama and Beroth,
label: Josue

text: and Meſphe, and Caphara, and Amoſa,
label: Josue

text: and Recem, Iarephel and Tharela,
label: Josue

text: and Sela, Eleph, and Iebus, which is Ieruſalem, Gabaath and Cariath: fourteenne cities, and their townes. This is the poſſeſſion of the children of Beniamin by their families.
label: Josue

text: AND the ſecond lotte came forth of the children of Simeon by their kinreddes: and their inheritance was,
label: Josue

text: in the middes of the poſſeſſion of the children of Iudas: Berſabee and Sabee and Molada,
label: Josue

text: and Haſerſual, Bala and Aſem,
label: Josue

text: and Eltholad, Bethul and Harma,
label: Josue

text: and Siceleg and Bethmarchaboth and Haſerſuſa,
label: Josue

text: and Bethlebaoth and Sarohen: thirtene cities, and their townes.
label: Josue

text: Ain and Remmon and Athor and Aſan: foure cities, and their townes:
label: Josue

text: al the litle townes round about theſe cities vnto Baalath Beer Ramath againſt the ſouth quarter. This is the inheritance of the children of Simeon according to their kinredes,
label: Josue

text: in the poſſeſſion and corde of the children of Iudas: becauſe it was greater. and therfore the children of Simeon poſſeſſed in the middes of their inheritance.
label: Josue

text: And the third lotte fel of the children of Zabulon by their kinredes: and the border of their poſſeſſion was made as farre as Sarid.
label: Josue

text: And it went vp from the ſea and Merala, and came into Debbaſeth: as farre as the torrent, which is againſt Ieconam.
label: Josue

text: And it returneth from Sared againſt the Eaſt into the endes of Ceſeleth thabor: and it goeth out to Dabereth, and ryſeth vp againſt Iaphie.
label: Josue

text: And thence it paſſeth along to the eaſt ſide of Geth hepher and Thacaſim: and goeth out into Remmon, Amthar and Noa.
label: Josue

text: And it compaſſeth to the North of Hanathon: and the iſſues therof are the valley Iephtahel,
label: Josue

text: and Cateth and Naalol and Semeron and Ierala and Bethlehem: twelue cities, and their townes.
label: Josue

text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Zabulon by their kinredes, the cities and their litle townes.
label: Josue

text: The fourth lotte came forth to Iſſachar by their kinredes.
label: Josue

text: and his inheritance was Iezrael and Caſaloth and Sunem,
label: Josue

text: and Hapharaim and Sehon, and Anaharath
label: Josue

text: and Rabboth and Ceſion, Abes,
label: Josue

text: and Rameth, and Engannim, and Enhadda and Bethpheſes.
label: Josue

text: And the border therof cometh to Thabor and Scheſema and Bethſames: and their iſſues were Iordan: ſixtene cities, and their townes.
label: Josue

text: This is the poſſeſſion of Iſſachar by their kinredes, the cities, and their litle townes.
label: Josue

text: And the fifth lotte fel to the tribe of the children of Aſer by their kinredes:
label: Josue

text: and their border was Halcath and Chali and Beten and Axaph,
label: Josue

text: and Elmelec and Amaad and Meſſal: and it reacheth to Carmel of the ſea and Sihor and Labanath.
label: Josue

text: And it returneth againſt the eaſt of Bethdagon: and paſſeth along to Zabulon and the Valley Iephthael againſt the North into Bethemec and Nehiel. And it goeth out to the left ſide of Cabul,
label: Josue

text: and Abran and Rohob and Hamon and Cana, as farre as great Sidon.
label: Josue

text: And it returneth into Horma vnto the verie wel fenſed citie Tyre, and vnto Hoſa: and the iſſues therof shal be into the ſea from the corde of Achziba:
label: Josue

text: and Amma and Aphec and Rohob. cities twentie two, and their townes.
label: Josue

text: This is the poſſeſſion of the children of Aſer by their kinredes, and the cities and their townes.
label: Josue

text: Of the ſonnes of Nepthali fel the ſixt lotte by their families:
label: Josue

text: and the border beganne from Heleph and Elon into Saanaim, and Adami, which is Neceb, and Iebnael vnto Lecum: and their iſſues vnto Iordan:
label: Josue

text: and the border returneth againſt the Weſt into Azanoththabor, and thence goeth out into Hucuca, and paſſeth along into Zabulon againſt the South, and into Azer againſt the Weſt, and into Iuda vnto Iordan againſt the riſing of the ſunne.
label: Josue

text: cities very wel fenſed, Aſſedim, Ser, and Emath, and Reccath and Cenereth,
label: Josue

text: and Edema and Arama, Aſor
label: Josue

text: and Cedes and Edrai, Enhaſor
label: Josue

text: and Ieron and Magdalel, Horem and Bethanath and Bethſames: ninetene cities, and their townes.
label: Josue

text: This is the poſſeſſion of the tribe of the children of Nephthali by their kinredes, the cities and their townes.
label: Josue

text: To the tribe of the children of Dan by their families came forth the ſeuenth lotte:
label: Josue

text: and the border of their poſſeſſion was Sara and Eſthaol, and Hiriſemes, that is the ſunne.
label: Josue

text: Selebin and Aialon and Iethela,
label: Josue

text: Elon and Themna and Acron,
label: Josue

text: Elthece, Gebbethon and Balaath,
label: Josue

text: and Iud and Bane and Barac and Gethremmon:
label: Josue

text: and Meiarcon & Arecon, with the border that looketh toward Ioppe,
label: Josue

text: and is shut vp with the ſame end. And the children of Dan went vp, and fought againſt Leſem, and they tooke it: and they ſtroke it in the edge of the ſword, and poſſeſſed, and dwelt in it, calling the name of it Leſem Dan, by the name of Dan the father therof.
label: Josue

text: This is the poſſeſſion of the tribe of the ſonnes of Dan, by their kinredes, the cities and their townes.
label: Josue

text: And when he had made an end of diuiding the Land by lotte to euerie one by their tribes, the children of Iſrael gaue poſſeſſion to Ioſue the ſonne of Nun in the middes of them,
label: Josue

text: according to the commandement of our Lord, the citie which he requeſted, Thamnath Saraa in mount Ephraim: and he built the citie, and dwelt in it.
label: Josue

text: Theſe are the poſſeſſions, which Eleazar the prieſt, and Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, and the princes of the families, and of the tribes of the children of Iſrael, diuided by lotte in Silo, before our Lord at the doore of the tabernacle of teſtimonie, and they parted the Land.
label: Josue

text: AND our Lord ſpake to Ioſue, ſaying: Speake to the children of Iſrael, and ſay to them:
label: Josue

text: Separate the cities of the fugitiues, of the which I ſpake to you by the hand of Moyſes;
label: Josue

text: that he may flee to them whoſoeuer shal ſtrike a ſoule vnwitting: and may eſcape the wrath of the nigh kinſeman, which is the reuenger of bloud:
label: Josue

text: when he shal be fled to one of theſe cities: he shal ſtand before the gate of the citie, and shal ſpeake to the ancientes of that citie thoſe thinges, that may proue him ſelfe innocent: and ſo they shal receiue him, and geue him place to inhabite.
label: Josue

text: And when the reuenger of the bloud shal purſew him, they shal not deliuer him into his handes: becauſe he ſtroke his neighbour by ignorance, neitheir is he proued to be his enemie two or three dayes before.
label: Josue

text: And he shal dwel in that citie, til he ſtand before iudgement rendring a cauſe of his fact, and the high prieſt die, which shal be at that time: then shal the manſlaer returne, and enter into the citie and his houſe out of the which he had fled.
label: Josue

text: And they appointed Cedes in Galilee of the mount of Nepthali, and Sichem in the mount of Ephraim, and Cariatharbee, the ſame is Hebron in the mount of Iuda.
label: Josue

text: And beyond Iordan againſt the Eaſt quarter of Iericho, they appointed Boſor, which is ſituated in the champaine wildernes of the tribe of Ruben, and Ramoth in Galaad of the tribe of Gad, and Gaulon in Baſan of the tribe of Manaſſes.
label: Josue

text: Theſe cities were appointed to al the children of Iſrael, and to the ſtrangeſrs, that dwelt among them: that he might flee to them which vnwittingly had ſtriken a ſoule, and might not die in the hand of the kinſeman, coueting to reuenge the bloud shed, vntil he might ſtand before the people to declare his cauſe.
label: Josue

text: AND the princes of the families of the Leui came to Eleazar the prieſt, and Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, and to the chief of the kinredes in euerie tribe of the children of Iſrael:
label: Josue

text: and they ſpake to them in Silo of the Land of Chanaan, and ſaid: Our Lord commanded by the hand of Moyſes, that cities should be geuen vs to inhabite, and their ſuburbes to feede cattel.
label: Josue

text: And the children of Iſrael gaue of their poſſeſſions according to the commandement of our Lord, cities and their ſuburbes.
label: Josue

text: And the lotte came forth vnto the familie of Caath of the children of Aaron the prieſt out of the tribe of Iudas, and Simeon, and Beniamin, thirtene cities.
label: Josue

text: And to the reſt of the children of Caath, that is to the Leuites, which remayned, out of the tribes of Ephraim, and Dan, and the halfe tribe of Manaſſes, ten cities.
label: Josue

text: Moreouer to the children of Gerſon came forth a lotte, that they should take of the tribes of Iſſachar and Aſer and Nephthali, and the halfe tribe of Manaſſes in Baſan, cities in number thirtene.
label: Josue

text: And to the ſonnes of Merari by their kinredes, of the tribe of Ruben and Gad and Zabulon, twelue cities.
label: Josue

text: and the children of Iſrael gaue to the Leuites cities and their ſuburbes, as our Lord commanded by the hand of Moyſes, geuing to euerie one by lotte.
label: Josue

text: Of the tribes of the children of Iudas and Simeon Ioſue gaue cities: whoſe names be theſe,
label: Josue

text: to the children of Aaron by the families of Caath of the Leuitical ſtocke (for the firſt lotte came forth to them)
label: Josue

text: Cariatharbe the father of Enac, which is called Hebron, in the mountaine of Iudas, and the ſuburbes therof round about.
label: Josue

text: But the fieldes and the townes therof he had geuen to Caleb the ſonne of Iephone to poſſeſſe.
label: Josue

text: He gaue therfore to the children of Aaron the prieſt Hebron a citie of refuge, and the ſuburbes therof: & Lobna with the ſuburbes therof:
label: Josue

text: and Iether and Eſtemo,
label: Josue

text: and Holon, and Dabir,
label: Josue

text: and Ain, and Ieta, and Bethſames, with the ſuburbes therof: nine cities of two tribes, as hath bene ſaid.
label: Josue

text: And of the tribe of the children of Beniamin, Gabaon, and Gabae,
label: Josue

text: and Anathoth and Almon, with their ſuburbes: foure cities.
label: Josue

text: Al the cities together of the children of Aaron the prieſt, thirtene, with their ſuburbes.
label: Josue

text: But to the reſt by the families of the children of Caath of the Leuitical ſtocke was geuen this poſſeſſion.
label: Josue

text: Of the tribe of Ephraim, the cities of refuge, Sichem with the ſuburbes therof in the mountayne of Ephraim, and Gazer
label: Josue

text: and Cibſaim, and Beth horon, with the ſuburbes therof, foure cities.
label: Josue

text: Of the tribe of Dan alſo, Eltheco and Gabathon,
label: Josue

text: and Aialon and Gethremmon, with the ſuburbes therof, foure cities.
label: Josue

text: Moreouer of the half tribe of Manaſſes, Thanac and Gethremmon, with their ſuburbes two cities.
label: Josue

text: Al the cities ten, and their ſuburbes, were geuen to the children of Caath of the inferiour degree.
label: Josue

text: To the children of Gerſon alſo of the Leuitical ſtocke he gaue of the half tribe of Manaſſes the cities of refuge, Gaulon in Baſan, and Boſram, with their ſuburbes, two cities.
label: Josue

text: Moreouer of the tribe of Iſſachar, Ceſion, and Dabereth,
label: Josue

text: and Iaramoth, and Engannim, with their ſuburbes, foure cities.
label: Josue

text: And of the tribe of Aſer, Maſal and Abdon,
label: Josue

text: and Helcath, and Rohob, with their ſuburbes, foure cities.
label: Josue

text: Of the tribe alſo of Nephthali the cities of refuge, Cedes in Galilee: and Hammoth Dor, and Carthan, with their ſuburbes, three cities.
label: Josue

text: Al the cities of the families of Gerſon, thirtene, with their ſuburbes.
label: Josue

text: And to the children of Merari Leuites of the inferiour degree by their families was geuen of the tribe of Zabulon, Iecnam and Cartha
label: Josue

text: and Damna and Naalol, foure cities with their ſuburbes.
label: Josue

text: Of the tribe of Ruben beyond Iordan againſt Iericho the cities of refuge, Boſor in the wildernes, Miſor and Iaſer and Iethſon and Mephaath, foure cities with their ſuburbes.
label: Josue

text: Of the tribe of Gad the cities of refuge, Ramoth in Galaad, and Manaim and Heſebon and Iaſer, foure cities with their ſuburbes.
label: Josue

text: Al the cities of the children of Merari by their families and kinredes, twelue.
label: Josue

text: Therfore al the cities of the Leuites in the middes of the poſſeſſion of the children of Iſrael were fourtie eight
label: Josue

text: with their ſuburbes, euerie one diſtributed by the families.
label: Josue

text: And our Lord God gaue to Iſrael al the Land, that he had ſworne he would geue to their fathers: and they poſſeſſed it, and dwelt in it.
label: Josue

text: And peace was geuen by him on al nations round about: and none of their enemies durſt reſiſt them, but al were brought into their dominion.
label: Josue

text: Not ſo much certes as one word, which he had promiſed, that he would performe vnto them, was fruſtrate, but al thinges were accomplished in deedes.
label: Josue

text: THE ſame time Ioſue called the Rubenites, and Gadites, and the halfe tribe of Manaſſes,
label: Josue

text: and ſaid to them: You haue done al thinges that Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord cōmanded you: me alſo haue you obeyed in al thinges,
label: Josue

text: neither haue you left your brethren a long time, vntil this preſent day, keeping the commandement of our Lord your God.
label: Josue

text: Therfore becauſe our Lord your God hath geuen your brethren quietnes and peace, as he promiſed: returne, and goe into your tabernacles, and to the land of your poſſeſſion, which Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord deliuered to you beyond Iordan:
label: Josue

text: alwayes ſo that you keepe attentiuely, and in worke fulfil the commandement, and the law which Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord commanded you, that you loue our Lord your God, and walke in al his wayes, and obſerue al his commandementes, & cleaue to him, and ſerue him in al your hart, and in al your ſoule.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue bleſſed them, and diſmiſſed them. Who returned into their tabernacles.
label: Josue

text: And to the halfe tribe of Manaſſes Moyſes had geuen poſſeſſion in Baſan: and therfore to the halfe that remayned, Ioſue gaue a lotte among the reſt of their brethren beyond Iordan at the Weſt ſide. And when he diſmiſſed them into their tabernacles, & had bleſſed them,
label: Josue

text: he ſaid to them: In much ſubſtance and riches returne to your ſeates, with ſiluer and gold, braſſe and yron, and varietie of rayment: diuide the praye of your enemies with your brethren.
label: Josue

text: And the children of Ruben, and the children of Gad, and the halfe tribe of Manaſſes returned, and went from the children of Iſrael in Silo, which is ſituated in Chanaan, to enter into Galaad the Land of their poſſeſſion, which they had obteyned according to the commandement of our Lord in the hand of Moyſes.
label: Josue

text: And when they were come to the litle banckes of Iordan, into the Land of Chanaan, they built beſide Iordan an altar of an infinite greatnes.
label: Josue

text: Which thing when the children of Iſrael had heard, and certaine meſſengers had reported to them that the children of Ruben, and Gad, and the halfe tribe of Manaſſes had builded an altar in the Land of Chanaan, vpon the litle banckes of Iordan, againſt the children of Iſrael:
label: Josue

text: they aſſembled al in Silo, that they might goe vp, and fight againſt them.
label: Josue

text: And in the meane time they ſent to them into the Land of Galaad, Phinees the ſonne of Eleazar the prieſt,
label: Josue

text: and ten princes with him, one of euerie tribe.
label: Josue

text: Who came to the children of Ruben, and Gad, and the halfe tribe of Manaſſes into the Land of Galaad, and ſaid to them:
label: Josue

text: This meſſage doth al the people of our Lord ſend to you: What is this tranſgreſſion? Why haue you forſaken our Lord the God of Iſrael, building a ſacrilegious altar, and reuolting from the worshippe of him?
label: Josue

text: Is it a ſmale thing to you that you ſinned in Beelphegor, and vntil this preſent day the ſporte of this abomination abideth in vs? and many of the people fel dead.
label: Josue

text: And you to day haue forſaken our Lord, and to morow his wrath wil rage againſt al Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: But if you thinke the land of your poſſeſſion to be vncleane, paſſe to the Land, wherein is the tabernacle of our Lord, and dwel among vs: only that you depart not from our Lord, and from our companie, an altar being built beſide the altar of our Lord God.
label: Josue

text: Did not Achan the ſonne of Zare tranſgreſs the commandement of our Lord, and his wrath lay vpon al the people of Iſrael? And he was one man, and I would he alone had perished in his wicked fact.
label: Josue

text: And the children of Ruben, and Gad, and of the halfe tribe of Manaſſes anſwered the princes of the legacie of Iſrael:
label: Josue

text: The moſt mightie God our Lord, The moſt mightie God our Lord, him ſelfe knoweth, and Iſrael together shal vnderſtand: If with the mind of preuarication we haue erected this altar, let him not keepe vs, but punish vs preſently:
label: Josue

text: and if we did it with that minde, that we might lay vpon it holocauſtes, and ſacrifice, and pacifique victimes, let him ſelfe examine it and iudge:
label: Josue

text: and not rather with that meaning and deliberation, that we ſaid: To morrow your children wil ſay to our children: What haue you to doe with our Lord the God of Iſrael?
label: Josue

text: Our Lord hath put a border betwen vs and you, O ye children of Ruben, and children of Gad, the riuer Iordan: and therfore you haue no part in our Lord. And by this occaſion your children ſhal auert our children from the feare of our Lord. We therfore thought it better,
label: Josue

text: and ſaid: Let vs build vs an altar, not for holocauſtes, nor to offer victimes,
label: Josue

text: but for a teſtimonie betwen vs and you, and our iſſue and your progenie, that we may ſerue our Lord, and it may be our right to offer both holocauſtes, and victimes, and pacifique hoſtes: and that your children to morrow ſay not to our children: You haue no part in our Lord.
label: Josue

text: And if they wil ſay ſo, they shal anſwer them: Behold the altar of our Lord, which our fathers made, not for holocauſtes, nor for ſacrifice, but for our teſtimonie and yours.
label: Josue

text: God ſaue vs from this abomination that we should reuolt from our Lord, and leaue his ſteppes, erecting an altar to offer holocauſtes, and ſacrifices, and victimes, beſide the altar of our Lord God, which is erected before his tabernacle.
label: Josue

text: Which thinges being heard, Phinees the prieſt, and the princes of the legacie, which were with him, were pacified: and they admitted moſt willingly the wordes of the children of Ruben, & Gad, and of the halfe tribe of Manaſſes.
label: Josue

text: And Phinees the prieſt the ſonne of Eleazar ſaid to them: Now we know that our Lord is with vs, becauſe you are not culpable of this preuarication, and haue deliuered the children of Iſrael from the hand of our Lord.
label: Josue

text: And he returned with the princes from the children of Ruben and Gad, out of the Land of Galaad, into the Land of Chanaan, to the children of Iſrael, and reported to them.
label: Josue

text: And the ſaying pleaſed al that heard it. And the children of Iſrael prayſed God, and they did no more ſay, that they would goe vp againſt them, and fight, and deſtroy the Land of their poſſeſſion.
label: Josue

text: And the children of Ruben, & the children of Gad called the altar, which they had built, Our teſtimonie, that our Lord he is God.
label: Josue

text: AND when much time was paſſed, after that our Lord had geuen peace to Iſrael, al the nations being ſubdewed round about, and Ioſue now verie ancient, and of a great age:
label: Josue

text: Ioſue called al Iſrael, and the elders, and the princes and the iudges, and the maiſters, and ſaid to them: I am old, and farre gone in age:
label: Josue

text: and you ſee al thinges, that our Lord your God hath done to al the nations round about, how him ſelfe hath fought for you:
label: Josue

text: and now becauſe he hath by lotte diuided to you al the Land, from the Eaſt part of Iordan vnto the great ſea, and manie nations yet remaine:
label: Josue

text: Our Lord your God wil deſtroy them, and take them away from your face, and you shal poſſeſſe the Land, as he hath promiſed you.
label: Josue

text: Onlie take courage, and be careful, that you keepe al thinges which be written in the volume of the law of Moyſes: and decline not from them neither to the right hand nor to the left:
label: Josue

text: leſt after that you are entred in to the Gentiles, which shal be among you, you ſweare in the name of their goddes, and ſerue them, and adore them:
label: Josue

text: but cleaue to our Lord your God: which you haue done vntil this day.
label: Josue

text: And then our Lord God wil take away in your ſight the great nations and very ſtrong, and no man shal be able to reſiſt you.
label: Josue

text: One of you shal purſew a thouſand men of the enemies: becauſe our Lord your God him ſelf wil fight for you, as he hath promiſed.
label: Josue

text: This onlie beware very diligently before hand, that you loue our Lord your God.
label: Josue

text: But if you wil cleaue to the errour of theſe nations, that dwel among you, and make mariages with them, and ioyne amitie:
label: Josue

text: euen now know ye that our Lord your God wil not deſtroy them before your face, but they shal be a pitte and a ſnare for you, and a ſtumbling blocke at your ſide, and ſtakes in your eies, til he take you away and deſtroy you from this excellent Land, which he hath deliuered to you.
label: Josue

text: Behold I this day enter into the way of al flesh, and you shal know with al your minde that al the wordes, which our Lord promiſed that he would performe to you, one is not eſcaped without effect.
label: Josue

text: Therfore as he hath fulfilled in deede that which he promiſed, and al thinges proſperous haue come: ſo wil he bring vpon you what euils ſoeuer he hath threatened, til he take you away and deſtroy you from this excellent Land, which he hath deliuered to you,
label: Josue

text: becauſe you haue tranſgreſſed the couenant of our Lord your God, which he hath made with you, and haue ſerued ſtrange goddes, and adored them: quickly and in haſt shal the furie of our Lord ryſe againſt you, and you shal be taken away from this excellent Land, which he hath deliuered to you.
label: Josue

text: AND Ioſue gathered together al the tribes of Iſrael into Sichem, and called the ancientes, and princes, and iudges, and maiſters: and they ſtoode in the ſight of our Lord:
label: Josue

text: and to the people he ſpake in this maner: Thus ſaith our Lord the God of Iſrael: Beyond the riuer did your fathers dwel from the beginning, Thare the father of Abraham, and of Nachor: and they ſerued ſtrange goddes.
label: Josue

text: I tooke therfore your father Abraham from the coaſtes of Meſopotamia: and brought him into the Land of Chanaan: and multiplied his ſeede,
label: Josue

text: and gaue him Iſaac: and againe to him I gaue Iacob and Eſau. Of whom, to Eſau I gaue mount Seir to poſſeſſe: but Iacob, and his children went downe into Ægypt.
label: Josue

text: And I ſent Moyſes and Aaron, and ſtroke Ægypt with many ſignes and wonders.
label: Josue

text: And I brought you and your fathers out of Ægypt, and you came to the ſea: and the Ægyptians purſewed your fathers with chariotes and horſemen, as farre as the Read ſea.
label: Josue

text: And the children of Iſrael cried to the Lord: who did put darkenes betwen you and the Ægyptians, and brought the ſea vpon them, & ouerwhelmed them. Your eies ſaw al thinges that I did in Ægypt, and you dwelt in the wildernes a great time:
label: Josue

text: and I brought you into the Land of the Amorrheite, which dwelt beyond Iordan. And when they fought againſt you, I deliuered them into your handes, and you poſſeſſed their Land, and ſlew them.
label: Josue

text: And there roſe Balac the ſonne of Sephor king of Moab, and fought againſt Iſrael. And he ſent and called Balaam the ſonne of Beor, that he might curſe you:
label: Josue

text: and I would not heare him, but contrariwiſe by him I bleſſed you, and deliuered you out of his hand.
label: Josue

text: And you paſſed Iordan, and came to Iericho. And the men of that citie fought againſt you, the Amorrheite, and Pherezeite and Chananeite, and the Hetheite, and Gergeſeite, and the Heueite, and Iebuſeite: and I deliuered them into your handes.
label: Josue

text: And I ſent before you hornettes: and I caſt them forth out of their places, the two Kinges of the Amorrheites, not in thy ſword and bow.
label: Josue

text: And I gaue you the Land, wherein you laboured not, and the cities which you built not, to dwel in them: vineyardes and oliue trees, which you planted not.
label: Josue

text: Now therfore feare our Lord and ſerue him with a perfect and verie true hart: and take away the goddes, which your fathers ſerued in Meſopotamia and in Ægypt, and ſerue our Lord.
label: Josue

text: But if it like you not to ſerue our Lord, choiſe is geuen you: chooſe this day that which pleaſeth you, whom you ought. eſpecially to ſerue, whether the goddes, which your fathers ſerued in Meſopotamia, or the goddes of the Amorrheites, in whoſe Land you dwel: but I and my houſe wil ſerue our Lord.
label: Josue

text: And the people anſwered, and ſaid: God forbid we should leaue our Lord, and ſerue ſtrange goddes.
label: Josue

text: Our Lord God he brought vs, and our fathers out of the Land of Ægypt, out of the houſe of ſeruitude: and did in our ſight great ſignes, and kept vs in al the way, by the which we walked, and among al the peoples, through which we paſſed.
label: Josue

text: And he hath caſt out al the nations, the Amorrheite inhabiter of the Land, which we haue entred. We therfore wil ſerue our Lord, becauſe he is our God.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue ſaid to the people: You can not ſerue our Lord: for God is holie, and a mightie æmulator, neither wil he pardon your wickednes and ſinnes.
label: Josue

text: If you leaue our Lord, and ſerue ſtrange goddes, he wil turne him ſelf, and wil afflict you, and ouerthrow you after he hath geuen you good thinges.
label: Josue

text: And the people ſaid to Ioſue: No, it shal not be ſo as thou ſpeakeſt, but we wil ſerue our Lord.
label: Josue

text: And Ioſue ſaid to the people: You are witneſſes, that your ſelues haue choſen to you our Lord for to ſerue him. And they anſwered: Witneſſes.
label: Josue

text: Now therfore, quoth he, take away ſtrange goddes out of the middes of you, and incline your hartes to our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: And the people ſaid to Ioſue: We wil ſerue our Lord God, and wil be obedient to his preceptes.
label: Josue

text: Ioſue therfore in that day made a couenant, and propoſed to the people preceptes and iudgementes in Sichem.
label: Josue

text: He wrote alſo al theſe wordes in the volume of the law of our Lord: and he tooke a very great ſtone, and put it vnder the oke, that was in the Sanctuarie of our Lord:
label: Josue

text: and ſaid to al the people: Behold this ſtone shal be a teſtimonie for you, that it hath heard al the wordes of our Lord, which he hath ſpoken to you: leſt perhaps hereafter you wil denie, and lye to our Lord your God.
label: Josue

text: And he diſmiſt the people, euerie one into their poſſeſſion.
label: Josue

text: And after theſe thinges Ioſue the ſonne of Nun the ſeruant of our Lord died, being a hundred and ten yeares old:
label: Josue

text: and they buried him in the coaſtes of his poſſeſſion in Thamnathſare, which is ſituated in the mountaine of Ephraim, on the North part of mount Gaas.
label: Josue

text: And Iſrael ſerued our Lord al the daies of Ioſue, and of the ancientes, that liued a long time after Ioſue, and that had knowen al the workes of our Lord which he had done in Iſrael.
label: Josue

text: The bones alſo of Ioſeph which the children of Iſrael had taken out of Ægypt, they buried in Sichem, in part of the field, which Iacob had bought of the ſonnes of Hemor the father of Sichem, for a hundred yong ewes, and it was in the poſſeſſion of the ſonnes of Ioſeph.
label: Josue

text: Eleazar alſo the ſonne of Aaron died: and they buried him in Gabaath of Phinees his ſonne, which was geuen him in mount Ephraim.
label: Josue

text: AFTER the death of Ioſue the children of Iſrael conſulted our Lord, ſaying: Who shal goe vp before vs againſt the Chananeite, and shal be captaine of the warre?
label: Judges

text: And our Lord ſaid: Iudas shal goe vp: behold I haue deliuered the Land into his handes,
label: Judges

text: And Iudas ſaid to Simeon his brother: Come vp with me into my lotte, and fight againſt the Chananeite, that I alſo may goe forward with thee into thy lotte. And Simeon went with him.
label: Judges

text: And Iudas went vp, and our Lord deliuered the Chananeite, and the Pherezeite into their handes: and they ſtroke in Bezec ten thouſand men.
label: Judges

text: And they found Adonibezec in Bezec, and fought againſt him, and ſtroke the Chananeite, and the Pherezeite.
label: Judges

text: And Adonibezec fled: whom purſewing they tooke, cutting of the extreme partes of his handes and feete.
label: Judges

text: And Adonibezec ſaid: Seuentie kinges hauing the extreme partes of their handes and feete cut of, gathered vp the reliques of meates vnder my table: as I haue done, ſo hath God repayed me. And they brought him into Ieruſalem, and there he died.
label: Judges

text: Therfore the children of Iudas aſſaulting Ieruſalem, tooke it, and ſtroke it in the edge of the ſword, ſetting the whole citie on fyre.
label: Judges

text: And afterward going downe they fought againſt the Chananeite, which dwelled in the mountaines, and ſouthward, and in the champaine countries.
label: Judges

text: And Iudas going forward againſt the Chananeite, that dwelled in Hebron (the name wherof was before time Cariatharbe) ſtroke Seſai, and Ahiman, and Tholmai:
label: Judges

text: and departing thence went to the inhabitantes of Dabir, the old name wherof was Cariath Sepher, that is, a citie of letters.
label: Judges

text: And Caleb ſaid: He that shal ſtrike Cariath Sepher, and ſpoile it, I wil geue him Axa my daughter to wife.
label: Judges

text: And when Othoniel the ſonne of Cenez, the yonger brother of Caleb had taken it, he gaue him Axa his daughter to wife.
label: Judges

text: Whom going on her way her husband admonished to aske a field of her father. To whom, when she had ſighed ſitting on her aſſe, Caleb ſaid: What aileth thee?
label: Judges

text: But she anſwered: Geue me a bleſſing, for a drie land thou haſt geuen me: geue me alſo a waterie. Caleb therfore gaue her a watrie ground aboue, & waterie beneath.
label: Judges

text: And the children of the Cineite the coſin of Moyſes went vp from the citie of palmes, with the children of Iudas into the deſet of his lotte, which is at the ſouth ſide of Arad, and dwelt with him.
label: Judges

text: But Iudas went with Simeon his brother, and together they ſtroke the Chananeite that dwelt in Sephaath, and ſlew him. And the name of the citie was called, Horma, that is, Anathema.
label: Judges

text: And Iudas tooke Gaza with the coaſtes therof, & Aſcalon, and Accaron with their boundes.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord was with Iudas, and he poſeſſed the mountaines: neither could he deſtroy the inhabitantes of the valley, becauſe they had manie hooked chariotes.
label: Judges

text: And they gaue to Galeb Hebron, as Moyſes had ſaid, who deſtroyed out of it the three ſonnes of Enac.
label: Judges

text: But the Iebuſeite the inhabiter of Ieruſalem the children of Beniamin deſtroyed not: and the Iebuſeite dwelt with the children of Beniamin in Ieruſalem vntil this preſent day.
label: Judges

text: The houſe alſo of Ioſeph went vp into Bethel, and our Lord was with them.
label: Judges

text: For when they beſieged the citie, which before was called Luza,
label: Judges

text: they ſaw a man comming out of the citie, and ſaid to him: Shew vs the entrrance of the citie, and we wil shew thee mercie.
label: Judges

text: Who when he had shewed them, they ſtroke the citie in the edge of the ſword: but that man, and al his kinred they diſmiſſed.
label: Judges

text: Who being diſmiſt, went into the Land of the Hetthims, and built there a citie, and called it Luza: which is ſo called vntil this preſent day.
label: Judges

text: Manaſſes alſo deſtroyed not Bethſan, and Thanac with their litle townes, and the inhabitantes of Dor, and Ieblaam, and Mageddo with their litle townes. And the Chananeite began to dwel with them.
label: Judges

text: But after that Iſrael was waxen ſtrong, he made them tributaries, and would not deſtroy them.
label: Judges

text: Ephraim alſo killed not the Chananeite, that dwelt in Gazer, but dwelt with him.
label: Judges

text: Zabulon deſtroyed not the inhabitantes of Cetron, & Naalol: but the Chananeite dwelt in the middes of him, and was made tributarie to him.
label: Judges

text: Aſer alſo deſtroyed not the inhabitantes of Accho, and of Sidon, of Ahalab, and Achazib, and Helba, and Aphec, and Rohob:
label: Judges

text: and he dwelt in the middes of the Chananeite the inhabiter of that Land, neither did he kil them.
label: Judges

text: Nepthali alſo deſtroyed not the inhabitantes of Bethſames, & Bethanath: and he dwelt in the middes of the Chananeite the inhabiter of the Land, and the Bethſamites & Bethanites were tributaries to him.
label: Judges

text: And the Amorrheite ſtraytened the children of Dan in the mountaine, and gaue them not place to goe downe to the playne:
label: Judges

text: and he dwelt in mount Hares which is interpreted shelles, in Aialon and Salebim. And the hand of the houſe of Ioſeph was agrauated, and he became tributarie to him.
label: Judges

text: And the border of the Amorrheite was from the Aſcent of the Scorpion, the rocke, and the higher places.
label: Judges

text: AND the Angel of our Lord went vp from Galgal to the place of weepers, and ſaid: I brought you out of Ægypt, and haue brought you into the Land, for the which I ſware to your fathers: and I promiſed that I would not make fruſtrate my couenant with you for euer:
label: Judges

text: onlie ſo that you should not make a league with the inhabitantes of this Land, but should ouerthrow their altares: and you would not heare my voice: why haue you done this?
label: Judges

text: For the which cauſe I would not deſtroy them from before your face: that you may haue enemies, and their goddes may be a ruine vnto you.
label: Judges

text: And when the Angel of our Lord ſpake theſe wordes to al the children of Iſrael: they lifted vp their voice, and wept.
label: Judges

text: And the name of that place was called, the place of weepers, or of teares: and there they immolated hoſtes to our Lord.
label: Judges

text: Ioſue therfore diſmiſſed the people, and the children of Iſrael went euerie one into his poſſeſſion, to obtayne it:
label: Judges

text: and they ſerued our Lord al his daies, and the daies of the ancientes, of them that liued a long time after him, and knew al the workes of our Lord, which he had done with Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: And Ioſue the ſonne of Nun, the ſeruant of our Lord, died, being a hundred and ten yeares old,
label: Judges

text: and they buried him in the borders of his poſſeſſion in Thamnathſare in the mount of Ephraim, on the North ſide of mount Gaas.
label: Judges

text: And al that generation was gathered to to their fathers: and there roſe others, that knew not our Lord, and the workes which he had done with Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: And the children of Iſrael did euil in the ſight of our Lord, and ſerued Baalim.
label: Judges

text: And they left our Lord the God of their fathers, that had brought them out of the Land of Ægypt: and folowed ſtrange goddes, and the goddes of the peoples, that dwelt round about them, and adored them: and they prouoked our Lord to anger,
label: Judges

text: leauing him, and ſeruing Baal and Aſtaroth.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord being wrath againſt Iſrael, deliuered them into the handes of ranſackers: who tooke them and ſold them to the enemies, that dwelt round about: neither could they reſiſt their aduerſaries:
label: Judges

text: but whitherſoeuer they had meant to goe, the hand of our Lord was vpon them, as he ſpake, and ſware to them: and they were vehemently afflicted.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord rayſed vp Iudges, that should deliuer them from the handes of the waſters: but
label: Judges

text: neither would they heare them, fornicating with ſtrange goddes, and adoring them. They did quickly forſake the way, in the which their fathers had gone: and hearing the commandementes of our Lord, they did al thinges contrarie.
label: Judges

text: And when our Lord rayſed vp Iudges, in their daies he was moued with mercie, and heard the groninges of the afflicted, and deliuered them from the ſlaughter of the waſters.
label: Judges

text: But after the Iudge was dead, they returned, and did much worſe things then their fathers had done, folowing ſtrange goddes ſeruing them, and adoring them. They left not their inuentions, and the verie hard way, by which they were accuſtomed to walke.
label: Judges

text: And the furie of our Lord was angrie againſt Iſrael, & ſaid: Becauſe this nation hath made my couenãt fruſtrate, which I had made with their fathers, & hath cõtemned my voice:
label: Judges

text: I alſo wil not deſtroy the nations which Ioſue did let alone, and died:
label: Judges

text: that in them I may trie Iſrael, whether they wil keepe the way of the Lord, and walke in it, as their fathers kept it, or no.
label: Judges

text: Our Lord therfore left al theſe nations, and would not quickly ouerthrow them, neither deliuered them into the handes of Ioſue.
label: Judges

text: THESE are the Nations, which our Lord left, that in them he might inſtruct Iſrael, and al that had not knowen the warres of the Chananeites:
label: Judges

text: that afterward their children might lerne to fight with their enemies, and to be accuſtomed to warre:
label: Judges

text: the fiue princes of the Philiſthimes, and the Chananeite, and Sidonian, and Heueite, that dwelt in mount Libanus, from mount Baal Hermon to the entring into Emath.
label: Judges

text: And he left them, that in them he might trie Iſrael, whether they would heare the commandementes of our Lord, which he had commanded their fathers by the hand of Moyſes, or not.
label: Judges

text: Therfore the children of Iſrael dwelt in the middes of the Chananeite, and Hetheite, and Amorrheite, and Pherezeite, and Heueite, and Iebuſeite:
label: Judges

text: and they tooke their daughters to wiues, and them ſelues gaue their owne daughters to their ſonnes, & ſerued their goddes.
label: Judges

text: And they did euil in the ſight of our Lord, and forgat their God, ſeruing Baalim and Aſtaroth.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord being wrath againſt Iſrael, deliuered them into the handes of Chuſan Raſathaim the king of Meſopotamia, and they ſerued him eight yeares.
label: Judges

text: And they cried to our Lord: who rayſed them vp a ſauiour, and deliuered them, to witte, Othoniel the ſonne of Cenez, the yonger brother of Caleb:
label: Judges

text: and the Spirit of our Lord was in him, and he iudged Iſrael. And he went forth to fight, and our Lord deliuered into his handes Chuſan Raſathaim the king of Syria, and oppreſſed him.
label: Judges

text: And the land reſted fourtie yeares, and Othoniel the ſonne of Cenez died.
label: Judges

text: And the children of Iſrael added to doe euil in the ſight of our Lord: who ſtrengthned againſt them Eglon the king of Moab: becauſe they did euil in his ſight.
label: Judges

text: And he ioyned to him the children of Ammon, and Amalec: and he went and ſtroke Iſrael, and poſſeſſed the Citie of palmes.
label: Judges

text: And the children of Iſrael ſerued Eglon the king of Moab eightene yeares:
label: Judges

text: and afterward they cried to our Lord: who rayſed vp vnto them a ſauiour called Aod, the ſonne of Gera, the ſonne of Iemini, who vſed both handes for the right. And the children of Iſrael ſent by him preſentes to Eglon the king of Moab.
label: Judges

text: Who made him ſelf a two edged ſword, hauing in the middes a hafte in length the palme of a hand, and was girded therwith vnder his caſſocke on the right thigh.
label: Judges

text: And he preſented the giftes to Eglon the king of Moab. And Eglon was exceeding groſſe.
label: Judges

text: And when he had preſented the giftes vnto him, he brought his felowes on the way that came with him.
label: Judges

text: And returning from Galgal, where the Idols were, he ſaid to the King: I haue a ſecrete meſſage to thee ô king. And he commanded ſilence: and al being gone forth, that were about him,
label: Judges

text: Aod went in to him: and he ſate in a ſommer chamber alone, and he ſaid: A word from God I haue to thee. Who forthwith roſe out of his throne.
label: Judges

text: And Aod put forth his left hand, and tooke the dagger from his right thigh, and faſtened it into his bellie
label: Judges

text: ſo mightelyt that the haft folowed the blade in the wound, and was cloſed vp faſt with the moſt fatte greaſe. Neither did he plucke out the dagger, but as he had ſtriken ſo leift it in the bodie: and forthwith by the ſecrete partes of nature the ordure of the bellie came forth.
label: Judges

text: But Aod shutting the doores of the chamber very diligently, and locking them ſure,
label: Judges

text: went out by a poſterne doore. And the kinges ſeruantes going in, ſaw the doores of the chamber shut, and they ſaid: Peraduenture he purgeth his bellie in the ſommer chamber.
label: Judges

text: And expecting long til they were ashamed, and ſeeing that no man did open, they tooke a key: and opening they found their lord on the earth lying dead.
label: Judges

text: But Aod, whiles they were trubled, eſcaped, and paſſed by the Place of Idols, whence he had returned. And he came into Seirath:
label: Judges

text: and forthwith the trumpet ſounded in the mount of Ephraim: and the children of Iſrael went downe with him, him ſelf going in the front.
label: Judges

text: Who ſaid to them: Folow me: for our Lord hath deliuered our enemies the Moabites into our handes. And they went downe after him, and occupied the fordes of Iordan, which bring ouer into Moab: and they ſuffered no man to paſſe:
label: Judges

text: but they ſtroke the Moabites at that time, about ten thouſand, al ſtoute and ſtrong men, none of them could eſcape.
label: Judges

text: And Moab was humbled that day vnder the hand of Iſrael: and the Land reſted eightie yeares.
label: Judges

text: After him was Samgar the ſonne of Anath, who ſtroke, of the Philiſthimes ſix hundred men with the culter of a ploughe: and he alſo defended Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: AND the children of Iſrael added to doe euil in the ſight of our Lord after the death of Aod,
label: Judges

text: and our Lord deliuered them into the handes of Iabin the king of Chanaan, which reigned in Aſor: and he had a captaine of his armie named Siſara, and he dwelt in Haroſeth of the gentiles.
label: Judges

text: And the children of Iſrael cried to our Lord: for he had nine hundred yron hooked chariottes, and for twentie yeres had vehemently oppreſſed them.
label: Judges

text: And there was one Debbora a propheteſe the wife of Lapidoth, which iudged the people at that time.
label: Judges

text: And ſhe ſate vnder a palme tree, which was called by her name, betwen Rama and Bethel in the mount of Ephraim: and the children of Iſrael went vp to her for al iudgement.
label: Judges

text: Who ſent, and called Barac the ſonne of Abinoem of Cedes in Nepthali: and she ſaid to him: Our Lord God of Iſrael hath commanded thee, Goe, and lead an armie into mount Thabor, and thou shalt take with thee ten thouſand fighting men of the children of Nepthali, and of the children of Zabulon:
label: Judges

text: and I wil bring vnto thee in the place of the Torrent Ciſon, Siſara the prince of the hoſte of Iabin, and his chariotes, and al the multitude, and wil deliuer them in thy hand.
label: Judges

text: And Barac ſaid to her: If thou come with me, I wil goe: If thou wilt not come with me, I wil not goe.
label: Judges

text: Who ſaid to him: I wil goe in deede with thee, but at this time the victorie ſhal not be imputed to thee, becauſe Siſara shal be deliuered into the hand of a woman. Debbora therfore aroſe, and went with Barac into Cedes.
label: Judges

text: Who calling vnto him Zabulon and Nepthali, went vp with ten thouſand fighting men, hauing Debbora in his companie.
label: Judges

text: And Haber the Cineite was in time paſt departed from the reſt of the Cineites his brethren of Hobab, the coſin of Moyſes: and had pitched his tentes vnto the valley, which is called Sennim, and was nere Cedes.
label: Judges

text: And it was told Siſara, that Barac the ſonne of Abinoem was gone vp into mount Thabor:
label: Judges

text: and he gathered nine hundred yron hooked chariottes, and al his armie from Haroſeth of the gentiles to the torrent Ciſon.
label: Judges

text: And Debbora ſaid to Barac: Ariſe, for this is the day, wherin our Lord hath deliuered Siſara into thy handes: behold he is thy leader. And Barac went downe from mount Thabor, and ten thouſand fighting men with him.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord terrified Siſara, and al his chariotes, and al the multitude in the edge of the ſword at the ſight of Barac: in ſo much, that Siſara leaping downe from his chariote, fled a foote,
label: Judges

text: and Barac purſewed the chariotes fleeing, and the armie vnto Haroſeth of the gentiles, and al the multitude of the enemies was vtterly deſtroyed.
label: Judges

text: But Siſara fleeing came to the tent of Iahel the wife of Haber the Cineite. for there was peace betwixt Iabin the king of Aſor, and the houſe of Haber the Cineite.
label: Judges

text: Iahel therfore going forth to meete Siſara, ſaid to him: Come in to me my Lord, come in, feare not. Who being entred into her tabernacle, and couered of her with a cloke,
label: Judges

text: ſaid to her: Geue me, I beſeech thee, a little water, for I am very thirſtie. Who opened a bottle of milke, and gaue him to drinke, and couered him.
label: Judges

text: And Siſara ſaid to her: Stand before the doore of the tabernacle, and when any shal come asking thee, and ſaying: Is there any man here? Thou shalt ſay: There is none.
label: Judges

text: Iahel therfore the wife of Haber tooke a nayle of the tabernacle, taking withal a hammer alſo: and going in ſecretely, and with ſilence she put the naile vpon the temple of his head, and ſtriking it with the hammer, faſtened it into his braine euen to the ground: who ioyning deepe ſleepe and death together, faynted, and died.
label: Judges
