text: And behold Barac folowing Siſara came: & Iahel going forth to meete him, ſaid to him: Come, and I wil shew thee the man whom thou ſeekeſt. Who when he was entered in vnto her, ſaw Siſara lying dead, and the nayle faſtened in his temples.
label: Judges

text: Therfore God that day humbled Iabin the king of Chanaan before the children of Iſrael:
label: Judges

text: which increaſed daily, and with ſtrong hand oppreſſed Iabin the king of Chanaan, til they deſtroyed him.
label: Judges

text: AND Debbora and Barac the ſonne of Abinoem ſang in that day, ſaying:
label: Judges

text: You that of Iſrael haue voluntarily offered your liues to peril, bleſſe our Lord.
label: Judges

text: Heare you kinges, and geue eare ye princes: I am, I am ſhe, that wil ſing to our Lord, I wil chaunte to our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: Lord when thou wentſt out of Seir, and didſt paſſe by the countries of Edom, the earth was moued, & the heauens and cloudes diſtilled waters.
label: Judges

text: The mountaines melted before the face of our Lord, and Sinai before the face of our Lord God of Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: In the daies of Samgar the ſonne of Anath, in the daies of Iahel the pathes reſted: and they that went by them, walked by bywaies.
label: Judges

text: The valiantes in Iſrael ceaſed, and reſted: vntil Debbora aroſe, a mother roſe in Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: Our Lord choſe new warres, and the gates of the enemies him ſelfe ſubuerted: shield and ſpeare if there appeared among fourtie thouſand of Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: My hart loueth the princes of Iſrael: you that of your owne good wil offered your ſelues to danger, bleſſe our Lord.
label: Judges

text: You that ride vpon your faire aſſes, and ſitte in iudgement, and walke in the way, ſpeake.
label: Judges

text: Where the chariottes were frushed together, and the armie of the enemie was ſuffocated, there let the iuſtices of our Lord be told, and his clemencie toward the valiantes of Iſrael: then did the people of our Lord goe downe to the gates, and obteyned the principalitie.
label: Judges

text: Ariſe, ariſe Debbora, ariſe, ariſe, and ſpeake a canticle: Ariſe Barac, and apprehend thy captiues thou ſonne of Abinoem.
label: Judges

text: The remnant of the people is ſaued, our Lord hath fought in the valiantes.
label: Judges

text: Out from Ephraim he deſtroyed them into Amalec, and after him out from Beniamin into thy peoples O Amalec: Out from Machir there deſcended princes, and out from Zabulon they that led the armie to fight.
label: Judges

text: The captaines of Iſſachar were with Debbora, and folowed the ſteppes of Barac, who as it were into a headlong and bottomeles pitte gaue him ſelf to danger: Ruben being diuided againſt it ſelf, there was found contention of couragious perſons.
label: Judges

text: Why dwelleſt thou betwen the two boundes, that thou mayeſt heare the whiſtlinges of the flockes? Ruben being diuided againſt it ſelf, there was found contention of couragious men.
label: Judges

text: Galaad reſted beyond Iordan, and Dan gaue him ſelf to ſhippes: Aſer dwelt in the ſea shore, and abode in hauens.
label: Judges

text: But Zabulon and Nepthali offered their liues to death in their countrie of Merome.
label: Judges

text: The kinges came and fought, the kinges of Chanaan fought in Thanac beſides the waters of Mageddo, and yet going a praying they tooke nothing.
label: Judges

text: From heauen they fought againſt them: the ſtarres remayning in their order and courſe, fought againſt Siſara.
label: Judges

text: The torrent of Ciſon drew their carcaſſes, the torrent of Cadumim, the torrent of Ciſon: my ſoule tread downe the ſtrong ones.
label: Judges

text: The hoofes of the horſes fel of, the ſtrongeſt of the enemies fleeing violently, and falling downe headlong.
label: Judges

text: Curſe ye the land of Meroz, ſaid the Angel of our Lord: Curſe the inhabitantes therof, becauſe they came not to help our Lord, to aide his moſt mightie ones.
label: Judges

text: Bleſſed among wemen be Iahel the wife of Haber the Cineite, and bleſſed be she in her tabernacle.
label: Judges

text: To him that asked water she gaue milke, and in the phial of princes she offered butter.
label: Judges

text: Her left hand she put to the naile, and her right hand to the ſmithes hammer, and ſtroke Siſara, ſeeking in his head a place for the wound, and piercing valiantly through his temple.
label: Judges

text: Betwen her feete he fel: he failed, and died: he was rowled before her feete, and he lay without life and miſerable.
label: Judges

text: Looking through a window, his mother howled: & she ſpake out of a higher chamber: Why lingereth his chariote to come backe? Wherfore are the feete of his waggans ſlow?
label: Judges

text: One wiſer then the reſt of his wiues, anſwered theſe wordes to her mother in law:
label: Judges

text: Peraduenture now he diuideth the ſpoyles, and the fayreſt of the wemen is choſen for him: garmentes of ſundrie colours are deliuered to Siſara for a praye, and diuerſe furniture is laid together to adorne the neckes.
label: Judges

text: So perish al thine enemies O Lord: but they that loue thee, as the Sunne shineth in his ryſing, ſo let them glitter.
label: Judges

text: And the Land reſted for fourtie yeares.
label: Judges

text: AND the children of Iſrael did euil in the ſight of our Lord: who deliuered them into the hand of Madian ſeuen yeares,
label: Judges

text: & they were ſore oppreſſed of them. And they made them ſelues dennes and caues in the mountaines, and very wel fenſed places to reſiſt.
label: Judges

text: And when Iſrael had ſowen, Madian came vp and Amalec, and the reſt of the Eaſt nations:
label: Judges

text: and pitching their tentes by rhem waſted al thinges as they were in the blade vnto the entring of Gaza: and they left nothing at al in Iſrael that perteyned to mans life, not ſheepe, not oxen, not aſſes.
label: Judges

text: For they and al their flockes came with their tabernacles, and like vnto locuſtes filled al places, an inumerable multitude of men, and of camels, waſting whatſoeuer they touched.
label: Judges

text: And Iſrael Was ſore humbled in the ſight of Madian.
label: Judges

text: And he cried to our Lord deſiring helpe againſt the Madianites.
label: Judges

text: Who ſent vnto them a man that was a prophet, and he ſpake: Thus ſayeth our Lord the God of Iſrael: I made you to come vp out of Ægypt, and brought you out of the houſe of ſeruitude,
label: Judges

text: and deliuered you out of the handes of the Ægyptians, and of al the enemies, that afflicted you: and I caſt them out at your entring, and deliuered you their Land.
label: Judges

text: And I ſaid: I the Lord your God, feare not the goddes of the Amorrheites, in whoſe land you dwel. And you would not heare my voice.
label: Judges

text: And an Angel of our lord came, and ſate vnder an oke, that was in Ephra, and perteyned to Ioas the father of the familie of Ezri. And when Gedeon his ſonne did thresh and purge wheate in a winepreſſe, to flee Madian,
label: Judges

text: the Angel of our Lord appeared to him, and ſaid: Our Lord be with thee ô moſt valiant of men.
label: Judges

text: And Gedeon ſaid to him: I beſech thee my Lord, if our Lord be with vs, why haue theſe euils apprehended vs? where are his meruelous workes, which our fathers haue told vs, and ſaid: Out of Ægypt did our Lord bring vs? but now our Lord hath forſaken vs, and deliuered vs into the hande of Madian.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord looked toward him, and ſaid: Goe in this thy ſtrength, and thou shalt deliuer Iſrael out of the hand of Madian: know that I haue ſent thee.
label: Judges

text: Who anſwering ſaid: I beſech thee, my Lord, wherein shal I deliuer Iſrael? behold my familie is the meaneſt in Manaſſes, and I the leaſt in my fathers houſe.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord ſaid to him: I wil be with thee: and thou shalt ſtrike Madian as it were one man.
label: Judges

text: And he ſaid: If I haue found, quoth he, grace before thee, geue me a ſigne that it is thou which ſpeakeſt to me.
label: Judges

text: Neither depart thou hence, til I returne to thee, bringing a ſacrifice, and offering to thee. Who anſwered: I wil tarie thy coming.
label: Judges

text: Gedeon therfore went in, and boyled a kidde, and of a bushel of flowre baked vnleuened loaues: and putting the flesh in a basket, and the broth of the flesh into a potte, he caried al vnder the oke, and offered to him.
label: Judges

text: To whom the Angel of our Lord ſaid: Take the flesh and the vnleuened loaues, and put them vpon that rocke, and powre out the broth theron. And when he had done,
label: Judges

text: the Angel of our Lord ſtretched forth the tippe of the rodde, which he held in his hand, and touched the flesh and the vnleuened loaues: and there aroſe a fyre from the rocke, and conſumed the flesh, and the leuened loaues: and the Angel of our Lord vanished from his eies.
label: Judges

text: And Gedeon ſeeing that it was the Angel of our Lord, ſaid: Alas my Lord God: that I haue ſeene the Angel our Lord face to face.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord ſaid to him: Peace be with thee: feare not, thou shalt not die.
label: Judges

text: And Gedeon built there an altar to our Lord, and called it, our Lords peace, vntil this preſent day. And when he was yet in Ephra, which is of the familie of Ezri,
label: Judges

text: that night our Lord ſaid to him: Take a bullocke of thy fathers, and an other bullocke of ſeuen yeares, and thou shalt deſtroy the altar of Baal, which is thy fathers: and cut downe the groue, that is about the altar:
label: Judges

text: and thou shalt build an altar to the Lord thy God in the toppe of this rocke, whereupon thou didſt lay the ſacrifice before: and thou shalt take the ſecond bullocke, and shalt offer an holocauſte vpon a pile of the wood, which thou shalt cut downe out of the groue.
label: Judges

text: Gedeon therfore taking to him ten men of his ſeruantes, did as our Lord had commanded him. But fearing his fathers houſe, and the men of that citie, he would not doe it by day, but accomplished al thinges by night.
label: Judges

text: And when the men of that towne were riſen in the morning, they ſaw the altar of Baal deſtroyed, and the groue cut downe, and the other bullocke laid vpon the altar, which then was built.
label: Judges

text: They ſaid one to an other: Who hath done this? And when they inquired for the author of the fact, it was ſaid: Gedeon the ſonne of Ioas did al theſe thinges.
label: Judges

text: And they ſaid to Ioas: Bring forth thy ſonne hither, that he may die: becauſe he hath deſtroyed the altar of Baal, and hath cut downe his groue.
label: Judges

text: To whom he anſwered: Why are you reuengers of Baal, that you fight for him? he that is his aduerſarie, let him die before to morrow light appeare: if he be God, reuenge he him ſelf, on him that hath rayſed his altar.
label: Judges

text: From that day Gedeon was called Ierobaal, becauſe Ioas had ſaid: Let Baal reuenge him ſelf on him, that hath rayſed his altar.
label: Judges

text: Therefore al Madian, and Amalec, and the eaſt peoples were gathered together, and paſſing ouer Iordan, camped in the vaile Iezrael.
label: Judges

text: But the ſpirit of our Lord reueſted Gedeon, who ſounding with a trumpet called together the houſe of Abiezer, to folow him.
label: Judges

text: And he ſent meſſengers into al Manaſſes, which it ſelfe alſo did folow him: and other meſſengers into Aſer and Zabulon and Nepthali, which mette him.
label: Judges

text: And Gedeon ſaid to God: If thou ſaue Iſrael by my hand, as thou haſt ſpoken,
label: Judges

text: I wil putte this fleece of wool on the floore: if there shal be dew in the fleece onlie, and on al the ground drienes, I shal know that by my hand, as thou haſt ſpoken, thou wilt deliuer Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: And it came ſo to paſſe. And ryſing in the night wringing the fleece, he filled a veſſel with the dew.
label: Judges

text: And he ſaid againe to God: Let not thy furie be angry againſt me if I tempt once againe, ſeeking a ſigne in the fleece. I deſire that the fleece onlie may be drie, and al the ground wette with dew.
label: Judges

text: And God did that night as he had requeſted: and there was drienes in the fleece onlie, and dew on al the ground.
label: Judges

text: THERFORE Ierobaal, which is alſo Gedeon, ryſing in the night, and al the people with him, came to the fountaine that is called Harad. and the campe of Madian was in the valley on the North ſide of the high hil.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord ſaid to Gedeon: There is much people with thee, neither shal Madian be deliuered into their hand: leſt Iſrael glorie againſt me, and ſay: By myne owne force I am deliuered.
label: Judges

text: Speake to the people, and proclame in al their hearing: He that is fearful and timorous, let him returne. And they departed ftom mount Galaad, and there returned two and twentie thouſand men, and onlie ten thouſand remained.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord ſaid to Gedeon: Yet there is a great multitude, leade them to the waters, and there I wil proue them: and of whom I shal tel thee that he goe with thee, let him goe: whom I shal forbid to goe, let him returne.
label: Judges

text: And when the people were come downe to the waters, our Lord ſaid to Gedeon: They that shal lappe the water with their tongues, as dogges are wont to lappe, thou ſhalt ſeparate them apart: but they that shal drinke bowing downe their knees, ſhal be on the other part.
label: Judges

text: The number therfore of them that had lapped watter, their hand caſting it to their mouth, was three hundred men: and al the reſt of the multitude had drunck kneeling.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord ſaid to Gedeon: In the three hundred men, that lapped water, I wil deliuer you, and geue Madian in thy hand: but let al the reſt of the multitude returne into their place.
label: Judges

text: Taking therfore victuals and trumpettes according to the number, al the reſt of the multitude he commanded to depart to their tabernacles: and him ſelfe with the three hundred gaue him ſelfe to the battel. And the campe of Madian was beneath in the valley.
label: Judges

text: The ſame night our Lord ſaid to him: Ariſe, and goe downe into the campe: becauſe I haue deliuered them into thy hand.
label: Judges

text: But if thou be afraid to goe alone, let Phara thy ſeruant goe downe with thee.
label: Judges

text: And when thou shalt heare what they ſpeake, then shal thy handes be ſtrengthned, and thou shalt goe downe more ſecure to the enemies campe. He therfore went downe and Phara his ſeruant into part of the campe, where the watch was of men in armes.
label: Judges

text: But Madian and Amalec, and al the Eaſt peoples lay ſcattered in the valley, as a multitude of locuſtes: their camels alſo were innumerable, as the ſand that lieth in the ſea shore.
label: Judges

text: And when Gedeon was come, one told his neighbour a dreame: & in this manner he reported that which he had ſeene: I ſaw a dreame, & there ſemed to me as it were a harth loafe of barlie to roll, & to come into the campe of Madian: and when it was come to the tabernacle, it ſtroke it, and ouerthrew it, and beate it al flatte with the earth.
label: Judges

text: He to whom he ſpake, anſwered: This is no other thing, but the ſword of Gedeon the ſonne of Ioas the man of Iſrael. For the Lord hath deliuered Madian into his handes, and al their campe.
label: Judges

text: And when Gedeon had heard the dreame, and the interpretation therof, he adored: and turned to the campe of Iſrael, and ſaid: Ariſe ye, for our Lord hath deliuered the campe of Madian into our handes.
label: Judges

text: And he diuided the three hundred men into three partes, and gaue them trumpettes in their handes, and emptie pitchers, and lampes in the middes of their pitchers.
label: Judges

text: And he ſaid to them: What you shal ſee me doe, that doe ye: I wil enter into part of the campe, and that which I shal doe folow you.
label: Judges

text: When the trumpet shal ſound in my hand, doe you alſo ſound and crie together round about the campe: To our Lord and to Gedeon.
label: Judges

text: And Gedeon went in, and the three hundred that were with him, into part of the campe, the watch of midnight beginning, and rayſing vp the watch men they began to ſound with their trumpettes, and to clappe the pitchers one againſt an other.
label: Judges

text: And when they ſounded in three places round about the campe, and had broken the pitchers, they held the lampes in the left handes, and with the right chey ſounded the trumpettes, and cried: The ſword of our Lord and of Gedeon:
label: Judges

text: ſtanding euerie one in his place round about the enemies campe. Therfore the whole campe was trubled, and crying out and howling they fled:
label: Judges

text: and the three hundred men neuertheles perſiſted ſounding with the trumpettes. And our Lord ſent in the ſword in al the campe, and they murdered one an other,
label: Judges

text: fleeing as farre as Bethſetta, and the brinke of Abelmehula in Tebbath. But the men of Iſrael of Nephthali, and Aſer shoutting together, and al Manaſſes purſewed Madian.
label: Judges

text: And Gedeon ſent meſſengers into al mount Ephraim, ſaying: Come downe to meete Madian, and take the waters before them to Bethbera and Iordan. And al Ephraim shouted, and tooke the waters before them and Iordan vnto Bethbera.
label: Judges

text: And two men that were apprehended of Madian, Oreb, and Zeb: Oreb he ſlew in the Rocke of Oreb, Zeb in the Preſſe of Zeb. And they purſewed Madian, carying the heades of Oreb and Zeb to Gedeon beyond the ſtreames of Iordan.
label: Judges

text: AND the men of Ephraim ſaid to him: What is this that thou didſt meane to doe, that thou wouldeſt not cal vs when thou didſt goe to fight againſt Madian? chyding bitterly and almoſt offering violence.
label: Judges

text: To whom he anſwered: What could I haue done like to that, which you haue done. Is not the cluſter of Ephraim better then the vintages of Abiezer?
label: Judges

text: Into your handes hath our Lord deliuered the princes of Madian, Oreb and Zeb, what could I haue done the like as you haue done? Which when he had ſpoken, their ſpirit reſted, wherwith they did ſwel againſt him.
label: Judges

text: And when Gedeon was come to Iordan, he paſſed ouer it with the three hundred men, that were with him: and for wearines, they could not purſew them that fled.
label: Judges

text: And he ſaid to the men of Soccoth: Geue, I beſeech you, bread to the people, that is with me, becauſe they are verie faint: that we may purſew Zebee, and Salmana the kinges of Madian.
label: Judges

text: The princes of Soccoth anſwered: Peraduenture the palmes of the handes of Zebee and Salmana are in thy hand, & therfore thou requireſt that we geue bread to thy armie.
label: Judges

text: To whom he ſaid: When our Lord therfore shal haue deliuered Zebee and Salmana into my handes, I wil teare your flesh with the thornes, and briers of the deſert.
label: Judges

text: And going vp from thence, he came into Phanuel: and he ſpake to the men of that place the like thinges. To whom they alſo anſwered, as the men of Soccoth had anſwered.
label: Judges

text: He ſaid therfore to them alſo: When I shal be returned conquerour in peace, I wil deſtroy this towre.
label: Judges

text: But Zebee and Salmana reſted with al their armie. For fiftene thouſand men were remayning of al the troupes of the Eaſt peoples, an hundred and twentie thouſand fighting men and thoſe that drew ſword, being ſlayne.
label: Judges

text: And Gedeon going vp by the way of them, that dwelt in tabernacles, on the Eaſt ſide of Nobe, and Iegbaa, ſtroke the campe of the enemies, which were ſecure, and ſuſpected no miſchance.
label: Judges

text: And Zebee and Salmana fled, whom Gedeon purſewing apprehended, al their hoſte being put out of aray.
label: Judges

text: And returning from the battel before ſunne ryſing,
label: Judges

text: he tooke a boy of the men of Soccoth: and he asked him the names of the princes and ancientes of Soccoth, and he deſcribed ſeuentie ſeuen men.
label: Judges

text: And he came to Soccoth, and ſaid to them: Behold Zebee, and Salmana concerning whom you vpbraided me, ſaying: Peraduenture the handes of Zebee and Salmana are in thy handes, and therfote thou deſireſt that we geue bread to the men that be wearie, and are fainte.
label: Judges

text: He tooke therfore the ancientes of the citie, and thornes and briers of the deſert, and tore them with the ſame, and cut the men of Soccoth into pieces.
label: Judges

text: The tower alſo of Phanuel he ouerthrew, killing the inhabitantes of the citie.
label: Judges

text: And he ſaid to Zebee and Salmana: What manner of men were they, whom you ſlew in Thabor? Who anſwared: Like vnto thee, and one of them as it were the ſonne of a king.
label: Judges

text: To whom he anſwered: They were my brethren, the ſonnes of my mother. Our Lord liueth, that if you had ſaued them, I would not kil you.
label: Judges

text: And he ſaid to Iether his eldeſt ſonne: Ariſe, and kil them. Who drew not out his ſword: for he was afraid, becauſe he was yet a boy.
label: Judges

text: And Zebee and Salmana ſaid: Doe thou riſe, and runne vpon vs: becauſe acording to his age is the ſtrength of a man. Gedeon roſe vp, and ſlew Zebee and Salmana: and he tooke the ornamentes and boſſes, wherwith the neckes of kinges camels are wont to be adorned.
label: Judges

text: And al the men of Iſrael ſaid to Gedeon: Rule thou ouer vs, and thy ſonne, and thy ſonnes ſonne: becauſe thou haſt deliuered vs from the hand of Madian.
label: Judges

text: To whom he ſaid: I wil not rule ouer you, neither shal my ſonne rule ouer you, but our Lord shal rule ouer you.
label: Judges

text: And he ſaid to them: One petition I requeſt of you: Geue me the earlettes of your praye. For the Iſmalites were accuſtomed to haue golden earlettes.
label: Judges

text: Who anſwered: we wil geue them moſt willingly. And ſpreading a mantel on the ground, they caſt on it the earlettes of the praye:
label: Judges

text: and the weight of the earlettes that he deſired, was a thouſand fiue hundred ſicles of gold, beſides the ornamentes, and iewels, and purple veſture, which the kinges of Madian were wont to vſe, and beſides the golden chaines of the camels,
label: Judges

text: And Gedeon made therof an Ephod, and put it in his citie Ephra. And al Iſrael did fornicate in it, and it became a ruine to Gedeon and to al his houſe.
label: Judges

text: But Madian was humbled before the children of Iſrael, neither could they any more lift vp their neckes: but the land reſted for fourtie yeares, wherin Gedeon ruled.
label: Judges

text: Ierobaal therfore the ſonne of Ioas went, and dwelt in his owne houſe:
label: Judges

text: and he had ſeuentie ſonnes, which came out of his rhigh, becauſe he had manie wiues.
label: Judges

text: And his concubine, which he had in Sichem, bare him a ſonne named Abimelec.
label: Judges

text: And Gedeon the ſonne of Ioas died in a good old age, & was buried in the ſepulchre of his father in Ephra of the familie of Ezri.
label: Judges

text: But after that Gedeon was dead, the children of Iſrael were auerted, and did fornicate with Baalim. And they made a couenant with Baal, that he should be their God:
label: Judges

text: neither did they remember our Lord their God, which deliuered them out of the handes of al their enemies round about:
label: Judges

text: neither did they mercie with the houſe of Ierobaal Gedeon, according to al the benefites that he had done to Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: AND Abimelech the ſonne of Ierobaal went into Sichem to his mothers brethren and ſpake to them, and to al the kinred of the houſe of his mothers father, ſaying:
label: Judges

text: Speake to al the men of Sichem: whether is better for you, that ſeuentie men haue dominion ouer you al the ſonnes of Ierobaal, or that one man haue dominion ouer you? and withal conſider that I am your bone, and your flesh.
label: Judges

text: And his mothers brethren ſpake of him to al the men of Sichem, al theſe wordes, and inclined their hartes after Abimelech, ſaying: He is our brother.
label: Judges

text: And they gaue him ſeuentie weight of ſiluer out of the temple of Baalberit. Who hyred therewith vnto him ſelf needie men and vagaboundes, and they folowed him.
label: Judges

text: And he came into his fathers houſe in Ephra, and murdered his brethren the ſonnes of Ierobaal ſeuentie men, vpon one ſtone: and there remayned Ioatham the youngeſt ſonne of Ierobaal, and was hidde.
label: Judges

text: And al the men of Sichem aſſembled together al the families of the citie of Mello: and they went & made Abimelech king, beſide the oke, that ſtood in Sichem.
label: Judges

text: Which being told to Ioatham, he went, and ſtoode in the toppe of mount Garizim: and lifting vp his voice, he cried, and ſaid: Heare me ye men of Sichem, ſo as God may heare you.
label: Judges

text: The trees went to anointe a king ouer them: and they ſaid to the oliue tree: Reigne ouer vs.
label: Judges

text: Which anſwered: Can I forſake my fatnes, which both goddes do vſe, and men, and come to be promoted among the trees?
label: Judges

text: And the trees ſaid to the figge tree: Come, and take the kingdome ouer vs.
label: Judges

text: Which anſwered them: Can I forſake my ſweetenes, and my moſt ſweete fruites, and go to be promoted among the other trees?
label: Judges

text: And the trees ſpake to the vine: Come, and reigne ouer vs.
label: Judges

text: Which anſwered them: Can I forſake my wine, that chereth God and men, & be promoted among the other trees?
label: Judges

text: And the trees ſaid to the rhamnus: Come, and reigne ouer vs.
label: Judges

text: Who anſwered them: If in deede you make me your king, Come, and reſt vnder my shadow: but if you meane it not, let there fyre iſſue forth of the rhamnus, and deuoure the ceders of Libanus.
label: Judges

text: Now therfore, if you haue wel, and without ſinne appointed Abimelech king ouer you, and haue dealt wel with Ierobaal, and with his houſe, and haue requitted him the like for his benefites, who fought for you,
label: Judges

text: and put his life in dangers, that he might deliuer you from the hand of Madian,
label: Judges

text: who now are riſen againſt my fathers houſe, and haue killed his ſonnes ſeuentie men vpon one ſtone, and haue made Abimelech the ſonne of his handmaide king ouer the inhabitantes of Sichem, becauſe he is your brother.
label: Judges

text: If therfore you haue dealt wel, and without fault with Ierobaal, and his houſe, reioyſe this day in Abimelech, and reioyſe he in you.
label: Judges

text: But if vniuſtly: let there fyre iſſue forth from him, and conſume the inhabitantes of Sichem, and towne of Mello: and let there fire goe forth from the men of Sichem, and from the towne of Mello, and deuoure Abimelech.
label: Judges

text: Which thinges when he had ſaid, he fled, and went into Bera: and dwelt there for feare of Abimelech his brother.
label: Judges

text: Abimelech therfore reigned ouet Iſrael three yeares.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord ſent a verie euil ſpirit betwen Abimelech and the inhabitantes of Sichem: Who began to deteſt him,
label: Judges

text: and to lay the wickednes of the murdering of the ſeuentie ſonnes of Ierobaal, and the sheading of their bloud vpon Abimelech their brother, and vpon the reſt of the princes of the Sichimites, that had holpen him.
label: Judges

text: And they ſette an ambuſhment againſt him on the toppe of the mountaines: and whiles they taryed for his coming, they committed robberies, taking prayes of them that paſſed by: and it was told Abimelech.
label: Judges

text: And Gaal the ſonne of Obed came with his brethen, and paſſed into Sichem. At whoſe coming the inhabitantes of Sichem taking courage,
label: Judges

text: iſſued forth into the fieldes, waſting the vineyardes, and treading the grapes: and gathering companies of muſicions went into the temple of their god, and in the bankettes and cuppes curſed Abimelech,
label: Judges

text: Gaal the ſonne of Obed crying: Who is Abimelech, and what is Sichem, that we should ſerue him? Is he not the ſonne of Ierobaal, and hath made Zebul his ſeruant prince ouer the men of Emor the father of Sichem? Why then shal we ſerue him?
label: Judges

text: would God that ſome man would geue this people vnder my hand, that I might take Abimelech out of the way. And ſome ſaid to Abimelech: Gather together a multitude of an armie, and come.
label: Judges

text: For Zebul the prince of the citie, hearing the wordes of Gaal the ſonne of Obed, was very wrath,
label: Judges

text: and ſent meſſengers ſecretely to Abimelech, ſaying: Behold, Gaal the ſonne of Obed is come into Sichem with his brethren, and rayſeth the citie againſt thee
label: Judges

text: Ariſe therfore in the night with the people, that is with thee, and lie hidde in the field:
label: Judges

text: and betimes in the morning at ſunne ryſing, ſette vpon the citie. And when he iſſueth forth againſt thee with his people, do to him what thou shalt be able.
label: Judges

text: Abimelech therfore aroſe with al his armie in the night, and laide ambuſhementes nere to Sichem in foure places.
label: Judges

text: And Gaal the ſonne of Obed went forth, & ſtoode in the entrance of the gate of the citie. And Abimelech roſe, and al his armie with him from the place of the ambushmentes.
label: Judges

text: And when Gaal had ſeene the people, he ſaid to Zebul: Behold a multitude cometh downe from the mountaines. To whom he anſwered: Thou ſeeſt the shadowes of the mountaines as it were heades of men, and with this errour thou art deceiued.
label: Judges

text: Againe Gaal ſaid: Behold there cometh downe people from the nauel of the land, and one trouppe cometh by the way, that looketh to the oke.
label: Judges

text: To whom Zebul ſaid: Where is now thy mouth, wherwith thou didſt ſpeake? Who is Abimelech that we should ſerue him? Is not this the people, which thou didſt deſpiſe? Goe forth, and fight againſt him.
label: Judges

text: Gaal therfore went, the people of the Sichimites looking on, and fought againſt Abimelech,
label: Judges

text: who purſewed him fleeing, and driue him into the citie: and there were ſlaine of his part manie, vnto the gate of the citie:
label: Judges

text: and Abimelech ſate in Ruma: but Zebul expelled Gaal, and his companions out of the citie, neither did he ſuffer them to abide in it.
label: Judges

text: Therfore the day folowing the people went forth into the field. Which being told to Abimelech,
label: Judges

text: he tooke his armie, and diuided it into three troupes, ſetting ambushmentes in the fieldes. And ſeeing that the people came out of the citie, he aroſe, & ſet vpon them
label: Judges

text: with his owne troupe, oppugning and beſieging the citie: and two troupes ſcattered through the field purſewed the aduerſaries.
label: Judges

text: Moreouer Abimelech al that day oppugned the citie: which he tooke, & killed the inhabitantes therof, and deſtroyed it, ſo that he ſowed ſalt in it.
label: Judges

text: Which when they had heard that dwelt in the towre of Sichem, they entered into the temple of their god Berith, where they had made a couenant with him, and therof the place had taken his name, which was exceding wel fenſed.
label: Judges

text: Abimelech alſo hearing that rhe men of the towre of Sichem were gathered together,
label: Judges

text: he went vp into mount Selmon with al his people: and taking an axe, he cut of the bough of a tree, and laying it on his ſhoulder & carying it, he ſaid to his companions: That which you ſee me do, doe ye out of hand.
label: Judges

text: They therfore cutting of boughes from the trees, euerie man as faſt as he could, folowed their captaine. Who compaſſing che forte burnt it: and ſo it came to paſſe, that with the ſmoke and the fyre a thouſand perſons were ſlaine, men and wemen together, of the inhabitantes of the towre of Sichem.
label: Judges

text: And Abimelech departing thence came to the towne of Thebes, which compaſſing he beſieged with his armie.
label: Judges

text: And there was in the middes of the citie an high towre, to the which were fled both men and wemen together, and al the princes of the citie, the gate being shut very ſtrongly, and they ſtanding vpon the batlementes of the towre by the bulwarkes.
label: Judges

text: And Abimelech coming nere the towre, fought manfully: and approching to the doore, endeuoured to put fire vnder it:
label: Judges

text: and behold one woman caſting from aboue a peece of a milſtone, dashed it againſt the head of Abimelech, and brake his brayne.
label: Judges

text: Who called by and by his eſquire, and ſaid to him: Draw out thy ſword, and ſtrike me: leſt perhaps it be ſaid that I was ſlaine of a woman. Who doing as he was commanded ſlew him.
label: Judges

text: And when he was dead, al that were with him of Iſrael, returned into their ſeates:
label: Judges

text: and God repayed the euil, that Abimelech had done againſt his father, killing his ſeuentie brethren.
label: Judges

text: The Sichemites were alſo rewarded for that which they had wrought, and the curſe of Ioatham the ſonne of Ierobaal came vpon them.
label: Judges

text: AFTER Abimelech there aroſe Ruler in Iſrael Thola the ſonne of Phua the vncle of Abimelech, a man of Iſſachar, which dwelt in Samir of mount Ephraim:
label: Judges

text: and iudged Iſrael three and twentie yeares, and died and was buried in Samir.
label: Judges

text: After him ſucceded Iair the Galaadite, who iudged Iſrael for two and twentie yeares,
label: Judges

text: hauing thirtie ſonnes ſitting vpon thirtie aſſe coltes, & princes of thirtie cities, which of his name were called Hauoth Iair, that is, the townes of Iair, vntil this preſent day in the Land of Galaad.
label: Judges

text: And Iair died; and was buried in the place, which is called Camon.
label: Judges

text: But the children of Iſrael ioyning new ſinnes to their old, did euil in the ſight of our Lord, & ſerued the Idols, Baalim and Aſtaroth, & the goddes of Syria and of Sidon and of Moab and of the children of Ammon and of the Philiſthimes: and they left our Lord, and did not ſerue him.
label: Judges

text: Againſt whom our Lord being wrath, deliuered them into the handes of the Philiſthijms and of the children of Ammon.
label: Judges

text: And they were afflicted, and ſore opreſſed for eightene yeares, al that dwelt beyond Iordan in the Land of the Amorrheite, which is in Galaad:
label: Judges

text: in ſo much, that the children of Ammon paſſing ouer Iordan, waſted Iudas and Beniamin and Ephraim: and Iſrael was afflicted exceedingly.
label: Judges

text: And crying to our Lord, they ſaid: We haue ſinned to thee, becauſe we haue forſaken our Lord God & haue ſerued Baalim.
label: Judges

text: To whom our Lord ſpake: Haue not the Ægyptians and the Ammorrheites, and the children of Ammon and the Philiſthijms,
label: Judges

text: the Sidonians alſo and Amalech and Chanaan oppreſſed you, & you cried to me, and I deliuered you out of their hand?
label: Judges

text: And yet you haue forſaken me, and haue worſhipped ſtrange goddes: therfore I wil not adde to deliuer you any more:
label: Judges

text: goe and inuocate the goddes which you haue choſen: let them deliuer you in the time of diſtreſſe.
label: Judges

text: And the children of Iſrael ſaid to our Lord: We haue ſinned, render to vs whatſoeuer pleaſeth thee: only now deliuer vs.
label: Judges

text: In ſaying which thinges, they threw away out of their coaſtes al the idols of ſtrange goddes, and ſerued our Lord God: who ſorowed for their miſeries.
label: Judges

text: Therfore the children of Ammon crying together pitcht their tentes in Galaad: againſt whom the children of Iſrael being aſſembled camped in Maſpha.
label: Judges

text: And the princes of Galaad ſaid euerie one to their neighbours: Who of vs shal firſt beginne to fight againſt the children of Ammon, ſhal be the duke of the people of Galaad.
label: Judges

text: THERE was at that time Iephte the Galaadite a moſt valiant man and a warrier, the ſonne of a woman that was an harlot, who was borne of Galaad.
label: Judges

text: And Galaad had a wife of whom he had ſonnes: who after they were growen, caſt out Iepthte, ſaying: Thou canſt not be heyre in the houſe of our father, becauſe thou art borne of an other mother.
label: Judges

text: Whom he fleeing and auoyding, dwelt in the Land of Tob: and there were gathered to him needie men, and theeuish, and folowed him as their prince.
label: Judges

text: In thoſe dayes the children of Aminon fought againſt Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: who preſſing ſore vpon them, the ancientes of Galaad went to take Iephte out of the Land of Tob to helpe them:
label: Judges

text: and they ſaied to him: Come and be our prince, and fight againſt the children of Ammon.
label: Judges

text: To whom he anſwered: Are not you they that hated me, and caſt me out of my fathers houſe, and now are come to me forced by neceſſitie.
label: Judges

text: And the princes of Galaad ſaid to Iephte: For this cauſe be we now come to thee, that thou goe forth with vs, and fight againſt the children of Ammon, and be the captaine of al that dwell in Galaad.
label: Judges

text: Iephte alſo ſaid to them: If you be come to me ſincerly, that I should fight for you againſt the children of Ammon, and if our Lord deliuer them into my handes, shal I be your prince?
label: Judges

text: Who anſwered him: Our Lord which heareth theſe thinges, him ſelfe is mediatour and witnes that we wil doe as we haue promiſed.
label: Judges

text: Iephte therfore went with the princes of Galaad, and al the people made him their prince. And Iephte ſpake al his wordes before our Lord in Maſpha.
label: Judges

text: And he ſent meſſengers to the king of the children of Ammon, which should ſay in his perſon: What is betwen me and thee, that thou art come againſt me, to waſt my Land?
label: Judges

text: To whom he anſwered: Becauſe Iſrael tooke my land, when he aſcended out of Ægypt, from the coaſts of Arnon vnto Iaboc and Iordan: now therfore with peace reſtore the ſame to me.
label: Judges

text: By whom Iephte againe ſent word, and commanded them that they should ſay to the king of Ammon:
label: Judges

text: Thus ſayth Iephte: Iſrael did not take the Land of Moab, nor the Land of the children of Ammon:
label: Judges

text: but when they aſcended out of Ægypt, he walked through the deſert vnto the Readſea, and came into Cades.
label: Judges

text: And he ſent meſſengers to the king of Edom, ſaying: Suffer me that I may paſſe through thy land. Who would not condeſcend to his requeſtes. He ſent alſo to the king of Moab, who alſo him ſelfe contemned to geue paſſage. He abode therfore in Cades,
label: Judges

text: and compaſſed the Land of Edom at the ſide, and the land of Moab: and came againſt the Eaſt quarter of the Land of Moab, and camped beyond Arnon: neither would he enter the boundes of Moab: for Arnon is the border of the Land of Moab.
label: Judges

text: Iſrael therfore ſent meſſengers to Sehon the king of the Ammorrheites, who dwelt in Heſebon, and they ſaid to him: Suffer me to paſſe through thy land vnto the riuer.
label: Judges

text: Who alſo him ſelfe deſpiſing the wordes of Iſrael, ſuffered him not to paſſe through his borders: but gathering an infinite multitude went forth againſt him into Iaſa, and reſiſted ſtrongly.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord deliuered him into the handes of Iſrael with al his armie, and he ſtroke him, and poſſeſſed al the Land of the Ammortheite the inhabiter of that countrie,

text: and al the coaſtes therof from Arnon vnto Iaboc, & from the wildernes vnto Iordan.
label: Judges

text: Our Lord therfore the God of Iſrael ſubuerted the Amorrheite, his people of Iſrael fighting againſt him, and wilt thou now poſſeſſe his land?
label: Judges

text: Are not thoſe thinges which Chamos thy God poſſeſſed, dew to thee by right? But the thinges that our Lord God hath obteyned conquerour, shal come to our poſſeſſion:
label: Judges

text: vnleſſe perhaps thou be better then Balac the ſonne of Sephor the king of Moab: or canſt shew, that he wrangled againſt Iſrael, and fought againſt him,
label: Judges

text: when he dwelt in Heſebon, and in the litle townes therof, and in Aroer, and the townes therof, or in al the cities nere Iordan, for three hundred yeares. Wherfore haue you ſo long attempted nothing for reclaime?
label: Judges

text: Therfore I doe not ſinne againſt thee, but thou doeſt euil againſt me, denouncing me vniuſt warres. Our Lord be iudge the arbiter of this day betwen Iſrael, and betwen the children of Ammon.
label: Judges

text: And the king of the children of Ammon would not harken to the wordes of Iephte, which he ſent him by the meſſengers.
label: Judges

text: Therfore the ſpirite of our Lord came vpon Iephte, and circuiting Galaad, and Manaſſes, Maſpha alſo of Galaad, and thence paſſing to the children of Ammon,
label: Judges

text: he vowed a vow to our Lord, ſaying: If thou wilt deliuer the children of Ammon into my handes,
label: Judges

text: whoſoeuer shal firſt come forth out of the doores of my houſe, and shal meete me returning with peace from the children of Ammon, him wil I offer an holocauſte to our Lord.

text: And Iephte paſſed to the children of Ammon, to fight againſt them: whom our Lord deliuered into his handes.
label: Judges

text: and he ſtroke from Aroer til thou come to Mennith, twentie cities, and as farre as Abel, which is ſette with vineyardes, with a very great plague. and the children of Ammon were humbled by the children of Iſrael
label: Judges

text: But Iephte returning into Maſpha to his houſe, his onlie begotten daughter mette him with tymbrels and daunces. for he had not other children.
label: Judges

text: Whom when he ſaw, he rent his garmentes, and ſaid: Wo is me my daughter thou haſt deceiued me, and thy ſelf art deceiued: for I haue opened my mouth to our Lord, and I can doe no other thing.
label: Judges

text: To whom ſhe anſwered: My father, if thou haſt opened thy mouth to our Lord, do vnto me whatſoeuer thou haſt promiſed, the reuenge and victorie of thyne enemies being granted to thee.
label: Judges

text: And she ſaid to her father: This only graunt me which I deſire: Suffer me that two monethes I may goe about the mountaines, and bewayle my virginitie with my felowes.
label: Judges

text: To whom he anſwered: Goe. And he diſmiſſed her two monethes. And when she was gone with her felowes and companions, she mourned her virginitie in the mountaines.
label: Judges

text: And the two monethes being expired, she returned to her father, and he did to her as he had vowed, who knew not man. Thence forth a fashion in Iſrael, and a cuſtome was kept:

text: that after the compaſſe of a yeare the daughters of Iſrael aſſemble together, and mourne the daughter of Iephte the Galaadite foure dayes.
label: Judges

text: BVT behold in Ephraim there aroſe a ſedition. For they paſſing againſt the North, ſaid to Iephte: Going to fight againſt the children of Ammon, why wouldſt thou not cal vs, that we might goe with thee? Therfore we wil burne thy houſe.
label: Judges

text: To whom he anſwered: I and my people were at great ſtrife againſt the children of Ammon: and I called you, that you should ayde me, and you would not doe it.
label: Judges

text: Which I ſeeing put my life in myne owne handes, and paſſed to the children of Ammon, and our Lord deliuered them into my handes. What haue I deſerued, that you riſe againſt me in battel.
label: Judges

text: Therfore al the men of Galaad being called to him, he fought againſt Ephraim: and the men of Galaad ſtroke Ephraim, becauſe he had ſaid: Galaad is a fugitiue of Ephraim, and dwelleth in the middes of Ephraim and Manaſſes.
label: Judges

text: And the Galaadites tooke the fordes of Iordan, by the which Ephraim was to returne. And when there had come to the ſame one of the number of Ephraim, fleeing, and had ſaid: I beſech you let me paſſe: The Galaadites ſaid to him: Art thou not an Ephraite? Who ſaying: I am not:
label: Judges

text: they asked him: Say then Schibboleth, which is interpreted an Eare of corne. Who anſwered, Sibboleth, not being able by the ſame letter to expreſſe, an eare of corne. label: Judges

text: Therfore Iephte the Galaadite iudged Iſrael ſix yeares: and he died, and was buried in his citie of Galaad.
label: Judges

text: After him Abeſan of Bethlehem iudged Iſrael:
label: Judges

text: who had thirtie ſonnes, and as manie daughters, which he ſending abrode, gaue to huſbandes, and tooke wiues for his ſonnes of the ſame number, bringing them into his houſe. Who iudged Iſrael ſeuen yeares:
label: Judges

text: and died and was buried in Bethlehem.
label: Judges

text: To whom ſucceeded Ahialon a Zabulonite: and he iudged Iſrael ten yeares:
label: Judges

text: and he died and was buried in Zabulon.
label: Judges

text: After him Abdon iudged Iſrael, the ſonne of Illel a Pharathonite:
label: Judges

text: who had fourtie ſonnes, and of them thirtie nephewes, mounting vpon ſeuentie aſſe coltes, and he iudged Iſrael eight yeares:
label: Judges

text: and he died, and was buried in, Pharathon of the Land of Ephraim, in the mount of Amalec.
label: Judges

text: AND againe the children of Iſrael did euil in the ſight of our Lord: who deliuered them into the handes of the Philiſthimes fourtie yeares.
label: Judges

text: And there was a certaine man of Saraa, and of the ſtocke of Dan, named Manue, hauing a wife barren.

text: To whom an Angel of our Lord appeared, and ſaid to her: Thou art barren and without children: but thou shalt conceiue & beare a ſonne:

text: beware therfore that thou drinke not wine & ſicer, nor eate any vncleane thing:
label: Judges

text: becauſe thou shalt conceiue and beare a ſonne, whoſe head the raſer shal not touch: for he shal be a Nazareite of God, from his infancie, and from his mothers wombe, and he shal beginne to deliuer Iſrael from the handes of the Philiſtijmes.
label: Judges

text: Who when she was come to her huſband, ſaid to him: A man of God came to me, hauing an Angelical countenance, exceeding terrible. Whom when I had asked, who he was, and whence he came, and by what name he was called, he would not tel me:
label: Judges

text: but this he anſwered: Behold thou shalt conceiue and beare a ſonne: beware thou drinke not wine, nor ſicer, and that thou eate not any vncleane thing: for the child shal be the Nazareite of God from his infancie, and from his mothers wombe vntil the day of his death.
label: Judges

text: Manue therfore prayed to our Lord, and ſaid: I beſech thee ô Lord, that the man of God, whom thou didſt ſend, may come againe, and teach vs what we ought to doe concerning the child, that shal be borne.
label: Judges

text: And our Lord heard Manue praying, and the Angel of our Lord appeared againe to his wife ſitting in the field. but Manue her huſband was not with her. Who when ſhe had ſeene the Angel,
label: Judges

text: haſtened, and ranne to her huſband: and she told him, ſaying: Behold the man hath appeared to me, whom I ſaw before.
label: Judges

text: Who roſe, and folowed his wife: and comming to the man, ſaid to him: Art thou he that didſt ſpeake to the woman? And he anſwered: I am.
label: Judges

text: To whom Manue, when, ſayd he, thy word shal be fulfilled, what wilt thou that the child doe? or from what shal he keepe him ſelf?
label: Judges

text: And the Angel of our Lord ſaid to Manue: From al thinges, which I haue ſpoken to thy wife, let him refraine him ſelf:
label: Judges

text: and whatſoeuer groweth of the vineyard, let him not eate: wine and ſicer let him not drinke, let him not eate any vncleane thing: and whatſoeuer I haue commanded her, let him fulfil and keepe.
label: Judges

text: And Manue ſaid to the Angel of our Lord: I beſech thee that thou condeſcend to my petitions, and let vs make to thee a kidde of goates.
label: Judges

text: To whom the Angel anſwered: If thou conſtraine me, I wil not eate thy breade: but if thou wilt make holocauſt, offer it to our Lord. And Manue knew not that it was an Angel of our Lord.
label: Judges

text: And he ſaid to him: What is thy name, that, if thy word shal be fulfilled, we may honour thee?
label: Judges

text: To whom he anſwered: Why askeſt thou my name, which is merueilous?
label: Judges

text: Manue therfore tooke a kidde of the goates, and the libamentes, and put them vpon a rocke, offering to our Lord, who doeth meruelous thinges: and he and his wife looked on.
label: Judges

text: And when the flame of the altar aſcended into heauen, the Angel of our Lord aſcended together in the flame. Which when Manue and his wife had ſeene, they fel flatte on the ground,
label: Judges

text: and the Angel of our Lord appeared to them no more. And forthwith Manue vnderſtood that it was an Angel of our Lord,
label: Judges

text: and he ſaid to his wife: Dying we shal die, becauſe we haue ſeene God.
label: Judges

text: To whom his wife anſwered: If our Lord would haue killed vs, he would not haue taken of our handes holocauſtes and libamentes, neither would he haue shewed vs al theſe thinges, nor haue told vs theſe thinges that are to come.
label: Judges

text: She therfore bare a ſonne, and called his name Samſon. And the child grewe, and our Lord bleſſed him.
label: Judges

text: And the Spirit of our Lord beganne to be with him in the campe of Dan betwixt Saraa and Eſthaol.
label: Judges

label: Judges

text: he went vp, and told his father and his mother, ſaying: I ſaw a woman in Thamnatha of the daughters of the Philiſthijms: which I beſech you take for me to wife.
label: Judges

text: To whom his father and mother ſaid: Is there not a woman among the daughters of thy bretheren, and in al my people, that thou wilt take a wife of the Philiſthijms, which are vncircumciſed? And Samſon ſaid to his father: Take this for me: becauſe she hath pleaſed mine eyes.
label: Judges

text: But his parentes knew not that the thing was done of our Lord, and he ſought an occaſion againſt the Philiſthims. for at that time the Philiſthiims had dominion ouer Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: Samſon therfore went downe with his father and mother into Thamnatha. And when they were come to the vineyardes of the towne, there appeared a lions whelpe cruel, and roaring, and mette him.
label: Judges

text: And the Spirit of our Lord came vpon Samſon, and he tore the lion, as if he ſhould teare a kidde into peeces, hauing nothing at al in his hand: and this thing he would not tel to his father and mother.
label: Judges

text: And he went downe and ſpake to the woman, that had pleaſed his eies.
label: Judges

text: And after ſome dayes returning to take her, he went aſide to ſee the carcaſſe of the lion, and behold there was a ſwarme of bees in the mouth of the lion and a honie combe.
label: Judges

text: Which when he had taken in his handes, he did eate in the way: and coming to his father and mother, he gaue them part, who alſo them ſelues did eate: neither would he for al that tel them, that he had taken the honie from the bodie of the lion.
label: Judges

text: His father therfore went downe to the woman, and made his ſonne Samſon a feaſt. for ſo yong men were accuſtomed to doe.

text: When the citizens therfore of that place had ſeene him, they gaue him thirtie companions to be with him.
label: Judges

text: To whom Samſon ſpake: I wil propoſe you a riddle, which if you shal ſolue me within the ſeuen dayes of the feaſt, I wil geue you thirtie ſindones, and as many coates:
label: Judges

text: but if you shal not be able to ſolue it, you shal geue me thirtie ſindones, and cotes of the ſame number. Who anſwered him: Propound the riddle, that we may heare it.
label: Judges

text: And he ſaid to them: Out of the eater came forth meate, and out of the ſtrong iſſued forth ſweetenes. neither could they for three dayes ſolue the propoſition.
label: Judges

text: And when the ſeuenth day was come, they ſaid to the wife of Samſon: Speake to thy husband, and vſe perſwaſion to him, that he tel thee what the riddle ſignifieth. label: Judges

text: Who shed teares before Samſon, and complained ſaying: Thou hateſt me, and loueſt me not: therfore the probleme, which thou haſt propounded to the ſonnes of my people, thou wilt not expound to me. But he anſwered: I would not tel it to my father and mother: and can I tel it to thee?
label: Judges

text: The ſeuen daies therfore of the feaſt she wept before him: and at the length the ſeuenth day for that she moleſted him he expounded it. Who immediately told her countrie men.
label: Judges

text: And they told it him the ſeuenth day before the going downe of the ſunne: What is ſweeter then honie, and what ſtronger then a lyon? Who ſaid to them: If you had not ploughed with my hayfer, you had not found out my propoſition.
label: Judges

text: The Spirit therfore of our Lord came vpon him, and he went downe to Aſcalon, and ſtroke there thirtie men, whoſe garmentes being taken away he gaue to them, that had ſolued the probleme. And being exceding wrath he went vp into his fathers houſe:

text: but his wife tooke a husband one of his freindes and bridal companions.
label: Judges

text: AND after a certaine time, when the dayes of wheate harueſt were at hand, Samſon came, meaning to viſite his wife, and he brought her a kidde of goates. And when he would enter into her chamber as he was wont, her father prohibited him, ſaying:
label: Judges

text: I thought that thou hadſt hated her, and therfore I deliuered her to thy freind: but she hath a ſiſter, which is yonger & fayrer then she, let this be thy wife in ſteade of her.

text: To whom Samſon anſwered: From this day there shal be no fault in me againſt the Philiſthimes: for I wil doe you euils.

text: And he went, and caught three hundred foxes, and he coupled them tayle to tayle, and tyed fyrebrandes in the middes:
label: Judges

text: which kindling with fyre, he let them goe, that they might runne abroade hither and thither. Who immediately went on into the corne of the Philiſthimes. label: Judges

text: And the Philiſthijmes ſaid: Who hath done this thing? To whom it was ſaid: Samſon the ſonne in law of the Thamnathate: becauſe he tooke his wife, and gaue her to an other, he hath wrought theſe thinges. And the Philiſthims went vp, and burnt both the woman and her father.
label: Judges

text: To whom Samſon ſaid: Although you haue done theſe thinges, notwithſtanding yet wil I require reuenge of you, and then I wil reſt.
label: Judges

text: And he ſtroke them with a great plague, ſo that aſtonied they laid the calfe of the leg vpon the thigh. And going downe he dwelt in the caue of the rocke Etam.
label: Judges

label: Judges

text: And they of the tribe of Iuda ſaid to them: Why are you come vp againſt vs? Who anſwered: That we may bind Samſon, we are come, and may repay him the thinges that he hath wrought againſt vs.
label: Judges

text: There went downe therfore three thouſand men of Iuda, to the caue of the flint Etam, and ſaid to Samſon: knoweſt not thou that the Philiſthijms reigne ouer vs? why wouldeſt thou doe this thing? To whom he ſaid: As they did to me ſo haue I done to them.
label: Judges

text: To bind thee, quoth they, we are come, and to deliuer thee into the handes of the Philiſthijms. To whom Samſon: Sweare, quoth he, & promiſe me that you kil me not.

text: They ſaid: We wil not kil thee, but wil deliuer the bound. And they bound him with two new cordes, and tooke him from the rocke Etam.

text: Who when he was come to the place of the Iawe-bone and the Philiſthijms shouting were come againſt him, the Spirit of our Lord fel vpon him: and as flax is wont to be conſumed at the ſauour of fyre, ſo the bandes wherwith he was bound, were diſſipated and looſed.

text: And finding a iawe bone, to witte, the iawe bone of an aſſe, which lay there, catching it, he ſlewe therwith a thouſand men,

text: and ſaid: In the iawe bone of an aſſe, in the iawe of the colt of she aſſes haue I deſtroyed them, and haue ſtrooke a thouſand men.

text: And when he had ended theſe wordes ſinging, he threw the iaw bone out of his hand, and called the name of that place Ramathlechi, which is interpreted the lifting vp of the iawbone.

text: And being very thirſtie, he cried to our Lord, and ſaid: Thou haſt geuen in the hand of thy ſeruant this very great ſaluation and victorie: and behold I die for thriſt, and shal fal into the handes of the vncircumciſed.
label: Judges

text: Our Lord therfore opened a great tooth in the iawe of the aſſe, & there iſſued out of it waters. which being drunke, he refreshed his ſpirit, and receiued ſtrength againe. Therfore the name of that place was called: The fountaine of him that inuocated from the iawbone, vntil this preſent day.
label: Judges

text: And he iudged Iſrael in the daies of the Philiſthijms twentie yeares.
label: Judges

label: Judges

text: But Samſon ſlept vntil midnigt, and then ariſing he tooke both the leaues of the gate, with their poſtes and locke, and laying them on his shoulders, caried them to the toppe of the mountaine, which looketh toward Hebron.

text: After theſe thinges he loued a woman, which dwelt in Valley Sorec, and she was called Dalila.
label: Judges

text: And the princes of the Philiſthiims came to her, and ſaid: Deceiue him, and learne of him, wherein he hath ſo great ſtrength, and how we may be able to ouercome him, and being bound to afflict him. which if thou shalt doe, we wil geue thee euerie one a thouſand and an hundred peeces of ſiluer.
label: Judges

text: Dalila therfore ſpake to Samſon: Tel me, I beſech thee, wherein thy greateſt ſtrength is, and what it is wherewith being bound thou canſt not breake forth.

text: To whom Samſon anſwered: If I shal be bound with ſeuen cordes of ſinewes not yet drie, and moyſte as yet, I shal be weake as other men.

text: And the princes of the Philiſthimes brought vnto her ſeuen cordes, as he had ſaid: with the which she bound him,
label: Judges

text: ambushementes lying ſecretely in wayte neere her, and in the chamber expecting the end of the thing, and she cried to him: The Philiſthijms vpon thee Samſon. label: Judges

text: And Dalila ſaid to him: Behold thou haſt deluded me, and haſt ſpoken falſe: now at the leaſt tel me wherwith thou mayeſt be bound.
label: Judges

text: To whom he anſwered: If I shal be bound with new cordes, that were neuer occupied, I shal be weake, and like to other men.
label: Judges

text: With the which Dalila againe bound him, and cried: The Philiſthijmes vpon thee Samſon, ambushementes being prepared in the chamber. Who did ſo breake the bandes as threades of linnen cloth.
label: Judges

text: And Dalila ſaid to him againe: How long deceiueſt thou me, and ſpeakeſt falſe? Shew wherewith thou mayeſt be bound. To whom Samſon anſwered: If thou platte ſeuen heares of my head with a heare laſe, and faſten a nayle tyed round about them in the ground, I shal be weake.
label: Judges

text: Which when Dalila had done, she ſaid to him: The Philiſthijms vpon thee Samſon. Who ryſing vp from ſleepe drew out the nayle with the heares and the heare laſe.
label: Judges

text: And Dalila ſaid to him: How doeſt thou ſay that thou loueſt me, whereas thy mind is not with me? Theſe three times thou haſt lied to me, & wouldeſt not tel wherein thy greateſt ſtrength is.
label: Judges

text: And when she moleſted him, and continually hong vpon him for many daies, not geuing him ſpace to reſt, his ſoule faynted, and was wearied euen vnto death.
label: Judges

text: Then opening the truth of the thing, he ſaid to her: There neuer came yron vpon my head, becauſe I am a Nazareite, that is to ſay, conſecrated to God from my mothers wombe: if my head shal be shauen, my ſtrength shal depart from me, and I shal fayle, and shal be as other men.
label: Judges

text: And she ſeing that he had confeſſed to her al his minde, ſent to the princes of the Philiſthijms and willed them: Come vp yet once more, for now he hath opened his hart to me. Who went vp taking with them the money which they had promiſed.
label: Judges

text: But she made him to ſleepe vpon her knees, and to lay his head in her boſome. And she called a barber, and shaued his ſeuen heares, and beganne to driue him away, and thruſt him from her: for immediately the ſtrungth departed from him:
label: Judges

text: and she ſaid: The Philiſthijms vpon thee Samſon. Who aryſing from ſleepe, ſaid in his minde: I wil goe forth as I did before, and wil shake my ſelf, not knowing that our Lord was departed from him.
label: Judges

text: Whom when the Philiſthijmes had apprehended, forthwith they plucked forth his eies, and led him to Gaza bound with chaynes, and being shut vp in priſon they made him grinde.
label: Judges

text: And now his heares had begone to grow againe,
label: Judges

text: and the princes of the Philiſthijms aſſembled in one, that they might immolate magnifical hoſtes to Dagon their god, and might feaſt, ſaying: Our God hath deliuered our enemie Samſon into our handes.
label: Judges

text: Which thing the people alſo ſeing, prayſed their god, and ſaid the ſame thinges: Our God hath deliuered our aduerſarie into our handes, who deſtroyed our countrie, and killed verie manie.
label: Judges

text: And reioyſing through out their bankettes, when they had now taken their good cheere, they commanded that Samſon should be called, and should play before them. Who being brought out of priſon played before them, and they made him to ſtand betwen two pillers.
label: Judges

text: Who ſaid to the ſeruant that gouerned his ſteppes: Suffer me to touch the pillers, on which al the houſe ſtayeth, and let me leane vpon them, and reſt a litle.
label: Judges

text: And the houſe was ful of men and wemen, and there were al the princes of the Philiſthijms, alſo from the roofe and higher part, about three thouſand of both ſexe beholding Samſon playing.
label: Judges

text: But he inuocating our Lord, ſaid: Lord God remember me, & reſtore now to me myne old ſtrength my God, that I may reuenge me of myne enemies, and for the loſſe of two eies may receiue one reuenge.
label: Judges

text: And taking both the pillers, on which the houſe reſted, and holding the one in his right hand, and the other in his left,
label: Judges

text: he ſaid: Let me die with the Philiſthijms. And the pillers being ſtrongly shaken, the houſe fel vpon al the princes, and the reſt of the multitude, that was there: and he killed manie moe dying, then before he had killed liuing.
label: Judges

text: And his brethren going downe and al his kindred, they tooke his bodie, and buried it betwixt Saraa and Eſthaol in the ſepulchre of his father Manue, and he iudged Iſrael twentie yeares.
label: Judges

text: THERE was at that time a certaine man of mount Ephraim named Michas,
label: Judges

text: who ſaid to his mother: The thouſand and hundred ſiluer peeces, which thou hadſt ſeparated to thy ſelfe, and concerning the which thou didſt ſweare in my hearing, behold I haue, and they are with me. To whom she ſaid: Bleſſed be my ſonne to the Lord.
label: Judges

text: He therfore rendred them to his mother, who had ſaid to him: I haue conſecrated and vowed this ſiluer to the Lord, that my ſonne may receiue it of my hand, and make a grauen and a molten (god) and now I deliuer that to thee.
label: Judges

text: He rendred them therfore to his mother: who tooke two hundred ſiluer peeces and gaue them to the ſiluerſmith, that he might make of them a grauen and a molten (god) which was in the houſe of Michas.
label: Judges

text: Who ſeparated alſo therein a litle houſe to the God, and made an Ephod, and Theraphim, that is to ſay, a prieſtlie veſtiment, and idoles: and he filled the hand of one of his ſonnes, and he became his prieſt.
label: Judges

text: In thoſe daies there was not a king in Iſrael, but euerie one did that, which ſemed right to him ſelf.
label: Judges

text: There was alſo an other yong man of Bethelem Iuda, of the kinred therof: and he was a Leuite, and dwelt there.
label: Judges

text: And going forth out of the citie of Bethelehem, he would ſeiourne whereſoeuer he should find it comodious for him. And when he was come into mount Ephraim, making his iourney, and had turned aſide a little into the houſe of Michas,
label: Judges

text: he was demanded of him whence he came. Who anſwered: I am a Leuite of Bethlehem Iuda, and I goe to dwel where I shal be able, and shal perceiue it to be profitable for me.
label: Judges

text: And Michas ſaid: Abide with me, and be to me a father and a prieſt, and I wil geue thee euerie yeare tenne ſiluer peeces, and duble liuerie, and the thinges that be neceſſarie for victual
label: Judges

text: He was content, and abode with the man, and was vnto him as one of his ſonnes.
label: Judges

text: And Michas filled his hand, and had the yong man for a prieſt with him, ſaying:
label: Judges

text: Now I know that God wil do me good hauing a prieſt of the Leuitical kinde.
label: Judges

text: IN thoſe dayes there was not a king in Iſrael, and the tribe of Dan ſought poſſeſſion for it ſelfe, that it might dwel therein: for vntil that day it had not receiued a lotte among the other tribes.
label: Judges

text: Therfore the children of Dan ſent fiue men of their ſtocke and familie moſt valiant from Saraa and Eſthaol, that they might view the land, and diligently behold it, and they ſaid to them: Goe, and conſider the land. Who going forward when they were come into mount Ephraim, and had entered into the houſe of Michas, they reſted there:
label: Judges

text: and knowing the voice of the yong man the Leuite; and vſing his lodging, they ſaid to him: Who brought thee hither? What doeſt thou here? For what cauſe wouldeſt thou come hither?
label: Judges

text: Who anſwered them: Theſe, and theſe thinges hath Michas done to me, & hath hyred me for wages to be his prieſt.
label: Judges

text: And they deſired him that he would conſult the Lord, that they might know whether they should goe on a proſperous iourney, and the thing should haue effect.
label: Judges

text: Who anſwered them: Goe in peace: The Lord regardeth your way, and the iourney that you goe.
label: Judges

text: The fiue men therfore going came to Lais, & they ſaw the people dwelling in it without any feare, according to the cuſtome of the Sidonians, ſecure and quiet, no man at al reſiſting them, & of greate riches, and ſeparated farre from Sidon and from al men.
label: Judges

text: And returning to their brethren in Saraa and Eſtaol, and asking what they had done they anſwered them:
label: Judges

text: Ariſe, and let vs goe vp to them: for we haue ſeene the Land exceding rich and plentiful: neglect not, ſlacke not: let vs goe, and poſſeſſe it, it wil be no labour.
label: Judges

text: We shal enter vnto them being ſecure, into a moſt large countrie, and our Lord wil deliuer to vs the place, wherein is penurie of nothing, of thoſe thinges that grow on the earth.
label: Judges

text: There departed therfore from the kinred of Dan, that is to ſay, from Saraa and Eſthaol ſix hundred men, furnished with warlike armour,
label: Judges

text: and going vp they taried in Cariathiarim of Iuda: which place from that time tooke the name of the Tentes of Dan, and it is at the backe of Cariathiarim.
label: Judges

text: Thence they paſſed into mount Ephraim. And when they were come to the houſe of Michas,
label: Judges

text: the fiue men, that before had been ſent to view the Land of Lais, ſaid to the reſt of their brethren: You know that in theſe houſes there is an Ephod, and Theraphim, and a grauen, and molten god: See what pleaſeth you.
label: Judges

text: And when they had turned a litle aſide, they entred into the houſe of the yong man the Leuite, which was in the houſe of Michas: and ſaluted him with peaceable wordes.
label: Judges

text: And the ſix hundred men ſo as they were armed, ſtoode before the doore.
label: Judges

text: But they, that were entred the houſe of the yong man, endeuoured to take away the grauen, the Ephod and the idols, and molten god, and the prieſt ſtoode before the doore, the ſix hundred moſt valiant men expecting not farre of.
label: Judges

text: They therfore that were entred tooke the grauen, the Ephod, the theraphim and molten god. To whom the prieſt ſaid: What doe you?
label: Judges

text: To whom they anſwered: Hold thy peace, and put thy finger vpon thy mouth and come with vs, that we may haue thee for a father, and a prieſt. Whether is better for thee, that thou be a prieſt in the houſe of one man, or in one tribe and familie in Iſrael?
label: Judges

text: Which when he had heard, he agreed to their wordes, and tooke the Ephod, and idols, and grauen god, and departed with them.
label: Judges

text: Who when they went forward, and had made the children and the cattel to goe before them, and al that was percious,
label: Judges

text: and were now farre from the houſe of Michas, the men that dwelt in the houſe of Michas crying out together folowed,
label: Judges

text: and at their backe began to shoute. Who looking backe, ſaid to Michas: What meaneſt thou? Why doeſt thou crie?
label: Judges

text: Who anſwered: My Goddes, which I made me, you haue taken away, and the prieſt, and al that I haue, and doe you ſay: What aileth thee?
label: Judges

text: And the children of Dan ſaid to him: Beware thou ſpeake no more vnto vs, and there come vnto thee men prouoked in mind, and thou with al thy houſe perish.
label: Judges

text: And ſo they went on their iourney begone. But Michas ſeing that they were ſtronger then he, returned into his houſe.
label: Judges

text: And the ſix hundred men tooke the prieſt, and the thinges which we ſpake of before, and came into Lais to a people that was quiet and ſecure, and ſtroke them in the edge of the ſword: and the citie they deliuered to fyre,
label: Judges

text: no man at al bringing them ſuccour, for that they dwelt farre from Sidon, and had with no men anie ſocietie and affayres. And the citie was ſituated in the countrie of Rohob: which building agayne they dwelt in it,
label: Judges

text: calling the name of the citie Dan, according to the name of their father, whom Iſrael had begotten, which before was called Lais.
label: Judges

text: And they ſette vp to them ſelues the grauen idol, and Ionathan the ſonne of Gerſon the ſonne of Moyſes, and his ſonnes prieſtes in the tribe of Dan, vntil the day of their captiuitie.
label: Judges

text: And the idol of Michas remayned with them al the time, that the houſe of God was in Silo. In thoſe daies there was not a king in Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: THERE was a certaine man a Leuite, dwelling on the ſide of mount Ephraim, who tooke a wife of Bethlehem Iuda:
label: Judges

text: which left him, and returned vnto her fathers houſe into Bethlehem, and abode with him foure monethes.
label: Judges

text: And her huſband folowed her, willing to be reconciled vnto her, and to ſpeake her fayre, and to bring her backe with him, hauing in his companie a ſeruant and two aſſes: who receiued him, and brought him into her fathers houſe. Which when his father in law had heard, and had ſeene him, he mette him ioyful,
label: Judges

text: and embraced the man. And the ſonne in law taried in the houſe of his father in law three daies, eating with him and drinking familiarly.
label: Judges

text: But the fourth day aryſing before day, he would depart. Whom his father in law held, and ſaid to him: Taſt firſt a litle bread, & ſtrengthen thy ſtomacke, and ſo thou shalt depart.
label: Judges

text: And they ſate together, and did eate and drinke. And the father of the yong woman ſaid to his ſonne in law: I beſech thee that thou tarie here to day, and let vs make merie together.
label: Judges

text: But he ryſing vp, beganne as if he would depart. And neuertheles with much adoe his father in law ſtayed him, and made him to tarie with him.
label: Judges

text: But when morning was come, the Leuite prepared to goe his iourney. To whom his father in law againe: I beſech thee, quoth he, that thou take a litle meate, and making thy ſelfe ſtrong, til the day be farder ſpent, afterward thou mayeſt depart. They did eate therfore together.
label: Judges

text: And the yong man aroſe, that he might ſette forward with his wife and his ſeruant. To whom his father in law ſpake againe: Conſider that the day is more declining to the weſt, and draweth nigh to euening: tarie with me to day alſo, and ſpend the day in mirth, and to morrow thou shalt depart that thou mayſt goe into thy houſe.
label: Judges

text: His ſonne in law would not condeſcend to his wordes: but forthwith went forward, and came ouer againſt Iebus, which by an other name is called Ieruſalem, leading with him two aſſes loden, and his concubine.
label: Judges

text: And now they were come nigh to Iebus and the day changed into night: & the ſeruant ſaid to his maiſter: Come, I beſech thee, let vs turne into the citie of the Iebuſeites, and tarie in it.
label: Judges

text: To whom his maiſter anſwered: I wil not enter iuto the towne of a ſtrange nation, which is not of the children of Iſrael, but I wil paſſe as farre as Gabaa:
label: Judges

text: and when I shal come thither, we wil lodge in it, or at the leaſt in the citie of Rama.
label: Judges

text: They paſſed therfore by Iebus, and went on their iourney begone, and the ſonne went downe to them byſide Gabaa, which is in the tribe of Beniamin:
label: Judges

text: and they turned into it, that they might lodge there. Whither when they were entred, they ſate in the ſtreate of the citie, and no man would receiue them to lodge.
label: Judges

text: And behold there appeared an old man, returning out of the field and from his worke in the euening, who him ſelfe alſo was of mount Ephraim, and dwelt as a ſtranger in Gabaa; but the men of that countrie were the children of Iemini.
label: Judges

text: And lifting vp his eies, the old man ſaw the man ſitting with his fardels in the ſtreate of the citie, and ſaid to him: Whence comeſt thou? and whither goeſt thou?
label: Judges

text: Who anſwered him: We departed from Bethlehem Iuda, and we goe to our place, which is on the ſide of mounr Ephraim, from whence we went into Bethlehem: and now we goe to the houſe of God, and none wil receiue vs vnder his roofe,
label: Judges

text: hauing ſtraw and hay for prouender of the aſſes, and bread and wine for the vſe of my ſelf and of thy handmaid, and of the ſeruant that is with me: we lacke nothing but lodging.
label: Judges

text: To whom the old man anſwered: Peace be with thee, I wil geue al thinges that are neceſſarie: only, I beſech thee, tarie not in the ſtreate.
label: Judges

text: And he brought him into his houſe, and gaue prouender to his aſſes: and after they had washed their feete, he receiued them to a bankette.
label: Judges

text: They making merie, and after the labour of their iourney, refreshing their bodie with meate and drinke, there came men of that citie, the children of Belial (that is to ſay, without yoke) and beſetting the old mans houſe, beganne to knocke at the doores, crying to the maiſter of the houſe, and ſaying: Bring forth the man, that entred into thy houſe, that we may abuſe him.
label: Judges

text: And the old man went out to them, and ſaid: Doe not ſo brethren, doe not this euil: becauſe this man is entered to my lodging, and ceaſe from this folie:
label: Judges

text: I haue a daughter that is a virgin, and this man hath a concubine, I wil bring them forth to you, that you may humble them, & fulfil your luſt: only, I beſeche you, worke not this wickednes againſt nature on the man.
label: Judges

text: They would not agree to his wordes which the man ſeing, he brought forth his concubine to them, and he deliuered her to them to be illuded: whom when they had abuſed al the night, they let her goe in the morning.
label: Judges

text: But the woman, when the darkenes departed, came to the doore of the houſe, where her lord lodged, and there fel downe.
label: Judges

text: Morning being come, the man aroſe, and opened the doore, that he might finish his iourney begone: and behold his concubine lay before the doore, her handes ſpredde on the threshold.
label: Judges

text: To whom he, thinking that she tooke her reſt, ſpake: Ariſe, and let vs walke. Who anſwering nothing, perceiuing that ſhe was dead; he tooke her, and laid her vpon his aſſe, & returned into his houſe.
label: Judges

text: Which when he was entred vnto, he tooke a ſword, and cutting the carcaſſe of his wife with her bones into twelue partes and peeces, he ſent them into al the borders of Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: Which when euerie one had ſeene, they cried together: There was neuer ſuch a thing done in Iſrael, from that day, when our fathers aſcended out of Ægypt, vntil this preſent time: geue ſentence, and decree in common what is needeful to be done.
label: Judges

text: THERFORE al the children of Iſrael went forth, and were gathered together, as it were one man, from Dan to Berſabee, and the Land of Galaad, to our Lord in Maſpha:
label: Judges

text: and al the corners of the people, and al the tribes of Iſrael aſſembled into the church of the people of God foure hundred thouſand footemen warriers.
label: Judges

text: ( Neither were the children of Beniamin ignorant that the children of Iſrael were come vp into Maſpha.) And the Leuite the huſband of the woman that was killed being asked, how ſo great wickednes had beene cōmitted,
label: Judges

text: anſwered: I came into Gabaa of Beniamin with my wife, and there I tooke my lodging:
label: Judges

text: and behold the men of that citie by night beſette the houſe wherein I taried, meaning to kil me, and vexing my wife with incredible furie of luſt, finally she died.
label: Judges

text: Whom being taken I did cutte into peeces, and ſent the partes into al the borders of your poſſeſſion: becauſe neuer was there ſo heinous an offenſe, and ſo greate an abomination done in Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: You are al preſent the children of Iſrael, determine what you ought to doe.
label: Judges

text: And al the people ſtanding, anſwered as it were by the word of one man: we wil not depart into our tabernacles, neither shal any man enter into his houſe:
label: Judges

text: but this wil we doe in common againſt Gabaa.
label: Judges

text: Let ten men be choſen of an hundred out of al the tribes of Iſrael, and an hundred of a thouſand, and a thouſand of ten thouſand, to bring victuals for the armie, and that we may fight againſt Gabaa of Beniamin, & render to it for the wicked fact, which it deſerueth.
label: Judges

text: And al Iſrael aſſembled to the citie, as it were one man with one minde, and one counſel:
label: Judges

text: and they ſent meſſengers to al the tribe of Beniamin, which should ſay: Why is there ſoe great abomination found in you?
label: Judges

text: Deliuer the men of Gabaa, that haue committed this heinous fact, that they may die, and the euil may be taken away out of Iſrael. Who would not heare the commandment of their brethren the children of Iſrael:
label: Judges

text: but out of al cities, which were of their lotte, they aſſembled into Gabaa, to ayde them, and to fight againſt al the people of Iſrael.
label: Judges

text: And there were found fiue and twentie thouſand of Beniamin of them that drew ſword, beſide the inhabitantes of Gabaa,
label: Judges
