text: And Saul and Ionathas his ſonne, and the people that were found with them, was in Gabaa of Beniamin: moreouer the Philiſthijms had pitched in Machmas.
label: 1 Kings

text: And there iſſued forth to praye from the campe of the Philiſthians three companies. One compaine went on againſt the way of Ephra to the Land of Saul.
label: 1 Kings

text: Moreouer an other went by the way of Bethhoron, & the third had turned it ſelfe to the way of the border, in the valley Seboim againſt the deſert.
label: 1 Kings

text: Moreouer there was not found any yron ſmith in al the Land of Iſrael. for the Philiſthijms had ſo prouided, leſt perhaps the Hebrewes should make ſword or ſpeare.
label: 1 Kings

text: Al Iſrael therfore went downe to the Philiſthijms, that euerie man might whette his plough culter, and ſpade, & axe, and rake.
label: 1 Kings

text: Therefore the edges of the shares, and ſpades, & forkes with three teeth, and axes, were blunt, euen to the godeprick, which was to be mended.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when the day was come to fight, there was not found ſword and ſpeare in the hand of al the people, that was with Saul and Ionathas, except Saul and Ionathas his ſonne.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the ſtation of the Philiſtijms went forth, to paſſe vp into Machmas.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND it chanced on a certeine day that Ionathas the ſonne of Saul ſayd to the yong man that bare his armour: Come, & let vs paſſe to the gariſon of the Philiſthijms, which is beyond yonder place. But to his father he told not this ſame thing.
label: 1 Kings

text: Moreouer Saul abode in the vtmoſt part of Gabaa vnder the pomegranate tree, which was in Magron: and the people with him was about ſix hundred men.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Achias the ſonne of Achitob the brother of Ichabod the ſonne of Phinees, which was borne of Heli the prieſt of our Lord in Silo, bare the ephod. But the people alſo was ignorant whither Ionathas was gone.
label: 1 Kings

text: And there were betwen the aſcentes, by the which Ionathas endeuoured to paſſe vnto the gariſon of the Philiſtijms, rockes ſtanding vp on both ſides, and as it were in maner of teeth ſtiepe broken rockes on either ſide, the name of one Boſes, and the name of the other Sene:
label: 1 Kings

text: one rocke ſtanding out toward the North ouer againſt Machmas, and the other to the South, againſt Gabaa.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas ſayd to the yong man that bare his armour: Come, let vs paſſe to the ſtation of theſe vncircumciſed, if haply our Lord wil make for vs: becauſe it is not hard for our Lord to ſaue either in manie, or in fewe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And his eſquier ſayd to him: Doe al thinges which pleaſe thy minde: goe whither thou deſireſt, and I wil be with thee whereſoeuer thou wilt.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas ſayd: Behold we paſſe to theſe men. And when we shal appeare to them,
label: 1 Kings

text: If they shal ſpeake to vs in this maner: Tarie til we come to you: let vs ſtand in our place, and not goe vp to them.
label: 1 Kings

text: But if they shal ſay: Come vp to vs: let vs goe vp, becauſe our Lord hath deliuered them in our handes, this shal be a ſigne vnto vs.
label: 1 Kings

text: Both of them therefore appeared to the ſtation of the Philiſthims: & the Philiſtijms ſayd: Behold the Hebrewes come out of the caues, wherein they were hid.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the men of the garniſon ſpake to Ionathas and to his eſquier, and ſayd: Come vp to vs, and we wil ſhew you a thing. And Ionathas ſayd to his eſquier: Let vs goe vp, folow me: for our Lord hath deliuered them into the handes of Iſrael.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas went vp on his handes & feete creeping, and his eſquier after him. Therefore ſome fel before Ionathas, other ſome his eſquier folowing ſlewe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the firſt ſlaughter, with which Ionathas & his eſquier made, was as it were of twentie men in the halfe part of an aker, which a yoke of oxen is wont to plough in a day.
label: 1 Kings

text: And there was made a miracle in the campe, through the fieldes: yea and al the people of their garriſon, which had gone to take prayes, was aſtonyed, and the land was trubled: and it happened as a miracle from God.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the watchemen of Saul, which were in Gabaa, of Beniamin looked, & loe a multitude ouerthrowen, & fleeing hither and thither.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd to the people, which was with him: Enquire, and ſee who is gone from vs. And when they had ſought, it was found that Ionathas was not preſent and his eſquier.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd to Achias: Bring the arke of our Lord. (for the arke of God was there that day with the children of Iſrael.)
label: 1 Kings

text: And when Saul ſpake to the prieſt, there aroſe a great tumult in the campe of the Philiſtijmes: and it grewe by litle and litle, and ſounded more cleerely. And Saul ſayd to the prieſt: Draw together thy hand.
label: 1 Kings

text: Saul therefore and al the people that was with him, ſhouted together, and they came to the place of the fight: and behold euerie mans ſword had beene turned to his neighbour, and a ſlaughter exceding great.
label: 1 Kings

text: But the Hebrewes alſo which had bene with the Philiſtijms yeſterday and the day before, and went vp with them in the campe, returned to be with Iſrael, which were with Saul and Ionathas.
label: 1 Kings

text: Al the Iſraelites alſo which had hid themſelues in mount Ephraim, hearing that the Philiſtijms were fled, ioyned them ſelues with their fellowes in battel. And there were with Saul as it were ten thouſand men.
label: 1 Kings

text: And our Lord in that day ſaued Iſrael. and the fight reached as farre as Bethauen.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the men of Iſrael were ioyned among themſelues in that day: and Saul adiured the people, ſaying: Curſed be the man, that shal eate bread vntil euening, til I be reuenged of myne enemies. And the whole people did eate no bread:
label: 1 Kings

text: and al the common people of the land came into a foreſt, wherein was honie vpon the face of the field.
label: 1 Kings

text: The people therefore entred into the foreſt, and there appeared dropping honie, and no man put his hand to his mouth. for the people feared the oath.
label: 1 Kings

text: But Ionathas had not heard when his father adiured the people: and he put forth the tippe of the rod, which he had in his hand, and dipped it into a honie combe: and he turned his hand to his mouth, and his eies were illuminated.
label: 1 Kings

text: And one of the people anſwering, ſayd: Thy father hath bound the people with an oath, ſaying: Curſed be the man that shal eate bread this day. (and the people was faynt)
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas ſayd: My father hath trubled the land: your ſelues haue ſeene that myn eies are illuminated, becauſe I haue taſted a litle of this honie:
label: 1 Kings

text: how much more if the people had eaten of the praye of their enemies, which they found? had there not beene made a greater plague in the Philiſtijms?
label: 1 Kings

text: They ſtroke therefore in that day the Philiſtijms from Machmas vnto Ailon. And the people was wearied excedingly:
label: 1 Kings

text: and being turned to the praye tooke ſheepe, and oxen, and calues, & ſlew them on the ground: and the people did eate with bloud.
label: 1 Kings

text: And they told Saul ſaying that the people had ſinned to our Lord, eating with bloud. Who ſayd: You haue tranſgreſſed: Roule to me euen now a great ſtone.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd: Diſperſe your ſelues among the common people, and tel them that euerie man bring me his oxe and ramme, and kil ye them vpon this ſame, and eate, and you shal not ſinne to our Lord eating with bloud. Al the people therefore brought euerie man his oxe in his hand vntil night: and ſlewe them there.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul built an altar to our Lord; and then firſt did he beginne to build an altar to our Lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd: Let vs fal vpon the Philiſtijms by night, and let vs ſpoyle them til it waxe light in the morning, neither let vs leaue a man of them. And the people ſayd: Doe al that ſemeth good in thyne eies. And the prieſt ſayd: Let vs approch hither to God.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul conſulted our Lord: Shal I purſew the Philiſtijms? wilt thou deliuer them into the handes of Iſrael? And he anſwered him not in that day.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd: Bring hither al the corners of the people: and know, and ſee by whom this ſinne hath chanced to day.
label: 1 Kings

text: Our Lord the ſauiour of Iſrael liueth, that if it were done by Ionathas my ſonne, he shal die without reuoking. Whereunto none of the people gayneſayed him.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he ſayd to al Iſrael: Be you ſeperated into one ſide, and I with Ionathas my ſonne wil be on the other ſide. And the people anſwered Saul: Doe what ſemeth good in thyn eies.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd to our Lord: Lord God of Iſrael, geue a ſigne: and Ionathas was caught and Saul, and the people went forth.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd: Caſt ye lotte betwen me, and Ionathas my ſonne. And Ionathas was taken.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd to Ionathas: Tel me what thou haſt done. And Ionathas told him, and ſayd: Taſting I taſted in the tippe of the rod, which was in myn hand a litle honie, and behold I die.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd: Theſe thinges doe God to me, and theſe thinges adde he, that dying thou shalt die Ionathas.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the people ſaid to Saul: Shal Ionathas then die, which hath made this great ſaluation in Iſrael? this is vnlawful: our Lord liueth, if there shal fal a heare from his head vpon the ground, becauſe with God hath he wrought to day. The people therefore deliuered Ionathas, that he should not die.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul retyred, neither did he purſew the Philiſtjims: moreouer the Philiſtijms departed into their places.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul, his kingdom being eſtablished ouer Iſrael, fought round about againſt al his enemies, againſt Moab, and the children of Ammon, and Edom, and the kinges of Soba, and the Philiſtians: and whither ſoeuer he turned him ſelf, he ouercame.
label: 1 Kings

text: And gathering together an armie, he ſtroke Amalec, and deliuered Iſrael from the hand of the ſpoylers thereof.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the ſonnes of Saul, were Ionathas and Ieſui, and Melchiſua: and the names of his two daughters, the name of the firſt borne Merob, and the name of the yonger Michol.
label: 1 Kings

text: and the name of Sauls wife, Achinoam the daughter of Achimaas: and the name of the prince of his hoſt Abner, the ſonne of Ner, the coſin german of Saul by the father.
label: 1 Kings

text: Moreouer Cis was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner, the ſonne of Abiel.
label: 1 Kings

text: And there was mightie battel agaynſt the Philiſthians al the dayes of Saul. For whomſoeuer Saul had ſeene a valiant man, and fitte for battel, he ioyned him to him ſelf.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND Samuel ſaid to Saul: Our Lord ſent me to annointe thee king ouer his people Iſrael; now therefore heare the voice of our Lord:
label: 1 Kings

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſtes: I haue recounted whatſoeuer Amalec hath done to Iſrael: how he reſiſted them in the way when they came vp out of Ægypt.
label: 1 Kings

text: Now therefore goe, and ſtrike Amalec, and deſtroy al that he hath: ſpare him not, and couet not ought of his thinges: but kil from man vnto woman, both childe & ſuckling, oxe and sheepe, camel and aſſe.
label: 1 Kings

text: Saul therefore commanded the people, and numbered them as it were lambes: two hundred thouſand footemen, & ten thouſand of the men of Iuda.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when Saul was come vnto the citie of Amalec, he laid ambushementes in the torrent.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſaid to the Cineite: Goe ye, retyre and depart from Amalec: leſt perhaps I wrappe thee in with him. for thou haſt done mercie with al the children of Iſrael, when they deſcended out of Ægypt. And the Cineite departed out of the middes of Amalec.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſtroke Amalec from Heuila, vntil thou come to Sur, which is ouer againſt Ægypt.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he apprehended Agag the king of Amalec aliue: but al the comon people he ſlewe in the edge of the ſword.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul and the people ſpared Agag, and the beſt flockes of ſheepe and heardes, and the garmentes and rammes, and al thinges, that were fayre, neither would they deſtroy them: but whatſoeuer was vile and refuſe, that they deſtroyed.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the word of our Lord was made to Samuel, ſaying:
label: 1 Kings

text: It repenteth me that I haue made Saul king: becauſe he hath forſaken me, & hath not fulfilled my wordes in worke. And Samuel was ſtrooken ſadde, and cried to our Lord al the night.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when Samuel had riſen in the night, to goe to Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, that Saul was come into Carmelus, and had erected to him ſelfe a triumphant arch, and returning was paſſed, and gone into Galgal. Samuel therefore came to Saul, and Saul offered an holocauſt to our Lord of the firſt of the prayes, which he had brought from Amalec.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when Samuel was come to Saul, Saul ſayd to him: Bleſſed be thou to our Lord, I haue fulfilled the word of our Lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſayd: And what is this voice of flockes, which ſoundeth in myne eares, and of heardes, which I heare?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſaid: They haue brought them from Amalec: for the people hath ſpared the better sheepe and heardes that they might be immolated to our Lord thy God, but the reſt we haue ſlaine.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſaid to Saul: Suffer me, and I wil shew thee what our Lord hath ſpoken to me this night. And he ſayd to him: Speake.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſaid: When thou waſt a little one in thyne owne eyes, was thou not made chief in the tribes of Iſrael? And our Lord annointed thee to be king ouer Iſrael,
label: 1 Kings

text: and our Lord ſent thee on the way, and ſayd: Goe, and kil the ſinners of Amalec, and thou shalt fight againſt them vntil the vtter deſtruction of them.
label: 1 Kings

text: Why therefore haſt thou not heard the voice of our Lord: but art turned to the praye, and haſt done euil in the eies of our Lord?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſaid to Samuel: Yea I haue heard the voice of our Lord, and haue walked in the way by which our Lord ſent me, and haue brought Agag the king of Amalec, and Amalec I haue ſlaine.
label: 1 Kings

text: But the people tooke of the praye sheepe and oxen, the principal of thoſe thinges which were ſlaine, to immolate to our Lord their God in Galgal.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſaid: Why wil our Lord haue holocauſtes and victimes, and not rather that the voice of our Lord be obeyed? For BETTER is obedience then victimes: and to harken rather then to offer the fatte of rammes.
label: 1 Kings

text: Becauſe it is as it were the ſinne of inchantment, to reſiſt: and as it were the wickednes of idolatrie, to refuſe to obey. For as much therefore as thou haſt reiected the word of our Lord, our Lord hath reiected thee that thou shalt not be king.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſaid to Samuel: I haue ſinned, becauſe I haue tranſgreſſed the ſaying of our Lord, and thy wordes, fearing the people, and obeying their voice.
label: 1 Kings

text: But now beare I beſech thee my ſinne, and returne with me, that I may adore our Lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſayd to Saul: I wil not returne with thee, becauſe thou haſt reiected the word of our Lord, and our Lord hath reiected thee that thou shalt not be king ouer Iſrael,
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel turned him ſelfe to depart: but he caught the hemme of his cloke, which alſo did rent.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſaid to him: Our Lord hath rent the kingdom of Iſrael from thee this day, and hath deliuered it to thy neighbour better then thou.
label: 1 Kings

text: Moreouer the Triumpher in Iſrael wil not ſpare, and he wil not be turned with repentance: for neither is he a man that he may repent.
label: 1 Kings

text: But he ſaid: I haue ſinned: howbeit now honour me before the ancientes of my people, and before Iſrael, and returne with me, that I may adore our Lord thy God.
label: 1 Kings

text: Samuel therefore returning folowed Saul: and Saul adored our Lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſaid: Bring vnto me Agag the king of Amalec. And Agag was preſented to him very fatte, trembling. And Agag ſayd: Doth bitter death thus ſeparat?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſaid: As thy ſword hath made wemen without children, ſo ſhal thy mother among wemen be without children. And Samuel hewed him into peeces before our Lord in Galgal.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel departeth into Ramatha: but Saul aſcended vnto his houſe into Gabaa.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſaw Saul no more vnto the day of his death: but yet Samuel lamented Saul becauſe it repented our Lord that he had appointed him king ouer Iſrael.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND our Lord ſaid to Samuel: How long doeſt thou mourne Saul, whom I haue reiected that he rule not ouer Iſrael? fil thy horne with oile, and come, that I may ſend thee to Iſai the Bethlehemite: for I haue prouided me a king among his ſonnes.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſaid: How shal I goe? for Saul wil heare of it, and wil kil me. And our Lord ſaid: A calfe of the heard shalt thou take in thy hand, and shalt ſay: I am come to immolate vnto our Lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: And thou shalt cal Iſai to the victime, and I wil shew thee what thou muſt doe, and thou shalt annointe whomſoeuer I shal shew to thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: Samuel therefore did as our Lord ſpake to him. And he came into Bethlehem, and the ancientes of the citie merueled, meeting him, and they ſaid: Is thy entrance peaceable?
label: 1 Kings

text: And he ſaid: Peaceable: I am come to immolate vnto our Lord, be ye ſanctified. and come with me that I may immolate. He therefore ſanctified Iſai and his ſonnes, and called them to the ſacrifice.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when they were entered in, he ſaw Eliab, and ſaid: Is there before our Lord his Chriſt?
label: 1 Kings

text: And our Lord ſaid to Samuel: Reſpect not his countenāce, nor the talnes of his ſtature: becauſe I haue reiected him, neither doe I iudge according to the looke of man: for man ſeeth thoſe thinges which appeare, but our Lord beholdeth the hart.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Iſai called Aminadab, and brought him before Samuel. Who ſaid: Neither this hath our Lord choſen.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Iſai brought Samma, of whom he ſayd: This alſo hath not our Lord choſen.
label: 1 Kings

text: Iſai therefore brought his ſeauen ſonnes before Samuel: and Samuel ſayd to Iſai: Our Lord hath not choſen of theſe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſayd to Iſai: Are al thy ſonnes now fully come? Who anſwered: Yet there is left a litle one, and he feedeth sheepe. And Samuel ſayd to Iſai: Send, and bring him: for neither wil we ſitte downe til he come hither.
label: 1 Kings

text: He ſent therefore, and brought him. And he was reade and beautiful to behold, and of a comelie face. And our Lord ſaid: Ariſe, and annoint him, for he it is.
label: 1 Kings

text: Samuel therefore tooke the horne of oile, and annointed him in the middes of his brethren: and the Spirit of our Lord from that day, and ſo forward was directed vpon Dauid: and Samuel riſing went into Ramatha.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the Spirit of our Lord departed from Saul, and a wicked ſpirit vexed him, from our Lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the ſeruantes of Saul ſaid to him: Behold an euil ſpirit of God vexeth thee,
label: 1 Kings

text: Let our lord command, and thy ſeruantes which are before thee, wil ſeeke a man skilful to play on the harpe, that when the euil ſpirit of our Lord shal take thee, he may play with his hand, and thou beare it more it more eaſily.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd to his ſeruantes: Prouid me therefore ſome man that playeth wel, and bring him to me.
label: 1 Kings

text: And one of the ſeruantes anſwering, ſayd: Behold I haue ſeene the ſonne of Iſai the Bethlehemite skilful to play, and very valiant in ſtrength, and a warlike man, and wiſe in his wordes, and a beautiful man: and our Lord is with him.
label: 1 Kings

text: Saul therfore ſent meſſengers to Iſai, ſaying: Send vnto me Dauid thy ſonne, which is in the paſtures.
label: 1 Kings

text: Iſai therefore tooke an aſſe loaden with loaues, and a flagon of wine, and one kidde of the goates, and ſent it by the hand of Dauid his ſonne to Saul.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid came to Saul, and ſtoode before him: but he loued him excedingly, & was made his eſquier.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſent to Iſai, ſaying: Let Dauid ſtand in my ſight: for he hath found grace in myn eies.
label: 1 Kings

text: Therefore whenſoeuer the euil ſpirit of our Lord caught Saul, Dauid tooke his harpe, & ſtrooke with his hand, and Saul was refreshed, and waxed better. for the euil ſpirit departed from him.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND the Philiſthijms gathering together their companies vnto battel, aſſembled into Socho of Iuda: and camped betwen Socho & Azeca in the borders of Dommim.
label: 1 Kings

text: Moreouer Saul and the children of Iſrael being gathered together came into the Valley of terebinth, and they put the armie in aray to fight againſt the Philiſtijms.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the Philiſtijms ſtoode vpon the mountaine on this ſide, and Iſrael ſtoode vpon the mountaine on the other ſide: and the valley was betwen them.
label: 1 Kings

text: And there came forth a man that was a baſtard from the campe of the Philiſtians named Goliath, of Geth, in height ſix cubites and a palme:
label: 1 Kings

text: and a helmet of braſſe vpon his head, and he was clothed with a cote of mayle linked. moreouer the weight of his cote of mayle was fiue thouſand ſicles of braſſe:
label: 1 Kings

text: and he had braſſen bootes on his thighes, and a target of braſſe couered his shoulders.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the ſhaft of his ſpeare was as it were a weauers beame. and the verie yton of his ſpeare had ſix hundred ſicles of yron: and his eſquier went before him.
label: 1 Kings

text: And ſtanding he cried againſt the bandes of Iſrael, and ſayd to them: Why came you prepared to fight? Am not I a Philiſtian, and you the ſeruantes of Saul? Chooſe out a man of you and let him deſcend to fight hand to hand.
label: 1 Kings

text: If he shal be able to fight with me, and ſtrike me, we wil be ſeruantes to you: but if I shal preuaile, and shal beate him, you shal be ſeruantes, and shal ſerue vs.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the Philiſtian ſayd: I haue defyed the bandes of Iſrael this day: Geue me a man, and let him fight with me hand to hand.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul and al the Iſraelites hearing ſuch wordes of the Philiſtian were aſtonied, and feared excedingly.
label: 1 Kings

text: And there was Dauid the ſonne of a man that was an Ephratheite, of whom there was mention before, of Bethlehem Iuda, whoſe name was Iſai, who had eight ſonnes, and he was in the dayes of Saul an old man, and aged among men.
label: 1 Kings

text: And his three elder ſonnes went after Saul into battel: and the names of his three ſonnes, which went to battel, were Eliab the firſt begotten, and the ſecond Abinadab, the third alſo Samma:
label: 1 Kings

text: and Dauid was the yongeſt. The three elder therefore hauing folowed Saul,
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid went, and returned from Saul, to feede his fathers flocke in Bethlehem.
label: 1 Kings

text: But the Philiſtian came forth morning and euening, and ſtoode fourtie dayes.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Iſai ſayd to Dauid his ſonne: Take for thy brethren an ephi of polent, and theſe ten loaues, and runne into the campe to thy brethren,
label: 1 Kings

text: and theſe ten litle cheeſes thou shalt carie to the tribune: and shalt viſite thy brethren, if they doe wel: and learne with whom they are placed.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul, and they, and al the children of Iſrael fought in the Valley of terebinth againſt the Philiſtijms.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore aroſe in the morning, and commended the flocke to the keeper: and he went loaded as Iſai had commanded him. And he came to the place Magala, and to the hoſt, which iſſuing out to fight had made a shoute in the battel.
label: 1 Kings

text: For Iſrael had put them ſelues in aray, and the Philiſtijms on the contrarie ſide were prepared.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore leauing the veſſels which he had brought, vnder the hand of him, that was keeper at the bagage, ranne to the place of the battel and asked if al thinges went wel with his brethren.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when he yet ſpake to them, that man the baſtard appeared coming vp, named Goliath, the Philiſtian of Geth, coming vp from the campe of the Philiſtians: and he ſpeaking theſe ſelf ſame wordes, Dauid heard them.
label: 1 Kings

text: And al the Iſraelites when they had ſene the man, fled from his face, fearing him excedingly.
label: 1 Kings

text: And ſome one of Iſrael ſayd: Haue you ſeene this man that came vp, to defye Iſrael he came vp? The man therefore that shal ſtrike him, the King wil geue him his daughter, and he wil make his fathers houſe without tribute in Iſrael.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſpake to the men that ſtood with him, ſaying: What shal be geuen to the man that shal beate this Philiſtian, and shal take away the reproch from Iſrael? For who is this vncircumciſed Philiſtian, which hath vpbraided the armies of the liuing God?
label: 1 Kings

text: And the people reported vnto him the ſelf ſame worde, ſaying: Theſe thinges shal be geuen to the man, that shal ſtrike him.
label: 1 Kings

text: Which when Eliab his eldeſt brother had heard, when he ſpake with others, he was angrie againſt Dauid, and ſayd: Wherefore cameſt thou? and why haſt thou left thoſe few sheepe in the deſert? I know thy pride, and the wickednes of thy hart: that to ſee the battel thou art come downe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd: What haue I done? is there not cauſe to ſpeake?
label: 1 Kings

text: And he went a litle aſide from him to an other: and ſayd the ſelf ſame word. And the people anſwered him as before.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the wordes which Dauid ſpake were heard, and told in the ſight of Saul.
label: 1 Kings

text: To whom when he was brought, he ſpake vnto him: Let not any mans hart be diſcouraged in him: I thy ſeruant wil goe, and wil fight againſt the Philiſtian.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd to Dauid: Thou art not able to reſiſt this Philiſtian, nor to fight againſt him, becauſe thou art a childe, but he is a man of warre from his youth.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to Saul: Thy ſeruant did feede his fathers flock, and there came a lyon, or a beare, and tooke a ramme out of the middes of the flocke:
label: 1 Kings

text: and I purſued them, and ſtroke them, and plucked them out of their mouth, and they aroſe vp againſt me, and I caught their chinne, and I ſtrangled and ſlew them.
label: 1 Kings

text: For both the lyon and the beare did I thy ſeruant kil: therefore this vncircumciſed Philiſtian alſo, shal be as it were one of them. Now wil I goe and take away the reproch of the people: for who is this vncircumciſed Philiſtian, which hath beene ſo hardie to curſe the hoſt of the liuing God?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd: Our Lord which hath deliuered me from the hand of the lion, and of the beare, he wil deliuer me from the hand of this Philiſtian. And Saul ſayd to Dauid: Goe, and our Lord be with thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul clothed Dauid with his rayments, and put an helmet of braſſe vpon his head, and veſted him with a coate of maile.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore being girded with his ſword ouer his rayment, beganne to proue if he could goe armed: for he was not accuſtomed. And Dauid ſayd to Saul: I can not goe ſo, becauſe I am not vſed, and he layd them of.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he tooke his ſtaffe, which he had alwaies in his handes: & he choſe him fiue moſt bright ſtones out of the torrent, and caſt them into the shepherds skrippe, which he had with him, and he tooke a ſling in his hand, and went forth againſt the Philiſtian.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the Philiſtian went, going and approching againſt Dauid, and his eſquier before him.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when the Philiſtian had ſeene, and beheld Dauid, he deſpiſed him. And he was a yong man redde, and beautiful to behold.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the Philiſtian ſayd to Dauid: Why am I a dogge, that thou commeſt to me with a ſtaffe? And the Philiſtian curſed Dauid in his goddes.
label: 1 Kings

text: and ſayd to Dauid: Come to me, and I wil geue thy flesh to the foules of the ayre and the beaſtes of the earth.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to the Philiſtian: Thou commeſt to me with a ſword, and ſpeare, and sheeld, but I come to thee in the name of the Lord of hoſts, the God of the bandes of Iſrael, whom thou haſt defied
label: 1 Kings

text: this day, and our Lord shal geue thee in my hand, and I shal ſtrike thee, and take away thy head from thee: and I shal geue the carcaſſes of the campe of the Philiſtijms this day, to the fowles of the ayre, and to the beaſtes of the earth: that al the earth may knowe that there is a God in Iſrael.
label: 1 Kings

text: And al this aſſemblie shal know, that not in ſword, nor in ſpeare, doth our Lord ſaue, for it is his battel, and he wil deliuer you into our handes.
label: 1 Kings

text: When the Philiſtian therefore was riſen vp, and came and approched againſt Dauid, Dauid made haſt, & ranne to the battel againſt the Philiſtian.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he put his hand into his skrippe, and tooke one ſtone, and caſt it with the ſling, and fetching it about ſtroke the Philiſtian in the forehead, and he fel on his face vpon the earth.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid preuailed agaynſt the Philiſtian with ſling and ſtone, and he ſtroke, and ſlew the Philiſtian. And whereas Dauid had no ſword in his hand,
label: 1 Kings

text: he ranne, and ſtood vpon the Philiſtian, and tooke his ſword, and drew it out of the ſcabard, and ſlew him, and cut of his head. And the Philiſtijms ſeing, that the ſtrongeſt of them was dead, did flee.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the men of Iſrael and Iuda riſing vp shouted, and purſued the Philiſtians til they came into a valley to the gates of Accaron, and there fel wounded of the Philiſtijms in the way of Saraim, as farre as Geth, & as farre as Accaron.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the children of Iſrael returning, after they had purſued the Philiſtians, inuaded their campe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid taking the head of the Philiſtian brought it into Ieruſalem: but his armour he layd in his tabernacle.
label: 1 Kings

text: And at the ſame time that Saul ſaw Dauid going forth againſt the Philiſtian, he ſayd to Abner the prince of the armie: Of what ſtocke is this yong man deſcended, Abner? And Abner ſayd: Thy ſoule liueth ô king, if I know.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the king ſayd: Aske thou, whoſe ſonne this yong man is.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when Dauid was returned, after the Philiſthian was ſlaine, Abner tooke him, and brought him in before Saul, hauing the head of the Philiſtian in his hand.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd to him: O yong man of what progenie art thou? And Dauid ſayd: I am the ſonne of thy ſeruant Iſai the Bethlemite.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND it came to paſſe, when he had finished to ſpeake vnto Saul, the ſoule of Ionathas was ioyned faſt to the ſoule of Dauid, & Ionathas loued him as his ſoule.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul tooke him in that day, and did not grant vnto him to returne into his fathers houſe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid and Ionathas entered a league, for he loued him as his ſoule.
label: 1 Kings

text: For Ionathas ſtripped himſelf of the cote wherwith he was clothed, and gaue it to Dauid, and the reſt of his garments, vnto his ſword, & bowe, & vnto his belt.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid alſo went forth to al thinges wheretoſoeuer Saul ſent him, & he behaued himſelf wiſely: and Saul placed him ouer the men of warre, and he was accepted in the eies of al the people, and ſpecially in the eies of Saules ſeruantes.
label: 1 Kings

text: Moreouer when Dauid returned, after he ſtroke the Philiſtian, the wemen came forth from al the tribes of Iſrael, ſinging and dancing to Saul the King, in timbrels of ioy, and in cornettes.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the wemen ſang, playing, and ſaying: Saul ſtroke a thouſand, and Dauid ten thouſand.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul was exceding angrie, and this word was diſpleaſant in his eies; and he ſayd: They haue geuen Dauid ten thouſand, and to me they haue geuen a thouſand: what remayneth for him but only the kingdom?
label: 1 Kings

text: Therefore Saul did not looke vpon Dauid with right eies from that day and afterward.
label: 1 Kings

text: And a day after, the euil ſpirit of God inuaded Saul, and he prophecied in the middes of his houſe. And Dauid played with his hand as euery day. And Saul held a ſpeare,
label: 1 Kings

text: and threw it, thinking that he could naile Dauid to the wal, and Dauid declined from his face the ſecond time.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul feared Dauid becauſe our Lord was with him, and was departed from himſelf.
label: 1 Kings

text: Saul therefore remoued him from him, and made him a tribune ouer a thouſand men, and he went out and came in before al the people.
label: 1 Kings

text: Alſo in al his wayes, Dauid delt wiſely, and our Lord was with him.
label: 1 Kings

text: Saul therefore ſaw that he was exceding wiſe, and he beganne to beware of him.
label: 1 Kings

text: But al Iſrael, and Iuda loued Dauid, for he came in and went out before them.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd to Dauid: Behold my elder daughter Merob, her wil I geue thee to wife, only be thou a valyant man, and fight the battels of our Lord. And Saul thought ſaying: Be not my hand vpon him, but let the handes of the Philiſtians be vpon him.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to Saul: What am I, or what is my life, or the kindred of my father in Iſrael, that I ſhould be made the ſonne in lawe of the king?
label: 1 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe, at what time, Merob the daughter of Saul ſhould haue beene geuen to Dauid, ſhe was geuen to Hadriel the Molathite to wife.
label: 1 Kings

text: But Dauid loued Michol the other daughter of Saul. And it was told Saul, and it pleaſed him.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd: I wil geue her to him, that she may be a ſcandal vnto him, and that the hand of the Philiſtians may be vpon him. And Saul ſayd to Dauid: In two thinges thou shalt be my ſonne in lawe this day.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul commanded his ſeruantes: Speake to Dauid ſecretly out of my preſence, ſaying: Behold thou pleaſeſt the King, and al his ſeruantes loue thee. Now therefore be thou the kinges ſonne in lawe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the ſeruantes of Saul ſpake al theſe wordes in the eares of Dauid. And Dauid ſayd: Doth it ſeme vnto you a ſmal matter to be the ſonne in lawe of a King? But I am a poore man, and of ſmal ability.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the ſeruantes of Saul reported, ſaying: Theſe maner of wordes hath Dauid ſpoken.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd: Speake thus to Dauid: The king nedeth no dowrie, but only an hundred prepuces of the Philiſtians, that reuenge may be made of the kinges enemies. Moreouer Saul thought to deliuer Dauid into the handes of the Philiſtians.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when his ſeruantes had reported to Dauid the wordes that Saul had ſayd, the word was liked in the eies of Dauid, to be made the kings ſonne in lawe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And after fewe days Dauid riſing vp, went with the men that were vnder him, and he ſtroke of the Philiſtijms two hundred men, and brought their prepuces, and numbered them to the King, that he might be his ſonne in law, Saul therefore gaue him Michol his daughter to wife.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſaw, and vnderſtood that our Lord was with Dauid. And Michol the daughter of Saul loued him.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul began more to feare Dauid: and Saul became enemie to Dauid al daies.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the princes of the Philiſtians went forth: and from the beginning of their going forth, Dauid behaued him ſelf more wiſely, then al the ſeruantes of Saul, and his name was made renowmed excedingly.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND Saul ſpake to Ionathas his ſonne, and to al his ſeruantes, that they should kil Dauid. Moreouer Ionathas the ſonne of Saul, loued Dauid excedingly.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas told Dauid, ſaying: Saul my father ſeeketh to kil thee: wherefore looke to thy ſelf I beſech thee in the morning, and thou shalt abide ſecretly, and shalt be hid.
label: 1 Kings

text: But I going forth wil ſtand beſide my father, in the field whereſoeuer he shal be: and I wil ſpeake of thee to my father, and whatſoeuer I shal ſee, I wil tel thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: Ionathas therefore ſpake good wordes of Dauid to Saul his father: and ſayd to him: Sinne not, o King againſt thy ſeruant Dauid, becauſe he hath not ſinned toward thee, and his workes are very good for thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he put his life in his hand, and ſtroke the Philiſtian, and our Lord made great ſaluation to al Iſrael. Thou haſt ſeene & didſt reioice, why therefore ſinneſt thou in innocent blood killing Dauid, who is without fault?
label: 1 Kings

text: Which when Saul had heard, being pacified with the voice of Ionathas, he ſware: Our Lord liueth, he shal not be ſlaine.
label: 1 Kings

text: Ionathas therefore called Dauid and shewed him al theſe wordes, and Ionathas brought in Dauid to Saul, and he was before him, as he had bene yeſterday and the day before.
label: 1 Kings

text: And there was battel rayſed againe, and Dauid going forth, fought againſt the Philiſtijms, and ſtroke them with a great ſlaughter, and they fled from his face.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the euil ſpirit of our Lord came vpon Saul, and he ſate in his houſe, and held a ſpeare: moreouer Dauid played with his hand.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul endeuoured to naile Dauid to the wal with his ſpeare. And Dauid declined from the face of Saul: and the ſpeare without making wound, pearced the wal, and Dauid fled, and was ſaued that night.
label: 1 Kings

text: Saul therefore ſent of his guarde into Dauids houſe, that they ſhould keepe him, & that he might be killed in the morning: Which when Michol his wife had told Dauid, ſaying: Vnles thou ſaue thy ſelf this night, to morowe thou shalt die:
label: 1 Kings

text: she let him downe through a windowe. moreouer he went and fled away, and was ſaued.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Michol tooke a ſtatua, and put it vpon the bed, and a hearie skinne of goates she layd at the head thereof, and couered it with garmentes.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſent ſerieantes, that should take away Dauid by force, and it was anſwered that he was ſicke.
label: 1 Kings

text: And againe Saul ſent meſſengers to ſee Dauid, ſaying: Bring him to me in the bed, that he may be ſlaine.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when the meſſengers were come, there was found a ſtatua vpon the bed, and skinnes of goates at the head thereof.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd to Michol: Why haſt thou mocked me, and let goe myn enemie that he might flee? And Michol anſwered Saul: Becauſe he ſayd to me: Let me goe, otherwiſe I wil kil thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: But Dauid fleing was ſaued, and came to Samuel in Ramatha, and told him al thinges that Saul had done to him: and he & Samuel went & abode in Naioth.
label: 1 Kings

text: And it was told Saul by ſome ſaying: Behold Dauid is in Naioth in Ramatha.
label: 1 Kings

text: Saul therefore ſent ſeriantes to take away Dauid: who when they had ſeene a troupe of prophetes prophecying, & Samuel ſtanding ouer them, the ſpirit of our Lord came alſo on them, and they alſo began to prophecie.
label: 1 Kings

text: Which when it was told Saul, he ſent other meſſengers: but they alſo did prophecie. And againe Saul ſent the third meſſengers: who alſo prophecied. And Saul being wrath for anger,
label: 1 Kings

text: went alſo him ſelfe into Ramatha, and came as farre as the great ceſterne, which is in Socho, and asked, and ſaid: In what place are Samuel and Dauid? And it was told him: Loe they are in Naioth in Ramatha.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he went into Naioth in Ramatha, and the Spirit of our Lord came vpon him, and he walked going, and he prophecied til he came into Naioth in Ramatha.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he ſtripped himſelfe of his garments, and prophecied with the reſt before Samuel, and ſang naked al that day and night. Wherupon there went out alſo a prouerb: What is Saul alſo among the prophetes.
label: 1 Kings

text: BVT Dauid alſo fled from Naioth, which is in Ramatha, and coming ſpake before Ionathas: What haue I done? what is myn iniquitie, and what ſinne of myn againſt thy father, that he ſeeketh my life?
label: 1 Kings

text: Who ſayd to him: God forbid, thou shalt not die: for neither wil my father doe any thing great or litle, vnles he firſt tel me: this word therefore only hath my father concealed from me? no this shal not be.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he ſware againe to Dauid. And Dauid ſayd: Thy father ſurely knoweth, that I haue found grace in thy ſight, and wil ſay: Let not Ionathas know this, leſt perhaps he be ſad. Yea more our Lord liueth, and thy ſoule liueth, by one degree only (as I may ſo ſay) I and death are diuided.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas ſaid to Dauid: Whatſoeuer thy ſoule shal ſay to me, I wil doe for thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to Ionathas: Behold the calendes are to morowe, & I after the maner am wont to ſitte beſide the king to eate: diſmiſſe me therefore that I may be hid in the field vntil the euening of the third day.
label: 1 Kings

text: If thy father looking inquire for me, thou shalt anſwer him: Dauid deſired me, that he might goe quickely into Bethlehem his citie: becauſe there be ſolemne victimes to al of his tribe.
label: 1 Kings

text: If he shal ſay, Wel: peace shal be to thy ſeruant, but if he be angrie, know that his malice is complete.
label: 1 Kings

text: Doe mercie therefore toward thy ſeruant: becauſe thou haſt cauſed me thy ſeruant to enter the league of our Lord with thee. but if there be any iniquitie in me, do thou kil me, and bring me not in to thy father.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas ſayd: Be this farre from thee, for neither can it be, that I should not tel thee, if I shal certainly know that my fathers malice is complete againſt thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid anſwered Ionathas: Who shal bring me word, if thy father anſwer thee perhaps any thing sharpely of me?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas ſayd to Dauid: Come, let vs goe forth abroad into the field, and when they were both gone forth into the field,
label: 1 Kings

text: Ionathas ſaid to Dauid: Lord God of Iſrael, if I shal ſearch out my fathers meaning, to morowe or the day after, and ſome good thing be vpon Dauid, and I ſend not immediatly vnto thee, and make thee know thereof,
label: 1 Kings

text: theſe thinges doe our Lord to Ionathas, and theſe thinges adde he. But if my fathers malice shal perſeuer againſt thee, I wil reuele thyn eare, and wil diſmiſſe thee, that thou mayſt goe in peace, and our Lord be with thee, as he hath beene with my father.
label: 1 Kings

text: And if I liue, thou ſhalt doe me the mercie of our Lord; but if I die,
label: 1 Kings

text: thou shalt not take away thy mercie from my houſe for euer, when our Lord shal haue rooted out the enemies of Dauid, euerie one out of the land, take he away Ionathas from his houſe, and our Lord require it of the handes of Dauides enemies.
label: 1 Kings

text: Ionathas therefore made a league with the houſe of Dauid: and our Lord required it of the handes of Dauids enemies.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas added to ſweare vnto Dauid, becauſe he loued him, for as his owne ſoule, ſo he loued him.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas ſayd to him: To morowe are the calendes, and thou shalt be asked for:
label: 1 Kings

text: for thy ſitting wil be inquired of til after to morowe. Thou shalt therefore goe downe in haſt, and shalt come to the place, where thou muſt be hid in the day, when it is lawful to worke, and thou shalt ſit beſide the ſtone, which is named Ezel.
label: 1 Kings

text: And I wil shoote three arrowes nere it, and wil shoote as it were excerſiſing my ſelf at a marke.
label: 1 Kings

text: I wil ſend alſo a boy ſaying to him: Goe, and fetch me the arrowes.
label: 1 Kings

text: If I shal ſay to the boy: Loe the arrowes are on this ſide thee, take them vp: come thou to me, becauſe there is peace to thee, and there is no euil, our Lord liueth. But if I shal ſpeake thus to the boy: Loe the arrowes are beyond thee: Goe in peace, becauſe our Lord hath dimiſſed thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: And corcerning the word which I and thou haue ſpoken, our Lord be betwen thee and me for euer.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore was hidde in the fielde, and the calendes came, and the king ſate downe to eate bread.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when the king was ſette vpon his chaire (according to the cuſtome) which was beſide the wal, Ionathas aroſe, and Abner ſate at the ſide of Saul, and Dauids place appeared voide.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd nothing that day, for he thought it had chanced perhaps vnto him, that he was not cleane, nor purified.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when the ſecond day was come after the calendes, againe Dauids place appeared emptie. And Saul ſaid to Ionathas his ſonne: Why came not the ſonne of Iſai neither yeſterday, nor to day to eate?
label: 1 Kings

text: Ionathas anſwered Saul: He deſired me inſtantly, that he might goe into Bethlehem,
label: 1 Kings

text: and he ſaid: Let me goe, becauſe there is a ſolemne ſacrifice in the citie, one of my brethren hath ſent for me: now therefore if I haue found grace in thy ſight, I wil goe quickly, and ſee my brethren. For this cauſe he came not to the kings table.
label: 1 Kings

text: But Saul being wrath againſt Ionathas, ſaid to him: Thou ſonne of a woman which of her owne accord rauisheth a man, am I ignorant that thou loueſt the ſonne of Iſai vnto thyne owne confuſion, and to the confuſion of thyne ignominious mother?
label: 1 Kings

text: For al the dayes, that the ſonne of Iſai shal liue vpon the earth, thou shalt not be eſtablished, nor thy kingdom. Therefore now preſently ſend, and bring him to me: becauſe he is the ſonne of death.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas anſwering Saul his father, faid: Why shal he dye? what hath he done?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul caught a ſpeare to ſtrike him. And Ionathas vnderſtood that it was determined of his father, that he would kil Dauid.
label: 1 Kings

text: Ionathas therefore roſe from the table in anger of furie, and did not eate bread the ſecond day of the calendes. For he was ſtroken heauie vpon Dauid, becauſe his father had confounded him.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when the morning appeared, Ionathas came into the field according to the appointment with Dauid, and a little boy with him.
label: 1 Kings

text: and ſaid to his boy: Goe, and fetch me the arrowes, which I shoote. And when the boy had runne, he shotte an other arrowe beyond the boy.
label: 1 Kings

text: The boy therefore came to the place of the arrowe, which Ionathas had shotte: and Ionathas cried behind the back of the boy, and ſaid: Loe the arrowe is there further beyond thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas cried againe behind the back of the boy, ſaying: Make haſt ſpedely, ſtand not. And Ionathas his boy gathered vp his arrowes, and brought them to his maſter:
label: 1 Kings

text: and he was altogether ignorant, what was done: for only Ionathas and Dauid knew the matter.
label: 1 Kings

text: Ionathas therefore gaue his armoure to the boy, and ſaid to him: Goe, and cary them into the citie.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when the boy was gone, Dauid roſe out of his place, which did bend to the South, and falling flatt on the ground, adored thriſe: and kiſſing one an other, they wept together, but Dauid more.
label: 1 Kings

text: Ionathas therefore ſaid to Dauid: Goe in peace: whatſoeuer we haue ſworne both of vs in the name of our Lord, ſaying: Our Lord be betwen me and thee, and betwen my ſeede and thy ſeede for euer.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid aroſe, and departed: but Ionathas alſo entred into the Citie.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND Dauid came into Nobe to Achimelech the prieſt: & Achimelech was aſtonyed, becauſe Dauid was come. And he ſaid to him: Why thou alone, and none is with thee?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid to Achimelech the prieſt: The king hath commanded me a word and ſaid: Let no man know the thing, for which thou art ſent by me, and what maner precepts I haue geuen thee, for my ſeruantes alſo I haue appointed into ſuch and ſuch a place.
label: 1 Kings

text: Now therfore if thou haue any thing at hand, yea if but fiue loaues, geue me, or whatſoeuer thou shalt finde.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the prieſt anſwered Dauid, ſaying: I haue no lay breads at hand, but only holy bread, if the ſeruants be cleane, eſpecially from wemen?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid anſwered the prieſt, and ſaid to him: And truly, if the matter be concerning wemen, we haue refrained our ſelues from yeſterday and the day before, when we came forth, and the veſſels of the ſeruants were holie. Moreouer this way is polluted, but it alſo shal be ſanctified this day in the veſſels.
label: 1 Kings

text: The prieſt therefore gaue him halowed bread; for neither was anie bread there, but only the loaues of propoſition, which had bene taken away from the face of our Lord, that hoate loaues might be ſette downe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And there was there a certaine man of the ſeruantes of Saul that day, within the tabernacle of our Lord: and his name was Doeg an Idumeite, the mightieſt of Saules paſtours.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid to Achimelech: Haſt thou here at hand a ſpeare, or a ſword? becauſe myn owne ſword, and myne owne weapons I tooke not with me. for the kings word haſtened forward.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the prieſt ſaid: Loe here the ſword of Goliath the Philiſtian, whom thou ſleweſt in the Valley of terebinth, is wrapped vp in a mantel behind the Ephod: if thou wilt take this, take it. for neither is here any other beſide that. And Dauid ſaid: There is none other like to that, geue me it.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore aroſe, and fled that day from the face of Saul: and came to Achis the king of Geth,
label: 1 Kings

text: and the ſeruantes of Achis ſaid to him, when they had ſeene Dauid: Is not this Dauid the king of the land? Did they not ſing in dances to this man ſaying: Saul ſtroke a thouſand, and Dauid ten thouſand?
label: 1 Kings

text: But Dauid put theſe wordes in his hart, and feared excedingly at the face of Achis the king of Geth.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he changed his countenance before them, and ſlipt downe betwen their handes: and he ſtumbled at the doores of the gate, & his ſpittle ranne downe vpon his bearde.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Achis ſaid to his ſeruantes: You haue ſeene the man madde: why haue you brought him to me?
label: 1 Kings

text: Doe we lack madde men, that you haue brought in this felowe, to play the madde man in my preſence? shal this man enter into my houſe?
label: 1 Kings

text: DAVID therefore went from thence, and fled to the caue of Odellam. Which when his brethren had heard, and a his fathers houſe, they went downe to him thither.
label: 1 Kings

text: And there were gathered vnto him, al that were in diſtreſſe, and oppreſſed with debt, and of a penſiue hart, and he was made their prince, and there were with him about foure hundred men.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid departed from thence into Maſpha, which is Moab: and he ſaid to the king of Moab: Let my father and my mother tary with you, I beſech thee, til I know what God wil doe to me.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he left them before the face of the king of Moab, and they abode with him al the dayes, that Dauid was in garriſon.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Gad the prophet ſaid to Dauid: Tary not in garriſon, depart, and goe into the Land of Iuda. And Dauid departed, and came into the foreſt of Haret.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul heard that Dauid had appeared, and the men that were with him. And Saul when he abode in Gabaa, and was in the wood, which is in Rama, holding a ſpeare in his hand, and al his ſeruantes that ſtood about him,
label: 1 Kings

text: he ſayd to his ſeruantes that ſtoode about him: Heare me now ye children of Iemini: wil the ſonne of Iſai geue to al you fieldes, and vineyardes, and make al you tribunes, & centurions:
label: 1 Kings

text: becauſe you haue al conſpired againſt me, and there is none that telleth me, eſpecially where my ſonne alſo hath entred league with the ſonne of Iſai? There is none of you, that pitieth my caſe, neither is there that telleth me: for that my ſonne hath raiſed vp my ſeruant againſt me, lying in waite for me vntil this day.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Doeg the Idumeite which ſtood by, and was the chief among the ſeruantes of Saul, anſwering, I ſawe, quoth he, the ſonne of Iſai, in Nobe with Achimelech the ſonne of Achitob the prieſt.
label: 1 Kings

text: Who conſulted our Lord for him; and gaue him victuals, yea and the ſword of Goliath the Philiſtian he gaue to him.
label: 1 Kings

text: The king therefore ſent to cal for Achimelech the prieſt the ſonne of Achitob, and al his fathers houſe, the prieſtes that were in Nobe, who came al to the king.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſaid to Achimelec: Heare thou ſonne of Achitob. Who anſwered: I am readie, my Lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſaid to him: Why haue you conſpired againſt me, thou, and the ſonne of Iſai, and haſt geuen him bread and a ſword, and haſt conſulted our Lord for him, that he might riſe vp againſt me, continuing a traitour vntil this day?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Achimelech anſwering the king, ſaid: And who amongſt al thy ſeruantes faithful as Dauid, and the kings ſonne in lawe, and going fourth at thy commandmẽt, and glorious in thy houſe?
label: 1 Kings

text: Did I beginne this day to conſult our Lord for him? farre be this from me: let not the king ſuſpect ſuch a thing againſt his ſeruant, in al the houſe of my father: for thy ſeruant knew not any thing concerning this buſines, either litle or great.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the king ſaidy: Ding thou shalt dye Achimelec, thou, and al thy fathers houſe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the king ſaid to the curriers, that ſtood about him: Turne your ſelues, and kil the prieſts of our Lord, for their hand is with Dauid, knowing that he was fled, and they told me not. And the kings ſeruantes would not extend their handes vpon the prieſts of our Lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the king ſaid to Doeg: Turne thou, and runne vpon the prieſts. And Doeg the Idumeite being turned, ranne vpon the prieſts, and murdered in that day eightie fiue men reueſted with an ephod of linnnen.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Nobe the citie of the prieſts, he ſtroke in the edge of the ſword, men and wemen, and children, and ſucklinges, and oxe and aſſe, and shepe in the edge of the ſword.
label: 1 Kings

text: But one ſonne of Achimelech the ſonne of Achitob, eſcaping, whoſe name was Abiathar, fled to Dauid,
label: 1 Kings

text: and told him that Saul had ſlaine the prieſtes of our Lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid to Abiathar: I knew in that day when Doeg the Idumeit was there, without doubt he would tel Saul, I am giltie of al the ſoules of thy father.
label: 1 Kings

text: Abide with me, feare not: if any man shal ſeeke my life, he ſhal ſeeke thy life alſo, and with me thou shal be preſerued.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND they told Dauid, ſaying: Behold the Philiſtijms oppugne Ceila, and ſpoyle the barnes.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore conſulted our Lord, ſaying: Shal I goe, and ſtrike theſe Philiſtians? And our Lord ſayd to Dauid: Goe, and thou shalt ſtrike the Philiſtians, and shalt ſaue Ceila.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the men that were with Dauid, ſayd to him: Behold we reſting here in Iurie are afrayd, how much more if we shal goe into Ceila againſt the bandes of the Philiſtians?
label: 1 Kings

text: Againe therefore Dauid conſulted our Lord. Who anſwering ſayd to him: Ariſe, and goe into Ceila: for I wil deliuer the Philiſtians in thy hand.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore, and his men, went into Ceila, and fought againſt the Philiſtians, and droue away their beaſtes, and ſtroke them with a great ſlaughter, and Dauid ſaued the inhabitantes of Ceila.
label: 1 Kings

text: Moreouer at that time, when Abiathar the ſonne of Achimelech fled to Dauid into Ceila, he went downe hauing with him an ephod.
label: 1 Kings

text: And it was told Saul that Dauid was come into Ceila: and Saul ſayd: Our Lord hath deliuered him into my handes, and he is shut vp being entered the citie, wherein are gates and lockes.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul commanded al the people, that they should goe downe into Ceila to fight, and beſeige Dauid, and his men.
label: 1 Kings

text: Which when Dauid vnderſtood, that Saul ſecretly prepared euil againſt him, he ſayd to Abiathar the prieſt: Applie the Ephod.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd: Lord God of Iſrael, thy ſeruant hath heard a bruite, that Saul determineth to come into Ceila, to deſtroy the citie for me:
label: 1 Kings

text: Wil the men of Ceila deliuer me into his handes? and wil Saul come downe, as thy ſeruant hath heard? Lord God of Iſrael tel thy ſeruant. And our Lord ſayd: He wil come downe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid: Wil the men of Ceila deliuer me, and the men that are with me, into the handes of Saul? And our Lord ſayd: They wil deliuer thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore aroſe and his men about ſix hundred, and going out of Ceila, wandered hither and thither vncertaine: and it was told Saul that Dauid was fled from Ceila, and was ſaued: for which cauſe he diſſembled to goe forth.
label: 1 Kings

text: But Dauid abode in the deſert in moſt ſtrong places, and he taried in the mount of the deſert Ziph, in a shadowed hil. Saul notwithſtanding ſought him alwayes: and our Lord deliuered him not into his handes.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaw that Saul was gone forth to ſeeke his life. Moreouer Dauid was in the deſert Ziph, in a wood.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Ionathas the ſonne of Saul aroſe, and went to Dauid into the wood, and ſtrengthened his handes in God: and ſayd to him:
label: 1 Kings

text: Feare not: for neither shal the hand of Saul my father finde thee, and thou shalt reigne ouer Iſrael, and I shal be ſecond to thee, yea and my father knoweth this.
label: 1 Kings

text: Both therefore made a league before our Lord: and Dauid abode in the wood: but Ionathas returned into his houſe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the Zeipheites went vp vnto Saul in Gabaa, ſaying: Loe doth not Dauid lye hid with vs in the moſt ſafe places of the wood, in the Hil Hachila, which is on the right hand of the deſert?
label: 1 Kings

text: Now therefore, as thy ſoule hath deſired, come downe: & it shal be our charge to deliuer him into the kinges handes.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd: Bleſſed be ye of our Lord, becauſe you haue pitied my caſe.
label: 1 Kings

text: Goe therefore I pray you, and prepare diligently, and deale curiouſly, and conſider the place, where his foote is, and who hath ſeene him there, for he thinketh of me, that I craftely lye in waite for him.
label: 1 Kings

text: Conſider and ſee al his lurking holes, wherein he is hid, and returne to me with the certeintie of the thing, that I may goe with you. Yea and if he shal ſtoppe vp himſelfe into the earth, I wil ſearch him out among al the thouſandes of Iuda.
label: 1 Kings

text: But they riſing went into Ziph before Saul: and Dauid and his men were in the deſert Maon, in the champaine country at the right hand of Ieſimon.
label: 1 Kings

text: Saul therefore and his companie went to ſeeke him: and it was told Dauid, and forthwith he went downe to the rocke, and abode in the deſert Maon, which when Saul had heard, he purſued Dauid in the deſert Maon.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul went at the ſide of the mountaine on the one part: and Dauid and his men were in the ſide of the mountaine on the other part: moreouer Dauid deſpayred that he could eſcape, from the face of Saul: Saul therefore and his men in maner of a ring, compaſſed Dauid and his men, to take them.
label: 1 Kings

text: And a meſſenger came to Saul, ſaying: Make haſt, and come, becauſe the Philiſtijms haue powred in themſelues vpon the land.
label: 1 Kings

text: Saul therefore returned leauing of to purſew Dauid, and he went to meete the Philiſtians. for this cauſe, they called that place, the Rocke diuiding.
label: 1 Kings

text: DAVID therefore went vp from thence, and dwelt in the ſafeſt places of Engaddi.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when Saul was returned, after he purſued the Philiſtians, they told him, ſaying: Behold, Dauid is in the deſert Engaddi.
label: 1 Kings

text: Saul therefore taking vnto him three thouſand choſen men of al Iſrael, went forth to ſearch out Dauid, and his men, yea ouer the ſteepe broken rockes, which are acceſſible only to wilde goates.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he came to the shepcotes, which fel in his way as he went. and there was a caue, which Saul entred into, to doe his eaſement: moreouer Dauid and his men lay hid in the inner part of the caue.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the ſeruantes of Dauid ſayd to him: Behold the day, whereof our Lord ſayd to thee: I wil deliuer thee thyne enemie, that thou mayeſt doe to him as it ſhal ſeeme good in thyne eies. Dauid therefore aroſe, and cut of the hemme of Saules cloke ſoftly.
label: 1 Kings

text: After this Dauids hart ſtroke him, for that he had cut of the hemme of Saules cloke.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he ſayd to his men: Our Lord be merciful vnto me, that I doe not this thing to my Maiſter the annointed of our Lord, that I ſhould lay my hand vpon him, becauſe he is the annointed of our Lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid perſwaded his men with wordes, and permitted them not to riſe againſt Saul: moreouer Saul riſing out of the caue, went on his iourney begunne.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid roſe vp after him: and going out of the caue, cried behind Sauls backe, ſaying: My Lord King. And Saul looked backe behind him: and Dauid bowing himſelfe flat toward the ground adored,
label: 1 Kings

text: and ſayd to Saul: Why doeſt thou heare the wordes of men that ſay: Dauid ſeeketh euil againſt thee?
label: 1 Kings

text: Loe this day thyne eies haue ſeene, that our Lord deliuered thee in my hand, in the caue, and I had a cogitation to kil thee, but myn eie hath ſpared thee. For I ſayd: I wil not extend myn hand vpon my lord, becauſe he is the annointed of our Lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: But rather ſee and knowe, o my father, the hemme of thy cloke in my hand, that when I did cut of the hemme of thy cloke, I would not extend my hand vpon thee. Marke, and ſee, that there is no euil in my hand, nor iniquitie, neither haue I ſinned againſt thee: but thou lyeſt in waite for my life, to take it away.
label: 1 Kings

text: Our Lord iudge betwen me and thee, and our Lord reuenge me of thee, but be not my hand vpon thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: As alſo it is ſayd in the old prouerbe: FROM THE IMPIOVS shal impietie procede: be not therefore my hand vpon thee: Whom doeſt thou perſecute O King of Iſrael?
label: 1 Kings

text: Whom doeſt thou perſecute? thou perſecuteſt a dead dog, and a flea.
label: 1 Kings

text: Our Lord be iudge, & iudge betwen me and thee, and he ſee, and iudge my cauſe, and deliuer me out of thy hand.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when Dauid had fully ended ſpeaking ſuch wordes to Saul, Saul ſayd: Is this thy voice my ſonne Dauid? and Saul lifted vp his voice, and wept:
label: 1 Kings

text: and ſayd to Dauid: Thou art iuſter then I: for thou haſt donne me good turnes, and I haue rendred thee euil.
label: 1 Kings

text: And thou haſt shewed this day what good thinges thou haſt done to me: how our Lord deliuered me into thy hande and thou haſt not killed me.
label: 1 Kings

text: For who when he hath found his enemie, wil let him goe in a good way? But our Lord render thee this good turne, for that which thou haſt wrought toward me this day.
label: 1 Kings

text: And now becauſe I knowe that thou moſt certeinly shalt reigne, and haue the kingdome of Iſrael in thy hand:
label: 1 Kings

text: ſweare to me in our Lord, not to deſtroy my ſeede after me, nor to take away my name from the houſe of my father.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſware to Saul. Saul therefore went into his houſe: and Dauid and his men went vp into ſafer places.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND Samuel died, and al Iſrael was gathered together, and they mourned for him, and buried him in his houſe in Ramatha. And Dauid riſing went downe into the deſert of Pharan.
label: 1 Kings

text: And there was a certaine man in the wildernes of Maon, and his poſſeſſion in Carmel, and that man was exceding great: and he had three thouſand sheepe, & a thouſand goates: and it chanced that his flocke was shorne in Carmel.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the name of that man was Nabal: and the name of his wife Abigail. and that woman was very wiſe and beutiful: moreouer her huſband hard, and very il, and malicious: and he was of the kindred of Caleb.
label: 1 Kings

text: When Dauid therefore heard in the deſert, that Nabal sheared his flocke,
label: 1 Kings

text: he ſent tenne yong men, and ſayd to them: Goe vp into Carmel, and you shal come to Nabal, and shal ſalute him in my name peaceably.
label: 1 Kings

text: And you shal ſay: Peace be to my brethren, and to thee, and peace to thy houſe, and to al whatſoeuer thou haſt be peace.
label: 1 Kings

text: I haue heard, that thy shephards which were with vs in the deſert did sheare we haue neuer moleſted them, neither hath ought beene wanting to them at any time of the flocke, al the time that they were with vs in Carmel.
label: 1 Kings

text: Aske thy ſeruantes, and they wil tel thee. Now therefore let thy ſeruantes finde grace in thyne eies: for we are come in a good day, whatſoeuer thy hand shal finde, geue to thy ſeruantes, and to thy ſonne Dauid.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when Dauids ſeruantes were come, they ſpoke to Nabal al theſe wordes in Dauids name: and ſo held their peace.
label: 1 Kings

text: But Nabal anſwering the ſeruantes of Dauid, ſaid: Who is Dauid? and what is the ſonne of Iſai? There are ſeruantes multiplied now adaies which flee from their maſters.
label: 1 Kings

text: Shal I then take my breades, and my waters, and the flesh of my cattel, which I haue killed for my sheares, and geue to men whom I know nnt whence they are?
label: 1 Kings

text: Therefore the ſeruantes of Dauid returned by their way, and returning came and told him al the wordes that he had ſaid.
label: 1 Kings

text: Then ſayd Dauid to his ſeruantes: Euery man gird him with his ſworde. And they were euery one girded with their ſwordes. And Dauid alſo was girded with his ſworde: and there folowed Dauid about foure hundred men: moreouer two hundred remayned at the baggage.
label: 1 Kings

text: But to Abigail the wife of Nabal one of their ſeruantes told, ſaying: Behold Dauid hath ſent meſſengers from the deſert, to bleſſe our maiſter. & he diſdayned them:
label: 1 Kings

text: theſe men were good ynough to vs, and not trubleſome; neither did euer any thing perish al the time, that we haue couuerſt with them in the deſert:
label: 1 Kings

text: they were in ſteed of a wal to vs both in the day and in the night, al the dayes that we fed the flockes with them.
label: 1 Kings

text: Wherefore conſider, & thinke what thou haſt to doe, for malice is accomplished againſt thy huſband, and againſt thy houſe, and he is the ſonne of Belial, ſo that no man can ſpeake to him.
label: 1 Kings

text: Abigail therefore made haſt, and tooke two hundred loaues, and two bottels of wine, and fiue muttons ready dreſt, and fiue meaſures of polent, and a hundred branches of rayſens, and two hundred maſes of drie figges, and laid them vpon aſſes:
label: 1 Kings

text: and ſaid to her ſeruantes: Goe before me: loe, I wil folow you at your backe: but she told not her huſband Nabal.
label: 1 Kings

text: When she therefore had gotten vpon an aſſe, and came downe to the foote of the mountaine, Dauid and his men came downe meeting her, whom she alſo mette.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid: In vaine veryly haue I preſerued al thinges that were this mans in the deſert, and there periſhed nothing of al that perteined to him: and he hath rendred me euil for good.
label: 1 Kings

text: Theſe thinges doe God to the enemies of Dauid, and theſe thinges adde he, if I shal leaue of al thinges that perteine to him vntil morning, any thing piſſing againſt the wal.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when Abigail had ſeene Dauid, she made haſt, and light from her aſſe, and fel downe before Dauid vpon her face, aud adored vpon the earth,
label: 1 Kings

text: and fel at his feete, and ſayd: In me my lord be this iniquitie: let thy handmayde ſpeake I beſech thee in thine eares: and heare the wordes of thy ſeruant.
label: 1 Kings

text: Let not my lord the king I pray thee, ſet his hart vpon this naughtie man Nabal: becauſe according to his name, he is a foole, and follie is with him: but I thy handmaide ſawe not thy ſeruantes my lord, whom thou didſt ſend.
label: 1 Kings

text: Now therefore my lord, our Lord liueth, and thy ſoule liueth, who hath ſtayed thee that thou shouldeſt not come vnto blood, and hath ſaued thy hand to thee: and now be thine enemies as Nabal, and they that ſeeke euil to my lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: Wherefore receiue this benediction, which thy handmaide hath brought to thee my lord: and geue to thy ſeruantes that folow thee my lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: Take away the iniquitie of thy handmaide: for our Lord making wil make to my lord a faithful houſe, becauſe thou my lord doeſt fight the battels of our Lord: let not malice therefore be found in thee al the dayes of thy life.
label: 1 Kings

text: For if a man shal riſe, perſecuting thee, and ſeeking thy life, the life of my lord ſhal be kept, as in the bundel of the liuing, with our Lord thy God: Moreouer the life of thine enemies shal be whurled, and in the violence, and whurle of a ſling.
label: 1 Kings

text: When our Lord therefore shal doe to thee, my lord, al good thinges, which he hath ſpoken concerning thee, and shal conſtitute thee prince ouer Iſrael,
label: 1 Kings

text: this shal not be an occaſion of ſobbing to thee, and a ſcruple of hart to my lord, that thou haſt ſhed innocent blood, or thy ſelfe haſt reuenged thy ſelfe: and when our Lord hath beſtowed theſe benefites vpon my lord, thou shalt remember thy handmaide.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to Abigail: Bleſſed be our Lord the God of Iſrael, who hath ſent thee this day to meete me, and bleſſed be thy ſpeach,
label: 1 Kings

text: and bleſſed be thou, which haſt ſtayed me to day, that I might not goe to blood, and reuenge me with myn owne hand.
label: 1 Kings

text: Otherwiſe our Lord liueth the God of Iſrael, who hath ſtaied me, that I should not doe thee any euil: vnles thou hadſt quickely come to meete me, there had not remained to Nabal vntil morning light, any piſſing againſt a wal.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid tooke of her hand al thinges which she had brought him, and ſaid to her: Goe peaceable into thy houſe, behold I haue heard thy voice, and haue honoured thy face.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Abigail came to Nabal: and behold he had a feaſt in his houſe, as it were the feaſt of a king, and Nabals hart was pleaſant: for he was drunke excedingly: and she told him not a word little or great vntil morning.
label: 1 Kings

text: But early when Nabal had digeſted his wine, his wife told him theſe wordes, and his hart was dead inwardly, and he became as a ſtone.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when ten dayes had paſſed, our Lord ſtroke Nabal, and he died.
label: 1 Kings

text: Which when Dauid had heard that Nabal was dead, he ſayd: Bleſſed be our Lord, who hath iudged the cauſe of my reproch at the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his ſeruant from euil, and the malice of Nabal hath our Lord rendred vpon his head. Dauid therefore ſent, and ſpake to Abigail, that he might take her to himſelfe to wife.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauids ſeruantes came to Abigail into Carmel, and ſpake to her, ſaing: Dauid hath ſent vs vnto thee, to take thee to his wife.
label: 1 Kings

text: Who ariſing adored flat toward the earth, and ſayd: Loe let thy ſeruant be as an handmaide, to wash the feete of the ſeruantes of my lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Abigail aroſe, and made haſt, and gatte vpon an aſſe, and fiue wemen went with her waiting maides, and folowed the meſſengers of Dauid, and became his wife.
label: 1 Kings

text: Yea and Achinoam alſo did Dauid take of Iezrahel: and both were his wiues.
label: 1 Kings

text: But Saul gaue Michol his daughter Dauids wife to Phalti, the ſonne of Lais, who was of Gallim.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND there came Zepheites vnto Saul in Gabaa, ſaying: Behold Dauid is hid in the hil Hachila, which is ouer againſt the wildernes.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul aroſe, and went downe into the deſert Ziph, and with him three thouſand men of the choſen of Iſrael, to ſeeke Dauid in the deſert Ziph.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul camped in Gabaa Hachila, which was ouer againſt the wildernes in the way: and Dauid dwelt in the deſert. And ſeing that Saul was come after him into the deſet,
label: 1 Kings

text: he ſent diſcouerers, and lerned that he was come thither moſt certainly.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid aroſe ſecretly, and came to the place where Saul was: and when he had ſeene the place, wherein Saul ſlept, and Abner the ſonne of Ner, the prince of his warre, and Saul ſleeping in the tent, and the reſt of the multitude round about him,
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid ſpake to Achimelech the Hetheit, and Abiſai the ſonne of Seruia the brother of Ioab, ſaying: Who wil goe downe with me to Saul into the campe? And Abiſai ſaid: I wil goe with thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore and Abiſai came to the people by night, and found Saul lying and ſleeping in the tent, and his ſpeare fixed in the ground at his head: and Abner, and the people ſleeping round about him.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Abiſai ſaid to Dauid: God hath shut vp thine enemie this day into thy handes: now therefore I wil thruſt him through with my ſpeare in the earth once, and twiſe shal not neede.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid to Abiſai: Kil him not: for who shal extend his hand vpon the annointed of our Lord, & shal be innocent?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid: Our Lord liueth, vnleſſe our Lord shal ſtrike him, or his day come to die, or deſcendig into battel he perish:
label: 1 Kings

text: Our Lord be merciful vnto me, that I extend not my hand vpon the annointed of our Lord. now therefore take the ſpeare, which is at his head, & cuppe of water, and let vs goe.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore tooke the ſpeare, and cuppe of water, which was at Saules head, and they went away: and there was none that ſawe, or vnderſtood, or awaked, but al ſlept, becauſe the dead ſleepe of our Lord. had fallen vpon them.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when Dauid had paſſed ouer againſt, and ſtood in the toppe of the mountaine farre of, and a good ſpace betwen them,
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid cried to the people, and to Abner the ſonne of Ner, ſaying: Wilt thou not anſwer Abner? And Abner anſwering ſayd: Who art thou, that crieſt and diſquieteſt the king?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to Abner: Art not thou a man? And who is like thee in Iſrael? why therefore haſt thou not kept thy lord the king? for one of the multitude hath entered in to kil the king thy lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: This thing is not good, which you haue done: Our Lord liueth, you are the children of death, which haue not kept your lord, the annointed of our Lord. Now therefore behold where the kinges ſpeare is, & where the cup of water is, which was at his head.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul knew Dauids voice, and ſayd: Is this thy voice, my ſonne Dauid? And Dauid ſayd: My voice, my lord king,
label: 1 Kings

text: and he ſaid: For what cauſe doth my lord perſecute his ſeruant? What haue I done? or what euil is there in my hand?
label: 1 Kings

text: Now therefore heare, I pray, my lord King, the wordes of thy ſeruant: If our Lord ſtirre thee vp againſt me, let there be odoure of ſacrifice: but if the ſonnes of men, they are curſed in the ſight of our Lord, which haue caſt me out this day, that I should not dwel in the inheritance of our Lord, ſaying: Goe, ſerue ſtrange goddes.
label: 1 Kings

text: And now let not my blood be shed vpon the earth before our Lord, for the king of Iſrael, is come forth to ſeeke one flea, as the perdix is purſued in the mountaines.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd: I haue ſinned, returne my ſonne Dauid, for I wil no more doe thee euil, for that my life hath bene precious in thyne eies to day: for it appeareth that I haue done foolishly, and haue bene ignorant of very many thinges.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid anſwering, ſayd: Behold the kings ſpeare, let one of the kings ſeruants paſſe, and take it.
label: 1 Kings

text: And our Lord wil reward euerie one according to his iuſtice, and fidelitie: for our Lord hath deliuered thee this day into my hand, & I would not extend my hand vpon the annointed of our Lord.
label: 1 Kings

text: And as thy life hath bene magnified to day in myne eies, ſo be my life magnified in the eies of our Lord, and deliuer he me from al diſtreſſe.
label: 1 Kings

text: Saul therefore ſayd to Dauid: Bleſſed art thou my ſonne Dauid: and truly doing thou shalt doe, and preuayling thou shalt preuaile. And Dauid went into his way, and Saul returned into his place.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND Dauid ſayd in his hart: at length I shal fal one day into the handes of Saul: is it not better that I flee, and be ſaued in the Land of the Philiſtians, that Saul may deſpaire, and ceaſe to ſeeke me in al the coaſtes of Iſrael? I wil flee therefore his handes.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid aroſe, and went himſelfe, and the ſix hundred men with him, to Achis the ſonne of Maoch, the King of Geth.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid dwelt with Achis in Geth, he and his men; euerie man & his houſe, and his two wiues, Achinoam the Iezrahelite, and Abigail the wife of Nabal of Carmel.
label: 1 Kings

text: And it was told Saul that Dauid was fled into Geth, and he added no more to ſeeke him.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to Achis: If I haue grace in thy ſight, let there a place be geuen me in one of thy cities of this countrie, that I may dwel there: for why abideth thy ſeruant in the citie of the king with thee?
label: 1 Kings

text: Achis therefore gaue him in that day Siceleg: for which cauſe Siceleg became the kinges of Iuda vntil this day.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the number of the daies, that Dauid dwelt in the country of the Philiſtians, was foure monethes.
label: 1 Kings
