text: And Dauid went vp, and his men, and draue prayes out of Geſſuri, and Gerzi, and from the Amalecites: for theſe villages were inhabited in the land in old time, as men goe to Sur, as farre as the Land of Ægypt.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſtroke al the land, neither left he anie man or woman: and taking the ſheepe & oxen, and aſſes, & camels, and garments, he returned & came to Achis.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Achis ſayd to him: Whom haſt thou ſet vpon to day? Dauid anſwered: Againſt the ſouth of Iuda, and againſt the ſouth of Ieramiel, and againſt the ſouth of Ceni.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid gaue life neither to man nor woman, neither brought them into Geth, ſaying: Leſt perhaps they ſpeake againſt vs. Theſe thinges did Dauid, and this was decreed of him al the daies that he dwelt in the countrie of the Philiſtians.
label: 1 Kings

text: Achis therefore did credite Dauid, ſaying: Manie euils hath he wrought againſt his people Iſrael: Therefore he shal be my ſeruant for euer.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND it came to paſſe that in thoſe daies the Philiſtijms gathered together their companies, that they might be prepared to battel againſt Iſrael: and Achis ſayd to Dauid: Knowing know thou now, that thou shalt goe forth with me in the campe, thou, and thy men.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to Achis: Now thou shalt know what thy ſeruant wil doe. And Achis ſayd to Dauid: And I wil appoint thee keper of my head al daies.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel was dead, and al Iſrael mourned for him, and buried him in Ramatha his citie. And Saul tooke al the magicians and ſoothſayers out of the land.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the Philiſtijms were gathered together, and came and camped in Sunam: and Saul alſo gathered together al Iſrael, and came into Gelboe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſaw the campe of the Philiſtijms, and feared, and his hart was afrayd excedingly.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he conſulted our Lord, and he anſwered him not, neither by dreames, nor by prieſtes, nor by prophetes.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd to his ſeruantes: Seeke me a woman that hath a pithonical ſpirite, and I wil goe to her, and wil aske by her. And his ſeruantes ſayd to him: There is a woman that hath a pithonical ſpirite in Endor.
label: 1 Kings

text: He therefore changed his habite and was clothed with other garmentes, and he went himſelfe, and two men with him, and they came to the woman in the night, and ſayd to her: Deuine vnto me in the pythonical ſpirite, and raiſe me vp whom I shal tel thee.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the woman ſayd to him: Loe, thou knoweſt what great thinges Saul hath done, and how he hath rayſed the magicians and ſothſayers out of the land: why therefore doeſt thou lye in waite for my life, that I may be ſlaine?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſware vnto her in our Lord, ſaying: Our Lord liueth, there shal no euil happen vnto thee for this thing.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the woman ſayd to him: Whom ſhal I rayſe vp to thee? Who ſayd: Raiſe me vp Samuel.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when the woman had ſeene Samuel, she cried out with a loud voice, and ſayd to Saul: Why haſt thou deceiued me? for thou art Saul.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the King ſayd to her: Feare not: what ſaweſt thou? And the woman ſayd to Saul: I ſaw Goddes coming out of the earth.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he ſayd to her: What maner of forme hath he? who ſayd: An old man is come vp, and he is clothed with a mantel. And Saul vnderſtood that it was Samuel, and he bowed himſelfe vpon his face on the earth, and adored.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſayd to Saul: why haſt thou diſquieted me, that I should be raiſed vp? And Saul ſayd, I am in great diſtreſſe: for the Philiſtijms fight againſt me, and God is departed from me, and would not heare me, neither in the hand of prophetes, nor by dreames: therefore I haue called thee, that thou shouldeſt shew me, what I shal doe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Samuel ſayd: Why askeſt thou, whereas our Lord is departed from thee, and is paſſed to thine aduerſarie?
label: 1 Kings

text: For our Lord wil doe to thee as he ſpake in my hand, and he wil cut thy kingdome out of thy hand, & wil geue it to thy neighbour Dauid:
label: 1 Kings

text: becauſe thou haſt not obeyed the voice of our Lord, neither didſt thou the wrath of his furie in Amalec. Therefore that which thou ſuffereſt hath our Lord done to thee this day.
label: 1 Kings

text: And our Lord wil geue Iſrael alſo with thee into the handes of the Philiſtijms: and to morow thou and thy ſonnes shal be with me: yea the campe alſo of Iſrael wil our Lord deliuer into the handes of the Philiſthijms.
label: 1 Kings

text: And forthwith Saul fel ſtretched forth on the ground, for he feared much the wordes of Samuel, and there was no ſtrength in him, becauſe he had not eaten bread al that day.
label: 1 Kings

text: That woman therefore went vnto Saul (for he was very much trubled) and ſayd to him: Behold thy handmaide hath obeied thy voice, and I haue put my life in my hand: and I heard the wordes, which thou ſpakeſt to me.
label: 1 Kings

text: Now therefore heare thou alſo the voice of thy handmaide, and I wil ſet before thee a morſel of bread, that eating thou mayeſt recouer ſtrength, and be able to goe on thy iourney.
label: 1 Kings

text: Who refuſed, and ſayd: I wil not eate. But his ſeruantes and the woman forced him, and at length hearing their voice, he aroſe from the ground, and ſate vpon the bed.
label: 1 Kings

text: And that woman had a paſture fed calfe in the houſe, and ſhe made haſt, and killed him: and taking meale kneded it, and baked azimes,
label: 1 Kings

text: and ſette before Saul, and before his ſeruantes, who when they had eaten roſe vp, and walked al that night.
label: 1 Kings

text: THEREFORE al the companies of the Philiſtijms were gathered together into Aphec: and Iſrael alſo camped vpon the fountaine, which was in Iezrahel.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the princes in dede of the Philiſtijms marched in hundreds and thouſandes: but Dauid and his men were in the laſt companie with Achis.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the princes of the Philiſtijms ſayd to Achis: What meane theſe Hebrewes? And Achis ſayd to the princes of the Philiſtijms: Doe you not knowe Dauid, which was the ſeruant of Saul the king of Iſrael, and is with me manie daies, or yeares, and I haue not found any thing in him, ſince the day that he fled to me, vntil this day?
label: 1 Kings

text: But the princes of the Philiſtijms were angrie againſt him, and ſayd to him: Let this man returne, and abide in his place, wherein thou haſt appointed him, and let him not goe downe with vs into battel, leſt he become an aduerſarie to vs, when we shal beginne to fight: for how can he otherwiſe pacifie his lord, but in our heades?
label: 1 Kings

text: Is not this Dauid, to whom they ſang in dances, ſaying: Saul hath ſtrooke his thouſandes, & Dauid his ten thouſandes?
label: 1 Kings

text: Achis therefore called Dauid, and ſayd to him: The Lord liueth, thou art iuſt, and good in my ſight: and thy going out, & thy coming in is with me in the campe: and I haue not found in thee anie euil, ſince the day that thou cameſt to me vntil this day: but thou pleaſeſt not the nobles.
label: 1 Kings

text: Returne therefore, and goe in peace, and offend not the eies of the princes of the Philiſtijms.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to Achis: For what haue I done, and what haſt thou found in me thy ſeruant, ſince the day that I haue beene in thy ſight, vntil this day, that I may not come, and fight againſt the enemies of my lord the King?
label: 1 Kings

text: And Achis anſwering ſpake to Dauid: I know that thou art good in my ſight, as an Angel of God: but the princes of the Philiſtijms haue ſayd: He shal not goe vp with vs into battel.
label: 1 Kings

text: Therefore ariſe in the morning, thou, and the ſeruantes of thy lord, which came with thee: and when you are riſen in the night, and it shal beginne to waxe light, goe foreward.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore aroſe in the night, he and his men, that they might ſette foreward in the morning, and returne to the land of the Philiſtijms: and the Philiſtijms went vp into Iezrahel.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND when Dauid and his men were come to Siceleg the third day, the Amalecites had made an inuaſion on the ſouth ſide into Siceleg, and had ſtrooken Siceleg, and burnt it with fire.
label: 1 Kings

text: And had led away wemen captiue out of it, from the leſſe vnto the great: and had not killed any man, but had led them with them, and went on their iourney.
label: 1 Kings

text: When Dauid therefore and his men were come to the citie, and had found it burnt with fire, and their wiues, and their ſonnes, and their daughters to be led away captiue,
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid and the people that was with him, lifted vp their voices, and mourned til teares fayled them.
label: 1 Kings

text: For the two wiues alſo of Dauid were led away captiue, Achinoam the Iezraelite, and Abigail the wife of Nabal of Carmel.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid was ſtrooken very ſad: for the people would haue ſtoned him, becauſe the ſoule of euerie man was bitterly affected vpon their ſonnes, and daughters: but Dauid was ſtrengthened in our Lord his God.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he ſayd to Abiathar the prieſt the ſonne of Achimelech: Applie vnto me the Ephod. And Abiathar applied the Ephod to Dauid,
label: 1 Kings

text: and Dauid conſulted our Lord, ſaying: Shal I purſue theſe theeues, and shal I take them or no? And our Lord ſayd to him: Purſue them: for thou shalt take them without doubt, & take from them the praye.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore went himſelfe, and the ſix hundred men that were with him, and they came vnto the Torrent Beſor: & ſome being wearie ſtayed.
label: 1 Kings

text: But Dauid himſelf, and foure hundred men purſued: for two hundred ſtayed, who being wearie could not paſſe the Torrent Beſor.
label: 1 Kings

text: And they found an Ægyptian in the field, and brought him to Dauid: and they gaue him bread to eate, and water to drink,
label: 1 Kings

text: and alſo a peece of a maſſe of drie figges, and two bunches of reſinnes. Who when he had eaten, his ſpirite returned, and he was refreshed: for he had not eaten bread, nor drunken water three daies, and three nightes.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore ſayd to him. Whoſe art thou? or whence? and whither goeſt thou? who ſayd: I am a yong man of Ægypt, the ſeruant of an Amalacite: and my maiſter hath leift me, becauſe I began to be ſicke three daies agone.
label: 1 Kings

text: For we brake forth at the ſouth ſide of Cerethi, and againſt Iuda, and at the ſouth of Caleb, and burnt Siceleg with fire.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to him: Canſt thou bring me to this companie? Who ſayd: Sweare to me by God, that thou wilt not kil me, nor deliuer me into the handes of my lord, and I wil bring thee to this companie. And Dauid ſware to him.
label: 1 Kings

text: Who when he had brought them, behold they ſate vpon the face of al the earth, eating and drinking, and as it were keping feſtiual day, for al the praye, and ſpoiles which they had taken out of the Land of the Philiſtijms, and out of the Land of Iuda.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid ſtroke them from euening vntil the euening of the next day, and there eſcaped not anie of them, but foure hundred yong men, which had gotten vpon camels, and were fled.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore reskewed al thinges, that the Amalecites had taken, and he reskewed his two wiues.
label: 1 Kings

text: Neither was there anie wanting from litle to great as wel of their ſonnes as of their daughters, and of the ſpoiles, and what thinges ſoeuer they had taken, Dauid brought al againe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And he tooke al the flockes & heardes, and draue them before his face: and they ſayd: This is the praye of Dauid.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Dauid came to the two hundred men, which being wearie had ſtaied, neither were able to folow Dauid, and he had bidden them to reſt in the Torrent Beſor: who came forth to meete Dauid, and the people that were with him. And Dauid coming to the people, ſaluted them peaceably.
label: 1 Kings

text: And euerie naughtie, and wicked felow of the men, that had gone with Dauid anſwering, ſayd: Becauſe they came not with vs, we wil not geue them anie thing of the praye, which we haue recouered: but let their wife and children ſuffice euerie man, whom when they haue receiued, let them depart.
label: 1 Kings

text: But Dauid ſayd: You shal not doe ſo my brethren, of theſe thinges, which our Lord hath deliuered to vs, and hath kept vs, and hath geuen the theeues, that were broken out againſt vs, into our handes:
label: 1 Kings

text: neither shal anie man heare you vpon this talke. For there, shal be equal portion of him that went downe into battel, and of him that abode at the baggage, & they shal diuide alike.
label: 1 Kings

text: And this hath beene downe from that day, and euer after it was decreed, and ordained as a law in Iſrael.
label: 1 Kings

text: Dauid therefore came into Siceleg, and ſent giftes of the praye to the ancientes of Iuda his neighboures, ſaying: Take a benediction of the praye of our Lords enemies.
label: 1 Kings

text: To them, that were in Bethel, and that were in Ramoth toward the South, and them that were in Gether,
label: 1 Kings

text: and them in Aroer, and them in Sephamoth, and them in Eſthamo,
label: 1 Kings

text: and them in Rachal, and them in the cities of Ierameel, and them in the cities of Semi,
label: 1 Kings

text: and them in Harama, and them in the lake of Aſan, and them in Athach,
label: 1 Kings

text: and them in Hebron, and to the reſt that were in thoſe places, in the which Dauid had taried, and his men.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND the Philiſtijms fought againſt Iſrael, and the men of Iſrael fled before the face of the Philiſtijms, and fel being ſlaine in mount Gelboe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the Philiſtijms fel vpon Saul, and vpon his ſonnes, and they ſtroke Ionathas, and Abinadab, and Melchiſua the ſonnes of Saul,
label: 1 Kings

text: and the whole weight of the battel was turned vpon Saul: and the archers ouertooke him, and he was ſore wounded of the archers.
label: 1 Kings

text: And Saul ſayd to his eſquier: Drawe out thy ſword, and ſtrike me: leſt perhaps theſe vncircumciſed come, and kilme, mocking me. And his eſquier would not: for he was frighted with exceding feare. Saul therefore caught his ſword, and fel vpon it.
label: 1 Kings

text: Which when his eſquier had ſeene, to wit that Saul was dead, himſelfe alſo fel vpon his ſword and died with him.
label: 1 Kings

text: Saul therefore died, and his three ſonnes, & his eſquier, and al his men in that day together.
label: 1 Kings

text: And the children of Iſrael, that were beyond the valley, and beyond Iordan, ſeing that the men of Iſrael were fled, and that Saul was dead, and his ſonnes, they left their cities, and fled: and the Philiſtijms came, and dwelt there.
label: 1 Kings

text: And when the next day was come, the Philiſtijms came to ſpoile them that were ſlaine, and they found Saul and his three ſonnes, lying in mount Gelboe.
label: 1 Kings

text: And they did cut of Saules head, and ſpoiled him of his armour, and ſent into the land of the Philiſtians round about, that it ſhould be declared in the temple of their Idols, and among their people.
label: 1 Kings

text: And they did put his armour in the temple of Aſtaroth, but his bodie they hung on the wal of Bethſam.
label: 1 Kings

text: Which when the inhabiters of Iabes Galaad had heard whatſoeuer the Philiſtijms had done to Saul,
label: 1 Kings

text: al the moſt valiant men aroſe, & walked al the night, and tooke the bodie of Saul, and the bodies of his ſonnes, from the wal of Bethſam: and they came to Iabes Galaad, and burnt them there:
label: 1 Kings

text: and they tooke their bones, and buried them in the wood of Iabes, and faſted ſeuen daies.
label: 1 Kings

text: AND it came to paſſe, after that Saul was dead, that Dauid returned from rhe ſlaughter of Amalec, and taryed in Siceleg two dayes.
label: 2 Kings

text: And in the third day there appeared a man coming out of Sauls campe, his garments torne, and ſprinkled on the head with duſt, and as he came to Dauid, he fel vpon his face, and adored.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid vnto him: Whence comeſt thou? Who ſaid to him: I fledde out of the campe of Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid vnto him: What is the matter that is done? tel me. Who ſaid: The people is fled out of the battel, and many of the people are ouerthrowen and dead: yea Saul alſo and Ionathas his ſonne are dead.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid to the yong man that told him: How knoweſt thou that Saul is dead, and Ionathas his ſonne?
label: 2 Kings

text: And the young man that told him, ſayd: By chance I came into mount Gelboe, and Saul leaned vpon his ſpeare: moreouer the chariots and horſemen approched vnto him,
label: 2 Kings

text: and turning backward, and ſeing me he called. To whom when I had anſwered, here I am:
label: 2 Kings

text: he ſaid to me: Who art thou? And I ſaid to him: I am an Amalecite,
label: 2 Kings

text: And he ſaid to me: Stand vpon me, and kil me: becauſe anguishes hold me, and as yet al my life is in me.
label: 2 Kings

text: And ſtanding vpon him, I killed him: for I knewe that he could not liue after the fal: and I tooke the Diademe that was on his head, & the bracelette from his arme, and haue brought to thee my lord hither.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid taking his garments rent them, and al the men that were with him,
label: 2 Kings

text: and they mourned, and wept, and faſted vntil euening vpon Saul and vpon Ionathas his ſonne, and vpon the people of our Lord, and vpon the houſe of Iſrael, becauſe they were fallen by the ſword.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid to the yong man that had told him: Whence art thou? Who anſwered: I am the ſonne of a man a ſtranger of Amalec.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid ſaid to him: Why didſt thou not feare to put to thy hand, to kil the annointed of our Lord?
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid calling one of his ſeruants, ſaid: Goe runne vpon him. Who ſtroke him, and he died.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid to him: Thy bloud be vpon thine owne head: for thyn owne mouth hath ſpoken againſt thee, ſaying: I haue ſlaine the annointed of our Lord.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid mourned this kind of mourning vpon Saul, and vpon Ionathas his ſonne,
label: 2 Kings

text: (and he commanded that they should teach the children of Iuda the bowe, as it is written in the Booke of the iuſt.) And he ſaid: Conſider, o Iſrael for them that be dead wounded vpon thy high places.
label: 2 Kings

text: The Nobles, ô Iſrael, are ſlaine vpon thy mountaynes: how are the valiants fallen?
label: 2 Kings

text: Tel it not in Geth, neither tel ye it in the high waies of Aſcalon: leſt perhaps the daughters of the Philiſthijms be gladde, leſt the daughters of the vncircumciſed reioice.
label: 2 Kings

text: Mountaines of Gelboe, let neither dew, nor rayne come vpon you, neither be they fields of the firſt fruits: becauſe there was the ſhield of the valiantes caſt away, the shield of Saul, as though he were not annointed with oyle.
label: 2 Kings

text: From the bloud of the ſlaine, from the fatte of the valiants, the arrowe of Ionathas neuer returned backward, and the ſword of Saul did not returne emptie.
label: 2 Kings

text: Saul and Ionathas amiable, and comely in their life, in death alſo were not diuided: ſwifter then eagles, ſtronger then lyons.
label: 2 Kings

text: Yee daughters of Iſrael weepe vpon Saul, who clothed you with ſcarlet in delicaces, who gaue golden ornaments to yout attyre.
label: 2 Kings

text: How haue the valiantes fallen in battel? Ionathas bene ſlayne in thy high places?
label: 2 Kings

text: I am ſorie for thee my brother Ionathas exceeding beautiful, and amiable aboue the loue of wemen. As the mother loueth her onlie ſonne, ſo did I loue thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: How haue the ſtrong fallen, and the weapons of warre perished?
label: 2 Kings

text: THHEREFORE after theſe thinges Dauid conſulted our Lord, ſaying: Shal I goe vp into one of the cities of Iuda? And our Lord ſaid to him: Goe vp. And Dauid ſaid: whither shal I goe vp? And he anſwered him: Into Hebron.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therefore went vp, and his two wiues, Achinoam the Iezrahelite, and Abigail the wife of Nabal of Carmel:
label: 2 Kings

text: yea and the men alſo that were with him, Dauid brought euery one with his houshould: and they abode in the townes of Hebron.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the men of Iuda came, and annoynted Dauid there, to reigne ouer the houſe of Iuda. And it was told Dauid, that the men of Iabes Galaad had buried Saul.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therefore ſent meſſengers vnto the men of Iabes Galaad, and ſayd vnto them: Bleſſed be you to our Lord, which haue done this mercie with your lord Saul, and haue buried him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And now our Lord certes wil render you mercie and truth: but I alſo wil requite you the good turne, for that you haue done this thing.
label: 2 Kings

text: Let your handes be ſtrengthned, and be yee ſtout men: for although your lord Saul be dead, yet the houſe of Iuda hath annointed me to be their king.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Abner the ſonne of Ner prince of Sauls armie, tooke Iſboſeth the ſonne of Saul, & led him about through the campe,
label: 2 Kings

text: and ordained him king ouer Galaad, and ouer Geſſuri, and ouer Iezrahel, & ouer Ephraim, and ouer Beniamin, and ouer al Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: Fourtie yeares old was Iſboſeth the ſonne of Saul when he began to reigne ouer Iſrael, and he reigned two yeares: and only the houſe of Iuda folowed Dauid.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the number of the daies, that Dauid abode, reigning in Hebron ouer the houſe of Iuda, was ſeuen yeares and ſix monethes.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abner the ſonne of Ner went forth, and the ſeruantes of Iſboſeth the ſonne of Saul, out of the campe into Gabaon.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer Ioab the ſonne of Saruia, and the ſeruants of Dauid went forth, and mette them beſide the poole of Gabaon, and when they were come together into one place, they ſate one ouer againſt an other: theſe on the one ſide of the poole, and they on the other.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abner ſaid to Ioab: Let the yong men riſe, and play before vs. And Ioab anſwered: Let them riſe.
label: 2 Kings

text: There roſe therefore and paſſed twelue in number, of Beniamin, of Iſboſeths part the ſonne of Saul, and twelue of the ſeruantes of Dauid.
label: 2 Kings

text: And euery one taking the head of his mate, ſticked his ſword into the ſide of his aduerſarie, and they fel together: & the name of the place was called: The field of the valiantes, in Gabaon.
label: 2 Kings

text: And there roſe a very ſore battel in that day: and Abner was put to flight, & the men of Iſrael, by the ſeruantes of Dauid.
label: 2 Kings

text: And there were there the three ſonnes of Saruia, Ioab, and Abiſai, and Aſael: moreouer Aſael was a moſt ſwift runner, as it were one of the roes, that abide in the wooddes.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Aſael purſued Abner, and declined not to the right hand nor to the left omitting to purſue Abner.
label: 2 Kings

text: Abner therefore looked backe behind him, and ſaid: Art thou Aſael? Who anſwered: I am.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abner ſaid to him: Goe to the right hand, or to the left, and apprehend one of the youug men, and take to thee his ſpoyles. But Aſael would not leaue but vrged him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And againe Abner ſaid to Aſael: Retyre, and do not folowe me, leſt I be compelled to ſticke thee to the ground, and I shal not be able to lift vp my face to Ioab thy brother.
label: 2 Kings

text: Who contemned to heare, and would not goe aſide: Abner therefore ſtroke him, with his ſpeare turned backe in the priuy partes, and thruſt him through, and he dyed in the ſame place: and al that paſſed by that place, wherein Aſael fel and dyed, did ſtay.
label: 2 Kings

text: But whiles Ioab and Abiſai purſued Abner fleeing, the ſunne went downe: and they came as farre as the hil of the water conduit, that is ouer againſt the valley the way of the deſert in Gabaon.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the children of Beniamin were aſſembled together to Abner: and being gathered in a plumpe, into one troupe, they ſtoode in the toppe of one hil.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abner cried out to Ioab, and ſaid: Shal thy ſword rage vnto vtter deſtructrion? knoweſt thou not that deſperation is dangerous? how long differreſt thou to ſay to the people, that they leaue to purſue their brethren?
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab ſaid: Our Lord liueth, if thou hadeſt ſpoken, in the morning had the people retyred, from purſuing their brethren.
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therefore ſounded the trumpette, and al the armie ſtood, neither did they purſue Iſrael any further, nor enter into fight.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abner and his men went through the champaine country, al that night: and they paſſed Iordan, and hauing viewed al Beth horon, came to the campe.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer Ioab returning, after he had leift Abner, aſſembled al the people: and there wanted of Dauids ſeruantes nintene men, beſide Aſael.
label: 2 Kings

text: But the ſeruantes of Dauid ſtroke of Beniamin, and of the men, that were with Abner three hundred three ſcore, who alſo died.
label: 2 Kings

text: And they tooke Aſael, & buried him in the ſepulchre of his father in Bethlehem: and Ioab, and the men that were with him, walked al the night, and in the very twilight they came into Hebron.
label: 2 Kings

text: THERE was made therefore long ſtrife betwen the houſe of Saul, and betwen the houſe of Dauid: Dauid proſpering and alwaies ſtronger then himſelf, but the houſe of Saul decreaſing daily.
label: 2 Kings

text: And there were ſonnes borne to Dauid in Hebron: and his firſt begotten was Amnon of Achinoam the Iezrahelite.
label: 2 Kings

text: And after him Cheleab of Abigail the wife of Nabal of Carmel: moreouer the third Abſalom the ſonne of Maacha the daughter of Tolmai king of Geſſur.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the fourth Adonias, the ſonne of Haggith: and the fifth Saphathia, the ſonne of Abital.
label: 2 Kings

text: The ſixt alſo Iethraam of Egla the wife of Dauid. theſe were borne to Dauid in Hebron.
label: 2 Kings

text: Therefore when there was battel betwen the houſe of Saul and houſe of Dauid, Abner the ſonne of Ner ruled the houſe of Saul.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Saul had a concubine named Reſpha, the daughter of Aia. And Iſboſeth ſaid to Abner:
label: 2 Kings

text: Why diddeſt thou go in to my fathers concubine? Who being wrath exceedingly for the wordes of Iſboſeth, ſaid: What am I a dogges head againſt Iuda this day, which haue done mercie vpon the houſe of Saul thy father, and vpon his brethren and neereſt freinds, & haue not deliuered thee into the hands of Dauid, & haſt thou ſought againſt me that thou mighteſt charge me for a woman to day?
label: 2 Kings

text: Theſe things do God to Abner, and theſe things adde he to him, vnleſſe as our Lord hath ſworne to Dauid, ſo I doe truth to him.
label: 2 Kings

text: That the kingdom be transferred from the houſe of Saul, and the throne of Dauid be exalted ouer Iſrael, and ouer Iuda, from Dan to Berſabee.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he could not anſwer him any thing, becauſe he feared him.
label: 2 Kings

text: Abner therefore ſent meſſengers to Dauid for himſelf ſaying: Whoſe is the land? And that they should ſay: Make amitie with me, & my hand shal be with thee: and I wil reduce vnto thee al Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: Who ſaid: Very wel: I wil make amitie with thee: but one thing I deſire of thee, ſaying: Thou shalt not ſee my face before thou bring Michol the daughter of Saul: and ſo thou shalt come, and ſee me.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſent meſſengers to Iſboſeth the ſonne of Saul, ſaying: Reſtore my wife Michol, which I betrothed to me for an hundred prepuces of the Philiſthijms.
label: 2 Kings

text: Iſboſeth therefore ſent, and tooke her from her huſband Phaltiel, the ſonne of Lais.
label: 2 Kings

text: And her huſband folowed her, weeping as farre as Bahurim: and Abner ſaid to him: Goe, and returne. Who returned.
label: 2 Kings

text: Abner alſo ſpake to the ancients of Iſrael, ſaying: Both yeſterday and the day before you ſought Dauid that he might reigne ouer you.
label: 2 Kings

text: Now therefore do ſo: becauſe our Lord hath ſpoken to Dauid, ſaying: In the hand of my ſeruant Dauid I wil ſaue my people Iſrael from the hands of the Philiſtijms, and of al their enemies.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abner ſpake alſo to Beniamin. And he went to ſpeake vnto Dauid in Hebron al things which pleaſed Iſrael, and al Beniamin.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he came to Dauid into Hebron with twentie men: and Dauid made a feaſt to Abner, and to his men that came with him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abner ſayd to Dauid: I wil riſe, that I may gather vnto thee my lord king al Iſrael, and may enter a league with thee, and thou mayſt reigne ouer al, as thy ſoule deſireth. When Dauid therefore had brought Abner on the way, and he was gone in peace,
label: 2 Kings

text: forthwith Dauids ſeruantes and Ioab came, hauing ſlayne the robbers, with a praye exceding great: and Abner was not with Dauid in Hebron, Becauſe he had now diſmiſſed him, and he was departed in peace.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab, and al the armie which were with him, came afterward: it was therefore told Ioab, that Abner the ſonne of Ner came to the king, and he diſmiſſed him, and he departed in peace.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab went in to the king, and ſaid: What haſt thou done? Behold Abner came to thee: why didſt thou diſmiſſe him and he is gone and departed?
label: 2 Kings

text: knoweſt thou not Abner the ſonne of Ner, that to this end he came to thee, that he might deceiue thee, and might know thy going out, and thy coming in, and vnderſtand al things that thou doeſt?
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therfore being gone from Dauid, ſent meſſengers after Abner, and brought him backe from the ceſterne Sira, Dauid being ignorant therof.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when Abner was returned into Hebron, Ioab brought him aſide to the middes of the gate, to ſpake vnto him in guile: and ſtroke him there in the priuie partes, and he died, in reuenge of the bloud of Aſael his brother.
label: 2 Kings

text: Which when Dauid had heard, that the thing was now done, he ſaid: I am innocent, and my kingdom before God for euer from the bloud of Abner the ſonne of Ner,
label: 2 Kings

text: and come it vpon the head of Ioab, and vpon al his fathers houſe: neither let there fayle of the houſe of Ioab one hauing a fluxe of ſeede, and a leper, and houlding the diſtaffe, and falling by the ſword, lacking bread.
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therefore and Abiſai his brother ſlewe Abner, becauſe he had killed Aſael their brother in Gabaon in the battel.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid to Ioab, and to al the people, that were with him: Rent your garmentes, and be girded with ſacke clothes, and mourne before the funeral of Abner. Moreouer king Dauid folowed the beere.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when they had buried Abner in Hebron, king Dauid lifted vp his voice, and wept vpon the graue of Abner: and al the people alſo wept.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king mourning and lamenting Abner, ſayd: Not as cowardes are wont to die, hath Abner died.
label: 2 Kings

text: Thy handes were not bound, and thy feete were not loden with fetters: but as men are wont to fal before the children of iniquitie, ſo art thou fallen. And al the people dubling it wept vpon him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when al the multitude was come to take meate with Dauid, when it was yet cleere day Dauid ſware, ſaying: Theſe thinges do God to me, and theſe adde he, if before ſunne ſet I ſhal taſt bread or any thing els.
label: 2 Kings

text: And al the people heard, and al thinges pleaſed them which the king did in the ſight of al the people.
label: 2 Kings

text: And al the people knewe, and al Iſrael in that day that it was not the kinges doing, that Abner the ſonne of Ner was ſlayne.
label: 2 Kings

text: The king alſo ſaid to his ſeruantes: Are you ignorant that a prince and the greateſt is ſlayne this day in Iſrael?
label: 2 Kings

text: But I as yet delicate, and annointed king: moreouer the the ſonnes of Saruia are hard to me: our Lord reward him that doth euil according to his malice.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND Iſboſeth the ſonne of Saul heard that Abner was ſlaine in Hebron: and his handes were weakened, and al Iſrael was trubled.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the ſonne of Saul had two men captaynes of robbers, the name of one Baana, and the name of the other Rechab, the ſonnes of Rhemmon the Berothite of the ſonnes of Beniamin: for Beroth alſo was accounted in Beniamin.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the Berothites fled into Gethaim, and were there ſtrangers vntil that time.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ionathas the ſonne of Saul had a ſonne lame in his feete: for he was fiue yeares old, when the tydinges came of Saul and Ionathas from Iezrahel. his nurſe therefore taking him, fled: and when ſhe made haſt to flee, he fel, and was made lame: and he was called Miphiboſeth.
label: 2 Kings

text: Therefore the ſonnes of Rhemmon the Berothite, Rachab and Baana coming, entered into the houſe of Iſboſeth in the heat of the day: who ſlept vpon his bed at noone.
label: 2 Kings

text: And they entered into the houſe ſecretely taking eares of corne, and Rechab and Baana his brother, ſtroke him in priuy partes and fled.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when they were entred into the houſe, he ſlept vpon his bed in a parler, and ſtriking they killed him: and taking away his head they went by the way of the deſert al night.
label: 2 Kings

text: And brought the head of Iſboſeth to Dauid into Hebron: and they ſaid to the king: Behold the head of Iſboſeth the ſonne of Saul thine enemie who ſought thy life: and our Lord hath geuen my lord the king this day reuenge of Saul, and of his ſeede.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Dauid anſwering Rechab, and Baana his brother, the ſonnes of Rhemmon the Berothite, and ſayd to them: our Lord liueth, which hath deliuered my ſoule out of al diſtreſſe,
label: 2 Kings

text: for ſo much as him that told me, and ſaid: Saul is dead, who thought that he told proſperous thinges, I apprehended, and ſlewe him in Siceleg, to whom I should haue geuen a reward for his tydinges.
label: 2 Kings

text: How much more now when wicked men haue ſlaine an innocent man in his owne houſe, vpon his bed, ſhal I not require his bloud of your hand, and take you away from the earth?
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therefore commanded his ſeruantes, and they ſlew them, and cutting of their hands and feete, hanged them ouer the poole in Hebron: but the head of Iſboſeth they tooke, and buried in the ſepulcher of Abner in Hebron.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND al the tribes of Iſrael came to Dauid in Hebton, ſaying: Behold we are thy bone and thy flesh.
label: 2 Kings

text: Yea and yeſterday alſo and the day before when Saul was king ouer vs, thou waſt he that didſt leade vs forth and bring backe Iſrael: and our Lord ſayd to thee: Thou shalt feede my people Iſrael, and thou shalt be prince ouer Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: The ancientes alſo of Iſrael came to the king into Hebron, and king Dauid made a league with them in Hebron before our Lord: and they annointed Dauid to be king ouer Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: Thirtie yeares old was Dauid when he began to reigne, and he reigned fourtie yeares.
label: 2 Kings

text: In Hebron he reigned ouer Iuda ſeuen yeares and ſix monethes: and in Ieruſalem he reigned three and thirtie yeares ouer al Iſrael & Iuda.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king went, & al the men that were with him, into Ieruſalem to the Iebuſeite the inhabiter of the land: & they ſaid to Dauid: Thou shalt not come in hither, vnleſſe thou take away the blind and the lame, ſaying: Dauid shal not come in hither.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Dauid tooke the towre of Sion, this is the citie of Dauid.
label: 2 Kings

text: For Dauid had propoſed in that day a reward to whoſoeuer ſhould ſtrike the Iebuſeite, and touch the gutters of the houſe toppes, and take away the blind and the lame that hated the ſoule of Dauid: therefore it is ſayd in the prouerbe The blind and the lame shal not enter into the temple.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid dwelt in the towre, and called it, The citie of Dauid: & built round about from Mello and inwards.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he went proſpering and growing vp, and our Lord the God of hoſtes was with him.
label: 2 Kings

text: Hiram alſo the king of Tyre ſent meſſengers to Dauid, and ceder trees, and carpenters, and maſons for walles: and they built a houſe for Dauid.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid knew that our Lord had confirmed him king ouer Iſrael, and that he had exalted his kingdome ouer his people Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therefore tooke yet concubines and wiues of Ieruſalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were borne to Dauid other ſonnes alſo and daughters:
label: 2 Kings

text: And theſe be the names of them, that were borne to him in Ieruſalem, Samua, and Sobab, and Nathan, and Salomon,
label: 2 Kings

text: and Iebahar, and Eliſua, and Nepheg,
label: 2 Kings

text: and Iaphia, and Eliſama, and Elioda, and Eliphaleth.
label: 2 Kings

text: The Philiſtijms therefore heard that they had annointed Dauid to be king ouer Iſrael: and they went vp al to ſeeke Dauid: which when Dauid had heard, he went downe into a hold.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the Philiſtijms coming were ſpred in the Vale Raphaim.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid conſulted our Lord, ſaying: Shal I goe vp to the Philiſtijms? and wilt thou geue them into my hand? And our Lord ſayd to Dauid: Goe vp, becauſe deliuering I wil geue the Philiſtjims in thy hand.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therefore came into Baal Pharaſim: and ſtroke them there, and ſaid: Our Lord hath diuided mine enemies before me, as waters are diuided, therefore the name of the place was called Baal Pharaſim.
label: 2 Kings

text: And they leift there their grauen goddes: which Dauid, and his men tooke.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the Philiſtians added yet to go vp, and ſpred them ſelues in the Vale Raphaim.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid conſulted our Lord: Shal I goe vp againſt the Philiſtijms, and wilt thou deliuer them into my handes? Who anſwered: Goe not vp againſt them, but fetch a compaſſe behind their backe, and thou shalt come to them ouer againſt the peare trees.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when thou ſhalt heare the ſound of one going in the toppe of the peare-trees, then shalt thou enter battel: becauſe then wil our Lord goe forth before thy face, to ſtrike the campe of the Philiſtijms.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therefore did as our Lord had commanded him, and he ſtroke the Philiſtijms from Gabaa, vntil thou come to Gezer.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND Dauid againe gathered together al the choſen of Iſrael, thirtie thouſand.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid aroſe, and went, and al the people that was with him of the men of Iuda, to bring the arke of God, vpon which was inuocated the name of the Lord of hoſtes, which ſitteth in the Cherubins vpon it.
label: 2 Kings

text: And they layd the arke of God vpon a new wayne: and tooke it out of the houſe of Abinadab, who was in Gabaa: and Oza, and Ahio the ſonnes of Abinadab, did driue the new wayne.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when they had taken it out of the houſe of Abinadab, who was in Gabaa, Ahio keeping the arke of God went before the arke.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Dauid, and al Iſrael played before our Lord in al wrought wood, both on harpes, and lutes and timbrels and ſitterns and cymbals.
label: 2 Kings

text: And after they came to the Floore of Nachon, Oza put forth his hand to the arke of God, and held it: becauſe the oxen ſpurned, and made it leane aſide.
label: 2 Kings

text: And our Lord was wrath with indignation againſt Oza, and ſtroke him for the raſhenes: who died there before the arke of God.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid was ſtrooken ſad, for that our Lord had ſtrooken Oza, and the name of that place was called: The ſtriking of Oza vntil this day.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid feared our Lord in that day, ſaying: How ſhal the arke of our Lord come vnto me?
label: 2 Kings

text: And he would not haue the arke of our Lord turne in to himſelf into the citie of Dauid: but he cauſed it to turne in vnto the houſe of Obededom the Getheite.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the arke of our Lord dwelt in the houſe of Obededom the Getheite three monethes: and our Lord bleſſed Obededom, and al his houſe.
label: 2 Kings

text: And it was told king Dauid, that our Lord had bleſſed Obededom, and al that he had for the arke of God. Dauid therefore went, and brought away the arke of God out of the houſe of Obededom, into the citie of Dauid with ioy.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when they had paſſed, that caried the arke of our Lord, ſix paſſes, he immolated an oxe and a ramme.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid danced with al his might before our Lord. moreouer Dauid was girded with a linnen ephod.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid, and al the houſe of Iſrael brought the arke of teſtament of our Lord in iubilation, and in ſounde of trumpet.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when the arke of our Lord was entred into the citie of Dauid, Michol the daughter of Saul looking forth through a window, ſawe king Dauid leaping, and dancing before our Lord: and she deſpiſed him in her hart.
label: 2 Kings

text: And they brought in the arke of our Lord, and ſette it in his place in the middes of the tabernacle, which Dauid had pitched for it: and Dauid offered holocauſtes, and pacifiques before our Lord.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when he had accomplished offering holocauſtes and pacifiques, he bleſſed the people in the name of the Lord of hoſtes.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he diſtributed to al the multitude of Iſrael as wel man as woman, to euerie one, one cake of bread, and one roaſted peece of beefe, and flowre fryed with oyle: and al the people went, euerie man into his houſe.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid returned to bleſſe his owne houſe: and Michol the daughter of Saul coming forth to meete Dauid, ſayd: How glorious was the king of Iſrael to day vncouering himſelf before the handmaydes of his ſeruantes, and was naked as if one of the ribbaldes should be naked.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd vnto Michol: Before our Lord, which hath choſen me rather then thy father, and then al his houſe, and commanded me that I ſhould be duke ouer the people of our Lord in Iſrael,
label: 2 Kings

text: both wil I play, & wil become more vile then I haue beene: and I wil be humble in mine eies, and with the handmaydes, of whom thou ſpeakeſt, I wil appeare more glorious.
label: 2 Kings

text: Therefore vnto Michol the daughter of Saul was there no child borne vnto the day of her death.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND it came to paſſe when the king ſate in his houſe, and our Lord had geuen him reſt on euery ſide from al his enemies,
label: 2 Kings

text: he ſayd to Nathan the prophet: Doeſt thou ſee that I dwel in a houſe of cedar, and the arke of God is ſette in the middes skinnes?
label: 2 Kings

text: And Nathan ſayd to the king: Al that is in thy hart, goe doe, becauſe our Lord is with thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe in that night: and behold the word of our Lord to Nathan, ſaying:
label: 2 Kings

text: Goe, and ſpeake to my ſeruant Dauid: Thus ſayth our Lord: Shalt thou build me a houſe to dwel in?
label: 2 Kings

text: For neither haue I dwelt in houſe from the day that I brought the children of Iſrael out of the Land of Ægypt, vntil this day: but I walked in tabernacle, and in tent.
label: 2 Kings

text: Through out al the places, that I haue paſſed with al the children of Iſrael, ſpeaking did I ſpeake to one of the tribes of Iſrael, which I commanded to feede my people Iſrael, ſaying: Why did you not build me a houſe of cedar?
label: 2 Kings

text: And now theſe thinges ſhalt thou ſay to my ſeruant Dauid: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſtes: I tooke thee out of the paſtures folowing the flockes, that thou shouldeſt be prince ouer my people Iſrael:
label: 2 Kings

text: and I haue beene with thee whereſoeuer thou haſt walked, and haue ſlayne al thine enemies from thy face: and haue made thee a great name, according to the name of the great ones, that are in the earth.
label: 2 Kings

text: And I wil appoint a place for my people Iſrael, and wil plant it, and they shal dwel vnder it, and shal be trubled no more: neither shal the children of iniquitie adde to afflict them as before.
label: 2 Kings

text: From the day that I appointed Iudges ouer my people Iſrael: and I wil geue thee reſt from al thine enemies. and our Lord foretelleth thee, that our Lord wil make thee a houſe.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when thy daies shal be accomplished, and thou shalt ſleepe with thy fathers, I wil rayſe vp thy ſeede after thee, which shal come forth of thy wombe, and I wil eſtablish his kingdom.
label: 2 Kings

text: He ſhal build a houſe to my name, and I wil eſtablish the throne of his kingedome for euer.
label: 2 Kings

text: I wil be to him for a father, and he ſhal be to me for a ſonne: who if he shal do any thing vniuſtly, I wil rebuke him in the rod of men, and in the plagues of the ſonnes of men.
label: 2 Kings

text: But my mercie I wil not take away from him, as I tooke from Saul, whom I remoued from thy face.
label: 2 Kings

text: And thy houſe shal be faithful, and thy kingdom for euer before thy face, and thy throne shal be firme continually.
label: 2 Kings

text: According to al theſe wordes, and according to al this viſion, ſo did Nathan ſpeake to Dauid.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid went in, and ſate before our Lord, and ſaid: Who am I ô Lord God, and what is my houſe, that thou haſt brought me thus farre?
label: 2 Kings

text: But this alſo hath ſemed litle in thy ſight ô Lord God, vnles thou didſt ſpeake alſo of the houſe of thy ſeruant for a long time: for this is the law of Adam, Lord God.
label: 2 Kings

text: What can Dauid therefore adde yet, to ſpeake vnto thee? for thou knoweſt thy ſeruant ô Lord God.
label: 2 Kings

text: For thy word, and according to thy hart thou haſt done al theſe great thinges, ſo that thou wouldeſt notifie it to thy ſeruant.
label: 2 Kings

text: Therefore art thou magnified ô lord God, becauſe there is none like to thee, neither is there a God beſides thee, in al thinges that we haue heard with out eares.
label: 2 Kings

text: And what nation is there in the earth, as thy people Iſrael, for the which God hath gone, that he might redeme it to be his people, and might make him ſelfe a name, & doe for them great wonders, and horrible thinges vpon the earth, before the face of thy people, whom thou redemedſt to thy ſelf out of Ægypt, from the nations and from their goddes.
label: 2 Kings

text: For thou haſt confirmed thy people Iſrael to be an euerlaſting people: and thou Lord God art become their God.
label: 2 Kings

text: Now therefore ô Lord God, raiſe vp for euer the word, that thou haſt ſpoken vpon thy ſeruant, and vpon his houſe: and doe as thou haſt ſpoken,
label: 2 Kings

text: that thy name may be magnified for euer, and it may be ſaid: The Lord of hoſtes is God ouer Iſrael. And the houſe of thy ſeruant Dauid shal be eſtablished before our Lord,
label: 2 Kings

text: becauſe thou ô Lord of hoſtes God of Iſrael haſt reueled the eare of thy ſeruant, ſaying: A houſe I build thee: therefore bath thy ſeruant found his hart to pray thee with this prayer.
label: 2 Kings

text: Now therefore ô Lord God, thou art God, and thy wordes shal be true: for thou haſt ſpoken to thy ſeruant theſe good thinges.
label: 2 Kings

text: Beginne therefore, and bleſſe the houſe of thy ſeruant, that it may be for euer before thee: becauſe thou Lord God haſt ſpoken, by thy bleſſing shal the houſe of thy ſeruant be bleſſed for euer.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND it came to paſſe after theſe thinges Dauid ſtroke the Philiſtijms, and humbled them, and Dauid tooke the Bridle of tribute out of the hand of the Philiſtijms.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he ſtroke Moab, and meaſured them with a corde, making them euen with the earth: and he meaſured two cordes, one to kil, and one to ſaue aliue: and Moab became ſeruing Dauid vnder tribute.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſtroke Adarezer the ſonne of Rohob king of Soba, when he went forth to haue dominion ouer the riuer Euphrates.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid hauing taken of his part a thouſand ſeuen hundred horſemen, and twentie thouſand footemen, hoghſinewed al the chariot horſes: and he leift of them a hundred chariotes.
label: 2 Kings

text: There came alſo Syria of Domaſcus, to bring ayde vnto Adar-ezer the king of Soba: and Dauid ſtroke of Syria two and twentie thouſand men.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid put a garriſon in Syria of Damaſcus: and Syria became ſeruing Dauid vnder tribute: and our Lord preſerued Dauid in al thinges to whatſoeuer he went forth.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid tooke the golden armour, which the ſeruantes of Adar-ezer had, and brought them into Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Kings

text: And out of Bete, and out of Beroth the cities of Adar-ezer king Dauid tooke braſſe exceding much.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Tou the king of Emath heard, that Dauid had ſtriken al the force of Adar-ezer,
label: 2 Kings

text: And Tou ſent Ioram his ſonne to king Dauid, to ſalute him congratulating, and to geue thankes: for that he had ouerthrowen Adarezer, and ſtriken him. For Tou was enemie to Adarezer, and in his hand were veſſels of gold, and veſſels of ſiluer, and veſſels of braſſe:
label: 2 Kings

text: which alſo king Dauid ſanctified to our Lord with the ſiluer and gold, that he had ſanctified of al the nations, which he had ſubdewed
label: 2 Kings

text: of Syria, and Moab, and the children of Ammon, and the Philiſtijms, and Amalec, and of the ſpoiles of Adarezer the ſonne of Rohob king of Soba.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid alſo made himſelfe a name, when he returned hauing taken Syria in the Vaile of Salt-pittes, eightene thouſand being ſlayne:
label: 2 Kings

text: and he put in ſouldiours in Idumea, and placed a garriſon: and al Idumea was made to ſerue Dauid: and our Lord preſerued Dauid in al thinges to whatſoeuer he proceeded.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid reigned ouer al Iſrael: Dauid alſo did iudgement and iuſtice to al his people.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab the ſonne of Seruia was ouer the armie: moreouer Ioſaphat the ſonne of Ahilud was recorder:
label: 2 Kings

text: and Sadoc the ſonne of Achitob, and Achimelech the ſonne of Abiathar, were prieſtes: and Saraias, ſcribe:
label: 2 Kings

text: And Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada was ouer the Cerethi and Phelethi: and the ſonnes of Dauid princes.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND Dauid ſayd: Is there any thinke you that is remaining of the houſe of Saul, that I may do mercie with him for Ionathas ſake?
label: 2 Kings

text: And there was of the houſe of Saul, a ſeruant named Siba: whom when the king had called vnto him, he ſaid to him: art thou Siba? And he anſwered: I am ſo thy ſeruant.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſaid: Is there anie remaining of the houſe of Saul, that I may doe with him the mercie of God? And Siba ſaid to the king: There is yet liuing a ſonne of Ionathas, lame of his feete.
label: 2 Kings

text: Where is he? quoth he. And Siba ſayd to the king: Behold he is in the houſe of Machir the ſonne of Ammiel in Lodabar.
label: 2 Kings

text: King Dauid therefore ſent, and tooke him out of the houſe of Machir the ſonne of Ammiel of Lodabar.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when Miphiboſeth the ſonne of Ionathas the ſonne of Saul was come to Dauid, he fel on his face, and adored. And Dauid ſaid: Miphiboſeth? Who anſwered: Here I am thy ſeruant.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid to him: Feare not, becauſe doing I wil do mercie on thee for Ionathas thy father, & I wil reſtore the landes of Saul thy father, and thou shalt eate bread vpon my table alwaies.
label: 2 Kings

text: Who adoring him, ſaid: Who am I thy ſeruant, that thou haſt reſpect vpon a dead dogge like vnto me?
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therefore called Siba the ſeruant of Saul, and ſaid to him: Al thinges whatſoeuer were Sauls, and al his houſe, I haue geuen to thy maſters ſonne,
label: 2 Kings

text: Til for him therefore the land, thou and thy ſonnes, and thy ſeruants: and thou shalt bring in meates for thy maſters ſonne, that he may be maintained: and Miphiboſeth the ſonne of thy lord ſhal eate alwaies bread vpon my table. And Siba had fiftene ſonnes, and twentie ſeruants.
label: 2 Kings

text: and Siba ſaid to the king: As thou my lord king haſt commanded thy ſeruant, ſo wil thy ſeruant doe: and Miphiboſeth shal eate vpon my table, as one of the ſonnes of the king.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Miphiboſeth had a little ſonne called Micha: and al the kinred of the houſe of Siba ſerued Miphiboſeth.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer Miphiboſeth dwelt in Ieruſalem: becauſe he did eate alwaies of the kings table: and he was lame on both feete.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND it came to paſſe after theſe thinges, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanon his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid: I wil doe mercie with Hanon the ſonne of Naas, as his father hath done mercie with me. Dauid therefore ſent, conforting him by his ſeruants vpon his fathers death. But when the ſeruantes of Dauid were come into the land of the children of Ammon,
label: 2 Kings

text: the princes of the children of Ammon ſaid to Hanon their lord: Thinkeſt thou that for the honour of thy father Dauid hath ſent comforters vnto thee, and not rather that he might ſearch, and ſpie into the citie, and ouerthrow it, hath Dauid ſent his ſeruants vnto thee?
label: 2 Kings

text: Hanon therefore tooke the ſeruants of Dauid, and shaued the one half of their breard, and cutte away halfe their garments vnto the buttockes, and ſent them away.
label: 2 Kings

text: Which when it was told Dauid, he ſent to meete them: for the men were counfounded very fowly, and Dauid commanded them: Tary in Iericho, til your beard be growen, and then returne.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the children of Ammon ſeing that they had done iniurie to Dauid, ſent, and hyred for wages the Syrian of Rohob, and the Syrian of Soba, twentie thouſand footemen, and of the king Maacha a thouſand men, and of Iſtob twelue thouſand men.
label: 2 Kings

text: Which when Dauid had heard, he ſent Ioab and the whole armie of warryers.
label: 2 Kings

text: The children therefore of Ammon iſſued forth, and ſette their men in aray before the verie entrance of the gate: but the Syrian of Soba, and Rohab, and Iſtob, and Maacha were by them ſelues in the fielde.
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therefore ſeing, that there was battel prepared againſt him, both before him and behind him, he piked out of al the choſen of Iſrael, and directed his armie agaynſt the Syrian:
label: 2 Kings

text: and the reſt of the people he deliuered to Abiſai his brother, who directed his armie againſt the children of Ammon.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab ſayd: If the Syrian shal preuayle againſt me, thou shalt ayde me: and if the children of Ammon shal preuayle agaynſt thee, I wil ayde thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: Play the man, and let vs fight for our people, and the citie of our God: and our Lord wil doe that which is good in his ſight.
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therefore and the people that were with him, began to fight againſt the Syrians: Who immediatly fled from his face.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the children of Ammon ſeing that the Syrians were fled, they alſo fled from the face of Abiſai, and entred into the citie: and Ioab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Kings

text: Therefore the Syrians ſeing that they were fallen before Iſrael, they gathered them ſelues together.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Adar-ezer ſent, and fetched out the Syrians, that were beyond the riuer, and brought their armie: and Sobach the maiſter of Adar-ezers warre, was their chief captaine.
label: 2 Kings

text: Which when it was told Dauid, he gathered together al Iſrael, and paſſed ouer Iordan, and came into Helam: & the Syrians put them ſelues in aray againſt Dauid, & fought againſt him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the Syrians fled from the face of Iſrael, and Dauid ſlewe of the Syrians ſeuen hundred chariotes, and fourtie thouſand horſemen: and Sobach the prince of the warre he ſtroke: who forthwith died.
label: 2 Kings

text: And al the kinges, that were to ayde Adarezer, ſeing them ſelues ouercome of Iſrael, were afrayd and fled eight & fiftie thouſand before Iſrael. And they made peace with Iſrael: and ſerued them, and the Syrians were afrayd any more to ayde the children of Ammon.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND it came to paſſe the yeare turning about, at ſuch time when kinges are wont to procede to battels, Dauid ſent Ioab, and his ſeruantes with him, and al Iſrael, and they ſpoyled the children of Ammon, and beſieged Rabba: but Dauid remayned in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Kings

text: Whiles theſe thinges were in doing, it chanced that Dauid aroſe from his bed after noone, and walked in the toppe of the kinges houſe: and he ſaw a woman washing her ſelf, ouer againſt the roofe of his houſe: and the woman was very beautiful.
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therefore ſent, and inquired what woman it was. And it was told him, that she was Bethſabee the daughtet of Eliam, the wife of Vrias the Hetheite.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therefore ſending meſſengers, tooke her, who when she was entered in to him, he ſlept with her: and forthwith she was ſanctified from her vnclennes:
label: 2 Kings

text: and she returned into her houſe hauing conceiued a childe. And ſending she told Dauid, and ſayd: I haue conceiued.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſent to Ioab, ſaying: Send me Vrias the Hetheite. And Ioab ſent Vrias to Dauid.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Vrias came to Dauid. And Dauid asked how wel Ioab did, & the people, and how the warre was ordered.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to Vrias: Goe into thy houſe, and wash thy feete. And Vrias went forth out of the kinges houſe, and the kinges meate folowed him.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Vrias ſlept before the gate of the kinges houſe, with the other ſeruantes of his lord, and went not downe to his owne houſe.
label: 2 Kings

text: And it was told Dauid of them that ſayd: Vrias went not into his houſe. And Dauid ſayd to Vrias: didſt thou not come from thy ioutney? Why didſt thou not goe downe into thy houſe?
label: 2 Kings

text: And Vrias ſayd to Dauid: The Arke of God and Iſrael and Iuda dwel in pauilions, & my lord Ioab and the ſeruantes of my lord abide vpon the face of the earth: and shal I enter into my houſe, to eate and to drinke, and ſleepe with my wife? by thy health, and by the health of thy ſoule I wil not do this thing.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therefore ſayd to Vrias: Tarie here alſo this day, and to morow I wil diſmiſſe thee. Vrias taried in Ieruſalem that day and the next:
label: 2 Kings

text: and Dauid called him to eate before him and to drinke, and he made him drunke: who going out at euen, ſlept on his couche with the ſeruantes of his lord, and went not downe into his houſe.
label: 2 Kings

text: The morning therefore was come, and Dauid wrote a letter to Ioab: and ſent it by the hand of Vrias,
label: 2 Kings

text: writing in the letter: Sette ye Vrias in the front of the battel, where the fight is ſtrongeſt; and leaue him, that being ſtriken he may die.
label: 2 Kings

text: Therefore when Ioab beſieged the citie, he put Vrias in the place where he knew the ſtrongeſt men were.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the men iſſuing out of the citie, fought againſt Ioab, and there fel of the people of the ſeruantes of Dauid, and Vrias alſo the Hetheite died.
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therefore ſent, and told Dauid al the ſtory of the battel:
label: 2 Kings

text: and he commanded the meſſenger, ſaying: When thou haſt told al the ſtory of the battel to the king,
label: 2 Kings

text: if thou ſee him to be angrie, and he ſay: Why approched you to the wal, to fight? Knew you not that manie weapons are throwen from aboue of the wal?
label: 2 Kings

text: Who ſtroke Abimelec the ſonne of Ierobaal? did not a woman caſt vpon him a peece of a milſtone from the wal, and ſlew him in Thebes? Why approched you nere the wal? Thou shalt ſay: Alſo thy ſeruant Vrias the Hetheite is ſlayne.
label: 2 Kings

text: The meſſenger therefore departed, and came, and told Dauid al thinges that Ioab had commanded him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the meſſenger ſayd to Dauid: The men haue preuailed againſt vs, and they iſſued forth to vs into the field: and we violently purſewed them euen to the gate of the citie.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the archers shot arrowes at thy ſeruantes from of the wal aboue: and there died of the kinges ſeruantes, yea and thy ſeruant Vrias the Hetheite is dead.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to the meſſenger: Thus shalt thou ſay to Ioab: Let not this thing diſcomfort thee: for the euent of warre is diuerſe: now this man, and now that man the ſword conſumeth: encourage thy warryers againſt the citie, that thou mayſt deſtroy it, and exhort them.
label: 2 Kings

text: Alſo the wife of Vrias heard, that Vrias her huſband was dead, & she mourned for him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the mourning being paſt Dauid ſent, and brought her in into his houſe, and she became his wife, and she bare him a ſonne: and this thing which Dauid had done, was diſpleaſant before our Lord.
label: 2 Kings

text: OVR Lord therfore ſent Nathan to Dauid: Who when he was come to him, he ſayd vnto him: There were two men in one citie, one riche, and the other poore.
label: 2 Kings

text: The rich man had sheepe, and oxen axceding manie.
label: 2 Kings

text: but the poore man had nothing at al, beſide one litle ewe, which he had bought and nourished, and which had growen in his houſe together with his children, eating of his bread, and drinking of his cuppe, and ſleping in his boſome: and it was to him as a daughter.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when a certayne ſtranger was come to the riche man, he ſparing to take of his owne ſheepe and oxen, to make a feaſt for that ſtranger, which was come to him, tooke the poore mans ewe, and made meates therof for the man that was come to him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid being excedingly wrath with indignation againſt that man, ſayd to Nathan: Our Lord liueth, the man that hath done this is the childe of death.
label: 2 Kings

text: He shal render the ewe fourefold, becauſe he hath done this thing, and hath not ſpared.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Nathan ſayd to Dauid: Thou art that man. Thus ſayth our Lord the God of Iſaael: I annointed thee to be king ouer Iſrael, and I deliuered thee from the hand of Saul,
label: 2 Kings

text: and gaue thee the houſe of thy lord, and the wiues of thy lord in thy boſome, and haue geuen thee the houſe of Iſrtel and Iuda: and if theſe thinges be litle, I wil adde farre greater thinges vnto thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: Why therefore haſt thou contemned the word of the lord, that thou wouldeſt doe euil in my ſight? Vrias the Hetheite thou haſt ſmitten with the ſword, & his wife thou haſt taken to thy wife, and haſt ſlayne him with the ſword of the children of Ammon.
label: 2 Kings

text: For which thing the ſword shal not depart from thy houſe for euer, becauſe thou haſt deſpiſed me, and haſt taken the wife of Vrias the Hetheite, to be thy wife.
label: 2 Kings

text: Therfore thus ſayth our Lord: Behold, I wil rayſe vpon thee euil out of thine owne houſe, and wil take thy wiues before thine eies, and geue them to thy neighbour, and he shal ſlepe with thy wiues in the ſight of this Sunne.
label: 2 Kings

text: For thou haſt done it ſecretly: but I wil doe this word in the ſight of al Iſrael, and in the ſight of the Sunne.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to Nathan: I haue ſinned to our Lord. And Nathan ſayd to Dauid: Our Lord alſo hath taken away thy ſinne: thou shalt not die.
label: 2 Kings

text: Neuertheles, becauſe thou haſt made the enemies of our Lord to blaſpheme, for this thing, the ſonne that is borne to thee, dying shal dye.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Nathan returned into his houſe. Our Lord alſo ſtroke the child, which the wife of Vrias had borne to Dauid, and he was paſt hope.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid beſought our Lord for the child: and Dauid faſted a faſt, and going in aſide, lay vpon the ground.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the ancientes of his houſe came, being earneſt with him, that he would riſe from the ground: who would not, neither did he eate meate with them.
label: 2 Kings

text: And it chanced the ſeuenth day that the infant died: and the ſeruantes of Dauid feared to tel him, that the child was dead. For they ſayd: Behold when the child yet liued, we ſpake to him, and he heard not our voice: how much more if we shal ſay: The child is dead, wil he afflict him ſelf?
label: 2 Kings

text: When Dauid therfore ſawe his ſeruantes muttering, he vnderſtood that the infant was dead: and he ſayd to his ſeruantes: Is the child dead? Who anſwered him: He is dead.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therfore roſe from the ground; and was washed and annoynted: and when he had changed his garment, he entered into the houſe of our Lord: and adored, and came into his owne houſe, and he called for bread, and he did eate.
label: 2 Kings

text: And his ſeruantes ſayd vnto him: What thing is this, that thou haſt done? for the infant, when he yet liued, thou didſt faſt and weepe: but the child being dead, thou didſt riſe vp, and haſt eaten bread.
label: 2 Kings

text: Who ſayd: For the infant, whiles he yet liued, I faſted and wept: for I ſayd: Who knoweth if perhaps our Lord wil geue him to me, and the infant may liue?
label: 2 Kings

text: But now becauſe he is dead, why do I faſt? Shal I be able to cal him againe any more? I shal go to him rather: but he shal not returne to me.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid comforted Bethſabee his wife, and going in vnto her, ſlept with her: Who bare a ſonne, and he called his name Salomon, and our Lord loued him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he ſent by the hand of Nathan the prophete, and called his name, Amiable to our Lord, becauſe our Lord loued him.
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therfore fought againſt Rabbath of the children of Ammon, and wonne the kinges citie.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab ſent meſſengers to Dauid, ſaying: I haue fought againſt Rabbath, and the Citie of waters is to be taken.
label: 2 Kings

text: Now therfore gather the reſt of the people, and beſiege the citie, & take it: leſt when the citie shal be waſted of me, the victorie be aſcribed to my name.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therfore gathered al the people, and went forth againſt Rabbath: and when he had fought, he tooke it.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he tooke the crowne of their king from his head, in weight a talent of gold, hauing moſt pretious ſtones, and it was put vpon Dauids head. Yea & the praye of the citie he caryed away exceding much:
label: 2 Kings

text: bringing forth alſo the people therof ſawed them, and drewe round about ouer them chariotes ſhod with yron: and he diuided them with kniues, and drew them through in forme of brikes: ſo did he to al the cities of the children of Ammon: and Dauid returned, and al the armie into Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND it came to paſſe after theſe thinges, that Amnon the ſonne of Dauid loued the ſiſter of Abſalom the ſonne of Dauid, being very beautiful, called Thamar,
label: 2 Kings

text: and was fond on her excedingly, ſo that for the loue of her he was ſicke: becauſe wheras she was a virgin, it ſemed vnto him had hard to doe any thing vnhoneſtly with her.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Amnon a freind, named Ionadab the ſonne of Semmaa Dauids brother, a very wiſe man:
label: 2 Kings

text: Who ſayd to him: Why art thou ſo worne away with leanenes the kinges ſonne, day by day? Why doeſt thou not tel me? And Amnon ſayd to him: I loue Thamar the ſiſter of my brother Abſalom.
label: 2 Kings

text: To whom Ionadab anſwered: Lye vpon thy bed, and fayne ſickenes: and when thy father shal come to viſite thee, ſay to him: Let my ſiſter Thamar, I pray, come to me, to geue me meate, and to make me broth, that I may eate of her hand.
label: 2 Kings

text: Amnon therefore lay downe, and began as it were to be ſicke: and when the king came to viſite him, Amnon ſayd to the king: Let Thamar my ſiſter come, I beſech you, that she may make in my ſight two litle ſuppinges, and I may take meate of her hand.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therfore ſent home to Thamar, ſaying: Come into the houſe of Amnon thy brother, & make him broth.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Thamar came into the houſe of Amnon her brother: and he lay, who taking meale tempered it: and reſoluing it in his ſight she made ſuppinges.
label: 2 Kings

text: And taking that which she had boyled, she powred it out, and ſet it before him, and he would nor eate: and Amnon ſayd: Put forth al from me. And when they had put forth al,
label: 2 Kings

text: Amnon ſayd to Thamar: Bring in the meate into the parler, that I may eate of thy hand. Thamar therfore tooke the ſuppinges, which she had made, and caryed it in to Amnon her brother in the parler.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when she had offered him the meate, he caught her, and ſayd: Come, lie with me my ſiſter.
label: 2 Kings

text: Who anſwered him: Doe not ſo my brother, doe not rauish me: for this is not lawful in Iſrael. Doe not this folie.
label: 2 Kings

text: For I shal not be able to beare my reproch, and thou shalt be as one of the foolish in Iſrael: but rather ſpeake to the king, and he wil not denie me to thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: But he would not reſt at her petitions, but preuayling by force rauiſhed her, and lay with her.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Amnon hated her with exceding great hatred: ſo that the hatred was greater, wherewith he hated her, then the loue with the which before he loued her. And Amnon ſaid to her: Ariſe; and goe.
label: 2 Kings

text: Who anſwered him: This euil, which now thou doeſt againſt me expelling me, is greater then that which thou didſt before. And he would not heare her:
label: 2 Kings

text: but calling the ſeruant, that miniſtred to him, he ſaid: Thruſt this woman out from me: and ſhut the doore after her.
label: 2 Kings

text: Who was clothed with a garment downe to the foote: for the kinges daughters that were virgins, vſed ſuch kinde of garmentes. His ſeruant therfore thruſt her out: and shut the doore after her.
label: 2 Kings

text: Who ſprinkling ashes on her head, renting her long garment, and her handes vpon her head, went going on, and crying.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abſolon her brother ſayd to her: hath Amnon thy brother lyen with thee? but now ſiſter hold thy peace, he is thy brother: neithet afflict thou thy hart for this thing. Thamar therefore taryed pyning in the houſe of Abſalom her brother.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when Dauid the king had heard theſe wordes, he was greeued excedingly.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer Abſalom ſpake not to Amnon neitheir good nor euil: for Abſalom hated Amnon becauſe he had rauished Thamar his ſiſter.
label: 2 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe after the ſpace of two yeares, that the sheepe of Abſalom were shorne in Baalhaſor, which is beſide Ephraim: and Abſalom called al the kinges ſonnes,
label: 2 Kings

text: and he came to the king, and ſaid to him: Behold thy ſeruantes sheepe are to be shorne: Let the king, I pray, with his ſeruantes come to his ſeruant.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſaid to Abſalom: Doe not ſo my ſonne, requeſt not that we come al, & charge thee. And when he was earneſt with him, & he would not goe, he bleſſed him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abſalom ſaid: If thou wilt not come, at the leaſt let Amnon my brother, I beſech thee, come with vs. And the king ſaid to him: It is not neceſſary that he goe with thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: Abſalom therefore was earneſt with him, and he let Amnon and al the kinges ſonnes goe with him. And Abſalom made a feaſt as it were the feaſt of a king.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abſalom had commanded his ſeruantes, ſaying: Marke when Amnon shal be drunke with wine, and I shal ſay to you: Strike him, and kil him, feare not: for it is I that command you: take courage, and play the valiant men.
label: 2 Kings

text: Therefore the ſeruantes of Abſalom did againſt Amnon, as Abſalom had commanded them. And al the kinges ſonnes ryſing gatte vp euery one vpon their mules, and fled.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when they yet went on in their way, a rumour came to Dauid, ſaying: Abſalom hath ſtricken al the kinges ſonnes, and there is not leift of them ſo much as one.
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therfore roſe vp, and rent his garmentes: and fel vpon the ground, and al his ſeruantes, that ſtood about him, rent their garmentes.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Ionadab the ſonne of Semmaa Dauids brother anſwering, ſayd: Let not my lord the king thinke, that al the kinges ſonnes be ſlayne: Amnon only is dead, becauſe he was put in the mouth of Abſalom ſince the day that he rauished Thamar his ſiſter.
label: 2 Kings

text: Now therefore let not my lord the king put this word vpon his hart, ſaying: Al the kinges ſonnes are ſlayne: becauſe Amnon only is dead.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abſalom fled: and the ſeruant that was the ſcoutewatch, lifted vp his eies, and looked: and behold much people came by a byway on the ſide of the mountayne.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ionadab ſayd to the king: Loe the kinges ſonnes be come: according to the wordes of thy ſeruant ſo, is it done.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when he had ceaſed to ſpeake, the kinges ſonnes alſo appeared: & entring in they lifted vp their voice, and wept: yea the king alſo and al his ſeruantes bewailed with an exceding great weeping.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer Abſalom fleing, went to Tholomai the ſonne of Ammiud the king of Geſſur, Dauid therefore mourned for his ſonne al daies.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abſalom when he was fled, and come into Geſſur, was there three yeares.
label: 2 Kings

text: And king Dauid ceaſed to purſew Abſalom, becauſe he was comforted vpon the death of Amnon.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND Ioab the ſonne of Saruia, vnderſtanding that the kinges hart was turned to Abſalom,
label: 2 Kings

text: he ſent to Thecua, and tooke thence a prudent woman: and he ſayd to her: Feyne that thou mourneſt, and put on a mourning garment, and be not annoynted with oyle, that thou mayſt be as a woman now a long tyme mourning for one dead.
label: 2 Kings

text: And thou shalt goe in vnto the king, and shalt ſpeake to him theſe maner of wordes. And Ioab put the wordes in her mouth.
label: 2 Kings

text: Therefore when the woman of Thecua was gone in to the king, ſhe fel before him vpon the ground, and adored, and ſaid: Saue me ô king.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſayd to her: What matter haſt thou? Who anſwered: Alas, I am a widow woman: for my huſband is dead.
label: 2 Kings

text: And thy handmaide had two ſonnes: who fel at wordes againſt eche other in the field, and there was none to ſtay them: and the one ſtroke the other, and ſlew him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And behold the whole kinred ryſing againſt thy handmaide, ſaith: Deliuer him that hath ſtriken his brother that we may kil him for the life of his brother, whom he hath ſlayne, and may cleane deſtroy the heire: and they ſeeke to extingniſh my ſparkle, which is leift, that there may no name remaine to my huſband, nor reliques vpon the earth.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſaid to the woman: Goe into thy houſe, and I wil geue commandement for thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the woman of Thecua ſaid to the king: Vpon me, my lord, be the iniquitie, and vpon the houſe of my father: but be the king and his throne innocent.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſaid: He that ſhal gayneſay thee bring him to me, & he ſhal adde no more to touch thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: Who ſayd: Let the king remember our Lord his God, that the next of bloud be not multiplied to reuenge, and that they kil not my ſonne. Who ſayd: Our Lord liueth, there ſhal not fal of the heares of thy ſonne vpon the earth.
label: 2 Kings

text: The woman therefore ſayd: Let thy handmayde ſpeake to my lord the king a word. And he ſayd: Speake.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the woman ſayd: Why haſt thou thought ſuch a thing agaynſt the people of God, and why hath the king ſpoken this word, that he would ſinne, and not bring againe his baniſhed one?
label: 2 Kings

text: We doe al dye, and as waters that returne not, we fal downe on the earth: neither wil God haue a ſoule to periſh, bur reuoketh, meaning that he perish not altogether that is caſt of.
label: 2 Kings

text: Now therefore I come, that I may ſpeake to my lord the king this word, the people being preſent. And thy handmayd ſayd: I wil ſpeake to the king, if by any meanes the king may doe the word of his handmaide.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king hath heard, to deliuer his handmaide out of the hand of al, that would deſtroy me out of the inheritance of our Lord, and my ſonne together.
label: 2 Kings

text: Let thy handmaide therefore ſay, that the word of my lord the king be made as a ſacrifice. For euen as an Angel of God, ſo is my lord the king, that he is moued neither with bleſſing nor curſing: Wherefore our Lord alſo thy God is with thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king anſwering, ſayd to the woman: Hide not from me the thing that I aske thee. And the woman ſayd to him: Speake my lord king.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſayd: Is the hand of Ioab with thee in al theſe thinges? The woman anſwered, and ſayd: By the health of thy ſoule, my lord king, it is neither on the left hand, nor on the right of al theſe thinges, which my lord the king hath ſpokeu: for thy ſeruant Ioab, he commanded me, and he put al theſe wordes into the mouth of thy handmayde.
label: 2 Kings

text: That I should change the forme of this ſpeach, thy ſeruant Ioab commanded this: and thou my lord king, art wiſe, as an Angel of God hath wiſdom, that thou vnderſtandeſt al thinges vpon the earth.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſayd to Ioab: Behold I being pacified haue done thy word: Goe therefore, and cal agayne the boy Abſalom.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab falling vpon his face vnto the earth, adored, and bleſſed the king: and Ioab ſayd: This day thy ſeruant hath vnderſtood, that I haue found grace in thy ſight my lord king: for thou haſt done the word of thy ſeruant.
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therefore aroſe and went into Geſſur, and brought Abſalom into Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Kings

text: But the king ſayd: Let him returne into his houſe, and not ſee my face. Abſalom therefore returned into his houſe, and the kings face he ſaw not.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer like as Abſalom, there was not a man in al Iſrael ſo beautiful, and exceding comelie: from the ſole of the foote to the crowne there was no blemish in him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when he powled his heare (once a yeare he was powled, becauſe his bush did burden him) he weighed the heare of his head at two hundred ſicles, of the common weight.
label: 2 Kings

text: And there were borne to Abſalom three ſonnes: and one daughter, named Thamar, of a goodly beautie.
label: 2 Kings
