text: And Abſalom abode in Ieruſalem two yeares, and ſaw not the kinges face.
label: 2 Kings

text: He therefore ſent to Ioab, to ſend him to the king: who would not come to him. And when he had ſent the ſecond time, and he would not come to him,
label: 2 Kings

text: he ſayd to his ſeruantes: You know the filde of Ioab beſide my filde, that hath barley harueſt: goe therefore and burne it with fyre. The ſeruantes therefore of Abſalom burnt the corne with fyre. And Ioabs ſeruantes coming, renting their garmentes, ſayd: The ſeruantes of Abſalom haue burnt part of the filde with fyre.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab aroſe, & came to Abſalom in his houſe, & ſayd: Why haue thy ſeruantes burnt my corne with fire?
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abſalom anſwered Ioab: I ſent to thee beſeching thee that thou wouldeſt come vnto me, and I might ſend thee to the king, and thou ſhouldeſt ſay to him: Wherefore came I out of Geſſur? It was better for me to be there: I beſech thee therefore that I may ſee the face of the king: & if he be mindeful of mine iniquitie, let him kil me.
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therefore entring in to the king, told him al thinges: and Abſalom was called, and he entered in to the king: and adored vpon the face of the earth before him: and the king kiſſed Abſalom.
label: 2 Kings

text: THEREFORE after theſe thinges Abſalom made him ſelf chariotes, and horſemen, and fiftie men, that should goe before him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abſalom riſing early, ſtoode beſide the entrance of the gate, and euerie man that had buſines to the kinges iudgement, did Abſalom cal to him, and ſayd: Of what citie art thou? Who anſwering ſayd: Of ſuch a tribe of Iſrael am I thy ſeruant.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abſalom anſwered him: Thy wordes ſeeme vnto me good and iuſt. But there is none to heare thee appointed of the king. And Abſalom ſayd:
label: 2 Kings

text: Oh who would appoint me iudge ouer the land, that al might come to me which haue buſines, and I might iudge iuſtly?
label: 2 Kings

text: Yea and when a man came vnto him to ſalute him, he put forth his hand, and taking him, kyſſed him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And this did he to al Iſrael coming for iudgement, to be heard of the king, and he intiſed the hartes of the men of Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: And after fourtie yeares, Abſalom ſayd to king Dauid: Let me goe, and pay my vowes which I haue vowed to our Lord in Hebron.
label: 2 Kings

text: For thy ſeruant vowing did vow, when he was in Geſſur of Syria, ſaying: If our Lord wil bring me againe into Ieruſalem, I wil ſacrifice to our Lord.
label: 2 Kings

text: And king Dauid ſayd to him: Goe in peace. And he aroſe, and went into Hebron.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abſalom ſent ſpies into al the tribes of Iſrael, ſaying: forthwith as you shal heare the ſound of the trumpet, ſay ye: Abſalom reigneth in Hebron.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer with Abſalom there went two hundred men out of Ieruſalem being called, going with a ſimple hart, and vtterly ignorant of the cauſe.
label: 2 Kings

text: Abſalom alſo ſent for Achitophel the Gilonite, Dauids counſeler, from his citie Gilo. And when he immolated victimes, there was made a ſtrong conſpiracie, and the people running together increaſed with Abſalom.
label: 2 Kings

text: A meſſenger therefore came to Dauid, ſaying: Al Iſrael with al their hart followeth Abſalom.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid to his ſeruantes, that were with him in Ieruſalem: Ariſe let vs flee: for there wil be no eſcape for vs from the face of Abſolom: make haſt to goe out, leſt coming perhaps he ouertake vs, and force ruine vpon vs, and ſtrike the citie in the edge of the ſword.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the kinges ſeruantes ſaid to him: al thinges whatſoeuer our lord the king shal command, we thy ſeruantes wil gladly execute.
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therefore went forth, and al his houſe on foote: & the king leift ten wemen his concubines to keepe the houſe.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king going forth & al Iſrael on their feete, ſtoode farre from the houſe:
label: 2 Kings

text: and al his ſeruantes walked by him, and the legions Cerethi, and Phelethi and al the Getheites, valiant warriers, ſix hundred men which had folowed him from Geth footemen, went before the king.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſaid to Ethai the Getheite: Why comeſt thou with vs? returne and dwel with the king, becauſe thou art a ſtranger, and art come forth out of thy place.
label: 2 Kings

text: Yeſterday thou cameſt, and to day shalt thou be forced to goe forth with vs? but I wil goe whither I shal goe: returne, and leade backe thy brethren with thee, and our Lord wil doe with thee mercie, and veritie, becauſe thou haſt shewed grace and fidelitie.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ethai anſwered the king, ſaying: The Lord liueth, and my lord the king liueth: for that in what place ſoeuer thou shalt be, my lord king, either in death, or in life, there wil thy ſeruant be.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſaid to Ethai: Come, and paſſe. And Ethai the Getheite paſſed, and al the men that were with him, and the reſt of the multitude.
label: 2 Kings

text: And they al wept with a lowd voice, and al the people paſſed: the king alſo went ouer the Torrent Cedron, and al the people marched againſt the way, that looketh to the deſert.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Sadoc alſo the prieſt came, and al the Leuites with him carying the arke of the couenant of God, and they ſette downe the arke of God: & Abiathar aſcended, til al the people was fully paſſed, which was come forth of the citie.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſayd to Sadoc: Cary backe the Arke of God into the citie: if I shal finde grace in the ſight of my Lord, he wil bring me agayne, and wil show me it, and his tabernacle.
label: 2 Kings

text: But if he shal ſay to me: Thou pleaſeſt me not: I am readie, let him doe that which is good before him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſayd to Sadoc the prieſt: O ſeer returne into the citie in peace: and Achimaas thy ſonne, and Ionathas the ſonne of Abiathar, your two ſonnes let them be with you.
label: 2 Kings

text: Behold I wil be hid in the champayne of the deſert, til there come word from you aduertiſing me.
label: 2 Kings

text: Sadoc therefore and Abiathar caryed backe the Arke of God into Ieruſalem: and they taried there.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer Dauid went vp mount Oliuet, climbing & weeping, going bare foote, and his head couered, yea and al the people which was with him, their head couered went vp weeping.
label: 2 Kings

text: And it was told Dauid that Achitophel alſo was in the conſpiracie with Abſalom, and Dauid ſayd: Infatuate o Lord I beſech thee, the counſel of Achitophel.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when Dauid went vp to the toppe of the mount, wherein he would adore our Lord, behold there mette him Chuſai the Arachite, his garment rent and his head ful of earth.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to him: If thou come with me, thou shalt be a burden to me:
label: 2 Kings

text: but if thou returne into the citie, and wilt ſay to Abſalom: I am thy ſeruant, o king: as I haue beene thy fathers ſeruant, ſo I wil be thy ſeruant: thou shalt defeate the counſel of Achitophel.
label: 2 Kings

text: And thou haſt with thee Sadoch, and Abiathar the prieſts: and euery word whatſoeuer thou shalt heare from out of the kinges houſe, thou shalt tel Sadoc, and Abiathar the prieſtes.
label: 2 Kings

text: And there are with them their two ſonnes Achimaas the ſonne of Sadoc, and Ionathas the ſonne of Abiathar: and you shal ſend by them vnto me euery word whatſoeuer you shal heare.
label: 2 Kings

text: Chuſai therefore the frend of Dauid coming into the citie, Abſalom alſo entred into Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND when Dauid had paſſed a litle the toppe of the Mount, Siba the ſeruant of Miphiboſeth appeared coming to meete him, with two aſſes, which were loden with two hundred loaues, and a hundred bunches of rayſens, an hundred maſſes of figges, and a bottel of wine.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſaid to Siba: What meane theſe thinges? And Siba anſwered: The aſſes are for the kinges houshould to ſitte on: and the loaues and the figges to eate for thy ſeruantes, and the wine to drinke if any man shal fainte in the deſert.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſaid: Where is thy maſters ſonne? And Siba anſwered the king: He hath remained in Ieruſalem, ſaying: This day wil the houſe of Iſrael reſtore me the kingdom of my father.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſaid to Siba: Let al thinges be thine that were Miphiboſeths. And Siba ſaid: I beſech thee let me find grace before thee, my lord king.
label: 2 Kings

text: King Dauid therefore came as farre as Bahurim: & behold there came forth thence a man of the kinred of the houſe of Saul named Semei, the ſonne of Sera, and he proceded going forth, & curſed.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he threw ſtones againſt Dauid, & againſt al the ſeruantes of king Dauid & the whole people, & al the warriers went on the right, and the left ſide of the king.
label: 2 Kings

text: And thus ſpake Semei when he curſed the king: Come forth, come forth thou man of bloud, and man of Belial.
label: 2 Kings

text: Our Lord hath repayed thee al the bloud of the houſe of Saul: becauſe thou haſt inuaded the kingdom for him, and our Lord hath geuen the kingdom into the hand of Abſalom thy ſonne: and behold thyne euiles preſſe thee, becauſe thou art a man of bloud.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abiſai the ſonne of Seruia ſaid to the king: Why curſeth this dead dogge my lord the king? I wil goe, and ſtrike of his head.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſaid: What is it to me and you, ye ſonnes of Saruia? Let him alone that he may curſe: for our Lord hath commanded him to curſe Dauid: and who is he that dare ſay, why hath he ſo done?
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſaid to Abiſai, and to al his ſeruantes: Behold my ſonne, that came out of my wombe, ſeeketh my life: how much more the ſonne of Iemini? let him alone that he may curſe according to the precept of our Lord:
label: 2 Kings

text: if perhaps our Lord may reſpect mine affliction, and our Lord may render me good for this dayes curſing.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therefore walked and his companie in the way with him. And Semei by the banke on the hils ſide, went ouer againſt him, curſing, and caſting ſtones againſt him, and ſprinkling earth.
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therefore came, and al the people with him wearie, and they were refreſhed there.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Abſalom and al his people entered into Ieruſalem, yea and Achitophel with him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when Chuſai the Arachite Dauids frend was come to Abſalom, he ſaid to him: God ſaue thee ô king, God ſaue thee ô king.
label: 2 Kings

text: To whom Abſalom, is this, quoth he, thy kindenes toward thy frend? why wenteſt thou not with thy frend?
label: 2 Kings

text: And Chuſai anſwered Abſalom: Not ſo: becauſe I wil be his, whom our Lord hath choſen, and al this people, and al Iſrael, and with him wil I tarie.
label: 2 Kings

text: Yea that I may adde this alſo, whom ſhal I ſerue? not the kinges ſonne? as I haue ſerued thy father, ſo wil I ſerue thee alſo.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abſalom ſaid to Achitophel: Conſult what we ought to doe.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Achitophel ſaid to Abſalom: Goe in to the concubines of thy father, which he hath left to keepe the houſe: that when al Iſrael shal heare that thou haſt defiled thy father, their handes may be ſtrengthened with thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: They pitched therefore a tent for Abſalom in the houſe toppe, and he went in to his fathers concubines before al Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the counſel of Achitophel, which he gaue in thoſe dayes, as if a man ſhould conſult God: ſo was al the counſel of Achitophel, both when he was with Dauid, and when he was with Abſalom.
label: 2 Kings

text: ACHITOPHEL therefore ſaid to Abſolom: I wil chooſe me twelue thouſand men, and ryſing I wil purſew Dauid this night.
label: 2 Kings

text: And falling vpon him (for as much as he is weary, and of weakened handes) I wil ſtrike him: and when al the people is fled, that is with him, I ſhal ſtrike the king
label: 2 Kings

text: being deſolate. And I shal reduce al the people, as one man is wont to returne: for thou ſeekeſt one man: and al the people shal be in peace.
label: 2 Kings

text: And his ſaying pleaſed Abſalom, and al the ancientes of Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Abſalom ſayd: Cal Chuſai the Arachite, and let vs heare what he alſo ſayeth.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when Chuſai was come to Abſalom, Abſalom ſayd to him: This maner of ſpeache ſpake Achitophel: shal we doe it or no? What counſel geueſt thou?
label: 2 Kings

text: And Chuſai ſayd to Abſalom: It is not good counſel, that Achitophel hath geuen this time.
label: 2 Kings

text: And agayne Chuſai inferred: Thou knoweſt thy father, and the men that are with him, to be verie valiant, and of fel courage, as if a beare in the wood her whelpes being taken away should rage: yea and thy father is a man of warre, neither wil he abyde with the people.
label: 2 Kings

text: Perhaps he lyeth now hid ſecretely in caues, or in ſome one place where he liſt: and when any one shal fal in the beginning, there shal one heare whoſoeuer shal heare it, & ſay: There is made a ſlaughter in the people that folowed Abſalom.
label: 2 Kings

text: And euerie one of the moſt valiant whoſe hart is as it were a lyons, shal fainte for feare: for al the people of Iſrael knowe thy father to be a valiant man, and that al be ſtrong which are with him.
label: 2 Kings

text: But this ſemeth vnto me to be good counſel: Let al Iſrael be gathered to thee, from Dan to Berſabee, as the ſand of the ſea innumerable: and thou shalt be in the middes of them.
label: 2 Kings

text: And we shal ſette vpon them in what place ſoeuer they shal be found: and we shal couer them, as dew is wont to fal vpon the earth: and we shal not leaue of the men, that are with him, not ſo much as one.
label: 2 Kings

text: And if he shal enter into any citie, al Iſrael shal caſt ropes vpon that citie round about, and we wil drawe it into the torrent, that there be not found therof not ſo much as a litle ſtone.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abſalom ſayd, and al the children of Iſrael: The counſel of Chuſai the Arachite is better then the counſel of Achitophel: and by the wil of our Lord was the profitable counſel of Achitophel defeated, that our Lord might bring in euil vpon Abſalom.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Chuſai ſayd to Sadoc and Abiathar the prieſtes: In this and this maner gaue Achitophel counſel to Abſalom, and to the Ancientes of Iſrael: and I gaue ſuch and ſuch counſel.
label: 2 Kings

text: Now therfore ſend quickly, and tel Dauid, ſaying: Tarie not this night in the champayne of the deſert, but without delay paſſe ouer: leſt perhaps the king be ſwalowed vp, and al the people that is with him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ionathas & Achimaas ſtood by the Fountayne rogel: there went a maide and told them: and they went forward, to report the meſſage to king Dauid: for they could not be ſeene, nor enter into the citie.
label: 2 Kings

text: And a certayne boy ſaw them, and told Abſalom: but they making haſt entered into the houſe of a certayne man in Bahurim, who had a wel in his court, and they went downe into it.
label: 2 Kings

text: And a woman tooke, and ſpred a couering ouer the mouth of the wel, as it were drying ſodde barley: and ſo the thing was not knowen.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when Abſaloms ſeruantes were come into the houſe, they ſayd to the woman: Where is Achimaas, and Ionathas? And the woman anſwered them: They paſſed in haſt, hauing taſted a litle water. But they that ſought, when they had not found, returned to Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when theſe were gone, they went vp out of the wel, and going on told king Dauid, and ſayd: Aryſe ye, and paſſe quickly the riuer: becauſe this maner of counſel hath Achitophel geuen againſt you.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therfore aroſe, and al the people that was with him, and they paſſed ouer Iordan, vntil it waxed light, and not one at al was remayning, which did not paſſe the riuer.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer Achitophel ſeing that his counſel was not executed, ſadled his aſſe, and roſe and went into his houſe and into his citie: and taking order with his houſe, hanged him ſelf, and was buried in the ſepulchre of his father.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Dauid came into the Campe, and Abſalom paſſed ouer Iordan, he and al the men of Iſrael with him.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Abſalom appoynted Amaſa for Ioab ouer the armie: and Amaſa was the ſonne of a man, which was called Iethra of Iezrael, who went in to Abigail the daughter of Naas, the ſiſter of Saruia which was the mother of Ioab.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Iſrael camped with Abſalom in the Land of Galaad.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when Dauid was come into the Campe, Sobi the ſonne of Naas of Rabbath the ſonnes of Ammon, and Machir the ſonne of Amihel of Lodabar, & Berzellai the Galaadite of Rogelim,
label: 2 Kings

text: preſented vnto him hanginges, and tapeſtrie, and earthen veſſels, wheate, and barley, and meale, and polent, and beanes, and rishe, and fryed peaſe,
label: 2 Kings

text: and honie, and butter, sheepe, & fatte calues. and they gaue to Dauid and the people, that was with him, to eate: for they ſuſpected that the people with hunger and thyrſt was faynte in the deſert.
label: 2 Kings

text: DAVID therfore hauing viewed his people, appointed ouer them tribunes & centurions,
label: 2 Kings

text: and gaue the third part of the people vnder the hand of Ioab, and the third part vnder the hand of Abiſai the ſonne of Seruia the brother of Ioab, and the third part vnder the hand of Ethai, who was of Geth: and the king ſaid to the people: I alſo wil goe forth with you.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the people anſwered: Thou shalt not goe forth: for whether we shal flee, it wil be no great importance to them of vs: or whether the halfe part of vs shal fal, they wil not greatly care: becauſe thou alone art accounted for ten thouſandes: it is better therefore that thou be in the citie to ayde vs.
label: 2 Kings

text: To whom the king ſaid: What ſeemeth good to you, that wil I doe. The king therfore ſtoode beſide the gate: and al the people went forth by their troupes, by hundredes and by thouſandes.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the King commanded Ioab, and Abiſai, and Ethai, ſaying: Saue me the child Abſalom. And al the people heard the King commanding al the princes for Abſalom.
label: 2 Kings

text: The people therfore went out into the filde againſt Iſrael, & the battel was fought in the foreſt of Ephraim.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the people of Iſrael was ſlayne there of Dauids armie, and there was made a great ſlaughter in that day, of twentie thouſand.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the battel there was diſperſed vpon the face of al the earth, and there were manie moe, whom the foreſt had conſumed of the people, then they whom the ſword deuoured in that day.
label: 2 Kings

text: And it chanced that Abſalom mette the ſeruantes of Dauid, ſitting on a mule: and when the mule was gone in vnder a thicke oke and a great, his head ſtucke to the oke: and he hanging betwen heauen and earth, the mule that he rode vpon paſſed through.
label: 2 Kings

text: And one ſawe this & told Ioab: ſaying: I ſaw Abſolom hang vpon an oke.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab ſayd to the man that told him: If thou ſaweſt him, why didſt thou not nayle him to the earth, and I had geuen thee ten ſicles of ſiluer, and one belt?
label: 2 Kings

text: Who ſayd to Ioab: If thou wouldeſt pay downe in my handes a thouſand peeces of ſiluer, I would not lay my handes vpon the kinges ſonne: for in our hearing the king commanded thee, and Abiſai, and Ethai, ſaying: Keepe me the child Abſalom.
label: 2 Kings

text: Yea and if I had done agaynſt my life boldly, this could not haue beene hid from the king, and thou wouldeſt haue ſtand agaynſt it?
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab ſayd: Not as thou wilt, but I wil ſet vpon him before thee. He tooke therefore three lances in his hand, and thruſt them in the hart of Abſalom: and when as yet he panted, for life ſticking on the oke,
label: 2 Kings

text: there ranne ten yong men the ſquyers of Ioab, and ſtriking they killed him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab ſounded the trumpet, and ſtayed the people, that they should not purſew Iſrael fleeing, willing to ſpare the multitude.
label: 2 Kings

text: And they tooke Abſalom, and caſt him in the forreſt; into a great pitte, and they heaped vpon him an exceding great heape of ſtones: but al Iſrael fled into their tabernacles.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer Abſalom had erected to himſelf, whiles he yet liued, a title which is in the kinges Valley: for he ſaid: I haue no ſonne, and this shal be a monument of my name. And he called the title by his name, and it is called The hand of Abſalom, vntil this preſent day.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Achimaas the ſonne of Sadoc ſaid: I wil runne, and tel the king, that our Lord hath done him iudgement of the hand of his enemies.
label: 2 Kings

text: To whom Ioab ſaid: Thou shalt not be meſſenger this day, but thou shalt carie the meſſage an other day: to day I wil not haue thee carie the meſſage, for the kinges ſonne is dead.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab ſaid to Chuſai: Goe, and tel the king what thou haſt ſeene. Chuſai adored Ioab, and ranne.
label: 2 Kings

text: And againe Achimaas the ſonne of Sadoc ſaid to Ioab: What letteth if I alſo runne after Chuſai? And Ioab ſayd to him: Why wilt thou runne my ſonne? thou shalt not be caryer of good tydinges.
label: 2 Kings

text: Who anſwered: But what if I runne? And he ſaid to him: Runne. Achimaas therfore running a nere way out went Chuſai.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſate betwen the two gates: and the watchman that was in the toppe of the gate vpon the wal, lifting vp his eies, ſaw a man running alone.
label: 2 Kings

text: And crying out he told the king: and the king ſaid: If he be alone, there are good tydinges in his mouth. And he making haſt, and coming neerer,
label: 2 Kings

text: the watchman ſaw an other man running, and crying alowde in the toppe, he ſaid: There appeareth vnto me an other man running alone. And the king ſaid: And this is a good meſſenger.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the watchman, I behold, ſaid he, the running of the former, as it were the running of Achimaas the ſonne of Sadoc. And the king ſaid: He is a good man: and cometh bringing good newes.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Achimaas crying, ſayd to the king: God ſaue thee ô king. And adoring the king before him flatte to the earth, he ſaid: Bleſſed be our Lord thy God, who hath shut vp the men that haue lifted vp their handes againſt my lord the king.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſayd: Is the child Abſalom ſafe? And Achimaas ſayd? I ſaw a great tumult, when thy ſeruant Ioab ſent, ô king, me thy ſeruant: other thing I know not.
label: 2 Kings

text: To whom the king, Paſſe, ſayd he, and ſtand here. And when he had paſſed, and ſtood,
label: 2 Kings

text: Chuſai appeared: and coming he ſayd: I bring good tydinges my lord king: for our Lord hath iudged for thee this day of the hand of al that haue ryſen againſt thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſayd to Chuſai: Is the child Abſalom ſafe? To whom Chuſai anſwering, ſayd: Let the enemies of my lord the king become, as the child, and al that ryſe againſt him vnto euil.
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therfore being made ſorie, went vp into the high chamber of the gate, and wept. And thus he ſpake, going: My ſonne Abſalom, Abſalom my ſonne: who would graunt me that I might die for thee, Abſalom my ſonne, my ſonne Abſalom.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND it was told Ioab, that the king wept, and mourned for his ſonne:
label: 2 Kings

text: And the victorie was turned into mourning that day to al the people: for the people heard it ſayd in that day: The king ſoroweth vpon his ſonne.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the people shunned that day to enter into the citie, as a people turned, & fleing out of battel is wont to shrinke aſide.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer the king couered his head, and cried with a lowd voice: O my ſonne Abſalom, o Abſalô my ſonne, o my ſonne.
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therfore entring in to the king, into his houſe, ſayd: Thou haſt cõfounded this day the countenances of al thy ſeruantes, that haue ſaued thy life, and the life of thy ſonnes, and thy daughters, and the life of thy wiues, and the life of thy concubines.
label: 2 Kings

text: Thou loueſt them that hate thee, and thou hateſt them that loue thee: and thou haſt shewed this day that thou careſt not for thy nobles, and for thy ſeruantes: and in deede I knowe now, that if Abſalom liued, and al we had beene ſlayne, then it would pleaſe thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: Now therfore ariſe, and come forth, and ſpeaking vnto them ſatisfie thy ſeruantes: for I ſweare to thee by our Lord, that if thou wilt not goe forth, not one verely wil remayne with thee this night: and this shal be worſe for thee, then al the euils, which haue come vpon thee from thy youth vntil this preſent.
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therfore aroſe and ſate in the gate: and it was told al the people that the king ſate in the gate: and al the multitude came forth before the king, but Iſrael fled into their tabernacles.
label: 2 Kings

text: Al the people alſo ſtroue in al the tribes of Iſrael, ſaying: The king hath deliuered vs out of the hand of our enemies, he hath ſaued vs from the head of the Philiſtianes: and now he fled out of the land for Abſalom.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Abſalom whom we annoynted ouer vs, is dead in the battel: how long are you ſtil, and reduce not the king?
label: 2 Kings

text: But king Dauid ſent to Sadoc, and Abiathar the prieſtes, ſaying: Speake to the Ancientes of Iuda, ſaying: Why come you laſt to bring backe the king into his houſe? (And the ſaying of al Iſrael was come to the king in his houſe.)
label: 2 Kings

text: You are my brethren, you my bone, and my flesh, why do you laſt bring backe the king?
label: 2 Kings

text: And ſay ye to Amaſa: Art not thou my bone, and my flesh? Theſe thinges do God to me, and theſe adde he, if thou be not the chiefe captayne of warfare before me alwayes for Ioab.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he inclined the hart of al the men of Iuda, as it were of one man: and they ſent to the king, ſaying: Returne thou, and al thy ſeruantes.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king returned, and came as far as Iordan, and al Iuda came as far as Galgal to meete the king, and to bring him ouer Iordan.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Semei the ſonne of Gera the ſonne of Iemini of Bahurim made haſt, and went downe with the men of Iuda to meete king Dauid
label: 2 Kings

text: with a thouſand men of Benjamin, and Siba the ſeruant of the houſe of Saul: and his fiftene ſonnes, and twentie ſeruantes were with him: and rushing into Iordan,
label: 2 Kings

text: paſſed the fordes before the king, that they might helpe ouer the kinges houshould, and doe according to his commandement. And Semei the ſonne of Gera proſtrate before the king, when he had now paſſed Iordan,
label: 2 Kings

text: ſayd to him: Impute not to me my lord the iniquitie, nor remember the iniuries of thy ſeruant in the day that thou my lord king wenteſt out of Ieruſalem, nor put it in thy hart o king.
label: 2 Kings

text: For I thy ſeruant acknowledge my ſinne: and therefore this day I am firſt come of al the houſe of Ioſeph, and am deſcended to meete my lord the king.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Abiſai the ſonne of Saruia anſwering, ſayd: What shal Semei for theſe wordes not be ſlayne, because he reuiled the annoynted of our Lord?
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd: What is to me and you ye ſonnes of Saruia? Why are you made this day as ſatan to me? Shal there a man be killed in Iſrael to day? Doe I not know that this day I am made king ouer Iſrael?
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſayd to Semei: Thou shalt not die. And he ſware to him.
label: 2 Kings

text: Miphiboſeth alſo the ſonne of Saul came downe to meete the king, his feete vnwashed, and his beard not pouled: and he had not washed his garmentes from the day that the king went forth, vntil the day of his returne in peace.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when he had mette the king at Ieruſalem, the king ſayd to him: Why cameſt thou not with me Miphiboſeth?
label: 2 Kings

text: And he anſwering, ſayd: My lord king, my ſeruant contemned me: and I thy ſeruant ſpake to him that he should ſadle me an aſſe, that getting on I might goe with the king: for I thy ſeruant am lame.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer he hath alſo accuſed me thy ſeruant to thee my lord king: but thou my lord king art as an Angel of God, doe what pleaſeth thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: For neither was my fathers houſe ought els, but guiltie of death to my lord king: and thou haſt put me thy ſeruant among the gueſtes of thy table? What iuſt complaynt therfore haue I? or what can I further crie out to the king?
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therfore ſayd to him: What ſpeakeſt thou any more? That is determined which I haue ſpoken: Thou, and Siba diuide the poſſeſſions.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Miphiboſeth anſwered the the king: Yea let him take al, for ſo much as my lord king is returned peaceably into his houſe.
label: 2 Kings

text: Berzellai alſo the Galaadite, coming downe from Rogelim, brought the king ouer Iordan, being readie alſo to attend on him beyond the riuer.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Berzellai the Galaadite was verie old, that is to ſay, of foure ſcore yeares, and he gaue the king victuals, when he abode in the Fild: for he was an exceding rich man.
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therfore ſayd to Berzellai: Come with me, that thou mayſt reſt ſecure with me in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Berzellai ſayd to the king: How manie are the daies of the yeares of my life, that I should goe vp with the king into Ieruſalem?
label: 2 Kings

text: I am this day foure ſcore yeares old, are my ſenſes quicke to diſcerne ſweete, or ſowre? or can meate or drinke delight thy ſeruant? or can I heare more the voyce of ſinging men and ſinging wemen? Why should thy ſeruant be a burden to my lord the king?
label: 2 Kings

text: I thy ſeruant wil goe forward a litle from Iordan with thee: I neede not this recompenſe,
label: 2 Kings

text: but I beſech thee that I thy ſeruant may returne, and die in my citie, and be buried by the ſepulchre of my father, and my mother. But there is thy ſeruant Chamaam, let him goe with thee, my lord king, and doe to him whatſoeuer ſemeth good to thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therfore ſayd to him: Let Charnaam paſſe on with me, and I wil doe for him whatſoeuer shal pleaſe thee, and al, that thou shalt aske of me, thou ſhalt obtayne.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when al the people and the king had paſſed Iordan, the king kiſſed Berzellai, and bleſſed him: and he returned into his place.
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therfore paſſed into Galgal, and Chamaam with him, and al the people of Iuda had brought ouer the king, and the halfe part onlie of the people of Iſrael were preſent.
label: 2 Kings

text: Therfore al the men of Iſrael concurring to the king, ſayd to him: Why haue our brethren the men of Iuda ſtolen thee, and brought the king and his houshould ouer Iordan, and al the men of Dauid with him?
label: 2 Kings

text: And euerie man of Iuda anſwered the men of Iſrael. Becauſe the king is neerer to me: why art thou angrie for this matter? haue we eaten any thing of the kinges, or were there giftes geuen vs?
label: 2 Kings

text: And a certayne man of Iſrael anſwered the men of Iuda, and ſayd: I am greater by ten partes with the king, & to me pertayneth Dauid more then to thee: why haſt thou done me wrong, and it was not told me firſt, that I might bring backe my king? And the men of Iuda anſwered more sharply then the men of Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: IT chanced alſo that there was there a man of Belial, named Seba, the ſonne of Bochri, a man of Iemini: and he ſounded the trumpet, and ſayd: We haue no part in Dauid, nor inheritance in the ſonne of Iſai: Returne into thy tabernacles Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: And al Iſrael was ſeparated from Dauid, and folowed Seba the ſonne of Bochri: but the men of Iuda ſtucke to their king from Iordan vnto Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when the king was come into his houſe to Ieruſalem, he tooke the ten wemen his concubines, which he had leift to keepe the houſe, and he deliuered them into cuſtodie, allowing them victuals: and he went not in vnto them, but they were shut vp vntil the day of their death liuing in widowhood. And the king ſayd to Amaſa:
label: 2 Kings

text: Cal me together al the men of Iuda agaynſt the third day, and be thou preſent.
label: 2 Kings

text: Amaſa therfote went to cal together Iuda, and taryed beyond the time appoynted which the king had aſſigned him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to Abiſai: Now wil Seba the ſonne of Bochri more afflict vs, then Abſalom: take therefore the ſeruantes of thy Lord, and purſew him, leſt perhaps he finde fenſed cities, & eſcape vs.
label: 2 Kings

text: There went forth therfore with him Ioabs men, Cerethi alſo and Phelethi: and al the ſtrong men yſſued forth of Ieruſalem to purſew Seba the ſonne of Bochri.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when they were beſide the great ſtone, which is in Gabaon, Amaſa coming mette them. Moreouer Ioab was clothed with a ſtrayte cote according to the meaſure of his ſtature, and vpon it girded with a ſword hanging downe to the flanke, in a ſcabbarde, which being made for the purpoſe could with light mouing come forth and ſtrike.
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therfore ſayd to Amaſa: God ſaue thee my brother. And he held with his right hand the chinne of Amaſa, as it were kiſſing him.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Amaſa marked not the ſword, which Ioab had, who ſtrick him in the ſide, and powred out his bowels on the ground, neither added he the ſecond wound, and he dyed. And Ioab, and Abiſai his brother purſewed Seba the ſonne of Bochri.
label: 2 Kings

text: In the meane time certayne men, when they ſtoode by the carcaſſe of Amala, Ioabs company, ſayd: Loe he that would haue beene for Ioab the companion of Dauid.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Amaſa embrewed with bloud, lay in the middes of the way. A certayne man ſaw this that al the people ſtayed to ſee him, and he remoued Amaſa out of the way into the filde, and couered him with a garment, that they which paſſed might not ſtay becauſe of him.
label: 2 Kings

text: He therefore being remoued out of the way, euery man paſſed folowing Ioab to purſew Seba the ſonne of Bochri.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer he had paſſed through al the tribes of Iſrael vnto Abela, and Bethmaaca: and al the choſen men were gathered together vnto him.
label: 2 Kings

text: They therfore came, and aſſaulted him in Abela, and in Bethmaaca, and they compaſſed the citie with munitions, and the citie was beſieged: and al the multitude, that was with Ioab, laboured to deſtroy the walles.
label: 2 Kings

text: And a wiſe woman cryed out from the citie: Heare ye, heare ye, tel Ioab: Approche hither, and I wil ſpeake with thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: Who when he was come to her, she ſayd to him: Art thou Ioab? And he anſwered, I am. To whom she ſpake thus: Heare the wordes of thy handmayd. Who anſwered: I doe heare.
label: 2 Kings

text: And she agayne ſayd: A ſaying was vſed in the old prouerbe: They that aske, let them aske in Abela: and ſo they proſpered.
label: 2 Kings

text: Am not I she that anſwer truth in Iſrael, and thou ſeekeſt to ſubuert the citie, & to ouerthrowe a mother citie in Iſrael? Why throweſt thou downe hedlong the inheritance of our Lord?
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab anſwering, ſayd: God forbid, God forbid that I should, I do not throw downe, nor deſtroy.
label: 2 Kings

text: The matter is not ſo, but a man of mount Ephraim, Seba the ſonne of Bochri by name, hath lifted vp his hand agaynſt king Dauid: Deliuer him onlie, and we wil depart from the citie. And the woman ſayd to Ioab: Behold his head shal be throwen to thee of the wal.
label: 2 Kings

text: She therfore went to al the people, and ſpake to them wiſely: who threw the head of Seba the ſonne of Bochri being cut of, to Ioab. And he ſounded the trumpet, and they departed from the citie, euery one into their tabernacles: and Ioab returned to Ieruſalem vnto the king.
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therfore was ouer al the armie of Iſrael: and Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada ouer the Cheretheites and Pheletheites.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Aduram ouer the tributes: moreouer Ioſaphat the ſonne of Ahilud, was regiſter.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Siua, a ſcribe: and Sadoc and Abiathar, prieſtes.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ira the Iairite was the prieſt of Dauid.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND there came a famine in the daies of Dauid three yeares continually: and Dauid conſulted the oracle of our Lord. And our Lord ſayd: For Saul, and his bloudy houſe, becauſe he ſlewe the Gabaonites.
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therfore calling the Gabaonites, ſayd to them. (Moreouer the Gabaonites were not of the children of Iſrael, but the reliques of the Amorrheites: For the children of Iſrael had ſworne to them, and Saul would ſtrike them of zeale, as it were for the children of Iſrael and Iuda.)
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therfore ſayd to the Gabaonites: What shal I do for you? And what shal be the expiation for you, that you may bleſſe the inheritance of our Lord?
label: 2 Kings

text: And the Gabaonites ſayd to him: We haue no queſtion vpon ſiluer and gold, but agaynſt Saul, and agaynſt his houſe: neither wil we that a man be ſlayne of Iſrael. To whom the king ſayd: What wil you then that I do for you?
label: 2 Kings

text: Who ſayd to the king? The man, that hath waſted vs and oppreſſed vs vniuſtly, we muſt ſo deſtroy, that there be not ſo much as one leift of his ſtocke in al the coaſtes of Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: Let there be geuen vs ſeuen men of his children, that we may crucifie them to our Lord in Gabaa of Saul, once the choſen of our Lord. And the king ſayd: I wil geue them.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſpared Miphiboſeth the ſonne of Ionathas the ſonne of Saul, for the oth of our Lord, that had beene betwen Dauid, and betwen Ionathas the ſonne of Saul.
label: 2 Kings

text: The king therfore tooke the two ſonnes of Reſpha the daughter of Aia, whom she bare to Saul, Armoni, and Miphiboſeth: and the fiue ſonnes of Michol the daughter of Saul, which she bare to Hadriel the ſonne of Berzellai, that was of Molathi,
label: 2 Kings

text: and gaue them into the handes of the Gabaonites: who crucified them on a hil before our Lord: and theſe ſeuen dyed together in the firſt dayes of harueſt, when the reaping of barley began. And Reſpha the daughter of
label: 2 Kings

text: Aia taking a heare cloth, ſpred it vnder her vpon the rocke from the beginning of harueſt, til water dropped vpon them from heauen: and she ſuffered not the birdes to teare them by day, nor the beaſtes by night.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the thinges were told Dauid, which Reſpha had done, the daughter of Aia, the concubine of Saul.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid went, and tooke the bones of Saul, and the bones of Ionathas his ſonne from the men of Iabes Galaad, who had ſtolen them out of the ſtreate of Bethſan, in the which the Philiſtijms hanged them when they had killed Saul in Gelboe.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he caried thence the bones of Saul, and the bones of Ionathas his ſonne: and gathering the bones of them, that were crucified,
label: 2 Kings

text: they buried them with the bones of Saul, and of Ionathas his ſonne in the Land of Beniamin, in the ſide, in the ſepulchre of Cis his father: and they did al thinges that the king had commanded, and God was made propitious agayne to the land after theſe thinges.
label: 2 Kings

text: And there was a battel made agayne of the Philiſtianes againſt Iſrael, and Dauid went downe, and his ſeruantes with him, and fought agaynſt the Philiſthijms. And Dauid faynting,
label: 2 Kings

text: Ieſbibenob, which was of the kinred of Arapha, the yron of whoſe ſpeare weyed three hundred ounces, and he was girded with a new ſword, aſſayed to ſtrike Dauid.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Abiſai the ſonne of Saruia reskewed him, and ſtriking the Philiſtian killed him. Then ſware Dauids men, ſaying: Thou shalt no more goe forth with vs into battel, leſt thou put out the lampe of Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: There was alſo a ſecond battel in Gob againſt the Philiſtians: then ſtroke Sobochai of Huſathi, Saph of the ſtocke of Arapha of the kindred of the gyantes.
label: 2 Kings

text: There was alſo a third battel in Gob agaynſt the Philiſtians, in the which Adeodatus the ſonne of the Foreſt a broderer the Bethlehemite ſtroke Goliath the Getheite, the shaft of whoſe ſpeare was as it were a weauers beame.
label: 2 Kings

text: The fourth battel was in Geth: in the which was a tal man, that had ſix fingers and ſix toes on eche hand and foote, that is fowre and twentie, and he was of the race of Arapha.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he blaſphemed Iſrael: and Ionathan the ſonne of Samaa the brother of Dauid ſtroke him.
label: 2 Kings

text: Theſe foure were borne of Arapha in Geth, and they fel by the hand of Dauid, and of his ſeruantes.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND Dauid ſpake to our Lord the wordes of this ſong, in the day that our Lord deliuered him out of the hand of al his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he ſayd: Our Lord is my rocke, and my ſtrength, and my ſauiour.
label: 2 Kings

text: God is my ſtrong one, I wil hope in him: my shilde, and the horne of my ſaluation: my lifter vp, and my refuge: my ſauiour, from iniquitie thou wilt deliuer me.
label: 2 Kings

text: Our Lord prayſe worthie wil I inuocate: and from mine enemies I shal be ſaued.
label: 2 Kings

text: Becauſe the pangues of death haue compaſſed me: the ſtreames of Belial haue terrified me.
label: 2 Kings

text: The ropes of hel haue compaſſed me: the ſnares of death haue preuented me.
label: 2 Kings

text: In my tribulation I wil inuocate our Lord, and I wil crie my God: and he wil heare my voice out of his holie temple, and my crie shal come to his eares.
label: 2 Kings

text: The earth quaked and trembled, the fundations of the mountaynes were ſtrycken, and shaken, becauſe he was angrie with them.
label: 2 Kings

text: A ſmoke aroſe out of his noſethrels, and a fyre from his mouth shal deuoure: coles were kindled from him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he bowed the heauens, and deſcended: and miſte vnder his feete.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he aſcended vpon the Cherubins, and flew: and ſlidde ouer the winges of the winde.
label: 2 Kings

text: He put darkenes round about him a couer: ſtilling waters out of the clowdes of heauen.
label: 2 Kings

text: By the shyning in his preſence: the coles of fire were kindled.
label: 2 Kings

text: Our Lord wil thunder from heauen: and the high one wil geue his voice.
label: 2 Kings

text: He shot his arrowes and diſperſed them: lightning, and conſumed them.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the ouerflowinges of the ſea appeared, and the fundations of the world were diſcouered at the rebuking of our Lord, at the breathing of the ſpirit of his furie.
label: 2 Kings

text: He ſent from hygh heauen, and tooke me, and drewe me out of manie waters.
label: 2 Kings

text: He deliuered me from my moſt mightie enemie, and from them that hated me: becauſe they were ſtronger then I.
label: 2 Kings

text: He preuented me in the day of my affliction, and our Lord became my ſtay.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he brought me forth into latitude, he deliuered me, becauſe I wel pleaſed him.
label: 2 Kings

text: Our Lord wil reward me according to my iuſtice: and according to the cleannes of my handes wil he render to me.
label: 2 Kings

text: Becauſe I haue kept the wayes of our Lord, and haue not done impiouſly, from my God.
label: 2 Kings

text: For al his iudgementes are in my ſight: and his preceptes I haue not remoued from me.
label: 2 Kings

text: And I shal be perfect with him: and shal keepe my ſelf from myne iniquitie.
label: 2 Kings

text: And our Lord wil reſtore vnto me according to my iuſtice: and according to the cleannes of my handes in the ſight of his eyes.
label: 2 Kings

text: With the holie one thou shalt be holie: and with the ſtrong perfect.
label: 2 Kings

text: With the elect thou shalt be elect: and with the peruerſe thou shalt be peruerted.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the poore people thou wilt ſaue: and the hautie in thyne eies thou wilt humble.
label: 2 Kings

text: Becauſe thou art my lampe o Lord: and thou wilt illuminate my darkenes.
label: 2 Kings

text: For in thee I wil runne girded: in my God I wil leape ouer the wal.
label: 2 Kings

text: God, his way immaculate, the word of our Lord is examined by fyre: he is the ſhield of al that truſt in him.
label: 2 Kings

text: Who is God beſide our Lord: and who is ſtrong beſide our God?
label: 2 Kings

text: God who hath girded me with ſtrength: and made euen my perfect way.
label: 2 Kings

text: Making my feete equal with the hartes, and ſetting me vpon my high places.
label: 2 Kings

text: Teaching my handes vnto battel: and framing myne armes as it were a braſen bow.
label: 2 Kings

text: Thou haſt geuen me the shield of thy ſaluation: and thy mildenes hath multiplied me.
label: 2 Kings

text: Thou shalt enlarge my ſteppes vnder me: and myne ankles shal not fayle.
label: 2 Kings

text: I wil purſew myne enemies, and bruiſe them: and wil not returne til I conſume them.
label: 2 Kings

text: I wil conſume and breake them, that they riſe not: they shal fal vnder my feete.
label: 2 Kings

text: Thou haſt girded me with ſtrength to battel: thou haſt bowed vnder me them that reſiſt me.
label: 2 Kings

text: Myne enemies thou haſt made to turne to me the backe: them that hated me, and I shal deſtroy them.
label: 2 Kings

text: They shal crie, and there shal not be to ſaue, to our Lord, and he wil not heare them.
label: 2 Kings

text: I wil deſtroy them as the duſt of the earth: as the myre of the ſtreates wil I bruiſe and breake them.
label: 2 Kings

text: Thou wilt ſaue me from the contredictions of my people: thou wilt keepe me to be the head of the Gentiles: the people which I knowe not, wil ſerue me.
label: 2 Kings

text: The children alienes wil reſiſt me, with the hearing of the eare they wil obey me.
label: 2 Kings

text: The children alienes are fallen away, and shal be ſtraytened in their diſtreſſes.
label: 2 Kings

text: Our lord liueth, and my God is bleſſed: and the ſtrong God of my ſaluation shal be exalted.
label: 2 Kings

text: God which geueſt me reuenges, and throweſt downe peoples vnder me.
label: 2 Kings

text: Which bringeſt me out from myne enemies, and from them that reſiſt me doſt lift me vp: from the wicked man thou shalt deliuer me.
label: 2 Kings

text: Therfore wil I confeſſe vnto thee o Lord among the Gentiles, and wil ſing to thy name.
label: 2 Kings

text: Magnifying the ſaluations of his king, and doing mercie to his Chriſt Dauid, and to his ſeede for euer.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND theſe are Dauides laſt wordes. Dauid the ſonne of Iſai ſayd: The man ſayd, to whom it was appointed concerning the Chriſt of the God of Iacob, the excellent Pſalmiſt of Iſrael:
label: 2 Kings

text: The Spirit of our Lord hath ſpoken by me, and his wordes by my tongue.
label: 2 Kings

text: The God of Iſrael ſayd to me, the Strong one of Iſrael hath ſpoken, the Dominatour of men, the iuſt ruler in the feare of God.
label: 2 Kings

text: As the light of the mourning when the ſunne ryſeth, early without cloudes, gliſtereth, and as by rayne graſſe ſpringeth out of the earth.
label: 2 Kings

text: Neither is my houſe ſo great with God, that he should enter with me an eternal couenant firme in al thinges & aſſured. For al my ſaluation, and al my wil: neither is there ought therof that ſpringeth not.
label: 2 Kings

text: And tranſgreſſors shal be plucked vp as thornes euery one: which are not taken with handes.
label: 2 Kings

text: And if a man wil touch them, he shal be armed with yron and a lance ſtaffe, and kindled with fyre they shal be burnt vnto nothing.
label: 2 Kings

text: Theſe be the names of the valiantes of Dauid. Sitting in his chaire the wiſeſt prince amongeſt three, he is as it were the moſt tender litle worme of the wood, which killed eight hundred at one brunt.
label: 2 Kings

text: After him, Eleazar the ſonne of his vncle the Ahohite among the three valiantes, that were with Dauid when they defyed the Philiſthijms, and were gathered thither into battel.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when the men of Iſrael were gone vp, he ſtood and ſtroke the Philiſtians til his hand faynted, and waxed ſtiffe with the ſword: and our Lord made a great victorie that day: and the people, that was fled, returned to take away of the ſpoyles of them that were ſlayne.
label: 2 Kings

text: And after him Semma the ſonne of Age of Arari. And the Philiſthijms were gathered togehter in their ward: for there was there a filde ful of rice. And when the people was fled from the face of the Philiſthijms,
label: 2 Kings

text: he ſtood in the middes of the filde, and defended it, and ſtroke the Philiſthians: and our Lord gaue great ſaluation.
label: 2 Kings

text: Moreouer alſo before there went downe three which were princes among thirtie, and came to Dauid in the harueſt time into the caue of Odollam: and the campe of the Philiſtianes was placed in the Vale of the giantes.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid was in a hold: moreouer the ward of the Philiſthianes was then in Bethlehem.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therfore deſyred, & ſayd: O that ſome man would geue me drinke of the water out of the ceſterne, that is in Bethlehem beſide the gate.
label: 2 Kings

text: Three valiantes therfore brake into the campe of the Philiſtianes, and drew water out of the ceſterne of Bethlehem, that was beſide the gate, and brought it to Dauid: but he would not drinke, but offered it to our Lord,
label: 2 Kings

text: ſaying: Our Lord be merciful to me, that I doe not this thing: shal I drinke the bloud of theſe men that went, & the peril of their liues? Therfore he would not drinke. Theſe thinges did the three ſtrongeſt.
label: 2 Kings

text: Abiſai alſo the brother of Ioab the ſonne of Saruia, was prince of three, it is he that lifted vp his ſpeare agaynſt three hundred, whom he ſlewe, renowmed among three,
label: 2 Kings

text: and the nobleſt of three, and he was the chiefe of them, but to the three firſt he raught not.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada the moſt valiant man of great workes, of Cabſeel: he ſtroke the two lions of Moab, and he went downe, and ſtroke the lyon in the middes of the ceſterne in the dayes of ſnow.
label: 2 Kings

text: He alſo ſtroke the AEgyptian, a man worthie to be a ſpectacle, hauing in his hand a ſpeare: therfore when he came downe to him with a rod, by force he wreſted the ſpeare out of the hand of the AEgyptian, and ſlewe him with his owne ſpeare.
label: 2 Kings

text: Theſe thinges did Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada.
label: 2 Kings

text: And he renowmed among the three valiantes, which were the nobler among thirtie: but vnto the three he raught not: and Dauid made him of his ſecrete counſel.
label: 2 Kings

text: Aſael the brother of Ioab among the thirtie, Elahanan the ſonne of his vncle of Bethlehem.
label: 2 Kings

text: Semma of Harodi, Elica of Harori,
label: 2 Kings

text: Heles of Phalti, Hira the ſonne of Acces of Thecua,
label: 2 Kings

text: Abiezer of Anathoth, Mobonnai of Huſati,
label: 2 Kings

text: Selmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
label: 2 Kings

text: Heled the ſonne of Baana, he alſo Netophathite, Ithai the ſonne of Ribai of Gabaath of the children of Benjamin,
label: 2 Kings

text: Banaia the Pharathonite, Heddai of the Torrent Gaas,
label: 2 Kings

text: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaueth of Beromi,
label: 2 Kings

text: Eliaba of Salaboni: The ſonnes of Iaſſen, Ionathan,
label: 2 Kings

text: Semma of Orori, Ahiam the ſonne of Sarar the Ararite,
label: 2 Kings

text: Eliphelet the ſonne of Aaſbai the ſonne of Machati, Eliam the ſonne of Achitophel the Gelonite,
label: 2 Kings

text: Heſrai of Carmel, Pharai of Arbi,
label: 2 Kings

text: Igaal the ſonne of Nathan of Soba, Bonni of Gadi,
label: 2 Kings

text: Selec of Ammoni, Naharai the Berothite the ſquyer of Ioab the ſonne of Saruia,
label: 2 Kings

text: Ira the Iethrite, Gareb he alſo a Iethrite,
label: 2 Kings

text: Vrias the Hetheite. Al thirtie ſeuen.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND the furie of our Lord added to be angrie agaynſt Iſrael, and ſtirred vp Dauid among them ſaying: Goe, number Iſrael and Iuda.
label: 2 Kings

text: And the king ſayd to Ioab the General of his armie: Walke through al the tribes of Iſrael from Dan to Berſabee, and number ye the people, that I may know the number therof.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Ioab ſayd to the king: Our Lord thy God increaſe thy people, as much more as now it is, and agayne multiplie it an hundred fold in the ſight of my lord the king: but what meaneth my lord the king by this kind of thing?
label: 2 Kings

text: Howbeit the kinges word more preuailed then the wordes of Ioab, and of the chiefe of the armie: and Ioab went forth, and the captaynes of the ſouldiars from the face of the king, to number the people of Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when they had paſſed Iordan, they came into Aroer to the right hand of the citie, which is in the Vale of Gad.
label: 2 Kings

text: And by Iazer they paſſed into Galaad, and into the lower countrie of Hodſi, and they came into the wooddie countrie of Dan. And going about neere Sidon,
label: 2 Kings

text: they paſſed nigh to the walles of Tyre, and al the land of the Heueite, and the Chananeite, and they came to the ſouth of Iuda into Berſabee:
label: 2 Kings

text: and hauing viewed the whole land, after nine monethes and twentie dayes, they were come to Ietuſalem.
label: 2 Kings

text: Ioab therfore gaue the number of the deſcription of the people to the king, and there were found of Iſrael eight hundred thouſand ſtrong men, that could drawe ſword: and of Iuda fiue hundred thouſand fighting men.
label: 2 Kings

text: But Dauids hart ſtrooke him, after the people was numbred: and Dauid ſayd to our Lord: I haue ſinned very much in this fact: but I pray thee Lord to transferre the iniquitie of thy ſeruant, becauſe I haue done exceding foliſhly.
label: 2 Kings

text: Dauid therfore aroſe in the morning, and the word of our Lord was made to Gad the prophete and Seer of Dauid, ſaying:
label: 2 Kings

text: Goe, and ſpeake to Dauid: Thus ſayth our Lord: Choyſe is geuen thee of three thinges, chooſe one of them which thou wilt, that I may do it to thee.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when Gad was come to Dauid, he told him, ſaying: Either famine ſhal come to thee ſeuen yeares in thy land: or three monethes thou shalt flee thy aduerſaries, and they shal purſew thee: or certes three dayes the peſtilence shal be in thy land. Now therfore deliberate, and ſee what word I shal anſwer to him that ſent me.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to Gad: I am diſtreſſed excedingly: but it is better that I fal into the handes of our Lord (for his mercies be manie) then into the handes of men.
label: 2 Kings

text: And our Lord ſent the peſtilence in Iſrael, from morning vnto the time appoynted, and there died of the people from Dan to Berſabee ſeuentie thouſand men.
label: 2 Kings

text: And when the Angel of Our Lord had ſtretched fotth his hand ouer Ieruſalem to deſtroy it, our Lord had pitie vpon the affliction, and ſayd to the Angel that ſtroke the people: It is ſufficient: now hold thy hand: and the Angel of our Lord was beſide the floore of Areuna the Iebuſeite.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid ſayd to our Lord when he ſaw the Angel ſtriking the people: I am he that haue ſinned, I haue done wickedly: theſe that are the ſheepe, what haue they done? let thy hand, I beſeche thee, be turned agaynſt me, and agaynſt my fathers houſe.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Gad came to Dauid in that day, and ſayd to him: Goe vp, and build an altar to our Lord in the floore of Areuna the Iebuſeite.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Dauid went vp according to the word of Gad, which our Lord had cõmanded him.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Areuna looking, perceiued the king and his ſeruantes to come towards him
label: 2 Kings

text: And going forth he adored the king with his face bowing to the earth, and ſayd: What is the cauſe that my lord the king cometh to his ſeruant? To whom Dauid ſayd: That I may bye of thee the floore, and build an altar to our Lord, and the ſlaughter may ceaſe which rageth among the people.
label: 2 Kings

text: And Areuna ſayd to Dauid: Let my lord the king take, and offer, as it pleaſeth him: thou haſt the oxen for holocauſte, and the wayne, and the yokes of the oxen for prouiſion of wood.
label: 2 Kings

text: Areuna gaue al thinges to the king: and Areuna ſayd to the king: The Lord thy God receiue thy vowe.
label: 2 Kings

text: To whom the king anſwering, ſayd: Not ſo as thou wilt, but I wil bye it of thee at a price, and I wil not offer to our Lord my God holocauſtes geuen gratis. Dauid therfore bought the floore, and the oxen, for fiftie ſicles of ſiluer:
label: 2 Kings

text: and Dauid built there an altar to our Lord, & offered holocauſtes and pacifiques: and our Lord became merciful to the land, and the plague was ſtayed from Iſrael.
label: 2 Kings

text: AND king Dauid was old, and had manie daies of age: and when he was couered with clothes, he was not warmed.
label: 3 Kings

text: His ſeruantes therfore ſayd to him: Let vs ſeeke for our lord the king a yong woman a virgin, and let her ſtand before the king, and cherishe him, and ſleepe in his boſome, and warme our lord the king.
label: 3 Kings

text: They ſought therfore a beautiful yong woman in al the coſtes of Iſrael, and they found Abiſag a Sunamite, and brought her to the king.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the damſel was exceding beautiful, and she ſlept with the king, and ſerued him, but the king did not know her.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Adonias the ſonne of Haggith was eleuated, ſaying: I wil reigne. And he made him ſelf chariotes and horſemen, and fiftie men, that should runne before him.
label: 3 Kings

text: Neither did his father controwle him at any time, ſaying: Why didſt thou this? And he alſo was very beautiful, the ſecond borne after Abſalom.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he had talke with Ioab the ſonne of Saruia, & with Abiathar the prieſt, who furthered Adonias ſide.
label: 3 Kings

text: But Sadoc the prieſt, and Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Semei, and Rei, and the ſtrength of Dauids armie was not with Adonias.
label: 3 Kings

text: Adonias therfore hauing immolated rammes and calues, and al fatte beaſtes beſide the Stone zoheleth, which was nigh to the Fountaine Rogel, called al his brethren the ſonnes of the king, and al the men of Iuda the ſeruantes of the king:
label: 3 Kings

text: But Nathan the prophet, and Banaias, and al the ſtrong ones, and Salomon his brother he called not.
label: 3 Kings

text: Nathan therfore ſayd to Bethſabee the mother of Salomon: Haſt thou not heard that Adonias the ſonne of Haggith hath reigned, and our lord Dauid is ignorant therof?
label: 3 Kings

text: Now rherfore come, take counſel of me, and ſaue thy life, and thy ſonne Salomons.
label: 3 Kings

text: Goe, and enter in to king Dauid, and ſay to him: Didſt not thou my lord king ſweare to me thy handmayd, ſaying: Salomon thy ſonne shal reigne after me, and he shal ſitte in my throne? Why then reigneth Adonias?
label: 3 Kings

text: And whiles thou art yet ſpeaking there with the king, I wil come after thee, and make vp thy wordes.
label: 3 Kings

text: Bethſabee therfore went in to the king in the chamber: and the king was exceding old, and Abiſag the Sunamite miniſtred to him.
label: 3 Kings

text: Bethſabee bowed her ſelf, and adored the king. To whom the king ſayd: What is thy wil? quoth he.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who anſwering ſayd: My lord, thou didſt ſweare to thy handmayd by our Lord thy God, that Salomon thy ſonne shal reigne after me, and he shal ſitte in my throne.
label: 3 Kings

text: And behold now Adonias reigneth, thou my lord the king not knowing therof.
label: 3 Kings

text: He hath killed oxen, & al fatte thinges, and manie rammes, and called al the kinges ſonnes, Abiathar alſo the prieſt, and Ioab the General of the warfarre: but Salomon thy ſeruant he called not.
label: 3 Kings

text: Notwithſtanding my lord king, the eyes of al Iſrael looke vpon thee, that thou wouldeſt ſhew them, who shal ſitte in thy throne my lord king after thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: And it shal be when my lord king ſleepeth with his fathers, I and my ſonne Salomon shal be ſinners.
label: 3 Kings

text: As she was yet ſpeaking with the king, Nathan the prophet came.
label: 3 Kings

text: And they told the king, ſaying: Nathan the prophete is here. And when he was gone in to the king, and had adored bowing to the earth,
label: 3 Kings

text: Nathan ſayd: My lord king, didſt thou ſay: Let Adonias reigne after me, and let him ſitte vpon my throne?
label: 3 Kings

text: Becauſe he is gone downe to day, and hath immolated oxen, and fattelinges, and manie rammes, and called al the kinges ſonnes, and the captaynes of the armie, Abiathar alſo the prieſt: and they eating and drinking before him, and ſaying: God ſaue the king Adonias:
label: 3 Kings

text: me thy ſeruant, and Sadoc the prieſt, and Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada, and Salomon thy ſeruant he called not.
label: 3 Kings

text: Is this word proceded from my lord the king, and haſt thou not told me thy ſeruant who ſhould ſitte vpon the throne of my lord the king after him?
label: 3 Kings

text: And king Dauid anſwered, ſaying: Cal vnto me Bethſabee. Who when she was entered in to the king, and ſtood before him,
label: 3 Kings

text: the king ſware, and ſayd: Our Lord liueth, which hath deliuered my ſoule from al diſtreſſe,
label: 3 Kings

text: that as I ſware to thee by our Lord the God of Iſrael, ſaying: Salomon thy ſonne shal reigne after me, and he shal ſitte vpon my throne for me, ſo wil I doe this day.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Bethſabee bowing her contenance vnto the earth adored the king, ſaying: God ſaue my lord for euer.
label: 3 Kings

text: King Dauid alſo ſaid: Cal me Sadoc the prieſt, and Nathan the prophet, & Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada. Who when they were entred in before the king,
label: 3 Kings

text: he ſaid to them: Take with you the ſeruantes of your lord, and ſette Salomon my ſonne vpon my mule: and bring him into Gihon.
label: 3 Kings

text: And let Sadoc the prieſt anoint him there, and Nathan the prophet to be king ouer Iſrael: and you shal ſound the trumpet, and shal ſay: God ſaue king Salomon.
label: 3 Kings

text: And you shal goe vp after him, and he shal come, and shal ſitte vpon my throne, and he shal reigne for me: and I wil ordaine him that he be prince ouer Iſrael, and ouer Iuda.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada anſwered the king, ſaying: Amen: ſo ſpeake our Lord the God of my lord the king.
label: 3 Kings

text: As our Lord hath beene with my lord the king, ſo be he with Salomon, and make his throne higher then the throne of my lord king Dauid.
label: 3 Kings

text: Sadoc therfore the prieſt, and Nathan the prophet went downe, and Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada, and Cherethi, and Phelethi: and they ſet Salomon vpon the mule of king Dauid, and brought him into Gihon.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Sadoc the prieſt tooke a horne of oile out of the tabernacle, and annointed Salomon: and they ſounded the trumpet, and al the people ſaid: God ſaue king Salomon.
label: 3 Kings

text: And al the multitude went vp after him, and the people ſinging on shaulmes, and reioyſing with great gladnes, and the earth ſounded of their crie.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Adonias heard, and al that were inuited of him, and the feaſt was ended: yea and Ioab hearing the voice of the trumpet, ſaid: What meaneth the crie of the citie making a tumult?
label: 3 Kings

text: As he yet ſpake, came Ionathas the ſonne of Abiathar the prieſt: to whom Adonias ſaid: Come in, becauſe thou art a ſtout man, and bringeſt good newes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Ionathas anſwered Adonias: Not ſo: for our lord king Dauid hath appointed Salomon king.
label: 3 Kings

text: and hath ſent with him Sadoc the prieſt, and Nathan the prophete, and Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada, and Cerethi, and Phelethi, and they haue ſet him vpon the kinges mule.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Sadoc the prieſt, and Nathan the prophete haue annointed him king in Gihon: & they are gone vp thence reioyſing, and the citie ſounded: this is the voice that you heard.
label: 3 Kings

text: Yea and Salomon ſitteth vpon the throne of the kingdom.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the kinges ſeruantes entring in, haue bleſſed our lord king Dauid, ſaying: God amplify the name of Salomon aboue thy name, and magnifie his throne aboue thy throne. And the king adored in his bed:
label: 3 Kings

text: and he hath thus ſpoken: Bleſſed be our Lord the God of Iſrael, who hath geuen this day one ſitting in my throne, mine eies ſeing it.
label: 3 Kings

text: They therfore were terrified, and they al aroſe, that had beene inuited of Adonias, and euery man went his way.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Adonias fearing Salomon aroſe, and went, and held the horne of the altar.
label: 3 Kings

text: And they told Salomon, ſaying: Behold Adonias fearing king Salomon, hath taken hold of the horne of the altar, ſaying: Let king Salomon ſweare to me this day, that he wil not kil his ſeruant with the ſword.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon ſayd: If he be a good man, there shal not ſo much as one heare of his fal vpon the ground: but if euil shal be found in him, he shal die.
label: 3 Kings

text: King Salomon therfore ſent, and brought him out from the altar: and going in he adored king Salomon: and Salomon ſayd to him: Goe to thy houſe.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND the dayes of Dauid approched that he should die, and he commanded his ſonne Salomon, ſaying:
label: 3 Kings

text: I enter into the way of al flesh: take courage, and play the man.
label: 3 Kings

text: And obſerue the watches of our Lord thy God, that thou walke in his waies, and keepe his ceremonies, and his preceptes, and iudgementes, and teſtimonies, as is written in the law of Moyſes: that thou mayſt vnderſtand al thinges which thou doeſt, and whitherſoeuer thou shalt turne thy ſelfe:
label: 3 Kings

text: that our Lord may confirme his wordes, which he hath ſpoken of me, ſaying: If thy children shal keepe their waies, and shal walke before me in truth, in al their hart, and in al their ſoul, there shal not altogether be taken from thee a man out of the throne of Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: Thou knoweſt alſo what Ioab the ſonne of Saruia hath done to me, what he did to the two princes of the armie of Iſrael, to Abner the ſonne of Ner, and Amaſa the ſonne of Iether: whom he ſlewe, & shed the bloud of warre in peace, & put the bloud of battel in his belt, which was about his loynes, and in his shoe, which was on his feete.
label: 3 Kings

text: Thou shalt doe therfore accotding to thy wiſdom, and shalt not bring his hoare head peaceably vnto hel.
label: 3 Kings

text: But to the ſonnes alſo of Berzellai the Galaadite thou shalt render kindnes, and they shal eate on thy table: for they mette me when I fled from the face of Abſolom thy brother.
label: 3 Kings

text: Thou haſt alſo with thee Semei the ſonne of Gera the ſonne of Iemini of Bahurim, who curſed me with a wicked curſe, when I went to the Campe; but becauſe he came downe to meete me when I paſſed Iordan, and I ſware to him by our Lord, ſaying: I wil not kil thee with the ſword:
label: 3 Kings

text: doe not thou ſuffer him to be guiltles. But thou art a wiſe man, ſo that thou knoweſt what thou shalt doe to him, and thou shalt bring his hoare heare with bloud vnto hel.
label: 3 Kings

text: Dauid therefore ſlept with his fathers, and was buried in the citie of Dauid.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the daies that Dauid reigned in Iſrael, are fourtie yeares: in Hebron he reigned ſeuen yeares, in Ieruſalem thirtie three.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon ſate vpon the throne of Dauid his father, and his kingdome was confirmed excedingly.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Adonias the ſonne of Haggith entered in to Bethſabee the mother of Salomon. Who ſaid to him: Is thy coming peaceable? Who anſwered: peaceable.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he added: I haue a word to ſpeake with thee. To whom she ſaid: Speake. And he:
label: 3 Kings

text: Thou knoweſt, quoth he, that the kingdom was mine, and al Iſrael had purpoſed to make me ouer them to be their king: but the kingdom is tranſpoſed, & is made my brothers: for it was appointed him of our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: Now therefore I deſire one petition of thee; Confound not my face. Who ſaid to him: Speake.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſaid: I pray ſpeake to Salomon the king (for he can not denie thee any thing) that he geue me Abiſag the Sunamite to wife.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Bethſabee ſaid: wel, I wil ſpeake for thee to the king.
label: 3 Kings

text: Bethſabee therfore came to king Salomon, to ſpeake vnto him for Adonias: and the king aroſe to meete her, and adored her, and ſate downe vpon his throne: and a throne was ſette for the kinges mother, who ſate on his right hand.
label: 3 Kings

text: And she ſaid to him: One litle petition I deſire of thee, confound not my face. And the king ſaid to her: My mother aske: for it behoueth not that I turne away thy face.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who ſaid: Let Abiſag the Sunamite be geuen to Adonias thy brother to wife.
label: 3 Kings

text: And king Salomon anſwered, and ſaid to his mother: Why doeſt thou aske Abiſag the Sunamite for Adonias? aske for him alſo the kingdom: for he is my brother elder then I, & hath Abiathar the prieſt, & Ioab the ſonne of Saruia.
label: 3 Kings

text: Therfore king Salomon ſware by our Lord, ſaying: Theſe thinges doe God to me, and theſe adde he, becauſe Adonias hath ſpoken this word againſt his life.
label: 3 Kings

text: And now, our Lord liueth which hath eſtablished me, and placed me vpon the throne of Dauid my father, and which hath made me a houſe, as he ſpake, this day shal Adonias be ſlaine.
label: 3 Kings

text: And king Salomon ſent by the hand of Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada, who ſlewe him, and he died.
label: 3 Kings

text: To Abiathar alſo the prieſt the king ſaid: Goe into Anathoth to thy field, and thou in deede art a man of death: but to day I wil not kil thee, becauſe thou didſt carie the arke of our Lord God before Dauid my father, & haſt ſuſteyned labour in al thinges, wherein my father laboured.
label: 3 Kings

text: Salomon therefore caſt out Abiathar, that he should not be the prieſt of our Lord, that the word of our lord might be fulfilled, which he ſpake concerning the houſe of Heli in Silo.
label: 3 Kings

text: And then a meſſenger came to Ioab for that Ioab had turned after Adonias, and after Salomon had not turned: Ioab therfore fled into the tabernacle of our Lord, & caught the horne of the altar.
label: 3 Kings

text: And it was told king Salomon, that Ioab was fled into the tabernacle of our Lord, and was beſide the altar: & Salomon ſent Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada, ſaying: Goe, kil him.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Banaias came to the tabernacle of our Lord, and ſaid to him: Thus ſayth the king: Come forth. Who ſaid: I wil not come forth, but here wil I die. Banaias reported his word to the king, ſaying: Thus ſpake Ioab, and thus he anſwered me.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king ſaid to him: Doe as he hath ſpoken: and kil him, & burie him, and thou shalt temoue the innocent bloud, which hath beene shed of Ioab, from me, and from the houſe of my father.
label: 3 Kings

text: And our Lord shal render his bloud vpon his head, becauſe he murdered two iuſt men, & better then him ſelf: and ſlew them with his ſword, my father Dauid not knowing, Abner the ſonne of Ner general of the warfare of Iſrael, and Amaſa the ſonne of Iether general of the armie of Iuda:
label: 3 Kings

text: and their bloud shal returne vpon the head of Ioab, and vpon the head of his ſeede for euer. But to Dauid and his ſeede and his houſe, and to his throne be peace for euer from our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: Banaias therfore the ſonne of Ioiada went vp, and ſetting vpon him ſlewe him: and he was buried in his houſe in the deſert.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king appoynted Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada for him ouer the armie, and Sadoc the prieſt he placed for Abiathar.
label: 3 Kings

text: The king alſo ſent, and called Semei, and ſaid to him: Build thee a houſe in Ieruſalem, and dwel there: and thou shalt not goe out thence hither and thither.
label: 3 Kings

text: But what day ſoeuer thou shalt goe out, and shalt paſſe the Torrent Cedron know that thou art to be ſlaine: thy bloud shal be vpon thy head.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Semei ſaid to the king: The ſaying is good: as my lord the king hath ſpoken, ſo wil thy ſeruant doe. Semei therfore dwelt in Ieruſalem, manie dayes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe after three yeares, that the ſeruantes of Semei fled to Achis the ſonne of Maacha the king of Geth: and it was told Semei that his ſeruantes were gone into Geth.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Semei aroſe, and ſadled his aſſe, and went to Achis into Geth to require his ſeruantes, and he brought them out of Geth.
label: 3 Kings

text: And it was told Salomon that Semei went into Geth out of Ieruſalem, and was returned.
label: 3 Kings

text: And ſending he called him, and ſaid to him: Did I not teſtifie to thee by our Lord, and told thee before: What day ſoeuer thou going out shalt paſſe hither & thither, know that thou shalt die? And thou didſt anſwere me: The ſaying is good, which I haue heard.
label: 3 Kings

text: Why then haſt thou not kept the oath of our Lord, and the precept that I commanded thee?
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king ſaid to Semei: Thou knoweſt al the euil, wherof thy hart is priuy to thy ſelfe, which thou didſt to Dauid my father: our Lord hath rendred thy malice vpon thy head:
label: 3 Kings

text: And king Salomon be bleſſed, and the throne of Dauid shal be ſtable before our Lord for euer.
label: 3 Kings

text: The king therfore commanded Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada: who going out, ſtroke him, and he died.
label: 3 Kings

text: THE kingdom therfore was eſtablished in the hand of Salomon, and he was ioyned in affinitie to Pharao the king of Ægypt: for he tooke his daughter, and brought her into the citie of Dauid, vntil he accomplished building his owne houſe, and the houſe of our Lord, and the wal of Ieruſalem round about.
label: 3 Kings

text: But yet the people immolated in the excelſes: for there was no temple built to the name of our Lord vntil that day.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon loued our Lord, walking in the preceptes of Dauid his father, ſauing that he immolated in the excelſes, and burnt incenſe.
label: 3 Kings

text: He went therfore into Gabaon, to immolate there: for that was a verie great excelſe: a thouſand hoſtes for holocauſt did Salomon offer vpon that altar in Gabaon.
label: 3 Kings

text: And our Lord appeared to Salomon in a dreame by night, ſaying: Aske what thou wilt that I may geue it thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon ſaid: Thou haſt done great mercie with thy ſeruant Dauid my father, euen as he walked in thy ſight in truth, and iuſtice, and a right hart with thee: for thou haſt kept thy great mercie, and haſt geuen him a ſonne ſitting vpon his throne, as it is this day.
label: 3 Kings

text: And now Lord God, thou haſt made thy ſeruant to reigne for Dauid my father: but I am a litle childe, and ignorant of my going out and coming in.
label: 3 Kings

text: And thy ſeruant is in the middes of the people, which thou haſt choſen, a people infinite, which can not be numbred and counted for the multitude.
label: 3 Kings

text: Thou shalt therfore geue to thy ſeruant a docible hart, that he may iudge the people, & diſcerne betwen good and euil. For who ſhal be able to iudge this people, this thy people great in number?
label: 3 Kings

text: The word therfore was liked before our Lord, that Salomon had asked ſuch a thing.
label: 3 Kings

text: And our Lord ſayd to Salomon: Becauſe thou haſt asked this thing, and haſt not deſired for thy ſelf manie dayes, nor riches, nor the liues of thine enemies, but haſt deſired wiſedom for thy ſelf to diſcerne iudgement:
label: 3 Kings

text: behold I haue done vnto thee according to thy wordes, & I haue geuen thee a wiſe hart and intelligent, inſo much that none before thee hath beene like thee, nor shal ariſe after thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: Yea and theſe thinges, which thou didſt not aske, I haue geuen thee: to witte, riches, and glorie, ſo that none hath beene like thee among the kinges al dayes hertofore.
label: 3 Kings

text: And if thou wilt walke in my wayes, and keepe my preceptes, and my commandements, as thy father walked, I wil make thy dayes long.
label: 3 Kings

text: Therfore Salomon awaked, and perceiued that it was a dreame: and when he was come to Ieruſalem, he ſtood before the arke of couenant of our Lord, and offered holocauſtes, and made pacifique victimes, and a great feaſt to al his ſeruantes.
label: 3 Kings

text: Then came there two women harlottes to the king, and ſtood before him:
label: 3 Kings

text: of the which one ſaid: I beſech thee, my lord, I and this woman dwelt in one houſe, and I was deliuered of a childe beſide her in the chamber.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the third day, after that I was deliuered, she alſo was deliuered, and we were together, and no other perſon with vs in the houſe, except we two.
label: 3 Kings

text: And this womans childe died in the night. For ſleping she oppreſſed him.
label: 3 Kings

text: And ryſing in the dead tyme of the night, she tooke my childe from the ſide of me thy handmayd being aſlepe, and layed it in her boſome: and her childe that was dead, she put in my boſome.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when I was ryſen in the morning to geue my childe milke, he appeared dead: whom more diligently beholding when it was cleere day, I found that it was not mine which I bare.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the other woman anſwered: It is not ſo as thou ſayſt, but thy childe is dead, and mine liueth. On the contrarie part she ſayd: Thou lieſt: for my childe liueth, and thy childe is dead. And in this maner they ſtroue before the king.
label: 3 Kings

text: Then ſayd the king: This woman ſaith, My childe liueth, and thy childe is dead. And this hath anſwered, No, but thy childe is dead, and mine liueth.
label: 3 Kings

text: The king therfore ſaid: Bring me a ſword. And when they had brought a ſword before the King,
label: 3 Kings

text: Diuide, quoth he, the liuing child into two partes, and geue the halfe part to one, and halfe to the other.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the woman, whoſe childe was aliue, ſaid to the king (for her bowels were moued vpon her childe) I beſech thee my lord, geue her the childe aliue, and kil it not. On the contrarie part she ſayd: be it neither mine, nor thine, but let it be diuided.
label: 3 Kings

text: The king anſwered, and ſaid: Geue vnto this woman the infant aliue, and let it not be killed for this is the mother therof.
label: 3 Kings
