text: Al Iſrael therfore heard the iudgement that the king had iudged, and they feared the king, ſeing the wiſedom of God to be in him to doe iudgement.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND king Salomon was reigning ouer al Iſrael:
label: 3 Kings

text: and theſe were the princes which he had: Azarias the ſonne of Sadoc the prieſt:
label: 3 Kings

text: Elihoreph, and Ahia the ſonnes of Siſa Scribes: Ioſaphat the ſonne of Ahilud, regiſter:
label: 3 Kings

text: Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada, ouer the armie: and Sadoc, and Abiathar prieſtes.
label: 3 Kings

text: Azarias the ſonne of Nathan, ouer them that aſſiſted the king: Zabud the ſonne of Nathan prieſt the kinges frend:
label: 3 Kings

text: and Ahizar gouernour of the houſe: and Adoniram the ſonne of Abda ouer the tributes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon had twelue gouernours ouer al Iſrael, which ſerued out victuals for the king and for his houſe: for euerie one miniſtred neceſſaries, eche man his moneth in the yeare.
label: 3 Kings

text: And theſe are their names: Benhur in mount Ephraim.
label: 3 Kings

text: Bendecar, in Macces, and in Salebim, and in Bethſames, and in Elon, and in Bethhanan.
label: 3 Kings

text: Benheſed in Aruboth: his was Socho, and al the land Epher.
label: 3 Kings

text: Benabinadab, whoſe was al Nepha Dor, had Tapheth the daughter of Salomon to wife.
label: 3 Kings

text: Bana the ſonne of Ahilud gouerned Thanach and Mageddo, and al Bethſan, which is beſide Sarthana vnder Iezrahel, from Bethſan vnto Abelmehula ouer againſt Iecmaan.
label: 3 Kings

text: Bengaber in Ramoth galaad: had Auothiair the ſonne of Manaſſes in Galaad, he was chiefe in al the countrie of Argob, which is in Baſan, three ſcore cities great and walled, which had braſen lockes.
label: 3 Kings

text: Ahinadab the ſonne of Addo was chiefe in Manaim.
label: 3 Kings

text: Achimaas in Nephthali: yea he alſo had Baſemath the daughter of Salomon in mariage.
label: 3 Kings

text: Baana the ſonne of Huſi, in Aſer, and in Baloth.
label: 3 Kings

text: Ioſaphat the ſonne of Pharue, in Iſacar.
label: 3 Kings

text: Semei the ſonne of Ela, in Beniamin.
label: 3 Kings

text: Gaber the ſonne of Vri, in the land of Galaad in the land of Sehon the king of the Ammorrheite, & of Og the king of Baſan, ouer al thinges that were in that land.
label: 3 Kings

text: Iuda and Iſrael innumereble, as the ſand of the ſea in multitude: eating, and drinking, and reioycing.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon was in his dominion, hauing al the kingdomes with him from the riuer of the land of the Philiſthijms vnto the border of Ægypt: of them that offered him preſents, and ſerued him al the dayes of his life.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the prouiſion of Salomon was euerie day thirtie meaſures of floure, & three ſcore meaſures of meale,
label: 3 Kings

text: tenne fat oxen and twentie paſture fed, & a hundred rammes, beſide the veniſon of hartes, roes, and buffles, & fatted foule.
label: 3 Kings

text: For he poſſeſſed al the countrie, which was beyond the riuer, from Thapſa vnto Goza, and al the kinges of thoſe countries: and he had peace on euerie ſide round about.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Iuda and Iſrael dwelt without anie feare, euerie one vnder his vine, and vnder his figtree, from Dan vnto Berſabe al the dayes of Salomon.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon had fourtie thouſand ſtalles of chariothorſes, and twelue thouſand for the ſaddle.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the foreſaide gouernours of the king fed them: yea and the neceſſaries of king Salomons table they gaue forth with great care in their time.
label: 3 Kings

text: Barley alſo and ſtrow for the horſes, and beaſtes, they brought to the place, where the king was, according as it was appointed them.
label: 3 Kings

text: God alſo gaue wiſdom to Salomon and prudence exceding much, and latitude of hart as the ſand that is in the ſea shore.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the wiſdom of Salomon paſſed the wiſdom of al them in the eaſt, and of the Ægyptians,
label: 3 Kings

text: and he was wiſer then al men: wiſer then Ethan the Ezralite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Dorda the ſonnes of Mahol and he was renowmed in al nations round about.
label: 3 Kings

text: Salomon alſo ſpake three thouſand parables: and his ſongues were a thouſand & fiue.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he diſputed of trees from the ceder, that is in Libanus, vnto the hyſſop which cometh out of the wal: and he diſcourſed of beaſtes, and foules, and creeping wormes, and fiſhes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And there came from al people to heare the wiſdom of Salomon, and from al the kinges of the earth, which heard his wiſdom.
label: 3 Kings

text: HIRAM alſo the king of Tyre ſent his ſeruantes to Salomon: for he heard that they had auointed him king for his father: becauſe Hiram had bene Dauids frend at al time.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon ſent to Hiram, ſaying;
label: 3 Kings

text: Thou knoweſt the wil of Dauid my father, and that he could not build a houſe to the name of our Lord his God, becauſe of warres imminent round about, vntil our Lord put them vnder the ſole of his feete.
label: 3 Kings

text: But now our Lord my God hath geuen me reſt round about: and there is no ſatan, nor il rencounter.
label: 3 Kings

text: Wherfore I purpoſe to build a temple to the name of our Lord my God, as our Lord hath ſpoken to Dauid my father, ſaying: Thy ſonne, whom I wil geue for thee vpon thy throne, he shal build a houſe to my name.
label: 3 Kings

text: Command therfore that thy ſeruantes cut me downe cedres out of Libanus, and let my ſeruantes be with thy ſeruantes: and I wil geue thee the hire of thy ſeruantes whatſoeuer thou wilt aske, for thou knoweſt how there is not in my people a man that hath skil to hew wood as the Sidonians.
label: 3 Kings

text: When Hiram therfore had heard the wordes of Salomon, he reioyſed excedingly, and ſaid: Bleſſed be the Lord God this day, who hath geuen vnto Dauid a ſonne moſt wiſe ouer this people ſo great in number.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Hiram ſent to Salomon, ſaying: I haue heard whatſoeuer thou haſt willed me: I wil doe al thy wil in cedre trees, and firre trees.
label: 3 Kings

text: My ſeruantes shal bring them downe from Libanus to the ſea: and I wil put them in boates in the ſea, vnto the place, which thou shalt ſignifie to me; and wil land them there, and thou shalt take them: and thou shalt allow me neceſſaries, that there be meate geuen for my houſe.
label: 3 Kings

text: Therfore Hiram gaue Salomon cedre trees, and firre trees, according to al his wil.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon allowed Hiram twentie thouſand cores of wheate, for prouiſion for his houſe, and twentie cores of moſt pure oile: theſe thinges did Salomon geue to Hiram euerie yeare.
label: 3 Kings

text: Our Lord alſo gaue wiſedom to Salomon, as he ſpake to him: & there was peace betwen Hiram & Salomon, and both made a league.
label: 3 Kings

text: And king Salomon choſe workmen out of al Iſrael, and the taxed number was of thirtie thouſand men.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſent them into Libanus, ten thouſand euerie moneth by courſe, ſo that two monethes they were in their houſes: and Adoniram was ouer this taxing.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon had ſeuentie thouſand of them that caried burdens, and eightie thouſand hewers of ſtones in the mountaine:
label: 3 Kings

text: beſides the ouerſeers which were ouer euerie worke, in number three thouſand, and three hundred that commanded the people, and them that did the worke.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king commanded, that they should take great ſtones, choſen ſtones for the foundation of the temple, and should ſquare them:
label: 3 Kings

text: which the maſons of Salomon, and maſons of Hiram hewed: moreouer the Giblians prepared timber and ſtones, to build the houſe.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND it came to paſſe in the foure hundred and foureſcore yeare of the coming forth of the children of Iſrael out of the Land of Ægypt, in the fourth yeare, the moneth Zio (that is the ſecond moneth) of the reigne of Salomon ouer Iſrael, he began to build a houſe to our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the houſe, which king Salomon built to our Lord, had threeſcore cubites in length, and twentie cubites in bredth, and thirtie cubites in height.
label: 3 Kings

text: And there was a porche before the temple of twentie cubites of length, according to the meaſure of the bredth of the temple: and it had ten cubites of bredth before the face of the temple.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he made in the temple oblique windowes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he built vpon the wal of the temple loftes round about, in the walles of the houſe round about the temple and the oracle, and he made ſides round about.
label: 3 Kings

text: The loft that was vnderneth, had fiue cubites of bredth, & the middle loft was of ſix cubites in bredth, and the third loft had ſeuen cubites of bredth. And he put beames in the houſe round about on the outſide, that they might not cleaue to the walles of the temple.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the houſe when it was built, was built of ſtones hewed and perfected: and hammer, and hachet, and al the toole of yron were not heard in the houſe when it was built.
label: 3 Kings

text: The doore of the middle ſide was in the wal of the houſe on the right hand: and by wynding ſtaires they went vp into the middle rowme, and from the middle into the third.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he built the houſe, and finished it: he couered alſo the houſe with ſeelings of cedre trees.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he built a loft ouer al the houſe fiue cubites of height, and he couered the houſe with cedre timber.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the word of our Lord came to Salomon, ſaying:
label: 3 Kings

text: This houſe, which thou buildeſt, if thou wilt walke in my preceptes, and doe my iudgementes, and keepe al my commandementes, going in them, I wil eſtablish my word to thee, which I ſpake to Dauid thy father.
label: 3 Kings

text: And I wil dwel in the middes of the children of Iſrael, and wil not forſake my people Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: Salomon therfore built the houſe, and finished it.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he built the walles of the houſe on the inſide, with cedre loftes, from the pauement of the houſe to the toppe of the walles, and to the roofes, he couered it with cedre trees on the inſide: and he couered the floore of the houſe with boordes of firre.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he built loftes of cedre timber of twentie cubites at the hinder part of the temple, from the pauement to the higher partes: and he made the inner houſe of the oracle to be Sanctum Sanctorum.
label: 3 Kings

text: Moreouer the temple it ſelf was fourtie cubites before the doores of the oracle.
label: 3 Kings

text: And al the houſe was couered within with ceder, hauing roundels, and the ioyntes therof coningly wrought and the engrauinges ſtanding out: al thinges were couered with bordes: neither could there a ſtone appeare in the wal at al.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he made the oracle in the middes of the houſe, in the inner part, that he might put the arke of couenant of our Lord there.
label: 3 Kings

text: Moreouer the oracle had twentie cubites in length, and twentie cubites of bredth, and twentie cubites in height. And he couered and ſeeled it with moſt pure gold. and the altar alſo he decked with ceder.
label: 3 Kings

text: The houſe alſo before the oracle he couered with moſt pure gold, and faſtened on plates with nailes of gold.
label: 3 Kings

text: And there was nothing in the temple that was not couered with gold: yea and al the altar of the oracle he couered with gold.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he made in the oracle two cherubs of oliue trees, of ten cubites in height.
label: 3 Kings

text: One wing of a cherub of fiue cubites, and the other wing of a cherub fiue cubites: that is, hauing tenne cubites, from the end of one wing vnto the end of the other wing.
label: 3 Kings

text: Of ten cubites alſo was the ſecond cherub: in like meaſure, and the worke was one in both cherubs,
label: 3 Kings

text: that is to ſay, one cherub had the height of ten cubites, and in like maner the ſecond cherub.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he put the cherubs in the middes of the inner temple: and the cherubs extended their winges, and the one wing touched the wal, and the wing of the ſecond cherub touched the other wal: and the other winges in the middle part of the temple touched ech other.
label: 3 Kings

text: He couered alſo the cherubs with gold.
label: 3 Kings

text: And al the walles of the temple round about he graued with diuerſe engrauinges and caruing: & he made in them cherubs, and palme trees, and diuerſe pictures, as it were ſtanding out of the wal, and coming forth.
label: 3 Kings

text: Yea the pauement alſo of the houſe he couered, with gold within and without.
label: 3 Kings

text: And in the entrance of the oracle he made litle doores of the timber of oliuetrees, and fiue corner poſtes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And two doores of oliuetimber: and he graued in them pictures of Cherubs, and figures of Palme trees, and grauen workes ſtanding out very much; and he couered them with gold: and he couered as wel the cherubs as the palmetrees, and the other thinges with gold.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he made in the entrance of the temple poſtes of oliuetimber foure ſquare:
label: 3 Kings

text: and two doores of firre trees, one agaynſt an other: and either doore was duble, and ſo opened with folding leaues.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he graued cherubs, and palmetrees, and engrauinges appearing very much: and he couered al with golden plates in ſquare worke by rule.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he built the inner court with three rowes of ſtones polished, and one rowe of ceder timber.
label: 3 Kings

text: In the fourth yeare was the houſe of our Lord founded in the moneth of Zio:
label: 3 Kings

text: and in the eleuenth yeare in the moneth Bul (that is the eight moneth) the houſe was perfected in al the workes therof, and in al the implementes therof: and he was building it ſeuen yeares.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND his owne houſe Salomon built in thirtene yeares, and brough it to perfection.
label: 3 Kings

text: He built alſo the houſe of the foreſt of Libanus of an hundred cubites in length, and fiftie cubites in bredth, and thirtie cubites in height: and foure ſcore galleries betwen pillers of ceder: for he had cut ceder trees into pillers.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he decked the whole vaut with bordes of ceder, which was held vp with fiue and fourtie pillers. And one order had fiften pillers,
label: 3 Kings

text: ſet one againſt an other,
label: 3 Kings

text: and looked one ouer againſt an other, with equal ſpace betwen the pillers, and ouer the pillers ſquare beames in al equal.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the porche of the pillers he made of fiftie cubites in length, and thirtie cubites in bredth: and an other porche before the greater porche: and pillers, and toppes vpon the pillers.
label: 3 Kings

text: He made alſo the porche of the throne, wherein the ſeate of iudgement is; and couered it with ceder wood from the pauement vnto the toppe.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the litle houſe, where they ſate in iudgement, was in the middes of the porche of like worke. He made alſo a houſe for the daughter of Pharao (which Salomon had taken to wife) of ſuch worke, as alſo this porche.
label: 3 Kings

text: Al of choſen ſtones, which were ſawed by a certain rule & meaſure both within & without: from the fundation to the toppe of the walles, & without vnto the greater courte.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the fundations of choſen ſtones, great ſtones of ten or eight cubites.
label: 3 Kings

text: And aboue there were hewed choſen ſtones of equal meaſure, and in like maner of ceder.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the greater court round with three rewes of hewed ſtones, and one rew of planed ceder, moreouer alſo in the inner court of the houſe of our Lord, and in the porche of the houſe.
label: 3 Kings

text: King Salomon alſo ſent, and tooke Hiram from Tyre,
label: 3 Kings

text: the ſonne of a widow woman of the tribe of Nepthali, his father a Tyrian, an artificer in braſſe, and ful of wiſdom, and intelligence, and skil to make al worke of braſſe. Who when he was come to king Salomon, made al his worke.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he caſt two braſen pillers, of eightene cubites in height one piller: and a line of twelue cubites compaſſed both pillers.
label: 3 Kings

text: He made alſo two litle heades, which should be put vpon the heades of the pillers, caſt of braſſe: fiue cubites high one litle head, and fiue cubites the other litle head:
label: 3 Kings

text: and as it were in maner of a nette, and of cheynes knitte one to the other with maruelous worke. Both litle heades of the pillers were caſt: ſeuen rewes of litle nettes in one litle head, & ſeuen litle nettes in the other litle head.
label: 3 Kings

text: And finiſhed the pillers, and two rewes round about euerie nette, that they might couer the litle heades, which were ouer the toppe of the pomegranates: in like maner did he alſo to the ſecond litle head.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the litle heades, that were vpon the heades of the pillers, were made as it were with lilie worke, in the porche, of foure cubites.
label: 3 Kings

text: And againe other litle heades in the toppe of the pillers about, according to the meaſure of the piller againſt the litle nettes: and of the pomegranates were two hundred rewes round about the ſecond litle head.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſette two pillers in the porche of the temple: and when he had erected the piller on the right hand, he called the name therof, Iachin: in like maner he erected the ſecond piller, and called the name therof Booz.
label: 3 Kings

text: And vpon the heades of the pillers he put a worke in maner of a lilie: and the worke of the pyllers was perfected.
label: 3 Kings

text: He made alſo a ſea of founders worke of ten cubites from brimme to brimme, round in cõpaſſe, the height therof was of fiue cubites, and a corde of thirtie cubites did compaſſe it, round about.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the grauing vnder the brĩme compaſſed it, ten cubites going about the lauatorie: there were two rewes of chamfered forowed grauinges caſt.
label: 3 Kings

text: And it ſtood vpon twelue oxen, of which three looked to the North, and three to the Weſt, and three to the South, and three to the Eaſt, and the ſea was ouer them: whoſe hinder partes were al hid inward.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the thickenes of the lauatorie was of three ounces; and the brimme therof as it were the brimme of a chalice, and the leafe of criſped lilie: it contayned two thouſand bates.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he made ten braſen feete, of foure cubites in length euerie foote, and foure cubites in bredth, and three cubites in height.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the verie worke it ſelfe of the feete, was entergrauen: and entergrauinges betwen the ioyntures.
label: 3 Kings

text: And betwen the litle crownes and the playtes, lions, and oxen, and cherubs: and in the ioyntures likewiſe aboue: and vnder the lions, and oxen as it were bandes of braſſe hanging downe.
label: 3 Kings

text: And foure wheeles at euerie foote, and axeltrees of braſſe: and at foure ſides as it were litle ſhoulders vnder the lauatorie caſt, looking one againſt an other.
label: 3 Kings

text: The mouth alſo of the lauatorie was inward in the toppe of the head: and that which appeared outward, was of one cubite al round, and together it had one cubite & a halfe: and in the corners of the pillers were diuers engrauinges: and the middle enterpillers ſquare not round.
label: 3 Kings

text: The foure wheeles alſo, which were at the foure corners of a foote, ioyned one to an other vnder the foote: one wheele had in height a cubite and a halfe.
label: 3 Kings

text: And they were ſuch wheeles as are accuſtomed to be made in a chariote: and their axeltrees and ſpokes, and ſtrakes, and naues, al caſt.
label: 3 Kings

text: For thoſe foure litle ſhoulders alſo at euerie corner of one foote, were caſt out of the foote and ioyned together.
label: 3 Kings

text: And in the toppe of the foote was a certayne roundnes of halfe a cubite, ſo wrought, that the lauatorie might be put thereon, hauing the engrauinges therof, and diuerſe caruinges of it ſelf.
label: 3 Kings

text: He graued alſo in thoſe ſielinges, which were of braſſe, and in the corners, cherubs, and lions, and palmetrees, as it were in the ſimilitude of a man ſtanding, that they ſemed not to be engrauen, but put to round about.
label: 3 Kings

text: After this maner made he ten feete, of one caſting and meaſure, & like grauing.
label: 3 Kings

text: He made alſo ten lauatories of braſſe: one lauatorie conteyned fourtie bates, and it was of foure cubites: alſo at euerie foote, that is ten, he put ſo manie lauatories.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſette the ten feete, fiue on the right ſide of the temple, and fiue on the leaft: and the ſea he put on the right ſide of the temple againſt the Eaſt toward the South.
label: 3 Kings

text: Hiram therfore made cauldrons, and shoueles, and litle pottes, and perfected al the worke of king Salomon in the temple of our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: Two pyllers, and two cordes of the litle heades, vpon the litle heades of the pyllers: and two litle nettes, to couer the two cordes, that were ouer the heades of the pyllers.
label: 3 Kings

text: And foure hundred pomegranates in the two nettes: two rewes of pomegramates in euerie nette, to couer the cordes of the litle heades.
label: 3 Kings

text: And tenne feete, and tenne lauatories vpon the feete.
label: 3 Kings

text: And one ſea, and twelue oxen vnder the ſea.
label: 3 Kings

text: And cauldrons, and shouels, and litle pottes. Al the veſſels that Hiram made to king Salomon in the houſe of our Lord, were of bright latten.
label: 3 Kings

text: In the champayne countrie of Iordan did the king caſt thoſe thinges in clay ground, betwen Sacoth and Sarthan.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon placed al the veſſel: but for the exceding great multitude the braſſe could not be weyed.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon made al the veſſels in the houſe of our Lord: an altar of gold, and a table, whervpon the loaues of propoſition should be put, of gold:
label: 3 Kings

text: and candleſtickes of gold, fiue on the right hand, and fiue on the leaft againſt the oracle, of pure gold: and as it were lilie floures, and lampes about of gold: and golden ſnuffers,
label: 3 Kings

text: and water pottes, and fleshehookes, and phiales, and morters, and cenſars, of moſt pure gold: and the hindges of doores of the inner Sanctum ſanctorum, and of the doores of the houſe of the temple, were of gold.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon perfected al the worke that he did in the houſe of our Lord, and brought in the thinges that Dauid his father had ſanctified, ſiluer and gold, and the veſſel, and layed them in the treaſures of the houſe of our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: THEN were gathered together al the ancientes of Iſrael with the princes of the tribes, and the heades of the families of the children of Iſrael to king Salomon into Ieruſalem: that they might carrie the Arke of the couenant of our Lord out of the citie of Dauid, that is, out of Sion.
label: 3 Kings

text: And al Iſrael aſſembled to king Salomon in the moneth of Ethanim, on a ſolemne day, that is the ſeuenth moneth.
label: 3 Kings

text: And al the ancientes of Iſrael came, and the prieſtes tooke the arke,
label: 3 Kings

text: and caried the arke of our Lord, and the tabernacle of couenant, and al the veſſels of the Sanctuarie, that were in the tabernacle: and the Prieſtes and the Leuites caried them.
label: 3 Kings

text: And king Salomon, and al the multitude of Iſrael, which was aſſembled vnto him, went with him before the arke, and they immolated sheepe and oxen without eſtimation & number.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the prieſtes brought in the arke of the couenant of our Lord into his place, into the oracle of the temple, into Sanctum ſanctorum vnder the winges of the cherubs.
label: 3 Kings

text: For the cherubs ſpred their winges ouer the place of the arke, and couered the arke, and the barres therof aboue.
label: 3 Kings

text: And wheras the barres ſtood out, and the endes of them appeared without in the Sanctuarie before the oracle, they appeared no farder outward, which alſo were there vntil this preſent day.
label: 3 Kings

text: And in the arke there was nothing els but two tables of ſtone, which Moyſes put in it in Horeb, when our Lord made the couenant with the children of Iſrael, when they came out of the Land of Ægypt.
label: 3 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe, when the prieſtes were gone out of the Sanctuarie, a clowde filled the houſe of our Lord,
label: 3 Kings

text: and the prieſtes could not ſtand and miniſter for the clowde: for the glorie of our Lord had filled the houſe of our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: Then ſayd Salomon: Our Lord ſayd that he would dwel in a clowde.
label: 3 Kings

text: Building I haue built a houſe for thy habitation, thy moſt firme throne for euer.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king turned his face, and bleſſed al the church of Iſrael: for al the church if Iſrael ſtood.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon ſayd: Bleſſed be our Lord the God of Iſrael, who ſpake by his mouth to Dauid my father, & in his owne handes hath perfected it, ſaying:
label: 3 Kings

text: Since the day that I brought my people Iſrael out of Ægypt, I choſe no citie of al the tribes of Iſrael, that a houſe might be built, and my name might be there: but I choſe Dauid to be ouer my people Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Dauid my father would haue built a houſe to the name of our Lord the God of Iſrael:
label: 3 Kings

text: and our Lord ſayd to Dauid my father: In that thou haſt thought in thy hart to build a houſe to my name, thou haſt done wel, caſting this ſame thing in thy mynd.
label: 3 Kings

text: Neuertheleſſe thou shalt not build me a houſe, but thy ſonne, that shal come forth of thy reynes, he shal build a houſe to my name.
label: 3 Kings

text: Our Lord hath confirmed his word, which he ſpake: and I ſtand for Dauid my father, and ſitte vpon the throne of Iſrael, as our Lord hath ſpoken: and I haue built a houſe to the name of our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: And I haue appoynted there a place for the arke, wherin the couenant of our Lord is, which he made with our fathers, when they came out of the Land of Ægypt.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon ſtood before the altar of our Lord in the ſight of the aſſemblie of Iſrael, and extended his handes toward heauen,
label: 3 Kings

text: and ſayd: Lord God of Iſrael, there is no God like to thee in heauen aboue, and vpon the earth beneth: which keepeſt couenant and mercie with thy ſeruantes, that walke before thee in al their hart.
label: 3 Kings

text: Which haſt kept to thy ſeruant Dauid my father, the thinges that thou haſt ſpoken to him: by mouth thou didſt ſpeake, and with thy handes thou haſt accomplished, as this day proueth.
label: 3 Kings

text: Now therfore Lord God of Iſrael, keepe vnto thy ſeruant Dauid my father the thinges which thou haſt ſpoken to him, ſaying: There shal not be taken away of thee a man before me, which ſitteth vpon the throne of Iſrael: yet ſo if thy children shal keepe their way, that they walke before me as thou haſt walked in my ſight.
label: 3 Kings

text: And now Lord God of Iſrael, let thy wordes be eſtablished, which thou haſt ſpoken to thy ſeruant Dauid my father.
label: 3 Kings

text: Is it then to be thought that in deede God dwelleth vpon the earth? for if heauen, and the heauens of heauens can not conteyne thee, how much more this houſe, which I haue built?
label: 3 Kings

text: But looke toward the prayer of thy ſeruant, and to his petitions ô Lord my God: heare the hymne and the prayer, which thy ſeruant prayeth before thee this day:
label: 3 Kings

text: that thy eies be opened vpon this houſe night and day: vpon the houſe, wherof thou ſayeſt: My name ſhal be there: that thou heare the prayer, which thy ſeruant prayeth in this place to thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: That thou heare the requeſt of thy ſeruant and of thy people Iſrael, whatſoeuer they shal pray for in this place, and thou shalt heare in the place of thy habitation in heauen: and when thou haſt heard, thou shalt be merciful.
label: 3 Kings

text: If a man shal ſinne agaynſt his neighbour, and shal haue any oath, wherwith he is held faſt bound: and shal come becauſe of the oath before thine altar into thy houſe,
label: 3 Kings

text: thou shalt heare in heauen: and shalt doe, and iudge thy ſeruantes, condemning the impious, and rendring his way vpon his head, and iuſtifying the iuſt, and rewarding him according to his iuſtice.
label: 3 Kings

text: If thy people Iſrael shal flee their enemies (becauſe they wil ſinne agaynſt thee) and doing penance, and confeſſing to thy name, shal come, and pray, and beſech thee in this houſe;
label: 3 Kings

text: heare in heauen, and forgeue the ſinne of thy people Iſrael, and thou shalt reduce them vnto the land, which thou gaueſt to their fathers.
label: 3 Kings

text: If the heauen shal be shut, and it rayne not, becauſe of their ſinnes, and praying in this place, they doe penance to thy name, and shal be conuerted from their ſinnes through their affliction:
label: 3 Kings

text: heare them in heauen, and forgeue the ſinnes of thy ſeruantes, and of thy people Iſrael: and shew them a good way wherin they may walke, and geue rayne vpon thy land, which thou haſt geuen to thy people in poſſeſſion.
label: 3 Kings

text: If famine aryſe in the land, or peſtilence, or corrupt ayre, or blaſting, or locuſt, or ruſt, and their enemie afflict them beſieging the gates, al plague, al infirmity,
label: 3 Kings

text: al curſing, and banning, that shal chance to any man of thy people Iſrael: if any man shal know the wound of his hart, and shal ſpred forth his handes in this houſe,
label: 3 Kings

text: thou shalt heare in heauen, in the place of thy habitation, and shalt be merciful agayne, and shalt ſo doe that thou geue to euerie one according to his wayes, as thou shalt ſee his hart (for thou onlie knoweſt the hart of al the children of men)
label: 3 Kings

text: that they feare thee al the dayes, which they liue vpon the face of the land, which thou haſt geuen our fathers.
label: 3 Kings

text: Moreouer alſo the ſtranger, which is not of thy people Iſrael, when he shal come from a farre countrie for thy name (for thy great name shal be heard of, and thy ſtrong hand,
label: 3 Kings

text: and thy ſtretched out arme euerie where) when therfore he shal come, and shal pray in this place,
label: 3 Kings

text: thou shalt heare in heauen, in the firmament of thy habitation, & thou shalt doe al thinges, for the which the ſtranger shal inuocate thee: that al the peoples of the earth may lerne to feare thy name, as thy people Iſrael, and may proue that thy name is inuocated vpon this houſe, which I haue built.
label: 3 Kings

text: If thy people shal goe forth to warre agaynſt their enemies, by the way, whitherſoeuer thou shalt ſend them, they shal pray to thee agaynſt the way of the citie, which thou haſt choſen, and agaynſt the houſe, which I haue built to thy name,
label: 3 Kings

text: and thou shalt heare in heauen their prayers, and their petitions, and shalt doe iudgement for them.
label: 3 Kings

text: But if they shal ſinne to thee (for there is no man which ſinneth not) and thou being wrath shalt deliuer them to their enemies, and they shal be led captiue into the land of their enemies farre or neere,
label: 3 Kings

text: and shal doe penance in their hart in the place of captiuitie, and conuerted shal beſech thee in their captiuitie, ſaying: We haue ſinned, we haue done wickedly, we haue dealt impiouſly:
label: 3 Kings

text: and shal returne to thee in al their hart, and al their ſoule, in the land of their enemies, to the which they shal be led captiue: & shal pray to thee agaynſt the way of their land, which thou haſt geuen to their fathers, and of the citie which thou haſt choſen, & of the temple which I haue built to thy name:
label: 3 Kings

text: thou shalt heare in heauen, in the firmament of thy throne their prayers, and their petitions, and shalt doe their iudgement for them:
label: 3 Kings

text: and shalt be merciful to thy people, which ſinned to thee, and to al their iniquities, wherwith they haue tranſgreſſed agaynſt thee: and shalt geue mercie before them, that shal haue them captiues, that they may haue compaſſion on them.
label: 3 Kings

text: For they are thy people, and thine inheritance, whom thou haſt brought out of the Land of Ægypt, from the middes of the yron fornace.
label: 3 Kings

text: That thy eies be open to the petition of thy ſeruant, and of thy people Iſrael, & thou heare them in al thinges for which they shal inuocate thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: For thou haſt ſeparated them to thee for an inheritance from al the peoples of the earth, as thou haſt ſpoken by Moyſes thy ſeruant, when thou didſt bring our fathers out of Ægypt, Lord God.
label: 3 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe, when Salomon had accomplished praying to our Lord al this prayer and petition, he roſe from the ſight of the altar of our Lord: for he had faſtened both knees on the ground, and had ſpred his handes toward heauen.
label: 3 Kings

text: He ſtood therfore and bleſſed al the aſſemblie of Iſrael with a lowde voyce, ſaying:
label: 3 Kings

text: Bleſſed be our Lord, which hath geuen reſt to his people Iſrael, according to al thinges that he hath ſpoken: there hath not fayled ſo much as one word of al the good thinges, that he ſpake by Moyſes this ſeruant.
label: 3 Kings

text: Be our Lord God with vs, as he hath beene with our fathers, not forſaking, nor reiecting vs.
label: 3 Kings

text: But incline he our hartes to him, that we may walke in al his waies, and keepe his commandementes, and his ceremonies, and iudgementes whatſoeuer he commanded our fathers.
label: 3 Kings

text: And be theſe my wordes, wherewith I haue prayed before our Lord, approching to our Lord God day and night, that he may doe iudgement for his ſeruant, and for his people Iſrael day by day:
label: 3 Kings

text: that al the peoples of the earth may knowe, that our Lord he is God, and there is none other beſides him.
label: 3 Kings

text: Let our hart alſo be perfect with our Lord God, that we walke in his decrees, and keepe his cõmandementes, as alſo this day.
label: 3 Kings

text: Therfore the king, and al Iſrael with him, did immolate victimes before our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon killed pacifique hoſtes, which he immolated to our Lord, of oxen two and twentie thouſand, and of sheepe an hundred twentie thouſand: and they dedicated the temple of our Lord, the king, and the children of Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: In that day the king ſanctified the middes of the court, that was before the houſe of our Lord: for he made the holocauſt there, and ſacrifice, and fatte of the pacifiques: becauſe the braſen altar, that was before our Lord, was too litle, and could not take the holocauſt, and ſacrifice, and fatte of the pacifiques.
label: 3 Kings

text: Salomon therfore made in that time a ſolemne feſtiuitie, and al Iſrael with him, a great multitude from the entrance of Emath vnto the Ryuer of Ægypt, before our Lord God, ſeuen daies and ſeuen daies, that is, fourtene daies.
label: 3 Kings

text: And in the eight day he diſmiſſed the people: Who bleſſing the king, went into their tabernacles reioyſing, and with a ioyful hart for al the good thinges, that our Lord had done to Dauid his ſeruant, and to Iſrael his people.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND it came to paſſe when Salomon had perfected the building of the houſe, of our Lord, & the kinges houſe, and al that he wiſhed and would haue done,
label: 3 Kings

text: our Lord appeared to him the ſecond time, as he had appeared to him in Gabaon.
label: 3 Kings

text: And our Lord ſaid to him: I haue heard thy prayer & thy petition, which thou haſt prayed before me: I haue ſanctified this houſe, which thou haſt built, that I might put my name there for euer, and myne eies and my hart shal be there alwaies.
label: 3 Kings

text: Thou alſo if thou wilt walke before me, as thy father walked, in ſimplicitie of hart, and in equitie: and wilt doe al thinges, which I haue commanded thee, and wilt keepe my ordinances and my iudgementes,
label: 3 Kings

text: I wil ſette the throne of thy kingdom ouer Iſrael for euer, as I haue ſpoken to Dauid thy father, ſaying: There shal not be taken away a man of thy ſtocke from the throne of Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: But if by reuolting you and your children shal turne away, not folowing me, nor keeping my commandementes, and my ceremonies, which I haue propoſed to you, but shal goe and worshippe ſtrange goddes, and adore them:
label: 3 Kings

text: I wil take away Iſrael from the face of the land, which I haue geuen them, and the temple which I haue ſanctified to my name, I wil caſt away from my ſight, and Iſrael shal be for a prouerbe, and for a fable to al peoples.
label: 3 Kings

text: And this houſe shal be for an example: euerie one that shal paſſe by it, shal wonder, and hiſſe, and ſay: Why hath the Lord done thus to this land, and to this houſe?
label: 3 Kings

text: And they shal anſwere: Becauſe they haue forſaken the Lord their God, which brought their fathers out of the land of Ægypt, and haue folowed ſtrange goddes, & adored them, and worshipped them: therfore hath the Lord brought vpon them al this euil.
label: 3 Kings

text: And twentie yeares being complete, after that Salomon had built the two houſes, that is, the houſe of our Lord, and the houſe of the king
label: 3 Kings

text: (Hiram the king of Tyre miniſtring to Salomon ceder trees & firre trees, and gold according to al that he had neede) then Salomon gaue to Hiram twentie townes in the Land of Galilee.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Hiram went from Tyre to ſee the townes which Salomon had geuen him, and they pleaſed him not,
label: 3 Kings

text: and he ſayd: Are theſe the cities, which thou haſt geuen me, brother? And he called them the land Chabul, vntil this day.
label: 3 Kings

text: Hiram alſo ſent to king Salomon an hundred and twentie talentes of gold.
label: 3 Kings

text: This is the ſumme of the expences, which king Salomon offered to build the houſe of our Lord, and his owne houſe, and Mello, and the wal of Ieruſalem, and Heſer, and Mageddo, and Gazer
label: 3 Kings

text: Pharao the king of Ægypt came vp and tooke Gazer, and burnt it with fire: And the Chananite, that dwelt in the citie, he ſlewe, and gaue it for a dowrie to his daughter the wife of Salomon.
label: 3 Kings

text: Salomon therfore built Gazer, and Bethhoron the lower,
label: 3 Kings

text: and Baalath, and Palmira in the Land of the wildernes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And al the villages, that perteyned to him, and were without wal, he fenſed, and the cities of the chariotes, and the cities of the horſemen, and whatſoeuer pleaſed him to build in Ieruſalem, and in Libanus, and in al the land of his dominion.
label: 3 Kings

text: Al the people, that was remayning of the Amorrheites, and Hetheites, and Pherezeites, and Heueites, and Iebuſeites, that are not of the children of Iſrael:
label: 3 Kings

text: their children, that were remayning in the land, to witte, thoſe whom the children of Iſrael could not abolish: Salomon made tributaries, vntil this day.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the children of Iſrael Salomon appoynted not any man to ſerue, but they were men of warre, and his ſeruantes, and princes, and captaynes, and ouerſeers of the chariotes and horſes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And there were princes ouer al the workes of Salomon, made ouerſeers, fiue hundred fiftie, which had the people ſubiect, and commanded ouer their appoynted workes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the daughter of Pharao went vp out of the citie of Dauid into her houſe, which Salomon had built her: then did he build Mello.
label: 3 Kings

text: Salomon alſo offered three tymes euerie yeare holocauſtes, and pacifique victimes vpon the altar, which he had built to our Lord, and he burnt incenſe before our Lord: and the temple was perfected.
label: 3 Kings

text: King Salomon alſo made a name in Aſiongaber, which is beſide Ailath in the shore of the Readſea in the Land of Idumea.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Hiram ſent in that nauie his men, that were mariners and skilful of the ſea, with the ſeruantes of Salomon.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who when they were come into Ophir, the gold taken thence of foure hundred and twentie talentes, they brought to king Salomon.
label: 3 Kings

text: BVT the Queene of Saba alſo hauing heard the fame of Salomon, in the name of our Lord came to proue him, in hard propoſitions.
label: 3 Kings

text: And entring into Ieruſalem with a great trayne, and riches, and camels carying ſpices, and gold exceding infinite, and pretious ſtones, she came to king Salomon, and ſpake to him al thinges that she had in her hart.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon interpreted to her al the wordes, that she propoſed: there was not a word, that the king could be ignorant of, and could not anſwer her.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the queene of Saba ſeing al the wiſedom of Salomon, and the houſe, which he had built,
label: 3 Kings

text: and the meates of his table, and the habitations of his ſeruantes, and the orders of them that ſerued, and their garmentes, cupbearers, and the holocauſtes which he offered in the houſe of our Lord she had no longer ſpirit,
label: 3 Kings

text: and she ſaid to the king: The report is true, which I haue heard in my countrie,
label: 3 Kings

text: concerning thy wordes, and concerning thy wiſedom. and I did not beleue them that told me, til my ſelfe came, and ſawe with myne eies, and haue proued that the half not been told me: greater is thy wiſdom, and thy workes, then the rumour, which I haue heard.
label: 3 Kings

text: Bleſſed are thy men, and bleſſed are thy ſeruantes, which ſtand before thee alwaies, and heare thy wiſedom.
label: 3 Kings

text: Be the Lord thy God bleſſed, whom thou haſt pleaſed, and that hath ſette thee vpon the throne of Iſrael, for that the Lord hath loued Iſrael for euer, and hath appointed thee king, to do iudgement and iuſtice.
label: 3 Kings

text: She therfore gaue to the king an hundred and twentie talentes of gold, and ſpices exceding much, and pretious ſtones: There was no more brought ſo much ſpice, as that which the Quene of Saba gaue to king Salomon.
label: 3 Kings

text: (But the naue alſo of Hiram, which caried gold out of Ophir, brought from Ophir thyine trees exceding manie, and pretious ſtones.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king made of the thyine trees the porches of the houſe of our Lord, and of the kinges houſe and harpes & vials for the ſingers: there wete not ſuch thyine trees broughs, nor ſeen vntil this preſent daye.)
label: 3 Kings

text: And king Salomon gaue to the queene of Saba al that she would, and asked of him: beſide thoſe thinges, which of him ſelfe he offered her for a royal gift. Who returned, and went into her countrie with her ſeruantes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the weight of the gold, that was brought to Salomon euerie yeare, was of ſix hundred ſixtie ſix talentes of gold:
label: 3 Kings

text: beſide that, which the men brought, that were ouer the tributes, and merchantes, and al that ſold light wares, and al the kinges of Arabia, and the dukes of the land.
label: 3 Kings

text: Salomon alſo made two hundred ſhieldes of moſt pure gold, ſix hundred ſicles of gold did he allow for the plates of one shield.
label: 3 Kings

text: And three hundred tergattes of tried gold: and three hundred poundes of gold garnished one terget: and the king put them in the houſe of the foreſt of Libanus.
label: 3 Kings

text: King Salomon alſo made a great throne of yuorie: and couered it with gold exceding yellow,
label: 3 Kings

text: which had ſixe ſteppes: and the toppe of the throne was round in the hinder part: and the two handes on either ſide holding the ſeate: and two lyons ſtood at euery hand.
label: 3 Kings

text: And twelue litle lyons ſtanding vpon the ſixe ſteppes on either ſide: there was not ſuch a worke made in al kingdomes.
label: 3 Kings

text: Yea and al the veſſels, out of the which the king Salomon drunke, were of gold: and al the furniture of the houſe of the foreſt of Libanus of moſt pure gold: there was no ſiluer, neither was it thought of any price in the daies of Salomon,
label: 3 Kings

text: becauſe rhe kinges nauie, once in three yeares, went with the nauie of Hiram on the ſea into Tharſis, bringing thence gold, and ſiluer, and the teeth of elephantes, and apes, and pecockes.
label: 3 Kings

text: King Salomon therfore was magnified aboue al the kinges of the earth in riches, and wiſedom.
label: 3 Kings

text: And al the earth deſired to ſee Salomons face, that they might heare his wiſedom, which God had geuen in his hart.
label: 3 Kings

text: And euerie one preſented him giftes, veſſel of ſiluer and gold, garmentes and inſtrumentes for warre, ſpices alſo, and horſes and mules euerie yeare.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon gathered together the chariotes and horſemen, and there amounted to him a thouſand foure hundred chariotes, and twelue thouſand horſemen: and he diſpoſed them in fenſed cities, and with the king in Ieruſalem.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he made that there was as great abundance of ſiluer In Ieruſalem, as of ſtones: and of ceder trees he cauſed ſuch a multitude, as if it were ſycomore trees, which grow in the playnes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And there were horſes brought for Salomon out of Ægypt, and Coa, for the kinges merchantes brought them out of Coa, and brought them at a ſette price.
label: 3 Kings

text: And a chariote of foure horſes came out of Ægypt, for ſixe hundred ſicles of ſiluer, and one horſe for an hundred and fiftie. And after this maner did al the kinges of the Hetheites, and of Syria ſel horſes.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND king Salomon loued manie wemen ſtrangers, the daughter alſo of Pharao, and Moabites, and Ammonites, Idumeians, and Sidonians, and Hetheians:
label: 3 Kings

text: of the nations, wherof our Lord ſayd to the children of Iſrael: You ſhal not goe in vnto them, neither shal anie of them come in vnto yours: for they wil moſt certainly turne away your hartes to folow their goddes. To theſe therfore was Salomon copled in moſt feruent loue.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he had wiues as it were queenes ſeuen hundred, and concubines three hundred: and the wemen turned away his hart.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when he was now old, his hart was depraued by wemen, that he folowed ſtrange goddes: neither was his hart perfect with our Lord his God, as the hart of Dauid his father.
label: 3 Kings

text: But Salomon worshipped Aſtarthee the goddeſſe of the Sidonians, and Moloch the idol of the Ammonites.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon did that which was not liked before our Lord, and he accomplished not to folow our Lord, as Dauid his father.
label: 3 Kings

text: Then built Salomon a temple to Camos the idol of Moab, in the mount that is agaynſt Ieruſalem, and to Moloch the idol of the children of Ammon.
label: 3 Kings

text: And in this maner did he to al his wiues that were ſtrangers, which burnt frankencenſe, and immolated to their goddes.
label: 3 Kings

text: Therfore our Lord was wrath with Salomon, becauſe his minde was turned away from our Lord the God of Iſrael, who had appeared vnto him the ſecond tyme,
label: 3 Kings

text: and had commanded him concerning this word, that he should not folow ſtrange goddes, & he kept not the thinges which our Lord commanded him.
label: 3 Kings

text: Our Lord therfore ſayd to Salomon: Becauſe thou haſt done this, and haſt not kept my couenant, and my preceptes, which I haue commanded thee, breaking I wil rent aſunder thy kingdom, and wil geue it to thy ſeruant.
label: 3 Kings

text: Neuertheleſſe in thy dayes I wil not doe it, becauſe of Dauid thy father: out of the hand of thy ſonne I wil rent it,
label: 3 Kings

text: neither wil I take away the whole kingdom, but one tribe I wil geue to thy ſonne for Dauid my ſeruant, and Ieruſalem. Which I haue choſen.
label: 3 Kings

text: And our Lord rayſed vp an aduerſarie to Salomon, Adad an Idumeite of the kinges ſeede, who was in Edom.
label: 3 Kings

text: For when Dauid was in Idumea, and Ioab the general of the warfare was gone vp to burie them that were ſlayne, and had ſlayne al malekind in Idumea,
label: 3 Kings

text: (for Ioab taried there ſix monethes and al Iſrael, til he ſlew al malekind in Idumea,)
label: 3 Kings

text: Adad him ſelf fled, and men of Idumea of his fathers ſeruantes with him, to goe into Ægypt: and Adad was a litle boy.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when they roſe out of Madian, they came into Pharan, and they tooke with them men of Pharan, and entered into Ægypt to Pharao the king of Ægypt: who gaue him a houſe, and appoynted him meates, and aſſigued him land.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Adad found grace before Pharao excedingly, in ſo much that he gaue him to wife, the germane ſiſter of his wife Taphnes the queene.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the ſiſter of Taphnes bare him a ſonne Genubath, and Taphnes brought him vp in the houſe of Pharao: and Genubath was dwelling at Pharaoes houſe with his children.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when Adad in Ægypt had heard, that Dauid ſlept with his fathers, and that Ioab the general of the warefare was dead, he ſayd to Pharao: Diſmiſſe me, that I may goe into my countrie.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Pharao ſayd to him: For what lackeſt thou with me, that thou ſeekeſt to goe into thyne owne countrie? But he anſwered: Nothing: yet I beſech thee that thou diſmiſſe me.
label: 3 Kings

text: God alſo rayſed vp to him an aduerſarie, Razon the ſonne of Eliada, who had fled Adarezer the king of Soba his lord:
label: 3 Kings

text: and he gathered men agaynſt him, and he became the captayne of theues, when Dauid killed them: and they went to Damaſcus, and dwelt there, and they made him king in Damaſcus,
label: 3 Kings

text: and he was an aduerſarie to Iſrael al the dayes of Salomon: and this is the euil of Adad, and hatred agaynſt Iſrael, and he reigned in Syria.
label: 3 Kings

text: Ieroboam alſo the ſonne of Nabath, an Ephratheite of Sareda, the ſeruant of Salomon, whoſe mother was called Serua, a woman widow lifted vp his hand agaynſt the king.
label: 3 Kings

text: And this is the cauſe of his rebellion agaynſt him, becauſe Salomon built Mello, and filled vp the breache of the citie of Dauid his father.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Ieroboam was a ſtrong man and mightie: and Salomon ſeing the youngman of a good witte & induſtrious, had made him chief ouer the tributes of al the houſe of Ioſeph.
label: 3 Kings

text: It came to paſſe therfore at that tyme, that Ieroboam went out of Ieruſalem, and the prophete Ahias the Silonite found him in the way, couered with a new cloke: and they two onlie were in the field.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Ahias taking his new cloke, wherwith he was couered, cut it into twelue partes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſayd to Ieroboam: Take vnto thee ten pieces: for thus ſayth our Lord the God of Iſrael: Behold I wil rent the kingdom out of the hand of Salomon, and wil geue thee ten tribes.
label: 3 Kings

text: But one tribe shal remayne to him for my ſeruant Dauid, and Ieruſalem the citie, which I haue choſen of al the tribes of Iſrael:
label: 3 Kings

text: becauſe he hath forſaken me, and hath adored Aſtarthee the goddeſſe of the Sidonians, & Chamos the god of Moab, and Moloch the god of the children of Ammon: and hath not walked in my waies, to doe iuſtice before me, and my preceptes, and iudgementes as Dauid his father.
label: 3 Kings

text: Neither wil I take away al the kingdom out of his hand, but I wil make him prince al the daies of his life, for Dauid my ſeruant, whom I choſe, who kept my commandmentes and my preceptes.
label: 3 Kings

text: But I wil take away the kingdom out of his ſonnes hand, and wil geue thee ten tribes:
label: 3 Kings

text: and to his ſonne I wil geue one tribe, that there may remayne a lampe to Dauid my ſeruant at al times before me in Ieruſalem, the citie which I haue choſen, that my name might be there.
label: 3 Kings

text: And thee wil I take, and thou shalt reigne ouer al thinges, that thy ſoule deſireth, and thou shalt be king ouer Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: If therfore thou wilt heare al thinges, that I shal command thee, and wilt walke in my waies, and doe that which is right before me, keeping my commandmentes and my preeceptes, as Dauid my ſeruant did: I wil be with thee, and wil build thee a faythful houſe, as I built a houſe to Dauid, and I wil deliuer Iſrael to thee:
label: 3 Kings

text: and I wil afflict the ſeede of Dauid vpon this, but yet not alwaies.
label: 3 Kings

text: Salomon therfore would haue killed Ieroboam: who aroſe, and fled into Ægypt to Seſac the king of Ægypt, and was in Ægypt vntil the death of Salomon.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the reſt of the wordes of Salomon, and al that he did, and his wiſedom: behold they are al written in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of Salomon.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the daies, that Salomon reigned in Ieruſalem ouer al Iſrael, are fourtie yeares.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Salomon ſlept with his fathers, and was buried in the citie of Dauid his father, and Roboam his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND Roboam came into Sichem: for thither was al Iſrael gathered together to make him king.
label: 3 Kings

text: But Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, when he was yet in Ægypt fugitiue from the face of king Salomon, hearing of his death, returned out of Ægypt.
label: 3 Kings

text: And they ſent and called him: Ieroboam therfore came, and al the multitude of Iſrael, and they ſpake to Roboam, ſaying.
label: 3 Kings

text: Thy father layd a moſt hard yoke vpon vs: thou therfore diminish now a litle of thy fathers moſt hard empire, and of the moſt heauie yoke, that he layd vpon vs, and we wil ſerue thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who ſayd to them: Goe vntil the third day, and returne to me. And when the people was gone,
label: 3 Kings

text: king Roboam tooke counſel with the ancièntes, that aſſiſted before Salomon his father, whiles he yet liued, and he ſayd: What counſel doe you geue me, that I may anſwer this people?
label: 3 Kings

text: Who ſayd to him: If this day thou wilt yeld to this people, and condeſcend to them, and graunt to their petition, and wilt ſpeake to them gentle wordes, they wil be thy ſeruantes alwaies.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who leaft the counſel of the ancientes, which they had geuen him, and admitted yongmen, that had bene brought vp with him, and wayted on him,
label: 3 Kings

text: and he ſayd to them: What counſel geue you me, that I may anſwer this people, which haue ſayd to me: Make the yoke lighter which thy father hath put vpon vs?
label: 3 Kings

text: And the yongmen, that had bene brought vp with him, ſayd: Thus ſpeake to this people, which haue ſpoken to thee, ſaying: Thy father aggrauated our yoke, doe thou eaſe it. Thus shalt thou ſpeake to them: My leaſt finger is groſſer then the backe of my father.
label: 3 Kings

text: And now my father layd vpon you a heauie yoke, but I wil adde vpon your yoke: my father bette you with ſcourges, but I wil beate you with ſcorpions.
label: 3 Kings

text: Ieroboam therfore came, and al the people to Roboam the third day, as the king had ſpoken, ſaying: Returne to me the third day.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king anſwered the people rough wordes, leauing the counſel of the ancientes, which they had geuen him,
label: 3 Kings

text: and he ſpake to them according to the counſel of the youngmen, ſaying: My father made your yoke heauie, but I wil adde to your yoke: my father bette you with whippes, but I wil beate you with ſcorpions.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king condeſcended not to the people: becauſe our Lord was turned away from him, that he might rayſe vp his word, which he had ſpoken in the hand of Ahias the Silonite, to Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat.
label: 3 Kings

text: The people therfore ſeing that the king would not heare them, anſwered him, ſaying: What part haue we in Dauid? or what inheritance in the ſonne of Iſai? Goe into thy tabernacles Iſrael, now ſee to thy houſe Dauid. And Iſrael went into their tabernacles.
label: 3 Kings

text: But ouer the children of Iſrael, whoſoeuer dwelt in the cities of Iuda, Roboam reigned.
label: 3 Kings

text: King Roboam therfore ſent Aduram, who was ouer the tributes: and al Iſrael ſtoned him, and he died, moreouer King Roboam in haſt went vp into his chariote, and fled into Ieruſalem:
label: 3 Kings

text: and Iſrael reuolted from the houſe of Dauid, vntil this preſent day.
label: 3 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe when al Iſrael had heard, that Ieroboam was returned, they ſent, and called him, an aſſemblie being gathered, and they made him king ouer al Iſrael, neither did any man folow the houſe of Dauid beſide the tribe of Iuda onlie.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Roboam came to Ieruſalem, and gathered together al the houſe of Iuda, and the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred foureſcore thouſand choſen men warriers, to fight agaynſt the houſe of Iſrael, and to reduce the kingdom to Roboam the ſonne of Salomon.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the word of our Lord came to Semeias the man of God, ſaying:
label: 3 Kings

text: Speake to Roboam the ſonne of Salomon, the king of Iuda, and to al the houſe of Iuda, and Beniamin, and the reſt of the people, ſaying:
label: 3 Kings

text: Thus ſayth our Lord: You shal not goe vp, neither ſhal you fight agaynſt your brethren the children of Iſrael: let euerie man returne into his houſe, for this word is done by me. They heard the word of our Lord, and returned from their iourney as our Lord had commanded them.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Ieroboam built Sichem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt there: and departing thence he built Phanuel.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Ieroboam ſayd in his hart: Now wil the kingdom returne to the houſe of Dauid,
label: 3 Kings

text: if this people shal goe vp to make ſacrifices in the houſe of our Lord into Ieruſalem: and the hart of this people wil be turned to their lord Roboam the king of Iuda, and they wil kil me, and returne to him.
label: 3 Kings

text: And finding out a deuiſe he made two golden calues, and ſayd to them: Goe vp no more into Ieruſalem: Behold thy goddes Iſrael, which brought thee out of the Land of Ægypt.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he put one in Bethel, and the other in Dan:
label: 3 Kings

text: and this thing was an occaſion of ſinne: for the people went to adore the calfe, as farre as Dan.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he made temples in the excelſes, and prieſtes of the abiectes of the people, which were not of the children of Leui.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he appoynted a ſolemne day in the eight moneth, the fiftenth day of the moneth, after the ſimilitude of the ſolemnitie, that was celebrated in Iuda. And going vp he made in like maner an altar in Bethel, to immolate to the calues, which he had framed: and he ordayned in Bethel prieſtes of the excelſes, which he had made.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he went vpon the altar, which he had built in Bethel, the fiftenth day of the eight moneth, which he had forged out of his owne hart: and he made a ſolemnitie to the children of Iſrael, and went vp vpon the altar, to burne incenſe.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND behold a man of God came out of Iuda, in the word of our Lord into Bethel, Ieroboam ſtanding vpon the altar, and cenſing.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he cried out againſt the altar in the word of our Lord, and ſayd: Altar, altar, thus ſaith our Lord: Behold a child shal be borne to the houſe of Dauid, named Ioſias, and he shal immolate vpon thee prieſtes of the excelſes, which now doe burne frankencenſe on thee, and he shal burne mens bones vpon thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he gaue a ſigne in that day, ſaying: This ſhal be the ſigne, that our Lord hath ſpoken: Behold the altar shal be clouen, and the ashes shal be powred out in it.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when the king had heard the word of the man of God, which he cried out againſt the altar in Bethel, he ſtretched forth his hand from the altar, ſaying: Take him. And his hand withered, which he ſtretched forth agaynſt him: neither was he able to draw it backe vnto him.
label: 3 Kings

text: The altar alſo was clouen, and the ashes were powred out of the altar, according to the ſigne which the man of God had told before in the word of our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king ſaid to the man of God: Beſech the face of our Lord thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be reſtored me. And the man of God beſought the face of our Lord, and the kinges hand was reſtored to him, and it became as it was before.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king ſpake to the man of God: Come home with me, that thou mayſt dyne, and I wil geue the giftes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the man of God anſwered the king: If thou wouldeſt geue me the halfe part of thy houſe, I wil not come with thee, nor eate bread, nor drinke water in this place:
label: 3 Kings

text: for ſo was it enioyned in the word of our Lord cõmanding: Thou ſhalt not eate bread nor drinke water, nor returne by the way that thou cameſt.
label: 3 Kings

text: He departed therfore by an other way, and returned not by the way, that the came into Bethel.
label: 3 Kings

text: And a certaine prophete being old dwelt in Bethel, to whom his ſonnes came and told him al the workes, that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: and the wordes which he had ſpoken to the king, they told their father.
label: 3 Kings

text: And their father ſayd to them: What way went he? His ſonnes shewed him the way, by which the man of God was gone, which came out of Iuda.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſaid to his ſonnes: Sadle me and aſſe. Who when they had ſadled it, he got vp,
label: 3 Kings

text: and went after the man of God, and found him ſitting vnder a terebinth: and he ſaid to him: Art thou the man of God that cameſt out of Iuda? He anſwered: I am he.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſayd to him: Come home with me, that thou mayſt eate bread.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who ſayd: I can not returue, nor come with thee, neither wil I eate bread, nor drinke water in this place:
label: 3 Kings

text: becauſe our Lord ſpake to me in the word of our Lord, ſaying: Thou shalt not eate bread, and thou shalt not drinke water there, nor returne by the way thou wenteſt.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who ſayd to him: I alſo am a prophet like to thee: and an Angel hath ſpoken to me in the word of our Lord, ſaying: Bring him backe wirh thee into thy houſe, that he may eate bread, and drinke water. He deceiued him,
label: 3 Kings

text: and brought him backe with him: he did eate therfore bread in his houſe, and drunke water.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when they ſate at the table, the word, of our Lord came to the prophete, that brought him backe.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he cried out to the man of God, which came out of Iuda, ſaying: Thus ſayth our Lord: Becauſe thou haſt not beene obedient to the mouth of our Lord, and haſt not kept the commandment, which our Lord thy God commanded thee,
label: 3 Kings

text: and haſt returned, and eaten bread, & drunke water in the place wherin he commanded thee that thou shouldeſt not eate bread, nor drinke water, thy dead bodie ſhal not be brought into the ſepulchre of thy fathers.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when he had eaten & drunke, he ſadled his aſſe for the prophet, whom he brought backe.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who when he was gone, a lion found him in the way, and killed him, and his bodie was caſt forth in the way: and the aſſe ſtood by him, and the lion ſtood by the dead bodie.
label: 3 Kings

text: And behold, men paſſing by ſaw the dead bodie caſt in the way, and the lion ſtanding beſide the bodie. And they came and diuulged it in the citie, wherein that old prophet dwelt,
label: 3 Kings

text: Which when that prophet heard, which had brought him backe out of the way, he ſayd: It is the man of God, that was diſobedient to the mouth of our Lord, and our Lord hath deliuered him to the lion, & he hath torne him, and killed him according to the word of our Lord, that he ſpake to him.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſayd to his ſonnes: Sadle me an aſſe. Who when they had ſadled,
label: 3 Kings

text: and he was gone, he found his dead bodie caſt forth in the way, and the aſſe and the lion ſtanding by the corſe: the lion did not eate of the dead bodie, nor hurt the aſſe.
label: 3 Kings

text: The prophet therfore tooke the corſe of the man of God, and layd it vpon the aſſe, and returning brought it into the citie of the old prophete, that they might mourne for him.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he layd his corſe in his owne ſepulchre: and they mourned for him: Alas, alas my brother.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when they had mourned for him, he ſayd to his ſonnes: When I shal be dead, burie me in the ſepulchre, wherein the man of Gcd is buried: beſide his bones lay my bones.
label: 3 Kings

text: For aſſuredly the word shal come to paſſe, which he hath foretold in the word of our Lord agaynſt the altar that is in Bethel: and agaynſt al the temples of the excelſes, that are in the cities of Samaria.
label: 3 Kings

text: After theſe wordes Ieroboam returned not from his wicked way: but on the contrarie part he made of the moſt abiect of the people prieſtes of the excelſes: Whoſoeuer would, he filled his hand, and he was made a prieſt of the excelſes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And for this cauſe did the houſe of Ieroboam ſinne, and was ouerthrowen, and deſtroyed from the face of the earth.
label: 3 Kings

text: AT that time Abia the ſonne of Ieroboam was ſicke.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Ieroboam ſayd to his wife: Ariſe, and change thy habite, that thou be not knowen to be the wife of Ieroboam, and goe into Silo, where Ahias the prophete is, which ſpake to me, that I should reigne ouer this people.
label: 3 Kings

text: Take alſo in thy hand ten loaues, and crackneles, and a veſſel of honie, and goe to him: for he wil shew thee what shal happen to this childe.
label: 3 Kings

text: The wife of Ieroboam did as he had ſpoken: and riſing vp went into Silo, and came into the houſe of Ahias: but he could not ſee, becauſe his eies were dimme for age.
label: 3 Kings

text: And our Lord ſayd to Ahias: Behold the wife of Ieroboam cometh in, to conſult thee concerning her ſonne that is ſicke: thus and thus shalt thou ſpeake to her. When ſhe therfore entered in, and diſſembled to be that she was,
label: 3 Kings

text: Ahias heard the ſound of her feete entring in at the doore, and ſayd: Come in Ieroboams wife: Why doeſt thou fayne thy ſelf to be an other woman? But I am ſent to thee a heauie meſſenger.
label: 3 Kings

text: Goe, and tel Ieroboam: Thus ſayth our Lord the God of Iſrael: Becauſe I haue exalted thee out of the middes of the people, and made thee prince ouer my people Iſrael:
label: 3 Kings

text: and haue rent the kingdom of the houſe of Dauid, and geuen it to thee, and thou haſt not beene as my ſeruant Dauid, who kept my commandementes, and folowed me in al his hart, doing that which was wel liked in my ſight:
label: 3 Kings

text: but haſt wrought euil aboue al, that haue beene before thee, and haſt made thee ſtrange and molten goddes, that thou mighteſt prouoke me to anger, and haſt reiected me behind thy backe:
label: 3 Kings

text: therfore behold I wil bring in euils vpon the houſe of Ieroboam, and wil ſtrike of Ieroboam him that pyſſeth to the wal, and the incloſed, and the vileſt in Iſrael: and I wil cleanſe the remaynes of the houſe of Ieroboam, as dung is wont to be cleanſed til al be pure.
label: 3 Kings

text: They that shal die of Ieroboam in the citie, them the dogges ſhal eate: and they that shal die in the field, them the foules of the ayre shal deuoure: becauſe our Lord hath ſpoken.
label: 3 Kings

text: Thou therfore ariſe, and goe into thy houſe: and in the verie entrance of thy feete into the citie, the childe shal die,
label: 3 Kings

text: and al Iſrael shal mourne for him, and shal burie him: for this onlie of Ieroboam shal be brought into the ſepulchre, becauſe vpon him hath beene found a good word from our Lord the God of Iſrael, in the houſe of Ieroboam.
label: 3 Kings

text: And our Lord wil appoynt to him ſelf a king ouer Iſrael, that shal ſtrike the houſe of Ieroboam in this day, and in this time:
label: 3 Kings

text: and our Lord the God of Iſrael shal ſtrike it, as a reede is wont to be moued in the water: and he shal plucke out Iſrael from this good countrie, which he gaue to their fathers, and shal ſcatter them ouer the Riuer: becauſe they haue made to them ſelues groues, to prouoke our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: And our Lord shal deliuer Iſrael for the ſinnes of Ieroboam, who hath ſinned, & made Iſrael to ſinne.
label: 3 Kings

text: The wife therfore of Ieroboam aroſe, and departed, and came into Therſa: and when she entered the threshold of the houſe, the childe died,
label: 3 Kings

text: and they buried him. And al Iſrael mourned for him according to the word of our Lord, which he ſpake in the hand of his ſeruant Ahias the prophete.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ieroboam, how he fought, and how he reigned, behold they are written in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the daies, that Ieroboam reigned, are two and twentie yeares: and he ſlept with his fathers: and Nadab his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 3 Kings

text: Moreouer Roboam the ſonne of Salomon reigned in Iuda: one and fourtie yeares old was Roboam when he began to reigne: ſeuentene yeares reigned he in Ieruſalem the citie, which our Lord choſe to put his name there, of al the tribes of Iſrael. And his mothers name was Naama an Ammonite.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Iudas did euil before our Lord, and prouoked him aboue al thinges, that their fathers had done, in their ſinnes which they ſinned.
label: 3 Kings

text: For they alſo built them altars, and ſtatues, and groues vpon euerie high hil, and vnder euerie tree ful of grene leaues:
label: 3 Kings

text: yea and effeminates were in the land, and they did al the abominations of the gentiles, which our Lord deſtroyed before the face of the children of Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: And in the fifth yeare of the reigne of Roboam, Seſac the king of Ægypt came vp into Ieruſalem,
label: 3 Kings

text: and tooke the treaſures of the houſe of our Lord, and the kinges treaſures, and al thinges he ſpoyled: the shieldes alſo of gold, which Salomon had made:
label: 3 Kings

text: for the which Roboam made braſen shieldes, & deliuered them into the hand of the captaynes of shield bearers, and of them that kept watch before the doore of the kinges houſe.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when the king went into the houſe of our Lord, they that had the office to goe before, caried them: and afterward they recaried them to the armourie of the shieldbearers.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the reſt of the wordes of Roboam, & al that he did, behold they are written in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iuda.
label: 3 Kings

text: And there was warre betwen Roboam and Ieroboam alwaies.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Roboam ſlept with his fathers, and was buried with them in the citie of Dauid: and his mothers name was Naama an Ammonite: and Abias his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 3 Kings

text: THERFORE in the eightenth yeare of king Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, Abias reigned ouer Iuda.
label: 3 Kings

text: Three yeares reigned he in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Maacha the daughter of Abeſſalom.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he walked in al the ſinnes of his father, which he had done before him: neither was his hart perfect with our Lord his God, as the hart of Dauid his father.
label: 3 Kings

text: But for Dauids ſake our Lord his God gaue him a lampe in Ieruſalem, that he might rayſe vp his ſonne after him, and eſtablish Ieruſalem:
label: 3 Kings

text: becauſe Dauid had done right in the eies of our Lord, and had not declined from al thinges, which he commanded him, al the daies of his life, except the matter of Vrias the Hetheite.
label: 3 Kings

text: But there was warre betwen Roboam and Ieroboam al the time of his life.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the reſt of the wordes of Abias, and al that he did, are they not written in the Booke of the wordes of the kinges of Iuda? And there was warre betwen Abias and Ieroboam.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Abias ſlept with his fathers, and they buried him in the citie of Dauid: and Aſa his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 3 Kings

text: In the twenteth yeare therfore of Ieroboam the king of Iſrael reigned Aſa the king of Iuda.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he reigned one & fourtie yeares in Ieruſalem. His mothers name was Maaca, the daughter of Abeſſalom.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Aſa did right before the ſight of our Lord, as Dauid his father:
label: 3 Kings

text: and he tooke away the effemmate out of the land, and he purged al the filth of the idols, which his fathers had made.
label: 3 Kings

text: Moreouer he remoued alſo Maaca his mother, that she ſhould not be princeſſe in the ſacrifices of Priapus, and in the groue which she had conſecrated: and he deſtroyed her denne, and brake the moſt filthie idol, and burnt it in the torrent cedron:
label: 3 Kings

text: but the excelſes he did not take away. Otherwiſe the hart of Aſa was parfect with our Lord al his daies:
label: 3 Kings

text: and he caried in thoſe thinges, which his father had ſanctified, and vowed into the houſe of our Lord, ſiluer and gold, and veſſels
label: 3 Kings

text: And there was warre betwen Aſa, and Baaſa the king of Iſrael al their daies.
label: 3 Kings

text: Baaſa alſo the king of Iſrael went vp into Iuda, and built Rama, that no man might go out or come in of Aſaes ſide the king of Iuda.
label: 3 Kings

text: Aſa therfore taking al the ſiluer, and gold that remained in the treaſures of the houſe of our Lord, and in the treaſures of the kinges houſe, gaue it into the handes of his ſeruantes: and he ſent to Benadad the ſonne of Tabremon the ſonne of Hezion, the king of Syria, which dwelt in Damaſcus, ſaying:
label: 3 Kings

text: There is a league betwen me and thee, & betwixt my father and thy father: therfore I haue ſent thee giftes, ſiluer and gold: and I deſire thee that thou come, and make void the league, that thou haſt with Baaſa the king of Iſrael, and he may retire from me.
label: 3 Kings

text: Benadad agreing to king Aſa, ſent the princes of his armie into the citiees of Iſrael, and they ſtroke Ahion, and Dan, and Abeldomum of Maacha, and al Cenneroth, to witte, al the Land of Nephthali.
label: 3 Kings

text: Which when Baaſa had heard, he intermitted to build Rama, and returned into Therſa.
label: 3 Kings

text: But king Aſa ſent word into al Iuda, ſaying: Let no man be excuſed. and they tooke ſtones from Rama, and the timber therof, wherwith Baaſa had built, and Aſa of it built GabaaBeniamin, and Maſpha.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the reſt of al the wordes of Aſa, and al his forces, and al that he did, & the cities that he built, are not theſe written in the Booke of the words of the dayes of the kinges of Iuda? How beit in the time of his old age he was diſeaſed in his feete.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſlept with his fathers, & was buried with them in the citie of Dauid his father. And Ioſaphat his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 3 Kings

text: But Nadab the ſonne of Ieroboam reigned ouer Iſrael the ſecond yeare of Aſa the king of Iuda: and he reigned ouer Iſrael two yeares.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he did that which is euil in the ſight of our Lord, and walked in the waies of his father, and in his ſinnes, wherwith he made Iſrael to ſinne.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Baaſa the ſonne of Ahias of the houſe of Iſſachar, lay in wayte againſt him, and ſtroke him in Gebbethon, which is a citie of the Philiſtimes: for Nadab and al Iſrael beſieged Gebbethon.
label: 3 Kings

text: Baaſa therfore ſlew him in the third yeare of Aſa the king of Iuda, and reigned for him.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when he reigned, he ſtroke al the houſe of Ieroboam: he leaft not ſo much as one ſoule of his ſeede, til he deſtroied him according to the word of our Lord, which he had ſpoken in the hand of Ahias the Silonite;
label: 3 Kings

text: for the ſinnes of Ieroboam, which he had ſinned, and wherwith he had cauſed Iſrael to ſinne, and for the offence, wherwith he prouoked our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Nadab, and al that he wrought, are not theſe thinges written in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 3 Kings

text: And there was warre betwen Aſa and Baaſa the king of Iſrael al their daies.
label: 3 Kings

text: In the third yeare of Aſa the king of Iuda, reigned Baaſa the ſonne of Ahias, ouer al Iſrael in Therſa foure and twentie yeares.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he did euil before our Lord, & walked in the waies of Ieroboam, and in his ſinnes, wherwith he made Iſrael to ſinne.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND the word of our Lord came to Iehu the ſonne of Hanani agaynſt Baaſa, ſaying:
label: 3 Kings

text: For ſo much as I haue exalted thee out of the duſt, & ſette thee duke ouer my people Iſrael, but thou haſt walked in the way of Ieroboam, and haſt made my people Iſrael to ſinne, that thou mighteſt anger me with their ſinnes:
label: 3 Kings

text: behold, I wil cut downe the poſteritie of Baaſa, and the poſteritie of his houſe, and I wil make thy houſe as the houſe of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat.
label: 3 Kings

text: Whoſoeuer of Baaſa shal die in the citie, him shal the dogges eate: and whoſoeuer of his shal die in the countrie, him shal the fowles of the ayre deuoure.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Baaſa, and whatſoeuer he did, and his battels, are not theſe things written in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 3 Kings

text: Baaſa therfore ſlept with his fathers, and was buried in Therſa: and Ela his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when the word of our Lord came in the hand of Iehu the ſonne of Hanani the prophete agaynſt Baaſa, and agaynſt his houſe, and agaynſt al the euil, that he had done before our Lord, to anger him in the workes of his handes, that it should be made as the houſe of Ieroboam: for this cauſe he ſlew him, that is to ſay, Iehu the ſonne of Hanani, the prophete.
label: 3 Kings

text: In the ſixe and twenteth yeare of Aſa the king of Iuda, reigned Ela the ſonne of Baaſa ouer Iſrael in Therſa two yeares.
label: 3 Kings

text: And his ſeruant Zambri rebelled agaynſt him, the captayne of the halfe part of the horſemen: and Ela was in Therſa drinking, and dronken in the houſe of Arſa the gouernour of Therſa.
label: 3 Kings

text: Zambri therfore rushing in, ſtroke and ſlew him in the ſeuen and twenteth yeare of Aſa the king of Iuda, & he reigned for him.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when he teigned, and ſate vpon his throne, he ſtroke al the houſe of Baaſa, and he leaft not of it one that could pyſſe agaynſt a wal, & his kinsfolke and frendes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Zambri deſtroyed al the houſe of Baaſa, according to the word of our Lord, that he had ſpoken to Baaſa in the hand of Iehu the prophet,
label: 3 Kings
