text: for al the ſinnes of Baaſa, and the ſinnes of Ela his ſonne, who ſinned, and made Iſrael to ſinne, prouoking our Lord the God of Iſrael in their vanities.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ela, and al that he did, are not theſe writen in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 3 Kings

text: In the ſeuen and twenteth yeare of Aſa the king of Iuda, reigned Zambri ſeuen daies in Therſa: moreouer the armie beſieged Gebbethon a citie of the Philiſthines.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when they heard that Zambri had rebelled, and ſlayne the king, al Iſrael made Amri their king, who was General of the warfare ouer Iſrael that day, in the campe.
label: 3 Kings

text: Amri therfore went vp, and al Iſrael with him from Gebbethon, and they beſieged Therſa.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Zambri ſeing that the citie should be taken, he went into the palace, and burnt him ſelf with the kinges houſe: and he died
label: 3 Kings

text: in his ſinnes, which he had ſinned doing euil before our Lord, and walking in the way of Ieroboam, and in his ſinne; wherwith he made Iſrael to ſinne.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Zambri, and of his treaſon, and tyrannie, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke of the wordes of the dayes of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 3 Kings

text: Then was the people of Iſrael diuided into two partes: the halfe part of the people folowed Thebni the ſonne of Gineth, to make him king: and the halfe part Amri.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the people that was with Amri, preuayled ouer the people that folowed Thebni the ſonne of Gineth: and Thebni died, and Amri reigned.
label: 3 Kings

text: In the one and thirteth yeare of Aſa the king of Iuda Amri reigned ouer Iſrael, twelue yeares: in Therſa he reigned ſix yeares.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he bought the mount of Samaria of Somer for two talentes of ſiluer: and he built it, and he called the citie which he had built, by the name of Semer the lord of the mount of Samaria.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Amri did euil in the ſight of our Lord, and wrought wickedly aboue al, that were before him.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he walked in al the way of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, and in his ſinnes wherwith he made Iſrael to ſinne: that they might anger our Lord the God of Iſrael in theit vanities.
label: 3 Kings

text: Bur the reſt of the wordes of Amri, and the battels he made, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke, of the battels that he made are not theſe thinges written in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 3 Kings

text: And Amri ſlept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria and Achab his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 3 Kings

text: But Achab the ſonne of Amri reigned ouer Iſrael the eight and thirteth yeare of Aſa the king of Iuda. And Achab the ſonne of Amri reigned ouer Iſrael in Samiaria two and twentie yeares.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Achab the ſonne of Amri did euil in the ſight of our Lord aboue al, that were before him.
label: 3 Kings

text: Neither did it ſuffice him that he walked in the ſinnes of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat: beſides he tooke to wife Iezabel the daughter of Ethbaul the king of the Sidonians. And he went, and ſerued Baal, and adored him.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſette an altar to Baal in the temple of Baal, which he had built in Samaria,
label: 3 Kings

text: and he planted a groue: and Achab added in his worke, prouoking our Lord the God of Iſrael aboue al the kinges of Iſrael, that were before him.
label: 3 Kings

text: In his daies Hiel of Bethel built Iericho: in Abiram his firſt borne he founded it, and in Segub his laſt he ſette vp the gates therof: according to the word of our Lord, which he ſpake in the hand of Ioſue the ſonne of Nun.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND Elias the Theſbite of the inhabiters of Galaad ſaid to Achab: Our Lord liueth the God of Iſrael, in whoſe ſight I ſtand, if there shal be theſe yearer dew and rayne, but according to the wordes of my mouth.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the word of our Lord came to him, ſaying:
label: 3 Kings

text: Depart from hence, and goe agaynſt the Eaſt, and be hidde in the Torrent carith, which is agaynſt Iordan,
label: 3 Kings

text: and there thou shalt drinke of the torrent: and I haue commanded the rauens that they feede thee there
label: 3 Kings

text: He therfore went, and did according to the word of our Lord: and when he was gone, he ſate in the Torrent carith, which is againſt Iordan.
label: 3 Kings

text: The rauens alſo brought him bread and flesh in the morning, in like maner bread and flesh in the euening, and he dranke of the torrent.
label: 3 Kings

text: But after certayne daies the torrent was dried: for it bad not rayned vpon the earth.
label: 3 Kings

text: Therfore the word of our Lord came to him, ſaying:
label: 3 Kings

text: Ariſe, and goe into Sareptha of the Sidonians, and thou shalt tarie there: for I haue commanded a wydow woman there to feede thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: He aroſe, and went into Sareptha. And when he was come to the gate of the citie, the wydow woman appeared to him gathering ſtickes, and he called her, and ſayd to her: Geue me a litle water in a veſſel, that I may drinke.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when she went to fetch it, he cried after her ſaying: Bring me alſo, I beſeche thee, a morſel of bread in thy hand.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who anſwered: Our Lord thy God liueth, I haue no bread, but ſo much meale in a potte as a hand can hold, and a litle oile in a veſſel: behold I gather two ſtickes, that I may goe in, and dreſſe it for me and my ſonne, that we may eate, and die.
label: 3 Kings

text: To whom Elias ſayd: feare not, but goe, and doe as thou haſt ſayd: but firſt make for me of the ſame meale a litle harth cake, and bring it to me: and for thy ſelf and thy ſonne thou shalt make afterward.
label: 3 Kings

text: For thus ſayth our Lord the God of Iſrael: The potte of meale shal not fayle, nor the veſſel of oile be diminished vntil the day, wherin our Lord wil geue rayne vpon the face of the earth.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who went and did according to the word of Elias: and he did eate, and she, and her houſe: and from that day
label: 3 Kings

text: the pot of meale fayled not, and the veſſel of oyle was not diminished, according to the word of our Lord, which he ſpake in the hand of Elias.
label: 3 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe after theſe thinges, the ſonne of the woman, the goodwife of the houſe, fel ſicke, and the ſickeneſſe was verie vehement ſo that there remayned no breath in him.
label: 3 Kings

text: She therfore ſayd to Elias: What is to me and thee thou man of God? comeſt thou vnto me, that myne iniquities might be remembred, and thou mighteſt kil my ſonne?
label: 3 Kings

text: And Elias ſayd to her: Geue me thy ſonne. And he tooke him from her boſome, and caried him into the vpper chamber where him ſelf abode, and layd him vpon his bed.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he cried to our Lord, and ſayd: O Lord my God, what, the widow alſo with whom I am after a ſort ſuſteyned, haſt thou afflicted, that thou wouldeſt kil her ſonne?
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſtretched forth, & meaſured him ſelfe vpon the childe three tymes, & he cried to our Lord, and ſayd: O Lord my God, let the ſoule of this childe, I beſeche thee, returne into his bodie.
label: 3 Kings

text: And our Lord heard the voice of Elias: and the ſoule of the child returned into him, and he reuiued.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Elias tooke the childe, and brought him downe from the vpper chamber into the lower houſe, and deliuered him to his mother, and ſayd to her: Behold thy ſonne liueth.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the woman ſayd to Elias: Now, in this I haue knowen that thou art a man of God, and the word of our Lord in the mouth iſ true.
label: 3 Kings

text: AFTER manie daies the word of our Lord came to Elias, the third yeare, ſaying: Goe, and shew thy ſelf to Achab, that I may geue rayne vpon the face of the earth.
label: 3 Kings

text: Elias therfore went to shew himſelf to Achab: and there was ſore famine in Samaria.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Achab called Abdias the gouernour of his houſe: and Abdias did feare our Lord very much.
label: 3 Kings

text: For when Iezabel killed the prophetes of our Lord, he tooke an hundred prophetes, and hid them by fiftie and fiftie in caues, and fed them with bread and water.
label: 3 Kings

text: Achab therfore ſayd to Abdias: Goe into the land to al the fountaynes of waters, and into al valleys, if perhaps we may finde graſſe, and ſaue the horſes and mules, and the beaſtes may not vtterly perish.
label: 3 Kings

text: And they diuided the countries betwen them, that they might goe circuite about them: Achab went one way, and Abdias an other way ſeuerally.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when Abdias was in the way, Elias mette him: who when he knew him, fel on his face, and ſayd: My lord, art not thou Elias?
label: 3 Kings

text: To whom he anſwered: I am. Goe, and tel thy lord: Elias is here.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſayd: What haue I ſinned, that thou deliuereſt me thy ſeruant into the hand of Achab, that he may kil me?
label: 3 Kings

text: Our Lord thy God liueth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not ſent to ſeeke thee: and al anſwering: He is not here: he adiured al kingdomes and nations, for that thou waſt not found.
label: 3 Kings

text: And now thou ſayeſt to me: Goe, and tel thy lord: Elias is here.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when I am departed from thee, the Spirit of our Lord wil carie thee into a place, that I know not: and I entering in shal tel Achab, and not finding thee, he wil kil me: and thy ſeruant feareth our Lord from his infancie.
label: 3 Kings

text: Hath it not beene told thee my lord, what I did when Iezabel killed the prophetes of our Lord, that I hid of the prophetes of our Lord an hundred men, by fiftie and fiftie in caues, and fed them with bread and water?
label: 3 Kings

text: And now thou ſayſt: Goe, and tel thy lord: Elias is here: that he may kil me?
label: 3 Kings

text: And Elias ſayd: The Lord of hoſtes liueth, before whoſe face I ſtand, this day wil I appeare to him.
label: 3 Kings

text: Abdias therfore went to meete Achab, and told him: and Achab came to meete Elias.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when he had ſeene him, he ſayd: Art thou he that doeſt truble Iſrael?
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſayd: not I haue trubled Iſrael, but thou, and the houſe of thy father, who haue forſaken the commandmentes of our Lord, and haue folowed Baalim.
label: 3 Kings

text: Neuertheleſſe ſend now, and gather vnto me al Iſrael in the mount of Carmel, and the prophetes of Baal foure hundred fiftie, and the prophetes of the groues foure hundred, which eate of Iezabels table.
label: 3 Kings

text: Achab ſent to al the children of Iſrael, and gathered together the prophetes in the mount of Carmel.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Elias coming to al the people, ſayd: How long halt you on two ſides? If our Lord be God, folow him: but if Baal, folow him. And the people did not anſwer him a word.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Elias ſayd agayne to the people: I onlie remayne a prophete of our Lord: and the prophetes of Baal are foure hundred and fiftie men.
label: 3 Kings

text: Let two oxen be geuen vs, and let them chooſe to them ſelues one oxe, and cutting it into peeces let them lay it vpon wood, but put no fyre vnder: and I wil dreſſe the other oxe, and wil lay it vpon wood, and put no fire vnder.
label: 3 Kings

text: Inuocate ye the names of your goddes, & I wil inuocate the name of my Lord: and the God that shal heare by fyre, let the ſame be God. And al the people anſwering ſayd: A very good propoſition.
label: 3 Kings

text: Elias therfore ſayd to the prophetes of Baal: Chooſe you one oxe, and make it firſt, becauſe you are manie: & inuocate the names of your goddes, and put no fire vnder.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who when they had taken the oxe, which he gaue them, they dreſſed it: and they inuocated the name of Baal from morning vntil midday, ſaying: Baal heare vs. And there was no voice, nor any that anſwered: and they leaped ouer the altar, that they had made.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when it was now midday, Elias ieſted at them, ſaying: Crie with a lowder voice: for he is God, and perhaps he ſpeaketh, or is in his inne, or in the way or at the leaſt he ſlepeth, that he muſt be waked.
label: 3 Kings

text: They cried therfore with a lowd voice, and cut them ſelues after their rite with kniues and lancers, til they were al embrewed with bloud
label: 3 Kings

text: And after the midday was paſt, and whiles they prophecied, the time was come, when they vſed to offer ſacrifice, neither voice was heard, nor any did anſwer, nor attend them praying:
label: 3 Kings

text: Elias ſayd to al the people: Come vnto me. And the people coming to him, he repayred the altar of our Lord, that was deſtroyed.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he tooke twelue ſtones according to the number of the tribes of the children of Iacob, to whom the word of our Lord came, ſaying: Iſrael shal be thy name.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he built of the ſtones an altar in the name of our Lord: and he made a water gutter, as it were by two furrowes round about the altar,
label: 3 Kings

text: and he layed the wood in order, and diuided the oxe in iointes, and layd it vpon the wood,
label: 3 Kings

text: and ſaid: Fil foure buckettes with water, and powre vpon the holocauſte, and vpon the wood. And againe he ſayd: Doe it alſo the ſecond time. Who hauing donne it the ſecond time, he ſaid: The third time alſo doe the ſame. And they did ſo the third time,
label: 3 Kings

text: and the warers ranne about the altar, and the trough of the conduite was filled.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when it was now time that the holocauſte should be offered, Elias the prophete coming ſaid: Lord God of Abraham, and Iſaac, & Iſrael, shew this day that thou art the God of Iſrael, and I thy ſeruant, & that according to thy commandment I haue done al theſe thinges.
label: 3 Kings

text: Heare me Lord, heare me: that this people may learne, that thou art our Lord God, & thou haſt conuerted their hart againe.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the fire of our Lord fel, & deuoured the holocauſte, & the wood, and the ſtones, licking alſo the duſt, and the water, that was in the water gutter.
label: 3 Kings

text: Which when al the people had ſeene, they fel on their face, and ſaid: Our Lord he is God, our Lord he is God.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Elias ſaid to them: Apprehend the prophetes of Baal, and let not one eſcape of them. Whom when they had taken, Elias brought them to the Torrent ciſon, and killed them there.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Elias ſayd to Achab: Goe vp, eate, and drinke: becauſe there is ſound of much raine.
label: 3 Kings

text: Achab went vp to eate and drinke: and Elias went vp into the toppe of Carmel, and flatte on the earth put his face betwen his knees,
label: 3 Kings

text: and he ſaid to his ſeruant: Goe vp, and looke toward the ſea. Who when he was gone vp, and had looked, he ſaid: There is nothing. And againe he ſaid to him: Returne ſeuen tymes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And in the ſeuenth time: Behold a litle cloud as it were a mans foote, came vp from the ſea. Who ſaid: Goe vp and ſay to Achab: Yoke thy chariote and goe downe, leſt the raine preuent thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when he turned him ſelfe hither and thither, behold the heauens were darkened, and cloudes, and winde, and there fel great raine. Achab therfore going vp went into Iezrahel:
label: 3 Kings

text: and the hand of our Lord was made vpon Elias, and his loynes girded he ranne before Achab, vntil he came into Iezrahel.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND Achab told Iezabel al thinges that Elias had done, and how he had killed al the prophetes with the ſword.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Iezabel ſent a meſſenger to Elias, ſaying: Theſe thinges do the goddes to me, and theſe adde they, if this houre to morow I make not thy ſoule as the ſoule of one of them.
label: 3 Kings

text: Elias therfore was afraid, & ryſing he went whither ſoeuer his wil caried him: and he came into Berſabee of Iuda, and leaft his ſeruant there,
label: 3 Kings

text: and went forward into the deſert, one dayes iourney. And when he was come, and ſate vnder a iuniper tree, he deſired for his ſoule to die, and ſayd: It ſufficeth me Lord, take my ſoul: for I am not better then my fathers.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he caſt him ſelf downe, and ſlept in the shadow of the iuniper tree: and behold an Angel of our Lord touched him, and ſayd to him: Ariſe, and eate.
label: 3 Kings

text: He looked, and behold at his head harthbaked bread, and a veſſel of water: he therfore did eate, and drinke, and he ſlept againe.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the Angel of our Lord returned the ſecond time, and touched him, and ſaid to him: Ariſe, eate: for thou haſt yet a great way to goe.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who when he was riſen: did eate and drinke, & walked in the ſtrength of that meate fourtie daies, and fourtie nightes, vnto the mount of God, Horeb.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when he was come thither, he taried in a caue: and behold the word of our Lord vnto him, & he ſaid to him: What doeſt thou here Elias?
label: 3 Kings

text: But he anſwered: With zele haue I beene zelous for our Lord the God of hoſtes. becauſe the children of Iſrael haue forſaken thy couenant: thy altars haue they deſtroyed, & thy prophetes they haue ſlaine with the ſword, & I alone am leaft, & they ſeeke my life to take it away.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſaid to him: Come forth, and ſtand in the mount before our Lord: and behold our Lord paſſeth, and a great winde, and ſtrong ouerthrowing mountaynes, and breaking rockes before our Lord: not in the winde is our Lord, and after the winde an earth quake: not in the earth quake is our Lord,
label: 3 Kings

text: and afrer the earth quake fire: not in the fire is our Lord, and after the fire a wiſtling of a gentle winde.
label: 3 Kings

text: Which when Elias had heard, he couered his face with his mantel, and coming forth ſtood in the doore of the caue, and behold a voyce vnto him, ſaying: What doeſt thou here Elias?
label: 3 Kings

text: And he anſwered: With zele haue I beene zelous for our Lord the God of hoſtes: becauſe the children of Iſrael haue forſaken thy couenant: thyn altars they haue deſtroyed, and thy prophetes they haue ſlaine with the ſword, and I alone am leaft, and they ſeeke my life to take it away.
label: 3 Kings

text: And our Lord ſayd to him: Goe, and returne into thy way by the deſert of Damiaſcus: and when thou art come thither thou shalt anoint Hazael king ouer Syria,
label: 3 Kings

text: and Iehu the ſonne of Namſi thou ſhalt anoynt king ouer Iſrael: and Eliſeus the ſonne of Saphat, which is of Abelmeula, thou shalt anoynt prophet for thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: And it shal be, whoſoeuer shal eſcape the ſword of Hazael, him Iehu shal kil: and whoſouer shal eſcape the ſword of Iehu, him shal Eliſeus kil.
label: 3 Kings

text: And I wil leaue me in Iſrael ſeuen thouſand men, whoſe knees haue not beene bowed before Baal, and euerie mouth, that hath not adored him kyſſing his handes.
label: 3 Kings

text: Elias therfore departing thence, found Eliſeus the ſonne of Saphat, ploughing with twelue yoke of oxen, and he was one of them that ploughed with twelue yoke of oxen: and when Elias came to him, he caſt his mantel vpon him.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who forth with leauing the oxen ranne after Elias, and ſaid: Let me kiſſe, I pray thee, my father, and my mother, and ſo I wil folow thee. And he ſayd to him: Goe, and returne: for that which was my part, I haue donne to thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: And returning from him. he tooke a yoke of oxen, and killed them, and ſod the flesh with the plough of the oxen, and gaue to the people, and they did eate: and ryſing vp he departed, and folowed Elias, & miniſtred to him.
label: 3 Kings

text: MOREOVER Benadad the king of Syria, gathered together al his hoſt, & two & thirtie kinges with him, & horſes, and chariotes: and going vp fought agaynſt Samaria, and beſieged it.
label: 3 Kings

text: And ſending meſſengers to Achab the king of Iſraal into the citie,
label: 3 Kings

text: he ſaid: Thus ſaith Benadad: Thy ſiluer, and thy gold is mine: and thy wiues, and thy principal children be mine.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king of Iſrael anſwered: According to thy word my lord king, I am thine, and al that is mine.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the meſſengers returning, ſaid: Thus ſaith Benadad, which ſent vs vnto thee: Thy ſiluer, and thy gold, and thy wiues, and thy children thou shalt geue me.
label: 3 Kings

text: To morow therfore this verie houre I wil ſend my ſeruantes to thee, and they shal ſearch thy houſe, and the houſe of thy ſeruantes: and al that pleaſeth them, they shal put in their handes, and take away.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king of Iſrael called al the ancientes of the land, and ſaid: Marke, and ſee that he ſeeketh to intrappe vs. for he ſent to me for my wiues, and children, and for the ſiluer and gold: and I ſaid not nay.
label: 3 Kings

text: And al the ancientes, and al the people ſaid to him: Heare not, neither agree vnto him.
label: 3 Kings

text: He therfore anſwered the meſſengers of Benadad: Tel my Lord the king: Al thinges for the which thou didſt ſend to me thy ſeruant in the beginning I wil doe: but this thing I can not doe.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the meſſengers returning made report vnto him, who ſent againe, and ſayd: Theſe thinges doe the goddes to me, and theſe adde they, if the duſt of Samaria shal ſuffice for the hanfulles of al the people, that foloweth me.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king of Iſrael anſwering, ſayd: Tel him Let not the girded glorie as the vngirded.
label: 3 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe, when Benaded had heard this word, himſelf and the kinges dranke in pauilions, and he ſayd to his ſeruantes: Beſette the citie, and they did beſette it.
label: 3 Kings

text: And behold a prophete coming to Achab the king of Iſrael, ſaid to him: Thus ſayth our Lord; Haſt thou in dede ſene al this exceding great multitude? behold, I wil deliuer them into thy hand this day: that thou mayſt know, that I am the Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Achab ſaid: By whom? And he ſaid to him: Thus ſaith our Lord: By the ſeruantes of the princes of the prouinces. And he ſaid: Who shal begin to fight? And he ſaid: Thou.
label: 3 Kings

text: He therfore muſtered the ſeruantes of the princes of the prouinces, and he found the number of two hundred thirtie two: and he muſtered after them the people, al the children of Iſrael, ſeuen thouſand.
label: 3 Kings

text: And they went forth at noone. But Benadad dranke al dronken in his tent, and two and thirtie kinges with him, which were come to ayde him.
label: 3 Kings

text: The ſeruantes therfore of the princes of the prouinces iſſued forth in the forefront. Benadad therfore ſent. Who told him, ſaying: Men are come forth out of Samaria.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſaid: Whether they come for peace, take them aliue: or els to fight, aliue take ye them.
label: 3 Kings

text: The ſeruantes therfore of the princes of the prouinces iſſued forth, and the reſt of the armie folowed:
label: 3 Kings

text: and euerie one ſtroke the man, that came againſt him: and the Syrians fled, and Iſrael purſued them. Benadad alſo the king of Syria fled on horſebacke with his horſemen.
label: 3 Kings

text: Moreouer the king of Iſrael iſſuing forth ſtroke the horſes and chariotes, and he ſtroke Syria with a great ſlaughter.
label: 3 Kings

text: And a prophet coming to the king of Iſrael, ſaid to him: Goe, and take courage, and know, and ſee what thou doeſt: for the yeare folowing the king of Syria wil come vp againſt thee. )
label: 3 Kings

text: But the ſeruantes of the king of Syria ſaid to him: The goddes of the mountaynes be their goddes, therfore haue they ouercome vs: but it is better that we fight againſt them in the champaine, & we shal ouercome them.
label: 3 Kings

text: Thou therfore do this word: Remoue al the kinges from thine armie, and put captaines for them:
label: 3 Kings

text: and repaire the number of ſouldiars, that are ſlaine of thine, and horſes according to the old horſes, & chariotes according to the chariotes, which thou hadſt before: and we wil fight againſt them in the champaine, and thou shalt ſee that we shal ouercome them. He beleued their counſel, and did ſo.
label: 3 Kings

text: Therfore after a yeare was paſſed, Benadad muſtered the Syrians, and went vp into Aphec, to fight againſt Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: Moreouer the children of Iſrael were muſtered, and taking victuals they went forth, on the contrarie ſide, and camped againſt them, as it were two litle flockes of goates: but the Syrians filled the land.
label: 3 Kings

text: ( And a man of God coming, ſaid to the king of Iſrael: Thus ſaith our Lord: Becauſe the Syrians haue ſaid: The Lord is God of the mountaines, and is not God of the Valleis: I wil geue al this great multitude into thy hand, and you ſhal know that I am the Lord. )
label: 3 Kings

text: And ſeuen dayes did theſe, and they direct their armies one againſt the other, and in the ſeuenth day was the battel fought: and the children of Iſrael ſtroke of the Syrians an hundred thouſand footemen in one day.
label: 3 Kings

text: And they that remained in Aphec, fled into the citie: and the wal fel vpon ſeuen and twentie thouſand men, that were leaft. Moreouer Benadad fleing entered the citie, into a chamber that was within a chamber,
label: 3 Kings

text: and his ſeruantes ſaid to him: Behold, we haue heard that the kinges of the houſe of Iſrael are merciful: Let vs therfore put ſackeclothes on our loynes, and cordes on our heades, and goe forth to the king of Iſrael: perhaps he wil ſaue our liues.
label: 3 Kings

text: They girded their loines with ſackclothes, and put cordes on their heades, and came to the king of Iſrael, and ſaid to him: Thy ſeruant ſaith: Let my ſoule liue, I beſech thee. And he ſaid: If he be yet aliue he is my brother.
label: 3 Kings

text: Which the men tooke for good lucke: and in haſt caught the word of his mouth, and ſaid: Thy brother Benadad. And he ſaid to them: Goe and bring him to me. Benadad therfore came out to him, and he lifted him vp into his chariote.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who ſaid to him: The cities which my father tooke from thy father, I wil render: doe thou make thee ſtretes in Damaſcus, as my father made in Samaria, and I confederate wil depart from thee. He therfore made a league, and dimiſſed him.
label: 3 Kings

text: Then a certaine man of the children of the prophetes ſayd to his felow in the word of our Lord: Strike me. But he would not ſtrike.
label: 3 Kings

text: To whom he ſaid: Becauſe thou wouldeſt not heare the word of our Lord, behold thou shalt depart from me, and a lion shal ſtrike thee. And when he was departed a litle from him, a lyon found him, and ſlew him.
label: 3 Kings

text: But finding alſo an other man, he ſaid to him: Strike me. Who ſtroke him, and wounded him.
label: 3 Kings

text: The prophete therfore went, and mette the king in the way, and with ſprinkling of duſt changed his face and his eies.
label: 3 Kings

text: And when the king paſſed by, he cried to the king, and ſaid: Thy ſeruant went forth to fight hand ſtrokes: and when a certaine man was fled, one brought him to me, and ſaid: Keepe this man: who if he shal ſlippe away, thy life shal be for his life, or thou shalt pay a talent of ſiluer.
label: 3 Kings

text: And whiles I being trubled turned hither and thither, ſodenly he appeared not. And the king of Iſrael ſayd to him: This is thy iudgement, which thy ſelf haſt decreed.
label: 3 Kings

text: But he forthwith wyped of the duſt from his face, and the king of Iſrael knew him, that he was of the prophetes.
label: 3 Kings

text: Who ſayd to him: Thus ſayth our Lord: Becauſe thou haſt let goe out of thy hand a man worthie to die, thy life shal be for his life, and thy people for his people.
label: 3 Kings

text: The king of Iſrael therfore returned into his houſe, contemning to heare, & raging came into Samaria.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND after theſe wordes, at that tyme Naboth the Iezrahelite had a vineyard, which was in Iezrahel, beſide the palace of Achab the king of Samaria.
label: 3 Kings

text: Achab therfore ſpake to Naboth, ſaying: Geue me thy vineyard, that I may make me a garden of herbes, becauſe it is nigh, and ioyning to my houſe, and I wil geue thee for it a better vineyard: or if thou thinke it more commodious for thee, the price of ſiluer, ſo much as it is worth.
label: 3 Kings

text: To whom Naboth anſwered: Our Lord be merciful to me, that I geue not the inheritance of my fathers to thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: Achab therfore came into his houſe with indignation, and fretting vpon the word, that Naboth the Iezrahelite had ſpoken to him, ſaying: I wil not geue thee the inheritance of my fathers. And caſting him ſelf vpon his bed, he turned away his face to the wal, and did not eate bread.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Iezabel his wife went in vnto him, and ſayd to him: What is this matter, whereupon thy ſoule is greued? and why eateſt thou not bread?
label: 3 Kings

text: Who anſwered her: I ſpake to Naboth the Iezrahelite, and ſayd to him: Geue me thy vineyard, taking money for it: or if it pleaſe thee, I wil geue thee a better vineyard for it. And he ſayd: I wil not geue thee my vineyard.
label: 3 Kings

text: Iezabel therfore his wife ſayd to him: Thou art of great authoritie, and doeſt wel gouerne the kingdome of Iſrael: Ariſe, and eate bread, and be of good cheere, I wil geue thee the vineyard of Naboth the Iezrahelite.
label: 3 Kings

text: She therfore wrote letters in the name of Achab, and ſigned them with his ring, and ſent to the ancientes, and the chiefe men that were in his citie, and dwelt with Naboth.
label: 3 Kings

text: And this was the tenor of the letters: Proclame a faſt, and make Naboth ſitte among the chiefe of the people,
label: 3 Kings

text: and ſuborne two men the children of Belial agaynſt him, and let them beare falſe teſtimony: that he hath bleſſed God and the king: and bring him forth, and ſtone him, and ſo let him die.
label: 3 Kings

text: His citizens therfore the ancientes and chiefe men, that dwelt with him in the citie, did as Iezabel had commanded them, and as it was written in the letters which she ſent to them:
label: 3 Kings

text: they proclamed a faſt, and made Naboth ſitte among the chiefe of the people.
label: 3 Kings

text: And two men the children of the diuel being brought forth, they made them ſitte agaynſt him: but they, as deuelish men, gaue teſtimonie agaynſt him before the multitude: Naboth hath bleſſed God and the king: for the which thing they brought him forth without the citie, and killed him with ſtones.
label: 3 Kings

text: And they ſent to Iezabel, ſaying: Naboth is ſtoned, and is dead.
label: 3 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe, when Iezabel had heard that Naboth was ſtoned, and dead, she ſpake to Achab: Ariſe, and poſſeſſe the vineyard of Naboth the Iezrahelite, who would not agree vnto thee, and geue it taking money: for Naboth liueth not, but is dead.
label: 3 Kings

text: Which when Achab had heard, to witte, that Naboth was dead, he aroſe, & went downe into the vineyard of Naboth the Iezrahelite, to poſſeſſe it.
label: 3 Kings

text: The word of our Lord therfore came to Elias the Theſbite, ſaying:
label: 3 Kings

text: Ariſe, and goe downe to meete Achab the king of Iſrael, who is in Samaria: behold he goeth downe to the vineyard of Naboth, to poſſeſſe it:
label: 3 Kings

text: and thou shalt ſpeake to him, ſaying: Thus ſayth our Lord: Thou haſt ſlayne, moreouer alſo thou haſt poſſeſt. And after theſe wordes thou shalt adde: Thus ſayth our Lord: In this place, wherein the dogges haue licked the bloud of Naboth, they shal licke thy bloud alſo.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Achab ſayd to Elias: Haſt thou found me thyne enemie? Who ſayd: I haue found thee, for that thou art ſold, to doe euil in the ſight of our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: Behold I wil bring euil vpon thee, and wil cut downe thy poſteritie, and wil kil of Achab him that piſſeth agaynſt the wal, and the incloſed, and the laſt in Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: And I wil make thy houſe, as the houſe of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, and as the houſe of Baaſa the ſonne of Ahias: becauſe thou haſt done, to prouoke me to anger, and haſt made Iſrael to ſinne.
label: 3 Kings

text: But of Iezabel alſo our Lord ſpake, ſaying: The dogges shal eate Iezabel in the field of Iezrahel.
label: 3 Kings

text: If Achab die in the citie, the dogges shal eate him: but if he die in the field, the foules of the ayre shal eate him.
label: 3 Kings

text: Therfore there was not ſuch an other as Achab, who was ſold to doe euil in the ſight of our Lord: for his wife Iezabel ſette him on,
label: 3 Kings

text: and he became abominable, in ſo much that he folowed the idols, which the Amorrheites had made, whom our Lord conſumed before the face of the children of Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: Therfore when Achab had heard theſe wordes, he rent his garmentes, and couered his flesh with haercloth, and faſted and ſlept in ſackcloth, and walked caſting downe his head.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the word of our Lord came to Elias the Theſbite, ſaying:
label: 3 Kings

text: Haſt thou not ſeene Achab humbled before me? therfore, becauſe he hath humbled him ſelf for my ſake, I wil not bring in the euil in his dayes, but in his ſonnes daies wil I bring the euil vpon his houſe.
label: 3 Kings

text: THERE paſſed therfore three yeares without warre betwen Syria aud Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: And in the third yeare, Ioſaphat the king of Iuda went downe to the king of Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: (And the king of Iſrael ſayd to his ſeruantes: are you ignorant that Ramoth-Galaad is ours, and we neglect to take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?)
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſayd to Ioſaphat: Wilt thou come with me to fight into Ramoth Galaad?
label: 3 Kings

text: And Ioſaphat ſayd to the king of Iſrael: As I am, ſo thou alſo: my people and thy people are one: and my horſemen thy horſmen. And Ioſaphat ſayd to the king of Iſraal: Aske, I beſech thee, this day the word of our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: The king of Iſrael therfore aſſembled the prophetes, about foure hundred men, and he ſayd to them: Shal I goe into Ramoth Galaad to fight, or ſitte ſtil? Who anſwered: Goe vp, and our Lord wil geue it into the kinges hand.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Ioſaphat ſayd: Is there not here ſome prophete of our Lord, that we may aske by him?
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king of Iſrael ſayd to Ioſaphat: There is one man leaft, by whom we may aske our Lord: but I hate him, becauſe he doeth not prophecie vnto me good, but euil, Micheas the ſonne of Iemla. To whom Ioſaphat ſayd: Speake not ſo ô king.
label: 3 Kings

text: The king of Iſrael therfore called a certaine eunuch, and ſayd to him: Make haſt, and bring hither Micheas the ſonne of Iemla.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king of Iſrael, and Ioſaphat the king of Iuda ſate eche in his throne clothed with royal attyre, in a court beſide the doore of the gate of Samaria, and al the prophetes prophecied before them.
label: 3 Kings

text: Sedecias the ſonne of Chanaana made him ſelf hornes of yron, and ſayd: Thus ſayth our Lord: With theſe shalt thou ſtrike Syria, til thou deſtroy it.
label: 3 Kings

text: And al the prophetes in like maner prophecied, ſaying: Aſcend into Ramoth Galaad, and goe proſperouſely, & our Lord wil deliuer it into the Kinges handes.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the meſſenger, that went to cal Micheas, ſpake to him, ſaying: Behold the wordes of the prophetes with one mouth preach good thinges to the king: let thy word therfore be like to theirs, and ſpeake good thinges.
label: 3 Kings

text: To whom Micheas ſayd: Our Lord liueth, whatſoeuer our Lord shal tel me, that wil I ſpeake.
label: 3 Kings

text: He therfore came to the king, and the king ſayd to him: Micheas, shal we goe into Ramoth Galaad to fight, or ſitte ſtil? To whom he anſwered: Aſcend, and goe proſperouſely, and our Lord wil deliuer it into the kinges handes.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the king ſayd to him: I adiure thee agayne and agayne, that thou ſpeake not to me but that which is true in the name of our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſayd: I ſaw al Iſrael diſperſed in the mountaynes, as sheepe not hauing a ſhepeheard, and our Lord ſayd: Theſe haue no maiſter: let euerie man returne into his houſe in peace.
label: 3 Kings

text: (Therfore the king of Iſrael ſayd to Ioſaphat: Did I not tel thee, that he doeth not prophecie me good, but alwaies euil?)
label: 3 Kings

text: But he adding, ſayd: Therfore heare the word of our Lord: I ſaw our Lord ſitting vpon his throne, and al the hoſte of heauen aſſiſting him on the right hand and on the left:
label: 3 Kings

text: and our Lord ſayd: Who shal deceiue Achab the king of Iſrael, that he may goe vp, and fal in Ramoth Galaad? And one ſayd theſe maner of wordes, and an other otherwiſe.
label: 3 Kings

text: And there came forth a ſpirit, and ſtood before our Lord, and ſayd: I wil deceiue him. To whom our Lord ſpake: Wherein?
label: 3 Kings

text: And he ſayd: I wil goe forth, and be a lying ſpirit in the mouth of al his prophetes. And our Lord ſayd: Thou shalt deceiue, and shalt preuayle: goe forth, and doe ſo.
label: 3 Kings

text: Now therfore behold our Lord hath geuen the ſpirite of lying in the mouth of al thy prophetes, that are here, and our Lord hath ſpoken euil agaynſt thee.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Sedecias the ſonne of Chanaana came, and ſmote Micheas on the cheeke, and ſayd: Hath the Spirit of our Lord leaft me, and hath it ſpoken to thee?
label: 3 Kings

text: And Micheas ſayd: Thou shalt ſee in that day, when thou shalt enter into thy chamber, within the chamber to be hid.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king of Iſrael ſayd: Take Micheas, and let him tarie with Amon the gouernour of the citie, and with Ioab the ſonne of Amelech,
label: 3 Kings

text: and tel them: Thus ſayth the king: Caſt this man into priſon, and feede him with bread of tribulation, and water of diſtreſſe, til I returne in peace.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Micheas ſayd: If thou returne in peace, our Lord hath not ſpoken in me. And he ſayd: Heare al ye peoples.
label: 3 Kings

text: Therfore the king of Iſrael went vp, and Ioſaphat the king of Iuda into Ramoth Galaad.
label: 3 Kings

text: The king of Iſrael therfore ſayd to Ioſaphat: Take armour, and goe into the battel, and put on thyne owne garmentes. Moreouer the king of Iſrael changed his habite, and went into the battel.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king of Syria had commanded the princes of his chariotes thirtie and two, ſaying: You shal not fight agaynſt any leſſer, or greater, but agaynſt the king of Iſrael onlie.
label: 3 Kings

text: When therfore the princes of the chariotes had ſeene Ioſaphat, they ſuſpected that he was the king of Iſrael, and making a violent aſſault they fought agaynſt him: & Ioſaphat cried out.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the princes of the chariotes perceiued that he was not the king of Iſrael, and they ceaſed from him.
label: 3 Kings

text: And a certaine man bent his bow, directing the arrow at al aduenture, and by chance he ſtroke the king of Iſrael betwen the lunges and the ſtomacke. But he ſayd to his cochere: Turne thy hand, and carrie me out of the armie, becauſe I am greuouſely wounded.
label: 3 Kings

text: The battel therfore was fought that day, and the king of Iſrael ſtood in his chariote agaynſt the Syrians, and he died in the euening: & the bloud of the wound ranne into the middes of the chariote,
label: 3 Kings

text: and the herauld ſounded in al the armie before the ſunne ſette, ſaying: Euerie man returne into his citie, and into his countrie.
label: 3 Kings

text: And the king died, and was carried into Samaria: and they buried the king in Samaria,
label: 3 Kings

text: and washed his chariote in the poole of Samaria, and the dogges licked his bloud, and they washed the raynes of the bridle, according to the word of our Lord which he had ſpoken.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Achab, and al that he did, and the houſe of yuorie, that he built, and of al the cities that he built, are not theſe thinges written in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 3 Kings

text: Achab therfore ſlept with his fathers, and Ochozias his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 3 Kings

text: But Ioſaphat the ſonne of Aſa began to reigne ouer Iuda the fourth yeare of Achab the king of Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: Fiue and thirtie yeares old was he when he began to reigne, and fiue and twentie yeares he reigned in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Azuba the daughter of Salai.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he walked in al the way of Aſa his father, and he declined not from it: and he did that which was right in the ſight of our Lord.
label: 3 Kings

text: But yet he tooke not away the excelſes: for as yet the people did ſacrifice, and burnt incenſe in the excelſes.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Ioſaphat had peace with the king of Iſrael.
label: 3 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ioſaphat, and his workes, which he did, and his battels, are not theſe thinges written in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iuda?
label: 3 Kings

text: Yea and the remnant of the effeminate, which remayned in the daies of Aſa his father, he tooke out of the land.
label: 3 Kings

text: Neither was there then a king appoynted in Edom.
label: 3 Kings

text: But king Ioſaphat had made nauies on the ſea, which should ſaile into Ophir for gold: and they could not goe, becauſe they were broken in Aſiongaber.
label: 3 Kings

text: Then ſayd Ochozias the ſonne of Achab to Ioſaphat: Let my ſeruantes goe with thy ſeruantes in the shippes. And Ioſaphat would not.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Ioſaphat ſlept with his fathers, and was buried with them in the Citie of Dauid his father: and Ioram his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 3 Kings

text: And Ochozias the ſonne of Achab began to reigne ouer Iſrael in Samaria, in the ſeuententh yeare of Ioſaphat the king of Iuda, and he reigned ouer Iſrael two yeares.
label: 3 Kings

text: And he did euil in the ſight of our Lord, and walked in the way of his father and his mother, and in the way of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, who made Iſrael to ſinne.
label: 3 Kings

text: He ſerued alſo Baal, and adored him, and prouoked our Lord the God of Iſrael, according to al thinges which his father had done.
label: 3 Kings

text: AND Moab moued warre agaynſt Iſrael, after that Achab was dead.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ochozias fel through the ſtanchions of his vpper chamber which he had in Samaria, and was ſicke: and he ſent meſſengers, ſaying to them: Goe, conſult Beelzebub the god of Accaron, whether I may liue of this my infirmitie.
label: 4 Kings

text: And an Angel of our Lord ſpake to Elias the Theſbite, ſaying: Ariſe, and goe vp to meete the meſſengers of the king of Samaria, and thou shal ſay to them: What is there not a God in Iſrael, that ye goe to conſult Beelzebub the god of Accaron?
label: 4 Kings

text: Wherfore thus ſaith our Lord: From the bed on which thou art aſcended, thou shalt not goe downe, but dying thou ſhalt die. And Elias wcnt away.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the meſſengers returned to Ochozias. Who ſaid to them: Why are you returned?
label: 4 Kings

text: But they anſwered him: A man mette vs: and ſayd to vs: Goe, and returne to the king, that ſent you, and you shal ſay to him: Thus ſaith our Lord: Doeſt thou therfore ſend to conſult Beelzebub the god of Accaron, becauſe there was no God in Iſrael? Therfore from the bed, which thou art vpon, thou ſhalt not goe downe, but dying thou shalt dye.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who ſaid to them: What shape and habite had that man, which mette you, and ſpake theſe wordes?
label: 4 Kings

text: But they ſaid: A hearie man, and girded about his raines with a girdle of lether: Who ſaid: It is Elias the Thesbite.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſent vnto him a captaine of fiftie men, and the fiftie that were vnder him. Who went vp and ſayd to him ſitting in the toppe of the mount: Man of God, the king hath commanded that thou come downe.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Elias anſwering, ſayd to the captaine of fiftie men: If I be a man of God, let fyre come downe from heauen, and deuoure thee, and thy fiftie. Fyre therfore came downe from heauen, and deuoured him and the fiftie men that were with him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſent againe vnto him an other captaine of fiftie men, and his fiftie with him. Who ſpake to him: Man of God, Thus ſaith the king: Make haſt, come downe.
label: 4 Kings

text: Elias anſwering ſaid: If I be a man of God, let fyre come downe from heauen, and deuoure thee, and thy fiftie. Fyre therfore came downe from heauen, and deuoured him, and his fiftie.
label: 4 Kings

text: Agayne he ſent a third captaine of fiftie men, and the fiftie that were with him. Who when he was come, bowed his knees toward Elias, and prayed him and ſayd: Man of God deſpiſe not my life and the liues of thy ſeruantes that are with me.
label: 4 Kings

text: Behold fyre came downe from heauen, and hath deuoured the two firſt captaynes of fiftie men, and the fifties, that were with them: but now I beſech the that thou haue mercie on my life.
label: 4 Kings

text: And an Angel of our Lord ſpake to Elias, ſaying: Goe downe with him, feare not. He therfore aroſe, and went downe with him to the king,
label: 4 Kings

text: and ſpakc to him: Thus ſaith our Lord: Becauſe thou haſt ſent meſſengers to conſult Beelzebub the god of Accaron, as though there were not a God in Iſrael, of whom thou mighteſt aske the word, therfore from the bed, which thou art aſcended vpon, thou shalt not deſcend, but dying thou shalt die.
label: 4 Kings

text: He died therfore according to the word of our Lord which Elias ſpake, & Ioram his brother reigned for him, in the ſecond yeare of Ioram the ſonne of Ioſaphat the king of Iuda: for he had no ſonne.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ochozias, which he wrought, are not theſe written in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 4 Kings

text: AND it came to paſſe, when our Lord would take vp Elias by a hurle winde into heauen, Elias and Eliſeus went from Galgal.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Elias ſayd to Eliſeus: Sitte here, becauſe our Lord hath ſent me as fur as Bethel. To whom Eliſeus ſayd: Our Lord liueth, and thy ſoule liueth, I wil not leaue thee. And when he was come downe to Bethel,
label: 4 Kings

text: the children of the prophetes, that were in Bethel, went forth to Eliſeus, and ſayd to him: Doeſt thou know, that this day our Lord wil take thy maiſter from thee? Who anſwered: I alſo know it: hold your peace.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Elias ſayd to Eliſeus: Sitte here, becauſe our Lord hath ſent me into Iericho. And he ſayd: Our Lord liueth, & thy ſoule liueth, I wil not leaue thee. And when they were come to Iericho,
label: 4 Kings

text: the children of the prophetes, that were in Iericho, came to Eliſeus, and ſayd to him: Doeſt thou know that this day our Lord wil take away thy maiſter from thee? And he ſayd: I alſo know it, hold your peace.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Elias ſayd to him: Sitte here, becauſe our Lord hath ſent me as farre as Iordan. Who ſayd: Our Lord liueth, and thy ſoule liueth, I wil not leaue thee: They went therfore both together,
label: 4 Kings

text: & fiftie men of the children of the prophetes folowed them, who alſo ſtood ouer agaynſt them, farre of: but they two ſtood vpon Iordan.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Elias tooke his mantel, and folded it together, and ſmote the waters, which were diuided into two partes, and they both paſſed ouer by the drie land.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when they were ouer, Elias ſayd to Eliſeus: Aske what thou wilt haue me to doe for thee, before I be taken from thee. And Eliſeus ſayd: I beſech thee that in me may be thy duble ſpirit.
label: 4 Kings

text: who anſwered: Thou haſt asked a hard thing: Neuertheleſſe if thou ſee me, when I shal be taken from thee, thou shalt haue that thou haſt asked: but if thou ſee me not, thou shalt not haue it.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when they went forward, and going talked together, behold a fyrie chariote, and fyrie horſes parted them two aſunder: and Elias aſcended by a hurle winde into heauen.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Eliſeus ſaw him, and cried: My father, my father, the chariote of Iſrael, and the guider therof. And he ſaw him no more: and he tooke his garmentes, and rent them in two peeces.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he tooke vp the mantel of Elias, that was fallen to him: and returning he ſtood vpon the banke of Iordan,
label: 4 Kings

text: and with the mantel of Elias, that fel downe to him, he ſmote the waters, and they were not diuided. And he ſayd: Where is the God of Elias, now alſo? and he ſmote the waters, and they were diuided this way and that way, and Eliſeus paſſed ouer.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the children of the prophetes, that were in Iericho, ouer agaynſt him ſeing him, ſayd: The ſpirit of Elias hath reſted vpon Eliſeus. And coming to meete him, adored him flatte to the ground,
label: 4 Kings

text: and they ſayd to him: Behold, there are with thy ſeruantes fiftie ſtrong men, that can goe, and ſeeke thy maiſter, leſt perhaps the ſpirit of our Lord hath taken him, and caſt him vpon one of the mountaines, or into one of the valleis. Who ſayd: Send not.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they forced him, til he agreed, and ſayd: Send. And they ſent fiftie men. Who when they had ſought three daies, found not.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they returned to him: but he dwelt in Iericho, and he ſayd to them: Did I not ſay to you: Send not?
label: 4 Kings

text: The men alſo of the citie ſayd to Eliſeus: Behold the habitation of this citie is verie good, as thy ſelfe my lord perceiueſt: but the waters are very il, and the ground barren.
label: 4 Kings

text: But he ſayd: Fetch me a new veſſel, and put ſalt into it. Which when they had btought,
label: 4 Kings

text: going out to the fountayne of the waters, he caſt ſalt into it, and ſayd: Thus ſayth our Lord: I haue amended theſe waters, and death shal no more be in them, nor barrenneſſe.
label: 4 Kings

text: The waters therfore were amended vntil this day, according to the word of Eliſeus, which he ſpake.
label: 4 Kings

text: And from thence he went vp into Bethel: & when he went vp by the way, little laddes came forth out of the citie, and mocked him, ſaying: Come vp baldhead, come vp baldhead.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who when he had looked backe, he ſaw them, & curſed them in the name of our Lord: and two beares came forth out of the foreſt, & tore of them two and fourtie boyes.
label: 4 Kings

text: and from thence he went into the mount of Carmel, and from thence he turned into Samaria.
label: 4 Kings

text: AND Ioram the ſonne of Achab reigned ouer Iſrael in Samaria the eightenth yeare of Ioſaphat the king of Iuda. And he reigned twelue yeares.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did euil before our Lord, but not as his father and mother: for he tooke away the ſtatues of Baal, which his father had made.
label: 4 Kings

text: Neuertheles in the ſinnes of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, who made Iſrael to ſinne, he ſtucke faſt, and departed not from them.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer Meſa the king of Moab, nourished manie sheepe, and he payed to the king of Iſrael an hundred thouſand lambes, and a hundred thouſand rammes with their fleeces.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when Achab was dead, he brake the league, which he had made with the king of Iſtael.
label: 4 Kings

text: Therfore king Ioram went forth that day out of Samaria, and muſtered al Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſent to Ioſaphat the king of Iuda, ſaying: The king of Moab is reuolted from me, come with me againſt him to battel. Who anſwered: I wil come vp: he that is mine, is thine: my people, thy people: & my horſes thy horſes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſaid: What way shal we goe vp? but he anſwered: By the deſert of Idumea.
label: 4 Kings

text: Therfore the king of Iſrael, and the king of Iuda, and the king of Edom went forward, and compaſſed ſeuen daies iourney, neither was there water for the armie, and the beaſtes, that folowed them.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king of Iſrael ſaid: Alas alas alas, our Lord hath gathered vs three kinges together, that he might deliuer vs into the handes of Moab.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioſaphat ſaid: Is there not here a prophet of our Lord, that we may beſech our Lord by him? And one of the ſeruantes of the king of Iſrael anſwered: Here is Eliſeus the ſonne of Saphat, which powred water vpon the handes of Elias.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioſaphat ſayd: The word of our Lord is with him. And the king of Iſrael went downe to him, and Ioſaphat the king of Iuda, and the king of Edom.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Eliſeus ſaid to the king of Iſrael: What is to me and thee? goe to the prophetes of thy father, and thy mother. And the king of Iſrael ſaid to him: Why hath our Lord gathered together theſe three kinges, that he might deliuer them into the handes of Moab?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Eliſeus ſaid to him: The Lord of hoſtes liueth, in whoſe ſight I ſtand, If I did not reuerence the face of Ioſaphat the king of Iuda, I would not certes haue harkened to thee, nor looked on thee.
label: 4 Kings

text: But now bring me hither a plaier on inſtrumentes. And when the player ſang, the hand of our Lord came vpon him, and he ſaid:
label: 4 Kings

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: Make the chanel of this torrent diches and diches.
label: 4 Kings

text: For thus ſaith our Lord: You shal not ſee winde, nor raine: and this chanel shal be filled with waters, & you shal drinke, and your families, & your beaſtes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And this is a ſmal thing in the ſight of our Lord: moreouer he wil deliuer alſo Moab into your handes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And you shal ſtrike euerie fenſed citie, and euerie principal citie, and shal cut downe al fruiteful trees, and shal ſtoppe vp al fountaines of waters, and euerie goodlie field you shal couer with ſtones.
label: 4 Kings

text: It came to paſſe therfore in the morning, when they vſed to offer the ſacrifice, and behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the ground was filled with waters.
label: 4 Kings

text: But al the Moabites hearing that the kinges were come vp to fight againſt them, they called together al that were girded with a belt vpon them, and they ſtoode in the borders.
label: 4 Kings

text: And ryſing early in the morning, and the ſunne being now riſen ouer againſt the waters, the Moabites ſaw the waters ouer againſt them red, as it were bloud,
label: 4 Kings

text: and ſaid: It is the bloud of the ſword: the kinges haue fought among them ſelues, and are ſlaine one of an other: now goe on forward to the pray, Moab.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they went forward into the campe of Iſrael: Moreouer Iſrael ryſing vp, ſtroke Moab: but they fled before them. They therfore that had ouercome, came and ſtroke Moab,
label: 4 Kings

text: and deſtroyed the cities: & euerie principal field they filled euerie man caſting ſtones: and they ſtopt vp al the fountaines of waters: and cut downe al trees that bare fruite, ſo that there remained onlie brike walles: and the citie was beſette of the ſlingers, and for a great part therof was ſtrooken.
label: 4 Kings

text: Which when the king of Moab had ſeene, to witte, that the enemies had preuayled, he tooke with him ſeuen hundred men that erew ſword, to breake in vpon the king of Edom: and they could not.
label: 4 Kings

text: And taking his firſt begotten ſonne, that should haue reigned for him, he offered him an holocauſt vpon the wal: and there was great indignation in Iſrael, and forthwith they retyred from him, and returned into their countrie.
label: 4 Kings

text: AND a certayne woman of the wiues of the prophetes cried to Eliſeus, ſaying: Thy ſeruant my huſband is dead, and thou knoweſt that thy ſeruant was one that feared God, & behold the creditour is come to take away my two ſonnes to ſerue him.
label: 4 Kings

text: To whom Eliſeus ſayd: What wilt thou that I doe for thee? Tel me, what haſt thou in thy houſe? But she anſwered: I thy handmaid haue nothing in my houſe, but a litle oyle, to anoynt me withal.
label: 4 Kings

text: To whom he ſayd: Goe, borrow of al thy neighbours emptie veſſels not a few.
label: 4 Kings

text: And goe in, and shut thy doore, when thou art within, thou and thy ſonnes: and powre therof into al theſe veſſels: and when they shal be ful, thou shalt take them away.
label: 4 Kings

text: The woman therfore went, and shut the doore vpon her, and vpon her ſonnes: they brought her veſſels, and she powred in.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when the veſſels were ful, she ſayd to her ſonne: Bring me yet a veſſel. And he anſwered: I haue none. And the oile ſtood.
label: 4 Kings

text: And she came, and told the man of God. And he ſayde, Goe, ſel the oyle, and pay thy creditour: and thou and thy ſonnes liue of the reſt:
label: 4 Kings

text: And there came a certayne day, and Eliſeus paſſed by Sunam: and there was there a great woman, which held him to eate bread: and when he paſſed often that way, he turned in to her to eate bread.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who ſayd to her huſband: I perceiue that this is a holie man of God, which paſſeth by vs often.
label: 4 Kings

text: Let vs therfore make him a litle chamber, and ſette him a litle bed in it, and a table, and a ſtoole, and a candleſticke, that when he cometh to vs he may tarie there.
label: 4 Kings

text: There came therfore a certayne day, and coming he turned in to the chamber, and reſted there.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſayd to Giezi his ſeruant: Call this Sunamite. Who when he had called her, and she ſtoode before him,
label: 4 Kings

text: he ſayd to his ſeruant: Speake to her: Behold thou haſt diligently miniſtred to vs in al thinges, what wilt thou that I doe for thee? haſt thou any buſines, and wilt thou that I ſpeake to the king, or the general of the warrefare? Who anſwered: I dwel in the middes of myne owne people.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſayd: What wil she then that I doe for her? And Giezi ſayd: Aske not: for she hath no ſonne, and her huſband is old.
label: 4 Kings

text: He therfore cõmanded him to cal her: who when she was called, and ſtoode before the doore,
label: 4 Kings

text: he ſayd to her: At this tyme, this ſelf ſame houre, if life accompanie, thou shalt haue a ſonne in thy wombe. But she anſwered: Doe not I beſech thee my lord, man of God, doe not lie to thy handmayd.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the woman conceiued, and brought forth a ſonne in that time, and in the ſelf ſame houre, that Eliſeus had ſayd.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the childe grewe. And vpon a cerraine day, when going forth he went to his father, vnto the reapers,
label: 4 Kings

text: he ſayd to his father: My head aketh, my head aketh. But he ſaid to his ſeruant, take him, and bring him to his mother,
label: 4 Kings

text: who when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, she ſette him vpon her knees vntil noone, and he dyed.
label: 4 Kings

text: And she went vp, and laid him vpon the bed of the man of God, and shut the doore: and going forth
label: 4 Kings

text: called her husband, and ſayd: Send with me, I beſech thee, one of the ſeruantes, and an aſſe, that I may runne to the man of God, and returne.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who ſayd to her: For what cauſe doeſt thou goe to him? The Calendes be not to day, nor the Sabbath. Who anſwered: I wil goe.
label: 4 Kings

text: And she ſadled the aſſe, and commanded her ſeruant: driue, and make haſt, make no ſtay in going. And doe that which I command thee.
label: 4 Kings

text: She therfore went forward, and came to the man of God into mount Carmel: and when the man of God ſaw her ouer againſt him, he ſaid to Giezi his ſeruant: Behold that Sunamite.
label: 4 Kings

text: Goe therfore to meete her, and ſay to her: Is al wel about thee, and about thy husband, and about thy ſonne? Who anſwered: Wel.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when she was come to the man of God into the mount, she caught his feet: and Giezi came to remoue her. And the man of God ſaid: Let her alone, for her ſoule is in anguish, and our Lord hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who ſaid to him: Did I aske a ſonne of my Lord? Did I not ſay to thee: Mocke me not?
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſaid to Giezi: Girde thy loynes, and take my ſtaffe in thy hand, & goe. If a man meete thee, ſalute him not: and if any man ſalute thee, anſwer him not: and thou ſhalt put my ſtaffe vpon the face of the childe.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer the mother of the childe ſaid: Our Lord liueth, and thy ſoul liueth, I wil not leaue thee. He aroſe therfore, and folowed her.
label: 4 Kings

text: But Giezi was gone before them, and had put the ſtaffe vpon the face of the childe, & there was not voice, nor ſenſe: and he returned to meete him, and told him, ſaying: The childe is not riſen.
label: 4 Kings

text: Eliſeus therfore went into the houſe, and behold the childe lay dead on his bed:
label: 4 Kings

text: and going in he shut the doore vpon him, & vpon the childe & prayed to our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he went vp, and lay vpon the childe: and he put his mouth vpon his mouth, & his eies vpon his eies & his handes vpon his handes: and he bowed him ſelf ouer him, and the childes flesh was warmed.
label: 4 Kings

text: But he returning, walked vp and downe in the houſe, once hither & thither: & he went vp, and lay vpon him: and the childe gaped ſeuen tymes, and opened his eies.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he called Gierzi, & ſaid to him: Call this Sunamite. Who being called, went in vnto him: Who ſaid: Take thy ſonne.
label: 4 Kings

text: She came, and fel at his feete, and adored vpon the ground: and tooke her ſonne, and went out,
label: 4 Kings

text: and Eliſeus returned into Galgal. And there was a famine in the land, and the children of the prophetes dwelt before him; and he ſayd to one of his ſeruantes: Sette on a greate potte, and ſeeth broth for the children of the prophetes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And one went out into the field to gather wilde herbes: and he found as it were a wilde vine, and gathered of it the colocynthides of the field, and filled his mantel, and returning cut it into the potte of broth, for he knew not what it was.
label: 4 Kings

text: They therfore powred it to their felowes, to eate: and when they had taſted of the broth, they cried, ſaying: Death is in the potte, man of God. And they could not eate.
label: 4 Kings

text: But he ſayd: Bring meale, and when they had brought it, he caſt it into the potte, and ſaid: powere in for the multitude, that they may eate. And there was no more anie bitterneſſe in the potte.
label: 4 Kings

text: And a certaine man came from Baalſaliſa bringing to the man of God loaues of the firſt fruites, twentie barley loaues, and new wheate in his ſcrippe. But he ſaid: Geue to the people, that they may eate.
label: 4 Kings

text: And his ſeruant anſwered him: How much is this, that I ſhould ſette it before an hundred men? Agayne he ſaid: Geue to the people, that they may eate: for thus ſaith our Lord: They shal eate, and there shal be leaft.
label: 4 Kings

text: He therfore ſette it before them: who did eate, and there was leaft according to the word of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: NAAMAN the General of the warfare of the king of Syria, was a great man with his lord, and honorable: for by him our Lord gaue health to Syria: and he was a valiant man and rich, but a leper.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer out of Syria there were come forth robbers, and had led away captiue out of the Land of Iſrael a litle girle, which wayted vpon the wife of Naaman.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who ſaid to her maiſtreſſe: I would my lord had bene with the prophete, that is in Samaria: ſurely he would haue cured him from the leproſie, which he hath.
label: 4 Kings

text: Naaman therfore went into his lord, and told him ſaying: Thus and thus hath the wench of the Land of Iſrael ſpoken.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king of Syria ſayd to him: Goe, & I wil ſend letters to the king of Iſrael Who when he was ſette forward, and had taken with him ten talentes of ſiluer, and ſix thouſand peces of gold, and ten change of rayment,
label: 4 Kings

text: he brought the letters to the king of Iſrael, in theſe wordes: When thou shalt receiue this letter, know that I haue ſent to thee Naaman my ſeruant, that thou mayeſt cure him of his leproſie.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when the king of Iſrael had read the letters, he rent his garmentes, and ſaid: Am I God, that I can kil, and geue life, becauſe this man hath ſent to me, that I should cure a man of his leproſie? marke, and ſee that he ſeeketh occaſions againſt me.
label: 4 Kings

text: Which when Eliſeus the man of God had heard, to witte, that the king of Iſrael had rent his garmentes, he ſent to him, ſaying: Why haſt thou rent thy garmentes? let him come to me and let him know that there is a prophet in Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: Naaman therfore came with horſes and chariotes, and ſtood at the doore of the houſe of Eliſeus:
label: 4 Kings

text: and Eliſeus ſent a meſſenger to him, ſaying: Goe and be washed ſeuen times in Iordan, and thy flesh shal receiue health, and thou shalt be cleane.
label: 4 Kings

text: Naaman being angrie departed, ſaying:I thought he would come out to me, and ſtanding would inuocate the name of the Lord his God, and touch with his hand the place of the leproſie, and cure me.
label: 4 Kings

text: What are not Abana, and Pharphar the riuers of Damaſcus, better then al the waters of Iſrael, that I may be washed in them, and be made cleane? Therfore when he had turned him ſelf, and went away with indignation,
label: 4 Kings

text: his ſeruantes came vnto him, & ſpake to him: Father, & if the prophet had ſayd a great thing to thee, certes, thou shouldeſt haue done it: how much more wheras now he ſayd vnto thee: Be washed, and thou shalt be cleane?
label: 4 Kings

text: He went downe, & washed in Iordan ſeuen times according to the word of the man of God, and his flesh was reſtored, as the flesh of a litle childe, & he was made cleane
label: 4 Kings

text: And returning to the man of God with al his trayne, he came, and ſtood before him, & ſayd: In very deede I know that there is no other God in al the earth, but only in Iſrael. I beſech the therfore to take a benediction of thy ſeruant.
label: 4 Kings

text: But he anſwered: Our Lord liueth, before whom I ſtand, I wil not take it. And when he would haue forced him, he did in no-wiſe agree.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Naaman ſayd: As thou wilt, but I beſech thee: graunt vnto me thy ſeruant, that I may take of the earth the burden of two mules: for thy ſeruant wil no more make holocauſt, or victimes to ſtrange goddes, but to the Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: But this onlie is it, for which thou shalt beſech the Lord for thy ſeruant, when my maiſter shal goe into the temple of Remmon, to adore: and he leaning vpon my hand, if I shal adore in the temple of Remmon, he adoring in the ſame place, that the Lord pardon me thy ſeruant fot this thing.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who ſayd to him: Goe in peace. He therfore went from him in the ſpring time of the earth.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Giezi the ſeruant of the man of God ſayd: My maiſter hath ſpared Naaman this Syrian, that he tooke not of him the things which he brought: Our Lord liueth, I wil runne after him, and wil take ſome thing of him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Giezi folowed at the backe of Naaman: whom when he ſaw running toward him, he lept downe from his chariote to mete him, and ſaid: Are al thinges wel?
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſaid: Wel. my maiſter hath ſent me to thee, ſaying: Euen now there are come to me two yong men from mount Ephraim, of the children of the prophetes: geue them a talent of ſiluer, and two change of rayment.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Naaman ſayd: It is better that thou take two talentes. And he forced him, & bound the two talentes of ſiluer in two bagges, and the duble rayment, & layd it vpon two of his ſeruantes, who alſo caried it before him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when he was come now in the euening, he tooke it out of their hand, & layd it vp in the houſe, & diſmiſſed the men, and they departed.
label: 4 Kings

text: And himſelf going in, ſtood before his maiſter. And Eliſeus ſaid: From whence comeſt thou Giezi? Who anſwered: Thy ſeruant hath not gone any whither.
label: 4 Kings

text: But he ſayd: Was not my hart preſent, when the man returned out of his chariote to meete thee? Now therfore thou haſt receiued ſiluer, and taken rayment, to bye oliuetes, and vineyardes, and sheepe, and oxen, and ſeruantes, and handmaides.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the leproſie alſo of Naaman shal cleaue to thee, and to thy ſeede, for euer. And he went out from him a leper as it were ſnow.
label: 4 Kings

text: AND the children of the prophetes ſayd to Eliſeus: Behold the place, wherin we dwel before thee is ſtreite for vs.
label: 4 Kings

text: Let vs goe as far as Iordan, and take out of the wood euerie man ſome timber, that we may build there a place to dwel in. Who ſaid: Goe.
label: 4 Kings

text: And one of them ſayd: Come therfore thou alſo with thy ſeruantes. He anſwered: I wil come.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he went with them. And when they were come to Iordan they cut wood.
label: 4 Kings

text: And it chanced, that when one had cut downe timber, the head of the axe fel into the water: and he cried out, and ſaid: Alas alas alas my lord, this ſame alſo I did borow.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the man of God ſayd: where fel it? and he shewed him the place: he therfore cut of a pece of wood, and caſt it thither: and the yron did ſwimme,
label: 4 Kings

text: and he ſaid: Take it vp. Who ſtretched forth his hand, and tooke it.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king of Syria fought againſt Iſrael, and tooke counſel with his ſeruantes, ſaying: In that and that place let vs lay embushementes.
label: 4 Kings

text: Therfore the man of God ſent to the king of Iſrael, ſaying: Beware thou paſſe not into ſuch a place: becauſe the Syrians are there in embushementes.
label: 4 Kings

text: The king of Iſrael therfore ſent to the place, which the man of God had told him, and preuented him, and looked wel to him ſelf there not once or twiſe.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the hart of the king of Syria was trubled for this thing. And calling together his ſeruantes, he ſayd: Why doe you not tel me who is the betraier of me to the king of Iſrael?
label: 4 Kings

text: And one of his ſeruantes ſayd: Not ſo my lord king, but Eliſeus the prophet, which is in Iſrael, telleth the king of Iſrael al wordes, whatſoeuer thou shalt ſpeake in thy priuy chamber.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſayd to them: Goe, and ſee where he is: that I may ſend, and take him. And they told him, ſaying: Behold in Dothan.
label: 4 Kings

text: He therfore ſent thither horſes and chariotes, and the force of his armie: who when they were come in the night, they beſette the citie.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the ſeruant of the man of God riſing early, went out, and ſaw an armie round about the citie, and horſes and chariotes: and he told him, ſaying: Alas alas alas my lord, what shal we doe.
label: 4 Kings

text: But he anſwered: Feare not: for there are more with vs then with them.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when Eliſeus had prayed, he ſayd: Lord open the eies of this man, that he may ſee. And our Lord opened the eies of the ſeruant, and he behold: and loe the mountaine ful of horſes, and of firie chariotes round about Eliſeus.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the enemies went downe to him: moreouer Eliſeus prayed to our Lord, ſaying: Strike, I beſech thee, this people with blindeneſſe. And our Lord ſmote them, that they ſaw not, according to the word of Eliſeus.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Eliſeus ſayd to them: This is not the way neither is this the citie: folow me, & I wil shew you the man, whom you ſeeke. He therfore led them into Samaria:
label: 4 Kings

text: and when they were entered into Samaria, Eliſeus ſaid: Lord open the eies of theſe men, that they may ſee. And our Lord opened their eies, and they ſaw them ſelues to be in the middes of Samaria.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king of Iſrael ſaid to Eliſeus, when he had ſene them: Shal I ſtrike them, my father?
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſaid: Thou shalt not ſtrike them: for thou didſt not take them with thy ſword, and thy bow, that thou mayſt ſtrike them: but ſet bread and water before them, that they may eate and drinke, and goe to their maiſter.
label: 4 Kings

text: And a great preparation of meates was ſette before them, and they did eate and drinke, and he diſmiſſed them, and they went away to their maiſter, and the robbers of Syria came no more into the Land of Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe after theſe thinges, Benadad the king of Syria gathered together al his armie, and went vp, and beſieged Samaria.
label: 4 Kings

text: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and ſo long it was beſieged, til the head of an aſſe was ſold for foure ſcore ſiluer peeces, & the fourth part of a cabe of pigeons dung, for fiue ſiluer peeces.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when the king of Iſrael paſſed by the wall, a certayne woman cried out to him, ſaying: Saue me my lord king.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who ſayd: No, our Lord ſaue thee: how can I ſaue thee? of the floore, or of the preſſe? And the king ſayd to her: What ayleth thee? Who anſwered:
label: 4 Kings

text: This woman ſayd to me: Geue thy ſonne, that we may eate him to day, & my ſonne we wil eate to morrow.
label: 4 Kings

text: We therfore boyled my ſonne, and did eate him. And I ſayd to her the next day: Geue thy ſonne, that we may eate him. Who hath hid her ſonne.
label: 4 Kings

text: Which when the king had heard, he rent his garmentes, and paſſed by the wal. And al the people ſaw the hearecloth, which he ware next vpon his flesh.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king ſayd: Theſe thinges doe God to me, and theſe adde he, if the head of Eliſeus the ſonne of Saphat shal ſtand vpon him this day.
label: 4 Kings

text: But Eliſeus ſate in his houſe, and the ancientes ſate with him. He therfore ſent a man before: and before that meſſenger came, he ſayd to the ancientes: Doe you know that this murderers ſonne hath ſent to cut of my head? See therfore, when the meſſenger shal come, shut the doore, and ſuffer him not to enter in: for behold the ſound of his maiſters feete is behinde him.
label: 4 Kings

text: Whiles he was yet ſpeaking to them, the meſſenger appeared, which came to him. And he ſayd: Behold, this ſo great euil is of our Lord: what shal I looke for more of our Lord?
label: 4 Kings

text: AND Eliſeus ſayd: Heare ye the word of our Lord: Thus ſayth our Lord: At this time to morow a bushel of floure shal be at one ſtater, and two bushels of barley at one ſtater, in the gate of Samaria.
label: 4 Kings

text: One of the Dukes, vpon whoſe hand the king leaned, anſwearing the man of God, ſayd: If our Lord shal make fludgates in heauen, can that poſſibly be which thou ſpeakeſt? Who ſayd: Thou shalt ſee it with thine eies, and shalt not eate therof.
label: 4 Kings

text: There were therfore, foure men lepers, beſide the entrance of the gate: who ſayd one to an other: What meane we to be here til we die?
label: 4 Kings

text: Whether we enter into the citie, we shal die for famine: or whether we tarie here, die we muſt: come therfore, and let vs runne away to the campe of Syria. If they ſpare vs, we shal liue: but if they wil kil vs, we shal die neuertheleſſe.
label: 4 Kings

text: They aroſe therfore in the euening, to come to the campe of Syria. And when they were come to the beginning of the campe of Syria, they found no man there.
label: 4 Kings

text: For our Lord had made them in the campe of Syria to heare the ſound of chariotes, and horſes, and of a verie great armie: and they ſayd one to an other: Behold the king of Iſrael hath for wages hyred agaynſt vs the kinges of the Hetheites, and of the Ægyptians, and they are come vpon vs.
label: 4 Kings

text: They aroſe therfore, and fled in the darke, and leaft their tentes, and their horſes and aſſes in the campe, and fled deſirous to ſaue their liues only.
label: 4 Kings

text: Therfore when theſe lepers were come to the beginning of the campe, they entered into one tabernacle, and did eate and drinke: and they tooke thence ſiluer, and gold, and rayment, and went, and hid it: againe they returned to an other tabernacle, and from thence likewiſe taking away they hid it.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they ſaid one to an other: We doe not wel: for this is a day of good tydinges. If we shal hold our peace, and wil not tel vntil morning, we shal be blamed of a heinous offence: Come, let vs goe, and make report in the kinges court.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when they were come to the gate of the citie, they told them ſaying: We went to the campe of Syria, and found no man there, but horſes, and aſſes tyed, and the tentes pitched.
label: 4 Kings

text: The porters therfore went, and told it to the king within his palace.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who aroſe in the night, & ſayd to his ſeruants: I tel you what the Syrians haue done to vs: They know that we ſuffer great famine, and therfore they are gone out of the campe and lie hid in the fieldes, ſaying: When they ſhal come forth out of the citie, we wil take them aliue, and then we may enter into the citie.
label: 4 Kings

text: But one of his ſeruantes anſwered: Let vs take fiue horſes that are remaining in the citie (becauſe they onlie are in the whole multitude of Iſrael for the other are conſumed) and ſending, we may trie.
label: 4 Kings

text: They brought therfore two horſes, and the king ſent into the campe of the Syrians, ſaying, Goe ye, and ſee.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who went after them as far as Iordan: and behold al the way was ful of rayment, and veſſels, which the Syrians had caſt away, when they were amaſed, and the meſſengers returning told the king.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the people going forth ſpoyled the campe of Syria: and a bushel of floure became at one ſtater, and two bushels of barley at one ſtater, according to the word of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer the king appoynted that duke on whoſe hand he leaned, to ſtand at the gate: whom the multitude trode in the entrance of the gate, & he died, according as the man of God had ſpoken, when the king came downe to him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe according to the word of the man of God, which he ſpake to the king, when he ſayd: Two bushels of barley shal be at one ſtater, and a bushel of floure at one ſtater, this verie tyme to morow it the gate of Samaria:
label: 4 Kings

text: when that duke anſwered the man of God, and ſayd: Although our Lord would make fludgates in the heauen, can this be done which thou ſpeakeſt? And he ſaid to him: Thou shalt ſee with thine eies, and shal not eate therof.
label: 4 Kings

text: It chanced therfore to him as it was foretold, and the people trode him in the gate, and he died.
label: 4 Kings

text: AND Eliſeus ſpake to the woman, whoſe ſonne he reſtored to life, ſaying: Ariſe, goe thou and thy houſe, and ſoiourne wherſoeuer thou shalt finde: for our Lord hath called a famine, and it ſhal come vpon the land ſeuen yeares.
