label: 4 Kings

text: Who aroſe, & did according to the word of the man of God: & going with her houſhould, she ſoiourned in the land of the Philiſtijms many dayes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when the ſeuen yeares were ended, the woman returned out of the Land of the Philiſthijms: and ſhe went forth to ſpeake to the king for her houſe, and for her landes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king ſpake with Giezi the ſeruant of the man of God, ſaying: Tel me al the meruelous thinges that Eliſeus hath done.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when he had told the king how he had rayſed a dead man, the woman appeared, whoſe ſonne he had reuiued, crying to the king for her houſe, and her landes. And Giezi ſayd: My lord king, this is the woman, and this is her ſonne, whom Eliſeus rayſed.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king asked the woman: who told him. And the king gaue her an eunuch, ſaying: Reſtore her al thinges that are hers, and al the reuenewes of the landes, from the day, that she leaft the land vntil this preſent.
label: 4 Kings

text: Eliſeus alſo came to Damaſcus, and Benadad the king of Syria was ſicke: and they told him, ſaying: The man of God cometh hither.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king ſayd to Hazael: Take with thee preſentes, and goe to meete the man of God, and conſult the Lord by him, ſaying: Can I eſcape of this myne infirmitie?
label: 4 Kings

text: Hazael therfore went to meete him, hauing with him preſentes, and al good thinges of Damaſcus, the lodes of fourtie camels. And when he ſtood before him, he ſayd: Thy ſonne Benadad the king of Syria hath ſent me to thee, ſaying: Can I recouer of this mine infirmitie?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Eliſeus ſayd to him: Goe, tel him: Thou shalt be healed: but our Lord hath shewed me that dying he shal die.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſtood with him, and was trubled ſo far that he blushed: and the man of God wept.
label: 4 Kings

text: To whom Hazael ſayd: Why doeth my lord weepe? But he ſayd: Becauſe I know what euils thou wilt doe to the children of Iſrael. Their fenſed cities thou wilt burne with fyre, and their yongmen thou wilt kil with the ſword, and their litle ones thou wilt dash in peeces, and wemen with childe thou wilt diuide.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Hazael ſayd: What am I thy ſeruant a dog, that I should doe this great thing? And Eliſeus ſayd: Our Lord hath shewed me that thou shalt be king of Syria.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who when he was departed from Eliſeus, came to his maiſter, who ſayd to him: What ſayd Eliſeus to thee? But he anſwered: He told me: Thou shalt recouer health.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when the next day was come, he tooke a couerlette, and powred water theron, and ſpred it vpon his face: who being dead, Hazael reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: In the fifth yeare of Ioram the ſonne of Achab the king of Iſrael, and of Ioſaphat the king of Iuda, reigned Ioram the ſonne of Ioſaphat the king of Iuda.
label: 4 Kings

text: He was two and thirtie yeares old when he began to reigne, and he reigned eight yeares in Ieruſalem.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he walked in the waies of the kinges of Iſrael, as the houſe of Achab had walked: for the daughter of Achab was his wife: and he did that which is euil in the ſight of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: But our Lord would not deſtroy Iuda, for Dauid his ſeruant, as he had promiſed him, to geue him a lampe to him, and to his children alwaies.
label: 4 Kings

text: In his daies reuolted Edom, from being vnder Iuda, and made to it ſelf a king.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioram came to Seira, and al the chariotes with him: and he aroſe in the night, and ſtroke the Idumeans, that had beſet him, and the captaynes of the chariotes, and the people fled into their tabernacles.
label: 4 Kings

text: Edom therfore reuolted from being vnder Iuda, vntil this day. Then Lobna alſo reuolted at that time.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ioram, and al that he did, are not theſe thinges written in the Booke of the wordes of the kinges of Iuda?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioram ſlept with his fathers, and was buried with them in the Citie of Dauid, and Ochozias his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: In the twelfth yeare of Ioram the ſonne of Achab the king of Iſrael, reigned Ochozias the ſonne of Ioram the king of Iuda.
label: 4 Kings

text: Two and twentie yeares old was Ochozias when he began to reigne, and he reigned one yeare in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Athalia the daughter of Amri the king of Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he walked in the waies of the houſe of Achab: and he did that which is euil before our Lord, as the houſe of Achab: for he was the ſonne in lawe of the houſe of Achab.
label: 4 Kings

text: He went alſo with Ioram the ſonne of Achab, to fight agaynſt Hazael the king of Syria in Ramoth Galaad, and the Syrians wounded Ioram:
label: 4 Kings

text: Who returned to be cured, in Iezrahel: becauſe the Syrians wounded him in Ramoth fighting agaynſt Hazael the king of Syria. Moreouer Ochozias the ſonne of Ioram the king of Iuda, went downe to viſite Ioram the ſonne of Achab into Iezrahel, becauſe he was ſicke there.
label: 4 Kings

text: AND Eliſeus the prophete called one of the children of the prophetes, and ſayd to him: Girde thy loynes, and take this litle boxe of oyle in thy hand, and goe into Ramoth Galaad.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when thou ſhalt come thither, thou shalt ſee Iehu the ſonne of Ioſaphat the ſonne of Namſi: and going in thou shalt rayſe him out of the middes of his brethren, and shalt bring him into an inner chamber.
label: 4 Kings

text: And holding the litle boxe of oyle, thou shalt powre vpon his head, and shalt ſay: Thus ſayth our Lord: I haue anoynted thee king ouer Iſrael. And thou shalt open the doore, and flee, and shalt not ſtay there.
label: 4 Kings

text: The yongman therfore the childe of a prophete went into Ramoth Galaad,
label: 4 Kings

text: and entered in thither: and behold the captaynes of the armie ſate, and he ſayd: I haue a word to thee o prince: And Iehu ſayd: to whom of vs al? But he ſayd: To thee o prince.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he aroſe, and went into the chamber: but he powred oyle vpon his head, and ſayd: Thus ſayth our Lord the God of Iſrael: I haue anoynted thee king ouer the people of the Lord of Iſrael,
label: 4 Kings

text: and thou shalt ſtrike the houſe of Achab thy maiſter, and I wil reuenge the bloud of my ſeruantes the prophetes, and the bloud of al the ſeruantes of the Lord of the hand of Iezabel.
label: 4 Kings

text: And I wil deſtroy al the houſe of Achab, and wil kil of Achab him that piſſeth agaynſt a wal, and the shut vp, and the meaneſt in Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: And I wil make the houſe of Achab, as the houſe of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, and as the houſe of Baaſa the ſonne of Ahias.
label: 4 Kings

text: Iezabel alſo the dogges ſhal eate in the field of Iezrahel, neither shal there be anie to burie her. And he opened the doore, and fled.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Iehu went forth to his maiſters ſeruantes. Who ſaid to him: Are al thinges wel? Why came this madde man to thee? Who ſayd to them: You know the man, and what he ſpake.
label: 4 Kings

text: But they anſwered: It is falſe, but rather doe thou tel vs. Who ſayd to them: Thus and thus he ſpake to me: and he ſayd: Thus ſayth our Lord, I haue anoynted thee king ouer Iſrael
label: 4 Kings

text: They therfore made haſt, and euerie man taking his mantel layd it vnder his feete, after the ſimilitude of a iudgement ſeate, & they ſounded the trumpet, and ſayd: Iehu hath the kingdom.
label: 4 Kings

text: Iehu therfore the ſonne of Ioſaphat the ſonne of Namſi conſpired agaynſt Ioram: Moreouer Ioram had beſieged Ramoth Galaad, he, and al Iſrael agaynſt Hazael the king of Syria:
label: 4 Kings

text: and was returned to be cured in Iezrael of the woundes, for the Syrians had wounded him, fighting againſt Hazael the king of Syria. And Iehu ſayd: If it pleaſe you, let no man goe forth fugitiue out of the citie, leſt he goe, and tel in Iezrahel.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he mounted, and went into Iezrahel: for Ioram was ſicke there, and Ochozias the king of Iuda was come downe to viſite Ioram.
label: 4 Kings

text: The watchman therfore, that ſtood vpon the toure of Iezrahel, ſaw the troupe of Iehu coming, & ſaid: I ſee a troupe. And Ioram ſaid: Take a Chariote, and ſend to meete them, and let him that goeth ſay: Are al thinges wel?
label: 4 Kings

text: He went therfore, that was gotten vp into the chariote, to meete him, and ſayd: Thus ſaith the king: Are al thinges peaceable? And Iehu ſayd: What haſt thou to doe with peace? paſſe, and folow me. The watchman alſo told, ſaying: The meſſenger came to them, & returneth not.
label: 4 Kings

text: He ſent alſo the ſecond chariote of horſes: and he came to them, and ſaid: Thus ſayth the king: Is there peace? And Iehu ſayd: What haſt thou to doe with peace? paſſe, and folow me.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the watchman told, ſaying: He is come as far as they, & returneth not: and it is the pace as it were the pace of Iehu the ſonne of Namſi, for he goeth amayne.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioram ſayd: Make readie the chariote. And they made readie his chariote, and Ioram the king of Iſrael went forth, and Ochozias the king of Iuda, ech in their chariotes, and they went forth to meete Iehu, and found him in the field of Naboth the Iezrahelite.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when Ioram had ſeene Iehu, he ſayd: Is there peace Iehu? But he anſwered: What peace? The fornications of Iezabel thy mother, and her manie ſorceries are in their vigour.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioram turned his hand, and fleing ſayd to Ochozias: Treaſon Ochozias.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer Iehu bent his bow with his hand, and ſtroke Ioram betwen the shoulders: and the arrow went out through his hart, and immediatly he fel in his chariote.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Iehu ſayd to captaine Badacer: Take him, throwe him forth in the field of Naboth the Iezrahelite: for I remember when I and thou ſitting in a chariote did folow Achab this mans father, that our Lord lifted vp this burden vpon him, ſaying:
label: 4 Kings

text: If not for the bloud of Naboth, and for the bloud of his children, which I ſaw yeſterday, ſayth our Lord, I requite thee not in this field ſayth our Lord. Now therfore take him, and throw him into the field according to the word of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: But Ochozias the king of Iuda ſeing this, fled by the way of the houſe of the garden: and Iehu purſewed him, and ſaid: This man alſo ſtrike ye in his chariote. And they ſtroke him in the going vp of Gauer, which is beſide Ieblaam: who fled into Mageddo, and died there.
label: 4 Kings

text: And his ſeruantes layd him vpon his chariote, and caried him into Ieruſalem: and they buried him there in his ſepulchre with his fathers in the Citie of Dauid.
label: 4 Kings

text: In the eleuenth yeare of Ioram the ſonne of Achab, reigned Ochozias ouer Iuda,
label: 4 Kings

text: and Iehu came into Iezrahel. Moreouer Iezabel hearing of his entrance, paynted her face with ſtibicke ſtone, and decked her head, and beheld through the window
label: 4 Kings

text: Iehu coming at the gate, and ſayd: Can there be peace to Zambri, that killed his maiſter?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Iehu lifted vp his face to the window, and ſayd: What is she? And two or three eunuches bowed them ſelues to him.
label: 4 Kings

text: But he ſayd to them: Caſt her downe headlong, & they threw her downe and the wal was ſprinkled with the bloud, and the hoofes of the horſes trode her.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when he was entered in, to eate, and to drinke, he ſayd: Goe, and ſee that curſed woman, and burie her: becauſe she is a kinges daughter.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when they went to burie her, they found nothing but the skul, and the feete, and the extreme partes of the handes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And returning they told him. And Iehu ſayd: It is the word of our Lord, which he ſpake by his ſeruant Elias the Theſbite, ſaying: In the field of Iezrahel shal the dogges eate the flesh of Iezabel,
label: 4 Kings

text: and the flesh of Iezabel shal be as dung vpon the face of the earth in the field of Iezrahel, ſo that they which paſſe by shal ſay: Is this that ſame Iezabel?
label: 4 Kings

text: AND Achab had ſeuentie ſonnes in Samaria: Iehu therfore wrote letters, and ſent into Samaria to the chiefe of the citie, and to the ancientes, and to them that brought vp Achabs children, ſaying:
label: 4 Kings

text: As ſowne as you shal receiue theſe letters, ye that haue your maiſters ſonnes, and chariotes, and horſes, and fenſed cities, and armour,
label: 4 Kings

text: chooſe the better, and him that shal pleaſe you of your maiſters ſonnes, and ſet him vpon his fathers throne, and fight for the houſe of your lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: They were ſore afrayd, and ſayd: Behold two kinges could not ſtand before him, and how shal we be able to reſiſt?
label: 4 Kings

text: The ouerſeers therfore of the houſe, and the rulers of the citie, and the ancientes, and the tutors ſent to Iehu, ſaying: We are thy ſeruantes, whatſoeuer thou shalt command we wil doe, neither wil we make vs a king: Doe thou whatſoeuer pleaſeth thee.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he wrote letters to them agayne, the ſecond tyme, ſaying: If you be mine, and obey me, take the heades of your maiſters ſonnes, and come to me this verie houre to morow into Iezrahel. Moreouer the kinges ſonnes, ſeuentie men were brought vp with the chiefe of the citie.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when the letters were come to them, they tooke the kinges ſonnes, and ſlew ſeuentie men, and put their heades in baskets, and ſent them to him into Iezrahel.
label: 4 Kings

text: And a meſſenger came, & told him, ſaying: They haue brought the heades of the kinges ſonnes. Who anſwered: Lay them in two heapes by the entrance of the gate vntil morning.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when it was light, he went forth, and ſtanding ſayd to al the people: You are iuſt: If I haue conſpired agaynſt my maiſter, and haue ſlayne him, who hath ſtrooken al theſe?
label: 4 Kings

text: See therfore now there hath not fallen of the wordes of our Lord on the ground, which our Lord ſpake vpon the houſe of Achab, and our Lord hath done that which he ſpake in the hand of his ſeruant Elias.
label: 4 Kings

text: Iehu therfore ſmote al that were leaft of the houſe of Achab in Iezrahel, and al his nobles, and familiars, and prieſtes, til there remayned no reliques of him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he aroſe, and came into Samaria: and when he was come to the cabbin of the shepeheardes in the way,
label: 4 Kings

text: he found the brethren of Ochozias the king of Iuda, and he ſayd to them: What are you? Who anſwered: We are the brethren of Ochozias, and are come downe to ſalute the kinges ſonnes, and the queenes ſonnes.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who ſayd: Take them aliue. Whom when they had taken aliue, they killed them in a ceſterne beſide the cabbin, two and fourtie men, and he leaft not any of them.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when he was gone thence, he found Ionadab the ſonne of Rechab coming to meete him, and he bleſſed him. And he ſayd to him: Is thy hart right as my hart with thy hart? And Ionadab ſayd: It is. If it be ſo, quoth he, geue me thy hand. Who gaue him his hand. But he lifted him vp to him into the chariote,
label: 4 Kings

text: and ſayd to him: Come with me, and ſee my zele for our Lord. And being ſette in his chariote,
label: 4 Kings

text: he brought him into Samaria. And he ſtroke al that were leaft of Achab in Samaria, til there was not one, according to the word of our Lord, which he ſpake by Elias.
label: 4 Kings

text: Iehu therfore aſſembled al the people, and ſayd to them: Achab worshipped Baal a litle, but I wil worshipe him more.
label: 4 Kings

text: Now therfore cal to me al the prophetes of Baal, and al his ſeruantes, and al his prieſtes: let there be none but that he come, for I haue a great ſacrifice to Baal: He that shal be wanting shal not liue. Moreouer Iehu did this craftely, that he might deſtroy the worshippers of Baal.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſayd: Sanctifie a ſolemne day to Baal. And he called
label: 4 Kings

text: and ſent into al the borders of Iſrael, and al the ſeruantes of Baal came: there was leaft not one that came not. And they entered into the temple of Baal: and the houſe of Baal was filled, from one end to the other.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſayd to them that were ouer the garmentes: Bring forth garmentes for al the ſeruantes of Baal. And they brought them forth garmentes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Iehu going in, and Ionadab the ſonne of Rechab into the temple of Baal, ſayd to the worshippers of Baal: Search, and ſee left perhaps there be any with you of the ſeruantes of the Lord, but that there be the ſeruantes of Baal onlie.
label: 4 Kings

text: They therfore went in to make victimes and holocauſtes: but Iehu had prepared him without foureſcore men, and ſayd to them: Whoſoeuer shal eſcape of theſe men, whom I wil bring into your handes, his life shal be for the life of him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And it came to paſſe, when the holocauſte was ended, Iehu commanded his ſouldiars and captaynes: Goe in, and ſtrike them, let none eſcape. And the ſouldiars and captaynes ſtroke them in the edge of the ſword, and caſt them forth: and they went into the citie of the temple of Baal,
label: 4 Kings

text: and brought forth the ſtatue out of Baals temple, and burnt it,
label: 4 Kings

text: and brake it in peeces. They deſtroyed alſo the temple of Baal, and made a iakes for it vntil this day.
label: 4 Kings

text: Iehu therfore deſtroyed Baal out of Iſrael:
label: 4 Kings

text: but yet from the ſinnes of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, who made Iſrael to ſinne, he departed not, neither forſooke he the golden calues, that were in Bethel, and Dan.
label: 4 Kings

text: And our Lord ſayd to Iehu: Becauſe thou haſt diligently done that which was right, and that pleaſed in mine eies, and haſt done al thinges that were in my hart, againſt the houſe of Achab: thy children shal ſitte vpon the throne of Iſrael to the fourth generation.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer Iehu obſerued not to walke in the law of our Lord the God of Iſrael in al his hart: for he departed not from the ſinnes of Ieroboam, who had made Iſrael to ſinne.
label: 4 Kings

text: In thoſe daies our Lord began to be wearie of Iſrael: and Hazael ſmote them in al the coſtes of Iſrael,
label: 4 Kings

text: from Iordan agaynſt the Eaſt quarter, al the land of Galaad, and Gad, and Ruben, and Manaſſes, from Aroer, which is vpon the Torrent Arnon, and Galaad, and Baſan.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Iehu, & al that he did, and his ſtrength, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke of the wordes of the dayes of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Iehu ſlept with his fathers, and they buried him in Samaria: and Ioachaz his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the dayes which Iehu reigned ouer Iſrael, be eight and twentie yeares in Samaria.
label: 4 Kings

text: BVT Athalia the mother of Ochozias ſeing her ſonne dead, aroſe, and ſlew al the kinges ſeede.
label: 4 Kings

text: But Ioſaba king Iorams daughter, the ſiſter of Ochozias, taking Ioas the ſonne of Ochozias, ſtole him out of the middes of the kinges children, that were ſlaine, and his nurce out of the bedchamber: and hid him from the face of Athalia, that he should not be ſlaine.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he was with her ſixe yeares ſecretly in the houſe of our Lord. Moreouer Athalia reigned ouer the land.
label: 4 Kings

text: And in the ſeuenth yeare Ioiada ſent and taking the centurions, and the ſouldiars brought them in to him into the temple of our Lord, and made a couenant with them: and adiuring them in the houſe of our Lord, shewed them the kinges ſonne:
label: 4 Kings

text: and commanded them, ſaying: This is the thing, which you muſt doe.
label: 4 Kings

text: Let the third part of you goe in on the Sabbath, and keepe the watch of the kinges houſe. And let a third part be at the gate Sur: & let a third part be at the gate behind the dwelling of the shildebearers: and you shal keepe the watch of the houſe of Meſſa.
label: 4 Kings

text: But let two partes of you al that goe forth on the Sabbath, keepe the watch of the houſe of our Lord about the king.
label: 4 Kings

text: And you shal gard him round about, hauing weapons in your hands: & if anie man shal enter the precinct of the temple, let him be ſlaine: and you shal be with the king coming in & going out.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the centurions did according to al thinges, that Ioiada the prieſt had commanded them: & euerie one taking their men, that went in on the Sabbath, with them that went out in the Sabbath, came to Ioiada the prieſt.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who gaue them the ſpeares, & the weapons of king Dauid, which were in the houſe of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they ſtood euerie one hauing their weapons in their hand, on the right ſide of the temple, vnto the leaft ſide of the altar, & of the temple, about the king.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he brought forth the kinges ſonne, and put vpon him the diademe, and the couenant: and they made him king, and anoynted him: and clapping with the hand, ſayd: God ſaue the king.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Athalia heard the voice of people running: and she going in to the multitudes into the temple of our Lord,
label: 4 Kings

text: ſaw the king ſtanding vpon the tribunal ſeate according to the maner, and the ſingers, and trumpettes nere him, and al the people of the land reioyſing, and ſounding the trumpettes: and she rent her garmentes, and cried: A conſpiracie, a conſpiracie.
label: 4 Kings

text: But Ioiada commanded the centurions, that were ouer the armie, and ſayd to them: Lead her forth without the precinct of the temple, and whoſoeuer shal folow her, let him be ſtriken with the ſword. For the prieſt had ſayd: Let her not be ſlaine in the temple of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they layd handes on her: and threw her by the way of the entrance of the horſes, beſide the palace, and she was ſlaine there.
label: 4 Kings

text: Ioiada therfore made a couenant betwen our Lord, and the king, and betwen the people, that it should be the people of our Lord, and betwen the king and the people.
label: 4 Kings

text: And al the people of the land entered into the temple of Baal, and deſtroyed his altars, and his images they brake in peces ſtoutly: Mathan alſo the prieſt of Baal thev ſlew before the altar. And the prieſt ſette gardes in the houſe of our Lord,
label: 4 Kings

text: And he tooke the centurious, and the legions of Cerethi and Phelethi, and al the people of the land, and they brought the king from the houſe of our Lord: and they came by the way of the gate of the shildebearers into the palace, and he ſate vpon the throne of the kinges.
label: 4 Kings

text: And al the people of the land reioyſed, and the citie was quiet: but Athalia was ſlaine with the ſword in the kinges houſe.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioas was ſeuen yeares old, when he began to reigne.
label: 4 Kings

text: IN the ſeuenth yeare of Iehu reigned Ioas: and he reigned fourtie yeares in Ieruſalem. The name of his mother was Sebia of Berſabee.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioas did right before our Lord al the daies, that Ioiada the prieſt taught him.
label: 4 Kings

text: But yet the excelſes he tooke not away: for the people immolated & burnt incenſe in the excelſes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioas ſayd to the prieſtes: Al the money of the ſanctified thinges, which is brought into the temple of our Lord by the paſſengers, which is offered for the price of a ſoule, and which of their owne accord, and of their owne free hart they bring into the temple of our Lord:
label: 4 Kings

text: let the prieſtes take it according to their order, and maynteine reparations of the houſe, if they shal ſee any thing that needeth reparation.
label: 4 Kings

text: Therfore vntil the three and twenteth yeare of king Ioas, the prieſtes did not make reparations of the temple.
label: 4 Kings

text: And king Ioas called Ioiada the high prieſt and the prieſtes, ſaying to them: Why make you not the reparations of the temple? Take you therfore money no more according to your order, but render it to the reparation of the temple.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the prieſtes were prohibited to take money anie more of the people, and to make the reparations of the temple.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioiada the high prieſt tooke a treaſurie, and opened a hole in the toppe, and ſette it by the altar at the right hand of them that goe into the houſe of our Lord, and the prieſtes that kept the doores, did caſt into it al the money, that was brought to the temple of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when they ſaw that there was very much money in the treaſurie, the kinges ſcribe, and the high prieſt went vp, and powred it out, and counted the money, that was found in the houſe of our Lord:
label: 4 Kings

text: and they gaue it according to number and meaſure into their hand, which did ouerſee the maſons of the houſe of our Lord: who beſtowed it on carpenters, and on maſons, ſuch as wrought in the houſe of our Lord,
label: 4 Kings

text: and made reparations: and on them that hewed ſtones, and that they should bye trees, and ſtones, that were hewed, ſo that the reparation of the houſe of our Lord was accomplished in al thinges, which had neede of coſt to vphold the houſe.
label: 4 Kings

text: But yet there were not made of the ſame money the watter pottes of the temple of our Lord, and the fleshhookes, and cenſars, and trumpets, and euerie veſſel of gold and ſiluer, of the money, that was brought into the temple of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: For it was geuen them that did the worke, that the temple of our Lord might be repayred:
label: 4 Kings

text: and there was no account made with thoſe men, that receiued the money to diſtribute it to the craftes men, but vpon their fidelitie they beſtowed it.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the money for offence, & the money for ſinnes, they brought not into the temple of our Lord, becauſe it was the prieſtes.
label: 4 Kings

text: Then Hazael the king of Syria went vp, and fought agaynſt Geth, and tooke it: and directed his face to goe vp to Ieruſalem.
label: 4 Kings

text: For which cauſe Ioas the king of Iuda tooke al the ſanctified thinges, which Ioſaphat, and Ioram, and Ochozias his fathers the kinges of Iuda had conſecrated, and which him ſelf had offered: and al the ſiluer, that could be found in the treaſures of the temple of our Lord, and in the kinges palace: and ſent it to Hazael the king of Syria, and he retyred from Ieruſalem.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ioas, and al that he did, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iuda?
label: 4 Kings

text: And his ſeruantes aroſe, and conſpired among them ſelues, and ſtroke Ioas in the houſe of Mello in the deſcent of Sella.
label: 4 Kings

text: For Ioſachar the ſonne of Semaath, and Iozabad the ſonne of Somer his ſeruantes, ſtroke him, and he died: and they buried him with his fathers in the citie of Dauid, and Amaſias his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: IN the three and twenteth yeare of Ioas the ſonne of Ochozias the king of Iuda, reigned Ioachaz the ſonne of Iehu ouer Iſrael in Samaria, ſeuentene yeares.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did euil before our Lord, and folowed the ſinnes of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, who made Iſrael to ſinne, and declined not from them.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the furie of our Lord was wrath agaynſt Iſrael, and he deliuered them into the hand of Hazael the king of Syria, and into the hand of Benadad the ſonne of Hazael, alwaies.
label: 4 Kings

text: But Ioachaz beſought the face of our Lord, and our Lord heard him: for he ſaw the diſtreſſe of Iſrael, that the king of Syria had broken them:
label: 4 Kings

text: and our Lord gaue a ſauiour to Iſrael, and they were deliuered out of the hand of the king of Syria: and the children of Iſrael dwelt in their tabernacles as yeſterday and the day before.
label: 4 Kings

text: But yet they departed not from the ſinnes of Ieroboam who made Iſrael to ſinne, but they walked in them: for the grone alſo remayned in Samaria.
label: 4 Kings

text: And there were leaft to Ioachaz of the people but fiftie horſemen, and ten chariotes, and ten thouſand footmen: for the king of Syria had ſlaine them, and had brought them as duſt by threshing in the barne floore.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ioachaz, and al that he did, and his ſtrength, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioachaz ſlept with his fathers, & they buried him in Samaria: and Ioas his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: In the ſeuen and thirteth yeare of Ioas the king of Iuda reigned Ioas the ſonne of Ioachaz ouer Iſrael in Samaria ſixtene yeares,
label: 4 Kings

text: and he did that which is euil in the ſight of our Lord, he declined not from al the ſinnes of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, who made Iſrael to ſinne, but he walked in them.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ioas, and al that he did, and his ſtrength, how he fought agaynſt Amaſias the king of Iuda, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke of the wordes of the dayes of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioas ſlept with his fathers: but Ieroboam ſate vpon his throne. Moreouer Ioas, was buried in Samaria with the kinges of Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Eliſeus was ſicke of an infirmitie, wherof alſo he died: and Ioas the king of Iſrael went downe to him, and wept before him, and ſayd: My father, my father, the chariote of Iſrael and the garder therof.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Eliſeus ſayd to him: fetch a bow and arrowes. And when he had brought him a bow, and arrowes,
label: 4 Kings

text: he ſayd to the king of Iſrael: Put thy hand vpon the bow. And when he had put his hand, Eliſeus put his handes ouer the kinges handes,
label: 4 Kings

text: and ſayd: Open the eaſt window. And when he had opened it, Eliſeus ſayd: Shote an arrow. And he shot. And Eliſeus ſayd: The arrow of the ſaluation of our Lord, and the arrow of ſaluation agaynſt Syria: and thou shalt ſtrike Syria in Aphec, til thou conſume it.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſayd: Take vp the arrowes. Who when he had taken them agayne, he ſayd to him: Strike the earth with a iauelin. And when he had ſtriken three times, and ſtood ſtil,
label: 4 Kings

text: the man of God was angrie with him, & ſayd: If thou hadſt ſtriken fiue or ſix or ſeuen times, thou hadſt ſtriken Syria euen to deſtruction: but now three times shalt thou ſtrike it.
label: 4 Kings

text: Eliſeus therfore died, and they buried him. And the rouers of Moab came into the land the ſame yeare.
label: 4 Kings

text: And certayne perſons burying a man, ſaw the rouers, and threw the bodie in the ſepulchre of Eliſeus. Which when it had touched the bones of Eliſeus, the man reuiued, and ſtood vpon his feete.
label: 4 Kings

text: Hazael therfore the king of Syria afflicted Iſrael al the daies of Ioachaz:
label: 4 Kings

text: and our Lord had mercie on them, and returned to them for his couenant, which he had with Abraham, and Iſaac, and Iacob: and he would not deſtroy them, nor vtterly caſt them away, vntil this preſent time.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Hazael the king of Syria died, and Benadad his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer Ioas the ſonne of Ioachaz, tooke the cities out of the hand of Benadad the ſonne of Hazael, which he had taken out of the hand of Ioachaz his father by the right of warre, three times did Ioas ſtrike him, and he deliuered the cities to Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: IN the ſecond yeare of Ioas the ſonne of Ioachaz the king of Iſrael reigned Amaſias the ſonne of Ioas the king of Iuda.
label: 4 Kings

text: Fiue and twentie yeares old was he when he began to reigne: and nine and twentie yeares he reigned in Ieruſalem, the name of his mother was Ioadan of Ieruſalem.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did right before our Lord, but yet not as Dauid his father. He did according to al thinges, which Ioas his father did:
label: 4 Kings

text: but this onlie that he tooke not away the excelſes: for yet the people immolated, and burnt incenſe in the excelſes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when he obtayned the kingdom, he ſmote his ſeruantes, which had ſlaine the king his father:
label: 4 Kings

text: but their children that killed him, he did not put to death, according to that which is written in the booke of the law of Moyſes, as our Lord commanded, ſaying: The fathers ſhal not die for the children, neither shal the children die for the fathers: but euerie one shal die in his owne ſinne.
label: 4 Kings

text: He ſmote Edom in the Vail of Salt pittes ten thouſand, and tooke the rocke in battel, and called the name therof, Iectehel vntil this preſent daye.
label: 4 Kings

text: Then Amaſias ſent meſſengers to Ioas the ſonne of Ioachaz, the ſonne of Iehu the king of Iſrael, ſaying: Come, let vs ſee one an other.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioas the king of Iſrael ſent agayne to Amaſias the king of Iuda ſaying: A thiſtle of Libanus ſent to a cedar tree, which is in Libanus, ſaying: Geue thy daughter to my ſonne to wife. And the beaſtes of the foreſt, that are in Libanus, paſſed and trode the thiſtle.
label: 4 Kings

text: Thou ſtriking haſt preuayled ouer Edom, and thy hart hath puffed thee vp: be content with the glorie, and ſit in thy houſe: Why prouokeſt thou euil, that thou mayſt fal and Iuda with thee.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Amaſias agreed not. And Ioas the king of Iſrael went vp, and they ſaw eche other, he and Amaſias the king of Iuda in Bethſames a towne of Iuda.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Iuda was ſtrooken before Iſrael, and euerie man fled into their tabernacles.
label: 4 Kings

text: But Ioas the king of Iſrael did take Amaſias the king of Iuda the ſonne of Ioas, the ſonne of Ochozias, in Bethſames, and brought him into Ieruſalem: and he brake downe the wal of Ieruſalem, from the gate of Ephraim vnto the gate of the corner, fowre hundred cubites.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he tooke al the gold, and ſiluer, and al the veſſel, that were found in the houſe of our Lord, and in the kinges treaſures, and hoſtages, and returned into Samaria.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ioas which he did, and his ſtrength, wherwith he fought againſt Amaſias the king of Iuda, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioas ſlept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kinges of Iſrael: & Ieroboam his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Amaſias the ſonne of Ioas the king of Iuda liued, after that Ioas the ſonne of Ioachaz the king of Iſrael was dead, fifetene yeares.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Amaſias, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iuda?
label: 4 Kings

text: And there was a conſpiracie made againſt him in Ieruſalem: but he fled into Lachis. And they ſent after him into Lachis, and killed him there.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they caried him away vpon horſes, and he was buried in Ieruſalem with his fathers in the Citie of Dauid.
label: 4 Kings

text: And al the people of Iuda tooke Azarias ſixtene yeares old, and made him king for his father Amaſias.
label: 4 Kings

text: He built Aelath, and reſtored it to Iuda, after that the king ſlept with his fathers.
label: 4 Kings

text: In the fifteenth yeare of Amaſias the ſonne of Ioas the king of Iuda, reigned Ieroboam the ſonne of Ioas the king of Iſrael in Samaria, one and fourtie yeares:
label: 4 Kings

text: and he did that which is euil before our Lord. He departed not from al the ſinnes of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, who made Iſrael to ſinne.
label: 4 Kings

text: He reſtored the borders of Iſrael from the entrance of Emath, vnto the Sea of the wilderneſſe, according to the word of our Lord the God of Iſrael, which he ſpake by his ſeruãt Ionas the ſonne of Amathi, the prophete, who was of Geth, which is in Opher.
label: 4 Kings

text: For our Lord ſaw the afliction of Iſrael exceding bitter, and that they werc conſumed vnto the impriſoned & meaneſt perſons, and that there was none to helpe Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: Neither did our Lord determine that he would deſtroy the name of Iſrael from vnder heauen, but he ſaued them in the hand of Ieroboam the ſonne of Ioas.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ieroboam, and al that he did, and his ſtrength, wherwith he fought, and how he reſtored Damaſcus, and Emath to Iuda in Iſrael, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ieroboam ſlept with his fathers the kinges of Iſrael, and Zacharias his ſonne, reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: IN the ſeuen and twenteth yeare of Ieroboam the king of Iſrael reigned Azarias the ſonne of Amaſias the king of Iuda.
label: 4 Kings

text: He was ſixtene yeares old, when he began to reigne, and two and fiftie yeares he reigned in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Iechelia of Ieruſalem,
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did that which was liked before our Lord, according to al thinges that his father Amaſias did.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the excelſes he deſtroyed not: as yet the people ſacrificed, and burnt incenſe in the excelſes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And our Lord ſtroke the king, and he was a leper vntil the day of his death, and he dwelt in a free houſe a part: but Ioathan the kinges ſonne gouerned the palace, and iudged the people of the land.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Azarias, and al that he did, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iuda?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Azarias ſlept with his fathers: and they buried him with his ancetors in the citie of Dauid, and Ioathan his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: In the eight and thirteth yeare of Azarias the king of Iuda, reigned Zacharias the ſonne of Ieroboam ouer Iſrael in Samaria ſixe monethes:
label: 4 Kings

text: and he did that which is euil before our Lord, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the ſinnes of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, who made Iſrael to ſinne.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Sellum the ſonne of Iabes conſpired againſt him: and ſmote him openly, killed him, and reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Zacharias, are not theſe writen in the Booke of the wordes of the dayes of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 4 Kings

text: This is the word of our Lord, which he ſpake to Iehu, ſaying: Thy children shal ſit vnto the fourth generation vpon the throne of Iſrael. And ſo it came to paſſe.
label: 4 Kings

text: Sellum the ſone of Iabes reigned the nine and thirteth yeare of Azarias the king of Iuda: and reigned one moneth in Samaria.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Manahem the ſonne of Gadi went vp from Therſa: and he came into Samaria, and ſmote Sellum the ſonne of Iabes in Samaria, and ſlew him, & reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Sellum, & his conſpiracie, wherwith he wrought treaſon, are not theſe thinges written in the Booke of the wordes of the dayes of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 4 Kings

text: Then Manahem ſtroke Thapſa and al that were in it and the borders therof from Therſa, for they would not open vnio him: and he ſlew al wemen therof that were withchilde, and ripped them.
label: 4 Kings

text: In the nine and thirteth yeare of Azarias the king of Iuda, reigned Manahem the ſonne of Gadi ouer Iſrael ten yeares in Samaria.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did that which was euil before our Lord: he departed not from the ſinnes of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, who made Iſrael to ſinne al his dayes.
label: 4 Kings

text: Phul alſo the king of the Aſſyrians came into the land, and Manahem gaue to Phul a thouſand talentes of ſiluer, that he should ayde him, & eſtablish his kingdom.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Manahem put a taxe of ſiluer vpon Iſrael, on them that were mightie and riche to geue the king of the Aſſyrians, fiftie ſicles of ſiluer euerie man: and the king of the Aſſyrians returned, and taried not in the land.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Manahem, and al that he did, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iſrael?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Manahem ſlept with his fathers: and Phaceia his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: In the fifteth yeare of Azarias the king of Inda reigned Phaceia the ſonne of Manahem ouer Iſrael in Samria two yeares:
label: 4 Kings

text: and he did that which was euil before our Lord: he departed not from the ſinnes of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, who made Iſrael to ſinne.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Phacee the ſonne of Romelia, his captaine conſpired againſt him, and ſtroke him in Samaria, in the towre of the kinges houſe beſide, Argob and beſide Arie, and with him fiftie men of the children of the Galaadites, and he ſlewe him, and reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Phaceia & al that he did, are not theſe things writen in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kings of Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: In the two and fifteth yeares of Azarias the king of Iuda reigned Phacee the ſonne Romelia ouer Iſrael in Samaria twentie yeares.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did that which was euil before our Lord: he departed not from the ſinnes of Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, who made Iſrael to ſinne.
label: 4 Kings

text: In the daies of Phacee the king of Iſrael came Theglathphalaſar the king of Aſſur, & tooke Aion, and Abel the houſe of Maachat and Ianoe, and Cedes, and Aſor, and Galaad, and Galilee, and al the land of Nepthali: and tranſported them vnto the Aſſyrians.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Oſee the ſonne of Ela conſpired, and lay in wayte againſt Phacee the ſonne of Romelia, and ſtroke him, and ſlew him: and he reigned for him the twentith yeare of Ioatham the ſonne of Ozias.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Phacee, and al that he did, are not theſe things written in the Booke of the wordes of the dayes of the kings of Iſrael?
label: 4 Kings

text: In the ſecond yeare of Phacee the ſonne of Romelia the king of Iſrael, reigned Ioatham the ſonne of Ozias the king of Iuda.
label: 4 Kings

text: Fiue and twentie yeares old was he when he began to reigne, and ſixtene yeares he reigned in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Ieruſa, the daughter of Sadoc.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did that which was liked before our Lord: according to al things, which Ozias his father had done, did he worke.
label: 4 Kings

text: Howbeit the excelſes he tooke not away: as yet the people immolated, and burnt incenſe in the excelſes, he built the higheſt gate of the houſe of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ioatham, and al that he did, are not theſe things written in the Booke of the words of the dayes of the kings of Iuda?
label: 4 Kings

text: In thoſe dayes our Lord began to ſend into Iuda Raſin the king of Syria, and Phacee the ſonne of Romelia.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioatham ſlept with his fathers, and was buried with them in the citie of Dauid his father, and Achaz his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: IN the ſeuenteth yeare of Phacee the ſonne of Romelia reigned Achaz the ſonne of Ioatham king of Iuda.
label: 4 Kings

text: Twentie yeares old was Achaz when he began to reigne, and he reigned ſixtene yeares in Ieruſalem: he did not that which was pleaſing in the ſight of our Lord his God, as Dauid his father.
label: 4 Kings

text: But he walked in the way of the kings of Iſrael: moreouer alſo he conſecrated his ſonne, making him paſſe through fire according to the idols of the Gentils: which our Lord deſtroyed before the children of Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: He immolated alſo victimes, and burnt incenſe in the excelſes, and on the hilles, and vnder euery tree full of greene leaues.
label: 4 Kings

text: Then went vp Raſin the king of Syria, and Phacee the ſonne of Romelia the king of Iſrael into Ieruſalem to fight: & when they beſieged Achaz, they were not able to ouercome him.
label: 4 Kings

text: At that time Raſin the king of Syria reſtored Aila to Syria, and threw out the Iewes out of Aila: and the Idumeians came into Aila, and dwelt there vnto this day.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Achaz ſent meſſengers to Theglathphalaſar the king of the Aſſyrians, ſaying; I am thy ſeruant, and thy ſonne: come vp, and ſaue me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and from the hand of the king of Iſrael, which are riſen together againſt me.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when he had gathered together the ſiluer and gold, that could be founde in the houſe of our Lord, and in the kings treaſures, he ſent giftes to the king of the Aſſyrians.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who alſo agreed to his wil: for the king of the Aſſyrians went vp into Damaſcus, and waſted it: and he transferred the inhabitants therof to Cyrene, but Raſin he ſlew.
label: 4 Kings

text: And king Achaz went forth to meete Theglathphalaſar the king of the Aſſyrians into Damaſcus, and when he had ſeene the altar of Damaſcus, king Achaz ſent to Vrias the prieſt a paterne of it, and a ſimilitude according to al the worke therof.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Vrias the prieſt built an altar, according to al things, which king Achaz had commanded, from Damaſcus, ſo did the prieſt Vrias, whileſt king Achaz came from Damaſcus.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when the king was come from Damaſcus, he ſaw the altar and worshipped it: and went vp and immolated holocauſtes, and his ſacrifice,
label: 4 Kings

text: and offered libamentes, and powred the bloud of the pacifiques, which he had offered vpon the altar.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer the altar of braſſe that was before our lord, he remoued from the face of the temple, and from the place of the altar, and from the place of the temple of our Lord: and he ſett it at the ſide of the altar toward the North.
label: 4 Kings

text: King Achaz alſo comanded Vrias the prieſt, ſaying: Vpon the greater altar offer the morning holocauſt, and the euening ſacrifice, and the kings holocauſt, and his ſacrifice, and the holocauſt of the whole people of the land, and their ſacrifices, and their libamentes: and al the bloud of the holocauſt, and al the bloud of the victime thou shalt powre out vpon it: but the altar of braſſe shalbe prepared readie at my pleaſure
label: 4 Kings

text: Vrias therfore the prieſt did according to al things, which king Achaz had commanded him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And king Achaz tooke the engrauen feete, and the lauatorie that was vpon them: and he tooke downe the ſea from the oxen of braſſe, that held it vp, and put it vpon the pauement paued with ſtone.
label: 4 Kings

text: The Muſach alſo of the Sabbath, which he had built in the temple: and the entrie of the king outward, he turned into the temple of our Lord becauſe of the king of the Aſſyrians.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Achaz, which he did, are not theſe writen in the Booke of the wordes of the dayes of the kinges of Iuda?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Achaz ſlept with his fathers, and was buried with them in the citie of Dauid, and Ezechias his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: IN the twelfth yeare of Achaz king of Iuda, reigned Oſee the ſonne of Ela in Samaria ouer Iſrael nine yeares.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did euil before our Lord: but not as the kinges of Iſrael, that had bene before him.
label: 4 Kings

text: Againſt him came vp Salmanaſar king of the Aſſyrians, and Oſee was made ſeruant to him, and payd him tributes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when the king of the Aſſyrians had found, that Oſee endeuoring to rebel had ſent meſſengers to Sua the king of Ægypt, that he might not pay tributes to the king of the Aſſyrians, as euery yeare he was accuſtomed, he beſieged him, and caſt him blound into priſon.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ranged through al the land: and going vp to Samaria, he beſieged it three yeares.
label: 4 Kings

text: And in the ninth yeare of Oſee, the king of Aſſyrians tooke Samaria, and transferred Iſrael vnto the Aſſyrians: and he put them in Hala, and in Habor beſide the riuer of Gozan, in the cities of the Medes.
label: 4 Kings

text: For it came to paſſe, when the children of Iſrael had ſinned to our Lord their God, which brought them out of the land of Ægypt, and out of the hand of Pharao the king of Ægypt, they worshipped ſtrange goddes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they walked according to the rite of the Gentiles, which our Lord had conſumed in the ſight of the children of Iſrael, and of the kings of Iſrael: becauſe they had done in like maner.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the children of Iſrael offended our Lord their God with wordes not right: & built them excelſes in al their cities from the Towre of watchmen vnto the fenſed citie.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they made them ſtatues & groues on euerie high hil, and vnder euerie thicke woddie tree:
label: 4 Kings

text: and burnt there incenſe vpon the altars after the maner of the Gentiles, which our Lord remoued from their face: and they did wicked things, prouoking our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they worshipped the filthes, wherof our Lord commanded them, that thou ſhould not doe this thing.
label: 4 Kings

text: And our Lord teſtified in Iſrael and in Iuda by the hand of al the Prophetes and Seers, ſaying: Returne from your moſt wicked wayes, and keepe my precepts, and ceremonies according to al the law, which I commanded your fathers: and as I haue ſent to you in the hand of my ſeruantes the Prophetes.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who heard not, but hardened their necke according to the necke of their fathers, who would not obey our Lord their God.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they caſt away his ordinances, and the couenant that he made with their fathers, and the teſtifications, wherwith he conteſted them: and they folowed vanities, and did vaynly: and they folowed the Gentiles, that were round about them, concerning which our Lord had commanded them, that they ſhould not doe as they did.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they forſooke al the preceptes of our Lord their God: and made to them ſelues two molten calues, and groues, and adored al the hoſte of heauen: and they ſerued Baal,
label: 4 Kings

text: and conſecrated their ſonnes, and their daughters through fyre: and they gaue themſelues to deuinations, and ſoothſayings: and they deliuered vp themſelues to doe euil before our Lord, that they might prouoke him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And our Lord was wrath with Iſrael vehemently, and tooke them away from his ſight, and there remayned but the tribe of Iuda onlie.
label: 4 Kings

text: But neither Iuda it ſelf kept the commandementes of our Lord their God: but walked in the errours of Iſrael, which it had wrought.
label: 4 Kings

text: And our Lord reiected al the ſeede of Iſrael, and afflicted them, & deliuered them into the hand of the ſpoylers, til he threwe them away from his face:
label: 4 Kings

text: euen now from that time, when Iſrael was rent from the houſe of Dauid, and made Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat their king: for Ieroboam ſeperated Iſrael from our Lord, and made them ſinne a great ſinne.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the children of Iſrael walked in al the ſinnes of Ieroboam, which he had done: and they departed not from them,
label: 4 Kings

text: vntil our Lord tooke away Iſrael from his face, as he had ſpoken in the hand of al his ſeruantes the Prophetes: and Iſrael was tranſported out of their land vnto the Aſſyrians, vntil this day.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king of the Aſſyrians brought from Babylon, and from Cutha, and from Auah, and from Emath, and from Sepharuaim: and placed them in the cities of Samaria for the children of Iſrael: who poſſeſſed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities therof.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when they began to dwel there, they feared not our Lord: and our Lord ſent lions vpon them, which killed them.
label: 4 Kings

text: And it was told the king of the Aſſyrians, and ſayd. The nations, which thou haſt transferred, and made to dwel in the cities of Samaria, know not the ordinances of the God of the land: and the Lord hath ſent lions vpon them: and behold they kil them, for that they know not the rite of the God of the land.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king of the Aſſyrians commanded, ſaying: Bring thither one of the prieſtes, which you brought thence captiue, and let him goe, and dwel with them: and let him teach them the ordinances of the God of the land.
label: 4 Kings

text: Therfore when one of thoſe prieſts, which were led captiue from Samaria, was come, he dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should worship our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And euerie Nation framed their owne god, and put them in the highe temples, which the Samaritanes had made, Nation and Nation in their cities, where they dwelt.
label: 4 Kings

text: For the men of Babylon made Socothbenoth: and the Cutheites made Nergel: and the men of Emath made Aſima.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer the Heueites made Nebahaz & Tharthac. And they that were of Sepharuaim burnt their children in fyre, to Adramelech, and Anamelech the goddes of Sepharuaim.
label: 4 Kings

text: and neuetheles they worshipped our Lord. And they made to themſelues of the vileſt perſones prieſtes of the excelſes, and they placed them in the highe temples.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when they worſhipped our Lord, they ſerued alſo their owne goddes according to the cuſtome of the Nations out of the which they were tranſported to Samaria:
label: 4 Kings

text: vntil this preſent day they folow the old maner: they feare not our Lord, neither keepe they his ceremonies, and iudgementes, and law, and the commandemet, which our Lord commanded the children of Iacob, whom he ſurnamed Iſrael:
label: 4 Kings

text: and he had made a couenant with them, & had commanded them, ſaying: Feare not ſtrange goddes, and adore them not, neither worſhip them, and immolate not to them.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the Lord your God, which brought you out of the Land of Ægypt in great ſtrength, and a ſtretched out arme, him feare ye, and him adore, and to him doe ye immolate.
label: 4 Kings

text: The ceremonies alſo, and iudgementes, and law, and the commandment, that he wrote you, kepe ye, that you may doe them alwaies: and feare not ſtrange goddes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the couenant, that he made with you, forget not: neither doe ye worſhip ſtrange goddes,
label: 4 Kings

text: but feare our Lord your God, and he wil deliuer you out of the hand of al your enemies.
label: 4 Kings

text: But they heard not, but did according to their old cuſtome.
label: 4 Kings

text: Theſe Nations therfore were fearing of our Lord but neuertheleſſe ſeruing their idols alſo: for both their children and nephewes, as their fathers did, ſoe doe they vntil this preſent day.
label: 4 Kings

text: IN the third yeare of Oſee the ſonne of Ela king of Iſrael, reigned Ezechias the ſonne of Achaz king of Iuda.
label: 4 Kings

text: Fiue and twentie yeares old was he when he began to reigne: and he reigned nine and twentie yeares in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Abi the daughter of Zacharias.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did that which was good before our Lord, according to al thinges which Dauid his father had done.
label: 4 Kings

text: He deſtroyed the excelſes, and brake the ſtatuees in peeces, and cut downe the groues, and brake the braſen ſerpent, which Moyſes had made: for vntil that time the children of Iſrael burnt incenſe to it: and he called the name therof Noheſtan.
label: 4 Kings

text: He truſted in our Lord the God of Iſrael: therfore after him there was not the like to him in al the kings of Iuda, yea neither among them that were before him:
label: 4 Kings

text: and he cleaued to our Lord, and departed not from his ſteppes, and he did his commandmentes, which our Lord commanded Moyſes.
label: 4 Kings

text: Wherfore our Lord alſo was with him, and in al things, to the which he proceded, he behaued himſelfe wiſely. He rebelled alſo agaynſt the king of the Aſſyrians, and ſerued him not.
label: 4 Kings

text: He ſtroke the Philiſthians as farre as Gaza, & al the borders, from the Towre of watchmen vnto the fenſed citie.
label: 4 Kings

text: In the fourth yeare of king Ezechias, which was the ſeuenth yeare of Oſee the ſonne of Ela the king of Iſrael, came vp Salmanaſar the king of the Aſſyrians into Samaria, and aſſaulted it,
label: 4 Kings

text: and tooke it. For after three yeares, in the ſixt yeare of Ezechias, that is, the ninth yeare of Oſee the king of Iſrael, Samaria was taken:
label: 4 Kings

text: and the king of the Aſſyrians tranſported Iſrael vnto the Aſſyrians, and placed them in Hala, and in Habor riuers of Gozan in the cities of the Medes:
label: 4 Kings

text: becauſe they heard not the voice of our Lord their God, but tranſgreſſed his couenant: al things, that Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord commanded, they heard not, neither did they it.
label: 4 Kings

text: In the fourtenth yeare of king Ezechias, came vp Sennacherib the king of Aſſyrians to al the fenſed cities of Iuda: and tooke them.
label: 4 Kings

text: Then ſent Ezechias the king of Iuda meſſengers to the king of the Aſſyrians into Lachis, ſaying: I haue ſinned, retyre from me: and al that thou shalt put vpon me, I will beare. Therfore the king of the Aſſyrians put a taxe vpon Ezechias the king of Iuda, three hundred talents of ſiluer, and thirtie talents of gold.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ezechias gaue al the ſiluer that was found in the houſe of our Lord, and in the kinges treaſures.
label: 4 Kings

text: At that time Ezechias brake the doores of the temple of our Lord, and the plates of gold, which he had faſtened on them, and gaue them to the king of the Aſſyrians.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the king of the Aſſyrias ſent Tharthan, and Rabſaris, and Rabſaces from Lachis to king Ezechias with a ſtrong powre to Ieruſalem: who when they were come vp they came to Ieruſalem, and ſtoode beſide the conduite of the vpper poole, which is in the way of the fullers field.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they called the king: and there went out to them Eliacim the ſonne of Helcias gouernour of the houſe and Sobna the Scribe and Ioahe the ſonne of Aſaph, the regiſter,
label: 4 Kings

text: And Rabſaces ſayd to them: Speake to Ezechias: Thus ſayth the great king, the king of Aſſyrians: What is this confidence, that thou doeſt ſtay vpon?
label: 4 Kings

text: Perhaps thou haſt taken counſel, to prepare thy ſelfe to battle. Wherin haſt thou confidence, that thou dareſt to rebel?
label: 4 Kings

text: Doſt thou hope in Ægypt a ſtaffe of reede and broken, vpon which if a man leane, broken into ſplinters it wil enter into his hand, and pearce it? ſo is Pharao the king of Ægypt, to al that haue confidence in him.
label: 4 Kings

text: But if you wil ſay to me: We haue confidence in our Lord God: is not this he, whoſe excelſes and altars Ezechias hath taken away: and he commanded Iuda and Ieruſalem: Before this altar shal you adore in Ieruſalem?
label: 4 Kings

text: Now therfore paſſe to my lord the king of the Aſſyrians, and I wil geue you two thouſand horſes, and ſee whether you be able to haue ryders for them.
label: 4 Kings

text: And how can you reſiſte before one prince of the leaſt ſeruantes of my lord? Haſt thou confidence in Ægypt for the chariotes and horſemen?
label: 4 Kings

text: Why am I come vp without the wil of the Lord to deſtroy it? The Lord ſayd to me: Goe vp to this land, and deſtroy it.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Eliacim the ſonne of Helcias, and Sobna, and Ioahe ſayd to Rabſaces: We pray thee that thou ſpeake to vs thy ſeruantes in Syryake: for we vnderſtand this tongue: and ſpeake not to vs in the Iewes language, the people hearing it, which is vpon the wal.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Rabſaces anſwered them, ſaying: What did my lord ſend me to thee, that I should ſpeake theſe wordes, and not rather to the men that ſit vpon the wal, that they may eate their owne dung, and drinke their vrine with you?
label: 4 Kings

text: Rabſaces therfore ſtood, and cryed out with a lowd voyce in the Iewes language, and ſayd: Heare ye the wordes of the great king, the king of the Aſſyrians.
label: 4 Kings

text: Thus ſayth the king: Let not Ezechias ſeduce you: for he shal not be able to deliuer you out my hand.
label: 4 Kings

text: Neither let him geue you confidence vpon the Lord, ſaying: Our Lord deliuering wil deliuer vs, and this citie shal not be geuen into the hand of the king of the Aſſyrians.
label: 4 Kings

text: Doe not heare Ezechias. For thus ſayth the king of the Aſſyrians: Doe with me that which is profitable for you, and come forth to me: and euery man ſhal eate of his vineyard, and of his figge tree: and you shal drinke waters of your owne ceſternes,
label: 4 Kings

text: til I come, and tranſporte you into a land, that is like to your land, into a fruiteful land, and plentiful of wyne, a land of bread and of vineyardes, a land of oliuetes, and of oyle and honie, and you shal liue, and shal not die. Heare not Ezechias, who deceiueth you, ſaying: Our Lord wil deliuer vs.
label: 4 Kings

text: Did the goddes of Nations deliuer their land from the hand of the king of Aſſyrians?
label: 4 Kings

text: Where is the God of Emath & Arphad? Where is the God of Sepharuaim, of Ana, and Aua? did they deliuer Samaria out of my hand?
label: 4 Kings

text: What are they among al the goddes of nations, which haue deliuered their countrey out of my hand, that the Lord can deliuer Ieruſalem out of my hand?
label: 4 Kings

text: The people therfore held their peace, and did not anſwer him any thing: for they had receiued the kings commandement that they should not anſwer him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Eliacim the ſonne of Helcias, gouernour of the houſe, and Sobna the ſcribe, and Ioahe the ſonne of Aſaph regiſter came to Ezechias, their garments rent, and told him the wordes of Rabſaces.
label: 4 Kings

text: VVHICH thinges when Ezechias the king had heard, he rent his garmentes, and was couered with ſackcloth, and entered into the houſe of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſent Eliacim the gouernour of the houſe, and Sobna the ſcribe, and the ancientes of the prieſtes couered with ſackclothes, to Iſaias the prophete the ſonne of Amos.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who ſayd to him: Thus ſaith Ezechias: This day is a day of tribulation, and rebuke, and of blaſphemie: the children are come to the birth, and the woman in trauel hath not ſtrength.
label: 4 Kings

text: If perhaps our Lord thy God wil heare al the wordes of Rabſaces, whom the king of the Aſſyrians his maiſter hath ſent to vpbrayd the liuing God, and reproue with wordes, which our Lord thy God hath heard: and make thou prayer for the remnantes that are found.
label: 4 Kings

text: The ſeruantes therfore of king Ezechias came to Iſaie.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Iſaie ſayd to them: Thus shal you ſay to your maiſter: Thus ſayth our Lord: Feare not for the wordes, which thou haſt heard, with which the ſeruantes of the king of the Aſſyrians haue blaſphemed me.
label: 4 Kings

text: Behold I wil ſend into him a ſpirit, and he shal here a meſſage, and shal returne into his country, and I wil ouerthrow him with the ſword in his country.
label: 4 Kings

text: Rabſaces therfore returned, and found the king of Aſſyrians expugning Lobna: for he heard that he was departed from Lachis.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when he had heard of Tharaca the king of Æthiopia, ſaying: Behold, he is come forth to fight agaynſt thee: and went agaynſt him, he ſent meſſengers to Ezechias, ſaying:
label: 4 Kings

text: Say this to Ezechias the king of Iuda: Let not thy God ſeduce thee, in whom thou haſt confidence: neither ſay thou: Ieruſalem shal not be deliuered into the handes of the king of the Aſſyrians.
label: 4 Kings

text: For thou thy ſelf haſt heard what the kinges of the Aſſyrians haue done to al the countries, how they haue ſpoyled them: canſt thou therfore onlie be deliuered?
label: 4 Kings

text: Why haue the goddes of the Nations deliuered al thoſe, whom my fathers haue deſtroyed, to witte, Gozan, & Haran, and Reſeph, and the children of Eden, which were in Thelaſſar?
label: 4 Kings

text: Where is the king of Emath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the citie of Sepharuaim, of Ana and Aua?
label: 4 Kings

text: Therfore when Ezechias had receiued the letters of the hand of meſſengers, & had read them, he went vp into the houſe of our Lord, & layd them open before our Lord,
label: 4 Kings

text: & prayd in his ſight, ſaying: Lord God of Iſrael, which ſitteſt vpon the cherubins, thou art the only God of al the kinges of the earth: thou madeſt heauen and earth:
label: 4 Kings

text: Incline thine eare, and heare: open Lord thine eies, and ſee: and heare al the wordes of Sennacherib, who hath ſent to vpbrayd vnto vs the liuing God.
label: 4 Kings

text: In verie deede Lord, the kinges of the Aſſyrians haue deſtroyed Nations, and the countries of al.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they haue caſt their goddes into fire: for they were not goddes, but the workes of mens handes of wood and ſtone, and they deſtroyed them.
label: 4 Kings

text: Now therfore O Lord our God, ſaue vs from his hand, that al the kingdomes of the earth may know, that thou art the Lord the onlie God.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Iſaie the ſonne of Amos ſent to Ezechias, ſaying: Thus ſaith our Lord the God of Iſrael: That which thou haſt beſought me concerning Sennacherib the king of the Aſſyrians, I haue heard.
label: 4 Kings

text: This is the word, that our Lord hath ſpoken of him: The virgine daughrer of Sion hath diſpiſed thee, and ſcorned thee: Behinde thy backe hath the daughter of Ieruſalem wagged her head.
label: 4 Kings

text: Whom haſt thou vpbrayded, and whom haſt thou blaſphemed? againſt whom haſt thou exalted thy voice, and lifted vp thine eies in high? againſt the holie one of Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: By the hand of thy ſeruantes thou haſt vpbrayded our Lord, and haſt ſayd: In the multitude of my chatiotes haue I climed the height of mouutaynes, in the toppe of Libanus, and haue cut downe high cedars therof, and the choſen firretrees of it. And I haue entered into the borders therof, & the forreſt of the carmel therof haue I cut downe.
label: 4 Kings

text: And I haue drunke ſtrange waters, and haue dried vp with the ſteppes of my feete al the waters incloſed.
label: 4 Kings

text: Why, haſt thou not heard what I haue done from the begining? From ancient daies I haue made that thing, and now I haue brought it to effect: and fenſed cities shal be into ruine of litle hilles bickering together.
label: 4 Kings

text: And they that ſitte in them, weake of hand, they haue trembled and are confounded, they became as the graſſe of the field, and the greene herbe of the roofes of houſes, which withered before it came to ripeneſſe.
label: 4 Kings

text: Thy habitation, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy waye I haue knowen before, & thy furie againſt me.
label: 4 Kings

text: Thou haſt bene madde againſt me, & thy pride hath aſcended into myn eares: I therfore wil put a ring in thy noſtrels, and a bitte in thy lippes, and wil bring thee back into the way, by the which thou cameſt.
label: 4 Kings

text: And to thee Ezechias this shal be a ſigne: Eate this yeare what thou shalt finde: & in the ſecond yeare, the things that growe of themſelues: moreouer in the third yeare ſawe ye and reape: plant ye vineyardes, and eate the fruite of them.
label: 4 Kings

text: And whatſoeuer shal be leaft of the houſe of Iuda, shal take roote downeward, and beare fruit vpward.
label: 4 Kings

text: For out of Ieruſalem there ſhal remmantes goe forth, and that which is to be ſaued from the mounte of Sion: the zeale of the Lord of hoſtes shal doe this.
label: 4 Kings

text: Wherfore thus ſayth our Lord of the king of the Aſſyrians: He shal not enter into this citie, nor ſhoote arrowe into it, neither shal shield occupie it, nor munition compaſſe it.
label: 4 Kings

text: By the way, that he came, he shal returne: and into this citie he shal nos enter, ſayth our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And I wil protect this citie. and wil ſaue it for my ſelf, and for Dauid my ſeruant.
label: 4 Kings

text: It came to paſſe therfore in that night, an Angel of our Lord came, and ſtroke in the campe of the Aſſyrians an hundred eightie fiue thouſand. And when he was riſen early, he ſawe al the bodies of the dead,
label: 4 Kings

text: and Sennacherib the king of the Aſſyrians departing went away, and taried in Niniue.
label: 4 Kings

text: And when he adored in the temple of Neſroch his god, Adramelech and Saraſar his ſonnes ſtroke him with the ſword, and they fled into the land of the Armenians, and Aſarhaddon his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: IN thoſe dayes Ezechias was ſick euen to death: and Iſaie the ſonne of Amos the prophete, came and ſayd to him: Thus ſayth our Lord God: Take order with thy houſe, for thou shalt die, and shalt not liue.
label: 4 Kings

text: Who turned his face to the wal, and prayed our Lord, ſaying:
label: 4 Kings

text: I beſech thee Lord, remember I pray thee how I haue walked before thee in truth, and in a perfect hart, and haue done that which is liked before thee. Ezechias therfore wept with great weeping.
label: 4 Kings

text: And before Iſaie was gone out of the middes of the court, the word of our Lord came to him, ſaying:
label: 4 Kings

text: Returne, and tel Ezechias the prince of my people: Thus ſayth our Lord the God of Dauid thy father: I haue heard thy prayer, and ſeene thy teares: and behold I haue healed thee, the third day thou shalt goe vp to the temple of the Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And I wil adde to thy daies fiftene yeares: yea & out of the hand of the king of Aſſyrians I wil deliuer thee, and this citie, & I wil protect this citie for my ſake, and for Dauid my ſeruant.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Iſaie ſaid: Fetch me a bunch of figges. Which when they had brought, and had layd it vpon his ſore, he was cured.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ezechias had ſayd to Iſaie: What ſigne shal there be, that our Lord wil heale me, and that I shal goe vp the third day to the temple of our Lord?
label: 4 Kings

text: To whom Iſaie ſayd: This shal be the ſigne from our Lord, that our lord wil doe the word, which he hath ſpoken: Wilt thou that the shadow goe forward ten lines, or that it goe backe ſoe many degrees.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ezechias ſayd: It is an eaſie matter for the shadow to goe forward ten lines, neither wil I that this be done, but that it returne back ten degrees.
label: 4 Kings

text: Iſaie therfore the prophet inuocated our Lord, and brought backe the ſhadow by the lines, by the which it was now gone downe in the dial of Achaz, backward ten degrees.
label: 4 Kings

text: In that time Berodach Baladan, the ſonne of Baladan, the king of the Babilonians ſent letters and giftes to Ezechias: for he had heard that Ezechias had bene ſicke.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ezechias reioyſed in their coming, and he shewed them the houſe of aromatical ſpices, and gold and ſiluer, and diuerſe precious, odours, oyntementes alſo, and the houſe of his veſſels, and al that he had in his treaſures. There was not any thing which Ezechias shewed them, not in his houſe, and in al his powre.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Iſaie the prophete came to king Ezechias, and ſayd to him: What ſayd theſe men? or from whence came they to thee? To whom Ezechias ſaid: From a far counttie they came to me out of Babylon.
label: 4 Kings

text: But he anſwered: What ſaw they in thy houſe? Ezechias ſayd: They ſaw al things whatſoeuer are in my houſe: there is nothing that I haue not shewed them in my treaſures.
label: 4 Kings

text: Iſaie therfore ſaid to Ezechias, heare the word of our Lord:
label: 4 Kings

text: Behold the daies shal come, & al things shal be taken away, that are in thy houſe, and that thy fathers haue layd vp vntil this day, into Babylon: there shal not anie thing remayne, ſayth our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: Yea of the children alſo that come forth of thee, whom thou shalt beget shalbe taken away, and they shal be eunuches in the palace of the king of Babylon.
label: 4 Kings

text: Ezechias ſaid to Iſaie: The word of our Lord which thou haſt ſpoken is good: be there peace and truth in my daies.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ezechias, and al his ſtrength, and how he made a poole, and a conduite, and brought waters in to the citie, are not theſe things writen in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iuda?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ezechias ſlept with his fathers, and Manaſſes his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: TWELVE yeares old was Manaſſes, when he began to reigne, & he reigned fiue and fiftie yeares in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was haphſiba.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did euil in the ſight of our Lord, acording to the idols of the Nations, which our Lord deſtroyed from the face of the children of Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he was turned, and built the excelſes, which Ezechias his father had deſtroyed: and he ſette vp altars to Baal, and made groues, as Achab the king of Iſrael had done: and he adored al the hoſt of heauen, and worshipped it.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he built altars in the houſe of our Lord, of the which our Lord ſayd: In Ieruſalem I wil put my name.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he built altars to al the hoſt of heauen in the two courtes of the temple of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he made his ſonne paſſe through fyre: and he vſed ſoothſaying, and obſerued diuinations, and made pithones, and multiplied inchanters, to doe euil before our Lord, and to prouoke him.
label: 4 Kings

text: He ſette alſo the idol of the groue, which he had made in the temple of our Lord: concerning the which our Lord ſpake to Dauid, and to Salomon his ſonne: In this temple, and in Ieruſalem, which I haue choſen out of al the tribes of Iſrael, I wil put my name for euer.
label: 4 Kings

text: And I wil noe more make the foote of Iſrael to be moued out of the land, which I gaue to their fathers: yet ſo if in worke they shal keepe al things, that I haue commanded them, al the law which my ſeruantes Moyſes commanded them.
label: 4 Kings

text: But they heard not: but were ſeduced by Manaſſes, to doe euil aboue the Nations, which our Lord deſtroyed before the face of the children of Iſrael.
label: 4 Kings

text: And our Lord ſpake in the hand of his ſeruantes the prophetes, ſaying:
label: 4 Kings

text: Becauſe Manaſſes the king of Iuda hath done theſe moſt wicked abominations, paſſing al thinges that the Amorrheites did before him, and hath made Iuda alſo to ſinne in his filthes:
label: 4 Kings

text: therfore thus ſayth our Lord the God of Iſrael: Behold I wil bring in euils vpon Ieruſalem and Iuda: that whoſoeuer shal heare it, both his eares shal tingle.
label: 4 Kings

text: And I wil ſtretch out vpon Ieruſalem the corde of Samaria, and the weight of the houſe of Achab: and I wil wipe out Ieruſalem, as tables are wont to be wiped out, and wyping out I wil turne it, and draw often the pencil vpon the face therof.
label: 4 Kings

text: But I wil leaue remnantes of mine inheritance, and wil deliuer them into the handes of their enemies: and they shalbe vnto waſte, and vnto ſpoile to al their aduerſaries:
label: 4 Kings

text: becauſe they haue done euil before me, and haue continewed prouoking me, from the day that their fathers came out of Ægypt, vntil this day.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer Manaſſes shed alſo innocent bloud exceding much til he filled Ieruſalem euen to the mouth: beſide his ſinnes, wherin he made Iuda to ſinne, to doe euil before our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Manaſſes, and al that he did, and his ſinne, which he ſinned, are not theſe thinges written in the Booke of the wordes of the dayes of the kinges of Iuda?
label: 4 Kings

text: And Manaſſes ſlept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his houſe, in the garden of Oza: and Amon his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: Two and twentie yeares old was Amon when he began to reigne: two yeares alſo he reigned in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Meſſalemeth the daughter of Ieteba.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did euil in the ſight of our Lord, as Manaſſes his father had done.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he walked in al the way, by the which his father had walked: and he ſerued the filthes, which his father had ſerued, and he adored them,
label: 4 Kings

text: and forſooke our Lord the God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And his ſeruantes lay in wayte agaynſt him, and ſlewe the king in his houſe.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the people of the land ſtroke al them, that had conſpired agaynſt king Amon: and made Ioſias his ſonne their king for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Amon which he did, are not theſe writen in the Booke of the wordes of the dayes of the kinges of Iuda?
label: 4 Kings

text: And they buried him in his ſepulchre, in the garden of Oza: and Ioſias his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: EIGHT yeares old was Ioſias when he began to reigne, he reigned one and thirtie yeares in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Idida, the daughter of Hadaia of Beſecath.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did that which was liked before our Lord, and walked in al the waies of Dauid his father: he declined not to the right hand, or to the lefte.
label: 4 Kings

text: And in the eightenth yeare of king Ioſias, the king ſent Saphan the ſonne of Aſlia, the ſonne of Meſſulam, the ſcribe of the temple of our Lord, ſaying to him:
label: 4 Kings

text: Goe to Helcias the high prieſt, that the money may be gathered into a ſumme, which hath beene brought into the temple of our Lord, which the porters of the temple haue gathered of the people,
label: 4 Kings

text: and let it be geuen to the workemen by the ouerſeers of the houſe of our Lord: who alſo shal deſtribute it to them that worke in the temple of our Lord, to make the reparations of the temple:
label: 4 Kings

text: that is, to the carpenters and maſons, and to them that mend broken places: and that timber may be bought, and ſtones out of the quarries to repayre the temple of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: Yet let not the money which they receiue be accounted to them, but let them haue it in their powre, and vpon their fidelitie.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Helcias the highe prieſt ſayd to Saphan the ſcribe: I haue found the Booke of the law in the houſe of our Lord: and Helcias gaue the volume to Saphan, who alſo did reade it.
label: 4 Kings

text: Saphan alſo the ſcribe came to the king, and reported vnto him that which he had commanded, and ſayd: Thy ſeruantes haue gathered into a ſumme the money, which is found in the houſe of our Lord: and they haue geuen it to be deſtributed to the workemen, by the ouerſeers of the workes of the temple of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: Saphan alſo the ſcribe told the king, ſaying: Helcias the prieſt hath geuen me a Booke. Which when Saphan had read before the king,
label: 4 Kings

text: and the king had heard the wordes of the law of our Lord, he rent his garmentes.
label: 4 Kings
