text: And he willed Helcias the prieſt, and Ahicam the ſonne of Saphan, and Achobor the ſonne of Micha, and Saphan the Scribe, and Aſaia the kinges ſeruant, ſaying:
label: 4 Kings

text: Goe and conſult our Lord for me, and for the people, and for al Iuda, concerning the wordes of this volume, which is found: for the great wrath of our Lord is kindled agaynſt vs: becauſe our fathers haue not heard the wordes of this Booke, to doe al that is writen for vs.
label: 4 Kings

text: Helcias therfore the prieſt, and Ahicam, and Achabor, and Saphan, and Aſaia went to Holda a propheteſſe the wife of Sellum the ſonne of Thecua, the ſonne of Araas keeper of the garmentes, who dwelt in Ieruſalem in the ſecond: and they ſpake to her.
label: 4 Kings

text: And she anſwered them: Thus ſayth our Lord the God of Iſrael: Tel the man, that ſent you to me:
label: 4 Kings

text: Thus ſayth our Lord: Behold, I wil bring euils vpon this place, and vpon the inhabitantes therof, al the wordes of the law which the king of Iuda hath read:
label: 4 Kings

text: becauſe they haue forſaken me, and haue ſacrificed to ſtrange goddes, prouoking me in al the workes of their handes: and my indignation shal be kindled in this place, and shal not be quenched.
label: 4 Kings

text: But to the king of Iuda, that ſent you to conſult our lord, thus you shal ſay: Thus ſayth our Lord the God of Iſrael: For that thou haſt heard the wordes of the volume,
label: 4 Kings

text: and thy hart is ſtriken with feare, and thou art humbled before the Lord, hearing the wordes agaynſt this place, and the inhabitantes therof, to witte that they should become a wonder and a curſe: and haſt rent thy garmentes, and wept before me, and I haue heard it, ſayth our Lord:
label: 4 Kings

text: therfore I wil gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy ſepulchre in peace, that thy eies may not ſee al the euils, which I wil bring in vpon this place.
label: 4 Kings

text: AND they reported to the king that which she had ſayd. Who ſent: and al the ancientes of Iuda and Ieruſalem were aſſembled to him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king went vp to the temple of our Lord, and al the men of Iuda, and al that dwelt in Ieruſalem with him prieſtes and prophetes, and al the people from litle to great: and in hearing of al he read al the wordes of the Booke of the couenant, which was found in the houſe of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king ſtood vpon the ſteppe: and made a couenant with our Lord, to walke after our Lord, & kepe his preceptes, and teſtimonies and ceremonies, with al their hart, and with al their ſoule, and to performe the wordes of this couenant, which were writen in that booke: & the people agreed to the couenant:
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king willed Helcias the high prieſt, & the prieſtes of the ſecond order, & al the porters, that they ſhould caſt out of the temple of our Lord al the veſſels, that had bene made to Baal, and in the groue, and to al the hoſt of heauen: & he burnt them without Ieruſalem in the Valley cedron, and caried the duſt of them into Bethel.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he deſtroyed the Southſayers, which the kinges of Iuda had appointed to ſacrifice in the excelſes in the cities of Iuda, and round about Ieruſalem: and them that burnt incenſe to Baal, and to the Sunne, and to the Moone, and to the twelue ſignes, and to al the hoſt of heauen.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he cauſed the groue to be caried forth out of the houſe of our Lord without Ieruſalem in the Valley cedron, & he burnt it there, and brought it into duſt, and threw it vpon the ſepulchres of the common people.
label: 4 Kings

text: He deſtroyed alſo the litle houſes of the effeminates, which were in the houſe of our Lord, for the which the wemen woue as it were litle houſes of the groue.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he gathered together al the prieſtes of the cities of Iuda: and he contaminated the excelſes, where the prieſtes did ſacrifice from Gabaa vnto Berſabee: and he deſtroyed the altars of the gates in the entrance of the doore of Ioſue chief of the citie, which was on the left hand of the gate of the citie.
label: 4 Kings

text: Howbeit the prieſtes of the excelſes went not vp to the altar of our Lord in Ieruſalem: but only they did eate azimes in the middes of their brethren.
label: 4 Kings

text: He contaminated alſo Topheth, which is in the Valley of the ſonne of Ennom: that no man should conſecrate his ſonne or daughter by fyre to Moloch.
label: 4 Kings

text: He tooke away alſo the horſes, which the kinges of Iuda had geuen to the Sunne, in the entrance of the temple of our Lord, beſide the chamber of Nathanmelech the eunuch, who was in Pharurim: and the chariotes of the Sunne he burnt with fire.
label: 4 Kings

text: The altars alſo that were vpon the roofes of the vpper chamber of Achaz, which the kinges of Iuda had made, and the altars which Manaſſes had made in the two courtes of the temple of our Lord, the king deſtroyed: and he ranne from thence, and ſprinkled the aſhes of them into the Torrent cedron.
label: 4 Kings

text: The excelſes alſo that were in Ieruſalem on the right ſide of the Mount of offence, which Salomon the king of Iſrael had built to Aſtaroth the idol of the Sidonians, and to Chamos the ſcandal of Moab, and to Melchom the abomination of the children of Ammon, the king deſtroyed.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he brake in peces the ſtatues, and cut downe the groues: and he filled their places with the bones of dead men.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer the altar alſo, that was in Bethel, and the excelſe, which Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat had made, who made Iſrael to ſinne: and that altar, and excelſe he deſtroyed, and burnt, and brake into powder, and the groue alſo he burnt.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioſias turning, ſaw there ſepulchres, that were in the mount: and he ſent and tooke the bones out of the ſepulchres, and burnt them vpon the altar, and polluted it according to the word of our Lord, which the man of God ſpake, who had foretold theſe thinges.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſayd: What title is that, which I ſee? And the citizens of that citie anſwered: It is the ſepulchre of the man of God, which came from Iuda, and foretold theſe thinges which thou haſt done vpon the altar of Bethel.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſayd: Let him alone, let no man moue his bones. And his bones remayned vntouched with the bones of the prophet, that came out of Samaria.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer al the temples of the excelſes, which were in the cities of Samaria, which the kinges of Iſrael had made to prouoke our Lord, Ioſias tooke away: and he did to them according to al the workes, which he had done in Bethel.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſlew al the prieſtes of the excelſes, that were there vpon the altars: and he burnt mens bones vpon them: & turned into Ieruſalem.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he commanded al the people, ſaying: Make a Phaſe to our Lord your God, according as it is writen in the booke of this couenant.
label: 4 Kings

text: For there was not ſuch a Phaſe made from the daies of the Iudges, which iudged Iſrael, and of al the daies of the kinges of Iſrael, and of the kinges of Iuda,
label: 4 Kings

text: as in the eightenth yeare of king Ioſias this Phaſe was made to our Lord in Ieruſalem.
label: 4 Kings

text: Yea and the Pythones, and Southſayers, and the images of idols, and the filthes, and the abominations, that had bene in the land of Iuda and Ieruſalem, Ioſias tooke away: that he might eſtablish the wordes of the law, that were writen in the Booke, which Helcias the prieſt found in the temple of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: There was no king before him like to him, that returned to our Lord in al his hart, & in al his ſoule, and in al his powre according to al the law of Moyſes: neither after him did there ariſe the like to him.
label: 4 Kings

text: But yet our Lord was not auerted from the wrath of his great furie, wherwith his furie was wrath agaynſt Iuda: for the prouocations, wherwith Manaſſes had prouoked him.
label: 4 Kings

text: Our Lord therfore ſayd Iuda alſo wil I take away from my face, as I haue taken away Iſrael: and I wil reiect this citie, which I choſe Ieruſalem, and the houſe, wherof I ſayd: My name shal be there.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ioſias, and al that he did, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iuda?
label: 4 Kings

text: In his dayes came vp Pharao Nechao the king of Ægypt, agaynſt the king of Aſſyrians to the riuer Euphrates: and Ioſias the king went to meete him: and was ſlaine in Mageddo, when he had ſeene him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And his ſeruantes caried him dead from Mageddo: & they brought him into Ieruſalem, and buried him in his ſepulchre. And the people of the land tooke Ioachaz the ſonne of Ioſias: and they anoynted him, and made him king for his father.
label: 4 Kings

text: Three and twentie yeares old was Ioachaz when he began to reigne, and he reigned three monethes in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Amital, the daughter of Ieremie of Lobna.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did euil before our Lord, according to al thinges which his fathers had done.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Pharao Nechao bound him in Rebla, which is in the land Emath, that he ſhould not reigne in Ieruſalem: and he ſette a penaltie vpon the land, an hundred talentes of ſiluer, and a talent of gold.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Pharao Nechao made Eliacim king the ſonne of Ioſias, for Ioſias his father: and turned his name Ioakim. Moreouer he tooke Ioachaz and brought him into Ægypt, and he died there.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioakim gaue the ſiluer and the gold to Pharao, when he had taxed the land vpon euerie man, that it might be payd according to the precept of Pharao: and he exacted of euerie man according to his abilitie, as wel ſiluer as gold of the people of the land: to geue vnto Pharao Nechao.
label: 4 Kings

text: Fiue and twentie yeares old was Ioakim, when he begau to reigne: and he reigned eleuen yeares in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was zebida the daughter of Phadaia of Ruma.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did euil before our Lord according to al thinges, which his fathers had done.
label: 4 Kings

text: IN his daies came vp Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon, and Ioakim was made his ſeruant three yeares: and he rebelled agaynſt him againe.
label: 4 Kings

text: And our Lord ſenr in vpon him the rouers of the Chaldees, and the rouers of Syria, and the rouers of Moab, & the rouers of the children of Ammon: and he ſent them into Iuda, to deſtroy it, according to the word of our Lord, which he had ſpoken by his ſeruantes the prophetes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And this by the word of our Lord was done againſt Iuda, to take it away before him for al the ſinnes of Manaſſes which he did,
label: 4 Kings

text: and for the innocent bloud, that he had shed, & filled Ieruſalem with the bloud of innocentes: & for this thing God would not be made propitious.
label: 4 Kings

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ioakim, and al that he did, are not theſe thinges writen in the Booke of the wordes of the daies of the kinges of Iuda? And Ioakim ſlept with his fathers:
label: 4 Kings

text: and Ioachin his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king of Ægypt added no more to come out of his countrie: for the king of Babylon had taken al that had beene the kinges of Ægypt, from the riuer of Ægypt, vnto the riuer Euphrates.
label: 4 Kings

text: Eightene yeares old was Ioachin when he began to reigne, and he reigned three monethes in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Noheſta the daughter of Elnathan of Ieruſalem.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did euil before our Lord, according to al thinges which his father had done.
label: 4 Kings

text: At that time came vp the ſeruantes of Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon into Ieruſalem, and the citie was compaſſed with fortes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon came to the citie with his ſeruantes to aſſault it.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Ioachin the king of Iuda went forth to the king of Babylon, he and his mother, and his ſeruantes, and his nobles, and his eunuches: and the king of Babylon receiued him the eight yeare of his reigne.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he brought forth from thence al the treaſures of the houſe of our Lord, and the treaſures of the kinges houſe: and he cut in peces al the golden veſſel, which Salomon the king of Iſrael had made in the temple of our Lord, according to the word of our Lord.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he tranſported al Ieruſalem, and al the princes, and al the ſtrong men of the armie, ten thouſand into captiuitie: and euerie artificer and incloſer: and nothing was left, ſauing the poore ſorte of the people of the land.
label: 4 Kings

text: He tranſported alſo Ioachin into Babylon, and the kinges mother, and the kinges wiues, and his eunuches: and the iudges of the land he led into captiuitie from Ieruſalem into Babylon.
label: 4 Kings

text: And al the ſtrong men, ſeuen thouſand, and the artificers, and incloſers a thouſand, al valiant men and warries: and the king of Babylon led them captiues into Babylon.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he appointed Matthanias his vncle for him: and called his name Sedecias.
label: 4 Kings

text: One and twentie yeares old was Sedecias when he began to reigne, and he reigned eleuen yeares in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Amital, the daughter of Ieremie of Lobna,
label: 4 Kings

text: And he did euil before our Lord, according to al thinges which Ioakim had done.
label: 4 Kings

text: For our Lord was wrath againſt Ieruſalem and againſt Iuda, til he caſt them away from his ſace: and Sedecias reuolted from the king of Babylon.
label: 4 Kings

text: AND it came to paſſe in the ninthe yeare of his reigne, the tenth moneth, the tenth day of the moneth, came Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon, himſelfe and al his armie vnto Ieruſalem, and they beſette it: and built rampires rond about it.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the citie was shut vp & trenched about vntil the eleuenth yeare of king Sedecias,
label: 4 Kings

text: the ninth day of the moneth: and there was a ſore famine in the citie, neither was there bread for the people of the land.
label: 4 Kings

text: And a breach was made into the citie: and al the men of warre fled in the night by the way of the gate, which is betwen the duble wal toward the kinges garden (moreouer the Chaldees beſieged the citie round about) Sedecias therfore fled by the way, that leadeth to the champayne of the wildernes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the armie of the Chaldees purſewed the king, and ouertooke him in the plaine of Iericho: and al the warriers, that were with him, were diſperſed, and forſooke him.
label: 4 Kings

text: They therfore hauing taken the king, brought him to the king of Babylon into Reblatha, who ſpake iudgement with him.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſlewe the ſonnes of Sedecias before his face, and he put out his eies, and bound him with cheynes, and brought him into Babylon.
label: 4 Kings

text: The fifth moneth, the ſeuenth day of the moneth, that is, the ninetenth yeare of the king of Babylon, came Nabuzardan the General of the armie, the ſeruant of the king of Babylon into Ieruſalem.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he burnt the houſe, of our Lord, the kings houſe, and the houſes of Ieruſalem, & euerie houſe he burnt with fyre.
label: 4 Kings

text: And al the armie of the Chaldees, which was with the General of the ſouldiars, deſtroyed the walles of Ieruſalem round about.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Nabuzardan the General of the armie, tranſported the remnant of the people that remained in the citie, and the fugitiues, that were fled to the king of Babylon, and the reſt of the comon people.
label: 4 Kings

text: And of the poore of the land he leift dreſſers of vineyardes and huſbandmen.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the braſen pillers, that were in the temple of our Lord, and the feete, and the ſea of braſſe, which was in the houſe of our Lord, the Chaldees brake, and tranſported al the braſſe into Babylon.
label: 4 Kings

text: The pottes alſo of braſſe, and maſars, and forkes with three teeth, and cuppes, and litle mortars, and al the veſſel of braſſe, in the which they miniſtred, they tooke away.
label: 4 Kings

text: Moreouer alſo the cenſars, and phials: thoſe that were of gold: and that were of ſiluer the General of the warfare tooke,
label: 4 Kings

text: that is, two pillers, one ſea, and the feete which Salomon had made in the temple of our Lord: there was no weight of the braſſe of al the veſſels.
label: 4 Kings

text: One piller had eightene cubites in height: and the litle head of braſſe vpon it was three cubites in height: and the nette, and pomegranates vpon the litle head of the piller, al of braſſe: the ſecond alſo had the like adorning.
label: 4 Kings

text: Alſo the general of the armie tooke Saraias the chieſe prieſt, and Sophonias the ſecond prieſt, and three porters.
label: 4 Kings

text: And of the citie one Eunuch, which was captayne ouer the men of warre: and fiue men of them, that wayted before the king, whom he found in the citie, and Sopher the captaine of the armie who proued the yong ſouldiars of the people of the land: and threeſcore men of the common people, which were found in the citie.
label: 4 Kings

text: Whom Nabuzardan the General of the armie taking, brought them to the king of Babylon into Reblatha.
label: 4 Kings

text: And the king of Babylon ſtroke them, and ſlew them in Reblatha in the land of Emath: and Iuda was tranſported out of their land.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he made Godolias the ſonne of Ahicam the ſonne of Saphan Gouernour ouer the people, that was leift in the land of Iuda, which Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon had leift.
label: 4 Kings

text: Which when al the captaynes of the ſouldiars had heard, they and the men that were with them, to witte, that the king of Babylon had appoynted Godolias, there came to Godolias into Maſpha Iſmael the ſonne of Mathanias, and Iohanan the ſonne of Carée, and the Saraia the ſonne of Thanehumeth a Netophathite, and Iezonias the ſonne of Maachathi, they and their felowes.
label: 4 Kings

text: And Godolias ſware to them and to their companions, ſaying: Be not afrayd to ſerue the Caldees: tarie in the countrie, and ſerue the king of Babylon, and it shal be wel with you
label: 4 Kings

text: But it came to paſſe in the ſeuenth moneth, there came Iſmahel the ſonne of Nathanias, the ſonne of Eliſama of the kinges ſeede, and ten men with him: and ſtroke Godolias, who alſo died: yea the Iewes alſo & the Chaldees, that were with him in Maſpha.
label: 4 Kings

text: And al the people ryſing vp from litle to great, & the captaynes of the ſouldiars, came into Ægypt fearing the Caldees.
label: 4 Kings

text: But it came to paſſe in the ſeuen and thirteth yeare of the Tranſmigration of Ioachin the king of Iuda, in the twelfth moneth, the ſeuen and twenteth day of the moneth: Euilmerodach the king of Babylon, in the yeare, that he began to reigne, lifted vp the head of Ioachin the king of Iuda out of priſon.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he ſpake vnto him courteouſly: and he ſette his throne aboue the throne of the kinges, that were with him in Babylon.
label: 4 Kings

text: And he changed his garmentes, which he had in the priſon, and he did eate bread alwayes in his ſight, al the dayes of his life.
label: 4 Kings

text: A certayne prouiſion alſo he appointed for him without intermiſſion, which was alſo geuen him of the king day by day, al the daies of his life.
label: 4 Kings

text: ADAM, Seth, Enos,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Cainan, Malaleel, Iared,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Henoch, Mathuſale, Lamech,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Noe, Sem, Cham, and Iapheth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Iapheth: Gomer, and Magog, & Madai, and Iauan, Thubal, Moſoch, Thiras.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſonnes of Gomer: Aſcenez, and Riphath, and Thogorma.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Iauan: Eliſa and Tharſis, Cethim and Dodanim.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Cham: Chus, and Meſraim, and Phut, & Chanaan.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Chus: Saba, and Heuila, Sabatha, & Regma, and Sabathaca. Moreouer the ſonnes of Regma: Saba, and Dadan.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Chus begat Nemrod: this begane to be mightie in the earth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Meſraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Laabim, & Nephtuim,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Phetruſim alſo, and Caſluim: from whom came Philiſthijm, & Caphthorim.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Chanaan begat Sidon his firſtborne, the Hetheite alſo,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and the Iebuſeite, and the Amorrheite, & the Gergeſeite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: & the Heueite, and the Araceite, and the Sineite.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The Aradium alſo, and the Samareite, and the Hamatheite.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Sem: Aelam, and Aſſur, and Arphaxad, & Lud, and Aram, and Hus, and Hul, and Gether, and Moſoch.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Arphaxad begat Sale, who alſo begat Heber.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer to Heber were borne two ſonnes, the name of one was Phaleg, becauſe in his daies the earth was diuided; and the name of his brother Iectan.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Iectan begat Elmodad, and Saleph, & Aſarmoth, and Iare,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Adoram alſo, and Vſal, and Decla,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Hebal alſo, and Abimael, and Saba, moreouer
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: alſo Ophir, and Heuila, and Iobab. Al theſe are the ſonnes of Iactan:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Sem, Arphaxad, Sale,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Heber Phaleg, Ragau,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Serug, Nachor, Thare,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Abram, this is Abraham.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Abraham, Iſaac & Iſmael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And theſe are the generations of them, The firſtbegoten of Iſmael, Nabaioth, and Cedar, and Adbeel, and Mabſam,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Maſma, and Duma, Maſſa, Hadad, and Thema,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ietur, Naphis, Cedma. theſe are the ſonnes of Iſmahel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Cetura Abrahams concubine, which she bare: Zamran, Iecſan, Madan, Madian, Ieſboc, and Sue. Moreouer the ſonnes of Iecſan: Saba, and Dadan. And the ſonnes of Dadan: Aſſurim, and Latuſſim, and Laomim.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Madian: Epha, and Epher and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaa. Al theſe the ſonnes of Cetura.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Abraham begat Iſaac: whoſe ſonnes were Eſau, & Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Eſau: Eliphaz, Rahuel, Iehus, Ihelom, and Core.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Eliphaz: Theman, Omar, Sephi, Gathan, Cenez, Thamna; Amalec.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Rahuel: Nahath, Zara, Samma, Meza.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Seir: Lotan, Sobal, Sebeon, Ana, Diſon, Eſer, Diſan.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Lotan: Hori, Homam. And the ſiſter of Lotan was Thamna.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Sobal: Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Sephi, & Onam. The ſonnes of Sebeon: Aia & Ana. The ſonnes of Ana: Diſon.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Diſon: Hamram, and Eſeban, and Iethran, and Charan.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Eſer: Balaan, and Zauan, and Iacan. The ſonnes of Diſan: Hus and Aran.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe be the kinges, that reigned in the Land of Edom, before there was a king ouer the chidren of Iſrael: Bale the ſonne of Beor: and the name of his citie, Deneba.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Bale died, and Iobab the ſonne of Zare of Boſra, reigned for him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when Iobab alſo was dead, Huſam of the Land of the Themanes reigned for him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Huſam alſo died, and Adad the ſonne of Badad reigned for him, who ſtroke Madian in the Land of Moab: and the name of his citie was Auith.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when Adad alſo was dead, Semla of Maſreca reigned for him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Semla alſo died, and there reigned for him Saul of Rohoboth, which is ſituate beſides the riuer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Saul alſo being dead, Balanan, the ſonne of Achobor reigned for him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But this alſo died, and Adad reigned for him: whoſe cities name was Phau, and his wife was called Meetabel the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezaab.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Adad being dead, there began to be dukes in Edom for kinges: duke Thamna, duke Alua, duke Ietheth,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: duke Oolibama, duke Ela, duke Phinon,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: duke Cenez, duke Theman, duke Mabſar,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: duke Magdiel, duke Hiram. theſe be the dukes of Edom.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AND the chidren of Iſrael: Ruben, Simeon, Leui, Iuda, Iſſachar, and Zabulon,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dan, Ioſeph, Beniamin, Nephthali, Gad, and Aſer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Iuda: Her, Onan, and Sela. theſe three were borne to him of the Chananite the daughter of Sue. And Her the firſtbegotten of Iuda, was euil before our Lord, and he ſlewe him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Thamar his daughter in law bare him Phares and Zara.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore al the ſonnes of Iuda, were fiue. And the ſonnes of Phares, Heſron and Hamul.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes alſo of Zara: Zamri, and Ethan, and Eman, Chalcal alſo, and Dara, together fiue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Charmi: Achar, who trubled Iſrael, & ſinned in the theft of the anathema.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Ethan: Azarias.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Heſron that were borne to him: Ierameel, and Ram, and Calubi.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Ram begat Aminadab, and Aminadab, begat Nahaſſon, the prince of the children of Iuda.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Nahaſſon alſo begat Salma, of whom was borne Booz.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Booz begat Obed, who alſo begat Iſai.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Iſai. begat the firſtbegotten Eliab, the ſecond Abinadab, the third Simmaa,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the fourth, Nathanael, the fifth Raddai,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſixt Aſom, the ſeuenth Dauid.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Whoſe ſiſters were Saruia, and Abigail. The ſonnes of Saruia: Abiſai, Ioab, and Aſael, three.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Abigail beare Amaſa, whoſe father was Iether the Iſmaelite.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Caleb the ſonne of Heſron tooke a wife named Azuba, of whom he begat Ierioth: and her ſonnes were Iaſer, and Sobab, and Ardon.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when Azuba was dead, Caleb tooke to wife Ephratha: who bare him Hur.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Hur begat Vri: and Vri begat Bezeleel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: After theſe thinges Heſron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Galaad, and tooke her, when he was three ſcore yeares old: who bare him Segub.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Segub alſo begat Iair, & poſſeſſed three and twentie cities in the Land of Galaad.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he tooke Geſſur, and Aram the townes of Iair, and Canath, and the villages therof, threeſcore cities, al theſe are the ſonnes of Machir the father of Galaad.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when Heſron was dead: Caleb went in to Ephrata. Heſron alſo had to wife Abia who bare him Ashur the father of Thecua.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And there were borne ſonnes to Ierameel the firſtbegotten Heſron, Ram his firſtborne, and Buna, and Aram, and Aſom, and Achia.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ierameel maried alſo an other wife, named Atara, which was the mother of Onam.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But the ſonnes alſo of Ram the firſtbegotten of Ierameel, were Moos, Iamin, and Acar.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Onam had ſonnes Semei, and Iada. And the ſonnes of Semei: Nadab, and Abiſur.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But the name of Abiſurs wife, was Abihail, who bare him Ahobban, and Molid.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonne of Nadab were Saled, & Apphaim. And Saled died without children.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But the ſonne of Apphaim, Ieſi: which Ieſi begat Seſan. Moreouer Seſan begat Oholai.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Iada the brother of Semei: Iether, and Ionathan. But Iether alſo died without children.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Ionathan begat Phaleth, and Ziza. Theſe were the ſonnes of Ierameel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Seſan had noe ſonnes, but daughters: and a ſeruant an Ægyptian, named Ieraa.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he gaue him his daughter to wife: who bare him Ethei.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Ethei begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Zabad alſo begat Ophlal, & Ophlal begat Obed,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Obed begat Iehu, Iehu begat Azarias,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Azarias begat Helles, and Helles begat Elaſa,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ealaſa begat Siſamoi, Siſamoi begat Sellum,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Sellum begat Icamiam, and Icamia begat Eliſama.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Caleb the brother of Ierameel: Meſa his firſtbegotten, he is the father of Ziph: and the ſonnes of Mareſa the father of Hebron.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſonnes of Hebron, Core, and Thaphua, and Recem, and Samma.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Samma begat Raham, the father of Iercaam, and Recem begat Sammai.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonne of Sammai, Maon: and Maon the father of Bethſur.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Epha the concubine of Caleb bare Haran, and Moſa, and Gezez. Moreouer Haran begat Gezez.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Iahaddai, Regom, and Ioathan, and Geſan, and Phalet, and Epha, and Saaph.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The concubine of Caleb Maacha bare Saber, and Tharana.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Saaph the father of Madmena begat Sue the father of Machbena, and the father of Gabaa. But the daughter of Caleb, was Achſa.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe were the ſonnes of Caleb, the ſonne of Hur the firſtbegotten of Ephrata, Sobal the father of Cariathiarim.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hariph the father of Bethgader.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And there were ſonnes of Sobal the father of Chariathiarim, he that ſaw the halfe of the reſtinges.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and of the kinred of Cariatharim, the Iethreites, and Aphutheites, and Sematheites, and Maſeretes. Out of theſe iſſued the Saraites, and Eſthaolites.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Salma, Bethlehem, and Netophathi, the Crownes of the houſe of Ioab, and the Halfe of the reſting of Sarai,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The kinredes alſo of the ſcribes dwelling in Iabes, ſinging and founding, and abyding in tabernacles. Theſe are the Cineites, which came from heate of the father of the houſe of Rechab.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: BVT Dauid had theſe ſonnes, which were borne to him in Hebron: the firſtbegotten Ammon of Achinoam the Ieſraelite, the ſecond Daniel of Abigail the Carmelite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the third Abſolom the ſonne of Maacha the daughter of Tolmai the king of Geſſur, the fourth Adonias the ſonne of Aggith,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the fift Saphatias of Abital, the ſixth Iethraham of Egla his wife.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Six ſonnes therfore were borne to him in Hebron, where he reigned ſeuen yeares and ſix monethes. And in Ieruſalem he reiged three and thirtie yeares.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer in Ieruſalem ſonnes were borne to him, Simmaa, and Sobab, and Nathan, & Salomon, foure of Bethſabea the daughter of Ammiel,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Iebaar alſo and Eliſama,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Eliphaleth, and Noge, and Nepheg, and Iaphia,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: moreouer Eliſanna, and Eliada, and Elipheleth, nine:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: al theſe the ſonnes of Dauid, beſide the ſonnes of his concubines: and they had a ſiſter Thamar.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonne of Salomon, Roboam: whoſe ſonne Abia begat Aſa. Of this alſo was borne Ioſaphat,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the father of Ioram: which Ioram begat Ochozias, of whom roſe Ioas:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and his ſonne Amaſias begat Azarias. Moreouer Azarias the ſonne of Ioathan
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: begat Achaz, the father of Ezechias, of whom was borne Manaſſes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Manaſſes alſo begat Amon the father of Ioſias.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Ioſias were, the firſtbegotten Iohanam, the ſecond Ioakim, the third Sedecias, the fourth Sellum.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of Ioakim was borne Iechonias, and Sedecias.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Iechonias were Aſir, Salathiel,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Melchiram, Phadaia, Senneſer & Iecemia, Sama, and Nadabia.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of Phadaia were borne Zorobabel and Semei. Zorobabel begat Moſollom, Hananias, and Salomith their ſiſter:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Haſaba alſo, and Ohol, and Barachias, and Haſadias, Iaſabheſed, fiue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonne of Hananias, Phaltias the father of Ieſeias, whoſe ſonne was Raphaia. This mans ſonne alſo Arnan, of whom was borne Obdia, whoſe ſonne was Sechenias.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonne of Sechenias: Semeia, whoſe ſonnes were Hattus, and Iegaal, and Baria, and Naaria, and Saphat, ſix in number.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Naaria, Elioenai, & Ezechias, and Ezricam, three.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Elioenai, Oduia, and Eliaſub, and Pheleia, and Accub, and Iohanan, and Dalaia, and Anani, ſeuen.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: THE ſonnes of Iuda: Phares, Heſron, and Charmi, and Hur, and Sobal.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Raia the ſonne of Sobal begat Iahath, of whom were borne Ahumai, and Laad. theſe be the kinredes of Sarathi.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: This allo is the ſtocke of Etam: Iezrahel, and Ieſema, and Iedebos, And the name of their ſiſter Aſalelphuni.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Phanuel the father of Gedor, and Ezar the father of Hoſa, theſe are the ſonnes of Hur the firſtbegotten of Ephratha the father of Bethlehem.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Aſſur the father of Thecua had two wiues, Halaa, & Naara.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Naara bare him Oozam, and Hepher, and Themani, and Ahaſthari. theſe are the ſonnes of Naara.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſonnes of Halaa, Sereth, Iſaar, and Ethnan.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Cos begat Anob, and Soboba, and the kinred of Aharehel the ſonne of Arum.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Iabes was honorable aboue his brethren, and his mother called his name Iabes, ſaynig: Becauſe I bare him in ſorow.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Iabes inuocated the God of Iſrael, ſaying: If bleſſing thou wilt bleſſe me, and wilt enlarge my borders, and thy hand be with me, and thou wilt make that I be not oppreſſed by malice. And God granted the thinges that he prayed for.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Caleb the brother of Sua begat Mahir, who was the father of Eſthon.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Eſthon begat Bethrapha, and Pheſſe, and Tehinna the father of the citie of Naas: theſe are the men of Recha.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Cenez, Othoniel, and Saraia. Moreouer the ſonnes of Othoniel, Hathath, and Maonathi,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Maonathi begat Ophra, & Saraia begat Ioab the father of the Vale of Artificers: for there were artificers.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Caleb the ſonne of Iephone, Hir, and Ela, and Naham. The ſonnes alſo of Ela: Cenez.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes alſo of Ialeleel: Ziph, and Zipha, Thiria, and Aſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Eſra, Iether, and Mered, and Epher, and Ialon, and he begat Mariam, and and Sammai, and Ieſba the father of Eſthamo.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Alſo his wife Iudaia, bare Iared the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Icuthiel the father of Zanoe. and theſe are the ſonnes of Bethia the daughter of Pharao, whom Mered tooke.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of the wife of Odaia the ſiſter of Naham the father of Ceila, Garmi, and Eſthamo, which was of Macathi.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes alſo Simon, Amnon, and Rinna the ſonne of Hanan, and Thilon. And the ſonnes of Ieſi, Zoheth, and Benzoheth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Sela the ſonne of Iuda: Her the father of Lecha, and Laada the father of Mareſa, and the kinredes of their houſe that worke ſilke in the Houſe of oath.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he that made the Sunne to ſtand, and the men of Lying, and Secure, and Burning, which were princes in Moab, and which returned into Lahem. and theſe are old wordes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe are potters, dwelling in Plantinges, and in Hedges, with the king in his workes, and they abode there.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Simeon: Namuel, and Iamin, Iarib, Zara, Saul:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Sellum his ſonne, Mapſam his ſonne, Maſma his ſonne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Maſma: Hamuel his ſonne, Zachur his ſonne, Semei his ſonne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Semei ſixtene, and ſix daughters: but his brethren had not manie ſonnes, and the whole kinred could not reach to the ſumme of the children of Iuda.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they dwelt in Berſabee, and Molada, and Haſarſuhal,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and in Bala, and in Aſom, and in Tholad,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and in Bathuel, and in Hormi, and in Siceleg,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and in Bethmarcaboth, and in Haſarſuſim, and in Bethberai, and in Saarim. theſe were their cities vntil king Dauid.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Their townes alſo: Etam, and Aen, Rhemmon, and Thochen, and Aſan, fiue cities.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And al their villages round about theſe cities vnto Baal. this is their habitation, and the diſtribution of their dwellinges.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moſabab alſo and Iemlech, and Ioſa the ſonne of Amaſias,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Ioel, and Iehu the ſonne of Ioſabia the ſonne of Saraia, the ſonne of Aſiel,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Elioenai, and Iacoba, and Iſuhaia, and Aſaia, and Adiel, and Iſmiel, and Banaia,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ziza alſo the ſonne of Zephei the ſonne of Allon the ſonne of Idaia the ſonne of Semri the ſonne of Samaia.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe renowmed princes in their kinredes, & in the houſe of their affinities they were multiplied excedingly.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they went forth to enter into Gador as far as the Eaſt ſide of the valley, and to ſeeke paſtures for their flockes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they found fatte paſtutes, and very good, and a countrie very large and quiet and fruiteful, in the which before had dwelt the ſtocke of Cham.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe therfore, whom before we deſcribed by name, came in the dayes of Ezechias the king of Iuda: and they ſtroke their tabernales, and the inhabitantes that were found there, & cleane deſtroyed them vntil this preſent day: and they dwelt for them, becauſe they found there moſt fatte paſtures.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Alſo of the children of Simeon there went into mount Seir fiue hundred men, hauing their princes Phaltias and Naaria and Raphaia and Oziel the ſonnes of Ieſi:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and they ſtroke the remnant of the Amalecites, which were able to eſcape, and they dwelt there for them vntil this day.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: ALSO the ſonnes of Ruben the firſt begotten of Iſrael (for he was his firſt begotten: but when he had violated his fathers bed, his firſtbirthright was giuen to the ſonnes of Ioſeph the ſonne of Iſrael, and he was not reputed for the firſtbegotten.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Iudas, which was the ſtrongeſt among his brethren, of his ſtocke ſprang the princes: but the firſtbirthright was reputed to Ioſeph.)
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes then of Ruben the firſtbegotten of Iſrael: Enoch, & Phallu, Eſron, and Charmi.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Ioel: Samia his ſonne, Gog his ſonne, Semei his ſonne,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Micha his ſonne, Reia his ſonne, Baal his ſonne,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Beera his ſonne, whom Theglathphalnaſar the king of the Aſſyrians led away captiue, and he was prince in the tribe of Ruben.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And his brethren, and al his kinred, when they were numbred by their families, had theſe princes Iehiel, and Zacharias.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Bala the ſonne of Azaz, the ſonne of Samma, the ſonne of Ioel, he dwelt in Aroer as far as Nebo, and Beelmeon.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Agaynſt the eaſt quarter alſo he dwelt vnto the entrance of the deſert, and the riuer Euphrates. For they poſſeſſed a great number of cattel in the land of Galaad.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And in the daies of Saul they fought agaynſt the Agarenes, and ſtewe them, and dwelt for them in their tabernacles, in al the quarter, that looketh to the Eaſt of Galaad.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But the children of Gad dwelt ouer agaynſt them in the land of Baſan, as far as Selcha:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Iohel the head, and Sapham the ſecond: and Ianai, and Saphat in Baſan.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And their brethren according to the houſes of their kinredes, Michael, and Moſollam, and Sebe, and Iorai, and Iacan, and Zie, and Heber, ſeuen.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe are the ſonnes of Abihail, the ſonnes of Huri, the ſonne of Iara, the ſonne of Galaad, the ſonne of Michael, the ſonne of Ieſeſi, the ſonne of Ieddo, the ſonne of Buz.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Alſo the brethren of the ſonne of Abdiel, the ſonne of Guni, prince of the houſe in their families.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they dwelt in Galaad, and in Baſan, and in the townes therof, and in al the ſuburbes of Saron, vnto the borders.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Al theſe were numbred in the daies of Ioatham the king of Iuda, and in the daies of Ieroboam the king of Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The children of Ruben, and of Gad, and of halſe the tribe of Manaſſes, men of warre, carying sheildes, & ſwordes, and bending the bow, and taught to battels, four and fourtie thouſand, and ſeuen hundred threeſcore going forth to fight.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: They fought agaynſt the Agarenes: but the Itureians, and Naphis, and Nodab
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: gaue them ayde. And the Agarenes were deliuered into their handes, and al that were with them, becauſe they called vpon God when they fought: and he heard them, becauſe they beleued in him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they tooke al that they poſſeſſed, Camels fiftie thouſand, and ſheepe two hundred fiftie thouſand, and aſſes two thouſand, and of men an hundred thouſand ſoules.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And manie fel downe wounded: for it was the battel of our Lord. And they dwelt for them vntil the tranſmigration.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Alſo the children of the halſe tribe of Manaſſes poſſeſſed the land, from the coſtes of Baſan vnto Baal, Hermon, and Sanir, and mount Hermon, for the number was great.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And theſe were the princes of the houſe of their kinred, Epher, and Ieſi, and Eliel, and Eſriel, and Ieremia, and Odoia, and Iediel, moſt valiant men and mightie, and renowned princes in their families.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But they forſooke the God of their ſathers, and fornicated after the goddes of the peoples of the land, whom God tooke away before them.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the God of Iſrael rayſed vp the ſpirit of Phul king of the Aſſyrians, and the ſpirit of Thelgathphalnaſar king of Aſſur: and he tranſported Ruben, and Gad, and the halfe tribe of Manaſſes, and brought them into Lahela, and into Habor, and to Ara, and to the riuer of Gozan, vntil this day.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: THE ſonnes of Leui: Gerſon, Caath, and Merari.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Caath: Amram, Iſaar, Hebron, and Oziel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moyſes, and Maria. The ſonnes of Aaron: Nadab and Abiu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Eleazar begat Phinees, and Phinees begat Abiſue,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Abiſue begat Bocci, & Bocci begat Ozi.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ozi begat Zaraias, and Zaraias begat Maraioth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Meraioth begat Amarias, and Amarias begat Achitob.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Achitob begat Sadoc, and Sadoc begat Achimaas,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Achimaas begat Azarias, Azarias begat Iohanan,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Iohanan begat Azarias. the ſame is he that executed the prieſtlie office in the houſe, which Salomon built in Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Azarias begat Amarias, and Amarias begat Achitob,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Achitob begat Sadoc, and Sadoc begat Sellum,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Sellum begat Helcias, and Helcias begat Azarias,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Azarias begat Saraias, and Saraias begat Ioſedec.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Ioſedec went forth, when our Lord tranſported Iuda, and Ieruſalem by the handes of Nabuchodonoſor.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes then of Leui: Gerſon, Caath, and Merari.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And theſe be the names of the ſonnes of Gerſon: Lobni and Semei.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Caath: Amram, and Iſaar, and Hebron, and Oziel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Merari: Moholi and Muſi. And theſe are the kinredes of Leui according to their families.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Gerſon, Lobni his ſonne, Iahath his ſonne, Zamma his ſonne,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ioah his ſonne, Addo his ſonne, Zara his ſonne, Iethrai his ſonne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Caath, Aminadab his ſonne, Core his ſonne, Aſir his ſonne,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Elcana his ſonne, Abiaſaph his ſonne, Aſir his ſonne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Thahath his ſonne, Vriel his ſonne, Ozias his ſonne, Saul his ſonne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Elcana: Amaſai, and Achimoth,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Elcana: The ſonnes of Elcana: Sophai his ſonne, Nahath his ſonne,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Eliab his ſonne, Ieroham his ſonne, Elcana his ſonne,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Samuel: the firſt begotten Vaſſeni, and Abia.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Merari, Moholi: Lobni his ſonne, Semei his ſonne, Oza his ſonne,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Sammaa his ſonne, Haggia his ſonne, Aſaia his ſonne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe are they, whom Dauid appointed ouer the ſinging men of the houſe of our Lord, ſince the Arke was placed:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and they miniſtred before the tabernacle of teſtimonie, ſinging vntil Salomon built the houſe of our Lord in Ieruſalem: and they ſtood according to their order in the miniſterie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And theſe are they, which aſſiſted with their ſonnes, of the ſonnes of Caath, Hemam ſinging man, the ſonne of Ioel, the ſonne of Samuel,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Elcana, the ſonne of Ieroham, the ſonne of Eliel, the ſonne of Thohu,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Suph, the ſonne of Elcana, the ſonne of Mahath, the ſonne of Amaſai,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Elcana, the ſonne of Iohel, the ſonne of Azaries, the ſonne of Sophonias,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Thahath, the ſonne of Aſir, the ſonne of Abiaſaph, the ſonne of Core,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Iſaar, the ſonne of Caath, the ſonne of Leui, the ſonne of Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And his brother Aſaph, who ſtood on his right hand, Aſaph the ſonne of Barachias, the ſonne of Samaa,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Michael, the ſonne of Baſaia, the ſonne of Melchia,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Athanai, the ſonne of Zara, the ſonne of Adaia,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Ethan, the ſonne of Zamma, the ſonne of Semei.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Ieth, the ſonne of Gerſon, the ſonne of Leui.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the children of Merari their brethren, on the left hand, Ethan the ſonne of Cuſi, the ſonne of Abdi, the ſonne of Maloch,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Haſabia, the ſonne of Amaſia, the ſonne of Helcias,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Amaſai, the ſonne of Boni, the ſonne of Somer,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Moholi, the ſonne of Moſi, the ſonne of Merari, the ſonne of Leui.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Their brethren alſo the Leuites, which were ordained for al the miniſterie of the tabernacle of the houſe of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Aaron, and his ſonnes burnt incenſe vpon the altar of holocauſt, and vpon the altar of incenſe, for euerie worke of Sancta Sanctorum: and to pray for Iſrael according to al thinges, which Moyſes the ſeruant of God had commanded.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And theſe are the ſonnes of Aaron: Eleazar his ſonne, Phinees his ſonne, Abiſue his ſonne
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Bocci his ſonne, Ozi his ſonne, Zarahia his ſonne,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Meraioth his ſonne, Amarias his ſonne, Achitob his ſonne,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Sadoc his ſonne, Achimaas his ſonne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And theſe are their habitations by the townes and confines, to witte, of the ſonnes of Aaron, according to the kinredes of the Caathites: for they were fallen to them by lotte.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: They gaue therfore to them Hebron in the Land of Iuda, and the ſuburbes therof round about:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: but the fieldes of the citie, and the townes to Caleb the ſonne of Iephone.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer to the ſonnes of Aaron they gaue cities, to flee vnto, Hebron, and Lobna, and the ſuburbes therof,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Iether alſo and Eſthemo with the ſuburbes therof, yea & Helon, and Dabir with their ſuburbes:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Aſan alſo & Bethſemes, & their ſuburbes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And of the tribe of Beniamin: Gabee and the ſuburbes therof, Almath with the ſuburbes therof, Anothoth alſo with the ſuburbes therof. al the cities, thirtene, by their kinredes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And to the children of Caath the reſidue of their kinred they gaue of the halſe tribe of Manaſſes in poſſeſſion ten cities.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer to the children of Gerſon by their kinredes of the tribe of Iſſachar, & of the tribe of Aſer, and of the tribe of Nephthali, and of the tribe of Manaſſes in Baſan, thirtene cities.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And to the ſonnes of Merari by their kinredes of the tribe of Ruben, and of the tribe of Gad, and of the tribe of Zabulon, they gaue by lot twelue cities.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Alſo the children of Iſrael gaue to the Leuites cities, and their ſuburbes:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and they gaue by lot, of the tribe of the children of Iuda, & of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and of the tribe of the children of Beniamin, theſe cities, which they called by their names,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and to them, that were of the kinred of the ſonnes of Caath, and the cities in their borders were of the tribe of Ephraim.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: They therfore gaue them cities, to flee vnto, Sichem with the ſuburbes therof in mount Ephraim, and Gazer with the ſuburbes therof,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Iecmaan alſo with the ſuburbes therof, and Bethhoron in like maner,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: moreouer Helon alſo with the ſuburbes therof, and Gethremmon in like maner.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer of the halfe tribe of Manaſſes, Aner & the ſuburbes therof, Balaam and the ſuburbes therof: to witte, to them, which were leaft of the kinred of the ſonnes of Caath.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And to the ſonnes of Gerſom of the kinred of the halfe tribe of Manaſſes, Gaulon in Baſan, and the ſuburbes therof, and Aſtaroth with the ſuburbes therof.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of the tribe of Iſſachar, Cedes and the ſuburbes therof, and Dabereth with the ſuburbes therof,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ramoth alſo and the ſuburbes therof, and Anem with the ſuburbes therof.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And of the tribe of Aſer: Maſal with the ſuburbes therof, & Abdon in like mamer,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Hucac alſo and the ſuburbes therof, and Rohob with the ſuburbes therof.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer of the tribe of Nephthali, Cedes in Galilee and the ſuburbes therof, Hamon with the ſuburbes therof, and Cariathaim, and the ſuburbes therof.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And to the reſt of the ſonnes of Merari: of the tribe of Zabulon, Remmono and the ſuburbes therof, and Thabor with the ſuburbes therof:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: beyond Iordan alſo ouer agaynſt Iericho, agaynſt the Eaſt of Iordan, of the tribe of Ruben, Boſor in the wilderneſſe with the ſuburbes therof, and Iaſſa with the ſuburbes therof,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Cademoth alſo and the ſuburbes therof, and Mephaath with the ſuburbes thereof.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer alſo of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Galaad and the ſuburbes therof, and Manaim with the ſuburbes therof,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: yea and Heſebon with the ſuburbes therof, and Iezer with the ſuburbes therof.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: MOREOVER the ſonnes of Iſſachar: Thola, and Phua, Iaſub and Simeron, foure.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Thola: Ozi and Raphaia, and Ieriel, and Iemai, and Iebſem, and Samuel, princes by the houſes of their kinredes. Of the ſtocke of Thola were numbred moſt valiant men in the daies of Dauid, two and twentie thouſand ſix hundred.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Ozi: Izrahia, of whom were borne Michael, and Obadia, and Ioel, and Ieſia, fiue, al princes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And with them by their families and peoples, readie girded to battel, moſt valiant men, ſix and thirtie thouſand: for they had many wiues, and children.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Their brethren alſo through al the kinred of Iſſachar, moſt ſtrong to fight, were numbred foure ſcore and ſeuen thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Beniamin: Bela, and Bechor, & Iadihel, three.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Bela: Eſbon, and Ozi, and Oziel, and Ierimoth, and Vrai, fiue princes of their families, and moſt ſtrong to fight, and their number was twentie two thouſand and thirtie foure.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſonnes of Bechor: Zamira, and Ioas, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Amri, and Ierimoth, and Abia, and Anathoth, and Almath al theſe: the ſonnes of Bechor.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And there were numbred by their families princes of their kinredes moſt valiant vnto battel, twentie thouſand and two hundred.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſonnes of Iadihel: Balon. And the ſonnes of Balan: Iehus, and Beniamin, and Aod, and Chanana, and Zethan, and Tharſis, Ahiſahar.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: al theſe the ſonnes of Iadihel, princes of their kinredes, moſt valiant men, ſeuentene thouſand, and two hundred going forth to battel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Sepham alſo, and Hapham the ſonnes of Hir: and Haſim the ſonnes of Aher.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Nephthali: Iaſiel, and Guni, and Iezer, and Sellum, the ſonnes of Bala.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſonne of Manaſſes, Ezriel: and his concubine the Syrian bare Machir the father of Galaad.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Machir tooke wiues for his ſonnes Happhim, and Saphan: and he had a ſiſter named Maacha: the name of the ſecond Salphaad, and to Salphaad were borne daughters.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Maacha the wife of Machir bare a ſonne, and she called his name Phares: moreouer the name of his brother, was Sares: and his ſonnes, Vlam, and Recen.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonne of Vlam, Badan. Theſe are the children of Galaad, the ſonne of Machir, the ſonne of Manaſſes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And his ſiſter Queene bare Goodlieman, and Abiezer, and Mohola.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Semida were, Ahin, and Sechem, and Leci, and Anion.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Ephraim: Suthala, Bared his ſonne, Thahath his ſonne, Elada his ſonne, Thahath his ſonne, and this mans ſonne Zabad,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and this mans ſonne Suthala, and this mans ſonne Ezer, and Elad: and the men of Geth borne in the land ſlewe them, becauſe they came downe to inuade their poſſeſſions.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Eghraim therfore their father mourned many daies, and his brethren came to comfort him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he went in vnto his wife: who conceiued and bare a ſonne, and he called his name Beria, for that he was borne in the euils of his houſe:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and his daughter was Sara, who built Bethhoron, the nether and the vpper, and Ozenſara.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer his ſonne Rapha, and Reſeph, and Thale, of whom was borne Thaan,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: who begat Laadan: this mans ſonne alſo was Ammiud, who begat Eliſama,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: of whom was borne Nun, who had Ioſue his ſonne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And their poſſeſſion and habitation, was Bethel with her daughters, and agaynſt the eaſt of Noran, and on the weſt quarter of Gazer and her daughters, Sichem alſo with her daughters, as farre as Aſa with her daughters.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Alſo neere the children of Manaſſes Bethſan and her daughters, Thanach & her daughters, Mageddo and her daughters; Dor and her daughters: in theſe dwelt the children of Ioſeph, the ſonne of Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The children of Aſer: Iemna, and Ieſua, and Ieſſui, and Baria, and Sara their ſiſter.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Baria: Heber, and Melchiel: he is the father of Barſaith.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Heber begat Iephlat, and Somer, and Hotham, and Suaa their ſiſter.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Iephlat: Phoſech, and Chamaal, and Aſoth: theſe be the ſonnes of Iephlat.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſonnes of Somer: Ahi, and Roaga, and Haba, and Aram.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Helem his brother: Supha, and Iemna, and Selles, and Amal.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Supha: Sue Harnapher, and Sual, and Beri, and Iamra,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Boſor, and hod, and Samma, and Saluſa, and Iethran, and Bera.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Iether: Iephone, and Phaſpha, and Ara.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Olla: Aree, and haniel and Reſia.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Al theſe be the ſonnes of Aſer, princes of their kinredes, the choſen and moſt valiant dukes of dukes: and their number of the age that was fitte for battel, was ſix and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AND Beniamin begat Bale his firſt begotten, Asbel the ſecond, Ahara the third,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Nohaa the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Bale were: Addar, and Gera, and Abiud,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Abiſue alſo, and Naaman, and Ahoe;
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and alſo Gera, and Sephuphan, and Huram.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe are the ſonnes of Ahod, princes of their kinredes that dwelt in Gabaa, which were tranſported into Manahath.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Naaman, and Achia, and Gera he tranſported them, and begat Oza, and Ahiud.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer he begat Saharaim in the countrie of Moab, after he diſmiſſed Huſim and Bara his wiues.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And of Hodes his wife he begat Iobab, and Sebia, and Moſa, and Molchom,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Iehus alſo, and Sechia, and Marma. theſe are his ſonnes princes in their families.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Mehuſim begat Abitob, and Elphaal.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſonnes of Elphaal Heber, and Miſaam, and Samad: this man built Ono, and Lod, and her daughters.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Baria, and Sama princes of their kinredes that dwelt in Aialon: theſe droue away the inhabitantes of Geth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Ahio, and Seſac, and Ierimoth,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Sabadia, and Arod, and Heder,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Michael alſo, and Ieſpha, and Ioha the ſonnes of Baria.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Zabadia, and Moſollam, and Hezeci, and Heber,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Ieſamari, and Iezlia, and Iobab ſonnes of Elphaal,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Iacim, and Zechri, and Zabdi,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Elioenai, and Selethai, and Eliel,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Adaia, and Baraia, and Samarath the ſonnes of Semei.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Ieſpham, and Heber, and Eliel,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Abdon, and Zechri, and Hanan,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Hanania, and Ælam, and Anathothia,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Iephdaia, and Phanuel the ſonnes of Seſac.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Samſari, and Sohoria and Otholia,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Ierſia, and Elia, and Zechri, the ſonnes of Ieroham.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: theſe be the patriaches, and princes of their kinredes, which dwelt in Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And in Gabaon dwelt Abigabaon, and the name of his wife Maacha:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And his firſt begotten ſonne Abdon, and Sur, and Cis, and Baal, and Nadab.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Gedor alſo, and Ahio, and Zacher, and Macelloth:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Macelloth begat Samaa: and they dwelt ouer agaynſt their brethren in Ieruſalem with their brethren.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Ner begat Cis, and Cis begat Saul. Moreouer Saul begat Ionathas, and Melchiſua, and Abinadab, and Eſbaal.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonne of Ionathas, Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micha.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Micha, Phithon, and Melech, & Tharaa, and Ahaz.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Ahaz begat Ioada: and Ioada begat Alamath, and Azmoth, and Zamri: moreouer Zamri begat Moſa,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Moſa begat Banaa, whoſe ſonne was Rapha, of whom was borne Elaſa, who begat Aſel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Aſel had ſix ſonnes of theſe names, Ezricam, Bochru, Iſmahel, Saria, Obdia, and Hanan. al theſe the ſonnes of Aſel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Eſec his brother, Vlam the firſtbegotten, and Iehus the ſecond, and Eliphalet the third.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Vlam were moſt ſtrong men, and archers of great force: and hauing many ſonnes and nephewes, vnto an hundred fiftie. Al theſe the children of Beniamin.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AL Iſrael therfore was numbred: and the ſumme of them was written in the Booke of the kinges of Iſrael, and Iuda: and they were tranſported into Babylon for their ſinne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they that dwelt firſt in their poſſeſſions and in their cities: Iſrael, and the Prieſtes, and the Leuites, and the Nathineans.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: There dwelt in Ieruſalem of the children of Iuda, and of the children of Beniamin, alſo of the children of Ephraim, and Manaſſes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Othei the ſonne of Ammiud, the ſonne of Amri, the ſonne of Omrai, the ſonne of Bonni, of the ſonnes of Phares the ſonne of Iuda.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And of Siloni: Aſaia the firſtbegotten, and his ſonnes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And of the ſonnes of Zara: Iehuel, and their brethren, ſix hundred ninetie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer of the ſonnes of Beniamin: Salo the ſonne of Moſollam, the ſonne of Odiua the ſonne of Aſana:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Iobania the ſonne of Ieroham: and Ela the ſonne of Ozi, the ſonne of Mochori: and Moſollam the ſonne of Saphatias, the ſonne of Rahuel,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of Iebania, and their brethren by their families, nine hundred fiftie ſix. Al theſe princes of their kinredes by the houſes of their fathers.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And of the prieſtes: Iedaia, Ioiarib, and Iachin:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Azarias alſo the ſonne of Helcias, the ſonne of Moſollam, the ſonne of Sadoc, the ſonne of Maraioth, the ſonne of Achitob, high prieſt of the houſe of God.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Adaias the ſonne of Ieroham, the ſonne of Phaſſur, the ſonne of Melchias: and Maaſai the ſonne of Adiel, the ſonne of Iezra, the ſonne of Moſollam, the ſonne of Moſollamith, the ſonne of Emmer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: their brethren alſo princes by their families a thouſand ſeuen hundred threeſcore, moſt able men of ſtrength to the worke of the miniſterie in the houſe of God.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And of the Leuites: Semeia the ſonne of Haſſub the ſonne of Ezricam, the ſonne of Haſebia of the ſonnes of Merari.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Bacbacar alſo a carpenter, and Galal, and Mathania the ſonne of Micha, the ſonne of Zechri the ſonne of Aſaph:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and Obdia the ſonne of Semeia, the ſonne of Galal, the ſonne of Idithun: and Barachia the ſonne of Aſa, the ſonne of Elcana, who dwelt in the courtes of Netophati.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the porters: Sellum, and Accub, and Telmon, and Ahimam: and their brother Sellum the prince,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: vntil that time, in the kinges gate toward the eaſt, wayted by their courſes of the children of Leui.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Sellum the ſonne of Core the ſonne of Abiaſaph, the ſonne of Core, with his brethren, and his fathers houſe, theſe are the Corites ouer the workes of the miniſterie, keepers of the entrances of the tabernacle: and their families in courſe keeping the entrance of the campe of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Phinees the ſonne of Eleaſar, was their prince before our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Zacharias the ſonne of Moſollamia, porter of the gate of the tabernacle of teſtimonie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Al theſe choſen men for porters, at euerie gate, two hundred twelue: and appointed out in their proper townes: Whom Dauid and Samuel the Seer appointed, vpon their fidelitie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: as wel them as their ſonnes. in the doores of the houſe of our Lord, and in the tabernacle by their courſes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: By the foure windes were the porters: that is to ſay, toward the Eaſt, and toward the Weſt, and toward the North, and toward the South.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And their brethren dwelt in villages, and came vpon their Sabbathes from time to time.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: To theſe four Leuites was committed al the number of porters, and they were ouer the chambers, and treaſures of the houſe of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Alſo round about the temple of our Lord they abode in their watches: that when it was time, they in the morning might open the doores.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of theſe mens ſtocke there were alſo ouer the veſſels of the miniſterie: for by number the veſſels were both brought in and caried out.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of them alſo they that had the implements of the ſancturie committed vnto them, did ouerſee the floure, and wine, and oile, and frankincenſe, and ſpices.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of prieſtes made oyntementes of the ſpices.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Mathathias a Leuite the firſtbegotten of Sellum the Corite, was ouerſeer of thoſe thinges, which were fryed in the frying panne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer of the children of Caath their brethren, there were ouer the loaues of propoſition, to prepare alwaies new euerie Sabbath.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe are the chief of the ſinging men by the families of the Leuites, which abode in the chambers, that they might day and night continually ſerue in their miniſterie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The heades of the Leuites, princes in their families, taried in Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And in Gabaon abode Iehiel the father of Gabaon, and the name of his wife Maacha.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: His firſt begotten ſonne Abdon, and Sur, and Cis, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Gedor alſo, and Ahio, and Zacharias, and Macelloth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Macelloth begat Samaan: theſe dwelt ouer agaynſt their brethren in Ieruſalem, with their brethren.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Ner bagat Cis: and Cis begat Saul: end Saul begat Ionathas, and Melchiſua, and Abinadab, and Esbaal.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonne of Ionathas, Meribbaal: and Meribbaal begat Micha.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſonnes of Micha, Phithon, and Melech, and Tharaa, and Ahaz.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Ahaz begat Iara, and Iara begat Alamath, and Azmoth, and Zamri. And Zamri begat Moſa.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Moſa begat Banaa: whoſe ſonne Raphaia bepat Elaſa: of whom was borne Aſel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Aſel had ſix ſonnes of theſe names, Ezricam, Bochru, Iſmael, Saria, Obdia, Hanan, theſe are the ſonnes of Aſel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AMd the Philiſtijms fought agaynſt Iſrael, and the men of Iſrael fled from the Paleſthines, and they fel wounded in mount Gelboe.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when the Philiſthians were come nere purſewing Saul, and his ſonnes, they ſtroke Ionathas, and Abinadab, and Melchiſua the ſonnes of Saul.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the battel grewc ſore agaynſt Saul, and the archers fouud him, and wounded him with arrowes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Saul ſayd to his eſquyer: Draw thy ſwoord, and kil me: leſt perhaps theſe vncircumciſed'come, and deride me. But his harnes bearer would not, being frighted with feare: Saul therfore caught his ſword, and fel vpon it.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Which wheu his harnes bearer had ſeene, to witte, that Saul was dead, him ſelf alſo fel vpon his ſword, aud died.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Saul therfore died, and his three ſonnes, and al his houſe fel together.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Which when the men of Iſrael had ſene, that dwelt in the chainpayne, they fled: and Saul and his ſonnes being dead, they forſooke their cities, and were diſpetſed hither and thither: and the Philiſthijms came, and dwelt in them.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The next day therfore the Philiſthijms taking away the ſpoiles of them that were ſtayne, fonnd Saul and his ſonnes lying on mount Gelboe.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when they had ſpoyled him, and cut of his head, and ſtripped him of his armour, they ſent into their land, that it ſhould be caried abour, and should be shewed in the temples of the Idols, and to the people:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and his armour they dedicated in the temple of their god, and the head they nailed vp in the temple of Dagon.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: When the men of Iabes Galaad had heard this, to witte, al thinges that the Philiſtijms had done vpon Saul,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: euerie one of the valiant men aroſe, and tooke the bodies of Saul and of his ſonnes, and brought them into Iabes, and buried their bones vnder an oke, that was in Iabes, and they faſted ſeuen daies.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Saul therfore died for his iniquities, for that he tranſgreſſed the commandement of our Lord which he had commanded, and kept it not: yea and beſides alſo conſulted the Pythoneſſe,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and truſted not in our Lord: for the which he ſlewe him, and transferred his kingdome to Dauid the ſonne of Iſai.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AL Iſrael therfore was gathered together to Dauid in Hebron, ſaying: We are thy bone, and thy fleſh.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Yeſterday alſo, and the day before when Saul as yet reigned, thou waſt he that didſt leade out and leade in Iſrael: for to thee our Lord thy God ſayd: Thou shalt feede my people Iſrael, and thou shalt be prince ouer it.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Al the ancientes therfore of Iſrael came to the king into Hebron, and Dauid entred into a league with them before our Lord: and they annoynted him king ouer Iſrael, according to the word of our Lord, which he ſpake in the hand of Samuel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid alſo went, and al Iſrael into Ieruſalem this is Iebus, where the Iebuſeites were the inhabiters of the land.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they that dwelt in Iebus, ſayd to Dauid: Thou ſhalt not come in here. Moreouer Dauid tooke the towre of Sion, which is the Citie of Dauid,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and he ſayd: Euerie one that shal among the firſt ſtrike the Iebuſeite, shal be the prince and chiefe captayne. Ioab therfore the ſonne of Saruia went vp firſt, and was made the prince.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid dwelt in the towre, and therfore it was called the Citie of Dauid.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he built the citie round about from Mello vnto a round compaſſe, and Ioab built the reſt of the citie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And dauid ptoſpered going and increaſing, and the Lord of hoſtes was with him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe are the princes of the valiant men of Dauid, which holpe him to be made king ouer al Iſrael according to the word of our Lord, which he ſpake to Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And this is the number of dauids ſtrong ones: Iesbaam the ſonne of Hachamoni prince among thirtie: this man lifted vp his ſpeare vpon three hundred wounded at one time.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And after him Eleazar his vncles ſonne an Ahohite, who was among the three mighties.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: This was with Dauid in Pheſdomim, when the Philiſthijms were gathered to that place into battel: and the field of that countrie was ful of barley, and the people was fled from the face of the Philiſthimes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe ſtood in the middes of the fielde, and defended him: and when they had ſtriken the Philiſtheans, our Lord gaue great health to his people.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And there went downe three of the thirtie princes to a rocke, wherin Dauid was, to the caue of Odollam, when the Philiſthijms had camped in the Vale raphaim.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer dauid was in a hold, and the ward of the Pheliſthimes in Bethlehem.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid therfore deſired and ſayd: O that ſome man would giue me water of the ceſterne of Bethlehem, which is in the gate.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe three therfore went forward through the middes of the campe of the Philiſthimes, and drewe water of the ceſterne of Bethlehem, which was in the gate, and brought it to Dauid to drinke: who would not, but tather offered it to our Lord,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: ſaying: God forbid that in the ſight of my God I should doe this, and ſhould drinke the bloud of theſe men: becauſe in the peril of their liues they haue brought me the water. And for this cauſe he would not drinke. Theſe thinges did the three moſt valiantes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Abiſai alſo the brother of Ioab he was prince of three, and he lifted vp his ſpeare agaynſt three hundred wounded, and he was among three moſt renowned,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and among the ſecond three he the noble one, and prince of them: but yet vnto the three firſt he taught not.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada a moſt valiant man, of Cabſeel: who had done manie factes, he ſtroke the two ariel of Moab: and he went downe, and ſlewe the lion in the middes of the ciſterne in the time of ſnow.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he ſtorke the Aegyptian, whoſe ſtature was of fiue cubites, and which had a ſpeare as the weauers beame: he therfore went downe to him with a rod, and by force tooke away the ſpeare, that he held in his hand, and ſlewe him with his owne ſpeare.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe thinges did Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada, who was among the three valiantes moſt renowned,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the firſt among thirtie, but yet the three he raught not: and Dauid made him of his counſel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the moſt valiant men in the armie, Aſahel the brother of Ioab, and Elchanan the ſonne of his vncle of Bethlehem,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Sammoth an Arortie, Helles a Phalonite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ira the the ſonne of Acces a Thecaite, Abiezer an Anathothite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Sobbochai an Huſathite, Ilai an Ahohite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Maharai a Netophathite, Heled the ſonne of Baana a Netophathite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ethai the ſonne of Ribai of Gabaath the children of Beniamin, Banaia a Pharatonite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Hurai of the Torrent Gaas, Abiel an Arbathite, Azmoth a Bauramite, Eliaba a Salabonite.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Aſſem a Gezonite, Ionathan the ſonne of Sage an Ararite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ahiam the ſonne of Sachar an Ararite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Eliphal the ſonne of Vr,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Hepher a Mecherathite, Ahia Phelonite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Heſro a Carmelite, Naarai the ſonne of Azbai,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ioel the brother of Nathan, Mibahar the ſonne of Agarai.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Selet an Ammonite, Naharai a Berothite the armour bearer of Ioab the ſonne of Saruia,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ira a Iethreite, Gareb a Iethreite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Vrias the Hetheite, Zabad the ſonne of Oholi,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Adina the ſonne of Sizaa Rubenite the prince of the Rubenites, & with him thirtie:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Hanan the ſonne of Maacha, and Ioſaphat a Mathanite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ozia an Aſtarothite, Samma, and Iehiel the ſonnes of Hotham an Arorite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Iedihel the ſonne of Zamri, and Ioha his brother a Thoſaite,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Eliel a Mahumite, and Ictibai, and Ioſaia the ſonnes of Elnaim, and Iethma a Moabite, Eliel, and Obed, and Iaſiel of Maſobia.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: THESE alſo came to dauid into Siceleg, when as yet he fled from Saul the ſonne of Cis, the which were moſt valiant and excellent warriers,
label: 1 Paralipomenon
