text: drawing the bowe, and hurling with both handes ſtones in ſlinges, and ſhooting arrowes directly: of the brethren of Saul of Beniamin.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The prince Ahiezer, and Ioas the ſonnes of Sammaa a Gabaathite, and Iaziel, and Phallet the ſonnes of Azmoth, and Beracha, and Iehu an Anothothite.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Samaias alſo a Gabaonite the moſt valiant amongſt the thirtie and aboue the thirtie. Ieremias, and Ieheziel, and Iohanan, and Iezabad a Gaderothite.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Eluzai, and Ierimuth, and Baalia, and Samaria, and Saphatia an Haruphite.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Elcana, and Ieſia, and Azareel, and Ioezer, & Ieſbaam of Carehim:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ioela alſo, and Zabadia the ſonnes of Ieroham of Gedor.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and of Gaddi alſo there fled to Dauid, when he lay hid in the deſert moſt valiant men, and the beſt warriers, holding sheild and ſpeare: their faces as the faces of a lion, nd ſwift as the roebuckes on the mountaynes:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ezer the prince, Obdias the ſecond, Eliab the third,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Maſmana the fourth, Ieremias the fifth,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ethi the ſixth, Eliel the ſeuenth,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Iohanan the eight, Elzebad the ninth,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ierenias the tenth, Machbani the eleuenth,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: theſe of the children of Gad were the princes of his armie: the meaneſt was captayne ouer an hundred ſouldiars, and the greateſt, ouer a thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe are they which paſſed Iordan the firſt moneth, when it vſed to flow ouer his bankes: and they chaſed away al that dwelt in the valleis toward the eaſt quarter and the weſt.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And there came alſo of Beniamin, and of Iuda to the hold, wherin Dauid abode.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid went out to mete them, and ſayd: If you be come peaceably to me for to helpe me, my hart be ioyned to you, but if you lye in wayte againſt me for my aduerſaries, whereas I haue no iniquitie in my handes, the God of our fathers ſee, and iudge.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But the ſpirit came on Amaſai the prince among thirtie, and he ſayd: We are thine ô Dauid, and with thee ô ſonne of Iſai: peace, peace be to thee, & peace to thy helpers. for thy God helpeth thee. Dauid therfore receiued them, and appoynted them princes of the band.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer of Manaſſes there fled to Dauid, when he came with the Philiſthijms agaynſt Saul, to fight and he fought not with them: becauſe the princes of the Philiſthimes taking counſel ſent him backe, ſaying: with the peril of our head wil he returne to his lord Saul.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore when he returned into Siceleg, there fled to him of Manaſſes, Ednas, and Iozabab, and Iedihel, and Michael, and Ednas, & Iozabad, and Eliu, and Salathi, the princes of a thouſand in Manaſſes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe did ayde Dauid agaynſt the rouers: for they were al moſt valiant men, and were made commanders in the armie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and there came euerie day to Dauid to helpe him, til it became a great number, as it were the armie of God.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: This alſo is the number of the commanders of the armie, which came to Dauid, when he was in Hebron, to transferre the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The children of Iuda bearing shield and ſpeare, ſix thouſand eight hundred wel appoynted to battel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of the children of Simeon valiant men to fight, ſeuen thouſand one hundred.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of the children of Leui, foure thouſand ſix hundred.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ioiada alſo prince of the ſtocke of Aaron, and with him three thouſand ſeuen hundred.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Sadoc alſo a young man of goodlie towardenes, and the houſe of his father, princes twentie two.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And of the children of Beniamin the brethren of Saul, three thouſand: for a great part of them as yet folowed the houſe of Saul.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer of the children of Ephraim twentie thouſand eight hundred, valiant of ſtrength, men renowmed in their kinredes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And of the halfe tribe of Manaſſes, eightene thouſand, euerie one by their names, came to make Dauid king.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Alſo of the children of Iſſachar men of vnderſtanding, that knewe al times to command what Iſrael ſhould doe, princes two hundred: and al the reſt of the tribe did folow their counſel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer of Zabulon ſuch as went forth to battel, & ſtood in aray wel appoynted with armour of warre, there came fiftie thouſand to ayde, not in a duble hart.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And of Nepthali, commanders a thouſand: and with them furnished with shield and ſpeare, ſeuen and thirtie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of Dan alſo prepared to battel, twentie eight thouſand ſix hundred.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And of Aſer going forth to fight, and prouoking in batttel, fourtie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And beyond Iordan of the children of Ruben, and of Gad, and the halfe part of the tribe of Manaſſes furniſhed with armour of warre an hundred twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Al theſe men of warre wel appoynted to fight, with perfect hart came into Hebron, to make Dauid King ouer al Iſrael: yea and al the reſt of Iſrael, were of one hart, that Dauid should be made king.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they were there with Dauid three daies eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and they that were neere them as farre as Iſſachar, & Zabulon, and Nephthali, brought loaues on Aſſes, and on camels, and on mules, and vpon oxen, to eate: meale, figges, reyſens, wine, oile, beeues, muttons, in al abundance, for there was ioy in Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AND Dauid tooke counſel with the tribunes, and centurions, and al the commanders,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and he ſayd to al the aſſemblie of Iſrael: If it pleaſe you: and if the word which I ſpeake procede from our Lord God, let vs ſend to the reſt of our brethren into al the countries of Iſrael, & to the Prieſtes, and Leuites, that dwel in the ſuburbes of the cities, that they may be gathered together vnto vs,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and we may bring agayne vnto vs the Arke of our God: for we ſought it not in the daies of Saul.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the whole multitude anſwered that it ſhould be ſoe done: for the word had pleaſed al the people.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid therfore aſſembled al Iſrael from Sihor of Ægypt, til thou enter into Emath, to bring the Arke of God from Caria Thiarim.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid went vp, and euerie man of Iſrael to the hil of Caria Thiarim which is in Iuda, to fetch thence the Arke of our Lord God ſitting vpon the Cherubim, where his name is inuocated.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they layd the Arke of God vpon a new wayne, out of the houſe of Abinadab. And Oza and his brother did driue the wayne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Dauid, and al Iſrael playd before our Lord with al their might in ſongues, and on harpes, and pſalteries, and timbrels, and cymbals, and trumpettes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when they were come to the Floore of Chidon, Oza ſtretched forth his hand, to hold vp the Arke: for the oxe being wantone had made it leane a litle a ſide.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Our Lord therfore was angrie agaynſt Oza, and ſtroke him, for that he had touched the Arke: and he died there before our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid was ſtrooken ſad, becauſe our Lord had diuided Oza: and he called that place, the Diuiſion of Oza vntil this preſent day.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he feared God at that time, ſaying: How may I bring in the Arke of God vnto me?
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And for this cauſe he brought it not vnto himſelfe, that is, into the citie of Dauid, but turned it away into the houſe of Obededom the Getheite.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore the Arke of God remayned in the houſe of Obededom three monethes: & our Lord bleſſed his houſe, and al thinges that he had.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: HIRAM alſo the king of Tyre ſent meſſengers to Dauid, and cedar trees, and artificers for walles, and timber: to build him a houſe.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid knew that our Lord had eſtablished him to be king ouer Iſrael, and that his kingdom was exalted ouer his people Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid alſo tooke other wiues in Ieruſalem: and he begat ſonnes, and daughters.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And theſe be their names, that were borne to him in Ieruſalem: Samua, and Sobad, Nathan, and Salomon,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Iebahar, and Eliſua, and Eliphalet,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Noga alſo, and Napheg, and Iaphia,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Eliſama, and Baalaida, and Eliphalet.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the Philiſthijms hearing that Dauid was annoynted for king ouer al Iſrael, they went vp al to ſeeke him: which when Dauid had heard, he went out to meete them.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the Philiſthijms coming, were ſpred abrode in the Vale Raphaim.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid conſulted our Lord, ſaying: Shal I goe vp to the Philiſteans, and wilt thou deliuer them into my hand? And our Lord ſayd to him: Goe vp, and I wil deliuer them into thy hand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when they were come vp into Baalpharaſim, Dauid ſtroke them there, and ſayd: God hath diuided myn enemies by my hand, as waters are diuided: and therfore the name of that place was called Baal Pharaſim.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they leaft there their goddes, which Dauid commanded to be burnt.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: An other time alſo the Philiſthijms invaded, and were diſperſed in the Vale.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid conſulted God agayne, and God ſayd to him: Goe not vp after them, retyre from them, and thou ſhalt come agaynſt them ouer agaynſt the pearetrees.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when thou shalt heare the ſound of one going in the toppe of the pearetrees, then shalt thou yſſue forth to battel. For God is gone forth before thee, to ſtrike the campe of the Philiſthijms.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid therfore did as God had commanded him, and ſtroke the campe of the Philiſthianes from Gabaon vnto Gazera.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the name of Dauid was bruited in al countries, and our Lord gaue the dreade of him ouer al nations.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: HE made alſo houſes for him ſelfe in the citie of Dauid: and built a place for the Arke of God, & pitcht a tabernacle for it.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Then ſayd Dauid: It is vnlawful that the Arke of God be caried of any man, but of the Leuites: whom our Lord choſe to carie it, and to miniſter vnto himſelf for euer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he gathered together al Iſrael into Ieruſalem, that the Arke of God might be brought into his place, which he had prepared for it.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer alſo the ſonnes of Aaron, and the Leuites.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of the children of Caath, Vriel was the prince, and his brethren an hundred twentie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of the ſonnes of Merari, Aſaia the prince: and his brethren two hundred twentie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of the ſonnes of Gerſom, Ioel the prince: and his brethren an hundred thirtie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of the ſonnes of Eliſaphan, Semeias the prince: and his brethren two hundred.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of the ſonnes of Hebron, Eliel the prince: and his brethren eightie
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of the ſonnes of Oziel, Aminadab the prince: and his brethren and hundred twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid called Sadoc, and Abiathar the Prieſtes, and the Leuites, Vriel, Aſaia, Ioel, Semeia, Eliel, and Aminadab:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and he ſayd to them: You that are the princes of the Leuitical families, be ſanctified with your brethren, and fetch the Arke of our Lord the God of Iſrael to the place, which is prepared for it:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: leſt as from the beginning, becauſe yow were not preſent, our Lord ſtrike vs: ſo now alſo it come to paſſe, we doing ſome vnlawful thing.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The Prieſtes therfore, and the Leuites were ſanctified, to carie the Arke of our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Leui tooke the Arke of God, as Moyſes had commanded, according to the word of our Lord, vpon their shoulders, on barres.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid ſayd to the princes of the Leuites, that they should appoynt of their brethren ſinging men on muſical inſtrumentes, to witte, on nables, & harpes, and cymbals, that the ſound of ioy might reſound on high.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they appoynted Leuites: Hemam the ſonne of Ioel, and of his brethren Aſaph the ſonne of Barachias: and of the children of Merari, their brethren: Ethan the ſonne of Caſaia.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And with them their brethren: in the ſecond order, Zacharias, and Ben, and Iaziel, and Semiramoth, and Iahiel, and Ani, Eliab, and Banaias, and Maaſias, and Mathathias, and Eliphalu, and Macenias, and Obededom, and Iehiel, porters.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer them that ſang, Heman, Aſaph, and Ethan: ſounding on braſen cymbals.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Zacharias, and Oziel, and Semiramoth, and Iahiel, & Ani, and Eliab, and Maaſias, and Banaias vpon nables ſang myſteries.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Mathathias, and Eliphalu, and Macenias, and Obededom, and Iehiel, and Ozaziu, vpon harpes for the octaue ſang a triumphant ſong.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Chonenias the prince of the Leuites, was chiefe ouer prophecie, to beginne the melodie: for he was verie coning.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Barachias, and Elcana: doore keepers of the Arke.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Sebenias, and Ioſaphat, and Nathanael, and Amaſai, and Zacharias, and Banaias, and Eliezer prieſtes, ſounded with trumpettes, before the Arke of God: and Obededom, and Iehias kept the doore of the Arke.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore Dauid and al the ancientes of Iſrael, and the tribunes, went to fetch the Arke of the couenant of our Lord, out of the houſe of Obededom with ioy.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when God had holpen the Leuites, which caried the Arke of the couenant of our Lord, there were immolated ſeuen oxen, & ſeuen rammes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Dauid was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and al the Leuites that caried the Arke, and the ſinging men, and Chonenias the prince of prophecie among the ſingers: and Dauid alſo was clothed with an Ephod of linen.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And al Iſrael brought the Arke of the couenant of our Lord in iubiley, and ſounding with the ſound of ſhaulme, and with trumpettes, and cymbals, and nables, and harpes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when the Arke of the couenant of our Lord was come vnto the citie of Dauid, Michol the daughter of Saul looking forth through a window, ſaw Dauid the king dancing and playing, and she deſpiſed him in her hart.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: THEY therfore brought the Arke of God, and ſet it in the middes of the tabernacle, which Dauid had pitched for it: and they offered holocauſtes, and pacifiques before God.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when Dauid had finished offering holocauſtes, and pacifiques, he bleſſed the people in the name of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he duided to al through out euerie one, from man vnto woman a loafe of bread, and a peece of roſted beefe, and floore fryed with oile.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he appoynted before the Arke of our Lord of the Leuites, that should miniſter, and ſhould remember his workes, & glorifie, and prayſe our Lord the God of Iſrael:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Aſaph the prince, and the ſecond after him Zacharias: moreouer Iahiel, and Semiramoth, and Iehiel, and Mathathias, and Eliab, and Banaias, & Obededom: and Iehiel ouer the inſtrumentes of pſalterie, and the harpes: & Aſaph to ſound vpon the cymbals:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: but Banaias, and Iaziel prieſtes, to ſound the trumpet continually before the Arke of the couenant of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: In that day Dauid made Aſaph, prince to confeſſe to our Lord and his brethren.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Confeſſe ye to our Lord, and inuocate his name: make his inuentions knowen among the peoples.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Chaunt to him, and ſing to him: and tel ye al his meruelous thinges.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Prayſe ye his holie name: let the hart of them that reioyſe, ſeeke our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Seeke ye our Lord, and his powre: ſeeke ye his face alwayes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Remember his meruelous thinges which he hath done: his ſignes, and the iudgementes of his mouth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſeede of Iſrael his ſeruant: the children of Iacob his elect.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: He is the Lord our God: in al the earth are his iudgementes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Remember for euer his coueuant: the word, which he commanded vnto a thouſand generations.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Which he couenanted with Abraham: and his othe with Iſaac.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he appoynted it to Iacob for a precept: and to Iſrael for an euer laſting couenant:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Saying: To thee wil I geue the Land of Chanaan: the corde of your inheritance.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: When they were few in number: ſmal and ſoiourners therof.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they paſſed from nation into nation: & from kingdom to an other people.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: He ſuffered not any man to calumniate them: but rebuked kinges for their ſake.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Touch not my anoynted: and vnto my prophetes be not malicious.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Sing ye to our Lord al the earth: shew forth from day to day his ſaluation.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Tel his glorie among the gentiles: among al peoles his meruelous workes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Becauſe our Lord is great, and laudable excedingly: and terrible ouer al goddes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: For al the goddes of the peoples, be idols: but our Lord made the heauens.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Confeſſion and magnificence before him: ſtrength and ioy in his place.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Bring to our Lord ye families of peoples: bring to our Lord glorie and impire.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Geue our Lord glorie, to his name, eleuate ſacrifice, and come ye in his ſight: and adore our Lord in holie honour.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Let al the earth be moued before his face: for he founded the world vnmoueable.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Let the heauens be glad, & the earth reioyſe: and let them ſay among the nations, Our Lord hath reigned.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Let the ſea thunder, and the fulneſſe therof: let the fieldes reioyſe, and al thinges that are in them.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Then shal the trees of the foreſt prayſe before our Lord: becauſe he is come to iudge the earth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Confeſſe ye to our Lord, becauſe he is good: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And ſay ye: Saue vs ô God our ſauiour: and gather vs together, & deliuer vs out of the nations, that we may confeſſe to thy holie name, and may reioyſe in thy ſongues.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Bleſſed be our Lord the God of Iſrael from eternitie vnto eternitie: and let al the people ſay: Amen, and hymne to God.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: He therfore leaft Aſaph there before the Arke of the couenant of our Lord, and his brethren to miniſter in the preſence of the Arke continually day by day, and in their courſes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Obededom, and his brethren ſixtie eight: and Obededom the ſonne of Idithun, and Hoſa he appoynted for porters.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Sadoc the prieſt, and his brethren prieſtes, before the tabernacle of our Lord in the excelſe, which was in Gabaon,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: that they should offer holocauſtes to our Lord vpon the altar of holocauſt continually, morning and euening, according to al thinges that are writen in the law of our Lord, which he commanded Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And after him Heman, and Idithun, and the reſt of the choſen men, euerie one by his name to confeſſe vnto our Lord: Becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Heman alſo and Idithun ſounding the trumpet, and quauering on the cymbals, and al muſical inſtrumentes to ſing vnto God: and the ſonnes of Idithun he made porters.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And al the people returned into their houſe: and Dauid, to bleſſe alſo his houſe.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AND when Dauid dwelt in his houſe, he ſayd to Nathan the prophete: Behold I dwel in a houſe of cedar: and the Arke of the couenant of our Lord is vnder skinnes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Nathan ſayd to Dauid: Al thinges, that are in thy hart doe: for God is with thee.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore that night the word of God came to Nathan, ſaying:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Goe, and ſpeake to Dauid my ſeruant: Thus ſayth our Lord: Thou shalt not build me a houſe to dwel in.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: For neither haue I remayned in houſe from the time, that I brought out Iſrael, vntil this day: but I haue bene alwaies changing places of tabernacle, and in tent
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: abyding with al Iſrael. Did I ſpeake to one, at the leaſt, of al the iudges of Iſrael, whom I commanded to feede my people, and did I ſay: Why haue you not built me a houſe of cedar?
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Now therfore ſo ſhalt thou ſpeake to my ſeruant Dauid: Thus ſayeth the Lord of hoſtes: I tooke thee, when in the paſtures thou dideſt folow the flocke, that thou shouldeſt be prince of my people Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And I haue beene with thee whither ſoeuer thou wenteſt: and I haue ſlayne al thine enemies before thee, and haue made thee a name as of one of the great ones, that are renowmed in the earth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And I haue geuen a place to my people Iſrael: it shal be planted, and shal dwel therin, and shal be moued no more, neither ſhal the children of iniquitie conſume them, as from the beginning,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: ſince the dayes that I gaue Iudges to my people Iſrael, and humbled al thine enimies. I therfore tel thee, that our Lord wil build thee a houſe.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when thou ſhalt haue accomplished thy daies to goe to thy fathers, I wil rayſe vp thy ſeede after thee, which shalbe of thy children: and I wil eſtablish his kingdom.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: He shal build me a houſe, and I wil confirme his throne for euer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: I wil be to him for a father, and he shal be to me for a ſonne: and my mercie I wil not take from him, as I tooke from him, that was before thee.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And I wil eſtablish him in my houſe, and in my kingdom for euer: and his throne shalbe moſt firme for euer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: According to al theſe wordes, and according to al this viſion, ſo ſpake Nathan to Dauid
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when king Dauid came, and ſate before our Lord, he ſayd: Who am I Lord God, and what is my houſe, that thou shouldeſt geue me ſuch thinges?
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But this alſo hath ſemed little in thy ſight, and therfore thou haſt ſpoken concerning the houſe of thy ſeruant for time to come alſo: and haſt made me renowned aboue al men Lord God.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: What can Dauid adde farther, wheras thou haſt ſoe glorified thy ſeruant, and knowen him?
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Lord for thy ſeruant according to thy hart thou haſt done al this magnificence, and would haue al thy great wonders to be knowen.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Lord, there is not the like to thee: and there is none other beſide thee, of al whom we haue heard with our eares.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: For what other is there, as thy people Iſrael, one nation in the earth, to the which God went, to deliuer it and make it his people, and with his greateneſſe and terrours caſt out the nations before the face of it, which he deliuered out of Ægypt?
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And thou haſt made thy people Iſrael to be thy people euer, and thou Lord art made the God therof.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Now therfore Lord, the word, which thou haſt ſpoken to thy ſeruant, and concerning his houſe, be it confirmed for euer, and do as thou haſt ſpoken.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And let thy name remayne and be magnified for euer: and let it be ſayd: The Lord of hoſtes is God of Iſrael, and the houſe of Dauid his ſeruant permanent before him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: For thou Lord my God haſt reueled the eare of thy ſeruant, to build him a houſe: and therfore thy ſeruant hath found confidence, to pray before thee.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Now therfore Lord thou art God: and thou haſt ſpoken to thy ſeruant ſo great benefittes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And thou haſt begunne to bleſſe the houſe of thy ſeruant, that it be alwaies before thee: for thee ô Lord bleſſing it, it shal be bleſſed for euer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AND it came to paſſe after theſe thinges, that Dauid ſtroke the Philiſthijms, and humbled them, and tooke away Geth, and her daughters out of the hand of the Philiſthijms,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and ſtroke Moob, and the Moabites were made Dauids ſeruantes, offering him giftes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: At that time Dauid ſtroke Adazezer alſo the king of Soba of the countrie of Hemath, when he went on to dilate his empire as farre as the riuer Euphrates.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid therfore tooke a thouſand chariotes of his, & ſeuen thouſand horſmen, & twentie thouſand footemen, & he hoghſinewed al the chariot horſes, ſauing an hundred chariotes, which he reſerued to himſelf.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the Syrian alſo of Damaſcus came moreouer, to giue ayde to Adarezer the king of Soba but Dauid ſtroke alſo of his two & twentie thouſand men.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he put ſouldiars in Damaſcus, that Syria alſo ſhould ſerue him, & bring giftes. And our Lord holpe him in al thinges, to the which he went.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid alſo tooke the golden quyuers, which the ſeruantes of Adarezer had, and he brought them into Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer of Thebath, and Chun the cities of Adarezer verie much braſſe, of which Salomon made the braſen Sea, and pillers, and braſen veſſels.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Which when Tou the king of Hemath had heard, to witte, that Dauid had ſtriken al the armie of Adarezer the king of Soba,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: he ſent Adoram his ſonne to king Dauid, to deſire peace of him, & to congratulate him that he had ſtriken, and had ouerthrowen Adarezer: for Tou was aduerſarie to Adarezer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But al the veſſel alſo of gold, and ſiluer, and braſſe king Dauid conſecrated to our Lord, with the ſiluer and gold, which he had taken out of al the nations, as wel of Idumea, and Moab, & the children of Ammon, as of the Philiſthijms and Amalec.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Abiſai the ſonne of Saruia ſtroke Edom in the Vale of ſalt pittes, eightene thouſand:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and he appoynted a garryſon in Edom, that Idumea should ſerue Dauid: and our Lord ſaued Dauid in al thinges, to which he went.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid therfore reigned ouer al Iſrael, & did iudgement and iuſtice to al his people.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Ioab the ſonne of Saruia was ouer the armie, and Ioſaphat the ſonne of Ahilud commenter.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Sadoc the ſonne of Achitob, & Ahimelech the ſonne of Abiathar, Prieſtes: and Suſa, Scribe.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Banaias alſo the ſonne of Ioiada ouer the legions Cerethi, and Phelethi: moreouer the ſonnes of Dauid the chief at the kinges hand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AND it chanced that Naas the king of the children of Ammon died, and his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid ſayd: I wil do mercie with Hanon the ſonne of Naas: for his father hath done me pleaſure. And Dauid ſent meſſengers to confort him vpon the death of his father. Who when they were come into the land of the children of Ammon, to confort Hanon,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the princes of the children of Ammon ſayd to Hanon: Thou thinkeſt perhaps, that Dauid for honour ſake toward thy father hath ſent ſome that ſhould comfort thee: neither markeſt thou, that his ſeruantes are come to thee to eſpie, and ſeeke out, and ſearche thy land.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore Hanon made the ſeruantes of Dauid balde, and shaued them, and cut away their cotes from the buttockes to the feete, and ſent them away.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Who when they were gone, and had ſent word to Dauid, he ſent to meete them (for they had ſuſteyned great reproch) and commanded them to tarie in Iericho, til their beard growe, and then they should returne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the children of Ammon ſeing, that they had done iniurie to Dauid, as wel Hanon as the reſt of the people, they ſent a thouſand talents of ſiluer, to hyre them chariotes and horſemen out of Meſopotamia, and from Siria Maacha, and from Soba.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they hyred two and thirtre thouſand chariotes, and king Maacha with his people. Who when they were come, camped ouer agaynſt Medaba. The children of Ammon alſo being gathered together out of their cities came to the battel.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Which when Dauid had heard, he ſent Ioab, and al the hoſt of valiant men:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and the children of Ammon iſſuing forth, put their armie in aray beſide the gate of the citie: and the kinges, that were come to ayde him, ſtood apart in the field.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ioab therfore vnderſtanding that battel was made agaynſt him before and behind, choſe the moſt valiant men of al Iſrael, and marched on againſt the Syrian.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the reſt of the people he gaue vnder the hand of Abiſai his brother: and they went forth agaynſt the children of Ammon
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he ſayd: If the Syrian shal ouercome me, thou shalt ayde me: and if the children of Ammon shal ouercome thee, I wil ayde thee.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Take courage, and let vs play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and our Lord wil doe that which is good in his ſight.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ioab therfore marched on, and the people that were with him, agaynſt the Syrian to battel: and he put them to flight
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the childen of Ammon ſeing that the Syrian was fled, themſelues alſo fled from Abiſai his brother, and went into the citie: and Ioab alſo returned into Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But the Syrian ſeing that he was fallen before Iſrael, ſent meſſengers, and brought the Syrian, that was beyond the riuer: and Sophach the General of Aderezers warre, was their captayne
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Which when it was told Dauid, he gathered together al Iſrael, and paſſed Iordan, and fel vpon them, and directed his armie agaynſt him, they fighting on the contrarie part.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the Syrian fled from Iſrael: and Dauid ſlewe of the Syrians ſeuen thouſand chariotes, and fourtie thouſand footemen, and Sophach General of the armie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſeruantes of Adarezer ſeing themſelues to be ouercome of Iſrael, fled to Dauid, & ſerued him: and Syria would no more giue ayde to the children of Ammon.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AND it came to paſſe after the compaſſe of a yeare, at ſuch time when kinges are wont to goe forth to battel, Ioab gathered together the armie and force of warre, and ſpoyled the land of the children of Ammon: and went on and beſieged Rabba. Moreouer Dauid taried in Ieruſalem, when Ioab ſtroke Rabba, and deſtroyed it.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid tooke the crowne of Melchom from his head, and found in it a talent weight of gold, and moſt precious pearles, and he made himſelf therof a diademe: he tooke alſo the ſpoiles of the citie very much.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the people that was therin, he brought forth: and he made harrowes, and ſleddes, and chariotes shod with Iron to paſſe ouer them, ſoe that they were cut in ſunder, & broken in peces: ſo did Dauid to al the cities of the children of Ammon: & he returned with al his people into Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: After theſe thinges there was warre begunne in Gazer agaynſt the Philiſthians: in which Sobachai the Huſathite ſtroke Saphai of the kinred of Raphaim, & humbled them.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: An other battel alſo was fought agaynſt the Philiſtheans, wherein Adeodatus the ſonne of Saltus a Bethlehemite ſtroke the brother of Goliath the Getheite, the ſtaffe of whoſe ſpeare was as it were a weauers beame.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But an other battel alſo happened in Geth, wherin there was a verie long man, hauing fingers and toes by ſix and ſix, that is, together foure and twentie: who alſo was borne of the ſtocke of Rapha.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: This man blaſphemed Iſrael: and Ionathan the ſonne of Samaa the brother of Dauid ſtroke him. Theſe be the children of Rapha in Geth, which fel by the hand of Dauid and of his ſeruantes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: BVT Satan roſe agaynſt Iſrael: and moued Dauid to number Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid ſayd to Ioab, and to the princes of the people: Goe, and number Iſrael from Berſabee vnto Dan, and bring me the number that I may know.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Ioab, anſwered: Our Lord increaſe his people an hundred fold more then they are: are they not my lord king al thy ſeruantes? why doth my lord ſeeke this, which may be reputed for a ſinne to Iſrael?
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But the kinges word preuailed more: and Ioab went forth, and went about al Iſrael: and returned to Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he gaue Dauid the number of them, whom he had ſurueyed: and al the number of Iſrael was found a thouſand thouſand and an hundred thouſand men that drew ſword: and of Iuda foure hundred ſeuentie thouſand men of warre.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: For Leui and Beniamin he numbred not: becauſe Ioab vnwillingly executed the kings commandement.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And that which was commanded diſpleaſed God: and he ſtroke Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid ſayd to God: I haue ſinned excedingly in that I would doe this: I beſech thee take away the iniquitie of thy ſeruant, becauſe I haue done foolishly.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And our Lord ſpake to Gad the Seer of Dauid, ſaying:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Goe, and ſpeake to Dauid, and tel him: Thus ſayth our Lord: I geue thee the choyſe of three thinges, chooſe one which thou wilt, and I wil doe it to thee.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when Gad was come to Dauid, he ſayd to him: Thus ſayth our Lord: Chooſe which thou wilt:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: either three yeares famine: or three monethes to flee from thine enemies, and not to be able to eſcape their ſword: or three dayes the ſword of our Lord, and peſtilence to be in the land, and the Angel of our Lord to kil in al the coſtes of Iſrael: now therfore ſee what I shal anſwer him, that ſent me.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid ſayd to Gad: I am on euerie ſide in great diſtreſſe: but it is better, that I fal into the handes of our Lord, becauſe his mercies be manie, then into the handes of men.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Our Lord therfore ſent the peſtilence in Iſrael, and there fel of Iſrael ſeuentie thouſand men.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: He ſent alſo an Angel into Ieruſalem, to ſtrike it: and when it was ſtriken, our Lord ſaw, and had compaſſion vpon the greateneſſe of the euil: and commanded the Angel, that ſmote: It is ſufficient, now let thy hand ceaſe. Moreouer the Angel of our Lord ſtoode beſide the floore of Ornan the Iebuſeite.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid lifting vp his eies, ſaw the Angel of our Lord ſtanding betwen heauen and earth, and a ſword drawen in his hand, turned agaynſt Ieruſalem: & they fel as wel he as the ancientes clothed in heare clothes, flatte on the earth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid ſayd to God: Am not I he, that commanded the people to be mumbred? It is I that haue ſinned: it is I that haue done the euil: this flocke what hath it deſerued? Lord my God let thy hand be turned I beſech thee vpon me, and vpon my fathers houſe: and let not thy people be ſtriken
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the Angel of our Lord commanded Gad to tel Dauid, that he ſhould goe vp, and build an altar to our Lord God in the floore of Ornan the Iebuſeite.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid therfore went vp according to the word of Gad, which he had ſpoken to him in the name of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Ornan when he had looked vp, and ſene the Angel, and his foure ſonnes with him, they hid themſelues: for at that time he threshed wheat in the floore.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore when Dauid came to Ornan, Ornan beheld him, & went forth to mete him out of the floore, and adored him flatte on the ground.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid ſayd to him: Geue me the place of thy floore, that I may build therein an altar to our Lord: ſo that thou take as much ſiluer as it is worth, and the plague may ceaſe from the people.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Ornan ſayd to Dauid: Take it, and let my lord the king doe whatſoeuer pleaſeth him: yea the oxen alſo I geue for holocauſt, and the dreyes for wood, and wheat for ſacrifice: I wil giue al thinges willingly.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And king Dauid ſayd to him: It ſhal not be ſo, but I wil geue thee ſiluer as much as it is worth: for I may not take it from thee, and ſo offer to our Lord holocauſtes geuen gratis.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid therfore gaue Ornan for the place, ſix hundred ſicles of gold of moſt iuſt weight.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he built there an altar to our Lord: and he offered holocauſtes, and pacifiques, and he inuocated our Lord, & he heard him in fyre from heauen vpon the altar of holocauſte.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And our Lord commanded the Angel: and he turned his ſword into the ſcabbard.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid therfore forthwith, ſeing that our Lord had heard him in the floore of Ornan the Iebuſeite, immolated victimes there.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But the tabernacle of our Lord. which Moyſes made in the deſert, and the altar of holocauſtes, was at that time in the excelſe of Gabaon.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid could not goe to the altar to pray God there: for he had bene frighted with exceding feare, ſeing the ſword of the Angel of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AND Dauid ſayd: This is the houſe of God, and this is an altar for holocauſte to Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he commanded that the proſelytes of the land of Iſrael ſhould be gathered together, and he appoynted of them maſons to hewe ſtones and polish them, that the houſe of God might be built.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid prepared alſo verie much yron for the nayles of the gates, and for the ioyninges and ioynctures: and of braſſe an inmumerable weight.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The cedar trees alſo could not be eſtemed, which the Sidonians, and Tyrians brought downe to Dauid.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid ſayd: Salomon my ſonne is yet a litle child and delicate, and the houſe which I would haue to be builded to our Lord, muſt be ſuch as may be renowned in al countries: I therfore wil prepare him neceſſaries. And for this cauſe before his death he prepared al the expenſes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he called Salomon his ſonne: and commanded him that he ſhould build a houſe to our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid ſayd to Salomon: My ſonne, it was my wil to haue built a houſe to the name of our Lord my God.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying: Thou haſt shed much bloud, and fought verie manie battels, thou canſt not build a houſe to my name, ſo much bloud being shed before me:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne, which shal be borne to thee, shal be a moſt quiet man: for I wil make him reſt from al his enemies round about: and for this cauſe, he shal be called Peaceable: and I wil geue peace and quietneſſe in Iſrael al his dayes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: He shal build a houſe to my name, & he shal be to me for a ſonne, and I wil be to him for a father: and I wil eſtablih the throne of his kingdom ouer Iſrael for euer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Now therfore my ſonne, Our Lord be with thee, and doe thou proſper, and build the houſe to our Lord thy God, as he hath ſpoken of thee.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Our Lord alſo giue thee wiſdome and vnderſtanding, that thou mayſt be able to rule Iſrael, and to kepe the law of our Lord thy God
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: For then thou shalt be able to proſper, if thou shalt keepe the commandementes, and iudgementes, which our Lord commanded Moyſes to teach Iſrael: take courage and play the man, feare not, neither be diſmayde.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Behold I in my pouertie haue prepared the charges of the houſe of our Lord, of gold an hundred thouſand talentes, and of ſiluer a thouſand thouſand talentes: but of braſſe, and of yron there is noe weight, for the number is ſurpaſſed with the greatneſſe: timber and ſtones I haue prepared to al the charges.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Thou haſt alſo verie manie artificers; hewers of ſtones, and maſons, & carpenters, and of al occapations moſt skilful to make worke,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: in gold and ſiluer and braſſe and yron, wherof there is no number. Ryſe therfore, and do it, and our Lord wil be with thee.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid alſo commanded al the princes of Iſrael, that they ſhould help Salomon his ſonne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: You ſee, quoth he, that our Lord your God is with you, and hath geuen you reſt round about, and hath deliuered al your enemies into your handes, and the land is ſubdewed before our Lord, and before his people.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Geue therfore your hart and your ſoules, to ſeeke our Lord your God: and ariſe, and build a ſanctuarie to our Lord God, that the Arke of the couenant of our Lord, and the veſſels conſecrated to our Lord, may be brought into the houſe, which is built to the name of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: DAVID therfore being old & ful of daies, made Salomon his ſonne king ouer Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he gathered al the princes of Iſrael, and the Prieſtes and Leuites.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the Leuites were numbred from thirtie yeares, & vpward: and there were found thirtie eight thouſand men.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of theſe were choſen, and diſtributed into the miniſterie of the houſe of our Lord foure and twentie thouſand: and of the ouerſeers and iudges, ſix thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer foure thouſand porters: and as manie ſinging to our Lord on inſtrumentes, which he had made to ſing on.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid diſtributed them by the courſes of the children of Leui, to witte, of Gerſon, and Caath, and Merari.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Gerſon: Leedan, and Semei.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Leedan: the prince Iahiel, & Zethan, and Ioel, three.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Semei: Salomith, and Hoſiel, and Aram, three: theſe be the princes of the familes of Leedan.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſonnes of Semei: Leheth, and Ziza, and Iaus, and Baria: theſe be the ſonnes of Semei, foure.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Leheth was the firſt, Ziza the ſecond: moreouer Iaus and Baria had not manie children, and therfore they were counted in one familie, and in one houſe.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The children of Caath: Amram, and Iſaar, Hebron, and Oziel, foure.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Amram, Aaron, and Moyſes. And Aaron was ſeperated to miniſter in Sanctaſanctorum, he and his ſonnes for euer, and to burne incenſe to our Lord according to his rite, and to bleſſe his name for euer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Moyſes alſo the man of God were numbred in the tribe of Leui.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Moyſes: Gerſom and Eliezari:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonnes of Gerſom: Subuel the firſt.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Eliezer were: Rohobia the firſt: and Eleezer had noe moe ſonnes. Moreouer the children of Rohobia were multiplied exceedingly.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Iſaar: Salomith the firſt.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Hebron: Ieriau the firſt, Amarias the ſecond, Iahaziel the third, Iecmaan the fourth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Oziel: Micha the firſt, Ieſia the ſecond.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Merari: Moholi, & Muſi. The ſonnes of Moholi: Eleazar and Cis.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Eleazar died, and had no ſonnes but daughters. and the ſonnes of Cis their brethren tooke them.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Muſi: Moholi, and Eder, and Ierimoth, three.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe be the children of Leui in their kinredes and families, princes by courſes, and number of euerie head, that did the workes of miniſterie of the houſe of our Lord from twentie yeares, and vpward.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: For Dauid ſayd; Our Lord the God of Iſrael hath geuen reſt to his people, and the habitation of Ieruſalem for euer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Neither shal it be the office of the Leuites to carie any more the tabernacle, and al the veſſels therof to miniſter.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: According to the laſt preceptes alſo of Dauid the number of the children of Leui ſhalbe numbred from twentie yeares and vpward.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they shal be vnder the hand of the ſonnes of Aaron for the ſeruice of the houſe of our Lord, in the entrances, and in the chambers, and in the place of purification, and in the Sanctuarie, and in al the workes of the miniſterie of the temple of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the Prieſtes, ouer the loaues of propoſition, and for the ſacrifice of floure, and for cakes and azimes, and the frying panne, and to roſt, and ouer al weight and meaſure.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But the Leuites to ſtand in the morning to confeſſe, and ſing to our Lord: and in like maner at euening,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: as wel in the oblation of the holocauſtes of our Lord, as in the Sabbathes and Calendes, and the reſt of the ſolemnities, according to the number, and ceremonies of euerie thing, continually before our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And let them keepe the obſeruations of the tabernacle of couenant, and the rite of the Sanctuarie, and the obſeruance of the children of Aaron their brethren, that they miniſter in the houſe of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: MOREOVER to the ſonnes of Aaron theſe were the partions: The ſonnes of Aaron: Nadab, and Abiu, and Eleazar, and Ithamar.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But Nadab and Abiu died before their father without children: and Eleazar and Ithamar did the function of prieſthood.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid diuided them, that is, Sadoc of the ſonnes of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the ſonnes of Ithamar, according to their courſes and miniſterie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And there were found manie more children of Eleazar among the principal men, then children of Ithamar. And he diuided to them, that is, to the children of Eleazar princes by their families ſixtene: and to the children of Ithamar by their families and houſes eight.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer he diuided both families betwen themſelues by lottes: for there were princes of the Sanctuarie, and princes of God, as wel of the children of Eleazar, as of the children of Ithamar.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Semeias wrote them, the ſonne of Nathanael the Scribe a Leuite, before the king and princes, and Sadoc the Prieſt, and Ahimelech the ſonne of Abiathar, the princes alſo of the Prieſtlie and Leuitical families: one houſe, which was ouer the reſt, Eleazars: and an other houſe, which had the reſt vnder it, Ithamars.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the firſt lot came forth to Ioiarib, the ſecond to Iedei,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the fifth to Melchia, the ſixt to Maiman,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſeuenth to Accos, the eight to Abia,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ninth to Ieſua, the tenth to Sechenia,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the eleuenth to Eliaſib, the twelfth to Iaeim,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the thirtenth to Hoppha, the fourtenth to Iſbaab,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the fiftenth to Belga, the ſixtenth to Emmer,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſeuententh to Hezir, the eightenth to Aphſes,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ninetenth to Pheteia, the twenteth to Hezechiel,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the one and twenteth to Iachin, the two and twenteth to Gamul,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the three and twenteth to Dalaiau, the foure and twenteth to Maaziau.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe be their courſes according to their miniſteries, to enter into the houſe of our Lord, and according to their rite vnder the hand of Aaron their father: as our Lord the God of Iſrael had commanded.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer of the children of Leui, which were remayning, there was Subael of the children of Amram: and of the children of Subael, Iehedeia.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Alſo of the children of Rohobia the prince of Ieſias.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonne of Iſaari Salemoth, and the ſonne of Salemoth Iahath:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and his ſonne Ieriau the firſt, Amarias the ſecond, Iahaziel the third, Iecmaan the fourth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonne of Oziel, Micha: the ſonne of Micha, Samir.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The brother of Micha, Ieſia: and the ſonne of Ieſia, Zacharias.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Merari: Moholi and Muſi. The ſonne of Oziau: Benno.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonne alſo of Merari: Oziau, and Soam, and Zacchur, and Hebri.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſonne of Moholi: Eleazar, who had no children.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonne of Cis, Ieramael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Muſi: Moholi, Eder, and Ierimoth. Theſe be the ſonnes of of Leui according to the houſes of their families.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they alſo did caſt lottes agaynſt their brethren the ſonnes of Aaron before Dauid the king and Sadoc, and Ahimelech, and the princes of the Prieſtlie and Leuitical families, as wel the elder as the yonger. Lotte diuided al equally.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: THERFORE Dauid, and the officers of the hoſte ſeperated for the miniſterie the ſonnes of Aſaph, and Heman, and Idithun: which ſhould prophecie on harpes, & pſalteries, & cymbals according to their number ſeruing the office dedicated to them.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of the ſonnes of Aſaph: Zacchur, and Ioſeph, and Nathania, & Aſarela, the ſonnes of Aſaph: vnder the hand of Aſaph prophecying neere the king.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Idithun: the ſonnes of Idithun, Godolias, Sori, Ieſeias, and Haſabias, and Mathathias, ſix, vnder the hand of their father Idithun, who prophecied on harpe ouer them that confeſſed and prayſed our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of Heman alſo: the ſonnes of Heman Bocciau, Mathaniau, Oziel, Subuel, and Ierimoth, Hananias, Hanani, Eliatha, Geddelthi, and Romemthiezer, and Ieſbacaſſa, Mellothi, Othir, Mahazioth:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: al theſe the ſonnes of Heman the Seer of the king in the wordes of God, that he might exalt the horne: & God gaue to Heman fourtene ſonnes and three daughters.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Al vnder their fathers were diſtributed to ſing in the temple of our Lord, on cymbals, and pſalteries and harpes, for the miniſteries of the houſe of our Lord neere the king: to witte, Aſaph, and Idithun, and Heman.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the number of them with their brethren, that taught the ſongue of our Lord, al the teachers two hundred eightie eight.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they did caſt lottes by their courſes, equally as wel the elder as the yonger, the learned and the vnlearned together.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the firſt lotte came forth to Ioſeph, which was of Aſaph. The ſecond to Godolias, to him and his ſonnes, and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The third to Zachur, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The fourth to Iſari, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The fifth to Nathanias, to his ſonnes & his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſixth to Bocciau, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſeueth to Iſreela, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The eight to Ieſaia, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ninth to Mathanias, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The tenth to Semeias, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The eleuenth to Azareel, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The twelfth to Haſabia, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The thirtenth to Subael, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The fourtenth to Mathathias, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The fiftenth to Ierimoth, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſixtenth to Hananias, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſeuententh to Ieſbacaſſa, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The eightenth to Hanani, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ninetenth to Mellothi, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The twenteth to Eliatha, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The one and twenteth to Othir, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The two and twenteth to Geddelthi, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The three and twenteth to Mahazioth, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The foure and twenteth to Romemthiezer, to his ſonnes and his brethren twelue.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AND the diuiſions of the porters: of the Corites Meſelemia, the ſonnes of Core, of the ſonnes of Aſaph.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Meſelemia: Zacharias the firſt begotten, Iadihel the ſecond, Zabadias the third, Iathanael the fourth,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Aelam the fifth, Iohanan the ſixth, Elioenai the ſeuenth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the ſonnes of Obededom Semeias the firſtbegotten, Iozabad the ſecond, Ioaha the third, Sachar the fourth, Nathanael the fiifth,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ammiel the ſixth, Iſſachar the ſeuenth, Phollathi the eight: becauſe our Lord bleſſed him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And to Semias his ſonne were borne ſonnes, the chiefe of their families: for they were moſt valiant men.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonnes then of Semeias: Othni, and Raphael, and Obed, Elizabad, and his brethren moſt valiant men: Eliu alſo, and Samachias.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Al theſe of the ſonnes of Obededom: they, and their ſonnes, and their brethren moſt able to miniſter, ſixtie two of Obededom.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſonnes of Meſelemia, and their brethren moſt ſtrong, eightene.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And of Hoſa, that is, of the ſonnes of Merari: Semri the prince ( for he had not a firſt-begotten, and therfore his father made him chief)
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Helcias the ſecond, Tabelias the third Zacharias, the fourth: al theſe the ſonnes, and brethren to Hoſa, thirtene.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe were diuided into porters, that the princes alſo of the watches, euen as their brethren, might miniſter in the houſe of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Lottes therfore were caſt equally, both to litle, and great, by their families for euerie one of the gates.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The lotte then of the Eaſt fel to Selemia, Moreouer to Zacharias his ſonne, a moſt wiſe man, and skilful, the North quarter chanced by lot
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But to Obededom and his ſonnes, toward the South: in which part of the houſe was the councel of the ancientes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Sephim, and Hoſa toward the Weſt, by the gate, which leadeth to the way of aſcent: watch againſt watch.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And toward the Eaſt ſix Leuites: and toward the North foure a day: and toward the South likewiſe in a day foure: and where the councel was two and two.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: In the celles alſo of the porters toward the Weſt foure in the way: and two at euerie celle.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Theſe be the diuiſions of the porters of the ſonnes of Core, and of Merari.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Achias was ouer the treaſures of the houſe of God, and the veſſels of the holie places.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes alſo of Ledan, the ſonnes of Gerſonni: of Ledan princes of the families, Ledan, and Gerſonni, Iehieli.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſonnes of Iehieli: Zathan, and Ioel his brethren ouer the treaſures of the houſe of our Lord,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: to the Amramites, and Iſaarites, and Hebronites, and Ozielites.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Subael the ſonne of Gerſom, the ſonne of Moyſes, chiefe ouer the treaſures.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: His brethren alſo Eliezer, whoſe ſonne Rahabia, and his ſonne Iſaias, and his ſonne Ioram, his ſonne alſo Zechri, and his ſonne Selemith.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Selemith himſelf, and his bretbren ouer the treaſures of the ſanctified holie thinges, which Dauid the king ſanctified, and the princes of families, and the centurions, and the captaynes of the hoſt
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: of the warres, and of the ſpoyles of the battels, which they had conſecrated to the maynteynance and furniture of the temple of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And al theſe thinges did Samuel the Seer ſanctifie, and Saul the ſonne of Cis, and Abner the ſonne of Ner, and Ioab the ſonne of Saruia: and al that had ſanctified them by the hand of Selemith, and of his brethren.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But the chiefe ouer the Iſaarites was Chonenias, and his ſonnes to the workes abrode ouer Iſrael to teach and iudge them.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the Hebronites Haſabias, and his brethren moſt able men, a thouſand ſeuen hundred were chiefe ouer Iſrael beyond Iordan agaynſt the Weſt, in al the workes our Lord, and for the miniſterie of the king.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the prince of the Hebronites was Ieria according to their families and kinredes. In the fourteth yeare of king Dauid they were numbred, and there were found moſt valiant men in Iazer Galaad,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and his brethren of ſtronger age, two thouſand ſeuen hundred princes of families. And Dauid the king made them ouerſeers ouer the Rubenites and the Gaddites, and the halſe tribe of Manaſſes, for al the miniſterie of God, and the king.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AND the children of Iſrael according to their number, the princes of families, tribune, and centurions, and ouerſeers, that miniſtred to the king according to their companies, coming in and going out euerie moneth in the yeare, euerie one was chiefe ouer foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ouer the firſt companie the firſt moneth Ieſboam was chiefe the ſonne of Zabdiel, and vnder him foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Of the ſonnes of Phares, the prince of al the princes in the hoſte the firſt moneth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The companie of the ſecond moneth had Dudia an Ahohite, and after him an other named Macelloth, which gouerned part of foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Captayne alſo of the third companie in the third moneth, was Banaias the ſonne of Ioiada the Prieſt: and in his diuiſion foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſame is Banaias the moſt valiant among thirtie, and aboue the thirtie. & ouer his companie Amizabad his ſonne was chiefe.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The fourth, in the fourth moneth, Aſahel the brother of Ioab, and Zabadias his ſonne after him: and in his companie foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The fifth, in the fifth moneth, prince Samaoth a Iezerite: and his companie foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſixth, in the ſixth moneth, Hira the ſonne of Acces a Thecuite: and in his companie foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ſeuenth, in the ſeuenth moneth, Helles a Phallonite of the children of Ephraim: and in his companie foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The eight, in the eight moneth, Sobochai an Huſathite of the ſtocke of Sarahi: and in his companie foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The ninth, in the ninth moneth, Abiezer an Anathothite of the children of Iemini: and in his companie foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The tenth, in the tenth moneth, Marai, and he a Netophathite of the ſtocke of Zarahi: and in his companie foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The eleuenth, in the eleuenth moneth, Banaias, a Pharathonite of the children of Ephraim: and in his companie foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The twelfth, in the twelfth moneth, Holdai a Netophathite, of the ſtocke of Gothoniel: and in his companie foure and twentie thouſand.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Furthermore there were chiefe ouer the tribes of Iſrael, ouer the Rubenites, Duke Eliezer the ſonne of Zechri: ouer the Simeonites, Duke Saphatias the ſonne of Maacha:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: ouer the Leuites, Haſabias the ſonne of Camuel: ouer the Aaronites, Sadoc:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: ouer Iuda, Eliu the brother of Dauid: ouer Iſſachar, Amri the ſonne of Michael:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: ouer the Zabulonites, Ieſmaias the ſonne of Abdias: ouer the Nepthalites, Ierimoth the ſonne of Ozriel:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: ouer the children of Ephraim, Oſee the ſonne of Ozaziu: ouer the halfe tribe of manaſſes, Ioel the ſonne of Phadaia:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and ouer the halfe tribe of Manaſſes in Galaad, Iaddo the ſonne of Zacharias: and our Beniamin, Iaſiel the ſonne of Abner.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But ouer Dan, Ezrihel the ſonne of Ieroham: theſe be the princes of the children of Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid would not number them from twentie yeares downeward: becauſe our Lord had ſayd that he would multiplie Iſrael as the ſtarres of heauen.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Ioab the ſonne of Saruia beganne to number, and finished not: becauſe vpon this there fel wrath vpon Iſrael: and therfore the number of them that were numbered, was not regeſtred in the chronicles of king Dauid.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And ouer the kinges treaſures was Azmoth the ſonne of Adiel, and ouer thoſe treaſures, which were in the cities, and in the townes, and in the towers, Ionathan the ſonne of Ozias was preſident.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And ouer huſbandrie, and the huſbandmen, which tilled the ground, Ezri the ſonne of Chelub was ouerſeer:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and ouer the dreſſers of vineyardes, Semeias a Romathite: and ouer the wine cellars, Zabdias an Aphonite.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: For ouer the Oliuetes and the figgegroues, which were in the champayne, was Balanam a Gederite: and ouer the oile cellars, Ioas.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Furthermore ouer the heardes that fed in Saron, the ouerſeer was Setrai a Saronite: and ouer the oxen in the valleis Saphat the ſonne of Adli:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: but ouer the camels, Vbil an Iſmaelite: and ouer the aſſes, Iadias a Meronathite:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: ouer the sheepe alſo Iaziz an Agarene. al theſe, princes of the ſubſtance of king Dauid.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Ionathan Dauids vncle, a counſeler, a man wiſe and learned: He and Iahiel the ſonne of Hachamoni were with the kinges ſonnes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Achitophel alſo the kinges counſeler, and Chuſai an Arachite the kinges freinde.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: After Achitophel was Ioiada the ſonne of Banaias, and Abiathar. And the prince of the kinges armie was Ioab.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: DAVID therfore called together al the princes of Iſrael, the dukes of the tribes, and the heades of the compaynies, which miniſtred to the king: the tribunes alſo and the centurions, and them that were chiefe ouer the ſubſtance and poſſeſſions of the king, and his ſonnes with the eunuches, and the mightie, and al the moſt viliant in the hoſt of Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And when the king had riſen vp, and ſtoode, he ſayd: Heare me my brethren, and my people: I meant to haue built a houſe, wherein the Arke of our Lord might reſt, and the foote ſtoole of the feete of our God: and to build it I prepared al thinges.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But God ſayd to me: Thou shalt not build a houſe to my name: becauſe thou art a man of warre, and haſt ſhed bloud.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Howbeit our Lord the God of Iſrael choſe me of al the houſe of my father, to be king ouer Iſrael for euer: for of Iuda he choſe the princes: moreouer of the houſe of Iuda, my fathers houſe: and of the ſonnes of my father, it pleaſed him to chooſe me king ouer al Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and of my ſonnes (for our Lord hath geuen me manie ſonnes) he hath choſen Salomon my ſonne, to ſitte in the throne of the kingdome of our Lord ouer Iſrael,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and he ſayd to me: Salomon thy ſonne shal build my houſe, and my courtes: for him haue I choſen to me for a ſonne, and I wil be to him for a father.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And I wil confirme his kingdome for euer, if he shal perſeuere to doe my preceptes, and my iudgementes, as at this day.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Now then before al the aſſemblie of Iſrael in the hearing of our God, keepe ye, & ſearch al the commandmentes of our Lord God: that you may poſſeſſe the good land, and may leaue it to your children after you for euer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And thou Salomon my ſonne, know the God of thy father, and ſerue him with a perfect hart, and a voluntarie minde: for our Lord ſearcheth al hartes, and vnderſtandeth al cogitations of mindes. If thou ſeeke him, thou shalt finde: but if thou forſake him he wil reiect thee for euer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Now therfore becauſe our Lord hath choſen thee to build the houſe of the Sanctuarie, take courage, and perfitte it.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid gaue to Salomon his ſonne a deſcription of the porch, and of the temple, and of the cellars, and of the vpper loft, and of the chambers in the inner roomes, and of the houſe of the propitiation,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: moreouer alſo of al the courtes, which he had thought vpon, and of the chambers round about, for the treaſures of the houſe of our Lord, and for the treaſures of the holie thinges,
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and of the diuiſions of the Prieſtes and the Leuites, for al the workes of the houſe of our Lord, and for al the veſſels of the miniſterie of the temple of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Gold in weight for euerie veſſel of the miniſterie. A weight of ſiluer alſo according to the diuerſitie of the veſſels and workes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And for golden candleſtickes alſo, and their lampes, gold according to the meaſure of euerie candleſticke, and of the lampes. In like maner alſo for the ſiluer candleſtickes, and for their lampes, according to the diuerſitie of the meaſure, he deliuered a weight of ſiluer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: He gaue alſo gold for tables of propoſition, according to the diuerſitie of the tables: in like maner alſo ſiluer for other ſiluer tables.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: For flesh hookes alſo, and phials, and cenſars of moſt pure gold, and for little lions of gold, according to the qualitie of the meaſure; he diſtributed a weight, for lyon and lyon. In like maner alſo for lyons of ſiluer he ſeperated a diuerſe weight of ſiluer.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And for the Altar whereupon incenſe is burnt, he gaue moſt pure gold: that of it might be made a ſimilitude of the chariote of the Cherubs ſpredding their winges, and couering the Arke of the couenant of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Al thinges, quoth he, came writen with the hand of our Lord vnto me: that I might vnderſtand al the workes of the paterne.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid alſo ſayd to Salomon his ſonne: Deale manfully, and take courage, and doe it: feare not, and be not diſmayed: for our Lord my God wil be with thee, and wil not leaue thee, nor forſake thee, til thou perfite al the worke of the miniſterie of the houſe of our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Behold the diuiſions of the Prieſtes and the Leuites, for euerie miniſterie of the houſe of our Lord, aſſiſt thee, and are readie, and as wel the princes know, as the people, to doe al thy preceptes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: AND Dauid the king ſpake to al the aſſemblie: Salomon my ſonne alone hath God choſen, as yet a child and a litle tender one: for the worke is great, neither is the habitation prepared for man, but for God.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And I with al my abilitie haue prepared the expenſes of the houſe of my God. Gold for veſſels of gold, and ſiluer for them of ſiluer, braſſe for them of braſſe, yron for them of yron, wood for them of wood: and onyx ſtones, and as it were ſtibians, & of diuerſe colours, and euerie precious ſtone, and marble of Paros moſt abundantly:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and aboue theſe thinges, which I haue offered into the houſe of my God, I geue of myne owne peculiar goods, gold and ſiluer vnto the temple of my God, beſide thoſe thinges, which I haue prepared for the holie houſe.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Three thouſand talentes of gold of the gold of Ophir: and ſeuen thouſand talentes of moſt approued ſiluer, to guilte the walles of the temple.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And, whereſoeuer there needeth gold, of gold: and wherſoeuer there needeth filuer, of ſiluer: let the workes be made by the handes of the artificers: and if any man offer voluntarily, let him fil his hand to day, and offer what he wil to our Lord.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: The princes therfore of the families promiſed, and the nobles of the tribes of Iſrael, the tribunes alſo and the centurions, and the princes of the kinges poſſeſſions.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they gaue vnto the workes of the houſe of our Lord, of gold, fiue thouſand talentes, and ten thouſand ſolidos: of ſiluer ten thouſand talentes, and of braſſe eightene thouſand talentes: of yron alſo an hundred thouſand talentes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And with whomſoeuer were found ſtones, they gaue them into the treaſures of the houſe of our Lord, by the hand of Iahiel the Gerſonite.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the people reioyſed, when they promiſed vowes of their owne accord: becauſe they did offer them to our Lord with al their hart: yea and Dauid the king reioyſed with great ioy.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he bleſſed our Lord before al the multitude, and he ſayd: Bleſſed art thou ô Lord the God of Iſrael our father from eternitie vnto eternitie.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Thine ô Lord is the magnificence, and might, and glorie, and victorie: & to thee is the prayſe: for al thinges that be in heauen, and in the earth, are thine: thine ô Lord is, the kingdom, and thou art ouer al princes.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Thine are riches and thine is glorie: thou haſt dominion ouer al, in thy hand is power & might: in thy hand greateneſſe, and the empire of al thinges.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Now therfore our God we confeſſe to thee, and we prayſe thy glorious name.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Who am I, and what is my people, that we can promiſſe thee al theſe thinges? al are thine: and thinges that we receiued of thy hand, we haue geuen thee.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: For we are pilgrimes before thee, and ſtrangers, as al our fathers. Our daies are as a shadow vpon the earth, and there is noe abyding.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Lord our God, al this plentie, which we haue prepared that a houſe might be built to thy holie name, is of thy hand, and al thinges are thine.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: I know my God that thou proueſt the hartes, and loueſt ſimplicitie, wherfore I alſo in the ſimplicitie of my hart, gladly haue offered al theſe thinges: and thy people, which is here found, I haue ſene with great ioy offer thee donaries.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Lord God of Abraham, and Iſaac, and Iſrael our fathers, keepe for euer this wil of their hart, and let this mind reinayne alwaies to the honour of thee.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: To Salomon alſo my ſonne geue a perfect hart, that he keepe thy commandementes, thy teſtimonies, and thy ceremonies, and doe al thinges: and build the houſe, the expenſes whereof I haue prepared.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Dauid commanded the whole aſſemblie: Bleſſe ye our Lord God. And al the aſſemblie bleſſed our Lord the God of their fathers: and they bowed themſelues, and adored God, and then the king.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they immolated victime to our Lord: and they offered holocauſtes the day folowing, oxen a thouſand, rammes a thouſand, lambes a thouſand with their libamentes, & with al rite moſt abundantly for al Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And they did eate, and drinke before our Lord in that day with great ioy. And they anoynted the ſecond time Salomon the ſonne of Dauid. And they anoynted him to our Lord for the prince, and Sadoc for the high prieſt.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And Salomon ſate vpon the throne of our Lord as king for Dauid his father, and he pleaſed al: & al Iſrael obeyed him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and al the princes, and men of might, and al the ſonnes of king Dauid gaue their hand, and were ſubiect to Salomon the king.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Our Lord therfore magnified Salomon ouer al Iſrael: and gaue him the glorie of a kingdom, ſuch as no king of Iſrael had before him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: Dauid therfore the ſonne of Iſai reigned ouer al Iſrael.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And the daies, that he reigned ouer Iſrael, were fourtie yeares: in Hebron he reigned ſeuen yeares, and in Ieruſalem three and thirtie yeares.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: And he died in a good age, ful of daies, and riches, and glorie. And Salomon his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: But the actes of king Dauid the firſt and the laſt are writen in the Booke of Samuel the Seer, & in the Booke of Nathan the prophete, & in the Volume of Gad the Seer:
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: and of al his kingdom, and ſtrength, and of the times, that paſſed vnder him, either in Iſrael, or in al the kingdomes of the earth.
label: 1 Paralipomenon

text: SALOMON therfore the ſonne of Dauid was ſtrengthened in his kingdom, and our Lord was with him, and magnified him on high.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Salomon commanded al Iſrael, the tribunes, and the centurious, and the dukes, and iudges of al Iſrael, and the princes of the families:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and he went with al the multitude into the Excelſe of Gabaon, where was the tabernacle of the couenant of our Lord, which Moyſes the ſeruant of God made, in the wilderneſſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For Dauid had brought the Arke of God from Cariathiarim into the place, which he had prepared for it, and where he had pitcht a tabernacle for it, that is, in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The altar alſo of braſſe, which Beſeleel the ſonne of Vri the ſonne of Hur had made was there before the tabernacle of our Lord: which alſo Salomon ſought, and al the aſſemblie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Salomon went vp to the altar of braſſe, before the tabernacle of the couenant of our Lord, and offered on it a thouſand hoſtes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And behold in that verie night God appeared to him, ſaying: Aske what thou wilt that I may geue it thee.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Salomon ſayd to God: Thou haſt done great mercie with my father Dauid: and haſt made me king for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Now therfore Lord God be thy word fulfilled, which thou haſt promiſed to Dauid my father: for thou haſt made me king ouer thy people great in number, which is ſo innumerable as the duſt of the earth.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Geue me wiſdom and intelligence, that I may come in & goe out before thy people: for who can worthely iudge this thy people, which is ſo great?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And God ſayd to Salomon: Becauſe this rather hath pleaſed thy hart, and thou haſt not asked riches, and ſubſtance, and glorie, not their liues that hate thee, no nor manie dayes of life: but haſt deſired wiſdom and knowledge, that thou mayſt be able to iudge my people, ouer which I haue made thee king.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Wiſdom and knowledge are geuen thee: and riches, and ſubſtance and glorie I wil geue thee, ſoe that none among the kinges neither before thee, nor after thee shal be like thee.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Salomon therfore came from the Excelſe of Gabaon into Ieruſalem before the tabernacle of couenant, & reigned ouer Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon
