text: And he gathered to him chariotes and horſemen, and there amounted to him a thouſand foure hundred chariotes, and twelue thouſand horſemen: and he cauſed them to be in the cities of the chariotes, and with the king in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the king gaue ſiluer and gold in Ieruſalem as ſtones, & cedar trees as ſycomores, which grow in the champayne in great multitude.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And there were horſes brought him from Ægypt, and from Coa by the kinges merchantes, which went, and brought by a price,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: a chariote of foure horſes for ſix hundred peces of ſiluer, and an horſe for an hundred fiftie: in like maner of al the kingdomes of Hetheites, and of the kinges of Syria market was made.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND Salomon determined to build a houſe to the name of our Lord, and a palace for himſelf.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he numbred ſeuentie thouſand men that caried on their shoulders, and eightie thouſand that ſhould hew ſtones in the mountaynes, and ouerſeers of them three thouſand ſix hundred.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He ſent alſo to Hiram the king of Tyre, ſaying: As thou didſt with Dauid my father, and didſt ſend him cedar trees, to build him a houſe, wherin alſo he dwelt:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: ſo doe with me that I may build a houſe to the name of our Lord my God, that I may conſecrate it to burne incenſe before him, and to perfume with aromatical ſpices, and to the euerlaſting propoſition of loaues, and for holocauſtes, morning and euening, on the ſabbathes alſo, and the newmoones, and the ſolemnities of our Lord God for euer, which are commanded Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For the houſe which I deſire to build, is great: for our God is great aboue al goddes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who then can be able, to build him a worthie houſe? if heauen, and the heauens of heauens can not conteyne him: how great am I, that I may build him a houſe? but to this end only, that incenſe may be burnt before him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Send me therfore a cunning man, that hath skil to worke in gold, and ſiluer, braſſe, and yron, purple, ſcarlet, and hyacinth, and that knoweth to make engraued workes with theſe artificers, which I haue with me in Iewrie, and Ieruſalem, whom Dauid my father prepared.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But ſend me alſo cedar trees, firretrees, and pintrees from Libanus: for I know that thy ſeruantes haue skil to hew the timber of Libanus, and my ſeruantes shal be with thy ſeruantes,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: that manie trees maybe prepared for me. For the houſe which I deſire to build, is exceding great, and glorious.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer to the workemen, that ſhal hew the trees, thy ſeruantes, I wil geue for victuals of wheat twentie thouſand cores, and of barley as manie cores, and of wine twentie thouſand, oyle alſo twentie thouſand ſates
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Hiram the king of Tyre by letters, which he ſent to Salomon, ſayd: Becauſe the Lord loued his people, therfore hath he made thee to reigne ouer it.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he added, ſaying: Bleſſed be the Lord the God of Iſrael, that made heauen and earth, who hath geuen to Dauid the king a ſonne wiſe and learned, and of vnderſtanding, and prudent, to build a houſe to the Lord, and a palace for himſelf.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: I therfore haue ſent thee a man wiſe and moſt skilful Hiram, my father,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: the ſonne of a woman of the daughters of Dan, whoſe father was a Tyrian, who knoweth to worke in gold, and ſiluer, braſſe, and yron, and marble, and in timber, in purple alſo, and hiacinth, and ſilke and ſcarlet: and that knoweth to graue al engrauing, and to deuiſe wiſely whatſoeuer in the worke is neceſſarie with thy artificers, and with the artificers of my lord Dauid thy father.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The wheate therfore, and barley, and oile, and wine, which thou my lord haſt promiſed, ſend to thy ſeruantes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And we wil cut downe the trees out of Libanus, as manie as shal be neceſſarie for thee, and wil conuey them in boates by the ſea vnto Ioppe: and it shal be thy part to tranſport them into Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Salomon therfore numbred al the men, that were proſelytes in the land of Iſrael, after the numbering which Dauid his father numbered, and they were found an hundred fiftie three thouſand and ſix hundred.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he made of them ſeuentie thouſand, that ſhould carie burdens on their shoulders, and eightie thouſand, that ſhould cut ſtones out of the mountaynes: and three thouſand and ſix hundred ouerſeers of the worke of the people.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND Salomon began to build the houſe of our Lord in Ieruſalem, in mount Moria, which had bene shewed to Dauid his father, in the place, which Dauid had prepared in the floore of Ornan the Iebuſeite.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he began to build in the ſecond moneth, in the fourth yeare of his kingdom.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And theſe be the fundations, which Salomon layd, to build the houſe of God, of length in the firſt meaſure ſixtie cubites, of bredth twentie cubites.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the porch before the front, which was extended in length according to the meaſure of the bredth of the houſe, of twentie cubites: moreouer the height was of an hundred twentie cubites: and he did guilt it on the inſide with moſt pure gold.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Alſo the greater houſe he couered with wodden bordes of firre tree, and he faſtened on plates of fine gold throughout: and he graued in it palme trees, and as it were litle chaines embracing one an other.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He paued alſo the floore of the Temple with moſt precious marble, in much beautie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer it was moſt tried gold, of the plates wherof he couered the houſe, and the beames therof, and the poſtes, and the walles, and the doores: and he graued cherubs in the walles.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He made alſo the houſe of Sanctum ſanctorum: the length according to the bredth of the houſe, of twentie cubites: and the bredth likewiſe of it twentie cubites: and he couered it with plates of gold, as it were ſix hundred talentes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and he made nailes of gold, ſo that euerie naile weighed fiftie ſicles a peece: the vpper chambers alſo he couered with gold.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He made alſo in the houſe of Sanctum ſanctorum two Cherubs of ſtatuarie worke: and he couered them with gold.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The winges of the cherubs were extended twentie cubites, ſo that one wing had fiue cubites, and touched the wal of the houſe: and the other hauing fiue cubites, touched the wing of the other cherub.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: In like maner the wing of the other cherub, had fiue cubites, and touched the wal: and his othet wing of fiue cubites, touched the wing of the other Cherub.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore the winges of both the cherubs were ſpred forth, and were extended twentie cubites: and they ſtoode vpright on their feete, and their faces were turned to the vtter houſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He made alſo a vele of hyacinth, purple, ſcarlet, and ſilke: & woue in it cherubs.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Before the doores alſo of the temple two pillers, which had fiue and thirtie cubites in height: moreouer their heades, of fiue cubites.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer alſo as it were litle chaynes in the oracle, & he put them to the heades of the pillers: pomegranates alſo an hundred, which he put betwen the litle chaynes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The pillers alſo them ſelues he put in the entrance of the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left: that, which was on the right hand, he called Iachin: and that on the left hand, Boz.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: HE made alſo an altar of braſſe of twentie cubites in length, and of twentie cubites in bredth, and of ten cubites in height.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: A Sea alſo caſt, ten cubites from brimme to brimme, round in compaſſe: it had fiue cubites in height, and a corde of thirtie cubites did compaſſe it round about.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: There was alſo vnder it the ſimilitude of oxen, and certaine engrauinges of ten cubites on the outſide compaſſed the bealie of the Sea, as it were with two rewes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the oxen were caſt: and the Sea it ſelf was ſette vpon the twelue oxen, of the which three looked toward the North, and other three to the Weſt: moreouer other three to the South, and the three that remayned, to the Eaſt, hauing the Sea put vpon them: and the hinder partes of the oxen were inward vnder the ſea.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the thickneſſe therof had the meaſure of a palme, and the brimme therof was as it were the brimme of a chalice, or of a criſped lilie: and it held three thouſand metretes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He made alſo ten lauatories: and ſet fiue on the right hand, and fiue on the left, that they might wash in them al thinges, that they would offer for holocauſt: moreouer in the Sea the prieſtes were washed.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he made alſo ten golden candleſtickes, according to the fashion which they were commanded to be made by: and he ſet them in the temple, fiue on the right hand, & fiue on the left.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer alſo ten tables: and he ſet them in the temple, fiue on the right hand, and fiue on the left. Phials alſo of gold an hundred.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He made alſo the court of the prieſtes, and a great hal: and doores in the hal, which he couered with braſſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer he ſet the Sea on the right ſide agaynſt the Eaſt toward the South.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Hiram made cauldrons, and flesh hookes, and phials: and accomplished al the kinges worke in the houſe of God:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: that is to ſay, two pillers, and the chapiters, and the heades, and as it were certayne litle nettes, which should couer the heades ouer the chapiters.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Pomegranates alſo foure hundred, and two litle nettes, ſoe that two rewes of the pomegranates were ioyned to ech litle nette, which couered the pommels, and the heades of the pillers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He made feete alſo, and lauatories, which he put vpon the feete:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: one ſea, alſo twelue oxen vnder the ſea.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the cauldrons, and flesh hookes, and phials. Al the veſſels did Hiram his father make for Salomon in the houſe of our Lord of moſt pure braſſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: In the countrie of Iordan did the king caſt them, in a clay ground bewen Socot and Saredatha.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the multitude of veſſels was innumerable, ſo that the weight of the braſſe was not knowen.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Salomon made al the veſſels of the houſe of God, and the golden altar, and the tables, & vpon them the loaues of propoſition,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: the candleſtickes alſo with their lampes to giue light before the oracle, according to the rite, of moſt pure gold:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and certayne florishing thinges, and lampes, and golden tonges al were made of moſt fine gold.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The veſſels alſo of perfume and cenſars, and phials, and litle mortars, of moſt pure gold. And he graued the doores of the inner temple, that is, in Sancta ſanctorum: and the doores of the temple without of gold. And ſo al the worke was finishd which Salomon made in the houſe of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: SALOMON therfore brought in al the thinges, that Dauid his father had vowed, the ſiluer, and gold, and al the veſſels he put in the treaſures of the houſe of God.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: After which thinges he gathered together al the ancientes of Iſtael, and al the princes of the tribes, and the heades of families, of the children of Iſrael into Ieruſalem, to bring the Arke of the couenant of our Lord from the Citie of Dauid, which is Sion.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: There came therfore vnto the king al the men of Iſrael in the ſolemne day of the ſeuenth moneth.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when al the ancientes of Iſrael were come, the Leuites caried the Arke,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and brought it in, and al the furniture of the tabernacle. Moreouer the Prieſtes, with the Leuites did carrie the veſſels of the Sanctuarie, which were in the tabernacle.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And king Salomon, and al the aſſemblie of Iſrael, and al that were gathered before the Arke, immolated rammes, and oxen without anie number: for ſo great was the multitude of victimes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the prieſtes brought in the Arke of the couenant of our Lord into his place, that is, to the oracle of the temple, into Sancta ſanctorum vnder the winges of the cherubs:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: ſo that the cherubs ſpred their winges ouer the place, wherin the Arke was ſet, and couered the Arke it ſelfe with his barres.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the heades of the barres, wherwith the Arke was caried, becauſe they were a litle longer, appeared before the oracle: but if a man had beene a litle outward, he could not ſee them. The Arke therfore was there vntil this preſent day.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And there was nothing in the Arke, but the two tables, which Moyſes had put in Horeb, when our Lord gaue the law to the children of Iſrael coming out of Ægypt.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the Prieſtes being gone out of the Sanctuarie ( for al the prieſtes that could be found there, were ſanctified, neither as yet at that time were the courſes, and the order of the miniſteries deuided among them )
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: as wel the Leuites as the ſinging men, that is, both they which were vnder Aſaph, and they which were vnder Heman, and they which were vnder Idithun, their ſonnes, & brethren reueſted with finne linnen clothes, ſounded on cymbals, and pſalteries, and harpes, ſtanding at the Eaſt ſide of the Altar, and with them Prieſtes an hundred twentie, ſounding with trumpettes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore al ſounding together, both with trumpettes, and voyce, and cymbals, and organes, and with diuerſe kind of muſical inſtrumentes, and lifteng vp their voice on high: the ſound was heard far of, ſo that when they began to prayſe our Lord, and to ſay: Confeſſe to our Lord becauſe he is good, becauſe his mercie is for euer: the houſe of God was filled with a cloud,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: that the Prieſtes could not ſtand and miniſter for the darkeneſſe. For the glorie of our Lord had filled the houſe of God.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: THEN Salomon ſayd: Our Lord promiſed that he would dwel in darkeneſſe:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and I haue built a houſe to his name, that he might dwel there for euer.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the king turned his face, and bleſſed al the multitude of Iſrael ( for al the multitude ſtood attent ) and ſayd:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Bleſſed be our Lord the God of Iſrael, who in worke hath accomplished that, which he ſpake to Dauid my father, ſaying:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: From the day, that I brought my people out of the Land of Aegypt, I choſe not a citie of al the tribes of Iſrael, that a houſe might be built in it to my name: neither did I chooſe anie other man, to be Duke in my people Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: but I choſe Ieruſalem, that my, name may be in it: and I choſe Dauid, that I might appoynt him ouer my people Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And wheras Dauid my father had meant to build a houſe to the name of our Lord the God of Iſrael,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: our Lord ſayd to him: Becauſe thy wil was this, that thou wouldeſt build a houſe to my name, thou haſt done wel certes to haue ſuch a wil:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: howbeit thou shalt not build the houſe, but thy ſonne, which shal come out of thy loynes, he ſhal build a houſe to my name.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Our Lord therfore hath accomplished his word, which he ſpake: and I am riſen for Dauid my father, and ſit vpon the throne of Iſrael, as our Lord hath ſpoken: and haue built a houſe to the name of our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And I haue put in it the Arke, wherin is the couenant of our Lord, which he made with the children of Iſrael:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He therfore ſtoode before the Altar of our Lord, ouer agaynſt al the multitude of Iſrael, and ſtretched forth his handes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For Salomon had made an eminent place of braſſe, and had put it in the middes of the Temple, hauing fiue cubites of length, & bredth, & three of height: & he ſtoode vpon it: & afterward kneeling ouer agaynſt al the multitude of Iſrael, and his handes lifted vp toward heauen,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: he ſayd: Lord God of Iſrael, there is not the like God to thee in heauen and in earth: which keepeſt couenant and mercie with thy ſeruantes, that walke before thee in al their hart:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: which haſt performed to thy ſeruant Dauid my father what thinges ſoeuer thou hadſt ſpoken to him: and the thinges that by mouth thou hadſt promiſed, in worke thou haſt accomplished, as alſo the preſent time proueth.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Now therfore Lord God of Iſrael, fulfil to thy ſeruant my father Dauid, what ſoeuer thou didſt ſpeake to him, ſaying: There shal not fayle of thee a man before me, to ſitte vpon the throne of Iſrael: yet ſo if thy children keepe their waies, and walke in my law, as thou alſo haſt walked before me.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And now Lord God of Iſrael, be thy word confirmed, which thou haſt ſpoken to thy ſeruant Dauid.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Is it credible then that God ſhould dwel with men vpon the earth? If heauen and the heauens of heauens doe not take thee, how much more this houſe, which I haue built?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But to this end only it is made, that thou ſhouldeſt reſpect the prayer of thy ſeruant, and his ſupplication Lord my God: and mayſt heare the prayers, which thy ſeruant powreth out before thee:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: that thou open thine eies vpon this houſe daies & nightes, vpon the place, wherein thou haſt promiſed that thy name ſhould be inuocated,

text: and wouldeſt heare the prayer, which thy ſeruant prayeth in it: and mayſt heare the prayers of thy ſeruant, and of thy people Iſrael. Whoſoeuer shal pray in this place, heare out of thy habitation, that is from the heauens, and be propitious.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: If anie man shal ſinne agaynſt his neighbour, and come readie to ſweare agaynſt him, and binde himſelf with a curſe before the altar in this houſe:

text: thou shalt heare from heauen, and ſhalt doe the iudgement of thy ſeruantes, ſo that thou render to the vniuſt his way vpon his owne head, and reuenge the iuſt, rewarding him according to his iuſtice.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: If thy people Iſrael shal be ouercome of their enemies, ( for they wil ſinne to thee ) and conuerted shal doe penance, and beſech thy name, and pray in this place,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: thou shalt heare from heauen, and be thou propetious to the ſinne of thy people Iſrael, and reduce them into the land, which thou gaueſt them, and their fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: If the heauen being ſhut, there fal no rayne for the ſinnes of the people, and they shal beſech thee in this place, and shal confeſſe to thy name, and shal be conuerted from their ſinnes, when thou shalt afflict them,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: heare from heauen ô Lord, and forgeue the ſinnes of thy ſeruantes and of thy people Iſrael, and teach them the good way, by the which they may goe: and geue rayne to thy land, which thou haſt geuen thy people to poſſeſſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: If famine shal ariſe in the land, and peſtilence, ruſt, and blaſt, and locuſt, and bruche, and the enemies, waſting the countries, shal beſiege the gates of the citie, and al plague and infirmitie shal preſſe them:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: if any of thy people Iſrael shal pray, knowing their plague and infirmitie, and shal ſpred forth their handes in this houſe,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: that they may feare thee, and walke in thy waies al the daies, that they liue vpon the face of the land, which thou haſt geuen to our fathers.

text: thou shalt heare from heauen thy moſt firme habitation, & shalt do al thinges, for the which that pilgrime shal inuocate thee: that al the peoples of the earth may know thy name, and may feare thee, as thy people Iſrael, and may know, that thy name is inuocated vpon this houſe, which I haue built.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: If thy people shal goe forth to warre agaynſt their aduerſaries, by the way, that thou ſhalt ſend them, shal adore thee agaynſt the way, wherein is this citie, which thou haſt choſen, and the houſe, which I haue built to thy name:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: thou shalt from heauen heare their prayers, and petition, and doe thou reuenge.

text: And if they shal ſinne to thee ( for there is no man that ſinneth not ) and thou be angrie with them, and deliuer them to the enemies, and they leade them captiue into a farre countrie, or which is neere at the leaſt,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: thou shalt heare from heauen, that is, from thy firme habitation their prayers, and doe thou iudgement, and forgeue thy people, although ſinneful:

label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Lord God turne not away from the face of thy Chriſt: remember the mercies of Dauid thy ſeruant.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Neither could the Prieſtes enter into the Temple of our Lord, becauſe the maieſtie of our Lord had filled the temple of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and al the children of Iſrael ſawe the fyre deſcending, and the glorie of our Lord vpon the houſe: and falling flat on the earth vpon the pauement paued with ſtone, they adored, and prayſed our Lord: Becauſe he is good, becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the king and al the people immolated victimes before our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: . King Salomon therfore killed hoſtes, of oxen twentie two thouſand, of rammes an hundred twentie thouſand: and the king and al the people dedicated the houſe of God.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the Prieſtes ſtood in their offices: and the Leuites with the inſtrumentes of the ſongues of our Lord, which Dauid the king made to prayſe our Lord: Becauſe his mercie is for euer, ſinging the hymnes of Dauid by their handes: moreouer the Prieſtes ſounded with trumpettes before them, and al Iſrael ſtood.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Salomon alſo ſanctified the middes of the court before the temple of our Lord: for he had offered there the holocauſtes, and the fatte of the pacifiques: becauſe the braſen altar, which he had made, could not ſuſteyne the holocauſtes and the ſacrifices and the fatte.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Salomon therfore made a ſolemnitie at that time ſeuen daies, and al Iſrael with him, an aſſemblie verie great, from the entrance of Emath to the Torrent of Aegypt.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he made in the eight day an aſſemblie, becauſe he had dedicated the altar ſeuen daies, and had celebrated the ſolemnitie ſeuen daies.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore in the three and twenteth day of the ſeuenth moneth, he diſmiſt the people to their tabernacles, reioyſing and being glad for the good, that our Lord had done to Dauid, and Salomon, and Iſrael his people.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Salomon accomplished the houſe of our Lord, and the houſe of the king, and al that he had diſpoſed in his hart to do, in the houſe of our Lord, and in his owne houſe, and he proſpered.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And our Lord appeared to him by night, and ſayd: I haue heard thy prayer, and haue choſen this place to me for a houſe of ſacrifice.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: If I shal shut heauen, and rayne fal not, and shal bid and command the locuſt to deuoure the land, and shal ſend peſtilence into my people:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and my people being conuerted, vpon whom my name is inuocated, ſhal beſech me, and ſeeke out my face, and shal doe penance from their moſt wicked waies: I alſo wil heare from heauen, and wil be propitious to their ſinnes, and wil ſaue their land.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Mine eies alſo shal be opened, and mine eares erected to his prayer, that shal pray in this place.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For I haue choſen, and haue ſanctified this place, that my name may be there for euer, and mine eies and my hart may remaine there al daies.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Thou alſo if thou walke before me, as Dauid thy father walked, and shalt doe according to al thinges, which I haue commanded thee, and shalt keepe my iuſtices and iudgementes:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: I wil rayſe vp the throne of thy kingdom, as I promiſed to Dauid thy father, ſaying: There shal not be taken away of thy ſtocke a man, that shal be prince in Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But if you shal be turned away, and shal forſake my iuſtices, and my preceptes, which I haue propoſed to you, and going shal ſerue ſtrange goddes, and adore them,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: I wil plucke you out of my land, which I haue geuen you: and this houſe, which I haue ſanctified to my name, I wil caſt away from my face, and wil deliuer it for a parable, and an exemple to al peoples.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And this houſe shal be for a prouerbe to al paſſengers, and they shal ſay being aſtonyshed: Why hath the Lord done ſo to this land, and to this houſe?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they shal anſwer: Becauſe they forſooke the Lord the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the Land of Aegypt, and tooke hold of ſtrange goddes, and adored them, and worshipped them: therfore are al theſe euils come vpon them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND twentie yeares being complete after that Salomon built the houſe of our Lord and his owne houſe:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: he built the cities, which Hiram had geuen to Salomon, and made the children of Iſrael dwel there.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He went alſo into Emath Suba, and obteyned it.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he built Palmira in the deſert, and he built other cities very wel fenſed in Emath.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he built Beth horon the vpper, and Beth horon the nether, walled cities hauing gates and barrigates and lockes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Balaath alſo and al the ſtrongeſt cities that were Salomons, and al the cities of the chariotes, and the cities of the horſemen. Al thinges whatſoeuer Salomon would, & diſpoſed, he built in Ieruſalem and in Libanus, and in al the land of his dominion.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Al the people that was leaft of the Hetheites, and Amorrheites, and Pherezeites, and Heueites, and Iebuſeites, which were not of the ſtocke of Iſrael,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: of their children: and of the poſteritie, which the children of Iſrael had not ſlaine, Salomon ſubdewed to be tributaries, vntil this day.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer of the children of Iſrael he ſette not to ſerue the kinges workes: for they were men of warre, and the chiefe captaines, and princes of his chariotes and horſemen.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And al the princes of king Salomons armie were two hundred fiftie, which taught the people.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the daughter of Pharao he remoued from the citie of Dauid, into the houſe, which he had built for her. For the king ſayd: My wife shal not dwel in the houſe of Dauid the king of Iſrael, becauſe it is ſanctified: becauſe the Arke of our Lord is entered into it.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Then Salomon offered holocauſtes to our Lord vpon the altar of our Lord, which he had built before the porch,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: that euerie day there might be offering on it, according to the precept of Moyſes, in the Sabbathes, and in the Calendes, and in the feſtiual daies thriſe a yere, that is to ſay, in the Solemnitie of Azymes, and in the Solemnitie of weekes, and in the Solemnitie of tabernacles.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he appoynted according to the diſpoſition of Dauid his father the offices of the Prieſtes in their miniſteries: & the Leuites in their order that they should prayſe, and miniſter before the Prieſtes according to the rite of euerie day: & the porters in their diuiſions by gate and gate: (for ſo Dauid the man of God had commanded.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Neither did they trangreſſe of the kinges commandementes as wel the Prieſtes as the Leuites, touching al thinges, that he had commanded, and in the cuſtodies of the treaſures.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Salomon had al expenſes prepared, from the day that he founded the houſe of our Lord, vntil the day wherein he perfitted it.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Then went Salomon into Aſiongaber, and into Ailath to the coaſt of the Red ſea, which is in the Land of Edom.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Hiram ſent vnto him by the handes of his ſeruantes, shippes, and cunning mariners, and they went with Salomons ſeruantes into Ophir, and they tooke from thence foure hundred fiftie talentes of gold, and brought it to king Salomon.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: THE queene of Saba alſo, when she had heard the fame of Salomon, came to proue him in hard propoſitions in Ieruſalem, with great riches, and camels, which caried ſpices, and very much gold, and pretious ſtones. And when ſhe was come to Salomon, ſhe ſpake to him what thinges ſoeuer were in her hart.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Salomon expounded to her al thinges that ſhe propounded: neither was there anie thing, that he made uot playne vnto her.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who after she ſaw, to witte, the wiſedom of Salomon, and the houſe which he had built,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: moreouer alſo the meates of his table, and the habitations of his ſeruantes, and the offices of his miniſters, and their garmentes, the cupbearers alſo, and their garmentes, and the victimes, which he immolated in the houſe of our Lord: there was no ſpirit in her anie longer, she was ſoe aſtonied.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And she ſayd to the king: The word is true, which I heard in my countrie of thy vertues and wiſdom.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: I did not beleue them that told it, vntil my ſelf was come, and mine eies had ſeene, and I had proued ſcarce the half part of thy wiſedom to haue beene told me: thou haſt paſſed the fame with thy vertues.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Bleſſed are thy men, and bleſſed are thy ſeruantes, which aſſiſt before thee at al time, and heare thy wiſedom.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Be the Lord thy God bleſſed, who would ordayne thee ouer his throne, king of the Lord thy God. Becauſe God loueth Iſrael, and wil preſetue it for euer: therfore hath he ſette thee king ouer it, to doe iudgementes and iuſtice.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And she gaue to the king an hundred twentie talentes of gold, and ſpices exceding much, and moſt pretious ſtones: there were not ſuch ſpices, as theſe, which the Queene of Saba gaue to King Salomon.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the ſeruantes of Hiram alſo with the ſeruantes of Salomon brought gold from Ophir, and Thymtrees, and moſt pretious ſtones:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: wherof the king made, to witte, of the Thymtrees, ſtayers in the houſe of our Lord, and in the kinges houſe, harpes alſo and pſalteries for the ſinging men: neuer were there ſeene ſuch trees in the Land of Iuda.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And king Salomon gaue to the Queene of Saba al thinges that she would, and that she asked, and manie moe thinges then she brought to him: who returning, went into her countrie with her ſeruantes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the weight of the gold, that was brought to Salomon euerie yeare was ſix hundred ſixtie ſix talentes of gold:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: beſide that ſumme, which the legates of diuers nations, and the merchantes were accuſtomed to bring, and al the kinges of Arabia, and the Dukes of the landes, which brought gold and ſiluer to Salomon.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: King Salomon therfore made two hundred golden ſpeares, of the ſumme of ſix hundred peces of gold, which were ſpent in euerie ſpeare:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: alſo three hundred golden shieldes of three hundred peces of gold, with which euerie shield was couered: and the king put them in the armarie, which was beſette with a wood.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The king alſo made a great throne of iuorie, and couered it with moſt fyne gold.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Six ſteppes alſo, wherwith the going vp was to the throne, and a foote ſtoole of gold, and two litle armes on either ſide, and two lions ſtanding by the litle armes,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: yea and other twelue litle lions ſtanding vpon the ſteppes on both ſides: there was not ſuch a throne in al kingdomes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Al the veſſels alſo of the kinges table were of gold, and the veſſels of the houſe of the foreſt of Libanus of moſt pure gold. For ſiluer in thoſe daies was reputed for nothing.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For the kinges shippes went into Tharſis with the ſeruantes of Hiram, once in three yeares: and they brought from thence gold and ſiluer, and yuorie, and apes, and pecockes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Salomon therfore was magnified aboue al the kinges of the earth for riches and glorie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And al the kinges of the earth deſired to ſee Salomons face, that they might heare the wiſedom, which God had geuen in his hart.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they brought him giftes, veſſels of ſiluer, and gold, and garmentes, and armour, and ſpices, horſes, and mules, euerie yeare.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Salomon alſo had fourtie thouſand horſes in the ſtables, and of chariotes, and horſemen twelue thouſand, and he placed them in the cities of the chariotes, and where the king was in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He exerciſed alſo authoritie ouer al the kinges from the riuer Euphrates vnto the land of the Philiſthines, and vnto the borders of Ægypt.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he made ſo great plentie of ſiluer in Ieruſalem as it were of ſtones: and of cedres ſo great a multitude as of ſicomores, which grow in the champayne.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And horſes were brought him out of Ægypt, and al countries.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the reſt of of the workes of Salomon the firſt and the laſt are writen in the wordes of Nathan the Prophet, and in the bookes of Ahias the Silonite, in the Viſion alſo of Addo the Seer, agayaſt Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Salomon reigned in Ieruſalem ouer al Iſrael fourtie yeares.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he ſlept with his fathers: and they buried him in the citie of Dauid: and Roboam his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND Roboam went forth into Sichem: for thither al Iſrael was aſſembled, to make him king.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Which when Ieraboam the ſonne of Nabat had heard, who was in Aegypt (for he was fled thither from Salomon) forthwith he returned.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they called him, & he came with al Iſrael & ſpake to Roboam, ſaying:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Thy father preſſed vs with a moſt hard yoke, do thou command lighter thinges then thy father, who layd vpon vs a heauie ſeruitude, and eaſe thou a litle of the burden, that we may ſerue thee.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who ſayd: After three daies returne ye to me. And when the people was gone,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: he tooke counſel with the Ancientes, which ſtoode before his father Salomon, whiles he yet liued, ſaying: What counſel geue you, that I may anſwer the people?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who ſayd to him: If thou wilt pleaſe this people, and pacifie them with wordes of clemencie, they wil ſerue thee at al times.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But he forſooke the counſel of the Ancientes, and began to treat with yongmen, that had beene brought vp with him, and were in his trayne.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he ſayd to them: What ſemeth to you? or what shal I anſwer this people, which hath ſayd to me: Eaſe the yoke which thy father layd vpon vs?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But they anſwered as yongmen, and brought vp with him in delicaneſſe, and ſayd: Thus shalt thou ſpeake to the people, that ſayd to thee: Thy father aggrauated our yoke, doe thou eaſe it: and thus shalt thou anſwer them: My leaſt finger is thicker then the loynes of my father.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: My father layd vpon yow an heauie yoke, and I wil adde a greater weight: my father bette you with ſcourges, but I wil beate you with ſcorpions.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ieroboam therfore came, and al the people to Roboam the third day, as he had commanded them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the king anſwered rough wordes, leauing the counſel of the Ancientes:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and he ſpake according to the yongmens wil: My father layd vpon you a heauie yoke, which I wil make heauier: my father bette you with ſcourges, but I wil beate you with ſcorpions.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he condeſcended not to the peoples requeſtes: for it was the wil of God, that his word should be accomplished, which he had ſpoken by the hand of Ahias the Silonite to Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And al the people when the king ſpake rough wordes, ſayd thus vnto him: We haue no part in Dauid, nor inheritance in the ſonne of Iſai. Returne into thy tabernacles ô Iſrael, and do thou feede thy houſe Dauid. And Iſrael went into their tabernacles.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But ouer the children of Iſrael, that dwelt in the cities of Iuda, Roboam reigned.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And king Roboam ſent Aduram, who was ouer the tributes, and the children of Iſrael ſtoned him, and he died: moreouer king Roboam made haſt to get vp into his chariote, and fled into Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Iſrael reuolted from the houſe of Dauid vntil this day.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND Roboam came into Ieruſalem, and called together al the houſe of Iuda and Beniamin, an hundred foureſcore thouſand choſen men and warriers, to fight agaynſt Iſrael, and to conuert his kingdom vnto him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the word of our Lord came to Semeias the man of God, ſaying:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Speake to Roboam the ſonne of Salomon the king of Iuda, and to al Iſrael, that is in Iuda and Beniamin:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Thus ſayth our Lord: You shal not goe vp, neither ſhal you fight agaynſt your brethren: let euerie man returne into his houſe, becauſe this thing is done by my wil. Who when they had heard the word of our Lord, returned, neither went they forward agaynſt Ieroboam.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Roboam dwelt in Ieruſalem, and built walled cities in Iuda.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he built Bethlehem, and Etam, and Thecue,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Bethſur alſo, and Socho, & Odollam,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: moreouer alſo Geth, and Mareſa, and Ziph,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: yea and Aduram, and Lachis, and Azeca,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Saraa alſo, and Aialon, and Hebron, which were in Iuda and Beniamin, moſt fenſed cities.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when he had incloſed them with walles, he put in them princes, and ſtore houſes of victuals, that is, of oile and wine.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and in euerie citie he made armories of shieldes and ſpeares, and he ſtrengthened them with great diligence, and reigned ouer Iuda and Beniamin.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the Prieſtes and Leuites, that were in al Iſrael, came to him out of al their ſeates,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: leauing their ſuburbes, and their poſſeſſious, and paſſing to Iuda, and Ieruſalem, becauſe Ieroboam had caſt them of, and their poſteritie: that they should not execute the prieſthood of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who made vnto him ſelfe prieſtes of the excelſes, and of diuels, and of the calues which he had made.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and of al the tribes of Iſrael, whoſoeuer had geuen their hart to ſeeke our Lord the God of Iſrael, came into Ieruſalem to immolate their victims before our Lord the God of their fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they ſtrenghened the kingdom of Iuda, and eſtablished Roboam the ſonne of Salomon for three yeares: for they walked in the waies of Dauid and Salomon, onlie three yeares.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Roboam tooke to wife Mahalath, the daughter of Ierimoth the ſonne of Dauid: Abihail alſo the daughter of Eliab the ſonne of Iſai,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: who bare him ſonnes Iehus, and Somorias, and Zoom.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: After this woman alſo he tooke Maacha the daughter of Abſalom, who bare him Abia, and Ethai, and Ziza, and Salomith.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Roboam loued Maacha the daughter of Abſalom aboue al his wiues, and concubines: for he had maried eightene wiues, and threeſcore concubines: and he begat eight and twentie ſonnes, and threeſcore daughters.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But he appoynted for head Abias the ſonne of Maacha duke ouer al his brethren: for he meant to make him king,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: becauſe he was wiſer, and mightier aboue al his ſonnes, and in al the coſtes of Iuda, and of Beniamin, and in al the walled cities: and he gaue them much meate, and he deſired manie wiues.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND when the kingdom of Roboam was ſtrengthened and fortified, he forſooke the law of our Lord, and al Iſrael with him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And in the fifth yeare of the kingdom of Roboam, came vp Seſac the king of Ægypt into Ieruſalem (becauſe they had ſinned to our Lord)
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: with a thouſand two hundred chariotes, and threeſcore thouſand horſemen: neither was anie number of the common people, that came with him out of Ægypt, to witte, Lybians, and Troglodytes, and Æthiopians.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he tooke the moſt fenſed cities in Iuda, and came ouer vnto Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Semeias the prophete went to Roboam, and to the princes of Iuda, that were gathered together in Ieruſalem, fleing from Seſac, and he ſayd to them: Thus ſayth our Lord: You haue leaft me, and I haue leaft you in the hand of Seſac.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the princes of Iſrael, and the king, being aſtonied, ſayd: Our Lord is iuſt.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when our Lord had ſeene that they were humbled, the word of our Lord came to Semeias, ſaying: Becauſe they are humbled, I wil not deſtroy them, and I wil geue them a litle ayde, and my furie shal not droppe vpon Ieruſalem by the hand of Seſac.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But yet they shal ſerue him, that they may know the diſtance of my ſeruice, and of the ſeruice of the kingdom of the earth.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore Seſac the king of Æpypt retyred from Ieruſalem, taking away the treaſures of the houſe of our Lord, and of the kinges houſe, and he tooke al thinges with him, and the golden shieldes that Salomon had made,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: for the which the king made braſen ones, and deliuered them to the princes of the shieldbearers, which kept the entrance of the palace.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when the king entred into the houſe of our Lord, the shieldbearers came, and tooke them, & brought them backe agayne to their armorie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But yet becauſe they were humbled, the wrath of our Lord was turned away from them, neither were they vtterly deſtroyed: for in Iuda there were found good workes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: King Roboam therfore was ſtrengthened in Ieruſalem, & reigned: one and fourtie yeares old was he when he beganne to reigne, and he reigned ſeuentene yeares in Ieruſalem, the citie, which our Lord choſe, to confirme his name there, out of al the tribes of Iſrael: and the name of his mother was Naama an Ammonite.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he did euil, and prepared not his hart to ſeke our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the workes of Roboam the firſt and the laſt are writen in the Bookes of Semeias the Prophete, and of Addo the Seer, and diligently expounded: and Roboam and Ietoboam fought one agaynſt the other al their daies.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Roboam ſlept with his fathers, and was buried in the citie of Dauid. And Abias his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: IN the eightenth yeare of king Ieroboam, reigned Abias ouer Iuda.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Thtee yeares reigned he in Ieruſalem, and his mothers name was Michaia, the daughter of Vriel of Gabaa: there was warre betwen Abias and Ieroboam.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when Abias had begun battel, and had moſt warlike men, & of choſen ones four hundreth thouſand: Ieroboam put his armie in aray on the contrarie ſide, eight hundreth thouſand men, who them ſelues alſo were choſen men, and moſt valiant to battels.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Abias therfore ſtood vpon mount Semeron, which was in Ephraim, and ſayd: Heare Ieroboam, and al Iſrael:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Are you ignorant that our Lord the God of Iſrael gaue the kingdom to Dauid ouer Iſrael for euer, to him and his children as a couenant of ſalt?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And there roſe vp Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, the ſeruant of Salomon the ſonne of Dauid: and rebelled agaynſt his lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And there were gathered to him al the moſt vayne men, and the children of Belial: and they preuayled agaynſt Roboam the ſonne of Salomon: moreouer Roboam was rude, and of a fearful hart, and could not reſiſt them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Now therfore you ſay that you are able to reſiſt the kingdom of our Lord, which he poſſeſſeth by the children of Dauid, and you haue a great multitude of people, and golden calues, which Ieroboam hath made you for goddes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And you haue caſt out the Prieſtes of of our Lord, the children of Aaron, and the Leuites: and you haue made you prieſtes, as al the peoples of the earth: whoſoeuer shal come & conſecrate his hand in a bullock of oxen, and in ſeuen rammes, is made the prieſt of them that are not goddes,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But our Lord is God, whom we forſake not, and the Prieſtes do miniſter to our Lord of the children of Aaron, and the Leuites are in their order.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Holocauſtes alſo they do offer to our Lord, euerie day morning and euening, and incenſe made according to the preceptes of the law, and the loaues are ſet forth on a moſt cleane table, and there is with vs the golden condleſticke, and the lampes therof, that they may be lighted alwaies at euening: for we keepe the preceptes of the Lord our God, whom you haue forſaken.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore in our hoſt God is the prince, and his Prieſtes, which ſound with trumpettes, and reſound agaynſt you: children of Iſrael fight not agaynſt our Lord the God of your fathers, becauſe it is not expedient for you.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He ſpeaking theſe thinges, Ieroboam endeuoured to entrappe him behind. And when he ſtood ouer agaynſt the enemies, he compaſſed Iuda vnwitting with his armie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Iudas looking backe, ſaw the battel at hand before and behind, and cryed to our Lord: and the Prieſtes begane to ſound with trumpettes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And al the men of Iuda made a ſhout: and behold they crying, God terrified Ieroboam, and al Iſrael that ſtood agaynſt Abias and Iuda.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the children of Iſrael fled from Iuda, and our Lord deliuered them into their hand.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Abias therfore and his people ſtroke them with a great ſlaughter, and there fel wounded of Iſrael fiue hundreth thouſand valiant men.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the children of Iſrael were humbled, at that time, and the children of Iuda excedingly encouraged becauſe they had truſted in our Lord the God of their fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Abias purſewed Ieroboam fleing, and he tooke his cities, Bethel and her daughters, and Ieſana with her daughters, Ephron alſo and her daughters.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Neither was Ieroboam able to reſiſt anie more, in the daies of Abias: whom our Lord ſtroke, and he died.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore Abias, his empite being ſtrengthened, tooke fourtene wiues: and he begat two and twentie ſonnes, and ſixtene daughters.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Abias, and of his waies and wordes, are writen diligently in the Booke of Addo the Prophete.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND Abias ſlept with his fathers, and they buried him in the Citie of Dauid: and Aſa his ſonne reigned for him, in whoſe daies the land was quiet tenne yeares.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Aſa did that which was good and pleaſing in the ſight of his God, and he ouerthrew the altars of ſtrange ſeruice, and the excelſes,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: .and brake the ſtatues, and cut downe the groues.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he commanded Iuda that they should ſeeke our Lord the God of their fathers, and ſhould doe the law, and al the commandementes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he tooke away out of al the cities of Iuda the altars, and temples, & reigned in peace.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He built alſo fenſed cities in Iuda, becauſe he was quiet, and there had no battels riſen in his time, our Lord geuing peace.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he ſayd to Iuda: Let vs build theſe cities, and compaſſe them with walles, and ſtrengthen them with towers, and gates, and lockes, whiles thinges are quiet from battels, becauſe we haue ſought out Lord the God of our fathers, and he hath geuen vs peace round about. They therfore did build, and there was no impediment in building.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Aſa had in his armie of them that caried ſhieldes and ſpeares, of Iuda three hundred thouſand: and of Beniamin ſhieldbearers and archers, two hundred eightie thouſand, al theſe were moſt valiant men.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Zara the Ethiopian with his armie iſſued forth agaynſt them, tenne hundred thouſand, and with three hundred chariotes: and he came as far as Mareſa.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Aſa went on to meete him, and ſet his armie in aray to battel in the vale Sephata, which is neere Mareſa.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he inuocated our Lord God, and ſayd: Lord there is no difference with thee, whether thou helpe in few, or in manie: helpe vs ô Lord our God: for hauing confidence in thee, and in thy name we are come agaynſt this multitude. Lord, thou art our God, let not man preuaile agaynſt thee.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Our Lord therfore tertified the Æthiopians before Aſa and Iuda: and the Æthiopians fled.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Aſa purſewed them, and the people that was with him, vnto Gerara: and the Æthiopians fel to vtter deſtruction, becauſe our Lord killing them, and his armie fighting they were deſtroyed. They tooke therfore manie ſpoiles,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and they ſtroke al the cities round about Gerara: for great terrour had inuaded al men: and they ſpoyled the cities, and caried away much praye.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and deſtroying the sheepecotes of sheepe, they tooke an infinite multitude of cattel, and of camels: and returned into Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND Azarias the ſonne of Oded, the Spirit of God coming vpon him,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: went out to meete Aſa, and ſayd to him: Heare ye me Aſa, and al Iuda and Beniamin: Our Lord is with you, becauſe you haue beene with him. If you wil ſeeke him, you shal finde: but if you forſake him, he wil forſake you.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And manie daies shal paſſe in Iſrael without the true God, and without Prieſt a teacher, and without the Law.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when they shal returne in their diſtreſſe to our Lord the God of Iſrael, and shal ſeeke him, they shal finde him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: At that time there shal not be peace to him that goeth out and cometh in, but terrours on euerie ſide in the inhabiters of the earth.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: for nation shal fight agaynſt nation, and citie agaynſt citie, becauſe our Lord wil truble them with al diſtreſſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: You therfore take courage, and let not your handes be diſſolued: for there shal be reward to your worke.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Which when Aſa had heard, to witte, the wordes, and the prophecie of Azarias the ſonne of Oded the prophete, he tooke courage, and tooke away the Idols out of al the land of Iuda, and out of Beniamin, and out of the cities, which he had taken, of mount Ephraim, and he dedicated the altar of our Lord, which was before the porche of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he gathered together al Iuda and Beniamin, and the ſtrangers with them of Ephraim, and of Manaſſes, and of Simeon: for manie were fled to him of Iſrael, ſeing that our Lord his God was with him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when they were come into Ieruſalem the third moneth, in the fiftenth yeare of the reigne of Aſa,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: they immolated to our Lord in that day of the ſpoiles, & the praie, that they had brought, oxen ſeuen hundred, and rammes ſeuen thouſand.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he went in after the maner to eſtablish the couenant, that they ſhould ſeeke our Lord the God of their fathers in al their hart, and in al their ſoul.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And if anie man, quoth he, shal not ſeeke our Lord the God of Iſrael, let him die, from the leaſt to the greateſt, from man vnto woman.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they ſware to our Lord with a lowd voyce in iubilation, and in noyſe of trumpet, and ſound of shaulmes,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: al that were in Iuda with execration: for in al their hart did they ſweare, and with al their wil did they ſeeke him, and found him, & our Lord gaue them reſt round about,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and Maacha the mother of king Aſa he depoſed from the royal empyre, becauſe she had made in a groue the idol of Priapus: which he wholy deſtroyed, and breaking into peeces, burnt it in the Torrent cedron.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the Excelſes were leaft in Iſrael: neuertheleſſe the hart of Aſa was perfect al his daies.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And thoſe thinges which his father had vowed, and him ſelf, he brought into the houſe of our Lord, gold and ſiluer, and of veſſels diuers furniture.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And there was no warre vnto the fiue and thirteth yeare of the reigne of Aſa.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND in the ſix and thirteth yeare of his reigne, came vp Baaſa the king of Iſrael into Iuda, and with a wall compaſſed Rama, that none could ſafely goe out and come in of the kingdom of Aſa.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Aſa therfore brought forth ſiluer and gold, out of the treaſures houſe of our Lord, and of the kinges treaſures, and he ſent to Benadad the king of Syria, who dwelt in Damaſcus, ſaying:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: There is league betwen me & thee, my father alſo and thy father had concord, wherfore I haue ſent thee ſiluer and gold, that breaking the league, which thou haſt with Baaſa the king of Iſrael, thou make him retire from me.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Which being knowen, Benadad ſent the princes of his hoſtes to the cities of Iſrael: who ſtroke Ahion, and Dan, and Ablemaim, and al the walled cities of Nephthali.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: which when Baaſa had heard, he ceaſed to build Rama, and intermitted his worke.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Aſa the king tooke al Iuda, and caried away the ſtones out of Rama, and the timber that Baaſa had prepared for the building: and he built of them Gabaa, & Maſpha.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: At that time came Hanani the prophete to Aſa the king of Iuda, and ſayd to him: Becauſe thou haſt had confidence in the king of Syria, and not in our Lord thy God, therfore hath the armie of the king of Syria eſcaped out of thy hand.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Were not the Æthiopians, and Libyians manie moe in chariotes, and horſemen, and a multitude exceding great: whom, when thou didſt beleue in our Lord, he deliuered into thy hand?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For the eies of our Lord behold al the earth, and geue ſtrength to them, that with perfect hart beleue in him. Thou therfore haſt done foolyshly, & for this cauſe from this preſent time shal battels ariſe agaynſt thee.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Aſa being angrie agaynſt the Seer, commanded him to be caſt into fetters: for he tooke indignation excedingly vpon this thing: and he ſlewe of the people at that time verie manie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the workes of Aſa the firſt & the laſt are writen in the Booke of the kinges of Iuda and Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Aſa alſo fel ſicke in the nine and thirteth yeare of his reigne, of a moſt vehement payne of his feete, and neither in his infirmitie did he ſeeke our Lord, but rather truſted in the arte of Phiſitians.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he ſlept with his fathers: and he died the one and fourteth yeare of his reigne.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they buried him in his ſepulchre, which he had digged for himſelf in the Citie of Dauid: and they layd him vpon his bed ful of ſpices and odoriferous oyntementes, which were made by the arte of apothecaries, and they burnt it ouer him with exceding ambition.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND Ioſaphat his ſonne reigned for him, & grew ſtrong agaynſt Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he appoynted numbers of ſouldiars in al the cities of Iuda, that were compaſſed with walles. And he placed garriſons in the land of Iuda, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Aſa his father had taken.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And our Lord was with Ioſaphat, becauſe he walked in the firſt waies of Dauid his father: and he truſted not in Baalim,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: but in the God of his father, and went forward in his preceptes, and not according to the ſinnes of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And our Lord confirmed the kingdom in his hand, and al Iuda gaue giftes to Ioſaphat: and there grew to him infinite riches, and much glorie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when his hart had taken courage for the waies of our Lord, he tooke away alſo the Excelſes and groues out of Iuda.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And in the third yeare of his kingdom, he ſent of his princes Benhail, and Abdias, and Zacharias, and Nathanael, and Micheas, that they ſhould teach in the cities of Iuda:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and with them Leuites, Semeias, and Nathanias, and Zabadias, Aſael alſo, and Semiramoth, and Ionathan, and Adonias and Tobias, and Thobadonias Leuites, and with them Eliſama, and Ioram Prieſtes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they taught the people in Iuda, hauing the booke of the law of our Lord: and they went about al the cities of Iuda, and inſtructed the people.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore the dread of our Lord came vpon al the kingdomes of the landes, that were round about Iuda, neither durſt they make battel agaynſt Ioſaphat.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and the Philiſtians brought giftes to Ioſaphat, and tribute of ſiluer, the Arabians alſo brought cattel, of rammes ſeuen thouſand ſeuen hundred, and buckegoates as manie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ioſaphat therfore grewe, and was magnified on high: and he built in Iuda houſes like to toures, and walled cities.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he prepared manie workes in the cities of Iuda: there were alſo men of warre, and valiant in Ieruſalem,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: of whom this is the number by the houſes and families of euerie one: In Iuda princes of the armie, Ednas duke, and with him moſt valiant men three hundred thouſand.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: After him Iohanan the prince, and with him two hundred eightie thouſand.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: After him alſo Amaſias the ſonne of Zechri, conſecrated to our Lord, and with him two hundred thouſand of valiant men.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Him followed Eliada valiant to battels, and with him of them that held bow & ſhield two hundred thouſand.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: After this man alſo Iozabad, and with him an hundred eightie thouſand readie ſouldiars.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Al theſe were at the hand of the king, beſide others, whom he had put in walled cities, in al Iuda.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: IOSAPHAT therfore was rich and verie glorious, and was ioyned in affinitie to Achab.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he went downe to him after certaine yeares into Samaria: at whoſe coming Achab killed muttons, and oxen very manie for him and the people that came with him: and he perſwaded him to goe vp into Ramoth Galaad.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Achab the king of Iſrael ſayd to Ioſaphat the king of Iuda: Come with me into Ramoth Galaad. To whom he anſwered: As I am thou alſo: as thy people; ſo my people alſo: and we wil be with thee in battel.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ioſaphat ſayd to the king of Iſrael: Conſult I beſech thee preſently the word of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore the king of Iſrael gathered together of the prophetes four hundred men, and ſayd to them: Shal we goe into Ramoth Galaad to fight, or ſitte ſtil? But they ſayd: Goe vp, ſay they, and God wil deliuer it into thy hand.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ioſaphat ſayd: Is there not here a prophete of our Lord, that we may enquire alſo of him?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the king of Iſrael ſayd to Ioſaphat: There is one man, of whom we may aske the wil of our Lord: but I hate him, becauſe he doth not prophecie me good, but euil at al times: and it is Micheas the ſonne of Iemla. And Ioſaphat ſayd: Speake not in this maner ô king.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The king of Iſrael therfore called one of the Eunuches, and ſayd to him: Cal quickly Micheas the ſonne of Iemla.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the king of Iſrael, and Ioſaphat the king of Iuda, both ſate in their thrones, clothed with kinglie attyre, and they ſate in the court beſide the gate of Samaria, and al the prophetes prophecied before them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But Sedecias the ſonne of Chanaana made him hornes of yron, and ſayd: Thus ſayth our Lord: With theſe shalt thou ſtrike Syria, til thou deſtroy it.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And al the prophetes in like manner prophecied, and ſayd: Goe vp into Ramoth Galaad, and thou shalt proſper, and our Lord wil deliuer them into the kinges hand.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the meſſenger that went to cal Micheas, ſayd to him: Behold the wordes of al the prophetes with one mouth tel the king good thinges: I beſech thee therfore that thy word alſo diſſent not from them, and that thou ſpeake proſperous thinges.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: To whom Micheas anſwered: Our Lord liueth, whatſoeuer my God shal ſay to me, that wil I ſpeake.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He therfore came to the king. To whom the king ſayd: Micheas, shal we goe into Ramoth Galaad to fight, or ſit ſtil? To whom he anſwered Goe ye vp: for al thinges shal fal out proſperous, and the enemies shal be deliuered into your handes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the king ſayd: Agayne, and agayne I adiure thee, that thou ſpeake not to me, but that which is true in the name of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But he ſayd: I ſaw al Iſrael diſperſt in the mountaynes, as ſheepe without a ſhepheard: and our Lord ſayd: Theſe haue no maiſters: let euerie man returne into his houſe in peace.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the king of Iſrael ſayd to Ioſaphat: did I not tel thee that this man did not prophecie me anie good, but theſe thinges that be euil?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But he ſayd: Heare ye therfore the word of our Lord: I ſaw our Lord ſitting in his throne, and al the hoſt of heauen aſſiſting him on the right hand and on the left.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And our Lord ſayd: who shal deceiue Achab the king of Iſrael, that he may goe vp and fal in Ramoth Galaad. And when one ſayd in this maner, and an other otherwiſe:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: there came forth a ſpirit, and ſtood before our Lord, and ſayd: I wil deceiue him. To whom our Lord ſayd: wherin wilt thou deceiue him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But he anſwered: I wil goe forth, and wil be a lying ſpirit in the mouth of al his prophetes. And our Lord ſayd: Thou shalt deceiue, and shalt preuaile: goe forth, and doe ſo.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Now therfore, behold our Lord hath geuen the ſpirit of lying in the mouth of al thy prophetes, and our Lord hath ſpoken of thee euil thinges.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Sedecias the ſonne of Chanaana came, and ſtroke the cheeke of Micheas, and ſayd: Which way paſſed the ſpirit of our Lord from me, that it should ſpeake to thee.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Micheas ſayd: Thou thy ſelf shalt ſee in that day, when thou ſhalt enter into chamber out of chamber, to be hid.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the king of Iſrael commanded, ſaying: Take Micheas, and lead him to Amon the gouernour of the citie, and to Ioab the ſonne of Amelech.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And you ſhal ſay: Thus ſayth the king: Caſt this felow into priſon, and giue him a litle bread, and a litle water, til I returne in peace.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Micheas ſayd: If thou returne in peace, our Lord hath not ſpoken in me, & he ſayd: Heare al ye peoples.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore the king of Iſrael, and Ioſaphat the king of Iuda went vp into Ramoth Galaad.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the king of Iſrael ſayd to Ioſaphat: I wil change my habite, and ſo I wil goe to the fight, but be thou clothed with thine owne garmentes. And the king of Iſrael changing his habit came to the battel.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the king of Syria had commanded the captaynes of his horſemen ſaying: Fight not agaynſt the leaſt, or agaynſt the greateſt, but agaynſt the king of Iſrael only.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore when the princes of the horſemen ſaw Ioſaphat, they ſayd: This is the king of Iſrael. And they compaſſed him fighting: but he cried to our Lord, and he holpe him, and turned them away from him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For when the captaynes of the horſemen ſaw, that is was not the king of Iſrael, they leaft him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And it chanced that one of the people shot an arrow at aduenture, and ſtroke the king of Iſrael betwen the necke and the ſhoulders, and he ſayd to his cocher: Turne thy hand, and carie me out of the battel, becauſe I am wounded.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the fight was ended in that day: moreouer the king of Iſrael ſtood in his chariote agaynſt the Syrians vntil euening, and died at the ſunne ſette.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND Ioſaphat the king of Iuda returned into his houſe peaceably, into Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Whom Iehu the ſonne of Hanani the Seer mette, and ſayd to him: To the impious man thou geueſt ayde, and to them that hate our Lord thou art ioyned in frendship, and therfore thou didſt deſerue in deed the wrath of our Lord:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: but good workes are found in thee, for that thou haſt taken away the groues out of the land of Iuda, and haſt prepared thy hart to ſeeke our Lord the God of thy fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ioſaphat therfore dwelt in Ieruſalem: and he went forth to the people agayne from Berſabee vnto mount Ephraim, and recalled them to our Lord the God of their fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he appoynted iudges of the land in al the fenſed cities of Iuda, in euerie place,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and commanding the iudges, he ſayd: Take heede what you doe: for you exerciſe not the iudgement of man, but of our Lord: and whatſoeuer you shal iudge, it shal redound to you.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Let the feare of our Lord be with you, and with diligence doe al thinges: for there is no iniquitie with the Lord our God, nor acception of perſonnes, nor deſyre of giftes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: In Ieruſalem alſo Ioſaphat appoynted Leuites, and Prieſtes, and princes of families of Iſrael, that they should iudge the iudgement and cauſe of our Lord to the inhabitantes therof.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he commanded them, ſaying: Thus shal you doe in the feare of our Lord faithfully, and with a perfect hart.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Euerie cauſe, that shal come to you of your brethren, that dwel in their cities, betwen kinred and kinred, wherſoeuer there is queſtion of the law, of the commandement, of ceremonies, of iuſtifications: shew it them, that they ſinne not agaynſt our Lord, and leſt there come wrath vpon you and your brethren: ſo doing therfore you shal not ſinne.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Amarias the prieſt and your Bishop shal be chiefe in theſe thinges, which pertayn to God: moreouer Zabadias the ſonne of Iſmahel, who is the prince in the houſe of Iuda, shal be ouer thoſe workes, which pertayne to the kinges office: and you haue maiſters the Leuites before you, take courage, and doe diligently, and our Lord wil be with the good.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AFTER theſe thinges were the children of Moab gathered together, and the children of Ammon, and with them of the Ammonites, to fight agaynſt Ioſaphat
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And there came meſſengers, and told Ioſaphat, ſaying: There cometh agaynſt thee a great multitude from thoſe places, which are beyond the ſea, and out of Syria, and behold they ſtay in Aſaſonthamar, which is Engaddi.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ioſaphat being frighted with feare, he tooke him wholy to beſech our Lord, and he proclamed a faſt to al Iuda.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Iudas was gathered together to pray to our Lord: yea and al came out of their cities to beſech him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when Ioſaphat ſtood in the middes of the aſſemblie of Iuda, and Ieruſalem in the houſe of our Lord before the new court,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: he ſayd: Lord God of our fathers, thou art God in heauen, and ruleſt ouer al the kingdomes of Nations, in thy hand is ſtrength and might, neither can anie man reſiſt thee.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Didſt not thou our God kil al the inhabitantes of this land before thy people Iſrael, and gaueſt it to the ſeed of Abraham thy frend for euer?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they dwelt in it, & built in it a Sanctuarie to thy name, ſaying:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: If euils fal vpon vs, the ſword of iudgement, peſtilence, & famine, we wil ſtand before this houſe in thy ſight, wherein thy name is inuocated: & we wil crie to thee in our tribulations, and thou shalt heare, and ſaue vs.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Now therfore behold the children of Ammon, and mount Seir, by whom thou didſt not grant Iſrael to paſſe, when they came out of Ægypt, but they declined from them, & ſlew them not:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: doe the contrarie, and endeuoure to caſt vs out of the poſſeſſion, which thou haſt deliuired to vs.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Our God, wilt not thou therfore iudge them? In vs in deed there is not ſo great ſtrength, that we can reſiſt this multitude, which cometh violently vpon vs. But whereas we are ignorant what we ought to doe, this onlie we haue leaft, that we direct our eies to thee.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And al Iuda ſtood before our Lord with their litle ones, and wiues, and their children.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And there was Iahaziel the ſonne of Zacharias, the ſonne of Banaias, the ſonne of Iehiel, the ſonne of Mathanias, a Leuite of the children of Aſaph, vpon whom the ſpirit of our Lord came in the middes of the multitude,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and he ſayd: Attend ye al Iuda, and you that dwel in Ieruſalem, and thou king Ioſaphat: thus ſayth our Lord to you: Feare not, neither dread ye this multitude: for it is not your battel, but Gods.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: To morrow you shal goe downe agaynſt them: for they wil come vp by the ſteepe named Sis, and you shal find them in the vtmoſt part of the torrent, which is agaynſt the wilderneſſe of Ieruel.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: It shal not be you that shal fight, but onlie ſtand confidently, and you shal ſee the helpe of our Lord ouer you, ô Iuda, and Ieruſalem: feare not, neither dreade ye: to morrow you shal goe out agaynſt them, and our Lord wil be with you.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ioſaphat therfore, and Iuda, and al the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem fel flat on the earth before our Lord, and adored him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the Leuites of the children of Caath, and of the children of Core prayſed our Lord the God of Iſrael with a lowd voice, on high.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when they had riſen earely in the morning, they went forth by the deſert of Thecua: and they being gone forth, Ioſaphat ſtanding in the middes of them, ſayd: Heare me ye men of Iuda, and al the inhabiters of Ieruſalem: beleue in the Lord your God, and you shal be ſecure: beleue his prophetes, and al thinges shal fal out proſperous.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He gaue counſel alſo to the people, and appoynted the ſinging men of our Lord, that they should prayſe him in their companies, and should goe before the hoſt, and with agreable voice ſhould ſay: Confeſſe to our Lord, becauſe his mercie is foreuer.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when they began to ſing prayſes, our Lord turned their embuſhementes vpon themſelues, to witte, of the children of Ammon, and of Moab, and of mount Seir, who were gone forth to fight agaynſt Iuda, and were ſtriken.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For the children of Ammon, and of Moab, roſe together agaynſt the inhabitantes of mount Seir, to kil and deſtroy them: and when they had in worke atcheued this, being turned alſo agaynſt themſelues, they fel wounded one of an other.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Iuda when they were come to the watch place, that looketh to the deſert, ſaw a far of al the countrie abrode ful of dead bodies, and that none remayned aliue that could eſcape death.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ioſaphat therfore came, and al the people with him to take away the ſpoiles of the dead, and they found among the dead bodies, diuerſe ſtuffe, garments alſo, and moſt pretious veſſels: and they ſpoiled it, ſoe that they could not carie al thinges, nor in three dayes take away the ſpoiles for the greatneſſe of the praye.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And in the fourth day they were aſſembled in the Vale of bleſſing: for becauſe there they had bleſſed our Lord, they called that place the Vale of bleſſing vntil this preſent day.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And euerie man of Iuda returned, and the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem, and Ioſaphat before them into Ieruſalem with great ioy, becauſe our Lord had geuen them ioy of their enemies.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they entered into Ieruſalem with pſalteries, and harpes, and trumpettes into the houſe of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the dread of our Lord fel vpon al the kingdomes of the landes when they heard that our Lord had fought agaynſt the enemies of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the kidgdom of Ioſaphat was quiet and God gaue him peace round about.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ioſaphat therfore reigned ouer Iuda, and he was fiue and thirtie yeares old when he begane to reigne: and he reigned fiue and twentie yeares in Ieruſalem: and the name of his mother was Azuba the daughter of Selahi.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he walked in the way of his father Aſa, neither declined he from it, doing the thinges that were pleaſing before our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But yet the excelſes he tooke not away, and as yet the people had not directed their hart to our Lord the God of their fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the reſt of the actes of Ioſaphat, the firſt and the laſt are writen in the wordes of Iehu the ſonne of Hanani, which he diſpoſed into the Bookes of the kinges of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: After theſe thinges Ioſaphat the king of Iuda entered frendshipe with Ochozias the king of Iſrael, whoſe workes were moſt impious.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he was partaker to make shippes, which should goe into Tharſis: and they made a nauie in Aſiongaber.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Eliezer the ſonne of Dodau of Mareſa prophecied to Ioſaphat, ſaying: Becauſe thou haſt had a league with Ochozias, our Lord hath ſtrooken thy workes, and the shippes are broken, neither could they goe into Tharſis.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND Ioſaphat ſlept with his fathers, & was buried with them in the Citie of Dauid: and Ioram his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who had brethren the ſonnes of Ioſaphat, Azarias, and Iahiel, and Zacharias, and Azarias, and Michael, and Saphatias. al theſe were the ſonnes of Ioſaphat the king of Iuda.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And their father gaue them manie giftes of ſiluer, and of gold, and penſions, with the moſt fenſed cities in Iuda: but the kingdom he deliuered to Ioram, becauſe he was the firſt begotten.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ioram roſe ouer the kingdom of his father: and when he had eſtablished himſelf, he ſlew al his brethren with the ſword, and certain of the princes of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Two and thirtie yeare old was Ioram when he began to reigne: and he reigned eight yeares in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he walked in the waies of the kinges of Iſrael, as the houſe of Achab had done: for Achabs daughter was his wife, and he did euil in the ſight of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But our Lord would not deſtroy the houſe of Dauid for the couenant, which he had made with him: and becauſe he had promiſed that he would geue him a lampe, and to his ſonnes for euer.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: In thoſe daies Edom rebelled, from being ſubiect to Iuda, and made themſelues a king.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when Ioram had paſſed with his princes, and al the horſemen, that were with him, he roſe in the night, and ſtroke Edom, which had compaſſed him, and al the captaynes of his horſemen.
label: 2 Paralipomenon
