text: But yet Edom rebelled, from being vnder the dominion of Iuda vntil this day: at that time Lobna alſo reuolted, from being vnder his hand. For he had forſaken our Lord the God of their fathers:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: moreouer he built alſo excelſes in the cities of Iuda, and he made the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem to fornicate, and Iuda to tranſgreſſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And there were letters brought him from Elias the prophete, in which was Writen: Thus ſayth our Lord the God of Dauid thy father: Becauſe thou haſt not walked in the waies of Ioſaphat thy father, & in the waies of Aſa the king of Iuda,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: but haſt gone by the waies of the kinges of Iſrael, and haſt made Iuda to fornicate, and the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem, hauing imitated the fornication of the houſe of Achab, moreouer alſo haſt killed thy brethren, the houſe of thy father, better men then thou:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: behold our Lord wil ſtrike thee with a great plague with al thy people, and children, and thy wiues, and al thy ſubſtance.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And thou shalt be ſicke of a very ſore diſeaſe of thy bealie, til thy vital partes come forth by litle and litle euerie day.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Our Lord therfore raiſed vp agaynſt Ioram the ſpirit of the Philiſthianes, and of the Arabians, which are borderers to the Æthiopians.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and they went vp into the Land of Iuda, and waſted it, and they ſpoyled al the ſubſtance, that was found in the kinges houſe, moreouer alſo his ſonnes, and wiues: neither was there a ſonne left him but Ioachaz, who was the yongeſt.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And beſide al theſe thinges our Lord ſtroke him with an incurable diſeaſe of the bealie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when day ſucceded day, and the ſpaces of times paſſed about, the circuite of two yeares was complete: and ſoe being waſted with a long comſumption, ſoe that he voyded euen his very bowels, he was ridde of the diſeaſe, and of his life together. And he died in an exceding vile infirmitie, & the people made him not exequies according to the maner of burning, as they had done to his anceters.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He was two and thirtie yeares old, when he began to reigne, and he reigned eight yeares in Ieruſalem. And he walked not rightly, and they buried him in the Citie of Dauid: but yet not in the ſepulchre of the kinges.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem made Ochozias his leaſt ſonne, king for him: for al the elders, that had bene before him, the rouers of the Arabians had ſlayne, which inuaded the campe: and Ochozias the ſonne of Ioram the king of Iuda reigned.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Two and fourrie yeares old was Ocohzias when he began to reigne, and he reigned one yeare in Ieruſalem, and the name of his mother was Athalia the daughter of Amri.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But he alſo went by the waies of the houſe of Achab: for his mother forced him to doe impiouſly.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He therfore did euil in the ſight of our Lord, as the houſe of Achab: for they were his counſelers after the death of his father, to his deſtruction.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he walked in their counſels. And he went forth with Ioram the ſonne of Achab king of Iſrael, into battel agaynſt Hazael king of Syria, into Ramoth Galaad: and the Syrians wounded Ioram.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Wbo returned to be cured into Iezrael: for he had taken manie woundes in the foreſayd battel. Therfore Ochozias the ſonne of Ioram king of Iuda, went downe te viſit Ioram the ſonne of Achab in Iezrael being ſicke.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For it was the wil of God agaynſt Ochozias, that he ſhould come to Ioram: and when he was come he ſhould goe out alſo againſt Iehu the ſonne of Namſi, whom our Lord anoynted to deſtroy the houſe of Achab.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: When Iehu therfore ouerthrew the houſe of Achab, he found the princes of Iuda, and the ſonne of the brethren of Ochozias, which ſerued him, and he ſlewe them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Searching alſo for Ochozias himſelf, he tooke him lying hid in Samaria: and being brought vnto him, he killed him, and they buried him: becauſe he was the ſonne of Ioſaphat, who had ſought our Lord in al his hart neither was rhere anie more hope that anie ſhould reigne of the ſtocke of Ochozias.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For Athalia his mother, ſeing that her ſonne was dead, aroſe, and ſleu al the kinges ſtocke of the houſe of Ioram.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Sauing that Ioſabeth the kinges daughter tooke Ioas the ſonne of Ochozias, and ſtole him out of the middes of the kinges ſonnes, when they were ſlayne. and she hid thim with his nource in the bedde chamber: and Ioſabeth that hid him, was the daughter of king Ioram, the wife of Ioiada the high prieſt, the ſiſter of Ochozias, and therfore Athalia did not kil him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He therfore was with them in the houſe of God ſix yeares, in the which Athalia reigned ouer the Land.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND in the ſeuenth yeare Ioiada taking courage, tooke the centurions, to witte, Azarias the ſonne of Ieroham, and Iſmahel the ſonne of Iohanan, Azarias alſo the ſonne of Obed, and Maaſias the ſonne of Adaias, and Eliſaphat the ſonne of Zechri: and made a couenant with them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who going about Iuda, gathered together the Leuites out of al the cities of Iuda, and the princes of the families of Iſrael, and they came into Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore al the multitude made a couenant with the king in the houſe of God: and Ioiada ſayd to them: Behold the kinges ſonne shal reigne, as our Lord hath ſpoken, vpon the ſonnes of Dauid.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: This therfore is the thing which you shal doe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The third part of you that come to the Sabbath of the Prieſtes, and of Leuites, and of porters ſhal be in the gates: and a third part at the kinges houſe: and a third at the gate, which is called of the Fundation: but let al the reſt of the common people be in the courtes of the houſe of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Neither let anie other enter into the houſe of our Lord, but the Prieſtes, and they that miniſter of the Leuites: let them onlie goe in, becauſe they are ſanctified and let al the reſt of the multitude obſerue the watches of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And let the Leuites enuiron the king, hauing euerie one their weapons: (and if anie other ſhal enter into the temple, let him be ſlayne) and let them be with the king both coming in, and going out.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The Leuites therfore, & al Iuda did according to al thinges, which Ioiada the high Prieſt had commanded; and they tooke euerie one the men that were vnder them, and came by the order of the Sabbath, with them that had fulfilled the Sabbath, and were to goe forth. For Ioiada the high Prieſt permitted not the companies to depart, which were accuſtomed to ſuccede one an other euerie weeke.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ioiada the Prieſt gaue to the centurions the ſpeares, and the shieldes, and targattes of king Dauid, which he had conſecrated in the houſe of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he appoynted al the people of them that held weapons on the right ſide of the temple, vnto the left ſyde of the temple, before the altar, and the temple, round about the king.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they brought forth the kinges ſonne, and put the crowne vpon him, and the teſtimonie, and gaue the law to be in his hand, & they made him king: Ioiada alſo the high Prieſt, and his ſonnes annoynted him: and they wished him wel, and ſaid: God ſaue the king.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Which thing when Athalia had heard, to witte, the voice of them that ranne and prayſed the king, she went in vnto the people, into the temple of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when she had ſeene the king ſtanding vpon the ſteppe in the entrance, and the princes, and the companies about him, and al the people of the land reioyſing, and ſounding with trumpettes, and playing on inſtrumentes of diuerſe kind, and the voice of them that prayſed, ſhe rent her garmentes, and ſayd: Treaſon, treaſon.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ioiada the high Prieſt going forth to the centurions, and captaines of the armie, ſayd to them: Bring her forth without the precinct of the temple, and let her be killed with the ſword without. And the Prieſt commanded that she ſhould not be killed in the houſe of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they layd handes vpon her necke: and when she was entred within the gate of the horſes of the kinges houſe, they killed her there.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ioiada made a couenant betwen himſelf, and al the people, and the king, that they would be the people of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Al the people therfore entred into the houſe of Baal, and deſtroyed it: and they brake his altars and his images: Mathan alſo the prieſt of Baal they ſlewe before the altars.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ioiada appoynted ouerſeers in the houſe of our Lord, vnder the handes of the Prieſtes, & the Leuites, which Dauid diſtributed in the houſe of our Lord: that they ſhould offer holocauſtes to our Lord, as it is writen in the law of Moyſes, in ioy and ſonges, according to the diſpoſition of Dauid.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He appoynted alſo porters in the gates of the houſe of our Lord, that the vncleane in anie thing should not enter in.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he tooke the centurions, and the moſt valiant men and princes of the people, and al the common people of the land, and they made the king to goe downe from the houſe of our Lord, & to enter by the middes of the vpper gate into the kinges houſe, and placed him in the royal throne.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And al the people of the land reioyſed, & the citie was quiet: moreouer Athalia was ſlayne with the ſword.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: SEVEN yeares old was Ioas when he began to reigne: and he reigned fourty yeares in Ieruſalem, the name of his mother was Sebia of Berſabee.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he did that which is good before our Lord al the dayes of Ioiada the Prieſt.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ioiada tooke for him two wiues, of whom he begat ſonnes & daughters.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: After which thinges it pleaſed Ioas to repayre the houſe of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he aſſembled the Prieſtes, and the Leuites, and ſayd to them: Goe ye forth to the cities of Iuda, and gather of al Iſrael money for the reparation of the temple of your God, yeare by yeare, and doe this in haſt: moreouer the Leuites did negligently.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the king called Ioiada the prince, and ſayd to him: why haſt thou had no care to conſtrayne the Leuites to bring in out of Iuda and Ieruſalem the money, that was appointed of Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord, that al the multitude of Iſrael ſhould bring it in into the tabernacle of teſtimonie?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For the moſt impious Athalia, and her children haue deſtroyed the houſe of God, and of al thinges that had bene ſanctified in the temple of our Lord, they adorned the temple of Baalim.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The king therfore commanded and they made a cheſt: and ſet it by the gate of our Lord on the out ſide.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And it was proclaymed in Iuda and Ieruſalem, that euery man should bring the price to our Lord, which Moyſes the ſeruant of God appoynted ouer al Iſrael, in the deſert.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And al the princes reioyſed, and al the people: and going in they contributed into the cheſt of our Lord, and caſt in ſo that it was filled.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when it was time that they should bring the cheſt before the king by the handes of Leuites (for they ſaw much money) the kinges Scribe went in, and he whom the high prieſt had appoynted: & they powred out the money that was in the cheſt, & recaried it to his place: and ſo did they from day to day, and there was gathered infinite money.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Which the king and Ioiada gaue to them, that ouerſaw the workes of the houſe of our Lord: but they hired with it hewers of ſtones, and artificers of al workes, to repayre the houſe of our Lord: ſmithes alſo of yron and braſſe, that that which began to fal, might be vpholden.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they that wrought did induſtriouſly, and the breach of the walles was cloſed by their handes, and they rayſed the houſe of our Lord into the old ſtate, and made it ſtand firmely.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when they had accomplished al the workes, they brought the reſt of the money before the king and Ioiada: of the which were made veſſels of the temple to the miniſterie, and for holocauſtes, phials alſo, and other veſſels of gold and ſiluer: and holocauſtes were offered in the houſe of our Lord continually al the daies of Ioiada.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But Ioiada became old being ful of dayes, and died when he was an hundred and thirtie yeares old.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they buried him in the citie of Dauid with the kinges, becauſe he had done good with Iſrael, and with his houſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And after that Ioiada was dead, the princes of Iuda went in, and adored the king, who being altered by their ſeruiceableneſſe, agreed to them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they forſooke the temple of our Lord the God of their fathers, and ſerued groues, and ſculptilles, and there came wrath agaynſt Iuda, and Ieruſalem for this ſinne.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he ſent them prophetes, that they ſhould returne to our Lord, whom proteſting they would not heare.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The ſpirit of God therfore inueſted Zacharias the ſonne of Ioiada the Prieſt, & he ſtood in the ſight of the people, and ſayd to them: Thus ſayth our Lord God: Why tranſgreſſe you the precept of our Lord, which thing ſhal not profit you, & haue forſaken our Lord, that he ſhould forſake you?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who being gathered agaynſt him, they threw ſtones according to the kinges commandement, in the court of the houſe of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ioas the king did not remember the mercie, that Ioiada his fathet had done with him, but he killed his ſonne. Who when he died, ſayd: Our Lord ſee, and require it.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when a yeare was come about, the armie of Syria came vp againſt him: & it came into Iuda & Ieruſalem, & ſlewe al the princes of the people, and al the pray they ſent to the king into Damaſcus.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And wheras there was come a very ſmal number of the Syrians, our Lord deliuered into their handes an infinit multitude, for that they had forſaken our Lord the God of their fathers: on Ioas alſo they exerciſed ignomious iudgementes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And departing they left him in great diſeaſes: and his ſetuantes roſe agaynſt him, for reuenge of the bloud of the ſonne of Ioiada the prieſt, & they ſlewe him in his bed, & he dyed: and they buried him in the Citie of Dauid, but not in the kinges ſepulchres.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And there conſpired againſt him Zabad the ſonne of Semmaath an Ammoniteſſe, & Iozabad the ſonne of Semarith a Moabiteſſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer his children, and the ſumme of money, which was gathered vnder him, & the repayring of the houſe of God are writen more diligently in the Booke of kinges: and Amaſias his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: FIVE and twentie yeares old was Amaſias when he began to reigne, and he reigned nine and twentie yeares in Ieruſalem, the name of his mother was Ioaden of Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he did good in the ſight of our Lord: but yet not in a perfect hart.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when he ſaw his kingdom ſtrengthned, he put to death the ſeruantes, that had ſlayne the king his father,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: but their children he ſlew not, as it is writen in the Booke of the law of Moyſes, where our Lord commanded, ſaying. The fathers shal not be ſlayne for the children, nor the children for their fathers, but euerie one ſhal die in his owne ſinne.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Amaſias therfore gathered together Iuda, and appoynted them by families, and tribunes, and centurions in al Iuda, and Beniamin: and he numbred from twentie yeares vpward, and found three hundred thouſand of yong men that went forth to battel, and held ſpeare and shielde.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He hyred alſo for wages of Iſrael an hundred thouſand ſtrong men, for an hundred talentes of ſiluer.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But a man of God came to him, and ſayd: O king, let not the hoſt of Iſrael goe forth with thee, for our Lord is not with Iſrael, and al the children of Ephraim:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and if thou thinke that battels conſiſt in the force of an armie, God wil make thee to be ouercome of the enemies: for it perteyneth to God both to helpe, and to put to flight.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Amaſias ſayd to the man of God: What shal become then of the hundred talentes, which I haue geuen the ſouldiars of Iſrael? And the man of God anſwered him: Our Lord hath wherby he is able to geue thee much more then this.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Amaſias therfore ſeperated the hoſt, that came to him out of Ephraim, that they ſhould returne into their place: but they being wrath excedingly agaynſt Iuda, returned into their countrie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Amaſias brought forth his people confidently, and went into the Vale of ſalt pittes, and ſtroke the children of Seir, ten thouſand.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And other ten thouſand men did the children of Iuda take, and bring to the ſteepe of a certaine rocke, and caſt them downe headlong from the toppe, who burſt in ſunder euerie one.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But that armie which Amaſias had ſent backe, from going with him to battel, was ſpred in the cities of Iuda, from Samaria vnto Bethhoron, & killing three thouſand tooke away a great praye.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But Amaſias after the ſlaughter of the Idumeans, ſette vp the goddes of the children of Seir, which he had brought thence, for his goddes, and adored them, and burnt incenſe to them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For which thing our Lord being angrie againſt Amaſias, ſent a prophete vnto him, which should ſay to him: Why haſt thou adored goddes, that haue not deliuered their owne people out of thy hand?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when he ſpake theſe thinges, he anſwered him: Art thou the kinges counſeler? be quiet, leſt I kil thee. And the prophet departing, ſayd: I know that God is minded to kil thee, becauſe thou haſt done this euil, and beſides haſt not agreed to my counſel.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore Amaſias the king of Iuda taking verie il counſel, ſent to Ioas the ſonne of Ioachaz the ſonne of Iehu, the king of Iſrael, ſaying: Come, let vs ſee one an other.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But he ſent backe the meſſengers, ſaying: A thiſtle that is in Libanus ſent to a cedar of Libanus, ſaying: Geue thy daughter to my ſonne to wife: & behold the beaſtes that were in the wood of Libanus paſſed, and trode downe the thiſtle.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Thou haſt ſayd: I haue ſtroken Edom, and therfore thy hart is extolled into pryde, ſitte in thy houſe, why doſt thou prouoke euil againſt thee, that both thou mayeſt fal, and Iuda with thee.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Amaſias would not heare, becauſe it was our Lordes wil, that he should be deliuered into the handes of the enemies for the goddes of Edom.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ioas therfore the king of Iſrael went vp, and they gaue themſelues one the ſight of the other: and Amaſias the king of Iuda was in Bethſames of Iuda:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and Iuda fel before Iſrael, and fled into their tabernacles.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Amaſias the king of Iuda, the ſonne of Ioas, the ſonne of Ioachaz, did take Ioas the king of Iſrael in Bethſames, & brought him into Ieruſalem: and deſtroyed the wal therof from the gate of Ephraim, to the gate of the corner, foure hundred cubites.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Al the gold alſo, and ſiluer, and al the veſſels, that he found in the houſe of God, and with Obededom in the treaſures alſo of the kinges houſe, moreouer he brought backe the ſonnes of the hoſtages into Samaria.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Amaſias the ſonne of Ioas the king of Iuda liued, after that Ioas died the ſonne of Ioachaz the king of Iſrael, fiftene yeares.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Amaſias the firſt and the laſt are Writen in the Booke of the kinges of Iuda and Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who after he reuolted from our Lord, they lay in waite agaynſt him in Ieruſalem. And when he had fled into Lachis, they ſent, and ſlew him there.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And carying him backe vpon horſes, buried him with his fathers in the Citie of Dauid.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND al the people of Iuda made his ſonne Ozias ſixtene yeares old, king for Amaſias his father.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He built Ailath, and reſtored it to the dominion of Iuda, after that the king ſlept with his fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Sixtene yeares old was Ozias when he began to reigne, and he reigned two and fiftie yeares in Ieruſalem, the name of his mother was Iechelia of Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he did that which was right in the eies of our Lord, according to al thinges, which Amaſias his father had done.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he ſought our Lord in the daies of Zacharias that vnderſtood and ſaw God: and when he ſought our Lord, he directed him in al thinges.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer he went forth, and fought againſt the Philiſthijms, and deſtroyed the wal of Geth, and the wal of Iabinia, and the wal of Azotus: he built alſo townes in Azotus, and among the Philiſthijms.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And God did helpe him againſt the Philiſthijms, and againſt the Arabians, thar dwelt in Garbaal, and againſt the Ammonites.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the Ammonites gaue giftes to Ozias: and his name was renowmed vnto the entrance of Ægypt for his often victories.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ozias built towers in Ieruſalem ouer the gate of the corner, and ouer the gate of the valley, and the reſt, in the ſame ſide of the wal, and ſtrengthened them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He built towers alſo in the wilderneſſe, and digged manie ceſternes, becauſe he had much cattel as wel in the champaine, as in the vaſtitie of the deſert: he had alſo vineyardes & dreſſers of vines in the mountaynes, and in Carmel: for he was a man geuen to huſbandrie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the hoſt of his warriers, which went forth to battels, was vnder the hand of Ichiel the ſcribe, & Maaſias the doctor, and vnder the hand of Hananias, who was of the kinges dukes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And al the number of the princes by families of valiant men, was two thouſand ſix hundred.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And vnder them al the hoſt of three hundred & ſeuen thouſand fiue hundred: which were apt to battels, and fought for the king againſt the aduerſaries.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ozias alſo prepared for them, that is to ſay, for al the armie, shildes, and ſpeares, and helmettes, and coates of mayle, and bowes, and ſlinges to caſt ſtones.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he made in Ieruſalem engines of diuerſe kind, which he placed in the towers, and in the corners of the walles, to shoote arrowes, and great ſtones: and his name went forth farre, for that our Lord did ayde him, and had ſtrengthned him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But when he was ſtrengthned, his hart was eleuated to his deſtruction, and he neglected our Lord his God: and entering into the temple of our Lord: he would burne incenſe vpon the altar of incenſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And incontinent Azarias the Prieſt going in after him, & with him the Prieſtes of our Lord eightie, moſt valiant men,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: they reſiſted the king, and ſayd: It is not thy office Ozias, to burne incenſe to our Lord, but of the Prieſtes, that is, of the children of Aaron, which are conſecrated to this kind of miniſterie: goe out of the Sanctuarie, contemne not: becauſe this thing shal not be reputed to thee for glorie of our Lord God.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ozias being angrie, and holding in his hand the cenſar to burne incenſe, threatned the Prieſtes. And fotthwith there roſe a leproſie in his forehead before the Prieſtes, in the houſe of our Lord vpon the altar of incenſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when Azarias tne high Prieſt had beheld him, and al the reſt of the Prieſtes, they ſaw the leproſie in his forehead, and in haſt they thruſt him out. Yea and him ſelf being ſore afrayd, made haſt to goe out, becauſe he felt by and by the plague of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ozias therfore the king was a leper vntil the day of his death, and he dwelt in a houſe apart ful of the leproſie, for the which he had bene caſt out of the houſe of our Lord. Moreouer Ioathan his ſonne gouerned the kinges houſe, and iudged the people of the land.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ozias the firſt and the laſt wrote Iſaias the ſonne of Amos, the prophet.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ozias ſlept with his fathers, and they buried him in the kings ſepulchres field, becauſe he was a leper: and Ioathan his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: FIVE and twentie yeares old was Ioathan when he began ro reigne, and he reigned ſixtene yeares in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Ieruſa the daugter of Sadoc.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he did that which was right before our Lord, according to al thinges, which Ozias his father had done, ſauing that he entered not into the temple of our Lord, and as yet the people did ſinne.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He built the high gate of the houſe of our Lord, and in the wal of Ophel he built manie thinges.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Cities alſo he built in the mountaynes of Iuda, and caſtelles and towres in the forreſtes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He fought agaynſt the king of the children of Ammon, and ouercame them, and the children of Ammon gaue him at that time an hundred talentes of ſiluer, and tenne thouſand cores of wheate, and as manie cores of barley: the children of Ammon gaue him theſe thinges in the ſecond and third yeare.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ioathan was ſtrengthened, becauſe he had directed his waies before our Lord his God.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ioathan, and al his battels, and workes, are writen in the Booke of the kinges of Iſrael and Iuda.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He was fiue and twentie yeares old when he began to reigne, and he reigned ſixtene yeares in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ioathan ſlept with his fathers, and they buried him in the Citie of Dauid: and Achaz his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: TWENTIE yeares old was Achaz when he began to reigne, & he reigned ſixtene yeares in Ieruſalem: he did not right in the ſight of our Lord as Dauid his father.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: but walked in the wayes of the kinges of Iſrael, moreouer alſo he did caſt ſtatues to Baalim.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He it is that burnt incenſe to the Valebenennom, and he conſecrated his ſonnes in fire according to the rite of the nations, which our Lord ſlewe in the coming of the children of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He ſacrified alſo, & burnt incenſe in the excelſes, & on hilles, and vnder euerie tree ful of grene leaues.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And our Lord his God deliuered him into the handes of the king of Syria, who ſtroke him, and tooke a great praye out of his kingdom, & brought into Damaſcus: to the handes alſo of the king of Iſrael was he deliuered, and ſtriken with a great plague.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Phacee the ſonne of Romelia ſlewe of Iuda an hundred twentie thouſand in one day, al men of warre: for that they had forſaken our Lord the God of their fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: At that time Zechri a mightie man of Ephraim, ſlewe Maaſias the kinges ſonne, and Ezricam the gouernour of his houſe, Elcana alſo ſecond from the king.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the children of Iſrael tooke of their brethren two hundred thouſand of wemen, of boyes, and of wenches, and an infinite praye: and they brought it into Samaria.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: At that time there was a Prophete of our Lord, named Oded: who going forth to meete the armie coming into Samaria, ſayd to them: Behold our Lord the God of your fathers being angrie againſt Iuda, hath deliuered them into your handes, and you haue ſlayne them cruelly, ſo that your crueltie did reach to heauen.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the children of Iuda and Ieruſalem you wil ſubdue vnto you for bondmen and bondwemen, which nedeth not to be done: for you haue ſinned hereupon to our Lord your God.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But heare ye my counſel, and carie backe the captiues, that you haue brought of your brethren, becauſe the great furie of our Lord hangeth ouer you.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: There ſtood therfore princes of the children of Ephraim, Azarias the ſonne of Iohanan, Barachias the ſonne of Moſollomoth, Ezechias the ſonne of Sellum, and Amaſa the ſonne of Hadali, againſt them that came out of the battel,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and they ſayd to them: You shal not bring in the captiues hither, leſt we ſinne to our Lord. Why wil you adde vpon our ſinnes, and heape vp old offences? for it is a great ſinne, and the anger of the furie of our Lord hangeth ouer Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the men of warre diſmiſt the pray, & al the thinges that they had taken, before the princes and al the multitude.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the men, whom we mentioned aboue, ſtood and taking the captiues, and al that were naked they clothed and ſhod them, with the ſpoyles: and when they had clothed and refreshed them with meate and drinke, and annoynted them becauſe of their labour, and had looked carefully to them: as manie as could not walke, and were of a weake bodie, they ſet on beaſtes, and brought them to Iericho the Citie of palme trees to their brethren, and themſelues returned into Samaria.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: At that time king Achaz ſent to the king of the Aſſyrians asking helpe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the Idumeans came and ſtroke manie of Iuda, and tooke a great praye.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The Philiſthijms alſo were ſpred abroad by the cities of the champayne, and toward the South of Iuda: and they tooke Bethſames, & Aialon, and Gaderoth, Socho alſo, & Thamnan, and Gamzo, with their villages, and dwelt in them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For our Lord had humbled Iuda becauſe of Achaz the king of Iuda, fot that he had made it naked of helpe, and had contemned our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he brought agaynſt him Theglathphalnaſar the king of the Aſſyrians, who alſo afflicted him, and ſpoyled him no man reſiſting.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore Achaz ſpoyling the houſe of our Lord, and the houſe of the kinges, and of the princes gaue giftes to the king of the Aſſyrians, and yet it did nothing profite him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer alſo in the time of his diſtreſſe he increaſed contempte agaynſt our Lord, king Achaz himſelf by himſelf,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: immolated victimes to the goddes of Damaſcus that ſtroke him, and ſayd: The goddes of the kinges of Syria doe helpe them, whom I wil pacifie with hoſtes, and they wil ayde me, wheras on the contrarie part they were his ruine, and al Iſraels.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Achaz therfore hauing ſpoyled al the veſſels of the houſe of God, and broken them shut the gates of the temple of God, and made him alrars in al the corners of Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: In al the cities alſo of Iuda he built altars to burne frankincenſe, and he prouoked to wrath our Lord the God of his fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the reſt of his wordes, al his workes the firſt and the laſt are writen in the Booke of the kinges of Iuda and Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Achaz ſlept with his fathers, and they buried him in the Citie of Ieruſalem: for they receiued him not into the ſepulchres of the kinges of Iſrael. And Ezechias his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: THERFORE Ezechias began to reigne, when he was fiue and twentie yeares old, and he reigned nine and twentie yeares in Ieruſalem: the name of his mother was Abia, the daughter of Zacharias.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he did that which was pleaſing in the ſight of our Lord, according to al thinges that Dauid his father had done.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He in the firſt yeare and moneth of his reigne opened the doores of the houſe of our Lord, and repayred them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he brought the Prieſtes and the Leuites, and aſſembled them in the Eaſt ſtreate.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he ſayd to them: Heare me ye Leuites, and be ſanctified, cleanſe the houſe of our Lord the God of your fathers, and take away al vncleannes out of the Sanctuarie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Our fathers haue ſinned and done euil in the ſight of our Lord God, forſaking him: they haue turned away their faces from the tabernacle of our Lord, and geuen the backe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: They haue shut the doores, that were in the porch, and put out the lampes, and haue not burnt incenſe, and haue not offered holocauſtes in the Sanctuarie of the God of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore was the furie of our Lord ſtirred vp vpon Iuda and Ieruſalem, and he hath deliuered them into commotion, and into deſtruction, & to be hiſſed at, as your ſelues ſee with your eyes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Behold, our fathers haue fallen by the ſwordes, our ſonnes, and our daughters, and wiues are led captiue for this wickedneſſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Now therfore it pleaſeth me that we make a couenant with our Lord the God of Iſrael, and he wil turne away the furie of his wrath from vs.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: My children be not negligent: our Lord hath choſen you to ſtand before him, and to miniſter to him, and to worshipe him, and to burne incenſe to him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The Leuites therfore aroſe Mahath the ſonne of Amaſai, and Ioel the ſonne of Azarias, of the children of Caath: moreouer the children of Merari, Cis the ſonne of Abdi, and Azarias the ſonne of Ialaleel. And of the children of Gerſon, Ioah the ſonne of Zemma, and Eden the ſonne of Ioah.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Bu of the children of Eliſaphan, Samri, and Iahiel. Alſo of the children of Aſaph, Zacharias, and Mathanias.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer alſo of the children of Heman, Iahiel, & Semei: yea and of the children of Idithun, Semeias, and Oziel.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they gathered together their brethren, and were ſanctified, and went in according to the commandment of the king, and the precept of our Lord, to purge the houſe of God.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The Prieſtes alſo going into the Temple of our Lord to ſanctifie it, brought out al vncleannes, which they found within the entrance of the houſe of our Lord, which the Leuites tooke, and caried to the Torrent cedron without.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they began to clenſe it the firſt day of the firſt moneth, and in the eight day of the ſame moneth they entred into the porche of the temple of our Lord, and they purged the temple in eight dayes, and in the ſixtenth day of the ſame moneth, they accomplished that which they began.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: They entered in alſo to Ezechias the king, and ſayd to him: We haue ſanctified al the houſe of our Lord, and the altar of holocauſt, and the veſſels therof, moreouer alſo the table of propoſition with al the veſſels therof,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and al the furniture of the temple, which king Achaz in his reigne had polluted, after that he tranſgreſſed; and behold al thinges are ſet forth before the altat of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and Ezechias the king riſing early, aſſembled al the princes of the citie, and went vp into the houſe of our Lord:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and they offered together ſeuen oxen, and ſeuen rammes, ſeuen lambes, and ſeuen buckgoates for ſinne, for the kingdom, for the ſanctuarie, for Iuda, and he ſayd to the Prieſtes the children of Aaron, that they ſhould offer them vpon the altar of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: They killed therfore the oxen, and the Prieſtes tooke the bloud, and powred it vpon the altar, they killed alſo the rammes, and their bloud they powred alſo vpon the altar, and they immolated the lambes, and powred the bloud vpon the altar.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: They brought the buckgoates for ſinne before the king, and the whole multitude, and they put their handes vpon them:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and the Prieſtes immolated them, and ſprinkled their bloud on the altar for an expiation of al Iſrael: for the king had commanded for al Iſrael, that holocauſt should be made, ana for ſinne.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He appoynted alſo the Leuites in the houſe of our Lord with cymbals, and pſalteries, and harpes according to the diſpoſition of Dauid the king, and of Gad the Seer, and of Nathan the Prophete: for it was the precept of our Lord by the hand of his prophetes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the Leuites ſtoode, holding the inſtrumentes of Dauid, and the Prieſtes trumpettes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ezechias commanded that they should offer holocauſtes vpon the altar: and when holocauſtes were offered, they began to ſing prayſes to our Lord, and to ſound with trumpettes, and on diuerſe inſtrumentes, which Dauid the king of Iſrael had prepared for to ſound.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And al the multitude adoring, the ſinging men, and they that held the trumpettes, were in their office, whiles the holocauſt was accomplished.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when the oblation was ended, the king bowed, and al that were with him, and adored.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ezechias, and the princes commanded the Leuites, that they should prayſe our Lord in the wordes of Dauid, and Aſaph the Seer: who prayſed him with great ioy, and bowing the knee adored.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But Ezechias added theſe wordes alſo: You haue filled your handes to our Lord, come, and offer victimes, and prayſes in the houſe of our Lord. Al the multitude therfore offered hoſtes, and prayſes, and holocauſtes with a deuout minde.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the number of the holocauſtes, which the multitude offered, was thls, oxen ſeuentie, rammes an hundred, lambes two hundred.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they ſanctified to our Lord oxen ſix hunered, & sheepe three thouſand.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the Prieſtes were few, neither could they ſuffiſe to draw of the skinnes of the holocauſtes: wherfore the Leuites alſo their brethren holpe them, til the worke was accomplished, and the Prieſtes were ſanctified, for the Leuites are ſanctified with an eaſier rite, then the Prieſtes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: There were holocauſtes therfore verie many, the fatte of pacifiques, and the libamentes of the holocauſtes: and the ſeruice of the houſe of our Lord was accomplished.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ezechias reioyſed, and al the people, becauſe the miniſterie of our Lord was accomplished. For it pleaſed them that the thing should be done of a ſoden.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: EZECHIAS alſo ſent to al Iſrael and Iuda: and he wrote letters to Ephraim and Manaſſes, that they should come to the houſe of our Lord in Ieruſalem, and should make a Phaſe to our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Counſel therfore being taken of the king and the princes, and of al the aſſemblie of Ieruſalem, they decreed to make the Phaſe the ſecond moneth.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For they could not make it in his time: becauſe the Prieſtes that might ſuffiſe, had not bene ſanctified, and the people had not as yet bene gathered into Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the word pleaſed the king, and al the multitude.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they decreed to ſend meſſengers into al Iſrael from Berſabee vnto dan, that they should come, and make the Phaſe to our Lord the God of Iſrael in Ieruſalem: for manie had not made it as is preſcribed by the law.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the poſtes went forth with letters of commandement from the king, and his princes, into al Iſrael and Iuda, according to that, which the king had commanded, proclaming: Children of Iſrael returne ye to our Lord the God of Abraham, and Iſaac, and Iſrael: and he wil returne to the remnant, that hath eſcaped the hand of the king of the Aſſyrians.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Become not as your fathers, and brethren, which haue reuolted from our Lord the God of their fathers, who hath deliuered them into deſtruction, as your ſelues ſee.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Harden not your neckes, as your fathers: geue handes to our Lord, and come to his Sanctuarie, which he hath ſanctified for euer: ſerue our Lord the God of your fathers, and the wrath of his furie shal be turned away from you.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For if you shal returne to our Lord: your brethren, and children shal haue mercie before their Lordes, that haue led them captiue, and they shal returne into this land: for our Lord your God is merciful, and wil not turne away his face from you, if you shal returne to him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore the poſtes went forward ſpedely from citie to citie, through the land of Ephraim, and of Manaſſes, as farre as Zabulon, they mocking and skorning them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Neuertheleſſe certayne men of Aſer, and Manaſſes, and Zabulon, condeſcending to the counſel, came to Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the hand of God was in Iuda, to geue them one hart to doe the word of our Lord, according to the precept of the king and of the princes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And much people was gathered into Ieruſalem to make the ſolemnitie of Azimes in the ſecond moneth:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And riſing they deſtroyed the altars that were in Ieruſalem, and ouerthrowing al thinges wherin incenſe was burnt to idols, they threw it into the Torrent cedron.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they immolated the Phaſe the fourtenth day of the ſecond moneth. The Prieſtes alſo and the Leuites at length being ſanctified offered holocauſtes in the houſe of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they ſtoode in their order according to the diſpoſition, & law of Moyſes the man of God: but the Prieſtes receiued the bloud to be powred out of the handes of the Leuites,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: becauſe a great multitude Was not ſanctified: & therfore the Leuites immolated the Phaſe for them, that came not in time to be ſanctified to our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For a great part of the people of Ephraim, and Manaſſes, and Iſſachar, and Zabulon, that had not bene ſanctified, did eate the Phaſe, not according to that which is writen: and Ezechias prayed for them, ſaying: Our good Lord wil be merciful,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: to al them, that in al their hart ſeeke our Lord the God of their fathers: and wil not impute it to them that they are not ſanctified.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Whom our Lord heard, and was pacified to the people.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the children of Iſrael, that were found in Ieruſalem, made the ſolemnitie of Azimes ſeuen daies in great ioy, prayſing our Lord euerie day. The Leuites alſo and the Prieſtes by inſtrumentes, that agreed to their office.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ezechias ſpake to the hart of al the Leuites, that had good vnderſtanding concerning our Lord: and they did eate during the ſeuen daies of the ſolemnitie, immolating victimes of pacifiques, and prayſing our Lord the God of their fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And it pleaſed the whole multitude to celebrate it other ſeuen daies: which alſo they did with great ioy.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For Ezechias the king of Iuda had geuen the multitude a thouſand oxen, and ſeuen thouſand ſheepe: but the princes had geuen the people oxen a thouſand, & sheepe ten thouſand: there was ſanctified therfore a verie great multitude of Prieſtes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And al the multitude of Iuda was ful of mirth, as wel of the Prieſtes and Leuites, as of al the aſſemblie, that came out of Iſrael; of the proſelites alſo of the land of Iſrael, and them that dwelt in Iuda.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And there was made a great ſolemnitie in Ieruſalem, ſuch as had not bene in that citie from the dayes of Salomon the ſonne of Dauid the king of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the Prieſtes & the Leuites roſe vp bleſſing the people: & their voice was heard: and their prayer came into the holie habitation of heauen.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND when theſe thinges had bene ritely celebrated, al Iſrael that was found in the cities of Iuda, went forth, and they brake the idols, and cut downe the groues, ouerthrew the excelſes, and deſtroyed the altars, not onlie out of al Iuda and Beniamin, but out of Ephraim alſo and Manaſſes, til they vtterly deſtroyed them: and al the children of Iſrael returned into their poſſeſſions and cities.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ezechias appoynted companies of Prieſtes, and of Leuites, by their diuiſions, euerie man in his owne office, towitte, as wel of the Prieſtes, as of the Leuites, for the holocauſtes, and pacifiques, that they ſhould miniſter, and confeſſe, and ſing in the gates of the campe of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the kinges part was, that of his proper ſubſtance holocauſt should be offered, morning alwaies and euening, in the Sabbathes alſo, and the Calendes and in other ſolennites, as it is writen in the law of Moyſes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He commanded alſo the people that dwelt in Ieruſaiem, to geue portions to the Prieſtes, and the Leuites, that they might attend the law of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Which when it was noyſed in the eares of the multitude, the children of Iſrael offered very manie firſt fruites of corne, of wine, and of oyle, of honie alſo: and of al thinges, which the ground bringeth forth, they offered tithes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and the children of Iſrael and Iuda, that dwelt in the cities of Iuda, offered tithes of oxen, and ſheepe, and tithes of ſanctified thinges, which they had vowed to our Lord their God: and carying them al, made manie heapes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The third moneth they began to lay the fundations of the heapes, and in the ſeuenth moneth they finiſhed them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when Ezechias, and his princes came in, they ſaw the heapes, and bleſſed our Lord, and the people of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ezechias asked the Prieſtes and the Leuites, why the heapes lay ſo:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Azarias the high Prieſt of the ſtocke of Sadoc anſwered him, ſaying: Since firſt fruites began to be offered in the houſe of our Lord, we haue eaten, and haue bene ful, and very much hath remayned, becauſe our Lord hath bleſſed his people: and of the remaynes this is the abundance, which thou ſeeſt.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Fzechias therfore commanded that ſtorehouſes should be prepared in the houſe of our Lord. Which when they had done,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: they brought in as wel the firſt fruites, as the tithes, and watſoeuer they had vowed, faythfully. And the ouerſeer of them was Chonenias a Leuite, and Semei his brother the ſecond,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: after whom Iahiel, and Azarias, and Nahath, and Aſael, and Ierimoth, Ioſabad alſo, and Eliel, and Ieſmachias, and Mahath, and Banaias, ouerſeers vnder the hand of Chonenias, and Semei his brother, by the commandment of Ezechias the king, and Azarias the high Prieſt of the houſe of God, to whom al thinges apperteyned.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But Core the ſonne of Iemna a Leuite, and porter of the eaſt gate, was ouerſeer of thoſe thinges, which were voluntarily offered to our Lord, and of the firſt fruites and the thinges conſecrated for Sancta ſanctorum.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And vnder his charge Eden, and Beniamin, Ieſue, and Semeias, Amarias alſo, and Sechenias, in the cities of the Prieſtes, that they ſhould faithfnlly diſtribute to their brethren portions, to the leſſer and greater:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: ſauing the men children from three yeares and aboue, to al that entered into the temple of our Lord, and whatſoeuer day by day was profitable in the miniſterie, and the obſeruances according to their diuiſions,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: to the Prieſtes by families, and to the Leuites from the twentith yeare and vpward, by the orders and companies,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and to al the multitude, as wel their wiues, as their children of both ſex, meates were geuen faithfully of theſe thinges, that had bene ſanctified.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and of the children of Aaron by the fildes and the ſuburbes of euerie citie, there were men ordayned, that ſhould diſtribute portions, to al the male ſexe, of the Prieſtes and the Leuites.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ezechias therfore did al thinges which we haue ſayd in al Iuda: and wrought good and right, and truth before our Lord his God,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: in al the ſeruice of the miniſterie of the houſe of our Lord, according to the law and the ceremonies, willing to ſeeke his God in al his hart, and he did it and proſpered.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AFTER which thinges, and this maner of truth, came Sennacherib the king of the Aſſyrians, and entering into Iuda, beſieged the fenſed cities, deſirous to take them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Which when Ezechias had ſene, to witte, that Sennacherib was come, and the whole force of the battel to be turned agaynſt Ieruſalem,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: taking counſel with the princes, and the moſt valiant men, to ſtoppe vp the heades of the fountaynes, that were without the citie: and the ſentence of them al decreing this,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: he gathered a very great multitude, & they ſtopped vp al the fountaynes, and the riuer, that ranne in the middes of the land, ſaying: Leſt the kinges of the Aſſyrians come, and finde abundance of waters.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He built alſo doing induſtriouſly euerie wall that had bene deſtroyed, and built towers vpon them, and an other wall without: and he repayred Mello in the citie of Dauid, and made armour and ſhildes of al ſortes:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he appointed princes of warryers in the armie: and he called them al together in the ſtreate of the gate of the citie, and ſpake to their hart, ſaying:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Doe manfully, and take courage: feare not, neither dread ye the king of the Aſſyrians, and al the multitude, that is with him: for there are manie moe with vs, then with him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For with him is an arme of flesh: with vs the Lord our God, which is our helper, and fighteth for vs. And the people was encouraged with theſe maner of wordes of Ezechias the king of Iuda.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Which thinges after they were done, Sennacherib the king of the Aſſyrians ſent his ſeruantes to Ieruſalem (for himſelf with al his armie beſeiged Lachis) to Ezechias the king of Iuda, & to al the people, that was in the citie, ſaying:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Thus ſayth Sennacherib the king of the Aſſyrians: In whom hauing affiance, doe you ſitte beſieged in Ieruſalem?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Hath Ezechias deceiued you, to deliuer you to death in hunger and thirſt, affirming that the Lord your God can deliuer you from the hand of the king of the Aſſyrians?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Why, is not this Ezechias, that hath deſtroyed his excelſes, and altars, and hath commanded Iuda & Ieruſalem, ſaying: Before one altar you shal adore, and on it you shal burne incenſe?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Are you ignorant what thinges I haue done, and my fathers to al the peoples of the landes? haue the goddes of nations, and of al landes bene able to deliuer their countrie out of my hand?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who is there of al the goddes of the nations, which my fathers waſted, that could deliuer his people out of my hand, that your God alſo can deliuer you out of this hand?
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Let not therfore Ezechias deceiue you, nor delude you with vayne perſuaſion, neither beleue ye him. For if no god of al nations and kingdomes, could deliuer his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers, conſequently neither shal your God be able to deliuer you out of my hand.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and manie other thinges did his ſeruantes ſpeake, agaynſt our Lord God, and agaynſt Ezechias his ſeruant.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Letters alſo he wrote ful of blaſphemie againſt our Lord the God of Iſrael, and he ſpake agaynſt him: as the goddes of their nations could not deliuer their people out of my hand, ſo the God alſo of Ezechias can not deliuer his people out of this hand.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer alſo with a lowd crie, in the Iewes tongue, he ſounded againſt the people, that ſate on the walles of Ieruſalem, that he might terrifie them, and take the citie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he ſpake agaynſt the God of Ieruſalem, as agaynſt the goddes of the peoples of the earth, the workes of mens handes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ezechias therfore the king, and Iſaias the prophet the ſonne of Amos, prayed agaynſt this blaſphemie, and cried out euen to heauen.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And our Lord ſent an Angel, which ſtroke euerie ſtrong man, and warryer, and prince of the armie of the king of the Aſſyrians: and he returned with ignominie into his countrie. And when he was entered into the houſe of his God, his ſonnes that were come forth of his wombe, ſlewe him with the ſword.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And our Lord ſaued Ezechias and the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem, out of the hand of Sennacherib the king of the Aſſyrians, and out of the hand of al, & gaue them reſt round about.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Manie alſo brought hoſtes, and ſacrifices to our Lord into Ieruſalem, and giftes to Ezechias the king of Iuda: who was exalted after theſe thinges before al nations.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: In thoſe daies Ezechias was ſick euen to death, and he prayed our Lord: and he heard him, and gaue him a ſigne.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But not according to the benefites, which he receiued, did he recompenſe, becauſe his hart was eleuated: and wrath came agaynſt him, and agaynſt Iuda and Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he was humbled afterward, becauſe his hart had bene exalted, both he and the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem: and therfore the wrath of our Lord came not vpon them in the daies of Ezechias.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ezechias was rich, and glorious excedingly and gathered to himſelf great treaſures of ſiluer and of gold, and of pretious ſtone, of ſpices, and of armour of al kinde, and of veſſels of great price.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Storehouſes alſo of corne, of wyne, and of oyle, and ſtalles of al beaſtes, and foldes of cattel,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and ſix cities he built to him ſelf: for he had flockes of sheepe, and of heardes innumerable, becauſe our Lord had geuen him ſubſtance exceding much.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The ſame is Ezechias, that ſtopped the vpper fountaine of the waters of Gihon, and turned them away vnderneth toward the Weſt of the Citie of Dauid: in al his workes he did proſperouſly what he would.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But yet in the embaſſie of the princes of Babylon, that were ſent to him, to aske of the wonder, that had chanced vpon the earth, God leift him that he might be tempted, and al thinges might be made knowen, that were in his hart.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ezechias, and of his mercies are writen in the viſion of Iſaias the ſonne of Amos the prophete, and in the booke of the kinges of Iuda & Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Ezechias ſlept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefe ſepulchres of the children of Dauid: and al Iuda celebrated his funeralles, & al the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem: and Manaſſes his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: TWELVE yeares old was Manaſſes when he began to reigne, and he reigned fiftie fiue yeares in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he did euil before our Lord, according to al the abominations of the nations, which our Lord ouerthrew before the children of Iſrael:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and being turned, he reedified the excelſes which Ezechias his father had deſtroyed: and he built altars to Baalim, and made groues, and he adored al the hoſt of heauen, and worshipped it.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He built alſo altars in the houſe of our Lord, wherof our Lord had ſayd: In Ieruſalem ſhal my name be for euer.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he built them to al the hoſt of heauen in the two courtes of the houſe of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he made his ſonnes to paſſe through fyre, to the Valebenennom: he obſerued dreames, folowed ſouthſayings, gaue him ſelf to magike artes, he had with him magicians, & inchaunters: and he wrought manie euils before our Lord, to prouoke him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Alſo a grauen, and a molten ſigne he put in the houſe of God, wherof our Lord ſpake to Dauid, and to Salomon his ſonne, ſaying: In this houſe, and in Ieruſalem, which I haue choſen al the tribes of Iſrael, Wil I put my name for euer,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And I wil not make the foote of Iſrael to moue out of the land, which I haue deliuered to their fathers: yet ſo if they shal obſerue to doe that I haue commanded them, and al the law, and the ceremonies, and iudgementes by the hand of Moyſes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Manaſſes therfore ſeduced Iuda, and the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem, that they did euil aboue al the nations, which our Lord had ouerthrowen before the face of the children of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And our Lord ſpake to him, and to his people, and they would not attend.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore he brought vpon them the princes of the hoſt of the king of the Aſſyrians: and they tooke Manaſſes, & led him bound with chaynes, and fetters into Babylon.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who after that he was in diſtreſſe, prayed our Lord his God: and did penance excedingly before the God of his fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he deſired him, and beſought him earneſtly: and he heard his prayer, and brought him agayne to Ieruſalem into his kingdom, and Manaſſes knew that our Lord he was God.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: After theſe thinges he built a wal without the citie of Dauid, on the weſt of Gihon in the valley, from the entrance of the fish gate roundabout vnto Ophel, and rayſed it excedingly: and he appoynted princes of the hoſt in al the fenſed cities of Iuda:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and he tooke away ſtrange goddes, and the idol out of the houſe of our Lord: the altars alſo which he had made in the mount of the houſe of our Lord, and in Ieruſclem, and he threw al without the citie.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer he reedified the altar of our Lord, and immolated vpon it victimes, and pacifiques, and prayſe: and he commanded Iuda to ſerue our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Neuertheleſſe as yet the people immolated in the excelſes to our Lord their God.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the reſt of the actes of Manaſſes: and his obſecration to his God: the wordes alſo of the Seers, that ſpake to him in the name of our Lord the God of Iſrael, are conteyned in the wordes of the kinges of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: His prayer alſo, and his obtayning, and al his ſinnes, and contempt, the places alſo wherein he built excelſes, and made groues, and ſtatues before he did penance, are writen in the wordes of Hozai.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Manaſſes therfore ſlept with his fathers, and they buried him in his houſe: & his ſonne Amon reigned for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ammon was two and twentie yeares old when he began to reigne, and he reigned two yeares in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he did euil in the ſight of our Lord, as Manaſſes his father had done: and he immolated to al the idols, which Manaſſes his father had made, and ſerued them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he did not reuerence the face our Lord, as Manaſſes his father did reuerence it, and he committed farre greater ſinnes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when his ſeruantes had conſpired agaynſt him, they ſlewe him in his owne houſe.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the reſt of the multitude of the people, hauing ſlaine them that ſtroke Amon, made Ioſias his ſonne king for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: EIGHT yeares old was Ioſias when he began to reigne, & he reigned thirtie and one yeares in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he did that which was right in the ſight of our Lord, and walked in the waies of Dauid his father: he declined not neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And in the eight yeare of his reigne, when he was yet a child, he began to ſeeke the God of his father Dauid: and the twelfth yeare after he began to reigne, he cleanſed Iuda and Ieruſalem from excelſes, and groues, and idols, & ſculptils.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they deſtroyed before him the altars of Baalim, and the idols, that had bene ſet vpon them, they deſtroyed: the groues alſo and ſculptils he cut downe and brake in peeces: and ouer their tombes, that were accuſtomed to immolate vnto them, he ſtrawed the fragmentes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the bones of the Prieſtes he burnt on the altars of the idols, and he clenſed Iuda and Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Yea and in the cities of Manaſſes, and of Ephraim, and of Simeon, vnto Nepthali he ouerthrew al.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when he had deſtroyed the altars, and the groues, and had broken the idols into peces, and had ouerthrowen al profane temples out of al the land of Iſrael, he returned into Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore in the eightenth yeare of his reigne, the land now clenſed, and the temple of our Lord, he ſent Saphan the ſonne of Eſelias, and Maaſias the gouernour of the citie, and Ioha the ſonne of Ioachaz Commenter, that they should repayre the houſe of our Lord his God.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who came to Helcias the high prieſt: and taking of him the money, which had bene brought into the houſe of our Lord, and which the Leuites and porters had gathered together of Manaſſes, and Ephraim, and of al the remnant of Iſrael, of al Iuda alſo, and Beniamin, and the inhabiters of Ieruſalem,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: they deliuered in their handes, that ouerſaw the workemen in the houſe of our Lord, that they should repayre the temple, and mend al weake partes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But they gaue it to the artificers, and to the maſons, that they ſhould bye ſtones out of the quarries, and timber for the ioyntures of the building, and for making the roofe of the houſe, which the kinges of Iuda had deſtroyed.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who did al thinges faithfully. And the ouerſeers of the workemen were Iahath & Abdias of the children of Merari, Zacharias and Moſollam of the children of Caath, which vrged the worke: al Leuites skilful to ſing on inſtrumentes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But ouer them, that caried burdens to diuerſe vſes, were ſcribes, and maſters of the Leuites, and porters.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when they caried forth the money, that had bene brought into the temple of our Lord, Helcias the Prieſt found the Booke of the law of our Lord, by the hand of Moyſes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he ſayd to Saphan the Scribe: I haue found the booke of the law in the houſe of our Lord: and deliuered it to him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But he brought in the volume to the king, and told him, ſaying: Al thinges, which thou gaueſt into the hand of thy ſeruantes, loe are accomplished.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The ſiluer that was found in the houſe of our Lord, they haue gathered into a maſſe: and it was geuen to the ouerſeers of the artificers, and of them that make diuerſe workes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Helcias the Prieſt deliuered me this booke. Which when he had read in the kinges preſence,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and he had heard the wordes of the law, he rent his garmentes:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and he commanded Helcias, and Ahicam the ſonne of Saphan, and Abdon the ſonne of Micha, Saphan alſo the ſcribe, and Aſaa the kinges ſeruant, ſaying:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Goe, and pray our Lord for me, and for the remnant of Iſrael, and Iuda, concerning al the wordes of this Booke, which is found: for the great furie of our Lord hath diſtilled vpon vs, for that our fathers haue not kept the wordes of our Lord, to doe al thinges, that are writen in this volume.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Helcias therfore went, and they that were ſent together by the king, to Olda a propheteſſe, the wife of Sellum the ſonne of Thecuath, the ſonne of Haſra keeper of the garmentes: who dwelt in Ieruſalem in the ſecond part: and they ſpake to her the wordes, which we haue aboue mentioned.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But she anſwered them: Thus ſayth out Lord the God of Iſrael: Tel the man, that ſent you to me:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Thus ſayth our Lord: Behold I wil bring euils vpon this place, and vpon the inhabitantes therof, and al the curſes, that are writen in this Booke, which they redde before the king of Iuda.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Becauſe they haue forſaken me, and haue ſacrificed to ſtrange goddes, that they might prouoke me to wrath in al the workes of their handes, therfore shal my furie droppe vpon this place, & shal not be extinguished.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But to the king of Iuda that ſent you to beſeche our Lord, thus ſpeake ye: Thus ſayth our Lord the God of Iſrael; Becauſe thou haſt heard the wordes of this volume,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and thy bart is mollified, and thou art humbled in the ſight of our Lord for theſe thinges, which are ſpoken againſt this place, and the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem, and reuerencing my face, haſt rent thy garmentes, and wept before me; I alſo baue heard thee, ſayth our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For now wil I gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be brought into thy graue in peace: neither shal thyne eies ſee al the euil that I wil bring in vpon this place, and vpon the inhabitantes therof, They therfore reported to the king al thinges that ſhe had ſayd.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But he calling together al the ancienres of Iuda and Ieruſalem,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: went vp into the houſe of our Lord, and al the men of Iuda, and the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem, Prieſtes and Leuites, and al the people from the leaſt to the greateſt. In whoſe hearing in the houſe of our Lord, the king read al the wordes of the volume.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And ſtanding on his tribunal ſeate, he made a couenant before our Lord, that he would walke after him, and keepe his preceptes, and teſtimonies, and iuſtifications in al his hart, and in al his ſoule, and would do the thinges that were writen in that volume, which he had read.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He adiured alſo vpon this al that were found in Ieruſalem, and Beniamin: and the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem did according to the couenant, of our Lord the God of their fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ioſias therfore tooke away al abominations of al the countries of the children of Iſrael: and made al, that were left in Iſrael, to ſerue our Lord their God. Al his daies they reuolted not from our Lord the God of their fathers.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: AND Ioſias made in Ieruſalem a Phaſe to our Lord, which was immolated the fourtenth day of the firſt moneth.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he appoynted the Prieſtes in their offices, and exhorted them that they would miniſter in the houſe of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: To the Leuites alſo, at whoſe inſtruction al Iſrael was ſanctified to our Lord, he ſpake: Put the Arke in the Sanctuarie of the temple, which Salomon built the ſonne of Dauid the king of Iſrael, for you shal carie it no more: but now miniſter to our Lord your God, and to his people Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And prepare your ſelues by your houſes, and kinredes in the diuiſions of euerie one, as Dauid the king of Iſrael commanded, and Salomon his ſonne deſcribed.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And miniſter ye in the Sanctuarie by families and Leuitical companies,
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and being ſanctified immolate the Phaſe, prepare alſo your brethren, that they may doe according to the wordes, which our Lord ſpake in the hand of Moyſes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer Ioſias gaue to al the people, that was found there in the ſolemnitie of the Phaſe, lambes and kiddes of the flockes, and of the reſt of the cattel thirtie thouſand, of oxen alſo three thouſand, al theſe thinges of the kinges ſubſtance.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: His dukes alſo voluntarily offered that which they vowed, as wel to the people, as to the Prieſtes and the Leuites. Moreouer Helcias, and Zacharias, and Iahiel princes of the houſe of our Lord, gaue to the Prieſtes to make the Phaſe cattel one with an other two thouſand ſix hundred, and oxen three hundred.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And Chonenias, and Semeias, alſo Nathanael, his brethren, moreouer Haſabias, and Iehiel, and Iozabad princes of the Leuites, gaue to the reſt of the Leuites to celebrate the Phaſe fiue thouſand sheepe, and oxen fiue hundred.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the miniſterie was prepared, and the Prieſtes ſtood in their office: the Leuites alſo in companies, according to the kinges commandement.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the Phaſe was immolated: and Prieſtes ſprinkled the blood with their hand, and the Leuites drew of the skinnes of the holocauſtes:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: and they ſeperated them to geue them by the houſes and families of euerie one, and to be offered to our Lord, as it is writen in the Booke of Moyſes, of oxen alſo they did in like maner.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And they roſted the Phaſe vpon fyre, according to that which is writen in the law: but the pacifique hoſtes they boyled in caudrons, and kettles, and pottes, and in haſt they diſtributed it to al the people.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And for themſelues, and for the Prieſtes they prepared afterward: for in oblation of holocauſtes and of fatte the Prieſtes were occupied vntil night: wherfore the Leuites prepared for themſelues, and for the Prieſtes the children of Aaron laſt.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Moreouer the ſinging men the children of Aſaph ſtood in their order, according to the precept of Dauid, and Aſaph, and Heman, and Idithun the prophetes of the king: and the porters watched at euerie gate, ſo that they departed not a moment from the miniſterie: for the which cauſe alſo their brethren the Leuites prepared meates for them.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Therfore al the ſeruice of our Lord was ritely accomplished that day, ſo that they made the Phaſe, and offered holocauſtes vpon the altar of our Lord, according to the precept of king Ioſias.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the children of Iſrael that were found there, made the Phaſe at that time, and the ſolemnitie of Azymes ſeuen daies.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: There was not a Phaſe like to this in Iſrael, from the daies of Samuel the prophete: neither did anie of al the kinges of Iſrael make a Phaſe as Ioſias, to the Prieſtes, and the Leuites, and to al Iuda, and Iſrael that was found, and to the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: In the eightenth yeare of the kingdom of Ioſias was this Phaſe celebrated.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: After that Ioſias had repayred the temple, came vp Nechao the king of Ægypt to fight in Charcamis beſide Euphrates: and Ioſias went forth to meete him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But he ſending meſſengers vnto him, ſayd: What haue I to doe with thee king of Iuda? I come not agaynſt thee this day, but I fight agaynſt an other houſe, to the which God hath commanded me to goe in haſt: leaue to doe agaynſt God, who is with me, leſt he kil thee.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ioſias would not returne, but prepared battel agaynſt him, neither did he agree to the wordes of Nechao from the mouth of God, but went forward to fight in the fielde of Mageddo.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And there being wounded of the Archers, he ſayd to his ſeruantes: Carie me out of the battel, becauſe I am ſore wounded.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Who remoued him from one chariote into an other chariote, that folowed him after the maner of kinges, and they caried him away into Ieruſalem, & he died, and was buried in the monument of his fathers, and al Iuda and Ieruſalem mourned for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Ieremie moſt of al: whoſe lamentations al the ſinging men and ſinging wemen repeate vntil this preſent day vpon Ioſias, and it is growen as it were a law in Iſrael: Behold it is ſayd to be writen in the lamentations.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ioſias & of his mercies: which are commanded by the law of our Lord:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: his workes alſo the firſt and the laſt, are writen in the Booke of the kinges of Iuda and Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: THE people therfore of the land tooke Ioachaz the ſonne of Ioſias, and made him king for his father in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Three and twentie yeares old was Ioachaz, when he began to reigne, and he reigned three monethes in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And the king of Ægypt when he came into Ieruſalem, depoſed him, and condemned the land in an hundred talentes of ſiluer, and a talent of gold.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he made Eliakim his brother king for him, ouer Iuda and Ieruſalem: and he turned his name Ioakim; but he tooke Ioachaz himſelf with him, and caried him away into Ægypt.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Fiue and twentie yeares old was Ioakim when he began to reigne, and he reigned eleuen yeares in Ieruſalem: and he did euil before our Lord his God.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Agaynſt him came vp Nabuchodonoſor the king of the Chaldees, and brought him bound in chaynes into Babylon.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Whither he tranſported alſo the veſſels of our Lord, and put them in his temple.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But the reſt of the wordes of Ioakim, and of his abominations; which he wrought, and the thinges that were found in him, are contayned in the Booke of the kinges of Iuda and Iſrael. And Ioachin his ſonne reigned for him.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Eight yeares old was Ioachin when he began to reigne, and he reigned three monethes and ten dayes in Ieruſalem, and he did euil in the ſight of our Lord.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And when the compaſſe of a yeare was come about, Nabuchodonoſor the king ſent ſome, that brought him in to Babylon, the moſt precious veſſels of the houſe of our Lord being caried away withal: But he made Sedecias his vncle king ouer Iuda and Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: One & twentie yeares old was Sedecias when he began to reigne: & he reigned eleuen yeares in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And he did euil in the eies of our Lord his God, neither did he reuerence the face of Ieremie the prophet ſpeaking to him from the mouth of our Lord
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: He reuolted alſo from king Nabuchodonoſor, who had adiured him by God: & he hardened his necke & his hart, that he would not returne to our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Yea & al the chiefe of the Prieſtes, and the people tranſgreſſed vnlawfully according to al the abominations of the Gentiles: and they polluted the houſe of our Lord, which he had ſanctified to him in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And our Lord the God of their fathers ſent to them, by the hand of his meſſengers, ryſing by night, and daily admonishing them: for that he ſpared his people and his habitation.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But they mocked the meſſengers of God, and litle eſtemed his wordes, and ſcorned the prophetes, vntil the furie of our Lord aſcended vpon his people, and there was no amendment.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: For he brought vpon them the king of the Chaldees, and ſlewe their yong men with the ſword in the houſe of his ſanctuarie, he pitied not yong man, and virgin, and old man, no neither him that ſtouped for age, but he deliuered al into his handes.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: And al the veſſels of the houſe of our Lord, as wel greater as leſſer, and the treaſures of the temple, and of the king, and the princes he tranſported into Babylon.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: The enemies ſet fyre on the houſe of God, and deſtroyed the wal of Ieruſalem, al the towres they burnt, and what ſoeuer was pretious, they deſtroyed.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: If anie man eſcaped the ſword, being led into Babylon he ſerued the king and his ſonnes, til the king of the Perſians reigned.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: That the word of our Lord by the mouth of Ieremie might be accompliſhed, and the land might celebrate their Sabbathes: for al the daies of the deſolation she kept a Sabbath, til the ſeuentie yeares were expyred.
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: But in the firſt yeare of Cyrus king of Perſians, to fulfil the word of our Lord, which he had ſpoken by the mouth of Ieremie, our Lord rayſed vp the ſpirit of Cyrus king of the Perſians: who commanded to be proclaymed in al his kingdom, yea by writing, ſaying:
label: 2 Paralipomenon

text: Thus ſayth Cyrus king of the Perſians: Al kingdomes of the earth hath the Lord the God of heauen geuen me, and he hath commanded me that I should build him a houſe in Ieruſalem, which is in Iewrie: who of you is there in al his people? The Lord his God be with him, and let him goe vp.
label: 2 Paralipomenon
