text: IN THE firſt yeare of Cyrus king of the Perſians, that the word of our Lord by the mouth of Ieremie might be accomplishd, our Lord rayſed vp the ſpirit of Cyrus king of Perſians: and he made proclamation in al his kingdom, yea by wryting, ſaying:
label: 1 Esdras

text: Thus ſayth Cyrus king of the Perſians: Al the kingdomes of the earth hath the Lord the God of heauen geuen me, & he hath commanded me that I should build him a houſe in Ieruſalem, which is in Iewrie.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Who is there among you of al his people? His God be with him. Let him goe vp into Ieruſalem, which is in Iewrie, and build the houſe of the Lord the God of Iſrael, he is the God that is in Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And let al the reſt in al places wherſoeuer they dwel, let euery man of his place helpe him, with ſiluer and gold, and ſubſtance, and cattel, beſides that which they offer voluntarily to the temple of God, which is in Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And there roſe vp the princes of the fathers of Iuda and Beniamin, & the Prieſtes, and Leuites, and euerie one, whoſe ſpirit God rayſed vp, to goe vp to build the temple of our Lord, which was in Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And al that were round about, did helpe their handes in veſſels of ſiluer, and of gold, in ſubſtance, and beaſtes, in furniture, beſides thoſe thinges which they had offered voluntarily.
label: 1 Esdras

text: King Cyrus alſo brought forth the veſſels of the temple of our Lord, which Nabuchodonoſor had taken of Ieruſalem, and had put them in the temple of his God.
label: 1 Esdras

text: But Cyrus the king of Perſians brought them forth by the hand of Mithridates the ſonne of Gazabar, & numbred them to Saſſabaſar the prince of Iuda.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And this is the number of them; Phials of gold thirtie, phials of ſiluer a thouſand, kniues twentie nine, goblettes of gold thirtie,
label: 1 Esdras

text: goblettes of ſiluer of the ſecond order, foure hundred tenne: other veſſels a thouſand.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Al the veſſels of gold and ſiluer, fiue thouſand foure hundred: Saſſabaſar tooke al with them, that went vp from the tranſmigration of Babylon into Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Esdras

text: AND theſe are the children of the prouince, that went vp from the captiuitie, which Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon had tranſported into Babylon, and returned into Ieruſalem and Iuda, euerie man into his citie.
label: 1 Esdras

text: They that came with Zorobabel, Ioſue, Nehemia, Saraia, Rahelaia, Mardochai, Belſan, Meſphar, Beguai, Rehum, Baana: The number of the men of the people of Iſrael:
label: 1 Esdras

label: 1 Esdras

label: 1 Esdras

text: The children of the Porters: the children of Sellum, the children of Ater, the childreu of Telmon, the children of Accub, the children of Hatita, the children of Sobai: al an hundred thirtie nine.
label: 1 Esdras

label: 1 Esdras

label: 1 Esdras

label: 1 Esdras

text: The children of Bacbuc, the children of Hacupha, the children of Harhur,
label: 1 Esdras

label: 1 Esdras

label: 1 Esdras

text: The children of Naſia, the children of Hatipha,
label: 1 Esdras

text: The children of the ſeruants of Salomon, the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Pharuda,
label: 1 Esdras

text: The children of Iala, the children of Dercon, the childrē of Geddel,
label: 1 Esdras

text: The children of Saphatia, the children of Hatil, the children of Phochereth, which were of Aſebaim, the children of Ami.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Al the Nathineites, and the children of the ſeruantes of Salomon, three hundred ninetie two.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And theſe are they that came vp from Thelmela, Thelharſa, Cherub, and Adon, and Emer. And they could not shew the houſe of their fathers and their ſeede, whether they were of Iſrael.
label: 1 Esdras

text: The children of Dalaia, the children of Tobia, the children of Necoda, ſix hundred fiftie two.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the children of the Prieſtes: The children of Hobia, the children of Accos, the children of Berzellai, who tooke a wife of the daughters of Berzellai the Galaadite, and was called by their name:
label: 1 Esdras

text: theſe ſought the writing of their genealogie, and found it not, and they were caſt out of the Prieſthood.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And Atherſatha ſaid to them, that they should not eate of the Holie of holies, til there roſe a prieſt learned and perfect.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Al the multitude as it were one man, fourtie two thouſand three hundred ſixtie:
label: 1 Esdras

text: beſide their men ſeruantes, & wemen ſeruantes, which were ſeuen thouſand three hundred thirtie ſeuen: and among them ſinging men, and ſinging wemen two hundred.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Their horſes ſeuen hundred thirtie ſix, their mules two hundred fourtie fiue,
label: 1 Esdras

text: their cameles, foure hundred thirtie fiue, their aſſes ſix thouſand ſeuen hundred twentie.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the princes of the fathers, when they entred into the temple of our Lord, which is in Ieruſalem, they offered voluntarily vnto the houſe of our Lord to build it in his place.
label: 1 Esdras

text: According to their abilities, they gaue the expenſes of the worke, of gold ſixtie one thouſand ſoldes, of ſiluer fiue thouſand poundes, & garmentes for the prieſtes an hundred.
label: 1 Esdras

text: The Prieſtes therfore & the Leuites, and they of the people, and the ſinging men, and the porters, and the Nathinaites dwelt in their cities, and al Iſrael in their cities.
label: 1 Esdras

text: AND now the ſeuenth moneth was come, and the children of Iſrael were in their cities: the people therfore was gathered together as it were one man into Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And Ioſue the ſonne of Ioſedec roſe vp, and his brethren the Prieſtes, and Zorobabel the ſonne of Salathiel, and his brethren, and they built the altar of the God of Iſrael, that they might offer on it holocauſtes, as it is writen in the law of Moyſes the man of God.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they placed the altar of God vpon his feete, the people of the lands round about putting them in feare, & they offered vpon it holocauſt to our Lord morning and euening.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they made the ſolemnitie of tabernacles, as it is writen, and holocauſt euery day by order according to the præcept, the worke of the day in his day.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And after theſe thinges the continual holocauſt, as wel in the Calendes, as in al the ſolemnities of our Lord, that were conſecrated, and in al wherein there was offered voluntarily a gift to our Lord.
label: 1 Esdras

text: From the firſt day of the ſeuenth moneth they began to offer holocauſt to our Lord: moreouer the temple of God was not yet founded.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they gaue money to hewers of ſtones and to maſons: meate alſo and drinke, and oyle to the Sidonians and Tyrians, that they should bring ceder trees from Libanus to the ſea vnto Ioppe, according to that which Cyrus the king of the Perſians had commanded them.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And in the ſecond yeare of their coming to the temple of God in Ieruſalem, the ſecond moneth, began Zorobabel the ſonne of Salathiel, and Ioſue the ſonne of Ioſedec, and the reſt of their brethren the Prieſtes, and the Leuites, and al that were come from the captiuitie into Ieruſalem, and they appoynted Leuites from twentie yeares and vpward, that they ſhould haſten forward the worke of our Lord.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And Ioſue ſtood and his ſonnes, and his brethren, Cedmihel, and his ſonnes, and the children of Iuda, as it were one man, that they might be inſtant vpon them, that did the worke in the temple of God: the ſonnes of Henadad, and their ſonnes, and their brethren Leuites.
label: 1 Esdras

text: The temple therfore of our Lord being founded by the maſons, the Prieſtes ſtood in their attyre with trumpettes: and the Leuites the children of Aſaph in cymbals, to prayſe God by the handes of Dauid the king of Iſrael.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they ſang together in hymnes, and confeſſion to our Lord: Becauſe he is good, becauſe his mercie is for euer vpon Iſrael. Al the people alſo made a ſhoute with a lowde crie in prayſing our Lord, becauſe the temple of our Lord was founded.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Verie manie alſo of the Prieſtes and the Leuites, and the princes of the fathers, & the ancients, that had ſeene the former temple; when they ſaw this temple founded, they wept with a lowd voyce: and manie ſhouting in ioy, lifted vp their voyce.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Neither could anie man diſcerne the voice of the crie of them that reioyced, and the voice of the weeping of the people: for one with an other the people showted with a lowd crie, and the voice was heard far of.
label: 1 Esdras

text: BVT the enemies of Iuda and Beniamin heard that the children of the captiuitie built a temple to our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And coming to Zorobabel, and the princes of the fathers, they ſayd to them: Let vs build with you, becauſe euen as you, ſo do we ſeeke your God: Behold we haue immolated victimes from the dayes of Aſor Haddan the king of Aſſur, which brought vs hither.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And Zorobabel ſayd to them, and Ioſue, and the reſt of the princes of the fathers of Iſrael: It is not for you and vs to build a houſe to our God, but we our ſelues alone wil build to the Lord our God, as Cyrus the king of the Perſians hath cōmanded vs.
label: 1 Esdras

text: It came to paſſe therfore that the people of the land hindred the handes of the people of Iuda, and trubled them in building.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they hyred counſelers agaynſt them, to deſtroy theyr counſel al the dayes of Cyrus the king of the Perſians, & vntil the reigne of Darius the king of the Perſians.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And in the reigne of Aſſuerus in the begining of his reigne, they wrote an accuſation againſt the inhabitantes of Iuda and Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And in the dayes of Artaxerxes Beſelam, Mitridates, & Thabeel, & the reſt that were in theyr counſel writ to Artaxerxes king of the Perſians: and the epiſtle of the accuſation was writen in Syriake, and was read in the Sirian language.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Reum Beelteem, and Samſai ſcribe wrote one epiſtle from Ieruſalem to Artaxerxes the king, of this tenure:
label: 1 Esdras

text: Reum Beelteem, and Samſai ſcribe, and the reſt of their counſelers, the Dineites, and the Apharſathaceites, the Terphaleites, the the Apharſeites, the Erchueites; the Babylonians, the Suſanecheites, the Dieuites, and the Aelamites,
label: 1 Esdras

text: and the reſt of the Gentiles, which Aſenaphar the great and glorious tranſported: and made them dwel in the cities of Samaria, and in the reſt of the countries beyond the Riuer in peace:
label: 1 Esdras

text: ( this is the copie of the epiſtle, which they ſent to him) To Artaxerxes the king, thy ſeruantes, the men that are beyond the Riuer, ſend greeting.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Be it knowen to the king, that the Iewes, which came vp from thee to vs, are come into Ieruſalem a rebellious and naughtie citie, which they build making the rampyres thereof, and repayring the walles.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Now therfore be it knowen to the king, that if that citie ſhal be built, and the walles therof repayred, they will not geue tribute, and tolle, & yearly rentes, and this damage wil come euen to the kinges.
label: 1 Esdras

text: But we mindful of the ſalt that we haue eaten in the palace, and becauſe we count it heynous to ſee the kings harmes, therfore we haue ſent and certified the king,
label: 1 Esdras

text: that thou recount in the bookes of the hiſtories of thy fathers, and thou shalt finde writen in the commentaries: and shalt know that that citie is a rebellious citie, and hurtful to the kinges, and prouinces, and battels are rayſed in it of old time: for the which cauſe alſo the citie it ſelfe was deſtroyed.
label: 1 Esdras

text: We certifie the king, that if that citie shal be built, and the walles therof repayred, thou shalt haue no poſſeſſion beyond the Riuer.
label: 1 Esdras

text: The king ſent word to Reum Beelteem, and Samſai ſcribe, and to the reſt that were in their counſel inhabitantes of Samaria, and to the reſt beyond the Riuer, ſending greeting and peace.
label: 1 Esdras

text: The accuſation, which you haue ſent to vs, was openly read before me.
label: 1 Esdras

text: and I gaue commandment: and they recounted, and haue found, that that citie of old time rebelleth agaynſt the kinges, and ſeditions and battels are rayſed in it.
label: 1 Esdras

text: For there haue beene alſo moſt valiant kinges in Ieruſalem, which alſo had dominion ouer al the countrie, that is beyond the Riuer. They tooke alſo tribute, and tolle, and rentes.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Now therfore heare the ſentence: Prohibite ye thoſe men, that that citie be not built, til it perhaps ſhal be commanded by me.
label: 1 Esdras

text: See that you doe not negligently accomplish this thing; and by litle there grow euil agaynſt the kinges.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Therfore the copie of the edict of Artaxerxes the king was read before Reum Beelteem, and Samſai the ſcribe, and their counſelers: and they went in haſt into Ieruſalem to the Iewes, & prohibited them with arme and ſtrength.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Then was the worke of the houſe of our Lord in Ieruſalem intermitted, and was not done vntil the ſecond yeare of the reigne of Darius the king of the Perſians.
label: 1 Esdras

text: AND there prophecied Aggeus the Prophete, & Zacharias the ſonne of Addo, prophecying to the Iewes, that were in Iewrie and Ieruſalem, in the name of the God of Iſrael.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Then roſe vp Zorobabel the ſonne of Salathiel, and Ioſue the ſonne of Ioſedec, and began to build the temple of God in Ieruſalem, and with them the prophetes of God helping them.
label: 1 Esdras

text: But at the ſame time there came to them Thathanai, who was prince beyond the Riuer, and Stharbuzanai, and their counſelers: and ſayd thus to them: Who hath geuen you counſel to build this houſe, and to repayre the walles?
label: 1 Esdras

text: Wherto we anſwered them, what the names were of the men that were authors of that building.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And the eye of theyr God was ſet vpon the ancientes of the Iewes, and they could not inhibite them. And it pleaſed them that the matter ſhould be referred to Darius, and then they would ſatisfie agaynſt that accuſation.
label: 1 Esdras

text: The copie of the epiſtle, which Thathanai prince of the countrie beyond the Riuer ſent, and Stharbuzanai, and his counſelers the Arphaſacheites, which were beyond the Riuer, to Darius the king.
label: 1 Esdras

text: The word, which they ſent him, was writen thus: To Darius the king al peace.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Be it knowen to the king, that we went to Iurie, the prouince, to the houſe of the great God, which is in building with ſtone vnpolished, and timber is put in the walles: and that worke is in building diligently, and groweth in their handes.
label: 1 Esdras

text: We therfore demanded of thoſe ancientes; and thus we ſayd to them: Who hath geuen you authoritie to build this houſe, & to repaire theſe walles?
label: 1 Esdras

text: Yea and their names we asked of them, that we might certifie thee: and we writte the names of thoſe men, that are the chiefe among them.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they anſwered vs theſe wordes, ſayng: We are the ſeruantes of the God of heauen & earth, and we do build a temple, that was built theſe manie yeares before, and which a great king of Iſrael built and ſet vp.
label: 1 Esdras

text: But after that our fathers prouoked the God of heauen to wrath, he deliuered them into the handes of Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon the Chaldee: this houſe alſo he deſtroyed, and his people he tranſported into Babylon.
label: 1 Esdras

text: But in the firſt yeare of Cyrus the king of Babylon, Cyrus the king put forth an edict, that this houſe of God should be built.
label: 1 Esdras

text: For the veſſeles alſo of the temple of God, of gold and of ſiluer, which Nabuchodonoſor had taken out of the temple, that was in Ieruſalem, and had caried them into the temple of Babylon, Cyrus the king brought forth out of the temple of Babylon, and they were geuen to Saſſabaſar ſo called, whom alſo he appointed the chiefe,
label: 1 Esdras

text: and ſayd to him: Take theſe veſſels, and goe, and put them in the temple, that is in Ieruſalem, and let the houſe of God be built in his place.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Then therfore came this Saſſabaſar, and layd the foundations of the temple of God in Ieruſalem, and from that time vntil now it is in building, and is not yet finished.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Now therfore if it ſeeme good to the king, let him ſearch in the kings librarie, which is in Babylon, whether it hath beene commanded by Cyrus the king, that the houſe of God in Ieruſalem should be built, and let him ſend the kings pleaſure concerning this thing vnto vs.
label: 1 Esdras

text: THen Darius the king commanded, and they ſearched in the librarie of the bookes, that were layd vp in Babylon,
label: 1 Esdras

text: and there was found in Ecbatanis, which is a caſtle in the prouince Medena, one volume, and there was ſuch a cōmentarie writen therein:
label: 1 Esdras

text: In the firſt yeare of Cyrus the king: Cyrus the king decreed, that the houſe of God should be built, which is in Ieruſalem, in the place where they immolate hoſtes, and that they lay the foundations ſupporting the height of threeſcore cubites, & the bredth of threeſcore cubites,
label: 1 Esdras

text: three rewes of ſtones vnpolished, & ſo rewes of new timber: and the coſtes shal be geuen out of the kings houſe.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Yea & the veſſels of the temple of God, of gold & of ſiluer which Nabuchodonoſor had taken out of the Temple of Ieruſalem, and had brought them into Babylon, let them be reſtored,& brought backe into the temple of Ieruſalem vnto their place, which alſo were put in the temple of God.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Now therfore Thathanai prince of the countrie, that is beyond the Riuer, Stharubazanai, and your counſelers the Apharſacheites, which are beyond the Riuer, depart farre from them,
label: 1 Esdras

text: and ſuffer that temple of God to be made of the duke of the Iewes, and of their ancientes, that they may build that houſe of God in his place.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Alſo there is cōmandment geuen from me what muſt be done of thoſe ancientes of the Iewes, that the houſe of God may be built, to witte, that of the kings coffer, that is, of the tributes, that are geuen out of the countrie beyond the Riuer, the charges be diligently geuen to thoſe men, leſt the worke be hindred.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And if it ſhal be neceſſarie, calues alſo, and lambes, and kiddes, for holocauſt to the God of heauen, wheate, ſalt, wyne, and oyle, according to the rite of the Prieſtes, that are in Ieruſalem, let there be geuen them day dy day, that there be no complaynte in any thing.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And let them offer oblations to the God of heauen, and pray for the life of the king, and of his children.
label: 1 Esdras

text: By me therfore there is a decree made; That euerie man, which ſhal alter this commandement, there be a beame taken of his houſe, and ſet vp, and he be faſt hanged vpon it, and his houſe be confiſcate.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And the God, that hath made his name to dwel there, deſtroy al kingdomes, and the people that shal extend theyr hand to reſiſt, & to deſtroy the houſe of God, that is in Ieruſalé. I Darius haue made the decree, which I wil to be diligently accōplished.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Therfore Thathanai the prince of the countrie beyond the Riuer, and Stharbuzani, and his counſelers, according to that which Darius the king had commanded, ſo did execute it diligently.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And the ancientes of the Iewes built, and proſpered according to the prophecie of Aggeus the prophet, and of Zacharias the ſonne of Addo: and they built and ſet vp, the God of Iſrael commanding, and Cyrus commanding, and Darius, and Artaxerxes the kings of the Perſians.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they were finiſhing this houſe of God, vntil the third day of the moneth of Adar, which is the ſixth yeare of Darius the king.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And the children of Iſrael, the Prieſtes and the Leuites, and the reſt of the tranſmigration, made the dedication of the houſe of God in ioy.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they offered in the dedication of the houſe of God, calues an hundred, rammes two hundred, lambes foure hundred, buckgoates for the ſinne of al Iſrael twelue, according to the number of the tribes of Iſrael.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they ſet the Prieſtes in theyr orders, and the Leuites in theyr courſes ouer the workes of God in Ieruſalem, as it is writen in the booke of Moyſes.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And the children of Iſrael of the tranſmigration made the Phaſe, the fourtenth day of the firſt moneth,
label: 1 Esdras

text: For al the Prieſtes and the Leuites were purified as it were one man: al cleane to immolate the Phaſe for al the children of the tranſmigration, and for theyr brethren the Prieſtes, and them ſelues.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And the children of Iſrael that were returned from the tranſmigration, did eate, and al that had ſeparated them ſelues from the coinquination of the Gentiles of the earth vnto them, to ſeeke our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they made the ſolemnitie of Azymes ſeuen dayes in ioy, becauſe our Lord had made them ioyful, and had turned the hart of the king of Aſſur to them, that he ſhould helpe theyr handes in the worke of the houſe of our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 1 Esdras

text: AND after theſe thinges in the reigne of Artaxerxes king of Perſians, Eſdras the ſonne of Saraias, the ſonne of Azarias, the ſonne of Helcias,
label: 1 Esdras

text: the ſonne of Sellum, the ſonne of Sadoc, the ſonne of Achitob,
label: 1 Esdras

text: the ſonne of Amarias, the ſonne of Azarias, the ſonne of Maraioth,
label: 1 Esdras

text: the ſonne of Zarahias, the ſonne of Ozi, the ſonne of Bocci,
label: 1 Esdras

text: the ſonne of Abiſue, the ſonne of Phinees, the ſonne of Eleazar, the ſonne of Aaron the Prieſt from the begynning.
label: 1 Esdras

text: The ſame Eſdras came vp from Babylon, and he was a quicke ſcribe in the law of Moyſes, which our Lord God gaue to Iſrael: and the king gaue him according to the hand of our Lord his God vpon him al his petition.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And there came vp of the children of Iſrael, and of the children of the Prieſtes, and of the children of the Leuites, and of the ſinging men, and of the porters, and of the Nathineites into Ieruſalem in the ſeuenth yeare of Artaxerxes the king.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they came into Ieruſalem the fifth moneth, that is the ſeuenth yeare of the king.
label: 1 Esdras

text: For in the firſt day of the firſt moneth he began to goe vp from Babylon, and in the firſt day of the fifth moneth he came into Ieruſalem according to the good hand of his God vpon him.
label: 1 Esdras

text: For Eſdras prepared his hart to ſearch the law of our Lord, and to doe and to teach in Iſrael preceptes and iudgement.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And this is the copie of the epiſtle of the edict, which king Artaxerxes gaue to Eſdras the Prieſt, the learned ſcribe, in the wordes and preceptes of our Lord, and his ceremonies in Iſrael.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Artaxerxes the king of kings to Eſdras the Prieſt, the moſt learned ſcribe of the law of God of heauē, greeting.
label: 1 Esdras

text: It is decreed by me that whōſoeuer it shal pleaſe in my kingdom of the people of Iſrael, and of the Prieſtes and Leuites, to goe into Ieruſalē, let him goe with thee.
label: 1 Esdras

text: For thou art ſent from the face of the king, and of his ſeuen counſelers, that thou mayſt viſite Iewrie and Ieruſalem in the law of thy God, which is in thy hand.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And that thou maiſt carie the ſiluer & gold, which the king & his counſelers haue voluntarily offered to the God of Iſrael, whoſe tabernacle is in Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And al the ſiluer and gold whatſoeuer thou ſhalt finde in al the prouince of Babylon, and the people wil offer, and of the Prieſtes that shal voluntarely offer to the houſe of theyr God, which is in Ieruſalem,
label: 1 Esdras

text: take freely, and bye diligently of this money calues, rammes, lambes, and the ſacrifices and libamentes of them, and offer them vpon the altar of the temple of your God, that is in Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Yea and if it shal pleaſe thee, and thy brethren to doe any thing with the reſt of the ſiluer and gold, doe ye according to the wil of your God.
label: 1 Esdras

text: The veſſels alſo, which are geuen thee for the miniſterie of the houſe of thy God, deliuer thou in the ſight of God in Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Yea and other thinges wherof neede shal be for the houſe of thy God, how much ſoeuer is neceſſarie for thee to ſpend, thou shalt geue it out of the treaſure, and excheker of the king, and from me.
label: 1 Esdras

text: I Artaxerxes the king haue appointed and decreed to al the keepers of the common coffer, that are beyond the Riuer, that whatſoeuer Eſdras the Prieſt, the ſcribe of the law of God of heauen, shal aske of you, you geue it without delay,
label: 1 Esdras

text: vnto an hundred talentes of ſiluer, and vnto an hundred cores of wheat, and vnto an hundred bates of wyne, and vnto an hundred bates of oyle, but ſalt without meaſure.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Al that pertayneth to the rite of the God of heauen, let it be geuen diligently in the houſe of the God of heauen: leſt perhaps he be angrie agaynſt the kingdom of the king, and of his ſonnes.
label: 1 Esdras

text: We doe you alſo to vnderſtand concerning al the Prieſtes, and Leuites, and the ſingers, and the porters, the Nathineites, and miniſters of the houſe of this God, that you haue no authoritie to put tolle and tribute, and yearlie rentes vpon them.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And thou Eſdras according to the wiſedom of thy God, which is in thy hand, appoynt iudges and preſidentes, that they may iudge for al the people, that is beyond the Riuer, that is for them which know the law of thy God, yea and the ignorant teach ye frely.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And euerie one that shal not doe the law of thy God, and the law of thy king diligently, there shal be iudgement of him, either vnto death, or into banishment, or to the confiſcation of his ſubſtance, or at the leaſt into priſon.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Bleſſed be our Lord, the God of our fathers, which hath put this in the kinges hart, that he would glorifie the houſe of our Lord, which is in Ieruſalem,
label: 1 Esdras

text: and hath inclined his mercie toward me before the king and his counſelers, and al the mightie princes of the king: and I taking courage by the hand of our Lord my God, which was on me, gathered together out of Iſrael princes that should goe vp with me.
label: 1 Esdras

text: THESE therfore are the princes of the families, and the genealogie of them, that came vp with me in the reigne of Artaxerxes the king out of Babylon.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Phinees, Gerſom. Of the children of Ithamar, Daniel. Of the children of Dauid, Hattus.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Sechenias, the children of Pharos, Zacharias: and with him were numbered an hundred fiftie men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Phahath Moab, Eleoenai the ſonne of Zareha, and with him two hundred men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Sechenias, the ſonne of Ezechiel, and with him three hundred men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Adan, Abed the ſonne of Ionathan, and with him fiftie men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Alam, Iſaias the ſonne of Athalia, and with him ſeuentie men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Saphatia, Zebedia the ſonne of Michael, and with him eightie men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Ioab, Obedia the ſonne of Iahiel, and with him two hundred and eightene men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Selomith, the ſonne of Ioſphia, and with him an hundred ſixtie men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Bebai, Zacharias the ſonne of Bebai: and with him twentie eight men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Azgad, Ioanan the ſonne of Eccetan, and with him an hundred and ten men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Adonicam, which were the laſt: and theſe are theyr names: Elipheleth, and Iehiel, and Samaias, and with them ſixtie men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Begui, Vthai and Zachur, and with them ſeuentie men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And I gathered them to the riuer, which runneth downe to Ahaua, and we taried there three daies: and I ſought among the people and among the Prieſtes for the children of Leui, and found none there.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Therfore I ſent Eliezer, and Ariel, and Semeias, and Elnathan, and Iarib, and other Elnathan, and Nathan, and Zacharias, and Moſollam princes: and Ioiarib, and Elnathan wiſe men.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And I ſent them to Eddo, which is chiefe in the place of Chaſphia, and I did put in theyr mouth the wordes that they should ſpeake to Eddo, and his brethren the Nathineites in the place of Chaſphia, that they should bring vs miniſters of the houſe of our God.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they brought vs by the good hand of our God vpon vs a moſt learned man of the children of Mocholi the ſonne of Leui the ſonne of Iſrael, and Sarabias and his ſonnes, aud his brethren eightene,
label: 1 Esdras

text: and Haſabias, and with him Iſaias of the children of Merari, and his brethren, and his ſonnes twentie.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And al the Nathineites, which Dauid gaue, and the princes for the miniſteries of the Leuites, Natineites two hundred twentie: al theſe were called by theyr names.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And I proclaymed there a faſt beſide the Riuer of Ahaua, that we might be afflicted before the Lord our God, and might deſire of him a right way for vs and our children, and al our ſubſtance.
label: 1 Esdras

text: For I was aſhamed to aſke the king ayde and horſemen, that might defend vs from the enemie in the way: becauſe we had ſayd to the king: The hand of our God is vpon al them, that ſeeke him in goodneſſe: and his empire and ſtrength, and furie vpon al them that forſake him.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And we faſted, and beſought our God hereby: and it fel out proſperouſely vnto vs.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And I ſeparated twelue of the chief Prieſtes, Sarabias, and Haſabias, and with them ten of theyr brethren.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And I weyed vnto them the ſiluer and gold, and the conſecrated veſſels of the houſe of our God, which the king had offered and his counſelers, and his princes, and al Iſrael of them, that were found:
label: 1 Esdras

text: and I weyed in theyr handes of ſiluer ſix hundred fiftie talentes, and veſſels of ſiluer an hundred, of gold an hundred talentes:
label: 1 Esdras

text: and cuppes of gold twentie, which had a thouſand ſolides, and two veſſels of the beſt ſhyning braſſe, fayre, as gold.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And I ſayd to them: You are the holie of our Lord, and the veſſels are holie, and the ſiluer and gold, that is voluntarely offered to our Lord the God of our fathers:
label: 1 Esdras

text: Watch & keepe it, vntil you deliuer it by weight before the princes of the Prieſtes, and of the Leuites, and the princes of the families of Iſrael in Ieruſalem, into the treaſure of the houſe of our Lord.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And the Prieſtes and the Leuites receiued the weight of the ſiluer and gold, and of the veſſels, to carie it to Ieruſalem into the houſe of our God.
label: 1 Esdras

text: We therfore did ſette forward from the riuer of Ahaua the twelfth day of the firſt moneth to goe on to Ieruſalem: and the hand of our God was vpon vs, and deliuered vs from the hand of the enemie, and the lyer in wayte by the way.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And we came to Ieruſalem, and we taried there three dayes.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And in the fourth day the ſiluer was weyed, and the gold, and the veſſels in the houſe of our God by the hand of Meremoth the ſonne of Vrias the Prieſt, and with him Eleazar the ſonne of Phimees, and with them Iozabed the ſonne of Ioſue, and Noadaia the ſonne of Bemai Leuites,
label: 1 Esdras

text: according to the number and weight of al: and al the weight was deſcribed at that tyme.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Yea and the children of the tranſmigration that were come from the captiuitie, offered holocauſtes to the God of Iſrael, calues twelue for al the people of Iſrael, rammes nyntie ſix, lambes ſeuentie ſeuen, buckegoates for ſinne twelue: al for holocauſt to our Lord.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they gaue the kings edictes to the princes, that were ouerſeers for the king, and the dukes beyond the Riuer, and they aduanced the people and the houſe of God.
label: 1 Esdras

text: AND after theſe thinges were accomplished, the princes came to me, ſaying: The people of Iſrael, and the Prieſts and Leuites are not ſeperated from the people of the landes, and from the abhominations of them, to witte, of the Chananeite, and Hetheite, and Pherezeite, and Iebuſeite, and of the Ammonites, and Moabites, and the Ægyptians, and Amorrheites.
label: 1 Esdras

text: For they haue taken of their daughters to them and to their ſonnes, and haue mingled the holie ſeede with the people of the landes. The hand alſo of the princes and magiſtrates hath bene firſt in this tranſgreſſion.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And when I had heard this word, I rent my cloke and my coate, and plucked of the heares of my head and bearde, and ſate mourning.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And there aſſembled to me al that feared the God of Iſrael, for the trangreſſion of them, that were come from the captiuitie, and I ſate ſorowful, vntil the euening ſacrifice.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And at the euening ſacrifice I roſe out of my affliction, and my cloke and coate being rent I fell vpon my knees, and ſpred forth my hands to our Lord my God,
label: 1 Esdras

text: And ſaid: My God I am confounded and ashamed to lifte vp my face to thee: becauſe our iniquities are multiplied ouer our head, and our ſinnes haue growen euen vnto heauen,
label: 1 Esdras

text: from the dayes of our fathers: yea and we our ſelues alſo haue ſinned greuouſly vnto this day, and in our iniquities haue we bene deliuered our ſelues, and our Kinges, and our Prieſtes into the hand of the kinges of the landes, and into the ſword, and into captuitie, and into ſpoyle, and into confuſion of countenance, as alſo at this day.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And now as it were a litle, and for a moment was our prayer made before the Lord our God, that a remnant might be left vs, and a nayle might be geuen vs in his holie place, and that our God would illuminate our eies, and would geue vs a litle life in our bondage.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Becauſe we are bondmen, and in our bondage our God did not forſake vs, & he inclined mercie vpon vs before the king of the Perſians, to geue vs life, and to aduance the houſe of our God, and to build the deſolations therof and to geue vs a hedge in Iuda and Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And now what shal we ſay, ô our God, after theſe thinges? becauſe we haue forſaken thy cōmandmēts,
label: 1 Esdras

text: which thou haſt cōmanded in the hand of thy ſeruantes the prophetes, ſaying: The land, to the which you enter to poſſeſſe it, is an vncleane land, according to the vncleanneſſe of peoples, and of other landes, by the abhominations of them that haue filled it from mouth vnto mouth in theier coinquination.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Now therfore geue not your daughters to their ſonnes, and their daughters take not for your ſonnes, and doe ye not ſeeke their peace, and their proſperity for euer: that you may be ſtrengthned, and may eate the goodes that are of the land, and may haue your children heyres for euer.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And after al thinges that come vpon vs in our moſt wicked workes, and our moſt great ſinne, becauſe thou our God haſt deliuered vs from our iniquitie, and haſt geuen vs health as it is at this day,
label: 1 Esdras

text: that we shal not turne away, and make fruſtrate thy commandementes, neither ſhould ioyne matrimonies with the peoples of theſe abominations. Why art thou angrie with vs vnto vtter deſtruction, not to leaue vs a remnant vnto ſaluation?
label: 1 Esdras

text: Lord God of Iſrael thou art iuſt: becauſe we are leift, which ſhould be ſaued as at this day. Behold we are before thee in our ſinne, for there can be no ſtanding before thee vpon this.
label: 1 Esdras

text: ESDRAS therfore thus praying, and beſeeching, and weeping, and lying before the temple of God, there was gathered to him of Iſrael an exceeding great companie of men and wemen and children, and the people wept with much lamentation.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And Sechenias the ſonne of Iehiel of the children of Aelam anſwered, and ſaid to Eſdras: We haue tranſgreſſed againſt our God, and haue taken to wiues ſtrange wemen of the peoples of the land: and now if there be penance in Iſrael vpon this,
label: 1 Esdras

text: let vs make a couenant with the Lord our God, to put away al the wiues, and them that are borne of them, according to the wil of our Lord, and of them that feare the precept of the Lord our God: be it done according to the law.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Ariſe, it is thy part to diſcerne, and we wil be with thee: take courage, and doe it.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Eſdras therefore roſe vp, and adiured the Princes of the Prieſtes and of the Leuites, and al Iſrael, that they should doe according to this word, and they ſware.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And Eſdras roſe vp before the houſe of God, and went to the chamber of Iohanan the ſonne of Eliaſib, and entered into it, he did eate no bread, and dranke no water: for he mourned for the tranſgreſſion of them, that were come out of the captiuitie.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And there was a proclamation ſent in Iuda and Ieruſalem to al the children of the tranſmigration, that they should aſſemble together into Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And euerie one that shal not come within three dayes, according to the counſel of the princes and ancientes, al his ſubſtance shal be taken away, and him ſelfe shal be caſt out of the companie of the tranſmigration.
label: 1 Esdras

text: There aſſembled therfore al the men of Iuda, and Beniamin into Ieruſalem within three dayes, that is the ninth moneth, the twenteth day of the moneth: and al the people ſate in the ſtreate of the houſe of God, trembling for the ſinne, and the rayne.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And Eſdras the Prieſt aroſe, and ſayd to them: You haue tranſgreſſed, and taken ſtrange wemen to wife, to adde vpon the ſinne of Iſrael.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And now geue confeſſion to our Lord the God of your fathers, and doe his pleaſure, and be ſeparated from the peoples of the land, and from your wiues the ſtrangers.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And al the multitude anſwered, and ſayd with a lowde voyce: According to thy word vnto vs, ſo be it done.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Neuertheleſſe becauſe there is much people, and a tyme of rayne, and we can not abyde to ſtand without, and it is not a worke of one day or two ( for we haue excedingly ſinned in this thing )
label: 1 Esdras

text: let there be princes appoynted in al the multitude: and let al in our cities that haue taken ſtrangers to wife, come at ſette tymes, and with them the ancientes by citie and citie, and the iudges therof, vntil the wrath of our God be turned away from vs for this ſinne.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Therfore Ionathan the ſonne of Azahel, and Iaazia the ſonne of Thecua were appoynted ouer this, and Meſollam and Sebethai Leuites did helpe them:
label: 1 Esdras

text: and the children of the tranſmigration did ſo. And Eſdras the Prieſt, and the men, princes of the families went into the houſes of theyr fathers, and al by theyr names, and they ſate in the firſt day of the tenth moneth to ſearch out the matter.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And al the men were fully counted that had taken ſtrangers to wife, vnto the firſt day of the firſt moſneth.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And there were found of the ſonnes of the Prieſtes that had taken ſtrangers to wife. Of the children of Ioſue the ſonne of Ioſedec, and his brethren, Maaſia, and Eliezer, and Iarib, and Godolia.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And they gaue theyr handes to put away theyr wiues, and to offer for theyr offence a ramme of the flocke.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the children of Emmer, Hanani, and Zebedia.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the children of Harim, Maaſia, and Elia, and Semeia, and Iehiel, and Ozias.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the children of Pheſhur, Elionai, Maaſia, Iſmael, Nathanael, Iozabed, and Elaſa.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the children of the Leuites, Iozabed, and Semei, and Celaia, the ſame is Calita, Phataia, Iuda, and Eliezer.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the ſinging men Eliaſib: and of the porters, Sellum, and Thelem, and Vri.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of Iſrael, of the children of Pharos, Remeia, and Iezia, and Melchia, and Miamin, and Eliezer, and Melchia, and Banea.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the children of Aelam, Mathania, Zacharias, and Iehiel, and Abdi, and Ierimoth, and Elia.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the children of Zethua, Elioenai, Eliaſib, Mathania, Ierimuth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the children of Bebai, Iohanan, Hanamia, Zabbai, Athalai:
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the children of Bani, Moſollam, and Melluch, and Adaia, Iaſub, and Saal, and Ramoth.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the children of Phahath Moab, Edna and Chalal, Bananias, and Maaſias, Mathanias, Beſeleel, Bennui, and Manaſſe.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the children of Herem, Eliezer, Ioſue, Melchias, Semeias, Simeon,
label: 1 Esdras

text: Beniamin, Maloch, Samarias.
label: 1 Esdras

text: And of the children of Haſom, Mathanai, Mathatha, Zabad, Eliphelet, Iermai, Manaſſe, Semei.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Bani, Maaddi, Amram, and Vel,
label: 1 Esdras

text: Baneas, and Badaias, Cheliau,
label: 1 Esdras

text: Vania, Marimuth, and Eliaſib,
label: 1 Esdras

text: Mathanias, Mathanai, and Iaſi,
label: 1 Esdras

text: and Bani, and Bennui, Semei,
label: 1 Esdras

text: and Salmias, and Nathan, and Adaias,
label: 1 Esdras

text: and Mechnedebai, Siſai, Sarai,
label: 1 Esdras

text: Ezrel, and Selemiau, Semeria,
label: 1 Esdras

text: Sellum, Amaria, Ioſeph.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Of the children of Nebo, Iehiel, Mathathias, Zabad, Zabina, Ieddu, and Ioel. and Banaia.
label: 1 Esdras

text: Al theſe had taken ſtrangers to wife, and there were of them that had borne children.
label: 1 Esdras

text: THE wordes of Nehemias the ſonne of Helchias. And it came to paſſe in the moneth of Caſleu, the twenteth yeare, and I was in Suſis the caſtel.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And Hanani one of my brethren came, him ſelfe and men of Iuda, and I asked them of the Iewes, that remayned, and were left aliue of the captiuitie, and of Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And they ſayd to me. They that remayned, and are left of the captiuitie there in the prouince, are in great affliction, and in reproche: and the wal of Ieruſalem is broken downe, and the gates therof are burnt with fire.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And when I had heard theſe maner of wordes, I ſate, and wept, and mourned many dayes: and faſted, and prayed before the face of the God of heauen.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I ſayd: I beſech thee Lord God of heauen, ſtrong, great, and terrible, which keepeſt couenant & mercie with them that loue thee, and keepe thy cōmandmentes:
label: 2 Esdras

text: let thine eares be harkning, and thine eyes open, to heare the prayer of thy ſeruant, which I pray before thee this day, night & day for the children of Iſrael thy ſeruantes: and I confeſſe for the ſinnes of the children of Iſrael, in which they haue ſinned to thee: I & my fathers houſe haue ſinned,
label: 2 Esdras

text: we haue bene ſeduced with vanitie, and haue not kept thy commandments, and cerimonies and iudgement, which thou haſt commanded to Moyſes thy ſeruant.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Remember the word, that thou didſt command vnto Moyſes thy ſeruant, ſaying: When you shal tranſgreſſe, I will depreſſe you into peoples:
label: 2 Esdras

text: and if you returne to me, and keepe my precepts, and doe them, although you ſhal be led away to the vttermoſt partes of heauen, thence wil I gather you, and bring you backe into the place, which I haue choſen that my name should dwel there.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And they are thy ſeruantes, and thy people: whom thou haſt redemed in thy great ſtrength, and in thy mighty hand.
label: 2 Esdras

text: I beſech thee Lord, let thine eare be attent to the prayer of thy ſeruant, and to the prayer of thy ſeruants, which will feare thy name: and direct thy ſeruant this day, and giue him mercy before this man. for I was the kings cupbearer.
label: 2 Esdras

text: AND it came to paſſe in the moneth of Niſan, the twentith yeare of Artaxerxes the king: and there was wine before him, and I lifted vp the wine, and gaue to the king: and I was as it were languishing before his face.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the king ſayd to me: Why is thy countenance ſad, whereas I doe not ſee thee ſicke? this is not without cauſe, but ſome euil I know not what, is in thy hart. And I was very much and excedingly afrayd:
label: 2 Esdras

text: and I ſayd to the king: O king for euer mayſt thou liue: why should not my countenance be heauie, becauſe the citie of the houſe of the ſepulchres of my fathers is deſolate, and the gates therof are burnt with fire?
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the king ſayd to me: For what thing makeſt thou requeſt? And I prayed the God of heauen,
label: 2 Esdras

text: and I ſayd to the king: If it ſeme good to the king, and if thy ſeruant do pleaſe before thy face, thou ſend me into Iewrie to the citie of the ſepulchre of my father, and I wil build it.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the king ſayd to me, and the Queene that ſate by him: Vnto what time wil thy iourney be, and when wilt thou returne? And it pleaſed before the king, and he ſent me: and I appoynted him a time.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I ſayd to the king: If it ſeme good to the king, let him geue me letters to the gouernours of the country beyond the Riuer, that they conduct me, til I come into Iewrie:
label: 2 Esdras

text: and a letter to Aſaph the keeper of the kings foreſt, to geue me timber that I may couer the gates of the towre of the houſe, and the walles of the citie, and the houſe that I shal enter into. And the king gaue according to the good hand of my God with me.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I came to the dukes of the countrie beyond the Riuer, and gaue them the kings letters. And the king had ſent with me captaynes of ſoldiers, and horſemen.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And Sanaballat an Horonite, and Tobias a ſeruant an Ammonite heard it, and were greiued with great affliction, that a man was come, which ſought the proſperitie of the children of Iſrael.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I came to Ieruſalem and was there three dayes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: and I aroſe in the night, I and a few men with me, and I told not anie man what God had put in my hart to doe in Ieruſalem, and there was no beaſt with me, but the beaſt wheron I ſate.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I went out by the gate of the valley by night, and before the fountayne of the dragon, and to the gate of the dung, and I viewed the wal of Ieruſalem broken downe, and the gates therof conſumed with fire.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I paſſed to the gate of the fountayne, and to the kinges conduite, and there was no place for the beaſt where on I ſat, to paſſe.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I went vp by the torrent in the night, and viewed the wal, and going backe I came to the gate of the valley, and returned.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But the magiſtraſtes knew not whither I went, or what I did: yea and to the Iewes, and the Prieſtes, and the nobles, and the magiſtrates, and the reſt that did the worke vntil then I had shewed nothing.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I ſayd to them: You know the affliction wherin we are, becauſe Ieruſalem is made deſolate, and the gates thereof are conſumed with fire: Come, and let vs build the walles of Ieruſalem, and let vs be no longer a reproch.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I shewed them the hand of my God, that it was good with me, and the kings wordes, which he had ſpoken to me, and I ſayd: Let vs riſe, and let vs build. And their handes were incouraged in good.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But Sanaballat the Horonite, and Tobias the ſeruant an Ammanite, and Goſem an Arabian heard of it, and they ſcorned vs, and deſpyſed vs, and ſayd: What is this thing, that you doe? Why do you rebel againſt the king?
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I anſwered them, and ſayd to them: The God of heauen he helpeth vs, and we are his ſeruants: let vs riſe and build: but you haue no part, nor iuſtice, nor memorie in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Esdras

text: AND Eliaſib the high Prieſt aroſe, and his bretheren the Prieſtes: and they built the gate of the flocke: they ſanctified it, and ſet the doores therof, and vnto the towre of an hundred cubites they ſanctified it, vnto the towre of Hananeel.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And beſides him did the men of Iericho build, and beſides him built Zachur the ſonne of Amri.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But the fishgate the children of Aſnaa did builde: they couered it, and ſet vp the doores therof, and the lockes, and barres. And beſides them built Marimuth the ſonne of Vrias the ſonne of Accas.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And beſides him built Moſollam the ſonne of Bazachias, the ſonne of Merezebel, and beſides them built Sadoc the ſonne of Baana.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And beſide them builded the Thecuenes: but their great men did not put vnder their neckes in the worke of their Lord.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And Ioiada the ſonne of Phaſea, and Moſollam the ſonne of Beſodia built the oldgate couered it, and ſet vp the doores therof, and the lockes, and barres.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And beſide them built Meltias a Gabaonite, and Iadon a Meronathite, men of Gabaon and Maſpha, for the duke that was in the country beyond the Riuer.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And beſide him built Eziel the ſonne of Araia a goldſmith: and beſide him built Ananias the ſonne of a Pigmentarie: and they leift Ieruſalem vnto the wal of the broder ſtreate.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And beſide him built Raphaia the ſonne of Hur, prince of the ſtreate of Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And beſide them Iedaia the ſonne of Haromaph againſt his houſe: and beſide him built Hattus the ſonne of Haſebomia.
label: 2 Esdras

text: The halfe part of the ſtreate built Melchias the ſonne of Herem, and Haſub the ſonne of Phahath Moab, and the towre of the fornaces.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And beſide him built Sellum the ſonne of Alohes prince of the halfe part of the ſtreate of Ieruſalem, he and his daughters.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the gate of the valley built Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoe: they built it, and ſette vp the dores therof, and the lockes, and barres, and a thouſand cubites in the wal vnto the gate of the dunghil.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the gate of the dunghil built Melchias the ſonne of Rechab, the prince of the ſtreate of Bethacaram: he built it, and ſette vp the dores therof, and the lockes, and barres.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the gate of the fountayne Sellum builded the ſonne of Colhoza, prince of the village of Maſpha: he built it, and couered it, and ſet vp the doores therof, & the lockes, & barres, and the walles of the poole of Siloe vnto the kings gardē, and vnto the ſteppes that goe downe from the citie of Dauid.
label: 2 Esdras

text: After him built Nehemias the ſonne of Azboc prince of the halfe part of the ſtreate of Bethſur, as far as ouer againſt the ſepulchre of Dauid, and vnto the poole, that is built with great worke, and vnto the houſe of the valiants.
label: 2 Esdras

text: After him the Leuites builded, Rehum the ſonne of Benni. After him built Haſebias prince of the halfe part of the ſtreate of Ceila in his ſtreate.
label: 2 Esdras

text: After him built their bretheren Bauai the ſonne of Enadad, prince of the halfe part of Ceila.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And beſide him built Azer the ſonne of Ioſue, the prince of Maſpha the ſecond meaſure, againſt the viſiting of the moſt ſure corner.
label: 2 Esdras

text: After him in the mount built Baruch the ſonne of Zachai the ſecond meaſure, from the corner vnto the gate of the houſe of Eliaſib the high Prieſt.
label: 2 Esdras

text: After him built Merimuth the ſonne of Vrias the ſonne of Haccus, the ſecōd meaſure, from the gate of the houſe of Eliaſib, as far as the houſe of Eliaſib extended.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And after him built the Prieſts, men of the champayne of Iordan.
label: 2 Esdras

text: After him built Beniamin & Haſub againſt their houſe: & after him built Azarias the ſonne of Maſias the ſonne of Ananias againſt his houſe.
label: 2 Esdras

text: After him built Bennui the ſonne of Hanadad the ſecond meaſure, from the houſe of Azarias vnto the bending, and vnto the corner.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Phalel the ſonne of Ozi againſt the bending and the towre, which appeareth from out of the kings high houſe, that is, in the court of the priſon: after him Phadaia the ſonne of Pharos.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the Nathineites dwelt in Ophel, as far as ouer againſt the gate of waters toward the Eaſt, and the towre that ſtoode out.
label: 2 Esdras

text: After him the Thecuenes builded the ſecond meaſure ouer againſt, from the great and eminent towre vnto the wall of the temple.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And vpward to the gate of horſes the Prieſtes built, euery man againſt his houſe.
label: 2 Esdras

text: After them built Sadoc the ſonne of Emmer againſt his houſe. And after him built Semaia the ſonne of Sechenias, keeper of the Eaſt gate.
label: 2 Esdras

text: After him built Hanania the ſonne of Selemia, and Hanun the ſonne of Seleph the ſixth, the ſecond meaſure: after him built Moſollam the ſonne of Barachias, againſt his treaſurie. After him Melchias a goldſmith ſonne vnto the houſe of the Natheneites, and of them that ſold old ſtuffe againſt the iudgement gate, and vnto the vpper chamber of the corner.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And within the vpper chamber of the corner in the gate of the flocke, the goldſmithes and marchants builded.
label: 2 Esdras

text: AND it came to paſſe, when Sanaballat had heard that we builded the wal, he was very angrie: and being moued excedingly he ſcorned the Iewes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: and ſayd before his bretheren, and the multitude of the Samaritanes: What doe the ſillie Iewes? Wil the gentiles let them alone? Shal they ſacrifice and accomplish in one day? Why, are they able to build vp the ſtones out of the heapes of duſt, that are burnt?
label: 2 Esdras

text: Yea Tobias alſo the Ammanite his neighbour ſayd: Let them build: if a fox come vp, he shal leape ouer their ſtone wal.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Heare our God, becauſe we are had in diſpiſe: turne the reproch vpon their head, and giue them into diſpite in a Land of captiuitie.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Couer not their iniquitie, and let not their ſinne be put out before thy face, becauſe they haue mocked thy builders.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Therfore we built the wal, and ioyned together the whole vnto the halfe part: and the hart of the people was prouoked to worke.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And it came to paſſe, when Sanaballat had heard, and Tobias, and the Arabians, and the Ammanites, and the Azotians, that the breach of the wal of Ieruſalem was cloſed vp, and the gates began to be ſtopped, they were wrath excedingly.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And they were al aſſembled together, to come, and to fight againſt Ieruſalem, and to prepare embuſhments.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And we prayed our God, and ſet watchmen vpon the wal day and night againſt them.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And Iudas ſayd: The ſtrength of him that carrieth is weakened, & the morter is very much, and we ſhal not be able to build the wal.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And our enimies ſayd: Let them not know, and let them be ignorant, til we come into the mideſt of them, and kil them, and make their worke to ceaſe.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And it came to paſſe, the Iewes that dwelt beſide them, coming and telling vs ten times, out of al places from whence they came to vs,
label: 2 Esdras

text: I ſette the people in a place behind the wal round about in order, with their ſwordes, and ſpeares, and bowes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I looked and roſe vp: & I ſayd to the princes and magiſtrates, and to the reſt of the common people: Be not afrayd at their face: Remember our Lord great and terrible, and fight for your bretheren, your ſonnes, and your daughters, and your wiues, and your houſes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And it came to paſſe, when our enimies had heard that it was told vs, God defeted their counſel. And we returned al to the walles, euery man to his worke.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And it came to paſſe from that day, the halfe part of their yongmen did the worke, and halfe was ready to battel, and ſpeares, & ſheilds, and bowes, and cotes of mayle, and the princes behind them in al the houſe of Iuda
label: 2 Esdras

text: of them that built in the wal, and that carried burdens, and that laded them: with one of his hands he did the worke, & with the other he held a ſword:
label: 2 Esdras

text: for euery one of the builders was girded with a ſword about his reynes. And they builded, and ſounded with the trumpet nere me.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I ſayd to the princes, and to the magiſtrates, & to the reſt of the common people: The worke is great and broad, and we are ſeperated in the wal one far from an other:
label: 2 Esdras

text: in what place ſoeuer you shal heare the ſound of the trumpet, thither runne together vnto vs: our God wil fight for vs.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And let vs our ſelues doe the worke: and let the halfe part of vs hold ſpeares from the ryſing of the morning, til the ſtarres appeare.
label: 2 Esdras

text: At that time alſo I ſayd to the people: Let euery man with his ſeruant tarry in the middes of Ieruſalem, and let there be courſes among vs by day and night to worke.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I and my bretheren, and my ſeruants, and the watchmen, that were behinde me, did not put of our clothes: euery man was made bare only to washing.
label: 2 Esdras

text: AND there was a great crie of the people, and of their wiues againſt their brethren the Iewes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And there were that ſaid. Our ſonnes and our daughters are verie manie: let vs take corne for the price of them, and let vs eate, and liue.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And there were that ſayd: Let vs pledge our fieldes, and vineyardes, and our houſes, and let vs take corne in famine.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And others ſayd: Let vs borow money for the kings tributes, and let vs giue our fields and vineyardes,
label: 2 Esdras

text: and now as the flesh of our bretheren, ſo is our flesh: and as their children ſo alſo our children. behold we ſubdew our ſonnes, and our daughters into bondage, and our daughters there are bondwemen, neither haue we wherewith they may be redemed, and our fieldes and our vineyardes other men doe poſſeſſe.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I was exceding angrie, when I had heard their crie according to theſe wordes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And my hart thought with my ſelfe: and I rebuked the princes and magiſtrates, and ſayd to them: Do you euery one exact vſuries of your brethen? and I gathered againſt them a great aſſemblie,
label: 2 Esdras

text: and I ſayd to them: We as you know, haue redemed our bretheren the Iewes, that were ſold to the gentiles, according to our abilitie: and wil you therfore ſel your bretheren, and shal we redeme them? And they held their peace, neither did they find what to anſwer.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I ſayd to them: The thing is not good, which you doe: why walke you not in the feare of our God, leſt we be vpbrayded with al the gentiles our enimies?
label: 2 Esdras

text: I alſo and my bretheren, and my ſeruantes, haue lent money and corne to very manie: let vs not aske this againe in common, let vs remitte them the debt, that is dewe to vs.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Reſtore ye to them their fieldes this day, and their vineyards, and their oliuets, and their houſes: yea the hundreth part alſo of money, corne, wine and oyle, which you were wont to exact of them, giue it rather for them.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And they ſayd: We wil reſtore, and we wil ſeeke nothing of them: and we wil do ſo as thou ſpeakeſt. And I called the Prieſtes, and adiured them, to do according to that which I had ſayd.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Moreouer I shooke my boſome, and ſayd: God ſo shake euery man, that shal not accomplish this word, out of his houſe, and out of his labours, ſo be he shaken out, and made emptie. And al the multitude ſayd: Amen. And they prayſed God. And the people did as it was ſayd.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And from that day, wherin the king commended me to the duke in the land of Iuda, from the twenteth yeare til the two & thirteth yeare of Artaxerxes the king for twelue yearees, I and my bretheren did not eate the yearly allowance, that was dewe to the dukes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But the former dukes, that had bene before me, burdened the people, and tooke of them in bread, and wine, and money euery day fourtie ſicles: yea and their officers oppreſſed the people. But I did not ſo for the feare of God.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Yea I builded rather in the worke of the wal, and field I bought not, and al my ſeruantes were gathered together to the worke.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Tke Iewes alſo and the magiſtrates an hundred fiftie men, and they that came to vs out of the nations, that were round about vs were at the table.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And there was prepared for me day by day one oxe, ſix choſen rammes, beſide foules, and within ten dayes diuers wines, & many other things did I giue. Moreouer alſo the yearly allowance of my dukedome I ſought not, for the people was very much empoueriſhed.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Remember me my God to good, according to al things, which I haue done to this people
label: 2 Esdras

text: AND it came to paſſe, when Sanaballat had heard, and Tobias, and Goſſem the Arabian, and the reſt of our enimies, that I did build the wal, and there was no breach remayning in it (how beit at that time I had not put the doores in the gates)
label: 2 Esdras

text: Sanaballat and Goſſem ſent to me, ſaying: Come, and let vs make a league together in the villages, in the field of Ono: But they thought to doe me euil.
label: 2 Esdras

text: I ſent therfore meſſengers to them, ſaying: I am doing a great worke, and I can not goe downe, leſt perhaps it be neglected when I shal come, and deſcend to you.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But they ſent to me according to this word, foure times: and I anſwered them according to the former word.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And Sanaballat ſent his ſeruant to me the fifth time according to the former word, and he had a letter in his hand written in this maner:
label: 2 Esdras

text: Among the Gentiles it is heard, and Goſſem hath ſayd, that thou and the Iewes meane to rebel, and therfore thou buildeſt the wal, and wil aduance thy ſelfe king ouer them: for which cauſe
label: 2 Esdras

text: thou haſt ſette vp prophettes alſo, which should preach of thee in Ieruſalem, ſaying: There is a king in Iurie: The king wil heare of theſe thinges: therfore come now, that we may take counſel together.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I ſent to them, ſaying: It is not done according to theſe words, which thou ſpeakeſt: for thou frameſt theſe things of thine owne hart.
label: 2 Esdras

text: For al theſe terrified vs, thinking that our hands would ceaſe from the worke, and we would leaue of. For which cauſe I did the more ſtrengthen my hands:
label: 2 Esdras

text: and I entred into the houſe of Samaia the ſonne of Dalaia the ſonne of Metabeel ſecretly. who ſayd: Let vs conſult with our ſelues in the houſe of God in the middes of the temple: and Let vs ſhutte the doores of the temple becauſe they wil come to kil thee, and in the night they wil come to ſlea thee.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I ſayd: Doth any man that is like vnto me flee? and who being as I am, wil goe into the temple, and liue? I wil not goe in.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I vnderſtood that God had not ſent him, but as it were prophicying he had ſpoken to me, and Tobias, and Sanaballat had hyred him.
label: 2 Esdras

text: For he had taken a price, that I being terrified should do it, and ſinne, and they might haue ſome euil to vpbraid me withal.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Remember me Lord for Tobias and Sanaballat, according to ſuch rheir workes. Yea and Noadias the prophete, and the reſt of the prophetes that terrified me.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But the wal was finished the fiue and twenteth day of the moneth of Elul, in two and fiftie dayes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: It came topaſſe therfore when al our enimies had heard it, that al nations which were round about vs, feared, & were diſmayed within them ſelues, and knew that this worke was done of God.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But in thoſe dayes alſo many letters of the principal Iewes were ſent to Tobias, and from Tobias there came to them.
label: 2 Esdras

text: For there were many in Iurie ſworne vnto him, becauſe he was the ſonne in law of Sechenias the ſonne of Area, and Iohanan his ſonne had taken the daughter of Moſollam the ſonne of Barachias.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Yea and they prayſed him before me, and they reported my words vnto him: and Tobias ſent letters to terrifie me.
label: 2 Esdras

text: AND after the wal was built, & I had put on the doores, and numbred the porters, and ſinging men, and Leuites:
label: 2 Esdras

text: I commanded Hanani my brother, and Hananias prince of the houſe of Ieruſalem (for he ſemed as it were a true man, and one that feared God aboue the reſt)
label: 2 Esdras

text: and I ſayd to them: Let not the gates of Ieruſalem be opened vntil the heate of the ſunne. And when they yet ſtood by, the gates were shut, and barred: and I ſette watchmen of the inhabitants of Ieruſalem, euery one by their courſes, and euery man againſt his houſe.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the citie was exceding large and great, and the people few in the middes therof, & there were no houſes built.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But God gaue me in my hart, and I aſſembled the princes and magiſtrates, and common people, that I might number them: and I found a booke of the number of them, that came vp firſt, and there was found written in it:
label: 2 Esdras

text: Theſe are the children of the prouince, which came vp from the captiuitie of them that were tranſported, whom Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon had tranſported, and returned into Iurie, euery one into his owne citie.
label: 2 Esdras

text: They that came with Zorobabel, Ioſue, Nehemias, Azarias, Rahamias, Nahamani, Mardochæus, Belſam, Meſpharath, Begoai, Nahum, Baana. The number of the men of the people of Iſrael.
label: 2 Esdras
