label: 2 Esdras

text: the childeren of Saphia, the childeren of Hatil, the chideren of Phohereth, who was borne vnto Sabaim, the ſonne of Amon.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Al Natheneites, and the childeren of the ſeruantes of Salomon, three hundred nyntie two.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But theſe be they which came vp from Thelmela, Thelharſa, Cherub, Addon, and Emmer: and could not ſhew the houſe of their fathers, and their ſeed, whether they were of Iſrael.
label: 2 Esdras

text: The children of Dalaia, the childeren of Tobia, the childeren of Necoda, ſix hundred fourtie two.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And of the Prieſts, the childeren of Habia, the childeren of Accos, the childeren of Berzellai, who tooke a wife of the daughters of Berzellai a Galeadite, and he was called by their name.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Theſe ſought their writing in the regiſter, and found it not: & they were caſt out of the Prieſthood.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And Atherſatha ſaid to them, that they ſhould not eate of the Holies of holies, vntil there ſtood vp a Prieſt learned and cunning.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Al the multitude as it were one man fourtie two thouſand three hundred ſixtie,
label: 2 Esdras

text: beſide their men ſeruants and wemen ſeruantes, which were ſeuen thouſand three hundred thirtie ſeuen: and among them ſinging men, & ſinging wemen, two hundred fourtie fiue.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Their horſes, two hundred fourtie ſix their mules two hundred fourtie fiue,
label: 2 Esdras

text: their camels, foure hundred thirtie fiue, aſſes ſix thouſand ſeuẽ hundred twentie.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And certaine of the princes of families gaue vnto the worke. Atherſatha gaue into the treaſure of gold a thouſand drachmas, phials fiftie, tunikes for Prieſtes fiue hundred thirtie.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And of the princes of families there gaue into the treaſure of the worke of gold, twentie thouſand drachmas, and of ſiluer two thouſand two hundred pound.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And that which the reſt of the people gaue, of gold twentie thouſand drachmas, and of ſiluer two thouſand pound, and tunikes for Prieſtes ſixtie ſeuen.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the Prieſtes, and Leuites, and porters, and ſinging men, and the reſt of the common people, and the Nathineites, and al Iſrael dwelt in their cities. And the ſeuenth moneth was come: and the childeren of Iſrael were in their cities.
label: 2 Esdras

text: AND al the people was gathered togethor as it were one man to the ſtreate, which is before the water and they ſayd to Eſdras the ſcribe, that he should bring the booke of the law of Moyſes, which our Lord had commanded Iſrael.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Eſdras therfore the prieſt brought the law before the multitude of men and wemen, and al that could vnderſtand, in the firſt day of the ſeuenth moneth.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And he read it playnly in the ſtreate that was before the water gate, from morning vntil midday, in the preſence of the men, and wemen, and of theſe that vnderſtood: and the eares of al the people were attent to the booke.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And Eſdaas the ſcribe ſtood vpon a ſteppe of wood, which he made to ſpeake vpon: and there ſtood by him Mathathias, and Semeia, and Ania, and Vria, and Helcia, and Maaſia, on his right hand: and on the left: Phadaia, Miſael, and Melchia, and Haſum, and Hasbadana, Zacharia, and Moſollam.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And Eſdras opened the booke before al the people: for he appeared aboue al the people: and when he had opened it, al the people ſtood.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And Eſdras bleſſed our Lord the great God: and al the people anſwred: Amen, amen: lifting vp their handes, and they bowed, and adored God flatte on the earth.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Moerouer Ioſue, & Bani, and Serebia, Iamin, Accub, Septhai, Odia, Maaſia, Celita, Azarias, Iozabed, Hanan, Phalaia: Leuites made ſilence in the people to heare the law: and the people ſtoode in their degree.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And they read in the booke of the law of God diſtinctly and playnly, for to vnderſtand: and they vnderſtood when it was read.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And Nehemias ſaid (the ſame is Atherſatha)and Eſdras the Prieſt and ſcribe, and the Leuites interpreting to al the people: It is a day ſanctified to the Lord our God, mourne ye not, and weepe not. For al the people wept, when they heard the wordes of the law.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And he ſaid to them: Goe, eate fat thinges, and drinck the ſweete wine, and ſend portions to them, that haue not prepared for them ſelues: becauſe it is the holie day of our Lord, and be not ſadde: for the ioy of our Lord is our ſtrength.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the Leuites made ſilence in al the people, ſaying: Hold your peace, becauſe the day is holie, and be not ſorowful.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Therefore al the people went to eate and drinck, and to ſend portions, and to make great ioy: becauſe they vnderſtood the wordes, that he had taught them.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And in the ſecond day were gathered the princes of the families of al the people, the Prieſts and Leuites to Eſdras the ſcribe, that he ſhould interpret vnto them the wordes of the law.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And they found written in the law, that our Lord commanded in the hand of Moyſes, that the children of Iſrael should dwel in tabernacles, on the ſolemne day, the ſeuenth moneth:
label: 2 Esdras

text: and that they should proclame and publish a voice in al their cities, and in Ieruſalem, ſaying: Goe ye forth into the mount, and fetch branches of the oliue tree, and branches of the moſt fayre tree, branches of the mirtle tree, and boughes of the palme trees, and branches of the thicke leaued tree, that tabernacles may be made, as it is written.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the people went forth, and brought. And they made them ſelues tabernacles euery man in his houſe toppe, and in his courtes, and in the courtes of the houſe of God, and in the ſtreate of the water gate, and in the ſtreate of the gate of Ephraim
label: 2 Esdras

text: Therefore al the church of them, that were returned from the captiuitie, made tabernacles, and dwelt in tabernacles. For from the daies of Ioſue the ſonne of Nun the children of Iſrael had not done it in ſuch ſort, vntil that day: and there was exceeding great ioy.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And he reade in the booke of the law of God day by day, from the firſt day til the laſt, and they made the ſolemnitie ſeuen dayes, & in the eight day a collect according to the rite.
label: 2 Esdras

text: AND in the foure and twenteth day of the moneth the children of Iſrael came together in faſting and ſacke-clothes, and earth vpon them.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the ſeede of the children of Iſrael was ſeperated from euerie ſtrange childe: and they ſtood, and confeſſed their ſinnes, and the iniquities of their fathers.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And they roſe vp to ſtand: and they read in the volume of the law of our Lord their God, foure times in a day, and foure times they confeſſed, and adored our Lord their God.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And there aroſe vpon the ſteppe of the Leuites Ioſue, and Bani, Cedmihel, Sabania, Bonni, Sarebias, Bani, and Chanani: and they cried with a lowde voice to our Lord their God.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the Leuites Ioſue and Cedmihel, Bonni, Haſebnia, Serebia, Odaia, Sebnia, and Phathahia, ſaid: Ariſe, Bleſſe our Lord your God from eternitie to eternitie: and let them bleſſe the high name of thy glorie in al bleſſing & praiſe.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Thou the ſame o Lord, alone thou haſt made heauen, & al the hoſt therof: the earth & al thinges that are in it: the ſeas and al thinges that are therin: and thou doſt giue life to al theſe thinges, and the hoſt of heauẽ adoreth thee.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Thou the ſame o Lord God, which didſt chooſe Abram, & broughteſt him out of the fire of the Chaldees, and gaueſt him the name Abraham.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And thou didſt finde his hart faithful before thee: and thou madeſt a couenante with him, that thou wouldeſt geue him the land of the Chananite, of the Hetheite, and of the Amorrheite, and of the Pherezeite, and of the Iebuſeite, & of the Gergeſeite, to geue vnto his ſeede: and thou haſt fulfilled thy wordes, becauſe thou art iuſt.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And thou ſaweſt the affliction of our fathers in Ægypt: & their crie thou didſt heare vpon the Read ſea.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And thou gaueſt ſignes & wonders in Pharao, and in al his ſeruants, and in al the people of his land: for thou didſt know that they had done proudly againſt them: and thou madeſt thyſelf a name, as alſo at this day.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And thou didſt diuide the ſea before them, and they paſſed througth the midſt of the ſea in drie land: but their perſecutors thou threweſt into the depth, as a ſtone into the rough waters.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And in a piller of a cloude thou waſt their leader by day, and in a piller of fire by night, that the way might appeare to them, by the which they went.
label: 2 Esdras

text: To mount Sinai alſo thou didſt deſcend, and ſpakeſt with them from heauen, and thou gaueſt them right iudgements, and the law of truth, ceremonies, and good preceptes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Thy ſanctified Sabbath thou didſt shew them, and the commandements, and ceremonies, and the law thou didſt command them in the hand of Moyſes thy ſeruant.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Bread alſo from heauen thou gaueſt them in their hunger, and water out of the rocke thou didſt bring forth to them thirſting, and thou ſaideſt to them that they should enter in, and poſſeſſe the land, vpon which thou didſt lift vp thy hand to diliuer it them.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But they and our fathers did proudly, and hardned their neckes and heard not thy cōmandements.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And they would not heare, and they remembred not thy merueylous workes which thou haſt done to them. And they hardned their neckes, and gaue the head to returne to their ſeruitude, as it were by contention. But thou a propitious God, and gratious, and merciful, long ſuffering and of much compaſſion, didſt not forſake them.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Yea and when they had made to them ſelues a molten calfe, and had ſaid: This is thy God, which brought thee out of Ægypt: and they did great blaſphemies.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But thou in thy manie mercies didſt not leaue them in the deſert: the piller of the cloude departed not from them by day to lead them into the way, and the piller of fire by night to shew them the way by which they should goe.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And thou gaueſt them thy good ſpirite, which should teach them, and thy Manna thou didſt not withhold from their mouth, and thou gaueſt them water in thirſt.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Fourtie yeares didſt thou feede them in the deſert, and nothing was wanting to them, their garmentes waxed not old, and their feete not worne.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And thou gaueſt them kingdomes, and peoples, and didſt part lottes vnto them: and they poſſeſſed the land of Sehon, and the land of the king Heſebon, and the land of Og the king of Baſan.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And thou didſt multiplie their children as the ſtarres of heauen, & brought them to the land wherof thou hadſt ſaid to their fathers, that they ſhould enter and poſſeſſe it.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the children came, and poſſeſſed the land, and thou didſt humble before them the inhabiters of the land, the Chananeites, and gaueſt them into their hand, and their kinges, and the peoples of the land, that they might doe to them as it pleaſed them.
label: 2 Esdras

text: They therfore tooke the fenſed cities and fatte ground, and poſſeſſed houſes ful of al goodes: ceſternes made by others, vineyardes, and oliuetes, & manie trees that bare fruite: and they did eate, and were filled, and became fatte, and abounded with delicious thinges in thy great goodnes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But they prouoked thee to wrath, & departed from thee, and threw thy law behind their backes: & they killed thy prophetes, which admoniſhed them erneſtly to returne to thee: and they did great blaſphemies.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And thou gaueſt them into the handes of their enemies, and they afflicted them. And in the time of their tribulation they cried to thee, & thou from heauen didſt heare, and according to thy manie cōpaſſions gaueſt them ſauiours, that should ſaue them from the hand of their enemies.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And when they had reſted, they returned to do euil in thy ſight: & thou didſt leaue them in the land of their enemies, and they poſſeſſed them. And they returned, & cried to thee: & thou heardeſt from heauen, and deliueredſt thē in thy mercies, manie times.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And thou didſt admoniſh them that they ſhould returne to thy law. But they did proudly, & heard not thy cōmandmentes, and ſinned in thy iudgementes, which a man should do, and shal liue in them, and they gaue the reuolting ſhoulder, and hardned their necke, neither did they heare.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And thou didſt prolong manie yeares ouer them, and didſt teſtifie to charge them in thy ſpirit by the hand of thy Prophetes: and they heard not, and thou didſt deliuer them into the hand of the peoples of the nations.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But in thy very many mercies thou madeſt them not into conſumption, neither didſt thou forſake them: becauſe a God of compaſſions and gratious art thou.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Now therfore O our God, great, ſtrong, and terrible, keeping couenant and mercie, turne not away from thy face al the labour, which hath found vs, our Kinges, and our Princes, and our Prieſts, and our Prophetes, and our fathers, and al the people from the daies of the king of Aſſur, vntil this day.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And thou art iuſt in al thinges, that haue come vpon vs: becauſe thou haſt done truth, but we haue done wickedly.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Our Kinges, our Princes, our Prieſtes, and our fathers haue not done thy law, and haue not attended thy commandmentes, and thy teſtimonies which thou haſt teſtified among them.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And they in their reignes, and in thy manifold goodnes, which thou gaueſt them, and in the land moſt large and fatte, which thou didſt deliuer in their ſight, ſerued not thee, nor returned from their moſt wicked deuiſes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Behold we our ſelues this day are bondmen: and the land, which thou gaueſt our fathers, that they should eate the bread therof, and the good thinges that are therof, and our ſelues are ſeruantes in it.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the fruites therof are multiplied to the kinges, whom thon haſt ſette ouer vs for our ſinnes, and they haue dominion ouer our bodies, and ouer our beaſtes, according to their wil, and we are in great tribulation.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Therfore vpon al theſe thinges we our ſelues make a couenant, and write, and our Princes, our Leuites, and our Prieſtes ſigne it.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the reſt of the people, Prieſtes, Leuites, Porteres, and ſinging men, Nathineites, and al that ſeperated them ſelues from the peoples of the landes to the law of God, their wiues, their ſonnes, and their daughters.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Al that could vnderſtand promiſing for their bretheren, their princes, and they that came to promiſe, and ſweare that they would walke in the law of God, which he gaue in the hand of Moyſes the ſeruant of God, that they would do & kepe al the cōmandments of the Lord our God, and his iudgementes and his ceremonies.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And that we would not geue our daughters to the people of the land, and their daughters we would not take to our sōnes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: The peoples of the land, which bring in things to ſel, & al thinges to be vſed, to ſel them on the Sabbath day, we wil not take it of them in the Sabbath, and in the ſanctified day. And we wil let paſſe the ſeuenth yeare, and the exaction of euerie hand.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And we wil ordayñe preceptes vpon our ſelues, to giue the third part of a ſicle euerie yeare to the worke of the houſe of our God,
label: 2 Esdras

text: to the loaues of propoſition, and to the continual ſacrifice, and for a continual holocauſt in the Sabbathes, in the Calendes, in the Solemnities, and in the ſanctified, and for ſinne: that propitiation may be made for Iſrael, and vnto al vſe of the houſe of our God.
label: 2 Esdras

text: We therfore did caſt lotes concerning the oblation of wood betwen the Prieſtes, and the Leuites, and the people, that it should be brought into the houſe of our God by the houſes of our fathers at ſet times, from yeare to yeare: that it might burne vpon the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the law of Moyſes:
label: 2 Esdras

text: And that we would bring the firſt borne of our land, and the firſt fruites of al the fruite of euerie tree, from yeare to yeare, in the houſe of our Lord.
label: 2 Esdras

text: and the firſt fruites of our ſonnes, and of our cattel, as it is written in the law, and the firſt fruites of our oxen, and of our ſheepe, that they might be offered in the houſe of our God, to the Prieſtes which miniſter in the houſe of our God.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the firſt fruites of our meates, and of our libamentes, and the fruites of euerie tree, of vintage alſo and of oyle we wil bring to the Prieſtes, vnto the treaſurie of our God, and the tenth part of our land to the Leuites. The Leuites them ſelues shal receiue the tithes out of al the cities of our works.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the Prieſt the ſonne of Aaron shalbe with the Leuites in the tythes of the Leuites, and the Leuites shal offer the tenth part of their tythe in the houſe of our God, to the treaſurie in the treaſure houſe.
label: 2 Esdras

text: For the children of Iſrael and the children of Leui ſhal carie to the treaſurie the firſt fruites of corne, of wine, and of oyle: and the ſanctified veſſels ſhal be there, and the Prieſtes, and ſinging men, and porters, and miniſters, and we wil not leaue the houſe of our God.
label: 2 Esdras

text: AND the princes of the people dwelt in Ieruſalem: but the reſt of the people caſt lottes, to take one part of ten that ſhould dwel in Ieruſalem the holie citie, and nine partes in the cities.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the people bleſſed al the men that had voluntarily offered them ſelues to dwel in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Theſe therfore are the princes of the prouince, which dwelt in Ieruſalem, and in the cities of Iuda. And euerie one dwelt in his poſſeſſion, in their cities, Iſrael, the Prieſtes, the Leuites, the Nathineites, and the children of the ſeruants of Salomon.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And in Ieruſalem there dwelt of the children of Iuda, and of the children of Beniamin: of the children of Iuda, Athaias the ſonne of Aziam, the ſonne of Zacharias, the ſonne of Amarias, the ſonne of Saphatias, the ſonne of Malaleel: of the children of Phares,
label: 2 Esdras

label: 2 Esdras

text: And the children of the ſinging men were gathered together out of the champaine about Ieruſalem, and out of the townes Nethuphati,
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the Prieſtes and Leuites were cleanſed, and they cleanſed the people, and the gates, and the wall.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I made the Princes of Iuda, goe vp vpon the wal, and I ſette two great quyers of them that ſhould praiſe. And they went on the right hand vpon the wal to the gate of the dunghil.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And after them went Oſaias, and the halfe part of the princes of Iuda,
label: 2 Esdras

text: and Azarias, Eſdras, and Moſollam, Iudas, and Beiamin, and Semeia, and Ieremias.

label: 2 Esdras

text: and his bretheren Semeia, and Azareel, Malalai, Galalai, Maai, Nathanael, and Iudas, and Hanani, with the inſtrumentes of the ſonge of Dauid the man of God: and Eſdras the ſcribe before them in the gate of the fountayne.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And againſt them there went vp in the ſtayers of the citie of Dauid, in the riſing of the wal aboue the houſe of Dauid, and vnto the gate of waters toward the Eaſt.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the ſecond quyer of thankes geuers went on the contrarie ſide, and I after it, and the halfe part of the people vpon the wal, and aboue the tower of the fornaces, & vnto the brodeſt wal,
label: 2 Esdras

text: and aboue the gate of Ephraim, and aboue the old gate, and aboue the gate of fishes and the towre of Hananeel, aud the towre of Emath, and vnto the gate of the flocke: and they ſtood in the gate of the watch,
label: 2 Esdras

text: and there ſtood two quyers of them that prayſed in the houſe of God, and I, and the halfe part of the magiſtrates with me.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the Prieſtes, Eliachim, Maaſia, Miamin, Michea, Elioenai, Zacharia, Hanania with trumpettes,
label: 2 Esdras

text: & Maaſia, and Semeia, and Eleazar, and Azzi, and Iohanan, and Melchia, and Aelam, and Ezer. And the ſinging men ſang alowd, and Iezraia the ouerſeer:
label: 2 Esdras

text: and they immolated in that day great victimes, and reioyced: for God had made them ioyful with great ioy: yea their wiues alſo and childeren reioyced, and the ioy of Ieruſalem was heard far of.
label: 2 Esdras

text: They numbered alſo in that day, men ouer the ſtorehouſes of the treaſure, for the libamentes, and for the firſt fruites, and for the tythes. that the princes of the citie might bring in by them in the honour of thankesgiuing, Prieſtes and Leuites: becauſe Iuda was made ioyful, in the Prieſtes & Leuites ſtanding by.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And they kept the watch of their God, and the obſeruance of expiation, and the ſinging men, and the porters, according to the precept of Dauid, and of Salomon his ſonne,
label: 2 Esdras

text: becauſe in the daies of Dauid, and Aſaph from the beginning there were princes appoynted of the ſinging men in ſong prayſing, and confeſſing to God.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And al Iſrael, in the daies of Zorobabel, and in the daies of Nehemias, gaue portions to the ſinging men, and to the porters day by day, and they ſanctified the Leuites, and the Leuites ſanctified the children of Aaron.
label: 2 Esdras

text: AND in that day there was read in the volume of Moyſes the people hearing it: and there was found written in it, that the Ammonites and the Moabites should not enter into the Church of God for euer:
label: 2 Esdras

text: for that they mette not the children of Iſrael with bread and water: and they hyred againſt them Balaam, to curſe them: and our God turned the curſing into bleſſing.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And it came to paſſe, when they had heard the law, they ſeperated euerie ſtranger from Iſrael.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And ouer this thing was Eliaſib the Prieſt, who had bene made ouerſeer in the treaſurie of the houſe of our God, and neere kinne to Tobias
label: 2 Esdras

text: He therfore made to himſelfe a great treaſurie, and they were there before him laying vp giftes, and frankincenſe, and veſſeles, and the tythe of corne, of wine, and of oyle, the portions of the Leuites, and of the ſinging men, and of the porters, and the firſt fruites of the Prieſtes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But in al theſe things I was not in Ieruſalem, becauſe in the two and thirteth yeare of Arraxerxes the king of Babylon I came to the king, and in the end of certaine dayes I deſired the king.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I came to Ieruſalem, and I vnderſtood the euil, that Eliaſib had done to Tobias, to make him a treaſure in the entrances of the houſe of God.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And it ſemed to me exceding euil. And I threw forth the veſſels of the houſe of Tobias out of the treaſurie:
label: 2 Esdras

text: and I commanded and they clenſed the treaſurie: and I brought thither againe the veſſels of the houſe of God, the ſacrifice, and the frankincenſe.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I knew that the portion of the Leuites had not bene geuen: and that euerie man was fled into his countrie of the Leuites, and the ſinging men, and of them that miniſtred:
label: 2 Esdras

text: and I pleaded the matter againſt the magiſtrates, and ſaid: Why haue we forſaken the houſe of God? And I aſſembled them, and I made them to ſtand in their ſtandings.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And al Iuda caried the tythe of the corne, wine, and oyle into the ſtore houſes.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And we appoynted ouer the ſtore-houſes Selemias Prieſt, and Sadoc ſcribe, and Phadaia of the Leuites, and next to them Hanan the ſonne of Zachur, the ſonne of Mathania: becauſe they were approued faithful, and to them were committed the portions of the bretheren.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Remember me my God for this thing, and wipe not out my mercies, which I haue done in the houſe of my God, and in his ceremonies.
label: 2 Esdras

text: In thoſe daies I ſaw them in Iuda treading the preſſes on the Sabbath, carying heapes, and loding vpon aſſes wine, and grapes, and figges, and al maner of burthen, and bringing it into Ieruſalem on the Sabbath day. And I charged them, that they should ſel on a day that it was lawful to ſel in.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the Tyrians dwelt in it, bringing fiſhes, and al thinges to ſel: and they ſold on the Sabbathes to the children of Iuda in Ieruſalem.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I rebuked the Princes of Iuda, and ſaid to them: What is this euil thing, that you doe, and prophane the day of the Sabbath?
label: 2 Esdras

text: Why did not our fathers theſe thinges, and our God brought vpon vs al this euil, and vpon this citie? And you adde wrath vpon Iſrael in violating the Sabbath.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And it came to paſſe, when the gates of Ieruſalem had reſted on the Sabbath day, I ſpake: and they shut the gates, and I commanded them that they ſhould not open them til after the Sabbath: and of my ſeruantes I appoynted ouer the gates, that none ſhould bring in burdens in the Sabbath day.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And the merchantes, and they that ſold al merchandiſe, taried without Ieruſalem once and againe.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I charged them, and I ſaid to them: Why tarie you ouer againſt the wal? if you shal doe ſo the ſecond time, I wil lay my hand vpon you. Therfore from that time they came not on the Sabbath.
label: 2 Esdras

text: I ſpake alſo to the Leuites that they ſhould be cleanſed, and should come to keepe the gates, and to ſanctifie the day of the Sabbath: therfore for this alſo remember me my God, & ſpare me according to the multitude of thy mercies.
label: 2 Esdras

text: But in thoſe daies alſo I ſaw the Iewes marying wiues wemen of Azotus, and of Ammon, and of Moab.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And their children ſpake, the halfe part the Azotian tongue, and they could not ſpeake the Iewes language, and they ſpake according to the language of the people and people.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And I rebuked them, and curſed them. And I beate of them ſome men, and shaued them bald, and adiured them by God, that they should not geue their daughters to their ſonnes, nor take their daughters for their ſonnes, & for themſelues, ſaying:
label: 2 Esdras

text: Did not Salomon the king of Iſrael ſinne in this kind of thing? and ſurely in manie nations, there was not a king like to him, & he was beloued of his God, and God ſette him king ouer al Iſrael: him therfore alſo foren wemen brought to ſinne.
label: 2 Esdras

text: And shal we alſo being diſobedient perſons doe al this great euil, to tranſgreſſe againſt our God, and to marie foren wemen?
label: 2 Esdras

text: And Sanaballat the Horonite was ſonne in law to one of the ſonnes of Ioiada, the ſonne of Eliaſib the high Prieſt, whom I draue from me.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Remember o Lord my God againſt them, that pollute the Prieſthood, and the right of Prieſtes and Leuites.
label: 2 Esdras

text: Therfore I ſeparared from them al ſtrangers, and I appoynted the courſes of the Prieſtes and Leuites, euerie man in his miniſterie:
label: 2 Esdras

text: and in the oblation of woode at times appoynted, and in the firſt fruites: Remember me my God vnto good. Amen.
label: 2 Esdras

text: TOBIAS of the tribe, and citie of Nepthali (which is in the vpper partes of Galilee aboue Naaſſon, beyond the way, that leadeth to the weaſt, hauing on the right hand the citie Sephet)
label: Tobias

text: when he was captiue in the daies of Salmanaſar the king of the Aſſyrians, yet being in captiuitie, he forſooke not the way of truth,
label: Tobias

text: ſo that he imparted al things that he could make, dayly to his brethren captiues with him, which were of his kinred.
label: Tobias

text: And whereas he was yonger then al the tribe of Nephthali, yet did he no childish thing in his worke.
label: Tobias

text: Finally when al went to the golden calues, which Ieroboam the king of Iſrael had made, he alone fled the companies of al,
label: Tobias

text: and went into Ieruſalem to the temple of our Lord, and there adored our Lord God of Iſrael, offering faithfully al his firſt fruites, and his tithes,
label: Tobias

text: ſo that in the third yeare he miniſtred al the tithing to the proſelytes, and ſtrangers.
label: Tobias

text: Theſe thinges and the like to theſe did he obſerue being a childe according to the law of God.
label: Tobias

text: But when he was a man, he tooke to wife Anna of his owne tribe, and he begat a ſonne of her, geuing him his owne name,
label: Tobias

text: whom from his infancie he taught to feare God, and to abſtayne from al ſinne.
label: Tobias

text: Therfore when by the captiuitie he was come with his wife and ſonne into the citie of Niniue, with al his tribe,
label: Tobias

text: ( when al did eate of the meates of the Gentiles) he kept his ſoule, and neuer was contaminated in their meates.
label: Tobias

text: And becauſe he was mindful of our Lord in al his hart, God gaue him grace in the ſight of Salmanaſar the king,
label: Tobias

text: and he gaue him leaue to goe whitherſoeuer he would, hauing libertie to doe what thinges ſoeuer he would.
label: Tobias

text: He therfore went to al that were in the captiuitie, and gaue them holeſome admonitions.
label: Tobias

text: And when he was come into Rages a citie of the Medes, and had ten talentes of ſiluer of theſe, wherwith he had beene honoured of the king:
label: Tobias

text: and when in a great multitude of his kinred, he ſaw Gabelus ſtand in nede, who was of his tribe, vnder a bil of his hand he gaue him the ſayd weight of ſiluer.
label: Tobias

text: But after much time, Salmanaſar the king being dead, when Sennacherib his ſonne reigned for him, and eſtemed the children of Iſrael odious in his ſight:
label: Tobias

text: Tobias dayly went through al his kinred, and conforted them, and diuided to euerie one, as he was able, of his goods:
label: Tobias

text: the hungrie he nourished, and to the naked he gaue clothes, and the dead, and them that were ſlayne, he buryed carefully.
label: Tobias

text: Finally when king Sennacherib was returned fleing from Iewrie the ſhaughter, that God had made about him for his blaſphemie, and being angrie ſlewe manie of the children of Iſrael, Tobias buryed their bodies.
label: Tobias

text: But when it was told the king, he commanded him to be ſlayne, and tooke al his ſubſtance.
label: Tobias

text: But Tobias fleing with his ſonne and with his wife, nakedly lay hid, becauſe manie loued him.
label: Tobias

text: But after fourtie fiue dayes the king was ſlayne of his owne ſonnes,
label: Tobias

text: and Tobias returned into his houſe, and al his ſubſtance was reſtored to him.
label: Tobias

text: BVT after theſe thinges, when there was a feſtiual day of our Lord, and a good dinner was made in Tobias houſe,
label: Tobias

text: he ſayd to his ſonne: Goe, and bring ſome of our tribe, that feare God, to make merie with vs.
label: Tobias

text: And when he had gone, returning he tolde him, that one of the children of Iſrael lay ſlayne in the ſtreate. And he forthwith leaping vp from his place at the table, leauing his dinner, came faſting to the bodie:
label: Tobias

text: and taking it vp caried it to his houſe ſecretely, that when the ſunne should be downe, he might warely burie him.
label: Tobias

text: And whẽ he had hid the bodie, he eate bread with mourning and trẽbling,
label: Tobias

text: remembring that word, which our Lord ſayd by Amos the Prophet: Your feſtiual dayes shal be turned into lamentation and mourning.
label: Tobias

text: But when the ſunne was downe, he went, and buried him.
label: Tobias

text: And al his neighbours rebuked him, ſaying: Euen now thou waſt commanded to be ſlayne becauſe of this matter, and thou dideſt ſcarce eſcape the commandment of death, and doeſt thou burie the dead agayne?
label: Tobias

text: But Tobias more fearing God, then the king, in haſte tooke the bodies of them that were ſlayne, and hid them in his houſe, and at midnight buried them.
label: Tobias

text: And it happened that on a certayne day, being wearied with burying, coming into his houſe he had caſt himſelf downe by the wal, and ſlept,
label: Tobias

text: and as he was ſleeping, hote dung out of the ſwallowes neſt fel vpon his eyes, and he was made blinde.
label: Tobias

text: And this tentation therfore our Lord permitted to chance vnto him, that an example might be geuen to poſteritie of his patience, alſo of holie Iob.
label: Tobias

text: For whereas he feared God alwaies from his infancie, and kept his commandmentes, he grudged not agaynſt God for that the plague of blindnes had chanced to him,
label: Tobias

text: but continewed immoueable in the feare of God, geuing thankes to God al the dayes of his life.
label: Tobias

text: For as the kinges inſulted againſt bleſſed Iob: ſo his parentes and coſins derided his life, ſaying.
label: Tobias

text: Where is thy hope, for the which thou dideſt beſtowe almes and burials?
label: Tobias

text: But Tobias rebuked them, ſaying: Speake not ſo:
label: Tobias

text: becauſe we are the children of holie ones, and looke for that life, which God wil geue to them, that neuer change their faith from him.
label: Tobias

text: But Anna his wife went dayly to weauing worke, and she brought the gaines of her handie labour, which she could get.
label: Tobias

text: Whereby it came to paſſe, that she receiuing a kid of goates had brought it home:
label: Tobias

text: the voice whereof bleating when her huſband had heard, he ſayd: Take heed, leſt perhaps it be ſtollen, reſtore ye it to his owners, becauſeit is not lawful for vs either to eate anie thing of theft or to touch it.
label: Tobias

text: To theſe wordes his wife being angrie anſwered: Thy hope is become vayne manifeſtly, and thine almes now haue appeared.
label: Tobias

text: And with theſe, and other ſuch like wordes she vpbrayded him.
label: Tobias

text: THEN Tobias lamented, and began tõ pray with teares,
label: Tobias

text: ſaying: Thou art iuſt ô Lord, & al thy iudgementes are iuſt, and al thy waies, mercie, & truth, and iudgement.
label: Tobias

text: And now Lord be mindful of me, and take not reuenge of my ſinnes, neither remember the ſinnes of me, or of my parentes.
label: Tobias

text: Becauſe we haue not obeyed thy commandmentes, therfore we are deliuered in ſpoile, and captiuitie, and death, and into a fable, and into reproch to al nations, in which thou haſt diſperſed vs.
label: Tobias

text: And now Lord great are thy iudgementes, becauſe we haue not done according to thy preceptes, & haue not walked ſincerely before thee:
label: Tobias

text: and now Lord according to thy wil do with me, & command my ſpirite to be receiued in peace: for it is expedient for me to die, rather then to liue.
label: Tobias

text: The verie ſame day therfore it chanced that Sara the daughter of Raguel in Rages a citie of the Medes, she alſo heard reproch of one of her fathers handmaydes,
label: Tobias

text: becauſe she had beene deliuered to ſeuen huſbandes, & the diuel named Aſmodeus had killed them, forthwith as they were entred in vnto her.
label: Tobias

text: Therfore when she rebuked the wench for her fault, she anſwered her, ſaying: Let vs no more ſee ſonne of thee, or daughter vpon the earth, thou murderer of thy huſbandes.
label: Tobias

text: What wilt thou kil me alſo, as thou haſt now killed ſeuen husbandes? At this voice ſhe went into an higher chamber of her houſe: and three dayes, and three nightes did not eate, nor drinke:
label: Tobias

text: but continewing in prayer with teares beſought God, that he would deliuer her from this reproch.
label: Tobias

text: And it came to paſſe the third day, whiles she accomplished her prayer, bleſſing our Lord,
label: Tobias

text: ſhe ſayd: Bleſſed is thy name ô God of our fathers: who when thou haſt bene angrie, wilt doe mercie, & in the time of tribulation forgeueſt them their ſinnes, that inuocate thee.
label: Tobias

text: To thee ô Lord I turne my face, to thee I direct myne eyes.
label: Tobias

text: I deſire Lord that thou looſe me from the bond of this reproch, or els take me away from the earth.
label: Tobias

text: Thou knoweſt Lord that I neuer coueted a huſband, and haue kept my ſoule cleane from al concupiſcence.
label: Tobias

text: Neuer haue I companied my ſelf with ſporters: neither haue I made my ſelfe partaker with them that walke in lightneſſe.
label: Tobias

text: But a huſband I conſented to take, with thy feare, not with my luſt.
label: Tobias

text: And either I was vnworthie of them, or they perhaps were not worthie for me: becauſe perhaps thou haſt kept me for an other man.
label: Tobias

text: For thy counſel is not in mans power.
label: Tobias

text: But this hath euerie one for certayne, that worshippeth thee, that his life, if it be in probation, shal be crowned: and if it be in tribulation, it shal be deliuered: and if it be in correction, it shal be lawful to come to thy mercie.
label: Tobias

text: For thou art not delighted in our perditions: becauſe after a tempeſt thou makeſt a calme, and after teares and weeping thou powreſt in ioyfulneſſe.
label: Tobias

text: Be thy name God of Iſrael bleſſed foreuer.
label: Tobias

text: At that time the prayers of both were heard in the ſight of the glorie of the high God:
label: Tobias

text: and the holie Angel of our Lord Raphael was ſent, to cure them both, whoſe prayers at one time were recited in the ſight of our Lord.
label: Tobias

text: THERFORE when Tobias thought his prayer to be heard that he might haue died, he called to him Tobias his ſonne,
label: Tobias

text: and ſayd to him: Heare my ſonne the wordes of my mouth, & lay them as a foundation in thy hart.
label: Tobias

text: When God shal take my ſoule, burie my bodie: and thou ſhalt doe honour to thy mother al the dayes of her life:
label: Tobias

text: for thou muſt be mindful what perils, and how great ſhe ſuffered for thee in her wombe.
label: Tobias

text: And when she alſo ſhal haue accomplished the time of her life, burie her beſide me.
label: Tobias

text: And al the dayes of thy life haue God in thy mind: and beware thou conſent not to ſinne at anie time, and pretermitte the preceptes of our Lord God.
label: Tobias

text: Of thy ſubſtance geue almes, and turne not away thy face from anie poore perſon: for ſo it shal come to paſſe that neither the face of our Lord shal be turned from thee.
label: Tobias

text: As thou shalt be able; ſo be merciful.
label: Tobias

text: If thou haue much, geue aboundantly: if thou haue litle, ſtudie to impert alſo a litle willingly.
label: Tobias

text: For thou doſt treaſure vp to thy ſelf a good reward in the day of neceſſitie.
label: Tobias

text: becauſe almes deliuereth from al ſinne, and from death, & wil not ſuffer the ſoule to goe into darkeneſſe.
label: Tobias

text: Great confidence before God moſt high shal almes be to al them that doe it.
label: Tobias

text: Take heed to thy ſelf my ſonne of al fornication, & beſide thy wife neuer abide to know crime.
label: Tobias

text: Neuer permitte pryde to rule in thy word: for in it al perdition tooke his beginning.
label: Tobias

text: Whoſoeuer hath wrought anie thing for thee, pay him his hyre immediatly, and let not the hyre of thy hyred ſeruant remayne with thee at al.
label: Tobias

text: That which thou hateſt to be done to thee by an other, ſee thou doe it not to an other at anie time.
label: Tobias

text: Eate thy bread with the hungrie & needie, and of thy garmentes couer the naked.
label: Tobias

text: Set thy bread, and thy wine vpon the burial of a iuſt man, and doe not eate and drinke therof with ſinners.
label: Tobias

text: Seeke counſel alwaies of a wiſeman:
label: Tobias

text: At al time bleſſe God: and deſire of him, that he direct thy waies, and that al thy counſels remayne in him.
label: Tobias

text: I tel thee alſo my ſonne that I gaue tenne talentes of ſiluer, whiles thou waſt yet a. child, to Gabelus, in Rages a citie of the Medes, and I haue a bil of his hand with me:
label: Tobias

text: and therfore enquire how thou maiſt come to him, and receiue of him the foreſayd weight of ſiluer, and reſtore him the bil of his hand.
label: Tobias

text: Feare not my ſonne: we leade in dede a poore life, but we shal haue many good thinges if we feare God, and depart from al ſinne, and doe wel.
label: Tobias

text: THEN Tobias anſwered his father, and ſayd: I wil doe al things, father, whatſoeuer thou haſt commanded me.
label: Tobias

text: But how I shal require this money, I can not tel, he knoweth not me, and I know not him: what token shal I geue him? Yea neither the way which leadeth thither, did I euer know.
label: Tobias

text: Then his father anſwered him, and ſayd: I haue the bil of his hand with me, which when thou shalt shew him he wil forthwith reſtore it.
label: Tobias

text: But goe now, and ſeeke thee out ſome faythful man, that may goe with thee being ſure of his hyre: that thou mayſt receiue it, whiles I yet liue.
label: Tobias

text: Then Tobias going forth, found a goodlie yongman, ſtanding girded, and as it were readie to walke.
label: Tobias

text: And not knowing that it was an Angel of God, he ſaluted him, and ſayd: From whence haue we thee, good yongman?
label: Tobias

text: But he anſwered: Of the children of Iſrael. And Tobias ſayd to him: Knoweſt thou the way, that leadeth vnto the countrie of the Medes?
label: Tobias

text: To whom he anſwered: I know it: and al the wayes therof I haue often walked, and I haue taried with Gabelus our brother, who abydeth in Rages a citie of the Medes, which is ſituate in the Mount Ecbatanis.
label: Tobias

text: To whom Tobias ſayd: Stay for me I beſeech thee, til I tel theſe ſame things to my father.
label: Tobias

text: Then Tobias going in told al theſe things to his father. Whereupon his father marueiling, requeſted that he would come in vnto him.
label: Tobias

text: Going in therfore he ſaluted him, and ſayd: Ioy be to thee alwaies.
label: Tobias

text: And Tobias ſayd: What maner of ioy ſhal be to me, which ſitte in darkenes, and ſee not the light of heauen?
label: Tobias

text: To whom the yong man ſayd: Be of good cheere, it is very neere that thou mayſt be cured of God.
label: Tobias

text: Tobias therfore ſayd to him: Canſt thou bring my ſonne to Gabelus into Rages a citie of the Medes? and when thou shalt returne, I wil pay thee thy hyre.
label: Tobias

text: And the Angel ſayd to him: I wil conduct him, & bring him to thee againe.
label: Tobias

text: To whom Tobias anſwered: I pray thee, tel me, of what houſe, or what tribe art thou?
label: Tobias

text: To whom Raphael the Angel ſayd: Seekeſt thou the kinred of an hyred ſeruant, or an hyred ſeruant himſelfe, that may goe with thy ſonne?
label: Tobias

text: But leſt perhaps I make thee careful, I am Azarias the ſonne of Ananias the great.
label: Tobias

text: And Tobias anſwered: Thou art of a great kinred. But I pray the be not angrie that I would know thy kinred.
label: Tobias

text: And the Angel ſayd to him: I wil lead thy ſonne ſafe, and bring him to thee agayne ſafe.
label: Tobias

text: And Tobias anſwering, ſayd: Wel may you walke, and God be in your iourney, and his Angel accompanie you.
label: Tobias

text: Then al things being readie, that were to be caried in the way, Tobias bid his father and his mother, fare wel, and they walked both together.
label: Tobias

text: And when they were departed, his mother began to weepe, & to ſay: Thou haſt taken the ſtaffe of our old age, and ſent him away from vs.
label: Tobias

text: I would the money had neuer bene, for the which thou haſt ſent him.
label: Tobias

text: For our pouertie ſufficed vs, that we might account this thing riches, that we ſaw our ſonne.
label: Tobias

text: And Tobias ſayd to her: Weepe not, our ſonne shal come thither ſafe, and shal returne ſafe to vs, and thyne eies shal ſee him.
label: Tobias

text: For I beleue that the good Angel of God doth accompanie him, & doth wel diſpoſe al things, that are done about him, ſo that he shal returne to vs with ioy.
label: Tobias

text: At this voyce his mother left weeping, and held her peace.
label: Tobias

text: AND Tobias went forward, & a dogge folowed him, and he made his firſt abode by the riuer of Tigris.
label: Tobias

text: And he went out to wash his feete, and behold an huge fish came forth to deuoure him.
label: Tobias

text: Of whom Tobias being afrayd, cryed out with a loud voice, ſaying: Sir, he inuadeth me.
label: Tobias

text: And the Angel ſaid to him: Take him by the gille, & draw him to thee. Which when he had done, he drew him on the drie land, and he began to ſtrugle before his feete.
label: Tobias

text: Then ſayd the Angel to him: Take out the entralles of this fishe, and his hart, and gal, and liuer, keepe to thee: for theſe are neceſſarie and profitable for medecines.
label: Tobias

text: Which when he had done, he roſted the flesh therof, and they tooke it with them in the way: the reſt they ſalted which might ſuffiſe them, til they came to Rages the citie of Medes.
label: Tobias

text: Then Tobias asked the Angel, and ſayd to him: I beſech thee brother Azarias, tel me what remedies shal theſe things haue, which thou haſt bid me keepe of the fish?
label: Tobias

text: And the Angel anſwering, ſayd to him: If thou put a litle peece of his hart vpon coales, the ſmoke therof driueth out al kinde of diuels, either from man or from woman, ſo that it cometh no more vnto them.
label: Tobias

text: And the gall is auailable to annoynt the eies, in which there shal be white blemish, and they ſhal be healed.
label: Tobias

text: And Tobias ſayd to him: Where wilt thou that we tarie?
label: Tobias

text: And the Angel anſwering, ſayd: Here is one named Raguel, a nere kinſman of thy tribe, and he hath a daughter named Sara, and he hath neither man child, nor anie woman child beſide her.
label: Tobias

text: Al his ſubſtance is dewe to thee, and thou mayſt take her to wife.
label: Tobias

text: Aske her therfore of her father, and he wil giue her thee to wife.
label: Tobias

text: Then Tobias anſwered, and ſayd: I heare that she hath beene deliuered to ſeuen husbandes, and they are dead: yea and I haue heard, that a diuel killed them.
label: Tobias

text: I am afrayd therfore, leſt theſe things may happen to me alſo: & whereas I am the onlie childe of my parentes, I may bring downe their old age with ſorow vnto hel.
label: Tobias

text: Then the Angel Raphael ſayd to him: Heare me, and I wil shewe thee who they are, on whom the diuel can preuaile.
label: Tobias

text: For they, that ſo receiue matrimonie, that they exclude God from them ſelues, and from their mind, and ſo geue them ſelues to their luſt, as horſe and mule, which haue not vnderſtanding, ouer them the diuel hath power.
label: Tobias

text: But thou when thou shalt take her, entring into the chamber, for three daies be continent from her, and thou shalt geue thy ſelf to nothing els but to prayers with her.
label: Tobias

text: And the ſame night, the liuer of the fish ſette on the fyre, the diuel shal be driuen away.
label: Tobias

text: But the ſecond night thou shalt be admitted in the copulation of the holie Patriarches.
label: Tobias

text: And the third night thou shalt obteyne a bleſſing that ſound children may be procreated of you.
label: Tobias

text: And when the third night is paſt, thou shalt take the virgin with the feare of our Lord, moued rather for loue of childeren then for luſt, that in the ſeede of Abraham thou mayſt obteyne bleſſing in children.
label: Tobias

text: AND they went to Raguel, and Raguel receiued them with ioy.
label: Tobias

text: And Raguel beholding Tobias, ſayd to Anna his wife: How like is this yongman to my ſiſters ſonne!
label: Tobias

text: And when he had ſpoken theſe wordes, he ſayd: Whence are you ye yongmen our brethren?
label: Tobias

text: But they ſayd: We are of the tribe of Nephthali, of the captiuitie of Niniue.
label: Tobias

text: And Raguel ſayd to them: Know you Tobias my brother? Who ſayd: We know him.
label: Tobias

text: And when he ſpake much good of him, the Angel ſayd to Raguel: Tobias, of whom thou askeſt is this mans father.
label: Tobias

text: And Raguel put forth him ſelfe, and with teares kiſſed him, and weeping vpon his necke, ſayd: Bleſſing haue thou my ſonne, becauſe thou art the ſonne of a good and moſt vertuous man.
label: Tobias

text: And Anna his wife, and Sara theyr daughter wept.
label: Tobias

text: And after they had talked, Raguel commanded a wether to be killed, and a banket to be prepared. And when he deſired them to ſitte downe to dinner,
label: Tobias

text: Tobias ſaid: I wil not eate nor drinke here this day, vnleſſe thou firſt aſſure my petition, and promiſe to geue me Sara thy daughter.
label: Tobias

text: Which word Raguel hearing, was ſore afrayd, knowing what had chanced to thoſe ſeuen husbands, which went in vnto her: and he began to feare leſt perhaps it might chance to him alſo in like maner: and when he doubted, and gaue no anſwer to him demanding,
label: Tobias

text: the Angel ſayd to him: Feare not to geue her to this man, for to him fearing God is thy daughter dewe to be his wife: therfore an other could not haue her.
label: Tobias

text: Then ſayd Raguel: I doubt not but God hath admitted my prayers and teares in his ſight.
label: Tobias

text: And I beleue that therfore he hath made you come to me, that this mayde might be ioyned to her kinred, according to the law of Moyſes: and now haue no doubt but I wil deliuer her to thee.
label: Tobias

text: And taking his daughter by the right hand, gaue it into the right hand of Tobias, ſaying: The God of Abraham, and the God of Iſaac, and the God of Iacob be with you, and he ioyne you together, and fulfil his bleſſing in you.
label: Tobias

text: And taking paper they made a writing of the mariage.
label: Tobias

text: And after theſe things they made merie, bleſſing God.
label: Tobias

text: And Raguel called to him Anna his wife, and commanded her to prepare an other chamber.
label: Tobias

text: And she brought Sara her daughter in thither, and she wept.
label: Tobias

text: And she ſayd to her: Be of good cheere my daughter, our Lord of heauen geue thee ioy for the tediouſneſſe which thou haſt ſuffered.
label: Tobias

text: AND after they had ſupped, they brought in the yong man to her.
label: Tobias

text: Tobias therfore remembring the Angels word, brought forth out of his bag, part of the liuer, and layd it vpon liue coales.
label: Tobias

text: Then Raphael the Angel tooke the diuel, and bound him in the deſert of higher Ægypt.
label: Tobias

text: Then Tobias exhorted the virgin, & ſayd to her: Sara ariſe, and let vs pray to God to day, and to morow, and the next morow: becauſe theſe three nights we are ioyned to God: and when the third night is paſt, we wil bein our wedlocke.
label: Tobias

text: For we are the children of holie men, & we may not be ioyned together as gentiles, that know not God.
label: Tobias

text: And they riſing together, prayed both together that health might be geuen them.
label: Tobias

text: And Tobias ſayd: Lord God of our fathers, the heauens & the earth, and the ſea & fountaynes, and riuers, and al thy creatures that are in them, bleſſe thee.
label: Tobias

text: Thou madeſt Adam of the ſlime of the earth, & gaueſt him Eue an helper.
label: Tobias

text: And now Lord thou knoweſt, that not for fleshlie luſt doe I take my ſiſter to wife, but only for the loue of poſteritie, in the which thy name may be bleſſed for euer & euer.
label: Tobias

text: Sara alſo ſayd: Haue mercie on vs Lord, haue mercie vpon vs and let vs grow old both together in health.
label: Tobias

text: And it came to paſſe about the cock crowing, Raguel bad his ſeruantes to be called for, & they went with him together to digge a graue.
label: Tobias

text: For he ſayd: Leſt perhaps it may chance to him, as alſo to the other ſeuen huſbandes, that went in vnto her.
label: Tobias

text: And when they had prepared the pitte, Raguel returning to his wife, ſayd to her:
label: Tobias

text: Send one of thy handmaydes, and let her ſee if he be dead, that I may burie him before it be day.
label: Tobias

text: But she lent one of her handmaydes, who going into the chamber, found them ſafe and ſound, ſleeping both together.
label: Tobias

text: And returning she brought good tydings: and they bleſſed our Lord, to witte, Raguel & Anna his wife,
label: Tobias

text: and ſayd: We bleſſe thee Lord God of Iſrael, becauſe it hath not chanced as we thought.
label: Tobias

text: For thou haſt done thy mercie with vs, & haſt excluded from vs the enemie, that perſecuted vs.
label: Tobias

text: And thou haſt taken pitie vpon two the only children. Make them Lord bleſſe thee more fully: and to offer vp to thee a ſacrifice of thy prayſe, and of their health, that al nations may know, that thou art God onlie in al the earth.
label: Tobias

text: And forthwith Raguel commanded his ſeruantes, that they should fil vp the pitte, which they had made, before it were day.
label: Tobias

text: And he bad his wife make readie a feaſt, and prepare al thinges, that for victuals were neceſſarie to them that goe a iourney.
label: Tobias

text: He cauſed alſo two fatte kyne, and foure wethers to be killed, and great chere to be prepared for al his neighbours, and al his freindes.
label: Tobias

text: And Raguel adiured Tobias, that he should abide with him two weekes.
label: Tobias

text: And of al thinges which Raguel poſſeſſed, he gaue the halfe part to Tobias, and made this writing, that the halfe part, which was remayning after their deceaſe, should come to the dominion of Tobias.
label: Tobias

text: THEN Tobias called the Angel to him, whom he thought to be a man, and he ſayd to him: Brother Azarias, I pray thee harken to my wordes:
label: Tobias

text: If I should deliuer my ſelf to be thy ſeruant I shal not deſerue thy prouidence.
label: Tobias

text: Howbeit I beſech thee, that thou take vnto thee beaſtes and ſeruantes, and goe to Gabelus into Rages the citie of Medes: & render him his handwriting, and receiue of him the money, and deſire him to come to my mariage.
label: Tobias

text: For thyſelf knoweſt that my father numbreth the dayes: and if I ſlacke one day more, his ſoule is made ſorowful.
label: Tobias

text: And ſurely thou ſeeſt how Raguel hath adiured me, whoſe adiuring I can not diſpiſe.
label: Tobias

text: Then Raphael taking foure of Raguels ſeruantes, & two camels, went into Rages the citie of Medes: & finding Gabelus gaue him his handwriting, and receiued of him al the money.
label: Tobias

text: And he told him of Tobias the ſonne of Tobias, al thinges that were done: and made him come with him to the mariage.
label: Tobias

text: And when he was entered into Raguels houſe, he found Tobias ſitting at the table: and he leaping vp, they kiſſed ech other: and Gabelus wept, and bleſſed God,
label: Tobias

text: and ſayd: The God of Iſrael bleſſe thee, becauſe thou art the ſonne of a verie good man, and iuſt, and that feareth God, and doth almes deedes:
label: Tobias

text: and bleſſing be geuen vpon thy wife, and vpon your parentes:
label: Tobias

text: & that you may ſee your children, and your childrens children, vnto the third & fourth generation: and your ſeede be bleſſed of the God of Iſrael, who reigneth fer euer and euer.
label: Tobias

text: And when al had ſayd, Amen; they went to the feaſt: but with the feare of our Lord alſo did they celebrate the feaſt of the mariage.
label: Tobias

text: BVT when Tobias taried long becauſe of the mariage, Tobias his father was careful, ſaying: Why thinkeſt thou doth my ſonne tarie, or why is he held there?
label: Tobias

text: Is Gabelus dead thinkeſt thou, and no man wil reſtore him the money?
label: Tobias

text: And he began to be ſorowful exceedingly him ſelfe, and Anna his wife with him: and they began both to weepe together: becauſe their ſonne did not returne to them the day appointed.
label: Tobias

text: His mother therfore wept with diſcomfortable teares, and ſayd: Woe, woe is me, my ſonne, why ſent we thee to goe to a ſtrange countrie, the light of our eies, the ſtaffe of our old age, the comforte of our life, the hope of our poſteritie?
label: Tobias

text: We hauing al things together in thee onlie, ought not to haue let thee goe from vs.
label: Tobias

text: To whom Tobias ſaid: Hold thy peace, and be not trubled, our ſonne is ſafe, that man with whom we ſent him is faithſul ynough.
label: Tobias

text: Howbeit she could by no meanes be comforted, but dayly running out looked about, and went about al waies by which there ſeemed hope he would returne, that she might ſee him a far of, if it were poſſible, coming.
label: Tobias

text: But Raguel ſayd to his ſonne in law: Tarie here, and I wil ſend a meſſenger to Tobias thy father, that thou art in health.
label: Tobias

text: To whom Tobias ſayd: I know that my father & my mother do now count the dayes, and their ſpirite is tormented in them.
label: Tobias

text: And when Raguel deſired Tobias in manie wordes, and he by no meanes would heare him, he deliuered Sara vnto him, and the halfe part of al his ſubſtance in men ſeruantes, & wemen ſeruantes, in cattel, in camels, and in kine, and in much money and diſmiſt him ſafe and ioyful from him,
label: Tobias

text: ſaying: The holie Angel of our Lord be in your iourney, and bring you through ſafe, and that you may finde al thinges wel about your parentes, and myn eies may ſee your children before I die.
label: Tobias

text: And the parentes taking their daughter, kiſſed her, and let her goe:
label: Tobias

text: admoniſhing her to honour her father and mother inlaw, to loue her huſband, to rule the houſhold, to gouerne the houſe, and to shewe her ſelfe irreprehenſible.
label: Tobias

text: AND when they returned they came to Charan, which is in the middeway agaynſt Niniue, the eleuenth day.
label: Tobias

text: And the Angel ſaid: Brother Tobias thou knoweſt how thou dideſt leaue thy farher.
label: Tobias

text: If it pleaſe thee therfore, let vs goe before, and let the families folow ſoftly after vs, together with thy wife, and with the beaſtes.
label: Tobias

text: And when this pleaſed him that they should goe, Raphael ſaid to Tobias: Take with thee of the gal of the fish: for it shal be neceſſarie. Tobias therfore tooke of that gal and they departed.
label: Tobias

text: But Anna ſate beſide the way dayly, in the toppe of a hil, from whence she might ſee afar of.
label: Tobias

text: And whiles she watched his coming out of that place, she ſaw afar of, and by and by perceiued her ſonne coming: and running she told her huſband ſaying: Behold thy ſonne cometh.
label: Tobias

text: And Raphael ſaid to Tobias: But when thou art entred into thy houſe forthwith adore our Lord thy God: and geuing thankes to him goe to thy father, and kiſſe him.
label: Tobias

text: And immediatly annointe vpon his eies of this gal of the fish, which thou carieſt with thee. For know thou that forthwith his eies ſhal be opened, and thy father shal ſee the light of heauen, and ſhal reioice in the ſight of thee.
label: Tobias

text: Then ranne the dogge before, which had beene with them in the way, and coming as it were a meſſenger with the fawning of his tayle reioyſed.
label: Tobias

text: And his father that was blind ryſing vp, began to runne ſtumbling with his feete: and geuing a ſeruant his hand, went to meete his ſonne.
label: Tobias

text: And receiuing him kiſſed him, with his wife, and they began both to weepe for ioy.
label: Tobias

text: And when they had adored God, and geuen thankes, they ſate downe together.
label: Tobias

text: Then Tobias taking of the gal of the fish, annoynted his fathers eies.
label: Tobias

text: And he ſtayed as it were almoſt halfe an houre: & the white blenish began to come out of his eies, as it were the skine of an egge.
label: Tobias

text: Which Tobias taking drewe from his eies, and immediatly he receiued ſight.
label: Tobias

text: And they glorified God, to wit, himſelfe and his wife, and al that knewe him.
label: Tobias

text: And Tobias ſaid: I bleſſe thee Lord God of Iſrael, becauſe thou haſt chaſtiſed me, and thou haſt ſaued me: and behold I ſee Tobias my ſonne.
label: Tobias

text: After ſeuen dayes alſo came in Sara his ſonnes wife, and al the familie ſafe, and cattel, and the camels, and much money of his wiues: and that money alſo, which he had receiued of Gabelus:
label: Tobias

text: and he told his parentes al the benefites of God, which he had done to him by the man, that conducted him.
label: Tobias

text: And Achior and Nabath Tobias ſiſters ſonnes came, reioyſing at Tobias, and congratulating him for al good thinges, that God had ſhewed towards him.
label: Tobias

text: And for ſeuen daies making good chere, they reioyſed al with great ioy.
label: Tobias

text: THEN Tobias called to him his ſonne, and ſayd to him: What may we geue to this holie man, that is come with thee.
label: Tobias

text: Tobias anſwering, ſayd to his father: Father what reward shal we geue him? or what can be worthie of his benefittes?
label: Tobias

text: He hath led me and brought me agayne ſafe, he receiued the money of Gabelus, he cauſed me to haue my wife, and the euil ſpirit he chaſed from her, he made ioy vnto her parentes, my ſelf he deliuered from being deuoured of the fish, thee alſo he hath made to ſee the light of heauen, and we are replenished with al good things by him. What can we geue him worthie for theſe things?
label: Tobias

text: But I beſeech thee my father, that thou deſire him, if perhaps he wil voutſafe to take vnto him the one halfe of al thinges, which are brought.
label: Tobias

text: And they calling him, to wit the father and the ſonne, tooke him aſide: & began to deſire him that he would voutſafe to accept the halfe part of al thinges, that they had brought.
label: Tobias

text: Then he ſayd to them ſecretely: Bleſſe ye the God of heauen, and before al that liue confeſſe to him, becauſe he hath done mercie with you.
label: Tobias

text: For to hide the ſecrete of a king is good: but to reueale & confeſſe the workes of God is an honorable thing.
label: Tobias

text: Prayer is good with faſting and almes, rather then to lay vp treaſures of gold:
label: Tobias

text: becauſe almes deliuereth from death, and that is it which purgeth ſinnes, and maketh to finde mercie and life euerlaſting.
label: Tobias

text: But they that committe ſinne and iniquitie, are enemies to their owne ſoule.
label: Tobias

text: I open therfore vnto you the truth, and I wil not hide from you the ſecrete word.
label: Tobias

text: When thou didſt pray with teares, and didſt burie the dead and leaft thy dinner, and dideſt hide the dead by day in thy houſe, and by night didſt burie them, I offered thy prayer to our Lord.
label: Tobias

text: And becauſe thou waſt acceptable to God, it was neceſſarie that tentation should proue thee.
label: Tobias

text: And now our Lord ſent me to cure thee, and to deliuer Sara thy ſonnes wife from the diuel.
label: Tobias

text: For I am Raphael an Angel, one of the ſeuen, which aſſiſt before our Lord.
label: Tobias

text: And when they had heard theſe thinges, they were trubled, & trembling fel vpon the ground on their face.
label: Tobias

text: And the Angel ſayd to them: Peace be to you, feare not.
label: Tobias

text: For when I was with you, by the wil of God I was ſo: bleſſe ye him, and ſing to him.
label: Tobias

text: I ſeemed indeede to eate with you, and to drinke: but I vſe an inuiſible meate and drinke; which can not be ſeene of men.
label: Tobias

text: It is time therfore that I returne to him, that ſent me: but bleſſe ye God, and tel al his maruelous workes.
label: Tobias

text: And when he had ſayd theſe things, he was taken from their ſight, and they could ſee him no more.
label: Tobias

text: Then proſtrate for three houres vpon their face, they bleſſed God: and ryſing vp they told al his maruelous workes.
label: Tobias

text: AND Tobias the elder opening his mouth, bleſſed our Lord, and ſayd: Thou art great Lord for euer, and thy kingdom world without end:
label: Tobias

text: becauſe thou ſcourgeſt, and ſaueſt: leadeſt downe to hel, and bringeſt backe agayne: and there is none that may eſcape thy hand.
label: Tobias

text: Cōfeſſe to our Lord ye children of Iſrael, and in the ſight of the Gentiles prayſe him:
label: Tobias

text: becauſe he hath therfore diſperſed you among the gentiles, which know not him, that you may declare his maruelous workes, and make them know, that there is no other God omnipotent beſides him.
label: Tobias

text: He hath chaſtiſed vs for our iniquities: and he wil ſaue vs for his mercie.
label: Tobias

text: Behold therfore what he hath done with vs, and with feare and trembling confeſſe ye to him: and extol the king of the worldes in your workes.
label: Tobias

text: And I in the land of my captiuitie wil confeſſe to him: becauſe he hath shewed his maieſtie toward a ſinful nation.
label: Tobias

text: Conuert therfore ye ſinners, & do iuſtice before God, beleuing that he wil doe his mercie with you.
label: Tobias

text: And I, and my ſoule wil reioyce in him.
label: Tobias

text: Bleſſe ye our Lord al his elect, celebrate daies of gladnes, and confeſſe to him.
label: Tobias

text: Ieruſalem the citie of God, our Lord hath chaſtiſed thee in the workes of thy handes.
label: Tobias

text: Confeſſe to our Lord in thy good thinges, and bleſſe the God of the worldes, that he may reedefie his tabernacle in thee, and may cal backe al the captiues to thee, & thou mayſt reioyce for euer and euer.
label: Tobias

text: Thou shalt shine with a glorious light: and al the coaſtes of the earth shal adore thee.
label: Tobias

text: Nations from far shal come to thee: and bringing giftes, they shal adore our Lord in thee, and shal eſteeme thy land for ſanctification.
label: Tobias

text: For they shal inuocate the great name in thee.
label: Tobias

text: Curſed shal they be that shal contemne thee: and damned shal they be that shal blaſpheme thee: and bleſſed shal they be that shal build rhee.
label: Tobias

text: And thou shalt reioyce in thy children, becauſe they shal al be bleſſed, & shal be gathered together to our Lord.
label: Tobias

text: Bleſſed are al that loue thee, and that reioyce vpon thy peace.
label: Tobias

text: My ſoule, bleſſe thou our Lord, becauſe he hath deliuered Ieruſalem his citie from al her tribulations, the Lord our God.
label: Tobias

text: Bleſſed shal I be if there shal remayne of my ſeede, to ſee the glorie of Ieruſalem.
label: Tobias

text: The gates of Ieruſalem shal be built of Saphire and the Emerauld: and al the compaſſe of the walles therof of pretious ſtone.
label: Tobias

text: With white and cleane ſtone shal al the ſtreates therof be paued: and in the ſtreates therof Alleluia shal be ſong.
label: Tobias

text: Bleſſed be our Lord, which hath exalted it, and his kingdom be for euer and euer ouer it Amen.
label: Tobias

text: AND the wordes of Tobias were ended. And after that Tobias was reſtored to his ſight, he liued two and fourtie yeares, and ſaw the children of his nephewes.
label: Tobias

text: Therfore an hundred and two yeares being accomplished, he was buried honorably in Niniue.
label: Tobias

text: For being ſix and fiftie yeares old he loſt the ſight of his eies, and being threeſcore he receiued it agayne.
label: Tobias

text: And the reſt of his life was in ioy, and with great increaſe of the feare of God he went forward in peace.
label: Tobias

text: And at the houre of his death he called vnto him Tobias his ſonne, and his ſeuen yong ſonnes, his nephewes, and ſayd to them:
label: Tobias

text: The deſtruction of Niniue is neere: for the word of our Lord fayleth not: and our brethren, which are diſperſed from the land of Iſrael, shal returne to it.
label: Tobias

text: And al the deſert land therof shal be repleniſhed, and the houſe of God which is burnt in it, shal agayne be reedefied: and thither shal al returne that feare God,
label: Tobias

text: and the Gentiles shal forſake their idols, and shal come into Ieruſalem, and shal inhabite in it,
label: Tobias

text: and al the kings of the earth shal reioyce in it, adoring the king of Iſrael.
label: Tobias

text: Heare ye therfore my children your father: ſerue our Lord in truth, and ſeeke to doe the thinges that pleaſe him:
label: Tobias

text: and command your children that they doe iuſtices and almes deedes, that they be mindeful of God, and bleſſe him at al time in truth, and in al their power.
label: Tobias

text: Now therfore children heare me, and doe not tarie here: but what day ſoeuer you shal burie your mother by me in one ſepulchre, from thenceforth directe your ſteppes to depart hence:
label: Tobias

text: for I ſee that the iniquitie therof wil giue it an end.
label: Tobias

text: And it came to paſſe after the death of his mother, Tobias departed out of Niniue with his wife, and children, and childrens children, and returned to his father and mother in law.
label: Tobias

text: And he found them in health in good old age: and he tooke care of them, and he cloſed their eies: and al the inheritance of Raguels houſe he receiued: & he ſaw the fifth generation, his childrens children.
label: Tobias

text: And nintie nine yeares being accomplished in the feare of our Lord, with ioy they buried him.
label: Tobias

text: And al his kinred, and al his generation continewed in good life, and in holie conuerſation, ſo that they were acceptable both to God, and to men, and to al the inhabitantes in in the land.
label: Tobias

text: ARPHAXAD therfore king of the Medes had ſubdued manie nations to his empire, & he built a moſt mightie citie, which he called Ecbatanis,
label: Judith

text: Of ſtone ſquared and hewed: he made walles therof in height ſeuentie cubites, and in breadth thirtie cubites, and the towers therof he made in height an hundred cubites.
label: Judith

text: But each ſide of them was in foure ſquare twentie foote long, and he made the gates therof according to the height of the towers:
label: Judith

text: and he gloried as mightie in the force of his armie, and in the glorie of his chariotes.
label: Judith

text: In the twelfth yeare of his reigne: Nabuchodonoſor the king of the Aſſyrians, who reigned in Niniue the greate citie, fought againſt Arphaxad, and ouercame him
label: Judith

text: in the great field, which is called Ragau, about Euphrates, and Tigris, and Iadaſon in the field of Erioch the king of the Elicians.
label: Judith

text: Then was the kingdom of Nabuchodonoſor exalted, and his hart was eleuated: and he ſent to al, that dwelt in Cilicia and Damaſcus, and Libanus,
label: Judith

text: and to the nations, that are in Carmelus, and Cedar, and the inhabitantes of Galilee in the great field of Eſdrelon,
label: Judith

text: and to al that were in Samaria, and beyond the riuer Iordan euen to Ieruſalem, and al the land of Ieſſe til you come to the borders of Æthiophia.
label: Judith

text: To al theſe Nabuchodoſor king of the Aſſyrians ſent meſſengers:
label: Judith

text: Who al with one minde ſaid nay, & ſent them backe emptie, and reiected them without honour.
label: Judith

text: Then Nabuchodonoſor the king taking indignation againſt al that land, ſwore by his throne and kingdom that he would reuenge him ſelfe of al thoſe countries.
label: Judith

text: IN the thirtenth yeare of king Nabuchodonoſor, the two and twenteth day of the firſt moneth, the word was geuen out in the houſe of Nabuchodonoſor the king of the Aſſyrians, that he would reuenge him ſelfe.
label: Judith

text: And he called al the ancientes, and al the captaynes, and his men of warre, and communicated with them the ſecrete of his counſel:
label: Judith

text: and he ſaid that his cogitation was vpon that, to ſubdew al the earth to his empire.
label: Judith

text: which ſaying when it had pleaſed them al, Nabuchodonoſor the king called Holofernes the General of his warres,
label: Judith

text: and ſaid to him: Goe forth againſt euerie kingdom of the weſt, & againſt them eſpecially, that contemned my commandment.
label: Judith

text: Thyne eie shal ſpare no kingdom, and euerie fenſed citie thou shalt ſubdew to me.
label: Judith

text: Then Holofernes called the captaynes, & magiſtrates of the powre of the Aſſyrians: and he muſtered men for the expedition, as the king commanded him, an hundred twentie thouſand fighting men on foote, and twelue thouſand archers horſemen.
label: Judith

text: And he made al his expedition to goe before in a multitude of inumerable camels, with thoſe thinges that might ſuffice the armies abundantly, heardes of oxen alſo, and flockes of sheepe, which had no number.
label: Judith

text: He appoynted corne to be prepared out of al Syria in his paſſage.
label: Judith

text: But gold and ſiluer he tooke out of the kings houſe exceding much.
label: Judith

text: And he went forth and al the armie with the chariotes, & horſemen, and the archers, which couered the face of the earth, as locuſtes.
label: Judith

text: And when he had paſſed through the coaſtes of the Aſſyrians, he came to the great mountaines of Ange, which are on the left hand of Cilicia: and he went vp into al theit caſteles, and wonne euerie fortreſſe.
label: Judith

text: And he brake downe the renowmed citie of Melothus, and ſpoyled al the children of Therſis, and the childten of Iſmael, which wete againſt the face of the deſert, and on the ſouth of the land of Cellon.
label: Judith

text: And he paſſed ouer Euphrates, and came into Meſopotamia: and he brake al the high cities, that were there, from the torrent of Membre, til ye come to the ſea:
label: Judith

text: and he tooke the borders therof, from Cilicia vnto the coaſtes of Iapheth, which are toward the ſouth.
label: Judith

text: And he caried away al the children of Madian, and ſpoyled al their riches, and al that reſiſted him he ſlew in the edge of the ſword.
label: Judith

text: And after theſe thinges he went downe into the fieldes of Damaſcus in the daies of harueſt, and he ſet al the corne on fire, and he made al the trees and vineyardes to be cut downe;
label: Judith

text: and the feare of him fel vpon al the inhabitantes of the land.
label: Judith

text: THEN the kinges and princes of al cities and prouinces; namely of Syria and Meſopotamia, and Syria Sobal, and Libya, and Cilicia ſent their embaſſadours, which coming to
label: Judith

text: Holofernes, ſaid: Let thy indignation towarde vs ceaſe: For it is better that liuing we feare Nabuchodonoſor the great king, and be ſubiect to thee, then dying, we should with our deſtruction ſuffer the damages of our ſeruitude.
label: Judith

text: Euerie citie of ours, and al our poſſeſſion, al mountaynes, and hilles, and fieldes, and heardes of oxen, and flockes of sheepe, and goates, and of horſes, and camels, and al our goodes, and families are in thy ſight:
label: Judith

text: let al our thinges be vnder thy law.
label: Judith

text: We alſo, and our children are thy ſeruantes.
label: Judith

text: Come to vs a peaceable Lord, and vſe our ſeruice, as it shal pleaſe thee.
label: Judith

text: Then went he downe from the mountaynes with horſemen in a great powre, and tooke euerie citie, and euerie inhabiter of the land.
label: Judith

text: And of al the cities he tooke to helpe him valiant men, and choſen for battel.
label: Judith

text: And ſo great feare lay vpon al thoſe prouinces, that the inhabitantes of al cities, princes and honorable perſons, together with the people went out to meete him coming,
label: Judith

text: receyuing him with garlandes, and torches, dauncing with timbrels, & shaulmes.
label: Judith

text: Neither doing theſe thinges, could they for al that mitigate the firceneſſe of his ſtomacke:
label: Judith

text: for he did both deſtroy their cities, and cut downe their groues.
label: Judith

text: For Nabuchodonoſor the king had commanded him, that he should deſtroy al the goddes of the earth, that he only might be called God of thoſe nations, which could be ſubdewed with the might of Holofernes.
label: Judith

text: And paſſing through al Syria Sobal, and al Apamea, & al Meſopotamia he came to the Idumeians into the land of Gabaa,
label: Judith

text: and tooke their cities, and ſate there for thirtie dayes, in which daies he commanded al the armie of his powre to be vnited.
label: Judith

text: THEN the children of Iſrael, which dwelt in the Land of Iuda, hearing theſe thinges, were ſore afrayd of his preſence.
label: Judith

text: Trembling alſo, and horrour inuaded their ſenſes, leſt he would doe that to Ieruſalem and to the temple of our Lord, which he had done to other cities, and their temples.
label: Judith

text: And they ſent into al Samaria round about, as for as Iericho, and preoccupated al the toppes of mountaynes:
label: Judith

text: and they compaſſed their townes with walles, and gathered together corne for prouiſion of battel.
label: Judith

text: Eliachim the prieſt wrote to al, that were againſt Eſdrelon, which is againſt the face of the great fielde beſide Dothain, and to al, by whom there might be paſſage of way,
label: Judith

text: that they should take the aſcentes of the mountaynes, by which there might be way to Ieruſalem, and should keepe watch, where the way was narrow betwen the mountaynes.
label: Judith

text: And the children of Iſrael did according as the Prieſt of our Lord, Eliachim had appointed them.
label: Judith

text: And al the people cried to our Lord with great inſtance, and they humbled their ſoules in faſtings, and prayers they & their wiues.
label: Judith

text: And the Prieſtes put on heareclothes, and they laide the infantes proſtrate againſt the face of the temple of our Lord, and the altar of our Lord they couered with hearecloth:
label: Judith

text: and they cried to our Lord the God of Iſrael With one accord, that their infantes might not be geuē into praye, & their wiues into ſpoile, and their cities into deſtruction, and their holie thinges into pollution, and they be made a reproch to the Gentiles.
label: Judith

text: Then Eliachim the high Prieſt of our Lord went about al Iſrael and ſpake to them,
label: Judith

text: ſaying: Know ye, that our Lord wil heare your prayers, if continewing you continew in faſtinges and ptayers in the ſight of our Lord.
label: Judith

text: Be mindful of Moyſes the ſeruant of our Lord, who ouerthrew Amalec truſting in his power, and in his might, and in his armie, & in his shieldes, & in his chariotes, & in his horſemen, not by fighting, but with holie prayers:
label: Judith

text: ſo shal al the enemies of Iſrael be; if you perſeuere in this worke, which you haue begunne.
label: Judith

text: They therfore at this exhortation of his, beſeching our Lord, continewed in the ſight of our Lord,
label: Judith
