text: he made manie battels, and obteyned the munition of al, and ſlewe the kinges of the earth:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he paſſed through euen to the ends of the earth: and tooke the ſpoiles of the multitude of the Gentils: and the earth was ſilent in his ſight.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he gathered powre, and an armie exceeding ſtrong: and his hart was exalted and eleuated:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he obtayned the regions of the Gentils, and the tyrantes: and they were made tributaries to him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And after theſe thinges, he fel downe in his bed, and he knew that he should dye.
label: 1 Machabees

label: 1 Machabees

text: And there came forth of them a ſinful roote Antiochus Illuſtre, the ſonne of king Antiochus, that had bene at Rome an hoſtage: and he reigned in the hundreth and ſeuen and thirtieth yeare of the kingdom of the Greekes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: In thoſe dayes there went forth of Iſrael wicked children; & perſwaded manie, ſaying: Let vs goe, and make a couenant with the Gentils, that are about vs: becauſe ſince we departed from them, manie euils haue found vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the talke ſemed good in their eyes.
label: 1 Machabees

label: 1 Machabees

label: 1 Machabees

label: 1 Machabees

label: 1 Machabees

text: And he tooke the fenſed cities in the land of Ægypt: and he tooke the ſpoiles of the land of Ægypt.
label: 1 Machabees

label: 1 Machabees

text: And he tooke the ſiluer and gold, and the deſiderable veſſels: and he tooke the hidden treaſures which he found: and carying away he departed into his owne land.

label: 1 Machabees

label: 1 Machabees

label: 1 Machabees

label: 1 Machabees

label: 1 Machabees

label: 1 Machabees

label: 1 Machabees

text: and layd them vp there: and they became a great ſnare.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And this was made for an embushment of the ſanctification, and to be an il deuil in Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they shed innocent bloud round about the ſanctification, and contaminated the ſanctification.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the inhabitants of Ieruſalem fled by reaſon of them, and it became the habitation of ſtrangers, and she became ſtranger to her owne ſeede, and her children forſooke her.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Her ſanctification was deſolate as a wildernes, her feſtiual dayes were turned into mourning, her ſabbaths into reproche, her honours into naught.
label: 1 Machabees

text: According to her glorie was her ignominie multiplied, and her highnes was turned into mourning.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And king Antiochus wrote to al his kingdom, that al the people should be one: and euerie one should leaue his owne law.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al Nations conſented according to the word of king Antiochus.
label: 1 Machabees

text: and manie of Iſrael conſented to his ſeruice, and they ſacrificed to idols, and defiled the ſabbath.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king ſent bookes by the handes of meſſengers into Ieruſalem, & into al the cities of Iuda: that they should folow the law of the Nations of the earth,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and should prohibite holocauſts and ſacrifices, & placations to be made in the temple of God,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and should prohibite the ſabbath to be celebrated, and the ſolemne dayes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he commanded the holie places to be defiled, and the holie people of Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he commanded altars to be built, and temples, and idols, and ſwines flesh to be immolated, and common beaſts,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and to leaue their children vncircumciſed, and their ſoules to be contaminated in al vncleanneſſes, and abominations, ſo that they should forget the law, and should change al the iuſtifications of God.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And whoſoeuer had not done acording to the word of king Antiochus, they should dye.
label: 1 Machabees

text: According to al theſe words wrote he to al his kingdom: and he appoynted princes ouer the people, that should force theſe thinges to be done.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they commanded the cities of Iuda to ſacrifice.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And manie of the people were gathered to them, they that had forſaken the law of our Lord: and they did euils vpon the land:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they chaſed forth the people of Iſrael in hidden corners, and in the ſecret places of fugitiues.
label: 1 Machabees

text: The fifteenth day of the moneth Caſleu, the hundreth fiue and fourtith yeare king Antiochus built the abominable idol of deſolation vpon the altar of God, and through out al the cities of Iuda round about they builded altars:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and before the gates of houſes, and in the ſtretes they burnt frankincenſe, & ſacrificed.
label: 1 Machabees

text: and the bookes of the law of God they burnt with fyre, cutting them:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and with whomſoeuer were found the bookes of the teſtament of our Lord, and whoſoeuer obſerued the law of our Lord, they murdered him, according to the edict of the king.
label: 1 Machabees

text: In their powre did they theſe thinges to the people of Iſrael, that was found in euerie moneth and moneth in the cities:
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the fiue and twentith day of the moneth they ſacrificed vpon the altar that was agaynſt the altar.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the wemen that circumcided their children, were murdered according to the commandment of king Antiochus,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they hang vp the children by the neck through out al their houſes, and thoſe that had circumcided them, they murdered.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And manie of the people of Iſrael determined with themſelues, that they would not eate the vncleane thinges: & they choſe rather to dye, then to be defiled with vncleane meates:
label: 1 Machabees

text: & they would not breake the holie law of God, & they were murdered,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and there was made great wrath vpon the people excedingly .
label: 1 Machabees

text: IN thoſe dayes aroſe Mathathias the ſonne of Iohn, the ſonne of Simeon, prieſt of the ſonnes of Ioarib from Ieruſalem, and he ſate in the mountayne of Modin:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he had fiue ſonnes, Iohn who was ſurnamed Gaddis:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and Simon, who was ſurnamed Thaſi:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and Iudas, who was called Machabeus:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and Eleazar, who was ſurnamed Abaron: and Ionathan, who was ſurnamed Apphus.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Theſe ſaw the euils, that were done in the people of Iuda, and in Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Mathathias ſayd: Wo is me, wherfore was I borne to ſee the affliction of my people, and the affliction of the holie citie, and to ſitte there, when it is geuen in the handes of the enemies?
label: 1 Machabees

text: The holie places are come into the hand of ſtrangers: the temple therof as an ignoble man.
label: 1 Machabees

text: The veſſels of her glorie are caried away captiue: her old men are murdered in the ſtreets, and her youngmen are fallen by the ſword of the enemies.
label: 1 Machabees

text: What nation hath not inherited her kingdom, and hath not obteyned her ſpoiles?
label: 1 Machabees

text: Al her beautie is taken away. She that was free, is made a ſeruant.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And loe our holies, and our beautie, and our glorie is deſolate, and the Nations haue defiled them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Whereto then is it for vs yet to liue?
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Mathathias rent his garments, & his ſonnes: and they couered themſelues with heareclothes, and lamented excedingly.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there came thither they that were ſent from king Antiochus, to compel them, that were fled into the citie of Modin, to immolate, and to burne frankincenſe, and to depart from the law of God.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And manie of the people of Iſrael conſenting came to them: but Mathathias, and his ſonnes ſtood conſtantly.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they that were ſent from Antiochus anſwering ſayd to Mathathias: Thou art the prince, and moſt honorable, and great in this citie, and adorned with ſonnes, and bretheren.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Therfore come thou firſt, and doe the kings commandement, as al Nations haue done, and the men of Iuda, and they that are remayning in Ieruſalem: & thou shalt be, and thy ſonnes among the kings frends, & amplified with gold, and ſiluer, and manie giftes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Mathathias anſwered, & ſayd with a lowde voice: Although al Nations obey king Antiochus, that euerie man reuolt from the ſeruice of the law of his fathers, and conſent to his commandements:
label: 1 Machabees

text: I and my ſonnes, and my bretheren wil obey the law of our fathers.
label: 1 Machabees

text: God be merciful vnto vs: it is not profitable for vs to forſake the law, and the iuſtices of God:
label: 1 Machabees

text: we wil not heare the wordes of king Antiochus, neither wil we ſacrifice, tranſgreſſing the commandments of our law, to go an other way.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And as he ceaſed to ſpeake theſe words, there came a certayne Iewe in the eyes of al to ſacrifice to the idols vpon the altar in the citie of Modin, according to the kings commandment.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Mathathias ſaw, and was ſorie, and his reynes trembled, and his furie was kindled according to the iudgement of the law, and flying vpon him he ſlew him vpon the altar:
label: 1 Machabees

text: yea and the man, whom king Antiochus had ſent, which compelled them to immolate, he ſlewe in that verie time, and deſtroyed the altar,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and zeled the law, as did Phinees to Zamri the ſonne of Salomi.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Mathathias cried out with a lowde voice in the citie, ſaying: Euerie one that hath zele of the law, eſtablishing his teſtament, let him comeforth after me.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he fled himſelf, and his ſonnes into the mountaynes, and left al thinges whatſoeuer they had in the citie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Then came downe manie ſeeking iudgement, and iuſtice, into the deſert:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they ſate there themſelues, and their children, and their wiues, and their cattel: becauſe the euils ouerflowed vpon them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And it was reported to the kings men, and to the armie that was in Ieruſalem in the citie of Dauid, that certayne men which diſſipated the kings commandment, were departed into ſecrete places in the deſert, and manie were gone after them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And forthwith they went forwards towards them, and ſet battel againſt them in the day of the Sabbaths,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they ſayd to them: Doe you reſiſt now alſo as yet? comeforth, and doe according to the word of king Antiochus, and you shal liue.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they ſayd: We wil not comeforth, neither wil we doe the kings word, to pollute the day of the Sabbaths.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they haſtened battel againſt them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they anſwered them not, neither did they caſt a ſtone at them, nor ſtopped the ſecrete places,
label: 1 Machabees

text: ſaying: Let vs dye al in our ſimplicitie: and heauen and earth shal be witneſſes, vpon vs that you vniuſtly deſtroy vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they gaue them battel on the Sabbaths: and there died they, & their wiues, & their children, and their cattel euen to a thouſand ſoules of men.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Mathathias vnderſtood it and his freinds, and they had lamentation vpon them excedingly.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And euerie man ſayd to his neighbour: If we shal al doe as our bretheren haue done, and shal not fight againſt the heathen for our liues, and our iuſtifications: now wil they quickly deſtroy vs from the earth.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they thought in that day, ſaying: Euerie man whoſoeuer shal come vnto vs in battel on the day of the Sabbaths, let vs fight againſt him: and we wil not al dye, as our bretheren died in ſecrete places.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Then was there gathered to them the ſynagoge of the Aſſideans ſtrong of force out of Iſrael, euerie voluntarie in the law:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and al that fled from the euils, were added to them, & were made a ſtrength to them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they gathered an armie, and ſtroke the ſinners in their wrath, and the wicked men in their indignation: and the reſt fled to the nations to eſcape.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Mathathias went round about, and his freindes, and they deſtroyed the altars:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they circumcided the vncircumciſed children, as manie as they found in the coſts of Iſrael: and in ſtrength.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they perſecuted the children of pride, and the worke proſpered in their handes:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they obteyned the law out of the handes of the nations, and out of the handes of the kinges: & they gaue not the horne to the ſinner.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the dayes of Mathathias approched to dye, & he ſayd to his ſonnes: Now is pride ſtrengthened, and chaſtiſement, and the time of ſubuerſion, & the wrath of indignation:
label: 1 Machabees

text: Now therfore ô my ſonnes, be ye emulatours of the law, & geue your liues for the teſtament of your fathers.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And remember the workes of the fathers, which they haue done in their generations: & you shal receiue great glorie, and an eternal name.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Abraham was he not in tentation found faythful, and it was reputed to him vnto iuſtice?
label: 1 Machabees

text: Ioſeph in the time of his diſtreſſe kept the commandment, and he was made lord of Ægypt.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Phinees our father, feruent in the zele of God, receiued the teſtament of an euerlaſting prieſthood.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Ieſus, whiles he accomplished the word, was made the duke in Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Caleb whiles he teſtifieth in the church, receiued an inheritance.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Dauid in his mercie obteyned the ſeate of the kingdom for euer.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Elias whiles he zeleth the zele of the law, was receiued into heauen.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Ananias and Azarias and Miſael beleuing, were deliuered out of the flame.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Daniel in his ſimplicitie was deliuered out of the lions mouth:
label: 1 Machabees

text: And ſo thinke ye through generation & generation: that al that hope in him, are not weakened.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And of the wordes of the ſinful man be not afrayd: becauſe his glorie is dung, & worme:
label: 1 Machabees

text: to day he is extolled, & to morow he shal not be found: becauſe he is turned into his earth, & his cogitation is perished.
label: 1 Machabees

text: You therfore my ſonnes take courege, & doe manfully in the law: becauſe in it you shal be glorious.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And behold Simon your brother, I know that he is a man of counſel: heare ye him alwayes, & he shal be a father to you.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas Machabeus valiant of ſtrength from his youth, let him be to you the prince of warfare, & he shal manage the battel of the people.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And you shal bring to you al the doers of the law: and reuenge ye the reuenge of your people.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Repay retribution to the Gentiles, and attend to the precept of the law.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he bleſſed them, and was layd to his fathers.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he died the hundreth and ſix and fourtith yeare: and he was buried by his ſonnes in the ſepulchers of his fathers in Modin, and al Iſrael lamented him with great lamentation.
label: 1 Machabees

text: AND Iudas, that was called Machabeus his ſonne aroſe in his ſteed:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and al his bretheren helped him, and al that had ioyned themſelues to his father, and they fought the battel of Iſrael with ioy.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he dilated glorie to his people, and put on him a brigantine as a giant, and girded about him his warlie armour in battels, and protected the campe with his ſword.
label: 1 Machabees

text: He became like a lion in his actes, and as a lions whelpe roaring in hunting.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he perſecuted the wicked enquiring them out, and ſuch as trubled his people, them he burnt with fyre:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and his enemies were repelled for feare of him, al the workers of iniquitie were trubled: and ſaluation was directed in his hand.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he exaſperated manie kinges, and reioyced Iacob in his workes, and for euer his memorie is in benediction.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he walked through the cities of Iuda, and deſtroyed the impious out of them, and turned away wrath from Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he was renowned euen to the vttermoſt part of the earth, & he gathered them that perished.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Apollonius gathered together the Gentils, and from Samaria a powre much and great, to make battel againſt Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas vnderſtood it, and wentforth to meete him: and he ſtroke, and killed him: and there fel manie wounded, and the reſt fled away.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he tooke the ſpoiles of them, and the ſword of Apollonius Iudas tooke away, and he fought with it al his dayes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Seron capitaine of the armie of Syria heard that Iudas gathered a congregation of the faithful, and an aſſemblie with him,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he ſayd: I wil make me a name, & wil be glorified in kingdom, & wil ouerthrow Iudas, and thoſe that are with him, that deſpiſed the word of the king.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he prepared himſelf: and there went vp with him a campe of the impious ſtrong helpers, to doe vengeance vpon the children of Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they approched euen as far as Bethoron: & Iudas went forth to meete him with few.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But as they ſaw the armie coming to meete them, they ſayd to Iudas: How shal we a few be able to fight againſt ſo great a multitude and ſo ſtrong, and we are wearied with faſting to day?
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas ſayd: It is an eaſie matter for manie to be incloſed in the hand of few: & there is no difference in the ſight of the God of heauen to deliuer in manie, and in few.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Becauſe not in the multitude of the armie is the victorie of battel, but from heauen is the ſtrength.
label: 1 Machabees

text: They come to vs in an obſtinate multitude, and in pride, to deſtroy vs, and our wiues, and our children, and to ſpoile vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But we wil fight for our liues, and our lawes:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and our Lord himſelf wil deſtroy them before our face, but you feare them not.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And as he ceaſed to ſpeake, he flew vpon them ſodenly: and Seron was deſtroyed, and his hoſt in his ſight:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he purſewed him in the deſcent of Bethoron euen to the playne, and there fel of them eight hundred men, and the reſt fled into the land of the Phyliſthims.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the feare of Iudas and of his bretheren, and the dread fel vpon al the nations round about them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And his name came to the king, and al nations told of the battels of Iudas.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And as king Antiochus heard theſe wordes he was wrath in his mind: and he ſent, and gathered the armie of al his kingdom, a campe exceding ſtrong:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he opened his treaſurie, and gaue wages to the armie for a yeare: and he commanded them, that they should be readie at al aſſayes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſaw that money fayled out of his treaſures, and the tributes of the region ſmal becauſe of the diſſenſion, and the plague, that he had made in the land, to take away the ordinances, that were from the firſt dayes:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he feared leſt he should not haue as once and twiſe, for coſts and gifts, which he had geuen before with a large hand: and he had abunded aboue the kinges, that had bene before him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he was excedingly aſtonied in minde, & purpoſed to goe into Perſis, and to take the tributes of the regions, and to gather together much ſiluer.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he left Lyſias a noble man of the bloud royal, ouer the kings affayres, from the riuer Euphrates euen to the riuer of Ægypt:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and that he should bring vp Antiochus his ſonne, til he returned.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he deliuered to him half the armie, and Elephants: and he gaue him in commandment concerning al thinges that he would, & concerning the inhabitants of Iurie, and Ieruſalem:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and that he should ſend an armie to them, to deſtroy and roote out the powre of Iſrael, and the remnant of Ieruſalem, and to take away the memorie of them out of the place:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and that he should appoynt inhabitants in al their coſts, children ſtrangers, & should by lot diſtribute their land.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king tooke the part of the armie that remayned, and went forth from Antioch the citie of his kingdom in the yeare an hundreth and ſeuen and fourtie: and he paſſed ouer the riuer Euphrates, & walked through the higher countries.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Lyſias choſe Ptolomee the ſonne of Doryminus, and Nicanor, and Gorgias, mightie men of the kings freindes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſent with them fourtie thouſand men, and ſeuen thouſand horſemen: that they should come into the land of Iuda, and should deſtroy it according to the word of the king.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they went forth with al their power, and came, and ioyned nere to Enimaum in the champaine countrie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the merchants of the countries heard the name of them: and they tooke ſiluer and gold exceding much, and ſeruants: and they came into the campe, to take the children of Iſrael for ſlaues, and there were added to them the armie of Syria, and of the land of the ſtrangers.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas ſaw, and his bretheren, that the euils were multiplied, and the armies approched to their borders: and they knew the kings words, which he commanded to doe to the people vnto deſtruction and conſummation:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they ſayd euerie one to his neighbour: Let vs ſet vp the abaſing of our people, and let vs fight for our people, and our holies.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And an aſſemblie was gathered, that they should be readie vnto battel: and that they should pray and deſire mercie and miſerations.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ieruſalem was not inhabited, but was as a deſert: there was none that came in and went out of her children: and the holie place was conculcated: and the children of ſtrangers were in the caſtel, there was the inhabitation of the Gentils, and pleaſure was taken away from Iacob, and there failed their pipe, and harpe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they gathered together, and came into Maſpha againſt Ieruſalem: becauſe the place of prayer in Iſrael was in Maſpha before.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they faſted that day, and clothed themſelues with heareclothes, and put ashes on their head: and they rent their garments:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they layd open the bookes of the law, out of which the Gentils ſearched the ſimilitude of their idols:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they brought the ornaments of prieſts, and firſtfruites, and tithes, and rayſed vp Nazareits, that had fulfilled their dayes:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they cried with a lowd voice to heauen, ſaying: What shal we doe with theſe, & whither shal we carie them?
label: 1 Machabees

text: And thy holies are conculcated, and they are contaminated, and thy prieſts are brought into mourning, and into humiliation.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And behold the Nations are come together againſt vs, to deſtroy vs: thou knoweſt what thinges they intend againſt vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: How shal we be able to ſtand before their face, vnles thou ô God doe helpe vs?
label: 1 Machabees

text: And with trumpets they cried out with a lowd voice.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And after theſe thinges Iudas appointed captaynes of the people, tribunes, and centurions, and ſeargents, and decurions.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſayd to them, that built houſes, and deſpouſed wiues, and planted vyneyards, and to the fearful, that euerie one should returne into his houſe according to the law.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they remoued the campe, and pitched at the South of Emmaum.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas ſayd: Gird vp your ſelues, and be mightie ſonnes, and be readie agaynſt the morning, that you may fight againſt theſe nations, which are aſſembled againſt vs to deſtroy vs, and our holies:
label: 1 Machabees

text: becauſe it is better for vs to dye in battel, then to ſee the euils of our nation, and of the holies:
label: 1 Machabees

text: but as it shal be the wil in heauen, ſo be it done.
label: 1 Machabees

text: AND Gorgias tooke fiue thouſand men, and a thouſand choſen horſemen: & they remoued the campe by night,
label: 1 Machabees

text: that they might approch to the campe of the Iewes, and might ſtrike them ſodenly: and the children that were of the caſtel, were their guides.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas heard, and aroſe he and the mighties to ſtrike the powre of the kings armie, that were in Emmaum.
label: 1 Machabees

text: For as yet the armie was diſperſed from the campe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Gorgias came into the campe of Iudas by night, and found no man, and he ſought them in the mountaynes: becauſe he ſayd: Theſe flee from vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And when the day was come, Iudas appeared in the filde with three thouſand men onlie, which had not harnes, and ſwords as they would:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they ſaw the campe of the Gentils ſtrong, and the men in brigantines, and horſemen round about them, and theſe were skilful to battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas ſayd to the men that were with him: Feare not the multitude of them, & of their aſſault be not afrayd.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Remember in what ſort our fathers were ſaued in the redſea, when Pharao with a great armie folowed them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And now let vs crie towards heauen: and our Lord wil haue mercie on vs, and wil be mindful of the teſtament of our fathers, & wil deſtroy this armie, before our face this day:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and al Nations shal know that there is one that redemeth and deliuereth Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the aliens lifted vp their eyes, and ſaw them coming againſt them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they went out of the campe into battel, and theſe that were with Iudas, ſounded with the trumpet.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they mette together: and the Gentils were diſcomfited, and fled into the playne.
label: 1 Machabees

text: but al the hinmoſt fel by the ſword, and they purſewed them as far as Gezeron, and euen to the playnes of Idumea, and of Azotus, and of Iamnia: and there fel of them euen to three thouſand men.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas returned, and his armie folowing him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſayd to the people: Couet not the ſpoiles: becauſe there is battel againſt vs,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and Gorgias and his armie are neere vs in the mount: but ſtand ye now againſt our enemies, and ouerthrow them, and you shal take the ſpoiles afterwards ſecure.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And as Iudas was ſpeaking theſe wordes, loe a certaine part appeared looking forth from the montayne.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Gorgias ſaw that his men were turned to flight, & that they burnt the campe: for the ſmoke that was ſene declared what was done.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Which thinges ſeene they feared excedingly, beholding withal both Iudas, & the armie in the playne readie to battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they did al flee into the playne of the aliens:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and Iudas returned to the ſpoiles of the campe, & they tooke much gold, and ſiluer, and hiacynth, and purple of the ſea, and great riches.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And turning they ſung an hymne, and bleſſed God towards heauen, becauſe he is good, becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And great ſaluation was made in Iſrael in that day.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And whoſoeuer eſcaped of the aliens, they came and told Lyſias al thinges that had chanced.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Which when he heard being amaſed he faynted in mynd: that ſuch thinges chanced not in Iſrael, as he would, and ſuch as the king commanded.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the yeare folowing Lyſias gathered of choſen men three ſcore thouſand, and of horſemen fiue thouſand, to ouerthrow them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they came into Iewrie, and pitched the campe in Bethoron, and Iudas mette them with ten thouſand men.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they ſaw the armie ſtrong, and he prayed, and ſayd: Bleſſed art thou ô ſauiour of Iſrael, which brakeſt the aſſault of the mightie by the hand of thy ſeruant Dauid, and didſt deliuer the campe of the aliens into the hand of Ionathas Sauls ſonne, and of his eſquyer.
label: 1 Machabees

text: shut vp this armie in the hand of thy people Iſrael, and let them be confounded in their armie and horſemen.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Geue them feare, and conſume the bouldnes of their ſtrength, and let them be shaken with their contrition,
label: 1 Machabees

text: caſt them downe with the ſword of them, that loue thee: & let al that know thy name, prayſe thee in hymnes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they ioyned battel: and there fel of the armie of Lyſias fiue thouſand men.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Lyſias ſeing the flight of his men, and the boldnes of the Iewes, and that they are readie either to liue or to dye manfully, he went to Antioch, and choſe ſouldiars, that being multiplied they might come agayne into Iewrie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But Iudas, and his bretheren ſayd: Behold our enemies are diſcomfited: let vs goe vp now to clenſe the holie places, and to renew them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al the armie aſſembled together, and they went vp into mount Sion.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they ſaw the ſanctification deſert, and the altar prophaned, and the gates burnt, and in the courts shrubbes growen vp as in a foreſt, or on the mountaynes, & the chambers throwen downe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they rent their garments, and lamented with a great lamentation, and layd ashes vpon their head:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they fel on their face vpon the earth, and cried out with trumpets of ſignifications, and cried towards heauen.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Then Iudas ordayned men, to fight againſt them that were in the caſtel, til they clenſed the holie places.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he choſe prieſts without ſpotte, hauing their wil in the law of God:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they clenſed the holie places, and tooke away the ſtones of contamination into an vncleane place.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he conſidered of the altar of holocauſts, that was prophaned, what he should doe with it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And good counſel came to their mindes, to deſtroy it: leſt perhaps it might be a reproch to them, becauſe the Gentils contaminated it, and they threw it downe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they layd vp the ſtones in the mount of the houſe in a place conuenient, til there should come a prophete, and geue anſwer concerning them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they tooke whole ſtones according to the law, and builded a new altar according to that which was before:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they built the holie places, and the thinges that were within the temple inward: and the temple, and the courts they ſanctified.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they made the holie veſſels new, and brought in the candleſtike, and the altar of incenſes, and the table into the temple.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they put incenſe vpon the altar, and lighted the lampes, that were vpon the candleſticke, and they gaue light in the temple.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they ſet loaues vpon the table, and hung vp the veles, and finished al the workes, that they had made.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And before the morning they aroſe the fiue and twentith day of the ninth moneth (this is the moneth of Caſleu) of the hundreth and eight and fourtith yeare:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they offered ſacrifice according to the law vpon the new altar of holocauſts, which they made.
label: 1 Machabees

text: According to the time and according to the day, wherin the heathen contaminated it, in the ſame was it renewed in canticles, and harps, and lutes, and in cymbals.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al the people fel on their face, and they adored toward heauen, and bleſſed him that proſpered them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they made the dedication of the altar eight dayes, and they offered holocauſts with ioy, and ſacrifice of ſaluation, and of prayſe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they adorned the face of the temple with golden crownes, & litle shieldes: and they dedicated the gates, and the chambers, and hanged doores vpon them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there was made exceding great ioy in the people, and the reproch of the Gentils was turned away.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas decreed, and his bretheren, and al the church of Iſrael, that the day of the dedication of the altar be kept in the times therof from yeare to yeare for eight dayes, from the fiue and twentith day of the moneth Caſleu, with ioy and gladnes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they builded at that time mount Sion, & round about high walles, and ſtrong towres, leſt ſometime the Gentils should come, & conculcate it as they did before.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he placed an armie there, to keepe it, and he fenſed it to keepe Bethſura, that the people might haue a munition againſt the face of Idumea.
label: 1 Machabees

text: AND it came to paſſe, as the Gentils round about heard that the altar was builded vp, & the ſanctuarie as before, they were exceding angrie:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they thought to take away the ſtocke of Iacob, that were among them, & they began to kil of the people, and to perſecute.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas fought againſt the children of Eſau in Idumea, and them that were in Acrabathane: becauſe they beſette the Iſraelites round about, and he ſtroke them with a great plague.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he remembred the malice of the children of Bean, which were to the people a ſnare and a ſcandal, lying in waite for them in the way.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they were shut vp by him in towres, & he came nere to them, & aanathematized them, & burnt their towres with fyre, with al that were in them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he paſſed to the children of Ammon, and found a ſtrong band, and a copious people, and Timothee their captaine:
label: 1 Machabees

text: & he made manie battels with them, and they were diſcomfited in their ſight, and he ſtroke them:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he tooke Gazer the citie, & her daughters, and returned into Iewrie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the Gentils that are in Galaad, gathered together agaynſt the Iſraelites, that were in their coſts to diſpatch them: and they fled into the fortreſſe of Batheman.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they ſent letters to Iudas, & his bretheren, ſaying: The heathen round about are gathered together againſt vs, to diſpatch vs:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they prepare to come, and to occupie the fortreſſe into which we are fled: and Timothee is the captayne of their hoſt.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Now therfore come, & deliuer vs, out of their handes, becauſe a multitude of vs is fallen.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al our bretheren, that were in the places of Tubin, are ſlaine: & they led away their wiues captiues, and the children, and the ſpoiles, and they haue ſlaine there almoſt a thouſand men.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the epiſtles were yet in reading, and loe other meſſengers came out of Galilee their coates rent reporting according to theſe wordes:
label: 1 Machabees

text: ſaying that there were aſſembled againſt them from Ptolemais, and Tyre, and Sidon, and al Galilee is replenished with alienes, to conſume vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And as Iudas and the people heard theſe wordes, a great aſſemblie aſſembled together to conſider what they should doe for their bretheren, that were in tribulation, and were expugned of them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas ſayd to Simon his brother: Chooſe thee men, and goe, and deliuer thy bretheren in Galilee: and I, and my brother Ionathas wil goe into the countrie of Galaad.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he left Ioſeph the ſonne of Zacharie, and Azarias captaynes of the people with the reſidue of the armie in Iurie to keepe it:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he commanded them, ſaying: Be ye ouer this people: & make no battel againſt the heathen, til we returne.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there were parted to Simon three thouſand men, to goe into Galilee: but to Iudas eight thouſand to goe into the countrie of Galaad.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon went into Galilee, and made manie battels with the heathen: & the heathen were diſcomfited before his face, and he purſewed them euen to the gate of Ptolemais.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there fel of the heathen almoſt three thouſand men, & he tooke the ſpoiles of them,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he toke them that were in Galilee & in Arbatis with their wiues, and children, & al thinges that they had, and he brought them into Iurie with great ioy.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas Machabeus, and Ionathas his brother paſſed ouer Iordan, and went three dayes iorney through the deſert.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the Nabutheians mette them, and receiued them peaceably, and told them al thinges, that had happened to their bretheren in the countrie of Galaad,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and that manie of them were comprehended in Baraſa, and Boſor, and in Alimis, and in Caſphor, and Mageth, and Carnaim, al theſe cities fenſed, and great.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Yea and in the reſt of the cities of Galaad they are held captiue, & on the morow they appoynted to remoue the armie nere to theſe cities, and to take them, & to diſpatch them in one day.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas turned, and his armie the way into Boſor ſodenly, and tooke the citie: and he ſlew euerie male in the edge of the ſword, and tooke al their ſpoiles, and burnt it with fire.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they aroſe thence by night, and went euen to the fortreſſe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And it came to paſſe early in the morning, when they had lifted vp their eyes, and behold much people, wherof there was no number, carying ladders, and engins, to take the fortreſſe, and they expugned them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas ſaw that the battel began, and the crie of the battel aſcended to heauen as a trumpet, and a great crie out of the citie:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he ſayd to his hoſt: Fight ye to day for your bretheren.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he came with three rankes behind them, and they cried out with trumpets, and cried in prayer.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the campe of Timothee vnderſtood that it was Machabeus, and they fled backe from his preſence: and they ſtroke them with a great plague: and there fel of them in that day almoſt eight thouſand men.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas turned aſide into Maſpha, and expugned, and tooke it, and he ſlew euerie male therof, and he tooke the ſpoiles therof, and burnt it with fyre.
label: 1 Machabees

text: From thence he marched, and tooke Casbon, and Mageth, and Boſor, and the reſt of the cities of Galaad.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But after theſe wordes Timothee gathered an other armie, & camped againſt Raphon beyond the torrent.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas ſent to vewe the armie: and they reported vnto him, ſaying: That al the nations, that are round about vs, are aſſembled againſt vs, an armie exceding great:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they haue hyred the Arabians to helpe them, and they haue camped beyond the torrent, being readie to come vnto thee into battel. And Iudas went to meete them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Timothee ſayd to the princes of his armie: When Iudas shal approch, and his armie to the torrent of water: if he paſſe ouer vnto vs firſt, we shal not be able to ſuſtaine him: becauſe preuayling he wil preuaile againſt vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: but if he be afrayd to paſſe ouer, and campe without the riuer, let vs paſſe ouer to them, and we shal preuaile againſt him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But as Iudas approched to the torrent of water, he ſet the ſcribes of the people by the torrent, and commanded them, ſaying: Leaue not a man: but let al come into the battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he paſſed ouer to them firſt, and al the people after him, and al the heathen were diſcomfited at their preſence, and they threw away their weapons, and fled to the temple, that was in Carnaim.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he tooke the citie itſelf, and the temple he burnt with fire, with al thinges that were therein: & Carnaim was ſubdewed, and could not ſtand againſt the face of Iudas.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas gathered together al the Iſraelites, that were in the countrie of Galaad, from the leaſt euen to the greateſt, and their wiues, and children, and an armie exceding great, to come into the land of Iuda.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they came as far as Ephron, and this citie was great ſituate in the entrance, fenced excedingly, and there was no meanes to decline from it on the right hand or on the left, but the way was through the middes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they that were in the citie, shut in themſelues, and ſtopped the gates with ſtones: and Iudas ſent to them in peaceable wordes,
label: 1 Machabees

text: ſaying: Let vs paſſe through your land, and goe into our countrie: and no man shal hurt you, onlie on foote we wil paſſe. And they would not open vnto them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas commanded proclamation to be made in the campe, that they should approch euerie man in the place wherein he was.
label: 1 Machabees

text: and the men of ſtrength approched, and he aſſaulted that citie al the day, and al the night, and the citie was deliuered into his hand:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they ſlew euerie male in the edge of the ſword, and he rooted it vp, and tooke the ſpoiles therof, and paſſed through al the citie vpon the ſlaine.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they paſſed ouer Iordan in the great playne, againſt the face of Bethſan.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas gathered together the hinmoſt, and he exhorted the people throughout al the way, til they came into the land of Iuda:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they went vp into mount Sion with ioy, and gladnes, & offered holocauſts becauſe none of them was fallen til they returned in peace.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And in the dayes, that Iudas and Ionathas were in the land of Galaad, and Simon his brother in Galilee againſt the face of Ptolomais,
label: 1 Machabees

text: Ioſeph the ſonne of Zacharie heard, and Azarias, the princes of the band, the thinges wel atcheiued, and the battels that were made,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he ſayd: Let vs alſo make vs a name, and let vs goe fight againſt the heathen, that are round about vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he commanded them that were in his armie, and they went to Iamnia.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Gorgias went forth out of the citie, and his men to meete them into battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ioſeph and Azarias were chaſed in flight euen vnto the borders of Iurie: and there fel that day of the people of Iſrael about two thouſand men, and there was made a great tumult in the people:
label: 1 Machabees

text: becauſe they heard not Iudas, and his bretheren, thinking that they should doe manfully.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But they were not of the ſeede of thoſe men by whom ſaluation was made in Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the men of Iuda were magnified excedingly in the ſight of al Iſrael, and of al nations where their name was heard.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they came together vnto them, with acclamations for their good ſucceſſe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas went out, and his bretheren, and they expugned the children of Eſau in the land, that is toward the South, and they ſtroke Chebron, and her daughters: and the walles therof and the towres he burnt with fyre round about.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he remoued the campe to goe into the land of the aliens, and he walked through Samaria.
label: 1 Machabees

text: In that day fel the prieſts in battel, whiles they wil doe manfully, whiles they goe forth without counſel into battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas declined to Azotus into the land of the aliens, and he threw downe their altars, and the ſculptils of their goddes he burnt with fyre: and he tooke the ſpoiles of the cities, and returned into the land of Iuda.
label: 1 Machabees

text: AND king Antiochus walked through the higher countries, and he heard that there was a citie Elymais in Perſis moſt noble, and plentiful in ſiluer, and gold,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and a temple therin exceeding rich: and coucrings thereof gold, and brigantines, and shildes, which Alexander philips ſonne the king of Macedonia that reigned firſt in Grece left there.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he came, and ſought to take the citie, and to ſpoile it, and he could not, becauſe the word was knowen to them that were in the citie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they roſe vp into battel, and he fled from thence, and departed with great ſorow, and returned into Babylonia.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there came one that told him in Perſis, that the campes that were in the land of Iuda, were put to flight:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and that Lyſias went with great powre with the firſt, and was put to flight before the face of the Iewes, and they grew ſtrong with armour, and force, and manie ſpoiles, which they tooke out of the campes, which they deſtroyed:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and that they threw downe the abomination which they had builded vpon the altar that was in Ieruſalem, and the ſanctification they compaſſed about as before with high walles, yea and Bethſura his citie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And it came to paſſe as the king heard theſe wordes, he was ſore afrayd, and was moued excedingly: and he lay downe vpon his bed, and fel into ſicknes for ſorow, becauſe it was not chanced to him as he thought.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he was there for manie dayes: becauſe there was renewed in him great ſorowfulnes, and he made account to dye.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he called al his freindes, and ſayd to them: Sleepe is departed from mine eyes, and I am fallen away, & my hart is gone for penſifenes:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and I ſayd in my hart: Into how great tribulation am I come, & into what waues of ſorow, wherin now I am: who was pleaſant, and beloued in my powre!
label: 1 Machabees

text: But now I remember the euils, that I haue done in Ieruſalem, from whence alſo I tooke away al the ſpoiles of gold, and of ſiluer, that were in it, and I ſent to take away the inhabitants of Iewrie, without cauſe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: I know therfore that for this cauſe haue theſe euils found me: and loe I perish with great ſorow in a ſtrange countrie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he called philip, one of his frendes, and he made him chiefe ouer al his kingdom.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he gaue him the crowne, and his robe, and ring, that he should bring Antiochus his ſonne, & should bring him vp to reigne.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Antiochus the king died there in the yeare an hundreth fourtie nine.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Lyſias vnderſtood that the king was dead, and he appoynted Antiochus his ſonne to reigne, whom he brought vp a young man: and he called his name Eupator.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they that were in the caſtel, had incloſed Iſrael round about the holie places: and they ſought them euils alwayes, and the ſtrengthning of the Gentils,
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas thought to deſtroy them: and he called together al the people, to beſiege them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they came together, and beſieged them in the yeare an hundredth fiftie, and they made baliſts and engins.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And certaine of them that were beſieged, went forth: & ſome impious men of Iſrael ioyned them ſelues vnto them,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they went to the king, and ſayd: How long doeſt thou not iudgements, and reuengeſt our bretheren?
label: 1 Machabees

text: We decreed to ſerue thy father, and to walke in his precepts, and obey his edicts:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and the children of our people for this alienated them ſelues from vs, and whoſoeuer were found of vs, they were ſlayne, and our inheritances were ſpoiled.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And not to vs only haue they extended the hand, but alſo into al our coaſts.
label: 1 Machabees

text: and behold they haue approched this day to the caſtel in Ieruſalem to take it, and they haue fortified a fortreſſe in Bethſura:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and vnles thou preuent them more ſpedely, they wil doe greater thinges then theſe, and thou shalt not be able to winne them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king was angrie, as he heard theſe thinges: and he called together al his freinds, and the princes of his armie, and them that were ouer the horſemen.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Yea and of other realmes, and of the ilands by the ſea there came vnto him hyred armies.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the number of his armie was an hundred thouſand footemen, and twentie thouſand horſemen, and elephants thirtie two, taught to battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they came through Idumea, and approched to Bethſura, and fought manie dayes, and they made engins and came forth, and burnt them with fyre, and fought manfully.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas departed from the caſtel, and remoued the campe to Bethzacaram againſt the kings campe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king aroſe before it was light, and ſtirred the bands into fiercenes againſt the way to Bethzacaram: and the armies made them ſelues readie to the battel, and they ſounded with trumpets:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and to the elephants they shewed the bloud of the grape, and of the mulberie, to prouoke them to the battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they diuided the beaſts by the legions: and there ſtood by euerie elephant a thouſand men in coates of maile, & helmets of braſſe on their heads: and fiue hundred horſemen ſet in order were choſen for euerie beaſt.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Theſe before the time wherſoeuer the beaſt was, there were they: and whither ſoeuer it went, they went, and they departed not from it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Yea & vpon them were ſtrong woodden towres protecting euerie beaſt: & vpon them engins, and vpon euerie one thirtie two men of ſtrength, which fought from aboue: & within the maſter of the beaſt.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the reſidue of the horſemen he placed on this ſide and on that ſide into two parts, with trumpets to ſtir vp the armie, & to vrge them that ſtood thicke together in the legions therof.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And as the ſunne did shine vpon the bucklers of gold, and of braſſe, the mountaynes gliſtered therewith, and they gliſtered as lampes of fire.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And part of the kings armie was ſeuered by the high montaynes, and an other part by the low places: and they marched warely and orderly.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al the inhabitants of the land were moued at the voice of the multitude of them, and the marching of the troupe, & the ratling of the armour, for it was an armie exceding great and ſtrong.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas approched, and his armie into battel: & there fel of the kings armie ſix hundred men.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Eleazar the ſonne of Saura ſaw one of the beaſts harneſſed with the kings harnes: and it was eminent aboue the other beaſts; and it ſemed to him that the king was on it:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he gaue himſelf to deliuer his people, and to get himſelf an euerlaſting name.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ranne to it boldly in the middes of the legion, killing on the right hand, & on the left, and they were ſlaine of him on this ſide and that ſide.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he went vnder the feete of the elephant, and put himſelf vnder him, and ſlew him: and it fel to the ground vpon him, and he died there.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they ſeing the kinges powre, and the fiercenes of his armie, turned them ſelues aſide from them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But the kings campe went vp againſt them vnto Ieruſalem: and the kings campe approched to Iurie and mount Sion.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he made peace with them that were in Bethſura: and they came forth out of the citie, becauſe there were no victuals for them there benig shut vp, becauſe it was the ſabbaths of the land.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king tooke Bethſura: and he placed there a garriſon to kepe it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he turned the place of the ſanctification manie dayes: & he placed there arbaliſts and engins, and inſtruments to caſt fyre, and peeces to caſt ſtones, and arrowes, & ſcorpions to shoote arrowes, and ſlings.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they alſo made engins againſt their engins, and they fought manie dayes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But there were no victuals in the citie, for that it was the ſeuenth yeare: and they that had remayned in Iurie of the Gentils, had conſumed their remaynes, that had bene layd vp.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there remayned in the holies few men, becauſe famine had preuailed ouer them: and they were diſperſed euerie man into his place.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Lyſias heard that Philip, whom king Antiochus when he liued, had appointed to bring vp his ſonne to reigne,
label: 1 Machabees

text: was returned from Perſis, and Media, and the armie that went with him, and that he ſought to take vpon him the affayres of the kingdom:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he haſtened to goe, and to ſay to the king, and to the princes of the armie: We decay dayly, and there is litle victual for vs, and the place that we beſiege, is fenſed, & it lyeth vpon vs to take order for the kingdom.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Now therfore let vs geue the right handes to theſe men, and make peace with them, and with al their nation.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And let vs decree for them, that they walke in their owne ordinances as before. For, becauſe of their ordinances which we diſpiſed, they haue bene wrath, and haue done al theſe thinges.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the word was liked in the ſight of the king, and of the princes: and he ſent vnto them to make peace: and they receiued it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king and the princes ſware to them: and they came out of the fortreſſe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king entred mount Sion, and ſaw the munition of the place: and he brake quickly the othe which he ſware, and commanded to deſtroy the wal round about.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he departed in haſt, and returned to Antioche, and found Philip ruling ouer the citie: and he fought againſt him and wanne the citie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: IN the yeare an hundreth fiftie firſt went forth Demetrius the ſonne of Seleucus from the citie of Rome, and he aſcended with few men into a citie by the ſea ſide, and reigned there.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And it came to paſſe, as he entered into the houſe of the kingdom of his fathers, the armie tooke Antiochus, and Lyſias, to bring them vnto him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king was knowne to him: and he ſayd: Shew me not their face.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the armie ſlew them. And Demetrius ſate vpon the ſeate of his kingdom:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and there came to him the wicked and impious men of Iſrael: & Alcimus the captaine of them, who would be made the prieſt.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they accuſed the people to the king, ſaying: Iudas and his bretheren haue deſtroyed al thy freindes, and vs he hath deſtroyed out of our land.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Now therfore ſend a man, whom thou doeſt credite, that he may goe, and ſee al the deſtruction, that he hath done to vs, and to the kings countries: and let him puniſh al his freinds, and their ayders.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king choſe of his freinds Bacchides, that ruled beyond the great riuer in the kingdom, and was faythful to the king: and he ſent him,
label: 1 Machabees

text: to ſee the deſtruction that Iudas hath made: and Alcimus the impious man he appointed to the prieſthood, and gaue him in commandment to make reuenge vpon the children of Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they aroſe, and came with a great armie into the land of Iuda: and they ſent meſſengers, and ſpake to Iudas, & his brethren with peaceable wordes in guile.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they attended not to their wordes: for they ſaw that they came with a great armie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there aſſembled to Alcimus & Bacchides a congregation of the ſcribes to require the thinges that are iuſt:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and firſt, the Aſſideans that were in the children of Iſrael, and they ſought peace of them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: for they ſayd: A man that is a prieſt of the ſeede of Aaron is come, he wil not deceiue vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſpake with them peaceable wordes: and he ſware to them, ſaying: We wil doe you no harme, nor your freindes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they beleued him. And he tooke of them threeſcore men, and ſlew them in one day according to the word, that is written:
label: 1 Machabees

text: The flesh of thy ſaincts, and the bloud of them they haue shed round about Ieruſalem, and there was none to burie them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there fel feare, and trembling vpon al the people, becauſe they ſayd: There is no truth, & iudgement in them: for they haue tranſgreſſed the appointment, and the othe which they ſware.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Bacchides remoued the campe from Ieruſalem, and approched to Bethzecha: and he ſent, & tooke manie of them that were fled from him, and certaine of the people he killed, and threw them into a great pitte.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he committed the countrie to Alcimus, and left with him ayde to helpe him. And Bacchides went away to the king:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and Alcimus did what he could for the principalitie of his prieſthood:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and there gathered together vnto him al that diſturbed their people, and they obteyned the land of Iuda, & made a great plague in Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas ſaw al the euils that Alcimus did, and they that were with him, to the children of Iſrael, much more then the Gentils.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he went out into al the coaſts of Iurie round about, and did vengeance vpon the men that reuolted, and they ceaſed to goe forth any more into the countrie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But Alcimus ſaw that Iudas preuailed, and they that were with him: and he knew that he could not ſtand with them, and he went backe to the king, and accuſed them of manie crimes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king ſent Nicanor, one of his nobler princes: that practiſed emnities againſt Iſrael: and he commanded him to deſtroy the people.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Nicanor came into Ieruſalem with a great armie, and he ſent to Iudas and to his bretheren in peaceable wordes with guile,
label: 1 Machabees

text: ſaying: Let there be no fighting betwen me and you: I wil come with few men, to ſee your faces with peace.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he came to Iudas, and they ſaluted one an other peaceably: and the enemies were readie to catch Iudas.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the thing was knowne to Iudas that he was come with guile: and he was ſore afrayd of him, & would not ſee his face any more.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Nicanor knew that his counſel was diſcloſed: and he went forth to Iudas into battel beſide Capharſalama.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there fel of Nicanors armie almoſt fiue thouſand men, and they fled into the citie of Dauid.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And after theſe wordes Nicanor went vp into mount Sion: & there went forth of the prieſts of the people to ſalute him in peace, and to shew him the holocauſts, that were offered for the king.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And ſcorning he contemned them, and polluted them: and he ſpake proudly,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and ſware with anger, ſaying: Vnles Iudas be deliuered, and his armie into my handes, incontinent when I shal returne in peace, I wil burne this houſe. And he went out with great anger:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and the prieſts entered in, and ſtood before the face of the altar and the temple: and weeping they ſayd:
label: 1 Machabees

text: Thou ô Lord haſt choſen this houſe for thy name to be inuocated therin, that it might be a houſe of prayer, and obſecration for thy people.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Take vengeance vpon this man, and his armie, and let them fal by the ſword: remember their blaſphemies, and grant not vnto them to be permanent.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Nicanor went out from Ieruſalem, and moued the campe neere to Bethhoron: and the armie of Syria mette him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas approched in Adarſa with three thouſand men: and Iudas prayed, and ſayd:
label: 1 Machabees

text: They that were ſent by king Sennacherib, ô Lord, becauſe they blaſphemed thee, an angel came forth, and ſtroke of them an hundred eightie fiue thouſand:
label: 1 Machabees

text: ſo deſtroy this armie in our ſight to day, and let the reſt know that he hath ſpoken il vpon the holy places: and iudge thou him according to his malice.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the armies ioyned battel the thirtenth day of the moneth Adar: and the campe of Nicanor was diſcomfited, and himſelf was ſlaine firſt in the battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And as his armie ſaw that Nicanor was ſlaine, they threw away their weapons, & fled:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they purſewed them one dayes iorney from Adazer, euen til ye come into Gazara, and with trumpets they ſounded after them with ſignifications.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they went forth out of al the townes of Iurie round about, and they pushed them with the hornes, and they turned againe to them, and they were al ſlaine with the ſword, and there was not left of them ſo much as one.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they tooke the ſpoiles of them for a praye: and Nicanors head they cut of, and his right hand, which he had proudly ſtretched forth, and they brought it, and hung it vp againſt Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the people reioyced excedingly, and they ſpent that day in great gladnes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ordayned that this day should be kept euerie yeare the thirtenth of the moneth Adar.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the land of Iuda was quiet for a few dayes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: AND Iudas heard of the name of the Romanes, that they are mightie of power, and agree vnto al thinges that are requeſted of them: and whoſoeuer haue come vnto them, they haue made amitie with them, and that they are mightie of powre.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they heard of their battels, & goodlie acts, which they did in Galatia, that they ouercame them, and brought them vnder tribute:
label: 1 Machabees

text: & how great thinges they did in the countrie of Spaine, & that they brought into their powre the meralles of ſiluer and gold, that are there, and poſſeſſed euerie place by their counſel, & patience:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and deſtroyed the places that were very far of from them, & the kings that came vpon them from the ends of the earth, and ſtroke them with a greate plague: and the reſt geue them tribute euerie yeare.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Philip and Perſes the king of the Ceteans, and the reſt that had borne weapon againſt them, they diſcomfited in battel, and ouercame them:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and that Antiochus the great king of Aſia, who made battel againſt them, hauing an hundred and twentie elephants, & horſemen, & chariottes an armie exceeding great was diſcomfited by them:
label: 1 Machabees

text: & that they tooke him aliue, and appointed him, that himſelf and they that should reigne after him, should geue a great tribute, and he should geue hoſtages, and the thing appointed him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: and the region of the Indes, & the Medes, & the Lydians of their beſt countries: and the ſame being taken of them, they gaue to Eumenes the king.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And that they which were in Hellada, would haue gone to diſpatch them: and the word was knowen to them,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they ſent vnto them one captayne, and they fought againſt them, & manie of them were ſlaine, and they led away their wiues captiue, and their children, and ſpoiled them, and poſſeſſed their land, and deſtroyed their walles, and brought them into bondage euen vntil this day:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and the reſidue of kingdoms, and iles that ſome time had reſiſted them, they ſpoyled, and brought vnder their powre.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But with their freinds, and thoſe that reſted in them, they kept amitie, and obteyned the kingdoms, that were next, and that were far of: that whoſoeuer heard their name, feared them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But ſuch as they would helpe to reigne, thoſe reigned: and whom they would, they depoſed from the kingdom: and they were exalted excedingly.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And in al theſe none bare a crowne, nor was clothed with purple, to be magnified therin.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And that they made them ſelues a court, and conſulted dayly three hundred and twentie, that ſate in counſel alwayes for the multitude, that they might doe the thinges that were conuenient:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they committe their gouerment to one man euerie yeare to rule ouer al their land, & al they obey one, & there is no enuie, nor emulation amongſt them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas choſe Eupolemus the ſonne of Iohn, the ſonne of Iacob, and Iaſon the ſonne of Eleazar, & he ſent them to Rome to make amitie and ſocietie with them:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and that they should take from them the yoke of the Greeks, becauſe they ſaw that they preſſed the kingdom of Iſrael vnto bondage.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they went to Rome, a way exceeding great, and they entered into the court, and ſayd:
label: 1 Machabees

text: Iudas Machabeus, and his bretheren, and the people of the Iewes haue ſent vs vnto you to make ſocietie and peace with you, and to write vs your felowes and freindes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the word was liked in their ſight.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And this is the reſcript, that they wrote againe in tables of braſſe, and ſent into Ieruſalem, that it might be with them there a memorial of peace, & ſocietie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: BE IT WEL TO THE ROMANES, and to the nation of the Iewes by ſea, & by land for euer: and ſword and enemie be far from them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But and if warre be toward the Romanes firſt, or al their felowes in al their dominion:
label: 1 Machabees

text: the nation of the Iewes shal geue ayde, according as the time shal appoint, with ful hart:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and to them fighting, they shal not geue nor allow wheate, armour, money, shippes, as it hath pleaſed the Romanes: and they shal keepe their charge, taking nothing of them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: In like maner alſo and if warre shal happen firſt to the nation of the Iewes, the Romanes shal helpe with al their hart, according as the time shal permitte them:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and to them helping shal not be geuen wheate, armour, money, shippes, as it hath pleaſed the Romanes: and they shal keepe their charge without guile.
label: 1 Machabees

text: According to theſe wordes did the Romanes agree to the people of the Iewes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And if after theſe wordes theſe or they wil adde to theſe, or take away any thing, they shal doe it at their pleaſure: and whatſoeuer they shal adde, or take away, shal be ratified.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Yea and concerning the euils, that Demetrius the king hath done againſt them, we haue writen to him, ſaying: Why haſt thou aggrauated thy yoke vpon our freinds, and felowes the Iewes?
label: 1 Machabees

text: If therfore they come againe vnto vs againſt thee, we wil doe iudgement for them, and wil fight with thee by ſea and land.
label: 1 Machabees

text: IN the meane time as Demetrius heard that Nicanor was fallen and his armie in the battel, he added to ſend Bacchides and Alcimus againe into Iurie, and the right wing with them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they went the way, that leadeth into Galgal, and camped in Maſaloth, which is in Arbellis: and they wanne it, & ſlew of men manie ſoules.
label: 1 Machabees

text: In the firſt moneth of the yeare an hundreth and fiftie two they brought the armie nere to Ieruſalem:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they aroſe, and went into Beræa twentie thouſand men, and two thouſand horſemen.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas had camped in Laiſa, and three thouſand choſen men with him:
label: 1 Machabees

text: & they ſaw the multitude of the armie that they were manie, and they feared excedingly: and manie withdrew themſelues out of the campe, and there remayned of them but eight hundred men.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas ſaw that his armie shrunke away, and the battel preſſed vpon him, and his hart was broken: becauſe he had not time to gather them together, and he was diſcouraged.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſayd to them that were remayning: Let vs riſe, and goe to our aduerſaries, if we may be able to fight againſt them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they diſwaded him, ſaying: We are not able, but let vs ſaue our liues now, and returne to our brethren, and then we wil fight againſt them: and we are few.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas ſayd: God forbid we should doe this thing, to flee from them: and if our time be neere, let vs dye manfully for our bretheren, and let vs not ſtayne our glorie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the armie moued out of the campe, and they ſtood to meete them: and the horſemen were diuided into two parts, and the ſlingers, and the archers went before the armie, and of the foreward al mightie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Bacchides was in the right wing, and the legion approched on two ſides, and they ſounded with trumpets:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they alſo cried out that were on Iudas ſide, euen they alſo, and the earth was moued at the voice of the armies: and the battel was fought from morning euen vntil the euening.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas ſaw that the ſtronger part of the armie was on the right hand, & al the ſtout of hart came together with him:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and the right ſide was diſcomfited of them, and he purſewed them euen to the mount of Azotus.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they that were in the left wing, ſaw that the right wing was diſcomfited, and they folowed after Iudas, and them that were with him at the backe:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and the battel grew ſore, and there fel manie wounded of theſe and of them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Iudas was ſlaine, and the reſt fled.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas and Simon tooke Iudas their brother, and buried him in the ſepulcher of their fathers in the citie Modin.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al the people of Iſrael lamented him with great lamentation, and they mourned manie dayes,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and ſayd: How is the mightie fallen, that ſaued the people of Iſrael!
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the reſt of the wordes of Iudas battels, and of the valient acts that he did, and of his greatnes are not deſcribed: for they were exceding manie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And it came to paſſe: after the death of Iudas, there came forth the wicked men in al the coſts of Iſrael, and there aroſe al that wrought iniquitie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: In thoſe dayes was made an exceding great famine, and al their countrie with themſelues yelded to Bacchides.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Bacchides choſe the impious men, and appointed them lords of the countrie:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they ſought out, and ſearched for the freindes of Iudas, and brought them to Bacchides, and he tooke reuenge on them, & ſcorned them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there was made great tribulation in Iſrael, ſuch as was not ſince the day, that there was no prophete ſeene in Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al the freinds of Iudas gathered, and ſayd to Ionathas:
label: 1 Machabees

text: Since thy brother Iudas died, there is not a man like vnto him, to goe forth againſt the enemies, Bacchides, & them that are the enemies of our nation.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Now therfore thee haue we choſen this day to be for him our prince, and captayne to wage our battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas tooke vpon him at that time the princedom, and aroſe in the place of Iudas his brother.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Bacchides vnderſtood it, and ſought to kil him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas vnderſtood it, & Simon his brother, and al that were with them: and they fled into the deſert of Thecua, and they pitched by the water of the lake Aſphar.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Bacchides vnderſtood it, and in the day of the Sabbaths came him ſelf, and al his armie ouer Iordan.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas ſent his brother captayne of the people, to deſire the Nabutheians his freindes, that they would lend him their prouiſion, which was copious.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the children of Iambri iſſued forth of Madaba, and tooke Iohn, and al thinges that he had, and went away hauing them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: After theſe wordes, it was told Ionathas, and Simon his brother, that the children of Iambri make a great mariage, and bring the bride out of Madaba, the daughter of one of the great princes of Chanaan with great pompe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they remembred the bloud of Iohn their brother: and they went vp, and hid them ſelues vnder the couert of the mountayne.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they lifted vp their eyes, and ſaw: and loe a tumult, and great preparation: and the bridegrome came forth, and his freindes, and his bretheren to meete them with timbrils, and muſical inſtruments, and manie weapons.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they roſe vpon them out of the embushement, and ſlew them, and there fel manie wounded, & the reſt fled into the mountaines, and they tooke al the ſpoiles of them:
label: 1 Machabees

text: & the mariage was turned into mourning, and the voice of their muſical inſtruments into lamentation.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they tooke reuenge of the bloud of their brother: & they returned to the banke of Iordan.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Bacchides heard it, and he came on the day of the Sabbaths euen to the brinke of Iordan with a great powre.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas ſayd to his companie: Let vs ariſe, and fight againſt our enemies: for it is not to day as yeſterday, and the day before.
label: 1 Machabees

text: For loe battel directly againſt vs, and the water of Iordan on this ſide and on that ſide, & bankes, & marriſes, and foreſts: and there is no place to turne aſide.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Now therfore crie ye vnto heauen, that you may be deliuered out of the hand of your enemies. And battel was ioyned.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas ſtretched forth his hand to ſtrike Bacchides, and he turned aſide from him backwards.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas lept aſide, and they that were with him into Iordan, and they ſwame ouer Iordan to them:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and there fel of Bacchides part that day a thouſand men: and they returned into Ieruſalem,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and built fenſed cities in Iurie, the fortreſſe that was in Iericho, and in Ammaum, & in Bethoron, and in Bethel, and Thamnata, and Phara, and Thopo with high walles, and gates, and lockes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he placed a garriſon in them, that they might exerciſe emnities againſt Iſrael:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he fenſed the citie Bethſura, and Gazara, and the caſtel, and ſet gariſons in them, and prouiſion of victuals:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he tooke the ſonnes of the princes of the countrie for hoſtages, & put them in the caſtel in Ieruſalem into ward.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And in the yeare an hundred fiftie three, the ſecond moneth, Alcimus commanded the walles of the inner holie houſe to be deſtroyed, and the workes of the prophets to be deſtroyed: and he began to deſtroy.
label: 1 Machabees

text: In that time was Alcimus ſtrooken: and his workes were ſtayed, and his mouth was ſtopped, and he was diſſolued with the palſey, neither could he ſpeake a word any more, and geue commandement touching his houſe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Alcimus died at that time with great torment.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Bacchides ſaw that Alcimus was dead: and he returned to the king, and the land was quiet for two yeares.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al the wicked thought ſaying: Behold Ionathas, and they that are with him, dwel in ſilence ſecurely: now therfore let vs bring Bacchides, and he shal take them al in one night.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they went, and gaue him counſel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he aroſe to come with a great armie: and he ſent ſecretly epiſtles to his felowes that were in Iurie, to take Ionathas, and them that were with him: but they could not, becauſe their counſel was knowen to them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he apprehended of the men of the countrie, that were the principal of the miſchife, fiftie men, and he ſlew them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas retyred aſide, and Simon, and they that were with him into Bethbeſſen, which is in the deſert: and he built vp the ruins therof, and they fortified it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Bacchides vnderſtood it, and gathered together al his multitude: and ſent word to them that were of Iurie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he came, and camped aboue Bethbeſſen, and aſſaulted it manie dayes, and made engins.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas left Simon his brother in the citie, and went forth into the countrie, and came with a number,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and ſtroke Odares, and his bretheren, and the children of Phaſeron in their tabernacles, & he began to ſlay, and to grow in forces.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But Simon and they that were with him, went out of the citie, and burnt the engins,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they fought againſt Bacchides, and he was diſcomfited by them: and they afflicted him excedingly, becauſe his counſel, and his conflict was in vayne.
