label: 1 Machabees

text: And being angrie againſt the wicked men, that had geuen him counſel to come into their countrie, he ſlewe manie of them: but himſelf thought with the reſt to depart into their countrie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas vnderſtood it, and he ſent vnto him legates to make peace with him, and to render vnto him the captiues.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he tooke it gladly, and did according to his wordes, & ſware that he would doe him no harme al the dayes of his life.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he rendered vnto him the captiues, which he before had taken for a praye, out of the land of Iuda: and returning he departed into his owne countrie, and he added no more to come into their coaſts.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the ſword ceaſed out of Iſrael: and Ionathas dwelt in Machmas, & Ionathas began there to iudge the people, and he deſtroyed the impious out of Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: AND in the yeare an hundreth threeſcore came vp Alexander the ſonne of Antiochus, that was ſurnamed Noble: and he tooke Ptolemais, and they receiued him, and he reigned there.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Demetrius the king heard it, and he gathered together an exceding great armie, and went forth to meete him into battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Demetrius ſent an epiſtle to Ionathas in peaceable wordes, to magnifie him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: For he ſayd: Let vs preuent to make peace with him, before he make with Alexander againſt vs:
label: 1 Machabees

text: for he wil remember al the euils, that we haue done againſt him, and againſt his brother, and againſt his nation.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he gaue him authoritie to gather an armie, and to make weapons, and to be himſelf his felow: and the hoſtages that were in the caſtel, he commanded to be deliuered to him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas came into Ieruſalem, and read the epiſtles in the hearing of al the people, and of them that were in the caſtle.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they feared with great feare, becauſe they heard that the king gaue him authoritie to gather an armie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the hoſtages were deliuered to Ionathas, & he rendered them to their parents.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas dwelt in Ieruſalem, and began to build, and to renew the citie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſpake to them that made the workes, that they should build the walles, and mount Sion round about with ſquare ſtones for munition: and ſo they did.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the Aliens fled that were in the holdes, which Bacchides had built:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and euerie man left his place, and departed into his owne countrie:
label: 1 Machabees

text: onlie in Bethſura there remained ſome of them, that had forſaken the law, and the precepts of God: for this was for a refuge to them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Alexander the king heard of the promiſes, that Demetrius had promiſed to Ionathas: and they told him the battels, and the worthie acts that he did, and his bretheren, and the labours, that they endured:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he ſayd: Why, shal we find any ſuch man? and now we wil make him a freind, & our felow.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he wrote an epiſtle, & ſent it to him according to theſe wordes, ſaying:
label: 1 Machabees

text: KING Alexander to his brother Ionathas greeting.
label: 1 Machabees

text: We haue heard of thee, that thou art mightie of powre, and art meete to be our freind:
label: 1 Machabees

text: & now we make thee this day high prieſt of thy nation, that thou be called the kings freind (and he ſent him purple, and a crowne of gold) and in our affayres thou be of one minde with vs, and keepe amitie towards vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas put on him the holie ſtole the ſeuenth moneth, in the yeare an hundreth threeſcore in the ſolemne day of Scenopegia: and he gathered an armie, and made very manie weapons.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Demetrius heard theſe wordes, and was exceding ſorie, and ſayd:
label: 1 Machabees

text: What is this that we haue done, that Alexander hath preuented vs to take the frendshippe of the Iewes for his ſtrength?
label: 1 Machabees

text: I alſo wil write to them wordes of requeſt, and dignities, and gifts: that they may be with me to ayde me.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he wrote to them in theſe wordes: KING Demetrius to the nation of the Iewes greeting.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Becauſe you haue kept couenant towards vs, and haue continewed in our amitie, and haue not ioyned to our enemies, we haue heard of it, & are glad.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And now perſeuere ſtil to keepe fidelitie towards vs, & we wil reward you with good thinges, for that you haue done with vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And we wil remitte you manie charges, and wil geue you manie gifts.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And now I releaſe you, and al the Iewes from tributes, and I pardon you the prices of ſalt, and remitte the crownes, and the thirds of the ſeede:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and the halfe of the fruite of trees, which is my portion, I leaue to you from this day forward, that it be not taken of the land of Iuda, and of the three cities that are added therto of Samaria, and Galilee from this day and for euer:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and let Ieruſalem be holie, and free with the coaſts therof: and the tithes, & tributes be they to it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: I releaſe alſo the authoritie of the caſtel, that is in Ieruſalem, and I geue it to the high prieſt, to place therin men whomſoeuer he shal chooſe, that may keepe it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And euerie ſoule of the Iewes, that is captiue from the land of Iuda in al my kingdom, I diſmiſſe free for nothing, that al may be diſcharged alſo from tributes of their cattel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al the ſolemne dayes, and the ſabbaths, and the new moones, and the dayes appointed, and three dayes before the ſolemne day, and three dayes after the ſolemne day let them al be of immunitie and remiſſion, to al the Iewes that are in my kingdom:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and no man shal haue powre to do any thing, and to make buſineſſes againſt any of them in any cauſe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And let there be inrolled of the Iewes in the kinges armie to the number of thirtie thouſand men: and allowance ſhal be geuen them as behoueth to al the kings bands, and of them there shal be ordayned certaine, that shal be in the fortreſſes of the great king:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and of theſe there shal be appoynted ouer the affayres of the kingdom, that are done of truſt, and let there be princes of them, and let them walke in their owne lawes, as the king hath commanded in the land of Iuda.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the three cities that are added to Iurie of the countrie of Samaria, let them be accounted with Iurie: that they may be vnder one, and obey no other powre, but the high prieſtes:
label: 1 Machabees

text: Ptolomais, and the confines therof, which I haue geuen for a gift to the holies, that are in Ieruſalem, to the neceſſarie charges of the holie thinges.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And I geue euerie yeare fiftene thouſand ſicles of ſiluer of the kings accounts, that belong to me:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and al that is aboue which they had not rendred, that were ouer the affayres the yeares before, from this time they shal geue it to the workes of the houſe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And beſide theſe fiue thouſand ſicles of ſiluer, which they receiued of the account of the holies euerie yeare: and let theſe perteyne to the prieſts, that execute the miniſterie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And whoſoeuer flee into the temple that is in Ieruſalem, & in al the coaſts therof, in the kings danger for matter, let them be diſmiſſed, & al thinges, that they haue in my kingdom, let them haue it free.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And to build or repayre the workes of the holie places, the charges shal be geuen of the kings account:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and to build the walles in Ieruſalem, and to fortifie them round about, the charges shal be geuen of the kings account, and to build the walles in Iurie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But as Ionathas, and the people heard theſe wordes, they beleued them not, nor receiued them: becauſe they remembred the great miſchife, that he had done in Iſrael, and had afflicted them excedingly.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And their liking was toward Alexander, becauſe he had bene the firſt mouer of the wordes of peace vnto them, and him they ayded al dayes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And king Alexander gathered a great armie, and moued the campe nere to Demetrius.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the two kinges ioyned battel, and the armie of Demetrius fled, and Alexander purſewed him, and vrged them ſore.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the battel grew very ſore, til the ſunne went downe: and Demetrius was ſlaine in that day.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Alexander ſent legates to Ptolomee king of Ægypt according to theſe wordes, ſaying:
label: 1 Machabees

text: BECAVSE I am returned into my kingdom, and am ſet in the ſeate of my fathers, and haue obteyned the princedom, and haue deſtroyed Demetrius, and poſſeſſed our countrie,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and haue ioyned battel with him, and he is deſtroyed him ſelf, & his campe by vs, and we ſit in the ſeate of his kingdom:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and now let vs make amitie one with an other: and geue me thy daughter to wife, and I wil be thy ſonne in law, and I wil geue thee gifts, and to her, dignitie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And king Ptolomee anſwered, ſaying: HAPPIE is the day wherin thou art returned to the land of thy fathers, and art ſet in the ſeate of their kingdom.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And now I wil doe to thee that which thou haſt writen: but meete me at Ptolomais, that we may ſee one an other, and I may deſpouſe her to thee as thou haſt ſayd.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ptolomee went out of Ægypt, he and Cleopatra his daughter, and he came to Ptolomais in the yeare an hundred threeſcore and two.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Alexander the king mette him, and he gaue him Cleopatra his daughter: and he made her mariage at Ptolomais, as kinges in great glorie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And king Alexander wrote to Ionathas, that he ſhould come to meete him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he went with glorie to Ptolomais, and he mette there the two kinges, and he gaue them much ſiluer, and gold, and gifts: and he found grace in their ſight.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there aſſembled againſt him peſtilent men of Iſrael, wicked men ſoliciting againſt him: and the king attended not to them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he commanded Ionathas to be changed of his garments, and that he should be clothed with purple: and ſo they did. And the king placed him to ſit with him ſelf.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſayd to his princes: Goe ye out with him into the middes of the citie, & proclame, that no man ſolicite againſt him for any matter, and that no man be trubleſome vnto him for any cauſe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And it came to paſſe, as they that ſolicited, ſaw his glorie that was published, & him couered with purple, they al fled:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and the king magnified him, and wrote him amongſt his chiefe freindes, and made him Duke, and partaker of the princedom.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas returned into Ieruſalem with peace, and ioy.
label: 1 Machabees

text: In the yeare an hundreth ſixtie fiue came Demetrius the ſonne of Denetrius from Crete into the land of his fathers.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Alexander the king heard it, and he was verie ſorie, and returned to Antioche.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Demetrius the king made Apollonius general, who was ruler of Cœleſiria: & he gathered a great armie, & came to Iamnia: and he ſent to Ionathas the high prieſt,
label: 1 Machabees

text: ſaying: Thou onlie reſiſteſt vs, and I am brought into deriſion, and into reproch, becauſe thou doeſt exerciſe powre againſt vs in the mountains.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Now therfore if thou truſt in thy forces, come downe to vs into the plaine, let vs compare there one with an other: becauſe with me is the force of battels.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Aske, and learne who I am, and the reſt, that ayde me, who alſo ſay that your foote can not ſtand before our face, becauſe twiſe haue thy fathers bene put to flight in their owne land:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and now how wilt thou be able to abide the horſemen, & ſo great an armie in the plaine, where is no ſtone, nor rocke, nor place to flee?
label: 1 Machabees

text: But as Ionathas heard the wordes of Apollonius, he was moued in minde: and he choſe tenne thouſand men, and went forth from Ieruſalem, & Simon his brother mette him to ayde him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they moued the campe to Ioppe, and it shut him out of the citie: becauſe the gariſon of Apollonius was in Ioppe, and he aſſaulted it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they that were in the citie being put in great feare, opened to him, and Ionathas obteyned Ioppe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Apollonius heard it, & he tooke three thouſand horſemen, and a great armie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he went to Azotus as making iorney, and immediatly he went forth into the plaine: becauſe he had a multitude of horſemen, and he truſted in them. And Ionathas purſewed him vnto Azotus, and they ioyned battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Apollonius left in the campe a thouſand horſemen behinde them ſecretly.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas vnderſtood that there was an embushement behind him, and they compaſſed his campe, and they threw dartes vpon the people from morning euen vnto euening.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But the people ſtood, as Ionathas had commanded: and their horſes laboured.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon put forth his armie, and ioyned it againſt the legion: for the horſemen were wearied: and they were diſcomfited by him, and fled.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they that were ſcattered by the playne, fled into Azotus, and entered into Bethdagon their idol houſe, there to ſaue them ſelues.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas burnt Azotus, and the cities that were round about it, and he tooke the ſpoiles of them, and the temple of Dagon: and al that fled into it, he burnt with fire.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there were that were ſlayne by the ſword, with theſe that were burnt, almoſt eight thouſand men.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas remoued the campe from thence, and brought it to Aſcalon: and they went out of the citie to meete him in great glorie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas returned into Ieruſalem with his companie, hauing manie ſpoiles.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And it came to paſſe: as Alexander the king heard theſe wordes, he added yet to glorifie Ionathas.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſent him a cheyne of gold, as the cuſtome is to be geuen to the coſins of kings. And he gaue him Accaron and al the borders therof in poſſeſſion.
label: 1 Machabees

text: AND the king of Egypt gathered an armie, as the ſand that is about the ſea shore, and manie shippes: and he ſought to winne the kingdom of Alexander by guile, and to adde it to his owne kingdom.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he went out into Syria with peaceable wordes, and they opened to him the cities, and mette him: becauſe Alexander the king had commanded them to goe forth to meete him, for that he was his father in law.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But when Ptolomee entered the cities, he put garriſons of ſouldiars in euerie citie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And as he approched to Azotus, they shewed him the temple of dagon burnt with fyre, and Azotus, and the reſt therof throwen downe, and the bodies caſt forth, and the graues of them that were ſlaine in the battel, which they had made neere the way.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they told the king that Ionathas did theſe thinges: to raiſe enuie againſt him: and the king held his peace.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas came to meete the king into Ioppe with glorie, and they ſaluted one an other, and they ſlept there.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas went with the king euen to the riuer, that was called Eleutherus: and he returned into Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And king Ptolomee obteyned the dominion of the cities euen to Seleucia by the ſea ſide, and he purpoſed euil purpoſes againſt Alexander.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And ſent legates to Demetrius, ſaying: Come, let vs make a league betwen vs, and I wil geue thee my daughter that Alexander hath, & thou shalt reigne in the kingdom of thy father.
label: 1 Machabees

text: For it repenteth me that I haue geuen him my daughter: for he hath ſought to kil me.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he diſpraſed him, for that he coueted his kingdom,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he tooke away his daughter, & gaue her to Demetrius, and alienated him ſelf from Alexander, and his emnities were made manifeſt.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ptolomee entered into Antioch, & he put two crownes vpon his head, of Egypt, & of Aſia.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But Alexander the king was in Cilicia at that time: becauſe they rebelled that were in thoſe places.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Alexander heard it, and came to him into battel: and Ptolomee the king brought forth an armie, and mette him with a ſtrong power, and put him to flight.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Alexander fled into Arabia, there to be protected: and king Ptolomee was exalted.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Zabdiel an Arabian tooke of Alexanders head, & ſent it to Ptolomee.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And king Ptolomee died the third day: and they that were in the fortreſſes, perished by them that were within the campe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Demetrius reigned the yeare an hundreth ſixtie ſeuen.
label: 1 Machabees

text: In thoſe dayes Ionathas gathered together them, that were in Iurie, to winne the caſtel in Ieruſalem: and they made engins againſt it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And certaine that hated their owne nation wicked men, went to king Demetrius, and told him that Ionathas beſieged the caſtel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And as he heard it, he was wrath: and forthwith he came to Ptolemais, and wrote to Ionathas, that he should not beſiege the caſtel, but should meete him to talke together in haſt.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But as Ionathas heard it, he bade them beſiege it: and he choſe of the ancients of Iſrael, and of the prieſts, and put himſelf in hazard.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he tooke gold, and ſiluer and rayments, and manie other preſents, and went to the king to Ptolomais, and he found grace in his ſight.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And certaine wicked men of his nation ſolicited againſt him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king did to him, as they had done to him which had bene before him: and he exalted him in the ſight of al his freinds,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he eſtablished to him the chiefe prieſthood, and whatſoeuer other thinges he had before precious, and he made him the chiefe of his freindes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas requeſted of the king that he would make Iurie free, and the three toparchies, & Samaria, & the confines therof: and he promiſed him three hundred talents.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king conſented: and he wrote to Ionathas epiſtles of al theſe thinges, conteyning this tenure.
label: 1 Machabees

text: KING Demetrius to his brother Ionathas greeting, & to the nation of the Iewes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: A copie of the epiſtle, which we haue writen to Laſthenes our parent concerning you, we haue ſent to you that you might know it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: KING Demetrius to Laſthenes his parent greeting.
label: 1 Machabees

text: We haue determined to do good to the nation of the Iewes our freinds, & that keepe the thinges that are iuſt with vs, for their gentlenes which they beare towards vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: We haue ordayned therfore vnto them al the coaſts of Iurie, & the three cities, Apherema, Lyda, & Ramatha, which are added to Iurie of Samaria, & al their confines, to be ſequeſtred to al them that ſacrifice in Ieruſalem, for theſe thinges, which the king receiued of them euerie yeare, and for the fruits of the land, and of the trees.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And other thinges, that perteined to vs of the tithes, and of the tributes, from this time we remitte to them: and the ſalt floores, and the crownes, that were preſented to vs,
label: 1 Machabees

text: we grant al to them, and nothing of theſe shal be broken from this time, and for euer.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Now therfore prouide to make a copie of theſe, and let it be geuen to Ionathas, and let it be layd in the holie mount, and in a ſolemne place.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Demetrius the king ſeing that the land was quiet in his ſight, and nothing reſiſted him, he diſmiſſed al his armie, euerie man to his place, except the forren armie, which he brought from the iles of the Gentils: and al the bandes of his fathers were enemies to him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there was one Tryphon of Alexanders part before: and he ſaw that al the armie murmured againſt Demetrius, & he went to Emalchuel the Arabian, that brought vp Antiochus the ſonne of Alexander:
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he lay vpon him, to deliuer this Antiochus vnto him, to reigne in his fathers place: and he declared vnto him what great thinges Demetrius did, & the emnities of his hoſts againſt him. And he taried there manie dayes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas ſent to Demetrius the king, that he would caſt out them, that were in the caſtel in Ieruſalem, and that were in the holdes: becauſe they impugned Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Demetrius ſent to Ionathas, ſaying: I wil not onlie doe theſe thinges for thee, and for thy nation, but with glorie I wil honour thee, and thy nation, when it shal be time conuenient.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Now therfore thou shalt doe wel if thou wilt ſend men to helpe me: becauſe al mine armie is departed.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas ſent him three thouſand valient men to Antioch: and they came to the king, and the king was delighted at their coming.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there aſſembled they that were of the citie, an hundred twentie thouſand men, and they would haue ſlaine the king.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king fled into the court: and they that were of the citie kept the wayes of the citie, and began to fight.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king called the Iewes for ayde: and they came together to him al at once, and they were al diſperſed through the citie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they ſlew in that day an hundred thouſand men, and they burnt the citie, and tooke manie ſpoiles in that day, and deliuered the king.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they that were of the citie ſaw, that the Iewes had obteyned the citie as they would: and they were diſcomfited in their minde, and cried to the king with petitions, ſaying:
label: 1 Machabees

text: Geue vs the right hand, and let the Iewes ceaſe to oppugne vs, and the citie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they threw away their weapons, & made peace, and the Iewes were glorified in the kings ſight, & were renowmed in the ſight of al that were in his kingdom, & returned into Ieruſalem with manie ſpoiles.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And king Demetrius ſate in the ſeat of his kingdom: & the land was at reſt in his ſight.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he feaned al thinges whatſoeuer he ſayd, and alienated himſelf from Ionathas, and he requited him not according to the benefites, that he had geuen him, and he vexed him excedingly.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And after theſe thinges Tryphon returned, and with him Antiochus the yong boy, who reigned, and put the crowne vpon him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there gathered vnto him al the bandes, which Demetrius had diſperſed, and they fought agaynſt him: and he fled, and turned the backe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Tryphon tooke the beaſtes, and wanne Antioch.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Antiochus the yong man wrote to Ionathas, ſaying: I appoynt to thee the prieſthood, and I place thee ouer the foure cities, that thou mayſt be of the kings freinds.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſent him veſſels of gold for his ſeruice, and he gaue him leaue to drinke in gold, and to be in purple, and to haue a cheyne of gold: .
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he appointed Simon his brother gouerner from the borders of Tyre euen to the coaſts of Ægypt.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas went forth, and walked through the cities beyond the riuer: and al the band of Syria gathered vnto him to helpe him, and he came to Aſcalon, & they mette him honorably out of the citie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he went from thence to Gaza: and they that were in Gaza, shut in them ſelues: and he beſieged it, & burnt the thinges that were round about the citie, and he ſpoiled it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the men of Gaza beſought Ionathas, and he gaue them the right hand: and he tooke their ſonnes for hoſtages, and ſent them into Ieruſalem: and he walked through the countrie euen to Damaſcus.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas heard that the princes of Demetrius preuaricated in Cades, which is in Galilee, with a great armie meaning to remoue him from the affayres of the kingdom:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he went againſt them: but his brother Simon he left within the prouince.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon approched to Bethſura, and expugned it manie dayes, and incloſed them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they requeſted of him to take the right handes, and he gaue it them: and he caſt them out from thence, and tooke the citie, and placed therin a garriſon.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas, and his campe approched to the water of Geneſar, and before it was light they watched in the plaine Aſor.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And loe the campe of the aliens mette him in the playne, & they layd embushments for him in the mountaines: but he went againſt them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the embushments roſe out of their places, and they ioyned battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al fled that were on Ionathas part, and none was left of them, but Mathathias the ſonne of Abſolom, and Iudas the ſonne of Calphi, chiefe captayne of the chiualrie of the hoſt.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas rent his garments, and put earth vpon his head, and prayed.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas returned to them into battel, & he put them to flight, and they fought.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they of his part that fled, ſaw, and returned to him, and Purſewed with him euen to Cades to their campe, and they came euen thither.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And there fel of the aliens in that day three thouſand men: and Ionathas returned into Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Machabees

text: AND Ionathas ſaw that the time helped him, he choſe men and ſent them to Rome, to eſtablish and to renew amitie with them:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and to the Spartiats, and to other places he ſent epiſtles according to the ſame tenure.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they went to Rome, and entered into the court, and ſayd: Ionathas the hight prieſt, and the nation of the Iewes haue ſent vs to renew the amitie, and ſocietie according as before.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they gaue them epiſtles vnto them by place and place, to conduct them into the land of Iuda with peace.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And this is a copie of the epiſtles which Ionathas wrote to the Spartiats:
label: 1 Machabees

text: IONATHAS the high prieſt, and the ancients of the nation, and the prieſts, and the reſt of the people of the Iewes, to the Spartiats their bretheren greeting.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Long agoe were epiſtles ſent to Onias the high prieſt from Arius who reigned with you, that you are our bretheren, as the writing conteyneth, that here beneath foloweth.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Onias receiued the man, that was ſent, with honour: and he receiued the epiſtles, where in there was ſignification of the ſocietie, and amitie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: We wheras we neded none of theſe hauing for our comfort the holie bookes, that are in our handes,
label: 1 Machabees

text: choſe rather to ſend vnto you to renew the fraternitie, leſt perhaps we be made aliens from you: for much time is paſſed, ſince you ſent to vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: We therfore at al time without intermiſſion in the ſolenne dayes, and the reſt where in we should, are mindful of you in the ſacrifices, that we offer, and in the obſeruances, as it is meete, and becometh to remember bretheren.
label: 1 Machabees

text: We reioyce therfore of your glorie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But manie tribulations haue compaſſed vs, and manie battels, and the kinges that are round about vs, haue impugned vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: We therfore would not be trubleſome to you, nor to the reſt our felowes and freindes in theſe battels.
label: 1 Machabees

text: For we haue had ayde from heauen, and we are deliuered, and our enemies are humbled.
label: 1 Machabees

text: We haue choſen therfore Numenius the ſonne of Antiochus, and Autipater the ſonne of Iaſon, and haue ſent to the Romanes to renew with them the old amitie and ſocietie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: We therfore haue commanded them that they come vnto you alſo, & ſalute you, and deliuer you our epiſtles, concerning the renewing of our fraternitie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And now you shal doe wel in anſwering vs to theſe thinges.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And this is the reſcript of the epiſtles, which he had ſent to Onias:
label: 1 Machabees

text: ARIVS the king of the Spartians to Onias the grandprieſt greeting.
label: 1 Machabees

text: It is found in ſcripture of the Spartians, and the Iewes that they are bretheren, & that they are of the ſtocke of Abraham.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And now ſince we vnderſtood theſe thinges, you doe wel in writing to vs of your peace.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Yea and we haue writen agayne to you, Our cattel, & our poſſeſſions, are yours: and yours, ours. We therfore haue commanded that theſe thinges be told you.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas heard that the princes of Demetrius were come agayne with a great armie more then before to fight againſt him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he went out from Ieruſalem, aud mette them in the countrie of Amathis: for he gaue them not ſpace to enter into his countrie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſent ſpies into their campe, & they returning reported that they appointed to come vpon them in the night.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And when the ſunne was ſet, Ionathas cammanded his men to watch, and to be in armour readie to fight al night, & he ſet watchmen round about the campe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the aduerſaries heard that Ionathas with his companie was prepared to battel: & they feared, and were afrayd in their hart: and they kindled fyres in their campe.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But Ionathas, and they that were with him, knew it not til the morning: and they ſaw light burning,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and Ionathas folowed them, and ouertooke them not: for they had paſſed the riuer Eleutherus.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas turned aſide to the Arabians, that were called Zabadeans: and he ſtroke them, and tooke the ſpoiles of them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ioyned, and came to Damaſcus, and walked through al that countrie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But Simon went forth, and came euen to Aſcalon, and to the next holdes, and he declined into Ioppe, and tooke it. (
label: 1 Machabees

text: For he heard that they would deliuer the hold to Demetrius part) and he put a garriſon there to keepe it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas returned, & called together the ancients of the people, and he conſulted with them to build fortreſſes in Iurie,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and to build the walles in Ieruſalem, and to reare a mount of a great height betwen the caſtel and the citie, to ſeparate it from the citie, that it might be alone, and they might neither bye nor ſel:
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they came together to build the citie: and the wal fel that was vpon the torrent toward the riſing of the ſunne, and he repayred it, which is called Caphetetha:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and Simon built Adiada in Sephela, and fortified it, & hanged on gates aud lockes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And when Tryphon had purpoſed to reigne ouer Aſia, and to take the crowne, & to extend his hand againſt Antiochus the king:
label: 1 Machabees

text: fearing leſt perhaps Ionathas would not permit him, but would fight againſt him: he ſought to take him: & to kil him. And riſing vp he went into Bethſan.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas went forth to meete him with fourtie thouſand choſen men into battel, and came to Bethſan.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Tryphon ſaw that Ionathas came with a great armie, to extend his handes vpon him: and he feared:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and receiued him with honour, and commended him to al his freindes, and gaue him gifts: and he commanded his hoſts to obey him, as him ſelf.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſayd to Ionathas: Why haſt thou trubled al the people: wheras we haue no warre?
label: 1 Machabees

text: And now ſend them backe to their houſes, but chooſe thee a few men, that may be with thee, and come with me to Ptolemais, and I wil deliuer it to thee, and the other holdes, and the armie, and al the ouerſeers of the affayres, and returning I wil depart: for therfore I came.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas beleued him, and did as he ſayd: and diſmiſſed his armie, and they departed into the land of Iuda:
label: 1 Machabees

text: but he reteyned with him three thouſand men: of whom he ſent backe two thouſand into Galilee, and a thouſand came with him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But as Ionathas entered into Ptolemais, they of Ptolemais shut the gates of the citie: and they tooke him, and al that had entered with him they ſlew with the ſword.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Tryphon ſent an armie and horſemen into Galilee, and into the great playne to deſtroy al Ionathas felowes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But they when they vnderſtood that Ionathas was taken, and was perished, and al that were with him, they encouraged them ſelues, & went forth readie to battel.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And theſe that had purſewed, ſeing that the matter ſtood vpon their life, they returned.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But they came al with peace into the land of Iuda. And they lamented Ionathas, and them that were with him excedingly: and Iſrael mourned with great mourning.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al the heathen that were round about them, ſought to deſtroy them. for they ſayd:
label: 1 Machabees

text: They haue no prince, and helper: now therfore let vs expugne them, and take away from men the memorie of them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: AND Simon heard that Tryphon gathered a very great armie, to come into the land of Iuda, and to deſtroy it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Seing that the people was in dread, and in feare, he went vp to Iuruſalem, and aſſembled the people:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and exhorting he ſayd: You know what great battels I and my bretheren, and the houſe of my father, haue made for the lawes, & the holies, and the diſtreſſes that we haue ſene:
label: 1 Machabees

text: by reaſon of theſe are al my bretheren perished for Iſrael, and I onlie am left.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And now let it not fal to me to ſpare my life in al time of tribulation: for I am not better then my bretheren.
label: 1 Machabees

text: I wil auenge therfore my nation and the holies, our children alſo, & wiues: becauſe al the heathen are gathered together to deſtroy vs of emnitie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the ſpirit of the people was kindled as ſoone as they heard theſe wordes:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they anſwered with a lowd voice, ſaying: Thou art our captayne in the place of Iudas, and Ionathas thy brother:
label: 1 Machabees

text: fight thou our battel, & we wil doe al thinges whatſoeuer thou shalt ſay to vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And gathering together al the men of warre, he haſtened to finish al the walles of Ieruſalem, and fortified it round about.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſent Ionathas the ſonne of Abſalom, & with him a new armie into Ioppe, and they that were in the caſtel being caſt out, he remayned there.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Tryphon remoued from Ptolemais with a great armie, to come into the land of Iuda, & Ionathas with him in ward.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But Simon pitched in Addus againſt the face of the playne.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And as Tryphon vnderſtood that Simon was riſen in the place of his brother Ionathas: and that he would ioyne battel with him, he ſent legats to him,
label: 1 Machabees

text: ſaying: For the ſiluer, that thy brother Ionathas owed in the kings account, for the affayres which he had, we haue ſtayed him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And now ſend an hundred talents of ſiluer, and his two ſonnes for hoſtages, that being diſmiſſed he flee not from vs, and we wil releaſe him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon knew that with guile he ſpake with him, neuertheles he commanded the ſiluer, and the children to be geuen: leſt he should get great emnitie with the people of Iſrael, ſaying:
label: 1 Machabees

text: Becauſe he ſent not the ſiluer, & the children, therfore is he perished.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſent the children, and the hundred talents: and he lyed, and diſmiſſed not Ionathas.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And after theſe thinges came Tryphon within the countrie, to deſtroy it, and they compaſſed by the way that leadeth to Addar, & Simon, and his campe marched into euerie place whither ſoeuer they went.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they that were in the caſtel, ſent legates to Tryphon, that he should haſten to come through the deſert, and should ſend them victuals.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Tryphon prepared al the horſemen, to come that night: but there was an exceding great ſnow, and he came not into the countrie of Galaad.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And when he had approched to Baſcama, he ſlew Ionathas and his ſonnes there.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Tryphon returned, & went into his countrie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon ſent, and tooke the bones of Ionathas his brother, and buried them in Modin the citie of his fathers.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al Iſrael lamented him with great lamentation: & they mourned for him manie dayes,
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon built ouer the ſepulcher of his father and of his bretheren, a building high to behold, of ſtone polished behind and before:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he erected ſeuen ſpyres one againſt one, to his father and mother, and to his foure bretheren:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and about theſe he ſet great pillers: and vpon the pillers armour for an eternal memorie: and by the armour shippes grauen, which might be ſene of al that ſayled the ſea.
label: 1 Machabees

text: This is the ſepulcher, that he made in Modin euen vntil this day.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But Tryphon when he iourneyed with Antiochus the king being but a yong man, by guile he ſlew him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he reigned in his place, and put the crowne of Aſia vpon him ſelf, and made a great plague in the land.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon built the fortreſſes of Iurie, fortifying them with high towres, and great walles, and gates, and lockes: and he put victuals in the fortreſſes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon choſe men & ſent to Demetrius the king, that he would make a releaſe to the countrie: becauſe al Tryphons actes had bene done by ſpoile.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Demetrius the king according to theſe wordes anſwered him, and wrote an epiſtle in this maner:
label: 1 Machabees

text: KING demetrius to Simon the high prieſt, and the freind of kinges, and to the ancients, and to the nation of the Iewes, greeting.
label: 1 Machabees

text: The crowne of gold, and the bahem, which you ſent, we haue receiued: and we are readie to make with you great peace, and to write to the kings chiefe officers to releaſe you the thinges that we haue releaſed.
label: 1 Machabees

text: For what ſoeuer thinges we haue decreed vnto you, ſtand in force. The holdes that you haue built, let them be to you.
label: 1 Machabees

text: We remitte alſo the ignorances, and offences euen vntil this day, and the crowne which you owed: and if any other thing was tributarie in Ieruſalem, now let it not be tributarie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And if anie of you be fitte to be inrolled among ours, let them be inrolled, and let there be peace betwen vs.
label: 1 Machabees

text: In the yeare an hundreth ſeuentie was the yoke of the Gentils taken away from Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the people of Iſrael began to write in the tables, and publique inſtruments. The firſt yeare vnder Simon the high prieſt, the great duke, and the prince of the Iewes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: In theſe dayes Simon approched to Gaza, and compaſſed it with campes, and he made engins, & ſet them to the citie, and he ſtroke one towre, and tooke it.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they that were within the engin, brake out into the citie: and there was made a great ſturre in the citie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they that were in the citie went vp with their wiues, & children vpon the wal their coates rent, and they cried with a lowd voice, deſyring of Simon that the right handes might be geuen them,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they ſayd: Requite vs not according to our malices, but occording to thy mercies.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon yelding deſtroyed them not: but yet he caſt them out of the citie, and clenſed the houſes, wherein there had bene idols, and then he entered into it with hymes bleſſing our Lord:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and al filthines being caſt out of it, he placed in it men that should doe the law: and he fortified it, and made it his habitation.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But they that were in the caſtel of Ieruſalem, were prohibited to goe out and to come in to the countrie, & to bye, and ſel: and they were exceding hungrie, and manie of them perished for famine,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they cried to Simon to receiue the right handes, and he gaue it them: and he caſt them out from thence, and clenſed the caſtel from the contaminations:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they entered into it the three and twentith day of the ſecond moneth, the yeare an hundreth ſeuentie one, with prayſe, and boughes of palme trees, and harpes, and cymbals, & nables, and hymnes, and canticles, becauſe the great enemie was deſtroyed out of Iſrael.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ordayned that euerie yeare theſe dayes should be kept with gladnes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he fortified the mount of the temple, that was by the caſtel, and he dwelt there him ſelf, and they that were with him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon ſaw Iohn his ſonne, that he was a valient man of warre: & he made him captayne of al the hoſts: and he dwelt in Gazara.
label: 1 Machabees

text: IN THE yeare an hundreth ſeuentie two, king Demetrius gathered his armie, and went into Media to get him aydes to expugne Tryphon.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Arſaces the king of Perſia, and Media heard, that Demetrius was entered his confines, and he ſent one of his princes to take him aliue.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he went, and ſtroke the campe of Demetrius: and tooke him, and brought him to Arſaces, and he put him into ward.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al the land of Iuda was at reſt al the dayes of Simon, and he ſought good to his nation: and his powre, and his glorie pleaſed them al dayes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And with al his glorie he tooke Ioppe for an hauen, and made it an entrance vnto the iles of the ſea.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he enlarged the borders of his nation, and obteyned the countrie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he gathered a great captiuitie, and had the dominion of Gazara, and of Bethſura, and of the caſtle: and tooke away the vncleanes out of it, and there was none that reſiſted him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And euerie man tilled his land with peace: & the land of Iuda yelded her fruites, and the trees of the fildes their fruit.
label: 1 Machabees

text: The ancients ſafe al in the ſtreetes, and treated of the good thinges of the land, & the yongmen did on them glorie, and the ſtoles of warre.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he gaue victuals to the cities, and he appointed them that they should be veſſels of munition, til the name of his glorie was renowmed euen to the end of the earth.
label: 1 Machabees

text: He made peace vpon the land, & Iſrael reioyced with great ioy.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And euerie man ſate vnder his vine, and vnder his figtree: and there was none to make them afrayd.
label: 1 Machabees

text: There was none left that impugned them vpon the earth: kinges were diſcomfited in thoſe dayes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he confirmed al the humble of his people, and ſought the law, and tooke away euerie wicked and euil man:
label: 1 Machabees

text: he glorified the holies, and multiplied the veſſels of the holie places.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And it was heard at Rome that Ionathas was dead, and euen vnto the Spartiats: and they were very ſorie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But as they heard that Simon his brother was made the high prieſt in his place, and he obteyned al the countrie, and the cities therein;
label: 1 Machabees

text: they wrote to him in braſen tables, to renew the amities and ſocietie, which they had made with Iudas, & with Ionathas his bretheren.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they were read in the ſight of the church in Ieruſalem. And this is a copie of the epiſtles, that the Spartiates ſent.
label: 1 Machabees

text: THE PRINCES and the cities of the Spartians to Simon the grand prieſt, and to the ancients, and the prieſts, and the reſt of the people of the Iewes their bretheren, greeting.
label: 1 Machabees

text: The legates, that were ſent to our people, haue told vs of your glorie, and honour, and ioy: and we reioyced at their entrance.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And we wrote that, which was ſayd of them in the counſels of the people, thus: Numenius the ſonne of Antiochus, and Antipater the ſonne of Iaſon legates of the Iewes, came to vs, renewing with vs old amitie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And it pleaſed the people to receiue the men gloriouſly, and to put a copie of their wordes in the ſeuered booke of the people, to be for a memorie to the people of the Spartiats. And a copie of theſe we haue writen to Simon the grand prieſt.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And after theſe thinges Simon ſent Numenius to Rome, hauing a great buckler of gold, of the weight of thouſand poundes, to eſtablish amitie with them. But when the people of Rome had heard
label: 1 Machabees

text: theſe wordes, they ſayd: What thankes geuing shal we render to Simon, and his children?
label: 1 Machabees

text: For he hath reſtored his bretheren, and hath expugned the enemies of Iſrael from them: & they decreed him libertie, and regiſtred it in tables of braſſe, and put it in titles in mount Sion.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And this is a copie of the writing. THE EIGHTENTH day of the moneth Elul, in the yeare an hundreth ſeuentie two, the third yeare vnder Simon the grand prieſt in Aſaramel,
label: 1 Machabees

text: in a great aſſemblie of the prieſts, & of the people and the princes of the nation, and the ancients of the countrie, theſe thinges were notified: that there haue often bene battels made in our countrie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But Simon the ſonne of Mathathias of the children of Iarib, and his bretheren put themſelues in danger, and reſiſted the aduerſaries of their nation, that their holies, and law might ſtand: & with great glorie haue they glorified their nation.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ionathas gathered together his nation, and was made their grand prieſt, and he was layd to his people.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And their enemies would conculcate, and deſtroy their countrie, and extend their handes againſt the holies.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Then Simon, reſiſted and fought for his nation, and beſtowed much money, and armed the valient men of his nation, & gaue them wages:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he fortified the cities of Iurie, and Bethſura, that was in the borders of Iurie, where the armour of the enimies was before: and he placed there Iewes for a garriſon.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he fortified Ioppe, which was by the ſea: and Gazara, which is in the borders of Azotus, wherin the enemies dwelt before, and he placed Iewes there: and whatſoeuer was fitte for their correption, he put in them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the people ſaw the fact of Simon, and the glorie that he meant to doe to his nation, & they made him their duke, and grand prieſt, for that he had done al theſe thinges, and for the iuſtice, and fayth, which he kept to his nation, & for that he ſought by al meanes to aduance his people.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And in his dayes it proſpered in his hands, ſo that the heathen were taken away out of their countrie, and they that were in the citie of of Dauid in Ieruſalem in the caſtel, out of which they came forth, and contaminated al thinges that were round about the holies, & they brought great plague vpon chaſtitie:
label: 1 Machabees

text: & he placed in it men of Iurie to the defence of the countrie, & of the citie, & he rayſed the walles of Ieruſalem.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And king Demetrius appointed him the high prieſthood.
label: 1 Machabees

text: According to theſe thinges he made him his freind, and glorified him with great glorie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: For he heard that the Iewes were called of the Romanes, freinds, and felowes, and bretheren, and that they receiued Simons legates gloriouſly:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and that the Iewes, and their prieſts conſented that he should be their duke, and high prieſt for euer, til there riſe the faithful prophete:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and that he be duke ouer them, and that he should haue the care of the holies, and that he should appoint rulers ouer their workes, and ouer the countrie, and ouer the armour, and ouer the holdes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And that he haue care of the holies: and that he be heard of al, and that al writinges in the countrie be writen in his name: and that he be clothed with purple, and gold:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and that it be not lawful for any of the people, and of the prieſts to diſanul anie of theſe, and to gainſay thoſe thinges, that are ſayd of him, or to cal together an aſſemblie in the countrie without him: and to be clothed with purple, and to weare a cheyne of gold.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But he that shal doe beſide theſe thinges, or shal make fruſtrate any of theſe he shal be guiltie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And it pleaſed al the people to appoiut Simon, and to doe according to theſe wordes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon tooke it vpon him, and it pleaſed him to execute high prieſthood, and to be duke, and prince of the nation of the Iewes, and of the prieſts, and to be chiefe ouer al.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And this writing they bad them put in tables of braſſe, and to ſet them in the circuite of the holies, in a famous place:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and to put a copie therof in the treaſurie, that Simon may haue it, and his children.
label: 1 Machabees

text: AND king Antiochus the ſonne of Demetrius ſent epiſtles from the iles of the ſea to Simon the prieſt, and prince of the nation of the Iewes, and to al the nation:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and they conteyned this tenure: KING Antiochus to Simon the grand prieſt, and to the nation of the Iewes greeting.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Becauſe certaine peſtilent men haue obteyned the kingdom of our fathers, and I meane to challenge the kingdom, and to reſtore it as it was before: and I haue choſen a great armie, & haue made shippes of warre.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And I wil march through the countrie, that I may take reuenge of them, that haue deſtroyed our countrie, and that haue made manie cities deſolate in my realme.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Now therfore I eſtablish vnto thee al the oblations, which al the kinges before me remitted vnto thee, and what other gifts ſoeuer they remitted thee:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and I permitte thee to make a coyne of thy owne money in thy countrie:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and Ieruſalem to be holie and free, and al the armour that is made, and the fortreſſes which thou haſt built, and which thou doſt hold, let them remayne to thee.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And al that is dew to the king, and the thinges that are to be the kings hereafter, from this preſent and for al time, they are remitted to thee.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And when we shal haue obteyned our kingdom, we wil glorifie thee, and thy nation, and the temple with great glorie, ſo that your glorie shal be made manifeſt in al the earth.
label: 1 Machabees

text: In the yeare an hundreth ſeuentie foure went forth Antiochus into the land of his fathers, and al the hoſts aſſembled vnto him, ſo that there were few left with Tryphon.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Antiochus the king purſewed him, and he came to Dora flying by the ſeacoſt.
label: 1 Machabees

text: For he knew that euils were heaped vpon him, and the armie forſooke him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Antiochus camped vpon Dora with an hundred twentie thouſand men of warre, and eight thouſand horſemen:
label: 1 Machabees

text: and he compaſſed the citie, and the shippes approched to the ſea: and they vexed the citie by land, and by ſea, and ſuffered none to come in, or to goe out.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Numenius came, and they that had bene with him, from the citie of Rome, hauing epiſtles written to kinges, and countries, wherein were conteyned theſe wordes:
label: 1 Machabees

text: LVCIVS the conſul of the Romanes, to Ptolomee the king greeting.
label: 1 Machabees

text: The ambaſſadours of the Iewes our freindes came to vs, renewing the old amitie, and ſocietie, being ſent from Simon the prince of the prieſts, and the people of the Iewes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they brought alſo a buckler of gold of a thouſand powndes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: It hath pleaſed vs therfore to write to the kinges, and countries, that they doe them no harme, nor impugne them, and their cities, and their countries: and that they geue no ayde to them that fight againſt them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And it hath ſemed good vnto vs to take the buckler of them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: If therfore anie peſtilent men are fled out of their countrie to you, deliuer them to Simon the prince of the prieſts, that he may punish them according to their law.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Theſe ſelf ſame thinges were written to Demetrius the king, & to Attalus, and to Ariarathes, and to Arſaces,
label: 1 Machabees

text: and into al countries: and to Lampſaces, and to the Spartiats, and to Delus, and to Myndus, and to Sicyon, and to Caria, and to Samus, & Pamphilia, and Lycia, and Alicarnaſſus, and Coo, and Siden, and Aradon, and Rhodes, & Phaſelis, and Gortyna, and Gnidus, and Cypres, and Cyrenee.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And a copie therof they wrote to Simon the prince of the prieſts & people of the Iewes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But king Antiochus moued his campe vnto Dora the ſecond time, ſetting handes alwayes vpon it, & making engins: & he shut vp Tryphon, that he could not goe forth.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon ſent vnto him two thouſand choſen men for ayde, and ſiluer, and gold, and abundance of furniture.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he would not take them, but brake al thinges that he couenanted with him before, & alienated him ſelf from him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſent to him Athenobius one of his freinds, to treate with him, ſaying: You hold Ioppe, and Gazara, and the caſtel, that is in Ieruſalem, cities of my kingdom:
label: 1 Machabees

text: their borders you haue made deſolate, and you haue made a great plague in the land, and haue ruled in manie places in my kingdom.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Now therfore deliuer the cities, that you haue taken, and the tributes of the places, wherin you haue ruled without the borders of Iurie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But if not, geue you for them fiue hundred talents of ſiluer, and for the deſtruction, that you haue made, and the tributes of cities other fiue hundred talents: but if not, we wil come and expugne you.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Athenobius the kings freind came into Ieruſalem, & ſaw the glorie of Simon, and his magnificence in gold, & ſiluer, and furniture abundant, and he was aſtonied, and told him the kings wordes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon anſwered him, and ſayd to him: Neither haue we taken other mens land, neither do we hold that is other mens: but the inheritance of our fathers, which was a certaine ſeaſon vniuſtly poſſeſſed of our enemies.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But we hauing oportunitie challenge the inheritance of our fathers.
label: 1 Machabees

text: For concerning Ioppe, and Gazara, that thou complayneſt they made a great plague among the people, and in our countrie: for theſe we geue an hundred talents. And Athenobius anſwered him not a word.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But with anger returning to the king, he reported vnto him theſe wordes, and the glorie of Simon, & al thinges that he ſaw, and the king was wrath with great anger.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Tryphon fled by shippe to Orthoſias.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the king appointed Cendebæus captaine by the ſea coſt, and gaue him an armie of foote men and horſemen.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he commanded him to moue the campe againſt the face of Iurie: and he commanded him to build Cedron, and to fortifie the gates of the citie, and to conquer the people. But the king purſewed Tryphon.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Cendebæus came to Iamnia, and began to prouoke the people, & to conculcate Iurie, and to take the people captiue, and to kil, and to build Cedron.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he placed there horſemen, and an hoſt: that going forth they might walke by the way of Iurie, as the king appointed him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: AND Iohn went vp from Gazara, and told Simon his father what Cendebæus did amongſt their people.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon called his two elder ſonnes, Iudas & Iohn, and he ſayd to them: I and my bretheren, and the houſe of my father, haue expugned the enemies of Iſrael from our youth euen to this day: and it hath proſpered in our handes to deliuer Iſrael oftentimes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And now I am old, but be you in place of me, and my bretheren, & going forth fight for our nation: & the helpe from heauen be with you.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he choſe out of the countrie twentie thouſand fighting men, and horſemen, and they went forth to Cendebæus: and they ſlept in Modin.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they aroſe in the morning, and went into the plaine filde: and loe a mightie great armie coming to meete them of foote men, and horſemen, & there was a running riuer betwen them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he camped agaynſt the face of them, him ſelf and his people, and he ſaw the people fearful to paſſe through the torrent, and he paſſed through firſt: and the men ſaw him, and they paſſed ouer after him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he diuided the people, and the horſemen in the middes of the footemen: and the horſemen of the aduerſaries were exceding manie.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And they ſounded with the holie trompets: and Cendebæus was put to flight, and his campe: and there fel manie of them wounded, and the reſt fled into the hold.
label: 1 Machabees

text: Then was Iudas Iohns brother wounded: But Iohn purſewed them, til he came to Cedron.
label: 1 Machabees

text: which he built: and they fled euen to the towres, that were in the fildes of Azotus, and he burnt them with fyre. And there fel of them two thouſand men, and he returned into Iurie in peace.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ptolomee the ſonne of Abobus was appointed captayne in the plaine of Iericho, and he had much ſiluer, and gold.
label: 1 Machabees

text: For he was the ſonne in law of the high prieſt.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And his hart was exalted, and he would gayne the countrie, and he purpoſed treacherie againſt Simon, and his ſonnes to diſpatch them.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Simon walking through the cities, that were in the countrie of Iurie, and being careful of them, went downe into Iericho, he and Mathathias his ſonne, and Iudas the yeare an hundreth ſeuentie ſeuen, the eleuenth moneth: this is the moneth Sabath.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the ſonne of Abobus receiued them with guile into a litle fortreſſe, that is called Doch which he built: and he made them a great feaſt, and hid men there.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And when Simon was inebriated and his ſonnes, Ptolomee aroſe with his companie, and they tooke their weapons, and entered into the feaſt, and ſlew him, and his two ſonnes, and certain of his ſeruants.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he did great deceite in Iſrael, & rendered euil for good.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And Ptolomee wrote theſe thinges, and ſent to the king that he should ſend him an armie for ayde, and he would deliuer him the countrie, and their cities, and tributes.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſent others into Gazara to diſpatch Iohn: and to the tribunes he ſent epiſtles, that they should come to him, & he would geue them ſiluer, & gold, and gifts.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And he ſent others to take Ieruſalem, & the mount of the temple.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And one running before, told Iohn in Gazara, that his father was perished, and his bretheren, & that he hath ſent that thou alſo mayſt be ſlayne.
label: 1 Machabees

text: But as he heard it, he was excedingly afrayd: and he apprehended the men, that came to deſtroy him, & he ſlew them: for he knew that they ſought to deſtroy him.
label: 1 Machabees

text: And the reſt concerning the wordes of Iohn, & his battels, and the valient actes, which he did manfully, and the building of the walles, which he built, & the thinges that he did:
label: 1 Machabees

text: loe theſe are writen in the booke of the dayes of his prieſthood, from the time that he was made prince of the prieſts after his father.
label: 1 Machabees

text: TO THE bretheren, the Iewes that are through out Ægypt, the bretheren, the Iewes that are in Ieruſalem, and that are in the countrie of Iurie, ſend health, and good peace.
label: 2 Machabees

text: God doe good to you, and remember his teſtament, that he ſpake to Abraham, and Iſaac, and Iacob, his faithful ſeruantes:
label: 2 Machabees

text: and geue he vnto you al an hart to worshippe him, and to doe his wil with a great hart, and a willing minde.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Open he your hart in his law, and in his precepts, and make peace.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Heare he your prayers, and be he reconciled vnto you, neither forſake he you in the euil time.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And now here we are praying for you.
label: 2 Machabees

text: When Demetrius reigned, in the yeare one hundreth ſixtie nine, we Iewes wrote vnto you in the tribulation, and violence, that came vpon vs in theſe yeares, ſince Iaſon reuolted from the holie land, and from the kingdom.
label: 2 Machabees

text: They burnt the gate, and shed innocent bloud: and we prayed to our Lord, and were heard, and we offered ſacrifice, and fine floore, and lighted the lampes, and ſetforth there breades.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And now celebrate ye the dayes of Scenopegia of the moneth Ceſleu.
label: 2 Machabees

text: In the yeare one hundreth eightie eight, the people that is at Ieruſalem, and in Iurie, and the ſenate, and Iudas, to Ariſtobolus the maiſter of Ptolomee the king, who is of the ſtocke of the annointed prieſtes, and to thoſe Iewes, that are in Ægypt health, and welfare.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Being deliuered by God out of great dangers, we geue him thankes magnifically, as who haue fought againſt ſuch a king.
label: 2 Machabees

text: For he made them ſwarme out of Perſis, that haue fought againſt vs, and the holie citie.
label: 2 Machabees

text: For when he was captaine in Perſis, & with him a very great armie, he fel in the temple of Nania, being deceiued by the counſel of Naneaes prieſtes.
label: 2 Machabees

text: For Antiochus, & his freindes came to the place as to dwel with her, & that he might receiue much money vnder the title of a dowrie.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And when Naneaes prieſtes had layde it forth, and he with a few was entered within the compaſſe of the temple, they shut the temple,
label: 2 Machabees

text: when Antiochus was entered in: & a ſecrete entrance of the temple being opened, caſting ſtones they ſtroke the duke, and them that were with him, and diuided them in peeces, and cutting of their heades they threw them forth.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Bleſſed be the God in al thinges, who hath deliuered vp the impious.
label: 2 Machabees

text: We therefore meaning to keepe the purification of the temple the fiue and twentith day of the moneth Caſleu, thought it neceſſary to ſignifie vnto you: that you alſo may kepe the day of Scenopegia, and the day of the fire, that was geuen when Nehemias, after the temple was built and the altar, offered ſacrifice.
label: 2 Machabees

text: For when our fathers were caryed into Perſis, the prieſtes that then were the worshippers of God, taking the fire from the altar, hid it ſecretly in a valley where there was a pitte deepe, and dry, and therin they ſaued it, ſo that the place was vnknowne to al men.
label: 2 Machabees

text: But when manie yeares had paſſed, and it pleaſed God that Nehemias should be ſent of the king of Perſis: he ſent the nephewes of thoſe prieſtes, that had hid it, to ſeeke out the fire: and as they told vs, they found not fire, but thicke water.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And he bad them draw, & bring vnto him: and the ſacrifices, that were layd on, the prieſt Nehemias commanded to be ſprinckled with the ſame water, and the wood, and the thinges that were layde therupon.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And as this was done, & the time was come that the ſunne shone forth, which before was in a cloude, there was kindled a great fire, ſo that al merueiled.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And al the prieſtes made prayer, whiles the ſacrifice was conſuming, Ionathas beginning, and the reſt anſwering.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And the prayer of Nehemias was in this maner: O LORD God creatour of al, dreadful, and ſtrong, iuſt, and merciful, which only art the good king,
label: 2 Machabees

text: only giuer, only iuſt, and omnipotent, and eternal, which deliuereſt Iſrael from al euil, which madeſt the fathers elect, and didſt ſanctifie them.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Receiue the ſacrifice for al thy people Iſrael, and kepe thy part, and ſanctifie it.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Gather together our diſperſion, deliuer them, that ſerue the Gentils, and regard the contemned & abhorred: that the Gentils may know that thou art our God.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Afflict them that oppreſſe vs, and that doe contumelie in pride.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Place thy people in thy holie place, as Moyſes ſayd.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And the prieſtes ſang hymnes, til the ſacrifice was conſumed.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And when the ſacrifice was conſumed, of the reſt of the water Nehemias commanded the greater ſtones to be throughly washed.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Which thing as it was done, out of them was kindled a flame: but by light alſo, that shined from the altar, it was conſumed.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And as the thing was made manifeſt, it was told the king of the Perſians, that in the place, wherin thoſe prieſtes that were tranſported, had hid fire, there appeared water, with the which Nehemias, and they that were with him, purified the ſacrifices.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And the king conſidering, and diligently examining the matter, made a temple for it, that he might approue that which was done.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And when he had approued it, he gaue to the prieſtes manie good thinges, and diuerſe giftes, and taking them with his owne hand, he gaue to them.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And Nehemias called this place Nephthar, which is interpreted purification. But it is called with manie Nephi.
label: 2 Machabees

text: AND it is found in the deſcriptions of Ieremie the prophet, that he commanded them that went in tranſmigration, to take the fire, as it was ſignified, & as he commanded them that were caried away in tranſmigration.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And he gaue them a law that they should not forget the precepts of our Lord, and that they should not erre in their mindes, ſeing the idols of gold, and ſiluer, and the ornaments of them.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And ſaying other like thinges, he exhorted them that they would not remoue the law from their hart.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And it was in the ſame writing, how the prophet commanded by the diuine anſwer made to him, that the tabernacle, & the arke should folow in company with him, til he came forth into the mount in which Moyſes aſcended, and ſaw the inheritance of God.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And Ieremie coming thither found a place of a caue: & he brought the tabernacle, and the arke, and the altar of incenſe in thither, and ſtopped the doore.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And there came certaine withal, that folowed, to marke the place for themſelues: and they could not finde it.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And as Ieremie vnderſtood it, blaming them he ſayd: that the place shal be vnknowne, til God gather together the congregation of the people, and become propicious:
label: 2 Machabees

text: and then our Lord wil shew theſe thinges, and the maieſtie of our Lord shal appeare, & there shal be a cloude as it was alſo made manifeſt to Moyſes, and as when Salomon prayed that the place might be ſanctified to the great God, he did manifeſt theſe thinges.
label: 2 Machabees

text: For he handled wiſedom magnifically: as hauing wiſedome, did he offer the ſacrifice of the dedication, and of the conſummation of the temple.
label: 2 Machabees

text: As Moyſes alſo prayed to our Lord, and as Salomon prayed, and fire came downe from heauen, and conſumed the holocauſt.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And Moyſes ſayd: Becauſe that which was for ſinne, was not eaten, it was conſumed.
label: 2 Machabees

text: In like maner Salomon alſo eight dayes celebrated the dedication.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And theſe ſelf ſame thinges were put in the deſcriptions, and commentaries of Nehemias: and after what ſort he making a librarie gathered together bookes of the prophetes, and of Dauid, and the epiſtles of the kinges, and concerning the donaries.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And in like maner Iudas alſo ſuch thinges as were fallen away by the warre that happened to vs, gathered them al together, and they are with vs.
label: 2 Machabees

text: If therfore you deſire theſe thinges, ſend ſome that may fetch them vnto you.
label: 2 Machabees

text: We therfore meaning to kepe the purification haue written vnto you: You shal doe wel then, if you kepe theſe dayes.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And God that hath deliuered his people, and rendered the inheritance to al, the kingdom, and the prieſthoode, and the ſanctification,
label: 2 Machabees

text: as he promiſed in the law, we hope that he wil quickly haue mercie vpon vs, and wil gather vs together from vnder heauen into the holie place.
label: 2 Machabees

text: For he hath deliuered vs out of great perils, and hath purged the place.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Concerning Iudas Machabeus, and his brethren, and of the purification of the great temple, and of the dedication of the altar,
label: 2 Machabees

text: Yea and of the battels that perteyne to Antiochus the Noble, and his ſonne Eupator:
label: 2 Machabees

text: and of the apparitions, that were made from heauen to them, that did manfully for the Iewes, ſo that being few they reuenged the whole countrie, and put to flight the barbarous multitude:
label: 2 Machabees

text: and repayred the moſt famous temple in al the world, and deliuered the citie, and the lawes that were abolished, were reſtored, our Lord with al clemencie being made propicious vnto them.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Alſo the thinges which by Iaſon the Cyrenean, are compriſed in fiue bookes we haue attempted to abridge in one volume.
label: 2 Machabees

text: For conſidering the multitude of bookes, and the difficultie to them, that wil attempt the narrations of hiſtories, becauſe of the multitude of matters:
label: 2 Machabees

text: we haue bene careful for them that are willing to reade, that there might be delectation of the minde: and for the ſtudious, that they may more eaſily comitte it to memorie: and that profite might enſewe to al that read it.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And to our owne ſelues in deede, which haue taken vpon vs this worke to make an abridgement, we haue taken in hand no eaſie labour, yea rather a buſines ful of watching and ſwette.
label: 2 Machabees

text: As they that prepare a feaſt, and ſeeke to condeſcend to other mens wil: for manie mens ſakes we doe willingly ſuſteyne the labour.
label: 2 Machabees

text: The veritie certes concerning euery particular leauing to the auctors, and our ſelues according to the forme that is geuen, ſtudying to be briefe.
label: 2 Machabees

text: For as the builder of a new houſe muſt haue care of the whole building: but he that hath the care to paint, muſt ſeeke out the thinges that are apt for garnishing: ſo muſt it be eſteemed alſo in vs.
label: 2 Machabees

text: For to gather together the vnderſtanding, to order the ſpeach, and curiouſly to diſcuſſe euerie particular part, agreeth to the auctor of an hiſtorie:
label: 2 Machabees

text: but to purſew the breuitie of ſpeach, & to auoyde the exact declarations of thinges, is to be granted to him that abridgeth.
label: 2 Machabees

text: From hence then wil we begine the narration: of the preface let it be ſufficient to haue ſayd thus much. for it is a foolish thing before the hiſtorie to flow ouer, and in the hiſtorie to be shorte.
label: 2 Machabees

text: THEREFORE when the holie citie was inhabited in 1. al peace, 2. the lawes alſo as yet were very wel kept, becauſe of Onias 3. the high prieſt his pietie, & minde that hated euils,
label: 2 Machabees

text: it came to paſſe that kinges alſo themſelues, and princes eſteemed the place worthie of high honour, and glorified the temple with verie great giftes:
label: 2 Machabees

text: ſo that Seleucus the king of Aſia of his reuenewes allowed al the charges perteyning to the miniſterie of the ſacrifices.
label: 2 Machabees

text: But Simon of the tribe of Beniamin, being appointed ouerſeer of the temple, 1 contended, the prince of the prieſtes reſiſting him, to worke ſome wicked thing in the citie.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And 2. when he could not ouercome Onias, he came to Appollonius the ſonne of Tharſæas, who at that time was gouernour of Cæleſyria, and Phænicia:
label: 2 Machabees

text: and told him, that the treaſurie at Ieruſalem was ful of innumerable deale of money, and the common ſtore to be infinite, which perteyne not to the account of the ſacrifices: and that
label: 2 Machabees

text: it is poſſible, al might fal into the kings powre. And 3. when Appollonius had made relation to the king, concerning the money that he was told of, he calling for Heliodorus, who was ouer his affayres, ſent him with commiſſion to tranſport the foreſayde money.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And forthwith Heliodorus began to take his iourney, in shew in dede as if he would goe viſite the cities through out Cœleſyria and Phænicia, but in very deede to accomplish the kings purpoſe.
label: 2 Machabees

text: But when he was come to Ieruſalem, and was curteouſly receiued in the citie by the highprieſt, he told of the the aduertiſment geuen of the money: and opened for what cauſe he was come: and asked if theſe thinges were ſo in very deede.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Then the highprieſt shewed that theſe were depoſita, and the liuelihoods of widowes, and pupils:
label: 2 Machabees

text: but certaine of them to belong vnto Hircanus of Tobie a very noble man, among theſe thinges, which impious Simon had promoted, & the whole to be of ſiluer foure hundred talents, and of gold two hundred.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And that they should be deceiued which had committed it to the place, & the temple, that is honoured through out the whole world, to be a thing, for the reuerence, and holines therof altogether vnpoſſible.
label: 2 Machabees

text: But he by reaſon of thoſe thinges, which he had in commiſſion of the king, ſayd in any wiſe that they muſt be caried to the king.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And on a day appointed, Heliodorus entered in to take order concerning theſe thinges. But there was noe ſmal trembling through out the whole citie.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And the prieſtes caſt them ſelues before the altar with their prieſtes ſtoles, and inuocated him from heauen, which made the law of depoſita, that he would kepe the thinges ſafe, from them that had depoſed them.
label: 2 Machabees

text: But now he that ſaw the countenance of the high prieſt, was wounded in minde: for his face and colour being changed declared the inner ſorow of the minde.
label: 2 Machabees

text: For there was a certaine penſiuenes powred about the man, and horrour of the bodie, wherby the ſorow of his hart was made manifeſt to them that beheld him.
label: 2 Machabees

text: Others alſo came flocking together out of their houſes: praying with publicke ſupplication, for that the place was to come into contempt.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And the wemen hauing their breaſt girded with heareclothes, came together through the ſtretes. Yea and the virgins that were shut vp, came forth to Onias, and ſome to the walles, but ſome looked through the windowes:
label: 2 Machabees

text: and al ſtretching forth their handes vnto heauen, prayed.
label: 2 Machabees

text: For the expectation of the confuſe multitude, and of the grand prieſt being in an agonie, was miſerable.
label: 2 Machabees

text: And theſe certes inuocated almightie God, that the thinges committed to them, might be performed with al integritie for them that had committed the ſame of truſt.
label: 2 Machabees

text: But Heliodorus exerciſed that which he had decreed in the ſame place himſelf preſent with his gard about the treaſurie.
label: 2 Machabees

text: But the ſpirit of almightie God made great euidence of his appearing, ſo that al which had preſumed to obey him, falling by the vertue of God, were turned into diſſolution and feare.
label: 2 Machabees

text: For there appeared to them a certaine horſe hauing a terrible rider, adorned with very rich harneſſe: and he with feircenes ſtroke Heliodorus with his forefoote, and he that ſate vpon him, ſeemed to haue armour of gold.
label: 2 Machabees
