text: Theſe are then the tabernacles of the wicked man, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
label: Job

text: BVT Iob anſwering, ſayd:

text: How long doe you afflict my ſoule, and weare me with wordes?

text: For although I haue beene ignorant, mine ignorance shal be with me.

text: My kinſemen haue forſaken me, and they that knew me haue forgotten me.

text: The gheſtes of my houſe, and my mayd-ſeruantes haue counted me an aliene, and I haue bene as it were a ſtranger in their eies.

text: I called my ſeruant, and he did not anſwer me, with mine owne mouth I beſought him.

text: My wife hath abhorred my breath, and I prayed the children of my wombe.

text: Fooles alſo deſpiſed me, and when I was departed from them, they backbited me.

text: My counſelers ſometime haue abhorred me: and he whom I loued moſt hath turned againſt me.

text: Haue mercie vpon me, haue mercie vpon me, at the leaſt you my frendes, becauſe the hand of our Lord hath touched me.

text: Why doe you as God perſecute me, and are filled with my flesh.

label: Job

text: This the portion of an impions man from God, & the inheritance of his wordes from our Lord.

text: For thou haſt taken away the pledge of thy brethren without cauſe, and the naked thou haſt ſpoyled of clothes.

label: Job

text: In the ſtrength of thine arme thou didſt poſſeſſe the earth, and being the mightieſt thou didſt obteyne it.
label: Job

text: Widowes thou haſt ſent away emptie, and the armes of pupilles thou haſt broken in peeces.
label: Job

text: Therfore art thou compaſſed with ſnares, and ſoden feare trubleth thee.
label: Job

text: And thoughteſt thou that thou shouldeſt not ſee darkenes, and that thou shouldeſt not be oppreſſed with the violence of ouerflowing waters?
label: Job

text: Doeſt thou not thinke that God is higher then heauen, & is exalted aboue the toppe of the ſtarres?
label: Job

text: And thou ſayeſt: For what knoweth God? and he iudgeth as it were by a miſt.
label: Job

text: The cloudes are his couert, neither doth he conſider our thinges, and he walketh about the poles of heauen
label: Job

text: Doeſt thou couet ro keepe the path of worldes, which wicked men haue troden?
label: Job

text: Who were taken away before their time, and a floud hath ouerthrowen their foundation:
label: Job

text: Who ſayd to God: Depart from vs: and as though the Omnipotent could do nothing, they eſtemed him:
label: Job

text: Whereas he had filled their houſes with good things, whoſe ſentence be far from me.
label: Job

text: The iuſt shal ſee, and shal reioyſe, and the innocent man shal skorne them
label: Job

text: Is not their exaltation cut downe, and hath not fire deuoured the remnantes of them?
label: Job

text: Agree thou therfore to him, and haue peace: and by theſe thinges thou shalt haue the beſt fruites.
label: Job

text: Receiue the law of his mouth, and put his wordes in thy hart.
label: Job

text: If thou wilt returne to the Omnipotent, thou shalt be builded vp, and shalt make iniquitie far from thy tabernacle.
label: Job

text: He shal geue for earth flint, and for flint torrentes of gold.
label: Job

text: And the Omnipotent shal be agaynſt thine enemies, & ſiluer shal be heaped together vnto thee.
label: Job

text: Then shalt thou abound in delightes vpon the Omnipoten, and shalt lift vp thy face to God.
label: Job

text: Thou shalt aske him, and he wil heare thee, and thou shal pay thy vowes.
label: Job

text: Thou shalt decree a thing, and it shal come to thee, and light shal shine in thy waies.
label: Job

text: For who wil be humbled, shal be in glorie: and he that wil bow downe his eies, he shal be ſaued.
label: Job

text: The innocent shal be ſaued, but he shal be ſaued in the cleanneſſe of his handes.
label: Job

text: BVT Iob anſwering, ſayd:
label: Job

text: Now alſo my talke is in bitterneſſe, and the hand of my plague is aggrauated vpon my mourning.
label: Job

text: Who wil grant me that I may know and find him, and come euen to his throne?
label: Job

text: I wil ſet iudgement before him, and wil fil my mouth with accuſations.
label: Job

text: That I may know the wordes, that he wil anſwer me, and vnderſtand what he wil ſpeake to me.
label: Job

text: I wil not that he contend with me with much ſtrength, nor that he oppreſſe me with the weight of his greatnes.
label: Job

text: Let him propoſe equitie againſt me, and my iudgement shal come to victorie.
label: Job

text: If I shal goe to the Eaſt, he appeareth not: if to the Weſt, I shal not vnderſtand him.
label: Job

text: If to the left band, what shal I doe? I shal not apprehend him: if I turne my ſelf to the right hand, I shal not ſee him.
label: Job

text: But he knoweth my way, & hath proued me as gold that paſſeth through the fyre:
label: Job

text: My foote hath folowed his ſteppes, I haue kept his way, & haue not declined out if it.
label: Job

text: From the commandementes of his lippes I haue not departed, and I haue hid the wordes of his mouth in my boſome.
label: Job

text: For he is alone, and no man can turne away his cogitation: and whatſoeuer his ſoule would, that hath he done.
label: Job

text: And when he shal haue fulfilled his wil in me, manie other things alſo are at hand wit him.
label: Job

text: And therfore I am trubled at his face, and conſidering, him I am made penſife withfeare.
label: Job

text: God hath mollified my hart, and the Omnipotent hath trubled me.
label: Job

text: For I haue not perished becauſe of the imminent darkeneſſe, neither hath the miſt couered my face.
label: Job

text: TIMES are not hid from the Omnipotent: but they that know him, know not his daies.
label: Job

text: Some haue transferred boundes, ſpoiled flockes, & fed them.
label: Job

text: They haue driuen away the aſſe of pupilles, & haue taken away the widowes oxe for a pledge.
label: Job

text: They haue ſubuerted the way of the poore, and haue oppreſſed together the meeke of the earth.
label: Job

text: Others as wilde aſſes in the deſerte goe forth to their worke: watching to the praye, doe prepare bread for their children.
label: Job

text: They reape the filde that is not theirs, and gather the grapes of his vineyard, whom by violence they haue oppreſſed.
label: Job

text: They ſend men away naked, taking away their clothes, which haue no couering in the cold.
label: Job

text: Whom the ſhowers of the mountaynes doe wash, and not hauing a couert, they embrace ſtones.
label: Job

text: They did violence ſpoyling the pupilles, and the common poore people they ſpoyled.
label: Job

text: From the naked and them that goe without clothing, and the hungrie they haue taken away the eares of corne.
label: Job

text: They haue reſted the noonetide among their heapes, which hauing troden the wine preſſes are a thirſt.
label: Job

text: Out of the cities they haue made men to mourne, and the ſoule of the wounded hath cryed, and God doth not ſuffer it to paſſe vnreuenged:
label: Job

text: They haue bene rebellious to the light, they haue not knowen his wayes, neither did they returne by his pathes.
label: Job

text: At the verie breake of day the murderer ryſeth, he killeth the needie, and the poore man: but by night he wil be as a theefe.
label: Job

text: The eie of the aduouterer obſerueth darkeneſſe, ſaying: Eie shal not ſee me: and he wil couer his face.
label: Job

text: He diggeth through houſes in the darke, as in the day they had oppoynted with them ſelues, and they haue not knowen the light.
label: Job

text: If ſodenly the morning shal appeare, they thinke it the ſhadow of death: and they walke ſo in darkeneſſe as it were in light.
label: Job

text: He is light aboue the face of the water: curſed be his portion in the earth, neither walke he by the way of the vineyardes.
label: Job

text: Let him paſſe from ſnowe waters to exceding heate, and his ſinne euen vnto hel.
label: Job

text: Let mercie forget him: wormes his ſweetnes: be he not in remembrance, but be he broken in peeces as an vnfruitful tree.
label: Job

text: For he hath fedd the barren, and her that bareth not, and to the widow he hath not done good.
label: Job

text: He hath pulled downe the ſtrong in his ſtrength, and when he shal ſtand, he wil not credit his life.
label: Job

text: God hath geuen him place for penance, and he abuſeth it vnto pride: but his eies be vpon his waies.
label: Job

text: They are eleuated for a litle, and shal not ſtand, and shal be humbled as al thinges, and shal be taken away, and as the toppes of the eares of corne they shal be broken.
label: Job

text: And if it be not ſo, who can reproue me that I haue lied, and ſet my wordes before God?
label: Job

text: BVT Baldad the Suhite anſwering, ſayd:
label: Job

text: Power and terrour is with him, that maketh concord in his high ones.
label: Job

text: Is there anie number of his ſouldiars? and vpon whom shal not his light ariſe,
label: Job

text: can man be iuſtified compared with God, or the borne of a woman appeare cleane?
label: Job

text: Behold the moone alſo doth not ſhine, and the ſtarres are not cleane in his ſight.
label: Job

text: How much more man rottennes, & the ſome of man a worme?
label: Job

text: BVT Iob anſwering, ſayd:
label: Job

text: Whoſe helper art thou? his that is weake? and doeſt thou hold vp the arme of him, that is not ſtrong?
label: Job

text: To whom haſt thou geuen counſel? perhaps to him, that hath not wiſdom, and thy prudence haſt thou ſhewed very great.
label: Job

text: Whom wouldeſt thou teach? not him that made breath?
label: Job

text: Behold the gyantes grone vnder the waters, and they that dwel with them.
label: Job

text: Hel is naked before him, and there is no couert to perdition.
label: Job

text: Who ſtretcheth out the northwind ouer the vacant, and hangeth the earth vpon nothing.
label: Job

text: Who bindeth the waters in his cloudes, that they breake not forth together downeward.
label: Job

text: Who holdeth the countenance of his throne, and ſpreddeth his clowde ouet it.
label: Job

text: He hath made a limite about the waters, til light & darkenes be ended.
label: Job

text: The pillers of heauen tremble, and dread at his beck.
label: Job

text: In his ſtrength ſodenly the ſeas are gathered together, and with his wiſdom he ſtroke the proud man.
label: Job

text: His ſpirite hath adorned the heauens, and his hand being the midwife, the winding ſerpent is brought forth.
label: Job

text: Loe, theſe things are ſayd in part of his waies: and where as we haue heard ſcarce a litle droppe of his word, who shal be able to behold the thunder of his greatnes?
label: Job

text: IOB alſo added, taking his parable, and ſayd:
label: Job

label: Job

text: That as long as breath remaineth in me, and the ſpirit of God in my noſthrels,
label: Job

text: My lippes shal not ſpeake iniquitie, neither shal my tongue meditate lying.
label: Job

text: God forbid that I ſhould iudge you to be iuſt: til I faile, I wil not departe from mine innocencie.
label: Job

text: My iuſtification which I haue begune to hold, I wil not forſake: for my hart doth not reprehend me in al my life.
label: Job

text: Let mine enemie be as the impions, and mine aduerſarie as the wicked one.
label: Job

text: For what is the hypocrites hope if couetouſely he take by violence, and God deliuer not his ſoule?
label: Job

text: Wil God heare his crie, when diſtreſſe shal come vpon him?
label: Job

text: Or can he be delighted in the Omnipotent, and inuocate God at al time?
label: Job

text: I wil teach you by the hand of God, what the Omnipotent hath, neither wil I hide it.
label: Job

text: Loe, you doe al knowe, and why ſpeake you vaine thinges without cauſe.
label: Job

text: This is the portion of an impions man with God, and inheritance of the violent, which they shal receiue of the Omnipotent.
label: Job

text: If his children be multiplied, they shal be in the ſword, & nephewes shal not be filled with bread.
label: Job

text: They that shal be leaft of him, shal be buried in death, and his widowes shal not weepe.
label: Job

text: If he shal heape together ſiluer as earth, and as clay shal prepare garmentes:
label: Job

text: He shal prepare in deede, but the iuſt man shal be clothed with them: and the innocent shal diuide the ſiluer.
label: Job

text: He hath built his houſe as a moth, and as a keeper hath he made a bowre.
label: Job

text: The rich man when he shal ſleepe shal take away nothing with him: he shal oppen his eies, & finde nothing.
label: Job

text: Pouertie as water shal apprehend him, in the night a tempeſt shal oppreſſe him.
label: Job

text: The burning wind shal take him vp, and cary him away, and as a whirlewinde shal pul him violently out of his place.
label: Job

text: And he shal caſt vpon him, and shal not ſpare: out of his hand fleing he shal flee.
label: Job

text: He shal claſpe his handes vpon him, and shal hiſſe vpon him, beholding his place.
label: Job

text: SILVER hath beginnings of her vaines, and gold hath a place, where in it is molten.
label: Job

text: Yron is taken out of the earth, and ſtone reſolued with heate, is turned into braſſe.
label: Job

text: He hath ſet a time for darkeneſſe, and the end of al thinges he conſidereth, the ſtone alſo of darkeneſſe, and the shadow of death.
label: Job

text: The torrent diuideth from the pilgrime people, them whom the foote of the needie man hath forgotten, and to whom there is no way.
label: Job

text: The land, out of which bread grew in his place, is deſtroyed with fire.
label: Job

text: The place of the ſapphire the ſtones thereof, and the cloddes of it gold.
label: Job

text: The bird hath not knowen the path, neither hath the eie of the vulter beheld it.
label: Job

text: The children of merchantes haue not troden it, neither hath the lioneſſe paſſed by it.
label: Job

text: He hath ſtretched forth his hand to the flint, he hath ouerthrowen mountaines from the rootes.
label: Job

text: In the rockes he hath cut out riuers, and his eie hath ſeene euerie pretious thing.
label: Job

text: The depthes alſo of riuers he hath ſearched, & hid things he hath brought forth to light:
label: Job

text: But where is wiſdome to be found, and what is the place of vnderſtanding?
label: Job

text: Man knoweth not the price therof, neither is it found in the land of them that liue pleaſently.
label: Job

text: The depth ſayth: It is not in me: and the ſea ſpeaketh: It is not with me.
label: Job

text: The fineſt gold shal not be geuen for it, neither ſhal ſiluer be weyed in the change therof.
label: Job

text: It shal not be compared with the died colours of India, nor with Sardonyx the moſt pretious ſtone, or with the Sapphire.
label: Job

text: Gold or glaſſe shal not be equal to it, neither ſhal veſſels of gold be changed for it.
label: Job

text: High and eminent thinges shal not be mentioned in compariſon of it: and wiſedom is drawen out of ſecrete places.
label: Job

text: The topazius of Æthiopia shal not be equal to it, neither shal it be compared to the cleaneſt diyng.
label: Job

text: From whence then cometh wiſedom? and what is the place of vnderſtanding?
label: Job

text: It is hid from the eies of al liuing, the foules of the ayre alſo know it not.
label: Job

text: Perdition and death haue ſayd: With our eares we haue heard the fame therof.
label: Job

text: God vnderſtandeth the way of it, and he knoweth the place therof.
label: Job

text: For he beholdeth the endes of the world: & looketh on al thinges that are vnder heauen.
label: Job

text: Who made a poiſe to the windes, and weyed the waters in a meaſure.
label: Job

text: When he gaue a lawe to the raynes, and a way to the ſounding ſtormes.
label: Job

text: Then he ſaw it, and declared, and prepared and ſearched it.
label: Job

text: And he ſayd to man: Behold the feare of our Lord, that is wiſedom: and to depart from euil vnderſtanding.
label: Job

text: IOB alſo added, taking his parable, and ſayd:
label: Job

text: Who wil grant me, that I may be according to the former monethes, according to the daies in which God kept me?
label: Job

text: When his lampe ſhined ouer my head, & I walked by his light in darknes?

text: As I was in the daies of my youth, when God was ſecretly in my tabernacle?
label: Job

text: When the Omnipotent was with me: and my ſeruantes round about me?
label: Job

text: When I washed my feete with butter, and the rocke powred me riuers of oile?
label: Job

label: Job

label: Job

label: Job

text: Dukes held in their voice, and their tongue cleaued to their throte.

text: For that I had deliuered the poore man crying out, and the pupil, that had no helper.

text: The bleſſing of him that was readie to perish came vpon me, and I conforted the hart of the widow.
label: Job

text: I was clothed with iuſtice: and I reueſted me with my iudgement, as with a garment and crowne.
label: Job

text: I was an eie to the blind, and a foote to the lame.
label: Job

text: I was the father of the poore: and the cauſe which I knew not, I ſearched moſt diligently.
label: Job

text: I brake the iawes of the wicked man, and out of his teeth I tooke away the praye.

text: And I ſaid: I wil die in my litle neſt, & as a palme-tree wil multiplie daies.
label: Job

text: My roote is opened beſide the waters, and dewe shal continue in my harueſt.
label: Job

text: My glorie shal alwaies be renewed, and my bow in my hand shal be repayred.
label: Job

text: They that heard me, expected ſentence, and attent held their peace at my counſel.
label: Job

text: To my wordes they durſt adde nothing, and my ſpeach diſtilled vpon them.
label: Job

text: They expected me as rayne, and they opened their mouth as it were to a lateward shower.
label: Job

text: If at anie time I laughed on them, they beleued not, and the light of my countenance fel not on the earth.
label: Job

text: If I would haue gone to them, I ſate firſt, and when I ſate as a king, with his armie ſtanding about him, yet was I a conforter of them that mourned.
label: Job

text: BVT now they of yonger time ſcorne me, whoſe fathers I vouchſafed not to put with the dogs of my flocke:
label: Job

text: The force of whoſe handes was to me as nothing, and they were thought vnworthie of life it ſelf.

label: Job

label: Job

label: Job

text: Who reioyſed among theſe kind of thinges, and counted it delicacies to be vnder the briars.
label: Job

text: The children of foolish and baſe men, and in the earth not appearing at al.

text: I am compared to durt, and am reſembled to imbers and ashes.

text: I crie to thee, and thou heareſt me not: I ſtand, and thou doeſt not reſpect me.

text: Thou art changed to be cruel roward me, and in the hardeneſſe of thy hand thou art againſt me.

text: Thou didſt lift me vp, and ſetting me as it were vpon the wind thou haſt mightely dashed me.

text: But yet not to my conſumption doeſt thou ſend forth thy hand: and if they shal fal, thou wilt ſaue.

text: I expect good thinges, and euils are come vpon me: I taried for light, and darkeneſſe brake forth.

text: Doth not he conſider my waies, and number al my ſteppes?

text: If I haue eaten my morſel alone, and the pulpil hath not eaten therof with me. (
label: Job

text: If I haue diſpiſed him that perisheth, for that he had not clothing, and the poore man without wherwithal to couer him:
label: Job

text: If his ſides haue not bleſſed me, & he was not warmed with the fliſes of my sheepe:
label: Job

text: If I haue lifted vp my hand ouer the pupil, yea when I ſaw my ſelf in the gate the ſuperior:
label: Job

text: Let my ſhoulder fal from his iuncture, and let my arme with his bones be broken.
label: Job

text: For I haue alwaies feared God as waues ſwelling vpon me, and his weight I could not beare.
label: Job

text: If I haue thought gold my ſtrength, and haue ſaid to fine gold: My confidence.
label: Job

text: If I haue reioyſed vpon my great riches, and becauſe my hand found manie thinges.
label: Job

text: If I ſaw the ſunne when it shined, and the moone going cleerly:
label: Job

text: And my hart in ſecret reioyſed, and I kiſſed my hand with my mouth.
label: Job

text: Which is moſt great iniquitie, and a denial againſt God the moſt high?
label: Job

text: If I haue beene glad of his fal, that hated me, & haue reioyſed that euil had found him.
label: Job

text: For I haue not geuen my throte to ſinne, that curſing I wished his ſoule.
label: Job

text: If the men of my tabernacle haue not ſayd: Who wil giue of his flesh that we may be filled?
label: Job

text: The ſtranger taried not without, my doore was open to the wayfaring man
label: Job

text: If as man I haue hid my ſinne, and haue concealed my iniquitie in my boſome.
label: Job

text: If I haue bene afrayd at a verie great multitude, & the contempt of kinſmen hath terrified me: and I haue not rather held my peace, & not gone out of the doore.
label: Job

text: Who wil grant me an hearer, that the Omnipotent would heare my deſire: and that himſelf that iudgeth would write a booke.
label: Job

text: That I may carie it on my ſhoulder, and put it about me as a crowne?
label: Job

text: At euerie ſteppe of mine I wil pronounce it, and as to the prince I wil offer it.
label: Job

text: If my Land cry againſt me, and with it the furrowes therof lament:
label: Job

text: If I haue eaten the fruites therof without money, and haue afflicted the ſoule of the tillers therof.
label: Job

text: For wheate let the bryar grow to me, and for barlie the thorne. The wordes of Iob are ended.
label: Job

text: BVT theſe three men omitted to anſwer Iob, for that he ſeemed iuſt to himſelf.
label: Job

text: And Eliu the ſonne of Barachel a Buzite, of the kinred of Ram, was angrie and tooke indignation: and he was angrie againſt Iob, for that he ſayd himſelf to be iuſt before God.
label: Job

text: Moreouer againſt his freindes he had indignation, for that they had not found a reaſonable anſwer, but onlie had condemned Iob.
label: Job

text: Therfore Eliu expected Iob ſpeaking, becauſe they were his elders that ſpake.
label: Job

text: But when he ſaw that the three were not able to anſwer, he was wrath excedingly.
label: Job

text: And Eliu the ſonne of Barachel a Buzite anſwering, ſayd: I am yonger in time, and you more ancient, therfore caſting downe my head, I was afrayd to shewe yon my ſentence.
label: Job

text: For I hoped that longer age would ſpeake, and that a multitnde of yeares would teach wiſdom.
label: Job

text: But as I ſee, there is a Spirite in men, and the inſpiration of the Omnipotent geueth vnderſtanding.
label: Job

text: They of many yeares are not the wiſe men, neither doe the ancientes vnderſtand iudgement.
label: Job

text: Therfore wil I ſpeake: Heare ye me, I alſo wil shew you my wiſedom.
label: Job

text: For I haue expected your wordes, I haue heard your wiſdom, as long as you contended in wordes.
label: Job

text: And as long as I thought you ſaid ſomewhat, I conſidered: but as I ſee, here is none of you that can reproue Iob, and anſwer to his wordes.
label: Job

text: Leſt perhaps you may ſay: We haue found wiſedom, God hath reiected, him not man.
label: Job

text: He hath ſpoken nothing to me, and I wil not anſwer him according to your wordes.
label: Job

text: They were afrayd, and anſwered no more, & they haue taken away talke from themſelues.
label: Job

text: Therfore becauſe I haue expected, and they ſpake not: they ſtoode, & anſwered no more:
label: Job

text: I alſo wil anſwer my part, and wil shew my knowledge.
label: Job

text: For I am ful of wordes, and the ſpirit of my bellie ſtreyneth me.
label: Job

text: Behold, my bellie is as new wine without a vent, which breaketh new veſſels.
label: Job

text: I wil ſpeake, and take breath a litle: I wil open my lippes, and wil anſwer.
label: Job

text: I wil not accept the perſon of a man, and I wil not make God equal to man.
label: Job

text: For I know not how long I shal continewe, and whether after a while my maker wil take me away.
label: Job

text: HEERE therfore Iob my ſayings, and harken to al my wordes.
label: Job

text: Behold I haue opened my mouth, let my tongue ſpeake within my iawes.
label: Job

text: My wordes are of my ſimple hart, and my lippes shal ſpeake a pure ſentence.
label: Job

text: The Spirit of God made me, and the breath of the Omnipotent gaue me life.
label: Job

text: If thou canſt, anſwer me, and ſtand againſt my face.
label: Job

text: Behold God hath made me alſo euen as thee, and of the ſame clay I alſo was formed.
label: Job

text: But yet let not my miracle terrifie thee, and let not my eloquence be burdenous to thee.
label: Job

text: Thou therfore haſt ſayd in my eares, and I haue heard the voice of thy wordes:
label: Job

text: I am cleane, and without ſinne: vnſpotted, and there is no iniquitie in me.
label: Job

text: Becauſe he hath found quarrels in me, therfore hath he thought me his enemy
label: Job

text: He hath put my feete in the ſtockes, he hath obſerued al my waies.
label: Job

text: This therfore is it, wherein thou art not iuſtified: I wil anſwer thee, that God is greater then man.
label: Job

text: Doeſt thou contend againſt him becauſe he hath not anſwered thee to al wordes?
label: Job

text: God ſpeaketh once, & repeateth not the ſelf ſame the ſecond time.
label: Job

text: By a dreame in a viſion by night, when heauie ſleepe falleth vpon men, and they ſleepe in their bed.
label: Job

text: Thē doth he open the eares of men, & teaching inſtructeth them with diſcipline,
label: Job

text: That he may turne a man from theſe things, which he doth, & may deliuer him from pride:
label: Job

text: Deliuering his ſoule from corruption: and his life, that it paſſe not vnto the ſword.
label: Job

text: He rebuketh alſo by ſorow in the bed, and he maketh al his bones to wither.
label: Job

text: Bread is become abominable to him in his life, and to his ſoule the meate before deſired.
label: Job

text: His flesh ſhal conſume, and the bones that had beene couered, shal be made naked.
label: Job

text: His ſoule hath approched to corruption, and his life to things cauſing death.
label: Job

text: If there shal be an Angel ſpeaking for him, one of thouſandes, to declare mans equitie.
label: Job

text: He shal haue mercie on him, and shal ſay: deliuer him, that he deſcend not into corruption: I haue found wherein I may be propitious to him.
label: Job

text: His fleſh is conſumed with punishments, let it returne to the daies of his youth.
label: Job

text: He shal beſeche God, and he wil be pacified towards him: and he shal ſee his face in iubilation, and he wil render to a man his iuſtice.
label: Job

text: He shal behold men, and shal ſay: I haue ſinned, and in deede I haue offended, and, as I was worthie, I haue not receiued.
label: Job

text: He hath deliuered his ſoule that it ſhould not goe into death, but liuing ſhould ſee the light.
label: Job

text: Behold, al theſe things doth God worke three times in euerie one.
label: Job

text: That he may reclame their ſoules from corruption, and illuminate them with the light of the liuing.
label: Job

text: Attend Iob, and heare me: and hold thy peace, whiles I ſpeake.
label: Job

text: But if thou haſt what to ſpeake, anſwer me, ſpeake: for I would thee to appeare iuſt.
label: Job

text: And if thou haue not, heare me: hold thy peace, and I wil teach thee wiſedom.
label: Job

text: ELIV therfore pronouncing, ſpake theſe wordes alſo.
label: Job

text: Heare ye wiſe men my wordes, and ye learned harken to me:
label: Job

text: For the eare proueth wordes, and the throate diſcerneth meates by the taſt.
label: Job

text: Let vs chooſe vs iudgement, and among vs let vs ſee what is the better.
label: Job

text: Becauſe Iob ſayd: I am iuſt, and God hath ſubuerted my iudgement.
label: Job

text: For in iudging me there is a lie: mine arrow is violent without anie ſinne.
label: Job

text: What man is there as is Iob, that drinketh ſkorning as it were water?
label: Job

text: That goeth with them that worke iniquitie, and walketh with impious men?
label: Job

text: For he hath ſayd: Man shal not pleaſe God although he runne with him.
label: Job

text: Therfore ye diſcrete men heare me, far from God be impietie, and iniquitie from the Omnipotent.
label: Job

text: For he wil render a man his worke, and according to the waies of euerie one he wil recompence them.
label: Job

text: For in verie deed God wil not condemne without cauſe, neither wil the Omnipotent ſubuert iudgement.
label: Job

text: What other hath he appointed ouer the earth? or whom hath he ſette ouer the world, which he made?
label: Job

text: If he direct his hart to him, he shal drawe his ſpirit and breath vnto him.
label: Job

text: Al flesh shal faile together, and man shal returne into ashes.
label: Job

text: If then thou haue vnderſtanding, heare that is ſayd, and harken to the voice of my ſpeach.
label: Job

text: Can he that loueth not iudgement, be healed? and how doeſt thou ſo far condemne him, that is iuſt?
label: Job

text: That ſayth to the king, Apoſtata: that calleth dukes impious:
label: Job

text: Who accepteth not the perſones of princes: nor hath knowen the tyrant, when he contended againſt the poore man: for al are the worke of his handes.
label: Job

text: They shal ſodenly die, and at midnight peoples shal be trubled, and shal paſſe, and take away the violent without hand.
label: Job

text: For his eies are vpon the waies of men, and he conſidereth al their ſteppes.
label: Job

text: There is not darkeneſſe, and there is not shadow of death, that they may be hid there which worke iniquitie.
label: Job

text: For it is no more in mans powre, to come to God into iudgement.
label: Job

text: He shal deſtroy manie, & innumerable, & shal make other to ſtand for them.
label: Job

text: For he knoweth their workes: and therfore he shal bring night, and they shal be deſtroyed.
label: Job

text: As impious men he hath ſtroken them in the place of them that ſee.
label: Job

text: Who as it were of purpoſe haue reuolted from him, and would not vnderſtand al his waies:
label: Job

text: That they cauſed the crie of the needie man to come to him, and he heard the voice of the poore.
label: Job

text: For he granting peace, who is there that can condemne? After he shal hide his countenance, who is there that may behold him, both vpon nations, and vpon al men?
label: Job

text: Who maketh a man that is an hypocrite reigne for the ſinnes of the people.
label: Job

text: Therfore becauſe I haue ſpoken to God, thee alſo I wil not prohibite.
label: Job

text: If I haue erred, teach thou me: if I haue ſpoken iniquitie, I wil adde no more.
label: Job

text: Doth God require it of thee, becauſe it hath diſpleaſed thee? for thou beganſt to ſpeake, and not I: but if thou know anie better thing, ſpeake.
label: Job

text: Let men of vnderſtanding ſpeake to me, and let a wiſeman heare me.
label: Job

text: But Iob hath ſpoken folishly, and his wordes ſound not diſcipline.
label: Job

text: O my father, let Iob be proued euen to the end: ceaſe not from the man of iniquity.
label: Job

text: Who addeth blaſphemie vpon his ſinnes, let him be reſtrayned in the meane time among vs: and then let him prouoke God to iudgement with his ſpeaches.
label: Job

text: THERFORE Eliu againe ſpake theſe wordes:
label: Job

text: Doth thy cogitation ſeme iuſt to thee, that thou ſaydſt: I am iuſter then God?
label: Job

text: For thou ſaydſt: That which is right doth not pleaſe thee: or what wil it profite thee if I ſinne?
label: Job

text: Therfore wil I anſwer to thy wordes, & to thy frendes with thee.
label: Job

text: Looke vp to heauen and ſee, and behold the skie, that it is higher then thou.
label: Job

text: If thou ſinne, what shalt thou hurt him? and if thine iniquities be multiplied, what shalt thou doe againſt him?
label: Job

text: Moreouer if thou doe iuſtly, what shalt thou geue him, or what shal he receiue of thy hand?
label: Job

text: Man that is like to thee, thy impietie shal hurt: and thy iuſtice shal helpe the ſonne of man.
label: Job

text: Becauſe of the multitude of calumniatours they shal cry: and shal waile for the force of the arme of tyrantes.
label: Job

text: And he hath not ſayd: Where is God, that made me, that hath geuen ſongs in the night?
label: Job

text: Who teacheth vs aboue the beaſtes of the earth, and inſtructeth vs aboue the foules of the ayre.
label: Job

text: There shal they crie, and he wil not heare, becauſe of the pride of the euil.
label: Job

text: God therfore wil not heare without cauſe, and the Omnipotent wil behold the cauſes of euerie one.
label: Job

text: Yea when thou shalt ſay: He conſidereth not: be iudged before him, & expect him.
label: Job

text: For he doth not now inferte his furie, neither doth he reuenge wickedneſſe excedingly.
label: Job

text: Therfore Iob in vaine openeth his mouth, and without knowledge multiplieth wordes.
label: Job

text: ELIV alſo adding ſpeake theſe wordes:
label: Job

text: Beare with me a litle, and I wil shew to thee: for as yet I haue what to ſpeake for God.
label: Job

text: I wil repete my knowledge from the beginning, and I wil proue my maker iuſt.
label: Job

text: For in deede my wordes are without lye, and perfect knowledge shal be proued to thee.
label: Job

text: God doth not caſt away the mightie, wheras himſelf alſo is mightie.
label: Job

text: But he ſaueth not the impious, and he giueth iudgement to the poore.
label: Job

text: He shal not take away his eyes from the iuſt man, and he placeth kinges in the throne for euer, and there they are extolled.
label: Job

text: And if they shal be in cheines, and be bound with the ropes of pouertie.
label: Job

text: He shal shew them their workes, and their wicked deedes, becauſe they haue bene violent.
label: Job

text: He alſo shal reuele their eare, to chaſtiſe them: and shal ſpeake, that they may returne from iniquitie:
label: Job

text: If they shal heare and obſerue, they shal accomplish their daies in good, and their yeares in glorie.
label: Job

text: But if they heare not they shal paſſe by the ſworde, and shal be conſumed in folie.
label: Job

text: Diſſemblers and craftie men prouoke the wrath of God, neither shal they crie when they are bound.
label: Job

text: Their ſoule shal dye in tempeſt, & their life among the effeminates.
label: Job

text: He shal deliuer the poore out of his diſtreſſe, and shal reuele his eare in tribulation.
label: Job

text: Therfore he shal ſaue thee moſt largely out of the narrow mouth, and not hauing foundation vnder it: and the quietneſſe of thy table shal be ful of fatneſſe.
label: Job

text: Thy cauſe is iudged as an impious mans, cauſe and iudgement thou shalt receiue.
label: Job

text: Let not therfore anger ouercome thee, that thou oppreſſe anie man: neither let multitude of gifres incline thee.
label: Job

text: Lay downe thy greatnes without tribulation, and al the puiſſant of ſtrength.
label: Job

text: Protract not the night, that peoples may come vp for them.
label: Job

text: Beware thou decline not to iniquitie: for thou haſt begunne to folow it after miſerie.
label: Job

text: Behold, God is high in his ſtrength, and none is like to him among the lawgeuers.
label: Job

text: Who can ſearch his waies? or who can ſay to him: Thou haſt wrought iniquitie?
label: Job

text: Remember that thou knoweſt not his worke, wherof men haue ſong.
label: Job

text: Al men ſee him, euerie one beholdeth far of.
label: Job

text: Behold, God is great ſurmounting our knowledge: the number of his yeares is ineſtimable.
label: Job

text: Who taketh away the droppes of raine, and powreth out showers as it were gulfes of water.
label: Job

text: Which flow out from the clowdes, that couer al thinges from aboue.
label: Job

text: If he wil ſtretch forth clowdes as his tent.
label: Job

text: And lighten with his light from aboue, he shal couer alſo the endes of the ſea.
label: Job

text: For by theſe he iudgeth peoples, and geueth victuals to manie mortal men.
label: Job

text: In his handes he hideth the light, and commandeth it that it come agayne.
label: Job

text: He sheweth his freind therof, that it is his poſſeſſion, and that he may aſcend to it.
label: Job

text: VPON this my hart is ſore afrayd, and is moued out of his place.
label: Job

text: Heare ye his ſpeach in the terrour of his voice, and the ſound proceding out of his mouth.
label: Job

text: Vnder al the heauens he conſidereth, and his light is vpon the endes of the earth.
label: Job

text: After him shal ſounding roare, he shal thunder with the voice of his greatnes, & shal not be found out when his voice shal be heard.
label: Job

text: God shal thunder in his voice meruelouſly, he that doeth great & vnſearcheable thinges.
label: Job

text: He that commandeth the ſnow to deſcend vpon the earth, and the winter raines, and the shower of his ſtrength.
label: Job

text: He that ſigneth in the hand of al men, that euerie one may know his workes.
label: Job

text: The beaſt shal enter into his couert, and shal abide in his denne.
label: Job

text: From the inner partes shal tempeſt come forth, and cold from Arcturus.
label: Job

text: When God bloweth froſt congeleth, and againe waters are powred moſt largely.
label: Job

text: Corne deſireth clowdes, and the clowdes ſpred their light
label: Job

text: Which goe round about, whither ſoeuer the wil of the gouerner shal lead them, to al that he shal cōmand them vpon the face of the whole earth
label: Job

text: Whether in one tribe, or in his land, or in what place ſo euer of his mercy he shal command them to be found
label: Job

text: Harken to theſe things Iob: ſtand, and conſider the maruels of God.
label: Job

text: Doeſt thou know when God commanded the raines, that they shew the light of his clowdes?
label: Job

text: Knoweſt thou the great pathes of the clowdes, and the perfect knowledges?
label: Job

text: Are not thy garments hote, when the earth shal be blowen with the South winde?
label: Job

text: Thou perhaps madſt the heauens with him, which are moſt ſound, caſt as it were of braſſe.
label: Job

text: Shew vs what we may ſay to him: for we are wrapped in darkenes.
label: Job

text: Who shal tel him the things that I ſpeake? yea if man shal ſpeake, he shal be deuoured.
label: Job

text: But now they ſee not the light: ſodenly the ayre shal be thickned into clowdes, and the wind paſſing by shal driue them away.
label: Job

text: From the North gold cometh, & toward God fearful prayſing.
label: Job

text: We can not find him worthely: great of ſtrength, and iudgement, and iuſtice, and he can not be vttered.
label: Job

text: Therfore shal men feare him, and al that ſeme to themſelues to be wiſe, shal not dare to behold him.
label: Job

text: BVT our Lord anſwering Iob out of a whirlewind, ſayd:
label: Job

text: Who is this that wrappeth in ſentences with vnskilful wordes?
label: Job

text: Gird thy loynes as a man: I wil aske thee, and anſwer thou me.
label: Job

text: Where waſt thou when I layd the foundations of the earth? tel me if thou haſt vnderſtanding.
label: Job

text: Who ſet the meaſures therof, if thou know? or who ſtretched out the line vpon it?
label: Job

text: Vpon what are the foundations therof grounded? or who let downe the corner ſtone therof,
label: Job

text: when the morning ſtarres praiſed me together, and al the ſonnes of God made iubilation?
label: Job

text: Who shut in the ſea with doores when it brake forth proceding as it were out of a matrice:
label: Job

text: When I made a clowde the garment therof, and wrapped it in darkenes as in cloutes of infancie.
label: Job

text: I compaſſed it with my boundes, and put barre and doores.
label: Job

text: And I ſayd: Hitherto thou shalt come, and shalt not procede farder, & here thou shalt breake thy ſwelling waues.
label: Job

text: Didſt thou after thy birth command the morning, and shew the dawning his place.
label: Job

text: And didſt thou hold the extremities of the earth shaking them, and haſt thou shaken the impious out of it?
label: Job

text: The ſeale shal be reſtored as clay, and shal ſtand as a garment:
label: Job

text: From the impious their light shal be taken away, and the high arme shal be broken.
label: Job

text: Haſt thou entered into the depthes of the ſea, and walked in the loweſt partes of the great depth?
label: Job

text: Haue the gates of death bene open to thee, and haſt thou ſene the darkeſome doores?
label: Job

text: Haſt thou conſidered the bredth of the earth? tel, me if thou know al things,
label: Job

text: In what way the light dwelleth, and what is the place of darkeneſſe.
label: Job

text: That thou canſt bring euerie thing to his borders, and vnderſtand the pathes of the houſe therof.
label: Job

text: Didſt thou know then that thou shouldeſt be borne? and didſt thou know the number of thy dayes?
label: Job

text: Haſt thou entered into the treaſures of the ſnow, or haſt thou beheld treaſures of haile?
label: Job

text: Which I haue prepared for the time of the enemie, for the day of fight and battel?
label: Job

text: What way is the light ſpred, is heate diuided vpon the earth?
label: Job

text: Who gaue courſe to the moſt vehement shower, and the way of the ſounding thunder:
label: Job

text: That it should rayne vpon the earth, without man in the deſert, where no mortal man abideth:
label: Job

text: That it should fil the deſert & deſolate ground, and should bring forth grene graſſe?
label: Job

text: Who is the father of rayne? or who begot the droppes of dewe?
label: Job

text: Out of whoſe wombe came forth yſe? & froſt from heauen who ingendred?
label: Job

text: Waters are hardened like ſtone, and the face of the depth is congealed?
label: Job

text: Shalt thou be able to ioyne together the shining ſtarres Pleiades, or canſt thou diſſipate the circuite of Acturus?
label: Job

text: Doeſt thou bring forth the day ſtarre in his time, and make Euening ſtarre to riſe vpon the children of the earth?
label: Job

text: Doeſt thou know the order of heauen, and shalt thou Put downe the reaſon therof on the earth?
label: Job

text: Shalt thou eleuate the voice in the clowde, & the violence of the waters couer thee?
label: Job

text: Shalt thou ſend lightenings, and wil they goe, and returning shal they ſay to thee: Here we are?
label: Job

text: Who put wiſedom in the hart of man? or who gaue the cocke vnderſtanding?
label: Job

text: Who shal declare the maner of the heauens, and the harmonie of heauen who shal make to ſleepe.
label: Job

text: When was the duſt powred on the earth, and the cloddes compact together?
label: Job

text: Shalt thou take a praye for the liones and fil the appetite of her whelpes.
label: Job

text: When they lie in the dennes, and in holes ſit in wayte?
label: Job

text: Who prepareth for the rauen her meate, when her yong ones crie to God, wandring about, becauſe they haue not meate?
label: Job

text: HAST thou knowen the time when the wild goates bring forth yong among the rockes, or haſt thou obſerued the hyndes when they fawne?
label: Job

text: Haſt thou numbred the monethes of their conceiuing, and knowen the time of their bearing?
label: Job

text: They bowe downe themſelues to bring forth yong, and they caſt them, and make roarings.
label: Job

text: Their yong are ſeperated, and goe to feed: they goe forth, and returne not to them.
label: Job

text: Who hath diſmiſt the wilde aſſe free, and who hath looſed his bondes?
label: Job

text: To whom I haue geuen a houſe in the wildernes, and his tabernacles in the land of ſaltneſſe.
label: Job

text: He contemneth the multitude of the citie, the crie of the exactour he heareth not.
label: Job

text: He looketh about the mountaines of his paſture, and ſeeketh out al greene places.
label: Job

text: Wil the Rhinoceres ſerue thee, and wil he tarie at thy ſtal?
label: Job

text: Shal thou tie the Rhinoceres with thy coller to plough, or wil he breake the cloddes of the valleys after thee?
label: Job

text: Shalt thou haue confidence in his great ſtrength, and leaue thy labours vnto him?
label: Job

text: Wilt thou credit him that he wil render thee the ſeede, and gather together thy barne floore?
label: Job

text: The wing of the Oſtrich is like to the winges of the Herodius, and of the hawke.
label: Job

text: When she leaueth her egges on the earth, thou perhaps wilt heate them in the duſt.
label: Job

text: She forgeteth that foote may treade vpon them, or beaſt of the fild breake them.
label: Job

text: She is hardened toward her yong, as though they were not hers, ſhe hath laboured in vaine no feare compelling her.
label: Job

text: For God hath depriued her of wiſedom neither hath he geuen her vnderſtanding.
label: Job

text: When time shal be, she ſetteth vp the winges on high: she skorneth the horſe & his rider.
label: Job

text: Shalt thou geue ſtrentgh to the horſe, or put neying about his necke?
label: Job

text: Shalt thou raiſe him vp as Locuſtes? the glorie of his noſthrels is terrour.
label: Job

text: He diggeth the earth with his houfe, he prawnſeth boldly, he goeth forward to meete the armed men.
label: Job

text: He contemneth feare, neither yealdeth he to the ſword.
label: Job

text: Vpon him shal the quiuer ſound, the ſpeare ſhal gliſter and the shilde.
label: Job

text: Feruent and foming he ſuppeth the earth, neither doth he make account when the noyſe of the trumpet ſoundeth.
label: Job

text: When he ſhal heare the trumpet he ſayth: Vah, he ſmelleth battel far of, the exhortation of the captaines, and the crie of the armie.
label: Job

text: Doth the hawke waxe fethered by thy wiſedom, ſpreding her winges to the South?
label: Job

text: Shal the eagle mount at thy commandment, and put her neſt in high places?
label: Job

text: She abideth in rockes, and tarieth among cragged flintes, and ſtonie hilles where is no acceſſe.
label: Job

text: Thence she beholdeth the praye, and her eies ſee a far of.
label: Job

text: Her yong ones shal licke bloud: & wherſoeuer the carcaſſe shal be, she is preſent by and by.
label: Job

text: And our Lord added, and ſpake to Iob:
label: Job

text: He that contendeth with God is he quieted ſo eaſily? Verely he that reproueth God, ought to anſwer him.
label: Job

text: But Iob anſwering our Lord, ſayd:
label: Job

text: I that haue ſpoken lightly what can I anſwer? I wil put my hand vpon my mouth.
label: Job

text: One thing I haue ſpoken, which I would I had not ſayd: and an other, to the which thinges I wil adde no more.
label: Job

text: AND our Lord anſwering Iob out of the whirlewinde, ſayd:
label: Job

text: Gird thy loynes as a man: I wil aske thee, and doe thou tel me.
label: Job

text: Shalt thou make my iudgement of none effect: and condemne me, that thou mayſt be iuſtified?
label: Job

text: And haſt thou an arme as God, and doſt thou thunder with like voice.
label: Job

text: Put beautie about thee, and ſet vp thy ſelfe aloft, and be glorious, and put on goodlie garmentes.
label: Job

text: Diſperſe the prowde in thy furie, and beholding euerie arrogant man, humble him.
label: Job

text: Behold al the prowde, and confound them, and deſtroy the impious in their place.
label: Job

text: Hide them in the duſt together, and plunge their faces in the pit.
label: Job

text: And I wil confeſſe, that thy right hand is able to ſaue thee.
label: Job

text: Behold, Behemoth whom I made with thee, shal eate hay as it were an oxe.
label: Job

text: His ſtrength is in his loynes, and his powre in the nauil of his bellie.
label: Job

text: He gathereth together his taile as the ceder tree, the ſinewes of his ſtones are perplexe.
label: Job

text: His bones are as pipes of braſſe, his griſtle as it were plates of iron.
label: Job

text: He is the beginning of the wayes of God, which made him, he shal applie his ſword.
label: Job

text: To him the mountaines beare graſſe: al the beaſtes of the filde shal play there.
label: Job

text: He ſleepeth vnder the shadow, in the ſecrete of the reede, and in moyſt places.
label: Job

text: Shadowes doe protect his shadow, the willowes of the torrent shal compaſſe him.
label: Job

text: Loe, he shal ſup vp the riuer, and shal not meruaile: and he hath confidence that Iordan may runne into his mouth.
label: Job

text: In his eies as with a hooke he shal take him, and with ſtakes he shal boare through his noſthrels.
label: Job

text: Canſt thou drawe out the Leuiathan with a hooke, and with a rope shalt thou tye his tongue?
label: Job

text: Shalt thou put a ring in his noſthrels, or bore through his iaw with a buckle?
label: Job

text: Wil he multiplie prayers to thee, or ſpeake to thee gentle wordes?
label: Job

text: Wil he make a couenant with thee, and shalt thou take him to be a ſeruant for euer?
label: Job

text: Shalt shou delude him as a birde, or tye him for thy handmaydes?
label: Job

text: Shal freindes cut him, merchantes diuide him?
label: Job

text: Shalt thou fil nettes with his skinne, and the cabbin of fishes with his heade?
label: Job

text: Lay thy hand vpon him: remember battel, and adde to ſpeake no more.
label: Job

text: Behold his hope shal fruſtrate him, and in the ſight of al he shal be caſt downe headlong.
label: Job

text: NOT as cruel wil I raiſe him: for who can reſiſt my countenance?
label: Job

text: Who hath geuen me befote, that I may render vnto him? Al thinges that are vnder heauen be myne.
label: Job

text: I wil not ſpare him, and his mightie wotdes, and framed to beſeech.
label: Job

text: Who shal reuele the face of his garment: and who shal enter into the middes of his mouth?
label: Job

text: Who shal open the gate of his countenance? dreade is round about his teeth.
label: Job

text: His bodie as shildes that are caſt, compact with skales faſt cleauing together.
label: Job

text: One is ioyned to an other, and not ſo much as anie ayre entereth betwen them:
label: Job

text: One shal ſticke to an other, & holding eche other, they shal not be ſeperated.
label: Job

text: His ſneeſing is as the shining of fire, & his eies as the twinklings of the morning.
label: Job

text: Out of his mouth procede lampes, as it were torches of lighted fire.
label: Job

text: Out of his noſthrels procedeth ſmoke, as it were of a pot heated and boyling.
label: Job

text: His breath maketh coales to burne, & a flame cometh fotth out of his mouth.
label: Job

text: In his necke shal ſtrength abide, & needines goeth befote his face.
label: Job

text: The members of his flesh cleaue together one to an other: he shal ſend lightnings againſt him, and he shal not be caried to an other place.
label: Job

text: His hart shal be hardened as a ſtone, and shal be ſtifly compact as the ſmithes ſtithie.
label: Job

text: When he shal be taken away, the Angels shal feare, and being feared shal be purged.
label: Job

text: When the ſword shal apprehend him, neither ſpeare, nor breſtplate shal be able to abide.
label: Job

text: For he shal eſteme yron as chaffe, and braſſe, as rotten wood.
label: Job

text: The bowman shal not put him to flight, the ſtones of the ſling, to him are turned into ſtubble.
label: Job

text: As ſtubble wil he eſteme the hammer, and he wil laugh him to skorne that shaketh the ſpeare.
label: Job

text: The beames of the ſunne shal be vnder him, and he shal ſtraw gold vnder him as durt.
label: Job

text: He shal make the deepe ſea to boyle as a pot, and shal put it as when ointmentes boyle.
label: Job

text: A path shal shine after him, he shal eſteme the depth as waxing old.
label: Job

text: There is no power vpon the earth, that may be compared with him, who is made to feare no man.
label: Job

text: He ſeeth euerie high thing, he is king ouer al the children of pryde.
label: Job

text: AND Iob anſwering our Lord, ſayd:
label: Job

text: I know that thou canſt doe al thinges, and no cogitation is hid from thee.
label: Job

text: Who is this, that concealeth counſel without knowledge? Therfore haue I ſpoken vnwiſely, and the thinges that did excede my knowledge beyond meſure.
label: Job

text: Heare (I beſech thee) and I wil ſpeake: I wil aske thee, and do thou tel me.
label: Job

text: With the hearing of the eare I haue heard thee, but now my eye ſeeth thee.
label: Job

text: Therfore I reprehend my ſelf, and I do penance in imbers and ashes.
label: Job

text: And after our Lord ſpake theſe wordes to Iob, he ſayd to Eliphaz the Themanite: My furie is wrath againſt thee, and againſt thy two frendes, becauſe you haue not ſpoken right before me, as my ſeruant Iob.
label: Job

text: Take therfore vnto you ſeuen oxen, and ſeuen rammes, and goe to my ſeruant Iob, and offer holocauſte for your ſelues: and my ſeruant Iob shal pray for you: his face I wil receiue, that the follie be not imputed to you: for you haue not ſpoken right thinges before me, as my ſeruant Iob.
label: Job

text: Eliphaz therfore the Themanite, and Baldad the Suhite, and Sophar the Naamathite went, and did as our Lord had ſpoken to them, and our Lord receiued the face of Iob.
label: Job

text: Our Lord alſo was turned at the penance of Iob, when he prayed for his freindes. And our Lord added al thinges whatſoeuer had bene Iobes, duble.
label: Job

text: And al his brethren came to him, and al his ſiſters, and al that knew him befote, and they did eate bread with him in his houſe: and wagged the head vpon him, and comforted him vpon al the euil that God had brought in vpon him. And euerie man gaue him one ewe, and one earelet of gold.
label: Job

text: And our Lord bleſſed the laſt daies of Iob more then his beginning. And he had fourtene thouſand sheepe, and ſix thouſand camels, & a thouſand yoke of oxen, and a thouſand she aſſes.
label: Job

text: And he had ſeuen ſonnes, and three daughters.
label: Job

text: And he called the name of one Dies, and the name of the ſecond Caſſia, & the name of the third Cornuſtibij.
label: Job

text: And there were not found in al the earth wemen ſo beautiful as the daughters of Iob: and their father gaue them inheritance among their brethren.
label: Job

text: And Iob liued after theſe thinges, an hundred fourtie yeares, and he ſaw his children, and his childrens children, vnto the fourth generation, and he died an old man, and ful of daies.
label: Job

text: BLESSED is the man, that hath not gone in the counſel of the impious, & hath not ſtoode in the way of ſinners, and hath not ſitte in the chayre of peſtilence:
label: Psalms

text: But his wil is in the way of our Lord, and in his law he wil meditate day and night.
label: Psalms

text: And he shal be as a tree, that is planted nigh to the ſtreames of waters, which shal geue his fruite in his time: And his leafe shal not fal: and al thinges whatſoeuer he shal doe, shal proſper.
label: Psalms

text: The impious not ſo: but as duſt, which the winde driueth from the face of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Therfore the impious shal not riſe againe in iudgement: nor ſinners in the councel of the iuſt.
label: Psalms

text: For our Lord knoweth the way of the iuſt, and the way of the impious shal perish.
label: Psalms

text: WHY did the Gentiles rage, and peoples meditate vaine things?
label: Psalms

text: The kings of the earth ſtood vp, and the princes came together in one againſt our Lord, and againſt his Chriſt.
label: Psalms

text: Let vs breake their bondes a ſunder: and let vs caſt away their yoke from vs.
label: Psalms

text: He that dwelleth in the heauens, shal laugh at them: and our Lord shal ſcorne them.
label: Psalms

text: Then shal he ſpeake to them in his wrath, & in his furie he shal truble them.
label: Psalms

text: But I am appoynted king by him ouer Sion his holie hil, preaching his precept.
label: Psalms

text: The Lord ſaid to me; Thou art my Sonne, I this day haue begotten thee.
label: Psalms

text: Aske of me, and I wil geue thee the Gentiles, for thyne inheritance, and thy poſſeſſion the endes of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Thou shalt rule them in a rod of yron, and as a potters veſſel thou shalt breake them in peeces.
label: Psalms

text: And now ye kings vnderſtand: take inſtruction you that iudge the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Serue our Lord in feare: and reioyce to him with trembling.
label: Psalms

text: Apprehend diſcipline leſt ſometime our Lord be wrath, and you perish out of the iuſt way.
label: Psalms

text: When his wrath shal burne in short time, bleſſed are al, that truſt in him.
label: Psalms

text: The Pſalme of Dauid, when he fled from the face of Abſalom his ſonne. (2. Reg. 15.)
label: Psalms

text: LORD why are they multiplied that truble me? manie riſe vp againſt me.
label: Psalms

text: Many ſay to my ſoule: There is no ſaluation for him in his God.
label: Psalms

text: But thou Lord art my protectour, my glorie, & exalting my head.
label: Psalms

text: With my voice I haue cried to our Lord: and he hath heard me from his holie hil.
label: Psalms

text: I haue ſlept, and haue bene at reſt; and haue riſen vp, becauſe our Lord hath taken me.
label: Psalms

text: I wil not feare thouſandes of people compaſſing me: ariſe Lord, ſaue me my God.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou haſt ſtroken al that are my aduerſaries without cauſe: thou haſt broken the teeth of ſinners.
label: Psalms

text: Saluation is our Lordes: and thy bleſſing vpon thy people.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, in ſongues, the Pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: WHEN I inuocated, the God of my iuſtice heard me: in tribulation thou haſt enlarged to me. Haue mercie on me, and heare my prayer.
label: Psalms

text: Ye ſonnes of men how long are you of heauie hart? why loue you vanitie, and ſeeke lying?
label: Psalms

text: And know ye that our Lord hath made his holie one meruelous: our Lord wil heare me, when I shal crie to him.
label: Psalms

text: Be ye angrie, and ſinne not: the thinges that you ſay in your hartes, in your chambers be ye ſorie for.
label: Psalms

text: Sacrifice ye the ſacrifice of iuſtice, and hope in our Lord. Manie ſay: Who sheweth vs good thinges?
label: Psalms

text: The light of thy countenance ô Lord is ſigned vpon vs: thou haſt geuen gladneſſe in my hart.
label: Psalms

text: By the fruite of their corne, and wine, and oile they are multiplied.
label: Psalms

text: In peace in the ſelfe ſame I wil ſleepe, and reſt:
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou Lord haſt ſingularly ſetled me in hope.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for her that obtaineth the inheritance. The Pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: RECEIVE ô Lord my wordes with thine eares, vnderſtand my crie.
label: Psalms

text: Attend to the voice of my prayer, my king and my God.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe I wil pray to thee: Lord in the morning thou wilt heare my voice.
label: Psalms

text: In the morning I wil ſtand by thee and wil ſee: becauſe thou art not a God that wilt iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: Neither shal the malignant dwel neere thee: neither shal the vniuſt abide before thine eies.
label: Psalms

text: Thou hateſt al that worke iniquitie: thou wilt deſtroy al that ſpeake lie.
label: Psalms

text: The bloudie and deceitful man our Lord wil abhorre:
label: Psalms

text: But I in the multitude of thy mercy. I wil enter into thy houſe: I wil adore toward thy holie temple in thy feare. Lord conduct me in thy iuſtice: becauſe of mine enimies direct my way in thy ſight.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe there is no truth in their mouth: their hart is vayne.
label: Psalms

text: Their throte is an open ſepulchre, they did deceitfully with their tongues, iudge them o God.
label: Psalms

text: Let them faile of their cogitations, according to the multitude of their impieties expel them, becauſe they haue prouoked thee ô Lord.
label: Psalms

text: And let al be glad, that hope in thee, they shal reioyce for euer: and thou shalt dwel in them. And al that loue thy name shal glorie in thee, becauſe thou wilt bleſſe the iuſt.
label: Psalms

text: Lord, as with a shield of thy good wil, thou haſt crowned vs.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end in ſongs, the Pſalme of Dauid for the octaue.
label: Psalms

text: LORD, rebuke me not in thy furie; nor chaſtiſe me in thy wrath.
label: Psalms

text: Haue mercie on me Lord, becauſe I am weake: heale me Lord, becauſe al my bones be trubled.
label: Psalms

text: And my ſoule is trubled exceedingly: but thou Lord how long?
label: Psalms

text: Turne thee o Lord, and deliuer my ſoule: ſaue me for thy mercie.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe there is not in death, that is mindful of thee: and in hel who shal confeſſe to thee?
label: Psalms

text: I haue labored in my ſighing, I wil euerie night washe my bed; I wil water my couche with my teares.
label: Psalms

text: My eye is trubled for furie: I haue waxen old among al myne enemies.
label: Psalms

text: Depart from me al ye that worke iniquitie: becauſe our Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord hath heard my petition, our Lord hath receiued my prayer.
label: Psalms

text: Let al myne enemies be ashamed, & very ſore trubled: let them be conuerted and ashamed very quicly.
label: Psalms

text: The Pſalme of Dauid which he ſong to our Lord, for the wordes of Chuſi the ſonne Iemini. (2. Reg. 16.)
label: Psalms

text: O Lord my God I haue hoped in thee: ſaue me from al that perſecute me, and deliuer me.
label: Psalms

text: Leſt ſometime he as a Lyon violently take my ſoule, whiles there is none to redeme, nor to ſaue.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord my God if I haue done this, if there be iniquitie in my handes;
label: Psalms

text: If I haue rendred to them that repayd me euils, let me worthely fal emptie from myne enemies.
label: Psalms

text: Let the enemie perſecute my ſoule, and take it, and treade downe my life in the earth, and bring downe my glorie into the duſt.
label: Psalms

text: Ariſe Lord in thy wrath: and be exalted in the coaſtes of myne enemies. And ariſe ô Lord my God in the precept which thou haſt cõmanded:
label: Psalms

text: and a ſinagogue of peoples shal compaſſe thee. And for it returne on high:
label: Psalms

text: our Lord iudgeth peoples. Iudge me ô Lord according to my iuſtice, and according to my innocencie vpon me.
label: Psalms

text: The wickedneſſe of ſinners shal be conſumed, and thou shalt direct the iuſt, which ſearcheſt the hart and raynes ô God.
label: Psalms

text: My iuſt helpe is from our Lord, who ſaueth thoſe that be right of hart.
label: Psalms

text: God is a iuſt iudge, ſtrong, & patient: is he angrie euerie day?
label: Psalms

text: Vnleſſe you wil be conuerted, he shal shake his ſword; he hath bent his bow, and prepared it.
label: Psalms

text: And in it he hath prepared the veſſels of death: he hath made his arrowes for them that burne.
label: Psalms

text: Behold he hath bredde with iniuſtice: he hath conceiued ſorow, and brought forth iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: He hath opened a pit, and digged it vp: and he is fallen into the diche, which he made.
label: Psalms

text: His ſorrow shal be turned vpon his head: and his iniquitie shal deſcend vpon his crowne.
label: Psalms

text: I wil confeſſe to our Lord according to his iuſtice: and wil ſing to the name of our Lord moſt high.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end for preſſes, the Pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: O LORD our Lord, how meruelous is thy name in the whole earth! Becauſe thy magnificence is eleuated, aboue the heauens.
label: Psalms

text: Out of the mouth of infantes and ſucklinges, thou haſt perfected praiſe becauſe of thine enemies, that thou mayeſt deſtroy the enemie and reuenger.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe I shal ſee thy heauens, the workes of thy fingers: the moone and the ſtarres, which thou haſt founded.
label: Psalms

text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the ſonne of man, that thou viſiteſt him?
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt minished him a litle leſſe then Angels; with glorie and honour thou haſt crowned him:
label: Psalms

text: and haſt appointed him ouer the worke of thy handes.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt ſubiected al thinges vnder his feete, al sheepe and oxen: moreouer alſo the beaſtes of the field.
label: Psalms

text: The birdes of the ayre, and fishes of the ſea; that walke the pathes of the ſea.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord our Lord, how meruelous is thy name in the whole earth!
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for the ſecrets of the ſonne, the Pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: I WIL confeſſe to thee ô Lord with al my hart: I wil tel al thy meruelous thinges.
label: Psalms

text: I wil be glad and reioyce in thee: I wil ſing to thy name ô moſt High.
label: Psalms

text: In turning mine enemie backward: they shal be weakened, and perish before thy face.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou haſt done my iudgement and my cauſe: thou haſt ſitte vpon the throne which iudgeſt iuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt rebuked the Gentiles, and the impious hath perished: their name thou haſt deſtroyed for euer, and for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: The ſwordes of the enemie haue fayled vnto the end: and their cities thou haſt deſtroyed.
label: Psalms

text: Their memorie hath perished wirh a ſound: and our Lord abideth for euer. He hath prepared his throne in iudgement:
label: Psalms

text: & he wil iudge the whole world in equitie, he wil iudge the people in iuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: And our Lord is made a refuge for the poore: an helper in opportunities, in tribulation.
label: Psalms

text: And let them hope in thee that know thy name: becauſe thou haſt not forſaken them that ſeeke thee ô Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Sing to our Lord, which dwelleth in Sion: declare his ſtudies among the Gentiles:
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he requiring bloud remembred them: he hath not forgotten the crie of the poore.
label: Psalms

text: Haue mercie on me ô Lord: See my humiliation by my enemies.
label: Psalms

text: Which exalteſt me from the gates of death, that I may declare al thy prayſes in the gates of the daughter of Sion.
label: Psalms

text: I wil reioyce in thy ſaluation: the Gentiles are faſtened in the deſtruction, which they made. In this ſnare, which they hid, is their foote taken.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord shal be knowen doing iudgements: the ſinner is taken in the workes of his owne handes.
label: Psalms

text: Let ſinners be turned into hel, al nations that forget God.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe to the end there shal not be obliuion of the poore man: the patience of the poore, shal not perish in the end.
label: Psalms

text: Ariſe Lord, let not man be ſtrengthned: let the Gentiles be iudged in thy ſight.
label: Psalms

text: Appoint Lord a lawgeuer ouer them: that the Gentiles may know that they be men.
label: Psalms

text: Why Lord haſt thou departed far of, deſpiſeſt in opportunities, in tribulation?
label: Psalms

text: Whiles the impious is proude, the poore is ſet on fyre: they are caught in the counſels which they deuiſe.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe the ſinner is prayſed in the deſires of his ſoule: and the vniuſt man is bleſſed.
label: Psalms

text: The ſinner hath exaſperated our Lord, according to the multitude of his wrath he shal not ſeeke.
label: Psalms

text: There is no God in his ſight: his waies are defiled at al time. Thy iudgementes are taken away from his face: he shal rule ouer al his enemies
label: Psalms

text: For he hath ſayd in his hart: I wil not be moued from generation vnto generation, without euil.
label: Psalms

text: Whoſe mouth is ful of curſing, and bitterneſſe, and guile: vnder his tongue labour and ſorrow.
label: Psalms

text: He ſitteth in waite with the rich in ſecrete places, to kil the innocent.
label: Psalms

text: His eyes looke vpon the poore: he lyeth in wayte in ſecret, as a lyon in his denne.
label: Psalms

text: He lyeth in wayte to take the poore man violently: violently to take the poore man whiles he draweth him. In his ſnare he wil humble him ſelfe, and shal fal when he shal haue dominion ouer the poore.
label: Psalms

text: For he hath ſayed in his hart; God hath forgotten, he hath turned away his face not to ſee for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Ariſe Lord God, let thy hand be axalted: forget not the poore.
label: Psalms

text: Wherfore hath the impious prouoked God? for he hath ſaid in his hart; He wil not enquire.
label: Psalms

text: Thou ſeeſt, that thou conſidereſt labour and ſorrow: that thou mayeſt deliuer them into thy handes. To thee is the poore left: to the orphane thou wilt be an helper
label: Psalms

text: Breake the arme of the ſinner and malignant: his ſinne shal be ſought, and shal not be found.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord shal reigne for euer, and for euer and euer: ye Gentiles shal perish from his land.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord hath heard the deſire of the poore: thy eare hath heard the preperation of their hart,
label: Psalms

text: To iudge for the pupil and the humble, that man adde no more to magnifie him ſelfe vpon the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end the pſalme of Dauid I TRVST in our Lord: how ſay ye to my ſoule: Paſſe ouer vnto the mountayne as a ſparrow?
label: Psalms

text: For behold ſinners haue bent the bow, they haue prepared their arrowes in the quiuer, that they may shoote in the darke, at them that be right of hart.
label: Psalms

text: For they haue deſtroyed the thinges, which thou didſt perfite: but the iuſt what hath he done?
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is in his holie temple, our Lord his ſeate is in heauen.
label: Psalms

text: His eies haue reſpect vnto the poore: his eieliddes examine the ſonnes of men.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord examineth the iuſt, and the impious: but he that loueth iniquity, hateth his owne ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: He shal rayne ſnares vpon ſinners: fyre and brimſtone, and blaſt of ſtormes the portion of their cuppe.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord is iuſt and hath loued iuſtice: his countenance hath ſeene equitie.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end for the octaue, the Pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: SAVE me Lord, becauſe the holy hath fayled becauſe verities are diminished from among the children of men.
label: Psalms

text: They haue ſpoken vaine thinges euerie one to his neighbour, deiceitful lippes, they haue ſpoken in hart and hart,
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord deſtroy al deceitful lippes, & the tongue that ſpeaketh great thinges
label: Psalms

text: Which haue ſaid: We wil magnifie our tongue, our lippes are of vs, who is our Lord?
label: Psalms

text: For the miſerie of the needie, and mourning of the poore, now wil I ariſe, ſaith our Lord: I wil put in a ſaluation: I wil do confidently in him.
label: Psalms

text: Wordes of our Lord, be chaiſt wordes: ſiluer examined by fire, tryed from the earth, purged ſeuen fold.
label: Psalms

text: Thou Lord wilt preſerue vs: and keepe vs from this generation for euer.
label: Psalms

text: The impious walke round about: according to thy highnes thou haſt multiplied the children of men.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, the Pſalme of Dauid. HOw long ô Lord wilt thou forget me vnto the end? How long doeſt thou turne away thy face from me?
label: Psalms

text: How long shal I put counſels in my ſoule, ſorrow in my hart by day?
label: Psalms

text: How long shal mine enemies be exalted ouer me? Regard and heare me ô Lord my God.
label: Psalms

text: Illuminate mine eies that I ſleepe not in death at any time: leſt ſometime mine enemie ſay: I haue preuailed againſt him.
label: Psalms

text: They that truble me, wil reioyce if I be moued: but I haue hoped in thy mercie.
label: Psalms

text: My hart shal reioyce in thy ſaluation: I wil ſing to our Lord which geueth me good thinges: and I wil ſing to the name of our Lord moſt high.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, the Pſalme of Dauid. THE foole hath ſaid in his hart: There is no God. They are corrupt, and are become abominable in their ſtudies: there is not that doth good no not one.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord hath looked forth from heauen vpon the children of men, to ſee if there be that vnderſtandeth, and ſeeketh after God.
label: Psalms

text: Al haue declined, they are become vnprofitable together: there is not that doth good, no not one. Their throte is an open ſepulchre: with theit tongues they did deceitfully, the poyſon of aſpes vnder their lippes. Whoſe mouth is ful of curſing and bitterneſſe: their feete ſwift to sheed bloud. Deſtruction and infelicitie in their waies, and the way of peace they haue not knowen: there is no feare of God before their eies.
label: Psalms

text: Shal not al they know that worke iniquitie, that deuoure my people as foode of bread?
label: Psalms

text: They haue not inuocated our Lard, there haue they trembled for feare, where no feare was:
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord is in the iuſt generation, you haue confounded the counſel of the poore man: becauſe our Lord is his hope.
label: Psalms

text: Who wil geue from Sion the ſaluation of Iſrael? when our Lord shal haue turned away the captiuitie of his people, Iacob shal reioyce, and Iſrael shal be glad.
label: Psalms

text: The Pſalme of Dauid. LORD who shal dwel in thy tabernacle? or who shal reſt in thy holie hil?
label: Psalms

text: He that walketh without ſpot, and worketh iuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: He that ſpeaketh truth in his hart, that hath not done guile in his tongue. Nor hath done euil to his neighbour, and hath not taken reproch againſt his neighbour,
label: Psalms

text: The malignant is brought to nothing in his ſight; but them that feare our Lord, he glorifieth: he that ſweareth to his neighbour, and deceiueth not,
label: Psalms

text: that hath not geuen his money to vſurie, and hath not taken giftes vpon the innocent: He that doeth theſe thinges, shal not be moued for euer.
label: Psalms

text: The inſcription of the title to Dauid him ſelf. PRESERVE me ô Lord, becauſe I haue hoped in thee.
label: Psalms

text: I haue ſaid to our Lord: Thou art my God, becauſe thou needeſt not my goods.
label: Psalms

text: To the ſainctes, that are in his land, he hath made al my willes meruelous in them.
label: Psalms

text: Their infirmities were multiplied: afterward they made haſt. I wil not aſſemble their conuenticles of bloud: neither wil I be mindful of their names by my lippes.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord the portion of myne inheritance, and of my cuppe: thou art he, that wil reſtore myne inheritance vnto me.
label: Psalms

text: Cordes are fallen to me in goodly places: for mine inheritance is goodlie vnto me.
label: Psalms

text: I wil bleſſe our Lord, who hath geuen me vnderſtanding: moreouer alſo euen til night, my veines haue rebuked me.
label: Psalms

text: I forſaw our Lord in my ſight alwaies: becauſe he is at my right hand, that I be not moued.
label: Psalms

text: For this thing my hart hath beene glad, and my tongue hath reioyced: moreouer alſo my flesh shal reſt in hope.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou wilt not leaue my ſoule in hel: neither wilt geue thy holie one to ſee corruption. Thou haſt made the waies of life knowen to me, thou shalt make me ful of ioy with thy countenance: delectations on thy right hand, euen to the end.
label: Psalms

text: The prayer of Dauid. HEARE ô Lord my iuſtice: attend my petition: With thine eares heare my prayer, not in deceitful lippes.
label: Psalms

text: From thy countenanee let my iudgement procede: let thine eies ſee equities.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt proued my hart, and viſited it by night: by fire thou haſt examined me, and there is no iniquitie found in me.
label: Psalms

text: That my mouth ſpeake not the workes of men: for the wordes of thy lippes I haue kept the hard wayes.
label: Psalms

text: Perfite my paſes in thy pathes: that my ſteppes be not moued.
label: Psalms

text: I haue cried, becauſe thou haſt heard me ô God: incline thyne eare to me, and heare my wordes.
label: Psalms

text: Make thy mercies meruelous, which ſaueſt them that hope in thee.
label: Psalms

text: From them that reſiſt thy right hand keepe me, as the apple of the eie. Vnder the shadowe of thy winges protect me:
label: Psalms

text: from the face of the impious, that haue afflicted me. Mine enemies haue compaſſed my ſoule,
label: Psalms

text: they haue shut vp their fatte; their mouth hath ſpoken pride.
label: Psalms

text: Caſting me forth now haue they compaſſed me: they haue ſette their eies to bend them vnto the earth.
label: Psalms

text: They haue taken me as a lion readie to the pray: and as a lions whelpe dwelling in hid places.
label: Psalms

text: Ariſe Lord, preuent him, and ſupplant him: deliuer my ſoule from the impious, thy ſword
label: Psalms

text: from the enemies of thy hand. Lord from a few out of the land diuide them, in their life: their bellie is filled of thy ſecretes. They are filled with children: and they haue leaft their remnantes to their litle ones.
label: Psalms

text: But I in iuſtice shal appeare to thy ſight: I shal be filled when thy glorie shal appeare?
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, to the ſeruant of our Lord Dauid, who ſpake to our Lord the wordes of this canticle, in the day, that our Lord deliuered him out of the hand of al his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul, and he ſaid: (2. Reg. 22.) I wil loue thee ô Lord my ſtrength:
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is my firmament, and my refuge, and my deliuere.
label: Psalms

text: My God is my helper, and I wil hope in him. My protectour and the horne of my ſaluation, and my receiuer.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſing I wil inuocate our Lord: and I shal be ſaued from mine enemies.
label: Psalms

text: The ſorrowes of death haue compaſſed me: and torrentes of iniquitie haue trubled me.
label: Psalms

text: The ſorrowes of hel haue compaſſed me: the ſnares of death haue preuented me.
label: Psalms

text: In my tribulation I haue inuocated our Lord, and haue cried to my God: And he hath heard my voice from his holie temple: and my crie in his ſight, hath entered into his eares.
label: Psalms

text: The earth was shaken & trembled: the fundations of mountaines were trubled, and were moued, becauſe he was wrath with them.
label: Psalms

text: Smoke aroſe in his wrath: and fire flamed vp from his face: coles were kindled from him.
label: Psalms

text: He bowed the heauens, and deſcended: and darkeneſſe vnder his feete.
label: Psalms

text: And he aſcended vpon the cherubs, and flew: he flew vpon the wings of windes.
label: Psalms

text: And he put darkeneſſe his couert, his tabernacle is round about him: darkeſome water in the cloudes of the aire.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe of the brightneſſe in his ſight the cloudes paſſed, hayle and coles of fire.
label: Psalms

text: And our Lord thundered from heauen, and the Higheſt gaue his voice: haile and coles of fire.
label: Psalms

text: And he shot his arrowes, and diſſipated them: he multiplied lightnings, and trubled them.
label: Psalms

text: And the fountaynes of waters appeared, and the fundations of the world were reueled. At thy rebuke ô Lord, at the blaſt of the ſpirit of thy wrath.
label: Psalms

text: He ſent from on high, and tooke me: and he receiued me out of manie waters.
label: Psalms

text: He deliuered me from my moſt ſtrong enemies, and from them that hated me: becauſe they were made ſtrong ouer me.
label: Psalms

text: They preuented me in the day of mine affliction: and our Lord was made my protectour.
label: Psalms

text: And he brought me out into largeneſſe: he ſaued me, becauſe he would me.
label: Psalms

text: And our Lord wil reward me according to my iuſtice, and according to the purity of my handes he wil reward me.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe I haue kept the waies of our Lord, neither haue I done impiouſly from my God.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe al his iudgementes are in my ſight: and his iuſtices I haue not repelled from me.
label: Psalms

text: And I shal be immaculate with him; and shal keepe me from mine iniquitie.
label: Psalms
