text: And our Lord wil reward me according to my iuſtice: and according to the puritie of my handes in the ſight of his eies.
label: Psalms

text: With the holie thou shalt be holie, and with the innocent man thou shalt be innocent.
label: Psalms

text: And with the elect thou shalt be elect: and with the peruerſe thou shalt be peruerted.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou wilt ſaue the humble people: and the eies of the proud thou wilt humble.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou doſt illuminate my lampe ô Lord: my God illuminate my darkeneſſe.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe in thee I shal be deliuered from tentation, and in my God I shal goe ouer the wal.
label: Psalms

text: My God his way is vnpolluted: the wordes of our Lord are examined by fire: he is protector of al that hope in him.
label: Psalms

text: For who is God but our Lord? or who is God but our God?
label: Psalms

text: God that girded me with ſtrength: and made my way immaculate.
label: Psalms

text: That perfited my feete as it were of hartes: and ſetting me vpon high thinges.
label: Psalms

text: That teacheth my handes to battel: and haſt put mine armes, as a bow of braſſe.
label: Psalms

text: And haſt geuen me the protection of thy ſaluation: and thy right hand hath receiued me: And thy diſcipline hath corrected me vnto the end: and thy diſcipline the ſame shal teach me.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt enlarged my paſes vnder me: and my ſteppes are not weakened:
label: Psalms

text: I wil purſew myne enemies, and ouertake them: and wil not returne til they faile.
label: Psalms

text: I wil breake them, neither shal they be able to ſtand: they shal fal vnder my feete.
label: Psalms

text: And thou haſt girded me with ſtrength to battel: and haſt ſupplanted them that riſe againſt me vnder me.
label: Psalms

text: And myne enemies thou haſt geuen me their backe, and them that hate me thou haſt deſtroyed.
label: Psalms

text: They cried, neither was there that would ſaue them, to our Lord; neither did he heare them.
label: Psalms

text: And I wil breake them to powder, as the duſt before the face of winde: as the durt of the ſtreates I wil deſtroy them.
label: Psalms

text: Thou wilt deliuer me from the contradictions of the people: thou wilt appoynte me to be head of the Gentiles.
label: Psalms

text: A people, which I knew not, hath ſerued me: in the hearing of the eare it hath obeyed me.
label: Psalms

text: The children being alienes haue lyed to me, the children alienes are inueterated, and haue halted from their pathes.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord liueth, and bleſſed be my God, and the God of my ſaluation be exalted.
label: Psalms

text: O God which geueſt me reuenges, & ſubdeweſt peoples vnder me, my deliuerer from mine angrie enemies.
label: Psalms

text: And from them that riſe vp againſt me thou wilt exalt me: from the vniuſt man thou wilt deliuer me.
label: Psalms

text: Therfore wil I confeſſe to thee among nations ô Lord: and wil ſay a pſalme to thy name,
label: Psalms

text: Magnifying the ſaluations of his king, and doing mercie to his Chriſt Dauid, and to his ſeede for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, the pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: THE heauens shew forth the glorie of God, and the firmament declareth the workes of his handes.
label: Psalms

text: Day vnto day vttereth word: and night vnto night sheweth knowledge.
label: Psalms

text: There are no languages, nor ſpeaches, whoſe voyces are not heard.
label: Psalms

text: Their ſound hath gone forth into al the earth; and vnto the endes of the round world the wordes of them.
label: Psalms

text: He put his tabernacle in the ſunne: & himſelf as a bridgrome coming forth of his bridechamber. He hath reioyced as a giant to runne the way,
label: Psalms

text: his comming forth from the toppe of heauen: And his recourſe euen to the toppe therof: neither is there that can hide him ſelfe from his heate.
label: Psalms

text: The law of our Lord is immaculate conuerting ſoules: the teſtimonie of our Lord is faithful, geuing wiſedome to litle ones.
label: Psalms

text: The iuſtices of our Lord be right, making hartes ioyful: the precept of our Lord lightſome; illuminating the eies.
label: Psalms

text: The feare of our Lord is holie, permanent for euer and euer: the iudgmentes of our Lord be true, iuſtified in themſelues.
label: Psalms

text: To be deſired aboue gold and much pretious ſtone: and more ſweete aboue honie and the honie combe.
label: Psalms

text: For thy ſeruant keepeth them, in keeping them is much reward.
label: Psalms

text: Sinnes who vnderſtandeth? from my ſecrete ſinnes cleanſe me:
label: Psalms

text: and from other mens ſpare thy ſeruant. If they shal not haue dominion ouer me, then shal I be immaculate; and shal be cleanſed from the greateſt ſinne.
label: Psalms

text: And the wordes of my mouth shal be ſuch as may pleaſe: and the meditation of my hart in thy ſight alwayes. O Lord my helper, and my redemer.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, the Pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: OVr Lord heare thee in the day of tribulation: the name of the God of Iacob protect thee.
label: Psalms

text: Send he ayde to thee from the holie place: and from Sion defend he thee.
label: Psalms

text: Be he mindeful of al thy ſacrifice: and be thy holocauſt made fatte.
label: Psalms

text: Geue he vnto thee according to thy hart: and confirme he al thy counſel.
label: Psalms

text: We shal reioyce in thy ſaluation: and in the name of our God we shal be magnified.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord accomplish al thy petitions: now haue I knowen that our Lord hath ſaued his CHRIST. He shal heare him from his holie heauen: the ſaluation of his righthand is, in powers.
label: Psalms

text: Theſe in chariotes, and theſe in horſes: but we wil inuocate in the name of the Lord our God.
label: Psalms

text: They are bound, and haue fallen: but we haue riſen and are ſet vpright.
label: Psalms

text: Lord ſaue the king, and heare vs in the day, that we shal inuocate thee.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, the Pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: LOrd in thy power the king shal be glad: and vpon thy ſaluation he shal reioyce excedingly.
label: Psalms

text: The deſire of his hart thou haſt geuen him: and of the wil of his lippes thou haſt not defrauded him.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou haſt preuented him in bleſſinges of ſweetneſſe: thou haſt put on his head a crowne of pretious ſtone.
label: Psalms

text: He asked life of thee: and thou gaueſt him length of daies for euer, and for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: Great is his glorie in thy ſaluation: glorie and great beautie thou shalt put vpon him.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou shalt geue him to be a bleſſing for euer and euer: thou shalt make him ioyful in gladeneſſe with thy countenance.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe the king hopeth in our Lord: and in the mercie of the Higheſt he shal not be moued.
label: Psalms

text: Let thy hand be found of al thy enemies: let thy righthand find al, that hate thee.
label: Psalms

text: Thou shalt put them as an ouen of fyre in the time of thy countenance: our Lord in his wrath shal truble them, and fyre shal deuoure them.
label: Psalms

text: Their fruite thou shalt deſtroy from the land: and their ſeede from the children of men.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe they haue turned the euils vpon thee: they haue deuiſed counſels, which they could not eſtablish.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou shalt put them backe: in thy remnantes thou shalt prepare their countenance.
label: Psalms

text: Be exalted Lord in thy powre: we wil chaunte and ſing thy powers.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end for the morning enterpriſe, the Pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: GOD my God haue reſpect to me: why haſt thou forſaken me? far from my ſaluation are the wordes of my ſinnes.
label: Psalms

text: My God I shal crie by day, and thou wilt not heare: and by night, and not for follie vnto me.
label: Psalms

text: But thou dwelleſt in the holie place, the prayſe of Iſrael.
label: Psalms

text: In thee our fathers haue hoped: they hoped, and thou didſt deliuer them.
label: Psalms

text: They cried to thee, and were ſaued: they hoped in thee, and were not confounded.
label: Psalms

text: But I am a worme and no man: a reproch of men and outcaſt of the people.
label: Psalms

text: Al that ſee me haue ſcorned me: they haue ſpoken with the lippes, and wagged the head.
label: Psalms

text: He hoped in the Lord, let him deliuer him: let him ſaue him, becauſe he wil him.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou art he that haſt drawen me out of the wombe: my hope from the breſtes of my mother.
label: Psalms

text: Vpon thee I haue bene caſt from the matrice: from my mothers wombe thou art my God,
label: Psalms

text: depart not from me. Becauſe tribulation is verie nigh: becauſe there is not that wil helpe.
label: Psalms

text: Manie calues haue compaſſed me: fatte bulles haue beſieged me.
label: Psalms

text: They haue opened their mouth vpon me, as a lion rauening and roaring.
label: Psalms

text: As water I am powred out: and al my bones are diſperſed. My hart is made as waxe melting in the middes of my bellie.
label: Psalms

text: My ſtrength is withered as a pot-shard, and my tongue cleaued to my iawes: and thou haſt brought me downe into the duſt of death.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe manie dogges haue compaſſed me: the counſel of the malignant hath beſieged me. They haue digged my handes and my feete:
label: Psalms

text: they haue numbered al my bones. But themſelues haue conſidered and beheld me:
label: Psalms

text: they haue deuided my garmentes among them, and vpon my veſture they haue caſt lot.
label: Psalms

text: But thou Lord prolong not thy helpe from me: looke toward my defenſe.
label: Psalms

text: Deliuer, ô God, my ſoule from the ſword: and myne onlie one from the hand of the dog.
label: Psalms

text: Saue me out of the lions mouth: and my humilitie from the hornes of vnicornes.
label: Psalms

text: I wil declare thy name to my bretheren: in the middes of the Church I wil prayſe thee.
label: Psalms

text: Ye that feare our Lord praiſe him: al the ſeede of Iacob glorifie ye him:
label: Psalms

text: Let al the ſeede of Iſrael feare him: becauſe he hath not contemned, nor deſpiſed the petition of the poore. Neither hath he turned away his face from me: and when I cried to him he heard me.
label: Psalms

text: With thee is my praiſe in the great Church: I wil render my vowes in the ſight of them that feare him.
label: Psalms

text: The poore shal eate, and shalbe filled: and they shal praiſe our Lord that ſeeke after him: their hartes shal liue for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: Al the endes of the earth shal remember, and be conuerted to our Lord: And al the families of the Gentiles shal adore in his ſight.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe the kingdome is our Lords: and he shal haue dominion ouer the Gentiles.
label: Psalms

text: Al the fatte ones of the earth haue eaten, and adored: in his ſight shal al fal, that deſcend into the earth.
label: Psalms

text: And my ſoule shal liue to him: and my ſeede shal ſerue him.
label: Psalms

text: The generation to come shal be shewed to our Lord: and the heauens shal shew forth his iuſtice to the people that shal be borne, whom our Lord hath made.
label: Psalms

text: The Pſalme of Dauid. OVr Lord ruleth me, and nothing shal be wanting to me:
label: Psalms

text: in place of paſture there he hath placed me . Vpon the water of refection he hath brought me vp:
label: Psalms

text: he hath conuerted my ſoule. He hath conducted me vpon the pathes of iuſtice, for his name.
label: Psalms

text: For, although I shal walke in the middes of the shadow of death, I wil not feare euils: becauſe thou art with me. Thy rod and thy ſtaffe: they haue comforted me.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt prepared in my ſight a table, againſt them; that truble me. Thou haſt fatted my head with oyle: and my chalice inebriating how goodlie is it!
label: Psalms

text: And thy mercie shal folow me al the dayes of my life: And that I may dwel in the houſe of our Lord, in longitude of dayes.
label: Psalms

text: The firſt of the Sabbath, the Pſalme of Dauid. THE earth is our Lordes, and the fulneſſe therof: the round world, and al that dwel therein.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath founded it vpon the ſeas: and vpon the riuers hath prepared it.
label: Psalms

text: Who shal aſcend into the mount of our Lord? or who shal ſtand in his holie place?
label: Psalms

text: The innocent of handes, and of cleane hart, that hath not taken his ſoule in vayne, nor ſworne to his neighbour in guile.
label: Psalms

text: He shal receiue bleſſing of our Lord: and mercie of God his Sauiour.
label: Psalms

text: This is the generation of them that ſeeke him, of them that ſeeke the face of the God of Iacob.
label: Psalms

text: Lift vp your gates ye princes, and be ye lifted vp ô eternal gates: and the king of glorie shal enter in,
label: Psalms

text: Who is this king of glorie? Our Lord ſtrong & mightie, our Lord mightie in battel.
label: Psalms

text: Lift vp your gates ye princes, and be ye lifted vp ô eternal gates: and the king of glorie shal enter in.
label: Psalms

text: Who is this king of glorie? The Lord of powers he is the king of glorie.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, the Pſalme of Dauid. TO THEE ô Lord I haue lifted vp my ſoule:
label: Psalms

text: my God in thee is my confidence, let me not be ashamed:
label: Psalms

text: Neither let mine enemies ſcorne me: for al that expect thee, shal not be confounded.
label: Psalms

text: Let al be confounded that do vniuſt thinges in vayne. Lord shew me thy wayes: and teach me thy pathes.
label: Psalms

text: Direct me in thy truth, and teach me: becauſe thou art God my Sauiour, and thee haue I expected al the day.
label: Psalms

text: Remember ô Lord thy commiſerations, and thy mercies: that are from the beginning of the world.
label: Psalms

text: The ſinnes of my youth, and my ignorances doe not remember. According to thy mercie remember thou me: for thy goodneſſe ô Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is ſweete, and righteous: for this cauſe he wil geue a law to them that ſinne in the way.
label: Psalms

text: He wil direct the milde in iudgement: he wil teach the meeke his wayes.
label: Psalms

text: Al the wayes of our Lord, be mercie and truth, to them that ſeeke after his teſtament and his teſtimonies.
label: Psalms

text: For thy name ô Lord thou wilt be propitious to my ſinne: for it is much.
label: Psalms

text: Who is the man that feareth our Lord? he appoynteth him a law in the way, that he hath choſen.
label: Psalms

text: His ſoule shal abide in good things: and his ſeede shal inherite the land.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is a firmament to them that feare him: & his teſtament that it may be made manifeſt to them.
label: Psalms

text: Myne eies are alwayes to our Lord: becauſe he wil plucke my feete out of the ſnare.
label: Psalms

text: Haue reſpect to me, and haue mercie on me: becauſe I am alone and poore.
label: Psalms

text: The tribulations of my hart are multiplied: deliuer me from my neceſſities.
label: Psalms

text: See my humiliation, and my labour: and forgeue al my ſinnes.
label: Psalms

text: Behold mine enemies, becauſe they are multiplied, and with vniuſt hatred hated me.
label: Psalms

text: Keepe my ſoule, and deliuer me: I shal not be ashamed, becauſe I hoped in thee.
label: Psalms

text: The innocent and righteous haue cleaued to me: becauſe I expected thee.
label: Psalms

text: Deliuer Iſrael ô God, out of al his tribulations.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end the Pſalme of Dauid. IVDGE me ô Lord becauſe I haue walked in my innocencie: and hoping in our Lord I shal not be weakened.
label: Psalms

text: Proue me Lord, and tempt me: burne my reynes and my hart.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thy mercie is before mine eies: and I am wel pleaſed in thy truth.
label: Psalms

text: I haue not ſitten with the councel of vanitie: and with them that doe vniuſt thinges. I wil not enter in
label: Psalms

text: I haue hated the Church of the malignant: and with the impious I wil not ſitte.
label: Psalms

text: I wil wash my handes among innocentes: and wil compaſſe thy altar ô Lord:
label: Psalms

text: That I may heare the voice of praiſe, and shew forth al thy meruelous workes.
label: Psalms

text: Lord I haue loued the beautie of thy houſe, and the place of the habitation of thy glorie.
label: Psalms

text: Deſtroy not ô God my ſoule with the impious, and my life with bloudie men.
label: Psalms

text: In whoſe handes are iniquities: their righthand is replenished with giftes.
label: Psalms

text: But I haue walked in mine innocencie: redeme me, and haue mercie on me.
label: Psalms

text: My foote hath ſtood in the direct way: in the Churches I wil bleſſe thee ô Lord.
label: Psalms

text: The Pſalme of Dauid before he was annoynted. OVr Lord is my illumination, and my ſaluation, whom shal I feare? Our Lord is the protectour of my life, of whom shal I be afrayd?
label: Psalms

text: Whiles the harmeful approch vpon me, to eate my flesh. Mine enemies that truble me, them ſelues are weakened and are fallen.
label: Psalms

text: If campes ſtand together againſt me, my hart shal not feare. If battel riſe vp againſt me, in this wil I hope.
label: Psalms

text: One thing I haue asked of our Lord, this wil I ſeeke for, that I may dwel in the houſe of our Lord al the dayes of my life. That I may ſee the pleaſentnes of our Lord, and viſite his temple.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath hid me in his tabernacle: in the day of euils he hath protected me, in the ſecrete of his tabernacle.
label: Psalms

text: In a rocke he hath exalted me: and now he hath exalted my head ouer mine enemies. I haue gone round about, and haue immolated in his tabernacle an hoſt of iubilation: I wil ſing, and ſay a Pſalme to our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Heare ô Lord my voice, wherwith I haue cried to thee: haue mercie on me, and heare me.
label: Psalms

text: My hart hath ſayd to thee, my face hath ſought thee out: thy face ô Lord I wil ſeeke.
label: Psalms

text: Turne not away thy face from me: decline not in wrath from thy ſeruant. Be thou my helper: forſake me not, neither deſpiſe me ô God my Sauiour.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe my father and my mother haue forſaken me: but our Lord hath taken me.
label: Psalms

text: Geue me a law ô Lord in thy way: and direct me in the right path, becauſe of mine enemies.
label: Psalms

text: Deliuer me not into the ſoules of them that truble me: becauſe vniuſt witneſſes haue riſen vp againſt me, and iniquity hath lyed to it ſelfe.
label: Psalms

text: I beleue to ſee the good things of our Lord, in the land of the liuing.
label: Psalms

text: Expect our Lord, doe manfully: and let thy hart take courage, and expect thou our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme to Dauid him ſelfe. TO THEE ô Lord I wil crie, my God keepe not ſilence from me: leſt at any time thou hold thy peace from me, and I shal be like to them that goe downe into the lake.
label: Psalms

text: Heare ô Lord the voice of my petition whiles I pray to thee: whiles I lift vp my handes to thy holie temple.
label: Psalms

text: Draw me not together with ſinners: and with them that worke iniquitie deſtroy me not. Which ſpeake peace with their neighbour, but euils in their hartes.
label: Psalms

text: Geue them according to their workes, and according to the wickedneſſe of their inuentions. According to the workes of their handes geue vnto them: render them their retribution.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe they haue not vnderſtood the workes of our Lord, and in the workes of his handes thou shalt deſtroy them, and not build them vp.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed be our Lord: becauſe he hath heard the voice of my petition.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is my helper, and my protectour: in him my hart hath hoped, and I was holpen. And my flesh florished againe: and with my wil I wil confeſſe to him.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is the ſtrength of his people: and he is the protector of the ſaluations of his annoynted.
label: Psalms

text: Saue thy people ô Lord, and bleſſe thine inheritance: and rule them, and extol them for euer.
label: Psalms

text: The Pſalme of Dauid, in the conſummation of the tabernacle. BRING to our Lord ye children of God: bring to our Lord the ſonnes of rammes.
label: Psalms

text: Bring to our Lord glorie and honour, bring to our Lord glorie vnto his name: adore ye our Lord in his holie court.
label: Psalms

text: The voice of our Lord vpon waters, the God of maieſtie hath thundered: Our Lord vpon manie waters.
label: Psalms

text: The voice of our Lord in powre: the voice of our Lord in magnificence.
label: Psalms

text: The voice of our Lord breaking ceders: and our Lord shal breake the ceders of Libanus:
label: Psalms

text: And he shal breake them in peeces as a calfe of Libanus. and the beloued as the ſonne of vnicornes.
label: Psalms

text: The voice of our Lord diuiding the flame of fire:
label: Psalms

text: The voice of our Lord shaking the deſert; and our Lord shal moue the deſert of Cades.
label: Psalms

text: The voice of our Lord preparing hartes, and he shal diſcouer thicke woodes: and in his temple al shal ſay glorie.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord maketh to inhabite the floud: and our Lord shal ſit king for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord wil geue ſtrength to his people: our Lord wil bleſſe his people in peace.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme of Canticle, in the dedication of Dauids houſe.
label: Psalms

text: I WIL exalt thee ô Lord, becauſe thou haſt receiued me: neither haſt delighted myne enemies ouer me.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord my God I haue cried to thee, and thou haſt healed me.
label: Psalms

text: Lord thou haſt brought forth my ſoule out of hel: thou haſt ſaued me from them that goe downe into the lake.
label: Psalms

text: Sing to our Lord ye his ſainctes: and confeſſe to the memorie of his holines.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe wrath is in his indignation: and life in his wil. At euening shal weeping abide: and in the morning gladneſſe.
label: Psalms

text: And I ſaid in my abundance: I wil not be moued for euer.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord in thy wil, thou haſt geuen ſtrength to my beautie. Thou haſt turned away thy face from me, and I became trubled.
label: Psalms

text: To thee ô Lord I wil crie: and I wil pray to my God.
label: Psalms

text: What profite is in my bloud, whiles I deſcend into corruption? Shal duſt confeſſe to thee, or declare thy truth?
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord hath heard, and had mercie on me: our Lord is become my helper.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt turned my mourning into ioy vnto me: thou haſt cut my ſackcloth, and haſt compaſſed me with gladnes.
label: Psalms

text: That my glorie may ſing to thee: and I be not compunct: Lord my God for euer wil I confeſſe to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, the Pſalme of Dauid, for exceſſe of minde.
label: Psalms

text: IN THEE ô Lord haue I hoped, let me not be confounded for euer: in thy iuſtice deliuer me.
label: Psalms

text: Incline thine eare to me, make haſt to deliuer me. Be vnto me for a God protector: and for a houſe of refuge, that thou mayſt ſaue me.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou art my ſtrength, and my refuge: and for thy name thou wilt conduct me, and wilt nourish me.
label: Psalms

text: Thou wilt bring me out of this ſnare, which they haue hid for me: becauſe thou art my protector.
label: Psalms

text: Into thy handes I commend my ſpirit: thou haſt redeemed me ô Lord God of truth.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt hated them that obſerue vanities, vnprofitably. But I haue hoped in our Lord:
label: Psalms

text: I shal reioyce and be ioyful in thy mercie. Becauſe thou haſt reſpected my humilitie, thou haſt ſaued my ſoule out of neceſſities.
label: Psalms

text: Neither haſt thou shut me vp in the handes of the enemie: thou haſt ſet me feete in a large place.
label: Psalms

text: Haue mercie vpon me ô Lord becauſe I am in tribulation: myne eie is trubled for wrath, my ſoule, and my bellie:
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe my life is decayed for ſorrowe: and my yeares for gronings. My ſtrength is weakened for pouertie; and by bones are trubled.
label: Psalms

text: Aboue al myne enemies I am made a reproch both to my neighbours excedingly: and a feare to my acquantance. They that ſaw me, fled forth from me:
label: Psalms

text: I am forgotten, from the hart as one dead. I am made as a veſſel deſtroyed:
label: Psalms

text: becauſe I haue heard the reprehenſion of manie that abide round about: In that whiles, they aſſembled together againſt me, they conſulted to take my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: But I haue hoped in thee ô Lord: I ſayd: Thou art my God:
label: Psalms

text: my lottes are in thy handes. Deliuer me out of the handes of my enemies, and from them that perſecute me.
label: Psalms

text: Illuſtrate thy face vpon thy ſeruant, ſaue me in thy mercie:
label: Psalms

text: Lord let me not be confounded, becauſe I haue inuocated thee. Let the impious be ashamed, and brought downe into hel:
label: Psalms

text: let the deceitful lippes be made mute. Which ſpeake iniquitie againſt the iuſt, in pride, and abuſe.
label: Psalms

text: How great is the multitude of thy ſweetneſſe ô Lord, which thou haſt hid for them that feare thee. Thou haſt perfited it for them that hope in thee, in the ſight of the children of men.
label: Psalms

text: Thou shalt hide them in the ſecrete of thy face from the diſturbance of men. Thou shalt protect them in thy tabernacle from the contradiction of tongues.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed be our Lord: becauſe he hath made his mercie merueilous to me in the fenſed citie.
label: Psalms

text: But I haue ſaid in the exceſſe of my minde: I am caſt away from the ſight of thine eies. Therfore thou haſt heard the voice of my praier, whiles I cried to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Loue our Lord al ye his ſainctes: becauſe our Lord wil require truth, & wil repay them abundantly that doe proudly.
label: Psalms

text: Do ye manfully, and let your hart take courage, al ye that hope in out Lord.
label: Psalms

text: To Dauid him ſelfe vnderſtanding. BLESSED are they, whoſe iniquities are forgeuen: and whoſe ſinnes be couered.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed is the man, to whom our Lord hath not imputed ſinne, neither is there guile in his ſpirit.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe I held my peace, my bones are inueterated, whiles I cried al the day.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe day and night thy hand is made heauie vpon me: I am turned in my anguish, whiles the thorne is faſtened.
label: Psalms

text: I haue made my ſinne knowen to thee: and my iniuſtice I haue not hid. I ſaid: I wil confeſſe againſt me my iniuſtice to our Lord: and thou haſt forgeuen the impietie of my ſinne.
label: Psalms

text: For this shal euerie holie one pray to thee, in time conuenient. But yet in the floud of manie waters, they shal not approche to him.
label: Psalms

text: Thou art my refuge from tribulation, which hath compaſſed me: my exultation, deliuer me from them that compaſſe me.
label: Psalms

text: I wil geue thee vnderſtanding, and wil inſtruct thee in the way, that thou shalt goe; I wil faſten mine eies vpon thee.
label: Psalms

text: Doe not become as horſe and mule, which haue no vnderſtanding. In bit and bridle binde faſt their cheekes, that approch not to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Manie are the ſcourges of a ſinner, but him that hopeth in our Lord mercie shal compaſſe.
label: Psalms

text: Be ioyful in our Lord and reioyſe ye iuſt, and glorie al ye right of hart.
label: Psalms

text: REIOYCE ye iuſt in our Lord: prayſing becometh the righteous.
label: Psalms

text: Confeſſe ye to our Lord on the harpe: on a pſalter of ten ſtrings ſing to him.
label: Psalms

text: Sing ye to him a new ſong: ſing wel to him in iubilation.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe the word of our Lord is right, and al his workes are in faith.
label: Psalms

text: He loueth mercie and iudgement: the earth is ful of the mercie of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: By the word of our Lord the heauens are eſtablished: and by the ſpirit of his mouth al the power of them.
label: Psalms

text: Gathering together the waters of the ſea, as it were in a bottel: putting the depthes in treaſures.
label: Psalms

text: Let al the earth feare our Lord: and let al the inhabitantes of the world be moued at him.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he ſaid, and they were made: he commanded and they were created,
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord diſſipateth the counſels of nations: and he reproueth the cogitations of people, and he reproueth the counſels of princes.
label: Psalms

text: But the counſel of our Lord abydeth for euer: the cogitations of his hart in generation and generation.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed is the nation, whoſe God is our Lord: the people whom he hath choſen for his inheritance.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord hath looked from heauen: he hath ſene al the children of men.
label: Psalms

text: From his prepared habitation he hath looked vpon al, that inhabite the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Who made their hartes ſeuerally: who vnderſtandeth al their workes.
label: Psalms

text: The king is not ſaued by much powre: and the gyant shal not be ſaued in the multitude of his ſtrength.
label: Psalms

text: The horſe fayleth to ſafetie, and in the abundance of his force he shal not be ſaued.
label: Psalms

text: Behold the eies of our Lord be vpon them that feare him: and on them, that hope vpon his mercie.
label: Psalms

text: That he may deliuer their ſoules from death: and nourish them in famine.
label: Psalms

text: Our ſoule expecteth our Lord: becauſe he is our helper and protector.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe in him our hart shal reioyce: and we haue truſted in his holie name.
label: Psalms

text: Let thy mercie ô Lord be made vpon vs: as we haue hoped in thee.
label: Psalms

text: To Dauid, when he changed his countenance before Abimelech, and he diſmiſt him, and he went away. (1. Reg. 21.)
label: Psalms

text: I WIL bleſſe our Lord at al time: his prayſe alwayes in my mouth.
label: Psalms

text: In our Lord my ſoule shal be praiſed: let the milde heare, and reioyce.
label: Psalms

text: Magnifie ye our Lord with me: and let vs exalt his name for euer.
label: Psalms

text: I haue ſought out our Lord, and he hath heard me: and from al my tribulations he hath deliuered me.
label: Psalms

text: Come ye to him, and be illuminated: and your faces shal not be confounded.
label: Psalms

text: This poore man hath cried, and our Lord hath heard him: and from al his tribulations he hath ſaued him.
label: Psalms

text: The Angel of our Lord shal put in him ſelfe about them that feare him: and shal deliuer them.
label: Psalms

text: Taſt ye, and ſee that our Lord is ſweete: bleſſed is the man, that hopeth in him.
label: Psalms

text: Feare ye our Lord al ye his ſainctes: becauſe there is no lacke to them that feare him.
label: Psalms

text: The rich haue wanted, and haue bene hungrie: but they that ſeeke after our Lord shal not be diminished of any good.
label: Psalms

text: Come children, heare me: I wil teach you the feare of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Who is the man that wil haue life: loueth to ſee good daies.
label: Psalms

text: Stay thy tongue from euil: and thy lippes that they ſpeake not guile.
label: Psalms

text: Turne away from euil, and do good: ſeeke after peace, and purſewe it.
label: Psalms

text: The eies of our Lord vpon the iuſt: and his eares vnto their prayers
label: Psalms

text: But the countenance of our Lord is vpon them that doe euil things: to deſtroy their memorie out of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: The iuſt haue cried, and our Lord hath heard them: and out of al their tribulations he hath deliuered them.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is nigh to them, that are of a contrite hart: and the humble of ſpirit he wil ſaue.
label: Psalms

text: Manie are the tribulations of the iuſt: and out of al theſe our Lord wil deliuer them.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord keepeth al their bones: there shal not one of them be broken.
label: Psalms

text: The death of ſinners is verie il: and they that hate the iuſt shal offend.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord wil redeme the ſoules of his ſeruantes: and al that hope in him shal not offend.
label: Psalms

text: To Dauid himſelf. IVDGE bô Lord them that hurt me: ouerthrow them that impugne me.
label: Psalms

text: Take armour and shield: and riſe vp to helpe me.
label: Psalms

text: Bring forth the ſword, and shut vp againſt them, that perſecute me: ſay to my ſoule: I am thy ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: Let them be counfounded & ashamed, that ſeeke my ſoule. Let them be turned backward, and be confounded that thinke euil againſt me
label: Psalms

text: Be they made as duſt before the face of winde; and the angel of our Lord ſtraictning them.
label: Psalms

text: Let their way be made darkeneſſe and ſlippernes: and the angel of our Lord purſewing them.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe they haue hid the deſtruction of their ſnare for me without cauſe: in vaine haue they vpbrayded my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: Let the ſnare which he knoweth not, come on him; and the net, which he hath hid, catch him: and let him fal into the verie ſame ſnare.
label: Psalms

text: But my ſoule shal reioyce in our Lord: and shal be delighted vpon his ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: Al my bones shal ſay: Lord, who is like to thee? Deliuering the needie from the hand of them that are ſtronger then he: the needie and poore from them that ſpoile him.
label: Psalms

text: Vniuſt witneſſes ryſing vp, asked me things that I knew not.
label: Psalms

text: They repayed me euil things for good, ſterilitie to my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: But I when they were trubleſome to me, did put on cloth of heare. I humbled my ſoule in faſting: and my prayer shal be turned into my boſome.
label: Psalms

text: As a neighbour, as our brother, ſo did I pleaſe: as mourning and ſorowful ſo was I humbled.
label: Psalms

text: And they reioyced againſt me, and came together: ſcourges were gathered together vpon me, and I was ignorant.
label: Psalms

text: They were diſſipated, and not compunct, they tempted me, they ſcorned me with ſcorning: they gnashed vpon me with their teeth.
label: Psalms

text: Lord when wilt thou regard? reſtore thou my ſoule from their malignitie, myne only one from the lions.
label: Psalms

text: I wil confeſſe to thee in the great Church, in a graue people I wil prayſe thee.
label: Psalms

text: Let them not reioyce ouer me that are my aduerſaries vniuſtly: that hate me without cauſe, and twinckle with the eies.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe they ſpake in deede peaceably to me: and in the anger of the earth ſpeaking they meant guiles.
label: Psalms

text: And they opened their mouth a wide vpon me: they ſaid; Wel, wel, our eies haue ſeene.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt ſene ô Lord, keepe not ſilence: Lord depart not from me.
label: Psalms

text: Ariſe and attend to my iudgement: my God, and my Lord vnto my cauſe.
label: Psalms

text: Iudge me according to thy iuſtice ô Lord my God, and let them not reioyce ouer me
label: Psalms

text: Let them not ſay in their hartes: Wel, wel, to our ſoule: neither let them ſay: We haue deuoured him.
label: Psalms

text: Let them blush and be ashamed together, that reioyce at my euils. Let them be clothed with confuſion and shame; that ſpeake great things vpon me.
label: Psalms

text: Let them reioyce and be glad, that wil my iuſtice: and let them ſay alwayes: Our Lord be magnified, that wil the peace of his ſeruant.
label: Psalms

text: And my tongue shal meditate thy iuſtice, thy prayſe al the day.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, to the ſeruant of our Lord Dauid him ſelfe.
label: Psalms

text: THE vniuſt hath ſaid within him ſelfe, that he would ſinne: there is no feare of God before his eies
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath done deceitfully in his ſight: that his iniquitie may be found vnto hatred.
label: Psalms

text: The wordes of his mouth are iniquitie, and guile: he would not vnderſtand that he might doe wel.
label: Psalms

text: He hath meditated iniquitie in his bed: he hath ſet himſelfe on euery way not good, and malice he hath not hated.
label: Psalms

text: Lord thy mercie is in heauen: and thy truth euen to the clowdes.
label: Psalms

text: Thy iuſtice as the hilles of God: thy iudgementes are great depth. Men & beaſtes thou wilt ſaue ô Lord:
label: Psalms

text: as thou haſt multiplied thy mercie ô God. But the children of men, shal hope in the couert of thy winges.
label: Psalms

text: They shal be inebriated with the plentie of thy houſe: and with the torrent of thy pleaſure thou shalt make them drinke,
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe with thee is the fountaine of life: and in thy light we shal ſee light.
label: Psalms

text: Extend thy mercie to them that know thee, and thy iuſtice to them, that are of a right hart.
label: Psalms

text: Let not the foote of pride come to me: and let not the hand of a ſinner moue me.
label: Psalms

text: There haue they fallen that worke iniquitie: they were expelled, neither could they ſtand.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme to Dauid him ſelf. HAVE no emulation toward the malignant: neither enuie them that doe iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe they shal quickely wither as graſſe: and as the bloſſomes of herbes they shal ſoone fal.
label: Psalms

text: Hope in our Lord and doe good: and inhabite the land, and thou shalt be fed in the riches therof.
label: Psalms

text: Be delighted in our Lord: and he wil geue thee the petitions of thy hart.
label: Psalms

text: Reuele thy way to our Lord, and hope in him: and he wil doe it.
label: Psalms

text: And he wil bring forth thy iuſtice as light: and thy iudgement as midday:
label: Psalms

text: be ſubiect to our Lord, and pray him. Haue no emulation in him, that proſpereth in his way: in a man that doth iniuſtices.
label: Psalms

text: Ceaſe from wrath, and leaue furie: haue not emulation that thou be malignant.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe they that are malignant, shal be caſt out: but they that expect our Lord, the ſame shal inherite the land.
label: Psalms

text: And yet a litle while, and the ſinner shal not be: and thou shalt ſeeke his place, and shal not find it.
label: Psalms

text: But the meeke shal inherite the land, and shal be delighted in multitude of peace.
label: Psalms

text: The ſinner shal obſerue the iuſt: and shal gnash vpon him with his teeth.
label: Psalms

text: But our Lord shal ſcorne him: becauſe he foreſeeth that his day shal come.
label: Psalms

text: Sinners haue drawen out the ſword; they haue bent their bowe; That they may deceiue the poore and needie: that they may murder the right of hart.
label: Psalms

text: Let their owne ſwordes enter into their hartes: and let their bowe be broken.
label: Psalms

text: Better is a litle to the iuſt, aboue much riches of ſinners.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe the armes of ſinners shal be broken in pieces: but our Lord comfirmeth the iuſt.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord knoweth the daies of the immaculate: and their inheritance shal be for euer.
label: Psalms

text: They shal not be confounded in the euil time, and in the dayes of famine they shal be filled:
label: Psalms

text: becauſe the ſinners shal perish. But the enemies of our Lord forthwith as they shal be honoured and exalted, vanishing shal vanish as ſmoke.
label: Psalms

text: The ſinner shal borrow, and not pay: but the iuſt is merciful and wil geue.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe they that bleſſe him shal inherite the land: but they that curſe him shal perish.
label: Psalms

text: With our Lord the ſteppe of man shal be directed: and he shal like wel of his way.
label: Psalms

text: When he shal fal, he shal not be bruſed: becauſe our Lord putteth his hand vnder.
label: Psalms

text: I haue bene yong, for I am old: and I haue not ſene the iuſt forſaken, nor his ſeede ſeeking bread.
label: Psalms

text: Al the day he is merciful and lendeth: and his ſeede shal be in bleſſing.
label: Psalms

text: Decline from euil, and doe good: and inhabite for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord loueth iudgement, and he wil not forſake his ſainctes: they shal be preſerued for euer. The vniuſt shal be punished: and the ſeede of the impious shal perish.
label: Psalms

text: But the iuſt shal inherite the land: and shal inhabite for euer and euer vpon it.
label: Psalms

text: The mouth of the iuſt shal meditate wiſedome, and his tong shal ſpeake iudgement.
label: Psalms

text: The law of his God in his hart: and his ſteppes shal not be ſupplanted.
label: Psalms

text: The ſinner conſidereth the iuſt: and ſeeketh to murder him.
label: Psalms

text: But our Lord wil not leaue him in his handes: neither wil he condemne him, when iudgement shal be geuen of him.
label: Psalms

text: Expect our Lord, and keepe his way: and he wil exalt thee, that thou mayſt inherite the land: when the ſinners shal perish thou shalt ſee.
label: Psalms

text: I haue ſeene the impious highly exalted, and aduanced as the ceders of Libanus.
label: Psalms

text: And I paſſed by, and behold he was not: and I ſought him, and his place was not found.
label: Psalms

text: Keepe innocencie, and ſee equitie: becauſe there are remaynes for the peaceable man.
label: Psalms

text: But the vniuſt shal perish together: the remaines of the impious shal perish.
label: Psalms

text: But the ſaluation of the iuſt is of our Lord: and he is their potector in the time of tribulation.
label: Psalms

text: And our Lord wil helpe them, and deliuer them: and he wil take them away from ſinners, and ſaue them: becauſe they haue hoped in him.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme of Dauid, in recordation of the ſabbath.
label: Psalms

text: LORD rebuke me nor in thy furie: nor chaſtiſe me in thy wrath.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thy arrowes are faſt ſticked in me: and thou haſt faſtened thy hand vpon me.
label: Psalms

text: There is no health in my flesh, at the face of thy wrath: my bones haue no peace at the face of my ſinnes.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe mine iniquities are gone ouer my head: and as a heauie burden are become heauie vpon me.
label: Psalms

text: My ſcarres are putrified and corrupted, becauſe of my folishnes.
label: Psalms

text: I am become miſerable, and am made crooked euen to the end: I went ſorowful al the day.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe my loynes are filled with illuſions: and there is no health in my flesh.
label: Psalms

text: I am afflicted and am humbled excedingly: I rored for the groning of my hart.
label: Psalms

text: Lord, before thee is al my deſire: and my groning is not hid from thee.
label: Psalms

text: My hart is trubled, my ſtrength hath forſaken me: and the light of mine eies, and the ſame is not with me.
label: Psalms

text: My frendes, and my neighbores haue approched, & ſtood againſt me. And they that were neere me, ſtood far of:
label: Psalms

text: and they did violence which ſought my ſoule. And they that ſought me euils, ſpake vanities: and meditated guiles al the day.
label: Psalms

text: But I as one deafe did not heare: and as one dumme not opening his mouth.
label: Psalms

text: And I became as a man not hearing: and not hauing reproofes in his mouth.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe in thee ô Lord haue I hoped, thou wilt heare me ô Lord my God.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe I ſaid: Leſt ſometime mine enemies reioyce ouer me: and whiles my feete are moued, they ſpeake great thinges vpon me.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe I am readie for ſcourges: and my ſorow is in my ſight alwaies:
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe I wil declare my iniquitie: and I wil thinke for my ſinne.
label: Psalms

text: But mine enemies liue, and are confirmed ouer me: and they are multiplied that hate me vniuſtly.
label: Psalms

text: They that repay euil thinges for good, detracted from me: becauſe I folowed goodnes.
label: Psalms

text: Forſake me not ô Lord my God, depart not from me.
label: Psalms

text: Attend vnto my help, ô Lord the God of my ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, to Idithun him ſelfe, a canticle of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: I HAVE ſaid: I wil keepe my waies: that I offend not in my tongue. I haue ſet a gard to my mouth, when the ſinner ſtood againſt me.
label: Psalms

text: I was dumme and humbled, and kept ſilence from good thinges: and my ſorrow was renewed.
label: Psalms

text: My hart waxed hote within me: and in my meditation a fyre shal burne.
label: Psalms

text: I haue ſpoken in my tongue: Lord make mine end knowne to me. And the number of my daies what it is: that I may know what is lacking to me.
label: Psalms

text: Behold thou haſt put my daies meaſurable, and my ſubſtance is as nothing before thee. Doubtles al things are vanitie, euerie man liuing.
label: Psalms

text: Surely man paſſeth as an image; yea and he is trubled in vayne. He gathereth treaſure; and knoweth not to whom he shal gather them.
label: Psalms

text: And now what is my expectation? is not our Lord? and my ſubſtance is with thee.
label: Psalms

text: From al mine iniquities deliuer me: a reproch to the foolish thou haſt geuen me.
label: Psalms

text: I was dumme, and opened not my mouth, becauſe thou didſt it:
label: Psalms

text: Remoue thy ſcourges from me.
label: Psalms

text: By the ſtrength of thy hand I haue faynted in reprehenſions: for iniquitie thou haſt chaſtiſed man. And thou haſt made his ſoule pyne away as a ſpider: but vaynly is euerie man trubled.
label: Psalms

text: Heare my prayer ô Lord, and my petition; with thyne eares receiue my teares. Keepe not ſilence: becauſe I am a ſtranger with thee, and a pilgrime, as my fathers.
label: Psalms

text: Forgeue me, that I may be refreshed before I depart: and shal be no more.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, a Pſalme to Dauid himſelfe.
label: Psalms

text: EXPECTING I expected our Lord, and he hath attended to me.
label: Psalms

text: And he heard my prayers, and brought me out of the lake of miſerie, and from the myre of dregges. And hath ſet my feete vpon a rocke: and hath directed my ſteppes.
label: Psalms

text: And he hath put a new canticle into my mouth: a ſong to our God. Manie shal ſee, and shal feare: and they shal hope in our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed is the man, whoſe hope is in the name of our Lord: and hath not had regard to vanities and falſe madnes.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt done manie thy meruelous thinges ô Lord my God: & in thy cogitations there is none that may be like to thee. I haue declared and haue ſpoken: they multiplied aboue number.
label: Psalms

text: Sacrifice and oblation thou wouldeſt not: but eares thou haſt perfited to me. Holocauſt and for ſinne thou didſt not require:
label: Psalms

text: then ſaid I, Behold I come. In the head of the booke it is written of me,
label: Psalms

text: that I should doe thy wil: my God I would, and thy law in the middes of my hart.
label: Psalms

text: I haue declared thy iuſtice in the great Church, loe I wil not ſtay my lippes: Lord thou haſt knowen it.
label: Psalms

text: Thy iuſtice I haue not hid in my hart: thy truth and thy ſaluation I haue ſpoken. I haue not hid thy mercie, and thy truth from the great councel.
label: Psalms

text: But thou ô Lord make not thy commiſerations farre from me: thy mercie and thy truth haue alwayes receiued me.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe euils haue compaſſed me, which haue no number: mine iniquities haue ouertaken me, & I was not able to ſee. They are multiplied aboue the heares of my head: and my hart hath forſaken me.
label: Psalms

text: It may pleaſe thee ô Lord to deliuer me: Lord haue reſpect to helpe me.
label: Psalms

text: Let them be confounded and ashamed together, that ſeeke my ſoule, to take it away. Let them be turned backward, and be ashamed that wil me euils.
label: Psalms

text: Let them forthwith receiue their confuſion, that ſay to me: Wel, wel.
label: Psalms

text: Let al that ſeeke thee, reioyce and be glad vpon thee: and let them that loue thy ſaluation, ſay alwayes: Our Lord be magnified:
label: Psalms

text: But I am a begger, and poore: Our Lord is careful of me. Thou art my helper, & my protector: my God be not ſlacke.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, a Pſalme to Dauid him ſelfe.
label: Psalms

text: BLESSED is the man that vnderſtandeth concerning the needie, and the poore: in the euil day our Lord wil deliuer him.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord preſerue him, and geue him life, and make him bleſſed in the land: and deliuer him not vnto the wil of his enemies.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord helpe him vpon the bed of his ſorow: thou haſt turned al his couche in his infirmitie.
label: Psalms

text: I ſaid: Lord haue haue mercie on me: heale my ſoule, becauſe I haue ſinned to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Mine enemies haue ſpoken euils to me: When shal he die, and his name perish?
label: Psalms

text: And if he came in to ſee, he ſpake vayne thinges: his hart hath gathered together iniquitie to him ſelfe. He went forth. and ſpake together.
label: Psalms

text: Al mine enemies whiſpered againſt me: they did thinke euils to me.
label: Psalms

text: They haue determined an vniuſt word againſt me: Shal not he that ſleepeth adde to ryſe againe?
label: Psalms

text: For the man alſo of my peace, in whom I hoped: who did eate my breades, hath greatly troden me vnder foote
label: Psalms

text: But thou ô Lord haue mercie vpon me, and raiſe me vp againe: and I wil repay them.
label: Psalms

text: In this I haue knowen that thou wouldeſt me: becauſe mine enemie shal not reioyce ouer me.
label: Psalms

text: But me thou haſt receiued becauſe of innocencie: and thou haſt confirmed me in thy ſight for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed be our Lord the God of Iſrael from the beginning of the world, and for euermore: Be it, be it.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, vnderſtanding to the ſonnes of Core.
label: Psalms

text: EVEN as the harte deſireth after the fountaines of waters: ſo doth my ſoule deſire after thee ô God.
label: Psalms

text: My ſoule hath thirſted after God the ſtrong liuing: when shal I come and appeare before the face of God?
label: Psalms

text: My teares haue beene breades vnto me day and night: whiles it is ſaid to me dayly: Where is thy God?
label: Psalms

text: Theſe thinges haue I remembred, and haue powred out my ſoule in me, becauſe I shal paſſe into the place of a meruelous tabernacle, euen to the houſe of God. In the yoyce of exultation, and confeſſion: the ſound of one feaſting.
label: Psalms

text: Why art thou ſorowful my ſoule? and why doſt thou truble me? Hope in God, becauſe yet I wil confeſſe to him: the ſaluation of my countenance,
label: Psalms

text: and my God. My ſoule is trubled toward my ſelfe; therfore wil I be mindful of thee from the land of Iordan, and Hermoniim from the litle mountaine.
label: Psalms

text: Depth calleth on depth, in the voice of thy flould-gates. Al thy high thinges, and thy waues haue paſſed ouer me.
label: Psalms

text: In the day our Lord hath commanded his mercie: and in the night a ſong of him. With me is prayer to the God of my life:
label: Psalms

text: I wil ſay to God: Thou art my defender. Why haſt thou forgotten me? and why goe I ſorowful, whiles mine enemie afflicteth me?
label: Psalms

text: Whiles my bones are broken, mine enemies that truble me haue vpbrayded me: Whiles they ſay to me day by day: Where is thy God?
label: Psalms

text: Why art thou heauie ô my ſoule? & why doſt thou truble me? Hope in God, becauſe yet I wil confeſſe to him: the ſaluation of my countenance, and my God.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme of Dauid. IVDGE me ô God, & diſcerne my cauſe from the nation not holie, from the vniuſt and deceitful man deliuer me.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou art God my ſtrength: why haſt thou repelled me? and why goe I ſorowful, whiles the enemie afflicteth me?
label: Psalms

text: Send forth thy light and thy truth: they haue conducted me, and haue brought me into thy holy hil, and into thy tabernacles.
label: Psalms

text: And I wil goe in to the altar of God: to God, which maketh my youth ioyful.
label: Psalms

text: I wil confeſſe to thee on the harpe ô God my God: why art thou ſorowful ô my ſoule? and doſt thou trubel me?
label: Psalms

text: Hope in God, becauſe yet wil I cõfeſſe to him: the ſaluation of my countenance, and my God.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for the ſonnes of Core to vnderſtanding.
label: Psalms

text: O GOD we haue heard with our eares: our fathers haue declared to vs. The worke, that thou haſt wrought in their dayes: and in the dayes of old.
label: Psalms

text: Thy hand deſtroyed the nations, and thou didſt plant them: thou didſt afflict the peoples, and expel them:
label: Psalms

text: For not by their owne ſword did they poſſeſſe the land, and their owne arme did not ſaue them: But thy right hand, and thyne arme, and the illumination of thy countenance: becauſe thou waſt pleaſed in them.
label: Psalms

text: Thou art the ſame my king and my God: which commandeſt the ſaluations of Iacob.
label: Psalms

text: In thee we shal turne out our enemies with the horne, & in thy name we shal contemne them that ryſe vp against vs.
label: Psalms

text: For I wil not hope in my bowe: and my ſword wil not ſaue me.
label: Psalms

text: For thou haſt ſaued vs from them that afflict vs: and them that hate vs thou haſt confounded.
label: Psalms

text: In God we shal be prayſed al the day: and in thy name we wil confeſſe for euer.
label: Psalms

text: But now thou haſt repelled and confounded vs: and thou wilt not goe forth ô God in our hoſtes.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt turned vs backe behind our enemies: and they that hated vs, ſpoyled for themſelues.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt geuen vs as sheepe that are to be eaten: and thou haſt diſperſed vs among the nations.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt ſold thy people without price: and there was no multitude in the exchanges of them.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt made vs a reproche to our neighbours, a ſcorne and mocking ſtocke to them, that are round about vs.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt made vs for a parable to the Gentiles: a wagging of the head among the peoples.
label: Psalms

text: Al the day my shame is againſt me, and the confuſion of my face hath couered me.
label: Psalms

text: At the voyce of the vpbrayder, and the reprocher: at the face of the enemie and perſecutor.
label: Psalms

text: Al theſe thinges haue come vpon vs, neither haue we forgotten thee: and we haue not done wickedly in thy teſtament.
label: Psalms

text: And our hart hath not reuolted backward: and thou haſt declined our pathes from thy way:
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou haſt humbled vs in the place of affliction, and the shadow of death hath couered vs.
label: Psalms

text: If we haue forgotten the name of our God, and if we haue ſpred forth our handes to a ſtrange God:
label: Psalms

text: Wil not God enquire of theſe thinges? For he knoweth the ſecretes of the hart. Becauſe for thee we are killed al the day: we are eſtemed as sheepe of ſlaughter.
label: Psalms

text: Ariſe why ſleepeſt thou ô Lord? Ariſe, and expel vs not to the end.
label: Psalms

text: Why doſt thou turne away thy face, forgetteſt our pouertie and our tribulation?
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our ſoule is humbled in the duſt: our bellie is glewed in the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Ariſe Lord, helpe vs: and redeme vs for thy name.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for them, that shal be changed, to the ſonnes of Core, for vnderſtanding, a Canticle for the beloued.
label: Psalms

text: MY hart hath vttered a good word: I tel my workes to the king. My tongue is the penne of a ſcribe, that writeth ſwiftly.
label: Psalms

text: Goodly of beautie aboue the ſonnes of men, grace is powred abrode in thy lippes: therfore hath God bleſſed thee for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Be girded with thy ſword vpon thy thigh, ô moſt mightie.
label: Psalms

text: With thy beautie and fayrneſſe intend, procede proſperouſly, and reigne, Becauſe of truth, and mildeneſſe, and iuſtice: and thy right hand shal conduct thee meruelouſly.
label: Psalms

text: Thy sharpe arrowes, the peoples vnderneth thee shal fal into the hartes of the kings enemies.
label: Psalms

text: Thy ſeate ô God for euer and euer: a rod of direction the rod of thy kingdom.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt loued iuſtice, and haſt hated iniquitie: therfore God, thy God, hath annoynted thee with the oile of gladnes aboue thy felowes.
label: Psalms

text: Myrrhe, and Aloes, and Caſſia from thy garmentes, from houſes of yuorie; out of the which
label: Psalms

text: the daughter of kinges haue delighted thee in thy honour.
label: Psalms

text: The Queene ſtood on thy right hand in golden rayment: compaſſed with varietie. Heare daughter, and ſee, and incline thyne eare: and forget thy people, and the houſe of thy father.
label: Psalms

text: And the king wil couet thy beautie: becauſe he is the Lord thy God, and they shal adore him.
label: Psalms

text: And the daughters of Tyre with giftes, al the rich of the people shal beſech thy countenance.
label: Psalms

text: Al the glorie of that daughter of the king is within, in borders of gold
label: Psalms

text: clothed round about with varieties. Virgins shal be brought to the king after her: her neighbours shal be brought to thee.
label: Psalms

text: They shal be brought in ioy and exultation: they shal be brought into the temple of the king.
label: Psalms

text: For thy fathers there are borne ſonnes to thee: thou ſhalt make them princes ouer al the earth.
label: Psalms

text: They shal be mindeful of thy name in al generation and generation. Therfore shal peoples confeſſe to thee for euer: and for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, to the ſonnes of Core, for the ſecretes.
label: Psalms

text: OVr God is a refuge. and ſtrength: an helper in tribulations, which haue found vs excedingly.
label: Psalms

text: Therfore wil we not feare when the earth shal be trubled: and mountaines tranſported into the hart of the ſea.
label: Psalms

text: Their waters haue ſounded, and were trubled: the mountaines were trubled in his ſtrength.
label: Psalms

text: The violence of the riuer maketh the citie of God ioyful: the Higheſt hath ſanctified his tabernacle.
label: Psalms

text: God is in the middes therof, it shal not be moued: God wil helpe it in the morning early.
label: Psalms

text: Nations are trubled, and kingdomes are inclined: he gaue his voice, the earth was moued
label: Psalms

text: The Lord of hoſtes is with vs: the God of Iacob is our defender.
label: Psalms

text: Come ye, and ſee the workes of our Lord, what wonders he hath put vpon the earth:
label: Psalms

text: taking away warres euen vnto the end of the earth. He shal deſtroy bow, & breake weapons: and shields he shal burne with fire.
label: Psalms

text: Be quiet, and ſee that I am God: I shal be exalted among the gentiles, and I shal be exalted in the earth.
label: Psalms

text: The Lord of hoſtes is with vs: the God of Iacob is our defender.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for the ſonnes of Core.
label: Psalms

text: AL YE Nations clappe handes: make iubilation to God in the voyce of exultation.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord is high, terrible; a great king ouer al the earth.
label: Psalms

text: He hath made peoples ſubiect to vs: & gentiles vnder our feete.
label: Psalms

text: He hath choſen his inheritance in vs: the beautie of Iacob which he loued.
label: Psalms

text: God is aſcended in iubilation: and our Lord in the voice of trumpet.
label: Psalms

text: Sing ye to our God, ſing ye: Sing ye to our king, ſing ye.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe God is king of al the earth: ſing ye wiſely.
label: Psalms

text: God shal reigne ouer the gentiles: God ſitteth vpon his holie ſeate.
label: Psalms

text: Princes of peoples are gathered together with the God of Abraham: becauſe the ſtrong goddes of the earth, are excedingly aduanced.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme of Canticle to the ſonnes of Core, the ſecond of the Sabbath.
label: Psalms

text: GREAT is our Lord, and to be prayſed excedingly in the citie of our God, in his holie mount.
label: Psalms

text: Mount Sion is founded with the exultation of the whole earth, the ſides of the North, the citie of the great king.
label: Psalms

text: God shal be knowen in the houſes therof, when he shal receiue it.
label: Psalms

text: For behold the kings of the earth were gathered together: they aſſembled in one.
label: Psalms

text: They ſeing it ſo, were in admiration, were trubled, were moued:
label: Psalms

text: trembling tooke them. Their ſorowes as a woman traueling,
label: Psalms

text: In a vehement ſpirit thou shalt breake the shippes of Tharſis.
label: Psalms

text: As we haue heard, ſo haue we ſeene in the citie of the Lord of hoſtes, in the citie of our God: God hath founded it for euer.
label: Psalms

text: We haue receiued thy mercie, ô God, in the middes of thy temple.
label: Psalms

text: According to thy name ô God, ſo alſo is thy prayſe vnto the endes of the earth: thy right hand is ful of iuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: Let mount Sion be glad, and the daughters of Iuda reioyce, becauſe of thy iudgementes ô Lord
label: Psalms

text: Compaſſe Sion, and embrace ye her: tel ye in her towers.
label: Psalms

text: Set your hartes on her ſtrength: and diſtribute ye her houſes, that you may declare it in an other generation.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe this is God, our God for euer, and for euer and euer: he shal rule vs euermore.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, to the ſonnes of Core a Pſalme.
label: Psalms

text: HEARE theſe thinges al ye Gentiles: receiue with your eares al ye, that inhabite the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Al ye earthly perſons, and children of men: together in one the rich and the poore.
label: Psalms

text: My mouth shal ſpeake wiſedom, and the meditation of my hart prudence.
label: Psalms

text: I wil incline mine eare vnto a parable: I wil open my propoſition on a Pſalter.
label: Psalms

text: Why shal I feare in the euil day? the iniquitie of my heele shal compaſſe me.
label: Psalms

text: They that truſt in their ſtrength: and glorie in the multitude of their riches.
label: Psalms

text: A brother doth not redeme, man shal redeme: he shal not geue vnto God his reconciliation.
label: Psalms

text: And the price of the redemption of his owne ſoule: and he shal labour for euer,
label: Psalms

text: and shal liue yet vnto the end.
label: Psalms

text: He shal not ſee death, when he shal ſee the wiſe dying the vnwiſe, and the foole shal perish together. And they shal leaue their riches to ſtrangers:
label: Psalms

text: and their ſepulchers their houſes for euer. Their Tabernacles in generation and generation: they haue renowmed their names in their landes.
label: Psalms

text: And man, when he was in honour, did not vnderſtand: he was compared to beaſts without vnderſtanding, and became like to them.
label: Psalms

text: This their way is a ſcandal to them: and afterward in their mouth they shal take pleaſure.
label: Psalms

text: As sheepe they are put in hel: death shal feede vpon them. And the iuſt shal rule ouer them in the morning: and their aide shal waxe old in hel from their glorie.
label: Psalms

text: Neuertheleſſe God wil redeme my ſoule out of the hand of hel, when he shal take me.
label: Psalms

text: Feare not when a man shal be made rich: and when the glory of his houſe shal be multiplied,
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe when he shal dye, he shal not take al thinges: neyther shal his glorie goe downe with him.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe his ſoule in his life shal be bleſſed: he wil confeſſe to thee when thou shalt do him good.
label: Psalms

text: He shal enter in, euen to the progenies of his fathers: and he shal not ſee light for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Man, when he was in honour, did not vnderſtand: he was compared to beaſts without vnderſtanding, and became like to them.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme to Aſaph. THE God of goddes our Lord hath ſpoken: and he hath called the earth, from the ryſing of the ſunne euen to the going downe.
label: Psalms

text: Out of Syon the beauty of his comelines.
label: Psalms

text: God wil come manifeſtly: our God and he wil not kepe ſilence. Fire shal burne forth in his ſight: and round about him a mighty tempeſt.
label: Psalms

text: He shal cal the heauen from aboue: and the earth to diſcerne his people.
label: Psalms

text: Gather ye together his ſaincts vnto him: which ordaine his teſtament aboue ſacrifices.
label: Psalms

text: And the heauens shal shew forth his iuſtice: becauſe God is Iudge.
label: Psalms

text: Heare ô my people, and I wil ſpeake: Iſrael, and I wil teſtifie to thee: God thy God am I.
label: Psalms

text: I wil not rebuke thee in thy ſacrifices: and thy holocauſtes are in my ſight alwaies.
label: Psalms

text: I wil not take calues out of thy houſe: nor buckegoats out of thy flockes.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe al the wilde beaſts of the woods be myne, the cattle in the mountaines and oxen.
label: Psalms

text: I haue knowne al the foules of the ayer: and the beauty of the fielde is with me.
label: Psalms

text: If I shal be hungrie, I wil not tel thee: for the round earth is myne, and the fulnes therof.
label: Psalms

text: Wil I eate the flesh of oxen? or wil I drinke the blood of buckegoats?
label: Psalms

text: Immolate to God the ſacrifice of praiſe, and pay thy vowes to the Higheſt.
label: Psalms

text: And inuocate me in the day of tribulation: I wil deliuer thee, and thou shalt glorifie me.
label: Psalms

text: But to the ſinner God hath ſayde: Why doeſt thou declare my iuſtices, and takeſt my teſtament by thy mouth?
label: Psalms

text: But thou haſt hated diſcipline: & caſt my words behind thee.
label: Psalms

text: If thou didſt ſee a theeſe, thou didſt rune with him: and with adulterers thou didſt put thy portion.
label: Psalms

text: Thy mouth hath abounded with malice: and thy tongue fourged guiles.
label: Psalms

text: Sitting thou ſpakeſt againſt thy brother, and againſt thy mothers ſonne thou didſt put a ſcandal:
label: Psalms

text: theſe things haſt thou done, and I haue held my peace. Thou haſt thought vniuſtly that I wil be like thee: I wil reproue thee, and ſet it againſt thy face.
label: Psalms

text: Vnderſtand theſe things you that forget God: leſt ſometime he take you violently and there be none to deliuer you.
label: Psalms

text: The ſacrifice of prayſe shal glorifie me: and there is the way, by which I wil shew him the ſaluation of God.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, a Pſalme of Dauid,
label: Psalms

text: when Nathan the Prophet came to him, after that he had ſinned with Bethſabee. (2. Reg. 12.)
label: Psalms

text: HAVE mercie on me ô God, according to thy great mercie. And according to the multitude of thy commiſerations, take away myne iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: Wash me more amply from mine iniquitie: & cleanſe me from my ſinne.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe I do know myne iniquitie: and my ſinne is before me alwaies.
label: Psalms

text: To thee onely haue I ſinned, and haue done euil before thee: that thou mayſt be iuſtified in thy words, and mayſt ouercome when thou art iudged.
label: Psalms

text: For behold I was conceiued in iniquities: & my mother conceiued me in ſinnes.
label: Psalms

text: For behold thou haſt loued truth: the vncertaine, and hidden thinges of thy wiſdome thou haſt made manifeſt to me.
label: Psalms

text: Thou shalt ſprinkle me with hyſſope, and I shal be clenſed: thou shalt wash me, and I shal be made whiter then ſnow.
label: Psalms

text: To my hearing thou shalt geue ioy and gladnes, and the bones humbled shal reioyce.
label: Psalms

text: Turne away thy face from my ſinnes: and wipe away al mine iniquities.
label: Psalms

text: Create a cleane hart in me ô God: and renew a right ſpirit in my bowels.
label: Psalms

text: Caſt me not away from thy face: and thy Holie ſpirit take not from me.
label: Psalms

text: Render vnto me the ioy of thy ſaluation? and confirme me with the principal ſpirit,
label: Psalms

text: I wil teach the vniuſt thy waies: and the impious shal be conuerted to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Deliuer me from bloudes ô God, the God of my ſaluation: and my tongue shal exult [for] thy iuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: Lord, thou wilt open my lippes: & my mouth shal shew forth thy prayſe.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe if thou wouldeſt haue had ſacrifice, I had verily giuen it: with holocauſtes thou wilt not be delighted.
label: Psalms

text: A ſacrifice to God is an afflicted ſpirit: a contrite, and humbled hart, ô God thou wilt not deſpiſe.
label: Psalms

text: Deale fauorably ô Lord in thy good wil with Sion: that the walles of Ieruſalem may be built vp.
label: Psalms

text: Then shalt thou accept ſacrifice of iuſtice, oblations, & holocauſtes: then shal they lay calues vpon thyne altar.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, vnderſtanding to Dauid,
label: Psalms

text: when Doeg the Idumeite came and told Saul: Dauid is come into the houſe of Achimelech. (1. Reg. 22.)
label: Psalms

text: WHY doeſt thou glorie in malice, which art mightie in iniquitie?
label: Psalms

text: Al the day hath thy tongue thought iniuſtice: as a sharp raſor thou haſt done guile.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt loued malice more then benignitie: iniquitie rather then to ſpeake equitie.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt loued al wordes of precipitation, a deceitful tongue.
label: Psalms

text: Therfore Wil God deſtroy thee for euer, he wil plucke thee out, & remoue thee out of thy tabernacle: & thy roote out of the land of the liuing.
label: Psalms

text: The iuſt shal ſee, and feare, and shal laugh at him, and they shal ſay:
label: Psalms

text: Behold the man, that hath not put God for his helper. But hath hoped in the multitude of his riches, and hath preualed in his vanitie.
label: Psalms

text: But I as a fruitful oliue tree in the houſe of God, haue hoped in the mercie of God for euer: and for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: I wil confeſſe to thee for euer, becauſe thou haſt done it: and I wil expect thy name, becauſe it is good in the ſight of thy ſaints:
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for Maeleth; vnderſtandings of Dauid. THE foole hath ſaid in his hart: There is no God.
label: Psalms

text: They are corrupte, and become abominable in iniquities: there is not that doth good.
label: Psalms

text: God hath looked forth from heauen, vpon the children of men: to ſee if there be that vnderſtandeth, or ſeeketh after God.
label: Psalms

text: Al haue declined, they are become vnprofitable together: there is not that doth good, no there is not one.
label: Psalms

text: Shal they not al know that worke iniquitie, that deuoure my people as food of bread?
label: Psalms

text: God they haue not inuocated: there haue they trembled for feare, where no feare was. Becauſe God hath diſſipated the bones of them that pleaſe men: they are confounded, becauſe God hath deſpiſed them.
label: Psalms

text: Who wil geue out of Sion the ſaluation of Iſrael? when God shal conuert the captiuitie of his people: Iacob shal reioyce, and Iſrael shal be glad.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, in ſongs vnderſtanding for Dauid
label: Psalms

text: when the Zipheites were come, and ſaid to Saul: Is not Dauid hid with vs? (1. Reg. 1. 23. & 26.)
label: Psalms

text: O GOD ſaue me in thy name: and in thy ſtrength iudge me.
label: Psalms

text: O God heare my prayer with thine eares: receiue the words of my mouth.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe ſtrangers haue riſen vp againſt me, & the ſtrong haue ſought my ſoule: and they haue not ſet God before their eies.
label: Psalms

text: For behold God helpeth me: and our Lord is the receiuer of my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: Turne away the euils to mine enimies: and in thy truth deſtroy them.
label: Psalms

text: I wil voluntarily ſacrifice to thee, and wil confeſſe to thy name ô Lord, becauſe it is good:
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou haſt deliuered me out of al tribulation: and mine eie hath looked downe vpon mine enimies.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, in ſonges, vnderſtanding to Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: HEARE my prayer ô God, deſpiſe not my petition,
label: Psalms

text: Attend to me; and heare me.
label: Psalms

text: I am made ſorowful in my exerciſe: and am trubled at the voice of the enimie: and at the tribulation of the ſinner. Becauſe they haue wreſted iniquities vpon me: & in anger they were trubleſome to me.
label: Psalms

text: My hart is trubled in me: and the feare of death is falne vpon me.
label: Psalms

text: Feare and trembling are come vpon me: and darkenes hath couered me.
label: Psalms

text: And I ſaid: Who wil geue me wings as of a doue, and I wil fly: and reſt?
label: Psalms

text: Loe I haue gone far flying away: and I abode in the wildernes.
label: Psalms

text: I expected him, that ſaued me from puſillanimitie of ſpirit, and tempeſt.
label: Psalms

text: Precipitate ô Lord, and diuide their tongues: becauſe I haue ſene iniquitie, and contradiction in the citie.
label: Psalms

text: Day and night shal iniquitie compaſſe it vpon the walles therof; and labour in the middeſt therof, and iniuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: And there hath not ceaſed out of the ſtreetes therof vſurie, and guile.
label: Psalms

text: For if myne enimie had ſpoken euil to me, I would verely haue borne it. And if he that hated me had ſpoken great thinges vpon me: I would perhaps haue hid myſelfe from him.
label: Psalms

text: But thou a man of the ſame minde: my guide, and my familiar.
label: Psalms

text: Which diddeſt take ſwete meats together with me, in the houſe of God we walked with conſent.
label: Psalms

text: Let death come vpon them: and let them goe downe quicke into hel. Becauſe there is wickednes in their habitations, in the middes of them.
label: Psalms

text: But I haue cried to God, and our Lord wil ſaue me.
label: Psalms

text: In the euening, and morning, & at midday, I wil ſpeake, and declare, and he wil heare my voice.
label: Psalms

text: He wil redeme my ſoule in peace from them, that approch to me: becauſe among manie they were with me.
label: Psalms

text: God wil heare, and he which is before the worldes wil humble them.
label: Psalms

text: For there is no change with them, & they feared not God: he hath ſtreached forth his hand in repaying.
label: Psalms

text: They haue contaminated his teſtament, they are diuided by the wrath of his countenance; and his hart hath approched. His wordes are made ſofter then oile: and the ſame are dartes.
label: Psalms

text: Caſt thy care vpon our Lord: and he wil nourish thee: he vvil not geue fluctuation to the iuſt for euer.
label: Psalms

text: But thou ô God wilt bring them downe into the pitte of deſtruction. Bloudy and deceitful men shal not liue halfe their daies. but I wil hope in thee ô Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for a people, that is made far from the Sainctes, Dauid in the inſcription of the title, when the foreners held him in Geth. (1. Reg. 12. v. 12.)
label: Psalms

text: HAVE mercie on me ô God, becauſe man hath troden vpon me: al the day impugning he hath afflicted me.
label: Psalms

text: Myne enimies haue troden vpon me al the day: becauſe they are manie that warre againſt me.
label: Psalms

text: From the height of the day I shal feare: but I wil truſt in thee.
label: Psalms

text: In God I wil praiſe my wordes, in God haue I hoped: I wil not feare what flesh may do to me.
label: Psalms

text: Al the day did they deteſt my wordes; againſt me, al their cogitations are vnto euil.
label: Psalms

text: They wil inhabite and keepe ſecret: they wil obſerue my heele. As they haue expected my ſoule,
label: Psalms

text: for nothing shalt thou ſaue them: in wrath thou wilt breake peoples. O God,
label: Psalms

text: I haue shewed my life to thee: thou haſt ſet my teares in thy ſight. As alſo in thy promiſe:
label: Psalms

text: then shal mine enemies be turned backward. In what day ſoeuer I shal inuocate thee: loe I haue knowne that thou art my God.
label: Psalms

text: In God I wil praiſe the word, in our Lord wil I praiſe thee ſaying, I haue hoped in God, I wil not feare what man can do to me.
label: Psalms

text: In me, ô God are thy vowes, which I wil render, praiſes to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou haſt deliuered my ſoule from death, and my feete from falling: that I may pleaſe before God, in the light of the liuing.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, deſtroy not, to Dauid in the inſcription of the title; when he fled from the face of Saul into the caue. (1.Reg.22.24.)
label: Psalms

text: HAVE mercie on me ô God, haue mercie on me: becauſe my ſoule hath truſted in thee. And I wil hope in the shadow of thy winges, vntil iniquitie paſſe.
label: Psalms

text: I wil crie to God the higheſt: God that hath done me good.
label: Psalms

text: He ſent from heauen, and deliuered me: he hath geuen into reproche them that trode vpon me. God hath ſent his mercie, and his truth,
label: Psalms

text: and hath deliuered my ſoule out of the middes of Lions whelpes: I ſlept trubled. The ſonnes of men, their teeth are weapons and arrowes: and their tongue a sharpe ſword.
label: Psalms

text: Be exalted aboue the heauens ô God: and thy glorie vpon al the earth.
label: Psalms

text: They prepared a ſnare for my feete: and bowed downe my ſoule. They digged a pit before my face: and they are falne into it.
label: Psalms

text: My hart is readie ô God, my hart is readie: I wil ſing, and ſay a Pſalme.
label: Psalms

text: Ariſe my glorie, ariſe pſalter and harpe: I wil ariſe early.
label: Psalms

text: I wil confeſſe to thee among peoples ô Lord: and I wil ſay a Pſalme to thee among the Gentiles.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thy mercie is magnified euen to the heauens, and thy truth euen to the cloudes.
label: Psalms

text: Be axalted aboue the heauens ô God: and thy glorie vpon al the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, deſtroy not, to Dauid in, the inſcription of the title.
label: Psalms

text: IF in very dede you ſpeake iuſtice: iudge right thinges ye ſonnes of men.
label: Psalms

text: For in the hart you worke iniquities: in the earth your handes forge iniuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: Sinners are alienated from the matrice, they haue erred from the wombe: they haue ſpoken falſe thinges.
label: Psalms

text: They haue furie according to the ſimilitude of a ſerpent: as of the aſpe that is deafe, and ſtoppeth his eares.
label: Psalms

text: Which wil not heare the voice of the inchanters, and of the ſorcerer inchanting wiſely.
label: Psalms

text: God shal breake their teeth in their mouth, the cheeke tooth of the lions, our Lord wil breake in peeces.
label: Psalms

text: They shal come to nothing as water running downe: he hath bent his bow til they be weakened.
label: Psalms

text: As waxe that melteth, shal they be taken away: fyre hath falne on them, and they haue not ſcene the ſunne.
label: Psalms

text: Before your thornes did vnderſtand the old bryar: as liuing ſo in wrath he swalloweth them.
label: Psalms

text: The iuſt shal reioice when he shal ſee reuenge: he shal wash his handes in the bloud of a ſinner.
label: Psalms

text: And man shal ſay: If certes there be fruite to the iuſt: there is a God certes iudging them on the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, deſtroy not, to Dauid in the inſcription of the title, when Saul ſent, and watched his houſe to kil him. (1. Reg. 19.)
label: Psalms

text: DELIVER me from mine enimies ô my God: and from them that riſe vp againſt me defend me.
label: Psalms

text: Deliuer me from them that worke iniquitie: and from bloudy men ſaue me.
label: Psalms
