text: Becauſe loe they haue taken my ſoule: the ſtrong haue falne violently vpon me.
label: Psalms

text: Neyther is it mine iniquitie, nor my ſinne ô Lord: without iniquitie haue I runne, and gone directly.
label: Psalms

text: Ryſe vp to meete me, and ſee: and thou ô Lord the God of powres, God of Iſrael attend to viſite al nations: haue no mercie on al that worke iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: They wil returne at euening: and they shal ſuffer famine as dogges, and shal compaſſe the citie.
label: Psalms

text: Behold they wil ſpeake in their mouth, and a ſworde in their lippes: becauſe who hath heard?
label: Psalms

text: And thou ô Lord wilt ſcorne them: thou wilt bring to naught al the nations.
label: Psalms

text: I wil keepe my ſtrength to thee: becauſe thou art my recciuer:
label: Psalms

text: my God, thy mercie shal preuent.
label: Psalms

text: God wil shew vnto me concerning mine enimies, kil them not leſt ſometime my peoples forgete. Diſperſe them in thy ſtrength: and depoſe them my protector ô Lord.
label: Psalms

text: The ſinne of their mouth, the word of their lippes: and let them be taken in their pride. And for curſing and lying they shal be talked of
label: Psalms

text: in conſummation: in wrath of comſummation and they shal not be. And they shal know that God wil rule ouer Iacob: and ouer the ends of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: They shal be turned at euening, and shal ſuffer famine as dogges: and shal compaſſe the citie.
label: Psalms

text: They shal be diſperſed to eate: and if they be not filled, they wil murmur alſo.
label: Psalms

text: But I wil ſing thy ſtrength: and wil exalt thy mercie in the morning. Becauſe thou art become my receiuer, and my refuge, in the day of my tribulation.
label: Psalms

text: My helper, I wil ſing to thee, becauſe thou art God my receiuer: my God, my mercie.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for them, that shal be changed, in the inſcription of the title to Dauid him ſelfe, for doctrine,
label: Psalms

text: when he ſet fire on Meſopotamia of Syria, and in Sobal, and Ioab returned, and ſtroke Idumæa in the valley of ſalt-pittes twelue thouſand. (2. Reg. 8. & 10. & 1. Paral. 18.)
label: Psalms

text: O GOD thou haſt repelled vs, & haſt deſtroyed vs: thou waſt angrie and haſt had mercie on vs.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt moued the earth, and haſt trubled it: heale the breaches thereof, becauſe it is moued.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt shewed vnto thy people hard thinges: thou haſt made vs drinke the wine of compunction.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt geuen a ſignification to them that feare thee: they flee from the face of the bow.
label: Psalms

text: That thy beloued may be deliuered, ſaue me with thy right hand; and heare me.
label: Psalms

text: God hath ſpoken in his holie: I shal reioyce, and shal diuide Sichem: and shal meſure the valley of tabernacles.
label: Psalms

text: Galaad is mine, and Manaſſes is mine: and Ephraim the ſtrength of my heade.
label: Psalms

text: Iuda my king: Moab the pot of my hope. Into Edom wil I ſtretch out my shoe: the foreners are ſubiect to me.
label: Psalms

text: Who shal conduct me into a fenſed citie? who shal conduct me euen into Idumea?
label: Psalms

text: Shal not thou ô God, that haſt expelled vs: and wilt not thou ô God goe forth in our hoſtes?
label: Psalms

text: Giue vs aide from tribulation: becauſe mans ſaluation is vaine.
label: Psalms

text: In God we shal doe ſtrength: and he shal bring to nothing them that afflict vs.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, in hyms to Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: HEARE ô God my petition: attend to my praier.
label: Psalms

text: From the ends of the earth I haue cried to thee: whiles my hart was in anguish, thou didſt exalt me on a rocke.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt conducted me, becauſe thou art made my hope: a toure of ſtrength from the face of the enimie.
label: Psalms

text: I shal inhabite in thy tabernacle for euer: I shal be protected in the couert of thy winges.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou my God haſt heard my prayer: thou haſt giuen inheritance to thoſe that feare thy name.
label: Psalms

text: Thou wilt adde dayes vpon the dayes of the king: his years euen vnto the day of generation and generation.
label: Psalms

text: He is permanent for euer in the ſight of God: his mercie and truth who shal require?
label: Psalms

text: So wil I ſay a Pſalme to thy name for euer and euer: that I may render my vowes from day to day.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for Iduthun a Pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: Shal not my ſoule be ſubiect to God? for of him is my ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: For he is my God, and my ſauiour: my receiuer I shal be moued no more.
label: Psalms

text: How long ſet you violently vpon a man: you al doe kil: as it were vpon a wal, that is leaning, and a wal shaken.
label: Psalms

text: But yet they thought to repel my price, I ranne in thirſt: they bleſſed with their mouth, and curſed with their hart.
label: Psalms

text: But yet my ſoule be thou ſubiect to God: becauſe my patience is from him.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he is my God, and my ſauiour: my helper I shal not remoue.
label: Psalms

text: In God is my ſaluation, and my glorie: the God of my helpe, and my hope is in God.
label: Psalms

text: Hope in him al ye the congregation of people: powre out your harts before him, God is our helper for euer.
label: Psalms

text: But yet the children of men are vaine, the children of men are liers in balances: that they may deceiue by vanitie together.
label: Psalms

text: Hope not in iniquitie, and couete not robberies: if riches abound ſet not your hart vpon them.
label: Psalms

text: Once hath God ſpoken, theſe two things haue I heard:
label: Psalms

text: That powre is Gods, and mercie ô Lord is to thee: becauſe thou wilt render to euery one according to his workes.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme of Dauid when he was in the deſert of Iuda (1. Reg. 22.)
label: Psalms

text: O GOD my God to thee I watch, from the morning light. My ſoule hath thirſted to thee, my flesh to thee very manie wayes.
label: Psalms

text: In a deſert land, and inacceſſible, and without water, ſo in the holie haue I appeared to thee, that I might ſee thy ſtrength, and thy glorie.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thy mercie is better then liues, my lippes shal prayſe thee.
label: Psalms

text: So wil I bleſſe thee in my life: and in thy name I wil liſte vp my hands.
label: Psalms

text: As with marrow and fatnes let my ſoule be filled: and my mouth shal praiſe with lippes of exultation.
label: Psalms

text: If I haue bene mindful of thee vpon my bedde, in the morning I wil meditate on thee:
label: Psalms

text: becauſe thou haſt bene my helper.
label: Psalms

text: And in the couert of thy winges I wil reioice, my ſoule hath cleaued after thee: thy right hand hath receiued me.
label: Psalms

text: But they in vaine haue ſought my ſoule, they shal enter into the inferiour partes of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: They shal be deliuered into the handes of the ſworde, they shal be the portions of foxes.
label: Psalms

text: But the king shal reioice in God, al shal be praiſed that ſweare by him: becauſe the mouth is ſtopped of thoſe that ſpeake wicked thinges.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, a Pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: HEARE ô God my prayer when I make petition: from the feare of my enimie deliuer my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt protected me from the aſſemblie of the malignant: from the multitude of them that worke iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe they haue sharpned their tongues as a ſworde: they haue bent the bow a bitter thing,
label: Psalms

text: that they may shoote in ſecretes at the immaculate.
label: Psalms

text: Sodanely they wil shoote at him, and wil not feare: they haue confirmed to themſelues a wicked worde. They haue talked to hide ſnares: they haue ſaide, who shal ſee them?
label: Psalms

text: They haue ſearched iniquities: they haue failed ſearching with ſcrutanie.
label: Psalms

text: Man shal come to a deepe hart: and God shal be exalted. Childrens arrowes are made their woundes:
label: Psalms

text: and their tongues are weakned againſt them. Al that ſaw them were trubled:
label: Psalms

text: and euerie man feared. And they shewed forth the workes of God: and they vnderſtood his doinges.
label: Psalms

text: The iuſt shal reioice in our Lord, and shal hope in him, and al the right of hart shal be praiſed.
label: Psalms

text: To the end, a Pſalme of Dauid, the Canticle of Ieremie, and Ezechiel, to the people of the tranſmigration, when they begane to goe forth.
label: Psalms

text: AN hymne ô God becometh thee in Sion: & a vow shal be rendered to thee in Ieruſalem.
label: Psalms

text: Heare my prayer: al flesh shal come to thee.
label: Psalms

text: The wordes of the wicked haue preuailed vpon vs: and thou wilt be propitious to our impieties.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed is he, whom thou haſt choſen, and taken: he shal dwel in thy courtes.
label: Psalms

text: We shal be replenished in the goods of thy houſe: holie is thy temple, meruelous in equitie. Heare vs ô God our ſauiour, the hope of al the ends of the earth; and in the ſea farre.
label: Psalms

text: Preparing mountanes in thy ſtrength, girded with might:
label: Psalms

text: which trubleſt the depths of the ſea, the ſound of the waues therof.
label: Psalms

text: The Gentiles shal be trubled, and they that inhabite the borders shal be affraide of thy ſignes: the outegoinges of the morning and euening thou shalt delight.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt viſited the earth, and haſt inebriated it: thou haſt multiplied to inrich it. The riuer of God is replenished with waters, thou haſt prepared their meat: becauſe ſo is the preparation therof.
label: Psalms

text: Inebriate her riuers, multiplie her fruites: in her dropps she shal reioyce ſpringing.
label: Psalms

text: Thou wilt bleſſe the crowne of the yeare of thy goodnes: and thy fildes shal be replenished with plentie.
label: Psalms

text: The beautiful places of the deſert shal be fat: and the litle hilles shal be girded aboute with exultation.
label: Psalms

text: The rammes of the shepe are clothed, and the valleis shal abounde with corne: they wil crie, yea they wil ſay an hymne.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, a Canticle of reſurrection. MAke ye iubilation to God al the earth,
label: Psalms

text: ſay a pſalme to his name: geue glorie to his praiſe.
label: Psalms

text: Say ye to God: How terrible are thy workes ô Lord! in the multitude of thy ſtrength thine enimies shal lie to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Let al the earth adore thee, and ſing to thee: let it ſing a pſalme to thy name.
label: Psalms

text: Come ye, and ſee the workes of God: terrible in counſels ouer the chidren of men.
label: Psalms

text: Who turneth the ſea into drie land, in the riuer they shal paſſe on foote, there we shal reioyce in him.
label: Psalms

text: Who ruleth in his ſtrength for euer his eyes looke vpon the gentiles: they that exaſperate him let them not be exalted in themſelues.
label: Psalms

text: Ye Gentiles bleſſe our God: and make the voice of his prayſe hearde.
label: Psalms

text: Who hath put my ſoule in life: and hath not geuen my feete to be moued.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou haſt proued vs ô God: by fire thou haſt tried vs, as ſiluer is tried.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt brought vs into a ſnare, thou haſt laide tribulations on our backe: thou haſt ſet men vpon our heades.
label: Psalms

text: We haue paſſed through fire and water: and thou haſt brought vs out into refreshing.
label: Psalms

text: I wil goe into thy houſe with holocauſtes: I wil render thee my vowes:
label: Psalms

text: which my lippes haue diſtinguished. And my mouth hath ſpoken in my tribulation.
label: Psalms

text: Holocauſtes with marrow wil I offer to thee, with incenſe of rammes: I wil offer to thee oxen with bucke goates.
label: Psalms

text: Come ye, heare, and I wil tel al ye that feare God, what great things he hath done for my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: To him haue I cried with my mouth, and haue exulted vnder my tongue.
label: Psalms

text: If I haue beheld iniquitie in my hart, our Lord wil not heare.
label: Psalms

text: Therfore hath God heard, and hath attended to the voice of my petition.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed be God who hath not remoued my prayer, and his mercie from me.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, in hymes, a Pſalme of Canticle to Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: GOd haue mercie vpon vs, and bleſſe vs: illuminate his countenance vpon vs, and haue mercie on vs.
label: Psalms

text: That we may know thy way vpon earth: in al nations thy ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: Let peoples ô God, confeſſe to thee: let al peoples confeſſe to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Let nations be glad & reioice: becauſe thou iudgeſt peoples in equitie, and the nations in earth thou doeſt direct.
label: Psalms

text: Let peoples ô God confeſſe to thee, let al peoples confeſſe to thee:
label: Psalms

text: the earth hath yelded her fruite. God, our God bleſſe vs,
label: Psalms

text: God bleſſe vs: and let al the endes of the earth feare him.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, a Pſalme of Canticle, to Dauid himſelf.
label: Psalms

text: LEt God ariſe, and let his enimies be diſperſed, and let them that hate him flee from his face.
label: Psalms

text: As ſmoke vanisheth, let them vanish away: as waxe melteth at the preſence of fire, ſo let ſinners perish at the preſence of God.
label: Psalms

text: And let the iuſt make merrie, and reioyce in the ſight of God: and let them be delighted in mirth.
label: Psalms

text: Sing to God, ſay a Pſalme to his name: make way to him, who mounteth vpon the weſt, Lord is his name. Reioyce ye in his ſyght, they shal be trubled at the preſence of him:
label: Psalms

text: the father of orphanes, and iudge of widowes. God in his holie place:
label: Psalms

text: God that maketh men to inhabite of one manner in a houſe. That bringeth forth them, that be bound, in ſtrengh, likewiſe them, that exaſperate, that dwel in ſepulchers.
label: Psalms

text: O God when thou wenteſt forth in the ſight of thy people, when thou didſt paſſe through the deſert.
label: Psalms

text: The earth was moued, and the heauens alſo diſtilled, at the preſence of the God of Sina, at the face of the God of Iſrael.
label: Psalms

text: Voluntarie rayne shalt thou ſeperat ô God to thine inheritance: and it was weakned, but thou haſt perfited it.
label: Psalms

text: Thy liuing creatures shal dwel in it: thou haſt prepared in thy ſwetnes for the poore, ô God.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord shal geue the word to them that euanglize, with great powre.
label: Psalms

text: The king of hoaſtes the beloued of the beloued: and to the beautie of the houſe, to diuide the ſpoyles.
label: Psalms

text: If ye ſleepe among the middeſt of the lottes, the winges of a doue layde ouer with ſiluer, and the hinder parts of her backe in the palenes of gold.
label: Psalms

text: Whiles the heauenlie diſcerneth kings ouer her, with ſnow they shal be made white in Selmon.
label: Psalms

text: The mountane of God a fat mountane. A mountane crudded as cheeſe, a fatte mountane:
label: Psalms

text: why ſuppoſe you crudded mountanes? A mountane, in which it hath wel pleaſed God to dwel therin: for in dede our Lord wil dwel euen to the end.
label: Psalms

text: The chariote of God is ten thouſand folde, thouſands of them that reioyce, our Lord in them, in Sina in the holie place.
label: Psalms

text: Thou art aſcended on hygh, thou haſt taken captiuitie: thou haſt receiued gifts in men: for euen thoſe that do not beleue, our Lord God to inhabite.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed be our Lord day by day: the God of our ſaluations wil make vs a proſperous iourney.
label: Psalms

text: Our God is the God of ſauing: and the iſſues of death are of our Lord, our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: But yet God ſtil breake the heads of his enimies: the hearie croune of them, that walke in their ſinnes.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord Said: Out of Baſan I wil conuert, I wil conuert into the depth of the ſea.
label: Psalms

text: That thy foote may be dipped in bloude: the tongue of thy dogges [made redde] with the ſame [bloud] of the enimies.
label: Psalms

text: They haue ſeene thy entringes in ô God, the entrings of my God: of my King Who is in the holie place.
label: Psalms

text: Princes came before ioyned with them that ſang, in the middes of young wemen plaing on tymbrels.
label: Psalms

text: In churches bleſſe ye God our Lord, of the fountains of Iſrael.
label: Psalms

text: There Beniamin a youngman, in exceſſe of minde. The Princes of Iuda: their leaders: the Princes of Zabulon, the Princes of Nephthali.
label: Psalms

text: Command thy ſtrength ô God: confirme this ô God, which thou haſt wrought in vs.
label: Psalms

text: From thy temple in Ieruſalem, kinges shal offer giftes to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Rebuke the wilde beaſts of the reede, the congregation of bulles in the kine of thy peoples: that they may exclude them, which are tried with ſiluer. Diſſipate the nations that wil warres:
label: Psalms

text: Legates shal come out of Ægypt: Æthiopia shal preuent his handes to God.
label: Psalms

text: Ye kingdomes of the earth ſing to God: ſing to our Lord:
label: Psalms

text: Sing ye to God, that mounteth vpon the heauen of heauen, to the Eaſt. Behold he wil giue to his voice the voice of ſtrength,
label: Psalms

text: giue you glorie to God vpon Iſrael, his magnificence, and his powre in the cloudes.
label: Psalms

text: God is meruelous in his ſaintes, the God of Iſrael he wil giue powre, and ſtrength to his people, God be bleſſed.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for them that shal be changed, to Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: SAve me ô God: becauſe waters are entered into my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: I ſticke faſt in the myre of the depth: and there is no ſure ſtanding. I am come into the depth of the ſea: and a tempeſt hath ouerwhelmed me.
label: Psalms

text: I haue labored crying, my iawes are made hoarſe: my eies haue failed, whiles I hope in my God.
label: Psalms

text: They are multiplied aboue the heares of my head, that hate me without cauſe. Mine enimies are made ſtrong, that haue perſecuted me vniuſtly: then did I pay the thinges that I tooke not.
label: Psalms

text: O God thou knoweſt my foolishnes: and mine offences are not hide from thee.
label: Psalms

text: Let them not be ashamed vpon me, which expect thee ô Lord, Lord of hoſtes. Let them not be confounded vpon me that ſeeke thee, ô God of Iſrael.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe for thee haue I ſuſtained reproch, confuſion hath couered my face.
label: Psalms

text: I am become a forener to my brethren, and a ſtranger to the ſonnes of my mother.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe the zele of thy houſe hath eaten me: and the reproches of them that reproched thee, fel vpon me.
label: Psalms

text: And I couered my ſoule in faſting: and iton was made a reproch to me.
label: Psalms

text: And I put heare cloth my garment, & I became a parable to them.
label: Psalms

text: They ſpake aganſt me that ſat in the gate; and they ſoong aganſt me that dranke wine.
label: Psalms

text: But I, my prayer to thee ô Lord: a time of thy good pleaſure ô God. In the multitude of thy mercie heare me, in the truth of thy ſaluation:
label: Psalms

text: Deliuer me out of the myre, that I ſtick not faſt: deliuer me from them that hate me, and from the depthes of waters.
label: Psalms

text: Let not the tempeſt of water drowne me, nor the depth ſwallowe me: neyther let the pit shut his mouth vpon me.
label: Psalms

text: Heare me ô Lord becauſe thy mercie is benigne: according to the multitude of thy commiſerations haue reſpect to me.
label: Psalms

text: And turne not away thy face from thy ſeruant: becauſe I am in tribulation, heare me ſpeedily.
label: Psalms

text: Attend to my ſoule and, deliuer it: becauſe of mine enimies deliuer me.
label: Psalms

text: Thou knoweſt my reproch, & my confuſion, & my shame.
label: Psalms

text: In thy ſight are al they that afflict me, my hart hath looked for reproch and miſerie. And I expected ſome bodie that would be ſorie together with me, and there was none: and that would confort me, and I founde not.
label: Psalms

text: And they gaue gal for my meate: & in my thirſt they gaue me vinegre to drinke.
label: Psalms

text: Let their table be made a ſnare before them, & for retributions, and for a ſcandal.
label: Psalms

text: Let Their eies be darkned that they ſee not: and make their backe crooked alwaies.
label: Psalms

text: Poure out thy wrath vpon them: and let the furie of thy wrath ouertake them.
label: Psalms

text: Let their habitation be made deſert: and in their tabernacles let there be none to dwel.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe whom thou haſt ſtriken, they haue perſecuted: and vpon the ſorrow of my wounds they haue added.
label: Psalms

text: Adde thou iniquitie vpon their iniquitie: and let them not enter into thy iuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: Let them be put out of the booke of the liuing: and with the iuſt let them not be written.
label: Psalms

text: I am poore and ſorowful: thy ſaluation ô God hath receiued me.
label: Psalms

text: I wil praiſe the name of God with canticle: and wil magnifie him in prayſe.
label: Psalms

text: And it shal pleaſe God more then a young calfe: that bringeth forth hornes and hoofes.
label: Psalms

text: Let the poore ſee and reioyce: ſeeke ye God, and your ſoule shal liue.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord hath heard the poore: and he hath not deſpiſed his priſoners.
label: Psalms

text: Let the heauens and earth praiſe him, the ſea, and al the creeping beaſtes in them.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe God wil ſaue Sion: and the cities of Iuda shal be built vp. And they shal inhabite there, & by inheritance they shal get it.
label: Psalms

text: And the ſeede of his ſeruants shal poſſeſſe it, and they that loue his name shal dwel in it.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, a Pſalme of Dauid, in remembrance, that our Lord ſaued him.
label: Psalms

text: O God intend vnto my helpe: Lord make haſt to helpe me.
label: Psalms

text: Let them be confounded, and be ashamed, that ſeeke my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: Let them be turned away backeward, and be ashamed that wil me euils. Let them be turned away forthwith ashamed, that ſay to me: Wel, wel.
label: Psalms

text: Let al that ſeeke thee reioyce, and be glad in thee, and let them ſay alwayes: Our Lord be magnified: which loue thy ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: But I am needie and poore: ô God helpe me thou art my helper, and deliuerer: ô Lord be not ſlacke.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme for Dauid, of the ſonnes of Ionadab, and the former captiues. IN thee ô Lord I haue hoped, let me not be confounded for euer:
label: Psalms

text: in thy iuſtice deliuer me, and receiue me. Incline thine eare to me, and ſaue me.
label: Psalms

text: Be vnto me for a God protector, and for a fenſed place: that thou maiſt ſaue me: Becauſe thou art my firmament, and my refuge.
label: Psalms

text: My God deliuer me out of the hand of the ſinner, and out of the hand of him that doth aganſt the law, and of the vniuſt.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou art my patience ô Lord: ô Lord my hope from my youth.
label: Psalms

text: Vpon thee haue I bene confirmed from the wombe: from my mothers bellie thou art my protector. In thee is my ſinging alwaies:
label: Psalms

text: I was made to manie as a wonder: and thou art a ſtrong helper.
label: Psalms

text: Let my mouth be filled with praiſe, that I may ſing thy glorie: al the day thy greatnes.
label: Psalms

text: Reiect me not in the time of olde age: when my ſtrength shal faile, forſake me not.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe mine enimies haue ſaid to me: and they that watched my ſoule, conſulted together,
label: Psalms

text: Saying: God hath forſaken him, purſew, and take him: becauſe there is none to deliuer.
label: Psalms

text: O God be not farre from me: my God haue reſpect to mine ayde.
label: Psalms

text: Let them be confounded, and fayle that detract from my ſoule: let them be couered with confuſion, and shame, that ſeeke euils to me.
label: Psalms

text: But I wil alwaies hope: and wil adde vpon al thy praiſe.
label: Psalms

text: My mouth shal shew forth thy iuſtice: al the day thy ſaluation. Becauſe I haue not knowne lerning, I wil enter into the powres of our Lord:
label: Psalms

text: ô Lord I wil be mindful of thy iuſtice onely.
label: Psalms

text: O God thou haſt taught me from my youth: and vntil now I wil pronounce thy meruelous workes.
label: Psalms

text: And vnto ancient age, and olde age: ô God forſake me not? Vntil I shew forth thy arme to al the generation, that is to come. Thy might,
label: Psalms

text: and thy iuſtice ô God euen to the higheſt, great meruailes which thou haſt done: ô God who may be like to thee?
label: Psalms

text: How great tribulations haſt thou shewed me, manie and euil: and turning thou haſt quickened me: and from the depthes of the earth thou haſt brought me backe againe.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt multiplied thy magnificence: and being turned thou haſt comforted me.
label: Psalms

text: For I alſo wil confeſſe to thee in the inſtruments of Pſalme thy truth: ô God I wil ſing to thee on the harpe, holie one of Iſrael.
label: Psalms

text: My lippes shal reioyce when I shal ſing to thee; and my ſoule, which thou haſt redemed.
label: Psalms

text: Yea and my tongue al the day shal meditate thy iuſtice: when they shal be confounded and ashamed that ſeeke euils to me.
label: Psalms

text: Concerning Salomon.
label: Psalms

text: O God giue thy iudgement to the king: and thy iuſtice to the ſonne of the king. To iudge thy people in iuſtice, and thy poore in iudgement.
label: Psalms

text: Let the mountains receiue peace for the people: and the litle hilles iuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: He shal iudge the poore of the people, and shal ſaue the children of the poore: and he shal humble the calumniator.
label: Psalms

text: And he shal continew with the ſunne, and before the moone in generation and generation.
label: Psalms

text: He shal deſcend as rayne vpon a fleece: and as droppes diſtilling vpon the earth.
label: Psalms

text: There shal riſe in his dayes iuſtice, and aboundance of peace, vntil the moone be taken away.
label: Psalms

text: And he shal rule from ſea vnto ſea: and from the riuer euen to the ends of the round world.
label: Psalms

text: Before him shal the Æthiopians fal downe: and his enimies shal lick the earth.
label: Psalms

text: The kinges of Tharſis, and the Ilands shal offer preſentes: the kings of the Arabians, and of Sabá shal bring giftes.
label: Psalms

text: And al kinges of the earth shal adore him: al nations shal ſerue him.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he shal deliuer the poore from the mightie: and the poore which had no helper.
label: Psalms

text: He shal ſpare the poore and needy: and he shal ſaue the ſoules of the poore.
label: Psalms

text: From vſuries and iniquitie he shal redeme their ſoules: and their name shal be honorable before him.
label: Psalms

text: And he shal liue, and there shal be giuen him of the gold of Arabia, and they shal adore it alwaies: al the day they shal bleſſe him.
label: Psalms

text: And there shal be a firmament in the earth, in the toppes of mountanes, the fruite therof shal be extolled farre aboue Libanus: and they shal florish of the citie, as the graſſe of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Be his name bleſſed for euer: before the ſunne his name is permanent. And al the tribes of the earth shal be bleſſed in him: al nations shal magnifie him.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed be our Lord the God of Iſrael, who only doth meruelous thinges.
label: Psalms

text: And bleſſed be the name of his maieſtie for euer: and al the earth shal be filled with his maieſtie. Be it, be it.
label: Psalms

text: The praiſes of Dauid, the ſonne of Ieſſe are ended.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme to Aſaph. HOw good is God to Iſrael, to them, that are of a right hart!
label: Psalms

text: But my feete were almoſt moued, my ſteppes almoſt ſlipped.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe I haue had zele vpon the wicked, ſeing the peace of ſinners.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe there is no reſpect to their death: and ſtabilitie in ther plague.
label: Psalms

text: In the labours of men they are not, and with men they shal not be ſcourged.
label: Psalms

text: Therfore hath pride helde them, they are couered with their iniquitie and impietie.
label: Psalms

text: Their iniquitie hath proceded as it were of fatte: they haue paſſed into the affection of the hart.
label: Psalms

text: They haue thought, and haue ſpoken wickednes they haue ſpoken iniquitie on high.
label: Psalms

text: They haue ſette their mouth vnto heauen: ãd their tongue hath paſſed in the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Therfore wil my people returne here: and ful daies shal be found in them.
label: Psalms

text: And they haue ſaide: How doth God know, and is there knowledge in the higheſt?
label: Psalms

text: Loe the ſinners them ſelues, and they that abounde in the world, haue obtained riches.
label: Psalms

text: And I ſaide: Then haue I iuſtified my hart without cauſe, and haue washed my handes amongſt innocentes:
label: Psalms

text: And haue bene ſcourged al the day, and my chaſtiſing in the morninges.
label: Psalms

text: If I ſaide: I wil ſpeake this: behold I reproued the nation of thy children.
label: Psalms

text: I thought to know this thing, it is labour before me:
label: Psalms

text: Vntil I may enter into the ſanctuarie of God: and may vnderſtand concerning their latter endes.
label: Psalms

text: But yet for guiles thou haſt put it to them: thou haſt caſt them downe whiles they were eleuated.
label: Psalms

text: How are they brought into deſolation, they haue failed ſodanely: they haue perished for their iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: As the dreame of them that riſe ô Lord, in thy citie thou shalt bring their image to nothing.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe my hart is inflamed, and my reynes are changed:
label: Psalms

text: And I am brought to nothing, and knew not.
label: Psalms

text: As a beaſt am I become with thee: and I alwaies with thee.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt helde my right hand: and in thy wil thou haſt conducted me, and with glorie thou haſt receiued me.
label: Psalms

text: For what is to me in heauen? and beſides thee what would I vpon the earth?
label: Psalms

text: My flesh hath fainted, and my hart: God of my hart, and God my portion for euer.
label: Psalms

text: For behold, they that make them ſelues farre from thee, shal perish: thou haſt deſtroyed al, that fornicate from thee.
label: Psalms

text: But it is good for me to cleaue to God: to put my hope in our Lord God: That I may shew forth al thy prayſes, in the gates of the daughter of Sion.
label: Psalms

text: Vnderſtanding to Aſaph. WHy haſt thou ô God repelled for euer: is thy furie wrath vpon the sheepe of thy paſture?
label: Psalms

text: Be mindful of thy congregation, which thou haſt poſſeſſed from the beginning. Thou haſt redemed the rod of thine inheritance: mount Sion, in which thou haſt dwelt.
label: Psalms

text: Lift vp thy handes vpon their prides for euer: how great things hath the enimie done malignantly in the holy place:
label: Psalms

text: And they that hate thee haue gloried: in the middes of thy ſolemnitie. They haue ſette their ſignes, for ſignes:
label: Psalms

text: and haue not knowne, as in the iſſue on high. As in a wood of trees they haue with axes
label: Psalms

text: cut out the gates therof together: in hatchet, and chippeaxe they haue caſt it downe.
label: Psalms

text: They haue burnt thy ſanctuarie with fire: they haue polluted the tabernacle of thy name in the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Their kinred together haue ſaide in their hart: Let vs make al the feſtiual daies of God to ceaſe from the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Our ſignes we haue not ſeene, there is now no prophet: and he wil know vs no more.
label: Psalms

text: How long ô God shal the enimie vpbraide: the aduerſarie prouoke thy name for euer?
label: Psalms

text: Why doeſt thou turne away thy hand, and thy right hand, out of the middes of thy boſome for euer?
label: Psalms

text: But God our king before the worldes: he hath wrought ſaluation in the middes of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Thou in thy ſtrength haſt confirmed the ſea: thou haſt crushed the head of Dragons in the waters.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt broken the heads of the dragon: thou haſt giuen him for meate to the peoples of the Æthiopians.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt broken vp fountaines, and torrentes: thou haſt dried the riuers of Ethan.
label: Psalms

text: The day is thine, and the night is thine: thou haſt made the morning and the ſunne.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt made al the coaſtes of the earth: the ſummer and the ſpring thou haſt formed them.
label: Psalms

text: Be mindeful of this, the enimie hath vpbraided our Lord: and a foolish people hath prouoked thy name.
label: Psalms

text: Deliuer not to beaſts the ſoules that confeſſe to thee: and the ſoules of thy poore forget not for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Haue reſpect vnto thy teſtament: becauſe they that are obſcure of the earth, are filled with houſes of iniquities.
label: Psalms

text: Let not the humble be turned away being confounded: the poore and needy shal praiſe thy name.
label: Psalms

text: Ariſe God, iudge thy cauſe: be mindful of thoſe thy reproches, that are from the foolish man al the day.
label: Psalms

text: Forget not the voices of thine enimies: the pride of them that hate thee, hath aſcended alwaies.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, Corrupt not, a Pſalme of Canticle to Aſaph.
label: Psalms

text: We wil confeſſe to thee ô God: we wil confeſſe, and wil inuocate thy name. We wil tel thy meruelouſe workes:
label: Psalms

text: when I shal take a time, I wil iudge iuſtices.
label: Psalms

text: The earth is melted, and al that dwel in it: I haue confirmed the pillers thereof.
label: Psalms

text: I ſaid to the wicked: doe not wickedly: and to them that offend: Exalt not the horne.
label: Psalms

text: Exalt not your horne on high: ſpeake not iniquitie aganſt God.
label: Psalms

text: For neither from the Eaſt, nor from the Weſt, nor from the deſert mountanes:
label: Psalms

text: becauſe God is Iudge. This man he humbleth, and him he exalteth,
label: Psalms

text: becauſe there is a cuppe in the hand of our Lord of mere wine ful of mixture. And he hath powred it out of this into that, but yet the dregges therof are not emptied: al the ſinners of the earth shal drinke.
label: Psalms

text: But I wil shewforth for euer: I wil ſing to the God of Iacob.
label: Psalms

text: And I wil breake al the hornes of ſinners: and the hornes of the iuſt shal be exalted.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, in prayſes, a Pſalme to Aſaph, a Canticle to the Aſſirians.
label: Psalms

text: God is knowne in Iewrie: in Iſrael his name is great.
label: Psalms

text: And his place is made in peace: and his habitation in Sion.
label: Psalms

text: There he brake the powres of bowes, the shilde, the ſword, and the battle.
label: Psalms

text: Thou doeſt illuminate meruelouſely from the eternal mountaynes:
label: Psalms

text: al the foolish of hart were trubled. They ſlept their ſleepe: and al the men of riches found nothing in their handes.
label: Psalms

text: At thy reprehenſion ô God of Iacob, they haue al ſlumbered that mounted on horſes.
label: Psalms

text: Thou art terrible, and who shal reſiſt thee? from that time thy wrath.
label: Psalms

text: From heauen thou haſt made thy iudgement hearde: the earth trembled and was quiet.
label: Psalms

text: When God aroſe vnto iudgement, that he might ſaue al the meeke of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe the cogitation of man shal confeſſe to thee: and the remanes of the cogitation shal keepe feſtiual day to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Vowe ye, and render to our Lord your God: al ye that round about him bring giftes.
label: Psalms

text: To vthe terrible, and him that taketh away the ſpirite of princes, terrible to the kinges of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for Idithun, a pſalme to Aſaph.
label: Psalms

text: With my voice I haue cried to our Lord: with my voice to God and he attended to me.
label: Psalms

text: In the day of my tribulation I ſought God, with my handes in the night before him: and I was not deceiued. My ſoule refuſed to be comforted,
label: Psalms

text: I was mindeful of God, and was delighted, and was exerciſed: and my ſpirite fainted.
label: Psalms

text: Myne eies preuented the watches: I was trubled, & ſpake not.
label: Psalms

text: I thought vpon old daies: and the eternal yeares I had in minde.
label: Psalms

text: And I meditated in the night with my hart, and I was exerciſed, and I ſwept my ſpirite.
label: Psalms

text: Why, wil God reiect for euer: or wil he not adde to be better pleaſed as yet?
label: Psalms

text: Or wil he cutte of his mercie for euer, from generation vnto generation?
label: Psalms

text: Or wil God forget to haue mercie? or wil he in his wrath keepe in his mercies?
label: Psalms

text: And I ſayde: Now haue I begune: this is the change of the right hand of the Higheſt.
label: Psalms

text: I haue bene mindful of the workes of our Lord: becauſe I wil be mindful, from the beginning of thy meruelous workes.
label: Psalms

text: And I wil meditate in al thy workes: and in thy inuentions I wil be exerciſed.
label: Psalms

text: O God in the holie is thy way: what God is great as our God?
label: Psalms

text: thou art the God that doeſt meruelous thinges. Thou haſt made thy powre knowne among peoples:
label: Psalms

text: thou haſt with thine arme redemed thy people, the children of Iacob, and Ioſeph.
label: Psalms

text: The waters ſaw thee ô God, the waters ſaw thee: and they were afrayd, and the depthes were trubled.
label: Psalms

text: A multitude of the ſounding of waters: the cloudes gaue a voice. For in deede arrowes doe paſſe:
label: Psalms

text: the voice of thy thunder in a wheele. Thy lightenings shined to the rounde world: the earth was moued and trubled.
label: Psalms

text: Thy way in the ſea, and thy pathes in many waters: and thy ſteppes shal not be knowne.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt conducted thy people as sheepe: in the hand of moyſes and Aaron.
label: Psalms

text: Vnderſtanding to Aſaph. MY people attend ye to my law: incline your eare vnto the wordes of my mouth.
label: Psalms

text: I wil open my mouth in parables: I wil ſpeake propoſitions from the beginning.
label: Psalms

text: How great thinges haue we heard and haue knowne them, and our fathers haue told vs.
label: Psalms

text: They were not hid from their children, in an other generation. Telling the prayſes of our Lord, and his powers, and his meruelous workes which he hath done.
label: Psalms

text: And he raiſed vp a teſtimonie in Iacob: and made a law in Iſrael. How great thinges he commanded our fathers, to make
label: Psalms

text: the ſame knowne to their children: that an other generation may know. The children that shal be borne, and shal riſe vp, and shal tel their children.
label: Psalms

text: That they may put their hope in God, and may not forget the workes of God: and may ſeeke after his commandmentes.
label: Psalms

text: That they become not as their fathers: a peruerſe generation and exaſperating. A generation, that hath not directed their hart, their ſpirit hath not bene faithful towards God.
label: Psalms

text: The children of Ephrem bending, and shooting with bow: were turned in the day of battel.
label: Psalms

text: They kept not the teſtament of God: and in his law they would not walke.
label: Psalms

text: And they forgate his benefites, and his meruelous workes, which he shewed them.
label: Psalms

text: Before their fathers he did meruelous thinges in the land of Ægypt, in the filde of Tanis.
label: Psalms

text: He diuided the ſea & brought them through: and he made the waters to ſtand as in a bottle.
label: Psalms

text: And he conducted them in a cloude by day: and al the night by light of fire.
label: Psalms

text: He ſtroke the rocke in the deſert: and gaue them water to drinke as in a great depth.
label: Psalms

text: And he brought forth water out of the rocke: and made waters runne downe as riuers.
label: Psalms

text: And they added as yet to ſinne vnto him: they prouoked the Higheſt to wrath in the place without water.
label: Psalms

text: And they tempted God in their hartes: ſo that they asked meats for their liues.
label: Psalms

text: And they ſpake euil of God: they ſaide: Can God prepare a table in the deſert?
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he ſtroke the rocke and waters ranne, & torrentes flowed: Can he alſo giue bread, or prepare a table for his people?
label: Psalms

text: Therfore our Lord heard, and made delay: and fire was kindled in Iacob, and wrath aſcended vpon Iſrael.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe they beleued not in God, nor hoped in his ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: And he commanded the cloudes from aboue, and opened the gates of heauen.
label: Psalms

text: And he rayned them Manna to eate, and bread of heauen he gaue to them.
label: Psalms

text: Bread of Angels did man eate: he ſent them victuals in abundance.
label: Psalms

text: He tranſported the Southwinde from heauen: and in his powre he brought in the Southweſt winde.
label: Psalms

text: And he rayned vpon them flesh as duſt: and as the ſand of the ſea fethered fowles.
label: Psalms

text: And they fel in the middes of their campe: about their tabernacles.
label: Psalms

text: And they did eate and were filled excedingly, and their deſire he brought to them:
label: Psalms

text: They were not defrauded of their deſire. As yet their meats were in their mouth:
label: Psalms

text: And the wrath of God aſcended vpon them. And he killed their fat ones, and the choſen of Iſrael he hindered.
label: Psalms

text: In al theſe things they ſinned as yet: and they beleued not in his meruelous workes.
label: Psalms

text: And their daies failed in vanitie: and their years in haſt.
label: Psalms

text: When he ſlew them, they ſought him: and they returned, and early they came to him.
label: Psalms

text: And they remembred that God is their helper: and the high God is their redemer.
label: Psalms

text: And they loued him with their mouth, and with their tongue they did lie to him.
label: Psalms

text: But their hart was not right with him: neither were they counted faithful in his teſtament.
label: Psalms

text: But he is merciful, and wil be propicious to their ſinnes: and he wil not deſtroy them. And he abunded to turne away his wrath: and he kindled not al his wrath.
label: Psalms

text: And he remembred that they are flesh: ſpirit going, and not returning.
label: Psalms

text: How often haue they exaſperated him in the deſert: prouoked him to wrath in the place without water.
label: Psalms

text: And they returned, and tempted God: and the holie one of Iſrael they exaſperaed.
label: Psalms

text: They did not remember his hand: in the day that he redemed them from the hand of the afflicter.
label: Psalms

text: As he put his ſignes in Ægypt, and his wonders in the filde of Tanis.
label: Psalms

text: And he turned their riuers into bloude, & their showers that they might not drinke.
label: Psalms

text: He ſent vpon them a ſwarme of flies, and it eate them: and the frogge, and it deſtroyed them.
label: Psalms

text: And he gaue their fruites to the blaſt, and their labors to the locuſte.
label: Psalms

text: And he killed their vineyeardes with haile: and their mulberie trees with horefroſt.
label: Psalms

text: And he deliuered their beaſt to haile: and their poſſeſſion to fire.
label: Psalms

text: He ſent vpon them the wrath of his indignation: indignation, & wrath, and tribulation: immiſſions by euil angels.
label: Psalms

text: He made a way to the path of his wrath, he ſpared not their liues from death: and their cattel he shut vp in death.
label: Psalms

text: And he ſtroke al the firſtborne in the land of Ægypt: the firſt fruites of al their labors in the tabernacles of Cham.
label: Psalms

text: And he tooke away his people as sheepe: and led them as a flock in the deſert.
label: Psalms

text: And he brought them forth in hope, and they feared not: and the ſea couered their enemies.
label: Psalms

text: And he brought them into the mount of his ſanctification, the mount, which his right hand purchaſed. And he caſt out the gentiles from their face: and by lot he diuided the land of them in a corde of diſtribution:
label: Psalms

text: And he made the tribes of Iſrael to dwel in their tabernacles.
label: Psalms

text: And they tempted, and exaſperated God the higheſt, and they kept not his teſtimonies.
label: Psalms

text: And they turned away themſelues, & kept not the couenant: euen as their fathers, they were turned as a crooked bow.
label: Psalms

text: They incenſed him to wrath in their hilles: and in their grauens they prouoked him to emulation.
label: Psalms

text: God heard, and contemned: and he brought Iſrael to nothing excedingly.
label: Psalms

text: And he reiected the tabernacle of Silo, his tabernacle, where he dwelt among men.
label: Psalms

text: And he deliuered their force into captiuitie: and their beautie into the hands of the enemie.
label: Psalms

text: And he shut vp his people in the ſword: and he diſpiſed his inheritance.
label: Psalms

text: Fyre deuoured their young men: and their virgins were not lamented.
label: Psalms

text: Their Prieſtes fel by the ſworde: and their widowes were not wept for.
label: Psalms

text: And our Lord was raiſed vp as one that ſleepeth: as a mightie man hauing ſurfited of wine.
label: Psalms

text: And he ſtroke his enimies on the hinder partes: an euerlaſting reproch he gaue to them.
label: Psalms

text: And he reiected the tabernacle of Ioſeph: and the tribe of Ephraim he choſe not.
label: Psalms

text: But he choſe the tribe of Iuda, mount Sion which he loued.
label: Psalms

text: And he built his ſanctuarie as of vnicornes in the land, which he hath founded for euer.
label: Psalms

text: And he choſe Dauid his ſeruant, and tooke him from the flockes of sheepe: from after the ewes with yong he tooke him.
label: Psalms

text: To feede Iacob his ſeruant, and Iſrael his inheritance.
label: Psalms

text: And he fedde them in the innocencie of his hart: and in the vnderſtandings of his hands he conducted them.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme to Aſaph. O God the Gentiles are come into thine inheritance, they haue polluted thy holie temple: they haue made Ieruſalem as a watch toure of fruits.
label: Psalms

text: They haue made the carcaſes of thy ſeruants, meats for the foules of the aire: the flesh of thy ſainctes for the beaſtes of the land.
label: Psalms

text: They haue poured out their bloude as water round about Ieruſalem: and there was none to burie them.
label: Psalms

text: We are become a reproch to our neighboures: a ſcorne and mocke to them that are round about vs.
label: Psalms

text: How long ô Lord wilt thou be angrie for euer: shal thy zele be kindled as a fire?
label: Psalms

text: Poure out thy wrath vpon the Gentiles, that haue not knowne thee: & vpon the kingdomes, that haue not inuocated thy name.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe they haue deuoured Iacob: and his place they haue made deſolate.
label: Psalms

text: Remember not our old iniquities, let thy mercies quickly preuent vs: becauſe we are become exceding poore.
label: Psalms

text: Help vs ô God our ſauiour: and for the glorie of thy name ô Lord deliuer vs: and be propicious to our ſinnes for thy names ſake.
label: Psalms

text: Leſt they ſay perhaps amongſt the Gentiles: where is their God? and be notified in the nations before our eies. The reuenge of the bloud of thy ſeruants, which hath benne shed:
label: Psalms

text: let the groning of the fettered enter in thy ſight. According to the greatnes of thine arme, poſſeſſe thou the children of them that are put to death.
label: Psalms

text: And tender to our neighboures ſeuenfold in their boſome: their reproch wherewith they haue reproched thee ô Lord.
label: Psalms

text: But we thy people, and the sheepe of thy paſture, wil confeſſe to thee for euer: Vnto generation and generation we wil shew forth thy praiſe.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for them, that shal be changed, teſtimonie to Aſaph, a Pſalme.
label: Psalms

text: Thou that ruleſt Iſrael, attend: that conducteſt Ioſeph as a sheepe. Which ſitteſt vpon the cherubs be manifeſt
label: Psalms

text: before Ephraim, Beniamin, and Manaſses. Raiſe vp thy might, and come, to ſaue vs.
label: Psalms

text: O God conuert vs: and shew thy face, & we shal be ſaued.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord the God of hoſtes, how long wilt thou be angrie vpon the prayer of thy ſeruant?
label: Psalms

text: Thou wilt feede vs with the bread of teares: and giue vs drinke with teares in meſure.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt made vs to be a contradiction to our neighboures and our enimies haue ſcorned vs.
label: Psalms

text: O God of hoſts conuert vs: and shew thy face, and we shal be ſaued.
label: Psalms

text: Thou didſt tranſport the vineyeard out of Ægypt: thou didſt caſt out the Gentiles, and plantedſt it.
label: Psalms

text: Thou waſt the guide of the way in the ſight therof: thou didſt plant the rootes therof, and it filled the earth.
label: Psalms

text: The shadow of it couered the mountanes: and the bowghes of it the ceders of God.
label: Psalms

text: It extended her branches euen to the ſea; and her boughes vnto the riuer.
label: Psalms

text: Why haſt thou deſtroyed the hedge therof: and al that paſſe by the way doe plucke it.
label: Psalms

text: The boare of the wood hath deſtroyed it: and the ſingular wilde beeſt hath eaten it.
label: Psalms

text: O God of hoaſts returne: regard from heauen, and ſee, and viſite this vineyeard.
label: Psalms

text: And perfite it, which thy right hand hath planted: and vpon the ſonne of man whom thou haſt confirmed to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Thinges burnt with fyre, and digged doune at the increpation of thy countenance shal perish.
label: Psalms

text: Let thy hand be vpon the man of thy right hand: and vpon the ſonne of man, whom thou haſt confirmed to thee.
label: Psalms

text: And we depart not from thee, thou wilt quicken vs: and we wil inuocate thy name.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord the God of hoaſtes conuert vs: and shew thy face, and we shal be ſaued.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for wine preſſes, a Pſalme to Aſaph him ſelfe.
label: Psalms

text: Reioice to God our helper: make Iubilation to the God of Iacob.
label: Psalms

text: Take ye Pſalme, and giue timbrel: pleaſant Pſalter with the harpe.
label: Psalms

text: Sound ye with trumpet in the new moone, in the notable day of your ſolemnitie.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe it is a precept in Iſrael, and iudgement to the God of Iacob.
label: Psalms

text: He put it for a teſtimonie in Ioſeph, when he came out of the Land of Ægypt: he heard a tongue which he knew not.
label: Psalms

text: He turned away his backe from burdens: his handes ſerued in baskettes.
label: Psalms

text: In tribulation thou dideſt inuocate me, and I heard thee: I heard thee in the ſecret of the tempeſt: I proued thee at the water of contradiction.
label: Psalms

text: Heare ô my people: and I wil conteſt thee: Iſrael if thou wilt heare me.
label: Psalms

text: There shal be no new God in thee, neither shalt thou adore a ſtrange God.
label: Psalms

text: For I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Ægypt: dilate thy mouth and I wil fil it.
label: Psalms

text: And my People heard not my voice: and Iſrael attended not to me.
label: Psalms

text: And I let them alone, according to the deſires of their hart, they shal goe in their owne inuentions.
label: Psalms

text: If my people had heard me: if Iſrael had walked in my wayes:
label: Psalms

text: I had for nothing, perhaps humbled their enimies: and had laide my hand vpon thoſe that afflict them.
label: Psalms

text: The enimies of our Lord haue lied to him: and their time shal be for euer.
label: Psalms

text: And he fedde them of the fatte of corne: and out of the rocke, with honie he filled them.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme to Aſaph. God ſtood in the aſſemblie of goddes, and in the middes he iudgeth goddes.
label: Psalms

text: How long iudge ye iniquitie: and accept ye the perſons of ſinners.
label: Psalms

text: Iudge ye for the needie and the pupil: iuſtifie ye the humble, and the poore.
label: Psalms

text: Take away the poore: and deliuer the needie from the hand of the ſinner.
label: Psalms

text: They knew not, neither did they vnderſtand, they walke in darkeneſſe: al the fundations of the earth shal be moued.
label: Psalms

text: I ſaide: Yow are goddes, and the ſonnes of the higheſt al.
label: Psalms

text: But you shal die as men: and fal as one of the princes.
label: Psalms

text: Ariſe ô God, iudge the earth: becauſe thou shalt inherite in al the Gentiles.
label: Psalms

text: A Canticle of Pſalme to Aſaph.
label: Psalms

text: O God who shal be like to thee? hold not thy peace, neither be thou appeaſed ô God:
label: Psalms

text: For behold thine enimies haue made a ſound: they that hate thee, haue lifted vp the head.
label: Psalms

text: They haue taken malignant counſel vpon thy people: and they haue deuiſed againſt thy ſaincts.
label: Psalms

text: They haue ſaide: Come, and let vs deſtroy them out of the nation: and let the name of Iſrael be remembred no more.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe they haue deuiſed with one conſent: they haue together made a couenant againſt thee.
label: Psalms

text: The tabernacles of the Idumeians, and the Iſmahelites Moab, and the Agarens.
label: Psalms

text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalec: the foreners, with the inhabitantes of Tyre.
label: Psalms

text: Yea and Aſſur alſo is come with them: they are made an aide to the children of Lot.
label: Psalms

text: Doe to them as to Madian, and Siſara: as to Iabin in the torrent Ciſſon.
label: Psalms

text: They perished in Endor: they were made as the dung of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Put their princes as Oreb, and Zeb, and Zebee, and Salmana.
label: Psalms

text: Al their princes: which haue ſaide: Let vs poſſeſſe the Sanctuarie of God for an inheritance.
label: Psalms

text: My God put them as a wheele: and as ſtubble before the face of the winde.
label: Psalms

text: Euen as fire that burneth a wood: & as a flame that burneth the mountaines:
label: Psalms

text: So shalt thou purſew them in thy tempeſt: and in thy wrath thou shalt truble them.
label: Psalms

text: Fil their faces with ignominie: and they wil ſeeke thy name, ô Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Let them be ashamed, and trubled for euer and euer: and let them be confounded, and perish.
label: Psalms

text: And let them know that Lord is thy name, thou onlie the Higheſt in al the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, for wine preſſes, the children of Core, a Pſalme.
label: Psalms

text: How beloued are thy tabernacles ô Lord of hoaſtes!
label: Psalms

text: My ſoule coueteth, and fainteth vnto the courtes of our Lord. My hart, and my flesh haue reioyced toward the liuing God.
label: Psalms

text: For the ſparow alſo hath found her an houſe: and the turtledoue a neſt for her ſelfe, where she may lay her young ones. Thine altars ô Lord of hoaſtes: my King, and my God.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed are they, that dwel in thy houſe ô Lord: for euer and euer they shal praiſe thee.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed is the man, whoſe helpe is from thee: he hath diſpoſed aſcenſion in his hart,
label: Psalms

text: in the vaile of teares, in the place, which he hath appointed.
label: Psalms

text: For the lawgeuer shal geue bleſſing, they shal goe from vertue into vertue: the God of goddes shal be ſeene in Sion.
label: Psalms

text: Lord God of hoaſtes heare my prayer: receiue with thine eare ô God of Iacob.
label: Psalms

text: Behold ô God our protectour: and looke vpon the face of thy Chriſt.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe better is one day in thy courtes, aboue thouſands. I haue choſen to be an abiect in the houſe of my God: rather then to dwel in the tabernacles of ſinners.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe God loueth mercie and truth: our Lord wil geue grace, and glorie.
label: Psalms

text: He wil not depriue them of good thinges, that walke in innocencie: ô Lord of hoaſtes bleſſed is the man, that hopeth in thee.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, to the children of Core, a Pſalme.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord thou haſt bleſſed thy land: thou haſt turned away the captiuitie of Iacob.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt forgeuen the iniquitie of thy people: thou haſt couered al their ſinnes.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt mitigated al thy wrath: thou haſt turned away from the wrath of thine indignation.
label: Psalms

text: Conuert vs ô God our ſauiour: and auert thy wrath from vs.
label: Psalms

text: Wilt thou be wrath with vs for euer? or wilt thou extend thy wrath from generation vnto generation?
label: Psalms

text: O God thou being turned shalt quicken vs: and thy people shal reioyce in thee.
label: Psalms

text: Shew vs ô Lord thy mercie and giue vs thy ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: I wil heare what our Lord God wil ſpeake in me: becauſe he wil ſpeake peace vpon his people. And vpon his ſainctes: and vpon them, that are conuerted to the hart.
label: Psalms

text: But yet his ſaluation is nigh to them that feare him: that glorie may inhabite in our land.
label: Psalms

text: Mercie and truth haue met each other: iuſtice and peace haue kiſſed.
label: Psalms

text: Truth is riſen out of the earth: and iuſtice hath looked downe from heauen.
label: Psalms

text: For our Lord certes wil geue benignitie: and our land shal giue her fruite.
label: Psalms

text: Iuſtice shal walke before him: and shal ſet his ſteppes in the way.
label: Psalms

text: A praier to Dauid him ſelfe. Incline thine eare ô Lord, and heare me: becauſe I am needie and poore.
label: Psalms

text: Keepe my ſoule, becauſe I am holie: ſaue thy ſeruant my God, that hopeth in thee.
label: Psalms

text: Haue mercie on me ô Lord, becauſe I haue cried to thee al the day:
label: Psalms

text: make ioyful the ſoule of thy ſeruant, becauſe to thee ô Lord haue I lifted vp my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou ô Lord art ſwete, and milde: and of ſo much mercie to al that inuocate thee.
label: Psalms

text: Receiue ô Lord my praier with thine eares: and attend to the voice of my petition.
label: Psalms

text: In the day of my tribulation I haue called to thee: becauſe thou haſt heard me.
label: Psalms

text: There is not the like to thee amongſt goddes ô Lord: and there is not according to thy workes.
label: Psalms

text: Al nations whatſoeuer thou haſt made, shal come, and shal adore before thee ô Lord: and they shal glorifie thy name.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou art great and doing meruelous thinges: thou onlie art God.
label: Psalms

text: Conduct me ô Lord in thy way, and I wil walke in thy truth: let my hart reioyce that it may feare thy name.
label: Psalms

text: I wil confeſſe to thee ô Lord my God with al my hart, and wil glorifie thy name for euer:
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thy mercie is great vpon me: and thou haſt deliuered my ſoule out of the lower hel.
label: Psalms

text: O God the wicked are riſen vp vpon me, and the ſynagogue of the mightie haue ſought my ſoule: and they haue not ſet thee in their ſight.
label: Psalms

text: And thou ô Lord the God of compaſſion and merciful, patient, and of much mercie, and true.
label: Psalms

text: Haue reſpect to me, and haue mercie on me, giue thine empire to thy ſeruant: and ſaue the ſonne of thy handmaide.
label: Psalms

text: Make with me a ſigne vnto God, that they may ſee which hate me, and may be confounded: becauſe thou ô Lord haſt holpen me.
label: Psalms

text: To the children of Core, a Pſalme of Canticle. THE fundations thereof in the holie mountaynes:
label: Psalms

text: our Lord loueth the gates of Sion, aboue al the tabernacles of Iacob.
label: Psalms

text: Glorious thinges are ſaide of thee, ô cittie of God.
label: Psalms

text: I wil be mindeful of Raab, and Babylon knowing me. Behold the foreners, and Tyre, & the people of the Æthiopians, theſe were there.
label: Psalms

text: Shal it not be ſaid of Sion Man and man, is borne in her; and the Higheſt himſelfe founded her?
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord wil declare in ſcriptures of peoples, and of princes: of thoſe that haue bene in her.
label: Psalms

text: The habitation in thee, is as it were of al reioycing.
label: Psalms

text: A Canticle of a Pſalme, to the children of Core, vnto the end, for Maheleth to anſwer, of vnderſtanding to Eman the Ezrahite.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord the God of my ſaluation: in the day haue I cried, and in the night before thee.
label: Psalms

text: Let my prayer enter in thy ſight: incline thine eare to my petition.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe my ſoule is replenished with euils: and my life hath approched to hel.
label: Psalms

text: I am accounted with them that deſcend into the lake. I am become as a man without helpe,
label: Psalms

text: free among the dead, as the wounded ſleeping in the ſepulchres, of whom thou art mindeful no more: and they are caſt of from thy hand.
label: Psalms

text: They haue put me in the lower lake: in the darke places, and in the shadowe of death.
label: Psalms

text: Thy furie is confirmed vpon me: and al thy waues thou haſt brought in vpon me.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt made my familiars far from me: they haue put me abomination to themſelues. I was deliuered and came not forth:
label: Psalms

text: myne eies languished for pouertie. I cried to thee ô Lord al the day: I ſtretched out my handes to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Wilt thou doe meruels to the dead: or shal phiſicians raiſe to life, and they confeſſe to thee?
label: Psalms

text: Shal any in the ſepulchre declare thy mercie, and thy truth in perdition?
label: Psalms

text: Shal thy meruelous workes be knowne in darkenes: and thy iuſtice in the land of obliuion.
label: Psalms

text: And I ô Lord haue cried to thee: and in the morning shal my praier preuent thee.
label: Psalms

text: Why doeſt thou o Lord reiect my prayer: turneſt away thy face from me?
label: Psalms

text: I am poore, and in labours from my youth: and being exalted, humbled and troubled.
label: Psalms

text: Thy wrathes haue paſſed vpon me: and thy terrouts haue trubled me.
label: Psalms

text: They haue compaſſed me as water al the day: they compaſſed me together.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt made frend, and neighboure far from me: and my familiars becauſe of miſerie.
label: Psalms

text: Of vnderſtanding to Ethan the Ezrahite.
label: Psalms

text: THE mercies of our Lord I wil ſing for euer. In generation and generation I wil shewe forth thy truth, in my mouth.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou ſaidſt: Mercie shal be built vp for euer in the heauens: thy truth shal be prepared in them.
label: Psalms

text: I haue ordained a teſtament with mine elect, I haue ſworne to Dauid my ſeruant:
label: Psalms

text: for ever wil I prepare thy ſeede. And I wil build thy ſeat vnto generation and generation.
label: Psalms

text: The heauens shal confeſſe thy meruelous workes ô Lord: yea and thy truth in the church of ſaintes.
label: Psalms

text: For who in the cloudes shal be equal to our Lord: shal be like to God among the ſonnes of God?
label: Psalms

text: God, who is glorified in the counſel of ſaintes: great and terrible ouer al that are round about him.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord God of hoaſtes who is like to thee? thou art mightie ô Lord, and thy truth round about thee.
label: Psalms

text: Thou ruleſt ouer the powre of the ſea: and the mouing of the waues therof thou doeſt mitigate.
label: Psalms

text: Thou humbledſt the proud one, as one wounded: in the arme of thy ſtrength thou haſt diſperſed thine enimies.
label: Psalms

text: The heauens are thine, and the earth is thine, the round earth, and the fulnes therof thou haſt founded:
label: Psalms

text: the north, and the ſea thou haſt created. Thabor and Hermon shal reioice in thy name:
label: Psalms

text: thy arme is with might. Let thy hand be confirmed, and thy righthand exalted:
label: Psalms

text: iuſtice and iudgement is the preparation of thy ſeat. Mercie and truth shal goe before thy face:
label: Psalms

text: bleſſed is the people that knoweth iubilation. Lord they shal walke in the light of thy countinance,
label: Psalms

text: and in thy name they shal reioyce al the day: and in thy iuſtice they shal be exalted.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou art the glorie of their ſtreingth: and in thy good pleaſure shal our horne be exalted.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our protection is of our Lord: and of the holie one of Iſrael our king.
label: Psalms

text: Then didſt thou ſpeake in viſion to thy ſaintes, and ſaidſt I haue put helpe on the mightie one: and haue exalted an elect one of my people.
label: Psalms

text: I haue found Dauid my ſeruant: with myne holie oyle haue I anointed him.
label: Psalms

text: For mine hand shal helpe him: and myne arme shal ſtrengthen him.
label: Psalms

text: The enimie shal nothing preuale in him: and the ſonne of iniquitie shal not adde to hurt him.
label: Psalms

text: And I wil cut downe his enimies before his face: and them that hate him I wil put to flight.
label: Psalms

text: And my truth, and my mercie with him: and in my name shal his horne be exalted.
label: Psalms

text: And I wil put his hand in the ſea: and his righthand in the riuers.
label: Psalms

text: He shal inuocate me: Thou art my Father: my God, and the protector of my ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: And I wil put him the firſtbegotten, high aboue the kings of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: I wil kepe my mercie vnto him for euer: and my teſtament faithful to him.
label: Psalms

text: I wil put his ſeed for euer and euer: and his throne as the daies of heauen.
label: Psalms

text: But if his children shal forſake my lawe: and wil not walke in my Iudgementes:
label: Psalms

text: If they shal profane my iuſtices: and not kepe my commandmentes:
label: Psalms

text: I wil viſite their iniquities with a rod: and their ſinnes with ſtripes:
label: Psalms

text: But, my mercie I wil not take away from him: neither wil I hurt in my truth:
label: Psalms

text: Neither wil I profane my teſtament: and the words that procede from my mouth I wil not make fruſtrate.
label: Psalms

text: Once I haue ſworne in my holie, if I lie to Dauid:
label: Psalms

text: his ſeede shal continewe for euer.
label: Psalms

text: And his throne as the Sunne in my ſight, and as the Moone perfect for euer: and a faithful witneſſe in heauen.
label: Psalms

text: But thou haſt repelled and diſpiſed: thou haſt differred thy Chriſt.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt ouerthrowne the teſtament of thy ſeruant: thou haſt profaned his ſanctuarie on the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt deſtroyed al the hedges therof: thou haſt made the firmament therof feare.
label: Psalms

text: Al that paſſe by the way haue ſpoiled him: he is become a reproch to his neighbours.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt exalted the righthand of them that oppreſſe him: thou haſt made al his enimies ioyful.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt turned away the helpe of his ſword: and haſt not holpen him in battel.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt deſtroied him from emundation: and his ſeat thou haſt broken downe to the ground.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt leſſened the daies of his time: thou haſt ouerwhelmed him with confuſion.
label: Psalms

text: How long ô Lord doeſt thou turne away for euer: shal thy wrath burne as a fire?
label: Psalms

text: Remember what my ſubſtance is: for haſt thou made al the children of men in vaine?
label: Psalms

text: Who is the man that shal liue, and shal not ſee death: shal deliuer his ſoule from the hand of hel?
label: Psalms

text: Where are thyne old mercies ô Lord, as thou ſwareſt to Dauid in thy truth?
label: Psalms

text: Be mindeful ô Lord of the aeproch of thy ſeruantes (which I haue held in my boſome) of manie nations.
label: Psalms

text: Which thine enimies haue reproched ô Lord, which they haue reproched the commutation of thy Chriſt.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed be our Lord for euer: Be it, be it.
label: Psalms

text: A prayer of Moyſes the man of God. Lord, thou art made a refuge for vs: from generation vnto generation.
label: Psalms

text: Before the mountaines were made, or the earth and the world formed: from euerlaſting euen vnto euerlaſting thou art God.
label: Psalms

text: Turne not away man into humiliation: thou ſaidſt: Be conuerted ye children of men.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe a thouſand years before thine eies, are as yeſterday, that is paſt. And as a watch in the night,
label: Psalms

text: thinges that are counted nothing shal their years be.
label: Psalms

text: In the morning as an herbe he shal paſſe, in the morning he shal florish, and paſſe: in the euening he shal fal, be hardened, and withered.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe we haue faynted in thy wrath, and in thy furie we are trubled.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt put our iniquities in thy ſight: our age in the light of thy countinance.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe al our daies haue failed: and in thy wrath we haue failed. Our yeares shal be conſidered as a ſpyder:
label: Psalms

text: the daies of our yeares in them, are ſeuentie yeares. And if in ſtrong ones eightie years: and the more of them, labour and ſorrow. Becauſe mildnes is come vpon vs: and we shal be chaſtiſed.
label: Psalms

text: Who knoweth the powre of thy wrath: and for feare
label: Psalms

text: to number thy wrath? So make thy righthand knowne: and men learned in hart, in wiſedome.
label: Psalms

text: Turne ô Lord, how long? and be intreated for thy ſeruants.
label: Psalms

text: We are replenished in the morning with thy mercie: and we haue reioyced, and are delighted al our daies.
label: Psalms

text: We haue reioyced for the daies wherin thou haſt humbled vs: the yeares, wherin we haue ſeene euils.
label: Psalms

text: Looke vpon thy ſeruants, and vpon thy workes: and direct their children.
label: Psalms

text: And let the brightnes of our Lord God be vpon vs, and direct thou the workes of our handes ouer vs: and the worke of our handes doe thou direct.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſe of a Canticle to Dauid. He that dwelleth in the helpe of the Higheſt, shal abide in the protection of the God of heauen.
label: Psalms

text: He shal ſay to our Lord: Thou art my protectour, and my refuge: my God I wil hope in him.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath deliuered me from the ſnare of the hunters, and from the sharpe word.
label: Psalms

text: With his shoulders shal he ouershadowe thee: and vnder his winges thou shalt hope.
label: Psalms

text: With shilde shal his truth compaſſe thee: thou shalt not be afrayed of the feare in the night.
label: Psalms

text: Of the arrow flying in the day, of buſines walking in darkenes: of inuaſion, and the midday diuel.
label: Psalms

text: A thouſand shal fal on thy ſyde, & ten thouſand: on thy righthand: but to thee it shal not approch.
label: Psalms

text: But thou shalt conſider with thine eies: and shalt ſee the retribution of ſinners.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou ô Lord art my hope: thou haſt made the Higheſt thy refuge.
label: Psalms

text: There shal no euil come to thee: and ſcourge shal not approch to thy tabernacle.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath geuen his Angels charge of thee: that they keepe thee in al thy waies.
label: Psalms

text: In their handes they shal beare thee: leſt perhaps thou knocke thy foote againſt a ſtone.
label: Psalms

text: Vpon the aſpe, and the baſiliſcus thou shalt walke: & thou shalt tread vpon the lion, and the dragon.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath hoped in me, I wil deliuer him: I wil protect him, becauſe he hath knowne my name.
label: Psalms

text: He shal crie to me, and I wil heare him: with him I am in tribulation: I wil deliuer him, and wil glorifie him.
label: Psalms

text: With length of daies I wil replenish him: and I wil shew him my ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme of Canticle, in the ſabbath day.
label: Psalms

text: IT is good to confeſſe to our Lord; and to ſing to thy name ô Higheſt.
label: Psalms

text: To shewforth thy mercie in the morning: and thy truth in the night.
label: Psalms

text: In the inſtrument of tenſtrings, in Pſalter: with Canticle, on the Harpe.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou haſt delighted me ô Lord in thy workemanship: and in the workes of thy handes I wil reioyce.
label: Psalms

text: How are thy workes magnified ô Lord! thy cogitations are made very profounde.
label: Psalms

text: The vnwiſe man wil not know; and the foule wil not vnderſtand theſe thinges.
label: Psalms

text: When ſinners shal ſpring vp as graſſe: and al that worke iniquitie shal appeare. That they may perish for euer:
label: Psalms

text: but thou the Higheſt for euer ô Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe loe thine enimies ô Lord, becauſe loe thine enimies shal perish: and al that worke iniquitie shal be diſperſed.
label: Psalms

text: And my horne shal be exalted, as the vnicorns: and my old age in plentiful mercie.
label: Psalms

text: And mine eie hath looked vpon mine enimies: and the malignant ryſing vp againſt me, mine ears shal heare.
label: Psalms

text: The iuſt, shal florish as a palme tree: as the ceder of Libanus shal he be multiplied.
label: Psalms

text: They that are planted in the houſe of our Lord, shal florish in the courtes of the houſe of our God.
label: Psalms

text: As yet shal they be multiplied in plentiful old age: and they shal be wel affected,
label: Psalms

text: that they may shewforth: That the Lord our God is righteous, and there is no iniquitie in him.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſe of Canticle to Dauid himſelfe, in the day before the ſabbath, when the earth was founded. OVr Lord hath reigned, he hath put on beutie: our Lord hath put on ſtrength, and hath girded him ſelfe. For he hath eſtablished the round world, which shal not be moued.
label: Psalms

text: Thy ſeat is prepared from that time: thou art from euerlaſting.
label: Psalms

text: The riuers ô Lord haue lifted vp: the riuers haue lifted vp their voice. The riuers haue lifted vp their waues,
label: Psalms

text: aboue the voices of manie waters. The ſurges of the ſea are meruelous; meruelous is our Lord on high.
label: Psalms

text: Thy teſtimonies are made credible exceedingly: holines becometh thy houſe ô Lord for length of daies.
label: Psalms

text: To Dauid himſelfe, in the fourth of the ſabbath. OVr Lord God of reuenges: the God of reuenges hath done freely.
label: Psalms

text: Be exalted thou that iudgeſt the earth: render retribution to the proude.
label: Psalms

text: How long shal ſinners ô Lord: how long shal ſinners glorie?
label: Psalms

text: Shal they vtter, and ſpeake iniquitie? shal al they ſpeake, that worke iniuſtice?
label: Psalms

text: Thy people ô Lord they haue humbled: and thine inheritance they haue vexed.
label: Psalms

text: The widow, and the ſtranger they haue ſlaine: and the pupilles they haue killed.
label: Psalms

text: And they haue ſaide: The Lord shal not ſee, neither shal the God of Iacob vnderſtand.
label: Psalms

text: Vnderſtand ye foolish in the people: and ye fooles be wiſe at ſometime.
label: Psalms

text: He that planted the eare, shal he not heare? Or he that made the eie doth he not conſider?
label: Psalms

text: He that chaſtiſeth nations, shal he not rebuke: he that teacheth man knowledge?
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord knoweth the cogitations of men: that they be vaine.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed is the man, whom thou shalt inſtruct ô Lord: and shalt teach out of thy lawe.
label: Psalms

text: That thou maiſt geue him quietnes from the euil daies: til a pitte be digged for the ſinner.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord wil not reiect his people: and his inheritance he wil not forſake.
label: Psalms

text: Vntil iuſtice be turned into iudgement: and they who are neere it, are al that are right of hart.
label: Psalms

text: Who shal riſe for me againſt the malignant? or who shal ſtand with me againſt them that worke iniquitie?
label: Psalms

text: But that our Lord hath holpen me: within very litle my ſoule had dwelt in hel.
label: Psalms

text: If I ſaid: My foote is moued: thy mercie ô Lord did help me
label: Psalms

text: According to the multitude of my ſorrowes in my hart: thy conſolations haue made my ſoule ioyful.
label: Psalms

text: Doth the ſeat of iniquitie cleaue to thee: which makeſt labour in precept?
label: Psalms

text: They wil hunt after the ſoule of the iuſt: and wil condemne innocent bloud.
label: Psalms

text: And our Lord became my refuge: and my God the helpe of my hope.
label: Psalms

text: And he wil repay them their iniquitie: and in their malice he wil deſtroy them: the Lord our God wil deſtroy them.
label: Psalms

text: Praiſe of Canticle, to Dauid him ſelfe. COME, let vs reioyce to our Lord: let vs make iubilation to God our ſauiour.
label: Psalms

text: Let vs preuent his face in confeſſion: and in Pſalmes let vs make iubilation to him.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord is a great God: and a great King aboue al goddes.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe in his hand are the endes of the earth: and the heightes of the mountaines be his.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe the ſea is his, and he made it: and his handes formed the drie land.
label: Psalms

text: Come let vs adore, and fal downe: and wepe before our Lord, that made vs.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he is the Lord our God; and we the people of his paſture, and the shepe of his hand.
label: Psalms

text: To day if ye shal heare his voice, harden not your hartes;
label: Psalms

text: As in the prouocation according to the day of the tentation in the deſert: where your fathers tempted me, proued me, and ſaw my workes.
label: Psalms

text: Fourtie years was I offended with that generation, and ſaid: Theſe alwaies erre in hart.
label: Psalms

text: And theſe haue not knowne my waies: as I ſware in my wrath: if they shal enter into my reſt.
label: Psalms

text: A Canticle to Dauid himſelfe, when the houſe was built after the captiuitie. SING ye to our Lord a new ſong: ſing to our Lord al the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Sing ye to our Lord, and bleſſe his name: shewforth his ſaluation from day to day.
label: Psalms

text: Shewforth his glorie among the Gentiles, his meruelous workes in al peoples.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord is great, and exceeding laudable: he is terrible aboue al goddes.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe al the goddes of the Gentiles are diuels, but our Lord made the heauens.
label: Psalms

text: Confeſſion, and beauty in his ſight: holineſſe, and magnificence in his ſanctification.
label: Psalms

text: Bring to our Lord ye families of Gentiles, bring ye to our Lord glorie and honour:
label: Psalms

text: bring to our Lord glorie vnto his name. Take vp hoaſtes, and enter into his courtes:
label: Psalms

text: adore ye our Lord in his holie court. Let al the earth be moued before his face:
label: Psalms

text: ſay ye among the Gentiles that our Lord hath reigned. For he hath corrected the round world which shal not be moued: he wil iudge peoples in equitie.
label: Psalms

text: Let the heauens be glad, and the earth reioyce, the ſea be moued, and the fulneſſe therof:
