text: the fieldes shal be glad, and al things, that are in them. Then shal the trees of the woodes reioyce
label: Psalms

text: before the face of our Lord, becauſe he cometh: becauſe he cometh to iudge the earth. He wil iudge the round world in equitie, and peoples in his truth.
label: Psalms

text: To this Dauid, when his land was reſtored agane to him. OVr Lord hath reigned, let the earth reioyce: let manie Ilands be glad.
label: Psalms

text: Cloude, and miſt round about him: iuſtice, and iudgement the correction of his ſeat.
label: Psalms

text: Fire shal goe before him, and shal inflame his enimies round about.
label: Psalms

text: His lightninges shined to the round world, the earth ſawe, and was moued,
label: Psalms

text: The mountaines melted as waxe, before the face of our Lord: before the face of our Lord al the earth.
label: Psalms

text: The heauens haue shewed forth his iuſtice: and al peoples haue ſeene his glorie.
label: Psalms

text: Let them al be confounded, that adore ſculptils: and that glorie in their idoles. Adore him al ye his Angels:
label: Psalms

text: Sion heard, and was glad. And the daughters of Iuda reioyced, becauſe of thy iudgements ô Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou Lord moſt high ouer al the earth: thou art exalted excedingly aboue al goddes.
label: Psalms

text: You that loue our Lord, hate ye euil: our Lord keepeth the ſoules of his ſaintes, out of the hand of the ſinner he wil deliuer them.
label: Psalms

text: Light is riſen to the iuſt, and ioy to the right of hart.
label: Psalms

text: Be glad ye iuſt in our Lord: and confeſſe ye to the memorie of his ſanctification.
label: Psalms

text: A pſalme to Dauid himſelfe. SING ye to our Lord a new ſong: becauſe he hath done meruelous thinges. His righthand hath wrought ſaluation to himſelfe: and his arme is holie.
label: Psalms

label: Psalms

label: Psalms

label: Psalms

label: Psalms

label: Psalms

text: let the ſea be moued, and the fulnes therof: the round world, and they that dwel therin:
label: Psalms

label: Psalms

text: at the ſight of our Lord: becauſe he cometh to iudge the earth. He wil iudge the round earth in iuſtice, and the peoples in equitie.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme to Dauid himſelfe. OVr Lord hath reigned, let peoples be angrie: he that ſitteth vpon the Cherubs, let the earth be moued.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord great in Sion: and high aboue al peoples.
label: Psalms

text: Let them confeſſe to thy great name: becauſe it is terrible, and holie.
label: Psalms

label: Psalms

text: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and adore his footſtoole: becauſe it is holie.
label: Psalms

text: Moyſes, and Aaron in his prieſtes: and Samuel among them, that inuocate his name: They inuocated our Lord and he heard them:
label: Psalms

text: in a piller of a cloud he ſpake to them. They kept his teſtimonies, & the precept which he gaue them.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord our God thou heardeſt them: God thou waſt propitious to them, and taking vengeance vpon al their inuentions.
label: Psalms

text: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and adore ye in his holie mount: becauſe the Lord our God is holie.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme in confeſſion.
label: Psalms

text: MAKE ye iubilation to God al the earth: ſerue ye our Lord in gladneſſe. Enter ye in before his ſight, in exulration.
label: Psalms

text: Know ye that our Lord he is God: he made vs, and not we ourſelues. His people, and the sheepe of his paſture:
label: Psalms

text: enter ye into his gates in confeſſion, his courtes in hymnes: confeſſe ye to him. Praiſe ye his name:
label: Psalms

text: becauſe our Lord is ſweete, his mercie for euer, and his truth euen vnto generation and generation.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme to Dauid himſelfe. MERCIE and iudgement I wil ſing to thee ô Lord: I wil ſing,
label: Psalms

text: and I shal vnderſtand in the immaculate way, when thou shalt come to me. I walked through in the inocencie of my hart, in the middes of my houſe.
label: Psalms

text: I did not propoſe before mine eies any vniuſt thing: I hated them that do preuarication.
label: Psalms

text: A peruerſe hart hath not cleaued to me: the malignant declining from me I knew not.
label: Psalms

text: One ſecretly detracting from his neighbour, him did I perſecute. One of a proud eye, and vnſatiable hart, with him I did not eate.
label: Psalms

text: Mine eies are towards the faithful of the earth that they may ſit with me. A man that walketh in the immaculate way, he did miniſter to me.
label: Psalms

text: He that doth proudly shal not dwel in the middes of my houſe: he that ſpeaketh vniuſt thinges, hath not directed in the ſight of mine eies.
label: Psalms

text: In the morning did I kil al the ſinners of the earth: that I might deſtroy out of the citie of our Lord, al thoſe that worke iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: The prayer of the poore, when he shal be anxious, and shal make his petition before our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: LORD heare my prayer: and let my crie come to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Turne not away thy face from me: in what day ſoeuer I am in tribulation, incline thine eare to me. In what day ſoeuer I shal inuocate thee, heare me ſpeedely.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe my dayes haue vanished as ſmoke: and my bones are withered as a drie burnt firebrand.
label: Psalms

text: I am ſtriken as graſſe, and my hart is withered: becauſe I haue forgotten to eate my bread.
label: Psalms

text: For the voyce of my groning, my bone hath cleaued to my flesh.
label: Psalms

text: I am become like a pellicane of the wildernes: I am become as a nightcrow in the houſe.
label: Psalms

text: I haue watched, and am become as a ſparow ſolitarie in the houſetoppe.
label: Psalms

text: Al the day did mine enemies vpbrayde me: and they that praiſed me, ſware againſt me.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe I did eate ashes as bread, & mingled my drinke with weeping.
label: Psalms

text: At the face of thy wrath and indignation: becauſe lifting me vp thou haſt throwne me downe.
label: Psalms

text: My daies haue declined as a ſhadow: and I am withered as graſſe.
label: Psalms

text: But thou ô Lord endureſt for euer: and thy memorial in generation and generation.
label: Psalms

text: Thou ryſing vp shal haue mercie on Sion: becauſe it is time to haue mercie on it, becauſe the time cometh.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe the ſtones therof haue pleaſed thy ſeruantes: and they shal haue pittie on the earth therof.
label: Psalms

text: And the Gentiles shal feare thy name ô Lord, and al the kinges of the earth thy glorie.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord hath built Sion: and he shal be ſeene in his glorie.
label: Psalms

text: He hath had reſpect to the prayer of the humble: and he hath not deſpiſed their petition.
label: Psalms

text: Let theſe thinges be written vnto an other generation: and the people, that shal be created, shal praiſe our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath lookedforth from his high holie place: our Lord from heauen hath looked vpon the earth.
label: Psalms

text: That he might heare the gronings of the fettered: that he might looſe the children of them that are ſlayne:
label: Psalms

text: That they may shewforth the name of our Lord in Sion: and his praiſe in Ieruſalem.
label: Psalms

text: In the aſſembling of the people together in one, and kinges to ſerue our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: He anſwered him in the way of his ſtrength: Shew me the fewnes of my daies.
label: Psalms

text: Cal me not backe in the halfe of my daies: thy yeares are vnto generation and generation.
label: Psalms

text: In the beginning ô Lord thou didſt found the earth: and the heauens are the workes of thy hands.
label: Psalms

text: They shal perish, but thou art permanent: and they shal al waxe old as a garment. And as a veſture thou shalt change them, and they shal be changed:
label: Psalms

text: but thou art the ſelfe ſame, and thy yeares shal not faile.
label: Psalms

text: The children of thy ſeruantes shal inhabite: and their ſeede shal be directed for euer.
label: Psalms

text: To Dauid himſelf. MY ſoule bleſſe thou our Lord: and al thinges, that are within me, his holie name.
label: Psalms

text: My ſoule bleſſe thou our Lord: and forget not al his retributions.
label: Psalms

text: Who is propitious to al thine iniquities: who healeth al thine infirmities.
label: Psalms

text: Who redemeth thy life from deadly falling: who crowneth thee in mercie and commiſerations.
label: Psalms

text: Who replenisheth thy deſire in good thinges: thy youth shal be rewed as the eagles.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord doth mercies: and iudgement to al that ſuffer wrong.
label: Psalms

text: He made his waies knowne to Moyſes, his willes to the children of Iſrael.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is pitieful, and merciful: long ſuffering, and very merciful.
label: Psalms

text: He wil not be angrie alwayes: neither wil he threaten for euer.
label: Psalms

text: He hath not done to vs according to our ſinnes: neither according to our iniquities hath he rewarded vs.
label: Psalms

text: For according to the height of heauen from the earth: hath he ſtrengthned his mercie vpon them that feare him.
label: Psalms

text: As far as the Eaſt is diſtant from the Weſt: hath he made our iniquities far from vs.
label: Psalms

text: As a father hath compaſſion of his children, ſo hath our Lord compaſſion on them that feare him:
label: Psalms

text: becauſe he hath knowen our making. He remembred that we are duſt:
label: Psalms

text: man, his daies are as graſſe, as the floure of the filde ſo shal he florish.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe the ſpirit shal paſſe in him, and he shal not ſtand: and he shal know his place no more.
label: Psalms

text: But the mercie of our Lord from euerlaſting, and vnto euerlaſting vpon them that feare him. And his iuſtice is vpon the childrens children, to them that keepe his teſtament.
label: Psalms

text: And are mindful of his commandmentes, to doe them.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord hath prepared his ſeate in heauen: and his kindom shal haue dominion ouer al.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſe our Lord al ye his Angels: mightie in powre, doing his word, that feare the voice of his wordes.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſe our Lord al ye his hoaſtes: you his miniſters, that doe his wil.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſe ye our Lord al his workes: in euerie place of his dominion, my ſoule bleſſe thou our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: To Dauid him ſelf. MY ſoule bleſſe thou our Lord: ô Lord my God thou art magnified excedingly.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt put on confeſſion and beautie: being clothed with light as with a garment: Stretching out the heauen as a skinne:
label: Psalms

text: which couereſt the higher partes therof with waters. Which makeſt the cloude for thee to aſcend on: which walkeſt vpon the winges of windes.
label: Psalms

text: Which makeſt ſpirites thine Angels: and thy miniſters a burning fyre.
label: Psalms

text: Which haſt founded the earth vpon the ſtabilitie therof: it shal not be inclined for euer and euer
label: Psalms

text: The depth, as a garment, is his clothing: vpon the mountaines shal waters ſtand.
label: Psalms

text: At thy reprehention they shal flee: at the voice of thy thunder they shal feare.
label: Psalms

text: The mountaines aſcend: and the plaine fildes deſcend into the place, which thou haſt founded for them.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt ſet a bound, which they shal not paſſe ouer: neither shal they returne to couer the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Which ſendeſtforth fontaines in the valles: betwen the middeſt of mountaines shal waters paſſe.
label: Psalms

text: Al the beaſtes of the filde shal drinke: the wilde aſſes shal expect in their thirſt.
label: Psalms

text: Ouer them shal the foules of the ayre inhabite: out of the middes of rockes they shal geueforth voices.
label: Psalms

text: Watering the mountaines from his higher places: of the fruite of thy worke shal the earth be filled:
label: Psalms

text: Bringing forth graſſe for beaſtes, and herbe for the ſeruice of men. That thou mayſt bring forth bread out of the earth:
label: Psalms

text: and wine may make the hart of man ioyful: That he may make the face chereful with oile: and bread may confirme the hart of man.
label: Psalms

text: The trees of the filde shal be filled, and the ceders of Libanus, which he hath planted:
label: Psalms

text: there ſparowes shal make their neſt. The houſe of the hearne is the leader of them:
label: Psalms

text: the high mountaines for hartes: the rocke a refuge for the Irchins.
label: Psalms

text: Thou didſt appoint darkenes, and night was made: in it shal al the beaſtes of the wood paſſe.

text: The whelpes of lions roaring, to rauen, and to ſeeke of God meate for themſelues.
label: Psalms

text: The ſunne is riſen, and they are gathered together: and in their couches they shal be placed.
label: Psalms

text: Man shal goe forth to his worke: and to his working vntil euening.
label: Psalms

label: Psalms

label: Psalms

label: Psalms

label: Psalms

text: Let my ſpeach be acceptable to him: but I wil take delight in our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: He is the Lord our God: in al the earth are his iudgementes.

text: They made petition, and the quaile came: and he filled them with the bread of heauen.

text: He diuided the rocke, and waters flowed: riuers ranne in the drie ground.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he was mindful of his holie word, which he had vttered to Abraham his ſeruant.
label: Psalms

text: And he broughtforth his people in exultation, and his elect in ioy.
label: Psalms

text: And he gaue them the countries of the Nations: and they poſſeſſed the labours of peoples:
label: Psalms

text: That they might keepe his iuſtifications, and ſeeke after his lawe.
label: Psalms

text: Alleluia. CONFESSE ye to our Lord becauſe he is good: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Who shal ſpeake the powers of our Lord, shal make al his praiſes to be heard?
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed are they, that keepe iudgement, and doe iuſtice at al time.
label: Psalms

text: Remember vs ô Lord in the good pleaſure of thy people: viſite vs in thy ſaluation:
label: Psalms

text: To ſee in the goodnes of thyne elect, to reioyce in the ioy of thy nation: that thou maiſt be praiſed with thine inheritance.
label: Psalms

text: We haue ſinned with our fathers: we haue dealt vniuſtly, we haue done iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: Our fathers in Ægypt did not vnderſtand thy meruelous workes: they were not mindeful of the multitude of thy mercie. And they prouoked thee to wrath going vp vnto the ſea, the Read ſea.
label: Psalms

text: And he ſaued them for his name ſake; that he might make his power knowen.
label: Psalms

text: And he rebuked the Read ſea, and it was made drie: and he led them in the depths as in a deſert.
label: Psalms

text: And he ſaued them from the hand of them that hated them: and he redemed them out of the hand of the enemie.
label: Psalms

text: And water ouerwhelmed thoſe that afflicted them: there did not one of them remaine.
label: Psalms

text: And they beleued his wordes: and they ſang his praiſe.
label: Psalms

text: They had quickly donne, they forgot his workes: and they expected not his counſel.
label: Psalms

text: And they coueted concupiſcence in the deſert: and tempted God in the place without water.
label: Psalms

text: He gaue them their petition: and ſent ſaturitie into their ſoules.
label: Psalms

text: And they prouoked Moyſes in the campe: Aaron the holie of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: The earth was opened, and ſwalowed Dathan: and ouerwhelmed the congregation of Abiron.
label: Psalms

text: And a fire flamed vp in their ſinagogue: the flame burnt the ſinners.
label: Psalms

text: And they made a calfe in Horeb: and they adored the ſculptil.
label: Psalms

text: And they changed their glorie into the ſimilitude of a calfe that eateth graſſe.
label: Psalms

text: They forgat God, which ſaued them, which did great thinges in Ægypt,
label: Psalms

text: meruelous thinges in the land of Cham, terrible thinges in the Read ſea.
label: Psalms

text: And he ſayd to deſtroy them: if Moyſes his elect had not ſtood in the way before him: To turne away his wrath that he should not deſtroy them:
label: Psalms

text: and they eſtemed for naught the land that was to be deſired. They did not beleue his word,
label: Psalms

text: and they murmured in their tabernacles: they heard not the voice of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: And he lifted vp his hand ouer them: to ouerthrowe them in the deſert:
label: Psalms

text: And to caſt doune their ſeede among the Nations: and to diſperſe them in the countries.
label: Psalms

text: And they were profeſſed to Beelphegor: and they did eate the ſacrifices of the dead.
label: Psalms

text: And they prouoked him in their inuentions: and ruine was multiplied on them.
label: Psalms

text: And Phinees ſtood, and pacified: and the ſlaughter ceaſed.
label: Psalms

text: And it was reputed to him vnto iuſtice, in generation and generation euen for euer.
label: Psalms

text: And they prouoked him at the waters of contradiction: and Moyſes was vexed for them:
label: Psalms

text: becauſe they exaſperated his ſpirit. And he plainly affirmed in his lips:
label: Psalms

text: they deſtroyed not the nations, of which our Lord ſpake to them.
label: Psalms

text: And they were mingled among the nations, and learned their workes:
label: Psalms

text: and they ſerued their ſculptils: and it became a ſcandal to them.
label: Psalms

text: And they immolated their ſonnes, and their daughters to diuels.
label: Psalms

text: And they shed innocent bloud: the bloud of their ſonnes and of their daughters, which they ſacrificed to the ſculptils of Chanaan. And the land was infected with bloud,
label: Psalms

text: and was contaminated in their workes: and they did fornicat in their inuentions.
label: Psalms

text: And our Lord was wrath with furie vpon his people: and he abhorred his inheritance.
label: Psalms

text: And he deliuered them into the handes of the nations: and they that hated them, had the dominion of them.
label: Psalms

text: And their enimies afflicted them: and they were humbled vnder their handes:
label: Psalms

text: he did often deliuer them. But they exaſperated him in their counſel: and they were humbled in their iniquities.
label: Psalms

text: And he ſaw when they were afflicted: and he heard their prayer.
label: Psalms

text: And he was mindeful of his teſtament: and it repented him according to the multitude of his mercie.
label: Psalms

text: And he gaue them into mercies in the ſight of al, that had taken them.
label: Psalms

text: Saue vs ô Lord our God: and geather vs out of the Nations: That we may confeſſe to thy holie name: & may glorie in thy prayſe.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed be our Lord the God of Iſrael from euerlaſting vnto euerlaſting: and al the people shal ſay: Be it, be it.
label: Psalms

text: Alleluia. CONFESSE ye to our Lord becauſe he is good: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Let them ſay that are redemed of our Lord, whom he redemed out of the hand of the enemie: and out of the countries he gathered them:
label: Psalms

text: From the riſing of the ſunne, and the going downe: from the north, and the ſea.
label: Psalms

text: They wandered in the wildernes, in a place without water: the way of citie for habitation they found not.
label: Psalms

text: Hungrie, and thirſtie: their ſoule fainted in them.
label: Psalms

text: And they cried to our Lord when they were in tribulation: and he deliuered them out of their neceſſities.
label: Psalms

text: And he conducted them into the right way: to goe into a citie of habitation.
label: Psalms

text: Let the mercies of our Lord confeſſe to him: and his meruelous workes to the children of men.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath filled the emptie ſoule: and the hungrie ſoule he hath filled with good thinges.
label: Psalms

text: Them that ſate in darkenes, and in the shadow of death: bound in needines, and yron.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe they exaſperated the wordes of God: and they prouoked the counſel of the Higheſt.
label: Psalms

text: And their hart was humbled in labours: they were weakened, neither was there anie to helpe.
label: Psalms

text: And they cried to our Lord when they were in tribulation: and he deliuered them out of their neceſſities.
label: Psalms

text: And he brought them out of darkenes, and the shadow of death: and brake their bondes aſunder.
label: Psalms

text: Let the mercies of our Lord confeſſe to him: and his meruelous workes to the children of men.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath deſtroyed the gates of braſſe: and the barres of yron he hath broken.
label: Psalms

text: He hath receiued them out of the way of their iniquitie: for they were humbled for their iniuſtices.
label: Psalms

text: Their ſoule did abhorre al meate: & they approched euen to the gates of death.
label: Psalms

text: And they cried to our Lord when they were in tribulation: and he deliuered them out of their neceſſities.
label: Psalms

text: He ſent his word, and healed them: and deliuered them out of their deſtructions.
label: Psalms

text: Let the mercies of our Lord confeſſe to him: and his meruelous workes to the children of men.
label: Psalms

text: And let them ſacrifice the ſacrifice of praiſe: and shew forth his workes in exulation.
label: Psalms

text: They that goe downe into the ſea in shippes, making trafike in the great waters.
label: Psalms

text: They haue ſene the workes of our Lord, and his meruelous thinges in the depth.
label: Psalms

text: He ſayd, and the blaſt of the ſtorme ſtood: and the waues therof were exalted.
label: Psalms

text: They aſcend euen to the heauens, and they deſcend euen to the depthes: their ſoule pyned away in euils.
label: Psalms

text: They were trubled, and were moued as a drunken man: and al their wiſedom was deuoured.
label: Psalms

text: And they cried to our Lord when they were in tribulation, and he brought them out of their neceſſities.
label: Psalms

text: And he turned his ſtorme into calme: and the waues therof were quiet.
label: Psalms

text: And they reioyced becauſe they were quiet: and he conducted them into the hauen of their wil.
label: Psalms

text: Let the mercies of our Lord confeſſe to him: and his meruelous workes to the children of men.
label: Psalms

text: And let them exalt him in the church of the people: and the chayre of the ancientes let them praiſe him.
label: Psalms

text: He turned the riuers into a deſert: and the iſſues of waters into drineſſe.
label: Psalms

text: The fruiteful land into a ſalt ground, for the malice of them that inhabite it.
label: Psalms

text: He turned the deſert into pooles of waters: and the land without water into iſſues of waters.
label: Psalms

text: And he placed the hungrie there, and they built a citie of habitation.
label: Psalms

text: And they ſowed fildes, and planted vineyardes: and they made fruicte of natiuitie.
label: Psalms

text: And he bleſſed them, and they were multiplied excedingly: and their beaſtes he leſſened not.
label: Psalms

text: And they were made fewe: and were vexed by the tribulation of euiles, and with ſorow.
label: Psalms

text: Contempt was powred out vpon princes: and he made them wander where was no way, and not in the way.
label: Psalms

text: And he did helpe the poore out of pouertie: and made families as sheepe.
label: Psalms

text: The iuſt shal ſee, and shal reioyce: & al iniquitie shal ſtoppe her mouth.
label: Psalms

text: Who is wiſe and wil keepe theſe thinges? and wil vnderſtand the mercies of our Lord?
label: Psalms

text: A Canticle of Pſalme, to Dauid himſelfe.
label: Psalms

text: MY HART is readie ô God, my hart is readie: I wil chaunte, and wil ſing in my glorie.
label: Psalms

text: Ariſe my glorie, ariſe pſalter, and harpe: I wil ariſe early.
label: Psalms

text: I wil confeſſe to thee in peoples ô Lord: and I wil ſing to thee in the Nations.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thy mercie is great aboue the heauens: and thy truth euen to the cloudes.
label: Psalms

text: Be exalted aboue the heauens ô God, and thy glorie ouer al the earth:
label: Psalms

text: that thy beloued may be deliuered. Saue with thy righthand; and heare me:
label: Psalms

text: God ſpake in his holie: I wil reioyce, and wil diuide Sichem; and I wil meſure the vale of tabernacles.
label: Psalms

text: Galaad is mine, and Manaſſes is mine: and Ephraim the protection of my head.
label: Psalms

text: Iuda is my king: Moab the potte of my hope. Vpon Idumea I wil extend my shoe: the ſtrangers are made my freindes.
label: Psalms

text: Who wil conduct me into a fenſed citie? who wil conduct me into Idumea?
label: Psalms

text: Wilt not thou ô God, which haſt repelled vs, and wilt not thou goeforth ô God in our hoaſtes?
label: Psalms

text: Geue vs helpe out of tribulation: becauſe mans ſaluation is vayne.
label: Psalms

text: In God we shal doe ſtrength: and he wil bring our enemies to nothing.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, a Pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: O God conceale not my prayſe: becauſe the mouth of the ſinner, and the mouth of the deceitful man is open vpon me.
label: Psalms

text: They haue ſpoken againſt me with deceitful tongue, and with wordes of hatred they haue compaſſed me: and they haue impugned me without cauſe.
label: Psalms

text: For that they should loue me, they backbited me: but I prayed.
label: Psalms

text: And they ſet againſt me euil thinges for good: and hatred for my loue.
label: Psalms

text: Appoint a ſinner ouer him: and let the diuel ſtand on his righthand.
label: Psalms

text: When he is iudged, let him comeforth condemned: and let his prayer be turned into ſinne.
label: Psalms

text: Let his dayes be made fewe: and let an other take his bishopricke.
label: Psalms

text: Let his children be made orphans: and his wife a widow.
label: Psalms

text: Let his children be tranſported wandering, and let them begge: and let them be caſt out of their habitations.
label: Psalms

text: Let the vſurer ſearch al his ſubſtance: and let ſtrangers ſpoile his labours.
label: Psalms

text: Let there be none to helpe him: neither let there be anie to haue pittie on his pupilles.
label: Psalms

text: Let his children come to deſtruction: in one generation let his name be cleane put out.
label: Psalms

text: Let the iniquitie of his fathers returne to memorie in the ſight of our Lord: and let not the ſinne of his mother be blotted out.
label: Psalms

text: Let them be before our Lord alwayes, and let the memorie of them perish out of the earth:
label: Psalms

text: For that he remembred not to doe mercie.
label: Psalms

text: And he perſecuted the poore, and needie man, and the compunct in hart to kil him.
label: Psalms

text: And he loued curſing, and it shal come to him: and he would not bleſſing, and it shal be far from him. And he put on curſing as a garment, and it entred as water into his inner partes, and as oile in his bones.
label: Psalms

text: Be it to him as a garment, wherwith he is couered: and as a girdle, wherwith he is alwayes girded.
label: Psalms

text: This is the worke of them, that detract from me before our Lord: and that ſpeake euils againſt my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: And thou Lord, Lord, doe with me for thy names ſake: becauſe thy mercie is ſwete.
label: Psalms

text: Deliuer me becauſe I am needie, and poore: and my hart is trubled within me.
label: Psalms

text: As a shadow when it declineth, am I taken away: and I am shaken as locuſtes.
label: Psalms

text: My knees are weakened with faſting: and my flesh is changed by reaſon of oile.
label: Psalms

text: And I am made a reproch to them: they ſaw me, and wagged their heades.
label: Psalms

text: Helpe me ô Lord my God: ſaue me according to thy mercie.
label: Psalms

text: And let them know that this is thy hand: and thou ô Lord haſt done it.
label: Psalms

text: They wil curſe, and thou shalt bleſſe: let them that riſe vp againſt me, be confounded: but thy ſeruant shal reioyce.
label: Psalms

text: Let them that detract from me, be clothed with shame: and let them be couered with their confuſion, as with a duble patched cloke.
label: Psalms

text: I wil confeſſe to our Lord excedingly with my mouth: and in the middes of manie I wil prayſe him:
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath ſtood on the righthand of the poore, that he might ſaue my ſoule from the perſecutors.
label: Psalms

text: A pſalme of Dauid. OVR Lord ſayd to my Lord: Sitte on my right hand: til I make thine enemies, thy footeſtoole of thy feete.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord wil ſendforth the rod of thy ſtrength from Sion: rule thou in the middes of thine enemies.
label: Psalms

text: With thee the beginning in the day of thy ſtrength, in the brightnes of holie thinges: from the wombe before the day ſtarre I begat thee.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord ſware, and it shal not repent him: Thou art a Prieſt for euer according to the order of Melchiſedech.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord on thy righthand, hath broken kinges in the day of his wrath.
label: Psalms

text: He shal iudge in nations, he shal fil ruines, he shal crush the heads in the land of manie.
label: Psalms

text: Of the torrent in the way he shal drinke: therfore shal he exalt the head.
label: Psalms

text: Alleluia. I wil confeſſe to thee ô Lord with al my hart: in the counſel of the iuſt, and the congregation.
label: Psalms

text: The workes of our Lord are great: exquiſite according to al his willes.
label: Psalms

text: Confeſſion and magnificence his worke: and his iuſtice continueth for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: He hath made a memorie of his meruelous workes; merciful and pittiful Lord:
label: Psalms

text: he hath geuen meate to them that feare him. He wil be mindful for euer of his teſtament:
label: Psalms

text: the force of his workes he wil shew forth to his people:
label: Psalms

text: To geue them the inheritance of the gentiles: the workes of his handes truth, and iudgement.
label: Psalms

text: Al his commandmentes are faithful: confirmed for euer and euer, made in truth and equitie.
label: Psalms

text: He ſent redemption to his people: he commanded his teſtament for euer. Holie, and terrible is his name:
label: Psalms

text: the feare of our Lord is the beginning of wiſedom. Vnderſtanding is good to al that doe it: his prayſe remaineth for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: Alleluia, Of the returne of Aggeus, and Zacharie. BLESSED is the man that feareth our Lord: he shal haue great delight in his commandmentes.
label: Psalms

text: His ſeede shal be mightie in the earth: the generation of the righteous shal be bleſſed,
label: Psalms

text: Glorie, and riches in his houſe: and his iuſtice abideth for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: Light is riſen vp in darkenes to the righteous: he is merciful, and pitiful, and iuſt.
label: Psalms

text: Acceptable is the man, that is merciful and lendeth, that shal diſpoſe his wordes in iudgement:
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he shal not be moued for euer.
label: Psalms

text: The iuſt shal be in eternal memorie: he shal not feare at the hearing of euil.
label: Psalms

text: His hart is readie to hope in our Lord, his hart is confirmed:
label: Psalms

text: he shal not be moued til he looke ouer his enemies.
label: Psalms

text: He diſtributed, he gaue to the poore: his iuſtice remaineth for euer and euer his horne shal be exalted in glorie.
label: Psalms

text: The ſinner shal ſee, and wil be angrie, he shal gnash his teeth and pine away: the deſire of ſinners shal perish.
label: Psalms

text: Alleluia. PRAYSE our Lord ye children: praiſe ye the name of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Be the name of our Lord bleſſed, from henceforth now and for euer.
label: Psalms

text: From the riſing of the ſunne vnto the going downe, the name of our Lord is laudable.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is high aboue al nations, and his glorie aboue the heauens.
label: Psalms

text: Who is as the Lord our God, that dwelleth on high,
label: Psalms

text: and beholdeth the low thinges in heauen and in earth?
label: Psalms

text: Raiſing vp the needie from the earth, and lifting vp the poore out of the dung:
label: Psalms

text: To place him with princes, with the princes of his people.
label: Psalms

text: Who maketh the barren woman to dwel in a houſe, a ioyful mother of children.
label: Psalms

text: Allelu ia. IN the comming forth of Iſrael out of Ægypt, of the houſe of Iacob from the barbarous people.
label: Psalms

text: Iewrie was made his ſanctification, Iſrael his dominion.
label: Psalms

text: The ſea ſaw, and fled: Iordan was turned backeward.
label: Psalms

text: The mountaines leaped as rammes: and the litle hilles as the lambes of sheepe.
label: Psalms

text: What ayleth thee ô ſea that thou didſt flee: and thou ô Iordan, that thou waſt turned backeward?
label: Psalms

text: Ye mountaines leaped as rammes, and ye litle hilles as the lambes of shepe.
label: Psalms

text: At the face of our Lord was the earth moued, at the face of the God of Iacob.
label: Psalms

text: Who turned the rocke into pooles of waters, and ſtonie hil into fountaines of waters.
label: Psalms

text: NOT TO VS O LORD, NOT TO VS: but to thy name geue the glorie.
label: Psalms

text: For thy mercie, and thy truth: leſt at any time the Gentiles ſay: Where is their God?
label: Psalms

text: But our God is in heauen: he hath done al thinges whatſoeuer he would.
label: Psalms

text: The idols of the gentiles are ſiluer, and gold, the workes of mens handes.
label: Psalms

text: They haue mouth, and shal not ſpeake: they haue eies, and shal not ſee.
label: Psalms

text: They haue eares, and shal not heare: they haue noſthrels and shal not ſmel.
label: Psalms

text: They haue handes, and shal not handle: they haue feete, and shal not walke: they shal not crie in their throte.
label: Psalms

text: Let them that make them become like to them: and al that haue confidence in them.
label: Psalms

text: The houſe of Iſrael hath hoped in our Lord: he is their helper and their protector.
label: Psalms

text: The houſe of Aaron hath hoped in our Lord: he is their helper and their protector.
label: Psalms

text: They that feare our Lord, haue hoped in our Lord: he is their helper and their protector.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord hath beene mindful of vs: and hath bleſſed vs: He hath bleſſed the houſe of Iſrael: he hath bleſſed the houſe of Aaron.
label: Psalms

text: He hath bleſſed al, that feare our Lord, the litle with the great.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord adde vpon you: vpon you, & vpon your children.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed be you of our Lord, which made heauen, and earth.
label: Psalms

text: The heauen of heauen is to our Lord: but the earth he hath geuen to the children of men.
label: Psalms

text: The dead shal not prayſe thee ô Lord: nor al they, that goe downe hel.
label: Psalms

text: But we that liue, doe bleſſe our Lord, from this time, and for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Allelu ia. I haue loued, becauſe our Lord wil heare the voice of my prayer.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath inclined his eare to me: and in my daies I wil inuocate.
label: Psalms

text: The ſorowes of death haue compaſſed me: and the perils of hel haue found me. I haue found tribulation and ſorow:
label: Psalms

text: and I inuocated the name of our Lord. O Lord deliuer my ſoule:
label: Psalms

text: our Lord is merciful, and iuſt, and our God doth mercie.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord kepeth litle ones: I was humbled, and he hath deliuered me.
label: Psalms

text: Turne ô my ſoule into thy reſt: becauſe our Lord hath done good to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath deliuered my ſoule from death: mine eies from teares, my feete from ſliding.
label: Psalms

text: I wil pleaſe our Lord in the countrie of the liuing.
label: Psalms

text: Alleluia. I beleued, for which cauſe I ſpake: but I was humbled excedingly.
label: Psalms

text: I ſaid in mine exceſſe: Euerie man is a lyer.
label: Psalms

text: What shal I render to our Lord, for al thinges that he hath rendred to me?
label: Psalms

text: I wil take the chalice of ſaluation: and I wil inuocat the name of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: I wil render my vowes to our Lord before al his people:
label: Psalms

text: precious in the ſight of our Lord is the death of his Sainctes.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord becauſe I am thy ſeruant: I am thy ſeruant, and the ſonne of thy handmaide. Thou haſt broken my bondes:
label: Psalms

text: I wil ſacrifice to thee the hoaſt of praiſe, and I wil inuocate the name of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: I wil render my vowes to our Lord in the ſight of al his people:
label: Psalms

text: in the courtes of the houſe of our Lord, in the middes of thee ô Ieruſalem.
label: Psalms

text: Allelu ia. PRAYSE our Lord al ye Gentiles: prayſe him al ye peoples.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe his mercie is confirmed vpon vs: and his truth remaineth for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Allelu ia. CONFESSE ye to our Lord becauſe he is good: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Let Iſrael now ſay that he is good: that his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Let the houſe of Aaron now ſay: that his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Let them now ſay which feare our Lord: that his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: From tribulation I inuocated our Lord: and our Lord heard me in largenes.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is my helper: I wil not feare what man can doe to me.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is my helper: and I wil looke ouer mine enemies.
label: Psalms

text: It is good to hope in our Lord, rather then to hope in man.
label: Psalms

text: It is good to hope in our Lord, rather then to hope in princes.
label: Psalms

text: Al nations haue compaſſed me: and in the name of our Lord am I reuenged on them.
label: Psalms

text: Compaſſing they haue compaſſed me: and in the name of our Lord I was reuenged on them.
label: Psalms

text: They compaſſed me as bees, and were inflamed as fyre in thornes: and in the name of our Lord I was reuenged on them.
label: Psalms

text: Being thruſt I was ouerturned to fal: and our Lord receiued me.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is my ſtrength, and my prayſe: and he is made my ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: The voice of exultation, and of ſaluation in the tabernacles of the iuſt.
label: Psalms

text: The right hand of our Lord hath wrought ſtrength: the right hand of our Lord hath exalted me, the right hand of our Lord hath wrought ſtrength.
label: Psalms

text: I shal not die, but shal liue: and I wil tel the workes of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord chaſtiſing hath chaſtiſed me: and to death he hath not deliuered me.
label: Psalms

text: Open ye the gates of iuſtice to me, being entred into them I wil confeſſe to our Lord:
label: Psalms

text: this is the gate of our Lord, the iuſt shal enter into it.
label: Psalms

text: I wil confeſſe to thee becauſe thou haſt heard me: and art become my ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: The ſtone, which the builders reiected: the ſame is made into the head of the corner.
label: Psalms

text: This was done by our Lord: and it is meruelous in our eies.
label: Psalms

text: This is the day, which our Lord made: let vs reioice, and be glad therein.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord ſaue me, ô Lord geue good ſucceſſe: Bleſſed be he that cometh in the name of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: We haue bleſſed you of the houſe of our Lord:
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is God, and he hath geuen light to vs. Appoint a ſolemne day with thicke bowes, euen to the horne of the altar.
label: Psalms

text: Thou art my God, and I wil confeſſe to thee: thou art my God, and I wil exalt thee. I wil confeſſe to thee becauſe thou haſt heard me: and art become my ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: Confeſſe ye to our Lord becauſe he is good: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Allelu ia. BLESSED are the immaculate in the vvay: which walke in the law of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed are they, that ſearch his teſtimonies: that ſeeke after him with al their hart.
label: Psalms

text: For they that worke iniquitie, haue not walked in his waies.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt very much commanded thy commandmentes to be kept.
label: Psalms

text: Would God my waies might be directed, to keepe thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: Then shal I not be confounded, when I shal looke throughly in al thy commandmentes.
label: Psalms

text: I wil confeſſe to thee in direction of hart: in that I haue lerned the iudgements of thy iuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: I wil keepe thy iuſtifications: forſake me not wholy.
label: Psalms

text: Wherein doth a yongman correct his way? in keeping thy wordes.
label: Psalms

text: With my whole hart I haue ſought after thee: repel me not from thy commandmentes.
label: Psalms

text: In my hart I haue hid thy wordes: that I may not ſinne to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed art thou o Lord: teach me thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: In my lippes, I haue pronounced al the iudgementes of thy mouth.
label: Psalms

text: I am delighted in the way of thy teſtimonies, as in al riches.
label: Psalms

text: I wil be exerciſed in thy commandmentes: and I wil conſider thy waies.
label: Psalms

text: I wil meditate in thy iuſtifications: I wil not forget thy wordes.
label: Psalms

text: Render to thy ſeruant, quicken me: and I shal keepe thy wordes.
label: Psalms

text: Reuele mine eies: and I shal conſider the meruelous thinges of thy law.
label: Psalms

text: I am a ſeiourner in the land, hide not thy commandmentes from me.
label: Psalms

text: My ſoule hath coueted to deſire thy iuſtifications, at al time.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt rebuked the prowde: curſed are they that decline from thy commandmentes.
label: Psalms

text: Take from me reproch, and contempt: becauſe I haue ſought after thy teſtimonies.
label: Psalms

text: For princes ſate, and they ſpake againſt me: but thy ſeruant was exerciſed in thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: For both thy teſtimonies are my meditation: and thy iuſtifications my counſel.
label: Psalms

text: My ſoule hath cleaued to the pauement: quicken me according to thy word.
label: Psalms

text: I haue vttered my wayes, and thou haſt heard me: teach me thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: Inſtruct me the way of thy iuſtifications: and I shal be exerciſed in thy meruelous workes.
label: Psalms

text: My ſoule hath ſlumbered for tediouſnes: confirme me in thy wordes.
label: Psalms

text: Remoue from me the way of iniquitie: and according to thy law, haue mercie on me.
label: Psalms

text: I haue choſen the way of truth: I haue not forgotten thy iudgements.
label: Psalms

text: I haue cleaued to thy teſtimonies o Lord: do not confound me.
label: Psalms

text: I ranne the way of thy commandments: when thou didſt dilate my hart.
label: Psalms

text: Set me a law o Lord the way of thy iuſtifications: and I wil ſeeke after it alwayes.
label: Psalms

text: Geue me vnderſtanding, and I wil ſearch thy law: and I wil keepe it with my whole hart.
label: Psalms

text: Conduct me into the path of thy commandments: becauſe I would it.
label: Psalms

text: Incline my hart into thy teſtimonies: and not into auarice.
label: Psalms

text: Turne away mine eies that they ſee not vanitie: in thy way quicken me.
label: Psalms

text: Eſtablish thy word to thy ſeruant, in thy feare.
label: Psalms

text: Take away my reproch, which I haue feared: becauſe thy iudgements are pleaſant.
label: Psalms

text: Behold I haue coueted thy commandments: in thine equitie quicken me.
label: Psalms

text: And let thy mercie come vpon me o Lord: thy ſaluation according to thy word.
label: Psalms

text: And I shal anſwer a word to them that vpbrayde me: becauſe I haue hoped in thy wordes.
label: Psalms

text: And take not away out of my mouth the word of truth vtterly: becauſe I haue much hoped in thy iudgementes.
label: Psalms

text: And I wil keepe thy law alwayes: for euer, and for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: And I walked in largeneſſe: becauſe I haue ſought after thy commandments.
label: Psalms

text: And I ſpake of thy teſtimonies in the ſight of kinges: and was not confounded.
label: Psalms

text: And I meditated in thy commandments, which I loued.
label: Psalms

text: And I haue lifted vp my handes to thy commandments, which I loued: and I was exerciſed in thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: Be mindeful of thy word to thy ſeruant, wherein thou haſt geuen me hope.
label: Psalms

text: This hath comforted me in my humiliation: becauſe thy word hath quickened me.
label: Psalms

text: The prowd did vniuſtly exceedingly: but I declined not from thy law.
label: Psalms

text: I haue bene mindful of thy iudgements from euerlaſting o Lord: and was comforted.
label: Psalms

text: Faynting poſſeſſed me, becauſe of ſinners forſaking thy law.
label: Psalms

text: Thy iuſtifications were ſongue by me, in the place of my peregrination.
label: Psalms

text: I haue bene mindful in the night of thy name o Lord: and haue kept thy law.
label: Psalms

text: This was done to me: becauſe I ſought after thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: My portion o Lord, I ſayd to keepe thy law.
label: Psalms

text: I beſought thy face, with al my hart: haue mercie on me according to thy word.
label: Psalms

text: I thought vpon my wayes: and conuerted my feete vnto thy teſtimonies.
label: Psalms

text: I am prepared, and am not trubled: to keepe thy commandments.
label: Psalms

text: The cordes of ſinners haue wrapped me round about: and I haue not forgotten thy law.
label: Psalms

text: At midnight I roſe to confeſſe to thee; for the iudgements of thy iuſtification.
label: Psalms

text: I am partaker of al that feare thee: and that keepe thy commandments.
label: Psalms

text: The earth o Lord is ful of thy mercie: teach me thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt done bountie with thy ſeruant o Lord: according to thy word.
label: Psalms

text: Teach me goodneſſe, and diſcipline, and knowledge: becauſe I haue beleued thy commandments.
label: Psalms

text: Before I was humbled I offended: therfore haue I kept thy word.
label: Psalms

text: Thou art good: and in thy goodneſſe teach me thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: The iniquitie of the prowd is multiplied vpon me: but I in al my hart wil ſearch thy commandments.
label: Psalms

text: Their hart is crudded together as milke: but I haue meditated thy law.
label: Psalms

text: It is good for me that thou haſt humbled me: that I may learne thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: The law of thy mouth is good vnto me, aboue thouſands of gold, and ſiluer.
label: Psalms

text: Thy handes haue made me, and formed me: geue me vnderſtanding, and I wil learne thy commandmentes.
label: Psalms

text: They that feare thee shal ſee me, & shal reioyce: becauſe I haue much hoped in thy wordes.
label: Psalms

text: I know o Lord that thy iudgements are equitie: and in thy truth thou haſt humbled me.
label: Psalms

text: Let thy mercie be done to comfort me, according to thy word vnto thy ſeruant.
label: Psalms

text: Let thy commiſerations come to me, and I shal liue: becauſe thy law is my meditation.
label: Psalms

text: Let the prowde be confounded, becauſe they haue done vniuſtly toward me: but I wil be exerciſed in thy commandments.
label: Psalms

text: Let them be conuerted to me that feare thee: and that know thy teſtimonies.
label: Psalms

text: Let my hart be made immaculate in thy iuſtifications, that I be not confounded.
label: Psalms

text: My ſoule hath fainted for thy ſaluation: and I haue much hoped in thy word.
label: Psalms

text: Myne eies haue fayled for thy word, ſaying: When wilt thou comfort me?
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe I am made as a bottel in the hoare froſt: I haue not forgotten thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: How manie are the daies of thy ſeruant: when wilt thou doe iudgement on them that perſecute me?
label: Psalms

text: The vniuſt haue told me fables: but not as thy law.
label: Psalms

text: Al thy commandmentes are truth: they haue vniuſtly perſecuted me, helpe me.
label: Psalms

text: They haue welnere made an end of me in the earth: but I haue not forſaken thy commandments.
label: Psalms

text: According to thy mercie quicken me: and I shal keepe the teſtimonies of thy mouth.
label: Psalms

text: For euer Lord thy word is permanent in heauen.
label: Psalms

text: Thy truth in generation and generation: thou haſt founded the earth, and it is permanent.
label: Psalms

text: By thy ordinance the day contineweth: becauſe al thinges ſerue thee.
label: Psalms

text: But that thy law is my meditation: I had then perhaps perished in my humiliation.
label: Psalms

text: I wil not forget thy iuſtifications for euer: becauſe in them thou haſt quickned me.
label: Psalms

text: I am thine, ſaue me: becauſe I haue ſought out thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: Sinners haue expected me to deſtroy me: I vnderſtood thy teſtimonies.
label: Psalms

text: Of al conſummation I haue ſene the end: thy commandment is exceding large.
label: Psalms

text: How haue I loued thy law ô Lord! al the day it is my meditation.
label: Psalms

text: Aboue mine enemies thou haſt made me wiſe by thy commaundment: becauſe it is to me for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Aboue al that taught me haue I vnderſtood: becauſe thy teſtimonies are my meditation.
label: Psalms

text: Aboue ancientes haue I vnderſtood: becauſe I haue ſought thy commandments.
label: Psalms

text: I haue ſtaied my feete from al euil way: that I may keepe thy wordes.
label: Psalms

text: I haue not declined from thy iudgements: becauſe thou haſt ſet me a law.
label: Psalms

text: How ſweete are thy wordes to my iawes, more then honie to my mouth!
label: Psalms

text: By thy commandments I haue vnderſtood: therfore haue I hated al the way of iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: Thy word is a lampe to my feete, and a light to my pathes.
label: Psalms

text: I ſware, and haue determined to keepe the iudgements of thy iuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: I am humbled exceedingly ô Lord: quicken me according to thy word.
label: Psalms

text: The voluntaries of my mouth make acceptable ô Lord: and teach me thy iudgementes.
label: Psalms

text: My ſoule is in my handes alwaies: and I haue not forgotten thy law.
label: Psalms

text: Sinners laid a ſnare for me: and I haue not erred from thy commandments.
label: Psalms

text: For inheritance I haue purchaſed thy teſtimonies for euer: becauſe they are the ioy of my hart.
label: Psalms

text: I haue inclined my hart to doe thy iuſtifications for euer, for reward.
label: Psalms

text: I haue hated the vniuſt: and I haue loued thy law.
label: Psalms

text: Thou art my helper, and protectour: and vpon thy word I haue much hoped.
label: Psalms

text: Depart from me ye malignant: and I wil ſearch the commandmentes of my God.
label: Psalms

text: Recciue me according to thy word, and I shal liue: and confound me not of myn expectation.
label: Psalms

text: Helpe me, and I shal be ſaued: and I wil meditate in thy iuſtifications alwayes.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt deſpiſed al that reuolt from thy iudgementes: becauſe their cogitation is vniuſt.
label: Psalms

text: Al the ſinners of the earth I haue reputed preuaricatours: therfore haue I loued thy teſtimonies.
label: Psalms

text: Pearſe my flesh with thy feare: for I am afrayd of thy iudgementes.
label: Psalms

text: I haue done iudgement and iuſtice: deliuer me not to them that calumniate me.
label: Psalms

text: Recciue thy ſeruant vnto good: let not the prowde calumniate me.
label: Psalms

text: Mine eies haue fayled. after thy ſaluation: and for the word of thy iuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: Doe with thy ſeruant according to thy mercie: and teache me thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: I am thy ſeruant: geue me vnderſtanding, that I may know thy teſtimonies.
label: Psalms

text: It is time to doe ô Lord: they haue diſſipated thy law.
label: Psalms

text: Therfore haue I loued thy commandementes, aboue gold and topazius:
label: Psalms

text: Therfore was I directed to al thy commandementes: al wicked way I haue hated.
label: Psalms

text: Thy teſtimonies are meruelous: therfore hath my ſoule ſearched them.
label: Psalms

text: The declaration of thy wordes doth illuminate: and geueth vnderſtanding to litle ones.
label: Psalms

text: I opened my mouth, and drew breath: becauſe I deſired thy commandments.
label: Psalms

text: Looke vpon me, and haue mercie on me, according to the iudgement of them that loue thy name.
label: Psalms

text: Direct my ſteppes according to thy word: and let not anie iniuſtice haue domination ouer me.
label: Psalms

text: Redeme me from the calumnies of men: that I may kepe thy commondmentes.
label: Psalms

text: Illuminate thy face vpon thy ſeruant: and teach me thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: Mine eies haue gushed forth iſſues of waters: becauſe they haue not kept thy law.
label: Psalms

text: Thou art iuſt ô Lord: and thy iudgement is right.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt commanded iuſtice thy teſtimonies: and thy veritie excedingly.
label: Psalms

text: My Zele hath made me to pine away: becauſe mine enimies haue forgotten thy wordes.
label: Psalms

text: Thy word is fired excedingly: and thy ſeruant hath loued it.
label: Psalms

text: I am a yongman, and contemned: I haue not forgotten thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: Thy iuſtice, is iuſtice for euer: and thy law is veritie.
label: Psalms

text: Tribulation, and diſtreſſe haue found me: thy commandments are my meditation.
label: Psalms

text: Thy teſtimonies are equitie for euer geue me vnderſtanding, and I shal liue.
label: Psalms

text: I haue cried in my whole hart, heare me ô Lord: I wil ſeeke after thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: I haue cried to thee, ſaue me: that I may keepe thy commandmentes.
label: Psalms

text: I haue preuented in maturitie, and haue cried: becauſe I hoped much in thy wordes.
label: Psalms

text: Mine eies haue preuented early vnto thee: that I might meditate thy wordes.
label: Psalms

text: Heare my voice according to thy mercie ô Lord: and according to thy iudgement quicken me.
label: Psalms

text: They that perſecute me haue approched to iniquitie: but from thy law they are made far of.
label: Psalms

text: Thou art nigh ô Lord: and al thy wayes are truth.
label: Psalms

text: From the beginning I knewe of thy teſtimonies: that thou haſt founded them for euer.
label: Psalms

text: See my humiliation, and deliuer me: becauſe I haue not forgotten thy law.
label: Psalms

text: Iudge my iudgement, & redeme me: for thy word quicken thou me.
label: Psalms

text: Saluation is far from ſinners: becauſe they haue not ſought after thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: Thy mercies are manie ô Lord: according to thy iudgement quicken me.
label: Psalms

text: There are manie that perſecute me, and afflict me: I haue not declined from thy teſtimonies.
label: Psalms

text: I ſaw the preuaricatours, and I pyned away: becauſe they kept not thy wordes.
label: Psalms

text: See that I haue loued thy commandmentes ô Lord: in thy mercie quicken me.
label: Psalms

text: The beginning of thy wordes is truth: al the iudgementes of thy iuſtice are for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Princes haue perſecuted me without cauſe: and my hart hath bene afrayd of thy wordes.
label: Psalms

text: I wil reioyce at thy wordes: as he that findeth manie ſpoyles.
label: Psalms

text: I haue hated iniquitie, and abhorred it: but thy law I haue loued.
label: Psalms

text: Seuentimes in the day. I haue ſayd praiſe to thee, for the iudgements of thy iuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: There is much peace to them that loue thy law: & there is no ſcandal to them.
label: Psalms

text: I expected thy ſaluation ô Lord: and haue loued thy commandmentes.
label: Psalms

text: My ſoule hath kept thy teſtimonies: and hath loued them excedindgly.
label: Psalms

text: I haue kept thy commandmentes, and thy teſtimonies: becauſe al my waies are in thy ſight.
label: Psalms

text: Let my petition approch in thy ſight ô Lord: according to thy word giue me vnderſtanding.
label: Psalms

text: Let my requeſt enter in thy ſight: according to thy word deliuer me.
label: Psalms

text: My lippes shal vtter an hymne, when thou shalt teach me thy iuſtifications.
label: Psalms

text: My tongue shal pronounce thy word: becauſe al thy commandmentes are equitie.
label: Psalms

text: Let thy hand be to ſaue me: becauſe I haue choſen thy commandmentes.
label: Psalms

text: I haue coueted thy ſaluation ô Lord: and thy law is my meditation.
label: Psalms

text: My ſoule shal liue, and shal prayſe thee: and thy iudgementes shal helpe me.
label: Psalms

text: I haue ſtrayed, as a sheepe, that is loſt: ſeeke thy ſeruant, becauſe I haue not forgotten thy commandmentes.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle. WHEN I was in tribulation I cried to our Lord: and he heard me.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord deliuer my ſoule from vniuſt lippes, and from a deceiptful tongue.
label: Psalms

text: What may be geuen thee, or what may be added vnto thee, to a deceiptful tongue?
label: Psalms

text: The sharpe arrowes of the mightie, with coales of deſolation.
label: Psalms

text: Woe is to me, that my ſeiourning is prolonged: I haue dwelte with the inhabitantes of Cedar:
label: Psalms

text: My ſoule hath bene long a ſeiourner.
label: Psalms

text: With them, that hated peace, I was peaceable: when I ſpake to them, they impugned me without cauſe.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle. I HAVE lifted vp mine eies vnto the mountaines, from whence helpe shal come to me.
label: Psalms

text: My helpe is from our Lord, who made heauen and earth.
label: Psalms

text: Geue he not thy foote to be moued: neither doe he ſlumber that keepeth thee.
label: Psalms

text: Loe he shal not ſlumber nor ſleepe, that kepeth Iſrael.
label: Psalms

text: Our lord kepeth thee, our Lord is thy protection, vpon thy right hand.
label: Psalms

text: By day the ſunne shal not burne thee: nor the moone by night.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord doth kepe thee from al euil: our Lord kepe thy ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord kepe thy coming in, and thy going out: from hence forth now, and for euer.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle. I REIOYCED in theſe thinges, which were ſayd to me: We shal goe into the houſe of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Our feete were ſtanding, in thy courtes ô Ieruſalem
label: Psalms

text: Ieruſalem, which is built as a citie: whoſe participation is together in it ſelf.
label: Psalms

text: For thither did the tribes aſcend, the tribes of our Lord: the teſtimonie of Iſrael to confeſſe vnto the name of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe ſeates ſate there in iudgement, ſeates vpon the houſe of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: Aske ye the thinges that are for the peace of Ieruſalem: and abundance to them that loue thee.
label: Psalms

text: Peace be made in thy ſtrength: and abundance in thy towers.
label: Psalms

text: For my bretheren, and my neigbours ſakes, I ſpake peace of thee:
label: Psalms

text: For the houſe of our Lord God, I haue ſought good thinges to thee.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle. TO thee haue I lifted vp mine eies, which dwelleſt in the heauens.
label: Psalms

text: Behold as the eies of ſeruantes, are on the handes of their maſters, As the eies of the handmaide on the handes of her miſtreſſe: ſo are our eies to our Lord God vntil he haue mercie on vs.
label: Psalms

text: Haue mercie on vs ô Lord, haue mercie on vs: becauſe we are much replenished with contempt.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our ſoule is much replenished: reproch to them that abund, and contempt to the prowde.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle. BVt that our Lord was in vs, let Iſrael now ſay:
label: Psalms

text: but that our Lord was in vs, When men roſe vp againſt vs,
label: Psalms

text: perhaps they had ſwalowed vs aliue: When their furie was angrie againſt vs,
label: Psalms

text: perhaps water had ſwalowed vs.
label: Psalms

text: Our ſoule hath paſſed through a torrent: perhaps our ſoule had paſſed through an intolerable water.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed be our Lord which hath not geuen vs, for a pray to their teeth.
label: Psalms

text: Our ſoule as a ſparow is deliuered from the ſnare of the fowlers: The ſnare is broken, and we are deliuered.
label: Psalms

text: Our helpe is in the name of our Lord, who made heauen and earth.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle. THEY that truſt in our Lord, as mount Sion: he shal not be moued for euer, that dwelleth in Ieruſalem.
label: Psalms

text: Mountaines round about it: and our Lord round about his people, from hence forth now and for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord wil not leaue the rod of ſinners vpon the lote of the iuſt: that the iuſt reach not their handes to iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: Doe wel ô Lord to the good, and right of hart.
label: Psalms

text: But thoſe that decline into obligations, our Lord wil bring with them that worke iniquitie: peace vpon Iſrael.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle. WHEN our Lord turned the captiuitie of Sion: we were made as men comforted.
label: Psalms

text: Then was our mouth replenished with ioy: and our tongue with exultation. Then shal they ſay among the Gentiles: Our Lord hath done magnifically vvith them.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord hath done magnifically with vs: we are made ioyful.
label: Psalms

text: Turne our captiuitie ô Lord, as a torrent in the South.
label: Psalms

text: They that ſow in teares, shal reape in ioyfulneſſe.
label: Psalms

text: Going they went and wept, caſting their ſeedes.
label: Psalms

text: But coming they shal come with exultation, carying their sheaues.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle of Salomon: VNLESSE our Lord build the houſe, they haue laboured in vayne that build it. Vnleſſe our Lord kepe the citie, he watcheth in vayne that kepeth it.
label: Psalms

text: It is vaine for you to riſe before light: riſe ye after ye haue ſitten, which eate the bread of ſorow.
label: Psalms

text: When he shal giue ſleepe to his beloued: behold the inheritance of our Lord are children: the reward, the fruite of the wombe.
label: Psalms

text: As arrowes in the hand of the mightie: ſo are the children of them that are shaken.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed is the man that hath filled his deſire of them: he shal not be confounded when he shal ſpeake to his enemies in the gate.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle. BLESSED are al that feare our Lord, that walke in his wayes.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou shalt eate the labours of thy handes: bleſſed art thou, and it shal be wel with thee.
label: Psalms

text: Thy wife as a fruitful vine, in the ſides of thy houſe. Thy children as young plantes of oliuetrees, round about thy table.
label: Psalms

text: Behold ſo shal the man be bleſſed, that feareth our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord out of Sion bleſſe thee: and that thou mayſt ſee the good thinges of Ieruſalem al the dayes of thy life.
label: Psalms

text: And that thou mayſt ſee thy childrens children, peace vpon Iſrael.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle. OFTEN haue they impugned me from my youth, let Iſrael now ſay:
label: Psalms

text: Often haue they impugned me from my youth: but they haue not preuailed againſt me.
label: Psalms

text: Sinners haue builded vpon my backe: they haue prolonged their iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: Our iuſt Lord wil cut the neckes of ſinners:
label: Psalms

text: let them al be confounded and turned backward, that hate Sion.
label: Psalms

text: Let them be made as graſſe in the toppes of houſes: which is withered before it be plucked vp.
label: Psalms

text: Wherof the reaper hath not filled his hand, and he that gathereth the sheaues his boſome.
label: Psalms

text: And they ſayd not that paſſed by: The bleſſing of our Lord be vpon you: we haue bleſſed you in the name of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle. FROM the depthes I haue cried to thee ô Lord:
label: Psalms

text: Lord heare my voice: Let thine eares be intent, to the voice of my petition.
label: Psalms

text: If thou shalt obſerue iniquities ô Lord: Lord who shal ſuſteyne it?
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe with thee there is propiciation: and for thy law I haue expected thee ô Lord. My ſoule hath expected in his word:
label: Psalms

text: my ſoule hath hoped in our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: From the morning watch euen vntil night: let Iſrael hope in our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe with our Lord there is mercie: and with him plenteous redemption.
label: Psalms

text: And he shal redeme Iſrael, from al his iniquities.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle of Dauid. LORD my hart is not exalted: neither are mine eies loftie. Neither haue I walked in great matters: nor in meruelous thinges aboue me.
label: Psalms

text: If I was not humbly mynded: but exalted my ſoule: As the weaned childe is toward his mother, ſo retribution in my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: Let Iſrael hope in our Lord, from henceforth now and for euer.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle. REMEMBER Dauid ô Lord, and al his meekenes:
label: Psalms

text: As he ſware to our Lord, vowed a vowe to the God of Iacob.
label: Psalms

text: If I shal enter into the tabernacle of my houſe, if I shal aſcend into the bed of my couch.
label: Psalms

text: If I shal geue ſleepe to mine eies, and ſlumbering to mine eie liddes:
label: Psalms

text: And reſt to my temples: vntil I finde a place for our Lord, a tabernacle for the God of Iacob.
label: Psalms

text: Behold we haue heard of it in Ephrata: we haue found it in the fildes of the wood.
label: Psalms

text: We wil enter into his tabernacle: we wil adore in the place where his feete ſtood.
label: Psalms

text: Ariſe Lord into thy reſt, thou and the arke of thy ſanctification.
label: Psalms

text: Let thy Prieſtes be clothed with iuſtice: & let thy ſainctes reioyce.
label: Psalms

text: For Dauid thy ſeruants ſake, turne not away the face of thy Chriſt.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord hath ſworne truth to Dauid, and he wil not diſapoint it: Of the fruite of thy wombe I vvil ſet vpon thy ſeate.
label: Psalms

text: If thy children shal keepe my teſtament, and theſe my teſtimonies which I wil teach them: Their children alſo euen for euer, shal ſit vpon thy ſeate.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord hath choſen Sion: he hath choſen it for an habitation to himſelf.
label: Psalms

text: This is my reſt for euer and euer: here wil I dwel becauſe I haue choſen it.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſing I wil bleſſe her widow: her poore I wil fil with breades.
label: Psalms

text: Her Prieſtes I wil clothe with ſaluation: and her ſainctes shal reioyce with ioyfulnes.
label: Psalms

text: Thither wil I bring forth a horne to Dauid, I haue prepared a lampe to my Chriſt.
label: Psalms

text: His enemies I wil clothe with confuſion: but vpon him shal my ſanctification florish.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle of Dauid. BEHOLD how good, and how pleaſant a thing it is, for brethren to dwel in one:
label: Psalms

text: As oyntement on the head, which ranne downe vpon the beard, the beard of Aaron, which ranne downe vnto the hemme of his garment:
label: Psalms

text: As the dew of Hermon, which runneth downe vpon mount Sion. Becauſe there hath our Lord commanded bleſſing, and life euen for euer.
label: Psalms

text: A gradual Canticle. LOE now bleſſe our Lord, al ye the ſeruantes of our Lord: which ſtand in the houſe of our Lord, in the courtes of the houſe of our God.
label: Psalms

text: In the nightes lift vp your handes vnto the holie places, and bleſſe ye our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord out of Sion bleſſe thee, who made heauen and earth.
label: Psalms

text: Allelu ia. PRAYSE ye the name of our Lord, ye ſeruantes prayſe our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Ye that ſtand in the houſe of our Lord, in the courtes of the houſe of our God.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſe ye our Lord, becauſe our Lord is good: ſing ye to his name, becauſe it is ſweete.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord hath choſen Iacob to himſelf, Iſrael for his owne poſſeſſion.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe I haue knowne that our Lord is great, and our God aboue al goddes.
label: Psalms

text: Al thinges whatſoeuer our Lord would he hath done, in heauen, in earth, in the ſea, and in al the depthes.
label: Psalms

text: Bringing forth clowdes from the vttermoſt of the earth: lightenings he hath turned into rayne. Who bringeth forth the windes out of his treaſures:
label: Psalms

text: who ſtroke the firſt begotten of Ægypt from man euen to beaſt.
label: Psalms

text: He ſent forth ſignes, and wonders in the middes of thee ô Ægypt: vpon Pharao, and vpon al his ſeruantes.
label: Psalms

text: Who ſtroke manie nations: and ſlew ſtrong kinges:
label: Psalms

text: Sehon the king of the Amorrheites, & Og the king of Baſan, and al the kingdomes of Chanaan.
label: Psalms

text: And he gaue their land for inheritance, for an inheritance to Iſrael his people.
label: Psalms

text: Lord thy name is for euer: Lord thy memorial is vnto generation and generation.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord shal iudge his people: and wil be intreated toward his ſeruantes.
label: Psalms

text: The idoles of the Gentiles are ſiluer, and gold, the workes of mens handes.
label: Psalms

text: They haue mouth, and shal not ſpeake: they haue eies, and shal not ſee.
label: Psalms

text: They haue eares, and shal not heare: for neither is there breath in their mouth.
label: Psalms

text: Let them that make them become like to them: and al that haue confidence in them.
label: Psalms

text: Ye houſe of Iſrael bleſſe our Lord: ye houſe of Aaron bleſſe our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Ye houſe of Leui bleſſe our Lord: you that feare our Lord, bleſſe ye our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed be our Lord out of Sion, who dwelleth in Ieruſalem.
label: Psalms

text: Allelu ia. CONFESSE ye to our Lord becauſe he is good: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Confeſſe ye to the God of goddes: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Confeſſe ye to the Lord of lordes: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Who onlie doth great meruels: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Who made the heauen in vnderſtanding: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Who eſtablished the earth ouer the waters: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Who made the great lightes: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: The ſunne to rule the day: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: The moone, and ſtarres to rule the night: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Who ſtroke Ægypt with their firſtbegotten: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Who brought forth Iſrael out of the middes of them: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: In a mightie hand, and loftie arme: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Who diuided the Read ſea into diuiſions: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: And brought forth Iſrael through the middes therof: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: And he ouerthrew Pharao, and his hoſt in the Read ſea: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Who led his people through the deſert: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Who ſtroke great kinges: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: And ſlewe ſtrong kinges: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Sehon the king of the Amorrheites: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: And Og the king of Baſan: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: And he gaue their land for an inheritance: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: For an inheritance to Iſrael his ſeruant: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: For in our humiliation he was mindful of vs: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: And he redemed vs from our enemies: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Who geueth foode to al fleshe: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: Confeſſe ye to the God of heauen: becauſe his mercie is for euer. Confeſſe ye to the Lord of lordes: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme of Dauid for Ieremie. VPON the riuers of Babylon, there we ſate and wept: whiles we remembred Sion.
label: Psalms

text: On the willowes in the middes therof, we hanged vp our inſtrumentes.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe there they that led vs captiue, demanded of vs wordes of ſonges. And they that led vs away: Sing ye an hymne to vs of the ſonges of Sion.
label: Psalms

text: How shal we sing the ſong of our Lord in a ſtrange land?
label: Psalms

text: If I shal forget thee ô Ieruſalem, let my right hand be forgotten.
label: Psalms

text: Let my tongue cleaue to my iawes, if I doe not remember thee: If I shal not ſet Ieruſalem in the beginning of my ioy.
label: Psalms

text: Be mindful ô Lord of the childrem of Edom, in the day of Ieruſalem: That ſay: Raſe it, raſe it, euen vnto the foundation therof.
label: Psalms

text: Daugther of Babylon miſerable: bleſſed is he, that shal repay thee thy payment, which thou haſt payed vs.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed is he, that shal hold, and shal dash thy litle ones againſt the rocke.
label: Psalms

text: To Dauid him ſelf. I wil confeſſe to thee ô Lord in my whole hart: becauſe thou haſt heard the wordes of my mouth. In the ſight of Angels I wil ſing to thee:
label: Psalms

text: I wil adore toward thy holie temple, and wil confeſſe to thy name. For thy mercie, and thy truth: becauſe thou haſt magnified aboue euerie thing thy holie name.
label: Psalms

text: In what day ſoeuer I shal inuocate thee, heare me: thou wilt multiplie ſtrength in my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: Let al the kinges of the earth ô Lord confeſſe to thee: becauſe they haue heard al the wordes of thy mouth:
label: Psalms

text: And let them ſing in the wayes of our Lord: becauſe great is the glorie of our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord is high, and he beholdeth low thinges: and high thinges he knoweth far of.
label: Psalms

text: If I shal walke in the middes of tribulation, thou wilt quicken me: and vpon the wrath of mine enimies thou haſt extended thy hand, and thy right hand hath ſaued me.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord wil repay for me: ô Lord thy mercie is for euer: deſpiſe not the workes of thy handes.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, a Pſalme of Dauid. LORD thou haſt proued me, and haſt knowen me:
label: Psalms

text: thou haſt knowen my ſitting downe, and my riſing vp.
label: Psalms

text: Thou haſt vnderſtood my cogitations far of: my path, and my corde thou haſt ſearched out.
label: Psalms

text: And thou haſt foreſene al my wayes: becauſe there is not a word in my tongue.
label: Psalms

text: Behold ô Lord thou haſt knowen al the laſt thinges, & them of old: thou haſt formed me, and haſt put thy hand vpon me.
label: Psalms

text: Thy knowledge is become meruelous of me: it is made great, and I can not reach to it.
label: Psalms

text: Whither shal I goe from thy ſpirit? and whither shal I flee from thy face?
label: Psalms

text: If I shal aſcend into heauen, thou art there: if I deſcend into hel, thou art preſent.
label: Psalms

text: If I shal take my winges early, and dwel in the extreme partes of the ſea:
label: Psalms

text: Certes thither alſo shal thy hand conduct me: and thy right hand shal hold me.
label: Psalms

text: And I ſayd: Perhaps darknes shal treade ouer me: and the night is mine illumination in my delightes.
label: Psalms

text: For darkenes shal not be darkened from thee, and the night shal be lightened as the day: as the darkenes therof, ſo alſo the light therof.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe thou haſt poſſeſſed my reynes: thou haſt receiued me from my mothers wombe.
label: Psalms

text: I wil confeſſe to thee, becauſe thou art terribly magnified: thy workes are meruelous, & my ſoule knoweth excedingly.
label: Psalms

text: My bone is not hid from thee, which thou madeſt in ſecrete: and my ſubſtance in the lower partes of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Mine imperfection thine eies haue ſene, & in thy booke al shal be written: daies shal be formed, & no man in them.
label: Psalms

text: But to me thy frendes ô God are become honorable exceedingly: their principalitie is exceedingly ſtrengthned.
label: Psalms

text: I wil number them, and they shal be multiplied aboue the ſand: I roſe vp and I am yet with thee.
label: Psalms

text: If thou shalt kil ſinners ô God: ye men of blood depart from me.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe you ſay in thought: they shal receiue thy cities in vayne.
label: Psalms

text: Did not I hate them, that hate thee ô Lord: and pyned away becauſe of thine enemies?
label: Psalms

text: with perfect hatred did I hate them: they are become enemies to me.
label: Psalms

text: Proue me ô God, and know my hart: examine me, and know my pathes.
label: Psalms

text: And ſee, if the way of iniquitie be in me: and conduct me in the euerlaſting way.
label: Psalms

text: Vnto the end, a Pſalme of Dauid.
label: Psalms

text: DELIVER me ô Lord from the euil man: from the vniuſt man reſcue me.
label: Psalms

text: Which haue deuiſed iniquitie in their hart: al the day they did appoint battels. They haue whet their tongues as that of a ſerpent:
label: Psalms

text: the venome of aſpes is vnder their lippes.
label: Psalms

text: Kepe me ô Lord from the hand of the ſinner: and from vniuſt men deliuer me.
label: Psalms

text: Who haue deuiſed to ſupplant my ſteppes: the proude haue hid a ſnare for me: And they haue ſtreched out ropes for a ſnare: they haue layd a ſtumbling blocke for me nere the way.
label: Psalms

text: I ſayd to our Lord: Thou art my God: heare ô Lord the voice of my petition.
label: Psalms

text: O Lord, Lord the ſtrength of my ſaluation: thou haſt ouershadowed my head in the day of battel.
label: Psalms

text: Yeld me not ô Lord from my deſire, to the ſinner: they haue deuiſed againſt me, forſake me not, leſt they perhaps be proude.
label: Psalms

text: The head of their compaſſe: the labour of their lippes shal couer them.
label: Psalms

text: Coales shal fal vpon them, thou shalt caſt them downe into fyre: in miſeries they shal not ſtand vp.
label: Psalms

text: A man ful of tongue shal not be directed in the earth: euils shal take the vniuſt man into deſtruction.
label: Psalms

text: I haue knowne that our Lord wil do the iudgement of the needie: and the reuenge of the poore.
label: Psalms

text: But as for the iuſt, they shal confeſſe to thy name: and the righteous shal dwel with thy countenance.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme of Dauid. LORD I haue cried to thee, heare me: attend to my voice, when I shal crie to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Let my prayer be directed as incenſe in thy ſight: the eleuation of my handes as euening ſacrifice.
label: Psalms

text: Set ô Lord a watch to my mouth: and a doore round about to my lippes.
label: Psalms

text: Decline not my hart into wordes of malice, to make excuſes in ſinnes. With men that worke iniquitie: and I wil not communicate with the chiefe of them.
label: Psalms

text: The iuſt shal rebuke me in mercie, and shal reprehend me: but let not the oyle of a ſinner fatte my head. Becauſe, yet alſo my prayer is in their good pleaſures:
label: Psalms

text: their Iudges are ſwalowed vp ioyned to the rocke. They shal heare my wordes becauſe they haue preuailed:
label: Psalms

text: as the groſſenes of the earth is broken out vpon the earth. Our bones are diſſipated nere to hel:
label: Psalms
