text: for to thee ô Lord, Lord are mine eies; in thee haue I hoped, take not away my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: Keepe me from the ſnare, which they haue ſet for me: and from the ſcandals of them that worke iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: Sinners shal fal in his net: I am alone vntil I paſſe.
label: Psalms

text: OF vnderſtanding to Dauid, when he was in the caue, a prayer. 1. Reg. 24.
label: Psalms

text: VVIth my voice I haue cried to our Lord: with my voice I haue prayed to our Lord:
label: Psalms

text: I powre out my prayer in his ſight, and I pronounce my tribulation before him.
label: Psalms

text: When my ſpirit faileth of my ſelf, and thou haſt knowne my pathes. In this way, which I walked, they hid a ſnare for me.
label: Psalms

text: I looked toward the right hand, and ſaw: and there was none that would know me. Flight hath failed me: and there is none to require my ſoule.
label: Psalms

text: I haue cried to thee ô Lord, I haue ſayd: Thou art my hope, my portion in the land of the liuing.
label: Psalms

text: Attend to my petition: becauſe I am humbled exceedingly. Deliuer me from them that perſecute me: becauſe they are made ſtrong ouer me.
label: Psalms

text: Bring forth my ſoule out of priſon, to confeſſe vnto thy name: the iuſt expect me; til thou reward me.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme of Dauid, when Abſalom his ſonne perſecuted him. 2. Reg. LORD heare my prayer: with thine eares receiue my petition in thy truth: heare me in thy iuſtice.
label: Psalms

text: And enter not into iudgement with thy ſeruant: becauſe no man liuing shal be iuſtified in thy ſight.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe the enemie hath perſecuted my ſoule: he hath humbled my life in the earth. He hath ſet me in obſcure places as the dead of the world:
label: Psalms

text: and my ſpirit is in anguish vpon me, within me my hart is trubled.
label: Psalms

text: I was mindful of old dayes, I haue meditated in al thy workes: in the factes of thy handes did I meditate.
label: Psalms

text: I haue ſtretched forth my handes to thee: my ſoule is as earth without water vnto thee.
label: Psalms

text: Heare me quickly ô Lord: my ſpirite hath faynted. Turne not away thy face from me: and I shal be like to them that deſcend into the lake.
label: Psalms

text: Make me heare thy mercie in the morning: becauſe I haue hoped in thee. Make the way knowen to me, wherein I may walke: becauſe I haue lifted vp my ſoule to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Deliuer me from mine enemies ô Lord, to thee I haue fled:
label: Psalms

text: teach me to doe thy wil, becauſe thou art my God: Thy good ſpirite wil conduct me into the right way:
label: Psalms

text: for thy name ſake ô Lord thou wilt quicken me, in thine equitie. Thou wilt bring forth my ſoule out of tribulation:
label: Psalms

text: and in thy mercie thou wilt deſtroy mine enemies. And thou wilt deſtroy al, that afflict my ſoule: becauſe I am thy ſeruant.
label: Psalms

text: A Pſalme of Dauid, againſt Goliath. BLESSED be our Lord my God, who teacheth my handes to battel; and my fingers to warre.
label: Psalms

text: My mercie, and my refuge: my defender, and my deliuerer. My protectour, and I haue hoped in him, who ſubdeweth my people vnder me.
label: Psalms

text: Lord what is man, that thou art made knowne to him? or the ſonne of man; that thou eſtemeſt him?
label: Psalms

text: Man is made like to vanitie: his dayes paſſe as a shadow.
label: Psalms

text: Lord incline thy heauens, and deſcend: touch the mountaynes, and they wil ſmoke.
label: Psalms

text: Lighten lightening, and thou shalt diſperſe them: shoote out thine arrowes, and thou shalt deſtroy them.
label: Psalms

text: Send forth thy hand from on high, take me out, and deliuer me from manie waters: from the hand of children ſtrangers.
label: Psalms

text: Whoſe mouth hath ſpoken vanitie: and their right hand is the right hand of iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: O God I wil ſing to thee a new ſong: in the pſalter of ten ſtringes, I wil ſing to thee.
label: Psalms

text: Who geueſt ſaluation to kinges: who haſt redemed Dauid thy ſeruant from the malignant ſword:
label: Psalms

text: deliuer me, And reſcue me out of the hand of children ſtrangers, whoſe mouth hath ſpoken vanitie: and their right hand, is the right hand of iniquitie.
label: Psalms

text: Whoſe ſonnes, are as new plantes in their youth. Their daughters comly trimmed: decked about after the ſimilitude of a temple.
label: Psalms

text: Their ſtorehouſes ful, flowing out of this into that. Their ewes ful of yong, abunding in their going forth:
label: Psalms

text: their oxen are fatte. There is no ruine of wal, nor paſſage, nor crie in their ſtreates.
label: Psalms

text: They haue ſaid, that it is a happie people, which hath theſe things: bleſſed is the people, whoſe God is our Lord.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſing, to Dauid himſelfe. I Wil exalt thee my God the king: and I wil bleſſe thy name for euer, and for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: Euerie day wil I bleſſe thee: and wil praiſe thy name, for euer, and for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: Great is our Lord and exceding laudable, and of his greatnes there is no end.
label: Psalms

text: Generation and generation shal praiſe thy workes: and they shal pronounce thy powre.
label: Psalms

text: They shal ſpeake the magnificence of the glorie of thy holines: and shal tel thy meruelous workes.
label: Psalms

text: And they shal tel the force of thy terrible thinges: and shal declare thy greatnes:
label: Psalms

text: They shal vtter the memorie of the abundance of thy ſwetnes: and in thy iuſtice they shal reioyce.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is pitiful and merciful: patient and very merciful.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is ſweete to al: and his commiſerations are ouer al his workes.
label: Psalms

text: Let al thy workes o Lord confeſſe to thee: and let thy ſainctes bleſſe thee.
label: Psalms

text: They shal tel the glorie of thy kingdom: and shal ſpeake thy might.
label: Psalms

text: That they may make thy might knowne to the children of men: and the glorie of the magnificence of thy kingdom.
label: Psalms

text: Thy kingdom is a kingdom of al worldes: and thy dominion in al generation and generation. Our Lord is faithful in al his wordes: and holie in al his workes.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord lifteth vp al that fal: and ſetteth vp al that are bruiſed.
label: Psalms

text: The eies of al hope in thee ô Lord: and thou geueſt their meate in time conuenient.
label: Psalms

text: Thou openeſt thy hand: and filleſt euerie liuing creature with bleſſing.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is iuſt in al his wayes: and holie in al his workes.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is neere to al that inuocate him: to al that inuocate him in truth.
label: Psalms

text: He wil doe the wil of them that feare him, and wil heare their prayer; and ſaue them.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord keepeth al that loue him: and he wil deſtroy al ſinners.
label: Psalms

text: My mouth shal ſpeake the prayſe of our Lord: and let al flesh bleſſe his holie name for euer, and for euer and euer.
label: Psalms

text: Alleluia, of Aggæus, and Zacharie.
label: Psalms

text: MY ſoule prayſe thou our Lord, I wil praiſe our Lord in my life: I wil ſing to my God as long as I shal be. Put not confidence in princes:
label: Psalms

text: in the ſonnes of men, in whom there is no ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: His ſpirit shal goe forth, and he shal returne into his earth: in that day al their cogitations shal perish.
label: Psalms

text: Bleſſed is he, whoſe helper is the God of Iacob, his hope in our Lord his God:
label: Psalms

text: who made heauen and earth, the ſea, and al thinges, that are in them.
label: Psalms

text: Which keepeth truth for euer, doth iudgement for them that ſuffer wrong: geueth foode to the hungrie. Our Lord looſeth the fettered:
label: Psalms

text: our Lord illuminateth the blind. Our Lord lifteth vp the bruiſed, our Lord loueth the iuſt.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord keepeth ſtrangers, the pupil, and widow he wil receiue: and the wayes of ſinners he wil deſtroy.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord wil reigne for euer thy God ô Sion, in generation and generation.
label: Psalms

text: Alleluia. PRAYSE ye our Lord becauſe Pſalme is good: to our God let there be pleaſant, and comelie praiſe.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord building vp Ieruſalem: wil gather together the diſperſions of Iſrael.
label: Psalms

text: Who healeth the contrite of hart: and bindeth vp their ſores.
label: Psalms

text: Who numbereth the multitude of ſtarres: and geueth names to them al.
label: Psalms

text: Great is our Lord, and great is his ſtrength: and of his wiſdom there is no number.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord receiuing the meeke: & humbling ſinners euen to the ground.
label: Psalms

text: Sing ye to our Lord in confeſſion: ſing ye to our God on harpe.
label: Psalms

text: Who couereth the heauen with cloudes: and prepareth rayne for the earth. Who bringeth forth graſſe in the mountaines: and herbe for the ſeruice of men.
label: Psalms

text: Who geueth to beaſtes their foode: and to the young rauens that cal vpon him.
label: Psalms

text: He shal not haue pleaſure in the ſtrength of an horſe: nor in the legges of a man shal he be wel pleaſed.
label: Psalms

text: Our Lord is wel pleaſed toward them that feare him: and in them, that hope vpon his mercie.
label: Psalms

text: Alleluia. O Ieruſalem praiſe our Lord: praiſe thy God ô Sion.
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe he hath ſtrengthened the lockes of thy gates: he hath bleſſed thy children in thee.
label: Psalms

text: Who hath ſet thy borders peace: and filleth thee with the fatte of corne.
label: Psalms

text: Who ſendeth forth his ſpeach to the earth: his word runneth ſwiftly.
label: Psalms

text: Who geueth ſnow as vvool: ſcatereth miſt as ashes.
label: Psalms

text: He caſteth his cryſtal as morſeles: before the face of his cold who shal endure?
label: Psalms

text: He shal ſendforth his word, and shal melt them: his ſpirit shal blowe, and waters shal flowe.
label: Psalms

text: Who declareth his word to Iacob: his iuſtices, and iudgements to Iſrael.
label: Psalms

text: He hath not done in like maner to anie nation: and his iudgements he hath not made manifeſt to them. Allelu-ia.
label: Psalms

text: Alleluia. PRAYSE ye our Lord from the heauens: praiſe ye him in the high places.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſe ye him al his Angels: prayſe ye him al his hoſtes.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſe ye him ſunne and moone: prayſe him al ye ſtarres, and light.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſe him ye heauens of heauens: and the waters that are aboue the heauens,
label: Psalms

text: let them praiſe the name of our Lord. Becauſe he ſayd, and they were made: he commanded, and they were created.
label: Psalms

text: He eſtablished them for euer, and for euer and euer: he put a precept, and it shal not paſſe.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſe our Lord from the earth: ye dragons, and al depthes.
label: Psalms

text: Fyre, haile, ſnow, yſe, ſpirit of ſtormes: which doe his worde:
label: Psalms

text: Mountaines, and al litle hilles: trees that beare fruite, and al ceders.
label: Psalms

text: Beaſtes, and al cattel: ſerpentes, and fethered fowles:
label: Psalms

text: Kinges of the earth, and al peoples: princes, and al iudges of the earth.
label: Psalms

text: Yongmen, and virgins: old with yong let them prayſe the name of our Lord:
label: Psalms

text: becauſe the name of him alone is exalted.
label: Psalms

text: The confeſſion of him aboue heauen, and earth: and he hath exalted the horne of his people. An hymne to al his ſainctes: to the children of Iſrael, a people approching vnto him. Alleluia.
label: Psalms

text: Alleluia. SING ye to our Lord a new ſong: let his praiſe be in the Church of ſainctes.
label: Psalms

text: Let Iſrael be ioyful in him, that made him: and let the children of Sion reioyce in their king.
label: Psalms

text: Let them praiſe his name in quire: on tymbrel, and pſalter let them ſing to him:
label: Psalms

text: Becauſe our Lord is wel pleaſed in his people: and he wil exalt the meeke vnto ſaluation.
label: Psalms

text: The ſainctes shal reioyce in glorie: they shal be ioyful in their beddes.
label: Psalms

text: The exaltations of God in their throte: and two edged ſwordes in their handes.
label: Psalms

text: To doe reuenge in the nations: chaſtiſements among the peoples.
label: Psalms

text: To binde their kinges in fetters: and their nobles in yron manicles.
label: Psalms

text: That they may doe in them the iudgement that is written: this glorie is to al his ſainctes. Alleluia.
label: Psalms

text: Alleluia. PRAYSE ye our Lord in his holies: prayſe ye him in the firmament of his ſtrength.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſe ye him in his powers: prayſe ye him according to the multitude of his greatnes.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſe ye him in the ſound of trumpet: prayſe ye him on pſalter, and harpe.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſe ye him on timbrel and quire: prayſe ye him on ſtringes, and organ.
label: Psalms

text: Prayſe ye him on wel ſounding cymbals: prayſe ye him on cymbales of iubilation:
label: Psalms

text: let euerie ſpirit praiſe our Lord. Alleluia.
label: Psalms

text: THE Parables of Salomon, the ſonne of Dauid, king of Iſrael.
label: Proverbs

text: To know wiſdom, and diſcipline:
label: Proverbs

text: to vnderſtand the wordes of prudence: and to receiue inſtruction of doctrine, iuſtice, and iudgement, and equitie:
label: Proverbs

text: that subtilitie may be geuen to litle ones, knowlege and vnderſtanding to the youngman.
label: Proverbs

text: The wiſe man hearing shal be wiser: and he that vnderſtandeth, shal poſſeſſe gouernementes.
label: Proverbs

text: He shal vnderſtand a parable, and interpretation, the wordes of the wiſe, and their darke ſayings.
label: Proverbs

text: The feare of our Lord is the begynning of wiſdom. Fooles deſpiſe wiſedom and doctrine.
label: Proverbs

text: My ſonne, heare the diſcipline of thy father, and leaue not the lawe of thy mother:
label: Proverbs

text: that grace may be added to thy head, and a cheyne of gold to thy necke.
label: Proverbs

text: My ſonne, if ſinners shal entiſe thee, condeſcend not to them.
label: Proverbs

text: If they shal ſay: Come with vs, let vs lye in waite for bloud, let vs hide ſnares againſt the innocent without cauſe:
label: Proverbs

text: let vs swalow him aliue as hel, and whole as one deſcending into the lake.
label: Proverbs

text: We shal finde al precious ſubſtance, we shal fil our houſe with ſpoiles.
label: Proverbs

text: Caſt in thy lot with vs, let there be one purse of vs al.
label: Proverbs

text: My ſonne, walke not with them, ſtay thy foote from their pathes.
label: Proverbs

text: For their feete runne to euil, and make haſte to shede bloud.
label: Proverbs

text: But a nette is caſt in vayne before the eies of them that haue winges.
label: Proverbs

text: Themſelues alſo lye in wayte againſt their owne bloud & practiſe deceites againſt their owne ſoules.
label: Proverbs

text: So the pathes of euerie couetous man, take violently the ſoules of the poſſeſſors.
label: Proverbs

text: Wiſdom preacheth abrode, she geueth her voice in the ſtreates:
label: Proverbs

text: In the head of multitudes she cryeth, in the doores of the gates of the citie she vttereth her wordes, ſaying:
label: Proverbs

text: O children how long doe you loue infancie, and fooles couet thoſe thinges, which are hurtful to them ſelues, and the vnwiſe hate knowlege?
label: Proverbs

text: Turne ye at my correction: behold I wil vtter my ſpirite to you, and wil shewe you my wordes.
label: Proverbs

text: Becauſe I called, and you refuſed: I ſtreched out my hand, and there was none that regarded.
label: Proverbs

text: You haue deſpiſed al my counſel, and haue neglected my reprehenſions.
label: Proverbs

text: I alſo wil laugh in your deſtruction, and wil ſcorne, when that shal come to you, which you feared.
label: Proverbs

text: When ſoden calamitie shal fal on you, and deſtruction, as a tempeſt shal be at hand: when tribulation, and diſtreſſe shal come vpon you:
label: Proverbs

text: Then shal they inuocate me, and I wil not heare: in the morning shal they ariſe, and shal not finde me:
label: Proverbs

text: for that they haue hated diſcipline, and not receiued the feare of our Lord,
label: Proverbs

text: nor conſented to my counſel, & detracted from al my correction.
label: Proverbs

text: They shal eate therefore the fruites of their way, and shal be filled with their owne counſels.
label: Proverbs

text: The auerſion of litle ones shal kil them, and the proſperitie of fooles shal deſtroy them.
label: Proverbs

text: But he that shal heare me, shal reſt without terrour, and shal enioy abundance, feare of euils being taken away.
label: Proverbs

text: MY ſonne, if thou wilt receiue my wordes, and wilt hide my commandments with thee,
label: Proverbs

text: that thyne eare may heare wiſdom: incline thyne hart to knowe prudence.
label: Proverbs

text: For if thou shalt cal for wiſdom, and incline thyne hart to prudence:
label: Proverbs

text: If thou shalt ſeeke her as money, and as treaſures shalt dig her vp:
label: Proverbs

text: then shalt thou vnderſtand the feare of our Lord, and shalt finde the knowlege of God.
label: Proverbs

text: Becauſe our Lord geueth wiſdom: and out of his mouth prudence and knowlege.
label: Proverbs

text: He wil keepe the ſaluation of the righteous, & protect them that walke ſimply
label: Proverbs

text: Keeping the pathes of iuſtice, & garding the wayes of ſaints.
label: Proverbs

text: Then shalt thou vnderſtand iuſtice, and iudgement, and equitie, and euery good path.
label: Proverbs

text: If wiſdom shal enter into thy hart, and knowlege pleaſe thy ſoule:
label: Proverbs

text: counſel shal keepe thee, and prudence shal preſerue thee,
label: Proverbs

text: that thou mayſt be deliuered from the euil way, and from the man, that ſpeaketh peruerſe thinges:
label: Proverbs

text: who leaue the right way, and walke by darke wayes:
label: Proverbs

text: who are glad when they haue done euil, and reioyce in moſt wicked thinges:
label: Proverbs

text: whoſe wayes are peruerſe, and their ſteppes infamous.
label: Proverbs

text: That thou mayſt be deliuered from the ſtrange woman, and from the forener, which mollifieth her wordes,
label: Proverbs

text: forſaketh the guide of her youth,
label: Proverbs

text: and hath forgotten the couenant of her God. For her houſe is bowed downe to death, and her pathes to hel.
label: Proverbs

text: Al that goe in vnto her, shal not returne neither shal they apprehend the pathes of life.
label: Proverbs

text: That thou mayſt walke in a good way: and mayſt keepe the pathes of the iuſt.
label: Proverbs

text: For they that are right, shal dwel in the earth, and the ſimple shal continue in it.
label: Proverbs

text: But the impious shal be deſtroyed from the earth: and they that doe vniuſtly shal be taken away from it.
label: Proverbs

text: MY ſonne, forget not my law, and let thy hart keepe my precepts.
label: Proverbs

text: For they shal adde to thee length of dayes, and yeares of life, and peace.
label: Proverbs

text: Let not mercie and truth leaue thee, put them about thy throte; and write them in the tables of thy hart:
label: Proverbs

text: He that gathereth in the harueſt, is a wiſe ſonne: but he that ſnorteth in ſummer, is the ſonne of confuſion.
label: Proverbs

text: The bleſſing of our Lord is vpon the head of the iuſt: but iniquitie couereth the mouth of the impious.
label: Proverbs

text: The memorie of the iuſt is with prayſes: and the name of the impious shal rotte.
label: Proverbs

text: The wiſe of hart shal receiue preceptes: a foole is beaten with lippes.
label: Proverbs

text: He that walketh playnly, walketh confidently: but he that depraueth his wayes, shal be manifeſt.
label: Proverbs

text: He that wincketh with the eye, shal geue ſorow: and the foole in lippes shal be beaten.
label: Proverbs

text: A vayne of life, the mouth of the iuſt: and the mouth of the impious couereth iniquitie.
label: Proverbs

text: Hatred rayſeth brawles: and charitie couereth al ſinnes.
label: Proverbs

text: In the lippes of the wiſe wiſdom is found: and a rod on his backe that lacketh witte.
label: Proverbs

text: Wiſe men hide knowlege: but the mouth of the foole is next to confuſion.
label: Proverbs

text: The ſubſtance of a rich man, is a citie of his ſtrength: the feare of the poore their pouertie.
label: Proverbs

text: The worke of the iuſt vnto life: but the fruite of the impious vnto ſinne.
label: Proverbs

text: The way of life, to him that keepeth diſcipline: but he that forſaketh reprehenſions, erreth.
label: Proverbs

text: Lying lippes hide hatred; he that vttereth contumelie is vnwiſe.
label: Proverbs

text: In much talke there shal not want ſinne: but he that moderateth his lippes is moſt wiſe.
label: Proverbs

text: The tongue of the iuſt, is choſen ſiluer: but the hart of the impious is nothing worth.
label: Proverbs

text: The lippes of the iuſt teach verie many: but they that are vntaught, shal die in the penurie of witte.
label: Proverbs

text: The bleſſing of our Lord maketh men rich: neither shal affliction be ioyned to them.
label: Proverbs

text: A foole worketh miſcheefe as it were by laughter: but wiſdom is prudence to a man.
label: Proverbs

text: That which the impious feareth, shal come vpon him: to the iuſt their deſire shal be geuen.
label: Proverbs

text: As a tempeſt paſſing the impious shal not be: but the iuſt as an euerlaſting fundation.
label: Proverbs

text: As vinegre to the teeth, and ſmoke to the eies, ſo a ſluggard to them, that ſent him.
label: Proverbs

text: The feare of our Lord shal adde dayes: and the yeares of the impious shal be shortened.
label: Proverbs

text: The expectation of the iuſt is ioy: but the hope of the impious shal perish.
label: Proverbs

text: The ſtrength of the ſimple the way of our Lord: and feare is to them that worke euil.
label: Proverbs

text: The iuſt for euer shal not be moued: but the impious shal not dwel on the earth.
label: Proverbs

text: The mouth of the iuſt shal bring forth wiſdom: the tongue of the froward shal perish.
label: Proverbs

text: The lippes of the iuſt conſider gratful thinges: and the mouth of the impious peruerſe thinges.
label: Proverbs

text: A deceitful balance, is abomination before God: and an equal weight is his wil.
label: Proverbs

text: Where pride shal be, there shal be contumelie alſo: but where humilitie, there alſo wiſdom.
label: Proverbs

text: The ſimplicitie of the iuſt shal direct them: and the ſupplanting of the peruers shal waſte them.
label: Proverbs

text: Riches shal not profit in the day of reuenge: but iuſtice shal deliuer from death.
label: Proverbs

text: The iuſtice of the ſimple shal direct his way: and the impious shal fal in his impietie.
label: Proverbs

text: The iuſtice of the righteous shal deliuer them: and the vniuſt shal be caught in their deceitful practiſes.
label: Proverbs

text: The impious man being dead, there shal be no hope any more: and the expectation of the careful shal perish.
label: Proverbs

text: The iuſt is deliuered from diſtreſſe: and the impious shal be geuen for him.
label: Proverbs

text: The diſſembler with his mouth deceiueth his freind: but the iuſt shal be deliuered by knowlege.
label: Proverbs

text: In the good thinges of the iuſt the citie shal reioyce; and in the deſtruction of the impious there shal be prayſe.
label: Proverbs

text: With the benediction of the iuſt the citie shal be exalted: and by the mouth of the impious it shal be ſubuerted.
label: Proverbs

text: He that deſpiſeth his freind, lacketh hart: but the wiſe man wil hold his peace.
label: Proverbs

text: He that walketh fraudulently, reueleth ſecretes: but he that is faithful, concealeth the thing comitted of his freind.
label: Proverbs

text: Where there is no gouernour, the people shal fal: but there is health where is much counſel.
label: Proverbs

text: He shal be afflicted with euil, that is ſuretie for a ſtranger: but he that is ware of the ſnares, shal be ſecure.
label: Proverbs

text: A gracious woman shal finde glorie: and the ſtrong shal haue riches.
label: Proverbs

text: A merciful man doth good to his kinred alſo.
label: Proverbs

text: The impious maketh an vnſtable worke: but to him that ſoweth iuſtice, is a faythful reward.
label: Proverbs

text: Clemencie prepareth life: & the purſewing of euil thinges death.
label: Proverbs

text: A peruers hart is abominable to our Lord: and his wil is in them that walke ſimply.
label: Proverbs

text: Hand in hand the euil man shal not be innocent: but the ſeede of the iuſt shal be ſaued.
label: Proverbs

text: A ring of gold in a ſwines ſnoute, a fayre woman & a foole.
label: Proverbs

text: The deſire of the iuſt is al good: the expectation of the impious furie.
label: Proverbs

text: Some diuide their owne goodes, and are made richer: others take violently not their owne, and are alwayes in pouertie.
label: Proverbs

text: The ſoule which bleſſeth, shal be made fatte: and he that inebriateth himſelf shal alſo be inebriated.
label: Proverbs

text: He that hydeth corne, shal be curſed among the peoples: but bleſſing vpon the head of them that ſel.
label: Proverbs

text: Wel riſeth he early who ſeeketh good thinges: but he that is a ſearcher after euil thinges, shal be oppreſſed of them.
label: Proverbs

text: He that truſteth in his riches shal fal: but the iuſt shal ſpring as a greene leafe.
label: Proverbs

text: He that troubleth his houſe, shal poſſeſſe the windes: and he that is a foole shal ſerue the wiſe.
label: Proverbs

text: The fruite of the iuſt man a tree of life: and he that gaineth ſoules, is wiſe.
label: Proverbs

text: If the iuſt man receiue in the earth, how much more the impious and ſinner?
label: Proverbs

text: HE that loueth diſcipline, loueth knowlege: but he that hateth reprehenſions is vnwiſe.
label: Proverbs

text: He that is good, shal draw grace from our Lord: but he that truſteth in his owne cogitation, doth impiouſly.
label: Proverbs

text: Man shal not be ſtrengthened by impietie: and the roote of the iuſt shal not be moued.
label: Proverbs

text: A diligent woman is a crowne to her husband: and putrefaction in his bones, she that doth thinges worthie of confuſion.
label: Proverbs

text: The cogitations of the iuſt are iudgements: & the counſels of the impious are fraudulent.
label: Proverbs

text: The wordes of the impious lie in wayte for bloud: the mouth of the iuſt shal deliuer them.
label: Proverbs

text: Turne the impious, and they shal not be: but the houſe of the iuſt shal be permanent.
label: Proverbs

text: A man shal be knowen by his doctrine: but he that is vaine and foolish, shal lye open to contempt.
label: Proverbs

text: Better is the poore and ſufficient to himſelf, then he that is glorious and wanteth bread.
label: Proverbs

text: The iuſt knoweth the liues of his beaſtes: but the bowels of the impious are cruel.
label: Proverbs

text: He that tilleth his land, shal be filled with breads: but he that purſeweth idlenes is a verie foole. He that is delighted in much quaffing of wine, leaueth contumelie in his munitions.
label: Proverbs

text: The deſire of the impious is the muniment of the moſt wicked: but the roote of the iuſt shal proſper.
label: Proverbs

text: For the ſinnes of the lippes ruine approcheth to the euil man: but the iuſt eſcapeth out of diſtreſſe.
label: Proverbs

text: Of the fruite of his owne mouth shal euerie man be replenished with good thinges, and according to the workes of his handes it shal be repayed him.
label: Proverbs

text: The way of a foole is right in his eies: but he that is wiſe heareth counſels.
label: Proverbs

text: A foole by & by sheweth his anger: but he that diſſembleth iniuries is wiſe.
label: Proverbs

text: He that ſpeaketh that which he knoweth, is an vtterer of iuſtice: but he that lyeth, is a fraudulent witneſſe.
label: Proverbs

text: There is that promiſeth, and is pricked as it were with the ſword of conſcience: but the tongue of the wiſe is health.
label: Proverbs

text: The lippe of truth shal be ſtable for euer: but he that is an haſtie witneſſe, frameth a tongue of lying.
label: Proverbs

text: Guile is in the hart of them that thinke euil thinges: but ioy foloweth them that geue counſels of peace.
label: Proverbs

text: It shal not make the iuſt ſorie what ſoeuer shal fal to him: but the impious shal be replenished with euil.
label: Proverbs

text: Lying lippes are an abomination to our Lord: but they that doe faithfully pleaſe him.
label: Proverbs

text: A circumſpect man concealeth knowlege: and the hart of the vnwiſe prouoketh folie.
label: Proverbs

text: The hand of the ſtrong shal rule, but that which is ſlothful, shal ſerue vnder tributes.
label: Proverbs

text: Penſifneſſe in the hart of a man shal humble him, & with a good word he shal be made glad.
label: Proverbs

text: He that neglecteth damage for a freind, is iuſt: but the way of the impious shal deceiue them.
label: Proverbs

text: The fraudulent man shal not finde gayne: and the ſubſtance of a man shal be the price of gold.
label: Proverbs

text: In the path of iuſtice, life: but the byway leadeth to death.
label: Proverbs

text: A wiſe ſonne, is the doctrine of the father: but he that is a ſcorner, heareth not when he is rebuked.
label: Proverbs

text: Of the fruite of his owne mouth man shal be filled with good thinges: but the ſoule of the preuaricatours is wicked.
label: Proverbs

text: He that kepeth his mouth, kepeth his ſoule: but he that is vnaduiſed to ſpeake shal feele euils.
label: Proverbs

text: The ſluggard wil and wil not: but the ſoule of them that worke, shal be made fatte.
label: Proverbs

text: The iuſt shal deteſt a lying word: but the impious confoundeth, and shal be confounded.
label: Proverbs

text: Iuſtice kepeth the way of the innocent: but impietie ſupplanteth the ſinner.
label: Proverbs

text: There is one as it were with riches wheras he hath nothing: and there is as it were poore, wheras he is in much riches.
label: Proverbs

text: The redemption of a mans life, his riches: but he that is poore, beareth not reprehenſion.
label: Proverbs

text: The light of the iuſt maketh glad: but the candle of the impious shal be extinguished.
label: Proverbs

text: Among the prowde there are alwayes brawles: but they that doe al thinges with counſel, are ruled by wiſdom.
label: Proverbs

text: Subſtance haſtened shal be diminished: but that which by litle and litle is gathered with the hand, shal be multiplied.
label: Proverbs

text: Hope that is differred afflicteth the ſoule: a tree of life the deſire of coming.
label: Proverbs

text: Who ſo detracteth from any thing, he byndeth himſelfe for the time to come: but he that feareth the precept, shal conuers in peace. Guilful ſoules erre in ſinnes: the iuſt are merciful & haue pitie.
label: Proverbs

text: The law of a wiſe man a fountaine of life, that he may decline from the ruine of death.
label: Proverbs

text: Good doctrine shal geue grace: in the way of contemners a whirlepoole.
label: Proverbs

text: The ſubtel man doth al thinges with counſel: but he that is a foole openeth folie.
label: Proverbs

text: The meſſenger of the impious shal fal into euil: but a faithful legate, is health.
label: Proverbs

text: Pouertie, and ignominie, to him that forſaketh diſcipline: but he that yeldeth to him that rebuketh, shal be glorified.
label: Proverbs

text: Deſire if it be accomplished, delighteth the ſoule: fooles deteſt them that flee euil thinges.
label: Proverbs

text: He that walketh with the wiſe, shal be wiſe: a freind of fooles shal be made like.
label: Proverbs

text: Euil purſeweth ſinners, and to the iuſt good thinges shal be repayed.
label: Proverbs

text: The good man leaueth heyres, ſonnes and nephewes: and the ſubſtance of the ſinner is kept for the iuſt.
label: Proverbs

text: Much meate in the tilled growndes of the fathers: and to others they are gathered without iudgement.
label: Proverbs

text: He that ſpareth the rod, hateth his childe: but he that loueth him doth inſtantly nurture him.
label: Proverbs

text: The iuſt eateth and filleth his ſoule: but the bellie of the impious vnſatiable.
label: Proverbs

text: A wiſe woman buildeth her houſe: the vnwiſe wil with her handes deſtroy that alſo which is built.
label: Proverbs

text: He that walketh in the right way, & feareth God is deſpiſed of him, that goeth an infamous way.
label: Proverbs

text: In the mouth of a foole the rod of pride: but the lippes of the wiſe keepe them.
label: Proverbs

text: Where oxen are not, the ſtal is emptie: but where much corne is, there is the oxes ſtrength manifeſt.
label: Proverbs

text: A faithful witneſſe wil not lie: but a deceitful witneſſe vttereth a lie.
label: Proverbs

text: A ſcorner ſeeketh wiſdom and findeth it not: the doctrine of the prudent is eaſie.
label: Proverbs

text: Goe againſt a foolish man, and he knoweth not the lippes of prudence.
label: Proverbs

text: The wiſdom of a diſcrete man is to vnderſtand his way: and the imprudence of fooles erreth.
label: Proverbs

text: A foole wil laugh at ſinne, & among the iuſt grace shal abide.
label: Proverbs

text: The hart that knoweth the bitternes of his ſoule, in his ioy shal not the ſtranger be mingled.
label: Proverbs

text: The houſe of the impious shal be raſed: the tabernacles of the iuſt shal ſpring.
label: Proverbs

text: There is a way, which ſeemeth to a man iuſt: but the later endes therof lead to death.
label: Proverbs

text: Laughter shal be mingled with ſorow, and mourning occupieth the later endes of ioy.
label: Proverbs

text: A foole shal be replenished with his wayes, and the good man shal be aboue him.
label: Proverbs

text: The innocent beleueth euerie word: the diſcrete man conſidereth his ſteppes.
label: Proverbs

text: A wiſe man feareth and declineth from euil: the foole leapeth ouer and is confident.
label: Proverbs

text: The impatient man shal worke folie: and the ſubtel man is odious.
label: Proverbs

text: The childish man shal poſſeſſe folie, and the prudent shal expect knowlege.
label: Proverbs

text: The euil shal lie downe before the good, and the impious before the gates of the iuſt.
label: Proverbs

text: The poore shal be odious euen to his neighbour: but the freindes of the rich be manie.
label: Proverbs

text: He that deſpiſeth his neighbour, ſinneth: but he that hath pitie on the poore, shal be bleſſed.
label: Proverbs

text: They erre that worke euil: mercie and truth prepare good thinges.
label: Proverbs

text: In euerie worke there shal be abundance: but where manie wordes are, there is oftentimes pouertie.
label: Proverbs

text: The crowne of the wiſe, their riches: the follie of fooles, inprudence.
label: Proverbs

text: A faithful witnes deliuereth ſoules: and the diſſembler vttereth lyes.
label: Proverbs

text: In the feare of our Lord is confidence of ſtrength, and to his children there shal be hope.
label: Proverbs

text: The feare of our Lord a fountaine of life, that he may decline from the ruine of death.
label: Proverbs

text: In the multitude of people the dignitie of the king: and in fewnes of people the ignominie of the prince.
label: Proverbs

text: He that is patient, is gouerned with much wiſdom: but he that is impatient, exalteth his follie.
label: Proverbs

text: Health of hart, the life of the flesh: enuie, the putrefaction of the bones.
label: Proverbs

text: He that doth calumniate the needie, vpbraideth his maker: but he honoreth him, that hath pitie on the poore.
label: Proverbs

text: The impious shal be expelled in his malice: but the iuſt hopeth in his death.
label: Proverbs

text: In the hart of the prudent reſteth wiſdom, & it shal inſtruct al the vnlerned.
label: Proverbs

text: Iuſtice aduanceth a nation: but ſinne maketh peoples miſerable.
label: Proverbs

text: A ſeruant that vnderſtandeth is acceptable to the king: he that is vnprofitable shal ſuſteyne his anger.
label: Proverbs

text: A ſoft anſwer breaketh anger: and a hard word rayſeth vp furie.
label: Proverbs

text: The tongue of the wiſe adorneth knowlege: the mouth of fooles boyleth forth follie.
label: Proverbs

text: In euerie place the eies of our Lord behold the good and the euil.
label: Proverbs

text: A peaceable tongue is a tree of life: but that which is immoderate, shal breake the ſpirite.
label: Proverbs

text: A foole ſcorneth the diſcipline of his father: but he that regardeth reprehenſions, shal become more prudent. In abundant iuſtice there is greateſt force: but the cogitations of the impious shal be rooted out.
label: Proverbs

text: The houſe of the iuſt is very much ſtrength: and in the fruites of the impious is perturbation.
label: Proverbs

text: The lippes of the wiſe shal ſow knowlege: the hart of fooles shal be vnlike.
label: Proverbs

text: The victimes of the impious are abominable to our Lord: the vowes of the iuſt are acceptable.
label: Proverbs

text: The way of the impious is abomination to our Lord: he that foloweth iuſtice is beloued of him.
label: Proverbs

text: The doctrine is euil of them that forſake the way of life: he that hateth reprehenſions shal dye.
label: Proverbs

text: Hel, and perdition are before our Lord: how much more the hartes of the children of men?
label: Proverbs

text: The peſtilent man loueth not him, that rebuketh him: nor goeth to the wiſe.
label: Proverbs

text: A glad hart cheereth the face: in pensifnes of minde the ſpirit is caſt downe.
label: Proverbs

text: The hart of the wiſe ſeeketh doctrine: and the mouth of fooles is fed with vnskilfulnes.
label: Proverbs

text: Al the dayes of the poore are euil: a ſecure minde is as it were a continual feaſt.
label: Proverbs

text: Better is a litle with the feare of our Lord, then great treaſures and vnſatiable.
label: Proverbs

text: It is better to be called to herbes with charitie: then to a fatted calfe with hatred.
label: Proverbs

text: An angrie man ſtirreth brawles: he that is patient appeaſeth thoſe that are raiſed.
label: Proverbs

text: The way of the ſlothful is as an hedge of thornes: the way of the iuſt is without offence.
label: Proverbs

text: A wiſe ſonne maketh the father ioyful: and the foolish man deſpiſeth his mother.
label: Proverbs

text: Follie is ioy to a foole: and the wiſeman directeth his ſteppes.
label: Proverbs

text: Cogitations are diſſipated where there is no counſel: but where manie counſellers are, they are confirmed.
label: Proverbs

text: A man reioyceth in the ſentence of his mouth: and a word in due time is beſt.
label: Proverbs

text: The path of life aboue the lerned, that he may decline from the laweſt hel.
label: Proverbs

text: Our Lord wil deſtroy the houſe of the proude: and wil make ſure the borders of the widow.
label: Proverbs

text: Euil cogitations are an abomination to our Lord: and pure ſpeach moſt beautiful shal be confirmed of him.
label: Proverbs

text: He that purſueth auarice diſturbeth his houſe: but he that hateth giftes shal liue. By mercie and faith ſinnes are purged: and by the feare of our Lord euerie one declineth from euil.
label: Proverbs

text: The minde of the iuſt meditateth obedience: the mouth of the impious redoundeth with euils.
label: Proverbs

text: Our Lord is far from the impious: and he wil heare the prayers of the iuſt.
label: Proverbs

text: The light of the eies reioyceth the ſoule: a good name fatteth the bones.
label: Proverbs

text: The eare that heareth the reprehenſions of life, shal abide in the middes of the wiſe.
label: Proverbs

text: He that reiecteth diſcipline, deſpiſeth his ſoule: but he that yeldeth to reprehenſions, is a poſſeſſour of the hart.
label: Proverbs

text: The feare of our Lord, the diſcipline of wiſdom: and humilitie goeth before glorie.
label: Proverbs

text: IT perteyneth to man to prepare the hart: and to our Lord to gouerne the tongue.
label: Proverbs

text: Al the wayes of man are open to his eies: our Lord is the weigher of ſpirites.
label: Proverbs

text: Reueale thy workes to our Lord: and thy cogitations shal be directed.
label: Proverbs

text: Our Lord hath wrought al thinges for himſelf: the impious alſo to the euil day.
label: Proverbs

text: Euerie arrogant man is an abomination to our Lord: although hand shal be to hand he is not innocent. The beginning of a good way, is to doe iuſtice: and it is more acceptable with God, then to immolate hoſtes.
label: Proverbs

text: By mercie and truth iniquitie is redemed: and in the feare of our Lord euil is auoided.
label: Proverbs

text: When the wayes of man shal pleaſe our Lord, he wil conuert alſo his enemies to peace.
label: Proverbs

text: Better is a litle with iuſtice, then much fruite with iniquitie.
label: Proverbs

text: The hart of man diſpoſeth his way: but it perteyneth to our Lord to direct his progreſſe.
label: Proverbs

text: Diuination is in the lippes of the king, his mouth shal not erre in iudgement.
label: Proverbs

text: Weight and balance are iudgements of our Lord: and his worke al the ſtones of the bagge.
label: Proverbs

text: In the multiplication of iuſt men, the common people shal reioyce: when the impious shal take princedom, the people shal mourne.
label: Proverbs

text: A man that loueth wiſedom, maketh his father glad: but he that maintaineth harlots, shal deſtroy his ſubſtance.
label: Proverbs

text: A iuſt king ſetteth vp the land, a couetous man shal deſtroy it.
label: Proverbs

text: A man, that with fayre, and fayned wordes ſpeaketh to his frend, ſpreadeth a nette to his ſteppes.
label: Proverbs

text: A ſnare shal intangle the wicked man ſinning: and the iuſt shal praiſe and reioyce.
label: Proverbs

text: The iuſt knoweth the cauſe of the poore: the impious is ignorant of knowlege.
label: Proverbs

text: Peſtilent men diſſipate a citie: but the wiſe turne away furie.
label: Proverbs

text: A wiſe man, if he contend with a foole, whether he be angrie, or whether he laugh, shal not finde reſt.
label: Proverbs

text: Men of bloud hate the ſimple: but iuſt men ſeeke his ſoule.
label: Proverbs

text: A foole vttereth al his ſpirit: a wiſeman differreth, and reſerueth til afterward.
label: Proverbs

text: A prince that gladly heareth wordes of lying, hath al his ſeruants impious.
label: Proverbs

text: The pooreman and the creditour haue mette one an other: our Lord is illuminatour of both.
label: Proverbs

text: The king, that iudgeth the poore in truth, his throne shal be replenished for euer.
label: Proverbs

text: Rod and rebuke geueth wiſedom: but the childe, that is left to his owne wil, confoundeth his mother.
label: Proverbs

text: In the multiplication of the impious, wickednes shal be multiplied, and the iuſt shal ſee the ruines of them.
label: Proverbs

text: Nurter thy ſonne, and he shal refresh thee, and shal geue delightes to thy ſoule.
label: Proverbs

text: When prophecie shal fayle, the people shal be diſſipated: but he that keepeth the Law, is bleſſed.
label: Proverbs

text: A ſeruant can not be taught by wordes: becauſe he vnderſtandeth that which thou ſayſt, and contemneth to anſwer.
label: Proverbs

text: Haſt thou ſeene a man ſwifte to ſpeake? follie is rather to be hoped, then his amendement.
label: Proverbs

text: He that nourisheth his ſeruant delicatly from his childhood, afterward shal feele him ſtubburne.
label: Proverbs

text: An angrie man prouoketh brawles: and he that is eaſie to indignation, shal be more prone to ſinne.
label: Proverbs

text: Humiliation foloweth the proude: and glorie shal receiue the humble of ſpirite.
label: Proverbs

text: He that is partaker with a theefe, hateth his owne ſoule: he heareth one adiuring, and telleth not.
label: Proverbs

text: He that feareth man, shal ſoone fal: he that truſteth in our Lord shal be lifted vp.
label: Proverbs

text: Manie ſeeke after the face of the prince: & the iudgement of euerie one commeth forth from our Lord.
label: Proverbs

text: The iuſt abhorre an impious man: & the impious abhorre them that are in the right way. The ſonne that keepeth the word, shal be out of perdition.
label: Proverbs

text: THE wordes of the Gatherer the ſonne of Vomiter. The viſion, that the man ſpake, with whom God is, and who being ſtrengthened by God abiding with him, ſayd:
label: Proverbs

text: I am moſt foolish of men, & the wiſedom of men is not with me.
label: Proverbs

text: I haue not learned wiſedom, and haue not knowen the ſcience of ſaints.
label: Proverbs

text: Who hath aſcended into heauen and deſcended? who hath conteyned the ſpirit in his handes? who hath bound the waters together as in a garment? who hath rayſed vp al the borders of the earth? what is his name, and what is the name of his ſonne, if thou know?
label: Proverbs

text: Euerie word of God tryed by fyre, is a buckler to them that hope in him:
label: Proverbs

text: Adde not any thing to his wordes, and ſo thou be reproued and found a lyer:
label: Proverbs

text: Two thinges I haue asked thee, denie them not to me before I dye.
label: Proverbs

text: Vanitie, and lying wordes make far from me. Beggerie, and riches geue me not: geue only things neceſſarie for my ſuſtenance:
label: Proverbs

text: leſt perhaps being filled I be allured to denie, and may ſay: Who is the Lord? or being compelled by pouertie I may ſteale, and forſweare the name of my God.
label: Proverbs

text: Accuſe not a ſeruant to his maſter, leſt perhaps he curſe thee, and thou fal.
label: Proverbs

text: There is a generation that curſeth their father, and that bleſſeth not their mother.
label: Proverbs

text: A generation, that ſemeth to it ſelf cleane, & yet is not washed from their filthines.
label: Proverbs

text: A generation, whoſe eies are loftie, and the eielids therof ſet vp on high.
label: Proverbs

text: A generation, that for teeth hath ſwordes, and chaweth with theyr grinding teeth, that they may eate the needie out of the earth, and the poore from among men.
label: Proverbs

text: The horseleach hath two daughters that ſay: Bring, bring. Three things are vnſatiable, the fourth neuer ſayth it ſufficeth.
label: Proverbs

text: Hel, and the mouth of the matrice, & the earth which is not ſatisfied with water: but the fyre neuer ſayth it ſufficeth.
label: Proverbs

text: The eie, that ſcorneth his father, & that deſpiſeth the trauail of his mother, in bearing him, let the rauens of the torrents pick it out, and the young of the eagle eate it.
label: Proverbs

text: Three thinges are hard to me, and of the fourth I am vtterly ignorant.
label: Proverbs

text: The way of an eagle in the ayre, the way of a ſerpent vpon a rocke, the way of a shippe in the middes of the ſea, and the way of a man in youth.
label: Proverbs

text: Such is alſo the way of an adulterous woman, which eateth, and wyping her mouth ſayth: I haue done no euil.
label: Proverbs

text: By three thinges the earth is moued, and the fourth it can not ſuſteyne.
label: Proverbs

text: By a ſeruant when he shal reigne: by a foole when he shal be filled with meate:
label: Proverbs

text: by an odious woman when she shal be taken in matrimonie: & by a bondwoman when she shal be heyre to her miſtreſſe.
label: Proverbs

text: There are foure the leaſt thinges of the earth, and they are wiſer then the wiſe.
label: Proverbs

text: The antes, a weake people, which prepareth in the harueſt meate for themſelues:
label: Proverbs

text: The leueret, a people not ſtrong, which placeth his bed in the rocke:
label: Proverbs

text: The locuſt hath no king, and they go out al by their troopes:
label: Proverbs

text: The ſtellion ſtayeth on his handes, & tarieth in kings houſes.
label: Proverbs

text: There are three thinges which go wel, and the fourth that goeth happely.
label: Proverbs

text: The lyon, the ſtrongeſt of beaſtes shal feare at the meeting of none:
label: Proverbs

text: the cocke gyrded about the loines, and the ramme: alſo the king, againſt whom none can reſiſt.
label: Proverbs

text: There is that hath appeared a foole after that he was lifted vp on high: for if he had vnderſtood, he would haue layd his hand vpon his mouth.
label: Proverbs

text: And he that ſtrongly preſſeth the pappes to wring out milke, ſtrayneth out butter, and he that violently cleanceth his noſe, wringeth out bloud: & he that prouoketh angers, bringeth forth diſcordes.
label: Proverbs

text: THE wordes of Lamuel the king. The viſion wherwith his mother inſtructed him.
label: Proverbs

text: What ô my beloued, what ô the beloued of my wombe, what ô beloued of my vowes?
label: Proverbs

text: Geue not thy ſubſtance to wemen, & thy riches to deſtroy kinges.
label: Proverbs

text: Geue not to kinges, ô Lamuel, geue not wine to kinges: becauſe there is no ſecrete where drunknes reigneth,
label: Proverbs

text: & leſt perhaps they drinke, & forget iudgements, & change the cauſe of the children of the poore.
label: Proverbs

text: Geue ſtrong drinke to them that be ſad, and wine vnto them, that are of a penſiue minde:
label: Proverbs

text: let them drinke, and forget their pouertie, and not remember their ſorow any more.
label: Proverbs

text: Open thy mouth to the dumme, & to the cauſe of al the children that paſſe:
label: Proverbs

text: open thy mouth, decree that which is iuſt, & iudge the needie & poore.
label: Proverbs

text: A valiant woman who shal finde? far, and from the vtmoſt borders is the price of her.
label: Proverbs

text: The hart of her husband truſteth in her, and he shal not neede ſpoyles.
label: Proverbs

text: She shal render good, and not euil, al the dayes of her life.
label: Proverbs

text: She hath ſought wool and flaxe, and hath wrought by the counſel of her handes.
label: Proverbs

text: She is become as a marchants shippe, bringing her bread from farre.
label: Proverbs

text: And she hath riſen in the night, and geuen pray to her houshold, and meates to her handmaides.
label: Proverbs

text: She hath vewed a filde, and bought it, of the fruite of her handes she hath planted a vineyard.
label: Proverbs

text: She hath gyrded her loines with ſtrength, and hath ſtrengthened her arme.
label: Proverbs

text: She hath taſted, and ſene that her traficke is good: her lampe shal not be extinguished in the night.
label: Proverbs

text: She hath put her hand to ſtrong thinges, and her fingers haue taken hold of the ſpindle.
label: Proverbs

text: She hath opened her hand to the needie, and ſtretched out her palmes to the poore.
label: Proverbs

text: She shal not feare for her houſe in the coldes of ſnow: for al her houshould are clothed with duble.
label: Proverbs

text: Tapeſtrie clothing she hath made to herſelf: ſilke, and purple is her garment.
label: Proverbs

text: Her husband is noble in the gates, when he shal ſitte with the ſenatours of the land.
label: Proverbs

text: She made ſindon, and ſold it, and deliuered a girdle to the Chananeite.
label: Proverbs

text: Strength and beautie is her garment, and she shal laugh in the later day.
label: Proverbs

text: She hath opened her mouth to wiſedom, and the law of clemencie is in her tongue.
label: Proverbs

text: She hath conſidered the pathes of her houſe, and hath not eaten her bread idle.
label: Proverbs

text: Her children aroſe, and commended her to be moſt bleſſed: her husband, and he prayſed her.
label: Proverbs

text: Manie daughters haue gathered together riches: thou haſt paſſed them al.
label: Proverbs

text: Grace is deceitful, and beautie is vayne: the woman that feareth our Lord shal be prayſed.
label: Proverbs

text: Geue ye to her of the fruite of her handes: and let her workes praiſe her in the gates.
label: Proverbs

text: THE wordes of Eccleſiaſtes, the ſonne of Dauid, king of Ieruſalem.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Vanitie of vanities, ſayd Eccleſiaſtes: vanitie of vanities, & al thinges vanitie.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: What hath a man more of al his labour, wherby he laboreth vnder the ſunne?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Generation paſſeth, and generation cometh: but the earth ſtandeth for euer.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: The ſunne riſeth, and goeth downe, and returneth to his place: and there riſing againe,
label: Ecclesiastes

text: compaſſeth by the South, and bendeth to the North: compaſſing al thinges, goeth forward in circuite, & returneth vnto his circles.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Al riuers enter into the ſea, and the ſea ouerfloweth not: to the place, whence the riuers iſſueforth, they do returne, that they may flow againe.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Al thinges are hard: man can not explicate them in word. The eye is not filled with ſeing, neither is the eare filled with hearing.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: What is that hath bene? the ſame thing that shal be. What is that hath bene done? the ſame that is to be done.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Nothing vnder the ſunne is new, neither is anie man able to ſay: Behold this is new: for it hath already gone before in the ages, that were before vs.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: There is no memorie of former thinges: but neither of thoſe thinges verily, which hereafter are to come, shal there be remenbrance with them, that shal be in the later end.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I Eccleſiaſtes haue bene king of Iſrael in Ieruſalem,
label: Ecclesiastes

text: and haue propoſed in my mind, to ſeke and ſearch wiſely of al thinges, that are done vnder the ſunne. This very euil occupation hath God geuen to the children of men, that they might be occupied in it.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I haue ſene al thinges, that are done vnder the ſunne, and behold al are vanitie, & affliction of ſpirit.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: The peruerſe are hardly corrected, and the number of fooles is infinite.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I haue ſpoken in my hart, ſaying: Loe I haue bene made great, and haue gone beyond al in wiſdom, that were before me in Ieruſalem: and my minde hath contemplated manie thinges wiſely, and I haue lerned.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And I haue geuen my hart to know prudence, and doctrine, and errors and follie: and I haue perceiued that in theſe alſo there was labour, and affliction of ſpirite,
label: Ecclesiastes

text: for that in much wiſdom there is much indignation: and he that addeth knowlege, addeth alſo labour.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I Sayde therfore in my hart: I wil goe, & flow in delightes, and enioy good thinges. And I ſaw that this alſo was vanitie.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Laughter I haue reputed errour: and to ioy I haue ſaide: Why art thou deceiued in vaine?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I haue thought in my hart, to withdraw my flesh from wine, that I might transferre my minde to wiſdom, and might auoid follie, til I might ſee what should be profitable for the children of men: what is nedeful to be done vnder the ſunne, in the number of the dayes of their life.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I haue magnified my workes, I haue built me houſes, & planted vineyards,
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I haue made gardens, and orchards, and ſet them with trees of al kindes,
label: Ecclesiastes

text: and I haue made me ponds of waters, to watter the wood of ſpringing trees,
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I haue poſſeſſed menſeruants and wemenſeruants, and haue had a great familie: heardes alſo, and great flockes of shepe, aboue al that were before me in Ieruſalem:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I haue heaped together to myſelf ſiluer, and gold, and the ſubſtance of kinges, and prouinces: I made me ſingingmen, & ſingingwemen, and the delightes of the children of men: cuppes, and goblets to ſerue to powre out wines:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: and I ſurpaſſed in riches al, that were before me in Ieruſalem: wiſdom alſo hath perſeuered with me.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And al thinges, that myne eies deſired, I haue not denied to them: neither haue I ſtayed my hart, but that it enioyed al pleaſure, & delighted itſelf in theſe thinges, which I had prepared: and this I eſteemed my portion, if I did vſe my labour.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And when I had turned myſelf to al the workes, which my handes had done, & to the laboures, wherin I had ſwette in vaine, I ſaw in al thinges vanitie, and affliction of minde, & nothing to be permanent vnder the ſunne.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I paſſed further to contemplate wiſdom, and errors, and follie (what is man, quoth I, that he can folow the king his Maker?)
label: Ecclesiastes

text: and I ſaw that wiſdom ſo much excelled follie, as light differeth from darknes.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: The eyes of a wiſeman are in his head: the foole walketh in darknes: and I haue lerned that there was one death of both.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And I ſayd in my hart: If the fal of the foole & myne shal be one, what doth it profite me, that I haue beſtowed greater labour for wiſdom? And ſpeaking with my minde, I perceiued that this alſo was vanitie.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: For there shal be no memorie of the wiſe in like maner as of the foole for euer, and the times to come shal couer al thinges together with obliuion: the lerned dieth in like maner as the vnlerned.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And therfore I haue bene wearie of my life, ſeing al thinges vnder the ſunne to be euil, and al thinges vanitie and affliction of ſpirite.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Againe I deteſted al myne induſtrie, wherwith I haue laboured vnder the ſunne moſt ſtudiouſly, being like to haue an heyre after me:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: whom I know not, whether he wil be a wiſeman or a foole, and he shal rule in my labours, wherewith I haue ſwette and haue bene careful: and is there anie thing ſo vaine?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Wherfore I ceaſed, and my hart hath renounced to labour anie more vnder the ſunne.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: For whereas one laboreth in wiſdom, and doctrine, and carefulnes, he leaueth the thinges gotten to an idleman: and this therfore is vanitie, and great euil.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: For what profite shal be to a man of al his labour, and affliction of ſpirite, wherwith he is vexed vnder the ſunne?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Al his daies are ful of ſorowes and miſeries, neither by night doth he reſt in minde, and is not this vanitie?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Is it not better to eate and drinke, and shew vnto his ſoule good thinges of his laboures? & this is of the hand of God.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Who shal ſo deuour, and flow with delightes as I?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: To a man good in his ſight, God hath geuen wiſdom, and knowlege, and ioy: but to the ſinner he hath geuen affliction, and ſuperfluous care, to adde, and to gather together, and deliuer it to him that hath pleaſed God: but this alſo is vanitie, & vaine carefulnes of the minde.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: AL thinges haue a time, and in their ſpaces al thinges paſſe vnder heauen.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: A time to be borne, & a time to dye. A time to plant, & a time to pluck vp that which was planted.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: A time to kil, and a time to heale. A time to deſtroy, and a time to builde.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: A time to wepe, & a time to laugh. A time to mourne, and a time to dance.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: A time to diſperſe ſtones, and a time to gather. A time to embrace, and a time to be farre from embracings.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: A time to gette, and a time to loſe. A time to kepe, and a time to caſt away.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: A time to rent, and a time to ſow together. A time to kepe ſilence, & a time to ſpeake.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: A time of loue, and a time of hatred. A time of warre, and a time of peace.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: What hath man more of his labour?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I haue ſene the affliction, which God hath geuen to the children of men, that they may be diſtracted in it.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: He hath made al thinges good in their time, and hath deliuered the world to their diſputation, and that man can not finde the worke, which God hath wrought from the beginning vnto the end.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And I haue knowne that there was no better thing then to reioyce, and to do wel in his life.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: For euerie man, that eateth and drinketh, and ſeeth good of his labour, this is the gift of God.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I haue lerned that al the workes, which God hath made, perſeuere for euer: we can not adde anie thing, nor take away from thoſe thinges, which God hath made that he may be feared.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: That which hath bene made, the ſame is permanent: the thinges that shal be, haue already bene: and God reſtoreth that which is paſt.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I ſaw vnder the ſunne in the place of iudgement impietie, and in the place of iuſtice iniquitie.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And I ſayde in my hart: the iuſt and the impious God wil iudge, and then shal be the time of euerie thing.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I ſayd in my hart of the children of men, that God would proue them, and shew them to be like beaſtes.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Therfore there is one death of man, and beaſtes, and the condition of both equal: as man dieth, ſo they alſo dye: al thinges breath alike, and man hath nothing more then beaſt: al thinges are ſubiect to vanitie,
label: Ecclesiastes

text: and al thinges paſſe to one place: of earth they were made, and into earth they returne together.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Who knoweth if the ſpirit of the children of Adam aſcend vpward, and if the ſpirite of beaſtes deſcend downward?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And I haue found that nothing is better then for a man to reioyce in his worke, and that this is his portion. For who shal bring him, to know the thinges that shal be after him?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I Turned my ſelf to other thinges, and I ſaw the oppreſſions, that are done vnder the ſunne, and the teares of the innocents, and no comforter: & that they can not reſiſt their violence, being deſtitute of al mens helpe.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And I praiſed rather the dead, then the liuing:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: and happier then both haue I iudged him, that is not yet borne, nor hath ſene the euils that are done vnder the ſunne.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Againe I haue contemplated al the labours of men, and their induſtries I haue perceiued to lie open to the enuie of their neighbour: and in this therfore there is vanitie, and ſuperfluous care.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: A foole foldeth his handes together, and eateth his owne flesh, ſaying:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Better is an handful with reſt, then both handes ful with labour, and affliction of mind.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Conſidering I found alſo an other vanitie vnder the ſunne:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: There is one, and he hath not a ſecond, not a ſonne, not a brother, and yet he ceaſeth not to labour, neither are his eyes ſatisfied with riches, neither doth he recount, ſaying: For whom do I labour, and defraud my ſoule of good thinges? in this alſo is vanitie, and very il affliction.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: It is better therfore that two be together, then one: for they haue profite of their ſocietie:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: if one fal, he shal be ſtayed vp of the other. Woe to him that is alone: becauſe when he falleth, he hath none to lift him vp.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And if two ſleepe together, they shal warme eche other: one how shal he be warmed?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And if a man preuaile againſt one, two reſiſt him: a triple coard is hardly broken.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Better is a child that is poore and wiſe, then a king old and foolish, that knoweth not to foreſee for hereafter
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Becauſe out of the priſon, and cheynes ſometime there cometh one forth to a kingdom: and an other borne in his kingdom, is conſumed with pouertie.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I ſaw al men aliue, that walke vnder the ſunne, with the ſecond yongman, which shal riſe vp for him.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: The number of the people, of al that haue bene before him is infinite: and they that shal be afterward, shal not reioyce in him. But this alſo is vanitie, and affliction of ſpirite.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Take heede to kepe thy foote, when thou entreſt into the houſe of God, and approch thou to heare.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: For much better is obedience, then the victimes of fooles, who know not what euil they doe.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: SPEAKE not anie thing rashly, neither let thy hart be ſwift to vtter a word before God. For God is in heauen, and thou vpon the earth: therfore let thy wordes be few.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Dreames do folow manie cares, and in manie wordes follie wil be found.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: If thou haſt vowed anie thing to God, differre not to pay it: for an vnfaithful and foolish promiſe diſpleaſeth him. But what ſoeuer thou haſt vowed, pay it:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: and it is much better not to vow, then after a vow not to performe the thinges promiſed.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Geue not thy mouth to make thy flesh to ſinne: neither ſay thou before the Angel: There is no prouidence: leſt perhaps God being wrath againſt thy wordes, diſſipate al the workes of thy handes.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Where manie dreames are, there are manie vanities, and wordes innumerable: but do thou feare God.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: If thou shalt ſee the oppreſſions of the poore, and violent iudgements, and iuſtice to be ſubuerted in the prouince, meruel not at this matter: becauſe there is an other higher then the high, and ouer theſe alſo there are others more eminent:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: and beſides the king of al the earth reigneth ouer his ſeruant.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: A couetous man shal not be filled with money: and he that loueth riches, shal take no fruite of them: and this therfore is vanitie.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Where great riches are, there are alſo manie that eate them. And what doth it profite the owner, but that he ſeeth the riches with his eyes?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Sleepe is ſwete to him that worketh, whether he eate much or litle: but the ſatietie of the rich doth not ſuffer him to ſleepe.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: There is alſo an other very il infirmitie, which I haue ſene vnder the ſunne: riches kept to the hurt of the owner.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: For they perish in very euil affliction: he hath begotten a ſonne, which shal be in great pouertie.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: As he came forth naked from his mothers wombe, ſo shal he returne, and shal take nothing away with him of his labour.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: An infirmitie vtterly miſerable: as he came, ſo shal he returne. What doth it then profite him, that he hath labored into the winde?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Al the dayes of his life he eateth in darknes, and in miſerie, and in heauines.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: This therfore hath ſemed good to me, that a man eate, and drinke, and take ioy of his labour, wherwith he hath labored vnder the ſunne, the number of the dayes of his life, which God hath geuen him, and this is his portion.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And to euerie man, vnto whom God hath geuen riches, and ſubſtance, and hath geuen him powre to eate of them, and to enioy his portion, and to reioyce of his labour: this is the gift of God.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: For he shal not greatly remember the dayes of his life, becauſe God doth occupie his hart with delightes.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: THERE is alſo an other euil, which I haue ſene vnder the ſunne, and that frequent with men:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: A man to whom God hath geuen riches, and ſubſtance, and honour, and nothing is lacking to his ſoule of al thinges, which he deſireth: neither doth God geue him powre to eate therof: but a ſtrange man shal eate it vp. This is vanitie and great miſerie.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: If a man shal begette an hundred children, and shal liue manie yeares, and haue manie dayes of age, and his ſoule vſe not the goods of his ſubſtance, and he lacke burial: of this man I pronounce, that the vntimely borne is better then he.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: For he came in vaine, and paſſeth to darknes, and his name shal be cleane forgotten.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: He hath not ſene the ſunne, nor knowen the diſtance of good and euil:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: although he liued two thouſand yeares, and hath not enioyed good thinges: do not al thinges haſten to one place?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Al the labour of man is in his mouth: but his ſoule shal not be filled.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: What hath the wiſeman more then the foole? and what the poore man, but to paſſe thither, where life is?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Better it is to ſee that, which thou maiſt couete, then to deſire that, which thou canſt not know. But this alſo is vanitie, and preſumption of ſpirite.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: He that shal be, his name is already called: and it is knowne, that he is a man, and can not contend in iudgement againſt a ſtronger then himſelf.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: There be manie wordes, that haue much vanitie in diſputing.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: VVHAT nedeth a man to ſeke thinges greater then himſelf, wheras he is ignorant, what is profitable for him in his life, in the number of the dayes of his peregrination, and the time that paſſeth as a shadow? Or who can tel him what shal be after him vnder the ſunne?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Better is a good name then precious ointments: and the day of death, then the day of natiuitie.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: It is better to goe to the houſe of mourning, then to the houſe of banketing: for in that the end of al men is ſignified, and he that liueth thinketh what shal be.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Anger is better then laughter: becauſe by ſadnes of the countenance, the mind of the offender is corrected.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: The hart of wiſemen where ſadnes is, and the hart of fooles where mirth.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: It is better to be rebuked of a wiſeman, then to be deceiued with the flaterie of fooles.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Becauſe as the ſound of thornes burning vnder a potte, ſo the laughter of a foole: but this alſo is vanitie.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Oppreſſion trubleth the wiſe, and shal deſtroy the ſtreingth of his hart.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Better is the end of a ſpeach, then the beginning. Better is the patient man then the arrogant.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Be not quickly angrie, becauſe anger reſteth in the boſom of a foole.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Say not: What is the cauſe thinkeſt thou that the former times were better then they are now? for this maner of queſtion is foolish.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Wiſdom with riches is more profitable, and doth more profite them that ſee the ſunne.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: For as wiſdom protecteth, ſo money protecteth. But lerning and wiſdom haue this much more, that they geue life to their owner.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Conſider the workes of God, that no man can correct whom he hath deſpiſed.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: In the good day enioy good thinges, and beware before of the euil day. For as this, ſo that alſo hath God made, that man finde not againſt him iuſt complants.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Theſe thinges alſo I ſaw in the dayes of my vanitie: The iuſt man perisheth in his iuſtice, and the impious liueth a long time in his malice.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Be not iuſt too much: neither be more wiſe, then is neceſſarie, leſt thou become more dul.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Doe not impiouſly much: and be not foolish, leſt thou dye not in thy time.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: It is good that thou hold vp the iuſt; yea and from him withdraw not thy hand: becauſe he that feareth God, neglecteth nothing.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Wiſdom hath ſtreingthned the wiſe aboue tenne princes of the citie.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: For there is no iuſt man in the earth, that doth good, and ſinneth not.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: But to al wordes alſo, that are ſpoken, do not applie thy hart: leſt perhaps thou heare thy ſeruant curſing thee.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: For thy conſcience knoweth, that thou alſo haſt curſed others.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I haue proued al thinges in wiſdom. I haue ſayd: I wil become wiſe, & it departed farder from me
label: Ecclesiastes

text: much more then it was: and a depe profunditie, who shal finde it?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I haue vewed al thinges with my minde, that I might know, and conſider, and might ſeke wiſdom, and reaſon: and that I might know the impietie of the foole, and the errour of the imprudent:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: and I haue found that a woman is more bitter then death, who is the ſnare of hunters, and her hart a nette, her handes are bandes. He that pleaſeth God, wil auoide her: but he that is a ſinner, wil be caught of her.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Loe this haue I found, ſayd Eccleſiaſtes, one thing and an other, that I might finde reaſon,
label: Ecclesiastes

text: which yet my ſoule ſeketh, and I haue not found it. A man of a thouſand I haue found one, a woman of al I haue not found.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Only this I haue found, that God made man right, and he hath intangled himſelf with infinite queſtions. Who is ſuch a one as the wiſe? and who hath knowne the reſolution of the word.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: THE wiſdom of a man shineth in his countenance, and the moſt mightie wil change his face,
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I obſerue the mouth of the king, and the precepts of the oath of God.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Haſten not to depart from his face, nor continew thou in an euil worke: becauſe al that he pleaſeth, he wil doe,
label: Ecclesiastes

text: and his word is ful of powre: neither can anie man ſay to him. Why doſt thou ſo?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: He that kepeth the precept, shal finde no euil. The hart of a wiſeman vnderſtandeth time and anſwer.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: There is a time for al buſines, and opportunitie, and much affliction of man:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: becauſe he is ignorant of thinges paſt, and thinges to come he can know by no meſſenger.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: It is not in mans powre to prohibite the ſpirite, neither hath he powre in the day of death, neither is he ſuffered to reſt when warre is at hand, neither shal impietie ſaue the impious.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Al theſe thinges I haue conſidered, and gaue my hart on al the workes, that are done vnder the ſunne. Sometime man ruleth ouer man to his owne hurt.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I ſaw the impious buried: who alſo when they yet liued, were in holie place, and were praiſed in the citie as men of iuſt workes. But this alſo is vanitie.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Becauſe ſentence is not ſpeedely pronounced againſt the euil, the children of men committe euils without anie feare.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: But yet a ſinner by this that he doth euil an hundred times, & by patience is borne withal, I know that it shal be good to them that feare God, which dread his face.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Let there be no good to the impious, neither let his dayes be prolonged, but as a shadow let them paſſe, that feare not the face of our Lord.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: There is alſo an other vanitie, which is done vpon the earth. There are iuſt men, to whom euils happen, as though they had done the workes of the impious: and there are impious men, which are ſo ſecure, as though they had the dedes of the iuſt. But this alſo I iudge moſt vaine.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I therfore haue praiſed mirth that there was no good thing for a man vnder the ſunne, but that he should eate, and drinke, and be glad: and this only he should take away with him of his labour in the dayes of his life, which God hath geuen him vnder the ſunne.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And I haue ſet my hart to know wiſdom, and to vnderſtand the diſtraction that is in the earth: There is a man that dayes and nightes taketh no ſlepe with his eyes.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And I vnderſtood that man can finde no reaſon of al thoſe workes of God, that are done vnder the ſunne: and the more he shal labour to ſeke, ſo much the leſſe he can finde: yea if the wiſman shal ſay, that he knoweth, he is not able to finde it.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: AL theſe thinges haue I diſcourſed in my hart, that I might curiouſly vnderſtand them: there are iuſt men and wiſe, and their workes are in the hand of God: and yet man knoweth not, whether he be worthie of loue, or hatred:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: but al thinges are reſerued vncertaine for the time to come, becauſe al thinges do equally chance to the iuſt and impious, to the good and the euil, to the cleane and vncleane, to him that immoleth victimes, and him that contemneth ſacrifices. As the good ſo alſo is the ſinner: as the periured, ſo he alſo that ſweareth truth.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: This is a very euil thing among al, which are done vnder the ſunne, that the ſame thinges chance to al men. Wherby alſo the hartes of the children of men are filled with malice, and with contempt in their life, and after that they shal be brought downe to hel.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: There is no man that may liue alwayes, and that can haue confidence of this thing: better is a dog liuing then a lion dead.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: For the liuing know that they shal dye, but the dead know nothing more, neither haue they reward anie more: becauſe the memorie of them is forgotten.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Loue alſo, and hatred, and enuies haue perished together, neither haue they part in this world, and in the worke, that is done vnder the ſunne.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Goe therfore and eate thy bread in ioy, & drinke thy wine with gladnes: becauſe thy workes pleaſe God.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: At al time let thy garments be white, and let not oyle fal from of thy head.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Enioy life, with thy wife whom thou loueſt, al the dayes of the life of thy inſtabilitie, which are geuen to thee vnder the ſunne, al the time of thy vanitie: for this is the portion in life, and in thy labour, wherwith thou laboreſt vnder the ſunne.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Whatſoeuer thy hand is able to doe, worke it inſtantly: for neither worke, nor reaſon, nor wiſdom nor knowlege shal be in hel, whither thou doſt haſten.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: I turned me to an other thing, and I ſaw vnder the ſunne, that neither running is of the ſwift, nor warre of the ſtrong, nor bread of the wiſe, nor riches of the lerned, nor grace of the artificers: but time and chance in al.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Man knoweth not his owne end: but as fishes are taken with the hooke, and as birdes are caught with the ſnare: ſo men are taken in the euil time, when it shal ſudenly come vpon them.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: This wiſdom alſo I haue ſene vnder the ſunne, and haue proued it to be very great:
label: Ecclesiastes

text: A litle citie, and few men in it: there came againſt it a great king, and compaſſed it, and builded fortes round about, and the ſiege was perfited.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And there was found in it a man poore and wiſe, and he deliuered the citie by his wiſdom, and no man afterward remembred that pooreman.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: And I ſayd, that wiſdom is better then ſtreingth: how then was the wiſdom of the pooreman contemned, & his wordes were not heard?
label: Ecclesiastes

text: The wordes of the wiſe are heard in ſilence, more then the crie of a prince among fooles.
label: Ecclesiastes

text: Better is wiſdom, then weapons of warre: and he that shal offend in one point, shal loſe manie good thinges.
label: Ecclesiastes
