text: FOR thy iudgements ô Lord are great, & thy wordes inexplicable, for this cauſe the ſoules lacking diſcipline haue erred.
label: Wisdom

text: For whiles the wicked are perſwaded that they can rule ouer the holie nation: fettered with the bands of darknes, and long night, shut vp vnder roofes, they haue lyen fugitiues from the euerlaſting prouidence.
label: Wisdom

text: And whiles they thincke that they lie hid in obſcure ſinnes, they were diſperſed by the darke couert of obliuion, being horribly afrayd and diſturbed with exceding admiration.
label: Wisdom

text: For neither did the denne that conteyned them, keepe them without feare: becauſe the ſound coming downe trubled them, and ſorowful viſions appearing to them, put them in feare.
label: Wisdom

text: And no force certes of the fyre could geue them light, neither could the clere flames of the ſtarres lighten that horrible night.
label: Wisdom

text: But there appeared to them ſoden fyre, ful of feare: and being ſtroken with the feare of that face, which was not ſene, they eſtemed the thinges that were ſene to be worſe:
label: Wisdom

text: and there were added deriſions of the magical art, and contumelious rebuke of the glorie of their wiſdom.
label: Wisdom

text: For they which promiſed that they would expel feares and perturbations from the languishing ſoule, theſe with deriſion languished ful of feare.
label: Wisdom

text: For although none of the monſters diſturbed them: being moued with the paſſing by of beaſts, and hiſſing of ſerpents, they perished trembling: and denying that they ſaw the ayre, which by no meanes any man could avoyde.
label: Wisdom

text: For wheras wickednes is fearful, it geueth teſtimonie of condemnation: for a trubled conſcience doth alwayes preſume cruel thinges.
label: Wisdom

text: For feare is nothing els but a bewraying of the aydes of cogitation.
label: Wisdom

text: And whiles inwardly there is leſſe expectation, the greater doth he count the ignorance of that cauſe which maketh the torment.
label: Wisdom

text: But they that during the night in deede impotent, and coming vpon them from the loweſt and higheſt hel, ſlept the ſame ſleepe,
label: Wisdom

text: were ſometime moleſted with the feare of monſters, ſometime fayled by paſſing away of the ſoule: for ſoden feare and vnlooked for came vpon them.
label: Wisdom

text: Moreouer if any of them had fallen downe, he was kept shut vp in priſon without yron.
label: Wisdom

text: For if one were a husbandman, or if a shepheard, or worker of the labours in the filde were ſodenly taken, he ſuſteyned neceſſitie ineuitable.
label: Wisdom

text: For with one chayne of darkenes they were al tyed together. Whether it were the hiſſing winde, or among the thicke boughes of trees the ſweete ſound of birdes, or the force of water running downward exceedingly,
label: Wisdom

text: or the mightie ſound of rockes tumbled headlong, or the running of playing beaſts, that were not ſene, or the mightie noyſe of roaring beaſtes, or an Echo reſounding from the higheſt mountaynes: they made them ſwoone for feare.
label: Wisdom

text: For al the world was illuminated with a cleare light, & none was hindered in their workes.
label: Wisdom

text: But ouer them onlie was layd an heauie night, the image of darkenes, which was to come vpon them. They therfore were vnto themſelues more heauie then the darknes.
label: Wisdom

text: BVT to thy ſaincts there was very great light, and their voyce in deede they heard, but figure they ſaw not. And becauſe themſelues alſo did not ſuffer by the ſame thinges,
label: Wisdom

text: they magnified thee: and they that before had bene hurt, becauſe they were not hurt, gaue thankes: and that there might be a difference, they asked a gift.
label: Wisdom

text: For the which cauſe they had a burning pillar of fyre for a guide of the vnknowen way, and thou gaueſt them the ſunne without hurt of a good harbour.
label: Wisdom

text: They in deede worthie to lacke light, and to ſuffer the priſon of darkenes, which kept thy children shut vp, by whom the vncorrupt light of the law began to be geuen to the world.
label: Wisdom

text: When they decreed to kil the infantes of the iuſt: and one child being layd forth, and deliuered, thou to the reprouing of them, didſt take away a multitude of children, and deſtroyedſt them together in the mightie water.
label: Wisdom

text: For that night was knowen before of our fathers, that they knowing in deede what othes they had credited, might be of better comfort.
label: Wisdom

text: And by thy people in deede the health of the iuſt, was receiued, but deſtruction by the vniuſt.
label: Wisdom

text: For as thou didſt hurt the aduerſaries: ſo vs alſo thou didſt magnifie, prouoking vs.
label: Wisdom

text: For the iuſt children of the good ſacrificed ſecretly, and diſpoſed the law of iuſtice in concorde: that the iuſt should receiue both good & euil alike, ſinging now the prayſes of the fathers.
label: Wisdom

text: But there ſounded a diſagreing voyce of the enemies, and a lamentable moorning was heard for the bewayled infants.
label: Wisdom

text: And the ſeruant with the maſter was afflicted with like punishment, and a man of the vulgar ſort ſuffered the like thinges to the king.
label: Wisdom

text: Al therfore alike by one name of death had dead ones innumerable. For neitheir did the liuing ſuffice to burie them: becauſe in one moment, that which was the nobler nation of them, was deſtroyed.
label: Wisdom

text: For concerning al thinges being incredulous becauſe of the inchantments, but then firſt when there was deſtruction of the firſt begotten, they promiſed to be the people of God.
label: Wisdom

text: For when quiet ſilence conteyned al thinges, and the night was in the midde way of her courſe,
label: Wisdom

text: thy omnipent word ſalying out of heauen from the royal ſeates, lighted as a ſeuere conquerour vpon the middes of the land of deſtruction,
label: Wisdom

text: a sharpe ſword carying thy vnfeyned commandment, and ſtanding filled al with death, and reached euen to heauen ſtanding on the earth.
label: Wisdom

text: Then incontinent the viſions of naughtie dreames trubled them, and feares vnlooked for came vpon them.
label: Wisdom

text: And one here an other there, caſt forth halfe aliue, shewed for what cauſe of death he died.
label: Wisdom

text: For the viſions, that trubled them, forewarned theſe thinges, that they might not perish as ignorant why they ſuffered euils.
label: Wisdom

text: But then there touched the iuſt alſo a tentation of death, and a diſturbance of the multitude was made in the wildernes: but thy wrath did not long continew.
label: Wisdom

text: For a man without blame haſting to pray for the people, bringing forth the shilde of his miniſterie prayer, and by incenſe alleaging ſupplication, reſiſted the wrath, and made an end of the neceſſitie, shewing that he is thy ſeruant.
label: Wisdom

text: And he ouercame the multitudes, not in ſtrength of bodie, nor with might of armour, but with a word ſubdewed him, that vexed him, rehearſing the oathes of the parents, and the teſtament.
label: Wisdom

text: For when they were now fallen dead by heapes one vpon an other, he ſtood betwen, and cut of the violence, and ſeperated that way which leadeth to the liuing.
label: Wisdom

text: For in the veſture downe to the foote, which he had, was al the world: and the glorious thinges of the fathers were grauen in the foure iewels of ſtones & thy magnificence was written in the diademe of his head.
label: Wisdom

text: And to theſe he that deſtroyed gaue place, & theſe did he feare: for the proofe onlie of wrath was ſufficient.
label: Wisdom

text: BVT vpon the impious euen to the later end there came wrath without mercie. For he foreknew alſo the thinges that should come vnto them:
label: Wisdom

text: becauſe when they had permitted that they should depart, and had ſent them away with great diligence, they repenting purſued them.
label: Wisdom

text: For hauing as yet moorning betwen their hands, and lamenting at the graues of the dead, they tooke to themſelues an other cogitation of follie: and whom by intreating they had caſt forth, them they purſued as fugitiues:
label: Wisdom

text: for worthie neceſſitie brought them to this end: and they loſt the remembrance of thoſe thinges, which had chanced, that punishment might fulfil the thinges that wanted to the torments:
label: Wisdom

text: and that thy people certes might paſſe through meruelouſly, but they might finde a new death.
label: Wisdom

text: For euerie creature according to his kind was fashioned agayne from the begyning, ſeruing thy precepts, that thy children might be kept without hurt.
label: Wisdom

text: For a clowde ouer shadowed their campe, and out of the water which was before, there appeared drie land, and in the redſea a way without impediment, and of the great depth a ſpringing filde:
label: Wisdom

text: through the which al the nation paſſed, which was protected with thy hand, ſeing thy meruelous thinges and wonders.
label: Wisdom

text: For euen as horſes they fed on meate, and as lambes they reioyced, magnifying thee ô Lord, which didſt deliuer them.
label: Wisdom

text: For they were mindful of thoſe thinges, which had bene done in their ſeiourning, how for the nation of beaſts the earth brought forth flies, and for fishes the riuer yelded a multitude of frogges.
label: Wisdom

text: And laſt of al they ſaw a new creature of birdes, when allured by concupiſcence they deſired meates of deliciouſnes.
label: Wisdom

text: For in comfort of their deſire, there came vp to them the quaile from the ſea: and vexations came vpon the ſinners, not without thoſe arguments, which were made before by the force of lightninges: for they ſuffered iuſtly occording to their wickednes.
label: Wisdom

text: For they inſtituted a more deteſtable inhoſpitalitie: ſome certes receiued not the vnknowen ſtrangers, and other ſome brought the good ſtrangers into ſeruitude.
label: Wisdom

text: And not onlie theſe thinges, but in deede there was an other reſpect alſo of them: for they againſt their wil receiued the ſtrangers.
label: Wisdom

text: But they that receiued them with gladnes, did afflict them with moſt cruel ſorowes, that vſed the ſame rightes:
label: Wisdom

text: but they were ſtriken with blindnes: as they in the dores of the iuſt, when they were couered with ſodaine darkenes, euerie man ſought the paſſage of his doore.
label: Wisdom

text: For whiles the elements are turned in themſelues, as in an inſtrument the ſound of the qualitie is changed, and al keepe their ſound: wherfore it may be certainly iudged by the very ſight.
label: Wisdom

text: For the thinges of the fild were turned into thinges of the water: and what ſoeuer were ſwimming thinges paſſed into the land.
label: Wisdom

text: The fyre had force in water aboue his powre, and the water forgot her quenching nature.
label: Wisdom

text: On the contrarie the flames vexed not the flesh of corruptible beaſts walking therewith, neither did they melt that good meate, which was eaſely diſſolued euen as yce. For in al thinges thou didſt magnifie thy people ô Lord, and didſt honour them, and didſt not deſpiſe them, at al time, and in euerie place aſſiſting them.
label: Wisdom

text: AL wiſdom is of our Lord God, & hath bene alwayes with him, & is before al time.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The ſand of the ſea, & the droppes of rayne, & the dayes of the world who hath numbred? The height of heauen, and breadth of the earth, & profunditie of the depth who hath meaſured?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The wiſdom of God that goeth before al thinges who hath ſearched out?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Wiſdom was created before al thinges, & the vnderſtanding of prudence from euerlaſting.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A fountayne of wiſdom the word of God on high, and the entrance therof euerlaſting commandments.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The roote of wiſdom to whom hath it bene reueled, & the ſubtilties therof who hath knowen?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The diſcipline of wiſdom to whom hath it bene reueled, and made manifeſt, and the multiplication of her entrance who hath vnderſtood?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is one moſt high Creatour omnipotent, and mightie King, and to be feared excedingly, ſitting vpon his throne and the God of dominion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He created her in the Holie Ghoſt, and hath ſene, and nummbred, and meaſured her.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he hath powred her out vpon al his workes, and vpon al flesh according to his gift, and hath geuen her to them that feare him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The feare of our Lord is glorie, and gloriation, and ioy, and a crowne of exultation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The feare of our Lord shal delight the hart, and shal geue ioy, gladnes in length of dayes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: With him that feareth our Lord it shal be wel in the later end, and in the day of his death he shal be bleſſed.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The loue of God is honorable wiſdom.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But they to whom she shal appeare in viſion, they loue her in the viſion, and in the agniſing of her great workes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The feare of our Lord, is the begynning of wiſdom, and was created with the faythful in the wombe, and goeth with the elect wemen, and is knowen with the iuſt and faythful.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The feare of our Lord is religioſitie of knowlege.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Religioſitie shal keepe and iuſtifie the hart, shal geue ioy and gladnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: With him that feareth our Lord it shal be wel, and in the dayes of his conſummation he shal be bleſſed.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The fulneſſe of wiſdom is to feare God, and fulneſſe is of the fruites therof.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al her houſe she shal fil with her generations, and the ſtorehouſes with her treaſures.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A crowne of wiſdom, the feare of our Lord, replenishing place, and the fruite of ſaluation:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he hath ſene, and numbred her: but both are the giftes of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Wiſdom shal diſtribute knowlege, and vnderſtanding of prudence: and exalteth the glorie of them that hold it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The roote of wiſdom is to feare our Lord: for the boughes therof are of long time.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the treaſures of wiſdom is vnderſtanding, & religioſitie of knowlege, but to ſinners wiſdom is abomination.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The feare of our Lord expelleth ſinne:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for he that is without feare, can not be iuſtified: for the anger of his animoſitie, is his ſubuerſion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Vntil a time the patient shal ſuſteyne, and after shal be rewarded of ioyfulnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A good vnderſtanding wil hide his wordes vntil a time, and the lippes of manie shal shew forth his vnderſtanding.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the treaſures of wiſdom is ſignification of diſcipline:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: but the worshipe of God, is abomination to a ſinner.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne, coueting wiſdom, keepe iuſtice, and God wil geue her to thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For the feare of our Lord is wiſdom and diſcipline: and that which wel pleaſeth him,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: is fayth, and meeknes, and he wil fil his treaſures.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not incredulous to the feare of our Lord: and come not to him with a duble hart.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not an hypocrite in the ſight of men, and be not ſcandalized in thy lippes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Attend to them, leſt perhaps thou fal, and bring dishonour to thy ſoule,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and God reuele thy ſecretes, and in the middes of the ſynagogue caſt thee downe:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: becauſe thou cameſt to our Lord wickedly, & thy hart is ful of guile and deceite.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: SONNE coming to the ſeruice of God, ſtand in iuſtice, and in feare, & prepare thy ſoule to tentation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Repreſſe thy hart, & ſuſteyne: incline thine eare, & receiue the wordes of vnderſtanding: and make no haſt in the time of obduction.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Suſteyne the ſuſtentations of God: be ioyned to God, and ſuſteyne, that thy life may increaſe in the later end.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al, that shal be applied to thee, receiue: and in ſorow ſuſteyne, and in thy humiliation haue patience:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for gold and ſiluer are tryed in the fyre, but acceptable men in the fornace of humiliation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Beleue God, and he wil recouer thee: and direct thy way, and hope in him. Keepe his feare, and grow old therin.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ye that feare our Lord expect his mercie: & decline not from him leſt ye fal.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ye that feare our Lord, beleue him, and your reward shal not be voyde.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ye that feare our Lord, hope in him: and mercie shal come to you for your delectation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ye that feare our Lord, loue him, & your hartes shal be illuminated.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Children behold the nations of men: and know ye that none hath hoped in our Lord, and hath bene confounded.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For who hath continewed in his commandment, and hath bene forſaken? or who hath inuocated him, and he deſpiſed him?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Becauſe God is pitiful and merciful, and wil forgeue ſinnes in the day of tribulation: and he is protector to al that ſeeke him in truth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Woe to them of a duble hart, and to wicked lippes, and to the handes that doe euil, and to the ſinner that goeth on the earth two wayes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Woe to them that be diſſolute of hart, which beleue not God: and therefore they shal not be protected of him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Woe be to them, that haue loſt patience, and that haue forſaken the right wayes, and haue declined into peruerſe wayes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And what wil they doe, when our Lord shal begynne to looke on them?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They that feare our Lord, wil not be incredulous to his word: and they that loue him, wil kepe his waye.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They that feare our Lord, wil ſeeke after the thinges that are wel pleaſing to him: and they that loue him, shal be filled with his law.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They that feare our Lord, wil prepare their hartes, and in his ſight wil ſanctifie their ſoules.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They that feare our Lord, kepe his commandements, and wil haue patience euen vntil his viſitation,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: ſaying: If we doe not penance, we shal fal into the handes of our Lord, and not into the handes of men.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For according to his greatnes, ſo alſo his mercie is with him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: THE children of wiſdom, are the Church of the iuſt: and their nation, obedience and loue.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Heare your fathers iudgement ô children, and ſo doe that you may be ſaued.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For God hath honoured the father in the children: and inquiring of the mothers iudgement, hath confirmed it vpon the children.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that loueth God, praying shal obteyne for ſinnes, and shal refrayne himſelf from them, and shal be heard in the prayer of dayes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And as he that gathereth treaſure, ſo he alſo that honoureth his mother.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that honoureth his father, shal haue ioy in children, and in the day of his prayer he shal be heard.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that honoureth his father, shal liue the longer life: & he that obeyeth the father, shal refresh the mother.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that feareth our Lord honoureth his parents, and as his lordes he wil ſerue them, that begat him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In worke and word, & al patience honour thy father,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: that bleſſing may come vpon thee from him, & his bleſſing may remayne in the later end.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The fathers bleſſing eſtablisheth the houſes of the children: but the mothers curſe rooteth vp the foundation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Glorie not in the contumelie of thy father: for his confuſion is no glorie to thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For the glorie of a man is by the honour of his father, and the father without honour is the dishonour of the ſonne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne receiue the old age of thy father, and make him not ſorowful in his life:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and if he fayle in vnderſtanding, pardon him, and deſpiſe him not in thy ſtrength: for the almes to the father shal not be in obliuion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For good shal be reſtored thee for the ſinne of thy mother,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and in iuſtice it shal be builded to thee, and in the day of tribulation there shal be remembrance of thee: and as yce in the clere weather shal thy ſinnes melt away.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Of what an euil fame is he, that forſaketh his father: and he is curſed of God, that doth exaſperate his mother.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne doe thy workes in meekenes, and thou shalt be beloued aboue the glorie of men.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The greater thou art, humble thy ſelf in al thinges, and thou shalt finde grace before God:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: becauſe the might of God onlie is great, and he is honoured of the humble.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Seeke not thinges higher then thy ſelf, and ſearch not thinges ſtronger then thy habilitie: but the thinges that God hath commanded thee, thincke on them alwayes, and in manie of his workes be not curious.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For it is not neceſſarie for thee, to ſee with thyne eies thoſe thinges that are hid.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In ſuperfluous thinges ſearch not manie wayes, and in manie of his workes thou shalt not be curious.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For verie manie thinges are shewed to thee aboue the vnderſtanding of men.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Manie alſo haue their ſuſpicion ſupplanted, and haue held their ſenſes in vanitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A hard hart shal fare il in the later end: and he that loueth danger, shal perish in it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A hart that goeth two wayes, shal not haue ſucceſſe, and the peruerſe of hart shal be ſcandalized in them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wicked hart shal be laden with ſorowes, and the ſinner wil adde to commit ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: To the ſynagogue of the proude there shal be no health: for the shrubbe of ſinne shal be rooted vp in them, and it shal not be perceiued.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The hart of the wiſe is vnderſtood in wiſdom, and a good eare wil heare wiſdom with al deſire.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wiſe hart, and that which hath vnderſtanding wil abſteyne it ſelf from ſinnes, and in the workes of iuſtice shal haue ſucceſſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Water quencheth burning fyre, and almes reſiſteth ſinnes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and God is the beholder of him that rendreth grace: he remembreth him afterward, and in the time of his fal he shal finde a ſure ſtay.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: SONNE defraude not the almes of the poore, and turne not away thyne eies from the poore.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Deſpiſe not the hungrie ſoule: and exaſperate not the poore in his pouertie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Afflict not the hart of the needie, and deferre not the gift to him that is in diſtreſſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Reiect not the petition of him that is afflicted: and turne not away thy face from the needie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: From the poore turne not away thine eies for anger: and leaue not to them that aske of thee, to curſe thee behinde thy backe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For the prayer of him that curſeth thee in the bitternes of his ſoule, shal be heard: and he that made him, wil heare him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Make thyſelf affable to the congregation of the poore, and to the ancient humble thy ſoule, and to a great man bow thy head.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Bow downe thyne eare to the poore without ſadneſſe, and render thy debt, and anſwer him peaceable wordes in mildenes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Deliuer him that ſuffereth iniurie out of the hand of the proud: and be not faynt harted in thy ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In iudging be merciful to pupils as a father, & as an husband to their mother:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and thou shalt be as the obedient ſonne of the Higheſt, and he wil haue mercie on thee more then a mother.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Wiſdom inſpireth life to her children, and receaueth them that ſeeke after her, and wil goe before them in the way of iuſtice.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he that loueth her, loueth life: and they that shal watch to her, shal embrace her ſweetnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They that shal hold her, shal inherite life: and whither ſoeuer he shal enter, God wil bleſſe him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They that ſerue her, shal be ſeruants to the holie: and them that loue her God loueth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that heareth her, shal iudge nations: and he that beholdeth her, shal remayne confident.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If he beleue her, he shal inherite her, and her creatures shal be in confirmation:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: becauſe in tentation she walketh with him, and firſt of al she chooſeth him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Feare and dread, and probation she wil bring vpon him: and she wil torment him in the tribulation of her doctrine, til she trie him in her cogitations, and credite his ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And she wil eſtablish him, and make a direct way vnto him, and reioyce him,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and wil diſcloſe her ſecretes to him, and wil heape vpon him as treaſures knowlege and vnderſtanding of iuſtice.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But if he goe amis, she wil forſake him, and deliuer him into the handes of his enimie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne obſerue time, and avoyd from euil.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For thy ſoule be not ashamed to ſay the truth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For there is shame that bringeth ſinne, & there is shame that bringeth glorie and grace.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Accept no face againſt thine owne face, nor againſt thy ſoule a lie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Reuerence not thy neighbour in his offence:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: nor kepe in a word in time of ſaluation. Hide not thy wiſdom in the beautie thereof.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For by the tongue wiſdom is diſcerned: and vnderſtanding, and knowlege, and doctrine by the word of the wiſe, and ſteedfaſtnes in the workes of iuſtice.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Doe not gayneſay the word of truth by any meanes, and be ashamed of the lie of thyne vnskilfulnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not ashamed to confeſſe thy ſinnes, and ſubmite not thy ſelf to euerie man for ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Reſiſt not againſt the face of the mightie, neither labour againſt the ſtreame of the riuer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For iuſtice contend for thy ſoule, and vnto death ſtriue for iuſtice, and God wil ouerthrow thyne enemies for thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not haſtie in thy tongue: and vnprofitable, and remiſſe in thy workes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not as a lion in thy houſe, ouerthrowing them of thy houshold, and oppreſſing them that are ſubiect to thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Let not thine hand be ſtretched out to receiue, and cloſed to geue.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: ATTEND not to vniuſt poſſeſſions, and ſay not: I haue ſufficient liuelihood: for it shal nothing profite in the time of vengeance & affliction.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Folow not in thy ſtrength the concupiſcence of thy hart:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and ſay not: How mightie am I? and who shal bring me vnder for my factes? for God reuenging wil reuenge.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Say not: I haue ſinned, and what ſorowful thing hath chanced to me? For the Higheſt is a patient rewarder.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Of ſinne forgeuen be not without feare, neither adde thou ſinne vpon ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And ſay not: The mercie of our Lord is great, he wil haue mercie on the multitude of my ſinnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For mercie and wrath quickly approch from God, and his wrath looketh vpon ſinners.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Slacke not to be conuerted to our Lord, and differre not from day to day.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For his wrath shal come ſodainly, and in the time of vengeance he wil deſtroy thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not careful in vniuſt riches: for they shal not profite thee in the day of obduction and vengeance.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Toſſe not thy ſelf into euerie winde, and goe not into euerie way: for ſo euerie ſinner is proued by a duble tongue.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be ſtedfaſt in the way of our Lord, & in the truth of thy vndeſtanding and in knowlege, and let the word of peace and iuſtice accompanie thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be milde to heare the word, thou maiſt vnderſtand: and with wiſdom vtter thou a true anſwer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou haue vnderſtanding, anſwer thy neighbour: but if not, let thine hand be vpon thy mouth, leſt thou be taken in an vnskilful word, and be confounded.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Honour and glorie in the word of the wiſe, but the tongue of the vnwiſe is his ſubuerſion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not called a whiſperer and be not taken in thy tongue, & confounded.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For vpon a theefe is confuſion & repentance, and a verie euil condemnation vpon the duble tongued, but to the whiſperer hatred, and emnitie, and contumelie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Iuſtifie thou the litle one, and the great alike.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: BE not for a frend made an enemie to thy neighbour: for the euil man shal inherite reproch and contumelie, and euerie ſinner enuious and duble tongued.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Extol not thyſelf in the cogitation of thy ſoule as it were a bul: leſt perhaps thy ſtrength be quashed,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and it eate thy leaues, and deſtroy thy fruites, and thou be leaft as a drie tree in the wildernes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For a wicked ſoule shal deſtroy him that hath it, and it geueth him to be a ioy to his enemies, and shal lead him into the lot of the impious.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A ſweete word multiplieth frends, & appeaſeth enemies, and a gratious tongue in a good man aboundeth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Let there be manie at peace with thee, and let one of a thouſand be thy counſeler.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou poſſeſſe a frend, in tentation poſſeſſe him, and not eaſely credite him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For he is a frend according to his owne time, and wil not abide in the day of tribulation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And there is a frend that is turned to emnitie: and there is a frend that wil diſcloſe hatred, and reproches.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And there is a frend companion at the table, and he wil not abide in the day of neceſſitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A frend if he continew ſtedfaſt, shal be to thee as an equal, and in them of thy houshold shal deale confidently:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: if he humble himſelf againſt thee, and hide himſelf from thy face, thou shalt haue frendshippe of one accord for good.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be ſeperated from thine enemies, & take heede of thy frends.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A faithful frend, is a ſtrong protection: and he that hath found him, hath found a treaſure.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: To a faythful frend there is no compariſon, and there is no poyſe of gold and ſiluer able to counteruaile the goodnes of his fidelitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A faythful frend, is the medecine of life & immortalitie: & they that feare our Lord, shal finde him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that feareth God, shal likewiſe haue good frendshipe: becauſe according to him shal his frend be.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne, from thy youth receiue doctrine, and euen to thy hoare heares thou shalt finde wiſdom.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As he that ploweth, and that ſoweth, goe to her, and expect her good fruites.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For in her worke thou shalt labour a litle, and shalt quickly eate of her generation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: How exceding sharpe is wiſdom to the vnlerned men, and the vnwiſe wil not continew in her.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As the vertue of a ſtone she shal be a probation in them, and they wil not ſtay to caſt her forth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For the wiſdom of doctrine is according to her name, and she is not manifeſt to manie, but to whom she is knowen, she contineweth euen to the ſight of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Heare my ſonne, and take counſel of vnderſtanding, and caſt not away my counſel.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Thruſt thy foote into her fetters, and thy necke into her cheynes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: put vnder thy shoulder, and carie her, and be not wearie of her bands.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: With al thy minde goe to her, and with al thy ſtrength keepe her wayes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Search her out, and she shal be made manifeſt to thee, and hauing obteyned her, forſake her not:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for in the later end, thou shalt finde reſt in her, and she shal be turned vnto delectation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And her fetters shal be to thee for a protection of ſtrength, and foundation of powre, & her cheynes for a ſtole of glorie:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For the beautie of life is in her, and her bands are a healthful bynding.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Thou shalt put on her a ſtole of glorie, and as a crowne of gratulation thou shalt ſet her vpon thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne, if thou attend to me, thou shal learne: and if thou wilt applie thy minde, thou shalt be wiſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou wilt incline thine eare, thou shalt receiue doctrine: and if thou loue to heare, thou shalt be wiſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Stand in the multitude of wiſe ancients, and be ioyned to their wiſdom from thy hart, that thou maiſt heare al the narration of God, and the prayſe may not eſcape thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And if thou ſee a wiſe man, watch after him, and let thy foote weare the ſteppes of his doores.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Haue thy cogitation in the precepts of God, and in his commandements moſt of al be dayly conuerſant: and he wil geue thee hart, and the deſire of wiſdom shal be geuen thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: DOE not euils, and they shal nor apprehend thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Depart from the wicked, & euil shal fayle from thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne, ſow not euils in the furrowes of iuſtice, & thou shalt not reape them ſeuenfold.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Seeke not of the lord chiefe principalitie, nor of the king the chayre of honour.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Iuſtifie not thyſelf before God, becauſe he is the knower of the hart: and before the king deſire not to ſeme wiſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Seeke not to be made a iudge, vnles thou be able by power to breake iniquities: leſt perhaps thou feare the face of the mightie, and put a ſcandal in thyne equitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sinne not againſt the multitude of a citie, neither thruſt thyſelf into the people,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: nor binde together duble ſinnes: for neither in one shalt thou be free from punishment.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not fayntharted in thy minde:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: deſpiſe not to pray, and to geue almes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Say not: In the multitude of my giftes God wil haue reſpect, and when I offer to God moſt high, he wil receiue my giftes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Laugh not a man to ſcorne in the bitternes of his ſoule: for there is that humbleth and exalteth, God the ouerſeer of al.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Plowe not a lie agaynſt thy brother: neither doe thou likewiſe agaynſt thy frend.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not willing to make any lie: for the cuſtome therof is not good.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not ful of wordes in a multitude of ancients, and iterate not a word in thy ſpeach.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Hate not laborious workes, and husbandrie created of the Higheſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Counte not thy ſelfe in the multitude of men without diſcipline.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be mindeful of wrath, becauſe it wil not ſlacke.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Humble thy ſpirit very much: becauſe the vengeance of the flesh of the impious, is fyre and the worme.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Doe not preuaricate againſt thy frend differring money, nor deſpiſe thy deareſt brother for gold.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Depart not from a wiſe and good woman, which thou haſt gotten in the feare of our Lord: for the grace of her bashfulnes is aboue gold.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Hurt not the ſeruant that worketh in truth, nor the hyred man that geueth his ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Let a wiſe ſeruant be beloued of thee as thy ſoule, defraude him not of libertie, nor leaue him needie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Haſt thou cattel? looke wel to them: and if they be profitable, let them continew with thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Haſt thou children? inſtruct them, & bowe them from their childehood.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Haſt thou daughters? keepe their bodie, and shew not thy countenance merrie towards them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Beſtow thy daughter, and thou shalt doe a great worke, and geue her to a wiſe man.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou haue a wife according to thy ſoule, caſt her not of: and to her that is hateful commit not thyſelf. With thy whole hart
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: honour thy father, and forget not the gronings of thy mother:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: remember that thou hadſt not bene borne but by them: and recompence them, as they alſo thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In al thy ſoule feare our Lord, and ſanctifie his prieſtes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: With al thy ſtrength loue him that made thee: & forſake not his miniſters.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Honour God with al thy ſoule, and honour the prieſtes, and purge thyſelf with the armes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue them the portion, as it is commanded thee, of the firſt fruites and purgation: and of thy negligence purge thy ſelf with few.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The gift of thyne armes and the ſacrifice of ſanctification thou shalt offer to our Lord, and the firſt of holie thinges:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and to the poore ſtretch out thyne hand, that thy propitiation may be perfected, and thy bleſſing.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The grace of a gift is in the ſight of al the liuing, and from the dead ſtay not grace.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Want not in conſolation to them that weepe, and walke with them that moorne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not loth to viſite the ſicke: for by theſe thinges thou shalt be confirmed in loue.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In al thy workes remember thy later ends, and thou wilt not ſinne for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: STRIVE not with a mightie man, leſt perhaps thou fal into his handes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Contend not with a rich man, leſt perhaps he make an action againſt thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For gold and ſiluer hath deſtroyed manie, and hath reached euen to the hart of kinges, and hath turned them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Striue not with a man ful of tongue, and thou shalt not heape ſtickes vpon his fyre.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Communicate not with the ignorant man, leſt he ſpeake il of thy progenie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Deſpiſe not a man that turneth himſelf from ſinne, nor vpbrayde him therwith: remember that we are al in ſtate to be blamed.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Deſpiſe not a man in his old age: for we alſo shal become old.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Reioyce not of thine enemie dead: knowing that we doe al die, and would not that others should ioy therat.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Deſpiſe not the narration of wiſe ancients, and in their prouerbes be thou conuerſant.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For of them thou shalt lerne wiſdom, and doctrine of vnderſtanding, and to ſerue great men without blame.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Let not the narration of the ancients eſcape thee: for they lerned of their fathers:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: becauſe of them thou shalt lerne vnderſtanding, and in time of neceſſitie to geue anſwer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Kindle not the coles of ſinners rebuking them, and be not kindled with the flame of the fire of their ſinnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Stand not againſt the face of a contumelious perſon, leſt he ſitte as a ſpie in wayte for thy mouth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Lend not to a man mightier then thyſelf, and if thou doeſt lend, count it as loſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not ſuretie aboue thy power: and if thou be ſuretie, thinke as if thou were to pay it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Iudge not agaynſt a iudge: becauſe he iudgeth according to that which is iuſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: With the audacious goe not on the way, leſt perhaps he burden thee with his euils: for he goeth according to his owne wil, and thou shalt perish together with his follie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: With an angrie man make no brawle, and with the audacious goe not into the deſert: becauſe bloud is as nothing before him, and where there is no helpe, he wil ouerthrow thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Conferre no counſel with fooles, for they can not loue but ſuch thinges as pleaſe them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before a ſtranger doe no matter of counſel: for thou knoweſt not what he wil bring forth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Make not thy hart manifeſt to euerie man: leſt perhaps he repay thee falſe kindnes, and ſpeake reprochfully to thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: BE not ielous ouer the wife of thy boſome, leſt she shew vpon thee the malice of wicked doctrine.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue not to a woman the power of thy ſoule, leſt she goe in thy ſtrength, and thou be confounded.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Looke not vpon a woman that is deſirous of manie: leſt perhaps thou fal into her ſnares.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: With her that is a dauncer be not daily conuerſant, nor heare her, leſt perhaps thou perish in her efficacie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Behold not a virgin, leſt perhaps thou be ſcandalized in her beautie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue not thy ſoule to harlottes in any poynt: leſt thou deſtroy thyſelf, and thine inheritance.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Looke not round about in the wayes of the citie, nor wander vp and downe in the ſtreates therof.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Turne away thy face from a trimmed woman, and gaze not about vpon an others beautie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: By the beautie of a woman manie haue perished: and hereby concupiſcence is inflamed as a fire.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Euerie woman, that is an harlot, shal be troden vpon as dung in the way.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Manie hauing admired the beautie of an other mans wife, haue become reprobate. for her communication burneth as fire.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sit not at al with an other mans wife, nor repoſe vpon the bed with her:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and ſtriue not with her at the wine, leſt perhapes thy hart decline toward her, & with thy bloud thou fal into perdition.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Forſake not an old frend: for the new wil not be like to him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A new frend, is as new wine: it shal waxe old, and thou shalt drinke it with ſweetnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Doe not zelouſely deſire the glorie, and the riches of a ſinner: for thou knoweſt not what his ſubuerſion shal be.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Let not the iniurie of the vniuſt pleaſe thee, knowing that euen to hel the impious shal not pleaſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be far from the man that hath power to kil, and thou shalt not ſuſpect the feare of death.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And if thou come to him, committe nothing, leſt perhaps he take away thy life.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Know it to be communication with death; becauſe thou shalt goe in the middes of ſnarres, and shalt walke vpon the weapons of the ſorowful.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: According to thy powre beware thee of thy neighbour; and treate with the wiſe and prudent.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Let iuſt men be thy gheſts, and let thy gloriation be in the feare of God,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and let the cogitation of God be in thy vnderſtanding, & al thine enarration in the precepts of the Higheſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Workes shal be prayſed in the handes of artificers, and the prince of the people in the wiſdom of his ſpeach, but the word of the ancients in the ſenſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man ful of tongue is terrible in his citie, and he that is rash in his word shal be odious.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wiſe iudge shal iudge his people, and the principalitie of the wiſe shal be ſtable.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: According to the Iudge of the people, ſo alſo are his miniſters: and what maner of man the ruler of a citie is, ſuch alſo are the inhabitants therein.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: An vnwiſe king shal deſtroy his people: and cities shal be inhabited by the vnderſtanding of the prudent.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The powre of the earth is in the hand of God, and he wil rayſe vp a profitable ruler for a time ouer it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The proſperitie of man is in the hand of God, & vpon the face of the ſcribe he wil put his honour.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Anie iniurie of thy neighbour remember not, and doe nothing by workes of iniurie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Pride is odious before God and men: and al the iniquitie of the nations is execrable.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A kingdome is tranſlated from nation vnto nation, becauſe of iniuſtices, and iniuries, and contumelies, and diuerſe deceites.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But nothing is more wicked then the couetous man. Why is earth and ashes proud?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Nothing is more wicked then to loue money. For he hath his ſoule alſo to ſel: becauſe in his life he hath caſt forth his moſt inward thinges:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al power is of short life. Long ſicknes greueth the Phyſicion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Short ſicknes the Phyſicion cutteth of at the firſt: ſo alſo the king is to day, & to morow he shal die.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For when a man shal die, he shal inherite ſerpents, and beaſts, and wormes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The begynning of the pride of man, is to apoſtate from God:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: becauſe his hart is departed from him that made him, for pride is the begynning of al ſinne: he that holdeth it, shal be filled with curſes, & it shal ſubuert him in the end.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Therfore hath our Lord dishonoured the congregations of the euil, & hath deſtroyed them euen to the end.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: God hath deſtroyed the ſeates of proud princes, and hath made the meeke ſitte in their ſtead.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: God hath made the rootes of the proud nations to wither, and hath planted the humble of the nations themſelues.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Our Lord hath ſubuerted the landes of the gentiles, and hath deſtroyed them euen to the fundation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He hath made of them to wither, and hath deſtroyed them, and hath made the memorie of them to ceaſe from the earth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: God hath deſtroyed the memorie of the proud, and hath left the memorie of them that are humble in vnderſtanding.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Pride was not created to men: nor wrath to the nation of wemen.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: That ſeede of men shal be honoured, which feareth God: but that ſeede shal be dishonoured, which tranſgreſſeth the commandments of our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the middes of brethren their ruler shal be in honour: and they that feare our Lord, shal be in his eyes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The glorie of the rich, of the honourable, and of the poore, is the feare of God:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Deſpiſe not the iuſt man that is poore, and magnifie not the ſinful man that is rich.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The great one, and the iudge, and the mightie is in honour, and there is none greater then he, that feareth God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Free men wil ſerue a ſeruant, that is wiſe: and a man that is prudent and hath diſcipline, wil not murmur being rebuked, and the ignorant shal not be honoured.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Extol not thyſelf in doing thy worke, and linger not in the time of diſtreſſe:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: better is he that worketh, and abundeth in al thinges, then he that glorieth, and lacketh bread.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne in mildenes keepe thy ſoule, and geue him honour according to his deſert.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Him that ſinneth agaynſt his owne ſoule who shal iuſtifie? and who shal honour him that dishonoureth his owne ſoule?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The poore man is glorified by his diſcipline and feare: & there is a man that is honoured for his ſubſtance.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But he that is glorified in pouertie, how much more in ſubſtance? and he that is glorified in ſubſtance, let him feare pouertie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: THE wiſdom of the humble shal exalt his head, & shal make him ſitte in the middes of great men.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Prayſe not a man in his beautie, neither deſpiſe a man by his looke.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The bee is ſmal among fowles, and her fruite hath the beginning of ſweetnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In apparel doe not glorie at any time, nor be extolled in the day of thine honour, becauſe the workes of the Higheſt onlie be meruelous, and his workes are glorious, and ſecrete, and not ſeene.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Manie tyrantes haue ſitte in the throne, and he whom no man would thincke hath worne the crowne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Manie mightie men haue bene greatly oppreſſed, and the glorious haue bene deliuered into the handes of others.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before thou enquire, blame no man: and when thou haſt enquired, chaſten iuſtly.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before thou heare, anſwer not a word, and in the middes of ancients adde not to ſpeake.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Striue not for that thing, which doeth not moleſt thee: and conſiſte not in the iudgement of ſinners.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne let not thy doings be in manie thinges: and if thou be rich, thou shalt not be free from ſinne. for if thou purſew, thou shalt not attayne: and if thou runne before, thou shalt not eſcape.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is one that laboureth, and haſteneth, and is a ſorowful impious man, and ſo much the more he shal not abound.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is a lither man that wanteth recouerie, more fayling in ſtrength, and abunding in pouertie:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and the eie of God hath reſpected him in good, and hath erected him from his low eſtate, and hath exalted his head: and manie haue merueled at him, and haue honoured God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Good thinges and euil, life and death, pouertie and honeſtie are of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Wiſdom and diſcipline, and the knowlege of the law are with God. Loue, and the wayes of good thinges are with him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Errour and darkenes are created with ſinners: and they that reioyce in euils, waxe old in euil.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The gift of God is permanent to the iuſt, and his proſpering shal haue ſucceſſe for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is that is enriched by doing ſparingly, and this is the portion of his reward
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: in that he ſayth: I haue found me reſt, and now I wil eate of my goods alone:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he knoweth not that time paſſeth, & death approcheth, and he muſt leaue al to others, and shal die.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Stand in thy couenant, and commen therein, and grow old in the worke of thy commandements.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Abide not in the workes of ſinners. But truſt in God, and tarie in thy place.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For it is eaſie in the eies of God ſodainly to enrich the poore man.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The bleſſing of God haſteth to the reward of the iuſt, and in a ſwift houre his proſpering fructifieth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Say not: What neede I, and what good shal I haue by this?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Say not: I am ſufficient for my ſelf: and what shal I be made worſe by this?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the day of good thinges be not vnmindful of euils: and in the day of euils be not vnmindful of good thinges:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: becauſe it is eaſie before God in the day of death to reward euerie one according to his wayes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The malice of an houre maketh obliuion of great voluptuouſnes, and in the end of a man is the diſcloſing of his workes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before death prayſe no man, becauſe a man is knowen in his children.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Bring not euerie man into thine houſe: for there be manie traynes of the deceitful man.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For as the ſtomakes belche of ſtinking breathes, and as the partriche is brought in the cage, and as the doe into the ſnare: ſo alſo the hart of the proude, and as a watche man that ſeeth the fal of his neighbour.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For turning good thinges into euil he lyeth in wayte, and on the elect he wil lay a blot.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For of one ſparke fire is increaſed, and of a deceitful man bloud is increaſed: and a ſinful man lyeth in wayte for bloud.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Take heede to thy ſelf of the peſtiferous perſon, for he forgeth euils: leſt perhaps he bring vpon thee deriſion for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Admitte a ſtraunger to thee, and he shal ouerthrow thee in an hurlewind, & shal make thee an aliene from thine owne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: IF thou wilt doe good, know to whom thou doeſt it, and there shal be much thanke in thy good deedes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Doe good to the iuſt, and thou shalt finde great rewarde: and if not of him, aſſuredly of our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For it is not wel with him, that is euer occupied in euil thinges, and that geueth not almes: becauſe the Higheſt both hateth ſinners, and hath mercie on them that are penitent.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue to the merciful, and receiue not the ſinner: both to the impious, & to ſinners he wil repay vengeance, keping them vnto the day of vengeance.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue to the good, and receiue not a ſinner.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Doe good to the humble, and geue not to the impious: prohibite to geue him bread, leſt therin he be mightier then thou:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for thou shalt finde duble euils in al the good, whatſoeuer thou shalt do to him: becauſe the Higheſt hateth ſinners, and wil repay vengeance to the impious.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A freind shal not be knowen in proſperitie, and an enimie shal not be hid in aduerſitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the proſperitie of a man, his enimies are in ſorow, and in affliction a freind is knowne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Credite not thyn enemie for euer: for as a braſſe potte his wickednes ruſteth:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and if humbling himſelf he goe crouching, be aduiſed in thy mind, and beware of him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Place him not by thee, neither let him ſitte on thy right hand, leſt perhaps turning into thy place, he ſeke after thy ſeate: and at the laſt thou know my wordes, and be pricked in my ſayinges.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who wil haue pittie vpon the inchanter ſtricking of a ſerpent, or of anie that come nere to beaſtes? ſo alſo he that kepeth companie with a wicked man, and is wrapped in his ſinnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For one houre he wil tarie with thee: but if thou decline, he wil not abide it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In his lippes the enimie ſpeaketh ſwetely, and in his hart he lyeth in wayte, that he may ouerthrow thee into the pitte.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In his eyes the enimie weepeth: and if he may finde a time, he wil not be ſatisfied with bloud:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and if euils happen to thee, thou shalt finde him there firſt
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In his eyes the enimie weepeth, and as it were helping thee, he wil vndermine thy feete.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He wil shake his head, and clappe his hand, and whiſpering manie thinges he wil change his countenance.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: HE that toucheth pitch, shal be defiled with it: and he that communicateth with the proud, shal put on pride.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He shal take a burden vpon him that communicateth with one more honorable then himſelf. And be not companion with one richer then thyſelf.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: What ſocietie shal the caudron haue with the earthen potte? for when they shal knock one againſt the other, it shal be broken.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The rich man hath done vniuſtly, and he wil fume: but the poore man being hurt wil hold his peace.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou geue, he wil take thee: and if thou haue not, he wil forſake thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou haue, he wil liue with thee, and wil emptie thee, and he wil not be ſorie for thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou be neceſſarie for him, he wil ſupplant thee, and ſmiling wil put thee in hope, telling thee good thinges, and wil ſay: What wanteſt thou?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he wil confound thee in his meates, til he emptie thee twiſe, & thriſe, and at the laſt he wil mocke thee: and afterward ſeeing he wil forſake thee, and wil shake his head at thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Humble thyſelf to God, and expect his handes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Take heede leſt ſeduced into follie thou be humbled.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not humble in thy wiſdom, leſt humbled thou be ſeduced into follie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Being called of the mightier depart: for by this he wil cal thee the more.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not importune, leſt thou be reiected: and be not farre from him, leſt thou goe into obliuion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Stay not to ſpeake felowlike with him: neither credite his manie wordes. For by much talke he wil proue thee, and ſmiling wil examine thee of thy ſecretes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: His cruel mind wil kepe thy wordes: and he wil not ſpare for malice, and for bandes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Take heede to thyſelf, and attend diligently to thyn hearing: becauſe thou walkeſt with thy ſubuerſion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But hearing thoſe thinges ſee as it were in ſleepe, and thou shalt watch.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Loue God al thy life, and inuocate him for thy ſaluation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Euerie beaſt loueth the like to it ſelf: ſo alſo euerie man the nereſt to himſelf.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al flesh wil match with the like to it ſelf, and euerie man wil aſſociate himſelf to his like.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If the woolf shal at anie time communicate with the lambe, ſo the ſinner with the iuſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: What fellowshippe hath an holy man with a dogge, or what part hath the riche with the poore?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The wilde aſſe in the deſerte is the lyons pray: ſo the poore are alſo the paſtures of the riche.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And as humilitie is abomination to the proude: ſo alſo the poore man is the execration of the riche.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The riche man being moued is confirmed by his frendes: but the humble when he is fallen, shal be thruſt out euen of his familiars.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: To the rich deceeued there are many recouerers: he hath ſpoken proud wordes, and they haue iuſtified him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The humble was deceiued, he moreouer is rebuked alſo: he hath ſpoken wiſely, and place was not geuen vnto him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The rich man ſpake, and al helde their peace, and they wil carry his worde euen to the cloudes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The poore man ſpake and they ſay: Who is this? and if he ſtumble, they wil ouerthrowe him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Subſtance is good, to him that hath no ſinne in his conſcience: and pouertie is moſt wicked in the mouth of the impious.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The hart of a man altereth his countenance, either into good, or into euil.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The token of a good hart, and a good countenance thou shalt hardly finde, and with labour.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: BLESSED is the man that hath not offended in a worde out of his mouth, and is not pricked with the ſorrow of ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Happie is he, that hath not had heauines of his minde, and hath not fallen from his hope.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Subſtance is without reaſon to the couetous man and niggard, and for the ſpiteful enuious man to what purpoſe is gold?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that heapeth together from his hart vniuſtly, gathereth for others, and in his goodes an other wil kepe riote.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that is wicked to himſelfe, to what other man wil he be good? and he shal haue no pleaſure in his goodes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that enuieth himſelfe, nothing is worſe then he; and this is the reward of his malice:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and if he doe good, he doth yt ignorantly, and not willing: and at the laſt he manifeſteth his malice.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The eye of the enuious is wicked, and turneth away his face, and deſpiſeth his owne ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The eye of the couetous man inſatiable in a portion of iniquitie, wil not be ſatisfied til he conſume his owne ſoule withering it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: An euil eye is towards euil thinges: & he shal haue his fil of bread, needie & in heauines shal he be at his table.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne if thou haue it, doe good to thyſelfe, and offer to God worthie oblations.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be mindful that death ſlacketh not, and that the couenant of hel hath beene shewed thee: for the couenant of this world shal dye the death.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before death do good to thy freind, and according to thine abilitie ſtretching out thy hand, geue to the poore.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not defrauded of thy good day, and let not a litle portion of a good gift ouerpaſſe the.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Shalt thou not leaue to others thy ſorrowes, & labours in the deuiſion of the lotte?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue and take, and iuſtifie thy ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before thy death worke iuſtice: for in hel there can not meat be found.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al flesh shal waxe olde as graſſe, and as the leafe fructifying on a greene tree.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Some grow, and ſome are shaken of: ſo the generation of flesh and bloude, one is ended, and an other is borne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al corruptible worke shal faile in the end: and he that worketh it shal goe therwith.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And euerie excellent worke shal be iuſtified: and he that worketh it, shal be honoured therin.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Bleſſed is the man that shal continew in wiſdom, and that shal meditate in his iuſtice, and in vnderſtanding shal conſider the prouidence of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that conſidereth her wayes in his hart, and hath vnderſtanding in her ſecrets, going after her as a ſearcher, and conſiſting in her wayes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that looketh through her windowes, and heareth in her gates:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that reſteth by her houſe, & in her walles faſtening a ſtake wil ſet vp his cotage beſide her handes, and good thinges shal reſt in his cottage for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He shal ſet his children vnder her couering, and shal abide vnder her boughes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: he shal be protected vnder her couering from the heate, and shal reſt in her glorie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: HE that feareth God, shal doe good thinges, and he that hath iuſtice shal apprehend her,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and she wil meete him as an honourable mother, and as a wife from virginitie she wil receiue him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: She shal fede him with the bread of life and vnderſtanding, and geue him the water of wholſome wiſdom to drinke: and she shal be made ſure in him, and he shal not be bowed:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and she shal hold him faſt, and he shal not be confounded: and she shal exalt him before his neighbours,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and in the middeſt of the Church she shal open his mouth, and shal fil him with the ſpirite of wiſdom and vnderſtanding, and shal clothe him with a ſtole of glorie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ioy & exultation she shal heape vpon him, & shal make him inherite an euerlaſting name.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Foolish men shal not apprehend her, & wiſe men shal meete her, foolish men shal not ſee her: for she is far from pride and deceite.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Lying men shal not be myndful of her: and true men shal be found in her, and shal haue ſucceſſe, euen to the beholding of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Prayſe is not comelie in the mouth of a ſinner:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Becauſe wiſdom proceded from God. For prayſe shal be with the wiſdom of God, & shal abound in a faithful mouth, & the dominator wil giue praiſe to yt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Say not: It is by God, that she is abſent: for doe not thou the thinges that he hateth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Say not: He hath made me erre: for impious men are not neceſſarie for him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Our Lord hateth al abomination of errour, and it shal not be amiable to them, that feare him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: God from the beginning made man, and left him in the hand of his owne counſel.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He added his commandmentes and precepts.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou wilt keepe the commandment, and keepe acceptable fidelitie for euer, they shal preſerue thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He hath ſet before thee water and fire: to which thou wilt, ſtretch forth thine hande.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before man there is life and death, good and euil: what pleaſeth him shal be geuen him:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Becauſe the wiſdom of God is much, and he is ſtrong in mighte, ſeing al men without intermiſſion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The eies of our Lord are towards them that feare him, and he knoweth al the worke of man.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He hath commanded no man to do impiouſly, and he hath geuen no man ſpace to ſinne:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for he deſireth not a multitude of faithleſſe and vnprofitable children.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: REIOICE not in impious children, if they be multiplied: neither be delighted vpon them, if the feare of God be not in them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Credite not their life, and reſpect not their labours.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For better is one fearing God, then a thouſand impious children.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And it is more profitable to die without children, rather then to leaue impious children.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: By one wiſe a countrie shal be inhabited, and the tribe of the impious shal be made deſolate.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Manie ſuch thinges hath mine eie ſene, and myne eare hath heard thinges of more force then theſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the ſynagogue of ſinners a fire shal flame, and in an incredulous nation wrath shal waxe hotte.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The old giantes did not obteine for their ſinnes, who were deſtroied truſting to their owne ſtrength:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he ſpared not the peregrination of Lot, and he deteſted them for the pride of their word.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He had not pitie on them, deſtroying the whole nation, and extolling themſelues in their ſinnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And as the ſix hundred thouſand foote men, which were gathered together in the hardnes of their hart: and if one had bene ſtiffe necked, it is meruel if he had bene vnpunished.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For there is mercie and wrath with him. Mightie exoration, & powring out wrath:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: according to his mercie, ſo his chaſtiſement iudgeth a man according to his workes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The ſinner shal not eſcape in robberie, and the ſufferance of him that doth mercie shal not ſlacke.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al mercie shal make a place to euerie man according to the merite of his workes, & according to the vnderſtanding of his peregrination.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Say not; I shal be hid from God, and from on high who shal remember me?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In a great people I shal not be knowen: for what is my ſoule among ſo innumerable creatures?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Behold heauen, and the heauens of heauens; the depth, and al the earth, & the thinges that are in them, in his ſight shal be moued,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: the mountaines together, and the litle hilles, & the fundations of the earth: & when God shal behold them, they shal be shaken with trembling.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And in al theſe thinges the hart is ſenſeles: and euerie hart is vnderſtood of him:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and his wayes who doth vnderſtand, and the ſtorme, which neither the eie of man shal ſee?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For manie of his workes are in ſecretes: but the workes of his iuſtice who shal declare? or who shal ſuſteine? For the teſtament is far from ſome, and the examination of al is in conſummation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that is leſſe of hart, thinketh vaine thinges: and the vnwiſe, and erring man, thinketh folish thinges.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Heare me my ſonne, and lerne the diſcipline of vnderſtanding, and attend to my wordes in thy hart,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and I wil ſpeake diſcipline in equitie, and wil ſearch to declare wiſedom, and to my wordes attend in thy hart, and I ſpeake in equitie of ſpirit the vertues, that God hath put vpon his workes from the beginning, and in truth I shew forth his knowlege.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the iudgement of God are his workes from the beginning, and from the inſtitution of them he diſtinguished their partes, and their beginninges in their nations.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He adorned their workes for euer, neither haue they hungred, nor laboured, and they haue not ceaſed from their workes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Euerie one shal not vexe his neighbour for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not incredulous to his word.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: After this God looked vpon the earth, & filled it with his good thinges.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And the ſoule of euerie liuing thing shal shew before the face thereof, and into it againe is their returne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: GOD created man of the earth, and after his owne image he made him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And againe he turned him into it, and conformable to himſelfe clothed him with ſtrength.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He gaue him a number of daies and time, and gaue him power of thoſe thinges, that are vpon the earth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He put his feare ouer al flesh, and he had dominion of beaſtes and fowles.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He created of him an helper like to himſelfe: he gaue them counſel, and tongue, and eies, & eares, and hart to deuiſe: and he filled them with the diſcipline of vnderſtanding.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He created in them the knowlege of the ſpirit, he filled their hart with vnderſtanding, and euil and good he shewed them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He ſet his eie vpon their hartes to shew them the great thinges of his workes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: that they might praiſe the name of ſanctification: and glorie in his meruelous workes, that thy might declare the glorious thinges of his workes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He added diſcipline vnto them, and made them inherite the lawe of life.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He made an euerlaſting teſtament with them, & he shewed them iuſtice and his iudgementes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And their eie ſaw the glorious thinges of his honour, and their eares heard the honour of his voice, and he ſaid to them: Beware of euerie vniuſt thing.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he gaue them commandment euerie one concerning his neighbour.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Their wayes are before him alwaies, they are not hid from his eies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ouer euerie nation he appointed a ruler.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And Iſrael was made the manifeſt portion of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And al their workes as the ſunne in the ſight of God: and his eies without intermiſſion looking on their wayes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The teſtamentes were not hid by their iniquitie, and al their iniquities are in the ſight of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The almes of a man is as a ſeale with him, and shal preſerue the grace of a man as the apple of the eie:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And afterward he shal ariſe, and shal render them reward, to euerie one vpon their head, and shal turne into the inner partes of the earth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But to the penitent he hath geuen the way of iuſtice, and he hath confirmed them that faile to ſuſteine, and hath appointed to them the lot of truth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Turne to our Lord, and forſake thy ſinnes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: pray before the face of our Lord, and diminish offences.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Returne to our Lord, and turne away from thine iniuſtice, and hate excedingly abomination:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and know the iniuſtices and iudgementes of God, and ſtand in the lot of thy purpoſe, and of praier of the moſt high God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Goe into the partes of the holie world, with the liuing, and them that geue praiſe to God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Tarie not in the errour of the impious, before death confeſſe. From the dead as nothing, confeſſion perisheth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Thou shalt confeſſe liuing, aliue and in health thou shalt confeſſe, and shalt praiſe God, and shalt glorie in his mercies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: How great is the mercie of our Lord, and his propitiation to them that turne to him!
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For al thinges can not be in men, becauſe the ſonne of man is not immortal, and they haue delighted in the vanitie of malice.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: What is brighter then the ſunne? & it shal faile. Or what more wicked then that which flesh and bloud hath inuented? and this shal be reproued.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He beholdeth the powre of the height of heauen: and al men be earth and ashes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: HE that liueth for euer, created al thinges together. God onlie shal be iuſtified, and remaineth an inuincible king for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who is ſufficient to declare his workes?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For who shal ſearch out his glorious thinges?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and who shal shew forth the powre of his greatneſſe? or who shal adde to declare his mercie?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: It is not poſſible to diminish, nor adde, neither is it poſſible to finde the glorious workes of God:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: When a man shal haue done, then shal he beginne: and when he shal reſt, he shal worke.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: What is man, and what is his grace? and what is his good, or what his euil?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The number of the daies of men at the moſt an hundred yeares: as droppes of the water of the ſea they are reputed: and as the grauel ſtone of the ſand, ſo a few yeares in the day of eternitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For this cauſe God is patient toward them, and powreth out his mercie vpon them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He hath ſenne the preſumption of their hart that it is naught, and hath knowen their ſubuerſion that it is euil.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Therefore hath he fulfilled his propitiation toward them, and hath shewed them the way of equitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Mans compaſſion is touching his neigbour: but the mercie of God is vpon al flesh.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that hath mercie, teacheth, and inſtructeth, as a paſtour his flocke.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He hath mercie on him that receiueth the doctrine of compaſſion, and he that haſteneth in his iudgementes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne in good deedes geue no blame, and in euerie gift geue not the ſadnes of an euil word.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Shal not the dew coole heate? ſo alſo a word better then a gift.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Is not a word aboue a good gift? but both are with a iuſtified man.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A foole wil vpbraide bitterly: and the gift of one vntaught maketh the eies to drie away.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before iudgement prepare thee iuſtice, and before thou ſpeake lerne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before ſickenes take medicine, and before iudgement examine thyſelf, and in the ſight of God thou shalt finde propitiation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before ſickenes humble thy ſelf, and in time of infirmitie shew thy conuerſation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not hindered to pray alwayes, & feare not to be iuſtified euen to death: becauſe the reward of God abideth for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before praier prepare thy ſoule: and be not as a man that tempteth God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Remember the wrath in the day of conſummation, and the time of reward in conuerſation of the face.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Remember pouertie in the time of abundance, and the neceſſities of pouertie in the day of riches.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: From morning vnto euening time shal be changed, & al theſe are ſowne in the eies of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wiſe man in al thinges wil feare, & in the daies of offences wil beware of ſloth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Euerie ſubtile man knoweth wiſdom, and to him that findeth her he wil geue prayſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus
