text: The wiſe in wordes, and they alſo haue done wiſely: and haue vnderſtood truth and iuſtice, and haue rayned prouerbes & iudgementes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Goe not after thy concupiſcences, and turne away from thy wil.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou geue to thy ſoule her concupiſcences; she wil make thee a ioy to the enemies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not delighted in multitudes, nor in few: for their concertation is continual.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not poore in contention of borowing, and thou haſt nothing in thy purſe: for thou shalt be enuious to thine owne life.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A workman that is a drunkard shal not be rich: and he that contemneth ſmal thinges, shal fal by litle and litle.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Wine and wemen make wiſemen to apoſtatate, and shal reproue the prudent:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he that ioyneth himſelf to harlotes, shal be naught. Rottennes and wormes shal inherite him, and he shal be lifted vp for a greater example, and his life shal be taken out of the number.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that geueth credite quickly, is light of hart, and shal be leſſened: and he shal more ouer be counted one that ſinneth againſt his owne ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that reioyceth in iniquitie, shal be reprehended, and he that hateth chaſtiſement, shal be diminished of life: and he that hateth babbling, extinquisheth malice.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that ſinneth againſt his owne ſoule, shal repent: and he that is delighted in naughtineſſe, shal be reprehended.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Iterate not a wicked and hard word, and thou shalt not be leſſened.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: To freind and foe tel not thy minde: and if thou haue ſinne, diſcloſe it not.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For he wil heare thee, and wil watch thee, and as it were defending the ſinne he wil hate thee, and ſo wil he be preſent with thee alwaies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Haſt thou heard a word againſt thy neighbour? let it die together in thee, truſting that it wil not burſt thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: At the preſence of a word the foole traueleth, as the groning of the childbirth of an infant.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: An arrow ſtickt in the thigh of flesh: ſo is a word in the hart of a foole.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Rebuke a freind, leſt perhapes he hath not vnderſtood, and ſay: I did it not: or if he did it, that he doe it not againe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Rebuke thy neighbour, leſt perhaps he ſaid it not: and if he ſaid it, leſt perhaps he iterate it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Rebuke thy freind: for there is often a fault committed:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And beleue not euerie word. There is that offendeth with the tongue, but not from his hart.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For who is there that hath not offended in his tongue? Rebuke thy neighbour before thou threaten.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And geue place to the feare of the Higheſt: becauſe the feare of God is al wiſedom, and to feare God is in it, & the diſpoſition of the law is in al wiſdom.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And the diſcipline of wickednes is not wiſedom: and the cogitation of ſinners is not prudence.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is wickednes, and in it execration: and there is a foole that hath leſſe wiſedom.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Better is a man that hath leſſe wiſdom, and lacketh vnderſtanding, in feare, then he that abundeth in vnderſtanding, and tranſgreſſeth the law of the Higheſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is an aſſured ſubtilitie, & the ſame wicked.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And there is that vttereth an exact word telling the truth. There is that wickedly humbleth himſelfe, and his inner partes be ful of deceite:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and there is a iuſt man that ſubmitteth himſelfe ouermuch of great humilitie: and there is a iuſt one that boweth his face, and feyneth himſelf not to ſee that which is vnknowen:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and if he be forbidden to ſinne for imbecillitie of power, if he shal finde a time to do euil, he wil do euil.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man is knowen by the ſight, and a wiſeman is knowen by the shew of his face.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The clothing of the bodie, and the laughing of the teeth, and the going of the man tel of him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is a lying chaſtiſement in the anger of a contumelious perſon: and there is a iudgement, that is not allowed to be good: and there is that holdeth his peace, and he is wiſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: HOW good a thing is it to rebuke, rather then to be angrie, and not to hinder him that confeſſeth in prayer!
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The concupiſcence of an eunuch shal defloure a young maide:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: ſo he that by violence doth vniuſt iudgement.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: How good a thing is it being rebuked to shew repentance! for ſo thou shalt auoid wilful ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is that holdeth his peace, which is found wiſe: and there is that is odious, he which is malepert to ſpeake.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is that holdeth his peace hauing not vnderſtanding to ſpeake: and there is that holdeth his peace, knowing the time of fitte opportunitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wiſe man wil hold his peace vntil a time: but a wanton, and the vnwiſe wil not obſerue time.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that vſeth manie wordes, shal hurt his owne ſoule: & he that taketh authoritie to himſelf vniuſtly, shal be hated.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is proceding in euils to a man without diſcipline, and there is finding to loſſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is a gift, that is not profitable: and there is a gift, the reward whereof is duble.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is debaſing becauſe of glorie: and there is that from humilitie shal lift vp the head.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is that redemeth manie thinges for a ſmale price, and reſtoreth the ſame ſeuen fold.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man wiſe in wordes shal make himſelfe beloued: but the graces of fooles shal be powred out.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The gift of the vnwiſe shal not be profitable for thee: for his eies are ſeuenfold.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He wil geue few thinges, and vpbraide manie: and the opening of his mouth is an inflammation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: To day a man lendeth, and to morow he asketh it againe: ſuch a man is odious.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A foole shal haue no freind, and there shal be no thanke to his goodes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For they that eate his bread, are of a falſe tongue. How often, and how manie wil laugh him to ſcorne?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For he doth not diſtribute with right vnderſtanding, that which was to be had: in like manner alſo that which was not to be had.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The ſlipping of a falſe tongue, as he that falleth on the pauement: ſo the falles of the euil shal come haſtely.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man without grace is as a vaine fable, it shal be continual in the mouth of them that are without diſcipline.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A parable out of a fooles mouth shal be reiected: for he doth not ſpeake it in his time.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is that is forbid to ſinne for pouertie, and in his reſt he shal be pricked.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is that wil deſtroy his ſoule for shamfaſtnes, and by an vnwiſe perſon he wil deſtroy it: and by acception of perſon he wil deſtroy himſelf.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is that for shamfaſtnes promiſeth to his freind, and hath gotten an enemie of him for naught.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Lying is a wicked reproch in a man, and in the mouth of men without diſcipline it shal be continually.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Better is a theefe, then the continual cuſtome of a lying man, but both shal inherite perdition.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The maners of lying men are without honour: and their confuſion is with them without intermiſſion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wiſeman in his wordes shal vtter himſelf, and a prudent man shal pleaſe great perſons.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that tilleth his land, shal make an high heape of corne: and who ſo worketh iuſtice, he shal be exalted: and he that pleaſeth great men, shal auoide iniquitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Preſentes, & giftes blind the eies of iudges, and as one dumbe in the mouth turneth away their chaſtiſementes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Wiſdom hid, and treaſure not ſene: what profit is there in both?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Better is he that concealeth his foolishnes, then the man that hideth his wiſdom.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: SONNE haſt thou ſinned? doe ſo no more: but for the old alſo pray that they may be forgeuen thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As from the face of a ſerpent flee from ſinnes: and if thou approch to them, they wil receiue thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The teeth of a lion the teeth thereof, killing the ſoules of men.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al iniquitie is as a two edged ſword, there is no remedie for the wound thereof.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Brawling and iniuries shal bring the ſubſtance to nothing: and the houſe that is verie rich, shal be made nothing by pride: ſo the ſubſtance of the proude shal be rooted out.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The prayer of the poore out of the mouth shal come to his eares, and iudgement shal come for him ſpedely.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that hateth chaſtiſement, is the trace of a ſinner: and he that feareth God, wil turne to his owne hart.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The mightie in a bold tongue is knowen a far of, and a wiſeman knoweth himſelf to fal by him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that buildeth his houſe at other menes charges, is as he that gathereth his ſtones in the winter.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The ſynagogue of ſinners is as tow gathered together, and their conſummation a flame of fire.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The way of ſinners is paued with ſtones, & in their end, hel, & darkenes, and paines.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that keepeth iuſtice, shal conteine the vnderſtanding therof.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The conſummation of the feare of God wiſdom and vnderſtanding.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He shal not be taught, that is not wiſe in good.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But there is wiſdom that aboundeth in euil: and there is no vnderſtanding where bitternes is.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The knowlege of the wiſe shal abound as an inundation, and his counſel is permanent as a fountaine of life.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The hart of a foole is as a broken veſſel, and al wiſdom it shal not hold.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man of knowlege wil praiſe whatſoeuer wiſe word he shal heare, and wil applie it to himſelf: the riotous man hath heard it, and it shal diſpleaſe him, and he wil caſt it behind his back.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The narration of a foole is as a burden in the way: for in the lippes of the wiſe shal grace be found.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The mouth of the prudent is ſought in the Church, and they wil thinke vpon his wordes in their hartes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As a houſe deſtroied, ſo is wiſdom to a foole: & the knowlege of the vnwiſe inexplicable wordes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Fetters on the feete, doctrine to a foole, and as manicles vpon the right hand.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A foole in laughter exalteth his voice: but a wiſeman wil ſcarſe laugh ſecretly.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Doctrine to the prudent is a golden ornament, and as it were a bracelet on the right arme.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The foote of a foole goeth eaſely into his neighbours houſe: & a cunning man wil be abashed at the perſon of the mightie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A foole wil looke from the window into the houſe: but the nurtered wil ſtand without.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: It is the follie of a man to harken by the dore: and a wiſeman wil be greeued with the contumelie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The lippes of the vnwiſe shal tel foolish thinges: but the wordes of the wiſe shal be pondered in balance.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The hart of fooles is in their mouth: and the mouth of wiſemen is in their hart.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Whiles the impious curſeth the diuel, he curſeth his owne ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The whiſperer shal defile his ſoule, and shal be hated in al: and he that shal abide with him, shal be odious: the ſtil man and wiſe shal be honored.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: THE ſluggard is ſtoned with a durtie ſtone, & al men wil ſpeake of his diſgrace.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The ſluggard is ſtoned with the dung of oxen: and euerie one, that shal touch him, wil shake his handes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The coufuſion of the father is of a ſonne without diſcipline; and the daughter shal be made of leſſe account.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wiſe daughter is an inheritance to her buſband. for she that confoundeth, is made a contumelie to her father.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: She that is bold shameth father and husband, and shal not be inferiour to the impious: but of them both she shal be dishonored.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Muſike in mourning is a tale out of time: ſcourges and doctrine are at al time wiſdom.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that teacheth a foole, is as he that gleweth together a potshard.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that telleth a word to him that heareth not, is as he that raiſeth vp a man ſleepeing out of an heauie ſleepe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He ſpeaketh with him that ſleepeth, which vttereth wiſdom to a foole: and in the end of the narration he ſaieth: Who is this?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Weepe vpon the dead, for his light hath failed: and weepe vpon a foole, for he faileth in vnderſtanding.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Weepe a little vpon the dead, becauſe he is at reſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For the wicked life of the very wicked, aboue the death of a foole.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The moorning of the dead is ſeuen daies: but of a foole and of the impious, al the daies of their life.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Speake not much with a foole, and goe not with the vnwiſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Keepe thy ſelfe from him, that thou haue no moleſtation; and thou shalt not be defiled with his ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Turne aſide from him, and thou shalt finde reſt; and shalt not be wearied with his follie:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: What shal be beauier then lead? and what other name hath it but foole.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: It is eaſier to beare ſand and ſalt, and a maſſe of yron, then an vnwiſe man, and a foole, and impious.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A frame of wood bound together in the fundation of a building, shal not be diſſolued: ſo alſo the hart confirmed in the cogitation of counſel.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The cogitation of the wiſe at al time, yea by feare shal not be depraued.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As ſtakes in high places, and plaiſteringes laid without coſt, shal not abide againſt the face of the winde:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: ſo alſo a feareful hart in the cogitation of a foole shal not reſiſt againſt the violence of feare.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As a trembling hart in the cogitation of a foole, al time wil not feare, ſo alſo he that continueth alwaies in the preceptes of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that pricketh the eie, bringeth forth teares: and he that pricketh the hart, bringeth forth feeling.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that caſteth a ſtone at fowles, and shal throw them downe: ſo he that ſpeaketh reprochefully to his freind, diſſolueth freindship.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Although thou droweſt a ſword at a freind, deſpaire not: for there is returning to a freind.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou open a ſad mouth, feare not. for there is agreement: except taunt, and reproch and pride, and reuealing of ſecret, and a traiterous wound: in al theſe thinges a freind wil flee away.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Poſſeſſe fidelitie with a freind in his prouertie, that in his goodes alſo thou maiſt reioyce.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the time of his tribulation continew faithful to him, that in his inheritance alſo thou maiſt be heire with him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before the fire the vapour of the chimney, and the ſmoke of the fire riſeth on high: ſo alſo before bloud euil wordes, and contumelies, & threates.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I wil not be ashamed to ſalute a freind, from his face I wil not hide myſelf: and if there chance euiles to me by him, I wil beare it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Euerie one that shal heare, wil beware of him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who wil geue a gard to my mouth, and a ſure ſeale vpon my lippes, that I fal not by them, and my tongue deſtroy me?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: O Lord father, and dominatour of my life leaue me not in their counſel: nor ſuffer me to fal in them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who laieth on ſtripes in my cogitation, and in my hart the doctrine of wiſdom, and in their ignorances they ſpare me not, and their offences appeare not,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and my ignorances increaſe not, and my offences be multiplied, and my ſinnes ahound, and I fal in the ſight of mine aduerſaries, & mine enemies reioyce.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: O Lord father, and God of my life, leaue me not in their cogitation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Hautines of mine eies geue me not, and al deſire turne away from me.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Take from me the concupiſcences of the bellie, and let not the concupiſcences of copulation take hold of me, and geue me not ouer to a shameleſſe and foolish minde.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: O children heare the doctrine of the mouth: and he that wil keepe it, shal not perish by his lippes, nor be ſcandalized in moſt wicked workes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A ſinner is taught in his vanitie, and the proud and the euil ſpeaker shal be ſcandalized in them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Let not thy mouth be accuſtomed to ſwearing: for there be manie falles in it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But let not the naming of God be vſual in thy mouth, and meddle not with the names of Sainctes, becauſe thou shalt not ſcape free from them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For as a ſeruant daily examined, lacketh not the marke therof: ſo euerie one that ſweareth, and nameth, shal not be wholy purged from ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man that ſweareth much shal be filled with iniquitie, and plague shal not depart from his houſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And if he fruſtrate it, his ſinne shal be vpon him: and if he diſſemble, he offendeth duble:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and if he ſweare in vaine, he shal not be iuſtified: for his houſe shal be filled with retribution.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is an other contrarie ſpeach, alſo to death, be it not found in the inheritance of Iacob.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For of the merciful al thoſe thinges shal be taken away, and they wil not wallow in ſinnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Let not thy mouth be accuſtomed to vnnurtered ſpeach: for there is in it a word of ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Remember thy father and thy mother, for thou ſitteſt in the middeſt of greate men:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: leſt perhapes God forget thee in their ſight, and being ſotted with thy dailie cuſtome, thou ſuffer reproch, and hadſt better not haue bene borne, and curſe the day of thy natiuitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man accuſtomed to the wordes of reproch, wil not be inſtructed in al his daies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Two ſortes abound in ſinnes, and the third bringeth wrath and perdition.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: An hote ſoule as a burning fire wil not be quenched, til it ſwallow ſomewhat.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and a wicked man in the mouth of his flesh wil not ceaſe til he kindle a fire.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: To a man that is a fornicatour al bread is ſweete, he wil not be wearie tranſgreſſing vnto the end.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Euerie man that paſſeth beyond his owne bed, contemning againſt his owne ſoule, and ſaying: Who ſeeth me?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Darkenes compaſſeth me, and the walles couer me, and no man beholdeth me: whom do I feare? the Higheſt wil not be mindful of my ſinnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he vnderſtandeth not that his eye ſeeth al thinges, for that ſuch feare of man expelleth from him the feare of God, & the eies of men fearing him:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he knoweth not that the eies of our Lord are much more brighter then the ſunne, beholding round about al the waies of men, and the botome of the depth, and the hartes of men looking into the hidden partes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For al thinges were knowen to our Lord God, before they were created: ſo alſo after it is perfected he beholdeth al thinges.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Reuenge shal be taken on this man in the ſtreates of the cittie, and as an horſecolt he shal be chaſed: and where he expected not, he shal be apprehended.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he shal be in dishonour with al men, for that he vnderſtood not the feare of our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: So euerie woman alſo that forſaketh her husband, & getteth inheritance by mariage of an other.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For firſt she hath bene vnfaithful in the law of the Higheſt: and ſecondly she hath ſinned againſt her huſband: thirdly she hath fornicated in adulterie, and hath gotten her children of an other man.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: This woman shal be brought into the Church, and vpon her children there shal be examination.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Her children shal not take roote, and her boughes shal not yeld fruite.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: She shal leaue her memorie to be curſed, and her dishonour shal not be wiped out.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And they that are leaft shal know, that nothing is better then the feare of God: and nothing ſweter, then to haue regard to the commandmentes of our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: It is great glorie to folow our Lord: for length of daies shal be taken of him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: VVISDOM shal praiſe her ſoule, & shal be honoured in God, and shal glorie in the middes of her people,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and shal open her mouth in the churches of the Higheſt, and shal glorie in the ſight of his power,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and in the middes of her people she shal be exalted, and in the holie aſſemblie she shal be admired,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and in the multitude of the elect she shal haue praiſe, and among the bleſſed, she shal be bleſſed, ſaying:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I come forth from the mouth of the Higheſt, the firſt begotten before al creatures.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I made that in the heauens there should riſe light that faileth not, and as a cloud I couered al the earth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I dwelt in the higheſt places, and my throne is in the pillar of a cloude.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I alone haue gone round about the compaſſe of heauen, and haue penetrated into the bottome of the depth, and haue walked in the waues of the ſea,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and ſtood in al the earth: and in al people,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and in euerie nation I haue had the primacie:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and I haue by ſtrength troden downe the hartes of al the excellent, and the baſe; and in al theſe thinges I ſought reſt, & I shal abide in the inheritance of our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Then the creatour of al commanded, and ſaid to me: & he that created me, reſted in my tabernacle,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he ſaid to me: Inhabite in Iacob, and inherite in Iſrael, and take roote in myne elect.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: From the beginning and before the worlds was I created, and vnto the world to come I shal not ceaſe, and in the holie habitation I haue miniſtred before him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And ſo in Sion was I eſtablished, and in the ſanctified cittie likewiſe I reſted, and my power was in Ieruſalem.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And I tooke roote in an honorable people, and in the portion of my God his inheritance, and my abiding is in the ful aſſemblie of ſaintes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I am exalted as a cedar in Libanus, and as a cypres tree in mount Sion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As a palme tree in Cades am I exalted, and as a roſe plant in Iericho:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As a faire oliue tree in the fieldes, and as a plane tree by the water in the ſtreates am I exalted.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I gaue an odour as cinnamon, & aromatical balme: as choſen myrrhe haue I geuen the ſweetenes of odour:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and as ſtorax, and galbanum, and onyx, and aloes, and as Libanus not cut, haue I perfumed myne habitation, and myne odour is as baulme non mingled.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I haue ſpred out my boughes as the terebinth, and my boughes are of honour and grace.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I as a vine haue fructified ſweetenes of odour: and my flowers are fruite of honour and honeſtie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I am the mother of beautiful loue, and of feare, and of knowlege, and of holie hope.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In me is al grace of way and truth, in me al hope of life and vertue.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Paſſe to me al ye that deſire me, and be filled of my generations.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For my ſpirit is ſweete aboue honie, and myne inheritance aboue honie and the honie combe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: My memorie is vnto generations of worldes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They that eate me, shal yet hunger: and they that drinke me, shal yet thirſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that heareth me, shal not be confounded: and they that worke in me, shal not ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They that explicate me, shal haue life euerlaſting.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al theſe thinges are the booke of life, and the teſtament of the Higheſt, & the knowlege of truth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Moyſes commanded a law in the preceptes of iuſtices, and an inheritance to the houſe of Iacob, and the promiſes to Iſrael.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He appointed to Dauid his ſeruant for to raiſe vp a king of him moſt ſtrong, and ſitting in the throne of honour for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who filleth wiſdom as Phiſon, and as Tigris in the daies of new fruites.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who replenisheth vnderſtanding as Euphrates, who multiplieth it as Iordan in the time of harueſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who ſendeth diſcipline as the light, and aſſiſting as Gehon in the day of vintage.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who firſt hath perfect knowledge of it, & a weaker shal not ſearche it out.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For her cogitation shal abound aboue the ſea, and her counſels aboue the greate depth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I wiſdom haue powred out riuers.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I as a ſluſe of a mightie water out of the riuer, I as the riuer Dioryx, & as a water coundite I came out of paradiſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I ſaid: I wil water my garden of plantes, and wil inebriate the fruite of my medow.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And behold my ſluſe was made aboundant, and my riuer came neere to a ſea.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Becauſe I illuminated doctrine to al as the morning light, & I wil declare it far.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I wil penetrate al the inferiour partes of the earth, and wil behold al that ſleepe, and wil illuminate al that hope in our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I wil yet powre out doctrine as prophecie, and wil leaue it to them that ſeeke wiſdom, and wil not ceaſe vnto their progenies euen to the holie age.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: See ye that I haue not laboured for myſelf only, but for al that ſeeke out the truth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: IN three thinges my ſpirit is pleaſed, which are approued before God, and men:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The concord of bretheren, and the loue of neighboures, and man and wife wel agreeing together.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Three ſortes my ſoule hateth, and I am greatly greeued at their life;
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A poore man proud: & a rich man a lyer: an old man a foole, and doting.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The thinges that thou haſt not gathered in thy youth, how shalt thou find them in thy old age?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: How beautiful is iudgement for a grey head, and for ancientes to know counſel!
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: How beautiful is wiſdom for the aged, & vnderſtanding glorious, and counſel!
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Much cunning is the croune of old men, and the feare of God is their glorie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Nine thinges not to be imagined of the hart haue I magnified, and the tenth I wil tel vnto men with my tongue:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man that hath ioy in his children; liuing and ſeeing the ſubuerſion of his enemies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Bleſſed is he that dwelleth with a wiſe woman; & that hath not offended with his tongue; and that hath not ſerued ſuch as are vnworthie of him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Bleſſed is he that findeth a true freind; and that declareth iuſtice to an eare that heareth:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: How great is he, that findeth wiſdom; and knowlege; but he is not aboue him that feareth our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The feare of God hath ſet it ſelf aboue al thinges:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: bleſſed is the man, to whom is geuen to haue the feare of God: he that holdeth it, to whom shal he be reſembled?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The feare of God is the beginning of his loue: and the beginning of faith is to be faſt ioyned vnto it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The heauines of the hart is al plague: & al malice, the wickednes of a woman.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he wil ſee al plague, and not the plague of the hart:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: & al wickednes, & not the wickednes of a woman:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and al obduction, and not the obduction of them that hate him:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and al reuenge, and not the reuenge of the enemies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is no head worſe then the head of a ſerpent:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and there is no anger aboue the anger of woman. It shal be more pleaſant to abide with a lyon and dragon, then to dwel with a wicked woman.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The wickednes of a woman changeth her face: and darkeneth her countenance as a beare: and wil shew it as a ſacke. In the middes of her neighbours,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: her husband groned, and hearing he ſighed a litle.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al malice is short to the malice of a woman, the lot of ſinners fal vpon her.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As the goeing vp a grauelie way in the feete of the aged, ſo a woman ful of tongue to a quiet man.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Looke not vpon a womans beautie, and deſire not a woman for beautie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A womans anger, and impudencie, and confuſion is great.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A woman if she haue ſuperioritie, is contrarie to her husband.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: An humbled hart, and heauie countenance, and plague of hart, is a wicked woman.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Feeble bandes, and diſiointed knees, a woman that doth not make her husband happie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: From woman came the beginning of ſinne, and by her we doe al die.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue not iſſue to thy water, no not a litle: nor to a wicked woman leaue, to goe forth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If she walke not at thine hand, she wil confound thee in the ſight of thyn enemies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Cut her off from thy flesh, leſt she alwaies abuſe thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: THE husband of a good wife is happie: for the number of his yeares is duble.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A ſtrong woman delighteth her husband, and shal accomplish the yeares of his life in peace.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A good woman is a good portion, in the good portion of them that feare God shal she be geuen to a man for good deedes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And the hart of rich and poore is good, at al time their countenance is merie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Of three thinges my hart hath bene afraid, and at the fourth my face hath trembled:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The betraying of a citie, and a gethering together of the people:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: falſe calumnie, al more greuous then death.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A ielous woman, is the ſorow and moorning of the hart.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In a ielous woman is a ſcourge of the tongue, communicating with al.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As a yoke of oxen, that is moued, ſo alſo a wicked woman: he that holdeth her, is as he that taketh hold of a ſcorpion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A woman geuen to drunkennes is great anger: & her contumelie and turpitude shal not be hid.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The fornication of a woman shal be knowen in the lifting vp of her eies, and in her cieliddes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: On thy daughter that turneth not away her ſelf, ſet ſure watche: leſt occaſion found she abuſe herſelf.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Take heede of the impudencie of her eies, and meruel not if she contemne thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As a wayfaring man that thirſteth, wil she open her mouth to the fountaine, and wil drinke of euerie water that is next, and wil ſit againſt euerie hedge, and open her quiuer againſt euerie arrow, vntil she faile.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The grace of a diligent woman shal delight her husband, and shal fatte his bones.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Her diſcipline is the gift of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wiſe and ſtil woman, there is no exchange for a ſoule inſtructed.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A holie, and shamefaſt woman, is grace vpon grace.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And al weight is not worthie a continent ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As the ſunne ryſing to the world in the higheſt places of God, ſo is the beautie of a good woman for an ornament of her houſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A lampe shyning vpon the holie candleſticke, & the beautie of the face vpon ſtayed age.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Pillars of gold vpon feete of ſiluer, and ſtable feete vpon the ſoules of a ſtayed woman.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Eternal fundations vpon a ſound rocke, and the commandments of God in the hart of a holie woman.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: At two thinges my hart is greeued, and at the third anger is come vpon me:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man of warre decaying by pouertie: and a wiſe man contemned:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he that tranſgreſſeth from iuſtice to ſinne, God hath prepared him to the ſword.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Two ſortes haue appeared vnto me hard and dangerous, a merchant is hardly rid of negligence: and a viteler shal not be iuſtified from the ſinnes of the lippes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: THROVGH pouertie manie haue offended: and he that ſeeketh to be made rich, turneth away his eie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As a ſtake is faſtened in the middes of ſtones compact together, ſo alſo in the middes of ſelling and buying, ſinne shal be ſtraytened.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sinne shal be deſtroyed with the ſinner.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou hold not thy ſelf inſtantly in the feare of our Lord, thy houſe shal quickly be ſubuerted.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As in the shaking of a ſieue the duſt wil remaine: ſo the perplexitie of a man in his cogitation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The fornace tryeth the potters veſſels, and the tentation of tribulation iuſt men.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As the huſbandrie about a tree sheweth the fruite thereof, ſo a word out of the thought of the hart of man.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Prayſe not a man before ful diſcourſe, for this is the trial of men.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou folow iuſtice, thou shalt apprehend it: and shalt put it on as a long robe of honour, and thou shalt dwel with it: and it shal protect thee for euer, and in the day of knowleging thou shalt finde ſtedfaſtnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The foules flocke together to their like: and truth shal returne to them, that worke it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The lion alwayes lyeth in wayte for a pray: ſo ſinnes for them that worke iniquities.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A holie man continueth in wiſdom as the ſunne: for a foole is changed as the moone.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the middes of the vnwiſe keepe the word til his time: but in the middes of deepe conſiderers be continually.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The narration of ſinners is odious, & their laughter is in the deligthes of ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Speach that ſweareth much shal make the heare of the head to ſtand vpright: and his lacke of reuerence is the ſtopping of the eares.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sheding of bloud is in the brawling of the proud: and their curſing is a greeuous hearing.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that diſcloſeth the ſecrete of a freind, loſeth credite, and he shal not finde a freind to his minde.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Loue thy neighbour, and be ioyned with him in fidelitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But if thou diſcouer his ſecrets, thou shalt not purſew after him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For as a man that loſeth his freind, ſo alſo he that loſeth the freindshipe of his neigbbour.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And as he that letteth a bird goe out of his hand, ſo haſt thou leaft thy neighbour, & shalt not take him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Folow him not, becauſe he is far abſent, for he is fled, as a doe out of the ſnare: becauſe his ſoule is wounded.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Thou canſt no more blinde him, and of a curſe there is reconciliation:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: but to diſcloſe the ſecrets of a freind, is the deſperation of an vnhappie ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that winketh with the eie, forgeth wicked thinges, and no man wil caſt him of:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: in the ſight of thyne eyes he wil ſweete his mouth, and wil be in admiration vpon thy wordes: but at the laſt he wil peruert his mouth, and in thy wordes he wil lay a ſcandal.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I haue heard manie thinges, & haue not eſteemed them equal to him, and our Lord wil hate him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that caſteth a ſtone on high, it wil fal vpon his head: and the deceitful ſtroke wil diuide the woundes of the deceitful.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that diggeth a pit, shal fal into it: and he that ſetteth a ſtone for his neighbour, shal ſtumble on it: & he that layeth a ſnare for an other, shal perish in it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: To a man that doth moſt wicked counſel, it shal be turned vpon himſelf, and he shal not know from whence it cometh to him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Deriſion & reproch of the proud, and vengeance as a lyon shal lie in waite for him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They shal perish in a ſnare that are delighted with the fal of the iuſt: and ſorow shal conſume them before they die.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Anger and furie, both are execrable, and the ſinful man shal be ſubiect to them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: HE that wil be reuenged, shal finde reuenge of our Lord, and keepeing he wil keepe his ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Forgeue thy neighbour hurting thee: & then shal thy ſinnes be looſed to thee when thou prayeſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Man to man reſerueth anger, and doth he ſeeke remedie of God?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He hath not mercie on a man like vnto himſelf, and doth he intreate for his owne ſinnes?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Himſelf whereas he is flesh, reſerueth anger, and doth he aske propitiation of God? Who by prayer shal obteyne for his ſinne?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Remember the laſt thinges, & ceaſe to be at enmitie:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for conſumption and death are imminent in his commandmentes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Remember the feare of God, and be not angrie with thy neighbour.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Remember the teſtament of the High, & contemne the ignorance of thy neighbour.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Refraine thyſelf from ſtrife, and thou shalt diminish thy ſinnes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for an angrie man kindleth ſtrife, and a ſinful man wil truble his freindes, and in the middes of them that are at peace he wil caſt in enmitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For according to the wood of the foreſt, ſo the fire burneth: and according to the power of a man, ſo shal his anger be, and according to his ſubſtance he wil increaſe his anger.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Haſtie contention kindleth a fire: and haſtie ſtrife shedeth bloud: and an il teſtifying tongue bringeth death.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou blow vpon a ſparck, it wil burne as a fire: and if thou ſpitte thereon, it shal be quenched: both procede out of the mouth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The whiſperer & duble tounged is accurſt: for he hath trubled manie that were at peace.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A third tongue hath moued manie, and diſperſed them from one nation into nation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: It hath deſtroyed the walled citie of the rich, and hath digged downe the houſes of great men.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: It hath cut the forces of peoples, and vndone ſtrong nations.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A third tongue hath caſt out manlie wemen, and depriued them of their labours.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that regardeth it, shal not haue reſt, neither shal he haue a freind in whom he may repoſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The ſtroke of a whippe maketh a blew marke: but the ſtroke of the tongue wil breake the bones.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Manie haue fallen by the edge of the ſword, but not ſo as they that haue perished by their tongue.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Bleſſed is he that is couered from a wicked tongue, that hath not paſſed into the anger therof, and that hath not drawen the yoke therof, and hath not bene tyed in the bandes therof:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for the yoke of it, is a yoke of yron: and the band of it is a band of braſſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The death of it, is a moſt wicked death: and hel is more profitable then it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The continuance of it shal not be permanent, but it shal obteyne the waies of the vniuſt: and it shal not burne the iuſt in the flame therof.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They that forſake God, shal fal into it, and it shal burne in them, and shal not be quenched, and it shal be ſent in vpon them as a lion, and as a leopard it shal hurt them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Hedge thine eares with thornes, and heare not a wicked tongue, and make doores to thy mouth, and locks.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Lay together thy ſiluer, and make balance to thy wordes, and right bridles to thy mouth:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and take heede leſt perhaps thou ſlippe in thy tongue, & fal in the ſight of the enemies, that lie in wayte for thee, and thy fal be vncurable vnto death.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: HE that lendeth to his neighbour, doth mercie: and he that preuayleth with hand, keepeth the commandmentes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Lend to thy neighbour in the time of his neceſſitie, and againe repay thy neighbour in his time.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Confirme thy word, and doe faithfully with him: & thou shalt finde at al time, that which is neceſſarie for thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Manie haue eſteemed a thing lent as a thing found, and haue geuen moleſtation to them that did helpe them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Til they receiue, they kiſſe the handes of the lender, and in promiſes they humble their voice:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and in the time of repaying they wil aske a time, and wil ſpeake wordes of tediouſnes and murmurings, and wil make the time an excuſe:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and if he be able to pay, he wil reſiſt, he wil pay ſcarſe halfe of the whole, and wil account it as a thing found:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: but if not, he wil defraude him of his money, and poſſeſſe him an enemie without cauſe:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and wil repay him reproches and curſes, and for honour and benefite wil repay him contumelie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Manie haue not lent, not becauſe of wickednes, but they were afraid to be defrauded without cauſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But yet vpon the humble be ſtronger of minde, & for almes differre him not.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Becauſe of the commandment receiue the poore: and becauſe of his pouertie, ſend him not away emptie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Loſe money for thy brother and thy freind: and hide it not vnder a ſtone vnto perdition.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Put thy treaſure in the precepts of the Higheſt, & it shal profite thee more then gold.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Shut vp almes in the hart of the poore, and the ſame shal obteyne for thee againſt al euil.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Aboue the shilde of the mightie,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: & aboue the ſpeare, it shal fight againſt thyne enemie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A good man becometh ſuretie for his neighbour: and he that hath loſt shame, wil leaue him to himſelf.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Forget not the kindnes of a ſuertie: for he hath geuen his life for thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The ſinner and vncleane perſon fleeth from his ſuretie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A ſinner counteth the goodes of his ſuretie to himſelf: and vnthankful in minde, wil forſake him that deliuered him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man is ſuretie for his neigbour: and when he hath loſt shame, he shal be forſaken of him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Naughtie ſuretieshippe hath vndone manie, that were in good caſe, and hath toſſed them as a waue of the ſea.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Whurling round about, it hath made mightie men to remoue, and they haue wandred in ſtrange nations.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A ſinner that trangreſſeth the commandment of our Lord, shal fal into naughtie ſuretieshippe: and he that endeuoureth to doe manie thinges, shal fal into iudgement.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Recouer thy neighbour according to thy power, and take heede to thy ſelf that thou fal not.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The beginning of mans life water & bread, and garment, and houſe couering his turpitude.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Better is the poore mans fayre vnder a roofe of bordes, then ſumptuous cheere in a ſtrange place without a houſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Let the leaſt thing pleaſe thee in ſteede of a great, and thou shalt not heare the reproch of peregrination.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: It is a naughtie life to change lodging from houſe to houſe: and where he shal lodge, he shal not deale boldely, nor open his mouth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He shal lodge, and feede, and make the vnthanckful drinke, and beſide theſe thinges he shal heare bitter wordes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Paſſe thou ſtranger, & furnish the table, & with the thinges thou haſt in thy hand, feede the reſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Depart from the preſence of the honour of my freindes: for the neceſſitie of my houſe my brother is to be lodged with me.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Theſe thinges be greuous to a man that hath vnderſtanding: rebuke for the houſe, and the reproch of the lender.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: HE that loueth his ſoune, doth accuſtome him to ſtripes, that he may reioyce in his later end, and not grope after the doores of his neighboures.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that teacheth his ſonne, shal be praiſed in him, & in the middes of them of his houshold he shal glorie in him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that teacheth his ſonne, doth caſt the enemie into emulation, and in the middes of his freindes he shal glorie in him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: His father is dead, & he is as it were not dead: for he hath left behind him the like to himſelf.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In his life he ſawe and reioyced in him: in his death he was not made ſorie, neither was he confounded before the enemies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For he left a defender of his houſe againſt the enemies, & one that should render thanck to his freindes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For the ſoules of his ſonnes he wil binde vp his woundes, & at euerie voice his bowels shal be trubled.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: An vntamed horſe becometh ſtubburne, and a diſſolute childe wil become headie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Pamper thy ſonne, and he wil make thee afraid: play with him, and he wil make thee ſorowful.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Laugh not with him, leſt thou be ſorie, and at the laſt thy teeth shal be on edge.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue him not power in his youth, and contemne not his cogitations.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Curbe his necke in youth, and knock his ſides whiles he is a childe, leſt perhaps he be hardned, and beleeue thee not, and he shal be ſorow of minde to thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Teach thy ſonne, and worke in him, that thou offend not in his dishoneſtie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Better is a poore man whole, and ſtrong of force, then a rich man weake and ſcourged with miſerie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The health of the ſoule in holines of iuſtice, is better then al gold and ſiluer: and a ſound bodie, then infinite reuenewes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is no riches aboue the riches of the health of the bodie: and there is noe delight aboue the ioy of the hart.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Better is death then a bitter life: and euerlaſting reſt, then continual ſicknes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Good thinges hid in a mouth that is shut, are as meſſes of meates ſet about a graue.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: What shal ſacrifice profite an idol? for neither shal he eate, nor ſmel:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: ſo he that is chaſed away of our Lord, beareth the rewardes of iniquitie:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: ſeing with his eies, & groning, as an eunuch embracing a virgin and ſighing.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue not heuines to thy ſoule, & afflict not thyſelf in thy counſel.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ioyfulnes of the hart, this is the life of a man, and a treaſure without defect of holines: and the ioy of a man is long life.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Haue mercie on thine owne ſoule, pleaſing God, and refraine: and comfort thy hart in his holines: and expel ſorow far from thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For ſorow hath killed manie, and there is noe profite in it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Enuie and anger diminish the daies, and thought wil bring old age before the time.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A magnifical hart, is good in bankettes: for his bankettes are made diligently.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: WATCHING after honeſtie shal pine the flesh, & the thought thereof taketh away ſleepe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The thought of foreknowlege turneth away the vnderſtanding, & greuous infirmitie maketh a ſober ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The riche man hath laboured in gathering of ſubſtance together, & in his reſt he shal be replenished with his goodes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The poore man hath laboured in the diminishing of his liuing, and in the end he is made poore.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that loueth gold shal not be iuſtified: & he that foloweth after corruption, shal be replenished of it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Manie haue bene geuen into falles for gold, and their perdition hath come by the beautie thereof.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The gold of them that ſacrifice is a wood of offence: wo to them, that folow after it, and euerie vnwiſe man shal perish in it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Bleſſed is the rich man that is found without ſpot: and that hath not gone after gold, nor hoped in money and treaſures.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who is this, & we wil praiſe him, for he hath done meruelous thinges in his life.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who is proued therin, & perfect, shal haue eternal glorie. He that could tranſgreſſe, and hath not tranſgreſſed: and doe euils, and hath not done:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: therfore are his good thinges ſtablished in our Lord, & al the church of ſaintes shal declare his almes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Art thou ſet at a great table? open not thy iawe thereupon firſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Say not this: There be manie thinges which are vpon it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Remember that a naughtie eie is euil.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: What is created worſe then the eie? therefore shal it weepe at euerie face. When it shal ſee,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: ſtretch not out thy hand firſt, and ſo contaminated with enuie thou be ashamed.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not oppreſſed in a feaſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Vnderſtand by thyſelf what thy neighbours thinges are.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Vſe as a frugal man thoſe thinges, that are ſet before thee: leſt thou be hated when thou eateſt much.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Leaue of firſt, for maners ſake, and exceede not, leſt thou perhaps offend.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And if thou be ſet in the middes of manie, ſtretch not forth thy hand before them: neither doe thou firſt aske to drinke.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: How ſufficient is a little wine for a man wel taught, and in ſleeping thou shalt not be pained with it, and thou shalt feele no griefe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Watching, & choler, & torment to an vnſatiable man:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: ſleepe of health is in a man of ſpare diet: he shal ſleepe until morning, and his ſoule with him shal be deligted.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And if thou haſt bene forced with eating much, riſe from the middes, and vomite, and it shal refresh thee, and thou shalt not bring infirmitie to thy bodie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Heare me my ſonne, and deſpiſe me not: and in the end thou shalt finde my wordes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In al thy workes be quicke, and al infirmitie shal not chance vnto thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The lippes of manie shal bleſſe him that is magnifical in breads, and the teſtimonie of his truth is faithful.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In naughtie bread the cittie wil murmur, and the teſtimonie of the naughtines thereof is true.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Prouoke not them that loue wine: for wine hath deſtroyed very manie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Fire tryeth hard yron: ſo wine dronken in drunkennes shal rebuke the hartes of the proud.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Equal life to al men, wine in ſobrietie: if thou drinke it moderatly, thou shalt be ſober.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: What is the life that is diminished with wine?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: What defraudeth life? death.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Wine was created for ioyfulnes, and not for drunkennes from the beginning.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Wine drunken moderately is the ioy of the ſoule, and the hart.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sober drinking is health to ſoule and bodie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Much wine drunken maketh prouocation, & wrath, & manie ruines.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Much wine drunken is bitternes of the ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The couragiouſnes of drunkennes, is offence of the vnwiſe, leſſening the ſtrength, and making woundes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In a banquet of wine rebuke not thy neighbour: and deſpiſe him not in his mirth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Speake nor to him wordes of repoch: and preſſe him not in demanding againe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: HAVE they made thee Ruler? be not extolled: be among them as one of them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Haue care of them, and ſo ſitte thou ſtil, and al thy care being diſpatched, repoſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: That thou maiſt reioyce for their ſakes, & receiue a crowne as an ornament of grace, and obteyne the dignitie of the contribution.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Speake thou that art elder: for it becometh thee,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: the firſt word to him that loueth with knowlege, & hinder not muſike.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Where there is no hearing, power not out ſpeache, and extol not thyſelf out of time in thy wiſdom.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A litle pearle of the carbuncle in an ornament of gold, and the compariſon of muſicians in a banket of wine.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As a ſignet of the emerauld is in the working of gold: ſo the melodie of muſike in ioyful and moderate wine.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Heare holding thy peace, & for thy reuerence good grace shal come to thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Yong man ſpeake in thine owne cauſe ſcarſely.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou be asked twiſe, let thyne anſwer haue an head.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In manie thinges be as it were ignorant, and heare holding thy peace and withal asking.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the middes of greate men preſume not: and where ancients are, ſpeake not much.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before haile there shal goe lightning: & grace shal goe before shamfaſtnes, & for thy reuerence good grace shal come to thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And at the houre of ryſing ſlacke not thyſelf: but runne before firſt into thy houſe, and there withdraw thyſelf, and there play,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and doe thy conceites, and not in ſinnes and proud word.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And aboue al theſe thinges bleſſe our Lord, that made thee, & that doth replenish thee with al his goodes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that feareth our Lord, shal receiue his doctrine: and they that wil watch after him, shal finde bleſſing.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that ſeeketh the law, shal be replenished with it: and he that doth deceitfully, shal be ſcandalized by it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They that feare our Lord, shal finde iuſt iudgement, and shal kindle iuſtices as light.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A ſinful man wil flee reprehenſion, and according to his wil, wil finde excuſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man of counſel wil not deſtroy vnderſtanding, an aliene and proud man wil not dread feare:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Yea after he hath done with feare without counſel, he shal be controwled euen by his owne purſuites.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne doe nothing without counſel, and after the fact thou shalt not repent.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Goe not in the way of ruine, and thou shalt not ſtumble at ſtones: commite not thyſelf to a laborious way, leſt thou ſet a ſcandal to thy ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And beware of thy children, and take heede of them of thy houſehold.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In al thy worke beleue thy ſoule by faith: for this is the keeping of the commandmentes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that beleueth God, attendeth to the commandmentes: and he that truſteth in him, shal not be leſſened.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: TO him that feareth our Lord euils shal not happen, but in tentation God wil keepe him, and deliuer him from euils.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wiſe man hateth not the commandments and iuſtices, and he shal not be shaken as a shippe in a ſtorme.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man of vnderſtanding beleueth the law of God, and the law is ſure to him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that repeteth an interrogation, shal better prepare his anſwer, and ſo shal be heard, and shal keepe diſcipline.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The hart of a foole is as a wheele of a carte: & his cogitation as a turning axeltree.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A ſtalion horſe neyeth vnder euerie one that ſitteth vpon him, ſo a freind that is a ſcorner.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Why doth one day excel an other, and one light an other, and one yeare an other yeare of the ſunne?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: By the knowlege of our Lord they were ſeperated, the ſunne being made, and keeping the precept.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he changed times, and the feſtiual daies thereof, and in the ſame they celebrated the feſtiual daies at an houre.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Of them God exalted and magnified, and of them he put into the number of daies. And al men are of the ground, and of the earth, from whence Adam was created.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the multitude of the diſcipline of our Lord he ſeparated them, and changed their waies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Of them he bleſſed, and exalted: and of them he ſanctified, and applied to himſelf: and of them he curſed and humbled, and conuerted them from their ſeparation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As potters clay is in his hand, to fashion and diſpoſe it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al his wayes according to his diſpoſition: ſo man in the hand of him, and he wil render to him according to his iudgement.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Againſt euil is good, and againſt death life: ſo alſo againſt a iuſt man a ſinner. And ſo looke vpon al the workes of the Higheſt. Two againſt two, and one againſt one.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And I awaked laſt, and as he that gathereth bearies after the grape gatherers.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the bleſſing of God I alſo haue hoped: and as he that gathereth grapes, haue I filled the wine preſſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: See that I haue not laboured for myſelf only, but for al that ſeeke out diſcipline.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Heare me ye great men, and al peoples, and ye rulers of the Church harken with your eares.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: To ſonne and wife, brother and freind, geue not power ouer thee in thy life: and geue not thy poſſeſſion to an other: leſt perhaps thou repent thee, and thou entreate for them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Whiles thou art yet aliue and takeſt breath, al flesh shal not change thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For it is better that thy children aske of thee, then that thou looke toward the hands of thy children.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In al thy workes be exquiſite.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue no ſtaine to thy glorie. In the day of the conſummation of the dayes of thy life, and in the time of thy deceaſe diſtribute thine inheritance.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Fodder, and wande, and burden for an aſſe: bread, and diſcipline, and worke for a ſeruant.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He worketh in diſcipline, and ſeeketh to reſt: releaſe him his handes, and he ſeeketh libertie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The yoke and the reyne bend a ſtiff necke, and continual workes do bowe a ſeruant.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For a malicious ſeruant torment & fetters, ſend him into worke, that he be not idle.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For idlenes hath taught much naughtines.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Set him to worke: for ſo it becometh him. And if he be not obedient, bow him with fetters, and exceede not ouer al flesh: but without iudgement doe no greuous thing.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou haue a faithful ſeruant, let him be vnto thee as thy ſoule: as a brother ſo entreate him: becauſe in the bloud of thy ſoule thou haſt gotten him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If thou hurt him vniuſtly, he wil runne away:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: if riſing vp he depart: thou knoweſt not whom to aske, and what way to ſeeke him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: VAINE hope, & lying is to a foolish man: & dreames extol the vnwiſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As he that apprehendeth a shadow, and purſueth the winde: ſo is he alſo that attendeth to lying viſions.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: According to this is the viſion of dreames: as a mans ſimilitude before the face of a man.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Of the vncleane what shal be made cleane? and of a lyer what truth shal be ſaid?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Diuination of errour, and lying ſouthſayinges, and the dreames of them that do euil, are vanitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And as a woman that traueleth thy hart ſuffereth phantaſies: vnleſſe it be a viſion ſent forth from the Higheſt, ſet not thy hart vpon them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For dreames haue made manie to erre, and they that hoped in them haue failed.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The word of the law shal be fulfilled without lying, and wiſedom in the mouth of the faithful shal be made plaine.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that hath not bene proued, what knoweth he? A man expert in manie thinges, shal thinck manie thinges: and he that hath lerned manie thinges, shal declare vnderſtanding.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that is not tryed, knoweth few thinges: and he that hath bene in manie things, multiplyeth wickednes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that hath not bene proued, what maner of thinges knoweth he? He that is deceiued, shal abound with wickednes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I haue ſeene manie thinges in wandring to and fro, and very manie fashions of words:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Some times I haue bene in danger vnto death for theſe thinges, and I was deliuered by the grace of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The ſpirit of them that feare God is ſought, & at his ſight shal be bleſſed.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For their hope is on him that ſaueth them, and the eies of God vpon them that loue him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that feareth our Lord shal tremble at nothing, and shal not dread: becauſe he is his hope.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: His ſoule is bleſſed that feareth our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: To whom doth he looke, and who is his ſtrength?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The eies of our Lord are vpon them that feare him, a protectour of might, a ſtay of ſtrength, a couer from the heate, and shadow for the noone time,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: a ſauing from offence, and helpe from falling, exalting the ſoule, and illuminating the eies, geuing health, and life, and bleſſing.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The oblation of him that immolateth of an vniuſt thing is ſpotted, and the ſcorninges of the vniuſt are not acceptable.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Our Lord is onlie theirs that expect him, in the way of truth and iuſtice.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The Higheſt alloweth not the giftes of the wicked: neither hath he regard to the oblations of the vniuſt, neither wil he be made propitious for ſinnes by the multitude of their ſacrifices.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that offereth ſacrifice of poore mens ſubſtance, is as he that ſacrificeth the ſonne in the preſence of his father.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The bread of the needie, is the life of the poore: he that defraudeth it, is a man of bloud.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that taketh away bread in ſwet, is as he that killeth his neighbour.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that sheddeth bloud, and that defraudeth the hired man, are bretheren.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: One building, and an other deſtroing: what profite haue they but the labour?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: One praying, and an other curſing: whether's voice wil God heare?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that is washed from the dead, and toucheth him againe, what doth his washing profit?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: ſo a man that faſteth in his ſinnes: and doing the ſame againe, what doth he profite in humbling himſelf? who wil heare his prayer?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: HE that keepeth the law, multiplieth oblation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: It is an holſome ſacrifice, to attend to the commandments, and to depart from al iniquitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: To depart from iniquitie is a thing that pleaſeth our Lord wel: and to depart from iniuſtice is an intreating for ſinnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Thou shalt not appeare before the ſight of our Lord emptie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For al theſe thinges are done becauſe of the commandment of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The oblation of the iuſt maketh a fatte altar, and is an odour of ſweetenes in the ſight of the Higheſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The ſacrifice of the iuſt is acceptable, and our Lord wil not forget the memorie thereof.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Render glorie to God with a good minde: and diminish not the firſt fruites of thine handes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In euerie gift make thy countenance chereful, and in ioyfulnes ſanctifie thy tithes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue to the Higheſt according to his gift, and with a good eie, doe according to the abilitie of thine handes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: becauſe our Lord is a rewarder, and wil repay thee ſeuen times ſo much.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Offer not wicked giftes, for he wil not receiue them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And looke not vpon an vniuſt ſacrifice, becauſe our Lord is iudge, and there is not with him the glorie of perſon.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Our Lord wil not accept perſon againſt the poore, and he wil heare the prayer of him that is hurt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He wil not deſpiſe the prayers of the pupil: nor the widow, if she power out ſpeach of mourning.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Do not the widows teares runne downe to the cheeke, & her exclamation vpon him that cauſeth them to runne?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For from the cheeke they goe vp euen to heauen, and our Lord the hearer wil not be delighted in them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that adoreth God in delectation, shal be receiued, & his petition shal approch euen to the cloudes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The prayer of him that humbleth himſelf, shal penetrate the cloudes: and til it approch he wil not be comforted: and he wil not depart til the Higheſt behold.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And our Lord wil not be long, but wil iudge the iuſt, and wil do iudgement: and the ſtrongeſt wil not haue patience in them, that he may crush their backe:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he wil repay vengeance to the Gentiles, til he take away the multitude of the proude: & breake the ſcepters of the vniuſt;
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: til he reward men according to their doings: and according to the workes of man, and according to his preſumption,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: til he iudge the iudgement of his people, and shal delight the iuſt with his mercie:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The mercie of God is beautiful in the time of tribulation, as a cloude of raine in the time of drught.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: HAVE mercie vpon vs ô God of al, and reſpect vs, and shew vs the light of thy mercies:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and ſend in thy feare vpon the nations, that haue not ſought after thee, that they may know that there is no God but thou, and that they may shew forth thy glorious thinges.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Lift vp thy hand ouer the ſtrange Nations, that they may ſee thy might.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For as in their ſight thou art ſanctified in vs, ſo in our ſight thou shalt be magnified in them,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: that they may know thee, as we alſo haue knowen, that there is no God beſide thee ô Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Renewe ſignes, and change meruels.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Glorifie thy hand, and thy right arme.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Raiſe vp furie, and power out wrath.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Take away the aduerſarie, and afflict the enemie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Haſten the time, and remember the end, that they may declare thy meruels.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Let him that is ſaued be deuoured in the wrath of flame: and let them that euil intreate thy people, finde perdition.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Breake the head of princes of the enemies, that ſaie: There is none other beſide vs.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Gather together al the tribes of Iacob: and let them know that there is no God but thou, that they may declare thy great workes: & thou shalt inherite them as from the beginning.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Haue mercie on thy people, vpon which thy name is inuocated: and vpon Iſrael, whom thou haſt made equal to thy firſt begotten.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Haue mercie on the citie of thy ſanctification Ieruſalem, the citie of thy reſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Replenish Sion with thy wordes that can not be vttered, & thy people with thy glorie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue the teſtimonie to them, that are thy creatures from the beginning, and raiſe vp the prophecies, which the former prophets ſpake in thy name.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue reward to them that patiently expect thee, that thy prophets may be found faithful: and heare the prayers of thy ſeruants,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: according to Aarons benediction of thy people, and direct vs into the way of iuſtice, and let al knowe that inhabite the earth, that thou art God the beholder of the worldes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The bellie wil eate al meate, and one meate is better then an other meate.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The iawes taiſt veniſon, & the wiſe hart lying wordes,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A peruerſe hart wil geue ſorow, and a cunning man wil reſiſt it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Some woman wil receiue euerie man: and one daughter is better then an other daughter.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The beautie of a woman chereth the face of her husband, and increaſeth the deſire aboue al mans concupiſcence.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If there be a tongue of curing, there is alſo of mitigating and of mercie: her husband is not according to the ſonnes of men.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that poſſeſſeth a good woman, beginneth riches: she is an helpe like vnto him, & a piller as reſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Where there is no hedge, the poſſeſſion shal be ſpoiled: and where there is no wife, he mourneth wanting.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who doth credite him that hath no neſt, and turning aſide whereſoeuer it waxeth darke, as a robber girded, leaping from citie to citie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: EVERIE freind wil ſay: I alſo haue ioyned freindshipe: but there is a freind, in name only a freind. Doth there not ſorow remaine euen to death?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But a companion and freind wil be turned to enmitie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: O moſt wicked preſumption, whence waſt thou created to couer the drie land with malice, and with the deceitfulnes thereof?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A companion is pleaſant with his freind in delectations, and in the time of tribulation he wil be an aduerſarie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A companion is ſorie with his freind for his bellies ſake, and he wil take a shield againſt the enemie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Forgete not thy freind in thy minde, and be not vnmindeful of him in thy riches.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Conſult not with him which betraieth, and hide thy counſel from them that enuie thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Euerie counſeler vttereth counſel, but there is a counſeler in him ſelfe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: From ſuch a counſeler kepe thy ſoule. Firſt know what his neceſſitie is: for he wil deuiſe to his owne minde:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: leſt perhaps he thruſt a sharpe ſtake into the ground and ſay to thee:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Thy way is good; and ſtand ouer againſt thee to ſee what wil befal thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: With an irreligious man treate not of holines, and with the vniuſt of iuſtice, and with a woman of the thing whereof she is ielous: with a feareful man of warre, with a marchant of traficke, with a byer of ſelling, with an enuious man of geuing thankes,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: with the impious of pietie, with the vnhoneſt of honeſtie, with the field labourer of al worke,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: with him that worketh by the yeare of the ending of the yeare, with a ſlothful ſeruant of much working: attend not to theſe in al counſel.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But be continual with a holie man, whomſoeuer thou shalt know to obſerue the feare of God,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: whoſe ſoule is according to thine owne ſoule: and who when thou shalt ſtumble in the darke, wil be ſorie for thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And eſtablish with thy ſelf an hart of good counſel: for there is none other thing more worth to thee then it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The ſoule of a holie man vttereth ſometime true thinges, more then ſeuen watchmen that ſitte in a high place to watch.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And in al theſe beſeech the Higheſt, that he direct thy way in truth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before al workes let a true word goe before thee, and ſtable counſel before euerie act.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wicked word shal change the hart: out of which riſe foure partes, good, and euil, life, and death: and the tongue is a continual ruler of them. There is a ſubtile man teacher of manie, and to his owne ſoule he is vnprofitable.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A cunning man hath taught manie, and is ſwete to his owne ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that ſpeaketh ſophiſtically, is odious: in euerie thing he shal be defrauded.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Grace is not geuen him of our Lord: for he is defrauded of al wiſdom.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is a wiſe man, wiſe to his owne ſoule: and the fruite of his vnderſtanding is laudable.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wiſe man teacheth his people, and the fruites of his vnderſtanding are faithful.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wiſe man shal be filled with bleſſinges, and they that ſee wil praiſe him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The life of a man is in the number of dayes: but the dayes of Iſrael are innumerable.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A wiſe man in the people shal inherite honour, and his name shal liue for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne in thy life proue thy ſoule: & if it be wicked, geue it not power:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for al thinges are not expedient for al, and euerie kinde pleaſeth not euerie ſoule.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be not greedie in al feaſting, and power not out thy ſelf vpon al meate:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for in manie meates there shal be infirmitie, and greedines shal approch euen to choler.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Becauſe of ſurfet manie haue died: but he that is abſtinent, shal adde life.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: HONOVR the phiſition for neceſſitie: for the Higheſt hath created him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For al medicine is of God, & it shal receiue gift of the king.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The knowlege of the phiſition shal exalt his head, and in the ſight of great men he shal be praiſed.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The Higheſt hath created medicines of the earth, and a wiſe man wil not abhorre them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Was not bitter water made ſweete by wood?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The vertue of theſe thinges is come to the knowlege of men, and the Higheſt hath geuen knowlege to men, for to be honoured in his meruelous thinges.
label: Ecclesiasticus
