text: Curing with theſe thinges he shal mitigate paine, and the apothecarie shal make confections of ſwetenes, and shal make ointments of health, and his workes shal not be conſummated.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For the peace of God is vpon the face of the earth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne in thine infirmitie contemne not thy ſelf, but pray our Lord, and he wil cure thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Turne away from ſinne, and direct thy handes, and from al offence cleanſe thy hart.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue ſwetenes and a memorial of fine floure, and make a fat oblation, and geue place to the phiſition.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For our Lord created him: and let him not depart from thee, becauſe his workes be neceſſarie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For there is a time when thou maiſt fal into their handes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and they shal beſeech our Lord, that he direct their reſt, and healing; for their conuerſation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He that ſinneth in his ſight, that made him, shal fal into the handes of the phiſition.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne vpon the dead shed teares, and beginne to weepe as hauing ſuffered doleful thinges, and according to iudgement couer his bodie, and neglect not his burial.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But for detraction beare bitterly the mourning of him one day, and be comforted for the heauines,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and make mourning according to his deſert one day, or two, becauſe of detraction.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For by heauines death haſteneth, and it couereth the ſtrength, and ſorow of the hart boweth the necke.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In abſtraction ſorow is permanent: and the ſubſtance of the poore is according to his hart.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue not thine hart into heauines, but expel it from thee: and remember the latter endes,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and forget not: for neither is there returne, and him thou shalt profit nothing, and thou shalt hurt thy ſelf.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be mindful of my iudgement: for thine alſo muſt be ſo: to me yeſterday, and to thee to day.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the repoſe of the dead make the memorie of him to reſt, and comfort him in the departing of his ſpirit.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The wiſdom of a ſcribe in the time of vacance: and he that is leſſe in action, shal receiue wiſdom.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: With what wiſdom shal he be replenished, that holdeth the plough, and glorieth in the goade, driueth oxen with the prickle, and conuerſeth in their workes, and his talke is in the breede of bulles?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He wil geue his hart to turne vp furrowes, and his watching in the feeding of kine.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: So euerie craftſman and workemaſter that paſſeth the night as the day, that maketh grauen ſeales, and his continual diligence varieth the picture: he wil geue his hart to the ſimilitude of the picture, and his watching wil perfect the worke.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: So the yronſmith ſitting by the anuil and conſidering the worke of yron. The vapour of the fire wil parche his flesh, and he ſtriueth in the heate of the fournace:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The noyſe of the hammer reneweth his eare, and his eye is againſt the ſimilitude of the veſſel.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He wil geue his hart to the finishing of the workes, and his watching wil polish to perfection.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: So the potter ſitting at his worke, turning the wheele with his feete, who is alwayes ſet in carefulnes for his worke, and al his working is in number:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: With his arme he wil fashion the clay, and before his feete he wil bend his ſtrength:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He wil geue his hart to finish the vernishing thereof, and his watching wil make cleane the fournace.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al theſe haue hoped in their handes, and euerie one is wiſe in his owne art.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Without theſe a citie is not built.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And they shal not inhabite, nor walke therein, and they shal not leape high into the congregation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Vpon the iudges ſeate they shal not ſitte, and the ordinance of iudgement they shal not vnderſtand, neither shal they declare diſcipline and iudgement, and in parables they shal not be found:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: but they shal confirme the creature of the world, and their prayer shal be in the worke of their art, applying their ſoule, & ſearching in the law of the Higheſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: THE wiſe man wil ſearch out the wiſdom of al the ancientes, and wil be occupied in the prophetes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He wil keepe the narration of famous men, and wil enter withal into the ſubtilities of parables.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He wil ſearch out the hidden ſenſes of prouerbes, and wil conuerſe in the ſecretes of parables.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the middes of great men he wil miniſter, and in the ſight of the preſident he shal appeare.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He shal paſſe into the land of ſtrange nations: for he shal trie good and euil in men.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He wil geue his hart to watch early vnto our Lord, that made him, and he wil pray in the ſight of the Higheſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He wil open his mouth in prayer, and wil entreate for his ſinnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For if it shal pleaſe our great Lord, he wil fil him with the ſpirit of vnderſtanding:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he wil power forth the wordes of his wiſdom as showres, and in prayer wil confeſſe to our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he wil direct his counſel, and diſcipline, and in his ſecretes he wil conſult.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He wil open the diſcipline of his doctrine, and wil glorie in the law of the teſtament of our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Manie wil praiſe his wiſdom, and it shal not be abolished for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The memorie of him shal not depart, and his name shal be required from generation to generation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Nations shal declare his wiſdom, and the church wil shew forth his praiſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: If he continew, he shal leaue a name more then a thouſand: and if he reſt, it shal profite him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I wil yet conſult that I may declare: For as with furie I am replenished.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In voice he ſaith: Heare me ye diuine fruites, and as the roſe planted vpon the riuers of waters fructifie ye.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As Libanus haue ye the odours of ſweetnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Florish ye flowres, as the lilie, and geue forth an odour, and bring forth leaues in grace, and praiſe with ſongue, and bleſſe our Lord in his workes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Geue magnificence to his name, and confeſſe vnto him in the voice of your lippes, and in ſongues of the lippes, and harpes, & thus shal ye ſay in confeſſion:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al the workes of our Lord are exceeding good.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: At his word the water ſtood as an heape: and at the word of his mouth as it were receptacles of waters:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: becauſe in his commandment placabilitie is made, and there is no diminishing of his ſaluation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The workes of al flesh are before him, and there is nothing hid from his eyes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: From world to world he beholdeth, and nothing is meruelous in his ſight.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: It is not to be ſaied: What is this, or what is that? for al thinges shal be ſought in their time.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: His bleſſing hath ouerflowed as a ſtreame.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And as a flood hath watered the drie land, ſo his wrath shal inherite the nations, that haue not ſought him:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: euen as he turned waters into drught, and the earth was made drie: and his waies are direct to the waies of them: ſo to ſinners ſtumbling blockes in his wrath.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Good thinges were created for the good from the beginning, ſo for the wicked, good thinges and euil.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The beginning of the thing neceſſarie for the life of men, water, fire, and yron, ſalt, milke, and bread of flower, and honie, and the cluſter of grape, and oyle, & clothing.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al theſe shal be conuerted to ſaintes into good, ſo alſo to the impious and to ſinners into euil.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There are ſpirites, that were created for vengeance, and in their furie they haue confirmed their tormentes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: in the time of conſummation they shal power out ſtrength: and they shal accomplish the furie of him, that made them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Fire, haile, famine, and death, al theſe were created for vengeance:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: the teeth of beaſtes, and ſcorpions, and ſerpentes, and ſword reuenging the impious vnto deſtruction:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In his commandmentes they shal make merrie, and on the earth they shal be prepared when nede is, and in their times they shal not pretermitte a word.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Therefore from the beginning I was confirmed, and I haue conſulted, and thought, and leaft written.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al the workes of our Lord are good, & he wil geue euerie worke in his houre.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: It is not to be ſaid: This is worſe then that: for al shal be approued in their time.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And now with al hart and mouth praiſe ye, and bleſſe the name of our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: GREAT trauel is created to al men, and an heauie yoke vpon the children of Adam, from the day of their coming forth of their mothers wombe, vntil the day of their burying, into the mother of al.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Their cogitations, and feares of the hart, imagination of thinges to come, and the day of their ending:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: from him that ſitteth vpon the glorious ſeate, vnto him that is humbled in earth & ashes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: From him that weareth hyacinth, and beareth the crowne, euen to him, that is couered with rude linen: furie, enuie, tumult, wauering, and the feare of death, anger perſeuering, and contention,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and in the time of repoſe in bed, the ſleepe of night changeth his knowlege.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A litle is as nothing in reſt, and afterward in ſleepe, as in the day of watche.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He is trubled in the viſion of his hart, as he that hath eſcaped in the day of battel. In the time of his ſafetie he roſe vp, and merueleth at noe feare:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: With al flesh, from man euen to beaſt, and vpon ſinners ſeuenfold.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Beſide theſe thinges, death, bloud, contention, and ſword, oppreſſions, famine, and contrition, and ſcourges:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for the wicked al theſe were created, and for them the floud was made.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al thinges that are of the earth, shal turne into the earth, and al waters shal returne into the ſea.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al bribing, and iniquitie shal be cleane taken away, and fidelitie shal ſtand for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The riches of the vniuſt shal be dried vp as a riuer, and they shal ſound as great thunder in rayne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In opening his handes he shal reioyce: ſo tranſgreſſors shal pine away in conſumption.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The nephewes of the impious shal not multiplie boughes, nor vncleane rootes ſound vpon the toppe of a rocke.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ouer al water grennes, and at the brincke of the riuer it shal be plucked vp before al graſſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Grace is as paradiſe in bleſſinges, and mercie remayneth for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The life of a workeman that is ſufficient for himſelf shal be ſweete, and in it thou shalt finde a treaſure.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Children, and building of a citie shal confirme the name, and an vnſpotted woman shal be counted aboue this.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Wine and muſicke make a ioyful hart: and the loue of wiſedom is aboue both.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Shalmes, and Pſalterie make ſweete melodie, and a ſweete tongue is aboue both.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Thine eye wil deſire grace and beautie, and greene ſowen fieldes are aboue this.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A freind and companion meeting together in time, and aboue them both is a woman with her husband.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Bretheren are an helpe in the time of tribulation, and mercie shal deliuer more then they.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Gold and ſiluer are the eſtablishing of the feete: and counſel is wel accepted aboue them both.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Riches and ſtrength exalt the hart, and aboue theſe is the feare of our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is no diminution in the feare of our Lord, and in it there is no neede to ſeeke for helpe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The feare of our Lord is as a paradiſe of bleſſing, and they haue couered it aboue al glorie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Sonne in thy life time want not: for it is better to die then to want.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A man that looketh toward an other mans table, his life is as no life, thinking how to liue, for he feedeth his ſoule with an other mans meates.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But a man nurtered, and taught wil looke to him ſelfe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Pouertie wil be ſweete in the mouth of the vnwiſe, and in his bellie a fire wil burne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: O DEATH how bitter is thy memorie to a man that hath peace in his riches:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: to a man that is at reſt, and whoſe wayes are proſperous in al thinges, and that is yet able to take meate!
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: O death, thy iudgement is good to a needy man, and him that is diminished in ſtrength,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and fayleth in age, and that is careful of al thinges, and to the incredulous, that loſeth patience!
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Feare not the iudgement of death. Remember what thinges haue bene before thee, and what come after thee: this is the iudgement from our Lord to al flesh:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and what shal come vpon thee by the good pleaſure of the Higheſt? whether it be ten, or an hundred, or a thouſand yeares.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For in hel there is no accuſing of life.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The children of ſinners be come children of abominations, and they that conuerſe neere the houſes of the impious.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The inheritance of the children of ſinners shal perish, and with their ſeede shal be continuance of reproch.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The children complaine of an impious father, becauſe for him they are in reproch.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Woe to you ye impious men, which haue forſaken the law of our Lord the Higheſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And if ye be borne, ye shal be borne in malediction: and if ye die, in malediction shal be your portion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al thinges that are of the earth, shal returne into the earth: ſo the impious from malediction to perdition.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The moorning of men is in their bodie, but the name of the impious shal be cleane wyped out.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Haue care of a good name: for this shal be more permanent to thee, then a thouſand treaſures precious and great.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There is a number of the daies of a good life: but a good name shal continew for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Children, keepe ye diſcipline in peace. For wiſdom hid, and treaſure not ſeene, what profite is there in them both?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Better is the man that hideth his follie, then the man that hideth his wiſdom.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But yet haue reuerence to theſe thinges, which proceede from my mouth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For it is not good to obſerue al shamfaſtnes: & al thinges do not pleaſe al men in opinion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Be ashamed before father & before mother, of fornication: and before the preſident and before the mightie, of lying:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: before the prince, and before the iudge, of offence: before the ſinagogue and the people, of iniquitie:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: before companion and freind, of iniuſtice: and before the place where thou dwelleſt,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: of theft, of the truth of God, and his teſtament: of leaning on the bread, and of reproofe for the thing geuen and taken:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: before them that ſalute thee, of ſilence: of beholding a woman that is an harlot: and of turning away thy countenance from thy kinſman.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Turne not away thy face from thy neighbour, & of taking away part and not reſtoring.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Behold not an other mans wife, and ſearch not his handmayde, neither ſtand by her bed.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before freindes of opprobrious wordes: and when thou haſt geuen, vpbrayde not.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: REPEATE not the word which thou haſt heard, neither reueale thou of a ſecret word, & thou shalt in deede be without confuſion, and shalt finde grace in the ſight of al men: be not ashamed for al theſe thinges, and accept not perſon therby to ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Of the law of the Higheſt, and his teſtament, and of iudgement to iuſtifie the impious,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: of the word of companions and wayfaring men, and of the geuing of the inheritance of freindes,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: of the equalitie of balance and weightes, of the getting of manie thinges and few,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: of the corruption of bying, and of marchantes, and of much diſcipline of thy children, and to make bloudie the ſide of a wicked ſeruant.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ouer a naughtie woman a ſeale is good.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Where there are manie handes, shut vp, and what ſoeuer thou shalt deliuer, number, and weigh it: and write euerie thing geuen and receiued.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Of the diſcipline of the vnwiſe and foolish, and of ancientes, that are iudged of young men: and thou shalt be wel inſtructed in al thinges, and approued in the ſight of al the liuing.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A daughter is the ſecret watch of the father, and the care of her taketh away ſleepe, leſt perhaps in her youth she become paſt age, & abiding with an husband she become odious:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: leſt at anie time she be corrupted in her virginitie, and in her fathers houſe she be found with childe: leſt perhaps abyding with her husband she tranſgreſſe, or at the leaſt become barren.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ouer a diſſolute daughter keepe ſure watch: leſt at anie time she make thee come into reprooche with thine enemies, becauſe of detraction in the citie, and the obiection of the people, and she confound thee in the multitude of the people.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Looke not on euerie bodie for beautie ſake: & among wemen tarie not.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For out of garments cometh forth the moth, and from a woman the iniquitie of a man.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For better is the iniquitie of a man, then a woman doing a good turne, and a woman shaming vnto reproche.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I therefore wil be mindeful of the workes of our Lord, and I wil shew forth which I haue ſeene. By the words of our Lord are his workes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The ſunne illuminating hath looked through out al, and ful of the glorie of our Lord is his worke.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Hath not our Lord made the ſainctes to declare al his meruelous thinges, which our Lord the omnipotent confirmed to be eſtablished in his glorie?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He hath ſearched out the depth, and the hart of men: and in their ſubtilitie he hath conſidered.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For our Lord hath knowen al knowlege, and hath beheld the ſigne of age, declaring what thinges are paſt, and what are to come, reueling the tokens of ſecret thinges.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: No cogitation eſcapeth him, and no word hideth it ſelf from him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The glorious workes of his wiſdom he hath beautified: who is before the world and world without end, neither is there added,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: nor diminised, and he needeth not anie mans counſel.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: How are al his workes to be deſired, and which is as it were a ſparke to conſider!
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al theſe liue, and remaine for euer, and in al neceſſitie al thinges obey him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al thinges duble, one againſt one, and he hath made nothing to want.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He hath confirmed the good thinges of euerie one. And who shal be filled ſeeing his glorie?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: THE firmament of height is his beautie, the beautie of heauen is in the viſion of glorie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The ſunne in ſight declaring at his coming forth, a meruelous inſtrument, the worke of the Higheſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: At noone it burneth the earth, and who can abide in the preſence of the heate thereof: kepeing a fornace in the workes of heate:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: the ſunne three times ſo much burning the mountaines, caſting out fyrie beames, and shining with his beames blindeth the eyes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Great is our Lord that made it, and by his wordes it hath haſtened his courſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And the moone in al in her time, is the shewing of ſeaſon and the ſigne of age.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: By the moone is the ſigne of a feſtiual day, a light that diminisheth in conſummation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The moneth is according to her name, increaſing meruelouſly in conſummation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: An inſtrument of the campe on high, shining gloriouſly in the firmament of heauen.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The glorie of the ſtarres is the beautie of heauen, our Lord illuminating the world on high.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In the words of the holie one they shal ſtand to iudgement, and shal not faile in their watches.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: See the bow, and bleſſe him that made it: it is very beautiful in his brightnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: It hath compaſſed heauen in the circuite of his glorie, the handes of the Higheſt haue opened it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But by his commandement he hath haſtened ſnow, & he haſteth to ſend forth the lightninges of his iudgement.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Therefore are the treaſures opened, and the cloudes flie forth as birdes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: By his greatnes he hath ſet the cloudes, and the haileſtones are broken.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In his ſight the mountaines shal be moued, and at his wil the ſouth winde hath blowen.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The noyſe of his thunder shal beate the earth, the tempeſt of the northwind, and the gathering together of wind:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and as the bird lighting downe to ſitte, he ſcatereth ſnow, and the falling thereof, is as the locuſt dyuing downeward.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The eye shal admire the beautie of the whitenes thereof, and the hart quaketh at the shower thereof.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He shal power out froſt vpon the earth as ſalt: and when it freeſeth, it shal be made as the toppes of a thiſtle.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The cold north winde blewe, & of water there froſe chryſtal, vpon al gathering together of waters it shal reſt, & as a breſt plate it shal put it ſelf vpon the waters.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And it shal deuoure the mountaines, & burne the deſert, & extinguish that which is grene as fire.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The remedie of al is in the haſtie coming of a cloude, and a dew meeting it by the heate that cometh, shal make it quaile.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: At his word the wind was ſtil, and with his thought he appeaſed the depth, and our Lord planted Ilandes therein.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They that ſaile on the ſea, tel the perils therof: & hearing with our eares we shal meruel.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There are goodly workes, & meruelous: diuers kindes of beaſtes, & of al cattel, & the creature of mightie beaſtes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Through him is the end of their iourney confirmed, and by his word al thinges are ſet in order.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: We shal ſay manie thinges, & shal faile in wordes; but the ſumme of our wordes is, he is in al.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Glorifying him how far shal we be able? for the omnipotent himſelf is aboue al his workes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Our Lord is terrible, & exceeding great, & his might is meruelous.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Glorifying our Lord as much as euer you can, he shal yet ſurpaſſe, and his magnificence is meruelous.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Bleſſing our Lord, exalt him as much as you can: for he is greater then al praiſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Exalting him be ye replenished with ſtrength. Labour not: for you shal not comprehend.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who shal ſee him, and shal declare him? and who shal magnifie him as he is from the beginning?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Manie thinges hid are greater then theſe: for we haue ſeene few of his workes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But our Lord made al thinges, and to them that liue piouſly he hath geuen wiſdom.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: LET vs praiſe glorious men, and our fathers in their generation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Much glorie hath our Lord made by his magnificence from the beginning of the world.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ruling in their dominions, men great for force, and endued with their wiſdom, declaring in the prophetes the dignitie of prophetes,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and ruling in the people that was preſent, and by the vertue of wiſdom moſt holie wordes to the peoples.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In their kil ſeeking out muſical melodies, & vttering ſongnes of ſcriptures.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Rich men in force ſtudying beautifulnes: liuing at peace in their houſes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Al theſe in the generations of their nation haue obteyned glorie, and in their daies are praiſed.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They that were borne of them haue leaft a name to tel their praiſes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and there are ſome of whom there is no memorie: they are perished, as they that neuer were; & are borne, as not borne at al, & their children with them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But they are men of mercie, whoſe godlie deedes haue not failed:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: good thinges continew with their ſeede,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: their nephewes are an holie inheritance, and their ſeede hath ſtoode in the teſtamentes:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and their children becauſe of them abide for euer: their ſeede and their glorie shal not be forſaken.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Their bodies are buried in peace, and their name liueth vnto generation and generation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Let peoples tel their wiſdom, and the Church declare their praiſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Henoch pleaſed God, and was tranſlated into paradiſe, that he may geue repentance to the nations.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Noe was found perfect, iuſt, and in the time of wrath he was made a reconciliation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Therefore was there a remnant leaft to the earth, when the flood was made.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The teſtaments of the world were made with him, that al flesh should no more be deſtroyed with the flood.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Abraham the great father of the multitude of the nations, and there was not found the like to him in glorie, who kept the law of the Higheſt, and was in couenant with him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In his flesh he made the couenant to ſtand, and in tentation he was found faithful.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Therefore by an oath he gaue him glorie in his nation, that he should encreaſe as an heape of earth,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and that he would exalt his ſeede as the ſtarres, and they should inherite from ſea to ſea, and from the riuer to the endes of the earth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he did in like manner in Iſaac for Abraham his father.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Our Lord gaue him the bleſſing of al nations, and confirmed his couenant vpon the head of Iacob.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He knew him in his bleſſinges, and gaue him an inheritance, & diuided him his portion in twelue tribes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he preſerued vnto him men of mercie, and found grace in the eies of al flesh.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: MOYSES beloued of God, and men: whoſe memorie is in benediction.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He made him like in the glorie of ſaintes, and magnified him in the feare of his enemies. And with his wordes he appeaſed monſters.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He glorified him in the ſight of kinges, and gaue him commandment before his people, & shewed him his glorie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In his faith and meekenes he made him holie, and choſe him of al flesh.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For he heard him, and his voice, and brought him into a cloude.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he gaue him precepts face to face, and a law of life and diſcipline, to teach Iacob his teſtament, and Iſrael his iudgements.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He exalted Aaron his brother high, and like to himſelf of the tribe of Leui.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He eſtablished vnto him an euerlaſting teſtament, and gaue him the prieſthood of the nation, and made him bleſſed in glorie,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he girded him about with a girdle, and put vpon him a robe of glorie, and crowned him in furniture of power.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Garments to the feete, and breches, and an Ephod he put vpon him, and compaſſed him with litle belles of gold very manie round about,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: to geue a ſound in his going, to make ſound heard in the temple for a memorie to the children of his nation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: An holie robe, of gold, and hyacinthe, and purple, a wouen worke, of a wiſeman, indued with iudgement and truth:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Of twiſted ſcarlet the worke of an artificer, with precious ſtones figured in the cloſure of gold, and grauen by the worke of a lapidatie for a memorial, according to the number of the tribes of Iſrael.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: A crowne of gold vpon his miter grauen with a ſeale of holines, and the glorie of honour: a worke of power, and the adorned deſires of the eies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: There were none ſuch ſo faire before him, euen from the beginning.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: No ſtranger was clothed with them, but only his children alone, and his nephewes for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: His ſacrifices were conſumed with fire euerie day.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Moyſes filled his handes, & anoynted him with holie oile.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: It was made vnto him for an euerlaſting teſtament, and to his ſeede as the daies of heauen, to doe the function of prieſthood, and to haue praiſe and to glorifie his people in his name.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He choſe him of al that liued, to offer ſacrifice to God, incenſe, and good odour, for a memorial to pacifie for his people:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he gaue them power in his preceptes, in the teſtaments of his iudgementes, to teach Iacob his teſtimonies, and in his law to geue light to Iſrael.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Becauſe ſtrangers ſtood againſt him, and for enuie men compaſſed him about in the deſert, they that were with Dathan and Abiron, and the congregation of Core in anger.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Our Lord God ſaw, and it pleaſed him not, and they were conſumed in the violence of wrath.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He did prodigious thinges vnto them, and conſumed them in flame of fire.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he added glorie to Aaron, and gaue him an inheritance, and diuided vnto him the firſt fruites of the increaſe of the earth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He prepared them bread in the firſt vnto ſatietie: for the ſacrifices alſo of our Lord they shal eate, which he gaue to him, and to his ſeede.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But he shal not inherite the nations in the land, and he hath no part in the nation: for himſelf is his portion & inheritance.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Phinees the ſonne of Eleazar is the third in glorie, in imitating him in the feare of our Lord:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and to ſtand in the reuerence of the nation: in the goodnes and alacritie of his ſoule he pacified God for Iſrael.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Therefore did he eſtablish vnto him a couenant of peace, to be the prince of the holies, and of his nation, that the dignitie of prieſthood should be to him and to his ſeede for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And the teſtament to Dauid king, the ſonne of Ieſſe of the tribe of Iuda, and inheritance to him and to his ſeede, that he might geue wiſdom into our hart to iudge his nation in iuſtice, that their good thinges might not be abolished, & their glorie in their nation he made euerlaſting.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: STRONG in battel was Ieſus the ſonne of Naue, ſucceſſour of Moyſes among the prophets, who was great according to his name,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: moſt great in the ſaluation of Gods elect, to ouerthrow the enemies riſing vp, that he might get the inheritanc of Iſrael.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: What glorie obteyned he in lifting vp his handes, and caſting ſwordes againſt the cities?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who before him did ſo reſiſt? for our Lord himſelf brought the enemies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Whether was not the ſunne hindered in his anger, and one day was made as two?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He inuocated the mightie ſoueraine in aſſaulting of the enemies on euerie ſide, and the great and holie God heard him in haile ſtones of exceeding great force.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He made violent aſſault againſt the nation of his enemies, and in the goeing downe he deſtroyed the aduerſaries,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: that the nations might know his might, that it is not eaſie to fight againſt God. And he folowed at the back of the mightie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And in the daies of Moyſes did mercie, and Caleb the ſonne of Iephone, did ſtand againſt the enemie, and ſtayed the nation from ſinnes, and appeaſed the murmuring of malice.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And they two being appointed, were deliuered out of danger from among the number of ſix hundred thouſand footemen, to bring them into their inheritance, into the land that yeldeth milke and honie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And our Lord gaue ſtrength to Caleb himſelf, and his ſtrength continued euen vntil old age, ſo that he went vp into the high place of the land, & his ſeede obteyned inheritance.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: That al the children of Iſrael might ſee, that it is good to obey the holie God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And al the iudges by their name, whoſe hart was not corrupted: which were not turned away from our Lord,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: that their memorie might be bleſſed, and their bones ſpring out of their place,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and their name continew for euer, the glorie of the holie men remayning vnto their children.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The beloued of our Lord his God Samuel the prophet of our Lord, renewed the empire, and anoynted princes in his nation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: By the law of our Lord he iudged the congregation, and the God of Iacob ſaw, and in his fidelitie was proued a prophet.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he was knowen faithful in his wordes, becauſe he ſaw the God of light:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and inuocated our Lord omnipotent, in aſſaulting the enemies beſetting him on euerie ſide, in the oblation of an immaculate lambe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And our Lord thundered from heauen, and in great ſound he made his voice heard,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he deſcomfited the princes of the Tyrians, and al the dukes of the Philiſthiims:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and before the time of the end of his life, and the world, he gaue teſtimonie before our Lord, and his Chriſt, money and what ſoeuer beſides vnto the verie shoes he tooke not of al flesh, and no man accuſed him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And after this he ſlept, and he notified to the king, and shewed him the end of his life, and he exalted his voice out of the earth in prophecie to take cleane away the impietie of the nation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: AFTER theſe thinges aroſe Nathan the Prophet in the daies of Dauid.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And as the fatte ſeparated from the flesh, ſo was Dauid from the children of Iſrael.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He plaied with lyons as it were with lambes: and with beares he did in like maner as with lambes of sheepe in his youth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Did not he kil the giant, and tooke away reproch from his nation?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In lifting vp his hand, with a ſtone of the ſling he ouerthrew the boaſting of Goliah:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for he inuocated our Lord the omnipotent, and he gaue in his right hand, to take away the man ſtrong in battel, and to exalt the horne of his nation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: So in ten thouſand did he glorifie him, and praiſed him in the bleſſinges of our Lord, in offering to him a crowne of glorie:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: for he deſtroyed the enemies on euerie ſide, and rooted out the Philiſthijms the aduerſaries euen vntil this preſent day: he brake their horne for euer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In euerie worke he gaue confeſſion to the Holie one, and to the Higheſt, in the word of glorie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: From al his hart he praiſed our Lord, & loued God that made him: and gaue him might againſt his enemies:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he made ſingers to ſtand before the altar, and by their ſound he made ſweete tunes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And in the ſolennities he gaue honour, and adorned the times euen to the end of his life, that they should praiſe the holie name of our Lord, and magnifie the holines of God in the morning.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Our Lord purged his ſinnes, and exalted his horne for euer: and he gaue him a teſtament of the kingdom, and the ſeate of glorie in Iſrael.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: After him aroſe a wiſe ſonne, and for him did he ouerthrowe al the might of the enemies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Salomon reigned in dayes of peace, to whom God ſubdewed al his enemies, that he might build an houſe in his name, and prepare holines for euer: as thou art inſtructed in thy youth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And thou art replenished as a riuer with wiſdom, and thy ſoule diſcouered the earth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And thou didſt multiplie darke ſayinges in compariſons: thy name was bruited to the ilandes far of, and thou waſt beloued in thy peace.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The landes merueled at the ſonges and prouerbes, and compariſons, and interpretations,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and at the name of our Lord God, whoſe name is, God of Iſrael.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Thou didſt gather gold as copper, and filledſt ſiluer as lead,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and bowdeſt thy thighes to wemen: thou haſt had power on thy bodie,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: thou haſt made a blotte in thy glorie, and profaned thy ſeede to bring wrath to thy children, and thy follie to be kindled,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: to make the kingdom diuided, and a ſtubburne kingdom to reigne of Ephraim.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But God wil not leaue his mercie, and he wil not corrupt, nor abolish his owne workes, neither wil he deſtroy from the ſtocke the nephewes of his elect: and he wil not corrupt the ſeede of him, that loueth our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: But he gaue a remnant to Iacob, and to Dauid of the ſame ſtocke.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And Salomon had an end with his fathers.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he left after him of his ſeede, the follie of the nation,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and Roboam hauing litle wiſedom, who turned away the nation by his counſel,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and Ieroboam the ſonne of Nabat, who made Iſrael to ſinne, and made a way of ſinning to Ephraim, and their ſinnes did abound very manie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They remoued them away from their land very far.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he ſought al iniquities, til there came defenſe vnto them, and he rid them from al ſinnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: AND there aroſe Elias the prophet, as it were fire, and his word burnt as a litle torche.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who brought famine vpon them, and they prouoking him in their enuie, were made fewe. for they could not abide the preceptes of our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: By the word of our Lord he ſtayed heauen, and he brought downe fire from heauen thriſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: So was Elias magnified in his meruelous workes. And who can ſo glorie like vnto thee?
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who didſt rayſe vp the dead from hel, from the lotte of death, in the word of our Lord God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who didſt caſt downe kinges to deſtruction, and didſt eaſily breake their might, and the glorious from their bed.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who heareſt iudgement in Sina, and in Horeb iudgementes of defence.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who anoynteſt kinges to repentance, and makeſt prophetes ſucceſſoures after thee.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who waſt receiued in a whirlewind of fire, in a chariot of fierie horſes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who art written in the iudgements of times, to appeaſe the wrath of our Lord, to reconcile the hart of the father to the ſonne, and to reſtore the tribes of Iacob.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Bleſſed are they, that ſaw thee, and were honored in thy freindshipe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For we liue by life only, but after death our name shal not be ſuch.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Elias was in dede hid in the whirlewind, & his ſpirit was complete in Eliſeus: in his daies he feared not the prince, and no man ouercame him by might.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Neither did any word ouercome him, and his bodie prophecied being dead.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In his life he did wonders, and in death he wrought meruelous thinges.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In al theſe thinges the people repented not, and they departed not from their ſinnes, til they were caſt out of their land, and were diſperſed into al the earth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And there was leaft a verie ſmal nation, and a prince in the houſe of Dauid.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Some of them did that which pleaſed God: but others committed manie ſinnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ezechias fenced his citie, and brough in water into the middes thereof, and digged a rocke with yron, and built a wel for water.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In his daies came vp Sennacherib, and ſent Rabſaces, and lifted vp his hand againſt them, and put forth his hand vpon Sion, and became proude by his mightines.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Then were their harts, and hands moued: and they were in ſorow as trauailing wemen.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And they invocated our merciful Lord, and ſpreding their handes, they lifted them vp to heauen: and the holie Lord God quickly heard their voice.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He was not mindful of their ſinnes, neither did he geue them to their enemies, but purged them by the hand of Iſaie the holie prophete.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He ouerthrew the campe of the Aſſirians, and the Angel of our Lord deſtroyed them.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For Ezechias did that which pleaſed God, and went ſtrongly in the way of Dauid his father, which Iſaie commanded him, the great prophet, and faithful in the ſight of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In his daies the ſunne returned backward, & added life to the king.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: By a great ſpirite he ſaw the laſt thinges, and comforted the mourners in Sion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For euer he shewed the thinges to come, & ſecret thinges before they came to paſſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: THE memorie of Ioſias is according to the confection of perfume made by the worke of an apothecarie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: His remembrance shal be ſweete as honie in euerie mouth, and as muſick in banket of wine.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He was directed by God into the repentance of the nation, and he tooke away the abominations of impietie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And he gouerned his hart toward our Lord, and in the daies of ſinners he ſtrengthened pietie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Except Dauid, and Ezechias, and Ioſias, al committed ſinne.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For the kinges of Iuda forſooke the law of the Higheſt, and contemned the feare of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For they gaue their kingdom to others, and their glorie to a ſtrange nation.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They burnt the choſen citie of holines, and made the waies thereof deſolate in the hand of Ieremie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For they euil intreated him; who was conſecrated a prophet from his mothers wombe, to ouerthrow, and pluck vp, and deſtroy, and to build againe, and renewe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ezechiel who ſaw the ſight of glorie, which he shewed him in the chariote of Cherubs.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For he made mention of the enemies in rayne, to doe good vnto them, that haue shewed right waies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And the bones of the twelue prophets wel may they ſpring out of their place: for they haue ſtrengthened Iacob, and haue redeemed themſelues in the fidelitie of power.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: How may we magnifie Zorobabel, for he alſo was as a ſignet on the right hand,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and ſo Ieſus the ſonne of Ioſedec? who in their daies built the houſe, and erected the holie temple to our Lord, prepared to euerlaſting glorie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And Nehemias in the memorie of much time, who erected vs our walles ouerthrowen, and ſet vp the gates and lockes, who built our houſes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: No man hath bene borne in the earth like to Henoch: for he alſo was taken vp from the earth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Neither as Ioſeph who was a man borne prince of his bretheren, the ſtay of the nation, the ruler of his bretheren, the ſtay of the people:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and his bones were viſited, and after death they prophecied.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Seth, and Sem obteyned glorie with men: and aboue euerie ſoule, in the beginning Adam.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: SIMON the ſonne of Onias, the high prieſt, who in his life held vp the houſe, and in his daies ſtrengthned the temple.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: The height alſo of the temple was founded by him, the duble building and high walles of the temple.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In his daies the welles of waters flowed out, and they were filled as the ſea aboue meaſure.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who had care of his nation, and deliuered it from perdition.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Who preuailed to amplifie the citie, who obteyned glorie in conuerſing with the nation: and amplified the entrance of the houſe, and the court.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As the morning ſtarre in the middes of a cloude, and as the ful moone he shineth in his dayes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And as the ſunne shining, ſo did he shine in the temple of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As the rainbow that shineth among the cloudes of glorie, and as a flower of roſes in the daies of the ſpring, and as the lilies that are in the paſſage of water, and as frankenſence ſmelling in ſummer daies.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As fire gliſtering, and frankenſence burning in the fire.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As a maſſie veſſel of gold, adorned with euerie precious ſtone.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: As an oliue tree budding, and a cypreſſe tree aduancing it ſelf on high, when he tooke the robe of glorie, and was reueſted to the conſummation of ſtrength.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: In going vp to the holie altar, he made the veſture of holines, glorie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And in receiuing the portions out of the hand of the prieſtes, himſelf alſo ſtanding by the altar. About him was the ring of his bretheren: and as the ceder plant in mount Libanus,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: ſo ſtoode they about him as boughes of the palme tree, & al the children of Aaron in their glorie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And the oblation of our Lord in their handes, before al the ſynagogue of Iſrael: and executing the conſummation on the altar, to amplifie the oblation of the high king,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: he ſtretched forth his hand in oblation of moiſt ſacrifice, and offered of the blood of the grape.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: He powred out on the fundation of the altar a diuine odour to the high prince.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Then cried out the children of Aaron, they ſounded with beaten trumpets, and made a great voice to be heard for a remembrance before God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Then al the people together made haſt, and fel on their face vpon the earth, to adore our Lord their God, and to make prayers to God omnipotent the Higheſt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And the ſingers amplified in their voices, and in the great houſe the ſound was encreaſed ful of ſweetenes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And the people in prayer deſired our Lord the Higheſt, vntil the honour of our Lord was perfected, and they finished their office.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Then coming downe, he lifted vp his handes ouer al the congregation of the children of Iſrael, to geue glorie to God from his lippes, and to glorie in his name,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and he repeated his prayer, willing to shew the power of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And now pray ye the God of al, who hath done great thinges in al the land, who hath encreaſed our daies from our mothers wombe, and hath done with vs according to his mercie:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: geue he vnto vs ioyfulnes of hart euerlaſting:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: that Iſrael may beleue that the mercie of God is with vs, to deliuer vs in his dayes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Two nations my ſoule hateth: and the third is no nation, which I hate:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: they that ſitte in mount Seir, and the Philiſthijms, and the foolish people that dwel in Sichem.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Ieſus the ſonne of Sirach, a man of Ieruſalem, wrote the doctrine of wiſdom and diſcipline in this booke, who renewed wiſdom from his hart.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Bleſſed is he, that conuerſeth in theſe good thinges: and he that layeth them in his hart, shal be wiſe alwayes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For if he doe them, he shal be able to doe al thinges: becauſe his ſteppes are in the light of God.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: THE prayer of Ieſus the ſonne of Sirach. I wil confeſſe to thee ô Lord king, and wil praiſe thee God my ſauiour.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I wil confeſſe to thy name: becauſe thou art become my helper and protectour,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and haſt deliuered my bodie from perdition, from the ſnare of an vniuſt tongue, and from the lippes of them that worke lying, and in the ſight of them that ſtoode vp thou art become my helper.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And thou haſt deliuered me according to the multitude of the mercie of thy name from them that did roare, prepared to deuoure,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: out of the handes of them that ſeeke my ſoule, and from the gates of tribulations which haue compaſſed me:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: from the oppreſſion of the flame, which hath compaſſed me, and in the middes of fire I was not burnt.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: From the depth of the bellie of hel, and from a defiled tongue, and from the word of lying, from a wicked king, and from an vniuſt tongue:
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: my ſoule shal praiſe our Lord euen to death,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and my life was approching to hel beneth.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: They haue compaſſed me on euerie ſide, & there was none that would helpe. I looked toward the helpe of men, & there was none.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I remembred thy mercie ô Lord, and thy operation, which are from the beginning of the world.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Becauſe thou deliuereſt them that patiently expect thee ô Lord, and ſaueſt them out of the handes of the nations.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Thou haſt exalted my habitation vpon the earth, and I haue prayed for death to paſſe away.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I haue inuocated our Lord the father of my Lord, that he leaue me not in the day of my tribulation, and in the time of the proude without helpe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I wil praiſe thy name continually, and wil collaude it in confeſſion, and my prayer was heard.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: And thou haſt deliuered me from perdition, and haſt reſcued me from the wicked time.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Therfore wil I confeſſe, & ſay praiſe to thee, and bleſſe the name of our Lord.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: When I was yet young, before I erred, I ſought for wiſdom openly in my prayer.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Before the temple I prayed for it, and vnto the later end I wil ſeeke after it, and it shal flourish as the grape timely ripe,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: my hart hath reioyced in it, my foote hath walked the right way, from my youth I ſearched after it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I bowed mine eare a litle, and receiued it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I found much wiſdom in myſelf, & I haue much profited therein.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: To him that geueth me wiſdom, wil I geue glorie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: For I haue conſulted to doe it: I haue had a zele to good, and shal not be confounded.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: My ſoule hath wreſtled in it, and in doing it I was confirmed.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I ſtretched forth my handes on high, & I lamented foolishnes.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I directed my ſoule to wiſdom, and in knowlege I found it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I poſſeſſed with it an hart from the beginning: for this cauſe I shal not be forſaken.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: My bellie was trubled in ſeeking it: therefore shal I poſſeſſe a good poſſeſſion.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Our Lord hath geuen me a tongue for my reward: and with the ſame I wil praiſe him.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Approch vnto me ye vnlerned, and gather yourſelues together into the houſe of diſcipline.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Why ſlacke ye yet? and what ſay you herein? your ſoules are exceeding thirſtie.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: I haue opened my mouth, and haue ſpoken: Bye it for you without ſiluer,
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: and ſubmit your necke to the yoke, and let your ſoule receiue diſcipline: for it is very neere to finde it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: See with your eyes that I haue laboured a litle, and haue found much reſt to myſelf.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Take ye diſcipline in a great ſumme of ſiluer, and poſſeſſe abundance of gold in it.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Let your ſoule reioyce in his mercie, and you shal not be confounded in praiſe.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: Worke your worke before the time, and he wil geue you your reward in his time.
label: Ecclesiasticus

text: THE viſion of Iſaie the ſonne of Amos, which he ſawe, concerning Iuda and Ieruſalem in the dayes of Ozias, Ioathan, Achaz, and Ezechias kinges of Iuda.
label: Isaie

text: Heare ye heauens, & geue eare ô earth, becauſe our Lord hath ſpoken. I haue brought vp children, and exalted them: but they haue deſpiſed me.
label: Isaie

text: The oxe hath knowen his owner, and the aſſe his maſters crib: but Iſrael hath not knowen me, and my people hath not vnderſtood.
label: Isaie

text: Woe to the ſinful nation, the people loden with greeuous iniquitie, the wicked ſeede, vngracious children: they haue forſaken our Lord, they haue blaſphemed the holie one of Iſrael, they are reuolted backewards.
label: Isaie

text: For what shal I ſtrike you anie more, which adde preuarication? euerie head is ſicke, & euerie hart in heauines.
label: Isaie

text: From the ſole of the foote vnto the toppe of the head, there is no health therein: wound, and wayle, and ſwelling ſtroke: it is not bound vp, nor cured, with medicine, nor mollified with oile.
label: Isaie

text: Your land is deſolate, your cities burnt with fire: your countrie ſtrangers deuoure before your face, and it shal be made deſolate as in the ſpoile of enemies.
label: Isaie

text: And the daughter of Sion shal be left as a vineyard, and as a cottage in a place of cucumbers, and as a citie that is waſted.
label: Isaie

text: Vnleſſe the Lord of hoſtes had lefte vs ſeed, we had beene as Sodom, and we should be like to Gomorrha.
label: Isaie

text: Heare the word of our Lord ye princes of Sodom, geue eare to the law of our God ye people of Gomorrha.
label: Isaie

text: To what purpoſe do you offer me the multitude of your victimes, ſaith our Lord? I am ful. the holocauſt of rammes, and the fatte of fatlings, and the bloud of calues, and lambes, and buck goates I haue not deſired.
label: Isaie

text: When you should haue come before my ſight, who ſought for theſe thinges at your handes, that you should walke in my courtes?
label: Isaie

text: Offer ſacrifice no more in vaine: incenſe is abomination to me. The Newe moone, and the Sabbath, and other feſtiuities I wil not abide, your aſſemblies are wicked.
label: Isaie

text: My ſoule hateth your Calendes, and your ſolemnities: they are become tedious to me, I haue laboured in ſuſteyning.
label: Isaie

text: And when you shal ſtreach forth your hands, I wil turne away mine eies from you: & when you shal multiplie prayer, I wil not heare: for your handes are ful of bloud;
label: Isaie

text: Wash you, be cleane, take away the euil of your cogitations from mine eies: ceaſe to doe peruerſely.
label: Isaie

text: Lerne to doe good: ſeeke iudgement, ſuccour the oppreſſed, iudge for the pupil, defend the widow.
label: Isaie

text: And come, and accuſe me, ſayth our Lord: if your ſinnes shal be as ſcarlet, they shal be made white as ſnow: and if they be red as vermelon, they shal be white as wooll.
label: Isaie

text: If you be willing, and wil heare me, you shal eate the good thinges of the earth.
label: Isaie

text: But if you wil not, and wil prouoke me to wrath: the ſword shal deuoure you, becauſe the mouth of our Lord hath ſpoken.
label: Isaie

text: How is the faythful citie, ful of iudgement, become an harlot? iuſtice hath dwelled in it, but now mankillers.
label: Isaie

text: Thy ſiluer is turned into droſſe: thy wine is mingled with water.
label: Isaie

text: Thy princes are vnfaithful, companions of theues: al loue giftes, folow rewardes. They iudge not for the pupil: and the widowes cauſe goeth not in to them.
label: Isaie

text: For this cauſe ſayth our Lord the God of hoſtes the mightie one of Iſrael: Alas, I wil comfort myſelfe vpon mine aduerſaries: and wil be reuenged of mine enemies.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil turne mine hand to thee, and I wil boyle out thy droſſe til it be pure, & wil take away al thy tinne.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil reſtore thy iudges as they haue beene before, and thy counſelers as of old. After theſe thinges thou shalt be called the iuſt, a faithful citie.
label: Isaie

text: Sion shal be redemed in iudgement, and they shal bring her backe in iuſtice.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal deſtroy the wicked, and the ſinners together: and they that haue forſaken our Lord, shal be conſumed.
label: Isaie

text: For they shal be confounded for the idols, to which they haue ſacrificed: and you shal be ashamed of the gardens, which you choſe.
label: Isaie

text: When you shal be as an oke the leaues falling of, and as a garden without water.
label: Isaie

text: And your ſtrength shal be, as the ashes of towe, and your worke as a ſparke: and both shal be ſet on fire together, and there shal be none to quench it.
label: Isaie

text: THE word, that Iſaie the ſonne of Amos ſaw vpon Iuda and Ieruſalem.
label: Isaie

text: And in the later dayes the montaine of the houſe of our Lord shal be prepared, in the toppe of montaines, and it shal be eleuated aboue the little hilles: and al nations shal flowe vnto it.
label: Isaie

text: And manie peoples shal goe, & shal ſay, come and let vs goe vp to the mount of our Lord, and to the houſe of the God of Iacob, and he wil teach vs his wayes, and we shal walke in his pathes: becauſe the law shal come forth from Sion, and the word of our Lord from Ieruſalem.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal iudge the Gentiles, and rebuke manie peoples: and they shal turne their ſwordes into culters, and their ſpeares into ſiethes: nation shal not lift vp ſword againſt nation, neither shal they be exerciſed any more to battel.
label: Isaie

text: Houſe of Iacob come ye, and let vs walke in the light of our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: For thou haſt reiected thy people, the houſe of Iacob: becauſe they are filled as in times paſt, and haue had ſouthſayers as the Philiſthijms, and haue ſtucke faſt to ſtrange children.
label: Isaie

text: The land is replenished with ſiluer and gold: and there is no end of their treaſures.
label: Isaie

text: And their land is replenished with horſes: and their chariotes are innumerable. And their land is ful of idoles: they haue adored the worke of their handes, which their fingers made.
label: Isaie

text: And man bowed himſelf, and man was humbled: therfore forgeue them not.
label: Isaie

text: Enter thou into the rocke, and be hid in a pitte, in the ground from the face of the feare of our Lord, & from the glorie of his maieſtie.
label: Isaie

text: The loftie eies of man are humbled, and the height of men shal be made to ſtoupe: & our Lord onlie shal be exalted in that day.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe the day of the Lord of hoſtes shal be vpon al the proude and loftie, and vpon euerie one that is arrogant, and he shal be humbled.
label: Isaie

text: And vpon al the ceders of Libanus high, & eleuated, & vpon al the okes of Baſan.
label: Isaie

text: And vpon al the high mountaines, and vpon al little hilles eleuated.
label: Isaie

text: And vpon euerie high towre, and euerie fenſed wal.
label: Isaie

text: And vpon al the shippes of Tharſis, and vpon al, that is fayre to behold.
label: Isaie

text: And the loftines of men shal be bowed, and the height of men shal be humbled; and our Lord onlie shal be exalted in that day.
label: Isaie

text: And idols shal vtterly be deſtroyed.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal enter into the caues of rockes, and into the pittes of the earth from the face of the feare of our Lord, and from the glorie of his maieſtie, when he shal riſe vp to ſtrike the earth.
label: Isaie

text: In that day shal a man caſt away the idols of his ſiluer, and the idols of his gold, which he had made him to adore, mowles and battes.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal goe into the clefts of rockes, and into the caues of ſtones from the face of the feare of our Lord, and from the glorie of his maieſtie, when he shal riſe vp to ſtrike the earth.
label: Isaie

text: Ceaſe therfore from the man, whoſe ſpirit is in his noſthrels, becauſe he is reputed high.
label: Isaie

text: FOR behold the dominatour the Lord of hoſtes shal take away from Ieruſalem, and from Iuda the valiant and the ſtrong, al ſtrength of bread, and al ſtrength of water.
label: Isaie

text: The ſtrong, and the man of warre, the iudge, and the prophete, and ſouthſayer, and the ancient.
label: Isaie

text: The prince ouer fiftie, and the honorable of countenance, and the counſeler, and the wiſe of workemaſters, and the skilful of myſtical ſpeach.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil geue children to be their princes, and the effeminate shal rule ouer them.
label: Isaie

text: And the people shal rush violently, man againſt man, and euerie one againſt his neighbour: the childe shal make tumult againſt the ancient, and the baſe againſt the noble.
label: Isaie

text: For a man shal take hold of his brother, one of the houſe of his father: Thou haſt a garment, be thou our prince, and let this ruine be vnder thy hand.
label: Isaie

text: He shal anſwer in that day, ſaying: I am no phyſicion, & in my houſe there is no bread, nor garment: do not appoint me prince of the people.
label: Isaie

text: For Ieruſalem is gone to ruine, and Iuda is fallen: becauſe their tongue, & their inuentions were againſt our Lord, to prouoke the eyes of his maieſtie.
label: Isaie

text: The knowlege of their face hath anſwered them: and they haue proclaimed their ſinne as Sodom, neither haue they hid it: woe to their ſoule, becauſe euils are rendered to them.
label: Isaie

text: Say to the iuſt that it is wel, becauſe he shal eate the fruite of his inuentions.
label: Isaie

text: Woe to the impious vnto euil: for the reward of his handes shal be made to him.
label: Isaie

text: My people their exactours haue ſpoyled, & wemen haue ruled ouer them. My people, they that cal thee bleſſed, the ſame deceiue thee, and diſſipate the way of thy ſteppes.
label: Isaie

text: Our Lord ſtandeth to iudge, and he ſtandeth to iudge peoples.
label: Isaie

text: Our Lord shal come to iudgement with the ancients of his people, and his princes: for you haue deuoured the vineyard, and the ſpoile of the poore is in your houſe.
label: Isaie

text: Why do you conſume my people, and grinde the faces of the poore, ſayth our Lord the God of hoſtes?
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord ſayd: for that the daughters of Sion are haughtie, and haue walked with ſtretched out necke, and went with twinglings of eies, and clapped their handes, walked on their feete, and ietted in a ſet pace.
label: Isaie

text: Our Lord shal make balde the crowne of the daughters of Sion, and our Lord shal diſcouer their haire.
label: Isaie

text: In that day shal our Lord take away the ornament of shoes, and litle moones.
label: Isaie

text: And cheynes, and ouches, and bracelettes, and bonnettes.
label: Isaie

text: And the sheading combes, and ſloppes, and tablettes, and ſweete balles, and earlets.
label: Isaie

text: And ringes, and pearles hanging on the forehead.
label: Isaie

text: And changes of apparel, and shorte clokes, and the fine linen, and nedles,
label: Isaie

text: and loking glaſſes, and launes, and headbands, and bonegraces.
label: Isaie

text: And for ſwete ſauour there shal be ſtinke, and for a girdle a corde, and for friſled haire baldnes, and for ſtomacher hairecloth.
label: Isaie

text: Thy fayreſt men alſo shal fal by the ſworde, and thy ſtrong ones in battle.
label: Isaie

text: And her gates shal lament and moorne, and she shal ſit deſolate on the ground.
label: Isaie

text: AND ſeuen wemen shal take hold of one man in that day, ſaying: We wil eate our owne bread, and be couered with our garments: only let thy name be called vpon vs, take away our reproch.
label: Isaie

text: In that day the bud of our Lord shal be in magnificence, and glorie, and the fruite of the earth high, and exultation to them, that shal be ſaued of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be: Euerie one that shal be leaft in Sion, and shal remaine in Ieruſalem, shal be called holie, euerie one that is written in life in Ieruſalem.
label: Isaie

text: If our Lord shal cleanſe the filth of the daughters of Sion, and shal wash the bloud of Ieruſalem out of the middes thereof in the ſpirit of iudgement, and ſpirit of heate.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord shal create vpon euerie place of mount Sion, and where he is inuocated, a clowde by day, and ſmoke, and the brightnes of flaming fyre in the night: for vpon al glorie protection.
label: Isaie

text: And there shal be a tabernacle for a place of shadow in the day from the heate, and for ſecuritie, and couert from the whyrlewind, and from rayne.
label: Isaie

text: I wil ſing to my beloued the canticle of my coſin concerning his vinyard. A vineyard was made to my beloued in horne the ſonne of oile.
label: Isaie

text: And he hedged it, and choſe ſtones out of it, and planted it elect, and built a towre in the middes thereof, and ſet vp a preſſe therein: and looked that it should yeld grapes, and it yelded wilde grapes.
label: Isaie

text: Now therfore ye inhabitants of Ieruſalem, and men of Iuda, iudge betwen me and my vineyard.
label: Isaie

text: What is there that I ought to doe more to my vineyard, and haue not done to it? Whether that I looked, it should yeld grapes, and it hath yelded wilde grapes?
label: Isaie

text: And now I wil shew you what I wil doe to my vineyard. I wil take away the hedge therof, and it shal be into ſpoile: I wil throw downe the wal thereof, and it shal be to be troden vpon.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil lay it waiſt: it shal not be pruned, and it shal not be digged: and bryers and thornes shal ouergrowe it: and I wil command the cloudes that they rayne no shower vpon it.
label: Isaie

text: For the vineyarde of the Lord of hoſtes, is the houſe of Iſrael: and the man of Iuda, his delectable bud: & I looked that it should doe iudgement, and behold iniquitie: and iuſtice, and behold clamour.
label: Isaie

text: Woe to you that ioyne houſe to houſe, and lay filde to filde, euen to the end of the place: why shal you alone dwel in the middes of the earth?
label: Isaie

text: Theſe thinges are in my eares, ſayth the Lord of hoſtes: vnles manie great and fayre houſes become deſolate, without an inhabiter.
label: Isaie

text: For ten acres of the vineyards shal yeld one litle flagon, and thirtie busheles of ſeede shal yeld three busheles.
label: Isaie

text: Woe to you that riſe vp early to folow drunkennes, and to drinke euen vntil euening, that you may be inflamed with wine.
label: Isaie

text: Harpe, and viole, & timbrel, and shalme, and wine in your feaſtes: and the worke of our Lord you regard not, nor conſider the workes of his handes.
label: Isaie

text: Therfore is my people led away captiue, becauſe they had not knowlege, and their nobles died with famine, and the multitude thereof dried away with thirſt.
label: Isaie

text: Therfore hath hel dilated his ſoule, and opened his mouth without anie limite, and their ſtrong ones, and their people, and their high and glorious ones shal deſcend into it.
label: Isaie

text: And man shal be bowed, and man shal be humbled, and the eies of the loftie shal be brought law.
label: Isaie

text: And the Lord of hoſtes shal be exalted in iudgement, and the holie God shal be ſanctified in iuſtice.
label: Isaie

text: And the lambes shal feede according to their order, and ſtrangers shal eate the deſertes turned into frutefulnes.
label: Isaie

text: Woe to you that draw iniquitie in cordes of vanitie, & ſinne as the linke of a wayne.
label: Isaie

text: Which ſay: let him make haſt, & let his worke come quickly, that we may ſee it: & let the counſel of the holie one of Iſrael come, and we shal know it.
label: Isaie

text: Woe vnto you that cal euil good, and good euil: putting darknes light, and light darknes: putting bitter for ſwete, & ſwete for bitter.
label: Isaie

text: Woe to you that are wiſe in your owne eies, and prudent before yourſelues.
label: Isaie

text: Woe to you that are mightie to drinke wine, & ſtout men in drunkennes.
label: Isaie

text: Which iuſtifie the impious for giftes, and take away the iuſtice of the iuſt from them.
label: Isaie

text: For this, euen as the tongue of fire deuoureth ſtuble, and the heate of the flame burneth it vp: ſo shal their roote be as iſles, and their bud shal riſe vp as duſt, for they haue caſt away the law of the Lord of hoſtes, and haue blaſphemed the word of the holie one of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: Therfore is the furie of our Lord wrath againſt his people, and he hath ſtretched out his hand vpon them, and ſtriken them: and the mountaines were trubled, and their carcaſſes were made as dung in the middes of the ſtreates. In al theſe thinges his furie is not turned away, but yet is his hand ſtretched forth.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal lift vp a ſigne in the nations a farre, and shal whiſtle to him of the ends of the earth: and behold he shal come in haſt ſpedely.
label: Isaie

text: There is none that faynteth, nor that laboreth in them, he wil not ſlumber, nor ſleepe, neither shal the girdle of his reines be looſed, neither shal the latchet of his shoe be broken.
label: Isaie

text: His arrowes sharpe, and al his bowes bent. The hoofes of his horſes as the flint, & his wheeles as the violence of a tempeſt.
label: Isaie

text: His roaring as a lions, he shal roare as lions whelpes: and he wil gnash, and hold the praye, and claſpe it, and there shal be none to plucke it away.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal ſound vpon him in that day, as the ſound of the ſea: we shal looke towards the earth, and behold darkenes of tribulation, and the light is darkened in the miſt therof.
label: Isaie

text: IN the yeare that king Ozias died, I ſaw our Lord ſitting vpon an high throne and eleuated: and thoſe thinges that were vnder him filled the temple.
label: Isaie

text: Seraphims ſtoode vpon the ſame: ſix winges to one, and ſix winges to the other: with two they couered his face, and with two they couered his feete, and with two they flewe.
label: Isaie

text: And they cried one to another, and ſayd: Holie, holie, holie, the Lord God of hoſtes, al the earth is ful of his glorie.
label: Isaie

text: And the lintels of the dores were moued at the voice of him that cried, and the houſe was filled with ſmoke.
label: Isaie

text: And I ſaid: Woe is me becauſe I haue held my peace, becauſe I am a man of polluted lippes, and I dwel in the middes of a people that hath polluted lippes, and the king the Lord of hoſtes I haue ſene with mine eies.
label: Isaie

text: And one of the Seraphims flewe to me, and in his hand an hote cole, which he had taken with tonges from the altar.
label: Isaie

text: And he touched my mouth, and ſaid: Behold this hath touched thy lippes, and thine iniquitie shal be taken away, & thy ſinne shal be cleanſed.
label: Isaie

text: And I heard the voice of our Lord ſaying: Whom shal I ſend? and who shal goe for vs? And I ſayd: Loe I am here, ſend me.
label: Isaie

text: And he ſayd: Goe, and thou shalt ſay to this people: Heare ye that heare, and vnderſtand not: and ſee viſion, and knowe it not.
label: Isaie

text: Blinde the hart of this people, and make their eares heauie, and shut their eies: leſt perhaps they may ſee with their eies, and heare with their eares, and vnderſtand with their hart, and be conuerted and I heale them.
label: Isaie

text: And I ſaid: How long Lord? And he ſaid: Vntil the cities be made deſolate without inhabiter, and the houſes without man, and the land shal be leaft deſert.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord shal make men goe farre of, and he shal be multiplied that was leaft in the middes of the earth.
label: Isaie

text: And yet there shal be tithing in it, and she shal be conuerted, and shal be to the shew as a terebinth, and as an oke, that ſpreadeth his boughes: that which shal ſtand in it, shal be an holie ſeede.
label: Isaie

text: AND it came to paſſe in the dayes of Achaz the ſonne of Ioathan, the ſonne of Ozias king of Iuda, there came vp Raſin the king of Syria, and Phacee the ſonne of Romelia the king of Iſrael to Ieruſalem, to fight againſt it: and they could not ouercome it.
label: Isaie

text: And they told the houſe of Dauid, ſaying: Syria hath reſted vpon Ephraim, & his hart was moued, and the hart of his people, as the trees of the wooddes are moued at the face of the winde.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord ſayd to Iſaie: Goe forth to meete Achaz, thou, and Iaſub thy ſonne that is leaft, to the conduite of the vpper poole, in the way of the Fullers filde.
label: Isaie

text: And thou shalt ſay to him: See thou be ſtil: feare not, and let not thine hart be afrayd of the two tailes of theſe ſmoking fyrebrands, in the wrath of the furie of Raſin the king of Syria, and of the ſonne of Romelia.
label: Isaie

text: For that Syria hath taken counſel againſt thee, vnto the euil of Ephraim, and the ſonne of Romelia, ſaying:
label: Isaie

text: Let vs goe vp to Iuda, and rayſe it vp, and plucke it away to vs, and make the ſonne of Tabeel king in the middes therof.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth our Lord God: It shal not ſtand, & this shal not be.
label: Isaie

text: But the head of Syria Damaſcus, & the head of Damaſcus Raſin: and yet threeſcore and fiue yeares, and Ephraim shal ceaſe to be a people:
label: Isaie

text: And the head of Ephraim Samaria, and the head of Samaria the ſonne of Romelia. If you wil not beleue, you shal not be permanent.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord added to ſpeake to Achaz, ſaying:
label: Isaie

text: Aske a ſigne for thee of the Lord thy God vnto the depth of hel, or vnto the height aboue.
label: Isaie

text: And Achaz ſayd: I wil not aske, and I wil not tempte our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: And he ſaid: Heare ye therfore ô houſe of Dauid: Is it a ſmal thing for you, to be greuous to men, that you are greuous to my God alſo?
label: Isaie

text: Therfore shal our Lord himſelfe geue you a ſigne. Behold a virgin shal conceiue, and beare a ſonne, & his name shal be called Emmanuel.
label: Isaie

text: He shal eate butter and honie, that he may know to refuſe euil, and chooſe the good.
label: Isaie

text: For before the childe know to refuſe euil, and chooſe good, the land which thou doeſt deteſt shal be forſaken of the face of her two kinges.
label: Isaie

text: Our Lord wil bring vpon thee, & vpon thy people, and vpon the houſe of thy father, daies that came not ſince the daies of the ſeparation of Ephraim from Iuda, with the king of the Aſſirians.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be in that day: our Lord shal hiſſe to the flie, that is in the vtter moſt part of the riuers of Ægypt, and to the bee, that is in the land of Aſſur.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal come, and shal reſt al in the torrentes of valleis, and in the caues of rockes, and in al shrubbe places, and in al holes.
label: Isaie

text: In that day our Lord shal shaue with a raſer, hyred by them, that are beyond the riuer, by the king of the Aſſirians, the head, and the haires of the feete, and the whole beard.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be in that day: a man shal nourish a young cowe, and two ewes.
label: Isaie

text: And for the abundance of milke he shal eate butter: for butter and honie shal euerie one eate, that shal be leaft in the middes of the land.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be in that day: euerie place where there shal be a thouſand vines, for a thouſand peeces of ſiluer, they shal be into thornes and bryers.
label: Isaie
