text: With arrowes and bow they shal goe in thither: for bryers and thornes shal be in al the land.
label: Isaie

text: And al mountaines, that shal be weeded with a weeding hooke, the terrour of thornes and bryers shal not come thither, and it shal be for the oxe to feede on, and cattle to treade vpon.
label: Isaie

text: AND our Lord ſayd to me: Take thee a great booke, & write in it with the pen of man. Take away the ſpoiles ſpedely, quickly take prayes.
label: Isaie

text: And I tooke to me faithful witneſſes, Vrias the prieſt, & Zacharias the ſonne of Barachias.
label: Isaie

text: And I went to the propheteſſe, and she conceiued, and bare a ſonne. And our Lord ſayd to me: Cal his name, Haſten to take away the ſpoiles: make haſt to take prayes.
label: Isaie

text: For before the childe know to cal his father and his mother, the ſtrength of Damaſcus shal be taken away, and the ſpoiles of Samaria before the king of the Aſſirians.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord added yet to ſpeake vnto me, ſaying:
label: Isaie

text: For that this people hath caſt away the waters of Siloe, that runne with ſilence, and rather taken Raſin, and the ſonne of Romelia:
label: Isaie

text: for this cauſe behold our Lord wil bring vpon them the waters of the riuer ſtrong and manie, the king of the Aſſirians, and al his glorie: and he wil aſcend ouer al their riuers, and wil flowe ouer al their bankes.
label: Isaie

text: And wil goe through Iuda, ouerflowing, and paſſing through shal come euen to the necke. And the ſtretching out of his winges shal fil the bredth of thy land ô Emmanuel.
label: Isaie

text: Gather ye together ô peoples, and be ouercome, and heare al ye landes far of: Take courege, and be ouercome, gird yourſelues, & be ouercome.
label: Isaie

text: Take counſel and it shal be defeated: ſpeake a word, and it shal not be done: becauſe God is with vs.
label: Isaie

text: For thus ſayth our Lord to me: As in a ſtrong arme he hath taught me, that I should not walke in the way of this people, ſaying:
label: Isaie

text: Say not: Conſpiracie: for al thinges that this people ſpeaketh, is conſpiracie: and feare ye not their feare, neither dread ye.
label: Isaie

text: The Lord of hoſtes him ſanctifie ye: be he your dread, and he your terrour.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal be a ſanctification to you. But for a ſtone of offence, and for a rocke of ſcandal to the two houſes of Iſrael, for a ſnare and a ruine to the inhabitants of Ieruſalem.
label: Isaie

text: And verie manie of them shal ſtumble and fal, and shal be broken in peeces, and shal be ſnared, and taken.
label: Isaie

text: Binde the teſtimonie, ſeale the law in my diſciples.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil expect our Lord, who hath hid his face from the houſe of Iacob, and I wil wayte for him.
label: Isaie

text: Behold I and my children, whom our Lord hath geuen me for a ſigne, and for a wonder in Iſrael from the Lord of hoſtes, which dwelleth in mount Sion.
label: Isaie

text: And when they shal ſay to you: Aske of Pythones, and of diuiners, which whiſper in their inchantments: shal not the people aske viſion of their God, for the liuing of the dead?
label: Isaie

text: To the law rather, and to the teſtimonie. And if they ſpeake not according to this word, they shal not haue the morning light.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal paſſe by it, shal fal, and be hungrie: and when he shal be hungrie, he wil be angrie, and curſe his king, and his God, and wil looke vpwards.
label: Isaie

text: And he wil looke to the earth, and behold tribulation and darknes, diſſolution and diſtreſſe, and miſt perſecuting, and he can not flie away from his diſtreſſe.
label: Isaie

text: AT the firſt time was the land of Zabulon alleuiated: and the land of Nepthali: and at the laſt was aggrauated the way of the ſea beyond Iordan of Galilee of the Gentiles.
label: Isaie

text: The people that walked in darknes, hath ſene great light: to them that dwelt in the countrie of the shadow of death, light is riſen.
label: Isaie

text: Thou haſt multiplied the nation, and not magnified the ioy. They shal reioyce before thee, as they that reioyce in harueſt, as conquerors reioyce after a pray is taken, when they diuide the ſpoiles.
label: Isaie

text: For the yoke of their burden, and the rod of their shoulder, and the ſcepter of their exactour thou haſt ouercome, as in the day of Madian.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe al violent taking of pray with tumult, and garment mingled with bloud, shal be to be burnt, and foode for the fyre.
label: Isaie

text: For A LITLE CHILD IS BORNE TO VS, and a ſonne is geuen to vs, and principalitie is made vpon his shoulder: and his name shal be called, Meruelous, Counſeler, God, Strong, Father of the world to come, the Prince of peace.
label: Isaie

text: His empire shal be multiplied, and there shal be no end of peace: he shal ſit vpon the throne of Dauid, and vpon his kingdom: that he may confirme it, and ſtrengthen it in iudgement and iuſtice, from this time & for euer: the zeale of the Lord of hoſtes shal doe this.
label: Isaie

text: Our Lord hath ſent a word into Iacob, and it is fallen in Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: And al the people of Ephraim shal know, & the inhabitans of Samaria, ſaying in pride & greatnes of hart:
label: Isaie

text: Brickes are fallen, but we wil build with ſquare ſtones: they haue cut downe ſycomores, but we wil change them into ceders.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord shal lifte vp the enemies of Raſin ouer him, and shal turne his enemies into tumult.
label: Isaie

text: Syria from the Eaſt, and the Philiſthims from the Weſt: and they shal deuoure Iſrael with ful mouth. In al theſe thinges his furie is not turned away, but his hand is yet ſtretched forth.
label: Isaie

text: And the people is not returned to him, who hath ſtrooken them, and haue not ſought after the Lord of hoſtes.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord shal deſtroy from Iſrael the head & the tayle, the peruerter and reſtrayner in one day.
label: Isaie

text: The aged and honorable, he is the head, & the prophet that teacheth a lie, he is the tayle.
label: Isaie

text: And they that cal this people bleſſed, ſeducing them: and that are called bleſſed, shal be throwen headlong.
label: Isaie

text: For this cauſe our Lord shal not reioyce vpon their yong men: and on their pupilles, and widowes he shal not haue mercie: becauſe euerie one is an hypocrite & wicked, and euerie mouth hath ſpoken follie. In al theſe thinges his furie is not turned away, but his hand is yet ſtretched forth.
label: Isaie

text: For impietie is kindled as a fyre, it shal deuoure bryer and thorne: and it shal be kindled in the thicket of the foreſt, and it shal be wrapped vp together in the pride of ſmoke.
label: Isaie

text: In the wrath of the Lord of hoſtes the earth is trubled, and the people shal be foode for the fyre: man shal not spare his brother.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal decline to the right hand, and shal be hungrie: and shal eate on the left hand, and shal not be filled: euerie one shal eate the flesh of his arme: Manaſſes Ephraim, and Ephraim Manaſſes, they together againſt Iuda.
label: Isaie

text: In al theſe thinges his furie is not turned away, but his hand is yet ſtretched forth.
label: Isaie

text: VVOE to them that make wicked lawes: and writing, haue written iniuſtice.
label: Isaie

text: That they might oppreſſe the poore in iudgement, & doe violence to the cauſe of the humble of my people: that widowes might be their praye, and they might ſpoile pupilles.
label: Isaie

text: What wil you doe in the day of viſitation, and of calamitie coming from farre? to whoſe helpe wil ye flee? and where wil ye leaue your glorie?
label: Isaie

text: That you be not bowed vnder the bond, and fal with the ſlaine? In al theſe thinges his furie is not turned away, but his hand is yet ſtretched forth.
label: Isaie

text: Woe to Aſſur, he is the rod of my furie, and the ſtaffe, myne indignation is in their handes.
label: Isaie

text: I wil ſend him to a deceitful nation, & I wil geue him commandment againſt the people of my furie, that he take away ſpoiles, and catche the praye, and put them to be troden vpon, as the mire of the ſtreates.
label: Isaie

text: But he shal not ſo thinke, and his hart shal not eſteme it ſo: but his hart shal be ſet to deſtroy, and to the deſtruction of no few nations.
label: Isaie

text: For he shal ſay:
label: Isaie

text: Are not my princes with al kinges? Is not as Charcamis, ſo Calano: and as Arphad, ſo Emath? Is not as Damaſcus, ſo Samaria?
label: Isaie

text: Euen as my hand hath found the kingdomes of the idol, ſo alſo their idols of Ieruſalem, & of Samaria.
label: Isaie

text: Shal I not as I haue done to Samaria and her idols, ſo do to Ieruſalem and her idols?
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be: when the Lord shal haue accomplished al his workes in mount Sion, and in Ieruſalem, I wil viſite ouer the fruite of the magnifical hart of the king of Aſſur, and ouer the glorie of the hautines of his eyes.
label: Isaie

text: For he hath ſaid: In the ſtrength of mine owne hand haue I done it, and in mine owne wiſdome haue I vnderſtood: and I haue taken away the borders of peoples, and haue ſpoiled their princes, and haue pulled downe as a mightie man, them that ſate on high.
label: Isaie

text: And my hand hath found the ſtrength of peoples as a neſt: and as egges be gathered, that are left, ſo haue I gathered together al the earth: and there was none that moued wing, and opened mouth, and once muttered.
label: Isaie

text: Shal the axe glorie againſt him, that cutteth with it? or shal the ſaw exalt itſelfe againſt him, by whom it is drawen? As if a rod should lift vp itſelf agaynſt him, that lifteth it vp, and a ſtaffe exalt itſelf which is certes but wood.
label: Isaie

text: For this cauſe the Dominatour the Lord of hoſtes shal ſend leannes in his fat ones: and vnder his glorie shal burne as it were the burning of fyre kindled.
label: Isaie

text: And the light of Iſrael shal be in fyre, and the Holie one therof in flame: and his thorne shal be kindled, and be deuoured, and the briars in one day.
label: Isaie

text: And the glorie of his foreſt, and of his carmelus shal be conſumed, from the ſoule euen to the flesh, and he shal be a fugitiue for feare.
label: Isaie

text: And the remaynes of the woode of his foreſt, for the fewnes shal be numbred, and a child shal write them.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be in that day, the reſidue of Iſrael, and they that shal eſcape of the houſe of Iacob, shal not adde to leane vpon him, that ſtriketh them: but they shal leane vpon our Lord the holie one of Iſrael in truth.
label: Isaie

text: The remnant shal be conuerted, the remnant I ſay of Iacob, to the ſtrong God.
label: Isaie

text: For if thy people ô Iſrael shal be as the ſand of the ſea, the remnant therof shal be conuerted, conſumnation abbridged shal make iuſtice ouerflow.
label: Isaie

text: For our Lord the God of hoſtes shal make conſummation, and abbridgement in the middes of al the earth.
label: Isaie

text: For this cauſe, thus ſayth our Lord the God of hoſtes: O my people inhabiter of Sion, be not afrayd of Aſſur: he shal ſtrike thee with his rod, and shal lift vp his ſtaffe ouer thee in the way of Ægypt.
label: Isaie

text: For yet a litle and a very litle, and mine indignation and furie vpon their wickednes shal be conſummate.
label: Isaie

text: And the Lord of hoſtes shal rayſe vp a ſcourge vpon him, according to the plague of Madian in the Rocke Oreb, and his rod vpon the ſea, and he shal lift it vp in the way of Ægypt.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be in that day: his burden shal be taken away from of thy shoulder, and his yoke from of thy necke, and the yoke shal putrifie at the face of oile.
label: Isaie

text: He shal come into Aiath, he shal paſſe into Magron: at Machmas he shal commend his veſſels.
label: Isaie

text: They haue paſſed in haſt, Gaba is our ſeate: Rama was aſtonied, Gabaath of Saul fled.
label: Isaie

text: Neay with thy voice ô daughter of Gallim, attend Laiſa, ſeelie poore Anathoth.
label: Isaie

text: Medemena is remoued: ye inhabitants of Gabin take courege.
label: Isaie

text: Yet there is day, to ſtand in Nobe: he shal shake his hand ouer the mountaine of the daughter of Sion, the litle hil of Ieruſalem.
label: Isaie

text: Behold the dominatour the Lord of hoſtes shal breake the litle flagon in terrour, and the high of ſtature shal be cut downe, and the loftie shal be humbled.
label: Isaie

text: And the thicke places of the foreſt shal be ouerthrowen with iron, and Libanus with the high ones shal fal.
label: Isaie

text: AND a rod shal come forth of the roote of Ieſſe, and a flowre shal riſe vp out of his roote.
label: Isaie

text: And the Spirite of our Lord shal reſt vpon him: the ſpirit of wiſdom, and vnderſtanding, the ſpirit of counſel, and ſtrength, the ſpirit of knowlege, and pietie,
label: Isaie

text: and the ſpirit of the feare of our Lord shal repleinsh him. He shal not iudge according to the ſight of the eies, nor rebuke according to the hearing of the eares.
label: Isaie

text: But he shal iudge the poore in iuſtice, and shal rebuke in equitie for the milde of the earth: and he shal ſtrike the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the ſpirit of his lippes he shal kil the impious.
label: Isaie

text: And iuſtice shal be the girdle of his loynes: and fayth the girdle of his reines.
label: Isaie

text: The woolfe shal dwel with the lambe: and the leopard shal lie with the kid: the calfe, and lion, and sheepe shal abide together, a litle child shal leade them.
label: Isaie

text: The calfe, and the beare shal feede: their yong ones shal reſt together: and the lion shal eate ſtrawe as it were an oxe.
label: Isaie

text: And the infant from the breſt shal be delighted vpon the hole of the aſpe: & he that is weyned, shal thruſt his hand into the hole of the cockatrice.
label: Isaie

text: They shal not hurt, and they shal not kil in al my holie mountayne, becauſe the earth is replenished with the knowlege of our Lord, as the couering waters of the ſea.
label: Isaie

text: In that day the roote of Ieſſe, that ſtandeth for a ſigne of peoples, him the nations shal beſech, & his ſepulchre shal be glorious.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be in that day: our Lord shal put to his hand the ſecond time to poſſeſſe the remnant of his people, which shal be leaft of the Aſſirians, and of Ægypt, and of Phethros, and of Æthiopia, and of Ælam, and of Sennaar, and of Emath, and of the ilands of the ſea.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal lift vp a ſigne vnto the nations, and shal aſſemble together the fugitiues of Iſrael, and shal gather the diſperſed of Iuda from the foure quarters of the earth.
label: Isaie

text: And the emulation of Ephraim shal be taken away, and the enemies of Iuda shal perish: Ephraim shal not enuie Iuda, & Iuda shal not fight againſt Ephraim.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal flie vpon the shoulders of the Philiſthiims by the ſea, they together shal ſpoile the children of the Eaſt: Idumea, and Moab the precept of their hand, and the children of Ammon shal be obedient.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord shal make deſolate the tongue of the ſea of Ægypt, and shal lift vp his hand ouer the riuer in the ſtrength of his ſpirit: and he shal ſtrike him in his ſeuen ſtreames, ſo that they may paſſe through it with showes.
label: Isaie

text: And there shal be a way to the remnant of my people, which shal be leaft of the Aſſirians: as there was to Iſrael in the day, that he came vp out of the Land of Ægypt.
label: Isaie

text: AND thou shalt ſay in that day: I WIL confeſſe to thee ô Lord, becauſe thou waſt angrie with me: thy furie is turned away, and thou haſt comforted me.
label: Isaie

text: Behold God is my ſauiour, I wil doe confidently, and wil not feare: becauſe our Lord is my ſtrength, and my praiſe, and he is become my ſaluation.
label: Isaie

text: You shal drawe waters in ioy out of the ſauiours fountaines.
label: Isaie

text: And you shal ſay in that day: Confeſſe ye to our Lord, and inuocate his name: make his inuentions knowen among the peoples: remember that his name is high.
label: Isaie

text: Sing ye to our Lord becauſe he hath done magnifically: shew this forth in al the earth.
label: Isaie

text: Reioyce, and prayſe ô habitation of Sion: becauſe great in the middes of thee, is the holie one of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: THE burden of Babylon, which Iſaie the ſonne of Amos ſaw.
label: Isaie

text: Vpon the darke mountaine lift vp a ſigne, exalt the voice, lift vp the hand, and let the dukes enter the gates.
label: Isaie

text: I haue commanded my ſanctified, and haue called my ſtrong ones in my wrath, them that reioce in my glorie.
label: Isaie

text: The voice of a multitude in the mountaines, as it were of manie peoples, a voice of the ſound of kinges, nations gathered together: The Lord of hoſtes hath commanded the hoſt of battel.
label: Isaie

text: Coming from a countrie far of, from the end of heauen: our Lord, and the inſtruments of his furie, to deſtroy the whole land.
label: Isaie

text: Howle ye, becauſe the day of our Lord is nere: it shal come as deſtruction from our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: For this cauſe shal al handes be diſſolued, and euerie hart of man shal melt,
label: Isaie

text: and be broken. Gripings and paines shal hold them, they shal be in paine as she that trauaileth. Euerie one shal be aſtonied at his neighbour, their countenances as faces burnt.
label: Isaie

text: Behold the day of our Lord shal come, cruel, and ful of indignation, and of wrath, and furie to bring the land to a wildernes, and to deſtroy the ſinners therof out of it.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe the ſtarres of heauen, and their brightnes shal not diſplay their light: the ſunne is darkened in his ryſing, and the moone shal not shine in her light.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil viſite ouer the euiles of the world, and againſt the impious their iniquitie, and I wil make the pride of infidels to ceaſe, and wil humble the arrogancie of the ſtrong.
label: Isaie

text: A man shal be more precious then gold, & man then pure fine gold.
label: Isaie

text: For this I shal truble heauen: & the earth shal be moued out of her place, for the indignation of the Lord of hoſtes, & for the day of the wrath of his furie.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be as a yong doe fleing, and as a sheepe: and there shal be none to gather them together: euerie man shal turne to his owne people, and euerie one shal flee to his owne land.
label: Isaie

text: Euerie one that shal be found, shal be ſlaine: and euerie one that shal come to ayde, shal fal by the ſword.
label: Isaie

text: Their infants shal be dashed in peeces before their eies: their houſes shal be ſpoiled, and their wiues shal be rauished.
label: Isaie

text: Behold I wil rayſe vpon them the Medes, which shal not ſeeke ſiluer, nor deſire gold.
label: Isaie

text: But with arrowes they shal kil the litle ones, and shal haue no pitie vpon the ſucklings of the wombe, and vpon the children their eie shal not ſpare.
label: Isaie

text: And that Babylon glorious in kingdoms, noble in the pride of the Chaldees, shal be euen as our Lord ſubuerted Sodom and Gomorrha.
label: Isaie

text: It shal not be inhabited for euer, & it shal not be founded vnto generation & generation: neither shal the Arabian pitch his tents there, nor shepeheardes reſt there.
label: Isaie

text: But beaſtes shal reſt there, and their houſes shal be filled with dragons, and oſtreches shal dwel there, and Satyrs shal daunce there:
label: Isaie

text: And the Syrach owles shal anſwer there in the houſes therof, and mermaides in the temples of pleaſure.
label: Isaie

text: IT is neere that the time therof shal come, and the daies therof shal not be porlonged. For our Lord wil haue mercie on Iacob, and wil yet chooſe out of Iſrael, and wil make them reſt vpon their owne ground: the ſtranger shal be ioyned to them, & shal ſticke to the houſe of Iacob.
label: Isaie

text: And peoples shal hold them, and bring them into their place: and the houſe of Iſrael shal poſſeſſe them vpon the land of our Lord for ſeruants and handmaides: and they shal lead captiue thoſe that had taken them, & shal ſubdewe their exactours.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be in that day, when God shal geue thee reſt from thy labour, and from thy vexation, and from the ſore ſeruitude, which thou didſt ſerue before.
label: Isaie

text: Thou shalt take this parable againſt the king of Babylon, and shalt ſay: How hath the exactour ceaſed, the tribute reſted:
label: Isaie

text: Our Lord hath broken the ſtaffe of the impious, the rodde of the rulers,
label: Isaie

text: that did beate peoples in indignation with vncurable wound, ſubdewing nations in furie, perſecuting cruelly.
label: Isaie

text: Al earth is quiet and ſtil, is glad & hath reioyced.
label: Isaie

text: The firre trees alſo haue reioyced ouer thee, and the cedars of Libanus: ſince thou haſt ſlept, there hath none come vp to hewe vs.
label: Isaie

text: Hel beneath is trubled to meete thy coming, it hath rayſed vp the giants for thee. Al the princes of the earth are riſen vp from their thrones, al the princes of nations.
label: Isaie

text: Al shal anſwere, and ſay to thee: Thou alſo art wounded euen as we, made like vnto vs.
label: Isaie

text: Thy pride is drawen downe to hel, thy carcaſſe is fallen: vnder thee shal the mothe be ſtrawed, and wormes shal be thy couering.
label: Isaie

text: How art thou fallen from heauen Lucifer, which didſt riſe in the morning? art thou fallen to the earth, that didſt wound nations?
label: Isaie

text: Which didſt ſay in thy hart: I wil aſcend into heauen, aboue the ſtarres of God wil I exalt my throne, I wil ſitte in the mount of the teſtament, in the ſides of the North.
label: Isaie

text: I wil aſcend aboue the height of the cloudes, I wil be like to the Higheſt.
label: Isaie

text: But yet thou shalt be drawen downe to hel, into the depth of the lake.
label: Isaie

text: They that shal ſee thee, shal turne toward thee, & behold thee: Is this the man, that trubled the earth, that shaked kingdomes,
label: Isaie

text: that made the world a deſert, & deſtroyed the cities therof, opened not the priſon to his priſoners?
label: Isaie

text: Al the kinges of the nations euerie one haue ſlept in glorie, eche man in his owne houſe.
label: Isaie

text: But thou art caſt forth out of thy ſepulchre, as an vnprofitable branche polluted, and wrapped vp with them that were ſlaine by the ſword, and are gone downe to the fundations of the lake, as a rotten carcaſſe.
label: Isaie

text: Thou shalt not keepe companie with them, neither in burial, for thou haſt deſtroyed thy land, thou haſt ſlaine thy people: the ſeede of the wicked shal not be named for euer.
label: Isaie

text: Prepare his children to ſlaughter in the iniquitie of their fathers: they shal not riſe vp, nor inherite the land, nor fil the world with cities.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil riſe ouer them, ſayth the Lord of hoſtes: & I wil deſtroy the name of Babylon, and the remaynes, and bud, and progenie: ſayth our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil make it the poſſeſſion of the hedgehog, & matrices of waters, & I wil ſweepe it with beſome wearing it, ſayth the Lord of hoſtes.
label: Isaie

text: The Lord of hoſtes hath ſworne, ſaying: If it shal not be, as I haue thought: and ſo fal out, as I haue in mind conſulted:
label: Isaie

text: That I deſtroy the Aſſirian in my land, and in my mountaines tread vpon him: and his yoke shal be taken away from them, and his burden taken of from their shoulder.
label: Isaie

text: This is the counſel, that I haue deuiſed vpon al the earth, and this is the hand ſtretched forth vpon al nations.
label: Isaie

text: For the Lord of hoſtes hath decreed, and who can weaken it? and his hand is ſtretched out: and who shal turne it away?
label: Isaie

text: In the yeare, that king Achaz died, was this burden made.
label: Isaie

text: Reioyce not thou whole Philiſtæa, that the rod of thy ſtriker is broken in peeces: for from the roote of the ſerpent shal iſſue forth a cockatrice, and his ſeede ſwalowing the bird.
label: Isaie

text: And the firſt borne of the poore shal be fed, & the poore shal reſt confidently: and I wil make thy roote to perish in famine, and wil kil thy remnant.
label: Isaie

text: Howle thou gate, crie out ô citie: al Philiſthæa is throwen downe: for a ſmoke shal come from the North, and there is none that shal eſcape his troupe.
label: Isaie

text: And what shal be anſwered to the meſſengers of nations? That our Lord hath founded Sion, and the poore of his people shal hope in him.
label: Isaie

text: THE burden of Moab. Becauſe Ar-Moab was waſted in the night, he hath held his peace: becauſe the wal of Moab is deſtroyed in the night, he hath held his peace.
label: Isaie

text: The houſe is gone vp, & Dibon to the high places to moorne vpon Nabo, and vpon Medaba shal Moab howle: on al the heades therof baldnes, and euerie beard shal be shauen.
label: Isaie

text: In the high wayes therof they are girded with ſackcloth: vpon the roofes therof, and in the ſtreates therof al howling, goeth downe to weepe.
label: Isaie

text: Heſebon shal crie, & Elealé, their voice is heard euen to Iaſa. For this shal the wel appoynted of Moab howle, his ſoule shal howle to himſelf.
label: Isaie

text: My hart shal crie to Moab, the barres therof vnto Segor an heifer aſtonishing: for by the aſcent of Luith he shal goe vp weeping: & in the way of Oronaim they shal lift vp a crie of contrition.
label: Isaie

text: For the waters of Nemrim shal be made deſolate, becauſe the graſſe is withered, the ſpring is faded, al grennes is perished.
label: Isaie

text: According to the greatnes of the worke, is alſo their viſitation: they shal lead them to the torrent of willowes.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe the crie shal goe round about the border of Moab: vnto Gallim the howling therof, and vnto the Pit-Elim the crie therof.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe the waters of Dibon are replenished with bloud: for I wil put additions vpon Dibon: the lion for them that shal flee of Moab, and for the remmant of the land.
label: Isaie

text: SEND forth ô Lord the lambe the dominatour of the earth, from the Rocke of the deſert, to the mount of the daughter of Sion.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal be as a bird fleing, and the yong flying out of the neſt, ſo shal the daughters of Moab be in the paſſage of Arnon.
label: Isaie

text: Take counſel, gather a councel: ſet thy shadow in the midday as it were night: hide them that flee, and them that wander bewray not.
label: Isaie

text: My fugitiues shal dwel with thee: Moab be thou their couert from the face of the deſtroyer: for the duſt is ended, the wretch is come to naught: he hath failed, that trode downe the earth.
label: Isaie

text: And a throne shal be prepared in mercie, and there shal ſit vpon it in truth in the tabernacle of Dauid, he that iudgeth and ſeketh iudgement, and quickly rendereth that which is iuſt.
label: Isaie

text: We haue heard the pride of Moab, he is proud excedingly: his pride and his arrogancie, and his indignation is more then his ſtrength.
label: Isaie

text: Therfore shal Moab howle to Moab, al shal howle: to them, that reioyce vpon the walles of baqued bricke, tel ye their plagues.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe the ſuburbes of Heſebon are deſolate, and the vineyard of Sabama the lords of the Nations haue cut of: the branches therof haue reached tô Iazer: they wandered in the deſert, the branches therof are leaft, they paſſed ouer the ſea.
label: Isaie

text: For this I wil lament in the weeping of Iazer the vineyard of Sabama: I wil inebriate thee with my teare ô Heſebon, and Elealé: becauſe the voice of the treaders is rusht in vpon thy vintage, and vpon thy harueſt.
label: Isaie

text: And gladnes and ioy shal be taken away from Carmelus, and it shal not reioyce nor make iubilation in vineyards. He shal not treade wine in the preſſe that was wonte to treade: the voice of the treaders I haue taken away.
label: Isaie

text: For this my bellie shal ſound as an harpe toMoab, & my bowels to the wal of baqued bricke.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be: when it shal appeare that Moab hath laboured for his excelſes, he shal goe in to his ſanctuaries to pray, & shal not preuaile.
label: Isaie

text: This is the word, that our Lord ſpake to Moab from that time:
label: Isaie

text: and now our Lord hath ſpoken, ſaying: In three yeares, as the yeares of an hired ſeruant, the glorie of Moab shal be taken away vpon al the multitude of people, and it shal be leaft litle and ſmal, not much.
label: Isaie

text: THE burden of Damaſcus. Behold Damaſcus shal ceaſe to be a citie, and shal be as an heape of ſtones in ruine.
label: Isaie

text: The forſaken cities of Aroer shal be for flockes, and they shal reſt there, and there shal be none to terrifie them.
label: Isaie

text: And ayde shal ceaſe from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damaſcus: and the remnant of Syria shal be as the glorie of the children of Iſrael: ſayth the Lord of hoſtes.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be in that day: the glorie of Iacob shal be diminished, and the fatnes of his flesh shal become leane.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be as one gathering in harueſt that which remayneth, and his arme shal gather the eares of corne: and it shal be as he that ſeketh eares in the vale of Raphaim.
label: Isaie

text: And the fruite therof shal be leaft, as it were a cluſter of grapes in it, and as the shaking of the oliue tree, of two or three oliues in the toppe of a bough, or foure or fiue in the toppes therof, ſayth our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: In that day man shal incline himſelfe to his maker, and his eies shal looke to the holie one of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal not incline to the altars, which his handes made: and the things that his fingers wrought he shal not regard, as groues and temples.
label: Isaie

text: In that day the cities of his ſtrength shal be leaft, as the ploughes, and the corne that were leaft before the face of the children of Iſrael, and thou shalt be deſolate.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thou haſt forgotten God thy ſauiour, and haſt not remembred thy ſtrong helper: therfore shalt thou plant a faythful plant, & shalt ſow a ſtrange ſeede.
label: Isaie

text: In the day of thy planting shal be the wilde grape, & in the morning thy ſeede shal florish: the harueſt is taken away in the day of inheritance, and he shal be vehemently ſorie.
label: Isaie

text: Woe to the multitude of manie peoples, being as the multitude of the ſounding ſea: & the tumult of multitudes, as the ſound of manie waters.
label: Isaie

text: Peoples shal ſound as the ſound of waters ouerflowing, and he shal rebuke him, and shal flee far of: and he shal be violently taken away as the duſt of the mountaines at the face of the wind, and as a whirlewind before a tempeſt.
label: Isaie

text: In the euentide, and behold truble: in the morning, and he shal not be. this is the portion of them, that haue waſted vs, & the lot of them that ſpoiled vs.
label: Isaie

text: VVOE to the land the cymbal of winges, which is beyond the riuers of Æthiopia,
label: Isaie

text: which ſendeth legates into the ſea, and in the veſſels of bulrushes vpon the waters. Goe ye ſwift angels to a nation shaken aſunder, and torne in peeces: to a terrible people, after which there is none other: to a nation expecting and troden vnder foote, whoſe land the floodes haue ſpoiled:
label: Isaie

text: Al ye inhabitants of the world, which abide in the earth, where the ſigne shal be lifted vp in the mountaines, you shal ſee, and shal heare the ſound of the trumpet:
label: Isaie

text: becauſe thus ſayth ourd Lord to me: I wil reſt, and conſider in my place, as the noone light is cleere, and as a cloud of dew in the day of harueſt.
label: Isaie

text: For before harueſt it hath wholly florished, and vnripe perfection shal ſpring forth, and the boughes therof shal be cut of with hookes: and the thinges that are leaft, shal be cut of, and shaken out.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal be left together to the birdes of the mountaynes, and beaſtes of the earth: and the foules shal be vpon it the whole ſummer, and al the beaſtes of the earth shal winter vpon it.
label: Isaie

text: In that time shal a gift be brought to the Lord of hoſtes, of a people plucked aſunder and rent in peeces: of a terrible people, after which there hath bene none other, of a nation expecting, expecting and troden vnder foote, whoſe land the floodes haue ſpoiled, to the place of the name of the Lord of hoſtes, mount Sion.
label: Isaie

text: THE burden of Ægypt. Behold our Lord wil aſcend vpon a ſwift cloude, and wil enter into Ægypt, and the idols of Ægypt shal be moued at his preſence, & the hart of Ægypt shal melt in the middes therof.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil make the Ægyptians to runne together againſt the Ægyptians: and a man shal fight againſt his brother, and euerie man againſt his freind, citie againſt citie, kingdom againſt kingdom.
label: Isaie

text: And the ſpirit of Ægypt shal be broken in the bowels therof, and I wil ouerthrow their counſel headlong: and they shal aske their idols, and their diuiners, and Pythons, and Southſayers.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil deliuer Ægypt into the hand of cruel maſters, and a ſtrong king shal rule ouer them, ſayth our Lord the God of hoſtes.
label: Isaie

text: And the water of the ſea shal be dried vp, and the riuer shal be made deſolate, and drie.
label: Isaie

text: And the riuers shal faile: the riuers of the ramppiers shal be diminished, & dried vp. The reede and bulrush shal wither:
label: Isaie

text: the chanel of the riuer shal be ſpoiled of his fountayne, and al ſowne corne filde that is watered shal be dried vp, it shal wither, and shal not be.
label: Isaie

text: And the fishers shal lament, and al that caſt angle into the riuer shal moorne, and they that ſprede net vpon the face of the water shal pine away.
label: Isaie

text: They shal be confounded that wrought twiſting flaxe, kombing and weauing fine thinges.
label: Isaie

text: And the watred places therof shal be drie, al they that made pooles to take fishes.
label: Isaie

text: The princes of Tanis are fooles, the wiſe counſelers of Pharao haue geuen vnwiſe counſel: how ſay ye vnto Pharao: I am the ſonne of the wiſe, the ſonne of the ancient kinges?
label: Isaie

text: Where are now thy wiſe men? let them tel thee, and shew what the Lord of hoſtes hath thought concerning Ægypt.
label: Isaie

text: The princes of Tanis are become fooles, the princes of Nemphis are withered away, they haue deceiued Ægypt, the corner of the peoples therof.
label: Isaie

text: Our Lord hath mingled in the middes therof the ſpirit of gladnes: and they haue made Ægypt to erre in euerie worke therof, as he erreth that is drunke and vomiteth.
label: Isaie

text: And Ægypt shal haue no worke, to make the head and the taile the peruerter, and reſtrayner.
label: Isaie

text: In that day Ægypt shal be as wemen, and they shal be aſtonied, and shal be afrayd at the face of the mouing of the hand of the Lord of hoſtes, which he shal moue ouer it.
label: Isaie

text: And the land of Iuda shal be a feare to Ægypt: euerie one, that shal remember it shal quake at the face of the counſel of the Lord of hoſtes, which he hath thought concerning it.
label: Isaie

text: In that day there shal be fiue cities in the land of Ægypt, ſpeaking tongue the of Chanaan, and ſwearing by the Lord of hoſtes: one shal be called the citie of the ſunne.
label: Isaie

text: In that day there shal be an altar of our Lord in the middes of the land of Ægypt, and a title of our Lord by the border therof
label: Isaie

text: it shal be for a ſigne, and for a teſtimonie to the Lord of hoſtes in the land of Ægypt. For they shal crie to our Lord at the preſence of the afflicter, and he shal ſend them a ſauiour and defender to deliuer them.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord shal be knowen of Ægypt, and the Ægyptians shal knowe our Lord in that day, and shal worshipe him in hoſtes and in giftes: and they shal vow vowes to our Lord, and pay them.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord shal ſmite Ægypt with a ſtrooke, and heale it, and they shal returne to our Lord, and he shal be pacified towards them, and heale them.
label: Isaie

text: In that day there shal be a way from Ægypt to the Aſſirians, and the Aſſirian shal enter into Ægypt, and the Ægyptians to the Aſſirians, and the Ægyptians shal ſerue Aſſur.
label: Isaie

text: In that day shal Iſrael be a third to the Ægyptian and the Aſſirian: a bleſſing in the middes of the earth,
label: Isaie

text: which the Lord of hoſtes hath bleſſed, ſaying: Bleſſed be my people of Ægypt, and the worke of my hands to the Aſſirian: but Iſrael is mine inheritance.
label: Isaie

text: IN the yeare, that Tharthan entred into Azotus, when Sargon the king of the Aſſyrians had ſent him, and he had fought againſt Azotus, and had taken it:
label: Isaie

text: at that time our Lord ſpake in the hand of Iſaie the ſonne of Amos, ſaying: Goe, and looſe the ſackcloth from of thy loynes, and take of thy shooes from thy feete. And he did ſo going naked, and barefoote.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord ſaid: As my ſeruant Iſaie hath walked, naked & barefoote, it shal be a ſigne & a wonder of three heres vpon Æghpt, and vpon Æthiopia,
label: Isaie

text: ſo shal the king of the Aſſyrians leade the captiuitie of Ægypt, and the tranſmigration of Æthiopia, yong and old, naked and vnshod, their buttockes vncouered to the ignominie of Ægypt.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal feare, & be ashamed of Æthiopia their hope, and of Ægypt their glorie.
label: Isaie

text: And the inhabitant of this ile shal ſay in that day: Loe this was our hope, to whom we fled for helpe, that they should deliuer vs from the face of the king of the Aſſyrians: and how shal we be able to eſcape?
label: Isaie

text: THE burden of the deſert ſea. As whirlewinds come from the South, it cometh from the deſert, from an horrible land.
label: Isaie

text: A ſore viſion was told me: he that is incredulous doth vnfaithfully: & he that is a ſpoiler, waſteth. Come vp Aelam, beſiege ô Mede: I haue made al the moorning therof to ceaſe.
label: Isaie

text: Therfore are my loines filled with ſorow, anguish hath poſſeſſed me, as the anguish of a woman that trauaileth: I fel downe when I heard it, I was trubled when I ſaw it.
label: Isaie

text: Mine hart fayled, darkenes made me aſtonied: Babylon my beloued is made a miracle vnto me.
label: Isaie

text: Lay the table, looke about in the watch towre the eaters and drinkers: ariſe ye princes, take shield.
label: Isaie

text: For thus hath our Lord ſayd to me: Goe, and ſet a watchman: and what ſoeuer he shal ſee, let him tel.
label: Isaie

text: And he ſaw a chariote of two horſemen, a rider vpon an aſſe, and a rider vpon a camel: and he beheld them diligently with much looking.
label: Isaie

text: And a lion cried: I am vpon the watch towre of our Lord, ſtanding continually by day: and I am vpon my watch, ſtanding whole nights.
label: Isaie

text: Behold this man cometh, the rider vpon the chariot of two horſemen, and he anſwered, and ſaid: Fallen, fallen is Babylon, and al the ſculptils of the gods therof are broken to the ground.
label: Isaie

text: O my threshing, and children of my flore, the thinges that I haue heard of the Lord of hoſtes the God of Iſrael, I haue shewed vnto you.
label: Isaie

text: The burden of Duma crieth to me out of Seir: Watchman what of the night? watchman what of the night?
label: Isaie

text: The watchman ſaid: morning is come & night: if you ſeeke, ſeeke: returne, come.
label: Isaie

text: The burden in Arabia. In the foreſt at euen you shal ſleepe, in the pathes of Dedanim.
label: Isaie

text: Meeting the thirſtie bring water, you that inhabite the land of the South, with bread meete him that fleeth.
label: Isaie

text: For they are fled from the face of the ſwordes, from the face of the ſword hanging ouer, from the face of the bow bent, from the face of a greuous battel.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thus ſayth our Lord to me: Yet in one yeare, as in the yeare of an hyred man, and al the glorie of Cedar shal be taken away.
label: Isaie

text: And the remnant of the number of the ſtrong archers of the children of Cedar shal be diminished: for our Lord the God of Iſrael hath ſpoken it.
label: Isaie

text: THE burden of the vale of viſion. What aileth thee, that thou art alſo wholly gone vp into the houſe toppes?
label: Isaie

text: ful of clamour, a populous citie, reioycing: thy ſlaine are not ſlaine by the ſword, nor dead in battel.
label: Isaie

text: Al thy princes are fled together, and are bound hard: al that were found, are bound together, they are fled far of.
label: Isaie

text: Therfore haue I ſayd: Depart from me, I wil weepe bitterly: labour not to comforte me, for the deſtruction of the daughter of my people.
label: Isaie

text: For it is a day of ſlaughter, and conculcation, and weepings to our Lord the God of hoſtes in the vale of viſitation, ſearching the wal, and magnifical vpon the mountaine.
label: Isaie

text: And Aelam tooke quiuer, chariote of the horſman, and the shilde hath made the wal naked.
label: Isaie

text: And thy principal valleis shal be ful of chariots, and the horſmen shal place them ſelues in the gate.
label: Isaie

text: And the couering of Iuda shal be diſcouered, and thou shalt ſee in that day the armourie of the houſe of the foreſt.
label: Isaie

text: And you shal ſee the breaches of the citie of Dauid, becauſe they are multiplied: and you haue gathered together the waters of the lower poole,
label: Isaie

text: and haue numbred the houſes of Ieruſalem, and deſtroyed houſes to fortifie the wal.
label: Isaie

text: And you haue made a lake betwen the two walles to the water of old poole: and you looked not vp to him, that made it, and the worker therof long before you ſaw not.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord the God of hoſtes shal cal in that day to weeping, and to moorning, to baldnes, and to girdle of ſackcloth:
label: Isaie

text: and behold ioy and gladnes, to kil calues, and to ſlea rammes, to eate flesh, and to drinke wine: Let vs eate, and drinke: for to morow we shal die.
label: Isaie

text: And the voice of the Lord of hoſtes was reuealed in mine eares: If this iniquitie shal be forgeuen you vntil you die, ſayth our Lord the God of hoſtes.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth our Lord the God of hoſtes: Goe, get thee in to him, that dwelleth in the tabernacle, to Sobna the prouoſt of the temple, and thou shalt ſay to him:
label: Isaie

text: What doeſt thou here, or as if thou were ſome bodie here? becauſe thou haſt cut thee out a ſepulchre here, thou haſt cut out a memorial diligently in an high place, a tabernacle for thee in a rocke.
label: Isaie

text: Behold our Lord wil cauſe thee to be caried away, as a cocke is caried, and he wil lift thee vp as a garment.
label: Isaie

text: Crowning he wil crowne thee with tribulation, he wil caſt thee as a bal into a brode and large countrie: there shalt thou die, and there shal the chariot of thy glorie be, the ignominie of the houſe of thy Lord.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil expel thee from thy ſtanding, and depoſe thee from thy miniſterie.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be in that day: I wil cal my ſeruant Eliacim the ſonne of Helcias,
label: Isaie

text: and wil cloth him with thy coate, and wil ſtrengthen him with thy girdle, and wil geue thy powre into his hand: and he shal be as a father to the inhabitants of Ieruſalem, and to the houſe of Iuda.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil geue the key of the houſe of Dauid vpon his shoulder: & he shal open, and there shal be none to shut: and he shal shut, and there shal be none to open.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil faſten him as a pinne in a ſure place, & he shal be for a throne of glorie to the houſe of his father.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal hang vpon him al the glorie of his fathers houſe, diuerſe kindes of veſſels, euerie litle veſſel from veſſels of cuppes euen to euerie inſtrument of muſike.
label: Isaie

text: In that day ſayth the Lord of hoſtes, shal the pinne be taken away, that was faſtened in the ſure place: and that which hong theron, shalbe broken, and fal, and perish, becauſe our Lord hath ſpoken.
label: Isaie

text: THE burden of Tyre. Howle ye shippes of the ſea, becauſe the houſe is deſtroyed, from whence they were wont to come: from the land of Cethim it is reueled to them.
label: Isaie

text: Hold your peace ye that dwel in the ile: the traffickers of Sidon paſſing ouer the ſea, haue replenished thee.
label: Isaie

text: The ſeede of Nilus in manie waters, the harueſt of the riuer was her fruites: & she was made the trafike of the nations.
label: Isaie

text: Be ashamed Sidon, for the ſea ſayth, the ſtrength of the ſea, ſaying: I haue not trauailed, and I haue not brought forth, and I haue not nourished yongmen, nor brought virgins to their growth.
label: Isaie

text: When it shal be heard in Ægypt, they wil be ſorie when they shal heare of Tyre:
label: Isaie

text: Paſſe ouer the ſeas, howle ye that dwel in the ile.
label: Isaie

text: Is not this your citie, which gloried from ancient dayes in her antiquitie? her feete shal leade her afarre to ſciourne.
label: Isaie

text: Who hath thought this againſt Tyre, that was ſome time crowned, whoſe merchants were princes, her chapmen the nobles of the earth?
label: Isaie

text: The Lord of hoſtes hath thought it, that he might plucke downe the pride of al glorie, and bring al the glorious of the earth to ignominie.
label: Isaie

text: Paſſe thy land as a riuer, ô daughter of the ſea, thou haſt a girdle no more.
label: Isaie

text: He hath ſtretched forth his hand vpon the ſea, he hath trubled kingdomes: Our Lord hath geuen commandment againſt Chanaan, to deſtroy the ſtrong therof,
label: Isaie

text: and he ſaid: Thou shalt adde no more to glorie, ô Virgin daughter of Sidon ſuſteyning calumnie: riſing vp ſaile ouer to Cethim, there alſo thou shalt haue no reſt.
label: Isaie

text: Behold the land of the Chaldees was not ſuch a people, Aſſur founded it: they led away the ſtrong therof into captiuitie, they vndermined the houſes therof, they brought it to ruine.
label: Isaie

text: Howle ye shippes of the ſea, becauſe your ſtrength is deſtroyed.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be in that day: thou shalt be in obliuion ô Tyre, ſeuentie yeares, as the daies of one king: but after ſeuentie yeares, there shal be to Tyre as it were the ſong of an harlot.
label: Isaie

text: Take an harpe, goe about the citie thou harlot forgotten: ſing wel, multiplie ſong, that there may be remembrance of thee.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be after ſeuentie yeares: our Lord wil viſite Tyre, and wil bring her backe againe to her merchandiſe: and she shal fornicate againe with al the kingdoms of the earth, vpon the face of the earth.
label: Isaie

text: And the martes, and rewards shal be ſanctified to our Lord: they shal not be kept in ſtore, nor layd vp: becauſe her merchandiſe shal be for them, that shal dwel before our Lord, that they may eate vnto ſatietie, and be clothed vnto continuance.
label: Isaie

text: BEHOLD our Lord shal diſſipate the earth, and make it naked, and afflict the face therof, and diſperſe the inhabitants therof.
label: Isaie

text: And as the people, ſo shal the prieſt be: & as the ſeruant, ſo his maſter: as the handmayde, ſo her miſtreſſe: as the byer, ſo he that ſelleth: as the lender, ſo he that boroweth: as he that asketh his dewe, ſo he that oweth.
label: Isaie

text: With diſſipation shal the earth be diſſipated, and with ſpoile it shal be ſpoiled: for our Lord hath ſpoken this worde.
label: Isaie

text: The earth hath mourned, and fallen away, and is weakened: the world is fallen away, the height of the people of the earth is weakened.
label: Isaie

text: And the earth is infected by the inhabitants therof: becauſe they haue tranſgreſſed the lawes, changed right, diſſipated the euerlaſting couenant.
label: Isaie

text: For this cauſe shal malediction deuoure the earth, & the inhabitants therof shal ſinne: and therfore the dwellers therein shal be madde, & few men shal be leaft.
label: Isaie

text: The vintage hath mourned, the vine is weakened, al haue ſighed that reioyced in hart.
label: Isaie

text: The ioy of tymbrels hath ceaſed, the ſound of them that reioyce is leaft of, the ſweetnes of the harpe is ſilent.
label: Isaie

text: They shal not drinke wine with ſong: the drinke shal be bitter to them that drinke it.
label: Isaie

text: The citie of vanitie is broken downe, euerie houſe is shut, no man goeth in.
label: Isaie

text: There shal be crying for the wine in the ſtreetes: al mirth is left: the ioy of the earth is caried away.
label: Isaie

text: Deſolation is left in the citie, and calamitie shal oppreſſe the gates.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe theſe thinges shal be in the middes of the earth, in the middes of peoples, in like maner as if a few oliues, which are remayning, should be shaken out of the oliue tree; and grapes, when the vintage is ended.
label: Isaie

text: Theſe shal lift vp their voice, and prayſe: when our Lord shal be glorified, they shal make a ioyful noiſe from the ſea.
label: Isaie

text: For this cauſe in doctrines glorifie our Lord in the iles of the ſea the name of our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: From the endes of the earth we haue heard praiſes, the glorie of the iuſt one. And I ſayd: My ſecrete to me, my ſecrete to me, woe is me: the preuaricatours haue preuaricated, and by the preuarication of trangreſſors they haue preuaricated.
label: Isaie

text: Feare, and pitte, and ſnare vpon thee, that art inhabiter of the earth.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be: He that shal flee from the voice of feare, shal fal into the pitte: and he that shal rid him ſelfe out of the pitte, shal be held in the ſnare: becauſe the fludgates from on high are opened, and the fundations of the earth shal be shaken.
label: Isaie

text: With breaking shal the earth the broken, with bruiſing shal the earth be bruiſed, with mouing shal the earth be moued,
label: Isaie

text: With shaking shal the earth be shaken as a drunken man, and shal be taken away as the tabernacle of one night: and the iniquitie therof shal be heauie vpon it, and it shal fal, and not adde to riſe againe.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be: In that day our Lord wil viſite vpon the hoſte of heauen on high, and vpon the kinges of the earth, that are vpon the earth.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal be gathered together as the gathering of a bundel into the lake, and shal be shut there in priſon: and after manie daies they shal be viſited.
label: Isaie

text: And the moone shal be confounded, when the Lord of hoſtes shal reigne in mount Sion, and in Ieruſalem, & shal be glorified in the ſight of his ancients.
label: Isaie

text: O LORD thou art my God, I wil exalt thee, and confeſſe to thy name: becauſe thou haſt done meruelous thinges, the old cogitations faithful, Amen.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thou haſt brought the citie into a heape, the ſtrong citie into ruine, the houſe of ſtrangers: that it be no citie, & that it be not built for euer.
label: Isaie

text: For this shal ſtrong people prayſe thee, the citie of ſtrong nations shal feare thee.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thou art become a ſtrength to the poore, a ſtrength to the needie in his tribulation: an hope againſt the whirlwinde, a shadow againſt the heate. For the ſpirit of the ſtrong is as a whirlwinde beating againſt a wal.
label: Isaie

text: As heate in thirſt, shalt thou humble the tumult of ſtrangers: and as with heate vnder a burning cloude thou shalt make the branch of the ſtrong to wither.
label: Isaie

text: And the Lord of hoſtes shal make to al peoples in this mount, a feaſt of fat thinges, a feaſt of vintage, of fat thinges ful of marrow, of vintage purified from the dregges.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal in this mount throw downe headlong the face of the bond, tied together vpon al peoples, and the webbe that he hath begune vpon al nations.
label: Isaie

text: He shal caſt death downe headlong for euer: and our Lord God shal take away teare from al face, and the reproch of his people he shal take away out of the whole earth: becauſe our Lord hath ſpoken it.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal ſay in that day: Loe this is our God, we haue expected him, and he wil ſaue vs: this is our Lord, we haue patiently wayted for him, we shal reioyce and be ioyful in his ſaluation.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe the hand of our Lord shal reſt in this mount: and Moab shal be treshed vnder him, as ſtraw is broken with the wayne.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal ſtretch forth his handes vnder him, as he that ſwimmeth ſtretcheth forth to ſwimme: and he shal humble his glorie with dashing of his handes.
label: Isaie

text: And the munitions of thy high walles shal fal, and be humbled, & shal be plucked downe to the grownd euen to the duſt.
label: Isaie

text: IN THAT day shal this ſong be ſung in the land of Iuda. Sion the citie of our ſtrength a Sauiour, therin shal be put a wal and bulworke.
label: Isaie

text: Open ye the gates, and let the iuſt nation enter in, that keepeth truth.
label: Isaie

text: The old errour is gone: thou wilt keepe peace: peace, becauſe, we haue hoped in thee.
label: Isaie

text: You haue hoped in our Lord in worldes euerlaſting, in our Lord God ſtrong for euer.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe he wil bowe downe them that dwel on high, the high citie he wil abaſe. He wil abaſe it euen to the ground, he wil plucke it downe euen to the duſt.
label: Isaie

text: The foote shal treade it downe, the feete of the poore, the ſteppes of the needie.
label: Isaie

text: The path of the iuſt is right, the path of the iuſt is right to walke in.
label: Isaie

text: And in the path of thy iudgements ô Lord, we haue patiently expected thee: thy name, and thy memorial are in the deſire of the ſoule.
label: Isaie

text: My ſoule hath deſired thee in the night: yea and with my ſpirit in my hart I wil watch to thee in the morning. When thou shalt doe thy iudgments in the earth, the inhabitants of the world shal learne iuſtice.
label: Isaie

text: Let vs haue mercie on the impious, and he wil not learne iuſtice: in the land of the holie he hath done wicked thinges, and he shal not ſee the glorie of our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: Lord thy hand be exalted, and let them not ſee: let the enuious people ſee, and be confounded: and let fyre deuoure thine enimies.
label: Isaie

text: Lord thou wilt geue peace to vs: for al our workes thou haſt wrought to vs.
label: Isaie

text: O Lord our God, there haue lordes beſides thee poſſeſſed vs, onlie in thee let vs remember thy name.
label: Isaie

text: Let not the dead liue, let not the giants riſe againe: therfore haſt thou viſited and deſtroyed them, & haſt deſtroyed al their memorie.
label: Isaie

text: Thou haſt bene fauorable to the nation ô Lord, thou haſt bene fauorable to the nation: waſt thou glorified? thou haſt made al the endes of the earth farre of.
label: Isaie

text: Lord in diſtreſſe they haue ſought after thee, in tribulation of murmur thy doctrine was to them.
label: Isaie

text: As she that conceiueth, when she draweth neere to be deliuered, being ſorowful crieth in her paines: ſo are we become at thy preſence ô Lord.
label: Isaie

text: We haue conceiued, and as it were traueled, and brought forth the ſpirit: ſaluation we haue not done in the earth, therfore the inhabitants of the earth haue not fallen.
label: Isaie

text: Thy dead shal liue, my ſlaine shal riſe againe: awake, and prayſe ye that dwel in the duſt: becauſe the dew of the light is thy dew; & the land of the giants thou shalt plucke downe into ruine.
label: Isaie

text: Goe my people, enter into thy chambers, shut thy doores vpon thee, be hid a litle for a moment, til the indignation paſſe.
label: Isaie

text: For behold our Lord wil come out of his place, to viſite the iniquitie of the inhabitant of the earth againſt him: and the earth shal reuele her bloud, and shal couer her ſlaine no more.
label: Isaie

text: IN that day our Lord wil viſite with his ſore, and great, and ſtrong ſword vpon Leuiathan the ſerpent, the barre, and vpon Leuiathan the crooked ſerpent, and shal kil the whale that is in the ſea.
label: Isaie

text: In that day the vineyard of pure wine shal ſing to it.
label: Isaie

text: I the Lord that keepe it, I wil ſodenly drinke to it: leſt perhaps there be viſitation agaynſt it, night and day I kepe it.
label: Isaie

text: There is no indignation in me: who wil geue me to be thorne and bryer in battel: to goe vpon it, to ſet it on fyre together?
label: Isaie

text: Or rather shal he hold my ſtrength, shal he make peace with me, shal he make peace with me?
label: Isaie

text: They that goe in with violence to Iacob, Iſrael shal florish and ſpring, and they shal fil the face of the world with ſeede.
label: Isaie

text: Hath he ſtriken him according to his ſtroke that ſtroke him? or as he killed his ſlaine, is he killed?
label: Isaie

text: In meaſure againſt meaſure, when it shal be caſt of, thou shalt iudge it. He hath meditated in his hard ſpirite during the day of heate.
label: Isaie

text: Therfore vpon this shal the iniquitie be forgeuen to the houſe of Iacob: and this is al the fruite that the ſinne therof be taken away, when he shal haue layd al the ſtones of the altar, as ſtones of ashes broken, the groues & temples shal not ſtand.
label: Isaie

text: For the defenſed citie shal be deſolate, the beautiful citie shal be forſaken, and shal be left as a deſert, there shal the calfe feede, and there he shal lie, and shal conſume the toppes therof.
label: Isaie

text: The harueſts therof shal be deſtroyed in drught, wemen coming and teaching it: for it is not a wiſe people, therfore shal not he that made it, haue mercie on it: and he that formed it, shal not ſpare it.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be, in that day our Lord wil ſtrike from the chanel of the riuer, euen to the torrent of Ægypt, and you shal be gathered together one and one ô children of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be: in that day a ſound shal be made with a great trompet, and they that were loſt, shal come from the land of the Aſſirians, and that were caſt out, from the land of Ægypt; and shal adore our Lord in the holie mount in Ieruſalem.
label: Isaie

text: VVOE to the crowne of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the flowre falling downe from the glorie of his exultation, which were in the toppe of the moſt fatte valley, erring by wine.
label: Isaie

text: Behold our Lord is valiant and ſtrong, as the violence of hayle: a whirlewind breaking, the violence of manie waters ouerflowing, & ſent forth vpon a large ground.
label: Isaie

text: The crowne of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim shal be troden vnder feete.
label: Isaie

text: And the flowre of the glorie of his exultation, which is vpon the toppe of the valley of fatte ones, shal be falling as a timely fruite before the ripeneſſe of autumme: which when he that ſeeth it shal behold, as ſoone as he taketh it in his hand, he wil deuoure it.
label: Isaie

text: In that day the Lord of hoſtes shal be a crowne of glorie, and a garland of exultation to the reſidue of his people:
label: Isaie

text: and a ſpirit of iudgement to him that ſitteth in iudgement, and ſtrength to them that returne out of battel to the gate.
label: Isaie

text: But theſe alſo haue bene ignorant becauſe of wine, and by drunkennes haue erred: the prieſt and the prophete haue bene ignorant becauſe of drunkennes, they are ſwalowed vp with wine, they haue erred in drunkennes, they haue not knowne him that ſeeth, they haue bene ignorant of iudgement.
label: Isaie

text: For al tables were filled with vomiting and filth, ſo that there was no more place.
label: Isaie

text: Whom shal he teach knowledge? and whom shal he make to vnderſtand the thing heard? them that are weyned from the milke, that are plucked away from the breaſts.
label: Isaie

text: For command recommand, command recommand; expect reexpect, expect reexpect; a litle there, a litle there.
label: Isaie

text: For in the ſpeach of lippe, and in an other tongue he wil ſpeake to his people.
label: Isaie

text: To whom he ſayd: This is my reſt, refresh the wearie, and this is my refreshing: & they would not heare.
label: Isaie

text: And the word of our Lord shal be to them command recommand, command recommand; expect reexpect, expect reexpect; a litle there, a litle there: that they may goe, and fal backward, and be deſtroyed, and ſnared, and taken.
label: Isaie

text: For this cauſe heare the word of our Lord ye ſcorneful men, which rule ouer my people, that is in Ieruſalem.
label: Isaie

text: For you haue ſayd: We haue ſtroken a league with death, and with hel we haue made a couenant. The ſcourge ouerflowing when it shal paſſe, shal not come vpon vs: becauſe we haue made lying our hope, and with lying we are protected.
label: Isaie

text: Therfore thus ſayth our Lord God: Behold I wil ſend in the foundations of Sion a ſtone, an approued ſtone, a corner ſtone, pretious founded in the foundation. He that beleueth, let him not make haſt.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil put iudgement in weight, and iuſtice in meaſure: and haile shal ouerthrow the hope of lying: and waters shal ouerflow the protection.
label: Isaie

text: And your league with death shal be abolished, and your couenant with hel shal not ſtand: when the ſcourge ouerflowing shal paſſe, you shal be troden downe of it.
label: Isaie

text: Whenſoeuer it shal paſſe through, it shal take you away: becauſe in the morning early it shal paſſe through, in the day and in the night, and vexation alone shal geue vnderſtanding in the hearing.
label: Isaie

text: For the bed is ſtreitened, ſo that one muſt fal out, and a short mantel can not couer both.
label: Isaie

text: For our Lord shal ſtand as in the mount of diuiſions: as in the valley, which is in Gabaon, shal he be angrie: that he may doe his worke, his ſtrange worke: that he may worke, his worke is ſtrange from him.
label: Isaie

text: And now mocke not, leſt perhaps your bonds be tied ſtrayte. For I haue heard of our Lord the God of hoſtes conſummation and abridgement vpon al the earth.
label: Isaie

text: Harken with your eares, and heare my voice, attend, and heare my ſpeach.
label: Isaie

text: Wil the ploughman plowe al the day to ſow, wil he cut and harrow his ground?
label: Isaie

text: Wil he not when he hath made euen the face therof, ſprinkle cummine, and place the wheate by order, and the barley, and millet, and vetche, in their bondes?
label: Isaie

text: And his God wil inſtruct him in iudgement: he wil teach him.
label: Isaie

text: For gith shal not be threshed with inſtruments that haue teeth, neither shal the wayne wheele turne about vpon cummine: but gith shal be beaten out with a rodde, and cummine with a ſtaffe.
label: Isaie

text: But bread corne shal be broken ſmal: but the thresher shal not thresh it for euer, neither shal the wayne wheele vexe it, nor breake it with the teeth therof.
label: Isaie

text: And this is come forth from our Lord the God of hoſtes, that he might make his counſel meruelous, and magnifie iuſtice.
label: Isaie

text: VVOE to Ariel, Ariel the citie, which Dauid ouercame: yeare is added to yeare: the ſolemnities are at an end.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil make a trench about Ariel, and it shal be ſorowful & moorning, and it shal be to me as Ariel.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil compaſſe as a ſphere round about thee, and wil caſt a rampier againſt thee, and place munitions to beſiege thee.
label: Isaie

text: Thou shalt be humbled, thou shalt ſpeake out of the earth, and out of the gronnd thy ſpeach shal be heard: and thy voice shal be out of the earth as the Pythons, and out of the ground thy ſpeach shal mutter.
label: Isaie

text: And the multitude of them that fanne thee shal be as ſmal duſt: and as iſſles paſſing away, the multitude of them, that haue preuailed agaynſt thee.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be ſodenly forthwith. It shal be viſited of the Lord of hoſtes in thunder, and earth quake, and with great voice of whirlewind and tempeſt, and with flame of deuouring fyre.
label: Isaie

text: And the multitude of al nations, that haue fought agaynſt Ariel, shal be as the dreame of a viſion in the night, and al that haue waried, and beſeged & preuailed agaynſt it.
label: Isaie

text: And as he that is hungrie dreameth, & eateth, but when he is awake, his ſoule is emptie: & as he that is thirſtie dreameth, and drinketh, and after he is awake, faint as yet thirſteth, and his ſoule is emptie: ſo shal the multitude be of al the Gentiles, that haue fought agaynſt mount Sion.
label: Isaie

text: Be aſtonied, and meruel, wauer, and ſtagger: be ye drunke, and not of wine: be moued, & not of drunkenes.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe our Lord hath mingled vnto you the ſpirit of drowſines, he wil shut your eyes, he wil couer your prophetes and princes, that ſee viſions.
label: Isaie

text: And the viſion of al shalbe vnto you as the wordes of a booke ſealed: which when they shal geue to him that knoweth letters, they shal ſay: Read this: and he shal anſwer, I can nor, for it is ſealed.
label: Isaie

text: And the booke shal be geuen to one that knoweth not letters, and it shal be ſayd to him: Reade: and he shal anſwer I know not letters.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord ſayd: Becauſe this people approcheth with their mouth, and with their lippes glorifieth me, but their hart is far from me, and they haue feared me by the commandement and doctrines of men:
label: Isaie

text: therfore behold I wil adde to make admiration to this people, by a great and wonderful miracle: for wiſdom shal perish from their wiſe men, and the vnderſtanding of their prudent shal be hid.
label: Isaie

text: Woe vnto you that are deepe of hart, to hide your counſel from our Lord: whoſe workes are in darkenes, and they ſay: Who ſeeth vs, and who knoweth vs?
label: Isaie

text: This your cogitation is peruerſe: as if the clay should thinke againſt the potter, and the worke should ſay to the maker therof: Thou madeſt me not: or the thing formed should ſay to the fashioner therof: Thou vnderſtandeſt not.
label: Isaie

text: Shal not yet within a litle while, and in a short time Libanus be turned into Charmel, & Charmel reputed for a foreſt?
label: Isaie

text: And in that day the deafe shal heare the wordes of the booke, and out of the darkenes and miſt the eies of the blinde shal ſee.
label: Isaie

text: And the meeke shal adde ioyfulneſſe in our Lord, and the poore men shal reioyce in the holie one of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe he hath fayled that did preuaile, the ſcorner is conſumed, and they are al cut downe that watched vpon iniquitie:
label: Isaie

text: that made men ſinne in word, and ſupplanted him that reproued them in the gate, and declined in vayne from the iuſt.
label: Isaie

text: For this cauſe, thus ſayth our Lord to the houſe of Iacob, he that redemed Abraham: Iacob shal not now be confounded, neither shal now his countenance be ashamed:
label: Isaie

text: but when he shal ſee his children, the workes of mine handes in the middes of him ſanctifying my name, and they shal ſanctifie the holie one of Iacob, and shal preach the God of Iſrael,
label: Isaie

text: and they that erre in ſpirit, shal know vnderſtanding, and the mutteters shal learne the law.
label: Isaie

text: VVOE vnto renegate children, ſayth our Lord, that you would take counſel, and not of me: & would beginne a webbe, and not by my ſpirite, that you might adde ſinne vpon ſinne:
label: Isaie

text: which walke to goe downe into Ægypt, & haue not asked my mouth, hoping for helpe in the ſtrength of Pharao, and hauing confidence in the shadow of Ægypt.
label: Isaie

text: And the ſtrength of Pharao shal be a confuſion to you, and the confidence of the shadow of Ægypt an ignominie.
label: Isaie

text: For thy princes were in Tanis, and thy meſſengers came euen to Hanes.
label: Isaie

text: Al were confounded vpon the people, that could not profite them: they were no helpe, nor to any profite, but to confuſion and to reproch.
label: Isaie

text: The burden of the beaſtes of the South. In a land of tribulation and diſtreſſe, the lioneſſe, and the lion of them, the viper & the flying baſiliſcus carying their riches vpon the shoulders of beaſts, and their treaſures vpon the bunch of camels to a people, that can not be able to profite them.
label: Isaie

text: For Ægypt shal helpe in vaine, and to no purpoſe: therfore haue I cried vpon this: It is pride onlie, ceaſe.
label: Isaie

text: Now therfore going in write to her vpon boxe, and drawe it diligently in a booke, and it shal be in the latter day for a teſtimonie for euer.
label: Isaie

text: For it is a people prouoking to wrath, and lying children, children that wil not heare the law of God.
label: Isaie

text: Which ſay to the ſeers: See not: and to them that behold: Behold vs not thoſe thinges that are right: Speake vnto vs pleaſant thinges, ſee errours vnto vs.
label: Isaie

text: Take from me the way, turne away the path from me, let the holie one of Iſrael ceaſe from our face.
label: Isaie

text: Therfore thus ſayth the holie one of Iſrael: For that you haue reiected this word, & haue hoped in calumnie and tumult, and haue leaned thereupon:
label: Isaie

text: therfore shal this iniquitie be vnto you as a breach that falleth, and is found lacking in an high wal, becauſe ſodenly, whiles it is not hoped, shal come the deſtruction therof.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be broken ſmal, as the potters veſſel is broken with mightie breaking: & there shal not a shread be found of the fragments therof, wherein a litle fyre may be caried from the burning, or a litle water be drawen out of the pitte.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thus ſayth our Lord the God of Iſrael: If you returne and be quiet, you shal be ſaued: in ſilence and in hope shal your ſtrength be. And you would not:
label: Isaie

text: and you haue ſayd: No, but we wil flee to horſes: therfore shal you flee. And we wil mount vpon ſwift ones: therfore shal they be ſwifter, that shal perſecute you.
label: Isaie

text: A thouſand men at the face of the terrour of one: and at the face of the terrour of fiue shal you flee, til you be left as the maſt of a shippe in the toppe of a mountaine, and as a ſigne vpon a litle hil.
label: Isaie

text: Therfore our Lord expecteth that he may haue mercie on you: and therfore shal he be exalted ſparing you: becauſe our Lord is the God of iudgment: bleſſed are al they that expect him.
label: Isaie

text: For the people of Sion shal dwel in Ieruſalem: weeping thou shalt not weepe, pitying he wil pitie thee: at the voice of thy crie as ſoone as he shal heare, he wil anſwer thee.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord wil geue you ſtraite bread, and short water: and wil not make thy doctor to flee away from thee any more: and thine eies shal ſee thy maſter.
label: Isaie

text: And thine eares shal heare the word of him, that behinde thy backe admonisheth thee: This is the way, walke in it: and decline ye not neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
label: Isaie

text: And thou shalt contaminate the plates of the ſculptils of thy ſiluer, and the garment of the molten of thy gold, and shalt ſcatter them as the vncleannes of a menſtruous woman. Thou shalt ſay to it: Get thee hence.
label: Isaie

text: And rayne shal be geuen to thy ſeede, whereſoeuer thou shalt ſow in the land: and the bread of the corne of the land shal be moſt plentiful, and fatte. The lambe in that day shal feede at large in thy poſſeſſion:
label: Isaie

text: and thyne oxen, as the aſſe coltes, that til the ground, shal eate mingled prouender as it was fanned in the floore.
label: Isaie

text: And there shal be vpon euerie high mountayne, and vpon euerie litle hil eleuated, riuers of running waters in the day of the killing of manie when the towres shal fal.
label: Isaie

text: And the light of the moone shal be as the light of the ſunne, and the light of the ſunne shal be ſeuenfold, as the light of ſeuen daies in the day, when our Lord shal bind vp the wound of his people, & shal heale the ſtroke of their wound.
label: Isaie

text: Behold the name of our Lord commeth from farre, his burning furie, and heauie to beare: his lippes are filled with indignation, and his tongue as a deuouring fire.
label: Isaie

text: His ſpirite as a torrent ouerflowing euen to the middes of the necke, to deſtroy the nations to nothing, and the bridle of errour, that was in the iawes of peoples.
label: Isaie

text: There shal be a ſong vnto you as the night of a ſanctified ſolemnitie, and ioy of hart as he that goeth with a shaulme, to enter into the mount of our Lord to the ſtrong one of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord shal make the glorie of his voice to be heard, and shal shew the terrour of his arme, in threatening of furie, and flame of deuouring fyre: he shal dashe to peeces in whirlwinde, and in haile ſtone.
label: Isaie

text: For at the voice of our Lord shal Aſſur feare being ſtroken with the rod.
label: Isaie

text: And the paſſage of the rod shal neuer ceaſe, which our Lord shal make to reſt vpon him in tymbrels and harpes: and in principal battels he shal ouerthrow them.
label: Isaie

text: For Topheth is prepared ſince yeſterday, prepared of the king, deepe, and wide. The nourishments therof, fyre & much wood: the breath of our Lord as a torrent of brinſtone kindling it.
label: Isaie

text: VVOE to them that goe downe into Ægypt for helpe; hoping in horſes, and hauing confidence vpon chariots, becauſe they be manie: and vpon horſemen, becauſe they be very ſtrong: and haue not truſted vpon the holie one of Iſrael, & haue not ſought after our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: But he that is the wiſe one hath brought euil, and hath not taken away his wordes: and he wil riſe vp againſt the houſe of the wicked, & againſt the ayde of them that worke iniquitie.
label: Isaie

text: Ægypt, a man, and not God: and their horſes, flesh, and not ſpirite: and our Lord shal bowe downe his hand, and the helper shal fal, and he that is holpen shal fal, and they shal al be confounded together.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thus ſayth our Lord to me: As if a lion should roare, and the lions whelpe vpon his praye, & when a multitude of shepheards shal come againſt him, he wil not feare at their voice, and of their multitude he wil not be afrayd: ſo shal the Lord of hoſtes deſcend, to fight vpon mount Sion, and vpon the litle hil therof.
label: Isaie

text: As birdes that flie, ſo wil the Lord of hoſtes protect Ieruſalem, protecting and deliuering, paſſing and ſauing.
label: Isaie

text: Returne as you reuolted deeply o children of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: For in that day man shal caſt away the idols of his ſiluer, and the idols of his gold, which your handes haue made you into ſinne.
label: Isaie

text: And Aſſur shal fal by the ſword not of man, and the ſword not of man shal deuoure him, & he shal flee not at the face of the ſword: and his yong men shal be tributaries:
label: Isaie

text: and his ſtrength shal paſſe away at the terrour, & his princes fleing shal be afrayd: our Lord hath ſayd it: whoſe fyre is in Sion, & his fornace in Ieruſalem.
label: Isaie

text: BEHOLD the king shal reigne in iuſtice, & the princes shal rule in iudgement.
label: Isaie

text: And a man shal be as he that is hid from the wind, and hideth himſelfe from a tempeſt, as riuers of waters in drought, and the shadow of a rocke that ſtandeth out in a deſert ground.
label: Isaie

text: The eies of them that ſee, shal not be dimme, and the eares of them that heare, shal harken diligently.
label: Isaie

text: And the hart of fooles shal vnderſtand knowlege, and the tongue of mafflers shal ſpeake readely and plaine.
label: Isaie

text: He that is vnwiſe shal no more be called prince: neither shal the deceitful be called the greater man:
label: Isaie

text: for the foole shal ſpeake foolish thinges, and his hart shal doe iniquitie, that he may worke ſimulation, and ſpeake to our Lord deceitfully, and make emptie the ſoule of the hungrie, and take away drinke from the thirſtie.
label: Isaie

text: The veſſels of the deceitful are moſt wicked: for he hath framed deuiſes to vndoe the meeke, with the word of lying, when the poore man ſpake iudgement.
label: Isaie

text: But the prince wil thinke theſe thinges, that are worthie of a prince, & he shal ſtand aboue the dukes.
label: Isaie

text: Ye riche wemen ariſe, and heare my voice: ye confident daughters geue eare to my ſpeach.
label: Isaie

text: For after dayes, & a yeare you shal be trubled that haue confidence: for the vintage is at an end, the gathering wil no more come.
label: Isaie

text: Be aſtonied ye riche wemen, be trubled ye confident: ſtrippe you, and be confounded, gird your loynes.
label: Isaie

text: Moorne vpon your breaſts, vpon the countrie worthie to be deſtroyed, vpon the fruitful vineyard.
label: Isaie

text: Vpon the ground of my people shal thornes and bryars come vp: how much more vpon al the houſes of ioy, of the citie reioycing?
label: Isaie

text: For the houſe is forſaken, the multitude of the citie is leaft, darkeneſſe and palpableneſſe are made vpon the dennes for euer.
label: Isaie

text: The ioy of wilde aſſes the paſtures of flockes, vntil the ſpirit be powred out vpon vs from on high: and the deſert shal be as charmel, and charmel shal be reputed for a foreſt.
label: Isaie

text: And iudgement shal dwel in the wildernes, and iuſtice shal ſit in charmel.
label: Isaie

text: And the worke of iuſtice shal be peace, and the ſeruice of iuſtice ſilence, and ſecuritie for euer.
label: Isaie

text: And my people shal ſitte in the beautie of peace, and in the tabernacles of confidence, and in wealthie reſt.
label: Isaie

text: But haile in falling vpon the foreſt, and the citie shal be humbled with lowneſſe.
label: Isaie

text: Bleſſed are ye, that ſow vpon al waters, ſending in the foote of the oxe and the aſſe.
label: Isaie

text: VVOE to thee that ſpoileſt, shalt not thy ſelfe alſo be ſpoiled? and that deſpiſeſt shalt not thy ſelf alſo be deſpiſed? when thou shalt haue ended ſpoyling, thou shalt be ſpoyled: when being wearied thou shalt ceaſe to contemne, thou shalt be contemned.
label: Isaie

text: O Lord haue mercie vpon vs: for we haue expected thee: be our arme in the morning, and our ſaluation in the time of our tribulation.
label: Isaie

text: At the voice of the Angel the peoples fled, and at thy exaltation the nations are diſperſed.
label: Isaie

text: And your ſpoiles shal be gathered together as the locuſt is gathered, as when the ditches shal be ful therof.
label: Isaie

text: Our Lord is magnified, becauſe he hath dwelt on high: he hath filled Sion with iudgement and iuſtice.
label: Isaie

text: And there shal be fayth in thy times: riches of ſaluation wiſdom and knowlege: the feare of our Lord that is his treaſure.
label: Isaie

text: Behold they that ſee shal crie without, the angels of peace shal weepe bitterly.
label: Isaie

text: The wayes are diſſipated, the paſſenger by the path hath ceaſed, the couenant is made fruſtrate, he hath reiected the cities, he hath not eſtemed the men.
label: Isaie

text: The land hath moorned, and languished: Libanus is confounded, and become foule, and Saron is made as a deſert: and Baſan is shaken, & Carmel.
label: Isaie

text: Now wil I riſe vp, ſayth our Lord: now wil I be exalted, now wil I be lifted vp.
label: Isaie
