text: You shal conceiue heate, you shal bring forth ſtubble: your ſpirit as fire shal deuoure you.
label: Isaie

text: And the peoples shal be as ashes of a great fyre, thornes gathered together shal be burned with fyre.
label: Isaie

text: Heare ye that are far of, what thinges I haue done, and ye that are neere, know my ſtrength.
label: Isaie

text: The ſinners are terrified in Sion, trembling hath poſſeſſed the hypocrites. Which of you can dwel with deuouring fyre? which of you shal dwel with euerlaſting heates?
label: Isaie

text: He that walketh in iuſtices, and ſpeaketh truth, that caſteth away auarice of oppreſſion, and shaketh his handes from al gift, that ſtoppeth his eares leſt he heare bloud, and shutteth his eyes that he may ſee no euil.
label: Isaie

text: This man shal dwel on high, the munitions of rockes shal be his highnes: bread is geuen to him, his waters are faithful.
label: Isaie

text: His eies shal ſee the king in his beautie, they shal ſee the land farre of.
label: Isaie

text: Thy hart shal meditate feare: where is the lerned? where is he that pondereth the wordes of the law? where the teacher of litle ones?
label: Isaie

text: The vnwiſe people thou shalt not ſee, the people of profound ſpeach: ſo that thou canſt not vnderſtand the eloquence of his tongue, in whom there is no wiſdome.
label: Isaie

text: Looke vpon Sion the citie of our ſolemnitie: thine eies shal ſee Ieruſalem, a rich habitation, a tabernacle that can not be transferred: neither shal the nailes therof be taken away for euer, and al the cordes therof shal not be broken:
label: Isaie

text: becauſe onlie there our Lord is magnifical: a place of floudes, riuers moſt brode and wide: no shippe of rowers shal paſſe by it, neither shal the great galley paſſe thereby.
label: Isaie

text: For the Lord is our iudge, the Lord is our lawmaker, the Lord is our king: he wil ſaue vs.
label: Isaie

text: Thy cordes are looſed, and they shal not preuaile: thy maſt shal be ſo, that thou canſt not ſpred the ſigne. Then shal the ſpoiles of manie prayes be diuided: the lame shal take the ſpoile.
label: Isaie

text: Neither shal the neighbour ſay: I am feble. The people that dwelleth therein, iniquitie shal be taken away from them.
label: Isaie

text: COME neere ye Gentiles, and heare, and ye peoples attend let the earth heare, & the fulnes therof, the round world, and euerie ſpring therof.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe the indignation of our Lord is vpon al Gentiles, and furie vpon al their hoſtes: he hath killed them, & geuen them into ſlaughter.
label: Isaie

text: Their ſlaine shal be caſt forth, and out of their carcaſſes shal riſe a ſtinche: the mountaines shal melt with their bloud.
label: Isaie

text: And al the hoſt of the heauens shal melt away, and the heauens shal be folded together as a booke: and al their hoſt shal fal away as the leafe falleth from the vine, and from the figge tree.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe my ſword is inebriated in heauen: behold it shal deſcend vpon Idumæa, and vpon the peoples of my ſlaughter to iudgement.
label: Isaie

text: The ſword of our Lord is filled with bloud, it is fatted of the bloud of lambes and buckgoates, of the bloud of rammes ful of marow: for the victime of our Lord is in Boſra, & a great ſlaughter in the land of Edom.
label: Isaie

text: And the vnicornes shal come downe with them, and the bulles with the mightie: their land shal be drunke with bloud, & their ground with the fatnes of fatte ones.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe it is the day of the reuenge of our Lord, the yeare of retributions of the iudgement of Sion.
label: Isaie

text: And the torrents therof shal be turned into pitch, and the ground therof into brimſtone: & the land therof shal be into burning pitch.
label: Isaie

text: Night and day it shal not be quenched, the ſmoke therof shal goe vp for euer: from generation vnto generation it shal be deſolate, there shal none paſſe by it world without end.
label: Isaie

text: The onocrotalus, and hedgehog shal poſſeſſe it: & the ibis, and the rauen shal dwel in it: and a meaſure shal be ſtretched out vpon it, to bring it to nothing, and a plumme line vnto deſolation.
label: Isaie

text: The nobles therof shal not be there: they shal cal rather vpon the king, and al the princes therof shal be as nothing.
label: Isaie

text: And thornes and nettles shal grow vp in the houſes therof, and the thiſtle in the munitions therof: and it shal be the couche of dragons, and the paſture of oſtriches.
label: Isaie

text: And ſpirites shal meete the onocentaurus, and the ſatyr shal crie one to the other, there hath the lamia lien, and found her ſelf reſt.
label: Isaie

text: There hath the hedgehog had an hole, and brought vp whelpes, and digged round about, and cherished them in the shadow therof: thither are the kites gathered together, one to an other.
label: Isaie

text: Searche ye diligently in the booke of our Lord, and read: one of them hath not wanted, one hath not ſought for the other, becauſe that which procedeth out of my mouth, he hath commanded, and his ſpirit the ſame hath gathered them.
label: Isaie

text: And he hath caſt them a lot, and his hand hath diuided it vnto them by meaſure: they shal poſſeſſe it for euer, in generation & generation they shal dwel therein.
label: Isaie

text: THE deſert and the land without paſſage shal be glad, & the wildernes shal reioyce, and shal florish as the lilie.
label: Isaie

text: Springing it shal ſpring, & shal reioyce ioyful and praiſing: the glorie of Libanus is geuen to it, the beautie of Carmel, and Saron, they shal ſee the glorie of our Lord, and the beautie of our God.
label: Isaie

text: Encouráge ye the looſe handes, & ſtrengthen the weake knees.
label: Isaie

text: Say to the faynt harted: Take couregé, and feare not: behold your God shal bring reuenge of retribution: God him ſelf wil come and wil ſaue you.
label: Isaie

text: Then shal the eies of the blind be opened, and the eares of the deafe shal be open.
label: Isaie

text: Then shal the lame leape as an hart, and the tongue of the dumme shal be opened: becauſe waters are cut out in the deſert, and torrents in the wildernes.
label: Isaie

text: And that which was drieland, shal be as a poole, and the thirſtie ground as fountaines of waters. In the dennes wherein dragons dwelt before, shal ſpring vp the greennes of reede and bulrush.
label: Isaie

text: And a pathe and a way shal be there, and it shal be called the holie way: the polluted shal not paſſe by it, and this shal be vnto you a direct way, ſo that fooles can not erre by it.
label: Isaie

text: The lion shal not be there, and the naughtie beaſt shal not goe vp by it, nor be found there: and they shal walke that shal be deliuered.
label: Isaie

text: And the redemed of our Lord shal be conuerted, and shal come into Sion with prayſe, and euerlaſting ioy shal be vpon their head: they shal obteyne ioy and gladnes, and ſorow and mourning shal flee away.
label: Isaie

text: AND it came to paſſe in the fourtenth yeare of king Ezechias, Sennacherib king of the Aſſyrians came vp agaynſt al the fenſed cities of Iuda, and tooke them.
label: Isaie

text: And the king of the Aſſyrians ſent Rabſaces from Lachis to Ieruſalem, to king Ezechias with a great armie, and he ſtood by the water conduite of the vpper poole in the way of the fullers filde.
label: Isaie

text: And there came out to him Eliacim the ſonne of Helcias, who was ouer the houſe, and Sobna the ſcribe, and Ioahe the ſonne of Aſaph the commenter.
label: Isaie

text: And Rabſaces ſayd to them: Tel Ezechias: Thus ſayth the great king, the king of the Aſſyrians: What is this confidence, wherevpon thou doſt truſt?
label: Isaie

text: or by what counſel or force art thou diſpoſed to rebel? vpon whom haſt thou confidence, that thou art reuolted from me?
label: Isaie

text: Loe thou doſt truſt vpon this broken ſtaffe of reede, vpon Aegypt: vpon which if a man leane, it wil enter into his hand, and pearce it: ſo is Pharao the king of Aegypt to al that truſt in him.
label: Isaie

text: But if thou wilt anſwer me: We truſt in our Lord God: is it not he whoſe excelſes and altars Ezechias hath taken away, and he ſayd to Iuda and Ieruſalem: Before this altar shal you adore?
label: Isaie

text: And now deliuer thyſelf to my lord the king of the Aſſyrians, & I wil geue thee two thouſand horſes, neither shalt thou be able of thyſelf to geue riders for them.
label: Isaie

text: And how wilt thou abide the face of the iudge of one place, of the leſſer ſeruants of my Lord? But if thou truſt in Aegypt, in chariotes and in horſemen:
label: Isaie

text: and now am I come vp without the Lord vnto this land to deſtroy it? The Lord ſayd to me: Goe vp agaynſt this land, & deſtroy it.
label: Isaie

text: And Eliacim, and Sobna, and Ioahe ſayd to Rabſaces: Speake to thy ſeruants in the Syrian tongue: for we vnderſtand it: ſpeake not to vs in the Iewes language in the eares of the people, that is vpon the wal.
label: Isaie

text: And Rabſaces ſayd to them: Why, did my lord ſend me to thy lord and to thee, to ſpeake al theſe wordes; and not rather to the men, that ſitte on the wal; that they may eate their owne dung, and drinke the vrine of their feete with you?
label: Isaie

text: And Rabſaces ſtood, & cried with a loude voice in the Iewes language, and ſayd: Heare ye the wordes of the great king, the king of Aſſyrians.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth the king: Let not Ezechias ſeduce you, for he shal not be able to deliuer you.
label: Isaie

text: And let not Ezechias geue you confidence vpon the Lord, ſaying: Our Lord deliuering wil deliuer vs, this citie shal not be geuen into the hand of the king of Aſſyrians.
label: Isaie

text: Heare not Ezechias: for thus ſayth the king of Aſſyrians, doe a bleſſing with me, and come forth to me, and eate ye euerie man of his owne wineyard, and euerie man of his owne figtree, and drinke ye euerie man the water of his owne ceſterne,
label: Isaie

text: til I come and take you away to a land, that is as your owne, a land of corne and of wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
label: Isaie

text: Neither let Ezechias truble you, ſaying: Our Lord wil deliuer vs. Why, haue the goddes of the nations deliuered euerie one their land out of the hand of the king of Aſſyrians?
label: Isaie

text: Where is the god of Emath, and Arphad? where is the god of Sepharuaim? haue they deliuered Samaria out of my hand?
label: Isaie

text: Who is there of al the goddes of theſe landes, which hath deliuered their land out of my hand, that the Lord can deliuer Ieruſalem out of my hand?
label: Isaie

text: And they held their peace, and anſwered him not a word. For the king had commanded, ſaying: Anſwer him not.
label: Isaie

text: And Eliacim the ſonne of Helcias, that was ouer the houſe, and Sobna the ſcribe, and Ioahe the ſonne of Aſaph the commenter, went in to Ezechias their garments rent, and told him the wordes of Rabſaces.
label: Isaie

text: AND it came to paſſe, when king Ezechias had heard it, he rent his garments, and was wrapped in ſackcloth, & entred into the houſe of our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: And he ſent Eliacim which was ouer the houſe, and Sobna the ſcribe, and the ancients of the prieſtes couered with ſackclothes to Iſaie, the ſonne of Amos the prophete,
label: Isaie

text: and they ſayd to him: Thus ſayth Ezechias: This day is a day of tribulation, and of rebuke, and of blaſphemie: becauſe the children are come euen to the birth, and there is not ſtrength to bring forth.
label: Isaie

text: If by any meanes our Lord thy God wil heare the wordes of Rabſaces, whom the king of Aſſyrians his Lord hath ſent to blaſpheme the liuing God, & to vpbraide with wordes which our Lord thy God hath heard: lift vp prayer therfore for the remnant that are left.
label: Isaie

text: And the ſeruants of Ezechias came to Iſaie.
label: Isaie

text: And Iſaie ſayd to them: Thus shal you ſay to your maſter: Thus ſaith our Lord: Feare not at the face of the wordes, which thou haſt heard, wherewith the ſeruants of the king of the Aſſyrians haue blaſphemed me.
label: Isaie

text: Behold, I wil geue him a ſpirit, and he shal heare a meſſage, and shal returne to his countrie, and I wil make him fal by the ſword in his owne countrie.
label: Isaie

text: And Rabſaces returned, and found the king of Aſſyrians fighting agaynſt Lobna. For he heard that he was departed from Lachis,
label: Isaie

text: and he heard of Tharaca the king of Æthiopia, them that ſayd: He is come forth to fight agaynſt thee. Which when he had heard, he ſent meſſengers to Ezechias, ſaying:
label: Isaie

text: Thus shal you ſay to Ezechaias the king of Iuda, ſpeaking: Let not thy God deceiue thee, in whom thou haſt confidence, ſaying: Ieruſalen shal not be geuen into the hand of the king of the Aſſyrians.
label: Isaie

text: Loe thou haſt heard al thinges the kinges of the Aſſyrians haue done to al countries, which they haue ſubuerted, and canſt thou be deliuered?
label: Isaie

text: Why, haue the goddes of the nations deliuered them, whom my fathers haue ſubuerted, Gozam, and Haram, and Reſeph, and the children of Eden, that were in Thalaſſar?
label: Isaie

text: Where is the king of Emath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the citie of Sepharuaim, of Ana, & Aua?
label: Isaie

text: And Ezechias tooke the letters of the hand of the meſſengers, and read them, and went vp into the houſe of our Lord, and Ezchias layd them open before our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: And Ezchias prayed to our Lord, ſaying:
label: Isaie

text: O Lord of hoſtes God of Iſrael, which ſitteſt vpon the Cherubs, thou art the onlie God of al the kingdomes of the earth, thou haſt made heauen and earth.
label: Isaie

text: Incline ô Lord thine eare, and heare: open ô Lord thine eies, and ſee, and heare al the wordes of Sennacherib, which he hath ſent to blaſpheme the liuing God.
label: Isaie

text: For in verie deede, ô Lord, the kinges of the Aſſyrians haue made landes deſolate, and the countries of the ſame.
label: Isaie

text: And they haue geuen their goddes to fyre: for they were not goddes, but the workes of mens handes, wood & ſtone: & they brake them in peeces.
label: Isaie

text: And now ô Lord our God ſaue vs out of his hand: and let al the kingdomes of the earth knowe, that thou onlie art the Lord.
label: Isaie

text: And Iſaie the ſonne of Amos ſent to Ezechias, ſaying: Thus ſayth our Lord the God of Iſrael: For the thinges that thou praied me concerning Sennacherib the king of Aſſyrians:
label: Isaie

text: this is the word which our Lord hath ſpoken vpon him: The virgin daughter of Sion hath deſpiſed thee, and ſcorned thee: the daughter of Ieruſalem hath wagged the head after thee.
label: Isaie

text: Whom haſt thou vpbrayded, and whom haſt thou blaſphemed, and vpon whom haſt thou exalted voice, and lifted vp the height of thine eies? To the holie one of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: By the hand of thy ſeruants thou haſt vpbrayded our Lord: and haſt ſayd: In the multitude of my chariotes haue I climed the height of mountaynes, the toppes of Libanus: and I wil cut downe the high cedres therof, & the choſen firre trees therof, and wil enter to the toppe of the height therof, to the foreſt of his Carmel.
label: Isaie

text: I haue digged, and drunken the water, and haue dried vp with the ſteppe of my foote al the riuers of the rampiers.
label: Isaie

text: Why, haſt thou not heard, what I haue done to him of old? from ancient daies haue I formed it: and now I haue brought it to effect: and it is made to the rooting out of litle hilles bickering together, and of fenſed cities.
label: Isaie

text: The inhabitants of them with shortened hand haue trembled, and are confounded: they are become as hay of the field, and graſſe of the paſture ground, and herbe of the houſe toppes, which hath withered before it was ripe.
label: Isaie

text: I haue knowen thy habitation, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy madnes agaynſt me.
label: Isaie

text: When thou didſt rage agaynſt me, thy pride aſcended into mine eares: therfore I wil put a ring in thy noſthrels, and a bitte in thy lippes, & wil bring thee backe into the way, by which thou cameſt.
label: Isaie

text: But to thee this shalbe a ſigne: eate this yeare the thinges that grow of themſelues, and in the ſecond yeare eate fruites: but in the third yeare ſow and reape, & plant vineyards, and eate the fruite of them.
label: Isaie

text: And that which shal be ſaued of the houſe of Iuda, and which is leaft, shal take roote downeward, and shal beare fruite vpward:
label: Isaie

text: becauſe out of Ieruſalem there shal a remnant goe forth, and ſaluation from mount Sion: the zele of the Lord of hoſtes shal doe this.
label: Isaie

text: Therfore thus ſayth our Lord concerning the king of the Aſſyrians: He shal not enter this citie, and he shal not shoote arrow there, and shilde shal not occupie it, and he shal not caſt rampier about it:
label: Isaie

text: In the way that he came, by the ſame he shal returne, and into this citie he shal not enter, ſayth our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil protect this citie, that I may ſaue it for myne owne ſake, and for Dauids ſake my ſeruant.
label: Isaie

text: And the Angel of our Lord came forth, and ſtroke in the campe of the Aſſyrians an hundred eightie fiue thouſand. And they aroſe in the morning, and behold, al were carcaſſes of dead men.
label: Isaie

text: And he went out, and departed, and Sennacherib the king of the Aſſyrians returned, and dwelt in Niniue.
label: Isaie

text: And it came to paſſe, when he adored in the temple of Neſroch his god, Adramelech and Saraſar his ſonnes ſtroke him with the ſword: and they fled into the land of Ararat, & Aſarhaddon his ſonne reigned for him.
label: Isaie

text: IN thoſe dayes Ezechias was ſick euen to death, and Iſaie the ſonne of Amos the prophet, went in vnto him, and ſaid to him: Thus ſayth our Lord: Take order with thy houſe, for thou shalt die, and shalt not liue.
label: Isaie

text: And Ezechias turned his face to the wal, and prayed to our Lord,
label: Isaie

text: and ſaid: I beſech thee Lord, remember I pray thee how I haue walked before thee in truth, and in a perfect hart, and haue done that which is good in thine eies. And Ezechias wepte with great weeping.
label: Isaie

text: And the word of our Lord was made to Iſaie, ſaying:
label: Isaie

text: Goe, & tel Ezechias: Thus ſaith our Lord the God of Dauid thy father: I haue heard thy prayer, and ſeene thy teares: Loe I wil adde vpon thy dayes fiftene yeares:
label: Isaie

text: and out of the hand of the king of the Aſſirians wil I deliuer thee: and this citie, and wil protect it.
label: Isaie

text: And this shal be a ſigne to thee from our Lord, that our Lord wil doe this word, which he hath ſpoken:
label: Isaie

text: Behold I wil make the shadow of the lines returne, by the which it is now gone downe in the dyal of Achaz in the ſunne, backward ten lines. And the ſunne returned ten lines by the degrees whereby it was gone downe.
label: Isaie

text: The ſcripture of Ezechias the king of Iuda, when he had bene ſicke, and was recouered of his infirmitie.
label: Isaie

text: I haue ſaid: In the middes of my daies shal I goe to the gates of hel. I haue ſought the reſidue of my yeares.
label: Isaie

text: I haue ſaid: I shal not ſee our Lord God in the land of the liuing. I shal behold man no more, and the inhabiter of reſt.
label: Isaie

text: My generation is taken away; and is wrapped together from me, as the tent of shepehards: My life is cut of, as by a weauer: whiles I yet began he cut me of: from morning vntil night thou wilt make an end of me.
label: Isaie

text: I hoped vntil morning, as a lion ſo hath he broken al my bones: From morning vntil euening thou wilt make an end of me.
label: Isaie

text: As a yong ſwallow ſo wil I crie, I wil meditate as a doue: Mine eies are weakened, looking on high: Lord I ſuffer violence, anſwer for me.
label: Isaie

text: What shal I ſay, or what shal he anſwer me, wheras him ſelf hath done it?
label: Isaie

text: I wil recount to thee al my yeares in the bitternes of my ſoule. Lord if mans life be ſuch, and the life of my ſpirit in ſuch thinges, thou shalt chaſten me, and shalt quicken me.
label: Isaie

text: Behold in peace is my bitternes moſt bitter: But thou haſt deliuered my ſoule that it should not perish, thou haſt caſt al my ſinnes behind thy backe.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe hel shal not confeſſe to thee, neither shal death prayſe thee: they that goe downe into the lake, shal not expect thy truth.
label: Isaie

text: The liuing the liuing he shal confeſſe to thee, as I alſo this day: the father shal make thy truth knowen to the children.
label: Isaie

text: O Lord ſaue me, and we shal ſing our pſalmes al the dayes of our life in the houſe of our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: And Iſaie commanded that they should take a lumpe of figges, & plaſter it vpon the wound, and he should be healed.
label: Isaie

text: And Ezechias ſayd : What shal be the ſigne that I shal goe vp into the houſe of our Lord?
label: Isaie

text: AT THAT time Merodach Baladan the ſonne of Baladan, king of Babylon, ſent letters & giftes to Ezechias: for he had heard that he had bene ſicke, and was recouered.
label: Isaie

text: And Ezechias reioyced vpon them, and he shewed them the ſtorehouſe of aromatical ſpices, and of ſiluer, and of gold, and of ſweete odours, and of the beſt oyntment, and al the ſtorehouſes of his furniture, and al thinges that were found in his treaſures. There was not anie thing, which Ezechias shewed them not in his houſe, and in al his dominion.
label: Isaie

text: But Iſaie the prophet went in to Ezechias the king, and ſaid to him: What ſayd theſe men, and from whence came they to thee? And Ezechias ſayd: From a far countrie they came to me, from Babylon.
label: Isaie

text: And he ſayd: What ſaw they in thy houſe? And Ezechias ſayd al thinges that are in my houſe haue they ſene, there was not anie thing, which I haue not shewed them in my treaſures.
label: Isaie

text: And Iſaie ſayd to Ezechias: Heare the word of the Lord of hoſtes.
label: Isaie

text: Behold the daies shal come: and al thinges that are in thy houſe, and that thy fathers haue layd vp for treaſure vntil this day, shal be taken away into Babylon: there shal not any thing be leaft, ſayth our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: And of thy children, which shal come forth of thee, whom thou shalt beget, they shal take away, and they shal be eunuches in the palace of the king of Babylon.
label: Isaie

text: And Ezechias ſayd to Iſaie: The word of our Lord which he hath ſpoken is good. And he ſaid: Onlie be there peace and truth in my daies.
label: Isaie

text: BE comforted, be comforted my people, ſaith your God.
label: Isaie

text: Speake to the hart of Ieruſalem, and cal to her: becauſe her malice is accomplished, her iniquitie is forgeuen: she hath receiued of the hand of our Lord duble for al her ſinnes.
label: Isaie

text: The voice of one crying in the deſert: Prepare the way of our Lord, make ſtreight the pathes of our God in the wildernes.
label: Isaie

text: Euerie valley shal be exalted, and euerie mountaine and litle hil shal be humbled, & crooked thinges shal become ſtreight, and rough wayes, playne.
label: Isaie

text: And the glorie of our Lord shal be reueled, and al flesh together shal ſee, that the mouth of our Lord hath ſpoken.
label: Isaie

text: The voice of one ſaying: Crie. And I ſayd: What shal I crie? Al flesh is graſſe, and al the glorie therof as the floure of the filde.
label: Isaie

text: The graſſe is withered, and the floure is fallen, becauſe the ſpirit of our Lord hath blowen on it. In deede the people is graſſe:
label: Isaie

text: the graſſe is withered, and the floure is fallen: but the word of our Lord abideth for euer.
label: Isaie

text: Vpon an high mountayne get thee vp, thou that euangelizeſt to Sion: exalt the voice in ſtrength, which euangelizeſt to Ieruſalem: exalt it, feare not. Say to the cities of Iuda: Behold your God:
label: Isaie

text: behold our Lord God shal come in ſtrength, and his arme shal haue dominion: behold his reward is with him, and his worke before him.
label: Isaie

text: As a shepheard shal he feede his flocke: in his arme shal he gather together the lambes, and in his boſome shal he lift them vp, and them with yong himſelf shal carie.
label: Isaie

text: Who hath meaſured the waters with his fiſt, and poundered the heauens with a ſpanne? who hath poyſed with three fingers the huge greatnes of the earth, and wayed the mountaines in weight, and the litle hilles in balance?
label: Isaie

text: Who hath holpen the ſpirit of our Lord? or who hath bene his counſeler, and shewed to him?
label: Isaie

text: With whom hath he taken counſel, and who hath inſtructed him, and taught him the path of iuſtice, and taught him knowlege, and shewed him the way of prudence?
label: Isaie

text: Behold the Gentiles are as a droppe of a bucket, and are reputed as the moment of a balance: behold the ilandes are as a litle duſt.
label: Isaie

text: And Libanus shal not ſuffice to kindle the fyre, and the beaſtes therof shal not be ſufficient for holocauſt.
label: Isaie

text: Al nations as if they were not, ſo are they before him, and they are reputed of him as nothing, and a vaine thing.
label: Isaie

text: To whom then haue you made God like? or what image wil you ſet to him?
label: Isaie

text: Hath the artificer caſt a ſculptil? or hath the goldſmith figured it with gold, or the ſiluerſmith with plates of ſiluer?
label: Isaie

text: Strong wood, and that which wil not putrifie hath he choſen: the wiſe artificer ſeeketh how he may ſet vp a ſculptile which may not be moued.
label: Isaie

text: Why, doe you not know? why, haue you not heard? why, hath it not bene told you from the beginning? Haue you not vnderſtood the fundations of the earth?
label: Isaie

text: He that ſitteth vpon the compaſſe of the earth, and the inhabitants therof are as locuſtes: he that ſtretcheth out the heauens as nothing, & ſpreddeth them as a tent to dwel in.
label: Isaie

text: He that maketh the ſearchers of ſecretes as if they were not, that hath made the iudges of the earth as a vayne thing:
label: Isaie

text: and in deede their ſtocke was neither planted, nor ſowen, nor rooted in the earth: ſodenly he hath blowen vpon them, and they haue withered, and a whirlewind shal take them away as ſtubble.
label: Isaie

text: And to whom haue ye likened me, and made me equal, ſaith the holie one?
label: Isaie

text: Lift vp your eies on high, and ſee who hath created theſe thinges: he that bringeth out the hoſt of them in number, and calleth them al by name: by the multitude of his force and ſtrength, and power, not one of them was miſſing.
label: Isaie

text: Why ſayeſt thou Iacob, and ſpeakeſt thou Iſrael: My way is hid from our Lord, and my iudgement is paſſed ouer of my God?
label: Isaie

text: Why knoweſt thou not, or haſt thou not heard? our Lord is God euerlaſting, which hath created the endes of the earth: he shal not faile, nor labour, neither is there ſearching out of his wiſdome.
label: Isaie

text: Which geueth ſtrength to the wearie: and to them that are not, multiplieth force and ſtrength.
label: Isaie

text: Children shal faynte, and labour, and yongmen shal fal by infirmitie.
label: Isaie

text: But they that hope in our Lord shal change their ſtrength, they shal take winges as eagles, they shal runne & not labour, they shal walke and not fainte.
label: Isaie

text: LET the ilands hold their peace before me, and the Gentiles change their ſtrength: let them come neere, and then ſpeake, let vs approche to iudgement together.
label: Isaie

text: Who hath rayſed the iuſt from the Eaſt, hath called him that he should folow him? he shal geue the Gentiles in his ſight, and he shal obteyne kinges: he shal geue them as it were duſt to his ſword, as ſtubble taken violently with with the winde, to his bow.
label: Isaie

text: He shal purſew them, he shal paſſe in peace, there shal no path appeare after his feete.
label: Isaie

text: Who hath wrought and done theſe thinges, calling the generations from the begynning? I the Lord, the firſt and the laſt I am.
label: Isaie

text: The ilands haue ſeene; and haue bene afrayd, the ends of the earth haue beene aſtonied, they haue approched, and come neere.
label: Isaie

text: Euerie one shal helpe his neighbour, and shal ſay to his brother: Be ſtrong.
label: Isaie

text: The copperſmith ſtriking with the hammer encouraged him that forged at that time, ſaying: It is good for ſodering: and he ſtrengthened it with nailes, that it should not be moued.
label: Isaie

text: And thou Iſrael my ſeruant, Iocob whom I haue choſen, the ſeede of Abraham my frend:
label: Isaie

text: in whom I haue taken thee from the ends of the earth, and from the far parts therof haue called thee, and ſayd to thee; Thou art my ſeruant, I haue choſen thee, and haue not caſt thee away.
label: Isaie

text: Feare not, becauſe I am with thee: decline not, becauſe I am thy God: I haue ſtrengthened thee, and haue holpen thee, and the right hand of my iuſt one hath ſuſteyned thee.
label: Isaie

text: Behold al that fight againſt thee shal be confounded and ashamed, they shal be as if they were not, and the men shal perish that gayneſay thee.
label: Isaie

text: Thou shalt ſeeke them, and shalt not find, the men thy rebelles: they shal be as if they were not: and as conſumption the men that warre agaynſt thee.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe I am the Lord thy God taking thy hand, and ſaying to thee: Feare not, I haue holpen thee.
label: Isaie

text: Feare not thou worme of Iacob, ye that are dead of Iſrael: I haue holpen thee, ſayth our Lord: and thy redemer the holie one of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: I haue made thee as a new threshing wayne, hauing teeth like a ſaw: thou shalt thresh the mountaynes, and breake them in peeces: and shalt make the litle hilles as duſt.
label: Isaie

text: Thou shalt fanne them, and the wind shal take them away, and the whirlewind shal diſperſe them: and thou shal reioyce in the Lord, in the holie one of Iſrael thou shalt be ioyful.
label: Isaie

text: The needie and the poore ſeeke for waters, and there are none: their tongue hath bene drie with thirſt. I the Lord wil heare them, I the God of Iſrael wil not forſake them.
label: Isaie

text: I wil open riuers in the high hilles, and fountaynes in the middes of plaine fildes: I wil make the deſert into pooles of waters, and the land not paſſable into riuers of waters.
label: Isaie

text: I wil geue into the wildernes the cedar, and the thorne, and the myrlte and the oliue tree: I wil ſet in the deſert the firretree, the elme, and the boxtree together.
label: Isaie

text: That they may ſee, and know, and reconnt, and vnderſtand together that the hand of the Lord hath done this, and the holie one of Iſrael hath created it.
label: Isaie

text: Make your iudgement approche, ſayth the Lord: bring hither, if perhaps you haue any thing, ſayd the king of Iacob.
label: Isaie

text: Let them come, and tel vs what thinges ſo euer are to come: tel the former thinges what they haue bene: and we wil ſet our hart, and shal know the later ends of them, and tel vs the thinges that are to come.
label: Isaie

text: Shew what thinges are to come hereafter, and we shal know that ye are goddes. Doe ye alſo good or euil, if you can: and let vs ſpeake, and ſee together.
label: Isaie

text: Behold, you are of nothing, and your worke of that which is not: he is abomination that hath choſen you.
label: Isaie

text: I haue rayſed vp from the North, and he shal come from the riſing of the ſunne: he shal cal vpon my name, and shal bring the magiſtrates as myre, and as the plaſterer treading claie.
label: Isaie

text: Who hath shewed from the beginning, that we may know: and from the beginning that we may ſay: Art thou iuſt? There is neyther that sheweth, nor telleth before, nor heareth your wordes.
label: Isaie

text: The firſt shal ſay to Sion: Loe I am preſent, and to Ieruſalem I wil geue an euangeliſt.
label: Isaie

text: And I ſaw, and neither of theſe was there any that would conſult, and being asked would anſwer a word.
label: Isaie

text: Behold al are vniuſt, and their workes vayne: their idols are wind and vanitie.
label: Isaie

text: BEHOLD my ſeruant, I wil receiue him: mine elect, my ſoule hath pleaſed itſelf in him: I haue geuen my ſpirit vpon him, he shal bring forth iudgement to the Gentiles.
label: Isaie

text: He shal not crie, nor accept perſon, neither shal his voice be heard abrode.
label: Isaie

text: The bruiſed reede he shal not breake, and ſmoking flaxe he shal not quench: he shal bring forth iudgement in truth.
label: Isaie

text: He shal not be ſad, nor turbulent, til he ſet iudgement in the earth: and the ilands shal expect his law.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth the Lord God that created the heauens, and ſtretched them out: that eſtablished the earth, & the thinges that ſpring therof: that geueth breath to the people, that is vpon it, and ſpirit to them that tread thereupon.
label: Isaie

text: I the Lord haue called thee in iuſtice, and taken thy hand, and preſerued thee. And I haue geuen thee for a couenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles.
label: Isaie

text: That thou mighteſt open the eyes of the blind, and bring forth the priſoner out of priſon, & them that ſitte in darknes out of the priſon houſe.
label: Isaie

text: I the Lord, this is my name: I wil not geue my glorie to an other, and my praiſe to grauen thinges.
label: Isaie

text: The thinges that were firſt, loe they are come: new thinges alſo I do shew: before they come forth, I wil make you heare them.
label: Isaie

text: Sing ye to the Lord a new ſong, his prayſe is from the endes of the earth: ye that goe downe to the ſea, and you the fulnes therof: ye ilands, and inhabitants of the ſame.
label: Isaie

text: Let the deſert be exalted and the cities therof: Cedar shal dwel in houſes: ye inhabitants of the Rocke, geue prayſe, they shal crye from the toppe of the mountaines.
label: Isaie

text: They shal geue glorie to the Lord, and shal declare his praiſe in the ilands.
label: Isaie

text: The Lord shal goe forth as a ſtrong man, as a man of warre shal he raiſe vp zele: he shal shoute and crie: ouer his enemies he shal be ſtrengthened.
label: Isaie

text: I haue alwayes held my peace, I haue kepte ſilence, I haue bene patient, I wil ſpeake as a trauailing woman: I wil diſſipate, and ſwallow vp together.
label: Isaie

text: I wil make mountaynes and litle hilles deſolate, and wil make al their graſſe to wither: and I wil turne riuers into ilands, and wil drie vp the ſtanding pooles.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil lead the blind into the way, which they know not: and in the pathes, which they haue bene ignorant of: I wil make them walke: I wil make darkenes before them to be light, and crooked thinges ſtreight: theſe words haue I done to them, and haue not forſaken them.
label: Isaie

text: They are turned backward: let them be confounded with confuſion, that truſt in grauen thing, that ſay to the framed thing, ye are our goddes.
label: Isaie

text: Heare ye deafe, and ye blind behold to ſee.
label: Isaie

text: Who is blind, but my ſeruant? and deafe, but he to whom I haue ſent my meſſengers? Who is blind, but he that is ſolde? and who is blind, but the ſeruant of the Lord?
label: Isaie

text: Thou that ſeeſt manie thinges, wilt thou not keepe them? thou that haſt eares open, wilt thou not heare?
label: Isaie

text: And the Lord hath bene willing to ſanctifie him, and to magnifie the law, and extol it.
label: Isaie

text: But the ſame people is ſpoiled, and waſted: al are the ſnare of yongmen, and they are hid in the houſes of priſons: they are made a praye, neither is there to deliuer them: a ſpoile, neither is there that ſayth: Reſtore.
label: Isaie

text: Who is there among you that wil heare this, attend and harken for thinges to come?
label: Isaie

text: Who hath geuen Iacob into ſpoyle, and Iſrael to the waſters? hath not our Lord himſelf, to whom we haue ſinned? And they would not walke in his wayes, & they haue not heard his law.
label: Isaie

text: And he hath powred out vpon them the indignation of his furie, & a ſtrong battel, and hath burnt him round about, and he knewe not: and ſet him on fyre, and he vnderſtoode not.
label: Isaie

text: AND now thus ſayth our Lord that created thee ô Iacob, & formed thee ô Iſrael: Feare not, becauſe I haue redemed thee, and called thee by thy name: thou art mine.
label: Isaie

text: When thou shalt paſſe through the waters, I wil be with thee, and the floudes shal not couer thee: when thou shalt walke in fyre, thou shalt not be burnt, and the flame shal not burne in thee:
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe I am the Lord thy God the holie one of Iſrael thy ſauiour, I haue geuen Aegypt thy propitiation, Æthiopia and Sale for thee.
label: Isaie

text: Since thou becameſt honorable in mine eies, and glorious: I haue loued thee, & I wil geue men for thee, and peoples for thy ſoule.
label: Isaie

text: Feare not, becauſe I am with thee: from the Eaſt wil I bring thy ſeede, and from the Weſt I wil gather thee.
label: Isaie

text: I wil ſay to the North: Geue: and to the South, Hinder not: bring my ſonnes from a farre, and my daughters from the endes of the earth.
label: Isaie

text: And euerie one that inuocateth my name, for my glorie haue I created him, formed him, and made him.
label: Isaie

text: Bring forth the blind people, and hauing eyes: the deafe, and he hath eares.
label: Isaie

text: Al the nations are aſſembled together, and the tribes are gathered: which of you can shew this, and shal make vs heare the former thinges? Let them geue their witneſſes, and be iuſtified, and heare, and ſay: In verie deede.
label: Isaie

text: You are my witneſſes, ſayth our Lord, and my ſeruants whom I haue choſen: that you may know, and beleue me, and vnderſtand that I myſelf am. Before me there hath no god bene formed, & after me there shal not be.
label: Isaie

text: I am, I am the Lord, and there is no ſauiour beſide me.
label: Isaie

text: I haue shewed, and haue ſaued: I haue made it heard, and there hath bene no ſtrange one among you. You are my witneſſes, ſayth our Lord, and I God.
label: Isaie

text: And from the beginning I my ſelf, and there is not that can deliuer out of my hand: I wil worke, and who shal turne it away?
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth the Lord your redemer, the holie one of Iſrael: For your ſake haue I ſent forth into Babylon, and haue plucked downe al the barres, and Chaldees glorying in their shippes.
label: Isaie

text: I the Lord your holie one, that created Iſrael your king.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth our Lord, that gaue a way in the ſea, and a path in the vehement waters.
label: Isaie

text: Which brought forth the chariote and the houſe: the arme and the ſtrong: they ſlept together, neither shal they riſe agayne: they are broken as flaxe, and are extinct,
label: Isaie

text: Remember not former thinges, and looke not on thinges of old.
label: Isaie

text: Behold I make new thinges, and now they shal ſpring forth, verely you shal know them: I wil make a way in the deſert, and riuers in the place not haunted.
label: Isaie

text: The beaſt of the fielde shal glorifie me, the dragons & the oſtreches: becauſe I haue geuen waters in the deſert: riuers in the place not haunted, that I might geue drinke to my people, to mine elect.
label: Isaie

text: This people haue I formed for myſelf, they shal tel my prayſe.
label: Isaie

text: Thou haſt not inuocated me ô Iacob, neither haſt thou labored in men ô Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: Thou haſt not offered me the ramme of thyne holocauſt, and with thy victimes thou haſt not glorified me: I haue not made thee to ſerue in oblation, nor put thee to payne in frankincenſe.
label: Isaie

text: Thou haſt not bought me ſweete cane for ſiluer, and with the fatte of thy victimes thou haſt not inebriated me. But thou haſt made me to ſerue with thy ſinnes, thou haſt put me to payne with thine iniquities.
label: Isaie

text: I am, I am he that take cleane away thine iniquities for mine owne ſake, and I wil not remember thy ſinnes.
label: Isaie

text: Bring me into remembrance, and let vs be iudged together: tel if thou haue any thing that thou mayſt be iuſtified.
label: Isaie

text: Thy firſt father ſinned, and thy interpreters haue tranſgreſſed againſt me.
label: Isaie

text: And I haue profaned the holie princes, I haue geuen Iacob to deſtruction, & Iſrael to reproch.
label: Isaie

text: AND now heare ô Iacob my ſeruant, and Iſrael whom I haue choſen.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth the Lord that made and formed thee, thy helper from the wombe: feare not ô my ſeruant Iacob, and thou moſt righteous whom I haue choſen.
label: Isaie

text: For I wil powre out waters vpon the thirſtie ground, and ſtreames vpon the drie land: I wil powre out my ſpirit vpon thy ſeede, and my bleſſing vpon thy ſtocke.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal ſpring the herbes as willowes beſide the waters running by.
label: Isaie

text: This man shal ſay: I am our Lords: and an other man shal cal in the name of Iacob, and this wil write with his hand, To the Lord: and in the name of Iſrael he shal be reſembled.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth our Lord the king of Iſrael, and the redemer therof the Lord of hoſtes: I am the firſt, and I the laſt, and beſide me there is no God.
label: Isaie

text: Who is like to me? let him cal and declare: and let him expound me the order, ſince, I appoynted the ancient people: the thinges to come, and that shal be hereafter let them shew vnto them.
label: Isaie

text: Feare ye not, neither be ye trubled, from that time I haue made thee to heare, and haue declared: you are my witneſſes. Is there a God beſide me, and a maker, whom I haue not knowen?
label: Isaie

text: Al the makers of an idol are nothing, and their beſt beloued thinges shal not profite them. Them ſelues are their witneſſes, that they doe not ſee, nor vnderſtand, that they may be confounded.
label: Isaie

text: Who hath formed a god, and molten a ſculptil profitable to nothing?
label: Isaie

text: Behold, al the partakers therof shal be confounded: for the makers are of men: they shal al aſſemble, they shal ſtand and feare, and shal be confounded together.
label: Isaie

text: The yron ſmith hath wrought with the file, with coales, and with hammers he hath formed it, and hath wrought in the arme of his ſtrength: he shal hunger and faynt, he shal not drinke water, and shal become wearie.
label: Isaie

text: The carpenter hath ſtretched out a rule, he hath formed it with a plaine: he hath made it with corners, and hath fashioned it round with the compaſſe: and he hath made the image of a man as it were a beautiful man dwelling in a houſe.
label: Isaie

text: He hath cut downe cedars, taken the helme tree, & the oke that ſtood among the trees of the foreſt: he hath planted the pine tree, which the rayne nourished.
label: Isaie

text: And it was made a fyre for men: he tooke of them, and was warmed: and kindled them, and baked bread: but of the reſt he wrought a god, and adored: he made a ſculptil, and bowed downe before it.
label: Isaie

text: Halfe he burnt with fyre, and of the halfe broyled he flesh & eate it: he ſod pottage, and was filled, and was warmed, and ſayd: Aha, I am warme, I haue ſene the fyre.
label: Isaie

text: But the reſt therof he made a god, and a ſculptil to him ſelf: he boweth before it, and beſecheth, ſaying: Deliuer me, becauſe thou art my God.
label: Isaie

text: They haue not knowen, nor vnderſtood: for they haue forgotten, that their eies could not ſee, and that they could not vnderſtand with their hart.
label: Isaie

text: They doe not recount in their minde, nor know, nor feele, that they should ſay: Halfe therof I haue burnt with fyre, and I haue baked bread vpon the coales therof: I haue broyled flesh, & haue eaten, and of the reſt therof shal I make an idol? shal I fal downe before the ſtocke of a tree?
label: Isaie

text: Part therof is ashes; an vnwiſe hart adored it, & he wil not ſaue his ſoule, nor ſay: Perhaps there is a lie in my right hand.
label: Isaie

text: Remember theſe thinges ô Iacob, and Iſrael, becauſe thou art my ſeruant. I haue formed thee, thou art my ſeruant ô Iſrael foget me not.
label: Isaie

text: I haue cleane taken away thine iniquities as a cloude, & thy ſinnes as a miſt: returne to me becauſe I haue redemed thee.
label: Isaie

text: Prayſe ye ô heauens, becauſe the Lord hath done mercie: make iubilation ye endes of the earth: ye mountaynes ſound prayſe, thou foreſt and euerie tree therof: becauſe the Lord hath redemed Iacob, and Iſrael shal be glorified.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth our Lord thy redemer, and thy maker, from the wombe: I am the Lord, that make al thinges, that alone ſtretch out the heauens, that eſtablish the earth, and none with me.
label: Isaie

text: That make the ſignes of diuiners voide, and turne the ſouthſayers into furie. That turne the wiſe backward, and that make their knowlege foolish.
label: Isaie

text: That rayſeth vp the word of his ſeruant, and accomplisheth the counſel of his meſſengers, which ſay to Ieruſalem: Thou shalt be inhabited; & to the cities of Iuda: You shal be built, and I wil rayſe vp the deſertes therof.
label: Isaie

text: Which ſay to the depth: Be thou deſolate, and thy riuers I wil drie vp.
label: Isaie

text: Who ſay to Cyrus: Thou art my paſtour, and thou shalt accomplish al my wil. Who ſay to Ieruſalem: Thou shalt be built; and to the temple: Thou shalt be formed.
label: Isaie

text: THVS ſayth the Lord to my chriſt Cyrus, whoſe right hand I haue taken, to ſubdew the Gentiles before his face, and to turne the backes of kinges, & to open the doores before him, and the gates shal not be shut.
label: Isaie

text: I wil goe before thee, and wil humble the glorious of the earth: I wil breake the braſen gates, and wil burſt the iron barres.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil geue thee hidden treaſures, & myſteries of ſecretes: that thou mayſt know that I am the Lord, which cal thy name, the God of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: For my ſeruant Iacob, and Iſrael myne elect, and I haue called thee by thy name: I haue reſembled thee, and thou haſt not knowen me.
label: Isaie

text: I the Lord, & there is none els: beſide me there is no God: I girded thee, and thou haſt not knowen me:
label: Isaie

text: that they which are from the riſing of the ſunne, and which are from the weſt may know, that there is none beſide me. I the Lord, and there is none oher,
label: Isaie

text: that forme light, and create darkneſſe, make peace, and create euil: I the Lord that doe al theſe thinges.
label: Isaie

text: Droppe dew ye heauens from aboue, and let the cloudes rayne the iuſt: be the earth opened, and bud forth a ſauiour: and let iuſtice ſpring vp withal: I the Lord haue created him.
label: Isaie

text: Woe to him that gaineſayeth his maker, a sheard of the earthen pottes: shal the clay ſay to him that fashioneth it: What makeſt thou, & thy worke is without handes?
label: Isaie

text: Woe to him that ſayth to his father: Why doeſt thou beget? and to the woman: Why doeſt thou trauel?
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth our Lord the holy one of Iſrael the maker therof: Aske me thinges to come: concerning my children and the worke of my handes command you me.
label: Isaie

text: I made the earth: & man vpon the ſame I haue created: my handes ſtretched forth the heauens, and I haue commanded al their hoſt.
label: Isaie

text: I haue rayſed him vp to iuſtice, & wil direct al his wayes: he shal build my citie, & diſmiſſe my captiuitie: not for price, nor for giftes, ſayth our Lord the God of hoſtes.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth our Lord: The labour of Aegypt, and the merchandiſe of Aethiopia, and of Sabaim the high men shal paſſe to thee, & shal be thine: they shal walke after thee, they shal goe bound with manicles: and they shal adore thee, and shal beſeche thee: Onlie in thee is God, and there is no God beſide thee.
label: Isaie

text: Verely thou art God hidden, the God of Iſrael a ſauiour.
label: Isaie

text: They are al confounded, and ashamed: the forgers of errours are gone together into confuſion.
label: Isaie

text: Iſrael is ſaued in our Lord with eternal ſaluation: you shal not be confounded, and you shal not be ashamed for euer and euer.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thus ſayth our Lord that created the heauens, the verie God that formed the earth, and made it, the verie maker therof: he did not create it in vaine: to be inhabited he formed it. I the Lord, and there is none other.
label: Isaie

text: I haue not ſpoken in ſecrete, in a darke place of the earth: I haue not ſayd to the ſeede of Iacob: Seeke me in vayne. I the Lord that ſpeake iuſtice, that declare right thinges.
label: Isaie

text: Gather ye together, and come, and approch together ye that are ſaued of the Gentiles: they haue bene ignorant that lift vp the wood of their grauen worke, and aske of a God that ſaueth not.
label: Isaie

text: Declare ye, and come, and conſult together: who hath made this to be heard from the begynning, from that time foretold this? Haue not I the Lord, and there is no God beſides but I? A iuſt God, and that ſaueth there is none beſide me.
label: Isaie

text: Be conuerted to me, and you shal be ſaued al ye endes of the earth: becauſe I am God, and there is none other.
label: Isaie

text: I haue ſworne by my ſelf, the word of iuſtice shal procede out of my mouth, and shal not returne, becauſe euerie knee shal be bowed to me, and euerie tongue shal ſweare.
label: Isaie

text: Therfore in our Lord, shal he ſay, are my iuſtices and empire: they shal come to him, and al that reſiſt him, shal be confounded.
label: Isaie

text: In our Lord shal al the ſeede of Iſrael be iuſtified and prayſed.
label: Isaie

text: BEL is broken, Nabo is deſtroyed: their idols are made to beaſtes and cattel, your burdens of heauie weight euen vnto wearines.
label: Isaie

text: They haue melted away; and are broken together: they could not ſaue him that caried them, and their ſoule shal goe into captiuitie.
label: Isaie

text: Heare me ô houſe of Iacob, al the remnant of the houſe of Iſrael, which are caried of my wombe, are borne vp of my matrice.
label: Isaie

text: Euen vnto old age I am the ſame, and vnto hoare heares I wil carie: I haue made, and I wil beare: I wil carie, and wil ſaue.
label: Isaie

text: Wherto haue you reſembled me, and made me equal, and compared me, and made me like?
label: Isaie

text: You that contribute gold out of the bag, and weigh ſiluer with balance: hyring a goldſmith to make a god: and they fal downe and adore.
label: Isaie

text: They beare him on their shoulders carying, and ſetting him in his place, & he shal ſtand, and shal not moue out of his place: Yea when they shal crie alſo vnto him, he shal not heare: from tribulation he shal not ſaue them.
label: Isaie

text: Remember this, & be confounded: returne ye tranſgreſſors to the hart.
label: Isaie

text: Remember the former world, becauſe I am God, and there is no God beſide, neither is there the like to me.
label: Isaie

text: Which shew the laſt thing from the beginning, and from the begynning the thinges that as yet were not done, ſaying: My counſel shal ſtand, and al my wil shal be done:
label: Isaie

text: Which cal a bird from the eaſt, and from a farre countrie, the man of mine owne wil, and I haue ſpoken, and wil bring it: I haue created, and wil doe it.
label: Isaie

text: Heare me ye hard harted, which are far from iuſtice.
label: Isaie

text: I haue made my iuſtice neere, it shal not be far of, & my ſaluation shal not tarie. I wil geue ſaluation in Sion, and my glorie to Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: COME downe, ſitte in the duſt ô Virgin daughter of Babylon, ſitte on the ground: there is no throne for the daughter of the Chaldees, becauſe thou shalt no more be called nice and tender.
label: Isaie

text: Take a mil, and grinde meale: make bare thy turpitude, diſcouer the shoulder, vncouer the thighes, paſſe the riuers.
label: Isaie

text: Thyne ignominie shal be diſcouered, and thy reproch shal be ſeene: I wil take vengeance, and no man shal reſiſt me.
label: Isaie

text: Our redemer, the Lord of hoſtes is his name the holie one of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: Sitte holding thy peace, and enter into darkenes ô daughter of the Chaldees: becauſe thou shalt no more be called the ladie of kingdomes.
label: Isaie

text: I was angrie agaynſt my people, I haue contaminated mine inheritance, and haue geuen them into thy hand: thou haſt not shewed mercies to them: vpon the ancient thou haſt made thy yoke exceding heauie.
label: Isaie

text: And thou haſt ſayd: I wil be a ladie for euer: thou haſt not put theſe thinges vpon thy hart, neither haſt thou remembred thy later end.
label: Isaie

text: And now heare theſe thinges thou that art delicate, and dwelleſt confidently, that ſayeſt in thy hart: I am, and there is none eles beſide me: I shal not ſitte a widow, and I shal not know barrenneſſe.
label: Isaie

text: Theſe two thinges shal come to thee ſodenly in one day, barrenneſſe and widowhood. Al thinges are come vpon thee, becauſe of the multitude of thy ſorceries, and for the vehement hardnes of thine inchanters.
label: Isaie

text: And thou haſt confidence in thy malice, & haſt ſayd: There is none that ſeeth me. Thy wiſdome, and thy knowlege, this hath deceiued thee. And thou haſt ſayd in thy hart: I am, and beſide me there is none other.
label: Isaie

text: Euil shal come vpon thee, and thou shalt not know the ryſing therof: and calamitie shal fal violently vpon thee, which thou canſt not expiate: miſerie shal come vpon thee ſodenly, which thou shalt not know.
label: Isaie

text: Stand with thine inchanters, and with the multitude of thy ſorceries, in which thou haſt traueled from thy youth, if perhaps it may profite thee any thing, or if thou mayſt become ſtronger.
label: Isaie

text: Thou haſt fayled in the multitude of thy counſels: let the aſtrologers of the heauen ſtand and ſaue thee, which did contemplate the ſtarres, and count the monethes, that by them they might tel thinges that shal come to thee.
label: Isaie

text: Behold they are become as ſtuble, fire hath burnt them; they shal not deliuer their ſoule from the hand of the flame: there are no coles, wherwith they may be warmed, nor fire, that they may ſitte therat.
label: Isaie

text: So are the thinges become vnto thee, in whatſoeuer thou haſt traueled: thy merchants from thy youth, euerie one hath erred in his owne way, there is none that can ſaue thee.
label: Isaie

text: HEARE ye theſe thinges ô houſe of Iacob, which are called by the name of Iſrael, and are come out of the waters of Iuda, which ſweare in the name of our Lord, & are mindful of the God of Iſrael not in truth, nor in iuſtice.
label: Isaie

text: For they are called of the holie citie, and are eſtablished vpon the God of Iſrael: the Lord of hoſtes is his name.
label: Isaie

text: The former thinges of old I haue declared, and they proceded out of my mouth, and I haue made them to be heard: ſodenly I haue wrought, and they came.
label: Isaie

text: For I knew that thou art ſtubburne, and thy necke is an yron ſinew, and thy forehead of braſſe.
label: Isaie

text: I foretold thee of old: before they came I told thee, leſt perhaps thou shouldeſt ſay: My idols haue done theſe thinges, and my ſculptils, and moltens haue commanded theſe thinges.
label: Isaie

text: See al the thinges which thou haſt heard: but haue you declared them? I haue made thee know new thinges of old, and the thinges are kept which thou knoweſt not:
label: Isaie

text: now they are created, and not of old: and before the day, and thou heardeſt them not, leſt perhaps thou mighteſt ſay: Behold I knewe them.
label: Isaie

text: Thou haſt neither heard, nor knowen, neither was thyne eare opened of old. For I know that tranſgreſſing thou wilt tranſgreſſe, and I haue called thee a tranſgreſſour from the wombe.
label: Isaie

text: For my names ſake I wil make my furie far of: and for my prayſe I wil bridle thee, that thou perish nor.
label: Isaie

text: Behold I haue fined thee, but not as ſiluer, I haue choſen thee in the fornace of pouertie.
label: Isaie

text: For myſelf, for my ſelf wil I do it, that I be not blaſphemed: and I wil not geue my glorie to an other.
label: Isaie

text: Heare me ô Iacob, and thou Iſrael whom I cal: I the ſame, I the firſt, & I the laſt.
label: Isaie

text: My hand alſo hath founded the earth, and my right hand hath meaſured the heauens: I shal cal them, and they shal ſtand together.
label: Isaie

text: Aſſemble ye together al you, and heare: which of them hath shewed theſe thinges? The Lord hath loued him, he wil do his wil in Babylon, and his arme in the Chaldees.
label: Isaie

text: I, euen I haue ſpoken, and called him: I haue brought him, and his way is directed.
label: Isaie

text: Come ye to me, and heare this: I haue not ſpoken in ſecrete from the begynning, from the time before it was done, I was there, and now the Lord God hath ſent me, and his ſpirite.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth our Lord thy redemer the holie one of Iſrael: I the Lord thy God that teach thee profitable thinges, that gouerne thee in the way that thou walkeſt.
label: Isaie

text: I would thou hadſt attended to my commandments: thy peace had bene as a floud, and thy iuſtice as the waues of the ſea.
label: Isaie

text: And thy ſeede had bene as the ſand, and the ſtocke of thy wombe as the grauel ſtones therof: his name had not perished, neither had it bene deſtroyed from before my face.
label: Isaie

text: Come forth out of Babylon, flee from the Chaldees, shew it forth in the voice of exultation: make this to be heard, and ſpeake it out euen to the endes of the earth. Say: Our Lord hath redemed his ſeruant Iacob.
label: Isaie

text: They thirſted not in the deſert, when he brought them forth: water out of the rocke he brought forth to them, and he cloue the rocke, and there flowed waters.
label: Isaie

text: There is no peace to the impious, ſayth our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: HEARE ye ilands, and attend ye peoples from a farre. The Lord hath called me from the wombe, from my mothers bellie he hath bene mindful of my name.
label: Isaie

text: And he hath made my mouth as a sharpe ſword: in the shadow of his hand he hath protected me, & hath made me as a choſen arrow in his quiuer he hath hidden me.
label: Isaie

text: And he ſayd to me: Thou art my ſeruant Iſrael, becauſe in thee wil I glorie.
label: Isaie

text: And I ſayd: I haue laboured in vayne, without cauſe, and in vayne haue I ſpent my ſtrength: therfore my iudgement is with the Lord, and my worke with my God.
label: Isaie

text: And now ſayth the Lord, that formed me from the wombe to be his ſeruant, that I may reduce Iacob vnto him, and Iſrael wil not be gathered together: and I am glorified in the eies of the Lord, and my God is made my ſtrength.
label: Isaie

text: And he ſayd: It is a ſmal thing that thou shouldeſt be my ſeruant to rayſe vp the tribes of Iacob, and to conuert the dregges of Iſrael. Behold, I haue geuen thee to be the light of the Gentiles, that thou mayſt be ſaluation euen to the fardeſt part of the earth.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth our Lord the redemer of Iſrael, the holie one therof, to the contemptible ſoule, to the nation that is abhorred, to the ſeruant of lordes: kinges shal ſee, & princes shal riſe, & adore for our Lords ſake, becauſe he is faythful, & for the holie one of Iſrael who hath choſen thee.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth our Lord: In time acceptable I haue heard thee, and in the day of ſaluation I haue holpen thee: and I haue kept thee, and geuen thee to be a couenant of the people, that thou mighteſt rayſe vp the land, and poſſeſſe the inheritances diſſipated:
label: Isaie

text: that thou mighteſt ſay to them, that are bound: Come forth: & to them that are in darkneſſe: Be ye diſcouered. Vpon the wayes shal they feede, & their paſtures shal be in al plaines.
label: Isaie

text: They shal not hunger, nor thirſt, & heate and ſunne shal not ſtrike them: becauſe he that is merciful to them, shal gouerne them, and al the fountaines of waters shal geue them drinke.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil make al my mountaines to be a way, & my pathes shal be exalted.
label: Isaie

text: Behold theſe shal come from farre, & behold they from the North and the ſea, and theſe from the South countrie.
label: Isaie

text: Ye heauens prayſe, and earth reioyce, ye mountaynes geue prayſe with iubilation: becauſe our Lord hath comforted his people, and wil haue mercie on his poore ones.
label: Isaie

text: And Sion ſayd: Our Lord hath forſaken me, & our Lord hath forgotten me.
label: Isaie

text: Why, can a woman forget her infant, that she wil not haue pitie on the ſonne of her wombe? And if she should forget, yet wil not I forget thee.
label: Isaie

text: Behold, I haue writen thee in my handes: thy walles are before myne eies alwayes.
label: Isaie

text: Thy builders are come: they that deſtroy thee, and diſſipate thee shal goe out of thee.
label: Isaie

text: Lift vp thine eies round about, and ſee, al theſe are gathered together, they are come to thee: I liue, ſaith our Lord, for thou shalt be clothed with al theſe as with an ornament, and as a bride thou shalt put them about thee.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thy deſerts, and thy ſolitarie places, and the land of thy ruine shal now be ſtraite by reaſon of the inhabitants, and they shal be chaſed far away that ſwalowed thee vp.
label: Isaie

text: As yet shal the children of thy barrenneſſe ſay in thine eares: The place is ſtraite for me, make me ſpace to dwel.
label: Isaie

text: And thou shalt ſay in thy hart: Who hath begot me theſe? I am barren & not bearing, ledde into tranſmigration, and captiue: and theſe who hath brought vp? I deſtitute and alone: & theſe where were they?
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth our Lord God: Behold I wil lift vp my hand to the Gentiles, & to the peoples I wil exalt my ſigne. And shal carie thy ſonnes in their armes, and thy daughters vpon their shoulders.
label: Isaie

text: And kinges shal be thy nourcing fathers, & queenes thy nources: with countenance caſt downe toward the ground they shal adore thee, & they shal licke vp the duſt of thy feete. And thou shalt know that I am the Lord, vpon whom they shal not be confounded that expect him.
label: Isaie

text: Shal a praye be taken from the ſtrong? or can that which was caught of the mightie be ſaued?
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thus ſayth our Lord: Yea verely, euen the captiuitie shal be taken away from the ſtrong: and that which was taken by the mightie, shal be ſaued. But thoſe that haue iudged thee, wil I iudge, and thy children I wil ſaue.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil feede thine enemies with their owne flesh: and as with new wine, ſo shal they be embrewed with their owne bloud: and al flesh shal know, that I am the Lord that ſaue thee, and thy redemer the mightie one of Iacob.
label: Isaie

text: THVS ſayth our Lord: What is this bill of the diuorce of our mother, wherwith I haue diſmiſſed her? or who is my creditour, to whom I ſold you? Loe you are ſolde for your wicked deedes, I haue diſmiſt your mother.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe I came, and there was not a man: I called, and there was none that would heare. Why, is myne hand abridged and made a litle one, that I can not redeme? or is there no ſtrength in me to deliuer? Behold, in my rebuke I wil make the ſea deſert, I wil turne the floodes into drie land: the fishes shal rot without water, and shal dye for thirſt.
label: Isaie

text: I wil clothe the heauens with darknes, and wil make ſackcloth their couering.
label: Isaie

text: The Lord hath geuen me a learned tongue, that I may know to ſtay him vp that is wearie, with a word: he ſtirreth vp in the morning, in the morning he ſtirreth vp mine eare, that I may heare him as a maſter.
label: Isaie

text: The Lord God hath opened mine eare, and I doe not gaynſay? I am not gone backward.
label: Isaie

text: I haue geuen my bodie to the ſtrikers, & my cheekes to the pluckers: I haue not turned away my face from the rebukers & ſpitters.
label: Isaie

text: The Lord God is mine helper, therfore am I not confounded: therfore haue I ſet my face, as a moſt hard rocke, and I know that I shal not be confounded.
label: Isaie

text: He is neere that iuſtifieth me, who shal gayneſay me? let vs ſtand together. who is myne aduerſarie? let him come to me.
label: Isaie

text: Behold the Lord God, my helper: who is he that shal condemne me? Loe they shal al be deſtroyed as a garment, the mothe shal eate them.
label: Isaie

text: Which of you feareth our Lord, heareth the voice of his ſeruant, who hath walked in darkenes, and hath no light? let him hope in the name of our Lord, and leane vpon his God.
label: Isaie

text: Loe al you doe kindle a fyre, are compaſſed with flames, walke in the light of your fyre, and in the flames which you haue kindled: of my hand is this done to you, you shal ſleepe in ſorrowes.
label: Isaie

text: HEARE me ye that folow that which is iuſt, and that ſeeke our Lord: attend to the rocke whence you are hewen out, & to the caue of the lake from the which you are cut out.
label: Isaie

text: Attend to Abraham your father, and to Sara that bare you: becauſe I called him alone, and bleſſed him, & multiplied him.
label: Isaie

text: Our Lord therfore wil comfort Sion, and wil comfort al the ruines therof: and he wil make her deſert as delicacies, and her wildernes as the garden of our Lord. Ioy and gladnes shal be found in it, geuing of thankes, and voice of prayſe.
label: Isaie

text: Attend vnto me ô my people, and my tribe heare ye me: becauſe a law shal proceede from me, and my iudgement shal reſt to be a light of the peoples.
label: Isaie

text: My iuſt one is nigh at hand, my ſauiour is gone forth, and mine armes shal iudge peoples: the ilands shal expect me, and shal patiently wayte for mine arme.
label: Isaie

text: Lift vp your eies into heauen, and looke downe to the earth beneath: becauſe the heauens shal melt as ſmoke, and the earth shal be worne away as a garment, and like to theſe thinges shal the inhabitants therof perish: but my ſaluation shal be for euer, and my iuſtice shal not faile.
label: Isaie

text: Heare me ye that know that which is iuſt, my people which haue my law in their hart: feare ye not the reproch of men, and be not afrayd of their blaſphemies.
label: Isaie

text: For as a garment, ſo shal the worme eate them: and as wool, ſo shal the moth deuoure them, but my ſaluation shal be for euer, and my iuſtice vnto generations of generations.
label: Isaie

text: Ariſe, ariſe, put on ſtrength ô arme of our Lord: ariſe as in the old dayes, in the generations of worldes. Haſt not thou ſtriken the proude, wounded the dragon?
label: Isaie

text: Haſt not thou dried the ſea, the water of the vehement, which madeſt the depth of the ſea a way, that the deliuered might paſſe.
label: Isaie

text: And now they that are redemed of our Lord, shal returne, and shal come into Sion prayſing, and ioy euerlaſting vpon their heades, they shal poſſeſſe ioy and gladnes, ſorrow and mourning shal flee away.
label: Isaie

text: I, euen I my ſelf wil comfort you: who art thou that thou shouldeſt be afrayd of a mortal man, and of the ſonne of man, which as graſſe ſo shal wither?
label: Isaie

text: And thou haſt forgotten our Lord thy maker, which ſtretched out the heauens, and founded the earth: and thou haſt bene afrayd continually al the day at the face of his furie, which afflicted thee, and had prepared to deſtroy: where is now the furie of the affliction?
label: Isaie

text: He shal quickly come going to open, and he shal not kil vnto vtter deſtruction, neither shal his bread faile.
label: Isaie

text: But I am the Lord thy God which truble the ſea, and the waues therof doe ſwel, the Lord of hoſtes is my name.
label: Isaie

text: I haue put my wordes in thy mouth, and in the shadow of my hand I haue protected thee, that thou mighteſt plant the heauens, and found the earth: & mighteſt ſay to Sion: Thou art my people.
label: Isaie

text: Be lifted vp, be lifted vp, ariſe Ieruſalem, which haſt drunken of the hand of our Lord the cuppe of his wrath: euen to the botome of the cuppe of drouſines haſt thou drunke, euen to the dregges.
label: Isaie

text: There is none that can vphold her of al the children, that she hath borne: and there is none that taketh her by the hand of al the children, that she hath brought vp.
label: Isaie

text: There are two thinges which haue happened to thee: who shal be ſorie for thee? Spoile, and deſtruction, and famine, and the ſword, who shal comfort thee?
label: Isaie

text: Thy children are throwen forth, they haue ſlept in the head of al wayes, as the orix that is ſnared: ful of the indignation of our Lord, of the rebuke of thy God.
label: Isaie

text: Therefore heare this poore little one, and drunken not of wine.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſayth thy dominatour our Lord, and thy God, who hath fought for his people: Behold I haue taken out of thy hand the cuppe of drouſines, the botome of the cuppe of mine indignation, thou shalt not adde to drinke it any more.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil put it in their hand, that haue humbled thee, and haue ſayd to thy ſoule: Bow downe, that we may paſſe ouer: and thou haſt layd thy bodie as the gronnd, and as a way to them that paſſe ouer?
label: Isaie

text: ARISE, ariſe, put on thy ſtrength ô Sion, put on the garments of thy glorie ô Ieruſalem the citie of the holie one: becauſe the vncircumciſed, and vncleane shal adde no more to paſſe by thee.
label: Isaie

text: Be shaken out of the duſt, ariſe, ſit vp Ieruſalem: looſe the bonds of thy necke ô captiue daughter of Sion.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thus ſayth our Lord: You were ſold for nought, and without ſiluer you shal be redemed.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thus ſayth our Lord God: My people went downe into Ægypt at the beginning to be a ſeiourner there: and Aſſur without any cauſe did oppreſſe them.
label: Isaie

text: And now what haue I here, ſayth our Lord: becauſe my people is taken away for nought? Their rulers doe vniuſtly, ſayth our Lord, and continually al the day my name is blaſphemed.
label: Isaie

text: For this cauſe shal my people know my name in that day: becauſe I my ſelf that ſpake, loe am preſent.
label: Isaie

text: How beautiful vpon the mountaines are the feete of him that euangelizeth & preacheth peace: of him that telleth good, preaching health, that ſayeth to Sion: Thy God shal reigne!
label: Isaie

text: The voice of thy watchemen, they haue lifted vp their voice, they shal prayſe together: becauſe eie to eie they shal ſee when our Lord shal conuert Sion.
label: Isaie

text: Reioyce, & prayſe together ye deſerts of Ieruſalem: becauſe our Lord hath comforted his people: he hath redemed Ieruſalem.
label: Isaie

text: Our Lord hath prepared his holie arme in the ſight of al the Gentiles: and al the endes of the earth shal ſee the ſaluation of our God.
label: Isaie

text: Depart, depart, goe ye out from thence, touch not a polluted thing: goe out of the middes of her, be cleanſed ye that carie the veſſeles of our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe you shal not goe out in tumult, neither with flight shal you make haſt: for our Lord wil goe before you, and the God of Iſrael wil gather you together.
label: Isaie

text: Behold my ſeruant shal vnderſtand, he shal be exalted, and shal be lifted vp, and shal be exceding high.
label: Isaie

text: As manie haue bene aſtoined vpon thee, ſo shal his looke among men be inglorious, and his forme among the ſonnes of men.
label: Isaie

text: He shal ſprinkle manie nations, kinges shal shut their mouthe vpon him: becauſe they to whom it was not told of him, haue ſene: and they that heard not haue beheld.
label: Isaie

text: VVHO hath beleued our hearing? and the arme of our Lord to whom is it reueled?
label: Isaie

text: And he shal come vp as a yong ſpring before him, and as a roote from a thirſtie ground: there is no beautie in him, nor comelineſſe: and we haue ſene him, and there was no ſightlines, and we were deſirous of him.
label: Isaie

text: Deſpiſed, and moſt abiect of men, a man of ſorowes, and knowing infirmitie: and his looke as it were hid and deſpiſed, whereupon neither haue we eſtemed him.
label: Isaie

text: He ſurely hath borne our infirmities, and our ſorowes he hath caried: and we haue thought him as it were a leper, and ſtriken of God and humbled.
label: Isaie

text: But he was wounded for our iniquities, he was broken for our ſinnes: the diſcipline of our peace vpon him, and with the waile of his ſtripe we are healed.
label: Isaie

text: Al we haue ſtrayed as sheepe, euerie one hath declined into his owne way: and our Lord hath put vpon him the iniquitie of al vs.
label: Isaie

text: He was offered becauſe him ſelf would, and opened not his mouth: as a sheepe to ſlaughter shal he be led, and as a lambe before his shearer, he shal be dumme, and shal not open his mouth:
label: Isaie

text: from diſtreſſe, and from iudgement he was taken vp: who shal declare his generation? becauſe he is cut out of the land of the liuing: for the wickednes of my people haue I ſtriken him.
label: Isaie

text: And he shal geue the impious for his burial, and the riche for his death: becauſe he hath not done iniquitie, neither was there guile in his mouth.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord would breake him in infirmitie: if he shal put away his ſoule for ſinne, he shal ſee ſeede of long age, and the wil of our Lord shal be directed in his hand.
label: Isaie

text: For that his ſoule hath laboured, he shal ſee and be filled: in his knowlege the ſame my iuſt ſeruant, shal iuſtifie manie, and he shal beare their iniquities.
label: Isaie

text: Therefore wil I diſtribute vnto him verie manie, and he shal diuide the ſpoiles of the ſtrong, for that he hath deliuered his ſoule vnto death, and was reputed with the wicked: and he hath borne the ſinnes of manie, and hath prayed for the tranſgreſſours.
label: Isaie

text: PRAISE ô barren woman which beareſt not: ſing prayſe, and make ioyful noyſe, which didſt not beare: becauſe manie are the children of the deſolate more then of her, that hath a husband, ſaith our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and ſtretch out the skinnes of thy tabernacles, ſpare not: make long thy coardes, and faſten thy nailes.
label: Isaie

text: For thou shalt penetrate to the right hand, and to the left: and thy ſeede shal inherite the Gentiles, and shal inhabite the deſolate cities.
label: Isaie

text: Feare not, becauſe thou shalt not be confounded, nor blush: for thou shalt not be ashamed, becauſe thou shalt forget the confuſion of thy youth, and the reproch of thy widowhood thou shalt remenber no more.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe he shal rule ouer thee that made thee, the Lord of hoſtes is his name: & thy redemer the holie one of Iſrael, shal be called the God of al the earth.
label: Isaie

text: For as a woman forſaken & mourning in ſpirit hath our Lord called thee, and as a wife caſt of from her youth, hath thy God ſayd:
label: Isaie

text: For a moment, a litle while haue I forſaken thee, & in great mercies wil I gather thee.
label: Isaie

text: In a moment of indignation haue I hid my face a litle while from thee, and in mercie euerlaſting haue I had mercie on thee, ſayd thy redeemer our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: As in the daies of Noe is this thing to me, to whom I ſware, that I would no more bring in the waters of Noe vpon the earth: ſo haue I ſworne not to be angrie with thee, and not to rebuke thee.
label: Isaie

text: For the mountaines shal be moued, and the little hilles shal tremble: but my mercie shal not depart from thee, and the couenant of my peace shal not be moued: ſayd our Lord thy miſeratour.
label: Isaie

text: Poore litle one shaken with tempeſt, without al comfort, behold I wil lay thy ſtones in order, and wil found thee in ſapphires,
label: Isaie

text: and I wil put the iaſper ſtone for thy munitions: and thy gates into grauen ſtones, and al thy borders into ſtones worthie to be deſired.
label: Isaie

text: Al thy children taught of our Lord: & a multitude of peace to thy children.
label: Isaie

text: And in iuſtice thou shalt be founded: depart far from calumnie becauſe thou shalt not feare: and from dread, becauſe it shal not approch to thee.
label: Isaie

text: Behold, the borderer shal come, which was not with me, thy ſtranger ſometime, shal be ioyned to thee.
label: Isaie

text: Behold, I haue created the ſmith that bloweth the coles in the fire, and bringeth forth a veſſel for his worke, & I created the killer to deſtroy.
label: Isaie

text: Euerie veſſel, that is made agaynſt thee, shal not proſper: and euerie tongue reſiſting thee in iudgement, thou shalt iudge. This is the inheritance of the ſeruants of our Lord, and their iuſtice with me, ſayth our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: AL YE that thirſt come to the waters: and you that haue no ſiluer, make haſt, bye, & eate: come, bye without ſiluer, and without any exchange wine and milke.
label: Isaie

text: Why beſtow you ſiluer not for bread, & your labour not for ſaciety? Hearing heare ye me, and eate that which is good, and your ſoule shal be delighted in fatnes.
label: Isaie

text: Incline your eare, & come to me: heare, and your ſoule shal liue, and I wil make an euerlaſting couenant with you, the faythful mercies of Dauid.
label: Isaie

text: Behold I haue geuen him for a witnes to the peoples, for a prince and maſter to the Gentiles.
label: Isaie

text: Behold thou shalt cal the nation, which thou knoweſt not: and the nations that knew not thee shal runne to thee, becauſe of the Lord thy God, and the holie one of Iſrael: becauſe he hath glorified thee.
label: Isaie

text: Seeke ye our Lord whiles he may be found, inuocate him, whiles he is neere.
label: Isaie

text: Let the impious forſake his way, and the vniuſt man his cogitations, and returne to our Lord, and he wil haue mercie on him, and to our God: becauſe he is bountiful to forgeue.
label: Isaie

text: For my cogitations are not your cogitations: nor your wayes my wayes, ſayth our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: For as the heauens are exalted aboue the earth, ſo are my wayes exalted aboue your wayes, and my cogitations aboue your cogitations.
label: Isaie

text: And as the showre cometh downe, and the ſnow from heauen, and returneth no more thither, but inebriateth the earth, and watereth it, and maketh it to ſpring, and geueth ſeede to the ſower, and bread to him that eateth:
label: Isaie

text: ſo shal my word be, which shal proceede from my mouth: it shal not returne to me voyde, but it shal doe what thinges ſoeuer I would, and shal proſper in theſe thinges for which I ſent it.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe you shal goe forth in ioy, and in peace shal you be conducted, the mountaines and the litle hilles shal ſing prayſe before you, and al the wood of the countrie shal clap the hand.
label: Isaie

text: For the shrubbe, shal come vp the firre tree, and for the nettle, shal grow the myrtle tree: and our Lord shal be named for an euerlaſting ſigne, that shal not be taken away.
label: Isaie

text: THVS ſayth our Lord: Kepe ye iudgement, and doe iuſtice: becauſe my ſaluation is nere to come: and my iuſtice to be reueled.
label: Isaie

text: Bleſſed is the man, that doth this thing, and the ſonne of man that shal apprehend this: keping the Sabbath that he pollute it not, keping his handes that he doe no euil.
label: Isaie
