text: And let not the ſonne of the ſtranger, that cleaueth to our Lord, ſay: By ſeperation the Lord wil diuide me from his people.
label: Isaie

text: And let not the eunuch ſay: Behold I am a drie tree. Becauſe thus ſayth our Lord to the eunuches: They that shal kepe my Sabbathes, and shal chooſe the thinges that I would, and shal hold my couenant:
label: Isaie

text: I wil geue vnto them in my houſe, and within my walles a place, and a name better then ſonnes and daughters: an euerlaſting name wil I geue them, which shal not perish.
label: Isaie

text: And the children of the ſtranger that cleaue to the Lord, to worshipe him, & to loue his name, to be his ſeruants: euerie one that kepeth the Sabbath not to pollute it, and that holdeth my couenant.
label: Isaie

text: I wil bring them into my holie mount, and wil make them ioyful in the houſe of my prayer: their holocauſtes, and their victims shal pleaſe me vpon mine altar: becauſe my houſe shal be called the houſe of prayer to al peoples.
label: Isaie

text: Sayth our Lord God that gathereth the diſperſed of Iſrael: As yet wil I gather vnto it, the gathered together therof.
label: Isaie

text: Al ye beaſts of the fielde come to deuoure, al ye beaſtes of the foreſt.
label: Isaie

text: His watchmen al blind haue bene ignorant: dume dogges not able to barke, ſeing vaine thinges, ſleeping and louing dreames.
label: Isaie

text: And moſt inpudent dogges, they haue knowne no ſacietie: the paſtors themſelues haue bene ignorant of vnderſtanding: al haue declined into their owne way, euerie one to his owne auarice, from the higheſt euen to the laſt.
label: Isaie

text: Come, let vs take wine, and be filled with drunkennes, and it shal be as to day, ſo alſo to morow, and much more.
label: Isaie

text: THE iuſt perisheth, and there is none that conſidereth in his hart, & men of mercie are gathered away, becauſe there is none that vnderſtandeth; for at the face of malice, is the iuſt gathered away.
label: Isaie

text: Let peace come, let him reſt in his bed that hath walked in his direction.
label: Isaie

text: But come you hither ye children of the witch, the ſeede of the aduouterer, and of the harlot.
label: Isaie

text: Vpon whom haue you ieſted? vpon whom haue you opened your mouth awide, and thruſt out the tongue? Are not you wicked children, a lying ſeede?
label: Isaie

text: Which take comforte in the goddes vnder euerie thicke greenetree, immolating your litle ones in the torrents, vnder the high rockes?
label: Isaie

text: In the partes of the torrent is thy part, this is thy lot: and thou haſt powred out libament to them, thou haſt offered ſacrifice. shal I not take indignation of theſe thinges?
label: Isaie

text: Vpon an high and loftie mountaine thou haſt layd thy bed, and haſt gone vp thither to immolate hoſtes.
label: Isaie

text: And behind the doore, and behind the poſt thou haſt ſet thy memorial: becauſe thou haſt diſcouered thyſelf neere me, and haſt receiued an aduouterer, thou haſt enlarged thy bed, and made a couenant with them: thou haſt loued their couche with open hand.
label: Isaie

text: And thou haſt adorned thyſelf with royal oyntment, and haſt multiplied the gay payntings. Thou didſt ſend thy legates far of, & waſt humbled euen to hel.
label: Isaie

text: In the multitude of thy way thou haſt laboured: thou ſaydſt not: I wil reſt: thou haſt found life of thine owne hand, therfore thou haſt not asked.
label: Isaie

text: For whom, with careful reuerence, haſt thou feared, wheras thou haſt lied, & haſt not bene mindful of me, nor thought on me in thy hart? becauſe I am holding my peace, and as it were not ſeing, and thou haſt forgotten me.
label: Isaie

text: I wil declare thy iuſtice, and thy workes shal not profite thee.
label: Isaie

text: When thou shalt crie, let thy gathered together deliuer thee, and the winde shal take them al away, a ſoft blaſt shal beare them away: But he that hath confidence in me, shal inherite the land, and shal poſſeſſe my holie mount.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil ſay: Make a way, geue paſſage, turne out of the path, take away ſtumbling blockes out of the way of my people.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thus ſaith the High & eminent, that inhabiteth eternitie: and his name is holie, dwelling in the high, and holie place, and with a contrite & humble ſpirit: that he may reuiue the ſpirit of the humble, and reuiue the hart of the contrite.
label: Isaie

text: For I wil not contend for euer, neither wil I be wrath vnto the end: becauſe the ſpirit shal proceede from my face, and breathinges I wil make.
label: Isaie

text: For the iniquitie of his auarice I was angrie, and haue ſtriken him: I haue hid my face from thee, and haue taken indignation: and he hath gone wandering in the way of his owne hart.
label: Isaie

text: I ſaw his wayes, and haue healed him, and reduced him, and haue reſtored conſolations vnto him, and to them that mourne for him.
label: Isaie

text: I haue created the fruite of the lippes peace, peace to him, that is far of, and that is nere, ſaid our Lord, and I haue healed him.
label: Isaie

text: But the impious are as it were the raging ſea, which can not be quiet, and the waues therof ouerflowe vnto conculcation and myre.
label: Isaie

text: There is no peace to the impious, ſayth our Lord God.
label: Isaie

text: CRIE, ceaſe not, as a trumpet exalt thy voice, and tel my people their wicked doinges, and the houſe of Iacob their ſinnes.
label: Isaie

text: For me in deede they ſeeke from day to day, and they wil know my waies, as a nation that hath done iuſtice, and hath not forſaken the iudgement of their God: they aske of me the iudgements of iuſtice: they wil approch to God.
label: Isaie

text: Why haue we faſted, and thou haſt not regarded: haue we humbled our ſoules, and thou haſt not knowen? Behold in the day of your faſt your owne wil is found, and you exact of al your detters.
label: Isaie

text: Behold you faſt to debates and contentions, and ſtrike with the fiſt impiouſly. Doe not faſt as vntil this day, that your crie may be heard on high.
label: Isaie

text: Is this ſuch a faſt, as I haue choſen: for a man by the day to afflict his ſoule? Is this it, to winde his head about like a circle, and to ſpread ſackcloth and ashes? wilt thou cal this a faſt, and a day acceptable to the Lord?
label: Isaie

text: Is not this rather the faſt that I haue choſen? Diſſolue the bands of impietie, looſe the bundels that ouerlode, diſmiſſe them free that are broken, and breake in ſunder euerie burden.
label: Isaie

text: Breake thy bread to the hungrie, and the needie, and herberles bring in into thy houſe: when thou shalt ſee the naked, couer him, and deſpiſe not thy flesh.
label: Isaie

text: Then shal thy light breake forth as the morning, and thy health shal ſooner ariſe, & thy iuſtice shal goe before thy face, and the glorie of our Lord shal embrace thee.
label: Isaie

text: Then shalt thou inuocate, and our Lord wil heare: thou shalt crie, and he wil ſay: Loe here I am. If thou wilt take away the cheine out of the middes of thee, and ceaſe to ſtretch out the finger, and to ſpeake that which profiteth not.
label: Isaie

text: When thou shalt powre out thy ſoule to the hungrie, and shalt fil the afflicted ſoule, thy light shal ariſe vp in darkenes, and thy darkenes shal be as the noone day.
label: Isaie

text: And our Lord wil geue thee reſt alwayes, and wil fil thy ſoule with brightnes, and deliuer thy bones, and thou shalt be as a watered garden, and as a fountaine of waters, whoſe waters shal not fayle.
label: Isaie

text: And the deſerts of the worlds shal be builded in thee: thou shalt rayſe vp the fundations of generation and generation: and thou shalt be called the builder of the hedges, turning the pathes into reſt.
label: Isaie

text: If thou turne away thy foote from the Sabbath, from doing thy wil in my holie day, and cal the Sabbath delicate, and the holie of our Lord glorious, and glorifie him, whiles thou doeſt not thine owne wayes, and thy wil be not found, to ſpeake a word:
label: Isaie

text: Then shalt thou be delighted vpon the Lord, & I wil lift thee vp aboue the heightes of the earth, & wil feede thee with the inheritance of Iacob thy father. For the mouth of the Lord hath ſpoken.
label: Isaie

text: BEHOLD the hand of our Lord is not abridged that he can not ſaue, neither is his eare made heauie that it can not heare.
label: Isaie

text: But your iniquities haue deuided betwen you and your God, and your ſinnes haue hid his face from you that he would not heare.
label: Isaie

text: For your handes are polluted with bloud and your fingeres with iniquitie: your lippes haue ſpoken lie, and your tongue ſpeaketh iniquitie.
label: Isaie

text: There is none that doth inuocate iuſtice, neither is there any that iudgeth truly: but they truſt in thinges of nothing, and ſpeake vanities: they haue conceiued labour, and brought forth iniquitie.
label: Isaie

text: They haue broken the egges of aſpes, and haue wouen the ſpiders webbes: he that shal eate of their egges, shal die: and that which is nourished, shal be hatched into a cockatrice.
label: Isaie

text: Their webbes shal not be for clothing, neither shal they be couered with their workes: their workes are vnprofitable workes, and the worke of iniquitie is in their handes.
label: Isaie

text: Their feete runne to euil, & haſten to shede innocent bloud: their cogitations are vnprofitable cogitations: waſte and deſtruction are in their wayes.
label: Isaie

text: They haue not knowen the way of peace, and there is no iudgement in their ſteppes: their pathes are become croked to them: euerie one that treadeth in them, knoweth not peace.
label: Isaie

text: For this cauſe is iudgement far from vs, & iuſtice shal not apprehend vs. We expected light, and behold darkeneſſe: brightnes, & we haue walked in darkenes.
label: Isaie

text: We haue groped as blind men, for the wal, and as without eies haue feeled: we haue ſtumbled at noone day as in darkenes, in darke places as the dead.
label: Isaie

text: We al shal roare as beares, and as mourning doues we shal lament. We haue expected iudgement, and there is none: ſaluation, and it is far from vs.
label: Isaie

text: For our iniquities are multiplied before thee, and our ſinnes haue anſwered to vs: becauſe our wicked doings are with vs, & our iniquities we haue knowen,
label: Isaie

text: to ſinne and lie againſt our Lord: and we were turned away ſo that we went not after our God, that we ſpake calumnie and trangreſſion: we conceiued, and ſpake from the hart words of lying.
label: Isaie

text: And iudgement was turned backward, and iuſtice ſtood far of: becauſe truth hath fallen downe in the ſtreete, and equitie could not enter in.
label: Isaie

text: And truth grew into obliuion: and he that departed from euil, lay open to the praye: and our Lord ſaw, and it appeared euil in his eies, becauſe there is no iudgement.
label: Isaie

text: And he ſaw that there is not a man: and he was aſtoined, becauſe there is none to oppoſe himſelf: and his owne arme ſaued to himſelf, and his iuſtice it ſelf confirmed him.
label: Isaie

text: He is clothed with iuſtice as with a breſtplate, and is an helmet of ſaluation on his head: he is clothed with garments of reuenge, and is couered as with a mantel of zele.
label: Isaie

text: As vnto reuenge, as it were vnto retribution of indignation to his aduerſaries, and recompence to his enemies: he wil repay the like to the ilandes.
label: Isaie

text: And they of the Weſt, shal feare the name of our Lord: and they of the ryſing of the ſunne, his glorie: when he shal come as a violent ſtreame, which the ſpirit of our Lord driueth:
label: Isaie

text: and there shal come a redemer to Sion, and to them, that returne from iniquitie in Iacob, ſayth our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: This is my couenant with them, ſayth our Lord My ſpirit that is in thee, and my wordes that I haue put in thy mouth, shal not depart out of thy mouth, and out of the mouth of thy ſeede, and out of the mouth of thy ſeedes ſeede, ſayth our Lord, from this preſent and for euer.
label: Isaie

text: ARISE, be illuminated Ieruſalem: becauſe thy light is come, & the glorie of our Lord is riſen vpon thee.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe loe darkenes shal couer the earth, & a miſt the peoples: but vpon thee shal our Lord ariſe, and his glorie shal be ſeene vpon thee.
label: Isaie

text: And the Gentiles shal walke in thy light, and kinges in the brightnes of thy riſing.
label: Isaie

text: Lift vp thine eies round about, and ſee al theſe are gathered together, they are come to thee: thy ſonnes shal come from a farre, & thy daughters shal riſe from the ſide.
label: Isaie

text: Then shalt thou ſee, & abound, and thy hart shal meruel and be enlarged, when the multitude of the ſea shal be conuerted to thee, the ſtrength of Gentiles shal come to thee.
label: Isaie

text: The inundation of camels shal couer thee, the dromedaries of Madian and Epha: al of Saba shal come, bringing gold and frakincenſe: and shewing forth prayſe to our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: Al the cattel of Cedar shal be gathered together vnto thee, the rammes of Nabaioth shal miniſter to thee: they shal be offered vpon my placable altar, and I wil glorifie the houſe of my maieſtie:
label: Isaie

text: Who are theſe, that flie as cloudes, and as doues to their windowes?
label: Isaie

text: For, the ilandes expect me, and the shippes of the ſea in the begynning, that I may bring thy ſonnes from a farre: their ſiluer, & their gold with them to the name of the Lord thy God, and to the holie one of Iſrael, becauſe he hath glorified thee.
label: Isaie

text: And the children of ſtrangers shal build thy walles, and their kinges shal miniſter to thee: for in mine indignation haue I ſtricken thee, and in my reconciliation haue I had mercie vpon thee.
label: Isaie

text: And thy gates shal be open continually: day and night they shal not be shut, that the ſtrength of the Gentiles may be brought to thee, and their kinges may be brought.
label: Isaie

text: For the nation and the kingdome that shal not ſerue thee, shal perish: and the Gentiles shal be waſted with deſolation.
label: Isaie

text: The glorie of Libanus shal come to thee, the firretree, and boxetree, and pinetree together, to adorne the place of my ſanctification, and the place of my feete I wil glorifie.
label: Isaie

text: And the children of them that humbled thee, shal come crouching to thee, and al that detracted from thee shal adore the ſteppes of thy feete, and shal cal thee the citie of the Lord, Sion of the holie one of Iſrael.
label: Isaie

text: For that, thou waſt forſaken, and hated, and there was none that paſſed by thee, I wil make thee to be the pride of worldes, a ioy vnto generation and generation:
label: Isaie

text: and thou shalt ſucke the milke of the Gentiles, and thou shalt be nurced with the tette of kinges: and thou shalt know that I am the Lord that ſaue thee, and thy redemer the ſtrong one of Iacob.
label: Isaie

text: For braſſe I wil bring gold, and for yron I wil bring ſiluer: and for wood braſſe, and for ſtones yron: and I wil make thy viſitation peace, and thine ouerſeers iuſtice.
label: Isaie

text: Iniquitie shal no more be heard in thy land, waſte and deſtruction in thy borders, and ſaluation shal occupie thy walles, and prayſe thy gates.
label: Isaie

text: Thou shalt haue the ſunne no more to shine by day, neither shal the brightnes of the moone lighten thee: but the Lord shal be vnto thee for an euerlaſting light, and thy God for thy glorie.
label: Isaie

text: Thy ſunne shal goe downe no more, and thy moone shal not be diminished: becauſe the Lord shal be vnto thee for an euerlaſting light, and the daies of thy mourning shal be ended.
label: Isaie

text: And thy people al iuſt, for euer shal inherite the land, the bud of my planting, the worke of mine hand to glorifie.
label: Isaie

text: The leaſt shal be into a thouſand, and the litle one into a moſt ſtrong nation: I the Lord in the time therof wil ſodenly doe it.
label: Isaie

text: THE ſpirit of the Lord vpon me, becauſe the Lord hath annoynted me: to preach to the milde he ſent me, that I should heale the contrite of hart, and preach indulgence to the captiues, and deliuerance to them that are shut vp.
label: Isaie

text: That I should preach the placable yeare to the Lord, and the day of vengeance of our God: that I might comfort al that mourne:
label: Isaie

text: that I might appoint to the mourners of Sion, and geue them a crowne for ashes, the oyle of ioy for mourning, a mantel of prayſe for the ſpirit of ſorrowfulnes: and they shal be called in it the ſtrong of iuſtice, planting of the Lord to glorifie.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal build the deſertes from the begynning of the world, and shal erect the old ruines; and shal repayre the deſolate cities, that were diſſipated in generation and generation.
label: Isaie

text: And aliens shal ſtand, and feede your cattel: and the children shal be your husbandmen, and dreſſers of the vines.
label: Isaie

text: And you shal be called the prieſtes of the Lord: to you it shal be ſayd: The miniſters of our God: you shal eate the ſtrength of the Gentiles, and in their glorie you shal be proude.
label: Isaie

text: For your duble confuſion and shame, they shal prayſe their part: for this cauſe shal they receiue duble in their land, euerlaſting ioy shal be to them.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe I am the Lord that loue iudgement, & hate robberie in holocauſt: and I wil geue their worke in truth, and make a perpetual couenant with them.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal know their ſeede in the Gentiles, and their bud in the middes of peoples; al that shal ſee them, shal know them, that theſe are the ſeede which the Lord hath bleſſed.
label: Isaie

text: Reioycing I wil reioyce in our Lord, and my ſoule shal be ioyful in my God: becauſe he hath clothed me with the garments of ſaluation: and with the garment of iuſtice he hath compaſſed me, as a bridegrome decked with a crowne, and as a bride adorned with her iewels.
label: Isaie

text: For as the earth bringeth forth her ſpring, and as the garden shooteth forth his ſeede: ſo shal our Lord God make iuſtice to ſpring forth, and prayſe before al the Gentiles.
label: Isaie

text: FOR Sion I wil not hold my peace, and for Ieruſalem, I wil not reſt, til her iuſt one come forth as brightnes, & her ſauiour be kindled as a lampe.
label: Isaie

text: And the Gentiles shal ſee thy iuſt one, and al kinges thy noble one: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of our Lord shal name.
label: Isaie

text: And thou shalt be a crowne of glorie in the hand of our Lord, and the diademe of a kingdome in the hand of thy God.
label: Isaie

text: Thou shalt no more be called, Forſaken: and thy land shal no more be called, Deſolate: But thou shalt be called, My wil in her, and thy land inhabited. becauſe it hath wel pleaſed our Lord in thee: and thy land shal be inhabited.
label: Isaie

text: For the yong man shal dwel with the virgin, and thy children shal dwel in thee. And the bridegrome shal reioyce vpon the bride, & thy God shal reioyce vpon thee.
label: Isaie

text: Vpon thy walles, Ieruſalem, I haue appointed watchemen, al the day, and al the night, for euer they shal not hold their peace. You that remember our Lord, hold not your peace,
label: Isaie

text: and geue not ſilence to him, vntil he eſtablish, and vntil he make Ieruſalem the prayſe in the earth.
label: Isaie

text: Our Lord hath ſworne by his right hand, and by the arme of his ſtrength: If I shal geue thy wheate any more to be meate for thine enemies: and if the ſtrange children shal drinke thy wine, wherein thou haſt laboured.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe they that shal gather it together, shal eate it, and shal prayſe the Lord: and they that carie it together, shal drinke it in my holie courtes.
label: Isaie

text: Paſſe ye, paſſe ye through the gates, prepare a way for the people, make the iourney plaine, & picke vp the ſtones and lift vp the ſigne to the peoples.
label: Isaie

text: Behold our Lord hath made heard in the ends of the earth, tel the daughter of Sion: Behold thy ſauiour cometh: behold his reward is with him, and his worke before him.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal cal them. The holie people, the redemed of our Lord. But thou shalt be called: a citie Sought for, and not Forſaken.
label: Isaie

text: WHO is this that cometh from Edom, with died garments from Boſra, this beautiful one in his robe, going in the multitude of his ſtrength. I, that ſpeake iuſtice, and am a defender to ſaue.
label: Isaie

text: Why then is thy clothing red, and thy garments as theirs that treade in the winepreſſe?
label: Isaie

text: I haue troden the preſſe alone, and of the Gentiles there is not a man with me: I haue troden them in my furie, and haue troden them downe in my wrath: and their bloud is ſprinkled vpon my garments, and I haue ſtayned al my rayment:
label: Isaie

text: For the day of reuenge is in my hart, the yeare of my redemption is come.
label: Isaie

text: I looked about, & there was no helper: I ſought, and there was none to ayde: and myne arme hath ſaued, and myne indignation itſelf hath holpen me.
label: Isaie

text: And I haue troden downe the peoples in my furie, and haue inebriated them in mine indignation, and haue drawen their ſtrength downe to the ground.
label: Isaie

text: I wil remember the mercies of our Lord, the prayſe of our Lord for al thinges, that our Lord hath rendred to vs, and for the multitude of the good thinges to the houſe of Iſrael, which he hath geuen them according to his indulgence, and according to the multitude of his mercies.
label: Isaie

text: And he ſayd: But yet is my people, children that denie not: and he is become their ſauiour.
label: Isaie

text: In al their tribulation he was not troubled, and the angel of his face ſaued them: in his loue, and in his indulgence he redemed them, and bare them, and lifted them vp al the daies of the world.
label: Isaie

text: But they prouoked to wrath, and afflicted the ſpirit of his holie one: and he was turned to be their enemie, and he conquered them.
label: Isaie

text: And he remembred the daies of the world of Moyſes, and of his people: Where is he that brought them out of the ſea, with the paſtours of his flocke? Where is he that put in the middes of him the ſpirit of his holie one?
label: Isaie

text: He that brought out Moyſes to the right hand by the arme of his maieſtie: that diuided the waters before them, that he might make to himſelf an euerlaſting name.
label: Isaie

text: He that brought them out through the depthes, as an horſe in the deſert that ſtumbled not.
label: Isaie

text: As the beaſt that goeth downe in the plaine field, the ſpirit of our Lord was their conductor: ſo didſt thou bring thy people that thou mighteſt make thee a name of glorie.
label: Isaie

text: Attend from heauen, and looke from thy holie habitation, & of thy glorie: where is thy zele, and thy ſtrength, the multitude of thy bowels, and of thy mercies? they haue held backe them ſelues toward me.
label: Isaie

text: For thou art our father, and Abraham hath not knowen vs, and Iſrael hath bene ignorant of vs: thou o Lord art our father, our redemer, from the begynning is thy name.
label: Isaie

text: Why haſt thou made vs erre o Lord from thy waies: haſt thou hardned our hart, that we feared not thee? Returne for thy ſeruants, the tribes of thine inheritance.
label: Isaie

text: As nothing haue they poſſeſſed thy holie people: our enemies haue troden downe thy ſanctification.
label: Isaie

text: We are become as in the begynning, when thou didſt not rule ouer vs, neither was thy name inuocated vpon vs.
label: Isaie

text: WOVLD God thou wouldeſt breake the heauens in ſunder, and wouldſt deſcend: at thy preſence the mountaines should melt away.
label: Isaie

text: As the burning of fyre would they melt, the waters would burne with fyre, that thy name might be made knowen to thine enemies: at thy preſence the nations should be trubled.
label: Isaie

text: When thou shalt doe meruelous thinges, we shal not ſuſtayne: thou art deſcended, and at thy preſence the mountaines are melted.
label: Isaie

text: From the begynning of the world they haue not heard, nor receiued with the eares: the eie hath not ſeene ô God beſide thee, what thinges thou haſt prepared for them that expect thee.
label: Isaie

text: Thou haſt mette him that reioyceth, and doth iuſtice: in thy waies they shal remember thee: behold thou art angrie, and we haue ſinned: we haue bene alwayes in them, and we shal be ſaued.
label: Isaie

text: And al we are become as one vncleane, and al our iuſtices as the cloth of a menſtrued woman: and we haue al fallen as a leafe, and our iniquities as the winde haue taken vs away.
label: Isaie

text: There is none that inuocateth thy name: that ryſeth vp, and holdeth thee: thou haſt hid thy face from vs, and haſt dashed vs in the hand of our iniquitie.
label: Isaie

text: And now Lord thou art our father, and we clay: and thou art our maker, and al we the workes of thy handes.
label: Isaie

text: Be not angrie ô Lord ynough, and remember no more our iniquitie: loe regard, al we are thy people.
label: Isaie

text: The citie of thy holie one is made deſert, Sion is made deſert, Ieruſalem is become deſolate.
label: Isaie

text: The houſe of our ſanctification, and of our glorie, where our fathers prayſed thee, is turned into the burning of fyre, and al our thinges worthie to be deſired are turned into ruines.
label: Isaie

text: Wilt thou vpon theſe thinges conteyne thyſelf ô Lord, wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict vs vehemently?
label: Isaie

text: THEY haue ſought me that before asked not, they haue found that ſought me not. I ſaid: Behold me, behold me, to a Gentilitie that did not inuocate my name.
label: Isaie

text: I haue ſpred forth mine handes al the day to an incredulous people, which goeth in a way not good after their owne cogitations.
label: Isaie

text: A people that prouoke me to anger before my face alwayes: that immolate in gardens, and ſacrifice vpon brickes.
label: Isaie

text: That dwel in ſepulchers, and ſleepe in temples of idols: that eate ſwines flesh, and profane potage in their veſſels.
label: Isaie

text: That ſay: Depart from me, approch not to me, becauſe thou art vncleane: theſe shal be ſmoke in my furie, a fyre burning al the day.
label: Isaie

text: Behold it is written before me: I wil not hold my peace, but I wil render and repay into their boſome
label: Isaie

text: your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, ſayth our Lord, that haue ſacrificed vpon the mountaines, and vpon the litle hilles haue reproched me, & I wil remeaſure their firſt worke in their boſome.
label: Isaie

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: As if a berrie be found in a cluſter, and it be ſaid: Deſtroy it not, becauſe it is a bleſſing: ſo wil I doe for my ſeruants ſake, that I deſtroy not the whole.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil bring forth ſeede out of Iacob, & out of Iuda a poſſeſſour of my mountaines: and mine elect shal inherite it, and my ſeruants shal inhabite there.
label: Isaie

text: And the champaine countries shal be into foldes of flockes, and the valley of Achor for the couche of heardes, vnto my people that haue ſought after me.
label: Isaie

text: And you, that haue forſaken the Lord, that haue forgotten my holie mount, that ſette a table to Fortune, and offer libaments vpon it.
label: Isaie

text: I wil number you in the ſword, and you shal al fal by ſlaughter: becauſe I called, and you haue not anſwered: I ſpake, and you haue not heard, and you did euil in mine eies: and you haue choſen the thinges, that I would not.
label: Isaie

text: For this cauſe thus ſayth our Lord God: Behold my ſeruants shal eate, and you shal be hungrie: behold, my ſeruants shal drinke, and you shal be thirſtie.
label: Isaie

text: Behold my ſeruants shal reioyce, and you shal be confounded: behold my ſeruants shal prayſe for ioyfulnes of hart: and you shal crie for ſorow of hart, and for contrition of ſpirit you shal howle.
label: Isaie

text: And you shal leaue your name for an othe to mine elect: and the Lord God shal kil thee, and wil cal his ſeruants by an other name.
label: Isaie

text: In which he that is bleſſed vpon the earth, shal be bleſſed in God amen: & he that ſweareth in the earth, shal ſweare by God amen: becauſe the former diſtreſſes are forgotten, and becauſe they are hid from myne eyes.
label: Isaie

text: For behold I create new heauens, and a new earth: and the former thinges shal not be in memorie, and they shal not aſcend vpon the hart.
label: Isaie

text: But you shal be glad and reioyce for euer in theſe thinges, which I create: becauſe loe I create Ieruſalem exultation, and the people therof ioy.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil reioyce in Ieruſalem, and be glad in my people, and there shal no more be heard in it the voice of weeping, and the voice of crying.
label: Isaie

text: There shal no more be a childe of daies, and an old man that shal not fil vp his dayes, becauſe the childe of an hundred yeares shal die, and the ſinner of an hundred yeares shal be accurſt.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal build cities, and inhabite: and they shal plant vineyardes, and eate the fruites therof.
label: Isaie

text: They shal not build, and an other shal dwel: they shal not plant, and an other shal eate: for according to the daies of the tree, shal be the dayes of my people, and they shal make old the workes of their handes.
label: Isaie

text: Myne elect shal not labour in vayne nor ingender in conturbation: becauſe it is the ſeede of the bleſſed of the Lord, and their poſteritie with them.
label: Isaie

text: And it shal be, before they cal, I wil heare: as they are yet ſpeaking, I wil heare.
label: Isaie

text: The wulfe and the lambe shal feede together, the lion and the oxe shal eate ſtraw: & to the ſerpent duſt shal be his bread: they shal not hurt, nor kil in al my holie mountaine, ſayth our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: THVS ſayth our Lord: Heauen is my ſeate, and the earth my foote ſtoole: what is this houſe that you wil build to me? and what is this place of my reſt?
label: Isaie

text: My hand hath made al theſe thinges, & al theſe thinges haue bene done, ſayth our Lord. But to whom shal I haue reſpect, but to the poore litle one, and the contrite of ſpirit, and him that trembleth at my wordes?
label: Isaie

text: He that immolateth an oxe, is as he that should ſlay a man: he that killeth a sheepe in ſacrifice, as he that should braine a dog: he that offereth oblation, as he that should offer ſwines bloud: he that remembreth frankincenſe, as he that should bleſſe an idol. Al theſe thinges haue they choſen in their wayes, and in their abominations their ſoule is delighted.
label: Isaie

text: Wherfore I alſo wil chooſe their deluſions: and the thinges that they feared, I wil bring to them: becauſe I called, and there was none that would anſwer: I haue ſpoken, and they heard not: and they haue done euil in mine eies, and haue choſen the thinges that I would not.
label: Isaie

text: Heare the word of our Lord, ye that tremble at his word: your brethren that hate you, and reiect you for my name ſake, haue ſayd: Let the Lord be glorified, & we shal ſee in your ioy: but they shal be counfounded.
label: Isaie

text: A voice of people from the citie, a voice from the temple, the voice of our Lord repaying retribution to his enemies.
label: Isaie

text: Before she traueled, she brought forth, before her time came to be deliuered, she brought forth a man childe.
label: Isaie

text: Who euer heard ſuch a thing? and who hath ſene the like to this? why, shal the earth trauel in one day? or shal a nation be brought forth together, becauſe Sion hath traueled, and brought forth her children?
label: Isaie

text: Shal not I that make others to bring forth children, my ſelf bring forth, ſaith the Lord? shal I, that geue generation to others, be barren, ſayth the Lord thy God?
label: Isaie

text: Reioyce with Ieruſalem, and be ioyful in her al ye that loue her: be glad with her in gladnes al ye, that mourne vpon her,
label: Isaie

text: that you may ſucke, and be filled of the breaſt of her conſolation: that you may milke, and flow with delightes in al maner of her glorie.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe thus ſaith our Lord: Behold I wil decline vpon her as it were a floud of peace, and as a torrent ouerflowing the glorie of the Gentiles, which you shal ſucke: at the breaſts you shal be caried, & vpon the knees they shal ſpeake you fayre.
label: Isaie

text: As if the mother would ſpeake one fayre, ſo wil I comfort you, and in Ieruſalem you shal be comforted.
label: Isaie

text: You shal ſee, and your hart shal reioyce, and your bones shal ſpring as an herbe, and the hand of our Lord shal be knowen to his ſeruants, and he shal be wrath with his enemies.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe loe our Lord wil come in fyre, and his chariotes as a whirlewind, to render his furie in indignation, and his rebuking in flame of fyre:
label: Isaie

text: becauſe our Lord shal iudge in fyre, and in his ſword to al flesh, and the ſlaine of our Lord shal be multiplied,
label: Isaie

text: they that were ſanctified, and thought them ſelues cleane in the gardens behind the gate within, they that did eate ſwines flesh, and abomination and the mouſe: they shal be confounded, ſayth our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: But I know their workes, and their cogitations: I come that I may gather together, with al nations and tongues: and they shal come and shal ſee my glorie.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil put a ſigne in them, and I wil ſend of them, that shal be ſaued, to the Gentiles into the ſea, into Afrike, and Lydia them that hold the arrow: into Italie, and Greece, to the ilandes farre of, to them that haue not heard of me, and haue not ſene my glorie. And they shal shew forth my glorie to the Gentiles:
label: Isaie

text: and they shal bring al your brethren of al nations a gift to our Lord, vpon horſes, and in chariotes, & in horſe litters, & on mules, and in coches, to my holie mountaine Ieruſalem, ſayth our Lord, as if the children of Iſrael should bring in a gift in a cleane veſſel into the houſe of our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: And I wil take of them to be prieſtes, and leuites, ſayth our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: Becauſe as new heauens, and a new earth, which I make to ſtand before me, ſayth our Lord: ſo shal your ſede ſtand, and your name.
label: Isaie

text: And there shal be moneth after moneth, and ſabbath after ſabbath: al flesh shal come to adore before my face, ſayth our Lord.
label: Isaie

text: And they shal goe out, and ſee the carcaſſes of the men, that haue tranſgreſſed againſt me: their worme shal not die, and their fyre shal not be quenched: and they shal be euen vnto ſatietie of ſight to al flesh.
label: Isaie

text: THE wordes of Ieremie the ſonne of Helcias, of the prieſtes that were in Anathoth, in the land of Beniamin.
label: Jeremy

text: The word of our Lord which was made to him in the daies of Ioſias the ſonne of Amon king of Iuda, in the thirteenth yeare of his kingdome.
label: Jeremy

text: And the word was made in the daies of Ioakim the ſonne of Ioſias king of Iuda, vnto the end of the eleuenth yeare of Sedecias the ſonne of Ioſias king of Iuda, euen vnto the tranſmigration of Ieruſalem, in the fifth moneth.
label: Jeremy

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Jeremy

text: Before I formed thee in the wombe, I knewe thee: and before thou cameſt forth of the matrice, I ſanctified thee, and a prophete in the Gentiles I gaue thee.
label: Jeremy

text: And I ſayd; A a a, ô Lord God: Behold, I can not ſpeake, becauſe I am a childe.
label: Jeremy

text: And our Lord ſaid vnto me: Say not: I am a childe: for to al thinges, to which I shal ſend thee, thou shalt goe: and al thinges whatſoeuer I shal command thee, thou shalt ſpeake.
label: Jeremy

text: Be not afraide of their face: becauſe I am with thee to deliuer thee, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: And our Lord put forth his hand, and touched my mouth: and our Lord ſaied to me: Beholde I haue geuen my wordes in thy mouth:
label: Jeremy

text: Behold I haue appointed thee this day ouer the Gentiles, and ouer kingdomes, that thou maiſt pluck vp, and deſtroy, and waſte, and diſſipate, and build, and plant.
label: Jeremy

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying: What ſeeſt thou Ieremie? And I ſaid: I ſee a rodde watching.
label: Jeremy

text: And our Lord ſayed to me: wel haſt thou ſeene; becauſe I wil watch vpon my word to doe it.
label: Jeremy

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me the ſecond time, ſaying: What ſeeſt thou? And I ſaid: I ſee a pot boyling hote, and the face thereof from the face of the North.
label: Jeremy

text: And our Lord ſaied vnto me: From the North shal euil be opened vpon al the inhabitantes of the land.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe loe I wil cal together al the kinredes of the kingdomes of the North, ſaith our Lord: and they shal come, and shal ſette euerie one his throne in the entring of the gates of Ieruſalem, and vpon al the walles therof round about, and vpon al the cities of Iuda.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil ſpeake my iudgements with them, touching al the wickednes of them, that haue forſaken me, and haue offered to ſtrange goddes, and haue adored the worke of their owne handes.
label: Jeremy

text: Thou therefore girde thy loynes, and riſe, and ſpeake to them al thinges that I command thee. Be not afraied of their face: for I wil make thee not to feare their countenance.
label: Jeremy

text: For I haue geuen thee this day to be as a fenced citie, and as an yron pillar, and as a braſen walle ouer al the land of the kinges of Iuda, to the princes thereof, & to the prieſtes, and to the people of the land.
label: Jeremy

text: And they shal fight againſt thee, and shal not preuaile: becauſe I am with thee, ſaith our Lord, to deliuer thee.
label: Jeremy

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Jeremy

text: Goe, and crie in the eares of Ieruſalem, ſaying: Thus ſaith our Lord: I haue remembred thee, pitying thy youth, and the charitie of thy deſpouſing, when thou dideſt folow me in the deſert, in a land that is not ſowen.
label: Jeremy

text: Iſrael is holie to our Lord, the firſt fruites of his fruites: al they that doe deuoure it doe ſinne: euil shal come vpon them, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Heare ye the word of our Lord ô houſe of Iacob, and al ye kinredes of the houſe of Iſrael:
label: Jeremy

text: thus ſaith our Lord: What iniquitie haue your fathers found in me, that they haue made themſelues far from me, and haue walked after vanitie, and are become vaine?
label: Jeremy

text: And they haue not ſaid: Where is our Lord, that made vs come vp out of the land of Ægypt: that led vs through the deſert, through a land inhabitable and without way, through a land of thirſt, & the image of death, through a land, wherein no man walked, nor anie man dwelt?
label: Jeremy

text: And I brought you into the land of Carmel, that you might eate the fruite thereof, and the beſt thinges therof: and being entered in, you haue contaminated my land, and made mine inheritance an abomination.
label: Jeremy

text: The prieſtes haue not ſaid: Where is our Lord? and they that held the law knew me not, and the paſtours haue tranſgreſſed againſt me, and the prophets haue prophecied in Baal, and haue folowed idoles.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore wil I yet contend in iudgement with you, ſaith our Lord, and I wil plead with your children.
label: Jeremy

text: Paſſe ye to the iles of Cethim, and ſee: and ſend into Cedar, and conſider earneſtly: and ſee if there hath the like thing bene done.
label: Jeremy

text: If a nation hath changed their goddes, and ſurely they are not goddes: but my people hath changed their glorie into an idol.
label: Jeremy

text: Be aſtoined ô heauens vpon this, and ô gates thereof be ye deſolate exceedingly, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: For two euils hath my people done, Me they haue forſaken the fountaine of liuing water, & haue digged to them ſelues ceſternes: broken ceſternes, that are not able to holde waters.
label: Jeremy

text: Why, is Iſrael a bondman, or a ſeruant borne in the houſe? why then is he become a praye?
label: Jeremy

text: The lions haue roared vpon him, and haue geuen their voice, they haue made his land a wildernes: his cities are burnt vp, & there is none to dwel in them.
label: Jeremy

text: The children alſo of Memphis, and Taphnes haue defloured thee, euen to the crowne of the head.
label: Jeremy

text: Is not this done to thee, becauſe thou dideſt forſake the Lord thy God at that time, when he led thee by the way?
label: Jeremy

text: And now what wilt thou in the way of Ægypt, to drinke the trubled water? And what haſt thou to doe with the way of the Aſſyrians, to drinke the waters of the riuer?
label: Jeremy

text: Thy malice shal reproue thee, and thine apoſtacie shal rebuke thee. Know thou, & ſee that it is an euil and a bitter thing for thee, to haue left the Lord thy God, and that my feare is not with thee, ſaith our Lord the God of hoſtes.
label: Jeremy

text: From the beginning thou haſt broken my yoke, thou haſt burſt my bonds, and thou ſaidſt: I wil not ſerue. For on euerie litle high hil, and vnder euerie greene thicke tree thou waſt laied downe as an harlot.
label: Jeremy

text: But I planted thee an elect vineyard, al true ſeede: how then art thou turned vnto me into that which is depraued, ô ſtrange vineyard?
label: Jeremy

text: If thou shalt wash thyſelf with nitre, and multiplie to thyſelf the herbe borith, thou art ſpotted in thine iniquitie before me, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Jeremy

text: How ſayſt thou: I am not polluted, I haue not walked after Baalim? ſee thy wayes in the valley, know what thou haſt done: a ſwift courſer that rideth his wayes.
label: Jeremy

text: The wild Aſſe accuſtomed to the wildernes in the deſire of his ſoule, hath drawen the winde of his loue: none shal turne her away: al that ſeeke her shal not faile: in her monethlie flowres they shal finde her.
label: Jeremy

text: Stay thy foote from nakednes, and thy throate from thirſt. And thou ſaideſt: I haue deſpayred, no, I wil not doe it: for I haue loued ſtrangers, and I wil walke after them.
label: Jeremy

text: As the theefe is confounded when he is taken, ſo is the houſe of Iſrael confounded, they and their kinges, the princes and prieſtes, and their prophetes,
label: Jeremy

text: ſaying to wood: Thou art my father: and to ſtone: Thou haſt begotten me: they haue turned the backe to me, & not the face: and in the time of their affliction they wil ſay: Ariſe, and deliuer vs.
label: Jeremy

text: Where are the goddes, whom thou haſt made to thee? let them ariſe and deliuer thee in the time of thine affliction: for according to the number of thy cities were thy goddes ô Iuda.
label: Jeremy

text: What wil you contend with me in iudgement? you haue al forſaken me, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: In vaine haue I ſtriken your children, they haue not receiued diſcipline: your ſworde hath deuoured your prophetes, as a waſting lion is your generation.
label: Jeremy

text: See yee the word of our Lord: why, am I become a wildernes to Iſrael, or a lateward ſpringing land? why then hath my people ſaid: We haue reuolted, we wil no more come to thee?
label: Jeremy

text: Wil a virgin forget her ornament, or a bride the ſtomacher of her breſt? but my people hath forgotten me innumerable daies.
label: Jeremy

text: Why doſt thou endeuour to shew thy way good to ſeeke loue, which moreouer alſo haſt taught thy malices to be thy wayes.
label: Jeremy

text: And in thy winges is found the bloud of the ſoules of the poore and innocentes? Not in diches haue I found them, but in al places, which before I haue mentioned.
label: Jeremy

text: And thou haſt ſaid: I am without ſinne and innocent: and therfore let thy furie be turned away from me. Beholde, I wil contend with thee in iudgement, becauſe thou haſt ſaid: I haue not ſinned.
label: Jeremy

text: How vile art thou become exceedingly, iterating thy wayes! and thou shalt be confounded of Ægypt, as thou art confounded of Aſſur.
label: Jeremy

text: For from hence alſo thou shalt goe, and thy handes shal be vpon thy head: becauſe the Lord hath deſtroyed thy confidence, and thou shalt haue nothing proſperous therein.
label: Jeremy

text: IT IS commonly ſaid: If a man put away his wife, and she departing from him, marie an other man wil he returne to her anie more? shal not that woman be polluted, and contaminated? but thou haſt committed fornication with manie louers: neuertheles returne vnto me, ſaith our Lord, and I wil receiue thee.
label: Jeremy

text: Lift vp thine eies direct: and ſee where thou haſt not bene polluted: thou dideſt ſitte in the waies, expecting them as a robber in the wildernes: and thou haſt polluted the land in thy fornications, and in thy malices.
label: Jeremy

text: For which thing the droppes of rayne were kept back, and there was no lateward shower: thou haddeſt an harlots forehead, thou wouldeſt not blush.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore at the leaſt from henceforth cal me: thou art my father, the guide of my virginitie.
label: Jeremy

text: Why, wilt thou be angrie for euer, or wilt thou perſeuere vnto the end? Loe, thou haſt ſpoken, and haſt done euils, and haſt preuailed.
label: Jeremy

text: And our Lord ſaid to me in the daies of Ioſias the king: Haſt thou ſeene what thinges the reuolter Iſrael hath done? she hath gone of herſelf vpon euerie high mountaine, and vnder euerie thicke greene tree, and hath fornicated there.
label: Jeremy

text: And I ſaid, when she had done al theſe thinges: Returne to me, and she returned not. And Iuda her tranſgreſſing ſiſter ſaw,
label: Jeremy

text: becauſe the rebel Iſrael had plaied the harlot, I had put her away, and geuen her a bil of diuorce: and Iuda her tranſgreſſing ſiſter was not afrayd, but went and plaid the harlot alſo herſelf.
label: Jeremy

text: And with the facilitie of her fornication she contaminated the land, and plaid the harlot with ſtone and wood.
label: Jeremy

text: And in al theſe thinges Iuda her tranſgreſſing ſiſter hath not returned to me in her whole hart, but in falſehood, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: And our Lord ſaid to me: The rebellious Iſrael hath iuſtified her ſoule, in compariſon of the tranſgreſſour Iuda.
label: Jeremy

text: Goe, and crie theſe wordes againſt the North, and thou shalt ſay: Returne ô rebellious Iſrael, ſaith our Lord, and I wil not returne away my face from you: becauſe I am holie, ſaith our Lord, and I wil not be angrie for euer.
label: Jeremy

text: But yet know thou thine iniquitie, that thou haſt tranſgreſſed againſt the Lord thy God: and thou haſt diſperſed thy waies to ſtrangers vnder euerie thicke greene tree, and haſt not heard my voice, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Returne ô ye reuolting children, ſaith our Lord: becauſe I am your husband: and I wil take you one of a citie, and two of a kinred, and wil bring you into Sion.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil geue you paſtours according to my hart, and they shal feede you with knowlege and doctrine.
label: Jeremy

text: And when you shal be multiplied, and increaſe in the land in thoſe daies, ſaith our Lord, they shal ſay no more: The Arke of the teſtament of our Lord: neither shal it aſcend vpon their hart, neither shal they be mindeful thereof, neither shal it be viſited, neither shal that be done anie more.
label: Jeremy

text: In that time Ieruſalem shal be called the throne of our Lord: and al Gentiles shal be gathered together to it, in the name of our Lord into Ieruſalem, & they shal not walke after the peruerſitie of their moſt wicked hart.
label: Jeremy

text: In thoſe daies the houſe of Iuda shal goe to the houſe of Iſrael, and they shal come together from the land of the North to the land, which I gaue to your fathers.
label: Jeremy

text: But I ſaid: How shal I make thee as children, and geue thee a land worthie to be deſired, the goodlie inheritance of the hoſtes of the Gentiles? And I ſaid: Thou shalt cal me father, & shalt not ceaſe to walke after me.
label: Jeremy

text: But as if a woman should contemne her louer, ſo hath the houſe of Iſrael contemned me, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: A voice was heard in the waies, weeping & howling of the children of Iſrael: becauſe they haue made their way vniuſt, they haue forgotten our Lord their God.
label: Jeremy

text: Returne ye reuolting children, and I wil heale your reuoltinges. Behold we come to thee: for thou art the Lord our God.
label: Jeremy

text: In verie deede the litle hilles were lyars, and the multitude of the mountaines: verily in the Lord our God is the ſaluation of Iſrael.
label: Jeremy

text: Confuſion hath eaten the labour of our fathers from our youth, their flockes, and their heards, their ſonnes, and their daughters.
label: Jeremy

text: We shal ſleepe in our confuſion, and our ignominie shal couer vs, becauſe we haue ſinned to the Lord our God, we, and our fathers from our youth euen to this day: and we haue not heard the voice of the Lord our God.
label: Jeremy

text: IF thou wilt returne ô Iſrael, ſaith our Lord, returne to me: if thou wilt take away thy ſtumbling blockes from my face, thou shalt not be moued.
label: Jeremy

text: And thou shalt ſweare: Our Lord liueth, in truth, & in iudgement, and in iuſtice: and the Gentiles shal bleſſe him, & shal praiſe him.
label: Jeremy

text: For thus ſaith our Lord to the man of Iuda, and to Ieruſalem: Make vnto you new fallow ground, & ſow not vpon thornes:
label: Jeremy

text: be circumciſed to our Lord, and take away the prepuces of your hartes ye men of Iuda, and inhabitants of Ieruſalem: leſt perhapes mine indignation goe forth as fire, and be kindled, and there be none that can quench it: becauſe of the malice of your cogitations.
label: Jeremy

text: Declare ye in Iuda, and make it heard in Ieruſalem: ſpeake, and ſound with the trumpet in the land: crie ſtrongly, and ſay: Aſſemble yourſelues, and let vs enter into the fenced cities,
label: Jeremy

text: lift vp the ſigne in Sion. Take courege, ſtand not, becauſe I do bring euil from the North, ad great deſtruction.
label: Jeremy

text: The lyon is come vp out of his denne, and the robber of the Gentiles hath lifted vp himſelfe: he is come forth out of his place, that he may make thy land as a wildernes: thy cities shal be waſted, remayning without an inhabiter.
label: Jeremy

text: For this gird yourſelues with clothes of heare, mourne and howle: becauſe the wrath of the furie of our Lord is not turned away from vs.
label: Jeremy

text: And it shal be in that day, ſaith our Lord: The hart of the king shal perish, & the hart of the princes: and the prieſts shal be aſtonied, and the prophets shal be amaſed.
label: Jeremy

text: And I ſaid: Alas, alas, alas, ô Lord God, haſt thou then deceiued this people and Ieruſalem, ſaying: You shal haue peace: and behold the ſword hath come euen to the ſoule?
label: Jeremy

text: At that time it shal be ſaid to this people, & to Ieruſalem: A burning wind in the waies, that are in the deſert of the way of the daughter of my people, not to fanne, and to purge.
label: Jeremy

text: A ful ſpirit from theſe shal come to me: and now I wil ſpeake my iudgement with them.
label: Jeremy

text: Behold he shal come in a cloude, and his chariots as a tempeſt: his horſes are ſwifter then eagles: woe vnto vs, becauſe we are deſtroyed.
label: Jeremy

text: Wash thy hart from malice ô Ieruſalem, that thou maiſt be ſaued: how long shal hurtful cogitations abide in thee?
label: Jeremy

text: For a voice of one declaring from Dan, and notifying the idol from mount Ephraim.
label: Jeremy

text: Say ye to the Gentiles: loe it is heard in Ieruſalem, that there come keepers from a farre countrie, & ſound their voice vpon the cities of Iuda.
label: Jeremy

text: They are ſet vpon her round about, as the keepers of fildes: becauſe she hath prouoked me to wrath, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Thy waies, and thy cogitations haue done theſe thinges to thee: this thy malice, becauſe it is bitter, becauſe it hath touched thy hart.
label: Jeremy

text: My bellie, my belly aketh, the ſenſes of my hart are trubled in me, I wil not hold my peace, becauſe my ſoule hath heard the voice of the trumpet, the crie of battel.
label: Jeremy

text: Deſtruction is called vpon deſtruction and al the earth is waſted: my tentes are waſted quickly, ſodenly my skinnes.
label: Jeremy

text: How long shal I ſee one that fleeth away, shal I heare the voice of the trumpet?
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe my foolish people haue not knowen me: they are vnwiſe children, and without witte: they are wiſe to do euils, but to doe wel they haue not knowen.
label: Jeremy

text: I beheld the earth, and loe it was voide, and a thing of nothing: and the heauens, & there was no light in them.
label: Jeremy

text: I ſaw the mountaines, & loe they were moued: & al the little hilles were trubled.
label: Jeremy

text: I beheld, and there was not a man: and euerie ſoule of the aire was departed.
label: Jeremy

text: I looked, and behold Carmel made deſert: and al the cities therof were deſtroyed at the face of our Lord, and at the face of the wrath of his furie.
label: Jeremy

text: For thus ſaith our Lord: Al the land shal be deſolate, but yet I wil not make a conſummation.
label: Jeremy

text: The earth shal mourne, and the heauens shal lament from aboue: becauſe I haue ſpoken, I haue purpoſed, and it hath not repented me, neither am I turned away from it.
label: Jeremy

text: At the voice of the horſeman, and the archer, al the citie is fled: they haue entred into high places, and haue climed the rocks: al the cities are forſaken, and there dwelleth not a man in them.
label: Jeremy

text: But thou being waſted, what wilt thou doe? when thou shalt clothe thy ſelfe in ſcarlet, when thou shalt be adorned with golden iewels, & shalt paint thine eies with ſtibikeſtone, thou shalt be trimmed in vaine: thy louers haue contemned thee, they wil ſeeke thy life.
label: Jeremy

text: For I haue heard the voice as of a traueling woman, anguishes as of a woman in labour of child. The voice of the daughter of Sion, amongſt them that dye, and ſtretch forth their handes: woe is me, becauſe my ſoule hath fainted for them that are ſlaine.
label: Jeremy

text: GOE round about the wayes of Ieruſalem, and looke, and conſider, and ſeeke in the ſtreetes therof, whether you can finde a man that doth iudgements, and ſeeketh fidelitie: & I wil be propicious vnto him.
label: Jeremy

text: Yea if they ſay: Our Lord liueth this alſo they wil ſweare falſely.
label: Jeremy

text: O Lord thyne eies regard fidelitie: thou haſt ſtriken them, & they were not ſorie: thou haſt broken them, and they haue refuſed to receiue diſcipline: they haue hardned their faces more then the rocke, and they would not returne.
label: Jeremy

text: But I ſaid: Perhaps they are poore & foolish, not knowing the way of the Lord, the iudgement of their God.
label: Jeremy

text: I wil go therfore to the great men, & wil ſpeake to them: for they haue knowen the way of their Lord: & behold theſe altogether haue more broken the yoke, haue burſt the bondes.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore hath the lion out of the wood ſtriken them, the woolf in the euening hath waſted them, the leopard watching vpon their citties: euerie one of them that shal come forth, shal be taken, becauſe their preuarications are multiplied, their reuoltinges are ſtrengthned.
label: Jeremy

text: Wherupon can I be propicious to thee? thy children haue forſaken me, and ſweare by them, that are not goddes: I filled them, & they committed aduoutrie, and did riotouſly in the harlots houſe.
label: Jeremy

text: They are become as amarous horſes, and ſtalions: euerie one neyed at his neighbours wife:
label: Jeremy

text: VVhy, shal I not viſite vpon theſe thinges, ſaith our Lord? and on ſuch a nation shal not my ſoule take reuenge?
label: Jeremy

text: Scale the walles therof, and diſſipate them, but make not a conſummation: take away the branches therof, becauſe they are not the Lordes.
label: Jeremy

text: For by preuarication hath the houſe of Iſrael preuaricated againſt me, & the houſe of Iuda, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: They haue denied our Lord, and ſaied: It is not he: neither shal the euil come vpon vs: we shal not ſee ſword & famine.
label: Jeremy

text: The prophets haue ſpoken into the wind, & there was no anſwer in them: theſe things therfore shal happen to them.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith our Lord the God of hoſtes: Becauſe you haue ſpoken this word: behold, I geue my wordes in thy mouth as fire, & this people as ſtickes, and it shal deuoure them.
label: Jeremy

text: Behold I wil bring vpon you a nation from a far ô houſe of Iſrael, ſaith our Lord: a ſtrong nation, an ancient nation, a nation whoſe tongue thou shalt not know, nor vnderſtand what it ſpeaketh.
label: Jeremy

text: The quiuer thereof is as an open ſepulcher, they are al ſtrong.
label: Jeremy

text: And it shal eate thy corne, and thy bread: it shal deuoure thy ſonnes, and thy daughters: it shal eate thy flocke, & thy heards: it shal eate thy vineyard, and thy figge: & it shal deſtroy thy fenced cities, wherein thou haſt confidence, with the ſword.
label: Jeremy

text: But yet in thoſe daies, ſaith our Lord: I wil not bring you into conſummation.
label: Jeremy

text: And if you shal ſay: Why hath the Lord our God done al theſe thinges to vs? thou shalt ſay to them: As you haue forſaken me, and ſerued a ſtrange god in your owne land, ſo shal you ſerue ſtrange ones in a land not your owne.
label: Jeremy

text: Declare ye this to the houſe of Iacob, and make it heard in Iuda, ſaying:
label: Jeremy

text: Heare thou foolish people, that haſt no hart, which hauing eies, ſeeſt not: and eares, and heareſt not.
label: Jeremy

text: Me then wil you not feare, ſaith our Lord: and at my preſence wil ye not be ſorie? Who haue ſet the ſand a limitie for the ſea, an euerlaſting precept, that shal not paſſe, and they shal be moued, and shal not preuaile: and the waues therof shal ſwel, and shal not paſſe ouer it.
label: Jeremy

text: But to this people their hart is become incredulous and exaſperating, they are reuolted and departed.
label: Jeremy

text: And they haue not ſaid in their hart: Let vs feare the Lord our God, who geueth vs the timely and lateward rayne in due ſeaſon: who preſerueth the fulnes of the yearly harueſt vnto vs.
label: Jeremy

text: Your iniquities haue turned away theſe thinges, and your ſinnes haue ſtayed good from you.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe there are found impious men in my people, that lye in wate as foulers ſetting ſnares & trappes to take men.
label: Jeremy

text: As a net ful of birdes, ſo their houſes are ful of guile: therefore are they magnified, & enriched.
label: Jeremy

text: They are made groſſe and fatte: and haue tranſgreſſed my wordes moſt wickedly. The cauſe of the widow they haue not iudged; the cauſe of the pupil they haue not directed, and the iudgement of the poore they haue not iudged.
label: Jeremy

text: Shal I not viſite vpon theſe thinges, ſaith our Lord? or vpon ſuch a nation shal not my ſoule take reuenge?
label: Jeremy

text: Aſtonishment and meruelous thinges are done in the land.
label: Jeremy

text: The prophets prophecied a lye, & the prieſts claped with their handes: and my people hath loued ſuch thinges: what shal be done therefore in the later end thereof?
label: Jeremy

text: TAKE courege ye children of Beniamin in the middes of Ieruſalem, and in Thecua ſound with the trumpet, & ouer Bethacarem lift vp the ſtandart: becauſe there is euil ſeene from the North, and great deſtruction.
label: Jeremy

text: I haue reſembled the daughter of Sion to a beautiful & delicate woman.
label: Jeremy

text: To her shal paſtours come, and their flockes: they haue pitcht tents in her round about: euerie one shal feede them that are vnder his hand.
label: Jeremy

text: Sanctifie ye battel vpon her: ariſe, and let vs go vp in the midday: wo vnto vs, becauſe the day is declined, becauſe the shaddowes of the euening are waxen longer.
label: Jeremy

text: Ariſe, and let vs goe vp in the night, and deſtroy her houſes.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe thus ſaith the Lord of boſtes: Hew downe her wood, caſt a trench about Ieruſalem: this is the citie of viſitation, al oppreſſion is in the middes thereof.
label: Jeremy

text: As a ceſterne maketh colde the water therof, ſo hath she made colde her malice: iniquitie and ſpoile shal be heard in her, infirmitie and plague alwaies before me.
label: Jeremy

text: Be thou taught Ieruſalem, leſt perhaps my ſoule depart from thee, leſt perhaps I make thee a deſert land not habitable.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſts: Euen to one cluſter shal they gather as in a vineyard the remaines of Iſrael, turne back thy hand, as the grapegatherer to the basket.
label: Jeremy

text: To whom shal I ſpeake? and whom shal I conteſt, that he may heare? behold, their eares are vncircumciſed, and they can not heare: behold the word of our Lord is become vnto them as a reproche: and they wil not receiue it.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore am I ful of the furie of our Lord, I haue laboured ſuſtayning: power out vpon the litle one without, and vpon the counſel of the yong men together: for man with woman shal be taken, the ancient with him that is ful of daies.
label: Jeremy

text: And their houſes shal paſſe to others, their landes and wiues together: becauſe I wil extend my hand vpon the inhabitants of the land, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: For from the leſſer euen to the greater, al ſtudie auarice: and from the prophets euen to the prieſt, al commit guile.
label: Jeremy

text: And they cured the deſtruction of the daughter of my people with ignominie, ſaying: Peace, peace: & there was not peace.
label: Jeremy

text: They were confounded, becauſe they did abomination: yea rather they were not confounded with confuſion, and they knew not how to blush, for the which thing, they shal fal among them that fal: in the time of their viſitation, they shal fal downe, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: Stand ye vpon the waies, and ſee, and aske of the old pathes, which is the good way, and walke ye in it: and you shal find refreshing for your ſoules. And they ſaid: We wil not walke.
label: Jeremy

text: And I appointed watchmen ouer you. Heare yee the voice of the trumpet. And they ſaid: We wil not heare.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore heare ye, ô Gentiles, and thou congregation know, what great thinges I wil doe to them.
label: Jeremy

text: Heare ô earth: Behold I wil bring euils vpon this people, the fruites of their cogitations: becauſe they haue not heard my wordes, and they haue caſt of my law.
label: Jeremy

text: To what purpoſe bring you me frankencenſe from Saba, and the ſweete ſmelling cane from a farre countrie? your holocauſtes are not acceptable, and your victimes haue not pleaſed me.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore thus ſaith our Lord: Behold I wil bring ruine vpon this people, & the fathers with the children shal fal in them together, neighbour and neighbour, and they shal perish.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: Behold there cometh a people from the land of the North, & a great nation shal ariſe vp from the endes of the earth.
label: Jeremy

text: It shal take arrow and shild: it is cruel, and wil haue no mercie. The voice thereof shal ſound as the ſea: & they shal mount vpon horſes, prepared as a man to battel, againſt thee ô daughter of Sion.
label: Jeremy

text: We haue heard the fame thereof, our handes are diſſolued: tribulation hath caught vs, ſorowes as a woman in trauel.
label: Jeremy

text: Goe not out to the fieldes and walke not in the way: becauſe the ſword of the enemie is feare round about.
label: Jeremy

text: Be girded with ſackcloth ô daughter of my people, & be ſprinkled with ashes: make thee a bitter lamentation as the mourning of the only begotten, becauſe the deſtroyer shal ſodenly come vpon vs.
label: Jeremy

text: I haue ſette thee a ſtrong prouer in my people: and thou shalt know, and proue their way.
label: Jeremy

text: Al theſe princes are declyning, walking deceitfully, braſſe and yron: they are al corrupted.
label: Jeremy

text: The bellowes haue failed, the lead is conſumed in the fire, the founder hath melted in vaine: for their malices are not conſumed.
label: Jeremy

text: Cal ye them reprobate ſiluer, becauſe our Lord hath reiected them.
label: Jeremy

text: THE word, that was made to Ieremie from our Lord, ſaying:
label: Jeremy

text: Stand in the gate of the houſe of the Lord, and preach there this word, and ſay: Heare ye the word of our Lord al Iuda, which goe in by theſe gates, to adore our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſtes the God of Iſrael: Make your wayes good, and your ſtudies: and I wil dwel with you in this place.
label: Jeremy

text: Truſt not in wordes of lying, ſaying: The temple of our Lord, the temple of our Lord, it is the temple of our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: For if you shal wel direct your waies, & your ſtudies: if you shal doe iudgement between a man and his neighbour,
label: Jeremy

text: to the ſtranger, & to the pupil, & to the widow shal do no oppreſſion, nor shede innocent bloud in this place, & walke not after ſtrange godds to your owne euil:
label: Jeremy

text: I wil dwel with you in this place: in the land, which I gaue to your fathers from the beginning and for euer.
label: Jeremy

text: Behold you truſt to your ſelues in wordes of lying: which shal not profite you:
label: Jeremy

text: to ſteale, to murder, to committe aduouterie, to ſweare falſely, to offer to Baalim, & to go after ſtrange godds, which you know not.
label: Jeremy

text: And you haue come, and ſtood before me in this houſe, in which my name is inuocated, and haue ſaid: We are deliuered becauſe we haue done al theſe abominations.
label: Jeremy

text: Why, is this houſe then wherein my name is inuocated, in your eies become a denne of theeues? I, euen I am: I haue ſeene, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Goe ye to my place in Silo, where my name dwelt from the beginning: and ſee what I haue done to it for the malice of my people Iſrael:
label: Jeremy

text: and now, becauſe you haue done al theſe workes, ſaith our Lord: and I haue ſpoken to you early riſing, and ſpeaking, and you haue not heard: and I haue called you, and you haue not anſwered:
label: Jeremy

text: I wil doe to this houſe, wherein my name is inuocated, and wherein you haue confidence: and to the place which I haue geuen you and your fathers, as I did to Silo.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil caſt you away from my face, as I haue caſt away al your bretheren, the whole ſeede of Ephraim.
label: Jeremy

text: Thou therefore pray not for this people, neither take vnto thee praiſe and prayer for them, and reſiſt me not: becauſe I wil not heare thee.
label: Jeremy

text: Seeſt thou not what theſe doe in the cities of Iuda, and in the ſtreete of Ieruſalem?
label: Jeremy

text: The children gather the ſtickes, & the fathers kindle the fire, and the wemen temper the dough to make cakes vnto the queene of heauen, & to offer libaments vnto ſtrange goddes, and to prouoke me to wrath.
label: Jeremy

text: Why doe they prouoke me to wrath, ſaith our Lord? and not themſelues to the confuſion of their owne countenance?
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore this ſaith our Lord God: Behold my furie, and my indignation is powred vpon this place, vpon men, and vpon beaſtes, and vpon the wood of the countrie, and vpon the fruites of the land, and it shal be kindled, and shal not be quenched.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſtes the God of Iſrael; Adde your holocauſtes to your victims, and eate ye the flesh.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe I ſpake not with your fathers, & I commanded them not in the day, that I brought them out of the land of Ægypt, touching the word of holocauſtes and victims.
label: Jeremy

text: But this word I commanded them, ſaying: Heare ye my voice, and I wil be your God, and you shal be my people: and walke ye in al the way, that I haue commanded you, that it may be wel with you.
label: Jeremy

text: And they heard not, nor inclined their eare: but haue gone in their pleaſures, and in the peruerſitie of their wicked hart: and haue bene made backward and not foreward,
label: Jeremy

text: from the day that their fathers came out of the land of Ægypt, euen to this day. And I haue ſent to you al my ſeruants the prophetes by day, riſing early, and ſending.
label: Jeremy

text: And they haue not heard me, nor inclined their eare: but they haue hardened their necke, and haue wrought worſe, then their fathers.
label: Jeremy

text: And thou ſhalt ſpeake vnto them al theſe wordes, & they wil not heare thee: & thou shalt cal them, and they wil not anſwere thee.
label: Jeremy

text: And thou shalt ſay to them: This is the nation which hath not heard the voice of the Lord their God, nor receiued diſcipline: faith is perished, and is taken away out of their mouth.
label: Jeremy

text: Powle thy heare, & caſt it away, and take lamentation on hiegh: becauſe our Lord hath caſt of, and hath left the generation of his furie,
label: Jeremy

text: becauſe the children of Iuda haue done euil in mine eies, ſaith our Lord. They haue put their ſtumbling blockes in the houſe, wherin my name is inuocated, that they might pollute it:
label: Jeremy

text: and they haue built the excelſes of Topheth, which is in the valley of the ſonne of Ennom, that they might burne their ſonnes, and their daughters with fire: which thinges I commanded not, nor thought in my hart.
label: Jeremy

text: Therfore loe the daies shal come, ſaith our Lord, & it shal no more be ſaid: Topheth, and the valley of the ſonne of Ennom: but the valley of ſlaughter: and They shal burie in Topheth, becauſe there is no place.
label: Jeremy

text: And the carcaſſe of this people shal be for meats to the foules of the ayre, and to the beaſtes of the land, and there shal be none to driue them away.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil make to ceaſe out of the cities of Iuda, and out of the ſtreetes of Ieruſalem, the voice of ioy, and the voice of gladnes, the voice of the bridegroome, and the voice of the bride: for the land shal be in deſolation.
label: Jeremy

text: AT THAT time, ſaith our Lord, they wil caſt out the bones of the kinges of Iuda, and the bones of the princes thereof, and the bones of prieſts, and the bones of the Prophets, and the bones of them that inhabite Ieruſalem; out of their ſepulchers.
label: Jeremy

text: And they shal ſpread them abrode in the ſunne, and the moone, and al the hoſt of heauen, which they haue loued, and which they haue ſerued, and after which they haue walked, and which they haue ſought, and adored: they shal not be gathered, and they shal not be buried: they shal be as a dunghil vpon the face of the earth.
label: Jeremy

text: And they shal chooſe rather death then life, al that shal be remaining of this wicked kinred in al places, which are left, to the which I haue caſt them out, ſaith the Lord of hoſtes.
label: Jeremy

text: And thou shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith our Lord: Shal not he that falleth riſe againe? and he that is turned away, shal he not turne againe?
label: Jeremy

text: Why then is this people in Ieruſalem turned away with a contentious reuolting? they haue apprehended lying, and would not returne.
label: Jeremy

text: I attended, and harkned: no man ſpeaketh that which is good, there is none that doth penance for his ſinne, ſaying: What haue I done? They are al turned to their owne courſe, as an horſe going with violence to battel.
label: Jeremy

text: The kite in the heauen hath knowen her time: the turtle, and the ſwalow, and the ſtorke haue obſerued the time of their coming but my people haue not knowen the iudgement of the Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: How ſay you: We are wiſe, and the law of our Lord is with vs? In very deede the lying penne of the Scribes hath wrought lying.
label: Jeremy

text: The wiſe are confounded, they are terrified & taken: for they haue caſt away the word of our Lord, and there is no wiſedom in them.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore wil I geue their wemen to ſtrangers, their fildes to inheritours: becauſe from the leaſt euen to the greateſt al folow auarice: from the prophet euen to the prieſt al make lies.
label: Jeremy

text: And they healed the deſtruction of the daughter of my people to ignominie, ſaying: Peace, peace, when there was not peace.
label: Jeremy

text: They are confounded, becauſe they haue done abomination: yea rather they are not confounded with confuſion, and they haue not knowen how to blush: therefore shal they fal among them that fal, in the time of their viſitation they shal fal, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Gathering I wil gather them together, ſaith our Lord, there is no grape in the vines, and there are no figges on the figtree, the leafe is fallen downe: and I haue geuen them the thinges that are paſſed.
label: Jeremy

text: Why doe we ſitte? come together and let vs enter into the fenced citie, and let vs be ſilent there: becauſe the Lord our God hath made vs to be ſilent, and hath geuen vs water of gaule for drinke: for we haue ſinned to our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: We expected peace and there was no good: a time of medicine and behold feare.
label: Jeremy

text: From Dan was the ſnoring noyſe of his horſes heard, with the voice of the neyinges of his fighting horſes al the land was moued: and they came and deuoured the land, and the fulnes thereof: the citie and the inhabitants thereof.
label: Jeremy

text: For behold I wil ſend you ſerpents baſaliskes, for which there is no inchantment: and they shal bite you, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: My ſorow is aboue ſorow, my hart mourning within me.
label: Jeremy

text: Behold the voice of the daughter of my people from a farre countrie: Is not our Lord in Sion: or is not her king in her? Why then haue they prouoked me to wrath in their ſculptils, and in ſtrange vanities?
label: Jeremy

text: The harueſt is paſt, ſommer is ended: and we are not ſaued.
label: Jeremy

text: For the affliction of the daughter of my people I am afflicted, and made ſorowful, aſtonishment hath taken me.
label: Jeremy

text: Is there noe roſen in Galaad? or is there no phiſition there? Why then is not the wound of the daughter of my people cloſed?
label: Jeremy

text: WHO wil geue water to my head, and to mine eies a fountaine of teares? and I wil weepe day & night for the ſlaine of the daughter of my people.
label: Jeremy

text: Who wil geue me in the wildernes an inne of wayfaring men, and I wil forſake my people, and depart from them? becauſe they are al adulterers, an aſſemblie of tranſgreſſors.
label: Jeremy

text: And they haue bent their tongue, as a bowe of lying and not of truth: they haue taken courege in the land, becauſe they haue proceeded from euil to euil, and me they haue not knowen, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Let euerie man take heede to himſelf of his neighbour, and in euerie brother of his, let him not haue affiance: becauſe euerie brother ſupplanting wil ſupplant, and euerie freind wil walke deceitfully.
label: Jeremy

text: And man shal ſcorne his brother, and they wil not ſpeake truth: for they haue taught their tongue to ſpeake lies: they haue laboured to doe vniuſtly.
label: Jeremy

text: Thine inhabitation is in the middes of deceipt: in deceipte they haue refuſed to know me, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore thus ſaith the Lord of hoſtes: Behold I wil melt, and wil trie them: for what els shal I doe at the face of the daughter of my people?
label: Jeremy

text: Their tongue is a wandring arrow, it hath ſpoken guile: in his mouth he hath ſpoken peace with his freind, and ſecretly he layeth waite for him.
label: Jeremy

text: Shal I not viſite vpon theſe thinges, ſaith our Lord? or vpon ſuch a nation shal not my ſoule be reuenged?
label: Jeremy

text: Vpon the mountaines I wil take vp weeping and lamentation, & vpon the beautiful places of the deſert, mourning: becauſe they are burnt, for that there is not a man that paſſeth through: & they haue not heard the voice of the owner: from the foule of the ayre vnto the beaſtes they are gone away and departed.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil make Ieruſalem to be heapes of ſand, and dennes of dragons: and I wil geue the cities of Iuda into deſolation, becauſe there is not an inhabiter.
label: Jeremy

text: Who is a wiſe man, that can vnderſtand this, and to whom the word of the mouth of our Lord may be made, that he may declare this, why the earth hath perished, and is burnt as a deſert, becauſe there is none that paſſeth through?
label: Jeremy

text: And our Lord ſaid: Becauſe they haue forſaken my law, which I gaue them, and haue not heard my voice, and haue not walked in it.
label: Jeremy

text: And they haue gone after the peruerſitie of their owne hart, and after Baalim, which they learned of their fathers.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore thus ſaith the Lord of hoſtes the God of Iſrael: Behold I wil feede this people with wormewood, and geue them water of gaule to drinke.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil diſperſe them in the Nations, which they and their fathers haue not knowen: and I wil ſend the ſword after them, til they be conſumed.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſtes the God of Iſrael: Conſider and cal ye lamenting wemen, and let them come: & ſend to them that are wiſe, and let them make haſte:
label: Jeremy

text: let them haſten & take vp a lamentation vpon vs: let our eies shede teares, & our eielids runne downe with waters.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe a voice of lamentation is heard from Sion; How are we waſted and confounded exceedingly? becauſe we haue left the land, becauſe our tabernacles are caſt downe.
label: Jeremy

text: Heare therefore ye wemen the word of our Lord: and let your eares take of the word of his mouth: and teach your daughters lamentation: and euerie one her neighbour mourning:
label: Jeremy

text: for death is come vp through our windowes, it is entred into our houſes, to deſtroy the children from without, the young men out of the ſtreetes.
label: Jeremy

text: Speake: Thus ſaith our Lord: And the carcaſſe of man shal fal as dung vpon the face of the countrie, and as a graſſe behind the backe of the mower, and there is none to gather it.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: Let not the wiſeman glorie in his wiſedom, and let not the ſtrong man glorie in his ſtrength, & let not the rich man glorie in his riches:
label: Jeremy

text: but he that glorieth, let him glorie in this, to vnderſtand & know me, becauſe I am the Lord that do mercie and iudgement, and iuſtice in the earth: for theſe thinges pleaſe me, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Behold, the daies come, ſaith our Lord; and I wil viſite vpon euerie one, that hath the prepuce circumciſed,
label: Jeremy

text: vpon Ægypt, and vpon Iuda, and vpon Edom, and vpon the children of Ammon, and vpon Moab, and vpon al that haue their heare powled, dwelling in the deſert: becauſe al nations haue the prepuce, but al the houſe of Iſrael are vncircumciſed in the hart.
label: Jeremy

text: HEARE ye the word, which our Lord hath ſpoken concerning you ô houſe of Iſrael.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: According to the waies of the Gentils learne not: and of the ſignes of heauen, which the heathen feare, be not afraid:
label: Jeremy
