text: Thus ſaith our Lord: Behold I wil deliuer Pharao Ephree the king of Ægypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that ſeeke his life: as I haue deliuered Sedecias the king of Iuda into the hand of Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon his enemie, and that ſeeketh his life.
label: Jeremy

text: THE word, that Ieremie ſpake to Baruch the ſonne of Nerias, when he had written theſe wordes in a booke, from the mouth of Ieremie, in the fourth yeare of Ioakim the ſonne of Ioſias king of Iuda, ſaying:
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith our Lord the God of Iſrael to thee Baruch:
label: Jeremy

text: Thou haſt ſaid: Woe is me wretch, becauſe our Lord hath added ſorow to my ſorow: I haue laboured in my mourning, and haue not found reſt.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: Thus shalt thou ſay to him: Behold, them whom I haue builded, I doe deſtroy: and whom I haue planted, I doe pluck vp, and al this land.
label: Jeremy

text: And doeſt thou ſeeke to thy ſelf great thinges? Seeke not: for behold I wil bring euil vpon al flesh, ſaith our Lord: and I wil geue thee thy life into ſafetie in al places, whither ſoeuer thou shalt goe.
label: Jeremy

text: THE word of our Lord that was made to Ieremie the prophet againſt the Gentiles,
label: Jeremy

text: to Ægypt againſt the armie of Pharao Nechao the king of Ægypt, which was beſide the riuer Euphrates in Charcamis, whom Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon ſtroke, in the fourth yeare of Ioakim the ſonne of Ioſias king of Iuda.
label: Jeremy

text: Prepare ye shild, and buckler, and goe forth to battel.
label: Jeremy

text: Yoke horſes, & mount ye horſemen: ſtand in helmets, furbish the ſpeares, put on coates of maile.
label: Jeremy

text: What then? I ſaw them feareful, and turning their backes, their valiants ſlaine: they fled in haſt, neither looked they backe: terrour on euerie ſide, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Let not the ſwift flee, nor the ſtrong thincke that he is ſafe: Toward the North by the riuer Euphrates they were ouercome, and fel downe.
label: Jeremy

text: Who is this that riſeth vp as a floud: and as it were of riuers, ſo his ſtreames doe ſwel?
label: Jeremy

text: Ægypt riſeth vp like a floud, and the waues thereof shal be moued as riuers, and shal ſay: Ryſing vp I wil couer the earth: I wil deſtroy citie, and the inhabitants thereof.
label: Jeremy

text: Get ye vp on horſes, & in chariots, and let the valiants come forth, Æthiopia, and the Lybians holding the shilde, and the Lydeans taking, and shooting arrowes.
label: Jeremy

text: And that day of our Lord the God of hoſtes, is a day of reuenge, that they may take vengeance of his enemies: the ſword shal deuoure, and be filled, & shal be drunken with their bloud: for the victime of our Lord the God of hoſtes is in the Land of the North by the riuer Euphrates.
label: Jeremy

text: Goe vp into Galaad, and take reſine ô virgin the daughter of Ægypt: thou doeſt in vaine multiplie medicines, there shal not be health to thee.
label: Jeremy

text: The Gentiles haue heard thine ignominie, and thine howling hath filled the earth: becauſe the ſtrong hath ſtumbled againſt the ſtrong, and both are fallen together.
label: Jeremy

text: The word that our Lord ſpake to Ieremie the prophet, concerning this that Nabuchodonoſor king of Babylon should come and ſtrike the Land of Ægypt:
label: Jeremy

text: Tel Ægypt, and make it heard in Magdal, and let it ſound in Memphis, and in Taphnis: Say ye: Stand, and prepare thy ſelf: becauſe the ſword shal deuoure thoſe thinges, that be round about thee.
label: Jeremy

text: Why is thy valiant become rotten? he ſtood not: becauſe our Lord hath ouerthrowen him.
label: Jeremy

text: He hath multiplied them that fal, and man hath fallen againſt his neighbour, and they shal ſay: Ariſe, and let vs returne to our people, and to the Land of our natiuitie, from the face of the ſword of the doue.
label: Jeremy

text: Cal ye the name of Pharao the king of Aegypt, Tumult, Time hath brought it.
label: Jeremy

text: I liue (ſaith the king, the Lord of hoſtes is his name) that as Thabor in the mountaines, and as Carmel in the ſea, he shal come.
label: Jeremy

text: Make ye veſſels of tranſmigration ô daughter inhabitant of Aegypt: becauſe Memphis shal be in deſolation, and shal be forſaken, and shal be inhabitable.
label: Jeremy

text: Aegypt a trimme and beautiful heyfer: a pricker from the North, shal come to her.
label: Jeremy

text: Her hyrelings alſo that conuerſed in the middes of her, as fatted calues are turned, and are fled together, neither could they ſtand: becauſe the day of their ſlaughter came vpon them, the time of their viſitation.
label: Jeremy

text: Her voice shal ſound as if it were of braſſe, becauſe they shal haſten with an armie, and with axes they shal come to her, as it were cutting trees.
label: Jeremy

text: They haue cut downe her foreſt, ſaith our Lord, which can not be counted: they are multiplied aboue locuſtes, and are without number.
label: Jeremy

text: The daughter of Ægypt is confounded, & deliuered into the hand of the people of the North.
label: Jeremy

text: The Lord of hoſtes the God of Iſrael hath ſaid: Behold I wil viſite vpon the tumult of Alexandria, and vpon Pharao, and vpon Ægypt, and vpon her goddes, and vpon her kinges, and vpon Pharao, and vpon them that truſt in him.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil geue them into the hand of them that ſeeke their life, and into the hand of Nabuchodonoſor king of Babylon, and into the hand of his ſeruants: and after theſe thinges it shal be inhabited as in the daies of old, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: And thou my ſeruant Iacob feare not, and be not thou afraid Iſrael: becauſe loe I wil ſaue thee from a farre, and thy ſeede out of the land of thy captiuitie: and Iacob shal returne, and reſt, and proſper: and there shal be none to terrifie him.
label: Jeremy

text: And thou my ſeruant Iacob feare not, ſaith our Lord: becauſe I am with thee, becauſe I wil conſume al the nations, to the which I haue caſt thee out: but thee I wil not conſume, but I wil chaſten thee in iudgement, neither wil I ſpare thee as innocent.
label: Jeremy

text: THE word of our Lord that was made to Ieremie the prophet againſt the Paleſthines, before Pharao ſtroke Gaza:
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: Behold there come vp waters from the North, and they shal be as a torrent ouerflowing, and they shal couer the earth, and the fulnes thereof, the citie and the inhabitantes thereof: men shal crie, and al the inhabitantes of the land shal howle
label: Jeremy

text: at the noiſe of the pompe of the armour, and of his men of warre, at the commotion of his chariots, and the multitude of his wheeles. The fathers haue not reſpected the children, being of diſſolute handes,
label: Jeremy

text: for the coming of the day, wherein al the Philiſthims shal be waſted, and Tyre, and Sidon shal be deſtroyed with al the reſt of their aydes. For our Lord hath ſpoyled the Paleſthines, the remnant of the ile of Cappadocia.
label: Jeremy

text: Baldnes is come vpon Gaza. Aſcalon hath held her peace, and the remnant of her valley; how long shalt thou be hewed?
label: Jeremy

text: O ſword of our Lord how long wilt thou not be quiet? Get thee into thy ſcabbard, be cooled, and be ſtil.
label: Jeremy

text: How shal it be quiet when our Lord hath commanded it againſt Aſcalon, and againſt the countries thereof by the ſea ſide, and there hath made appointment with it?
label: Jeremy

text: TO Moab thus ſaith the Lord of hoſtes the God of Iſrael: Woe vpon Nabo, becauſe it is waſted, and confounded: Cariathaim is taken: the ſtrong one is confounded, and hath trembled.
label: Jeremy

text: There is no more reioycing in Moab: againſt Heſebon they haue thought euil. Come, and let vs deſtroy it from being a nation. therefore shalt thou in ſilence hold thy peace, and the ſword shal folow thee.
label: Jeremy

text: The voice of a crie from Oronaim: waſte, and great deſtruction.
label: Jeremy

text: Moab is deſtroyed: proclaime a crie to her children.
label: Jeremy

text: For by the aſcent of Luith shal the mourner goe vp in weeping: becauſe in the deſcent of Oronaim the enemies haue heard the howling of deſtruction:
label: Jeremy

text: Flee, ſaue your liues: and you shal be as heath in the deſert.
label: Jeremy

text: For that thou haſt had confidence in thy munitions, and in thy treaſures, thou alſo shalt be taken: and Chamos shal goe into tranſmigration, his prieſts, and his princes together.
label: Jeremy

text: And the ſpoyler shal come to euerie citie, and no citie shal be ſaued: and the valleys shal perish, and the champaine countries shal be deſtroyed: becauſe our Lord hath ſaid:
label: Jeremy

text: Geue ye the floure to Moab, becauſe florishing it shal goe out: and her cities shal be deſolate, & inhabitable.
label: Jeremy

text: Curſed be he that doeth the worke of our Lord fraudulently: and curſed that ſtayeth his ſword from bloud.
label: Jeremy

text: Moab hath bene fruitful from his youth, and hath reſted in his dregges: neither hath he bene powred out of veſſel into veſſel, and hath not gone into tranſmigration: therefore hath his taſte remained in him, and his ſauour is not changed.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore behold the daies come, ſaith our Lord: and I wil ſend vnto him thoſe that shal order and diſpoſe of his pottes, and they shal ouerthrow him, and shal emptie his veſſels, and dash their pottes one againſt an other.
label: Jeremy

text: And Moab shal be ashamed of Chamos, as the houſe of Iſrael was ashamed of Bethel, wherein it had confidence.
label: Jeremy

text: How ſay ye: We are valiant, and ſtrong men to fight?
label: Jeremy

text: Moab is waſted, & her cities they haue caſt downe: and her choſen yongmen are gone downe into ſlaughter: ſaith the king, the Lord of hoſtes is his name.
label: Jeremy

text: The deſtruction of Moab is nigh to come: the euil thereof shal come exceeding ſwiftly.
label: Jeremy

text: Comfort him al ye that are round about him, and al you that know his name, ſay: How is the ſtrong rod broken, the glorious ſtaffe?
label: Jeremy

text: Come downe from thy glorie, and ſit in drought ô habitation of the daughter of Dibon: becauſe the waſter of Moab shal come vp to thee, he shal deſtroy thy munitions.
label: Jeremy

text: Stand in the way, and looke ô habitation of Aroer: aske of him that fleeth: and ſay to him that hath eſcaped: What is chanced?
label: Jeremy

text: Moab is confounded, becauſe he is ouercome: howle ye, and crie, declare in Arnon, that Moab is waſted.
label: Jeremy

text: And iudgement is come to the champaine countrie: vpon Helon, and vpon Iaſa, and vpon Mephaath,
label: Jeremy

text: and vpon Dibon, and vpon Nabo, & vpon the houſe of Deblathaim,
label: Jeremy

text: and vpon Cariathaim, and vpon Bethgamul, and vpon Bethmaon,
label: Jeremy

text: and vpon Carioth, and vpon Boſra: and vpon al the cities of the Land of Moab, that are far, and neere.
label: Jeremy

text: The horne of Moab is cut of, and his arme is broken, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Make him drunken, becauſe he is erected againſt our Lord: and Moab shal wring his hand in his vomiting, and him ſelf alſo shal be in deriſion.
label: Jeremy

text: For Iſrael hath bene in deriſion vnto thee: as though thou hadſt found him amongſt theeues: for thy wordes therefore, which thou haſt ſpoken againſt him, thou shalt be led captiue.
label: Jeremy

text: Leaue the cities, and dwel in the rocke ye inhabitants of Moab, and be ye as a doue making her neſt in the higheſt mouth of the hole.
label: Jeremy

text: We haue heard the pride of Moab, he is proude excedingly: his haughtines, and arrogancie, and pride, and loftines of his hart.
label: Jeremy

text: I know, ſaith our Lord, his boſting: and that the ſtrength thereof is not according to it, neither hath it endeuoured to doe according to that which it was able.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore wil I waile vpon Moab, and to al Moab wil I crie, to the men of the earthen wal that lament.
label: Jeremy

text: Of the mourning of Iazer I wil weepe to thee ô vineyard of Sabama: thy branches haue paſſed ouer the ſea, they are come euen to the ſea of Iaſer: the ſpoiler hath violently entered vpon thine harueſt, and thy vintage.
label: Jeremy

text: Ioy and gladnes is taken away out of Carmel, and out of the Land of Moab, and the wine out of the preſſes I haue taken away: the treader of the grape shal not ſing the accuſtomed cheereful note.
label: Jeremy

text: From the crie of Heſebon vnto Eleale, and Iaſa, they haue geuen their voice: from Segor to Oronaim, an heyfer of three yeares old: the waters alſo of Nemrim shal be verie il.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil take away from Moab, ſaith our Lord, him that offereth in the excelſes, and that ſacrificeth to his goddes.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore shal my hart ſound to Moab as a shaulme: and my hart shal geue the ſound of shaulmes to the men of the earthen wal: becauſe he hath done more then he could, therefore haue they perished.
label: Jeremy

text: For euerie head baldnes, and euerie beard shal be shauen: in al handes binding together, and vpon euerie backe cloth of heare.
label: Jeremy

text: Vpon al the houſe toppes of Moab, and in the ſtreetes thereof al mourning: becauſe I haue broken Moab as an vnprofitable veſſel, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: How is it ouercome, and they haue howled? How hath Moab caſt downe the necke, and is confounded? And Moab shal be in deriſion, and for an example to al round about him.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: Behold he shal flee as an eagle, & shal ſtretch forth his winges to Moab.
label: Jeremy

text: Carioth is taken, and munitions are wonne: and the hart of the valiants of Moab in that day, shal be as the hart of a woman in trauel.
label: Jeremy

text: And Moab shal ceaſe to be a people: becauſe he hath gloried againſt our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Feare, and pitte, and ſnare vpon thee ô inhabiter of Moab, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: He that shal flee from the face of feare, shal fal into the pitte: and he that shal come vp out of the pitte, shal be taken in the ſnare: for I wil bring vpon Moab the yeare of their viſitation, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: They ſtoode in the shadow of Heſebon that fled from the ſnare: becauſe there came a fire out of Heſebon, and a flame out of the middes of Sehon, and it hath deuoured part of Moab, and the toppe of the children of tumult.
label: Jeremy

text: Woe to thee Moab, thou haſt perished ô people of Chamos: becauſe thy ſonnes are taken, and thy daughters into captiuitie.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil conuert the captiuitie of Moab in the laſt daies, ſaith our Lord. Hitherto the iudgements of Moab.
label: Jeremy

text: TO THE children of Ammon. Thus ſaith our Lord: Why, hath Iſrael no children? or hath he not an heire? Why then hath Melchom by inheritance poſſeſſed Gad: and his people dwelt in his cities?
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore behold the daies come ſaith our Lord: and I wil make the noiſe of battel to be heard vpon Rabbath the children of Ammon, and it shal be deſtroyed into an heape, and her daughters shal be burnt with fire, and Iſrael shal poſſeſſe his poſſeſſoures, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Howle Heſebon, becauſe Hai is waſted. Crie ye daughters of Rabbath, gird your ſelues with clothes of heare: mourne and goe about by the hedges: becauſe Melchom shal be led into tranſmigration, his prieſts, and his princes together.
label: Jeremy

text: What glorieſt thou in the valleis? thy valley hath flowed away ô delicate daughter, which didſt truſt in thy treaſures, and ſaidſt: Who shal come to me?
label: Jeremy

text: Behold I wil bring terrour vpon thee, ſaith our Lord the God of hoſtes, from al that are round about thee: and you shal be diſperſed euerie one from an others ſight, neither shal there be anie to gather together them that flee.
label: Jeremy

text: And after theſe thinges I wil make the captiues of the children of Ammon to returne, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: To Idumæa. Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſtes: Why is wiſedom no more in Theman? Counſel is perished from the children: their wiſedom is become vnprofitable.
label: Jeremy

text: Flee and turne your backes, goe downe into the gulfe ye inhabitantes of Dedan: becauſe I haue brought the perdition of Eſau vpon him, the time of his viſitation.
label: Jeremy

text: If the grape gatherers had come vpon thee, they had not left a cluſter: if theeues in the night, they had taken that should ſuffice them.
label: Jeremy

text: But I haue diſcouered Eſau, I haue reuealed his ſecrets, and he can not be concealed: his ſeede is waſted, and his bretheren, and his neighbours, and he shal not be.
label: Jeremy

text: Leaue thy pupilles: I wil make them liue: and thy widowes shal hope in me.
label: Jeremy

text: For thus ſaith our Lord: Behold they whoſe iudgement was not to drinke the cuppe, drinking shal drinke: and shalt thou be left as innocent? thou shalt not be innocent, but drinking thou shalt drinke.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe I haue ſworne by my ſelf, ſaith our Lord, that Boſra shal be into deſolation, and into reproch, and into a deſert, and into malediction: and al her cities shal be into euerlaſting deſolations.
label: Jeremy

text: I haue heard a bruite from our Lord, and a legate is ſent to the Nations: Gather your ſelues together, and come againſt her, and let vs riſe vp into battel.
label: Jeremy

text: For behold I haue made thee a litle one in the Gentiles, contemptible among men.
label: Jeremy

text: Thine arrogancie hath deceiued thee, and the pride of thy hart: which dwelleſt in the caues of the rocke, and endeuoureſt to apprehend the height of the hil. when thou shalt exalt thy neſt as an eagle, thence wil I bring thee downe, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: And Idumea shal be deſolate: euerie one that shal paſſe by it, shal be aſtonied, and shal hiſſe vpon al the plagues thereof.
label: Jeremy

text: As Sodome is ouerthrowen and Gomorrha, and her neighbours ſaith our Lord: there shal not a man dwel there, and there shal no ſonne of man inhabite it.
label: Jeremy

text: Behold as a lion he shal come vp from the pride of Iordan, to the ſtrong beautifulnes: becauſe I wil make him runne ſodenly to her: and who shal be a choſen one whom I may appoint ouer her? for who is like to me? and who shal abide me? and who is this paſtour that can reſiſt my countenance?
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore heare ye the counſel of our Lord, which he hath taken concerning Edom: and his cogitations, which he hath thought concerning the inhabitants of Theman: If the litle ones of the flocke shal not caſt them downe, if they shal not deſtroy their habitation with them.
label: Jeremy

text: At the voice of their ruine the earth is moued: the crie of their voice is heard in the Red ſea.
label: Jeremy

text: Behold he shal come vp as an eagle, and flie out: and he shal ſpred his winges ouer Boſra: and the hart of the ſtrong of Idumea shal be in that day, as the hart of a woman in trauel.
label: Jeremy

text: To Damaſcus. Emath is confounded and Arphad: becauſe they haue heard a verie il bruite, they are trubled in the ſea: for carefulnes it could not be quiet.
label: Jeremy

text: Damaſcus is vndone, she is turned into flight, trembling hath apprehended her: anguish and ſorowes haue held her as a woman in trauel.
label: Jeremy

text: How haue they forſaken the laudable citie, the citie of ioy!
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore shal her yongmen fal in her ſtreetes: and al the men of warre shal be ſilent in that day, ſaith the Lord of hoſtes.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil kindle a fire in the wal of Damaſcus, and it shal deuour the walles of Benadad.
label: Jeremy

text: To Cedar, and to the kingdoms of Aſor, which Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon hath ſtrooken. Thus ſaith our Lord: Ariſe, and goe ye vp to Cedar, and waſte the children of the Eaſt.
label: Jeremy

text: They shal take their tabernacles, and their flockes: their cortines, and al their veſſels, and their camels they shal take to them: and they shal cal vpon them feare round about.
label: Jeremy

text: Flee yee, get away ſpedely, ſit in deepe pitts you that inhabite Aſor, ſaith our Lord: for Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon hath taken counſel againſt you, & hath deuiſed deuiſes againſt you.
label: Jeremy

text: Ariſe, and goe vp to the nation that is quiet, and that dwelleth confidently, ſaith our Lord, they haue neither doores, nor barres: they dwel alone.
label: Jeremy

text: And their camels shal be into ſpoile, and the multitude of beaſts for a praye: and I wil diſperſe them into euerie winde, which haue their heare powled: and from euerie confine of theirs, I wil bring deſtruction vpon them, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: And Aſor shal be for an habitation of dragons, deſolate for euer: there shal no man tarie there, nor ſonne of man inhabite it.
label: Jeremy

text: The word of our Lord that was made to Ieremie the prophet againſt Ælam, in he beginning of the kingdom of Sedecias king of Iuda, ſaying:
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſtes: Behold I wil breake the bow of Ælam, & their chife ſtrength.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil bring vpon Ælam the foure windes from the foure coſtes of heauen: and I wil ſcatter them into al theſe windes: & there shal not be a nation, to which the fugitiues of Aëlam shal not come.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil make Aelam to feare before his enemies, and in the ſight of them that ſeeke their life: and I wil bring euil vpon them, the wrath of my furie, ſaith our Lord: and I wil ſend the ſword after them, til I conſume them.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil ſet my throne in Aelam, and deſtroy kinges and princes from thence, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: But in the laſt daies I wil cauſe the captiues of Aelam to returne, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: THE word that our Lord hath ſpoken of Babylon, and the Land of the Chaldees in the hand of Ieremie the prophete.
label: Jeremy

text: Declare among the Gentiles, and make it heard, lift vp a ſigne: proclame and conceale it not: ſay; Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is ouercome, their ſculptiles are confounded, their idoles are ouercome.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe a nation is come vp againſt them from the North, which shal bring her Land into deſolation: and there shal be none to dwel therein, from man euen to beaſt, and they are remoued, and gone away.
label: Jeremy

text: In thoſe daies, and in that time, ſaith our Lord, the children of Iſrael shal come, they and the children of Iuda together: walking and weeping they shal haſten, and shal ſeeke the Lord their God.
label: Jeremy

text: Into Sion they shal aske the way, their faces hitherward. They shal come, and shal be ioyned to our Lord by an euerlaſting couenant, which shal by no obliuion be abolished.
label: Jeremy

text: My people is become a loſt flock, their paſtours haue ſeduced them, and haue made them wander in the mountaynes: they haue paſſed from mountayne to hil, they haue forgotten their couch.
label: Jeremy

text: Al that found them, haue eaten them: and their enemies ſaid: We haue not ſinned: becauſe they haue ſinned to the Lord the beautie of Iuſtice, and to the Lord the expectation of their fathers.
label: Jeremy

text: Depart out of the middes of Babylon, and goe forth out of the land of the Chaldees: and be ye as kiddes before the flocke.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe loe I rayſe vp, and wil bring into Babylon an aſſemblie of great nations from the land of the North: and they shal be prepared againſt her, and thereby she shal be taken: his arrow as a valiant mans that is a killer, shal not returne voide.
label: Jeremy

text: And Chaldea shal be for a praye: al that waſte it shal be filled, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe you reioyce, and ſpeake great thinges, ſpoyling mine inheritance: becauſe you are powred out as calues vpon the graſſe, and you haue belowed as bulles.
label: Jeremy

text: Your Mother is confounded exceedingly, and made euen with the duſt she that bare you: behold she shal be the laſt among the Gentiles, deſolate, without acceſſe, and drie.
label: Jeremy

text: Of the wrath of our Lord it shal not be inhabited, but shal be brought wholly into deſolation: euerie one that shal paſſe by Babylon, shal be aſtonied, and shal hiſſe vpon al the plagues thereof.
label: Jeremy

text: Be prepared againſt Babylon round about al ye that bend bow; ouerthrow her, ſpare not arrowes: becauſe she hath ſinned to our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Crie againſt her, she hath geuen the hand euerie where, her foundations are fallen, her walles are deſtroyed, becauſe it is the vengeance of our Lord. Take vengeance of her: as she hath done, ſo doe to her.
label: Jeremy

text: Deſtroy the ſower out of Babylon, and him that holdeth the ſickle in the harueſt time: at the face of the ſword of the doue euerie man shal returne to his people, and euerie one shal flee to his owne land.
label: Jeremy

text: Iſrael is a flock diſperſed, lyons haue caſt him out: firſt the king of Aſſur did eate him: laſt this Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon hath ſpoyled his bones.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore thus ſaith the Lord of hoſtes the God of Iſrael: Behold I wil viſite the king of Babylon and his land, as I haue viſited the king of Aſſur:
label: Jeremy

text: and I wil bring Iſrael againe to his habitation: and Carmel shal be fed, and Baſan, and in mount Ephraim, and Galaad his ſoule shal be filled.
label: Jeremy

text: In thoſe daies, and in that time, ſaith our Lord, the iniquitie of Iſrael shal be ſought, and it shal not be: and the ſinne of Iuda, and it shal not be found: becauſe I wil be propicious to them, whom I shal leaue.
label: Jeremy

text: Aſcend vpon the land of them that rule, and viſite vpon the inhabitants thereof, deſtroy, and kil the thinges that are behind them, ſaith our Lord: and doe according to al thinges that I haue commanded thee.
label: Jeremy

text: A voice of battel in the land, and great deſtruction.
label: Jeremy

text: How is the hammer of the whole earth broken, and deſtroyed? how is Babylon turned into a deſert among the nations?
label: Jeremy

text: I haue ſnared thee, and thou art taken Babylon, and thou kneweſt it not: thou art found & apprehended, becauſe thou haſt prouoked our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Our Lord hath opened his treaſure, and brought forth the veſſels of his wrath: becauſe the Lord the God of hoſtes hath a worke in the land of the Chaldees.
label: Jeremy

text: Come ye vnto her from the vttermoſt borders, open that they may goe forth that shal tread her downe: take the ſtones out of the way, and bring it into heapes, and kil her: neither let there be anie thing left.
label: Jeremy

text: Deſtroy al her valiants, let them deſcend into ſlaughter: woe vnto them, becauſe their day is come, the time of their viſitation.
label: Jeremy

text: A voice of them that flee, and of them, that haue eſcaped out of the land of Babylon: to tel in Sion the reuenge of the Lord our God, the reuenge of his temple.
label: Jeremy

text: Declare ye againſt Babylon to verie manie, to al that bend bow: ſtand together againſt her round about, and let none eſcape: repay her according to her worke: according to al thinges, that she hath done, doe ye to her: becauſe she is erected againſt our Lord, againſt the holie one of Iſrael.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore shal her yongmen fal in her ſtreetes: and al her men of warre shal hold their peace in that day, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Behold I to thee thou prowd one, ſaith our Lord the God of hoſtes: becauſe thy day is come, the time of thy viſitation.
label: Jeremy

text: And the prowd shal fal, and tumble downe, and there shal be none to raiſe him vp: and I wil kindle a fire in his cities, and it shal deuoure al thinges round about him.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſtes: The children of Iſrael, and the children of Iuda ſuſteyne calumnie together: al that haue taken them, hold them, they wil not let them goe.
label: Jeremy

text: Their ſtrong redeemer, the Lord of hoſtes is his name, in iudgement wil defend their cauſe, to terrifie the land, and to ſtirre vp the inhabitantes of Babylon.
label: Jeremy

text: The ſword to the Chaldees, ſaith our Lord, and to the inhabitants of Babylon, and to her princes, and to her wiſe men.
label: Jeremy

text: The ſword to her diuiners, who shal be foolish: the ſword to her valiants, who shal be afraid.
label: Jeremy

text: The ſword to his horſes, and to his chariots, and to al the common people, that is in the middes of her: and they shal be as wemen: the ſword to her treaſures, which shal be ſpoyled.
label: Jeremy

text: There shal be drought vpon her waters, and they shal be dryed vp: becauſe it is a land of ſculptiles, and they glorie in monſtrous thinges.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore shal the dragons dwel with the foolish murderers: and the oſtriches shal dwel in it: and it shal no more be inhabited for euer, neither shal it be built euen to generation and generation.
label: Jeremy

text: As our Lord ouerthrew Sodom and Gomorrha, and the neighbours thereof, ſaith our Lord: there shal no man dwel there, and ſonne of man shal not inhabite it.
label: Jeremy

text: Behold a people cometh from the North, and a great nation, and manie kinges shal riſe from the endes of the earth.
label: Jeremy

text: They shal take bow and shield: they are cruel and vnmerciful: their voice shal ſound as the ſea, and they shal mount vpon horſes: as a man prepared to battel againſt thee ô daughter of Babylon.
label: Jeremy

text: The king of Babylon hath heard the fame of them, and his handes are diſſolued: anguish hath caught him, ſorow as a woman in trauel.
label: Jeremy

text: Behold as a lion he shal come vp from the pride of Iordan to the ſtrong beautifulnes: becauſe I wil make him runne ſodenly to her: and who shal be a choſen one, whom I may appoint ouer her? For who is like to me? and who shal abide me? and who is this paſtour, that can reſiſt my countenance?
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore heare ye the counſel of our Lord, which he hath conceiued in his minde againſt Babylon: and his cogitations, which he hath thought vpon the land of the Chaldees: Vnles the litle ones of the flockes shal plucke them downe, vnles their habitation shal be deſtroyed with them.
label: Jeremy

text: At the voice of the captiuitie of Babylon the earth is moued, and the crie is heard amongſt the Nations.
label: Jeremy

text: THVS ſaith our Lord: Behold I wil raiſe vpon Babylon and vpon the inhabitants thereof, which haue lifted vp their hart againſt me, as it were a peſtilent winde.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil ſend vpon Babylon fanners, and they shal fanne it, and shal deſtroy her land: becauſe they are come vpon her on euerie ſide in the day of her affliction.
label: Jeremy

text: Let not him that bendeth bend his bow, and let not him goe vp that is in a brigandin, ſpare not her young men, kil al her hoſt.
label: Jeremy

text: And the ſlaine shal fal in the land of the Chaldees, and the wounded in the countries thereof.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe Iſrael and Iuda haue not bene left as a widow of their God the Lord of hoſtes: but their land hath bene replenished with ſinne from the holie one of Iſrael.
label: Jeremy

text: Flee ye out of the middes of Babylon, and let euerie one ſaue his owne life, hold not your peace vpon her iniquitie: becauſe it is the time of reuenge from our Lord, he wil requite her the like.
label: Jeremy

text: Babylon is a golden cuppe in the hand of our Lord, inebriating al the earth: of her wine haue the Nations drunke, and therefore they are in commotion.
label: Jeremy

text: Babylon is fallen ſodenly, and is deſtroyed: howle ye vpon her, take reſine for her ſorow, if perhaps she may be healed.
label: Jeremy

text: We haue cured Babylon, and she is not healed: let vs forſake her, & let vs goe euerie man to his owne land: becauſe her iudgement hath reached euen to the heauens, & is lifted vp vnto the clowdes.
label: Jeremy

text: Our Lord hath brought forth our iuſtices: come, and let vs tel in Sion the worke of the Lord our God.
label: Jeremy

text: Make sharpe the arrowes, fil the quiuers: our Lord hath rayſed vp the ſpirite of the kinges of the Medes: and againſt Babylon his minde is to deſtroy it, becauſe it is the reuenge of our Lord, the reuenge of his temple.
label: Jeremy

text: Vpon the walles of Babylon lift vp the enſigne, increaſe the watch: ſet vp watchemen, prepare embushments: becauſe our Lord hath meant, and hath done what ſoeuer he ſpake againſt the inhabitants of Babylon.
label: Jeremy

text: Thou that dwelleſt vpon manie waters, rich in treaſures: thine end is come with in a foote of thy cutting of.
label: Jeremy

text: The Lord of hoſtes hath ſworne by his ſoule: that I wil replenish thee with men as it were with the locuſt, and vpon thee shal the merie shoute be ſong.
label: Jeremy

text: He that made the earth in his ſtrength, hath prepared the world in his wiſedom, and with his prudence ſtretched out the heauens.
label: Jeremy

text: He geuing a voice, the waters are multiplied in heauen: who lifteth vp the clowdes from the extreme part of the earth, lightenings he hath turned into rayne: and he hath brought forth the winde out of his treaſures.
label: Jeremy

text: Euerie man is become a foole by knowlege: euerie mettal caſter is confounded in his ſculptil, becauſe his caſting is counterfet, neither is there ſpirite in them.
label: Jeremy

text: They are vaine workes, and worthie to be laughed at, in the time of their viſitation they shal perish.
label: Jeremy

text: The portion of Iacob is not as theſe thinges: becauſe he that made al thinges he it is, and Iſrael is the ſcepter of his inheritance: the Lord of hoſtes is his name.
label: Jeremy

text: Thou doeſt knocke together the veſſels of warre for me, and I wil knock together in thee the Gentiles, and I wil deſtroy in thee kingdomes:
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil breake in thee the horſe, and his rider: and I wil knock together in thee the chariot, and the rider thereof.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil knocke together in thee man and woman, and I wil knocke together in thee the old man and the child, and I wil knock together in thee the young man and the virgin:
label: Jeremy

text: and I wil knocke together in thee the paſtour and his flocke, and I wil knocke together in thee the husbandman and his draweing cattle, and I wil knocke together in thee dukes and magiſtrates.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil render to Babylon, and to al the inhabitants of Chaldee al their euil, that they haue done in Sion, before your eyes, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Behold I to thee thou peſtiferous mountaine, ſaith our Lord, which corrupteſt the whole earth: and I wil ſtreatch out my hand vpon thee, and wil roll thee out of the rockes, and wil geue thee to be a mountayne of burning.
label: Jeremy

text: And they shal not take of thee a ſtone for the corner, and a ſtone for foundations, but thou shalt be deſtroyed for euer, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Lift ye vp an enſigne in the land: ſound with the trumpet among the Gentiles: ſanctifie the Gentiles vpon her: declare againſt her to the kinges of Ararat, Menni, and Aſcenez: number Taphſar againſt her, bring the horſe as the ſtinging locuſt.
label: Jeremy

text: Sanctifie the Gentiles againſt her, the kings of Media, the dukes thereof, and al the Magiſtrates thereof, & al the land of his dominion.
label: Jeremy

text: And the land shal be in a commotion, and shal be trubled: becauſe the cogitation of our Lord shal awake againſt Babylon, to lay the Land of Babylon deſert and inhabitable.
label: Jeremy

text: The valiants of Babylon haue ceaſed from battel, they haue dwelt in holdes: their ſtrength is deuoured, and they are become as wemen: her tabernacles are burnt, her barres are broken.
label: Jeremy

text: A runner shal come to meete the runner, and meſſenger to meete meſſenger: to tel the king of Babylon that his citie is taken from one end to the other:
label: Jeremy

text: and the fordes are taken before hand, and the fennes be burnt with fire, and the men of warre be trubled.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe thus ſaith the Lord of hoſtes, the God of Iſrael: The daughter of Babylon is as a barne floore, the time of her threshing: yet a litle, and the time of her reaping shal come.
label: Jeremy

text: Nabuchodoſor the king of Babylon hath eaten me, he hath deuoured me: he hath made me as an emptie veſſel: he hath ſwallowed me vp as a dragon, he hath filled his bellie with my tendernes, and hath caſt me out.
label: Jeremy

text: Iniquitie againſt me, and my flesh vpon Babylon, ſaith the habitation of Sion: and my bloud vpon the inhabitantes of Chaldee, ſaith Ieruſalem.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore thus ſaith our Lord: Behold I wil iudge thy cauſe, and wil reuenge thy vengeance, and I wil make her ſea deſolate, and wil drie vp her vayne.
label: Jeremy

text: And Babylon shal be into heapes, the habitation of dragons, aſtonishment, and hiſſing, becauſe there is not an inhabiter.
label: Jeremy

text: They shal roare together as lions, they shal shake the manes as the whelpes of lions.
label: Jeremy

text: In their heate I wil ſet their drinke: and I wil make them drunke, that they may be drouſie, and ſleepe an euerlaſting ſleepe, & not ariſe, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: I wil leade them as lambes to be a victime, and as rammes with kiddes.
label: Jeremy

text: How is Seſach taken, and the noble one of al the earth apprehended? How is Babylon become an aſtonishment among the Gentiles?
label: Jeremy

text: The ſea is come vp ouer Babylon: she is couered with the multitude of the waues thereof.
label: Jeremy

text: Her cities are become an aſtonishment: a land inhabitable and deſolate, a land wherein none can dwel, nor ſonne of man may paſſe by it.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil viſite vpon Bel in Babylon, and I wil caſt out of his mouth that which he had ſwallowed: and the Gentiles shal no more runne together vnto him, for the wall alſo of Babylon shal fal.
label: Jeremy

text: Goe out of the middes of her my people: that euerie one may ſaue his life from the wrath of the furie of our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: And leſt perhaps your hartes faint, and ye feare the bruite, that shal be heard in the land: and there shal come a bruite in the yeare, and after this yeare a bruite: and iniquitie in the land, and ruler vpon ruler.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore behold the daies come, and I wil viſite vpon the ſculptiles of Babylon: and al her land shal be confounded and al her ſlaine shal fal in the middes of her.
label: Jeremy

text: And the heauens and the earth shal prayſe vpon Babylon, and al thinges that are in them: becauſe ſpoylers shal come to her from the North, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: And as Babylon cauſed that there should fal ſlaine in Iſrael: ſo of Babylon there shal fal ſlaine in the whole land.
label: Jeremy

text: You that haue eſcaped the ſword, come, ſtand not: remember our Lord a farre of, and let Ieruſalem aſcend vpon your hart.
label: Jeremy

text: We are confounded, becauſe we haue heard reproch: ignominie hath couered our faces: becauſe ſtrangers are come vpon the ſanctification of the houſe of our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: Therefore behold the daies come, ſaith our Lord: and I wil viſite vpon her ſculptiles, and in al her land the wounded shal roare.
label: Jeremy

text: If Babylon shal aſcend vp into heauen, and ſtablish her ſtrength on high: from me there shal come waſters of her, ſaith our Lord.
label: Jeremy

text: A voice of crying from Babylon, and great deſtruction from the Land of the Chaldees:
label: Jeremy

text: becauſe our Lord hath waſted Babylon, and deſtroyed out of it the great voice: and their waues shal ſound as manie waters: their voice hath geuen a ſound.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe the ſpoyler is come vpon her, that is, vpon Babylon, and her valiants are apprehended, and their bow is weakened: becauſe the ſtrong reuenger our Lord rendring wil repay.
label: Jeremy

text: And I wil inebriate her princes, and her wiſe men, and her dukes, and her magiſtrates, and her valiants: and they shal ſleepe an euerlaſting ſleepe, and shal not awake, ſaith the king, the Lord of hoſtes is his name.
label: Jeremy

text: Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſtes: That moſt brode wal of Babylon by vndermyning shal be vndermined, and her high gates shal be burnt with fire, and the labours of the peoples shal come to nothing, and of the nations shal be into the fire, and shal perish.
label: Jeremy

text: The word that Ieremie the prophete commanded Saraias the ſonne of Nerias, the ſonne of Maaſias, when he went with Sedecias the king into Babylon, in the fourth yeare of his kingdome: and Saraias was the prince of prophecie.
label: Jeremy

text: And Ieremie wrote al the euil, that was to come vpon Babylon in one booke: al theſe wordes, that are written againſt Babylon.
label: Jeremy

text: And Ieremie ſaid to Saraias: When thou shalt come into Babylon, and shalt ſee, and shalt reade al theſe wordes,
label: Jeremy

text: thou shalt ſay: Lord thou haſt ſpoken againſt this place to deſtroy it: that there be none to inhabite it from man euen vnto beaſt, and that it be a perpetual wilderneſſe.
label: Jeremy

text: And when thou shalt haue finished reading this booke, thou shalt tye a ſtone to it, and shalt throw it into the middes of Euphrates:
label: Jeremy

text: and thou shalt ſay: So shal Babylon be drowned, & she shal not riſe vp from the face of the affliction, that I wil bring vpon her, and she shal be diſſolued. Hitherto the wordes of Ieremie.
label: Jeremy

text: A Child of one and twentie yeares was Sedecias when he began to reigne: and eleuen yeares he reigned in Ieruſalem: and the name of his mother was Amital, the daughter of Ieremie of Lobna.
label: Jeremy

text: And he did euil in the eyes of our Lord, according to al thinges that Ioakim had done.
label: Jeremy

text: Becauſe the furie of our Lord was againſt Ieruſalem, and againſt Iuda, til he caſt them away from his face: and Sedecias reuolted from the king of Babylon.
label: Jeremy

text: And it came to paſſe in the ninth yeare of his reigne, in the tenth moneth, the tenth of the moneth, came Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon, him ſelf and al his armie againſt Ieruſalem, and they beſieged it, and built againſt it munitions round about.
label: Jeremy

text: And the citie was beſieged vntil the eleuenth yeare of king Sedecias.
label: Jeremy

text: And in the fourth moneth, the ninth of the moneth, a famine poſſeſſed the citie: and there were no victuals for the people of the land.
label: Jeremy

text: And a breache was made into the citie, and al the men of warre fled, and went out of the citie in the night by the way of the gate that is betwen the two walles, & leadeth to the kinges garden (the Chaldees beſieging the citie round about) and they departed by the way, that leadeth into the wildernes.
label: Jeremy

text: But the armie of the Chaldees purſued the king: and they apprehended Sedecias in the deſert, which is beſide Iericho: and al his trayne fled ſcattering from him.
label: Jeremy

text: And when they had taken the king, they brought him to the king of Babylon into Reblatha, which is in the land of Emath: and he ſpake to him iudgements.
label: Jeremy

text: And the king of Babylon killed the ſonnes of Sedecias before his eies: yea and al the princes of Iuda he ſlew in Reblatha.
label: Jeremy

text: And he plucked out the eies of Sedecias, and bound him with fetters, and the king of Babylon brought him into Babylon: and he put him in the priſon houſe euen to the day of his death.
label: Jeremy

text: And in the fifth moneth, the tenth of the moneth, the ſame is the ninetenth yeare of Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon: came Nabuzardan the prince of the warfare, who ſtood before the king of Babylon in Ieruſalem.
label: Jeremy

text: And he burnt the houſe of our Lord, and the kings houſe, and al the houſes of Ieruſalem, and euerie great houſe he burnt with fire.
label: Jeremy

text: And al the hoſt of the Chaldees that was with the prince of the warfare, deſtroyed al the wall of Ieruſalem round about.
label: Jeremy

text: But of the poore of the people, and of the reſt of the vulgar ſorte, which remayned in the citie, and of the fugitiues, that were fled to the king of Babylon, and the reſt of the multitude: Nabuzardan the prince of the warfare tranſported.
label: Jeremy

text: But of the poore of the land Nabuzardan the prince of the warfare left ſome to be dreſſers of vineyards, and husbandmen.
label: Jeremy

text: The braſen pillers alſo, that were in the houſe of our Lord, and the feete, and the ſea of braſſe, that was in the houſe of our Lord, the Chaldees brake: and they tooke al the braſſe of them into Babylon.
label: Jeremy

text: And the kettles, and the fleshhookes, and the pſalteries, and the phials, and the litle mortars, and al the braſen veſſels, that had bene in the miniſtrie, they tooke:
label: Jeremy

text: and the water pottes, and the cenſars, and the pitchers, and the baſins, and the candleſtickes, and the mortars, & the gobblets: as manie as of gold, of gold: and as manie as of ſiluer, of ſiluer, did the prince of the warfare take:
label: Jeremy

text: and two pillars, and one ſea, & twelue oxen of braſſe, that were vnder the feete, which king Salomon had made in the houſe of our Lord: there was no weight of the braſſe of al theſe veſſels.
label: Jeremy

text: And concerning the pillars, there were eightene cubits of height in one pillar: and a corde of twelue cubits did compaſſe it about: moreouer the thicknes thereof, of foure fingers, and within it was holow.
label: Jeremy

text: And the litle heads of braſſe vpon both: the height of one litle head, of fiue cubits: and the litle nettes, and the pomegranates vpon the crowne round about, al of braſſe. Likewiſe of the ſecond piller, and the pomegranates.
label: Jeremy

text: And there were nintie ſix pomegranates hanging downe: and al the pomegranates an hundred, were compaſſed with litle nettes.
label: Jeremy

text: And the maſter of the warfare tooke Saraias the chiefe prieſt, and Sophonias the ſecond prieſt: and the three kepers of the entrie.
label: Jeremy

text: And of the citie he tooke one eunuch, that was chiefe ouer the men of warre: and ſeuen men of them, that ſaw the kings face, that were found in the citie: and a ſcribe the captayne of the ſouldiars, who tryed the yong ſouldiars: and three ſcore of the people of the land, that were found in the middes of the citie.
label: Jeremy

text: And Nabuzardan the prince of the warfare tooke them, and he brought them to the king of Babylon into Reblatha.
label: Jeremy

text: And the king of Babylon ſtroke them: and he killed them in Reblatha in the land of Emath: and Iuda was tranſported from his land.
label: Jeremy

text: This is the people, which Nabuchodonoſor tranſported: In the ſeuenth yeare, Iewes three thouſand and twentie three.
label: Jeremy

text: In the eighteenth yeare of Nabuchodonoſor from Ieruſalem ſoules eight hundred thirtie two.
label: Jeremy

text: In the three and twentith yeare of Nabuchodonoſor, Nabuzardan the prince of the warfare tranſported of the Iewes ſeuen hundred fourtie fiue ſoules. al the ſoules therfore were foure thouſand ſix hundred.
label: Jeremy

text: And it came to paſſe in the ſeuen and thirtith yeare of the tranſmigration of Ioachin the king of Iuda, the twelfth moneth, the fiue and twentith of the moneth, Euilmerodach the king of Babylon lifted vp in the very yeare of his reigne, the head of Ioachin the king of Iuda, and he brought him out of the priſon houſe.
label: Jeremy

text: And he ſpake with him good thinges, and he ſette his throne aboue the thrones of the kinges, that were after himſelf in Babylon.
label: Jeremy

text: And he changed his priſon garments, and he did eate bread before him alwaies al the daies of his life.
label: Jeremy

text: And his allowance of meate, a continual prouiſion of meate was geuen him by the king of Babylon, euerie day a certaine, euen vnto the day of his death, al the daies of his life.
label: Jeremy

text: HOW doeth the citie ful of people, ſitte ſolitarie: how is the ladie of the Gentiles become as a widow: the princeſſe of prouinces is made tributarie?
label: Lamentations

text: Weeping she hath wept in the night, and her teares are on her cheekes: there is none to comfort her of al her deare ones: al her freindes haue deſpiſed her, and are become her enimies.
label: Lamentations

text: Iudas is gone into tranſmigration becauſe of affliction, and the multitude of bondage: she hath dwelt among the Gentiles, neither hath she found reſt: al her perſecuters haue apprehended her within the ſtraites.
label: Lamentations

text: The waies of Sion mourne, becauſe there are none that come to the ſolemnitie: al her gates are deſtroyed: her prieſtes ſighing: her virgins lothſome, and herſelf is oppreſſed with bitternes.
label: Lamentations

text: Her aduerſaries are made in the head, her enemies are enriched: becauſe our Lord hath ſpoken vpon her for the multitude of her iniquities: her litle ones are led into captiuitie, before the face of the afflicter.
label: Lamentations

text: And from the daughter of Sion al her beautie is departed: her princes are become as rammes not fynding paſtures: and they are gone without ſtrength before the face of the purſewer.
label: Lamentations

text: Ieruſalem hath remembred the dayes of her affliction, and preuarication of al her thinges worthie to be deſyred, which she had from the daies of old, when her people fel in the enimies hand, and there was no helper: the enemies haue ſene her, and haue ſcorned her ſabbathes.
label: Lamentations

text: Ieruſalem hath ſinned a ſinne, therfore is she made vnſtable: al that did glorifie her, haue deſpiſed her, becauſe they haue ſene her ignominie: but she ſighing is turned backward.
label: Lamentations

text: Her filthines is on her feete, neither hath she remembred her end; she is pulled downe exceedingly, not hauing a comforter: ſee ô Lord mine affliction, becauſe the enemie is exalted.
label: Lamentations

text: The enimie hath thruſt his hand to al her thinges worthie to be deſyred: becauſe she hath ſene the Gentiles enter into her ſanctuarie, of whom thou gaueſt commandment that they should not enter into thy church.
label: Lamentations

text: Al her people ſighing, and ſeeking bread: they haue geuen al precious thinges for meate to refresh the ſoule, ſee ô Lord and conſider, becauſe I am become vyle.
label: Lamentations

text: O al ye that paſſe by the way, attend, and ſee if there be ſorow like to my ſorow: becauſe he hath made vintage of me, as our Lord hath ſpoken in the day of the wrath of his furie.
label: Lamentations

text: From on high he hath caſt a fyre in my bones, and hath taught me: he hath ſpred a net for my feete, he hath turned me backward: he hath made me deſolate, al the day conſumed with ſorow.
label: Lamentations

text: The yoke of mine iniquities hath watched: they are folded together in his hand, and put vpon my necke: my ſtrength is weakened: our Lord hath geuen me into the hand, from which I can not riſe.
label: Lamentations

text: Our Lord hath taken away al my magnifical ones out of the middes of me: he hath called a time againſt me, to deſtroy mine elect: our Lord hath troden the winepreſſe to the virgin the daughter of Iuda.
label: Lamentations

text: Therfore am I weeping, and mine eye shedding teares: becauſe a comforter is made far from me, conuerting my ſoule: my children are become deſolate becauſe the enemie hath preuayled.
label: Lamentations

text: Sion hath ſpred forth her handes, there is none to comfort her: our Lord hath commanded againſt Iacob, round about him are his enemies: Ieruſalem is become as a woman polluted with menſtruous floores among them.
label: Lamentations

text: Our Lord is iuſt, becauſe I haue prouoked his mouth to wrath: heare I beſeech al ye peoples, and ſee my ſorow: my virgins, and my yong men are gone into captiuitie.
label: Lamentations

text: I haue called my freindes, they haue deceiued me: my prieſtes and my ancientes are conſumed in the citie: becauſe they haue ſought meat for themſelues, to refresh their ſoule.
label: Lamentations

text: See ô Lord that I am in tribulation, my bellie is trubled: my hart is ouerturned in myſelf, becauſe I am ful of bitternes: the ſword killeth abrode, and at home it is lyke death.
label: Lamentations

text: They haue heard that I doe ſigh, and there is none to comfort me: al mine enimies haue heard mine euil, they haue reioyced, becauſe thou haſt done it: thou haſt brought a day of conſolation, and they shal be made lyke to me.
label: Lamentations

text: Let al their euil enter in before thee: and vintage them, as thou haſt vintaged me for al mine iniquities: for my ſighings are manie, and my hart iſ ſorowful.
label: Lamentations

text: HOW hath our Lord in his furie couered the daughter of Sion with darknes: caſt forth the noble one of Iſrael from heauen to the earth, and hath not remembred the footeſtoole of his feete in the day of his furie.
label: Lamentations

text: Our Lord hath caſt downe headlong, and hath not ſpared, al the beautiful thinges of Iacob: he hath deſtroyed in his furie the munitions of the virgin of Iuda, and caſt it downe to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom, and the princes therof.
label: Lamentations

text: He hath broken euerie horne of Iſrael in the wrath of furie: he hath turned away his right hand backward from the face of the enemie: and he hath kinled in Iacob as it were the fyre of a flame deuouring round about.
label: Lamentations

text: He hath bent his bow as an enemie, he hath faſtned his right hand as an aduerſarie: and he hath killed al, that was fayre to behold in the tabernacle of the daughter of Sion, he hath powred out his indignation as fyre.
label: Lamentations

text: Our Lord is become as an enemie: he hath caſt downe Iſrael headlong, he hath caſt downe headlong al her walles: he hath deſtroyed the munitions therof, and hath replenished in the daughter of Iuda the humbled man and humbled woman.
label: Lamentations

text: And he hath deſtroyed his tent as a garden, he hath throwen downe his tabernacle: our Lord hath brought feſtiuitie and ſabbath in Sion to obliuion: and king and prieſt into reproch, and into the indignation of his furie.
label: Lamentations

text: Our Lord hath reiected, he hath curſed his ſanctification: he hath deliuered the walles of the towers therof into the hand of the enemie: they haue made a noyſe in the houſe of our Lord, as in a ſolemne day.
label: Lamentations

text: Our Lord hath meant to deſtroy the wal of the daughter of Sion: he hath ſtreched out his corde, and hath not turned away his hand from deſtruction: and the forewal hath mourned, and the wal is deſtroyed together.
label: Lamentations

text: Her gates are faſtned in the ground: he hath deſtroyed, and broken her barres: her king and her princes in the Gentiles: there is no law, and her prophets haue not found viſion from our Lord.
label: Lamentations

text: The ancients of the daughter of Sion haue ſitten on the ground, they haue held their peace: they haue ſprinkled their heades with duſt, they are girded with heare clothes, the virgins of Ieruſalem haue caſt downe their heades to the ground.
label: Lamentations

text: Myne eies haue fayled for teares, my bowels are trubled: my liuer is powred out on the earth, for the deſtruction of the daughter of my people, when the litle one, and the ſucking faynted in the ſtreetes of the towne.
label: Lamentations

text: They ſayd to their mothers: Where is wheate and wyne? when they faynted as the wounded in the ſtreets of the citie: when they yelded vp the ghoſtes in the boſome of their mothers.
label: Lamentations

text: Wherto shal I compare thee? or wherto shal I liken thee ô daughter of Ieruſalem: wherto shal I make thee equal, and comfort thee ô virgin daughter of Sion? For great is thy deſtruction as the ſea: who shal heale thee?
label: Lamentations

text: Thy prophetes haue ſene falſe and foolish thinges for thee: neither haue they opened thyne iniquitie, to prouoke thee to penance, but they haue ſene falſe burdens and banishements for thee.
label: Lamentations

text: Al that paſſed by the way haue clapped their handes vpon thee: they haue hiſſed, and moued their head vpon the daughter of Ieruſalem, ſaying: Is this the citie of perfect beautie, the ioy of al the earth?
label: Lamentations

text: Al thyne enemies haue opened their mouth vpon thee: they haue hiſſed, and gnashed with the teeth, and haue ſayd: We wil deuour: Loe this is the day, which we expected: we haue found it, we haue ſene it.
label: Lamentations

text: Our Lord hath done the thinges that he meant, he hath accomplished his word, which he commanded from the dayes of old: he hath deſtroyed, and hath not ſpared, and he hath made the enemie ioyful ouer thee, and hath exalted the horne of thine aduerſaries.
label: Lamentations

text: Their hart hath cryed to our Lord vpon the walles of the daughter of Sion: Shede teares as a torrent by day, and night: geue no reſt to thyſelf, neither let the aple of thyne eye ceaſe.
label: Lamentations

text: Ariſe, prayſe in the night in the beginning of the watches: powre out thy hart as waters before the ſight of our Lord: lift vp thy handes to him for the life of thy litle ones, which haue fainted for famine in the head of al high wayes.
label: Lamentations

text: See ô Lord, and conſider whom thou haſt vintaged thus: shal wemen then eate their owne fruite, litle ones of the meaſure of a ſpanne? is the prieſt, and the prophet ſlaine in the ſanctuarie of our Lord?
label: Lamentations

text: The childe and the old man lay on the ground without: my virgins and my yongmen are fallen by the ſword: thou haſt killed in the day of thy furie: thou haſt ſtrooken, neither haſt thou had mercie.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou haſt called as it were to a ſolemne day, thoſe that should terrifie me round about, and there was none in the day of the furie of our Lord, that eſcaped and was left: whom I brought vp, & nourished, mine enemie hath conſumed them.
label: Lamentations

text: I THE man that ſee my pouertie in the rod of his indignation.
label: Lamentations

text: He hath led me, and brought me into darknes and not into light.
label: Lamentations

text: Only againſt me he hath turned and hath conuerted his hand al the day.
label: Lamentations

text: He hath made my skinne old and my flesh, he hath broken my bones.
label: Lamentations

text: He hath built round about me, and he hath compaſed me with gaul, and labour.
label: Lamentations

text: In darke places he hath placed me as the euerlaſting dead.
label: Lamentations

text: He hath built round about againſt me, that I goe not forth: he hath aggrauated my fetters.
label: Lamentations

text: Yea and when I shal crie, and aske, he hath excluded my prayer.
label: Lamentations

text: He hath shut vp my wayes with ſquare ſtones, he hath ſubuerted my pathes.
label: Lamentations

text: He is become vnto me a beare lying in waite: a lyon in ſecret places.
label: Lamentations

text: He hath ſubuerted my pathes, and hath broken me, he hath made me deſolate.
label: Lamentations

text: He hath bent his bow, and ſet me as a marke for the arrow.
label: Lamentations

text: He hath shot in my reines the daughters of his quiuer.
label: Lamentations

text: I am made a deriſion to al my people, their ſong al the day.
label: Lamentations

text: He hath replenished me with bitternes, he hath inebriated me with wormwood.
label: Lamentations

text: And he hath broken my teeth by number, he hath fed me with ashes.
label: Lamentations

text: And my ſoule is repelled from peace, I haue forgotten good thinges.
label: Lamentations

text: And I ſayd: Mine end is perished, and mine hope from our Lord.
label: Lamentations

text: Remember my pouertie, and tranſgreſſion, the wormwood, and the gual.
label: Lamentations

text: Remembring I wil be mindful, and my ſoule shal languish in me.
label: Lamentations

text: Recording this thing in my hart, therfore wil I hope.
label: Lamentations

text: The mercies of our Lord that we are not conſumed: becauſe his commiſerations haue not fayled.
label: Lamentations

text: New in the morning, great is thy fidelite.
label: Lamentations

text: Our Lord is my portion, ſayd my ſoule: therfore wil I expect him.
label: Lamentations

text: Our Lord is good to them that hope in him, to the ſoule that ſeeketh him.
label: Lamentations

text: It is good to waite with ſilence for the ſaluation of God.
label: Lamentations

text: It is good for a man, when he beareth the yoke from his youth.
label: Lamentations

text: He shal ſit ſolitarie, and hold his peace: becauſe he hath lifted himſelfe aboue himſelf.
label: Lamentations

text: He shal put his mouth in the duſt, if perhaps there be hope.
label: Lamentations

text: He shal geue the cheeke to him that ſtriketh him, he shal be filled with reproches.
label: Lamentations

text: Becauſe our Lord wil not reiect for euer.
label: Lamentations

text: Becauſe if he hath reiected, he wil alſo haue mercie, according to the multitude of his mercies.
label: Lamentations

text: For he hath not humbled from his hart, and caſt of the children of men.
label: Lamentations

text: To ſtamp vnder his fete al the priſoners of the earth.
label: Lamentations

text: To auert the iudgement of a man before the face of the Higheſt.
label: Lamentations

text: To peruert a man in his iudgement, our Lord hath not knowne.
label: Lamentations

text: Who is this, that hath commanded it to be done, our Lord not commanding it?
label: Lamentations

text: Out of the mouth of the Higheſt, there shal not procede neither euil thinges, nor good.
label: Lamentations

text: What hath the liuing man murmured, man for his ſinnes?
label: Lamentations

text: Let vs ſearch our wayes, & ſeeke, and returne to our Lord.
label: Lamentations

text: Let vs lift vp our hartes with our handes to our Lord into the heauens.
label: Lamentations

text: We haue done wickedly, and prouoked to wrath: therfore thou art inexorable.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou haſt couered in furie, and haſt ſtrooken vs: thou haſt killed, and not ſpared.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou haſt ſette a cloude before thee, that prayer may not paſſe.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou haſt made me to be rooted out, and abiect in the middes of the peoples.
label: Lamentations

text: Al the enemies haue opened their mouth vpon vs.
label: Lamentations

text: Prophecie is made vnto vs, feare, and ſnare, and deſtruction.
label: Lamentations

text: Myne eye hath shed ſtreames of waters, in the deſtruction of the daughter of my people.
label: Lamentations

text: Myne eye is afflicted, neither hath it bene quiet, becauſe there was no reſt:
label: Lamentations

text: Til our Lord regarded and looked from the heauens.
label: Lamentations

text: Mine eye hath ſpoyled my ſoule for al the daughters of my citie.
label: Lamentations

text: Myne enemies in hunting haue caught me as a birde, without cauſe.
label: Lamentations

text: My life is fallen into the lake, and they haue layd a ſtone vpon me.
label: Lamentations

text: The waters haue flowed ouer my head: I ſayd: I am vndone.
label: Lamentations

text: I haue inuocated thy name ô Lord from the loweſt lake.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou haſt heard my voice: turne not away thine eare from my ſobbings, and cries.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou didſt approch in the day, when I inuocated thee: thou haſt ſayd: Feare not.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou haſt iudged ô Lord the cauſe of my ſoule, redemer of my life.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou haſt ſeene ô Lord their iniquitie againſt me: iudge my iudgement.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou haſt ſeene al their furie, al their cogitations againſt me.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou haſt heard their reproch ô Lord, al their cogitations againſt me.
label: Lamentations

text: The lippes of them that riſe vp againſt me; and their cogitations againſt me al the day.
label: Lamentations

text: See their ſitting downe, and their ryſing vp, I am their pſalme.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou shalt render them a recompence ô Lord, according to the workes of their handes.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou shalt geue them a shild of hart thy labour.
label: Lamentations

text: Thou shalt perſecute in furie, and shalt deſtroy them from vnder the heauens ô Lord.
label: Lamentations

text: HOW is the gold darkned, the beſt colour changed, the ſtones of the ſanctuarie diſperſed in the head of al ſtreetes?
label: Lamentations

text: The noble children of Sion, & they that were clothed with the principal gold: how are they reputed as earthen veſſels, the worke of the potters handes?
label: Lamentations

text: Yea euen the lamiaes haue opened their breaſt, they haue geuen ſucke to their yong, the daughter of my people is cruel, as the oſtrich in the deſert.
label: Lamentations

text: The tongue of the ſuckling hath clouen to the roofe of his mouth for thirſt: the litle ones haue asked bread, and there was none that brake it vnto them.
label: Lamentations

text: They that fed voluptuouſly, haue dyed in the wayes: they that were brought vp in ſcarlet, haue imbraced the dung.
label: Lamentations

text: And the iniquitie of the daughter of my people is become greater then the ſinne of Sodom: which was ouerthrowen in a moment, and handes tooke nothing in her.
label: Lamentations

text: Her Nazareites whiter then ſnow, purer then milke, ruddier then the old yuorie, fayrer then the ſapphire.
label: Lamentations

text: Their face is made blacker then coales, and they are not knowne in the ſtreetes: their skinne hath clouen to their bones, it is withered, and is made as wood.
label: Lamentations

text: It was better with them that were ſlaine with the ſword, then with them that were killed by famine: becauſe theſe pyned away conſumed by the barrennes of the countrie.
label: Lamentations

text: The handes of pitiful wemen haue ſodden their owne children: they were made their meate in the deſtruction of the daughter of my people.
label: Lamentations

text: Our Lord hath accomplished his furie, he hath powred out the wrath of his indignation: and he hath kindled a fyre in Sion, and it hath deuoured the fundations therof.
label: Lamentations

text: The kinges of the earth, and al the inhabitants of the world did not beleue, that the aduerſarie and the enemie should enter in by the gates of Ieruſalem.
label: Lamentations

text: For the ſinnes of her prophets, and the iniquities of her prieſtes, which haue shed the bloud of iuſt men in the middes of her.
label: Lamentations

text: The blind wandered in the ſtreetes, they were polluted with bloud: and when they could not, they held their skirtes.
label: Lamentations

text: Depart ye polluted, they cryed to them: depart, get ye hence, touch not: for they brawled, & were moued: they ſaid among the Gentiles: He wil adde no more to dwel among them.
label: Lamentations

text: The face of our Lord hath diuided them, he wil not adde to reſpect them: they haue not reuerenced the faces of the prieſts, neither had they pitie on the ancients.
label: Lamentations

text: Whiles we yet ſtood, our eyes fayled towards our vaine helpe, when we looked attentiue to a nation, that was not able to ſaue.
label: Lamentations

text: Our ſteppes ſlipped in the way of our ſtreetes, our end draweth nere: our dayes are accomplished, becauſe our end is come.
label: Lamentations

text: Our perſecuters were ſwifter then the eagles of the heauen: vpon the mountaines they purſued vs, in the deſert they lay in waite againſt vs.
label: Lamentations

text: The ſpirit of our mouth Chriſt our Lord is taken in our ſinnes: to whom we haue ſaid: In thy shadow shal we liue among the Gentiles.
label: Lamentations

text: Reioyce, and be glad ô daughter of Edom, which dwelleſt in the Land of Hus: to thee alſo shal the cuppe come, thou shalt be made drunken, and naked.
label: Lamentations

text: Thine iniquitie is accomplished ô daughter of Sion, he wil adde no more to tranſport thee: he hath viſited thine iniquitie ô daughter of Edom, he hath diſcouered thy ſinnes.
label: Lamentations

text: REmember ô Lord what is fallen to vs: behold, and regard our reproch.
label: Lamentations

text: Our inheritance iſ turned to aliens: our houſes to ſtrangers.
label: Lamentations

text: We are made pupils without father: our mothers are as it were widowes.
label: Lamentations

text: Our water we haue drunke for money: our wood we haue bought for a price.
label: Lamentations

text: We were led by our neckes, no reſt was geuen to the wearie.
label: Lamentations

text: We haue geuen our hand to Ægypt, and to the Aſſyrians, that we might be filled with bread.
label: Lamentations

text: Our fathers haue ſinned, and they are not: & we haue borne their iniquities.
label: Lamentations

text: Seruantes haue ruled ouer vs: there was none that would redeme vs out of their hand.
label: Lamentations

text: In peril of our liues did we fetch vs bread, at the face of the ſword in the deſert.
label: Lamentations

text: Our skinne was burnt as an ouen, by reaſon of the tempeſts of famine.
label: Lamentations

text: They humbled the wemen in Sion, and the virgins in the cities of Iuda.
label: Lamentations

text: The princes were hanged vp by the hand: they did not reuerence the faces of the ancients.
label: Lamentations

text: Yongmen they abuſed vnchaſtly: and the children fel in wood.
label: Lamentations

text: The ancients decayed out of the gates: the yongmen out of the quier of the ſingers.
label: Lamentations

text: The ioy of our hart hath fayled, our quyre is turned into mourning.
label: Lamentations

text: The crowne of our head is fallen: wo to vs, becauſe we haue ſinned.
label: Lamentations

text: Therfore is our hart made ſorowful, therfore are our eyes darkned.
label: Lamentations

text: For mount Sion, becauſe it is perished, foxes haue walked on it.
label: Lamentations

text: But thou ô Lord shalt remaine for euer, thy throne in generation and to generation.
label: Lamentations

text: Why wilt thou for euer be forgetful of vs? wilt thou forſake vs in length of daies?
label: Lamentations

text: Conuert vs ô Lord to thee, and we shal be conuerted: renew our dayes, as from the beginning.
label: Lamentations

text: But reiecting thou haſt reiected vs, thou art angrie againſt vs excedingly.
label: Lamentations

text: AND theſe be the wordes of the booke, that Baruch the ſonne of Nerias, the ſonne of Maaſias, the ſonne of Sedecias, the ſonne of Sedei, the ſonne of Helcias wrote in Babylon,
label: Baruch

text: in the fifth yeare, in the ſeuenth day of the moneth, at the time that the Chaldees tooke Ieruſalem, and burnt it with fyre.
label: Baruch

text: And Baruch redde the wordes of this booke vnto the eares of Iechonias the ſonne of Ioakim king of Iuda, and to the eares of al the people comming to the booke,
label: Baruch

text: and to the eares of the mightie, the ſonnes of the kinges, and to the eares of the ancients, and to the eares of the people, from the leaſt euen to the greateſt of them, that dwelt in Babylon, by the riuer Sodi.
label: Baruch

text: Who hearing it wept, and faſted, and prayed in the ſight of our Lord.
label: Baruch

text: And they gathered money, according as euerie mans hand was able,
label: Baruch

text: and they ſent into Ieruſalem to Ioakim the ſonne of Helcias, the ſonne of Salom, prieſt, and to the prieſts, and to al the people, that were found with him in Ieruſalem.
label: Baruch

text: When he tooke the veſſels of the temple of our Lord, which had bene taken away out of the temple, to returne them into the Land of Iuda the tenth day of the moneth Siuan, the ſiluer veſſels, which Sedecias the ſonne of Ioſias the king of Iuda made,
label: Baruch

text: after that Nabuchodonoſor king of Babylon had taken Iechonias, and the princes, and al the mightie, and the people of the land from Ieruſalem, and brought them bound into Babylon.
label: Baruch

text: And they ſaid: Behold we haue ſent you money, with the which bye ye holocauſts, and frankincenſe, and make manna, and offer for ſinne at the altar of the Lord our God:
label: Baruch

text: and pray ye for the life of Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon, and for the life of Balthaſar his ſonne, that their dayes may be as the dayes of heauen vpon the earth:
label: Baruch

text: and that our Lord geue vs ſtrength, and illuminate our eyes, that we may liue vnder the shadow of Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon, and vnder the shadow of Balthaſar his ſonne, and may ſerue them manie dayes, and may find grace in their ſight.
label: Baruch

text: And for our ſelues pray ye to the Lord our God: becauſe we haue ſinned to the Lord our God, and his furie is not turned away from vs euen to this day.
label: Baruch

text: And read ye this booke, which we haue ſent to you to be recited in the temple of our Lord, in a ſolemne day, and in a day couenient.
label: Baruch

text: And you shal ſay: To the Lord our God iuſtice: but to vs confuſion of our face: as is this day to al Iuda, and them that dwel in Ieruſalem,
label: Baruch

text: to our kinges, and to our princes, and to our prieſts, and to our prophetes, and to our fathers.
label: Baruch

text: We haue ſinned before the Lord our God, and beleued him not, hauing diffidence in him:
label: Baruch

text: and we would not be made ſubiect to him, and we haue not heard the voice of the Lord our God, to walke in his commandments, which he hath geuen vs.
label: Baruch

text: From the day, that he brought our fathers out of the Land of Ægypt, euen to this day, we would not be brought to beleue the Lord our God: and diſſipated we reuolted, that we might not heare his voice.
label: Baruch

text: And manie euils and maledictions haue clouen to vs, which our Lord appoynted to Moyſes his ſeruant: who brought our fathers out of the Land of Ægypt, to geue vs a land flowing with milke and honie, as at this preſent day.
label: Baruch

text: And we haue not heard the voice of the Lord our God according to al the wordes of the prophets, which he hath ſent to vs:
label: Baruch

text: and we haue gone away euerie man into the ſenſe of our malignant hart, to ſerue ſtrange goddes, doing euils before the eyes of the Lord our God.
label: Baruch

text: FOR the which thing the Lord our God hath eſtablished his word, that he ſpake to vs, and to our iudges, that haue iudged Iſrael, and to our kinges, and to our princes, and to al Iſrael and Iuda:
label: Baruch

text: that our Lord might bring vpon vs great euils, which were not done vnder the heauen, as haue bene done in Ieruſalem, according to the thinges that are written in the law of Moyſes:
label: Baruch

text: that a man should eate the flesh of his ſonne, and the flesh of his daughter.
label: Baruch

text: And he hath geuen them vnder the hand of al the kinges, that are round about vs into reproch, and into deſolation among al peoples, into which our Lord hath diſperſed vs.
label: Baruch

text: And we are made vnderneath, and not aboue: becauſe we haue ſinned to the Lord our God, in not obeying his voice.
label: Baruch

text: To the Lord our God iuſtice: but to vs, and to our fathers confuſion of face, as is this day.
label: Baruch

text: Becauſe our Lord hath ſpoken vpon vs al theſe euils, that are come vpon vs:
label: Baruch

text: and we haue not beſought the face of the Lord our God, to returne euerie one of vs from our moſt wicked waies.
label: Baruch

text: And our Lord hath watched in euils, and hath brought them vpon vs: becauſe our Lord is iuſt in al his workes, which he hath commanded vs:
label: Baruch

text: and we haue not heard his voice to walke in the precepts of our Lord, which he hath geuen before our face.
label: Baruch

text: And now ô Lord God of Iſrael, which brought out thy people out of the Land of Ægypt in a ſtrong hand, and in ſignes, and in wonders, and in thy great ſtrength, and in a mightie arme, and madeſt thee a name as is this day:
label: Baruch

text: we haue ſinned, we haue done impiouſly, we haue dealt vniuſtly ô Lord our God, in al thy iuſtices.
label: Baruch

text: Let thy wrath be turned away from vs: becauſe we are left a few among the nations, where thou haſt diſperſed vs.
label: Baruch

text: Heare ô Lord our prayers, and our petitions, and bring vs out for thine owne ſake: and grant vs to fynde grace before their face, that haue led vs away:
label: Baruch

text: that al the earth may know that thou art the Lord our God, and that thy name is invocated vpon Iſrael, and vpon his ſtocke.
label: Baruch

text: Looke ô Lord from thy holie houſe vpon vs, and incline thine eare, and heare vs.
label: Baruch

text: Open thine eies, & ſee: becauſe the dead that are in hel, whoſe ſpirite is taken from their bowels, shal not geue honour and iuſtification to our Lord:
label: Baruch

text: but the ſoule, that is ſorowful for the greatnes of euil, and goeth crooked, and weake, and the eyes fayling, and the hungrie ſoule geueth glorie and iuſtice to thee their Lord.
label: Baruch

text: For not according to the iuſtices of our fathers doe we powre out prayers, and aske mercie before thy ſight ô Lord our God:
label: Baruch

text: but becauſe thou haſt ſent thy wrath, and thy furie vpon vs, as thou haſt ſpoken by the hande of thy ſeruants the prophets, ſaying:
label: Baruch

text: Thus ſayth our Lord: Bowe downe your shoulder, & your necke, and doe workes for the king of Babylon: and you shal ſitte in the land, which I haue geuen to your fathers.
label: Baruch

text: But if you wil not heare the voice of the Lord your God, to worke for the king of Babylon: I wil make you to faile out of the cities of Iuda, and from without Ieruſalem,
label: Baruch

text: and I wil take from you the voice of mirth, and the voice of ioy, and the voice of the bridegrome, and the voice of the bride, and al the land shal be without foote ſteppe that inhabite it.
label: Baruch

text: And they heard not thy voice, to worke for the king of Babylon: and thou haſt eſtablished thy wordes, which thou ſpakeſt by the handes of thy ſeruants the prophets, that the bones of our kinges, and of our fathers should be tranſported out of their place:
label: Baruch

text: and behold they are caſt forth in the heate of the ſunne, and in the froſt of the night: and they are dead in verie ſore paines, in famine, and by ſword, and by caſting forth.
label: Baruch

text: And haſt made the temple, in which thy name was there invocated, as it is this day, for the iniquitie of the houſe of Iſrael, and of the houſe of Iuda.
label: Baruch

text: And thou haſt done in vs ô Lord our God according to al thy goodnes, and according to al that thy great compaſſion:
label: Baruch

text: as thou ſpakeſt by the hand of thy ſeruant Moyſes, in the day, that thou didſt command him to write thy law before the children of Iſrael,
label: Baruch

text: ſaying: If you wil not heare my voice, this great multitude shal be turned into a verie litle one among the Gentiles, whither I wil diſperſe them:
label: Baruch

text: becauſe I know that the people wil not heare me. for it is a people of a ſtiffe necke: and they shal be conuerted to their hart in the land of their captiuitie:
label: Baruch

text: and they shal knowe that I am the Lord their God: and I wil geue them a hart, and they shal vnderſtand: and eares, and they shal heare.
label: Baruch

text: And they shal praiſe me in the land of their captiuitie, and shal be mindful of my name.
label: Baruch
