text: And they shal turne away them ſelues from their hard backe, and from their malignant workes: becauſe they shal remember the way of their fathers, that ſinned againſt me.
label: Baruch

text: And I wil recal them backe into the land, which I ſware to their fathers, Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob, and they shal haue the dominion therof: and I wil multiplie them, and they shal not be leſned.
label: Baruch

text: And I wil eſtablish vnto them an other teſtament euerlaſting, that I be their God, and they shal be my people: and I wil no more moue my people, the children of Iſrael from the land, that I haue geuen them.
label: Baruch

text: AND now ô Lord omnipotent, God of Iſrael, the ſoule in diſtreſſes, & the penſiue ſpirite cryeth to thee:
label: Baruch

text: heare Lord, and haue mercie, becauſe thou art a merciful God, and haue mercie vpon vs; becauſe we haue ſinned before thee.
label: Baruch

text: Becauſe thou ſitteſt for euer, and shal we perish euerlaſtingly?
label: Baruch

text: O Lord omnipotent, God of Iſrael, heare now the prayer of the dead of Iſrael, and of their children, that haue ſinned before thee, and haue not heard the voice of the Lord their God, and euils haue ſtoocke faſt to vs.
label: Baruch

text: Remember not the iniquities of our fathers, but remember thy hand, and thy name in this time:
label: Baruch

text: becauſe thou art the Lord our God, and we wil praiſe thee ô Lord:
label: Baruch

text: becauſe for this end thou haſt geuen thy feare in our hartes, and that we may inuocate thy name, and may praiſe thee in our captiuitie, becauſe we are conuerted from the iniquitie of our fathers, which haue ſinned before thee.
label: Baruch

text: And behold we are in our captiuitie, this day, wherby thou haſt diſperſed vs into reproch, and into malediction, and into ſinne, according to al the iniquities of our fathers, which haue reuolted from thee ô Lord our God.
label: Baruch

text: Heare Iſrael the commandments of life: harken with your eares, that you may know prudence.
label: Baruch

text: What is the matter Iſrael that thou art in the land of the enemies?
label: Baruch

text: Thou art waxen old in a ſtrange land, thou art defiled with the dead: thou art reputed with them that goe downe into hel.
label: Baruch

text: Thou haſt forſaken the fountaine of wiſdom:
label: Baruch

text: for if thou hadſt walked in the way of God, thou hadſt verely dwelt in peace euerlaſting.
label: Baruch

text: Learne where wiſedom is, where ſtrength is, where vnderſtanding is: that thou mayſt know withal where is the long continuance of life and liuing, where the light of the eyes, and peace is.
label: Baruch

text: Who hath found the place therof? and who hath entered into the treaſures therof?
label: Baruch

text: Where are the princes of the Gentiles, and they that rule ouer the beaſts, that are vpon the earth?
label: Baruch

text: that play with the birdes of the heauen,
label: Baruch

text: that treaſure vp ſiluer, and gold, wherin men haue confidence, and is there no end of their getting? which fashion ſiluer & are careful, neither is there inuention of their workes?
label: Baruch

text: They are deſtroyed, and are gone downe to hel, and others are riſen vp in their place.
label: Baruch

text: Yong men ſaw the light, and dwelt vpon the earth: but the way of diſcipline they knew not,
label: Baruch

text: neither vnderſtood they the pathes therof, neither haue their children receiued it, it is made farre from their face.
label: Baruch

text: It hath not bene heard in the Land of Chanaan, neither hath it bene ſeene in Theman.
label: Baruch

text: The children of Agar alſo, that ſeke out the prudence, that is of the earth, marchants of Merrhe, and of Theman, and fablers, and ſearchers of prudence and vnderſtanding: but the way of wiſedom they haue not knowne, neither haue they remembred the pathes therof.
label: Baruch

text: O Iſrael how great is the houſe of God, and how great is the place of his poſſeſſion!
label: Baruch

text: It is great, and hath no end: high and vnmeſurable.
label: Baruch

text: There were the Giants thoſe renowned, that were from the beginning, of big ſtature, expert in warre?
label: Baruch

text: Theſe did not our Lord chooſe, neither found they the way of diſcipline: therfore did they perish.
label: Baruch

text: And becauſe they had not wiſedom, they perished through their follie.
label: Baruch

text: Who hath aſcended into heauen, and taken her, and brought her downe from the clowdes?
label: Baruch

text: Who hath paſſed ouer the ſea, and found her, and brought her aboue choſen gold?
label: Baruch

text: There is none that can know her waies, nor that can ſearch out her pathes:
label: Baruch

text: but he that knoweth al thinges, knoweth her, & hath found her out by his prudence: he that prepared the earth in time euerlaſting, and replenished it with cattel, and foure footed beaſtes:
label: Baruch

text: he that ſendeth forth light, and it goeth: and hath called it, and it obeyeth him with trembling.
label: Baruch

text: And the ſtarres haue geuen light in their watches, and reioyced:
label: Baruch

text: they were called, and they ſaid: here we are: and they haue shined to him with cheerfulnes, that made them.
label: Baruch

text: This is our God, and there shal none other be eſteemed againſt him.
label: Baruch

text: He found out al the way of diſcipline, and deliuered it to Iacob his ſeruant, and to Iſrael his beloued.
label: Baruch

text: After theſe thinges he was ſene vpon the earth, and was conuerſant with men.
label: Baruch

text: THIS is the booke of the commandments of God, and the law, that is for euer: al that hold it, shal come to life: but they that haue forſaken it, into death.
label: Baruch

text: Returne Iacob, and take hold of it, walke by the way to the brightnes of it, againſt the light therof.
label: Baruch

text: Deliuer not thy glorie to another, & dignitie to a ſtrange nation.
label: Baruch

text: We are bleſſed ô Iſrael: becauſe the thinges that pleaſe God, are manifeſt to vs.
label: Baruch

text: Be of good comfort ô people of God, memorable Iſrael:
label: Baruch

text: you are ſold to the Gentiles, not into perdition: but for that in anger you prouoked God to wrath, you are deliuered to the aduerſaries.
label: Baruch

text: For you haue exaſperated him, that made you, the eternal God, immolating to diuels, and not to God.
label: Baruch

text: For you haue forgotten God, who hath nourished you, and your nource Ieruſalem you haue made ſorowful.
label: Baruch

text: For she ſaw the wrath comming from God to you, and she ſayd: Heare ye confines of Sion, for God hath brought me great mourning:
label: Baruch

text: For I haue ſene the captiuitie of my people, and of my ſonnes, and daughters, which the euerlaſting hath brought vpon them.
label: Baruch

text: For I nourished them with ioyfulnes: but I haue left them with weeping and mourning.
label: Baruch

text: Let no man reioyce ouer me a widow, and deſolate: I am forſaken of manie for the ſinnes of my children, becauſe they haue declined from the law of God.
label: Baruch

text: And his iuſtices they haue not knowne, nor walked by the wayes of Gods commandments, neither haue they entered by the pathes of his truth and iuſtice.
label: Baruch

text: Let the borderers of Sion come, and remember the captiuitie of my ſonnes & daughters, which the euerlaſting hath brought vpon them.
label: Baruch

text: For he hath brought vpon them a nation from a farre, a wicked nation, and of an other tongue:
label: Baruch

text: which haue not reuerenced the ancient, nor pitied the children, & haue led away the beloued of the widow, and made the ſole woman deſolate of children.
label: Baruch

text: But as for me what can I helpe you?
label: Baruch

text: For he that hath brought the euils vpon you, he wil deliuer you out of the handes of your enemies.
label: Baruch

text: walke children, walke: for I am left alone.
label: Baruch

text: I haue put of the ſtole of peace, and I haue put vpon me the ſackcloth of prayer, and I wil crie to the Higheſt in my dayes.
label: Baruch

text: Be of good comfort my children, crie to our Lord, and he wil deliuer you out of the hand of the princes your enemies.
label: Baruch

text: For I haue hoped in the euerlaſting for your ſaluation: & ioy is come to me from the holie one vpon the mercie, which shal come to you from our euerlaſting ſauiour.
label: Baruch

text: For I ſent you forth with mourning and weeping: but our Lord wil bring you backe to me with ioy and gladnes for euer.
label: Baruch

text: For as the neighbours of Sion haue ſeene your captiuitie from God: ſo shal they ſee alſo with celeritie your ſaluation from God, which shal come vpon you with great honour, and euerlaſting brightnes.
label: Baruch

text: Children patiently ſuſtaine the wrath, which is come vpon you: for thyne enemie hath perſecuted thee, but thou shalt quickly ſee his deſtruction: and thou shalt get vp vpon his necke.
label: Baruch

text: My delicate ones haue walked rough waies, for they are led as a flocke taken violently of the enemies.
label: Baruch

text: Be of good comfort children, and crie out to our Lord: for there shal be remembrance of you with him, that hath led you away.
label: Baruch

text: For as your minde hath bene to ſtray from God: ten tymes ſo much shal you returning againe ſeeke him.
label: Baruch

text: For he that hath brought the euils vpon you, he againe wil bring vnto you euerlaſting ioy with your ſaluation.
label: Baruch

text: Be of good comfort Ieruſalem: for he exhorteth thee, that named thee.
label: Baruch

text: The wicked afflicters shal perish, that haue vexed thee: & they that haue reioyced in thy ruine, shal be punished.
label: Baruch

text: The cities which thy children haue ſerued, shal be punished: and she that receiued thy children.
label: Baruch

text: For as she hath reioyced in thy ruine, and bene glad at thy fal: ſo shal she be made ſorowful in her owne deſolation.
label: Baruch

text: And the reioycing of her multitude shal be cut of, & her gladnes shal be turned to mourning.
label: Baruch

text: For fyre shal come vpon her from the euerlaſting in long during dayes, and she shal be inhabited of diuels a great time.
label: Baruch

text: Looke about ô Ieruſalem toward the Eaſt, and ſee the ioy that commeth to thee from God.
label: Baruch

text: For behold thy children come, whom thou haſt let goe diſperſed, they come gathered together from the Eaſt euen to the Weſt, in the word of the holie one reioycing to the honor of God.
label: Baruch

text: PVT of Ieruſalem the robe of mourning, and of thy vexation: and put on the beautie, and honor of that euerlaſting glorie, which thou haſt of God.
label: Baruch

text: God wil cloath thee with the dublet of iuſtice, and wil put vpon thy head the mitre of euerlaſting honour.
label: Baruch

text: For God wil shew his brightnes in thee, which is vnder the heauen.
label: Baruch

text: For thy name shal be named of God to thee for euer: The peace of iuſtice, and honor of pietie.
label: Baruch

text: Ariſe Ieruſalem, and ſtand on high: and looke about toward the Eaſt, and ſee thy children gathered together from the ryſing of the ſunne to the going downe, in the word of the holie reioycing at the memorie of God.
label: Baruch

text: For they went out from thee on foote led by the enimies: but our Lord wil bring them to the exalted into honour as children of the kingdom.
label: Baruch

text: For God hath apoynted to humble euerie high mountaine, and euerlaſting rockes, and to fil vp valleis to be equal with the earth: that Iſrael may walke diligently to the honour of God.
label: Baruch

text: And the woods alſo, and euerie tree of ſweetnes haue ouershadowed Iſrael by the commandment of God.
label: Baruch

text: For God wil bring Iſrael with ioyfulnes in the light of his maieſtie, with mercie, and iuſtice, which is of him.
label: Baruch

text: For the ſinnes that you haue ſinned before God, you shal be led away captiue into Babylon by Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon.
label: Baruch

text: Being entered therfore into Babylon, you shal be there manie yeares, and long times euen vnto ſeuen generations: and after this I wil bring you forth from thence with peace.
label: Baruch

text: But now you shal ſee in Babylon goddes of gold, and of ſiluer, and of ſtone, and of wood to be caried vpon shoulders, shewing feare to the Gentiles.
label: Baruch

text: Beware therfore leſt you alſo be like to the doing of ſtrangers, and you be afrayd, and feare take you in them.
label: Baruch

text: Seeing therfore the multitude adoring behind, and before, ſay you in your hartes: Thou ougheſt to be adored ô Lord.
label: Baruch

text: For mine Angel is with you: and my ſelfe wil aske account of your ſoules.
label: Baruch

text: For their tongue polished by the crafteſman, them ſelues alſo layd ouer with gold, and ſiluer are falſe thinges, and they can not ſpeake.
label: Baruch

text: And as to a virgin that loueth ornaments: ſo taking gold their goddes are forged.
label: Baruch

text: Their goddes certes haue golden crownes vpon their heades: wherof the prieſtes ſecretely conuey away from them gold, and ſiluer, and beſtow it on them ſelues.
label: Baruch

text: Yea and they geue therof to ſtrumpettes, and they decke whores: and againe when they receiue it of the harlots, they decke their goddes.
label: Baruch

text: But theſe are not deliuered from the ruſt, and the moth.
label: Baruch

text: And theſe being couered with a purple garment, they wype their face for the duſt of the houſe, which is very much among them.
label: Baruch

text: And he hath a ſcepter as a man, as a iudge of the countrie, that killeth him not that offendeth againſt him.
label: Baruch

text: He hath alſo in his hand a ſword, and an axe, but him ſelfe he deliuereth not from the ſword, and from robbers, wherby be it knowne to you that they are not goddes.
label: Baruch

text: Therfore feare them not. For as a mans veſſel being broken is made vnprofitable: ſuch alſo are their goddes:
label: Baruch

text: they being placed in the houſe, their eies are ful of duſt by the feete of them that goe in.
label: Baruch

text: And as vpon one, that hath offended the king, the gates be shut round about, or as the dead brought to the graue, ſo doe the prieſtes gard the doores with shuttings, and lockes, leſt they be ſpoyled of theeues.
label: Baruch

text: They light candles to them, and that manie, of the which they can ſee none: but they are as beames in the houſe.
label: Baruch

text: And they ſay that the ſerpents which are of the earth, gnaw out their hartes, whiles they eate them and their garment, and they feele not.
label: Baruch

text: Their faces are blacke with the ſmoke, that is made in the houſe.
label: Baruch

text: The owles, and the ſwallowes flye vpon their bodie, and vpon their head, and the birdes alſo, the cattes in like manner.
label: Baruch

text: Wherby you may knowe that they are not goddes. Therfore feare them not.
label: Baruch

text: The gold alſo which they haue, is for bewtie, vnles a man wype of the ruſt, they shal not shine: for neither when they were moulten, did they feele.
label: Baruch

text: With al price are they bought, whereas there is no breath in them.
label: Baruch

text: As being without feete they are caried vpon shoulders, shewing their baſenes to men. Be they confounded alſo that worship them.
label: Baruch

text: Therfore if they fal to the ground, they riſe not vp of them ſelues, nor if a man ſet him vpright, shal he ſtand by him ſelf, but as to dead men their giftes shal be ſet before them.
label: Baruch

text: Their prieſtes ſel their ſacrifices, and abuſe them: likwiſe alſo their wiues plucking from them, impert nothing, neither to the ſicke, nor to the begger.
label: Baruch

text: Of their ſacrifices wemen in childbed, and in flowers doe touche: knowing therfore by theſe thinges that they are not goddes, feare them not.
label: Baruch

text: For whence are they called goddes? Becauſe wemen offer to the goddes of ſiluer, and gold, and wood:
label: Baruch

text: And prieſtes ſitte in their houſes, hauing their garments rent, and their heades, & beard shauen, whoſe heades be bare.
label: Baruch

text: And they were crying before their goddes, as at the ſupper of the dead.
label: Baruch

text: The prieſts take away their garments, and they cloath their wiues & their children.
label: Baruch

text: Neither if they ſuffer anie euil, nor if anie good of anie man, are they able to recompence it: neither can they make a king, nor take him away:
label: Baruch

text: In like maner they can neither geue riches, nor requyre euil. If a man vow a vow vnto them, and performe it not; neither this doe they require.
label: Baruch

text: They deliuer not a man from death, nor ſaue the weake from the mightier.
label: Baruch

text: The blind man they reſtore not to his ſight: they shal not deliuer a man out of neceſſitie.
label: Baruch

text: They shal not pitie the widow, nor doe good to the fatherleſſe.
label: Baruch

text: Like vnto the ſtones of the mountaine are their goddes, of wood, and of ſtone, and of gold, and of ſiluer. & they that worship them, shal be confounded:
label: Baruch

text: How then is it to be ſuppoſed, or to be ſayd, that they are goddes?
label: Baruch

text: Moreouer the Chldees themſelues not honoring them: who when they heare that the dumme can not ſpeake, they offer it to Bel, requeſting of him, that it may ſpeake.
label: Baruch

text: As though they could feele that haue no motion: and they when they shal vnderſtand, wil leaue them: for their goddes them ſelues haue no ſenſe.
label: Baruch

text: And wemen compaſſed with cordes, ſit in the waies, burning the bones of oliues.
label: Baruch

text: And when one of them being drawen of ſome paſſenger shal lie with him, she vpbraydeth her neighbour, that she is not counted worthie, as her ſelf, neither is her cord broken.
label: Baruch

text: But al thinges that are done about them, are falſe, how is it then to be thought, or to be ſayd, that they be goddes?
label: Baruch

text: And they are made by crafteſmen, & by goldſmithes. They shal be nothing els, but that which the prieſtes wil haue them to be.
label: Baruch

text: For the artificers themſelues, that make them, are of no long time. Why, can thoſe thinges then that are made by them, be goddes?
label: Baruch

text: But they haue left forged things & reproch, to them that shal come after.
label: Baruch

text: For when battel commeth vpon them, and euils: the prieſtes deuiſe with them ſelues, where they may hide them ſelues with them.
label: Baruch

text: How then may they be thought, that they are goddes, which neither deliuer them ſelues from battel, nor ſaue them ſelues from euils?
label: Baruch

text: For ſeing they be of wood, & layd ouer with gold, and with ſiluer, it shal be knowne afterwards that they are falſe thinges, of al the Gentiles, and kinges: Which are manifeſt that they are no goddes, but the workes of mens handes, and no worke of God is with them.
label: Baruch

text: Whence then is it knowne, that they are not goddes, but the workes of mens handes, & no worke of God is in them?
label: Baruch

text: A king to the countrie they raiſe not vp, neither shal they geue rayne to men.
label: Baruch

text: Iudgement alſo they shal not decerne, neither shal they deliuer countries from iniurie: becauſe they can not do nothing, as choughes betwen the heauen and the earth.
label: Baruch

text: For when fire shal fal into the houſe of the woodden, and ſiluer, and golden goddes, their prieſtes in dede shal flee, and be deliuered: but themſelues as beames shal be burnt in the middes.
label: Baruch

text: And king and battel they shal not reſiſt. How is it then to be ſuppoſed, or to be receiued that they are goddes?
label: Baruch

text: Not from theeues, nor from robbers shal the goddes of wood, and of ſtone, and layd ouer with gold, and with ſiluer deliuer them ſelues, ſtronger then which are the wicked men.
label: Baruch

text: The gold, and ſiluer, and the garment where with they are couered, they shal take from them, and shal depart, neither shal they helpe themſelues.
label: Baruch

text: Therfore it is better to be a king shewing his ſtrength: or a profitable veſſel in the houſe, wherin he wil glorie that poſſeſſeth it: or a doore in the houſe, which kepeth the thinges that are therin, then falſe goddes.
label: Baruch

text: The ſunne certes, and the moone, and the ſtarres wheras they are bright, and ſent forth for profitable vſes, obey.
label: Baruch

text: Likewiſe alſo the lightning, when it shal appeare is perſpicuous: and the winde alſo bloweth the ſelf ſame in euerie countrie.
label: Baruch

text: And the clowdes, which when God shal command to walke throughout the whole world, they doe that which is commanded them.
label: Baruch

text: The fyre alſo being ſent from aboue to conſume mountaines, and woodes, doeth that which is commanded it. But theſe neither in shapes, nor in vertues are like to one of them.
label: Baruch

text: Wherfore neither is it to be thought, nor to be ſaid, that they be goddes: wheras they can neither iudge iudgment, nor doe anie thing for men.
label: Baruch

text: Knowing therfore that they are not goddes, then feare them not.
label: Baruch

text: For neither shal they curſe kinges, nor bleſſe them.
label: Baruch

text: Signes alſo in the heauen to the Gentiles they shew not, neither shal they shine as the ſunne, nor geue light as the moone.
label: Baruch

text: Beaſtes are better then they, which can flie vnder the roofe, and profite themſelues.
label: Baruch

text: By no meanes therfore is it manifeſt vnto vs, that they are goddes: for which cauſe feare them not.
label: Baruch

text: For as in a garden of cucumbers a ſcarcrow keepeth nothing, ſo are their goddes of wood, and of ſiluer, and layd ouer with gold.
label: Baruch

text: After the ſame ſorte alſo in a garden the white thorne, vpon the which euerie bird ſitteth. In like manner alſo their goddes of wood, and layd ouer with gold, and with ſiluer, are like to a dead bodie caſt forth in the darke.
label: Baruch

text: By the purple alſo and the murex colour layde vpon them, which fadeth, you shal know that they are not goddes. At the laſt alſo they are conſumed, and shal be a reproch in the countrie.
label: Baruch

text: Better is therfore the iuſt man, that hath not Idols: for he shal be farre from reproches.
label: Baruch

text: AND IT came to paſſe in the thirtith yeare, in the fourth, in the fifth of the moneth, when I was in the middes of the captiues beſide the riuer Chobar, the heauens were opened, and I ſaw the viſions of God.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the fifth of the moneth, the ſame is the fifth yeare of the tranſmigration of king Ioachin,
label: Ezechiel

text: the word of our Lord was made to Ezechiel the ſonne of Buzi prieſt in the land of the Chaldees, by the riuer Chobar: and there the hand of our Lord was made vpon him.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaw, and behold a whirlewinde came from the North: and a great clowde, & a fire inuoluing, and brightnes round about it: & out of the middes therof as it were the forme of amber, that is, out of the middes of the fire:
label: Ezechiel

text: and out of the middes therof the ſimilitude of foure liuing creatures: and this was their look: the ſimilitude of a man in them.
label: Ezechiel

text: There were four faces to one, and foure winges to one.
label: Ezechiel

text: Their feete ſtreight feete, and the ſole of their foote as the ſole of a calues foote, and ſparkes as the forme of glowing braſſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the handes of a man vnder their winges in foure partes: and they had faces, and winges by the foure partes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the winges of them were ioyned one to an other. They returned not when they went: but euerie one went before his face.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſimilitude of their countenance: the face of a man, and the face of a lyon on the right hand of them foure: and the face of an oxe, on the left hand of them foure: and the face of an eagle ouer them foure.
label: Ezechiel

text: And their faces, and their winges were ſtreched out aboue: two winges of euerie one were ioyned, and two couered their bodies:
label: Ezechiel

text: and euerie one of them walked before his face: where the force of the ſpirite was, thither they went: neither did they returne when they went: neither did they returne when they walked.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſimilitude of the liuing creatures, their looke as it were of coales of burning fire, & as it were the reſemblance of lampes. This was the viſion running in the middes of the liuing creatures, brightnes of fire, and from the fire lightening going forth.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the liuing creatures went, and returned after the ſimilitude of gliſtering lightning.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when I beheld the liuing creatures, there appeared one wheele vpon the earth by the liuing creatures, hauing foure faces.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the shape of the wheeles, and the worke of them, as it were apparence of the ſea: and one ſimilitude of them foure: and their apparence and worke, as if it were a wheele in the middes of a wheele.
label: Ezechiel

text: By their foure partes going they went: and they returned not when they walked.
label: Ezechiel

text: There was a ſtature alſo to the wheeles, and height, and a fearful forme: and the whole bodie was ful of eies round about them foure.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when the liuing creatures walked, the wheeles alſo walked together by them: and when the liuing creatures were lifted vp from the earth, the wheeles alſo were lifted vp together.
label: Ezechiel

text: Whitherſoeuer the ſpirit went, thither the ſpirit going, the wheeles alſo were lifted vp withal, folowing it: for the ſpirit of life was in the wheeles.
label: Ezechiel

text: With them going they went, and with them ſtanding they ſtood, and with them lifted vp from the earth, the wheeles alſo were lifted vp together, folowing them: becauſe the ſpirit of life was in the wheeles.
label: Ezechiel

text: And a ſimilitude ouer the heades of the liuing creatures of the firmament, as it were the ſight of chriſtal dreadful, and ſtreched out ouer their heades aboue.
label: Ezechiel

text: And vnder the firmament the winges of them ſtreight one toward an other, euerie one with two winges couered his bodie, and the other was couered in like maner.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I heard the ſound of the winges, as it were the ſound of manie waters, as it were the ſound of the high God, when they walked, it was as the voice of a multitude, as the ſound of a campe, and when they ſtood, their winges were let downe.
label: Ezechiel

text: For when a voice was made aboue the firmament, that was ouer their head, they ſtood, and let downe their winges.
label: Ezechiel

text: And aboue the firmament, that hung ouer their head, as it were the forme of the ſapphire ſtone the ſimilitude of a throne, and vpon the ſimilitude of the throne, a ſimilitude as it were the shape of a man aboue.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaw as it were the forme of amber, as the reſemblance of fire within it round about: from his loines & vpward, and from his loines downward, I ſaw as it were the reſemblance of fire gliſtering round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: As the forme of the bow when it is in a clowde on a day of rayne, this was the forme of the brightnes round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: THIS was the viſion of the ſimilitude of the glorie of our Lord. And I ſaw, and I fel on my face, and I heard the voice of one ſpeaking. And he ſaid to mee: Sonne of man ſtand vpon thy feete, and I wil ſpeake with thee:
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſpirit entered into me after that he ſpake to me, and he ſette me vpon my feete: and I heard him ſpeaking to me,
label: Ezechiel

text: and ſaying: Sonne of man, I ſend thee to the children of Iſrael, to nations apoſtates wich haue reuolted from me: they, and their fathers, haue granſgreſſed my couenant euen vnto this day.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they are children of an hard face, and of an hart that can not be tamed, to whom I ſend thee: and this thou shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith our Lord God:
label: Ezechiel

text: If perhaps they at the leaſt wil heare, and if perhaps they wilceaſe, becauſe it is an exaſperating houſe: and they shal know that there was a prophet in the middes of them.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou therfore ô ſonne of man feare them not, neither be afrayd of their wordes: becauſe the incredulous and ſubuerters are with thee, and thou dwelleſt with ſcorpions. Feare not their wordes, and of their lookes be not afrayd: becauſe it is an exaſperating houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou therefore shalt ſpeake my wordes to them, if perhaps they wil heare, and be quiet, becauſe they are prouokers to anger.
label: Ezechiel

text: But thou ſonne of man heare whatſoeuer I ſpeake to thee: & be not exaſperating, as it is an exaſperating houſe: open thy mouth, and eate whatſoeuer I geue thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I looked, and behold, an hand ſent to me, wherin was a rowled booke: and he ſpred it before me, which was writen within and without: and there were writen in it lamentations, and a ſong, and woe.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND he ſaid to me: Sonne of man whatſoeuer thou shalt finde eate: eate this volume, and going ſpeake to the children of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I opened my mouth, and he fed me with that volume:
label: Ezechiel

text: and he ſaid to me: Sonne of man thy bellie shal eate, and thy bowels shal be filled with this volume, which I geue thee. And I did eate it: and it was made in my mouth ſweete as honie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Sonne of man goe to the houſe of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſpeake my wordes to them.
label: Ezechiel

text: For not to a people of profound ſpeach, and of an vnknowne tongue art thou ſent, to the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: Neither to manie peoples of profound ſpeach, & of an vnknowne tongue, whoſe wordes thou canſt not heare: and if thou were ſent to them, they would heare thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: But the houſe of Iſrael wil not heare thee: becauſe they wil not heare me. for al the houſe of Iſrael is of a shameles forehead, and hard hatted.
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold I haue made thy face ſtronger then their faces, and thy forehead harder then their foreheads.
label: Ezechiel

text: As the adamant, and as the flint ſtone haue I made thy face: feare them not, neither be afrayd of their face: becauſe it is an exaſperating houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Sonne of man, al my wordes which I ſpeake to thee, take in thy hart, and heare with thine eares:
label: Ezechiel

text: And goe, enter into the tranſmigration, to the children of thy people, and thou shalt ſpeake to them, and shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith our Lord God: if perhaps they wil heare, and be quiet.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſpirit tooke me vp, and I heard behinde me the voice of a great commotion: Bleſſed be the glorie of our Lord from his place,
label: Ezechiel

text: and the voice of the winges of liuing creatures ſtriking one againſt an other, & the voice of wheeles folowing the liuing creatures, and the voice of a great commotion.
label: Ezechiel

text: The ſpirit alſo lifted me, & tooke me vp: & I went away bitter in the indignation of my ſpirit: for the hand of our Lord was with me, ſtrengthening me.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I came to the tranſmigration, to the heape of new corne, to them, that dwelt by the riuer Chobar, and I ſate where they ſate: and I taried there ſeuen dayes mourning in the middes of them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when ſeuen dayes, were paſſed, the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, a watchman to the houſe of Iſrael haue I geuen thee: and thou shalt heare the word out of my mouth, and shalt tel it them from me.
label: Ezechiel

text: If when I ſay to the impious: Dying thou shalt dye: thou tel him not, nor ſpeake that he may be turned away from his impious way, and liue: the ſame impious man shal dye in his iniquitie, but his bloud I wil requyre at thy hand.
label: Ezechiel

text: But if thou denounce to the impious, and he be not conuerted from his impietie, and from his impious way: he verely shal dye in his iniquitie, but thou haſt deliuered thy ſoule.
label: Ezechiel

text: Yea and if the iuſt shal be turned from his iuſtice, & shal doe iniquitie: I wil lay a ſtumbling blocke before him, he shal dye: becauſe thou haſt not told him, he shal dye in his ſinne, and his iuſtices which he hath done shal not be in memorie: but his bloud I wil require at thy hand.
label: Ezechiel

text: But if thou warne the iuſt that the iuſt ſinne not, and he doe not ſinne: liuing he shal liue, becauſe thou haſt warned him, and thou haſt deliuered thy ſoule.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the hand of our Lord was made vpon me, and he ſaid to me: Riſing goe out into the fielde, and there I wil ſpeake with thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: And riſing I went out into the filde: and behold the glorie of our Lord ſtood there as it were the glorie, which I ſaw by the riuer Chobar: and I fel on my face:
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſpirit entered into me, and ſet me vpon my feete: and he ſpake to me, and ſayd to me: Goe in, and be shut vp in the middes of thy houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou ſonne of man, behold bandes are geuen vpon thee, and they shal binde thee in them: and thou shalt not goe forth from the middes of them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make thy tongue cleaue to the roofe of thy mouth, and thou shalt be dumme, not as a man controwling: becauſe it is an exaſperating houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: But when I shal ſpeake to thee, I wil open thy mouth, and thou shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith our Lord God: He that heareth, let him heare: and he that is quiet, let him be quiet: becauſe it is an exaſperating houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND thou ſonne of man take thee a bricke, & thou shalt put it before thee: and thou shalt draw in it the citie of Ieruſalem.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt lay ſiege againſt it, and shalt build munitions, and caſt vp a bancke, and pitch campes againſt it, and place engines round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou take thee an yron frying panne, and thou shalt ſet it as an yron wal betwen thee & the citie: and thou shalt ſet thy face ſtedely toward it, and it shal be beſieged, and thou shalt compaſſe it: which is a ſigne to the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt ſleepe vpon thy left ſide, and shalt put the iniquities of the houſe of Iſrael vpon it, according to the number of the daies, that thou shalt ſleepe vpon it, and thou shalt take their iniquitie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I haue geuen thee the yeares of their iniquitie, according to the number of daies three hundred and ninetie daies: and thou shalt beare the iniquitie of the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when thou haſt accomplished theſe thinges, thou shalt ſleepe vpon thy right ſide the ſecond time: and thou shalt take the iniquitie of the houſe of Iuda fourtie daies. a day for a yeare, a day, I ſay, for a yeare I haue geuen thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt turne thy face to the ſiege of Ieruſalem, and thine arme shal be ſtreched out: and thou shalt prophecie againſt it.
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold I haue compaſſed thee with bandes: and thou shalt not turne thy ſelf from thy ſide vnto the other ſide, til thou accomplish the daies of thy ſiege.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou take thee wheate and barley, and beanes, and lintiles, and millet, and fitches: and thou shalt put them into one veſſel, and make thee loaues according to the number of the daies, that thou shalt ſleepe vpon thy ſide: three hundred and ninetie daies shalt thou eate it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thy meate, that thou shalt eate, shal be in weight twentie ſtaters a day: from time to time thou shalt eate it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And water by meaſure thou shalt drinke, the ſixt part of an hin: from time to time thou shalt drinke it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And as hearth baken barley bread thou shalt eate it: and with the dung that commeth out of a man, thou shalt couer it before their eies.
label: Ezechiel

text: And our Lord ſaid: So shal the children of Iſrael eate their bread polluted among the Gentils, to the which I shal caſt them out.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaid: A, a, a, ô Lord God, behold my ſoule is not polluted, & a dead thing, and thing torne of beaſtes I haue not eaten from mine infancie euen til this time, and al vncleane flesh hath not entered into my mouth.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Behold I haue geuen thee dung of oxen for mans dung, and thou shalt make thy bread therwith.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Sonne of man: Behold I wil breake the ſtaffe of bread in Ieruſalem: and they shal eate bread in weight, and in carefulnes: and they shal drinke water in meaſure, and in diſtreſſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: That bread and water fayling, euerie man may fal againſt his brother, & they may pine away in their iniquities.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND thou ſonne of man take thee a sharpe knife, shauing the heares: and thou shalt take it and draw it ouer thy head, and ouer thy beard: and thou shalt take thee a ballance of weight, and shalt diuide them.
label: Ezechiel

text: The third part thou shalt burne with fire in the middes of the citie, according to the accomplishing of the dayes of the ſiege: and thou shalt take a third part, and cut it with the knife in the circuite therof: but the other third part thou shalt ſcatter into the wind, and I wil draw the ſword after them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt take therof a ſmal number: and shalt binde them in the skirt of thy cloke.
label: Ezechiel

text: And of them againe thou shalt take, and shalt caſt them forth in the middes of the fire, and shalt burne them with fire: and out of it shal come forth a fire into al the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: This is Ieruſalem, I placed her in the middes of the Gentils, and countries round about her.
label: Ezechiel

text: And ſhe hath contemned my iudgements, ſo that she was more impious then the Gentils: and my precepts more then the landes, that are round about her. For they haue caſt away my iudgements, and in my precepts they haue not walked.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Becauſe you haue paſſed the Gentils, that are round about you, & haue not walked in my precepts, & haue not done my iudgements, and according to the iudgements of the nations, which are round about you, you haue not wrought.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I to thee, and I my ſelf wil do iudgements, in the middes of thee in the eyes of the Gentils.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil doe in thee that which I haue not done: and the like wherof I wil doe no more for al thine abominations.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore the fathers shal eate the ſonnes in the middes of thee, and the ſonnes shal eate their fathers: and I wil doe iudgements in thee, and I wil ſcatter al thy remnant into euerie winde.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore I liue, ſaith our Lord God: Vnles for that thou haſt violated my ſanctuarie in al thine offences, and in al thine abominations: I alſo doe breake thee, and mine eye shal not ſpare, and I wil not haue mercie.
label: Ezechiel

text: The third part of thee shal dye with the peſtilence, & shal be conſumed with famine in the middes of thee: and a third part of thee shal fal by the ſword round about thee: and thy third part I wil ſcatter into euerie wind, and I wil draw a ſword after them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil accomplish my furie, & wil make mine indignation reſt in them, and wil be comforted: & they shal know that I the Lord haue ſpoken in my zele, when I shal haue accomplished mine indignation in them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make thee a deſert, and a reproch to the nations, that are round about thee, in the ſight of euerie one that paſſeth by.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt be a reproch, and blaſpemie, an example, and aſtonishment amongſt the nations, that are round about thee, when I shal haue done iudgements in thee in furie, and in indignation, and in the rebukes of anger.
label: Ezechiel

text: I the Lord haue ſpoken: When I shal ſend verie ſore arrowes of famine vpon them: which shal be mortiferous, and which I shal ſend to deſtroy you: and I wil gather famine vpon you, and wil breake among you the ſtaffe of bread.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſend in vpon you famine, and very ſore beaſtes euen to deſtruction: and peſtilence, and bloud shal paſſe through thee, and the ſword I wil bring in vpon thee. I the Lord haue ſpoken.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man ſet thy face toward the mountaines of Iſrael, and thou shalt prophecie to them,
label: Ezechiel

text: and shalt ſay: Mountaynes of Iſrael heare ye the word of our Lord God: Thus ſaith our Lord God to the mountaines, and litle hilles, and to the rockes, & the vallees: Behold I wil bring vpon you the ſword, and wil deſtroy your excelſes,
label: Ezechiel

text: and caſt downe your altars, and your idols shal be broken: and I wil ouerthrow your ſlaine before your idols.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil lay the carcaſſes of the children of Iſrael before the face of your idols: and I wil diſperſe your bones about your altars
label: Ezechiel

text: in al your habitations. The cities shal be deſolate, and the excelſes shal be caſt downe, and deſtroyed, and your altars shal perish, and shal be broken: and your idols shal ceaſe, and your temples shal be deſtroyed, and your workes shal be defaced.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſlaine shal fal in the middes of you: and you shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil leaue in you them, that shal eſcape the ſword in the Gentils, when I shal diſperſe you in the landes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And your deliuered shal remember me amongſt the Gentils, to which they are led captiuitie: becauſe I haue broken their hart fornicating, and reuolting from me: and their eyes fornicating after their idols: and they shal miſlike with them ſelues vpon the euils which they had done in al their abominations.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal know that I the Lord haue not ſpoken in vaine to do them this euil.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Strike thy hand, and knocke thy foote, and ſay: Alas, to al the abominations of the euils of the houſe of Iſrael: becauſe they shal fal by ſword, famine, and peſtilence.
label: Ezechiel

text: He that is far of, shal dye with peſtilence: and he that is nere, shal fal by the ſword: and he that shal be left, and beſieged, shal dye for famine: and I wil accomplish mine indignation in them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you shal know that I am the Lord, when your ſlaine shal be amongſt the middes of your idols, in the circuit of your altars, in euerie high hil, & in al the toppes of mountaines, and vnder euerie wooddie tree, and vnder euerie oake with thicke branches, the place where they burnt frankincenſe ſmelling ſweetly to al their idols.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſtrech forth my hand vpon them: and wil make the land deſolate, and deſtitute from the deſert of Deblatha in al their habitations: and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou ſonne of man, thus ſaith our Lord God to the land of Iſrael: The end is come, come is the end vpon the foure quarters of the land.
label: Ezechiel

text: Now an end vpon thee, and I wil ſend my furie vpon thee: and I wil iudge thee according to thy wayes: and I wil lay againſt thee al thine abominations.
label: Ezechiel

text: And vpon thee mine eye shal not ſpare, and I wil not haue mercie: but I wil lay thy waies vpon thee, and thyne abominations shal be in the middes of thee: and you shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: One affliction, loe affliction cometh.
label: Ezechiel

text: An end cometh, there cometh an end, it hath awaked againſt thee: behold it commeth.
label: Ezechiel

text: Deſtruction commeth vpon thee, which dwelleſt in the land: the time commeth, the day of ſlaughter is nere, and not of the glorie of mountaines.
label: Ezechiel

text: Now ſtreightway I powre out my wrath vpon thee, and I wil accomplish my furie in thee: and I wil iudge thee according to thy wayes, and I wil lay vpon thee al thy wicked deedes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And mine eye shal not ſpare, neither wil I haue mercie: but I wil lay thy wayes vpon thee, and thine abominations shal be in the middes of thee: and you shal know that I am the Lord that ſtrike.
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold the day, behold it commeth: deſtruction is gone forth, the rod hath floorished, pride hath budded.
label: Ezechiel

text: Iniquitie is riſen in the rodde of impietie: not of them, and not of the people, nor of the ſound of them: and there shal be no reſt in them.
label: Ezechiel

text: The time commeth, the day is at hand: he that bieth let him not reioyce: and he that ſelleth, let him not mourne: becauſe wrath vpon al the people therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe he that ſelleth, shal not returne to that, which he hath ſold, and as yet in the liuing the life of them. For the viſion shal not goe backe to al the multitude therof: and man in the iniquitie of his life shal not be ſtrengthened.
label: Ezechiel

text: Sound you with the trumpet, let al be prepared, and there is none to go to the battel: for my wrath shal be vpon al the people therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: The ſword without: and the peſtilence, and famine within: he that is in the filde shal dye by the ſword: and they that are in the citie, shal be deuoured with the peſtilence, and famine.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thoſe of them that flee shal be ſaued: and they shal be in the mountaines as doues of the valleis al trembling, euerie one in his iniquitie.
label: Ezechiel

text: Al handes shal be diſſolued, and al knees shal runne with waters.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal gird themſelues with hearecloathes, and feare shal couer them; and in euerie face confuſion, and vpon al their heades baldnes.
label: Ezechiel

text: Their ſiluer shal be throwne forth, and their gold shal be into a dunghil. Their ſiluer, and their gold shal not be able to deliuer them in the day of the furie of our Lord. Their ſoule they shal not ſatisfie, and their bellies shal not be filled: becauſe it is made a ſcandal of their iniquitie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ornament of their Iewels they haue turned into pride, and the images of their abominations, and idols they haue made of it: for this cauſe haue I geuen it them into vncleanes:
label: Ezechiel

text: and I wil geue it into the handes of aliens to ſpoyle, and to the impious of the earth for a praye, and they shal contaminate it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil turne away my face from them, & they shal violate my ſecrete: and ſpoylers shal enter into it, and shal contaminate it.
label: Ezechiel

text: Make a concluſion: becauſe the land is ful of the iudgement of bloud, and the citie ful of iniquitie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil bring the worſt of the nations, and they shal poſſeſſe their houſes: and I wil make the pride of the mightie to ceaſe, and they shal poſſeſſe their ſanctuarie.
label: Ezechiel

text: Diſtreſſe comming vpon them, they wil ſeeke peace, and there shal be none.
label: Ezechiel

text: Truble shal come vpon truble, and report vpon report, and they shal ſeeke viſion of the prophete, and the law shal perish from the prieſt, and counſel from the ancientes.
label: Ezechiel

text: The king shal mourne, and the prince shal be clothed with ſorowfulnes, and the handes of the people of the land shal be trubled. According to their way wil I doe to them, and according to their iudgements I wil iudge them: and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND it came to paſſe in the ſixt yeare, in the ſixt moneth, in the fifth of the moneth: I ſate in my houſe, and the ancients of Iuda ſate before me, and the hand of our Lord God fel there vpon me.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaw, and behold a ſimilitude as it were the reſemblance of fire: from the reſemblance of his loynes, and downeward, fire: and from his loynes, and vpward, as it were the reſemblance of brightnes, as the appearance of amber.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſimilitude of a hand put forth tooke me by the lockes of my head: and the ſpirite lifted me vp betwen the earth and the heauen, and brought me into Ieruſalem in the viſion of God, beſide the inner doore, that looked to the North, where was ſet an idol of zele to prouoke emulation.
label: Ezechiel

text: And loe there the glorie of the God of Iſrael according to the viſion which I had ſeene in the filde.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Sonne of man, lift vp thine eyes to the way of the North. And I lifted vp mine eyes to the way of the North: and behold on the North of the porte of the altar the idol of zele in the verie entrie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Sonne of man, doeſt thou ſee thinkeſt thou what theſe doe, the great abominations, that the houſe of Iſrael doth here, that I may depart far from my ſanctuarie? and yet turning thou shalt ſee greater abominations.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me into the doore of the court: and I ſaw, and behold one hole in the wal.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Sonne of man digge the wal. And when I had digged the wal, there appered one doore.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Goe in, and ſee the moſt wicked abominations, which theſe doe here.
label: Ezechiel

text: And being entered in I ſaw, and behold euerie ſimilitude of creeping creatures, and of beaſts, abomination, and al the idols of the houſe of Iſrael were painted in the wal round about through out.
label: Ezechiel

text: And ſeuentie men of the ancients of the houſe of Iſrael, and Iezonias the ſonne of Saphan ſtood in the middes of them, that ſtood before the pictures: and euerie one had a cenſar in his hand: and a vapour of a clowde roſe vp from the frankincenſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Surely thou ſeeſt ſonne of man what thinges the ancients of the houſe of Iſrael, doe in darkenes, euerie one in the ſecret of his chamber: for they ſay: Our Lord ſeeth vs not, our Lord hath forſaken the earth.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Yet turning thou shalt ſee greater abominations, which theſe doe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me in by the doore of the gate of the houſe of our Lord, which looked to the North: and behold their wemen ſate mourning for Adonis.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Surely thou haſt ſene ô ſonne of man: yet turning thou shalt ſee greater abominations then theſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me into the inner court of the houſe of our Lord: and behold in the doore of the temple of our Lord betwen the porch and the altar, as it were fiue and twentie men hauing their backes againſt the temple of our Lord, and their faces to the Eaſt: and they adored toward the riſing of the ſunne.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Surely thou haſt ſene ô ſonne of man: why, is this a light thing to the houſe of Iuda, that they should doe theſe abominations, which they haue done here: becauſe they replenishing the land with iniquitie, are turned to prouoke me? and behold they put a bough to their noſthrels.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore I alſo wil doe in my furie: mine eye shal not ſpare, neither wil I haue mercie: and when they shal crie to mine eares with a lowd voice, I wil not heare them.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND he cried in mine eares with a lowd voice, ſaying: The viſitations of the citie approch, and euerie one hath a weapon of ſlaughter in his hand.
label: Ezechiel

text: And behold ſix men came from the way of the vpper gate, which looketh to the North: and euerie mans weapon of deſtruction in his hand: one man alſo in the middes of them was clothed with linnen garments, and the inkehorne of a writer at his reines: and they entered in, and ſtood by the braſen altar.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the glorie of the Lord of Iſrael was taken vp from the Cherub, which was ouer him to the threshold of the houſe: and he called the man, that was clothed with the linnen garments, and had the inckhorne of a writer on his loynes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And our Lord ſaid to him: Paſſe through the middes of the citie in the middes of Ieruſalem: and ſigne Thau vpon the foreheades of the men that mourne, and lament vpon al the abominations, that are done in the middes therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: And to them he ſaid in my hearing: Paſſe through the citie folowing him, and ſtrike: let not your eye ſpare, neither haue ye mercie.
label: Ezechiel

text: The old, the yong man, and the virgin, the litle one, and the wemen kil to vtter deſtruction: but euery one vpon whom you shal ſee Thau, kil not, and begin ye at my Sanctuarie. They began therfore at the ancient men, which were before the face of the houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to them: Contaminate the houſe, & fil the courtes with the ſlaine: goe ye forth. And they went forth, and ſtroke them that were in the citie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſlaughter being accomplished I remained: and I fel vpon my face, and crying: I ſaid Alas, alas, alas ô Lord God, wilt thou then deſtroy al the remnant of Iſrael, powring out thy furie vpon Ieruſalem?
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: The iniquitie of the houſe of Iſrael, and Iuda is exceeding great, and the land is replenished with bloud, and the citie is replenished with auerſion: for they haue ſaid: Our Lord hath forſaken the earth, and our Lord ſeeth not.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore mine eye alſo shal not ſpare, neither wil I haue mercie: I wil requite their way vpon their head.
label: Ezechiel

text: And behold the man, that was clothed with the linnen garments, that had the inkehorne at his backe, anſwered a word, ſaying: I haue done as thou haſt commanded me.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND I ſaw, and behold in the firmament, that was ouer the head of the Cherubs, as it were the ſapphire ſtone, as it were the forme of the ſimilitude of a throne appeared ouer them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſpake to the man, that was clothed with the linnen garments, and ſayd: Goe in the middes of the wheeles that are vnder the Cherubs, and fil thy hand with the coles of fyre, that are betwen the Cherubs, & powre them out vpon the citie. And he went in, in my ſight:
label: Ezechiel

text: and the Cherubs ſtood on the right hand of the houſe, when the man went in, and a cloude filled the inner court.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the glorie of our Lord was lifted vp from aboue the Cherub to the threshold of the houſe: and the houſe was replenished with the cloude, and the court was replenished with the brightnes of the glorie of our Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſound of the winges of the Cherubs was heard euen to the vtter court, as it were the voice of God almightie ſpeaking.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when he had commanded the man, that was clothed with the linnen garments, ſaying: Take fyre from the middes of the wheeles, that are betwen the Cherubs: he being gone in ſtood beſide the wheele.
label: Ezechiel

text: And a Cherub ſtreched out his hand from the middes of the Cherubs to the fyre, that was betwen the Cherubs: and he tooke, & gaue into his handes, that was clothed with the linnen garments: who taking it went forth.
label: Ezechiel

text: And there appeared in the Cherubs the ſimilitude of a mans hand vnder their winges.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaw, and behold foure wheeles by the Cherubs: one wheele by one Cherub, and an other wheele by one Cherub: and the forme of the wheeles was as it were the reſemblance of the ſtone Chryſolithus:
label: Ezechiel

text: and their reſemblance, one ſimilitude to the foure: as it were a wheele in the middes of a wheele.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when they walked, they went into foure partes: and they returned not walking: but to the place, wherunto, that which was firſt, declined, the reſt alſo folowed, neither did they turne.
label: Ezechiel

text: And al their bodie, and neckes, and handes, and winges, and the circles were ful of eyes, in the circuite of the foure wheeles.
label: Ezechiel

text: And theſe wheeles he called voluble, my ſelf hearing it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And one had foure faces: one face, the face of a Cherub, and the ſecond face, the face of a man: and in the third the face of a lyon: and in the fourth the face of an eagle.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the Cherubs were lifted vp: the ſame is the liuing creature, that I had ſene by the riuer Chobar.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when the Cherubs walked, the wheeles alſo went together by them: and when the Cherubs lifted vp their winges, to be rayſed vp from the earth, the wheeles reſted not, but alſo were beſyde them.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thoſe ſtanding, they ſtood: and with them lifted vp they were lifted vp. For the ſpirit of life was in them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the glorie of our Lord went forth from the threshold of the temple: and ſtood ouer the Cherubs.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the Cherubs lifting vp their winges, were exalted from the earth before me: and they going forth, the wheeles alſo folowed: and it ſtood in the entry of the eaſt gate of the houſe of our Lord: and the glorie of the God of Iſrael was ouer them.
label: Ezechiel

text: The ſame is the liuing creature, which I ſaw vnder the God of Iſrael by the riuer Chobar? and I vnderſtood that they were Cherubs.
label: Ezechiel

text: Foure faces to one, and foure winges to one: and the ſimilitude of a mans hand vnder their winges.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſimilitude of their faces, the ſame faces, which I had ſeene by the riuer Chobar, and the lookes of them, and the ſway of euerie one to goe before his face.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the ſpirite lifted me vp, and brought me into the eaſt gate of the houſe of our Lord, which looketh to the ryſing of the ſunne: and behold in the entrie of the gate fiue and twentie men: and I ſaw in the middes of them Iezonias the ſonne of Azur, and Pheltias the ſonne of Banaias the princes of the people.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Sonne of man, theſe are the men, that conceiue iniquitie, and deuiſe moſt wicked counſel in this citie,
label: Ezechiel

text: ſaying: Were not houſes builded of late? This is the caldron, and we the flesh.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore prophecie of them, prophecie thou ſonne of man.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſpirit of our Lord fel vpon me, and ſaid to me: Speake: Thus ſaith our Lord: So haue you ſpoken ô houſe of Iſrael, and the cogitations of your hart I know.
label: Ezechiel

text: Very manie haue you killed in this citie, and you haue filled the wayes therof with the ſlaine.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Your ſlaine, whom you haue layd in the middes therof, theſe are the flesh, and this is the caldron: and I wil bring you out of the middes therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: The ſword you haue feared, and the ſword I wil bring vpon you, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil caſt you out of the middes therof, and I wil geue you into the hand of the enemies, and wil doe iudgements in you.
label: Ezechiel

text: You shal fal by the ſword: in the borders of Iſrael wil I iudge you, and you shal knowe that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: This shal not be as a caldron to you, and you shal not be as flesh in the middes therof, in the borders of Iſrael I wil iudge you.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you shal know that I am the Lord: becauſe you haue not walked in my precepts, & haue not done my iudgments, but you haue done according to the iudgements of nations, that are round about you.
label: Ezechiel

text: And it came to paſſe, when I prophecied, Pheltias the ſonne of Banaias died: and I fel vpon my face crying with a lowd voice: & ſayd: Alas, alas, alas, ô Lord God: makeſt thou a conſumation of the remnant of Iſrael?
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man thy bretheren, thy bretheren, thy kinſmen, & al the houſe of Iſrael, al to whom the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem haue ſayd: Depart ye far from our Lord, the land is geuen to vs in poſſeſſion.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſayth our Lord God: Becauſe I haue made them far of in the Gentils, and becauſe I haue diſperſed them in the landes: I wil be a litle ſanctification to them in the landes, to which they are come.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore ſpeake: Thus ſayth our Lord God: I wil gather you out of the peoples, and vnite you out of the landes, wherin you are diſperſed, & I wil geue you the ground of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal goe in thither, and shal take away al the offences, and al the abominations therof out of it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil geue them one hart, and wil geue a new ſpirite in their bowels: and I wil take away the ſtonie hart out of their flesh, and wil geue them a fleshie hart:
label: Ezechiel

text: that they may walke in my precepts, and keepe my iudgements, and doe them: and they may be my people, and I may be their God.
label: Ezechiel

text: Whoſe hart walketh after their offences and abominations, their way wil I lay on their head, ſayth our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the Cherubs lifted vp their winges, and the wheeles with them: and the glorie of the God of Iſrael was ouer them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the glorie of our Lord aſcended from the middes of the citie, & ſtood ouer the mount, that is on the eaſt ſide of the citie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſpirite lifted me vp, and brought me into Chaldee to the tranſmigration, in a viſion in the ſpirite of God: and the viſion which I had ſeene was taken vp from me.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſpake to the tranſmigration al the wordes of our Lord, which he had shewed me.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man thou dweleſt in the middes of an exaſperating houſe: which haue eyes to ſee, and ſee not: and eares to heare, and heare not: becauſe it is an exaſperating houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou therfore ô ſonne of man, make thee veſſels of tranſmigration, and thou shalt flitte by day before them: and thou shalt flitte out of thy place to an other place in their ſight, if perhaps they wil behold: becauſe it is an exaſperating houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt carie forth thy veſſels as the veſſels of one flitting by day in the ſight of them: and thou shalt goe forth at euen before them, as one goeth forth that flitteth.
label: Ezechiel

text: Before their eyes dig to thee through the wall: and thou shalt goe forth through it.
label: Ezechiel

text: In their ſight on shoulders thou shalt be caried, in the darke thou shalt be caried out: thou shalt couer thy face, & shalt not ſee the earth: becauſe I haue geuen thee a portending ſigne to the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: I did therfore as he had commanded me: I caried my veſſels as the veſſels of one flitting by day: and at euen I digged to me through the wall with my hand: and I went forth in the darke, and was caried on shoulders in their ſight.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me in the morning, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, hath not the houſe of Iſrael the exaſperating houſe ſayd to thee: What doeſt thou?
label: Ezechiel

text: Say to them: Thus ſayth our Lord God: This burden vpon the prince, that is in Ieruſalem, and vpon al the houſe of Iſrael, which is in the middes of them.
label: Ezechiel

text: Say: I am your portending ſigne, as I haue done, ſo shal it be done to them. into tranſmigration, and into captiuitie shal they goe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the prince, that is in the middes of them, shal be caried on shoulders, he shal goe forth in the darke: they shal digge through the wal to bring him out: his face shal be couered, that he may not ſee the earth with his eye.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſtrech forth my nette vpon him, and he shal be taken in my net: and I wil bring him into Babylon into the land of the Chaldees, and he shal not ſee it, and there he shal dye.
label: Ezechiel

text: And al that are about him, his gard, & his troupes I wil diſperſe into euerie wind: and I wil draw the ſword after them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal know that I am the Lord, when I shal haue diſperſed them in the Gentils, and ſcattered them in the landes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil leaue of them a few men from the ſword, & the famine, and the peſtilence: that they may declare al their wicked deeds in the Gentils, to which they shal enter: and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made vnto me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, eate thy breade in truble: yea and drinke thy water in haſt, & ſorowfulnes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt ſay to the people of the land: Thus ſayth our Lord God to them, that dwel in Ieruſalem in the land of Iſrael: Their bread they shal eate in carefulnes, and their water in deſolation they shal drinke: that the land may be made deſolate from the multitude therof, for the iniquitie of al that dwel therin.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the cities, that are now inhabited, shal be deſolate, and the land deſert: and you shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, what is this prouerbe with you in the land of Iſrael? ſaying: The dayes shal be differred to a long time, & al viſion shal perish.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore ſay to them: Thus ſayth our Lord God: I wil make this prouerb ceaſe, neither shal it anie more be commonly ſayd in Iſrael: and ſpeake to them that the dayes are at hand, and the word of euerie viſion.
label: Ezechiel

text: for al viſion shal no more be in vaine, nor diuination ambiguous in the middes of the children of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe I the Lord wil ſpeake: and what word ſoeuer I shal ſpeake, shal alſo be done, it shal not be prolonged anie more: but in your dayes ye exaſperating houſe, wil I ſpeake the word, & wil doe it, ſayth our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, behold the houſe of Iſrael, they that ſay: The viſion, that this man ſeeth, is for manie dayes: and this man prophecieth long times.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore ſay to them: Thus ſayth our Lord God: Euerie word of mine shal be prolonged no further: the word that I shal ſpeake, shal be accomplished, ſayth our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man prophecie to the prophetes of Iſrael, that prophecie: and thou shalt ſay to them, that prophecie of their owne hart: Heare ye the word of our Lord:
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſayth our Lord God: Wo to the foolish prophetes: which folow their owne ſpirite, and ſee nothing.
label: Ezechiel

text: As foxes in the deſertes, were thy prophetes ô Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: You haue not aſcended againſt, nor oppoſed a wal for the houſe of Iſrael, that you might ſtand in battel in the day of our Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: They ſee vayne thinges, and they diuine lies, ſaying: Our Lord ſayth: whereas our Lord ſent them not: and they perſeuered to confirme the word.
label: Ezechiel

text: Why haue you not ſeene vayne viſion, and ſpoken lying diuination? and you ſay: Our Lord ſaith; wheras I haue not ſpoken.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Becauſe you haue ſpoken vaine thinges, and haue ſeene lies: therfore behold I to you, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And my hand shal be vpon the prophetes, that ſee vaine thinges, and diuine a lie: in the counſel of my people they shal not be, and in the ſcripture of the houſe of Iſrael they shal not be written, neither shal they enter into the land of Iſrael: and you shal know that I am the Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: For that they haue deceiued my people, ſaying: Peace, and there is not peace: and he builded the wal, and they daubed it with morter without ſtraw.
label: Ezechiel

text: Say to them, that daube without tempering, that it shal fal: for there shal be a shower ouerflowing, and I wil geue very great ſtones falling violently from aboue, and the wind of a ſtorme diſſipating.
label: Ezechiel

text: for in dede behold the wal is fallen: shal it not be ſayd to you: Where is the dawbing, that you dawbed?
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſayth our Lord God: And I wil make the ſpirite of tempeſts to breake forth in myne indignation, and there shal be an ouerflowing shower in my furie: and great ſtones in my wrath vnto conſumption.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil deſtroy the wal, that you haue dawbed without tempering: and I wil make it euen with the ground, and the fundation therof shal be reueled: and it shal fal, and shal be conſumed in the middes therof: and you shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil accomplish myne indignation in the wal, & in them, that daube it without tempering, and I wil ſay to you: The wal is not, and they are not that daube it.
label: Ezechiel

text: The prophetes of Iſrael, which prophecie to Ieruſalem, and ſee viſion of peace for it: and there is not peace, ſayth our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou ſonne of man, put thy face againſt the daughters of thy people, which prophecie of their owne hart: and doe thou prophecie vpon them,
label: Ezechiel

text: and ſay: Thus ſayth our Lord God: Wo to them that ſow cushions vnder euerie cubite of the hand: and make pillowes vnder the head of euerie age to catch ſoules: and when they caught the ſoules of my people, they did viuificate their ſoules.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they violated me to my people, for a handful of barley, and a cantel of bread, that they might kil the ſoules, which dye not, and viuificate the ſoules which liue not, lying to my people, that beleeueth lies.
label: Ezechiel

text: For this cauſe thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I to your cushions, wherwith you catche flying ſoules: and I wil breake them from your armes: and I wil let goe the ſoules that you take, the ſoules to flie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil breake your pillowes, and wil deliuer my people out of your hand, neither shal they be anie more in your handes to be a praye: and you shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: For that you haue made the hart of the iuſt to mourne lyingly, whom I made not ſorowful: and haue ſtrenghtned the handes of the impious, that he might not returne from his euil way, and liue.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore you shal not ſee vaine thinges, and diuinations you shal diuine no more, and I wil deliuer my people out of you hand: and you shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND men of the ancients of Iſrael came to me, and ſate before me.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, Theſe men haue put their vncleannes in their hartes, and the ſcandal of their iniquitie they haue ſet againſt their face: what, being asked shal I anſwer them?
label: Ezechiel

text: For this cauſe ſpeake to them, and thou shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Man, man of the houſe of Iſrael, that shal put his vncleannes in his hart, & ſet the ſcandal of his iniquitie againſt his face, & shal come to the prophet aſking me by him: I the Lord wil anſwer him in the multitude of his vncleannes:
label: Ezechiel

text: that the houſe of Iſrael may be taken in their hart, wherwith they haue reuolted from me in al their idols.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore ſay to the houſe of Iſrael: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Conuert, and depart from your idols, and from al your contaminations turne away your faces.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe man man of the houſe of Iſrael, and of the proſelytes whoſoeuer shal be a ſtranger in Iſrael, if he be alienated from me, and put his idols in his hart, and ſet the ſcandal of his iniquitie againſt his face, and come to the prophet to aske me by him: I the Lord wil anſwer him by my ſelf.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſet my face vpon that man, and wil make him for an example, and afor a prouerbe, and wil deſtroy him out of the middes of my people: and you shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the prophete when he shal erre, and shal ſpeake a word: I the Lord haue deceiued that prophet: and I wil ſtrech forth my hand vpon him, and wil raſe him out of the middes of my people Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal carie their iniquitie: according to the iniquitie of him that asketh, ſo shal the iniquitie of the prophet be.
label: Ezechiel

text: That the houſe of Iſrael may no more erre from me, nor be polluted in al their preuarications: but may be my people, & I may be their God, ſaith the Lord of hoſtes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, the land when it shal ſinne to me, that tranſgreſſing it tranſgreſſeth, I wil ſtrech forth my hand vpon it, and wil breake the rod of the bread therof: and I wil ſend famine into it, and wil kil out of it man and beaſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And if theſe three men shal be in the middes therof, Noe, Daniel, and Iob: they by their iuſtice shal deliuer their owne ſoules, ſaith the Lord of hoſtes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And if I shal bring moſt euil beaſts alſo vpon the land, to waſte it; and it be without paſſage, for that there is none can paſſe becauſe of the beaſts:
label: Ezechiel

text: Theſe three men if they shal be therin, I liue, I, ſaith our Lord, that they shal deliuer neither ſonnes nor daughters: but themſelues alone shal be deliuered, and the land shal be made deſolate.
label: Ezechiel

text: Or if I shal bring the ſword in vpon that land, and shal ſay to the ſword: Paſſe through the land: and shal kil out of it man and beaſt:
label: Ezechiel

text: And theſe three men shal be in the middes therof: I liue, I, ſaith our Lord God, they shal not deliuer ſonnes nor daughters, but themſelues alone shal be deliuered.
label: Ezechiel

text: And if I shal ſend the peſtilence alſo in vpon that land, and shal powre out mine indignation vpon it in bloud, to take away out of it man and beaſt:
label: Ezechiel

text: And Noe, and Daniel, and Iob shal be in the middes therof: liue I, ſaith our Lord God, that ſonne and daughter they shal not deliuer: but themſelues by their iuſtice shal deliuer their owne ſoules.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe thus ſaith our Lord: That and if I shal ſend in vpon Ieruſalem my foure very ſore iudgements, the ſword, and famine, and euil beaſtes, and the peſtilence, to kil out of it man, and beaſt:
label: Ezechiel

text: Yet shal there be left in it ſaluation of ſome bringing out ſonnes, and daughters: behold they shal go forth to you, and you shal ſee their way, and their inuentions: and you shal be comforted vpon the euil, that I haue brought vpon Ieruſalem in al thinges, that I haue brought in vpon it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal comfort you, when you shal ſee their way, and their inuentions: and you shal know that I haue not in vaine done al thinges, which I haue done in it, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, what shal be made of the wood of the vine of al the trees of the woods, that are among the trees of the foreſts?
label: Ezechiel

text: Shal there be taken wood of it, that a worke may be made, or shal a pinne be made therof, that anie veſſel may hang theron?
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold it is geuen to the fire for food: the fire hath conſumed both partes therof, and the middes therof is brought into ashes: why, shal it be profitable for a worke?
label: Ezechiel

text: Yea when it was whole, it was not fit for a worke: how much more when the fire hath deuoured, and burnt it, shal no worke be made therof?
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: As the wood of the vine among the trees of the foreſts, which I haue geuen to the fire to be deuoured, ſo wil I deliuer the inhabitants of Ieruſalem.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſet my face againſt them: out of the fire shal they come forth, and fire shal conſume them: & you shal know that I am the Lord, when I shal ſet my face againſt them,
label: Ezechiel

text: and shal make their land not paſſable, and deſolate, becauſe they haue bene preuaricatours, ſayth our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man make knowne to Ieruſalem her abominations:
label: Ezechiel

text: and thou shalt ſay: Thus ſaith our Lord God to Ieruſalem: Thy roote, and thy generation of the land of Chanaan, thy father an Amorrheite, and thy mother a Cetheite.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when thou waſt borne, in the day of thy birth thy nauil was not cut, and thou waſt not washed with water to health, nor ſalted with ſalt, nor ſwadled in cloutes.
label: Ezechiel

text: No eye had mercie on thee to do vnto thee one of theſe thinges, hauing pitie on thee: but thou waſt throwen forth vpon the face of the earth in the abiection of thy ſoule, in the day that thou waſt borne.
label: Ezechiel

text: And paſſing by thee, I ſaw thee to be troden downe in thy bloud: and I ſaid to thee when thou waſt in thy bloud: Liue. I ſaid to thee, I ſay: In thy bloud liue.
label: Ezechiel

text: Multiplied as the ſpring of the field haue I made thee: and thou waſt multiplied, and made great, and thou wenteſt in, and cameſt to the ornaments of wemen: thy breaſtes ſwelled, and thy heare budded: and thou waſt naked, and ful of confuſion.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I paſſed by thee, and ſaw thee: and behold thy time, the time of louers: and I ſpred my garment ouer thee, and couered thy ignominie. And I ſware to thee, and I entered a couenant with thee: ſaith our Lord God: & thou waſt made myne.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I washed thee with water, and made cleane thy bloud from of thee: and I anoynted thee with oile.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I clothed thee with diuers colours, & shod thee with hyacinth: and I girded thee with ſilke, and clothed thee with fine garments.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I adorned thee with ornament, and gaue bracelettes on thy handes, and a cheine about thy necke.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I gaue a iewel vpon thy face, and ringes to thine eares, and a crowne of beautie on thy head.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou waſt adorned with gold, and ſiluer, and waſt clothed with ſilke, & embrodered worke, and manie colours: thou haſt eaten floure, and honie, and oile, and waſt made very beautiful excedingly: and didſt proſper to a kingdom.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thy name went forth into the Gentils, becauſe of thy beautie: becauſe thou waſt perfect in my beautie, which I had put vpon thee, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And hauing confidence in thy beautie thou haſt fornicated in thy name: and thou haſt layd forth thy fornication to euerie paſſenger to be made his.
label: Ezechiel
