text: And taking of thy garments thou madeſt thee idoles embrodred on each ſide: & thou didſt fornicate vpon them, as hath not bene done, nor shal not hereafter.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou tookeſt the veſſels of thy beautie, of my gold, and my ſiluer, which I gaue thee: and thou madeſt thee images of men, and haſt fornicated in them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou tookeſt thy garments of manie colours, and coueredſt them: and mine oile, and mine incenſe thou didſt put before them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And my bread, which I gaue thee, the floure, and oile, and honie, wherwith I haue nourished thee, thou didſt ſet in their ſight for an odour of ſweetnes, and it was done, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou haſt taken thy ſonnes, and thy daughters, which thou didſt begete to me: & haſt immolated the ſame vnto them to deuoure. Why, is thy fornication ſmal?
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou haſt immolated my ſonnes, and haſt geuen them, conſecrating them to the idols.
label: Ezechiel

text: And after al thine abominations, and fornications, thou waſt not mindful of the dayes of thy youth, when thou waſt naked, and ful of confuſion, troden downe in thy bloud.
label: Ezechiel

text: And it chanced after al thy malice (wo, wo to thee, ſaith our Lord God)
label: Ezechiel

text: thou didſt alſo build thee a ſtewes, and madeſt thee a brothel houſe in al ſtreetes.
label: Ezechiel

text: At euerie head of the way haſt thou built a ſigne of thy proſtitution: and haſt made thy beautie abominable: and haſt diuided thy feete to euerie one that paſſeth by, and haſt multiplied thy fornications.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou haſt fornicated with the children of Ægypt thy neighbours of great flesh, & haſt multiplied thy fornication to prouoke me.
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold I wil ſtrech out my hand vpon thee, and wil take away thy iuſtification: and I wil geue thee into the ſoules of the daughters of Paleſtine that hate thee, that are ashamed of thy wicked way.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou haſt committed fornication with the ſonnes of the Aſſyrians, becauſe neither as yet waſt thou filled: and after thou didſt fornicate, neither ſo waſt thou ſaciated.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou didſt multiplie thy fornication in the Land of Chanaan with the Chaldees: and neither ſo waſt thou ſaciated.
label: Ezechiel

text: Wherin shal I clenſe thy hart, ſaith our Lord God: wheras thou doeſt al theſe the workes of a woman that is a whore, and malapert?
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe thou haſt built thy brothel houſe in the head of euerie way, and thy exceſſe thou haſt made in euerie ſtrete, neither becameſt thou as an harlot that by diſdayne augmenteth the price,
label: Ezechiel

text: but as a woman aduoutereſſe, that ouer her husband bringeth in ſtrangers.
label: Ezechiel

text: To al harlots are rewards geuen: but thou haſt geuen rewardes to al thy louers, & thou didſt geue them giftes to come vnto thee on euerie ſide, to fornicate with thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in thee it was done contrarie to the cuſtome of wemen in thy fornications, and after thee there shal be no fornication: for in that thou gaueſt rewardes, and didſt not take rewardes, it hath bene done contrarie in thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore heare ô harlot the word of our Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Becauſe thy braſſe is powred out, and thine ignominie is reueled in thy fornications vpon thy louers, and vpon the idols of thine abominations in the bloud of thy children, whom thou gaueſt them:
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold I wil gather together al thy louers, with whom thou haſt taken pleaſure, & al, whom thou haſt loued, with al, whom thou didſt hate: and I wil gather them together vpon thee on euerie ſide, and wil diſcouer thine ignominie before them, and they shal ſee al thy turpitude.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil iudge thee by the iudgements of aduoutereſſes, and them that shed bloud: and I wil geue thee into bloud of furie and zele.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil geue thee into their handes, and they shal deſtroy thy brothel houſe, and throw downe thy ſtewes: and they shal turne thee naked out of thy garments, and shal take away the veſſels of thy beautie: and shal leaue thee naked, and ful of ignominie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal bring vpon thee a multitude, and they shal ſtone thee with ſtones, & shal murder thee with their ſwords.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal burne thy houſes with fire, and shal do iudgementes in thee in the eyes of very manie wemen: and thou shalt ceaſe to fornicate, and shalt geue rewardes no more.
label: Ezechiel

text: And mine indignation shal reſt in thee: and my zele shal be taken away from thee, and I wil ceaſe, and be angrie no more.
label: Ezechiel

text: For that thou haſt not remembred the dayes of thy youth, and haſt prouoked me in al theſe: wherfore I alſo haue geuen thy wayes on thy head, ſaith our Lord God, and I haue not done according to thy wicked dedes in al thine abominations.
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold euerie one, that ſpeaketh a common prouerbe, shal take vp that againſt thee, ſaying: As the mother, ſo alſo her daughter.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou art the daughter of thy mother, which did caſt of her husband, and her children: and thou art ſiſter of thy ſiſters, which did caſt of their huſbands, and their children: your mother was a Cetheite, & your father an Amorrheite.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thy elder ſiſter, Samaria, she and her daughters, that dwel on thy left hand, and thy ſiſter yonger then thou, which dwelleth on thy right hand, Sodom, & her daughters.
label: Ezechiel

text: But neither in their wayes haſt thou walked, nor according to their wicked dedes haſt thou done a very litle leſſe: thou haſt done almoſt more wicked thinges then they in al thy wayes.
label: Ezechiel

text: Liue I, ſaith our Lord God, that Sodom thy ſiſter her ſelfe hath not done, and her daughters, as thou haſt done, and thy daughters.
label: Ezechiel

text: Loe this was the iniquitie of Sodom thy ſiſter, pride, fulnes of bread, & abundance, and the idlenes of her, and of her daughters: and they raught not the hand to the needie, and the poore.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they were eleuated, and did abominations before me: and I tooke them away as thou haſt ſene.
label: Ezechiel

text: And Samaria ſinned not the halfe of thy ſinnes: but thou haſt paſſed them with thy wicked deedes, and haſt iuſtified thy ſiſters in al thine abominations, which thou haſt wrought.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou alſo therefore carie thy confuſion, which haſt paſſed thy ſiſters with thy ſinnes, doing more wickedly then they: for they are iuſtified aboue thee: thou alſo therfore be confounded, & beare thine ignominie, which haſt iuſtified thy ſiſters.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil conuert reſtoring them by the conuerſion of Sodom with her daughters, and by the conuerſion of Samaria, and her daughters: and I wil conuert thy reuerſion in the middes of them,
label: Ezechiel

text: that thou mayſt carie thine ignominie, and mayſt be confounded in al thinges, that thou haſt done, comforting them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thy ſiſter Sodom, and her daughters shal returne to their antiquitie: and Samaria, and her daughters shal returne to their antiquitie: and thou, and thy daughters shal returne to your antiquitie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And Sodom thy ſiſter was not heard in thy mouth, in the day of thy pride,
label: Ezechiel

text: before that thy malice was reueled: as at this time for reproch of the daughters of Syria, and of al the daughters of Paleſthine in the circuite of thee, which compaſſe thee round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thy wickednes, and thine ignominie thou haſt caried, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe thus ſaith our Lord God: And I wil do to thee, as thou haſt deſpiſed the oath, to make the couenant fruſtrate:
label: Ezechiel

text: and I wil remember my couenant with thee in the dayes of thy youth: and I wil raiſe vnto thee an euerlaſting couenant.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt remember thy wayes, and shalt be confounded: when thou shalt receiue thy ſiſters elder then thee with thy yonger: and I wil geue them to thee for daughters, but not by thy couenant.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil raiſe vp my couenant with thee: and thou shalt know that I am the Lord,
label: Ezechiel

text: that thou mayſt remember, and be confounded, and maiſt no more open thy mouth becauſe of thy confuſion, when I shal be pacified toward thee in al that thou haſt done, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, propoſe a darke ſpeach, and tel a parable to the houſe of Iſrael,
label: Ezechiel

text: and thou shalt ſay: Thus ſaith our Lord God: A great eagle with great winges, with a long reach of members; ful of fethers, and of varietie, came to Libanus, and tooke the marow of the ceder.
label: Ezechiel

text: He plucked away the top of the boughes therof: and tranſported it into the Land of Chanaan, in the citie of merchants he did put it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he tooke of the ſede of the land, & put it in the ground for ſede, that it might faſten the roote ouer manie waters: he planted it in the ouermoſt part of the earth.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when it had budded, it grew into a broad ſpredding vine of low ſtature, the boughes therof looking toward it and the rootes therof were vnder it. It became a vine then, and fructified into branches, and put forth shootes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And there was made an other great egle, with great winges, and manie fethers: & behold this vine as it were ſpredding her rootes towards it, ſtreched forth her branches to it, that she might water it from the beds of her ſpring.
label: Ezechiel

text: In a good ground vpon manie waters it was planted, that it might bring forth branches, and beare fruite, that it might be into a great vine.
label: Ezechiel

text: Say: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Shal it proſper then? shal he not plucke vp the rootes therof, and ſtrippe of the fruites therof, and drie vp al the branches of the ſpring therof, and it shal wither: and not in a great arme, nor in much people, to plucke it vp by the roote?
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold it is planted: shal it proſper then? shal it not be dried when the burning winde shal touch it, and wither in the beds of the ſpring therof?
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Say to the exaſperating houſe: Know you not what theſe thinges doe ſignifie? Say: Behold the king of Babylon cometh into Ieruſalem: and he shal take the king and the princes therof, and shal bring them to himſelfe into Babylon.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he shal take of the ſede of the kingdom, and shal make a couenant with it, and shal take an oath of it. Yea and he shal take away the ſtrong of the land,
label: Ezechiel

text: that it may be a lowe kingdom, and not be eleuated, but kepe his couenant, & obſerue it.
label: Ezechiel

text: Who reuolting from him ſent meſſengers to Ægypt, that it would geue him horſes, and much people. What, shal he proſper, or gette ſaluation that hath done theſe thinges? and he that broke the couenant, shal he eſcape?
label: Ezechiel

text: Liue I, ſaith our Lord God: that in the place of the king that made him king, whoſe oath he made fruſtrate, and brake the couenant, that he had with him, in the middes of Babylon shal he dye.
label: Ezechiel

text: And not in a great armie, nor in much people shal Pharao make battel agaynſt him: in the caſting vp of a ramper, and in the building of bulworkes, to kil manie ſoules.
label: Ezechiel

text: For he had deſpiſed the oath, that he might breake the couenant, and behold he gaue his hand, and when he hath done al theſe thinges, he shal not eſcape.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Liue I, that the oath which he hath deſpiſed, & the couenant, that he tranſgreſſed, I wil lay on his head.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſpread my nette ouer him, and he shal be taken in my nette: and I wil bring him into Babylon, and wil iudge him there in the preuerication, wherby he hath deſpiſed me.
label: Ezechiel

text: And al his fugitiues with al their troupe shal fal by the ſword: and the reſidue shal be diſperſed into euerie wind: and you shal know that I the Lord haue ſpoken.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: And I wil take of the marow of the high ceder, & wil ſet it: of the toppe of the boughes therof the tender one I wil ſtrippe of, and wil plant it vpon a mountaine high and eminent.
label: Ezechiel

text: On the high mountaines of Iſrael wil I plant it, and it shal shoote forth into a budde, and shal yelde fruite, and it shal be into a great ceder: and al birdes, and euerie foule shal dwel vnder the shadow of the boughes therof, and shal there make their neſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And al the trees of the countrie shal know, that I the Lord haue humbled the high tree, & exalted the low tree: and haue dried the greene tree, and haue cauſed the drie tree to ſpring. I the Lord haue ſpoken, and haue done it.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: What is that among you, you turne a parable into this prouerbe in the land of Iſrael, ſaying: The fathers did eate a ſowre grape, and the teeth of the children are ſet on edge?
label: Ezechiel

text: Liue I, ſaith our Lord God, if this parable shal be vnto you any more for a prouerbe in Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold al ſoules are mine: as the ſoule of the father, ſo alſo the ſoule of the ſonne is mine: the ſoule that shal ſinne, the ſame shal dye.
label: Ezechiel

text: And a man if he shal be iuſt, and hath done iudgement and iuſtice,
label: Ezechiel

text: hath not eaten on the mountaynes, and not lifted vp his eyes to the idols of the houſe of Iſrael: and hath not violated his neighbours wife, and approched not to a menſtruous woman:
label: Ezechiel

text: and made no man ſorowful: hath reſtored the pledge to the debter, taken nothing away by violence: hath geuen his bread to the hungrie, and couered the naked with a garment:
label: Ezechiel

text: hath not lent to vſurie, and not taken more: hath turned away his hand from iniquitie, and done true iudgement betwen man and man:
label: Ezechiel

text: hath walked in my precepts, and kept my iudgements, to doe truth: this man is iuſt, liuing he shal liue, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And if he hath begotten a ſonne that is a robber shedding bloud, & he doe one of theſe thinges:
label: Ezechiel

text: and that doth not in dede al theſe thinges, but eateth on the mountaynes, and defileth his neighbours wife:
label: Ezechiel

text: that maketh the needie and poore ſorowful, violently committeth robberies, reſtoreth not the pledge, & lifteth his eyes to idols, doth abomination:
label: Ezechiel

text: that geueth to vſurie, and taketh more: what, shal he liue? he shal not liue. Wheras he hath done al theſe deteſtable thinges, dying he shal dye, his bloud shal be vpon him.
label: Ezechiel

text: But and if he hath begotten a ſonne, that ſeing al his fathers ſinnes, which he hath done, is afrayd, and shal not doe the like to them:
label: Ezechiel

text: hath not eaten vpon the mountaines, and not lifted vp his eyes to the idols of the houſe of Iſrael, and hath not violated his neighbours wife:
label: Ezechiel

text: and hath made no man ſorowful, hath not withheld the pledge, and hath not violently committed robberie, hath geuen his bread to the hungrie, and couered the naked with clothing:
label: Ezechiel

text: hath turned away his hand from iniurie of the poore, hath not taken vſurie and ouerplus, hath done my iudgements, hath walked in my preceptes: this man shal not dye in the iniquitie of his father, but liuing he shal liue.
label: Ezechiel

text: His father becauſe he did calumniate, and did violence to his brother, and wrought euil in the middes of his people, behold he is dead in his owne iniquitie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you ſay: Why hath not the ſonne borne the iniquitie of his father? Verely becauſe the ſonne hath wrought iudgement and iuſtice, he hath kept al my precepts, and done them, liuing he shal liue.
label: Ezechiel

text: The ſoule that shal ſinne, the ſame shal dye: the ſonne shal not beare the iniquitie of the father, and the father shal not beare the iniquitie of the ſonne: the iuſtice of the iuſt shal be vpon him, and the impietie of he impious shal be vpon him.
label: Ezechiel

text: But if the impious shal doe penance from al his ſinnes, which he hath wrought, and shal keepe al my precepts, and doe iudgement, and iuſtice: liuing he shal liue, and shal not dye.
label: Ezechiel

text: Al his iniquities, which he hath wrought, I wil not remember them: in his iuſtice, which he hath wrought, he shal liue.
label: Ezechiel

text: Why, is the death of a ſinner my vvil, ſaith our Lord God, and not that he conuert from his wayes, and liue?
label: Ezechiel

text: But if the iuſt man shal turne away himſelfe from his iuſtice, and doe iniquitie according to al the abominations, which the impious vſeth to worke, shal he liue? al his iuſtices, which he had done, shal not be remembred: in the preuarication, which he hath preuaricated, and in his ſinne, which he hath ſinned, in them he shal dye.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you haue ſaid: The way of our Lord is not right. Heare ye therfore ô houſe of Iſrael: What, is not my way right, and are not rather your wayes peruerſe?
label: Ezechiel

text: For when the iuſt shal turne away himſelfe from his iuſtice, & doth iniquitie, he shal dye in them: in the iniuſtice, that he hath wrought he shal dye.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when the impious shal turne away himſelfe from his impietie, which he hath wrought, & shal doe iudgement, and iuſtice: he shal viuificate his ſoule.
label: Ezechiel

text: For conſidering, & turning away himſelf from al his iniquities, which he hath wrought, liuing he shal liue, and not dye.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the children of Iſrael ſay: The way of our Lord is not right. What, are not my wayes right, ô houſe of Iſrael, and not rather your wayes peruerſe?
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore wil I iudge euerie man according to his wayes ô houſe of Iſrael, ſaith our Lord God. Conuert, and doe penance from al your iniquities: and iniquitie shal not be a ruine to you.
label: Ezechiel

text: Caſt away from you al your preuarications, wherin you haue preuaricated, and make to yourſelues a new hart, and a new ſpirit: and why wil you dye ô houſe of Iſrael?
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe I wil not the death of him that dieth, ſaith our Lord God, returne ye, and liue.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND thou take vp lamentation vpon the princes of Iſrael,
label: Ezechiel

text: and thou shalt ſay: Why lay thy mother a lioneſſe among the lions, in the middes of young lions brought vp her whelpes?
label: Ezechiel

text: And she brought out one of her young lions, he became a lion: and he lerned to catch prayes, and to eate man.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the Gentils heard of him, and not without their woundes they tooke him: and they brought him in cheynes into the Land of Ægypt.
label: Ezechiel

text: Who when she ſaw that she was weakened, and her expectation was loſt, she tooke one of her young lions, she made him a lion.
label: Ezechiel

text: Who went among the lions, and became a lion: and he lerned to take praye, and to deuoure men.
label: Ezechiel

text: He lerned to make widowes, and to bring their cities into a deſert: and the land was made deſolate, and the fulnes therof by the voice of his roaring.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the Gentils came together againſt him on euerie ſide out of the prouinces, & they ſpred their nette vpon him, in their wounds he was taken.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they put him into a caue, in cheynes they brought him to the king of Babylon: and they caſt him into priſon, that his voice might no more be heard vpon the mountaines of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thy mother as it were a vine in thy bloud is planted vpon the water: her fruit and her branches haue growen out of manie waters.
label: Ezechiel

text: And there were made to her ſtrong roddes for the ſcepters of them that rule, and her ſtature was exalted among the branches: and she ſaw her height in the multitude of her branches.
label: Ezechiel

text: And she was plucked vp in wrath, and caſt on the ground: and the burning winde hath dried vp her fruite: the roddes of her ſtrength are withered, and dried vp: fire hath eaten her.
label: Ezechiel

text: And now she is tranſplanted into the deſert, in a land not paſſable, and drie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And there came forth fire from the rod of her boughes, which hath eaten her fruite: and there was not in her a ſtrong rod, the ſcepter of rulers. Lamentation it is, and it shal be into lamentation.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND it came to paſſe in the ſeuenth yeare, in the fifth, the tenth of the moneth: there came men of the ancients of Iſrael to aske our Lord, & they ſate before me.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, ſpeake to the ancients of Iſrael, & thou shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Why, are you come, to aske me? Liue I, that I wil not anſwer you, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: Doeſt thou iudge them, doeſt thou iudge ô ſonne of man? shew to them the abominations of their fathers.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith our Lord God: In the day that I choſe Iſrael, & lifted vp my hand for the ſtocke of the houſe of Iacob: and appeared to them in the Land of Ægypt, and lifted vp my hand for them, ſaying; I the Lord your God:
label: Ezechiel

text: in that day I lifted vp my hand for them, that I might bring them out of the Land of Ægypt, into a Land which I had prouided for them, flowing with milke and honie, which is excellent among al landes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaid to them, Let euerie man caſt away the ſcandals of his eyes, and in the idols of Ægypt be ye not polluted: I the Lord your God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they prouoked me, and would not heare me: euerie one did not caſt away the abominations of his eyes, neither did they leaue the idols of Ægypt: and I ſaid I would powre out mine indignation vpon them, and fil my wrath in them, in the middes of the Land of Ægypt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I did for my name ſake, that it might not be violated before the Gentils, in the middes of whom they were, and among whom I appeared to them, to bring them out of the Land of Ægypt.
label: Ezechiel

text: I caſt them out therfore of the Land of Ægypt, and brought them forth into the deſert.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I gaue them my precepts, and I shewed to them my iudgements, which a man doing, shal liue in them.
label: Ezechiel

text: Moreouer alſo my ſabbathes I gaue to them, to be a ſigne betwen me and them: and that they might know that I am the Lord ſanctifying them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the houſes of Iſrael prouoked me in the deſert; they walked not in my precepts, and my iudgements they reiected, which a man doing shal liue in them: and my ſabbathes they violated excedingly. I ſaid therfore I would powre out my furie vpon them in the deſert, and would conſume them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I did for my name ſake, leſt it should be violated before the Gentils, from which I caſt them out, in their ſight.
label: Ezechiel

text: I therfore lifted vp my hand vpon them in the deſert, not to bring them into the Land, which I gaue them flowing with milke and honie; the chiefe of al landes.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe they reiected my iudgements, and walked not in my precepts, and violated my ſabbathes: for their hart went after idols.
label: Ezechiel

text: And mine eye was merciful on them, that I killed them not: neither did I conſume them in the deſert.
label: Ezechiel

text: But I ſaid to their children in the wildernes: In the precepts of your fathers walke not, neither keepe ye their iudgements, nor be polluted in their idols:
label: Ezechiel

text: I the Lord your God: walke ye in my precepts, and keepe my iudgements, and doe them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And ſanctifie ye my ſabbathes, that they may be a ſigne betwen me and you: and ye may knowe that I am the Lord your God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the children exaſperated me, in my precepts they walked not: and my iudgements they kept not, to doe them: which when a man shal doe, he shal liue in them: and they violated my ſabbathes: and I threatned to powre out my furie vpon them, and to fil my wrath in them in the deſert.
label: Ezechiel

text: But I turned away my hand, & did for my names ſake, that it might not be violated before the Gentils, out of which I did caſt them forth in their eyes.
label: Ezechiel

text: Againe I lifted vp my hand vpon them in the wildernes, that I might diſperſe them into nations, and ſcatter them into landes:
label: Ezechiel

text: for that they had not done my iudgements, and had reiected my precepts, and had violated my ſabbathes, and their eyes had bene after the idols of their fathers.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore I alſo gaue them precepts not good, and iudgements, in which they shal not liue.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I polluted them in their giftes, when they offered al that opened the matrice, for their offences: and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: Wherfore ſpeake to the houſe of Iſrael, ô ſonne of man: and thou shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Yet alſo in this did your fathers blaſpheme me, when contemning they had deſpiſed me:
label: Ezechiel

text: and I had brought them into the Land, vpon which I lifted vp my hand to geue it them; they ſaw euerie high hil, and euerie wooddie tree, and there they immolated their victims: and there they gaue the irritation of their oblation, and there they put the odour of their ſweetnes, and offered their libations.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaid to them: What is the excelſe, vnto which you goe? & the name therof was called Excelſe euen to this day.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore ſay to the houſe of Iſrael: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Surely in the way of your fathers you are polluted, and after their ſcandals you doe fornicate.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in the oblation of your giftes, when you make your children paſſe through the fire, you are polluted in al your idols vnto this day: and shal I anſwer you ô houſe of Iſrael? Liue I, ſaith our Lord God, that I wil not anſwer you.
label: Ezechiel

text: Neither shal the cogitation of your minde come to paſſe, ſaying: We wil be as the Gentils, and as the kinreds of the earth, that we may worship wood, and ſtones.
label: Ezechiel

text: Liue I, ſaith our Lord God, that in a ſtrong hand, & in a ſtreched out arme, and in furie powred forth wil I reigne ouer you.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil bring you out of the peoples, and I wil gather you out of the landes, in which you are diſperſed, in a ſtrong hand, and in a ſtreched out arme and in furie powred forth wil I reigne ouer you.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil bring you into the deſert of peoples, and wil be iudged there with you face to face.
label: Ezechiel

text: As I contended in iudgement againſt your fathers in the deſert of the Land of Ægypt: ſo wil I iudge you, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſubdue you to my ſcepter, & wil bring you into the bandes of couenant.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil chooſe out of you the tranſgreſſours, and impious, and wil bring them out of the land of their ſeiourning, and into the land of Iſrael they shal not enter: and you shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you ô houſe of Iſrael, Thus ſaith our Lord God: Walke you euerie one after your idols, and ſerue them. But and if in this alſo you heare me not, and shal pollute my holie name any more in your giftes, and in your idols:
label: Ezechiel

text: in my holie mount, in the high mount of Iſrael, ſaith our Lord God, there shal al the houſe of Iſrael ſerue me; al I ſay in the land, wherin they shal pleaſe me, and there wil I require your firſt fruites, and the beginning of your tithes in al your ſanctifications.
label: Ezechiel

text: I wil receiue you for an odour of ſweetnes, when I shal haue brought you out of the peoples, and shal haue gathered you out of the landes, into which you are diſperſed, and I wil be ſanctified in you in the eyes of the nations.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you shal know that I am the Lord, when I shal haue brought you into the land of Iſrael, into the Land, for which I lifted vp my hand to geue it to your fathers.
label: Ezechiel

text: And there you shal remember your wayes, and al your wicked deedes, in which you were polluted: and you shal miſlike yourſelues in your owne ſight, in al your malices, which you haue done.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you shal know that I am the Lord, when I shal haue done you good for my name ſake, and not according to your euil wayes, nor according to your moſt wicked deedes ô houſe of Iſrael, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, ſet thy face againſt the way of the ſouth, and droppe toward the ſotherne winde, and prophecie to the forreſt of the ſotherne filde.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt ſay to the ſotherne forreſt: Heare the word of our Lord: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I wil kindle a fire in thee, and wil burne in thee euerie greene tree, and euerie drie tree: the flame of the fire shal not be quenched: and euerie face shal be burned in it, from the South euen to the North.
label: Ezechiel

text: And al flesh shal ſee, that I the Lord kindled it, neither shal it be quenched.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaid: A a a, ô Lord God: they ſay of me: Doth not this man ſpeake by parables?
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man ſet thy face to Ieruſalem, and droppe to the ſanctuaries, and prophecie againſt the ground of Iſrael:
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt ſay to the land of Iſrael: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I to thee, and I wil draw forth my ſword out of his ſcabbard, and wil kil in thee the iuſt, and the impious.
label: Ezechiel

text: And for that I haue killed in thee the iuſt, and the impious, therfore shal my ſword goe forth out of his ſcabbard to al flesh, from the South euen to the North.
label: Ezechiel

text: That al flesh may know that I the Lord haue drawen my ſword out of his ſcabbard not to be reuoked.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou ſonne of man, mourne in contrition of the loynes, and in bitternes mourne before them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when they shal ſay to thee: Why mourneſt thou? thou shalt ſay: For the bruite: becauſe it cometh, and euerie hart shal melt, & al handes shal be diſſolued, and euerie ſpirit shal be weakened, and waters shal runne by al knees: behold it commeth, and it shal be done, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man prophecie, and thou shalt ſay: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Speake: The ſword, the ſword is sharpened, and fourbished.
label: Ezechiel

text: To kil victims, it is sharpened; to glitter, it is fourbished: thou that moueſt the ſcepter of my ſonne, haſt cut downe euerie tree.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I gaue it to be made ſmooth, that it may be held with the hand: this is a sharpened ſword, and this is forbished, that it may be in the hand of the ſlayer.
label: Ezechiel

text: Crie, and howle ô ſonne of man, becauſe this ſame is made in my people, in al the captaines of Iſrael, that fled: they are deliuered to the ſword with my people, therfore ſtrike vpon the thigh,
label: Ezechiel

text: becauſe it is proued: and that, when it shal ouerthrow the ſcepter, it shal not be, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou therfore ô ſonne of man prophecie, & ſtrike hand againſt hand, and let the ſword be dubled, & let the ſword of the ſlaine be tripled: this is the ſword of great ſlaughter, that maketh them to be aſtonied,
label: Ezechiel

text: and to pine in hart, & multiplieth ruines. In al their gates haue I geuen the truble of the ſword sharpe and furbished to glitter, addreſſed to ſlaughter.
label: Ezechiel

text: Be thou sharpened, goe to the right hand, or to the left, whitherſoeuer the appetite of thy face is.
label: Ezechiel

text: Yea and I wil clappe hand to hand, and wil fil mine indignation: I the Lord haue ſpoken.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou ſonne of man, put thee two wayes, that the ſword of the king of Babylon may come: both shal come forth out of one land: and he shal take coniecture with the hand, in the head of the way of the citie shal he chooſe it.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou shalt make way that the ſword may come to Rabbath of the children of Ammon, and to Iuda into Ieruſalem moſt fenced.
label: Ezechiel

text: For the king of Babylon ſtood in the high way, in the head of two wayes, ſeeking diuination, shuffling arrowes: he asked the idols, & tooke counſel of intralles.
label: Ezechiel

text: On his right hand was made diuination vpon Ieruſalem, to ſette engins, to open the mouth in ſlaughter, to eleuate the voice in howling, to ſet engins againſt the gates, to caſt vp a rampier, to build munitions.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he shal be as it were conſulting the oracle in vaine in their eies, & imitating the reſt of ſabbathes: but he shal remember the iniquitie to take it.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: For that you haue remembred your iniquitie, and haue reueled your preuarications, and your ſinnes haue appeared in al your cogitations: for that, I ſay, that you remembred, you shal be taken by hand.
label: Ezechiel

text: But thou prophane, impious prince of Iſrael, whoſe day prefixed cometh in the time of iniquitie:
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Take away the myter, take of the crowne: is not this it, that extolled the humble, and humbled the high?
label: Ezechiel

text: Iniquitie, iniquitie, iniquitie wil I put it, and this was not done, til he came to whom iudgement belongeth, and I wil deliuer it to him.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou ſonne of man prophecie, and ſay: Thus ſaith our Lord God to the children of Ammon, and to their reproch, and thou shalt ſay: Sword, ſword draw out thy ſelfe to kil, fourbish thy ſelfe to ſlaye, and to glitter.
label: Ezechiel

text: When vaine thinges were ſene for thee, and lies were diuined: that thou mighteſt be geuen vpon the neckes of the wounded impious, whoſe day prefixed cometh in the time of iniquitie.
label: Ezechiel

text: Returne to thy ſcabbard in the place, wherin thou waſt created, in the land of thy natiuitie I wil iudge thee,
label: Ezechiel

text: and wil powre out vpon thee mine indignation: in the fire of my furie wil I blow vpon thee, and wil geue thee into the handes of men vnwiſe, & framing deſtruction.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou shalt be foode for the fire, thy bloud shal be in the middes of the land, thou shalt be forgotten: becauſe I the Lord haue ſpoken.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the woord of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou ſonne of man doeſt thou not iudge, doeſt thou not iudge the citie of bloud?
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt shew her al her abominations, and shalt ſay: Thus ſaith our Lord God: The citie shedding bloud in the middes of it, that her time may come: and that hath made idols againſt herſelfe,
label: Ezechiel

text: that she might be polluted. In thy bloud, which is shed by thee, thou haſt offended: and in thine idols, which thou haſt made, thou art polluted: and thou haſt made thy dayes to approch, and haſt brought the time of thy yeares: therfore haue I geuen thee a reproch to the Gentils, and a mockerie to al landes.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thoſe that are nere, and that are far from thee, shal triumph ouer thee: thou filthie one, noble, great in deſtruction.
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold the princes of Iſrael, euerie one in his arme, haue bene in thee, to shede bloud.
label: Ezechiel

text: Father and mother they haue abuſed with contumelies in thee, the ſtranger they haue calumniated in the middes of thee, the pupil and widow they haue made ſorowful in thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: My ſanctuaries you haue deſpiſed, and my ſabbathes you haue polluted.
label: Ezechiel

text: Detracting men haue bene in thee to shede bloud, and vpon the mountaynes they haue eaten in thee, they haue wrought wickednes in the middes of thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: The fathers shame they haue diſcouered in thee, the vncleannes of the menſtruous woman they haue humbled in thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: And euerie one hath wrought abomination vpon his neighbours wife, and the father in law hath polluted his daughter inlaw wickedly, the brother hath oppreſſed his ſiſter the daughter of his father in thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: They haue taken giftes in thee to shede bloud: thou haſt taken vſurie and ouerplus, and didſt calumniate thy neighbours couetouſly: and thou haſt forgotten me, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold, I haue wrong my handes vpon thy couetouſnes, which thou haſt done, and vpon the bloud that hath bene shed in the middes of thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: Why, shal thy hart abide, or shal thy handes preuaile in the dayes, which I shal make to thee? I the Lord haue ſpoken, and wil doe it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil diſperſe thee into nations, & wil ſcatter thee into landes, and wil make thy vncleannes to faile from thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil poſſeſſe thee in the ſight of the Gentils: and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, the houſe of Iſrael is turned into droſſe to me: al theſe are becóme braſſe, and tinne, and yron, and lead, & droſſe of ſiluer, in the middes of the fornace.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Becauſe you are al turned into droſſe, therfore behold I wil gather you together in the middes of Ieruſalem,
label: Ezechiel

text: with the gathering of ſiluer, and braſſe, and tinne, & yron, and lead in the middes of a fornace: that I may kindle a fire in it to melt it: ſo wil I gather you together in my furie, and in my wrath, and wil reſt: and I wil melt you.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil gather you together, and wil ſet you on fire, in the fire of my furie, and you shal be melted in the middes therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: As ſiluer is melted in the middes of the fornace, ſo shal you be in the middes therof: and you shal know that I am the Lord, when I haue powred out mine indignation vpon you.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, ſay to it: Thou art an vncleane land, and not rayned vpon in the day of furie.
label: Ezechiel

text: A conſpiracie of prophets in the middes therof: as a lion roaring, and rauening the praye, haue they deuoured ſoules, they haue taken the riches and the price, her widowes they haue multiplied in the middes therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: Her prieſts haue contemned my law, and haue polluted my ſanctuaries: betwen a holie thing and prophane they haue put no difference: and betwen the polluted and the cleane they vnderſtood not: and from my ſabbathes they haue turned away their eyes, and I was defiled in the middes of them.
label: Ezechiel

text: Her princes in the middes of her, as wolues rauening the praye to shede bloud, and to deſtroy ſoules, and to purſew gaynes couetouſly.
label: Ezechiel

text: And her prophetes dawbed them without tempering, ſeing vayne thinges, and diuining lies to them, ſaying: Thus ſaith our Lord God: wheras our Lord hath not ſpoken.
label: Ezechiel

text: The people of the land they oppreſſed by calumnie, and tooke away violently: the needie and poore they afflicted, and the ſtranger they oppreſſed by calumnie without iudgement.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſought of them a man that might enterpoſe an hedge, and ſtand oppoſite agaynſt me for the land, that I might not deſtroy it: and I found not.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I powred out mine indignation vpon them, in the fire of my wrath I conſumed them: I haue rendered their way vpon their head, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, there were two wemen daughters of one mother.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they fornicated in Ægypt, in their youth they fornicated: there were their breſtes preſſed, & the pappes of their virginitie were broken.
label: Ezechiel

text: And their names Oolla the elder and Ooliba her yonger ſiſter: and I had them, and they bare ſonnes, and daughters. Moreouer their names, Samaria Oolla, and Ieruſalem Ooliba.
label: Ezechiel

text: Oolla therfore fornicated ouer me, & was madde vpon her louers, vpon the Aſſirians approching,
label: Ezechiel

text: clothed with hyacinth, the princes, and the magiſtrates, al the youngmen of concupiſcences; al the horſmen, the riders of horſes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And she gaue her fornications vpon them al the choſen children of the Aſſirians: and in al, on whom she was madde, in their vncleannes she was polluted.
label: Ezechiel

text: Moreouer alſo her fornications, which she had made in Ægypt she left not: for they alſo ſlept with her in her youth, & they brake the breaſts of her virginitie, and powred out their fornication vpon her.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore haue I deliuered her into the handes of her louers, into the handes of the children of Aſſur, vpon whoſe luſt she was madde.
label: Ezechiel

text: They diſcouered her ignominie, tooke her ſonnes and daughters, & her they killed with the ſword: and they were made notorious wemen, and they did iudgements in her.
label: Ezechiel

text: Which when her ſiſter Ooliba had ſeene, she was madde with luſt more then she: & she gaue impudently her fornication aboue the fornication of her ſiſter
label: Ezechiel

text: to the children of the Aſſyrians, to the princes, and magiſtrates coming to her clothed with partie clothing, to the horſmen that were carried on horſes, and to yoongmen al of goodlie beautie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaw that she was polluted, both one way.
label: Ezechiel

text: And she increaſed her fornications: and when she had ſeene men paynted in a wal, the images of the Chaldees expreſſed in colours,
label: Ezechiel

text: and girded with girdles about their reynes, and died turbants on their heades, the forme of al the dukes, the ſimilitude of the children of Babylon, and of the land of the Chaldees, wherin they were borne,
label: Ezechiel

text: she was mad vpon them with the concupiſcence of her eyes, and she ſent meſſengers to them into Chaldee.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when the children of Babylon were come to her vnto the bed of pappes, they polluted her with their fornications, and she was polluted of them, & her ſoule was filled of them.
label: Ezechiel

text: She reueled alſo her fornications, and diſcouered her ignominie: and my ſoule departed from her, as my ſoule departed from her ſiſter.
label: Ezechiel

text: For she hath multiplied her fornications, remembring the dayes of her youth, in which she fornicated in the land of Ægypt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And she was madde for luſt vpon the lying with them, whoſe flesh is as the flesh of aſſes: and as the fluxe of horſes, their fluxe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou haſt viſited the wickednes of thy youth when thy breaſtes were preſſed in Ægypt, & the pappes of thy virginitie broken.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore Ooliba, thus ſayth our Lord God: Behold I wil rayſe vp al thy louers againſt thee, of whom thy ſoule is filled: and I wil gather them together againſt thee round about,
label: Ezechiel

text: the children of Babylon, and al the Chaldees, the nobles, and the tyrants, and princes, al the children of the Aſſyrians, the yongmen of goodlie beautie, al the captaynes, and magiſtrates, the princes of princes, and the renowned riders of horſes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal come vpon thee wel appoynted with chariot, and wheele, a multitude of peoples: with brigintine, and buckler, and helmet they shal be armed againſt thee, on euerie ſide: and I wil geue iudgement before them, & they shal iudge thee by their iudgements.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil put my zele in thee, which they exerciſe with thee in furie: thy noſe, and thine eares they shal cut of: and the thinges that remaine shal fal by the ſword: they shal take thy ſonnes, and thy daughters, and thy verie laſt thing shal be deuoured with fire.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal ſtrippe thee of thy garments, and shal take away the veſſels of thy glorie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make thy wickednes to ceaſe out of thee, and thy fornication out of the Land of Ægypt: neither shalt thou lift vp thine eyes to them, and Ægypt thou shalt remember no more.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I wil deliuer thee into the handes of them, whom thou hateſt, into their handes, of whom thy ſoule is filled.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal deale with thee in hatred, and they shal take away al thy labours, and shal let thee goe naked, and ful of ignominie, and the ignominie of thy fornications shal be reueled, thy wicked dede, and thy fornications.
label: Ezechiel

text: They haue done theſe thinges to thee, becauſe thou haſt fornicated after the Nations, among which thou waſt polluted in their idols.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou haſt walked in the way of thy ſiſter, and I wil geue her cuppe in thy hand.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: The cuppe of thy ſiſter thou shalt drinke deepe, and wide: thou shalt be into deriſion and into ſcorne, which is moſt capable.
label: Ezechiel

text: With drunckennes, and ſorow thou shalt be replenished: with the cuppe of penſifenes, and ſadnes, with the cuppe of thy ſiſter Samaria.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt drinke it, and shalt drinke it vp euen to the dregges, and the fragments therof thou shalt deuoure, thou shalt rent thy breaſtes: becauſe I haue ſpoken, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Becauſe thou haſt forgotten me, and haſt caſt me of behind thy bodie, thou alſo beare thy wickednes, and thy fornications.
label: Ezechiel

text: And our Lord ſpake to me, ſaying: Sonne of man, doeſt thou iudge Oolla, and Ooliba, and sheweſt thou them their wicked deedes?
label: Ezechiel

text: becauſe they haue committed aduoutrie, and bloud is in their handes, and with their idols they haue fornicated: moreouer alſo their children, whom they begate for me, they haue offered vnto them to be deuoured.
label: Ezechiel

text: Yea and they haue done this to me. They polluted my ſanctuarie in that day, and profaned my ſabbathes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when they immolated their children to their idols, and went into my ſanctuarie in that day to pollute it: theſe thinges alſo they did in the middes of my houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: They ſent to men comming from far, to whom they had ſent a meſſenger: therfore loe they came: to whom thou didſt wash thyſelf, and didſt annoint thine eyes about with ſtibikeſtone, and waſt adorned with wemens ornaments.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou ſateſt in a very faire bed, and a table was decked before thee: mine incenſe, and mine oyntment thou didſt ſet vpon it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the voice of a multitude reioycing was on it: and on the men, that were brought of the multitude of men, and came from the deſert, they did put bracelets on their handes, and beautiful crownes on their heades.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaid to her, that was worne in aduoutries: Now wil this woman alſo fornicate in her fornication.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they went to her as to an harlot woman: ſo went they vnto Oolla, and Ooliba wicked wemen.
label: Ezechiel

text: They therfore are iuſt men: theſe shal iudge them with the iudgement of adultereſſes, and with the iudgement of bloudshedders: becauſe they are adultreſſes, and bloud is in their handes.
label: Ezechiel

text: For thus ſaith our Lord God: Bring a multitude to them, and deliuer them into tumult, and into ſpoile:
label: Ezechiel

text: and let them be ſtoned with the ſtones of peoples, and let them be thruſt through with their ſwordes: they shal kil their ſonnes, and daughters, and their houſes they shal burne with fire.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil take away the wickednes out of the land, & al wemen shal learne, not to doe according to the wickednes of them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal geue your wickednes vpon you, and the ſinnes of your idols you shal carie: and you shal know that I am the Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, in the ninth yeare, in the tenth moneth, the tenth day of the moneth, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, write thee the name of this day, wherin the king of Babylon is confirmed againſt Ieruſalem to day.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt ſpeake by a prouerbe to the exaſperating houſe a parable, and shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Set thou a potte, ſet it, I ſay, and put water into it.
label: Ezechiel

text: Heape together the peeces therof into it, euerie good part, the thigh and the shoulder, the choſen thinges and ful of bones.
label: Ezechiel

text: Take the fatteſt beaſt, and lay together pyles of bones alſo vnder it: the ſeething therof is boyling hotte, and the bones therof are throughly ſodden in the middes therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Wo to the citie of bloud, to the potte, whoſe ruſtines is in it, and the ruſtines therof is not gone out of it: by her partes, and by her partes caſt her out, there hath no lotte fallen vpon her.
label: Ezechiel

text: For her bloud is in the middes of her, she hath shed it vpon the moſt cleare rocke: she shed it not vpon the ground, that it might be couered with duſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: That I might bring mine indignation in vpon her, and might reuenge with vengeance: I gaue her bloud vpon the moſt clere rocke, that it might not be couered.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Wo to the citie of bloud, whoſe bonefire I wil make great.
label: Ezechiel

text: Heape together the bones, which I wil burne with fire: the flesh shal be conſumed, and al the compoſition shal be ſod, and the bones shal drie away.
label: Ezechiel

text: Set it alſo vpon hote burning coles emptie, that the braſſe therof may waxe hote, and be melted: and let the filth of it be melted in the middes therof, & let the ruſt therof be conſumed.
label: Ezechiel

text: There hath bene ſweating with much labour, and the exceding ruſt therof is not gone out, no not by fire.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thine vncleannes is execrable: becauſe I would clenſe thee, and thou art not clenſed from thy filthines: yea neither shalt thou be clenſed, before I make myne indignation to ceaſe in thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: I the Lord haue ſpoken: It shal come, and I wil doe it: I wil not paſſe, nor ſpare, nor be pacified: according to thy wayes, and according to thine inuentions wil I iudge thee, ſaith our Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, behold I take from thee the thing that thine eyes deſire in a plague: and thou shalt not lament, nor weepe: neither shal thy teares runne.
label: Ezechiel

text: Sigh holding thy peace, thou shalt not make the mourning of the dead: let thy crowne be tyed round about thee, and thy shoes shal be on thy feete, neither shalt thou couer thy face with a cloth, neither shalt thou eate the meates of mourners.
label: Ezechiel

text: I ſpake therfore to the people in the morning, and my wife died at euen: and I did in the morning as he had commanded me.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the people ſayd to me: Why doeſt thou not tel vs what theſe thinges ſignifie, that thou doeſt?
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſayd to them: The word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Speake to the houſe of Iſrael: Thus ſayth our Lord God: Behold I wil pollute my ſanctuarie, the pride of your empire, and the thing that your eyes deſire, and vpon which your ſoule quaketh for feare: your ſonnes, and your daughters, which you haue left, shal fal by the ſword.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you shal doe as I haue done: your faces with a clothe you shal not couer, and the meates of mourners you shal not eate.
label: Ezechiel

text: You shal haue crownes on your heades, & shoes on your feete: you shal not lament nor weepe, but you shal pine away in your iniquities, and euerie one shal groane toward his brother.
label: Ezechiel

text: And Ezechiel shal be vnto you for a portending ſigne: according to al thinges, that he hath done, shal you doe when this shal come: and you shal know that I am the Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou ſonne of man, behold in the day, wherin I wil take away from them their ſtrength, and the ioy of dignitie, and the deſire of their eyes, wherupon their ſoules reſt, their ſonnes and daughters.
label: Ezechiel

text: In that day when one fleing shal come to thee, to tel thee:
label: Ezechiel

text: in that day, I ſay, shal thy mouth be opened with him that fleeth, and thou shalt ſpeake, and shalt be ſilent no more: and thou shalt be vnto them for a portending ſigne, and you shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, ſet thy face againſt the children of Ammon, and thou shalt prophecie of them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt ſay to the children of Ammon: Heare ye the word of our Lord God: Thus ſaith our Lord God For that thou haſt ſayd: Ha, ha, vpon my ſanctuarie, becauſe it is polluted: and vpon the Land of Iſrael, becauſe it is made deſolate: and vpon the houſe of Iuda, becauſe they are led into captiuitie:
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore wil I deliuer thee to the children of the eaſt for an inheritance, and they shal place their shepecotes in thee, and shal ſet their tents in thee: they shal eate thy fruites: and they shal drinke thy milke.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil geue Rabbath to be an habitation of camels, and the children of Ammon to be a lying place for beaſtes: and you shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe thus ſaith our Lord God: For that thou haſt clapped with the hand, and ſtriken with the foote, and haſt bene glad withal thy affection vpon the land of Iſrael:
label: Ezechiel

text: therfore behold I wil ſtretch forth my hand vpon thee, and wil deliuer thee into the ſpoile of the Gentils, and wil kil thee out of the peoples, and deſtroy thee out of the landes, and breake thee: and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: For that Moab, and Seir haue ſayd: Behold as al the Gentils, ſo is the houſe of Iuda:
label: Ezechiel

text: therfore behold I wil open the shoulder of Moab of his cities, of his cities I ſay, and of his borders the noble cities of the land Bethieſimoth, and Beelmeon, and Cariathaim,
label: Ezechiel

text: to the children of the Eaſt with the children of Ammon, and I wil geue it for an inheritance: that there may be memorie no more of the children of Ammon among the Gentils.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in Moab I wil do Iudgements: and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: For that Idumea hath made reuenge to reuenge herſelf of the children of Iuda, and hath ſinned offending, and hath ſought reuenge of them;
label: Ezechiel

text: therfore thus ſayth our Lord God: I wil ſtretch forth my hand vpon Idumea, and wil take away out of it man, and beaſt, and wil make it deſert from the South: and they that are in Dedan, shal fal by the ſword.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil geue my reuenge vpon Idumea by the hand of my people Iſrael: and they shal doe in Edom according to my wrath, and my furie: and they shal know my vengeance, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: For that the Paleſthines haue made reuenge, and haue reuenged themſelues with al their minde, killing, and accomplishing old enmities:
label: Ezechiel

text: therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I wil ſtretch forth my hand vpon the Paleſthines, and wil kil the killers, and wil deſtroy the remnant of the ſea coſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: and I wil make in them great reuengements arguing in furie: and they shal know that I am the Lord, when I shal haue geuen my vengeance vpon them.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND it came to paſſe in the eleuenth yeare, the firſt of the moneth, the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man for that Tyre hath ſayd of Ieruſalem: Ah the gates of the peoples are broken, she is turned to me: I shal be filled, she is deſert.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I vpon thee ô Tyre, and I wil make manie nations come vp to thee, as the ſea riſeth vp ſwelling.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal diſſipate the walles of Tyre, and shal deſtroy the towers therof: and I wil ſcrape her duſt from her, & wil make her as a moſt cleare rocke.
label: Ezechiel

text: The drying of nettes shal be in the middes of the ſea, becauſe I haue ſpoken, ſaith our Lord God: and she shal be for a ſpoile to the Gentils.
label: Ezechiel

text: Her daughters alſo that be in the field, shal be ſlaine by the ſword: and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I wil bring to Tyre Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon from the North, the king of kinges with horſes, and chariotes, and horſemen, and multitude, and a great people.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thy daughters that are in the field, he shal kil with the ſword: and he shal compaſſe thee with munitions, and shal caſt vp a mount round about: and he shal lift vp the buckler againſt thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he shal diſpoſe ordinances, and engins againſt thy walles, & shal deſtroy thy towers with his armour.
label: Ezechiel

text: With the inundation of his horſes, the duſt of them shal couer thee: at the ſound of the horſemen, and wheeles, and chariotes thy walles shal be moued, when he shal goe in at thy gates, as by the entrance of a citie deſtroyed.
label: Ezechiel

text: With the hoofes of his horſes he shal tread downe al thy ſtreetes: thy people he shal kil with the ſword, and thy noble ſtatues shal fal to the ground.
label: Ezechiel

text: They shal waſte thy riches, they shal ſpoile thy merchandiſe: and they shal deſtroy thy walles, and shal ouerthrow thy goodlie houſes: and thy ſtones, and thy timber, and thy duſt they shal put in the middes of the waters.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make the multitude of thy ſongues to ceaſe, and the ſound of thy harpes shal be heard no more.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make thee as a moſt cleare rocke, drying of nettes shalt thou be, neither shalt thou be built anie more: becauſe I haue ſpoken, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God to Tyre: Why, shal not the ilands be moued at the ſound of thy ruine, & the groning of thy ſlaine, when they shal be killed in the middes of thee?
label: Ezechiel

text: And al the princes of the ſea shal goe downe from their ſeates: and take of their roabes, and caſt away their brodered garments, & be clothed with aſtonishment, ſitte on the earth, and being aſtonied meruel at thy ſudden fal.
label: Ezechiel

text: And taking vpon thee a lamentation, they shal ſay to thee: How haſt thou perished that dwelleſt in the ſea, ô noble citie, which haſt bene ſtrong in the ſea with thine inhabitants, whom al did feare?
label: Ezechiel

text: Now shal the shippes be aſtonied in the day of thy feare: and the ilands in the ſea shal be trubled, for that none cometh forth out of thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe thus ſaith our Lord God: When I shal make thee a deſolate citie as the cities that are not inhabited: and shal bring vpon thee the depth, and manie waters shal couer thee:
label: Ezechiel

text: and shal plucke thee downe with thoſe, that deſcend into the lake to the euerlaſting people, and shal place thee in the loweſt ground as old deſolations, with them that are brought downe into the lake, that thou be not inhabited: moreouer when I shal geue glorie in the land of the liuing,
label: Ezechiel

text: I wil bring thee to nothing, and thou shalt not be, & being ſought for, thou shalt not be found anie more for euer, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou therfore ô ſonne of man, take vp a lamentation vpon Tyre:
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt ſay to Tyre, which dwelleth in the entrance of the ſea, being the traffike of peoples to manie ilands: Thus ſaith our Lord God: ô Tyre, thou haſt ſaid: I am of perfect beautie,
label: Ezechiel

text: and ſituated in the hart of the ſea. Thy borderers, which builded thee haue accomplished thy beautie:
label: Ezechiel

text: with the firretrees of Sanir they builded thee, with al the bordes of the ſea: they tooke the cedar from Libanus, to make thee a maſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: Okes of Baſan they haue hewed for thine ores: and thy bankes they haue made thee of the iuorie of India, and litle cabbins of the ilands of Italie.
label: Ezechiel

text: Various ſilke of Ægypt was wouen for thy ſaile, to be put on the maſt: hyacinth, and purple out of the ilands of Eliſa, were made thy couering.
label: Ezechiel

text: The inhabitants of Sidon, and the Aradians were thy rowers: thy wiſe men, ô Tyre, were made thy gouernors.
label: Ezechiel

text: The ancients of Gebal, and wiſemen therof had mariners to the ſeruice of thy diuerſe ſtuffe: al the shippes of the ſea, and their mariners haue bene in the people of thy traffike.
label: Ezechiel

text: The Perſians, and Lydians, and the Lybians were in thine armie thy men of warre: the buckler, and helmet they did hang in thee for thine ornament.
label: Ezechiel

text: The children of Arad were with thine armie vpon thy walles round about: yea and the Pygmeians, that were in thy towers, hung vp their quiuers on thy walles round about: they accomplished thy beautie.
label: Ezechiel

text: They of Carthage thy merchants, for the multitude of al riches, with ſiluer, iron, tinne, and lead did they replenish thy marts.
label: Ezechiel

text: Greece, Thubal, and Moſoch, they were thy merchants: ſlaues, & veſſels of braſſe they brought to thy people.
label: Ezechiel

text: From the houſe of Thogorma they brought horſes, & horſemen, and mules to thy market.
label: Ezechiel

text: The children of Dedan were thy merchants: manie ilands the traffike of thy hand, teeth of iuorie, and of Heben they exchanged for thy price.
label: Ezechiel

text: The Syrian was thy merchant for the multitude of thy workes, the precious ſtone, and purple, and branched workes, and fine linnen, and ſilke, and chodchod they did ſet forth in thy market.
label: Ezechiel

text: Iuda and the land of Iſrael they were thy merchants in the principal corne: balme, and honie, and oyle, and reſine they did ſet forth in thy marts.
label: Ezechiel

text: The Damacene was thy merchant in the multitude of thy workes, in the multitude of diuers riches, in fatte wine, in woolles of the beſt colour.
label: Ezechiel

text: Dan, and Greece, & Moſel in thy marts haue ſet forth wrought yron: ſtacte, and calums were in thy merchandiſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: Dedan thy merchants in tapeſtrie for ſeates.
label: Ezechiel

text: Arabia, and al the princes of Cedar, they were the merchants of thy hand: with lambes, and rammes, and kiddes thy merchants came to thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: The ſellers of Saba, & Reema, they were thy merchants: with principal ſpices, and precious ſtone, and gold, which they did ſet forth in thy market.
label: Ezechiel

text: Haran, and Chene, and Eden, thy merchants: Saba, Aſſur, and Chelmad thy ſellers.
label: Ezechiel

text: They were thy merchants in diuers manner, with folded peeces of hyacinth, and of embrodered clothes, and of precious riches, which were wrapped vp, and bound with cordes: cedars alſo they had in thy merchandiſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: The shippes of the ſea, thy chief in thy merchandiſe: and thou waſt replenished, and glorified excedingly in the hart of the ſea.
label: Ezechiel

text: In manie waters haue thy rowers brought thee: the ſouthwinde hath broken thee in the hart of the ſea.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thy riches, and thy treaſures, and thy manifold furniture, thy mariners, and thy gouerners, which hold thy ſtuffe, and were chiefe ouer thy people: thy men of warre alſo, that were in thee with al thy multitude, that is in the middes of thee: shal fal in the hart of the ſea in the day of thy ruine.
label: Ezechiel

text: At the ſound of the crie of thy gouernours shal the nauies be trubled.
label: Ezechiel

text: And al they that held ore shal goe downe out of their shippes: the mariners, and al the gouernours of the ſea shal ſtand on the land:
label: Ezechiel

text: and they shal bewaile vpon thee with a loude voice, and shal crie bitterly: and they shal caſt duſt vpon their heades, and shal be ſprinkled with ashes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal shaue baldnes vpon thee, and shal be girded with heareclothes: and they shal weepe for thee in bitternes of ſoule with moſt bitter weeping.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal take vp a mournful ſong vpon thee, and shal lament thee: What citie is as Tyre, which is become ſilent in the middes of the ſea?
label: Ezechiel

text: Which in the going forth of thy merchandiſe from the ſea didſt fil manie peoples: in the multitude of thy riches, and of thy peoples haſt inriched the kinges of the earth.
label: Ezechiel

text: Now thou art deſtroyed by the ſea, thy riches are in the bottome of the waters, and al the multitude, that was in the middes of thee, are fallen.
label: Ezechiel

text: Al the inhabitants of the ilands are aſtonied vpon thee: and al the kinges of the ſame being ſtriken with tempeſt haue changed their lookes.
label: Ezechiel

text: The merchants of peoples haue hiſſed vpon thee: thou art brought to nothing, and thou shalt not be euen for euer.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man ſay to the prince of Tyre: Thus ſaith our Lord God: For that thy hart is eleuated, & thou haſt ſayd: I am God, and I haue ſitten in the chaire of God in the hart of the ſea: wheras thou art a man, and not God: and haſt geuen thy hart as the hart of God.
label: Ezechiel

text: Loe thou art wiſer then Daniel: euerie ſecret is not hid from thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: In thy wiſedom and thy prudence thou haſt made thee ſtrength: and haſt gotten gold, and ſiluer in thy treaſures.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the multitude of thy wiſedome, & in thy merchandiſe thou haſt multiplied ſtrength to thee: and thy hart is eleuated in thy ſtrength.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: For that thy hart is eleuated as the hart of God:
label: Ezechiel

text: therfore behold I wil bring vpon thee ſtrangers the ſtrongeſt of the Gentils: and they shal draw their ſwordes vpon the beautie of thy wiſedome, and shal pollute thy comelines.
label: Ezechiel

text: They shal kil, and plucke thee downe: and thou shalt dye in the death of the ſlaine in the hart of the ſea.
label: Ezechiel

text: Why, shalt thou ſpeake ſaying: I am God, before them that kil thee: wheras thou art a man, and not God, in the hand of them that ſlay thee?
label: Ezechiel

text: By the death of the vncircumciſed shalt thou dye in the hand of ſtrangers: becauſe I haue ſpoken, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying: Sonne of man lift vp a lamentation vpon the king of Tyre:
label: Ezechiel

text: and thou shalt ſay to him: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Thou the ſignet of ſimilitude, ful of wiſedom, and perfect of beautie,
label: Ezechiel

text: thou waſt in the delicacies of the paradiſe of God: euerie precious ſtone thy couering: ſardius, topatius, and the iaſper, chryſolithus, and onyx, and berillus, the ſapphire, and the carbuncle, and the emerald: gold the worke of thy beautie: and thy pipes were prepared in the day, that thou waſt created.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou Cherub ſtreched out, and protecting, and I ſette thee in the holie mount of God, in the middes of fyrie ſtones thou haſt walked.
label: Ezechiel

text: Perfect in thy wayes from the day of thy creation, vntil iniquitie was found in thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the multitude of thy merchandiſe, thyne inner partes were filled with iniquitie, and thou didſt ſinne: and I caſt thee out from the mount of God, and deſtroyed thee ô Cherub protecting, out of the middes of the fyrie ſtones.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thy hart was eleuated in thy beautie: thou haſt loſt thy wiſedome in thy beautie, I haue caſt thee to the earth: before the face of kinges I haue geuen thee, that they might behold thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the multitude of thine iniquities, & in the iniquitie of thy merchandiſe, thou haſt polluted thy ſanctification: I wil therfore bring forth a fyre out of the middes of thee, to eate thee, and I wil make thee as ashes vpon the earth in the ſight of al that ſee thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: Al that shal ſee thee in the Gentils, shal be aſtonied vpon thee: thou art become a thing of naught, and thou shalt not be for euer.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, ſet thy face againſt Sidon: and thou shalt prophecie of it,
label: Ezechiel

text: and shalt ſay: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I to thee Sidon, and I wil be glorified in the middes of thee: and they shal know that I am the Lord, when I shal doe iudgements in it, and shal be ſanctified in it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſend into it peſtilence, and bloud in the ſtreetes therof: & the ſlaine shal fal in the middes therof by the ſword round about: and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And there shal be no more ſcandal of bitternes to the houſe of Iſrael, and thorne cauſing payne on euerie ſide round about them, that are againſt them: and they shal know that I am the Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: When I shal haue gathered together the houſe of Iſrael out of the peoples, in which they are diſperſed: I wil be ſanctified in them before the Gentils: and they shal dwel in their land, which I gaue to my ſeruant Iacob.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal dwel therin ſecure, and they shal build houſes, and shal plant vineyards, and shal dwel confidently, when I shal haue done iudgements in al, that are their enemies round about: & they shal know that I am the Lord their God.
label: Ezechiel

text: IN the tenth yeare, the tenth moneth, the eleuenth day of the moneth, the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, ſet thy face againſt Pharao the king of Ægypt: and thou shalt prophecie of him, and of al Ægypt.
label: Ezechiel

text: Speake, and thou shalt ſay: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I to thee Pharao king of Ægypt, thou great dragon, which lyeſt in the middes of thy riuers, and ſayeſt: The riuer is mine, and I made it my ſelfe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil put a bridle in thy iawes: and I wil faſten the fishes of thy riuers to thy ſcales: and I wil draw thee out of the middes of thy riuers, and al thy fishes shal ſticke to thy ſcales.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil caſt thee forth into the deſert, and al the fishes of thy riuer: thou shalt fal vpon the face of the earth, thou shalt not be collected, nor gathered together: to the beaſts of the earth, and to the foules of the heauen haue I geuen thee to be deuoured.
label: Ezechiel

text: And al the inhabitants of Ægypt shal know that I am the Lord: for that thou haſt bene a ſtaffe of reede to the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: When they tooke thee with the hand, and thou waſt broken, and didſt rent al their shoulder: and they leaning vpon thee, thou waſt broken, and didſt diſſolue al their reines.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I wil bring vpon thee the ſword: and wil kil out of thee man, and beaſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the Land of Ægypt shal be into a deſert, and into a wildernes: and they shal know that I am the Lord: for that thou haſt ſayd: The riuer is mine, and I made it.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore behold I to thee, and to thy riuers: and I wil geue the Land of Ægypt into deſolations, deſtroyed with the ſword, from the tower of Syene, euen to the borders of Æthiopia.
label: Ezechiel

text: The foote of man shal not paſſe through it, neither shal the foote of beaſt goe in it: and it shal not be inhabited fourtie yeares.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make the Land of Ægypt deſert in the middes of deſert lands, & the cities therof in the middes of cities ouerthrowen, and they shal be deſolate fourtie yeares: and I wil diſperſe the Ægyptians into nationes, and wil ſcatter them into the landes.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe thus ſaith our Lord God: After the end of fourtie years I wil gather Ægypt out of the peoples in which they had bene diſperſed.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil bring backe the captiuitie of Ægypt, and wil place them in the land of Phatures, in the land of their natiuitie, and they shal be there as a low kingdom:
label: Ezechiel

text: among other kingdoms it shal be loweſt, and it shal no more be eleuated ouer the nations, and I wil diminish them that they rule not ouer the Gentils.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shl no more be to the houſe of Iſrael in confidence, teaching iniquitie, that they may flee, and folow them: and they shal know that I am the Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And it came to paſſe in the ſeuen and twenteth yeare, in the firſt, in the firſt of the moneth: the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, Nabuchodnoſor the king of Babylon hath made his armie to ſerue with great ſeruice agaynſt Tyre: euerie head made bald, and euerie shoulder hath the heare plucked of: and there hath bene no reward rendred him, nor his armie concerning Tyre, for the ſeruice that he ſerued me agaynſt it.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſayth our Lord God: Behold I wil geue Nabuchodonſor the king of Babylon in the Land of Ægypt: and he shal take the multitude therof, and take the booties therof for a praye, and rifle the ſpoiles therof: and it shal be a reward for his armie,
label: Ezechiel

text: and for the worke, that he ſerued me agaynſt it: I haue geuen him the Land of Ægypt, for that they haue labored for me, ſayth our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: In that day there shal a horne ſpring to the houſe of Iſrael, and I wil geue thee an open mouth in the middes of them: and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man prophecie, & ſay: Thus ſayth our Lord God: Howle ye, wo, wo to the day:
label: Ezechiel

text: becauſe the day is nere, and the day of our Lord approcheth: the day of a cloude, the time of the Gentiles shal be.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſword shal come into Ægypt: & there shal be feare in Æthiopia, when the woonded shal fal in Ægypt, and the multitude therof shal be taken away, and the fundations therof be deſtroyed.
label: Ezechiel

text: Æthiopia, and Libia, and the Lydians, and al the reſt of the common people, and Chub, and the children of the land of couenan, shal fal with them, by the ſword.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſayth our Lord God: And they shal fal that vnderproppe Ægypt, and the pride of the empire therof shal be deſtroyed: from the towre of Siena shal they fal in it by the ſword, ſayth our Lord the God of hoſtes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal be diſſipated in the middes of deſolate landes, and the cities therof shal be in the middes of deſert cities.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal know that I am the Lord: when I shal haue geuen fyre in Ægypt, and al the ayders therof shal be broken.
label: Ezechiel

text: In that day shal meſſengers goe forth from my face in gallies to terrifie the confidence of Æthiopia, and there shal be feare among them in the day of Ægypt: becauſe it shal come without doubt.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſayth our Lord God: I wil make the multitude of Ægypt to ceaſe in the hand of Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon.
label: Ezechiel

text: He and his people with him the ſtrongeſt of the Gentiles shal be brought to deſtroy the land: and they shal draw their ſwordes vpon Ægypt: and shal fil the land with the ſlaine.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make the channels of the riuers drie, and wil deliuer the land into the handes of the moſt wicked: and wil diſſipate the land and the fulnes therof in the handes of aliens, I the Lord haue ſpoken.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſayth our Lord God: And I wil deſtroy the idols, and I wil make the idols to ceaſe out of Memphis: and duke of the land of Ægypt there shal be no more: and I wil geue terrour in the land of Ægypt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil deſtroy the land of Phathures, and wil geue fire in Taphnis, and wil do iudgements in Alexandria.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil powre out mine indignation vpon Peluſium the ſtrength of Ægypt, and wil kil the multitude of Alexandria,
label: Ezechiel

text: And wil geue fyre in Ægypt: as a woman in trauel shal Peluſium ſorow, & Alexandria shal be diſſipated, and in Memphis daylie diſtreſſes.
label: Ezechiel

text: The yong men of Heliopolis, and of Bubaſti shal fal by the ſword, and themſelues shal be led captiue.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in Taphnis the day shal waxe black, when I shal haue broken there the ſcepters of Ægypt, and the pride of the might therof shal faile in it: the cloude shal couer her, & her daughters shal be led into captiuitie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil doe iudgements in Ægypt: & they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And it came to paſſe in the eleuenth yeare, in the firſt moneth, in the ſeuenth of the moneth, the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, I haue broken the arme of Pharao king of Ægypt: and behold it is not wound vp, that health might be reſtored to it, that it might be bound with clothes, and ſwadled with linnen cloutes, that recouering ſtrength it might hold the ſword.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I to Pharao king of Ægypt, & I wil breake into peeces his ſtrong arme, already broken: and I wil caſt downe the ſword out of his hand:
label: Ezechiel

text: and wil diſperſe Ægypt among the Gentils, and wil ſcatter them in the landes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſtrengthen the armes of the king of Babylon, and wil geue my ſword in his hand: and I wil breake the armes of Pharao, and the ſlaine before his face shal grone with groninges.
label: Ezechiel
