text: And I wil ſtrengthen the armes of the king of Babylon, and the armes of Pharao shal fal: and they shal know that I am the Lord, when I shal geue my ſword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shal haue ſtreched it forth vpon the Land of Ægypt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil diſperſe Ægypt into nations, and wil ſcatter them into landes, and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND it came to paſſe in the eleuenth yeare, the third moneth, the firſt of the moneth, the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, ſay to Pharao the king of Ægypt, and to his people To whom art thou made like in thy greatnes?
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold Aſſur as it were a ceder in Libanus, fayre of boughes, and thicke of leaues, and high of height, and the toppe therof is eleuated among the thicke boughes.
label: Ezechiel

text: The waters haue nourished him, the depth hath exalted him, the riuers therof ranne out round about the rootes therof, and he ſent forth her riuers to al the trees of the countrie.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore was his height eleuated aboue al the trees of the countrie: and his groues were multiplied, and his boughes were eleuated becauſe of manie waters.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when he had ſpred forth his shadow, in his boughes al the foules of the heauen made neſts, and vnder his leaues al beaſts of the forreſts engendred, and vnder his shadow dwelt the aſſemblie of verie manie nations.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he was moſt faire in his greatnes, and in the enlarging of his groues: for his roote was nere manie waters.
label: Ezechiel

text: The ceders were not higher then he in the paradiſe of God, the firretrees matched not his toppe, and the planetrees were not equal to his boughes: no tree of the paradiſe of God was likened to him, and to his beautie.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe I made him beautiful, and with manie & thicke boughes: and al the trees of pleaſure, that were in the paradiſe of God, did emulate him.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: For that he is extolled in height, and hath geuen his toppe greene and thicke, and his hart is eleuated in his height:
label: Ezechiel

text: I haue deliuered him into the handes of the ſtrongeſt of the nations, doing he shal doe to him: according to his impietie I haue caſt him out.
label: Ezechiel

text: And aliens, and the moſt cruel of the nations shal cut him downe, and shal throw him forth vpon the mountaines, and in al valleis his boughes shal fal, and his groues shal be broken on al rockes of the land: and al the peoples of the earth shal depart from his shadow, and shal leaue him.
label: Ezechiel

text: In his ruine dwelt al the foules of heauen, and in his boughes were al the beaſts of the fielde.
label: Ezechiel

text: For which cauſe there shal not be eleuated in their height al the trees of the waters, neither shal they put their highnes among the wooddie and thicke ones, neither shal they ſtand in their height, al that are watered with waters: becauſe they are al deliuered into death to the loweſt earth in the middes of the children of men, to them that goe downe into the lake.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: In the day that he went downe to hel, I brought in mourning, I couered him with the depth: and I ſtayed his riuers, and kept in manie waters: Libanus was made ſad vpon him, and al the trees of the filde were shaken.
label: Ezechiel

text: At the ſound of his ruine I moued the Gentils, when I brought him downe to hel with them, that deſcended into the lake: and al the trees of pleaſure goodlie and glorious in Libanus, al that were watered with waters, were comfourted in the loweſt earth.
label: Ezechiel

text: For they alſo shal goe downe with him to hel to the ſlaine by the ſword: and the arme of euerie one shal ſitte vnder his shadow in the middes of the nations.
label: Ezechiel

text: To whom art thou likened ō thou noble and loftie among the trees of pleaſure? Behold thou art brought downe with the trees of pleaſure to the loweſt earth: in the middes of the vncircumciſed shalt thou ſleepe, with them that are ſlaine by the ſword, the ſame is Pharao, and al his multitude, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND it came to paſſe, the twelth yeare, in the twelth moneth, in the firſt of the moneth, the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, take vp a lamentation vpon Pharao the king of Ægypt, & thou shalt ſay to him: Thou art likened to the Lion of the Gentils, and the dragon, that is in the ſea: and thou didſt ſtrike with the horne in thy riuers, and didſt truble the waters with thy fete, and didſt conculcate their ſtreames.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: I wil ſpred my nette vpon thee in the multitude of manie peoples, and I wil draw thee out in my nette.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil throw thee forth on the ground, vpon the face of the filde wil I caſt thee away: and I wil make al the foules of heauen to dwel vpon thee, and I wil fil of thee the beaſtes of al the earth.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil geue thy flesh vpon the mountaines, and wil fil the litle hilles with thy corruption.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil water the earth with the ſtinche of thy bloud vpon the mountaines, and the valleis shal be filled of thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil couer the heauens, when thou shalt be extinguished, and I wil make the ſtarres therof to waxe blacke: the ſunne I wil couer with a cloude, and the moone shal not geue her light.
label: Ezechiel

text: I wil make al the lightes of heauen to mourne vpon thee: & I wil geue darkenes vpon thy land, ſaith our Lord God, when thy wounded shal fal in the middes of the land, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I shal prouoke to anger the hart of manie peoples, when I shal haue brought in thy deſtruction in the Gentils vpon the landes, which thou knoweſt not.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make manie peoples to be aſtonied vpon thee, and their kinges, with exceding horrour shal be afraid vpon thee, when my ſword shal beginne to flie vpon their faces: and they shal be aſtonied ſodenly, euerie one for his life, in the day of thy ruine.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe thus ſaith our Lord God:
label: Ezechiel

text: The ſword of the king of Babylon shal come to thee, in the ſwordes of the valients wil I ouerthrow thy multitude: inuincible are al theſe Gentils: and they shal waſte the pride of Ægypt, and the multitude therof shal be diſſipated.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil deſtroy al the beaſts therof, that were vpon verie manie waters: and the foote of man shal truble them no more, neither shal the hoofe of beaſts truble them.
label: Ezechiel

text: Then wil I make their waters moſt pure, and their riuers I wil bring as oile, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: When I shal haue made the Land of Ægypt deſolate: and the land shal be made deſert of her fulnes, when I shal haue ſtrooken al the inhabitants therof: & they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: It is lamentation, and they shal lament it, the daughters of the Gentils shal lament it, vpon Ægypt, and vpon the multitude therof they shal lament it, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And it came to paſſe in the twelfth yeare, in the fiftenth of the moneth, the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, ſing a mourning ſong vpon the multitude of Ægypt: and plucke her downe, herſelf, and the daughters of the ſtrong nations to the loweſt earth with them, that goe downe into the lake.
label: Ezechiel

text: Fayrer then whom art thou? Deſcend, and ſleepe with the vncircumciſed.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the middes of the ſlaine by the ſword they shal fal: the ſword is geuen, they haue drawen her, and al her peoples.
label: Ezechiel

text: The moſt mightie of the ſtrong shal ſpeake to him from the middes of hel, which went downe with his helpers, and ſlept vncircumciſed, ſlaine by the ſword.
label: Ezechiel

text: There Aſſur, and al his multitude: round about him their graues, al the ſlaine, and they that fel by the ſword.
label: Ezechiel

text: Whoſe graues were made in the loweſt lakes: and his multitude was made round about his graue: al the ſlaine, and they that fel by the ſword, which ſometime had geuen feare in the land of the liuing.
label: Ezechiel

text: There Ælam, and al the multitude therof round about her graue. al theſe ſlaine, and falling by the ſword: that went downe vncircumciſed to the loweſt earth: which did put their terrour in the land of the liuing, and they haue borne their ignominie with them, that goe downe into the lake.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the middes of their ſlaine they haue ſet her couche among al her peoples: round about him their graue: al theſe vncircumciſed, and ſlaine by the ſword, for they gaue their terrour in the land of the liuing, and haue borne their ignominie with them, that deſcend into the lake: they are layde in the middes of the ſlaine.
label: Ezechiel

text: There Moſoch, and Thubal, and al their multitude: round about him their graues: al theſe vncircumciſed, and ſlaine, and falling by the ſword: becauſe they gaue their feare in the land of the liuing.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal not ſleepe with the valients, and them that fel, and the vncircumciſed, that went downe to hel with their weapons, and put their ſwordes vnder their heades, and their iniquities were in their bones: becauſe they were made the terrour of the valients in the land of the liuing.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou therfore shalt be deſtroyed in the middes of the vncircumciſed, and shalt ſleepe with the ſlaine by the ſword.
label: Ezechiel

text: There Idumea, and her kinges, & al her princes, which were geuen with their hoſt with the ſlaine by the ſword: and which ſlept with the vncircumciſed, and with them that goe downe into the lake.
label: Ezechiel

text: There al the princes of the North, and al the hunters: which were brought downe with the ſlaine, fearing, and in their ſtrength confounded: which ſlept vncircumciſed with the ſlaine by the ſword, and haue borne their ignominie with them, that goe downe into the lake.
label: Ezechiel

text: Pharao ſaw them, and he was comforted vpon al his multitude, which was ſlaine by the ſword, Pharao, and al his hoſt, ſaith our Lord God:
label: Ezechiel

text: becauſe I gaue his terrour in the land of the liuing, & he ſlept in the middes of the vncircumciſed with the ſlaine by the ſword: Pharao and al his multitude: ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, ſpeake to the children of thy people, and thou shalt ſay to them: The land when I shal bring the ſword in vpon it, and the people of the land take a man, one of their meaneſt, & make him a watchman ouer them:
label: Ezechiel

text: and he shal ſee the ſword coming vpon the land, and ſound with the trumpet, & tel the people:
label: Ezechiel

text: and he that heareth the ſound of the trumpet, whoſoeuer he be, and doth not looke to himſelfe, and the ſword come, and take him: his bloud shal be vpon his head.
label: Ezechiel

text: He heard the ſound of the trumpet, and did not looke to himſelf, his bloud shal be on himſelf: but if he shal looke to himſelf, he shal ſaue his life.
label: Ezechiel

text: And if the watchman ſee the ſword coming, and ſound not with the trumpet: and the people looke not to them ſelues, and the ſword come, and take a ſoule from among them: he certes is caught in his iniquitie, but his bloud I wil require of the hand of the watchman.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou ſonne of man, I haue made thee a watchman to the houſe of Iſrael: hearing therfore the word from my mouth, thou shalt tel them from me.
label: Ezechiel

text: If when I ſay to the impious: O thou impious, dying thou shalt dye: thou ſpeake not that the impious may keepe himſelf from his way: the impious himſelf shal dye in his iniquitie, but his bloud I wil require at thy hand.
label: Ezechiel

text: But if thou telling the impious, that he conuert from his wayes, he conuert not from his way: he shal dye in his iniquitie: but thou haſt deliuered thy ſoule.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou therfore ô ſonne of man ſay to the houſe of Iſrael: Thus you haue ſpoken, ſaying: Our iniquities, and our ſinnes are vpon vs, & in them we fade away: how then can we liue?
label: Ezechiel

text: Say to them: Liue I, ſayeth our Lord God: I wil not the death of the impious, but that the impious conuert from his way, and liue: Conuert, conuert ye from your moſt euil wayes: and why wil you dye ô houſe of Iſrael?
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou therfore ſonne of man ſay to the children of thy people: The iuſtice of the iuſt shal not deliuer him, in what day ſoeuer he shal ſinne: and the impietie of the impious shal not hurt him, in what day ſoeuer he shal conuert from his impietie: and the iuſt can not liue in his iuſtice, in what day ſoeuer he shal ſinne.
label: Ezechiel

text: Yea if I shal ſay to the iuſt that liuing he shal liue, and he truſting in his iuſtice doe iniquitie: al his iuſtices shal be forgotten, and in his iniquitie, which he hath wrought, in the ſame shal he dye.
label: Ezechiel

text: And if I shal ſay to the impious: Dying thou shalt dye: and he do penance from his ſinne & do iudgement and iuſtice,
label: Ezechiel

text: and the ſame impious reſtore pledge, and render robberie, walke in the commandments of life, and doe not anie vniuſt thing: liuing he shal liue, & shal not dye.
label: Ezechiel

text: Al his ſinnes, which he hath ſinned, shal not be imputed to him: he hath done iudgment and iuſtice, liuing he shal liue.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the children of thy people, haue ſaid: The way of our Lord is not of equal weight, & their owne way is vniuſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: For when the iuſt shal depart from his iuſtice, and doe iniquities, he shal dye in them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when the impious shal depart from his impietie, and shal doe iudgements, and iuſtice: he shal liue in them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you ſay: The way of our Lord is not right, euery one according to his wayes wil I iudge of you, ô houſe of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: And it came to paſſe in the twelfth yeare, in the tenth moneth, in the fifth of the moneth of our tranſmigration, there came to me one that was fled from Ieruſalem, ſaying: The citie is made waſte.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the hand of our Lord had bene made to me in the euening, before he came that was fled: and he opened my mouth til he came to me in the morning, and my mouth being opened I was ſilent no more.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man: They that dwel in theſe ruinous places, vpon the ground of Iſrael, ſpeaking doe ſay: Abraham was one, and by inheritance he poſſeſſed the land: but we be manie, the land is geuen vs in poſſeſſion.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thou shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Ye that eate in bloud, & lift vp your eyes to your vncleanes, & shed bloud: what shal you poſſeſſe the land by inheritance?
label: Ezechiel

text: You ſtood on your ſwords, you haue done abominations, and euerie one hath polluted his neighbours wife: and you wil poſſeſſe the land by inheritance?
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus thou shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Liue I, that they which dwel in the ruinous places, shal fal by the ſword: and he that is in the filde, shal be deliuered to beaſtes to be deuoured: and they that are in holdes, and caues, shal dye of the peſtilence.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil geue the land into a wildernes, & into a deſert, and the proude ſtrength therof shal faile, and the mountaines of Iſrael shal be deſolate, becauſe there is none to paſſe by them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal know that I am the Lord, when I shal geue their land deſolate and deſert for al their abominations, which they haue wrought.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou ſonne of man: the children of thy people, which ſpeake of thee by the walles, and in the doores of houſes, and one ſaith to an other, a man to his neighbour, ſpeaking: Come, and let vs heare what is the word that procedeth from our Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they come to thee, as if a people should goe in, and my people ſitte before thee: and they heare thy wordes, and doe them not: becauſe they turne them into a ſong of their mouth, and their hart foloweth their auarice.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou art vnto them as a muſical ſong which is ſung with ſwete and pleaſant ſound: and they heare thy wordes, and doe them not.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when it shal come to paſſe which was told before (for behold it cometh) then shal they know that there was a prophet among them.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man prophecie of the paſtours of Iſrael: prophecie, and thou shalt ſay to the paſtours: Thus ſayth our Lord God: Wo to the paſtours of Iſrael, which fed themſelues: are not the flockes fed of the paſtours?
label: Ezechiel

text: You did eate the milke, and were couered with the wool, and that which was fatte ye killed: but my flocke you fed not.
label: Ezechiel

text: That which was weake, you ſtrengthened not: and that which was ſicke, you healed not: that which was broken, you bound not vp: and that which was caſt away, you brought not againe: and that which was loſt, you ſought not: but with auſteritie you did rule ouer them, and with might.
label: Ezechiel

text: And my sheepe were diſperſed, becauſe there was no paſtour: and they came to be deuoured of al the beaſts of the filde, and were diſperſed.
label: Ezechiel

text: My flockes haue wandered in al mountaines, and in euerie high hil: and vpon al the face of the earth were my flockes diſperſed, and there was none that ſought them, there was none, I ſay, that ſought them.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore ye sheepheards heare the word of our Lord:
label: Ezechiel

text: Liue I, ſaith our Lord God: that for as much as my flockes haue bene made a ſpoile: & my sheepe to be deuoured of al the beaſts of the filde, becauſe there was no paſtour (for my paſtours did not ſeeke my flocke but the paſtours fed themſelues, & my flockes they fed not:)
label: Ezechiel

text: therfore ye paſtours heare the word of our Lord:
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſayth our Lord God: Behold I my ſelf vpon the shepheards, I wil require my flocke of their hand, and I wil make them ceaſe, that they fede my flocke no more, and that the paſtours feede no more themſelues: and I wil deliuer my flocke out of their mouth, and it shal no more be meate for them.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I my ſelf wil ſeeke my sheepe, and wil viſite them.
label: Ezechiel

text: As the paſtour viſiteth his flocke in the day when he shal be in the middes of his sheepe which were ſcattered: ſo wil I viſite my sheepe, and wil deliuer them out of al places, wherein they had bene diſperſed in the day of the cloude and of darkenes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil bring them out of the peoples, and wil gather them out of the landes, and wil bring them into their owne land: and I wil feede them in the mountaines of Iſrael, in the riuers, and in al the ſeates of the land.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the moſt plentiful paſtures wil I feede them, and in the high mountaines of Iſrael shal be their paſtures: there shal they reſt on the greene graſſe, and in fatte paſtures they shal be fed vpon the mountaines of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: I wil fede my sheepe: & I wil make them lie, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: That which was loſt, I wil ſeke: & that which was caſt away, I wil bring againe: and that which was broken I wil binde vp: and that which was weake, I wil ſtrengthen: and that which was fatte & ſtrong, I wil kepe: & wil feede them in iudgment.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you my flockes, thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I iudge betwen beaſt and beaſt, of rammes, and of bucke goates.
label: Ezechiel

text: Was it not ynough for you to feede vpon good paſtures? you haue beſides alſo troden downe with your fete the reſidue of your paſtures: and when you dranke moſt pure water, the reſt you trubled with your feete.
label: Ezechiel

text: And my sheepe were fed with thoſe thinges, which were troden with your feete: and what your feete had trubled, that did they drinke.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God to you: Behold, I myſelf doe iudge betwen the fat beaſt and the leane.
label: Ezechiel

text: For that you with ſides and shoulders did thruſt, and with your hornes ſtroke al the weake beaſtes, til they were diſperſed abrode:
label: Ezechiel

text: I wil ſaue my flocke, & it shal be no more into ſpoile, & I wil iudge betwen beaſt and beaſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND I WIL RAISE VP OVER THEM ONE PASTOVR: who shal fede them, my ſeruant Dauid: he shal fede them, and he shal be their Paſtour.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I the Lord wil be their God: & my ſeruant Dauid the prince in the middes of them: I the Lord haue ſpoken.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make a couenant of peace with them, and wil make the moſt cruel beaſtes to ceaſe out of the land: and they that dwel in the deſert, shal ſleepe ſecure in the forreſts.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil put them round about my hil a bleſſing: and I wil bring downe the showere in his time, there shal be raynes of bleſſing.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the tree of the filde shal geue his fruite, and the earth shal geue her ſpring, and they shal be in their land without feare: and they shal know that I am the Lord, when I shal haue broken the cheynes of their yoke, and shal haue deliuered them out of the hand of thoſe that rule ouer them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal be no more for a ſpoile in the Gentiles, neither shal the beaſtes of the earth deuoure them: but they shal dwel confidently without any terrour.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil raiſe vp vnto them a bud of name: and they shal be no more diminished for famine in the land, neither shal they beare anie more the reproch of the Gentiles.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal know that I the Lord their God with them, and they my people the houſe of Iſrael: ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you my flockes, the flockes of my paſture are men: and I the Lord your God, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man ſet thy face againſt mount Seir, and thou shalt prophecie of it, and shalt ſay to it:
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I to thee mount Seir, and I wil ſtretch forth my hand vpon thee, and wil make thee deſolate and deſert.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thy cities I wil deſtroy, and thou ſhalt be deſert: and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: For that thou haſt bene an euerlaſting enemie, and haſt shut vp the children of Iſrael into the handes of the ſword in the time of their affliction, in the time of extreme iniquitie.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore liue I, ſaith our Lord God, that I wil deliuer thee vnto bloud, & bloud shal perſecute thee: & wheras thou haſt hated bloud, bloud shal perſecute thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make mount Seir deſolate and deſert: and I wil take from it the comer, and goer.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil fil his mountaines with his ſlaine: in thy hilles, and in thy valleis, and in the torrents shal the ſlaine with the ſword fal.
label: Ezechiel

text: Into euerlaſting deſolations wil I deliuer thee, and thy cities shal not be inhabited: and thou shalt know that I am the Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: For that thou haſt ſaid: The two nations, and the two landes shal be mine, and I wil poſſeſſe them by inheritance: wheras our Lord was there.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore liue I, ſaith our Lord God, that I wil doe according to thy wrath, and according to thy zele, which thou haſt vſed hating them: and I wil be made knowne by them, when I shal haue iudged thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt know that I the Lord haue heard al thy reproches, that thou haſt ſpoken of the montaines of Iſrael, ſaying: They are deſert, they are geuen vnto vs to deuoure.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you roſe vp vpon me with your mouth, & haue derogated your wordes againſt me: I heard it.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Al the earth reioycing, I wil bring thee into a wildernes
label: Ezechiel

text: As thou haſt reioyced vpon the inheritance of the houſe of Iſrael, becauſe it was diſſipated, ſo wil I doe to thee: Thou shalt be diſſipated mount Seir, and al Idumea: and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND thou ſonne of man, prophecie concerning the mountainnes of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay: Mountainnes of Iſrael heare ye the word of our Lord:
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: For that the enemie hath ſayd of you: Aha, the euerlaſting heightes are geuen to vs for an inheritance:
label: Ezechiel

text: therfore prophecie, & ſay: Thus ſaith our Lord God: For that you haue bene deſolate, and troden downe round about, and made an inheritance to the reſt of the Gentils, and haue aſcended vpon the lippe of the tongue, & the reproche of the people:
label: Ezechiel

text: therfore ye mountaines of Iſrael heare the word of our Lord God: Thus ſayth our Lord God to the mountaines, and hilles, to the torrents, and valleis, & the deſerts, and broken walleis, & to the cities forſaken which are ſpoiled, & ſcorned of the reſt of the Nations round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord God: Becauſe in fyre of my zele I haue ſpoken of the reſt of the nations, and of al Iduma, which haue geuen my land to themſelues for an inheritance with ioy, and with al their hart, and with the minde: and haue caſt it forth to waſte it:
label: Ezechiel

text: therfore prophecie concerning the ground of Iſrael, and thou shalt ſay to the montaines, & hilles, to the hiltoppes, and valleis: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I haue ſpoken in my zele, & in my furie becauſe you haue ſuſteyned the confuſion of the Gentiles.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thus ſayth our Lord God: I haue lifted my hand, that the Gentiles which are round about you, they may beare their confuſion.
label: Ezechiel

text: But you ô mountaines of Iſrael may shoote forth your boughes, and bring forth your fruite to my people of Iſrael: for he is at hand to come.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe loe I to you, and I wil turne to you, and you shal be ploughed, and shal take ſeede.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil multiplie in you men, & al the houſe of Iſrael: and the cities shal be inhabited, and the ruinous places shal be repayred.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil replenish you with men, and with beaſts: and they shal be multiplied, and increaſe: and I wil make you dwel as from the beginning, and wil endewe you with greater giftes, then you haue had from the beginning: and you shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil bring men vpon you, my people Iſrael, and they shal poſſeſſe thee by inheritance: and thou shalt be for an inheritance to them, and thou shalt adde no more to be without them.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: For that they ſay of you: A deuourer of men thou art, and one that doeſt ſuffocate thy nation.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thou shalt eate men no more, and thy nation thou shalt kil no more, ſaith our Lord God:
label: Ezechiel

text: neither wil I make the confuſion of the Gentils, to be heard in thee anie more, and the reproch of the people thou shalt not beare, and thy nation thou shalt loſe no more, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, the houſe of Iſrael dwelt in their ground, and polluted it in their wayes, and in their ſtudies according to the vncleanes of a menſtruous woman was their way made before me.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I haue powred out mine indignation vpon them for the bloud, which they haue shed vpon the land, and in their idols haue polluted it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I haue diſperſed them into the Gentils, and they are ſcattered into the landes: according to their wayes, and their inuentions haue I iudged them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they went in to the Nations, vnto which they entered, and haue polluted my holie name, when it was ſaid of them: This is the people of the Lord, and out of his land they are come forth.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I haue ſpared my holie name, which the houſe of Iſrael polluted among the Gentiles, to which they entered in.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore thou shalt ſay to the houſe of Iſrael: Thus ſaith our Lord God, not for your ſake wil I doe it, ô houſe of iſrael, but for my holie name which you haue polluted in the Nations to which you entered.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſanctifie my great name, that is polluted among the Gentiles, which you haue polluted in the middes of them: that the Gentils may know that I am the Lord, ſaith our Lord of hoſtes, when I shal be ſanctified in you before them.
label: Ezechiel

text: For I wil take you out of the Gentils, and wil gather you together out of al the landes, and wil bring you into your land.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil powre out vpon you cleane water, and you shal be clenſed from al your contaminations, & from al your idols wil I clenſe you.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil geue you a new hart, and wil put a new ſpirit in the middes of you: and wil take away the ſtonie hart out of your flesh, and wil geue you a fleshie hart.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil put my ſpirite in the middes of you: and I wil make that you walke in my precepts, & keepe my iudgements, and doe them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you shal dwel in the land: which I gaue to your fathers, and you shal be my people, and I wil be your God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſaue you from al your contaminations: and I wil cal for corne, and wil multiplie it, and wil not put famine vpon you.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil multiplie the fruite of the tree, and the ofſprings of the filde, that you beare no more the reproch of famine among the Gentils.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you shal remember your moſt wicked wayes, and your ſtudies not good: and your iniquities, and your wicked deedes shal diſpleaſe you.
label: Ezechiel

text: Not for you wil I doe it, ſaith our Lord God, be it knowne to you: be ye confounded, and ashamed vpon your wayes, ô houſe of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: In the day that I shal clenſe you from al your iniquities, and shal make the cities to be inhabited, and shal repayre the ruinous places,
label: Ezechiel

text: and the deſert land shal be tilled, which once was deſolate in the eyes of euerie wayfaringman,
label: Ezechiel

text: they shal ſay: This land vntilled is become as a garden of pleaſure: and the deſert cities, and deſtitute and vndermined, haue ſitten fenced.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the Nations whatſoeuer shal be left round about you, shal know that I the Lord haue builded the deſtroyed thinges, and planted the vntilled places, that I the Lord haue ſpoken, and done it.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: As yet in this shal the houſe of Iſrael finde me, that I wil doe for them: I wil multiplie them as a flocke of men,
label: Ezechiel

text: as a holie flocke, as the flocke of Ieruſalem in the ſolemnities therof: So shal the deſert cities be ful of flockes of men: and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: THE hand of our Lord was made vpon me, and brought me forth in the ſpirite of our Lord: and left me in the middes of a filde, that was ful of bones.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he led me about through them on euerie ſide: & there were verie manie vpon the face of the filde, and exceeding drie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſayd to me: Sonne of man, thinkeſt thou theſe bones shal liue? And I ſayd,: Lord God, thou knoweſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſayd to me: Prophecie of theſe bones: and thou shalt ſay to them: Drie bones heare ye the word of our Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God to theſe bones: Behold I wil put ſpirite into you, and you shal liue.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil geue ſinowes vpon you, and wil make flesh to grow vp ouer you, and wil ſtrech a skine on you: and I wil geue you ſpirite, and you shal liue, & you shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I prophecied as he had commanded me: and there was made a ſound when I prophecied, and behold a commotion: and bones came to bones, euerie one to his iuncture.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaw, and behold vpon them ſinowes, and flesh was growen vp: and a skinne was ſtrerched out in them aboue, and they had noe ſpirite.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſayd to me: Prophecie to the ſpirite, prophecie ſonne of man, & thou shalt ſay to the ſpirite: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Come ſpirite from the foure windes, and blow vpon theſe ſlaine, and let them be reuiued.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I prophecied as he had commanded me: & ſpirit entered into them, & they liued: & they ſtood vpon their feete, an armie paſſing great.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſayd to me: Sonne of man: Al theſe bones, are the houſe of Iſrael: They ſay: our bones are withered, our hope is perished, and we are cut of.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore prophecie, and thou shalt ſay to them: Thus ſayth our Lord God: Behold I wil open your graues, and wil bring you out of your ſepulchers ô my people: and wil bring you into the land of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you shal know that I am the Lord, when I shal haue opened your ſepulchres, and shal haue brought you out of your graues ô my people:
label: Ezechiel

text: and shal haue geuen my ſpirite in you, and you shal liue, and I shal make you reſt vpon your ground: & you shal know that I the Lord haue ſpoken, and done it, ſaith our Lord God:
label: Ezechiel

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou ſonne of man, take thee one peece of wood: and write vpon it: Of Iuda, and of the children of Iſrael his felowes: and take an other peece of wood, and write vpon it: Of Ioſeph the wood of Ephraim, and of al the houſe of Iſrael, and of his felowes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And ioyne them, one to the other for thee into one peece of wood, and they shal be into an vnion in thy hand.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when the children of thy people shal ſay to thee ſpeaking: Doeſt thou not declare vnto vs what thou meaneſt by theſe?
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou shalt ſpeake to them: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I wil take the peece of wood of Ioſeph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Iſrael, that are adioyned to him: and I wil geue them together with the peece of wood of Iuda, and wil make them into one peece of wood: and they shal be one in his hand.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the peeces of wood wherupon thou shalt write, in thy hand, shal be before their eyes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I wil take the children of Iſrael out of the middes of the nations, to which they are gone: and I wil gather them together on euerie ſide, and wil bring them to their ground.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make them into one nation in the land on the mountaines of Iſrael, & there shal be one king ruling ouer them al: and they shal no more be two nations, neither shal they be diuided any more into two kingdoms.
label: Ezechiel

text: Neither shal they be polluted any more in their idols, & their abominations, and al their iniquities: and I wil ſaue them out of al the ſeates, in which they haue ſinned, & I wil clenſe them: and they shal be my people, and I wil be their God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And my ſeruant Dauid king ouer them, and there shal be one paſtour of them al, they shal walke in my iudgements, and shal keepe my commandments, and shal doe them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal dwel vpon the land, which I gaue to my ſeruant Iacob, wherin your fathers dwelt, and they shal dwel vpon it, themſelues, and their children, and their childrens children, euen for euer: and Dauid my ſeruant their prince for euer,
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make a league of peace to them an euerlaſting couenat shal be to them: and I wil found them, and wil multiplie them, and wil geue my ſanctification in the middes of them for euer.
label: Ezechiel

text: And my tabernacle shal be in them: and I wil be their God, and they shal be my people.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the Gentils shal know that I am the Lord the ſanctifier of Iſrael, when my ſanctification shal be in the middes of them for euer.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Ezechiel

text: Sonne of man, ſet thy face againſt Gog, & the Land of Magog, the prince of the head of Moſoch, and Thubal: and prophecie of him and thou shalt ſay to him: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I to thee Gog prince of the head of Moſoch and Thubal.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil turne thee about, and wil put a bitte in thy iawes: and wil bring forth thee, and al thyne armie, the horſes and horſmen clothed with brigantines, (
label: Ezechiel

text: a great multitude, of them that take ſpeare and buckler and ſword)
label: Ezechiel

text: The Perſians, Æthiopians, and Lybians with them, al with shildes and helmets.
label: Ezechiel

text: Gomer, and al her troupes, the horſes of Thogorma the ſides of the North, & al his ſtrength, and manie peoples with them.
label: Ezechiel

text: Prepare and make readie thy ſelfe, and al thy multitude, that is gathered to thee in heapes: and be thou as a precept to them.
label: Ezechiel

text: After manie dayes thou shalt be viſited: in the later end of yeares thou shalt come to the land, that is returned from the ſword, and is gathered together out of manie peoples, to the mountaines of Iſrael, that were deſert continually: this ſame is brought forth out of the peoples, and they shal al dwel in it confidently.
label: Ezechiel

text: And going vp as a tempeſt thou shalt come, and as it were a clowde that thou maiſt couer the land, thou & thy troupes, and manie peoples with thee.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſayth our Lord God: In that day shal wordes aſcend vpon thy hart, & thou shalt thinke a moſt wicked thought.
label: Ezechiel

text: And shalt ſay: I wil goe vp to the land without wal: I wil come to them that reſt, and dwel ſecurely: al theſe dwel without wal, there are no barres nor gates to them:
label: Ezechiel

text: That thou mayſt take the ſpoiles, and inuade the praye, that thou maiſt lay thy hand vpon them, that had bene deſert, and afterward reſtored, and vpon the people that is gathered together out of the Gentils, which hath begune to poſſeſſe, and to be inhabitant of the nauel of the earth.
label: Ezechiel

text: Saba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tharſis, and al the lions therof shal ſay to thee: What comeſt thou to take ſpoiles? behold thou haſt gathered thy multitude to take the praye, that thou maiſt take ſiluer, and gold, and maiſt take away ſtuffe and ſubſtance, & ſpoile infinite booties.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore prophecie thou ſonne of man, and thou shalt ſay to Gog: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Why shalt thou not know in that day, when my people of Iſrael shal dwel confidently?
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt come out of thy place from the ſides of the North, thou and manie peoples with thee, al riders of horſes, a great companie, and a vehement armie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt aſcend vpon my people of Iſrael as a clowde, that thou couer the earth. In the later dayes shalt thou be, and I wil bring thee vpon my land: that the Gentils may know me, when I shal be ſanctified in thee before their eyes ô Gog.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſayth our Lord God: Thou then art he, of whom I ſpake in the dayes of old, in the hand of my ſeruants the prophets of Iſrael, which prophecied in the dayes of thoſe times, that I would bring in thee vpon them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And it shal be in that day, in the day of the coming of Gog vpon the land of Iſrael, ſaith our Lord God, myne indignation shal aſcend in my furie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in my zele, and in the fire of my wrath I haue ſpoken: That in that day shal be a great commotion vpon the land of Iſrael:
label: Ezechiel

text: and at my preſence shal the fishes of the ſea be moued, and the foules of heauen, and the beaſtes of the fild, and euerie creeping thing, that moueth vpon the ground & al men that are vpon the face of the earth: and the mountaines shal be ouerthrowen, and the hedges shal fal, and euerie wal shal fal on the ground.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil cal in againſt him in al my mountaines the ſword, ſaith our Lord God: euerie mans ſword shal be directed againſt his brother.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil iudge him with peſtilence, and bloud, and vehement showre, & mightie great ſtones: fire, and brimſtone wil I raine vpon him, and vpon his armie, and vpon the manie peoples that are with him.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil be magnified, and I wil be ſanctified: and I wil be knowen in the eyes of manie nations: and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: BVT thou ſonne of man, prophecie againſt Gog, and thou shalt ſay: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Behold I vpon thee Gog, the prince of the head of Moſoch and Thubal.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil turne thee about, and wil reduce thee, and wil make thee aſcend from the ſides of the North: and wil bring thee vpon the mountaines of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſtrike thy bow in thy left hand, and thine arrowes I wil caſt downe out of thy right hand.
label: Ezechiel

text: Vpon the mountaines of Iſrael shalt thou fal, and al thy troupes, and thy peoples that are with thee: to the wilde beaſtes, to the birdes, and to euerie foule, and to the beaſtes of the earth haue I geuen thee to be deuoured.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou shalt fal vpon the face of the fielde: becauſe I haue ſpoken, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil ſend in fire vpon Magog, and on them that dwel in the ilandes confidently: and they shal know that I am the Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And my holie name wil I make knowen in the middes of my people Iſrael, and I wil pollute my holie name no more: and the Gentils shal know that I am the Lord the holie one of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: Behold it cometh, and it is done, ſaith our Lord God: this is the day, wherof I haue ſpoken.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the inhabitants shal goe forth of the cities of Iſrael, and shal ſet on fire and burne weapons, buckler, and ſpeares, bow and arrowes, and handſtaues, and polaxes: and they shal burne them with fire ſeuen yeares.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal not carie trees out of the countries, nor cut downe out of the foreſts: becauſe they shal burne the weapons with fire, and shal make praye of them, to whom they had bene a praye, and they shal ſpoile their ſpoilers, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And it shal be in that day: I wil geue Gog a renowmed place for a ſepulcher in Iſrael: the valley of wayfaring men on the Eaſt of the ſea, which shal make them that paſſe by, to be aſtonied: and they shal there burne Gog, and al his multitude, and it shal be called the valley of the multitude of Gog.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the houſe of Iſrael shal burie them, that they may clenſe the land ſeuen monethes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And al the people of the land shal burie him, and it shal be vnto them a renowmed day, wherin I was glorified, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal appoint men continually going about the land, to burie and to ſeeke them, that were remayning vpon the face of the earth, that they may clenſe it: and after ſeuen monthes they shal begin to ſeeke.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they that trauel through the land shal goe about: and when they shal ſee the bone of a man, they shal ſet vp a ſigne beſide it, til the buriers burie it in the valley of the multitude of Gog.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the name of the citie Amona, and they shal clenſe the land.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thou therfore ô ſonne of man, ſaith our Lord God: Say to euerie foule, and to al birdes, and to al the beaſtes of the filde: Come together, make haſt, runne together on euerie ſide to my victime, which I immolate for you, the great victime vpon the mountaines of Iſrael: that you may eate the flesh, and drinke the bloud.
label: Ezechiel

text: The flesh of the ſtrong shal you eate, and the bloud of the princes of the earth shal you drinke: of rammes, of lambes, and of buckgoates, and bulles, and of fed wares, and of al fat thinges.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you shal eate the fatte your fil, and shal drinke bloud til you be drunke of the victime, which I shal immolate for you.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you shal be filled vpon my table of horſe, and ſtrong horſemen, and of al the men of warre, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: and I wil put my glorie in the Gentils: and al nations shal ſee my iudgement, that I haue done, and my hand, that I haue put vpon them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the houſe of Iſrael shal know that I am the Lord their God from that day, and ſo forward.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the Gentils shal know that the houſe of Iſrael was taken in their iniquitie, for that they forſooke me, and I hid my face from them: and deliuered them into the handes of the enemies, and they fel al by the ſword.
label: Ezechiel

text: According to their vncleannes, and wickednes haue I done to them, and haue hid my face from them.
label: Ezechiel

text: Therfore this ſaith our Lord God: Now wil I bring backe the captiuitie of Iacob, & wil haue mercie on al the houſe of Iſrael: and I wil take on me zele for my holie name.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal beare their confuſion, and al the preuarication wherwith they preuaricated againſt me, when they shal dwel in their land confidently fearing no man:
label: Ezechiel

text: and I shal haue brought them backe out of the peoples, and shal haue gathered them together out of the landes of their enemies, and shal be ſanctified in them, in the eyes of manie nations.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal know that I am the Lord their God, for that I tranſported them into the nations; and haue gathered them together vpon their owne land, and haue not left any of them there.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil hide my face no more from them, becauſe I haue powred out my ſpirite vpon al the houſe of Iſrael, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: IN the fiue and twentith yeare of our tranſmigration, in the beginning of the yeare, the tenth of the moneth, the fourtenth yeare, after the citie was ſtrooken: in this ſelf ſame day the hand of our Lord was made vpon me, and he brought me thither.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the viſions of God he brought me into the Land of Iſrael, and left me vpon a mountaine exceding high: vpon which there was as it were the building of a citie bending toward the ſouth.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me in thither: and behold a man, whoſe forme was as the forme of braſſe, and a linen corde in his hand, and a reede of meaſure in his hand: & he ſtood in the gate.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſame man ſpake to me: Sonne of man, ſee with thine eyes, and heare with thine eares, and ſet thy hart on al thinges, which I wil shew thee: for thou art brought hither that they may be shewed to thee: declare al thinges that thou ſeeſt, to the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: And behold a wal on the out ſide round about the houſe, and in the mans hand a reede of meaſure of ſix cubits & a palme: & he meaſured the breadth of the building with one reede, the height alſo with one reede.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he came to the gate, that looked to the way of the eaſt, & he aſcended by the ſteppes therof: & he meaſured the threshold of the gate with one reede the bredth, that is, one threshold with one reede in bredth:
label: Ezechiel

text: and a chamber with one reede in length, and one reede in bredth: and betwen the chambers fiue cubites:
label: Ezechiel

text: And the threshold of the gate by entrie of the gate within, with one reede.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he meaſured the entrie of the gate of eight cubites, and the front therof of two cubites: and the entrie of the gate was within.
label: Ezechiel

text: Moreouer the chambers of the gate to the way of the Eaſt, three on this ſide, and three on that ſide: one meaſure of the three, and one meaſure of the fronts, on both partes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he meaſured the bredth of the threshold of the gate of tenne cubits: and the length of the gate of thirtene cubits:
label: Ezechiel

text: and the border before the chambers of one cubite: and one cubite the end on both ſides, and the chambers were of ſix cubites, on this ſide and that ſide.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he meaſured the gate from the roofe of the chamber, euen to the roofe therof, the bredth of fiue and twentie cubits: doore againſt doore.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he made fronts by ſixtie cubits: & to the front the court of the gate on euerie ſide round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: And before the face of the gate, which raught euen to the face of the entrie of the inner gate, fiftie cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And oblique windowes in the chambers, and in their fronts, which were within the gate on euerie ſide round about: and in like maner, there were alſo in the entries windowes round about within, and before the fronts the picture of palme trees grauen.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me out to the vtter court, and behold celles, and the pauement paued with ſtone in the court round about: thirtie celles in the compas of the pauement.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the pauement in the front of the gates according to the length of the gates was beneath.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he meaſured the bredth from the face of the lower gate euen to the front of the inner court without, an hundred cubits to the Eaſt, and to the North.
label: Ezechiel

text: The gate alſo that looked to the way of the North of the vtter court, he meaſured as wel in length as in bredth.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the chambers therof three on this ſide, and three on that ſide: and the front therof, and the entrie therof according to the meaſure of the former gate, of fiftie cubits the length therof, and the bredth of fiue and twentie cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the windowes therof, and the entrie, and the grauings according to the meaſure of the gate, that looked to the Eaſt, and the aſcent therof was of ſeuen ſteppes, and an entrie before it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the gate of the inner court againſt the gate of the North, and the Eaſt gate: and he meaſured from gate euen to gate an hundred cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me out to the way of the South, and behold the gate, that looked to the South: and he meaſured the front therof, and the entrie therof according to the former meaſures.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the windowes therof, and the entries round about, as the other windowes: of fiftie cubits in length, and in bredth of fiue and twentie cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And on ſeuen ſteppes was the aſcent to it: and an entrie before the doores therof: and there were grauen palme trees, one on this ſide, and an other on that ſide in the front therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the gate of the inner court in the way of the South: and he meaſured from gate euen to gate in the way of the South, an hundred cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me into the inner court to the South gate: and he meaſured the gate according to the former meaſures.
label: Ezechiel

text: The chamber therof, and the front therof, and the entrie therof with the ſame meaſures: and the windowes therof, and entrie therof round about fiftie cubits of length, & of bredth fiue and twentie cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the entrie round about in length of fiue and twentie cubits, and in bredth of fiue cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the entrie therof to the vtter court, and the palmetrees therof in the front: and there were eight ſteppes, on which the aſcent was through it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me in into the inner court by the way of the eaſt: and he meaſured the gate according to the former meaſures.
label: Ezechiel

text: The chamber therof, and the front therof, and the entrie therof as before: and the windowes therof, and the entries therof round about, in length of fiftie cubits, and in bredth of fiue and twentie cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the entrie therof, that is, of the vtter court: and the grauen palmetrees in the front therof on this ſide and on that ſide: & on eight ſteppes the aſcent therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me into the gate, that looked to the North: and he meaſured according to the former meaſures.
label: Ezechiel

text: The chamber therof, and the front therof, and the entrie therof, and the windowes therof round about, in length of fiftie cubits, and bredth of fiue and twentie cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the entrie therof looked to the vtter court: and the grauing of palmetrees in the front therof on this ſide and on that ſide: and vpon eight ſteppes the aſcent therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: And at euerie chamber a doore in the forefronts of the gates: there they washed the holocauſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in the entrie of the gate, two tables on this ſide, and two tables on that ſide: that there might be immolated vpon them holocauſt, and for ſinne, and for offence.
label: Ezechiel

text: And on the vtter ſide, which goeth vp to the doore of the gate, that goeth on toward the North, two tables: and at the other ſide before the entrie of the gate, two tables.
label: Ezechiel

text: Foure tables on this ſide, and foure tables on that ſide: at the ſides of the gate were eight tables, wherupon they did immolate.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the foure tables for holocauſt, were made of ſquare ſtones: in length of one cubite and an halfe, and in bredth of one cubite and an halfe, and in height of one cubite: vpon which they shal put the veſſels, wherin is immolated the holocauſt, and the victime.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the brimmes of them of one palme, bowed backe within round about: and vpon the tables, the flesh of the oblation.
label: Ezechiel

text: And without the inner gate the celles of the ſinging men in the inner court, which was on the ſide of the gate that looketh to the North: and the faces of them againſt the way of the South, one at the ſide of the Eaſt gate, which looked to the way of the North.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: This is the chamber, which looketh to the way of the South, it shal be for the prieſts, that watche in the wardes of the temple.
label: Ezechiel

text: Moreouer the chamber that looketh to the way of the North shal be for the prieſts, that watche vpon the miniſterie of the altar. Theſe are the children of Sadoc, which of the children of Leui approch to our Lord, to miniſter vnto him.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he meaſured the court in length of an hundred cubits, and in bredth of an hundred cubits ſquare: and the altar before the face of the temple.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me into the entrie of the temple: and he meaſured fiue cubits on this ſide, and fiue cubits on that ſide: and the bredth of the gate of three cubits on this ſide, and of three cubits on that ſide.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the length of the entrie of twentie cubits: and the bredth of eleuen cubits, and by eight ſteppes was the aſcent to it. And there were pillers in the fronts: one on this ſide, & an other on that ſide.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND he brought me into the temple, and he meaſured the frontes ſix cubits of bredth on this ſide, and ſix cubits of breth on that ſide, the bredth of the tabernacle.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the bredth of the gate, was of ten cubits: and the ſides of the gate of fiue cubits on this ſide, and of fiue cubits on that ſide: and he meaſured the length therof of fourtie cubits, and the bredth of twentie cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And being entered within he meaſured in the front of the gate, two cubits: and the gate of ſix cubits: and the bredth of the gate of ſeuen cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he meaſured the length therof of twentie cubits, and the bredth of twentie cubits, before the face of the temple: and he ſaid to me: This is Sanctum Sanctorum.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he meaſured the wal of the houſe of ſix cubits: and the bredth of a ſide, of foure cubits on euerie ſide round about the houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſides, ſide to ſide, were twiſe thirtie three: and they were eminent, which might enter in through the wal of the houſe, in the ſides round about, to hold in, and not to touch the wal of the temple.
label: Ezechiel

text: And there was a broad alley made round, aſcending vp by winding ſtares, and it led into the vpper chamber of the temple round about: therfore was the temple broder in the higher partes: and ſo from the lower partes they mounted to the higher vnto the middes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaw in the houſe the height round about, the ſides founded by the meaſure of a reede the ſpace of ſix cubits:
label: Ezechiel

text: and the bredth through the wal of the ſide without of fiue cubits: and there was an inner houſe in the ſides of the houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And betwen the celles the bredth of twentie cubits round about the houſe on euerie ſide,
label: Ezechiel

text: and the doore of the ſide for prayer: one doore to the way of the North, and one doore to the way of the South: and the bredth of the place for prayer, of fiue cubits round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the building, that was ſeperated, and turned to the way that looketh toward the ſea, of the bredth of ſeuentie cubits: and the wal of the building, of fiue cubits in bredth round about: and the length therof of ninetie cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he meaſured the length of the houſe, of an hundred cubits: and the building that was ſeperated, and the walles therof, of the length of an hundred cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the bredth before the face of the houſe, and of that which was ſeperated againſt the Eaſt, of an hundred cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he meaſured the length of the building againſt the face of that, which was ſeperated at the backe: the etheckes on both ſides of an hundred cubits: and the inner temple, and the entries of the court.
label: Ezechiel

text: The thresholdes, & oblique windowes, and the etheckes round about by three partes, againſt the threshold of euerie one, and paued with wood round about the circuite: and earth euen to the windowes, and the windowes shut ouer the doores.
label: Ezechiel

text: And euen to the inner houſe, and without by euerie wal round about within and without, by meaſure.
label: Ezechiel

text: And Cherubs and palmetrees wrought, and a palmetree betwen Cherub and Cherub, & a Cherub had two faces.
label: Ezechiel

text: The face of a man by the palmetree on this ſide, and the face of a lion by the palmetree on the other ſide: expreſſed through al the houſe round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: From the ground euen to the vpper partes of the gate, were Cherubs, and palmetrees grauen in the wal of the temple.
label: Ezechiel

text: The threshold foure ſquare, and the face of the ſanctuarie, ſight to ſight.
label: Ezechiel

text: The height of the woden altar, of three cubits: and the length therof, of two cubits: and the corners therof, and the length therof, and the walles therof of wood. And he ſpake to me: This is the table before our Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And there were two doores in the temple, and in the ſanctuarie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in the two doores on both ſides were two litle doores, which were folded within each other: for there were two wickets on both ſides of the doores.
label: Ezechiel

text: And there were Cherubs alſo grauen in the ſame doores of the temple, and the grauing of palmetrees, as they were expreſſed in the walles: for which cauſe alſo there was thicker timber in the front of the entrie without.
label: Ezechiel

text: Vpon which were the oblique windowes, & the ſimilitude of palmetrees on this ſide and on that ſide in braces of the entrie: according to the ſides of the houſe, and the bredth of the walles.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND he brought me out into the vtter court by the way that leadeth to the North, and he brought me into the celle, that was againſt the ſeperated building, and againſt the houſe bending to the North.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the face of the length, an hundred cubits of the North doore: and the bredth fiftie cubits,
label: Ezechiel

text: againſt the twentie cubits of the inner court,& againſt the pauement paued with ſtone of the vtter court, where was a porche ioyned to a triple porche.
label: Ezechiel

text: And before the celles a walke of ten cubits in bredth, looking to the inner partes of the way of one cubite. And their doores toward the North:
label: Ezechiel

text: Where were chambers in the vpper partes more low:becauſe they bare vp the porches, which appeared aboue out of them from the neather partes, and from the middes of the building.
label: Ezechiel

text: For they were triple loftes, and had not pillers, as the pillers of the courtes: therfore did they appeare aboue out of the neather places; and out of the midle places, from the ground fiftie cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And an vtter cloſure according to the celles, which were in the way of the vtter court before the celles: the length therof of fiftie cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: Becauſe the length of the celles of the vtter court was of fiftie cubits: and the length before the face of the temple, of an hundred cubits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And there was vnder theſe celles an entrance from the Eaſt, going into them out of the vtter court.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the bredth of the cloſure of the court,that was againſt the way of the Eaſt, toward the face of the ſeperated building, and there were celles before the building.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the way before the face of them according to the ſimilitude of the celles, which were in the way of the North: according to the length of them, ſo alſo was their bredth: and al the entrance of them, and ſimilitudes, and their doores.
label: Ezechiel

text: According to the doores of the celles that were in the way looking to the South: a doore in the head of the way, which way was before the entrie ſeperated by the way of the Eaſt going in.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: The celles of the North, and the celles of the South, which are before the ſeperated building: theſe are the holie celles, wherin the prieſts do eate, which approch to our Lord into Sancta Sanctorum, there shal they lay the holies of holies, and the oblation for ſinne, and for offence: for it is a holie place.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when the prieſts shal be entered, they shal not goe forth out of the holie places into the vtter court: and there they shal lay their veſtiments, wherin they miniſter, becauſe they are holie: and they shal be clothed with other veſtments, & ſo they shal goe forth to the people.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when he had accomplished the meaſures of the inner houſe, he brought me out by the way of the gate, that looked to the way of the Eaſt: & he meaſured it on euerie ſide round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he meaſured againſt the Eaſt winde with the reede of meaſure, fiue hundred reedes in reede of meaſure round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he meaſured againſt the North winde fiue hundred reedes in reede of meaſure round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: And to the South wind he meaſured fiue hundred reedes, in reede of meaſure round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: And to the Weſt wind he meaſured fiue hundred reedes, in reede of meaſure.
label: Ezechiel

text: By the foure windes he meaſured the wal therof on euery ſide round about, the length and bredth of fiue hundred reedes, diuiding betwen the ſanctuarie and the place of the common people.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND he brought me to the gate that looked to the way of the Eaſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And behold the glorie of the God of Iſrael went by the Eaſt gate: and he had a voice as the voice of manie waters, & the earth shined at his maieſtie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I ſaw a viſion according to the forme which I had ſeene, when he came to deſtroy the citie: and the shape according to the ſight, which I had ſeene, by the riuer Chobar: and I fel vpon my face.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the maieſtie of our Lord went into the temple by the way of the gate that looked to the Eaſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſpirite lifted me vp, and brought me into the inner court: and behold the houſe was filled with the glorie of our Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I heard one ſpeaking to me out of the houſe, & a man ſtood by me,
label: Ezechiel

text: ſaid to me: Sonne of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the ſteppes of my feete, where I dwel in the middes of the children of Iſrael for euer: and the houſe of Iſrael shal no more pollute my holie name, they, and their kinges in their fornications, and in the ruines of their kinges, and in the excelſes.
label: Ezechiel

text: Who haue built their threshold by my threshold, and their poſts by my poſts: and there was a wal betwen me and them: and they polluted my holie name in the abominations, which they did: for the which thing I conſumed them in my wrath.
label: Ezechiel

text: Now therfore let them repel their fornication, and ruins of their kinges far from me: and I wil dwel in the middes of them alwayes.
label: Ezechiel

text: But thou ſonne of man, shew to the houſe of Iſrael the temple, and let them be confounded at their iniquities, and let them meaſure the frame:
label: Ezechiel

text: and be ashamed of al thinges that they haue done. The figure of the houſe, and of the frame therof, the goings out, & the comings in, and al the deſcription therof, and al the precepts therof, and al the order therof, and al the lawes therof shew to them, and thou shalt write in their eyes: that they may keepe al the deſcriptions therof, and the preceptes therof, and let them doe them.
label: Ezechiel

text: This is the law of the houſe in the toppe of the mount: Al the border therof round about is holie of holies: this then is the law of the houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And theſe are the meaſures of the altar by the moſt true cubite, which had a cubite and a palme: in the boſome therof was a cubit, & a cubite in bredth: and the limite therof euen to the brimme therof, and round about, one palme. this alſo was the trench of the altar.
label: Ezechiel

text: And from the boſome of the ground to the loweſt brimme two cubits, and the bredth of one cubite: & from the leſſer brimme vnto the greater brimme foure cubits, and the bredth of one cubite.
label: Ezechiel

text: And Ariel it ſelf of foure cubits: and from Ariel vpward foure hornes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And Ariel of twelue cubits in length by twelue cubits of bredth, foure ſquare with equal ſides.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the brimme of fourtene cubits of length by fourtene cubits of bredth in the foure corners therof: and the crowne round about it of halfe a cubite, and the boſome therof of one cubite round about: and the ſteppes therof turned to the Eaſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: Sonne of man, thus ſaith our Lord God: Theſe are the rites of the altar, in what day ſoeuer it shal be made: that holocauſt may be offered vpon it, and bloud powred out.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt geue to the Prieſtes, and Leuites, that are of the ſeede of Sadoc, that approch to me, ſaith our Lord God, that they offer to me a calfe of the heard for ſinne.
label: Ezechiel

text: And taking of his bloud, thou shalt put it vpon the foure hornes therof, and vpon the foure corners of the brimme, and vpon the crowne round about: and thou shalt clenſe, and expiate it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt take the calfe, that is offered for ſinne: and thou shalt burne him in a ſeperate place of the houſe without the ſanctuarie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in the ſecond day thou shalt offer a bucke of goates vnſpotted for ſinne: and they shal expiate the altar, as they did expiate in the calfe.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when thou shalt haue accomplished expiating it, thou shalt offer a calfe of the heard vnſpotted, and a ramme of the flocke vnſpotted.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt offer them in the ſight of our Lord: and the prieſts shal caſt ſalt vpon them, and shal offer them an holocauſt to our Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: Seuen dayes shalt thou make a bucke goate for ſinne dayly: and a calfe of the heard, and a ramme of the cattel vnſpotted shal they offer.
label: Ezechiel

text: Seuen dayes shal they expiate the altar, and shal clenſe it: and they shal fil his hand.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the dayes being expired, in the eight day & ſo forth, the prieſts shal make your holocauſts vpon the altar, and thoſe which they offer for peace: and I wil be pacified toward you, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND he turned me to the way of the vtter ſanctuarie, which looked toward the Eaſt: and it was shut.
label: Ezechiel

text: And our Lord ſaid to me: This gate shal be shut: it shal not be opened, and man shal not paſſe through it: Becauſe our Lord the God of Iſrael is entered in through it, and it shal be shut for the prince.
label: Ezechiel

text: The prince himſelf shal ſit in it, to eate bread before our Lord: by the way of the gate of the entrie shal he enter in, & by the way therof he shal go out.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me by the way of the North gate in the ſight of the houſe: and I ſaw, and behold the glorie of our Lord filled the houſe of our Lord: and I fel on my face.
label: Ezechiel

text: And our Lord ſaid to me: Sonne of man ſet thy hart, and ſee with thine eyes, & heare with thine eares al thinges, that I ſpeake to thee concerning al the ceremonies of the houſe of our Lord and concerning al the lawes therof: and thou shalt ſet thy hart in the wayes of the temple, by al the goings out of the ſanctuarie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And thou shalt ſay to the houſe of Iſrael that exaſperateth me: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Let al your wicked deedes ſuffice you ô houſe of Iſrael:
label: Ezechiel

text: becauſe you bring in ſtrange children vncircumciſed in hart, and vncircumciſed in flesh, to be in my ſanctuarie, and to pollute my houſe, & you offer my breades, the fatte, and the bloud: and you diſſolue my couenant in al your wicked abominations.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you haue not kept the precepts of my ſanctuarie: and you haue ſet keepers of my obſeruances in my ſanctuarie to your owne ſelues.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Euerie ſtranger vncircumciſed in hart, & vncircumciſed in flesh, shal not enter into my ſanctuarie, euerie ſtrange child that is in the middes of the children of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: Yea and the Leuites that haue reuolted farre from me in the errour of the children of Iſrael, & haue erred from me after their idols, and haue borne their iniquitie:
label: Ezechiel

text: they shal be officers in my ſanctuarie, and porters of the gates of the houſe, and miniſters of the houſe: they shal kil the holocauſts, and the victimes of the people: and they shal ſtand in their ſight, to ſerue them.
label: Ezechiel

text: For that they haue ſerued them in the ſight of their idols, and were made to the houſe of Iſrael a ſcandal of iniquitie: therfore haue I lifted vp mine hand vpon them, ſaith our Lord God, and they shal beare their iniquitie:
label: Ezechiel

text: and they shal not approch to me, to doe the function of prieſthood vnto me, neither shal they approche to al my ſanctuarie by Sancta Sanctorum: but they shal beare their confuſion, and their wicked abominations which they haue done.
label: Ezechiel

text: And I wil make them porters of the houſe, in al the miniſterie therof, and in al thinges that shal be done therin.
label: Ezechiel

text: But the prieſts, & Leuits, the ſonnes of Sadoc, which kept the ceremonies of my ſanctuarie, when the children of Iſrael erred from me, they shal approch to me, to miniſter vnto me: & they shal ſtand in my ſight, to offer me the fatte, and the bloud, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: They shal enter into my ſanctuarie, and they shal approch to my table, to miniſter vnto me, and to keepe my ceremonies.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when they shal enter into the gates of the inner court, they shal be clothed with linnen garments: neither shal anie wollen thing come vpon them, when they miniſter in the gates of the inner court & within.
label: Ezechiel

text: There shal be linnen mitres on their heades, and there shal be linnen breeches on their loynes, and they shal not be girded in ſwette.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when they shal goe out to the vtter court vnto the people, they shal put of from them their veſtiments, wherin they had miniſtered, and shal lay them vp in the veſterie of the ſanctuarie, & they shal cloth themſelues with other garments: & they shal not ſanctifie the people in their veſtures.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal not shaue their head, nor nourish their heare: but powling they shal powle their heades.
label: Ezechiel

text: And no prieſt shal drinke wine when he is to enter into the inner court.
label: Ezechiel

text: And widow, and her that is diuorced they shal not take for wiues, but virgins of the ſeede of the houſe of Iſrael: but a widow alſo, which hath bene the widow of a prieſt, they shal take.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal teach my people what is betwen a holie thing and polluted, and betwen cleane and vncleane they shal shew to them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when there shal be a controuerſie, they shal ſtand in my iudgements, & shal iudge: my lawes, & my preceptes in al my ſolemnities shal they keepe, and my ſabbathes they shal ſanctifie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And to a dead man they shal not enter in, leſt they be polluted, but to father and mother, & ſonne and daughter, and brother and ſiſter, which hath not had an other husband: in which they shal be contaminated.
label: Ezechiel

text: And after that he is clenſed, ſeuen daies shal be numbred to him.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in the day of his entering into the ſanctuarie to the inner court to miniſter vnto me in the ſanctuarie, he shal offer for his ſinne, ſayth our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And there shal not be inheritance to them, I am their inheritance: and poſſeſſion you shal not geue them in Iſrael, for I am their poſſeſſion.
label: Ezechiel

text: The victime both for ſinne and for offence they shal eate: and euerie vowed thing in Iſrael shal be theirs.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the firſt fruits of al the firſt borne, & al the libaments of al thinges that are offered, shal be the prieſts: & the firſt fruits of your meates you shal geue to the prieſt, that he may lay vp a bleſſing for thy houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: Al carren, and thing taken by a beaſt of birdes, and of cattel the prieſts shal not eate.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND when you shal begin to diuide the land by lot, ſeperate ye firſt fruits to our Lord, a peece ſanctified of the land, in length twentie fiue thouſand, and in bredth tenne thouſand: it shal be ſanctified in al the border therof round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: And it shal be ſanctified on euerie ſide by fiue hundred and fiue hundred, foure ſquare round about: and of fiftie cubits for the ſuburbs therof round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: And from this meaſure thou shalt meaſure the length, of fiue and twentie thouſand, and the bredth of tenne thouſand, & in it shal be the temple, and ſanctum ſanctorum.
label: Ezechiel

text: The ſanctified peece of the land shal be for the prieſts the miniſters of the ſanctuarie, which approch to the miniſterie of our Lord: and it shal be a place to them for houſes, and for the ſanctuarie of holines.
label: Ezechiel

text: And fiue and twentie thouſand of length, & tenne thouſand of bredth shal be for the Leuits, which miniſter in the houſe: they shal poſſeſſe twentie celles.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the poſſeſſion of the citie you shal geue fiue thouſand of bredth, and of length fiue and twentie thouſand, according to the ſeperation of the ſanctuarie, to al the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: To the prince alſo on this ſide and on that ſide, according to the ſeparation of the ſanctuarie, and according to the poſſeſſion of the citie, againſt the face of the ſeperation of the ſanctuarie, and againſt the face of the poſſeſſion of the citie: from the ſide of the Sea euen to the Sea, and from the ſide of the Eaſt euen to the Eaſt. And the length according to euerie part from the Weſt border to the Eaſt border.
label: Ezechiel

text: Of the land shal he haue poſſeſſion in Iſrael: and the princes shal no more ſpoile my people: but the land they shal geue to the houſe of Iſrael according to their tribes.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: Let it ſuffice you ô princes of Iſrael: intermitte ye iniquitie and robberies, and doe iudgement and iuſtice, ſeperate your confines from my people, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: Iuſt balance, and a iuſt ephi, and a iuſt bat shal be to you.
label: Ezechiel

text: The ephi, and the bat shal be equal, and of one meaſure: that the bat may take the tenth part of a core, & the ephi the tenth part of a core: according to the meaſure of a core shal be the equal balaſſing of them.
label: Ezechiel

text: And a ſicle hath twentie obolos. Moreouer twentie ſicles, & fiue and twentie ſicles, and fiftene ſicles make Mnam.
label: Ezechiel

text: And theſe are the firſt fruits, which you shal take: the ſixth part of an ephi of a core of wheate, and the ſixth part of an ephi of a core of barley.
label: Ezechiel

text: The meaſure of oyle alſo, a bat of oyle is the tenth part of a core: and ten battes make a core: becauſe ten battes fil a core.
label: Ezechiel

text: And one ramme of a flocke of two hundred, of thoſe thinges that Iſrael nourisheth for ſacrifice, and for holocauſt, and for pacifiques, to expiate for them, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: Al the people of the land shal be bound to theſe firſt fruits for the prince in Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: And vpon the prince shal the holocauſt be, and the ſacrifice, and the libaments in the ſolemnities, and in the Calends, and in the Sabbathes, & in al the ſolemnities of the houſe of Iſrael: he shal make the ſacrifice for ſinne, & the holocauſt, and the pacifiques to expiate for the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God. In the firſt moneth, the firſt of the moneth, thou shalt take a calfe of the heard vnſpotted, and thou shalt expiate the ſanctuarie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the prieſt shal take of the bloud that shal be for ſinne: and he shal put it on the poſts of the houſe, and on the foure corners of the brimme of the altar, and on the poſts of the gate of the inner court.
label: Ezechiel
