text: And ſo shalt thou do in the ſeuenth of the moneth for euerie one, that hath bene ignorant, and was deceiued by errour, and you shal expiate for the houſe.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the firſt moneth, the fourtenth day of the moneth shal be with you the ſolemnitie of paſch: ſeuen dayes shal Azymes be eaten.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the prince in that day shal make for himſelf, and for al the people of the land, a calfe for ſinne.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in the ſolemnitie of the ſeuen dayes he shal make holocauſt to our Lord ſeuen calues, & ſeuen rammes vnſpotted dayly ſeuen dayes: and for ſinne a bucke of goates dayly.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he shal make the ſacrifice an ephi to a calfe, and an ephi to a ramme: and of oyle an hin to euerie ephi.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the ſeuenth moneth the fiftenth day of the moneth, in the ſolemnitie he shal make as are before ſaid for ſeuen dayes: as wel for ſinne, as for holocauſt, and in ſacrifice, and in oyle.
label: Ezechiel

text: THVS ſaith our Lord God: The gate of the inner court, which looketh to the Eaſt, shal be shut the ſix dayes, in which worke is done: but in the Sabbath day it shal be opened yea and in the day of the Calends it shal be opened.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the prince shal enter in by the way of the entrie of the gate from without, and he shal ſtand in the threshold of the gate: and the prieſts shal make his holocauſt, and his pacifiques: and he shal adore vpon the threshold of the gate, and shal goe out: but the gate shal not be shut til euening.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the people of the land shal adore at the doore of that gate in the Sabbaths, and in the Calends before our Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: And this holocauſt shal the prince offer to our Lord: in the Sabbath day ſix lambes vnſpotted, and a ramme vnſpotted.
label: Ezechiel

text: And ſacrifice an ephi for a ramme: but in the lambes the ſacrifice that his hand shal geue: and of oyle an hin for euerie ephi.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in the day of the Calends a calfe of the heard vnſpotted: and the ſix lambes, and the rammes shal be vnſpotted.
label: Ezechiel

text: And an ephi for a calfe, an ephi alſo for a ramme shal he make ſacrifice: but the lambes, as his hand shal finde: and of oyle an hin, for euerie ephi.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when the prince is to goe in, let him goe in by the way of the entrie of the gate, and by the ſame way let him goe out.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when the people of the land shal enter in the ſight of our Lord in the ſolemnities: he that goeth in by the North gate to adore, let him goe out by the way of the South gate: moreouer he that goeth in by the way of the South gate, let him goe out by the way of the North gate: he shal not returne by the way of the gate, wherby he entered, but at that ouer againſt it he shal goe out.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the prince in the middes of them with the goers in shal goe in, and with the goers out shal goe out.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in the fayres, and in the ſolemnities there shal be ſacrifice an ephi for a calfe, and an ephi for a ramme: but of the lambes, there shal be ſacrifice as his hand shal finde: and of oyle an hin for euerie ephi.
label: Ezechiel

text: But when the prince shal make a voluntarie holocauſt, or voluntarie pacifiques to our Lord: to him the gate shal be opened, that looketh to the Eaſt, and he shal make his holocauſt, & his pacifiques, as it is wont to be done in the Sabbath day: and he shal goe out, & the gate shal be shut after that he is gone forth.
label: Ezechiel

text: And a lambe of the ſame yeare vnſpotted, shal he make for holocauſt dayly to our Lord: alwayes in the morning shal he make it.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he shal make ſacrifice vpon it morning by morning the ſixt part of an ephi: and of oyle the third part of an hin, that it may be mingled with the floure: a ſacrifice to our Lord by ordinance, continual and euerlaſting.
label: Ezechiel

text: He shal make the lambe, & the ſacrifice, and the oyle morning by morning: an euerlaſting holocauſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſaith our Lord God: If the prince shal geue a gift to anie of his ſonnes: his inheritance shal be to his ſonnes, they shal poſſeſſe it by inheritance.
label: Ezechiel

text: But if he geue a legacie of his inheritance to one of his ſeruants, it shal be his vntil the yeare of remiſſion, and it shal returne to the prince: and his inheritance shal be to his ſonnes.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the prince shal not take of the peoples inheritance by violence, and of their poſſeſſion: & of his owne poſſeſſion he shal geue the inheritance to his ſonnes: that my people be not diſperſed euerie one from his poſſeſſion.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me in by the entrie, that was on the ſide of the gate, into the celles of the ſanctuarie to the prieſts, which looked to the North. And there was a place bending to the Weſt.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: This is the place where the prieſts shal ſeeth that for ſinne, and that for offence: where they shal dreſſe the ſacrifice, that they bring it not out into the vtter court, and the people be ſanctified.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he brought me into the vtter court, and he led me about by the foure corners of the court: and behold there was a litle court in the corner of the court, to euerie corner of the court a litle court.
label: Ezechiel

text: In the foure corners of the court were litle courts diſpoſed, of fourtie cubits in length, and thirtie in bredth: the foure were of one meaſure.
label: Ezechiel

text: And a wal round about compaſſing the foure litle courts: and there were kichins builded vnder the porches round about.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſaid to me: This is the houſe of kichins wherin the miniſters of the houſe of our Lord shal ſeeth the victimes of the people.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND he turned me to the gate of the houſe, and behold waters iſſued forth vnder the threshold of the houſe toward the Eaſt: for the face of the houſe looked to the Eaſt: but the waters deſcended into the right ſide of the temple to the South part of the altar.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ledde me out by the way of the North gate, and he turned me to the way without the vtter gate, the way that looked to the Eaſt: and behold waters flowing on the right ſide.
label: Ezechiel

text: When the man went out toward the Eaſt, that had the cord in his hand, he meaſured a thouſand cubits: and he brought me through the water euen to the ankles.
label: Ezechiel

text: And againe he meaſured a thouſand, & he brought me through the water euen to the knees:
label: Ezechiel

text: and he meaſured a thouſand, and he brought me through the water euen to the reynes. And he meaſured a thouſand, a torrent, which I could not paſſe ouer: becauſe the waters were riſen of the deepe torrent, which can not be paſſed ouer.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſayd to me: Certes thou haſt ſene o ſonne of man. And he brought me out, and he turned me to the banke of the torrent.
label: Ezechiel

text: And when I had turned my ſelf, behold in the banke of the torrent exceding manie trees on both ſides.
label: Ezechiel

text: And he ſayd to me: Theſe waters, that iſſue forth toward the heapes of the ſand in the Eaſt, and deſcend to the plaines of the deſert, shal goe into the ſea, & shal goe out, & the waters shal be healed.
label: Ezechiel

text: And euerie liuing ſoule, that creepeth, whither ſoeuer the torrent cometh shal liue: and there shal be fishes very manie after theſe waters are come thither, & they shal be healed, & al thinges shal liue, to which the torrent shal come.
label: Ezechiel

text: And fishers shal ſtand ouer them, from Engaddi euen to Engallim shal be drying of nettes: there shal be very manie ſortes of fishes therof, as the fishes of the great ſea, of a paſſing great multitude:
label: Ezechiel

text: but in the shore therof, and in the fennie places they shal not be healed, becauſe they shal be turned into ſalt pits.
label: Ezechiel

text: And ouer the torrent shal riſe in the bankes therof on both ſides euerie tree bearing fruit: the leafe shal not fal from it, & the fruit therof shal not faile: euerie moneth shal it bring forth firſt fruits, becauſe the waters therof shal iſſue out of the ſanctuarie: & the fruits therof shal be for meate, & the leaues therof for medicine.
label: Ezechiel

text: Thus ſayth our Lord God: This is the border, in which you shal poſſeſſe the land in the twelue tribes of Iſrael becauſe Ioſeph hath a duble cord.
label: Ezechiel

text: and you shal poſſeſſe it euerie man in like maner as his brother: vpon which I lifted vp my hand to geue it to your fathers: and this land shal fal vnto you for a poſſeſſion.
label: Ezechiel

text: And this is the border of the land: toward the North quarter, from the great ſea by the way of Hethalon, as they come to Sedada,
label: Ezechiel

text: Emath, Berotha, Sabarim, which is betwen the border of Damaſcus and the confine of Emath, the houſe of Tichon, which is by the border of Auran.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the border from the Sea euen to the court of Enon, shal be the border of Damaſcus, and from the North to the North, the border of Emath the North quarter.
label: Ezechiel

text: Moreouer the Eaſt quarter from the middes of Auran, and from the middes of Damaſcus, and from the middes of Galaad, and from the middes of the land of Iſrael, Iordan making the bound to the Eaſt ſea, you shal meaſure alſo the Eaſt quarter.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the South quarter toward the South from Thamar euen to the waters of contradiction of Cades: & the torrent euen to the great ſea: and this is the South quarter toward the South.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the quarter of the Sea, the great ſea from the confine directly, til thou come to Emath: this is the quarter of the Sea.
label: Ezechiel

text: And you shal diuide this land vnto you by the tribes of Iſrael:
label: Ezechiel

text: and you shal caſt it for an inheritance to you, and to the ſtrangers, that shal come to you, that haue begotten children in the middes of you: and they shal be vnto you as the ſame countriemen borne among the children of Iſrael: they shal diuide the poſſeſſion with you in the middes of the tribes of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: And in what tribe ſoeuer the ſtranger shal be, there shal you geue him poſſeſſion, ſayth our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: AND theſe are the names of the tribes from the borders of the North, by the way of Hethalon, as they goe to Emath, the court of Enan the border of Damaſcus toward the North, by the way of Emath. And the Eaſt quarter therof to the ſea shal be for Dan one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And to the border of Dan, from the Eaſt quarter euen to the quarter of the Sea, for Aſer one:
label: Ezechiel

text: & vpon the border of Aſer, from the Eaſt quarter euen to the quarter of the Sea, for Nephthali one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And vpon the border of Nephthali, from the Eaſt quarter euen to the quarter of the Sea, for Manaſſes one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And vpon the border of Manaſſes, from the Eaſt quarter euen to the quarter of the Sea, for Ephraim one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And vpon the border of Ephraim, from the Eaſt quarter euen to the quarter of the Sea, for Ruben one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And vpon the border of Ruben, from the Eaſt quarter euen to the quarter of the Sea, for Iuda one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And vpon the border of Iuda, from the Eaſt quarter euen to the quarter of the Sea, shal be the firſt fruites, which you shal ſeperate, fiue and twentie thouſand of bredth & of length, as euery portion from the Eaſt quarter to the quarter of the Sea: and the ſanctuarie shal be in the middes therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: The firſt fruits, which you shal ſeperate to our Lord: the length of fiue and twentie thouſand, and the bredth of ten thouſand.
label: Ezechiel

text: And theſe shal be the firſt fruits of of the ſanctuarie of the prieſts: toward the North of length fiue and twentie thouſand, and toward the Sea of bredth ten thouſand. Yea and toward the Eaſt of bredth ten thouſand, and toward the South of length fiue and twentie thouſand: and the ſanctuarie of our Lord shal be in the middes therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: The ſanctuarie shal be for the prieſts of the ſonnes of Sadoc, which kept my ceremonies, and erred not when the children of Iſrael erred, as the Leuites alſo erred.
label: Ezechiel

text: And for them shal be the firſt fruits of the firſt fruits of the land holie of holies, by the border of the Leuites.
label: Ezechiel

text: Yea and to the Leuites in like maner by the borders of the prieſts fiue and twentie thouſand of length, and of bredth tenne thouſand. Al the length of fiue and twentie thouſand, & the bredth of tenne thouſand.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they shal not ſel therof, nor change, neither shal the firſt fruits of the land be tranſported, becauſe they are ſanctified to our Lord.
label: Ezechiel

text: But the fiue thouſand, that remaine in the bredth againſt the fiue & twentie thouſand, shal be the profane partes of the citie for habitation, and for the ſuburbs: and the citie shal be in the middes therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: And theſe are the meaſures therof: to the North quarter fiue hundred and foure thouſand: and to the South quarter fiue hundred and foure thouſand: and to the Eaſt quarter fiue hundred and foure thouſand: and to the Weſt quarter, fiue hundred and foure thouſand.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the ſuburbs of the citie shal be, to the North two hundred fiftie, and to the South two hundred fiftie, and to the Eaſt two hundred fiftie; and to the Sea two hundred fiftie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And that which shal be reſidue in length according to the firſt fruits of the ſanctuarie, ten thouſand toward the Eaſt, and ten thouſand toward the Weſt, shal be as the firſt fruits of the ſanctuarie: and the fruits therof shal be for bread to them, that ſerue the citie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And they that ſerue the citie, shal worke of al the tribes of Iſrael.
label: Ezechiel

text: Al the firſt fruits, of fiue and twentie thouſand, anſwering to fiue & twentie thouſand foure ſquare, shal be ſeperated according to the firſt fruits of the ſanctuarie, and to the poſſeſſion of the citie.
label: Ezechiel

text: And that which shal be left, shal be the princes of euerie part of the firſt fruits of the ſanctuarie, and of the poſſeſſion of the citie ouer againſt the fiue and twentie thouſand of the firſt fruits vnto the Eaſt border: Yea and to the ſea ouer againſt the fiue and twentie thouſand, vnto the border of the Sea, likewiſe it shal be in the portions of the prince: and the firſt fruits of the ſanctuarie, and the ſanctuarie of the temple shal be in the middes therof.
label: Ezechiel

text: And of the poſſeſſion of the Leuites, and of the poſſeſſion of the citie in the middes of the princes portions: shal be to the border of Iuda, and to the border of Beniamin, shal alſo perteine to the prince.
label: Ezechiel

text: And to the reſt of the tribes: from the Eaſt quarter to the Weſt quarter, for Beniamin one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And againſt the border of Beniamin, from the Eaſt quarter to the Weſt quarter, for Simeon one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And vpon the border of Simeon from the Eaſt quarter to the Weſt quarter, for Iſſachar one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And vpon the border of Iſſachar, from the Eaſt quarter to the Weſt quarter, for Zabulon one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And vpon the border of Zabulon, from the Eaſt quarter to the quarter of the Sea, for Gad one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And vpon the border of Gad, to the South quarter toward the South: and the border shal be from Thamar, euen to the waters of contradiction of Cades, the inheritance againſt the great ſea.
label: Ezechiel

text: This is the land, which you shal diuide by lot to the tribes of Iſrael: and theſe are the portions of them, ſaith our Lord God.
label: Ezechiel

text: And theſe are the goings out of the citie: from the North quarter thou shalt meaſure fiue hundred and foure thouſand.
label: Ezechiel

text: And the gates of the citie according to the names of the tribes of Iſrael, three gates on the North ſide, the gate of Ruben one, the gate of Iuda one, the gate of Leui one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And to the Eaſt quarter, fiue hundred and foure thouſand: and three gates, the gate of Ioſeph one, the gate of Beniamin one, the gate of Dan one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And to the South quarter, thou shalt meaſure fiue hundred & foure thouſand: and three gates, the gate of Simeon one, the gate of Iſſachar one, the gate of Zabulon one.
label: Ezechiel

text: And to the Weſt quarter, fiue hundred and foure thouſand, and their gates three, the gate of Gad one, the gate of Aſer one, the gate of Nephthali one.
label: Ezechiel

text: Round about eightene thouſand: and the name of the citie from that day, Our Lord there.
label: Ezechiel

text: IN THE third yeare of the kingdom of Ioakim king of Iuda, came Nabuchodonoſor king of Babylon into Ieruſalem, and beſieged it.
label: Daniel

text: And our Lord deliuered into his hand Ioakim the king of Iuda, and part of the veſſels of the houſe of God: and he caried them away into the land of Sennaar, into the houſe of his god, & the veſſels he brought into the houſe of the treaſure of his god.
label: Daniel

text: And the king ſpake to Aſphenez the gouernour of the Eunuches, that he should bring in of the children of Iſrael, and of the kings, & the tyrants ſeede,
label: Daniel

text: children in whom was no ſpot, beautiful of forme, and inſtructed in al wiſedom, cunning in knowlege, and taught in diſcipline, and that might ſtand in the kings palace, that he might teach them the learning, and the tongue of the Chaldees.
label: Daniel

text: And the king appoynted them a certaine prouiſion for euerie day, of his meates, & of the wine wherof he dranke himſelf, that being nourished three yeares, afterward they might ſtand in the kings ſight.
label: Daniel

text: There were therfore among them of the children of Iuda, Daniel, Ananias, Miſael, and Azarias.
label: Daniel

text: And the gouernour of the eunuches gaue them names: to Daniel, Baltaſſar: to Ananias, Sidrach, to Miſael, Miſach: & to Azarias, Abdenago.
label: Daniel

text: But Daniel purpoſed in his hart, that he would not be polluted of the kings table, nor of the wine of his drinke: & he requeſted the gouernour of the eunuches, that he might not be contaminated.
label: Daniel

text: And God gaue vnto Daniel grace and mercie in the ſight of the prince of the eunuches.
label: Daniel

text: And the prince of the eunuches ſaid to Daniel: I feare my Lord the king, who hath appoynted for you meate and drinke: who if he shal ſee your faces leaner then the other youthes your equals, you shal condemne my head to the king.
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel ſayd to Malaſar whom the prince of the eunuches appoynted ouer Daniel, Ananias, Miſael, and Azarias:
label: Daniel

text: Proue I beſech thee, thy ſeruants for tenne dayes, & let pulſe be geuen vs to eate, & water to drinke:
label: Daniel

text: and looke vpon our faces, and the faces of the children that eate of the kings meate: and as thou shalt ſee, thou shalt doe with thy ſeruants.
label: Daniel

text: Who hearing that maner of ſpeach, proued them for tenne dayes.
label: Daniel

text: And after tenne daies their faces appeared better & more corpulent then al the children, that did eate of the kings meate.
label: Daniel

text: Moreouer Malaſar tooke away the meates, and the wine of their drinke: and he gaue them pulſe.
label: Daniel

text: And to theſe children God gaue knowlege, and diſcipline in euerie booke, and wiſedom: but to Daniel the vnderſtanding of al viſions and dreames.
label: Daniel

text: The dayes therfore being accomplished, after which the king had ſayd, that they should be brought in; the gouernour of the eunuches brought them in the ſight of Nabuchodonoſor.
label: Daniel

text: And when the king had ſpoken to them, there were not fond ſuch of them al, as Daniel, Ananias, Miſael, and Azarias: and they ſtood in the kings ſight.
label: Daniel

text: And euerie word of wiſedom and vnderſtanding, that the king demanded of them, he found in them more by ten fold aboue al the ſouthſayers, & magicians, that were in al his kingdom.
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel was euen to the firſt yeare of Cyrus the king.
label: Daniel

text: IN the ſecond yeare of the kingdom of Nabuchodonoſor, Nabuchodonoſor ſaw a dreame, and his ſpirit was terrified,
label: Daniel

text: and his dreame was fled from him. But the king commanded, that the ſouthſayers should be called together, and, the magicians, and the ſorcerers, and the Chaldees: to declare vnto the king his dreames: whom when they were come, ſtood before
label: Daniel

text: the king. And the king ſayd to them: I ſaw a dreame: & being confounded in minde I know not what I ſaw.
label: Daniel

text: And the Chaldees anſwered the king in Syriach, King for euer liue: tel the dreame to thy ſeruants, and we wil declare the interpretation therof.
label: Daniel

text: And the king anſwering ſayd to the Chaldees. The word is departed from me: vnles you tel me the dreame, and the coniecture therof, you shal perish, and your houſes shal be confiſcate.
label: Daniel

text: But if you tel the dreame, & the coniecture therof, you shal receiue of me rewards, & gifts, and much honour: the dreame therfore, and the interpretation therof tel you me.
label: Daniel

text: They anſwered the ſecond time, & ſayd: Let the king tel his ſeruants the dreame, & we wil declare the interpretation therof.
label: Daniel

text: The king anſwered, & ſayd: Surely I know that you redeme time, knowing that the word is departed from me.
label: Daniel

text: If therfore you shew me not the dreame, there is one ſentence of you, that you haue alſo framed a guilful interpretation, and ful of deceite, to ſpeake vnto me til the time paſſe away. Tel me therfore the dreame, that I may know that you ſpeake a true interpretation alſo therof.
label: Daniel

text: The Chaldees therfore anſwering before the king, ſayd: There is no man vpon the earth, that can accomplish thy word, ó king, yea neither anie king great and mighty, demandeth ſuch a word of anie ſouthſayer, & magician, and Chaldee.
label: Daniel

text: For the word that thou askeſt, ó king, is weightie: neither shal there be found any, that can shew it in ſight of the king, except the goddes, whoſe conuerſation is not with men.
label: Daniel

text: Which thing being heard, the king in furie, and in great wrath commanded that al the wiſemen of Babylon should perish.
label: Daniel

text: And the ſentence being gone forth, wiſemen were ſlaine: & Daniel and his felowes were ſougth for, to perish.
label: Daniel

text: Then Daniel inquired concerning the law, and the ſentence, of Arioch the prince of the kings warfar, who was gone forth to kil the wiſemen of Babylon.
label: Daniel

text: And he asked him, that had receiued the powre of the king, for what cauſe ſo cruel a ſentence was gone forth from the face of the king. When Arioch therfore had shewed the matter to Daniel,
label: Daniel

text: Daniel going in deſired the king, that he would geue him a time to tel the ſolution to the king.
label: Daniel

text: And he went into his houſe, and he told the matter vnto Ananias, & Miſael, & Azarias his felowes:
label: Daniel

text: that they should aske mercie at the face of the God of heauen vpon this ſacrament, & Daniel and his felowes might not perish, with the reſt of the wiſemen of Babylon.
label: Daniel

text: Then was the myſterie reueled to Daniel by a viſion in the night: and Daniel bleſſed the God of heauen,
label: Daniel

text: and ſpeaking ſayd: The name of our Lord be bleſſed from euerlaſting & for euer more: becauſe wiſedom and ſtrength are his.
label: Daniel

text: And he changeth times, and ages: tranſporteth kingdoms & eſtablisheth them: geueth wiſedom to the wiſe, and knowlege to them that vnderſtand diſcipline:
label: Daniel

text: he reueleth profound, & hidden thinges, and knoweth the thinges that are done in darkenes: and light is with him.
label: Daniel

text: To thee ó God of our fathers I confeſſe, and I prayſe thee: becauſe thou haſt geuen me wiſedom, & ſtrength: and now thou haſt shewed me the thinges that we deſired of thee, becauſe the kings word thou haſt opened to vs.
label: Daniel

text: After theſe thinges Daniel being entered in to Arioch, whom the king had appoynted to deſtroy the wiſemen of Babylon, ſpake thus vnto him: Deſtroy not the wiſemen of Babylon: bring me in before the preſence of the king, & I wil tel the ſolution to the king.
label: Daniel

text: Then Arioch in haſt brought in Daniel to the king, and ſaid to him: I haue found a man of the children of the tranſmigration of Iuda, that can tel the ſolution to the king.
label: Daniel

text: The king anſwered, and ſaid to Daniel, whoſe name was Baltaſſar: Thinkeſt thou in very dede thou canſt tel me the dreame, that I ſaw, and the interpretation therof?
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel anſwering before the king, ſayd: The myſterie, that the king demandeth, the wiſemen, the Magicians, and the ſouthſayers, and the inchanters can not declare vnto the king.
label: Daniel

text: But there is a God in heauen that reueleth myſteries, who hath shewed vnto thee, king Nabuchodonoſor, what thinges are to come in the later times. Thy dreame, and the viſions of thy head in thy bed, are theſe.
label: Daniel

text: Thou ó king beganſt to thinke in thy bed, what should be hereafter: and he that reueleth myſteries, shewed thee what thinges are to come.
label: Daniel

text: To me alſo not in the wiſedom, that is in me more then in al men aliue, is this ſacrament reueled: but that the interpretation might be made manifeſt to the king, and thou mighteſt know the cogitations of thy minde.
label: Daniel

text: Thou ó king didſt ſee, and behold as it were one great ſtatua: that ſtatua, great and high of ſtature ſtood ouer againſt thee, and the ſight therof was terrible.
label: Daniel

text: The head of this ſtatua was of the beſt gold, but the breaſt and the armes of ſiluer, moreouer the bellie, and the thighes
label: Daniel

text: of braſſe: and the legges of yron, of the feete a certaine part was of yron, and a certaine of earth.
label: Daniel

text: Thou ſaweſt ſo, til a ſtone was cut out of a mountaine without handes: and it ſtroke the ſtatua on the yron, & earthen feete therof, & brake them in peeces.
label: Daniel

text: Then were the yron, the clay, the braſſe, the ſiluer, and gold broken together, and brought as it were into the duſt of a ſummers floore, that are taken violently with the winde: and there was no place found for them: but the ſtone that ſtroke the ſtatua, was made a great mountaine, and it filled al the earth.
label: Daniel

text: This is the dreame: the interpretation alſo therof we wil tel before thee, ó king.
label: Daniel

text: Thou art the king of kings: and the God of heauen hath geuen thee kingdom, and ſtrength, and empire, and glorie:
label: Daniel

text: and al thinges, wherin the children of men, and the beaſts of the filde doe inhabite, the foules alſo of the heauen he hath geuen in thy hand, and vnder thy dominion he hath appoynted al thinges: thou therfore art the golden head.
label: Daniel

text: And after thee shal ryſe vp an other kingdom leſſe then thou of ſiluer: and an other third kingdom of braſſe, which shal rule ouer al the world.
label: Daniel

text: And the fourth kingdom shal be as it were yron. As yron breaketh into peeces, & tameth al thinges, ſo shal that breake, and deſtroy al theſe.
label: Daniel

text: Moreouer becauſe thou ſaweſt part of the feete, and of the toes of the potters clay, and part of yron: the kindom shal be diuided, which notwithſtanding shal riſe of the ground of yron, according as thou ſaweſt the yron mingled with the earth of clay.
label: Daniel

text: And the toes in part of yron, and in part of earth: in part the kingdom shal be whole, and in part broken.
label: Daniel

text: And that thou ſaweſt the yron mingled with the earth of clay, they shal be mingled in dede together with mans ſeede, but they shal not ſticke faſt one to an other, as yron can not be mingled with earth.
label: Daniel

text: But in the dayes of thoſe kingdoms the God of heauen wil rayſe vp a kingdom, that shal not be diſſipated for euer, and his kingdom shal not be deliuered to an other people: and it shal breake in peeces, and shal conſume al theſe kingdoms: and itſelf shal ſtand for euer.
label: Daniel

text: According as thou ſaweſt, that the ſtone was cut out of the mountaine without handes, and brake the earth in peeces, and the yron, and the braſſe, and the ſiluer, and the gold, the great God hath shwed the king what thinges are to come hereafter. & the dreame is true, & the interpretation therof faithful.
label: Daniel

text: Then king Nabuchodonoſor fel on his face, & adored Daniel, & commanded to ſacrifice to him hoſtes & incenſe.
label: Daniel

text: The king therfore ſpeaking ſaid to Daniel: In very dede your God is the God of goddes, and Lord of kinges, and he that reueleth myſteries: becauſe thou couldſt open this ſacrament.
label: Daniel

text: Then the king aduanced Daniel on high, & he gaue him manie gifts, and great: and he made him prince ouer al the prouinces of Babylon: and chiefe of the magiſtrates, ouer al the wiſemen of Babylon.
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel requeſted of the king, and he appoynted ouer the workes of the prouince of Babylon, Sidrach, Miſach, and Abdenago: but Daniel himſelf was in the doores of the king.
label: Daniel

text: NABVCHODONOSOR the king made a ſtatua of gold in height of ſixtie cubites, in bredth of ſix cubits, and he ſet it in the fild of Dura of the prouince of Babylon.
label: Daniel

text: Therfor Nabuchodonoſor the king ſent to cal together the nobles, the magiſtrates, and iudges, dukes, and tyrants, and rulers, and al the princes of the countries, that they should come together to the dedication of the ſtatua, which Nabuchodonoſor the king had erected.
label: Daniel

text: Then were the nobles gathered together, the magiſtrates, and iudges, the dukes, and tyrants, & the great men that were placed in regiments, and al the princes of the countries, to come together to the dedication of the ſtatua, which Nabuchodonoſor the king had erected. And they ſtood in the ſight of the ſtatua, which Nabuchodonoſor the king had ſet vp.
label: Daniel

text: And the cryer cried mightely: To you peoples, and tribes, and tongues it is ſaid:
label: Daniel

text: In the houre that you shal heare the ſound of the trumpet, & pipe, and harpe, of the doulcimer, and pſalter, and ſymphonie, & al kind of muſical inſtruments: falling adore ye the golden ſtatua, which Nabuchodonoſor the king hath ſet vp.
label: Daniel

text: But if any man shal not adore proſtrate, he shal the ſelf ſame houre be caſt into a fornace of burning fyre.
label: Daniel

text: After this therfore forthwith as al the peoples heard the ſound of the trumpet, the pipe, & harpe, of the doulcimer, and pſalter, of the ſymphonie, and of al kind of muſical inſtruments: al the peoples, tribes, and tongues falling adored the golden ſtatua, which Nabuchodonoſor the king had ſet vp.
label: Daniel

text: And forthwith in the very ſame time men of Chaldee coming accuſed the Iewes,
label: Daniel

text: and ſayd to Nabuchodonoſor the king: King for euer liue:
label: Daniel

text: thou, ó king haſt made a decree, that euerie man which shal heare the ſound of the trumpet, of the pipe, and harpe, of the doulcimer, and pſalter, of the ſymphonie, and of al kind of muſical inſtrumentes, proſtrate himſelf, and adore the golden ſtatua:
label: Daniel

text: and if any man do not proſtrate on the grond adore, that he be caſt into a fornace of burning fyre.
label: Daniel

text: There are therfore men of Iewrie, whom thou didſt appoynte ouer the workes of the countrie of babylon, Sidrach, Miſach, and Abdenago: theſe men, ó king, haue contemned thy decree: thy goddes they worshipe not, and the golden ſtatua, which thou haſt erected, they adore not.
label: Daniel

text: Then Nabuchodonoſor in furie, and in wrath commanded, that Sidrach, Miſach, & Abdenago should be brought: who immediatly were brought before the king.
label: Daniel

text: And Nabuchodonoſor the king pronouncing, ſayd to them: In dede Sidrach, Miſach, and Abdenago, doe not you worshipe my goddes, & the golden ſtatua that I haue ſet vp doe not you adore?
label: Daniel

text: Now therfore if you be readie, in what houre ſoeuer you shal heare the ſound of the trumpet, the pipe, the harpe, of the doulcimer, and pſalter, and Symphonie, and of al kind of muſical inſtruments, proſtrate your ſelues, & adore the ſtatua which I haue made: but if you adore not, the ſelfe ſame houre you shal be caſt into the fornace of burning fyre: and what God is there, that shal deliuer you out of my hand?
label: Daniel

text: Sidrach, Miſach, and Abdenago anſwering ſaid to king Nabuchodonoſor; We muſt not anſwer thee concerning this thing.
label: Daniel

text: For behold our God, whom we worshipe, can ſaue vs from the fornace of burning fyre, and out of thy handes, ó king, deliuer vs.
label: Daniel

text: But if he wil not, be it knowen to thee, ó king, that we worshipe not thy goddes, & the golden ſtatua; which thou haſt erected, we adore not.
label: Daniel

text: Then was Nabuchodonoſor replenished with furie: and the looke of his face was altered vpon Sidrach, Miſach, and Abdenago, and he commanded that the fornace should be heated ſeuen times more, then it had bene accuſtomed to be heated.
label: Daniel

text: And commanded the ſtrongeſt men of his hoſt, to binde the feete of Sidrach, Miſach, and Abdenago, and to caſt them into the fornace of burning fyre.
label: Daniel

text: And forthwith thoſe men being bound with their breeches, and head attire, and shoes, and garments were caſt into the fornace of burning fyre.
label: Daniel

text: For the commandent of the king did vrge, and the fornace was heated excedingly. Moreouer the flame of the fyre ſlew thoſe men, that had caſt in Sidrach, Miſach, and Abdenago.
label: Daniel

text: But theſe three men, that is, Sidrach Miſach, and Abdenago fel in the middes of the fornace of burning fire, bound together.
label: Daniel

text: And they walked in the middes of the flame prayſing God, and bleſſing our Lord.
label: Daniel

text: And Azarias ſtanding prayed thus, and opening his mouth in the middes of the fire, he ſayd:
label: Daniel

text: Bleſſed art thou ó Lord the God of our fathers, and laudable, and glorious is thy name for euer:
label: Daniel

text: becauſe thou art iuſt in al thinges, which thou haſt done to vs, and al thy workes are true, and thy wayes right, and al thy iudgements true.
label: Daniel

text: For thou haſt done true iudgements according to al thinges, that thou haſt brought in vpon vs, and vpon the holie citie of our fathers Ieruſalem: becauſe in truth, & in iudgement thou haſt brought in al theſe thinges for our ſinnes.
label: Daniel

text: For we haue ſinned, and done vniuſtly reuolting from thee: and we haue offended in al thinges;
label: Daniel

text: and thy precepts we haue not heard, nor obſerued, nor done as thou hadſt commanded vs, that it might be wel with vs.
label: Daniel

text: Al thinges therfore that thou haſt brought in vpon vs, and al thinges that thou haſt done to vs, thou haſt done with true iudgement:
label: Daniel

text: and thou haſt deliuered vs into the handes of our enemies vniuſt, and moſt wicked, and preuaricatours, & to an vniuſt king and moſt wicked aboue al the earth.
label: Daniel

text: And now we can not open the mouth: we are become a confuſion, and reproch to thy ſeruants, & to them that worshipe thee.
label: Daniel

text: Deliuer vs not for euer, we beſech thee, for thy name ſake, and diſſipate not thy teſtament:
label: Daniel

text: neither take thou away thy mercie from vs for Abraham thy beloued, and Iſaac thy ſeruant, and Iſrael thy holie one:
label: Daniel

text: to whom thou haſt ſpoken, promiſing that thou wouldeſt multiplie their ſeede as the ſtarres of heauen, and as the ſand that is in the ſea shore.
label: Daniel

text: Becauſe ó Lord we are diminished more then al nations, and are abaſed in al the earth this day for our ſinnes.
label: Daniel

text: And there is not at this time prince, & duke, and prophet, nor holocauſt, nor ſacrifice, nor oblation, nor incenſe, nor place of firſt fruits before thee,
label: Daniel

text: that we may finde thy mercie: but in contrite minde, & ſpirit of humilitie let vs be receiued.
label: Daniel

text: As in holocauſt of rammes, and bulles, and as in thouſands of fat lambes: ſo let our ſacrifice be made in thy ſight this day, that it may pleaſe thee: becauſe there is no confuſion to them that truſt in thee.
label: Daniel

text: And now we folow thee in al our hart, and feare thee, and ſeeke thy face.
label: Daniel

text: Confound vs not, but doe with vs according to thy meekenes, and according to the multitude of thy mercie.
label: Daniel

text: And deliuer vs in thy meruels, and geue glorie to thy name ó Lord:
label: Daniel

text: and let al be confounded that shew euils to thy ſeruants, let them be confunded in al thy might, and let their ſtrength be broken:
label: Daniel

text: and let them know that thou art the Lord, the onlie God, and glorious ouer the round world.
label: Daniel

text: And the kings ſeruants that had caſt them in, ceaſed not to heate the fornace, with Naphtha, & tow, and pitch, and drie ſtickes,
label: Daniel

text: and the flame mounted out aboue the fornace nine and fourtie cubits:
label: Daniel

text: and it brake forth, and burnt them whom it found by the fornace, of the Chaldees.
label: Daniel

text: But the Angel of our Lord deſcended with Azarias, and his felowes into the fornace: and he shooke the flame of the fire out of the fornace,
label: Daniel

text: and made the middes of the fornace as a winde of dew blowing, and the fire touched them not at al, nor payned them, nor did them anie greuance.
label: Daniel

text: Then theſe three as out of one mouth prayſed, and glorified, and bleſſed God in the fornace, ſaying:
label: Daniel

text: Bleſſed art thou ó Lord the God of our fathers: and laudable, and glorious, and ſuperexalted for euer: and bleſſed is the holie name of thy glorie: and laudable, and ſuperexalted in al ages.
label: Daniel

text: Bleſſed art thou in the holie temple of thy glorie: & paſſing laudable, and paſſing glorious for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Bleſſed art thou in the throne of thy kingdom, and paſſing laudable, and ſuperexalted for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Bleſſed art thou, that beholdeſt the depths, and ſitteſt vpon the Cherubs: and laudable, and ſuperexalted for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Bleſſed art thou in the firmament of heauen: and laudable and glorious for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Al workes of our Lord bleſſe ye our Lord, prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Bleſſe our Lord ye Angels of our Lord: prayſe & ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Ye heauens bleſſe our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Al waters that are aboue the heauens, bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Bleſſe our Lord al ye powers of our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Sunne and moone bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Starres of heauens bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Euerie shower, & dew bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Al ſpirits of God bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Fire and heate bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Colde and heate bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Dewes and hore froſt bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Froſt and cold bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Yſe and ſnowes bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Nightes and dayes bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Light and darknes bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Lightenings and cloudes bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Let the earth bleſſe our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Mountaines and litle hilles bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Al things that ſpring in the earth bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Bleſſe our Lord ye fountaines: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Seas and riuers bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Whales, and al things that moue in the waters, bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Bleſſe our Lord al ye foules of heauen: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Al beaſts and cattel bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Sonnes of men bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Let Iſrael bleſſe our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalte him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Prieſts of our Lord bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Seruants of our Lord bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Spirits and ſoules of the iuſt bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Holie and humble of hart bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Ananias, Azarias, and Miſael, bleſſe ye our Lord: prayſe and ſuperexalt him for euer. Becauſe he hath deliuered vs from hel, and ſaued vs out of the hand of death, and deliuered vs out of the middes of the burning flame, and out of the middes of the fire hath he rid vs.
label: Daniel

text: Confeſſe ye to our Lord, becauſe he is good: becauſe his mercie is for euer.
label: Daniel

text: Al religious bleſſe ye our Lord the God of goddes: prayſe and confeſſe ye to him, becauſe his mercie is vnto al worldes.
label: Daniel

text: Then Nabuchodonoſor the king was aſtonied, and he aroſe haſtely, & ſaid to his nobles: Did we not caſt three men fettered into the middes of the fire? Who anſwering the king,
label: Daniel

text: ſaid: It is true ó king. He anſwered, and ſaid: Behold I ſee foure men looſe, and walking in the middes of the fire, and there is no corruption in them, & the forme of the fourth is like to the ſonne of God.
label: Daniel

text: Then came Nabuchodonoſor to the doore of the fornace of burning fire, and ſaid: Sidrach, Miſach, & Abdenago ſeruants of the high God, goe ye forth, and come. And forthwith Sidrach, Miſach, and Abdenago went out of the middes of the fire.
label: Daniel

text: And the nobles, and the magiſtrates, and iudges, and the potentates of the king being gathered together, beheld thoſe men, that the fire had no powre on their bodies, & not a heare of their head was ſinged, yea their breeches were not altered, & the ſent of the fire had not paſſed by them.
label: Daniel

text: And Nabuchodonoſor breaking forth, ſaid: Bleſſed be the God of them, to witte, of Sidrach, Miſach, and Abdenago, who hath ſent his Angel, and hath deliuered his ſeruants that beleued in him: and they changed the kings word, & deliuered their bodies that they might not ſerue, and might not adore anie god, except their owne God.
label: Daniel

text: By me therfore this decree is made, that euerie people, tribe, and tongue, whatſoeuer shal ſpeake blaſphemie againſt the God of Sidrach, Miſach, and Abdenago, he perish, and his houſe be waſted: for there is none other God, that can ſo ſaue.
label: Daniel

text: Then did the king promote Sidrach, Miſach, and Abdenago in the prouince of Babylon.
label: Daniel

text: Nabuchodonoſor the king, to al peoples, nations, and tongues, that dwel in the whole earth, peace be multiplied vnto you.
label: Daniel

text: The high God hath wrought ſignes and meruelous thinges with me. It hath pleaſed me therfore to publish
label: Daniel

text: his ſignes, becauſe they are great: and his meruels, becauſe they are ſtrong: and his kingdom an euerlaſting kingdom, & his powre in generation and to genaration.
label: Daniel

text: I Nabuchodonoſor was quiet in my houſe, and florishing in my palace.
label: Daniel

text: I ſaw a dreame that made me ſore afrayd: and my cogitations in my bed, and the viſions of my head diſturbed me.
label: Daniel

text: And by me there was a decree ſetforth, that al the wiſemen of Babylon should be brought into my ſight, and that they should shew me the ſolution of the dreame.
label: Daniel

text: Then came in the ſouthſayers, magicians, Chaldees, and diuiners, and I told the dreame in their ſight: & the ſolution therof they shewed me not:
label: Daniel

text: til their collegue Daniel came into my ſight, whole name is Baltaſſar, according to the name of my God, who hath the ſpirit of the holie goddes in himſelf: and I told the dreame before him.
label: Daniel

text: Baltaſſar prince of the ſouthſayers, becauſe I know that thou haſt the ſpirit of the holie goddes in thee, and no ſecrete is impoſſible to thee: tel thou the viſions of my dreames, which I haue ſene, and the ſolution of them.
label: Daniel

text: The viſion of my head in my bed, I ſaw, and behold a tree in the middes of the earth, and the height therof exceding.
label: Daniel

text: A great tree, and ſtrong: and the height therof touching the heauen: the ſight therof was euen to the endes of al the earth.
label: Daniel

text: The leaues therof moſt fayre, and the fruit therof exceding much: and the foode of al thinges in it: vnder it dwelt cattel, and beaſts, and in the boughes therof conuerſed the foules of heauen: and of it al flesh did eate.
label: Daniel

text: I ſaw in the viſion of my head vpon my bed, & behold a watchman, and an holie one deſcended from heauen.
label: Daniel

text: He cried mightely, and thus he ſayd: Cut ye downe the tree, & choppe of the boughes therof: shake of the leaues therof, and ſcatter the fruits therof: let the beaſts flie that are vnder it, and the foules from the boughes therof.
label: Daniel

text: But yet leaue the ſpring of the rootes therof in the earth, and let it be tyed with yron, and braſen band among the graſſe, that is without, and let it be dipped with the dew of heauen, and with wild beaſts his portion in the graſſe of the earth.
label: Daniel

text: Let his hart be changed from humane, & let the hart of a wild beaſt be geuen him: and let ſeuen times be changed ouer him.
label: Daniel

text: In the ſentence of the watchman is the decree, and the word of ſaintes, and the petition, til the liuing know, that the hiegh one ruleth in the kingdom of men; and to whom ſoeuer it shal pleaſe him, he wil geue it, & the baſeſt man he wil appoint ouer it.
label: Daniel

text: This dreame ſaw I Nabuchodonoſor the king: thou therfore ô Baltaſſar tel the interpretation quickly: becauſe al the wiſemen of my kingdom can not declare the ſolution vnto me: but thou canſt, becauſe the ſpirit of holie goddes is in thee.
label: Daniel

text: Then Daniel, whoſe name was Baltaſſar, began ſecretely to thinke within himſelf as it were for one houre: & his cogitations trubled him. But the king anſwering ſaid: Baltaſſar, let not the dreame and the interpretation therof truble thee. Baltaſſar anſwered, and ſaid: My Lord, the dreame be to them, that hate thee, and the interpretation therof be thine enemies.
label: Daniel

text: The tree which thou ſaweſt high and ſtrong, whoſe height reacheth to the heauen, and the ſight therof into al the earth:
label: Daniel

text: and the bough therof moſt fayre, and the fruit therof exceding much, and the foode of things in it, vnder it the beaſts of the ſilde inhabiting, & in the boughes therof the foules of heauen abyding:
label: Daniel

text: It is thou king, which art magnified, & become mightie: & thy greatnes hath growen, and is come euen to heauen, and thy power vnto the endes of the earth.
label: Daniel

text: But in that the king ſaw a watchman, and an holie one deſcend fron heauen, and ſay: Cut ye downe the tree, and diſſipate it, but leaue the ſpring of the rootes therof in the earth, and let it be bound with yron and braſſe among the graſſe without, and let it be ſprinkled with the dew of heauen, and let his foder be with the wild beasts, til ſeauen times be changed ouer him.
label: Daniel

text: This is the interpretation of the ſentence of the Higheſt, which is come vpon my Lord the king.
label: Daniel

text: They shal caſt thee out from men, and with beaſts and wilde beaſts shal thy habitation be, and graſſe thou shalt eate as an oze, & with the dew of heauen thou shalt be wett: ſeuen times alſo shal be chaunged ouer thee, til thou know that the High one ruleth ouer the kingdoms of men, and geueth it to whomſoeuer he wil.
label: Daniel

text: But wheras he commanded, that the ſpring of the rootes therof, that is, of the tree, should be left: thy kingdom shal remayne to thee after thou shalt haue knowen that powre is heauenly.
label: Daniel

text: Wherfore ô king let me counſel thee, and redeme thou thy ſinnes with almes, & thine iniquities with the mercies of the poore: perhaps he wil forgeue thyne offences.
label: Daniel

text: Al theſe thinges came vpon Nabuchodonoſor the king.
label: Daniel

text: After the end of twelue moneths he walked in the palace of Babylon.
label: Daniel

text: And the king anſwered, & ſayd: Is not this Babylon the great citie, which I haue built to be the houſe of the kingdom, in the ſtrength of my powre, and in the glorie of my beautie?
label: Daniel

text: And when the word was yet in the kings mouth, a voice came downe from heauen: To thee it is ſayd Nabuchodonoſor: Thy kingdom shal paſſe from thee,
label: Daniel

text: and from men they shal caſt thee out, and with beaſtes and wilde beaſts shal thy habitation be: graſſe as an oxe shalt thou eate, and ſeuen times shal be changed ouer thee til thou know that the Hiegh one ruleth in the kingdom of men, & to whom ſoeuer he wil, he geueth it.
label: Daniel

text: The ſelf ſame houre was the word accomplished vpon Nabuchodonoſor, and he was caſt away from among men, & as an oxe did he eate graſſe, and with the dew of heauen his bodie was imbrued: til his heares grew into the ſimilitude of eagles, & his nailes as it were of birds.
label: Daniel

text: Therfore after the end of the dayes, I Nabuchodonoſor lifted vp mine eyes to heauen, and my ſenſe was reſtored to me: and I bleſſed the Higheſt, and prayſed him that liueth for euer, and glorified him: becauſe his powre is an euerlaſting powre, and his kingdom in generation and generation.
label: Daniel

text: And al the inhabitants of the earth with him are reputed for nothing: for he doth according to his wil, as wel in the powers of heauen, as in the inhabitants of the earth: & there is none that can reſiſt his hand, and ſay to him: Why didſt thou it?
label: Daniel

text: In the very ſame time did my ſenſe returne tó me, & I came to the honour, and beautie of my kingdom: and my figure returned to me: and my nobles, & my magiſtrates ſought for me, and I was reſtored in my kingdom: and more ample magnificence was added to me.
label: Daniel

text: Now therfore I Nabuchodonoſor praiſe, and magnifie, and glorifie the king of heauen: becauſe al his workes are true, and his wayes iudgements, and them that walke in pride he can humble.
label: Daniel

text: BALTASSAR the king made a great feaſt to his nobles a thouſand: and euerie one dranke according to his age.
label: Daniel

text: He commanded therfore now being drunke that the veſſels of gold & ſiluer, should be brought, which Nabuchodonoſor his father had caried away out of the temple, that was in Ieruſalem, that the king, and his Nobles might drinke in them, and his wiues, and concubines.
label: Daniel

text: Then were the golden and ſiluer veſſels brought, which he had caried away out of the temple, that was in Ieruſalem: and the king and his nobles dranke in them, his wiues and concubines.
label: Daniel

text: They dranke wine, and prayſed their goddes of gold, and of ſiluer, of braſſe, of yron, and of wood, and of ſtone.
label: Daniel

text: In the very ſame houre there appeared fingers, as it were of the hand of a man, writing ouer againſt the candleſticke in the vtter part of the wal of the kings palace: and the king beheld the ioynts of the hand that wrote.
label: Daniel

text: Then was the kings face changed, and his cogitations trubled him: and the iunctures of his reynes were looſed, and his knees were ſtriken one againſt the other.
label: Daniel

text: The king therfore cried out mightely that they should bring in the magicians, Chaldees, and ſouthſayers. And the king ſpeaking ſayd to the wiſemen of Babylon: Whoſoeuer shal read this writing, and shal make the interpretation therof manifeſt vnto me, shal be clothed with purple, and shal haue a golden chayne on his necke, & shal be the third in my kingdom.
label: Daniel

text: Then al the kings wiſemen going in could not neither read the writing, nor declare the interpretation to the king.
label: Daniel

text: Wherewith king Baltaſſar was much trubled, and his countenance was changed: yea and his nobles were trubled.
label: Daniel

text: And the queene for the thing that had happened to the king, and his Nobles, entered into the houſe of the feaſt: and ſpeaking she ſayd: King for euer liue: let not thy cogitations truble thee, neither let thy face be changed.
label: Daniel

text: There is a man in thy kingdom, that hath the ſpirit of the holie goddes in him: and in the dayes of thy father knowlege and wiſedom were found in him: for king Nabuchodonoſor alſo thy father appoynted him prince of the magicians, inchanters, Chaldees and ſouthſayers, thy father,
label: Daniel

text: I ſay ô king: Becauſe more ample ſpirit, and prudence, and vnderſtanding, & interpretation of Dreames, and shewing of ſecrets, and ſolution of thinge bound were found in him, that is, in Daniel: to whom the king gaue the name Baltaſſar. Now therfore let Daniel be called, and he wil tel the interpretation.
label: Daniel

text: Daniel therfore was brought in before the king. To whom the king ſpeaking, ſaid: Art thou Daniel of the children of the captiuitie of Iuda, whom my father the king brought out of Iewrie?
label: Daniel

text: I haue heard of thee, that thou haſt the ſpirit of the goddes, and more ample knowlege, and vnderſtanding, and wiſedom are found in thee.
label: Daniel

text: And now there haue come in into my ſight the wiſe magicians, that they might read this writing, and might shew me the interpretation therof: and they could not declare me the ſenſe of this word.
label: Daniel

text: Moreouer I haue heard of thee, that thou canſt interpret obſcure thinges, and reſolue thinges bound: if therfore thou be able to reade the writing, & to shew me the interpretation therof, thou shalt be clothed with purple, and shalt haue a cheyne of gold about thy necke, & shalt be the third prince in my kingdom.
label: Daniel

text: To which thinges Daniel anſwering, ſayd before the king: Thy rewardes be they vnto thee, and the giftes of thy houſe geue to an other: but the writing wil I read thee, ô king, and the interpretation therof wil I shew to thee.
label: Daniel

text: O king, God the moſt high gaue to Nabuchodonoſor thy father kingdom and magnificence, glorie and honour.
label: Daniel

text: And for the magnificence, which he gaue to him, al peoples, tribes, and tongues trembled, and feared him: whom he would he killed: and whom he would, he ſtroke: and whom he would he exalted: and whom he would, he humbled.
label: Daniel

text: But when his hart was eleuated, and his ſpirit obſtinatly ſet to pride, he was depoſed from the throne of his kingdom, and his glorie was taken away.
label: Daniel

text: And he was caſt out from the ſonnes of men, yea and his hart was ſet with the beaſts, and with the wild aſſes was his habitation: graſſe alſo he did eate as an oxe, and with the dew of heauen his bodie was embrewed: til he knew that the Higheſt had powre in the kingdom of men, and whomſoeuer it shal pleaſe him he wil raiſe vp ouer it.
label: Daniel

text: Thou alſo his ſonne Baltaſſar, haſt not humbled thy hart, wheras thou knoweſt al theſe thinges:
label: Daniel

text: but againſt the dominatour of heauen thou waſt eleuated: and the veſſels of his houſe haue bene brought before thee: and thou, and thy nobles, and thy wiues, and thy concubins haue drunke wine in them: the goddes alſo of ſiluer, and of gold, and of braſſe, of yron, and of wood, and of ſtone that ſee not, nor heare, nor feele, thou haſt prayſed: moreouer the God, that hath thy breath in his hand, and al thy wayes, thou haſt not glorified.
label: Daniel

text: Therfore from him is the ioynt of the hand ſent, which hath written this that is drawen.
label: Daniel

text: And this is the writing which is ordered. MANE, THECEL, PHARES.
label: Daniel

text: And this the interpretation of the word. MANE: God hath numbred thy kingdom, and hath finished it.
label: Daniel

text: THECEL: thou art weighed in the balance, and art found hauing leſſe.
label: Daniel

text: PHARES: thy kingdom is diuided, and is geuen to the Medes, and Perſians.
label: Daniel

text: Then the king commanding Daniel was clothed with purple, and a cheyne of gold was put about his necke: & it was proclamed of him that he had powre the third in the kingdom.
label: Daniel

text: The ſame night was Baltaſſar the king of Chaldee ſlaine.
label: Daniel

text: And Darius the Mede ſucceded into the kingdom, being three ſcore and two yeares old.
label: Daniel

text: IT pleaſed Darius, and he appoynted ouer the kingdom Gouerners an hundred twentie to be in al his kingdom.
label: Daniel

text: And ouer them three princes, of whom Daniel was one: that the gouerners might render account to them, & the king might ſuſteyne no truble.
label: Daniel

text: Daniel therfore paſſed al the princes, and gouerners: becauſe there was the ſpirit of God more ample in him.
label: Daniel

text: Moreouer the king thought to appoynt him ouer al the kingdom, wherupon the princes, & the gouerners ſought to finde occaſion againſt Daniel on the behalfe of the king: and they could finde no cauſe, nor ſuſpicion, becauſe he was faithful, and no fault, nor ſuſpicion was found in him.
label: Daniel

text: Thoſe men therfore ſaid: We shal not finde againſt this ſame Daniel any occaſion, vnles perhaps in the law of his God.
label: Daniel

text: Then the princes, and the gouerners by ſurreption ſuggeſted to the king, and ſpake thus vnto him: King Darius, for euer liue:
label: Daniel

text: Al the princes of the kingdom, the magiſtrates, and gouerners, the ſenatours and iudges haue taken counſel, that there goe forth an imperial decree, and an edict: That euerie one, which shal aske any petition of whatſoeuer God, or man, vntil thirtie dayes, but of thee ô king, he be caſt into the lake of lions.
label: Daniel

text: Now therfore ô king confirme the ſentence, and write the decree: that it may not be changed, which is decreed by the Medes and the Perſians, nor be lawful for anie man to tranſgreſſe it.
label: Daniel

text: Moreouer king Darius put forth the edict, and decreed it.
label: Daniel

text: Which when Daniel had perceiued, that is to ſay, the law determined, he went into his houſe: and the windowes being opened in his vpper chamber, three times in a day toward Ieruſalem bowed he his knees, and adored, and confeſſed before his God, as alſo he had accuſtomed to doe before.
label: Daniel

text: Thoſe men therfore ſearching curiouſly, found Daniel praying, and beſeching his God.
label: Daniel

text: And coming they ſpake to the king vpon the edict: O king, haſt thou not decreed, that euerie man which should aske any of the goddes, & men vntil thirtie dayes, but thyſelf ô king, he should be caſt into the lake of lions? To whom the king anſwering, ſaid: The word is true according to the decree of the Medes, and Perſians, which it is not lawful to tranſgreſſe.
label: Daniel

text: Then they anſwering ſayd before the king: Daniel of the children of the captiuitie of Iuda, hath not cared for thy law, and for the edict, that thou madeſt: but three times in a day he prayeth with his prayer.
label: Daniel

text: Which word when the king had heard, he was ſtrooken very ſad: and for Daniel he ſet his hart to deliuer him, and euen vntil ſunne ſet he laboured to deliuer him.
label: Daniel

text: But thoſe men perceiuing the king ſaid to him: know thou ô king, that the law of Medes and Perſians is, that euerie decree, which the king hath determined, is not lawful to be changed.
label: Daniel

text: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and caſt him into the lake of lions. And the king ſaid to Daniel: Thy God, whom thou doeſt worshippe alwayes, he wil deliuer thee.
label: Daniel

text: And there was a ſtone brought, and layd vpon the mouth of the lake: which the king ſealed with his ring, and with the ring of his nobles, that nothing should be done againſt Daniel.
label: Daniel

text: And the king went into his houſe, and ſlept vnſupped, and meates were not brought before him, moreouer alſo ſleepe departed from him.
label: Daniel

text: Then the king riſing in the very firſt breake of day, went in haſt to the lake of the lions:
label: Daniel

text: and approching to the lake, cried on Daniel with a weeping voice, and ſpake vnto him: Daniel ſeruant of the liuing God, thy God whom thou ſerueſt alwayes, hath he bene able thinkeſt thou, to deliuer thee from the lions?
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel anſwering the king ſaid: King for euer liue.
label: Daniel

text: My God hath ſent his Angel, and hath shut vp the mouthes of the lions, and they haue not hurt me: becauſe before him iuſtice hath bene found in me: yea and before thee, ô king, I haue done no offence.
label: Daniel

text: Then was the king exceding glad vpon him, & he commanded Daniel to be brought out of the lake: and Daniel was brought out of the lake, and no hurt was found in him, becauſe he beleued his God.
label: Daniel

text: And by the kings comandment, thoſe men were brought that had accuſed Daniel: and they were caſt into the lake of the lions, themſelues, and their children, and their wiues: and they came not to the pauement of the lake, til the lions caught them, & brake al their bones in peeces.
label: Daniel

text: Then Darius the king wrote to al peoples, tribes, and tongues dwelling in the whole earth: PEACE be multiplied vnto you.
label: Daniel

text: By me a decree is made, that in al myne empire, and my kingdom they dread and feare the God of Daniel. for he is the liuing and eternal God for euer: and his kingdom shal not be diſſipated, & his power euen for euer.
label: Daniel

text: He is the deliuerer, and ſauiour, doing ſigne, & meruels in heauen, and in earth: who hath deliuered Daniel out of the lake of the lions.
label: Daniel

text: Moreouer Daniel continued vnto the kingdom of Darius, and the kingdom of Cyrus the Perſian.
label: Daniel

text: IN the firſt yeare of Baltaſſar the king of Babylon, Daniel ſaw a dreame: & the viſion of his head in his bed: and writing the dreame, he comprehended it in a short ſpeach: and in ſumme compriſing it, he ſaid:
label: Daniel

text: I ſaw in my viſion by night, and behold the foure windes of heauen fought in the great ſea.
label: Daniel

text: And foure great beaſts came vp, out of the ſea diuerſe one from an other.
label: Daniel

text: The firſt as it were a lyoneſſe, & she had the wings of an eagle: I beheld til her winges were plucked of, and she was lifted vp from the earth, & she ſtood vpon the fete as a man, & the hart of a man was geuen to her.
label: Daniel

text: And behold an other beaſt like a beare ſtood a ſide: and there were three rewes in the mouth therof, and in the teeth therof, & thus they ſaid to it: Ariſe, eate very much flesh.
label: Daniel

text: After this I beheld, and loe an other as it were a leopard, and it had winges as of a bird, foure vpon it, & there were foure heades in the beaſt, and powre was geuen to it.
label: Daniel

text: After this I beheld in the viſion of the night, and loe a fourth beaſt terrible and meruelous, and ſtrong excedingly, it had great yron teeth, eating and breaking, and treading the reſt with her fete: and it was vnlike to the other beaſts, which I had ſene before it, and it had tenne hornes.
label: Daniel

text: I conſidered the hornes, and behold an other litle horne ſprang out of the middes of them: and three of the firſt hornes were plucked of at the preſence therof, and loe eyes as it were the eyes of a man were in this horne, & a mouth ſpeaking great wordes.
label: Daniel

text: I beheld til thrones were ſet, and the ancient of dayes ſate: his veſture white as ſnow, and the heares of his head as cleane wool: his throne flames of fire: his wheeles fire kindled.
label: Daniel

text: A fire & ſwieft ſtreame came forth from his face thouſandes of thouſands miniſtred to him, & tenne thouſand hundred thouſands aſſiſted him: iudgement ſate, and the bookes were opened.
label: Daniel

text: I beheld becauſe of the voice of the great wordes, which that horne ſpake: and I ſaw that the beaſt was ſlaine, and the bodie therof was perished, and was committed to the fyre to be burnt.
label: Daniel

text: The power of the other beaſts alſo was taken away: and times of life were appointed them vntil time, and time.
label: Daniel

text: I beheld therfore in the viſion of the night, and loe with the clowdes of heauen there came in, as it were the ſonne of man, and he came euen to the ancient of dayes: and in his ſight they offered him.
label: Daniel

text: And he gaue him powre, and honour, and kingdom: and al peoples, tribes, & tongues shal ſerue him: his powre, an eternal power, that shal not be taken away: and his kingdom, that shal not be corrupted.
label: Daniel

text: My ſpirit trembled, I Daniel was made ſore afrayd at theſe thinges, and the viſions of my head trubled me.
label: Daniel

text: I came to one of the aſſiſtants, and I asked the truth of him concerning al theſe thinges, who told me the interpretation of the wordes, and taught me:
label: Daniel

text: Theſe foure great beaſts, are foure kingdoms, which shal riſe vp out of the earth.
label: Daniel

text: And they shal take the kingdom of the holie God moſt high: & they shal obteine the kingdom euen to world, & world of worldes.
label: Daniel

text: After this I would diligently lerne of the fourth beaſt, which was very vnlike from al, and exceding terrible: his teeth and clawes of yron: he did eate, and breake in peeces, & the reſt he ſtamped with his feete:
label: Daniel

text: and of the tenne hornes that he had on his head: and of the other, that had growen vp, before which the three hornes fel: and of that horne, that had eyes, and the mouth ſpeaking great wordes, and was greater then the reſt.
label: Daniel

text: I beheld, and loe that horne made warre agaynſt the ſaints, and preuailed ouer them,
label: Daniel

text: til the ancient of dayes came, & gaue iudgement to the ſaintes on High, and the time came, and the ſaintes obteyned the kingdom.
label: Daniel

text: And thus he ſayd: The fourth beaſt shal be the fourth kingdom in the earth, which shal be greater then al the kingdoms, and shal deuoure the whole earth, and shal conculcate, and breake it in peeces.
label: Daniel

text: Moreouer the tenne hornes of that ſame kingdom, shal be tenne kinges: and an other shal riſe vp after them, and he shal be mightier then the former, and he shal bring downe three kinges.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal ſpeake wordes agaynſt the High one, and shal deſtroy the ſaintes of the Higheſt: and he shal thinke that he can change times, & lawes, and they shal be deliuered into his hand euen to a time, & times, & half a time.
label: Daniel

text: And iudgement shal ſitte, that might may be taken away, and be broken, and perish euen to the end.
label: Daniel

text: And kingdom, and power, and the greatnes of the kingdom, that is vnder al the heauen, be geuen to the people of the ſaintes of the Higheſt: whoſe kingdom is an euerlaſting kingdom, and al kinges shal ſerue him, and shal obey him.
label: Daniel

text: Hitherto the end of the word. I Daniel was much trubled with my cogitations, and my face was changed in me: but the word I kept in my hart.
label: Daniel

text: IN the third yeare of the reigne of Baltaſſar the king, a viſion appeared to me.
label: Daniel

text: I Daniel ſaw in my viſion, after that which I had ſene in the beginning, when I was in Suſis the caſtel, which is in the prouince of Ælam: and I ſaw in the viſion, that I was ouer the gate Vlai.
label: Daniel

text: & I lifted vp mine eyes, and ſaw: and behold one ramme ſtood before the marrice, hauing highe hornes, & one higher then an other & growing vnder.
label: Daniel

text: Afterward I ſaw the ramme pushing with the hornes againſt the Weaſt, & againſt the North, and againſt the South: and al beaſts could not reſiſt him, nor be deliuered out of his hand: and he did according to his wil, & was magnified.
label: Daniel

text: And I vnderſtood: and behold a buckgoate came from the Weſt vpon the face of the whole earth, & he touched not the ground. Moreouer the buckgoate had a notable horne betwen his eyes:
label: Daniel

text: And he came euen to that ramme with the hornes, which I had ſene ſtanding before the gate, & he ranne towards him in the violence of his ſtrength.
label: Daniel

text: And when he had approched nere the ramme, he was wood againſt him, and ſtroke the ramme: and he brake his two hornes, and the ramme could not reſiſt him: and when he had caſt him on the ground, he trode him, and no man could deliuer the ramme out of his hand.
label: Daniel

text: And the buckgoate became exceding great: and when he was growne, the great horne was broken, and there roſe vp foure hornes vnder it by the foure windes of heauen.
label: Daniel

text: And out of one of them came forth one litle horne: and it was made great againſt the South, and againſt the Eaſt, and againſt the ſtrength.
label: Daniel

text: And it was magnified euen vnto the ſtrength of heauen: and it threw downe of the ſtrength, and of the ſtarres, and trode them.
label: Daniel

text: And it was magnified euen vnto the prince of the ſtrength: and from him it tooke the continual ſacrifice, and threw downe the place of his ſanctification.
label: Daniel

text: And ſtrength was geuen againſt the continual ſacrifice becauſe of ſinnes: and truth shal be throwen proſtrate on the ground, and he shal doe, and shal proſper.
label: Daniel

text: And I heard one of the ſaincts ſpeaking, & one ſainte ſayd to an other, I know not to whom that ſpake: How long the viſion, and the continual ſacrifice, and the ſinne of the deſolation that is made: and the ſanctuarie, and the ſtrength shal be conculcate?
label: Daniel

text: And he ſayd to him: Vnto the euening & morning, two thouſand three hundred: & the ſanctuarie shal be clenſed.
label: Daniel

text: And it came to paſſe when I Daniel ſaw the viſion, and ſought the vnderſtanding: behold there ſtood in my ſight as it were the forme of a man.
label: Daniel

text: And I heard the voice of a man betwen the bankes of Vlai: and he cried, and ſayd: Gabriel make this man vnderſtand the viſion.
label: Daniel

text: And he came and ſtood nere where I ſtoood: and when he was come, trembling I fel on my face, & he ſayd to me: Vnderſtand ſonne of man, that in the time of the end the viſion shal be accomplished.
label: Daniel

text: And when he ſpake to me I fel flat on the ground: and he touched me, and ſette me vp in my ſtanding,
label: Daniel

text: and ſayd to me: I wil shew thee what thinges are to come in the laſt of the malediction: becauſe the time hath his end.
label: Daniel

text: The ramme, which thou ſaweſt haue hornes, is the king of the Medes and Perſians.
label: Daniel

text: Moreouer the buckgoate, is the king of the Græcians, and the great horne, that was betwen his eyes, the ſame is the firſt king.
label: Daniel

text: But wheras that being broken, there roſe vp foure for it: foure kinges shal riſe vp of his nation, but not in his ſtrength.
label: Daniel

text: And after their reigne, when iniquities shal be increaſed, there shal ariſe a king impudent of face, and vnderſtanding propoſitions.
label: Daniel

text: And his ſtrength shal be made ſtrong, but not in his owne ſtrength: and more then can be beleued, shal he waſte al thinges, and shal proſper, and doe. And he shal kil the ſtrong, and the people of the ſaints
label: Daniel

text: according to his wil, and craft shal be directed in his hand: and he shal magnifie his hart, and in the abundance of al thinges he shal murder very manie: & agaynſt the prince of princes shal he ariſe, & without hand he shal be deſtroyed.
label: Daniel

text: & the viſion of the euening and the morning, which hath bene ſayd, is true: thou therfore ſeale the viſion, becauſe it shal be after manie dayes.
label: Daniel

text: And I Daniel languished, and was ſicke for certaine dayes: and when I was riſen vp, I did the kings workes, and was aſtonied at the viſion, and there was none that could interprete it.
label: Daniel

text: IN the firſt yeare of Darius the ſonne of Aſſuerus of the ſeede of the Medes, who reigned ouer the kingdom of the Chaldees:
label: Daniel

text: the firſt yeare of his kingdom, I Daniel vnderſtood in bookes the number of the yeares, wherof the word of our Lord was made to Ieremie the prophete, that ſeuentie yeares should be accomplished of the deſolation of Ieruſalem.
label: Daniel

text: And I ſette my face to our Lord my God to pray and beſech in faſtinges, ſackcloth, and ashes.
label: Daniel

text: And I prayed our Lord my God, and I confeſſed, and ſaid: I beſech thee ô Lord God great and terrible, which keepeſt couenant, & mercie to them that loue thee, and keepe thy commandements.
label: Daniel

text: We haue ſinned, we haue done iniquitie, we haue dealt impiouſly, and haue reuolted: & we haue declined from thy commandments, and iudgements.
label: Daniel

text: We haue not obeyed thy ſeruants the prophets, that haue ſpoken in thy name to our kinges, to our princes, to our fathers, and to al the people of the land.
label: Daniel

text: To thee ô Lord, iuſtice: but to vs confuſion of face, as is to day to the man of Iuda, and to the inhabiters of Ieruſalem, and to al Iſrael, to them that are nere, and to them that are farre of in al the landes, to which thou haſt caſt them out, for their iniquities in which they haue ſinned againſt thee.
label: Daniel

text: O Lord, to vs confuſion of face, to our princes, & to our fathers that haue ſinned.
label: Daniel

text: But to thee Lord our God mercie and propiciation, becauſe we haue reuolted from the:
label: Daniel

text: and haue not heard the voice of the Lord our God, to walke in his law, which he gaue vs by his ſeruants the prophetes.
label: Daniel

text: And al Iſrael haue tranſgreſſed thy law, and haue declined from hearing thy voice, and the malediction hath diſtilled vpon vs, & the deteſtation, which is written in the booke of Moyſes the ſeruant of God, becauſe we haue ſinned to him.
label: Daniel

text: And he hath eſtablished his wordes, which he ſpake vpon vs, and vpon our princes, that iudged vs, that he would bring in vpon vs a great euil, ſuch as neuer was vnder al the heauen, according to that which hath bene done in Ierſalem.
label: Daniel

text: As it is written in the law of Moyſes, al this euil is come vpon vs: and we beſought not thy face ô Lord our God, that we might returne from our iniquities, & might thinke on thy truth.
label: Daniel

text: And our Lord hath watched vpon the malice, and hath brought it vpon vs: iuſt is the Lord our God in al his workes, which he hath done: for we haue not heard his voice.
label: Daniel

text: And now ô Lord our God, which broughteſt forth thy people out of the Land of Ægypt in a ſtrong hand, & madſt thee a name according to this day: we haue ſinned, we haue done iniquitie.
label: Daniel

text: O Lord according to al thy iuſtice, but let thy wrath be turned away I beſech thee, and thy furie from thy citie Ieruſalem, & from thy holie mount. For by reaſon of our ſinnes, and the iniquities of our fathers, Ieruſalem, and thy people are a reproch to al round about vs.
label: Daniel

text: Now therfore heare ô our God the petition of thy ſeruant, & his prayers: and shew thy face vpon thy ſanctuarie, which is deſert, for thyne owne ſake.
label: Daniel

text: Incline my God thine eare, & heare: open thine eyes, and ſee our deſolation, & the citie vpon which thy name is inuocated: for neither in our iuſtifications doe we proſtrate prayers before thy face, but in thy manie commiſerations.
label: Daniel

text: Heare ô Lord, be pacified ô Lord: attend & doe, delay not for thine owne ſake my God: becauſe thy name is inuocated vpon thy citie, & vpon thy people.
label: Daniel

text: And when I yet ſpake, & prayed, and confeſſed my ſinnes, and the ſinnes of my people of Iſrael, and did proſtrate my prayers in the ſight of my God, for the holie mount of my God:
label: Daniel

text: as I was yet ſpeaking in prayer, loe the man Gabriel, whom I had ſene in the viſion from the beginning, quickly flying touched me in the time of the euening ſacrifice.
label: Daniel

text: And he taught me, and ſpake to me, & ſayd: Daniel now am I come forth to teach thee, and that thou mighſt vnderſtand.
label: Daniel

text: From the beginning of thy prayers the word came forth: and I am come to shew it to thee, becauſe thou art a man of deſires: and doe thou marke the word, and vnderſtand the viſion.
label: Daniel

text: Seuentie weekes are abbridged vpon thy people, & vpon thy holie citie, that preuarication may be conſummate, and ſinne take an end, & iniquitie be abolished; and euerlaſting iuſtice be brought; & viſion be accomplished, and prophecie; & the Holie one of holies be anointed.
label: Daniel

text: Know therfore, & marke: From the going forth of the word, that Ieruſalem be built againe, vnto Chriſt the prince, there shal be ſeuen weekes, & ſixtie two weekes, & the ſtreete shal be built againe, & the walles in ſtraitnes of the times.
label: Daniel

text: And after ſixty two weekes Chriſt shal be ſlaine: and it shal not be his people, that shal denie him. And the citie, & the ſanctuary shal the people diſſipate with the prince to come: & the end therof waſte, & after the end of the battel the appoynted deſolation.
label: Daniel

text: And he wil confirme the couenant to manie, one weeke: and in the halfe of the weeke shal the hoſte & the ſacrifice fayle: and there shal be in the temple the abomination of deſolation: & euen to the conſummation, and to the end shal the deſolation endure.
label: Daniel

text: IN the third yeare of Cyrus king of the Perſians, a word was reueled to Daniel ſurnamed Baltaſſar, and a true word, and great ſtrength: & he vnderſtood the word: for there is neede of vnderſtanding in viſion.
label: Daniel

text: In thoſe dayes I Daniel mourned the dayes of three weekes,
label: Daniel
