text: deſiderable bread I did not eate, and flesh and wine entered not into my mouth, yea neither with ointment was I annoynted: til the dayes of three weeks were accomplished.
label: Daniel

text: And in the foure & twentith day of the firſt moneth I was by the great riuer, which is Tigris.
label: Daniel

text: And I lifted vp mine eyes, & I ſaw: and beholde a man clothed with linnen clothes, & his reynes girded with the fineſt gold:
label: Daniel

text: and his bodie as it were the chryſolithus, and his face as the forme of lightning, and his eyes as a burning lampe: and his armes, & the partes that are downward euen to the feete, as it were the forme of gliſtering braſſe: and the voice of his word as the voice of a multitude.
label: Daniel

text: And I Daniel alone ſaw the viſion: moreouer the men that were with me, ſaw it not, but exceding terrour fel vpon them, and they fled away, and hidde themſelues.
label: Daniel

text: And I being left alone ſaw this great viſion: and there remayned no ſtrength in me, yea and my shape of contenance was changed in me, and I withered, neither had any ſtrength.
label: Daniel

text: And I heard the voice of his wordes: and hearing I lay aſtonished vpon my face, and my viſage cleaued to the ground.
label: Daniel

text: And behold a hand touched me, and lifted me vp vpon my knees, and vpon the ioynts of any handes.
label: Daniel

text: And he ſaid to me: Daniel thou man of deſires, vnderſtand the wordes, that I ſpeake to thee, and ſtand in thy place: for now am I ſent to thee. And when he had ſaid this word to me, I ſtood trembling.
label: Daniel

text: And he ſaid to me: Feare not Daniel: becauſe ſince the firſt day that thou didſt ſet thy hart to vnderſtand to afflict thy ſelf in the ſight of thy God, thy wordes haue bene heard: and I am come for thy wordes.
label: Daniel

text: But the prince of the kingdom of the Perſians reſiſted me one and twentie dayes: and behold Michael one of the chiefe princes came to ayde me, and I taried there by the king of the Perſians.
label: Daniel

text: But I am come to teach thee what thinges shal come to thy people in the later dayes, becauſe as yet the viſion vnto dayes.
label: Daniel

text: And when he ſpake to me in theſe maner of wordes, I caſt downe my countenance to the ground, and held my peace.
label: Daniel

text: And behold as it were the ſimilitude of the ſonne of man touched my lippes, and opening my mouth I ſpake, and ſayd to him, that ſtood before me: My Lord, in thy viſion my ioynts are diſſolued, and no ſtrength hath remayned in me.
label: Daniel

text: And how can the ſeruant of my Lord ſpeake with my Lord? for no ſtrength is remayning in me, yea & my breath is ſtopped.
label: Daniel

text: Agayne therfore there touched me as it were the viſion of a man, and ſtrengthened me,
label: Daniel

text: and he ſayd: Feare not ô man of deſires, Peace be to thee: take courege & be ſtrong. And when he ſpake with me, I receiued ſtrength, and ſayd: Speake my Lord, becauſe thou haſt ſtrengthened me.
label: Daniel

text: And he ſayd: Doeſt thou know wherfore I am come to thee? and now I wil returne, that I may fight agaynſt the prince of the Perſians. when I therfore went forth, there appeared the prince of the Greekes coming.
label: Daniel

text: Bnt yet I wil tel thee that which is expreſſed in the ſcripture of truth: and none is my helper in al theſe, but Michael your prince.
label: Daniel

text: AND I from the firſt yeare of Darius the Mede ſtood that he might be ſtrengthened, and made ſtrong.
label: Daniel

text: And now I wil declare the truth vnto thee. Behold three kinges as yet shal ſtand in Perſia, and the fourth shal be inriched with exceding riches aboue al: & when he is growne mightie in his riches, he shal rayſe vp al againſt the kingdom of Greece.
label: Daniel

text: But there shal riſe a ſtrong king, and shal rule with much power: and he shal doe what shal pleaſe him.
label: Daniel

text: And when he shal ſtand, his kingdom shal be broken, and it shal be diuided into the foure windes of heauen: but not vnto his poſteritie, nor according to his mightines wherwith he ruled. For his kingdom shal be rent euen vnto foreners, beſyde theſe.
label: Daniel

text: And the king of the South shal be made ſtrong, & there shal of his princes preuaile aboue him, and he shal rule in dominion: for his dominion shal be much.
label: Daniel

text: And after the end of yeares they shal be confederated: and the daughter of the king of the South shal come to the king of the North to make amitie, and shal not obtayne the ſtrength of the arme, neither shal his ſede ſtand: and she shal be deliuered, and they that brought her, her yongmen and they that ſtrengthened her in the times.
label: Daniel

text: And there shal ſtand of the bud of her rootes a plant: and he shal come with an armie, and shal enter the prouince of the king of the North: and he shal abuſe them, and shal obtayne.
label: Daniel

text: Moreouer alſo their goddes, and ſculptils, the precious veſſels alſo of gold, and ſiluer, he shal carie away captiue into Ægypt: he shal preuaile againſt the king of the North.
label: Daniel

text: And the king of the South shal enter into the kingdom, and shal returne to his owne land.
label: Daniel

text: And his ſonnes shal be prouoked, and they shal gather a multitude of very manie hoſtes: and he shal come haſtning, and ouerflowing: and he shal returne and be ſtirred vp, and he shal ioyne battel with his force.
label: Daniel

text: And the king of the South being prouoked shal goe forth, and shal fight againſt the king of the North, & shal prepare an exceding great multitude, and a multitude shal be geuen into his handes.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal take a multitude, and his hart shal be exalted, and he shal ouerthrow manie thouſands: but he shal not preuaile.
label: Daniel

text: For the king of the North shal returne, and shal prepare a multitude much greater then before: & in the end of times, & yeares, he shal come haſtining with a great hoſt, and riches exceding much.
label: Daniel

text: And in thoſe times manie shal riſe vp againſt the king of the South: the children alſo of the preuaricatours of thy people shal be extolled to fulfil the viſion, and they shal fal.
label: Daniel

text: And the king of the North shal come, and shal caſt vp a mount, and shal take the beſt fenſed cities: & the armes of the South shal not ſuſteyne, and his choſen shal riſe vp to reſiſt, & there shal be no ſtrength.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal doe coming vpon him according to his pleaſure, and there shal be none to ſtand agaynſt his face: and he shal ſtand in a noble land, & it shal be conſumed in his hand.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal ſette his face to come to poſſeſſe al his kingdom, & he shal doe right thinges with him: and he shal geue vnto him a daughter of wemen, to ouerthrow it: and she shal not ſtand neither shal she be his.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal turne his face to the ilands, & shal take manie: and he shal make the prince of his reproche to ceaſe, and his reproch shal be returned vpon him.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal turne his face to the empire of his owne land, and he shal ſtumble, and fal, & shal not be found.
label: Daniel

text: And there shal ſtand in his place one moſt vile, & vnworthy of kingly honour: & in few dayes he shal be deſtroyed, not in furie nor in battel.
label: Daniel

text: And there shal ſtand in his place one deſpiſed, and kinglie honour shal not be geuen him: and he shal come ſecretly, and shal obteyne the kingdom by fraude.
label: Daniel

text: And the armes of him that fighteth shal be expugned from before his face, and shal be broken: moreouer alſo the prince of the league.
label: Daniel

text: And after the amities, he shal worke deceite with him: and he shal goe vp, and shal ouercome with few people.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal enter abundant and plentiful cities: & he shal doe thinges that his fathers neuer did, & his fathers fathers: their robberies, and pray, & riches he shal diſſipate, and shal deuiſe deuiſes againſt the beſt fenſed: and this vntil a time.
label: Daniel

text: And his ſtrength & his hart shal be ſtirred vp againſt the king of the South in a great armie: and the king of the South shal be prouoked to battel with manie aydes, and exceding ſtrong: & they shal not ſtand becauſe they shal take counſels againſt him.
label: Daniel

text: And they that eate bread with him, shal deſtroy him, and his armie shal be oppreſſed: & there shal fal ſlaine very manie.
label: Daniel

text: The hart alſo of the two kinges shal be to euil, and at one table they shal ſpeake lies, and they shal not proſper: becauſe as yet the end vnto an other time.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal returne into his land with much riches: and his hart againſt the holie teſtament, and he shal proſper and shal returne into his owne land.
label: Daniel

text: At the time appointed he shal returne, and he shal come to the South, and the later end shal not be like to the former.
label: Daniel

text: And there shal come vpon him galleis, and the Romanes, and he shal be ſtrooken, and shal returne, and shal frette againſt the teſtament of the ſanctuarie, and he shal ſpede: and shal returne, and shal deuiſe againſt them, that haue forſaken the teſtament of the ſanctuarie.
label: Daniel

text: And of him shal ſtand armes, and shal pollute the ſanctuarie of ſtrength, and shal take away the continual ſacrifice: and they shal geue abomination into deſolation.
label: Daniel

text: And the impious againſt the teſtament shal diſſemble fraudulently: but mthe people that knoweth their God, shal obtayne, and shal doe.
label: Daniel

text: And the learned in the people shal teach very manie: and they shal fal by ſword, and by flame, and by captiuitie, and by ſpoyle of dayes.
label: Daniel

text: And when they are fallen, they shal be releeued with a litle ayde: and very manie shal be ioyned to them faynedly.
label: Daniel

text: And of the learned there shal fal, that they may be tried, and may be choſen, and made white euen to the time prefixed: becauſe yet there shal be an other time.
label: Daniel

text: And the king shal doe according to his wil, and shal be eleuated, & magnified againſt euerie god: and againſt the God of goddes he shal ſpeake magnifical thinges, & shal be directed, til the wrath be accomplished. for the determination is made.
label: Daniel

text: And the God of his fathers he shal not account of: and he shal be in the concupiſcences of wemen, neither shal be care for anie of the goddes: becauſe he shal ryſe vp againſt al thinges.
label: Daniel

text: But god Maozim he shal worshipe in his place: and the God whom his fathers knewe not, he shal worshipe with gold, and ſiluer, and precious ſtone, and precious thinges.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal doe it to fenſe Maôzim with a ſtrange god, whom he acknowledged, and he shal multiplie glorie, and shal geue them powre in manie, and shal diuide the land gratis.
label: Daniel

text: And in the time prefixed shal the king of the South make battel againſt him, & as a tempeſt shal the king of the North come againſt him in charets, and in horſemen, and in a great nauie, and he shal enter the landes, and shal deſtroy, and paſſe through.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal enter into the glorious land, and manie shal fal: but theſe onlie shal be ſaued out of his hand, Edom, and Moab, and the beginning of the children of Ammon.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal lay his hand vpon the landes: and the Land of Æygpt shal not eſcape.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal rule ouer the treaſures of gold, and of ſiluer, and in al the precious thinges of Ægypt: through Lybia alſo, and Æthyopia he shal paſſe.
label: Daniel

text: And a bruite shal truble him from the Eaſt, and from the North: and he shal come in a great multitude to deſtroy and kil very manie.
label: Daniel

text: And he shal pitche his tabernacle Apadno betwen the ſeas, vpon a mount glorious and holie: and he shal come euen to the toppe therof, and no man shal helpe him.
label: Daniel

text: BVT in that time shal riſe vp Michael the great prince, who ſtandeth for the children of thy people: and a time shal come ſuch as hath not beene from the time ſince nations begane euen vntil that time. And in that time shal thy people be ſaued, euerie one that shal be found writen in the booke.
label: Daniel

text: And manie of thoſe, that ſleepe in the duſt of the earth, shal awake: ſome vnto life euerlaſting, & others vnto reproch to ſee it alwayes.
label: Daniel

text: But they that be learned shal shine as the brightnes of the firmament: and they that inſtruct many to iuſtice, as ſtarres vnto perpetual eternities.
label: Daniel

text: But thou Daniel shut vp the wordes, and ſeale the booke, euen to the time appointed: verie manie shal paſſe ouer, and there shal be manifeſt knowlege.
label: Daniel

text: And I Daniel ſaw, and behold there ſtood as it were two others: one on this ſide vpon the banke of the riuer, and an other on that ſide, on the other banke of the riuer.
label: Daniel

text: ¶ And I ſayd to the man, that was clothed with linen garments, that ſtood vpon the waters of the riuer: How long the end of theſe meruels?
label: Daniel

text: And I heard the man, that was clothed with the linen garments, that ſtood vpon the waters of the riuer, when he had lifted vp his right hand, & his left hand vnto heauen, and had ſworne by him that liueth for euer, that vnto a time, & times, & the halfe of a time. And when the diſperſion of the hand of the holie people shal be accomplished, al theſe thinges shal be accomplished.
label: Daniel

text: And I heard, & vnderſtood not. And I ſayd: My Lord, what shal be after theſe things?
label: Daniel

text: And he ſaid? Goe Daniel, becauſe the wordes are shut vp, and ſealed vntil the prefixed time.
label: Daniel

text: Manie shal be choſen, and made white, & shal be tried as fyre: and the impious shal doe impiouſely, neither shal al the impious vnderſtand, but the learned shal vnderſtand.
label: Daniel

text: And from the time when the continual ſacrifice shal be taken away, and the abomination to deſolation shal be ſet vp, a thouſand two hundred ninetie dayes.
label: Daniel

text: Bleſſed is he that expecteth, and cometh vnto dayes a thouſand three hundred thirtie fiue.
label: Daniel

text: But thou goe, vntil the time prefixed: and thou shalt reſt, and ſtand in thy lotte vnto the end of the dayes.
label: Daniel

text: AND there was a man dwelling in Babylon, and this name Ioakim:
label: Daniel

text: & he tooke a wife named Suſanna, the daughter of Helcias exceding fayre, and fearing God.
label: Daniel

text: For her parents being iuſt, inſtructed their daughter according to the law of Moyſes.
label: Daniel

text: And Ioakim was very rich, and he had an orchard nere vnto his houſe: and to him the Iewes reſorted together, becauſe he was the more honorable of al.
label: Daniel

text: And there were two ancients appointed iudges in that yeare, of whom our Lord ſpake: That iniquities came out of Babylon from the ſeniour iudges, that ſemed to rule the people.
label: Daniel

text: Theſe frequented the houſe of Ioakim, and al that had iudgements came to them.
label: Daniel

text: And when the people returned at noone, Suſanna went in, and walked in her husbands orchard.
label: Daniel

text: and the ancients ſaw her dayly going in, and walking: and they were inflamed to the concupiſcence of her:
label: Daniel

text: and they ſubuerted their ſenſe, and declined their eyes that they would not ſee heauen, nor remember iuſt iudgements.
label: Daniel

text: They were both therfore wounded with the loue of her, neither did they shew their griefe one to the other:
label: Daniel

text: for they were ashamed to shew one an other their concupiſcence, being deſirous to lie with her:
label: Daniel

text: and they watched euerie day carefully to ſee her. And one ſayd to the other:
label: Daniel

text: Let vs goe home, becauſe it is the houre of dinner. And going forth they departed one from an other.
label: Daniel

text: And when they were returned, they came into one place: and asking of each other the cauſe, they confeſſed their concupiſcence: and then in commune they appoynted a time, when they might fynd her alone.
label: Daniel

text: And it came to paſſe, when they obſerued a fitte day, she went in on a time as yeſterday and the day before, with two maydes onlie, & would be washed in the orchard: for it was an hote ſeaſon.
label: Daniel

text: And there was none there, but the two ancients hid, & beholding her.
label: Daniel

text: She therfore ſayd to the maydes: Fetch me oile, and washing balles, and shut the doores of the orchard, that I may be washed.
label: Daniel

text: And they did as she had commanded: and they shut the doores of the orchard, and went out by a backe doore to fetch the thing that she had commanded. and they knew not that the ancients were hid within.
label: Daniel

text: But when the maydes were gone forth, the two ancients aroſe, and ranne to her, and ſayd:
label: Daniel

text: Loe the doores of the orchard be shut, and no bodie ſeeth vs, and we are in the concupiſcence of thee: wherfore conſent to vs, and lie with vs.
label: Daniel

text: and if thou wilt not, we wil geue teſtimonie againſt thee, that there was a yong man with thee, and for this cauſe thou didſt ſend out thy maydes from thee.
label: Daniel

text: Suſanna ſighed, and ſayd: Perplexities are to me on euerie ſide: for if I shal doe this, it is death to me: and if I doe it not, I shal not eſcape your handes.
label: Daniel

text: But it is better for me without the act to fal into your handes, then to ſinne in the ſight of our Lord.
label: Daniel

text: And Suſanna cried out with a lowd voice: but the ancients alſo cried out againſt her.
label: Daniel

text: And one ranne to the doore of the orchard, and opened it.
label: Daniel

text: when the ſeruants therfore of the houſe had heard the crie in the orchard, they rushed in by the backe doore, to ſee what it was.
label: Daniel

text: And after the ancients ſpake, the ſeruants were ashamed excedingly: becauſe neuer had there bene ſuch a word ſayd of Suſanna. And the morow came.
label: Daniel

text: And when the people was come to Ioakim her husband, the two ancients alſo came ful of vniuſt cogitation againſt Suſanna, to put her to death.
label: Daniel

text: And they ſayd before the people: Send to Suſanna daughter of Helcias the wife of Ioakim. And forthwith they ſent.
label: Daniel

text: And she came with her parents, and children, and al her kinne.
label: Daniel

text: Moreouer Suſanna was exceding delicate, and beautiful of face.
label: Daniel

text: But thoſe wicked men commanded that she should be vncouered (for she whas couered) that ſo at leaſt they might be ſatisfied with her beautie.
label: Daniel

text: Her frendes therfore wept, & al that had knowne her.
label: Daniel

text: But the two ancients ryſing vp in the middes of the people, layd their handes vpon her head.
label: Daniel

text: Who weeping looked vp to heauen, for her hart had confidence in our Lord.
label: Daniel

text: And the ancients ſayd: When we walked alone in the orchard, this woman came in with two maydes, & shut the doores of the orchard: and she ſent away the maydes from her.
label: Daniel

text: And a yongman that was hid came to her, and lay with her.
label: Daniel

text: But we being in a corner of the orchard, ſeeing the iniquitie, ranne to them, and ſaw them lie together.
label: Daniel

text: And him in deed we could not take, becauſe he was ſtronger then we, and opening the doores he lept out:
label: Daniel

text: but her when we apprehended, we asked what yongman it was, and she would not tel vs, of this thing we are witneſſes.
label: Daniel

text: The multitude beleued them as the ancients and the iudges of the people, and they condemned her to death.
label: Daniel

text: But Suſanna cried out with a lowd voice, and ſayd: Eternal God, which art the knower of hidden things before they come to paſſe,
label: Daniel

text: thou knoweſt that they haue borne falſe witnes againſt me: and loe I dye, wheras I haue done none of theſe thinges, which theſe men haue maliciouſely forged againſt me.
label: Daniel

text: And our Lord heard her voice.
label: Daniel

text: and when she was led to death, our Lord rayſed vp the holie ſpirit of a yong boy, whoſe name was Daniel:
label: Daniel

text: and he cried out with a lowd voice: I am cleane from the bloud of this woman.
label: Daniel

text: And al the people turning to him, ſayd: What is this word, that thou haſt ſpoken?
label: Daniel

text: Who when he ſtood in the middes of them, ſayd: So folish ye children of Iſrael, not iudgeing, nor diſcerning that which is the truth, haue you condemned the daughter of Iſrael?
label: Daniel

text: Returne ye to iudgement, becauſe they haue ſpoken falſe teſtimonie againſt her.
label: Daniel

text: The people therfore returned with ſpeede, and the ancients ſayd to him: Come, and ſitte in the middes of vs, and tel vs: becauſe God hath geuen thee the honour of old age.
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel ſayd to the people: Separate them far one from an other, and I wil diſcouer them.
label: Daniel

text: When they were therfore diuided one from the other, he called one of them, and ſaid to him: O thou inueterated of euil dayes, now are thy ſinnes come, which thou didſt committe before:
label: Daniel

text: iudging vniuſt iudgements, oppreſſing innocents, and diſmiſſing offenders, our Lord ſaying: The innocent and the iuſt thou shalt not kil.
label: Daniel

text: Now then if thou ſaweſt her, tel vnder what tree thou ſaweſt them talking together. Who ſayd: Vnder a ſchine tree.
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel ſayd: Wel haſt thou lyed agaynſt thine owne head: for behold the Angel of God taking the ſentence of him, shal cut thee in the middes.
label: Daniel

text: And remouing him away, he commanded that the other should come, and he ſayd to him: Seede of Chanaan, and not of Iuda, beautie hath deceiued thee, and concupiſcence hath ſubuerted thy hart:
label: Daniel

text: ſo did you to the daughters of Iſrael, and they fearing ſpake to you: but the daughter of Iuda did not abide your iniquitie.
label: Daniel

text: Now therfore tel me, vnder what tree thou tookeſt them ſpeaking one to an other. Who ſaid: Vnder a prine tree.
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel ſaid to him: Wel haſt thou alſo lyed againſt thine owne head: for the Angel of our Lord tarieth, hauing a ſword, that he may cut thee in the middes, and kil you.
label: Daniel

text: Therfore al the aſſemblie cried out with a lowd voice, and they bleſſed God, which ſaueth them that hope in him.
label: Daniel

text: And they roſe vp againſt the two elders. (for Daniel had conuinced them by their owne mouth to haue geuen falſe teſtimonie) and they did to them as they had dealt naughtely againſt their neighbour,
label: Daniel

text: to doe according to the law of Moyſes: & they killed them, and innocent bloud was ſaued in that day.
label: Daniel

text: But Helcias, and his wyfe prayſed God, for their daughter Suſanna, with Ioakim her husband, and al her kinne, becauſe there was no vnhoneſt thing found in her.
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel became great in the ſight of the people from that day, & thence forward.
label: Daniel

text: And king Aſtyages was layd to his fathers, & Cyrus the Perſian receiued his kingdom.
label: Daniel

text: AND Daniel was the kings gheſt, and honoured aboue al his freindes.
label: Daniel

text: There was alſo an idol among the Babylonians named Bel: and there were beſtowed on him euerie day of floure twelue arctabaes, and fourtie sheepe, and of wine ſix great pottes.
label: Daniel

text: The king alſo did worshipe him, and went euery day to adore him: But Daniel adored his God. & the king ſayd to him: Why doſt thou not adore Bel.
label: Daniel

text: Who anſwering, ſayd to him: Becauſe I worshipe, not idols made with hand, but the liuing God, that created heauen, and earth, and hath powre ouer al flesh.
label: Daniel

text: And the king ſayd to him: Doeth not Bel ſeme vnto thee to be a liuing God? Seeſt thou not how much he eateth and drinketh euerie day?
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel ſmiling ſayd: Be not deceiued ô king: For this ſame is within of clay, and without of braſſe, neither hath he eaten at any time.
label: Daniel

text: And the king being wrath called his prieſts, & ſayd to them: Vnleſſe you tel me, who it is that eateth theſe expenſes, you shal dye.
label: Daniel

text: But if you shew, that Bel eateth theſe things Daniel shal dye, becauſe he hath blaſphemed againſt Bel. And Daniel ſayd to the king: Be it done according to thy woord.
label: Daniel

text: And the prieſts of Bel were ſeuentie, beſide their wiues, and litle ones, & children. And the king came with Daniel into the temple of Bel.
label: Daniel

text: And the prieſtes of Bel ſayd: Behold we goe forth: & thou ô king ſet the meates, & mingle the wine, & shut the doore, & ſeale it with thy ring:
label: Daniel

text: and when thou shalt come in the morning, vnles thou finde al eaten of Bel, dying we wil dye, or Daniel that hath lyed againſt vs.
label: Daniel

text: And they contemned, becauſe they had made vnder the table a ſecrete entrance, & by it they came in alwayes, and deuoured thoſe thinges.
label: Daniel

text: It came to paſſe therfore after they were gone out, the king ſet the meates before Bel: & Daniel commanded his ſeruants, and they brought ashes, and he ſifted them ouer al the temple before the king: and going forth they shut the doore, and ſealing it with the kings ring, they departed.
label: Daniel

text: But the prieſtes went in by night, according to their cuſtome, and their wiues, and their children: and they did eate, and drinke al.
label: Daniel

text: And the king aroſe in the firſt breake of day, and Daniel with him.
label: Daniel

text: And the king ſayd: Are the ſeales ſafe, Daniel? Who anſwered: Safe ô king.
label: Daniel

text: And forthwith when he had opened the doore, the king looking on the table, cried out with a lowd voice: Great art thou ô Bel, and there is not any deceite with thee.
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel laughed: and he held the king that he should not goe in: and he ſayd: Behold the pauement, marke whoſe ſteppes theſe are.
label: Daniel

text: And the king ſayd: I ſee the ſteppes of men, & wemen, and of infantes. And the king was angrie.
label: Daniel

text: Then apprehended he the prieſts, & their wiues, & their children: and they shewed him ſecrete litle doores by which they came in, & conſumed the thinges that were on the table.
label: Daniel

text: The king therfore ſlewe them, & he deliuered Bel into the powre of Daniel: who ouerthrewe him, & his temple.
label: Daniel

text: And there was a great dragon in that place, & the Babylonians worshipped him.
label: Daniel

text: And the king ſayd to Daniel: Loe now thou canſt not ſay, that this ſame is not a liuing god: adore him therfore.
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel ſayd: The Lord my God I doe adore: becauſe he is the liuing God:
label: Daniel

text: but thou ô king geue me licence, and I wil kil the Dragon without ſword and clubbe. And the king ſayd: I geue thee licence.
label: Daniel

text: Daniel therfore tooke pitch, & fatte, and heares, and ſod them together: & he made lumpes, and gaue into the Dragons mouth, & the Dragon burſt in ſunder. And he ſayd: Loe whom you worshipped.
label: Daniel

text: Which when the Babylonians had heard, they were wrath excedingly: and being gathered together againſt the king, they ſaid: The king is become a Iewe. Bel he hath deſtroyed, the Dragon he hath killed, & he hath ſlaine the prieſts.
label: Daniel

text: And they ſayd when they were come to the king: Deliuer vs Daniel, otherwiſe we wil kil thee, & thy houſe.
label: Daniel

text: The king therfore ſaw that they preſſed vpon him vehemently: and compelled by neceſſity he deliuered Daniel to them.
label: Daniel

text: Who caſt him into the lake of lions, and he was there ſix dayes.
label: Daniel

text: Moreouer in the lake were ſeuen lions, & there were geuen to them two bodies euerie day, & two ſheepe: and they were not geuen vnto them, that they might deuoure Daniel.
label: Daniel

text: And there was Habacuc a prophete in Iewrie, & he had boyled broth, & had broken bread in a bowle: and he went into the field, to carie it to the reapers.
label: Daniel

text: And the Angel of our Lord ſayd to Habacuc: Carie the dinner which thou haſt, into Babylon to Daniel, who is in the lake of lions.
label: Daniel

text: And Habacuc ſayd: Lord, Babylon I haue not ſene, and the lake I know not.
label: Daniel

text: And the Angel of our Lord tooke him by the toppe of his head, and caried him by the heare of his head, & put him into Babylon ouer the lake in the force of his ſpirit.
label: Daniel

text: And Habacuc cried, ſaying: Daniel, take the dinner that God hath ſent to thee.
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel ſayd: Thou haſt remembred me ô God, and haſt not forſaken them that loue thee.
label: Daniel

text: And Daniel ryſing vp did eate. Moreouer the Angel of our Lord reſtored Habacuc forthwith in his place.
label: Daniel

text: The king therfore came the ſeuenth day to lament Daniel: and he came to the lake, and looked in, and behold Daniel ſitting in the middes of the lions.
label: Daniel

text: And the king cried out with a lowd voice, ſaying: Great art thou ô Lord the God of Daniel. And he drew him out of the lake of lions.
label: Daniel

text: But thoſe that had bene the cauſe of his perdition, he caſt into the lake, and they were deuoured in a moment before him.
label: Daniel

text: Then the king ſayd: Let al inhabitants in the whole earth feare the God of Daniel: becauſe he is the Sauiour, doing ſignes, & meruels in the earth: who hath deliuered Daniel out of the lions denne.
label: Daniel

text: THE word of our Lord, that was made to Oſee the ſonne of Beeri, in the dayes of Ozias, Ioathan, Achaz, Ezechias kinges of Iuda, and in the dayes of Ieroboam the ſonne of Ioas king of Iſrael.
label: Osee

text: The beginning to our Lord of ſpeaking in Oſee: and our Lord ſayd to Oſee: Goe, take thee a wife of fornications, and make children of fornications: becauſe the land fornicating shal fornicate from the Lord.
label: Osee

text: And he went, and tooke Gomer the daughter of Debelaim: and she conceiued, and bare him a ſonne.
label: Osee

text: And our Lord ſayd to him: Cal his name Iezrahel: becauſe yet a litle while, & I wil viſite the bloud of Iezrahel vpon the houſe of Iehu, and I wil make the kingdom of the houſe of Iſrael to ceaſe.
label: Osee

text: And in that day I wil breake the bow of Iſrael in the valley of Iezrahel.
label: Osee

text: And she conceiued yet agayne, and bare a daughter, & he ſayd to him: Cal her name, Without mercie: becauſe I wil adde no more to haue mercie on the houſe of Iſrael, but with obliuion I wil forget them.
label: Osee

text: And I wil haue mercie on the houſe of Iuda, and wil ſaue them in the Lord their God: & I wil not ſaue them in bow and ſword, and in battel, and in horſes, & in horſemen.
label: Osee

text: And she weyned her that was, Without mercie. And she conceiued, and bare a ſonne.
label: Osee

text: And he ſayd: Cal his name, Not my people: becauſe you not my people, and I wil not be yours.
label: Osee

text: And the number of the children of Iſrael shal be as the ſand of the ſea, that is without meaſure, and shal not be numbered. And it shal be in place where it shal be ſayd to them: Not my people you: it shal be ſayd to them: Children of the liuing God.
label: Osee

text: And the children of Iuda, and the children of Iſrael shal be gathered together: and they shal ſet to themſelues, one head, and shal aſcend out of the earth: becauſe great is the day of Iezrahel.
label: Osee

text: SAY ye to your bretheren: My people: & to your ſiſter, She that hath obteyned mercie.
label: Osee

text: Iudge your mother, iudge ye: becauſe she not my wife, and I not her husband. Let her take away her fornications from her face, and her adulteries from the middes of her breſts.
label: Osee

text: Leſt perhaps I ſtrippe her naked, and ſet her according to the day of her natiuitie: and I wil lay her as a wildernes, and wil ſet her as a land vnpaſſible, and wil kil her with drought.
label: Osee

text: And I wil not haue mercie on her children: becauſe they are the children of fornications,
label: Osee

text: becauſe their mother hath fornicated, she is confounded that conceiued them: becauſe she ſayd: I wil goe after my louers, that geue me my breads, and my waters, my wool, & my flaxe, mine oile, and my drinke.
label: Osee

text: For this behold I wil hedge thy way with thornes, and I wil hedge it with a wal, and she shal not finde her pathes.
label: Osee

text: And she shal folow her louers, & shal not ouertake them: and she shal ſeeke them, and shal not find, and she shal ſay: I wil goe, and wil returne to my former huſband: becauſe it was wel with me then, more then now.
label: Osee

text: And she did not know that I gaue her corne, and wine, and oile, and multiplied ſiluer vnto her, & gold, which they haue made to Baal.
label: Osee

text: Therfore wil I returne, and wil take my corne in his time, and my wine in his time, and I wil deliuer my wool, and my flaxe, which couered her ignominie.
label: Osee

text: And now I wil reuele her follie in the eyes of her louers: and there shal not a man deliuer her out of my hand:
label: Osee

text: and I wil make al her ioy to ceaſe, her ſolemnitie, her newmoone, her ſabbath, & al her feſtiual times.
label: Osee

text: And I wil deſtroy her vine, & her figtree: of which she ſaid: Theſe are my rewardes, which my louers haue geuen me: and I wil lay her as a forreſt, & the beaſt of the filde shal eate her.
label: Osee

text: And I wil viſite vpon her the dayes of Baalim, to whom she burnt incenſe, & was adorned with her earlet, and with her tablet, and went after her louers, & forgot me, ſayth our Lord.
label: Osee

text: For this, loe I wil allure her, & wil leade her into the wildernes: & I wil ſpeake to her hart.
label: Osee

text: And I wil geue her dreſſers of vines out of the ſame place, and the vale of Achor to open hope: and she shal ſing there according to the dayes of her youth, and according to the dayes of her aſcending out of the Land of Ægypt.
label: Osee

text: And it shal be in that day, ſaith our Lord: She shal cal me: My husband, and she shal cal me no more, Baalim.
label: Osee

text: And I wil take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and ſhe shal no more remember their name.
label: Osee

text: And I wil make with them a league in that day, with the beaſt of the filde, and with the foule of the heauen, and with that, which creepeth on the earth: and bow, and ſword, and battel I wil deſtroy out of the earth: and I wil make them ſleepe confidently.
label: Osee

text: And I wil deſpouſe thee to me for euer: and I wil deſpouſe thee to me in iuſtice, and iudgement, and in mercie, and in commiſerations.
label: Osee

text: And I wil deſpouſe thee to me in faith: and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.
label: Osee

text: And it shal be in that day: I wil heare, ſayth our Lord, I wil heare the heauens, and they shal heare the earth.
label: Osee

text: And the earth shal heare wheate, and wine, and oile: and theſe shal heare Iezrahel.
label: Osee

text: And I wil ſow her vnto me into the earth, and I wil haue mercie on her, that was Without mercie.
label: Osee

text: And I wil ſay to Not my people: My people art thou: and it shal ſay: Thou art my God.
label: Osee

text: AND our Lord ſayd to me: Yet againe goe, loue a woman beloued of her frend, and an aduoutreſſe; as our Lord loueth the children of Iſrael, and they haue reſpect to ſtrange goddes, and loue the kernels of grapes.
label: Osee

text: And I digged her vnto me for fiftene peeces of ſiluer, and for a core of barley, and for halfe a core of barley.
label: Osee

text: And I ſayd to her: Thou shalt expect me manie dayes: thou shalt not fornicate; & thou shalt be no mans: but I alſo wil expect thee.
label: Osee

text: Becauſe manie dayes shal the children of Iſrael ſit without king, & without prince, and without ſacrifice, and without altar, and without ephod, and without theraphim.
label: Osee

text: And after this the children of Iſrael shal returne, & shal ſeeke the Lord their God, and Dauid their king: and they shal dread at the Lord, and at his goodnes in the laſt dayes.
label: Osee

text: HEARE the word of our Lord ye children of Iſrael, becauſe there is iudgement to our Lord with the inhabitants of the land: for there is no truth, and there is no mercie, and there is no knowlege of God in the land.
label: Osee

text: Curſing, and lying, and manſlaughter, and theft, and aduoutrie haue ouerflowed, and bloud hath touched bloud.
label: Osee

text: For this shal the land moorne, and euerie one shal be weakened that dwelleth in it, in the beaſt of the filde, and in the foule of the heauen: yea and the fishes of the ſea shal be gathered together.
label: Osee

text: But yet let not euerie man iudge: and let not a man be rebuked: for thy people are as thoſe, that gayneſay the prieſt.
label: Osee

text: And thou shalt fal to day, and the prophete alſo shal fal with thee: in the night I made thy mother hold her peace.
label: Osee

text: My people haue held their peace, becauſe they had not knowlege: becauſe thou haſt repelled knowlege, I wil repel thee, that thou doe not the function of prieſthood vnto me: and thou haſt forgotten the law of thy God, I alſo wil forget thy children.
label: Osee

text: According to the multitude of them ſo haue they ſinned to me: their glorie I wil change into ignominie.
label: Osee

text: They shal eate the ſinnes of my people, and at their iniquitie shal lift vp their ſoules.
label: Osee

text: And as the people, ſo shal the prieſt be: & I wil viſite their wayes vpon them, and their cogitations I wil render to them.
label: Osee

text: And they shal eate and shal not be filled: they haue fornicated, and haue not ceaſed: becauſe they haue forſaken our Lord in not obſeruing.
label: Osee

text: Fornication, and wine, and drunkenes take away the hart.
label: Osee

text: My people hath asked in their wood, and their ſtaffe hath declared vnto them: for the ſpirit of fornications hath deceiued them, and they haue fornicated from their God.
label: Osee

text: Vpon the heads of mountaines they did ſacrifice, and vpon litle hilles they burnt incenſe: vnder the oke, and the poplartree, and the terebinth, becauſe the shadow therof was good: therfore shal your daughters fornicate, and your ſpouſes shal be aduoutreſſes.
label: Osee

text: I wil not viſite vpon your daughters when they shal fornicate, and vpon your ſpouſes when they shal commit aduoutrie: becauſe they themſelues conuerſt with harlots, and with the effeminate they did ſacrifice, and the people not vnderſtanding shal be beaten.
label: Osee

text: If thou fornicate fô Iſrael, at the leaſt let not Iuda offend: and enter ye not into Galgal, and goe not vp into Bethauen, neither ſweare ye: Our Lord liueth.
label: Osee

text: Becauſe Iſrael hath declined as a wanton cow: now wil our Lord feede them, as a lambe in latitude.
label: Osee

text: Ephraim is partaker of idols, let him alone.
label: Osee

text: Their banket is ſeparated, with fornication they haue fornicated: the protectours therof loued to bring ignominie.
label: Osee

text: The ſpirit hath bound him in his winges, and they shal be confounded at their ſacrifices.
label: Osee

text: HEARE ye this ô prieſtes, and attend ye houſe of Iſrael, and you the kinges houſe harken: becauſe there is iudgement for you, becauſe you are become a ſnare to ſpeculation, and a nette ſpred vpon Thabor.
label: Osee

text: And victims you haue declined into the depth: and I the teacher of them al.
label: Osee

text: I know Ephraim, and Iſrael is not hid from me: becauſe now hath Ephraim fornicated, Iſrael is contaminated.
label: Osee

text: They wil not geue their cogitations to returne to their God: becauſe the ſpirit of fornications is in the middes of them, and they haue not knowen the Lord.
label: Osee

text: And the arrogancie of Iſrael shal anſwere in his face: and Iſrael, and Ephraim shal fal in their iniquitie, Iudas alſo shal fal with them.
label: Osee

text: In their flockes, and in their heardes they shal goe to ſeeke the Lord, and shal not finde: he is taken away from them.
label: Osee

text: They haue preuaricated againſt the Lord, becauſe they haue begotten ſtrange children: now shal a moneth deuoure them with their partes.
label: Osee

text: Sound with the trumpet in Gabaa, and with the shaulme in Rama: howle ye in Bethauen, behind thy backe ô Beniamin.
label: Osee

text: Ephraim shal be in deſolation in the day of correction: in the tribes of Iſrael I haue shewed faith.
label: Osee

text: The princes of Iuda are become as they that take the bound: I wil power out my wrath as water vpon them.
label: Osee

text: Ephraim is ſuffering calumnie, broken in iudgement: becauſe he began to goe after filthines,
label: Osee

text: And I as it were a mothe to Ephraim: and as the rotte to the houſe of Iuda.
label: Osee

text: And Ephraim ſaw his ſicknes, and Iuda his band: and Ephraim went to Aſſur, and ſent to the king reuenger: and he shal not be able to heale you, neither shal he be able to looſe the band from you.
label: Osee

text: Becauſe I as it were a lioneſſe to Ephraim, and as a lions whelpe to the houſe of Iuda: I, I wil take, and goe: I wil take away, and there is none that can deliuer.
label: Osee

text: Going I wil returne to my place: vntil you fayle and ſeeke my face,
label: Osee

text: IN their tribulation early they wil riſe vp to me: Come, and let vs returne to our Lord.
label: Osee

text: Becauſe he hath wounded, and wil heale vs: he wil ſtrike, and wil cure vs.
label: Osee

text: He wil reuiue vs after two dayes: in the third day he wil raiſe vs vp, and we shal liue in his ſight. We shal know, and we shal folow, that we may know our Lord. As the morning light, is his coming forth prepared, and he wil come to vs as a shower timely, and late to the earth.
label: Osee

text: What shal I do to thee Ephraim? what shal I doe to thee Iuda? your mercie as a morning clowd, and as the dew paſſing away in the morning.
label: Osee

text: For this haue I hewed in prophets, I haue killed them in the wordes of my mouth: and thy iudgements shal come forth as the light.
label: Osee

text: Becauſe I would mercie, & not ſacrifice: and the knowlege of God more then holocauſts.
label: Osee

text: But they as Adam haue trangreſſed the couenant, there haue they preuaricated againſt me.
label: Osee

text: Galaad a citie of them that worke idol, ſupplanted with bloud.
label: Osee

text: And as it were the iawes of men that are robbers, partaker with the prieſts, of them that in the way kil thoſe that paſſe out of Sichem: becauſe they haue wrought wickednes.
label: Osee

text: In the houſe of Iſrael I ſaw an horrible thing: there the fornications of Ephraim: Iſrael is contaminated.
label: Osee

text: Yea and thou Iuda put thee an harueſt, when I shal conuert the captiuitie of my people.
label: Osee

text: WHEN I would heale Iſrael, the iniquitie of Ephraim was reueled, and the malice of Samaria, becauſe they haue wrought lying, and the theefe hath entered in ſpoyling, the robber without.
label: Osee

text: And leſt perhaps they may ſay in their hartes, that I haue remembred al their malice: now haue their owne inuentions compaſſed them, they haue bene done before me.
label: Osee

text: In their malice they haue reioyced the king: and in their lies the princes.
label: Osee

text: Al they committing aduoutrie, as it were an ouen heated of the baker: the citie was quiet a litle from the comiſtion of leauen, til the whole was leuened.
label: Osee

text: The day of our king, the princes begane to rage by reaſon of wine: he ſtreched out his hand with the ſcorners.
label: Osee

text: Becauſe they haue applied their hart as an ouen, when he lay in wayte for them: he ſlept al the night baking them, in the morning himſelf heated as a fire of flame.
label: Osee

text: Al were heated as an ouen, and haue deuoured their iudges: al their kinges are fallen: there is none amongſt them that crieth vnto me.
label: Osee

text: Ephraim him ſelf was mingled in the peoples: Ephraim is become as harth-baken-bread, that is not turned.
label: Osee

text: Strangers haue eaten his ſtrength, and he knew not: yea hore heares alſo were powred out on him, and he was ignorant.
label: Osee

text: And the pride of Iſrael shal be humbled in his face: neither did they returne to the Lord their God, & they haue not ſought him in al theſe.
label: Osee

text: And Ephraim is become as a doue ſeduced, not hauing an hart: they inuocated Ægypt, they went to the Aſſyrians.
label: Osee

text: And when they shal goe forth, I wil ſpred my nette vpon them: as a foule of the heauen wil I plucke them downe, I wil beate them according to the hearing of their aſſemblie.
label: Osee

text: Wo to them, becauſe they haue reuolted from me: they shal be waſted becauſe they haue preuaricated againſt me: & I redemed them and they haue ſpoken lies againſt me.
label: Osee

text: And they haue not cried to me in their hart, but they howled in their chambers: vpon wheate and wine they chewed the cudde, they are reuolted from me.
label: Osee

text: And I haue taught them, and ſtrengthened their armes: and againſt me they haue thought malice.
label: Osee

text: They returned, that they might be without yoke: they became as a deceitful bow: their princes shal fal by the ſword, for the furie of their tongue. This is their ſcorning in the Land of Ægypt.
label: Osee

text: IN thy throte let there be a trumpet as an eagle vpon the houſe of the Lord: for that they haue tranſgreſſed my couenant, and haue preuaricated my law.
label: Osee

text: Me they shal inuocate: My God, we Iſrael haue knowen thee.
label: Osee

text: Iſrael hath caſt away the good thing, the enemie shal perſecute him.
label: Osee

text: They haue reigned, and not of me: they haue bene princes, and I knew not: their ſiluer, and their gold they made idols to themſelues, that they might perish.
label: Osee

text: Thy calfe is caſt of ô Samaria, my furie is wrath againſt them. How long can they not be clenſed?
label: Osee

text: Becauſe it ſelf alſo is of Iſrael: the workman made it, and it is not God: becauſe the calfe of Samaria shal be as ſpiders webbes.
label: Osee

text: Becauſe they shal ſow winde, and reape a whirlewind: there is no ſtanding ſtalke in it, the bud shal not yeld meale: and if it doe yeld, ſtrangers shal eate it.
label: Osee

text: Iſrael is deuoured: Now is he become in nations as an vncleane veſſel.
label: Osee

text: Becauſe they went vp to Aſſur, a wilde aſſe ſolitarie to himſelf: Ephraim haue geuen gifts to louers.
label: Osee

text: Yea and when they shal hyre the nations with reward, now wil I gather them together: and they shal reſt a while from the burden of the king, and the princes.
label: Osee

text: Becauſe Ephraim hath multiplied altars to ſinne: altars are made to him vnto ſinne.
label: Osee

text: I wil write to him my manifold lawes, which haue bene accounted as ſtrange.
label: Osee

text: They shal offer hoſtes, they shal immolate flesh, and shal eate, and the Lord wil not receiue them: now wil he remember their iniquitie, and wil viſite their ſinnes: they shal returne into Ægypt.
label: Osee

text: And Iſrael hath forgotten his maker, and hath built temples: and Iudas hath multiplied fenſed cities: and I wil caſt fire on his cities, and it shal deuoure the houſes therof.
label: Osee

text: BE not glad Iſrael, reioyce not as the peoples: becauſe thou haſt fornicated from thy God, thou haſt loued reward aboue al the flores of wheate.
label: Osee

text: The flore and the winepreſſe shal not feede them, and the wine shal lie to them.
label: Osee

text: They shal not dwel in the land of our Lord: Ephraim is returned into Ægypt, and among the Aſſyrians he hath eaten the thing polluted.
label: Osee

text: They shal not offer wine to our Lord, and they shal not pleaſe him: their ſacrfices as the bread of mourners: al that shal eate it, shal be contaminated: becauſe their bread for their ſoule, shal not enter into the houſe of our Lord.
label: Osee

text: what wil you doe in the ſolemne day, in the day of the feſtiuitie of our Lord?
label: Osee

text: For behold they are gone forth from deſtruction: Ægypt shal gather them together, Memphis shal burie them: their ſiluer to be deſyred the nettle shal inherite, the burre in their tabernacles.
label: Osee

text: The dayes of viſitation are come, the dayes are come of retributions: know ô Iſrael the foolish prophete, the mad ſpiritual man, for the multitude of thine iniquitie, the multitude alſo madnes.
label: Osee

text: The watchman of Ephraim with my God: the prophete is made a ſnare of ruine vpon al his wayes, madnes in the houſe of his God.
label: Osee

text: They haue ſinned deeply, as in the dayes of Gabaa: he wil remember their iniquitie, and wil viſite their ſinne.
label: Osee

text: As grapes in the deſert I found Iſrael: as the firſt fruites of the figtree in the toppe therof I ſaw their fathers: but they haue entered into Beelphegor, and are alienated into confuſion, and are become abominable, as thoſe thinges, which they loued.
label: Osee

text: Ephraim as a bird hath flowen away, their glorie from birth, and from the wombe, and from conception.
label: Osee

text: But if they shal nourish vp their children, I wil make them without children among men: yea & wo to them, when I shal depart from them.
label: Osee

text: Ephraim, as I ſaw, was Tyre founded in beautie: and Ephraim shal lead out his children to the murderer.
label: Osee

text: Geue them ô Lord, what wilt thou geue to them? Geue them a wombe without children, and drie breſts.
label: Osee

text: Al their wicked in Galgal, becauſe there I hated them: for the malice of their inentions I wil caſt them forth out of my houſe: I wil not adde to loue them, al their princes reuolters.
label: Osee

text: Ephraim is ſtrooken, their roote is dried vp, they shal yeld no fruite. But and if they shal haue iſſue, I wil kil the beſt beloued things of their wombe.
label: Osee

text: My God wil caſt them away, becauſe they heare him not: and they shal be vagabunds in the nations.
label: Osee

text: ISRAEL a vine thicke of branches, the fruite is made equal to it: according to the multitude of his fruite he hath multiplied altars, according to the plentie of his land he hath abunded in idols.
label: Osee

text: Their hart is diuided, now they shal perish: he shal breake their idols, he shal deſtroy their altars.
label: Osee

text: Becauſe they wil now ſay: We haue no king: for we feare not our Lord: and what shal a king do to vs?
label: Osee

text: You ſpeake wordes of vnprofitable viſion, and you shal make a couenant: & iudgement shal ſpring as bitternes vpon the furrowes of the filde.
label: Osee

text: The kine of Bethauen haue the inhabitans of Samaria worshipped: Becauſe his people mourned vpon him, & his temple wardens reioyced vpon him in his glorie, becauſe it departed from him.
label: Osee

text: For he alſo was caried vnto Aſſur, a gift to the king Reuenger: confuſion shal take Ephraim, & Iſrael shal be confunded in his owne wil.
label: Osee

text: Samaria hath made her king to paſſe as froth vpon the face of water.
label: Osee

text: And the excelſes of the idol the ſinne of Iſrael shal be deſtroyed: the burre and the thiſtle shal grow vp ouer their altars: and they shal ſay to the mountaines: Couer vs; and to the litle hilles: Fal vpon vs.
label: Osee

text: From the Dayes of Gabaa, Iſrael hath ſinned, there they ſtood: the battel in Gabaa vpon the children of iniquitie shal not apprehend them.
label: Osee

text: According to my deſire I wil chaſtiſe them: and the peoples shal be gathered together vpon them, when they shal be chaſtiſed for their two inquities.
label: Osee

text: Ephraim an heifer taught to loue threshing, and I haue paſſed ouer the beautie of her necke: I wil aſcend vpon Ephraim, Iudas shal plough, Iacob shal breake the furrowes to him ſelf.
label: Osee

text: Sow to your ſelues in iuſtice, and reape in the mouth of mercie, fallow ground: but the time to ſeeke our Lord, when he shal come that shal teach you iuſtice.
label: Osee

text: you haue ploughed impietie, you haue reaped iniquitie, you haue eaten the fruite of lying: becauſe thou haſt truſted in thy wayes, in the multitude of thy ſtrong ones.
label: Osee

text: A tumult shal ariſe in thy people: & al thy munitions shal be deſtroyed as Salmana was deſtroyed by his houſe that tooke vengeance on Baal in the day of battel, the mother being dashed in peeces vpon the children.
label: Osee

text: So hath Bethel done to you, becauſe of the malice of your iniquities.
label: Osee

text: AS the morning paſſed, hath the king of Iſrael paſſed away. Becauſe Iſrael was a child, and I loued him: and out of Ægypt I called my ſonne.
label: Osee

text: They called them, ſo they departed from their face: they immolated to Baalim, & ſacrificed to idols.
label: Osee

text: And I as it were the nurſe of Ephraim, caried them in myne armes: and they knew not that I cured them.
label: Osee

text: In the cordes of Adam I wil draw them, in the bands of charitie: and I wil be to them as lifting vp the yoke vpon their cheekes: and I declined to him that he might eate.
label: Osee

text: He shal not returne into the Land of Ægypt, and Aſſur he his king: becauſe they would not conuert.
label: Osee

text: The ſword hath begune in his cities, and it shal conſume his elect, and shal eate their heades.
label: Osee

text: And my people shal hang vpon my returne: but a yoke shal be put vpon them together, which shal not be taken away.
label: Osee

text: how shal I geue thee Ephraim, protect thee Iſrael? how shal I geue thee as Adama, lay thee as Seboim? My hart is turned within, my repentance is diſturbed together.
label: Osee

text: I wil not doe the furie of my wrath: I wil not returne to deſtroy Ephraim: becauſe I am God, and not man: in the middes of thee the Holie one, and I wil not enter into the citie.
label: Osee

text: They shal walke after our Lord, as a lion wil he roare: becauſe he wil roare, and the children of the ſea shal feare.
label: Osee

text: And they shal flie away as a bird out of Ægypt, and as a doue out of the Land of the Aſſyrians: and I wil place them in their houſes, ſaith our Lord.
label: Osee

text: Ephraim hath compaſſed me in denying, and the houſe of Iſrael in deceite: but Iudas a witneſſe is deſcended with God, and with the ſainctes, faithful.
label: Osee

text: EPHRAIM feedeth the winde, and foloweth the heate: al the day he multiplieth lying and waſte: and he hath made a league with the Aſſyrians, and he caried oyle into Ægypt.
label: Osee

text: The iudgement therfore of our Lord with Iuda, and viſitation vpon Iacob: according to his wayes, and according to his inuentions he wil render to him.
label: Osee

text: In the wombe he ſupplanted his brother: and in his ſtrength he was directed with the Angel.
label: Osee

text: And he preuailed againſt the Angel, and was ſtrengthened: and he wept, and beſought him: in Bethel he found him, an there he ſpake with vs.
label: Osee

text: And our Lord the God of hoſtes, the Lord is his memorial.
label: Osee

text: And thou shalt conuert to thy God: keepe mercie and iudgement, and hope in thy God alwayes.
label: Osee

text: Chanaan in his hand a deceitful balance, he hath loued calumnie.
label: Osee

text: And Ephraim ſayd: But yet I am made rich, I haue found an idol to my ſelf: al my labours shal not finde me the iniquitie, which I haue ſinned.
label: Osee

text: And I the Lord thy God out of the Land of Ægypt, I wil yet make thee ſitte in tabernacles, as in the dayes of feſtiuitie.
label: Osee

text: And I haue ſpoken vpon the prophets, and I haue multiplied viſion, and in the hand of the prophets I haue bene reſembled.
label: Osee

text: If an idol in Galaad, then in vaine were they in Galgal immolating with oxen: for their altars alſo as heapes vpon the furrowes of the filde.
label: Osee

text: Iacob fled into the countrie of Syria, and Iſrael ſerued for a wife, and for a wife he kept her.
label: Osee

text: But by a prophete our Lord brought Iſrael out of Ægypt: and by a prophete he was preſerued.
label: Osee

text: Ephraim hath prouoked me to wrath in his bitternes, and his bloud shal come vpon him, and his reproch his Lord wil reſtore to him.
label: Osee

text: EPHRAIM ſpeaking, horrour inuaded Iſrael: and he ſinned in Baal, and died.
label: Osee

text: And now they haue added to ſinne: and they haue made to themſelues a molten of their ſiluer as it were the ſimilitude of idols, the whole is the worke of crafteſmen: to theſe they ſay: Immolate men adoring calues.
label: Osee

text: Therfore they shal be as a morning cloude, and as a morning dew paſſing away, as duſt caught with a whirlewind out of the floore, and as ſmoke out of the chimnie.
label: Osee

text: But I the Lord thy God out of the Land of Ægypt: and God beſide me thou shalt not know, and there is no Sauiour beſide me.
label: Osee

text: I knew thee in the deſert, in the land of wildernes.
label: Osee

text: According to their paſtures they were filled, and were made ful: they haue lifted vp their hart, and haue forgotten me.
label: Osee

text: And I wil be vnto them as a lioneſſe, as a leopard in the way of the Aſſyrians.
label: Osee

text: I wil meete them as a beare her yong being violently taken away, and I wil breake in ſunder the inner partes of their liuer: and wil conſume them there as a lion, the beaſt of the filde shal teare them.
label: Osee

text: Perdition is thine ô Iſrael: onlie in me thy helpe.
label: Osee

text: Where is thy king? Now eſpecially let him ſaue thee in al thy cities: & thy iudges, of whom thou ſaydſt: Geue me kinges, and princes.
label: Osee

text: I wil geue thee a king in my furie, and wil take him away in mine indignation.
label: Osee

text: The iniquitie of Ephraim is bound together, his ſinne is hidden.
label: Osee

text: The ſorowes of a woman in trauel shal come to him, he a ſonne not wiſe: for now he shal not ſtand the confraction of the children.
label: Osee

text: Out of the hand of death I wil deliuer them, from death I wil redeme them: I wil be thy death ô death, thy bitte wil I be ô hel, conſolation is hidden from mine eyes.
label: Osee

text: Becauſe he shal diuide betwen bretheren: our Lord wil bring a burning winde riſing from the deſert: and it shal drie vp his vaines, and shal make his fountaine deſolate, and he shal ſpoyle the treaſure of euerie veſſel that is to be deſired.
label: Osee

text: LET Samaria perish, becauſe she hath ſtirred vp her God to bitternes: let them perish by the ſword, let their litle ones be dashed, and let the wemen with child be cut in ſunder.
label: Osee

text: Conuert ô Iſrael to our Lord thy God: becauſe thou art fallen in thine iniquitie.
label: Osee

text: Take wordes with you, and conuert to our Lord, and ſay to him: Take away al iniquitie, and receiue good: and we wil render the calues of our lippes.
label: Osee

text: Aſſur shal not ſaue vs, we wil not mount vpon horſe: neither wil we ſay any more: Our goddes the worke of our handes: becauſe thou wilt haue mercie on that pupil, which is in thee.
label: Osee

text: I wil heale their confractions, I wil loue them voluntarily: becauſe my furie is auerted from them.
label: Osee

text: I wil be as dew, Iſrael ſhal ſpring as the lillie, and his roote shal breake forth as that of Libanus.
label: Osee

text: His boughes shal goe, and his glorie shal be as the oliuetree: and his ſmel as of Libanus.
label: Osee

text: They shal be conuerted that ſitte vnder his shadow: they shal liue with wheate, and they shal ſpring as a vine: his memorial as the wine of Libanus.
label: Osee

text: Ephraim what haue I to doe any more with idols? I wil heare, and I wil direct him as a verdant firretree: out of me thy fruit is found.
label: Osee

text: Who is wiſe, and shal vnderſtand theſe thinges? of vnderſtanding, and shal know theſe thinges? becauſe the wayes of our Lord be right, and the iuſt shal walke in them: but preuaricatours shal fal in them.
label: Osee

text: THE word of our Lord, that was made to Ioel the ſonne of Phatuel.
label: Joel

text: Heare this ye ancients, and harken with your eares al ye inhabitants of the land: if this hath bene done in your dayes, or in the dayes of your fathers?
label: Joel

text: Vpon this tel you to your children, and your children to their children, and their childred to an other generation.
label: Joel

text: The reſidue of the eruke hath the locuſt eaten, & the reſidue of the locuſt hath the bruke eaten, and the reſidue of the bruke hath the blaſt eaten.
label: Joel

text: Awake you that be drunke, and weepe, and howle al ye, that drinke wine in ſweetnes: becauſe it is perished from your mouth.
label: Joel

text: For a nation is aſcended vpon my land, ſtrong & innumerable: his teeth as the teeth of a lion: and his cheekteeth as of a lions whelpe.
label: Joel

text: He hath layd my vineyard into a deſert, and hath pilled of the barke of my figtree: ſtripping he hath ſpoiled it, and caſt it forth: the boughes therof are made white.
label: Joel

text: Mourne as a virgin girded with ſackcloth vpon the huſband of her youth.
label: Joel

text: Sacrifice and libation is perished out of the houſe of our Lord: the prieſts our Lords miniſters mourned.
label: Joel

text: The region is deſtroyed, the ground hath mourned: becauſe the wheate is waſted, the wine is confounded, the oyle hath languished.
label: Joel

text: The husbandmen are confounded, the dreſſers of vines haue howled vpon the wheate, and the barley, becauſe the harueſt of the filde is perished.
label: Joel

text: The vineyard is confounded, and the figtree hath languished: the pomegranet, & the palmetree, and the appletree, and al the trees of the filde are withered: becauſe ioy is confounded from the children of men.
label: Joel

text: Gird yourſelues, and mourne ye prieſts, howle ye miniſters of the altar: goe in, lie in ſackeclothe ye miniſters of my God: becauſe ſacrifice & libation is perished out of the houſe of your God.
label: Joel

text: Sanctifie ye a faſt, cal an aſſemblie, gather together the ancients, al the inhabitants of the land into the houſe of your God: and crie ye to our Lord:
label: Joel

text: A a a, for the day: becauſe the day of our Lord is at hand, and as deſtruction from the mightie it shal come.
label: Joel

text: Why, are not the victuals perished before your eyes, ioy and exultation out of the houſe of our God?
label: Joel

text: The beaſtes are rotted in their dung, the barnes are deſtroyed, the ſtorehouſes are diſſipated: becauſe the wheate is confounded.
label: Joel

text: Why groned the beaſt, why lowed the flockes of the heard? becauſe there is no paſture for them: yea and the flockes of the cattel are perished.
label: Joel

text: To thee ô Lord wil I crie: becauſe fire hath eaten the beautiful thinges of the deſert, and the flame hath burnt al the trees of the region.
label: Joel

text: Yea and the beaſtes of the filde, as a garden bed thirſting for a shower, haue looked vp to thee, becauſe the fountaines of waters are dried vp, & fire hath deuoured the beautiful thinges of the deſert.
label: Joel

text: SOVND ye with the trumpet in Sion, howle in my holie mount, let al the inhabitants of the land be trubled: Becauſe the day of our Lord cometh,
label: Joel

text: becauſe the day of darkenes, and of miſt is neere, the day of clowde, and whirlewind: as the morning ſpred vpon the montaines much people & ſtrong: the like to it hath not bene from the beginning, and after it ſhal not be euen vnto the yeares of generation & generation.
label: Joel

text: Before the face therof a deuouring fyre, and after it a burning flame: the land before it as it were a garden of pleaſure, and after it the wildernes of a deſert, neither is there that can eſcape it.
label: Joel

text: As the appearance of horſes, their appearance. & as horſemen ſo shal they runne.
label: Joel

text: As the ſound of chariots vpon the toppes of mountaines shal they leape, as the ſound of a flame of fire deuouring ſtubble, as a ſtrong people prepared to battel.
label: Joel

text: At his preſence the people shal be vexed: al viſages shal be made like a potte.
label: Joel

text: They shal runne as valients: as men of warre they shal ſcale the wal: the men shal march in their wayes, & shal not decline from their pathes.
label: Joel

text: None shal preſſe his brother; they shal walke euerie one in his owne pathe: yea & through the windowes they shal fal, & shal not demolish.
label: Joel

text: They shal enter the city: they shal runne on the wal, they shal climbe the houſes, by the windowes they shal enter as a theefe.
label: Joel

text: At his preſence the earth hath trembled, the heauens are moued: the ſunne and moone are darkened, and the ſtarres haue withdrawne their shining.
label: Joel

text: And our Lord hath geuen his voice before the face of his hoſt: becauſe his campes are exceding manie, becauſe ſtrong & doing his word: for great is the day of our Lord, & terrible excedingly: and who shal ſuſteyne it?
label: Joel

text: Now therfore ſayth our Lord: Conuert to me in al your hart, in faſting, and in weeping, and in mourning.
label: Joel

text: And rent your hartes, and not your garments, and turne to the Lord your God: becauſe he is benigne and merciful, patient and of much mercie, & readie to be gracious vpon the malice.
label: Joel

text: Who knoweth if he wil conuert, and forgeue, and leaue after him benediction, ſacrifice and libament to the Lord your God?
label: Joel

text: Sound ye with the trumpet in Sion, ſanctifie a faſt, cal an aſſemblie,
label: Joel

text: gather together the people, ſanctifie the Church, aſſemble the ancients, gather together the litle ones, and them that ſucke the breaſtes: let the bridegrome goe forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her bride chamber.
label: Joel

text: Betwen the porch and the altar the prieſts our Lords miniſters shal weepe, and shal ſay: Spare ô Lord, ſpare thy people: and geue not thine inheritance into reproch, that the nations haue dominion ouer them. Why ſay they in the peoples: Where is their God?
label: Joel

text: Our Lord hath bene zelous to his land, and hath ſpared his people.
label: Joel

text: And our Lord anſwered, and ſayd to his people: Behold I wil ſend you corne, and wine, and oyle, and you shal be replenished with them: and I wil geue you no more to be a reproch in the Gentils.
label: Joel

text: And him that is from the North, I wil make far from you: and I wil expel him into a land vnpaſſable, & deſert, his face againſt the eaſt ſea, and his extreme part to the laſt ſea: & his ſtinke shal aſcend, & his rotennes shal aſcend, becauſe he hath done proudly.
label: Joel

text: Feare not ô land, reioyce & be glad: becauſe our Lord hath magnified to doe.
label: Joel

text: Feare not ye beaſtes of the region: becauſe the beautiful thinges of the deſert are ſprung, becauſe the tree hath brought his fruite, the figtree, and the vine haue geuen their vigour.
label: Joel

text: And ye children of Sion reioyce, and be ioyful in the Lord your God: becauſe he hath geuen you a doctor of iuſtice, and he wil make the early and the late showre to deſcend to you as in the beginning.
label: Joel

text: And the floores shal be filled with wheate, and the preſſes shal ouerflow with wine, and oyle.
label: Joel

text: And I wil render you the yeares, which the locuſt, the bruke, and the blaſt, and the eruke hath eaten: my great ſtrength, which I haue ſent vpon you.
label: Joel

text: And you shal eate eating, and shal be filled: and you shal praiſe the name of the Lord your God, that hath done meruels with you, and my people shal not be confounded for euer.
label: Joel

text: And you shal know that I am in the middes of Iſrael: & I the Lord your God, and there is none beſides: and my people shal not be confounded for euer.
label: Joel

text: And it shal be after this: I wil powre out my ſpirit vpon al flesh: and your ſonnes, & your daughters shal prophecie: your ancients shal dreame dreames, and your yong men shal ſee viſions.
label: Joel

text: Yea and vpon my ſeruants, and handmayds in thoſe dayes I wil powre out my ſpirit.
label: Joel

text: And I wil geue wonders in heauen, and in earth, bloud, and fire, and vapour of ſmoke.
label: Joel

text: The ſunne shal be turned into darkenes, and the moone into bloud: before the great and horrible day of the Lord doth come.
label: Joel

text: And it shal be, euerie one that shal inuocate the name of the Lord, shal be ſaued: becauſe in mount Sion, and in Ieruſalem shal be ſaluation, as our Lord hath ſayd, and in the reſidew whom our Lord shal cal.
label: Joel

text: BECAVSE loe in thoſe dayes, and in that time when I shal conuert the captiuitie of Iuda, and Ieruſalem.
label: Joel

text: I wil gather together al Nations, & wil lead them into the valley of Ioſaphat: and I wil plead with them there vpon my people, and myne inheritance Iſrael, whom they haue diſperſed in the nations, and haue diuided my land.
label: Joel

text: And vpon my people they haue caſt lot: and boy they haue geuen to be a ſtrumpet, and wench they haue ſould for wine that they might drinke.
label: Joel

text: But what is to me and to you ô Tyre, and Sidon, and al the border of the Paleſthines? what, wil you render me reuenge? and if you doe reuenge againſt me, I wil ſoone render you quickly recompence vpon your head.
label: Joel

text: For my ſiluer, and my gold you haue taken: and my deſiderable thinges, and moſt beautiful you haue caried into your temples.
label: Joel

text: And the children of Ieruſalem you haue ſold to the children of the Greekes that you might make them far of from their coaſts.
label: Joel

text: Behold I wil rayſe them vp out of the place, wherin you haue ſold them: and I wil turne your retribution vpon your owne head.
label: Joel

text: And I wil ſel your ſonnes, & your daughters into the handes of the children of Iuda, and they shal ſel them to the Sabæans, a nation far of, becauſe our Lord hath ſpoken.
label: Joel

text: Proclaime ye this in the Gentils: ſanctifie battel, rayſe vp the ſtrong: let them come, let al the men of warre come vp.
label: Joel

text: Cut your ploughes into ſwordes, and your ſpades into ſpeares. Let the weake ſay: That I am ſtrong.
label: Joel

text: Breake out, and come al ye nations from round about, and be gathered together: there wil our Lord make al thy ſtrong ones to be ſlaine.
label: Joel

text: Let them ariſe, and let the Gentils aſcend into the valley of Ioſaphat: becauſe there I wil ſit, to iudge al nations round about.
label: Joel

text: Put in the ſithes, becauſe the harueſt is ripe: come, and deſcend, becauſe the preſſe is ful, the preſſes runne ouer: becauſe their malice is multiplied.
label: Joel

text: Peoples peoples in the valley of dconciſion, becauſe the day of our Lord is nigh in the valley of conciſion.
label: Joel

text: The ſunne and the moone are darkened, and the ſtarres haue withdrawen their shining.
label: Joel

text: And our Lord wil roare out of Sion, and out of Ieruſalem he wil geue his voice: and the heauens, & the earth shal be moued, and our Lord the hope of his people, and the ſtrength of the children of Iſrael.
label: Joel

text: And you shal know that I am the Lord your God dwelling in Sion my holy mount: and Ieruſalem shal be holie, & ſtrangers shal paſſe through it no more.
label: Joel

text: And it shal be in that day: the mountaines shal diſtil ſweetnes, and the hilles shal flow with milke: and through al the riuers of Iuda shal runne waters: & a fountaine shal iſſue out of the houſe of the Lord, and shal water the torrent of thornes.
label: Joel

text: Ægypt shal be into deſolation, & Idumea into a deſert of perdition, for that they haue done vniuſtly againſt the children of Iuda, and haue shed innocent bloud in their land.
label: Joel

text: And Iewrie shal be inhabited for euer, and Ieruſalem vnto generation and generation.
label: Joel

text: And I wil clenſe their bloud, which I had not clenſed: and the Lord wil dwel in Sion.
label: Joel

text: THE wordes of Amos, who was among the paſtours of Thecua: Which he ſaw vpon Iſrael in the dayes of Ozias the king of Iuda, and in the dayes of Iereboam the ſonne of Ioas the king of Iſrael two yeares before the earthquake.
label: Amos

text: And he ſayd: Our Lord wil roare out of Sion, and out of Ieruſalem he wil geue his voice: & the beautiful places of the paſtours haue mourned and the toppe of Carmel is withered.
label: Amos

text: Thus ſayth our Lord: Vpon three wickedneſſes of Damaſcus, and vpon foure I wil not conuert it: becauſe they haue threshed Galaad with yron waynes.
label: Amos

text: And I wil ſend fyre into the houſe of Azael, and it shal deuoure the houſes of Benadad.
label: Amos

text: And I wil breake the barre of Damaſcus: and I wil deſtroy the inhabitant out of the idol, and him that holdeth the ſcepter out of the houſe of pleaſure: and the people of Syria shal be tranſported to Cyrene, ſaith our Lord.
label: Amos

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: Vpon three wickedneſſes of Gaza, & vpon foure I wil not conuert it, becauſe they haue tranſported a perfect captiuitie, to shut it vp in Idumea.
label: Amos

text: And I wil ſend fyre on the wal of Gaza, and it shal deuoure the houſes therof.
label: Amos

text: And I wil deſtroy the inhabitant out of Azotus, and him that holdeth the ſcepter out of Aſcalon: and I wil turne my hand vpon Accaron, and the reſt of the Philiſthims shal perish, ſayth our Lord God.
label: Amos

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: Vpon the three wickedneſſes of Tyre, and vpon foure I wil not conuert it: becauſe they haue shut vp a perfect captiuite in Idumea, and haue not remembred the league of bretheren.
label: Amos

text: And I wil ſend fyre vpon the wal of Tyre, it shal deuoure the houſes therof.
label: Amos

text: Thus ſayth our Lord: Vpon three wickedneſſes of Edom, and vpon foure I wil not conuert him: becauſe he hath perſecuted his brother with the ſword, and hath violated his mercie, and hath held his furie longer, and hath kept his indignation euen to the end.
label: Amos

text: I wil ſend fyre into Theman: and it shal deuoure the houſes of Boſra.
label: Amos

text: Thus ſayth our Lord: Vpon three wickedneſſes of the children of Ammon, and vpon foure I wil not conuert him: becauſe he hath cut in ſunder the wemen with childe of Galaad to dilate his limite.
label: Amos

text: And I wil kindle a fyre in the wal of Rabba: & it shal deuoure the houſes therof with howling in the day of battel, and with a whirlewind in the day of commotion.
label: Amos

text: And Melchom shal goe into captiuitie, himſelf, and his princes together, ſayth our Lord.
label: Amos

text: THVS ſayth our Lord: Vpon three wickedneſſes of Moab and vpon foure I wil not conuert him: becauſe he hath burnt the bones of Idumea euen to ashes.
label: Amos

text: And I wil ſend fyre into Moab, and it shal deuoure the houſes of Carioth: and Moab shal dye in the ſound, in the noyſe of the trumpet:
label: Amos

text: and I wil deſtroy the iudge out of the middes of him, and al his princes I wil kil with him, ſaith our Lord.
label: Amos

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: Vpon three wickedneſſes of Iuda, & vpon foure I wil not conuert him: becauſe he hath caſt away the law of our Lord, and not kept his commandments: for their idols haue deceiued them, after which their fathers went.
label: Amos

text: And I wil ſend fire into Iuda, and it shal deuoure the houſes of Ieruſalem.
label: Amos

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: Vpon three wickedneſſes of Iſrael, and vpon foure I wil not conuert him: becauſe he hath ſold the iuſt for ſiluer, and the poore for shoes.
label: Amos

text: Which bruiſe the heades of the poore vpon the duſt of the earth, and decline the way of the humble: and the ſonne and his father haue gone to a young woman, that they might violate my holie name.
label: Amos

text: And vpon garments layd to pledge they did lye beſide euerie altar: & the wine of the condemned they dranke in the houſe of their God.
label: Amos

text: But I did caſt out the Ammorrheit before their face: whoſe height the height of Cedars, & he ſtrong as an oke: and I deſtroyed his fruite from aboue, & his rootes beneath.
label: Amos

text: It is I that made you come vp out of the Land of Ægypt, & I ledde you in the deſert fourtie yeares, that you might poſſeſſe the Land of the Amorrheite.
label: Amos

text: And I rayſed vp of your ſonnes to be prophets & of your yongmen Nazareites, is it not ſo ô children of Iſrael, ſaith our Lord?
label: Amos

text: And you dranke wine to the Nazareites: and the prophets you commanded, ſaying: Prophecie not.
label: Amos

text: Behold I wil ſcreake vnder you, as a wayne ſcreaketh loden vvith hay.
label: Amos

text: And flight shal perish from the ſwift, and the valient shal not obteyne his ſtrength, and the ſtrong shal not ſaue his life.
label: Amos

text: And he that holdeth the bow shal not ſtand, and the ſwift of his feete shal not be ſaued, and the rider of the horſe shal not ſaue his life.
label: Amos

text: and the ſtoute of hart among the valients shal flee naked in that day, ſayth our Lord.
label: Amos

text: HEARE the word, that our Lord hath ſpoken vpon you, ye children of Iſrael: vpon al the kindred that I brought forth out of the Land of Ægypt, ſaying:
label: Amos

text: Onlie you haue I knowen of al the kindreds of the earth: therfore wil I viſite vpon you al your iniquities.
label: Amos

text: Why shal two walke together, vnles they be agreed?
label: Amos

text: Wil the lion roare in the forreſt, vnles he haue a praye? wil the lions whelp geue voice out of his denne, vnles he hath caught ſomewhat?
label: Amos

text: wil the bird fal into the ſnare of the earth, without the ſowler? Shal the ſnare be taken away from the earth, before it hath taken ſomewhat?
label: Amos

text: Shal the trumpet ſound in the citie, and wil not the people be afrayd? Shal there be euil in the citie, which our Lord hath not done?
label: Amos

text: Becauſe our Lord God wil not doe a word, vnles he haue reueled his ſecret to his ſeruants the prophets.
label: Amos

text: The lion shal roare, who wil not feare? Our Lord God hath ſpoken, who shal not prophecie?
label: Amos

text: Make it heard in the houſes of Azotus, and in the houſes of the Land of Ægypt: and ſay: Gather ye together vpon the mountaines of Samaria, and ſee the manie madneſſes in the midddes therof, and them that ſuffer calumnie in the inner parts therof.
label: Amos

text: And they haue not knowne to doe right, ſayth our Lord, treaſuring vp iniquitie, and robberies in their houſes.
label: Amos

text: Therfore thus ſayth our Lord God: The land shal be in tribulation, & compaſſed about: and thy ſtrength shal be plucked away from thee, and thy houſes shal be ſpoyled.
label: Amos

text: Thus ſayth our Lord: As if a paſtour should get out of the lions mouth two legges, or the tippe of the eare: ſo shal the children of Iſrael, that dwel in Samaria, be deliuered, in the plague of the bed, and in the couche of Damaſcus.
label: Amos

text: Heare ye, and conteſt in the houſe of Iacob, ſayth our Lord the God of hoſts:
label: Amos
