text: That in the day when I shal begin to viſite the preuarications of Iſrael, I wil viſite vpon him, and vpon the altars of Bethel: and the hornes of the altar shal be cut of, and shal fal to the ground.
label: Amos

text: And I wil ſtrike the winter houſe with the ſummer houſe: and the houſes of yuorie shal perish, and manie houſes shal be diſſipated, ſayth our Lord.
label: Amos

text: HEARE this word ye fatte kine, which are in the mountaines of Samaria: which doe calumnie to the needie, and breake the poore: which ſay to your lords: Bring, and we wil drinke.
label: Amos

text: Our Lord God hath ſworne by his holie, that loe the dayes shal come vpon you, and they shal lift you vp on poles, and your remnant in pottes boyling hotte.
label: Amos

text: And by the breaches you shal goe out one againſt an other, & you shal be caſt forth into Armon, ſaith our Lord.
label: Amos

text: Come ye to Bethel, and doe impiouſely to Galgal, and multiplie preuarication: and offer in the morning your victimes, three dayes your tithes.
label: Amos

text: And ſacrifice ye prayſe of the leauened: and cal voluntarie oblations, and proclaime it: for ſo would you ô children of Iſrael, ſayth our Lord God.
label: Amos

text: Wherupon I alſo haue geuen you dulnes of the teeth in al your cities, and lacke of bread in al your places: and you haue not returned to me, ſayth our Lord.
label: Amos

text: I alſo haue ſtayed the rayne from you, when there remayned yet three monethes vnto harueſt: and I rayned vpon one citie, and vpon an other citie I rayned not: one part was rayned vpon; and the part whereupon I rayned not, withered.
label: Amos

text: And two and three cities came to one citie to drinke water, & were not filled: & you returned not to me, ſaith our Lord.
label: Amos

text: I ſtroke you with a burning winde, & with blaſting, the multitude of your gardens, and al your vineyards: your oliue groues, & figgroues the eruke hath eaten: and you returned not to me, ſayth our Lord.
label: Amos

text: I ſent death vpon you in the way of Ægypt, I ſtroke your yongmen with the ſword, euen to the captiuitie of your horſes: and I made the putrefaction of your campe to come vp into your noſtherels: and you returned not to me, ſayth our Lord.
label: Amos

text: I ſubuerted you, as God ſubuerted Sodom and Gomorth, and you were made as a fyrebrand haſtely caught from the burning: and you returned not to me, ſayth our Lord.
label: Amos

text: Wherfore theſe thinges wil I doe to thee Iſrael: but after I shal doe theſe thinges to thee, be prepared to meete thy God ô Iſrael.
label: Amos

text: Becauſe loe he that formeth the mountaines and createth the wind, and declareth his word to man, maketh the morning miſt, and walketh vpon the high places of the earth: our Lord the God of hoſt is his name.
label: Amos

text: HEARE ye this word, that I lift vpon you a lamentation. The houſe of Iſrael is fallen, and it shal not adde to riſe againe.
label: Amos

text: The virgine of Iſrael, is caſt forth vpon her land, there is none to rayſe her vp.
label: Amos

text: Becauſe thus ſayth our Lord God: The citie, out of which came forth a thouſand, there shal be left in it an hundred: and out of which there came an hundred, there shal be left in it tenne, in the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Amos

text: Becauſe thus ſayth our Lord to the houſe of Iſrael: Seeke ye me, and you shal liue.
label: Amos

text: And ſeeke not Bethel, and into Galgal enter not, and into Berſabee you shal not paſſe: becauſe Galgal shal be led captiue, and Bethel shal be vnprofitable.
label: Amos

text: Seke ye our Lord: and liue: leſt perhaps the houſe of Ioſeph be burnt as fyre, and it shal deuoure, and there shal be none to quench Bethel.
label: Amos

text: You that turne iudgement into wormewod, and leaue of iuſtice in the land.
label: Amos

text: Him that maketh Arcturus, and Orion, and that turneth darknes into morning, and that changeth day into night: that calleth the waters of the ſea, and powreth them out vpon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name.
label: Amos

text: He that ſeeketh deſtruction vpon the ſtrong, and bringeth depopulation vpon the mightie.
label: Amos

text: They haue hated him that rebuketh in the gate: and him that ſpeaketh perfectly they haue abhorred.
label: Amos

text: Therfore becauſe you ſpoiled the poore, and tooke the choſen praye from him: you shal build houſes with ſquare ſtone, and shal not dwel in them: you shal plant moſt amiable vineyards, and ſhal not drinke the wine of them.
label: Amos

text: Becauſe I haue knowen manie your wickedneſſes, and your ſtrong ſinnes: enemies of the iuſt, taking bribe, and oppreſſing the poore in the gate.
label: Amos

text: Therfore shal the wiſe at that time hold his peace, becauſe it is an euil time.
label: Amos

text: Seeke ye good, and not euil, that you may liue: and our Lord the God of hoſts wil be with you, as you haue ſayd.
label: Amos

text: Hate ye euil, and loue good, and eſtablish iudgement in the gate: if perhaps our Lord the God of hoſts may haue mercie on the remnant of Ioſeph.
label: Amos

text: Therfore thus ſayth our Lord the God of hoſts the Dominatour, in al ſtreates lamentation: and in al places that are without, shal be ſayd wo wo: and they shal cal the huſbandman to mourning, and to lamentation them that know to lament.
label: Amos

text: And in al vineyardes there shal be lamentation: becauſe I wil paſſe through in the middes of thee, ſayth our Lord.
label: Amos

text: Wo vnto them that deſyre the day of our Lord: to what purpoſe the ſame vnto you? This day of our Lord, darkenes, and not light.
label: Amos

text: As if a man should flee from the face of a lion, & a beare should mete him: & enter into the houſe, & leane with his hand vpon the wal, and a ſerpent should bite him.
label: Amos

text: Why, is not the day of our Lord darkenes, and not light: and miſt, and no shining therein?
label: Amos

text: I haue hated, and haue reiected your feſtiuities: and I wil not take the odour of your aſſemblies.
label: Amos

text: And if you shal offer vnto me holocauſts, and your gifts, I wil not receiue them: and the vowes of your fat thinges I wil not reſpect.
label: Amos

text: Take away from me the tumult of thy ſonges: and the canticles of thy harpe I wil not heare.
label: Amos

text: And iudgement shal be reueled as water, and iuſtice, as a mightie torrent.
label: Amos

text: Why, did you offer hoſtes and ſacrifice to me in the deſert fourtie yeares, ô houſe of Iſrael?
label: Amos

text: And you caried a tabernacle for your Moloch, and the image of your idols, the ſtarre of your God, which you made to your ſelues.
label: Amos

text: And I wil make you remoue beyond Damaſcus, ſaith our Lord, the God of hoſtes is his name.
label: Amos

text: WO TO you that are rich in Sion, and haue confidence in the mountaine of Samaria: ye great men, heads of the peoples, going ſtately into the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Amos

text: Paſſe ye into Chalane, and ſee, & goe ye thence into Emath the great: and deſcend into Geth of the Paleſtines, and to al the beſt kingdoms of theſe: if their border be larger then your border.
label: Amos

text: You that are ſeperated vnto the euil day: and approch to the throne of iniquitie.
label: Amos

text: You that ſleepe in beds of iuorie, and play the wantons in your couches: that eate the lambe out of the flocke, and calues out of the middes of the heard.
label: Amos

text: You that ſing to the voice of the pſalter: as Dauid they haue thought themſelues to haue the inſtruments of ſong.
label: Amos

text: That drinke wine in phials, and are annoynted with the beſt oyntment: and they ſuffered nothing vpon the contrition of Ioſeph.
label: Amos

text: Wherfore now they shal goe in the head of them, that goe in tranſmigration: and the faction of the wantons shal be taken away.
label: Amos

text: The Lord God hath ſworne by his ſoule, ſaith our Lord the God of hoſtes: I deteſt the pride of Iacob, and I hate his houſes, and I wil deliuer vp the citie with the inhabitants therof.
label: Amos

text: And if there shal be left tenne men in one houſe, they alſo shal dye.
label: Amos

text: And his kinſman shal take him vp, and shal burne him, that he may carie the bones out of the houſe: and he shal ſay to him, that is in the inner parts of the houſe: Is there yet with thee?
label: Amos

text: And he shal anſwer: There is an end. And he shal ſay to him: Hold thy peace, & remember not the name of our Lord.
label: Amos

text: Becauſe loe our Lord hath commanded, and he wil ſtrike the greater houſe with ruins, and the leſſer houſe with clefts.
label: Amos

text: Why can horſes runne vpon rockes, or can there be ploughing with buffles? becauſe you haue turned iudgement into bitternes, and the fruite of iuſtice into wormewood?
label: Amos

text: Which reioyce in thinges of naught: which ſay: Why haue not we taken vnto vs hornes in our owne ſtrength?
label: Amos

text: For behold I wil rayſe vp from you ô houſe of Iſrael, ſaith our Lord the God of hoſtes, a nation: and they shal deſtroy you from the entrance of Emath, euen to the torrent of the deſert.
label: Amos

text: THESE thinges hath our Lord God shewed to me: and loe the former of the locuſt in the beginning of thinges that ſpring of the later rayne, and behold the later rayne after the kings mowing.
label: Amos

text: And it came to paſſe: after it had finished to eate the graſſe of the land, I ſayd: O Lord God be propicious I beſeech thee: who shal rayſe vp Iacob, becauſe he is a litle one?
label: Amos

text: Our Lord hath had pitie vpon this: It shal not be, ſayth our Lord.
label: Amos

text: Theſe thinges hath our Lord God called iudgement vnto fyre, and it deuoured the great depth and it did eate a part together.
label: Amos

text: And I ſayd: Lord God be quiet I beſech thee: who shal rayſe vp Iacob, becauſe he is a litle one?
label: Amos

text: Our Lord had pitie vpon this: Yea this alſo shal not be, ſayth our Lord God.
label: Amos

text: Theſe thinges hath our Lord shewed to me: and loe our Lord ſtanding vpon a wal plaſtered, and in his hand a maſons truel.
label: Amos

text: And our Lord ſayd to me: What ſeeſt thou Amos? And I ſayd: A maſons truel. And our Lord ſayd: Behold I wil lay downe the truel in the middes of my people Iſrael: I wil adde no more to plaſter it ouer.
label: Amos

text: And the excelſes of the idol shal be throwen downe, and the ſanctifications of Iſrael shal be made deſolate: and I wil riſe vpon the houſe of Ieroboam with the ſword.
label: Amos

text: And Amaſias the prieſt of Bethel ſent to Ieroboam the king of Iſrael, ſaying: Amos hath rebelled againſt thee in the middes of the houſe of Iſrael: the land wil not be able to ſuſteyne al his wordes.
label: Amos

text: For thus ſaith Amos: Ieroboam shal dye by the ſword, and Iſrael shal depart captiue out of their land.
label: Amos

text: And Amaſias ſayd to Amos: Thou that ſeeſt, goe, flee into the land of Iuda: & eate bread there, and thou shalt prophecie there.
label: Amos

text: And in Bethel thou shalt adde no more to prophecie: becauſe it is the ſanctification of the king, and it is the houſe of the kingdom.
label: Amos

text: And Amos anſwered, and ſayd to Amaſias: I am not a prophete , and I am not the ſonne of a prophet: but an heardſman am I plucking ſycomores.
label: Amos

text: And our Lord tooke me when I folowed the flocke, and our Lord ſayd to me: Goe, prophecie to my people Iſrael.
label: Amos

text: And now heare the word of our Lord: Thou ſayeſt: Thou shalt not prophecie vpon Iſrael, and thou shalt not diſtil vpon the houſe of the idol.
label: Amos

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord: Thy wife shal fornicate in the citie, and thy ſonnes, and thy daughters shal fal by the ſword, & thy ground shal be meaſured with a corde: and thou shalt dye in a polluted land, and Iſrael shal depart captiue out of their land.
label: Amos

text: THESE thinges hath our Lord shewed to me: and be-hold an apple hooke.
label: Amos

text: And he ſayd: What ſeeſt thou Amos? And I ſayd: An apple hooke. And our Lord ſayd to me: The end cometh vpon my people Iſrael: I wil adde no more to paſſe them.
label: Amos

text: And the henges of the temple shal creake in that day, ſaith our Lord God: manie shal dye: in euerie place shal ſilence be caſt.
label: Amos

text: Heare this you that tread downe the poore, & make the needie of the land to fayle,
label: Amos

text: ſaying: When wil the moneth paſſe, and we shal ſel wares: and the Sabbath, and we open the corne: that we may diminish the meaſure, and increaſe the ſicle, and conuey in deceitful balances,
label: Amos

text: that we may for ſiluer poſſeſſe the needie, and the poore for shoes, and may ſel the refuſe of the corne?
label: Amos

text: Our Lord hath ſworne agaynſt the pride of Iacob If I shal forget euen to the end al their workes.
label: Amos

text: Why, shal not the land be moued vpon this, and euerie inhabitant therof mourne: and riſe vp as a riuer altogether, and be caſt out, and runne downe to the riuer of Ægypt?
label: Amos

text: And it shal be in that day, ſaith our Lord God: The ſunne shal goe downe at midday, & I wil make the earth to be darke in the day of light.
label: Amos

text: And I wil turne your feſtiuities into mourning, and al your ſongues into lamentation: and I wil bring in vpon euerie backe of yours ſackcloth, and vpon euerie head baldnes: and I wil lay it as the mourning of an onlie begotten ſonne; and the later end therof as a bitter day.
label: Amos

text: Behold the dayes come, ſaith our Lord, and I wil ſend forth famine into the land: not the famine of bread, nor thirſt of water, but of hearing the word of the Lord.
label: Amos

text: And they shal be moued from the ſea euen to ſea, and from the North euen to the Eaſt: they shal goe about ſeeking the word of our Lord, and shal not finde.
label: Amos

text: In that day the fayre virgins shal faile, & the yongmen in thirſt.
label: Amos

text: They that ſweare by the ſinne of Samaria, and ſay: Thy God ô Dan liueth: and the way of Berſebee liueth: and they shal fal, and shal riſe no more.
label: Amos

text: I SAW our Lord ſtanding vpon the altar, and he ſayd: Strike the henges, & let the lintels be moued: for there is auarice in the head of al, and the laſt of them wil I kil by the ſword: there shal be no flight for them: they shal flee, and he shal not be ſaued that shal flee of them.
label: Amos

text: If they shal deſcend euen to hel, thence shal my hand bring them out: and if they shal aſcend euen to heauen, thence wil I plucke them downe.
label: Amos

text: And if they shal be hid in the toppe of Carmel, thence ſearching wil I take them away: and if they shal hide themſelues from mine eyes in the depth of the ſea, there wil I command the ſerpent & he shal bite them.
label: Amos

text: And if they shal go into captiuitie before their enemies, there wil I command the ſword, and it shal kil them. And I wil ſet mine eyes vpon them to euil, and not to good.
label: Amos

text: And our Lord the God of hoſtes, which toucheth the earth, and it shal melt away: and al that dwel therein shal mourne: and it shal al riſe as a riuer, and shal runne downe as the floud of Ægypt.
label: Amos

text: He that buildeth in heauen his aſcenſion, and hath founded his bundel vpon the earth: who calleth the waters of the ſea, and powreth them out vpon the face of the earth, the Lord is his name.
label: Amos

text: Why, are not you as the children of the Æthiopians vnto me, ô children of Iſrael, ſaith our Lord? Did not I make Iſrael to aſcend out of the Land of Ægypt: and the Paleſthins out of Cappadocia, and the Syrians out of Cyrenee?
label: Amos

text: Behold the eyes of our Lord God vpon the ſinning kingdom; & I wil deſtroy it from the face of the earth: but yet deſtroying I wil not deſtroy the houſe of Iacob, ſayth our Lord.
label: Amos

text: For behold I wil command, and wil shake the houſe of Iſrael in al nations, as wheate is shaken in a ſieue: and there shal not a litle ſtone fal vpon the earth.
label: Amos

text: Al the ſinners of my people shal fal by the ſword: which ſay: The euil shal not approch, & shal not come vpon vs.
label: Amos

text: In that day I wil rayſe vp the tabernacle of Dauid, that was fallen: & I wil reedifie the breaches of the walles therof, and thoſe thinges, that were fallen I wil repayre: and I wil reedifie him as in the dayes of old.
label: Amos

text: That they may poſſeſſe the remnant of Idumea, and al nations, becauſe that my name is inuocated vpon them: ſaith our Lord that doth theſe thinges.
label: Amos

text: Behold the dayes come, ſaith our Lord: and the plougher shal ouertake the reaper, & the treader of the grape him that ſoweth ſede: and the mountaynes shal droppe ſweetnes, and al hilles shal be tilled.
label: Amos

text: And I wil conuert the captiuitie of my people Iſrael: and they shal build the deſert cities, & inhabite: and shal plant vineyards, and drinke the wine of them: & shal make gardens, and eate the fruites of them.
label: Amos

text: And I wil plant them vpon their owne ground: & I wil no more plucke them out of their land, which I haue geuen them, ſayth our Lord thy God.
label: Amos

text: THE viſion of Abdias. Thus ſayth our Lord God to Edom: We haue heard a bruit from our Lord, and he hath ſent a legate to the Gentils: Riſe ye, and let vs ariſe againſt him into battel.
label: Abdias

text: Behold I haue geuen thee a litle one in the Gentils: thou art contemptible exceedingly.
label: Abdias

text: The pride of thy hart hath extolled thee, dwelling in the clefts of rockes, exalting thy throne: which ſayſt in thy hart: Who shal plucke me downe to the earth?
label: Abdias

text: If thou shalt be exalted as an eagle, and if thou shalt ſet thy neſt among the ſtarres: thence wil I plucke thee downe, ſayth our Lord.
label: Abdias

text: If theues had gone in to thee, if robbers by night, how hadſt thou held thy peace? would not they haue ſtolen thinges ſufficent for themſelues? if the grape gatherers had entered in to thee, would they not haue left thee at the leaſt a cluſter?
label: Abdias

text: How haue they ſearched Eſau, haue they ſought out his hidden thinges?
label: Abdias

text: Euen to the border haue they caſt thee out: al the men of thy league haue mocked thee: the men of thy peace haue preuailed againſt thee: they that eate with thee, shal lay embushments vnder thee: there is no wiſdom in him.
label: Abdias

text: Why, shal not I in that day, ſayth our Lord, deſtroy the wiſe out of Idumea, and prudence from the mount of Eſau,
label: Abdias

text: And thy valients of the South shal feare, that man may perish from the mount of Eſau.
label: Abdias

text: For the ſlaughter, and for the iniquitie againſt thy brother Iacob, confuſion shal couer thee, and thou shalt perish for euer.
label: Abdias

text: In the day when thou ſtoodeſt againſt him, when ſtrangers tooke his armie, and foreners entered his gates, and vpon Ieruſalem caſt lotte: thou alſo waſt as one of them.
label: Abdias

text: And thou shalt not dispiſe in the day of thy brother, in the day of his peregrination: and thou shalt not reioyce ouer the children of Iuda, in the day of their perdition: & thou shalt not magnifie thy mouth in the day of diſtreſſe.
label: Abdias

text: Neither shalt thou enter the gate of my people in the day of their ruine: neither shalt thou alſo diſpiſe in his euils in the day of his deſtruction: and thou shalt not be ſent out againſt his armie in the day of his deſtruction.
label: Abdias

text: Neither shalt thou ſtand in the outgoings to kil them that flee: and thou shalt not shut vp his remnant in the day of tribulation.
label: Abdias

text: Becauſe the day of our Lord is at hand vpon al nations: as thou haſt done, ſo shal it be done to thee: thy retribution he wil returne vpon thine owne head.
label: Abdias

text: For as you haue drunke vpon my holie mount, shal al Gentils drinke continually: & they shal drinke, and ſwallow vp, and they shal be as though they were not.
label: Abdias

text: And in mount Sion shal be ſaluation, and it shal be holie: and the houſe of Iacob shal poſſeſſe thoſe that had poſſeſſed them.
label: Abdias

text: And the houſe of Iacob shal be a fyre, and the houſe of Ioſeph a flame, and the houſe of Eſau ſtubble: and they shal be kindled in them, and shal deuoure them: and there shal be no remaynes of the houſe of Eſau, becauſe our Lord hath ſpoken.
label: Abdias

text: And they that are toward the South, shal inherite the mount of Eſau, and they in the champaine countries, Philiſthiims: and they shal poſſeſſe the region of Ephraim, and the region of Samaria: and Beniamin shal poſſeſſe Galaad.
label: Abdias

text: And the tranſmigration of this hoſt of the children of Iſrael, al places of the Chananeits euen to Sarepta: and the tranſmigration of Ieruſalem, that is in Boſphorus, shal poſſeſſe the cities of the South.
label: Abdias

text: And ſauiours shal aſcend into mount Sion to iudge the mount of Eſau: and the kingdom shal be to our Lord.
label: Abdias

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to Ionas the ſonne of Amathi, ſaying:
label: Jonas

text: Ariſe, and goe into Niniue the great citie, and preach in it: becauſe the malice therof is aſcended before me.
label: Jonas

text: And Ionas aroſe, to flee into Tharſis from the face of our Lord, and he went downe into Ioppe, and found a shippe going into Tharſis: and he gaue the fare therof, & went downe into it, that he might goe with them into Tharſis from the face of our Lord.
label: Jonas

text: But our Lord ſent a great winde into the ſea: and a great tempeſt was made in the ſea, & the shippe was in danger to be broken.
label: Jonas

text: And the mariners were afrayd, and the men cried to their god: & they threw the veſſels, that were in the shippe, into the ſea, that it might be lightned of them: and Ionas went downe into the inner part of the shippe, and ſlept a deepe ſleepe.
label: Jonas

text: And the gouerner came to him, & ſayd to him: Why art thou oppreſſed with ſleepe? Riſe, inuocate thy God, if perhaps God wil thinke of vs, and we perish not.
label: Jonas

text: And euerie one ſayd to his felow: Come, and let vs caſt lottes, and know why this euil is to vs. And they caſt lottes, and the lot fel vpon Ionas.
label: Jonas

text: And they ſayd to him: Tel vs for whoſe cauſe this euil is to vs, what is thy worke? what is thy countrie? and whither goeſt thou? or of what people art thou?
label: Jonas

text: And he ſayd to them: I am an Hebrew & the Lord God of heauen I feare, which made the ſea and the drie land.
label: Jonas

text: And the men feared with great feare, and they ſayd to him: Why haſt thou done this? (For the men knew that he fled from the face of our Lord: becauſe he had told them.)
label: Jonas

text: And they ſayd to him: What shal we do to thee, and the ſea shal ceaſe from vs? becauſe the ſea went, and ſwelled.
label: Jonas

text: And he ſayd to them: Take me vp, and caſt me into the ſea, and the ſea shal ceaſe from you: for I know that for me this great tempeſt is vpon you.
label: Jonas

text: And the men rowed, to returne to the land, and they were not able: becauſe the ſea went and ſwelled vpon them.
label: Jonas

text: And they cried to our Lord, and ſayd: We beſech thee ô Lord, let vs not perish in the life of this man, and geue not vpon vs innocent bloud: becauſe thou ô Lord, haſt done as thou wouldeſt.
label: Jonas

text: And they tooke Ionas, and caſt him into the ſea: and the ſea ceaſed from his rage.
label: Jonas

text: And the men feared our Lord with great feare, & immolated hoſtes to our Lord, and vowed vowes.
label: Jonas

text: AND our Lord prepared a great fish to ſwallow done Ionas: and Ionas was in the bellie of the fish three dayes and three nightes.
label: Jonas

text: And Ionas prayed to our Lord his God out of the bellie of the fish.
label: Jonas

text: And he ſayd: I cryed out of my tribulation to our Lord, & he hath heard me: out of the bellie of hel cried I, and thou haſt heard my voice.
label: Jonas

text: And thou haſt caſt me forth into the depth in the hart of the ſea, and a floud hath compaſſed me: al thy ſurges, & thy waues haue paſſed ouer me.
label: Jonas

text: And I ſayd: I am caſt away from the ſight of thine eyes: but yet I shal ſee thy holie temple againe.
label: Jonas

text: The waters haue compaſſed me euen to the ſoule: the depth hath incloſed me, the ſea hath couered my head.
label: Jonas

text: I am deſcended to the extreme parts of the mountaines: the barres of the earth haue shut me vp for euer: and thou wilt lift vp my life from corruption, ô Lord my God.
label: Jonas

text: When my ſoule was in diſtreſſe within me, I remembred our Lord: that my prayer may come to thee vnto thy holie temple.
label: Jonas

text: They that kepe vanities in vaine, forſake their mercie.
label: Jonas

text: But I in the voice of prayſe wil immolate to thee: what thinges ſoeuer I haue vowed I wil render for ſaluation to our Lord.
label: Jonas

text: And our Lord ſpake to the fish: and it vomited vp Ionas vpon the drie land.
label: Jonas

text: AND the word of our Lord was made to Ionas the ſecond time, ſaying:
label: Jonas

text: Ariſe, & goe into Niniue the great citie: and preach in it the preaching which I ſpeake to thee.
label: Jonas

text: And Ionas aroſe, & went into Niniue according to the word of our Lord: & Niniue was a great citie of three dayes iorney.
label: Jonas

text: And Ionas began to enter into the citie on dayes iorney:& he cried, and ſayd: As yet fourtie dayes, and Niniue shal be ſubuerted.
label: Jonas

text: And the men of Niniue beleued in God: and they proclamed a faſt, and were clothed with ſackcloths from the greater to the leſſer.
label: Jonas

text: And the word came to the king of Niniue: and he roſe vp out of his throne, and caſt away his garment from him, and was clothed with ſackcloth, and ſate in ashes.
label: Jonas

text: And he cried, and ſayd in Niniue from the mouth of the king & of his princes, ſaying: Men, and beaſts, and oxen, and cattel let them not taſte any thing: nor feede, and let them not drinke water.
label: Jonas

text: And let men, and beaſts be couered with ſackcloths, and crie to our Lord in ſtrength, and let euerie man conuert from his euil way & from the iniquitie, that is in their handes.
label: Jonas

text: Who knoweth if God wil conuert, and forgeue: and wil returne from the furie of his wrath, and we shal not perish?
label: Jonas

text: And God ſaw their workes, that they were conuerted from their euil way: and God had mercie on the euil which he had ſpoken, that he would do to them, and he did it not.
label: Jonas

text: AND Ionas was afflicted with great affliction, and was angrie:
label: Jonas

text: and he prayed to our Lord, and ſayd: I beſech thee ô Lord, Why, is not this my word, when I was yet in my countrie? for this did I preuent to flee into Tharſis. For I know that thou art a clement, and merciful God, patient, and of much compaſſion, and forgeuing vpon the euil.
label: Jonas

text: And now Lord take I beſech thee my ſoule from me: becauſe better is death to me then life.
label: Jonas

text: And our Lord ſayd: Art thou angrie wel thinkeſt thou?
label: Jonas

text: And Ionas went out of the citie, and ſate againſt the Eaſt part of the citie: and he made himſelf a bowre there, and he ſate vnder it in the shadow, til he might ſee what would befal to the citie.
label: Jonas

text: And our Lord God prepared an iuie tree, & it came vp ouer the head of Ionas, to be a shadow ouer his head, and to couer him: for he had laboured: and Ionas reioyced vpon the iuie with great ioy.
label: Jonas

text: And God prepared a worme in the ryſing of the morning againſt the morrow: and it ſtroke the iuie, and it withered.
label: Jonas

text: And when the ſunne was riſen, our Lord commanded an hotte, and burning winde: and the ſunne beate vpon the head of Ionas, and he broyled for heate: and he deſired for his ſoule to dye, and ſayd: It is better for me to dye then to liue.
label: Jonas

text: And our Lord ſayd to Ionas: Art thou angrie wel, thinkeſt thou, for the iuie? And he ſayd: I am angrie wel euen vnto death.
label: Jonas

text: And our Lord ſayd: Thou art ſorie for the iuie, wherin thou haſt not laboured, nor made it to grow, which in one night came forth, and in one night is perished.
label: Jonas

text: And shal not I ſpare Niniue the great citie, wherin are more then a hundred twentie thouſand men, that know not what is betwen their right hand and their left, and manie beaſtes?
label: Jonas

text: THE word of our Lord that was made to Michæas the Moraſthite, in the dayes of Ioathan, Achaz, and Ezechias kinges of Iuda: which he ſaw vpon Samaria and Ieruſalem.
label: Micheas

text: Heare al ye peoples: and let the earth attend, and the fulnes therof: and let our Lord God be vnto you for a witnes, our Lord out of his holie temple.
label: Micheas

text: Becauſe loe our Lord wil goe forth out of his place: and he wil deſcend, & wil tread vpon the higheſt of the earth.
label: Micheas

text: And the mountaines shal be conſumed vnder him: and the valleis shal be clouen, as waxe at the preſence of fyre, & as waters that runne downe headlong.
label: Micheas

text: For the wickednes of Iacob al this, and for the ſinnes of the houſe of Iſrael. what is the wickednes of Iacob? is it not Sammaria? and what the exceſſes of Iuda? is it not Ieruſalem?
label: Micheas

text: And I wil lay Samaria as a heape of ſtones in the filde when a vineyard is planted: and I wil plucke downe her ſtones into the valley, & wil diſcouer her fundations.
label: Micheas

text: And al her ſculptils shal be cut in ſunder, and al her wages shal be burnt with fyre, and I wil lay al her idols into perdition: becauſe they are gathered together of the wages of an harlot, & vnto the hyre of an harlot they shal returne.
label: Micheas

text: Vpon this wil I lament, and howle: I wil goe ſpoiled, and naked: I wil make lamentation as of dragons, and mourning as it were of ſtriches.
label: Micheas

text: Becauſe her plague is deſperate, becauſe it is come euen to Iuda it hath touched the gate of my people euen to Ieruſalem.
label: Micheas

text: In Geth declare it not, weepe not with teares: in the houſe of duſt ſprinkle your ſelf with duſt.
label: Micheas

text: And paſſe ye to your ſelues ô faire habitation, confounded with ignominie: she went not out that dwelleth in the going out: the houſe adioyning shal receiue lamentation of you, which ſtood to her ſelf.
label: Micheas

text: Becauſe she is weakened to good which dwelleth in bitterneſſes: becauſe euil is deſcended from our Lord into the gate of Ieruſalem.
label: Micheas

text: Tumult of the chariot of aſtonishment to the inhabitant of Lachis: it is the beginning of ſinne to the daughter of Sion, becauſe in thee are found the wickedneſſes of Iſrael.
label: Micheas

text: Therfore shal he geue ſpoilers vpon the inheritance of Geth: the houſes of lying into deception to the kinges of Iſrael.
label: Micheas

text: As yet wil I bring an heyre to thee which dwelleſt in Mareſa: euen to Odolla shal the glorie of Iſrael come.
label: Micheas

text: Be bald, and be pouled for the children of thy delicacies: enlarge thy baldnes as an eagle: becauſe they are led captiues out of thee.
label: Micheas

text: WO TO you which thinke that is vnprofitable, and worke euil in your beds: in the morning light they doe it, becauſe their hand is againſt God.
label: Micheas

text: And they haue coueted fildes, and violently taken, and houſes forcibly taken away: and oppreſſed the man and his houſe, the man and his inheritance.
label: Micheas

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord: Behold I purpoſe euil vpon this familie: whence you shal not take away your neckes, and you shal not walke prowd, becauſe it is a very euil time.
label: Micheas

text: In that day a parable shal be taken vp vpon you, and a ſongue shal be ſung with ſweetnes, of them that ſay: With depopulation we are waſted: part of my people is changed: how shal he depart from me, wheras he returneth, that wil diuide our regions?
label: Micheas

text: For this cauſe thou shalt haue none caſting the cord of lot in the aſſemblie of our Lord.
label: Micheas

text: Speake ye not ſpeaking: It shal not droppe vpon theſe, confuſion shal not apprehend them.
label: Micheas

text: The houſe of Iacob ſaith: Why is the ſpirit of our Lord abridged, or are his cogitations ſuch? Are not my wordes good with him that walketh rightly?
label: Micheas

text: And on the contrarie my people is riſen vp as an aduerſarie: from aboue the cote you haue taken away the cloke: & them that paſſed ſimply, you turned into battel.
label: Micheas

text: The wemen of my people you haue caſt out of the houſe of their delicacies: from their litle ones you haue taken my praiſe for euer.
label: Micheas

text: Ariſe, and goe, becauſe you haue no reſt here. For the vncleannes therof it shal be corrupted with a ſore putrefaction.
label: Micheas

text: Would God I were not a man hauing the ſpirit, and that I did rather ſpeake a lie: I wil diſtil to thee into wine, and into drunkennes: and it shal be this people vpon whom it is diſtilled.
label: Micheas

text: Gathering I wil gather thee wholly together ô Iacob: I wil bring together the remnant of Iſrael into one, I wil put them together as a flocke in the fold, as cattel in the middes of sheepcotes, they shal make a tumult by reaſon of the multitude of men.
label: Micheas

text: For he shal aſcend opening the way before them: they shal diuide, and paſſe through the gate, and shal enter by it: and their king shal paſſe before them, and our Lord in the head of them.
label: Micheas

text: AND I ſayd: Heare ye princes of Iacob, & ye dukes of the houſe of Iſrael: Why, is it not your part to know iudgement,
label: Micheas

text: which hate good, and loue euil: which violently take away their skinnes from them, and their flesh from their bones?
label: Micheas

text: Which haue eaten the flesh of my people, and haue flead their skinne from them: and haue broken, and cut their bones as in a kettle & as it were flesh in the middes of a potte.
label: Micheas

text: shal they crie to our Lord, and he wil not heare them: and he wil hide his face from them at that time, as they haue done wickedly in their inuentions.
label: Micheas

text: Thus ſayth our Lord vpon the prophets, that ſeduce my people: that bite with their teeth, nnd preach peace: and if a man geue not ſomething in their mouth, they ſanctifie battel vpon him.
label: Micheas

text: Therfore there shal be nigt to you for viſion, and darkenes to you for diuination: and the ſunne shal goe downe vpon the prophets, & the day shal be darkened ouer them.
label: Micheas

text: And they shal be confounded that ſee viſions, and the diuiners shal be confounded: and al shal couer their faces, becauſe there is no anſwer of God.
label: Micheas

text: But yet I am replenished with the ſtrenght of the ſpirit of our Lord, with iudgement, and power: to declare vnto Iacob his wickednes, and to Iſrael his ſinne.
label: Micheas

text: Heare this ye princes of the houſe of Iacob, and ye iudges of the houſe of Iſrael: which abhorre iudgement, & peruert al right thinges,
label: Micheas

text: Which build Sion in bloud, and Ieruſalem in iniquitie.
label: Micheas

text: Her princes iudged for gifts, and her prieſts taught for wages, and her prophets diuined for money: & they reſted vpon our Lord, ſaying: Why, is not our Lord in the middes of vs? euils shal not come vpon vs.
label: Micheas

text: For this, becauſe of you, Sion shal be ploughed as a filde, and Ieruſalem shal be as an heape of ſtones, and the mount of the temple as the high places of foreſts,
label: Micheas

text: AND it shal be: In the later end of dayes there shal be the mount of the houſe of our Lord prepared in the toppe of mountaines, and high aboue the hilles: and peoples shal flow to it.
label: Micheas

text: And manie nations shal haſten, & shal ſay: Come, let vs goe vp to the mountaine of our Lord, & to the houſe of the God of Iacob: & he wil teach vs of his wayes, and we shal goe in this pathes: becauſe out of Sion shal the law goe forth, and the word of our Lord out of Ieruſalem.
label: Micheas

text: And he shal iudge betwen manie peoples, and he shal rebuke ſtrong nations vnto a far of: and they shal cut their ſwordes into culters, and their ſpeares into ſpades: nation shal not take ſword againſt nation: and they shal no more learne to make battel.
label: Micheas

text: And euerie man shal ſitte vnder his vine, & vnder his figtree, and there shal be none to make them afrayd: becauſe the mouth of the Lord of hoſts hath ſpoken it.
label: Micheas

text: Becauſe al peoples wil walke euerie one in the name of his God: but we shal walke in the name of the Lord our God for euer and euer.
label: Micheas

text: In that day, ſaith our Lord; I wil gather her that halteth: and her that I had caſt out, I wil gather vp, & her whom I had afflicted.
label: Micheas

text: And I wil make her that halted into a remnant: and her that had laboured into a mightie nation: and our Lord wil reigne ouer them in mount Sion, from this time now and for euer.
label: Micheas

text: And thou the towre of flocke, clowdie of the daughter of Sion shal come to thee: and the firſt powre shal come the kingdom to the daughter of Ieruſalem.
label: Micheas

text: Now why art thou drawne together with penſifnes? why, is there not a king to thee, or is thy counſelor perished, becauſe ſorow hath apprehended thee as a woman in trauel?
label: Micheas

text: Sorow thou & labour ô daughter of Sion as a woman in trauel: becauſe now shalt thou goe out of the citie, and shalt dwel in the countrie, and shalt come euen to Babylon, there thou shalt be deliuered: there our Lord wil redeme thee out of the hand of thine enemies.
label: Micheas

text: And now manie nations are gathered together vpon thee, which ſay: Let her be ſtoned: and let our eye looke vpon Sion.
label: Micheas

text: But they haue not knowne the cogitations of our Lord, and haue not vnderſtood his counſel: becauſe he hath gathered them together as the haye of the floore.
label: Micheas

text: Ariſe, and thresh ô daughter of Sion: becauſe I wil make thy horne of yron, and thy hoofes I wil make of braſſe: & thou shalt breake in peeces manie peoples, and shalt kil the ſpoiles of them to our Lord, and their ſtrength to the Lord of the whole earth.
label: Micheas

text: NOW shalt thou be ſpoiled daughter of the ſpoiler: they haue layd ſiege vpon vs, with a rod shal they ſtrike the cheeke of the iudge of Iſrael.
label: Micheas

text: AND THOV BETHLEHEM, Ephrata, art a litle one in the thouſands of Iuda: out of thee shal come forth vnto me he that shal be the dominatour in Iſrael: and his coming forth from the begynning, from the dayes of eternitie.
label: Micheas

text: Therfore shal he geue them euen til the time, wherin she that traueleth shal bring forth: and the remnant of his bretheren shal be conuerted to the children of Iſrael.
label: Micheas

text: And he shal ſtand, and feede in the ſtrength of our Lord, in the height of the name of our Lord his God: and they shal be conuerted, becauſe now shal he be magnified euen to the endes of the earth.
label: Micheas

text: And this man shal be peace: when the Aſſyrian shal come into our land, and when he shal tread in our houſes: and we wil rayſe vpon him ſeuen paſtours, and eight principal men.
label: Micheas

text: And they shal feede the land of Aſſur in the ſword, and the land of Nemrod in the ſpeares therof: and he shal deliuer from Aſſur, when he shal come into our Land, and when he shal tread in our coaſts.
label: Micheas

text: And the remnant of Iacob shal be in the middes of manie peoples as dew from our Lord, and as droppes vpon the graſſe, which expecteth not man, and tarieth not for the children of men.
label: Micheas

text: And the remnant of Iacob shal be in the Gentiles in the middes of manie peoples, as a lion among the beaſts of the foreſts, and as a lions whelpe among the flockes of cattel: who when he hath paſſed, and troden downe, and taken, there is none to deliuer.
label: Micheas

text: Thy hand shal be exalted ouer thine enemies, and al thine enemies shal perish.
label: Micheas

text: And it shal be in that day, ſayth our Lord: I wil take away thy horſes out of the middes of thee, and wil deſtroy thy chariots.
label: Micheas

text: And I wil deſtroy the cities of thy land, and wil deſtroy al thy munitions, and I wil take away ſorceries out of thy hand, & there shal be no diuinations in thee.
label: Micheas

text: And I wil make thy ſculptils to perish, and thy ſtatuees out of the middes of thee: and thou shalt no more adore the workes of thy handes.
label: Micheas

text: And I wil plucke vp thy groues out of the middes of thee: and wil deſtroy thy cities.
label: Micheas

text: And I wil doe vengeance in furie and in indignation among al the nations, that haue not heard.
label: Micheas

text: HEARE ye what our Lord ſpeaketh: Ariſe, contend in iudgement againſt the mountaines, & let the hilles heare thy voice.
label: Micheas

text: Let the mountaynes heare the iudgement of our Lord, & the ſtrong fundations of the earth: becauſe the iudgement of our Lord is with his people, and with Iſrael he wil be iudged.
label: Micheas

text: My people what haue I done to thee, or what haue I moleſted thee? anſwer me.
label: Micheas

text: Becauſe I brought thee out of the Land of Ægypt, & deliuered thee out of the houſe of them that ſerued: and ſent before thy face Moyſes, and Aaron, and Marie?
label: Micheas

text: My people remember I pray thee, what Balach the king of Moab purpoſed: and what Balaam the ſonne of Beor anſwered him: from Setim euen to Galgal; that thou mightſt know the iuſtices of our Lord.
label: Micheas

text: What worthie thing shal I offer to our Lord? shal I bow the knee to the high God? What shal I offer vnto him holocauſts, & calues of a yeare old?
label: Micheas

text: Why, can our Lord be pacified with thouſandes of rammes, or with manie thouſandes of fatte buckgoates? Why, shal I geue my firſt borne for my wickednes, the fruite of my womb for the ſinne of my ſoule?
label: Micheas

text: I wil shew thee ô man what is good, and what our Lord requireth of thee: Verely to do iudgement, and to loue mercie, and to walke ſolicitous with thy God.
label: Micheas

text: The voice of our Lord crieth to the citie, and ſaluation shal be to them that feare thy name: heare ye ô tribes, and who shal approue it?
label: Micheas

text: As yet there is fire in the houſe of the impious, treaſures of iniquitie, and a leſſer meaſure ful of wrath.
label: Micheas

text: Why, shal I iuſtifie an impious balance, and the deceitful weights of the bag?
label: Micheas

text: By which her richmen were replenished with iniquitie, and the inhabitants therin ſpake lies, and their tongue was fraudulent in their mouth.
label: Micheas

text: And I therfore begane to ſtrike thee with perdition for thy ſinnes.
label: Micheas

text: Thou shalt eate, & shalt not be filled: and thy humiliation in the middes of thee: and thou shalt apprehend, and shalt not ſaue: and whom thou shalt ſaue, I wil geue vnto the ſword.
label: Micheas

text: Thou shalt ſow, and shalt not reape: thou shalt tread the oliue, and shalt not be anoynted with the oyle: and preſſe muſte, & shalt not drinke the wine.
label: Micheas

text: And thou haſt kept the precepts of Amri, and al the worke of the houſe of Achab: and thou haſt walked in their willes, that I might geue thee into perdition, and the inhabitants therin into hiſſing, and the reproch of my people you shal beare.
label: Micheas

text: WO is me, becauſe I am become as he that gathereth in autumne the cluſters of vintage: there is no cluſter to eate, timely ripe figges my ſoule hath deſired.
label: Micheas

text: The holie is perished out of the earth, & there is none righteous among men: al lie in wayte for bloud, euerie one hunteth his brother to death.
label: Micheas

text: The euil of their handes they cal good the prince requireth, and the iudge is in rendring: and the great man hath ſpoken the deſire of his ſoule, and they haue trubled it.
label: Micheas

text: He that is left among them, is as a brier: and he that is righteous, as the thorne of the hedge. The day of thy ſpeculation, thy viſitation cometh: now shal be the deſtruction of them.
label: Micheas

text: Beleue not a frend, and truſt not in prince: from her that ſleepeth in thy boſome, keepe the cloſures of thy mouth.
label: Micheas

text: Becauſe the ſonne doth contumelie to the father, & the daughter ryſeth agaynſt her mother, the daughter in law againſt her mother in law: & a mans enemies they of his owne houshold.
label: Micheas

text: But I wil looke towards our Lord, I wil expect God my ſauiour: my God wil heare me.
label: Micheas

text: Reioyce not thou mine enemie ouer me, becauſe I am fallen: I shal ariſe, when I haue ſitte in darkenes, our Lord is my light.
label: Micheas

text: I wil beare the wrath of our Lord, becauſe I haue ſinned to him: vntil he iudge my iudgement: he wil bring me forth into the light, I shal ſee his iuſtice.
label: Micheas

text: And mine enemie shal behold, and she shal be couered with confuſion, which ſayth to me, where is the Lord thy God? Mine eyes shal looke on her: now shal she be into conculcation as the myre of the ſtreetes.
label: Micheas

text: The day that thy walles may be builded vp: in that day shal the law be made far of.
label: Micheas

text: In that day and Aſſur shal come euen to thee, & euen to the fenſed cities, and from the fenſed cities euen to the riuer, and to ſea from ſea, and to mountaine from mountaine.
label: Micheas

text: And the land shal be into deſolation for the inhabitants therof, and for the fruite of their cogitations.
label: Micheas

text: Feede thy people with thy rod, the flocke of thine inheritance, them that dwel alone in the foreſt, in the middes of Carmel: they shal feede vpon Baſan and Galaad according to the dayes of old.
label: Micheas

text: According to the dayes of thy coming forth out of the Land of Ægypt I wil shew him meruels.
label: Micheas

text: The nations shal ſee, and shal be confounded vpon al their ſtrength: they shal put the hand vpon the mouth, their eares shal be deafe.
label: Micheas

text: They shal licke duſt as ſerpents, as the creeping beaſts of the earth, they shal be trubled in their houſes: the Lord our God they shal dreade, and shal feare thee.
label: Micheas

text: What God is like to thee, which takeſt away iniquitie, and paſſeſt ouer the ſinne of the remnant of thine inheritance? he wil ſend his furie in no more, becauſe he is willing mercie.
label: Micheas

text: He wil returne, and wil haue mercie on vs: he wil lay away our iniquities: and he wil caſt al our ſinnes into the botome of the ſea.
label: Micheas

text: Thou wilt geue truth to Iacob, mercie to Abraham: which thou haſt ſworne to our fathers from the dayes of old.
label: Micheas

text: THE burden of Niniuie. The booke of the viſion of Nahum the Elceſeite.
label: Nahum

text: God is ielous, & our Lord reuenging, our Lord reuenging, and hauing furie: our Lord reuenging on his aduerſaries, and he is angrie with his enemies.
label: Nahum

text: Our Lord is patient, and great of ſtrength and clenſing, he wil not make innocent. Our Lords wayes in tempeſt, and whirlewind, and clowdes the duſt of his feete.
label: Nahum

text: Rebuking the ſea, and driyng it vp: and bringing al riuers to a deſert. Baſan is weakened and Carmel: & the floure of Libanus is faided.
label: Nahum

text: The mountaines were moued at him, and the hilles were deſolate: and the earth hath trembled at his preſence, and the world, and al that dwel therin.
label: Nahum

text: Before the face of his indignation who shal ſtand? and who shal reſiſt in the wrath of his furie? his indignation is powred out as fire: and the rockes are diſſolued by him.
label: Nahum

text: Our Lord is good, and ſtrenghning in the day of tribulation: and knowing them that hope in him.
label: Nahum

text: And in a floud paſſing by, he wil make a conſummation of the place therof: & darkenes shal purſew his enemies.
label: Nahum

text: VVhat thinke ye againſt our Lord? conſumation he wil make: there shal not riſe duble tribulation.
label: Nahum

text: Becauſe as thornes claſpe one an other: ſo the feaſt of them that drinke together: they shal be conſumed as ſtuble ful of drienes.
label: Nahum

text: Out of thee shal come forth one that thinketh malice againſt our Lord in the minde deuiſing preuarication.
label: Nahum

text: Thus ſaith our Lord: If they shal be perfect: and ſo a great manie, ſo alſo shal they be shorne, and he shal paſſe by: I haue afflicted thee, and I wil afflict thee no more.
label: Nahum

text: And now I wil breake his rod from of thy backe, and I wil burſt thy bondes in ſunder.
label: Nahum

text: And Our Lord wil command vpon thee, there shal not be ſowen of thy name any more: out of the houſe of thy God I wil deſtroy ſculptil, & molten, I wil put thy graue, becauſe thou art dishonored.
label: Nahum

text: Behold vpon the mountaines the feete of him that Euangalizeth, and preacheth peace: celebrate ô Iuda thy feſtiuities, & render thy vowes: becauſe Belial shal no more adde to paſſe through thee, he is wholly perished.
label: Nahum

text: HE is come vp that shal ſcatter before thee, that shal keepe the ſeige: behold the way, fortifie the loynes, ſtrengthen force excedingly.
label: Nahum

text: Becauſe our Lord hath rendered the pride of Iacob, as the pride of Iſrael: becauſe the waters haue diſſipated them, and haue marred their branches.
label: Nahum

text: The buckler of his valiants fyrie, the men of the armie in ſcarlets, the raynes of the chariot fyrie in the day of his preparation, and the driuers are brought aſleepe.
label: Nahum

text: In the wayes they are trubled, the chariots ſtrooke one agaynſt an other in the ſtreetes: their appearance are as it were lampes, as it were lightning running to and fro.
label: Nahum

text: He wil remember his valiants, they shal fal in their wayes: they shal quickly ſcale the walles therof, and a bowre shal be prepared.
label: Nahum

text: The gates of the riuers are opened, and the temple throwen downe to the ground.
label: Nahum

text: And the ſouldiar is led away captiue: and her handmayds were led away mourning as doues, murmuring in their hartes.
label: Nahum

text: And Niniue her waters as it were a fishpoole of waters: but themſelues are fled Stand ſtand, & there is none that wil returne.
label: Nahum

text: Spoile the ſiluer, ſpoile the gold: and there is no end of the riches of al veſſels that are to be deſired.
label: Nahum

text: She is diſſipated, and rent, and torne: and pyning hart, and diſſolution of the knees, and defect in al reynes: and the faces of them al as the blacknes of a pot.
label: Nahum

text: VVhere is the habitation of lions, & the paſture of lions welps, to which the lion went, to goe in thither, the lions whelpe, and is there none to make them afrayd?
label: Nahum

text: The lion hath caught ſufficiently for his welpes, and hath killed for his lioneſſes: and he hath filled his dennes with praye, and his couch with rauening.
label: Nahum

text: Behold I to thee, ſaith the Lord of hoſts, and I wil burne thy chariots euen to ſmoke, and the ſword shal eate thy litle lions: and I wil deſtroy thy praye out of the land, and the voice of thy meſſengers shal be heard no more.
label: Nahum

text: WO to thee ô citie of blouds, al of lying ful of tearing: ſpoile shal not depart from thee.
label: Nahum

text: The voice of the whippe, and the voice of the violence of the wheele, & of the neighing horſe, and of the feruent chariot, and of the horſman mounting.
label: Nahum

text: And of the gliſtering ſword, and of the glittering ſpeare, and of a multitude ſlaine, and of a greuous ruine: neither is there an end of corſes, and they shal fal on their bodies.
label: Nahum

text: Becauſe of the multitude of the fornications, of the harlot beautiful & gratful, and hauing ſorceries, which hath ſold nations in her fornications, & families in her ſorceries.
label: Nahum

text: Behold I to thee, ſayth the Lord of hoſts: and I wil diſcouer thy priuie parts in thy face, and wil shew to the Gentils thy nakednes, & to kingdoms thine ignominie.
label: Nahum

text: And I wil throw vpon thee abominations, and wil vſe thee contumeliouſly, and wil put thee for an example.
label: Nahum

text: And it shal be, euerie one that shal ſee thee, shal leape backe from thee, and shal ſay: Niniue is waſted: who shal shake the head vpon thee? whence shal I ſeeke a cõforter for thee?
label: Nahum

text: Why, art thou better then Alexandria ful of peoples, which dwelleth in the riuers? waters round about it: whoſe riches, the ſea: waters the walles therof.
label: Nahum

text: Æthiopia the ſtrength of it, and Ægypt, & there is no end: Afrike, and the Libyans haue bene in thine ayde.
label: Nahum

text: But she alſo in tranſmigration was led into captiuitie: her litle ones were dashed in the head of al wayes, and vpon her noble ones, they haue caſt lot, and al her great men were made faſt in fetters.
label: Nahum

text: Thou alſo therfore shalt be made drunke, and shal be deſpiſed: and thou shalt ſeeke helpe of the enemie.
label: Nahum

text: Al thy munitions as figtrees with their grene figges: if they be shaken, they wil fal into the mouth of the eater.
label: Nahum

text: Behold thy people wemen in the middes of thee: to thine enimies the gates of thy land with opening shal be opened, fyre shal deuoure thy barres.
label: Nahum

text: Draw thee water for the ſiege, build thy munitions: enter into the clay, and tread, making morter hold the bricke.
label: Nahum

text: There the fyre shal eate thee: thou shalt perish by the ſword, as a bruke it shal deuoure thee: be gathered together as the bruke, be multiplied as the locuſt.
label: Nahum

text: Thou haſt made thy merchandiſes more then are the ſtarres of heauen: the bruke was ſpred, & flew away.
label: Nahum

text: Thy kepers as the locuſts: & thy litle ones as it were the locuſts of locuſts, which ſwarme on the hedges in the day of could: the ſunne aroſe, & they flew away, and their place was not knowen where they were.
label: Nahum

text: Thy paſtours ſlumbred, ô King of Aſſur, thy princes shal be buried thy people lay hid in the mountaynes, and there is none to gather them together.
label: Nahum

text: Thy deſtruction is not obſcure, thy plague is very ſore: al that haue heard the fame of thee, haue clapped the hand vpon thee: for vpon whom hath not thy malice paſſed alwayes?
label: Nahum

text: THE burden that Habacuc the prophete ſaw.
label: Habacuc

text: How long ô Lord shal I crie, and thou wilt not heare? shal I crie out to thee ſuffering violence, and thou wilt not ſaue?
label: Habacuc

text: Why haſt thou shewed me iniquitie and labour, to ſee praye and iniuſtice againſt me? and iudgement is made, & contradiction more mightie.
label: Habacuc

text: For this cauſe is the law torne, & iudgement came not to the end: becauſe the impious preuaileth agaynſt the iuſt, therfore doth there come forth peruerte iudgement.
label: Habacuc

text: Behold ye in the nations, and ſee: meruel, and be aſtonied: becauſe a worke is done in your dayes, which no man wil beleue when it shal be told.
label: Habacuc

text: Becauſe loe I wil rayſe vp the Chaldees, a bitter & ſwift nation, walking vpon the latitude of the earth, to poſſeſſe tabernacles not their owne.
label: Habacuc

text: It is horrible, and terrible: out of it ſelf shal the iudgement, and the burden therof procede.
label: Habacuc

text: His horſes lighter then leopards, and ſwifter then euening wolues; and his horſemen shal be ſpred abrode, for his horſemen shal come from a far, they shal flie as an eagle haſtening to eate.
label: Habacuc

text: Al shal come to the praye, their faces a burning winde: & he shal gather together as the ſand, captiuitie.
label: Habacuc

text: And he shal triumph ouer kinges, & tyrants shal be his laughing flocke, and he shal laugh vpon euerie munition, and shal caſt vp a mount, and shal take it.
label: Habacuc

text: Then shal the ſpirit be changed, and he shal paſſe, & fal: this is his ſtrength of his God.
label: Habacuc

text: Why waſt thou not from the beginning ô Lord my God, my holie one, & we shal not dye? Lord thou haſt appoynted him for iudgement: and ſtrong to chaſtiſe, thou haſt founded him.
label: Habacuc

text: Thine eyes are cleane, from ſeing euil, & thou canſt not looke toward iniquitie. Why lookeſt thou not vpon them that doe vniuſt thinges, & holdeſt thy peace when the impious deuoureth him that is more iuſt then him ſelf?
label: Habacuc

text: And thou wilt make men as the fishes of the ſea, & as the creeping beaſt not hauing a prince.
label: Habacuc

text: He lifted vp al in the hooke, he drew it in his traine, and gathered it into his nette: vpon this he wil be glad and reioyce.
label: Habacuc

text: Therfore wil he immolate to his trayne, and he wil ſacrifice do his nette: becauſe by them his portion is fatte, and his meate choſen.
label: Habacuc

text: For this cauſe therfore ſpreddeth he his trayne, and alwayes tô kil the nations he wil not ſpare.
label: Habacuc

text: I WIL ſtand vpon my watch, and fixe my ſteppe vpon the munition: and I wil behold, to ſee what may be ſayd to me, and what I may anſwer to him that rebuketh me.
label: Habacuc

text: And our Lord anſwered me, & ſayd: Write the viſion, & make it playne vpon tables: that he which runneth may read it ouer.
label: Habacuc

text: Becauſe as yet the viſion is far, and it shal appeare at the end, and shal not lye: if he shal make tariance, expect him: becauſe coming he wil come, & he wil not ſlacke.
label: Habacuc

text: Behold he that is incredulous, his ſoule shal not be right in him ſelf: but the iuſt shal liue in his faith.
label: Habacuc

text: And as wine deceiueth him that drinketh: ſo shal the prowd man be, and he shal not be beautified: who as it were hel, hath dilated his ſoule: and himſelf as death, and he is not filled: and he hath gathered together vnto him al nations, and hath heaped together vnto him al peoples.
label: Habacuc

text: Why, shal not al theſe take vp a parable vpon him, and a ſpeach of obſcure ſayings of him: and it be ſayd: Wo to him, that multiplieth thinges not his owne? how long alſo doth he agrauat againſt himſelf thicke clay?
label: Habacuc

text: Why, shal they not riſe ſodenly, that shal bite thee: and they that teare thee, be rayſed vp, and thou be for a ſpoile to them?
label: Habacuc

text: Becauſe thou haſt ſpoiled manie nations, al that shal be left of the peoples shal ſpoile thee: for the bloud of man, and the iniquitie of the land, of the citie, and of al that dwel therein.
label: Habacuc

text: Wo to him that gathereth together naughtie auarice to his houſe, that his neſt may be on high, and thinketh he is deliuered out of the hand of euil.
label: Habacuc

text: Thou haſt thought confuſion to thy houſe, thou haſt cut in ſunder manie peoples, and thy ſoule hath ſinned.
label: Habacuc

text: Becauſe the ſtone out of the wal shal crie: and the timber, that is betwen the iunctures of the buildings, shal anſwer.
label: Habacuc

text: Wo to him that buildeth a citie in blouds, and prepareth a citie in iniquitie.
label: Habacuc

text: Why, are not theſe thinges from the Lord of hoſts? For the peoples shal labour in much fire: and the nations in vaine, and they shal faynt.
label: Habacuc

text: Becauſe the earth shal be replenished, that they may know the glorie of our Lord, as waters couering the ſea.
label: Habacuc

text: Wo to him that geueth drinke to his freind, putting in his gal, and making drunke, that he may behold his nakednes.
label: Habacuc

text: Thou art filled with ignominie for glorie, drinke thou alſo, and be faſt a ſleepe: the cuppe of the right hand of our Lord shal compaſſe thee, and the vomite of ignominie vpon thy glorie.
label: Habacuc

text: Becauſe the iniquitie of Libanus shal couer thee, and the waſting of the beaſts shal terrifie them for the blouds of men, and the iniquitie of the land, and of the citie, and of al that dwel therein.
label: Habacuc

text: What profiteth the thing engrauen, that the forger therof hath grauen it, a molten, and a falſe image? becauſe the forger therof hath hoped in his forgerie, to make dumme idols.
label: Habacuc

text: Wo vnto him that ſayth to wood: Awake: Ariſe, to the dumme ſtone. Why, can it teach? Behold, this ſame is couered with gold, and ſiluer: and there is no ſpirit in the bowels therof.
label: Habacuc

text: But our Lord is in his holie temple: let al the earth be ſilent at his preſence.
label: Habacuc

text: The prayer of Habacuc the prophet for ignorances.
label: Habacuc

text: LORD I heard thy hearing, and was afrayd. Lord thy worke in the middes of yeares, quicken it: In the middes of yeares shalt thou make it knowen: when thou art angrie, thou wilt remember mercie.
label: Habacuc

text: God wil come from the South, and the holie one from mount Pharan: His glorie shal couer the heauens, and the earth is ful of his prayſe.
label: Habacuc

text: His brightnes shal be as the light, hornes in his handes: There is his ſtrength hid.
label: Habacuc

text: Before his face shal death goe. and the deuil shal goe forth before his feete.
label: Habacuc

text: He ſtood and meaſured the earth. he beheld, and diſſolued the Gentils: and the mountaines of the world were broken. The hilles of the world were bowed, by the wayes of his eternitie.
label: Habacuc

text: For iniquitie I ſaw the tents of Æthiopia, the skinnes of the land of Madian shal be trubled.
label: Habacuc

text: Why, waſt thou angrie with the riuers ô Lord? or was thy furie in the riuers? or thine indignation in the ſea? Who wilt mount vpon thy horſes, and thy chariots ſaluation.
label: Habacuc

text: Rayſing thou wilt rayſe vp thy bow: the othe to the tribes which thou haſt ſpoken. Thou wilt cutte the riuers of the earth.
label: Habacuc

text: The mountaines ſaw thee, and were ſorie, the gulfe of water paſſed. The depth gaue his voice: the height lifted vp his handes.
label: Habacuc

text: The ſunne, and the moone ſtood in their habitation, in the light of thine arrowes, they shal goe in the brightnes of thy glittering ſpeare.
label: Habacuc

text: In freating thou wilt treade downe the earth: in furie thou wilt aſtonish the Gentils.
label: Habacuc

text: Thou wentſt forth the ſaluation of thy people: ſaluation with thy Chriſt. Thou ſtrokeſt the head out of the houſe of the impious, thou haſt diſcouered the fundation euen to the neck.
label: Habacuc

text: Thou haſt curſed his ſcepters, the head of his warriers, them that come as a whirlewinde to diſperſe me. Their exultation, as his that deuoureth the poore in ſecrete.
label: Habacuc

text: Thou madeſt a way in the ſea for thy horſes, in the middes of manie waters.
label: Habacuc

text: I heard, and my bellie was trubled: at the voice my lippes trembled. let rottenes enter in my bones, & ſwarme vnder me. That I may reſt in the day of tribulation: that I may aſcend to our girded people.
label: Habacuc

text: For the figtree shal not florish: and there shal be no ſpring in the vines. The worke of the oliuetree shal deceiue: and the fields shal not yeld meate: the cattel shal be cut of from the fold, and there shal be no heard in the ſtalles.
label: Habacuc

text: But I wil ioy in our Lord: and wil reioyce in God my IESVS.
label: Habacuc

text: God our Lord is my ſtrength: and he wil make my feete as of the harts. and vpon my high places he the conquerer wil lead me ſinging in pſalmes.
label: Habacuc

text: THE word of our Lord that was made to Sophonie the ſonne of Chuſi, the ſonne of Godolias, the ſonne of Amarias, the ſonne of Ezechias, in the dayes of Ioſias the ſonne of Amon king of Iuda.
label: Sophonias

text: Gathering I wil gather together al thinges from the face of the earth, ſayth our Lord:
label: Sophonias

text: gathering man, and beaſt, gathering the foules of the heauen, and fishes of the ſea: and there shal be ruines of the impious: and I wil deſtroy men from the face of the earth, ſayth our Lord.
label: Sophonias

text: And I wil ſtretch forth my hand vpon Iuda, and vpon al the inhabitantes of Ieruſalem: and I wil deſtroy out of this place the remnant of Baal, and the names of the templewardens with the prieſts:
label: Sophonias

text: and them that adore vpon the toppes of houſes the hoſt of heauen, and adore, and ſweare by our Lord, and ſweare by Melchom.
label: Sophonias

text: And them that turne away from after the backe of our Lord, and that haue not ſought our Lord, nor ſearched after him.
label: Sophonias

text: Be ſilent before the face of our Lord God: becauſe the day of our Lord is nere, becauſe our Lord hath prepared an hoſt, he hath ſanctified his called.
label: Sophonias

text: And it shal be: in the day of the hoſt of our Lord I wil viſite vpon the princes, and vpon the kinges ſonnes, and vpon al that are clothed with ſtrange clothing:
label: Sophonias

text: and I wil viſite vpon euerie one, that arrogantly entereth vpon the threshold in that day, them that fil the houſe of our Lord their God with iniquitie, & guile.
label: Sophonias

text: And it shal be in that day, ſayth our Lord, the voice of clamor from the gate of fishes, and howling from the ſecond, and great deſtruction from the hilles.
label: Sophonias

text: Howle ye inhabitants of the Morter. Al the people of Chanaan is hush, al are perished that were wrapped in ſiluer.
label: Sophonias

text: & it shal be in that time: I wil ſearch Ieruſalem with lampes, and wil viſite vpon the men that are fixed in their dregges: that ſay in their hartes: The Lord wil not doe good, and he wil not doe euil.
label: Sophonias

text: And their ſtrength shal be into ſpoile, and their houſes as a deſert: and they shal build houſes, and shal not inhabite them: and shal plant vineyards, & shal not drinke the wine of them.
label: Sophonias

text: The great day of our Lord is neere, it is neere and exceding ſwift: the voice of the day of our Lord is bitter, the ſtrong shal there haue tribulation.
label: Sophonias

text: That day a day of wrath, a day of tribulation and diſtreſſe, a day of calamitie and miſerie, a day of darknes and miſt, a day of clowde & whirlewind:
label: Sophonias

text: a day of the trumpet and ſound vpon the fenſed cities, & vpon the high corners.
label: Sophonias

text: And I wil afflict men, and they shal walke as blindmen, becauſe they haue ſinned to our Lord: and their bloud shal be powred out as duſt, and their bodies as dung.
label: Sophonias

text: Yea and their ſiluer, and their gold shal not be able to deliuer them in the day of the wrath of our Lord: in the fire of his ielouſie shal al the earth be deuoured, becauſe he wil make conſummation with ſpeede to al that inhabit the earth.
label: Sophonias

text: COME together, be ye gathered together ô nation not to be beloued:
label: Sophonias

text: before that the commandment bring forth the day as duſt paſſing away, before the wrath of the furie of our Lord come vpon you, before the day of the indignation of our Lord come vpon you.
label: Sophonias

text: Seeke our Lord al ye meeke of the earth, which haue wrought his iudgement: ſeeke the iuſt, ſeeke the meeke: if by any meanes you may be hid in the day of the furie of our Lord.
label: Sophonias

text: Becauſe Gaza is deſtroyed, and Aſcalon as a deſert, Azotus at noone they shal caſt out, and Accaron shal be rooted out.
label: Sophonias

text: Wo to you that inhabite the cord of the ſea, ô nation of caſtawayes: the word of our Lord vpon you ô Chanaan land of the Philiſthims, and I wil deſtroy thee, ſo that there shal not be an inhabiter.
label: Sophonias

text: And the cord of the ſea shal be the reſt of paſtours, and foldes of cattel.
label: Sophonias

text: and it shal be the cord of him, that shal remayne of the houſe of Iuda, there they shal feede: in the houſes of Aſcalon at euen they shal reſt: becauſe our Lord their God wil viſite them, and turne away their captiuitie.
label: Sophonias

text: I haue heard the reproch of Moab, and the blaſphemies of the children of Ammon, with which they haue vpbrayded my people, and were magnified vpon their borders.
label: Sophonias

text: Therfore liue I, ſayth the Lord of hoſts the God of Iſrael, that Moab shal be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrha, drynes of thornes, and heapes of ſalt, and a deſert euen for euer: the remnant of my people shal ſpoile them, and the reſidue of my nation shal poſſeſſe them.
label: Sophonias

text: This shal befal them for their pride: becauſe they haue blaſphemed, and haue beene magnified vpon the people of the Lord of hoſts.
label: Sophonias

text: Our Lord shal be dreadful vpon them, and shal attenuate al the goddes of the earth: and they shal adore him euerie man out of his owne place, al the ilands of the Gentils.
label: Sophonias

text: Yea and you Æthiopians shal be ſlaine with my ſword.
label: Sophonias

text: And he wil ſtretch forth his hand vpon the North, and wil deſtroy Aſſur: and he wil lay the Beautiful as a wildernes, and as a place not paſſable, and as a deſert.
label: Sophonias

text: And flockes shal lie in the middes therof, al the beaſtes of the Gentils: and onocratulus, and the Itchin shal abide in the thresholdes therof: the voice of one ſinging in the window, the rauen on the vpper poſt, becauſe I wil attenuate her ſtrength.
label: Sophonias

text: This is the glorious citie dwelling in confidence: that ſayd in her hart: I am, and beſide me there is none other els: how is she become as a deſert the couche for beaſtes? euerie one that paſſeth by her, shal hiſſe, and wag his hand.
label: Sophonias

text: WO TO thee thou prouoking, and redemed citie, the doue.
label: Sophonias

text: She hath not heard the voice, and she hath not receiued diſcipline: she hath not truſted in our Lord, to her God she hath not approched.
label: Sophonias

text: Her princes in the middes of her as lions roarnig: her iudges wolues in the euening, left nothing for the morning.
label: Sophonias

text: Her prophets madde, men vnfaythful: her prieſts haue polluted the holie, they haue done vniuſtly agaynſt the law.
label: Sophonias

text: Our iuſt Lord in the middes therof wil not doe iniquitie: in the morning in the morning he wil geue his iudgement into light, and it shal not be hid: but the wicked man hath not knowen the confuſion.
label: Sophonias

text: I haue deſtroyed the Gentils, & their corners are diſſipated: I haue made their wayes deſert, whiles there is none that paſſeth by: their cities are deſolate, not a man remayning, nor any inhabiter.
label: Sophonias

text: I ſayd: Neuertheles thou shalt feare me, thou shalt receiue diſcipline: and her habitation shal not perish for al thinges, wherin I haue viſited her: but yet ryſing early they corrupted al their cagitations.
label: Sophonias

text: ¶ Wherfore expect me, ſayth our Lord, in the day of my reſurrection til hereafter, becauſe my iudgement to aſſemble the Gentils, and to gather kingdomes: & to powre vpon them mine indignation, al the wrath of my furie: for in the fyre of my ielouſie shal al the earth be deuoured.
label: Sophonias

text: Becauſe then wil I reſtore to the peoples, a choſen lippe, that al may inuocate in the name of the Lord, & may ſerue him with one shoulder.
label: Sophonias

text: Beyond the riuers of Æthiopia, thence shal my ſuppliants the children of my diſperſed bring me a gift.
label: Sophonias

text: In that day thou shalt not be confounded vpon al thine inuentions, wherin thou haſt preuaricated againſt me: becauſe then wil I take away out of the middes of thee the loftie ſpeakers of thy pride, & thou shalt adde no more to be exalted in my holie mount.
label: Sophonias

text: And I wil leaue in the middes of thee a people poore and needie: & they shal hope in the name of our Lord.
label: Sophonias

text: The remnant of Iſrael shal not doe iniquitie, neyther shal they ſpeake leaſing, and deceitful tongue shal not be found in their mouth: becauſe they shal feede, and shal lie downe, and there shal be none to make them afrayd.
label: Sophonias

text: Prayſe ô daughter of Sion: make iubilation Iſrael: be glad, & reioyce in al thy hart ô daughter of Ieruſalem.
label: Sophonias

text: Our Lord hath taken away thy iudgement, he hath turned away thine enemies: the king of Iſrael our Lord in the middes of thee, thou shalt feare euil no more.
label: Sophonias

text: In that day it shal be ſayd to Ieruſalem: Feare not: to Sion, let not thy handes be diſſolued.
label: Sophonias

text: Our Lord thy God in the middes of thee ſtrong, he wil ſaue: he wil reioyce vpon thee in gladnes, he wil be ſilent in his loue, he wil be ioyful vpon thee in prayſe.
label: Sophonias

text: The etriflers that were departed from thee, I wil gather together, becauſe they were of thee: that thou mayſt no more haue reproch for them.
label: Sophonias

text: Behold I wil kil al that haue afflicted thee at that time: and I wil ſaue the halt, & her that was caſt out I wil gather: and I wil make them into prayſe, and into name, in al the land of their confusion.
label: Sophonias

text: In that time, when I wil bring you: and in the time, that I wil gather you: for I wil geue you into a name, and into prayſe to al the people of the earth, when I shal conuert your captiuitie before your eyes, ſaith our Lord.
label: Sophonias

text: IN THE ſecond yeare of Darius the king, the ſixth moneth, in the firſt day of the moneth: the word of our Lord was made in the hand of Aggeus the prophet, to Zorobabel the ſonne of Salathiel, duke of Iuda, & to Ieſus the ſonne of Ioſedec the grandprieſt ſaing
label: Aggeus

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſtes, ſaying: This people ſayth: The time is not yet come of building the houſe of our Lord.
label: Aggeus

text: And the word of our Lord was made in the hand of Aggeus the prophete, ſaying:
label: Aggeus

text: Why is it time for you to dwel in embowed houſes, and this houſe deſert?
label: Aggeus

text: And now thus ſayth the Lord of hoſtes? Set your hartes vpon your wayes.
label: Aggeus

text: You haue ſowed much, and brought in litle: you haue eaten, and haue not bene filled: you haue drunke, and haue not bene inebriated: you haue couered your ſelues, & haue not bene warmed: and he that hath gathered the wages, put them into a broken bag.
label: Aggeus

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: Set your harts vpon your wayes:
label: Aggeus

text: go vp into the mountayne, carie timber, and build the houſe: and it shal be acceptable to me, and I shal be glorified, ſayth our Lord.
label: Aggeus

text: You haue looked for more, and behold it became leſſe, and you brought it into the houſe, and I puft at it: for what cauſe ſayth the Lord of hoſts? becauſe my houſe is deſert, and you haſten euerie man into his owne houſe.
label: Aggeus

text: For this cauſe were the heauens ſtayed ouer you that they gaue no dew, and the earth was prohibited that it yelded not her ſpring:
label: Aggeus

text: and I called a drought vpon the earth, & vpon the montaines, and vpon the wheate, and vpon the wine, and vpon the oile, and what thinges ſoeuer the ground brought forth, & vpon men, & vpon beaſtes, & vpon al the labour of the handes.
label: Aggeus

text: And Zorobabel the ſonne of Salathiel, and Ieſus the ſonne of Ioſedec the high prieſt, & al the remnant of the people heard the voice of their God, & the wordes of Aggeus the prophet, as our Lord their God ſent him to them: & the people feared at the face of our Lord.
label: Aggeus

text: And Aggeus the meſſenger of our Lord, of the meſſengers of our Lord ſpake, ſaying to the people: I am with you, ſayth our Lord.
label: Aggeus

text: And our Lord rayſed vp the ſpirit of Zorobabel the ſonne of Salathiel duke of Iuda, and the ſpirit of Ieſus the ſonne of Ioſedec the grandprieſt, and the ſpirit of the reſt of al the people: and they went in, and did the worke in the houſe of the Lord of hoſtes their God.
label: Aggeus

text: IN the foure and twenteth day of the moneth, in the ſixth moneth, in the ſecond yeare of Darius the king.
label: Aggeus

text: In the ſeuenth moneth, the one and twentith of the moneth, the word of our Lord was made in the hand of Aggeus the prophet, ſaying:
label: Aggeus

text: Speake to Zorobabel the ſonne of Salathiel the duke of Iuda, & to Ieſus the ſonne of Ioſedec the grand prieſt, and to the reſt of the people, ſaying:
label: Aggeus

text: Who among you is left, that ſaw this houſe in the firſt glorie therof? & what do you ſee this ſame now? Why, is it not ſo, as if it were not in your eyes?
label: Aggeus

text: And now take courege Zorobabel, ſaith our Lord, and take courege Ieſus the ſonne of Ioſedec grand prieſt, and take courege al ye people of the land, ſaith the Lord of hoſtes: and doe (becauſe I am with you, ſayth the Lord of hoſts)
label: Aggeus

text: the word that I did couenant with you when you came out of the Land of Ægypt: and my ſpirit shal be in the middes of you: feare not.
label: Aggeus

text: Becauſe thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: As yet there is one litle while, and I wil moue the heauen, & the earth, and the ſea, and the drie land.
label: Aggeus

text: And I wil moue al nations: AND THE DESIRED OF AL NATIONS SHAL COME: and I wil fil this houſe with glorie, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Aggeus

text: Mine is the ſiluer, and mine is the gold, ſayth the Lord of hoſtes.
label: Aggeus

text: Great shal be the glorie of this laſt houſe more then of the firſt, ſayth the Lord of hoſts: and in this place wil I geue peace, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Aggeus

text: In the foure and twentith of the ninth moneth, in the ſecond yeare of Darius the king, the word of our Lord was made to Aggeus the prophet, ſaying:
label: Aggeus

text: Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſts: Aske the prieſts the law, ſaying:
label: Aggeus

text: If a man take ſanctified flesh in the skirt of his garment, and touch with the skirt therof bread, or broth, or wine, or oile, or any meate: shal it be ſanctified? And the prieſts anſwering, ſaid: No.
label: Aggeus

text: And Aggeus ſayd: If one polluted on a ſoule touch any of al theſe, shal he be contaminated? And the prieſts anſwered, and ſayd, he shal be contaminated.
label: Aggeus

text: And Aggeus anſwered, and ſayd: So this people, and ſo this nation before my face, ſayth our Lord, and ſo al the worke of their handes: & al that they haue offered there, shal be contaminated.
label: Aggeus

text: And now ſet your hartes, from this day and vpward, before there was ſtone layd vpon ſtone in the temple of our Lord.
label: Aggeus

text: When you went to an heape of twentie bushels, & they became ten: and entered into the preſſe, to preſſe out fiftie flagons, & they became twentie.
label: Aggeus

text: I ſtroke you with the burning winde, and with the blaſt, and with haile, al the workes of your handes: and there was none among you, that returned to me, ſaith our Lord.
label: Aggeus

text: Set your hartes from this day, and henceforward, from the foure and twenteth day of the ninth moneth: from the day that the fundations of the temple of our Lord were layd, lay it vpon your hartes.
label: Aggeus

text: Is there the ſeede now abreward? and as yet the wine, and the figtree, and the pomegranate, and the oliue tree hath not florished? from this day I wil bleſſe.
label: Aggeus

text: And the word of our Lord was made the ſecond time to Aggeus in the foure and twentith of the moneth, ſaying:
label: Aggeus

text: Speake to Zorobabel the duke of Iuda, ſaying: I wil moue the heauen and alſo the earth.
label: Aggeus
