text: And I wil ouerthrow the throne of kingdoms, & wil deſtroy the ſtrength of the kingdom of the Gentils: and I wil ouerthrow the chariote, and the rider therof: and the horſes shal come downe, and the riders of them, euerie one by the ſword of his brother.
label: Aggeus

text: In that day, ſayth the Lord of hoſts, I wil take thee ô Zorobabel ſonne of Salathiel my ſeruant, ſaith our Lord, and wil put thee as a ſignet, becauſe thee haue I choſen, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Aggeus

text: IN THE eight moneth in the ſecond yeare of king Darius the word of our Lord was made to Zacharie the ſonne of Barachias, the ſonne of Addo, the prophet, ſaying:
label: Zacharias

text: Our Lord hath bene wrath vpon your fathers with wrath.
label: Zacharias

text: And thou shalt ſay to them: Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſts: Conuert to me, ſayth the Lord of hoſts: and I wil conuert to you, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Zacharias

text: Be not as your fathers, to whom the former prophets cried, ſaying: Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſts: Conuert from your euil wayes, & from your moſt wicked thoughts: and they heard not, neither attended to me, ſayth our Lord.
label: Zacharias

text: Your fathers where are they? and the prophets shal they liue for euer?
label: Zacharias

text: But yet my wordes, & mine ordinances, which I gaue in commandment to my ſeruants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers, and they conuerted, & ſayd: As the Lord of hoſts thought to do to vs according to our wayes, & according to our inuentions, he hath done to vs.
label: Zacharias

text: In the foure & twentith day of the eleuenth moneth Sabath: in the ſecond yeare of Darius, the word of our Lord was made to Zacharie the ſonne of Barachias, the ſonne of Addo, the prophet, ſaying:
label: Zacharias

text: I ſaw by night, and behold a man mounting vpon a red horſe, & he ſtood among the myrtletrees, that were in the bottome: and after him horſes red, ſpeckled, and white.
label: Zacharias

text: And I ſayd: What are theſe, my Lord? and the Angel that ſpake in me, ſayd to me: I wil shew thee what theſe thinges are.
label: Zacharias

text: And the man, that ſtood among the myrtle trees anſwered, & ſayd: Theſe are they, whom our Lord ſent to walke through the earth.
label: Zacharias

text: And they anſwered to the Angel of our Lord, which ſtood among the mirtle trees, & ſayd: We haue walked through the earth, and loe al the earth is inhabited, and at reſt.
label: Zacharias

text: And the Angel of our Lord anſwered, and ſayd: ô Lord of hoſts, how long wilt thou not haue mercie on Ieruſalem, and on the cities of Iuda, with which thou haſt bene angrie? this now is the ſeuentith yeare.
label: Zacharias

text: And our Lord anſwered the Angel, that ſpake in me, good wordes, comfortable wordes.
label: Zacharias

text: And the Angel that ſpake in me, ſayd to me: Crie, ſaying: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: I haue bene zelous for Ieruſalem, and Sion with great zele.
label: Zacharias

text: And with great anger am I angrie vpon the welthie nations: becauſe I was angrie a litle, but they helped toward the euil.
label: Zacharias

text: Therfore thus ſaith our Lord: I wil returne to Ieruſalem in mercies: my houſe shal be built in it, ſaith the Lord of hoſts: & the plumme line shal be ſtretched forth vpon Ieruſalem.
label: Zacharias

text: As yet crie thou ſaying: Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſts: As yet shal my cities flow with good thinges: and the Lord wil yet comfort Sion, and he wil yet chooſe Ieruſalem.
label: Zacharias

text: And I lifted vp mine eyes, and ſaw: and behold foure hornes.
label: Zacharias

text: And I ſayd to the Angel, that ſpake in me: What are theſe: And he ſayd to me: Theſe are the hornes that haue ſcattered Iuda, and Iſrael, and Ieruſalem.
label: Zacharias

text: And our Lord shewed me foure artificers.
label: Zacharias

text: And I ſayd: What come theſe to doe? Who ſpake ſaying: Theſe are the hornes, that ſcattered Iuda euerie man a part, & none of them lifted his head: and theſe are come to fray them, to caſt downe the hornes of the nations, that haue lifted the horne vpon the land of Iuda to ſcatter it.
label: Zacharias

text: AND I lifted vp mine eyes, and ſaw: and loe a man, and in his hand a corde of meaſurers.
label: Zacharias

text: And I ſayd: Whither goeſt thou? And he ſayd to me: To meaſure Ieruſalem, and to ſee how great the breadth therof is, and how great the length therof.
label: Zacharias

text: And behold the Angel that ſpake in me, came forth, and an other Angel went out to meete him.
label: Zacharias

text: And he ſayd to him: Runne, ſpeake to this yongman ſaying: Without wal shal Ieruſalem be inhabited for the multitude of men, and of beaſts in the middes therof.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil be to it, ſayth our Lord, a wal of fire round about: and I wil be in glorie in the middes therof.
label: Zacharias

text: O flee ye out of the land of the North, ſaith our Lord, becauſe into the foure windes of heauen haue I diſperſed you, ſayth our Lord.
label: Zacharias

text: O Sion, flee thou that dwelleſt with the daughter of Babylon:
label: Zacharias

text: becauſe thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: After glorie he ſent me to the nations, that haue ſpoiled you: for he that shal touch you, toucheth the apple of myne eye:
label: Zacharias

text: becauſe loe I lift vp my hand vpon them, and they shal be a praye to thoſe that ſerued them: and you shal know that the Lord of hoſts ſent me.
label: Zacharias

text: Prayſe, and reioyce ô daughter of Sion: becauſe loe I come, and wil dwel in the middes of thee, ſayth our Lord.
label: Zacharias

text: And manie nations shal be ioyned to our Lord in that day, and they shal be my people, and I wil dwel in the middes of thee: and thou shal know that the Lord of hoſts hath ſent me to thee.
label: Zacharias

text: And our Lord wil poſſeſſe Iuda his portion in the ſanctified land: and he wil yet chooſe Ieruſalem.
label: Zacharias

text: Let al flesh be ſilent at the preſence of our Lord: becauſe he is riſen vp out of his holie habitation.
label: Zacharias

text: AND our Lord shewed me Ieſus the grand prieſt ſtanding before the Angel of our Lord: and Satan ſtood on his right hand, to be his aduerſarie.
label: Zacharias

text: And our Lord ſayd to Satan: The Lord geue rebuke on thee Satan: and the Lord that choſe Ieruſalem geue rebuke on thee: Why, is not this a firebrand, taken out of the fire?
label: Zacharias

text: And Ieſus was clothed with filthie garments: and he ſtood before the face of the Angel.
label: Zacharias

text: Who anſwered, and ſayd to them that ſtood before him, ſaying: Take away the filthie garments from him. And he ſayd to him: Behold I haue taken away thine iniquitie, and haue clothed thee with change of garments.
label: Zacharias

text: And he ſaid: Put a cleane mitre vpon his head: & they put a cleane mitre vpon his head, and clothed him with garments: and the Angel of our Lord ſtood.
label: Zacharias

text: And the Angel of our Lord conteſted Ieſus, ſaying:
label: Zacharias

text: Thus ſaith the Lord of hoſts: If you wil walke in my wayes, and keepe my watch, thou alſo shalt iudge my houſe, and shalt keepe my courts, and I wil geue thee walkers of them that now aſſiſt here.
label: Zacharias

text: Heare ô Ieſus thou grand prieſt, thou and thy frendes that dwel before thee, becauſe they are portending men: for behold I WIL BRING MY SERVANT THE ORIENT.
label: Zacharias

text: Becauſe loe the ſtone that I layd before Ieſus: vpon one ſtone there be ſeuen eyes, behold I wil graue the grauing therof, ſayth the Lord of hoſts: & I wil take away the iniquitie of that land in one day.
label: Zacharias

text: In that day, ſayth the Lord of hoſts, euerie man shal cal his frende vnder the vine and vnder the figtree.
label: Zacharias

text: AND the Angel returned that ſpake in me: and he rayſed me vp, as a man that is rayſed out of his ſleepe.
label: Zacharias

text: And he ſayd to me: What ſeeſt thou? And I ſayd: I ſaw, and loe a candleſticke al of gold, and the lampe therof vpon the head of it: and the ſeuen lights therof vpon it: and ſeuen funnels for the lights, that were vpon the head therof.
label: Zacharias

text: And two oliue trees vpon it: one on the right hand of the lampe, and one on the left hand therof.
label: Zacharias

text: And I anſwered, and I ſayd to the Angel that ſpake in me, ſaying: What are theſe thinges, my Lord?
label: Zacharias

text: And the Angel that ſpake in me anſwered, and ſayd to me: Why, knoweſt thou not what theſe thinges are? And I ſayd: No, my Lord.
label: Zacharias

text: And he anſwered, and ſayd to me, ſaying: This is the word of our Lord to Zorobabel, ſaying: Not in an hoſt, nor in ſtrength: but in my ſpirit, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Zacharias

text: Who art thou ô great mountayne before Zorobabel? into a plaine: and he wil bring forth the principal ſtone, and wil make grace equal to the grace therof.
label: Zacharias

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Zacharias

text: The handes of Zorobabel haue founded this houſe, and his handes shal perfite it: and you shal know that the Lord of hoſts hath ſent me to you.
label: Zacharias

text: For who hath deſpiſed litle dayes? and they shal reioyce, and shal ſee the ſtone of tinne in the hand of Zorobabel. Theſe are the ſeuen eyes of our Lord, that runne through out the whole earth.
label: Zacharias

text: And I anſwered, and ſayd to him: What are theſe two oliuetrees on the right hand of the candleſtike, and on the left hand therof?
label: Zacharias

text: And I anſwered the ſecond time, and ſayd to him: What are the two branches of oliuetrees, that are beſide the two beaks of gold, in which are the funnels of gold?
label: Zacharias

text: And he ſayd to me, ſaying: Why, knoweſt thou not what theſe are? And I ſayd: No, my Lord.
label: Zacharias

text: And he ſayd: Theſe are two ſonnes of oyle which aſſiſt the dominatour of the whole earth.
label: Zacharias

text: AND I turned and lifted vp myne eyes: and I ſaw, and behold a volume flying.
label: Zacharias

text: And he ſayd to me: What ſeeſt thou? And I ſayd: I ſee a volume flying: the length therof of twentie cubits, and the breadth therof of ten cubits.
label: Zacharias

text: And he ſayd to me: This is the malediction, that goeth forth vpon the face of the earth: becauſe euerie theefe, as is there written, shal be iudged: and euerie ſwearer, by it in like maner shal be iudged.
label: Zacharias

text: I wil bring it forth, ſayth the Lord of hoſts: and it shal come to the houſe of the theefe, and to the houſe of him that ſweareth by my name falſly: & it shal abide in the middes of his houſe, and shal conſume it, and the timber therof, and the ſtones therof.
label: Zacharias

text: And the Angel went out that ſpake in me: and he ſayd to me: Lift vp thine eyes, and ſee what is this, that goeth forth.
label: Zacharias

text: And I ſayd: What is it? And he ſayd: This is an amphore going forth. And he ſayd: This is their eye in al the earth.
label: Zacharias

text: And behold a talent of lead was caried, and loe one woman ſitting in the middes of the amphore.
label: Zacharias

text: And he ſayd: This is impietie. And he threw her in the middes of the amphore, and caſt a lumpe of lead vpon the mouth therof.
label: Zacharias

text: And I lifted vp mine eyes, and ſaw: and behold two wemen coming forth, and ſpirit in the winges of them, and they had winges as the winges of a kite: and they lifted vp the amphore betwen the earth and the heauen.
label: Zacharias

text: And I ſayd to the Angel that ſpake in me: Whither do theſe carie the amphore?
label: Zacharias

text: And he ſayd to me: That a houſe may be built for it in the land of Sennaar, and it may be eſtablished, and ſet there vpon the foundation therof.
label: Zacharias

text: AND I turned, and lifted vp mine eyes, and ſaw: and behold foure chariots coming forth from the middes of two mountaines: & the mountaines, mountaines of braſſe.
label: Zacharias

text: In the firſt chariot red horſes,& in the ſecond chariot blacke horſes,
label: Zacharias

text: and in the third chariot white horſes, and in the fourth chariot ſpeckled horſes, & ſtrong.
label: Zacharias

text: And I anſwered, and ſayd to the Angel, that ſpake in me: What are theſe thinges, my Lord?
label: Zacharias

text: And the Angel anſwered, and ſayd to me: Theſe are the foure windes of heauen, which goeforth to ſtand before the Dominatour of al the earth.
label: Zacharias

text: That, in which were the blacke horſes went forth into the land of the North, and the white went forth after them: and the ſpeckled went forth to the land of the South.
label: Zacharias

text: But they that were ſtrongeſt, went out, and ſought to goe, and to runne about through out al the earth. And he ſayd: Goe walke through out the earth: and they walked through out the earth.
label: Zacharias

text: And he called me, and ſpake to me, ſaying: Behold, they that goe forth into the land of the North, haue made my ſpirit to reſt in the land of the North.
label: Zacharias

text: And the word of our Lord was made to me, ſaying:
label: Zacharias

text: Take of the tranſmigration of Holdai, and of Tobias, and of Idaias: and thou shalt come in that day, and shalt enter into the houſe of Ioſias, the ſonne of Sophonias, who came out of Babylon.
label: Zacharias

text: And thou shalt take gold and ſiluer: & shalt make crownes, and thou shalt ſet on the head of Ieſus the ſonne of Ioſedec the grand prieſt,
label: Zacharias

text: and thou shalt ſpeake to him, ſaying: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts, ſaying: BEHOLD A MAN ORIENT IS HIS NAME: and vnder him shal ſpring vp, and shal build a temple to our Lord.
label: Zacharias

text: And he shal build a temple to our Lord: and shal beare glorie, and shal ſit, and rule vpon his throne: and he shal be a prieſt vpon his throne, and the counſel of peace shal be betwen them two.
label: Zacharias

text: And the crownes shal be to Helem, and Tobias, and Idaias, and Hem, the ſonne of Sophonias, a memorial in the temple of our Lord.
label: Zacharias

text: And they that are far, shal come, and shal build in the temple of our Lord: and you shal know that the Lord of hoſts ſent me to you. But this shal be, if hearing you wil heare the voice of our Lord your God.
label: Zacharias

text: AND it came to paſſe in the fourth yeare of Darius the king, the word of our Lord was made to Zacharie, in the fourth of the ninth moneth, which is Caſleu.
label: Zacharias

text: And Saraſar, and Rogommelech, and the men that were with him, ſent to the houſe of God, to beſech the face of our Lord:
label: Zacharias

text: that they should ſay to the prieſts of the houſe of the Lord of hoſts, and to the prophets, ſaying: Muſt I weepe in the fifth moneth, or muſt I ſanctifie myſelf as now I haue done manie yeares?
label: Zacharias

text: And the word of the Lord of hoſts was made to me, ſaying:
label: Zacharias

text: Speake to al the people of the land, and to the prieſts, ſaying: When you faſted, and mourned in the fifth and the ſeuenth for theſe ſeuentie yeares: did you faſt a faſt vnto me?
label: Zacharias

text: and when you did eate and drinke, did you not eate for your ſelues, and drinke for your ſelues?
label: Zacharias

text: Why, are they not the wordes, which our Lord ſpake in the hand of the former prophets, when Ieruſalem as yet was inhabited, and was welthie, it ſelf and the cities round about it, and toward the South, and in the champine there was dwelling?
label: Zacharias

text: And the word of our Lord was made to Zacharie, ſaying:
label: Zacharias

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts, ſaying: Iudge ye true Iudgement, and doe ye mercie, & miſerations euerie man with his brother.
label: Zacharias

text: And the widow, and the pupil, and the ſtranger, and the poore doe not calumniate: and let not a man thinke in his hart euil to his brother.
label: Zacharias

text: And they would not attend, and they turned away the shoulder departing: and they aggrauated their eares, not to heare.
label: Zacharias

text: And they made their hart as the adamant, leſt they should heare the law, & the wordes which the Lord ſent in his ſpirit by the hand of the former prophetes: and there was great indignation made from the Lord of hoſts.
label: Zacharias

text: And it came to paſſe as he ſpake, and they heard not: ſo shal they crie, & I wil not heare, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Zacharias

text: And I diſperſed them through out al kingdoms, which they know not: and the land was left deſolate of them, for that there was none paſſing & returning: and the land to be deſired they layd into a deſert.
label: Zacharias

text: AND the word of the Lord of hoſts was made, ſaying:
label: Zacharias

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſtes: I haue bene ielous for Sion with great zeale, and with great indignation haue I bene ielous for it.
label: Zacharias

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: I am returned to Sion, and I wil dwel in the middes of Ieruſalem: and Ieruſalem shal be called the Citie of truth, & the Mount of the Lord of hoſts, the ſanctified mount.
label: Zacharias

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: As yet shal old men dwel, and old wemen in the ſtreets of Ieruſalem: and euerie mans ſtafe in his hand for multitude of yeares.
label: Zacharias

text: And the ſtreets of the citie shal be filled with infantes, and girles playing in the ſtreets therof.
label: Zacharias

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: If it shal ſeme hard in the eyes of the remnant of this people in thoſe dayes: Why, shal it be hard in mine eyes, ſayth the Lord of hoſts?
label: Zacharias

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: Behold I wil ſaue my people from the land of the Eaſt, and from the land of the going downe of the ſunne.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil bring them, and they shal dwel in the middes of Ieruſalem: and they shal be my people, and I wilbe their God in truth and in iuſtice.
label: Zacharias

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: Let your handes be ſtrengthned, you that heare in theſe dayes theſe words by the mouth of the prophets in the day, that the houſe of the Lord of hoſts was founded, that the temple might be built.
label: Zacharias

text: For before thoſe dayes there was no hyre for men, neither was there hyre for beaſts, neither was there peace to the comer in, nor goer out for tribulation: and I did let goe al men, euerie one againſt his neighbour.
label: Zacharias

text: But now not according to the former dayes wil I doe to the remnant of this people, ſayth the Lord of hoſts,
label: Zacharias

text: but the ſeede of peace shal be: the vine shal geue his fruite, and the earth shal geue her ſpring, and the heauens shal geue their dew: and I wil make the remnant of this people to poſſeſſe al theſe thinges.
label: Zacharias

text: And it shal be: as you were a malediction among the Gentils, ô houſe of Iuda, & houſe of Iſrael: ſo wil I ſaue you, and you shal be a benediction: feare not, let your handes be ſtrengthned.
label: Zacharias

text: Becauſe thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: As I purpoſed to afflict you, when your fathers had prouoked me to wrath, ſayth our Lord,
label: Zacharias

text: and I had no mercie: ſo conuerting I haue meant in theſe dayes to doe good to the houſe of Iuda, and Ieruſalem: feare not.
label: Zacharias

text: Theſe then are the wordes, which you shal doe: Speake ye truth, euerie one with his neighbour: truth and iudgement of peace iudge ye in your gates.
label: Zacharias

text: And thinke ye not euerie man in your hart euil againſt his frend: & lying othe loue ye not: for al theſe things are ſuch as I hate, ſayth our Lord.
label: Zacharias

text: And the word of our Lord of hoſts was made to me, ſaying:
label: Zacharias

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: The faſt of the fourth, and the faſt of the fifth, and the faſt of the ſeuenth, and the faſt of the tenth shal be to the houſe of Iuda into ioy, and gladnes, & into goodlie ſolemnities: truth onlie, and peace loue ye.
label: Zacharias

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts, vntil peoples come, & dwel in manie cities,
label: Zacharias

text: and the inhabitants goe, one to an other, ſaying: Let vs goe, and beſech the face of our Lord, and let vs ſeeke the Lord of hoſts: I alſo wil goe.
label: Zacharias

text: And manie peoples shal come, and ſtrong nations to ſeeke the Lord of hoſts in Ieruſalem, & to beſech the face of our Lord.
label: Zacharias

text: Thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: In thoſe dayes, wherein ten men of al the tongue of the Gentils shal take hold, and they shal take hold of the skirt of a man that is a Iewe, ſaying: We wil goe with you: for we haue heard that God is with you.
label: Zacharias

text: THE burden of the word of our Lord in the land of Hadrach, & Damaſcus his reſt: becauſe our Lord is the eye of man, and of al the tribes of Iſrael.
label: Zacharias

text: Emath alſo in the borders therof, and Tyre, and Sidon: for they haue taken to themſelues wiſedom excedingly.
label: Zacharias

text: And Tyre hath built her munition, and heaped together ſiluer as earth, and gold as the myre of the ſtreets.
label: Zacharias

text: Behold our Lord shal poſſeſſe her, and shal ſtrike her ſtrength in the ſea, and she shal be deuoured with fyre.
label: Zacharias

text: Aſcalon shal ſee, and shal feare, and Gaza, and shal be ſorie excedingly: & Accaron, becauſe her hope is confounded: and the king shal perish out of Gaza, & Aſcalon shal not be inhabited.
label: Zacharias

text: And the ſeperatour shal ſit in Azotus, and I wil deſtroy the pride of the Philiſthims.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil take away his bloud out of his mouth, and his abominations out of the middes of his teeth: and he alſo shal be left to our God, and he shal be as a duke in Iuda, and Accaron as a Iebuſeite.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil enuiron my houſe of them, that ſerue me in warfayre going and returning, and the exactour shal no more paſſe ouer them: becauſe now I haue ſene with myne eyes.
label: Zacharias

text: Reioyce greatly ô daughter of Sion, make iubilation ô daughter of Ieruſalem: BEHOLD THY KING wil come to thee, the iuſt and ſauiour: himſelf poore, and ryding vpon an aſſe, and vpon a colt the fole of an aſſe.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil deſtroy chariot out of Ephraim, and horſe out of Ieruſalem, and the bow of warre shal be diſſipated: and he shal ſpeake peace to the Gentils, and his power from ſea euen to ſea, and from the riuers euen to the end of the earth.
label: Zacharias

text: Thou alſo in the bloud of thy teſtament haſt let forth thy priſoners out of the lake, wherin is no water.
label: Zacharias

text: Conuert to the munition ye priſoners of hope, to day alſo declaring I wil render thee duble.
label: Zacharias

text: Becauſe I haue bent Iuda for me as a bow, I haue filled Ephraim: and I wil rayſe vp thy ſonnes ô Sion vpon thy ſonnes ô Greece, & I wil make thee as the ſword of the ſtrong.
label: Zacharias

text: And our Lord God shal be ſeene ouer them, and his dart shal goe forth as lightning: & our Lord God wil ſound with trumpet, and wil goe in the whirlewind of the South.
label: Zacharias

text: The Lord of hoſts wil protect them: and they shal deuoure, and ſubdew with the ſtones of the ſling: and drinking they shal be drunke as it were of wine, & they shal be filled as phials, and as the hornes of the altar.
label: Zacharias

text: And our Lord their God wil ſaue them in that day, as the flocke of his people: becauſe holie ſtones shal be eleuated ouer his land.
label: Zacharias

text: For what is his good thing, and what is his beautiful thing, but the corne of the elect, and wine ſpringing virgins?
label: Zacharias

text: ASKE of our Lord rayne in the lateward time, and our Lord wil make ſnowes, and wil geue them rayne of showers, to euerie one graſſe in the filde.
label: Zacharias

text: Becauſe the idols ſpake that which was vnprofitable, and the deuiners ſaw a lie, & the dreamers ſpake in vayne: they comforted vaynely: therfore are they led away as a flock: they shal be afflicted, becauſe they haue no paſtour.
label: Zacharias

text: Vpon the paſtours my furie is wrath, and vpon the buckgoates I wil viſite: becauſe the Lord of hoſts hath viſited his flocke, the houſe of Iuda, and hath made them as the horſe of his glorie in the battel.
label: Zacharias

text: Of him the corner, of him the pinne, of him the bow of battel, of him shal come forth euerie exactour together.
label: Zacharias

text: And they shal be as valients, treading the myre of the wayes in battel: and they shal fight, becauſe our Lord is with them: and the riders of horſes shal be confounded.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil ſtrengthen the houſe of Iuda, and the houſe of Ioſeph I wil ſaue: and I wil conuert them, becauſe I wil haue mercie on them: and they shal be as they were when I had not caſt them of, for I am the Lord their God, and wil heare them.
label: Zacharias

text: And they shal be as the valients of Ephraim, & their hart shal reioyce as it were of wine: and their children shal ſee, and shal reioyce, & their hart shal be ioyful in our Lord.
label: Zacharias

text: I wil hiſſe to them, and wil gather them together, becauſe I haue redemed them: and I wil multiplie them as they were multiplied before.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil ſaw them among peoples, and from a far they shal remember me: and they shal liue with their children, and shal returne.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil bring them backe out of the Land of Ægypt, and out of the Aſſyrians I wil gather them: and to the Land of Galaad, & Libanus I wil bring them, and there shal not be found place for them.
label: Zacharias

text: And he shal paſſe ouer in the ſtrayte of the ſea, and shal ſtrike the waues in the ſea, and al the depths of the riuer shal be confounded, and the pride of Aſſur shal be humbled, and the ſcepter of Ægypt shal depart.
label: Zacharias

text: I wil ſtrengthen them in the Lord, and in his name they shal walke: ſayth our Lord.
label: Zacharias

text: OPEN thy gates aô Libanus, and let fyre deuoure thy ceders.
label: Zacharias

text: Howle thou firre tree, becauſe the ceder is fallen, becauſe the magnifical are waſted: howle ye okes of Baſan, becauſe the fenſed forreſt is cut downe.
label: Zacharias

text: The voice of the howling of paſtours, becauſe their magnificence is waſted: the voice of the roaring of lions, becauſe the pride of Iordan is waſted.
label: Zacharias

text: Thus ſayth our Lord my God: Feede thou the cattel of ſlaughter,
label: Zacharias

text: which they that poſſeſſed, ſlew, and were not ſorie, and they ſold them, ſaying: Bleſſed be our Lord, we are become rich: and their paſtours ſpared them not.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil ſpare no more vpon the inhabitants of the earth, ſayth our Lord: behold I wil deliuer men, euerie one in his neighbours hand, and in the hand of his king: and they shal cut the land in peeces, and I wil not deliuer it out of their hand.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil feede the cattel of ſlaughter for this, ô ye poore of the flocke: and I tooke vnto me two roddes, one I called Beautie, and the other I called Corde: and I fed the flocke.
label: Zacharias

text: And I cut of three paſtours in one moneth, and my ſoule shrunke together at them: for their ſoule alſo varied on me.
label: Zacharias

text: And I ſayd: I wil not feede you: that which dieth, let it dye: and that which is cut of, be it cut of: and let the reſt deuoure euerie one his neighbours flesh.
label: Zacharias

text: & I tooke my rod that was called beautie, and I cut it of to make voyd my couenant, which I made with al peoples.
label: Zacharias

text: And it was made voyd in that day: and ſo the poore of the flocke that keepe for me, vnderſtood, that it is the word of the Lord
label: Zacharias

text: And I ſayd to them: If it be good in your eyes, bring hither my hyre: and if not, be quiet. And they weighed my hyre thirtie peeces of ſiluer.
label: Zacharias

text: And our Lord ſayd to me, caſt it forth to the ſtatuarie, a goodlie price, that I was priced at by them. And I tooke the thirtie peeces of ſiluer: & I threw them into the houſe of our Lord to the ſtatuarie.
label: Zacharias

text: And I cut of my ſecond rod, that was called Corde, that I might diſſolue the brotherhood betwen Iuda and Iſrael.
label: Zacharias

text: And our Lord ſayd to me: As yet take to thee the veſſels of a foolish paſtour.
label: Zacharias

text: Becauſe loe I wil rayſe vp a paſtour in the land, which shal not viſite thinges forſaken, the thing diſperſed he shal not ſeeke, and the broken he shal not heale, & that which ſtandeth he shal not nourish, and he shal eate the flesh of the fat ones, and their hoofes he shal diſſolue.
label: Zacharias

text: O paſtour, and idol, leauing the flocke: the ſword vpon his arme, & vpon his right eye: his arme shal be dried with withering, and his right eye waxing darke shal be obſcured.
label: Zacharias

text: THE burden of the word of our Lord vpon Iſrael. Sayth our Lord extending the heauen, & founding the earth, & forming the ſpirit of man in him:
label: Zacharias

text: Behold I wil make Ieruſalem a lintel of ſurfet to al peoples round about: yea & Iuda shal be in the ſiege againſt Ieruſalem.
label: Zacharias

text: And it shal be: In that day I wil make Ieruſalem a ſtone of burden to al peoples: al that shal lift it, shal be torne with tearing: and al the kingdoms of the earth shal de gathered agaynſt her.
label: Zacharias

text: In that day, ſayth our Lord, I wil ſtrike euerie horſe into aſtonishment, and his rider into madnes: and vpon the houſe of Iuda I wil open mine eyes, and euerie horſe of the peoples I wil ſtrike with blindnes.
label: Zacharias

text: And the dukes of Iuda shal ſay in their hart: Let the inhabitants of Ieruſalem be ſtrengthened for me in the Lord of hoſts their God.
label: Zacharias

text: In that day I wil make the dukes of Iuda as a furnace of fyre amongſt ſtickes, and as a brand of fire in hay: and they shal deuoure to the right hand, & to the left al people round about: and Ieruſalem shal be inhabited agayne in her place in Ieruſalem.
label: Zacharias

text: And our Lord shal ſaue the tabernacles of Iuda, as in the begynning: that the houſe of Dauid glorie not magnifically, and the glorie of them that inhabite Ieruſalem agaynſt Iuda.
label: Zacharias

text: In that day shal our Lord protect the inhabitants of Ieruſalem, and he that offended of them in that day shal be as Dauid: and the houſe of Dauid, as of God, as an Angel of our Lord in their ſight.
label: Zacharias

text: And it shal be in that day: I wil ſeke to deſtroy al Nations, that come againſt Ieruſalem.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil powre out vpon the houſe of Dauid, & vpon the inhabitants of Ieruſalem the ſpirit of grace, and of prayers: and they shal looke toward me, whom they pearced: and they shal lament him with lamentation as it were vpon an only begotten, and they shal ſorow vpon him, as the maner is to be ſorowful in the death of the firſt begotten.
label: Zacharias

text: In that day shal be great lamentation in Ieruſalem, as the lamentation of Adadremmon in the filde of Mageddon.
label: Zacharias

text: And the land shal lament: families and families apart: the families of the houſe of Dauid apart, and their wemen apart:
label: Zacharias

text: the families of the houſe of Nathan apart, and their wemen apart: the families of the houſe of Leui apart, and their wemen apart: the families of Semei apart, and their wemen apart.
label: Zacharias

text: Al the reſt of the families, families and families apart, and their wemen apart.
label: Zacharias

text: IN that day shal be a fountayne lying open to the houſe of Dauid, and to the inhabitants of Ieruſalem: for the ablution of the ſinner, and of the menſtruous woman.
label: Zacharias

text: And it shal be in that day, ſayth the Lord of hoſts: I wil deſtroy the names of idols out of the earth, & they shal be remembred no more: and the falſe prophetes, and the vncleane ſpirit I wil take away out of the earth.
label: Zacharias

text: And it shal be when any man shal prophecie any more, his father & his mother that begot him, shal ſay to him: Thou shalt not liue: becauſe thou haſt ſpoken a lie in the name of our Lord. And his father, & his mother his parents shal ſtrike him, when he shal prophecie.
label: Zacharias

text: And it shal be: in that day, the prophets shal be confounded euerie one by his owne viſion, when he shal prophecie, neither shal they be couered with cloke of ſackcloth, to lie:
label: Zacharias

text: But he shal ſay: I am no prophet, an huſbandman am I: becauſe Adam my example from my youth.
label: Zacharias

text: And it shal be ſayd to him: What are theſe wounds in the middes of thy handes? And he shal ſay: With theſe was I wounded in the houſe of them, that loued me.
label: Zacharias

text: Sword be thou rayſed vp vpon my paſtour, and vpon the man that cleaueth to me, ſayth the Lord of hoſts: Strike the paſtour, and the sheepe shal be diſperſed: and I wil turne my hand to the litle ones.
label: Zacharias

text: And there shal be in al the earth, ſayth our Lord: two parts in it shal be deſtroyed, and shal fayle: and the third part shal be left in it.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil bring the third part through fyre, and wil burne them as ſiluer is burnt: and I wil trie them as gold is tried. They shal cal my name, and I wil heare them. I wil ſay: Thou art my people; and they shal ſay: Our Lord my God.
label: Zacharias

text: BEHOLD the dayes of our Lord shal come, and thy ſpoyles shal be diuided in the middes of thee.
label: Zacharias

text: And I wil gather together al nations to Ieruſalem into battel, and the citie shal be taken, and the houſes shal be waſted, and the wemen shal be defiled: and the halfe part of the citie shal goe forth into captiuitie, and the reſt of the people shal not be taken away out of the citie.
label: Zacharias

text: And our Lord wil goe forth, and wil fight againſt thoſe nations, as he fought in the day of conflict.
label: Zacharias

text: And his feete shal ſtand in that day vpon the mount of oliues, which is againſt Ieruſalem toward the Eaſt: and the mount of oliues shal be clouen by the halfe part therof to the Eaſt, & to the Weaſt with a ſtiepe rupture exceding great, and halfe of the mountayne shal be ſeperated to the North, & halfe therof to the South.
label: Zacharias

text: And you shal flie to the valley of thoſe mountaynes, becauſe the valley of the mountaynes shal be ioyned euen to the next, and you shal flee as you fled from the face of the earthquake in the dayes of Ozias king of Iuda: and our Lord my God shal come, and al the ſaintes with him.
label: Zacharias

text: And it shal be in that day: there shal be no light, but cold and froſt.
label: Zacharias

text: And there shal be one day, which is knowen to our Lord, not day nor night: & in the time of the euening there shal be light.
label: Zacharias

text: And it shal be in that day: liuing waters shal iſſue forth out of Ieruſalem: halfe of them to the Eaſt ſea, and halfe of them to the laſt ſea: in ſummer & in winter shal they be.
label: Zacharias

text: And our Lord shal be king ouer al the earth: in that day there shal be one Lord, & his name shal be one.
label: Zacharias

text: And al the land shal returne euen to the deſert, from the hil of Remmon to the South of Ieruſalem: and it shal be exalted, and shal dwel in her place, from the gate of Beniamin euen to the place of the former gate, and euen to the gate of the corners: & from the towre of Hananeel euen to the kings preſſes.
label: Zacharias

text: And they shal dwel in it, and there shal be anathema no more: but Ieruſalem shal ſit ſecure.
label: Zacharias

text: And this shal be the plague, wherwith our Lord shal ſtrike al nations, that haue fought againſt Ieruſalem: the flesh shal pine away of euerie one ſtanding vpon his feete, and his eyes shal weare away in their holes, & their tongue shal conſume away in their mouth.
label: Zacharias

text: In that day there shal be a great tumult of our Lord among them: and a man shal take the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shal be claſped vpon his neighbours hand.
label: Zacharias

text: Yea and Iudas shal fight agaynſt Ieruſalem: and the riches of al nations round about shal be gathered together, gold, and ſiluer, and garments exceding manie.
label: Zacharias

text: And ſo shal there be ruine of horſe, and mule, and camel, and aſſe, and of al the beaſts, that shal be in thoſe tents, as is this ruine.
label: Zacharias

text: And al that shal be left of al Nations, that came againſt Ieruſalem, shal goe vp from yeare to yeare, to adore the King, the Lord of hoſts, and to celebrate the feſtiuitie of tabernacles.
label: Zacharias

text: And it shal be: he that shal not aſcend of the families of the land to Ieruſalem, to adore the King, the Lord of hoſts, there shal be no showre vpon them.
label: Zacharias

text: Yea and if the familie of Ægypt shal not aſcend, and shal not come: neither vpon them shal it be, but ruine shal be, wherwith our Lord wil ſtrike al Nations that wil not aſcend to celebrate the feſtiuitie of tabernacles.
label: Zacharias

text: This shal be the ſinne of Ægypt, and this the ſinne of al Nations, that wil not aſcend to celebrate the feſtiuitie of tabernacles.
label: Zacharias

text: In that day shal that which is vpon the bridle of the horſe be holie to our Lord: and the caudrons in the houſe of our Lord shal be as the phials before the altar.
label: Zacharias

text: And euerie caudron in Ieruſalem, and Iuda shal be ſanctified to the Lord of hoſts: and al that immolate, shal come, and take of them, and shal ſethe in them: & there shal be merchant no more in the houſe of the Lord of hoſts in that day.
label: Zacharias

text: THE burden of the word of our Lord to Iſrael in the hand of Malachie.
label: Malachie

text: I haue loued you, ſayth our Lord: & you haue ſayd: Wherin haſt thou loued vs? Was not Eſau brother to Iacob, ſayth our Lord, and I loued Iacob,
label: Malachie

text: but hated Eſau? and I layd his mountaines into a wildernes, & his inheritance vnto the dragons of the deſert.
label: Malachie

text: But if Idumea shal ſay: We are deſtroyed, but returning we wil build the thinges that are deſtroyed: thus ſayth the Lord of hoſts: Theſe shal build, and I wil deſtroy: and they shal be called the borders of impietie, and the people with whom our Lord is angrie for euer.
label: Malachie

text: And your eyes shal ſee: and you shal ſay: Our Lord be magnified vpon the border of Iſrael.
label: Malachie

text: The ſonne honoureth the father, and the ſeruant his lord: if then I be the father, where is my honour? and if I be the Lord, where is my feare: ſayth the Lord of hoſts?
label: Malachie

text: To you ô prieſts, that deſpiſe my name, & haue ſayd: Wherin haue we deſpiſed thy name? You offer vpon myne altar polluted bread: and you ſay: Wherin haue we polluted thee? In that you ſay: The table of our Lord is contemptible.
label: Malachie

text: If you offer the blind to be immolated, is it not euil? and if you offer the lame and the feble is it not euil? offer it to thy prince if it shal pleaſe him, or if he wil receiue thy face, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Malachie

text: And now beſech ye the face of God, that he may haue mercie on you (for by your hand hath this bene done) if by any meanes he wil receiue your faces, ſaith the Lord of hoſts.
label: Malachie

text: Who is there among you, that wil shut the doores, & wil kindle fire on my altar for naught? I haue no wil in you, ſayth the Lord of hoſts: and gift I wil not receiue of your hand.
label: Malachie

text: For from the riſing of the ſunne euen to the going downe, great is my name among the Gentils, & in euerie place there is ſacrificing, and there is offered to my name a cleane oblation: becauſe my name is great among the Gentils, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Malachie

text: And you haue polluted it in that you ſay: The table of our Lord is contaminated: and that which is layd therupon, is contemptible with the fyre, that deuoureth it.
label: Malachie

text: And you haue ſayd: Loe of labour, and you puffed at it, ſayth the Lord of hoſts, and you brought in of robberies the lame; & the ſicke, and brought in a gift: Why, shal I receiue it of your hand, ſayth our Lord?
label: Malachie

text: Curſed is the deceitful, that hath in his flocke a male, and making a vow immolateth the feeble to our Lord: becauſe I am a great King, ſayth the Lord of hoſts, and my name is dreadful among the Gentils.
label: Malachie

text: AND now to you this commandment aô ye prieſts.
label: Malachie

text: If you wil not heare, and if you wil not ſet it vpon the hart, to geue glorie to my name, ſayth the Lord of hoſts: I wil ſend vpon you pouertie, & wil curſe your bleſſings, and I wil curſe them: becauſe you haue not ſet it vpon the hart.
label: Malachie

text: Behold I wil caſt forth to you the arme, and wil ſpinkle vpon your face the dung of your ſolemnities, and it shal take you with it.
label: Malachie

text: And you shal know that I ſent you this commandment, that my couenant might be with Leui, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Malachie

text: My couenant was with him of life and peace: & I gaue him feare: and he feared me, and at the face of my name he was afrayd.
label: Malachie

text: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquitie was not found in his lippes in peace, and in equitie he walked with me, and turned away manie from iniquitie.
label: Malachie

text: For the lippes of the prieſt shal keepe knowlege, and the law they shal require of his mouth: becauſe he is the angel of the Lord of hoſts.
label: Malachie

text: But you haue departed out of the way, and haue ſcandalized manie in the law: you haue made voide the couenant of Leui, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Malachie

text: For which cauſe I alſo haue made you contemtible, and baſe to al peoples, as you haue not kept my wayes, and haue accepted face in the law.
label: Malachie

text: Why, is there not one father of vs al? hath not one God created vs? why then doth euerie one of vs deſpiſe his brother, violating the couenant of our fathers?
label: Malachie

text: Iuda hath tranſgreſſed, and abomination was done in Iſrael, and in Ieruſalem: becauſe Iudas hath contaminated the ſanctification of our Lord, which he loued, and hath had the daughter of a ſtrange god.
label: Malachie

text: Our Lord wil deſtroy the man, that hath done this, the maſter, & the ſcholar out of the tabernacles of Iacob, & him that offereth gift to the Lord of hoſts.
label: Malachie

text: And this agayne haue you done, you couered the altar of the Lord with teares, with weeping, and howling, ſo that I haue reſpect no more to ſacrifice, neither do I accept any placable thing at your hand.
label: Malachie

text: And you haue ſayd: For what cauſe? becauſe the Lord hath teſtified betwen thee, and the wife of thy youth, whom thou haſt deſpiſed: and she thy partaker, and the wife of thy couenant.
label: Malachie

text: Did not one make, and the reſidue of the ſpirit is his? And what doth one ſeeke, but the ſeede of God? Keepe ye then your ſpirit, and the wife of thy youth deſpiſe thou not.
label: Malachie

text: When thou shalt hate, diſmiſſe, ſayth our Lord the God of Iſrael: but iniquitie shal couer his garment, ſaith the Lord of hoſts, keepe ye your ſpirit, and do not deſpiſe.
label: Malachie

text: You haue in your wordes made our Lord to labour: and you ſayd: Wherein haue we made him to labour? In that you ſay: Euerie one that doth euil, is good in the ſight of our Lord, and ſuch pleaſe him: or certes where is the God of iudgement?
label: Malachie

text: BEHOLD I ſend myne Angel, and he shal prepare the way before my face. And forthwith shal come to his temple the Dominatour, whom you ſeeke, and the Angel of the teſtament, whom you deſire. Behold he cometh, ſayth the Lord of hoſts:
label: Malachie

text: and who shal be able to thinke the day of his aduent? and who shal ſtand to ſee him? For he as it were purging fyre, & as the herbe of fullers:
label: Malachie

text: and he shal ſit purging, and clenſing the ſiluer, and he shal purge the ſonnes of Leui, and wil ſtreyne them as gold, and as ſiluer, and they shal be offering ſacrifices to our Lord in iuſtice.
label: Malachie

text: And the ſacrifice of Iuda and Ieruſalem shal pleaſe our Lord, as the dayes of the world, and as the yeares of old.
label: Malachie

text: And I wil come to you in iudgement, and wil be a ſwift witnes to ſorcerers, and aduouterers, and to the periured, and them that calumniate the hyre of the hyred man, the widowes, and pupils, and oppreſſe the ſtranger, nor haue feared me, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Malachie

text: For I the Lord, and I am not changed: and ye ſonnes of Iacob are not conſumed.
label: Malachie

text: For from the dayes of your fathers you haue departed from mine ordinances, and haue not kept them. Returne to me, and I wil returne to you, ſayth the Lord of hoſts. And you haue ſayd: Wherin shal we returne?
label: Malachie

text: Shal man faſten God, becauſe you do faſten me? And you haue ſayd: Wherin do we faſten thee? In tithes, and in firſt fruites.
label: Malachie

text: And in penurie you are accurſed, and you your whole nation faſten me.
label: Malachie

text: Bring in al the tithe into the barne: and let there be meate in my houſe, and proue me vpon this, ſayth our Lord: if I open not vnto you the fludgates of heauen, and powre you out bleſſing euen to abundance,
label: Malachie

text: and I wil rebuke for you the deuourer, and he shal not corrupt the fruite of your land: neither shal the vine in the filde be barren, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Malachie

text: And al Nations shal cal you bleſſed: for you shal be a land worthie to be deſired, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Malachie

text: Your wordes haue bene forcible vpon me, ſayth the Lord.
label: Malachie

text: And you ſayd: What haue we ſpoken againſt thee? You haue ſayd: He is vayne that ſerueth God, and what profite is it that we haue kept his precepts, and that we haue walked ſorowful before the Lord of hoſt?
label: Malachie

text: Therfore now we cal the arrogant bleſſed, for they that doe impietie are builded, and they haue tempted God and are made ſafe.
label: Malachie

text: Then ſpake they that feared our Lord, euerie one with his neighbour: and our Lord attended, and heard: and a booke of monument was writen before him for them that feare our Lord, and thinke on his name.
label: Malachie

text: And they shal be to me, ſaith the Lord of hoſts, in the day that I doe to my peculiar and I wil ſpare them, as a man ſpareth his ſonne ſeruing him.
label: Malachie

text: And you shal conuert, and shal ſee what is betwen the iuſt, and the impious: and betwen him that ſerueth God, and ſerueth him not.
label: Malachie

text: FOR behold the day shal come kindled as a furnace: and al the proude, and al that doe impietie shal be ſtubble: and the day coming shal inflame them, ſayth the Lord of hoſts, which shal not leaue them roote, and ſpring.
label: Malachie

text: And there shal riſe to you that feare my name the Sunne of iuſtice, and health in his winges: and you shal goe forth, and shal leape as calues of the heard.
label: Malachie

text: And you shal treade the impious, when they shal be ashes vnder the ſole of your feete in the day, that I doe, ſayth the Lord of hoſts.
label: Malachie

text: Remember ye the law of Moyſes my ſeruant, which I commanded him in Horeb to al Iſrael precepts, & iudgements.
label: Malachie

text: Behold I wil ſend you Elias the prophete, before the day of our Lord come great, and dreadful.
label: Malachie

text: And he shal conuert the hart of the fathers to the children & the hart of the children to their fathers: leſt perhaps I come, and ſtrike the earth with anathema.
label: Malachie

text: Lord omnipotent God of our fathers, Abraham, and Iſaac, and Jacob, and of their juſt ſeed,
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: which didſt make heaven and earth: with all the ornaments of them,
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: which haſt bound the ſea with the word of thy precept, which haſt shut up the depth, and ſealed it with thy terrible and laudable name:
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: whom all things dread, and tremble at the countenance of thy power,
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: becauſe the magnificence of thy glory is importable, and the wrath of thy threatening upon ſinners is intolerable:
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: but the mercy of thy promiſe is infinite and unſearchable:
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: becauſe thou art our Lord, moſt high, benign, long ſuffering, and very merciful, and penitent upon the wickedneſs of men. Thou Lord according to the multitude of thy goodneſs haſt promiſed penance and remiſſion to them that have ſinned to thee, and by the multitude of thy mercies thou haſt decreed penance to ſinners, unto ſalvation.
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: Thou therefore Lord God of the juſt, haſt not appointed penance to the juſt, Abraham, and Iſaac, and Jacob, them that have not ſinned to thee, but haſt appointed penance for me a ſinner:
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: becauſe I have ſinned above the number of the ſand of the ſea. Mine iniquities Lord be multiplied, mine iniquities be multiplied, and I am not worthy to behold and look upon the height of heaven, for the multitude of mine iniquities.
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: I am made crooked with many a band of iron, that I cannot lift up my head, and I have not reſpiration: becauſe I have ſtirred up thy wrath, and have done evil before thee: I have not done thy will, and thy commandments I have not kept: I have ſet up abominations, and multiplied offences.
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: And now I bow the knee of my heart, beſeeching goodneſs of thee.
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: I have ſinned Lord, I have ſinned, and I acknowledge mine iniquities.
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: Wherefore I beſeech deſiring thee, forgive me Lord, forgive me: and deſtroy me not together with mine iniquities, neither reſerve thou for ever, being angry, evils for me, neither damn me into the loweſt places of the earth: becauſe thou art God, I ſay, of the penitent:
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: in me thou shalt shew all thy goodneſs, becauſe thou shalt ſave me unworthy according to thy great mercy,
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: and I will praiſe thee always all the days of my life: becauſe all the power of the heavens praiſeth thee, and to thee is glory for ever and ever. Amen.
label: prayer-of-manasses

text: AND Ioſias made a Paſch in Ieruſalem to our Lord, & immolated the Phaſe the fourtenth moone of the moneth:
label: 3-esdras

text: appointing the Prieſtes by courſes of dayes clothed with ſtoles in the temple of our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he ſpake to the Leuites the ſacred ſeruantes of Iſrael, that they should ſanctifie them ſelues to our Lord in the placing of the holie arke of our Lord in the houſe, which king Salomon ſonne of Dauid built.
label: 3-esdras

text: It shal not be for you to take it vpon your shoulders. And now ſerue your Lord, and take the care of that nation Iſrael, in part according to your villages and tribes,
label: 3-esdras

text: according to the writing of Dauid king of Iſrael, and according to the magnificence of Salomon his ſonne, al in the temple, and according to your fathers portion of principalitie, among them that ſtand in the ſight of your brethren the children of Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: Immolate the Paſch, and prepare the ſacrifices for your bretheren, and doe according to the precept of our Lord which was geuen to Moyſes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Ioſias gaue vnto the people that was found of sheepe, lambes, and kiddes, and goates thirtie thouſand, calues three thouſand.
label: 3-esdras

text: Theſe thinges were geuen to the people of the kinges goodes according to promiſſe: and to the prieſtes for the Phaſe, sheepe in number two thouſand, and calues an hundred.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Iechonias, and Semeias, and Nathanael bretheren, and Haſabias, and Oziel, and Coraba for the Phaſe sheepe fiue thouſand, calues fiue hundred.
label: 3-esdras

text: And when theſe thinges were done in good order, the Prieſtes and the Leuites ſtood hauing azymes by tribes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And according to the portions of their fathers principalitie, in the ſight of the people they did offer, to our Lord according to thoſe thinges, which were written in the booke of Moyſes:
label: 3-esdras

text: and roſted the Phaſe with fire as it ought: and the hoſtes they boyled in cauldrons, and in pottes with beneuolence:
label: 3-esdras

text: and they brought to al that were of the people: and afterward they prepared for them ſelues and the prieſtes.
label: 3-esdras

text: For the Prieſtes offered the fatte, vntil the houre was ended: and the Leuites prepared for them ſelues, and their brethren, the children of Aaron.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the ſacred ſinging men, the children of Aſaph were by order according to the precept of Dauid and Aſaph, and Zacharias, and Ieddimus, which was from the king.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the porters at euerie gate, ſo that none tranſgreſſed his owne: for their brethren prepared for them.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the thinges were conſummate that perteyned to the ſacrifice of our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: In that day they celebrated the Phaſe, and offered hoſtes vpon the ſacrifice of our Lord, according to the precept of king Ioſias.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the children of Iſrael, that were found at that time, celebrated the Phaſe: and the feſtiual day of Azymes for ſeuen dayes:
label: 3-esdras

text: and there was not celebrated ſuch a Phaſe in Iſrael, from the times of Samuel the prophet:
label: 3-esdras

text: and al the kinges of Iſrael did not celebrate ſuch a Phaſe as Ioſias did, and the Prieſtes, and the Leuites, and the Iewes, and al Iſrael, that were found in their abode at Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: In the eightenth yeare, Ioſias reigning was the Phaſe celebrated.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the workes of Ioſias were directed in the ſight of his Lord in a hart ful of feare:
label: 3-esdras

text: and the thinges concerning him are writen in the ancient times, touching them that ſinned, and were irreligious againſt our Lord aboue al nations, and that ſought not the wordes of our Lord vpon Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: And after al this fact of Ioſias, came vp Pharao the king of Ægypt comming in Charcamis from the way vpon Euphrates, and Ioſias went forth to meete him.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the king of Ægypt ſent to Ioſias ſaying: What is there betwen me & thee king of Iuda?
label: 3-esdras

text: I was not ſent of the Lord to fight againſt thee: for my battel is vpon Euphrates, goe downe in haſt.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Ioſias did not returne vpon his chariote: but endeuoured to ouerthrow him, not attending the word of the prophet from the mouth of our Lord:
label: 3-esdras

text: but he made battel againſt him in the field of Mageddo. And princes went downe to king Ioſias.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the king ſaid to his ſeruantes: Remoue me from the battel, for I am weakned excedingly. And forthwith his ſeruantes remoued him out of the battel.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he went vp into his ſecond chariote: & comming to Ieruſalem, dyed, and was buried in his fathers ſepulchre.
label: 3-esdras

text: And in al Iurie they mourned for Ioſias, & the rulers with their wiues lamented him vntil this day. And this was geuen out to be done alwayes vnto al the ſtocke of Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: But theſe thinges were writen before in the booke of the hiſtories of the kinges of Iuda: and al the actes of the doing of Ioſias, and his glorie and his vnderſtanding in the law of our Lord: and the thinges that were done by him, and that are not writen in the booke of the kinges of Iſrael and Iuda.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they that were of the nation, taking Iechonias the ſonne of Ioſias, made him king for Ioſias his father, when he was three and twentie yeares old.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he reigned ouer Iſrael three monethes. And the king of Ægypt remoued him, that he should not reigne in Ieruſalem:
label: 3-esdras

text: and he put a taxe vpon the nation of ſiluer an hundred talentes, and of gold one talent.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the king of Ægypt made Ioacim his brother king of Iuda and Ieruſalem:
label: 3-esdras

text: and he bound the magiſtrates of Ioacim, and Zaracel his brother, and taking them brought them backe into Ægypt.
label: 3-esdras

text: Ioacim was fiue and twentie yeares old when he began to reigne in the land of Iuda and Ieruſalem: and he did euil in the ſight of our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: And after this man came vp Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon, and binding him with a bande of braſſe, brought him into Babylon.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Nabuchodonoſor tooke the ſacred veſſels of our Lord, and carried away, and conſecrated them in his temple in Babylon.
label: 3-esdras

text: For his vncleanes, and lacke of religion is written in the booke of the times of the kinges.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Ioachin his ſonne reigned for him. And when he was made king, he was eightene yeares old.
label: 3-esdras

text: And reigned three monethes and ten dayes in Ieruſalem, and did euil in the ſight of our Lord:
label: 3-esdras

text: and after a yeare Nabuchodonoſor ſending, tranſported him into Babylon together with the ſacred veſſels of our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he made Sedecias king of Iuda and Ieruſalem, when he was one and twentie yeares old: and he reigned eleuen yeares.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he did euil in the ſight of our Lord, and was not afraid of the wordes which were ſpoken by Ieremie the prophet from the mouth of our Lord:
label: 3-esdras

text: and being ſworne of king Nabuchodonoſor, forſworne he did reuolt: and his necke being hardened, & his hart, he tranſgreſſed the ordinances of our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the princes of the people of our Lord did manie thinges wickedly, and they did impiouſly aboue al the vncleannes of the nations: and they polluted the temple of our Lord that was holie in Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the God of their fathers ſent by his meſſenger to reclame them, for that he would ſpare them, and his tabernacle.
label: 3-esdras

text: But they ſcorned at his meſſengers: and in the day that our Lord ſpake to them, they were mocking his prophetes.
label: 3-esdras

text: Who was moued euen vnto wrath vpon his nation for their impietie, and commanded the kinges of the Chaldees to come vp.
label: 3-esdras

text: Theſe ſlewe their yong men with the ſword, round about their holie temple, and ſpared not yong man, and old man, and virgin, and youth:
label: 3-esdras

text: but al were deliuered into their handes: & taking al the ſacred veſſels of our Lord, and the kinges treaſures, they caried them into Babylon,
label: 3-esdras

text: and burnt the houſe of our Lord, and threwe downe the walles of Ieruſalem: and the towres therof they burnt with fire,
label: 3-esdras

text: and conſumed al their honorable thinges, and brought them to naught, and thoſe that were left of the ſword, they led into Babylon.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they were his ſeruants vntil the Perſians reigned in the fulfilling of the word of our Lord by the mouth of Ieremie:
label: 3-esdras

text: as long as the land quietly kept her ſabbathes, al the time of her deſolation she ſabbathized in the application of ſeuentie yeares.
label: 3-esdras

text: CYRVS king of the Perſians reigning for the accomplishment of the word of our Lord by the mouth of Ieremie,
label: 3-esdras

text: our Lord rayſed vp the ſpirit of Cyrus king of the Perſians, and he proclaymed in al his kingdomes, and that by writing,
label: 3-esdras

text: ſaying: Thus ſayth Cyrus king of the Perſians: The Lord of Iſrael, the high Lord, hath made me king ouer the whole earth.
label: 3-esdras

text: and hath ſignified to me to build him a houſe in Ieruſalem, which is in Iurie.
label: 3-esdras

text: If there be any of your kinred, his Lord goe vp with him into Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: Whoſoeuer therefore dwel about the places, let them helpe them that are in the ſame place, in gold and ſiluer,
label: 3-esdras

text: in giftes, with horſes, and beaſtes, and with other thinges which by vowes are added into the temple of our Lord, which is in Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the princes of the tribes, of the villages and of Iurie, of the tribe of Beniamin, & the Prieſtes, and the Leuites ſtanding vp, whom our Lord moued to goe vp, and to build the houſe of our Lord which is in Ieruſalem, and they that were round about them,
label: 3-esdras

text: did helpe them with al their gold and ſiluer, and beaſtes, and manie whoſe minde was ſtirred vp, with many vowes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Cyrus the king brought forth the ſacred veſſels of our Lord, which Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon tranſported out of Ieruſalem, and conſecrated them to his Idol.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Cyrus the king of Perſians bringing them forth, deliuered them to Mithridatus, who was ouer his treaſures.
label: 3-esdras

text: And by him they were deliuered to Salmanaſar preſident of Iurie.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of theſe this was the number: Cuppes for libamentes of ſiluer two thouſand foure hundred, baſens of ſiluer thirtie: phials of gold thirtie, alſo of ſiluer two thouſand foure hundred: and other veſsels a thouſand.
label: 3-esdras

text: and al the veſſels of gold and ſiluer, were fiue thouſand eight hundred ſixtie.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they were numbered to Salmanaſar together with them, that came out of the captiuite of Babylon into Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: But in the times of Artaxerxes king of the Perſians, there wrote to him of them that dwelt in Iurie and Ieruſalem, Balſamus, and Mithridatus, and Sabellius, and Rathimus, Balthemus, Sabellius ſcribe, and the reſt dweling in Samaria, and other places the epiſtle folowing to king Artaxerxes.
label: 3-esdras

text: SIR, thy ſeruantes Rathimus ouer occurrentes, and Sabellius the ſcribe, and the other iudges of thy court in Cæleſyria, and Phenice.
label: 3-esdras

text: And now be it knowen to our Lord the king, that Iewes came vp from you to vs, comming into Ieruſalem a rebellious, & very naughty citie, do build the fornaces thereof, and ſet vp the walles, and rayſe the temple.
label: 3-esdras

text: And if this citie, and the walles shal be finished, they wil not onlie not abyde to pay tributes, but alſo wil reſiſt the kinges.
label: 3-esdras

text: And becauſe that is in doing about the temple, we thought it should doe wel not to neglect this ſame thing:
label: 3-esdras

text: but to make it knowen to our Lord the king, that if it shal ſeme good, ô king, it may be ſought in the bookes of thy fathers,
label: 3-esdras

text: and thou shalt find in the recordes, thinges writen of theſe, and thou shalt know that this citie hath bene rebellious, and trubling kinges, and cities,
label: 3-esdras

text: and the Iewes rebelles, & making battels in it from time out of mind, for the which cauſe this citie was made deſolate.
label: 3-esdras

text: Now therfore we doe thee to vnderſtand, Lord king, that if this citie shal be built, and the walles therof shalbe erected, there wil be no comming downe for thee into Cæleſyria, & Phenice.
label: 3-esdras

text: Then wrote the king to Rathimus, the writer of the occurrentes, and to Balthemus, and to Sabellius the ſcribe, and to the reſt ioyned with them, and to the dwellers in Syria, and Phenice, as foloweth:
label: 3-esdras

text: I haue read the epiſtle that you ſent me. I commanded therfore ſearch to be made, & it was found that the ſame citie is from the beginning rebellious to kinges,
label: 3-esdras

text: and the men rebelles, and making battels in it, & there were moſt valient kinges ruling in Ieruſalem, and exacting tributes in Cæleſyria, & Phenice.
label: 3-esdras

text: Now therfore I haue geuen commandment to forbid thoſe men to build the citie, and to ſtay them that nothing be done more then is:
label: 3-esdras

text: and that they proceede not farder, wherof are euils, ſo that there may be truble brought vpon the kinges.
label: 3-esdras

text: Then theſe things being read which were writen of king Artaxerxes, Rathimus, and Sabellius the ſcribe, and they that were apointed with them ioyning together in haſt came to Ieruſalem with a troupe of horſemen, and multitude, & companie:
label: 3-esdras

text: and they begane to forbid the builders, and they ceaſed from building of the temple in Ieruſalem, til in the ſecond yeare of the reigne of Darius king of the Perſians.
label: 3-esdras

text: KING Darius made a great ſupper to al his domeſtical ſeruantes, and to al the magiſtrates of Media and Perſia,
label: 3-esdras

text: and to al that were purple, and to the prætors, and conſuls, and liuetenantes vnder him from India vnto Æthiopia, an hundred twentie ſeuen prouinces.
label: 3-esdras

text: And when they had eaten and drunken, and returned ful, then Darius went vp into his chamber, and ſlept, and awaked.
label: 3-esdras

text: Then thoſe three youngmen kepers of his bodie, which garded the kings bodie, ſayd one to an other:
label: 3-esdras

text: Let euerie one of vs ſay a word that may excel: & whoſe word ſoeuer shal appeare wiſer then the others, to him wil king Darius geue great giftes,
label: 3-esdras

text: to be couered with purple, & to drinke in gold, and to ſleepe vpon gold, & a chariote with a bridle of gold, & a bonet of ſilke, and a cheyne about his necke:
label: 3-esdras

text: and he shal ſit in the ſecond place next Darius for his wiſdome. And he shal be called the coſin of Darius.
label: 3-esdras

text: Then euerie one writing his word ſigned it, and they put it vnder the pillow of Darius the king,
label: 3-esdras

text: and they ſayd: When the king shal riſe, we wil geue him our writinges: and which ſoeuer of the three the king shal iudge, and the magiſtrates of Perſia, that his word is the wiſer, to him shal the victorie be geuen as is writen.
label: 3-esdras

text: One wrote: Wine is ſtrong.
label: 3-esdras

text: An other wrote, a King is ſtronger.
label: 3-esdras

text: The third wrote, Wemen are more ſtrong: but aboue al thinges truth ouercometh.
label: 3-esdras

text: And when the king was riſen, they tooke their writinges, and gaue him, and he read.
label: 3-esdras

text: And ſending he called al the Magiſtrates of the Perſians, and the Medes, and them that weare purple, and the pretors, and the ouerſeers;
label: 3-esdras

text: and they ſate in the councel: and the writinges were read before them.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he ſayd: Cal the youngmen, and they shal declare their owne wordes. And they were called, and went in.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he ſayd to them: Declare vnto vs concerning theſe thinges which are writen. And the firſt began, he that had ſpoken of the ſtrength of wine,
label: 3-esdras

text: and ſayd: O ye men, how doth wine preuaile ouer al men that drinke! it ſeduceth the minde.
label: 3-esdras

text: And alſo the mind of king and orphane it maketh vaine. Alſo of the bondman and the free, of the rich man and the poore,
label: 3-esdras

text: and euerie mind it turneth into ſecuritie and pleaſantnes, and it remembreth not any ſorow and dewtie,
label: 3-esdras

text: and al hartes it maketh honeſt; and it remembreth not king, nor magiſtrate, and it maketh a man ſpeake al thinges by talentes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And when they haue drunke, they remember not frendship, nor brotherhood: yea and not long after they take ſwordes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And when they are recouered and riſen from the wine, they remember not what they haue done.
label: 3-esdras

text: O ye men, doth not wine excel? who thinketh to doe ſo? And hauing ſayd this, he held his peace.
label: 3-esdras

text: AND the next began to ſpeake, he that ſpake of the ſtrength of a king.
label: 3-esdras

text: O ye men doe not the men excel, which obteyne land and ſea, and al thinges that are in them?
label: 3-esdras

text: But a king excelleth aboue al thinges, and hath dominion ouer them: and euerie thing whatſoeuer he shal ſay to them, they doe.
label: 3-esdras

text: And if he ſend them to warryers, they goe, and throw downe mountaines, and the walles, and towers.
label: 3-esdras

text: They kil, and are killed: and the kinges word they tranſgreſſe not. For if they shal ouercome, they bring to the king al thinges whatſoeuer they haue taken for a praye.
label: 3-esdras

text: In like maner alſo al others, for ſo many as are not ſouldiars, nor fight, but til the ground: when they shal reape, againe they bring tributes to the king.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he being one onlie if he ſay: Kil ye, they kil: ſay he: forgeue, they forgeue. ſay he: ſtrike: they ſtrike: ſay he, deſtroy, they deſtroy:
label: 3-esdras

text: ſay he: ſtrike: they ſtrike: ſay he, deſtroy, they deſtroy: ſay he build, they build.
label: 3-esdras

text: ſay he, cut downe, they cut downe, ſay he plant, they plant:
label: 3-esdras

text: and al the people, & poteſtates here him, and beſide this he ſitteth downe, and drinketh, and ſleepeth.
label: 3-esdras

text: And others gard him round about, and can not goe euerie one, and doe their owne workes, but at a word are obedient to him.
label: 3-esdras

text: O ye men, how doth not a king excel that is ſo renowmed? And he held his peace.
label: 3-esdras

text: The third that ſpake of wemen and truth, this is Zorobabel, began to ſpeake.
label: 3-esdras

text: O ye men, not the great king, & many men, neither is it wine that doth excel. Who is it then that hath the dominion of them?
label: 3-esdras

text: Haue not wemen brought forth the king, and al the people, that ruleth ouer land & ſea:
label: 3-esdras

text: and were they not borne of them, and did not they bring vp them which planted the vineyardes, whereof wine is made?
label: 3-esdras

text: And they make the garmentes of al men, & they doe honor to al men, and men can not be ſepared from wemen.
label: 3-esdras

text: If they haue gathered gold and ſiluer, and euerie beutiful thing, & ſee a woman comlie and fayre,
label: 3-esdras

text: leauing al theſe thinges they fixe their looke vpon her, & with open mouth beholde her, and allure her more then gold and ſiluer, and euerie precious thing.
label: 3-esdras

text: Man forſaketh his father that brought him vp, and his countrie, and ioyneth himſelf to a woman.
label: 3-esdras

text: And with a woman he refresheth his ſoul: and neither doth he remember father, nor mother, nor countrie.
label: 3-esdras

text: And hereby you muſt know that wemen rule ouer you. Are you not ſorie?
label: 3-esdras

text: And a man taketh his ſword, & goeth into the way to commit theftes and murders, & to ſayle ſeas & riuers,
label: 3-esdras

text: and ſeeth a lyon, and goeth in darkenes: and when he hath committed theft, and fraude, and ſpoyles, he bringeth it to his beloued.
label: 3-esdras

text: And againe, man loueth his wife more then father or mother.
label: 3-esdras

text: And many haue become madde for their wiues: and haue bene made bondmen for them:
label: 3-esdras

text: and many haue perished and bene ſlayne, and haue ſinned for wemen.
label: 3-esdras

text: And now beleue me, that the king is great in his powre: becauſe al countries are afrayd to touch him.
label: 3-esdras

text: Neuertheles I ſaw Apemes the daughter of Bezaces the concubine of a meruelous king, ſitting by the king at his right hand,
label: 3-esdras

text: and taking of the crowne from his head, and putting it vpon her ſelf, and with the palme of her lefthand she ſtroke the king.
label: 3-esdras

text: And beſide theſe thinges he with open mouth beheld her: and if she ſmile he laugheth, and if she be angrie with him, he flattereth, til he be reconciled to her fauour.
label: 3-esdras

text: O ye men, why are not wemen ſtronger? Great is the earth, and high is the heauen: who doeth theſe thinges?
label: 3-esdras

text: And then the king and they that weare purple looked one vpon an other. And he began to ſpeake of truth.
label: 3-esdras

text: O ye men, are not wemen ſtrong? The earth is great and heauen is high: & the ſwift courſe of the ſunne turneth the heauen round into his place in one day.
label: 3-esdras

text: Is not he magnifical that doth theſe thinges, and the truth great, and ſtronger aboue al thinges?
label: 3-esdras

text: Al the earth calleth vpon the truth, heauen alſo bleſſeth it, and al workes are moued, and tremble at it, and there is not any thing with it vniuſt.
label: 3-esdras

text: Wine is vniuſt, the king is vniuſt, wemen are vniuſt, al the ſonnes of men are vniuſt, and al their workes are vniuſt, and in them is not truth, and they shal perish in their iniquitie:
label: 3-esdras

text: and truth abydeth, and groweth ſtrong for euer, and liueth, and preuayleth for euer and euer.
label: 3-esdras

text: Neither is there with it acception of perſons, nor differences: but the thinges that are iuſt it doth to al men, to the vniuſt and malignant, and al men are wel pleaſed in the workes thereof.
label: 3-esdras

text: And there is no vniuſt thing in the iudgement therof, but ſtrength, and reigne, and power, and maieſtie of worldes. Bleſſed be the God of truth.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he left ſpeaking. And al the people cryed, and ſayd: Great is truth, and it preuaileth.
label: 3-esdras

text: Then the king ſayd to him: Aske, if thou wilt any more, then the thinges that are writen, and I wil geue it thee, according as thou art found wiſer then thy neighbours, & thou shalt ſitte next to me, and shalt be called my coſin.
label: 3-esdras

text: Then ſayd he to the king: Be mindful of thy vow, which thou haſt vowed, to build Ieruſalem in the day that thou didſt receiue the kindom:
label: 3-esdras

text: and to ſend backe al the veſſels that were taken out of Ieruſalem, which Cyrus ſeparated, when he ſacked Babylon, and would haue ſent them backe thither.
label: 3-esdras

text: And thou haſt vowed to build the temple, which the Idumeians burnt, when Iurie was deſtroyed of the Chaldees.
label: 3-esdras

text: And now this is that which I aſke Lord, & which I deſire, this is the maieſtie which I deſire of thee, that thou performe the vowe which thou haſt vowed to the king of heauen by thy mouth.
label: 3-esdras

text: Then Darius the king riſing vp, kiſſed him: and wrote letters to al the officers, and ouerſeers, and them that weare purple, that they should conduct him, and them that were with him, al going vp to build Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: And to al the ouerſeers that were in Syria, and Phœnice, and Libanus he wrote letters, that they should draw Ceder trees from Libanus into Ieruſalem, to build the citie with them.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he wrote to al the Iewes which went vp from the kindome into Iurie for libertie, euerie mightie man, & magiſtrate, & ouerſeer not to come vpon them to their gates,
label: 3-esdras

text: and al the countrie which they had obtayned to be free vnto them, & that the Idumeians leaue the caſtels which they poſſeſſe of the Iewes,
label: 3-esdras

text: and to the building of the temple to geue euerie yeare twentie talentes vntil it were throughly built:
label: 3-esdras

text: & vpon the altars to burne holocauſts dayly, as they haue commandment: to offer other ten talentes euery yeare,
label: 3-esdras

text: & to al that go forth from Babylon to build the citie, that there should be libertie aſwel to them as to their children, and to al the prieſtes that goe before.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he wrote a quantitie alſo, and commanded the ſacred ſtole to be geuen, wherein they should ſerue;
label: 3-esdras

text: and to the Leuites he wrote to geue preceptes, vntil the day wherein the houſe shalbe finished, and Ieruſalem builded.
label: 3-esdras

text: And to al that kepe the citie, he wrote portions and wages to be geuen to them.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he ſent away al the veſſels whatſoeuer Cyrus had ſeparated from Babylon, and al thinges whatſoeuer Cyrus ſayd, he alſo commanded to be donne, and to be ſent to Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: And when that yong man was gone forth, lyfting vp his face toward Ieruſalem, he bleſſed the king of heauen,
label: 3-esdras

text: and ſayd: Of thee is victorie, and of thee is wiſdome, and glorie. And I am thy ſeruant.
label: 3-esdras

text: Bleſſed art thou which haſt geuen me wiſedom, and I wil confeſſe to thee Lord God of our fathers.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he toke the letters, and went into Babylon. And he came, and told al his brethren that were in Babylon:
label: 3-esdras

text: and they bleſſed the God of their fathers, becauſe he gaue them remiſſion and refreshing,
label: 3-esdras

text: that they should goe vp and build Ieruſalem, and the temple wherein his name was renowmed, and they reioyced with muſike and ioy ſeuen dayes.
label: 3-esdras

text: AFTER theſe thinges there were choſen, to goe vp the princes of townes by their houſes, and tribes, and their wiues, and their ſonnes and daughters, and their men ſeruantes and wemen ſeruantes, and their cattel.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Darius the king ſent together with them a thouſand horſmen, til they conducted them to Ieruſalem with peace, & with muſicke & with tymbrels, and shaulmes:
label: 3-esdras

text: and al the brethren were playing, and he made them goe vp together with them.
label: 3-esdras

text: And theſe are the names of the men that went vp by their townes according to tribes, and according to the portion of their principalitie.
label: 3-esdras

text: Prieſtes: The children of Phinees, the ſonne of Aaron, Ieſus the ſonne of Ioſedec, Ioacim the ſonne of Zorobabel, the ſonne of Salathiel of the houſe of Dauid, of the progenie of Phares, of the tribe of Iuda.
label: 3-esdras

text: Who ſpake vnder Darius king of the Perſians the meruelous wordes in the ſecond yeare of his reigne the firſt moneth Niſan.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they are theſe, that of Iurie came vp from the captiuitie of the tranſmigration, whom Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon tranſported into Babylon, and returned into Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: And euerie one ſought a part of Iurie according to his owne citie, they that came with Zorobabel, and Ieſus, Nehemias, Areores, Elimeo, Emmanio, Mardocheo, Beelſuro, Mechpſatochor, Olioro, Emonia one of their princes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the number of them of the ſame nation, of their rulers the children of Phares, two thouſand an hundred ſeuentie two:
label: 3-esdras

text: The children of Ares, three thouſand an hundred fiftie ſeuen:
label: 3-esdras

text: The children of Phœmo, an hundred fourtie two: in the children of Ieſus and Ioabes, a thouſand three hundred two:
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Demu, two thouſand foure hundred ſeuentie: the children of Choraba, two hundred fiue: the children of Banica, an hundred ſixtie eight,
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Bebech, foure hundred three: the children of Archad, foure hundred twentie ſeuen:
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Cham, thirtie ſeuen: the children of Zoroar, two thouſand ſixtie ſeuen: the children of Adin, foure hundred ſixtie one:
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Aderectes, an hundred eight: the children of Ciaſo and Zelas, an hundred ſeuen: the children of Azoroc, foure hundred thirtie nine:
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Iedarbone, an hundred thirtie two: the children of Ananias, an hundred thirtie: the children of Aſoni, ninetie:
label: 3-esdras
