text: the children of Marſar, foure hundred twentie two: the children of Zabarus, nintie fiue: the children of Sepolemon, an hundred twentie three:
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Nepopas, fiftie fiue: the children of Hechanatus, an hundred fiftie eight: the children of Cebethamus, an hundred thirtie two:
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Crearpatros, which are of Enocadie and Modia, foure hundred twentie three: they of Gramas and Gabea, an hundred twentie one.
label: 3-esdras

text: They of Beſſelon, and Ceagge, ſixtie fiue: they of Baſtaro, an hundred twentie two:
label: 3-esdras

text: they of Bechenobes, fiftie fiue: the children of Liptis, an hundred fiftie fiue: the children of Labonni, three hundred fiftie ſeuen:
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Sichem, three hundred ſeuentie: the children of Suadon, & Cliomus, three hundred ſeuentie eight:
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Ericus, two thouſand an hundred fourtie fiue: the children of Anaas, three hundred ſeuentie. The prieſtes:
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Ieddus, the ſonne of Euther, the ſonne of Eliaſib, three hundred ſeuentie two: the children of Emerus, two hundred fiftie two:
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Phaſurius, three hundred fiftie ſeuen the children of Caree, two hundred twentie ſeuen.
label: 3-esdras

text: The Leuites: The children of Ieſus in Caduhel, and Bamis, and Serebias, and Edias, ſeuentie foure, the whole number from the twelfth yeare, thirtie thouſand foure hundred ſixtie two.
label: 3-esdras

text: The ſonnes, and daughters, and wiues, the whole number, fourtie thouſand two hundred fourtie two.
label: 3-esdras

text: The children of the Prieſtes, that ſang in the temple: the children of Aſaph, an hundred twentie eight.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the porters: the children of Eſmeni, the children of Azer, the children of Amon, the children of Accuba, of Topa, the children of Tobi, al an hundred thirtie nine.
label: 3-esdras

text: Prieſtes that ſerued in the temple: the children of Sel, the children of Gaſpha, the children of Tobloch, the children of Caria, the children of Su, the children of Hellu, the children of Lobana, the children of Armacha, the children of Accub, the children of Vtha, the children of Cetha, the children of Aggab, the children of Obai, the children of Anani, the children of Canna, the children of Geddu,
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of An, the children of Radin, the children of Deſanon, the children of Nachoba, the children of Caſeba, the children of Gaze, the children of Ozui, the children of Sinone, the children of Attre, the children of Haſten, the children of Aſiana, the children of Manei, the children of Naſiſſim, the children of Acuſu, the children of Agiſta, the children of Azui, the children of Fauon, the children of Phaſalon,
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Meedda, the children of Phuſa, the children of Caree, the children of Burcus, the children of Saree, the children of Cœſi, the children of Naſith, the children of Agiſti, the children of Pedon.
label: 3-esdras

text: Salomon his children, the children of Aſophot, the children of Phaſida, the children of Celi, the children of Dedon, the children of Gaddahel, the children of Sephegi,
label: 3-esdras

text: the children of Aggia, the children of Sachareth, the children of Sabathen, the children of Caroneth, the children of Malſith, the children of Ama, the children of Saſus, the children of Addus, the children of Suba, the children of Eura, the children of Rahotis, the children of Phaſphat, the children of Malmon.
label: 3-esdras

text: Al that ſerued the ſanctuarie, and the ſeruantes of Salomon, foure hundred eightie two.
label: 3-esdras

text: Theſe are the children that came vp from Thelmela, Thelharſa: the princes of them, Carmellam, and Careth:
label: 3-esdras

text: and they could not declare their cities, and their progenies, how they are of Iſrael. The children of Dalari, the children of Tubal, the children of Nechodaici,
label: 3-esdras

text: of the Prieſtes, that did the function of prieſthood: and there were not found the children of Obia, the children of Achiſos, the children of Addin, who tooke a wife of the daughters of Pargeleu:
label: 3-esdras

text: and they were called by his name, and the writing of the kinred of theſe was ſought in the regiſter, and it was not found, and they were forbid to doe the function of prieſthood.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Nehemias and Aſtharus ſayd to them: Let not the holie thinges be participated, til there ariſe a hiegh prieſt lerned for declaration and truth.
label: 3-esdras

text: And al Iſrael was beſide men ſeruantes, and wemen ſeruantes, fourtie two thouſand three hundred fourtie.
label: 3-esdras

text: Their men ſeruantes and wemen ſeruantes, ſeuen thouſand three hundred thirtie ſeuen. Singing men and ſinging wemen, two hundred three ſcore fiue.
label: 3-esdras

text: Camels, foure hundred thirtie fiue. Horſes, ſeuen thouſand thirtie ſix. Mules, two hundred thouſand fourtie fiue. Beaſtes vnder yoke, fiue thouſand twentie fiue.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the rulers themſelues by their villages, when they came into the temple of God, which was in Ieruſalem, to renew and raiſe vp the temple in his place, according to their power:
label: 3-esdras

text: and to be geuen into the temple to the ſacred treaſure of the workes, of gold twelue thouſand mnas, and fiue thouſand mnas of ſiluer, and ſtoles for Prieſtes an hundred.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the Prieſtes and Leuites, and they that came out of the people, dwelt in Ieruſalem, and in the countrie, and the ſacred ſingingmen, and porters, and al Iſrael in their countries.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the ſeuenth moneth being at hand, and when the children of Iſrael were euerie man in his owne affayres, they came together with one minde into the court, that was before the eaſt gate.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Ieſus the ſonne of Ioſedec, and his brethren the prieſtes: Zorobabel the ſonne of Salathiel, and his bretheren ſtanding vp, prepared an altar,
label: 3-esdras

text: that they might offer vpon it holocauſtes, according to the thinges that are writen in the booke of Moyſes the man of God.
label: 3-esdras

text: And there aſſembled there of other nations of the land, and al the nations of the land erected the altar in his place, and they offered hoſtes, and morning holocauſtes to our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they celebrated the feaſt of Tabernacles, and the ſolemne day, as it is commanded in the lawe: and ſacrifices dayly, as it behoued:
label: 3-esdras

text: and after theſe the appointed oblations, and the hoſtes of the ſabbathes, and of the newmoones, and of al the ſolemne ſanctified dayes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And as manie as vowed to our Lord from the new moone of the ſeuenth moneth, began to offer the hoſtes to God, and the temple of our Lord was not yet built.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they gaue monie to the maſones and workemen, and drinke and victuals with ioy.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they gaue cartes to the Sidonians, and Tyrianes, that with them they should carie ceder beames from Lybanus, and should make boates in the hauen Ioppe, according to the decre that was writen for them by Cyrus king of the Perſians.
label: 3-esdras

text: And in the ſecond yeare coming into the temple of God in Ieruſalem, in the ſecond moneth began Zorobabel the ſonne of Salathiel, and Ioſue the ſonne of Ioſedec, and their bretheren, and the Prieſtes and Leuites, and al that were come from the captiuitie into Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: and they founded the temple of God in the newmoone of the ſecond moneth of the ſecond yeare, after that they came into Iurie and Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they appoynted the Leuites from twentie yeares, ouer the workes of our Lord: and Ieſus ſtood and his ſonne, and the bretheren, al Leuites ioyning together, & executors of the lawe, doing the workes in the houſe of our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: And al the Prieſtes ſtood, hauing ſtoles with trumpettes:
label: 3-esdras

text: and Leuites the children of Aſaph, hauing cymbals together prayſing our Lord, and bleſſing him according to Dauid king of Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they ſong a ſong to our Lord, becauſe his ſweetenes, and honour is for euer vpon Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: And al the people ſounded with trumpet, and cried out with a loud voice, prayſing our Lord in the rayſing vp of the houſe of our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: And there came of the Prieſtes and Leuites, and preſidentes by their villages the more ancientes, which had ſene the old houſe:
label: 3-esdras

text: and to the building of this with crie and great lamentation, and manie with trumpettes and great ioy:
label: 3-esdras

text: in ſo much that the people heard not the trumpettes for the lamentation of the people. For the multitude was ſounding with trumpettes magnifically, ſo that it was heard far of.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the enimes of the tribe of Iuda, and Beniamin heard it, and they came to knowe what the voyce of the trumpettes was:
label: 3-esdras

text: And they knew that they which were of the captiuitie doe build a temple to our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: And coming to Zorobabel & Ieſus, the ouerſeers of the villages, they ſayd to them: We will build together with you:
label: 3-esdras

text: For we haue in like maner heard your Lord, & we walke like from the dayes of Asbazareth king of the Aſſyrians, who tranſported vs hither.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Zorobabel, and Ieſus, & the princes of the villages of Iſrael, ſayd to them:
label: 3-esdras

text: It is not for vs and you to build the houſe of our God. For we alone wil build to our Lord of Iſrael according as Cyrus the king of the Perſians hath commanded.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the nations of the land lying vpon them that are in Iurie, and lifting vp the worke of the building, and bringing ambushmentes, and peoples, prohibited them to build.
label: 3-esdras

text: and practiſing aſſaultes hindred them, that the building might not be finished al the time of the life of king Cyrus, and they differred the building for two yeares vntil the reigne of Darius.
label: 3-esdras

text: AND in the ſecond yeare of the reigne of Darius prophecied Aggeus, and Zacharias the ſonne of Addo the prophet to Iurie and Ieruſalem in the name of God of Iſrael vpon them.
label: 3-esdras

text: Then Zorobabel the ſonne of Salathiel ſtanding vp, and Ieſus the ſonne of Ioſedec begane to build the houſe of our Lord, which is in Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: When the prophetes of our Lord were preſent with them, and did helpe them. At the ſame time came Siſennes to them, the deputie of Syria, and of Phenice, and Satrabuzanes, and his felowes:
label: 3-esdras

text: and they ſayd to them: By whoſe commandment build ye this houſe, and this roofe, and perfite al other thinges? And who are the workmen that build theſe thinges?
label: 3-esdras

text: And the ancientes of the Iewes, which were left of the captiuitie by our Lord, had fauoure when the viſitation was made vpon them.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they were not hindered from building, til it was ſignified to Darius of al theſe thinges, and anſwer was receiued.
label: 3-esdras

text: A copie of the letter, which they ſent to Darius. SISENNES deputie of Syria and Phenice, and Satrabuzanes, and his felowes in Syria and Phenice preſidents, to king Darius greeting:
label: 3-esdras

text: Be al thinges knowen to our Lord the king, that when we came into the countrie of Iurie, and had entered into Ieruſalem, we found them building the great houſe of God.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the temple of polished ſtones, and of great and precious matter in the walles.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the workes to be a doing earneſtly, and to ſuccede, and proſper in their handes, and in al glorie to be perfited moſt diligently.
label: 3-esdras

text: Then we asked the ancients ſaying, by whoſe permiſſion build ye this houſe, & found theſe workes?
label: 3-esdras

text: And therfore we asked them, that we might doe thee to know the men & the ouerſeers, and we required of them a rolle of the names of the ouerſeers.
label: 3-esdras

text: But they anſwered vs ſaying: We are the ſeruantes of the Lord, which made heauen and earth.
label: 3-esdras

text: And this houſe was built theſe manie yeares paſt by a king of Iſrael that was great and moſt valiant, and was finished.
label: 3-esdras

text: And becauſe our fathers were prouoking to wrath, and ſinned agaynſt God of Iſrael, he deliuered them into the handes of Nabuchodonoſor the king of Babylon, king of the Chaldees.
label: 3-esdras

text: And throwing downe this houſe they burnt it, and they led the people captiue into Babylon.
label: 3-esdras

text: In the firſt yeare when Cyrus reigned the king of Babylon, Cyrus the king wrote to build this houſe.
label: 3-esdras

text: And theſe ſacred veſſels of gold and ſiluer which Nabuchodonoſor had taken out of the houſe which is in Ierualſem, and had conſecrated them in his owne temple, Cyrus brought them forth agayne out of the temple which was in Babylon, and they were deliuered to Zorobabel, & to Salmanaſar the deputie.
label: 3-esdras

text: And it was commanded them that they should offer theſe veſſels, & lay them vp in the temple, which was in Ieruſalem, and build the temple of God itſelf in his place.
label: 3-esdras

text: Then did Salmanaſar lay the fundations of the houſe of our Lord, which is in Ieruſalem: and from that time vntil now it is a building, and is not accomplished.
label: 3-esdras

text: Now therfore if thou thincke it good ô king, let it be ſought in the kings liberaries of Cyrus the king, which are in Babylon:
label: 3-esdras

text: and if it shal be found, that the building of the houſe of the Lord, which is in Ieruſalem, begane by the counſel of Cyrus the king, and it be thought good of our Lord the king, let him write to vs of theſe thinges.
label: 3-esdras

text: Then Darius the king commanded ſearch to be made in the libraries: and there was found in Ecbatana a towne that is in the countrie of Media, one place wherin were writen theſe wordes:
label: 3-esdras

text: IN THE FIRST YEARE of the reigne of Cyrus, king Cyrus commanded to build the houſe of the Lord which is in Ieruſalem, where they did burne incenſe with dayly fire,
label: 3-esdras

text: the height wherof shal be of ten cubits, & the bredth threeſcore cubites, foure ſquare with three ſtones polished, and with a loft galerie of wood of the ſame countrie, & one new galerie, and the expenſes to be geuen out of the houſe of Cyrus the king.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the ſacred veſſeles of the houſe of the Lord, as wel of gold as of ſiluer, which Nabuchodonoſor tooke from the houſe of our Lord, which is in Ieruſalem where they were layed, that they be put there:
label: 3-esdras

text: And he commanded Siſennes the deputie of Syria & Phœnice, and Satrabuzanes, and his felowes & them that were ordayned preſidentes in Syria & Phœnice, that they should refraine themſelues from that place.
label: 3-esdras

text: And I alſo haue geuen commandment to build it wholly: and haue prouided, that they helpe them, which are of the captiuitie of the Iewes, til the temple of the houſe of the Lord be accomplished.
label: 3-esdras

text: And from the vexation of the tributes of Cœleſyria & Phœnice, a quantitie to be geuen diligently to theſe men for the ſacrifice of the Lord, to Zorobabel the gouernour, for oxen, and rammes, and lambes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And in like maner corne alſo, and ſalt, and wine, and oyle continually yeare by yeare, according as the prieſtes which are in Ieruſalem, haue preſcribed to be ſpent dayly:
label: 3-esdras

text: that libamentes may be offered to the moſt high God for the king & his children, & that they may pray for their life.
label: 3-esdras

text: And that it be denounced, that whoſoeuer shal tranſgreſſe anie thing of theſe which are writen, or shal deſpiſe it, a beame be taken of theyr owne, & they be hanged, & their goodes be confiſcate to the king.
label: 3-esdras

text: Therfore the Lord alſo, whoſe name is inuocated there, deſtroy euery king & nation, that shal extend their hand to hinder or to handle il the houſe of the Lord which is in Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: I Darius the king haue decreed that it be moſt diligently done according to theſe thinges.
label: 3-esdras

text: THEN Siſennes the deputie of Cœleſyria, and Phænice, and Satrabuzames, and their felowes, obeying thoſe thinges which were decreed of Darius the king,
label: 3-esdras

text: applied the ſacred workes moſt diligently, working together with the ancientes of the Iewes, the princes of Syria.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the ſacred workes proſpered, Aggeus & Zacharias the prophetes prophecying.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they accomplished al thinges by the precept of our Lord the God of Iſrael, and by the counſel of Cyrus, & Darius, and Artaxerxes the king of the Perſians.
label: 3-esdras

text: And our houſe was a finishing vntil the three and twentith day of the moneth of Adar, the ſixth yeare of Darius the king.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the children of Iſrael, and the Prieſtes and Leuites, and the reſt that were of the captiuitie, which were added did according to thoſe thinges that are written in the booke of Moyſes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they offered for the dedication of the temple of our Lord, oxen an hundred, rammes two hundred, lambes foure hundred.
label: 3-esdras

text: And kiddes for the ſinnes of al Iſrael, twelue, according to the number of the tribes of Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the Prieſtes and Leuites ſtood clothed with ſtoles by tribes, ouer al the workes of our Lord the God of Iſrael, according to the booke of Moyſes, and the porters at euerie gate.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the children of Iſrael, with them that were of the captiuitie celebrated the phaſe the fourtenth moone of the firſt moneth, when the Prieſtes and Leuites were ſanctified.
label: 3-esdras

text: Al the children of the captiuitie were not ſanctified together, becauſe al the Leuites were ſanctified together.
label: 3-esdras

text: And al the children of the captiuitie immolated the phaſe, both for their brethren the Prieſtes, and for themſelues.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the children of Iſrael did eate, they that were of the captiuitie al that remayned apart from al the abominations of the nations of the land ſeeking our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they celebrated the feſtiual day of Azymes ſeuen dayes feaſting in the ſight of our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: Becauſe he turned the counſel of the king of the Aſſirians toward them, to ſtrengthen their handes to the workes of our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: AND after him when Artaxerxes king of the Perſians reigned, came Eſdras the ſonne of Azarias, the ſonne of Helcias the ſonne of Salome,
label: 3-esdras

text: the ſonne of Sadoc, the ſonne of Achitob, the ſonne of Ameri, the ſonne of Azahel, the ſonne of Bocci, the ſonne of Abiſue, the ſonne of Phinees the ſonne of Eleazar, the ſonne of Aaron the firſt prieſt.
label: 3-esdras

text: This Eſdras came vp from Babylon being ſcribe & wiſe in the law of Moyſes, which was geuen of our Lord the God of Iſrael to teach and to doe.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the king gaue him glorie, becauſe he had found grace in al dignitie and deſire in his ſight.
label: 3-esdras

text: And there went vp with him of the children of Iſrael, and the Prieſtes, and the Leuites, and the ſacred ſingers of the temple, and the porters, and the ſeruantes of the temple into Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: In the ſeuenth yeare when Artaxerxes reigned in the fifth moneth, this is the ſeuenth yeare of his reigne, going forth of Babylon in the newmoone of the fifth moneth,
label: 3-esdras

text: they came to Ieruſalem according to his commandment, according to the proſperitie of their iourney, which their Lord gaue them.
label: 3-esdras

text: For in theſe Eſdras had great knowlege, that he would not pretermitte anie of thoſe thinges, which were according to the law, and the preceptes of our Lord, and in teaching al Iſrael al iuſtice and iudgement.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they that wrote the writinges of Artaxerxes the king, coming deliuered the writing which was granted of Artaxerxes the king to Eſdras the Prieſt, & the reader of the law of our Lord, the copie wherof here foloweth.
label: 3-esdras

text: KING Artaxerxes to Eſdras the Prieſt, and reader of the law of the Lord, greeting.
label: 3-esdras

text: I of curteſie eſteming it among benifites, haue commanded them that of their owne accord are deſirous of the nation of the Iewes, and of the Prieſtes and Leuites, which are in my kingdom, to goe with thee into Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: If anie therfore deſire to goe with thee, let them come together, and ſet forward as it hath pleaſed me, and my ſeuen freindes my counſelers:
label: 3-esdras

text: that they may viſite thoſe thinges which are done touching Iurie and Ieruſalem, obſeruing as thou haſt in the law of the Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: And let them carie the giftes to the Lord the God of Iſrael, which I haue vowed and my freindes to Ieruſalem, and al the gold and ſiluer, that shal be found in the countrie of Babylon to the Lord in Ieruſalem, with that,
label: 3-esdras

text: which is geuen for the nation it ſelf vnto the temple of their Lord which is in Ieruſalem: that this gold and ſiluer be gathered for oxen, and rammes, and lambes, and kiddes, and for the thinges that are agreable to theſe,
label: 3-esdras

text: that they may offer hoſtes to the Lord vpon the altar of their Lord, which is in Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: And al thinges whatſoeuer thou with thy brethren wilt doe with gold and ſiluer, doe it at thy pleaſure according to the precept of the Lord thy God.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the ſacred veſſels, which are geuen thee to the workes of the houſe of the Lord thy God, which is in Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: And other thinges whatſoeuer shal helpe thee to the workes of the temple of thy God, thou shalt geue it out of the kings treaſure.
label: 3-esdras

text: When thou with thy brethren wilt doe ought with gold and ſiluer, doe according to the wil of the Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: And I king Artaxerxes haue geuen commandment to the keepers of the treaſure of Syria and Phænice, that what thinges ſoeuer Eſdras the Prieſt and reader of the law of the Lord, shal write for, they geue him vnto an hundred talentes of ſiluer, likewiſe alſo of gold.
label: 3-esdras

text: And vnto an hundred meaſures of corne, & an hundred veſſels of wine, and other thinges whatſoeuer abound without taxing.
label: 3-esdras

text: Let al thinges be done to the moſt high God according to the law of God, leſt perhaps there ariſe wrath in the reigne of the king, and of his ſonne, and his ſonnes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And to you it is ſayd, that vpon al the Prieſtes, and Leuites, and ſacred ſingers, and ſeruantes of the temple, & ſcribes of this temple
label: 3-esdras

text: no tribute, nor any other taxe be ſette, and that no man haue auctoritie to obiect any thing to them.
label: 3-esdras

text: But thou Eſdras according to the wiſedom of God appoynt iudges, and arbitrers in al Syria and Phænice: and teach al them that know no the law of thy God:
label: 3-esdras

text: that whoſoeuer shal tranſgreſſe the law, they be diligently punished either with death, or with torment, or els with a forfeite of money, or with banishment.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Eſdras the ſcribe ſayd: Bleſſed be the God of our fathers, which hath geuen this wil into the kings hart, to glorifie his houſe, which is in Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: And hath honoured me in the ſight of the king, and of his counſelers, and freindes, and them that weare purple.
label: 3-esdras

text: And I was made conſtant in minde according to the ayde of our Lord my God, and gathered together of Iſrael men, that should goe vp together with me.
label: 3-esdras

text: And theſe are the princes according to their kindredes, and ſeueral principalities of them that came vp from Babylon the kingdom of Artaxerxes.
label: 3-esdras

text: Of the children of Phares, Gerſomus: and of the children of Siemarith, Amenus: of the children of Dauid, Acchus the ſonne of Scecilia:
label: 3-esdras

text: Of the children of Phares, Zacharias, and with him returned an hundred fiftie men.
label: 3-esdras

text: Of the children of leader Moabilion, Zaræi, and with him two hundred fiftie men:
label: 3-esdras

text: Of the children of Zachues, Iechonias of Zechoel, and with him two hundred fiftie men:
label: 3-esdras

text: of the children of Sala, Maaſias of Gotholia, & with him ſeuentie men:
label: 3-esdras

text: of the children of Saphatia, Zarias of Michel, and with him eightie men:
label: 3-esdras

text: of the children of Iob, Abdias of Iehel, and with him two hundred twelue men:
label: 3-esdras

text: of the children of Bania, Salimoth, the ſonne of Ioſaphia, and with him an hundred ſixtie men:
label: 3-esdras

text: of the children of Beer, Zacharias Bebei, and with him two hundred eight men:
label: 3-esdras

text: of the children of Ezead, Ioannes of Eccetan, and with him an hundred ten men:
label: 3-esdras

text: of the children of Adonicam, which were laſt, and theſe are their names, Eliphalam the ſonne of Gebel, and Semeias, and with him ſeuentie men.
label: 3-esdras

text: And I gathered them together to the riuer that is called Thia, and we camped there three dayes, and vewed them againe.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the children of the Prieſtes and Leuites I found not there.
label: 3-esdras

text: And I ſent to Eleazarus, and Eccelon, and Maſman, and Maloban, and Enaathan, and Samea, and Ioribum, Nathan, Enuagam, Zacharias, and Moſolam the leaders them ſelues, and that were skilful.
label: 3-esdras

text: And I ſayd to them that they should come to Loddeus, who was at the place of the treaſurie.
label: 3-esdras

text: And I commanded them to ſay to Loddeus, and his brethren, and to them that were in the treaſurie, that they should ſend vs them that might doe the function of prieſthood in the houſe of the Lord our God.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they brought vnto vs according to the mightie hand of the Lord our God cunning men: of the children of Moholi, the ſonne of Leui, the ſonne of Iſrael, Sebebia, & his ſonnes and brethren, which were eightene:
label: 3-esdras

text: Asbia, and Amin of the ſonnes of the children of Chananeus, and their children twentie men.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of them that ſerued the temple, whom Dauid gaue, and the princes themſelues to the miniſterie of the Leuites of them that ſerued the temple, two hundred twentie. Al their names were ſignified in writings.
label: 3-esdras

text: And I vowed there a faſt to the yong men in the ſight of God, that I might aske of him a good iourney for vs, and them that were with vs, and for the children, and the cattel becauſe of ambushementes.
label: 3-esdras

text: For I was ashamed to aske of the king footemen and horſemen in my companie, to guard vs, againſt our aduerſaries.
label: 3-esdras

text: For we ſayd to the king that the power of our Lord wil be with them that ſeeke him with al affection.
label: 3-esdras

text: And agayne we beſought the Lord our God according to theſe thinges: whom alſo we had propicious, and we obteyned of our God.
label: 3-esdras

text: And I ſeparated of the rulers of the people, and of the Prieſtes of the temple, twelue men, and Sedebia, and Aſanna, and with them of their brethren ten men.
label: 3-esdras

text: And I weyed to them the gold and ſiluer, and the veſſels of the houſe of our God perteyning to the Prieſtes, which the king had geuen, and his counſelers, and the princes, and al Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: And when I had weyed it, I deliuered of ſiluer an hundred fiftie talentes, and ſiluer veſſels of an hundred talentes, and of gold an hundred talentes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of veſſels of gold ſeuen ſcore and twelue braſen veſſels good of shyning braſſe, reſembling the forme of gold.
label: 3-esdras

text: And I ſayd to them: You are alſo ſanctified to our Lord, and the veſſels be holie, and the gold and ſiluer is vowed to our Lord the God of our fathers.
label: 3-esdras

text: Watch and keepe, til you deliuer them to ſome of the rulers of the people, and to the Prieſtes, and Leuites, and to the princes of the cities of Iſrael in Ieruſalem, in the treaſurie of the houſe of our God.
label: 3-esdras

text: And thoſe Prieſtes and Leuites that receiued the gold and ſiluer and veſſels, brought it to Ieruſalem into the temple of our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: And we went forward from the riuer Thia, the twelfth day of the firſt moneth, til we entred into Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: And when the third day was come, in the fourth day the gold being weyed, and the ſiluer, was deliuered in the houſe of the Lord our God, to Marimoth Prieſt the ſonne of Iori.
label: 3-esdras

text: And with him was Eleazar the ſonne of Phinees: and with them were Ioſadus the ſonne of Ieſus, and Medias, and Banni the ſonne of a Leuite, by number and weight al thinges.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the weight of them was writen the ſame houre.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they that came out of the captiuitie, offered ſacrifice to our Lord the God of Iſrael, oxen twelue, for al Iſrael, rammes eightie ſix,
label: 3-esdras

text: lambes ſeuentie two, bucke goates for ſinne twelue, and for health twelue kyne, al for the ſacrifice of our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they read againe the preceptes of the king to the kinges officers, and to the deputies of Cœleſyria, and Phœnice: and they honored the nation, and the temple of our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: And theſe thinges being finished, the rulers came to me, ſaying: The ſtocke of Iſrael, and the princes, and the Prieſtes, and the Leuites,
label: 3-esdras

text: and the ſtrange people, and nations of the land haue not ſeparated their vncleannes from the Chananeites, and Hetheites, and Pherezeites, and Iebuſeites, and Moobites, & Ægyptians, and Idumeians.
label: 3-esdras

text: For they are ioyned to their daughters both themſelues, and their ſonnes: and the holie ſede is mingled with the ſtrange nations of the earth, and the rulers and magiſtrates were partakers of that iniquitie from the beginning of the reigne it ſelf.
label: 3-esdras

text: And forthwith as I heard theſe thinges, I rent my garmentes and the ſacred tunike: and tearing the heares of my head, and my beard, I ſate ſorowful and heauie.
label: 3-esdras

text: And there aſſembled to me mourning vpon this iniquitie, as manie as were then moued by the word of our Lord the God of Iſrael, and I ſate ſad vntil the euening ſacrifice.
label: 3-esdras

text: And I riſing vp from faſting, hauing my garmentes rent and the ſacred tunike, kneeling, and ſtretching forth my handes to our Lord,
label: 3-esdras

text: I ſayd: Lord I am confounded, and ashamed before thy face,
label: 3-esdras

text: for our ſinnes are multiplied ouer our heades, and our iniquities are exalted euen to heauen.
label: 3-esdras

text: Becauſe from the times of our fathers we are in great ſinne vnto this day.
label: 3-esdras

text: And for the ſinnes of vs, and of our fathers we haue bene deliuered with our brethren, and with our Prieſtes to the kinges of the earth, into ſword and captiuitie, and ſpoile with confuſion vnto this preſent day.
label: 3-esdras

text: And now what a great thing is this that mercie hath happened to vs from thee ô Lord God, & leaue thou vnto vs a roote, and a name in the place of thy ſanctification,
label: 3-esdras

text: to diſcouer our light in the houſe of the Lord our God, to geue vs meate in al the time of our bondage.
label: 3-esdras

text: And when we ſerued, we were not forſaken of the Lord our God: but he ſette vs in fauour, appointing the kinges of the Perſians to geue vs meate,
label: 3-esdras

text: and to glorifie the temple of the Lord our God, and to build the deſolations of Sion, to geue vs ſtabilitie in Iurie, and Ieruſalem.
label: 3-esdras

text: And now what ſay we Lord, hauing theſe thinges? For we haue tranſgreſſed thy preceptes, which thou gaueſt into the handes of thy ſeruants the prophetes,
label: 3-esdras

text: ſaying: That the land into which ye entred to poſſeſſe the inheritance therof, is a land polluted with the coinquinations of the ſtrangers of the land, and their vncleanes hath filled it wholy with their filthines.
label: 3-esdras

text: And now your daughters you shal not match with their ſonnes, and their daughters you shal not take for your ſonnes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And you shal not ſeeke to haue peace with them for euer, that growing ſtrong you may eate the beſt things of the land, and may diſtribute the inheritance to your children for euer.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the thinges that happen to vs, al are done for our nauhtie workes, and our great ſinnes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And thou gaueſt vs ſuch a roote, and we are returned againe to tranſgreſſe thy ordinances, that we would be mingled with the vncleannes of the nations of this land.
label: 3-esdras

text: Wilt not thou be wrath with vs to deſtroy vs, til there be no roote left nor our name?
label: 3-esdras

text: Lord God of Iſrael thou art true. For there is a roote left vntil this preſent day.
label: 3-esdras

text: Behold, now we are in thy ſight in our iniquities. For it is not to ſtand any longer before thee in theſe matters.
label: 3-esdras

text: And when Eſdras with adoration confeſſed weeping, lying flat on the ground before the temple, there were gathered before him out of Ieruſalem a verie great multitude, men and wemen, and yong men and youg wemen. For there was great weeping in the multitude it ſelf.
label: 3-esdras

text: And when he had cried, Iechonias of Ieheli of the children of Iſrael, ſayd to Eſdras: We haue ſinned againſt our Lord, for that we haue taken vnto vs in mariage ſtrange wemen of the nations of the land.
label: 3-esdras

text: And now thou art ouer al Iſrael, in theſe therfore let there be an othe from our Lord to expel al our wiues that are of ſtrangers with their children.
label: 3-esdras

text: As it was decreed to thee of the anceſters according to the law of our Lord, riſing vp declare it.
label: 3-esdras

text: For to thee the buſines perteineth, and we are with thee: doe manfully.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Eſdras ryſing vp adiured the princes of the Prieſtes and Leuites, and al Iſrael to doe according to theſe thinges and they ſware.
label: 3-esdras

text: AND Eſdras ryſing vp from before the court of the temple, went into the chamber of Ionathas the ſonne of Naſabi.
label: 3-esdras

text: And lodging there he taſted no bread, nor dranke water for the iniquitie of the multitude.
label: 3-esdras

text: And there was proclamation made in al Iurie, & in Ieruſalem to al that were of the captiuitie gathered in Ieruſalem,
label: 3-esdras

text: that whoſoeuer shal not appeare within two or three dayes, according to the iudgement of the ancients ſitting vpon it, their goods should be taken away, and himſelfe should be iudged an alien from the multitude of the captiuitie.
label: 3-esdras

text: And al were gathered that were of the tribe of Iuda, and of Beniamin within three dayes in Ieruſalem: this is the ninth moneth, the twentith day of the moneth.
label: 3-esdras

text: And al the multitude ſate in the court of the temple trembling, for the preſent winter.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Eſdras ryſing vp ſayd to them: You haue done vnlawfully taking to you in mariage ſtrang wiues, that you might adde to the ſinnes of Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: And now geue confeſſion, & magnificence to our Lord the God of our fathers:
label: 3-esdras

text: and accomplish his wil, and depart from the nations of the land, and from your wiues the ſtrangers.
label: 3-esdras

text: And al the multitude cried, and they ſayd with a lowde voice: As thou haſt ſayd, we wil doe.
label: 3-esdras

text: But becauſe the multitude is great, and winter time, and we can not ſtand in the ayre without ſuccour: and this is a worke for vs not of one day, nor of two, for we haue ſinned much in theſe thinges:
label: 3-esdras

text: Let the rulers of the multitude ſtand, and that dwel with vs, and as manie as haue with them forreine wiues,
label: 3-esdras

text: and at a time appointed let the prieſtes out of euerie place, and the iudges aſſiſt, vntil they appeaze the wrath of our Lord concerning this buſines.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Ionathas the ſonne of Ezeli, and Ozias of Thecam tooke vpon them according to theſe wordes: and Boſoramus, and Leuis, and Sabbathæus, wrought together with them.
label: 3-esdras

text: And al that were of the captiuitie ſtood according to al theſe thinges.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Eſdras the prieſt choſe vnto him men the great princes of their fathers according to their names: & they ſate together in the newmoone of the tenth moneth to examine this buſines.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they determined of the men that had outlandish wiues, vntil the newmoone of the firſt moneth.
label: 3-esdras

text: And there were found of the prieſtes entermingled that had outlandish wiues.
label: 3-esdras

text: Of the ſonnes of Ieſus the ſonne of Ioſedec, and his brethren: Maſeas, and Eleazarus, and Ioribus, and Ioadeus,
label: 3-esdras

text: and they put to their handes to expel their wiues: and to offer a ramme to obtayne pardon for their ignorance.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the ſonnes of Semmeri: Maſeas and Eſſes, Ieelech, and Azarias.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the children of Foſere: Limoſias, Hiſmaenis, and Nathanee, Iuſſio, Reddus, and Thalſas.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the Leuites: Iorabdus, and Semeis, and Colnis, and Calitas, and Facteas, and Coluas, and Eliomas,
label: 3-esdras

text: and of the ſacred ſinging men, Eliaſib, Zaccarus.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the porters, Salumus, and Tolbanes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of Iſrael: of the ſonnes of Foro, Ozi, and Remias, and Geddias, & Melchias, and Michelus, Eleazarus, and Iammebias, and Bannas.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the ſonnes of Iolaman: Chamas, and Zacharias, and Iezuelus, and Ioddius, and Erimoth, and Helias.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the ſonnes of Zathoim: Eliadas, and Liaſumus, Zochias, and Larimoth, & Zabdis, and Thebedias.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the ſonnes of Zebes: Ioannes, and Amanias, and Zabdias, and Emeus.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the ſonnes of Banni: Olamus, & Maluchus, and Ieddeus, and Iaſub, and Azabus, & Ierimoth.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the ſonnes of Addin: Nathus, and Mooſias, & Caleus, and Raanas, Maaſeas, Mathathias, and Beſeel, and Bonnus, and Manaſſes.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the ſonnes of Nuae: Noneas, and Aſeas, and Melchias, and Sameas, and Simon, Beniamin, and Malchus, and Marras.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the ſonnes of Aſom: Carianeus, Mathathias, & Bannus, & Eliphalach, and Manaſſes, and Semei.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the ſonnes of Banni: Ieremias, and Moadias, and Abramus, & Iohel, and Baneas, & Pelias, and Ionas, and Marimoth, & Eliaſib, and Matheneus, and Eliaſis, and Orizas, and Dielus, and Semedius, & Zambris, and Ioſephus.
label: 3-esdras

text: And of the ſonnes of Nobei: Idelus, and Mathathias, and Sabadus, and Zecheda, Zedmi, and Ieſſei, Baneas.
label: 3-esdras

text: Al theſe maried outlandish wiues, and did put them away with their children.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the Prieſtes and the Leuites, and they that were of Iſrael, dwelt in Ieruſalem, and in the whole countrie in the newmoone of the ſeuenth moneth. And the children of Iſrael were in their habitations.
label: 3-esdras

text: And al the multitude was gathered together into the court, which is on the eaſt of the ſacred gate:
label: 3-esdras

text: and they ſayd to Eſdras the high prieſt, and reader, that he should bring the law of Moyſes, which was deliuered of our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Eſdras the high prieſt brought the law to al the multitude of them from man vnto woman, and to al the prieſtes to heare the law in the newmoone of the ſeuenth moneth.
label: 3-esdras

text: And he read in the court, which is before the ſacred gate of the temple, from breake of day vntil euening before men and wemen. And they al gaue their minde to the law.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Eſdras the prieſt, and reader of the law ſtoode vpon a tribunal of wood, which was made.
label: 3-esdras

text: And by him ſtood Mathathias, and Samus, and Ananias, Azarias, Vrias, Ezechias, and Balſamus on the right hand,
label: 3-esdras

text: and on the left Faldeus, Miſael, Malachias, Ambuſthas, Sabus, Nabadias, and Zacharias.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Eſdras tooke the booke before al the multitude: for he was chiefe in glorie in the ſight of al.
label: 3-esdras

text: And when he had ended the law, they ſtood al vpright: and Eſdras bleſſed our Lord the moſt high God, the God of Sabaoth omnipotent.
label: 3-esdras

text: And al the people anſwered: Amen. And lifting vp their handes falling on the ground, they adored our Lord.
label: 3-esdras

text: Ieſus and Banaeus, and Sarebias, and Iaddimus, and Accubus, and Sabbathæus, and Calithes, & Azarias, and Ioradus, and Ananias, and Philias Leuites,
label: 3-esdras

text: who taught the law of our Lord, and read the ſame in the multitude, & euerie one preferred them that vnderſtood the leſſon.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Atharathes ſayd to Eſdras the high prieſt and the reader, and to the Leuites, that taught the multitude,
label: 3-esdras

text: ſaying: This day is ſanctified to our Lord. And they al wept, when they had heard the law.
label: 3-esdras

text: And Eſdras ſayd, departing therfore eate ye al the fatteſt thinges, & drinke al moſt ſwete things, and ſend giftes to them that haue not.
label: 3-esdras

text: For this is the holy day of our Lord, & be not ſad. For our Lord wil glorifie you.
label: 3-esdras

text: And the Leuites denounced openly to al, ſaying: This day is holie, be not ſad.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they went al to eate, and drinke, and make merie, and to geue giftes to them that had not, that they might make merie, for they were excedingly exalted with the wordes that they were taught.
label: 3-esdras

text: And they were al gathered in Ieruſalem to celebrate the ioy, according to the teſtament of our Lord the God of Iſrael.
label: 3-esdras

text: THE ſecond booke of Eſdras the prophet, the ſonne of Sarei, the ſonne of Azarei, the ſonne of Helcias, the ſonne of Sadanias, the ſonne of Sadoch, the ſonne of Achitob,
label: 4-esdras

text: the ſonne of Achias, the ſonne of Phinees, the ſonne of Heli, the ſonne of Amerias, the ſonne of Aſiel, the ſonne of Marimoth, the ſonne of Arna, the ſonne of Ozias, the ſonne of Borith, the ſonne of Abiſei, the ſonne of Phinees, the ſonne of Eleazar,
label: 4-esdras

text: the ſonne of Aaron of the tribe of Leui; who was captiue in the countrie of the Medes, in the reigne of Artaxerxes king of the Perſians.
label: 4-esdras

text: And the word of our Lord came to me, ſaying:
label: 4-esdras

text: Goe, and tel my people their wicked deedes, and their children the iniquities, that they haue done againſt me, that they may tel their childrens children:
label: 4-esdras

text: becauſe the ſinnes of their parentes are increaſed in them, for they being forgetful of me haue ſacrified to ſtrange goddes.
label: 4-esdras

text: Did not I bring them out of the land of Ægypt from the houſe of bondange? But they haue prouoked me, & haue deſpiſed my counſels.
label: 4-esdras

text: But doe thou shake of the heare of thy head, and throw al euils vpon them: becauſe they haue not obeyed my law. And it is a people without diſcipline.
label: 4-esdras

text: How long shal I beare with them, on whom I haue beſtowed ſo great benefites?
label: 4-esdras

text: I haue ouerthrowen manie kinges from them. I haue ſtroke Pharao with his ſeruantes, and al his hoſte.
label: 4-esdras

text: Al nations did I deſtroy before their face, & in the Eaſt I diſſipated the peoples of two prouinces Tyre and Sidon, and I ſlew al their aduerſaries.
label: 4-esdras

text: But ſpeake thou to them, ſaying: Thus ſayth our Lord:
label: 4-esdras

text: I made you paſſe through the ſea, and gaue you fenſed ſtreates from the beginning. I gaue you Moyſes for your gouernour, and Aaron for the Prieſt:
label: 4-esdras

text: I gaue you light by the piller of fire, & did manie meruelous things among you: but you haue forgotten me, ſayth our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: Thus ſayth our Lord omnipotent: The quayle was a ſigne to you, I gaue you a campe for defenſe, and there you murmured:
label: 4-esdras

text: And you triumphed not in my name for the deſtruction of your enemies, but yet vntil now you haue murmured.
label: 4-esdras

text: Where are the benefites, that I haue geuen you? Did you not crie out to me when you were hungrie in the deſert,
label: 4-esdras

text: ſaying: Why haſt thou brought vs into this deſert to kil vs? it had bene better for vs to ſerue the Ægyptians, then to dye in this deſert.
label: 4-esdras

text: I was ſorie for your mournings, & gaue you manna to eate. You did eate bread of Angels.
label: 4-esdras

text: When you thirſted did not I cleaue the rocke, & waters flowed in abundance? for the heates I couered you with the leaues of trees.
label: 4-esdras

text: I deliuered vnto you fatte landes: The Chananeites, and Pherezeites, and Philiſtheans I threw out from your face: what shal I yet doe to you, ſayth our Lord?
label: 4-esdras

text: Thus ſayth our Lord omnipotent: In the deſert when you were thirſtie in the riuer of the Amorrheites, and blaſpheming my name,
label: 4-esdras

text: I gaue you not fire for blaſphemies, but caſting wood into the water, I made the riuer ſwete.
label: 4-esdras

text: What shal I doe to thee Iacob? Thou wouldeſt not obey ô Iuda. I wil transferre my ſelf to other nations, and wil geue them my name, that they may keepe my ordinances.
label: 4-esdras

text: Becauſe you haue forſaken me, I alſo forſake you: when you aske mercie of me, I wil not haue mercie.
label: 4-esdras

text: When you shal inuocate me, I wil not heare you. For you haue defiled your handes with bloud, and your fete are quicke to commit murders.
label: 4-esdras

text: Not as though you haue forſaken me, but yourſelues, ſayth our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: Thus ſaith our Lord omnipotent, haue not I deſired you, as a father his ſonnes, and a mother her daughters, and as a nurce her litle ones,
label: 4-esdras

text: that you would be my people, and I your God, and to me for children, and I to you for a father?
label: 4-esdras

text: So haue I gathered you, as the henne her chickenes vnder her winges. But now what shal I doe to you? I wil throw you from my face.
label: 4-esdras

text: When you shal bring me oblation, I wil turne away my face from you. For I haue refuſed your feſtiual dayes, & newmoones, and circumciſions.
label: 4-esdras

text: I ſent my ſeruantes the prophetes to you, whom being taken you ſlew, and mangled their bodies, whoſe bloud I wil require, ſayth our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: Thus ſayth our Lord omnipotent, your houſe is made deſolate, I wil throw you away, as the winde doth ſtubble,
label: 4-esdras

text: and your children shal not haue iſſue: becauſe they haue neglected my commandment, and haue done that which is euil before me.
label: 4-esdras

text: I wil deliuer your houſes to a people comming, who not hearing me do beleue: to whom I haue not shewed ſignes, they wil do the thinges that I haue commanded.
label: 4-esdras

text: The prophetes they haue not ſene, and they wil be mindful of their iniquities.
label: 4-esdras

text: I cal to witnes the grace of the people comming, whoſe litle ones reioyce with ioy, not ſeing me with their carnal eyes, but in ſpirit beleuing the thinges that I haue ſayd.
label: 4-esdras

text: And now brother behold what glorie: and ſee people comming from the eaſt,
label: 4-esdras

text: to whom I wil geue the conduction of Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob, and of Oſee, and Amos, and of Ioel, and Abdias, and Ionas, and Michæas,
label: 4-esdras

text: and Naum and Habacuc, of Sophonias, Aggæus, Zacharias, and Malachias, who alſo is called the Angel of our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: THVS ſaith our Lord: I brought this people out of bondage, to whom I gaue commandment by my ſeruantes the Prophetes, whom they would not heare, but made my counſel fruſtrate.
label: 4-esdras

text: Their mother that bare them, ſayth to them: Goe children, becauſe I am a wydow and forſaken.
label: 4-esdras

text: I brought you vp with ioy, & haue loſt you with mourning & ſorow, becauſe you haue ſinned before our Lord your God, & haue done that which is euil before him.
label: 4-esdras

text: But now what shal I doe to you? I am a wydow and deſolate, goe my children, & aske mercie of our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I cal thee ô father a witnes vpon the mother of the children, that would not keepe my teſtament,
label: 4-esdras

text: that thou geue them confuſion, & their mother into ſpoile, that there be no generation of them.
label: 4-esdras

text: Let their names be diſperſed into the Gentiles, let them be deſtroyed out of the land: becauſe they haue deſpiſed my ſacrament.
label: 4-esdras

text: Woe be to thee Aſſur, which hideſt the wicked with thee. Thou naughtie nation, remember what I did to Sodom & Gomorrha:
label: 4-esdras

text: whoſe land lieth in cloddes of pitch, & heapes of ashes: ſo wil I make them, that haue not heard me, ſaith our Lord omnipotent.
label: 4-esdras

text: Thus ſaith our Lord to Eſdras: Tel my people, that I wil geue them the kingdom of Ieruſalem, which I ment to geue to Iſrael.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I wil take to me the glorie of them, and wil geue them eternal tabernacles, which I had prepared for them.
label: 4-esdras

text: The wood of life shal be to them for an odour of oyntment, and they shal not labour, nor be wearied.
label: 4-esdras

text: Goe & you shal receiue. Aske for your ſelues a few dayes, that they may abide. Now the kingdom is prepared for you, watch ye.
label: 4-esdras

text: Cal thou heauen and earth to witnes: for I haue deſtroyed euil, and haue created good, becauſe I liue ſayth our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: Mother embrace thy children, bring them vp with ioy. As a doue confirme their feete: becauſe I haue choſen thee, ſayth our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I wil raiſe againe the dead out of their places, and out of the monumentes I wil bring them forth, becauſe I haue knowen my name in Iſrael.
label: 4-esdras

text: Feare not ô mother of the children, becauſe I haue choſen thee, ſaith our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: I wil ſend thee ayde, my ſeruantes Iſaie, and Ieremie, at whoſe counſel I haue ſanctified, and prepared for thee twelue trees loden with diuerſe fruites,
label: 4-esdras

text: and as manie fountaines flowing milke and honie: and ſeuen huge mountaines, hauing the roſe and the lilie, in the which I wil fil thy children with ioy.
label: 4-esdras

text: Iuſtifie thou the widow, iudge for the pupil, geue to the needie, defend the orphane, cloth the naked,
label: 4-esdras

text: cure the broken & feeble, mocke not the lame, defend the maimed, and admitte the blind to the viſion of my glorie.
label: 4-esdras

text: The old man & the yong keepe within thy walles:
label: 4-esdras

text: where thou shalt finde the dead, committe them to the graue ſigning it, & I wil geue thee the firſt ſeate in my reſurrection.
label: 4-esdras

text: Pauſe and reſt my people, becauſe thy reſt shal come.
label: 4-esdras

text: As a good nurce nourish thy children, confirme their feete.
label: 4-esdras

text: The ſeruantes that I haue geuen thee, none of them shal perish. For I wil require them of thy number.
label: 4-esdras

text: Be not wearied. For when the day of affliction and diſtreſſe shal come, others shal weepe, and be ſad, but thou shalt be merie and plenteous.
label: 4-esdras

text: The gentiles shal enuie, and shal be able to doe nothing againſt thee, ſayth our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: My handes shal couer thee, that thy children ſee not hel.
label: 4-esdras

text: Be pleaſant thou mother with thy children, becauſe I wil deliuer thee ſayth our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: Remember thy children that ſleepe, for I wil bring them out of the ſides of the earth, & wil doe mercie with them: becauſe I am merciful, ſayth our Lord omnipotent.
label: 4-esdras

text: Embrace thy children til I come, & shew them mercie: becauſe my fountaines runne ouer, and my grace shal not faile.
label: 4-esdras

text: I Eſdras receiued commandment of our Lord, in mount Oreb; that I should goe to Iſrael: to whom when I came, they refuſed me, and reiected the commandement of our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: And therfore, I ſay vnto you gentiles, which heare, and vnderſtand, Looke for your paſtor, he wil geue you the reſt of eternitie: becauſe he is at hand, that shal come in the end of the world.
label: 4-esdras

text: Be ye readie for the rewardes of the kingdom, becauſe perpetual light shal shine to you for time euerlaſting.
label: 4-esdras

text: Flee from the shadow of this world: receiue ye the pleaſantnes of your glorie. I openly cal to witnes my ſauiour.
label: 4-esdras

text: Receiue the commended gift and be pleaſant, geuing thankes to him that called you to the heauenlie kingdomes.
label: 4-esdras

text: Ariſe, & ſtand & ſee the number of them that are ſigned in the feaſt of our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: They that haue transferred them ſelues from the shadow of the world, haue receiued glorious garmentes of our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: Receiue ô Sion thy number, and shut vp thyne made white, which haue accomplished the law of our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: The number of thy children, which thou didſt wish is ful. Deſire the powre of our Lord that thy people may be ſanctified, which was called from the beginning.
label: 4-esdras

text: I Eſdras ſaw in mount Sion a great multitude, which I could not number, and they did al prayſe our Lord with ſonges.
label: 4-esdras

text: And in the middes of them was a young man high of ſtature, appearing aboue ouer them al, & he put crownes vpon euerie one of their heades, and he was more exalted. And I was aſtonied at the miracle.
label: 4-esdras

text: Then asked I an Angel, and ſayd: Who are theſe Lord?
label: 4-esdras

text: Who anſwering ſayd to me: Theſe are they that haue laid of the mortal garment, and taken an immortal, and haue confeſſed the name of God. Now they are crowned, and receiue palmes.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I ſayd to the Angel: That yongman what is he, which putteth the crownes vpon them, and geueth palmes into their handes?
label: 4-esdras

text: And anſwering he ſayd to me: The ſame is the Sonne of God, whom they did confeſſe in the world: & I begane to magnifie them, that ſtood ſtrongly for the name of our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: Then ſayd the Angel to me: Goe, tel my people, what maner of meruelous thinges and how great, thou haſt ſene of the Lord God.
label: 4-esdras

text: IN the thirteth yeare of the ruine of the citie I was in Babylon, and was trubled lying in my chamber, and my cogitations came vp ouer my hart:
label: 4-esdras

text: becauſe I ſaw the deſolation of Sion, and the abundance of them that dwelt in Babylon.
label: 4-esdras

text: And my ſpirit was toſſed excedingly, and I began to ſpeake to the higheſt timorous wordes,
label: 4-esdras

text: and ſayd: O Lord dominatour thou ſpakeſt from the beginning, when thou didſt plant the earth, and that alone, and didſt rule ouer the people,
label: 4-esdras

text: and gaueſt Adam a dead bodie: but that alſo was the worke of thy handes, & didſt breath into him the ſpirit of life, and he was made to liue before thee:
label: 4-esdras

text: and thou broughſt him into paradiſe, which thy right hand had planted, before the earth came.
label: 4-esdras

text: And him thou didſt command to loue thy way, and he tranſgreſſed it, & forthwith thou didſt inſtitute death in him, and in his poſteritie, and there were borne nations, and tribes, and peoples, and kinreds, wherof there is no number.
label: 4-esdras

text: And euerie nation walked in their owne wil, & they did meruelous thinges before thee, and deſpiſed thy preceptes.
label: 4-esdras

text: And agane in time thou broughſt in the floud vpon inhabitantes of the world, and didſt deſtroy them.
label: 4-esdras

text: And there was made in euery one of them, as vnto Adam to dye, ſo to them the floud,
label: 4-esdras

text: But thou didſt leaue one of them, Noe with his houſe and of him were al the iuſt.
label: 4-esdras

text: And it came to paſſe, when they began to be multiplied, that dwelt vpon the earth, & multiplied children and peoples and manie nations: and they begane againe to doe impietie more then the former.
label: 4-esdras

text: And it came to paſſe when they did iniquitie before thee, thou didſt chooſe thee a man of them whoſe name was Abraham.
label: 4-esdras

text: And thou didſt loue him and to him onlie thou didſt shew thy wil.
label: 4-esdras

text: And thou didſt diſpoſe vnto him an euerlaſting teſtament, and toldſt him that thou wouldſt neuer forſake his ſeede. And thou gaueſt him Iſaac, and to Iſaac thou gaueſt Iacob and Eſau.
label: 4-esdras

text: And Iacob thou didſt ſeuer to thy ſelfe, but Eſau thou didſt ſeparate. And Iacob grewe to a great multitude.
label: 4-esdras

text: And it came to paſſe when thou didſt bring forth his ſede out of Ægypt, thou broughſt it vpon mount Sinai.
label: 4-esdras

text: And thou didſt bowe the heauens, and faſten the earth, and didſt shake the world, and madeſt the depthes to tremble, and trubledſt the world,
label: 4-esdras

text: and thy glorie paſſed foure gates of fire, and of earthquake, and winde, and froſt, that thou mightſt geue a law to the ſeede of Iacob, and to the generation of Iſrael diligence.
label: 4-esdras

text: And thou didſt not take away from them a malignant hart, that thy law might bring forth fruite in them,
label: 4-esdras

text: For Adam the firſt bearing a vicious hart tranſgreſſed and was ouercome, yea and al that were borne of him.
label: 4-esdras

text: And it was made a permanent infirmitie, and the law with the hart of the people, with the wickednes of the roote, and that which is good departed, and the wicked remayned.
label: 4-esdras

text: And the times paſſed, & the yeares were ended: and thou didſt raiſe vp vnto thee a ſeruant named Dauid,
label: 4-esdras

text: and ſpakeſt vnto him to build a citie of thy name, and to offer vnto thee in it frankencenſe, and oblations.
label: 4-esdras

text: And this was done manie yeares, and they that inhabited the citie forſooke thee,
label: 4-esdras

text: in al things as Adam and al his generations. For they alſo vſed a wicked hart.
label: 4-esdras

text: And thou didſt deliuer thy citie into the hands of thyne enimies.
label: 4-esdras

text: Why, doe they better thinges, that inhabite Babylon? And for this shal she rule ouer Sion?
label: 4-esdras

text: It came to paſſe when I was come hither, and had ſene the impieties that can not be numbred: and my ſoul ſaw manie offending this thirteth yeare, & my hart was aſtonied:
label: 4-esdras

text: becauſe I ſaw how thou beareſt with their ſinne, and didſt ſpare them that did impiouſly, and didſt deſtroy thine owne people, and preſerue thine enimies, and didſt not ſignifie it.
label: 4-esdras

text: I nothing remember how this way should be forſaken: doth Babylon better thinges then Sion?
label: 4-esdras

text: Or hath anie nation knowen thee beſide Iſrael: or what tribes haue beleued thy teſtamentes as Iacob?
label: 4-esdras

text: Whoſe reward hath not appeared, nor their labour fructified. For paſſing through I paſſed among the nations, and I ſaw them abound, and not mindeful of thy commandmentes.
label: 4-esdras

text: Now therfore wey our iniquities in a ballance, and theirs that dwel in the world: & thy name shal not be found, but in Iſrael.
label: 4-esdras

text: Or when haue not they ſinned in thy ſight, that inhabite the earth? or what nation hath ſo obſerued thy commandmentes?
label: 4-esdras

text: Theſe certes by their names thou shal finde to haue kept thy commandmentes, but the nations thou shalt not finde.
label: 4-esdras

text: AND the Angel anſwered me, that was ſent to me, whoſe name was Vriel,
label: 4-esdras

text: and ſayd to me: Thy hart exceding hath exceeded in this world, & thou thinkeſt to comprehend the way of the Higheſt.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I ſayd: It is ſo my Lord. And he anſwered me, & ſayd: I am ſent to shew thee three wayes, & to propoſe to thee three ſimilitudes.
label: 4-esdras

text: Of the which if thou shalt declare to me one of them, I alſo wil shew thee the way which thou deſireſt to ſee, and wil teach thee whence a wicked hart is.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I ſayd, Speake my Lord. And he ſayd to me: Goe, wey me the weight of the fire, or meaſure me the blaſt of the winde, or cal me backe the day that is paſt.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I anſwered, and ſayd: what man borne can doe it, that thou askeſt me of theſe thinges?
label: 4-esdras

text: And he ſayd to me: If I should aske thee, ſaying: How great habitations are there in the hart of the ſea, or how great vaines be there in the beginning of the depth, or how great vaines be there aboue the firmament, and what are the iſſues of paradiſe:
label: 4-esdras

text: thou wouldeſt perhaps ſay to me: I haue not deſcended into the depth, nor into hel as yet, neither haue I aſcended at anie time into heauen.
label: 4-esdras

text: But now I haue not asked thee, ſauing of the fire, and the winde, and the day by the which thou haſt paſſed, and from the which thou canſt not be ſeparated: and thou haſt not anſwered me of them.
label: 4-esdras

text: And he ſayd to me: Thou canſt not know the thinges that are thine which grow together with thee:
label: 4-esdras

text: and how can thy veſſel comprehend the way of the Higheſt, and now the world being outwardly corrupted, vnderſtand the corruption euident in my ſight:
label: 4-esdras

text: I ſayd to him: Better were it for vs not to be, then yet liuing to liue in impieties, and to ſuffer, and not to vnderſtand for what thing.
label: 4-esdras

text: And he anſwered me, & ſaid: Going forth I went forward to a wood of trees in the filde, and they deuiſed a deuiſe,
label: 4-esdras

text: and ſayd: Come and let vs goe, and make warre againſt the ſea, that it may retyre backe before vs, and we may make vs other woodes.
label: 4-esdras

text: And in like maner the waues of the ſea they alſo deuiſed a deuiſe, and ſayd: Come let vs goe vp, let vs ouerthrow the woodes of the filde, that there alſo we may conſummate an other countrie for our ſelues.
label: 4-esdras

text: And the woodes deuiſe was made vaine, for fire came, and conſumed it.
label: 4-esdras

text: Likewiſe alſo the deuiſe of the waues of the ſea. For the ſand ſtood, & ſtayed them.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I ſayd: Lord Dominatour, if I haue found grace before thine eyes, and if I am iuſtified before thee aboue manie, and if in deede my prayer be aſcended before thy face,

text: ſtrengthen me, and shew vnto me thy ſeruant the interpretation, and diſtinction of this horrible viſion, that thou mayſt comfort my ſoule moſt fully.
label: 4-esdras

text: For thou haſt counted me worthie to shew vnto me the later times. And he ſayd to me:
label: 4-esdras

text: This is the interpretation of this viſion.
label: 4-esdras

text: The eagle which thou ſaweſt coming vp from the ſea, this is the kingdom which was ſene in a viſion to Daniel thy brother.
label: 4-esdras

text: But it was not interpreted to him, therfore I do now interprete it to thee.
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold the dayes come, and there shal riſe a kingdom vpon the earth, and the feare shal be more terrible then of al the kingdomes that were before it.
label: 4-esdras

text: And there shal twelue kinges reigne it it, one after an other.
label: 4-esdras

text: For the ſecond shal beginne to reigne, and he shal continew more time then the reſt of the twelue.
label: 4-esdras

text: This is the interpretation of the twelue winges which thou ſaweſt.
label: 4-esdras

text: And the voice that ſpake which thou heardſt not coming forth of her heads, but from the middes of her bodie,
label: 4-esdras

text: this is the interpretation, that after the time of that kingdom shal riſe no ſmal contentions, and it shal be in danger to fal: and it shal not fal then, but shal be conſtituted againe according to the beginning therof.
label: 4-esdras

text: And wheras thou ſaweſt eight vnderwings cleauing to the wings therof,
label: 4-esdras

text: this is the interpretation, eight kinges shal ariſe in it, whoſe times shal be light, and yeares ſwift, and two of them shal perish.
label: 4-esdras

text: But when the middeſt time approcheth, foure shal be kept til a time, when the time therof shal beginne to approch to be ended, yet two shal be kept to the end.
label: 4-esdras

text: And wheras thou ſaweſt three heads reſting,
label: 4-esdras

text: this is the interpretation: in her laſt dayes the Higheſt wil rayſe vp three kingdoms, and wil cal backe manie thinges into them, and they shal rule ouer the earth,
label: 4-esdras

text: and them that dwel in it, with much labour aboue al them that vvere before them. For this cauſe they are called the heads of the eagle.
label: 4-esdras

text: For theſe shal be they that shal recapitulate her impieties, and that shal accomplish her laſt thinges.
label: 4-esdras

text: And wheras thou ſaweſt a greater head not appearing, this is the interpretation therof: that one of them shal dye vpon his bed, and yet with torments.
label: 4-esdras

text: For the two that shal remayne, the ſword shal eate them.
label: 4-esdras

text: For the ſword of one shal deuoure him that is with him: but yet this alſo at the laſt shal fal by the ſword.
label: 4-esdras

text: And wheras thou ſaweſt two vnderwings paſſing ouer the head that is on the right ſide,
label: 4-esdras

text: this is the interpretation: theſe are they whom the Higheſt hath kept to their end, this is a ſmal kingdom, and ful of truble.
label: 4-esdras

text: As thou ſaweſt the lyon alſo, whom thou ſaweſt awaking out of the wood, and roaring, and ſpeaking to the eagle, and rebuking her, and her iniuſtices by al his wordes as thou haſt heard:
label: 4-esdras

text: this is the wynde which the Higheſt hath kept vnto the end for them, and their impieties: and he shal rebuke them, and shal caſt in their ſpoyles before them.
label: 4-esdras

text: For he shal ſette them in iudgment aliue: and it shal be, when he hath reproued them, then shal he chaſtiſe them.
label: 4-esdras

text: For the reſt of my people he shal deliuer with miſerie, them that are ſaued vpon my borders, and he shal make them ioyful til the end shal come, the day of iudgment, wherof I haue ſpoken to thee from the beginning.
label: 4-esdras

text: This is the dreame which thou ſaweſt, and theſe be the interpretations.
label: 4-esdras

text: Thou therfore only haſt bene worthie to know this ſecrete of the Higheſt.
label: 4-esdras

text: Write therfore in a booke al theſe thinges which thou haſt ſene, and put them in a hidden place:
label: 4-esdras

text: and thou shalt teach them the wiſe men of thy people, whoſe harts thou knoweſt able to take, and to kepe theſe ſecretes.
label: 4-esdras

text: But doe thou ſtay here yet other ſeuen dayes, that there may be shewed thee whatſoeuer shal ſeme good to the Higheſt to shew thee.
label: 4-esdras

text: And he departed from me. And it came to paſſe, when al the people had heard that the ſeuen dayes were paſt, and I had not returned into the citie, and al gathered them ſelues together from the leaſt vnto the greateſt: & came to me, & ſpake to me ſaying:
label: 4-esdras

text: What haue we ſinned to thee, or what haue we done vniuſtly againſt thee, that leauing vs thou haſt ſitten in this place?
label: 4-esdras

text: For thou alone art remayning to vs of al peoples, as a cluſter of grapes of the vineyard, and as a candle in a darke place, and as an hauen and shippe ſaued from the tempeſt.
label: 4-esdras

text: Or are not the euiles that chance, ſufficient for vs?
label: 4-esdras

text: If then thou shalt forſake vs, how much better had it ben to vs, if we alſo had bene burnt with the burning of Sion?
label: 4-esdras

text: For we are not better then they that dyed there. And they wept with a lowd voice. And I anſwered them, and ſayd:
label: 4-esdras

text: Be of good chere Iſrael, and be not ſorowful thou houſe of Iacob.
label: 4-esdras

text: For there is remebrance of you before the Higheſt, and the Strong hath not forgotten you in tentation.
label: 4-esdras

text: For I haue not forſaken you, neither did I depart from you: but I came into this place, to pray for the deſolation of Sion, and to ſeeke mercie for the low eſtate of your ſanctification.
label: 4-esdras

text: And now goe euery one of you into his houſe, and I wil come to you after theſe dayes.
label: 4-esdras

text: And the people departed, as I ſayd to them, into the citie:
label: 4-esdras

text: but I ſate in the fielde ſeuen dayes, as he commanded me: and I did eate of the flowers of the field only, of the herbes was my meate made in thoſe dayes.
label: 4-esdras

text: AND it came to paſſe after ſeuen dayes, and I dreamed a dreame in the night.
label: 4-esdras

text: And behold there roſe a winde from the ſea, that trubled al the waues therof.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I ſaw, and behold that man grew ſtrong with thouſandes of heauen: and when he turned his countenance to conſider, al thinges trembled that were ſene vnder him:
label: 4-esdras

text: and whereſoeuer voyce proceded out of his mouth, al that heard his voices begaue to burne, as the earth is quiet when it feeleth the fire.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I ſaw after theſe, and behold a multitude of men was gathered together, of whom there was no number, from the foure windes of heauen, to fight againſt the man that was come vp out of the ſea.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I ſaw, and behold he had grauen to himſelf a great mountaine, & he flew vpon it.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I ſought to ſee the countrie, or the place whence the mountaine was grauen, & I could not.
label: 4-esdras

text: And after theſe thinges I ſaw, and behold al that were gathered to him, to ouerthrowe him, feared exceedingly, yet they were bold to fieght.
label: 4-esdras

text: And behold as he ſawe the violence of the multitude that came, he lifted not vp his hand, nor held ſword, nor anie warlyke inſtrument but only as I ſaw,
label: 4-esdras

text: that he ſentforth out of his mouth as it were a blaſte of fire, and from his lippes a ſpirit of flame, & from his tongue he ſentforth ſparkles & tempeſts, and al thinges were mingled together with this blaſt of fire, & ſpirit of flame, & multitude of tempeſts.
label: 4-esdras

text: And it fel with violence vpon the multitude, that was prepared to fight, and burned them al, that ſuddenly there was nothing ſene of an innumerable multitude, but only duſt, & the ſauour of ſmoke: and I ſaw, and was afrayd.
label: 4-esdras

text: And after theſe thinges I ſaw the man himſelf deſcending from the mountaine, and calling to him an other peaceable multitude,
label: 4-esdras

text: and there came to him the countenance of manie men ſome reioycing, and ſome ſorrowing: and ſome bond, ſome bringing of them that were offered. And I was ſicke for much feare, and awaked, and ſayd.
label: 4-esdras

text: Thou from the beginning haſt shewed thy ſeruant theſe meruelous thinges, and haſt counted me worthie that thou wouldeſt receiue my petition.
label: 4-esdras

text: And now shew me yet the interpretation of this dreame.
label: 4-esdras

text: For as I thinke in my iudgement, woe to them that were leaft in thoſe dayes: & much more woe to them that were not leaft.
label: 4-esdras

text: For they that were not leaft, were ſorrowful.
label: 4-esdras

text: I vnderſtand now what thinges are layde vp in the later dayes, and they shal happen to them, yea and to them that are leaft.
label: 4-esdras

text: For therefore they came into great dangers, and manie neceſſities, as theſe dreames do shew.
label: 4-esdras

text: But yet it is eaſier, aduenturing to come into it, then to paſſe, as a cloud from the world, and now to ſee the thinges that happen in the later time. And he anſwered me, and ſayd:
label: 4-esdras

text: Both the interpretation of the viſion I wil tel thee: and alſo concerning the thinges that thou haſt ſpoken I wil open to thee.
label: 4-esdras

text: Wheras thou ſpeakeſt of them that were leaft, this is the interpretation.
label: 4-esdras

text: He that taketh away danger at that time, he hath garded himſelf. They that haue fallen into danger, theſe are they that haue workes, and fayth in the Strongeſt.
label: 4-esdras

text: Know therefore that they are more bleſſed which are leaft, then they that are dead.
label: 4-esdras

text: Theſe are the interpretations of the viſion, wheras thou ſaweſt a man coming from the hart of the ſea,
label: 4-esdras

text: the ſame is he whom the Higheſt preſerueth much time, which by himſelf shal deliuer his creature: and he shal diſpoſe them that are leaft.
label: 4-esdras

text: And wheras thou ſaweſt proceede out of his mouth, as it were winde, and fire, and tempeſt:
label: 4-esdras

text: and wheras he held no ſworde, nor warlike inſtrument: for his violence deſtroyed the multitude that came to ouerthrow him: this is the interpretation.
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold the dayes come, when the Higheſt shal begin to deliuer them, that are vpon the earth:
label: 4-esdras

text: and he shal come in exceſſe of minde vpon them that inhabit the earth.
label: 4-esdras

text: And one shal thinke to ouerthrow an other: one citie an other citie, one place an other place, and
label: 4-esdras

text: nation againſt nation, and kingdom againſt kingdom. And it shal be, when theſe thinges shal come to paſſe, and the ſignes shal happen, which I shewed thee before: and then shal my ſonne be reueled, whom thou ſaweſt, as a man coming vp.
label: 4-esdras

text: And it shal be when al nations shal heare his voice: and euery one in his countrie shal leaue their warre, that they haue toward each other:
label: 4-esdras

text: and an innumerable multitude shal be gathered in one, as willing to come to ouerthrow him.
label: 4-esdras

text: But he shal ſtand vpon the top of mount Sion.
label: 4-esdras

text: And Sion shal come, and it shal be shewed to al prepared and builded, as thou ſaweſt the mountaine to be grauen without handes.
label: 4-esdras

text: And the ſame my ſonne shal reproue the thinges that the gentils haue inuented, theſe their impieties which came nere to the tempeſt, becauſe of their euil cogitations, and torments wherewith they shal begin to be tormented.
label: 4-esdras

text: Which were likened to the flame, and he shal deſtroy them without labour by the law that was likened to the fyre.
label: 4-esdras

text: And wheras thou ſaweſt him gathering vnto him an other peaceable multitude.
label: 4-esdras

text: Theſe are the ten tribes, which were made captiue out of their land in the dayes of Oſee the King, whom Salmanaſar the King of the Aſſyrians led captiue: and he tranſported them beyond the riuer, and they were tranſported into an other land.
label: 4-esdras

text: But they gaue themſelues this counſel, to forſake the multitude of nations, and to goe forth into a farther countrie, where mankind neuer inhabited.
label: 4-esdras

text: Or there to obſerue their ordinances, which they had not kept in their countrie.
label: 4-esdras

text: And they entred in by the narrow entrances of the riuer Euphrates.
label: 4-esdras

text: For the Higheſt then wrought them ſignes, and ſtayed the vaines of the riuer til they paſſed.
label: 4-esdras

text: For by that countrie was a great way to goe, of one yeare and a half: for the countrie is called Arſareth.
label: 4-esdras

text: Then did they inhabite there til in the later time: and now againe when they beginne to come,
label: 4-esdras

text: againe the Higheſt shal ſtay the vaines of the riuer, that they may paſſe: for theſe thou ſaweſt a multitude with peace.
label: 4-esdras

text: But they alſo that were leaft of the people, theſe are they that be within my border.
label: 4-esdras

text: It shal come to paſſe therefore, when he shal begine to deſtroy the multitude of theſe nations, that are gathered, he shal protect them that haue ouercome the people:
label: 4-esdras

text: and then shal he shew them very manie wonders.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I ſayd: Lord dominatour, shew me this, why I ſaw a man comming vp from the hart of the ſea, and he ſayd to me:
label: 4-esdras

text: As thou canſt not either ſearch theſe thinges, or know what thinges are in the depth of the ſea: ſo can not any man vpon the earth ſee my ſonne, or them that are with him, but in the time of a day.
label: 4-esdras

text: This is the interpretation of the dreame which thou ſaweſt, and for the which thou only art here illuminated.
label: 4-esdras

text: For thou haſt leaft thyne owne law, and haſt bene occupied about my law, and haſt ſought it.
label: 4-esdras

text: For thou haſt diſpoſed thy lyfe in wiſdom, and thyne vnderſtanding thou haſt called mother:
label: 4-esdras

text: and for this I haue shewed thee riches with the Higheſt. For it shal be after other three dayes, I wil ſpeake other thinges to thee, and I wil expound to thee weightie and meruelous thinges.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I went forth, and paſſed into the fielde, much glorifying & praiſing the Higheſt for the meruelous thinges that he did by time.
label: 4-esdras

text: And becauſe he gouerneth it, and the thinges that are brought in times, & I ſate there three dayes.
label: 4-esdras

text: AND it came to paſſe the third day, and I ſate vnder an oke.
label: 4-esdras

text: And behold a voice came forth againſt me out of a bush, and ſayd: Eſdras, Eſdras: and I ſayd: Loe here I am Lord. And I aroſe vpon my feete. And he ſayd to me:
label: 4-esdras

text: Reueling I was reueled vpon the bush, and ſpake to Moyſes, when the people ſerued in Ægypt,
label: 4-esdras

text: and I ſent him, and brought my people out of Ægypt, and brought him vpon mount Sina, & held him with me manie dayes.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I told him manie meruelous thinges, & shewed him the ſecrets of times, and the end: and I commanded him, ſaying:
label: 4-esdras

text: Theſe wordes thou shalt publish abroade, and theſe thou shalt hyde.
label: 4-esdras

text: And now to thee I ſay.
label: 4-esdras

text: The ſignes which I haue shewed, and the dreames which thou haſt ſene, and the interpretations which thou haſt ſene, lay them vp in thy hart.
label: 4-esdras

text: For thou shalt be receiued of al, thou shalt be conuerted the reſidue with thy counſel, and with the like to thee, til the times be finished.
label: 4-esdras

text: Becauſe the world hath loſt his youth, and the times draw nere to waxe old.
label: 4-esdras

text: For the world is diuided by twelue partes, & the tenth part, & half of the tenth part are paſſed:
label: 4-esdras

text: and there remaineth hereafter the half of the tenth part.
label: 4-esdras

text: Now therfore diſpoſe thy houſe, and correct thy people, & comfort the humble of them, & forſake now corruption,
label: 4-esdras
