text: and put from thee mortal cogitations, and caſt from thee humane burdens, and doe from thee now infirme nature, & lay at one ſide cogitations moſt trubleſome to thee, & make ſpeedie tranſmigration from theſe times,
label: 4-esdras

text: for the euiles which thou haſt ſene to haue chanced now, worſe then theſe wil they doe againe:
label: 4-esdras

text: for looke how much the world shal become weake by age, ſo much shal euiles be multiplied vpon the inhabitants.
label: 4-esdras

text: For truth hath remoued it ſelf farther of, and lying hath approched, for now the viſion which thou ſaweſt, haſteneth to come.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I anſwered, and ſayd before thee ô Lord:
label: 4-esdras

text: For behold I wil goe, as thou haſt commanded me, & wil rebuke the people that now is. But them that shal yet be borne, who shal admonish?
label: 4-esdras

text: The world therfore is ſet in darknes, and they that dwel in it without light.
label: 4-esdras

text: Becauſe thy law is burnt, therefore no man knoweth the workes that haue bene done by thee, or that shal begin.
label: 4-esdras

text: For if I haue found grace with thee, ſend the Holie Ghoſt to me, & I wil write al that hath bene done in the world from the beginning, the thinges that were written in thy law, that men may finde the pathe: and they that wil liue in the later times, may liue.
label: 4-esdras

text: And he anſwered me, and ſayd: Goe gather together the people, and thou shalt ſay to them, that they ſeeke thee not for fourtie dayes.
label: 4-esdras

text: And doe thou prepare thee manie tables of boxe, & take with thee Sarea, Dabria, Salemia, Echanus, and Aſiel, theſe fiue which are readie to write ſweeftly.
label: 4-esdras

text: And come hither, & I wil light in thy hart a candle of vnderſtanding, which shal not be put out til the things be finished, which thou shalt begine to write.
label: 4-esdras

text: And then ſome thinges thou shalt open to the perfect, ſome thou shalt deliuer ſecretly to the wyſe. For to morrow this houre thou shalt begine to write.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I went as he commanded me, & gathered together al the people, and ſayd:
label: 4-esdras

text: Heare Iſrael theſe wordes:
label: 4-esdras

text: Our fathers were pilgrimes from the beginning in Ægypt, and were deliuered from thence.
label: 4-esdras

text: And they receiued the law of life, which they kept not, which you alſo after them haue tranſgreſſed:
label: 4-esdras

text: and the land was geuen you by lotte, and the land of Sion, and your fathers, and you haue done iniquitie, and haue not kept the wayes which the Higheſt commanded you.
label: 4-esdras

text: And wheras he is a iuſt iudge, he hath taken from you in time that which he had geuen.
label: 4-esdras

text: And now you are here, and your brethren are among you.
label: 4-esdras

text: If then you wil rule ouer your ſenſe, & inſtruct your hart, you shal be preſerued aliue, and after death shal obtaine mercie.
label: 4-esdras

text: For the iudgement shal come after death, when we shal returne to lyfe againe: and then the names of the iuſt shal appeare, and the dedes of the impious shal be shewed.
label: 4-esdras

text: Let no man therfore come to me now, nor aske for me vntil fourtie dayes.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I tooke the fiue men, as he commanded me, and we went forth into the field, and taried there.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I was come to the morrow, & behold a voice called me, ſaying: Eſdras open thy mouth, and drinke that which I wil geue thee to drinke.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I opened my mouth, & behold a ful cuppe was brought me, this was ful as it were with water: but the colour therof like as fire.
label: 4-esdras

text: And I tooke it, and dranke; and when I had drunken of it, my hart was tormented with vnderſtanding, and wiſdome grewe into my breſt. For my ſpirit was kept by memorie.
label: 4-esdras

text: And my mouth was opened, and was shut no more.
label: 4-esdras

text: The Higheſt gaue vnderſtanding vnto the fiue men, and they wrote exceſſes of the night which were ſpoken, which they knewe not.
label: 4-esdras

text: And at night they did eate breade, but I ſpake by day, & by night held not my peace.
label: 4-esdras

text: And there were written in the fourtie dayes two hundred foure bookes.
label: 4-esdras

text: And it came to paſſe when they had ended the fourtie daies, the Higheſt ſpake, ſaying:
label: 4-esdras

text: The former thinges which thou haſt written, ſet abrode, and let the worthie and vnworthie reade: but the laſt ſeuentie bookes thou shalt keepe, that thou mayeſt deliuer them to the wyſe of thy people.
label: 4-esdras

text: For in theſe is the vaine of vnderſtanding, and the fountaine of wiſdome, and the ſtreame of knowledge. and I did ſoe.
label: 4-esdras

text: BEHOLD ſpeake into the eares of my people the wordes of prophecie, which I shal put into thy mouth, ſayth our Lord:
label: 4-esdras

text: and ſee that they be written in paper, becauſe they be faithful and true.
label: 4-esdras

text: Be not afrayd of the cogitations againſt thee, neither let the incredulities truble thee of them that ſpeake.
label: 4-esdras

text: Becauſe euerie incredulous perſon shal dye in his incredulitie.
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold I bring in, ſayth our Lord, vpon the whole earth euils, ſword, and famine, and death, and deſtruction.
label: 4-esdras

text: Becauſe iniquitie hath fully polluted ouer al the earth, and their hurtful workes are accomplished.
label: 4-esdras

text: Therefore ſayth our Lord:
label: 4-esdras

text: I wil not now kepe ſilence of their impieties which they doe irreligiouſly, neither wil I beare with thoſe thinges, which they practiſe vniuſtly. Behold the innocent & iuſt bloud crieth to me, & the ſoules of the iuſt crie continually.
label: 4-esdras

text: Reuenging I wil reuenge them, ſayth our Lord, and I wil take al innocent bloud out of them vnto me.
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold my people is led to ſlaughter as a flocke, I wil no more ſuffer it to dwel in the land of Ægypt.
label: 4-esdras

text: But I wil bring them forth in a mightie hand and valiant arme, and wil ſtrike with plague as before, and wil corrupt al the land thereof.
label: 4-esdras

text: Ægypt shal mourne, and the fundations thereof beaten with plague, and with the chaſtiſement which God wil bring vpon it.
label: 4-esdras

text: The husbandmen that til the ground shal mourne, becauſe their ſeedes shal perish by blaſting, and haile, and by a terible ſtarre.
label: 4-esdras

text: Woe to the world and them that dwel therein.
label: 4-esdras

text: Becauſe the ſword is at hand and the deſtruction of them, and nation shal riſe vp againſt nation to fight, & ſword in their handes.
label: 4-esdras

text: For there shal be inſtabilitie to men, & growing one againſt an other they shal not care for their king, & the princes of the way of their doinges, in their might.
label: 4-esdras

text: For a man shal deſire to go into the citie & can not.
label: 4-esdras

text: Becauſe of their prides the cities shal be trubled, the houſes raiſed, the men shal feare.
label: 4-esdras

text: Man shal not pitie his neighbour, to make their houſes nothingworth in the ſword, to ſpoyle their goodes for famine of bread, & much tribulation.
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold, I cal together ſayth God, al the kinges of the earth to feare me, that are from the Orient, & from the South, from the Eaſt, & from Libanus, to be turned vpon themſelues, and to render the thinges that they haue geuen them.
label: 4-esdras

text: As they doe vntil this day to myne elect, ſo wil I doe, and render in their boſome. Thus ſayth our Lord God:
label: 4-esdras

text: My righthand shal not ſpare ſinners, neither shal the ſword ceaſe vpon them that shede innocent bloud vpon the earth.
label: 4-esdras

text: Fire came forth from his wrath, and hath deuoured the fundations of the earth, and ſinners as it were ſtraw ſet on fire.
label: 4-esdras

text: Woe to them that ſinne, and obſerue not my comandmentes, ſayth our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: I wil not ſpare them: depart ô children from the powre. Defile not my ſanctification:
label: 4-esdras

text: becauſe the Lord knoweth al that ſinne againſt him; therefore hath he deliuered them into death and into ſlaughter.
label: 4-esdras

text: For now are euils come vpon the world, and you shal tarrie in them. For God wil not deliuer you, becauſe you haue ſinned againſt him.
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold an horrible viſion, and the face of it from the eaſt.
label: 4-esdras

text: And the nations of dragons of Arabians shal comeforth in manie chariots, & as a winde the number of them is caried vpon the earth, ſo that now al doe feare and tremble, that shal heare them.
label: 4-esdras

text: the Carmonians madde for anger, and they shal goe forth as wild boares out of the wood, & they shal come with great power, and shal ſtand in fight with them, & they shal waſte the portion of the land of the Aſſirians.
label: 4-esdras

text: And after theſe thinges the dragons shal preuaile mindful of their natiuitie, and conſpiring shal turne themſelues in great force to purſue them.
label: 4-esdras

text: Theſe shal be trubled and hold their peace at their force, and shal turne their fete into flight.
label: 4-esdras

text: And from the territorie of the Aſſirians the beſiegers shal beſeige them, and shal conſume one of them, and there shal be feare and trembling in their armie, and contention againſt their kinges.
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold cloudes from the eaſt, and from the north vnto the ſouth, and their face very horrible, ful of wrath and ſtorme.
label: 4-esdras

text: And they shal beate one againſt an other, and they shal beate downe manie ſtarres, and their ſtarre vpon the earth, and bloud shal be from the ſword vnto the bellie.
label: 4-esdras

text: And mans dung vnto the camels litter, and there shal be much feare, and trembling vpon the earth.
label: 4-esdras

text: And they shal shake that shal ſee that wrath, and tremble shal take them: and after theſe thinges there shal manie showers be moued:
label: 4-esdras

text: from the ſouth, and the north: and an other portion from the weaſt.
label: 4-esdras

text: And the windes from the eaſt shal preuaile vpon it, and shal shut it vp, and the cloudes which he raiſed in wrath, and the ſtarre to make terrour to the eaſt winde, and the weſt shal be deſtroyed.
label: 4-esdras

text: And there shal be exalted great and mightie cloudes ful of wrath, and a ſtarre to terrifie al the earth, and the inhabitantes therof, and they shal powre in vpon euerie high, and eminent place a terrible ſtarre,
label: 4-esdras

text: fire, and haile, and flying ſwordes, and manie waters, ſo that al fildes alſo shal be filled, and al riuers with the fulnes of manie waters.
label: 4-esdras

text: And they shal throw downe cities, and walles, and mountaines, and hilles, and the trees of the woodes, and the graſſe of the medowes, and their corne.
label: 4-esdras

text: And they shal paſſe conſtant vnto Babylon, and shal raiſe her.
label: 4-esdras

text: They shal come together againſt her, and shal compaſſe her, and shal power out the ſtarre, and al wrath vpon her, and the duſt and ſmoke shal goe vp euen into heauen, and round about shal lament her.
label: 4-esdras

text: And they that shal remaine vnder her, shal ſerue them that terified her.
label: 4-esdras

text: And thou Aſia agreeing into the hope of Babylon, and the glorie of her perſon,
label: 4-esdras

text: woe be to thee thou wretch, becauſe thou art like to her, and haſt adorned thy daughters in fornication, to pleaſe & glorie in thy louers, which haue deſired alwayes to fornicate with thee.
label: 4-esdras

text: Thou haſt imitated the odious in al her workes, and in her inuentions: therefore ſayth God:
label: 4-esdras

text: I wil ſend in euils vpon thee, widowhood, pouertie, and famine, and ſword, and peſtilence, to deſtroy thy houſes by violation, and death, and glorie of thy vertue.
label: 4-esdras

text: As a flower shal be withered, when the heate shal riſe that is ſent forth vpon thee,
label: 4-esdras

text: thou shalt be weakned as a litle poore ſoule plaged and chaſtiſed of wemen, that the mightie and the louers may not receiue thee.
label: 4-esdras

text: Wil I be zealous againſt thee ſayth our Lord,
label: 4-esdras

text: vnles thou hadſt ſlayne myne elect at al times, exalting the ſlaughter of the handes, and ſaying vpon their death, when thou waſt drunken.
label: 4-esdras

text: Adorne the beautie of thy countenance.
label: 4-esdras

text: The reward of thy fornication is in thy boſome, therefore thou shalt receiue recompence.
label: 4-esdras

text: As thou shalt doe to my elect, ſayth our Lord, ſo shal God do to thee, and shal deliuer thee vnto euil.
label: 4-esdras

text: And thy children shal dye for famine: and thou shalt fal by the ſword, and thy cities shal be deſtroyed, & al thyne shal fal in the filde by the ſword.
label: 4-esdras

text: And they that are in the mountaines, shal perish, with famine, and shal eate their owne flesh, & drinke kloud, for the famine of bread and thirſt of waters.
label: 4-esdras

text: Vnhappie by the ſeas shalt thou come, and againe thou shalt receiue euils.
label: 4-esdras

text: And in the paſſage they shal beate againſt the idle citie, and shal deſtroy ſome portion of thy land, and shal deface part of thy glorie, againe returning to Babylon ouerthrowen.
label: 4-esdras

text: And being throwen downe thou shalt be to them for ſtubble, and they shal be to thee fire:
label: 4-esdras

text: and deuoure thee, and thy cities, thy land, and thy mountaynes, al thy woodes and fruitful trees they wil burne with fire.
label: 4-esdras

text: Thy children they shal lead captiue, & shal haue thy goodes for a praye, and the glorie of thy face they shal deſtroy.
label: 4-esdras

text: WOE to thee Babylon & Aſia, woe to thee Ægypt, and Syria.
label: 4-esdras

text: Gird yourſelues with ſackclothes and shirtes of heare, & mourne for your children, & be ſorie: becauſe your deſtruction is at hand.
label: 4-esdras

text: The ſword is ſent in vpon you, and who is he that can turne it away?
label: 4-esdras

text: Fire is ſent in vpon you, and who is he that can quench it?
label: 4-esdras

text: Euiles are ſent in vpon you, and who is he that can repel them?
label: 4-esdras

text: Shal anie man repel the lion being hungrie in the woode, or quench the fire in ſtubble, forthwith when it beginneth to burne?
label: 4-esdras

text: Shal anie man repel the arrow shot of a ſtrong archer?
label: 4-esdras

text: Our ſtrong Lord ſendeth in euiles, and who is he that can repel them?
label: 4-esdras

text: Fire came forth from his wrath, and who is he that can quench it?
label: 4-esdras

text: He wil lighten, who shal not feare, he wil thunder, and who shal not be afrayde?
label: 4-esdras

text: Our Lord wil threaten, and who shal not vtterly be deſtroyed before his face?
label: 4-esdras

text: The earth hath trembled, and the fundations thereof, the ſea toſſeth vp waues from the depth, and the floudes of it shal be deſtroyed, and the fishes thereof at the face of our Lord, and at the glorie of his powre:
label: 4-esdras

text: becauſe his right hand is ſtrong which bendeth the bow, his arrowes be sharpe that are shot of him, they shal not miſſe, when they shal begine to be shot into the endes of the earth.
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold euiles are ſent, and they shal not returne til they come vpon the earth.
label: 4-esdras

text: The fire is kindled and it shal not be quenched, til it conſume the fundations of the earth.
label: 4-esdras

text: For as the arrow shot of a ſtrong archer returneth not, ſo shal not the euils returne backe, that shal be ſent vpon the earth.
label: 4-esdras

text: Woe is me, woe is me: who shal deliuer me in thoſe dayes?
label: 4-esdras

text: The beginning of ſorrowes and much mourning, the beginning of famine and much deſtruction. The beginning of warres and the poteſtates shal feare, the beginning of euiles and al shal tremble.
label: 4-esdras

text: In theſe what shal I doe, when the euiles shal come?
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold famine, and plague, and tribulation, and diſtreſſe are ſent al as ſcourges for amendment,
label: 4-esdras

text: and in al theſe they wil not conuert themſelues from their iniquities, neither wil they be alwayes mindful of the ſcourges.
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold, there shal be good cheape victuals vpon the earth, ſo that they may thinke that peace is directly coming toward them, and then shal euiles ſpring vpon the earth, ſword, famine, and great confuſion.
label: 4-esdras

text: For by famine manie that inhabit the earth shal dye, and the ſword shal deſtroy the reſt that remained aliue of the famine,
label: 4-esdras

text: and the dead shal be caſt forth as dung, and there shal be none to comfort them. For the earth shal be left deſert, and the cities therof shal be throwen downe.
label: 4-esdras

text: There shal not be left a man to til the ground and to ſow it.
label: 4-esdras

text: The trees shal yeeld fruites, and who shal gather them?
label: 4-esdras

text: The grape shal become ripe, & who shal tread it? For there shal be great deſolation to places.
label: 4-esdras

text: For a man shal deſire to ſee a man, or to heare his voyce.
label: 4-esdras

text: For there shal be leaft ten of a citie, and two of the filde that haue hid themſelues in thicke woodes, and cliffes of rockes.
label: 4-esdras

text: As there are left in the oliuet, and on euerie tree, three or foure oliues.
label: 4-esdras

text: Or as in a vinyeard when it is gathered there are grapes left by them, that diligently ſearch the vineyard:
label: 4-esdras

text: ſo shal there be left in thoſe dayes three or foure, by them that ſearch their houſes in the ſword.
label: 4-esdras

text: And the earth shal be left deſolate, and the fildes thereof shal waxe old, & the wayes thereof, and al the pathes thereof shal bringforth thornes, becauſe no man shal paſſe by it.
label: 4-esdras

text: Virgins shal mourne hauing no bridegromes, wemen shal mourne hauing no huſbandes, their daughters shal mourne hauing no helpe:
label: 4-esdras

text: their bridegromes shal be conſumed in battel, and their husbandes be deſtroyed in famine.
label: 4-esdras

text: But heare theſe thinges, and know them ye ſeruantes of our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold the word of our Lord, receiue it: beleue not the goddes of whom our Lord ſpeaketh.
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold the euiles approch, and ſlacke not.
label: 4-esdras

text: As a woman with childe when shee bringeth forth her child in the ninth moneth, the houre of her deliuerance approching, two or three howres before, paines come about her wombe, and the infants coming out of her wombe, they wil not tarrie one moment.
label: 4-esdras

text: So the euiles shal not ſlacke to come forth vpon the earth, and the world shal lament, and ſorowes shal hold it round about.
label: 4-esdras

text: Heare the word, my people: prepare yourſelues vnto the fight, & in the euiles ſo be ye as ſtrangers of the earth.
label: 4-esdras

text: He that ſelleth as if he should flee, and he that byeth as he that should loſe it.
label: 4-esdras

text: He that playeth the marchant, as he that should take no fruite: and he that buildeth as he that should not inhabite.
label: 4-esdras

text: He that ſoweth, as he that shal not reape: ſo he alſo that pruneth a vinyeard, as if he should not haue the vintage.
label: 4-esdras

text: They that marie ſo as if they should not get children, & they that marie not, ſo as it were widowes.
label: 4-esdras

text: Wherfore they that labour, labour without cauſe:
label: 4-esdras

text: for foreners shal reape their fruites, & shal violently take their goodes, and ouerthrow their houſes, and lead theire children captiue, becauſe in captiuitie, and famine they beget their children.
label: 4-esdras

text: And they that play the marchantes by robrie, the longer they adorne their cities and houſes, and their poſſeſſions and perſons:
label: 4-esdras

text: ſo much the more wil I be zealous toward them, vpon their ſinnes, ſayth our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: As a whore ennieth an honeſt & very good woman:
label: 4-esdras

text: ſo shal iuſtice hate impietie when she adorneth herſelfe, and accuſeth her to her face, when he shal come that may defend him that ſearcheth out al vpon the earth.
label: 4-esdras

text: Therefore be not made like to her, nor to her workes.
label: 4-esdras

text: For yet a little whyle & iniquitie shal be taken away from the earth, & iuſtice shal reigne ouer you.
label: 4-esdras

text: Let not the ſinner ſay he hath not ſinned: becauſe he shal burne coales of fire vpon his head, that ſayth I haue not ſinned before our Lord God and his glorie.
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold our Lord shal know al the workes of men, and their inuentions, & their cogitations, and their hartes.
label: 4-esdras

text: For he ſayd: Let the earth be made, and it was made: let the heauen be made, & it was made.
label: 4-esdras

text: And by his worde the ſtarrs were made, & he knoweth the number of the ſtarres.
label: 4-esdras

text: Who ſearcheth the depth and the treaſures therof: who hath meaſured the ſea, & capacitie therof.
label: 4-esdras

text: Who hath shut vp the ſea in the mideſt of waters, & hath hanged the earth vpon the waters with his word.
label: 4-esdras

text: Who hath ſpred heauen as it were a vault, ouer the waters he hath founded it.
label: 4-esdras

text: Who hath put fountaines of waters in the deſert, and lakes vpon the toppes of mountaines, to ſendforth riuers from the high rocke to watter the earth.
label: 4-esdras

text: Who made man & put his hart in the midds of the bodie, and gaue him ſpirit, life and vnderſtanding.
label: 4-esdras

text: And the inſpiration of God omnipotent that made al thinges, and ſearcheth al hid thinges, in the ſecretes of the earth.
label: 4-esdras

text: He knoweth your inuention, and what you thinke in your hartes ſinning, and willing to hide your ſinnes.
label: 4-esdras

text: Wherfore our Lord in ſearching hath ſearched al your workes, and he wil put you al to open shame,
label: 4-esdras

text: and you shal be confounded when your ſinnes shal come forth before men, and the iniquities shal be they, that shal ſtand accuſers in that day.
label: 4-esdras

text: What wil you doe? or how shal you hide your ſinnes before God and his Angels?
label: 4-esdras

text: Behold God is the Iudge, feare him. Ceaſe from your ſinnes, and now forget your iniquities to doe them anie more, & God wil bring you out, and deliuer you from al tribulation.
label: 4-esdras

text: For behold the heate of a great multitude is kindled ouer you, and they shal take certaine of you by violence, & shal make the ſlaine to be meate for idols.
label: 4-esdras

text: And they that shal conſent vnto them, shal be to them in deriſion, and in reproch, and in conculcation.
label: 4-esdras

text: For there shal be place againſt places, and againſt the next cities great inſurrection vpon them that feare our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: They shal be as it were madde ſparing no bodie, to ſpoyle and waſte yet them that feare our Lord.
label: 4-esdras

text: becauſe they shal waſte and ſpoyle the goodes, and shal caſt them out of their houſes.
label: 4-esdras

text: Then shal appeare the probation of mine elect, as gold that is proued by the fire.
label: 4-esdras

text: Heare my beloued, ſayth our Lord: Behold the dayes of tribulation are come: and out of them I wil deliuer you.
label: 4-esdras

text: Doe not feare, nor ſtagger, becauſe God is your guide.
label: 4-esdras

text: And he that kepeth my commandmentes, and precepts, ſayth our Lord God: Let not your ſinnes ouerway you, nor your inquities be aduanced ouer you.
label: 4-esdras

text: Woe to them that are entangled with their ſinnes, and are couered with their iniquities, as a filde is entangled with the wood, & the path therof couered with thornes, by which no man paſſeth, & it is cloſed out, & caſt to be deuoured of the fire.
label: 4-esdras

text: THE booke of the generation of IESVS Chriſt, the ſonne of Dauid, the ſonne of Abraham.
label: Matthew

text: Abraham begat Iſaac, And Iſaac begat Iacob. And Iacob begat Iudas and his brethren:
label: Matthew

text: And Iudas begat Phares and Zaram of Thamar. And Phares begat Eſron. And Eſron begat Aram.
label: Matthew

text: And Aram begat Aminadab. And Aminadab begat Naaſſon. And Naaſſon begat Salmon.
label: Matthew

text: And Salmon begat Booz of Raab. And Booz begat Obed of Ruth. And Obed begat Ieſſe.
label: Matthew

text: And Ieſſe begat Dauid the King. And Dauid the King begat Salomon of her that was the vvife of Vrias.
label: Matthew

text: And Salomon begat Roboam. And Roboam begat Abia. And Abia begat Aſa.
label: Matthew

text: And Aſa begat Ioſaphat. And Ioſaphat begat Ioram. And Ioram begat Ozias.
label: Matthew

text: And Ozias begat Ioatham. And Ioatham begat Achaz. And Achaz begat Ezechias.
label: Matthew

text: And Ezechias begat Manaſſes. And Manaſſes begat Amon. And Amon begat Ioſias.
label: Matthew

text: And Ioſias begat Iechonias & his brethren in the Tranſmigration of Babylon.
label: Matthew

text: And after the Tranſmigration of Babylon, Iechonias begat Salathiel. And Salathiel begat Zorobabel.
label: Matthew

text: And Zorobabel begat Abiud. And Abiud begat Eliacim. And Eliacim begat Azor.
label: Matthew

text: And Azor begat Sadoc. And Sadoc begat Achim. And Achim begat Eliud.
label: Matthew

text: And Eliud begat Eleazar. And Eleazar begat Mathan. And Mathan begat Iacob.
label: Matthew

text: And Iacob begat Ioſeph the huſband of MARIE: of vvhom vvas borne IESVS, vvho is called CHRIST. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Therefore al the generations from Abraham vnto Dauid, fourtene generations. And from Dauid to the Tranſmigration of Babylon, fourtene generations. And from the Tranſmigration of Babylon vnto CHRIST, fourtene generations.
label: Matthew

text: And the generation of CHRIST vvas in this vviſe. When his mother MARIE vvas ſpouſed to Ioſeph, before they came together, ſhe vvas found to be vvith childe by the Holy Ghoſt.
label: Matthew

text: VVherevpon Ioſeph, for that he vvas a iuſt man, & vvould not put her to open ſhame: vvas minded ſecretely to dimiſſe her.
label: Matthew

text: But as he vvas thus thinking, behold the Angel of our Lord appeared to him in ſleepe ſaying: Ioſeph ſonne of Dauid, feare not to take MARIE thy vvife. for that vvhich is borne in her, is of the Holy Ghoſt.
label: Matthew

text: And ſhe ſhal bring forth a ſonne: and thou ſhalt call his name IESVS. For he ſhal ſaue his people from their ſinnes. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And al this vvas done that it might be fulfilled vvhich our Lord ſpake by the Prophet ſaying.
label: Matthew

text: Behold a Virgin ſhal be vvith childe, and bring forth a ſonne, and they ſhal call his name Emmanuel, vvhich being interpreted is, God with vs.
label: Matthew

text: And Ioſeph riſing vp from ſleepe, did as the Angel of our Lord commaunded him, and tooke his vvife.
label: Matthew

text: And he knevv her not til ſhe brought forth her firſt borne ſonne: and called his name IESVS.
label: Matthew

text: WHEN IESVS therfore vvas borne in Bethlehem of Iuda in the dayes of Herod the King, behold, there came Sages from the Eaſt to Hieruſalem,
label: Matthew

text: ſaying, vvhere is he that is borne King of the Ievves? For vve haue ſeene his ſtarre in the Eaſt, and are come to adore him.
label: Matthew

text: And Herod the King hearing this, vvas troubled, & al Hieruſalem vvith him.
label: Matthew

text: And aſſembling together al the high Prieſtes & the Scribes of the people, he inquired of them vvhere Chriſt ſhould be borne.
label: Matthew

text: But they ſayd to him, In Bethlehem of Iuda. For ſo it is vvritten by the Prophet:
label: Matthew

text: And thou Bethlehem the land of Iuda, art not the leaſt among the Princes of Iuda: for out of thee ſhal come forth the Capitaine that ſhal rule my people Iſrael.
label: Matthew

text: Then Herod ſecretly calling the Sages, learned diligently of them the time of the ſtarre which appeared to them:
label: Matthew

text: and ſending them into Bethlehem, ſayd, Goe, and inquire diligently of the childe: and when you ſhal finde him, make reporte to me, that I alſo may come and adore him.
label: Matthew

text: Who hauing heard the king, went their way: and behold the ſtarre which they had ſeen in the Eaſt, went before them, vntil it came & ſtoode ouer, where the childe was.
label: Matthew

text: And ſeing the ſtarre, they reioyced vvith exceding great ioy.
label: Matthew

text: And entring into the houſe, they found the childe vvith MARIE his mother, & falling dovvne adored him: and opening their treaſures, they offered to him giftes: gold, frankincenſe, & myrrhe.
label: Matthew

text: And hauing receiued an anſvver in ſleepe that they ſhould not returne to Herod, they vvent backe an other vvay into their countrey. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And after they vvere departed, behold an Angel of our Lord appeared in ſleepe to Ioſeph, ſaying: Ariſe, & take the childe & his mother, & flee into Aegypt: and be there vntil I ſhal tel the. For it wil come to paſſe that Herod vvil ſeeke the childe to deſtroy him.
label: Matthew

text: Who aroſe, & tooke the childe and his mother by night, and retyred into Aegypt: and he vvas there vntil the death of Herod:
label: Matthew

text: that it might be fulfilled vvhich was ſpoken of our Lord by the Prophet, ſaying, Out of Aegypt haue I called my ſonne.
label: Matthew

text: Then Herod perceauing that he vvas deluded by the Sages, Was exceding angrie: and ſending murdered al the men children that vvere in Bethlehem, & in al the borders therof, from tvvo yere old & vnder, according to the time vvhich he had diligently ſought out of the Sages.
label: Matthew

text: Then was fulfilled that vvhich vvas ſpoken by Ieremie the Prophet ſaying,
label: Matthew

text: A voice in Rama vvas heard, crying out & much vvayling: Rachel bevvayling her children, & vvould not be comforted, becauſe they are not. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: But vvhen Herod vvas dead, behold an Angel of our Lord appeared in ſleepe to Ioſeph in Aegypt,
label: Matthew

text: ſaying, Ariſe, and take the childe & his mother, & goe into the land of Iſrael. for they are dead that ſought the life of the childe.
label: Matthew

text: Who aroſe, & tooke the childe & his mother, and came into the land of Iſrael.
label: Matthew

text: But hearing that Archelaus reigned in Ievvrie for Herod his father, he feared to goe thither: and being vvarned in ſleepe retyred into the quarters of Galilee.
label: Matthew

text: And coming he dwelt in a citie called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled vvhich vvas ſayd by the Prophetes: That he ſhal be called a Nazarite.
label: Matthew

text: AND in thoſe dayes cometh Iohn the Baptiſt preaching in the deſert of Iewrie,
label: Matthew

text: & ſaying, Doe penance: for the Kingdom of heauen is at hand.
label: Matthew

text: For this is he that vvas ſpoken of by Eſay the Prophet, ſaying, A voyce of one crying in the deſert, prepare ye the way of our Lord, make ſtraight his pathes.
label: Matthew

text: And the ſayd Iohn had his garment of camels heare, & a girdle of a ſkinne about his loynes: and his meate was locuſtes & vvilde honie.
label: Matthew

text: Then vvent forth to him Hieruſalem & al Ievvrie, and al the countrey about Iordan:
label: Matthew

text: & vvere baptized of him in Iordan, confeſſing their ſinnes.
label: Matthew

text: And ſeeing many of the Phariſees & Sadducées coming to his baptiſme, he ſayd to them. Ye vipers brood, vvho hath ſhevved you to flee from the vvrath to come?
label: Matthew

text: Yeld therfore fruite vvorthie of penance.
label: Matthew

text: And delite not to ſay vvithin your ſelues, vve haue Abraham to our father. for I tel you that God is able of theſe ſtones to raiſe vp children to Abraham.
label: Matthew

text: For novv the axe is put to the roote of the trees. Euery tree therefore that doth not yeld good fruite, ſhal be cut dovvne, & caſt into the fyre.
label: Matthew

text: I in deede baptize you in vvater vnto penance. but he that ſhal come after me, is ſtronger then I, vvhoſe ſhoes I am not vvorthie to beare, he ſhal baptize you in the Holy Ghoſt & fire.
label: Matthew

text: Whoſe fanne is in his hand, and he ſhal cleane purge his floore: and he vvil gather his vvheate into the barne, but the chaffe he vvil burne vvith vnquencheable fire.
label: Matthew

text: Then cometh IESVS from Galilee to Iordan, vnto Iohn, to be baptized of him.
label: Matthew

text: But Iohn ſtayed him, ſaying, I ought to be baptized of thee, and comeſt thou to me?
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS anſwering, ſayd to him, Suffer me for this time. for ſo it becommeth vs to fulfil al iuſtice. Then he ſuffered him.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS being baptized, forthvvith came out of the vvater: and loe the heauens vvere opened to him: and he ſavv the Spirit of God deſcending as a doue, & coming vpon him.
label: Matthew

text: And behold a voyce from heauen ſaying, This is my beloued ſonne, in vvhom I am wel pleaſed.
label: Matthew

text: THEN IESVS was ledde of the Spirit into the deſert, to be tempted of the Deuil.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen he had faſted fourtie daies and fourtie nightes, aftervvard he vvas hungrie.
label: Matthew

text: And the tempter approched & ſayd to him, If thou be the ſonne of God, commaund that theſe ſtones be made bread.
label: Matthew

text: VVho anſvvered & ſaid, It is vvritten, Not in bread alone doth man liue, but in euery word that procedeth from the mouth of God.
label: Matthew

text: Then the Deuil tooke him vp into the holy citie, and ſet him vpon the pinnacle of the Temple,
label: Matthew

text: and ſayd to him, If thou be the ſonne of God, caſt thy ſelf dovvne, for it is vvritten. That he wil giue his Angels charge of thee, & in their hands ſhal they hold thee vp, leſt perhaps thou knocke they foote agaynſt a ſtone.
label: Matthew

text: IESVS ſayd to him againe, It is vvritten, Thou ſhalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
label: Matthew

text: Againe the Deuil tooke him vp into a very high mountaine: and he ſhevved him al the Kingdoms of the vvorld, and the glorie of them,
label: Matthew

text: and ſayd to him, Al theſe vvil I giue thee, if falling dovvne thou vvilt adore me.
label: Matthew

text: Then IESVS ſayth to him, Auant Satan: for it is written, The Lord thy God ſhalt thou adore, & him onely ſhalt thou ſerue.
label: Matthew

text: Then the Deuil left him: and behold Angels came, and miniſtred to him. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen IESVS had heard that Iohn vvas deliuered vp, he retyred into Galilee:
label: Matthew

text: and leauing the citie Nazareth, came & dvvelt in Capharnaum a ſea tovvne, in the borders of Zabulon & Nephthali,
label: Matthew

text: that it might be fulfilled vvhich vvas ſayd by Eſay the Prophet.
label: Matthew

text: Land of Zabulon & land of Nephthali, the way of the ſea beyond Iordan of Galilee, of the Gentils:
label: Matthew

text: the people that ſate in darkneſſe, hath ſeen great light: and to them that ſate in a countrey of the ſhadow of death, light is riſen to them.
label: Matthew

text: From that time IESVS began to preach, and to ſay, Doe penance, for the Kingdom of heauen is at hand.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS vvalking by the ſea of Galilee, ſavv tvvo brethren, Simon vvho is called Peter, & Andrew his brother, caſting a nette into the ſea (for they vvere fiſhers)
label: Matthew

text: & he ſayth to them, Come ye after me, and I vvil make you to be fiſhers of men.
label: Matthew

text: But they incontinent leauing the nettes, folovved him.
label: Matthew

text: And going forvvard from thence, he ſavv other tvvo brethren, Iames of Zebedee & Iohn his brother in a ſhippe vvith Zebedee their father, repayring their nettes: and he called them.
label: Matthew

text: And they furthvvith left their nettes & father and folovved him. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS vvent round about all Galilee, teaching in their Synagogs, & preaching the Goſpel of the Kingdom: and healing euery maladie and euery infirmitie in the people.
label: Matthew

text: And the bruite of him vvent into al Syria, and they preſented to him al that vvere il at eaſe, diuerſly taken vvith diſeaſes and torments, and ſuch as vvere poſſeſt, and lunatikes, and ſicke of the palſey, and he cured them:
label: Matthew

text: And much people folovved him from Galilee and Decapolis, and Hieruſalem, and from beyond Iordan.
label: Matthew

text: AND ſeeing the multitudes, he vvent vp into a mountaine: and vvhen he vvas ſet, his Diſciples came vnto him,
label: Matthew

text: and opening his mouth he taught them, ſaying.
label: Matthew

text: Bleſſed are the poore in Spirit: for theirs is the Kingdom of heauen.
label: Matthew

text: Bleſſed are the meeke: for they ſhal poſſeſſe the land.
label: Matthew

text: Bleſſed are they that mourne: for they ſhal be comforted.
label: Matthew

text: Bleſſed are they that hunger & thirſt after iuſtice: for they ſhal haue their fil.
label: Matthew

text: Bleſſed are the merciful: for they ſhal obtayne mercie.
label: Matthew

text: Bleſſed are the cleane of hart: for they ſhal ſee God.
label: Matthew

text: Bleſſed are the peace-makers: for they ſhal be called the children of God.
label: Matthew

text: Bleſſed are they that ſuffer perſecution for iuſtice: for theirs is the Kingdom of heauen.
label: Matthew

text: Bleſſed are ye vvhen they ſhal reuile you, and perſecute you, & ſpeake al that naught is agaynſt you, vntruely, for my ſake:
label: Matthew

text: be glad & reioyce, for your revvard is very great in heauen. ⊢ For ſo they perſecuted the Prophets, that vvere before you.
label: Matthew

text: You are the ſalt of the earth.
label: Matthew

text: But if the ſalt leeſe his vertue, vvherevvith ſhal it be ſalted? It is good for nothing any more but to be caſt forth, and to be troden of men.
label: Matthew

text: You are the light of the vvorld. A citie cannot be hid, ſituated on a mountaine.
label: Matthew

text: Neither do men light a candel and put it vnder a buſhel, but vpon a candleſticke, that it may ſhine to al that are in the houſe.
label: Matthew

text: So let your light ſhine before men: that they may ſee your good workes, and glorifie your father vvhich is in heauen.
label: Matthew

text: Do not thinke that I am come to breake the Lavv or the Prophets. I am not come to breake: but to fulfil.
label: Matthew

text: For aſſuredly I ſay vnto you, til heauen and earth paſſe, one iote or one tittle ſhal not paſſe of the Lavv: til al be fulfilled.
label: Matthew

text: He therfore that ſhal breake one of theſe leaſt commaundementes, & ſhal ſo teach men: ſhal be called the leaſt in the Kingdom of heauen. But he that ſhal doe and teach: he ſhal be called great in the Kingdom of heauen. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: For I tel you, that vnles your iuſtice abound more then that of the Scribes and Phariſees, you ſhal not enter into the Kingdom of heauen.
label: Matthew

text: You haue heard that it vvas ſayd to them of old. Thou ſhalt not kil. and vvho ſo killeth, ſhal be in danger of iudgement.
label: Matthew

text: But I ſay to you, that vvhoſoeuer is angrie vvith his brother, ſhal be in danger of iudgment. And vvhoſoeuer ſhal ſay to his brother, Raca: ſhal be in danger of a councel. And whoſoeuer ſhal ſay, Thou foole: ſhal be guilty of the hel of fyre.
label: Matthew

text: If therefore thou offer thy gift at the altar, and there thou remember that thy brother hath ought agaynſt the:
label: Matthew

text: leaue there thy offering before the altar, and goe firſt to be reconciled to thy brother: and then coming thou ſhalt offer thy gift. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Be at agreement vvith thy aduerſarie betimes vvhiles thou art in the vvay vvith him: leſt perhaps the aduerſarie deliuer thee to the iudge, and the iudge deliuer thee to the officer, and thou be caſt into priſon.
label: Matthew

text: Amen I ſay to thee, thou ſhalt not goe out from thence til thou repay the laſt farthing.
label: Matthew

text: You haue heard that it vvas ſayd to them of old, Thou ſhalt not committe aduoutrie.
label: Matthew

text: But I ſay to you, that whoſoeuer ſhal ſee a vvoman to luſt after her, hath already committed aduoutrie vvith her in his hart.
label: Matthew

text: And if thy right eie ſcandalize thee, plucke it out, & caſt it from thee. for it is expedient for thee that one of thy limmes periſh, rather then thy vvhole body be caſt into hel.
label: Matthew

text: And if thy right hand ſcandalize thee, cut it of, and caſt it from thee: for it is expedient for thee that one of thy limmes periſh, rather then that thy whole body goe into hel.
label: Matthew

text: It vvas ſayd alſo, vvhoſoeuer ſhal dimiſſe his vvife, let him giue her a bil of diuorcement.
label: Matthew

text: But I ſay to you, whoſoeuer ſhal dimiſſe his vvife, excepting the cauſe of fornication, maketh her to committe aduoutrie: And he that ſhal marie her that is dimiſſed, committeth aduoutrie.
label: Matthew

text: Agayne you haue heard that it vvas ſayd to them of old, Thou ſhalt not committe periurie: but thou ſhalt performe thy othes to our Lord.
label: Matthew

text: But I ſay to you not to ſweare at al: neither by heauen, becauſe it is the throne of God: neither by the earth, becauſe it is the foote-ſtole of his feete: neither by Hieruſalem, becauſe it is the citie of the great King.
label: Matthew

text: Neither ſhalt thou ſweare by thy head, becauſe thou canſt not make one heare vvhite or blacke.
label: Matthew

text: Let your talke be, yea, yea: no, no: and that vvhich is ouer & aboue theſe, is of euil.
label: Matthew

text: You haue heard that it vvas ſayd, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.
label: Matthew

text: But I ſay to you not to reſiſt euil: but if one ſtrike thee on thy right cheeke, turne to him alſo the other:
label: Matthew

text: and to him that vvil contend vvith thee in iudgment, and take away thy cote, let goe thy cloke alſo vnto him,
label: Matthew

text: and vvhoſoeuer vvil force thee one mile, goe vvith him other tvvayne.
label: Matthew

text: He that aſketh of thee, giue to him: and to him that vvould borovv of thee, turne not avvay.
label: Matthew

text: You haue heard that it vvas ſayd, Thou ſhalt loue thy neighbour, and hate thine enemie.
label: Matthew

text: But I ſay to you, loue your enemies, doe good to them that hate you: and pray for them that perſecute and abuſe you:
label: Matthew

text: that you may be the children of your father vvhich is in heauen, vvho maketh his ſunne to riſe vpon good & bad, and rayneth vpon iuſt & vniuſt.
label: Matthew

text: For if you loue them that loue you, vvhat revvard ſhal you haue? do not alſo the Publicans this?
label: Matthew

text: And if you ſalute your brethren only, vvhat do you more? do not alſo the heathen this?
label: Matthew

text: Be you perfect therfore, as alſo your heauenly father is perfect.
label: Matthew

text: TAKE good heede that you doe not your iuſtice before men, to be ſeen of them: otherwiſe reward you ſhall not haue with your father which is in heauen.
label: Matthew

text: Therfore when thou doeſt an almes-deede, ſound not a trompet before thee, as the hypocrites doe in the Synagogues and in the ſtreetes, that they may be honoured of men: Amen I ſay to you, they haue receiued their reward.
label: Matthew

text: But when thou doeſt an almes-deede, let not thy left hand know vvhat thy right hand doeth:
label: Matthew

text: that thy almes-deede may be in ſecrete, and thy father vvhich ſeeth in ſecrete, vvil repay the. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And when ye pray, you ſhal not be as the hypocrites, that loue to ſtand & pray in the Synagogs and corners of the ſtreetes, that they may be ſeen of men: Amen I ſay to you, they haue receiued their revvard.
label: Matthew

text: But thou vvhen thou ſhalt pray, enter into thy chamber, & hauing ſhut the doore, pray to thy father in ſecrete: and thy father vvhich ſeeth in ſecrete, vvil repay thee.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen you are praying, ſpeake not much, as the heathen. For they thinke that in their much-ſpeaking they may be heard.
label: Matthew

text: Be not you therefore like to them, for your father knovveth vvhat is needeful for you, before you aſke him.
label: Matthew

text: Thus therefore ſhal you pray. OVR FATHER which art in heauen, ſanctified be thy name.
label: Matthew

text: Let thy Kingdom come. Thy wil be done, as in heauen, in earth alſo.
label: Matthew

text: Giue vs to day our ſuperſubſtantial bread.
label: Matthew

text: And forgiue vs our dettes, as we alſo forgiue our detters.
label: Matthew

text: And leade vs not into tentation. But deliuer vs from euil. Amen.
label: Matthew

text: For if you vvil forgiue men their offenſes, your heauenly father vvil forgiue you alſo your offenſes.
label: Matthew

text: But if you vvil not forgiue men, neither vvil your father forgiue you your offenſes.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen you faſt, be not as the hypocrites, ſad. For they disfigure their faces, that they may appeare vnto men to faſt. Amen I ſay to you, that they haue receiued their revvard.
label: Matthew

text: But thou vvhen thou doeſt faſt, anoynte thy head, and waſh thy face:
label: Matthew

text: that thou appeare not to men to faſt, but to thy father vvhich is in ſecrete: and thy father vvhich ſeeth in ſecrete, vvil repay thee.
label: Matthew

text: Heape not vp to your ſelues treaſures on the earth: vvhere the ruſt & mothe do corrupt, & vvhere theeues digge through & ſteale.
label: Matthew

text: But heape vp to your ſelues treaſures in heauen: vvhere neither the ruſt nor mothe doth corrupt, and vvhere theeues do not digge through nor ſteale.
label: Matthew

text: For vvhere thy treaſure is, there is thy hart alſo. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: The candel of thy body is thine eye. If thine eye be ſimple, thy vvhole body ſhal be lightſome.
label: Matthew

text: But if thine eye be naught: thy vvhole body ſhal be darkeſome. If then the light that is in thee, be darkenes: the darkenes it ſelf hovv great ſhal it be?
label: Matthew

text: No man can ſerue tvvo maſters. For either he vvil hate the one, and loue the other: or he vvil ſuſtayne the one, and contemne the other. You cannot ſerue God and Mammon.
label: Matthew

text: Therfore I ſay to you, be not careful for your life vvhat you ſhal eate, neither for your body vvhat rayment you ſhal put on. Is not the life more then the meate: and the body more then the rayment?
label: Matthew

text: Behold the foules of the ayre, that they ſovv not, neither reape, nor gather into barnes: and your heauenly father feedeth them. Are not you much more of price then they?
label: Matthew

text: And vvhich of you by caring, can adde to his ſtature one cubite?
label: Matthew

text: And for rayment vvhy are you careful? Conſider the lilies of the field hovv they grovv: they labour not, neither do they ſpinne.
label: Matthew

text: But I ſay to you, that neither Salomon in al his glorie vvas arayed as one of theſe.
label: Matthew

text: And if the graſſe of the field, vvhich to day is, and to morovv is caſt into the ouen, God doth ſo clothe: hovv much more you O ye of very ſmal fayth?
label: Matthew

text: Be not careful therefore, ſaying, vvhat ſhal vve eate, or vvhat ſhal we drinke, or wherewith ſhal vve be couered?
label: Matthew

text: for al theſe thinges the Heathen do ſeeke after. For your father knovveth that you neede al theſe things.
label: Matthew

text: Seeke therefore firſt the Kingdom of God, & the iuſtice of him: and al theſe things ſhal be giuen you beſides. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Be not careful therfore for the morow. For the morow day ſhal be careful for it ſelf. ſufficient for the day is the euil thereof.
label: Matthew

text: IVDGE not, that you be not iudged.
label: Matthew

text: For in what iudgment you iudge, you ſhal be iudged: and in what meaſure you mete, it ſhal be meaſured to you agayne.
label: Matthew

text: And why ſeeſt thou the mote that is in thy brothers eye: and the beame that is in thine ovvne eye thou ſeeſt not?
label: Matthew

text: Or how ſayeſt thou to thy brother, Let me caſt out the mote of thine eye: and behold a beame is in thine owne eye?
label: Matthew

text: Hypocrite, caſt out firſt the beame out of thine owne eye, and then ſhalt thou ſee to caſt out the mote out of thy brothers eye.
label: Matthew

text: Giue not that which is holy to dogges: neither caſt ye your pearles before ſwine, leſt perhaps they treade them with their feete, and turning, al to teare you.
label: Matthew

text: Aſke, and it ſhal be giuen you: ſeeke, and you ſhal finde, knocke, and it ſhal be opened to you.
label: Matthew

text: For euery one that aſketh, receiueth: and that ſeeketh, findeth: and to him that knocketh, it ſhal be opened.
label: Matthew

text: Or what man is there of you, vvhom if his childe ſhal aſke bread, vvil he reach him a ſtone?
label: Matthew

text: Or if he ſhal aſke him fiſh, vvil he reach him a ſerpent?
label: Matthew

text: If you then being naught, knovv hovv to giue good giftes to your children: hovv much more vvil your father vvhich is in heauen, giue good things to them that aſke him?
label: Matthew

text: Al things therfore vvhatſoeuer you vvil that men doe to you doe you alſo to them. For this is the Lavv and the Prophets.
label: Matthew

text: Enter ye by the narrovv gate: becauſe brode is the gate, and large is the vvay that leadeth to perdition, and many there be that enter by it.
label: Matthew

text: Hovv narrovv is the gate, and ſtraite is the vvay that leadeth to life: and fevv there are that finde it!
label: Matthew

text: Take ye great heede of falſe Prophets, vvhich come to you in the clothing of ſheepe, but invvardly are rauening vvolues.
label: Matthew

text: By their fruites you ſhal knovv them. Do men gather grapes of thornes, or figges of thiſtels?
label: Matthew

text: Euen ſo euery good tree yeldeth good fruites, and the euil tree yeldeth euil fruites.
label: Matthew

text: A good tree can not yeld euil fruites, neither an euil tree yeld good fruites.
label: Matthew

text: Euery tree that yeldeth not good fruite, ſhal be cut dovvne, and ſhal be caſt into fyre.
label: Matthew

text: Therfore by their fruites you ſhal knovv them.
label: Matthew

text: Not euery one that ſayth to me, Lord, Lord, ſhal enter into the Kingdom of heauen: but he that doeth the vvil of my father vvhich is in heauen, he ſhal enter into the kingdom of heauen. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Many ſhal ſay to me in that day, Lord, Lord, haue not vve prophecied in thy name, and in thy name caſt out diuels, and in thy name vvrought many miracles?
label: Matthew

text: And then I vvil confeſſe vnto them, That I neuer knevv you. depart from me you that vvorke iniquitie.
label: Matthew

text: Euery one therfore that heareth theſe my vvordes, and doeth them: ſhal be likened to a vviſe man that built his houſe vpon a rocke,
label: Matthew

text: and the rayne fel, and the fluddes came, & the vvindes blevve, and they beate agaynſt that houſe, and it fel not, for it vvas founded vpon a rocke.
label: Matthew

text: And euery one that heareth theſe my vvordes, & doeth them not, ſhal be like a fooliſh man that built his houſe vpon the ſand,
label: Matthew

text: and the rayne fel, and the fluddes came, and the vvindes blevve, and they beate agaynſt that houſe, and it fel, & the fall therof vvas great.
label: Matthew

text: And it came to paſſe, vvhen IESVS had fully ended theſe vvordes, the multitude vvere in admiration vpon his doctrine.
label: Matthew

text: For he vvas teaching them as hauing povver, and not as their Scribes and Phariſees.
label: Matthew

text: AND when he was come downe from the mountaine, great multitudes folowed him:
label: Matthew

text: And behold a leper came and adored him ſaying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canſt make me cleane.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſtretching forth his hand, touched him, ſaying. I wil. be thou made cleane. And forthwith, his leproſy was made cleane.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſayth to him, See thou tel no body: but goe, ſhevv thy ſelf to the prieſt, & offer the gift vvhich Moyſes commaunded for a teſtimonie to them.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen he vvas entred into Capharnaum, there came to him a Centurion, beſeeching him,
label: Matthew

text: & ſaying, Lord my boy lieth at home ſicke of the palſey, & is ſore tormented.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſayth to him, I vvil come, & cure him.
label: Matthew

text: And the Centurion making anſvver, ſayd, Lord I am not worthie that thou ſhouldeſt enter vnder my roofe: but only ſay the vvord, and my boy ſhal be healed.
label: Matthew

text: For I alſo am a man ſubiect to authoritie, hauing vnder me ſouldiars: and I ſay to this, goe, and he goeth: and to an other, come, & he cometh: and to my ſeruant, doe this, & he doeth it.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS hearing this, marueiled: and ſayd to them that folovved him, Amen I ſay to you, I haue not found ſo great faith in Iſrael.
label: Matthew

text: And I ſay to you, that many ſhal come from the Eaſt and Weſt, and ſhal ſitte dovvne vvith Abraham & Iſaac & Iacob in the kingdom of heauen:
label: Matthew

text: but the children of the kingdom ſhal be caſt out into the exteriour darkeneſſe: there ſhal be vveeping & gnaſhing of teeth.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſaid to the Centurion, Goe: and as thou haſt beleeued, be it done to thee. And the boy vvas healed in the ſame houre. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And when IESVS was come into Peters houſe, he ſavv his vviues mother layde, & in a fitte of a feuer:
label: Matthew

text: and he touched her hand, and the feuer left her, and ſhe aroſe, and miniſtred to him.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen euening vvas come, they brought to him many that had diuels: and he caſt out the ſpirites vvith a word: and al that vvere il at eaſe he cured:
label: Matthew

text: that it might be fulfilled vvich vvas ſpoken by Eſay the Prophete ſaying, He tooke our infirmities, and bare our diſeaſes.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſeeing great multitudes about him, commaunded to goe beyond the vvater.
label: Matthew

text: And a certaine Scribe came, and ſayd to him, Maſter, I vvil folovv thee vvitherſoeuer thou ſhalt goe.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſayth to him, the foxes haue holes, and the foules of the ayre neſtes: but the ſonne of man hath not vvhere to lay his head.
label: Matthew

text: And an other of his Diſciples ſayd to him, Lord, permit me firſt to goe & burie my father.
label: Matthew

text: But IESVS ſayd to him, Folovv me, and let the dead burie their dead.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen he entered into the boate, his Diſciples folowed him:
label: Matthew

text: and loe a great tempeſt aroſe in the ſea, ſo that the boate vvas couered vvith vvaues, but he ſlept.
label: Matthew

text: And they came to him, and raiſed him, ſaying, Lord, ſaue vs, vve periſh.
label: Matthew

text: And he ſaith to them, Why are you fearful O ye of litle faith? Then riſing vp he commaunded the vvindes & the ſea, and there enſued a great calme.
label: Matthew

text: Moreouer the men marueled ſaying, What an one is this, for the vvindes and the ſea obey him? ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen he was come beyond the vvater into the countrey of the Geraſens, there mette him tvvo that had diuels, coming forth out of the ſepulcres, exceding fierce, ſo that none could paſſe by that vvay.
label: Matthew

text: And behold they cried ſaying, What is betvvene vs and thee IESV the ſonne of God? art thou come hither to torment vs before the time?
label: Matthew

text: And there vvas not farre frome them an heard of many ſwine feeding.
label: Matthew

text: And the diuels beſought him ſaying, If thou caſt vs out, ſend vs into the heard of ſwine.
label: Matthew

text: And he ſaid to them, Goe. But they going forth vvent into the ſvvine, and behold the whole heard vvent vvith a violence headlong into the ſea: and they dyed in the waters.
label: Matthew

text: And the ſvvineheardes fled: and comming into the citie, told al, and of them that had been poſſeſſed of diuels.
label: Matthew

text: And behold the vvhole citie vvent out to meete IESVS, and vvhen they ſavv him, they beſought him that he vvould paſſe from their quarters.
label: Matthew

text: AND entring into a boate, he paſſed ouer the vvater, and came into his ovvne citie.
label: Matthew

text: And behold they brought to him one ſicke of the palſey lying in bedde. And IESVS ſeeing their faith, ſaid to the ſicke of the palſey, Haue a good hart ſonne, thy ſinnes are forgiuen thee.
label: Matthew

text: And behold certaine of the Scribes ſayd vvithin them ſelues, He blaſphemeth.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſeeing their thoughtes, ſaid. Wherfore thinke you euil in your hartes?
label: Matthew

text: Whether is eaſier, to ſay, thy ſinnes are forgiuen thee: or to ſay, Ariſe and vvalke?
label: Matthew

text: But that you may know that the Sonne of man hath povver in earth to forgiue ſinnes, (then ſayd he to the ſicke of the palſey,) Ariſe, take vp thy bedde, and goe into thy houſe.
label: Matthew

text: And he aroſe, and vvent into his houſe.
label: Matthew

text: And the multitudes ſeeing it, vvere afrayd, and glorified God that gaue ſuch povver to men. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen IESVS paſſed forth from thence, he ſavv a man ſitting in the cuſtome-houſe, named Matthevv: And he ſayth to him, Folovv me. And he aroſe vp, and folovved him.
label: Matthew

text: And it came to paſſe as he vvas ſitting at meate in the houſe, behold many Publicans and ſinners came, and ſate dovvne vvith IESVS and his Diſciples.
label: Matthew

text: And the Phariſees ſeeing it, ſayd to his Diſciples: vvhy doth your Maſter eate vvith Publicans & ſinners?
label: Matthew

text: But IESVS hearing it, ſayd: They that are in health, neede not a phyſicion, but they that are il at eaſe.
label: Matthew

text: But go your vvayes and learne vvhat it is, I vvil mercie, & not ſacrifice. For I am not come to cal the iuſt, but ſinners. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Then came to him the Diſciples of Iohn, ſaying, vvhy do vve and the Phariſees faſt often, but thy Diſciples do not faſt?
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſayd to them, Can the children of the bridegrome mourne, as long as the bridegrome is vvith them? But the dayes vvil come vvhen the bridegrome ſhal be taken avvay from them, and then they ſhal faſt.
label: Matthew

text: And no body putteth a peece of ravv cloth to an old garment. For he taketh avvay the peecing therof from the garment, and there is made a greater rent.
label: Matthew

text: Neither do they put nevv vvine into old bottels. Othervviſe the bottels breake, and the vvine runneth out, and the bottels periſh. But nevv vvine they put into nevv bottels: and both are preſerued together.
label: Matthew

text: As he was ſpeaking this vnto them, behold a certaine Gouernour approched, and adored him, ſaying, Lord, my daughter is euen novv dead: but come, lay thy hand vpon her, and ſhe ſhal liue.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ryſing vp folovved him, and his Diſciples.
label: Matthew

text: And behold a vvoman vvhich vvas troubled vvith an iſſue of bloud tvvelue yeres, came behind him, and touched the hemme of his garment.
label: Matthew

text: For ſhe ſayd vvithin her ſelf, If I ſhal touch only his garment: I ſhal be ſafe.
label: Matthew

text: But IESVS turning and ſeeing her, ſayd, Haue a good hart daughter, thy faith hath made the ſafe. And the woman became vvhole from that houre.
label: Matthew

text: And when IESVS vvas come into the houſe of the Gouernour, & ſavv minſtrels and the multitude keeping a ſturre,
label: Matthew

text: he ſayd, Depart: for the vvenche is not dead, but ſleepeth. And they laughed him to ſkorne.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen the multitude vvas put forth, he entred in, and held her hand. And the mayde aroſe.
label: Matthew

text: And this bruite vvent forth into al that countrie.
label: Matthew

text: And as IESVS paſſed forth from thence, there folovved him tvvo blinde men crying and ſaying, Haue mercie on vs, O ſonne of Dauid.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen he vvas come to the houſe, the blinde came to him. And IESVS ſayth to them, Do you beleeue, that I can doe this vnto you? They ſay to him, Yea Lord.
label: Matthew

text: Then he touched their eyes, ſaying, According to your faith, be it done to you.
label: Matthew

text: And their eyes vvere opened, and IESVS threatened them, ſaying, See that no man know it.
label: Matthew

text: But they vvent forth, & bruited him in al that countrey.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen they vvere gone forth, behold they brought him a dumme man, poſſeſſed vvith a diuel.
label: Matthew

text: And after the diuel vvas caſt out, the dumme man ſpake, and the multitudes marueled ſaying, Neuer vvas the like ſeene in Iſrael.
label: Matthew

text: But the Phariſees ſayd, In the prince of diuels he caſteth out diuels.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS vvent about al the cities, and tovvnes, teaching in their ſynagogs, and preaching the Goſpel of the kingdom, and curing euery diſeaſe, and euery infirmitie.
label: Matthew

text: And ſeing the multitudes, he pitied them: becauſe they vvere vexed, and lay like ſheepe that haue not a ſhepheard.
label: Matthew

text: Then he ſayth to his Diſciples, The harueſt ſurely is great, but the vvorkemen are fevv.
label: Matthew

text: Pray therfore the Lord of the harueſt, that he ſend forth vvorkemen into his harueſt.
label: Matthew

text: AND hauing called his tvvelue Diſciples together, he gaue them povver ouer vncleane ſpirites, that they ſhould caſt them out, and ſhould cure al maner of diſeaſe, and al maner of infirmitie.
label: Matthew

text: And the names of the tvvelue Apoſtles be theſe: the firſt, Simon vvho is called Peter, and Andrevv his brother,
label: Matthew

text: Iames of Zebedee, and Iohn his brother, Philip and Barthlemevv, Thomas and Matthevv the publican, and Iames of Alphaeus, & Thaddaeus,
label: Matthew

text: Simon Cananaeus, and Iudas Iſcariote, vvho alſo betrayed him.
label: Matthew

text: Theſe tvvelue did IESVS ſend: commaunding them, ſaying, Into the vvay of the Gentiles goe ye not, and into the cities of the Samaritans enter ye not:
label: Matthew

text: but goe rather to the ſheepe that are periſhed of the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Matthew

text: And going preache, ſaying, That the kingdom of heauen is at hand.
label: Matthew

text: Cure the ſicke, raiſe the dead, cleanſe the lepers, caſt out diuels: gratis you haue receiued, gratis giue ye.
label: Matthew

text: Do not poſſeſſe gold, nor ſiluer, nor money in your purſes:
label: Matthew

text: not a ſkrippe for the vvay, neither two coates, neither ſhoes, neither rodde. for the vvorkeman is vvorthie of his meate.
label: Matthew

text: And into vvhatſoeuer citie or tovvne you ſhal enter, inquire vvho in it is vvorthie: and there tarie til you goe forth.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen ye enter into the houſe, ſalute it, ſaying, Peace be to this houſe.
label: Matthew

text: And if ſo be that houſe be vvorthie, your peace ſhal come vpon it. but if it be not vvorthie: your peace ſhal returne to you.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhoſoeuer ſhal not receiue you, nor heare your vvordes: going forth out of the houſe or the citie ſhake of the duſt from your feete.
label: Matthew

text: Amen I ſay to you, it ſhal be more tolerable for the land of the Sodomites and Gomorrheans in the day of iudgement, then for that citie.
label: Matthew

text: Behold I ſend you as ſheepe in the middes of vvolues. Be ye therfore vviſe as ſerpents, and ſimple as dooues.
label: Matthew

text: And take heede of men. For they vvil deliuer you vp in Councels, and in their ſynagogs they vvil ſcourge you.
label: Matthew

text: And to Preſidents and to Kings ſhal you be ledde for my ſake, in teſtimonie to them and the Gentiles.
label: Matthew

text: But vvhen they ſhal deliuer you vp, take no thought hovv or vvhat to ſpeake: for it ſhal be giuen you in that houre vvhat to ſpeake.
label: Matthew

text: For it is not you that ſpeake, but the ſpirit of your father that ſpeaketh in you.
label: Matthew

text: The brother alſo ſhal deliuer vp the brother to death, and the father the ſonne: and the children ſhal riſe vp agaynſt the parents, and ſhal vvorke their death,
label: Matthew

text: and you ſhal be odious to al men for my name. but he that ſhal perſeuêre vnto the end, he ſhal be ſaued. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen they ſhal perſecute you in this citie, flee into an other. Amen I ſay to you, you ſhal not finiſh al the cities of Iſrael, til the ſonne of man come.
label: Matthew

text: The Diſciple is not aboue the maiſter, nor the ſeruant aboue his lord.
label: Matthew

text: It ſuffiſeth the diſciple that he be as his maiſter: and the ſeruant as his lord. If they haue called the goodman of the houſe Beelzebub, hovv much more them of his houſhold?
label: Matthew

text: Therfore feare ye not them. For nothing is hid, that ſhal not be reuealed: and ſecrete, that ſhal not be knovven.
label: Matthew

text: That vvhich I ſpeake to you in the darke, ſpeake ye in the light: and that vvhich you heare in the eare, preache ye vpon the houſe toppes.
label: Matthew

text: And feare ye not them that kil the body, and are not able to kil the ſoul: but rather feare him that can deſtroy both ſoul and body into hel. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Are not tvvo ſparovves ſold for a farthing: and not one of them ſhal fall vpon the ground vvithout your father?
label: Matthew

text: But your very heares of the head are al numbered.
label: Matthew

text: Feare not therfore: better are you then many ſparovves.
label: Matthew

text: Euery one therfore that ſhal confeſſe me before men, I alſo vvil confeſſe him before my father vvhich is in heauen.
label: Matthew

text: But he that ſhal denie me before men, I alſo vvil denie him before my father vvhich is in heauen.
label: Matthew

text: Do not ye thinke that I came to ſend peace into the earth: I came not to ſend peace, but the ſword.
label: Matthew

text: For I came to ſeparate man agaynſt his father, and the daughter agaynſt her mother, and the daughter in lavv agaynſt her mother in lavv.
label: Matthew

text: And a mans enemies, they of his ovvne houſhold.
label: Matthew

text: He that loueth father or mother more then me, is not vvorthy of me: and he that loueth ſonne or daughter aboue me, is not vvorthy of me.
label: Matthew

text: And he that taketh not his croſſe, and folovveth me, is not vvorthy of me.
label: Matthew

text: He that hath found his life, ſhal loſe it: and he that hath loſt his life for me, ſhal finde it.
label: Matthew

text: He that receiueth you, receiueth me: and he that receiueth me, receiueth him that ſent me.
label: Matthew

text: He that receiueth a Prophet in the name of a Prophet, ſhal receiue the revvard of a Prophet. and he that receiueth a iuſt man in the name of a iuſt man, ſhal receiue the revvard of a iuſt man.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhoſoeuer ſhal giue drinke to one of theſe litle ones a cuppe of cold vvater, only in the name of a diſciple, amen I ſay to you, he ſhal not loſe his revvard. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: AND it came to paſſe: vvhen IESVS had done commaunding his tvvelue Diſciples, he paſſed from thence, to teach & preach in their cities.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen Iohn had heard in priſon the vvorkes of Chriſt: ſending tvvo of his diſciples, he ſaid to him,
label: Matthew

text: Art thou he that art to come, or looke vve for an other?
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS making anſvver ſaid to them, Goe and report to Iohn vvhat you haue heard and ſeen.
label: Matthew

text: The blinde ſee, the lame vvalke, the lepers are made cleane, the deafe heare, the dead riſe againe, to the poore the Goſpel is preached:
label: Matthew

text: and bleſſed is he that ſhal not be ſcandalized in me.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen they vvent their vvay, IESVS began to ſay to the multitudes of Iohn, What vvent you out into the deſert to ſee? a reede ſhaken vvith the vvinde?
label: Matthew

text: But vvhat vvent you out to ſee? a man clothed in ſoft garments? Behold they that are clothed in ſoft garments, are in Kinges houſes.
label: Matthew

text: But vvhat vvent you out to ſee? a Prophet? yea I tel you and more then a Prophet.
label: Matthew

text: For this is he of vvhom it is vvritten, Behold I ſend mine angel before thy face, vvhich ſhal prepare thy vvay before thee. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Amen I ſay to you, there hath not riſen among the borne of vvomen a greater then Iohn the Baptiſt; yet he that is the leſſer in the kingdom of heauen, is greater then he.
label: Matthew

text: And from the dayes of Iohn the Baptiſt vntil novv, the kingdom of heauen ſuffereth violence, and the violent beare it avvay.
label: Matthew

text: For al the Prophets and the Lavv prophecied vnto Iohn:
label: Matthew

text: and if you vvil receiue it, he is Elias that is for to come.
label: Matthew

text: He that hath eares to heare, let him heare.
label: Matthew

text: And vvherevnto ſhal I eſteeme this generation to be like? It is like to children ſitting in the market-place:
label: Matthew

text: vvhich crying to their companions, ſay, We haue piped to you, and you haue not daunced: we haue lamented, and you haue not mourned.
label: Matthew

text: For Iohn came neither eating nor drinking: and they ſay, He hath a diuel.
label: Matthew

text: The Sonne of man came eating and drinking, and they ſay, Behold a man that is a glotton and a vvinedrinker, a frende of Publicans and ſinners. And vviſedom is iuſtified of her children.
label: Matthew

text: Then began he to vpbraide the cities, vvherein vvere done the moſt of his miracles, for that they had not done penance.
label: Matthew

text: Wo be to thee Corozain, vvo be to thee Beth-ſaida: for if in Tyre & Sidon had been vvrought the miracles that haue been vvrought in you, they had done penance in hearecloth and aſhes long agoe.
label: Matthew

text: But neuertheleſſe, I ſay to you, it ſhal be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the day of iudgement, then for you.
label: Matthew

text: And thou Capharnaum, ſhalt thou be exalted vp to heauen? thou ſhalt come dovvne euen vnto hel. for if in Sodom had been vvrought the miracles that haue been wrought in thee, perhaps it had remained vnto this day.
label: Matthew

text: But notvvithſtanding I ſay to you, that it ſhal be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of iudgement, then for thee.
label: Matthew

text: At that time IESVS anſvvered and ſaid. I confeſſe to thee O Father lord of heauen and earth, becauſe thou haſt hid theſe things from the vviſe and prudent, and haſt reuealed thē to litle ones.
label: Matthew

text: Yea Father: for ſo hath it vvel pleaſed thee.
label: Matthew

text: Al things are deliuered me of my Father. And no man knovveth the Sonne but the Father: neither doth any knovv the Father, but the Sonne, and to vvhom it ſhal pleaſe the Sonne to reueale.
label: Matthew

text: Come ye to me al that labour, and are burdened, and I vvil refreſh you.
label: Matthew

text: Take vp my yoke vpon you, and learne of me, becauſe I am meeke, and humble of hart: and you ſhal finde reſt to your ſoules.
label: Matthew

text: For my yoke is ſvveete, and my burden light. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: AT that time IESVS went through the corne on the Sabboth: and his Diſciples being hungrie, began to plucke the eares, and to eate.
label: Matthew

text: And the Phariſees ſeeing them, ſaid to him. Loe, thy Diſciples doe that vvhich is not lawful for them to doe on the Sabboth-dayes.
label: Matthew

text: But he ſayd to them, Haue you not read vvhat Dauid did vvhen he vvas an hungred, and they that vvere vvith him:
label: Matthew

text: hovv he entred into the houſe of God, and did eate the loaues of propoſition, vvhich it vvas not lavvful for him to eate, nor for them that vvere with him, but for prieſtes only?
label: Matthew

text: Or haue ye not read in the Lavv, that on Sabboth-dayes the prieſtes in the temple do breake the Sabboth, and are vvithout blame?
label: Matthew

text: but I tel you that there is here a greater then the temple.
label: Matthew

text: And if you did knovv vvhat it is, I wil mercie, and not ſacrifice: you vvould neuer haue condemned the innocentes.
label: Matthew

text: For the Sonne of man is lord of the Sabboth alſo.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen he had paſſed from thence, he came into their ſynagogue.
label: Matthew

text: And behold there vvas a man vvhich had a vvithered hand, and they aſked him ſaying, Whether is it lavvful to cure on the Sabboths? that they might accuſe him.
label: Matthew

text: But he ſayd to them, what man ſhal there be of you, that ſhal haue one ſheepe: and if the ſame fall into a ditche on the Sabboths, vvil he not take hold and lift it vp?
label: Matthew

text: Hovv much better is a man more then a ſheepe? therfore it is lavvful on the Sabboths to doe a good deede.
label: Matthew

text: Then he ſayth to the man, Stretch forth thy hand. and he ſtretched it forth, and it vvas reſtored to health euen as the other.
label: Matthew

text: And the Phariſees going forth made a conſultation agaynſt him, how they might deſtroy him.
label: Matthew

text: But IESVS knovving it, retired from thence: and many folovved him, and he cured them all.
label: Matthew

text: and he charged them that they ſhould not diſcloſe him.
label: Matthew

text: That it might be fulfilled vvhich vvas ſpoken by Eſay the Prophete, ſaying.
label: Matthew

text: Behold my ſeruant vvhom I haue choſen, my beloued in vvhom my ſoul hath vvel liked. I vvil put my ſpirit vpon him, and iudgement to the Gentiles ſhal he ſhew.
label: Matthew

text: He ſhal not contend, nor crie out, neither ſhal any man heare in the ſtreetes his voyce.
label: Matthew

text: The reede bruiſed he ſhal not breake, and ſmoking flaxe he ſhal not extinguiſh: til he caſt forth iudgement vnto victorie.
label: Matthew

text: And in his name the Gentiles ſhal hope.
label: Matthew

text: Then vvas offered to him one poſſeſſed vvith a deuil, blinde and dumme: and he cured him, ſo that he ſpake & ſaw.
label: Matthew

text: And al the multitudes vvere amaſed, and ſayd, Whether this be the Sonne of Dauid?
label: Matthew

text: But the Phariſees hearing it, ſayd. This felovv caſteth not out diuels but in Beelzebub the Prince of the diuels.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS knovving their cogitations, ſaid to them. Euery kingdom deuided againſt it ſelf ſhal be made deſolate: and euery citie or houſe deuided agaynſt it ſelf, ſhal not ſtand.
label: Matthew

text: And if Satan caſt out Satan, he is deuided againſt him ſelf: hovv then ſhal his kingdom ſtand?
label: Matthew

text: And if I in Beelzebub caſt out deuils: your children in vvhom do they caſt out? Therfore they ſhal be your iudges.
label: Matthew

text: But if I in the Spirit of God do caſt out deuils, then is the kingdom of God come vpon you.
label: Matthew

text: Or hovv can a man enter into the houſe of the ſtrong, and rifle his veſſel, vnles he firſt binde the ſtrong? and then he vvil rifle his houſe.
label: Matthew

text: He that is not vvith me, is agaynſt me: and he that gathereth not vvith me, ſcattereth.
label: Matthew

text: Therfore I ſay to you, euery ſinne and blaſphemie ſhal be forgiuen men, but the blaſphemie of the Spirit ſhal not be forgiuen.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhoſoeuer ſhal ſpeake a vvord agaynſt the Sonne of man, it ſhal be forgiuen him: but he that ſhal ſpeake againſt the Holy Ghoſt, it ſhal not be forgiuen him neither in this vvorld, nor in the vvorld to come.
label: Matthew

text: Either make the tree good, and his fruite good: or make the tree euil, and his fruite euil. for of the fruite the tree is knowen.
label: Matthew

text: You vipers broodes, hovv can you ſpeake good things, vvhereas you are euil? for of the aboundance of the hart the mouth ſpeaketh.
label: Matthew

text: A good man out of a good treaſure bringeth forth good things: and an euil man out of an euil treaſure bringeth forth euil things.
label: Matthew

text: But I ſay vnto you, that euery idle vvord that men ſhal ſpeake, they ſhal render an account for it in the day of iudgement.
label: Matthew

text: For of thy wordes thou ſhalt be iuſtified, and of thy vvordes thou ſhalt be condemned.
label: Matthew

text: Then anſvvered him certaine of the Scribes and Phariſees, ſaying, Maiſter, vve vvould ſee a ſigne from thee.
label: Matthew

text: who anſwered, and ſaid to them, The vvicked and aduouterous generation ſeeketh a ſigne: and a ſigne ſhal not be giuen it, but the ſigne of Ionas the Prophet.
label: Matthew

text: For as Ionas vvas in the vvhales belly three dayes and three nightes: ſo ſhal the Sonne of man be in the hart of the earth three dayes and three nightes.
label: Matthew

text: The men of Niniuee ſhal riſe in the iudgement vvith this generation, and ſhal condemne it: becauſe they did penance at the preaching of Ionas. And behold more then Ionas here.
label: Matthew

text: The Queene of the South ſhal riſe in the iudgement vvith this generation, and ſhal condemne it: becauſe ſhe came from the endes of the earth to heare the vviſedom of Salomon, and behold more then Salomon here.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen an vncleane ſpirit ſhal goe out of a man, he vvalketh through dry places, ſeeking reſt, and findeth not.
label: Matthew

text: Then he ſaith, I vvil returne into my houſe vvhence I came out. And coming he findeth it vacant, ſvvept vvith beſoms, and trimmed.
label: Matthew

text: Then goeth he, and taketh vvith him ſeuen other ſpirites more vvicked then him ſelf, and they enter in and dvvel there: and the laſt of that man be made vvorſe then the firſt. So ſhal it be alſo to this vvicked generation.
label: Matthew

text: As he vvas yet ſpeaking to the multitudes, behold his mother and his brethren ſtoode vvithout, ſeeking to ſpeake to him.
label: Matthew

text: And one ſaid vnto him, Behold thy mother and thy brethren ſtand without, ſeeking thee.
label: Matthew

text: But he anſvvering him that told him, ſaid, Who is my mother, and vvho are my brethren?
label: Matthew

text: And ſtretching forth his hand vpon his Diſciples, he ſaid, Behold my mother and my brethren.
label: Matthew

text: For vvhoſoeuer ſhal doe the vvil of my father, that is in heauen: he is my brother, and ſiſter, and mother. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: THE ſame day IESVS going out of the houſe, ſate by the ſea ſide.
label: Matthew

text: And great multitudes vvere gathered together vnto him, in ſo much that he vvent vp into a boate & ſate: and al the multitude ſtoode in the ſhore,
label: Matthew

text: and he ſpake to them many things in parables, ſaying, Behold the ſovver vvent forth to ſovv.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhiles he ſovveth, ſome fell by the vvay ſide, and the foules of the aire did come and eate it.
label: Matthew

text: Otherſome alſo fell vpon rockie places, where they had not much earth: and they ſhot vp incontinent, becauſe they had not deepenes of earth,
label: Matthew

text: and after the ſunne vvas vp, they parched: and becauſe they had not roote, they vvithered.
label: Matthew

text: And other fell among thornes: and the thornes grevve and choked them.
label: Matthew

text: And otherſome fell vpon good ground: and they yelded fruite, the one an hundredfold, the other threeſcore, and an other thirtie.
label: Matthew

text: He that hath eares to heare, let him heare.
label: Matthew

text: And his Diſciples came and ſaid to him. Why ſpeakeſt thou to them in parables?
label: Matthew

text: Who anſvvered and ſaid vnto them, Becauſe to you it is giuen to knovv the myſteries of the kingdom of heauen: but to them it is not giuen.
