label: Matthew

text: For he that hath, to him ſhal be giuen, and he ſhal abound: but he that hath not, from him ſhal be taken avvay that alſo vvhich he hath.
label: Matthew

text: Therfore in parables I ſpeake to them: becauſe ſeeing they ſee not, and hearing they heare not, neither do they vnderſtand:
label: Matthew

text: and the prophecie of Eſay is fulfilled in them, vvhich ſaith, With hearing ſhal you heare, and you ſhal not vnderſtand: and ſeeing ſhal you ſee, and you ſhal not ſee.
label: Matthew

text: For the hart of this people is vvaxed groſſe, and vvith their eares they haue heauily heard, and their eies they haue ſhut: leſt at any time they may ſee with their eies, and heare with their eares, and vnderſtand vvith their hart and be conuerted, and I may heale them.
label: Matthew

text: But bleſſed are your eyes becauſe they doe ſee, and your eares becauſe they doe heare.
label: Matthew

text: For amen I ſay to you, that many Prophets and iuſt men haue deſired to ſee the things that you ſee, and haue not ſeen them: and to heare the things that you heare, and haue not heard them.
label: Matthew

text: Heare you therfore the parable of the ſovver.
label: Matthew

text: Euery one that heareth the vvord of the kingdom and vnderſtandeth not, there cometh the vvicked one, and catcheth avvay that vvhich vvas ſovven in his hart: this is he that vvas ſovven by the vvay ſide.
label: Matthew

text: And he that vvas ſovven vpon rockie places: this is he that heareth the vvord, and incontinent receiueth it vvith ioy,
label: Matthew

text: yet hath he not roote in him ſelf, but is for a time: and vvhen there falleth tribulation and perſecution for the vvord, he is by and by ſcandalized.
label: Matthew

text: And he that vvas ſovven among thornes, this is he that heareth the vvord, and the carefulnes of this vvorld and the deceitfulnes of riches choketh vp the vvord, and he becometh fruitles.
label: Matthew

text: But he that vvas ſovven vpon good ground: this is he that heareth the vvord, and vnderſtandeth, and bringeth fruite, and yeldeth ſome an hundred-fold, and other threeſcore, and an other thirtie.
label: Matthew

text: An other parable he propoſed to them, ſaying, The kingdom of heauen is reſembled to a man that ſovved good ſeede in his field.
label: Matthew

text: But vvhen men vvere a ſleepe, his enemy came and ouerſovved cockle among the vvheate, and vvent his vvay.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen the blade vvas ſhot vp, and had brought forth fruite, then appeared alſo the cockle.
label: Matthew

text: And the ſeruants of the goodman of the houſe comming ſaid to him, Sir, didſt thou not ſovv good ſeede in thy field? Whence then hath it cockle?
label: Matthew

text: And he ſaid to them, The enemy man hath done this. And the ſeruants ſaid to him, Wilt thou vve goe and gather it vp?
label: Matthew

text: And he ſaid, No: leſt perhaps gathering vp the cockle, you may roote vp the vvheate alſo together vvith it.
label: Matthew

text: Suffer both to grovv vntil the harueſt, and in the time of harueſt I vvil ſay to the reapers, Gather vp firſt the cockle, and binde it into bundels to burne, but the vvheate gather ye into my barne. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: An other parable he propoſed vnto them, ſaying, The kingdom of heauen is like to a muſtard-ſeede, vvhich a man tooke and ſovved in his field.
label: Matthew

text: Which is the leaſt ſurely of al ſeedes: but vvhen it is grovven, it is greater then al herbes, and is made a tree, ſo that the foules of the aire come, and dvvel in the branches thereof.
label: Matthew

text: An other parable he ſpake to them, The kingdom of heauen is like to leauen, vvhich a vvoman tooke and hid in three meaſures of meale, vntil the vvhole vvas leauened.
label: Matthew

text: Al theſe things IESVS ſpake in parables to the multitudes, and vvithout parables he did not ſpeake to them:
label: Matthew

text: that it might be fulfilled vvhich vvas ſpoken by the Prophet ſaying, I wil open my mouth in parables, I wil vtter things hidden from the foundation of the vvorld. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Then hauing dimiſſed the multitudes, he came into the houſe, and his Diſciples came vnto him, ſaying, Expound vs the parable of the cockle of the field.
label: Matthew

text: Who made anſvver and ſaid to them, He that ſoweth the good ſeede, is the Sonne of man.
label: Matthew

text: And the field, is the vvorld. And the good ſeede: theſe are the children of the kingdom. And the cockle: are the children of the vvicked one.
label: Matthew

text: And the enemie that ſovved them, is the deuil. But the harueſt, is the ende of the vvorld. And the reapers, are the Angels.
label: Matthew

text: Euen as cockle therfore is gathered vp, and burnt vvith fire: ſo ſhal it be in the ende of the vvorld.
label: Matthew

text: The Sonne of man ſhal ſend his Angels, and they ſhal gather out of his kingdom al ſcandals, and them that vvorke iniquitie:
label: Matthew

text: and ſhal caſt them into the furnace of fire, There ſhal be vveeping and gnaſhing of teeth.
label: Matthew

text: Then ſhal the iuſt ſhine as the ſunne, in the kingdom of their father. He that hath eares to heare, let him heare.
label: Matthew

text: The kingdom of heauen is like a treaſure hidden in a field. vvich a man hauing found, did hide it, and for ioy thereof goeth, and ſelleth al that he hath, and byeth that field.
label: Matthew

text: Againe the kingdom of heauen is like to a marchant man, ſeeking good pearles.
label: Matthew

text: And hauing found one precious pearle, he vvent his vvay, and ſold al that he had, and bought it.
label: Matthew

text: Againe the kingdom of heauen is like to a nette caſt into the ſea, and gathering together of al kind of fiſhes.
label: Matthew

text: Which, vvhen it vvas filled, dravving it forth, and ſitting by the ſhore, they choſe out the good into veſſels, but the bad they did caſt out.
label: Matthew

text: So ſhal it be in the conſummation of the vvorld. The Angels ſhal goe forth, and ſhal ſeparate the euil from among the iuſt,
label: Matthew

text: and ſhal caſt them into the furnace of fire. there ſhal be vveeping and gnaſhing of teeth.
label: Matthew

text: Haue ye vnderſtoode al theſe things? They ſay to him, Yea.
label: Matthew

text: He ſaid vnto them, Therfore euery Scribe inſtructed in the kingdom of heauen, is like to a man that is an houſholder, vvhich bringeth forth out of his treaſure nevv things and old. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And it came to paſſe: vvhen IESVS had ended theſe parables, he paſſed from thence.
label: Matthew

text: And coming into his ovvne countrie, he taught them in their ſynagogues, ſo that they marueled, and ſaid, Hovv came this fellovv by this vviſedom and vertues?
label: Matthew

text: Is not this the carpenters ſonne? Is not his mother called MARIE, and his brethren, Iames and Ioſeph, and Simon and Iude:
label: Matthew

text: and his ſiſters, are they not al vvith vs? Whence therefore hath he al theſe things?
label: Matthew

text: And they vvere ſcandalized in him. But IESVS ſaid to them, There is not a Prophet vvithout honour but in his ovvne countrie, and in his ovvne houſe.
label: Matthew

text: And he vvrought not many miracles there becauſe of their incredulity.
label: Matthew

text: AT that time Herod the Tetrach heard the fame of IESVS:
label: Matthew

text: and ſaid to his ſeruants, This is Iohn the Baptiſt: he is riſen from the dead, and therfore vertues vvorke in him.
label: Matthew

text: For Herod apprehended Iohn and bound him, and put him into priſon becauſe of Herodias, his ‘brothers’ vvife.
label: Matthew

text: For Iohn ſaid vnto him, It is not lavvful for thee to haue her.
label: Matthew

text: And vvilling to put him to death, he feared the people: becauſe they eſteemed him as a Prophet.
label: Matthew

text: But on Herods birth-day, the daughter of Herodias daunced before them: and pleaſed Herod.
label: Matthew

text: VVherevpon he promiſed with an othe, to giue her vvhatſoeuer ſhe vvould aſke of him.
label: Matthew

text: But ſhe being inſtructed before of her mother ſaith, Giue me here in a diſh the head of Iohn the Baptiſt.
label: Matthew

text: And the king vvas ſtroken ſad: yet becauſe of his othe and for them that ſate vvith him at table, he commaunded it to be giuen.
label: Matthew

text: And he ſent, and beheaded Iohn in the priſon.
label: Matthew

text: And his head vvas brought in a diſh: and it vvas giuen to the damſel, and ſhe brought it to her mother.
label: Matthew

text: And his Diſciples came and tooke the body, and buried it: and came and told IESVS.
label: Matthew

text: Which vvhen IESVS had heard, he retired from thence by boate, into a deſert place apart, and the multitudes hauing heard of it, folovved him on foote out of the cities.
label: Matthew

text: And he coming forth ſavv a great multitude, and pitied them, and cured their diſeaſed.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen it vvas euening, his Diſciples came vnto him, ſaying, It is a deſert place, and the houre is novv paſt: dimiſſe the multitudes that going into the tovvnes, they may bye them ſelues victuals.
label: Matthew

text: But IESVS ſaid to them, They haue no neede to goe: giue ye them to eate.
label: Matthew

text: They anſvvered him. We haue not here, but fiue loaues, and tvvo fiſhes.
label: Matthew

text: Who ſaid to them, Bring them hither to me.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen he had commaunded the multitude to ſitte dovvne vpon the graſſe, he tooke the fiue loaues and the two fiſhes, and looking vp vnto heauen he bleſſed and brake, and gaue the loaues to his Diſciples, and the Diſciples to the multitudes.
label: Matthew

text: And they did al eate, and had their fil. And they tooke the leauings, twelue ful baſkettes of the fragments.
label: Matthew

text: And the number of them that did eate vvas, fiue thouſand men, beſide vvomen and children.
label: Matthew

text: And forth vvith IESVS commaunded his Diſciples to goe vp into the boate, and to goe before him ouer the vvater, til he dimiſſed the multitudes.
label: Matthew

text: And hauing dimiſſed the multitude, he aſcended into a mountaine alone to praye. And vvhen it vvas euening, he vvas there alone.
label: Matthew

text: But the boate in the middes of the ſea vvas toſſed vvith vvaues. for the vvinde vvas contrarie.
label: Matthew

text: And in the fourth vvatch of the night, he came vnto them vvalking vpon the ſea.
label: Matthew

text: And ſeeing him vpon the ſea vvalking, they vvere troubled ſaying, That it is a ghoſt. and for feare they cried out.
label: Matthew

text: And immediatly IESVS ſpake vnto them, ſaying, Haue confidence: it is I, feare ye not.
label: Matthew

text: And Peter making anſvver ſaid, Lord if it be thou, bid me come to thee vpon the vvaters.
label: Matthew

text: And he ſaid, Come. And Peter deſcending out of the boate, vvalked vpon the vvater to come to IESVS.
label: Matthew

text: But ſeeing the vvinde rough, he vvas afraid: and vvhen he began to be drovvned, he cried out ſaying, Lord, ſaue me.
label: Matthew

text: And incontinent IESVS ſtretching forth his hand tooke hold of him, and ſaid vnto him, O thou of litle faith, vvhy didſt thou doubt?
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen they vvere gone vp into the boate, the vvinde ceaſed.
label: Matthew

text: And they that vvere in the boate, came and adored him, ſaying, In deede thou art the ſonne of God. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And hauing paſſed the vvater, they came into the countrie of Geneſar.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen the men of that place vnderſtoode of him, they ſent into al that countrie, and brought vnto him al that vvere il at eaſe:
label: Matthew

text: and they beſought him that they might touche but the hemme of his garment, and vvhoſoeuer did touche, vvere made hole.
label: Matthew

text: THEN came to him from Hieruſalem Scribes and Phariſees, ſaying,
label: Matthew

text: VVhy do thy Diſciples tranſgreſſe the tradition of the Auncientes? For they waſh not their hands when they eate bread.
label: Matthew

text: But he anſwering ſaid to them: Why do you alſo tranſgreſſe the commaundement of God for your tradition? For God ſaid,
label: Matthew

text: Honour father and mother. and, He that ſhal curſe father or mother, dying let him dye.
label: Matthew

text: But you ſay, Whoſoeuer ſhal ſay to father or mother, The gift vvhatſoeuer procedeth from me, ſhal profite the:
label: Matthew

text: and ſhal not honour his father or his mother: and you haue made fruſtrate the commaundement of God for your ovvne tradition.
label: Matthew

text: Hypocrites, vvel hath Eſay Prophecied of you, ſaying,
label: Matthew

text: This people honoureth me vvith their lippes: but their hart is farre from me.
label: Matthew

text: And in vaine do they vvorſhippe me, teaching doctrines and commaundements of men.
label: Matthew

text: And hauing called together the multitudes vnto him, he ſaid to them, Heare ye and vnderſtand.
label: Matthew

text: Not that vvhich entreth into the mouth, defileth a man: but that vvhich procedeth out of the mouth, that defileth a man.
label: Matthew

text: Then came his Diſciples, and ſaid to him, Doeſt thou knovv that the Phariſees, when they heard this vvord, vvere ſcandalized?
label: Matthew

text: But he anſvvering ſayd: All planting vvhich my heauenly father hath not planted, ſhal be rooted vp.
label: Matthew

text: Let them alone: blinde they are, guides of the blinde. And if the blinde be guide to the blinde, both fall into the ditch.
label: Matthew

text: And Peter anſwering ſayd to him, Expound vs this parable.
label: Matthew

text: But he ſayd, Are you alſo as yet vvithout vnderſtanding?
label: Matthew

text: Do you not vnderſtand, that al that entreth into the mouth, goeth into the belly, and is caſt forth into the priuy?
label: Matthew

text: But the things that proceede out of the mouth, come forth from the hart, and thoſe things defile a man.
label: Matthew

text: For from the hart come forth euil cogitations, murders, aduoutries, fornications, thefts, falſe teſtimonies, blaſphemies.
label: Matthew

text: Theſe are the things that defile a man. but to eate vvith vnvvaſhen hands, doeth not defile a man. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS vvent forth from thence and retired into the quarters of Tyre and Sidon.
label: Matthew

text: And behold a vvoman of Chanaan came forth out of thoſe coaſtes, and crying out, ſayd to him, Haue mercie vpon me, O lord the Sonne of Dauid: my daughter is ſore vexed of a Deuil.
label: Matthew

text: VVho anſvvered her not a word. And his Diſciples came and beſought him ſaying, Dimiſſe her: becauſe ſhe crieth out after vs:
label: Matthew

text: And he anſvvering ſaid: I was not ſent but to the ſheepe that are loſt of the houſe of Iſrael.
label: Matthew

text: But ſhe came and adored him, ſaying, Lord, help me.
label: Matthew

text: Who anſvvering, ſaid: It is not good to take the bread of the Children, and to caſt it to the dogges.
label: Matthew

text: But ſhe ſaid, Yea lord: for the vvhelpes alſo eate of the crummes that fal from the table of their maiſters.
label: Matthew

text: Then IESVS anſvvering ſaid to her, O vvoman, great is thy faith: be it done to thee as thou vvilt: and her daughter was made hole from that houre. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And when IESVS vvas paſſed from thence, he came beſide the ſea of Galilee: and aſcending into the mountaine, ſate there.
label: Matthew

text: And there came to him great multitudes, hauing with them dumme perſons, blinde, lame, feeble, and many others: and they caſt them dovvne at his feete, and he cured them:
label: Matthew

text: ſo that the multitudes marueled ſeeing the dumme ſpeake, the lame vvalke, the blinde ſee: and they magnified the God of Iſrael.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS called together his Diſciples, and ſaid: I pitie the multitude: becauſe three dayes novv they continue vvith me, and haue not vvhat to eate: and dimiſſe them faſting I vvil not, leſt they fainte in the vvay.
label: Matthew

text: And the diſciples ſay vnto him: vvhence then may vve gette ſo many loaues in the deſert as to fil ſo great a multitude?
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſayd to them, Hovv many loaues haue you? but they ſayd, Seuen, & a fevv litle fiſhes.
label: Matthew

text: And he commaunded the multitude to ſit dovvne vpon the ground.
label: Matthew

text: And taking the ſeuen loaues & the fiſhes, and geuing thankes, he brake, & gaue to his diſciples, and the diſciples gaue to the people.
label: Matthew

text: And they did al eate, and had their fill. And that vvhich vvas left of the fragments they tooke vp, ſeuen baſkets ful.
label: Matthew

text: And there vvere that did eate, foure thouſand men, beſide children & women.
label: Matthew

text: And hauing dimiſſed the multitude, he vvent vp into a boate, and came into the coaſtes of Magedan.
label: Matthew

text: AND there came to him the Phariſees and Sadducees tempting: and they demaunded him to ſhevv them a ſigne from heauen.
label: Matthew

text: But he anſwered & ſaid to them, When it is euening, you ſay, It vvil be faire-wether, for the element is redde.
label: Matthew

text: And in the morning, This day there vvil be a tempeſt, for the element doth glovve and lovvre. The face therfore of the element you haue ſkil to diſcerne: and the ſignes of times can you not?
label: Matthew

text: The naughtie and aduouterous generation ſeeketh for a ſigne: and there ſhal not a ſigne be giuen it, but the ſigne of Ionas the Prophet. And he left them and vvent avvay.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen his diſciples vvere come ouer the vvater, they forgot to take bread.
label: Matthew

text: Who ſaid to them, Looke vvel and bevvare of the leauen of the Phariſees & Sadducees.
label: Matthew

text: But they thought vvithin them ſelues ſaying, Becauſe we tooke not bread.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS knovving it, ſaid, Why do you thinke vvithin your ſelues O ye of litle faith, for that you haue not bread?
label: Matthew

text: Do you not yet vnderſtand, neither do you remember the fiue loaues among fiue thouſand men, and how many baſkets you tooke vp?
label: Matthew

text: neither the ſeuen loaues, among foure thouſand men, and hovv many maundes you tooke vp?
label: Matthew

text: Why do you not vnderſtand that I ſaid not of bread to you, Bevvare of the leauen of the Phariſees & Sadducees?
label: Matthew

text: Then they vnderſtoode that he ſaid not they ſhould bevvare of the leauen of bread, but of the doctrine of the Phariſees and Sadducees.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS came into the quarters of Cæſarea Philippi: and he aſked his diſciples, ſaying, Whom ſay men that the Sonne of man is?
label: Matthew

text: But they ſaid, Some Iohn the Baptiſt, & otherſome Elias, and others Hieremie, or one of the Prophets.
label: Matthew

text: IESVS ſaith to them, But vvhom do you ſay that I am?
label: Matthew

text: Simon Peter anſvvered & ſaid, Thou art Chriſt the ſonne of the liuing God.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS anſvvering, ſaid to him, Bleſſed art thou Simon bar-Iona: becauſe fleſh & bloud hath not reuealed it to thee, but my father vvhich is in heauen.
label: Matthew

text: And I ſay to thee, That thou art Peter: and vpon this Rocke vvil I build my Church, and the gates of hel ſhal not preuaile againſt it.
label: Matthew

text: And I vvil giue to thee the keies of the kingdom of heauen. And vvhatſoeuer thou ſhalt binde vpon earth, it ſhal be bound alſo in the heauens: and whatſoeuer thou ſhalt looſe in earth, it ſhall be looſed alſo in the heauens. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Then he commaunded his diſciples that they ſhould tel no body that he vvas IESVS CHRIST.
label: Matthew

text: From that time IESVS began to ſhevv his diſciples, that he muſt goe to Hieruſalem, & ſuffer many things of the Ancients & Scribes & cheefe-Prieſtes, and be killed, and the third day riſe againe.
label: Matthew

text: And Peter taking him vnto him, began to rebuke him, ſaying, Lord, be it farre from thee, this ſhal not be vnto thee.
label: Matthew

text: Who turning ſaid to Peter, Goe after me Satan, thou art a ſcandal vnto me: becauſe thou ſauoureſt not the things that are of God, but the things that are of men.
label: Matthew

text: Then IESVS ſaid to his diſciples, If any man wil come after me, let him denie him ſelf, and take vp his croſſe, and follow me.
label: Matthew

text: For he that will ſaue his life, ſhal loſe it. and he that ſhal loſe his life for me, ſhal finde it.
label: Matthew

text: For what doth it profite a man, if he gaine the vvhole vvorld, and ſuſtaine the damage of his ſoule? Or vvhat permutation ſhal a man giue for his ſoule?
label: Matthew

text: For the Sonne of man ſhal come in the glorie of his father with his Angels: and then vvil he render to euery man according to his vvorkes. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Amen I ſay to you, there be ſome of them that ſtand here, that ſhal not taſte death, til they ſee the Sonne of man comming in his kingdom.
label: Matthew

text: AND after ſix dayes IESVS taketh vnto him Peter and Iames and Iohn his brother, and bringeth them into a high mountaine apart:
label: Matthew

text: And he vvas transfigured before them. And his face did ſhine as the ſunne: & his garments became vvhite as ſnow.
label: Matthew

text: And behold there appeared to them Moyſes and Elias talking vvith him.
label: Matthew

text: And Peter anſvvering, ſaid to IESVS, Lord, it is good for vs to be here: if thou vvilt, let vs make here three tabernacles, one for thee, and one for Moyſes, and one for Elias.
label: Matthew

text: And as he vvas yet ſpeaking, behold a bright cloude ouerſhadovved them. And loe a voice out of the cloude, ſaying. This is my vvelbeloued ſonne, in vvhom I am vvel pleaſed: heare ye him.
label: Matthew

text: And the diſciples hearing it, fel vpon their face, and vvere ſore afraid.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS came and touched them: and he ſaid to them, Ariſe, and feare not.
label: Matthew

text: And they lifting vp their eyes, ſavv no body, but only IESVS.
label: Matthew

text: And as they deſcended from the mount, IESVS commaunded them, ſaying, Tel the viſion to no body, til the Sonne of man be riſen from the dead. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And his Diſciples aſked him, ſaying, What ſay the Scribes then, that Elias muſt come firſt?
label: Matthew

text: But he anſvvering, ſaid to them, Elias in deede ſhal come, and reſtore al things.
label: Matthew

text: And I ſay to you, that Elias is already come, and they did not knovv him, but vvrought on him vvhatſoeuer they vvould. So alſo the Sonne of man ſhal ſuffer of them.
label: Matthew

text: Then the Diſciples vnderſtoode, that of Iohn the Baptiſt he had ſpoken to them.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen he vvas come vnto the multitude, there came to him a man falling dovvne vpon his knees before him,
label: Matthew

text: ſaying, Lord haue mercie vpon my ſonne, for he is lunatike, and ſore vexed: for he falleth often into the fire, and often into the vvater.
label: Matthew

text: and I offered him to thy Diſciples: and they could not cure him.
label: Matthew

text: IESVS anſvvered and ſaid, O faithles and peruerſe generation, hovv long ſhal I be vvith you? How long ſhal I ſuffer you? bring him hither to me.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS rebuked him, and the deuil vvent out of him, and the ladde vvas cured from that houre.
label: Matthew

text: Then came the Diſciples to IESVS ſecretely, and ſaid, Why could not we caſt him out?
label: Matthew

text: IESVS ſaid to them, becauſe of your incredulity. for, amen I ſay to you, if you haue faith as a muſtard ſeede, you ſhal ſay to this mountaine, Remoue from hence thither: and it ſhal remoue, and nothing ſhal be impoſſible to you.
label: Matthew

text: But this kinde is not caſt out but by prayer and faſting.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen they conuerſed in Galilee, IESVS ſaid to them, The Sonne of man is to be betraied into the hands of men:
label: Matthew

text: and they ſhal kil him, and the third day he ſhal riſe againe. And they vvere ſtroken ſadde excedingly.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen they vvere come to Capharnaum, there came they that receiued the didrachmes, vnto Peter, and ſaid to him, Your maiſter doth he not pay the didrachmes?
label: Matthew

text: He ſaith, Yes. And vvhen he vvas entered into the houſe, IESVS preuented him, ſaying, What is thy opinion Simon? The kings of the earth of vvhom receiue they tribute or cenſe? of their children, or of ſtrangers?
label: Matthew

text: And he ſaid, Of ſtrangers. IESVS ſaid to him, Then the children are free.
label: Matthew

text: But that vve may not ſcandalize them, goe thy vvaies to the ſea, and caſt a hooke: and that fiſh vvhich ſhal firſt come vp, take: and vvhen thou haſt opened his mouth, thou ſhalt find a ſtater: take that, and giue it them for me and thee.
label: Matthew

text: AT that houre the Diſciples came to IESVS, ſaying. Who, thinkeſt thou, is the greater in the kingdom of heauen?
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS calling vnto him a litle childe, ſet him in the middes of them,
label: Matthew

text: and ſaid, Amen I ſay to you, vnles you be conuerted, and become as litle children, you ſhal not enter into the kingdom of heauen.
label: Matthew

text: VVhoſoeuer therfore ſhal humble him ſelf as this litle childe, he is the greater in the kingdom of heauen.
label: Matthew

text: And he that ſhal receiue one ſuch litle childe in my name, receiueth me.
label: Matthew

text: And he that ſhal ſcandalize one of theſe litle ones that beleeue in me, it is expedient for him that a milſtone be hanged about his necke, and that he be drovvned in the depth of the ſea.
label: Matthew

text: VVo be to the vvorld for ſcandals. for it is neceſſary that ſcandals do come: but neuertheleſſe vvo to that man by vvhom the ſcandall commeth.
label: Matthew

text: And if thy hand, or thy foote ſcandalize thee: cut it of, and caſt it from thee. It is good for thee to goe in to life maimed or lame, rather then hauing tvvo hands or tvvo feete to be caſt into euerlaſting fire.
label: Matthew

text: And if thine eye ſcandalize thee, plucke him out, and caſt him from thee: It is good for thee hauing one eye to enter into life, rather then hauing tvvo eyes to be caſt into the hel of fire.
label: Matthew

text: See that you deſpiſe not one of theſe litle ones: for I ſay to you that their Angels, in heauen alvvaies do ſee the face of my father vvhich is in heauen.
label: Matthew

text: For the Sonne of man is come to ſaue that vvhich vvas periſhed.
label: Matthew

text: Hovv thinke you? If a man haue an hundred ſheepe, and one of them ſhal goe aſtray: doth he not leaue ninetie nine in the mountaines, and goeth to ſeeke that which is ſtraied?
label: Matthew

text: And if it chaunce that he finde it: amen I ſay to you, that he reioyceth more fore that, then for the ninetie nine that vvent not aſtray.
label: Matthew

text: Euen ſo it is not the vvil of your father, vvhich is in heauen, that one periſh of theſe litle ones.
label: Matthew

text: But if thy brother ſhal offend againſt thee, goe, and rebuke him betvvene thee and him alone. If he ſhal heare thee, thou ſhalt gaine thy brother.
label: Matthew

text: And if he vvil not heare thee, ioyne vvith thee beſides, one or tvvo: that in the mouth of tvvo or three vvitneſſes euery vvord may ſtand.
label: Matthew

text: And if he vvil not heare them, tel the Church. And if he vvil not heare the Church, let him be to thee as the heathen and the Publican.
label: Matthew

text: Amen I ſay to you, whatſoeuer you ſhal binde vpon earth, ſhal be bound alſo in heauen: and vvhatſoeuer you ſhal looſe vpon earth, ſhal be looſed alſo in heauen.
label: Matthew

text: Againe I ſay to you, that if two of you ſhal conſent vpon earth, concerning euery thing vvhatſoeuer they ſhal aſke, it ſhal be done to them of my father vvhich is in heauen.
label: Matthew

text: For vvhere there be tvvo or three gathered in my name, there am I in the middes of them.
label: Matthew

text: Then came Peter vnto him and ſaid, Lord, how often ſhal my brother offend againſt me, and I forgiue him? vntil ſeuentimes?
label: Matthew

text: IESVS ſaid to him, I ſay not to thee vntil ſeuen times: but vntil ſeuentie times ſeuen times. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Therfore is the kingdom of heauen likened to a man being a king, that vvould make an account vvith his ſeruants.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen he began to make the account, there vvas one preſented vnto him that ovved him ten thouſand talents.
label: Matthew

text: And hauing not vvhence to repay it, his lord commaunded that he ſhould be ſold, and his wife and children, and all that he had, and it to be repayed.
label: Matthew

text: But that ſeruant falling dovvne, beſought him, ſaying, Haue patience tovvard me, and I vvil repay thee all.
label: Matthew

text: And the lord of that ſeruant moued vvith pitie, dimiſſed him, and the dette he forgaue him.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen that ſeruant vvas gone forth, he found one of his felovv-ſeruants that did ovve him an hundred pence: and laying hands vpon him thratled him, ſaying, Repay that thou oweſt.
label: Matthew

text: And his felovv ſeruant falling dovvne, beſought him, ſaying, Haue patience tovvard me, and I vvil repay the all.
label: Matthew

text: And he vvould not: but vvent his vvay, and caſt him into priſon, til he repayed the dette.
label: Matthew

text: And his felovv-ſeruants ſeeing vvhat vvas done, vvere very ſorie, and they came, and told their lord al that vvas done.
label: Matthew

text: Then his lord called him: and he ſaid vnto him, Thou vngratious ſeruant, I forgaue thee al the dette becauſe thou beſoughteſt me:
label: Matthew

text: oughteſt not thou therfore alſo to haue mercie vpon thy felow-ſeruant, euen as I had mercie vpon thee?
label: Matthew

text: And his lord being angrie deliuered him to the tormenters, vntil he repayed al the dette.
label: Matthew

text: So alſo ſhal my heauenly father doe to you, if you forgiue not euery one his brother from your hartes. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: AND it came to paſſe, vvhen IESVS had ended theſe vvordes, he departed from Galilee, & came into the coaſtes of Ievvrie beyond Iordan,
label: Matthew

text: and great multitudes folovved him: and he cured them there.
label: Matthew

text: And there came to him the Phariſees tempting him, and ſaying, Is it lavvful for a man to dimiſſe his vvife, for euery cauſe?
label: Matthew

text: Who anſvvering, ſaid to them, Haue ye not read, that he which did `make' from the beginning, made them male and femal? And he ſaid.
label: Matthew

text: For this cauſe, man ſhal leaue father and mother, and ſhal cleaue to his vvife: and they tvvo ſhal be in one fleſh.
label: Matthew

text: Therfore novv they are not two, but one fleſh. That therfore vvhich God hath ioyned together, let not man ſeparate. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: They ſay to him, Why then did Moyſes commaund to giue a bil of diuorce, and to dimiſſe her?
label: Matthew

text: He ſaith to them, Becauſe Moyſes for the hardnes of your hart permitted you to dimiſſe your vviues: but from the beginning it vvas not ſo.
label: Matthew

text: And I ſay to you, that Whoſoeuer ſhal dimiſſe his vvife, but for fornication, and ſhal mary an other, doth committe aduoutrie: and he that ſhal mary her that is dimiſſed, committeth aduoutrie.
label: Matthew

text: His diſciples ſay vnto him, If the caſe of a man vvith his vvife be ſo, it is not expedient to mary.
label: Matthew

text: Who ſaid to them, Not al take this vvord, but they to vvhom it is giuen.
label: Matthew

text: For there are eunuches which vvere borne ſo from their mothers vvombe: and there are eunuches vvhich were made by men: and there are eunuches, vvhich haue gelded them ſelues for the kingdom of heauen. He that can take, let him take. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Then were litle children preſented to him, that he ſhould impoſe hands vpon them & pray. And the diſciples rebuked them.
label: Matthew

text: But IESVS ſaid to them, Suffer the litle children, and ſtay them not from comming vnto me: for the kingdom of heauen is for ſuch.
label: Matthew

text: And when he had impoſed hands vpon them, he departed from thence.
label: Matthew

text: And behold one came and ſaid to him, Good Maiſter, vvhat good ſhal I doe that I may haue life euerlaſting?
label: Matthew

text: Who ſaid to him, What aſkeſt thou me of good? One is good, God. But if thou vvilt enter into life, keepe the commaundements.
label: Matthew

text: He ſaith to him, Which? And IESVS ſaid, Thou ſhalt not murder, Thou ſhalt not committe aduoutrie, Thou ſhalt not ſteale, Thou ſhalt not beare falſe vvitnes,
label: Matthew

text: Honour thy father and thy mother, Thou ſhalt loue thy neighbour as thy ſelf.
label: Matthew

text: The yong man ſaith to him, Al theſe haue I kept from my youth: vvhat is yet vvanting vnto me?
label: Matthew

text: IESVS ſaid to him, If thou vvilt be perfect, goe, ſel the things that thou haſt, & giue to the poore, and thou ſhalt haue treaſure in heauen: and come, folovv me.
label: Matthew

text: And when the yong man had heard this vvord, he vvent avvay ſad: for he had many poſſeſſions.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſaid to his diſciples, Amen I ſay to you, that a rich man ſhal hardely enter into the kingdom of heauen.
label: Matthew

text: And againe I ſay to you, it is eaſier for a camel to paſſe through the eye of a nedle, then for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of heauen.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen they had heard this, the diſciples marueled very much, ſaying, Who then can be ſaued?
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS beholding, ſaid to them. With men this is impoſſible: but vvith God al things are poſſible.
label: Matthew

text: Then Peter anſvvering, ſaid to him, Behold vve haue left al things, & haue folovved thee: vvhat therfore ſhal vve haue?
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſaid to them, Amen I ſay to you, that you vvhich haue folovved me, in the regeneration, when the Sonne of man ſhal ſitte in the ſeate of his maieſtie, you alſo ſhal ſitte vpon tvvelue ſeates, iudging the tvvelue tribes of Iſrael.
label: Matthew

text: And euery one that hath left houſe, or brethren, or ſiſters, or father, or mother, or vvife, or children, or landes for my names ſake: ſhal receiue an hundred fold, and ſhal poſſeſſe life euerlaſting. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And many ſhal be firſt, that are laſt: and laſt, that are firſt.
label: Matthew

text: THE kingdom of heauen is like to a man that is an houſholder vvhich went forth early in the morning to hire vvorkemen into his vineyard.
label: Matthew

text: And hauing made couenant vvith the Workemen for a penie a day, he ſent them into his vineyard.
label: Matthew

text: And going forth about the third houre, he ſavv other ſtanding in the market place idle,
label: Matthew

text: and he ſaid to them, Goe you alſo into the vineyard: and that vvhich ſhal be iuſt, I vvil giue you.
label: Matthew

text: And they vvent their vvay. And againe he vvent forth about the ſixt & the ninth houre: and did likevviſe.
label: Matthew

text: But about the eleuenth houre he vvent forth and found other ſtanding, & he ſaith to them, What ſtand you here al the day idle?
label: Matthew

text: They ſay to him, Becauſe no man hath hired vs. He ſaith to them, Goe you alſo into the vineyard.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen euening vvas come, the lord of the vineyard ſaith to his bailife, Call the vvorkemen, and pay them their hire, beginning from the laſt euen to the firſt.
label: Matthew

text: Therfore vvhen they vvere come that came about the eleuenth houre, they receiued euery one a penie.
label: Matthew

text: But vvhen the firſt alſo came, they thought that they ſhould receiue more: and they alſo receiued euery one a penie.
label: Matthew

text: And receiuing it they murmured againſt the good man of the houſe,
label: Matthew

text: ſaying, Theſe laſt haue continued one houre: and thou haſt made them equal to vs that haue borne the burden of the day and the heates.
label: Matthew

text: But he anſvvering ſaid to one of them, Frende, I doe the no vvrong: didſt thou not couenant vvith me for a penie?
label: Matthew

text: Take that is thine, and goe: I vvil alſo giue to this laſt euen as to thee alſo.
label: Matthew

text: Or, is it not lavvful for me to do that I vvil? is thine eye naught, becauſe I am good?
label: Matthew

text: So ſhal the laſt, be firſt: and the firſt, laſt. For many be called, but fevv elect. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS going vp to Hieruſalem, tooke the tvvelue diſciples ſecretly, and ſaid to them,
label: Matthew

text: Behold vve goe vp to Hieruſalem, and the Sonne of man ſhal be deliuered to the cheefe prieſtes and to the Scribes, and they ſhal condemne him to death,
label: Matthew

text: and ſhal deliuer him to the Gentiles to be mocked, & ſcourged, & crucified, and the third day he ſhal riſe againe. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Then came to him the mother of the ſonnes of Zebedee vvith her ſonnes, adoring and deſiring ſome thing of him.
label: Matthew

text: Who ſaid to her, What wilt thou? She ſaith to him, Say that theſe my tvvo ſonnes may ſitte, one at thy right hand, and one at thy left hand in thy kingdom.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS anſvvering, ſaid, You knovv not vvhat you deſire. Can you drinke of the cuppe that I ſhal drinke of? They ſay to him, We can.
label: Matthew

text: He ſaith to them, My cuppe in deede you ſhal drinke of: but to ſitte at my right hand and left, is not mine to giue to you: but to vvhom it is prepared of my father. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And the ten hearing it, vvere diſpleaſed at the tvvo brethren.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS called them vnto him, and ſaid, You knovv that the princes of the gentiles ouerrule them: and they that are the greater, exerciſe povver againſt them.
label: Matthew

text: It ſhal not be ſo among you. but vvhoſoeuer vvil be the greater among you, let him be your miniſter:
label: Matthew

text: and he that vvil be firſt among you, ſhal be your ſeruant.
label: Matthew

text: Euen as the Sonne of man is not come to be miniſtred vnto, but to miniſter, and to giue his life a redemption for many. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen they vvent out from Iericho, a great multitude folovved him.
label: Matthew

text: And behold tvvo blinde men ſitting by the vvay ſide, heard that IESVS paſſed by, and they cried out ſaying, Lord, haue mercie vpon vs, ſonne of Dauid.
label: Matthew

text: And the multitude rebuked them that they ſhould hold their peace. But they cried out the more, ſaying, Lord, haue mercie vpon vs, ſonne of Dauid.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſtoode, and called them, and ſaid, VVhat vvil ye that I doe to you?
label: Matthew

text: They ſay to him, Lord, that our eies may be opened.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS hauing compaſſion on them, touched their eies. And immediatly they ſavv, and folovved him.
label: Matthew

text: AND vvhen they drevv nigh to Hieruſalem, and vvere come to Beth-phagee vnto Mount-oliuet, then IESVS ſent tvvo diſciples,
label: Matthew

text: ſaying to them, Goe ye into the tovvne that is againſt you, and immediatly you ſhal finde an aſſe tied and a colt vvith her: looſe them & bring them to me:
label: Matthew

text: and if any man ſhal ſay ought vnto you, ſay ye, that our Lord hath neede of them: and forthvvith he vvil let them goe.
label: Matthew

text: And this vvas done that it might be fulfilled vvhich vvas ſpoken by the Prophet, ſaying,
label: Matthew

text: Say ye to the daughter of Sion, Behold thy king commeth to thee, meeke, & ſitting vpon an aſſe and a colt the fole of her that is vſed to the yoke.
label: Matthew

text: And the diſciples going, did as IESVS commaunded them.
label: Matthew

text: And they brought the aſſe and the colt: and laide their garments vpon them, and made him to ſit thereon.
label: Matthew

text: And a very great multitude ſpred their garments in the vvay: and others did cut boughes from the trees, and ſtravved them in the vvay:
label: Matthew

text: and the multitudes that vvent before and that folovved, cried, ſaying, Hoſanna to the ſonne of Dauid: bleſſed is he that commeth in the name of our Lord. ⊢ Hoſanna in the higheſt.
label: Matthew

text: And when he vvas entred Hieruſalem, the vvhole citie vvas moued, ſaying, Who is this?
label: Matthew

text: And the people ſaid, This is IESVS the Prophet, of Nazareth in Galilee.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS entred into the temple of God, and caſt out al that ſold and bought in the temple, and the tables of the bankers, and the chaires of them that ſold pigeons he ouerthrevve:
label: Matthew

text: and he ſaith to them, It is vvritten, My houſe ſhal be called the houſe of prayer: but you haue made it a denne of theeues.
label: Matthew

text: And there came to him the blinde, and the lame in the temple: and he healed them.
label: Matthew

text: And the cheefe prieſtes & Scribes ſeeing the maruelous things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, & ſaying, Hoſanna to the ſonne of Dauid: they had indignation,
label: Matthew

text: and ſaid to him, Heareſt thou vvhat theſe ſay? And IESVS ſaid to them, Very vvel. haue you neuer read, That out of the mouth of infants and ſucklings thou haſt perfited praiſe?
label: Matthew

text: And leauing them, he vvent forth out of the citie into Bethania, and remained there. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And in the morning returning into the citie, he vvas an hungred.
label: Matthew

text: And ſeeing a certaine figtree by the vvay ſide, he came to it: and found nothing on it but leaues only, and he ſaith to it, Neuer grovv there fruite of thee for euer. And incontinent the figtree vvas vvithered.
label: Matthew

text: And the diſciples ſeeing it, marueled ſaying, How is it vvithered incontinent?
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS anſvvering ſaid to them, Amen I ſay to you, if you ſhal haue faith, and ſtagger not, not only that of the figtree ſhal you doe, but and if you ſhal ſay to this mountaine, Take vp and throvv thy ſelf into the ſea, it ſhal be done.
label: Matthew

text: And al things vvhatſoeuer you ſhal aſke in prayer beleeuing, you ſhal receiue.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen he vvas come into the temple, there came to him as he vvas teaching, the cheefe Prieſts and auncients of the people, ſaying, In vvhat povver doeſt thou theſe things? and vvho hath giuen thee this povver?
label: Matthew

text: IESVS anſvvering ſaid to them, I alſo vvil aſke you one vvord: vvhich if you ſhal tell me, I alſo vvil tel you in vvhat povver I doe theſe things.
label: Matthew

text: The Baptiſme of Iohn vvhence vvas it? from heauen, or from men? But they thought vvithin them ſelues, ſaying,
label: Matthew

text: If vve ſhal ſay from heauen, he vvil ſay to vs, vvhy then did you not beleeue him? but if vve ſhal ſay from men: vve feare the multitude. for al hold Iohn as a Prophet.
label: Matthew

text: And anſvvering to IESVS they ſaid, We know not. He alſo ſaid to them, Neither do I tel you in vvhat povver I doe theſe things.
label: Matthew

text: But vvhat is your opinion? A certaine man had tvvo ſonnes: and comming to the firſt, he ſaid, Sonne, goe vvorke to day in my vineyard.
label: Matthew

text: And he anſwering, ſaid, I wil not. But aftervvard moued vvith repentance he vvent.
label: Matthew

text: And comming to the other, he ſaid likevviſe. And he anſvvering, ſaid, I goe Lord, and he vvent not.
label: Matthew

text: VVhich of the tvvo did the fathers vvil? They ſay to him, The firſt. IESVS ſaith to them, Amen I ſay to you, that the Publicans and vvhoores goe before you into the kingdom of God.
label: Matthew

text: For Iohn came to you in the vvay of iuſtice: and you did not beleeue him. but the publicans and vvhoores did beleeue him: but you ſeeing it, neither haue ye had repentance aftervvard, to beleeue him.
label: Matthew

text: An other parable heare ye: A man there vvas an houſholder vvho planted a vineyard, and made a hedge round about it, and digged in it a preſſe, and builded a tovvre, and let it out to huſbandmen: and vvent forth into a ſtrange countrie.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen the time of fruites drevve nigh, he ſent his ſeruants to the huſbandmen, to receiue the fruites thereof.
label: Matthew

text: And the huſbandmen apprehending his ſeruants, one they beat, an other they killed, and an other they ſtoned.
label: Matthew

text: Againe he ſent other ſeruants moe then the former: and they did to them likevviſe.
label: Matthew

text: And laſt of al he ſent to them his ſonne, ſaying, They vvil reuerence my ſonne.
label: Matthew

text: But the huſbandmen ſeeing the ſonne, ſaid vvithin them ſelues, This is the heire, come, let vs kil him, and vve ſhal haue his inheritaunce.
label: Matthew

text: And apprehending him they caſt him forth out of the vineyard, and killed him.
label: Matthew

text: When therfore the lord of the vineyard ſhal come, vvhat vvil he doe to thoſe huſbandmen?
label: Matthew

text: They ſay to him, The naughtie men he vvil bring to naught: and his vineyard he vvil let out to other huſbandmen, that ſhal render him the fruite in their ſeaſons.
label: Matthew

text: IESVS ſaith to them, Haue you neuer read in the Scriptures, The ſtone which the builders reiected, the ſame is made into the head of the corner? By our lord was this done, and it is maruelous in our eyes.
label: Matthew

text: Therfore I ſay to you, that the kingdom of God ſhal be taken avvay from you, and ſhal be giuen to a nation yelding the fruites thereof.
label: Matthew

text: And he that falleth vpon this ſtone, ſhal be broken: and on whom it falleth, it ſhal al to bruiſe him.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen the cheefe Prieſtes and Phariſees had heard his parables, they knevve that he ſpake of them.
label: Matthew

text: And ſeeking to lay hands vpon him, they feared the multitudes: becauſe they held him as a Prophet. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: AND IESVS anſvvering, ſpake againe in parables to them, ſaying:
label: Matthew

text: The kingdom of heauen is likened to a man being a king, vvhich made a mariage to his ſonne.
label: Matthew

text: And he ſent his ſeruants to call them that vvere inuited to the mariage: and they vvould not come.
label: Matthew

text: Againe he ſent other ſeruants, ſaying, Tel them that vvere inuited, Behold I haue prepared my dinner: my beeues and fatlings are killed, and al things are ready: come ye to the mariage.
label: Matthew

text: But they neglected: and vvent their vvaies, one to his farme, and an other to his merchandiſe:
label: Matthew

text: and the reſt laid hands vpon his ſeruants, and ſpitefully intreating them, murdered them.
label: Matthew

text: But vvhen the king had heard of it, he vvas vvroth, and ſending his hoſtes, deſtroied thoſe murderers, and burnt their citie.
label: Matthew

text: Then he ſaith to his ſeruants, The mariage in deede is ready: but they that vvere inuited, vvere not vvorthie.
label: Matthew

text: Goe ye therfore into the high vvayes: and vvhoſoeuer you ſhal finde, call to the mariage.
label: Matthew

text: And his ſeruants going forth into the vvayes, gathered together al that they found, bad and good: and the mariage vvas filled vvith gheſtes.
label: Matthew

text: And the king vvent in to ſee the gheſtes: and he ſavv there a man not attired in a vvedding garment.
label: Matthew

text: And he ſaith to him, Frende, hovv cameſt thou in hither not hauing a vvedding garment? But he vvas dumme.
label: Matthew

text: Then the king ſaid to the vvaiters, Binde his hands and feete, and caſt him into the vtter darkenes: there ſhal be vveeping & gnaſhing of teeth.
label: Matthew

text: For many be called, but fevv elect. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Then the Phariſees departing, conſulted among them ſelues for to entrappe him in his talke.
label: Matthew

text: And they ſend to him their diſciples vvith the Herodians, ſaying, Maiſter, vve knovv that thou art a true ſpeaker, and teacheſt the vvay of God in truth, neither careſt thou for any man. for thou doeſt not reſpect the perſon of men:
label: Matthew

text: tel vs therfore vvhat is thy opinion, is it lawful to giue tribute to Cæſar, or not?
label: Matthew

text: But IESVS knovving their naughtines, ſaid, What do you tempt me Hypocrites?
label: Matthew

text: Shevv me the tribute coine. And they offred him a penie.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſaith to them, Whoſe is this image and ſuperſcription?
label: Matthew

text: They ſay to him, Cæſars. Then he ſaith to them, Render therfore the things that are Cæſars, to Cæſar: and the things that are Gods, to God.
label: Matthew

text: And hearing it they marueled, and leauing him vvent their vvaies.
label: Matthew

text: That day there came to him the Sadducees, that ſay there is no reſurrection: and aſked him,
label: Matthew

text: ſaying, Maiſter, Moyſes ſaid, If a man die not hauing a childe, that his brother marie his wife, and raiſe vp ſeede to his brother.
label: Matthew

text: And there vvere vvith vs ſeuen brethren: and the firſt hauing maried a wife, died: and not hauing iſſue, left his vvife to his brother.
label: Matthew

text: In like maner the ſecond and the third euen to the ſeuenth.
label: Matthew

text: And laſt of al the vvoman died alſo.
label: Matthew

text: In the reſurrection therfore vvhoſe vvife of the ſeuen ſhal ſhe be? for they al had her.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS anſwering, ſaid to them, You do erre, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the povver of God.
label: Matthew

text: For in the reſurrection neither ſhal they marie nor be maried: but are as the Angels of God in heauen.
label: Matthew

text: And concerning the reſurrection of the dead, haue you not read that vvich vvas ſpoken of God ſaying to you,
label: Matthew

text: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Iſaac, and the God of Iacob? He is not God of the dead, but of the liuing.
label: Matthew

text: And the multitudes hearing it, marueled at his doctrine.
label: Matthew

text: But the Phariſees hearing that he had put the Sadducees to ſilence, came together:
label: Matthew

text: and one of them a doctor of law aſked of him, tempting him,
label: Matthew

text: Maiſter, vvhich is the great commaundement in the lavv?
label: Matthew

text: IESVS ſaid to him, Thou ſhalt loue the lord thy God from thy whole hart, and with thy whole ſoul, and with thy whole minde.
label: Matthew

text: This is the greateſt and the firſt commaundement.
label: Matthew

text: And the ſecond is like to this, Thou ſhalt loue thy neighbour as thyſelf.
label: Matthew

text: On theſe tvvo commaundements dependeth the vvhole Lavv and the Prophets.
label: Matthew

text: And the Phariſees being aſſembled, IESVS aſked them
label: Matthew

text: ſaying, What is your opinion of Chriſt? Whoſe ſonne is he? They ſay to him, Dauids.
label: Matthew

text: He ſaith to them, Hovv then doth Dauid in ſpirit cal him Lord, ſaying,
label: Matthew

text: The Lord ſaid to my Lord, ſitte on my right hand, vntil I put thine enemies the foote ſtole of thy feete?
label: Matthew

text: If Dauid therfore call him Lord, how is he his ſonne?
label: Matthew

text: And no man could anſvver him a vvord: neither durſt any man from that day aſke him any more. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: THEN IESVS ſpake to the multitudes and to his diſciples,
label: Matthew

text: ſaying, Vpon the chaire of Moyſes haue ſitten the Scribes and the Phariſees.
label: Matthew

text: Al things therfore vvhatſoeuer they ſhal ſay to you, obſerue ye and doe ye: but according to their vvorkes doe ye not, for they ſay and doe not.
label: Matthew

text: For they binde heauy burdens & importable: and put them vpon mens ſhoulders: but vvith a finger of their ovvne they vvil not moue them.
label: Matthew

text: But they doe al their vvorkes, for to be ſeen of men. for they make brode their phylacteries, and enlarge their fringes.
label: Matthew

text: And they loue the firſt places at ſuppers, and the firſt chaires in the Synagogs,
label: Matthew

text: and ſalutations in the market-place, and to be called of men, Rabbi.
label: Matthew

text: But be not you called Rabbi. for one is your maiſter, and al you are brethren.
label: Matthew

text: And call none father to your ſelf vpon earth: for one is your father, he that is in heauen.
label: Matthew

text: Neither be ye called maiſters: for one is your maiſter, Chriſt.
label: Matthew

text: He that is the greater of you, ſhal be your ſeruiteur.
label: Matthew

text: And he that exalteth him ſelf, ſhal be humbled: and he that humbleth him ſelf, ſhal be exalted. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: But vvo to you Scribes & Phariſees, hypocrites: becauſe you ſhut the kingdom of heauen before men. For your ſelues do not enter in: & thoſe that are going in, you ſuffer not to enter.
label: Matthew

text: Wo to you Scribes and Phariſees, hypocrites: becauſe you deuoure vvidovves houſes, praying long prayers. for this you ſhal receiue the greater iudgement.
label: Matthew

text: Wo to you Scribes and Phariſees, hypocrites: becauſe you goe round about the ſea and the land, to make one proſelyte: and vvhen he is made, you make him the childe of hel double more then your ſelues.
label: Matthew

text: Wo to you blinde guides, that ſay, Whoſoeuer ſhal ſvveare by the temple, it is nothing: but he that ſhal ſvveare by the gold of the temple, is bound.
label: Matthew

text: Ye fooliſh and blinde, for vvhether is greater, the gold, or the temple that ſanctifieth the gold?
label: Matthew

text: And vvhoſoeuer ſhal ſvveare by the altar, it is nothing: but vvhoſoeuer ſhal ſweare by the gift that is vpon it, is bound.
label: Matthew

text: Ye blinde, for vvhether is greater, the gift, or the altar that ſanctifieth the gift?
label: Matthew

text: He therfore that ſweareth by the altar, ſweareth by it and by al things that are vpon it:
label: Matthew

text: and vvhoſoeuer ſhal ſvveare by the temple, ſweareth by it and by him that dvvelleth in it:
label: Matthew

text: and he that ſweareth by heauen, ſvveareth by the throne of God & by him that ſitteth thereon.
label: Matthew

text: Wo to you Scribes and Phariſees, hypocrites: becauſe you tithe mint, and aniſe, and cummin, and haue left the vveightier things of the lavv, iudgement, and mercie, and faith. theſe things you ought to haue done, & not to haue omitted thoſe.
label: Matthew

text: Blinde guides, that ſtraine a gnat, and ſwallow a camel.
label: Matthew

text: Wo to you Scribes and Phariſees, hypocrites: becauſe you make cleane that on the outſide of the cuppe and diſh: but vvithin `you are ful' of rapine and vncleannes.
label: Matthew

text: Thou blinde Phariſee, firſt make cleane the inſide of the cuppe and the diſh, that the outſide may become cleane.
label: Matthew

text: Wo to you Scribes and Phariſees, hypocrites: becauſe you are like to vvhited ſepulchres, vvhich outvvardly appeare vnto men beautiful, but vvithin are ful of dead mens bones, and al filthines.
label: Matthew

text: So you alſo outvvardly in deede appeare to men iuſt: but invvardly you are ful of hypocriſie and iniquitie.
label: Matthew

text: Wo to you Scribes and Phariſees, ye hypocrites: becauſe you build the Prophets ſepulchres, and garniſh the moniments of iuſt men,
label: Matthew

text: and ſay: If we had been in our fathers dayes, vve had not been their felovves in the bloud of the Prophets.
label: Matthew

text: Therefore you are a teſtimonie to your ovvne ſelues, that you are the ſonnes of them that killed the Prophets.
label: Matthew

text: And fil you vp the meaſure of your fathers.
label: Matthew

text: You ſerpents, vipers broodes, hovv vvil you flee from the iudgement of hel?
label: Matthew

text: Therfore behold I ſend vnto you Prophets and vviſe men and ſcribes, and of them you ſhal kil & crucifie, and of them you ſhal ſcourge in your Synagogs, and perſecute from citie into citie:
label: Matthew

text: that vpon you may come al the iuſt bloud that vvas ſhed vpon the earth, from the bloud of Abel the iuſt euen vnto the bloud of Zacharias the ſonne of Barachias,vvhom you murdered betvvene the temple and the altar.
label: Matthew

text: Amen I ſay to you, al theſe things ſhal come vpon this generation.
label: Matthew

text: Hieruſalem, Hieruſalem, vvhich killeſt the Prophets, and ſtoneſt them that vvere ſent to thee, hovv often vvould I gather together thy children as the henne doth gather together her chickens vnder her vvinges, and thou vvouldeſt not?
label: Matthew

text: Behold, your houſe ſhal be left deſert to you.
label: Matthew

text: For I ſay to you, you ſhal not ſee me from hence forth til you ſay, Bleſſed is he that commeth in the name of our Lord. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: AND IESVS being gone out of the temple, vvent. And his diſciples came to ſhevv him the buildings of the temple.
label: Matthew

text: And he anſwering ſaid to them, Do you ſee al theſe things? Amen I ſay to you, there ſhal not be left here a ſtone vpon a ſtone that ſhal not be deſtroied.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen he vvas ſitting vpon Mount-oliuet, the diſciples came to him ſecretly, ſaying: Tel vs, vvhen ſhal theſe things be? and vvhat ſhal be the ſigne of thy comming, and of the conſummation of the vvorld?
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS anſvvering, ſaid to them, Bevvare that no man ſeduce you:
label: Matthew

text: for many ſhal come in my name ſaying, I am Chriſt: and they ſhal ſeduce many.
label: Matthew

text: For you ſhal heare of vvarres, & bruites of vvarres. See that ye be not troubled. for theſe things muſt be done: but the end is not yet.
label: Matthew

text: for nation ſhal riſe againſt nation, and kingdom againſt kingdom: and there ſhal be peſtilences, and famines, and earth-quakes in places,
label: Matthew

text: and al theſe things are the beginnings of ſorovves. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: Then ſhal they deliuer you into tribulation, and ſhal kil you: and you ſhal be odious to al nations for my names ſake.
label: Matthew

text: And then many ſhal be ſcandalized: and they ſhal deliuer vp one an other: and they ſhal hate one an other.
label: Matthew

text: And many falſeprophets ſhal riſe: and ſhal ſeduce many.
label: Matthew

text: And becauſe iniquitie ſhal abound: the charitie of many ſhal waxe cold.
label: Matthew

text: But he that ſhal perſeuêre to the end, he ſhal be ſaued. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And this Goſpel of the kingdom ſhal be preached in the vvhole vvorld, for a teſtimonie to al nations, and then ſhal come the conſummation.
label: Matthew

text: Therfore vvhen you ſhal ſee the abomination of deſolation, vvhich vvas ſpoken of by Daniel the Prophet, ſtanding in the holy place (he that readeth, let him vnderſtand)
label: Matthew

text: then they that are in Ievvrie, let them flee to the mountaines:
label: Matthew

text: and he that is on the houſe-toppe, let him not come dovvne to take any thing out of his houſe:
label: Matthew

text: and he that is in the field, let him not goe backe to take his coate.
label: Matthew

text: And vvo to thē that are vvith childe, and that giue ſucke in thoſe dayes.
label: Matthew

text: But pray that your flight be not in the vvinter or on the Sabboth.
label: Matthew

text: For there ſhal be then great tribulation, ſuch as hath not been from the beginning of the vvorld vntil novv, neither ſhal be.
label: Matthew

text: And vnles thoſe daies had been ſhortened, no fleſh ſhould be ſaued: but for the elect the daies ſhal be ſhortened.
label: Matthew

text: Then if any man ſhal ſay vnto you, Loe here is Chriſt, or there: do not beleeue him.
label: Matthew

text: For there ſhal riſe falſe-Chriſtes and falſe-Prophets, and ſhal ſhevv great ſignes and vvonders, ſo that the elect alſo (if it be poſſible) may be induced into errour.
label: Matthew

text: Loe I haue foretold you.
label: Matthew

text: If therfore they ſhal ſay vnto you, Behold he is in the deſert: goe ye not out: behold in the cloſets, beleeue it not.
label: Matthew

text: For as lightening commeth out of the eaſt, and appeareth euen into the vveſt, ſo ſhal alſo the aduent of the ſonne of man be.
label: Matthew

text: VVhereſoeuer the body is, thither ſhal the egles alſo be gathered together.
label: Matthew

text: And immediatly after the tribulation of thoſe dayes the ſonne ſhal be darkened, and the moone ſhal not giue her light, and the ſtarres ſhal fal from heauen, and the powers of heauen ſhal be moued:
label: Matthew

text: and then ſhal appeare the ſigne of the Sonne of man in heauen: and then ſhal al tribes of the earth bevvaile: and they ſhal ſee the Sonne of man comming in the cloudes of heauen vvith much povver and maieſtie.
label: Matthew

text: And he ſhal ſend his Angels vvith a trumpet, and a great voyce: and they ſhal gather together his elect from the foure vvindes, from the furtheſt partes of heauen euen to the endes thereof.
label: Matthew

text: And of the figtree learne a parable: When novv the bough thereof is tender, and the leaues come forth, you know that ſommer is nigh.
label: Matthew

text: So you alſo, vvhen you ſhal ſee theſe things, knovv ye that it is nigh euen at the doores.
label: Matthew

text: Amen I ſay to you, that this generation ſhal not paſſe, til al theſe things be done.
label: Matthew

text: Heauen and earth ſhal paſſe, but my vvordes ſhal not paſſe. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: But of that day and houre no body knovveth, neither the Angels of heauen, but the Father alone.
label: Matthew

text: And as in the dayes of Noe, ſo ſhal alſo the comming of the Sonne of man be.
label: Matthew

text: For as they vvere in the dayes before the floud, eating and drinking, marying and giuing to mariage, euen vnto that day in which Noe entred into the arke,
label: Matthew

text: and knevve not til the floud came, and tooke them al: ſo alſo ſhal the comming of the Sonne of man be.
label: Matthew

text: Then two ſhal be in the field: one ſhal be taken, and one ſhal be left.
label: Matthew

text: tvvo vvomen grinding in the mill: one ſhal be taken, and one ſhal be left.
label: Matthew

text: Watch therfore becauſe you knovv not vvhat houre your Lord vvil come.
label: Matthew

text: But this knovv ye, that if the good man of the houſe did knovv vvhat houre the theefe vvould come, he vvould ſurely vvatch, and vvould not ſuffer his houſe to be broken vp.
label: Matthew

text: Therfore be you alſo ready, becauſe at vvhat houre you knovv not, the Sonne of man vvil come.
label: Matthew

text: Who, thinkeſt thou, is a faithful and vviſe ſeruant, vvhom his lord hath appointed ouer his familie, to giue them meate in ſeaſon?
label: Matthew

text: Bleſſed is that ſeruant, vvhom vvhen his lord commeth, he ſhal finde ſo doing.
label: Matthew

text: Amen I ſay to you, that ouer al his goods ſhal he appoint him. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: But if that naughtie ſeruant ſhal ſay in his hart, My lord is long a comming:
label: Matthew

text: and ſhal beginne to ſtrike his felovv-ſeruants, and eateth, and drinketh vvith drunkards:
label: Matthew

text: the lord of that ſeruant ſhal come in a day that he hopeth not, and an houre that he knovveth not,
label: Matthew

text: and ſhal deuide him, and appoint his portion vvith the hypocrites: there ſhal be vveeping and gnaſhing of teeth.
label: Matthew

text: THEN ſhal the kingdom of heauen be like to ten virgins: which taking their lampes vvent forth to meete the bridegrome and the bride.
label: Matthew

text: And fiue of them were fooliſh, and fiue vviſe.
label: Matthew

text: but the fiue fooliſh, hauing taken their lampes, did not take oile vvith them:
label: Matthew

text: but the vviſe did take oile in their veſſels vvith the lampes.
label: Matthew

text: And the bridegrome tarying long, they ſlumbered all and ſlept.
label: Matthew

text: And at midnight there vvas a clamour made, Behold the bridegrome commeth, goe ye forth to meete him.
label: Matthew

text: Then aroſe al thoſe virgins: and they trimmed their lampes.
label: Matthew

text: And the fooliſh ſaid to the vviſe, Giue vs of your oile: becauſe our lampes are going out.
label: Matthew

text: The vviſe anſvvered, ſaying, Leſt peraduenture there ſuffiſe not for vs and you, goe rather to them that ſel: and bie for your ſelues.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhiles they vvent to bie, the bridegrome vvas come: and they that vvere ready, entred vvith him to the mariage, and the gate vvas ſhut.
label: Matthew

text: But laſt of al come alſo the other virgins, ſaying: Lord, Lord, open to vs.
label: Matthew

text: But he anſvvering ſaid, Amen I ſay to you, I knovv you not.
label: Matthew

text: Watch ye therfore, becauſe you knovv not the day nor the houre. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: For euen as a man going into a ſtrange countrie, called his ſeruants, and deliuered them his goods.
label: Matthew

text: And to one he gaue fiue talents, and to an other tvvo, and to an other one, to euery one according to his propre facultie: and immediatly he tooke his iourney.
label: Matthew

text: And he that had receiued the fiue talents, vvent his vvay, and occupied vvith the ſame, and gained other fiue.
label: Matthew

text: Likevviſe alſo he that had receiued the tvvo, gained other tvvo.
label: Matthew

text: But he that had receiued the one, going his vvay digged into the earth, and hid his lords money.
label: Matthew

text: But after much time the lord of thoſe ſeruants commeth, and made a count vvith them.
label: Matthew

text: And there came he that had receiued the fiue talents, and offred other fiue talents, ſaying, Lord fiue talents thou didſt deliuer me, behold I haue gained other fiue beſides.
label: Matthew

text: His lord ſaid vnto him: Wel fare thee good and faithful ſeruant, becauſe thou haſt been faithful ouer a fevv things, I vvil place thee ouer many things: enter into the ioy of thy lord.
label: Matthew

text: And there came alſo he that had receiued the tvvo talents, and ſaid, Lord tvvo talents thou didſt deliuer me: behold I haue gained other tvvo.
label: Matthew

text: His lord ſaid to him, Wel fare thee good and faithful ſeruant: becauſe thou haſt been faithful ouer a fevv things, I vvil place thee ouer many things, enter into the ioy of thy lord. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: And he alſo that had receiued the one talent, came forth, and ſaid, Lord, I knovv that thou art a hard man, thou reapeſt vvhere thou didſt not ſovv: and gathereſt vvhere thou ſtrawedſt not:
label: Matthew

text: and being afraid I vvent, and hid thy talent in the earth: behold loe here thou haſt that vvhich thine is.
label: Matthew

text: And his lord anſvvering, ſaid to him: Naughtie and ſloughtful ſeruant, thou didſt knovv that I reape vvhere I ſow not, & gather vvhere I ſtravved not:
label: Matthew

text: thou oughteſt therfore to haue committed my money to the bankers, and comming I might haue receiued mine ovvne vvith vſurie.
label: Matthew

text: Take ye avvay therfore the talent from him, and giue it him that hath ten talents.
label: Matthew

text: For to euery one that hath ſhal be giuen, and he ſhal abound: but from him that hath not, that alſo vvhich he ſeemeth to haue, ſhal be taken avvay from him.
label: Matthew

text: And the vnprofitable ſeruant caſt ye out into the vtter darkneſſe. There ſhal be vveeping and gnaſhing of teeth.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen the ſonne of man ſhal come in his maieſtie, and al the Angels vvith him, then ſhal he ſitte vpon the ſeate of his maieſtie:
label: Matthew

text: and al nations ſhal be gathered together before him, and he ſhal ſeparate them one from an other, as the paſtor ſeparateth the ſheepe from the goates:
label: Matthew

text: and ſhal ſet the ſheepe at his right hand, but the goates at his left.
label: Matthew

text: Then ſhal the king ſay to them that ſhal be at his right hand, Come ye bleſſed of my father, poſſeſſe you the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the vvorld.
label: Matthew

text: for I vvas an hungred, and you gaue me to eate: I vvas a thirſt, and you gaue me to drinke.
label: Matthew

text: I vvas a ſtranger, and you tooke me in: naked, and you couered me: ſicke, and you viſited me. I vvas in priſon, and you came to me.
label: Matthew

text: Then ſhal the iuſt anſvver him, ſaying: Lord, vvhen did vve ſee thee an hungred, and fed thee: a thirſt, and gaue thee drinke?
label: Matthew

text: and vvhen did vve ſee thee a ſtranger, and tooke thee in? or naked, and couered thee?
label: Matthew

text: or vvhen did vve ſee thee ſicke or in priſon: and came to thee?
label: Matthew

text: And the king anſvvering, ſhall ſay to them, Amen I ſay to you, as long as you did it to one of theſe my leaſt brethren, you did it to me.
label: Matthew

text: Then he ſhal ſay to them alſo that ſhal be at his left hand, Get ye avvay from me you curſed into fire euerlaſting, vvhich vvas prepared for the Deuil and his angels.
label: Matthew

text: for I vvas an hungred, and you gaue me not to eate: I vvas a thirſt, and you gaue me not to drinke.
label: Matthew

text: I Was a ſtranger, and you tooke me not in: naked, and you couered me not: ſicke, and in priſon, and you did not viſite me.
label: Matthew

text: Then they alſo ſhall anſvver him, ſaying, Lord, vvhen did vve ſee thee an hungred, or a thirſt, or a ſtranger, or naked, or ſicke, or in priſon: and did not miniſter to thee?
label: Matthew

text: Then he ſhal anſvver them, ſaying, Amen I ſay to you, as long as you did it not to one of theſe leſſer, neither did you it to me.
label: Matthew

text: And theſe ſhal goe into puniſhment euerlaſting: but the iuſt, into life euerlaſting. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: AND it came to paſſe, when IESVS had ended al theſe vvordes, he ſaid to his Diſciples,
label: Matthew

text: You knovv that after tvvo dayes ſhal be Paſche, and the Sonne of man ſhal be deliuered to be crucified.
label: Matthew

text: Then vvere gathered together the cheefe Prieſtes and auncients of the people into the court of the high prieſt, vvho vvas called Caiphas:
label: Matthew

text: and they conſulted hovv they might by ſome vvile apprehend IESVS, and kil him.
label: Matthew

text: But they ſaid, Not on the feſtiual day, leſt perhaps there might be a tumult among the people.
label: Matthew

text: And when IESVS vvas in Bethania in the houſe of Simon the Leper,
label: Matthew

text: there came to him a vvoman hauing an alabaſter-boxe of pretious ointment, and povvred it out vpon his head as he ſate at the table.
label: Matthew

text: And the Diſciples ſeeing it, had indignation ſaying, Whereto is this vvaſt?
label: Matthew

text: for this might haue been ſold for much, and giuen to the poore.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS knovving it, ſaid to them: Why do you moleſt this vvoman? for ſhe hath vvrought a good vvorke vpon me.
label: Matthew

text: For the poore you haue alvvayes vvith you: but me you haue not alvvayes.
label: Matthew

text: For ſhe in povvring this ointment vpon my body: hath done it to burie me.
label: Matthew

text: Amen I ſay to you, vvhereſoeuer this Goſpel ſhal be preached in the vvhole vvorld, that alſo vvhich ſhe hath done, ſhal be reported for a memorie of her.
label: Matthew

text: Then went one of the Tvvelue, vvhich vvas called Iudas Iſcarioth, to the cheefe Prieſtes,
label: Matthew

text: and ſaid to them, What vvil you giue me, and I vvil deliuer him vnto you? But they appointed vnto him thirtie peeces of ſiluer.
label: Matthew

text: And from thenceforth he ſought opportunitie to betray him.
label: Matthew

text: And the firſt day of the Azymes the Diſciples came to IESVS, ſaying, Where vvilt thou that vve prepare for thee to eate the Paſche?
label: Matthew

text: But IESVS ſaid, Goe ye into the citie to a certaine man: and ſay to him, The Maiſter ſaith, My time is at hand, vvith thee do I make the Paſche vvith my Diſciples.
label: Matthew

text: And the Diſciples did as IESVS appointed them, and they prepared the Paſche.
label: Matthew

text: But vvhen it vvas euen, he ſate downe vvith his tvvelue Diſciples.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhile they vvere eating, he ſaid: Amen I ſay to you, that one of you ſhal betray me.
label: Matthew

text: And they being very ſad, began euery one to ſay, Is it I Lord?
label: Matthew

text: But he anſvvering ſaid, He that dippeth his hand vvith me in the diſh, he ſhal betray me.
label: Matthew

text: The Sonne of man in deede goeth as it is vvritten of him: but vvo be to that man, by vvhom the Sonne of man ſhal be betrayed. It vvere good for him, if that man had not been borne.
label: Matthew

text: And Iudas that betrayed him, anſvvering ſaid, Is it I Rabbi? He ſaith to him, Thou haſt ſaid.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhiles they vvere at ſupper, IESVS tooke bread, and bleſſed, and brake: and he gaue to his Diſciples, and ſaid, Take ye, and eate: THIS IS MY BODY.
label: Matthew

text: And taking the chalice, he gaue thankes: and gaue to them, ſaying: Drinke ye al of this.
label: Matthew

text: For THIS IS MY BLOVD OF THE NEVV TESTAMENT, VVHICH SHAL BE SHED FOR MANY VNTO REMISSION OF SINNES.
label: Matthew

text: And I ſay to you, I vvil not drinke from henceforth of this fruite of the vine, vntil that day vvhen I ſhal drinke it vvith you nevv in the kingdom of my father.
label: Matthew

text: And an hymne being ſaid, they vvent forth vnto Mount-oliuet.
label: Matthew

text: Then IESVS ſaith to them, Al you ſhal be ſcandalized in me, in this night. For it is vvritten, I vvil ſtrike the Paſtor, and the ſheepe of the flocke ſhal be diſperſed.
label: Matthew

text: But after I ſhal be riſen againe, I vvil goe before you into Galilee.
label: Matthew

text: And Peter anſwering, ſaid to him, Although al ſhal be ſcandalized in thee, I vvil neuer be ſcandalized.
label: Matthew

text: IESVS ſaid to him, Amen I ſay to thee, that in this night before the cocke crovv, thou ſhalt denie me thriſe.
label: Matthew

text: Peter ſaith to him, Yea though I ſhould die vvith thee, I vvil not denie thee. Likevviſe alſo ſaid al the Diſciples.
label: Matthew

text: Then IESVS commeth vvith them into a village called Gethſémani: and he ſaid to his Diſciples, Sitte you here til I goe yonder, and pray.
label: Matthew

text: And taking to him Peter and the tvvo ſonnes of Zebedee, he began to vvaxe ſorovvful and to be ſad.
label: Matthew

text: Then he ſaith to them: My ſoul is ſorovvful euen vnto death: ſtay here, and vvatch vvith me.
label: Matthew

text: And being gone forvvard a litle, he fel vpon his face, praying, and ſaying, My Father, if it be poſsible, let this chalice paſſe from me. neuertheleſſe not as I vvil, but as thou.
label: Matthew

text: And he commeth to his Diſciples, and findeth them ſleeping, and he ſaith to Peter, Euen ſo? Could you not vvatch one houre vvith me?
label: Matthew

text: Watch ye, and pray that ye enter not into tentation. The ſpirit in deede is prompt, but the fleſh vveake.
label: Matthew

text: Againe the ſecond time he vvent, and prayed, ſaying, My Father, if this chalice may not paſſe, but I muſt drinke it, thy vvil be done.
label: Matthew

text: And he commeth againe, and findeth them ſleeping: for their eyes vvere become heauy.
label: Matthew

text: And leauing them, he went againe: and he prayed the third time, ſaying the ſelf ſame vvord.
label: Matthew

text: Then he commeth to his Diſciples, and ſaith to them, Sleepe ye now and take reſt: behold the houre approcheth, and the Sonne of man ſhal be betrayed into the hands of ſinners.
label: Matthew

text: Riſe, let vs goe: behold he approcheth that ſhal betray me.
label: Matthew

text: As he yet ſpake, behold Iudas one of the Tvvelue came, and vvith him a great multitude vvith ſwordes and clubbes, ſent from the cheefe Prieſtes and the auncients of the people.
label: Matthew

text: And he that betrayed him, gaue them a ſigne, ſaying, Whomſoeuer I ſhal kiſſe, that is he, hold him.
label: Matthew

text: And forthvvith comming to IESVS, he ſaid, Haile Rabbi. And he kiſſed him.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſaid to him, Freend, vvhereto art thou come? Then they drevve neere, and laid hands on IESVS, and held him.
label: Matthew

text: And behold one of them that vvere vvith IESVS, ſtretching forth his hand, drevve out his ſvvord: and ſtriking the ſeruant of the high Prieſt, cut of his eare.
label: Matthew

text: Then IESVS ſaith to him, Returne thy ſword into his place: for al that take the ſvvord, ſhal periſh vvith the ſword.
label: Matthew

text: Thinkeſt thou that I cannot aſke my Father: and he vvil giue me preſently more then tvvelue legions of Angels?
label: Matthew

text: How then ſhal the ſcriptures be fulfilled, that ſo it muſt be done?
label: Matthew

text: In that houre IESVS ſaid to the multitudes: You are come out as it vvere to a theefe vvith ſwordes and clubbes to apprehend me: I ſate daily vvith you teaching in the temple: and you laid no hands on me.
label: Matthew

text: And al this vvas done, that the ſcriptures of the Prophets might be fulfilled. Then the diſciples al leauing him, fled.
label: Matthew

text: But they taking hold of IESVS, led him to Caiphas the high Prieſt, vvhere the Scribes and auncients vvere aſſembled.
label: Matthew

text: And Peter folovved him a farre of, euen to the court of the high Prieſt. And going in he ſate vvith the ſeruants, that he might ſee the end.
label: Matthew

text: And the cheefe Prieſtes and the vvhole Councel ſought falſe vvitnes againſt IESVS, that they might put him to death:
label: Matthew

text: and they found not, vvhereas many falſe witneſſes had come in. And laſt of al there came tvvo falſe vvitneſſes:
label: Matthew

text: and they ſaid, This man ſaid, I am able to deſtroy the temple of God, and after three dayes to reedifie it.
label: Matthew

text: And the high Prieſt riſing vp, ſaid to him: Anſvvereſt thou nothing to the things vvhich theſe do teſtifie againſt thee?
label: Matthew

text: But IESVS held his peace. And the high Prieſt ſaid to him: I adiure thee by the liuing God, that thou tel vs if thou be Chriſt the ſonne of God.
label: Matthew

text: IESVS ſaith to him, Thou haſt ſaid. neuertheles I ſay to you, hereafter you ſhal ſee the Sonne of man ſitting on the right hand of the povver of God, and comming in the cloudes of heauen.
label: Matthew

text: Then the high Prieſt rent his garments, ſaying, He hath blaſphemed, vvhat neede vve witneſſes any further? behold, novv you haue heard the blaſphemie,
label: Matthew

text: hovv thinke you? But they anſvvering ſaid, He is guilty of death.
label: Matthew

text: Then did they ſpit on his face, and buffeted him, and other ſmote his face vvith the palmes of their hands,
label: Matthew

text: ſaying, Prophecie vnto vs O Chriſt: vvho is he that ſtrooke thee?
label: Matthew

text: But Peter ſate vvithout in the court: and there came to him one vvenche, ſaying: Thou alſo vvaſt vvith IESVS the Galilean.
label: Matthew

text: But he denied before them all, ſaying, I wot not vvhat thou ſayeſt.
label: Matthew

text: And as he vvent out of the gate, an other vvenche ſavv him, and ſhe ſaith to them that vvere there, And this felow alſo vvas vvith IESVS the Nazarite.
label: Matthew

text: And againe he denied vvith an othe, That I knovv not the man.
label: Matthew

text: And after a litle they came that ſtoode by, and ſaid to Peter, Surely thou alſo art of them: for euen thy ſpeache doth bewray thee.
label: Matthew

text: Then he began to curſe and to ſvveare that he knevve not the man. And incontinent the cocke crevve.
label: Matthew

text: And Peter remembred the vvord of IESVS vvhich he had ſaid, Before the cocke crovv, thou ſhalt deny me thriſe. And going forth, he vvept bitterly.
label: Matthew

text: AND vvhen morning vvas come, al the cheefe Prieſtes and auncients of the people conſulted together againſt IESVS, that they might put him to death.
label: Matthew

text: And they brought him bound and deliuered him to Ponce Pilate the Preſident.
label: Matthew

text: Then Iudas that betrayed him, ſeeing that he vvas condemned, repenting him, returned the thirtie ſiluer peeces to the cheefe Prieſtes and auncients,
label: Matthew
