text: ſaying, I haue ſinned, betraying iuſt bloud. But they ſaid, what is that to vs? looke thou to it.
label: Matthew

text: And caſting dovvne the ſiluer peeces in the temple, he departed: and vvent and hanged him ſelf vvith an halter.
label: Matthew

text: And the cheefe Prieſtes hauing taken the ſiluer peeces, ſaid, It is not lavvful to caſt them into the Córbana: becauſe it is the price of bloud.
label: Matthew

text: And after they had conſulted together, they bought vvith them the potters field, to be a burying place for ſtrangers.
label: Matthew

text: For this cauſe that field vvas called Hacéldama, that is, the field of bloud, euen to this preſent day.
label: Matthew

text: Then vvas fulfilled that vvhich vvas ſpoken by Ieremie the Prophet, ſaying, And they tooke the thirtie peeces of ſiluer, the price of the priced, vvhom they did price of the children of Iſrael:
label: Matthew

text: and they gaue them into the potters field, as our Lord did appoint to me.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS ſtoode before the Preſident, and the Preſident aſked him, ſaying, Art thou the King of the Iewes? IESVS ſaith to him, Thou ſayeſt.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen he vvas accuſed of the cheefe Prieſtes and auncients, he anſvvered nothing.
label: Matthew

text: Then Pilate ſaith to him, Doeſt thou not heare hovv many teſtimonies they alleage againſt thee?
label: Matthew

text: And he anſvvered him not to any vvord: ſo that the Preſident did maruel excedingly.
label: Matthew

text: And vpon the ſolemne day the Preſident had accuſtomed to releaſe vnto the people one priſoner vvhom they vvould.
label: Matthew

text: And he had then a notorious priſoner, that vvas called Barabbas.
label: Matthew

text: They therfore being gathered together, Pilate ſaid: whom vvil you that I releaſe to you, Barabbas, or IESVS that is called Chriſt?
label: Matthew

text: For he knevve that for enuie they had deliuered him.
label: Matthew

text: And as he vvas ſitting in place of iudgment, his vvife ſent vnto him, ſaying: Haue thou nothing to doe vvith that iuſt man. for I haue ſuffred many things this day in my ſleepe for him.
label: Matthew

text: But the cheefe Prieſtes and auncients perſuaded the people, that they ſhould aſke Barabbas, and make IESVS avvay.
label: Matthew

text: And the Preſident anſvvering, ſaid to them: Whether vvil you of the tvvo to be releaſed vnto you? But they ſaid, Barabbas.
label: Matthew

text: Pilate ſaith to them, what ſhal I doe then vvith IESVS that is called Chriſt? They ſay al, Let him be crucified.
label: Matthew

text: The Preſident ſaid to them, why vvhat euil hath he done? But they cried the more, ſaying, Let him be crucified.
label: Matthew

text: And Pilate ſeeing that he nothing preuailed, but rather tumult vvas tovvard: taking vvater he vvaſhed his hands before the people, ſaying, I am innocent of the bloud of this iuſt man: looke you to it.
label: Matthew

text: And the vvhole people anſvvering, ſaid, His bloud be vpon vs, and vpon our children.
label: Matthew

text: Then he releaſed to them Barabbas, and hauing ſcourged IESVS, deliuered him vnto them for to be crucified.
label: Matthew

text: Then the Preſidents ſouldiars taking IESVS into the Palace, gathered together vnto him the vvhole band:
label: Matthew

text: and ſtripping him, put a ſcarlet cloke about him,
label: Matthew

text: and platting a crovvne of thornes, put it vpon his head, and a reede in his right hand. And bovving the knee before him, they mocked him, ſaying, Haile King of the Iewes.
label: Matthew

text: And ſpitting vpon him, they tooke the reede, and ſmote his head.
label: Matthew

text: And after they had mocked him, they tooke of the cloke from him, and put on him his ovvne garments, and led him avvay to crucifie him.
label: Matthew

text: And in going they found a man of Cyréne, named Simon: him they forced to take vp his croſſe.
label: Matthew

text: And they came into the place that is called Golgotha, vvhich is, the place of Caluarie.
label: Matthew

text: And they gaue him vvine to drinke mingled vvith gall. And vvhen he had taſted, he vvould not drinke.
label: Matthew

text: And after they had crucified him, they deuided his garments, caſting lottes: that it might be fulfilled vvhich vvas ſpoken by the Prophet, ſaying: They deuided my garments among them: and vpon my veſture they did caſt lottes.
label: Matthew

text: And they ſate and vvatched him.
label: Matthew

text: And they put ouer his head his cauſe vvritten, THIS IS IESVS THE KING OF THE IEWES.
label: Matthew

text: Then vvere crucified vvith him tvvo theeues: one on the right hand, and one on the left.
label: Matthew

text: And they that paſſed by, blaſphemed him, vvagging their heades,
label: Matthew

text: and ſaying, Vah, thou that deſtroyeſt the temple of God, and in three daies doeſt reedifie it: ſaue thine ovvne ſelf: if thou be the ſonne of God, come dovvne from the Croſſe.
label: Matthew

text: In like maner alſo the cheefe Prieſtes With the Scribes and auncients mocking, ſaid:
label: Matthew

text: He ſaued other: him ſelf he can not ſaue: if he be the King of Iſrael, let him novv come dovvne from the Croſſe, and vve vvil beleeue him.
label: Matthew

text: He truſted in God: let him novv deliuer him if he vvill: for he ſaid, That I am the ſonne of God.
label: Matthew

text: And the ſelf ſame thing the theeues alſo that were crucified vvith him, reproched him vvithal.
label: Matthew

text: And from the ſixt houre, there vvas darkeneſſe made vpon the vvhole earth, vntil the ninthe houre.
label: Matthew

text: And about the ninthe houre IESVS cried vvith a mighty voice, ſaying, Eli, Eli, lamma-ſabacthani? that is, My God, my God, vvhy haſt thou forſaken me?
label: Matthew

text: And certaine that ſtoode there and heard, ſaid, He calleth Elias.
label: Matthew

text: And incontinent one of them running, tooke a ſponge, & filled it vvith vinegre: and put it on a reede, and gaue him to drinke.
label: Matthew

text: And other ſaid, Let be, let vs ſee vvhether Elias come to deliuer him.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS againe crying vvith a mighty voice, yelded vp the ghoſt.
label: Matthew

text: And be hold the vele of the temple vvas rent in tvvo peeces, from the toppe euen to the botome. and the earth did quake, and the rockes vvere rent,
label: Matthew

text: and the graues vvere opened: and many bodies of the ſaincts that had ſlept, roſe.
label: Matthew

text: And they going forth out of the graues after his reſurrection, came into the holy citie: and appeared to many.
label: Matthew

text: And the Centurion and they that vvere vvith him vvatching IESVS, hauing ſeen the earth-quake and the things that vvere done, vvere ſore afraid, ſaying, In deede this vvas the ſonne of God.
label: Matthew

text: And there vvere there many vvomen a farre of, vvhich had folovved IESVS from Galilee, miniſtring vnto him:
label: Matthew

text: among vvhom vvas Marie Magdalene, and Marie the mother of Iames and Ioſeph, and the mother of the ſonnes of Zebedee.
label: Matthew

text: And vvhen it vvas euening, there came a certaine rich man of Arimathaea, named Ioſeph, vvho alſo him ſelf was diſciple to IESVS.
label: Matthew

text: He went to Pilate, and aſked the body of IESVS. Then Pilate commaunded that the body ſhould be deliuered.
label: Matthew

text: And Ioſeph taking the body, vvrapt it in cleane ſindon,
label: Matthew

text: and laid it in his ovvne nevve monument, vvhich he had hevved out in a rocke. And he rolled a great ſtone to the doore of the monument, and vvent his vvay.
label: Matthew

text: And there was there Marie Magdalene, and the other Marie, ſitting ouer againſt the ſepulchre.
label: Matthew

text: And the next day, vvhich is after the Paraſceue, the cheefe Prieſtes and the Phariſees came together to Pilate,
label: Matthew

text: ſaying, Sir, we haue remembred, that that ſeducer ſaid yet liuing, After three dayes I vvil riſe againe.
label: Matthew

text: Commaund therfore the ſepulchre to be kept vntil the third day: leſt perhaps his Diſciples come, and ſteale him, and ſay to the people, He is riſen from the dead: and the laſt errour ſhal be vvorſe then the firſt.
label: Matthew

text: Pilate ſaid to them, You haue a gard: goe, gard it as you knovv.
label: Matthew

text: And they departing, made the ſepulchre ſure: ſealing vp the ſtone, vvith vvatchmen.
label: Matthew

text: AND in the euening of the Sabboth vvhich davvneth on the firſt of the Sabboth, came Marie Magdalene, and the other Marie to ſee the ſepulchre.
label: Matthew

text: And behold there vvas made a great earth-quake. For an Angel of our Lord deſcended from heauen: and comming, rolled backe the ſtone, and ſate vpon it:
label: Matthew

text: and his countenance vvas as lightening: and his garment as ſnovv.
label: Matthew

text: And for feare of him, the vvatchmen vvere frighted, and became as dead.
label: Matthew

text: And the Angel anſvvering ſaid to the vvomen, Feare not you. for I know that you ſeeke IESVS that vvas crucified.
label: Matthew

text: he is not here: for he is riſen, as he ſaid. come, and ſee the place vvhere our Lord vvas laid.
label: Matthew

text: And going quickly, tel ye his Diſciples that he is riſen: and behold he goeth before you into Galilee. there you ſhal ſee him. loe I haue fortold you.
label: Matthew

text: And they vvent forth quickly out of the monument vvith feare and great ioy, running to tel his Diſciples.
label: Matthew

text: And behold IESVS mette them, ſaying, Al haile. But they came neere and tooke hold of his feete, and adored him.
label: Matthew

text: Then IESVS ſaid to them, Feare not. goe, tel my brethren that they goe into Galilee, there they ſhal ſee me.
label: Matthew

text: Who vvhen they vvere departed, behold certaine of the vvatchmen came into the citie, and told the cheefe Prieſtes al things that had been done.
label: Matthew

text: And being aſſembled together vvith the auncients, taking counſel, they gaue a greate ſumme of money to the ſouldiars,
label: Matthew

text: ſaying, Say you, That his Diſciples came by night, and ſtole him avvay vvhen vve were a ſleepe.
label: Matthew

text: And if the Preſident ſhal heare of this, vve vvil perſuade him, and make you ſecure.
label: Matthew

text: But they taking the money, did as they vvere taught. And this vvord vvas bruited abrode among the Ievves, euen vnto this day.
label: Matthew

text: And the eleuen Diſciples vvent into Galilee, vnto the mount vvhere IESVS had appointed them.
label: Matthew

text: And ſeeing him they adored, but ſome doubted.
label: Matthew

text: And IESVS comming neere ſpake vnto them, ſaying. Al povver is giuen to me in heauen and in earth.
label: Matthew

text: going therfore teach ye al nations: BAPTIZING THEM IN THE NAME OF THE FATHER AND OF THE SONNE AND OF THE HOLY GHOST,
label: Matthew

text: teaching them to obſerue al things vvhatſoeuer I haue commaunded you, and behold I am vvith you al daies, euen to the conſummation of the vvorld. ⊢
label: Matthew

text: THE beginning of the Goſpel of IESVS CHRIST the ſonne of God.
label: Mark

text: As it is vvritten in Eſay the Prophet : ( Behold I ſend mine Angel before thy face, who ſhal prepare thy way before thee.)
label: Mark

text: A voice of one crying in the deſert, Prepare ye the vvay of our Lord, make ſtraight his pathes.
label: Mark

text: Iohn vvas in the deſert baptizing, and preaching the baptiſme of penance vnto remiſsion of ſinnes.
label: Mark

text: And there vvent forth to him al the countrie of Iewrie, and al they of Hieruſalem: and vvere baptized of him in the riuer of Iordan, confeſsing their ſinnes.
label: Mark

text: And Iohn vvas clothed vvith camels heare, and a girdle of a ſkinne about his loines: and he did eate locuſtes and vvild honie.
label: Mark

text: And he preached, ſaying, There commeth a ſtronger then I after me: vvhoſe latchet of his ſhoes I am not vvorthie ſtouping downe to vnlooſe.
label: Mark

text: I haue baptized you vvith vvater: but he ſhal baptize you vvith the holy Ghoſt.
label: Mark

text: And it came to paſſe: in thoſe daies came IESVS from Nazareth of Galilee: and vvas baptized of Iohn in Iordan.
label: Mark

text: And forthvvith comming vp out of the vvater, he ſavv the heauens opened, and the Spirit as a doue deſcending, and remaining on him.
label: Mark

text: And a voice vvas made from heauen, Thou art my beloued ſonne, in thee I am vvel pleaſed.
label: Mark

text: And forthvvith the Spirit droue him out into the deſert.
label: Mark

text: And he was in the deſert fourtie daies, and fourtie nightes: and vvas tempted of Satan. and he vvas vvith beaſtes, and the Angels miniſtred to him.
label: Mark

text: And after that Iohn vvas deliuered vp, IESVS came into Galilee, preaching the Goſpel of the kingdom of God,
label: Mark

text: and ſaying, That the time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: be penitent, and beleeue the Goſpel.
label: Mark

text: And paſſing by the ſea of Galilee, he ſavv Simon and Andrew his brother, caſting nettes into the ſea (for they were fiſhers)
label: Mark

text: and IESVS ſaid to them, Come after me, and I vvil make you to become fiſhers of men.
label: Mark

text: And immediatly leauing their nettes, they folovved him.
label: Mark

text: And being gone thence a litle further, he ſavv Iames of Zebedee, and Iohn his brother, and them repairing their nettes in the ſhippe:
label: Mark

text: and forthvvith he called them. And leauing their father Zebedee in the ſhippe vvith his hired men, they folovved him.
label: Mark

text: And they enter into Capharnaum, and he forthvvith vpon the Sabboths going into the Synagogue, taught them.
label: Mark

text: And they vvere aſtonied at his doctrine. for he vvas teaching them as hauing povver, and not as the Scribes.
label: Mark

text: And there vvas in their Synagogue a man in an vncleane ſpirit: and he cried out,
label: Mark

text: ſaying, what to vs and to thee IESVS of Nazareth? art thou come to deſtroy vs? I knovv vvho thou art, the Sainct of God.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS threatened him, ſaying, Hold thy peace, and goe out of the man.
label: Mark

text: And the vncleane ſpirit tearing him, and crying out vvith a great voice, vvent out of him.
label: Mark

text: And they marueled al, in ſo much that they queſtioned among them ſelues, ſaying, what thing is this? vvhat is this nevv doctrine? for vvith povver he commaundeth the vncleane ſpirits alſo, and they obey him.
label: Mark

text: And the bruite of him vvent forth incontinent into al the countrie of Galilee.
label: Mark

text: And immediatly going forth out of the Synagogue, they came into the houſe of Simon and Andrevv, vvith Iames and Iohn.
label: Mark

text: And Simons vviues mother lay in a fit of a feuer: and forthvvith they tel him of her.
label: Mark

text: And comming neere he lifted her vp taking her by the hand: and incontinent the ague left her, and ſhe miniſtred vnto them.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen it vvas euening after ſunne ſet, they brought to him al that vvere il at eaſe and that had deuils.
label: Mark

text: And al the citie vvas gathered together at the doore.
label: Mark

text: And he cured many that vvere vexed vvith diuerſe diſeaſes: and he caſt out many deuils, and he ſuffred not them to ſpeake that they knevv him.
label: Mark

text: And riſing very early, and going forth he vvent into a deſert place: and there he prayed.
label: Mark

text: And Simon ſought after him, and they that vvere vvith him.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen they had found him, they ſaid to him, That al ſeeke for thee.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaith to them, Let vs goe into the next tovvnes and cities, that I may preach there alſo: for to this purpoſe am I come.
label: Mark

text: And he vvas preaching in their Synagogs, and in al Galilee: and caſting out deuils.
label: Mark

text: And a leper commeth to him beſeeching him: and kneeling dovvne ſaith to him, If thou vvilt, thou canſt make me cleane.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS hauing compaſsion on him, ſtretched forth his hand: and touching him, he ſaith vnto him, I vvil, be thou made cleane.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he had ſpoken, immediatly the leproſie departed from him, and he vvas made cleane.
label: Mark

text: And he threatened him, and forthvvith caſt him forth.
label: Mark

text: and he ſaith to him, See thou tel no body: but goe, ſhevv thy ſelf to the high prieſt, and offer for thy cleanſing the things that Moyſes commaunded, for a teſtimonie to them.
label: Mark

text: But he being gone forth, began to publiſh, and to blaſe abrode the vvord: ſo that novv he could not openly goe into the citie, but vvas abrode in deſert places, and they came together vnto him from al ſides.
label: Mark

text: AND againe he entred into Capharnaum after ſome daies, and it vvas heard that he vvas in the houſe,
label: Mark

text: and many came together, ſo that there was no place no not at the doore, and he ſpake to them the vvord.
label: Mark

text: And they came to him bringing one ſicke of the palſey, vvho vvas caried of foure.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen they could not offer him vnto him for the multitude, they vncouered the roofe vvhere he vvas: and opening it they did let dovvne the couche wherein the ſicke of the palſey lay.
label: Mark

text: And when IESVS had ſeen their faith, he ſaith to the ſicke of the palſey, Sonne, thy ſinnes are forgiuen thee.
label: Mark

text: And there vvere certaine of the Scribes ſitting there and thinking in their hartes,
label: Mark

text: why doth he ſpeake ſo? he blaſphemeth. Who can forgiue ſinnes but only God?
label: Mark

text: Which by and by IESVS knovving in his ſpirit, that they ſo thought vvithin them ſelues, ſaith to them, why thinke you theſe things in your hartes?
label: Mark

text: VVhether is eaſier, to ſay to the ſicke of the palſey, Thy ſinnes are forgiuen thee: or to ſay, Ariſe, take vp thy couche, and vvalke?
label: Mark

text: But that you may knovv that the Sonne of man hath povver in earth to forgiue ſinnes (he ſaith to the ſicke of the palſey)
label: Mark

text: I ſay to thee, Ariſe, take vp thy couche, and goe into thy houſe.
label: Mark

text: And forthvvith he aroſe: and taking vp his couche, vvent his vvay in the ſight of al, ſo that al marueled, and glorified God, ſaying, That vve neuer ſavv the like.
label: Mark

text: And he went forth againe to the ſea: and al the multitude came to him, and he taught them.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he paſſed by, he ſavv Leui of Alphæus ſitting at the cuſtome place: and he ſaith to him, Folovv me. And riſing vp he folowed him.
label: Mark

text: And it came to paſſe, as he ſate at meate in his houſe, many Publicans and ſinners did ſit dovvne together vvith IESVS and his Diſciples. for they vvere many, vvho alſo folovved him.
label: Mark

text: And the Scribes and the Phariſees ſeeing that he did eate vvith Publicans and Sinners, ſaid to his Diſciples, why doth your Maiſter eate and drinke vvith Publicans and ſinners?
label: Mark

text: IESVS hearing this, ſaith to them, The vvhole haue not neede of a Phyſicion, but they that are il at eaſe. for I came not to call the iuſt, but ſinners.
label: Mark

text: And the diſciples of Iohn and the Phariſees did vſe to faſt: and they come, and ſay to him, Why do the diſciples of Iohn and of the Phariſees faſt: but thy diſciples do not faſt?
label: Mark

text: And IESVS ſaid to them, why, can the children of the mariage faſt, as long as the bridegrome is vvith them? So long time as they haue the bridegrome vvith them, they can not faſt.
label: Mark

text: But the daies vvil come vvhen the bridegrome ſhal be taken avvay from them: and then they ſhal faſt in thoſe daies.
label: Mark

text: No body ſovveth a peece of ravv cloth to an old garment: othervviſe he taketh avvay the nevv peecing from the old, and there is made a greater rent.
label: Mark

text: And no body putteth nevv vvine into old bottels: othervviſe the vvine burſteth the bottels, and the vvine vvil be ſhed, and the bottels vvil be loſt. but new vvine muſt be put into nevv bottels.
label: Mark

text: And it came to paſſe againe vvhen he vvalked through the corne on the Sabboths, and his Diſciples began to goe forvvard and to plucke the eares.
label: Mark

text: And the Phariſees ſaid to him, Behold, vvhy do they on the Sabboths that vvhich is not lavvful?
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, Did you neuer read vvhat Dauid did, vvhen he vvas in neceſsitie, and him ſelf vvas an hungred and they that vvere vvith him?
label: Mark

text: hovv he entred into the houſe of God vnder Abiathar the high Prieſt, and did eate the loaues of Propoſition, vvhich it was not lavvful to eate but for the Prieſts, and did giue vnto them vvhich vvere with him?
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, The Sabboth was made for man, and not man for the Sabboth.
label: Mark

text: Therfore the ſonne of man is Lord of the Sabboth alſo.
label: Mark

text: AND he entred againe into the Synagogue, and there vvas a man there that had a withered hand.
label: Mark

text: And they vvatched him vvhether he vvould cure on the Sabboths: that they might accuſe him.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaith to the man that had the vvithered hand, Riſe vp into the middes.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaith to them, Is it lavvful on the Sabboths to doe vvel or il? to ſaue a ſoule, or to deſtroy? but they held their peace.
label: Mark

text: And looking round about vpon them vvith anger, being ſorovvful for the blindenes of their hart, he ſaith to the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he ſtretched it forth: and his hand vvas reſtored vnto him.
label: Mark

text: And the Phariſees going forth, immediatly made a conſultation vvith the Herodians againſt him hovv they might deſtroy him.
label: Mark

text: But IESVS with his Diſciples retired to the ſea: and a great multitude from Galilee and Ievvrie folovved him,
label: Mark

text: and from Hieruſalem, and from Idumæa, and beyond Iordan. And they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, hearing the things vvhich he did, came to him.
label: Mark

text: And he ſpake to his Diſciples that a boate might attend on him becauſe of the multitude, leſt they ſhould throng him.
label: Mark

text: for he healed many, ſo that there preaſed in vpon him for to touch him, as many as had hurtes.
label: Mark

text: And the vncleane ſpirites, vvhen they ſavv him, fel dovvne vnto him: and they cryed ſaying,
label: Mark

text: Thou art the ſonne of God. And he vehemently charged them that they ſhould not diſcloſe him.
label: Mark

text: And aſcending into a mountaine, he called vnto him vvhom he vvould himſelf: and they came to him.
label: Mark

text: And he made that tvvelue ſhould be vvith him, and that he might ſend them to preach.
label: Mark

text: And he gaue them povver to cure infirmities, and to caſt out diuels.
label: Mark

text: And he gaue to Simon the name Peter.
label: Mark

text: and Iames of Zebedee, and Iohn the brother of Iames: and he called their names, Boanerges, vvhich is, the ſonnes of thunder.
label: Mark

text: and Andrevv and Philippe, and Bartlemevv and Matthevv, and Thomas and Iames of Alphæus, and Thaddæus and Simon Cananæus,
label: Mark

text: and Iudas Iſcariote, vvho alſo betrayed him.
label: Mark

text: And they come to a houſe: and the multitude reſorteth together againe, ſo that they could not ſo much as eate bread.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen his had heard of it, they vvent forth to lay hands on him. for they ſaid, That he vvas become mad.
label: Mark

text: And the Scribes vvhich vvere come dovvne from Hieruſalem, ſaid, That he hath Beelzebub: and that in the prince of deuils he caſteth out deuils.
label: Mark

text: And after he had called them together, he ſaid to them in parables, Hovv can Satan caſt out Satan?
label: Mark

text: And if a kingdom be deuided againſt it ſelf, that kingdom can not ſtand.
label: Mark

text: And if a houſe be deuided againſt it ſelf, that houſe can not ſtand.
label: Mark

text: And if Satan be riſen againſt him ſelf, he is deuided, and can not ſtand, but hath an end.
label: Mark

text: No body can rifle the veſſel of the ſtrong, being entred into his houſe, vnles he firſt binde the ſtrong, and then ſhal he rifle his houſe.
label: Mark

text: Amen I ſay to you, that al ſinnes ſhal be forgiuen the ſonnes of men, and the blaſphemies wherevvith they ſhal blaſpheme.
label: Mark

text: But he that ſhal blaſpheme againſt the Holy Ghoſt, he hath not forgiueneſſe for euer, but ſhal be guilty of an eternal ſinne.
label: Mark

text: Becauſe they ſaid, He hath an vncleane ſpirit.
label: Mark

text: And there come his mother and brethren: and ſtanding vvithout they ſent vnto him calling him,
label: Mark

text: and the multitude ſate about him: and they ſay to him, Behold thy mother and thy brethren vvithout ſeeke thee.
label: Mark

text: And anſvvering them, he ſaid, Who is my mother and my brethren?
label: Mark

text: And looking about vpon them vvhich ſate round about him, he ſaith, Behold my mother and my brethren.
label: Mark

text: For vvhoſoeuer ſhal doe the vvil of God, he is my brother and my ſiſter and mother.
label: Mark

text: AND againe he began to teach at the ſea ſide: and a great multitude vvas gathered together vnto him, ſo that he vvent vp into a boate, and ſate in the ſea, and al the multitude about the ſea vvas vpon the land:
label: Mark

text: and he taught them in parables many things, and ſaid to them in his doctrine,
label: Mark

text: Heare ye: Behold, the ſovver vvent forth to ſovv.
label: Mark

text: And vvhiles he ſovveth, ſome fel by the vvay ſide, and the foules of the aire came, and did eate it.
label: Mark

text: And otherſome fel vpon rocky places vvhere it had not much earth: and it ſhot vp immediatly, becauſe it had not deepnes of earth:
label: Mark

text: and vvhen the ſunne was riſen, it parched, and becauſe it had not roote, it vvithered.
label: Mark

text: And ſome fel among thornes: and the thornes grewe vp, and choked it, and it yelded not fruite.
label: Mark

text: And ſome fel vpon good ground: and it yelded fruite that grewe vp and increaſed, and it brought forth, one thirtie, one ſixtie, and one an hundred.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid, He that hath eares to heare, let him heare.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he vvas alone, the Tvvelue that vvere vvith him, aſked him the parable.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, To you it is giuen to knovv the myſterie of the kingdom of God: but to them that are vvithout, al things are done in parables:
label: Mark

text: that ſeeing they may ſee, and not ſee: and hearing they may heare, and not vnderſtand: leſt at any time they ſhould be conuerted and their ſinnes be forgiuen them.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaith to them, Do you not knovv this parable? and hovv ſhal you knovv al parables?
label: Mark

text: He that ſovveth: ſovveth the vvord.
label: Mark

text: And they by the vvay ſide, are theſe: vvhere the vvord is ſovven, and vvhen they ſhal haue heard, immediatly commeth Satan, and taketh avvay the vvord that vvas ſovven in their hartes.
label: Mark

text: And thy likevviſe that are ſovven vpon the rocky places, are theſe: vvho vvhen they heare the vvord, immediatly vvith ioy receiue it:
label: Mark

text: and they haue not roote in them ſelues, but are temporal: aftervvard vvhen tribulation is riſen and perſecution for the vvord, forthvvith they are ſcandalized.
label: Mark

text: And other there be that are ſovven among thornes: theſe are they that heare the vvord,
label: Mark

text: and the cares of the vvorld and the deceitfulnes of riches, and concupiſcences about other things entring in choke the vvord, and it is made fruiteles.
label: Mark

text: And theſe are they that vvere ſovven vpon the good ground, vvhich heare the vvord and receiue it, and yeld fruite one thirtie, one ſixtie, and one an hundred.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, Commeth a candel to be put vnder a buſhel, or vnder a bed? and not to be put vpon the candleſticke?
label: Mark

text: For there is nothing hid, vvhich ſhal not be made manifeſt: neither vvas any thing made ſecret, but that it ſhal come to light.
label: Mark

text: If any man haue eares to heare, let him heare.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, See vvhat you heare. In vvhat meaſure you mete, it ſhal be meaſured to you againe, and more ſhal be giuen `to you'.
label: Mark

text: For he that hath, to him ſhal be giuen: and he that hath not, that alſo vvhich he hath, ſhal be taken avvay from him.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man caſt ſeede into the earth,
label: Mark

text: and ſleepe, and riſe vp night and day, and the ſeede ſpring, and grovve vp vvhiles he knovveth not.
label: Mark

text: For the earth of it ſelf bringeth forth fruite, firſt the blade, then the eare, aftervvard the ful corne in the eare.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen the fruite hath brought out it ſelf, immediatly he putteth in the ſickle, becauſe harueſt is come.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid, To vvhat ſhal vve liken the kingdom of God? or to vvhat parable ſhal vve compare it?
label: Mark

text: As a muſtard ſeede: vvhich vvhen it is ſovven in the earth, is leſſe then al the ſeedes that are in the earth:
label: Mark

text: and vvhen it is ſovven, it riſeth vp, and becommeth greater then al herbes, and maketh great boughes, ſo that the birdes of the aire may dvvel vnder the ſhadovv thereof.
label: Mark

text: And vvith many ſuch parables he ſpake to them the vvord, according as they vvere able to heare:
label: Mark

text: and vvithout parable he did not ſpeake vnto them. but apart, he explicated al things to his Diſciples.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaith to them in that day, vvhen euening vvas come, Let vs paſſe ouer to the other ſide.
label: Mark

text: And dimiſsing the multitude, they take him ſo as he vvas in the boate: and there vvere other boates with him.
label: Mark

text: And there aroſe a great ſtorme of winde, and the waues bette into the boate, ſo that the boate was filled.
label: Mark

text: And he was in the hinder part of the boate ſleeping vpon a pillow: and they raiſe him, and ſay to him, Maiſter, doth it not pertaine to thee that we periſh?
label: Mark

text: And riſing vp he threatened the winde, and ſaid to the ſea, Peace, be ſtil. And the winde ceaſed: and there was made a great calme.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, Why are you feareful? neither yet haue you faith? And they feared with great feare: and they ſaid one to an other, Who is this (thinkeſt thou) that both winde and ſea obey him?
label: Mark

text: AND they came beyond the ſtraite of the ſea into the countrie of the Geraſens.
label: Mark

text: And as he vvent out of the boate, immediatly there mette him out of the ſepulchres a man in an vncleane ſpirit,
label: Mark

text: that had his dvvelling in the ſepulchres. and neither vvith chaines could any man novv binde him:
label: Mark

text: for being often bound with fetters and chaines, he had burſt the chaines, and broken the fetters. and no body could tame him.
label: Mark

text: and he vvas alvvaies day and night in the ſepulchres and in the mountaines, crying and cutting him ſelf vvith ſtones.
label: Mark

text: And ſeeing IESVS a farre of, he ranne and adored him:
label: Mark

text: and crying vvith a great voice, ſaid, What to me and thee IESVS the ſonne of God moſt high? I adiure thee by God that thou torment me not.
label: Mark

text: For he ſaid vnto him, Goe out of the man thou vncleane ſpirit.
label: Mark

text: And he aſked him, What is thy name? And he ſaith to him, My name is Legion: becauſe vve are many.
label: Mark

text: And he beſought him much, that he vvould not expel him out of the countrie.
label: Mark

text: And there vvas there about the mountaine a great heard of ſwine, feeding.
label: Mark

text: And the ſpirits beſought him, ſaying, Send vs into the ſwine, that vve may enter into them.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS immediatly graunted vnto them. And the vncleane ſpirits going out, entred into the ſwine: and the heard vvith great violence vvas caried headlong into the ſea, about tvvo thouſand, and vvere ſtifled in the ſea.
label: Mark

text: And they that fed them, fled, and caried nevves into the citie and into the fields. And they vvent forth to ſee vvhat vvas done:
label: Mark

text: and they come to IESVS, and they ſee him that vvas vexed of the deuil, ſitting, clothed, and vvel in his vvittes: and they vvere afraid.
label: Mark

text: And they that had ſeen it, told them, in vvhat maner he had been dealt vvithal that had the diuel: and of the ſwine.
label: Mark

text: And they began to deſire him, that he vvould depart from their coaſtes.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he vvent vp into the boate, he that had been vexed of the diuel, began to beſeeche him that he might be vvith him,
label: Mark

text: and he admitted him not, but ſaith to him, Goe into thy houſe to thine, and tel them hovv great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had mercie vpon thee.
label: Mark

text: And he vvent his vvay, and began to publiſh in Decapolis hovv great things IESVS had done to him: and al marueled.
label: Mark

text: And when IESVS had paſſed in boate againe ouer the ſtraite, a great multitude aſſembled together vnto him, and he vvas about the ſea.
label: Mark

text: And there commeth one of the Archſynagogs, named Iaîrus: and ſeeing him, he falleth dovvne at his feete,
label: Mark

text: and beſought him much, ſaying, That my daughter is at the point of death, come, impoſe thy hands vpon her, that ſhe may be ſafe and liue.
label: Mark

text: And he vvent vvith him, and a great multitude folovved him, and they thronged him.
label: Mark

text: And a vvoman vvhich vvas in an iſſue of bloud tvvelue yeres,
label: Mark

text: and had ſuffred many things of many Phyſicions, and had beſtovved al that ſhe had, neither vvas any thing the better, but vvas rather vvorſe:
label: Mark

text: when ſhe had heard of IESVS, ſhe came in the preaſſe behind him, and touched his garment.
label: Mark

text: for ſhe ſaid, That if I ſhal touche but his garment, I ſhal be ſafe.
label: Mark

text: And forthvvith the fountaine of her bloud vvas dried: and ſhe felt in her body that ſhe vvas healed of the maladie.
label: Mark

text: And immediatly IESVS knovving in him ſelf the vertue that had proceeded from him, turning to the multitude, ſaid, Who hath touched my garments?
label: Mark

text: And his Diſciples ſaid to him, Thou ſeeſt the multitude thronging thee, and ſayeſt thou, who hath touched me?
label: Mark

text: And he looked about to ſee her that had done this.
label: Mark

text: But the vvoman fearing and trembling, knovving vvhat vvas done in her: came and fel dovvne before him, and told him al the truth.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee ſafe, goe in peace, and be vvhole of thy maladie.
label: Mark

text: As he vvas yet ſpeaking, they come `to' the Archſynagogue, ſaying, That thy daughter is dead: vvhy doeſt thou trouble the Maiſter any further?
label: Mark

text: But IESVS hauing heard the vvord that vvas ſpoken, ſaith to the Archſynagogue, Feare not: only beleeue.
label: Mark

text: And he admitted not any man to folovv him, but Peter and Iames and Iohn the brother of Iames.
label: Mark

text: And they come to the Archſynagogs houſe, and he ſeeth a tumult, and folke vveeping and vvailing much.
label: Mark

text: And going in, he ſaith to them: Why make you this a doe and vveepe? the vvenche is not dead, but ſleepeth.
label: Mark

text: And they derided him. But he hauing put forth al, taketh the father and the mother of the vvenche, and them that vvere vvith him, and they goe in where the vvenche vvas lying.
label: Mark

text: And holding the vvenches hand, he ſaith to her, Talitha cumi, vvhich is being interpreted, wenche (I ſay to thee) ariſe.
label: Mark

text: and forthwith the wenche roſe vp, and walked. and ſhe was twelue yeres old: and they were aſtonied vvith great aſtoniſhment.
label: Mark

text: And he commaunded them earneſtly that no body ſhould know it: and he bad that ſome thing ſhould be giuen her to eate.
label: Mark

text: AND going out from thence, he vvent into his countrie: and his Diſciples folowed him.
label: Mark

text: and when the Sabboth vvas come, he began to teach in the Synagogue: and many hearing him vvere in admiration at his doctrine, ſaying, How came this felovv by al theſe things? and vvhat vviſedom is this that is giuen to him, and ſuch vertues as are vvrought by his hands?
label: Mark

text: Is not this the Carpenter, the ſonne of MARIE, the brother of Iames and Ioſeph and Iude and Simon? why, are not alſo his ſiſters here vvith vs? And they vvere ſcandalized in him.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS ſaid to them, That there is not a Prophet vvithout honour, but in his ovvne countrie, and in his ovvne houſe, and in his ovvne kinred.
label: Mark

text: and he could not doe any miracle there, but only cured a fevv that vvere ſicke, impoſing his hands
label: Mark

text: and he marueled becauſe of their incredulity, and he vvent about the tovvnes in circuite teaching.
label: Mark

text: And he called the Tvvelue: and began to ſend them tvvo and tvvo, and gaue them povver ouer vncleane ſpirits.
label: Mark

text: And he commaunded them that they ſhould take nothing for the vvay, but a rod only: not ſkrippe, not bread, nor money in their purſe,
label: Mark

text: but ſhod vvith ſandals, and that they ſhould not put on tvvo coates.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, Whitherſoeuer you ſhal enter into an houſe, there tarie til you depart thence.
label: Mark

text: and vvhoſoeuer ſhal not receiue you, nor heare you: going forth from thence ſhake of the duſt from your feete for a teſtimonie to them.
label: Mark

text: And going forth they preached that they ſhould doe penance:
label: Mark

text: and they caſt out many diuels, and anointed vvith oile many ſicke, and healed them.
label: Mark

text: And king Herod heard (for his name vvas made manifeſt) and he ſaid, That Iohn the Baptiſt is riſen againe from the dead, and therfore vertues vvorke in him.
label: Mark

text: And others ſaid, That it is Elias. But others ſaid, That it is a Prophet, as one of the Prophets.
label: Mark

text: Which Herod hearing, ſaid, Iohn vvhom I beheaded, he is riſen againe from the dead.
label: Mark

text: For the ſaid Herod ſent and apprehended Iohn, and bound him in priſon for Herodias the vvife of Philippe his brother, becauſe he had maried her.
label: Mark

text: For Iohn ſaid to Herod, It is not lavvful for thee to haue thy brothers vvife.
label: Mark

text: And Herodias lay in vvaite for him: and vvas deſirous to kil him, and could not.
label: Mark

text: For Herod feared Iohn, knovving him to be a iuſt and holy man: and he kept him, and by hearing him did many things: and he heard him gladly.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen a conuenient day vvas fallen, Herod made the ſupper of his birth-day to the Princes and the Tribunes and the cheefe of Galilee.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen the daughter of the ſame Herodias came in, and had daunced, and pleaſed Herod, and them that ſate vvith him at the table: the King ſaid to the damſel, Aſke of me vvhat thou vvilt, and I vvil giue it thee.
label: Mark

text: and he ſware to her, That vvhatſoeuer thou ſhalt aſke I vvil giue thee, though the halfe of my kingdom.
label: Mark

text: Who vvhen ſhe vvas gone forth, ſaid to her mother, What ſhal I aſke? But ſhe ſaid, The head of Iohn the Baptiſt.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen ſhe vvas gone in by and by with haſt to the King, ſhe aſketh ſaying, I wil that forthvvith thou giue me in a platter the head of Iohn the Baptiſt.
label: Mark

text: And the King vvas ſtroken ſad. Becauſe of his othe and for them that ſate together at table he vvould not diſpleaſe her:
label: Mark

text: but ſending the hangman, commaunded that his head ſhould be brought in a platter.
label: Mark

text: And he beheaded him in the priſon, and brought his head in a platter: and gaue it to the damſel, and the damſel gaue it to her mother.
label: Mark

text: Which his diſciples hearing came, and tooke his body: and they put it in a monument. ⊢
label: Mark

text: And the Apoſtles gathering together vnto Ieſus, made relation to him of al things that they had done and taught.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, Come apart into the deſert place, and reſt a litle. For there vvere that came and vvent, many: and they had not ſo much as ſpace to eate.
label: Mark

text: And going vp into the boate, they vvent into a deſert place apart.
label: Mark

text: And they ſavv them going avvay, and many knevv: and they ranne flocking thither on foote from al cities, and preuented them.
label: Mark

text: And going forth, IESVS ſavv a great multitude: and he had compaſſion on them, becauſe they vvere as ſheepe not hauing a ſhepheard, and he began to teach them many things.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen the day vvas novv farre ſpent, his Diſciples came to him, ſaying, This is a deſert place, and the houre is novv paſt:
label: Mark

text: dimiſſe them, that going out into the next villages and tovvnes, they may bie them ſelues meates to eate.
label: Mark

text: And he anſvvering ſaid, Giue ye them to eate. And they ſaid to him, Let vs goe and bie bread for tvvo hundred pence: and vve vvil giue them to eate.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaith to them, Hovv many loaues haue you? goe and ſee. And vvhen they knevv, they ſay, Fiue, and tvvo fiſhes.
label: Mark

text: And he commaunded them that they ſhould make al ſit dovvne, by companies vpon the greene graſſe.
label: Mark

text: And they ſate dovvne in rankes by hundreds and fifties.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he had taken the fiue loaues, and the tvvo fiſhes: looking vp vnto heauen, he bleſſed, and brake the loaues, and gaue to his Diſciples to ſet before them: and the tvvo fiſhes he deuided to al.
label: Mark

text: And al did eate, and had their fill.
label: Mark

text: And they tooke vp the leauings, tvvelue ful baſkets of fragments: and of the fiſhes.
label: Mark

text: And they that did eate, vvere fiue thouſand men.
label: Mark

text: And immediatly he compelled his Diſciples to goe vp into the boate, that they might goe before him beyond the ſtraite to Bethſaida: vvhiles him ſelf did dimiſſe the people.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he had dimiſſed them, he vvent into the mountaine to pray.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen it vvas late, the boate vvas in the middes of the ſea, and him ſelf alone on the land.
label: Mark

text: And ſeeing them labouring in rovving (for the vvinde vvas againſt them) and about the fourth vvatch of the night he commeth to them vvalking vpon the ſea: and he vvould haue paſſed by them.
label: Mark

text: But they ſeeing him vvalking vpon the ſea, thought it vvas a ghoſt, and cried out.
label: Mark

text: For al ſavv him, and vvere troubled. And immediatly he talked vvith them, and ſaid to them, Haue confidence, it is I, feare ye not.
label: Mark

text: And he vvent vp to them into the ſhippe, and the vvinde ceaſed: and they vvere farre more aſtonied vvithin them ſelues:
label: Mark

text: for they vnderſtoode not concerning the loaues: for their hart vvas blinded.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen they had paſſed ouer, they came into the land of Genezareth, and ſet to the ſhore.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen they vvere gone out of the boate, incontinent they knevv him:
label: Mark

text: and running through that vvhole countrie, they began to carie about in couches thoſe that vvere il at eaſe, vvhere they heard he vvas.
label: Mark

text: And vvhitherſoeuer he entred into townes or into villages or cities, they laid the ſicke in the ſtreates, and beſought him that they might touche but the hemme of his garment: and as many as touched him, vvere made vvhole. ⊢
label: Mark

text: AND there aſſemble together vnto him the Phariſees and certaine of the Scribes, comming from Hieruſalem.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen they had ſeen certaine of his diſciples eate bread vvith common hands, that is, not vvaſhed, they blamed them.
label: Mark

text: For the Phariſees and al the Ievves, vnles they often vvaſh their hands, eate not, holding the tradition of the Auncients:
label: Mark

text: and from the market, vnles they be waſhed, they eate not: and many other things there be that vvere deliuered vnto them to obſerue, the vvaſhings of cuppes and cruſes, and of braſen veſſels & beddes.
label: Mark

text: And the Phariſees and Scribes aſked him, Why do not thy diſciples vvalke according to the tradition of the Auncients, but they eate bread vvith common hands?
label: Mark

text: But he anſvvering, ſaid to them, Wel did Eſay Prophecie of you hypocrites, as it is vvritten, This people honoureth me with their lippes, but their hart is farre from me.
label: Mark

text: and in vaine doe they vvorſhip me, teaching doctrines precepts of men.
label: Mark

text: For leauing the commaundement of God, you hold the traditions of men, the vvaſhings of cruſes and cuppes: & many other things you doe like to theſe.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, Wel do you fruſtrate the precept of God, that you may obſerue your ovvne tradition.
label: Mark

text: For Moyſes ſaid, Honour thy father & thy mother. and, He that ſhal curſe father or mother, dying let him dye.
label: Mark

text: But you ſay, If a man ſay to father or mother, Corban (vvhich is a gift) vvhatſoeuer proceedeth from me, ſhal profit thee:
label: Mark

text: and further you ſuffer him not to doe ought for his father or mother,
label: Mark

text: defeating the vvord of God for your ovvne tradition vvhich you haue giuen forth. and many other things of this ſort you doe.
label: Mark

text: And calling againe the multitude vnto him, he ſaid to them, Heare me al you, and vnderſtand.
label: Mark

text: Nothing is without a man entring into him, that can defile him. but the things that proceede from a man thoſe are they that make a man common.
label: Mark

text: If any man haue eares to heare, let him heare.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he vvas entred into the houſe from the multitude, his Diſciples aſked him the parable.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaith to them, So are you alſo vnſkilful? Vnderſtand you not that euery thing from vvithout, entring into a man, can not make him common:
label: Mark

text: becauſe it entreth not into his hart, but goeth into the belly, and is caſt out into the priuy, purging al the meates?
label: Mark

text: But he ſaid that the things vvhich come forth from a man, they make a man common.
label: Mark

text: For from vvithin out of the hart of men proceede euil cogitations, aduouteries, fornications, murders,
label: Mark

text: theftes, auarices, wickedneſſe, guile, impudicities, an euil eye, blaſphemie, pride, foliſhnes.
label: Mark

text: Al theſe euils proceede from vvithin, and make a man common.
label: Mark

text: And riſing from thence he vvent into the coaſtes of Tyre and Sidon: and entring into a houſe, he vvould that no man ſhould knovv, and he could not be hid.
label: Mark

text: For a woman immediatly as ſhe heard of him, vvhoſe daughter had an vncleane ſpirit, entred in, and fel dovvne at his feete.
label: Mark

text: For the vvoman vvas a Gentile, a Syrophaenician borne. And ſhe beſought him that he vvould caſt forth the diuel out of her daughter.
label: Mark

text: Who ſaid to her, Suffer firſt the children to be filled. for it is not good to take the childrens bread, and caſt it to the dogges.
label: Mark

text: But ſhe anſvvered, and ſaid to him, Yea lord. for the vvhelpes alſo eate vnder the table of the crummes of the children.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to her, For this ſaying goe thy vvay, the deuil is gone out of thy daughter.
label: Mark

text: And when ſhe vvas departed into her houſe, ſhe found the maid lying vpon the bed, and the deuil gone out.
label: Mark

text: And againe going out of the coaſtes `of Tyre, he came by Sidon' to the ſea of Galilee through the middes of the coaſtes of Decapolis.
label: Mark

text: And they bring to him one deafe and dumme: and they beſought him that he vvould impoſe his hand vpon him.
label: Mark

text: And taking him from the multitude apart, he put his fingers into his eares: and ſpitting, touched his tongue.
label: Mark

text: and looking vp vnto heauen, he groned, and ſaid to him, Ephphetha, vvhich is, Be thou opened.
label: Mark

text: And immediatly his eares vvere opened, and the ſtring of his tongue vvas looſed, and he ſpake right.
label: Mark

text: And he commaunded them not to tel any body. But hovv much he commaunded them, ſo much the more a great deale did they publiſh it,
label: Mark

text: and ſo much the more did they vvonder, ſaying, He hath done al things vvel: he hath made both the deafe to heare, and the dumme to ſpeake. ⊢
label: Mark

text: IN thoſe daies againe vvhen there vvas a great multitude, and had not what to eate: calling his Diſciples together, he ſaith to them,
label: Mark

text: I haue compaſsion vpon the multitude: becauſe loe three daies they now endure vvith me, neither haue vvhat to eate.
label: Mark

text: and if I dimiſſe them faſting into their home, they vvil faint in the vvay: for ſome of them came farre of.
label: Mark

text: And his Diſciples anſvvered him, Whence may a man fil them here vvith bread in the vvildernes?
label: Mark

text: And he aſked them, Hovv many loaues haue ye? Who ſaid, Seuen.
label: Mark

text: And he commaunded the multitude to ſit dovvne vpon the ground. And taking the ſeuen loaues, giuing thankes he brake, and gaue to his Diſciples for to ſet before them, and they did ſet them before the multitude.
label: Mark

text: And they had a fevv litle fiſhes: and he bleſſed them, and commaunded them to be ſet before them.
label: Mark

text: And they did eate and vvere filled. and they tooke vp that vvhich vvas left of the fragments, ſeuen maundes.
label: Mark

text: And they that had eaten vvere about foure thouſand: and he dimiſſed them.
label: Mark

text: And immediatly going vp into the boate vvith his Diſciples, he came into the quarters of Dalmanûtha.
label: Mark

text: And the Phariſees vvent forth, and began to queſtion vvith him, aſking of him a ſigne from heauen, tempting him.
label: Mark

text: And groning in ſpirit, he ſaith, Why doth this generation aſke a ſigne? Amen I ſay to you, If a ſigne ſhal be giuen to this generation.
label: Mark

text: And leauing them, he vvent vp againe into the boate, and paſſed beyond the ſtraite.
label: Mark

text: And they forgot to take bread: and they had but one loafe vvith them in the boate.
label: Mark

text: And he commaunded them, ſaying, Looke vvel and bevvare of the leauen of the Phariſees, and the leauen of Herod.
label: Mark

text: And they reaſoned among them ſelues ſaying, Becauſe vve haue not bread.
label: Mark

text: Which IESVS knovving, ſaith to them, Why doe you reaſon, becauſe you haue not bread? do you not yet knovv nor vnderſtand? yet haue ye your hart blinded?
label: Mark

text: hauing eies ſee you not? and hauing eares heare you not? Neither do you remember?
label: Mark

text: When I brake fiue loaues among fiue thouſand: and hovv many baſkets ful of fragments tooke you vp? They ſay to him, Tvvelue.
label: Mark

text: When alſo ſeuen loaues among foure thouſand, hovv many maundes of fragments tooke you vp? And they ſay to him, Seuen.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, Hovv do you not yet vnderſtand?
label: Mark

text: And they come to Bethſaida: and they bring to him one blinde, and deſired him that he vvould touche him.
label: Mark

text: And taking the hand of the blinde, he led him forth out of the towne: and ſpitting into his eies, impoſing his hands, he aſked him if he ſavv any thing.
label: Mark

text: And looking vp, he ſaid, I ſee men as it vvere trees, vvalking.
label: Mark

text: After that againe he impoſed his hands vpon his eies, and be began to ſee, and vvas reſtored, ſo that he ſavv al things clerely.
label: Mark

text: And he ſent him into his houſe, ſaying, Goe into thy houſe: and if thou enter in to the tovvne, tel no body.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS vvent forth and his Diſciples into the tovvnes of Caeſarêa-Philippi: and in the vvay he aſked his Diſciples, ſaying to them, Whom do men ſay that I am?
label: Mark

text: Who anſvvered him, ſaying, Iohn the Baptiſt, ſome Elias, & other ſome as it vvere one of the Prophets.
label: Mark

text: Then he ſaith to them, But vvhom do you ſay that I am? Peter anſvvering ſaid to him, Thou art Chriſt.
label: Mark

text: And he threatened them that they ſhould not tel any man of him.
label: Mark

text: And he began to teache them, that the Sonne of man muſt ſuffer many things, and be reiected of the Auncients and of the high Prieſtes and the Scribes, and be killed: and after three daies riſe againe.
label: Mark

text: And he ſpake the vvord openly. And Peter taking him, began to rebuke him.
label: Mark

text: VVho turning, and ſeeing his Diſciples, threatened Peter, ſaying, Goe behind me Satan, becauſe thou ſauoureſt not the things that are of God, but that are of men.
label: Mark

text: And calling the multitude together with his Diſciples, he ſaid to them, If any man wil folow me, let him deny him ſelf, and take vp his croſſe, and folow me.
label: Mark

text: For he that wil ſaue his life, ſhal loſe it: and he that ſhal loſe his life for me and the Goſpel, ſhal ſaue it.
label: Mark

text: For what ſhal it profit a man, if he gaine the whole world, and ſuffer damage of his ſoule?
label: Mark

text: Or what permutation ſhal a man giue for his ſoule?
label: Mark

text: For he that ſhal be aſhamed of me, and of my wordes in this aduouterous and ſinful generation, the Sonne of man alſo wil be aſhamed of him, when he ſhal come in the glorie of his father with the holy Angels.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, Amen I ſay to you, that there be ſome of them that ſtand here, vvhich ſhal not taſt of death, vntil they ſee the kingdom of God comming in povver.
label: Mark

text: And after ſix daies IESVS taketh Peter and Iames and Iohn: and bringeth them alone into a high mountaine apart, and vvas transfigured before them.
label: Mark

text: And his garments vvere made gliſtering and vvhite excedingly as ſnow, the like vvhereof a fuller cannot make vvhite vpon the earth.
label: Mark

text: And there appeared to them Elias vvith Moyſes: and they vvere talking vvith IESVS.
label: Mark

text: And Peter anſvvering, ſaid to IESVS, Rabbi, it is good for vs to be here: and let vs make three tabernacles, one for thee, and one for Moyſes, and one for Elias.
label: Mark

text: For he knevv not vvhat he ſaid: for they vvere frighted vvith feare:
label: Mark

text: and there vvas a cloude ouerſhadovving them, and a voice came out of the cloude, ſaying, This is my Sonne moſt deere: heare ye him.
label: Mark

text: And immediatly looking about, they ſavv no man any more but IESVS only vvith them.
label: Mark

text: And as they deſcended from the mountaine, he commaunded them that they ſhould not tel any man vvhat things they had ſeen: but vvhen the Sonne of man ſhal be riſen againe from the dead.
label: Mark

text: And they kept in the vvord vvith them ſelues: queſtioning together vvhat that ſhould be, when he ſhal be riſen from the dead.
label: Mark

text: And they aſked him, ſaying, What ſay the Phariſees then and the Scribes, that Elias muſt come firſt?
label: Mark

text: Who anſvvering ſaid to them, Elias vvhen he commeth firſt, ſhal reſtore al things: and `hovv' it is vvritten of the Sonne of man, that he ſhal ſuffer many things and be contemned.
label: Mark

text: But I ſay to you that Elias alſo is come (and they haue done to him vvhatſoeuer they vvould) as it is vvritten of him.
label: Mark

text: And comming to his Diſciples, he ſavv a great multitude about them, and the Scribes queſtioning vvith them.
label: Mark

text: And forthvvith al the people ſeeing IESVS, vvas aſtonied, and much afraid: and running to him, ſaluted him.
label: Mark

text: And he aſked them, What do you queſtion of among you?
label: Mark

text: And one of the multitude anſvvering, ſaid, Maiſter, I haue brought my ſonne to thee, hauing a dumme ſpirit,
label: Mark

text: Who, vvhereſoeuer he taketh him, daſheth him, and he fometh, and gnaſheth vvith the teeth, and vvithereth: and I ſpake to thy Diſciples to caſt him out, and they could not.
label: Mark

text: Who anſvvering them, ſaid, O incredulous generation, hovv long ſhal I be vvith you? hovv long ſhal I ſuffer you? bring him vnto me.
label: Mark

text: And they brought him. And vvhen he had ſeen him, immediatly the ſpirit troubled him: and being throvven vpon the ground, he tumbled foming.
label: Mark

text: And he aſked his father, Hovv long time is it ſince this hath chaunced vnto him? But he ſaid, From his infancie:
label: Mark

text: and often times hath he caſt him into fire and into vvaters, to deſtroy him. but if thou canſt any thing, helpe vs, hauing compaſsion on vs.
label: Mark

text: And Ieſus ſaid to him, If thou canſt beleeue, al things are poſsible to him that beleeueth.
label: Mark

text: And incontinent the father of the boy crying out, vvith teares ſaid, I do beleeue Lord: helpe my incredulity.
label: Mark

text: And when IESVS ſaw the people running together, he threatened the vncleane ſpirit, ſaying to him, Deafe and dumme ſpirit, I commaunde thee, goe out of him, and enter not any more into him.
label: Mark

text: And crying out, and greatly tearing him, he vvent out of him, and he became as dead, ſo that many ſaid, That he is dead.
label: Mark

text: But IESVS holding his hand, lifted him vp: and he roſe.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he vvas entred into the houſe, his Diſciples ſecretely aſked him, Why could not vve caſt him out?
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, This kinde can goe out by nothing, but by prayer and faſting. ⊢
label: Mark

text: And departing thence they paſſed by Galilee, neither vvould he that any man ſhould knovv.
label: Mark

text: And he taught his Diſciples, and ſaid to them, That the Sonne of man ſhal be betrayed into the hands of men, and they ſhal kil him, and being killed the third day he ſhal riſe againe.
label: Mark

text: But they knevv not the vvord: and they vvere afraid to aſke him.
label: Mark

text: And they came to Capharnaum. VVho, vvhen he vvas in the houſe, aſked them, What did you treate of in the vvay?
label: Mark

text: But they held their peace. for in the vvay they had diſputed among them ſelues, vvhich of them ſhould be the greater.
label: Mark

text: And ſitting dovvne, he called the Tvvelue, and ſaith to them, If any man vvil be firſt, he ſhal be laſt of al, and the miniſter of al.
label: Mark

text: And taking a childe, he ſet him in the middes of them. VVhom vvhen he had embraced, he ſaid to them,
label: Mark

text: VVhoſoeuer ſhal receiue one of ſuch children in my name, receiueth me. and vvhoſoeuer ſhal receiue me, receiueth not me, but him that ſent me.
label: Mark

text: Iohn anſvvered him, ſaying, Maiſter vve ſavv one caſting out deuils in thy name, vvho folovveth not vs, and vve prohibited him.
label: Mark

text: But IESVS ſaid, Do not prohibit him. for there is no man that doth a miracle in my name, and can ſoone ſpeake il of me.
label: Mark

text: for he that is not againſt you, is for you.
label: Mark

text: For whoſoeuer ſhal giue you to drinke a cuppe of vvater in my name, becauſe you are Chriſts: amen I ſay to you, he ſhal not loſe his revvard.
label: Mark

text: And vvhoſoeuer ſhal ſcandalize one of theſe litle ones beleeuing in me: it is good for him rather if a milſtone vvere put about his necke, and he vvere caſt into the ſea.
label: Mark

text: And if thy hand ſcandalize thee, cut it of. it is good for thee to enter into life, maimed, then hauing tvvo hands to goe into hel, into the fire vnquencheable,
label: Mark

text: vvhere their vvorme dieth not, and the fire quencheth not.
label: Mark

text: And if thy foote ſcandalize thee, choppe it of. it is good for thee to enter into life euerlaſting, lame, rather then hauing tvvo feete, to be caſt into the hel of vnquencheable fire,
label: Mark

text: vvhere their vvorme dieth not, and the fire quencheth not.
label: Mark

text: And if thine eye ſcandalize thee, caſt it out. it is good for thee vvith one eye to enter into the kingdom of God, rather then hauing tvvo eies, to be caſt into the hel of fire,
label: Mark

text: vvhere their vvorme dieth not, and the fire quencheth not.
label: Mark

text: For euery one ſhal be ſalted vvith fire: and euery victime ſhal be ſalted vvith ſalt.
label: Mark

text: Salt is good. but if the ſalt ſhal be vnſeaſoned: vvhervvith vvil you ſeaſon it? Haue ſalt in you, and haue peace among you.
label: Mark

text: AND riſing vp thence, he commeth into the coaſtes of Ievvrie beyond Iordan: and the multitudes aſſemble againe vnto him. and as he vvas accuſtomed, againe he taught them.
label: Mark

text: And the Phariſees comming neere, aſked him, Is it lavvful for a man to dimiſſe his vvife? tempting him.
label: Mark

text: But he anſvvering, ſaid to them, VVhat did Moyſes commaund you?
label: Mark

text: Who ſaid, Moyſes permitted to vvrite a bil of diuorce, and to dimiſſe her.
label: Mark

text: To vvhom IESVS anſvvering, ſaid, For the hardnes of your hart he vvrote you this precept.
label: Mark

text: but from the beginning of the creation God made them male and femal.
label: Mark

text: For this cauſe, man ſhal leaue his father and mother: and ſhal cleaue to his vvife,
label: Mark

text: and they tvvo ſhal be in one fleſh. therfore novv they are not tvvo, but one fleſh.
label: Mark

text: That therfore vvhich God hath ioyned together, let not man ſeparate.
label: Mark

text: And in the houſe againe his Diſciples aſked him of the ſame thing.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaith to them, Whoſoeuer dimiſſeth his vvife and marrieth an other: committeth aduoutrie vpon her.
label: Mark

text: And if the vvife dimiſſe her huſband, and mary an other, ſhe committeth aduoutrie.
label: Mark

text: And they offered to him yong children, that he might touche them. And the Diſciples threatened thoſe that offered them.
label: Mark

text: Whom vvhen IESVS ſavv, he tooke it il, and ſaid to them, Suffer the litle children to come vnto me, and prohibit them not. for the kingdom of God is for ſuch.
label: Mark

text: Amen I ſay to you: Whoſoeuer receiueth not the kingdom of God as a litle childe, ſhal not enter into it.
label: Mark

text: And embracing them, and impoſing hands vpon them, he bleſſed them.
label: Mark

text: And when he vvas gone forth in the way, a certaine man running forth and kneeling before him aſked him, Good Maiſter, vvhat ſhal I doe that I may receiue life euerlaſting?
label: Mark

text: And IESVS ſaid to him, Why calleſt thou me good? None is good but one, God.
label: Mark

text: Thou knoweſt the commaundements, Commit not aduoutrie, Kil not, Steale not, Beare not falſe witneſſe, doe no fraude, Honour thy father and mother.
label: Mark

text: But he anſwering, ſaid to him, Maiſter al theſe things I haue obſerued from my youth.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS beholding him, loued him, and ſaid to him, One thing is vvanting vnto thee: goe, ſel whatſoeuer thou haſt, and giue to the poore, and thou ſhalt haue treaſure in heauen: and come, folovv me.
label: Mark

text: Who being ſtroken ſad at the vvord, vvent avvay ſorovvful. for he had many poſſeſsions.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS looking about, ſaith to his Diſciples, Hovv hardly ſhal they that haue money, enter into the kingdom of God!
label: Mark

text: And the Diſciples vvere aſtonied at his vvordes. But IESVS againe anſvvering, ſaith to them, Children, hovv hard is it for them that truſt in money, to enter into the kingdom of God!
label: Mark

text: It is eaſier for a camel to paſſe through a nedels eie, then for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
label: Mark

text: VVho marueled more, ſaying to them ſelues, And vvho can be ſaued?
label: Mark

text: And IESVS beholding them, ſaith, VVith men it is impoſsibile: but not vvith God. for al things are poſsible vvith God.
label: Mark

text: And Peter began to ſay vnto him, Behold, vve haue left al things, and haue folowed thee.
label: Mark

text: IESVS anſvvering, ſaid, Amen I ſay to you, there is no man vvhich hath left houſe, or brethren, or ſiſters, or father, or mother, or children, or landes for me and for the Goſpel:
label: Mark

text: that ſhal not receiue an hundred times ſo much novv in this time: houſes, and brethren, and ſiſters, and mothers, and children, and landes, vvith perſecutions: and in the vvorld to come life euerlaſting.
label: Mark

text: But many that are firſt, ſhal be laſt: and the laſt, firſt.
label: Mark

text: And they vvere in the vvay going vp to Hieruſalem: and IESVS vvent before them, and they vvere aſtonied: and folowing vvere afraid. And taking againe the Tvvelue, he began to tel them the things that ſhould befal him.
label: Mark

text: That, behold vve goe vp to Hieruſalem, and the Sonne of man ſhal be betrayed to the cheefe Prieſtes, and to the Scribes and Auncients, and they ſhal condemne him to death, and ſhal deliuer him to the Gentiles,
label: Mark

text: and they ſhal mocke him, and ſpit on him, and ſcourge him, and kil him, and the third day he ſhal riſe againe.
label: Mark

text: And there come to him Iames and Iohn the ſonnes of Zebedee, ſaying, Maiſter, vve vvil that vvhat thing ſoeuer we ſhal aſke, thou doe it to vs.
label: Mark

text: But he ſaid to them, What vvil you that I doe to you?
label: Mark

text: And they ſaid, Graunt to vs, that vve may ſit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glorie.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS ſaid to them, You vvotte not vvhat you aſke. can you drinke the cuppe that I drinke: or be baptized vvith the baptiſme vvhervvith I am baptized?
label: Mark

text: But they ſaid to him, VVe can. And IESVS ſaid to them, The cuppe in deede vvhich I drinke, you ſhal drinke: and vvith the baptiſme vvhervvith I am baptized, ſhal you be baptized:
label: Mark

text: but to ſit on my right hand or on my left, is not mine to giue vnto you, but to vvhom it is prepared.
label: Mark

text: And the ten hearing, began to be diſpleaſed at Iames and Iohn.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS calling them, ſaith to them, You knovv that they vvhich ſeeme to rule ouer the gentiles, ouerrule them: and their Princes haue povver ouer them.
label: Mark

text: But it is not ſo in you. but vvhoſoeuer vvil be greater, ſhal be your miniſter:
label: Mark

text: and vvhoſoeuer vvil be firſt among you, ſhal be the ſeruant of al.
label: Mark

text: For the Sonne of man alſo is not come to be miniſtred vnto, but to miniſter, and to giue his life a redempption for many.
label: Mark

text: And they come to Iericho: and vvhen he departed from Iericho, and his Diſciples, and a very great multitude, the ſonne of Timæus, Bar-timæus the blinde man, ſate by the way ſide begging.
label: Mark

text: VVho vvhen he had heard, that it is IESVS of Nazareth: he began to crie, and to ſay, IESVS, ſonne of Dauid, haue mercie vpon me.
label: Mark

text: And many threatened him, to hold his peace. but he cried much more, Sonne of Dauid,
label: Mark

text: haue mercie vpon me. And IESVS ſtanding ſtil commaunded him to be called. And they call the blinde man, ſaying to him, Be of better comfort, ariſe, he calleth thee.
label: Mark

text: Who caſting of his garment leapt vp, and came to him.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS anſvvering, ſaid to him, VVhat vvilt thou that I doe vnto thee? And the blinde man ſaid to him, Rabbôni, that I may ſee.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS ſaid to him, Goe thy vvaies, thy faith hath made the ſafe. And forthvvith he ſavv, and folovved him in the vvay.
label: Mark

text: AND vvhen they came nigh vnto Hieruſalem and Bethania to Mount-oliuet, he ſendeth tvvo of his Diſciples,
label: Mark

text: and ſaith to them, Goe into the tovvne that is againſt you, and immediatly entring in thither, you ſhal finde a colt tied, vpon vvhich no man yet hath ſitten: looſe him, and bring him.
label: Mark

text: And if any man ſhal ſay to you, VVhat doe you? ſay that he is needeful for our Lord: and incontinent he vvil ſend him hither.
label: Mark

text: And going their vvaies, they found the colt tied before the gate vvithout in the meeting of tvvo vvaies: and they looſe him.
label: Mark

text: And certaine of them that ſtoode there, ſaid to them, VVhat doe you looſing the colt?
label: Mark

text: Vvho ſaid to them as IESVS had commaunded them: and they did let him goe vvith them.
label: Mark

text: And they brought the colt to IESVS: and they lay their garments vpon him, and he ſate vpon him.
label: Mark

text: And many ſpred their garments in the vvay: and others did cut boughes from the trees, and ſtravved them in the vvay.
label: Mark

text: And they that vvent before and they that folovved, cried ſaying, Hoſanna, bleſſed is he that commeth in the name of our Lord.
label: Mark

text: bleſſed is the kingdom of our father Dauid that commeth, Hoſanna in the higheſt.
label: Mark

text: And he entred Hieruſalem into the temple: and hauing vevved al things round about, vvhen novv the euening houre vvas come, he vvent forth into Bethania vvith the Tvvelue.
label: Mark

text: And the next day vvhen they departed from Bethania, he vvas an hungred.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he had ſeen a farre of a figtree hauing leaues, he came if happily he could finde any thing on it. And vvhen he was come to it, he found nothing but leaues. for it vvas not the time for figges.
label: Mark

text: And anſvvering he ſaid to it, Novv no man eate fruite of the any more for euer. And his Diſciples heard it.
label: Mark

text: And they come to Hieruſalem. And vvhen he vvas entred into the temple, he began to caſt out them that ſold and bought in the temple, and the tables of the bankers, and the chaires of them that ſold pigeons he ouerthrevv.
label: Mark

text: and he ſuffred not that any man ſhould carie a veſſel through the temple:
label: Mark

text: and he taught, ſaying to them, Is it not vvritten, That my houſe ſhal be called the houſe of prayer to al nations? But you haue made it a denne of theeues.
label: Mark

text: VVhich vvhen the cheefe Prieſtes and the Scribes had heard, they ſought hovv they might deſtroy him. for they vvere afraid of him, becauſe the vvhole multitude vvas in admiration vpon his doctrine.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen euening vvas come, he vvent forth out of the citie.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen they paſſed by in the morning, they ſavv the figtree vvithered from the rootes.
label: Mark

text: And Peter remembring, ſaid to him, Rabbi, behold the figtree that thou didſt curſe, is vvithered.
label: Mark

text: b And IESVS anſvvering ſaith to them, Haue faith of God.
label: Mark

text: Amen I ſay to you, that vvhoſoeuer ſhal ſay to this mountaine, Be taken vp and be caſt into the ſea, and ſhal not ſtagger in his hart, but beleeue that vvhatſoeuer he ſaith, ſhal be done: it ſhal be done vnto him.
label: Mark

text: Therfore I ſay to you, al things vvhatſoeuer you aſke, praying, beleeue that you ſhal receiue, and they ſhal come vnto you. ⊢
label: Mark

text: And when you ſhal ſtand to pray, forgiue if you haue ought againſt any man: that alſo your father which is in heauen, may forgiue you your ſinnes:
label: Mark

text: If ſo be that you wil not forgiue, neither wil your father that is in heauen, forgiue you your ſinnes.
label: Mark

text: And they come againe to Hieruſalem. And when he walked in the temple, there come to him the cheefe Prieſtes and the Scribes and the Auncients,
label: Mark

text: and they ſay to him, In what power doeſt thou theſe things? and who hath giuen thee this power, that thou ſhouldeſt doe theſe things?
label: Mark

text: And IESVS anſwering ſaid to them, I alſo wil aſke you one word, and anſwer you me: and I wil tel you in what power I doe theſe things.
label: Mark

text: The baptiſme of Iohn was it from heauen, or from men? anſwer me.
label: Mark

text: But they thought with them ſelues, ſaying, If we ſay, From heauen: he wil ſay, Why then did you not beleeue him?
label: Mark

text: If we ſay, From men, they feared the people. for al accounted Iohn that he was in deede a Prophet.
label: Mark

text: And they anſwering ſay to IESVS, We know not. And IESVS anſwering ſaith to them, Neither do I tel you in what power I doe theſe things.
label: Mark

text: AND he began to ſpeake to them in parables, A man planted a vineyard and made a hedge about it, and digged a trough, and built a tovvre, and let it out to huſbandmen: and vvent forth into a ſtrange countrie.
label: Mark

text: And he ſent to the huſbandmen in ſeaſon a ſeruant, to receiue of the huſbandmen, of the fruite of the vineyard.
label: Mark

text: Vvho apprehending him, bette him: and ſent him avvay emptie.
label: Mark

text: And againe he ſent to them an other ſeruant: and him they wounded in the head, and vſed him reprochefully.
label: Mark

text: And againe he ſent an other, and him they killed: and many other, beating certaine, and killing others.
label: Mark

text: Therfore hauing yet one ſonne moſt deere: him alſo he ſent vnto them laſt ſaying, That they vvill reuerence my ſonne.
label: Mark

text: But the huſbandmen ſaid one to an other, This is the heier: come, let vs kill him: and the inheritance ſhal be ours.
label: Mark

text: And apprehending him, they killed him, and caſt him forth out of the vineyard.
label: Mark

text: What therfore vvil the lord of the vineyard doe? He vvil come and deſtroy the huſbandmen: and vvil giue the vineyard to others.
label: Mark

text: Neither haue you read this ſcripture, The ſtone which the builders reiected, the ſame is made the head of the corner:
label: Mark

text: By our Lord was this done, and it is maruelous in our eies?
label: Mark

text: And they ſought to lay hands on him, and they feared the multitude. for they knevv that he ſpake this parable to them. And leauing him they vvent their way.
label: Mark

text: And they ſend to him certaine of the Phariſees and of the Herodians: that they ſhould entrappe him in his vvord.
label: Mark

text: VVho comming, ſay to him, Maiſter, vve knovv that thou art a true ſpeaker, and careſt not for any man: for thou doeſt not looke vpon the perſon of men, but teacheſt the vvay of God in truth. is it lavvful to giue tribute to Cæſar: or ſhal vve not giue it?
label: Mark

text: Who knovving their ſubteltie, ſaid to them, VVhy tempt you me? bring me a penie that I may ſee it.
label: Mark

text: But they brought it him. And he ſaith to them, VVhoſe is this image, and inſcription? They ſay to him, Cæſars.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS anſvvering, ſaid to them, Render therfore the things that are Cæſars, to Cæſar: and that are Gods, to God. And they marueled at him.
label: Mark

text: And there came to him the Saducees that ſay there is no reſurrection: and they aſked him ſaying, Maiſter,
label: Mark

text: Moyſes vvrote vnto vs, that if any mans brother die, and leaue his wife, and leaue no children, his brother ſhal take his vvife and raiſe vp ſeede to his brother.
label: Mark

text: There vvere therfore ſeuen brethren: and the firſt tooke a vvife, and died leauing no iſſue.
label: Mark

text: And the ſecond tooke her, and died: and neither this left iſſue. And the third in like maner.
label: Mark

text: And the ſeuen tooke her in like ſort: and did not leaue iſſue. Laſt of al the vvoman alſo died.
label: Mark

text: In the reſurrection therfore vvhen they ſhal riſe againe, vvhoſe vvife ſhal ſhe be of theſe? for the ſeuen had her to vvife.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS anſvvering, ſaid to them, Do ye not therfore erre , not knovving the ſcriptures, nor the povver of God?
label: Mark

text: For vvhen they ſhal riſe againe from the dead, they ſhal neither marrie, nor be married, but are as the Angels in heauen.
label: Mark

text: And as concerning the dead, that they do riſe againe, haue you not read in the booke of Moyſes, hovv in the buſh God ſpake to him, ſaying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Iſaac, and the God of Iacob?
label: Mark

text: He is not the God of the dead, but of the liuing. You therfore are much deceiued.
label: Mark

text: And there came one of the Scribes that had heard them queſtioning, and ſeeing that he had wel anſwered them, aſked him vvhich vvas the firſt commaundement of al.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS anſwered him, That the firſt commaundement of al is, Heare Iſrael: the Lord thy God, is one God.
label: Mark

text: And thou ſhalt loue the Lord thy God from thy vvhole hart, and with thy vvhole ſoul, and vvith thy vvhole minde, and vvith thy vvhole povver. This is the firſt commaundement.
label: Mark

text: And the ſecond is like to it, Thou ſhalt loue they neighbour as thy ſelf. An other commaundement greater then theſe there is not.
label: Mark

text: And the Scribe ſaid to him, VVel Maiſter, thou haſt ſaid in truth, that there is one God, and there is none other beſides him.
label: Mark

text: And that he be loued from the vvhole hart, and vvith the vvhole vnderſtanding, and vvith the vvhole ſoule, and vvith the vvhole ſtrength: and to loue his neighbour as him ſelf is a greater thing then al holocauſtes and ſacrifices.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS ſeeing that he had anſvvered vviſely, ſaid to him, Thou art not farre from the kingdom of God. And no man novv durſt aſke him.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS anſvvering, ſaid, teaching in the temple, Hovv do the Scribes ſay, that Chriſt is the ſonne of Dauid?
label: Mark

text: For Dauid him ſelf ſaith in the holy Ghoſt: Our Lord ſaid to my Lord, ſit on my right hand, vntil I put thine enemies the foote-ſtoole of thy feete.
label: Mark

text: Dauid therfore him ſelf calleth him Lord, and vvhence is he his ſonne? And a great multitude heard him gladly.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them in his doctrine, Take heede of the Scribes that vvil vvalke in long robes, and be ſaluted in the market-place,
label: Mark

text: and ſit in the firſt chaires in the Synagogs, and loue the higheſt places at ſuppers:
label: Mark

text: vvhich deuoure vvidovves houſes vnder the pretence of long prayer: theſe ſhal receiue larger iudgement.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS ſitting ouer againſt the treaſurie, beheld how the multitude did caſt money into the treaſurie, and many rich men did caſt in much.
label: Mark

text: And when there came a certaine poore widow, ſhe caſt in two mites, which is a farthing.
label: Mark

text: And calling his Diſciples together, he ſaith to them, Amen I ſay to you, that this poore widow hath caſt in more then al that haue caſt into the treaſurie.
label: Mark

text: For al they of their aboundance haue caſt in: but ſhe, of her penurie hath caſt in al that ſhe had, her whole liuing.
label: Mark

text: AND vvhen he vvent out of the temple, one of his Diſciples ſaith to him, Maiſter, behold what maner of ſtones, and vvhat kinde of buildings.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS anſvvering, ſaid to him, Seeſt thou al theſe great buildings? There ſhal not be left a ſtone vpon a ſtone, that ſhal not be deſtroied.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he ſate in Mount-oliuet againſt the temple, Peter and Iames and Iohn and Andrevv aſked him apart,
label: Mark

text: Tel vs, vvhen ſhal theſe things be? and vvhat ſhal be the ſigne vvhen al theſe things ſhal begin to be conſummate?
label: Mark

text: And IESVS anſvvering began to ſay to them, See, that no man ſeduce you.
label: Mark

text: for many ſhal come in my name ſaying that I am he: and they ſhal ſeduce many.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen you ſhal heare of vvarres and bruites of vvarres, feare not. for theſe things muſt be, but the end is not yet.
label: Mark
