text: For nation ſhal riſe againſt nation and kingdom againſt kingdom, and there ſhal be earthquakes in places, and famines. Theſe things are the beginning of ſorovves.
label: Mark

text: But looke to your ſelues. For they ſhal deliuer you vp in Councels, and in Synagogs ſhal you be beaten, and you ſhal ſtand before Preſidents and Kings for my ſake, for a teſtimonie vnto them.
label: Mark

text: And into al nations firſt the Goſpel muſt be preached.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen they ſhal leade you and deliuer you, be not careful before hand vvhat you ſhal ſpeake: but that vvhich ſhal be giuen you in that houre, that ſpeake ye. For it is not you that ſpeake, but the holy Ghoſt.
label: Mark

text: And brother ſhal deliuer brother vnto death, and the father his ſonne: and the children ſhal ariſe againſt the parents, and ſhal vvorke their death.
label: Mark

text: And you ſhal be odious to al men for my name. But he that ſhal endure vnto the end, he ſhal be ſaued.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen you ſhal ſee the abomination of deſolation, ſtanding vvhere it ought not (he that readeth, let him vnderſtand) then they that are in Ievvrie, let them flee vnto the mountaines:
label: Mark

text: and he that is on the houſe-toppe, let him not goe dovvne into the houſe, nor enter in to take any thing out of his houſe:
label: Mark

text: and he that ſhal be in the field, let him not returne backe to take his garment.
label: Mark

text: And vvo to them that are vvith childe and that giue ſucke in thoſe daies.
label: Mark

text: But pray that the things chaunce not in the vvinter.
label: Mark

text: For thoſe daies ſhal be ſuch tribulations as vvere not from the beginning of the creation that God created vntil novv, neither ſhal be.
label: Mark

text: And vnles the Lord had ſhortened the daies, no fleſh ſhould be ſaued: but for the elect vvhich he hath elected, he hath ſhortened the daies.
label: Mark

text: And then if any man ſhal ſay vnto you, Loe, here is Chriſt: loe, there: do not beleeue.
label: Mark

text: For there ſhal riſe vp falſe-Chriſts and falſe-Prophets, and they ſhal ſhevv ſignes and vvonders, to ſeduce (if it be poſsible) the elect alſo.
label: Mark

text: You therfore take heede: behold I haue foretold you al things.
label: Mark

text: But in thoſe daies after that tribulation the ſunne ſhal be darkened, and the moone ſhal not giue her light,
label: Mark

text: and the ſtarres of heauen ſhal be falling dovvne, and the povvers that are in heauen, ſhal be moued.
label: Mark

text: And then they ſhal ſee the Sonne of man comming in the cloudes, vvith much povver and glorie.
label: Mark

text: And then ſhal he ſend his Angels, and ſhal gather together his elect from the foure vvindes, from the vttermoſt part of the earth to the vttermoſt part of heauen.
label: Mark

text: And of the figtree learne ye a parable. VVhen novv the bough thereof is tender, and the leaues come forth, you knovv that ſommer is very nigh.
label: Mark

text: ſo you alſo vvhen you ſhal ſee theſe things come to paſſe, knovv ye that it is very nigh, at the doores.
label: Mark

text: Amen I ſay to you, that this generation ſhal not paſſe, vntil al theſe things be done.
label: Mark

text: Heauen and earth ſhal paſſe, but my vvordes ſhal not paſſe.
label: Mark

text: But of that day or houre no man knovveth, neither the Angels in heauen, nor the Sonne, but the Father.
label: Mark

text: Take heede, vvatch, and pray. for you know not vvhen the time is.
label: Mark

text: Euen as a man vvho being gone into a ſtrange countrie, left his houſe: and gaue his ſeruants authoritie ouer ech vvorke, and commaunded the porter to vvatch.
label: Mark

text: VVatch ye therfore (for you knovv not vvhen the lord of the houſe commeth: at euen, or at midnight, or at the cocke crovving, or in the morning)
label: Mark

text: leſt comming vpon a ſoden, he finde you ſleeping.
label: Mark

text: And that vvhich I ſay to you, I ſay to al, Vvatch. ⊢
label: Mark

text: AND the Paſche vvas and the Azymes after tvvo daies: and the cheefe Prieſts and the Scribes ſought hovv they might by ſome vvile lay hands on him, and kil him.
label: Mark

text: For they ſaid, Not on the feſtiual day, leſt there might be a tumult of the people.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he vvas at Bethania in the houſe of Simon the Leper, and ſate at meate, there came a vvoman hauing an alabaſter boxe of ointment, of pretious ſpike-narde: and breaking the alabaſter-boxe, ſhe povvred it out vpon his head.
label: Mark

text: But there vvere certaine that had indignation vvithin them ſelues, and ſaid, VVhereto is this vvaſt of the ointment made?
label: Mark

text: For this ointment might haue been ſold for more then three hundred pence, and giuen to the poore. And they murmured againſt her.
label: Mark

text: But IESVS ſaid, Let her alone, vvhy do you moleſt her? ſhe hath vvrought a good vvorke vpon me.
label: Mark

text: for the poore you haue alvvaies vvith you: and vvhen you vvil, you may doe them good: but me you haue not alvvaies.
label: Mark

text: That vvhich ſhe had, ſhe hath done: ſhe hath preuented to anoint my body to the burial.
label: Mark

text: Amen I ſay to you, VVhereſoeuer this Goſpel ſhal be preached in the vvhole vvorld, that alſo vvhich ſhe hath done, ſhal be told for a memorie for her.
label: Mark

text: And Iudas Iſcariote one of the Tvvelue vvent his vvay to the cheefe Prieſts, for to betray him to them.
label: Mark

text: Who hearing it, vvere glad: and they promiſed him that they vvould giue him money. And he ſought hovv he might betray him conueniently.
label: Mark

text: And the firſt day of the Azymes vvhen they ſacrificed the Paſche, the Diſciples ſay to him, VVither vvilt thou that vve goe, and prepare for thee to eate the Paſche?
label: Mark

text: And he ſendeth tvvo of his Diſciples, and ſaith to them, Goe ye into the citie: and there ſhal meete you a man carying a pitcher of vvater, folovv him:
label: Mark

text: and vvhitherſoeuer he entreth, ſay to the maiſter of the houſe, that the Maiſter ſaith, Vvhere is my refectorie, vvhere I may eate the Paſche vvith my Diſciples?
label: Mark

text: And he vvil ſhevv you a great chamber, adorned: and there prepare for vs.
label: Mark

text: And his Diſciples vvent their vvaies, and came into the citie: and they found as he had told them, and they prepared the Paſche.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen euen vvas come, he commeth vvith the Tvvelue.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen they vvere ſitting at the table and eating, IESVS ſaid, Amen I ſay to you, that one of you ſhal betray me, he that eateth vvith me.
label: Mark

text: But they began to be ſad, and to ſay to him ſeuerally, Is it I?
label: Mark

text: VVho ſaid to them, One of the Tvvelue, he that dippeth vvith me his hand in the diſh.
label: Mark

text: and the Sonne of man in deede goeth, as it is vvritten of him, but vvo to that man by vvhom the Sonne of man ſhal be betrayed. it vvere good for him, if that man had not been borne.
label: Mark

text: And vvhiles they vvere eating, IESVS tooke bread: and bleſſing brake, and gaue to them, and ſaid, Take, THIS IS MY BODY.
label: Mark

text: And taking the chalice, giuing thankes he gaue to them. and they al dranke of it.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, THIS IS MY BLOVD OF THE NEVV TESTAMENT, THAT SHAL BE SHED FOR MANY.
label: Mark

text: Amen I ſay to you, that novv I vvil not drinke of the fruite of the vine vntil that day vvhen I ſhal drinke it new in the kingdom of God.
label: Mark

text: And an hymne being ſaid, they vvent forth into Mountoliuet.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS ſaith to them, You ſhal al be ſcandalized in me in this night: for it is vvritten, I vvil ſtrike the Paſtor, and the ſheepe ſhal be diſperſed.
label: Mark

text: But after that I ſhal be riſen againe, I vvil goe before you into Galilee.
label: Mark

text: And Peter ſaid to him, Although al ſhal be ſcandalized: yet not I.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS ſaith to him, Amen I ſay to thee, that thou this day in this night, before the cocke crovv tvviſe, ſhalt thriſe deny me.
label: Mark

text: But he ſpake more vehemently, Although I ſhould die together vvith thee, I vvil not denie thee. And in like maner alſo ſaid they al.
label: Mark

text: And they come into a farme-place called Gethſemani. And he ſaith to his Diſciples, Sit you here, vntil I pray.
label: Mark

text: And he taketh Peter and Iames and Iohn vvith him: and he began to feare and to be heauy.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaith to them, My ſoul is ſorovvful euen vnto death: ſtay here, and vvatch.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he vvas gone forvvard a litle, he fel flat vpon the ground: and he prayed that if it might be, the houre might paſſe from him:
label: Mark

text: and he ſaid, Abba, Father, al things are poſſible to thee, tranſferre this chalice from me. but not that vvhich I vvil, but that vvhich thou.
label: Mark

text: And he commeth, and findeth them ſleeping. And he ſaith to Peter, Simon, ſleepeſt thou? couldſt thou not vvatch one houre?
label: Mark

text: VVatch ye, and pray that you enter not into tentation. The ſpirit in deede is prompt, but the fleſh infirme.
label: Mark

text: And going avvay againe, he prayed, ſaying the ſelfſame vvord.
label: Mark

text: And returning, againe he found them a ſleepe (for their eies vvere heauy) and they vviſt not vvhat they ſhould anſvver him.
label: Mark

text: And he commeth the third time, and ſaith to them, Sleepe ye novv, and take reſt, it ſuffiſeth, the houre is come: behold the Sonne of man ſhal be betraied into the hands of ſinners.
label: Mark

text: Ariſe, let vs goe. behold, he that ſhal betray me, is at hand.
label: Mark

text: And as he vvas yet ſpeaking, commeth Iudas Iſcariote one of the Tvvelue, and vvith him a great multitude vvith ſvvordes and clubbes, from the cheefe Prieſtes and the Scribes and the Auncients.
label: Mark

text: And the betrayer of him had giuen them a ſigne, ſaying, VVhomſoeuer I ſhal kiſſe, it is he, lay hold on him, and leade him vvarily.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he vvas come, immediatly going to him, he ſaith, Rabbi, and he kiſſed him.
label: Mark

text: But they laid hands vpon him: and held him.
label: Mark

text: And one certaine man of the ſtanders about, dravving out a ſvvord, ſmote the ſeruant of the cheefe prieſt, and cut of his eare.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS anſvvering, ſaid to them, As to a theefe are you come out vvith ſwordes and clubbes to apprehend me?
label: Mark

text: I vvas daily vvith you in the temple teaching, and you did not lay hands on me. But, that the Scriptures may be fulfilled.
label: Mark

text: Then his diſciples leauing him, al fled.
label: Mark

text: And a certaine yong man folowed him clothed vvith ſindon vpon the bare: & they tooke him.
label: Mark

text: But he caſting of the ſindon, fled from them naked.
label: Mark

text: And they brought IESVS to the cheefe Prieſt: and al the Prieſts and the Scribes and the Auncients aſſembled together.
label: Mark

text: And Peter folovved him a farre of euen in vnto the court of the high Prieſt: and he ſate vvith the ſeruants at the fire, and vvarmed him ſelf.
label: Mark

text: And the cheefe Prieſts and al the councel ſought teſtimonie againſt IESVS, that they might put him to death, neither found they.
label: Mark

text: For many ſpake falſe witnes againſt him: and the teſtimonies vvere not conuenient.
label: Mark

text: And certaine riſing vp, bare falſe vvitnes againſt him, ſaying,
label: Mark

text: That vve heard him ſay, I vvil diſſolue this temple made vvith hand, and in three daies vvil I build an other not made vvith hand.
label: Mark

text: And their teſtimonie vvas not conuenient.
label: Mark

text: And the high Prieſt riſing vp into the middes, aſked IESVS, ſaying, Anſvvereſt thou nothing to theſe things that are obiected to thee of theſe?
label: Mark

text: But he held his peace and anſwered nothing. Againe the high Prieſt aſked him, and ſaid to him, Art thou Chriſt the ſonne of the bleſſed God?
label: Mark

text: And IESVS ſaith to him, I am. And you ſhal ſee the Sonne of man ſitting on the right hand of povver, and comming vvith the cloudes of heauen.
label: Mark

text: And the high Prieſt renting his garments, ſaith, VVhat neede vve vvitneſſes any further?
label: Mark

text: You haue heard blaſphemie. hovv thinke you? VVho al condemned him to be guilty of death.
label: Mark

text: And certaine began to ſpit vpon him, and to couer his face, and to beate him vvith buffets, and to ſay vnto him, Prophecie: and the ſeruants gaue him blovves.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen Peter vvas in the court beneath, there commeth one of the vvoman-ſeruants of the high Prieſt.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen ſhe had ſeen Peter vvarming him ſelf, beholding him ſhe ſaith, And thou vvaſt vvith IESVS of Nazareth.
label: Mark

text: But he denied, ſaying, Neither knovv I, neither vvot I vvhat thou ſaieſt. And he vvent forth before the court: and the cocke crevve.
label: Mark

text: And againe a vvench ſeeing him, began to ſay to the ſtanders about, That this fellovv is of them.
label: Mark

text: But he denied againe. And after a vvhile againe they that ſtoode by, ſaid to Peter, Verily thou art of them: for thou art alſo a Galilæan.
label: Mark

text: But he began to curſe and to ſweare, That I knovv not this man vvhom you ſpeake of.
label: Mark

text: And immediatly the cocke crevv againe. And Peter remembred the vvord that IESVS had ſaid vnto him, Before the cocke crovv tvviſe, thou ſhalt thriſe deny me. And he began to vveepe.
label: Mark

text: AND forthvvith in the morning the cheefe Prieſts vvith the auncients and the Scribes and the vvhole councel, conſulting together, binding IESVS led and deliuered him to Pilate.
label: Mark

text: And Pilate aſked him, Art thou the King of the Ievves? but he anſwering, ſaid to him, Thou ſaieſt.
label: Mark

text: And the cheefe Prieſts accuſed him in many things.
label: Mark

text: And Pilate againe aſked him, ſaying, Anſvvereſt thou nothing? ſee in hovv many things they accuſe thee.
label: Mark

text: But IESVS anſwered nothing more: ſo that Pilate marueled.
label: Mark

text: And vpon the feſtiual day he vvas vvont to releaſe vnto them one of the priſoners vvhomſoeuer they had demaunded.
label: Mark

text: And there vvas one called Barabbas, vvhich vvas put in priſon vvith ſeditious perſons, vvho in a ſedition had committed murder.
label: Mark

text: And when the multitude vvas come vp, they began to require according as alvvaies he did vnto them.
label: Mark

text: And Pilate anſvvered them, and ſaid, VVil you that I releaſe to you the King of the Ievves?
label: Mark

text: For he knevv that the cheefe Prieſts for enuy had deliuered him.
label: Mark

text: But the cheefe Prieſts moued the people, that he ſhould releaſe Barabbas rather to them.
label: Mark

text: And Pilate againe anſvvering, ſaid to them, VVhat vvil you then that I doe to the King of the Ievves?
label: Mark

text: But they againe cried, Crucifie him.
label: Mark

text: And Pilate ſaid to them, VVhy, vvhat euil hath he done? But they cried the more, Crucifie him.
label: Mark

text: And Pilate vvilling to ſatisfie the people, releaſed to them Barabbas, and deliuered IESVS, hauing vvhipped him, for to be crucified.
label: Mark

text: And the ſouldiars led him into the court of the Palace, and they call together the vvhole band:
label: Mark

text: and they clothe him in purple, and platting a crovvne of thornes, they put it vpon him.
label: Mark

text: And they began to ſalute him, Haile King of the Iewes.
label: Mark

text: And they ſmote his head vvith a reede: and they did ſpit on him. and bovving the knees, they adored him.
label: Mark

text: And after they had mocked him, they ſtripped him of the purple, and put on him his ovvne garments, and they leade him forth to crucifie him.
label: Mark

text: And they forced a certaine man that paſſed by, Simon a Cyrenêan comming from the countrie, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to take vp his croſſe.
label: Mark

text: And they bring him into the place Golgotha, vvhich being interpreted is, The place of Caluarie.
label: Mark

text: And they gaue him to drinke vvine mingled vvith myrrhe: and he tooke it not.
label: Mark

text: And crucifying him, they deuided his garments, caſting lottes vpon them, vvho ſhould take vvhich.
label: Mark

text: And it vvas the third houre, and they crucified him.
label: Mark

text: And the title of his cauſe vvas ſuperſcribed, KING OF THE IEWES.
label: Mark

text: And vvith him they crucifie tvvo theeues: one on the right hand, and an other on his left.
label: Mark

text: And the Scripture vvas fulfilled that ſaith, And vvith the vvicked he vvas reputed.
label: Mark

text: And they that paſſed by, blaſphemed him, vvagging their heades, and ſaying, Vah, 'he that deſtroieth' the temple, and in three daies 'buildeth' it:
label: Mark

text: ſaue thy ſelf, comming dovvne from the croſſe.
label: Mark

text: In like maner alſo the cheefe Prieſts mocking, ſaid vvith the Scribes one to an other, He ſaued others, him ſelf he can not ſaue.
label: Mark

text: Let Chriſt the king of Iſrael come dovvne novv from the croſſe: that vve may ſee and beleeue. And they that vvere crucified vvith him, railed at him.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen it vvas the ſixt houre, there vvas made darkenes vpon the vvhole earth vntil the ninthe houre.
label: Mark

text: And at the ninthe houre IESVS cried out vvith a mightie voice, ſaying, Eloi, Eloi, lamma-ſabacthani? Which is being interpreted, My God, my God, vvhy haſt thou forsaken me?
label: Mark

text: And certaine of the ſtanders about hearing, ſaid, Behold, he calleth Elias.
label: Mark

text: And one running and filling a ſpunge vvith vinegre, and putting it about a reede, gaue him drinke, ſaying, Let be: let vs ſee if Elias come to take him dovvne.
label: Mark

text: And IESVS putting forth a mightie voice, gaue vp the ghoſt.
label: Mark

text: And the vele of the temple vvas rent in tvvo, from the toppe to the bottome.
label: Mark

text: And the Centurion that ſtoode ouer againſt him, ſeeing that ſo crying he had giuen vp the ghoſt, ſaid, In deede this man vvas the ſonne of God.
label: Mark

text: And there vvere alſo vvomen looking on a farre of: among vvhom vvas Marie Magdalene, and Marie the mother of Iames the leſſe and of Ioſeph, and Salóme:
label: Mark

text: and vvhen he vvas in Galilee, they folovved him, and miniſtred to him, and many other vvomen that came vp together vvith him to Hieruſalem.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen euening vvas come (becauſe it vvas the Paraſceue, vvhich is the Sabboth-eue)
label: Mark

text: came Ioſeph of Arimathæa a noble Senatour, vvho him ſelf alſo vvas expecting the kingdom of God: and he vvent in boldly to Pilate, and aſked the body of IESVS.
label: Mark

text: But Pilate marueled if he vvere novv dead. And ſending for the Centurion, aſked him if he vvere novv dead.
label: Mark

text: And vvhen he vnderſtoode by the Centurion, he gaue the body to Ioſeph.
label: Mark

text: And Ioſeph bying ſindon, and taking him dovvne, vvrapped him in the ſindon, and laid him in a monument, that vvas hevved out of a rocke. And he rolled a ſtone to the doore of the monument.
label: Mark

text: And Marie Magdalene and Marie of Ioſeph beheld vvhere he vvas laid.
label: Mark

text: AND vvhen the Sabboth vvas paſt, Marie Magdalene and Marie of Iames, and Salôme bought ſpices, that comming they might anoint IESVS.
label: Mark

text: And very early the firſt of the Sabboths, they come to the monument: the ſunne being novv riſen.
label: Mark

text: And they ſaid one to an other, VVho ſhal roll vs backe the ſtone from the doore of the monument?
label: Mark

text: And looking, they ſavv the ſtone rolled backe. for it vvas very great.
label: Mark

text: And entring into the monument, they ſavv a yong man ſitting on the right hand, couered vvith a white robe: and they vvere aſtonied.
label: Mark

text: VVho ſaith to them, Be not diſmaied: you ſeeke IESVS of Nazareth, that vvas crucified: he is riſen, he is not here, behold the place vvhere they laid him.
label: Mark

text: But goe, tel his Diſciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there you ſhal ſee him, as he told you. ⊢
label: Mark

text: But they going forth, fled from the monument. for trembling and feare had inuaded them: and they ſaid nothing to any body. for they vvere afraid.
label: Mark

text: And he riſing early the firſt of the Sabboth, appeared firſt to Marie Magdalene, out of vvhom he had caſt ſeuen deuils.
label: Mark

text: She went and told them that had been vvith him, that vvere mourning and vveeping.
label: Mark

text: And they hearing that he vvas aliue and had been ſeen of her, did not beleeue.
label: Mark

text: And after this he appeared in an other ſhape to tvvo of them vvalking, as they vvere going into the countrie.
label: Mark

text: and they going told the reſt: neither them did they beleeue.
label: Mark

text: Laſt he appeared to thoſe eleuen as they ſate at the table: and he exprobrated their incredulity and hardnes of hart, becauſe they did not beleeue them that had ſeen him riſen againe.
label: Mark

text: And he ſaid to them, Going into the vvhole vvorld preach the Goſpel to al creatures.
label: Mark

text: He that beleeueth and is baptized, ſhal be ſaued: but he that beleeueth not, ſhal be condemned.
label: Mark

text: And them that beleeue theſe ſignes ſhal folow: In my name ſhal they caſt out deuils, They ſhal ſpeake vvith nevv tonges,
label: Mark

text: Serpents ſhal they take avvay, And if they drinke any deadly thing, it ſhal not hurt them, They ſhal impoſe hands vpon the ſicke: and they ſhal be vvhole.
label: Mark

text: And ſo our Lord IESVS after he ſpake vnto them, vvas aſſumpted into heauen, and ſate on the right hand of God.
label: Mark

text: But they going forth preached euery vvhere: our Lord working vvithal, and confirming the vvord with ſignes that folowed. ⊢
label: Mark

text: BECAVSE many haue gone about to compile a narration of the things that haue been accompliſhed among vs:
label: Luke

text: according as they haue deliuered vnto vs, vvho from the beginning them ſelues ſavv and vvere miniſters of the vvord:
label: Luke

text: it ſeemed good alſo vnto me hauing diligently atteined to al things from the beginning, to vvrite to thee in order, good Theophilus,
label: Luke

text: that thou maiſt knovv the veritie of thoſe vvordes vvhereof thou haſt been inſtructed.
label: Luke

text: There vvas in the daies of Herod the king of Ievvrie, a certaine Prieſt named Zacharie, of the courſe of Abia: and his vvife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name Elizabeth.
label: Luke

text: And they vvere both iuſt before God, vvalking in al the commaundements and iuſtifications of our Lord vvithout blame,
label: Luke

text: and they had no ſonne: for that Elizabeth vvas barren, and both vvere vvel ſtriken in their daies.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe: vvhen he executed the prieſtly function in the order of his courſe before God,
label: Luke

text: according to the cuſtome of the Prieſtly function, he vvent forth by lot to offer incenſe, entring into the temple of our Lord:
label: Luke

text: and al the multitude of the people vvas praying vvithout at the houre of the incenſe.
label: Luke

text: And there appeared to him an Angel of our Lord, ſtanding on the right hand of the altar of incenſe.
label: Luke

text: And Zacharie vvas troubled, ſeeing him: and feare fel vpon him.
label: Luke

text: But the Angel ſaid to him, Feare not Zacharie, for thy praier is heard: and thy vvife Elizabeth ſhal beare thee a ſonne, and thou ſhalt cal his name Iohn:
label: Luke

text: and thou ſhalt haue ioy and exultation, and many ſhal reioyce in his natiuitie.
label: Luke

text: for he ſhal be great before our Lord: and vvine and ſicer he ſhal not drinke: and he ſhal be repleniſhed vvith the Holy Ghoſt euen from his mothers vvombe.
label: Luke

text: and he ſhal conuert many of the children of Iſrael to the Lord their God,
label: Luke

text: and he ſhal goe before him in the ſpirit and vertue of Elias: that he may conuert the hartes of the fathers vnto the children, and the incredulous to the vviſedom of the iuſt, to prepare vnto the Lord a perfect people. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And Zacharie ſaid to the Angel, VVhereby ſhal I knovv this? for I am old: and my vvife is vvel ſtriken in her daies.
label: Luke

text: And the Angel anſvvering ſaid to him, I am Gabriel that aſſiſt before God: and am ſent to ſpeake to thee, and to euangelize theſe things to thee.
label: Luke

text: And behold, thou ſhalt be dumme, and ſhalt not be able to ſpeake vntil the day vvherein theſe things ſhal be done: for-becauſe thou haſt not beleeued my wordes, vvhich ſhal be fulfilled in their time.
label: Luke

text: And the people vvas expecting Zacharie: and they marueled that he made tariance in the temple.
label: Luke

text: And comming forth he could not ſpeake to them, and they knevv that he had ſeen a viſion in the temple. And he made ſignes to them, and remained dumme.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe, after the daies of his office vvere expired, he departed into his houſe.
label: Luke

text: And after theſe daies Elizabeth his vvife conceiued: and hid her ſelf fiue moneths, ſaying,
label: Luke

text: For thus hath our Lord done to me in the daies vvherein he had reſpect to take avvay my reproche among men.
label: Luke

text: b And in the ſixt moneth, the Angel Gabriel vvas ſent of God into a citie of Galilee, called Nazareth,
label: Luke

text: to a virgin deſpouſed to a man vvhoſe name vvas Ioſeph, of the houſe of Dauid: and the virgins name vvas MARIE,
label: Luke

text: And the Angel being entred in, ſaid vnto her, HAILE ful of grace, our Lord is vvith thee: bleſſed art thou among vvomen.
label: Luke

text: Vvho hauing heard, vvas troubled at his ſaying, and thought vvhat maner of ſalutation this ſhould be.
label: Luke

text: And the Angel ſaid to her, Feare not MARIE, for thou haſt found grace vvith God.
label: Luke

text: Behold thou ſhalt conceiue in thy vvombe, and ſhalt beare a ſonne: and thou ſhalt call his name IESVS.
label: Luke

text: he ſhal be great, and ſhal be called the ſonne of the moſt High, and our Lord God ſhal giue him the ſeate of Dauid his father:
label: Luke

text: and he ſhal reigne in the houſe of Iacob for euer, and of his kingdom there ſhal be no end.
label: Luke

text: And MARIE ſaid to the Angel, How ſhal this be done? becauſe I knovv not man?
label: Luke

text: And the Angel anſvvering, ſaid to her, The Holy Ghoſt ſhal come vpon thee, and the povver of the moſt High ſhal ouerſhadovv thee. And therfore alſo that vvhich of thee ſhal be borne Holy, ſhal be called the ſonne of God.
label: Luke

text: And behold Eliſabeth thy coſin, ſhe alſo hath conceiued a ſonne in her old age: and this moneth, is the ſixt to her that is called barren:
label: Luke

text: becauſe there ſhal not be impoſſible vvith God any word.
label: Luke

text: And MARIE ſaid, BEHOLD the handmaid of our Lord, be it done to me according to thy word. ⊢ And the Angel departed from her.
label: Luke

text: And MARIE riſing vp in thoſe daies, vvent vnto the hil countrie vvith ſpeede, into a citie of Iuda.
label: Luke

text: and ſhe entred into the houſe of Zacharie, and ſaluted Eliſabeth.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe: as Eliſabeth heard the ſalutation of MARIE, the infant did leape in her vvombe. and Eliſabeth vvas repleniſhed vvith the Holy Ghoſt:
label: Luke

text: and ſhe cried out vvith a loude voice, and ſaid, BLESSED art thou among vvomen, and bleſſed is the fruite of thy vvombe.
label: Luke

text: And vvhence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord doth come to me?
label: Luke

text: For behold as the voice of thy ſalutation ſounded in mine eares, the infant in my vvombe did leape for ioy.
label: Luke

text: And bleſſed is ſhe that beleeued, becauſe thoſe things ſhal be accompliſhed that vvere ſpoken to her by our Lord.
label: Luke

text: And MARIE ſaid, MY SOVLE doth magnifie our Lord.
label: Luke

text: And my ſpirit hath reioyced in God my Sauiour. ⊢
label: Luke

text: Becauſe he hath regarded the humilitie of his handmaid: for behold from hence forth al generations ſhal call me bleſſed.
label: Luke

text: Becauſe he that is mightie hath done great things to me, and holy is his name.
label: Luke

text: And his mercie from generation vnto generations, to them that feare him.
label: Luke

text: He hath ſhewed might in his arme: he hath diſperſed the proude in the conceit of their hart.
label: Luke

text: He hath depoſed the mightie from their ſeate, and hath exalted the humble.
label: Luke

text: The hungrie he hath filled vvith good things: and the riche he hath ſent away emptie.
label: Luke

text: He hath receiued Iſrael his childe, being mindeful of his mercie,
label: Luke

text: As he ſpake to our fathers, to Abraham and his ſeede for euer.
label: Luke

text: And MARIE taried with her about three moneths: and ſhe returned into her houſe.
label: Luke

text: And Eliſabeths ful time vvas come to be deliuered: and ſhe bare a ſonne.
label: Luke

text: And her neighbours and kinsfolke heard that our Lord did magnifie his mercie vvith her, and they did congratulate her.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe: on the eight day they came to circumciſe the childe, and they called him by his fathers name, Zacharie.
label: Luke

text: And his mother anſvvering, ſaid, Not ſo, but he ſhal be called Iohn.
label: Luke

text: And they ſaid to her, That there is none in thy kinred that is called by this name.
label: Luke

text: And they made ſignes to his father, vvhat he vvould haue him called.
label: Luke

text: And demaunding a vvriting table, he vvrote, ſaying, Iohn is his name. And they al marueled.
label: Luke

text: And forthvvith his mouth vvas opened, and his tonge, and he ſpake bleſſing God.
label: Luke

text: And feare came vpon al their neighbours: and al theſe things vvere bruited ouer al the hil-countrie of Iewrie:
label: Luke

text: and all that had heard, laid them vp in their hart, ſaying, what an one, trovv ye, ſhal this childe be? For the hand of our Lord vvas vvith him.
label: Luke

text: And Zacharie his father vvas repleniſhed vvith the Holy Ghoſt: and he prophecied, ſaying,
label: Luke

text: BLESSED BE OVR LORD God of Iſrael: becauſe he hath viſited and vvrought the redemption of his people: ⊢
label: Luke

text: And hath erected the horne of ſaluation to vs, in the houſe of Dauid his ſeruant.
label: Luke

text: As he ſpake by the mouth of his holy Prophets, that are from the beginning.
label: Luke

text: Saluation from our enemies, and from the hand of al that hate vs:
label: Luke

text: To worke mercie vvith our fathers: and to remember his holy teſtament,
label: Luke

text: The othe vvhich he ſvvare to Abraham our father,
label: Luke

text: that he vvould giue to vs, That without feare being deliuered from the hand of our enemies, vve may ſerue him.
label: Luke

text: In holines and iuſtice before him, al our daies.
label: Luke

text: And thou childe, ſhalt be called the Prophet of the Higheſt: for thou ſhalt goe before the face of our Lord to prepare his vvaies.
label: Luke

text: To giue knovvledge of ſaluation to his people, vnto remiſsion of their ſinnes,
label: Luke

text: Through the bovvels of the mercie of our God, in vvhich the Orient, from on high, hath viſited vs,
label: Luke

text: To illuminate them that ſit in darkenes, and in the ſhadow of death: to direct our feete into the vvay of peace.
label: Luke

text: And the childe grew, and vvas ſtrengthened in ſpirit, and vvas in the deſerts vntil the day of his manifeſtation to Iſrael.
label: Luke

text: AND it came to paſſe, in thoſe daies there came forth an edict from Caeſar Auguſtus, that the vvhole vvorld ſhould be enrolled.
label: Luke

text: This firſt enrolling vvas made by the Preſident of Syria Cyrinus.
label: Luke

text: And al vvent to be enrolled, euery one into his ovvne citie.
label: Luke

text: And Ioſeph alſo vvent vp from Galilee out of the citie of Nazareth into Ievvrie, to the citie of Dauid that is called Beth-lehem: for-becauſe he vvas of the houſe and familie of Dauid,
label: Luke

text: to be enrolled vvith MARIE his deſpouſed vvife that vvas vvith childe.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe, vvhen they vvere there, her daies vvere fully come that ſhe ſhould be deliuered.
label: Luke

text: And ſhe brought forth her firſt begotten ſonne, and ſvvadled him in clothes, and laid him dovvne in a manger: becauſe there vvas not place for them in the inne.
label: Luke

text: And there vvere in the ſame countrie ſhepheards watching, and keeping the night vvatches ouer their flocke.
label: Luke

text: And behold, an Angel of our Lord ſtood beſide them, and the brightnes of God did ſhine round about them, and they feared vvith a great feare.
label: Luke

text: And the angel ſaid to them, Feare not: for behold I euangelize to you great ioy, that ſhal be to al the people:
label: Luke

text: becauſe this day is borne to you a SAVIOVR which is Chriſt our Lord, in the citie of Dauid.
label: Luke

text: And this ſhal be a ſigne to you, You ſhal finde the infant ſwadled in clothes: and laid in a manger.
label: Luke

text: And ſodenly there vvas vvith the Angel a multitude of the heauenly armie, praiſing God, and ſaying,
label: Luke

text: Glorie in the higheſt to God: and in earth peace to men of good vvil. ⊢
label: Luke

text: b And it came to paſſe: after the Angels departed from them into heauen, the ſhepheards ſpake one to an other: Let vs goe ouer to Bethlehem, and let vs ſee this word that is done, vvhich our Lord hath ſhevved to vs.
label: Luke

text: And they came with ſpeede: and they found MARIE and Ioſeph, and the infant laid in the manger.
label: Luke

text: And ſeeing it, they vnderſtood of the word that had been ſpoken to them concerning this childe.
label: Luke

text: And al that heard, did maruel: and concerning thoſe things that vvere reported to them by the ſhepheards.
label: Luke

text: But MARIE kept al theſe vvordes, conferring them in her hart.
label: Luke

text: And the ſhepheards returned, glorifying and prayſing God in al things that they had heard, and ſeen, as it was ſaid to them. ⊢
label: Luke

text: c And after eight daies vvere expired, that the childe ſhould be circunciſed: his name vvas called IESVS, vvhich vvas called by the Angel, before that he vvas conceiued in the vvombe. ⊢
label: Luke

text: d And after the daies vvere fully ended of her purification according to the lavv of Moyſes, they caried him into Hieruſalem, to preſent him to our Lord (
label: Luke

text: as it is vvritten in the lavv of our Lord, That euery male opening the matrice, ſhal be called holy to the Lord.)
label: Luke

text: and to giue a ſacrifice according as it is written in the lavv of our Lord, a paire of turtles, or tvvo yong pigeons.
label: Luke

text: And behold, there vvas a man in Hieruſalem, named Simeon, and this man was iuſt and religious, expecting the conſolation of Iſrael: and the Holy Ghoſt vvas in him.
label: Luke

text: And he had receiued an anſwer of the Holy Ghoſt, that he ſhould not ſee death vnles he ſavv firſt the CHRIST of our Lord.
label: Luke

text: And he came in ſpirit into the temple. And vvhen his parents brought in the childe IESVS, to doe according to the cuſtome of the Lavv for him:
label: Luke

text: he alſo tooke him into his armes, and bleſſed God, and ſaid,
label: Luke

text: NOW THOV doeſt dimiſſe thy ſeruant O Lord, according to thy vvord in peace.
label: Luke

text: Becauſe mine eies haue ſeen, thy Salvation,
label: Luke

text: Which thou hast prepared before the face of al peoples:
label: Luke

text: A light to the reuelation of the Gentils, and the glorie of thy people Iſrael. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And his father and mother vvere marueling vpon thoſe things vvhich vvere ſpoken concerning him.
label: Luke

text: And Simeon bleſſed them, and ſaid to MARIE his mother, Behold this is ſet vnto the ruine, and vnto the reſurrection of many in Iſrael, and for a ſigne vvhich ſhal be contradicted,
label: Luke

text: and thine ovvne ſoule ſhal a ſword pearce, that out of many hartes cogitations may be reuealed.
label: Luke

text: And there vvas Anne a prophetiſſe, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aſer: ſhe was farre ſtriken in daies, and had liued vvith her huſband ſeuen yeres from her virginitie.
label: Luke

text: And ſhe vvas a vvidovv vntil eightie and foure yeres: vvho departed not from the temple, by faſtings and praiers ſeruing night and day.
label: Luke

text: And ſhe at the ſame houre ſodenly comming in, confeſſed to our Lord: and ſpake of him to al that expected the redemption of Iſrael.
label: Luke

text: And after they had vvholy done al things according to the lavv of our Lord, they returned into Galilee, into their citie Nazareth.
label: Luke

text: And the childe grevv, and vvaxed ‘ſtrong': ful of wiſedom, and the grace of God vvas in him.
label: Luke

text: And his parents vvent euery yere vnto Hieruſalem, at the ſolemne day of Paſche.
label: Luke

text: And when he vvas tvvelue yeres old, they going vp into Hieruſalem according to the cuſtome of the feſtiual day,
label: Luke

text: and hauing ended the daies, vvhen they returned, the childe IESVS remained in Hieruſalem: and his parents knew it not.
label: Luke

text: And thinking that he vvas in the companie, they came a daies iourney, and ſought him among their kinſfolke and acquaintance.
label: Luke

text: And not finding him, they returned into Hieruſalem, ſeeking him.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe, after three daies they found him in the temple ſitting in the middes of the Doctors, hearing them, and aſking them.
label: Luke

text: And al vvere aſtonied that heard him, vpon his vviſedom and anſvvers.
label: Luke

text: And ſeeing him, they vvondered. And his mother ſaid to him, Sonne, vvhy haſt thou ſo done to vs? behold thy father and I ſorovving did ſeeke thee.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, VVhat is it that you ſought me? did you not knovv, that I muſt be about thoſe things, vvhich are my fathers?
label: Luke

text: And they vnderſtood not the vvord that he ſpake vnto them.
label: Luke

text: And he vvent dovvne vvith them, and came to Nazareth: and vvas ſubiect to them. And his mother kept al theſe vvordes in her hart.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS proceeded in vviſedom and age, and grace vvith God and men. ⊢
label: Luke

text: AND in the fiftenth yere of the empire of Tiberius Caeſar, Pontius Pilate being Gouernour of Ievvrie, and Herod being Tetrarch of Galilee, and Philip his brother Tetrarch of Ituréa and the countrie Trachonîtis, and Lyſanias Tetrarch of Abilîna,
label: Luke

text: vnder the high Prieſts Annas and Caiphas: the vvord of our Lord vvas made vpon Iohn the ſonne of Zacharie, in the deſert.
label: Luke

text: And he came into al the countrie of Iordan, preaching the baptiſme of penance vnto remiſſion of ſinnes: as it is vvritten in the booke of the ſayings of Eſay the Prophet:
label: Luke

text: A voice of one crying in the deſert: prepare the vvay of our Lord, make ſtraight his pathes.
label: Luke

text: Euery valley ſhal be filled: and euery mountaine and hil ſhal be made lovv, and crooked things ſhal become ſtraight: and rough vvaies, plaine:
label: Luke

text: and al fleſh ſhal ſee the SALVATION of God.
label: Luke

text: He ſaid therfore to the multitudes that vvent forth to be baptized of him, Ye vipers broodes, vvho hath ſhewed you to flee from the vvrath to come?
label: Luke

text: Yeld therfore fruites vvorthie of penance. and doe ye not begin to ſay, VVe haue Abraham to our father. For I tel you, that God is able of theſe ſtones to raiſe vp children to Abraham.
label: Luke

text: And novv the axe is put to the roote of the trees. Euery tree therfore that yeldeth not good fruite, ‘ſhal be' cut dovvne, and caſt into fire.
label: Luke

text: And the multitudes aſked him, ſaying, VVhat ſhal we doe then?
label: Luke

text: And he anſvvering, ſaid vnto them: He that hath tvvo coates, let him giue to him that hath not: and he that hath meate, let him doe likevviſe.
label: Luke

text: And the Publicans alſo came to be baptized, and ſaid to him, Maiſter, vvhat ſhal vve doe?
label: Luke

text: But he ſaid to them, Doe nothing more then that vvhich is appointed you.
label: Luke

text: And the ſouldiars alſo aſked him, ſaying, VVhat ſhal vve alſo doe? And he ſaid to them, Vexe not neither calumniate any man: and be content vvith your ſtipends.
label: Luke

text: And the people imagining, and al men thinking in their harts of Iohn, leſt perhaps he vvere Chriſt:
label: Luke

text: Iohn anſwered, ſaying vnto al, I in deede baptize you vvith vvater: but there ‘ſhal come' a mightier then I, vvhoſe latchet of his ſhoes I am not vvorthie to vnlooſe, he ſhal baptize you in the Holy Ghoſt and fire.
label: Luke

text: vvhoſe fanne is in his hand, and he vvil purge his floore: and vvil gather the vvheate into his barne, but the chaffe he vvil burne vvith vnquencheable fire.
label: Luke

text: Many other things alſo exhorting did he euangelize to the people.
label: Luke

text: And Herod the Tetrarch, vvhen he vvas rebuked of him for Herodias his ‘brothers' vvife, and for al the euils vvhich Herod did:
label: Luke

text: he added this alſo aboue al, and ſhut vp Iohn into priſon.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe vvhen al the people vvas baptized, IESVS alſo being baptized and praying, heauen vvas opened:
label: Luke

text: and the Holy Ghoſt deſcended in corporal ſhape as a doue vpon him: and a voice from heauen vvas made: Thou art my beloued ſonne, in thee I am vvel pleaſed.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS him ſelf was beginning to be about thirtie yeres old: as it was thought, the ſonne of Ioſeph, vvho vvas of Heli,
label: Luke

text: vvho vvas of Matthat, vvho vvas of Leui, vvho vvas of Melchi, vvho vvas of Ianné, vvho vvas of Ioſeph,
label: Luke

text: who vvas of Matthathias, vvho vvas of Amos, vvho vvas of Naum, vvho vvas of Heſli, vvho vvas of Naggé,
label: Luke

text: vvho vvas of Mahath, vvho vvas of Matthathias, vvho vvas of Semei, vvho vvas of Ioſeph, vvho vvas of Iuda,
label: Luke

text: who vvas of Iohanna, vvho vvas of Reſa, vvho vvas of Zorobabel, vvho vvas of Salathiel, vvho vvas of Neri,
label: Luke

text: vvho vvas of Melchi, vvho vvas of Addi, vvho vvas of Coſam, vvho vvas of Elmadan, vvho vvas of Her,
label: Luke

text: vvho vvas of Ieſus, vvho vvas of Eliézer, vvho vvas of Iorim, vvho vvas of Matthat, vvho vvas of Leui,
label: Luke

text: who vvas of Simeon, vvho vvas of Iudas, vvho vvas of Ioſeph, vvho vvas of Iona, vvho vvas of Eliacim,
label: Luke

text: who vvas of Melcha, vvho vvas of Menna, vvho vvas of Matthatha, vvho vvas of Nathan, vvho vvas of Dauid,
label: Luke

text: vvho vvas of Ieſſé, vvho vvas of Obed, vvho vvas of Booz, vvho vvas of Salmon, vvho vvas of Naaſſon,
label: Luke

text: vvho vvas of Aminadab, vvho vvas of Aram, vvho vvas of Eſron, vvho vvas of Phares, vvho vvas of Iudas,
label: Luke

text: vvho vvas of Iacob, vvho vvas of Iſaac, vvho vvas of Abraham, vvho vvas of Tharé, vvho vvas of Nachor,
label: Luke

text: vvho vvas of Sarug, vvho vvas of Ragau, vvho vvas of Phaleg, vvho was of Heber, vvho vvas of Salé,
label: Luke

text: vvho vvas of Cainan, vvho vvas of Arphaxad, vvho vvas of Sem, vvho vvas of Noë, vvho vvas of Lamech,
label: Luke

text: who vvas of Mathuſalé, vvho vvas of Henoch, vvho vvas of Iared, vvho vvas of Malaleel, vvho vvas of Cainan,
label: Luke

text: who vvas of Henos, vvho vvas of Seth, vvho vvas of Adam, vvho vvas of God.
label: Luke

text: AND IESVS ful of the Holy Ghoſt, returned from Iordan, and vvas driuen in the ſpirit into the deſert,
label: Luke

text: fourtie daies, and vvas tempted of the deuil. And he did eate nothing in thoſe daies: and vvhen they vvere ended, he vvas an hungred.
label: Luke

text: And the Deuil ſaid to him, If thou be the ſonne of God, ſay to this ſtone that it be made bread.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS made anſvver vnto him, It is vvritten, That not in bread alone ſhal man liue, but in euery vvord of God.
label: Luke

text: And the Deuil brought him into an high mountaine, and ſhevved him al the kingdoms of the vvhole vvorld in a moment of time:
label: Luke

text: and he ſaid to him, To thee vvil I giue this vvhole povver, and the glorie of them: for to me they are deliuered, and to vvhom I vvil, I doe giue them.
label: Luke

text: Thou therfore if thou vvilt adore before me, they ſhal al be thine.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS anſvvering ſaid to him, It is vvritten, Thou ſhalt adore the Lord thy God, and him only ſhalt thou ſerue.
label: Luke

text: And he brought him into Hieruſalem, and ſet him vpon the pinnacle of the temple: and he ſaid to him, If thou be the ſonne of God, caſt thy ſelf from hence downeward.
label: Luke

text: For it is written, that He hath giuen his Angels charge of thee, that they preſerue thee:
label: Luke

text: and that in their hands they ſhal beare thee vp, leſt perhaps thou knocke thy foote againſt a ſtone.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS anſvvering ſaid to him, It is ſaid, Thou ſhal not tempt the Lord thy God.
label: Luke

text: And al the tentation being ended, the Deuil departed from him vntil a time.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS returned in the force of the ſpirit into Galilee, and the fame vvent forth through the vvhole countrie of him.
label: Luke

text: And he taught in their ſynagogs, and vvas magnified of al.
label: Luke

text: And he came to Nazareth vvhere he vvas brought vp: and he entred according to his cuſtom on the Sabboth day into the ſynagogue: and he roſe vp to reade.
label: Luke

text: And the booke of Eſay the Prophet vvas deliuered vnto him. And as he vnfolded the booke, he found the place vvhere it vvas vvritten,
label: Luke

text: The Spirit of the Lord vpon me, for vvhich he anointed me, to euangelize vnto the poore he ſent me, to heale the contrite of hart,
label: Luke

text: to preach to the captiues remiſsion, and ſight to the blinde, to dimiſſe the bruiſed vnto remiſſion, to preach the acceptable yere of the Lord, and the day of retribution.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he had folded the booke, he rendred it to the miniſter, and ſate dovvne. And the eies of al in the ſynagogue vvere bent vpon him.
label: Luke

text: And he began to ſay vnto them: That this day is fulfilled this ſcripture in your eares.
label: Luke

text: And al gaue teſtimomonie to him: and they marueled in the vvordes of grace that proceded from his mouth, and they ſaid, Is not this Ioſephs ſonne?
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, Certes you vvil ſay to me this ſimilitude, Phyſicion, cure they ſelf: as great things as vve haue heard done in Capharnaum, doe alſo here in thy countrie.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid, Amen I ſay to you, that no Prophet is accepted in his ovvne countrie.
label: Luke

text: In truth I ſay to you, there vvere many vvidovves in the daies of Elias in Iſrael, vvhen the heauen vvas ſhut three yeres and ſix moneths, vvhen there vvas a great famine made in the whole earth:
label: Luke

text: and to none of them vvas Elias ſent, but into Sarepta of Sidon, to a vvidovv vvoman.
label: Luke

text: And there vvere many lepers in Iſrael vnder Eliſæus the Prophet: and none of them vvas made cleane but Naaman the Syrian.
label: Luke

text: And al in the ſynagogue vvere filled vvith anger, hearing theſe things.
label: Luke

text: And they roſe, and caſt him out of the citie: and they brought him to the edge of the hil, vvherevpon their citie vvas built, that they might throvv him dovvne headlong.
label: Luke

text: But he paſſing through the middes of them, vvent his vvay. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And he vvent dovvne into Capharnaum a citie of Galilee: and there he taught them on the Sabboths.
label: Luke

text: And they vvere aſtonied at his doctrine: becauſe his talke vvas in povver.
label: Luke

text: And in the ſynagogue there vvas a man hauing an vncleane Diuel, and he cried out vvith a loud voice,
label: Luke

text: ſaying, Let be, vvhat to vs and thee IESVS of Nazareth? art thou come to deſtroy vs? I know thee vvho thou art, the SAINCT of God.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS rebuked him, ſaying, Hold thy peace, & goe out of him. And vvhen the Deuil had throvven him into the middes, he vvent out of him, and hurted him nothing.
label: Luke

text: And there came feare vpon al, and they talked together one vvith an other, ſaying, VVhat vvord is this, that in povver and vertue he commaundeth the vncleane ſpirits, and they goe out?
label: Luke

text: And the fame of him vvas publiſhed into euery place of the countrie.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS riſing vp out of the ſynagogue, entred into Simons houſe. And Simons vviues mother vvas holden with a great feuer: and they beſought him for her.
label: Luke

text: And ſtanding ouer her, he commaunded the feuer, and it left her. And incontinent riſing, ſhe miniſtred to them.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen the ſunne vvas dovvne, al that had diſeaſed of ſundrie maladies, brought them to him. But he impoſing hands vpon euery one, cured them.
label: Luke

text: And Deuils vvent out from many, crying and ſaying, That thou art the ſonne of God. And rebuking them he ſuffred them not to ſpeake, that they knevv he vvas Chriſt.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen it vvas day, going forth he vvent into a deſert place: and the multitudes ſought him, and came euen vnto him: and they held him that he ſhould not depart from them.
label: Luke

text: To vvhom he ſaid, That to other cities alſo muſt I euangelize the kingdom of God: becauſe therfore I vvas ſent.
label: Luke

text: And he vvas preaching in the ſynagogs of Galilee. ⊢
label: Luke

text: AND it came to paſſe, vvhen the multitudes preſſed vpon him to heare the vvord of God, and him ſelf ſtoode beſide the lake of Geneſareth.
label: Luke

text: And he ſavv tvvo ſhippes ſtanding by the lake: and the fiſhers vvere gone dovvne, and vvaſhed their nettes.
label: Luke

text: And he going vp into one ſhip that vvas Simons, deſired him to bring it backe a litle from the land. And ſitting, he taught the multitudes out of the ſhip.
label: Luke

text: And as he ceaſed to ſpeake, he ſaid to Simon, Launche forth into the deepe, and let looſe your nettes to make a draught.
label: Luke

text: And Simon anſvvering, ſaid to him, Maiſter, labouring al the night, vve haue taken nothing: but in thy vvord I vvil let looſe the nette.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen they had done this, they incloſed a very great multitude of fiſhes, and their nette vvas broken.
label: Luke

text: And they beckened to their fellovves that vvere in the other ſhip, that they ſhould come and help them. And they came and filled both ſhippes, ſo that they did ſinke.
label: Luke

text: VVhich vvhen Simon Peter did ſee, he fel dovvne at IESVS knees, ſaying, Goe forth from me, becauſe I am a ſinful man, O Lord.
label: Luke

text: For he vvas vvholy aſtoniſhed and al that vvere vvith him, at the draught of fiſhes which they had taken.
label: Luke

text: In like maner alſo Iames and Iohn the ſonnes of Zebedee, vvho vvere Simons fellovves. And IESVS ſaid to Simon, Feare not: from this time novv, thou ſhalt be taking men.
label: Luke

text: And hauing brought their ſhippes to land, leauing al things they folovved him. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe, vvhen he vvas in one of the cities, and behold a man ful of leproſie, and ſeeing IESVS, and falling on his face, beſought him ſaying, Lord, if thou vvilt, thou canſt make me cleane.
label: Luke

text: And ſtretching forth the hand, he touched him, ſaying, I vvil. be thou made cleane. And immediatly the leproſie departed from him.
label: Luke

text: And he commaunded him that he ſhould tel no body, but, Goe, ſhevv thy ſelf to the Prieſt, and offer for thy cleanſing as Moyſes commaunded, for a teſtimonie to them.
label: Luke

text: But the bruite of him vvent abrode the more. and great multitudes came together to heare, and to be cured of their infirmities.
label: Luke

text: And he retired into the deſert, and praied.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe one day, and he ſate teaching. And there vvere Phariſees ſitting and Doctors of Lavv that vvere come out of euery tovvne of Galilee and Ievvrie and Hieruſalem: and the vertue of our Lord vvas to heale them.
label: Luke

text: And behold men carying in a bed a man that had the palſey: and they ſought to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
label: Luke

text: And not finding on vvhich ſide they might bring him in for the multitude, they vvent vp vpon the roofe, and through the tiles let him dovvne vvith the bed into the middes, before IESVS.
label: Luke

text: VVhoſe faith vvhen he ſavv, he ſaid, Man, thy ſinnes are forgiuen thee.
label: Luke

text: And the Scribes and Phariſees began to thinke, ſaying, Who is this that ſpeaketh blaſphemies? Who can forgiue ſinnes, but only God?
label: Luke

text: And when IESVS knevve their cogitations, anſvvering he ſaid to them, VVhat doe you thinke in your hartes?
label: Luke

text: VVhich is eaſier to ſay, Thy ſinnes are forgiuen thee: or to ſay, Ariſe, and vvalke?
label: Luke

text: but that you may knovv that the ſonne of man hath povver in earth to forgiue ſinnes (he ſaid to the ſicke of the palſey) I ſay to thee, Ariſe, take vp thy bed, and goe into thy houſe.
label: Luke

text: And forthvvith riſing vp before them, he tooke that wherein he lay: and he vvent into his houſe, magnifying God.
label: Luke

text: And al vvere aſtonied: and they magnified God. And they vvere repleniſhed vvith feare, ſaying, That vve haue ſeen maruelous things to day. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And after theſe things he vvent forth, and ſavv a Publican called Leui, ſitting at the Cuſtome-houſe, and he ſaid to him, Folovv me.
label: Luke

text: And leauing al things, he roſe and folovved him.
label: Luke

text: and Leui made him a great feaſt in his houſe: and there vvas a great multitude of Publicans, and of others that vvere ſitting at the table vvith them.
label: Luke

text: And their Phariſees and Scribes murmured, ſaying to his diſciples, Why doe you eate and drinke vvith Publicans and ſinners?
label: Luke

text: And IESVS anſwering ſaid to them, They that are vvhole, neede not the Phyſicion: but they that are il at eaſe.
label: Luke

text: I came not to call the iuſt, but ſinners to penance. ⊢
label: Luke

text: But they ſaid to him, VVhy doe the diſciples of Iohn faſt often, and make obſecrations, and of the Phariſees in like maner: but thine doe eate and drinke?
label: Luke

text: To vvhom he ſaid, Why, can you make the children of the bridegrome faſt vvhiles the bridegrome is vvith them?
label: Luke

text: But the daies vvil come: and vvhen the bridegrome ſhal be taken avvay from them, then they ſhal faſt in thoſe daies.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid a ſimilitude alſo vnto them, That no man putteth a peece from a nevv garment into an old garment: othervviſe both he breaketh the nevv, and the peece from the nevv agreeth not vvith the old.
label: Luke

text: And no bodie putteth nevv vvine into old bottels: othervviſe the nevv vvine vvil breake the bottels, and it ſelf vvil be ſhed, and the bottels vvil be loſt.
label: Luke

text: But nevv vvine is to be put into nevv bottels: and both are preſerued together.
label: Luke

text: And no man drinking old, vvil nevv by and by. for he ſaith, The old is better.
label: Luke

text: AND it came to paſſe on the Sabboth ſecond-firſt, vvhen he paſſed through the corne, his Diſciples did plucke the eares, and did eate rubbing them vvith their hands.
label: Luke

text: And certaine of the Phariſees ſaid to them, VVhy doe you that vvhich is not lawful on the Sabboths?
label: Luke

text: And IESVS anſvvering them, ſaid, Neither this haue you read vvhich Dauid did, vvhen him ſelf vvas an hungred and they that vvere vvith him:
label: Luke

text: hovv he entred into the houſe of God, and tooke the loaues of Propoſition, and did eate, and gaue to them that vvere vvith him, vvhich it is not lavvful to eate but only for Prieſts?
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, That the ſonne of man is Lord of the Sabboth alſo.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe on an other Sabboth alſo, that he entred into the ſynagogue, and taught. And there vvas a man, and his right hand vvas vvithered.
label: Luke

text: And the Scribes and Phariſees vvatched if he vvould cure on the Sabboth: that they might finde hovv to accuſe him.
label: Luke

text: But he knevv their cogitations: and he ſaid to the man that had the withered hand, Ariſe, and ſtand forth into the middes. And riſing he ſtoode.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid to them, I aſke you, if it be lavvful on the Sabboths to doe vvel or il: to ſaue a ſoule or to deſtroy?
label: Luke

text: And looking about vpon them al, he ſaid to the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he ſtretched it forth: and his hand vvas reſtored.
label: Luke

text: And they vvere repleniſhed vvith madnes: and they communed one with an other what they might doe to IESVS.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe in thoſe daies, he vvent forth into the mountaine to pray, and he paſſed the vvhole night in the prayer of God.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen day vvas come, he called his Diſciples: and he choſe tvvelue of them ( vvhom alſo he named Apoſtles)
label: Luke

text: Simon vvhom he ſurnamed Peter, and Andrevv his brother, Iames and Iohn, Philippe and Bartholomew,
label: Luke

text: Matthevv and Thomas, Iames of Alphæus and Simon that is called Zelótes,
label: Luke

text: and Iude of Iames, and Iudas Iſcariote vvhich vvas the traitour.
label: Luke

text: And deſcending vvith them he ſtoode in a plaine place, and the multitude of his Diſciples, and a very great companie of people from al Ievvrie and Hieruſalem: and the ſea coaſt both of Tyre and Sidon,
label: Luke

text: vvhich vvere come to heare him, and to be healed of their maladies. And they that vvere vexed of vncleane ſpirits, vvere cured.
label: Luke

text: And al the multitude ſought to touch him, becauſe vertue vvent forth from him, and healed al. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And he lifting vp his eies vpon his Diſciples, ſaid, Bleſſed are ye poore: for yours is the kingdom of God.
label: Luke

text: Bleſſed are you that novv are an hungred: becauſe you ſhal be filled. Bleſſed are you that novv doe vveepe: becauſe you ſhal laugh.
label: Luke

text: Bleſſed ſhal you be vvhen men ſhal hate you, and vvhen they ſhal ſeparate you, and vpbraide you, and abandon your name as euil, for the ſonne of mans ſake.
label: Luke

text: Be glad in that day and reioyce: for behold, your revvard is much in heauen. ⊢ for according to theſe things did their fathers to the Prophets.
label: Luke

text: But wo to you that are riche, becauſe you haue your conſolation.
label: Luke

text: VVo to you that are filled: becauſe you ſhal be hungrie. VVo to you that novv doe laugh: becauſe you ſhal mourne and vveepe.
label: Luke

text: VVo, vvhen al men ſhal bleſſe you. for according to theſe things did their fathers to the falſe-Prophets.
label: Luke

text: But to you I ſay that doe heare, Loue your enemies, doe good to them that hate you.
label: Luke

text: Bleſſe them that curſe you, and pray for them that calumniate you.
label: Luke

text: And he that ſtriketh thee on the cheeke, offer alſo the other. And from him that taketh avvay from thee thy robe, prohibit not thy coate alſo.
label: Luke

text: And to euery one that aſketh thee, giue: and of him that taketh avvay the things that are thine, aſke not againe.
label: Luke

text: And according as you vvil that men doe to you, doe you alſo to them in like maner.
label: Luke

text: And if you loue them that loue you, vvhat thanke is to you? for ſinners alſo loue thoſe that loue them.
label: Luke

text: And if ye doe good to them that doe you good: vvhat thanke is to you? for ſinners alſo doe this.
label: Luke

text: And if ye lend to them of vvhom ye hope to receiue: vvhat thanke is to you? for ſinners alſo lend vnto ſinners, for to receiue as much.
label: Luke

text: But loue ye your enemies: doe good and lend, hoping for nothing thereby, and your reward ſhal be much, and you ſhal be the ſonnes of the Higheſt, becauſe him ſelf is beneficial vpon the vnkinde and the euil.
label: Luke

text: Be ye therfore merciful as alſo your father is merciful.
label: Luke

text: Iudge not, & you ſhal not be iudged. condemne not, & you ſhal not be condemned. forgiue, and you ſhal be forgiuen.
label: Luke

text: Giue, and there ſhal be giuen to you. good meaſure & preſſed dovvne and ſhaken together and running ouer ſhal they giue into your boſome. For vvith the ſame meaſure that you do meate, it ſhal be meaſured to you againe.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them a ſimilitude alſo: Can the blinde leade the blinde? doe not both fal into the ditch?
label: Luke

text: The diſciple is not aboue his maiſter: but euery one ſhal be perfect, if he be as his maiſter.
label: Luke

text: And vvhy ſeeſt thou the mote in thy brothers eie: but the beame that is in thine ovvne eie thou conſidereſt not?
label: Luke

text: Or hovv canſt thou ſay to thy brother, Brother, let me caſt out the mote out of thine eie: thy ſelf not ſeeing the beame in thine ovvne eie? Hypocrite, caſt firſt the beame out of thine ovvne eie: and then ſhalt thou ſee clerely to take forth the mote out of thy brothers eie. ⊢
label: Luke

text: For there is no good tree that yeldeth euil fruites: nor euil tree, that yeldeth good fruite.
label: Luke

text: For euery tree is knovven by his fruite. For neither doe they gather figges of thornes: neither of a buſh doe they gather the grape.
label: Luke

text: The good man of the good treaſure of his hart bringeth forth good: and the euil man of the il treaſure bringeth forth euil. for of the aboundance of the hart the mouth ſpeaketh.
label: Luke

text: And vvhy cal you me, Lord, Lord: and doe not the things vvhich I ſay?
label: Luke

text: Euery one that commeth to me, and heareth my vvords, and doeth them: I vvil ſhevv you to vvhom he is like.
label: Luke

text: He is like to a man building a houſe, that digged deepe, and laid the foundation vpon a rocke. And vvhen an inundation roſe, the riuer bette againſt that houſe, and it could not moue it: for it vvas founded vpon a rocke.
label: Luke

text: But he that heareth, and doeth not: is like to a man building his houſe vpon the earth vvithout a foundation: againſt the vvhich the riuer did beate: and incontinent it fell, and the ruine of that houſe vvas great.
label: Luke

text: AND vvhen he had fully ſaid al his vvords into the eares of the people, he entred into Capharnaum.
label: Luke

text: And the ſeruant of a certaine Centurion being ſicke, vvas readie to die: vvho vvas deere vnto him.
label: Luke

text: And when he had heard of IESVS, he ſent vnto him the Auncients of the Ievves, deſiring him to come and heale his ſeruant.
label: Luke

text: But they being come to IESVS, beſought him earneſtly, ſaying to him, That he is vvorthie that thou ſhouldeſt doe this for him.
label: Luke

text: for he loueth our nation: and he hath built a ſynagogue for vs.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS went with them. And vvhen he vvas novv not farre from the houſe, the Centurion ſent his frends vnto him, ſaying, Lord, trouble not thy ſelf. for I am not vvorthie that thou ſhouldeſt enter vnder my roofe.
label: Luke

text: for the vvhich cauſe neither did I thinke my ſelf vvorthie to come to thee: but ſay the vvord, and my ſeruant ſhal be made whole.
label: Luke

text: for I alſo am a man ſubiect to authoritie, hauing vnder me ſouldiars: and I ſay to this, goe, and he goeth: and to an other, come, and he commeth: and to my ſeruant, doe this, and he doeth it.
label: Luke

text: Which IESVS hearing, marueiled: and turning to the multitudes that folovved him he ſaid, Amen I ſay to you, neither in Iſrael haue I found ſo great faith.
label: Luke

text: And they that vvere ſent, being returned home, found the ſeruant that had been ſicke, vvhole.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe, aftervvard he vvent into a citie that is called Naim: and there vvent vvith him his Diſciples and a very great multitude.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he came nigh to the gate of the citie, behold a dead man vvas caried forth, the only ſonne of his mother: and ſhe, vvas a vvidovv: and a great multitude of the citie vvith her.
label: Luke

text: Vvhom vvhen our Lord had ſeen, being moued vvith mercie vpon her, he ſaid to her, VVeepe not.
label: Luke

text: And he came neere and touched the coffin. And they that caried it, ſtood ſtil: and he ſaid, Yong man, I ſay to thee, Ariſe.
label: Luke

text: And he that vvas dead, ſate vp, and beganne to ſpeake. And he gaue him to his mother.
label: Luke

text: And feare tooke them al: and they magnified God, ſaying, That a great Prophet is riſen among vs: and, That God hath viſited his people.
label: Luke

text: And this ſaying vvent forth into al Ievvrie of him, and into al the countrie about.
label: Luke

text: And Iohns diſciples ſhevved him of al theſe things.
label: Luke

text: And Iohn called tvvo of his diſciples, and ſent them to IESVS, ſaying, Art thou he that art to come: or expect vve an other?
label: Luke

text: And vvhen the men vvere come vnto him, they ſaid, Iohn the Baptiſt hath ſent vs to thee, ſaying, Art thou he that art to come: or expect vve an other?
label: Luke

text: (And the ſelf ſame houre, he cured many of maladies, and hurtes, and euil ſpirits: and to many blinde he gaue ſight.)
label: Luke

text: And anſwering, he ſaid to them, Goe and report to Iohn vvhat you haue heard and ſeen: That the blinde ſee, the lame vvalke, the lepers are made cleane, the deafe heare, the dead riſe againe,
label: Luke

text: the poore are euangelized: and bleſſed is he vvhoſoeuer ſhal not be ſcandalized in me.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen Iohns meſſengers vvere departed, he began to ſay of Iohn to the multitudes, VVhat vvent you out into the deſert to ſee? a reede moued vvith the vvinde?
label: Luke

text: But vvhat vvent you forth to ſee? a man clothed in ſoft garments? behold they that are in coſtly apparel and delicacies, are in the houſe of kings.
label: Luke

text: But what vvent you out for to ſee? a Prophet? Certes I ſay to you, and more then a Prophet.
label: Luke

text: this is he of vvhom it is vvritten, Behold I ſend mine Angel before thy face, vvhich ſhal prepare thy vvay before thee.
label: Luke

text: For I ſay to you, A greater Prophet among the children of vvomen then Iohn the Baptiſt, there is no man. but he that is the leſſer in the kingdom of God, is greater then he.
label: Luke

text: And al the people hearing and the Publicans, iuſtified God, being baptized vvith Iohns baptiſme.
label: Luke

text: But the Phariſees and the lavvyers deſpiſed the counſel of God againſt them ſelues, being not baptized of him.
label: Luke

text: And our Lord ſaid, VVherevnto then ſhal I liken the men of this generation, and vvherevnto are they like?
label: Luke

text: They are like to children ſitting in the market-place, and ſpeaking one to an other, and ſaying, VVe haue piped to you, and you haue not daunced: vve haue lamented, and you haue not vvept.
label: Luke

text: For Iohn the Baptiſt came neither eating bread nor drinking vvine: and you ſay, He hath a deuil.
label: Luke

text: The ſonne of man came eating and drinking: and you ſay, Behold a man that is a gurmander and a drinker of vvine, a frende of Publicans and ſinners.
label: Luke

text: And vviſedom is iuſtified of al her children.
label: Luke

text: And one of the Phariſees deſired him to eate vvith him. And being entred into the houſe of the Phariſee, he ſate downe to meate.
label: Luke

text: And behold a vvoman that was in the citie, a ſinner, as ſhe knevv that he vvas ſet downe in the Phariſees houſe, ſhe brought an alabaſter boxe of ointment:
label: Luke

text: and ſtanding behind beſide his feete, ſhe began to vvater his feete vvith teares, & vviped them vvith the heares of her head, and kiſſed his feete, & anointed them with the ointment.
label: Luke

text: And the Phariſee that had bid him, ſeeing it, ſpake vvithin him ſelf, ſaying, This man if he vvere a Prophet, vvould know certes vvho and vvhat maner of woman ſhe is vvhich toucheth him, that ſhe is a ſinner.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS anſwering ſaid to him, Simon, I haue ſomevvhat to ſay vnto thee. but he ſaid, Maiſter, ſay.
label: Luke

text: A certaine creditour had tvvo debters: one did ovve fiue hundred pence, and the other fiftie.
label: Luke

text: They hauing not vvherevvith to pay, he forgaue both. VVhether therfore doth loue him more?
label: Luke

text: Simon anſvvering ſaid, I ſuppoſe that he to vvhom he forgaue more. But he ſaid to him, Thou haſt iudged rightly.
label: Luke

text: And turning to the vvoman, he ſaid vnto Simon, Doeſt thou ſee this vvoman? I entred into thy houſe, vvater to my feete thou didſt not giue: but ſhe vvith teares hath vvatered my feete, and vvith her heares hath vviped them.
label: Luke

text: Kiſſe thou gaueſt me not: but ſhe ſince I came in, hath not ceaſed to kiſſe my feete.
label: Luke

text: VVith oile thou didſt not anoint my head: but ſhe vvith ointment hath anointed my feete.
label: Luke

text: For the vvhich I ſay to thee, Many ſinnes are forgiuen her, becauſe ſhe hath loued much. But to vvhom leſſe is forgiuen, he loueth leſſe.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to her, Thy ſinnes are forgiuen thee.
label: Luke

text: And they that ſate together at the table, began to ſay within them ſelues, Who is this that alſo forgiueth ſinnes?
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to the woman, Thy faith hath made the ſafe, goe in peace. ⊢
label: Luke

text: AND it came to paſſe afterward, and he made his iourney by cities and tovvnes preaching and euangelizing the kingdom of God: and the Tvvelue vvith him,
label: Luke

text: and ſome vvomen that had been cured of wicked ſpirits and infirmities, Marie vvhich is called Magdalene, out of whom ſeuen deuils vvere gone forth,
label: Luke

text: and Ioane the vvife of Chuſa Herods procurator, and Suſan, and many others that did miniſter vnto him of their ſubſtance.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen a very great multitude aſſembled, and haſtened out of the cities vnto him, he ſaid by a ſimilitude.
label: Luke

text: The ſovver vvent forth to ſovv his ſeede. and vvhiles he ſoweth, ſome fel by the vvay ſide, and vvas troden vpon, and the foules of the aire did eate it.
label: Luke

text: And other ſome fel vpon the rocke: and being ſhot vp, it withered, becauſe it had not moiſture.
label: Luke

text: And otherſome fel among thornes, and the thornes grovving vp vvithal, choked it.
label: Luke

text: And other ſome fel vpon good ground: and being ſhot vp, yelded fruite an hundred fold. Saying theſe things he cried, He that hath eares to heare, let him heare.
label: Luke

text: And his diſciples aſked him vvhat this parable was.
label: Luke

text: To vvhom he ſaid, To you it is giuen to knovv the myſterie of the kingdom of God, but to the reſt in parables, that ſeeing they may not ſee, and hearing may not vnderſtand.
label: Luke

text: And the parable is this: The ſeede, is the vvord of God.
label: Luke

text: And they beſides the vvay: are thoſe that heare, then the deuil commeth, and taketh the vvord out of their hart, leſt beleeuing they be ſaued.
label: Luke

text: For they vpon the rocke: ſuch as vvhen they heare, vvith ioy receiue the vvord: and theſe haue no rootes: becauſe for a time they beleeue, and in time of tentation they reuolt.
label: Luke

text: And that vvhich fel into thornes, are they that haue heard, and going their vvaies, are choked vvith cares and riches and pleaſures of this life, and render not fruite.
label: Luke

text: And that vpon good ground: are they vvhich in a good and very good hart, hearing the vvord, doe reteine it, and yeld fruite in patience. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And no man lighting a candel doth couer it vvith a veſſel, or put it vnder a bed: but ſetteth it vpon a candelſticke, that they that enter in, may ſee the light.
label: Luke

text: For there is not any thing ſecrete, that ſhal not be made manifeſt: nor hid, that ſhal not be knowen, & come abrode.
label: Luke

text: See therfore how you heare. For he that hath, to him ſhal be giuen: and vvhoſoeuer hath not, that alſo vvhich he thinketh he hath, ſhal be taken avvay from him.
label: Luke

text: And his mother and brethren came vnto him: and they could not come at him for the multitude.
label: Luke

text: And it vvas told him, Thy mother and thy brethren ſtand vvithout, deſirous to ſee thee.
label: Luke

text: Who anſvvering ſaid to them, My mother and my brethren, are they that heare the vvord of God and doe it.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe one day: and he vvent vp into a boate, and his diſciples, and he ſaid to them, Let vs ſtrike ouer the lake. And they launched forth.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen they vvere ſailing, he ſlept: and there fel a ſtorme of vvinde into the lake, and they vvere filled, and vvere in danger.
label: Luke

text: And they came and raiſed him, ſaying, Maiſter, vve periſh. But he riſing, rebuked the vvinde and the tempeſt of vvater: and it ceaſed, and there vvas made a calme.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, VVhere is your faith? Who fearing, marueiled one to an other, ſaying, VVho is this (trovv ye) that he commaundeth both the vvindes and the ſea, and they obey him?
label: Luke

text: And they ſailed to the countrie of the Geraſens vvhich is ouer againſt Galilee.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he vvas come forth to the land, there mette him a certaine man that had a deuil novv a very long time, and he did vveare no clothes, neither did he tarie in houſe, but in the monuments.
label: Luke

text: And as he ſaw IESVS, he fel dovvne before him: and crying out vvith a great voice, he ſaid, VVhat is to me and thee IESVS ſonne of God moſt high? I beſeech thee doe not torment me.
label: Luke

text: For he commaunded the vncleane ſpirit to goe forth out of the man. For many times he caught him, and he was bound vvith chaines, and kept vvith fetters: and breaking the bondes vvas driuen of the deuil into the deſerts.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS aſked him ſaying, VVhat is thy name? But he ſaid, Legion. becauſe many deuils vvere entred into him.
label: Luke

text: And they beſought him that he vvould not commaund them to goe into the depth.
label: Luke

text: And there vvas there a heard of many ſvvine feeding on the mountaine: and they deſired him, that he vvould permit them to enter into them. And he permitted them.
label: Luke

text: The deuils therfore vvent forth out of the man, and entred into the ſwine: and the heard vvith violence vvent headlong into the lake, and vvas ſtifled.
label: Luke

text: Which vvhen the ſvvineheards ſavv done, they fled: and told into the citie and into the tovvnes.
label: Luke

text: And they vvent forth to ſee that vvhich vvas done: and they came to IESVS, and found the man, out of whom the deuils vvere gone forth, ſitting at his feete, clothed, and vvel in his vvittes, and they vvere afraid.
label: Luke

text: And they alſo that had ſeen, told them hovv he had been made whole from the legion.
label: Luke

text: And al the multitude of the countrie of the Geraſens beſought him to depart from them: for they vvere taken vvith great feare. And he going vp into the boate, returned.
label: Luke

text: And the man out of vvhom the deuils vvere departed, deſired him that he might be vvith him. But IESVS dimiſſed him, ſaying,
label: Luke

text: Returne into thy houſe, and tel hovv great things God hath done to thee. And he vvent through the vvhole citie, preaching hovv great things IESVS had done to him.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe: vvhen IESVS vvas returned, the multitude receiued him. and al vvere expecting him.
label: Luke

text: And behold there came a man vvhoſe name vvas Iairus, and he vvas Prince of the Synagogue: and he fel at the feete of IESVS, deſiring him that he vvould enter into his houſe,
label: Luke

text: becauſe he had an only daughter almoſt tvvelue yeres old, and ſhe vvas a dying. And it chaunced, vvhiles he vvent, he vvas thronged of the multitudes.
label: Luke

text: And there vvas a certaine vvoman in a fluxe of bloud from tvvelue yeres paſt, vvhich had beſtovved al her ſubſtance vpon Phyſicions, neither could ſhe be cured of any:
label: Luke

text: ſhe came behind him, and touched the hemme of his garment: and forthvvith the fluxe of her bloud ſtinted,
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid, VVho is it that touched me? And al denying, Peter ſaid, and they that vvere vvith him, Maiſter, the multitudes throng and preſſe thee, and doeſt thou ſay, VVho touched me?
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid, Some bodie hath touched me. for I know that there is vertue proceded from me.
label: Luke

text: And the vvoman ſeeing, that ſhe vvas not hid, came trembling, and fel dovvne before his feete: and for vvhat cauſe ſhe had touched him, ſhe ſhevved before al the people: and hovv forthvvith ſhe vvas made vvhole.
label: Luke

text: But he ſaid to her, Daughter, thy faith hath made the ſafe, goe thy vvay in peace.
label: Luke

text: As he vvas yet ſpeaking, there commeth one to the Prince of the ſynagogue, ſaying to him, That thy daughter is dead, trouble him not.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS hearing this vvord, anſvvered the father of the maide, Feare not: beleeue only, and ſhe ſhal be ſafe.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he vvas come to the houſe, he permitted not any man to enter in vvith him, but Peter, and Iames, and Iohn, and the father and mother of the maide.
label: Luke

text: And al vvept, and mourned for her. But he ſaid, VVeepe not, the maide is not dead, but ſleepeth.
label: Luke

text: And they derided him, knovving that ſhe vvas dead.
label: Luke

text: But he holding her hand cried ſaying, Maide ariſe.
label: Luke

text: And her ſpirit returned, and ſhe roſe incontinent. And he bade them giue her to eate.
label: Luke

text: And her parentes were aſtonied, whom he commaunded to tel no man that which was done.
label: Luke

text: AND calling together the tvvelue Apoſtles, he gaue them vertue and povver ouer al deuils, and to cure maladies.
label: Luke

text: And he ſent them to preach the kingdom of God: and to heale the ſicke.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, Take nothing for the vvay, neither rod, nor ſkrippe, nor bread, nor money, neither haue tvvo coates.
label: Luke

text: And into vvhatſoeuer houſe you enter, tarie there, and thence doe not depart.
label: Luke

text: And whoſoever ſhal not receiue you, going forth out of that citie, ſhake of the duſt alſo of your feete for a teſtimonie vpon them.
label: Luke

text: And going forth they vvent a circuite from tovvne to tovvne euangelizing and curing euery vvhere. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And Herod the Tetrarch heard al things that vvere done by him: and he ſtaggered becauſe it vvas ſaid of ſome, That Iohn vvas riſen from the dead.
label: Luke

text: but of other ſome, That Elias hath appeared: and of others, that a Prophet one of the old ones vvas riſen.
label: Luke

text: And Herod ſaid, Iohn I haue beheaded: but vvho is this of vvhom I heare ſuch things? And he ſought for to ſee him.
label: Luke

text: And the Apoſtles being returned, reported to him vvhatſoeuer they did: and taking them he retired apart into a deſert place, vvhich belongeth to Beth-ſaida.
label: Luke

text: Which the multitudes vnderſtanding, folovved him: & he receiued them, and ſpake to them of the kingdom of God, and them that had neede of cure he healed.
label: Luke
