text: And the day began to dravv towards an end. And the Tvvelue comming neere, ſaid to him, Dimiſſe the multitudes, that going into tovvnes and villages here about, they may haue lodging, and finde meates: becauſe here we are in a deſert place.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, Giue you them to eate. But they ſaid, We haue no more but fiue loaues and tvvo fiſhes: vnles perhaps vve ſhould goe and bie meates for al this multitude.
label: Luke

text: And there vvere men almoſt fiue thouſand. And he ſaid to his diſciples, Make them ſit dovvne by companies fiftie and fiftie.
label: Luke

text: And ſo they did. And they made al ſit downe.
label: Luke

text: And taking the fiue loaues and the tvvo fiſhes, he looked vp vnto heauen, and bleſſed them: and he brake, and diſtributed to his diſciples, for to ſet before the multitudes.
label: Luke

text: And they did al eate, and had their fill. And there vvas taken vp that vvhich remained to them, tvvelue baſkets of fragments.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe: vvhen he vvas alone praying, his diſciples alſo vvere vvith him: and he aſked them ſaying, VVhom doe the multitudes ſay that I am?
label: Luke

text: But they anſwered, and ſaid, Iohn the Baptiſt: and ſome, Elias: but ſome, that one of the Prophets before time, is riſen.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, But vvhom ſay ye that I am? Simon Peter anſvvering, ſaid, The CHRIST of God.
label: Luke

text: But he rebuking them, commaunded that they ſhould tell this to no man,
label: Luke

text: ſaying, That the ſonne of man muſt ſuffer many things, and be reiected of the Auncients and cheefe Prieſts and Scribes, and be killed, and the third day riſe againe.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to al, If any man vvil come after me, let him denie him ſelf, and take vp his croſſe daily, and folovv me.
label: Luke

text: For he that vvil ſaue his life, ſhal loſe it: for he that ſhal loſe his life for my ſake, ſhal ſaue it.
label: Luke

text: for vvhat profit hath a man if he gaine the vvhole vvorld, and loſe him ſelf, and caſt avvay him ſelf?
label: Luke

text: For he that ſhal be aſhamed of me and of my vvordes, him the Sonne of man ſhal be aſhamed of, vvhen he ſhal come in his maieſtie, and his fathers, and of the holy Angels.
label: Luke

text: And I ſay to you aſſuredly, There be ſome ſtanding here that ſhal not taſt death, til they ſee the kingdom of God.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe after theſe vvordes almoſt eight daies, and he tooke Peter and Iames and Iohn, and vvent into a mountaine to pray.
label: Luke

text: And vvhiles he prayed, the ſhape of his countenance vvas altered: and his raiment vvhite and gliſtering.
label: Luke

text: And behold tvvo men talked vvith him. And they vvere Moyſes and Elias,
label: Luke

text: appearing in maieſtie. And they told his deceaſe that he ſhould accompliſh in Hieruſalem.
label: Luke

text: But Peter and they that vvere vvith him, vvere heauie vvith ſleepe. And avvaking, they ſavv his maieſtie, and the tvvo men that ſtoode vvith him.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe, vvhen they departed from him, Peter ſaid to IESVS, Maiſter, it is good for vs to be here: and let vs make three tabernacles, one for thee, and one for Moyſes, and one for Elias: not knovving vvhat he ſaid.
label: Luke

text: And as he ſpake theſe things, there came a cloud, and ouerſhadovved them: and they feared, vvhen they entered into the cloude.
label: Luke

text: And a voice vvas made out of the cloude, ſaying, This is my beloued ſonne, heare him.
label: Luke

text: And vvhiles the voice vvas made, IESVS vvas found alone. And they held their peace, and told no man in thoſe daies any of theſe things vvhich they had ſeen.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe the day folovving, vvhen they came dovvne from the mountaine, there mette him a great multitude.
label: Luke

text: And behold a man of the multitude cried out, ſaying, Maiſter, I beſeeche thee, looke vpon my ſonne becauſe he is mine only one.
label: Luke

text: and loe, the ſpirit taketh him, and he ſodenly crieth, and he daſheth him, and teareth him that he fometh, and vvith much a doe departeth renting him.
label: Luke

text: And I deſired thy diſciples to caſt him out, and they could not.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS anſvvering ſaid, O faithles and peruerſe generation, how long ſhal I be vvith you and ſuffer you? bring hither thy ſonne.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he came to him, the deuil daſhed, and tore him. And IESVS rebuked the vncleane ſpirit, and healed the lad: and rendred him to his father.
label: Luke

text: And al vvere aſtonied at the might of God: and al merueiling at al things that he did, he ſaid to his diſciples,
label: Luke

text: Lay you in your hartes theſe vvordes, for it ſhal come to paſſe that the Sonne of man ſhal be deliuered into the hands of men.
label: Luke

text: But they did not know this vvord, and it vvas couered before them, that they perceiued it not. And they vvere afraid to aſke him of this vvord.
label: Luke

text: And there entred a cogitation into them, vvhich of them ſhould be greater.
label: Luke

text: But IESVS ſeeing the cogitations of their hart, tooke a childe and ſet him by him,
label: Luke

text: and ſaid to them, Whoſoeuer receiueth this childe in my name, receiueth me: and vvhoſoeuer receiueth me, receiueth him that ſent me. For he that is the leſſer among you al, he is the greater.
label: Luke

text: And Iohn anſvvering ſaid, Maiſter, vve ſavv a certaine man caſting out deuils in thy name, and vve prohibited him, becauſe he folovveth not vvith vs.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid to him, Prohibit not. for he that is not againſt you, is for you.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe, vvhiles the daies of his aſſumption vvere accompliſhing, and he fixed his face to goe into Hieruſalem.
label: Luke

text: And he ſent meſſengers before his face: and going they entred into a citie of the Samaritans to prepare for him.
label: Luke

text: And they receiued him not, becauſe his face vvas to goe to Hieruſalem.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen his diſciples Iames and Iohn had ſeen it, they ſaid, Lord vvilt thou vve ſay that fire come dovvne from heauen and conſume `them'?
label: Luke

text: And turning, he rebuked them, ſaying, You knovv not of vvhat ſpirit you are.
label: Luke

text: The ſonne of man came not to deſtroy ſoules, but to ſaue. And they vvent into an other tovvne.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe as they vvalked in the vvay, a certaine man ſaid to him, I vvil folovv thee vvhitherſoeuer thou goeſt.
label: Luke

text: IESVS ſaid to him, The foxes haue holes, and the foules of the aire neſtes: but the ſonne of man hath not where to repoſe his head.
label: Luke

text: But he ſaid to an other, Folow me. And he ſaid, Lord, permit me firſt to goe, and to burie my father.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid to him, Let the dead burie their dead: but goe thou, ſet forth the kingdom of God.
label: Luke

text: And an other ſaid, I vvil folovv thee Lord, but permit me firſt to take my leaue of them that are at home.
label: Luke

text: IESVS ſaid to him, No man putting his hand to the plough, and looking backe, is apt for the kingdom of God.
label: Luke

text: AND after this our Lord deſigned alſo other ſeuentie tvvo: and he ſent them tvvo and tvvo before his face into euery citie and place vvhither him ſelf vvould come.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, The harueſt truely is much: but the vvorkemen fevv. Deſire therfore the lord of the harueſt, that he ſend vvorkemen into his harueſt.
label: Luke

text: Goe: behold I ſend you as lambes among wolues.
label: Luke

text: Carie not purſe nor ſkrip, nor ſhoes: and ſalute no body by the vvay.
label: Luke

text: Into vvhatſoeuer houſe you enter, firſt ſay, Peace to this houſe.
label: Luke

text: and if the ſonne of peace be there, your peace ſhal reſt vpon him: but if not, it ſhal returne to you.
label: Luke

text: And in the ſame houſe tarie you, eating and drinking ſuch things as they haue. For the vvorkeman is vvorthie of his hire. Remoue not from houſe to houſe.
label: Luke

text: And into vvhat citie ſoeuer you enter, and they receiue you, eate ſuch things as are ſet before you:
label: Luke

text: and cure the ſicke that are in it, and ſay to them, The kingdom of God is come nigh vpon you. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And into vvhatſoeuer citie you enter, and they receiue you not, going forth into the ſtreates thereof, ſay,
label: Luke

text: The duſt alſo of your citie that cleaueth to vs, vve doe vvipe of againſt you. yet this knovv ye that the kingdom of God is at hand.
label: Luke

text: I ſay to you, it ſhal be more tolerable for Sodom in that day, then for that citie.
label: Luke

text: VVo to thee Corozáim, vvo to thee Beth-ſaida: for if in Tyre and Sidon had been vvrought the miracles that haue beene vvrought in you, they had done penance ſitting in ſacke cloth and aſhes long agoe.
label: Luke

text: But it ſhal be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the iudgement, then for you.
label: Luke

text: And thou Capharnaum that art exalted vnto heauen: thou ſhalt be thruſt dovvne euen vnto hel.
label: Luke

text: He that heareth you, heareth me: and he that deſpiſeth you, deſpiſeth me. And he that deſpiſeth me, deſpiſeth him that ſent me.
label: Luke

text: And the Seuentie-tvvo returned vvith ioy, ſaying, Lord, the Deuils alſo are ſubiect to vs in thy name.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, I ſavv Satan as a lightening fal from heauen.
label: Luke

text: Behold, I haue giuen you povver to treade vpon ſerpents, and ſcorpions, and vpon al the povver of the enemie, and nothing ſhal hurt you.
label: Luke

text: But yet reioyce not in this, that the ſpirits are ſubiect vnto you: but reioyce in this, that your names are written in heauen. ⊢
label: Luke

text: In that very houre he reioyced in ſpirit, and ſaid, I confeſſe to thee O Father, Lord of heauen and earth, becauſe thou haſt hid theſe things from the wiſe and prudent, and haſt reuealed them to litle ones. Yea Father, for ſo hath it wel pleaſed thee.
label: Luke

text: Al things are deliuered to me of my father. And no man knovveth vvho the Sonne is, but the Father: and vvho the Father is, but the Sonne, and to vvhom the Sonne vvil reueale.
label: Luke

text: And turning to his Diſciples, he ſaid, Bleſſed are the eies that ſee the things that you ſee.
label: Luke

text: For I ſay to you, that many Prophets and Kings deſired to ſee the things that you ſee, and ſaw them not: and to heare the things that you heare, and heard them not.
label: Luke

text: And behold a certaine lavvyer ſtoode vp, tempting him and ſaying, Maiſter, by doing of what thing ſhal I poſſeſſe life euerlaſting?
label: Luke

text: But he ſaid to him, In the law vvhat is vvritten? hovv readeſt thou?
label: Luke

text: He anſvvering ſaid, Thou ſhalt loue the Lord thy God vvith thy whole hart, and with thy whole ſoule, and with al thy ſtrength, and vvith al thy minde: and thy neighbour as thy ſelf.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to him, Thou haſt anſvvered right, this doe and thou ſhalt liue.
label: Luke

text: But he deſirous to iuſtifie him ſelf, ſaid to IESVS, And vvho is my neighbour?
label: Luke

text: And IESVS taking it, ſaid, A certaine man vvent dovvne from Hieruſalem into Iericho, and fel among theeues, vvho alſo ſpoiled him, and giuing him vvoundes vvent avvay leauing him halfe-dead.
label: Luke

text: And it chaunced that a certaine Prieſt vvent dovvne the ſame vvay: and ſeeing him, paſſed by.
label: Luke

text: In like maner alſo a Leuite, vvhen he vvas neere the place, and ſavv him, paſſed by.
label: Luke

text: But a certaine Samaritane going his iourney, came neere him: and ſeeing him, was moued vvith mercie.
label: Luke

text: And going vnto him, bound his vvoundes, povvring in oile and vvine: and ſetting him vpon his ovvne beaſt, brought him into an inne, and tooke care of him.
label: Luke

text: And the next day he tooke forth two pence, and gaue to the hoſt, and ſaid, Haue care of him: and whatſoeuer thou ſhalt ſupererogate, I at my returne vvil repay thee.
label: Luke

text: Vvhich of theſe three in thy opinion was neighbour to him that fel among theeues?
label: Luke

text: But he ſaid, He that did mercie vpon him. And IESVS ſaid to him, Goe, and doe thou in like maner. ⊢
label: Luke

text: b And it came to paſſe as they vvent, and he entred into a certaine tovvne: and a certaine vvoman named Martha, receiued him into her houſe,
label: Luke

text: and ſhe had a ſiſter called Marie. vvho ſitting alſo at our Lords feete, heard his vvord.
label: Luke

text: But Martha vvas buſie about much ſeruice. who ſtoode and ſaid, Lord, haſt thou no care that my ſiſter hath left me alone to ſerue? ſpeake to her therfore, that ſhe help me.
label: Luke

text: And our Lord anſvvering ſaid to her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful, and art troubled about very many things.
label: Luke

text: But one thing is neceſſarie. Marie hath choſen the beſt part vvhich ſhal not be taken avvay from her. ⊢
label: Luke

text: AND it came to paſſe, vvhen he was in a certaine place, praying, as he ceaſed, one of his Diſciples ſaid to him, Lord teach vs to pray, as Iohn alſo taught his Diſciples.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, VVhen you pray, ſay, FATHER, ſanctified be thy name. Thy kingdom come,
label: Luke

text: Our daily bread giue vs this day,
label: Luke

text: and forgiue vs our ſinnes, for becauſe our ſelues alſo doe forgiue euery one that is in debt to vs. And lead vs not into temptation.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, VVhich of you ſhal haue a frende, and ſhal goe to him at midnight, and ſhal ſay to him, Frende, lend me three loaues,
label: Luke

text: becauſe a frende of mine is come out of his way to me, and I haue not what to ſet before him:
label: Luke

text: & he from vvithin anſvvering ſaith, Trouble me not, novv the doore is ſhut, and my children are vvith me in bed: I can not riſe and giue thee.
label: Luke

text: And if he ſhal perſeuêre knocking, I ſay to you, although he vvil not riſe and giue him becauſe he is his frende, yet for his importunitie he vvil riſe, and giue him as many as he needeth.
label: Luke

text: And I ſay to you, Aſke, and it ſhal be giuen you: ſeeke, and you ſhal finde: knocke, and it ſhal be opened to you.
label: Luke

text: For euery one that aſketh, receiueth: and he that ſeeketh, findeth: and to him that knocketh, it ſhal be opened.
label: Luke

text: And vvhich of you if he aſke his father bread, vvil he giue him a ſtone? or a fiſh, vvil he for a fiſh giue him a ſerpent?
label: Luke

text: Or if he aſke an egge, vvil he reach him a ſcorpion?
label: Luke

text: If you then being naught, knovv hovv to giue good giftes to your children, hovv much more vvil your father from heauen giue the good ſpirit to them that aſke him? ⊢
label: Luke

text: And he vvas caſting out a deuil, and that vvas dumme. And vvhen he had caſt out the deuil, the dumme ſpake: and the multitudes marueiled.
label: Luke

text: And certaine of them ſaid, In Beel-zebub the prince of Deuils he caſteth out Deuils.
label: Luke

text: And other tempting, aſked of him a ſigne from heauen.
label: Luke

text: But he ſeeing their cogitations, ſaid to them, Euery kingdom deuided againſt it ſelf, ſhal be made deſolate, and c houſe vpon houſe, ſhal fall.
label: Luke

text: And if Satan alſo be deuided againſt him ſelf, hovv ſhal his kingdom ſtand? becauſe you ſay that in Beel-zebub I doe caſt out Deuils.
label: Luke

text: And if I in Beel-zebub caſt out Deuils: your children, in vvhom doe they caſt out? therfore they ſhal be your iudges.
label: Luke

text: But if I in the finger of God doe caſt out Deuils: ſurely the kingdom of God is come vpon you.
label: Luke

text: When the ſtrong armed keepeth his court: thoſe things are in peace that he poſſeſſeth.
label: Luke

text: But if a ſtronger then he, come vpon him and ouercome him: he vvil take avvay his vvhole armour vvherein he truſted, and vvil diſtribute his ſpoiles.
label: Luke

text: He that is not vvith me, is againſt me: and he that gathereth not vvith me, ſcattereth.
label: Luke

text: When the vncleane ſpirit ſhal depart out of a man, he vvandereth through places vvithout vvater, ſeeking reſt. And not finding, he ſaith, I vvil returne into my houſe vvhence I departed.
label: Luke

text: And when he is come, he findeth it ſwept vvith a beſome, and trimmed.
label: Luke

text: Then he goeth and taketh ſeuen other ſpirits vvorſe then him ſelf, and entring in they dvvel there. And the c laſt of that man be made vvorſe then the firſt.
label: Luke

text: b And it came to paſſe: vvhen he ſaid theſe things, a certaine vvoman lifting vp her voice out of the multitude ſaid to him, Bleſſed is the vvombe that bare thee, and the pappes that thou didſt ſucke.
label: Luke

text: But he ſaid, Yea rather, bleſſed are they that heare the vvord of God, and keepe it. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And the multitudes running together, he began to ſay, This generation, is a vvicked generation: it aſketh a ſigne, and a ſigne ſhal not be giuen it but the ſigne of Ionas the Prophet.
label: Luke

text: For as Ionas vvas a ſigne to the Niniuites: ſo ſhal the Sonne of man alſo be to this generation.
label: Luke

text: The Queene of the South ſhal riſe in the iudgement vvith the men of this generation, and ſhal condemne them: becauſe ſhe came from the endes of the earth to heare the vviſedom of Salomon. and behold, more then Salomon here.
label: Luke

text: The men of Niniuee ſhal riſe in the iudgement vvith this generation, and ſhal condemne it, becauſe they did penance at the preaching of Ionas. and behold, more then Ionas here.
label: Luke

text: No man lighteth a candel, and putteth it in ſecrete, neither vnder a buſhel: but vpon a candleſticke, that they that goe in may ſee the light.
label: Luke

text: The candel of thy body, is thine eie. If thine eie be ſimple, thy vvhole body ſhal be lightſome: but if it be naught, thy body alſo ſhal be darkeſome.
label: Luke

text: See therfore that the light vvhich is in thee, be not darkeneſſe.
label: Luke

text: If then thy vvhole body be lightſome, hauing no part of darkeneſſe: it ſhal be lightſome vvholy, and as a bright candel it ſhal lighten thee. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he vvas ſpeaking, a certaine Phariſee deſired him that he vvould dine vvith him. and he going in ſate dovvne to eate.
label: Luke

text: And the Phariſee began to thinke vvithin him ſelf and to ſay, VVhy he vvas not vvaſhed before dinner.
label: Luke

text: And our Lord ſaid to him, Novv you Phariſees doe make cleane that on the out ſide of the cuppe and of the platter: but that of yours vvhich is vvithin, is ful of rapine and iniquitie.
label: Luke

text: Fooles, did not he that made that on the outſide, make that alſo that is on the inſide?
label: Luke

text: But yet c that that remaineth, giue almes, & behold al things are cleane vnto you.
label: Luke

text: But vvo to you Phariſees, becauſe you tithe minte and revve and euery herbe: and paſſe ouer iudgement and the charitie of God. but theſe things you ought to haue done, and not to omit thoſe.
label: Luke

text: Wo to you Phariſees, becauſe you loue the firſt chaires in the ſynagogs, and ſalutations in the market-place.
label: Luke

text: Wo to you, becauſe you are as monuments that appeare not, and men vvalking ouer, are not vvare.
label: Luke

text: And one of the Lavvyers anſwering ſaith to him, Maiſter, in ſaying theſe things, thou ſpeakeſt to our reproche alſo.
label: Luke

text: But he ſaid, Vvo to you Lavvyers alſo: becauſe you lode men vvith burdens which they can not beare, and your ſelues touch not the packes vvith one of your fingers.
label: Luke

text: Wo to you that build the monuments of the Prophets: and your fathers did kil them.
label: Luke

text: Surely you doe teſtifie that you conſent to the vvorkes of your fathers: becauſe they in deede did kil them, and you build their ſepulchres.
label: Luke

text: For this cauſe the wiſedom alſo of God ſaid, I vvil ſend to them Prophets and Apoſtles, and of them they vvil kil and perſecute.
label: Luke

text: that the bloud of al the Prophets that vvas ſhed from the making of the vvorld, may be required of this generation,
label: Luke

text: from the bloud of Abel vnto the bloud of Zacharie that vvas ſlaine betvvene the altar and the temple. Yea I ſay to you, it ſhal be required of this generation. ⊢
label: Luke

text: Vvo to you Lavvyers, becauſe you haue taken avvay the key of knovvledge: your ſelues haue not entred, and thoſe that did enter you haue prohibited.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he ſaid theſe things to them, the Phariſees and the Lavvyers began vehemently to vrge him, and to ſtoppe his mouth about many things,
label: Luke

text: lying in waite for him, & ſeeking to catch ſome thing of his mouth, that they might accuſe him.
label: Luke

text: AND when great multitudes ſtoode about him, ſo that they trode one an other, he began to ſay to his Diſciples, Take good heede of the leauen of the Phariſees, vvhich is hypocriſie.
label: Luke

text: For nothing is hid, that ſhal not be reuealed: nor ſecrete, that ſhal not be knovven.
label: Luke

text: For the things that you haue ſaid in darkneſſe, ſhal be ſaid in the light: and that which you haue ſpoken into the eare in the chambers, ſhal be preached in the houſe-toppes.
label: Luke

text: And I ſay to you my frendes, Be not afraid of them that kil the body, and after this haue no more to doe.
label: Luke

text: But I wil ſhevv you whom ye ſhal feare: feare him vvho after he hath killed, hath povver to caſt into hel. yea I ſay to you, feare him.
label: Luke

text: Are not fiue ſparowes ſold for tvvo farthings: and one of them is not forgotten before God?
label: Luke

text: Yea the heares alſo of your head are al numbered. Feare not therfore: you are more vvorth then many ſparowes.
label: Luke

text: And I ſay to you, Euery one that confeſſeth me before men, the Sonne of man alſo vvil confeſſe him before the Angels of God.
label: Luke

text: But he that denieth me before men, ſhal be denied before the Angels of God.
label: Luke

text: And euery one that ſpeaketh a vvord againſt the ſonne of man, it ſhal be forgiuen him: but he that ſhal blaſpheme againſt the holy Ghoſt, to him it ſhal not be forgiuen.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen they ſhal bring you in to the ſynagogs and to magiſtrates and poteſtates, be not careful in what maner, and vvhat you ſhal anſvver, or vvhat you ſhal ſay.
label: Luke

text: For the holy Ghoſt ſhal teach you in the very houre vvhat you muſt ſay.
label: Luke

text: And one of the multitude ſaid to him, Maiſter, ſpeake to my brother that he deuide the inheritaunce vvith me.
label: Luke

text: But he ſaid to him, Man, vvho hath appointed me iudge or deuider ouer you?
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, See and bevvare of al auarice: for not in any mans aboundance doth his life conſiſt, of thoſe things vvhich he poſſeſſeth.
label: Luke

text: And he ſpake a ſimilitude to them, ſaying, A certaine riche mans field yelded plentie of fruites.
label: Luke

text: and he thought vvithin him ſelf, ſaying, VVhat ſhal I doe, becauſe I haue not vvhither to gather my fruites?
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid, This vvil I doe, I vvil deſtroy my barnes, and vvil make greater: and thither vvil I gather al things that are grovven to me, and my goods,
label: Luke

text: and I vvil ſay to my ſoule, Soule, thou haſt much goods laid vp for many yeres, take thy reſt, eate, drinke, make good cheere.
label: Luke

text: But God ſaid to him, Thou foole, this night they require thy ſoule of thee: and the things that thou haſt prouided, vvhoſe ſhal they be?
label: Luke

text: So is he that laieth vp treaſure to him ſelf, and is not riche to God vvard.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to his Diſciples, Therfore I ſay to you, Be not careful for your life, vvhat you ſhal eate: nor for your body, vvhat you ſhal doe on.
label: Luke

text: The life is more then the meate, and the body is more then the raiment.
label: Luke

text: Conſider the rauens, for they ſovv not, neither doe they reape, vvhich neither haue ſtorehouſe nor barne, and God feedeth them. Hovv much more are you of greater price then they?
label: Luke

text: And vvhich of you by caring can adde to his ſtature one cubite?
label: Luke

text: If then you be not able to doe ſo much as the leaſt thing, for the reſt vvhy are you careful?
label: Luke

text: Conſider the lilies how they grovv: they labour not, neither doe they ſpinne. But I ſay to you, Neither Salomon in al his glorie vvas araied as one of theſe.
label: Luke

text: And if the graſſe that to day is in the field, and to morovv is caſt into the ouen, God ſo clotheth: hovv much more you O ye of litle faith!
label: Luke

text: And you, doe not ſeeke vvhat you ſhal eate, or vvhat you ſhal drinke: and c be not lifted vp on high.
label: Luke

text: for al theſe things the nations of the vvorld doe ſeeke. but your father knovveth that you haue neede of theſe things.
label: Luke

text: But ſeeke firſt the kingdom of God, and al theſe things ſhal be giuen you beſides.
label: Luke

text: b Feare not litle flocke, for it hath pleaſed your father to giue you a kingdom.
label: Luke

text: Sel the things that you poſſeſſe, and giue almes. Make to you purſes that vveare not, treaſure that vvaſteth not, in heauen: vvhither the theefe approcheth not, neither doth the mothe corrupt.
label: Luke

text: For vvhere your treaſure is, there vvil your hart be alſo. ⊢
label: Luke

text: b Let your loynes be girded, and candles burning in your handes,
label: Luke

text: and you like to men expecting their lord, when he ſhal returne from the mariage: that vvhen he doth come and knocke, forthvvith they may open vnto him.
label: Luke

text: Bleſſed are thoſe ſeruants, vvhom vvhen the Lord commeth, he ſhal finde vvatching. Amen I ſay to you, that he vvil gird him ſelf, and make them ſit dovvne, and paſſing vvil miniſter vnto them.
label: Luke

text: And if he come in the ſecond vvatch, and if in the third vvatch he come, and ſo finde, bleſſed are thoſe ſeruants.
label: Luke

text: And this knovv ye, that if the houſholder did knovv vvhat houre the theefe vvould come, he would watch verely, and vvould not ſuffer his houſe to be broken vp.
label: Luke

text: Be you alſo ready: for at vvhat houre you thinke not, the Sonne of man vvil come. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And Peter ſaid to him, Lord, doeſt thou ſpeake this parable to vs, or likevviſe to al?
label: Luke

text: And our Lord ſaid, VVho (thinkeſt thou) is a faithful ſtevvard and vviſe, vvhom the lord appointeth ouer his familie, to giue them in ſeaſon their meaſure of vvheate?
label: Luke

text: Bleſſed is that ſeruant, vvhom vvhen the lord commeth, he ſhal finde ſo doing.
label: Luke

text: Verely I ſay to you, that ouer al things vvhich he poſſeſſeth, he ſhal appoint him.
label: Luke

text: But if that ſeruant ſay in his hart, My lord is long a comming: and ſhal begin to ſtrike the ſeruants and handmaides, and eate and drinke, and be drunke:
label: Luke

text: the lord of that ſeruant ſhal come in a day that he hopeth not, and at an houre that he knovveth not, and ſhal deuide him, and ſhal appoint his portion with the infidels.
label: Luke

text: And that ſeruant that knew the wil of his lord, and prepared not him ſelf, and did not according to his vvil: ſhal be beaten vvith many ſtripes.
label: Luke

text: But he that knevv not, and did things worthie of ſtripes: ſhal be beaten vvith fevv. And euery one to whom much vvas giuen, much ſhal be required of him: and to vvhom they committed much, more vvil they demaund of him.
label: Luke

text: I came to caſt fire on the earth: and vvhat vvil I, but that it be kindled?
label: Luke

text: But I haue to be baptized with a baptiſme: and hovv am I ſtraitened vntil it be diſpatched?
label: Luke

text: Thinke you that I came to giue peace on the earth? No, I tel you, but ſeparation.
label: Luke

text: For there ſhal be from this time, fiue in one houſe deuided: three againſt tvvo, and tvvo againſt three.
label: Luke

text: There ſhal be deuided, the father againſt the ſonne, and the ſonne againſt his father, the mother againſt the daughter, and the daughter againſt the mother, the mother in lavv againſt her daughter in lavv, and the daughter in lavv againſt her mother in lavv.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid alſo to the multitudes, When you ſee a cloude riſing from the vveſt, by and by you ſay, A ſhoure commeth, and ſo it commeth to paſſe:
label: Luke

text: and vvhen the ſouth vvinde blovving, you ſay, That there vvil be heate: and it commeth to paſſe.
label: Luke

text: Hypocrites, the face of the heauen and of the earth you haue ſkil to diſcerne: but this time hovv doe you not diſcerne?
label: Luke

text: And why of your ſelues alſo iudge you not that vvhich is iuſt?
label: Luke

text: And vvhen thou goeſt vvith thy aduerſarie to the Prince, in the vvay endeuour to be deliuered from him: leſt perhaps he dravv thee to the iudge, and the iudge deliuer thee to the exactour, and the exactour caſt thee into priſon.
label: Luke

text: I ſay to thee, thou ſhalt not goe out thence, vntil thou pay the very laſt mite.
label: Luke

text: AND there vvere certaine preſent at that very time telling him of the Galilaeans, vvhoſe bloud Pilate mingled vvith their ſacrifices.
label: Luke

text: And he anſvvering ſaid to them, Thinke you that theſe Galileans vvere ſinners more then al the Galilaeans that they ſuffred ſuch things?
label: Luke

text: No, I ſay to you: but vnles you haue penance, you ſhal al likewiſe periſh.
label: Luke

text: As thoſe eightene vpon vvhom the toure fel in Silóe, and ſlevv them: thinke you that they alſo vvere detters aboue al the men that dvvel in Hieruſalem?
label: Luke

text: No, I ſay to you: but if you haue not penance, you ſhal al likevviſe periſh.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid this ſimilitude, A certaine man had a figtree planted in his vineyard, and he came ſeeking for fruite on it, and found not.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to the dreſſer of the vineyard, Loe it is three yeres ſince I come ſeeking for fruite vpon this figtree: and I finde not. Cut it dovvne therfore: vvhereto doth it alſo occupie the ground?
label: Luke

text: But he anſwering ſaith to him, Lord, let it alone this yere alſo, vntil I digge about it, and dung it.
label: Luke

text: and if happily it yeld fruite: but if not, hereafter thou ſhalt cut it dovvne.
label: Luke

text: And he vvas teaching in their ſynagogue on the Sabboths.
label: Luke

text: And behold a vvoman that had a ſpirit of infirmitie eightene yeres: and ſhe vvas crooked neither could ſhe looke vpvvard at al.
label: Luke

text: Whom vvhen IESVS ſavv, he called her vnto him, and ſaid to her, Woman, thou art deliuered from thy infirmitie.
label: Luke

text: And he impoſed hands vpon her, and forthvvith ſhe vvas made ſtraight and glorified God.
label: Luke

text: And the Archſynagogue anſvvering (becauſe he had indignation that IESVS had cured on the Sabboth) ſaid to the multitude, Sixe daies there are vvherein you ought to vvorke. in them therfore come, and be cured: and not in the Sabboth day.
label: Luke

text: And our Lord anſvvering to him, ſaid, Hypocrite, doth not euery one of you vpon the Sabboth looſe his oxe or his aſſe from the manger, and leadeth them to vvater?
label: Luke

text: But this daughter of Abraham vvhom Satan hath bound, loe, theſe eightene yeres, ought not ſhe to be looſed from this bond on the Sabboth day?
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he ſaid theſe things, al his aduerſaries vvere aſhamed: and al the people reioyced in al things that vvere gloriouſly done of him. ⊢
label: Luke

text: He ſaid therfore, VVherevnto is the kingdom of God like, and vvherevnto ſhal I eſteeme it like?
label: Luke

text: It is like to a muſtard ſeede, vvhich a man tooke and caſt into his garden, and it grevv: and became a great tree, and the foules of the aire reſted in the boughes thereof.
label: Luke

text: And againe he ſaid, Like to vvhat ſhal I eſteeme the kingdom of God?
label: Luke

text: It is like to leauen, vvhich a vvoman tooke and hid in three meaſures of meale, til the vvhole vvas leauened.
label: Luke

text: And he vvent by cities and tovvnes teaching, and making his iourney vnto Hieruſalem.
label: Luke

text: And a certaine man ſaid to him, Lord, be they fevv that are ſaued? But he ſaid to them,
label: Luke

text: Striue to enter by the narrow gate: becauſe many, I ſay to you, ſhal ſeeke to enter, and ſhal not be able.
label: Luke

text: But vvhen the good man of the houſe ſhal enter in, and ſhut the doore, and you ſhal begin to ſtand vvithout, and knocke at the doore, ſaying, Lord open to vs: and he anſvvering ſhal ſay to you, I knovv you not vvhence you are:
label: Luke

text: then you ſhal begin to ſay, VVe did eate before thee and drinke, and in our ſtreates didſt thou teach.
label: Luke

text: And he ſhal ſay to you, I knovv you not vvhence you are, depart from me al ye vvorkers of iniquitie.
label: Luke

text: There ſhal be vveeping and gnaſhing of teeth: vvhen you ſhal ſee Abraham and Iſaac and Iacob, and al the Prophets in the kingdom of God, and you to be thruſt out.
label: Luke

text: And there ſhal come from the Eaſt and the Weſt and the North and the South: and ſhal ſit dovvne in the kingdom of God.
label: Luke

text: And behold, they are laſt that ſhal be firſt, and they be firſt that ſhal be laſt.
label: Luke

text: The ſame day there came certaine of the Phariſees, ſaying to him, Depart and get the hence, becauſe Herod vvil kil thee.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, Goe, and tel that foxe, Behold I caſt out deuils, and perfite cures this day and to morovv, and the third day I am conſummate.
label: Luke

text: But yet, I muſt vvalke this day and to morovv and the day folovving, becauſe it ccannot be that a Prophet periſh out of Hieruſalem.
label: Luke

text: Hieruſalem, Hieruſalem vvhich killeſt the Prophets, and ſtoneſt them that are ſent to thee, hovv often vvould I gather thy children as the bird doth her brood vnder her vvings, and thou vvouldeſt not?
label: Luke

text: Behold your houſe ſhal be left deſert to you. And I ſay to you, that you ſhal not ſee me til it come vvhen you ſhal ſay, Bleſſed is he that commeth in the name of our Lord.
label: Luke

text: AND it came to paſſe when IESVS entred into the houſe of a certaine Prince of the Phariſees vpon the Sabboth to eate bread, and they vvatched him.
label: Luke

text: And behold there vvas a certaine man before him that had the dropſie.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS anſvvering, ſpake to the Lavvyers and Phariſees, ſaying, Is it Lavvful to cure on the Sabboth?
label: Luke

text: But they held their peace. but he taking him, healed him, and ſent him avvay.
label: Luke

text: And anſvvering them he ſaid, VVhich of you ſhal haue an aſſe or an oxe fallen into a pit: and vvil not incontinent dravv him out on the Sabboth day?
label: Luke

text: And they could not anſvver him to theſe things.
label: Luke

text: And he ſpake to them alſo that vvere inuited a parable, marking hovv they choſe the firſt ſeats at the table, ſaying to them,
label: Luke

text: When thou art inuited to a mariage, ſit not dovvne in the firſt place, leſt perhaps a more honorable then thou be inuited of him:
label: Luke

text: and he that bade thee and him, come and ſay to thee, Giue this man place: and then thou begin vvith ſhame to take the laſt place.
label: Luke

text: But vvhen thou art bidden, goe, ſit dovvne in the lovveſt place: that vvhen he that inuited thee, commeth, he may ſay to thee, Frende, ſit vp higher: then ſhalt thou haue glorie before them that ſit at table vvith thee.
label: Luke

text: becauſe euery one that exalteth him ſelf, ſhal be humbled: and he that humbleth him ſelf, ſhal be exalted. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to him alſo that had inuited him, VVhen thou makeſt a dinner or a ſupper, call not thy frendes, nor thy brethren, nor kinſmen, nor thy neighbours that are riche: leſt perhaps they alſo inuite thee againe, and recompenſe be made to thee.
label: Luke

text: But vvhen thou makeſt a feaſt, cal the poore, feeble, lame, and blinde,
label: Luke

text: and thou ſhalt be bleſſed, becauſe they haue not to recompenſe thee: for recompenſe ſhal be made thee in the reſurrection of the iuſt.
label: Luke

text: VVhen one of them that ſate at the table vvith him, had heard theſe things, he ſaid to him, Bleſſed is he that ſhal eate bread in the kingdom of God.
label: Luke

text: But he ſaid to him, A certaine man made a great ſupper, and called many.
label: Luke

text: And he ſent his ſeruant at the houre of ſupper to ſay to the inuited, That they ſhould come, becauſe now al things are ready.
label: Luke

text: And they began al at once to make excuſe. The firſt ſaid to him, I haue bought a farme, and I muſt needes goe forth and ſee it, I pray thee hold me excuſed.
label: Luke

text: And an other ſaid, I haue bought fiue yoke of oxen, and I goe to proue them, I pray thee, hold me excuſed.
label: Luke

text: And an other ſaid, I haue maried a vvife, and therfore I can not come.
label: Luke

text: And the ſeruant returning told theſe things to his lord. Then the maiſter of the houſe being angrie, ſaid to his ſeruant, Goe forth quickly into the ſtreates and lanes of the citie, and the poore and feeble and blinde and lame bring in hither.
label: Luke

text: And the ſeruant ſaid, Lord, it is done as thou didſt commaunde, and yet there is place.
label: Luke

text: And the lord ſaid to the ſeruant, Goe forth into the waies and hedges: and compel them to enter, that my houſe may be filled.
label: Luke

text: But I ſay to you, that none of thoſe men that vvere called, ſhal taſt my ſupper. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And great multitudes vvent vvith him: and turning, he ſaid to them,
label: Luke

text: If any man come to me and hateth not his father and mother, and vvife and children, and brethren and ſiſters, yea and his ovvne life beſides: he can not be my diſciple.
label: Luke

text: And he that doth not beare his croſſe and come after me: cannot be my diſciple.
label: Luke

text: For, vvhich of you minding to build a toure, doth not firſt ſit dovvne and recken the charges that are neceſſarie, vvhether he haue to finiſh it:
label: Luke

text: leſt, after that he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finiſh it, al that ſee it, begin to mocke him,
label: Luke

text: ſaying, That this man began to build, and he could not finiſh it?
label: Luke

text: Or what king about to goe to make warre againſt an other king, doth not firſt ſit downe and thinke whether he be able with ten thouſands to meete him that with twentie thouſands commeth againſt him?
label: Luke

text: Otherwiſe whiles he is yet farre of, ſending a legacie he aſketh thoſe things that belong to peace.
label: Luke

text: So therfore euery one of you that doth not renounce al that he poſſeſſeth, cannot be my diſciple. ⊢
label: Luke

text: Salt is good. But if the ſalt leeſe his vertue, wherewith ſhal it be ſeaſoned?
label: Luke

text: It is profitable neither for the ground, nor for the dunghil, but it ſhal be caſt forth. He that hath eares to heare, let him heare. ⊢
label: Luke

text: AND there approched Publicans and ſinners vnto him for to heare him.
label: Luke

text: And the Phariſees and the Scribes murmured ſaying, That this man receiueth ſinners, and eateth vvith them.
label: Luke

text: And he ſpake to them this parable, ſaying,
label: Luke

text: VVhat man of you hauing an hundred ſheepe: and if he hath loſt one of them, doth he not leaue the ninetie nine in the deſert, and goeth after that vvhich vvas loſt vntil he finde it?
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he hath found it, laieth it vpon his ſhoulders reioycing:
label: Luke

text: and comming home calleth together his frendes and neighbours, ſaying to them, Reioyce vvith me, becauſe I haue found my ſheepe that vvas loſt?
label: Luke

text: I ſay to you, that euen ſo there ſhal be ioy in heauen vpon one ſinner that doth penance, then vpon ninetie nine iuſt that neede not penance.
label: Luke

text: Or vvhat vvoman hauing ten grotes: if ſhe leeſe one grote, doth ſhe not light a candle, and ſweepe the houſe, and ſeeke diligently, vntil ſhe finde?
label: Luke

text: And vvhen ſhe hath found, calleth together her frendes and neighbours, ſaying, Reioyce vvith me, becauſe I haue found the grote vvhich I had loſt?
label: Luke

text: So, I ſay to you, there ſhal be ioy before the Angels of God vpon one ſinner that doth penance. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid, A certaine man had tvvo ſonnes:
label: Luke

text: and the yonger of them ſaid to his father, Father, giue me the portion of ſubſtance that belongeth to me. And he deuided vnto them the ſubſtance.
label: Luke

text: And not many daies after the yonger ſonne gathering al his things together vvent from home into a farre countrie: and there he waſted his ſubſtance, liuing riotouſly.
label: Luke

text: And after he had ſpent al, there fel a ſore famine in that countrie, and he began to be in neede.
label: Luke

text: And he vvent, and cleaued to one of the citizens of that countrie. And he ſent him into his farme to feede ſvvine.
label: Luke

text: And he vvould faine haue filled his bellie of the huſkes that the ſvvine did eate: and no bodie gaue vnto him.
label: Luke

text: And returning to him ſelf he ſaid, Hovv many of my fathers hirelings haue aboundance of bread: and I here periſh for famine?
label: Luke

text: I vvil ariſe, and vvil goe to my father, and ſay to him, Father, I haue ſinned againſt heauen and before thee:
label: Luke

text: I am not novv vvorthie to be called thy ſonne: make me as one of thy hirelings.
label: Luke

text: And riſing vp he came to his father. And vvhen he vvas yet farre of, his father ſavv him, and vvas moued vvith mercie, and running to him fel vpon his necke, and kiſſed him.
label: Luke

text: And his ſonne ſaid to him, Father, I haue ſinned againſt heauen & before thee, I am not novv vvorthie to be called thy ſonne.
label: Luke

text: And the father ſaid to his ſeruants, Quickely bring forth the firſt ſtole, and doe it on him, and put a ring vpon his hand, and ſhoes vpon his feete:
label: Luke

text: and bring the fatted calfe, and kil it, and let vs eate, and make merie:
label: Luke

text: becauſe this my ſonne vvas dead, and is reuiued: vvas loſt, and is found. And they began to make merie.
label: Luke

text: But his elder ſonne vvas in the field. and vvhen he came and drevv nigh to the houſe, he heard muſicke and dauncing:
label: Luke

text: and he called one of the ſeruants, and aſked vvhat theſe thinges ſhould be.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to him, Thy brother is come, and thy father hath killed the fatted calfe, becauſe he hath receiued him ſafe.
label: Luke

text: But he had indignation, and vvould not goe in. His father therfore going forth began to deſire him.
label: Luke

text: But he anſvvering ſaid to his father, Behold, ſo many yeres doe I ſerue thee, and I neuer tranſgreſſed thy commaundement, and thou didſt neuer giue me a kidde to make merie vvith my frendes:
label: Luke

text: but after that thy ſonne, this that hath deuoured his ſubſtance vvith Whoores, is come, thou haſt killed for him the fatted calfe.
label: Luke

text: But he ſaid to him, Sonne, thou art alvvaies vvith me, and al my things are thine.
label: Luke

text: But it behoued vs to make merie and be glad, becauſe this thy brother vvas dead, and is reuiued, vvas loſt, and is found. ⊢
label: Luke

text: AND he ſaid alſo to his Diſciples, There vvas a cartaine riche man that had a cbailife: & he vvas il reported of vnto him, as he that had waſted his goods.
label: Luke

text: And he called him, and ſaid to him, VVhat heare I this of thee? render account of thy cbailiſhip: for novv thou canſt no more be bailife.
label: Luke

text: And the bailife ſaid vvithin him ſelf, VVhat ſhal I doe, becauſe my lord taketh avvay from me the bailiſhip? digge I am not able, to begge I am aſhamed.
label: Luke

text: I knovv vvhat I vvil doe, that vvhen I ſhal be remoued from the bailiſhip, they may receiue me into their houſes.
label: Luke

text: Therfore calling together euery one of his lords detters, he ſaid to the firſt, Hovv much doeſt thou ovve my lord?
label: Luke

text: But he ſaith, An hundred pipes of oile. And he ſaid to him, Take thy bil: and ſit dovvne, quickly vvrite fiftie.
label: Luke

text: After that he ſaid to an other, But thou, hovv much doeſt thou ovve? VVho ſaid, An hundreth quarters of vvheat. He ſaid to him, Take thy bil, and vvrite eightie.
label: Luke

text: And the lord praiſed the bailife of iniquitie, becauſe he had done vviſely: for the children of this vvorld, are vviſer then the children of light in their generation.
label: Luke

text: And I ſay to you, Make vnto you frendes of the mammon of iniquitie: that vvhen you faile, they may receiue you into the eternal tabernacles. ⊢
label: Luke

text: He that is faithful in the leſt, is faithful in the greater alſo: and he that is vniuſt in litle, is vniuſt in the greater alſo.
label: Luke

text: If then you haue not been faithful in the vniuſt mammon: vvith that vvhich is the true vvho may credit you?
label: Luke

text: And if you haue not been faithful in other mens: that vvhich is yours, vvho vvil giue you?
label: Luke

text: No ſeruant can ſerue tvvo maiſters, for either he ſhal hate the one, and loue the other: or cleaue to one, and contemne the other. You can not ſerue God and mammon.
label: Luke

text: And the Phariſees vvhich vvere couetous, heard al theſe things: and they derided him.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, You are they that iuſtifie your ſelues before men, but god knovveth your hartes, becauſe that vvhich is high to men, is abomination before God.
label: Luke

text: The lavv and the prophets, vnto Iohn. from that time the kingdom of God is euangelized, and euery one doth force tovvard it.
label: Luke

text: And it is eaſier for heauen and earth to paſſe, then one tittle of the lavv to fall.
label: Luke

text: Euery one that dimiſſeth his wife, and marieth an other, committeth aduoutrie: and he that marieth her that is dimiſſed from her huſband, committeth aduoutrie.
label: Luke

text: There vvas a certaine riche man, & he vvas clothed with purple and ſilke: and he fared euery day magnifically.
label: Luke

text: And there vvas a certaine begger called Lazarus, that lay at his gate, ful of ſores:
label: Luke

text: deſiring to be filled of the crommes, that fel from the riche mans table, but the dogges alſo came, and licked his ſores.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe that the begger died, and vvas caried of the Angels into Abrahams boſome. And the riche man alſo died: and he vvas buried in hel.
label: Luke

text: And lifting vp his eies, vvhen he vvas in torments, he ſavv Abraham a farre of, and Lazarus in his boſome:
label: Luke

text: and he crying ſaid, Father Abraham, haue mercie on me, and ſend Lazarus that he may dippe the tippe of his finger into vvater, for to coole my tongue, becauſe I am tormented in this flame.
label: Luke

text: And Abraham ſaid to him, Sonne, remember that thou didſt receiue good things in thy life time, and Lazarus likevviſe euil: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.
label: Luke

text: And beſide al theſe things, betvvene vs and you there is fixed a great cchaos: that they vvhich vvil paſſe from hence to you, may not, neither goe from thence hither.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid, Then, father, I beſeeche thee that thou vvouldeſt ſend him vnto my fathers houſe, for I haue fiue brethren,
label: Luke

text: for to teſtifie vnto them, leſt they alſo come into this place of torments.
label: Luke

text: And Abraham ſaid to him, They haue Moyſes and the Prophets: let them heare them.
label: Luke

text: But he ſaid, No, father Abraham, but if ſome man ſhal goe from the dead to them, they vvil doe penance.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to him, If they heare not Moyſes and the Prophets, neither if one ſhal riſe againe from the dead, vvil they beleeue. ⊢
label: Luke

text: AND he ſaid to his Diſciples, It is impoſſible that ſcandale ſhould not come: but vvo to him by vvhom they come.
label: Luke

text: It is more profitable for him, if a mil-ſtone be put about his necke, and he be caſt into the ſea, then that he ſcandalize one of theſe litle ones.
label: Luke

text: Looke vvel to your ſelues, If thy brother ſinne againſt thee, rebuke him: and if he doe penance, forgiue him.
label: Luke

text: And if he ſinne againſt thee ſeuen times in a day, and ſeuen times in a day be conuerted vnto thee, ſaying, It repenteth me, forgiue him.
label: Luke

text: And the Apoſtles ſaid to our Lord, Increaſe faith in vs.
label: Luke

text: And our lord ſaid, If you had faith like to a muſtard ſeede, you might ſay to this mulberie tree, be thou rooted vp, and be tranſplanted into the ſea: and it vvould obey you.
label: Luke

text: And vvhich of you hauing a ſeruant plovving or keeping cattle, that vvil ſay to him returning out of the field, Paſſe quickly, ſit downe:
label: Luke

text: and ſaith not to him, Make ready ſupper, and gird thy ſelf, and ſerue me vvhiles I eate and drinke, and afterward thou ſhalt eate and drinke?
label: Luke

text: Doth he giue that ſeruant thankes, for doing the things vvhich he commaunded him?
label: Luke

text: I trovv not. So you alſo, vvhen you ſhal haue done al things that are commaunded you, ſay, VVe are vnprofitable ſeruants: vve haue done that vvhich vve ought to doe.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe, as he vvent vnto Hieruſalem, he paſſed through the middes of Samaria and Galilee.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he entred into a certaine tovvne, there mette him ten men that vvere lepers, vvho ſtoode a farre of:
label: Luke

text: and they lifted vp their voice, ſaying, IESVS maiſter, haue mercie on vs.
label: Luke

text: Whom as he ſavv, he ſaid, Goe, ſhevv your ſelues to the Prieſts. And it came to paſſe, as they vvent, they vvere made cleane.
label: Luke

text: And one of them as he ſavv that he vvas made cleane: vvent backe vvith a loud voice magnifying God,
label: Luke

text: and he fel on his face before his feete, giuing thankes: and this vvas a Samaritane.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS anſvvering ſaid, VVere not ten made cleane? and vvhere are the nine?
label: Luke

text: There vvas not found that returned, and gaue glorie to God, but this ſtranger.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to him, Ariſe, goe thy vvaies: becauſe thy faith hath made thee ſafe. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And being aſked of the Phariſees, VVhen commeth the kingdom of God? he anſvvered them and ſaid, The kingdom of God commeth not vvith obſeruation:
label: Luke

text: neither ſhal they ſay, Loe here, or loe there. for loe the kingdom of God is vvithin you.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to his Diſciples, The daies vvil come vvhen you ſhal deſire to ſee one day of the Sonne of man: and you ſhal not ſee.
label: Luke

text: And they vvil ſay to you, Loe here and loe there. Goe not, neither doe ye folovv after.
label: Luke

text: For euen as the lightening that lighteneth from vnder heauen, vnto thoſe partes that are vnder heauen, ſhineth: ſo ſhal the Sonne of man be in his day.
label: Luke

text: But firſt he muſt ſuffer many things and be reiected of this generation.
label: Luke

text: And as it came to paſſe in the daies of Noé, ſo ſhal it be alſo in the daies of the Sonne of man.
label: Luke

text: They did eate and drinke, they did marie vviues and vvere giuen to mariage euen vntil the day that Noé entred into the arke: and the floud came, and deſtroyed them al.
label: Luke

text: Likevviſe as it came to paſſe in the daies of Lot: They did eate and drinke, bought and ſould, planted, and builded:
label: Luke

text: and in the day that Lot vvent out from Sodome, it rained fire and brimſtone from heauen, and deſtroyed them all:
label: Luke

text: according to theſe things it ſhal be in the day that the Sonne of man ſhal be reuealed.
label: Luke

text: In that houre he that ſhal be in the houſe-toppe, and his veſſel in the houſe, let him not goe dovvne to take them vp: and he that is in the field, in like maner let him not returne backe.
label: Luke

text: Be mindeful of Lots vvife.
label: Luke

text: VVhoſoeuer ſeeketh to ſaue his life, ſhal loſe it: and vvhoſoeuer doth loſe the ſame, ſhal quicken it.
label: Luke

text: I ſay to you, in that night there ſhal be tvvo in one bed: the one ſhal be taken, and the other ſhal be left:
label: Luke

text: tvvo vvomen ſhal be grinding together: the one ſhal be taken, and the other ſhal be left: tvvo in the field: the one ſhal be taken, and the other ſhal be left.
label: Luke

text: They anſvvering ſay to him, VVhere Lord?
label: Luke

text: VVho ſaid to them, VVhereſoeuer the body ſhal be, thither vvil the eagles alſo be gathered together.
label: Luke

text: AND he ſpake alſo a parable to them that it behoueth alwaies to pray, & not to be weary,
label: Luke

text: ſaying, There was a certaine iudge in a certaine citie, vvhich feared not God, and of man made no accoumpt.
label: Luke

text: And there vvas a certaine widow in that citie: and ſhe came to him, ſaying, Reuenge me of mine aduerſarie.
label: Luke

text: And he vvould not of a long time. but aftervvard he ſaid vvithin him ſelf, Although I feare not God, nor make accoumpt of man:
label: Luke

text: yet becauſe this vvidovv is importune vpon me, I wil reuenge her, leſt at the laſt ſhe come and defame me.
label: Luke

text: And our Lord ſaid, Heare vvhat the iudge of iniquitie ſayeth.
label: Luke

text: And vvil not God reuenge his elect that crie to him day and night: and vvil he haue patience in them?
label: Luke

text: I ſay to you that he vvil quickly reuenge them. But yet the Sonne of man comming, ſhal he finde trovv you, faith in the earth?
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid alſo to certaine that truſted in them ſelues as iuſt, and deſpiſed others, this parable:
label: Luke

text: Two men went vp into the Temple to pray: the one a Phariſee, and the other a Publicane.
label: Luke

text: The Phariſee ſtanding, praied thus vvith him ſelf: God, I giue thee thankes that I am not as the reſt of men, extorcioners, vniuſt, aduouterers, as alſo this Publicane.
label: Luke

text: I faſt twiſe in a vveeke: I giue tithes of al that I poſſeſſe.
label: Luke

text: And the Publicane ſtanding a farre of vvould not ſo much as lift vp his eies tovvard heauen: but he knocked his breaſt, ſaying, God be merciful to me a ſinner.
label: Luke

text: I ſay to you, this man vvent dovvne into his houſe iuſtified more then he: becauſe euery one that exalteth him ſelf, ſhal be humbled: and he that humbleth him ſelf, ſhal be exalted. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And they brought vnto him infants alſo, that he might touche them. Vvhich thing vvhen the Diſciples ſavv, they rebuked them.
label: Luke

text: But IESVS calling them together, ſaid, Suffer children to come vnto me, and forbid them not, for the kingdom of heauen is for ſuch.
label: Luke

text: Amen I ſay to you, Whoſoeuer receiueth not the kingdom of God as a childe, ſhal not enter into it.
label: Luke

text: And a certaine Prince aſked him, ſaying, Good maiſter, by doing what, ſhal I poſſeſſe euerlaſting life?
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid to him, Vvhy doeſt thou call me good? None is good but only God.
label: Luke

text: Thou knovveſt the commaundements: Thou ſhalt not kil, Thou ſhalt not commit aduoutrie, Thou ſhalt not beare falſe vvitnes, Thou ſhalt not ſteale, Honour thy father and mother.
label: Luke

text: Vvho ſaid, Al theſe things haue I kept from my youth.
label: Luke

text: Which IESVS hearing, ſaid to him, Yet one thing thou lackeſt: Sel al that euer thou haſt, and giue to the poore, and thou ſhalt haue treaſure in heauen: and come, folovv me.
label: Luke

text: He hearing theſe things, vvas ſtroken ſad: becauſe he vvas very riche.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſeeing him ſtroken ſad, ſaid, Hovv hardly ſhal they that haue money, enter into the kingdom of God?
label: Luke

text: For it is eaſier for a camel to paſſe through the eie of a nedle, then for a riche man to enter into the kingdom of God.
label: Luke

text: And they that heard, ſaid, And vvho can be ſaued?
label: Luke

text: He ſaid to them, The things that are impoſſible vvith men, are poſsible vvith God.
label: Luke

text: And Peter ſaid, Loe, vve haue left al things, and haue folowed thee.
label: Luke

text: Vvho ſaid to them, Amen I ſay to you, There is no man that hath leaft houſe, or parents, or brethren, or vvife, or children for the kingdom of God,
label: Luke

text: and ſhal not receiue much more in this time, and in the world to come life euerlaſting.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS tooke the Tvvelue, and ſaid to them, Behold vve goe vp to Hieruſalem, and al things ſhal be conſummate vvhich vvere vvritten by the Prophets of the ſonne of man.
label: Luke

text: For he ſhal be deliuered to the Gentiles, and ſhal be mocked, and ſcourged, and ſpit vpon:
label: Luke

text: and after they haue ſcourged him, they vvil kil him, and the third day he ſhal riſe againe.
label: Luke

text: And they vnderſtoode none of theſe things, and this vvord vvas hid from them, and they vnderſtoode not the things that vvere ſaid.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe, vvhen he drevv nigh to Iericho, a certaine blinde man ſate by the vvay, begging.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he heard the multitude paſſing by, he aſked what this ſhould be.
label: Luke

text: And they told him that IESVS of Nazareth paſſed by.
label: Luke

text: And he cried ſaying, IESVS ſonne of Dauid, haue mercie vpon me.
label: Luke

text: And they that vvent before, rebuked him, that he ſhould hold his peace. But he cried much more, Sonne of Dauid haue mercie vpon me.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſtanding, commaunded him to be brought vnto him. And vvhen he vvas come neere, he aſked him,
label: Luke

text: ſaying, VVhat vvilt thou that I doe to thee? but he ſaid, Lord, that I may ſee.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid to him, Do thou ſee, thy faith hath made thee vvhole.
label: Luke

text: And forthvvith he ſavv, and folovved him, magnifying God. And al the people as they ſavv it, gaue praiſe to God. ⊢
label: Luke

text: AND entring in, he vvalked through Iericho.
label: Luke

text: And behold a man named Zachaeus: and this vvas a Prince of the Publicans, and he riche.
label: Luke

text: And he ſought to ſee IESVS vvhat he vvas, and he could not for the multitude, becauſe he vvas litle of ſtature.
label: Luke

text: And running before, he vvent vp into a ſycomore tree that he might ſee him: becauſe he vvas to paſſe by it.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he vvas come to the place, IESVS looking vp, ſavv him, and ſaid to him, Zachaeus, come dovvne in haſt: becauſe this day I muſt abide in thy houſe.
label: Luke

text: And he in haſt came dovvne, and receiued him reioycing.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen al ſavv it, they murmured, ſaying that he turned in, to a man that vvas a ſinner.
label: Luke

text: But Zachaeus ſtanding, ſaid to our Lord, Behold the halfe of my goods, Lord, I giue to the poore: and if I haue defrauded any man of any thing, I reſtore fourefold.
label: Luke

text: IESVS ſaid to him, That this day ſaluation is made to this houſe: becauſe that he alſo is the ſonne of Abraham.
label: Luke

text: For the Sonne of man is come to ſeeke and to ſaue that vvhich vvas loſt. ⊢
label: Luke

text: They hearing theſe things, he added and ſpake a parable, for that he was nigh to Hieruſalem, and becauſe they thought that forthvvith the kingdom of God ſhould be manifeſted.
label: Luke

text: He ſaid therfore, A certaine noble man vvent into a farre countrie to take to him ſelf a kingdom, and to returne.
label: Luke

text: And calling his ten ſeruants, he gaue them ten poundes, and ſaid to them, Occupie til I come.
label: Luke

text: And his citizens hated him: and they ſent a legacie after him, ſaying, VVe vvil not haue this man reigne ouer vs.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe after he returned, hauing receiued his kingdom: and he commaunded his ſeruants to be called, to vvhom he gaue the money: that he might knovv how much euery man had gained by occupying.
label: Luke

text: And the firſt came, ſaying, Lord, thy pound hath gotten ten poundes.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to him, VVel fare thee good ſeruant, becauſe thou haſt been faithful in a litle, thou ſhalt haue povver ouer ten cities.
label: Luke

text: And the ſecond came, ſaying, Lord, thy pound hath made fiue poundes.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to him, And be thou ouer fiue cities.
label: Luke

text: And an other came, ſaying, Lord, loe here thy pound, vvhich I haue had laid vp in a napkin.
label: Luke

text: for I feared thee, becauſe thou art an auſtêre man: thou takeſt vp that thou didſt not ſet dovvne, and thou reapeſt that vvhich thou didſt not ſovv.
label: Luke

text: He ſaith to him, By thine ovvne mouth I iudge thee, naughtie ſeruant. Thou didſt knovv that I am an auſtere man, taking vp that I ſet not dovvne, and reaping that vvhich I ſovved not:
label: Luke

text: and vvhy didſt thou not giue my money to the banke, and I comming might certes vvith vſurie haue exacted it?
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them that ſtoode by, Take the pound avvay from him, and giue it to him that hath the ten poundes.
label: Luke

text: And they ſaid to him, Lord, he hath ten poundes.
label: Luke

text: But I ſay to you, that to euery one that hath ſhal be giuen: and from him that hath not, that alſo vvhich he hath ſhal be taken from him. ⊢
label: Luke

text: But as for thoſe mine enemies that vvould not haue me reigne ouer them, bring them hither: and kil them before me.
label: Luke

text: And hauing ſaid theſe things, he vvent before aſcending to Hieruſalem.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe vvhen he vvas come nigh to Bethphagé and Bethania vnto the mount called Oliuet, he ſent tvvo of his Diſciples,
label: Luke

text: ſaying, Goe into the tovvne vvhich is ouer againſt, into the vvhich as you enter, you ſhal finde the colt of an aſſe tied, on vvhich no man euer hath ſitten: looſe him, and bring him.
label: Luke

text: And if any man aſke you, VVhy looſe you him? You ſhal ſay thus to him, becauſe our Lord needeth his ſeruice.
label: Luke

text: And they that vvere ſent, vvent their vvaies, and found as he ſaid to them, the colt ſtanding.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen they looſed the colt, the ovvners thereof ſaid to them, VVhy looſe you the colt?
label: Luke

text: But they ſaid, becauſe our Lord hath neede of him.
label: Luke

text: And they brought him to IESVS. And caſting their garments vpon the colt, they ſet IESVS therevpon.
label: Luke

text: And as he vvent, they ſpred their garments vnderneath in the vvay.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he approched novv to the deſcent of mount-Oliuet, al the multitudes of `them that deſcended', began vvith ioy to praiſe God vvith a loude voice, for al the miracles that they had ſeen,
label: Luke

text: ſaying, Bleſſed is he that commeth king in the name of our Lord, peace in heauen, and glorie on high.
label: Luke

text: And certaine Phariſees of the multitudes ſaid to him, Maiſter, rebuke thy diſciples.
label: Luke

text: To vvhom he ſaid, I ſay to you, That if theſe hold their peace, the ſtones ſhal crie.
label: Luke

text: And as he drevv neere, ſeeing the citie, he vvept vpon it, ſaying,
label: Luke

text: Becauſe if thou alſo hadſt knovven, and that in this thy day, the things that pertaine to thy peace: but novv they are hid from thine eies.
label: Luke

text: For the daies ſhal come vpon thee: and thy enemies ſhal compaſſe thee vvith a trenche, and incloſe thee about, and ſtraiten thee on euery ſide,
label: Luke

text: and beate thee flat to the ground, and thy children that are in thee. and they ſhal not leaue in thee a ſtone vpon a ſtone: becauſe thou haſt not knovven the time of thy viſitation.
label: Luke

text: And entring into the temple, he began to caſt out the ſellers therein and the biers,
label: Luke

text: ſaying to them, It is vvritten, That my houſe is the houſe of praier. But you haue made it a denne of theeues.
label: Luke

text: And he vvas teaching daily in the temple. And the cheefe Prieſts and the Scribes and the Princes of the people ſought to deſtroy him:
label: Luke

text: and they found not vvhat to doe to him. For al the people vvas ſuſpenſe, hearing him.
label: Luke

text: AND it came to paſſe: in one of the daies vvhen he vvas teaching the people in the temple and euangelizing, the cheefe Prieſts and the Scribes vvith the auncients aſſembled,
label: Luke

text: and ſpake ſaying to him, Tel vs, in vvhat povver doeſt thou theſe things? or, who is he that hath giuen the this povver?
label: Luke

text: And IESVS anſvvering, ſaid to them, I alſo vvil aſke you one vvord. Anſvver me,
label: Luke

text: The baptiſme of Iohn was it from heauen, or of men?
label: Luke

text: But they thought within them ſelues, ſaying, That if we ſay, From heauen: he vvil ſay, VVhy then did you not beleeue him?
label: Luke

text: But if vve ſay, Of men: the vvhole people vvil ſtone vs: for they are certaine that Iohn is a Prophet.
label: Luke

text: And they anſvvered that they knevv not vvhence it vvas.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid to them, Neither doe I tel you in vvhat povver I doe theſe things.
label: Luke

text: And he began to ſay to the people this parable, A certaine man planted a vineyard, & let it out to huſbandmen: and he vvas from home a long time.
label: Luke

text: And in time he ſent to the huſbandmen a ſeruant, that they ſhould giue him of the fruit of the vineyard. VVho beating him, ſent him avvay emptie.
label: Luke

text: And againe he ſent an other ſeruant. But they beating him alſo and reprochfully abuſing him, ſent him avvay emptie.
label: Luke

text: And againe he ſent the third: vvho vvounding him alſo, caſt him out.
label: Luke

text: And the lord of the vineyard ſaid, What ſhal I doe? I vvil ſend my beloued ſonne: perhaps vvhen they ſhal ſee him, they vvil reuerence him.
label: Luke

text: Whom vvhen the huſbandmen ſavv, they thought vvithin them ſelues, ſaying, This is the heire, let vs kil him, that the heritage may be ours.
label: Luke

text: And caſting him forth out of the vineyard, they killed him. VVhat therfore vvil the Lord of the vineyard doe to them?
label: Luke

text: He vvil come, and vvil deſtroy theſe huſbandmen, and vvil giue the vineyard to others. VVhich they hearing, ſaid to him, God forbid.
label: Luke

text: But he beholding them ſaid, VVhat is this then that is vvritten, The ſtone vvhich the builders reiected, the ſame is become into the head of the corner?
label: Luke

text: Euery one that falleth vpon this ſtone, ſhal be quaſhed: and vpon vvhom it ſhal fall, it ſhal breake him to pouder.
label: Luke

text: And the cheefe Prieſts and Scribes ſought to lay handes vpon him that houre: and they feared the people. for they knevv that he ſpake this ſimilitude to them.
label: Luke

text: And watching, they ſent ſpies which ſhould feine them ſelues iuſt: that they might take him in his talke, and deliuer him to the principaltie and povver of the Praeſident.
label: Luke

text: And they aſked him, ſaying, Maiſter, vve knovv that thou ſpeakeſt and teacheſt rightly: and thou doeſt not accept perſon, but teacheſt the vvay of God in truth.
label: Luke

text: Is it lavvful for vs to giue tribute to Caeſar, or no?
label: Luke

text: But conſidering their guile, he ſaid to them, VVhy tempt you me?
label: Luke

text: Shevv me a penie. VVhoſe image hath it and inſcription? They anſvvering ſaid, Caeſars.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, Render therfore the things that are Caeſars, to Caeſar: and the things that are Gods, to God.
label: Luke

text: And they could not reprehend his vvord before the people: and marueiling at his anſvver, they held their peace.
label: Luke

text: And there came certaine of the Sadducees, vvhich denie that there is a reſurrection, and they aſked him,
label: Luke

text: ſaying, Maiſter, Moyſes gaue vs in vvriting, If a mans brother die hauing a vvife, and he haue no children, that his brother take her to vvife, and raiſe vp ſeede to his brother.
label: Luke

text: There vvere therfore ſeuen brethren: and the firſt tooke a vvife, and died vvithout children.
label: Luke

text: And the next tooke her, and he died vvithout children.
label: Luke

text: And the third tooke her. In like maner alſo al the ſeuen, and they left no ſeed, and died.
label: Luke

text: Laſt of al the vvoman died alſo.
label: Luke

text: In the reſurrection therfore, vvhoſe vvife ſhal ſhe be of them? ſithens the ſeuen had her to vvife.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid to them, The children of this vvorld marrie, and are giuen in mariage:
label: Luke

text: but they that ſhal be counted vvorthie of that vvorld and the reſurrection from the dead, neither marrie, nor take vviues,
label: Luke

text: neither can they die any more, for they are equal to Angels: and they are the ſonnes of God, ſeeing they are the ſonnes of the reſurrection.
label: Luke

text: But that the dead riſe againe, Moyſes alſo ſhevved, beſide the buſh, as he calleth the Lord, The God of Abraham, and the God of Iſaac, and the God of Iacob.
label: Luke

text: For God is not of the dead, but of the liuing. for al liue to him.
label: Luke

text: And certaine of the Scribes anſwering, ſaid to him, Maiſter, thou haſt ſaid vvel.
label: Luke

text: And further they durſt not aſke him any thing.
label: Luke

text: But he ſaid to them, Hovv ſay they that Chriſt is the ſonne of Dauid?
label: Luke

text: and Dauid him ſelf ſaith in the booke of pſalmes, The Lord ſaid to my Lord, Sit on my right hand,
label: Luke

text: til I put thine enemies, the foote ſtoole of thy feete?
label: Luke

text: Dauid then calleth him Lord: and hovv is he his ſonne?
label: Luke

text: And al the people hearing him, he ſaid to his Diſciples,
label: Luke

text: Beware of the Scribes, that wil walke in robes, and loue ſalutations in the market-place, and the firſt chaires in the ſynagogs, and the cheefe roomes in feaſtes.
label: Luke

text: which deuoure widowes houſes: feining long praier. Theſe ſhal receiue greater damnation.
label: Luke

text: AND beholding, he ſavv them that did caſt their giftes into the treaſurie, riche perſons.
label: Luke

text: And he ſavv alſo a certaine poore vvidovv caſting tvvo braſſe mites.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid, Verely I ſay to you, that this poore vvidovv hath caſt more then al.
label: Luke

text: For al theſe of their aboundance haue caſt into the giftes of God: but ſhe of her penurie, hath caſt in al her liuing that ſhe had.
label: Luke

text: And certaine ſaying of the temple that it vvas adorned vvith goodly ſtones and donaries, he ſaid,
label: Luke

text: Theſe things vvhich you ſee, the daies vvil come vvherein there ſhal not be left a ſtone vpon a ſtone that ſhal not be deſtroied.
label: Luke

text: And they aſked him, ſaying, Maiſter, When ſhal theſe things be: and vvhat ſhal be the ſigne vvhen they ſhal begin to come to paſſe?
label: Luke

text: VVho ſaid, See you be not ſeduced. for many vvil come in my name, ſaying that I am he: and the time is at hand, goe not therfore after them.
label: Luke

text: b And vvhen you ſhal heare of vvarres and ſeditions, be not terrified: theſe things muſt firſt come to paſſe, but the end is not yet by and by.
label: Luke

text: Then he ſaid to them, Nation ſhal riſe againſt nation, and kingdom againſt kingdom.
label: Luke

text: And there ſhal be great earth-quakes in places, and peſtilences and famines, and terrours from heauen, and there ſhal be great ſignes.
label: Luke

text: But before al theſe things they vvil lay their hands vpon you: and perſecute you deliuering you into ſynagogs and priſons, dravving you to kings and preſidents for my name.
label: Luke

text: and it ſhal happen vnto you for teſtimonie.
label: Luke

text: Lay vp this therfore in your hartes, not to premeditate hovv you ſhal anſvver.
label: Luke

text: For I vvil giue you mouth and vviſedom, vvhich al your aduerſaries ſhal not be able to reſiſt and gaineſay.
label: Luke

text: And you ſhal be deliuered vp of your parents and brethren, and kinſemen & frendes: and they vvil put to death of you.
label: Luke

text: And you ſhal be odious to al men for my name:
label: Luke

text: and a heare of your head ſhal not periſh.
label: Luke

text: In your patience you ſhal poſſeſſe your ſoules. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And vvhen you ſhal ſee Hieruſalem compaſſed about vvith an armie: then knovv that the deſolation thereof is at hand.
label: Luke

text: then they that are in Ievvrie, let them flee to the mountaines: and they in the middes thereof, let them depart: and they in the countries, let them not enter into it.
label: Luke

text: for theſe are the daies of vengeance, that al things may be fulfilled that are vvritten.
label: Luke

text: But vvo to them that are vvith childe and that giue ſucke in thoſe daies. for there ſhal be great affliction vpon the land, and vvrath on this people.
label: Luke

text: And they ſhal fall by the edge of the ſvvord: and ſhal be led captiue into al nations. and Hieruſalem ſhal be troden of the Gentiles: til the times of nations be fulfilled.
label: Luke

text: And there ſhal be ſignes in the ſunne and the moone and the ſtarres: and vpon earth diſtreſſe of nations, for the confuſion of the ſound of ſea and vvaues,
label: Luke

text: men withering for feare and expectation, vvhat ſhal come vpon the vvhole vvorld. for the povvers of heauen ſhal be moued:
label: Luke

text: and then they ſhal ſee the Sonne of man comming in a cloude vvith great povver and maieſtie.
label: Luke

text: But vvhen theſe things begin to come to paſſe, looke vp and lift vp your heades: becauſe your redemption is at hand.
label: Luke

text: And he ſpake to them a ſimilitude. See the figtree and al trees:
label: Luke

text: Vvhen they novv budde forth fruite out of them ſelues, you knovv that ſummer is nigh.
label: Luke

text: So you alſo vvhen you ſhal ſee theſe things come to paſſe, knovv that the kingdom of God is nigh.
label: Luke

text: Amen I ſay to you, that this generation ſhal not paſſe, til al be done.
label: Luke

text: Heauen and earth ſhal paſſe: but my vvordes ſhal not paſſe. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And looke vvel to your ſelues, leſt perhaps your hartes be ouercharged vvith ſurfetting and drunkenneſſe and cares of this life: and that day come vpon you ſodenly.
label: Luke

text: For as a ſnare ſhal it come vpon al that ſit vpon the face of al the earth.
label: Luke

text: VVatch therfore, praying at al times, that you may be caccounted vvorthie to eſcape al theſe things that are to come, and to ſtand before the Sonne of man.
label: Luke

text: And the daies he vvas teaching in the temple: but the nightes going forth, he abode in the mount that is called Oliuet.
label: Luke

text: And al the people in the morning vvent vnto him in the temple to heare him.
label: Luke

text: AND the feſtiual day of the Azymes approched, vvhich is called Paſche:
label: Luke

text: and the cheefe Prieſts and the Scribes ſought hovv they might kil him: but they feared the people.
label: Luke

text: And Satan entred into Iudas that vvas ſurnamed Iſcariote, one of the Tvvelue.
label: Luke

text: And he vvent, and talked vvith the cheefe Prieſts and the Magiſtrates, hovv he might betray him to them.
label: Luke

text: And they vvere glad, and bargained to giue him money.
label: Luke

text: And he promiſed. And he ſought opportunitie to betray him apart from the multitudes.
label: Luke

text: And the day of the Azymes came, vvherein it vvas neceſſarie that the Paſche ſhould be killed.
label: Luke

text: And he ſent Peter and Iohn, ſaying, Goe and prepare vs the Paſche, that vve may eate.
label: Luke

text: But they ſaid, VVhere vvilt thou that we prepare it?
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, Behold, as you enter into the citie, there ſhal meete you a man carying a pitcher of vvater: folovv him into the houſe into vvhich he entreth,
label: Luke

text: and you ſhal ſay to the good man of the houſe, The Maiſter ſaith to thee, VVhere is the inne vvhere I may eate the Paſche vvith my Diſciples?
label: Luke

text: And he vvil ſhevv you a great refectorie adorned: and there prepare.
label: Luke

text: And they going, found as he ſaid to them, and prepared the Paſche.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen the houre was come, he ſate dovvne, and the tvvelue Apoſtles vvith him.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, VVith deſire I haue deſired to eate this Paſche vvith you before I ſuffer.
label: Luke

text: For I ſay to you, that from this time I vvil not eate it, til it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
label: Luke

text: And taking the chalice he gaue thankes, and ſaid, Take and deuide among you,
label: Luke

text: for I ſay to you, That I vvil not drinke of the generation of the vine, til the kingdom of God doe come.
label: Luke

text: And taking bread, he gaue thankes, and brake: and gaue to them, ſaying, THIS IS MY BODY VVHICH IS GIVEN FOR YOV. Doe this for a commemoration of me.
label: Luke

text: In like maner the chalice alſo, after he had ſupped, ſaying, THIS IS THE CHALICE THE NEVV TESTAMENT IN MY BLOVD, VVHICH SHAL BE SHED FOR YOV.
label: Luke

text: But yet behold, the hand of him that betraieth me, is vvith me on the table.
label: Luke

text: And the Sonne of man in deede goeth according to that vvhich is determined: but yet vvo to that man by vvhom he ſhal be betrayed.
label: Luke

text: And they began to queſtion among them ſelues, vvhich of them it ſhould be that ſhould doe this.
label: Luke

text: And there fel alſo a contention betvvene them, vvhich of them ſeemed to be greater.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, The kinges of the Gentiles ouerrule them: and they that haue povver vpon them, are called beneficial.
label: Luke

text: But you not ſo: but he that is the greater among you, let him become as the yonger: & he that is the leader, as the waiter.
label: Luke

text: For which is greater, he that ſitteth at the table, or he that miniſtreth? is not he that ſitteth? but I am in the middes of you, as he that miniſtreth:
label: Luke

text: & you are they that haue remained vvith me in my tentations.
label: Luke

text: And I diſpoſe to you, as my father diſpoſed to me, a kingdom:
label: Luke

text: that you may eate & drinke vpon my table in my kingdom, & may ſit vpon thrones, iudging the twelue tribes of Iſrael.
label: Luke

text: And our Lord ſaid, Simon, Simon, behold Satan hath required to haue you for to ſift as vvheate:
label: Luke

text: BVT I HAVE PRAIED FOR THEE, that thy faith faile not: and thou once conuerted, confirme thy brethren.
label: Luke

text: Vvho ſaid to him, Lord, vvith thee I am readie to goe both into priſon and vnto death.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid, I ſay to thee, Peter, the cocke ſhal not crow to day, til thou denie thriſe that thou knovveſt me.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, VVhen I ſent you vvithout purſe and ſkrippe and ſhoes, did you lacke any thing? But they ſaid, Nothing.
label: Luke

text: He ſaid therfore vnto them, But novv he that hath a purſe, let him take it, likevviſe alſo a ſkrippe: and he that hath not, let him ſel his coate, and bie a ſword.
label: Luke

text: For I ſay to you, that yet this that is written, muſt be fulfilled in me, And vvith the vvicked vvas he reputed. For thoſe things that are concerning me, haue an end.
label: Luke

text: But they ſaid, Lord, Loe tvvo ſwordes here. But he ſaid to them, It is ynough.
label: Luke

text: And going forth he vvent according to his cuſtome into mount-Oliuet. And his Diſciples alſo folovved him.
label: Luke
