text: And vvhen he vvas come to the place, he ſaid to them, Pray, leſt ye enter into tentation.
label: Luke

text: And he vvas pulled avvay from them a ſtones caſt: and kneeling he praied,
label: Luke

text: ſaying, Father, if thou vvilt, transferre this chalice from me. But yet not my vvil, but thine be done.
label: Luke

text: And there appeared to him an Angel from heauen, ſtrengthening him. And being in an agonie, he praied the longer.
label: Luke

text: And his ſvveat became as droppes of bloud trikling dovvne vpon the earth.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he vvas riſen vp from praier, and vvas come to his Diſciples, he found them ſleeping for penſifenes.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, VVhy ſleepe you? ariſe, pray, leſt you enter into tentation.
label: Luke

text: As he vvas yet ſpeaking, behold a multitude: and he that vvas called Iudas, one of the Tvvelue, vvent before them, and approched to IESVS, for to kiſſe him.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid to him, Iudas with a kiſſe doeſt thou betray the ſonne of man?
label: Luke

text: And they that vvere about him, ſeeing vvhat vvould be, ſaid to him, Lord, Shal vve ſtrike vvith the ſvvord?
label: Luke

text: And one of them ſmote the ſeruant of the high Prieſt: and cut of his right eare.
label: Luke

text: But IESVS anſvvering, ſaid, Suffer ye thus farre. And vvhen he had touched his eare, he healed him.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid to them that vvere come vnto him, the cheefe Prieſts, and magiſtrates of the temple, and auncients, As it vvere to a theefe are you come forth vvith ſwordes and clubbes?
label: Luke

text: Vvhen I vvas daily vvith you in the temple, you did not lay handes vpon me, but this is your houre, and the povver of darkeneſſe.
label: Luke

text: And apprehending him, they led him to the high Prieſts houſe: but Peter folovved a farre of.
label: Luke

text: And a fire being kindled in the middes of the court, & they ſitting about it, Peter vvas in the middes of them.
label: Luke

text: VVhom vvhen a certaine vvenche ſavv ſitting at the light, and had beheld him, ſhe ſaid, This fellovv alſo vvas vvith him.
label: Luke

text: But he denied him, ſaying, VVoman, I knovv him not.
label: Luke

text: And after a vvhile an other man ſeeing him, ſaid, And thou art of them. But Peter ſaid, O man I am not.
label: Luke

text: And after the ſpace as it vvere of one houre, a certaine other man affirmed, ſaying, Verely this fellovv alſo vvas vvith him. for he is alſo a Galilaean.
label: Luke

text: And Peter ſaid, Man I knovv not vvhat thou ſayeſt. And incontinent as he vvas yet ſpeaking, the cocke crevv.
label: Luke

text: And our Lord turning looked on Peter. And Peter remembred the vvord of our Lord, as he had ſaid, That before the cocke crovv, thou ſhalt thriſe denie me.
label: Luke

text: And Peter going forth a doores, vvept bitterly.
label: Luke

text: And the men that held him, mocked him, beating him.
label: Luke

text: And they did blindefold him, and ſmote his face. And they aſked him ſaying, Prophecie, vvho is it that ſmote thee?
label: Luke

text: And blaſpheming many other things they ſaid againſt him.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen it vvas day, there aſſembled the auncients of the people and cheefe Prieſts and Scribes, and they brought him into their councel, ſaying,
label: Luke

text: If thou be Chriſt tel vs. And he ſaid to them, If I tel you, you vvil not beleeue me:
label: Luke

text: if alſo I aſke, you vvil not anſvver me, nor dimiſſe me.
label: Luke

text: But from hence forth the Sonne of man ſhal be ſitting on the right hand of the povver of God.
label: Luke

text: And they al ſaid, Art thou then the ſonne of God? VVho ſaid, You ſay that I am.
label: Luke

text: But they ſaid, VVhat neede we teſtimonie any further? For our ſelues haue heard of his ovvne mouth.
label: Luke

text: AND all the multitude of them riſing vp, led him to Pilate.
label: Luke

text: And they began to accuſe him, ſaying, VVe haue found this man ſubuerting our nation, & prohibiting to giue tributes to Cæſar, and ſaying that he is Chriſt the king.
label: Luke

text: And Pilate aſked him, ſaying, Art thou the king of the Ievves? But he anſvvering ſaid, Thou ſayeſt.
label: Luke

text: And Pilate ſaid to the cheefe Prieſts and multitudes, I finde no cauſe in this man.
label: Luke

text: But they vvere more earneſt, ſaying, He ſtirreth the people teaching through out al Ievvrie, beginning from Galilee euen hither.
label: Luke

text: But Pilate hearing Galilee, aſked if the man vvere of Galilee.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he vnderſtoode that he vvas of Herods iuriſdiction, he ſent him backe to Herod, vvho vvas alſo him ſelf at Hieruſalem in thoſe daies.
label: Luke

text: And Herod ſeeing IESVS, vvas very glad, for he vvas deſirous of a long time to ſee him, for becauſe he heard many things of him: and he hoped to ſee ſome ſigne vvrought by him.
label: Luke

text: And he aſked him in many vvordes. But he anſvvered him nothing.
label: Luke

text: And there ſtoode the cheefe Prieſts and the Scribes conſtantly accuſing him.
label: Luke

text: And Herod vvith his armie ſet him at naught: and he mocked him, putting on him a vvhite garment, and ſent him backe to Pilate.
label: Luke

text: And Herod and Pilate vvere made frendes that day. for before they vvere enemies one to an other.
label: Luke

text: And Pilate calling together the cheefe Prieſts and magiſtrates, and the people,
label: Luke

text: ſaid to them, You haue preſented vnto me this man, as auerting the people, and behold I examining him before you, haue found no cauſe in this man of thoſe things vvherein you accuſe him.
label: Luke

text: No, nor Herod neither. for I ſent you to him, and behold, nothing vvorthie of death is done to him.
label: Luke

text: I vvil chaſten him therfore and dimiſſe him.
label: Luke

text: And he of neceſſitie had to releaſe vnto them vpon the feaſt day, one.
label: Luke

text: But the vvhole multitude together cried out, ſaying, Diſpatch him, and releaſe vs Barabbas.
label: Luke

text: vvho vvas for a certaine ſedition made in the citie and murder, caſt into priſon.
label: Luke

text: And Pilate againe ſpake to them, deſirous to releaſe IESVS.
label: Luke

text: But they cried againe, ſaying, Crucifie, crucifie him.
label: Luke

text: And he the third time ſaid to them, VVhy, vvhat euil hath this man done? I finde no cauſe of death in him. I vvil correct him therfore and let him goe.
label: Luke

text: But they vvere inſtant vvith loude voices requiring that he might be crucified. And their voices preuailed.
label: Luke

text: And Pilate adiudged their petition to be done.
label: Luke

text: And he releaſed vnto them him that for murder and ſedition had been caſt into priſon, vvhom they demaunded: but IESVS he deliuered to their pleaſure.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen they led him, they tooke one Simon of Cyréne comming from the countrie: and they laid the croſſe vpon him to carie after IESVS.
label: Luke

text: And there folovved him a great multitude of people, and of vvomen vvhich bevvailed and lamented him.
label: Luke

text: But IESVS turning to them, ſaid, Daughters of Hieruſalem, vveepe not vpon me, but vveepe vpon your ſelues, and vpon your children.
label: Luke

text: For behold the daies ſhal come, vvherein they vvil ſay, Bleſſed are the barren, and the vvombes that haue not borne, and the pappes that haue not giuen ſucke.
label: Luke

text: Then ſhal they begin to ſay to the mountaines, Fal vpon vs: and to the hilles, Couer vs.
label: Luke

text: For if in the greene wood they doe theſe things, in the drie vvhat ſhal be done?
label: Luke

text: And there vvere led alſo other tvvo malefactours vvith him, to be executed.
label: Luke

text: And after they came to the place vvhich is called Caluarie, there they crucified him: and the theeues, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid, Father, forgiue them, for they knovv not vvhat they doe. But they deuiding his garments, did caſt lottes.
label: Luke

text: And the people ſtoode `expecting', and the princes vvith them derided him, ſaying, Others he hath ſaued, let him ſaue him ſelf, if this be Chriſt, the elect of God.
label: Luke

text: And the ſouldiars alſo mocked him comming to him, and offering him vinegre,
label: Luke

text: ſaying, If thou be the king of the Ievves, ſaue thy ſelf.
label: Luke

text: And there vvas alſo a ſuperſcription vvritten ouer him in Greeke, and Latine, and Hebrew letters: THIS IS THE KING OF THE IEWES.
label: Luke

text: And one of thoſe theeues that vvere hanged, blaſphemed him, ſaying, If thou be Chriſt, ſaue thy ſelf, and vs.
label: Luke

text: But the other anſvvering, rebuked him, ſaying, Neither doeſt thou feare God, vvhere as thou art in the ſame damnation?
label: Luke

text: And vve in deede iuſtly, for vve receiue vvorthie of our doings: but this man hath done no euil.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to IESVS, Lord, remember me vvhen thou ſhalt come into thy kingdom.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS ſaid to him, Amen I ſay to thee: this day thou ſhalt be vvith me in paradiſe.
label: Luke

text: And it was almoſt the ſixt houre: and there vvas made darkeneſſe vpon the vvhole earth vntil the ninthe houre.
label: Luke

text: And the ſunne vvas darkened: and the veile of the temple vvas rent in the middes.
label: Luke

text: And IESVS crying vvith a loude voice, ſaid, Father, into thy handes I commend my ſpirit. And ſaying this, he gaue vp the ghoſt.
label: Luke

text: And the Centurion ſeeing that vvhich vvas done, glorified God, ſaying, In deede this man vvas iuſt.
label: Luke

text: And al the multitude of them that vvere preſent together at that ſight, and ſavv the things that vvere done, returned knocking their breaſts.
label: Luke

text: And al his acquaintance ſtoode a far of: and the vvomen that had folovved him from Galilee, ſeeing theſe things.
label: Luke

text: And behold a man named Ioſeph, vvhich vvas a ſenatour, a good man and a iuſt,
label: Luke

text: he had not conſented to their counſeil and doings, of Arimathæa a citie of Ievvrie, vvho alſo him ſelf expected the kingdom of God.
label: Luke

text: This man came to Pilate, and aſked the body of IESVS.
label: Luke

text: And taking it dovvne, vvrapped it in ſindon, and laid him in a monument hevved of ſtone, vvherein neuer yet any man had been laid.
label: Luke

text: And it vvas the day of Paraſceue, and the Sabboth drew neere.
label: Luke

text: And the women that vvere come with him from Galilee, folovving after, ſavv the monument, and hovv his body vvas laid.
label: Luke

text: And returning they prepared ſpices and ointments: and on the Sabboth they reſted according to the commaundement.
label: Luke

text: AND in the firſt of the Sabboth very early they came to the monument, carying the ſpices vvhich they had prepared.
label: Luke

text: And they found the ſtone rolled backe from the monument.
label: Luke

text: And going in, they found not the body of our Lord IESVS.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe: as they vvere aſtonied in their minde at this, behold tvvo men ſtoode beſide them in gliſtering appareil.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen they feared and caſt dovvne their countenance tovvard the ground, they ſaid vnto them, VVhy ſeeke you the liuing vvith the dead?
label: Luke

text: he is not here, but is riſen. remember hovv he ſpake to you, vvhen he yet vvas in Galilee,
label: Luke

text: ſaying, That the Sonne of man muſt be deliuered into the handes of ſinners and be crucified, and the third day riſe againe.
label: Luke

text: And they remembred his vvordes.
label: Luke

text: And going backe from the monument, they told al theſe things to thoſe eleuen, and to al the reſt.
label: Luke

text: And it vvas Marie Magdalene, and Ioane, and Marie of Iames, and the reſt that vvere with them, vvhich ſaid theſe things to the Apoſtles.
label: Luke

text: And theſe vvordes ſeemed before them as dotage, and they did not beleeue them.
label: Luke

text: But Peter riſing vp ranne to the monument: and ſtouping dovvne he ſavv the linnen clothes lying alone, and went avvay marueiling with him ſelf at that which was done.
label: Luke

text: And behold, tvvo of them vvent the ſame day into a tovvne vvhich vvas the ſpace of ſixtie furlonges from Hieruſalem, named Emmäùs.
label: Luke

text: And they talked betwixt them ſelues of al thoſe things that had chaunced.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe: vvhile they talked and reaſoned vvith them ſelues, IESVS alſo him ſelf approching vvent vvith them.
label: Luke

text: but their eies vvere held that they might not know him.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, VVhat are theſe communications that you conferre one vvith an other vvalking, and are ſad?
label: Luke

text: And one vvhoſe name vvas Cleophas, anſvvering, ſaid to him, Art thou only a ſtranger in Hieruſalem, and haſt not knovven the things that haue been done in it, theſe daies?
label: Luke

text: To vvhom he ſaid, VVhat things? And they ſaid, concerning IESVS of Nazareth, vvho vvas a man a Prophet, mightie in vvorke and vvorde before God and al the people.
label: Luke

text: And how our cheefe Prieſtes and Princes deliuered him into condemnation of death, and crucified him.
label: Luke

text: but vve hoped that it vvas he that ſhould redeeme Iſrael: and novv beſides al this, to day is the third day ſince theſe things vvere done.
label: Luke

text: But certaine vvomen alſo of ours, made vs afraid: vvho before it vvas light, vvere at the monument,
label: Luke

text: and not finding his body, came, ſaying that they ſavv a viſion alſo of Angels, vvho ſay that he is aliue.
label: Luke

text: And certaine men of ours vvent to the monument: and they found it ſo as the vvomen ſaid, but him they found not.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, O foliſh, and ſlovv of hart to beleeue, in al things vvhich the Prophets haue ſpoken.
label: Luke

text: Ought not Chriſt to haue ſuffred theſe things, and ſo to enter into his glorie?
label: Luke

text: And beginning from Moyſes and al the Prophets, he did interpret to them in al the ſcriptures the things that vvere concerning him.
label: Luke

text: And they drevv nigh to the tovvne vvhither they vvent: and he made ſemblaunce to goe further.
label: Luke

text: And they forced him, ſaying, Tarie vvith vs, becauſe it is tovvard night, and the day is novv farre ſpent. And he vvent in vvith them.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe, vvhiles he ſate at the table vvith them, he tooke bread, and bleſſed and brake, and did reach to them.
label: Luke

text: And their eies vvere opened, and they knevv him: and he vaniſhed out of their ſight.
label: Luke

text: And they ſaid one to the other, VVas not our hart burning in vs, vvhiles he ſpake in the vvay, and opened vnto vs the ſcriptures?
label: Luke

text: And riſing vp the ſame houre they vvent backe into Hieruſalem: and they found the eleuen gathered together, and thoſe that vvere vvith them,
label: Luke

text: ſaying, That our Lord is riſen in deede, and hath appeared to Simon.
label: Luke

text: And they told the things that vvere done in the vvay: and hovv they knevv him in the breaking of bread. ⊢
label: Luke

text: And vvhiles they ſpeake theſe things, IESVS ſtoode in the middes of them, and he ſaith to them, Peace be to you: it is I. feare not.
label: Luke

text: But they being troubled and frighted, imagined that they ſaw a ſpirit.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, VVhy are you troubled, and cogitations ariſe into your harts?
label: Luke

text: See my handes, and feete, that it is I my ſelf. handle, and ſee: for a ſpirit hath not fleſh and bones, as you ſee me to haue.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he had ſaid this, he ſhevved them his handes and feete.
label: Luke

text: But they yet not beleeuing and marueiling for ioy, he ſaid, Haue you here any thing to be eaten?
label: Luke

text: But they offred him a peece of fiſh broiled, and a honie combe.
label: Luke

text: And vvhen he had eaten before them, taking the remaines he gaue to them.
label: Luke

text: And he ſaid to them, Theſe are the vvordes vvhich I ſpake to you, vvhen I vvas yet vvith you, that al things muſt needes be fulfilled, vvhich are vvritten in the lavv of Moyſes, and the Prophets, and the Pſalmes, of me.
label: Luke

text: Then he opened their vnderſtanding, that they might vnderſtand the Scriptures.
label: Luke

text: and he ſaid to them, That ſo it is vvritten, and ſo it behoued Chriſt to ſuffer, and to riſe againe from the dead the third day:
label: Luke

text: and penance to be preached in his name and remiſſion of ſinnes vnto al nations, ⊢ beginning from Hieruſalem.
label: Luke

text: And you are vvitneſſes of theſe things.
label: Luke

text: And I ſend the promes of my Father vpon you: but you, tarie in the citie, til you be endued vvith povver from high.
label: Luke

text: And he brought them forth abrode into Bethánia: and lifting vp his handes he bleſſed them.
label: Luke

text: And it came to paſſe, vvhiles he bleſſed them, he departed from them, and was caried into heauen.
label: Luke

text: And they adoring vvent backe into Hieruſalem vvith great ioy:
label: Luke

text: and they vvere alvvaies in the temple praiſing and bleſſing God.
label: Luke

text: IN THE beginning vvas the WORD, and the WORD vvas vvith God, and God vvas the WORD.
label: John

text: This vvas in the beginning vvith God.
label: John

text: Al things vvere made by him: and vvithout him vvas made ‘nothing. That vvhich vvas made’,
label: John

text: in him was life, and the life vvas the light of men:
label: John

text: and the light ſhineth in darkeneſſe, and the darkeneſſe did not comprehend it.
label: John

text: There vvas a man ſent from God, vvhoſe name vvas Iohn.
label: John

text: This man came for teſtimonie: to giue teſtimonie of the light, that al might beleeue through him.
label: John

text: He was not the light, but to giue teſtimonie of the light.
label: John

text: It vvas the true light, vvhich lighteneth euery man that commeth into this vvorld.
label: John

text: He vvas in the vvorld, and the vvorld vvas made by him, and the vvorld knevv him not.
label: John

text: He came into his ovvne, and his ovvne receiued him not.
label: John

text: But as many as receiued him, he gaue them povver to be made the ſonnes of God, to thoſe that beleeue in his name.
label: John

text: VVho, not of bloud, nor of the vvil of fleſh, nor of the vvil of man, but of God are borne.
label: John

text: AND THE VVORD VVAS MADE FLESH, and dwelt in vs (and vve ſavv the glorie of him, glorie as it vvere of the only-begotten of the Father) ful of grace and veritie. ⊢
label: John

text: Iohn giueth teſtimonie of him, and crieth ſaying, This vvas he of vvhom I ſpake, He that ſhal come after me, is made before me: becauſe he vvas before me.
label: John

text: And of his fulnes al vve haue receiued, and grace for grace.
label: John

text: For the lavv vvas giuen by Moyſes, grace and veritie vvas made by IESVS Chriſt.
label: John

text: God no man hath ſeen at any time: the only begotten Sonne vvhich is in the boſome of the father, he hath declared.
label: John

text: And this is Iohns teſtimonie, vvhen the Ievves ſent from Hieruſalem Prieſts and Leuites to him, that they ſhould aſke him, VVho art thou?
label: John

text: And he confeſſed, and did not denie: and he confeſſed, That I am not CHRIST.
label: John

text: And they aſked him, VVhat then? Art thou Elias? And he ſaid, I am not. Art thou the Prophet? And he anſvvered, No.
label: John

text: They ſaid therefore vnto him, Vvho art thou, that vve may giue an anſvver to them that ſent vs? vvhat ſaieſt thou of thy ſelf?
label: John

text: He ſaid, I am the voyce of one crying in the deſert, make ſtraight the vvay of our Lord, as Eſaie the Prophet ſaid.
label: John

text: And they that vvere ſent, vvere of the Phariſees.
label: John

text: And they aſked him, and ſaid to him, VVhy then doeſt thou baptize, if thou be not Chriſt, nor Elias, nor the Prophet?
label: John

text: Iohn anſvvered them, ſaying, I baptize in vvater: but there hath ſtood in the middes of you vvhom you know not.
label: John

text: The ſame is he that ſhal come after me, that is made before me: vvhoſe latchet of his ſhoe I am not worthie to vnlooſe.
label: John

text: Theſe things were done in Bethania beyond Iordan, vvhere Iohn vvas baptizing. ⊢
label: John

text: The next day Iohn ſavv IESVS comming to him, and he ſaith, Behold the lambe of God, behold him that taketh avvay the ‘ſinne’ of the vvorld.
label: John

text: This is he of vvhom I ſaid, After me there commeth a man, vvhich is made before me: becauſe he vvas before me.
label: John

text: And I knew him not, but that he may be manifeſted in Iſrael, therefore came I baptizing in vvater.
label: John

text: And Iohn gaue teſtimonie, ſaying, That I ſavv the Spirit deſcending as a doue from heauen, and he remained vpon him.
label: John

text: And I knevv him not: but he that ſent me to baptize in vvater, he ſaid to me, He vpon vvhom thou ſhalt ſee the Spirit deſcending and remaining vpon him, he it is that baptizeth in the holy Ghoſt.
label: John

text: And I ſavv: and I gaue teſtimonie that this is the ſonne of God. ⊢
label: John

text: The next day againe Iohn ſtoode, and tvvo of his diſciples.
label: John

text: And beholding IESVS vvalking, he ſaith, Behold the lambe of God.
label: John

text: And the tvvo Diſciples heard him ſpeaking, and they folovved IESVS.
label: John

text: And IESVS turning, and ſeeing them folowing him, ſaith to them, VVhat ſeeke you? VVho ſaid to him, Rabbi (vvhich is called by interpretation, Maiſter) vvhere dvvelleſt thou?
label: John

text: He ſaith to them, Come and ſee. They came, and ſavv where he abode and they taried with him that day: and it vvas about the tenth houre.
label: John

text: And Andrevv the brother of Simon Peter vvas one of the tvvo that had heard of Iohn, and folovved him.
label: John

text: He findeth firſt his brother Simon, and ſaith to him, VVe haue found MESSIAS, vvhich is being interpreted, CHRIST.
label: John

text: And he brought him to IESVS. And IESVS looking vpon him, ſaid, Thou art Simon the ſonne of Iona: thou ſhalt be called Cephas, vvhich is interpreted, Peter.
label: John

text: On the morovv he vvould goe forth into Galilee, and he findeth Philippe. And IESVS ſaith to him, Folovv me.
label: John

text: And Philippe vvas of Bethſaida, the citie of Andrevv and Peter.
label: John

text: Philippe findeth Nathanael, and ſaith to him, Him vvhom Moyſes in the lavv, and the Prophets vvrote of: vve haue found IESVS the ſonne of Ioſeph, of Nazareth.
label: John

text: And Nathanael ſaid to him, From Nazareth can there be any good? Philippe ſaith to him, Come and ſee.
label: John

text: IESVS ſavv Nathanael comming to him, and he ſaith of him, Behold an Iſraelite in very deede, in vvhom there is no guile.
label: John

text: Nathanael ſaith to him, Hovv knoweſt thou me? IESVS anſvvered and ſaid to him, Before that Philippe did cal thee, vvhen thou waſt vnder the figtree, I ſaw thee.
label: John

text: Nathanael anſvvered him, and ſaith, Rabbi, thou art the ſonne of God, thou art the king of Iſrael.
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, and ſaid to him, Becauſe I ſaid vnto thee, I ſavv thee vnder the figtree, thou beleeueſt: greater then theſe things ſhalt thou ſee.
label: John

text: And he ſaith to him, Amen Amen I ſay to you, You ſhal ſee the heauen opened, and the Angels of God aſcending and deſcending, vpon the Sonne of man. ⊢
label: John

text: AND the third day there vvas a mariage made in Cana of Galilee: and the mother of IESVS vvas there.
label: John

text: And IESVS alſo vvas called, and his Diſciples to the mariage.
label: John

text: And the vvine failing, the mother of IESVS ſaith to him, They haue no vvine.
label: John

text: And IESVS ſaith to her, VVhat is to me and thee vvoman? my houre commeth not yet.
label: John

text: His mother ſaith to the miniſters, VVhatſoeuer he ſhal ſay to you, doe ye.
label: John

text: And there were ſet there ſixe water-pottes of ſtone, according to the purification of the Ievves, holding euery one tvvo or three meaſures.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to them, Fil the vvater-pottes vvith vvater. And they filled them vp to the toppe.
label: John

text: And IESVS ſaith to them, Dravv novv, and carie to the cheefe ſtevvard. And they caried it.
label: John

text: And after the cheefe ſtevvard taſted the water made vvine, and knevv not vvhence it vvas, but the miniſters knew that had dravvne the vvater: the cheefe ſtevvard calleth the bridegrome,
label: John

text: and ſaith to him, Euery man firſt ſetteth the good vvine: and vvhen they haue vvel drunke, then that vvhich is vvorſe. But thou haſt kept the good vvine vntil novv.
label: John

text: This beginning of miracles did IESVS in Cana of Galilee: and he manifeſted his glorie, and his Diſciples beleeued in him. ⊢
label: John

text: After this he vvent dovvne to Capharnaum him ſelf and his mother, and his brethren, and his diſciples: and there they remained not many daies.
label: John

text: And the Paſche of the Iewes vvas at hand, and IESVS vvent vp to Hieruſalem:
label: John

text: and he found in the temple them that ſold oxen and ſheepe and doues, and the bankers ſitting.
label: John

text: And vvhen he had made as it vvere a vvhippe of litle coardes, he caſt them al out of the temple, the ſheepe alſo and the oxen, and the money of the bankers he powred out, and the tables he ouerthrevv.
label: John

text: And to them that ſold doues, he ſaid, Take avvay theſe things hence, and make not the houſe of my father, a houſe of marchandiſe.
label: John

text: And his Diſciples remembred that it is vvritten, The zeale of thy houſe hath eaten me.
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore anſvvered and ſaid to him, VVhat ſigne doeſt thou ſhevv vs, that thou doeſt theſe things?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered and ſaid to them, Diſſolue this temple, and in three daies I vvil raiſe it.
label: John

text: The Iewes therfore ſaid, In fourtie and ſixe yeres vvas this temple built, and vvilt thou raiſe it in three daies?
label: John

text: But he ſpake of the temple of his body.
label: John

text: Therfore vvhen he vvas riſen againe from the dead, his Diſciples remembred, that he ſaid this, and they beleeued the ſcripture and the vvord that IESVS did ſay.
label: John

text: And vvhen he was at Hieruſalem in the Paſche, vpon the feſtiual day, many beleeued in his name, ſeeing his ſignes vvhich he did.
label: John

text: But IESVS did not commit him ſelf vnto them, for that he knevv al,
label: John

text: and becauſe it vvas not needeful for him that any ſhould giue teſtimonie of man: for he knevv vvhat vvas in man. ⊢
label: John

text: AND there vvas a man of the Phariſees, named Nicodemus, a prince of the Ievves.
label: John

text: This man came to IESVS by night, and ſaid to him, Rabbi, vve knovv that thou art come from God a maiſter, for no man can doe theſe ſignes vvhich thou doeſt, vnles God be vvith him.
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, and ſaid to him, Amen, Amen I ſay to thee, Vnles a man be borne againe, he can not ſee the kingdom of God.
label: John

text: Nicodemus ſaid to him, Hovv can a man be borne, vvhen he is old? can he enter into his mothers vvombe againe and be borne?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, Amen, Amen I ſay to thee, Vnles a man be borne againe of vvater and the Spirit, he can not enter into the kingdom of God.
label: John

text: That vvhich is borne of the fleſh, is fleſh: & that vvhich is borne of the ſpirit, is ſpirit.
label: John

text: Marueil not, that I ſaid to thee, You muſt be borne againe.
label: John

text: The ſpirit breatheth vvhere he vvil: and thou heareſt his voice, but thou knovveſt not vvhence he commeth and vvhither he goeth: ſo is euery one that is borne of the Spirit.
label: John

text: Nicodemus anſvvered, & ſaid to him, Hovv can theſe things be done?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, and ſaid to him, Thou art a maiſter in Iſrael, and art thou ignorant of theſe things?
label: John

text: Amen, Amen I ſay to thee, that we ſpeake that vvhich vve knovv, and that vvhich vve haue ſeen vve teſtifie, and our teſtimonie you receiue not.
label: John

text: If I haue ſpoken to you earthly things, and you beleeue not: hovv if I ſhal ſpeake to you heauenly things, vvil you beleeue?
label: John

text: And no man hath aſcended into heauen, but he that deſcended from heauen, the Sonne of man vvhich is in heauen.
label: John

text: And as Moyſes exalted the ſerpent in the deſert, ſo muſt the Sonne of man be exalted:
label: John

text: that euery one vvhich beleeueth in him, periſh not, but may haue life euerlaſting.
label: John

text: For ſo God loued the vvorld, that he gaue his only-begotten ſonne: that euery one that beleeueth in him, periſh not, but may haue life euerlaſting. ⊢
label: John

text: For God ſent not his ſonne into the vvorld, to iudge the vvorld, but that the vvorld may be ſaued by him.
label: John

text: He that beleeueth in him, is not iudged. but he that doeth not beleeue, is already iudged: becauſe he hath not beleeued in the name of the only-begotten ſonne of God.
label: John

text: And this is the iudgment: becauſe the light is come into the vvorld, and men haue loued the darkeneſſe rather then the light: for their vvorkes vvere euil.
label: John

text: For euery one that doeth il, hateth the light, and commeth not to the light, that his vvorkes may not be controuled.
label: John

text: But he that doeth veritie, commeth to the light, that his vvorkes may be made manifeſt, becauſe they vvere done in God. ⊢
label: John

text: After theſe things IESVS came and his Diſciples into the countrie of Ievvrie: and there he abode vvith them, and baptized.
label: John

text: And Iohn alſo vvas baptizing in Aenon beſide Salim: becauſe there vvas much vvater there, and they came, and vvere baptized.
label: John

text: For Iohn vvas not yet caſt into priſon.
label: John

text: And there roſe a queſtion of Iohns diſciples vvith the Ievves concerning purification.
label: John

text: And they came to Iohn, and ſaid to him, Rabbi, he that vvas vvith thee beyond Iordan, to vvhom thou didſt giue teſtimonie, behold he baptizeth, and al come to him.
label: John

text: Iohn anſvvered and ſaid, A man can not receiue any thing, vnleſſe it be giuen him from heauen.
label: John

text: Your ſelues doe beare me vvitneſſe, that I ſaid, I am not CHRIST: but that I am ſent before him.
label: John

text: He that hath the bride, is the bridegrome: but the frende of the bridegrome that ſtandeth and heareth him, reioyceth vvith ioy for the voice of the bridegrome. This my ioy therfore is filled.
label: John

text: He muſt increaſe, and I diminiſhe.
label: John

text: He that commeth from aboue, is aboue al. He that is of the earth, of the earth he is, and of the earth he ſpeaketh. He that commeth from heauen, is aboue al.
label: John

text: And vvhat he hath ſeen and heard, that he teſtifieth: and his teſtimonie no man receiueth.
label: John

text: He that hath receiued his teſtimonie, hath ſigned that God is true.
label: John

text: For he vvhom God hath ſent, ſpeaketh the vvordes of God. for God doth not giue the ſpirit by meaſure.
label: John

text: The Father loueth the Sonne: & he hath giuen al things in his hand.
label: John

text: He that beleeueth in the Sonne, hath life euerlaſting: but he that is incredulous to the Sonne, ſhal not ſee life, but the vvrath of God remaineth vpon him.
label: John

text: WHEN IESVS therfore vnderſtoode that the Phariſees heard that IESVS maketh mo Diſciples, and baptizeth, then Iohn,
label: John

text: (hovvbeit IESVS did not baptize, but his Diſciples)
label: John

text: he left Iewrie, and vvent againe into Galilee.
label: John

text: and he had of neceſſitie to paſſe through Samaria.
label: John

text: He commeth therfore into a citie of Samaria vvhich is called Sichar: beſide the maner that Iacob gaue to Ioſeph his ſonne.
label: John

text: And there vvas there the fountaine of Iacob. IESVS therfore vvearied of his iourney, ſate ſo vpon the fountaine. It vvas about the ſixt houre.
label: John

text: There commeth a vvoman of Samaria to dravv water, IESVS ſaith to her, Giue me to drinke.
label: John

text: For his Diſciples vvere gone into the citie, to bie meates.
label: John

text: Therfore that Samaritane vvoman ſaith to him, How doeſt thou being a Ievve, aſke of me to drinke, vvhich am a Samaritane woman? For the Iewes do not communicate vvith the Samaritanes.
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, and ſaid to her, If thou didſt know the gift of God, and vvho he is that ſaith vnto thee, Giue me to drinke: thou perhaps vvouldeſt haue aſked of him, and he vvould haue giuen thee c liuing vvater.
label: John

text: The vvoman ſaith to him, Sir, neither haſt thou vvherein to dravv, and the vvel is deepe: whence haſt thou the liuing vvater?
label: John

text: art thou greater then our father Iacob, who gaue vs the vvel, and him ſelf dranke of it, and his children, and his cattel?
label: John

text: IESVS anſwered, and ſaid to her, Euery one that drinketh of this water, ſhal thirſt againe: but he that ſhal drinke of the water that I wil giue him, ſhal not thirſt for euer,
label: John

text: but the vvater that I vvil giue him, ſhal become in him a fountaine of water ſpringing vp vnto life euerlaſting.
label: John

text: The vvoman ſaith to him, Lord giue me this vvater, that I may not thirſt, nor come hither to dravv.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to her, Goe, call thy huſband, and come hither.
label: John

text: The vvoman anſvvered and ſaid, I haue no huſband. IESVS ſaith to her, Thou haſt ſaid vvel, that I haue no huſband.
label: John

text: For thou haſt had fiue huſbands: and he vvhom thou novv haſt, is not thy huſband. this thou haſt ſaid truely.
label: John

text: The vvoman ſaith to him, Lord, I perceiue that thou art a Prophet.
label: John

text: Our fathers adored in this mountaine, and you ſay, that at Hieruſalem is the place vvhere men muſt adore.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to her, VVoman beleeue me, that the houre ſhal come, vvhen you ſhal neither in this mountaine, nor in Hieruſalem adore the Father.
label: John

text: You adore that you knovv not: vve adore that vve knovv, for ſaluation is of the Ievves.
label: John

text: But the houre commeth, and novv it is, vvhen the true adorers ſhal adore the Father in ſpirit and veritie. for the Father alſo ſeeketh ſuch, to adore him.
label: John

text: God is a ſpirit, and they that adore him, muſt adore in ſpirit and veritie.
label: John

text: The vvoman ſaith to him, I know that MESSIAS commeth, (vvhich is called CHRIST): therfore when he commeth, he vvil ſhevv vs al things.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to her, I am he, that ſpeake with thee.
label: John

text: And incontinent his Diſciples came: and they marueiled that he talked vvith a vvoman. No man for al that ſaid, VVhat ſeekeſt thou, or vvhy talkeſt thou with her?
label: John

text: The woman therfore left her vvater-pot: and ſhe vvent into the citie, and ſaith to thoſe men,
label: John

text: Come, and ſee a man that hath told me al things vvhatſoeuer I haue done. Is not he CHRIST?
label: John

text: They vvent forth therfore out of the citie, and came to him.
label: John

text: In the meane time the Diſciples deſired him, ſaying, Rabbi eate.
label: John

text: But he ſaid to them, I haue meate to eate which you knovv not.
label: John

text: The Diſciples therfore ſaid one to an other, Hath any man brought him for to eate?
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to them, My meate is to doe the vvil of him that ſent me, to perfit his vvorke.
label: John

text: Doe not you ſay that yet there are foure moneths, and harueſt commeth? Behold I ſay to you, lift vp your eies, and ſee the countries, that they are vvhite already to harueſt.
label: John

text: And he that reapeth, receiueth hire, and gathereth fruite vnto life euerlaſting: that both he that ſovveth, and he that reapeth, may reioyce together.
label: John

text: For in this is the ſaying true: that it is one man that ſovveth, and it is an other that reapeth.
label: John

text: I haue ſent you to reape that vvhich you laboured not: others haue laboured, and you haue entred into their labours.
label: John

text: And of that citie many beleeued in him of the Samaritans, for the vvord of the vvoman giuing teſtimonie, that he told me al things vvhatſoeuer I haue done.
label: John

text: Therfore vvhen the Samaritans vvere come to him, they deſired him that he vvould tarie there. And he taried there tvvo daies.
label: John

text: And many moe beleeued for his ovvne vvord.
label: John

text: And they ſaid to the vvoman, That novv not for thy ſaying doe vve beleeue: for our ſelues haue heard, and doe knovv that this is the Sauiour of the vvorld in deede. ⊢
label: John

text: And after the tvvo daies he departed thence: and vvent into Galilee.
label: John

text: For IESVS him ſelf gaue teſtimonie that a Prophet hath not honour in his ovvne countrie.
label: John

text: Therfore vvhen he vvas come into Galilee, the Galilaeans receiued him, vvhereas they had ſeen al things that he had done at Hieruſalem in the feſtiual day: for them ſelues alſo came to the feſtiual day.
label: John

text: He came againe therfore into Cana of Galilee, VVhere he made vvater vvine. And there vvas a certaine lord vvhoſe ſonne was ſicke at Capharnáum.
label: John

text: He hauing heard that IESVS came from Ievvrie into Galilee, vvent to him, and deſired him that he vvould come dovvne & heale his ſonne. for he began to die.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaid to him, Vnleſſe you ſee ſignes and vvonders, you beleeue not.
label: John

text: The lord ſaith to him, Lord, come dovvne before that my ſonne die.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to him, Goe, thy ſonne liueth. The man beleeued the vvord that IESVS ſaid to him, and vvent.
label: John

text: And as he was novv going downe, his ſeruants mette him: and they brought vvord, ſaying, That his ſonne liued.
label: John

text: He aſked therfore of them the houre, vvherein he vvas amended. And they ſaid to him, That yeſterday at the ſeuenth houre the feuer left him.
label: John

text: The father therfore knevv that it vvas in the ſame houre vvherein IESVS ſaid to him, Thy ſonne liueth. and him ſelf beleeued and his vvhole houſe. ⊢
label: John

text: This againe the ſecond ſigne did IESVS, vvhen he vvas come from Ievvrie into Galilee.
label: John

text: AFTER theſe things there vvas a feſtiual day of the Ievves, and IESVS vvent vp to Hieruſalem.
label: John

text: And there is at Hieruſalem ‘vpon’ Probatica a pond vvhich in hebrevv is ſurnamed ‘Bethſaida’, hauing fiue porches.
label: John

text: In theſe lay a great multitude of ſicke perſons, of blinde, lame, vvithered, expecting the ſtirring of the vvater.
label: John

text: And an Angel of our Lord deſcended at a certaine time into the pond: and the vvater vvas ſtirred. And he that had gone dovvne firſt into the pond after the ſtirring of the vvater, vvas made vvhole of vvhatſoeuer infirmitie he vvas holden.
label: John

text: And there vvas a certaine man there that had been eight and thirtie yeres in his infirmitie.
label: John

text: Him when IESVS had ſeen lying, & knevv that c he had novv a long time, he ſaith to him, Vvilt thou be made vvhole?
label: John

text: The ſicke man anſwered him, Lord, I haue no man, vvhen the vvater is troubled, to put me into the pond. For vvhiles I come, an other goeth dovvne before me.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to him, Ariſe, take vp thy bed, and vvalke.
label: John

text: And forthvvith he vvas made vvhole: and he tooke vp his bed, and vvalked. And it vvas the Sabboth that day.
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore ſaid to him that vvas healed, It is the Sabboth, thou maiſt not take vp thy bed.
label: John

text: He anſwered them, He that made me vvhole, he ſaid to me, Take vp thy bed, and walke.
label: John

text: They aſked him therfore, VVhat is that man that ſaid to thee, Take vp thy bed, and vvalke?
label: John

text: But he that vvas made vvhole, knevv not vvho it vvas. For IESVS ſhronke aſide from the multitude ſtanding in the place.
label: John

text: Aftervvard IESVS findeth him in the temple, and ſaid to him, Behold thou art made vvhole: ſinne no more, leſt ſome vvorſe thing chaunce to thee.
label: John

text: That man vvent his way, and told the Ievves that it was IESVS that made him whole. ⊢
label: John

text: Therevpon the Iewes perſecuted IESVS, becauſe he did theſe things on the Sabboth.
label: John

text: But IESVS anſwered them, My father vvorketh vntil novv: and I doe vvorke.
label: John

text: Therevpon therefore the Iewes ſought the more to kil him: becauſe he did not only breake the Sabboth, but alſo he ſaid God was his father, making him ſelf aequal to God.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore anſvvered, and ſaid to them, Amen, amen I ſay to you, The Sonne can not doe any thing of him ſelf, but that vvhich he ſeeth the Father doing. For vvhat things ſoeuer he doeth, theſe the Sonne alſo doeth in like maner.
label: John

text: For the Father loueth the Sonne, and ſheweth him al things that him ſelf doeth, and greater vvorkes then theſe vvil he ſhevv him, that you may marueil.
label: John

text: For as the Father doth raiſe the dead and quickeneth: ſo the Sonne alſo quickeneth whom he vvil.
label: John

text: For neither doth the Father iudge any man: but al iudgement he hath giuen to the Sonne,
label: John

text: that al may honour the Sonne, as they doe honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Sonne, doth not honour the Father, vvho ſent him.
label: John

text: Amen, amen I ſay to you, that he vvhich heareth my vvord, and beleeueth him that ſent me, hath life euerlaſting. and he commeth not into iudgement, but ‘ſhal paſſe’ from death into life.
label: John

text: Amen, amen I ſay to you, that the houre commeth, and novv it is, vvhen the dead ſhal heare the voice of the Sonne of God, and they that haue heard, ſhal liue.
label: John

text: For as the Father hath life in him ſelf: ſo he hath giuen to the Sonne alſo to haue life in him ſelf:
label: John

text: and he hath giuen him povver to doe iudgement alſo, becauſe he is the Sonne of man.
label: John

text: Marueil not at this, becauſe the houre commeth vvherein al that are in the graues, ſhal heare his voice,
label: John

text: and they that haue done good things, ſhal come forth into the reſurrection of life: but they that haue done euil, into the reſurrection of iudgement. ⊢
label: John

text: I can not of my ſelf doe any thing. As I heare, ſo I iudge: and my iudgement is iuſt. becauſe I ſeeke not my vvil, but the vvil of him that ſent me.
label: John

text: If I giue teſtimonie of my ſelf, my teſtimonie is not true.
label: John

text: There is an other that giueth teſtimonie of me: and I know that the teſtimonie is true vvhich he giueth of me.
label: John

text: You ſent to Iohn: and he gaue teſtimonie to the truth.
label: John

text: But I receiue not teſtimonie of man: but I ſay theſe things that you may be ſaued.
label: John

text: He vvas the lampe burning and ſhining. And you vvould for a time reioyce in his light.
label: John

text: But I haue a greater teſtimonie then Iohn. For the vvorkes vvhich the Father hath giuen me to perfit them: the very vvorkes them ſelues vvhich I doe, giue teſtimonie of me, that the Father hath ſent me.
label: John

text: And the Father that ſent me, him ſelf hath giuen teſtimonie of me. neither haue you heard his voice at any time, nor ſeen his ſhape,
label: John

text: and his vvord you haue not remaining in you: becauſe vvhom he hath ſent, him you beleeue not.
label: John

text: Search the ſcriptures, for you thinke in them to haue life euerlaſting: and the ſame are they that giue teſtimonie of me:
label: John

text: and you vvil not come to me that you may haue life.
label: John

text: Glorie of men I receiue not.
label: John

text: But I haue knovven you, that the loue of God you haue not in you.
label: John

text: I am come in the name of my Father, and you receiue me not: if an other ſhal come in his ovvne name, him you vvil receiue.
label: John

text: Hovv can you beleeue, that receiue glorie one of an other: and the glorie vvhich is of God only, you ſeeke not?
label: John

text: Thinke not that I vvil accuſe you to the Father. there is that accuſeth you, Moyſes, in whom you truſt.
label: John

text: For if you did beleeue Moyſes: you vvould perhaps beleeue me alſo. for of me he hath written.
label: John

text: And if you doe not beleeue his vvritings: hovv vvil you beleeue my vvordes?
label: John

text: AFTER theſe things IESVS vvent beyond the ſea of Galilee, vvhich is of Tiberias:
label: John

text: and a great multitude folovved him, becauſe they ſavv the ſignes vvhich he did vpon thoſe that vvere ſicke.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore went vp into the mountaine, and there he ſate vvith his Diſciples.
label: John

text: And the Paſche vvas at hand, the feſtiual day of the Iewes.
label: John

text: When IESVS therfore had lifted vp his eies, and ſavv that a very great multitude commeth to him, he ſaith to Philippe, VVhence ſhal vve bie bread: that theſe may eate?
label: John

text: And this he ſaid, tempting him. for him ſelf knevv vvhat he vvould doe?
label: John

text: Philippe anſvvered him, Tvvo hundred penie vvorth of bread is not ſufficient for them, that euery man may take a litle peece.
label: John

text: One of his Diſciples, Andrevv the brother of Simon Peter, ſaith to him,
label: John

text: There is a boy here that hath fiue barley loaues, & tvvo fiſhes: but vvhat are theſe among ſo many?
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaith, Make the men to ſit dovvne. And there vvas much graſſe in the place. The men therfore ſate dovvne, in number about fiue thouſand.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore tooke the loaues: and vvhen he had giuen thankes, he diſtributed to them that ſate. in like maner alſo of the fiſhes as much as they vvould.
label: John

text: And after they vvere filled, he ſaid to his Diſciples, Gather the fragments that are remaining, leſt they be loſt.
label: John

text: They gathered therfore, and filled tvvelue baſkets vvith fragments of the fiue barley loaues, vvhich remained to them that had eaten.
label: John

text: Thoſe men therfore vvhen they had ſeen vvhat a ſigne IESVS had done, ſaid, That this is the Prophet in deede that is to come into the vvorld.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore when he knevv that they vvould come to take him, and make him king, he fled againe into the mountaine him ſelf alone. ⊢
label: John

text: And vvhen euen vvas come, his Diſciples vvent dovvne to the ſea.
label: John

text: And vvhen they vvere gone vp into the ſhippe, they came beyond the ſea into Capharnáum. and now it vvas darke, and IESVS vvas not come vnto them
label: John

text: And the ſea aroſe, by reaſon of a great vvinde that blevv.
label: John

text: VVhen they had rovved therfore about fiue and tvventie or thirtie furlonges, they ſee IESVS vvalking vpon the ſea, and to dravv nigh to the ſhippe, and they feared.
label: John

text: But he ſaith to them, It is I, feare not.
label: John

text: They vvould therfore haue taken him into the ſhippe: and forthvvith the ſhippe vvas at the land to vvhich they vvent.
label: John

text: The next day, the multitude that ſtoode beyond the ſea, ſavv that there vvas no other boate there but one, and that IESVS had not entred into the boate vvith his Diſciples, but that his Diſciples only vvere departed:
label: John

text: but other boates came in from Tiberias beſide the place vvhere they had eaten the bread, our Lord giuing thankes.
label: John

text: VVhen therfore the multitude ſavv that IESVS vvas not there, nor his Diſciples, they vvent vp into the boates, & came to Capharnaum ſeeking IESVS.
label: John

text: And when they had found him beyond the ſea, they ſaid to him, Rabbi, when cameſt thou hither?
label: John

text: IESVS anſwered them, and ſaid, Amen, amen I ſay to you, you ſeeke me not becauſe you haue ſeene ſignes, but becauſe you did eate of the loaues, and vvere filled.
label: John

text: VVorke not the meate that periſheth, but that endureth vnto life euerlaſting, vvhich the Sonne of man vvil giue you. For him the Father, God, hath ſigned.
label: John

text: They ſaid therfore vnto him, VVhat ſhal vve doe that vve may vvorke the vvorkes of God?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, and ſaid to them, This is the vvorke of God, that you beleeue in him vvhom he hath ſent.
label: John

text: They ſaid therfore to him, VVhat ſigne therfore doeſt thou, that vve may ſee, and may beleeue thee? vvhat vvorkeſt thou?
label: John

text: Our fathers did eate Manna in the deſert, as it is written, Bread from heauen he gaue them to eate.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaid to them, Amen, amen I ſay to you, Moyſes gaue you not the bread from heauen, but my Father giueth you the true bread from heauen.
label: John

text: For the bread of God it is that deſcendeth from heauen, and giueth life to the vvorld.
label: John

text: They ſaid therfore vnto him, Lord, giue vs alvvaies this bread.
label: John

text: And IESVS ſaid to them, I am the bread of life, he that commeth to me, ſhal not hunger: and he that beleeueth in me, ſhal neuer thirſt.
label: John

text: But I ſaid to you that both you haue ſeen me and you beleeue not.
label: John

text: Al that the Father giueth me, ſhal come to me: and him that commeth to me I vvil not caſt forth.
label: John

text: Becauſe I deſcended from heauen, not to doe mine ovvne vvil, but the vvil of him that ſent me.
label: John

text: For this is the vvil of him that ſent me, the Father: that al that he hath giuen me I leeſe not thereof, but raiſe it in the laſt day.
label: John

text: And this is the vvil of my father that ſent me: that euery one that ſeeth the Sonne, and beleeueth in him, haue life euerlaſting, and I vvil raiſe him in the laſt day. ⊢
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore murmured at him, becauſe he had ſaid, I am the bread vvhich deſcended from heauen:
label: John

text: and they ſaid, Is not this IESVS the ſonne of Ioſeph, vvhoſe father and mother vve knovv? Hovv then ſaith he, That I deſcended from heauen?
label: John

text: IESVS therfore anſvvered and ſaid to them, Murmure not one to an other:
label: John

text: no man can come to me, vnles the Father that ſent me, dravv him: and I vvil raiſe him vp in the laſt day.
label: John

text: It is vvritten in the Prophets, And al ſhal be docible of God. Euery one that hath heard of the Father, and hath learned, commeth to me.
label: John

text: Not that any man hath ſeen the Father, but he vvhich is of God: this hath ſeen the Father.
label: John

text: Amen, amen I ſay to you, he that beleeueth in me, hath life euerlaſting.
label: John

text: I am the bread of life.
label: John

text: Your fathers did eate Manna in the deſert: and they died.
label: John

text: This is the bread that deſcendeth from heauen: that if any man eate of it, he die not.
label: John

text: I am the liuing bread, that came dovvne from heauen. If any man eate of this bread, he ſhal liue for euer: and the bread vvhich I vvil giue, is my fleſh for the life of the vvorld. ⊢
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore ſtroue among them ſelues, ſaying, How can this man giue vs his fleſh to eate?
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaid to them, Amen, amen I ſay to you, Vnles you eate the fleſh of the Sonne of man, and drinke his bloud, you ſhal not haue life in you.
label: John

text: He that eateth my fleſh, and drinketh my bloud, hath life euerlaſting: and I vvil raiſe him vp in the laſt day. ⊢
label: John

text: For my fleſh, is meate in deede: and my bloud is drinke in deede.
label: John

text: He that eateth my fleſh, and drinketh my bloud, abideth in me, and I in him.
label: John

text: As the liuing father hath ſent me, and I liue by the father: and he that eateth me, the ſame alſo ſhal liue by me.
label: John

text: This is the bread that came dovvne from heauen. Not as your fathers did eate Manna, and died. He that eateth this bread, ſhal liue for euer. ⊢
label: John

text: Theſe things he ſaid teaching in the Synagogue, in Capharnáum.
label: John

text: Many therfore of his Diſciples hearing it, ſaid, This ſaying is hard, and vvho can heare it?
label: John

text: But IESVS knovving vvith him ſelf that his Diſciples murmured at this, he ſaid to them, Doth this ſcandalize you?
label: John

text: If then you ſhal ſee the Sonne of man aſcend vvhere he vvas before?
label: John

text: It is the ſpirit that quickeneth, the fleſh profiteth nothing. The wordes that I haue ſpoken to you, be ſpirit and life.
label: John

text: But there be certaine of you that beleeue not. For IESVS knevv from the beginning vvho they vvere that did not beleeue, and vvho he vvas that vvould betray him.
label: John

text: And he ſaid, Therfore did I ſay to you, that no man can come to me, vnles it be giuen him of my Father.
label: John

text: After this many of his Diſciples vvent backe: and novv they vvalked not vvith him.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaid to the Tvvelue, VVhat, vvil you alſo depart?
label: John

text: Simon Peter therfore anſwered him, Lord, to vvhom ſhal vve goe? thou haſt the vvordes of eternal life.
label: John

text: And we beleeue and haue knovven that thou art Chriſt the ſonne of God.
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered them, Haue not I choſen you the Tvvelue: & of you one is a deuil?
label: John

text: And he meant Iudas Iſcariot, Simons ſonne: for this ſame vvas to betray him, vvhereas he vvas one of the Twelue.
label: John

text: AFTER theſe things IESVS vvalked ‘into Galilee’, for he vvould not vvalke ‘into Iewrie’: becauſe the Iewes ſought to kil him.
label: John

text: And the feſtiual day of the Ievves, Scenopégia, vvas at hand.
label: John

text: And his brethren ſaid to him, Paſſe from hence, and goe into Ievvrie: that thy Diſciples alſo may ſee thy vvorkes vvhich thou doeſt.
label: John

text: For no man doeth any thing in ſecrete, and ſeeketh him ſelf to be in publike. If thou doe theſe things, manifeſt thy ſelf to the vvorld.
label: John

text: For neither did his brethren beleeue in him.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaith to them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alvvaies readie.
label: John

text: The vvorld can not hate you. but me it hateth: becauſe I giue teſtimonie of it, that the vvorkes there of are euil.
label: John

text: Goe you vp to this feſtiual day: ‘I goe not vp’ to this feſtiual day: becauſe my time is not yet accompliſhed.
label: John

text: When he had ſaid theſe things, him ſelf taried in Galilee.
label: John

text: But after his brethren vvere gone vp, then he alſo vvent vp to the feſtiual day, not openly, but as it vvere in ſecrete.
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore ſought him in the feſtiual day, and ſaid, VVhere is he?
label: John

text: And there vvas much murmuring in the multitude of him. For certaine ſaid, That he is good. And others ſaid, No, but he ſeduceth the multitudes.
label: John

text: Yet no man ſpake openly of him for feare of the Iewes. ⊢
label: John

text: And when the feſtiuitie vvas novv halfe done, IESVS vvent vp into the temple, and taught.
label: John

text: And the Iewes marueiled, ſaying, Hovv doth this man knovv letters, vvhereas he hath not learned?
label: John

text: IESVS anſwered them, and ſaid, My doctrine is not mine, but his that ſent me.
label: John

text: If any man vvil doe the vvil of him, he ſhal vnderſtand of the doctrine vvhether it be of God, or I ſpeake of my ſelf.
label: John

text: He that ſpeaketh of him ſelf, ſeeketh his ovvne glorie. But he that ſeeketh the glorie of him that ſent him, he is true, and iniuſtice in him there is not.
label: John

text: Did not Moyſes giue you the lavv, and none of you doeth the lavv?
label: John

text: VVhy ſeeke you to kil me? The multitude anſvvered, and ſaid, Thou haſt a deuil, who ſeeketh to kil thee?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, and ſaid to them, One vvorke I haue done: and you doe al marueil.
label: John

text: Therfore Moyſes gaue you circunciſion: not that it is of Moyſes, but of the fathers, and in the Sabboth you circunciſe a man.
label: John

text: If a man receiue circunciſion in the Sabboth, that the lavv of Moyſes be not broken: are you angrie at me becauſe I haue healed a man vvholy in the Sabboth?
label: John

text: Iudge not according to the face, but iudge iuſt iudgement.
label: John

text: Certaine therfore of Hieruſalem ſaid, Is not this he vvhom they ſeeke to kil?
label: John

text: And behold, he ſpeaketh openly, and they ſay nothing to him. Haue the Princes knovven in deede that this is CHRIST?
label: John

text: But this man vve knovv whence he is. But vvhen CHRIST commeth, no man knovveth vvhence he is.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore cried in the temple teaching, and ſaying, Both me you doe knovv, and vvhence I am you knovv. And of my ſelf I am not come, but he is true that ſent me, vvhom you knovv not.
label: John

text: I knovv him, becauſe I am of him, and he ſent me.
label: John

text: They ſought therfore to apprehend him: and no man laide handes vpon him, becauſe his houre vvas not yet come.
label: John

text: But of the multitude many beleeued in him, ⊢ and ſaid, CHRIST vvhen he commeth, ſhal he doe more ſignes then theſe vvhich this man doeth?
label: John

text: The Phariſees heard the multitude murmuring theſe things touching him: and the ‘Princes’ and Phariſees ſent miniſters to apprehend him.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaid to them, Yet a litle time I am vvith you: and I goe to him that ſent me.
label: John

text: You ſeeke me, and ſhal not finde: and vvhere I am, you can not come.
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore ſaid among them ſelues, VVhither vvil this man goe, that vve ſhal not finde him? VVil he goe into the diſperſion of the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
label: John

text: VVhat is this ſaying that he hath ſaid, You ſhal ſeeke me, and ſhal not finde: And vvhere I am, you can not come.
label: John

text: And in the laſt, the great day of the feſtiuitie IESVS ſtoode, and cried, ſaying, If any man thirſt, let him come to me, and drinke.
label: John

text: He that beleeueth in me, as the ſcripture ſaith, Out of his belly ſhal flovv riuers of liuing vvater.
label: John

text: (And this he ſaid of the Spirit that they ſhould receiue vvhich beleeued in him. ⊢ for as yet the Spirit vvas not giuen: becauſe IESVS vvas not yet glorified.)
label: John

text: Of that multitude therfore, vvhen they had heard theſe wordes of his, ſome ſaid, This is the Prophet in deede.
label: John

text: others ſaid, This is CHRIST. But certaine ſaid, VVhy, doth CHRIST come from Galilee?
label: John

text: Doth not the ſcripture ſay, that of the ſeede of Dauid, and from Bethlehem the tovvne vvhere Dauid vvas, CHRIST doth come?
label: John

text: Therfore there aroſe diſſenſion in the multitude for him.
label: John

text: And certaine of them vvould haue apprehended him: but no man laid handes vpon him.
label: John

text: The miniſters therfore came to the cheefe prieſts and the Phariſees. And they ſaid to them, VVhy haue you not brought him?
label: John

text: The miniſters anſvvered, Neuer did there man ſo ſpeake, as this man.
label: John

text: The Phariſees therfore anſvvered them, VVhy, are you alſo ſeduced?
label: John

text: Hath any of the Princes beleeued in him, or of the Phariſees?
label: John

text: but this multitude that knovveth not the lavv, are accurſed.
label: John

text: Nicodemus ſaid to them, he that came to him by night, who vvas one of them,
label: John

text: Doth our lavv iudge a man, vnles it firſt heare him, and knovv vvhat he doeth?
label: John

text: They anſvvered, and ſaid to him, VVhy, art thou alſo a Galilaean? Search, and ſee that from Galilee a Prophet riſeth not.
label: John

text: And euery man returned to his houſe.
label: John

text: AND IESVS vvent into the Mount-oliuet:
label: John

text: and early in the morning againe he came into the temple, and the people came to him, and ſitting he taught them.
label: John

text: And the Scribes and Phariſees bring a vvoman taken in aduoutrie: and they did ſet her in the middes,
label: John

text: and ſaid to him, Maiſter, this woman vvas euen novv taken in aduoutrie.
label: John

text: And in the lavv Moyſes commaunded vs to ſtone ſuch. What ſaieſt thou therfore?
label: John

text: And this they ſaid tempting him: that they might accuſe him. But IESVS bovving him ſelf dovvne, vvith his finger vvrote in the earth.
label: John

text: VVhen they therfore continued aſking him: he lifted vp him ſelf, and ſaid to them, He that is vvithout ſinne of you, let him firſt throvv the ſtone at her.
label: John

text: And againe bovving him ſelf, he vvrote in the earth.
label: John

text: And they hearing, went out one by one, beginning at the ſeniours: and IESVS alone remained, and the vvoman ſtanding in the middes.
label: John

text: And IESVS lifting vp him ſelf, ſaid to her, VVoman, vvhere are they that accuſed thee? hath no man condemned thee?
label: John

text: VVho ſaid, No man, Lord. And IESVS ſaid, Neither vvil I condemne thee. Goe, and novv ſinne no more. ⊢
label: John

text: b Againe therfore IESVS ſpake to them, ſaying, I am the light of the vvorld. he that folovveth me, vvalketh not in darkeneſſe: but ſhal haue the light of life.
label: John

text: The Phariſees therfore ſaid to him, Thou giueſt teſtimonie of thy ſelf: thy teſtimonie is not true.
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, and ſaid to them, Although I doe giue teſtimonie of my ſelf, my teſtimonie is true: becauſe I knovv vvhence I came, & vvhither I goe: but you knovv not whence I come, or whither I goe.
label: John

text: You iudge according to the fleſh: I doe not iudge any man.
label: John

text: And if I doe iudge, my iudgement is true: becauſe I am not alone, but I and he that ſent me, the Father.
label: John

text: And in your lavv it is vvritten, that the teſtimonie of tvvo men is true.
label: John

text: I am he that giue teſtimonie of my ſelf: and he that ſent me, the Father, giueth teſtimonie of me.
label: John

text: They ſaid therfore to him, VVhere is thy father? IESVS anſvvered, Neither me doe you knovv, nor my Father. If you did knovv me: perhaps you might knovv my Father alſo.
label: John

text: Theſe vvordes IESVS ſpake in the Treaſurie, teaching in the temple: and no man apprehended him, becauſe his houre vvas not yet come. ⊢
label: John

text: Againe therfore IESVS ſaid to them, I goe, and you ſhal ſeeke me, and ſhal die in your ſinne. VVhither I goe, you can not come.
label: John

text: The Iewes therfore ſaid, VVhy, vvil he kil him ſelf, becauſe he ſaith, Vvhither I goe, you can not come?
label: John

text: And he ſaid to them, You are from beneath, I am from aboue. you are of this vvorld, I am not of this vvorld.
label: John

text: Therfore I ſaid to you that you ſhal die in your ſinnes. for if you beleeue not that I am he, you ſhal die in your ſinne.
label: John

text: They ſaid therfore to him, VVho art thou? IESVS ſaid to them, The beginning vvho alſo ſpeake to you.
label: John

text: Many things I haue to ſpeake and iudge of you. but he that ſent me, is true: and vvhat I haue heard of him, theſe things I ſpeake in the vvorld.
label: John

text: And they knevv not that he ſaid to them that his father vvas God.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaid to them, VVhen you ſhal haue exalted the ſonne of man, then you ſhal know that I am he, and of my ſelf I doe nothing, but as the Father hath taught me, theſe things I ſpeake:
label: John

text: and he that ſent me, is vvith me: and he hath not left me alone, becauſe the things that pleaſe him I doe alvvaies. ⊢
label: John

text: Vvhen he ſpake theſe things, many beleeued in him.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaid to them that beleeued him, the Ievves: If you abide in my vvorde, you ſhal be my diſciples in deede.
label: John

text: And you ſhal knovv the truth, and the truth ſhal make you free.
label: John

text: They anſvvered him, VVe are the ſeed of Abraham, and vve neuer ſerued any man: hovv ſaieſt thou, You ſhal be free?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered them, Amen, amen I ſay to you, that euery one vvhich committeth ſinne, is the ſeruant of ſinne.
label: John

text: and the ſeruant abideth not in the houſe for euer: the ſonne abideth for euer.
label: John

text: If therfore the ſonne make you free, you ſhal be free in deede.
label: John

text: I know that you are the children of Abraham: but you ſeeke to kil me, becauſe my vvorde taketh not in you.
label: John

text: I ſpeake that vvhich I haue ſeen vvith my father: and you doe the things that you haue ſeen vvith your father.
label: John

text: They anſvvered, and ſaid to him, Our father is Abraham. IESVS ſaith to them, If you be the children of Abraham, doe the vvorkes of Abraham.
label: John

text: But novv, you ſeeke to kil me, a man that haue ſpoken the truth to you, vvhich I haue heard of God. this did not Abraham.
label: John

text: You doe the vvorkes of your father. They ſaid therfore to him, VVe vvere not borne of fornication. vve haue one father, God.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaid to them, If God vvere your father: verely you vvould loue me. for from God I proceded, and came: for I came not of my ſelf, but he ſent me:
label: John

text: VVhy doe you not knovv my ſpeach? Becauſe you can not heare my vvord.
label: John

text: You are of your father the Diuel, and the deſires of your father you vvil doe. he vvas a mankiller from the beginning, and he ſtoode not in the veritie: becauſe veritie is not in him. vvhen he ſpeaketh a lie, he ſpeaketh of his owne, becauſe he is a lyer, and the father thereof.
label: John

text: But becauſe I ſay the veritie, you beleeue me not.
label: John

text: VVhich of you ſhal argue me of ſinne? If I ſay the veritie: why doe you not beleeue me?
label: John

text: He that is of God, heareth the vvordes of God. Therfore you heare not, becauſe you are not of God.
label: John

text: The Iewes therfore anſvvered, and ſaid to him, Doe not we ſay vvel that thou art a Samaritane, and haſt a diuil?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, I haue no deuil: but I doe honour my Father, and you haue diſhonoured me.
label: John

text: but I ſeeke not mine ovvne glorie. there is that ſeeketh and iudgeth.
label: John

text: Amen, amen I ſay to you, If any man keepe my vvord, he ſhal not ſee death for euer.
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore ſaid, Now vve haue knovven that thou haſt a deuil. Abraham is dead, and the Prophets: and thou ſaieſt, If any man keepe my vvord, he ſhal not taſt death for euer.
label: John

text: VVhy, art thou greater then our father Abraham, vvho is dead? and the Prophets are dead. VVhom doeſt thou make thy ſelf?
label: John

text: IESVS anſwered, If I doe glorifie my ſelf, my glorie is nothing. it is my father that glorifieth me, vvhom you ſay that he is your God.
label: John

text: And you haue not knovven him, but I knovv him. And if I ſhal ſay that I knovv him not: I ſhal be like to you, a lyer. But I doe knovv him, and doe keepe his vvord.
label: John

text: Abraham your father reioyced that he might ſee my day: and he ſavv, and vvas glad.
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore ſaid to him, Thou haſt not yet fiftie yeres, and haſt thou ſeen Abraham?
label: John

text: IESVS ſaid to them, Amen, amen I ſay to you, before that Abraham vvas made, I am.
label: John

text: They tooke ſtones therfore to caſt at him. but IESVS hid him ſelf, and vvent out of the temple. ⊢
label: John

text: AND IESVS paſſing by, ſavv a man blinde from his natiuitie:
label: John

text: and his diſciples aſked him, Rabbi, vvho hath ſinned, this man, or his parents, that he ſhould be borne blinde?
label: John

text: Neither hath this man ſinned, nor his parents: but that the vvorkes of God may be manifeſted in him.
label: John

text: I muſt vvorke the vvorkes of him that ſent me, vvhiles it is day. The night commeth, vvhen no man can vvorke.
label: John

text: As long as I am in the vvorld, I am the light of the vvorld.
label: John

text: When he had ſaid theſe things, he ſpit on the ground, and made clay of the ſpettle, and ſpred the clay vpon his eies,
label: John

text: and ſaid to him, Goe, c vvaſh in the poole of Siloé, vvhich is interpreted, Sent. He vvent therfore, and vvaſhed: and he came ſeeing.
label: John

text: Therfore the neighbours, and they vvhich had ſeen him before, that he vvas a begger, ſaid, Is not this he that ſate, and begged? Others ſaid, That this is he.
label: John

text: But others, No, not ſo, but he is like him. But he ſaid, That I am he.
label: John

text: They ſaid therfore to him, Hovv vvere thine eies opened?
label: John

text: He anſwered, That man that is called IESVS, made clay: and anointed mine eies, and ſaid to me, Goe to the poole of Siloé, and waſh. And I vvent, and vvaſhed, and ſavv.
label: John

text: And they ſaid to him, VVhere is he? He ſaith, I know not.
label: John

text: They bring him that had been blinde, to the Phariſees.
label: John

text: And it vvas the Sabboth vvhen IESVS made the clay, and opened his eies.
label: John

text: Againe therfore the Phariſees aſked him, hovv he ſavv. But he ſaid to them, He put clay vpon mine eies, & I vvaſhed: and I ſee.
label: John

text: Certaine therfore of the Phariſees ſaid, This man is not of God, that keepeth not the Sabboth. But others ſaid, Hovv can a man that is a ſinner doe theſe ſignes? And there vvas a ſchiſme among them.
label: John

text: They ſay therfore to the blinde againe, Thou, vvhat ſaieſt thou of him that opened thine eies? And he ſaid, That he is a Prophet.
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore did not beleeue of him, that he had been blinde and ſavv: vntil they called the parents of him that ſavv,
label: John

text: and aſked them, ſaying, Is this your ſonne, vvhom you ſay that he vvas borne blinde? hovv then doeth he now ſee?
label: John

text: His parents anſvvered them, and ſaid, VVe knovv that this is our ſonne, and that he vvas borne blinde:
label: John

text: but hovv he novv ſeeth, vve knovv not, or vvho hath opened his eies, vve knovv not, aſke him ſelf: he is of age, let him ſelf ſpeake of him ſelf.
label: John

text: Theſe things his parents ſaid, becauſe they feared the Ievves. for the Ievves had novv conſpired, that if any man ſhould confeſſe him to be CHRIST, he ſhould be put out of the Synagogue.
label: John

text: Therfore did his parents ſay, That he is of age, aſke him ſelf.
label: John

text: They therfore againe called the man that had been blinde, and ſaid to him, Giue glorie to God. vve knovv that this man is a ſinner.
label: John

text: He therfore ſaid to them, Whether he be a ſinner, I know not: one thing I know, that vvhereas I vvas blinde, novv I ſee.
label: John

text: They ſaid therfore to him, VVhat did he to thee? hovv did he open thine eies?
label: John

text: He anſvvered them, I haue novv told you, and you haue heard: vvhy vvil you heare it againe? vvil you alſo become his diſciples?
label: John

text: They reuiled him therfore, & ſaid, Be thou his diſciple: but we are the diſciples of Moyſes.
label: John

text: VVe know that to Moyſes God did ſpeake: but this man vve knovv not vvhence he is.
label: John

text: The man anſvvered and ſaid to them, For in this it is marueilous that you knovv not vvhence he is, and he hath opened mine eies.
label: John

text: and vve know that ſinners God doth not heare. but if a man be a ſeruer of God, and doe the vvil of him, him he heareth.
label: John

text: From the beginning of the vvorld it hath not been heard that any man hath opened the eies of one borne blinde.
label: John

text: Vnles this man vvere of God, he could not doe any thing.
label: John

text: They anſvvered, and ſaid to him, Thou waſt wholy borne in ſinnes, and doeſt thou teach vs? And they did caſt him forth.
label: John

text: IESVS heard that they caſt him forth: and vvhen he had found him, he ſaid to him, Doeſt thou beleeue in the ſonne of God?
label: John

text: He anſvvered, and ſaid, VVho is he Lord, that I may beleeue in him?
label: John

text: And IESVS ſaid to him, Both thou haſt ſeen him: and he that talketh vvith thee, he it is.
label: John

text: But he ſaid, I beleeue Lord. And falling dovvne he adored him. ⊢
label: John

text: And IESVS ſaid to him, For iudgement came I into this vvorld: that they that ſee not, may ſee: and they that ſee, may become blinde.
label: John

text: And certaine of the Phariſees that vvere vvith him, heard: and they ſaid to him, VVhy, are vve alſo blinde?
label: John

text: IESVS ſaid to them, If you vvere blinde, you ſhould not haue ſinne. but novv you ſay, That vve ſee. Your ſinne remaineth.
label: John

text: AMEN, amen I ſay to you, he that entreth not by the doore into the folde of the ſheepe, but climeth vp an other vvay: he is a theefe and a robber.
label: John

text: But he that entreth by the doore, is the Paſtor of the ſheepe.
label: John

text: To this man the porter openeth: & the ſheepe heare his voice: and he calleth his ovvne ſheepe by name, and leadeth them forth.
label: John

text: And vvhen he hath let forth his ovvne ſheepe, he goeth before them: and the ſheepe folovv him, becauſe they knovv his voice.
label: John

text: But a ſtranger they folovv not, but flee from him: becauſe they knovv not the voice of ſtrangers.
label: John

text: This prouerbe IESVS ſaid to them. But they knew not vvhat he ſpake to them.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaid to them againe, Amen, amen I ſay to you, that I am the doore of the ſheepe.
label: John

text: And hovv many ſoeuer haue come, are theeues and robbers: but the ſheepe heard them not.
label: John

text: I am the doore. By me if any enter, he ſhal be ſaued: and he ſhal goe in and ſhal goe out, and ſhal finde paſtures.
label: John

text: The theefe commeth not but to ſteale and kil and deſtroy. I came that they may haue life, and may haue more aboundantly. ⊢
label: John

text: I am the good Paſtor. The good Paſtor giueth his life for his ſheepe.
label: John

text: But the hireling and he that is not the Paſtor, vvhoſe ovvne the ſheepe are not, ſeeth the vvoulfe comming, and leaueth the ſheepe, and fleeth: and the vvoulfe raueneth, and diſperſeth the ſheepe.
label: John

text: And the hireling fleeth becauſe he is a hireling: and he hath no care of the ſheepe.
label: John

text: I am the good Paſtor: and I knovv mine, and mine knovv me.
label: John

text: As the Father knovveth me, and I knovv the Father: and I yeld my life for my ſheepe.
label: John

text: And c other ſheepe I haue that are not of this folde: them alſo I muſt bring, and they ſhal heare my voice, and there ſhal be made one folde and one Paſtor. ⊢
label: John

text: Therfore the Father loueth me: becauſe I yeld my life, that I may take it againe.
label: John

text: No man taketh it avvay from me: but I yeld it of my ſelf. and I haue povver to yeld it: and I haue povver to take it againe. This commaundement I receiued of my father.
label: John

text: A diſſenſion roſe againe among the Ievves for theſe vvordes.
label: John

text: And many of them ſaid, He hath a deuil and is mad: vvhy heare you him?
label: John

text: Others ſaid, Theſe are not the vvordes of one that hath a deuil. can a deuil open the eies of blinde men?
label: John

text: And the Dedication vvas in Hieruſalem: and it vvas vvinter.
label: John

text: And IESVS vvalked in the temple, in Salomons porche.
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore compaſſed him round about, and ſaid to him, Hovv long doeſt thou hold our ſoule in ſuſpenſe? if thou be CHRIST, tel vs openly.
label: John

text: IESVS anſwered them, I ſpeake to you: and you beleeue not. the vvorkes that I doe in the name of my Father, they giue teſtimonie of me.
label: John

text: but you doe not beleeue, becauſe you are not of my ſheepe.
label: John

text: My ſheepe heare my voice: and I knovv them, and they folovv me.
label: John

text: And I giue them life euerlaſting: and they ſhal not periſh for euer, and no man ſhal plucke them out of my hand.
label: John

text: My father, that vvhich he hath giuen me, is greater then al: and no man can plucke them out of the hand of my father.
label: John

text: I and the Father are c one.
label: John

text: The Ievves tooke vp ſtones, to ſtone him.
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered them, Many good vvorkes I haue ſhewed you from my father, for vvhich of thoſe vvorkes doe you ſtone me?
label: John

text: The Iewes anſvvered him, For a good vvorke we ſtone the not, but for blaſphemie, and becauſe thou being a man, makeſt thy ſelf God.
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered them, Is it not vvritten in your lavv, that I ſaid, you are goddes?
label: John

text: If he called them goddes, to vvhom the vvord of God vvas made, and the ſcripture can not be broken:
label: John

text: vvhom the Father hath ſanctified and ſent into the vvorld, ſay you, That thou blaſphemeſt, becauſe I ſaid I am the ſonne of God?
label: John

text: If I doe not the vvorkes of my father, beleeue me not.
label: John

text: But if I doe, and if you vvil not beleeue me, beleeue the vvorkes: that you may knovv and beleeue that the Father is in me, and I in the Father. ⊢
label: John

text: They ſought therfore to apprehend him: and he vvent forth out of their handes.
label: John

text: and he vvent againe beyond Iordan into that place vvhere Iohn vvas baptizing firſt: and he taried there.
label: John

text: and many came to him. and they ſaid, That Iohn in deede did no ſigne. But al things vvhatſoeuer Iohn ſaid of this man, vvere true.
label: John

text: And many beleeued in him.
label: John

text: AND there vvas a certaine ſicke man, Lazarus of Bethánia, of the tovvne of Marie and Martha her ſiſter.
label: John

text: (And Marie vvas ſhe that anointed our Lord vvith ointement, and vviped his feete vvith her heare: vvhoſe brother Lazarus vvas ſicke.)
label: John

text: His ſiſters therfore ſent to him ſaying, Lord, behold, he vvhom thou loueſt, is ſicke.
label: John

text: And IESVS hearing, ſaid to them, This ſickneſſe is not to death, but for the glorie of God: that the ſonne of God may be glorified by it.
label: John

text: And IESVS loued Martha, and her ſiſter Marie, and Lazarus.
label: John

text: As he heard therfore that he vvas ſicke, then he taried in the ſame place tvvo daies:
label: John

text: then after this he ſaith to his Diſciples, Let vs goe into Ievvrie againe.
label: John

text: The Diſciples ſay to him, Rabbi, novv the Ievves ſought to ſtone thee: and goeſt thou thither againe?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, Are there not tvvelue houres of the day? If a man vvalke in the day, he ſtumbleth not: becauſe he ſeeth the light of this world:
label: John

text: but if he walke in the night, he ſtumbleth, becauſe the light is not in him.
label: John

text: Theſe things he ſaid: and after this he ſaith to them, Lazarus our frende ſleepeth: but I goe that I may raiſe him from ſleepe.
label: John

text: His Diſciples therfore ſaid, Lord, if he ſleepe, he ſhal be ſafe.
label: John

text: but IESVS ſpake of his death: & they thought that he ſpake c of the ſleeping of ſleepe.
label: John

text: Then therfore IESVS ſaid to them plainely, Lazarus is dead:
label: John

text: and I am glad for your ſake, that you may beleeue, becauſe I vvas not there. but let vs goe to him.
label: John

text: Thomas therfore, vvho is called Didymus, ſaid to his condiſciples, Let vs alſo goe, to die vvith him.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore came, and found him novv hauing been foure daies in the graue.
label: John

text: (and Bethánia vvas nigh to Hieruſalem about fiftene furlonges.)
