label: John

text: And many of the Ievves vvere come to Martha and Marie, to comfort them concerning theire brother.
label: John

text: Martha therfore vvhen ſhe heard that IESVS vvas come, vvent to meete him: but Marie ſat at home.
label: John

text: Martha therfore ſaid to IESVS, Lord if thou hadſt been here, my brother had not died.
label: John

text: but novv alſo I knovv that vvhat things ſoeuer thou ſhalt aſke of God, God vvil giue thee.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to her, Thy brother ſhal riſe againe.
label: John

text: Martha ſaith to him, I know that he ſhal riſe againe in the reſurrection, in the laſt day.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaid to her, I am the reſurrection and the life: he that beleeueth in me, although he be dead, ſhal liue.
label: John

text: and euery one that liueth, and beleeueth in me, ſhal not die for euer, Beleeueſt thou this?
label: John

text: She ſaith to him, Yea Lord, I haue beleeued that thou art CHRIST the ſonne of God that art come into this vvorld. ⊢
label: John

text: And vvhen ſhe had ſaid theſe things, ſhe went, and called Marie her ſiſter ſecretely, ſaying, The maiſter is come, & calleth thee.
label: John

text: She, when ſhe heard, riſeth quickely, & commeth to him.
label: John

text: For IESVS was not yet come into the towne: but he vvas yet in that place vvhere Martha had mette him.
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore that vvere vvith her in the houſe and did comfort her, vvhen they ſavv Marie that ſhe roſe quickly and vvent forth, folovved her, ſaying, That ſhe goeth to the graue, to vveepe there.
label: John

text: Marie therfore vvhen ſhe vvas come vvhere IESVS vvas, ſeeing him, fel at his feete, and ſaith to him, Lord, if thou hadſt been here, my brother had not died.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore vvhen he ſavv her vveeping, and the Ievves that vvere come vvith her, vveeping, he groned in ſpirit, and troubled him ſelf,
label: John

text: and ſaid, VVhere haue you laid him? They ſay to him, Lord, come and ſee.
label: John

text: And IESVS vvept.
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore ſaid, Behold hovv he loued him.
label: John

text: But certaine of them ſaid, Could not he that opened the eies of the blinde man, make that this man ſhould not die?
label: John

text: IESVS therfore againe groning in him ſelf, commeth to the graue. and it vvas a caue: and a ſtone vvas laid ouer it.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith, Take avvay the ſtone. Martha the ſiſter of him that vvas dead, ſaith to him, Lord, novv he ſtinketh, for he is novv of foure daies.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to her, Did not I ſay to thee, that if thou beleeue, thou ſhalt ſee the glorie of God?
label: John

text: They tooke therfore the ſtone avvay. And IESVS lifting his eies vpvvard, ſaid, Father, I giue thee thankes that thou haſt heard me.
label: John

text: and I did know that thou doeſt alvvaies heare me, but for the people that ſtandeth about, haue I ſaid it, that they may beleeue that thou haſt ſent me.
label: John

text: VVhen he had ſaid theſe things, he cried vvith a loude voice, Lazarus, come forth.
label: John

text: And forthvvith he came forth that had been dead, bound feete and handes vvith vvinding bandes, and his face vvas tied vvith a napkin. IESVS ſaid to them, Looſe him, and let him goe.
label: John

text: Many therfore of the Ievves that vvere come to Marie and Martha, and had ſeen the things that IESVS did, beleeued in him. ⊢
label: John

text: And certaine of them vvent to the Phariſees, and told them the things that IESVS did.
label: John

text: The cheefe prieſts therfore and the phariſees gathered a councel, and ſaid, VVhat doe vve, for this man doeth many ſignes.
label: John

text: If vve let him alone ſo, al vvil beleeue in him: and the Romanes vvil come, and take avvay our place and nation.
label: John

text: But one of them named Caiphas, being the high prieſt of that yere, ſaid to them, You knovv nothing,
label: John

text: neither doe you conſider that it is expedient for vs that one man die for the people, and the vvhole nation periſh not.
label: John

text: And this he ſaid not of him ſelf: but being the high prieſt of that yere, he prophecied that IESVS ſhould die for the nation:
label: John

text: and not only for the nation, but to gather into one the children of God that vvere diſperſed.
label: John

text: From that day therfore they deuiſed to kil him.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore vvalked no more openly among the Ievves, but he vvent into the countrie beſide the deſert vnto a citie that is called Ephrem, and there he abode vvith his Diſciples. ⊢
label: John

text: And the Paſche of the Ievves vvas at hand: and many of the countrie vvent vp to Hieruſalem before the Paſche to ſanctifie them ſelues.
label: John

text: They ſought IESVS therfore: and they communed one vvith an other, ſtanding in the temple, VVhat thinke you, in that he is not come to the feſtiual day? And the cheefe Prieſts & Phariſees had giuen commaundement, that if any man ſhould knovv vvhere he vvas, he ſhould tel, that they might apprehend him.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſixe daies before the Paſche came to Bethánia, vvhere Lazarus vvas, that had been dead, vvhom IESVS raiſed.
label: John

text: And they made him a ſupper there: and Martha miniſtred, but Lazarus vvas one of them that ſate at the table vvith him.
label: John

text: Marie therfore tooke a pownd of ointement of right ſpikenard, pretious, and anointed the feete of IESVS, and vviped his feete vvith her heare: and the houſe vvas filled of the odour of the ointment.
label: John

text: One therfore of his diſciples, Iudas Iſcariote, he that vvas to betray him, ſaid,
label: John

text: VVhy vvas not this ointment ſold for three-hundred pence, and giuen to the poore?
label: John

text: And he ſaid this, not becauſe he cared for the poore: but becauſe he vvas a theefe, and hauing the purſe, caried the things that vvere put in.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaid, Let her alone that ſhe may keepe it for the day of my burial.
label: John

text: For the poore you haue alvvaies vvith you: but me you ſhal not haue alwaies.
label: John

text: A great multitude therfore of the Ievves knevv that he vvas there: and they came, not for IESVS only, but that they might ſee Lazarus, vvhom he raiſed from the dead. ⊢
label: John

text: But the cheefe Prieſts deuiſed for to kil Lazarus alſo:
label: John

text: becauſe many for him of the Ievves vvent avvay, and beleeued in IESVS.
label: John

text: And on the morow a great multitude that vvas come to the feſtiual day, vvhen they had heard that IESVS commeth to Hieruſalem:
label: John

text: they tooke the boughes of palmes, and vvent forth to meete him, and cried, Hoſanna, bleſſed is he that commeth in the name of our Lord, the king of Iſrael.
label: John

text: And IESVS found a yong aſſe, and ſate vpon it, as it is vvritten,
label: John

text: Feare not daughter of Sion: behold, thy king commeth ſitting vpon an aſſes colt.
label: John

text: Theſe things his diſciples did not knovv at the firſt: but vvhen IESVS vvas glorified, then they remembred that theſe things had been vvritten of him, and theſe things they did to him.
label: John

text: The multitude therfore gaue teſtimonie, vvhich vvas vvith him when he called Lazarus out of the graue, and raiſed him from the dead.
label: John

text: For therfore alſo the multitude came to meete him, becauſe they heard that he had done this ſigne.
label: John

text: The Phariſees therfore ſaid among them ſelues, Doe you ſee that vve preuaile nothing? behold, the vvhole vvorld is gone after him.
label: John

text: And there vvere certaine Gentiles of them that came vp to adore in the feſtiual day.
label: John

text: Theſe therfore came to Philippe vvho vvas of Bethſaida of Galilee, and deſired him, ſaying, Sir, vve are deſirous to ſee IESVS.
label: John

text: Philippe commeth, and telleth Andrevv. Againe Andrevv & Philippe told IESVS.
label: John

text: But IESVS anſvvered them, ſaying, The houre is come, that the Sonne of man ſhal be glorified.
label: John

text: b Amen, amen I ſay to you, vnles the graine of vvheate falling into the ground, die: it ſelf remaineth alone. but if it die, it bringeth much fruite.
label: John

text: He that loueth his life, ſhal loſe it: and he that hateth his life in this vvorld, doth keepe it to life euerlaſting.
label: John

text: If any man miniſter to me, let him folovv me: and vvhere I am, there alſo ſhal my miniſter be. If any man miniſter to me, my father vvil honour him. ⊢
label: John

text: Novv my ſoule is troubled. And vvhat ſhal I ſay? Father, ſaue me from this houre. But therfore came I into this houre.
label: John

text: Father, glorifie thy name. A voice therfore came from heauen, Both I haue glorified it, and againe I vvil glorifie it.
label: John

text: The multitude therfore that ſtoode and had heard, ſaid that it thundered. Others ſaid, An Angel ſpake to him.
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, and ſaid, This voice came not for me, but for your ſake.
label: John

text: Novv is the iudgement of the vvorld: novv the Prince of this vvorld ſhal be caſt forth.
label: John

text: And I, if I be exalted from the earth, vvil dravv al things to my ſelf.
label: John

text: (and this he ſaid, ſignifying vvhat death he ſhould die.)
label: John

text: The multitude anſvvered him, VVe haue heard out of the lavv, that CHRIST abideth for euer: and hovv ſaieſt thou, The Sonne of man muſt be exalted? VVho is this Sonne of man?
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaid to them, Yet a litle vvhile, the light is among you. VValke vvhiles you haue the light, that the darkeneſſe ouertake you not. And he that vvalketh in darkeneſſe, knovveth not vvhither he goeth.
label: John

text: VVhiles you haue the light, beleeue in the light, that you may be the children of light. ⊢ Theſe things IESVS ſpake and he vvent avvay, and hid him ſelf from them. ⊢
label: John

text: And vvhereas he had done ſo many ſignes before them, they beleeued not in him:
label: John

text: that the ſaying of Eſay the Prophet might be fulfilled, vvhich he ſaid, Lord, vvho hath beleeued the hearing of vs? and the arme of our Lord to whom hath it bene reuealed?
label: John

text: Therfore they could not beleeue, becauſe Eſay ſaid againe,
label: John

text: He hath blinded their eies, and indurated their hart: that they may not ſee vvith their eies, nor vnderſtand vvith their hart, and be conuerted, and I heale them.
label: John

text: Theſe things ſaid Eſaie, vvhen he ſavv his glorie, and ſpake of him.
label: John

text: But yet of the Princes alſo many beleeued in him: but for the Phariſees they did not confeſſe, that they might not be caſt out of the Synagogue.
label: John

text: for they loued the glorie of men more, then the glorie of God.
label: John

text: But IESVS cried, and ſaid, He that beleeueth in me, doth not beleeue in me, but in him that ſent me.
label: John

text: And he that ſeeth me, ſeeth him that ſent me.
label: John

text: I a light am come into this vvorld: that euery one vvhich beleeueth in me, may not remaine in the darkeneſſe.
label: John

text: And if any man heare my vvordes, and keepe them not: I doe not iudge him. for I came not to iudge the vvorld, but to ſaue the vvorld.
label: John

text: He that deſpiſeth me, & receiueth not my vvordes, hath that iudgeth him. the vvord that I haue ſpoken, that ſhal iudge him in the laſt day.
label: John

text: Becauſe of my ſelf I haue not ſpoken, but the Father that ſent me, he gaue me commaundement vvhat I ſhould ſay, and what I ſhould ſpeake.
label: John

text: And I knovv that his commaundement is life euerlaſting. The things therfore that I ſpeake: as the Father ſaid to me, ſo doe I ſpeake.
label: John

text: AND before the feſtiual day of Paſche, IESVS knovving that his houre was come that he ſhould paſſe out of this vvorld to his Father: vvhereas he had loued his that vvere in the vvorld, vnto the end he loued them.
label: John

text: And vvhen ſupper vvas done, vvhereas the deuil novv had put into the hart of Iudas Iſcariote the ſonne of Simon, to betray him:
label: John

text: knovving that the Father gaue him al things into his handes, and that he came from God, and goeth to God:
label: John

text: he riſeth from ſupper, and laieth aſide his garments, and hauing taken a tovvel, girded him ſelf.
label: John

text: After that, he put vvater into a baſon, and began to vvaſh the feete of the diſciples, and to vvipe them vvith the tovvel vvherevvith he vvas girded.
label: John

text: He commeth therfore to Simon Peter. And Peter ſaith to him, Lord, doeſt thou vvaſh my feete?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered and ſaid to him, That vvhich I doe, thou knovveſt not novv, hereafter thou ſhalt knovv.
label: John

text: Peter ſaith to him, Thou ſhalt not waſh my feete for euer. IESVS anſvvered him, If I vvaſh thee not, thou ſhalt not haue part vvith me.
label: John

text: Simon Peter ſaith to him, Lord, not only my feete, but alſo handes, and head.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to him, He that is vvaſhed, nedeeth not but to waſh his feete, but is cleane vvholy. And you are cleane, but not al.
label: John

text: For he knevv vvho he vvas that vvould betray him. therfore he ſaid, You are not cleane al.
label: John

text: Therfore, after he had vvaſhed their feete, and taken his garments, being ſet dovvne, againe he ſaid to them, Knovv you what I haue done to you?
label: John

text: You cal me, Maiſter, and Lord: and you ſay vvel, for I am ſo.
label: John

text: If then I haue waſhed your feete, Lord and Maiſter, you alſo ought to waſh one an others feete.
label: John

text: For I haue giuen you an example, that as I haue done to you, ſo you doe alſo. ⊢
label: John

text: Amen, amen I ſay to you, a ſeruant is not greater then his lord, neither is an apoſtle greater then he that ſent him.
label: John

text: If you know theſe things, you ſhal be bleſſed if you doe them.
label: John

text: I ſpeake not of you al: I knovv vvhom I haue choſen. But that the ſcripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread vvith me, ſhal lift vp his heele againſt me.
label: John

text: From this time I tel you, before it come to paſſe: that vvhen it ſhal come to paſſe, you may beleeue, that I am he.
label: John

text: Amen, amen, I ſay to you, he that receiueth any that I ſend, receiueth me: & he that receiueth me, receiueth him that ſent me.
label: John

text: When IESVS had ſaid theſe things, he vvas troubled in ſpirit: and he proteſted, and ſaid: Amen, amen I ſay to you: that one of you ſhal betray me.
label: John

text: The diſciples therfore looked one vpon an other, doubting of whom he ſpake.
label: John

text: There vvas therfore one of his diſciples leaning in the boſome of IESVS, he whom IESVS loued.
label: John

text: Therfore Simon Peter beckeneth to him, and ſaid to him, who is it of whom he ſpeaketh?
label: John

text: He therfore leaning vpon the breaſt of IESVS, ſaith to him, Lord, vvho is he?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered: He it is to whom I ſhal reach the dipped bread. And vvhen he had dipped the bread, he gaue it to Iudas Iſcariote Simons ſonne.
label: John

text: And after the morſel, then Satan entred into him. And IESVS ſaith to him, That vvhich thou doeſt, doe it quickely.
label: John

text: But no man knevv of thoſe that ſate at table to vvhat purpoſe he ſaid this vnto him.
label: John

text: For certaine thought, becauſe Iudas had the purſe, that IESVS had ſaid to him, Bie thoſe things vvhich are needeful for vs to the feſtiual day: or that he ſhould giue ſome thing to the poore.
label: John

text: He therfore hauing receiued the morſel, incontinent vvent forth. And it vvas night.
label: John

text: VVhen he therfore vvas gone forth, IESVS ſaid, Novv the Sonne of man is glorified, and God is glorified in him.
label: John

text: If God be glorified in him, God alſo vvil glorifie him in him ſelf, and incontinent vvil he glorifie him.
label: John

text: Litle children, yet a litle vvhile I am vvith you. You ſhal ſeeke me, & as I ſaid to the Ievves, VVhither I goe, you can not come: to you alſo I ſay novv.
label: John

text: A nevv commaundement I giue to you, That you loue one an other: as I haue loued you, that you alſo loue one an other.
label: John

text: In this al men ſhal knovv that you are my diſciples, if you haue loue one to an other.
label: John

text: Simon Peter ſaith to him, Lord, vvhither goeſt thou? IESVS anſvvered, vvhither I goe, thou canſt not novv folovv me, but hereafter thou ſhalt folow.
label: John

text: Peter ſaith to him, VVhy can not I folow thee novv? I vvil yeld my life for thee.
label: John

text: IESVS anſwered him, Thy life wilt thou yeld for me? Amen, amen I ſay to thee, the cocke ſhal not crovv, vntil thou denie me thriſe.
label: John

text: LET not your hart be troubled. You beleeue in God, beleeue in me alſo.
label: John

text: In my fathers houſe there be many manſions. If not, I vvould haue told you, Becauſe I goe to prepare you a place.
label: John

text: And if I goe, and prepare you a place: I come againe and vvil take you to my ſelf, that vvhere I am, you alſo may be.
label: John

text: And vvhither I goe you knovv, and the vvay you knovv.
label: John

text: Thomas ſaith to him, Lord, vve knovv not vvhither thou goeſt: and hovv can vve knovv the vvay?
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to him, I am the vvay, and the veritie, and the life. no man commeth to the Father, but by me.
label: John

text: If you had knovven me, my father alſo certes you had knovven: and from hence forth you ‘ſhal know’ him, and you haue ſeen him.
label: John

text: Philippe ſaith to him, Lord ſhevv vs the Father, and it ſufficeth vs.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to him, So long time I am vvith you: & haue you not knowen me? Philippe, he that ſeeth me, ſeeth the Father alſo. Hovv ſaieſt thou, Shevv vs the father?
label: John

text: Doeſt thou not beleeue that I am in the Father, & the Father in me? The vvordes that I ſpeake to you, of my ſelf I ſpeake not. But my father that abideth in me, he doeth the vvorkes.
label: John

text: Beleeue you not, that I am in the Father and the Father in me? Otherwiſe for the vvorkes them ſelues beleeue.
label: John

text: Amen, amen I ſay to you, he that beleeueth in me, the vvorkes that I doe, he alſo ſhal doe, and greater then theſe ſhal he doe,
label: John

text: becauſe I goe to the Father, and vvhatſoeuer you ſhal aſke in my name, that wil I doe: ⊢ that the Father may be glorified in the Sonne.
label: John

text: If you aſke me any thing in my name, that wil I doe.
label: John

text: If you loue me, keepe my commaundements.
label: John

text: And I wil aſke the father, and he vvil giue you an other c Paraclete, that he may abide vvith you for euer,
label: John

text: the Spirit of truth, vvhom the vvorld can not receiue, becauſe it ſeeth him not, neither knovveth him, but you ‘knovv’ him: becauſe he ſhal abide vvith you, and ſhal be in you.
label: John

text: I vvil not leaue you orphanes: I vvil come to you.
label: John

text: Yet a litle vvhile: and the vvorld ſeeth me no more. But you ſee me: becauſe I liue, and you ſhal liue. ⊢
label: John

text: In that day you ſhal knovv that I am in my father, and you in me, and I in you.
label: John

text: He that hath my commaundements, and keepeth them: he it is that loueth me. And he that loueth me, ſhal be loued of my father: and I vvil loue him, and vvil manifeſt my ſelf to him. ⊢
label: John

text: Iudas ſaith to him, not that Iſcariote, Lord, vvhat is done, that thou vvilt manifeſt thy ſelf to vs, and not to the vvorld?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, and ſaid to him, If any loue me, he vvil keepe my vvord, and my father vvil loue him, and vve vvil come to him, and vvil make abode vvith him.
label: John

text: He that loueth me not, keepeth not my vvordes. And the vvord vvhich you haue heard, is not mine: but his that ſent me, the Fathers.
label: John

text: Theſe things haue I ſpoken to you abiding vvith you.
label: John

text: But the Paraclete the holy Ghoſt, vvhom the Father vvil ſend in my name, he ſhal teach you al things, & ſuggeſt vnto you al things vvhatſoeuer I ſhal ſay to you.
label: John

text: Peace I leaue to you, my peace I giue to you. not as the vvorld giueth, doe I giue to you. Let not your hart be troubled, nor feare.
label: John

text: You haue heard that I ſaid to you, I goe and I come to you. If you loued me, you would be glad verily, that I goe to the Father: becauſe the Father is greater then I.
label: John

text: And novv I haue told you before it come to paſſe: that vvhen it ſhal come to paſſe, you may beleeue.
label: John

text: Novv I vvil not ſpeake many things vvith you. for the prince of this vvorld commeth, and in me he hath not any thing.
label: John

text: But that the vvorld may knovv that I loue the Father: and as the Father hath giuen me commaundement, ſo doe I: ⊢ Ariſe, let vs goe hence.
label: John

text: I AM the true vine: and my father is the huſband-man.
label: John

text: Euery branche in me, not bearing fruite, he wil take it avvay: and euery one that beareth fruite, he vvil purge it, that it may bring more fruite.
label: John

text: Now you are cleane for the word vvhich I haue ſpoken to you.
label: John

text: Abide in me: and I in you. As the branche can not beare fruite of it ſelf, vnles it abide in the vine: ſo you neither, vnles you abide in me.
label: John

text: I am the vine: you the branches. he that abideth in me, and I in him, the ſame beareth much fruite: for vvithout me you can doe nothing.
label: John

text: If any abide not in me: he ſhal be caſt forth as the branche, and ſhal vvither, and they ſhal gather him vp, and caſt him into the fire, and he burneth.
label: John

text: If you abide in me, and my wordes abide in you: you ſhal aſke what thing ſoeuer you vvil, and it ſhal be done to you. ⊢
label: John

text: In this my father is glorified: that you bring very much fruite, and become my Diſciples.
label: John

text: As my father hath loued me, I alſo haue loued you. Abide in my loue.
label: John

text: If you keepe my precepts, you ſhal abide in my loue: as I alſo haue kept my fathers precepts, and doe abide in his loue.
label: John

text: Theſe things I haue ſpoken to you, that my ioy may be in you, and your ioy may be filled.
label: John

text: This is my precept, that you loue one an other, as I haue loued you.
label: John

text: Greater loue then this no man hath, that a man yeld his life for his frendes.
label: John

text: You are my frendes, if you doe the things that I commaund you.
label: John

text: Now I cal you not ſeruants: for the ſeruant knovveth not vvhat his lord doeth. But you I haue called frendes: becauſe al things vvhatſoeuer I heard of my father, I haue notified vnto you.
label: John

text: You choſe not me, but I choſe you: and haue appointed you: that you goe, & bring fruite: and your fruite abide: that vvhatſoeuer you aſke the father in my name, he may giue it you. ⊢
label: John

text: Theſe things I commaund you, that you loue one an other.
label: John

text: If the vvorld hate you: know ye that it hath hated me before you.
label: John

text: If you had been of the vvorld, the vvorld vvould loue his owne. but becauſe you are not of the world, but I haue choſen you out of the vvorld, therfore the vvorld hateth you.
label: John

text: Remembre my vvord that I ſaid to you, The ſeruant is not greater then his maiſter. If they haue perſecuted me, you alſo vvil they perſecute. if they haue kept my vvord, yours alſo vvil they keepe.
label: John

text: But al theſe things they vvil doe to you for my name ſake: becauſe they knovv not him that ſent me.
label: John

text: If I had not come, and ſpoken to them, they ſhould not haue ſinne: but novv they haue no excuſe of their ſinne.
label: John

text: He that hateth me, hateth my Father alſo.
label: John

text: If I had not done among them vvorkes that no other man hath done, they ſhould not haue ſinne: but novv both they haue ſeen, and they doe hate both me and my Father.
label: John

text: But that the vvord may be fulfilled, vvhich is vvritten in their lavv: That they hated me gratis. ⊢
label: John

text: But vvhen the Paraclete commeth vvhom I vvil ſend you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, vvhich procedeth from the Father, he ſhal giue teſtimonie of me:
label: John

text: and you ſhal giue teſtimonie, becauſe you are vvith me from the beginning.
label: John

text: THESE things haue I ſpoken to you, that you be not ſcandalized.
label: John

text: Out of the ſynagogs they vvil caſt you: but the houre commeth, that euery one vvhich killeth you, ſhal thinke that he doeth ſeruice to God.
label: John

text: and theſe things they vvil doe to you: becauſe they haue not knovven the Father, nor me.
label: John

text: But theſe things I haue ſpoken to you: that vvhen the houre ſhal come, you may remember them, that I told you. ⊢
label: John

text: But I told you not theſe things from the beginning, becauſe I vvas vvith you. And novv I goe to him that ſent me, and none of you aſketh me: VVhither goeſt thou?
label: John

text: But becauſe I haue ſpoken theſe things to you, ſorovv hath filled your hart.
label: John

text: But I tel you the truth. it is expedient for you that I goe. For if I goe not, the Paraclete ſhal not come to you: but if I goe, I vvil ſend him to you.
label: John

text: And vvhen he is come, he ſhal argue the vvorld of ſinne, and of iuſtice, and of iudgement.
label: John

text: of ſinne: becauſe they beleeue not in me.
label: John

text: but of iuſtice: becauſe I goe to the Father: and novv you ſhal not ſee me.
label: John

text: and of iudgement: becauſe the prince of this vvorld is now iudged.
label: John

text: Yet many things I haue to ſay to you: but you can not beare them novv.
label: John

text: But vvhen he, the Spirit of truth, commeth, he ſhal teach you al truth. for he ſhal not ſpeake of him ſelf: but vvhat things ſoeuer he ſhal heare, he ſhal ſpeake: and the things that are to come he ſhal ſhevv you.
label: John

text: He ſhal glorifie me: becauſe he ſhal receiue of mine, and ſhal ſhevv to you. ⊢
label: John

text: Al things vvhatſoeuer the Father hath, be mine. Therfore I ſaid, that he ſhal receiue of mine, and ſhal ſhew to you.
label: John

text: A litle vvhile, and novv you ſhal not ſee me: and againe a litle vvhile, and you ſhal ſee me: becauſe I goe to the Father.
label: John

text: Some therfore of his diſciples ſaid one to an other, VVhat is this that he ſaith to vs: A litle vvhile, and you ſhal not ſee me: and againe a litle vvhile, and you ſhal ſee me, and, becauſe I goe to the Father?
label: John

text: They ſaid therfore, VVhat is this that he ſaith, A litle vvhile? vve know not vvhat he ſpeaketh.
label: John

text: And IESVS knew, that they vvould aſke him: and he ſaid to them, Of this you doe queſtion among your ſelues, becauſe I ſaid to you, A litle vvhile, and you ſhal not ſee me: and againe a litle vvhile, and you ſhal ſee me.
label: John

text: Amen, amen I ſay to you, that you ſhal vveepe, and lament, but the vvorld ſhal reioyce: and you ſhal be made ſorovvful, but your ſorovv ſhal be turned into ioy.
label: John

text: A vvoman vvhen ſhe trauaileth, hath ſorovv, becauſe her houre is come: but vvhen ſhe hath brought forth the childe, novv ſhe remembreth not the anguiſh for ioy, that a man is borne into the vvorld.
label: John

text: And you therfore, novv in deede you haue ſorow, but I vvil ſee you againe, and your hart ſhal reioyce: and your ioy no man ſhal take from you. ⊢
label: John

text: And in that day me you ſhal not aſke any thing. Amen, amen I ſay to you, if you aſke the Father any thing in my name, he vvil giue it you.
label: John

text: Vntil novv you haue not aſked any thing in my name. Aſke and you ſhal receiue: that your ioy may be ful.
label: John

text: Theſe things in prouerbes I haue ſpoken to you. The houre commeth vvhen in prouerbes I vvil no more ſpeake to you, but plainely of the Father I vvil ſhew you.
label: John

text: In that day you ſhal aſke in my name: and I ſay not to you, that I vvil aſke the Father for you.
label: John

text: For the Father him ſelf loueth you, becauſe you haue loued me, and haue beleeued that I came forth from God.
label: John

text: I came forth from the Father, and came into the vvorld: againe I leaue the vvorld, and I goe to the Father.
label: John

text: His diſciples ſay to him, Behold novv thou ſpeakeſt plainely, and ſaieſt no prouerbe.
label: John

text: novv vve knovv that thou knovveſt al things, and thou needeſt not that any man aſke thee. in this vve beleeue that thou cameſt forth from God. ⊢
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered them, Novv do you beleeue?
label: John

text: Behold the houre commeth, and it is novv come, that you ſhal be ſcattered euery man into his ovvne, and me you ſhal leaue alone: and I am not alone, becauſe the Father is vvith me.
label: John

text: Theſe things I haue ſpoken to you, that in me you may haue peace. In the vvorld you ſhal haue diſtreſſe: but haue confidence, I haue ouercome the vvorld.
label: John

text: THESE things ſpake IESVS: and lifting vp his eies into heauen, he ſaid, Father, the houre is come, glorifie thy ſonne, that thy ſonne may glorifie thee.
label: John

text: As thou haſt giuen him povver ouer al fleſh that al vvhich thou haſt giuen him, to them he may giue life euerlaſting.
label: John

text: And this is life euerlaſting that they know thee, the only true God, and vvhom thou haſt ſent IESVS CHRIST.
label: John

text: I haue glorified thee vpon the earth: I haue conſummated the vvorke vvhich thou gaueſt me to doe:
label: John

text: and novv glorifie thou me O Father vvith thy ſelf, vvith the glorie vvhich I had before the vvorld vvas, with thee.
label: John

text: I haue manifeſted thy name to the men vvhom thou gaueſt me out of the vvorld. Thine they vvere, and to me thou gaueſt them: and they haue kept thy vvord.
label: John

text: Novv they haue knovven that al things vvhich thou gaueſt me, are from thee:
label: John

text: becauſe the vvordes vvhich thou gaueſt me, I haue giuen them: and they haue receiued, and knovven in very deede that I came forth from thee, and haue beleeued that thou didſt ſend me.
label: John

text: For them doe I pray: Not for the vvorld doe I pray, but for them vvhom thou haſt giuen me:
label: John

text: becauſe they be thine: and al my things be thine, and thine be mine: and I am glorified in them. And novv I am not in the vvorld, and theſe are in the vvorld, and I come to thee. ⊢
label: John

text: Holy father, keepe them in thy name, vvhom thou haſt giuen me: that they may be one, as alſo vve.
label: John

text: Vvhen I vvas vvith them, I kept them in thy name. Thoſe vvhom thou gaueſt me, haue I kept: and none of them periſhed, but the ſonne of perdition, that the ſcripture may be fulfilled.
label: John

text: And now I come to thee: and theſe things I ſpeake in the world, that they may haue my ioy filled in them ſelues.
label: John

text: I haue giuen them thy vvord, and the vvorld hath hated them, becauſe they are not of the vvorld: as I alſo am not of the vvorld.
label: John

text: I pray not that thou take them avvay out of the vvorld, but that thou preſerue them from euil.
label: John

text: Of the vvorld they are not: as I alſo am not of the vvorld.
label: John

text: Sanctifie them in truth. Thy vvord is truth.
label: John

text: As thou didſt ſend me into the vvorld, I alſo haue ſent them into the vvorld.
label: John

text: And for thē I doe ſanctifie my ſelf: that they alſo may be ſanctified in truth.
label: John

text: And not for them only doe I pray, but for them alſo that by their vvord ſhal beleeue in me:
label: John

text: that they al may be one, as thou (Father) in me, and I in thee, that they alſo in vs may be one: that the vvorld may beleeue that thou haſt ſent me.
label: John

text: And the glorie that thou haſt giuen me, haue I giuen to them: that they may be one, as vve alſo are one.
label: John

text: I in them, and thou in me: that they may be conſummate in one: ⊢ and the vvorld may knovv that thou haſt ſent me, and haſt loued them, as me alſo thou haſt loued.
label: John

text: Father, vvhom thou haſt giuen me, I vvil, that vvhere I am, they alſo may be vvith me: that they maye ſee my glorie vvhich thou haſt giuen me, becauſe thou haſt loued me before the creation of the vvorld.
label: John

text: Iuſt Father, the vvorld hath not knovven thee. but I haue knovven thee: and theſe haue knovven, that thou didſt ſend me.
label: John

text: And I haue notified thy name to them, and vvil notifie it: that the loue vvhervvith thou haſt loued me may be in them, and I in them.
label: John

text: WHEN IESVS had ſaid theſe things, he went forth vvith his diſciples beyond the Torrent-Cedron, vvhere vvas a garden, into the vvhich he entred and his Diſciples.
label: John

text: And Iudas alſo, that betraied him, knevv the place: becauſe IESVS had often reſorted thither together vvith his Diſciples.
label: John

text: Iudas therfore hauing receiued the band of men, and of the cheefe Prieſts and the Phariſees, miniſters, commeth thither vvith lanternes and torches and vveapons.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore knovving al things that ſhould come vpon him, vvent forth, and ſaid to them, VVhom ſeeke ye?
label: John

text: they anſvvered him, IESVS of Nazareth. IESVS ſaith to them, I am he. And Iudas alſo that betraied him, ſtoode vvith them.
label: John

text: As ſone therfore as he ſaid to them, I am he: they vvent backvvard, and fel to the ground.
label: John

text: Againe therfore he aſked them, VVhom ſeeke ye? And they ſaid, IESVS of Nazareth.
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, I haue told you, that I am he. if therfore you ſeeke me, let theſe goe their vvaies.
label: John

text: That the vvord might be fulfilled vvhich he ſaid, That of them vvhom thou haſt giuen me, I haue not loſt any.
label: John

text: Simon Peter therfore hauing a ſvvord, drevve it out: and ſmote the ſeruant of the high prieſt: & cut of his right eare. And the name of the ſeruant vvas Malchus.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaid to Peter, Put vp thy ſword into the ſcabbard. The chalice vvhich my father hath giuen me, ſhal not I drinke it?
label: John

text: The band therfore and the Tribune & the miniſters of the Ievves apprehended IESVS, and bound him:
label: John

text: and they brought him to Annas firſt, for he vvas father in lavv to Caiphas, vvho vvas the high prieſt of that yere.
label: John

text: And Caiphas vvas he that had giuen the counſel to the Iewes, That it is expedient that one man die for the people.
label: John

text: And Simon Peter folovved IESVS, and an other diſciple. And that Diſciple vvas knovven to the high prieſt, and vvent in with IESVS into the court of the high prieſt.
label: John

text: but Peter ſtoode at the doore vvithout. The other diſciple therfore that vvas knovven to the high Prieſt, vvent forth, and ſpake to the portreſſe, and brought in Peter.
label: John

text: The vvench therfore that vvas portreſſe, ſaith to Peter, Art not thou alſo of this mans diſciples? He ſaith to her, I am not.
label: John

text: And the ſeruants and miniſters ſtoode at a fire of coles, becauſe it vvas cold, and vvarmed them ſelues. And vvith them vvas Peter alſo ſtanding, and vvarming him ſelf.
label: John

text: The high prieſt therfore aſked IESVS of his diſciples, and of his doctrine.
label: John

text: IESVS anſwered him, I haue openly ſpoken to the vvorld: I haue alvvaies taught in the ſynagogue, and in the temple vvhither al the Ievves reſort together: and in ſecrete I haue ſpoken nothing.
label: John

text: VVhy aſkeſt thou me? aſke them that haue heard vvhat I haue ſpoken vnto them: behold they knovv vvhat things I haue ſaid.
label: John

text: VVhen he had ſaid theſe things, one of the miniſters ſtanding by, gaue IESVS a blovv, ſaying, Anſvvereſt thou the high prieſt ſo?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered him, If I haue ſpoken il, giue teſtimonie of euil: but if vvel, vvhy ſtrikeſt thou me?
label: John

text: And Annas ſent him bound to Caiphas the high prieſt.
label: John

text: And Simon Peter vvas ſtanding, and vvarming him ſelf. They ſaid therfore to him, Art not thou alſo of his diſciples? He denied and ſaid: I am not.
label: John

text: One of the ſeruants of the high prieſt ſaith to him, his coſin vvhoſe eare Peter did cut of, Did not I ſee thee in the garden vvith him?
label: John

text: Againe therfore Peter denied: and forth with the cocke crevve.
label: John

text: They therfore bring IESVS from Caiphas into the Palace. And it vvas morning: and they vvent not in into the Palace, that they might not be contaminated, but that they might eate the Paſche.
label: John

text: Pilate therfore vvent forth to them vvithout, and ſaid, VVhat accuſation bring you againſt this man?
label: John

text: They anſvvered and ſaid to him, If he vvere not a malefactour, vve vvould not haue deliuered him vp to thee.
label: John

text: Pilate therfore ſaid to them, Take him you, and according to your lavv iudge him. The Ievves therfore ſaid to him, It is not lavvful for vs to kil any man.
label: John

text: That the vvord of IESVS might be fulfilled vvhich he ſaid, ſignifying what death he ſhould die.
label: John

text: Pilate therfore vvent into the Palace againe, and called IESVS, and ſaid to him, Art thou the king of the Ievves?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, Saieſt thou this of thy ſelf, or haue others told it thee of me?
label: John

text: Pilate anſwered, VVhy, am I a Iewe? Thy nation, and the cheefe prieſts haue deliuered thee vp to me: vvhat haſt thou done?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, My kingdom is not of this vvorld. if my kingdom vvere of this vvorld, my miniſters verily vvould ſtriue that I ſhould not be deliuered to the Ievves. but novv my kingdom is not from hence.
label: John

text: Pilate therfore ſaid to him, Art thou a king then? IESVS anſwered, Thou ſaieſt, that I am a king. For this vvas I borne, and for this came I into the vvorld: that I ſhould giue teſtimonie to the truth. Euery one that is of the truth, heareth my voice.
label: John

text: Pilate ſaith to him, VVhat is truth? And vvhen he had ſaid this, he vvent forth againe to the Ievves, and ſaith to them, I finde no cauſe in him.
label: John

text: But you haue a cuſtome that I ſhould releaſe one to you in the Paſche: vvil you therfore that I releaſe vnto you the king of the Ievves?
label: John

text: They al therfore cried againe, ſaying, Not him but Barabbas. And Barabbas vvas a theefe.
label: John

text: THEN therfore Pilate tooke IESVS, and ſcourged him.
label: John

text: And the ſouldiars platting a crowne of thornes, put it vpon his head: and they put about him a purple garment.
label: John

text: And they came to him, and ſaid, Haile king of the Ievves, and they gaue him blovves.
label: John

text: Pilate vvent forth againe, and ſaith to them, Behold I bring him forth vnto you, that you may know that I finde no cauſe in him.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore vvent forth carying the crovvne of thornes, and the purple veſtiment. And he ſaith to them, Loe the man.
label: John

text: Vvhen the cheefe prieſts therfore and the miniſters had ſeen him, they cried, ſaying, Crucifie, crucifie him. Pilate ſaith to them, Take him you, and crucifie him. for I finde no cauſe in him.
label: John

text: The Ievves anſvvered him, VVe haue a Law: and according to the Law he ought to die, becauſe he hath made him ſelf the ſonne of God.
label: John

text: When Pilate therfore had heard this ſaying, he feared more.
label: John

text: And he entred into the Palace againe: and he ſaith to IESVS, VVhence art thou? But IESVS gaue him no anſvver.
label: John

text: Pilate therfore ſaith to him, Speakeſt thou not to me? knovveſt thou not that I haue povver to crucifie thee, and I haue povver to releaſe thee?
label: John

text: IESVS anſvvered, Thou ſhouldeſt not haue any povver againſt me, vnles it vvere giuen thee from aboue. Therfore he that hath betraied me to thee, hath the greater ſinne.
label: John

text: From thence forth Pilate ſought to releaſe him. But the Iewes cried, ſaying, If thou releaſe this man, thou art not Cæſars frend. euery one that maketh him ſelf a king, ſpeaketh againſt Cæſar.
label: John

text: But Pilate vvhen he had heard theſe vvordes, brought forth IESVS: and he ſate in the iudgement ſeate, in the place that is called Lithóſtrotos, and in Hebrew Gábbatha.
label: John

text: And it vvas the Paraſceue of Paſche, about the ſixt houre, and he ſaith to the Ievves, Loe your king.
label: John

text: But they cried, Avvay, avvay vvith him, crucifie him. Pilate ſaith to them, Shal I crucifie your king? The cheefe prieſts anſwered, VVe haue no king, but Cæſar.
label: John

text: Then therfore he deliuered him vnto them for to be crucified. And they tooke IESVS, and led him forth.
label: John

text: And bearing his ovvne croſſe he went forth into that vvhich is called the place of Caluarie, in Hebrew Gólgotha.
label: John

text: vvhere they crucified him, and vvith him two others, on the one ſide and on the other, and in the middes IESVS.
label: John

text: And Pilate wrote a title alſo: and he put it vpon the croſſe. And it vvas vvritten, IESVS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE IEWES.
label: John

text: This title therfore many of the Ievves did reade: becauſe the place vvhere IESVS vvas crucified, vvas nigh to the citie: and it vvas vvritten in Hebrevv, in Greeke, and in Latin.
label: John

text: The cheefe prieſts therfore of the Ievves ſaid to Pilate, VVrite not, The king of the Iewes: but that he ſaid, I am king of the Iewes.
label: John

text: Pilate anſvvered, That vvhich I haue written, I haue vvritten.
label: John

text: The ſouldiars therfore vvhen they had crucified him, tooke his garments (and they made foure partes, to euery ſouldiar a part) & his coate. And his coate vvas vvithout ſeame, wrought from the toppe through out.
label: John

text: They ſaid therfore one to an other, Let vs not cut it, but let vs caſt lottes for it vvhoſe it ſhal be. That the ſcripture might be fulfilled ſaying, They haue parted my garments among them: and vpon my veſture they haue caſt lottes. And the ſouldiars did theſe things.
label: John

text: And there ſtoode beſide the croſſe of IESVS, his mother, and his mothers ſiſter, Marie of Cléphas, and Marie Magdalene.
label: John

text: VVhen IESVS therfore had ſeen his mother and the diſciple ſtanding vvhom he loued, he ſaith to his mother: VVoman, behold thy ſonne.
label: John

text: After that, he ſaith to the diſciple, Behold thy mother. And from that houre the diſciple tooke her to his ovvne.
label: John

text: Aftervvard IESVS knovving that al things vvere novv conſummate, that the ſcripture might be fulfilled, he ſaith, I thirſt.
label: John

text: A veſſel therfore ſtoode there ful of vinegre. And they putting a ſpongeful of vinegre about hyſſope, offered it to his mouth.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore vvhen he had taken the vinegre, ſaid, It is conſummate. And bovving his head, he gaue vp the ghoſt.
label: John

text: The Ievves therfore (becauſe it vvas the Paraſceue) that the bodies might not remaine vpon the croſſe on the Sabboth (for that vvas a greate Sabboth day) they deſired Pilate that their legges might be broken, and they might be taken avvay.
label: John

text: The ſouldiars therfore came: and of the firſt in deede they brake the legges, and of the other that vvas crucified vvith him.
label: John

text: But after they vvere come to IESVS, vvhen they ſavv that he vvas dead, they did not breake his legges,
label: John

text: but one of the ſouldiars vvith a ſpeare opened his ſide, and incontinent there came forth bloud and vvater.
label: John

text: And he that ſaw it, hath giuen teſtimonie: and his teſtimonie is true. And he knovveth that he ſaith true, that you alſo may beleeue.
label: John

text: For theſe things vvere done that the ſcripture might be fulfilled, You ſhal not breake a bone of him.
label: John

text: And againe an other ſcripture ſaith, They ſhal looke on him whom they pearſed.
label: John

text: And after theſe things Ioſeph of Arimathaea (becauſe he vvas a diſciple of IESVS, but ſecrete for feare of the Iewes) deſired Pilate that he might take avvay the body of IESVS. And Pilate permitted. He came therfore, and tooke avvay the body of IESVS.
label: John

text: Nicodemus alſo came, he that at the firſt came to IESVS by the night, bringing a mixture of myrrhe and aloés, about an hundred poundes.
label: John

text: They tooke therfore the body of IESVS, and bound it in linnen clothes vvith the ſpices, as the maner is vvith the Ievves to burie.
label: John

text: And there vvas in the place vvhere he vvas crucified, a garden: and in the garden a nevv monument, vvherein no man yet had been laide.
label: John

text: There therfore becauſe of the Paraſceue of the Ievves, they laid IESVS, becauſe the monument vvas hard by.
label: John

text: AND the firſt of the Sabboth, Marie Magdalene commeth early, vvhen it vvas yet darke, vnto the monument: and ſhe ſavv the ſtone taken avvay from the monument.
label: John

text: She ranne therfore and commeth to Simon Peter, and to the other diſciple vvhom IESVS loued, and ſaith to them, They haue taken our Lord out of the monument, and vve knovv not vvhere they haue laid him.
label: John

text: Peter therfore vvent forth and that other diſciple, and they came to the monument.
label: John

text: And both ranne together, and that other diſciple did out-runne Peter, and came firſt to the monument.
label: John

text: And vvhen he had ſtouped dovvne, he ſavv the linnen clothes lying: but yet he went not in.
label: John

text: Simon Peter therfore commeth, folovving him, and vvent in to the monument, and ſaw the linnen clothes lying,
label: John

text: and the napkin that had been vpon his head, not lying vvith the linnen clothes, but apart, vvrapped vp into one place.
label: John

text: Then therfore vvent in that other diſciple alſo vvhich came firſt to the monument: and he ſavv, and beleeued.
label: John

text: For as yet they knevv not the ſcripture, that he ſhould riſe againe from the dead. ⊢
label: John

text: The diſciples therfore departed againe to them ſelues.
label: John

text: b But Marie ſtoode at the monument vvithout, weeping. Therfore as ſhe vvas vveeping, ſhe ſtouped dovvne, & looked into the monument:
label: John

text: and ſhe ſaw two Angels in vvhite, ſitting, one at the head, and one at the feete, where the body of IESVS had been laid.
label: John

text: They ſay to her, Woman, why weepeſt thou? She ſaith to them, Becauſe they haue taken avvay my Lord, and I knovv not vvhere they haue put him.
label: John

text: Vvhen ſhe had ſaid thus, ſhe turned backvvard, and ſaw IESVS ſtanding: and ſhe knevv not that it is IESVS.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to her, Woman, vvhy vveepeſt thou? vvhom ſeekeſt thou? She thinking that it vvas the gardiner, ſaith to him, Sir, if thou haſt caried him avvay, tel me vvhere thou haſt laid him: & I wil take him avvay.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to her, Marie. She turning ſaith to him, Rabbóni (which is to ſay, Maiſter.)
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to her, Do not touche me, for I am not yet aſcended to my Father: but goe to my brethren, and ſay to them, I aſcend to my Father and your Father, my God and your God.
label: John

text: Marie Magdalene commeth and telleth the diſciples, That I haue ſeen our Lord, and thus he ſaid vnto me.
label: John

text: Therfore vvhen it vvas late that day, the firſt of the Sabboths, and the doores vvere ſhut, where the diſciples vvere gathered together for feare of the Ievves, IESVS came and ſtoode in the middes, and ſaith to them, Peace be to you.
label: John

text: And vvhen he had ſaid this, he ſhewed them his handes and ſide. The diſciples therfore vvere glad vvhen they ſavv our Lord.
label: John

text: He ſaid therfore to them againe, Peace be to you. As my Father hath ſent me, I alſo doe ſend you.
label: John

text: Vvhen he had ſaid this, he breathed vpon them: and he ſaith to them, Receiue ye the Holy Ghoſt:
label: John

text: VVHOSE SINNES YOV SHAL FORGIVE, THEY ARE FORGIVEN THEM: AND VVHOSE YOV SHAL RETEINE, THEY ARE RETEINED.
label: John

text: But Thomas one of the Tvvelue, vvho is called Didymus, vvas not vvith them when IESVS came.
label: John

text: The other diſciples therfore ſaid to him, VVe haue ſeen our Lord. But he ſaid to them, Vnles I ſee in his handes the print of the nailes, and put my finger into the place of the nailes, and put my hand into his ſide: I vvil not beleeue.
label: John

text: And after eight daies, againe his diſciples vvere vvithin: and Thomas vvith them. IESVS commeth the doores being ſhut, and ſtoode in the middes, and ſaid, Peace be to you.
label: John

text: Then he ſaith to Thomas, Put in thy finger hither, and ſee my handes, and bring hither thy hand, and put it into my ſide: & be not incredulous but faithful.
label: John

text: Thomas anſvvered, & ſaid to him, My Lord, & my God.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to him, Becauſe thou haſt ſeen me, Thomas, thou haſt beleeued: bleſſed are they that haue not ſeen & haue beleeued.
label: John

text: Many other ſignes alſo did IESVS in the ſight of his diſciples, vvhich are not written in this booke.
label: John

text: And theſe are vvritten, that you may beleeue that IESVS is CHRIST the ſonne of God: and that beleeuing, you may haue life in his name.
label: John

text: AFTER IESVS manifeſted him ſelf againe at the ſea of Tibérias. And he manifeſted thus:
label: John

text: There vvere together Simon Peter and Thomas vvho is called Didymus, and Nathanael vvhich vvas of Cana in Galilee, and the ſonnes of Zebedee, and tvvo others of his diſciples.
label: John

text: Simon Peter ſaith to them, I goe to fiſh. They ſay to him, VVe alſo come vvith thee. And they vvent forth and got vp into the boate: and that night they tooke nothing.
label: John

text: But vvhen morning vvas novv come, IESVS ſtoode on the ſhore: yet the diſciples knevv not that it was IESVS.
label: John

text: IESVS therfore ſaith to them, Children, haue you any meate? They anſvvered him, No.
label: John

text: He ſaith to them, Caſt the nette on the right ſide of the boate: and you ſhal finde. They therfore did caſt it: and novv they vvere not able to dravv it for the multitude of fiſhes.
label: John

text: That diſciple therfore vvhom IESVS loued, ſaith to Peter, It is our Lord. Simon Peter when he had heard that it is our Lord: girded his coate vnto him (for he vvas naked) and caſt him ſelf into the ſea.
label: John

text: But the other diſciples came in the boate (for they vvere not farre from the land, but as it vvere tvvo hundred cubits) dravving the nette of fiſhes.
label: John

text: Therefore after they came dovvne to land, they ſavv hote coles lying, and fiſh laid thereon, and bread.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to them, Bring hither of the fiſhes that you tooke novv.
label: John

text: Simon Peter vvent vp, and drevv the nette to the land, ful of great fiſhes, an hundred fiftie three. And although they vvere ſo many, the nette vvas not broken.
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to them, Come, dine. And none of them that ſate at meate, durſt aſke him, Who art thou? knovving that it is our Lord.
label: John

text: And IESVS commeth and taketh the bread and giueth them, and the fiſh in like maner.
label: John

text: This novv the third time IESVS vvas manifeſted to his diſciples, after he vvas riſen from the dead.
label: John

text: Therfore vvhen they had dined, IESVS ſaith to Simon Peter, Simon of Iohn, loueſt thou me more then theſe? He ſaith to him, Yea Lord: thou knovveſt that I loue thee. he ſaith to him, FEEDE MY LAMBES.
label: John

text: He ſaith to him againe, Simon of Iohn, loueſt thou me? he ſaith to him, Yea Lord, thou knovveſt that I loue thee. He ſaith to him, FEEDE MY LAMBES.
label: John

text: He ſaith to him the third time, Simon of Iohn, loueſt thou me? Peter vvas ſtroken ſad, becauſe he ſaid vnto him the third time, Loueſt thou me? And he ſaid to him, Lord, thou knovveſt al things: thou knovveſt that I loue thee. He ſaith to him, FEEDE MY SHEEPE.
label: John

text: Amen, amen I ſay to thee, vvhen thou vvaſt yonger, thou didſt girde thy ſelf, and didſt vvalke vvhere thou vvouldeſt. but vvhen thou ſhalt be old, thou ſhalt ſtretch forth thy handes, and an other ſhal girde thee, and leade thee whither thou vvilt not.
label: John

text: And this he ſaid, ſignifying by vvhat death he ſhould glorifie God. And vvhen he had ſaid this, he ſaith to him, Folovv me.
label: John

text: Peter turning, ſavv that diſciple vvhom IESVS loued, folovving, vvho alſo leaned at the ſupper vpon his breaſt, and ſaid, Lord vvho is he that ſhal betray thee?
label: John

text: Him therfore vvhen Peter had ſeen, he ſaith to IESVS, Lord, and this man vvhat?
label: John

text: IESVS ſaith to him, So I vvil haue him to remaine til I come, vvhat to thee? folovv thou me.
label: John

text: This ſaying therfore vvent abrode among the brethren, that that diſciple dieth not. And IESVS did not ſay to him, he dieth not: but, So I vvil haue him to remaine til I come, what to thee?
label: John

text: This is that diſciple vvhich giueth teſtimonie of theſe things, and hath vvritten theſe things: and vve knovv that his teſtimonie is true.
label: John

text: But there are many other things alſo vvhich IESVS did: vvhich if they vvere vvritten in particular, neither the vvorld it ſelf I thinke vvere able to conteine thoſe bookes that ſhould be vvritten.
label: John

text: THE firſt treatiſe I made of al things, O Theophilus, which IESVS began to doe and to teache,
label: Acts

text: vntil the day vvherein giuing commaundement by the holy Ghoſt to the Apoſtles vvhom he choſe, he vvas aſſumpted:
label: Acts

text: to whom he ſhewed alſo him ſelf aliue after his paſſion in many arguments, for fourtie daies appearing to them, & ſpeaking of the kingdom of God.
label: Acts

text: And eating vvith them, he commaunded them, that they ſhould not depart from Hieruſalem, but ſhould expect the promiſſe of the Father, vvhich you haue heard (ſaith he) by my mouth:
label: Acts

text: for Iohn in deede baptized vvith vvater, but you ſhal be baptized vvith the holy Ghoſt after theſe fevv daies.
label: Acts

text: They therfore that vvere aſſembled, aſked him, ſaying, Lord, whether at this time vvilt thou reſtore the kingdom to Iſrael?
label: Acts

text: but he ſaid to them, It is not for you to know times or moments, vvhich the Father hath put in his owne power:
label: Acts

text: but you ſhal receiue the vertue of the holy Ghoſt comming vpon you, and you ſhal be witneſſes vnto me in Hieruſalem, and in al Iewrie, and Samaria, and euen to the vtmoſt of the earth.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen he had ſaid theſe things, in their ſight he vvas eleuated: and a cloud receiued him out of their ſight.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they beheld him going into heauen, behold two men ſtoode beſide them in white garments,
label: Acts

text: vvho alſo ſaid, Ye men of Galilee, vvhy ſtand you looking into heauen? This IESVS vvhich is aſſumpted from you into heauen, ſhal ſo come as you haue ſeen him going into heauen. ⊢
label: Acts

text: Then they returned to Hieruſalem from the mount that is called Oliuet, which is by Hieruſalem, diſtant a Sabboths iourney.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they vvere entred in, they vvent vp into an vpper chamber, vvhere abode Peter & Iohn, Iames and Andrevv, Philippe and Thomas, Bartholomevv and Mathevv, Iames of Alphæus and Simon Zelótes, and Iude of Iames.
label: Acts

text: Al theſe vvere perſeuering vvith one minde in praier vvith the vvomen and MARIE the mother of IESVS, and his brethren.
label: Acts

text: In thoſe daies Peter riſing vp in the middes of the brethren, ſaid: (and the multitude of perſons together, vvas almoſt an hundred and tvventie)
label: Acts

text: You men, brethren, the ſcripture muſt be fulfilled vvhich the holy Ghoſt ſpake before by the mouth of Dauid concerning Iudas, vvho vvas the captaine of them that apprehended IESVS:
label: Acts

text: vvho vvas numbred among vs and obteined the lot of this miniſterie.
label: Acts

text: And he in deede hath poſſeſſed a field of the revvard of iniquitie, and being hanged he burſt in the middes, and al his bovvels guſhed out.
label: Acts

text: And it vvas made notorious to al the inhabitants of Hieruſalem: ſo that the ſame field vvas called in their tonge, Hacel-dema, that is to ſay, the field of bloud.
label: Acts

text: For it is vvritten in the booke of Pſalmes. Be their habitation made deſert, and be there none to dvvel in it. And his Biſhoprike let an other take.
label: Acts

text: Therfore, of theſe men that haue aſſembled vvith vs, al the time that our Lord IESVS vvent in and vvent out among vs,
label: Acts

text: beginning from the baptiſme of Iohn vntil the day vvherein he vvas aſſumpted from vs, there muſt one of theſe be made a vvitnes vvith vs of his reſurrection.
label: Acts

text: And they appointed tvvo, Ioſeph, vvho was called Bárſabas, vvho vvas ſurnamed Iuſtus: and Mathias.
label: Acts

text: And praying they ſaid, Thou Lord that knovveſt the harts of al men, ſhevv of theſe two, one, vvhom thou haſt choſen,
label: Acts

text: to take the place of this miniſterie and Apoſtleſhip, from the vvhich Iudas hath preuaricated that he might goe to his ovvne place.
label: Acts

text: And they gaue them lottes, and the lot fel vpon Mathias, and he vvas numbered vvith the eleuen Apoſtles. ⊢
label: Acts

text: AND when the daies of Pentecoſt vvere accompliſhed, they vvere al together in one place:
label: Acts

text: and ſodenly there vvas made a ſound from heauen, as of a vehement vvinde comming, & it filled the whole houſe vvhere they vvere ſitting.
label: Acts

text: And there appeared to them parted tonges as it were of fire, and it ſate vpon euery one of them:
label: Acts

text: and they vvere al repleniſhed vvith the HOLY GHOST, and they began to ſpeake vvith diuerſe tonges, according as the HOLY GHOST gaue them to ſpeake.
label: Acts

text: And there vvere dvvelling at Hieruſalem Iewes, deuout men of euery nation that is vnder heauen.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen this voice vvas made, the multitude came together, and vvas aſtonied in minde, becauſe euery man heard them ſpeake in his ovvne tongue.
label: Acts

text: And they vvere al amaſed, and marueled ſaying, Are not, lo, al theſe that ſpeake, Galilæans,
label: Acts

text: and hovv `haue vve heard' eche man our ovvne tongue vvherein vve vvere borne?
label: Acts

text: Parthians, and Medians, and Elamites, and that inhabite Meſopotámia, Iewrie, and Cappadocia, Pontus, and Aſia,
label: Acts

text: Phrygia, and Pamphilia, Ægypt and the partes of Lybia that is about Cyrénee, and ſtrangers of Rome,
label: Acts

text: Iewes alſo, and Proſelytes, Cretenſians, and Arabians: Vve `haue heard' them ſpeake in our ovvne tonges the great workes of God. ⊢
label: Acts

text: And they vvere al aſtonied, and marueled, ſaying one to an other, Vvhat meaneth this?
label: Acts

text: But others deriding ſaid, That theſe are ful of nevv vvine.
label: Acts

text: But Peter ſtanding vvith the Eleuen, lifted vp his voice, and ſpake to them, Ye men, Iewes, and al you that dwel in Hieruſalem, be this knovven to you, and vvith your eares receiue my vvordes.
label: Acts

text: For theſe are not drunke, as you ſuppoſe, vvhereas it is the third houre of the day:
label: Acts

text: But this is it that vvas ſaid by the Prophet Ioël,
label: Acts

text: And it ſhal be, in the laſt daies (ſaith our Lord) of my Spirit I vvil powre out vpon al fleſh: and your ſonnes and your daughters ſhal prophecie, and your yong men ſhal ſee viſions, and your auncients ſhal dreame dreames.
label: Acts

text: And vpon my ſeruants truely, and vpon my handmaides vvil I povvre out in thoſe daies, of my Spirit, and they ſhal prophecie:
label: Acts

text: and I vvil giue vvonders in the heauen aboue, and ſignes in the earth beneath, bloud, and fire, and vapour of ſmoke.
label: Acts

text: The ſunne ſhal be turned into darkenes, and the moone into bloud, before the great and manifeſt day of our Lord doth come.
label: Acts

text: And it ſhal be, euery one vvhoſoeuer calleth vpon the name of our Lord, ſhal be ſaued. ⊢
label: Acts

text: Ye men of Iſraël heare theſe vvordes, IESVS of Nazareth a man approued of God among you, by miracles and vvonders and ſignes vvhich God did by him in the middes of you, as you knovv:
label: Acts

text: this ſame, by the determinate counſel and preſcience of God being deliuered, you by the handes of vvicked men haue crucified and ſlaine.
label: Acts

text: vvhom God hath raiſed vp looſing the ſorovves of hel, according as it vvas impoſſible that he ſhould be holden of it.
label: Acts

text: For Dauid ſaith concerning him, I foreſavv the Lord in my ſight alvvaies: becauſe he is at my right hand that I be not moued.
label: Acts

text: For this, my hart hath been glad and my tongue hath reioyced: moreouer my fleſh alſo ſhal reſt in hope.
label: Acts

text: becauſe thou vvilt not leaue my ſoul in hel, nor giue thy Holy one to ſee corruption.
label: Acts

text: Thou haſt made knovven to me the vvaies of life: thou ſhalt make me ful of ioyfulnes vvith thy face.
label: Acts

text: Ye men, brethren, let me boldly ſpeake to you of the Patriarch Dauid: that he died, and vvas buried: and his ſepulchre is vvith vs vntil this preſent day.
label: Acts

text: VVhereas therfore he vvas a Prophet, and knevv that by an othe God had ſvvorne to him that of the fruite of his loynes there ſhould ſit vpon his ſeate:
label: Acts

text: forſeeing he ſpake of the reſurrection of Chriſt, for neither vvas he left in hel, neither did his fleſh ſee corruption.
label: Acts

text: This IESVS hath God raiſed againe, vvhereof al vve are vvitneſſes.
label: Acts

text: Being exalted therfore by the right hand of God, and hauing receiued of his father the promiſſe of the Holy Ghoſt, he hath povvred out `this vvhom' you ſee and heare.
label: Acts

text: For Dauid aſcended not into heauen: but he ſaith, Our Lord hath ſaid to my Lord, ſit on my right hand,
label: Acts

text: vntil I make thine enemies the footeſtoole of thy feete.
label: Acts

text: Therfore let al the houſe of Iſraël know moſt certainly that God hath made him both Lord, and CHRIST, this IESVS, vvhom you haue crucified.
label: Acts

text: And hearing theſe things, they were compuncte in hart, and ſaid to Peter and to the reſt of the Apoſtles, Vvhat ſhal vve doe men, brethren?
label: Acts

text: But Peter ſaid to them, Doe penance, and be euery one of you baptized in the name of IESVS CHRIST for remiſſion of your ſinnes: and you ſhal receiue the gift of the holy Ghoſt.
label: Acts

text: For to you is the promiſſe, and to your children, and to al that are farre of, vvhomſoeuer the Lord our God ſhal call.
label: Acts

text: Vvith very many other vvordes alſo did he teſtifie, and exhorted them, ſaying: Saue your ſelues from this peruerſe generation.
label: Acts

text: They therfore that receiued his vvord, vvere baptized: and there vvere added in that day about three thouſand ſoules.
label: Acts

text: And they vvere perſeuering in the doctrine of the Apoſtles, and in the communication of the breaking of bread, and praiers.
label: Acts

text: And feare came vpon euery ſoul: many vvonders alſo and ſignes vvere done by the Apoſtles in Hieruſalem, and there vvas great feare in al.
label: Acts

text: Al they alſo that beleeued, vvere together, and had al things common.
label: Acts

text: Their poſſeſſions and ſubſtance they ſold, and deuided them to al, according as euery one had neede.
label: Acts

text: Daily alſo continuing vvith one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from houſe to houſe, they tooke their meate vvith ioy and ſimplicitie of hart:
label: Acts

text: praiſing God, and hauing grace vvith al the people. And our Lord increaſed them that ſhould be ſaued, daily together.
label: Acts

text: AND Peter and Iohn vvent vp into the temple, at the ninthe houre of praier.
label: Acts

text: And a certaine man that vvas lame from his mothers vvombe, vvas caried: vvhom they laid euery day at the gate of the temple, that is called Specious, that he might aſke almes of them that vvent into the temple.
label: Acts

text: He, vvhen he had ſeen Peter and Iohn about to enter into the temple, aſked to receiue an almes.
label: Acts

text: But Peter vvith Iohn looking vpon him, ſaid, Looke vpon vs.
label: Acts

text: But he looked earneſtly vpon them, hoping that he ſhould receiue ſome thing of them.
label: Acts

text: But Peter ſaid, Siluer and gold I haue not, but that vvhich I haue, the ſame I giue to thee: In the name of IESVS CHRIST of Nazareth ariſe, and vvalke.
label: Acts

text: And taking his right hand, he lifted him vp, and forthvvith his feete and ſoles vvere made ſtrong.
label: Acts

text: And ſpringing he ſtoode, and vvalked: and vvent in vvith them into the temple vvalking, and leaping, and praiſing God.
label: Acts

text: And al the people ſavv him vvalking and praiſing God.
label: Acts

text: And they knevv him, that, it vvas he vvhich ſate for almes at the Specious gate of the temple: and they vvere excedingly aſtonied and agaſt at that that had chaunced to him.
label: Acts

text: And as he held Peter and Iohn, al the people ranne to them vnto the porche vvhich is called Salomons, vvondering.
label: Acts

text: But Peter ſeing them, made anſvver to the people, Ye men of Iſraël, vvhy maruel you at this, or vvhy looke you vpon vs, as though by our povver or holines vve haue made this man to vvalke?
label: Acts

text: The God of Abraham, and the God of Iſaac, and the God of Iacob, the God of our fathers hath glorified his ſonne IESVS, vvhom you in deede deliuered and denied before the face of Pilate, he iudging him to be releaſed.
label: Acts

text: But you denied the holy and the iuſt one, and aſked a man killer to be giuen vnto you.
label: Acts

text: ſaying, VVhat ſhal vve doe to theſe men? for a notorious ſigne in deede hath been done by them, to al the inhabitants of Hieruſalem: it is manifeſt, and vve can not denie it.

text: But that it be no further ſpred abrode among the people, let vs threaten them, that they ſpeake no more in this name to any man.

text: And calling them, they charged them that they ſhould not ſpeake at al, nor teache in the name of IESVS.

text: For the man vvas more then fourtie yeres old, in vvhom that ſigne of health had been vvrought.

text: to doe vvhat thy hand & thy counſel decreed to be done.

text: And the multitude of beleeuers had one hart and one ſoule: neither did any one ſay that ought vvas his ovvne of thoſe things vvhich he poſſeſſed, but al things vvere common vnto them.

text: and laid it before the feete of the Apoſtles. And to euery one vvas deuided according as euery one hade neede.

label: Acts

label: Acts

text: And Ananias hearing theſe vvordes, fel dovvne, and gaue vp the ghoſt. And there came great feare vpon al that heard it.

label: Acts

text: And there ranne together vnto Hieruſalem the multitude alſo of the cities adioyning, bringing ſicke perſons and ſuch as vvere vexed of vncleane ſpirits: vvho vvere al cured. ⊢

text: Vvho hauing heard this, early in the morning entred into the temple, and taught. And the high prieſt comming, and they that vvere vvith him, called together the Councel & al the auncients of the children of Iſraël: and they ſent to the priſon that they might be brought.

text: And you tooke vnto you the tabernacle of Moloch, and the ſtarre of your God Rempham, figures vvhich you made, to adore them. And I vvil tranſlate you beyond Babylon.
label: Acts

text: The tabernacle of teſtimonie vvas among our fathers in the deſert, as God ordained ſpeaking to Moyſes, that he ſhould make it according to the forme vvhich he had ſeen.
label: Acts

text: Vvhich our fathers vvith c Ieſus receiuing, brought it in alſo into the poſſeſſion of the Gentiles, vvhich God expelled from the face of our fathers, till in the daies of Dauid,
label: Acts

text: Vvho found grace before God, and deſired that he might finde a tabernacle for the God of Iacob.
label: Acts

text: And Salomon built him a houſe.
label: Acts

text: But the Higheſt dvvelleth not in houſes made by hand, as the prophet ſaith:
label: Acts

text: Heauen is my ſeate: and the earth the foote-ſtole of my feete. Vvhat houſe vvil you build me, ſaith our Lord? or vvhat place is there of my reſting?
label: Acts

text: Hath not my hand made al theſe things?
label: Acts

text: You ſtiffe-necked and of vncircumciſed hartes and eares, you alvvaies reſiſt the holy Ghoſt: as your fathers, your ſelues alſo.
label: Acts

text: Vvhich of the prophets did not your fathers perſecute? And they ſlevve them that foretold of the comming of the Iuſt one, of vvhom novv
label: Acts

text: you haue been betraiers and murderers: vvho receiued the Lavv by the diſpoſition of Angels, and haue not kept it.
label: Acts

text: And hearing theſe things they vvere cut in their hartes, and they gnaſhed vvith their teeth at him.
label: Acts

text: But he being ful of the holy Ghoſt, looking ſtedfaſtly vnto heauen, c ſavv the glorie of God, and IESVS ſtanding on the right hand of God. And he ſaid, Behold I ſee the heauens opened, and the Sonne of man ſtanding on the right hand of God.
label: Acts

text: And they crying out vvith a loude voice, ſtopped their eares, & vvith one accord ranne violently vpon him.
label: Acts

text: And caſting him forth vvithout the citie, they ſtoned him: and the vvitneſſes laid of their garments beſide the feete of a yong man that vvas called Saul.
label: Acts

text: And they ſtoned Steuen inuocating, and ſaying: Lord IESVS, receiue my ſpirit.
label: Acts

text: And falling on his knees, he cried vvith a loude voice, ſaying: Lord, lay not this ſinne vnto them. And vvhen he had ſaid this, he fel a ſleepe. And Saul vvas conſenting to his death.
label: Acts

text: AND the ſame day there vvas made a great perſecution in the Church, vvhich vvas at Hieruſalem, and al vvere diſperſed through the countries of Ievvrie and Samaria, ſauing the Apoſtles.
label: Acts

text: And deuout men c tooke order for Steuens funeral, and made great mourning vpon him.
label: Acts

text: But Saul vvaſted the Church: entring in from houſe to houſe, and dravving men and vvomen, deliuered them into priſon.
label: Acts

text: They therfore that vvere diſperſed, paſſed through, euangelizing the vvord.
label: Acts

text: And Philippe deſcending into the citie of Samaria, preached CHRIST vnto them.
label: Acts

text: And the multitudes vvere attent to thoſe things vvhich vvere ſaid of Philippe, vvith one accord hearing, and ſeing the ſignes that he did.
label: Acts

text: For many of them that had vncleane ſpirits, crying vvith a loud voice, vvent out. And many ſicke of the palſey and lame vvere cured.
label: Acts

text: There vvas made therfore great ioy in that citie. ⊢
label: Acts

text: And a certaine man named Simon, vvho before had been in that citie a Magician, ſeducing the nation of Samaria, ſaying him ſelf to be ſome great one:
label: Acts

text: vnto vvhom al harkened from the leaſt to the greateſt, ſaying, This man is the povver of God, that is called great.
label: Acts

text: And they vvere attent vpon him, becauſe a long time he had bewitched them vvith his magical practiſes.
label: Acts

text: But vvhen they had beleeued Philippe euangelizing of the kingdom of God, and of the name of IESVS CHRIST, they vvere baptized, men and vvomen.
label: Acts

text: Then Simon alſo him ſelf beleeued: and being baptized, he cleaued to Philippe. Seing alſo ſignes and very great miracles to be done, he vvas aſtonied vvith admiration.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen the Apoſtles vvho vvere in Hieruſalem, had heard that Samaria had receiued the vvord of God: they ſent vnto them Peter & Iohn.
label: Acts

text: Vvho vvhen they vvere come, praied for them, that they might receiue the holy Ghoſt.
label: Acts

text: For he vvas not yet come vpon any of them, but they vvere only baptized in the name of our Lord IESVS.
label: Acts

text: Then did they impoſe their handes vpon them, and they receiued the holy Ghoſt. ⊢
label: Acts

text: And vvhen Simon had ſeen that by the impoſition of the hand of the Apoſtles, the holy Ghoſt vvas giuen, he offered them money,
label: Acts

text: ſaying, Giue me alſo this povver, that on vvhomſoeuer I impoſe my handes, he may receiue the holy Ghoſt.
label: Acts

text: But Peter ſaid to him, Thy money be vvith thee vnto perdition: becauſe thou haſt thought that the gift of God is purchaſed vvith money.
label: Acts

text: Thou haſt no part, nor lot in this vvord. For thy hart is not right before God.
label: Acts

text: Doe penance therfore from this thy vvickedneſſe: and pray to God, if perhaps this cogitation of thy hart may be remitted thee.
label: Acts

text: For I ſee thou art in the gall of bitternes and the obligation of iniquitie.
label: Acts

text: And Simon anſvvering ſaid, Pray you for me to our Lord, that nothing come vpon me of theſe things vvhich you haue ſaid.
label: Acts

text: And they in deede hauing teſtified and ſpoken the vvord of our Lord, returned to Hieruſalem, and euangelized to many countries of the Samaritans.
label: Acts

text: b And an Angel of our Lord ſpake to Philippe, ſaying: Ariſe, and goe tovvard the South, to the vvay that goeth dovvne from Hieruſalem into Gaza: this is deſert.
label: Acts

text: And riſing he vvent. And behold, a man of Æthiopia, an eunuch, of great authoritie vnder Candáce the Queene of the Æthiopians, vvho vvas ouer al her treaſures, vvas come to Hieruſalem to adore:
label: Acts

text: and he vvas returning and ſitting vpon his chariot, and reading Eſay the prophet.
label: Acts

text: And the Spirit ſaid to Philippe, Goe neere, and ioyne thy ſelf to this ſame chariot.
label: Acts

text: And Philippe running therevnto, heard him reading Eſay the prophet, and he ſaid: Trovveſt thou that thou vnderſtandeſt the things vvhich thou readeſt?
label: Acts

text: Vvho ſaid, And hovv can I, vnleſſe ſome man ſhevv me? & he deſired Philippe that he vvould come vp and ſit vvith him.
label: Acts

text: And the place of the ſcripture vvhich he did reade, vvas this: As a ſheepe to ſlaughter vvas he led: and as a lambe before his ſhearer, vvithout voice, ſo did he not open his mouth.
label: Acts

text: In humilitie his iudgement vvas taken avvay. His generation vvho ſhal declare, for from the earth ſhal his life be taken?
label: Acts

text: And the eunuch anſvvering Philip, ſaid, I beſeeche thee, of vvhom doth the Prophet ſpeake this? of him ſelf, or of ſome other?
label: Acts

text: And Philip opening his mouth, and beginning from this ſcripture, euangelized vnto him IESVS.
label: Acts

text: And as they vvent by the vvay, they came to a certaine vvater: and the eunuch ſaid, Lo vvater, ‘vvho’ doth let me to be baptized?
label: Acts

text: And Philip ſaid, If thou beleeue vvith al thy hart, thou maieſt. And he anſvvering ſaid, I beleeue that IESVS CHRIST is the ſonne of God.
label: Acts

text: And he commaunded the chariot to ſtay: and both vvent dovvne into the vvater, Philip and the Eunuch, and he baptized him.
label: Acts

text: And when they vvere come vp out of the vvater, the Spirit of our Lord tooke avvay Philip, and the eunuch ſavv him no more. And he vvent on his vvay reioycing.
label: Acts

text: But Philip vvas found in Azótus, & paſſing through, he euangelized to al the cities, til he came to Cæſaréa. ⊢
label: Acts

text: AND Saul as yet breathing forth threatenings and ſlaughter againſt the diſciples of our Lord, came to the high prieſt,
label: Acts

text: and aſked letters of him vnto Damaſcus to the ſynagogs, that if he had found any men and vvomen of this vvay, he might bring them bound vnto Hieruſalem.
label: Acts

text: And as he vvent on his iourney, it chaunced that he drevv nigh to Damaſcus: and ſodenly a light from heauen ſhined round about him.
label: Acts

text: And falling on the ground, he heard a voice ſaying to him, Saul, Saul vvhy perſecuteſt thou me?
label: Acts

text: Vvho ſaid, Vvho art thou Lord? And he, I am IESVS vvhom thou doeſt perſecute. it is hard for thee to kicke againſt the pricke.
label: Acts

text: And trembling and being aſtonied he ſaid, Lord, vvhat vvilt thou haue me to doe?
label: Acts

text: And our Lord to him, Ariſe, and goe into the citie, and it ſhal be told thee vvhat thou muſt doe. But the men that vvent in companie vvith him, ſtood amaſed, hearing the voice, but ſeeing no man.
label: Acts

text: And Saul roſe vp from the ground, and his eies being opened, he ſavv nothing. And they dravving him by the handes, brought him into Damaſcus.
label: Acts

text: And he vvas three daies not ſeeing, and he did neither eate nor drinke.
label: Acts

text: And there vvas a certaine diſciple at Damaſcus, named Ananias: and our Lord ſaid to him in a viſion, Ananias. But he ſaid, Loe, here I am Lord.
label: Acts

text: And our Lord to him, Ariſe, & goe into the ſtreate that is called Straight: and ſeeke in the houſe of Iudas, one named Saul of Tarſus. for behold he prayeth.
label: Acts

text: ( And he ſavv a man named Ananias, comming in and impoſing handes vpon him for to receiue his ſight.)
label: Acts

text: But Ananias anſvvered, Lord, I haue heard by many of this man, hovv much euil he hath done to thy ſainctes in Hieruſalem:
label: Acts

text: and here he hath authoritie from the cheefe prieſts to binde al that inuocate thy name.
label: Acts

text: And our Lord ſaid to him, Goe, for a veſſel of election is this man vnto me, to carie my name before the Gentiles, and kinges, and the children of Iſraël.
label: Acts

text: For I vvil ſhevv him hovv great things he muſt ſuffer for my name.
label: Acts

text: And Ananias vvent, and entred into the houſe: and impoſing handes vpon him, he ſaid, Brother Saul, our Lord IESVS hath ſent me, he that appeared to thee in the vvay that thou cameſt: that thou maieſt ſee and be filled vvith the holy Ghoſt.
label: Acts

text: And forthvvith there fel from his eies as it vvere ſcales, and he receiued ſight. and riſing he vvas baptized.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen he had taken meate, he vvas ſtrengthened. And he vvas vvith the diſciples that vvere at Damaſcus, for certaine daies.
label: Acts

text: And incontinent entring into the ſynagogs, he preached IESVS, that this is the ſonne of God.
label: Acts

text: And al that heard, vvere aſtonied, and ſaid, Is not this he that expugned in Hieruſalem thoſe that inuocated this name: and came hither to this purpoſe that he might bring them bound to the cheefe prieſts?
label: Acts

text: But Saul vvaxed mightie much more, and confounded the Ievves that dvvelt at Damaſcus, affirming that this is CHRIST. ⊢
label: Acts

text: And vvhen many daies vvere paſſed, the Ievves conſulted that they might kil him.
label: Acts

text: But their conſpiracie came to Sauls knovvledge. And they kept the gates alſo day and night, that they might kil him.
label: Acts

text: But the diſciples taking him in the night, conueied him avvay by the vvall, letting him dovvne in a baſket.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen he vvas come into Hieruſalem, he aſſaied to ioyne him ſelf to the diſciples, & al feared him, not beleeuing that he vvas a diſciple.
label: Acts

text: But Barnabas tooke him & brought him to the Apoſtles, and told them hovv in the vvay he had ſeen our Lord, and that he ſpake vnto him, and hovv in Damaſcus he dealt confidently in the name of IESVS.
label: Acts

text: And he vvas vvith them going in and going out in Hieruſalem, and dealing confidently in the name of our Lord.
label: Acts
