text: He ſpake alſo to the Gentiles, and diſputed vvith the Greekes: but they ſought to kil him.
label: Acts

text: Vvhich vvhen the brethren had knovven, they brought him dovvne to Cæſaréa, and ſent him avvay to Tarſus.
label: Acts

text: The CHVRCH truely through al Ievvrie & Galilee and Samaria had peace, & vvas edified, vvalking in the feare of our Lord, and vvas repleniſhed vvith the conſolation of the holy Ghoſt.
label: Acts

text: And it came to paſſe, that Peter as he paſſed through al, came to the ſainctes that dvvelt at Lydda.
label: Acts

text: and he found there a certaine man named Æneas, lying in his bed from eight yeres before, vvho had the palſey.
label: Acts

text: And Peter ſaid to him, Æneas, our Lord IESVS CHRIST heale thee: ariſe, and make thy bed. And incontinent he aroſe.
label: Acts

text: And al that dvvelt at Lydda and Saróna, ſavv him: vvho conuerted to our Lord.
label: Acts

text: And in Ioppé there vvas a certaine diſciple named Tabitha, vvhich by interpretation is called Dorcas. This vvoman vvas ful of good vvorkes and almes-deedes vvhich ſhe did.
label: Acts

text: And it came to paſſe in thoſe daies, that ſhe vvas ſicke and died. Vvhom vvhen they had vvaſhed, they laid her in an vpper chamber.
label: Acts

text: And vvhereas Lydda vvas nigh to Ioppé, the diſciples hearing that Peter vvas in it, they ſent tvvo men vnto him, deſiring him, Be not loth to come ſo farre as to vs.
label: Acts

text: And Peter riſing vp came vvith them. And vvhen he vvas come, they brought him into the vpper chamber: and al the vvidovves ſtoode about him vveeping, and ſhevving him the coates and garments vvhich Dorcas made them.
label: Acts

text: And al being put forth, Peter falling on his knees praied, and turning to the body he ſaid: Tabitha, ariſe. And ſhe opened her eies: and ſeeing Peter, ſhe ſate vp.
label: Acts

text: And giuing her his hand, he lifted her vp. And vvhen he had called the ſainctes and the vvidovves, he preſented her aliue.
label: Acts

text: And it vvas made knovven through out al Ioppé: and many beleeued in our Lord.
label: Acts

text: And it came to paſſe that he abode many daies in Ioppé, vvith one Simon a tanner.
label: Acts

text: AND there vvas a certaine man in Cæſaréa, named Cornelius, Centurion of that vvhich is called the Italian band,
label: Acts

text: religious, & fearing God vvith al his houſe, doing many almes-deedes to the people. And alvvaies praying to God,
label: Acts

text: he ſavv in a viſion manifeſtly, about the ninthe houre of the day, an Angel of God comming in vnto him, and ſaying to him, Cornelius.
label: Acts

text: But he beholding him, taken vvith feare, ſaid, Vvho art thou Lord? And he ſaid to him, Thy praiers and thy almes-deedes are aſcended into remembrance in the ſight of God.
label: Acts

text: And novv ſend men vnto Ioppé, and call hither one Simon that is ſurnamed Peter.
label: Acts

text: he lodgeth vvith one Simon a tanner, vvhoſe houſe is by the ſea ſide. he vvil tel thee vvhat thou muſt doe.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen the Angel vvas departed that ſpake to him, he called tvvo of his houſhold, and a ſouldiar that feared our Lord, of them that vvere vnder him.
label: Acts

text: To vvhom vvhen he had told all, he ſent them vnto Ioppé.
label: Acts

text: And the next day vvhiles they vvere going on their iourney, and dravving nigh to the citie, Peter vvent vp into the higher partes, to pray about the ſixt houre.
label: Acts

text: And being hungrie, he vvas deſirous to take ſomevvhat. And as they vvere preparing, there fel vpon him an exceſſe of minde:
label: Acts

text: and he ſavv the heauen opened, and a certaine veſſel deſcending, as it vvere a great linnen ſheete vvith foure corners let dovvne from heauen to the earth,
label: Acts

text: vvherein vvere al foure-footed beaſtes, and that creepe on the earth, and foules of the aire.
label: Acts

text: And there came a voice to him, Ariſe Peter: kil, and eate.
label: Acts

text: But Peter ſaid, God forbid, Lord: for I did neuer eate any common and vncleane thing.
label: Acts

text: And a voice came to him againe the ſecond time, That vvhich God hath purified, doe not thou cal common.
label: Acts

text: And this vvas done thriſe. and forthvvith the veſſel was taken vp againe into heauen.
label: Acts

text: And vvhiles Peter doubted vvithin him ſelf, vvhat the viſion ſhould be that he had ſeen, behold the men that vvere ſent from Cornelius, inquiring for Simons houſe, ſtood at the gate.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they had called, they aſked, if Simon that is ſurnamed Peter, vvere lodged there.
label: Acts

text: And as Peter vvas thinking of the viſion, the Spirit ſaid to him, Behold three men doe ſeeke thee.
label: Acts

text: Ariſe therfore, and get thee dovvne, and goe vvith them, doubting nothing: for I haue ſent them.
label: Acts

text: And Peter going dovvne to the men, ſaid, Behold, I am he vvhom you ſeeke: vvhat is the cauſe, for the vvhich you are come?
label: Acts

text: Vvho ſaid, Cornelius the Centurion, a iuſt man & that feareth God, and hauing teſtimonie of al the nation of the Ievves, receiued an anſvver of an holy Angel to ſend for thee into his houſe, and to heare vvordes of thee.
label: Acts

text: Therfore bringing them in, he lodged them. And the day folovving he aroſe and vvent vvith them: and certaine of the brethren of Ioppé accompanied him.
label: Acts

text: And on the morow he entred into Cæſaréa. And Cornelius expected them, hauing called together his kinne, and ſpecial frendes.
label: Acts

text: And it came to paſſe, Vvhen Peter vvas come in, Cornelius came to meete him, and falling at his feete adored.
label: Acts

text: But Peter lifted him vp ſaying, Ariſe, my ſelf alſo am a man.
label: Acts

text: And talking vvith him, he vvent in, and findeth many that vvere aſſembled,
label: Acts

text: and he ſaid to them, You knovv hovv abominable it is for a man that is a Ievve, to ioyne, or to approche vnto a ſtranger: but God hath ſhevved to me, to call no man common or vncleane.
label: Acts

text: For the vvhich cauſe, making no doubt, I came vvhen I vvas ſent for. I demaund therfore, for vvhat cauſe you haue ſent for me?
label: Acts

text: And Cornelius ſaid, Foure daies ſince, vntil this houre, I vvas praying the ninthe houre in my houſe, and behold a man ſtoode before me in vvhite apparel,
label: Acts

text: and ſaid: Cornelius, thy praier is heard, and thy almes-deedes are in memorie in the ſight of God.
label: Acts

text: Send therfore to Ioppé, and call hither Simon that is ſurnamed Peter: he lodgeth in the houſe of Simon a tanner by the ſea ſide.
label: Acts

text: Immediatly therfore I ſent to thee: and thou haſt done vvel in comming. Novv therfore al vve are preſent in thy ſight, to heare al things vvhatſoeuer are commaunded thee of the Lord.
label: Acts

text: And Peter opening his mouth, ſaid, In very deede I perceiue that God is not an accepter of perſons.
label: Acts

text: but in euery nation, he that feareth him, and vvorketh iuſtice, is acceptable to him.
label: Acts

text: The word did God ſend to the children of Iſraël, preaching peace by IESVS CHRIST (this is Lord of al.)
label: Acts

text: You knovv the vvord that hath been made through al Ievvrie, for beginning from Galilee, after the baptiſme vvhich Iohn preached.
label: Acts

text: IESVS of Nazareth hovv God anointed him vvith the holy Ghoſt and vvith povver, vvho vvent through out doing good and healing al that vvere oppreſſed of the Deuil, becauſe God vvas vvith him.
label: Acts

text: And vve are vvitneſſes of al things that he did in the countrie of the Ievves and in Hieruſalem, vvhom they killed hanging him vpon a tree.
label: Acts

text: Him God raiſed vp the third day and gaue him to be made manifeſt,
label: Acts

text: not to al the people, but to vs, vvho did eate and drinke vvith him after he roſe againe from the dead.
label: Acts

text: And he commaunded vs to preach to the people, and to teſtifie that it is he that of God vvas appointed iudge of the liuing and of the dead.
label: Acts

text: To him al the prophets giue teſtimonie, that al receiue remiſſion of ſinnes by his name, vvhich beleeue in him. ⊢
label: Acts

text: As Peter vvas yet ſpeaking theſe vvordes, the holy Ghoſt fel vpon al that heard the vvord.
label: Acts

text: And the faithful of the Circumciſion that came with Peter, vvere aſtonied, for that the grace of the holy Ghoſt vvas poured out vpon the Gentiles alſo.
label: Acts

text: For they heard them ſpeaking with tonges, and magnifying God.
label: Acts

text: Then Peter anſvvered, Can any man forbid vvater, that theſe ſhould not be baptized vvhich haue receiued the holy Ghoſt as vvel as vve?
label: Acts

text: And he commaunded them to be baptized in the name of our Lord IESVS CHRIST. ⊢ Then they deſired him that he vvould tarie vvith them certaine daies.
label: Acts

text: AND the Apoſtles and brethren that vvere in Ievvrie, heard that the Gentiles alſo receiued the vvord of God.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen Peter vvas come vp to Hieruſalem, they that vvere of the Circumciſion reaſoned againſt him, ſaying,
label: Acts

text: Vvhy didſt thou enter in to men vncircumciſed, and didſt eate vvith them?
label: Acts

text: But Peter began and declared to them the order, ſaying:
label: Acts

text: I was in the citie of Ioppé praying, & I ſavv in an exceſſe of minde a viſion, a certaine veſſel deſcending as it vvere a great ſheete with foure corners let dovvne from heauen, and it came euen vnto me.
label: Acts

text: Into vvhich I looking conſidered, and ſavv foure footed beaſtes of the earth, and cattel, and ſuch as creepe, and foules of the aire.
label: Acts

text: And I heard alſo a voice ſaying to me, Ariſe Peter, kil and eate.
label: Acts

text: And I ſaid, Not ſo Lord: for common or vncleane thing neuer entred into my mouth.
label: Acts

text: And a voice anſvvered the ſecond time from heauen: That vvhich God hath made cleane, doe not thou call common.
label: Acts

text: And this vvas done thriſe: and al vvere taken vp againe into heauen.
label: Acts

text: And behold, three men immediatly vvere come to the houſe vvherein I vvas, ſent to me from Cæſaréa.
label: Acts

text: And the ſpirit ſaid to me, that I ſhould goe vvith them, doubting nothing. And there came vvith me theſe ſixe brethren alſo: and vve vvent in to the mans houſe.
label: Acts

text: And he told vs, hovv he had ſeen an Angel in his houſe, ſtanding and ſaying to him, Send to Ioppé, and cal hither Simon, that is ſurnamed Peter,
label: Acts

text: vvho ſhal ſpeake to thee vvordes vvherein thou ſhalt be ſaued and al thy houſe.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen I had begonne to ſpeake, the holy Ghoſt fel vpon them, as vpon vs alſo in the beginning.
label: Acts

text: And I remembred the vvord of our Lord, according as he ſaid, Iohn in deede baptized vvith vvater, but you ſhal be baptized vvith the holy Ghoſt.
label: Acts

text: If therfore God hath giuen them the ſame grace, as to vs alſo that beleeued in our Lord IESVS CHRIST: vvho vvas I that might prohibite God?
label: Acts

text: Hauing heard theſe things, they held their peace: and glorified God, ſaying, God then to the Gentiles alſo hath giuen repentance vnto life.
label: Acts

text: And they truely that had been diſperſed by the tribulation that vvas made vnder Steuen, vvalked through out vnto Phœnîce and Cypres & Antioche, ſpeaking the vvord to none, but to the Ievves only.
label: Acts

text: But certaine of them vvere men of Cypres and Cyréne, vvho vvhen they vvere entred into Antioche, ſpake to the Greekes, preaching our Lord IESVS.
label: Acts

text: And the hand of our Lord vvas vvith them: and a great number of beleeuers vvas conuerted to our Lord.
label: Acts

text: And the report came to the eares of the Church that vvas at Hieruſalem, touching theſe things: and they ſent Barnabas as farre as Antioche.
label: Acts

text: Vvho vvhen he vvas come, and ſavv the grace of God, reioyced: and he exhorted al vvith purpoſe of hart to continew in our Lord:
label: Acts

text: becauſe he vvas a good man, and ful of the holy Ghoſt and faith. And a great multitude vvas added to our Lord.
label: Acts

text: And he vvent, forth to Tarſus, to ſeeke Saul:
label: Acts

text: vvhom vvhen he had found, he brought him to Antioche. And they conuerſed there in the church a vvhole yere: and they taught a great multitude, ſo that the diſciples vvere at Antioche firſt named CHRISTIANS.
label: Acts

text: And in theſe daies there came Prophets from Hieruſalem to Antioche,
label: Acts

text: and one of them riſing, named Agabus, did by the Spirit ſignifie a great famine that ſhould be in the vvhole vvorld, vvhich fel vnder Claudius.
label: Acts

text: And the diſciples according as eche man had, purpoſed euery one to ſend, for to ſerue the brethren that dvvelt in Ievvrie:
label: Acts

text: vvhich alſo they did, ſending to the auncients by the handes of Barnabas and Saul.
label: Acts

text: AND at the ſame time Herod the king ſet his handes, to afflicte certaine of the Church.
label: Acts

text: And he killed Iames the brother of Iohn vvith the ſword.
label: Acts

text: And ſeing that it pleaſed the Iewes, he added to apprehend Peter alſo. And it vvas the daies of the Azymes.
label: Acts

text: Vvhom vvhen he had apprehended, he caſt into priſon, deliuering him to foure quaterniõs of ſouldiars to be kept, meaning after the Paſche to bring him forth to the people.
label: Acts

text: And Peter in deede vvas kept in priſon. But praier vvas made of the Church vvithout intermiſſion vnto God for him.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen Herod vvould haue brought him forth, the ſame night Peter vvas ſleeping betwene two ſouldiars, bound vvith tvvo chaines: and the keepers before the doore kept the priſon.
label: Acts

text: And behold an Angel of our Lord ſtoode in preſence: and light ſhined in the houſe: and ſtriking Peters ſide, he raiſed him, ſaying, Ariſe quickely. And the chaines fel from his handes.
label: Acts

text: And the Angel ſaid to him, Gird thee, and put on thy ſhoes. And he did ſo. And he ſaid to him, Put thy garment about thee, & folovv me.
label: Acts

text: And going forth he folovved him, & he knew not that it vvas true vvhich vvas done by the Angel: but he thought that he ſavv a viſion.
label: Acts

text: And paſſing through the firſt & the ſecond vvatch, they came to the yron gate that leadeth to the citie, vvhich of it ſelf opened to them. And going out, they vvent forvvard one ſtreate: and incontinent the Angel departed from him.
label: Acts

text: And Peter returning to him ſelf, ſaid: Novv I know in very deede that our Lord hath ſent his Angel, and deliuered me out of Herods hand, & from al the expectation of the people of the Iewes. ⊢
label: Acts

text: And conſidering, he came to the houſe of Marie the mother of Iohn, who vvas ſurnamed Marke, vvhere many were gathered and praying.
label: Acts

text: And when he knocked at the doore of the gate, there came forth a vvenche to ſee, named Rhodè.
label: Acts

text: And as ſhe knew Peters voice, for ioy ſhe opened not the gate, but running in ſhe told that Peter ſtoode before the gate.
label: Acts

text: But they ſaid to her, Thou art mad. But ſhe affirmed that it vvas ſo. But they ſaid, It is his Angel.
label: Acts

text: And Peter continued knocking. And when they had opened, they ſavv him, & were aſtonied.
label: Acts

text: And beckening with his hand to them, that they ſhould hold their peace, he told hovv our Lord had brought him out of priſon, and he ſaid, Tel theſe things to Iames & to the brethren. And going forth he vvent into an other place.
label: Acts

text: And when day vvas come, there vvas no litle a doe betvvene the ſouldiars, vvhat vvas become of Peter.
label: Acts

text: And Herod, vvhen he had ſought him, and had not found, making inquiſition of the keepers, commaunded them to be led away: & going dovvne from Iewrie into Cæſaréa, there he abode.
label: Acts

text: And he vvas angrie vvith the Tyrians and the Sidonians. But they vvith one accord came to him, and perſuading Blaſtus that vvas cheefe of the kings chamber, they deſired peace, for that their countries vvere nouriſhed by him.
label: Acts

text: And vpon a day appointed, Herod being araied with kingly attire, ſate in the iudgement ſeate, and made an oration to them.
label: Acts

text: And the people made acclamation, The voices of a God, & not of a man.
label: Acts

text: And forthwith an Angel of our Lord ſtrooke him, becauſe he had not giuen the honour to God: and being conſumed of vvormes, he gaue vp the ghoſt.
label: Acts

text: But the vvord of our Lord increaſed and multiplied.
label: Acts

text: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Hieruſalem, hauing accompliſhed their miniſterie, taking vvith them Iohn that vvas ſurnamed Marke.
label: Acts

text: AND there vvere in the Church vvhich vvas at Antioche, Prophets and Doctors, among vvhom vvas Barnabas, & Simon that vvas called Niger, and Lucius of Cyréne, and Manahen vvho was the foſter-brother of Herod the Tetrarch, and Saul.
label: Acts

text: And as they vvere miniſtring to our Lord, and faſting, the holy Ghoſt ſaid: Separate me Saul and Barnabas vnto the vvorke, vvhereto I haue taken them.
label: Acts

text: Then they faſting and praying, and impoſing hands vpon them, dimiſſed them.
label: Acts

text: And they being ſent of the holy Ghoſt, went to Seleucia, and thence ſailed to Cypres.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they vvere come to Salamîna, they preached the vvord of God in the ſynagogs of the Iewes. And they had Iohn alſo in their miniſterie.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they had vvalked through out the vvhole iland as farre as Paphos, they found a certaine man that vvas a magician, a falſe-prophete, a Iew, vvhoſe name vvas ‘Bar-ieſu’,
label: Acts

text: vvho vvas vvith the Proconſul Sergius Paulus a vviſe man. He ſending for Barnabas & Saul, deſired to heare the vvord of God.
label: Acts

text: But Elymas the magician (for ſo is his name interpreted) reſiſted them, ſeeking to auert the Proconſul from the faith.
label: Acts

text: But Saul, othervviſe Paul, repleniſhed vvith the holy Ghoſt, looking vpon him,
label: Acts

text: ſaid: O ful of al guile, and al deceit, ſonne of the deuil, enemie of al iuſtice, thou ceaſeſt not to ſubuert the right vvaies of our Lord.
label: Acts

text: And now behold the hand of our Lord vpon thee, and thou ſhalt be blind, not ſeing the ſunne vntil a time. And forthvvith there fel dimneſſe and darkeneſſe vpon him, and going about he ſought ſome body that vvould giue him his hand.
label: Acts

text: Then the Proconſul, vvhen he had ſeen that vvhich vvas done, beleeued, marueling at the doctrine of our Lord.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen Paul and they that vvere vvith him had ſailed from Paphos, they came to Pergè in Pamphylia. And Iohn departing from them, returned to Hieruſalem.
label: Acts

text: But they paſſing through Pergè, came to Antioche in Piſidia: and entring into the ſynagogue on the day of the Sabboths, they ſate dovvne.
label: Acts

text: And after the leſſon of the Lavv and the Prophets, the princes of the Synagogue ſent to them, ſaying, Men brethren, if there be among you any ſermon of exhortation to the people, ſpeake.
label: Acts

text: And Paul riſing vp, and vvith his hand beckening for ſilence, ſaid, Ye men of Iſraël, and you that feare God, harken:
label: Acts

text: The God of the people of Iſraël choſe our fathers, and exalted the people vvhen they vvere ſeiourners in the land of Ægypt, and in a mightie arme brought them out thereof,
label: Acts

text: and for the ſpace of fourtie yeres tolerated their maners in the deſert.
label: Acts

text: And deſtroying ſeuen nations in the land of Chanaan, by lot he deuided their land among them,
label: Acts

text: as it vvere after foure hundred and fiftie yeres: and after theſe things he gaue Iudges, vntil Samuël the prophet.
label: Acts

text: And thenceforth they deſired a king: and he gaue them Saul the ſonne of Cis, a man of the tribe of Beniamin, fourtie yeres.
label: Acts

text: and remouing him, he raiſed them vp Dauid to be king: to vvhom giuing teſtimonie, he ſaid, I haue found Dauid the ſonne of Ieſſe, a man according to my hart, vvho ſhall doe al my vvilles.
label: Acts

text: Of his ſeede God according to his promiſſe hath brought forth to Iſraël a Sauiour IESVS,
label: Acts

text: Iohn preaching before the face of his comming, baptiſme of penance to al the people of Iſraël.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen Iohn fulfilled his courſe, he ſaid, Vvhom doe you thinke me to be? I am not he, but behold there commeth after me, vvhoſe ſhoes of his feete I am not vvorthie to vnlooſe.
label: Acts

text: Men brethren, children of the ſtocke of Abraham, & they among you that feare God, to you the vvord of this ſaluation vvas ſent.
label: Acts

text: For they that inhabited Hieruſalem, and the princes thereof, not knovving him, nor the voices of the prophets that are read euery Sabboth, iudging haue fulfilled them,
label: Acts

text: and finding no cauſe of death in him, deſired of Pilate, that they might kil him.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they had conſummated al things that vvere vvritten of him, taking him dovvne from the tree, they put him in a monument.
label: Acts

text: But God raiſed him vp from the dead the third day:
label: Acts

text: vvho vvas ſeen for many daies of them that came vp together vvith him from Galilee into Hieruſalem, vvho vntil this preſent are his vvitneſſes to the people.
label: Acts

text: And vve preach vnto you that promiſſe vvhich vvas made to our fathers:
label: Acts

text: that God hath fulfilled this ſame ‘to our children’, raiſing vp IESVS, as in the ſecond Pſalme alſo it is vvritten: My ſonne art thou, this day haue I begotten thee.
label: Acts

text: And that he raiſed him vp from the dead, not to returne novv any more into corruption, thus he ſaid, That I vvil giue you the holy things of Dauid faithful.
label: Acts

text: And therefore in an other place alſo he ſaith, Thou ſhalt not giue thy holy one to ſee corruption.
label: Acts

text: For Dauid in his generation vvhen he had ſerued, according to the vvil of God ſlept: and he vvas laid to his fathers & ſavv corruption.
label: Acts

text: But he vvhom God hath raiſed vp, ſavv no corruption.
label: Acts

text: Be it knovven therfore to you, men brethren, that through him, forgiueneſſe of ſinnes is preached to you, from al the things from the vvhich you could not be iuſtified by the lavv of Moyſes.
label: Acts

text: In him euery one that beleeueth, is iuſtified.
label: Acts

text: Take heede therfore leſt that come vpon you vvhich is ſpoken in the prophets,
label: Acts

text: See ye contemners, and vvonder, and periſh: becauſe I vvorke a vvorke in your daies, a vvorke vvhich you vvil not beleeue, if any man ſhal tel it you.
label: Acts

text: And they going forth, they deſired them that the Sabboth folovving they would ſpeake vnto them theſe wordes.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen the ſynagogue vvas dimiſſed, many of the Ievves, and of the ſtrangers ſeruing God, folovved Paul & Barnabas: vvho ſpeaking exhorted them to continue in the grace of God.
label: Acts

text: But the next Sabboth the vvhole citie almoſt aſſembled to heare the vvord of God.
label: Acts

text: And the Ievves ſeing the multitudes, vvere repleniſhed vvith enuy, & contradicted thoſe things vvhich vvere ſaid of Paul, blaſpheming.
label: Acts

text: Then Paul and Barnabas conſtantly ſaid, To you it behoued vs firſt to ſpeake the vvord of God: but becauſe you repell it, and iudge your ſelues vnvvorthie of eternal life: behold vve turne to the Gentils.
label: Acts

text: For ſo our Lord commaunded vs: I haue put thee to be the light of the Gentils: that thou maieſt be ſaluation vnto the vtmoſt of the earth.
label: Acts

text: And the Gentils hearing it, vvere glad, and glorified the vvord of our Lord: and there beleeued as many as vvere preordinate to life euerlaſting.
label: Acts

text: And the vvord of our Lord vvas ſpred through out the vvhole countrie.
label: Acts

text: But the Ievves ſtirred vp religious and honeſt vvomen, and the cheefe of the citie, and raiſed perſecution againſt Paul and Barnabas: and they did caſt them forth out of their coaſtes.
label: Acts

text: But they ſhaking of the duſt of their feete againſt them, came to Icónium.
label: Acts

text: The diſciples alſo vvere repleniſhed vvith ioy and vvith the holy Ghoſt.
label: Acts

text: AND it came to paſſe at Iconium, that they entred together into the ſynagogue of the Ievves, and ſo ſpake, that a very great multitude of Iewes and of the Greekes did beleeue.
label: Acts

text: But the Iewes that were incredulous, ſtirred vp and incenſed the hartes of the Gentils to anger againſt the brethren.
label: Acts

text: A long time therfore they abode, dealing confidently in our Lord, vvho gaue teſtimonie to the vvord of his grace, graunting ſignes and vvonders to be done by their handes.
label: Acts

text: And the multitude of the citie vvas deuided: and certaine of them in deede vvere vvith the Iewes, but certaine vvith the Apoſtles.
label: Acts

text: And when the Gentils and the Iewes vvith their princes had made an aſſault, to vſe them contumeliouſly, and to ſtone them,
label: Acts

text: vnderſtanding it, they fled to the cities of Lycaónia, Lyſtra and Derbé, and the vvhole countrie about, and there they vvere euangelizing.
label: Acts

text: And a certaine man at Lyſtra impotent of his feete ſate there, lame from his mothers wombe, that neuer had vvalked.
label: Acts

text: This ſame heard Paul ſpeaking. Vvho looking vpon him, and ſeeing that he had faith for to be ſaued,
label: Acts

text: he ſaid vvith a loud voice, Stand vp right on thy feete. And he leaped & vvalked.
label: Acts

text: And the multitudes vvhen they had ſeen vvhat Paul had done, lifted vp their voice in the lycaónian tongue, ſaying, Gods made like to men, are deſcended to vs.
label: Acts

text: And they called Barnabas, Iupiter: but Paul, Mercurie, becauſe he vvas the cheefe ſpeaker.
label: Acts

text: The Prieſt alſo of Iupiter that vvas before the citie, bringing oxen & garlands before the gates, vvould vvith the people ſacrifice.
label: Acts

text: Vvhich thing vvhen the Apoſtles Barnabas & Paul heard, renting their coates, they leaped forth into the multitudes, crying & ſaying,
label: Acts

text: Ye men, vvhy doe you theſe things? Vve alſo are mortal, men like vnto you, preaching to you for to conuert from theſe vaine things, to the liuing God that made the heauen, and the earth, and the ſea, and al things that are in them:
label: Acts

text: vvho in the generations paſt ſuffred al the Gentils to goe their ovvne vvaies.
label: Acts

text: Hovvbeit he left not him ſelf without teſtimonie, being beneficial from heauen, giuing raines, and fruiteful ſeaſons, filling our hartes with foode & gladnes.
label: Acts

text: And ſpeaking theſe things, they ſcarſe appeaſed the multitudes from ſacrificing to them.
label: Acts

text: But there came in certaine Iewes from Antioche and Icónium: and perſuading the multitudes, and ſtoning Paul, they drew him out of the citie, thinking him to be dead.
label: Acts

text: But the diſciples compaſſing him round about, he riſing vp, entred into the citie, and the next day he vvent forth with Barnabas vnto Derbè.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they had euangelized to that citie, and had taught many, they returned to Lyſtra and Icónium, and to Antioche:
label: Acts

text: confirming the hartes of the diſciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that by many tribulations vve muſt enter into the kingdom of God.
label: Acts

text: And when they had ordained to them Prieſts in euery Church, and had praied with faſtings, they commended them to our Lord in whom they beleeued.
label: Acts

text: And paſſing through Piſidia, they came into Pamphylia,
label: Acts

text: and ſpeaking the word of our Lord in Pergé, they went downe into Attalia:
label: Acts

text: and from thence they ſailed to Antioche, whence they had been deliuered to the grace of God vnto the vvorke vvhich they accompliſhed.
label: Acts

text: And when they were come, and had aſſembled the Church, they reported what great things God had done with them, & that he had opened a doore of faith to the Gentils.
label: Acts

text: And they abode no litle time vvith the diſciples.
label: Acts

text: AND certaine comming dovvne from Iewrie, taught the brethren: That vnles you be circumciſed according to the maner of Moyſes, you can not be ſaued.
label: Acts

text: No litle ſedition therfore being riſen to Paul and Barnabas againſt them, they appointed that Paul and Barnabas ſhould goe vp, & certaine others of ‘the reſt’, to the Apoſtles and prieſts vnto Hieruſalem, vpon this queſtion.
label: Acts

text: They therfore being brought on their vvay by the Church, paſſed through Phœnîce and Samaria, reporting the conuerſion of the Gentiles: and they made great ioy to al the brethren.
label: Acts

text: And when they were come to Hieruſalem, they vvere receiued of the Church and of the Apoſtles and Auncients, declaring vvhatſoeuer God had done vvith them.
label: Acts

text: And there aroſe certaine of the hereſie of the Phariſees that beleeued, ſaying, That they muſt be circumciſed, commaunded alſo to keepe the lavv of Moyſes.
label: Acts

text: And the Apoſtles and Auncients aſſembled to conſider of this vvord.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen there vvas made a great diſputation, Peter riſing vp ſaid to them, Men brethren, you knovv that of old daies God among vs choſe, that by my mouth the Gentiles ſhould heare the vvord of the Goſpel, and beleeue.
label: Acts

text: And God vvhich knovveth the hartes, gaue teſtimonie, giuing vnto them the holy Ghoſt as vvel as to vs,
label: Acts

text: and hath put no difference betvvene vs and them, by faith purifying their hartes.
label: Acts

text: Novv therfore vvhy tempt you God, to put a yoke vpon the neckes of the diſciples, vvhich neither our fathers nor vve haue been able to beare?
label: Acts

text: but by the grace of our Lord IESVS CHRIST vve beleeue to be ſaued, in like maner as they alſo.
label: Acts

text: And al the multitude held their peace: and they heard Barnabas and Paul telling vvhat great ſignes and vvonders God had done among the Gentiles by them.
label: Acts

text: And after they held their peace, Iames anſwered, ſaying, Men brethren, heare me.
label: Acts

text: Simon hath told hovv God firſt viſited to take of the Gentiles a people to his name.
label: Acts

text: And to this accord the vvordes of the prophets, as it is vvritten:
label: Acts

text: After theſe things I vvil returne, and vvil reedifie the tabernacle of Dauid, which was fallen, and the ruines thereof I vvil reedifie, and ſet it vp:
label: Acts

text: that the reſidue of men may ſeeke after the Lord, and al nations vpon whom my name is inuocated, ſaith the Lord that doeth theſe things.
label: Acts

text: To our Lord vvas his ovvne vvorke knovven from the beginning of the vvorld.
label: Acts

text: For the vvhich cauſe I iudge, that they vvhich of the Gentiles are conuerted to God, are not to be diſquieted,
label: Acts

text: but to write vnto them that they refraine them ſelues from the contaminations of Idols, and fornication, and ſtrangled things, and bloud.
label: Acts

text: For Moyſes of old times hath in euery citie them that preach him in the ſynagogs, vvhere he is read euery Sabboth.
label: Acts

text: Then it pleaſed the Apoſtles and Auncients vvith the vvhole Church, to choſe men out of them, & to ſend to Antioche vvith Paul and Barnabas, Iudas, vvho vvas ſurnamed Barſabas, & Silas, cheefe men among the brethren,
label: Acts

text: vvriting by their handes. The Apoſtles and Auncients, the brethren, to the brethren of the Gentiles that are at Antioche and in Syria and Cilicia, greeting.
label: Acts

text: Becauſe vve haue heard that certaine going forth from vs, haue troubled you vvith vvordes, ſubuerting your ſoules, to vvhom vve gaue no commaundement:
label: Acts

text: it hath pleaſed vs being gathered in one, to choſe out men and to ſend them vnto you vvith our deereſt Barnabas and Paul,
label: Acts

text: men that haue giuen their liues for the name of our Lord IESVS CHRIST:
label: Acts

text: We haue ſent therfore Iudas & Silas, vvho them ſelues alſo wil in vvordes report vnto you the ſame things.
label: Acts

text: For it hath ſeemed good to the holy Ghoſt & to vs, to lay no further burden vpon you then theſe neceſſarie things:
label: Acts

text: that you abſteine from the things immolated to Idols, and bloud, and that vvhich is ſtrangled, and fornication, from the vvhich things keeping your ſelues, you ſhal doe vvell. Fare ye vvel.
label: Acts

text: They therfore being dimiſſed went downe to Antioche: and gathering the multitude, deliuered the epiſtle.
label: Acts

text: Vvhich vvhen they had read, they reioyced vpon the conſolation:
label: Acts

text: but Iudas and Silas, them Selues alſo being prophets, vvith many vvordes comforted the brethren, and confirmed them.
label: Acts

text: And hauing ſpent ſome time there, they vvere vvith peace dimiſſed of the brethren vnto them that had ſent them.
label: Acts

text: But it ſeemed good vnto Silas to remaine there: and Iudas departed alone:
label: Acts

text: and Paul and Barnabas taried at Antioche, teaching and euangelizing vvith many others the vvord of our Lord.
label: Acts

text: And after certaine daies, Paul ſaid to Barnabas, Let vs returne and viſite our brethren in al cities vvherein vve haue preached the vvord of our Lord, how they doe.
label: Acts

text: And Barnabas vvould haue taken vvith them Iohn alſo that vvas ſurnamed Marke.
label: Acts

text: But Paul deſired that he (as vvho had departed from them out of Pamphylia, and had not gone vvith them to the vvorke) might not be receiued.
label: Acts

text: And there roſe a diſſention, ſo that they departed one from an other, & that Barnabas in deede taking Marke ſailed to Cypres.
label: Acts

text: But Paul choſing Silas departed, being deliuered of the brethren to the grace of God.
label: Acts

text: And he vvalked through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the Churches: commaunding them to keepe the præcepts of the Apoſtles and the Auncients.
label: Acts

text: AND he came to Derbé and Lyſtra. And behold, there vvas a certaine diſciple there named Timothee, the ſonne of `a vvidovv' vvoman that beleeued, of a father a Gentile.
label: Acts

text: To this man the brethren that vvere in Lyſtra and Iconium, gaue a good teſtimonie.
label: Acts

text: Him Paul vvould haue to goe forth vvith him: and taking him he circumciſed him becauſe of the Ievves that vvere in thoſe places. For they al knevv that his father vvas a Gentile.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they paſſed through the cities, they deliuered vnto them to keepe the decrees that vvere decreed of the Apoſtles and Auncients which were at Hieruſalem.
label: Acts

text: And the Churches vvere confirmed in faith, and did abound in number daily.
label: Acts

text: And paſſing through Phrygia and the countrie of Galatia, they vvere forbidden by the holy Ghoſt to preach the vvord in Aſia.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they vvere come into Myſia, they attempted to goe into Bithynia: and the Spirit of IESVS permitted them not.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they had paſſed through Myſia, they vvent dovvne to Troas:
label: Acts

text: and a viſion by night vvas ſhevved to Paul: There vvas a certaine man of Macedónia ſtanding and beſeeching him, and ſaying, paſſe into Macedónia, and helpe vs.
label: Acts

text: And as ſoone as he had ſeen the viſion, forthvvith vve ſought to goe into Macedónia, being aſſured that God had called vs to euangelize to them.
label: Acts

text: And ſailing from Troas, vve came vvith a ſtraight courſe to Samothrácia, and the day folovving to Neapolis:
label: Acts

text: and from thence to Philippi, vvhich is the firſt citie of the part of Macedonia, a colónia. And vve were in this citie certaine daies, abiding.
label: Acts

text: And vpon the day of the Sabboths, vve vvent forth vvithout the gate beſide a riuer, vvhere it ſeemed that there vvas praier: & ſitting vve ſpake to the vvomen that vvere aſſembled.
label: Acts

text: And a certaine vvoman named Lydia, a ſeller of purple of the citie of the Thyatirians, one that vvorſhipped God, did heare: vvhoſe hart our Lord opened to attend to thoſe things vvhich vvere ſaid of Paul.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen ſhe vvas baptized, and her houſe, ſhe beſought vs, ſaying: If you haue iudged me to be faithful to our Lord, enter in vnto my houſe, and tarie. And ſhe conſtrained vs.
label: Acts

text: And it came to paſſe as vve vvent to praier, a certaine vvenche hauing a Pythónical ſpirit, mette vs, that brought great gaine to her maiſters by diuîning.
label: Acts

text: This ſame folovving Paul and vs, cried ſaying, Theſe men are the ſeruants of the high God, vvhich preach vnto you the vvay of ſaluation.
label: Acts

text: And this ſhe did many daies. And Paul being ſorie, and turning, ſaid to the ſpirit, I commaund thee in the name of IESVS CHRIST to goe out from her. And he vvent out the ſame houre.
label: Acts

text: But her maiſters ſeeing that the hope of their gaine vvas gone, apprehending Paul and Silas, brought them into the market place to the Princes:
label: Acts

text: and preſenting them to the magiſtrates, they ſaid, Theſe men trouble our citie, being Ievves:
label: Acts

text: and they preach a faſhion vvhich it is not lavvful for vs to receiue, nor doe, being Romanes.
label: Acts

text: And the people ranne againſt them: and the magiſtrates tearing their coates, commaunded them to be beaten vvith roddes.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they had laid many ſtripes vpon them, they did caſt them into priſon, commaunding the keeper that he ſhould keepe them diligently.
label: Acts

text: VVho vvhen he had receiued ſuch commaundement, caſt them into the inner priſon, and made their feete faſt in the ſtockes.
label: Acts

text: And at mid-night, Paul and Silas praying, did praiſe God. And they that vvere in priſon, heard them.
label: Acts

text: But ſodenly there vvas made a great earthquake, ſo that the foundations of the priſon vvere ſhaken. And forthvvith al the doores vvere opened: and the bands of al vvere looſed.
label: Acts

text: And the keeper of the priſon vvaked out of his ſleepe, and ſeeing the doores of the priſon opened, dravving out his ſvvord, vvould haue killed him ſelf, ſuppoſing that the priſoners had been fled.
label: Acts

text: But Paul cried vvith a loud voice, ſaying, Doe thy ſelf no harme, for vve are al here.
label: Acts

text: And calling for light, he vvent in, and trembling fel dovvne to Paul and Silas at their feete:
label: Acts

text: and bringing them forth, he ſaid, Maiſters, vvhat muſt I doe that I may be ſaued?
label: Acts

text: But they ſaid, Beleeue in our Lord IESVS: and thou ſhalt be ſaued and thy houſe.
label: Acts

text: And they preached the vvord of our Lord to him vvith al that vvere in his houſe.
label: Acts

text: And he taking them in the ſame houre of the night, c vvaſhed their vvoundes: and him ſelf vvas baptized and al his houſe incontinent.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen he had brought them into his ovvne houſe, he laid the table for them, and reioyced vvith al his houſe, beleeuing God.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen day vvas come, the magiſtrates ſent the ſergeants, ſaying, Let thoſe men goe.
label: Acts

text: And the keeper of the priſon told theſe vvordes to Paul, That the magiſtrates haue ſent that you ſhould be let goe. novv therfore departing, goe ye in peace.
label: Acts

text: But Paul ſaid to them: Being vvhipped openly, vncõdemned, men that are Romanes, they haue caſt vs into priſon: & novv do they ſend vs out ſecretly? Not ſo, but let them come, & let vs out them ſelues.
label: Acts

text: And the ſergeants reported theſe wordes to the magiſtrates. And they vvere afraid hearing that they vvere Romanes:
label: Acts

text: and comming they beſought them, & bringing them forth they deſired them to depart out of the citie.
label: Acts

text: And going out of the priſon, they entred in vnto Lydia: and hauing ſeen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.
label: Acts

text: AND vvhen they had vvalked through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Theſſalonica, vvhere there vvas a ſynagogue of the Iewes.
label: Acts

text: And Paul according to his cuſtome entred in vnto them, & three Sabboths he diſcourſed to them out of the Scriptures,
label: Acts

text: declaring and inſinuating that it behoued CHRIST to ſuffer and to riſe againe from the dead: and that this is IESVS CHRIST, vvhom I preach to you.
label: Acts

text: And certaine of them beleeued, and vvere ioyned to Paul and Silas, and of the Gentiles that ſerued God a great multitude, and noble vvomen not a fevv.
label: Acts

text: But the Ievves enuying, & taking vnto them of the raſcal ſort certaine naughtie men, and making a tumult, ſtirred the citie: and beſetting Iaſons houſe, ſought to bring them forth vnto the people.
label: Acts

text: And not finding them, they drevv Iaſon and certaine brethren to the princes of the citie, crying, That theſe are they that ſtirre vp the vvorld, and are come hither,
label: Acts

text: vvhom Iaſon hath receiued, and al theſe doe againſt the decrees of Cæſar, ſaying that there is an other king, IESVS.
label: Acts

text: And they moued the people, and the princes of the citie hearing theſe things.
label: Acts

text: And taking a ſatisfaction of Iaſon and of the reſt, they dimiſſed them.
label: Acts

text: But the brethren forthwith by night ſent away Paul and Silas vnto Berœa. Vvho vvhen they vvere come, entred into the ſynagogue of the Iewes.
label: Acts

text: (And theſe were more noble then they that are at Theſſalonica, vvho receiued the vvord vvith al greedines, daily ſearching the ſcriptures, if theſe things vvere ſo.
label: Acts

text: And many ſurely of them beleeued, and of honeſt women Gentiles, and men not a few.)
label: Acts

text: And vvhen the Iewes in Theſſalonica vnderſtood, that at Berœa alſo the vvord of God was preached by Paul, they came thither alſo, mouing and troubling the multitude.
label: Acts

text: And then immediatly the brethren ſent away Paul, to goe vnto the ſea: but Silas and Timothee remained there.
label: Acts

text: And they that conducted Paul, brought him as farre as Athens, and receiuing commaundement of him to Silas and Timothee, that they ſhould come to him very ſpeedily, they departed.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen Paul expected them at Athens, his ſpirit vvas incenſed vvithin him, ſeeing the citie giuen to Idolatrie.
label: Acts

text: He diſputed therfore in the ſynagogue vvith the Ievves, & them that ſerued God, and in the market-place, euery day vvith them that were there.
label: Acts

text: And certaine Philoſophers of the Epicures and the Stoikes diſputed vvith him, and certaine ſaid, Vvhat is it that this b vvord-ſovver vvould ſay? But others, He ſeemeth to be a preacher of nevv c gods. becauſe he preached to them IESVS and the reſurrection.
label: Acts

text: And apprehending him, they led him to Areopagus, ſaying, May vve know vvhat this new doctrine is that thou ſpeakeſt of?
label: Acts

text: for thou bringeſt in certaine nevv things to our eares. Vve vvil know therfore vvhat theſe things may meane.
label: Acts

text: ( And al the Athenians, and the ſtrangers ſeiourning there, emploied them ſelues to nothing els but either to ſpeake, or to heare ſome newes.)
label: Acts

text: But Paul ſtanding in the middes of Areopagus, ſaid: Ye men of Athens, in al things I perceiue you as it vvere ſuperſtitious.
label: Acts

text: For paſſing by and ſeeing your c Idols, I found an altar alſo vvherevpon vvas vvritten, To the vnknowen God. That therfore vvhich you vvorſhippe, not knovving it, the ſame do I preach to you.
label: Acts

text: The God that made the vvorld and al things that are in it, he being Lord of heauen & earth, dvvelleth not in temples made vvith hand,
label: Acts

text: neither is he ſerued vvith mens hands, needing any thing, vvhereas him ſelf giueth life vnto al, and breathing, and al things:
label: Acts

text: and he made of one al mankinde, to inhabite vpon the vvhole face of the earth, aſſigning ſet times, and the limits of their habitation,
label: Acts

text: for to ſeeke God, if happily they may feele or finde him, although he be not farre from euery one of vs.
label: Acts

text: For in him vve liue and moue and be, as certaine alſo of your ovvne poëtes ſaid, For of his kinde alſo vve are.
label: Acts

text: Being therfore of Gods kinde, vve may not ſuppoſe, the Diuinitie to be like vnto gold or ſiluer, or ſtone, the grauing of art and deuiſe of man.
label: Acts

text: And the times truely of this ignorance vvhereas God diſpiſed, novv he denounceth vnto men that al euery vvhere doe penance,
label: Acts

text: for that he hath appointed a day wherein he vvil iudge the world in equitie, by a man whom he hath appointed, giuing al men faith, rayſing him vp from the dead.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they had heard the reſurrection of the dead, certaine in deede mocked, but certaine ſaid, Vve vvil heare thee againe concerning this point.
label: Acts

text: So Paul vvent forth out of the middes of them.
label: Acts

text: But certaine men ioyning vnto him, did beleeue: among vvhom vvas alſo Dionyſius Areopagîta, and a vvoman named Dámaris, and others vvith them. ⊢
label: Acts

text: AFTER theſe things, departing from Athens, he came to Corinth.
label: Acts

text: and finding a certaine Iew, named Aquila, borne in Pontus, vvho of late vvas come out of Italie, and Priſcilla his vvife (becauſe Claudius had commaunded al Iewes to depart from Rome,) he came to them.
label: Acts

text: And becauſe he vvas of the ſame craft, he remained with them, and wrought, (and they vvere tentmakers by their craft.)
label: Acts

text: And he diſputed in the ſynagogue euery Sabboth, interpoſing the name of our Lord IESVS, and he exhorted the Iewes and the Greekes.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen Silas and Timothee vvere come from Macedonia, Paul vvas inſtant in preaching, teſtifying to the Iewes that IESVS is CHRIST.
label: Acts

text: But they contradicting and blaſpheming, he ſhaking his garments, ſaid to them, Your bloud vpon your ovvne head: I being cleane, from hence forth vvil goe to the Gentiles.
label: Acts

text: And departing thence, he entred into the houſe of a certaine man, named Titus Iuſtus, one that ſerued God, vvhoſe houſe vvas adioyning to the ſynagogue.
label: Acts

text: And Criſpus the prince of the Synagogue beleeued our Lord, vvith al his houſe: and many of the Corinthians hearing beleeued, and vvere baptized.
label: Acts

text: And our Lord ſaid in the night by a viſion to Paul, Doe not feare, but ſpeake, and hold not thy peace,
label: Acts

text: for-becauſe I am vvith thee: and no man ſhal ſet vpon thee to hurt thee: for I haue much people in this citie.
label: Acts

text: And he ſate there a yere & ſixe moneths, teaching among them the vvord of God.
label: Acts

text: But Gallio being Proconſul of Achaia, the Iewes vvith one accord roſe vp againſt Paul, and brought him to the iudgement ſeate,
label: Acts

text: ſaying, That this man contrarie to the Law perſuadeth men to worſhippe God.
label: Acts

text: And Paul beginning to open his mouth, Gallio ſaid to the Iewes, If it vvere ſome vniuſt thing, or an heinous facte, O you men Iewes, I ſhould by reaſon beare you.
label: Acts

text: But if they be queſtions of vvord & names, and of your law, your ſelues looke vnto it: I vvil not be iudge of theſe things.
label: Acts

text: And he droue them from the iudgement ſeate.
label: Acts

text: And al apprehending Sóſthenes the prince of the ſynagogue, ſtrooke him before the iudgement ſeate: and Gallio cared for none of thoſe things.
label: Acts

text: But Paul vvhen he had ſtaied yet many daies, taking his leaue of the brethren, ſailed to Syria, (and vvith him Priſcilla and Aquila,) vvho had ſhorne his head in Cenchris. for he had a vow.
label: Acts

text: And he came vnto Epheſus, and them he left there. But him ſelf entring into the ſynagogue, diſputed vvith the Iewes.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they deſired him, that he would tarie a longer time, he conſented not,
label: Acts

text: but taking his leaue, and ſaying, I vvil returne to you againe God vvilling, he departed from Epheſus.
label: Acts

text: And going dovvne to Cæſaréa, he vvent vp, and ſaluted the Church, and came downe to Antioche.
label: Acts

text: And hauing taried there a certaine time, he departed, vvalking in order through the countrie of Galatia and Phrygia, confirming al the diſciples.
label: Acts

text: And a certaine Iew, named Apollo, borne at Alexandria, an eloquent man, came to Epheſus, mighty in the ſcriptures.
label: Acts

text: This man was taught the vvay of our Lord: and being feruent in ſpirit he ſpake, and taught diligently thoſe things that pertaine to IESVS, knovving only the baptiſme of Iohn.
label: Acts

text: This man therfore began to deale confidently in the ſynagogue. Vvhom vvhen Priſcilla and Aquila had heard, they tooke him vnto them, and expounded to him the vvay of our Lord more diligently.
label: Acts

text: And vvhereas he vvas deſirous to goe to Achaia, the brethren exhorting vvrote to the diſciples to receiue him. Vvho, vvhen he vvas come, profited them much that had beleeued.
label: Acts

text: For he vvith vehemencie conuinced the Iewes openly, ſhewing by the ſcriptures, that IESVS is CHRIST.
label: Acts

text: AND it came to paſſe vvhen Apollo vvas at Corinth, that Paul hauing gone through the higher partes came to Epheſus, and found certaine diſciples:
label: Acts

text: and he ſaid to them, Haue you receiued the holy Ghoſt, beleeuing? But they ſaid to him, Nay, neither haue vve heard Whether there be a holy Ghoſt.
label: Acts

text: But he ſaid, In vvhat then vvere you baptized? Vvho ſaid, c In Iohns baptiſme.
label: Acts

text: And Paul ſaid: Iohn baptized the people vvith the baptiſme of penance, ſaying: That they ſhould beleeue in him that vvas to come after him, that is to ſay, c in IESVS.
label: Acts

text: Hearing theſe things, they vvere baptized in the name of our Lord IESVS.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen Paul had impoſed hands on them, the holy Ghoſt came vpon them, and they ſpake vvith tongues, and prophecied.
label: Acts

text: And all the men vvere about tvvelue.
label: Acts

text: And entring in to the ſynagogue, he ſpake confidently for three moneths, diſputing and exhorting of the kingdom of God. ⊢
label: Acts

text: But vvhen certaine vvere indûrate, and beleeued not, il-ſpeaking the vvay of our Lord before the multitude, departing from them, he ſeparated the diſciples, daily diſputing in the ſchole of one Tyrannus.
label: Acts

text: An this vvas done for the ſpace of tvvo yeres, ſo that al vvhich dvvelt in Aſia, heard the vvord of our Lord, Iewes and Gentils.
label: Acts

text: And God vvrought by the hand of Paul miracles not common:
label: Acts

text: ſo that there were alſo brought from his body napkins or handkerchefs vpon the ſicke, and the diſeaſes departed from them, and the vvicked ſpirits vvent out.
label: Acts

text: And certaine alſo of the Iudaical exorciſts that vvent about, aſſaied to inuocate vpon them that had euil ſpirits, the name of our Lord IESVS, ſaying, I adiure you by IESVS vvhom Paul preacheth.
label: Acts

text: And there vvere certaine ſonnes of Sceua a Iewe, cheefe prieſt, ſeuen, that did this.
label: Acts

text: But the vvicked ſpirit anſwering, ſaid to them, IESVS I know, and Paul I knovv: but you, what are ye?
label: Acts

text: And the man in whom the wicked ſpirit vvas, leaping vpon them, and maſtring `both', preuailed againſt them, ſo that they fled out of that houſe naked and vvounded.
label: Acts

text: And this vvas made notorious to al the Iewes and the Gentiles that dwelt at Epheſus: and feare fel vpon al them, and the name of our Lord IESVS vvas magnified.
label: Acts

text: And many of them that beleeued, came confeſſing and declaring their deedes.
label: Acts

text: And many of them that had folovved curious things, brought together their bookes, and burnt them before al: and counting the prices of them, they found the money to be fiftie thouſand pence.
label: Acts

text: So mightely increaſed the vvord of God and vvas confirmed.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen theſe things vvere ended, Paul purpoſed in the Spirit, vvhen he had paſſed through Macedonia and Achaia, to goe to Hieruſalem, ſaying, After I ſhall haue been there, I muſt ſee Rome alſo.
label: Acts

text: And ſending into Macedonia tvvo of them that miniſtred vnto him, Timothee and Eraſtus, him ſelf remained for a time in Aſia.
label: Acts

text: And at that time there vvas made no litle trouble about the way of our Lord.
label: Acts

text: For one named Demetrius, a ſiluerſmith, that made ſiluer c temples of Diána, procured to the artificers no ſmal gaine:
label: Acts

text: whom calling together and them that were the ſame kinde of workemen, he ſaid, Sirs, you know that our gaine is of this occupation:
label: Acts

text: and you ſee, and heare that this ſame Paul by perſuaſion hath auerted a great multitude not only of Epheſus, but almoſt of al Aſia, ſaying, That they are not gods vvhich be made by handes.
label: Acts

text: And not only vnto vs is this part in danger to be reproued, but alſo the temple of great Diana ſhal be reputed for nothing, yea & her maieſtie ſhal begin to be deſtroied, vvhom al Aſia & the vvorld worſhippeth.
label: Acts

text: Hearing theſe things, they were repleniſhed with anger, and cried out ſaying, Great is Diana of the Epheſians.
label: Acts

text: And the vvhole citie vvas filled vvith confuſion, & they ranne violently vvith one accord into the theátre, catching Gaius and Ariſtarchus Macedonians, Paules companions.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen Paul vvould haue entred in to the people, the diſciples did not permit him.
label: Acts

text: And certaine alſo of the Princes of Aſia that vvere his frendes, ſent vnto him, deſyring that he vvould not aduenture him ſelf into the theátre:
label: Acts

text: and others cried an other thing. For the aſſemblie vvas confuſe, & the more part knevv not for what cauſe they were aſſembled.
label: Acts

text: And of the multitude they drevv forth Alexander, the Ievves thruſting him forvvard. But Alexander vvith his hand deſyring ſilence, vvould haue giuen the people ſatisfaction.
label: Acts

text: Vvhom as ſoone as they perceiued to be a Iewe, there vvas made one voice of al, almoſt for the ſpace of tvvo houres crying out, Great is Diana of the Epheſians.
label: Acts

text: And when the Scribe had appeaſed the multitudes, he ſaith, Ye men of Epheſus, for vvhat man is there that knovveth not the citie of the Epheſians to be a vvorſhipper of great Diana, & c Iupiters childe?
label: Acts

text: Foraſmuch therfore as theſe things can not be gainſaid, you muſt be quieted, and doe nothing raſhly.
label: Acts

text: For you haue brought theſe men, being neither ſacrilegious, nor blaſpheming your Goddeſſe.
label: Acts

text: But if Demetrius and the artificers that are vvith him, haue matter to ſay againſt any man, there are Courtes kept in the common place, & there are Proconſuls, let them accuſe one an other.
label: Acts

text: And if you aſke any other matter: it may be reſolued in a lavvful aſſemblie.
label: Acts

text: For we are in danger alſo to be accuſed for this daies ſedition: vvhereas there is no man guilty by vvhom vve may giue an account of this concourſe. And vvhen he had ſaid theſe things, he dimiſſed the aſſemblie.
label: Acts

text: AND after that the tumult was ceaſed, Paul calling the diſciples, and exhorting them, tooke his leaue, and ſet forvvard to goe into Macedonia.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen he had vvalked through thoſe partes, & had exhorted them vvith much ſpeach, he came to Greece:
label: Acts

text: vvhere when he had ſpent three moneths, the Iewes laid wait for him as he was about to ſaile into Syria: and he had councel to returne through Macedonia.
label: Acts

text: And there accompanied him Soſipater of Pyrrhus, of Berœa: and of Theſſalonians, Ariſtarchus, and Secundus: and Caius of Derbè, and Timothee: and of Aſia, Tychicus and Tróphimus.
label: Acts

text: Theſe going before, ſtaied for vs at Troas:
label: Acts

text: but vve ſailed after the daies of Azymes from Philippi, and came to them vnto Troas in fiue daies, vvhere vve abode ſeuen daies.
label: Acts

text: And in the firſt of the Sabboth vvhen we vvere aſſembled to breake bread, Paul diſputed with them, being to depart on the morow, and he continued the ſermon vntil midnight.
label: Acts

text: And there vvere a great number of lampes in the vpper chamber vvhere vve vvere aſſembled.
label: Acts

text: And a certaine yong man named Eútychus, ſitting vpon the window, vvhereas he vvas oppreſſed vvith heauy ſleepe ( Paul diſputing long) driuen by ſleepe, fel from the third loft downe, and was taken vp dead.
label: Acts

text: To whom when Paul was gone dovvne, he lay vpon him: and embracing him he ſaid, Be not troubled, for his ſoule is in him.
label: Acts

text: And going vp and breaking bread and taſting, and hauing talked ſufficiently to them vntil day light, ſo he departed.
label: Acts

text: And they brought the lad aliue, and were not a litle comforted.
label: Acts

text: But we going vp into the ſhip, ſailed to Aſſon, from thence meaning to receiue Paul. for ſo he had ordained, him ſelf purpoſing to iourney by land.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen he had found vs in Aſſon, taking him with vs vve came to Mityléne.
label: Acts

text: And ſailing thence, the day folovving vve came ouer againſt Chios: and the other day we arriued at Samos: and the day folovving vve came to Milétum.
label: Acts

text: for Paul had purpoſed to ſaile leauing Epheſus, leſt any ſtay ſhould be made him in Aſia. For he haſtened, if it vvere poſſible for him, to keepe the day of Pentecoſt at Hieruſalem.
label: Acts

text: And ſending from Milétum to Epheſus, he called the c Auncients of the Church.
label: Acts

text: Who being come to him, and aſſembled together, he ſaid to them, You knovv from the firſt day that I entred into Aſia, in vvhat maner I haue been vvith you al the time,
label: Acts

text: ſeruing our Lord vvith al humilitie and teares, and tentations that did chaunce to me by the conſpiracies of the Iewes:
label: Acts

text: Hovv I haue vvithdravven nothing that vvas profitable, but that I preached it to you, & taught you openly and from houſe to houſe,
label: Acts

text: teſtifying to Iewes and Gentils penance tovvard God and faith in our Lord IESVS CHRIST.
label: Acts

text: And now behold, being bound by the ſpirit, I goe to Hieruſalem: not knovving vvhat things ſhal befall me in it,
label: Acts

text: but that the Holy Ghoſt through out al cities doth proteſt to me, ſaying: that bands and tribulations abide me at Hieruſalem.
label: Acts

text: But I feare none of theſe things, neither doe I make my life more pretious then my ſelf, ſo that I may cōſúmat my courſe & miniſterie vvhich I receiued of our Lord IESVS, to teſtifie the Goſpel of the grace of God.
label: Acts

text: And novv behold I doe knovv, that you ſhal no more ſee my face al you, through whom I haue paſſed preaching the kingdom of God.
label: Acts

text: Wherefore I take you to witneſſe this preſent day that I am cleere from the bloud of al.
label: Acts

text: For I haue not ſpared to declare vnto you al the counſel of God.
label: Acts

text: Take heede to your ſelues and to the vvhole flocke vvherein the Holy Ghoſt hath placed you biſhops, to rule the Church of God vvhich he hath purchaſed with his ovvne bloud.
label: Acts

text: I knovv that after my departure there vvil rauening wolues enter in among you, not ſparing the flocke.
label: Acts

text: And out of your ovvne ſelues ſhal ariſe men ſpeaking peruerſe things, to draw avvay diſciples after them ſelues.
label: Acts

text: For the vvhich cauſe be vigilant, keeping in memorie that for three yeres night and day I ceaſed not with teares to admoniſh euery one of you.
label: Acts

text: And now I commend you to God and to the vvord of his grace, vvho is able to edifie, and to giue inheritance in al the ſanctified.
label: Acts

text: No mans ſiluer and gold or garment haue I coueted.
label: Acts

text: Your ſelues knovv that for ſuch things as vvere needful for me and them that are vvith me, theſe hands haue miniſtred.
label: Acts

text: I haue ſhevved you al things, that ſo labouring, you muſt receiue the vveake, and remember the vvord of our Lord IESVS, becauſe he ſaid, It is a more bleſſed thing to giue rather then to take.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen he had ſaid theſe things, falling on his knees he praied vvith al them.
label: Acts

text: And there vvas great vveeping made of al, and falling vpon the necke of Paul, they kiſſed him,
label: Acts

text: being ſorie moſt of al for the vvord which he had ſaid, that they ſhould ſee his face no more. And they brought him going vnto the ſhippe.
label: Acts

text: AND when it came to paſſe that vve ſailed, being caried from them, with a ſtraight courſe we came to Coos, and the day folowing to Rhodes, and from thence to Patara.
label: Acts

text: And when vve had found a ſhip that paſſed ouer to Phœnice, going vp into it we ſailed.
label: Acts

text: And when we were in the ſight of Cypres, leauing it on the left hand, vve ſailed into Syria, and came to Tyre: for there the ſhip vvas to diſcharge her lode.
label: Acts

text: And finding diſciples, vve taried there ſeuen daies: vvho ſaid to Paul by the Spirit, that he ſhould not goe vp to Hieruſalem.
label: Acts

text: And the daies being expired, departing vve went forvvard, al bringing vs on the vvay, vvith their vviues and children, til vve vvere out of the citie: and falling vpon our knees on the ſhore, vve praied.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen vve had bid one an other farevvel, vve vvent vp into the ſhip: and they returned vnto their owne.
label: Acts

text: But we hauing ended the nauigation, from Tyre came dovvne to Ptolomáis: and ſaluting the brethren, vve taried one day with them.
label: Acts

text: And the next day departing, vve came to Cæſaréa. And entring into the houſe of Philip the Euangeliſt, vvho vvas one of the ſeuen, vve taried with him.
label: Acts

text: And he had foure daughters virgins, that did prophecie.
label: Acts

text: And as we abode there for certaine daies, there came a certaine prophet from Ievvrie, named Agabus.
label: Acts

text: He, when he was come to vs, tooke Paules girdle: and binding his owne handes & feete, he ſaid, Thus ſaith the holy Ghoſt: The man whoſe girdle this is, ſo ſhal the Iewes binde in Hieruſalem, & ſhal deliuer him into the handes of the Gentiles.
label: Acts

text: Which when vve had heard, vve & they that vvere of the ſame place, deſired him that he would not goe vp to Hieruſalem.
label: Acts

text: Then Paul anſvvered, and ſaid, What doe you, vveeping and afflicting my hart? for I am ready not only to be bound, but to die alſo in Hieruſalem for the name of our Lord IESVS.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen vve could not perſuade him, we ceaſed, ſaying, The vvil of our Lord be done.
label: Acts

text: And after theſe daies, being prepared, vve vvent vp to Hieruſalem.
label: Acts

text: And there came alſo of the diſciples from Cæſaréa vvith vs, bringing with them one Iaſon a Cyprian (vvith vvhom vve ſhould lodge) an old diſciple.
label: Acts

text: And when vve vvere come to Hieruſalem, the brethren receiued vs gladly.
label: Acts

text: And the day folovving Paul vvent in vvith vs to Iames, and al the Auncients vvere aſſembled.
label: Acts

text: Vvhom vvhen he had ſaluted, he told particularly vvhat God had done among the Gentiles by his miniſterie.
label: Acts

text: But they hearing it, magnified God, and ſaid to him: Thou ſeeſt (brother) how many thouſands there are among the Ievves that haue beleeued: and al are zelátours of the Lavv.
label: Acts

text: But they haue heard of thee that thou doeſt teach thoſe Iewes that are among the Gentiles, to depart from Moyſes: ſaying that they ought not to circumciſe their children, nor vvalke according to the cuſtome.
label: Acts

text: What is it then? needes muſt the multitude aſſemble: for they vvil heare that thou art come.
label: Acts

text: Doe this therfore vvhich vve tel thee, There are vvith vs foure men, that haue a vow on them.
label: Acts

text: Taking theſe vnto thee, ſanctifie thy ſelf vvith them: and beſtovv on them, that they may ſhaue their heads: and al ſhal knovv that the things vvhich they heard of thee, are falſe: but that thy ſelf alſo walkeſt keeping the Law.
label: Acts

text: But concerning them that beleeue of the Gentils, vve haue written, decreeing that they ſhould refraine them ſelues from the immolated to Idols, and bloud, and ſuffocated, and fornication.
label: Acts

text: Then Paul taking the men vnto him, the next day being purified vvith them entred into the temple, ſhevving the accompliſhment of the daies of the purification, vntil an oblation vvas offered for euery one of them.
label: Acts

text: But vvhiles the ſeuen daies were a finiſhing, thoſe Ievves that vvere of Aſia, vvhen they had ſeen him in the temple, ſtirred vp al the people, and laid handes vpon him,
label: Acts

text: crying, Ye men of Iſraël, help: this is the man that againſt the people & the Law and this place teaching al men euery where, hath alſo moreouer brought in Gentiles into the temple, and hath violated this holy place.
label: Acts

text: (For they had ſeen Tróphimus the Epheſian in the citie vvith him, vvhom they ſuppoſed that Paul had brought into the temple.)
label: Acts

text: And the vvhole citie vvas in an vproare: and there vvas made a concourſe of the people. And apprehending Paul, they drevve him forth of the temple: and immediatly the doores vvere ſhut.
label: Acts

text: And as they ſought to kil him, it vvas told the Tribune of the band, That al Hieruſalem is in a confuſion.
label: Acts

text: Vvho forthvvith taking vnto him ſouldiars & Centurions, ranne downe to them. Who, when they had ſeen the Tribune and the ſouldiars, ceaſed to ſtrike Paul.
label: Acts

text: Then the Tribune comming neere apprehended him, and commaunded him to be bound vvith tvvo chaines: and he demaunded vvho he vvas, and what he had done.
label: Acts

text: And ſome cried one thing, ſome an other, in the multitude. And vvhereas he could not knovv the certaintie for the tumult, he commaunded him to be led c into the caſtel.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen he vvas come to the ſtaires, it chaunced that he vvas caried of the ſouldiars becauſe of the violence of the people.
label: Acts

text: For the multitude of the people folovved, crying, Avvay vvith him.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen Paul began to be brought into the caſtel, he ſaith to the Tribune, Is it lavvful for me to ſpeake ſome thing to thee? Vvho ſaid, Canſt thou ſpeake Greeke?
label: Acts

text: Art not thou the Ægyptian that before theſe daies did raiſe a tumult, and didſt lead forth into the deſert foure thouſand men that vvere murderers?
label: Acts

text: And Paul ſaid to him, I am a man truely a Iewe of Tarſus, a citizen not of an obſcure citie of Cilicia. And I deſire thee, permit me to ſpeake to the people.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen he had permitted him, Paul ſtanding on the ſtaiers, beckened with his hand to the people. and great ſilence being made, he ſpake vnto them in the Hebrevv tongue, ſaying.
label: Acts

text: MEN brethren and fathers, heare vvhat account I doe render novv vnto you.
label: Acts

text: (And vvhen they had heard that he ſpake to them in the Hebrevv tongue, they did the more keepe ſilence.
label: Acts

text: And he ſaith,) I am a man a Iewe, borne at Tarſus in Cilicia, but brought vp in this citie, at the feete of Gamaliel inſtructed according to the veritie of the law of the fathers, an emulátour of the Law as alſo al you are this day:
label: Acts

text: who perſecuted this vvay vnto death, binding & deliuering into cuſtodies men & women,
label: Acts

text: as the high Prieſt doth giue me teſtimonie, and al the auncients. of vvhom receiuing letters alſo to the brethren, I vvent to Damaſcus, that I might bring them thence bound to Hieruſalem, to be puniſhed.
label: Acts

text: And it came to paſſe as I vvas going, and drawing nigh to Damaſcus at midday, ſodenly from heauen there ſhone round about me much light:
label: Acts

text: and falling on the ground, I heard a voice ſaying to me, Saul, Saul, vvhy perſecuteſt thou me?
label: Acts

text: And I anſwered, Vvho art thou Lord? And he ſaid to me, I am IESVS of Nazareth, vvhom thou perſecuteſt.
label: Acts

text: And they that vvere vvith me, ſavv the light in deede, but the voice they heard not of him that ſpake with me.
label: Acts

text: And I ſaid, Vvhat ſhal I doe Lord? And our Lord ſaid to me, Ariſe and goe to Damaſcus: and there it ſhal be told thee of al things that thou muſt doe.
label: Acts

text: And vvhereas I did not ſee for the brightneſſe of that light, being led of my companions by the hand, I came to Damaſcus.
label: Acts

text: And one Ananias, a man according to the Law hauing teſtimonie of al the Ievves inhabitants,
label: Acts

text: comming to me, and ſtanding by me, ſaid to me, Brother Saul, looke vp. And I the ſelf ſame houre looked vp on him.
label: Acts

text: But he ſaid, The God of our fathers hath prëordained thee, that thou ſhouldeſt knovv his wil, and ſee the iuſt one, and heare a voice from his mouth:
label: Acts

text: becauſe thou ſhalt be his witnes to al men, of thoſe things vvhich thou haſt ſeen and heard.
label: Acts

text: And now what tarieſt thou? Riſe vp, and be baptized, & vvaſh avvay thy ſinnes inuocating his name.
label: Acts

text: And it befel me returning into Hieruſalem, and praying in the temple, that I vvas in a traunce,
label: Acts

text: and ſavv him ſaying vnto me, Make haſt, and depart quickely out of Hieruſalem: becauſe they vvil not receiue thy teſtimonie of me.
label: Acts

text: And I ſaid, Lord, they know that I did caſt into priſon and beate in euery ſynagogue them that beleeued in thee.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen the bloud of Steuen thy c vvitnes vvas ſhed, I ſtoode by and conſented, and kept the garments of them that killed him.
label: Acts

text: And he ſaid to me, Goe, for into the Gentiles a farre vvil I ſend thee.
label: Acts

text: And they heard him vntil this vvord, and they lifted vp their voice, ſaying, Avvay vvith ſuch an one from the earth: for it is not meete he ſhould liue.
label: Acts

text: And when they cried out, and threvv off their garments, and caſt duſt into the aire,
label: Acts

text: the Tribune commaunded him to be caried into the caſtel, and to be beaten with vvhippes, and that he ſhould be tormented: to know for vvhat cauſe they did ſo crie at him.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they had bound him very ſtraight vvith thongs, Paul ſaith to the Centurion ſtanding by him: Is it lavvful for you to whippe a man that is a Romane and vncondemned?
label: Acts

text: Vvhich the Centurion hearing, vvent to the Tribune, and told him, ſaying, Vvhat wilt thou doe? for this man is a citizen of Rome.
label: Acts

text: And the Tribune comming, ſaid to him, Tel me, art thou a Romane? But he ſaid, Yea.
label: Acts

text: And the Tribune anſwered, I obtained this citie vvith a great ſumme. And Paul ſaid, But I was alſo borne to it.
label: Acts

text: Immediatly therfore they departed from him that vvere to torment him. The Tribune alſo feared after he vnderſtoode that he was a citizē of Rome, and becauſe he had bound him.
label: Acts

text: But the next day meaning to know more diligently for vvhat cauſe he vvas accuſed of the Ievves, he looſed him, and commaunded the c Prieſts to come together and al the Councel: & bringing forth Paul, he ſet him among them.
label: Acts

text: AND Paul looking vpon the Councel, ſaid, Men brethren, I vvith al good conſcience haue conuerſed before God, vntil this preſent day.
label: Acts

text: And the high Prieſt Ananias commaunded them that ſtoode by him, to ſmite him on the mouth.
label: Acts

text: Then Paul ſaid to him, God ſhal ſtrike thee, thou whited vvall. And thou ſitting iudgeſt me according to the lavv, and contrarie to lavv doeſt thou commaund me to be ſmitten?
label: Acts

text: And they that ſtoode by, ſaid, Doeſt thou reuile the high Prieſt of God?
label: Acts

text: And Paul ſaid, I knewe not, brethren, that he is the high Prieſt. For it is written: The prince of thy people thou ſhalt not miſſpeake.
label: Acts

text: And Paul knovving that the one part vvas of Sadducees, and the other of Phariſees, he cried out in the Councel, Men brethren, I am a Phariſee, the ſonne of Phariſees: of the hope and reſurrection of the dead am I iudged.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen he had ſaid theſe things, there roſe diſſenſion betvvene the Phariſees and Sadducees, and the multitude vvas diuided.
label: Acts

text: For the Sadducees ſay there is no reſurrection, nor Angel, nor ſpirit: but the Phariſees confeſſe both.
label: Acts

text: And there vvas made a great crie. And certaine of the Phariſees riſing vp, ſtroue ſaying, Vve finde no euil in this man. what if a ſpirit hath ſpoken to him, or an Angel?
label: Acts

text: And vvhen there vvas riſen great diſſenſion, the Tribune fearing leſt Paul ſhould be torne in peeces by them, commaunded the ſouldiars to goe dovvne, and to take him out of the middes of them, and to bring him into the caſtel.
label: Acts

text: And the night folovving our Lord ſtanding by him, ſaid, Be conſtant: for as thou haſt teſtified of me in Hieruſalem, ſo muſt thou teſtifie at Rome alſo.
label: Acts

text: And when day vvas come, certaine of the Ievves gathered them ſelues together, & vovved them ſelues, ſaying, that they vvould neither eate nor drinke til they killed Paul.
label: Acts

text: And they vvere more then fourtie men that had made this conſpiracie:
label: Acts

text: vvho came to the cheefe prieſts and the auncients, and ſaid, By execration vve haue vovved our ſelues, that vve vvil eate nothing, til vve kill Paul.
label: Acts

text: Novv therfore giue you knowledge to the Tribune vvith the Councel, that he bring him forth to you, as if you meant to knovv ſome more certaintie touching him. But we, before he come neere, are ready for to kil him.
label: Acts

text: Vvhich when Paules ſiſters ſonne had heard, of their lying in vvaite, he came and entred into the caſtel and told Paul.
label: Acts

text: And Paul calling to him one of the Centurions, ſaid, Bring this yong man to the Tribune, for he hath ſome thing to tel him.
label: Acts

text: And he taking him, brought him to the Tribune, and ſaid, The priſoner Paul deſired me to bring this yong man vnto thee, hauing ſome thing to ſay to thee.
label: Acts

text: And the Tribune taking him by the hand, vvent aſide vvith him apart, and aſked him, Vvhat is it that thou haſt to tel me?
label: Acts

text: And he ſaid, The Ievves haue agreed to deſire thee, that to morovv thou vvilt bring forth Paul into the Councel, as though they meant to inquire ſome more certaintie touching him.
label: Acts

text: But doe not thou credite them, for there lie in vvaite for him more then fourtie men of them, vvhich haue vowed neither to eate nor to drinke, til they kil him: and they are novv ready, expecting thy promiſſe.
label: Acts

text: The Tribune therfore dimiſſed the yong man, commaunding that he ſhould ſpeake to no man that he had notified theſe things vnto him.
label: Acts

text: And calling tvvo Centurions, he ſaid to them, Make ready tvvo hundred ſouldiars, to goe as farre as Cæſaréa, and ſeuentie horſemen, and launces tvvo hundred, from the third houre of the night:
label: Acts

text: and prepare beaſts. that ſetting Paul on, they might bring him ſafe to Felix the Preſident
label: Acts

text: (For he feared leſt perhaps the Ievves might take him avvay, and kil him, and him ſelf aftervvard ſhould ſuſtaine reproche, as though he vvould haue taken money)
label: Acts

text: vvriting a letter conteining this much. Claudius Lyſias to the moſt excellent Preſident Felix, greeting.
label: Acts

text: This man being apprehended of the Ievves, and ready to be killed of them, I comming in vvith the band deliuered him, vnderſtanding that he is a Romane:
label: Acts

text: and meaning to know the cauſe that they obiected vnto him, I brought him downe into their Councel.
label: Acts

text: Vvhom I found to be accuſed concerning queſtions of their lavv: but hauing no crime worthie of death or of bandes.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen it vvas told me of embuſhments that they had prepared againſt him, I ſent him to thee, ſignifying alſo to the accuſers, to ſpeake before thee. Fare vvel.
label: Acts

text: And the ſouldiars according as it vvas commaunded them, taking Paul, brought him by night to Antipatris.
label: Acts

text: And the next day ſending avvay the horſemen to goe vvith him, they returned to the caſtel.
label: Acts

text: Vvho when they vvere come to Cæſaréa, and had deliuered the letter to the Preſident, they did ſet Paul alſo before him.
label: Acts

text: And when he had read, and had aſked of vvhat prouince he vvas: and vnderſtanding that of Cilicia:
label: Acts

text: I vvil heare the, ſaid he, vvhen thy accuſers are come. And he commaunded him to be kept in Herods palace.
label: Acts

text: AND after fiue daies the high prieſt Ananias deſcended, vvith certaine auncients and one Tertullus an oratour, vvho vvent to the Preſident againſt Paul.
label: Acts

text: And Paul being cited, Tertullus began to accuſe, ſaying. Vvhereas vve liue in much peace by thee, & many things are corrected by thy prouidence:
label: Acts

text: vve doe alvvaies and in al places receiue it, moſt excellent Felix, vvith al thanks-geuing.
label: Acts

text: But leſt I hinder thee any longer, I deſire thee of thy clemencie breifely to heare vs.
label: Acts

text: Vve haue found this man peſtiferous, and raiſing ſeditiōs to al the Ievves in the vvhole vvorld, and authour of the ſedition c of the ſecte of the Nazarenes,
label: Acts

text: vvho alſo hath attempted to violat the temple, vvhom alſo being apprehended vve vvould haue iudged according to our lavv.
label: Acts

text: But Lyſias the Tribune comming in, vvith great force tooke him avvay out of our handes,
label: Acts

text: commaunding his accuſers to come to thee, of vvhom thou maieſt thy ſelf iudging, vnderſtand of al theſe things, vvhereof vve accuſe him.
label: Acts

text: And the Ievves alſo added, ſaying that theſe things vvere ſo.
label: Acts

text: But Paul anſvvered, (the Preſident making a ſigne vnto him for to ſpeake.) Knovving that of many yeres thou art iudge ouer this nation, I vvil vvith good courage anſvver for my ſelf.
label: Acts

text: For thou maieſt vnderſtand that it is not aboue tvvelue daies to me, ſince I vvent vp to adore in Hieruſalem.
label: Acts

text: and neither in the temple did they finde me diſputing vvith any man, or cauſing concourſe of the multitude, neither in the ſynagogs, nor in the citie:
label: Acts

text: neither can they proue vnto thee the things vvhereof they novv accuſe me.
label: Acts

text: But this I confeſſe to thee, that c according to the ſecte, vvhich they call hereſie, I doe ſo ſerue ‘the father my God’, beleeuing al things that are vvritten in the Law & the Prophets:
label: Acts

text: hauing hope in God, the vvhich theſe alſo them ſelues expect, that there ſhal be a reſurrection of iuſt and vniuſt.
label: Acts

text: In this my ſelf alſo doe ſtudie to haue a cōſcience vvithout offenſe tovvard God & tovvard men alvvaies.
label: Acts
