text: And after many yeres I came to beſtovv almes vpon my nation, & oblations, and vovves.
label: Acts

text: In the vvhich they found me purified in the temple: not vvith multitude nor vvith tumult.
label: Acts

text: But certaine Ievves of Aſia, vvho ought to be preſent before thee and to accuſe, if they had any thing againſt me:
label: Acts

text: or let theſe men thē ſelues ſay, if they haue found in me any iniquitie, foraſmuch as I ſtand in the Councel,
label: Acts

text: but of this one voice only that I cried ſtanding among them, That of the reſurrection of the dead am I iudged this day of you.
label: Acts

text: And Felix differred them, knovving moſt certainely of this vvay, ſaying, Vvhen Lyſias the Tribune is come dovvne, I vvil heare you.
label: Acts

text: And he commaunded the Centurion to keepe him, and that he ſhould haue reſt, neither to prohibit any of his to miniſter vnto him.
label: Acts

text: And after ſome daies, Felix comming vvith Druſilla his vvife, vvhich vvas a Ievve, called Paul, and heard of him the faith that is in Chriſt IESVS.
label: Acts

text: And he diſputing of iuſtice and chaſtitie, and of the iudgement to come, Felix being terrified, anſvvered, For this time, goe thy vvay: but in time conuenient I vvil ſend for thee.
label: Acts

text: hoping alſo vvithal, that money vvould be giuen him of Paul, for the vvhich cauſe alſo oftentimes ſending for him, he ſpake vvith him.
label: Acts

text: But vvhen tvvo yeres vvere ended, Felix had a ſucceſſour Portius Feſtus. And Felix being vvilling to ſhevv the Ievves a pleaſure, left Paul in priſon.
label: Acts

text: FESTVS therfore vvhen he vvas come into the prouince, after three daies vvent vp to Hieruſalem from Cæſaréa.
label: Acts

text: And the cheefe prieſts, & principal men of the Iewes vvent vnto him againſt Paul: and they deſired him,
label: Acts

text: requeſting fauour againſt him, that he vvould commaund him to be brought to Hieruſalem, laying vvaite for to kil him in the vvay.
label: Acts

text: But Feſtus anſvvered, that Paul is in Cæſaréa: and that he vvould very ſhortly goe thither.
label: Acts

text: They therfore, ſaith he, that are of abilitie among you, going dovvne vvith me, if there be any crime in the man, let them accuſe him.
label: Acts

text: And hauing taried among them not aboue eight or ten daies, he vvent dovvne to Cæſaréa, and the next day he ſate in the iudgement ſeate: and he commaunded Paul to be brought.
label: Acts

text: Vvho being brought, there ſtoode about him the Iewes that vvere come dovvne from Hieruſalem, obiecting many and greuous c cauſes vvhich, they could not proue,
label: Acts

text: Paul making anſvver, That neither againſt the lavv of the Iewes, nor againſt the temple, nor againſt Cæſar haue I any thing offended.
label: Acts

text: But Feſtus vvilling to ſhevv the Iewes a pleaſure, anſvvering Paul, ſaid, Vvilt thou goe vp to Hieruſalem, and there be iudged of theſe things before me?
label: Acts

text: And Paul ſaid, At Cæſars iudgement ſeate doe I ſtand, vvhere I ought to be iudged: the Iewes I haue not hurt, as thou very vvel knovveſt.
label: Acts

text: For if I haue hurt them, or done any thing vvorthie of death, I refuſe not to die. but if none of thoſe things be, vvhereof theſe accuſe me, no man can giue me to them. I appeale to Cæſar.
label: Acts

text: Then Feſtus hauing conferred vvith the Councel, anſvvered, Haſt thou appealed to Cæſar? to Cæſar ſhalt thou goe.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen certaine daies vvere paſſed, king Agrippa & Bernice came dovvne to Cæſaréa to ſalute Feſtus.
label: Acts

text: And as they taried there a good many daies, Feſtus ſignified to the king, of Paul, ſaying, A certaine perſon vvas left priſoner by Felix,
label: Acts

text: concerning vvhom, vvhen I vvas at Hieruſalem, the cheefe prieſts and the auncients of the Iewes came vnto me, deſyring condemnation againſt him.
label: Acts

text: To vvhom I anſvvered, That it is not the Romanes cuſtome to yeld vp any man before that he vvhich is accuſed haue his accuſers preſent and take place to make his anſvver for to cleere him ſelf of the crimes.
label: Acts

text: Vvhen they therfore vvere aſſembled hither, vvithout any delaie, the day folovving, ſitting in the iudgement ſeat, I commaunded the man to be brought.
label: Acts

text: Of vvhom, vvhen the accuſers ſtoode vp, they brought no cauſe vvhich I thought il of:
label: Acts

text: but certaine queſtions of their ovvne ſuperſtition they had againſt him, and of one IESVS deceaſed, vvhom Paul affirmed to liue.
label: Acts

text: Doubting therfore of this kinde of queſtion, I ſaid, vvhether he vvould goe to Hieruſalem, & there be iudged of theſe things.
label: Acts

text: But Paul appealing to be kept vnto the knovvledge of Auguſtus, I commaunded him to be kept, til I ſend him to Cæſar.
label: Acts

text: And Agrippa ſaid to Feſtus, My ſelf alſo vvould heare the man. To morovv, ſaid he, thou ſhalt heare him.
label: Acts

text: And the next day vvhen Agrippa and Bernice vvere come vvith great pompe, and had entred into the hall of audience vvith the Tribunes and principal men of the citie, at Feſtus commaundement Paul vvas brought.
label: Acts

text: And Feſtus ſaith, King Agrippa, and al ye men that are preſent together vvith vs, you ſee this man, concerning vvhom al the multitude of the Iewes called vpon me at Hieruſalem, requeſting and crying out that he ought not to liue any longer.
label: Acts

text: Yet haue I found nothing that he hath committed vvorthie of death. But foraſmuch as he him ſelf appealed to Auguſtus, I haue determined to ſend him.
label: Acts

text: Of vvhom vvhat to vvrite for certaintie to my lord, I haue not. For the vvhich cauſe I haue brought him forth to you, and eſpecially to thee, king Agrippa, that examination being made, I may haue vvhat to vvrite.
label: Acts

text: For it ſeemeth to me vvithout reaſon, to ſend a priſoner, & not to ſignifie c his cauſes.
label: Acts

text: BVT Agrippa ſaid to Paul, Thou art permitted to ſpeake for thy ſelf. Then Paul ſtretching forth his hand, began to make his anſvver.
label: Acts

text: Touching al things vvhereof I am accuſed of the Iewes, king Agrippa, I account my ſelf happie for that I am to defend my ſelf this day before thee,
label: Acts

text: eſpecially vvhereas thou knovveſt al things that are among the Ievves, cuſtomes and queſtions: for the vvhich cauſe I beſeeche thee, heare me patiently.
label: Acts

text: And my life truely from my youth, vvhich vvas from the beginning in my nation in Hieruſalem, al the Ievves doe knovv:
label: Acts

text: knovving me before from the beginning (if they vvil giue teſtimonie) that according to the moſt ſure ſecte of our religion I liued a Phariſee.
label: Acts

text: And novv for the hope of the promiſſe that vvas made of God to our fathers, doe I ſtand ſubiect to iudgement:
label: Acts

text: the vvhich, our tvvelue tribes ſeruing night and day, hope to come vnto. Of the vvhich hope, o king, I am accuſed of the Iewes.
label: Acts

text: Vvhat incredible thing is it iudged vvith you, if God raiſe the dead?
label: Acts

text: And my ſelf truely had thought that I ought to doe againſt the name of IESVS of Nazareth many contrarie things.
label: Acts

text: Vvhich alſo I did at Hieruſalem, and many of the ſaincts did I ſhut vp in priſons, hauing receiued authoritie of the cheefe prieſts: and vvhen they vvere put to death, I brought the ſentence.
label: Acts

text: And through out al the ſynagogs often times puniſhing them, I compelled them to blaſpheme: and yet more mad againſt them, I perſecuted them euen vnto foraine cities.
label: Acts

text: Among vvhich things vvhiles I vvent to Damaſcus vvith authoritie and permiſſion of the cheefe prieſts,
label: Acts

text: at midday, in the vvay, I ſavv (o king) from heauen a light to haue ſhined round about me and them that vvere in companie vvith me, aboue the brightnes of the ſunne.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen al vve vvere fallen dovvne on the ground, I heard a voice ſpeaking to me in the Hebrew tongue: Saul, Saul, vvhy perſecuteſt thou me? It is hard for thee to kicke againſt the pricke.
label: Acts

text: And I ſaid, Vvho art thou Lord? And our Lord anſvvered, I am IESVS vvhom thou doeſt perſecute.
label: Acts

text: But riſe vp and ſtand vpon thy feete: for to this end haue I appeared to thee, that I may ordaine thee a miniſter and vvitnes of thoſe things vvhich thou haſt ſeen, and of thoſe things vvherein I vvil appeare to thee,
label: Acts

text: deliuering thee out of the peoples & nations vnto the vvhich novv I ſend thee,
label: Acts

text: to open their eies, that they may be conuerted from darkenes to light, and from the povver of Satan to God, that they may receiue remiſſion of ſinnes and lot among the ſaincts by the faith that is in me.
label: Acts

text: Vvherevpon, king Agrippa, I vvas not incredulous to the heauenly viſion:
label: Acts

text: but to them firſt that are at Damaſcus, and at Hieruſalem, and vnto al the countrie of Ievvrie, and to the Gentiles did I preach that they ſhould doe penance, and turne to God, doing vvorkes vvorthie of penance.
label: Acts

text: For this cauſe the Iewes, vvhen I vvas in the temple, apprehending me, attempted meaning to kil me.
label: Acts

text: But aided by the help of God, I ſtand vntil this day, teſtifying to ſmall and to great, ſaying nothing beſide thoſe things vvhich the Prophets did ſpeake ſhould come to paſſe, & Moyſes,
label: Acts

text: if C H R I S T vvere paſſible, if the firſt of the reſurrection from the dead, he vvere to ſhevv light to the people and to the Gentiles.
label: Acts

text: As he ſpake theſe things and made his anſvver, Feſtus vvith a loud voice ſaid, Thou art mad, Paul: much learning turneth thee to madneſſe.
label: Acts

text: And Paul ſaid, I am not mad, moſt excellent Feſtus: but I ſpeake vvordes of veritie and ſobrietie.
label: Acts

text: for the king knovveth of theſe things, to vvhom alſo I ſpeake conſtantly. for I thinke none of theſe things to be vnknovven to him. For neither vvas any of theſe things done in a corner.
label: Acts

text: Beleeueſt thou the prophets, king Agrippa? I knovv that thou beleeueſt.
label: Acts

text: And Agrippa ſaid to Paul: A litle thou perſuadeſt me to become a C H R I S T I A N.
label: Acts

text: And Paul ſaid, I vviſh of God, both in litle, and in much, not only thee, but alſo al that heare this day, to become ſuch as I am alſo, except theſe bandes.
label: Acts

text: And the king roſe vp, and the Preſident, and Bernice, and they that ſate by them.
label: Acts

text: And going a ſide, they ſpake among them ſelues, ſaying, That this man hath done nothing vvorthie of death or bandes.
label: Acts

text: And Agrippa ſaid to Feſtus, This man might be releaſed, if he had not appealed to Caeſar.
label: Acts

text: AND after it vvas decreed that he ſhould ſaile into Italie, and that Paul vvith other priſoners ſhould be deliuered to a Centurion named Iulius, of the band Auguſta,
label: Acts

text: vve going vp into a ſhip of Adrumétum, beginning to ſaile about the places of Aſia, looſed from the land, Ariſtarchus the Macedonian of Theſſalonica continuing vvith vs.
label: Acts

text: And the day folovving vve came to Sidon. And Iulius intreating Paul courteouſly, permitted him to goe to his frendes, and to take care of him ſelf.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen vve had looſed thence, vve ſailed vnder Cypres: becauſe the vvindes vvere contrarie.
label: Acts

text: And ſailing the ſea of Cilicia and Pamphilia, vve came to `Lyſtra', vvhich is in Lycia:
label: Acts

text: and there the Centurion finding a ſhip of Alexandria ſailing into Italie, remoued vs into it.
label: Acts

text: And vvhereas many daies vve ſailed ſlovvly, & vvere ſcarſe come ouer againſt Gnidus, the vvinde hindering vs, vve ſailed neere Crete by Salmóne:
label: Acts

text: and vvith much a doe ſailing by it, vve came into a certaine place that is called Good-hauens, nigh to the vvhich vvas a citie Thalaſſa.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen much time vvas ſpent, and vvhereas novv it vvas not ſafe ſailing, becauſe the faſt novv vvas paſt, Paul comforted them,
label: Acts

text: ſaying to them, Ye men, I ſee that the ſailing beginneth to be vvith hurt and much damage not only of the lading and the ſhip, but alſo of our liues.
label: Acts

text: But the Centurion beleeued the gouernour and maiſter of the ſhip, more then thoſe things vvhich vvere ſaid of Paul.
label: Acts

text: And vvhereas it vvas not a commodious hauen to vvinter in, very many taking counſel appointed to ſaile thence, if by any meanes they might comming to Phœníce, vvinter there, a hauen of Crete looking tovvard the Afrike and the Chore.
label: Acts

text: And the ſouthvvinde blovving, they thinking that they had obteined their purpoſe, vvhen they had parted from Aſſon, ſailed along by Crete.
label: Acts

text: But not long after, a tempeſtuous vvinde that is called Euro-aquilo, droue againſt it.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen the ſhippe vvas caught and could not make vvay againſt the vvinde, giuing vp the ſhip to the vvindes, vve vvere driuen.
label: Acts

text: And running vpon a certaine iland, that is called Cauda, vve could ſcarſe get the cock-boate.
label: Acts

text: Vvhich being taken vp, they vſed helps, girding the ſhip, and fearing leſt they ſhould fall into the Syrte, letting dovvne the veſſel, ſo vvere they caried.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen vve vvere mightily toſſed vvith the tempeſt, the next day they caſt forth,
label: Acts

text: And the third day vvith their ovvne handes they threvve forth the tacklinges of the ſhip.
label: Acts

text: And neither ſunne, nor ſtarres appearing for many daies, and no ſmal ſtorme being tovvard, al hope vvas novv taken avvay of our ſauing.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen there had been long faſting, then Paul ſtanding in the middes of them, ſaid, You ſhould in deede, O ye men, haue heard me, and not haue parted from Crete, & haue gained this hurt and loſſe.
label: Acts

text: And novv I exhort you to be of good cheere. for there ſhal be no loſſe of any ſoule among you, but of the ſhip.
label: Acts

text: For an Angel of the God vvhoſe I am, and vvhom I ſerue, ſtoode by me this night,
label: Acts

text: ſaying, Feare not Paul, thou muſt appeare before Cæſar: and behold God hath giuen thee al that ſaile vvith thee.
label: Acts

text: For the vvhich cauſe be of good cheere ye men: for I beleeue God, that it ſhal ſo be, as it hath been ſaid to me.
label: Acts

text: And vve muſt come vnto a certaine iland.
label: Acts

text: But after the fourtenth night vvas come on vs, as vve vvere ſailing in Adria about midnight, the ſhipmen deemed that there appeared ſome countrie to them.
label: Acts

text: Vvho alſo ſounding, found tvventie fadomes: and being parted a litle from thence, they found fiftene fadomes.
label: Acts

text: And fearing leſt vve ſhould fall into rough places, caſting out of the ſterne foure ankers, they vviſhed that day vvere come.
label: Acts

text: But as the ſhipmen ſought to flee out of the ſhip, hauing let dovvne the cock-boate into the ſea, pretending as if they vvere about to caſt out ankers out of the fore part of the ſhip,
label: Acts

text: Paul ſaid to the Centurion and to the ſouldiars, Vnles theſe tarie in the ſhip, you can not be ſaued.
label: Acts

text: Then the ſouldiars cut of the ropes of the cock-boate: and ſuffered it to fal avvay.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen it began to be light, Paul deſired all to take meate, ſaying, This day is the fourtenth day that you expect and remaine faſting, taking nothing.
label: Acts

text: For the vvhich cauſe I deſire you to take meate for your health ſake: for there ſhal not an heare of the head periſh of any of you.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen he had ſaid theſe things, taking bread, he gaue thankes to God in the ſight of them al: and vvhen he had broken it, he began to eate.
label: Acts

text: And being al made of better cheere, they alſo tooke meate.
label: Acts

text: And vve vvere in al in the ſhip, ſoules tvvo hundred ſeuentie ſixe.
label: Acts

text: And being filled vvith meate, they lighted the ſhip, caſting the vvheat into the ſea.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen day vvas come, they knevv not the land: but they ſpied a certaine creeke that had a ſhore, into the vvhich they minded, if they could, to caſt a land the ſhip.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they had taken vp the ankers, they committed them ſelues to the ſea, looſing vvithal the rudder bands: and hoiſing vp the maine ſaile according as the vvinde blevve, they vvent on tovvard the ſhore.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen vve vvere fallen into a place betvvene tvvo ſeas, they graueled the ſhip: and the fore-part truly ſticking faſt remained vnmoueable: but the hinder part vvas broken by the violence of the ſea.
label: Acts

text: And the counſel of the ſouldiars vvas, that they ſhould kil the priſoners: leſt any ſvvimming out, might runne avvay.
label: Acts

text: But the Centurion vvilling to ſaue Paul, forbade it to be done: & he commaunded them that could ſvvimme, to caſt out them ſelues firſt, and eſcape, and goe forth to land:
label: Acts

text: and the reſt, ſome they caried on bordes, and ſome vpon thoſe things that vvere of the ſhip. And ſo it came to paſſe, that al the ſoules eſcaped to land.
label: Acts

text: AND vvhen we had eſcaped, then vve knevv that the iland vvas called `Mityléne'. But the Barbarous ſhewed vs no ſmal courteſie.
label: Acts

text: For, kindling a fire they refreſhed vs al, becauſe of the imminent raine and the colde.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen Paul had gathered together ſome number of ſtickes, and had laide them on the fire, a viper iſſuing out of the heate, inuaded his hand.
label: Acts

text: But as the Barbarous ſaw the beaſt hanging on his hand, they ſaid one to an other, Vndoubtedly this man is a murderer, vvho being eſcaped out of the ſea, Vengeance doth not ſuffer him to liue.
label: Acts

text: And he in deede ſhaking of the beaſt into the fire, ſuffred no harme.
label: Acts

text: But they ſuppoſed that he ſhould be turned into a ſwelling, and that he vvould ſodenly fall and die. But expecting long and ſeeing that there vvas no harme done on him, being changed they ſaid, that he was a God.
label: Acts

text: And in thoſe places were lands of the prince of the ile, named Publius, vvho receiuing vs, for three daies intreated vs courteouſly.
label: Acts

text: And it chaunced that the father of Publius lay vexed vvith feuers and the bloudy flixe. Vnto whom Paul entred: and vvhen he had praied, and impoſed hands on him, he healed him.
label: Acts

text: Vvhich being done, al in the ile alſo that had infirmities, came, and vvere cured:
label: Acts

text: who alſo honoured vs vvith many honours, and when vve vvere ſailing away, laded vs vvith neceſſaries.
label: Acts

text: And after three moneths, we ſailed in a ſhip of Alexandria, that had wintered in the iland, vvhoſe ſigne vvas the Caſtors.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen vve vvere come to Syracûſa, vve taried there three daies.
label: Acts

text: Thence compaſſing by the ſhore, vve came to Rhegium: and after one day the South winde blovving, vve came the ſecond day to Putéoli,

text: vvhere finding brethren, vve were deſired to tarie vvith them ſeuen daies: and ſo vve came to Rome.
label: Acts

text: And from thence, vvhen the brethren had heard, they came to meete vs vnto Apij-forum, and the Three-tauerns. Vvhom vvhen Paul had ſeen, giuing thanks to God, he tooke courage.

text: And vvhen vve vvere come to Rome, Paul vvas permitted to remaine to him ſelf with a ſouldiar that kept him.
label: Acts

text: And after the third day he called together the cheefe of the Iewes. And vvhen they vvere aſſembled, he ſaid to them, Men brethren, I doing nothing againſt the people, or the cuſtome of the fathers, vvas deliuered priſoner from Hieruſalem into the hands of the Romanes,

text: who vvhen they had examined me, vvould haue releaſed me, for that there vvas no cauſe of death in me.
label: Acts

text: But the Ievves contradicting it, I vvas compelled to appeale vnto Cæſar, not as hauing any thing to accuſe my nation.
label: Acts

text: For this cauſe therfore I deſired to ſee you and to ſpeake to you. for, becauſe of the hope of Iſraël, am I compaſſed vvith this chaine.
label: Acts

text: But they ſaid to him, Vve neither receiued letters concerning thee from Iewrie, neither did any of the brethren that came hither, report or ſpeake any euil of thee.
label: Acts

text: But vve deſire of thee to heare vvhat thou thinkeſt: for concerning this ſecte, it is knowen to vs that it is gaineſaid euery vvhere.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen they had appointed him a day, they came to him vnto his lodging very many: to vvhom he expounded, teſtifying the kingdom of God, and vſing perſuaſion to them of IESVS out of the law of Moyſes and the Prophets, from morning vntil euening.
label: Acts

text: And certaine beleeued thoſe things that were ſaid: but certaine beleeued not.
label: Acts

text: And vvhereas they did not agree among them ſelues, they departed, Paul ſaying one vvord: That wel did the holy Ghoſt ſpeake by Eſaie the prophet to our fathers,
label: Acts

text: ſaying, Goe to this people, and ſay to them, Vvith the eare you ſhal heare, and ſhal not vnderſtand: and ſeeing you ſhal ſee, and ſhal not perceiue.

text: For the hart of this people is vvaxen groſſe, and vvith their eares haue they heauily heard, and their eies they haue ſhut: leſt perhaps they may ſee vvith their eies, and heare vvith their eares, and vnderſtand vvith their hart, and be conuerted, and I heale them.
label: Acts

text: Be it knowen therfore to you, that this Saluation of God is ſent to the Gentiles, and they vvil heare.
label: Acts

text: And vvhen he had ſaid theſe things, the Ievves vvent out from him, hauing much queſtioning among them ſelues.
label: Acts

text: And he taried ful tvvo yeres in his hired lodging: and he receiued al that came into him,
label: Acts

text: preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching the things that concerne our Lord IESVS CHRIST vvith al confidence, vvithout prohibition.
label: Acts

text: PAVL the ſeruant of IESVS CHRIST, called to be an Apoſtle, ſeparated into the Goſpel of God,
label: Romans

text: vvhich before he had promiſed by his Prophets in the holy Scriptures,
label: Romans

label: Romans

text: by vvhom vve haue receiued grace and Apoſtleſhip for obedience to the faith in al Nations for the name of him,
label: Romans

text: among vvhom are you alſo the called of IESVS CHRIST:) ⊢
label: Romans

text: to al that are at Rome the beloued of God, called to be ſaincts. Grace to you and peace from God our father, and our Lord IESVS CHRIST.
label: Romans

label: Romans

text: For God is my vvitnes, vvhom I ſerue in my ſpirit in the Goſpel of his Sonne, that vvithout intermiſsion I make a memorie of you
label: Romans

text: alvvaies in my praiers, beſeeching, if by any meanes I may ſometime at the length haue a proſperous iourney by the vvil of God, to come vnto you.

label: Romans

text: And I vvil not haue you ignorant (brethren) that I haue often purpoſed to come vnto you (and haue been ſtaied hitherto) that I may haue ſome fruite in you, as alſo in the other Gentiles.

text: To the Greekes and the Barbarous, to the vviſe and the vnvviſe I am detter.
label: Romans

text: ſo (as much as is in me) I am ready to euangelize to you alſo that are at Rome.
label: Romans

text: For I am not aſhamed of the Goſpel. For it is the povver of God, vnto ſaluation to euery one that beleeueth, to the Ievve firſt and to the Greeke.

text: For the iuſtice of God is reuealed therein by faith into faith: as it is vvritten: And the iuſt liueth by faith.
label: Romans

text: For the vvrath of God from heauen is reuealed, vpon al impietie and iniuſtice of thoſe men that deteine the veritie of God in iniuſtice:
label: Romans

text: becauſe, that of God vvhich is knovvē, is manifeſt in them. For God hath manifeſted it vnto them.
label: Romans

text: For his inuiſible things, from the creation of the vvorld are ſeen, being vnderſtoode by thoſe things that are made: his eternal povver alſo & Diuinitie: ſo that they are inexcuſable.
label: Romans

text: Becauſe, vvhereas they knew God, they haue not glorified him as God, or giuē thankes: but are become vaine in their cogitations, and their foliſh hart hath been darkened.
label: Romans

text: for, ſaying them ſelues to be vviſe, they became fooles.
label: Romans

text: And they changed the glorie of the incorruptible God, into a ſimilitude of the image of a corruptible man, and of foules and foure-footed beaſtes and of them that creepe.
label: Romans

text: (For the vvhich cauſe God hath deliuered them vp vnto the deſires of their hart, into vncleanneſſe, for to abuſe their owne bodies among them ſelues ignominiouſly.)
label: Romans

text: vvho haue changed the veritie of God into lying: and haue vvorſhipped & ſerued the creature rather then the creator, vvho is bleſſed for euer. Amen.
label: Romans

text: Therfore God hath deliuered them into paſsions of ignominie. For their vvomen haue changed the natural vſe, into that vſe that is contrarie to nature.
label: Romans

text: And in like maner the men alſo, leauing the natural vſe of the woman, haue burned in their deſires one tovvard an other, men vpon men vvorking turpitude, & the revvard of their errour (vvhich they ſhould) receauing in them ſelues.
label: Romans

text: And as they liked not to haue God in knovvledge: God deliuered them vp into a reprobate ſenſe: to doe thoſe things that are not conuenient:
label: Romans

text: repleniſhed vvith al iniquitie, malice, fornication, auarice, vvickednes, ful of enuie, murder, contention, guile, malignitie, vvhiſperers,
label: Romans

text: detractours, odible to God, contumelious, proude, hautie, inuentours of euil things, diſobedient to parents,
label: Romans

text: foliſh, diſſolute, vvithout affection, vvithout fidelitie, vvithout mercie.
label: Romans

text: Who vvhereas they knevv the iuſtice of God, did not vnderſtand that they vvhich doe ſuch things, are vvorthie of death: not only they that doe them, but they alſo that conſent to the doers.
label: Romans

text: FOR the vvhich cauſe thou art inexcuſable ô man vvhoſoeuer thou be that iudgeſt. For vvherein thou iudgeſt an other, thou condemneſt thy ſelf. for thou doeſt the ſame things vvhich thou iudgeſt.
label: Romans

text: For vve knovv that the iudgement of God is according to veritie vpon them that doe ſuch things.
label: Romans

text: And doeſt thou ſuppoſe this ô man that iudgeſt them which doe ſuch things, and doeſt the ſame, that thou ſhalt eſcape the iudgement of God?
label: Romans

text: Or doeſt thou contemne the riches of his goodnes, and patience, and longanimity, not knovving that the benignity of God bringeth thee to penance?
label: Romans

text: But according to thy hardnes and impenitent hart, thou heapeſt to thy ſelf vvrath, in the day of vvrath and of the reuelation of the iuſt iudgement of God,

text: vvho vvil render to euery man according to his vvorkes.
label: Romans

text: to them truely that according to patience in good vvorke, ſeeke glorie and honour and incorruption, life eternal.
label: Romans

text: but to them that are of contention, and that obey not the truth, but giue credite to iniquitie, vvrath and indignation.
label: Romans

text: Tribulation and anguiſh vpon euery ſoul of man that vvorketh euil, of the Ievve firſt and of the Greeke:
label: Romans

text: but glorie and honour and peace to euery one that vvorketh good, to the Ievv firſt and to the Greeke.
label: Romans

text: for there is no acception of perſons vvith God.
label: Romans

text: For vvhoſoeuer haue ſinned vvithout the Lavv, vvhithout the Lavv ſhal periſh: and vvhoſoeuer haue ſinned in the Lavv, by the Lavv ſhal be iudged.
label: Romans

text: For not the hearers of the Lavv are iuſt vvith God: but the doers of the Lavv ſhal be iuſtified.
label: Romans

text: For vvhen the Gentiles vvhich haue not the Lavv, naturally doe thoſe things that are of the Lavv: the ſame not hauing the Lavv, them ſelues are a lavv to them ſelues:
label: Romans

text: vvho ſhevv the vvorke of the Lavv vvritten in their hartes, their conſcience giuing teſtimonie to them, and among them ſelues mutually their thoughtes accuſing, or alſo defending,
label: Romans

text: in the day vvhen God ſhal iudge the ſecretes of men, according to my Goſpel, by IESVS CHRIST.
label: Romans

text: But if thou be ſurnamed a Ievv, and reſteſt in the Lavv, and doeſt glorie in God,
label: Romans

text: and knovveſt his vvil, and approueſt the more profitable things, inſtructed by the Lavv,
label: Romans

text: preſumeſt that thy ſelf art a leader of the blinde, a light of them that are in darknes,
label: Romans

text: a teacher of the foliſh, a maiſter of infants, hauing the forme of ſcience & of veritie in the Lavv.
label: Romans

text: Thou therfore that teacheſt an other, teacheſt not thy ſelf: that preacheſt, men ought not to ſteale, thou ſtealeſt:
label: Romans

text: that ſaieſt men ſhould not commit aduoutrie, thou committeſt aduoutrie: that abhorreſt idols, thou doeſt ſacrilege:

text: that doeſt glorie in the Lavv, thou by preuarication of the Lavv doeſt diſhonour God. (
label: Romans

text: For the name of God through you is blaſphemed among the Gentiles, as it is vvriten.)
label: Romans

text: Circumciſion in deede profiteth, if thou obſerue the Lavv: but if thou be a preuaricatour of the Law, thy circumciſion is become prepuce.

label: Romans

text: and ſhal not that vvhich of nature is prepuce, fulfilling the Lavv, iudge thee, that by the letter and circumciſion art a preuaricatour of the Lavv?

text: For not he that is in open ſhevv, is a Ievv, nor that vvhich is in open ſhevv, in the fleſh, is circumciſion:
label: Romans

text: but he that is in ſecrete, is a Ievv: and the circumciſion of the hart, in ſpirit, not in the letter: vvhoſe praiſe is not of men, but of God.

text: WHAT preeminence then hath the Ievv, or what is the profit of circumciſion?

text: for vvhat if certaine of them haue not beleeued? Hath their incredulitie made the faith of God fruſtrate?
label: Romans

text: God forbid. but God is true: & euery man a lyer, as it is vvritten: That thou maieſt be iuſtified in thy vvordes, and ouercome vvhen thou art iudged.
label: Romans

text: But if our iniquitie commend the iuſtice of God, vvhat ſhal vve ſay? Is God vniuſt that executeth vvrath? (I ſpeake according to man)

text: God forbid. othervviſe hovv ſhal God iudge this vvorld?
label: Romans

text: For if the veritie of God hath abounded in my lie, vnto his glorie, vvhy am I alſo yet iudged as a ſinner,

label: Romans

text: Al haue declined, they are become vnprofitable together: there is not that doeth good, there is not ſo much as one.

text: Their throte is an open ſepulchre, with their tonges they dealt deceitefully. The venim of aſpes vnder their lippes.
label: Romans

text: Whoſe mouth is ful of malediction and bitternes:
label: Romans

text: Their feete ſwift to ſhede bloud.
label: Romans

text: Deſtruction and infelicitie in their vvaies:
label: Romans

label: Romans

text: There is no feare of God before their eies.
label: Romans

text: And vve knovv that vvhatſoeuer the Lavv ſpeaketh, to them it ſpeaketh that are in the Lavv: that euery mouth may be ſtopped, and al the vvorld may be made ſubiect to God:

text: But novv vvithout the Lavv the iuſtice of God is manifeſted: teſtified by the lavv and the Prophets.

text: Iuſtified gratis by his grace, by the redemption that is in CHRIST IESVS,

text: For we account a man to be iuſtified by faith vvithout the vvorkes of the Lavv.

label: Romans

label: Romans

label: Romans

label: Romans

label: Romans

text: How vvas it reputed? in circumciſion, or in prepuce? Not in circumciſion, but in prepuce.
label: Romans

label: Romans

text: and might be father of circumciſion, not to them only that are of the circumciſion, but to them alſo that folovv the ſteppes of the faith that is in the prepuce of our father Abraham.
label: Romans

text: For not by the Lavv vvas the promiſſe to Abraham, or to his ſeede, that he ſhould be heire of the vvorld: but by the iuſtice of faith.
label: Romans

text: For if they that are of the Lavv, be heires: faith is made voide, the promiſſe is aboliſhed.

text: For the Lavv vvorketh vvrath. For vvhere is no lavv, neither is there preuarication.
label: Romans

text: Therfore of faith: that according to grace the promiſſe may be firme to al the ſeede, not to that only vvhich is of the Lavv, but to that alſo vvhich is of the faith of Abraham, vvho is the father of vs al,

text: (as it is vvritten: For, a father of many nations haue I appointed thee) before God, vvhom thou didſt beleeue, vvho quickeneth the dead: and calleth thoſe things that are not, as thoſe things that are.
label: Romans

text: VVho contrarie to hope beleeued in hope: that he might be made the father of many nations, according to that vvhich vvas ſaid to him: So ſhal thy ſeede be, as the ſtarres of heauen, and the ſand of the ſea.
label: Romans

text: In the promiſſe alſo of God he ſtaggered not by diſtruſt: but vvas ſtrengthened in faith, giuing glorie to God:

label: Romans

text: And it is not vvritten only for him, that it vvas reputed him to iuſtice:

text: vvho vvas deliuered vp for our ſinnes, and roſe againe for our iuſtification.

label: Romans

text: and patience probation: and probation, hope.

label: Romans

text: Therefore, as by one man ſinne entred into this vvorld, and by ſinne death: and ſo vnto al men death did paſſe, in vvhich al ſinned.
label: Romans

text: For euen vnto the Lavv ſinne vvas in the world: but ſinne was not imputed, when the law was not.
label: Romans

text: But death reigned from Adam vnto Moyſes, euen on them alſo that ſinned not after the ſimilitude of the preuarication of Adam, vvho is a figure of him to come.
label: Romans

text: But not as the offence, ſo alſo the gift. for if by the offence of one, many died: much more the grace of God and the gift, in the grace of one man IESVS Chriſt, hath abounded vpon many.
label: Romans

text: And not as by one ſinne, ſo alſo the gift. for iudgement in dede is of one, to condemnation: but grace is of many offences, to iuſtification.
label: Romans

text: For if in the offence of one, death reigned by one: much more they that receiue the aboundance of grace and of donation & of iuſtice, ſhal reigne in life by one, IESVS Chriſt.
label: Romans

text: Therfore as by the offence of one, vnto al men to condemnation: ſo alſo by the iuſtice of one, vnto al men to iuſtification of life.
label: Romans

text: For as by the diſobedience of one man, many vvere made ſinners: ſo alſo by the obedience of one, many ſhal be made iuſt.
label: Romans

text: But the Lavv entred in, that ſinne might abound. And vvhere ſinne abounded, grace did more abound.
label: Romans

text: that as ſinne reigned to death: ſo alſo grace may reigne by iuſtice to life euerlaſting, through IESVS Chriſt our Lord.
label: Romans

text: WHAT ſhal vve ſay then? Shal vve continue in ſinne that grace may abound?
label: Romans

text: God forbid. For vve that are dead to ſinne, hovv ſhal vve yet liue therein?
label: Romans

text: b Are you ignorant that al vve vvhich are baptized in Chriſt IESVS, in his death we are baptized?
label: Romans

text: For we are buried together vvith him by Baptiſme into death: that as Chriſt is riſen from the dead by the glorie of the father, ſo vve alſo may vvalke in newneſſe of life.
label: Romans

text: For if we be become complanted to the ſimilitude of his death, vve ſhal be alſo of his reſurrection.
label: Romans

text: Knovving this, that our old man is crucified vvith him, that the body of ſinne may be deſtroied, to the end that vve may ſerue ſinne no longer.
label: Romans

text: For he that is dead, is iuſtified from ſinne.
label: Romans

text: And if vve be dead vvith Chriſt, vve beleeue that vve ſhal liue alſo together vvith Chriſt.
label: Romans

text: knovving that Chriſt riſing againe from the dead, novv dieth no more, death ſhal no more haue dominion ouer him.
label: Romans

text: For that he died, to ſinne he died once: but that he liueth, he liueth to God.
label: Romans

text: So thinke you alſo, that you are dead to ſinne, but aliue to God in Chriſt IESVS our Lord. ⊢
label: Romans

text: Let not ſinne therfore reigne in your mortal body, that you obey the concupiſcences thereof.
label: Romans

text: But neither doe ye exhibite your members inſtruments of iniquitie vnto ſinne: but exhibite your ſelues to God as of dead men, aliue: and your members inſtruments of iuſtice to God.
label: Romans

text: For ſinne ſhal not haue dominion ouer you. for you are not vnder the Lavv, but vnder grace.
label: Romans

text: VVhat then? ſhal vve ſinne, becauſe vve are not vnder the Lavv, but vnder grace? God forbid.
label: Romans

text: Knovv you not that to vvhom you exhibite your ſelues ſeruants to obey, you are the ſeruants of him vvhom you obey, vvhether it be of ſinne, to death, or of obedience, to iuſtice.
label: Romans

text: But thankes be to God, that you vvere the ſeruants of ſinne, but haue obeied from the hart, vnto that forme of doctrine, into the vvhich you haue been deliuered.
label: Romans

text: And being made free from ſinne, you vvere made ſeruants to iuſtice.
label: Romans

text: I ſpeake an humane thing, becauſe of the infirmitie of your fleſh. for as you haue exhibited your members to ſerue vncleanneſſe and iniquitie, vnto iniquitie: ſo now exhibite your members to ſerue iuſtice, vnto ſanctification.
label: Romans

text: For when you vvere ſeruants of ſinne, you were free to iuſtice.
label: Romans

text: VVhat fruite therfore had you then in thoſe things, for vvhich novv you are aſhamed? for the end of them is death.
label: Romans

text: But novv being made free from ſinne, and become ſeruants to God, you haue your fruite vnto ſanctification, but the end, life euerlaſting.
label: Romans

text: For the ſtipends of ſinne, death. but the grace of God, life euerlaſting in Chriſt IESVS our Lord. ⊢
label: Romans

text: ARE you ignorant brethren (for I ſpeake to them that knovv the Lavv) that the Law hath dominion ouer a man as long time as he liueth?
label: Romans

text: for the vvoman that is vnder a huſband: her huſband liuing is bound to the lavv. but if her huſband be dead, ſhe is looſed from the lavv of her huſband.
label: Romans

text: Therfore her huſband liuing, ſhe ſhal be called an aduoutereſſe if ſhe be vvith an other man: but if her huſband be dead, ſhe is deliuered from the lavv of her huſband: ſo that ſhe is not an aduoutereſſe if ſhe be vvith an other man.
label: Romans

text: Therfore my brethren you alſo are made dead to the Lavv by the body of Chriſt: that you may be an other mans vvho is riſen againe from the dead, that vve may fructifie to God.
label: Romans

text: For vvhen vve vvere in the fleſh, the paſſions of ſinnes, that vvere by the Lavv, did vvorke in our members, to fructifie vnto death.
label: Romans

text: but novv vve are looſed from the lavv of death, vvherein vve vvere deteined: c in ſo much we ſerue in nevvneſſe of ſpirit, and not in the oldnes of the letter.
label: Romans

text: VVhat ſhal we ſay then? is the Lavv ſinne? God forbid. But ſinne I did not knovv, but by the Lavv. for concupiſcence I knevv not, vnleſſe the lavv did ſay: Thou ſhalt not couet.
label: Romans

text: But occaſion being taken, ſinne by the commaundement vvrought in me al concupiſcence. For vvithout the Lavv ſinne vvas dead.
label: Romans

text: And I liued vvithout the Lavv ſometime. But vvhen the commaundement vvas come, ſinne reuiued.
label: Romans

text: And I vvas dead: and the commaundement, that vvas vnto life, the ſame to me vvas found to be vnto death.
label: Romans

text: For ſinne taking occaſion by the commaundement, ſeduced me, and by it killed me.
label: Romans

text: Therfore the Lavv in deede is holy, and the commaundement holy, and iuſt, and good.
label: Romans

text: That then vvhich is good, to me vvas it made death? God forbid. but ſinne, that it may appeare ſinne, by the good thing vvrought me death: that ſinne might become ſinning aboue meaſure by the commaundement.
label: Romans

text: For vve knovv that the Law is ſpiritual, but I am carnal, ſold vnder ſinne.
label: Romans

text: For that which I vvorke, I vnderſtand not. for not that vvhich I vvil, the ſame do I: but vvhich I hate, that I doe.
label: Romans

text: And if that vvhich I vvil not, the ſame I do: I conſent to the Lavv, that it is good.
label: Romans

text: But novv, not I vvorke it any more, but the ſinne that dvvelleth in me.
label: Romans

text: For I know that there dvvelleth not in me, that is to ſay, in my fleſh, good. For to vvil, is preſent vvith me, but to accompliſh that vvhich is good, I finde not.
label: Romans

text: For not the good vvhich I vvil, that do I: but the euil vvhich I vvil not, that I do.
label: Romans

text: And if that vvhich I vvil not, the ſame I doe: novv not I vvorke it, but the ſinne that dwelleth in me.
label: Romans

text: I finde therfore, the Lavv, to me hauing a vvil to doe good, that euil is preſent vvith me.
label: Romans

text: For I am delighted vvith the lavv of God according to the invvard man:
label: Romans

text: but I ſee an other lavv in my members, repugning to the lavv of my minde, and captiuing me in the lavv of ſinne, that is in my members.
label: Romans

text: Vnhappie man that I am, vvho ſhal deliuer me from the body of this death?
label: Romans

text: The grace of God by IESVS Chriſt our Lord. ⊢ Therfore I my ſelf vvith the minde c ſerue the lavv of God, but vvith the fleſh, the lavv of ſinne.
label: Romans

text: THERE is novv therfore no damnation to them that are in Chriſt IESVS: that walke not according to the fleſh.
label: Romans

text: For the lavv of the ſpirit of life in Chriſt IESVS, hath deliuered me from the lavv of ſinne and of death.
label: Romans

text: For that vvhich vvas impoſſible to the Lavv, in that it vvas vveakened by the fleſh: God ſending his ſonne in the ſimilitude of the fleſh of ſinne, euen of ſinne damned ſinne in the fleſh,
label: Romans

text: that the iuſtification of the lavv might be fulfilled in vs, vvho vvalke not according to the fleſh, but according to the ſpirit.
label: Romans

text: For they that are according to the fleſh, are affected to the things that are of the fleſh, but they that are according to the ſpirit: are affected to the things that are of the ſpirit.
label: Romans

text: For the vviſedom of the fleſh, is death: but the vviſedom of the ſpirit, life and peace.
label: Romans

text: Becauſe the vviſedom of the fleſh, is an enemie to God: for to the law of God it is not ſubiect, neither can it be.
label: Romans

text: And they that are in the fleſh, can not pleaſe God.
label: Romans

text: But you are not in the fleſh, but in the ſpirit, yet if the Spirit of God dvvel in you. But if any man haue not the Spirit of Chriſt, the ſame is not his.
label: Romans

text: But if Chriſt be in you: the body in deede is dead becauſe of ſinne, but the ſpirit liueth becauſe of iuſtification.
label: Romans

text: And if the Spirit of him that raiſed vp IESVS from the dead, dvvel in you: he that raiſed vp IESVS CHRIST from the dead, ſhal quicken alſo your mortal bodies, becauſe of his Spirit dwelling in you.
label: Romans

text: Therfore brethren, vve are detters: not to the fleſh, to liue according to the fleſh.
label: Romans

text: For if you liue according to the fleſh, you ſhal die. but if by the ſpirit, you mortifie the deedes of the fleſh, you ſhal liue.
label: Romans

text: For vvhoſoeuer are ledde by the Spirit of God, they are the ſonnes of God.
label: Romans

text: For you haue not receiued the ſpirit of ſeruitude againe in feare: but you haue receiued the ſpirit of adoption of ſonnes, vvherein vve crie: Abba, (father).
label: Romans

text: For the Spirit him ſelf, giueth teſtimonie to our ſpirit, that we are the ſonnes of God.
label: Romans

text: And if ſonnes, heires alſo: heires truly of God, and coheires of Chriſt: ⊢ yet if vve ſuffer vvith him, that vve may be alſo glorified vvith him.
label: Romans

text: For I thinke that the paſſions of this time are not condigne to the glorie to come that ſhal be reuealed in vs.
label: Romans

text: For the expectation of the creature, expecteth the reuelation of the ſonnes of God.
label: Romans

text: For the creature is made ſubiect to vanitie, not vvilling, but for him that made it ſubiect in hope:
label: Romans

text: becauſe the creature alſo it ſelf ſhal be deliuered from the ſeruitude of corruption, into the libertie of the glorie of the children of God.
label: Romans

text: For vve knovv that euery creature groneth, and trauaileth euen til novv.
label: Romans

text: And not only it, but vve alſo our ſelues hauing the firſt fruites of the ſpirit, vve alſo grone vvithin our ſelues, expecting the adoption of the ſonnes of God, the redemption of our body. ⊢
label: Romans

text: For by hope vve are ſaued. But hope that is ſeen, is not hope. for that vvhich a man ſeeth, vvherfore doth he hope it?
label: Romans

text: But if vve hope for that vvhich vve ſee not: vve expect by patience.
label: Romans

text: And in like maner alſo the Spirit helpeth our infirmitie. For, vvhat vve ſhould pray as vve ought, vve knovv not: but the Spirit him ſelf requeſteth for vs vvith gronings vnſpeakeable.
label: Romans

text: And he that ſearcheth the hartes, knovveth vvhat the Spirit deſireth: becauſe according to God he requeſteth for the ſainctes.
label: Romans

text: And vve knovv that to them that loue God, al things cooperate vnto good, to ſuch as according to purpoſe are called to be ſainctes.
label: Romans

text: For vvhom he hath forknowen, he hath alſo predeſtinated to be made conformable to the image of his ſonne: that he might be the firſt-borne in many brethren.
label: Romans

text: And vvhom he hath predeſtinated: them alſo he hath called. and vvhom he hath called: them alſo he hath iuſtified. and vvhom he hath iuſtified: them alſo hath he glorified.
label: Romans

text: What ſhal vve then ſay to theſe things? If God be for vs, vvho is againſt vs?
label: Romans

text: He that ſpared not alſo his ovvne ſonne, but for vs al deliuered him: hovv hath he not alſo vvith him giuen vs al things?
label: Romans

text: Who ſhal accuſe againſt the elect of God? God that iuſtifieth.
label: Romans

text: Who is he that ſhal condemne? Chriſt IESVS that died, yea that is riſen alſo againe, vvho is on the right hand of God, vvho alſo maketh interceſſion for vs.
label: Romans

text: Who then ſhal ſeparate vs from the charitie of Chriſt? tribulation? or diſtreſſe? or famine? or nakednes? or danger? or perſecution? or the ſvvord?
label: Romans

text: (as it is vvritten, For vve are killed for thy ſake al the day: vve are eſteemed as ſheepe of ſlaughter.)
label: Romans

text: But in al theſe things we ouercome becauſe of him that hath loued vs. c
label: Romans

text: For I am ſure that neither death, nor life, nor Angels, nor Principalities, nor Povvers, neither things preſent, nor things to come, neither might,
label: Romans

text: nor height, nor depth, nor other creature, ſhal be able to ſeparate vs from the charitie of God vvhich is in Chriſt IESVS our Lord. ⊢
label: Romans

text: I SPEAKE the verity in Chriſt, I lie not, my conſcience bearing me vvitnes in the holy Ghoſt,
label: Romans

text: that I haue great ſadneſſe & continual ſorovv in my hart.
label: Romans

text: For I vviſhed, my ſelf to be an anáthema from Chriſt for my brethren, vvho are my kinſmen according to the fleſh,
label: Romans

text: vvho are Iſraëlites, vvhoſe is the adoption of ſonnes, and the glorie, and the teſtament, and the lavv giuing, and c the ſeruice, and the promiſſes:
label: Romans

text: vvhoſe are the fathers, & of vvhom Chriſt is according to the fleſh, vvho is aboue al things God bleſſed for euer. Amen.
label: Romans

text: But not that the vvord of God is fruſtrate. For, not al that are of Iſraël, they be Iſraëlites:
label: Romans

text: nor they that are the ſeede of Abraham, al be children: but in Iſaac ſhal the ſeede be called vnto thee:
label: Romans

text: that is to ſay, not they that are the children of the fleſh, they are the children of God: but they that are the children of the promiſſe, are eſteemed for the ſeede.
label: Romans

text: For the word of promiſſe is this, According to this time vvil I come: and Sara ſhal haue a ſonne.
label: Romans

text: And not only ſhe, But Rebecca alſo conceiuing of one copulation, of Iſaac our father.
label: Romans

text: For vvhen they vvere not yet borne, nor had done any good or euil (that the purpoſe of God according to election might ſtand)
label: Romans

text: not of vvorkes, but of the caller it vvas ſaid to her: That the elder ſhal ſerue the yonger,
label: Romans

text: as it is vvritten: Iacob I loued, but Eſau I hated.
label: Romans

text: VVhat ſhal vve ſay then? Is there iniquitie vvith God? God forbid.
label: Romans

text: For to Moyſes he ſaith, I vvil haue mercie on vvhom I haue mercie: and I vvil ſhew mercie to whom I wil ſhew mercie.
label: Romans

text: Therfore it is not of the vviller, nor the runner, but of God that ſheweth mercie.
label: Romans

text: For the Scripture ſaith to Pharao: That to this very purpoſe haue I raiſed thee, that in thee I may ſhevv my povver: and that my name may be renowmed in the vvhole earth.
label: Romans

text: Therfore on vvhom he vvil, he hath mercie: and vvhom he vvil, he doth indurate.
label: Romans

text: Thou ſaieſt therfore vnto me: VVhy doth he yet complaine? for vvho reſiſteth his vvil?
label: Romans

text: O man, vvho art thou that doeſt anſvver God? Doth the vvorke ſay to him that vvrought it: VVhy haſt thou made me thus?
label: Romans

text: Or hath not the potter of clay, povver, of the ſame maſſe to make one veſſel vnto honour, and an other vnto contumelie?
label: Romans

text: And if God vvilling to ſhevv vvrath, and to make his might knovven, ſuſteined in much patience the veſſels of wrath `apte' to deſtruction,
label: Romans

text: that he might ſhevv the riches of his glorie vpon the veſſels of mercie vvhich he prepared vnto glorie.
label: Romans

text: VVhom alſo he hath called, vs, not only of the Ievves, but alſo of the Gentiles,
label: Romans

text: as in Oſee he ſaith, I wil call that which is not my people, my people: and her that vvas not beloued, beloued: and her that hath not obteined mercie, hauing obteined mercie.
label: Romans

text: And it ſhal be, in the place vvhere it vvas ſaid to them, you are not my people: there they ſhal be called the ſonnes of the liuing God.
label: Romans

text: And Eſaie crieth for Iſrael, If the number of the children of Iſrael be as the ſand of the ſea, the remaines ſhal be ſaued.
label: Romans

text: For, conſummating a word, and abbridging it in equitie: becauſe a vvord abbridged ſhal our Lord make vpon the earth.
label: Romans

text: And as Eſay foretold, Vnles the Lord of Sabaoth had left vs ſeede: vve had been made like Sodom, and vve had been like as Gomorrha.
label: Romans

text: What ſhal vve ſay then? That the Gentiles vvhich purſued not after iuſtice, haue apprehended iuſtice, but the iuſtice that is of faith.
label: Romans

text: But Iſrael in purſuing the lavv of iuſtice, is not come vnto the lavv of iuſtice.
label: Romans

text: VVhy ſo? Becauſe not of faith, but as it vvere of vvorkes. for c they haue ſtombled at the ſtone of ſtombling,
label: Romans

text: as it is vvritten, Behold I put in Sion a ſtone of ſtombling, and a rocke of ſcandal: and vvhoſoeuer beleeueth in him, ſhal not be confounded.
label: Romans

text: BRETHREN, the vvil of my hart ſurely and praier to God, is for them vnto ſaluation.
label: Romans

text: For I giue them teſtimonie that they haue zeale of God, but not according to knowledge.
label: Romans

text: For, not knovving the iuſtice of God, & ſeeking to eſtabliſh their ovvne, they haue not been ſubiect to the iuſtice of God.
label: Romans

text: For, the end of the Law is Chriſt: vnto iuſtice to euery one that beleeueth.
label: Romans

text: For Moyſes vvrote, that, the iuſtice vvhich is of the Lavv, the man that hath done it, ſhal liue in it.
label: Romans

text: But the iuſtice vvhich is of faith, ſaith thus, Say not in thy hart, Who ſhal aſcend into heauen? that is to bring Chriſt dovvne.
label: Romans

text: Or vvho deſcendeth into the depth? that is to call Chriſt againe from the dead.
label: Romans

text: But vvhat ſaith the Scripture? The vvord is nigh, in thy mouth, and in thy hart. this is the vvord of faith vvhich vve preach.
label: Romans

text: For if thou confeſſe vvith thy mouth our Lord IESVS, and in thy hart beleeue that God hath raiſed him vp from the dead, thou ſhalt be ſaued.
label: Romans

text: For vvith the hart vve beleeue vnto iuſtice: but vvith the mouth confeſſion is made to ſaluation.
label: Romans

text: For the Scripture ſaith: Whoſoeuer beleeueth in him, ſhal not be confounded.
label: Romans

text: For there is no diſtinction of the Iew and the Greeke: for one is Lord of al, riche tovvard al that inuocate him.
label: Romans

text: For euery one vvhoſoeuer ſhal inuocate the name of our Lord, ſhal be ſaued.
label: Romans

text: Hovv then ſhal they inuocate in vvhom they haue not beleeued? Or hovv ſhal they beleeue him vvhom they haue not heard? And hovv ſhal they heare without a preacher?
label: Romans

text: But hovv ſhal they preach vnles they be ſent? as it is vvritten: Hovv beautiful are the feete of them that euangelize peace, of them that euangelize good things?
label: Romans

text: But al do not obey the Goſpel. For Eſay ſaith, Lord, vvho hath beleeued the hearing of vs?
label: Romans

text: Faith then, is by hearing: and heating is by the vvord of Chriſt.
label: Romans

text: But I ſay, haue they not heard? And certes into al the earth hath the ſound of them gone forth: and vnto the endes of the vvhole world the vvordes of them. ⊢
label: Romans

text: But I ſay, hath not Iſrael knovven? Moyſes firſt ſaith, I vvil bring you to emulation in that vvhich is not a nation: in a foliſh nation I vvil driue you into anger.
label: Romans

text: But Eſay is bold, and ſaith, I was found of them that did not ſeeke me: openly I appeared to them that aſked not of me.
label: Romans

text: But to Iſrael he ſaith, Al the day haue I ſpred my handes to a people that beleeueth not, and contradicteth me.
label: Romans

text: I Say then: Hath God reiected his people? God forbid. for I alſo am an Iſraelite, of the ſeede of Abraham, of the tribe of Ben-iamin.
label: Romans

text: God hath not reiected his people vvhich he foreknevve. Or knovv you not in Elias vvhat the Scripture ſaith: hovv he requeſteth God againſt Iſraël?
label: Romans

text: Lord, they haue ſlaine thy Prophets, they haue digged dovvne thine altares: and I am left alone, and they ſeeke my life.
label: Romans

text: But vvhat ſaith the diuine anſvver vnto him? I haue left me ſeuen thouſand men, that haue not bovved their knees to Baal?
label: Romans

text: So therfore at this time alſo, there are remaines ſaued according to the election of grace.
label: Romans

text: And if by grace: not novv of vvorkes. othervviſe grace now is not grace.
label: Romans

text: What then? that vvhich Iſrael ſought, the ſame he hath not obtained: but the election hath obtained: and the reſt vvere blinded.
label: Romans

text: as it is vvritten: God hath giuen them the ſpirit of compunction: eies, that they may not ſee: and eares, that they may not heare: vntil this preſent day.
label: Romans

text: And Dauid ſaith: Be their table made for a ſnare and for a trappe and for a ſcandal and for a retribution vnto them.
label: Romans

text: Be their eies darkened, that they may not ſee: and their backe make thou alvvaies crooked.
label: Romans

text: I ſay then, haue they ſo ſtombled, that they ſhould fall? God forbid. but by their offence, ſaluation is to the Gentils, that they may emulate them.
label: Romans

text: And if the offence of them be the riches of the vvorld, and the diminution of them the riches of the Gentils: hovv much more the fulneſſe of them?
label: Romans

text: For to you Gentils I ſay, as long verely as I am the Apoſtle of the Gentils, I vvil honour my miniſterie,
label: Romans

text: if by any meanes I may prouoke my fleſh to emulation, and may ſaue ſome of them.
label: Romans

text: For if the loſſe of them be the reconciliation of the vvorld: vvhat ſhal the receiuing be, but life from the dead?
label: Romans

text: And if the firſt fruite be holy, the maſſe alſo: and if the roote be holy, the boughes alſo.
label: Romans

text: And if ſome of the boughes be broken, and thou vvhereas thou vvaſt a vvilde oliue, art graffed in them, and art made partaker of the roote and of the fatneſſe of the oliue,
label: Romans

text: glorie not againſt the boughes. And if thou glorie: not thou beareſt the roote, but the roote thee.
label: Romans

text: Thou ſaieſt then: The boughes were broken, that I might be graffed in.
label: Romans

text: Vvel: becauſe of incredulitie they vvere broken, but thou by faith doeſt ſtand: be not to highly vviſe, but feare.
label: Romans

text: For if God hath not ſpared the natural boughes: leſt perhaps he vvil not ſpare thee neither.
label: Romans

text: See then the goodnes and the ſeueritie of God: vpon them ſurely that are fallen, the ſeueritie: but vpon thee the goodnes of God, if thou abide in his goodneſſe, othervviſe thou alſo ſhalt be cut of.
label: Romans

text: But they alſo, if they do not abide in incredulitie, ſhal be graffed in. for God is able to graffe them in againe.
label: Romans

text: For if thou waſt cut out of the natural vvild oliue, and contrarie to nature waſt graffed into the good oliue: hovv much more they that are according to nature, ſhal be graffed into their ovvne oliue?
label: Romans

text: For I vvil not haue you ignorant, brethren, of this myſterie (that you be not wiſe in your ſelues) that blindnes in part hath chaunced in Iſraël, vntil the fulnes of the Gentiles might enter:
label: Romans

text: and ſo al Iſraël might be ſaued, as it is vvritten: There shal come out of Sion, he that ſhal deliuer, and ſhal auert impietie from Iacob.
label: Romans

text: And this to them the teſtament from me: vvhen I ſhal haue taken avvay their ſinnes.
label: Romans

text: According to the Goſpel in deede enemies for you: but according to the election, moſt deere for the fathers.
label: Romans

text: for vvithout repentance are the giftes and the vocation of God.
label: Romans

text: for as you alſo ſometime did not beleeue God, but novv haue obteined mercie becauſe of their incredulitie:
label: Romans

text: ſo theſe alſo novv haue not beleeued, for your mercie, that they alſo may obteine mercie.
label: Romans

text: For God hath concluded al into incredulitie, that he may haue mercie on al.
label: Romans

text: O depth of the riches of the vviſedom and of the knowledge of God: hovv incomprehenſible are his iudgements, and his vvaies vnſearcheable?
label: Romans

text: for vvho hath knovven the minde of our Lord? Or vvho hath been his counſeler?
label: Romans

text: Or vvho hath firſt giuen to him, and retribution ſhal be made him?
label: Romans

text: For of him, and by him, and in him are al things: to him be glorie for euer. Amen. ⊢
label: Romans

text: I BESECH you therfore brethren by the mercie of God, that you exhibite your bodies a liuing hoſt, holy, pleaſing God, your reaſonable ſeruice.
label: Romans

text: And be not conformed to this vvorld: but be reformed in the newnes of your minde, that you may proue vvhat the good, and acceptable, and perfect vvil of God is.
label: Romans

text: for I ſay by the grace that is giuen me, to al that are among you, not to be more vviſe then behoueth to be vviſe, but to be vviſe vnto ſobrietie, to euery one as God hath deuided the meaſure of faith.
label: Romans

text: For as in one body vve haue many members, but al the members haue not one action:
label: Romans

text: ſo vve being many, are one body in Chriſt, & eche one an others members. ⊢
label: Romans

text: And hauing giftes, according to the grace that is giuen vs, different: either prophecie according to the rule of faith,
label: Romans

text: or miniſterie in miniſtring, or he that teacheth in doctrine,
label: Romans

text: he that exhorteth in exhorting, he that giueth in ſimplicitie, he that ruleth in carefulnes, he that ſhevveth mercie in cheerefulnes.
label: Romans

text: Loue vvithout ſimulation. Hating euil. cleauing to good.
label: Romans

text: Louing the charitie of the brotherhod one toward an other. VVith honour preuenting one an other.
label: Romans

text: In carefulnes not ſlouthful. In ſpirit feruent. Seruing our Lord.
label: Romans

text: Reioycing in hope. Patient in tribulation. Inſtant in praier.
label: Romans

text: Communicating to the neceſſities of the ſainctes. Purſuing hoſpitalitie.
label: Romans

text: Bleſſe them that perſecute you: bleſſe, and curſe not.
label: Romans

text: To reioyce vvith them that reioyce, to vveepe vvith them that vveepe.
label: Romans

text: Being of one minde one tovvard an other. Not minding high things, but conſenting to the humble. ⊢ Be not vviſe in your ovvne conceite.
label: Romans

text: To no man rendring euil for euil. Prouiding good things not only before God, but alſo before al men.
label: Romans

text: If it may be, as much as is in you, hauing peace vvith al men.
label: Romans

text: Not reuenging your ſelues my deereſt, but giue place vnto vvrath, for it is vvritten: Reuenge to me: I vvil revvard, ſaith our Lord.
label: Romans

text: but if thine enemie hunger, giue him meate: if he thirſt, giue him drinke. for, doing this, thou ſhalt heape coales of fire vpon his head.
label: Romans

text: Be not ouercome of euil, but ouercome in good the euil. ⊢
label: Romans

text: LET euery ſoul be ſubiect to higher powers, for there is no povver but of God. And thoſe that are, of God are ordeined.
label: Romans

text: Therfore he that reſiſteth the povver, reſiſteth the ordinance of God. And they that reſiſt, purchaſe to them ſelues damnation.
label: Romans

text: for princes are no feare to the good worke, but to the euil. But wilt thou not feare the povver? Doe good: and thou ſhalt haue praiſe of the ſame.
label: Romans

text: for he is gods miniſter vnto thee for good. But if thou doe euil, feare. for he beareth not the ſvvord without cauſe. For he is Gods miniſter: a reuenger vnto vvrath, to him that doeth euil.
label: Romans

text: Therfore be ſubiect of neceſſitie, not only for vvrath, but alſo for conſcience ſake.
label: Romans

text: For therefore you giue tributes alſo. for they are the miniſters of God, ſeruing vnto this purpoſe.
label: Romans

text: Render therfore to al men their devv: to vvhom tribute, tribute: to vvhom cuſtom, cuſtom: to whom feare, feare: to vvhom honour, honour.
label: Romans

text: Ovve no man any thing: but, that you loue one an other. For he that loueth his neighbour, hath fulfilled the lavv.
label: Romans

text: for, Thou ſhalt not commit aduoutrie, Thou ſhalt not kil, Thou ſhalt not ſteale, Thou ſhalt not beare falſe vvitnes, Thou ſhalt not couet, and if there be any other commaundement: it is compriſed in this vvord, Thou ſhalt loue thy neighbour as thy ſelf.
label: Romans

text: The loue of thy neighbour, vvorketh no euil. Loue therfore is the fulneſſe of the lavv. ⊢
label: Romans

text: And that knovving the ſeaſon, that it is novv the houre for vs to riſe from ſleepe. For novv our ſaluation is neerer then vvhen vve beleeued.
label: Romans

text: The night is paſſed, and the day is at hand. Let vs therfore caſt of the vvorkes of darkneſſe, and doe on the armour of light.
label: Romans

text: As in the day let vs vvalke honeſtly: not in banketings and drunkennes, not in chamberings and impudicities, not in contention and emulation:
label: Romans

text: but doe ye on our Lord IESVS Chriſt, ⊢ and make not prouiſion for the fleſh in concupiſcences.
label: Romans

text: AND him that is vveake in faith, take vnto you: not in diſputations of cogitations.
label: Romans

text: For one beleeueth that he may eate al things: but he that is vveake, let him eate herbes.
label: Romans

text: Let not him that eateth, deſpiſe him that eateth not: and he that eateth not: let him not iudge him that eateth. for God hath taken him to him.
label: Romans

text: VVho art thou that iudgeſt an other mans ſeruant? To his ovvne Lord he ſtandeth or falleth. and he ſhal ſtand: for God is able to make him ſtand.
label: Romans

text: For one iudgeth betvveene day and day: and an other iudgeth euery day. let euery one abound in his ovvne ſenſe.
label: Romans

text: He that reſpecteth the day, reſpecteth to our Lord. And he that eateth, eateth to our Lord: for he giueth thankes to God. And he that eateth not, to our Lord he eateth not, and giueth thankes to God.
label: Romans

text: For none of vs liueth to him ſelf: & no man dieth to him ſelf.
label: Romans

text: For whether vve liue, we liue to our Lord: or vvhether we die, we die to our Lord. Therfore vvhether vve liue, or vvhether vve die, vve are our Lords.
label: Romans

text: For to this end Chriſt died and roſe againe: that he may haue dominion both of the dead and of the liuing.
label: Romans

text: But thou, vvhy iudgeſt thou thy brother? or thou, vvhy doeſt thou deſpiſe thy brother? For vve ſhal al ſtand before the iudgement ſeate of Chriſt.
label: Romans

text: For it is vvritten, Liue I, ſaith our Lord, that euery knee ſhal bovve to me: and euery tongue ſhal confeſſe to God.
label: Romans

text: Therfore euery one of vs for him ſelf ſhal render account to God.
label: Romans

text: Let vs therfore no more iudge one an other. but this iudge ye rather, that you put not a ſtumbling blocke or a ſcandal to your brother.
label: Romans

text: I knovv and am perſuaded in our Lord IESVS Chriſt, that nothing is common of it ſelf, but to him that ſuppoſeth, any thing to be common, to him it is common.
label: Romans

text: For if becauſe of meate thy brother be greeued: novv thou vvalkeſt not according to charitie. Do not vvith thy meate deſtroy him for vvhom Chriſt died.
label: Romans

text: Let not then our good be blaſphemed.
label: Romans

text: For the kingdom of God is not meate and drinke: but iuſtice, and peace, and ioy in the holy Ghoſt.
label: Romans

text: For he that in this ſerueth Chriſt, pleaſeth God, and is acceptable to men.
label: Romans

text: Therfore the things that are of peace let vs purſue: and the things that are of edifying one tovvard an other let vs keepe.
label: Romans

text: Deſtroy not the vvorke of God for meate. Al things in deede are cleane: but it is il for the man that eateth by giuing offence.
label: Romans

text: It is good not to eate fleſh, and not to drinke vvine, nor that vvherein thy brother is offended, or ſcandalized, or vveakened.
label: Romans

text: Haſt thou faith? haue it with thy ſelf before God. Bleſſed is he that iudgeth not him ſelf in that vvhich he approueth.
label: Romans

text: But he that diſcerneth, if he eate, is damned: becauſe not of faith. for al that is not of faith, is ſinne.
label: Romans

text: AND vve that are the ſtronger, muſt ſuſteine the infirmities of the vveake, & not pleaſe our ſelues.
label: Romans

text: Let euery one of you pleaſe his neighbour vnto good, to edification.
label: Romans

text: For, Chriſt did not pleaſe him ſelf, but as it is vvritten, The reproches of them that reproched thee, fel vpon me.
label: Romans

text: For vvhat things ſoeuer haue been vvritten, to our learning they are vvritten: that by the patience and conſolation of the Scriptures, vve may haue hope.
label: Romans

text: And the God of patience and of comfort giue you to be of one minde one tovvard an other according to IESVS Chriſt:
label: Romans

text: that of one minde, vvith one mouth you may glorifie God and the Father of our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: Romans

text: For the vvhich cauſe receiue one an other: as Chriſt alſo hath receiued you vnto the honour of God.
label: Romans

text: For I ſay Chriſt IESVS to haue been miniſter of the circumciſion for the veritie of God, to confirme the promiſſes of the fathers.
label: Romans

text: But the Gentils to honour God for his mercie, as it is vvritten: Therfore vvil I confeſſe to thee in the Gentils ô Lord, and vvil ſing to thy name.
label: Romans

text: And againe he ſaith, Reioyce ye Gentils vvith his people.
label: Romans

text: And againe, Praise al ye Gentils our Lord: and magnifie him al ye peoples.
label: Romans

text: And againe Eſaie ſaith, There ſhal be the roote of Ieſſe: and he that ſhal riſe vp to rule the Gentils, in him the Gentils ſhal hope.
label: Romans

text: And the God of hope repleniſh you vvith al ioy and peace in beleeuing: that you may abound in hope, and in the vertue of the holy Ghoſt. ⊢
label: Romans

text: And I my ſelf alſo, my brethren, am aſſured of you, that you alſo are ful of loue, repleniſhed vvith al knowledge, ſo that you are able to admoniſh one an other.
label: Romans

text: But I haue vvritten to you (brethren) more boldly in part, as it were putting you in remembrance: for the grace vvhich is giuen me of God,
label: Romans

text: to be the miniſter of Chriſt IESVS in the Gentils: ſanctifying the Goſpel of God, that the oblation of the Gentils may be made acceptable and ſanctified in the holy Ghoſt.
label: Romans

text: I haue therfore glorie in Chriſt IESVS toward God.
label: Romans

text: For I dare not ſpeake any of thoſe things vvhich Chriſt vvorketh not by me for the obedience of the Gentils, by vvord and deedes,
label: Romans

text: in the vertue of ſignes and wonders, in the vertue of the holy Ghoſt: ſo that from Hieruſalem round about vnto Illyricum I haue repleniſhed the Goſpel of Chriſt.
label: Romans

text: And I haue ſo preached this Goſpel, not vvhere Chriſt vvas named, leſt I ſhould build vpon an other mans foundation:
label: Romans

text: but as it is vvritten, They to vvhom it hath not been preached of him, ſhal ſee: and they that haue not heard, ſhal vnderſtand.
label: Romans

text: For the vvhich cauſe alſo I vvas hindred very much from comming vnto you.
label: Romans

text: But now hauing no longer place in theſe countries, and hauing a deſire to come vnto you theſe many yeres novv paſſed:
label: Romans

text: vvhen I ſhal begin to take my iourney into Spaine, I hope that as I paſſe, I ſhal ſee you, and be brought thither of you, if firſt in part I ſhal haue enioyed you.
label: Romans

text: Now therfore I vvil goe vnto Hieruſalem to miniſter to the ſaincts.
label: Romans

text: For Macedonia and Achaia haue liked vvel to make ſome contribution vpon the poore ſaincts that are in Hieruſalem.
label: Romans

text: For it hath pleaſed them: and they are their detters. For if the Gentiles be made partakers of their ſpiritual things: they ought alſo in carnal things to miniſter vnto them.
label: Romans

text: This therfore vvhen I ſhal haue accompliſhed, and ſigned them this fruite, I vvil goe by you into Spaine.
label: Romans

text: And I knovv that comming to you, I ſhal come in aboundance of the bleſſing of Chriſt.
label: Romans

text: I beſeeche you therfore brethren by our Lord IESVS Chriſt, and by the charitie of the holy Ghoſt, that you helpe me in your praiers for me to God,
label: Romans

text: that I may be deliuered from the infidels that are in Ievvrie, and the oblation of my ſeruice may become acceptable in Hieruſalem to the ſaincts,
label: Romans

text: that I may come to you in ioy by the vvil of God, that I may be refreſhed vvith you.
label: Romans

text: And the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
label: Romans

text: AND I commend to you Phœbè our ſiſter, vvho is in the miniſterie of the Church that is in Cenchris:
label: Romans

text: that you receiue her in our Lord as it is vvorthie for ſaincts: and that you aſſiſt her in whatſoeuer buſines ſhe ſhal neede you. for ſhe alſo hath aſſiſted many and my ſelf.
label: Romans

text: Salute Priſca and Aquila my helpers in Chriſt IESVS,
label: Romans

text: ( vvho for my life haue laid dovvne their neckes: to whom not I only giue thankes, but alſo al the Churches of the Gentiles)
label: Romans

text: and their domeſtical Church. Salute Epænetus my beloued: vvho is the firſt fruite of Aſia in Chriſt.
label: Romans

text: Salute Marie vvho hath laboured much about vs.
label: Romans

text: Salute Andrónicus and ‘Iulia’ my coſins and fellovv captiues: vvho are noble among the Apoſtles, vvho alſo before me vvere in Chriſt.
label: Romans

text: Salute Ampliátus my beſt beloued in our Lord.
label: Romans

text: Salute Vrbánus our helper in Chriſt IESVS, and Stachys my beloued.
label: Romans

text: Salute Apelles approued in Chriſt. Salute them that are of Ariſtóbolus houſe.
label: Romans

text: Salute Herodion my kinſman. Salute them that are of Narciſſus houſe, that are in our Lord.
label: Romans

text: Salute Tryphæna and Tryphóſa: vvho labour in our Lord. Salute Perſis the beloued, vvho hath much laboured in our Lord.
label: Romans

text: Salute Rufus the elect in our Lord and his mother and mine.
label: Romans

text: Salute Aſyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Pátrobas, Hermes: and the brethren that are vvith them.
label: Romans

text: Salute Philólogus and Iulia, Nereus, and his ſiſter and Olympias: and al the ſaincts that are vvith them.
label: Romans

text: Salute one an other in a holy kiſſe. Al the churches of Chriſt ſalute you.
label: Romans

text: And I deſire you brethren, to marke them that make diſſenſions and ſcandals contrarie to the doctrine vvhich you haue learned, and auoid them.
label: Romans

text: For ſuch doe not ſerue Chriſt our Lord, but their ovvne belly: and by ſvveete ſpeaches and benedictions ſeduce the hartes of innocents.
label: Romans

text: For your obedience is publiſhed into euery place. I reioyce therfore in you. But I vvould haue you to be vviſe in good, and ſimple in euil.
label: Romans

text: And the God of peace cruſh Satan vnder your feete quickely. The grace of our Lord IESVS Chriſt be vvith you.
label: Romans

text: Timothee my coadiutor ſaluteth you, and Lucius, and Iaſon, and Soſípater, my kinſmen.
label: Romans

text: I Tertius ſalute you, that vvrote the epiſtle, in our Lord.
label: Romans

text: Caius mine hoſt, and the whole Churches, ſaluteth you. Eraſtus the Cofferer of the citie ſaluteth you, and Quartus, a brother.
label: Romans

text: The grace of our Lord IESVS Chriſt be vvith al you, Amen.
label: Romans

text: And to him that is able to confirme you according to my Goſpel and preaching of IESVS Chriſt, according to the reuelation of the myſterie from eternal times kept ſecrete,
label: Romans

text: vvhich novv is opened by the Scriptures of the prophets according to the precept of the eternal God, to the obedience of faith knovven in al Gentiles,
label: Romans

text: to God the only vviſe through IESVS Chriſt, ‘to vvhom’ be honour & glorie for euer and euer. Amen.
label: Romans

text: PAVL called to be an Apoſtle of IESVS Chriſt, by the vvil of God, and Sóſthenes a brother,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: to the Church of God that is at Corinth, to the ſanctified in Chriſt IESVS, called to be ſaincts, with al that inuocate the name of our Lord IESVS Chriſt in euery place of theirs and ours.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Grace to you and peace from God our father and our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: I giue thankes to my God alvvaies for you for the grace of God that is giuen you in Chriſt IESVS,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: that in al things you be made riche in him, in al vtterance, and in al knovvledge,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: ( as the teſtimonie of Chriſt is confirmed in you,)
label: 1 Corinthians

text: ſo that nothing is vvanting to you in any grace, expecting the reuelation of our Lord IESVS Chriſt,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: vvho alſo vvil confirme you vnto the end vvithout crime, in the day of the comming of our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: God is faithful: by whom you are called into the ſocietie of his ſonne IESVS Chriſt our Lord.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And I beſeeche you brethren by the name of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, that you al ſay one thing, and that there be no ſchiſmes among you: but that you be perfect in one ſenſe, & in one knovvledge.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For it is ſignified vnto me (my brethren) of you, by them that are of Chloè, that there be contentions among you.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And I meane this, for that euery one of you ſaith, I certes am Paules, & I Apollos, but I Cephas, and I Chriſts.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Is Chriſt deuided? Vvhy, vvas Paul crucified for you? or in the name of Paul vvere you baptized?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: I giue God thankes, that I baptized none of you, but Criſpus and Caius:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: leſt any man ſay that in my name you were baptized.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And I baptized alſo the houſe of Stéphanas. But I know not if I haue baptized any other.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For Chriſt ſent me not to baptize, but to euangelize: not in vviſedom of ſpeache, that the croſſe of Chriſt be not made void.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For the vvord of the croſſe, to them in deede that periſh, is foliſhnes: but to them that are ſaued, that is, to vs, it is the povver of God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For it is vvritten, I wil deſtroy the wiſedom of the vviſe: and the prudence of the prudent I wil reiecte.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Where is the vviſe? where is the Scribe? where is the diſputer of this world? Hath not God made the vviſedom of this vvorld foliſh?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For becauſe in the vviſedom of God the vvorld did not by vviſedom know God: it pleaſed God by the foliſhnes of the preaching to ſaue them that beleeue.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For both the Iewes aſke ſignes, and the Greekes ſeeke vviſedom:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: but vve preach Chriſt crucified, to the Iewes certes a ſcandal, and to the Gentiles, foliſhnes:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: but to the called Iewes & Greekes, Chriſt the povver of God and the wiſedom of God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For that which is the foliſh of God, is vviſer then men: and that which is the infirme of God, is ſtronger then men.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For ſee your vocation brethren, that not many vviſe according to the fleſh, not many mightie, not many noble:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: but the foliſh things of the vvorld hath God choſen, that he may confound the vviſe: and the vveake things of the vvorld hath God choſen, that he may confound the ſtrong:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: and the baſe things of the vvorld and the contemptible hath God choſen, and thoſe things vvhich are not, that he might deſtroy thoſe things which are:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: that no fleſh may glorie in his ſight.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And of him you are in Chriſt IESVS, vvho is made vnto vs vviſedom from God, & iuſtice, & ſanctification, and redemption:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: that as it is written, He that doth glorie, may glorie in our Lord. ⊢
label: 1 Corinthians

text: AND I (brethren) when I came to you, I came not in loftineſſe of ſpeache or of vviſedom, preaching to you the teſtimonie of Chriſt.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For I iudged not my ſelf to knovv any thing among you but IESVS Chriſt, and him crucified.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And I vvas vvith you in infirmitie, and feare and much trembling:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: and my ſpeache and my preaching vvas not in the perſuaſible vvordes of humane vviſedom, but in ſhevving of ſpirit and povver:
