label: 1 Corinthians

text: that your faith might not be in the vviſedom of men, but in the povver of God. But vve ſpeake vviſedom among the perfect.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: but the vviſedom not of this vvorld, neither of the princes of this vvorld that come to naught:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: but we ſpeake the wiſedom of God in a myſterie, which is hid, vvhich God did predeſtinate before the worlds, vnto our glorie:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: which none of the princes of this world did know: for if they had knovven, they vvould neuer haue crucified the Lord of glorie.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But as it is vvritten, That vvhich eie hath not ſeen, nor eare hath heard, neither hath it aſcended into the hart of man, vvhat things God hath prepared for them that loue him.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: but to vs God hath reuealed by his Spirit. For the Spirit ſearcheth al things, yea the profoundities of God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For vvhat man knoweth the things of a man, but the ſpirit of a man that is in him? ſo the things alſo that are of God no man knovveth, but the ſpirit of God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And we haue receiued not the ſpirit of this vvorld, but the ſpirit that is of God: that vve may know the things that of God are giuen to vs.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: which alſo we ſpeake not in learned vvordes of humane vviſedom: but in the doctrine of the Spirit, comparing ſpiritual things to the ſpiritual.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But the ſenſual man perceiueth not thoſe things that are of the ſpirit of God. for it is foliſhnes to him, and he can not vnderſtand: becauſe he is ſpiritually examined.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But the ſpiritual man iudgeth al things: and him ſelf is iudged of no man.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For vvho hath knovven the ſenſe of our Lord that may inſtructe him? But vve haue the ſenſe of Chriſt.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: AND I, brethren, could not ſpeake to you as to ſpiritual, but as to carnal. As it vvere to litle ones in Chriſt,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: I gaue you milke to drinke, not meate: for you could not as yet. but neither can you novv verely, for yet you are carnal.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For vvhereas there is among you emulation and contention, are you not carnal, and vvalke according to man?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For vvhen one ſaith, I certes am Paules, & an other, I Apollos: are you not men? Vvhat is Apollo then? and vvhat is Paul?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: The miniſters of him vvhom you haue beleeued, & to euery one as our Lord hath giuen.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: I planted, Apollo vvatered: but God gaue the increaſe.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Therefore neither he that planteth is any thing, nor he that vvatereth: but he that giueth the increaſe, God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And he that planteth and he that vvatereth are one. And euery one ſhal receiue his owne reward according to his ovvne labour.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For vve are Gods ccoadiutors: you are Gods huſbandrie, you are Gods building.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: According to the grace that is giuen me, as a vviſe vvorkemaſter haue I laid the foundation: and an other buildeth therevpon. but let euery one looke hovv he buildeth thereon.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For other foundation no man can lay, beſide that vvhich is laid: vvhich is Chriſt IESVS.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And if any man build vpon this foundation, gold, ſiluer, pretious ſtones, vvood, hay, ſtubble,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: the vvorke of euery one ſhal be manifeſt: for the day of our Lord vvil declare, becauſe it ſhal be reuealed in fire: and the vvorke of euery one of vvhat kinde it is, the fire ſhal trie.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: If any mans vvorke abide, vvhich he built therevpon: he ſhal receiue revvard.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: If any mans vvorke burne, he ſhal ſuffer detriment: but him ſelf ſhal be ſaued: yet ſo as by fire.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Knovv you not that you are the temple of God: and the Spirit of God dvvelleth in you?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But if any violate the temple of God, God vvil deſtroy him. For the temple of God is holy: vvhich you are.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Let no man ſeduce him ſelf: if any man ſeeme to be vviſe among you in this world, let him become a foole that he may be vviſe.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For the vviſedom of this vvorld is foliſhnes vvith God. For it is vvritten, I vvil compaſſe the vviſe in their ſubteltie.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And againe, Our Lord knovveth the cogitations of the vviſe that they be vaine.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Let no man therfore glorie in men. For al things are yours:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: vvhether it be Paul, or Apollo, or Cephas, or the vvorld, or life, or death, or things preſent, or things to come, for al are yours:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: and you are Chriſts, and Chriſt iſ Gods.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: SO let a man eſteeme vs as the miniſters of Chriſt, and the diſpenſers of the myſteries of God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Here now is required among the diſpenſers that a man be found faithful.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But to me it is a thing of leſt account, to be iudged of you, or of mans day: but I iudge not my ſelf neither.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For I am not guilty in conſcience of any thing:but I am not iuſtified herein: but he that iudgeth me, is our Lord.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Therfore iudge not before the time: vntil our Lord do come, vvho alſo wil lighten the hidden things of darkenes, and vvil manifeſt the counſels of the hartes: & then the praiſe ſhal be to euery man of God. ⊢
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But theſe things, brethren, I haue tranſfigured into my ſelf and Apollo, for you: that in vs you may learne, one not to be puffed vp againſt an other, aboue that is vvritten.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For vvho diſcerneth thee? Or vvhat haſt thou that thou haſt not receiued? And if thou haſt receiued, what doeſt thou glorie as though thou haſt nor receiued?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Now you are filled, now are you become riche: without vs you reigne: & I would to God you did reigne, that vve alſo might reigne vvith you.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For I thinke that God hath ſhevved vs Apoſtles the laſt, as it vvere deputed to death: becauſe vve are made a ſpectacle to the vvorld, and to Angels and men.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Vve are fooles for Chriſt: but you wiſe in Chriſt. vve vveake: but you ſtrong, you noble, but vve baſe.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Vntil this houre we doe both hunger, and thirſt, and are naked, and are beaten vvith buffets, and are vvanderers,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: and labour vvorking vvith our ovvne handes. vve are curſed: and do bleſſe. vve are perſecuted: and ſuſteine it.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: vve are blaſphemed: and vve beſeeche. vve are made the refuſe of this vvorld, the droſſe of al euen vntil novv.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Not to confound you, do I write theſe things: but as my deereſt children I admoniſh you. ⊢
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For if you haue ten thouſand pædagoges in Chriſt: yet not many fathers. For in Chriſt IESVS by the Goſpel I begat you. ⊢
label: 1 Corinthians

text: I beſeeche you therfore be folovvers of me.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Therfore haue I ſent to you Timothee, vvho is my deereſt ſonne and faithful in our Lord: vvho vvil put you in minde of my vvaies that are in Chriſt IESVS, as euery where in euery Church I teach.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: As though I vvould not come to you, ſo certaine are puffed vp.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But I vvil come to you quickly, if our Lord vvil: and vvil know not the vvordes of them that be puffed vp, but the povver.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For the kingdom of God is not in vvordes, but in povver.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Vvhat vvil you? in rodde that I come to you: or in charitie, and the ſpirit of mildnes?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: THERE is plainely heard fornication among you, and ſuch fornication, as the like is not among the heathen, ſo that one hath his fathers vvife.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And you are puffed vp: and haue not mourned rather, that he might be taken avvay from among you, that hath done this deede.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: I in deede abſent in body, but preſent in ſpirit, haue already iudged, as preſent, him that hath ſo done,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: in the name of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, you being gathered together and my ſpirit, vvith the vertue of our Lord IESVS
label: 1 Corinthians

text: to deliuer ſuch an one to Satan for the deſtruction of the fleſh, that the ſpirit may be ſaued in the day of our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Your glorying is not good. Knovv you not that a litle leauen corrupteth the vvhole paſte?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Purge the old leauen, that you may be a nevv paſte, as you are azymes. For our Paſche, Chriſt, is immolated.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Therfore let vs feaſt, not in the old leauen, nor in the leauen of malice and vvickednes, but in the azymes of ſinceritie and veritie. ⊢
label: 1 Corinthians

text: I vvrote to you in can epiſtle, Not to keepe companie vvith fornicatours.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: I meane not the fornicatours of this vvorld, or the couetous, or the extorſioners, or ſeruers of Idols: othervviſe you ſhould haue gone out of this vvorld.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But novv I vvrote to you, not to keepe companie, if he that is named a brother, be a fornicatour, or a couetous perſon, or a ſeruer of Idols, or a railer, or a drunkarde, or an extorſioner: vvith ſuch an one not ſo much as to take meate.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For vvhat is it to me to iudge of them that are vvithout? Do not you iudge of them that are vvithin?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: for them that are vvithout, God vvil iudge. Take away the euil-one from among your ſelues.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: DARE any of you hauing a matter againſt an other, to be iudged before the vniuſt, and not before the ſaincts?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Or knovv you not that the ſaincts ſhal iudge of the vvorld? And if the vvorld ſhal be iudged by you: are you vnvvorthie to iudge of the leſt things?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Knovv you not that vve ſhal iudge Angels? hovv much more ſecular things?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: If therfore you haue ſecular iudgements: the contemptible that are in the Church, ſet them to iudge.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: I ſpeake to your ſhame. So is there not among you any vviſe man, that can iudge betvvene his brother?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: but brother vvith brother contendeth in iudgement: and that before infidels?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Novv certes there is plainely a fault in you, that you haue iudgements among you. Vvhy do you not rather take vvrong? vvhy do you not rather ſuffer fraude?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But your ſelues doe vvrong and defraude: and that to the brethren.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Knovv you not that the vniuſt ſhal not poſſeſſe the kingdom of God? Do not erre, Neither fornicatours, nor cſeruers of Idols, nor aduouterers, nor the effeminat, nor the liers vvith mankinde,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: nor theeues, nor the couetous, nor drunkards, nor railers, nor extorſioners ſhal poſſeſſe the kingdom of God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And theſe things certes you vvere: but you are vvaſhed, but you are ſanctified, but you are iuſtified in the name of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, and in the Spirit of our God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Al things are lavvful for me, but al things are not expedient. Al things are lavvful for me, but I vvil be brought vnder the povver of none.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: The meate to the belly, and the belly to the meates: but God vvil deſtroy both it and them: and the body not to fornication, but to our Lord, and our Lord to the body.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But God both hath raiſed vp our Lord, and vvil raiſe vp vs alſo by his povver.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Knovv you not that your bodies are the members of Chriſt? Taking therfore the members of Chriſt, ſhal I make them the members of an harlot? God forbid.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Or knovv you not, that he which cleaueth to an harlot, is made one body? For they ſhal be, ſaith he, tvvo in one fleſh.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But he that cleaueth to our Lord, is one ſpirit.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Flee fornication. Euery ſinne vvhatſoeuer a man doth, is vvithout the body: but he that doth fornicate, ſinneth againſt his ovvne body.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Or knovv you not that your members are the temple of the holy Ghoſt vvhich is in you, vvhom you haue of God, and you are not your ovvne?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For you are bought vvith a great price. Glorifie and beare God in your body.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: AND concerning the things vvhereof you vvrote to me: It is good for a man not to touch a vvoman.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But becauſe of fornication let euery man haue his ovvne vvife, and let euery vvoman haue her ovvne huſband.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Let the huſband render his dette to the vvife: and the vvife alſo in like maner to her huſband.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: The vvoman hath not povver of her ovvne body: but her huſband. And in like maner the man alſo hath not povver of his ovvne body: but the vvoman.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Defraude not one an other, except perhaps by conſent for a time, that you may giue your ſelf to praier: and returne againe together, leſt Satan tempt you for your incontinencie.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But I ſay this by indulgence, not by commaundement.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For I vvould al men to be as my ſelf: but euery one hath a proper gift of God: one ſo, and an other ſo.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But I ſay to the vnmaried and to vvidovves: it is good for them if they ſo abide euen as I alſo.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But if they doe not conteine them ſelues, let them marie. For it is better to marie then to be burnt.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But to them that be ioyned in matrimonie, not I giue commaundement, but our Lord, that the vvife depart not from her huſband:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: and if ſhe depart, to remaine vnmaried, or to be reconciled to her huſband. And let not the huſband put avvay his vvife.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For to the reſt, I ſay, not our Lord. If any brother haue a vvife an infidel, and ſhe conſent to dvvel with him: let him not put her avvay.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And if any vvoman haue a huſband an infidel, and he conſent to dvvel vvith her: let her not put avvay her huſband.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For the man an infidel is ſanctified by the faithful vvoman: and the vvoman an infidel is ſanctified by the faithful huſband: otherwiſe your children ſhould be vncleane: but novv they are holy.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But if the infidel depart, let him depart. for the brother or ſiſter is not ſubiect to ſeruitude in ſuch. but in peace hath God called vs.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For how knoweſt thou woman, if thou ſhalt ſaue thy huſband? or how knoweſt thou man, if thou ſhalt ſaue the vvoman?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But to euery one as our Lord hath deuided, as God hath called euery one, ſo let him vvalke, and as in al Churches I teach.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Is any man called being circumciſed? let him not procure prepuce. Is any man called in prepuce? let him not be circumciſed.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Circumciſion is nothing, and prepuce is nothing: but the obſeruation of the commaundements of God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Euery one in the vocation that he vvas called, in it let him abide.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: VVaſt thou called being a bondman? care not for it: but and if thou canſt be made free, vſe it rather.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For he that in our Lord is called, being a bondman, is the cfranchiſed of our Lord. likevviſe he that is called, being free, is the bondman of Chriſt.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: You vvere bought vvith price, be not made the bondmen of men.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Euery brother vvherein he vvas called, in that let him abide before God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And as concerning virgins, a commaundement of our Lord I haue not: but counſel I giue, as hauing obteined mercie of our Lord to be faithful.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: I thinke therfore that this is good for the preſent neceſſitie, becauſe it is good for a man ſo to be.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Art thou tied to a vvife? ſeeke not to be looſed. Art thou looſe from a vvife? ſeeke not a vvife.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But if thou take a vvife, thou haſt not ſinned. And if a virgin marie, ſhe hath not ſinned. neuertheleſſe tribulation of the fleſh ſhal ſuch haue. but I ſpare you.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: This therfore I ſay brethren, the time is ſhort, it remaineth, that they alſo which haue vviues, be as though they had not:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: and they that vveepe, as though they vvept not: and they that reioyce, as though they reioyced not: and they that bye, as though they poſſeſſed not:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: and they that vſe this vvorld, as though they vſed it not. for the figure of this vvorld paſſeth avvay.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But I vvould haue you to be vvithout carefulnes. He that is vvithout a vvife, is careful for the things that pertaine to our Lord, how he may pleaſe God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But he that is vvith a vvife, is careful for the things that pertaine to the vvorld, hovv he may pleaſe his vvife: and he is deuided.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And the vvoman vnmaried & the virgin, thinketh on the things that pertaine to our Lord: that ſhe may be holy both in body and in ſpirit. ⊢ But ſhe that is maried, thinketh on the things that pertaine to the vvorld, hovv ſhe may pleaſe her huſband.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And this I ſpeake to your profit: not to caſt a ſnare vpon you, but to that vvhich is honeſt, & that may giue you povver vvithout impediment to attend vpon our Lord.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But if any man thinke that he ſeemeth diſhonoured vpon his virgin, for that ſhe is paſt age, and if it muſt ſo be, let him doe that he vvil. He ſinneth not if ſhe marie.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For he that hath determined in his hart being ſettled, not hauing neceſſitie, but hauing povver of his ovvne vvil, and hath iudged this in his hart, to keepe his virgin, doeth vvel.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Therfore both he that ioyneth his virgin in matrimonie, doeth vvel: & he that ioyneth not, doeth better.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: A vvoman is bound to the lavv ſo long time as her huſband liueth: but if her huſband ſleepe, ſhe is at libertie: let her marie to vvhom ſhe vvil: only in our Lord.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But more bleſſed ſhal ſhe be if ſhe ſo remaine, according to my counſel. and I thinke that I alſo haue the Spirit of God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: AND concerning thoſe things that are ſacrificed to Idols, vve knovv that vve al haue knovvledge. Knovvledge puffeth vp: but charitie edifieth.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And if any man thinke that he knoweth ſomething, he hath not yet knovven, as he ought to knovv.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But if any man loue God, the ſame is knovven of him.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But as for the meates that are immolated to Idols, vve knovv that an Idol is nothing in the vvorld, and that there is no God, but one.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For although there be that are called gods, either in heauen, or in earth (for there are many gods, and many lordes)
label: 1 Corinthians

text: yet to vs there is one God, the Father, of vvhom al things, and vve vnto him: and one Lord, IESVS Chriſt, by vvhom al things, and vve by him.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But there is not knovvledge in al. For ſome vntil this preſent vvith a conſcience of the Idol, eate as a thing ſacrificed to Idols: and their conſcience being vveake, is polluted.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But meate doth not commend vs to God. For neither if vve eate, ſhal vve abound: nor if vve eate not, ſhal vve lacke.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But take heede leſt perhaps this your libertie be an offenſe to the vveake.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For if a man ſee him that hath knovvledge, ſit at table in the Idols temple: ſhal not his conſcience, being vveake, be edified, to eate things ſacrificed to Idols?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And through thy knovvledge ſhal the vveake brother periſh, for whom Chriſt hath died?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But ſinning thus againſt the brethren, and ſtriking their vveake conſcience: you ſinne againſt Chriſt.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: VVherfore if meate ſcandalize my brother: I vvil neuer eate fleſh, leſt I ſcandalize my brother.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: AM I not free? Am I not an Apoſtle? Haue I not ſeen Chriſt IESVS our Lord? Are not you my vvorke in our Lord?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And if to others I be not an Apoſtle, but yet to you I am. for you are the ſeale of my Apoſtleſhip in our Lord.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: my defenſe to them that examine me is this:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Haue not vve povver to eate and drinke?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Haue vve not povver to lead about a vvoman a ſiſter, as alſo the reſt of the Apoſtles, and our Lordes brethren, and Cephas?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Or I only and Barnabas haue not vve povver to doe this?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Vvho euer plaieth the ſouldiar at his ovvne charges? Vvho planteth a vine, and eateth not of the fruite thereof? Vvho feedeth a flocke, and eateth not of the milke of the flocke?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Speake I theſe things according to man? Or doth not the Lavv alſo ſay theſe things?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For it is vvritten in the Lavv of Moyſes, Thou ſhalt not mooſel the mouth of the oxe that treadeth out the corne. Vvhy, hath God care of oxen?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Or for vs certes doth he ſay it? For they are vvritten for vs, becauſe he that eateth, ought to eate in hope: and he that treadeth, in hope to receiue fruite.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: If vve haue ſovven vnto you ſpiritual things, is it a great matter if vve reape your carnal things?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: If other be partakers of your povver: vvhy not vve rather? Hovvbeit vve haue not vſed this povver: but vve beare al things, leſt vve ſhould giue any offence to the Goſpel of Chriſt.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Knovv you not that they which vvorke in the holy place, eate the things that are of the holy place: and they that ſerue the altar, participat with the altar?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: So alſo our Lord ordained for them that preach the Goſpel, to liue of the Goſpel.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But I haue vſed none of theſe. Neither haue I vvritten theſe things, that they ſhould be ſo done in me: for it is good for me to die rather, then that any man ſhould make my glorie void.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For and if I euangelize, it is no glorie to me: for neceſſitie lieth vpon me: for vvoe is to me if I euangelize not.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For if I doe this vvillingly, I haue revvard: but if againſt my vvil, a charge is committed to me.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Vvhat is my revvard then? That preaching the Goſpel, I yeld the Goſpel vvithout coſt, that I abuſe not my povver in the Goſpel.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For vvhereas I vvas free of al, I made my ſelf the ſeruant of al: that I might gaine the moe.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And I became to the Ievves as a Ievv, that I might gaine the Ievves.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: to them that are vnder the Lavv, as though I vvere vnder the Lavv (vvhereas my ſelf vvas not vnder the Lavv) that I might gaine them that vvere vnder the Lavv. to them that vvere vvithout the Lavv, as though I vvere vvithout the Lavv (vvhereas I vvas not vvithout the lavv of God, but vvas in the lavv of Chriſt) that I might gaine them that vvere vvithout the Lavv.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: To the vveake I became weake, that I might gaine the weake. To al men I became al things, that I might ſaue al.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And I doe al things for the Goſpel, that I may be made partaker thereof.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Knovv you not that they that runne in the race, al runne in deede, but one receiueth the price? So runne that you may obteine.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And euery one that ſtriueth for the maiſtrie, refraineth him ſelf from al things: and they certes, that they may receiue a corruptible crovvne: but vve an incorruptible.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: I therfore ſo runne, not as it vvere at an vncertaine thing: ſo I fight, not as it vvere beating the aire:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: but I chaſtiſe my body, and bring it into ſeruitude, leſt perhaps vvhen I haue preached to others, my ſelf become reprobate.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: FOR I vvil not haue you ignorant brethren, that our fathers vvere al vnder the cloude, & al paſſed through the ſea,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: and al in Moyſes vvere baptized in the cloude and in the ſea:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: and al did eate the ſame ſpiritual foode,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: and al drunke the ſame ſpiritual drinke (and they drunke of the ſpiritual rocke that folovved them, and the rocke vvas Chriſt,)
label: 1 Corinthians

text: but in the more part of them God vvas not vvel pleaſed. ¶ for they vvere ouerthrovven in the deſert.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And theſe things vvere done in a figure of vs, that vve be not coueting euil things, as they alſo coueted.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Neither become ye Idolaters, as certaine of them: as is vvritten: The people ſate dovvne to eate and drinke, and roſe vp to play.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Neither let vs fornicate, as certaine of them did fornicate, and there fel in one day three and tvventie thouſand.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Neither let vs tempt Chriſt: as certaine of them tempted, and periſhed by the ſerpents.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Neither doe you murmure: as certaine of them murmured, and periſhed by the deſtroyer.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And al theſe things chaunced to them in figure: but they are vvritten to our correption, vpon vvhom the endes of the vvorld are come.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Therefore he that thinketh him ſelf to ſtand, let him take heede leſt he fall.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: `Let not tentation apprehend' you, but humane. and God is faithful, vvho vvil not ſuffer you to be tempted aboue that vvhich you are able: but vvil make alſo vvith tentation iſſue, that you may be able to ſuſteine.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For the vvhich cauſe, my deereſt, flee from the ſeruing of Idols.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: I ſpeake as to vviſe men: your ſelues iudge vvhat I ſay.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: The chalice of benediction vvhich vve do bleſſe: is it not the cōmunication of the bloud of Chriſt? and the bread vvhich vve breake, is it not the participation of the body of our Lord?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For being many, vve are one bread, one body, al that participate of one bread.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Behold Iſraël according to the fleſh: they that eate the hoſtes, are they not partakers of the altar?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Vvhat then? do I ſay that that vvhich is immolated to Idols, is any thing? or that the Idol is any thing?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But the things that the heathen do immolate, to deuils they do immolate, and not to God. And I vvil not haue you become felovves of deuils.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: You can not drinke the chalice of our Lord, and the chalice of deuils: you can not be partakers of the table of our Lord, and of the table of deuils.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Or do vve emulate our Lord? Vvhy, are we ſtronger then he? Al things are lavvful for me, but al things are not expedient.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Al things are lavvful for me, but al things do not edifie.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Let no man ſeeke his ovvne, but an other mans.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Al that is ſold in the ſhambles, eate: aſking no queſtion for conſcience.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: The earth is our Lordes, and the fulnes thereof.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: If any inuite you of the infidels, and you vvil goe: eate of al that is ſet before you, aſking no queſtion for conſcience.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But if any man ſay, This is immolated to Idols: do not eate for his ſake that ſhevved it, and for conſcience:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: conſcience I ſay not thine but the others. For vvhy is my libertie iudged of an other mans conſcience?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: If I participate vvith thankes: vvhy am I blaſphemed for that vvhich I giue thankes for?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Therfore vvhether you eate, or drinke, or do any other thing: doe al things vnto the glorie of God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Be vvithout offenſe to the Ievves and to the Gentiles, and to the Church of God:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: as I alſo in al things doe pleaſe al men, not ſeeking that vvhich is profitable to my ſelf, but vvhich is to many: that they may be ſaued.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: BE ye folovvers of me, as I alſo of Chriſt.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And I praiſe you brethren, that in al things you be mindeful of me: and as I haue deliuered vnto you, you keepe my precepts.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And I vvil haue you knovv, that the head of euery man, is Chriſt: and the head of the vvoman, is the man: and the head of Chriſt, is God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Euery man praying or prophecying vvith his head couered: diſhoneſteth his head.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But euery vvoman praying or prophecying vvith her head not couered: diſhoneſteth her head: for it is al one as if ſhe vvere made balde.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For if a vvoman be not couered, let her be polled. but if it be a foule thing for a vvoman to be polled or made balde: let her couer her head.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: The man truely ought not to couer his head, becauſe he is the image and glorie of God, but the vvoman is the glorie of the man.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For the man is not of the vvoman, but the vvoman of the man.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For the man vvas not created for the vvoman, but the vvoman for the man.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: (Therfore ought the vvoman to haue povver vpon her head for the Angels.)
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But yet neither the man vvithout the vvoman: nor the vvoman vvithout the man, in our Lord.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For as the vvoman is of the man, ſo alſo the man by the vvoman: but al things of God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Your ſelues iudge: doth it become a vvoman not couered to pray vnto God?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Neither doth nature it ſelf teach you, that a man in deede if he nouriſh his heare, it is an ignominie for him:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: but if a vvoman nouriſh her heare, it is a glorie for her, becauſe heare is giuen her for a veile?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But if any man ſeeme to be contentious, vve haue no ſuch cuſtome, nor the `CHVRCH' of God.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And this I commaund: not praiſing it that you come together not to better, but to vvorſe.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Firſt in deede vvhen you come together into the Church, I heare that there are ſchiſmes among you, and in part I beleeue it.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For there muſt be hereſies alſo: that they alſo vvhich are approued, may be made manifeſt among you.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Vvhen you come therfore together in one, is it not novv to eate our Lordes ſupper.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For euery one taketh his ovvne ſupper before to eate. And one certes is an hungred, and an other is drunke.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Vvhy, haue you not houſes to eate and drinke in? or contemne ye the Church of God: and confound them that haue not? Vvhat ſhal I ſay to you? praiſe I you in this? I do not praiſe you.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For I receiued of our Lord that vvhich alſo I haue deliuered vnto you, that our Lord IESVS in the night that he vvas betraied, tooke bread:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: and giuing thankes brake, and ſaid: Take ye & eate, THIS IS MY BODY VVHICH SHAL BE DELIVERED FOR YOV: this doe ye for the commemoration of me.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: In like maner alſo the chalice after he had ſupped, ſaying, THIS CHALICE IS THE NEVV TESTAMENT IN MY BLOVD. this doe ye, as often as you ſhal drinke, for the cōmemoration of me.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For as often as you ſhal eate this bread, and drinke the chalice, you ſhal ſhevv the death of our Lord, vntil he come.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Therfore vvhoſoeuer ſhal eate this bread, or drinke the chalice of our Lord vnvvorthily, he ſhal be guilty of the body and of the bloud of our Lord.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But let a man proue him ſelf: and ſo, let him eate of that bread, and drinke of the chalice.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For he that eateth and drinketh vnvvorthily: eateth and drinketh iudgement to him ſelf, not diſcerning the body of our Lord. ⊢
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Therfore are there among you many weake and feble, and many ſleepe.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But if vve did iudge our ſelues: vve ſhould not be iudged.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But vvhiles vve are iudged, of our Lord vve are chaſtiſed: that vvith this world vve be not damned. ⊢
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Therfore my brethren, vvhen you come together to eate, expect one an other.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: If any man be an hungred, let him eate at home: that you come not together vnto iudgement. And the reſt I vvil diſpoſe, vvhen I come.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: ANd concerning ſpiritual things, I vvil not haue you ignorant, brethren.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: You know that vvhen you vvere heathen, you vvent to dumme Idols according as you vvere ledde.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Therfore I doe you to vnderſtand that no man ſpeaking in the Spirit of God, ſaith anáthema to IESVS. And no man can ſay, Our Lord IESVS: but in the holy Ghoſt.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And there are diuiſions of graces, but one Spirit.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And there are diuiſions of miniſtrations: but one Lord.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And there are diuiſions of operations, but one God, vvhich vvorketh al in al.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And the manifeſtation of the Spirit is giuen vnto euery one to profit.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: To one certes by the Spirit is giuen the vvord of vviſedom: and to an other, the vvord of knovvledge according to the ſame Spirit:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: to an other, faith in the ſame Spirit: to an other, the grace of doing cures in one Spirit:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: to an other, the vvorking of miracles: to an other, prophecie: to an other, diſcerning of ſpirites: to an other, kindes of tonges: to an other, interpretation of languages.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And al theſe things vvorketh one and the ſame Spirit, diuiding to euery one according as he vvil. ⊢
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and al the members of the body vvhereas they be many, yet are one body: ſo alſo Chriſt.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For in one Spirit vvere vve al baptized into `one', vvhether Ievves, or Gentiles, or bondmen, or free: and in one Spirit vve vvere al made to drinke.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For the body alſo is not one member, but many.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: If the foote ſhould ſay, becauſe I am not the hand, I am not of the body: is it therfore not of the body?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And if the eare ſhould ſay, becauſe I am not the eie, I am not of the body: is he therfore not of the body?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: If the vvhole body vvere the eie: vvhere is the hearing? If the vvhole vvere the hearing: vvhere is the ſmelling?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But novv God hath ſet the members, euery one of them in the body as he vvould.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And if al vvere one member, vvhere vvere the body?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But novv there are many members in deede, yet one body.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And the eie can not ſay to the hand: I neede not thy helpe. or againe the head to the feete, You are not neceſſarie for me.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But much more thoſe that ſeeme to be the more vveake members of the body, are more neceſſarie:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: and ſuch as vve thinke to be the baſer members of the body, vpon them vve put more aboundant honour: and thoſe that are our vnhoneſt partes, haue more aboundant honeſtie.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And our honeſt partes neede nothing: but God hath tempered the body, giuing to it that vvanted, the more aboundant honour,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: that there might be no ſchiſme in the body, but the members together might be careful one for an other.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And if one member ſuffer any thing, al the members ſuffer vvith it. or if one member do glorie, al the members reioyce vvith it.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And you are the body of Chriſt, and members of member.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And ſome verily God hath ſet in the Church firſt Apoſtles, ſecondly prophets, thirdly doctors, next miracles, thē the graces of doing cures, helpes, gouernements, kindes of tonges.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Are al Apoſtles? are al prophets? are al doctors?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: are al miracles? haue al the grace of doing cures? do al ſpeake vvith tonges? do al interpret?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But purſue the better giftes. And yet I ſhevv you a more excellent vvay.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: IF I ſpeake vvith the tonges of men and of Angels, and haue not charitie: I am become as ſounding braſſe, or a tinkling cymbal.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And if I ſhould haue prophecie, and knevv al myſteries, and al knovvledge, and if I ſhould haue al faith ſo that I could remoue mountaines, and haue not charitie, I am nothing.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And if I ſhould diſtribute al my goods to be meate for the poore, and if I ſhould deliuer my body ſo that I burne, and haue not charitie, it doth profit me nothing.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Charitie is patient, is benigne: Charitie enuieth not, dealeth not peruerſly: is not puffed vp,
label: 1 Corinthians

text: is not ambitious, ſeeketh not her ovvne, is not prouoked to anger, thinketh not euil:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: reioyceth not vpon iniquitie, but reioyceth vvith the truth:
label: 1 Corinthians

text: ſuffereth al things, beleeueth al things, hopeth al things, beareth al things.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Charitie neuer falleth avvay: vvhether prophecies ſhal be made voide, or tonges ſhal ceaſe, or knovvledge ſhal be deſtroied.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For in part vve knovv, and in part vve prophecie.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But vvhen that ſhal come that is perfect, that ſhal be made voide that is in part.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Vvhen I vvas a litle one, I ſpake as a litle one, I vnderſtood as a litle one, I thought as a litle one. But vvhen I vvas made a man, I did avvay the things that belonged to a litle one.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Vve ſee novv by a glaſſe in a darke ſort: but then face to face. Novv I knovv in part: but then I ſhal knovv as alſo I am knovven.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And novv there remaine, faith, hope, charitie, theſe three. but the greater of theſe is charitie.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: FOLOVV Charitie, earneſtly purſue ſpiritual things: but rather that you may prophecie.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For he that ſpeaketh vvith tongue, ſpeaketh not to men, but to God: for no man heareth. But in ſpirit he ſpeaketh myſteries.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For he that prophecieth, ſpeaketh to men vnto edification, and exhortation, and conſolation.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: He that ſpeaketh vvith tongues, edifieth him ſelf: but he that prophecieth, edifieth the Church.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And I would haue you al to ſpeake vvith tongues, but rather to prophecie. For greater is he that prophecieth, then he that ſpeaketh vvith tongues: vnleſſe perhaps he interpret, that the Church may take edification.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: But novv brethren if I come to you ſpeaking vvith tongues: vvhat ſhal I profit you, vnleſſe I ſpeake to you either in reuelation, or in knovvledge, or in prophecie, or in doctrine?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Yet the things vvithout life that giue a ſound, be it pipe or harpe, vnleſſe they giue a diſtinction of ſoundes, hovv ſhal that be knovven which is piped, or which is harped?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For if the trumpet giue an vncertaine voice, vvho ſhal prepare him ſelf to battel?
label: 1 Corinthians

text: So you alſo by a tongue vnleſſe you vtter manifeſt ſpeach, hovv ſhal that be knovven that is ſaid? for you ſhal be ſpeaking into the aire.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: There are (for example) ſo many kindes of tongues in this vvorld, & none is vvithout voice.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: If then I knovv not the vertue of the voice, I ſhal be to him to vvhom I ſpeake, barbarous: and he that ſpeaketh, barbarous to me.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: So you alſo, becauſe you be emulators of ſpirites: ſeeke to abound vnto the edifying of the Church.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: And therfore he that ſpeaketh vvith the tongue, let him pray that he may interpret.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: For if I pray vvith the tongue, my ſpirit praieth, but my vnderſtanding is vvithout fruite.
label: 1 Corinthians

text: Vvhat is it then? I vvil pray in the ſpirit, I vvil pray alſo in the vnderſtanding: I vvil ſing in the ſpirit, I vvil ſing alſo in the vnderſtanding.
