text: Hauing therfore ſuch hope, vve vſe much confidence:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: and not as Moyſes put a vele vpon his face, that the children of Iſraël might not behold his face, vvhich is made voide,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: but their ſenſes vvere dulled. For vntil this preſent day, the ſelf ſame vele in the lecture of the old teſtament remaineth vnreuealed (becauſe in Chriſt it is made voide)
label: 2 Corinthians

text: but vntil this preſent day, vvhen Moyſes is read, a vele is put vpon their hart.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But vvhen he ſhal be conuerted to our Lord, the vele ſhal be taken avvay.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And our Lord is a Spirit. And vvhere the Spirit of our Lord is, there is libertie.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But vve al, beholding the glorie of our Lord vvith face reuealed, are transformed into the ſame image from glorie vnto glorie, as of our Lordes Spirit.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: THERFORE hauing this miniſtration: according as vve haue obteined mercie, we faile not,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: but vve renounce the ſecrete things of diſhoneſtie, not walking in craftines, nor adulterating the vvord of God, but in manifeſtation of the truth commending our ſelues to euery conſcience of men before God.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And if our Goſpel be alſo hidde, in them that periſh it is hidde,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: in whom the God of this vvorld hath blinded the mindes of the infidels, that the illumination of the Goſpel of the glorie of Chriſt vvho is the image of God, might not ſhine to them.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For vve preache not our ſelues, but IESVS Chriſt our Lord: and vs, your ſeruants by IESVS,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: becauſe God that commaunded light to ſhine of darkenes, he hath ſhined in our hartes to the illumination of the knovvledge of the glorie of God, in the face of Chriſt IESVS.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But we haue this treaſure in earthen veſſels, that the excellencie may be of the povver of God, and not of vs.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: In al things vve ſuffer tribulation, but are not in diſtreſſe: vve vvant, but are not deſtitute:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: vve ſuffer perſecution, but are not forſaken: vve are caſt dovvne, but we periſh not:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: alvvaies bearing about in our body the mortification of IESVS, that the life alſo of IESVS may be manifeſted in our bodies.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For vve that liue, are alvvaies deliuered vnto death for IESVS: that the life alſo of IESVS may be manifeſted in our mortal fleſh.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Death then vvorketh in vs, but life in you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And hauing the ſame ſpirit of faith, as it is vvritten, I beleeued, for the vvhich cauſe I haue ſpoken, vve alſo beleeue, for the vvhich cauſe vve ſpeake alſo:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: knovving that he vvhich raiſed vp IESVS, vvil raiſe vp vs alſo vvith IESVS, and ſet vs vvith you. ⊢
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For al things are for you: that the grace abounding by many in giuing of thankes, may abound vnto the glorie of God.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For vvhich cauſe vve faile not: but although that our man vvhich is vvithout, bcorrupte: yet that vvhich is vvithin, is renevved from day to day.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For that our tribulation vvhich preſently is momentanie & light, vvorketh aboue meaſure excedingly an eternal vveight of glorie in vs,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: we not conſidering the things that are ſeen, but that are not ſeen. For the things that be ſeen, are temporal: but thoſe that be not ſeen, are eternal.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: FOR vve knovv that if our earthly houſe of this habitation be diſſolued, that vve haue a building of God, a houſe not made vvith hand, eternal in heauen.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For in this alſo do vve grone, deſirous to be ouerclothed with our habitation that is from heauen:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: yet ſo, if we be found clothed, not naked.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For vve alſo that are in this tabernacle, grone being burdened: becauſe vve would not be ſpoiled, but ouerclothed, that that vvhich is mortal, might be ſwallowed vp of life.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And he that maketh vs to this ſame, is God, vvho hath giuen vs the pledge of the Spirit.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Being bold therfore alvvaies, and knovving that vvhile vve are in the body, we are pilgrimes from God,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: (for vve vvalke by faith and not by ſight)
label: 2 Corinthians

text: but we are bold, and haue a good vvil to be pilgrimes rather from the body, & to be preſent vvith our Lord.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And therfore vve endeuour, vvhether abſent or preſent, to pleaſe him.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For vve muſt al be manifeſted before the iudgement ſeate of Chriſt, that euery one may receiue the proper things of the body, according as he hath done, either good or euil.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Knovving therfore the feare of our Lord vve vſe perſuaſion to men: but to God we are manifeſt. And I hope alſo that in your conſciences vve are manifeſt.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: We commend not our ſelues againe to you, but giue you occaſion to glorie for vs: that you may haue againſt them that glorie in face, and not in hart.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: for vvhether vve excede in minde, to God: or vvhether vve be ſober, to you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For the charitie of Chriſt vrgeth vs: iudging this, that if one died for al, then al vvere dead.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: and Chriſt died for al: that they alſo vvhich liue, may not now liue to them ſelues, but to him that died for them and roſe againe.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Therfore vve from hence forth knovv no man according to the fleſh. And if vve haue knovven Chriſt according to the fleſh: but now we know him no more.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: If then any be in Chriſt a nevv creature: the old are paſſed, behold al things are made nevv.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: but al of God, vvho hath reconciled vs to him ſelf by Chriſt: and hath giuen vs the miniſterie of reconciliation.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For God in deede vvas in Chriſt reconciling the vvorld to him ſelf, not imputing to them their ſinnes, and hath put in vs the vvord of reconciliation.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For Chriſt therfore vve are legates, God as it vvere exhorting by vs. For Chriſt vve beſeeche you, be reconciled to God.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Him that knevv no ſinne, for vs he made ſinne: that vve might be made the iuſtice of God in him.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: AND vve helping do exhorte, that you receiue not the grace of God in vaine.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: ( For he ſaith, In time accepted haue I heard thee: and in the day of ſaluation haue I holpen thee. Behold, novv is the time acceptable: behold novv the day of ſaluation.)
label: 2 Corinthians

text: to no man giuing any offence, that our miniſterie be not blamed:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: but in al things let vs exhibite our ſelues as the miniſters of God, in much patience, in tribulations, in neceſſities, in diſtreſſes,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: in ſtripes, in priſons, in ſeditions, in labours, in vvatchings, in faſtings,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: in chaſtitie, in knovvledge, in longanimitie, in ſweetenes, in the holy Ghoſt, in charitie not feined,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: in the vvord of truth, in the vertue of God, by the armour of iuſtice on the right hand, and on the left,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: by honour and diſhonour, by infamie and good fame: as ſeducers, and true: as they that are vnknovven and knovven:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: as dying, and behold we liue: as chaſtened, & not killed:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: as ſorovvful, but alvvaies reioycing: as needie, but enriching many: as hauing nothing, and poſſeſſing al things. ⊢
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Our mouth is open to you ô Corinthians, our hart is dilated.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: You are not ſtraitened in vs: but in your ovvne bovvels you are ſtraitened.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But hauing the ſame revvard (I ſpeake as to my children) be you alſo dilated.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Beare not the yoke vvith infidels. For vvhat participation hath iuſtice vvith iniquitie? or vvhat ſocietie is there betwene light and darkenes?
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And vvhat agreement vvith Chriſt and Belial? or vvhat part hath the faithful vvith the infidel?
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And vvhat agreement hath the temple of God vvith Idols? For you are the temple of the liuing God. as God ſaith, That I wil dvvel, and walke in them, and vvil be their God: and they ſhal be my people.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For the vvhich cauſe, Goe out of the middes of them, and ſeparate your ſelues, ſaith our Lord, and touch not the vncleane: and I wil receiue you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: and I vvil be a father to you: and you ſhal be my ſonnes and daughters, ſaith our Lord omnipotent.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: HAVING therfore theſe promiſſes, my deereſt, let vs cleanſe our ſelues from al inquination of the fleſh and ſpirit, perfiting ſanctification in the feare of God.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Receiue vs. VVe haue hurt no man, vve haue corrupted no man, vve haue circumuented no man.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: I ſpeake not to your condemnation. for I ſaid before that you are in our hartes to die together and to liue together.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Much is my confidence vvith you, much is my glorying for you: I am repleniſhed vvith conſolation: I do excedingly abound in ioy in al our tribulation.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For alſo vvhen we were come into Macedonia, our fleſh had no reſt, but vve ſuffered al tribulation: without, combats: vvithin, feares.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But God that comforteth the humble, did comforte vs, in the comming of Titus.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And not only in his comming, but alſo in the conſolation, vvhervvith he vvas comforted among you, reporting to vs your deſire, your vveeping, your emulation for me, ſo that I reioyced the more.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For although I made you ſorie in an epiſtle, it repenteth me not: albeit it repented me, ſeing that the ſame epiſtle (although but for a time) did make you ſorie.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Now I am glad: not becauſe you vvere made ſorie, but becauſe you vvere made ſorie to penance. For you vvere made ſorie according to God, that in nothing you ſhould ſuffer detriment by vs.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For the ſorovv that is according to God, vvorketh penance vnto ſaluation that is ſtable: but the ſorovv of the vvorld vvorketh death.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For behold this very thing, that you vvere made ſorie according to God, hovv great carefulnes it vvorketh in you: yea defenſe, yea indignation, yea feare, yea deſire, yea emulation, yea reuenge. in al things you haue ſhewed your ſelues to be vndefiled in the matter.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Therfore although I vvrote to you, not for him that did the iniurie, nor for him that ſuffered: but to manifeſt our carefulnes that vve haue for you before God,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: therfore vve are comforted. But in our conſolation, vve did the more aboundantly reioyce vpon the ioy of Titus, becauſe his ſpirit vvas refreſhed of al you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And if to him I gloried any thing of you, I am not confounded: but as vve ſpake al things to you in truth, ſo alſo our glorying that vvas to Titus, is made a truth,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: and his bovvels are more aboundantly toward you: remembring the obedience of you al, hovv vvith feare and trembling you receiued him.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: I reioyce that in al things I haue confidence in you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: AND vve doe you to vnderſtand, brethren, the grace of God, that is giuen in the churches of Macedonia,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: that in much experience of tribulation they had aboundance of ioy, & their very deepe pouertie abounded vnto the riches of their ſimplicitie,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: for according to their povver (I giue them teſtimonie) and aboue their povver they vvere willing,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: vvith much exhortation requeſting vs the grace and communication of the miniſterie that is done tovvard the ſaincts.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And not as vve hoped, but their ovvne ſelues they gaue, firſt to our Lord, then to vs by the vvil of God:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: in ſo much that vve deſired Titus, that as he began, ſo alſo he vvould perfit in you this grace alſo.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But as in al things you abound in faith, and vvord, and knovvledge, & al carefulnes, moreouer alſo in your charitie tovvard vs, that in this grace alſo you may abounde.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: I ſpeake not as commaunding: but by the carefulnes of others, approuing alſo the good diſpoſition of your charitie.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For you knovv the grace of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, that for you he vvas made poore, whereas he vvas riche: that by his pouertie you might be riche.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And in this point I giue counſel: for this is profitable for you, vvhich haue begonne not only to doe, but alſo to be willing, from the yere paſt:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: but novv perfourme ye it alſo in deede: that as your minde is prompt to be vvilling, ſo it may be alſo to perfourme, of that vvhich you haue.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For if the vvil be prompt: it is accepted according to that vvhich it hath, not according to that which it hath not.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For not that other ſhould haue eaſe, and you tribulation: but by an equalitie.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Let in this preſent time your aboundance ſupplie their want: that their aboundance alſo may ſupplie your vvant, that there be an equalitie,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: as it is vvritten: He that had much, abounded not: and he that had litle, vvanted not. ⊢
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And thankes be to God, that hath giuen the ſelf ſame carefulnes for you in the hart of Titus,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: for that he admitted in deede exhortation: but being more careful, of his ovvne vvil he vvent vnto you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: VVe haue ſent alſo vvith him the brother, vvhoſe praiſe is in the Goſpel through al the churches:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: & not only that, but alſo he vvas ordeined of the churches fellovv of our peregrination, for this grace vvhich is miniſtred of vs to the glorie of our Lord, and our determined vvil:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: auoiding this, leſt any man might reprehend vs in this fulnes that is miniſtred of vs.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For vve prouide good things not only before God, but alſo before men.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And vve haue ſent with them our brother alſo, vvhom vve haue proued in many things often to be careful: but now much more careful, for the great confidence in you,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: either for Titus vvhich is my fellovv and coadiutor tovvard you, or our brethren Apoſtles of the churches, the glorie of Chriſt.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: The declaration therfore vvhich is of your charitie and our glorying for you, declare ye tovvard them in the face of the churches. ⊢
label: 2 Corinthians

text: FOR concerning the miniſterie that is done tovvard the ſainctes, it is ſuperfluous for me to vvrite vnto you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For I know your prompt minde: for the which I glorie of you to the Macedonians: That Achaia alſo is ready from the yere paſt, and your emulation hath prouoked very many.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But I haue ſent the brethren, that the thing vvhich vve glorie of you, be not made voide in this behalfe, that (as I haue ſaid) you may be ready:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: leſt vvhen the Macedonians ſhal come vvith me, and finde you vnready, vve (that vve ſay not, ye) may be aſhamed in this ſubſtance.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Therfore I thought it neceſſarie to deſire the brethren that they vvould come to you, and prepare this bleſſing before promiſed, to be ready ſo, as a bleſſing, not as auarice.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And this I ſay, he that ſovveth ſparingly, ſparingly alſo ſhal reape: and he that ſovveth in bleſſings, of bleſſings alſo ſhal reape.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Euery one as he hath determined in his hart, not of ſadnes or of neceſſitie. for God loueth a cheereful giuer.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And God is able to make al grace abound in you: that in al things alvvaies hauing al ſufficiencie, you may abound vnto al good vvorkes,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: as it is vvritten: He diſtributed, he gaue to the poore: his iuſtice remaineth for euer.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And he that miniſtreth ſeede to the ſovver, vvil giue bread alſo for to eate: & vvil multiplie your ſeede, and vvil augment the increaſes of the fruites of your iuſtice: ⊢
label: 2 Corinthians

text: that being enriched in al things, you may abound vnto al ſimplicitie, vvhich worketh by vs thankes-giuing to God.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Becauſe the miniſterie of this office doth not only ſupplie thoſe things that the Saincts want, but aboundeth alſo by many thankes-giuings in our Lord,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: by the proofe of this miniſterie, glorifying God in the obedience of your confeſſion vnto the Goſpel of Chriſt, and in the ſimplicitie of communicating vnto them, and vnto al,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: and in their praying for you, being deſirous of you becauſe of the excellent grace of God in you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Thankes be to God for his vnſpeakeable gift.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: AND I Paul my ſelf beſeeche you by the mildenes and modeſtie of Chriſt, vvho in preſence in deede am humble among you, but abſent am bold on you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But I beſeeche you, that being preſent I neede not be bold by that confidence vvhervvith I am thought to be bold againſt ſome: vvhich thinke vs as though vve vvalke according to the fleſh.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For vvalking in the fleſh, vve vvarre not according to the fleſh.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For the vveapons of our vvarfare are not carnal: but mightie to God vnto the deſtruction of munitions, deſtroying counſels,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: and al loftineſſe extolling it ſelf againſt the knovvledge of God, and bringing into captiuitie al vnderſtanding vnto the obedience of Chriſt,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: and hauing in a readineſſe to reuenge al diſobedience, vvhen your obedience ſhal be fulfilled.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: See the things that are according to appearance. If any man haue affiance in him ſelf, that he is Chriſts: let him thinke this againe vvith him ſelf, that as he is Chriſts, ſo vve alſo.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For and if I ſhould glorie ſomevvhat more of our povver, vvhich our Lord hath giuen vs vnto edification and not to your deſtruction: I ſhal not be aſhamed.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But that I may not be thought as it vvere to terrifie you by epiſtles (
label: 2 Corinthians

text: for his epiſtles in deede, ſay they, are ſore and vehement: but his bodily preſence vveake, and his ſpeache contemptible)
label: 2 Corinthians

text: let him this thinke that is ſuch a one, that ſuch as vve are in vvord by epiſtles, abſent: ſuch alſo we are in deede, preſent.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For we dare not matche or compare our ſelues vvith certaine, that commend them ſelues: but vve meaſure our ſelues in our ſelues, and compare our ſelues to our ſelues.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But vve vvil not glorie aboue our meaſure: but according to the meaſure of the rule, vvhich God hath meaſured to vs, a meaſure to reache euen vnto you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For not, as though vve reached not vnto you, doe vve extend our ſelues beyond. For we are come as farre as to you in the Goſpel of Chriſt.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: not glorying aboue meaſure in other mens labours: but hauing hope of your faith increaſing, to be magnified in you according to our rule aboundantly,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: yea vnto thoſe places that are beyond you, to euangelize, not in an other mans rule, to glorie in thoſe things that are prepared before.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But he that glorieth, let him glorie in our Lord.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For not he that commendeth him ſelf, the ſame is approued: but vvhom God commendeth.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: VVould God you could beare ſome litle of my folly: but do ye alſo ſupport me:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: for I emulate you vvith the emulation of God. For I haue deſpouſed you to one man, to preſent you a chaſte virgin vnto Chriſt.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But I feare leſt, as the ſerpent ſeduced Eue by his ſubteltie, ſo your ſenſes may be corrupted, & fall from the ſimplicitie that is in Chriſt.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For if he that commeth, preache an other Chriſt whom we haue not preached, or you receiue an other ſpirit vvhom you haue not receiued: or an other Goſpel vvhich you haue not receiued: you might wel ſuffer it.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For I ſuppoſe that I haue done nothing leſſe then the great Apoſtles.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For although rude in ſpeache, yet not in knovvledge. but in al things we are made manifeſt to you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Or did I commit a ſinne, humbling my ſelf, that you might be exalted? becauſe I euangelized vnto you the Goſpel of God gratis?
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Other churches I ſpoiled, taking a ſtipend, for your miniſterie.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And when I vvas vvith you, and had neede, I vvas burdenous to none: for that which I vvanted, the brethren ſupplied that came from Macedonia: & in al things I haue kept my ſelf vvithout burden to you, and vvil keepe.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: The truth of Chriſt is in me, that this glorying ſhal not be infringed tovvard me in the countries of Achaia.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Wherfore? becauſe I loue you not? God doth knovv.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But that vvhich I doe, I vvil alſo doe, that I may cut avvay the occaſion of them that deſire occaſion: that, in that vvhich they glorie, they may be found euen like vs.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For ſuch falſe apoſtles are craftie vvorkers, trāsfiguring them ſelues into Apoſtles of Chriſt.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And no maruel: for Satan him ſelf transfigureth him ſelf into an Angel of light.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: It is no great matter therfore if his miniſters be transfigured as the miniſters of iuſtice: vvhoſe ende ſhal be according to their vvorkes.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Againe I ſay, (let no man thinke me to be fooliſh: otherwiſe take me as fooliſh, that I alſo may glorie a litle,)
label: 2 Corinthians

text: that vvhich I ſpeake, I ſpeake not according to God, but as it vvere in fooliſhnes, in this ſubſtance of glorying.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Becauſe many glorie according to the fleſh, I alſo wil glorie.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For you do gladly ſuffer the fooliſh: vvhereas your ſelues are wiſe.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For you ſuffer if a man bring you into ſeruitude, if a man deuoure, if a man take, if a man be extolled, if a man ſtrike you on the face.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: I ſpeake according to diſhonour, as though vve had been vveake in this part. VVherein any man dare (I ſpeake foliſhly) I dare alſo.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: They are Hebrevves: and I. They are Iſraëlites: and I. They are the ſeede of Abraham: and I.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: They are the miniſters of Chriſt: and I. (I ſpeake as one ſcarſe vviſe) more I: in many moe labours, in priſons more aboundantly, in ſtripes aboue meaſure, in deathes often.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Of the Ievves fiue times, did I receiue fourtie, ſauing one.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Thriſe vvas I beaten vvith roddes, once I vvas ſtoned, thriſe I ſuffred ſhipvvracke, night and day haue I been in the depth of the ſea,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: in iourneying often, perils of vvaters, perils of theeues, perils of my nation, perils of Gentiles, perils in the citie, perils in the wildernes, perils in the ſea, perils among falſe brethren,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: in labour and miſerie, in much vvatchings, in hunger and thirſt, in faſtings often, in colde and nakednes,
label: 2 Corinthians

text: beſide thoſe things which are outwardly: my daily binſtance, the carefulnes of al churches.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: VVho is vveake, and I am not vveake? vvho is ſcandalized, and I cam not burnt?
label: 2 Corinthians

text: If I muſt glorie: I vvil glorie of the things that concerne my infirmitie.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: The God and Father of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, vvho is bleſſed for euer, knovveth that I lie not.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: At Damaſcus the Gouernour of the nation vnder Aretas the king, kept the citie of the Damaſcenes, for to apprehend me:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: and through a vvindovv in a baſket vvas I let dovvne by the vvall, and ſo eſcaped his handes.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: IF I muſt glorie (it is not expedient in deede) but I vvil come to the viſions and reuelations of our Lord.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: I knovv a man in Chriſt aboue fourtene yeres agoe (vvhether in the body, I knovv not: or out of the body, I knovv not: God doth knovv) ſuch a one rapt euen to the third heauen.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And I know ſuch a man (vvhether in the body, or out of the body, I know not: God doth know)
label: 2 Corinthians

text: that he vvas rapt into Paradiſe: & heard ſecrete vvordes, which it is not lavvful for a man to ſpeake.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For ſuch an one I wil glorie: but for my ſelf I vvil glorie nothing, ſauing in my infirmities.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For and if I vvil glorie, I ſhal not be fooliſh: for I ſhal ſay truth. but I ſpare, leſt any man ſhould eſteeme me aboue that vvhich he ſeeth in me, or heareth any thing of me.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And leſt the greatnes of the reuelations might extoll me, there vvas giuen me a pricke of my fleſh, an angel of Satan, to buffet me.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For the vvhich thing thriſe I beſought our Lord, that it might depart from me:
label: 2 Corinthians

text: and he ſaid to me, My grace ſufficeth thee, for povver is perfited in infirmitie. Gladly therfore vvil I glorie in mine infirmitie, that the povver of Chriſt may dvvel in me. ⊢
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For the vvhich cauſe I pleaſe my ſelf in infirmities, in contumelies, in neceſſities, in perſecutions, in diſtreſſes for Chriſt. for vvhen I am vveake, then am I mightie.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: I am become fooliſh: you haue compelled me. For I ought to haue been commended of you: for I haue been nothing leſſe then they that are aboue meaſure Apoſtles: although I am nothing.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Yet the ſignes of my Apoſtleſhip haue been done vpon you in al patience, in ſignes & wonders and mighty deedes.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For vvhat is there that you haue had leſſe then the other churches: but that I my ſelf haue not burdened you? Pardon me this iniurie.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Behold, novv the third time I am ready to come to you: and I vvil not be burdenous vnto you. For I ſeeke not the things that are yours: but you. For neither ought the children lay vp treaſures for the parents, but the parents for the children.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But I moſt gladly vvil beſtovv, & vvil my ſelf moreouer be beſtovved for your ſoules: although louing you more, I am loued leſſe.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But be it ſo: I haue not burdened you: but being craftie, I tooke you by guile.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Haue I circumuented you by any of them vvhom I ſent to you?
label: 2 Corinthians

text: I requeſted Titus, and I ſent vvith him a brother. Did Titus circumuent you? walked vve not vvith one ſpirit? not in the ſelf ſame ſteppes?
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Of old thinke you that vve excuſe our ſelues to you? Before God, in Chriſt vve ſpeake: but al things (my deereſt) for your edifying.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For I feare leſt perhaps vvhen I come, I finde you not ſuch as I vvould: and I be found of you, ſuch an one as you vvould not. leſt perhaps contentions, emulations, ſtomakings, diſſenſions, detractions, vvhiſperings, ſwellings, ſeditions be among you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: leſt againe vvhen I come, God humble me among you: & I mourne many of them that ſinned before, & haue not done penance for the vncleannes & fornication and incontinencie that they haue committed.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: LO this the third time I come vnto you: In the mouth of tvvo or three vvitneſſes ſhal euery vvord ſtand.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: I foretold and doe foretel as preſent, and novv abſent, to them that ſinned before, and al the reſt, that if I come againe, I vvil not ſpare.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Seeke you an experiment of him that ſpeaketh in me, Chriſt: vvho in you is not vveake, but is mightie in you?
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For although he vvas crucified of infirmitie: yet he liueth by the povver of God. For vve alſo are vveake in him: but vve ſhal liue vvith him by the povver of God on you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Trie your ovvne ſelues if you be in the faith: proue ye your ſelues. Knovv you not your ſelues that Chriſt IESVS is in you, vnleſſe perhaps you be reprobates.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: But I hope you bknow that vve are not reprobates.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: And vve pray God that you doe no euil, not that vve may appeare approued, but that you may doe that vvhich is good, and vve be as reprobates.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For we can not any thing againſt the truth: but for the truth.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For vve reioyce, for that vve are vveake, & you are mightie. This alſo vve pray for, your conſummation.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Therfore theſe things I vvrite abſent: that being preſent I may not deale hardly according to the povver vvhich our Lord hath giuen me vnto edification and not vnto deſtruction.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: For the reſt brethren, reioyce, be perfect, take exhortation, be of one minde, haue peace, and the God of peace & of loue ſhal be vvith you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: Salute one an other in a holy kiſſe. Al the ſaincts ſalute you.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: The grace of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, and the charitie of God, and the communication of the holy Ghoſt be vvith you all. Amen.
label: 2 Corinthians

text: PAVL an Apoſtle not of men, neither by man, but by IESVS Chriſt, and God the Father that raiſed him from the dead,
label: Galatians

text: and al the brethren that are vvith me: to the churches of Galatia.
label: Galatians

text: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord IESVS Chriſt,
label: Galatians

text: vvho gaue him ſelf for our ſinnes, that he might deliuer vs from this preſent vvicked vvorld, according to the vvil of our God and father:
label: Galatians

text: to vvhom is glorie for euer and euer. Amen.
label: Galatians

text: I maruel that thus ſo ſoone you are transferred from him that called you into the grace of Chriſt, vnto an other Goſpel:
label: Galatians

text: which is not an other, vnles there be ſome that trouble you, and vvil inuert the Goſpel of Chriſt.
label: Galatians

text: But although we, or an Angel from heauen, euangelize to you beſide that vvhich vve haue euangelized to you, be he anáthema.
label: Galatians

text: As we haue ſaid before, ſo novv I ſay againe, If any euangelize to you, beſide that vvhich you haue receiued, be he anáthema.
label: Galatians

text: For do I novv vſe perſuaſion to men, or to God? Or do I ſeeke to pleaſe men? If I yet did pleaſe men, I ſhould not be the ſeruant of Chriſt.
label: Galatians

text: For I doe you to vnderſtand, brethren, the Goſpel that vvas euangelized of me, that it is not according to man.
label: Galatians

text: For neither did I receiue it of man, nor learne it: but by the reuelation of IESVS Chriſt.
label: Galatians

text: For you haue heard my conuerſation ſometime in Iudaiſme, that aboue meaſure I perſecuted the Church of God, and expugned it,
label: Galatians

text: and profited in Iudaiſme aboue many of mine equales in my nation, being more aboundantly an emulator of the traditions of my fathers.
label: Galatians

text: But vvhen it pleaſed him that ſeparated me from my mothers vvombe, and called me by his grace, to reueale his ſonne in me,
label: Galatians

text: that I ſhould euangelize him among the Gentils, incontinent I condeſcended not to fleſh and bloud,
label: Galatians

text: neither came I to Hieruſalem to the Apoſtles my anteceſſors: but I vvent into Arabia, and againe I returned to Damaſcus.
label: Galatians

text: Then, after three yeres I came to Hieruſalem to ſee Peter: and taried with him fiftene daies.
label: Galatians

text: But other of the Apoſtles ſavv I none: ſauing Iames the brother of our Lord.
label: Galatians

text: And the things that I vvrite to you: behold before God, that I lie not. ⊢
label: Galatians

text: After that, I came into the partes of Syria and Cilicia.
label: Galatians

text: And I vvas vnknowen by ſight to the churches of Ievvrie, that vvere in Chriſt:
label: Galatians

text: but they had heard only, That he vvhich perſecuted vs ſometime, doth novv euangelize the faith vvhich ſometime he expugned:
label: Galatians

text: and in me they glorified God.
label: Galatians

text: THEN after fourtene yeres I vvent vp againe to Hieruſalem vvith Barnabas, taking Titus alſo vvith me.
label: Galatians

text: And I vvent vp according to reuelation: and cóferred with them the Goſpel which I preach among the Gentiles, but apart with them that ſeemed to be ſomething, leſt perhaps in vaine I ſhould runne or had runne.
label: Galatians

text: But neither Titus which vvas with me, vvhereas he vvas a Gentil, vvas compelled to be circumciſed:
label: Galatians

text: but becauſe of the falſe brethren craftely brought in, vvhich craftely came in to eſpie our libertie that vve haue in Chriſt IESVS, that they might bring vs into ſeruitude.
label: Galatians

text: To vvhom vve yelded not ſubiection no not for an houre, that the truth of the Goſpel may remaine vvith you.
label: Galatians

text: But of them that ſeemed to be ſomething, (vvhat they vvere ſometime, it is nothing to me. God accepteth not the perſon of man) for to me, they that ſeemed to be ſomething, added nothing.
label: Galatians

text: But contrarievviſe vvhen they had ſeen, that to me vvas committed the Goſpel of the prepuce, as to Peter of the circumciſion (
label: Galatians

text: for he that vvrought in Peter to the Apoſtleſhip of the circumciſion, vvrought in me alſo among the Gentils)
label: Galatians

text: and vvhen they had knovven the grace that vvas giuen me, Iames and Cephas and Iohn, vvhich ſeemed to be pillers, gaue to me and Barnabas the right handes of ſocietie: that vve vnto the Gentiles, & they vnto the circumciſion:
label: Galatians

text: only that vve ſhould be mindeful of the poore: the vvhich ſame thing alſo I vvas careful to doe.
label: Galatians

text: And vvhen Cephas vvas come to Antioche, I reſiſted him in face, becauſe he vvas reprehenſible.
label: Galatians

text: For before that certaine came from Iames, he did eate with the Gentiles: but vvhen they vvere come, he vvithdrevv and ſeparated him ſelf, fearing them that vvere of the circumciſion.
label: Galatians

text: And to his ſimulation conſented the reſt of the Ievves, ſo that Barnabas alſo vvas ledde of them into that ſimulation.
label: Galatians

text: But vvhen I ſavv that they vvalked not rightly to the veritie of the Goſpel, I ſaid to Cephas before them al: If thou being a Ievve, liueſt Gentile-like & not Iudaically: hovv doeſt thou compel the Gentils to Iudaize.
label: Galatians

text: We are by nature Ievves, and not of the Gentils, ſinners.
label: Galatians

text: But knovving that man is not iuſtified by the vvorkes of the Lavv, but by the faith of IESVS Chriſt: we alſo beleeue in Chriſt IESVS, that we may be iuſtified by the faith of Chriſt, and not by the vvorkes of the Lavv: for the vvhich cauſe, by the workes of the Law no fleſh ſhal be iuſtified.
label: Galatians

text: But if ſeeking to be iuſtified in Chriſt, our ſelues alſo be found ſinners: is Chriſt then a miniſter of ſinne? God forbid.
label: Galatians

text: For if I build the ſame things againe vvhich I haue deſtroied, I make my ſelf a preuaricatour.
label: Galatians

text: For I by the Lavv, am dead to the Law, that I may liue to God: vvith Chriſt I am nailed to the croſſe.
label: Galatians

text: And I liue, novv not I: but Chriſt liueth in me. And that that I liue novv in the fleſh, I liue in the faith of the ſonne of God, who loued me, & deliuered him ſelf for me.
label: Galatians

text: I caſt not avvay the grace of God. For if iuſtice be by the Lavv, then Chriſt died in vaine.
label: Galatians

text: O Senſles Galatians, vvho hath bevvitched you, not to obey the truth, before vvhoſe eies IESVS Chriſt vvas proſcribed, being crucified among you?
label: Galatians

text: This only I vvould learne of you, By the vvorkes of the Lavv, did you receiue the Spirit, or by the hearing of the faith?
label: Galatians

text: Are you ſo fooliſh, that vvhereas you began vvith the ſpirit, now you vvil be conſummate vvith the fleſh?
label: Galatians

text: Haue you ſuffered ſo great things vvithout cauſe? if yet vvithout cauſe.
label: Galatians

text: He therfore that giueth you the Spirit, and vvorketh miracles among you: by the vvorkes of the Lavv, or by the hearing of the faith doeth he it?
label: Galatians

text: As, Abraham beleeued God, and it vvas reputed to him vnto iuſtice.
label: Galatians

text: Know ye therfore that they that are of faith, the ſame are the children of Abraham.
label: Galatians

text: And the Scripture foreſeing that God iuſtifieth the Gentils by faith, ſhewed vnto Abraham before, That in thee ſhal al nations be bleſſed.
label: Galatians

text: Therfore they that are of faith, ſhal be bleſſed vvith the faithful Abraham.
label: Galatians

text: For vvhoſoeuer are of the vvorkes of the Lavv, are vnder curſe. For it is vvritten: Curſed be euery one that abideth not in al things that be written in the booke of the Lavv, to doe them.
label: Galatians

text: But that in the Law no man is iuſtified vvith God, it is manifeſt, becauſe The iuſt liueth by faith.
label: Galatians

text: But the Lavv is not by faith: but, He that doeth thoſe things, ſhal liue in them.
label: Galatians

text: Chriſt hath redeemed vs from the curſe of the Lavv, being made a curſe for vs (becauſe it is vvritten, Curſed is euery one that hangeth on a tree)
label: Galatians

text: that on the Gentiles the bleſſing of Abraham might be made in Chriſt IESVS: that vve may receiue the promiſſe of the Spirit by faith.
label: Galatians

text: Brethren (I ſpeake according to man) yet a mans teſtament being confirmed no man deſpiſeth, or further diſpoſeth.
label: Galatians

text: To Abraham vvere the promiſes ſaid, and to his ſeede. He ſaith not, And to ſeedes, as in many: but as in one, And to thy ſeede, vvhich is Chriſt.
label: Galatians

text: And this I ſay, the teſtament being confirmed of God, the Lavv vvhich vvas made after foure hundred and thirtie yeres, maketh not void to fruſtrate the promiſe.
label: Galatians

text: For if the inheritance be of the Lavv, novv not of promiſe. But God gaue it to Abraham by promiſe.
label: Galatians

text: VVhy vvas the Lavv then? It vvas put for tranſgreſſions, vntil the ſeede came to vvhom he had promiſed: ordeined by Angels in the hand of a mediatour.
label: Galatians

text: And a mediatour is not of one: but God is one.
label: Galatians

text: VVas the Lavv then againſt the promiſes of God? God forbid. For if there had been a Lavv giuen that could iuſtifie, vndoubtedly iuſtice ſhould be of the Lavv.
label: Galatians

text: But the Scripture hath concluded al things vnder ſinne: that the promiſe by the faith of IESVS Chriſt might be giuen to them that beleeue. ⊢
label: Galatians

text: But before the faith came, vnder the Lavv we vvere kept ſhut vp, vnto that faith which vvas to be reuealed.
label: Galatians

text: Therfore the Lavv vvas our Pedagogue in Chriſt: that vve may be iuſtified by faith.
label: Galatians

text: But when the faith came, novv vve are not vnder a pædagogue.
label: Galatians

text: For you are al the children of God by faith in Chriſt IESVS.
label: Galatians

text: For as many of you as are baptized in Chriſt, haue put on Chriſt.
label: Galatians

text: There is not Ievve nor Greeke, there is not bond nor free, there is not male nor femal. For al you are one in Chriſt IESVS.
label: Galatians

text: And if you be Chriſts, then are you the ſeede of Abraham, heires according to promiſe.
label: Galatians

text: AND I ſay, as long as the heire is a litle one, he differeth nothing from a ſeruant, although he be lord of al,
label: Galatians

text: but is vnder tutors and gouernours vntil the time limited of the father:
label: Galatians

text: ſo vve alſo, vvhen vve vvere litle ones, vvere ſeruing vnder the elemétes of the vvorld.
label: Galatians

text: But vvhen the fulnes of time came, God ſent his ſonne made of a vvoman, made vnder the Lavv:
label: Galatians

text: that he might redeeme them that vvere vnder the Lavv, that vve might receiue the adoption of ſonnes.
label: Galatians

text: And becauſe you are ſonnes, God hath ſent the Spirit of his ſonne into your hartes crying: Abba, Father.
label: Galatians

text: Therfore now he is not a ſeruant, but a ſonne. And if a ſonne, an heire alſo by God. ⊢
label: Galatians

text: But then in deede not knowing God, you ſerued them that by nature are not Gods.
label: Galatians

text: But novv vvhen you haue knovven God, or rather are knovven of God: hovv turne you againe to the vveake & poore elements, vvhich you vvil ſerue againe?
label: Galatians

text: You obſerue daies, and moneths, and times, and yeres.
label: Galatians

text: I feare you, leſt perhaps I haue laboured in vaine among you.
label: Galatians

text: Be ye as I, becauſe I alſo am as you: brethren, I beſeeche you, you haue hurt me nothing.
label: Galatians

text: And you knovv that by infirmitie of the fleſh I euangelized to you heretofore:
label: Galatians

text: and your tentation in my fleſh you deſpiſed not, neither reiected, but as an Angel of God you receiued me, as Chriſt IESVS.
label: Galatians

text: VVhere is then your bleſſednes? for I giue you teſtimonie that if it could be done, you vvould haue plucked out your eies and haue giuen them to me.
label: Galatians

text: Am I then become your enemie, telling you the truth?
label: Galatians

text: They emulate you not vvel: but they vvould exclude you, that you might emulate them.
label: Galatians

text: But do you emulate the good in good alvvaies: and not only vvhen I am preſent vvith you.
label: Galatians

text: My litle children, vvhom I trauail vvithal againe, vntil Chriſt be formed in you.
label: Galatians

text: And I vvould be vvith you now and chaunge my voice: becauſe I am confounded in you.
label: Galatians

text: Tel me you that vvil be vnder the Lavv, haue you not read the Law?
label: Galatians

text: For it is vvritten that Abraham had tvvo ſonnes: one of the bond-vvoman, and one of the free-vvoman.
label: Galatians

text: But he that of the bond-vvoman, vvas borne according to the fleſh: and he that of the free-vvoman, by the promiſſe.
label: Galatians

text: vvhich things are ſaid by an allegorie. For theſe are the two teſtaments. The one from mount Sina, gendring vnto bondage: vvhich is Agar,
label: Galatians

text: (for Sina is a mountaine in Arabia, vvhich hath affinitie to that vvhich novv is Hieruſalem) and ſerueth vvith her children.
label: Galatians

text: But that Hieruſalem vvhich is aboue, is free: vvhich is our mother.
label: Galatians

text: For it is vvritten: Reioyce thou barren, that beareſt not: breake forth and crie, that trauaileſt not: becauſe many are the children of the deſolate, more then of her that hath a huſband.
label: Galatians

text: But we brethren, according to Iſaac, are the children of promis.
label: Galatians

text: But as then he that vvas borne according to the fleſh, perſecuted him that vvas after the ſpirit: ſo now alſo.
label: Galatians

text: But vvhat ſaith the Scripture? Caſt out the bond-woman and her ſonne. for the ſonne of the bond-vvoman ſhal not be heire vvith the ſonne of the free-woman.
label: Galatians

text: Therfore brethren we are not the children of the bond-vvoman, but of the free: by the freedom vvherevvith Chriſt hath made vs free. ⊢
label: Galatians

text: STAND, and be not holden in againe vvith the yoke of ſeruitude.
label: Galatians

text: Behold I Paul tel you that if you be circumciſed, Chriſt ſhal profite you nothing.
label: Galatians

text: And I teſtifie againe to euery man circumciding him ſelf, that he is a detter to doe the vvhole Lavv.
label: Galatians

text: You are euacuated from Chriſt, that are iuſtified in the Lavv: you are fallen from grace.
label: Galatians

text: For vve in ſpirit, by faith, expect the hope of iuſtice.
label: Galatians

text: For in Chriſt IESVS neither circumciſion auaileth ought, nor prepuce: but faith that vvorketh by charitie.
label: Galatians

text: You ranne vvel, vvho hath hindered you not to obey the truth?
label: Galatians

text: The perſuaſion is not of him that calleth you.
label: Galatians

text: A litle leauen corrupteth the vvhole paſte.
label: Galatians

text: I haue confidence in you in our Lord: that you vvil be of no other minde: but he that troubleth you, ſhal beare the iudgement, vvhoſoeuer he be.
label: Galatians

text: And as for me, brethren, if as yet I preach circumciſion, vvhy doe I yet ſuffer perſecution? then is the ſcandal of the croſſe euacuated.
label: Galatians

text: I would they vvere alſo cut of that trouble you.
label: Galatians

text: For you, brethren, are called into libertie: only make not this libertie an occaſion to the fleſh, but by charitie ſerue one an other.
label: Galatians

text: For al the Lavv is fulfilled in one vvord: Thou ſhalt loue thy neighbour as thy ſelf.
label: Galatians

text: But if you bite and eate one an other: take heede you be not conſumed one of an other.
label: Galatians

text: And I ſay, vvalke in the ſpirit, and the luſtes of the fleſh you ſhal not accompliſh.
label: Galatians

text: For the fleſh luſteth againſt the ſpirit: and the ſpirit againſt the fleſh. for theſe are aduerſaries one to an other: that not vvhat things ſoeuer you vvil, theſe you doe.
label: Galatians

text: But if you be ledde by the ſpirit, you are not vnder the Lavv.
label: Galatians

text: And the workes of the fleſh be manifeſt, vvhich are, fornication, vncleannes, impudicitie, lecherie,
label: Galatians

text: ſeruing of Idols, vvitch-craftes, enmities, contentions, emulations, angers, bravvles, diſſenſions, ſectes,
label: Galatians

text: enuies, murders, ebrieties, commeſſations, and ſuch like. vvhich I foretel you, as I haue foretold you, that they vvhich doe ſuch things, ſhal not obteine the kingdom of God.
label: Galatians

text: But the fruite of the Spirit is, Charitie, ioy, peace, patience, benignitie, goodnes, longanimitie,
label: Galatians

text: mildnes, faith, modeſtie, cótinencie, chaſtitie. Againſt ſuch there is no lavv.
label: Galatians

text: And they that be Chriſts, haue crucified their fleſh vvith the vices and concupiſcences. ⊢
label: Galatians

text: If vve liue in the ſpirit, in the ſpirit alſo let vs vvalke.
label: Galatians

text: Let vs not be made deſirous of vaine glorie, prouoking one an other, enuying one an other.
label: Galatians

text: BRETHREN, and if a man be preoccupated in any fault, you that are ſpiritual, inſtruct ſuch an one in the ſpirit of lenitie, conſidering thine owne ſelf, leſt thou alſo be tempted.
label: Galatians

text: Beare ye one an others burdens: & ſo you ſhal fulfil the lavv of Chriſt.
label: Galatians

text: For if any man eſteeme him ſelf to be ſomething, vvhereas he is nothing, he ſeduceth him ſelf.
label: Galatians

text: But let euery one proue his ovvne vvorke, & ſo in him ſelf only ſhal he haue the glorie, and not in an other.
label: Galatians

text: For euery one ſhal beare his ovvne burden.
label: Galatians

text: And let him that is catechized in the vvord, communicate to him that catechizeth him, in al his goods.
label: Galatians

text: Be not deceiued, God is not mocked. For what things a man ſhal ſow, thoſe alſo ſhal he reape.
label: Galatians

text: For he that ſovveth in his fleſh, of the fleſh alſo ſhal reape corruption. but he that ſoweth in the ſpirit, of the ſpirit ſhal reape life euerlaſting.
label: Galatians

text: And doing good, let vs not faile. For in due time vve ſhal reape not failing.
label: Galatians

text: Therfore vvhiles vve haue time, let vs vvorke good to al, but eſpecially to the domeſticals of the faith. ⊢
label: Galatians

text: See vvith vvhat maner of letters I haue written to you vvith mine ovvne hand.
label: Galatians

text: VVhoſoeuer vvil pleaſe in the fleſh, they force you to be circumciſed, only that they may not ſuffer the perſecution of the croſſe of Chriſt.
label: Galatians

text: For neither they that are circumciſed, do keepe the Law: but they vvil haue you to be circumciſed, that they may glorie in your fleſh.
label: Galatians

text: But God forbid that I ſhould glorie, ſauing in the croſſe of our Lord IESVS Chriſt: by vvhom the vvorld is crucified to me, and I to the vvorld.
label: Galatians

text: For in Chriſt IESVS neither circumciſion auaileth ought, nor prepuce, but a nevv creature.
label: Galatians

text: And vvhoſoeuer ſhal folovv this rule, peace vpon them, and mercie, and vpon the Iſraël of God.
label: Galatians

text: From hencefurth let no man be troubleſome to me. for I beare the markes of our Lord IESVS in my body.
label: Galatians

text: The grace of our Lord IESVS Chriſt be vvith your ſpirit brethren. Amen. ⊢
label: Galatians

text: PAVL an Apoſtle of IESVS Chriſt by the vvil of God: to al the ſaincts that are at Epheſus: and to the faithful in Chriſt IESVS.
label: Ephesians

text: Grace to you and peace from God our father, and our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: Ephesians

text: Bleſſed be God and the Father of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, vvhich hath bleſſed vs in al ſpiritual bleſſing, in coeleſtials, in Chriſt:
label: Ephesians

text: as he choſe vs in him before the conſtitution of the vvorld, that vve ſhould be holy and immaculate in his ſight in charitie.
label: Ephesians

text: VVho hath predeſtinated vs vnto the adoption of ſonnes, by IESVS Chriſt, vnto him ſelf: according to the purpoſe of his vvil:
label: Ephesians

text: vnto the praiſe of the glorie of his grace, vvherein he hath cgratified vs in his beloued ſonne.
label: Ephesians

text: In vvhom vve haue redemption by his bloud (the remiſſion of ſinnes) according to the riches of his grace.
label: Ephesians

text: Vvhich hath ſuperabounded in vs in al vviſedom and prudence,
label: Ephesians

text: that he might make knovven vnto vs the ſacrament of his vvil, according to his good pleaſure, vvhich he purpoſed in him ſelf,
label: Ephesians

text: in the diſpenſation of the fulnes of times, to cperfit al things in Chriſt, that are in heauen and in earth, in him.
label: Ephesians

text: In vvhom vve alſo are called by lot: predeſtinate according to the purpoſe of him that vvorketh al things, according to the counſel of his vvil:
label: Ephesians

text: that vve may be vnto the praiſe of his glorie, vvhich before haue hoped in Chriſt:
label: Ephesians

text: in vvhom you alſo, vvhen you had heard the vvord of truth (the Goſpel of your ſaluation:) in vvhich alſo beleeuing you vvere ſigned vvith the holy Spirit of promis,
label: Ephesians

text: vvhich is the pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of acquiſition, vnto the praiſe of his glorie.
label: Ephesians

text: Therfore I alſo hearing your faith that is in our Lord IESVS, and loue tovvard al the ſainctes:
label: Ephesians

text: ceaſe not to giue thankes for you, making a memorie of you in my praiers,
label: Ephesians

text: that God of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, the father of glorie, giue you the ſpirit of vviſedom and of reuelation, in the knovvledge of him,
label: Ephesians

text: the eies of your hart illuminated, that you may knovv vvhat the hope is of his vocation, and vvhat are the riches of the glorie of his inheritance in the ſainctes,
label: Ephesians

text: and vvhat is the paſſing greatnes of his povver tovvard vs that beleeue: according to the operation of the might of his povver,
label: Ephesians

text: vvhich he vvrought in Chriſt, raiſing him vp from the dead, and ſetting him on his right hand in celeſtials,
label: Ephesians

text: aboue al Principalitie & Poteſtate & Power, and Domination, and euery name that is named not only in this vvorld, but alſo in that to come.
label: Ephesians

text: And he hath ſubdued al things vnder his feete: and hath made him head ouer al the CHVRCH,
label: Ephesians

text: vvhich is his body, the fulnes of him vvhich is filled al in al.
label: Ephesians

text: AND you vvhen you vvere dead by your offenſes & ſinnes,
label: Ephesians

text: vvherein ſometime you vvalked according to the courſe of this vvorld, according to the prince of the povver of this aire, of the ſpirit that novv vvorketh on the children of diffidence,
label: Ephesians

text: in vvhom alſo vve al conuerſed ſometime in the deſires of our fleſh, doing the vvil of the fleſh and of thoughtes, and vvere by nature the children of vvrath as alſo the reſt:
label: Ephesians

text: but God (vvhich is riche in mercie) for his exceding charitie vvhervvith he loued vs,
label: Ephesians

text: euen vvhen vve vvere dead by ſinnes, quickened vs together in Chriſt, (by vvhoſe grace you are ſaued,)
label: Ephesians

text: and raiſed vs vp vvith him, and hath made vs ſit vvith him in the celeſtials in Chriſt IESVS,
label: Ephesians

text: that he might ſhevv in the vvorldes ſucceding, the aboundant riches of his grace, in bountie vpon vs in Chriſt IESVS.
label: Ephesians

text: For by grace you are ſaued through faith (and that not of your ſelues, for it is the gift of God)
label: Ephesians

text: not of vvorkes, that no man glorie
label: Ephesians

text: For vve are his vvorke, created in Chriſt IESVS in good vvorkes, vvhich God hath prepared that vve ſhould vvalke in them.
label: Ephesians

text: For the vvhich cauſe be mindeful that ſometime you vvere Gentils in the fleſh, vvho vvere called prepuce, of that vvhich is called circumciſion in the fleſh, made vvith hand:
label: Ephesians

text: vvho vvere at that time vvithout Chriſt, alienated from the conuerſation of Iſrael, and ſtrangers of the teſtaments, hauing no hope of the promis, and vvithout God in this vvorld.
label: Ephesians

text: But novv in Chriſt IESVS, you that ſometime vvere farre of, are made nigh in the bloud of Chriſt.
label: Ephesians

text: For he is our peace, vvho hath made both one, and diſſoluing the middle vvall of the partition, the enmities in his fleſh:
label: Ephesians

text: euacuating the lavv of commaundements in decrees: that he may create the tvvo in him ſelf into one new man, making peace,
label: Ephesians

text: and may reconcile both in one body to God by the croſſe, killing the enmities in him ſelf.
label: Ephesians

text: And comming he euangelized peace to you that vvere farre of, and peace to them that vvere nigh.
label: Ephesians

text: For by him vve haue acceſſe both in one Spirit to the Father.
label: Ephesians

text: Novv then you are not ſtrangers and forreiners: but you are citizens of the ſainctes, and the domeſticals of God,
label: Ephesians

text: built vpon the foundation of the Apoſtles and Prophets, IESVS Chriſt him ſelf being the higheſt corner ſtone:
label: Ephesians

text: in vvhom al building framed together, grovveth into an holy temple in our Lord,
label: Ephesians

text: in vvhom you alſo are built together into an habitation of God in the holy Ghoſt. ⊢
label: Ephesians

text: FOR this cauſe, I Paul the priſoner of IESVS Chriſt, for you Gentiles:
label: Ephesians

text: if yet you haue heard the diſpenſation of the grace of God, vvhich is giuen me tovvard you,
label: Ephesians

text: becauſe according to reuelation the ſacrament vvas made knovven to me, as I haue vvritten before in breife:
label: Ephesians

text: according as you reading may vnderſtand my vviſedom in the myſterie of Chriſt,
label: Ephesians

text: vvhich vnto other generations vvas not knovven to the ſonnes of men, as novv it is reuealed to his holy Apoſtles & Prophets in the Spirit.
label: Ephesians

text: The Gentils to be coheires & concorporat and comparticipant of his promis in Chriſt IESVS by the Goſpel:
label: Ephesians

text: vvhereof I am made a miniſter according to the gift of the grace of God, vvhich is giuen me according to the operation of his povver.
label: Ephesians

text: To me the leaſt of al the ſainctes is giuen this grace, among the Gentils to euangelize the vnſearcheable riches of Chriſt,
label: Ephesians

text: and to illuminate al men vvhat is the diſpenſation of the ſacrament hidden from vvorldes in God, vvho created al things:
label: Ephesians

text: that the manifold vviſedom of God, may be notified to the Princes and Poteſtats in the celeſtials by the Church,
label: Ephesians

text: according to the cprefinitiō of worldes, vvhich he made in Chriſt IESVS our Lord.
label: Ephesians

text: In vvhom vve haue affiance and acceſſe in confidence, by the faith of him.
label: Ephesians

text: For the vvhich cauſe I deſire that you faint not in my tribulations for you, vvhich is your glorie.
label: Ephesians

text: For this cauſe I bovve my knees to the Father of our Lord IESVS Chriſt,
label: Ephesians

text: of vvhom al paternitie in the heauens and in earth is named,
label: Ephesians

text: that he giue you according to the riches of his glorie, povver to be fortified by his Spirit in the inner man.
label: Ephesians

text: Chriſt to dvvel by faith in your hartes, rooted and founded in charitie,
label: Ephesians

text: that you may be able to comprehend vvith al the ſainctes, vvhat is the bredth, and length, and height, and depth,
label: Ephesians

text: to knovv alſo the charitie of Chriſt, ſurpaſſing knovvledge, that you may be filled vnto al the fulnes of God.
label: Ephesians

text: And to him that is able to doe al things more aboundantly then vve deſire or vnderſtand, according to the povver that vvorketh in vs:
label: Ephesians

text: to him be glorie in the Church, and in Chriſt IESVS, vnto al generations vvorld vvithout end. Amen.
label: Ephesians

text: I Therfore priſoner in our Lord, beſeeche you, that you vvalke vvorthy of the vocation in vvhich you are called,
label: Ephesians

text: vvith al humilitie & mildenes, vvith patience, ſupporting one an other in charitie,
label: Ephesians

text: careful to keepe the vnitie of the ſpirit in the bond of peace.
label: Ephesians

text: One body and one ſpirit: as you are called in one hope of your vocation.
label: Ephesians

text: One Lord, one faith, one baptiſme.
label: Ephesians

text: One God and Father of al, vvhich is ouer al, and by al, and in al vs. ⊢
label: Ephesians

text: But to euery one of vs is giuen grace according to the meaſure of the donation of Chriſt.
label: Ephesians

text: For the vvhich he ſaith, Aſcending on high, he ledde captiuitie captiue: he gaue giftes to men.
label: Ephesians

text: (And that he aſcended, vvhat is it, but becauſe he deſcended alſo firſt into the cinferiour partes of the earth?
label: Ephesians

text: He that deſcended, the ſame is alſo he that is aſcended aboue al the heauens, that he might fill al things.)
label: Ephesians

text: And he gaue, ſome Apoſtles, and ſome Prophets, and otherſome Euangeliſts, and otherſome paſtors and doctors,
label: Ephesians

text: to the conſummation of the ſainctes, vnto the vvorke of the miniſterie, vnto the edifying of the body of Chriſt:
label: Ephesians

text: vntil we meete al into the vnitie of faith, and knovvledge of the ſonne of God, into a perfect man, into the meaſure of the age of the fulnes of Chriſt: ⊢
label: Ephesians

text: that novv vve be not children vvauering, and caried about vvith euery vvinde of doctrine in the vvickednes of men, in craftines to the circumuention of errour.
label: Ephesians

text: But doing the truth in charitie, let vs in al things grow in him, vvhich is the head, Chriſt:

text: of vvhom the vvhole body being compacte and knit together by al iuncture of ſubminiſtration, according to the operation in the meaſure of euery member, maketh the increaſe of the body vnto the edifying of it ſelf in charitie.
label: Ephesians

text: This therfore I ſay and teſtifie in our Lord: that novv you vvalke not as alſo the Gentiles vvalke in the vanitie of their ſenſe,
label: Ephesians

text: hauing their vnderſtanding obſcured vvith darkenes, alienated from the life of God by the ignorance that is in them, becauſe of the blindenes of their hart,

text: vvho deſpairing, haue giuen vp them ſelues to impudicitie, vnto the operation of al vncleannes, vnto auarice.

text: But you haue not ſo learned Chriſt:
label: Ephesians

text: if yet you haue heard him, and haue been taught in him, (as the truth is in IESVS.) ⊢
label: Ephesians

text: Lay you avvay, according to the old conuerſation the old man, vvhich is corrupted according to the deſires of errour.

text: And be renevved in the ſpirit of your minde:

text: and put on the nevv man vvhich according to God is created in iuſtice, and holineſſe of the truth.
label: Ephesians

text: For the vvhich cauſe laying avvay lying, ſpeake ye truth euery one vvith his neighbour, becauſe vve are members one of an other.
label: Ephesians

text: Be angrie and ſinne not. let not the ſonne goe dovvne vpon your anger.
label: Ephesians

text: Giue not place to the Deuil.
label: Ephesians

text: He that ſtole, let him novv not ſteale: but rather let him labour in vvorking vvith his handes that vvhich is good, that he may haue vvhence to giue vnto him that ſuffereth neceſſitie.

text: Al naughtie ſpeache let it not proceede out of your mouth: but if there be any good to the edifying of the faith, that it may giue grace to the hearers.

text: And contriſtate not the holy Spirit of God: in vvhich you are ſigned vnto the day of redemption.

text: Let al bitternes, and anger, and indignation, and clamour, and blaſphemie be taken avvay from you vvith al malice.

text: And be gentle one to an other, merciful, pardoning one an other, as alſo God in Chriſt hath pardoned you.

text: BE ye therfore folovvers of God, as moſt deere children:

text: and walke in loue, as Chriſt alſo loued vs, and deliuered him ſelf for vs an oblation and hoſt to God in an odour of ſvvetenes.

text: But fornication and al vncleannes, or auarice, let it not ſo much as be named among you, as it becommeth ſainctes:

text: For vnderſtanding knovv you this, that no fornicatour, or vncleane, or couetous perſon (vvhich is the ſeruice of Idols) hath inheritance in the kingdom of Chriſt and of God.

text: Let no man ſeduce you vvith vaine vvordes. For, for theſe things commeth the anger of God vpon the children of diffidence.

text: Let vvomen be ſubiect to their huſbandes, as to our Lord:
label: Ephesians

text: becauſe the man is the head of the woman: as Chriſt is the head of the CHVRCH. Him ſelf, the ſauiour of his body.
label: Ephesians

text: But as the CHVRCH is ſubiect to Chriſt, ſo alſo the vvomen to their huſbands in al things.
label: Ephesians

text: Huſbands, loue your vviues, as Chriſt alſo loued the CHVRCH, and deliuered him ſelf for it:
label: Ephesians

text: that he might ſanctifie it, cleanſing it by the lauer of vvater in the vvord,
label: Ephesians

text: that he might preſent to him ſelf a glorious CHVRCH, not hauing ſpot, or wrinkle, or any ſuch thing, but that it may be holy and vnſpotted.
label: Ephesians

text: So alſo men ought to loue their vviues as their ovvne bodies. He that loueth his vvife, loueth him ſelf.
label: Ephesians

text: For no man euer hated his ovvne fleſh: but he nouriſheth & cheriſheth it, as alſo Chriſt the CHVRCH:
label: Ephesians

text: becauſe vve be the members of his body, of his fleſh & of his bones.
label: Ephesians

text: For this cauſe ſhal man leaue his father & mother: and ſhal cleaue to his vvife, and they ſhal be tvvo in one fleſh.
label: Ephesians

text: This is a great ſacrament. but I ſpeake in Chriſt and in the CHVRCH
label: Ephesians

text: Neuertheles you alſo euery one, let eche loue his vvife as him ſelf: and let the vvife feare her huſband. ⊢
label: Ephesians

text: CHILDREN, obey your parents in our Lord. for this is iuſt.
label: Ephesians

text: Honour thy father and thy mother (vvhich is the firſt commaundement in the promis,)
label: Ephesians

text: that it may be vvel vvith thee, and thou maieſt be long-liued vpon the earth.
label: Ephesians

text: And you fathers, prouoke not your children to anger: but bring them vp in the diſcipline and correption of our Lord.
label: Ephesians

text: Seruants, be obedient to your lordes according to the fleſh, with feare and trembling, in the ſimplicitie of your hart, as to Chriſt:
label: Ephesians

text: not ſeruing to the eie, as it vvere pleaſing men, but as the ſeruants of Chriſt, doing the vvil of God from the hart,
label: Ephesians

text: vvith a good vvil ſeruing, as to our Lord and not to men.
label: Ephesians

text: Knovving that euery one vvhat good ſoeuer he ſhal doe, that ſhal he receiue of our Lord, vvhether he be bond, or free.
label: Ephesians

text: And you maiſters, doe the ſame things to them, bremitting threatenings: knovving that both their Lord and yours, is in heauen: and acception of perſons is not vvith him.
label: Ephesians

text: Hence forth brethren, be ſtrengthened in our Lord, & in the might of his povver.
label: Ephesians

text: Put you on the armour of God, that you may ſtand againſt the deceites of the Deuil.
label: Ephesians

text: For our vvreſtling is not againſt fleſh and bloud: but againſt Princes and Poteſtats, againſt the rectors of the vvorld of this darkenes, againſt the ſpirituals of vvickednes in the celeſtials.
label: Ephesians

text: Therfore take the armour of God, that you may reſiſt in the euil day, and ſtand in al things perfect.
label: Ephesians

text: Stand therfore hauing your loines girded in truth, and clothed with the breaſt-plate of iuſtice,
label: Ephesians

text: & hauing your feete ſhod to the preparation of the Goſpel of peace:
label: Ephesians

text: in al things taking the ſhield of faith, vvherevvith you may extinguiſh al the firie dartes of the moſt vvicked one.
label: Ephesians

text: and take vnto you the helmet of ſaluation: and the ſvvord of the ſpirit ( vvhich is the vvord of God ) ⊢
label: Ephesians

text: in al praier and ſupplication praying at al time in ſpirit: and in the ſame vvatching in al inſtance and ſupplication for al the ſaincts:
label: Ephesians

text: and for me, that ſpeache may be giuen me in the opening of my mouth vvith confidence, to make knowen the myſterie of the Goſpel,
label: Ephesians

text: for the vvhich I am a legate in this chaine, ſo that in it I may be bold according as I ought, to ſpeake.
label: Ephesians

text: And that you alſo may knovv the things about me, vvhat I doe: Tychicus my deereſt brother and faithful miniſter in our Lord, vvil make you vnderſtand al things:
label: Ephesians

text: vvhom I haue ſent to you for this ſame purpoſe, that you may know the things about vs, and he may comfort your hartes.
label: Ephesians

text: Peace to the brethren and charitie vvith faith from God the Father, and our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: Ephesians

text: Grace vvith al that loue our Lord IESVS Chriſt in incorruption. Amen.
label: Ephesians

text: PAVL and Timothee the ſeruants of IESVS Chriſt: to al the ſainctes in Chriſt IESVS that are at Philippi, vvith the Biſhops and Deacons.
label: Philippians

text: Grace to you and peace from God our father, and our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: Philippians

text: I giue thankes to my God in al memorie of you
label: Philippians

text: ( alvvaies in al my praiers for al you, vvith ioy making petition )
label: Philippians

text: for your communicating in the Goſpel of Chriſt from the firſt day vntil novv.
label: Philippians

text: truſting this ſame thing, that he which hath begōne in you a good worke, vvil perfit it vnto the day of Chriſt IESVS.
label: Philippians

text: as it is reaſon for me, this to thinke for al you, for that I haue you in hart, & in my bandes, and in the defenſe, and the confirmation of the Goſpel, al you to be partakers of my ioy.
label: Philippians

text: For God is my vvitnes, hovv I couet you al in the bowels of IESVS Chriſt.
label: Philippians

text: And this I pray, that your charitie may more and more abound in knovvledge and in al vnderſtanding:
label: Philippians

text: that you may approue the better things, that you may be ſincere and vvithout offence vnto the day of Chriſt,
label: Philippians

text: repleniſhed vvith the fruite of iuſtice by IESVS Chriſt, vnto the glorie and praiſe of God. ⊢
label: Philippians

text: And I vvil haue you knovv brethren, that the things about me are come to the more furtherance of the Goſpel:
label: Philippians

text: ſo that my bandes vvere made manifeſt in Chriſt in al the court, and in al the reſt,
label: Philippians

text: that many of our brethren in our Lord, hauing confidence in my bandes, vvere bold more aboundantly vvithout feare to ſpeake the vvord of God.
label: Philippians

text: Some in deede euen for enuie and contention: but ſome alſo for good vvil preache Chriſt.
label: Philippians

text: Some of charitie: knovving that I am ſet vnto the defenſe of the Goſpel.
label: Philippians

text: And ſome of contention preache Chriſt not ſincerely: ſuppoſing that they raiſe affliction to my bandes.
label: Philippians

text: But vvhat? So that by al meanes, vvhether by occaſion, or by truth, Chriſt be preached: in this alſo I reioyce, yea & vvil reioyce.
label: Philippians

text: For I knovv that this ſhal fall out to me vnto ſaluatiō by your praier and the ſubminiſtration of the Spirit of IESVS Chriſt,
label: Philippians

text: according to my expectation & hope, becauſe in nothing ſhal I be confounded, but in al confidence as alvvaies, novv alſo ſhal Chriſt be magnified in my body, vvhether it be by life, or by death.
label: Philippians

text: For vnto me, to liue is Chriſt: and to die is gaine.
label: Philippians

text: And if to liue in the fleſh, this vnto me be the fruit of the vvorke, and vvhat I ſhal chooſe I knovv not.
label: Philippians

text: And I am ſtraitened of the tvvo: hauing deſire to be diſſolued & to be vvith Chriſt, a thing much more better.
label: Philippians

text: but to abide in the fleſh, `neceſſarie' for you.
label: Philippians

text: And truſting this, I know that I ſhal abide and continue vvith you al, vnto your furtherance and ioy of the faith:
label: Philippians

text: that your gratulation may abound in Chriſt IESVS in me, by my comming againe to you.
label: Philippians

text: Only conuerſe ye vvorthie of the Goſpel of Chriſt: that vvhether vvhen I come and ſee you, or els be abſent, I may heare of you that you ſtand in one Spirit, of one minde labouring together to the faith of the Goſpel:
label: Philippians

text: And in nothing be ye terrified of the aduerſaries, vvhich to them is cauſe of perdition: but to you of ſaluation, & this of God:
label: Philippians

text: for to you it is giuen for Chriſt, not only that you beleeue in him, but alſo that you ſuffer for him,
label: Philippians

text: hauing the ſame combat like as you haue ſeen in me, and novv `haue heard' of me.
label: Philippians

text: IF therfore there be any conſolation in Chriſt, if any ſolace of charitie, if any ſocietie of ſpirit, if any bovvels of commiſeration:
label: Philippians

text: fulfil my ioy, that you be of one meaning, hauing the ſame charitie, of one minde, agreing in one.
label: Philippians

text: nothing by contentiō, neither by vaine glorie: but in humilitie, eche coūting other better then them ſelues:
label: Philippians

text: euery one not cōſidering the things that are their owne, but thoſe that are other mens.
label: Philippians

text: For this thinke in your ſelues, vvhich alſo in Chriſt IESVS,
label: Philippians

text: vvho vvhen he vvas in the forme of God, thought it no robberie, him ſelf to be equal to God,
label: Philippians

text: but he exinanited him ſelf, taking the forme of a ſeruant, made into the ſimilitude of men, and in ſhape found as man.
label: Philippians

text: He humbled him ſelf, made obediēt vnto death: euen the death of the croſſe.
label: Philippians

text: For the vvhich thing God alſo hath exalted him, and hath giuen him a name vvhich is aboue al names:
label: Philippians

text: that in the name of IESVS euery knee bovve of the celeſtials, terreſtrials, and infernals:
label: Philippians

text: and euery tongue cōfeſſe that our Lord IESVS Chriſt is in the glorie of God the Father. ⊢
label: Philippians

text: Therfore my deereſt, ( as you haue alvvaies obeied ) not as in the preſence of me only, but much more novv in my abſence, vvith feare and trembling vvorke your ſaluation.
label: Philippians

text: For it is God that vvorketh in you both to vvil and to accompliſh, according to his good vvil.
label: Philippians

text: And doe ye al things vvithout murmurings and ſtaggerings:
label: Philippians

text: that you may be vvithout blame, and the ſimple children of God, vvithout reprehenſion in the middes of a crooked and peruerſe generation. among vvhom you ſhine as lightes in the vvorld:
label: Philippians

text: conteining the vvord of life to my glorie in the daie of Chriſt, becauſe I haue not runne in vaine, nor in vaine laboured.
label: Philippians

text: But and if I be immolated, vpon the ſacrifice and ſeruice of your faith, I reioyce and congratulate vvith you al.
label: Philippians

text: And the ſelf ſame thing doe you alſo reioyce, and congratulate vvith me.
label: Philippians

text: And I hope in our Lord IESVS, to ſend Timothee vnto you quickly, that I alſo may be of good comfort, when I knovv the things pertaining to you.
label: Philippians

text: For I haue no mā ſo of one minde that vvith ſincere affection is careful for you.
label: Philippians

text: For al ſeeke the things that are their ovvne: not the things that are IESVS Chriſts.
label: Philippians

text: And knovv ye an experiment of him, that as a ſonne the father, ſo hath he ſerued vvith me in the Goſpel.
label: Philippians

text: This man therfore I hope to ſend vnto you, immediatly as I ſhal ſee the things that concerne me.
label: Philippians

text: And I truſt in our Lord that my ſelf alſo ſhal come to you quickly.
label: Philippians

text: But I haue thought it neceſſarie to ſend to you Epaphroditus my brother and coadiutor and felovv ſouldiar, but your Apoſtle, and miniſter of my neceſſitie.
label: Philippians

text: Becauſe in deede he had a deſire tovvard you al: and vvas penſiue, for that you had heard that he vvas ſicke.
label: Philippians

text: For in deede he vvas ſicke euen to death: but God had mercie on him: and not only on him, but on me alſo, leſt I ſhould haue ſorovv vpon ſorovv.
label: Philippians

text: Therfore I ſent him the more ſpedily: that ſeeing him, you may reioyce againe, and I may be vvithout ſorovv.
label: Philippians

text: Receiue him therfore vvith al ioy in our Lord: and ſuch intreate vvith honour.
label: Philippians

text: becauſe for the vvorke of Chriſt, he came to the point of death: yelding his life, that he might fulfil that vvhich on your part vvanted tovvard my ſeruice.
label: Philippians

text: FROM hence forth my brethren, reioyce in our Lord. To vvrite the ſame things vnto you, to me ſurely it is not tedious, and to you it is neceſſarie.
label: Philippians

text: See the dogges, ſee the euil vvorkers, ſee the cconciſiō.
label: Philippians

text: For vve are the circumciſion, vvhich in ſpirit ſerue God: and vve glorie in Chriſt IESVS, and not hauing confidence in the fleſh,
label: Philippians

text: albeit I alſo haue confidence in the fleſh. If any other man ſeeme to haue confidence in the fleſh, I more,
label: Philippians

text: circumciſed the eight day, of the ſtocke of Iſraël, of the tribe of Beniamin, an Hebrevv of Hebrevves: according to the Lavv, a Phariſee:
label: Philippians

text: according to emulation, perſecuting the Church of God: according to the iuſtice that is in the Lavv, conuerſing vvithout blame.
label: Philippians

text: But the things that vvere gaines to me, thoſe haue I eſteemed for Chriſt, detriments.
label: Philippians

text: Yea but I eſteeme al things to be detriment for the paſſing knovvledge of IESVS Chriſt my Lord: for vvhom I haue made al things as detriment, and do eſteeme them as dung, that I may gaine Chriſt:
label: Philippians

text: and may be found in him not hauing my iuſtice vvhich is of the Lavv, but that vvhich is of the faith of Chriſt, vvhich is of God iuſtice in faith:
label: Philippians

text: to knovv him, and the vertue of his reſurrection, and the ſocietie of his paſſions, configured to his death,
label: Philippians

text: if by any meanes I may come to the reſurrection vvhich is from the dead.
label: Philippians

text: Not that novv I haue receiued, or novv am perfect: but I purſue, if I may comprehend vvherein I am alſo comprehended of Chriſt IESVS. ⊢
label: Philippians

text: Brethren, I do not account that I haue comprehended. Yet one thing: forgetting the things that are behinde, but ſtretching forth my ſelf to thoſe that are before,
label: Philippians

text: I purſue to the marke, to the price of the ſupernal vocation of God in Chriſt IESVS.
label: Philippians

text: Let vs therfore as many as are perfect, be thus minded: and if you be any othervviſe minded, this alſo God hath reuealed to you.
label: Philippians

text: Neuertheleſſe vvherevnto we are come, that vve be of the ſame minde, let vs continue in the ſame rule.
label: Philippians

text: Be folovvers of me brethren: & obſerue them that vvalke ſo as you haue our forme.
label: Philippians

text: For many vvalke vvhom often I told you of (and novv vveeping alſo I tel you) the enemies of the croſſe of Chriſt:
label: Philippians

text: vvhoſe end is deſtruction: vvhoſe God, is the belly: and their glorie in their confuſion, vvhich minde vvorldly things.
label: Philippians

text: But our conuerſation is in heauen? vvhence alſo vve expect the Sauiour, our Lord IESVS Chriſt,
label: Philippians

text: vvho vvil reforme the body of our humilitie, configured to the body of his glorie, according to the operation vvhereby alſo he is able to ſubdue al things to him ſelf.
label: Philippians

text: THERFORE, my deereſt brethren and moſt deſired, my ioy and my crovvne: ſo ſtand in our Lord, my deereſt.
label: Philippians

text: `Euchodia' I deſire & Syntyché I beſeeche to be of one minde in our Lord.
label: Philippians

text: Yea and I beſeeche thee my ſincere companion, helpe thoſe vvomen that haue laboured vvith me in the Goſpel vvith Clement, and the reſt my coadiutors, vvhoſe names are in the booke of life. ⊢
label: Philippians

text: Reioyce in our Lord alvvaies: againe I ſay reioyce.
label: Philippians

text: Let your modeſtie be knovven to al men. Our Lord is nigh.
label: Philippians
