text: Be nothing careful: but in euery thing by praier & ſupplicatiō vvith thākeſgiuing let your petitions be knovven vvith God.
label: Philippians

text: And the peace of God vvhich paſſeth al vnderſtanding, keepe your hartes and intelligences in Chriſt IESVS. ⊢
label: Philippians

text: For the reſt brethren, vvhat things ſo euer be true, vvhatſoeuer honeſt, whatſoeuer iuſt, vvhatſoeuer holy, whatſoeuer amiable, vvhatſoeuer of good fame, if there be any vertue, if any praiſe of diſcipline, theſe things thinke vpon.
label: Philippians

text: Vvhich you haue both learned, and receiued, and heard, & ſeen in me: theſe things doe ye, and the God of peace ſhall be vvith you.
label: Philippians

text: And I reioyced in our Lord excedingly, that once at the length you haue crefloriſhed to care for me, as you did alſo care: but you vvere occupied.
label: Philippians

text: I ſpeake not as it vvere for penurie. for I haue learned, to be cōtent vvith the things that I haue.
label: Philippians

text: I knovv both to be brought lovv, I knovv alſo to abound: ( euery vvhere, and in al things I am inſtructed) both to be ful, & to be hungrie, both to abound, and to ſuffer penurie.
label: Philippians

text: I can al things in him that ſtrengtheneth me.
label: Philippians

text: Neuertheleſſe you haue done vvel, communicating to my tribulation.
label: Philippians

text: And you alſo knovv ô Philippians, that in the beginning of the Goſpel, vvhen I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated vnto me in the account of gift and receite, but you only:
label: Philippians

text: for vnto Theſſalonica alſo, once and tvviſe you ſent to my vſe.
label: Philippians

text: Not that I ſeeke the gift, but I ſeeke the fruite abounding in your account.
label: Philippians

text: But I haue al things, and abound: I vvas filled after I receiued of Epaphroditus the things that you ſent, an odour of ſvveetenes, an acceptable hoſt, pleaſing God.
label: Philippians

text: And my God ſupply al your clacke according to his riches in glorie, in Chriſt IESVS.
label: Philippians

text: And to God & our father be glorie vvorld vvithout end. Amen.
label: Philippians

text: Salute ye euery ſaincte in Chriſt IESVS.
label: Philippians

text: The brethren that are vvith me, ſalute you. Al the ſainctes ſalute you: but eſpecially they that are of Cæſars houſe.
label: Philippians

text: The grace of our Lord IESVS Chriſt be vvith your ſpirit. Amen.
label: Philippians

text: PAVL an Apoſtle of IESVS Chriſt by the vvil of God, and brother Timothee:
label: Colossians

text: to them that are at Coloſſa ſainctes and faithful brethren in Chriſt IESVS.
label: Colossians

text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and our Lord IESVS Chriſt. Vve giue thankes to God and the Father of our Lord IESVS Chriſt alvvaies for you, praying:
label: Colossians

text: hearing your faith in Chriſt IESVS, and the loue vvhich you haue tovvard al the ſainctes,
label: Colossians

text: for the hope that is laid vp for you in heauen, vvhich you haue heard in the vvord of the truth of the Goſpel,
label: Colossians

text: that is come to you, as alſo in the vvhole vvorld it is, and fructifieth and grovveth, euen as in you, ſince that day that you heard & knevv the grace of God in truth,
label: Colossians

text: as you learned of Epaphras our deereſt fellovv-ſeruant, vvho is a faithful miniſter of IESVS Chriſt for you,
label: Colossians

text: vvho alſo hath manifeſted to vs your loue in ſpirit.
label: Colossians

text: Therfore vve alſo from the day that vve heard it, ceaſe not praying for you and deſiring, that you may be filled vvith the knovvledge of his vvil, in al vviſedom, and ſpiritual vnderſtanding:
label: Colossians

text: that you may vvalke vvorthie of God, in al things pleaſing: Fructifying in cal good vvorke, & increaſing in the knovvledge of God:
label: Colossians

text: in al povver ſtrengthened according to the might of his glorie, in al patience and longanimitie vvith ioy
label: Colossians

text: giuing thankes to God and the Father, vvho hath made vs vvorthy vnto the part of the lot of the ſainctes in the light:
label: Colossians

text: vvho hath deliuered vs from the povver of darkenes, and hath tranſlated vs into the kingdom of the ſonne of his loue,
label: Colossians

text: in vvhom vve haue redemption, the remiſſion of ſinnes: ⊢
label: Colossians

text: vvho is the image of the inuiſible God, the firſt-borne of al creature:
label: Colossians

text: becauſe in him vvere created al things in heauen, and in earth, viſible, and inuiſible, vvhether Thrones, or Dominations, or Principalities, or Poteſtates: al by him, & in him vvere created:
label: Colossians

text: and he is before al, and al conſiſt in him.
label: Colossians

text: And he is the head of the body, the CHVRCH, vvho is the beginning, firſt-borne of the dead: that he may be in al things holding the primacie:
label: Colossians

text: becauſe in him it hath vvel pleaſed, al fulnes to inhabite:
label: Colossians

text: and by him to reconcile al things vnto him ſelf, pacifying by the bloud of his croſſe, vvhether the things in earth, or the things that are in heauen.
label: Colossians

text: And you, vvhereas you vvere ſometime alienated and enemies in ſenſe, in euil vvorkes:
label: Colossians

text: yet novv he hath reconciled in the body of his fleſh by death, to preſent you holy & immaculate, and blameles before him:
label: Colossians

text: if yet ye continue in the faith, grounded and ſtable, and vnmoueable from the hope of the Goſpel vvhich you haue heard, vvhich is preached among al creatures that are vnder heauen, vvhereof I Paul am made a miniſter.
label: Colossians

text: Vvho novv reioyce in ſuffering for you, and do accompliſh thoſe things that vvant of the paſſions of Chriſt, in my fleſh for his body, vvhich is the CHVRCH:
label: Colossians

text: vvhereof I am made a miniſter according to the diſpenſation of God, vvhich is giuen me tovvard you, that I may fulfil the vvord of God,
label: Colossians

text: the myſterie that hath been hidden from vvorldes and generations, but novv is manifeſted to his ſainctes,
label: Colossians

text: to vvhom God vvould make knowen the riches of the glorie of this ſacrament in the Gentiles, vvhich is Chriſt, in you the hope of glorie,
label: Colossians

text: vvhom vve preache, admoniſhing euery man, and teaching euery man in al vviſedom, that vve may preſent euery man perfect in Chriſt IESVS.
label: Colossians

text: Vvherein alſo I labour ſtriuing according to his operation vvhich he vvorketh in me in povver.
label: Colossians

text: FOR I vvil haue you knovv brethren, vvhat maner of care I haue for you and for them that are at Laodicia, and vvhoſoeuer haue not ſeen my face in the fleſh:
label: Colossians

text: that their hartes may be comforted, inſtructed in charitie, & vnto al the riches of the fulnes of vnderſtanding, vnto the knovvledge of the myſterie of God the Father of Chriſt IESVS,
label: Colossians

text: in vvhom be al the treaſures of vviſedom and knovvledge hidde.
label: Colossians

text: But this I ſay that no man deceiue you in loftines of vvordes.
label: Colossians

text: For although I be abſent in body, yet in ſpirit I am vvith you: reioycing, & ſeeing your order, & the conſtancie of that your faith which is in Chriſt.
label: Colossians

text: Therfore as you haue receiued IESVS Chriſt our Lord, vvalke in him,
label: Colossians

text: rooted and built in him, and confirmed in the faith, as alſo you haue learned, abounding `in him' in thankes-giuing.
label: Colossians

text: Bevvare leſt any man deceiue you by philoſophie, and vaine fallacie: according to the tradition of men, according to the elements of the vvorld, and not according to Chriſt.
label: Colossians

text: For in him dvvelleth al the fulneſſe of the Godhead corporally:
label: Colossians

text: and you are in him repleniſhed, vvho is the head in al Principalitie and Povver:
label: Colossians

text: in vvhom al you are circumciſed vvith circumciſion not made by hand in ſpoiling of the body of the fleſh, in the circumciſion of Chriſt,
label: Colossians

text: buried vvith him in Baptiſme: in vvhom alſo you are riſen againe by the faith of the operation of God, vvho raiſed him vp from the dead.
label: Colossians

text: And you vvhen you vvere dead in the offenſes and the prepuce of your fleſh, did he quicken together vvith him: pardoning you al offenſes,
label: Colossians

text: vvyping out the hand vvriting `of decree' that vvas againſt vs, vvhich vvas contrarie to vs. and the ſame he hath taken out of the vvay, faſtening it to the croſſe:
label: Colossians

text: and ſpoiling the Principalities and Poteſtats, hath ledde them confidently in open ſhevv, triumphing them in him ſelf.
label: Colossians

text: Let no man therfore iudge you in meate or in drinke, or in part of a feſtiual day, or of the Nevv-moone, or of Sabboths:
label: Colossians

text: vvhich are a ſhadovv of things to come, but the body Chriſts.
label: Colossians

text: Let no man ſeduce you, bvvilling in the humilitie and religion of Angels, vvalking in the things vvhich he hath not ſeen, in vaine puffed vp by the ſenſe of his fleſh,
label: Colossians

text: and not holding the head, vvhereof the vvhole body by ioyntes and bandes being ſerued & compacted, grovveth to the increaſe of God.
label: Colossians

text: If then you be dead vvith Chriſt, from the elements of this vvorld: vvhy do you yet decree as liuing in the vvorld?
label: Colossians

text: Touch not, taſt not, handle not:
label: Colossians

text: vvhich things are al vnto deſtruction by the very vſe, according to the precepts and doctrines of men.
label: Colossians

text: vvhich are in deede hauing a ſhevv of vviſedom in ſuperſtition and humilitie, and not to ſpare the body, not in any honour to the filling of the fleſh.
label: Colossians

text: THERFORE if you be riſen vvith Chriſt, ſeeke the things that are aboue: vvhere Chriſt is ſitting on the right hand of God.
label: Colossians

text: Minde the things that are aboue, not the things that are vpon the earth.
label: Colossians

text: For you are dead: and your life is hidde vvith Chriſt in God.
label: Colossians

text: Vvhen Chriſt ſhal appeare, your life: then you alſo ſhal appeare vvith him in glorie. ⊢
label: Colossians

text: Mortifie therfore your members that are vpon the earth, fornication, vncleanneſſe, luſt, euil concupiſcence, and auarice, vvhich is the ſeruice of Idols.
label: Colossians

text: for vvhich things the vvrath of God commeth vpon the children of incredulitie.
label: Colossians

text: in vvhich you alſo vvalked ſometime, vvhen you liued in them.
label: Colossians

text: But novv lay you alſo al avvay: anger, indignation, malice, blaſphemie, filthie talke out of your mouth.
label: Colossians

text: Lie not one to an other: ſpoiling your ſelues of the old man vvith his actes,
label: Colossians

text: and doing on the nevv, him that is renevved vnto knovvledge, according to the image of him that created him.
label: Colossians

text: vvhere there is not, Gentile and Ievve, circumciſion and prepuce, Barbarous and Scythian. bonde and free: but al, and in al Chriſt.
label: Colossians

text: Put ye on therfore as the elect of God, holy, and beloued, the bovvels of mercie, benignitie, humilitie, modeſtie, patience,
label: Colossians

text: ſupporting one an other: and pardoning one an other, if any haue a quarel againſt any man. as alſo our Lord hath pardoned vs: ſo you alſo.
label: Colossians

text: But aboue al theſe things haue charitie, vvhich is the band of perfection:
label: Colossians

text: & let the peace of Chriſt cexult in your hartes, vvherein alſo you are called in one body: and be thankeful.
label: Colossians

text: Let the vvord of Chriſt dvvel in you aboundantly, in al vviſedom: teaching and admoniſhing your ovvne ſelues, vvith pſalmes, hymnes, and ſpiritual canticles, in grace ſinging in your hartes to God.
label: Colossians

text: Al vvhatſoeuer you doe in vvord or in vvorke, al things in the name of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, giuing thankes to God and the Father by him. ⊢
label: Colossians

text: Vvomen be ſubiect to your huſbands, as it behoueth in our Lord.
label: Colossians

text: Men, loue your vviues: and be not bitter tovvard them.
label: Colossians

text: Children obey your parents in al things: for that is vvel pleaſing to our Lord.
label: Colossians

text: Fathers, prouoke not your children to indignation: that they become not diſcouraged.
label: Colossians

text: Seruants, obey in al things, your maiſters according to the fleſh, not ſeruing to the eie, as pleaſing men, but in ſimplicitie of hart, fearing God.
label: Colossians

text: Vvhatſoeuer you doe, vvorke it from the hart as to our Lord, and not to men:
label: Colossians

text: knovving that you ſhal receiue of our Lord the retribution of inheritance. Serue our Lord Chriſt.
label: Colossians

text: For he that doeth iniurie, ſhal receiue that vvhich he hath done vniuſtly: and there is not acception of perſons vvith God.
label: Colossians

text: YOV Maiſters, that vvhich is iuſt and equal, doe to your ſeruants: knovving that you alſo haue a Maiſter in heauen.
label: Colossians

text: Be inſtant in praier: vvatching in it in thankes giuing,
label: Colossians

text: praying vvithal for vs alſo, that God may open vnto vs the doore of ſpeache to ſpeake the myſterie of Chriſt ( for the vvhich alſo I am bound )
label: Colossians

text: that I may manifeſt it, ſo as I ought to ſpeake.
label: Colossians

text: Vvalke vvith vviſedom tovvard them that be vvithout: redeeming the time.
label: Colossians

text: Your talke alvvaies, in grace let it be ſeaſoned vvith ſalte: that you may knovv hovv you ought to anſvver euery man.
label: Colossians

text: The things that are about me, Tychicus our deereſt brother, and faithful miniſter, & fellovv-ſeruant in our Lord, vvil make you vnderſtand al,
label: Colossians

text: vvhom I haue ſent to you for this ſame purpoſe, that he may know the things that concerne you, and may comfort your hartes,
label: Colossians

text: vvith Oneſimus the moſt deere and faithful brother vvho is of you. Al things that are done here, ſhal they doe you to vnderſtand.
label: Colossians

text: Ariſtarchus my fellovv-priſoner ſaluteth you, & Marke the coſin-german of Barnabas ( concerning vvhom you haue receiued commaundements, If he come to you, receiue him )
label: Colossians

text: and Ieſus that is called Iuſtus: vvho are of the Circumciſion. theſe only are my coadiutors in the kingdom of God: vvhich haue been a comfort to me.
label: Colossians

text: Epaphras ſaluteth you vvho is of you, the ſeruant of Chriſt IESVS, alvvaies careful for you in praiers, that you may ſtand perfect and ful in al the vvil of God.
label: Colossians

text: For I giue him teſtimonie that he hath much labour for you, and for them that be at Laodicia, and that are at Hierapolis.
label: Colossians

text: Luke the moſt deere phyſicion ſaluteth you: and Demas.
label: Colossians

text: Salute the brethren that are at Laodicia: and Nymphas and the Church that is in his houſe.
label: Colossians

text: And vvhen the epiſtle ſhal be read vvith you, make that it be read alſo in the Church of the Laodicians: and that you read that vvhich is of the Laodicians.
label: Colossians

text: And ſay to Archippus, See the miniſterie vvhich thou haſt receiued of our Lord, that thou fulfil it.
label: Colossians

text: The ſalutation: vvith mine owne hand, Paules. Be mindeful of my bandes. Grace be vvith you. Amen.
label: Colossians

text: PAVL and Siluanus and Timothee to the Church of the Theſſalonians in God the Father, & our Lord IESVS Chriſt. Grace to you and peace.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Vve giue thankes to God alvvaies for al you: making a memorie of you in our praiers without intermiſſion,
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: mindeful of the vvorke of your faith and labour, and of the charitie, & of the enduring of the hope of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, before God and our father:
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: knovving brethren beloued of God, your election:
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: that our Goſpel hath not been to you in word only, but in povver and the holy Ghoſt, and in much fulneſſe, as you knovv vvhat maner of men vve haue been among you for your ſakes.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: And you became folovvers of vs, & of our Lord: receiuing the vvord in much tribulation, vvith ioy of the holy Ghoſt:
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: ſo that you were made a paterne to al that beleeue in Macedonia & in Achaia.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For from you vvas bruited the vvord of our Lord: not only in Macedonia and in Achaia, but in euery place, your faith vvhich is to God vvard, is proceded, ſo that it is not neceſſarie for vs to ſpeake any thing.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For they them ſelues report of vs vvhat maner of entring vve had to you: and how you are turned to God from Idols, to ſerue the liuing and true God,
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: and to expect his Sonne from heauen ( vvhom he raiſed vp from the dead) IESVS, vvho hath deliuered vs from the vvrath to come. ⊢
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: FOR your ſelues knovv, brethren, our entrance vnto you, that it vvas not vaine:
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: but hauing ſuffered before and been abuſed vvith contumelies (as you knovv) at Philippi, vve had confidence in our God, to ſpeake vnto you the Goſpel of God in much carefulnes.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For our exhortation vvas not of errour, nor of vncleanneſſe, nor in deceite:
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: but as vve vvere approued of God that the Goſpel ſhould be committed to vs, ſo vve ſpeake: not as pleaſing men, but God, vvho proueth our hartes.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For neither haue we been at any time in the vvord of adulation, as you knovv: nor in occaſion of auarice, God is vvitnes:
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: nor ſeeking glorie of men, neither of you, nor of others.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Vvhereas vve might haue been a burden to you, as the Apoſtles of Chriſt: but vve became children in the middes of you, as if a nource ſhould cheriſh her children:
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: ſo hauing a deſire to you, vve would gladly deliuer vnto you not only the Goſpel of God, but alſo our ovvne ſoules: becauſe you are become moſt deere vnto vs.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For you are mindeful, brethren, of our labour and toile. day & night vvorking, leſt vve ſhould charge any of you, vve preached among you the Goſpel of God.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: You are vvitneſſes and God, hovv holily and iuſtly and vvithout blame, vve haue been to you that did beleeue.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: as you knovv in vvhat maner we deſiring and comforting you, haue adiured euery one of you (as a father his children)
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: that you vvould vvalke vvorthie of God, vvho hath called you into his kingdom and glorie.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Therfore vve alſo giue thankes to God vvithout intermiſſion: becauſe that vvhen you had receiued of vs the vvord of the hearing of God, you receiued it not as the vvord of men, but (as it is in deede) the vvord of God, who vvorketh in you that haue beleeued.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For you, brethren, are become folovvers of the churches of God that be in Ievvrie, in Chriſt IESVS: for you alſo haue ſuffered the ſame things of your ovvne lineage, as they alſo of the Ievves,
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: vvho both killed our Lord IESVS, and the Prophets, and haue perſecuted vs, and pleaſe not God, and are aduerſaries to al men,
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: prohibiting vs to ſpeake to the Gentiles that they may be ſaued, to make vp their ſinnes alvvaies. for the vvrath of God is come vpon them euen to the end.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: But vve, brethren, cdepriued of you for a ſhort time, in ſight, not in hart: haue haſtened the more aboundantly to ſee your face vvith much deſire.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For vve vvould haue come to you, I Paul certes, once and againe: but Satan hath hindered vs.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For vvhat is our hope, or ioy, or crovvne of glorie? Are not you before our Lord IESVS Chriſt in his comming?
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For you are our glorie and ioy.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: FOR the vvhich cauſe forbearing no longer, it pleaſed vs to remaine at Athens, alone.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: And vve ſent Timothee our brother, & the miniſter of God in the Goſpel of Chriſt, to confirme you and exhort you for your faith,
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: that no man be moued in theſe tribulations, for your ſelues knovv, that vve are appointed to this.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For euen vvhen vve vvere vvith you, vve foretold you that vve ſhould ſuffer tribulations, as alſo it is come to paſſe, & you knovv.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Therfore I alſo forbearing no longer, ſent to knovv your faith: leſt perhaps he that tempteth, hath tempted you, & our labour be made vaine.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: But now Timothee comming vnto vs from you, & reporting to vs your faith & charitie, and that you haue a good remembrance of vs alvvaies, deſiring to ſee vs, as vve alſo you:
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: therfore vve are comforted, brethren, in you, in al our neceſſitie & tribulation, by your faith,
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: becauſe novv vve liue, if you ſtand in our Lord.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For vvhat thankes-giuing can vve render to God for you, in al ioy vvherevvith vve reioyce for you before our God,
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: night and day more aboundantly praying that vve may ſee your face, and may accompliſh thoſe things that vvant of your faith.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: And God him ſelf and our Father, and our Lord IESVS Chriſt direct our vvay to you.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: And our Lord multiplie you, and make your charitie abound one to an other, & tovvard al men: as vve alſo in you,
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: to confirme your hartes vvithout blame, in holineſſe, before God and our Father, in the comming of our Lord IESVS Chriſt vvith al his Sainctes. Amen.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: FOR the reſt therfore, brethren, vve deſire & beſeeche you in our Lord IESVS, that as you haue receiued of vs hovv you ought to vvalke, and to pleaſe God, as alſo you doe vvalke, that you abounde more.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For you knovv vvhat precepts I haue giuen to you by our Lord IESVS.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For this is the vvil of God, your ſanctification: that you abſtaine from fornication,
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: that euery one may knovv to poſſeſſe his veſſel in ſanctification and honour:
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: not in the paſſion of luſt, as alſo the Gentiles that knovv not God,
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: and that no man ouergoe, nor circumuent his brother in buſineſſe: becauſe our Lord is reuenger of al theſe things, as vve haue foretold you,& haue teſtified.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For God hath not called vs into vncleanneſſe: but into ſanctification. ⊢
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Therfore he that deſpiſeth theſe things, deſpiſeth not man but God, vvho alſo hath giuen his holy Spirit in vs.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: But concerning the charitie of the cfraternitie, vve haue no neede to vvrite to you: for your ſelues haue learned of God to loue one an other.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Yea and you do it tovvard al the brethren in al Macedonia. But vve deſire you brethren, that you abound more:
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: & that you employ your indeuour to be quiet, & that you doe your ovvne buſineſſe, & vvorke vvith your ovvne handes, as we haue commaunded you:
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: and that you vvalke honeſtly tovvard them that are vvithout: and neede nothing of any mans.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: And vve vvil not haue you ignorant, brethren, concerning them that ſleepe, that you be not ſorovvful, as alſo others that haue no hope.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For if vve beleeue that IESVS died and roſe againe, ſo alſo God them that haue ſlept by IESVS vvil bring vvith him.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For this vve ſay to you in the vvord of our Lord, that vve vvhich liue, vvhich are remaining in the aduent of our Lord, ſhal not preuent them that haue ſlept.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For our Lord him ſelf in commaundement and in the voice of an Archangel and in the trompet of God vvil deſcend from heauen: and the dead that are in Chriſt, ſhal riſe againe firſt.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Then vve that liue, that are left, vvithal ſhal be taken vp vvith them in the cloudes to meete Chriſt, into the aire, and ſo alvvaies vve ſhal be vvith our Lord.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Therfore comfort ye one an other in theſe vvordes. ⊢
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: AND of the times and momentes, brethren, you neede not that vve vvrite to you.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For your ſelues knovv perfectly that the day of our Lord ſhal ſo come, as a theefe in the night.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For vvhen they ſhal ſay, peace & ſecuritie: then ſhal ſodaine deſtruction come vpon them, as the paines to her that is vvith childe, and they ſhal not eſcape.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: But you brethren are not in darkneſſe: that the ſame day may, as a theefe ouertake you.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For al you are the children of light, and children of the day: vve are not of the night nor of darkneſſe.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Therfore let vs not ſleepe as alſo others: but let vs vvatch and be ſober.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For they that ſleepe, ſleepe in the night: & they that be drunke, be drunke in the night.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: But vve that are of the day, are ſober, hauing on the breaſt-plate of faith and charitie, and a helmet, the hope of ſaluation.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For God hath not appointed vs vnto vvrath, but vnto the purchaſing of ſaluation by our Lord IESVS Chriſt,
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: vvho died for vs: that vvhether vve vvatch, or ſleepe, vve may liue together vvith him.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: For the vvhich cauſe comfort one an other: & edifie one an other, as alſo you doe.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: And vve beſeeche you brethren, that you vvil knovv them that labour among you, and that gouerne you in our Lord, and admoniſh you:
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: that you haue them more aboundantly in charitie for their vvorke. haue peace vvith them.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: And vve beſeeche you brethren, admoniſh the vnquiet, comfort the vveake-minded, beare vp the vveake, be patient to al.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: See that none render euil for euil to any man: but alvvaies that vvhich is good purſue tovvards eche other, and tovvards al.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Alvvaies reioyce.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Pray vvithout intermiſſion.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: In al things giue thankes. for this is the vvil of God in Chriſt IESVS in al you.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: The Spirit extinguiſh not.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Prophecies deſpiſe not.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: But prooue al things: hold that vvhich is good.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: From al appearance of euil refraine your ſelues.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: And the God of peace him ſelf ſanctifie you in al things: that your vvhole ſpirit, and ſoule and body vvithout blame may be preſerued in the comming of our Lord IESVS Chriſt. ⊢
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: He is faithful, that hath called you, vvho alſo vvil doe it.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Brethren pray for vs.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: Salute al the brethren in a holy kiſſe.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: I adiure you by our Lord that this epiſtle be read to al the holy brethren.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: The grace of our Lord IESVS Chriſt be vvith you. Amen.
label: 1 Thessalonians

text: PAVL and Siluanus and Timothee: to the churche of the Theſſalonians in God our Father and our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: Vve ought to giue thankes alvvaies to God for you brethren, ſo as meete is, becauſe your faith increaſeth excedingly, and the charitie of euery one of you aboundeth tovvards eche other:
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: ſo that vve our ſelues alſo glorie in you in the churches of God, for your patience, and faith in al your perſecutions and tribulations, vvhich you ſuſtaine
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: for an example of the iuſt iudgement of God, that you may be counted vvorthie of the kingdom of God, for the vvhich alſo you ſuffer.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: if yet it be iuſt vvith God to repay tribulation, to them that vexe you:
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: and to you that are vexed, reſt with vs in the reuelation of our Lord IESVS from heauen vvith the Angels of his povver,
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: in flame of fire, giuing reuenge to them that knovv not God, & that obey not the Goſpel of our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: vvho ſhal ſuffer eternal paines in deſtruction, from the face of our Lord and from the glorie of his povver:
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: vvhen he ſhal come to be glorified in his ſainctes, and to be made maruelous in al them that haue beleeued, becauſe our teſtimonie concerning you vvas credited in that day.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: Vvherein alſo vve pray alvvaies for you, that our God make you vvorthie of his vocation, and accompliſh al the good pleaſure of his goodneſſe & the vvorke of faith in povver,
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: that the name of our Lord IESVS Chriſt may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God, and of our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: AND vve deſire you, brethren, by the comming of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, and of our congregation into him:
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: that you be not eaſily moued from your ſenſe, nor be terrified, neither by ſpirit, nor by vvord, nor by epiſtle as ſent by vs, as though the day of our Lord vvere at hand.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: Let no man ſeduce you by any meanes, for vnleſſe there come a reuolt firſt, and the man of ſinne be reuealed, the ſonne of perdition,
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: vvhich is an aduerſarie & is extolled aboue al that is called God, or that is vvorſhipped, ſo that he ſitteth in the temple of God, ſhevving him ſelf as though he were God.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: Remember you not, that vvhen I vvas yet vvith you, I told you theſe things?
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: And novv vvhat letteth, you knovv: that he may be reuealed in his time.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: ( For novv the myſterie of iniquitie vvorketh: only that he vvhich novv holdeth, doe hold, vntil he be taken out of the vvay.)
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: And then that vvicked one ſhal be reuealed vvhom our Lord IESVS ſhal kil vvith the ſpirit of his mouth: & ſhal deſtroy vvith the manifeſtation of his aduent, him,
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: vvhoſe comming is according to the operation of Satan, in al povver, and lying ſignes and vvonders,
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: and in al ſeducing of iniquitie to them that periſh, for that they haue not receiued the charitie of the truth that they might be ſaued.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: Therfore God vvil ſend them the operation of errour, to beleeue lying:
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: that al may be iudged vvhich haue not beleeued the truth, but haue conſented to iniquitie.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: But vve ought to giue thankes to God alvvaies for you, brethren beloued of God, that he hath choſen you firſt-fruites vnto ſaluation, in ſanctification of ſpirit and faith of the truth:
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: into the vvhich alſo he hath called you by our Goſpel, vnto the purchaſing of the glorie of our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: Therfore brethren ſtand: and hold the traditions vvhich you haue learned, vvhether it be by vvord, or by our epiſtle.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: And our Lord IESVS Chriſt him ſelf, and God and our father vvhich hath loued vs, and hath giuen eternal conſolation, and good hope in grace,
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: cexhort your hartes, and confirme you in euery good vvorke and vvorde.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: FOR the reſt, brethren, pray for vs, that the vvord of God may haue courſe and be glorified, as alſo vvith you:
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: and that vve may be deliuered from importunate and naughtie men. for al men haue not faith.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: But our Lord is faithful, vvho vvil confirme and keepe you from euil.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: And vve haue confidence of you in our Lord, that the things vvhich vve commaund, both you doe, and vvil doe.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: And our Lord direct your hartes in the charitie of God, and patience of Chriſt.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: And vve denounce vnto you, brethren, in the name of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, that you vvithdravv your ſelues from euery brother vvalking inordinatly, and not according to the ctradition vvhich they haue receiued of vs.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: For your ſelues knovv hovv you ought to imitate vs: for vve haue not been vnquiet among you:
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: neither haue vve eaten bread of any man gratis, but in labour & in toile night and day vvorking, leſt vve ſhould burden any of you.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: Not as though vve had not authoritie: but that vve might giue our ſelues a paterne vnto you for to imitate vs.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: For alſo vvhen vve vvere vvith you, this vve denounced to you, that if any vvil not vvorke, neither let him eate.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: For vve haue heard of certaine among you that vvalke vnquietly, vvorking nothing, but curiouſly meddling.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: And to them that be ſuch vve denounce, & beſeeche them in our Lord IESVS Chriſt, that vvorking vvith ſilence, they eate their ovvne bread.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: But you brethren fainte not vvel-doing.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: And if any obey not our vvord, note him by an epiſtle:
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: and do not companie vvith him, that he may be confounded: and do not eſteeme him as an enemie, but admoniſh him as a brother.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: And the Lord of peace him ſelf giue you euerlaſting peace in euery place. Our Lord be vvith you al.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: The ſalutation, vvith mine ovvne hand, Paules: vvhich is a ſigne in euery epiſtle. ſo I vvrite.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: The grace of our Lord IESVS Chriſt be vvith you al. Amen.
label: 2 Thessalonians

text: PAVL an Apoſtle of IESVS Chriſt according to the commandement of God our ſauiour, and of Chriſt IESVS our hope:
label: 1 Timothy

text: to Timothee his beloued ſonne in the faith. Grace, mercie, and peace from God the father, and from Chriſt IESVS our Lord.
label: 1 Timothy

text: As I deſired thee to remaine at Epheſus vvhen I vvent into Macedonia, that thou ſhouldeſt denounce to certaine not to teache othervviſe,
label: 1 Timothy

text: nor to attend to fables and genealogies hauing no ende: vvhich miniſter queſtions rather then the edifying of God vvhich is in faith.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But the ende of the precept is charitie from a pure hart, and a good conſcience, and a faith not feined.
label: 1 Timothy

text: From the vvhich things certaine ſtraying, are turned into vaine talke,
label: 1 Timothy

text: deſirous to be doctors of the Lavv, not vnderſtanding neither vvhat things they ſpeake, nor of vvhat they affirme.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But vve know that the Lavv is good, if a man vſe it lavvfully:
label: 1 Timothy

text: knovving this that the Lavv is not made to the iuſt man, but to the vniuſt and diſobedient, to the impious and ſinners, to the vvicked and contaminate, to killers of fathers and killers of mothers, to murderers,
label: 1 Timothy

text: to fornicatours, to lyers vvith man-kinde, to man-ſtealers, to liers, to periured perſons, and vvhat other thing ſoeuer is contrarie to ſound doctrine,
label: 1 Timothy

text: vvhich is according to the Goſpel of the glorie of the bleſſed God, vvhich is committed to me.
label: 1 Timothy

text: I giue him thankes vvhich hath ſtrengthened me, Chriſt IESVS our Lord, becauſe he hath eſteemed me faithful, putting me in the miniſterie.
label: 1 Timothy

text: vvho before vvas blaſphemous and a perſecutor & contumelious. but I obteined the mercie of God, becauſe I did it being ignorant in incredulitie.
label: 1 Timothy

text: And the grace of our Lord ouer-abounded vvith faith and loue, vvhich is in Chriſt IESVS.
label: 1 Timothy

text: A faithful ſaying, & vvorthie of al acceptatiō, that Chriſt IESVS came into this vvorld to ſaue ſinners, of vvhom I am the cheefe.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But therfore haue I obtained mercie: that in me firſt of al Chriſt IESVS might ſhevv al patience, to the information of them that ſhal beleeue on him vnto life euerlaſting.
label: 1 Timothy

text: And to the king of the vvorldes, immortal, inuiſible, onely God, honour & glorie for euer and euer. Amen.
label: 1 Timothy

text: This precept I commend to thee ô Timothee: according to the prophecies going before on thee, that thou warre in them a good vvarfare,
label: 1 Timothy

text: hauing faith and a good conſcience, vvhich certaine repelling, haue made ſhipvvracke about the faith.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Of vvhom is Hymenæus & Alexander: vvhom I haue deliuered to Satan, that they may learne not to blaſpheme.
label: 1 Timothy

text: I Deſire therfore firſt of al things that obſecrations, praiers, poſtulations, thankeſgeuings be made for al men,
label: 1 Timothy

text: for kings and al that are in preeminence: that vve may leade a quiet and a peaceable life in al pietie and chaſtitie.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For this is good and acceptable before our Sauiour God,
label: 1 Timothy

text: vvho vvill al men to be ſaued, and to come to the knovvledge of the truth,
label: 1 Timothy

text: For there is one God, one alſo mediatour of God and men, man Chriſt IESVS:
label: 1 Timothy

text: vvho gaue himſelf a redemption for al, vvhoſe teſtimonie in due times is confirmed:
label: 1 Timothy

text: vvherein I am appointed a preacher & an Apoſtle (I ſay the truth, I lie not) doctor of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
label: 1 Timothy

text: I vvil therfore that men pray in euery place: lifting vp pure handes, vvithout anger and altercation.
label: 1 Timothy

text: In like maner vvomen alſo in comely attire: vvith demureneſſe and ſobrietie adorning them ſelues, not in plaited heare, or gold, or pretious ſtones, or gorgeous apparel,
label: 1 Timothy

text: but that vvhich becommeth vvomen profeſſing pietie by good vvorkes.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Let a vvoman learne in ſilence, vvith al ſubiection.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But to teach I permit not vnto a vvoman, nor to haue dominion ouer the man: but to be in ſilence.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For Adam vvas formed firſt: then Eue.
label: 1 Timothy

text: and Adam vvas not ſeduced: but the vvoman being ſeduced, vvas in preuarication.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Yet ſhe ſhal be ſaued by generation of children: if 'they' continue in faith & loue and ſanctification vvith ſobrietie.
label: 1 Timothy

text: A Faithful ſaying. If a man deſire a Biſhops office, he deſireth a good worke.
label: 1 Timothy

text: It behoueth therfore a Biſhop to be irreprehenſible, the huſband of one vvife, ſobre, vviſe, comely, chaſt, a man of hoſpitalitie, a teacher,
label: 1 Timothy

text: not giuen to vvine, no fighter, but modeſt, no quareler, not couetous,
label: 1 Timothy

text: vvel ruling his ovvne houſe, hauing his children ſubiect vvith al chaſtitie.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But if a man knovv not to rule his ovvne houſe: hovv ſhal he haue care of the Church of God?
label: 1 Timothy

text: Not a neophyte: leſt puffed into pride, he fall into the iudgment of the Deuil.
label: 1 Timothy

text: And he muſt haue alſo good teſtimonie of them that are vvithout: that he fall not into reproch and the ſnare of the Deuil.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Deacons in like maner cchaſt, not double-tonged, not giuen to much vvine, not folovvers of filthie lucre:
label: 1 Timothy

text: hauing the myſterie of faith in a pure conſcience.
label: 1 Timothy

text: And let theſe alſo be proued firſt: & ſo let them miniſter, hauing no crime.
label: 1 Timothy

text: The vvomen in like maner chaſt, not detracting, ſober, faithful in al things.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Let deacons be the huſbandes of one vvife: vvhich rule vvel their children, & their houſes.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For they that haue miniſtred vvel, ſhal purchaſe to them ſelues a good degree, and much confidence in the faith vvhich is in Chriſt IESVS.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Theſe things I vvrite to thee, hoping that I ſhal come to thee quickly.
label: 1 Timothy

text: but if I tary long, that thou maieſt knovv how thou oughteſt to conuerſe in the houſe of God, which is the CHVRCH of the liuing God, the piller and ground of truth.
label: 1 Timothy

text: And manifeſtly it is a great ſacrament of pietie, vvhich vvas manifeſted in fleſh, vvas iuſtified in ſpirit, appeared to Angels, hath beene preached to gentils, is beleeued in the world, is aſſumpted in glorie.
label: 1 Timothy

text: AND the Spirit manifeſtly ſaith that in the laſt times certain ſhal depart from the faith attending to ſpirites of errour, and doctrines of diuels,
label: 1 Timothy

text: ſpeaking lies in hypocriſie, and hauing their conſcience ſeared,
label: 1 Timothy

text: forbidding to marie, to abſtaine from meates vvhich God created to receaue vvith thankes-giuing for the faithful, and them that haue knovven the truth.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For euery creature of God is good, and nothing to be reiected that is receiued vvith thankes-giuing.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For it is ſanctified by the vvord of God and praier.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Theſe things propoſing to the brethren, thou ſhalt be a good miniſter of Chriſt IESVS, nouriſhed in the vvordes of the faith and the good doctrine vvhich thou haſt attained vnto.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But foliſh and old vviues fables auoid: and exerciſe thy ſelf to pietie.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For corporal exerciſe is profitable to litle: but pietie is profitable to al things: hauing promiſſe of the life that novv is, and of that to come.
label: 1 Timothy

text: A faithful ſaying and vvorthie of al acceptation.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For to this purpoſe vve labour and are reuiled, becauſe vve hope in the liuing God vvhich is the Sauiour of al men, eſpecially of the faithful.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Commaund theſe things and teach.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Let no man contemne thy youth: but be an example of the faithful, in vvord, in conuerſation, in charitie, in faith, in chaſtitie.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Til I come, attend vnto reading, exhortation, doctrine.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Neglect not the grace that is in thee: vvhich is giuen thee by prophecie, vvith impoſition of the handes of prieſthod.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Theſe things doe thou meditate, be in theſe things: that thy profiting may be manifeſt to al.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Attend to thy ſelf, and to doctrine: be earneſt in them. For, this doing, thou ſhalt ſaue both thy ſelf and them that heare thee.
label: 1 Timothy

text: A Seniour rebuke not: but beſeeche as a father: yong men, as brethren:
label: 1 Timothy

text: old vvomen, as mothers: yong vvomen, as ſiſters, in al chaſtitie.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Honour vvidovves: vvhich are vvidovves in deede.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But if any vvidovv haue children or nephevves: let her learne firſt to rule her ovvne houſe, and to render mutual dutie to her parents. for this is acceptable before God.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But ſhe that iſ a vvidovv in deede and deſolate: let her hope in God, and continue in obſecrations & praiers night and day.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For ſhe that is in deliciouſenes, liuing is dead.
label: 1 Timothy

text: And this commaund that they be blamleſſe.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But if any man haue not care of his ovvne, and eſpecially of his domeſticals, he hath denied the faith, and is vvorſe then an infidel.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Let a vvidovv be choſen of no leſſe thē three ſcore yeres, vvhich hath been the vvife of one huſband,
label: 1 Timothy

text: hauing teſtimonie in good vvorkes, if ſhe haue brought vp her children, if ſhe haue receiued to harbour, if ſhe haue vvaſhed the Saincts feete, if ſhe haue miniſtred to them that ſuffer tribulation, if ſhe haue folovved euery good vvorke. ⊢
label: 1 Timothy

text: But the yonger vvidovves auoid. For vvhen they ſhal be vvanton in Chriſt, they vvil marie:
label: 1 Timothy

text: hauing damnation, becauſe they haue made void their firſt faith.
label: 1 Timothy

text: and vvithal idle alſo they learne to goe about from houſe to houſe: not only idle, but alſo ful of vvordes and curious, ſpeaking things vvhich they ought not.
label: 1 Timothy

text: I vvil therfore the yonger to marie, to bring forth children, to be houſevviues: to giue no occaſion to the aduerſarie for to ſpeake euil.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For novv certaine are turned backe after Satan.
label: 1 Timothy

text: If any faithful man haue vvidovves, let him miniſter to them, and let not the Church be burdened: that there may be ſufficient for them that are vvidovves in deede.
label: 1 Timothy

text: The prieſtes that rule vvel, let them be eſteemed vvorthie of double honour: eſpecially they that labour in the vvord and doctrine.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For the Scripture ſaith: Thou ſhalt not mooſel the mouth to the oxe that treadeth out the corne and, The vvorke man is vvorthie of his hire.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Againſt a prieſt receiue not accuſation: but vnder tvvo or three vvitneſſes.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Them that ſinne, reproue before al: that the reſt alſo may haue feare.
label: 1 Timothy

text: I teſtifie before God and Chriſt IESVS, and the elect Angels, that thou keepe theſe things vvithout preiudice, doing nothing by declining to the one part.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Impoſe hādes on no man lightly, neither do thou communicate vvith other mens ſinnes. Keepe thy ſelf chaſt.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Drinke not yet vvater: but vſe a litle vvine for thy ſtomake, and thy often infirmities.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Certaine mens ſinnes be manifeſt, going before to iudgement: and certaine men they folovv.
label: 1 Timothy

text: In like maner alſo good deedes be manifeſt, & they that are othervviſe, can not be hidde.
label: 1 Timothy

text: WHOSOEVER are ſeruantes vnder yoke, let them counte their maiſters vvorthie of al honour: leſt the name of our Lord and his doctrine be blaſphemed.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But they that haue faithful maiſters, let them not contemne them becauſe they are brethren, but ſerue the rather, becauſe they be faithful and beloued, vvhich are partakers of the benefite. Theſe things teache and exhort.
label: 1 Timothy

text: If any man teach othervviſe, and conſent not to the ſound vvordes of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, and to that doctrine vvhich is according to pietie:
label: 1 Timothy

text: he is proude, knovving nothing, but languiſhing about queſtions and ſtrife of vvordes: of vvhich riſe enuies, contentions, blaſphemies, euil ſuſpicions,
label: 1 Timothy

text: conflictes of men corrupted in their minde, and that are depriued of the truth, that eſteeme gaine to be pietie.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But bpietie vvith ſufficiencie is great gaine.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For vve brought nothing into this vvorld: doubtleſſe, neither can vve take avvay any thing.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But hauing foode, and vvhervvith to be couered, vvith theſe vve are content.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For they that vvil be made riche, fall into tentation & the ſnare of the deuil, & many deſires vnprofitable and hurteful, vvhich drovvne men into deſtruction and perdition.
label: 1 Timothy

text: For the roote of al euils is couetouſenes: vvhich certaine deſiring haue erred from the faith, and haue intangled them ſelues in many ſorovves.
label: 1 Timothy

text: But thou, ô man of God, flee theſe things: and purſue iuſtice, pietie, faith, charitie, patience, mildenes.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Fight the good fight of faith: apprehend eternal life, ⊢ vvherein thou art called and haſt confeſſed a good confeſſion before many vvitneſſes.
label: 1 Timothy

text: I commaund thee before God vvho quickeneth al things, and Chirſt IESVS vvho gaue teſtimonie vnder Pontius Pilate a good confeſſion:
label: 1 Timothy

text: that thou keepe the commaundement vvithout ſpotte, blameleſſe vnto the comming of our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: 1 Timothy

text: vvhich in due times the Bleſſed & onely Mightie vvil ſhevv, the King of kings and Lord of lordes,
label: 1 Timothy

text: vvho only hath immortalitie, and inhabiteth light not acceſſible, vvhom no man hath ſeen, yea neither can ſee, to vvhom be honour and empire euerlaſting. Amen. ⊢
label: 1 Timothy

text: Commaund the riche of this vvorld not to be high minded, nor to truſt in the vncertaintie of riches, but in the liuing God (vvho giueth vs al things aboundantly to enioy)
label: 1 Timothy

text: to doe wel, to become riche in good workes, to giue eaſily, to communicate,
label: 1 Timothy

text: to heape vnto them ſelues a good foūdation for the time to come, that they may apprehend the true life.
label: 1 Timothy

text: O Timothee, keepe the depoſitum, auoiding the profane cnouelties of voices, & oppoſitions of falſely called knovvledge.
label: 1 Timothy

text: Vvhich certaine promiſing, haue erred about the faith. Grace be vvith thee. Amen.
label: 1 Timothy

text: PAVL an Apoſtle of IESVS Chriſt by the vvil of God, according to the promiſſe of the life which is in Chriſt IESVS:
label: 2 Timothy

text: to Timothee my deereſt ſonne, grace, mercie, peace from God the father, and Chriſt IESVS our Lord.
label: 2 Timothy

text: I giue thankes to God, vvhom I ſerue from my progenitours in a pure conſcience, that vvithout intermiſſion I haue a memorie of thee in my praiers, night and day
label: 2 Timothy

text: deſiring to ſee thee, mindeful of thy teares, that I may be filled vvith ioy,
label: 2 Timothy

text: calling to minde that faith vvhich is in thee not feined, vvhich alſo dvvelt firſt in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice, and I am ſure that in thee alſo.
label: 2 Timothy

text: For the vvhich cauſe I admoniſh thee that thou reſuſcitate the grace of God, vvhich is in thee by the impoſition of my handes.
label: 2 Timothy

text: For God hath not giuen vs the ſpirit of feare: but of povver, and loue, and ſobrietie.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Be not therfore aſhamed of the teſtimonie of our Lord, nor of me his priſoner: but trauail vvith the Goſpel according to the povver of God,
label: 2 Timothy

text: vvho hath deliuered and called vs by his holy calling, not according to our vvorkes, but according to his purpoſe and grace, vvhich vvas giuen to vs in Chriſt IESVS before the ſecular times.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But it is manifeſted novv by the illumination of our Sauiour IESVS Chriſt, vvho hath deſtroied death, & illuminated life and incorruption by the Goſpel:
label: 2 Timothy

text: vvherein I am appointed a preacher and Apoſtle and Maiſter of the Gentiles.
label: 2 Timothy

text: For the vvhich cauſe alſo I ſuffer theſe things: but I am not cõfounded. For I know whom I haue beleeued, & I am ſure that he is able to keepe my depoſitum vnto that day.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Haue thou a forme of ſound vvordes, vvhich thou haſt heard of me in faith & in the loue in Chriſt IESVS.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Keepe the good depoſitum by the holy Ghoſt, vvhich dvvelleth in vs.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Thou knovveſt this, that al vvhich are in Aſia, be auerted from me: of vvhom is Phigelus and Hermogenes.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Our Lord giue mercie to the houſe of Oneſiphorus: becauſe he hath often refreſhed me, and hath not been aſhamed of my chaine.
label: 2 Timothy

text: but vvhen he vvas come to Rome: he ſought me carefully, and found me.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Our Lord graunt him to finde mercie of our Lord in that day. And how many things he miniſtred to me at Epheſus, thou knovveſt better.
label: 2 Timothy

text: THOV therfore my ſonne, be ſtrong in the grace vvhich is in Chriſt IESVS:
label: 2 Timothy

text: & the things vvhich thou haſt heard of me by many vvitneſſes, theſe cōmend to faithful men, vvhich ſhal be fit to teach others alſo.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Labour thou as a good ſouldiar of Chriſt IESVS.
label: 2 Timothy

text: No man being a ſouldiar to God, intãgleth him ſelf vvith ſecular buſineſſes: that he may pleaſe him to vvhom he hath approued him ſelf.
label: 2 Timothy

text: For he alſo that ſtriueth for the maiſterie, is not crovvned vnleſſe he ſtriue lavvfully.
label: 2 Timothy

text: The huſbandman that laboureth, muſt firſt take of the fruites.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Vnderſtand vvhat I ſay: for our Lord vvil giue thee in al things vnderſtanding.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Be mindeful that our Lord IESVS Chriſt is riſen againe from the dead, of the ſeede of Dauid, according to my Goſpel,
label: 2 Timothy

text: vvherein I labour euen vnto bandes, as a malefactour: but the vvord of God is not tied.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Therfore I ſuſtaine al things for the elect, that they alſo may obtaine the ſaluation, vvhich is in Chriſt IESVS, vvith heauenly glorie.
label: 2 Timothy

text: A faithful ſaying. For if vve be dead vvith him, vve ſhal liue alſo together.
label: 2 Timothy

text: If vve ſhal ſuſtaine, vve ſhal alſo reigne together. If vve ſhal deny, he alſo vvil denie vs.
label: 2 Timothy

text: If vve beleeue not: he continueth faithful, he can not denie him ſelf.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Theſe things admoniſh: teſtifying before our Lord. Contend not in vvordes, for it is profitable for nothing, but for the ſubuerſion of them that heare.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Carefully prouide to preſent thy ſelf approued to God, a vvorkeman not to be confounded, rightly handling the vvord of truth.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But cprofane and vaine ſpeaches auoid: for they doe much grovv to impietie:
label: 2 Timothy

text: & their ſpeache ſpreadeth as a canker: of vvhom is Hymenæus and Philetus:
label: 2 Timothy

text: vvho haue erred from the truth, ſaying that the reſurrection is done already, and haue ſubuerted the faith of ſome.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But the ſure foundation of God ſtandeth, hauing this ſeale, Our Lord knovveth, vvho be his, and let euery one depart from iniquitie that nameth the name of our Lord.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But in a great houſe there are not only veſſels of gold and of ſiluer, but alſo of vvood and of earth: and certaine in deede vnto honour, but certaine vnto contumelie.
label: 2 Timothy

text: If any man therfore ſhal cleanſe him ſelf from theſe, he ſhal be a veſſel vnto honour, ſanctified & profitable to our Lord, prepared to euery good vvorke.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But youthful deſires flee: and purſue iuſtice, faith, charitie, & peace vvith them that inuocate our Lord from a pure hart.
label: 2 Timothy

text: And fooliſh and vnlearned queſtiõs auoid, knovving that they ingender braules.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But the ſeruant of our Lord muſt not vvrangle: but be milde tovvard al men, apt to teache, patient,
label: 2 Timothy

text: vvith modeſtie admoniſhing them that reſiſt the truth: leſt ſometime God giue them repentance to knovv the truth:
label: 2 Timothy

text: and they recouer them ſelues from the ſnares of the deuil, of vvhom they are held captiue at his vvil.
label: 2 Timothy

text: AND this knovv thou, that in the laſt daies ſhal approche perilous times.
label: 2 Timothy

text: and men ſhal be louers of them ſelues, couetous, hautie, proud, blaſphemous, not obedient to their parents, vnkinde, vvicked,
label: 2 Timothy

text: vvithout affection, vvithout peace, accuſers, incontinent, vnmerciful, vvithout benignitie,
label: 2 Timothy

text: traitours, ſtubburne, puffed vp, and louers of voluptuouſnes more then of God:
label: 2 Timothy

text: hauing an appearance in deede of pietie, but denying the vertue thereof. And theſe auoid.
label: 2 Timothy

text: For of theſe be they that craftely enter into houſes: and leade captiue ſeely vvomen loden vvith ſinnes, vvhich are ledde vvith diuers deſires:
label: 2 Timothy

text: alvvaies learning, and neuer attaining to the knovvledge of the truth.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But as Iannes & Mambres reſiſted Moyſes, ſo theſe alſo reſiſt the truth, men corrupted in minde, reprobate cõcerning the faith.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But they ſhal proſper no further: for their folly ſhal be manifeſt to al, as theirs alſo vvas.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But thou haſt attained to my doctrine, inſtitution, purpoſe, faith, longanimitie, loue, patience,
label: 2 Timothy

text: perſecutions, paſſions: vvhat maner of things vvere done to me at Antioche, at Iconium, at Lyſtra: vvhat maner of perſecutiõs I ſuſtained. and out of al our Lord deliuered me.
label: 2 Timothy

text: And al that vvil liue godly in Chriſt IESVS, ſhal ſuffer perſecution.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But euil men and ſeducers ſhal proſper to the vvorſe: erring, and driuing into errour.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But thou, continue in thoſe things vvhich thou haſt learned, and are committed to thee: knovving of vvhom thou haſt learned:
label: 2 Timothy

text: and becauſe from thine infancie thou haſt knovven the holy Scriptures, vvhich can inſtruct thee to ſaluation, by the faith that is in Chriſt IESVS.
label: 2 Timothy

text: All Scripture inſpired of God, is profitable to teach, to argue, to correct, to inſtruct in iuſtice:
label: 2 Timothy

text: that the man of God may be perfect, inſtructed to euery good vvorke.
label: 2 Timothy

text: I Teſtifie before God and IESVS Chriſt vvho ſhal iudge the liuing and the dead, and by his aduent, and his kingdom:
label: 2 Timothy

text: Preach the vvord. vrge in ſeaſon, out of ſeaſon, reproue, beſeeche, rebuke in al patience and doctrine.
label: 2 Timothy

text: For there ſhal be a time vvhen they vvil not beare ſound doctrine: but according to their ovvne deſires they vvil heape to them ſelues maiſters, hauing itching eares,
label: 2 Timothy

text: and from the truth certes they vvil auert their hearing, and to fables they vvil be conuerted.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But be thou vigilant, labour in al things, doe the vvorke of an Euangeliſt, fulfil thy miniſterie. Be ſober.
label: 2 Timothy

text: For I am euen novv to be ſacrificed: & the time of my reſolutiõ is at hand.
label: 2 Timothy

text: I haue fought a good fight, I haue conſummate my courſe, I haue kept the faith.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Concerning the reſt, there is laid vp for me a crovvne of iuſtice, vvhich our Lord vvil render to me in that day, a iuſt iudge: and not only to me, but to them alſo that loue his comming. ⊢
label: 2 Timothy

text: Make haſt to come to me quickly.
label: 2 Timothy

text: For Demas hath left me, louing this vvorld, and is gone to Theſſalonica: Creſcens into Galatia, Titus into Dalmatia.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Luke only is vvith me. Take Marke, and bring him vvith thee: for he is profitable to me for the miniſterie.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But Tychicus I haue ſent to Epheſus.
label: 2 Timothy

text: The cloke that I left at Troas vvith Carpus, cõming bring vvith thee, and the bookes, eſpecially the parchement.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Alexander the Copperſmith hath ſhevved me much euil, our Lord vvil revvard him according to his vvorkes:
label: 2 Timothy

text: vvhom doe thou alſo auoid, for he hath greatly reſiſted our vvordes.
label: 2 Timothy

text: In my firſt anſvver no man vvas with me, but al did forſake me: be it not imputed to them.
label: 2 Timothy

text: But our Lord ſtoode to me, and ſtrengthened me, that by me the preaching may be accompliſhed, and al Gentiles may heare: and I was deliuered from the mouth of the lion.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Our Lord ‘hath deliuered’ me from al euil vvorke: and vvil ſaue me vnto his heauenly kingdom. to vvhom be glorie for euer & euer. Amen.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Salute Priſca and Aquila, and the houſe of Oneſiphorus.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Eraſtus remained at Corinth. And Trophimus I left ſicke at Miletum.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Make haſt to come before vvinter. Eubulus and Pudens and Linus and Claudia, and al the brethren, ſalute thee.
label: 2 Timothy

text: Our Lord IESVS Chriſt be vvith thy ſpirit. Grace be vvith you. Amen.
label: 2 Timothy

text: PAVL the ſeruant of God, and an Apoſtle of IESVS Chriſt according to the faith of the elect of God and knowledge of the truth: vvhich is according to pietie
label: Titus

text: into the hope of life euerlaſting, vvhich he promiſed that lieth not, God, before the ſecular times:
label: Titus

text: but hath manifeſted in due times his vvord in preaching, vvhich is committed to me according to the precept of our Sauiour God:
label: Titus

text: to Titus my beloued ſonne according to the common faith, grace and peace from God the father, and Chriſt IESVS our Sauiour.
label: Titus

text: For this cauſe left I thee in Crete, that thou ſhouldeſt reforme the things that are vvanting, and ſhouldeſt ordaine prieſtes by cities, as I alſo appointed thee:
label: Titus

text: if any be vvithout crime, the huſband of one vvife, hauing faithful children, not in the accuſation of riote, or not obedient.
label: Titus

text: For a Biſhop muſt be vvithout crime, as the ſtevvard of God: not proud, not angrie, not giuen to vvine, no ſtriker, not couetous of filthy lucre:
label: Titus

text: but giuen to hoſpitalitie, gentle, ſober, iuſt, holy, continent:
label: Titus

text: embracing that faithful vvord vvhich is according to doctrine, that he may be able to exhort in ſound doctrine, & to reproue them that gaineſay it.
label: Titus

text: For there be many diſobedient, vaine-ſpeakers, and ſeducers, eſpecially they that are of the Circumciſion.
label: Titus

text: vvho muſt be controuled. vvho ſubuert vvhole houſes, teaching the things they ought not, for filthie lucre.
label: Titus

text: One of them ſaid, their ovvne proper prophete, The Cretenſians alvvaies liers, naughtie beaſtes, ſlouthful bellies.
label: Titus

text: This teſtimonie is true. For the vvhich cauſe rebuke them ſharpely, that they may be ſound in the faith,
label: Titus

text: not attending to Ievviſh fables, and commaundements of men auerting them ſelues from the truth.
label: Titus

text: Al things are cleane to the cleane: but to the polluted and to infidels nothing is cleane: but polluted are both their minde and conſcience.
label: Titus

text: They confeſſe that they knovv God: but in their vvorkes they deny, vvhereas they be abominable and incredulous and to euery good vvorke reprobate.
label: Titus

text: BVT doe thou ſpeake the things that become ſound doctrine.
label: Titus

text: Old men that they be ſober, cchaſt, vviſe, ſound in the faith, in loue, in patience.
label: Titus

text: Old women in like maner, in holy attire, not il ſpeakers, not giuen to much wine: teaching vvel,
label: Titus

text: that they may teach the yong women vviſedom, to loue their huſbands, to loue their children,
label: Titus

text: vviſe, chaſt, ſober, hauing a care of the houſe, gentle, ſubiect to their huſbandes, that the vvord of God be not blaſphemed.
label: Titus

text: Yong men in like maner exhort that they be ſober.
label: Titus

text: In al things ſhevv thy ſelf an example of good vvorkes, in doctrine, in integritie, in grauitie,
label: Titus

text: the vvord ſound, irreprehenſible: that he vvhich is on the contrarie part, may be afraid, hauing no euil to ſay of vs.
label: Titus

text: Seruants to be ſubiect to their maiſters, in al things pleaſing, not gainſaying:
label: Titus

text: not defrauding, but in al things ſhewing good faith, that they may adorne the doctrine of our Sauiour God in al things.
label: Titus

text: For the grace of God our Sauiour hath appeared to al men:
label: Titus

text: inſtructing vs that denying impietie & worldly deſires, vve liue ſoberly, and iuſtly, and godly in this vvorld,
label: Titus

text: expecting the bleſſed hope and caduent of the glorie of the great God and our Sauiour IESVS Chriſt,
label: Titus

text: vvho gaue him ſelf for vs, that he might redeeme vs from al iniquitie, and might cleanſe to him ſelf a people acceptable, a purſuer of good vvorkes.
label: Titus

text: Theſe things ſpeake, and exhort ⊢ and rebuke vvith al authoritie. Let no man contemne thee.
label: Titus

text: ADMONISH them to be ſubiect to Princes and Poteſtates, to obey at a vvord, to be ready to euery good vvorke,
label: Titus

text: to blaſpheme no man, not to be litigious, but modeſt: ſhevving al mildenes tovvard al men.
label: Titus

text: for we alſo vvere ſometime vnwiſe, incredulous, erring, ſeruing diuerſe deſires & voluptuouſneſſes, liuing in malice & enuie, odible, hating one an other.
label: Titus

text: But when the benignitie and ckindnes tovvard man of our Sauiour God appeared:
label: Titus

text: not by the vvorkes of iuſtice vvhich vve did, but according to his mercie he hath ſaued vs by the lauer of regeneratiō and renouation of the holy Ghoſt,
label: Titus

text: vvhom he hath povvred vpon vs aboundantly by IESVS Chriſt our Sauiour:
label: Titus

text: that being iuſtified by his grace, vve may be heires according to hope of life euerlaſting. ⊢
label: Titus

text: It is a faithful ſaying, and of theſe things I vvil haue thee auouch earneſtly: that they vvhich beleeue in God, be careful to excell in good vvorkes. Theſe things be good and profitable for men.
label: Titus

text: But fooliſh queſtions, and genealogies, and contentions, and controuerſies of the Lavv auoid. For they are vnprofitable and vaine.
label: Titus

text: A man that is an heretike after the firſt and ſecond admonition auoid:
label: Titus

text: knovving that he that is ſuch an one, is ſubuerted, and ſinneth, being condemned by his ovvne iudgement.
label: Titus

text: VVhen I ſhal ſend to thee Artemas or Tychicus, haſten to come vnto me to Nicopolis. for there I haue determined to vvinter.
label: Titus

text: Set forvvard Zenas the lavvyer and Apollos carefully, that nothing be vvanting to them.
label: Titus

text: And let our men alſo learne to excel in good vvorkes to neceſſarie vſes: that they be not vnfruiteful.
label: Titus

text: Al that are vvith me, ſalute thee: ſalute them that loue vs in the faith. The grace of God be vvith you al. Amen.
label: Titus

text: PAVL the priſoner of Chriſt IESVS, and brother Timothee: to Philémon the beloued and our coadiutor,
label: Philemon

text: & to Appia our deereſt ſiſter, & to Archippus our felovv-ſouldiar and to the church vvhich is in thy houſe.
label: Philemon

text: Grace to you and peace from God our father, and our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: Philemon

text: I giue thankes to my God, alvvaies making a memorie of thee in my praiers,
label: Philemon

text: hearing thy charitie and faith vvhich thou haſt in our Lord IESVS, and tovvard al the ſainctes:
label: Philemon

text: that the communication of thy faith may be made euident in the agnition of al good that is in you in Chriſt IESVS.
label: Philemon

text: For I haue had great ioy and conſolation in thy charitie, becauſe the bovvels of the ſainctes haue reſted by thee brother.
label: Philemon

text: For the vvhich thing hauing great confidence in Chriſt IESVS to commaund thee that vvhich pertaineth to the purpoſe:
label: Philemon

text: for charitie rather I beſeeche, vvhereas thou art ſuch an one, as Paul being old and novv priſoner alſo of IESVS Chriſt.
label: Philemon

text: I beſeeche thee for my ſonne vvhom I haue begotten in bandes, Oneſimus,
label: Philemon

text: vvho hath been ſometime vnprofitable to thee, but novv profitable both to me & thee,
label: Philemon

text: vvhom I haue ſent backe to thee. And do thou receiue him as mine ovvne bovvels.
label: Philemon

text: vvhom I would haue reteined vvith me, that for thee he might miniſter to me in the bandes of the Goſpel:
label: Philemon

text: but vvithout thy counſel I vvould doe nothing: that thy good might be not as it vvere of neceſſitie, but voluntarie.
label: Philemon

text: For perhaps therfore he departed for a ſeaſon from thee, that thou mighteſt take him againe for euer.
label: Philemon

text: novv not as a ſeruant, but for a ſeruant, a moſt deere brother, eſpecially to me, but hovv much more to thee both in the fleſh and in our Lord?
label: Philemon

text: If therfore thou take me for thy fellovv: receiue him as my ſelf.
label: Philemon

text: And if he hath hurt thee any thing or is in thy dette, that impute to me.
label: Philemon

text: I Paul haue vvritten vvith mine ovvne hand: I vvil repay it: not to ſay to thee, that thou ovveſt me thine ovvne ſelf alſo.
label: Philemon

text: Yea brother. God graunt I may enioy thee in our Lord. Refreſh my bovvels in our Lord.
label: Philemon

text: Truſting in thy obedience I haue vvritten to thee, knovving that thou vvilt doe aboue that alſo vvhich I do ſay.
label: Philemon

text: And withal prouide me alſo a lodging. for I hope by your praiers that I ſhal be giuen to you.
label: Philemon

text: There ſalute thee Epaphras my fellovv-priſoner in Chriſt IESVS,
label: Philemon

text: Marke, Ariſtarchus, Demas and Luke my coadiutors.
label: Philemon

text: The grace of our Lord IESVS Chriſt be with your ſpirit. Amen,
label: Philemon

text: DIVERSELY and many vvaies in times paſt God ſpeaking to the fathers in the prophets:
label: Hebrews

text: laſt of al in theſe daies hath ſpoken to vs in his Sonne, vvhom he hath appointed heire of al, by vvhom he made alſo the vvorldes.
label: Hebrews

text: Vvho being the cbrightneſſe of his glorie, and the bfigure of his ſubſtance, & carying al things by the vvord of his povver, making purgation of ſinnes, ſitteth on the right hand of the Maieſtie in the high places:
label: Hebrews

text: being made ſo much better then Angels, as he hath inherited a more excellent name aboue them.
label: Hebrews

label: Hebrews

text: Thou haſt loued iuſtice, and hated iniquitie: therfore thee, God, thy God hath anointed vvith the oile of exultation aboue thy fellovves.

text: And, Thou in the beginning ô Lord didſt found the earth: and the vvorkes of thy handes are the heauens.

text: They ſhal periſh, but thou ſhalt continue: and they ſhal al vvaxe old as a garment.
label: Hebrews

text: And as a veſture ſhalt thou chaunge them, and they ſhal be changed: but thou art the ſelf ſame, and thy yeres ſhal not faile. ⊢

label: Hebrews

text: THERFORE more aboundantly ought vve to obſerue thoſe things vvhich vve haue heard: leſt perhaps vve runne out.
label: Hebrews

text: For if the vvord that vvas ſpoken by Angels, became ſure, and al preuarication and diſobedience hath receiued a iuſt retribution of revvard:

text: God vvithal teſtifying by ſignes, & vvonders, and diuers miracles, & diſtributions of the holy Ghoſt according to his vvil.
label: Hebrews

text: For not to Angels hath God made ſubiect the world to come, whereof vve ſpeake.
label: Hebrews

label: Hebrews

text: Al things haſt thou made ſubiect vnder his feete. For in that he ſubiected al things to him, he left nothing not ſubiect to him. But novv vve ſee not as yet al things ſubiected to him.

text: But him that vvas a litle leſſened vnder the Angels, vve ſee IESVS, becauſe of the paſſion of death, crovvned with glorie and honour: that through the grace of God he might taſt death for al.
label: Hebrews

text: For it became him for vvhom al things, and by vvhom al things, that had brought many children into glorie, to conſummate the author of their ſaluation, by his paſſion.

text: For he that ſanctifieth, and they that be ſanctified: al of one. For the which cauſe he is not aſhamed to call them brethren,

text: ſaying, I vvil declare thy name to my brethren: in the middes of the Church wil I praiſe thee.

text: And againe, I vvil haue affiance in him. And againe, Behold here am I and my children: vvhom God hath giuen me.

label: Hebrews

text: And againe in this, If they ſhal enter into my reſt.
label: Hebrews

text: Becauſe then it remaineth that certaine enter into it, and they to vvhom firſt it vvas preached, did not enter becauſe of incredulitie:

text: For if Ieſus had giuen them reſt: he vvould neuer ſpeake of an other day aftervvard.

text: Therfore there is left a ſabbatiſme for the people of God.

text: For he that is entred into his reſt, the ſame alſo hath reſted from his vvorkes, as God from his.

text: For the vvord of God is liuely and forcible, and more perſing then any tvvo edged ſword: and reaching vnto the diuiſion of the ſoule and the ſpirit, of the ioyntes alſo and the marowes, and a diſcerner of the cogitations and intentes of the hart.

text: And there is no creature inuiſible in his ſight. but al things are naked and open to his eies, to vvhom our ſpeache is.

text: Hauing therfore a great high Prieſt that hath entred the heauens, IESVS the ſonne of God, let vs hold the confeſſion.

text: For we haue not a high prieſt that can not haue compaſſion on our infirmities: but tempted in al things by ſimilitude, except ſinne.

text: Let vs goe therfore vvith confidence to the throne of grace: that vve may obteine mercie, and finde grace in ſeaſonable aide.

text: FOR euery high Prieſt taken from among men, is appointed for men in thoſe things that pertaine to God: that he may offer giftes and ſacrifices for ſinnes:

text: that cā haue compaſſion on them that be ignorant and do erre: becauſe him ſelf alſo is compaſſed vvith infirmitie:
label: Hebrews

text: & therfore he ought, as for the people, ſo alſo for him ſelf to offer for ſinnes.
label: Hebrews

text: Neither doth any man take the honour to him ſelf, but he that is called of God, as Aaron. ⊢
label: Hebrews

text: So Chriſt alſo did not glorifie him ſelf that he might be made a high prieſt: but he that ſpake to him, My Sonne art thou, I this day haue begotten thee.
label: Hebrews

text: As alſo in an other place he ſaith, Thou art a prieſt for euer, according to the order of Melchiſedec. ⊢
label: Hebrews

text: VVho in the daies of his fleſh, vvith a ſtrong crie and teares, offering praiers and ſupplications to him that could ſaue him from death, vvas heard for his reuerence. ⊢
label: Hebrews

text: And truely vvhereas he was the Sonne, he learned by thoſe things vvhich he ſuffered, obedience:
label: Hebrews

text: and being conſummate, was made to al that obey him, cauſe of eternal ſaluation,
label: Hebrews

text: called of God a high prieſt according to the order of Melchiſedec.
label: Hebrews

text: Of vvhome vve haue great ſpeache and inexplicable to vtter: becauſe you are become vveake to heare.
label: Hebrews

text: For vvhereas you ought to be maiſters for your time, you neede to be taught againe your ſelues vvhat be the elements of the beginning of the vvordes of God: and you are become ſuch as haue neede of milke, & not of ſtrong meate.
label: Hebrews

text: For euery one that is partaker of milke, is vnſkilful of the vvord of iuſtice: for he is a childe.
label: Hebrews

text: But ſtrong meate is for the perfect, them that by cuſtome haue their ſenſes exerciſed to the diſcerning of good & euil.
label: Hebrews

text: VVHERFORE intermitting the vvord of the beginning of Chriſt, let vs proceede to perfection, not againe laying the foundation of penance from dead vvorkes, and of faith tovvard God,

text: of the doctrine of baptiſmes, and of impoſition of handes, and of the reſurrection of the dead, and of eternal iudgement.
label: Hebrews

text: And this ſhal we doe, if God vvill permit.
label: Hebrews

text: For it is impoſſible for them that were once illuminated, haue taſted alſo the heauenly gift, and vvere made partakers of the holy Ghoſt,

text: haue moreouer taſted the good vvord of God, and the povvers of the world to come,
label: Hebrews

text: and are fallen: to be reneued againe to penance, crucifying againe to them ſelues the ſonne of God, and making him a mockerie.

text: For the earth drinking the raine often comming vpon it, & bringing forth graſſe commodious for them by vvhom it is tilled, receiueth bleſſing of God.

text: but bringing forth thornes and bryers, it is reprobate, and very neere a curſe, vvhoſe end is, to be burnt.
label: Hebrews

text: But vve confidently truſt of you, my beſt beloued, better things and neerer to ſaluation: although we ſpeake thus.
label: Hebrews

text: For God is not vniuſt, that he ſhould forget your vvorke & loue which you haue ſhevved in his name, vvhich haue miniſtred to the ſainctes and do miniſter.

text: And our deſire is that euery one of you ſhevv forth the ſame carefulneſſe to the accompliſhing of hope vnto the end:

label: Hebrews

text: And ſo patiently enduring he obtained the promiſe.
label: Hebrews

text: For men ſvveare by a greater then them ſelues: and the end of al their controuerſie, for the confirmation, is an othe.
label: Hebrews

text: VVherein God meaning more aboundantly to ſhevv to the heires of the promiſe the ſtabilitie of his counſel, he interpoſed an othe:

text: that by tvvo things vnmoueable, vvhereby it is impoſſible for God to lie, vve may haue a moſt ſtrong comfort. vvho haue fled to hold faſt the hope propoſed,

text: vvhich vve haue as an anker of the ſoule, ſure and firme, and going in into the inner partes of the vele,

text: vvhich hath not neceſſitie daily (as the prieſtes) firſt for his ovvne ſinnes to offer hoſtes, then for the peoples. for this he did once, in offering him ſelf. ⊢

text: BVT the ſumme concerning thoſe things vvhich be ſaid, is: VVe haue ſuch an high prieſt, vvho is ſette on the right hand of the ſeate of maieſtie in the heauens,

label: Hebrews

label: Hebrews

text: For if the bloud of goates and of oxen & the aſhes of an heifer being ſprinkled, ſanctifieth the polluted to the cleanſing of the fleſh:
label: Hebrews

text: hovv much more `hath' the bloud of Chriſt vvho by the holy Ghoſt offered him ſelf vnſpotted vnto God, `cleanſed' our conſcience from dead vvorkes, to ſerue the liuing God?
label: Hebrews

text: And therfore he is the mediatour of the nevv Teſtament: that death being a meane, vnto the redemption ″ of theſe preuarications vvhich vvere vnder the former teſtament, they that are called may receiue the promiſe of eternal inheritance. ⊢
label: Hebrews

text: For vvhere there is a teſtament: the death of the teſtatour muſt of neceſſitie come betvvene.
label: Hebrews

text: For a teſtament is confirmed in the dead: othervviſe it is yet of no value, vvhiles he that teſted, liueth.
label: Hebrews

text: Vvherevpon neither vvas the firſt certes dedicated vvithout bloud.
label: Hebrews

text: For al the commaundement of the Lavv being read of Moyſes to al the people: he taking the bloud of calues and goates vvith vvater and ſcarlet vvool and hyſſope, ſprinkled the very booke alſo it ſelf and al the people,
label: Hebrews

text: ſaying, ″ This is the bloud of the Teſtament, vvhich God hath commaunded vnto you.
label: Hebrews

text: The tabernacle alſo & al the veſſel of the miniſterie he in like maner ſprinkled with bloud.
label: Hebrews

text: And al things almoſt according to the lavv are cleanſed with bloud: and vvithout ſheading of bloud there is not remiſſion.
label: Hebrews

text: It is neceſſarie therfore that ″ the examplers of the cœleſtials be cleanſed vvith theſe: but the celeſtials them ſelues vvith better hoſtes then theſe.
