label: Hebrews

text: For IESVS is not entred into Holies made vvith hand, examplers of the true: but into heauen it ſelf, that he may appeare novv to the countenance of God for vs.
label: Hebrews

text: Nor that he ſhould ″ offer him ſelf often, as the high prieſt entereth into the Holies, euery yere in the bloud of others:
label: Hebrews

text: othervviſe he ought to haue ſuffered often from the beginning of the vvorld: but novv once in the conſummation of the vvorldes, to the deſtruction of ſinne, he hath appeared by his ovvne hoſt.
label: Hebrews

text: And as it is appointed to men to die once, and after this, the iudgement:
label: Hebrews

text: ſo alſo Chriſt vvas offered once to exhauſt the ſinnes of many. the ſecond time he ſhal appeare without ſinne to them that expect him, vnto ſaluation.
label: Hebrews

text: FOR the lavv hauing a ſhadovv of good things to come, not the very image of the things: euery yere vvith the ſelf ſame hoſtes which they offer inceſſantly, can neuer make the commers thereto perfect:
label: Hebrews

text: othervviſe they ſhould haue ceaſed to be offered, becauſe the vvorſhippers once cleanſed ſhould haue no conſcience of ſinne any longer.
label: Hebrews

text: but in them there is made a commemoration of ſinne euery yere.
label: Hebrews

text: for it is impoſſible that vvith the bloud of oxen and goates ſinnes ſhould be taken avvay.
label: Hebrews

text: Therfore comming into the vvorld he ſaith: Hoſt and oblation thou vvouldeſt not: but a body thou haſt fitted to me:
label: Hebrews

text: Holocauſtes and for ſinne did not pleaſe thee.
label: Hebrews

text: Then ſaid I, Behold I come: in the head of the booke it is vvritten of me: That I may doe thy vvil ô God.
label: Hebrews

text: Saying before, Becauſe hoſtes and oblations, & holocauſtes, & for ſinne thou vvouldeſt not, neither did they pleaſe thee, vvhich are offered according to the lavv,
label: Hebrews

text: then ſaid I, Behold I come that I may doe thy vvil ô God: he taketh avvay the firſt, that he may eſtabliſh that that folovveth.
label: Hebrews

text: In the vvhich vvil, vve are ſanctified by the oblation of the body of IESVS Chriſt once.
label: Hebrews

text: And euery prieſt in deede is ready daily miniſtring, and often offering the ſame hoſtes, vvhich can neuer take avvay ſinnes:
label: Hebrews

text: but this man offering one hoſt for ſinnes, for euer ſitteth on the right hand of God,
label: Hebrews

text: hence forth expecting, vntil his enemies be put the footeſtoole of his feete.
label: Hebrews

text: For by one oblation hath he conſummated for euer them that are ſanctified.
label: Hebrews

text: And the holy Ghoſt alſo doth teſtifie to vs. For after that he ſaid:
label: Hebrews

text: And this is the Teſtament vvhich I wil make to them after thoſe daies, ſaith our Lord, giuing my lavves in their hartes, & in their mindes vvil I ſuperſcribe them:
label: Hebrews

text: and their ſinnes and iniquities I wil now remember no more.
label: Hebrews

text: But vvhere there is remiſſion of theſe, novv there is not an oblation for ſinnes.
label: Hebrews

text: Hauing therfore brethren confidence in the entring of the holies in the bloud of Chriſt:
label: Hebrews

text: vvhich he hath cdedicated to vs a nevv and liuing vvay by the vele, that is, his fleſh,
label: Hebrews

text: and a high prieſt ouer the houſe of God,
label: Hebrews

text: let vs approche vvith a true hart in fulneſſe of faith, hauing our hartes ſprinkled from euil conſcience, and our body waſhed vvith cleane vvater,
label: Hebrews

text: let vs hold the confeſſion of our hope vndeclining (for he is faithful that hath promiſed)
label: Hebrews

text: and let vs conſider one an other vnto the prouocation of charitie and of good vvorkes:
label: Hebrews

text: not forſaking our aſſemblie as ſome are accuſtomed, but comforting, and ſo much the more as you ſee the day approching.
label: Hebrews

text: For if vve ſinne vvillingly after the knovvledge of the truth receiued, novv there is not left an hoſt for ſinnes,
label: Hebrews

text: but a certaine terrible expectation of iudgement and rage of fire, vvhich ſhal conſume the aduerſaries.
label: Hebrews

text: A man making the lavv of Moyſes fruſtrate: vvithout any mercie dieth vnder tvvo or three vvitneſſes.
label: Hebrews

text: how much more thinke you, doth he deſerue vvorſe puniſhements vvhich hath troden the ſonne of God vnder foote, and eſtemed the bloud of the teſtament polluted, vvherein he is ſanctified, and hath done contumelie to the ſpirit of grace?
label: Hebrews

text: For vve knovv him that ſaid, Reuenge to me, I wil repay. And againe, That our Lord vvil iudge his people.
label: Hebrews

text: It is horrible to fal into the handes of the liuing God.
label: Hebrews

text: But call to minde the old daies: vvherein being illuminated, you ſuſtained a great fight of paſſions.
label: Hebrews

text: and on the one part certes by reproches and tribulations made a ſpectacle: and on the other part made companions of them that conuerſed in ſuch ſort.
label: Hebrews

text: For, you both had compaſſion on them that vvere in bondes: and the ſpoile of your ovvne goodes you tooke vvith ioy, knovving that you haue a better and a permanent ſubſtance.
label: Hebrews

text: Do not therfore leeſe your confidence, vvhich hath a great remuneration.
label: Hebrews

text: For patience is neceſſarie for you: that doing the vvil of God, you may receiue the promiſe.
label: Hebrews

text: For yet a litle and a very litle vvhile, he that is to come, vvil come, and vvil not ſlacke.
label: Hebrews

text: and my iuſt liueth of faith. ⊢ but if he vvithdravv him ſelf, he ſhal not pleaſe my ſoule.
label: Hebrews

text: But vve are not the children of vvithdravving vnto perdition: but of faith to the vvinning of the ſoule.
label: Hebrews

text: AND faith is, the ſubſtance of things to be hoped for, the argument of things not appearing.
label: Hebrews

text: For in this the old men obtained teſtimonie.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, vve vnderſtand that the vvorldes vvere framed by the vvord of God: that of inuiſible things viſible things might be made.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, Abel offered a greater hoſte to God then Cain: by vvhich he obtained teſtimonie that he vvas iuſt, God giuing teſtimonie to his giftes, & by it, he being dead, yet ſpeaketh.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith Henoch vvas tranſlated, that he ſhould not ſee death, and he vvas not found: becauſe God tranſlated him. for before his tranſlation he had teſtimonie that he had pleaſed God.
label: Hebrews

text: But vvithout faith it is impoſſible to pleaſe God. For he that commeth to God, muſt beleeue that he is, and is a revvarder to them that ſeeke him.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, Noë hauing receiued an anſvver concerning thoſe things vvhich as yet vvere not ſeen, fearing, framed the arke for the ſauing of his houſe, by the vvhich he condemned the vvorld: and vvas inſtituted heire of the iuſtice vvhich is by faith.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, he that is called, Abraham, obeied to goe forth into the place vvhich he vvas to receiue for inheritance: and he vvent forth, not knovving whither he vvent.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, he abode in the land of promiſe, as in a ſtrange land, dvvelling in cottages vvith Iſaac & Iacob the coheires of the ſame promiſe.
label: Hebrews

text: For he expected the citie that hath foundations: vvhoſe artificer and maker is God.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, Sara alſo her ſelf being barren, receiued vertue in conceauing of ſeede, yea paſt the time of age: becauſe ſhe beleeued that he vvas faithful which had promiſed.
label: Hebrews

text: For the vvhich cauſe euen of one (and him quite dead) there roſe as the ſtarres of heauen in multitude, & as the ſand that is by the ſea ſhore innumerable.
label: Hebrews

text: According to faith died al theſe, not hauing receiued the promiſes, but beholding them a farre of, and ſaluting them, and confeſſing that they are pilgrimes & ſtrangers vpon the earth,
label: Hebrews

text: for they that ſay theſe things, doe ſignifie that they ſeeke a countrie.
label: Hebrews

text: And in deede if they had been mindeful of the ſame from vvhence they came forth, they had time verely to returne.
label: Hebrews

text: but novv they deſire a better, that is to ſay, a heauenly. Therfore God is not confounded to be called their God. for he hath prepared them a citie.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, Abraham offered Iſaac, vvhen he vvas tempted: and his onlie-begotten did he offer vvho had receiued the promiſes:
label: Hebrews

text: (to vvhom it vvas ſaid, That in Iſaac ſhal ſeede be called to thee.)
label: Hebrews

text: accounting that God is able to raiſe vp euen from the dead. wherevpon he receiued him alſo for a parable.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, alſo of things to come, Iſaac bleſſed Iacob and Eſau.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, Iacob dying, bleſſed euery one of the ſonnes of Ioſeph: and adored the toppe of his rodde.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, Ioſeph dying, made mention of the going forth of the children of Iſraël: and gaue commaundement concerning his bones.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, Moyſes being borne, vvas hidde three monethes by his parents: becauſe they ſavv him a proper infant, and they feared not the kings edict.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, Moyſes being made great, denied him ſelf to be the ſonne of Pharaos daughter:
label: Hebrews

text: rather choſing to be afflicted vvith the people of God, then to haue the pleaſure of temporal ſinne,
label: Hebrews

text: eſteeming the reproche of Chriſt, greater riches then the treaſure of the Ægyptians. for he looked vnto the remuneration.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, he left Ægypt: not fearing the fiercenes of the king. for him that is inuiſible he ſuſteined as if he had ſeen him.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, he celebrated the Paſche, & the ſheading of the bloud: that he which deſtroied the firſt-borne, might not touche them.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith they paſſed the redde ſea as it vvere by the drie land: vvhich the Ægyptians aſſaying, vvere deuoured.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith the vvalles of Iericho fel dovvne, by the circuting of ſeuen daies.
label: Hebrews

text: By faith, Rahab the harlot periſhed not vvith the incredulous, receiuing the ſpies vvith peace.
label: Hebrews

text: And vvhat ſhal I yet ſay? For the time vvil faile me telling of Gedeon, Barac, Sampſon, Iephtè, Dauid, Samuël, & the prophets:
label: Hebrews

text: vvho by faith ouercame kingdoms, vvrought iuſtice, obteined promiſes, ſtopped the mouthes of lions,
label: Hebrews

text: extinguiſhed the force of fire, repelled the edge of the ſword, recouered of their infirmitie, vvere made ſtrong in battel, turned avvay the campe of forainers:
label: Hebrews

text: vvomen receiued of reſurrection their dead. and others vvere racked, not accepting redemption, that they might finde a better reſurrection.
label: Hebrews

text: And others had trial of mockeries and ſtripes, moreouer alſo of bandes & priſons:
label: Hebrews

text: they vvere ſtoned, they vvere hevved, they vvere tempted, they died in the ſlaughter of the ſword, they vvent about in ſheep-ſkinnes, in goates ſkinnes, needy, in diſtreſſe, afflicted:
label: Hebrews

text: of vvhom the vvorld vvas not vvorthie. vvandering in deſertes, in mountaines and dennes, and in caues of the earth.
label: Hebrews

text: And al theſe being approued by the teſtimonie of faith, ⊢ receiued not the promiſe,
label: Hebrews

text: God for vs prouiding ſome better thing, that they vvithout vs ſhould not be conſummate.
label: Hebrews

text: AND therfore vve alſo hauing ſo great a cloud of vvitneſſes put vpon vs: laying avvay al vveight and ſinne that compaſſeth vs, by patience let vs runne to the fight propoſed vnto vs,
label: Hebrews

text: looking on the author of faith, and the conſummator IESVS, vvho, ioy being propoſed vnto him, ſuſtained the croſſe, contemning confuſion, and ſitteth on the right hand of the ſeate of God.
label: Hebrews

text: For, thinke diligently vpon him vvhich ſuſtained of ſinners ſuch contradiction againſt him ſelf: that you be not vvearied, fainting in your mindes.
label: Hebrews

text: For you haue not yet reſiſted vnto bloud, repugning againſt ſinne:
label: Hebrews

text: and you haue forgotten the conſolation, vvhich ſpeaketh to you, as it vvere to children, ſaying, My ſonne, neglect not the diſcipline of our Lord: neither be thou vvearied vvhiles thou art rebuked of him.
label: Hebrews

text: For vvhom our Lord loueth, he chaſteneth: and he ſcourgeth euery childe that he receiueth,
label: Hebrews

text: Perſeuêre ye in diſcipline. As vnto children doth God offer him ſelf to you. for vvhat ſonne is there, vvhom the father doth not correct?
label: Hebrews

text: But if you be vvithout diſcipline, vvhereof al be made partakers: then are you baſtards, & not children.
label: Hebrews

text: Moreouer the fathers in deede of our fleſh vve had for inſtructors, and vve did reuerence them: ſhal vve not much more obey the Father of ſpirites, & liue?
label: Hebrews

text: And they in deede for a time of fevv daies, according to their vvil inſtructed vs: but he, to that vvhich is profitable in receiuing of his ſanctification.
label: Hebrews

text: And al diſcipline for the preſent certes ſeemeth not to be of ioy, but of ſorovv: but aftervvard it vvil render to them that are exerciſed by it, moſt peaceable fruite of iuſtice.
label: Hebrews

text: For the vvhich cauſe ſtretch vp the ſlacked handes and the looſe knees:
label: Hebrews

text: and make ſtraight ſteppes to your feete: that no man halting erre, but rather be healed.
label: Hebrews

text: Folovv peace vvith al men, and holineſſe: vvithout vvhich no man ſhal ſee God:
label: Hebrews

text: looking diligently leſt any man be wanting to the grace of God: leſt any roote of bitternes ſpringing vp do hinder, and by it many be polluted.
label: Hebrews

text: Leſt there be any fornicator or prophane perſon as Eſau: vvho for one diſh of meate ſold his firſt-birth-rightes.
label: Hebrews

text: For know ye that aftervvard alſo deſiring to inherite the benediction, he vvas reprobated: for he found not place of repentance, although vvith teares he had ſought it.
label: Hebrews

text: For you are not come to a palpable mount, and an `acceſſible' fire, and vvhirlevvinde, and darkenes, and ſtorme,
label: Hebrews

text: and the ſound of trompet, & voice of vvordes, vvhich they that heard, excuſed them ſelues, that the vvord might not be ſpokē to them,
label: Hebrews

text: ( for they did not beare that which was ſaid, And if a beaſt ſhal touche the mount, it ſhal be ſtoned.
label: Hebrews

text: And ſo terrible vvas it vvhich vvas ſeen, Moyſes ſaid: I am frighted and tremble.
label: Hebrews

text: But you are come to mount Sion, and the citie of the liuing God, heauenly Hieruſalem, and the aſſemblie of many thouſand Angels,
label: Hebrews

text: & the Church of the firſt-borne, vvhich are vvritten in the heauens, and the iudge of all, God: and the ſpirites of the iuſt made perfect,
label: Hebrews

text: and the mediator of the nevv Teſtament IESVS, and the ſprinkling of bloud ſpeaking better then Abel.
label: Hebrews

text: See that you refuſe him not ſpeaking. for if they eſcaped not, refuſing him that ſpake vpon the earth: much more vve, that turne avvay from him ſpeaking to vs from heauen.
label: Hebrews

text: VVhoſe voice moued the earth then: but novv he promiſeth, ſaying, Yet once: and I vvil moue not only the earth, but heauen alſo.
label: Hebrews

text: And in that he ſaieth, Yet once, he declareth the tranſlation of moueable things as being made, that thoſe things may remaine vvhich are vnmoueable.
label: Hebrews

text: Therfore receiuing an vnmoueable kingdom, vve haue grace: by the vvhich let vs ſerue pleaſing God, vvith feare & reuerence.
label: Hebrews

text: For our God is a conſuming fire.
label: Hebrews

text: LET the charitie of the fraternitie abide in you.
label: Hebrews

text: And hoſpitalitie do not forget, for by this, certaine being not avvare, haue receiued Angels to harbour.
label: Hebrews

text: Remember them in bondes, as if you vvere bound vvith them: and them that labour, as your ſelues alſo remaining in bodie.
label: Hebrews

text: Mariage honorable in all, and the bed vndefiled. For, fornicatours & aduouterers God vvil iudge.
label: Hebrews

text: Let your maners be vvithout auarice: contented vvith things preſent. For he ſaid, I vvil not leaue thee, neither vvil I forſake thee.
label: Hebrews

text: ſo that vve do confidently ſay: Our Lord is my helper: I vvil not feare vvhat man ſhal doe to me.
label: Hebrews

text: Remember your Prelates, vvhich haue ſpoken the vvord of God to you: the end of vvhoſe conuerſation beholding, imitate their faith.
label: Hebrews

text: IESVS Chriſt yeſterday, and to day: the ſame alſo for euer.
label: Hebrews

text: VVith various & ſtrange doctrines be not led avvay. For it is beſt that the hart be eſtabliſhed vvith grace, not vvith meates: vvhich haue not profited thoſe that vvalke in them.
label: Hebrews

text: VVe haue an altar: vvhereof they haue not povver to eate vvhich ſerue the tabernacle.
label: Hebrews

text: For the bodies of thoſe beaſtes, vvhoſe bloud for ſinne is caried into the holies by the high prieſt, are burned vvithout the campe.
label: Hebrews

text: For the vvhich thing IESVS alſo, that he might ſanctifie the people by his ovvne bloud, ſuffered vvithout the gate.
label: Hebrews

text: Let vs goe forth therfore to him vvithout the campe: carying his reproche.
label: Hebrews

text: For vve haue not here a permanent citie: but vve ſeeke that vvhich is to come.
label: Hebrews

text: By him therfore let vs offer the hoſt of praiſe alvvaies to God, that is to ſay, the fruite of lippes confeſſing to his name.
label: Hebrews

text: And beneficence aud communication do not forget: for vvith ſuch hoſtes God is promerited.
label: Hebrews

text: Obey your Prelates, and be ſubiect to them. For they vvatch as being to render account for your ſoules: ⊢ that they may doe this vvith ioy, and not mourning. for this is not expedient for you.
label: Hebrews

text: Pray for vs. for vve haue confidence that vve haue a good conſcience, vvilling to conuerſe vvel in all.
label: Hebrews

text: And I beſeeche you the more to doe this, that I may the more ſpedily be reſtored to you.
label: Hebrews

text: And the God of peace vvhich brought out from the dead the great Paſtor of the ſheepe, in the bloud of the eternal teſtament, our Lord IESVS Chriſt:
label: Hebrews

text: cfitte you in al goodnes, that you may doe his vvil, doing in you that vvhich may pleaſe before him by IESVS Chriſt: to vvhom is glorie for euer and euer. Amen.
label: Hebrews

text: And I deſire you brethren that you ſuffer the vvord of conſolation. For in very fevv vvordes haue I vvritten to you.
label: Hebrews

text: Knovv you our brother Timothee to be diſmiſſed: vvith vvhom (if he come the ſooner) I vvil ſee you.
label: Hebrews

text: Salute al your prelates, and al the ſainctes. The brethren of Italie ſalute you.
label: Hebrews

text: Grace be vvith you al. Amen.
label: Hebrews

text: IAMES the ſeruant of God and of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, to the tvvelue tribes that are in diſperſion, greeting.
label: James

text: Eſteeme it, my brethren, al ioy, vvhen you ſhal fall into diuers tentations:
label: James

text: knovving that the probation of your faith vvorketh patience.
label: James

text: And let patience haue a perfect vvorke: that you may be perfect & entire, failing in nothing.
label: James

text: But if any of you lacke vviſedom, let him aſke of God who giueth to al men aboundantly, and vpbraideth not: and it ſhal be giuen him.
label: James

text: But let him aſke in faith nothing doubting. for he that doubteth, is like to a vvaue of the ſea, vvhich is moued & caried about by the vvinde.
label: James

text: therfore let not that man thinke that he ſhal receiue any thing of our Lord.
label: James

text: A man double of minde is inconſtant in al his waies.
label: James

text: But let the humble brother glorie, in his exaltation.
label: James

text: and the riche, in his humilitie, becauſe as the floure of graſſe ſhal he paſſe:
label: James

text: for the ſunne roſe vvith heate, & parched the graſſe, and the floure of it fel avvay, and the beautie of the ſhape thereof periſhed: ſo the riche man alſo ſhal wither in his vvaies.
label: James

text: Bleſſed is the man that ſuffereth tentation: for vvhen he hath been proued, he ſhal receiue the crovvne of life, vvhich God hath promiſed to them that loue him. ⊢
label: James

text: Let no man vvhen he is tempted, ſay that he is tempted of God. for God is not a tempter of euils, and he tempteth no man.
label: James

text: But euery one is tempted of his ovvne concupiſcence abſtracted and allured.
label: James

text: Aftervvard concupiſcence vvhen it hath conceiued, bringeth forth ſinne. but ſinne when it is conſummate, ingendreth death.
label: James

text: Do not erre therfore my deereſt brethren.
label: James

text: Euery beſt gift, and euery perfect gift, is from aboue, deſcending from the Father of lightes, with whom is no tranſmutation, nor ſhadowing of alteration.
label: James

text: Voluntarily hath he begotten vs by the vvord of truth, that vve may be ſome beginning of his creature. ⊢
label: James

text: You know my deereſt brethren, And let euery man be ſwift to heare: but ſlovv to ſpeake, and ſlow to anger.
label: James

text: For the anger of man worketh not the iuſtice of God.
label: James

text: For the vvhich thing caſting avvay al vncleanneſſe and aboundance of malice, in meekeneſſe receiue the engraffed vvord, vvhich is able to ſaue your ſoules. ⊢
label: James

text: But be doers of the vvord, and not hearers only, deceauing your ſelues.
label: James

text: For if a man be a hearer of the vvord, and not a doer: he ſhal be compared to a man beholding the countenance of his natiuitie in a glaſſe.
label: James

text: For he conſidered him ſelf, and vvent his vvay, and by and by forgat vvhat an one he was.
label: James

text: But he that hath looked in the lavv of perfect libertie, and hath remained in it, not made a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the worke: this man ſhal be bleſſed in his deede.
label: James

text: And if any man thinke him ſelf to be religious, not bridling his tong, but ſeducing his hart: this mans religion is vaine.
label: James

text: Religion cleane and vnſpotted vvith God and the Father, is this, to viſite pupilles and vvidovves in their tribulation: & to keepe him ſelf vnſpotted from this vvorld. ⊢
label: James

text: MY brethren, Haue not the faith of our Lord IESVS Chriſt of glorie in acception of perſons.
label: James

text: For if there ſhal enter into your aſſemblie a man hauing a golden ring in goodly appareil, and there ſhal enter in a poore man in homely attire,
label: James

text: & you haue reſpect to him that is clothed vvith the goodly appareil, and ſhal ſay to him, Sitte thou here vvel: but ſay to the poore man, Stand thou there: or ſitte vnder my foote-ſtoole:
label: James

text: do you not iudge vvith your ſelues, and are become iudges of vniuſt cogitations?
label: James

text: Heare my deereſt brethren: hath not God choſen the poore in this vvorld, riche in faith, and heires of the kingdom vvhich God hath promiſed to them that loue him?
label: James

text: But you haue diſhonoured the poore man. Do not the riche oppreſſe you by might: and them ſelues drawe you to iudgements?
label: James

text: Doe not they blaſpheme the good name that is inuocated vpon you?
label: James

text: If not-vvithſtanding you fulfil the roial lavv according to the ſcriptures, Thou ſhalt loue thy neighbour as thy ſelf, you doe vvel:
label: James

text: but if you accept perſons, you vvorke ſinne, reproued of the Lavv as tranſgreſſours.
label: James

text: And vvhoſoeuer ſhal keepe the whole Lavv, but offendeth in one: is made guilty of al.
label: James

text: For he that ſaid, Thou ſhalt not commit aduoutrie, ſaid alſo, Thou ſhalt not kil. And if thou doe not commit aduoutrie, but ſhalt kil: thou art made a tranſgreſſour of the Law.
label: James

text: So ſpeake ye, and ſo doe, as beginning to be iudged by the lavv of libertie.
label: James

text: For iudgement without mercie to him that hath not done mercie. And mercie cexalteth it ſelf aboue iudgement.
label: James

text: Vvhat ſhal it profit my brethren, if a man ſay he hath faith, but hath not vvorkes? Shal faith be able to ſaue him?
label: James

text: And if a brother or ſiſter be naked, & lacke daily foode:
label: James

text: and one of you ſay to them, Goe in peace, be warmed & filled: but you giue them not the things that are neceſſarie for the bodie: vvhat ſhal it profit?
label: James

text: So faith alſo, if it haue not vvorkes, is dead in it ſelf.
label: James

text: But ſome man ſaith, Thou haſt faith, and I haue vvorkes: ſhew me thy faith vvithout vvorkes: & I vvil ſhew thee by vvorkes my faith.
label: James

text: Thou beleeueſt that there is one God. Thou doeſt vvel: the deuils alſo beleeue and tremble.
label: James

text: But vvilt thou knovv ô vaine man, that faith vvithout vvorkes is 'idle?
label: James

text: Abraham our father vvas he not iuſtified by vvorkes, offering Iſaac his ſonne vpon the altar?
label: James

text: Seeſt thou that faith did vvorke vvith his vvorkes: and by the vvorkes the faith vvas conſummate?
label: James

text: And the Scripture vvas fulfilled, ſaying, Abraham beleeued God, and it was reputed him to iuſtice, and he vvas called the freende of God.
label: James

text: Do you ſee that by vvorkes a man is iuſtified: & not by faith only?
label: James

text: And in like maner alſo Rahab the harlot, vvas not ſhe iuſtified by vvorkes, receiuing the meſſengers, and putting them forth an other vvay?
label: James

text: For euen as the bodie vvithout the ſpirit is dead: ſo alſo faith without vvorkes is dead.
label: James

text: BE yee not many maiſters my brethren, knovving that you receiue the greater iudgement,
label: James

text: For in many things vve offend al. If any man offend not in vvord: this is a perfect man. he is able alſo vvith bridle to turne about the whole body.
label: James

text: And if vve put bittes into the mouthes of horſes that they may obey vs, vve turne about al their body alſo.
label: James

text: And behold, the ſhippes, vvhereas they be great, and are driuen of ſtrong windes: yet are they turned about vvith a litle ſterne whither the violence of the director vvil.
label: James

text: So the tongue alſo is certes a litle member, & cvaunteth great things. Behold how 'much' fire what a great vvood it kindleth?
label: James

text: And the tongue, is fire, a vvhole vvorld of iniquitie. The tongue is ſet among our members, vvhich defileth the vvhole bodie, & inflameth the wheele of our natiuitie, inflamed of hel.
label: James

text: For al nature of beaſtes & foules and ſerpents & of the reſt is tamed & hath been tamed by the nature of man.
label: James

text: but the tongue no man can tame, an vnquiet euil, ful of deadly poiſon.
label: James

text: By it vve bleſſe God & the Father: & by it vve curſe men vvhich are made after the ſimilitude of God.
label: James

text: Out of the ſelf ſame mouth procedeth bleſſing & curſing. Theſe things muſt not be ſo done my brethren.
label: James

text: Doth the fountaine giue forth out of one hole ſvveete & ſoure water?
label: James

text: Can, my brethren, the figge tree yeld grapes: or the vine, figges? So neither 'can the ſalt water yeld' ſweete.
label: James

text: Vvho is vviſe and hath knowledge among you? Let him ſhevv by good conuerſation his vvorking in mildeneſſe of vviſedom.
label: James

text: But if you haue bitter zeale, and there be contentions in your hartes: glorie not and be not liers againſt the truth.
label: James

text: for this is not vviſedom deſcending from aboue: but earthly, ſenſual, diueliſh.
label: James

text: For where zeale and contention is: there is inconſtancie, and euery peruerſe vvorke.
label: James

text: But the vviſedom that is from aboue, firſt certes is chaſt: then peaceable, modeſt, ſuaſible, conſenting to the good, ful of mercie and good fruites, not iudging, without ſimulation.
label: James

text: And the fruite of iuſtice, in peace is ſowed, to them that make peace.
label: James

text: FROM vvhence are vvarres & contentions among you? Are they not hereof? of your concupiſcences vvhich vvarre in your members?
label: James

text: You couet: and haue not. you kil, & enuie: and can not obtaine. you contend and warre: and you haue not, becauſe you aſke not.
label: James

text: You aſke, and receiue not: becauſe you aſke amiſſe: that you may conſume it on your concupiſcences.
label: James

text: Aduouterers, know you not that the frendſhip of this vvorld, is the enemie of God? Whoſoeuer therfore vvil be a frende of this vvorld: is made an enemie of God.
label: James

text: Or do you thinke that the Scripture ſaieth in vaine: To enuie doth the ſpirit couet which dvvelleth in you?
label: James

text: And giueth greater grace. For the which cauſe it ſaith, God reſiſteth the proud, & giueth grace to the humble.
label: James

text: Be ſubiect therfore to God, but reſiſt the Deuil, and he wil flee from you.
label: James

text: Approche to God, & he vvil approche to you. Cleanſe your handes, ye ſinners: and purifie your hartes, ye double of minde.
label: James

text: Be miſerable, and mourne, & weepe: let your laughter be turned into mourning: and ioy, into ſorow.
label: James

text: Be humbled in the ſight of our lord, and he wil exalt you.
label: James

text: Detracte not one from an other my brethren. He that detracteth from his brother, or he that iudgeth his brother, detracteth from the Law, and iudgeth the Law. But if thou iudge the Law, thou art not a doer of the Lavv, but a iudge.
label: James

text: For there is one law-maker, and iudge that can deſtroy and deliuer.
label: James

text: But thou, what art thou that iudgeſt thy neighbour? Behold novv you that ſay, To day or to morovv vve vvil goe into that citie, and there certes vvil ſpend a yere, and vvil traficke, and make our gaine (
label: James

text: vvho are ignorant what ſhal be on the morow. For vvhat is your life? It is a vapour appearing for a litle vvhile, and aftervvard it ſhal vaniſh away)
label: James

text: for that you ſhould ſay, If our Lord wil: and, If vve ſhal liue, vve wil doe this or that.
label: James

text: But novv you reioyce in your arrogancies. Al ſuch reioycing, is vvicked.
label: James

text: To one therfore knovving to doe good, and not doing it: to him it is ſinne.
label: James

text: GOE to now ye riche men, vveepe, hovvling in your miſeries which ſhal come to you.
label: James

text: Your riches are corrupt: and your garmentes are eaten of mothes.
label: James

text: Your gold and ſiluer is ruſted: and their ruſt ſhal be for a teſtimonie to you, and ſhal eate your fleſh as fire. You haue ſtored to your ſelues vvrath in the laſt daies.
label: James

text: Behold the hire of the vvorkemen that haue reaped your fields, vvhich is defrauded of you, crieth: and their crie hath entred into the eares of the Lord of Sabboth.
label: James

text: You haue made merie vpon the earth: and in riotouſnes you haue nouriſhed your hartes in the day of ſlaughter.
label: James

text: You haue 'preſented, and ſlaine the iuſt one: and he reſiſted you not.
label: James

text: Be patient therfore brethren, vntil the comming of our Lord. Behold, the huſband man expecteth the pretious fruite of the earth: patiently bearing til he receiue the timely and the latevvard.
label: James

text: Be you alſo patient, and confirme your hartes: becauſe the comming of our Lord 'vvil approche.
label: James

text: Grudge not brethren one againſt an other: that you be not iudged. Behold, the iudge ſtandeth before the gate.
label: James

text: Take an example, brethren, of labour and patience, the prophetes: vvhich ſpake in the name of our Lord.
label: James

text: Behold vve account them bleſſed that haue ſuffered. The ſufferance of Iob you haue heard, and the end of our Lord you haue ſeen, becauſe our Lord is merciful and pitieful.
label: James

text: But before al things my brethren, ſvveare not, neither by heauen, nor by earth, nor other othe whatſoeuer. But let your talke be, yea, yea: no, no: that you fall not vnder iudgement.
label: James

text: Is any of you in heauineſſe? let him pray. Is he of a cheereful hart? let him ſing.
label: James

text: Is any man ſicke among you? let him bring in the prieſtes of the Churche, and let them pray ouer him, anoiling him vvith oile in the name of our Lord.
label: James

text: and the praier of faith ſhal ſaue the ſicke: and our Lord ſhal lift him vp: and if he be in ſinnes, they ſhal be remitted him.
label: James

text: Confeſſe therfore your ſinnes one to an other: & pray one for an other that you may be ſaued. ⊢ for the continual praier of a iuſt man auaileth much.
label: James

text: Elias was a man like vnto vs paſſible: and vvith praier he praied that it might not raine vpon the earth, and it rained not for three yeres and ſixe monethes.
label: James

text: And he praied againe: and the heauen gaue raine, and the earth yelded her fruite.
label: James

text: My brethren, if any of you ſhal erre from the truth, & a man conuert him:
label: James

text: he muſt know that he vvhich maketh a ſinner to be conuerted from the errour of his vvay, ſhal ſaue his ſoule from death, and couereth a multitude of ſinnes. ⊢
label: James

text: PETER an Apoſtle of IESVS Chriſt, to the electe ſtrangers of the diſperſion of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Aſia, and Bithynia,
label: 1 Peter

text: according to the preſcience of God the Father, into ſanctification of the Spirit, vnto the obedience and ſprinkling of the bloud of IESVS Chriſt: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
label: 1 Peter

text: Bleſſed be God and the father of our Lord IESVS Chriſt, vvho according to his great mercie hath regenerated vs vnto a liuely hope, by the reſurrection of IESVS Chriſt from the dead,
label: 1 Peter

text: vnto an inheritance incorruptible, and incontaminate, and that can not fade, conſerued in the heauens in you,
label: 1 Peter

text: (vvho in the vertue of God are kept by faith vnto ſaluation) ready to be reuealed in the laſt time.
label: 1 Peter

text: wherin you ſhal reioyce, a litle novv if you muſt be made heauy in diuerſe tentations:
label: 1 Peter

text: that the probation of your faith much more pretious then gold (vvhich is proued by the fire) may be found vnto praiſe and glorie and honour in the reuelation of IESVS Chriſt: ⊢
label: 1 Peter

text: vvhom hauing not ſeen, you loue: in vvhom novv alſo not ſeing you beleeue: and beleeuing you reioyce vvith ioy vnſpeakable and glorified,
label: 1 Peter

text: receiuing the end of your faith, the ſaluation of your ſoules.
label: 1 Peter

text: Of the vvhich ſaluation the Prophetes inquired & ſearched, vvhich prophecied of the grace to come in you,
label: 1 Peter

text: ſearching vnto vvhich or vvhat maner of time the Spirit of Chriſt in them did ſignifie: foretelling thoſe paſſions that are in Chriſt and the glories folovving:
label: 1 Peter

text: to vvhom it vvas reuealed, that not to thē ſelues, but to you they miniſtred thoſe things vvhich novv are told you by them that haue euangelized to you, the holy Ghoſt being ſent from heauen, on vvhom the Angels deſire to looke.
label: 1 Peter

text: For the vvhich cauſe hauing the loines of your minde girded, ſober, truſt perfectly in that grace vvhich is offered you, in the reuelation of IESVS Chriſt,
label: 1 Peter

text: as children of obedience, not configurated to the former deſires of your ignorance:
label: 1 Peter

text: but according to him that hath called you, the Holy one, be you alſo in al conuerſation holy:
label: 1 Peter

text: becauſe it is vvritten: You ſhal be holy, becauſe I am holy.
label: 1 Peter

text: And if you inuocate the Father, him vvhich vvithout acception of perſons iudgeth according to euery ones vvorke: in feare conuerſe ye the time of your peregrination.
label: 1 Peter

text: Knovving that not vvith corruptible things, gold or ſiluer, you are redeemed from your vaine conuerſation of your fathers tradition:
label: 1 Peter

text: but vvith the precious bloud as it vvere of an immaculate and vnſpotted lambe, Chriſt,
label: 1 Peter

text: foreknovven in deede before the conſtitution of the vvorld, but manifeſted in the laſt times for you,
label: 1 Peter

text: vvhich by him are faithful in God vvho raiſed him from the dead, and hath giuen him glorie, that your faith and hope might be in God.
label: 1 Peter

text: Making your ſoules chaſte in obedience of charitie, in the ſincere loue of the fraternitie from the hart loue ye one an other earneſtly:
label: 1 Peter

text: borne againe not of corruptible ſeede, but incorruptible by the vvord of God vvho liueth and remaineth for euer.
label: 1 Peter

text: For al fleſh is as graſſe: and al the glorie thereof as the floure of graſſe. the graſſe is vvithered, and the floure thereof is fallen avvay.
label: 1 Peter

text: But the vvord of our Lord remaineth for euer, and this is the vvord that is euangelized among you.
label: 1 Peter

text: LAYING avvay therfore al malice, and al guile, and ſimulations, and enuies, and al detractions,
label: 1 Peter

text: as infants euen novv borne, reaſonable, milke vvithout guile deſire ye, that in it you may grovv vnto ſaluation.
label: 1 Peter

text: if yet you haue taſted that our Lord is ſvveete.
label: 1 Peter

text: Vnto vvhom approching, a liuing ſtone, of men in deede reprobated, but of God elect and made honorable:
label: 1 Peter

text: be ye alſo your ſelues ſuperedified as it vvere liuing ſtones, `ſpiritual houſes', a holy prieſthod, to offer ſpiritual hoſtes, acceptable to God by IESVS Chriſt.
label: 1 Peter

text: For the vvhich cauſe the Scripture conteineth, Behold I put in Sion a principal corner ſtone elect, pretious. and he that ſhal beleeue in him, ſhal not be confounded.
label: 1 Peter

text: To you therfore that beleeue, honour: but to them that beleeue not, the ſtone vvhich the builders reiected, the ſame is made into the head of the corner:
label: 1 Peter

text: and a ſtone of offenſe, and a rocke of ſcandal, to them that ſtumble at the vvord, neither doe beleeue `vvherin alſo they are put'.
label: 1 Peter

text: But you are an elect generation, a ckingly prieſthod, a holy nation, a people of purchaſe: that you may declare his vertues vvhich from darkeneſſe hath called you into his maruelous light.
label: 1 Peter

text: Vvhich ſometime not a people: but novv the people of God. Vvhich not hauing obtained mercie: but novv hauing obtained mercie.
label: 1 Peter

text: My deereſt I beſeche you as ſtrangers & pilgrimes, to refraine your ſelues from carnal deſires which vvarre againſt the ſoule,
label: 1 Peter

text: hauing your conuerſation good among the Gentiles: that in that vvherein they miſreport of you as of malefactors, by the good vvorkes conſidering you, they may glorifie God in the day of viſitation.
label: 1 Peter

text: Be ſubiect therfore to euery humane creature for God: vvhether it be to king, as excelling:
label: 1 Peter

text: or to rulers as ſent by him to the reuenge of malefactors, but to the praiſe of the good:
label: 1 Peter

text: for ſo is the vvil of God, that doing vvel you may make the ignorance of vnvviſe men to be dumme:
label: 1 Peter

text: as free, & not as hauing the freedom for a cloke of malice, but as the ſeruants of God.
label: 1 Peter

text: Honour al men. Loue the fraternitie. Feare God. Honour the king.
label: 1 Peter

text: Seruants be ſubiect in al feare to your maiſters, not only to the good & modeſt, but alſo to the vvaivvard.
label: 1 Peter

text: For this is thanke, if for conſcience of God a man ſuſtaine ſorovves, ſuffering vniuſtly.
label: 1 Peter

text: For vvhat glorie is it: if ſinning, and buffeted you ſuffer? but if doing vvel you ſuſtaine patiently: this is thanke before God.
label: 1 Peter

text: For vnto this are you called: becauſe Chriſt alſo ſuffred for `vs', leauing `you' an example that you may folovv his ſteppes.
label: 1 Peter

text: vvho did no ſinne, neither vvas guile found in his mouth.
label: 1 Peter

text: vvho vvhen he vvas reuiled, did not reuile: vvhen he ſuffred, he threatened not: but deliuered him ſelf to him that iudged him vniuſtly.
label: 1 Peter

text: vvho him ſelf bare our ſinnes in his body vpon the tree: that dead to ſinnes, we may liue to iuſtice. by vvhoſe ſtripes you are healed.
label: 1 Peter

text: For you vvere as ſheepe ſtraying: but you be conuerted novv to the Paſtor and Biſhop of your ſoules. ⊢
label: 1 Peter

text: IN like maner alſo let the vvomen be ſubiect to their huſbandes: that if any beleeue not the vvord, by the conuerſation of the vvomen vvithout the vvord they may be vvonne,
label: 1 Peter

text: conſidering your chaſt conuerſation in feare.
label: 1 Peter

text: VVhoſe trimming let it not be outvvardly the plaiting of heare, or laying on gold round about, or of putting on veſtures:
label: 1 Peter

text: but the man of the hart that is hidden, in the incorruptibilitie of a quiet and a modeſt ſpirit, vvhich is riche in the ſight of God.
label: 1 Peter

text: For ſo ſometime the holy vvomen alſo that truſted in God, adorned them ſelues, ſubiect to their ovvne huſbandes.
label: 1 Peter

text: As Sara obeied Abraham, calling him lord: vvhoſe daughters you are, doing vvel, and not fearing any perturbation.
label: 1 Peter

text: Huſbandes likevviſe, dvvelling vvith them according to knovvledge, as vnto the vveaker feminine veſſel imparting honour, as it vvere to the coheires alſo of the grace of life: that your praiers be not hindered.
label: 1 Peter

text: And `in fine' al of one minde, hauing compaſſion, louers of the fraternitie, merciful, modeſt, humble.
label: 1 Peter

text: not rendering euil for euil, nor curſe for curſe: but contrariewiſe, bleſſing: for vnto this are you called, that you may by inheritance poſſeſſe a benediction.
label: 1 Peter

text: For he that vvil loue life, and ſee good daies: let him refraine his tong from euil, and his lippes that they ſpeake not guile.
label: 1 Peter

text: Let him decline from euil, and doe good: let him enquire peace, and folovv it:
label: 1 Peter

text: becauſe the eies of our Lord are vpon the iuſt, and his eares vnto their praiers: but the countenance of our Lord vpon them that doe euil things.
label: 1 Peter

text: And vvho is he that can hurt you, if you be emulators of good?
label: 1 Peter

text: But & if you ſuffer ought for iuſtice, bleſſed are ye. And the feare of them feare ye not, & be not troubled.
label: 1 Peter

text: But ſanctifie our Lord Chriſt in your hartes, ready alwaies to ſatiſfie euery one that aſketh you a reaſon of that hope vvhich is in you:
label: 1 Peter

text: but vvith modeſtie and feare, hauing a good conſcience: that in that vvhich they ſpeake il of you, they may be confounded vvhich calumniate your good conuerſation in Chriſt.
label: 1 Peter

text: For it is better to ſuffer as doing vvel (if the vvil of God vvil haue it ſo) then doing il.
label: 1 Peter

text: Becauſe Chriſt alſo died once for our ſinnes, the iuſt for the vniuſt: that he might offer vs to God, mortified certes in fleſh, but quickened in ſpirit.
label: 1 Peter

text: In the vvhich ſpirit comming he preached to `them' alſo that vvere in priſon:
label: 1 Peter

text: vvhich had been incredulous ſometime, vvhen they expected the patience of God in the daies of Noë, vvhen the arke vvas a building: in the vvhich, fevv, that is, eight ſoules vvere ſaued by vvater.
label: 1 Peter

text: Vvherevnto Baptiſme being of the like forme novv ſaueth `you' alſo: not the laying avvay of the filth of the fleſh, but the examination of a good conſcience tovvard God by the reſurrection of IESVS Chriſt.
label: 1 Peter

text: vvho is on the right hand of God, ⊢ ſvvallovving death, that vve might be made heires of life euerlaſting: being gone into heauen, Angels and Potentates and Povvers ſubiected to him.
label: 1 Peter

text: CHRIST therfore hauing ſuffered in the fleſh, be you alſo armed vvith the ſame cogitation. becauſe he that hath ſuffered in the fleſh, hath ceaſed from ſinnes:
label: 1 Peter

text: that novv not after the deſires of men, but according to the vvil of God he liue the reſt of his time in the fleſh.
label: 1 Peter

text: For the time paſt ſufficeth (to accompliſh the vvil of the Gentiles) them that haue vvalked in riotouſnes, deſires, exceſſe of wine, banketings, potations, and vnlavvfnl ſeruices of Idols.
label: 1 Peter

text: VVherein they maruel blaſpheming, you not concurring into the ſame confuſion of riotouſnes.
label: 1 Peter

text: vvho ſhal render account to him, vvhich is ready to iudge the liuing and the dead.
label: 1 Peter

text: For, for this cauſe alſo vvas it euangelized to the dead: that they may be iudged in deede according to men, in the fleſh: but may liue according to God in the Spirit.
label: 1 Peter

text: And the end of al `ſhal approche'. Be vviſe therfore: and vvatch in praiers.
label: 1 Peter

text: But before al things, hauing mutual charitie continual among your ſelues: becauſe charitie couereth the multitude of ſinnes.
label: 1 Peter

text: Vſing hoſpitalitie one tovvard an other vvithout murmuring.
label: 1 Peter

text: Euery one as he hath receiued grace, miniſtring the ſame one tovvard an other: as good diſpenſers of the manifold grace of God.
label: 1 Peter

text: If any man ſpeake, as the vvordes of God. if any man miniſter: as of the povver, vvhich God adminiſtreth. that in al things God may be honoured by IESVS Chriſt: ⊢ to vvhom is glorie and empire for euer and euer. Amen.
label: 1 Peter

text: My deereſt, thinke it not ſtrange in the feruour vvhich is to you for a tentation, as though ſome nevv thing happened to you:
label: 1 Peter

text: but communicating vvith the paſſions of Chriſt, be glad, that in the reuelation alſo of his glorie you may be glad reioycing.
label: 1 Peter

text: If you be reuiled in the name of Chriſt, you ſhal be bleſſed: becauſe that vvhich is of the honour, glorie, and vertue of God, and the Spirit vvhich is his, ſhal reſt vpon you.
label: 1 Peter

text: But let none of you ſuffer as a murderer, or a theefe, or a railer, or a coueter of other mens things.
label: 1 Peter

text: But if as a Chriſtian, let him not be aſhamed, but let him glorifie God in this name.
label: 1 Peter

text: for the time is that iudgement begin of the houſe of God. And if firſt of vs: vvhat ſhal be the end of them that beleeue not the Goſpel of God?
label: 1 Peter

text: And if the iuſt man ſhal ſcarſe be ſaued: where ſhal the impious and ſinner appeare?
label: 1 Peter

text: Therfore they alſo that ſuffer according to the vvil of God, let them commend their ſoules to the faithful creator, in good deedes. ⊢
label: 1 Peter

text: THE ſeniors therfore that are among you, I beſeche, my ſelf a fellovv ſenior vvith them and a vvitneſſe of the paſſions of Chriſt, vvho am alſo partaker of that glorie vvhich is to be reuealed in time to come:
label: 1 Peter

text: feede the flocke of God vvhich is among you, cprouiding not by conſtrainte, but vvillingly according to God: neither for filthie lucre ſake, but voluntarily:
label: 1 Peter

text: neither as ouerruling the Clergie, but made examples of the flocke from the hart.
label: 1 Peter

text: And vvhen the prince of paſtors ſhal appeare, you ſhal receiue the incorruptible crovvne of glorie.
label: 1 Peter

text: In like maner ye yong men be ſubiect to the ſeniors. And do ye al inſinuate humilitie one to an other, becauſe God reſiſteth the proude: and to the humble he giueth grace.
label: 1 Peter

text: Be ye humbled therfore vnder the mightie hand of God, that he may exalt you in the time of viſitation:
label: 1 Peter

text: caſting al your carefulnes vpon him, becauſe he hath care of you.
label: 1 Peter

text: Be ſober and vvatch: becauſe your aduerſarie the Diuel as a roaring lion goeth about, ſeeking vvhom he may deuoure.
label: 1 Peter

text: vvhom reſiſt ye, ſtrong in faith: knovving that the ſelf ſame affliction is made to that your fraternitie vvhich is in the vvorld.
label: 1 Peter

text: But the God of al grace, vvhich hath called vs vnto his eternal glorie in Chriſt IESVS, he vvil perfite you hauing ſuffered a litle, and confirme, and ſtabliſh you.
label: 1 Peter

text: To him be glorie and empire for euer and euer. Amen. ⊢
label: 1 Peter

text: By Syluanus a faithful brother to you, as I thinke, I haue breefely vvritten: beſeching and teſtifying that this is the true grace of God, vvherein you ſtand.
label: 1 Peter

text: The Church ſaluteth you, that is in Babylon, coëlect: and Marke my ſonne.
label: 1 Peter

text: Salute one an other in a holy kiſſe. Grace be to al you vvhich are in Chriſt IESVS. Amen.
label: 1 Peter

text: SIMON PETER ſeruant and Apoſtle of IESVS Chriſt, to them that haue obtained equal faith vvith vs in the iuſtice of our God and Sauiour IESVS Chriſt.
label: 2 Peter

text: Grace to you and peace be accompliſhed in the knovvledge of God and Chriſt IESVS our Lord:
label: 2 Peter

text: as al things of his diuine povver vvhich pertaine to life and godlines, are giuen vs by the knovvledge of him vvhich hath called vs by his ovvne propre glorie and vertue,
label: 2 Peter

text: by vvhom he hath giuen vs moſt great and pretious promiſes: that by theſe you may be made partakers of the diuine nature, fleeing the corruption of that concupiſcence vvhich is in the vvorld.
label: 2 Peter

text: And you employing al care, miniſter ye in your faith, vertue: and in vertue, knovvledge:
label: 2 Peter

text: and in knovvledge, abſtinence: and in abſtinence, patience: and in patience, pietie:
label: 2 Peter

text: and in pietie, loue of the fraternitie: and in the loue of the fraternitie, charitie.
label: 2 Peter

text: For if theſe things be preſent vvith you, & abound: they ſhal make you not vacant, nor vvithout fruite in the knovvledge of our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: 2 Peter

text: For he that hath not theſe things ready, is blinde, and groping vvith his hand, hauing forgotten the purging of his old ſinnes.
label: 2 Peter

text: VVherfore, brethren, labour the more that by good vvorkes you may make ſure your vocation and election. for, doing theſe things, you ſhal not ſinne at any time.
label: 2 Peter

text: For ſo there ſhal be miniſtred to you aboundantly an entrance into the euerlaſting kingdom of our Lord and Sauiour IESVS Chriſt.
label: 2 Peter

text: For the vvhich cauſe I wil begin to admoniſh you alvvaies of theſe things: and you in deede knovving & being confirmed in the preſent truth.
label: 2 Peter

text: But I thinke it meete as long as I am in this tabernacle, to ſtirre you vp by admonition:
label: 2 Peter

text: being certaine that the laying avvay of my tabernacle is at hand, according as our Lord IESVS Chriſt alſo ſignified to me.
label: 2 Peter

text: And I vvil doe my diligence, you to haue often after my deceaſe alſo, that you may keepe a memorie of theſe things.
label: 2 Peter

text: For not hauing folovved vnlearned fables, haue vve made the povver and `preſence' of our Lord IESVS Chriſt knovven to you: but made beholders of his greateneſſe.
label: 2 Peter

text: For, he receiuing from God his father honour and glorie, this maner of voice comming dovvne to him from the magnifical glorie, This is my beloued ſonne in vvhom I haue pleaſed my ſelf, heare him.
label: 2 Peter

text: And this voice vve heard brought from heauen, vvhen vve vvere vvith him in the holy mounte.
label: 2 Peter

text: And we haue the prophetical vvord more ſure: vvhich you doe vvel attending vnto, as to a candel ſhining in a darke place, vntil the day davvne, and the day ſtarre ariſe in your hartes: ⊢
label: 2 Peter

text: vnderſtanding this firſt that no prophecie of ſcripture is made by priuate interpretation.
label: 2 Peter

text: For, not by mans vvil vvas prophecie brought at any time: but the holy men of God ſpake, inſpired vvith the holy Ghoſt.
label: 2 Peter

text: BVT there vvere alſo falſe-prophets in the people, as alſo in you there ſhal be lying maiſters vvhich ſhal bring in ſectes of perdition, and denie him that hath bought them, the Lord: bringing vpon them ſelues ſpeedie perdition.
label: 2 Peter

text: And many ſhal folovv their riotouſneſſes, by vvhom the vvay of truth ſhal be blaſphemed.
label: 2 Peter

text: and in auarice ſhal they vvith feined vvordes make merchandiſe of you. vnto vvhom the iudgement novv long ſince ceaſeth not: and their perdition ſlumbereth not.
label: 2 Peter

text: For if God ſpared not Angels ſinning: but with the ropes of Hel being dravven dovvne into Hel deliuered them to be tormented, that they ſhould be reſerued vnto iudgement:
label: 2 Peter

text: & he ſpared not the original vvorld, but kept the eight, Noë, the preacher of iuſtice, bringing in the deluge vpon the vvorld of the impious.
label: 2 Peter

text: And bringing the cities of the Sodomites and of the Gomorrheites into aſhes, he damned them vvith ſubuerſion, putting an example of them that ſhal doe impiouſly:
label: 2 Peter

text: and deliuered iuſt Lot oppreſſed by the iniurie and luxurious conuerſation of the abominable men.
label: 2 Peter

text: for in ſight and hearing he vvas iuſt: dvvelling vvith them vvho from day to day vexed the iuſt ſoule vvith vniuſt vvorkes.
label: 2 Peter

text: Our Lord knovveth to deliuer the godly from tentation, but to reſerue the vniuſt vnto the day of iudgement to be tormented:
label: 2 Peter

text: and eſpecially them vvhich vvalke after the fleſh in concupiſcence of vncleanneſſe, and contemne dominion, bold, ſelf-pleaſers: they feare not to bring in ſectes, blaſpheming.
label: 2 Peter

text: Vvhereas Angels being greater in ſtrength and povver, beare not the execrable iudgement againſt them.
label: 2 Peter

text: But theſe men as vnreaſonable beaſtes, naturally tending to the ſnare and into deſtruction, in thoſe things vvhich they know not, blaſpheming, ſhal periſh in their corruption,
label: 2 Peter

text: receiuing the revvard of iniuſtice, eſteeming for a pleaſure the delightes of a day: bcoinquinations and ſpottes, flovving in delicacies, in their feaſtings rioting vvith you,
label: 2 Peter

text: hauing eies ful of adulterie and inceſſant ſinne: alluring vnſtable ſoules, hauing their hart exerciſed vvith auarice, the children of malediction:
label: 2 Peter

text: leauing the right vvay they haue erred, hauing folovved the vvay of Balaam of Boſor, vvhich loued the revvard of iniquitie,
label: 2 Peter

text: but had a checke of his madneſſe. the dumme beaſt vnder the yoke, ſpeaking vvith mans voice, prohibited the foliſhnes of the prophet.
label: 2 Peter

text: Theſe are fountaines vvithout vvater, and cloudes, toſſed vvith vvhirlevvindes, to vvhom the miſt of darkeneſſe is reſerued.
label: 2 Peter

text: For, ſpeaking the proud things of vanitie, they allure in the deſires of fleſhly riotouſnes, thoſe that eſcape a litle, vvhich conuerſe in errour,
label: 2 Peter

text: promiſing them libertie, vvhereas them ſelues are the ſlaues of corruption. for, vvherevvith a man is ouercome: of that he is the ſlaue alſo.
label: 2 Peter

text: For if fleeing from the coinquinations of the vvorld in the knovvledge of our Lord and Sauiour IESVS Chriſt, they againe intangled vvith the ſame be ouercome: the later things are become vnto them vvorſe then the former.
label: 2 Peter

text: For it vvas better for them not to knovv the vvay of iuſtice, then after the knovvledge, to turne backe from that holy commandement vvhich vvas deliuered to them.
label: 2 Peter

text: For, that of the true prouerbe is chaunced to them, The dogge returned to his vomite: and, The ſovve vvaſhed into her vvallovving in the mire.
label: 2 Peter

text: THIS loe the ſecond epiſtle I vvrite to you my deereſt, in vvhich I ſtirre vp by admonition your ſincere minde:
label: 2 Peter

text: that you may be mindeful of thoſe vvordes vvhich I told you before from the holy Prophetes, and of your Apoſtles, of the preceptes of our Lord and Sauiour.
label: 2 Peter

text: Knovving this firſt, that in the laſt daies ſhal come mockers in deceit, vvalking according to their ovvne concupiſcences,
label: 2 Peter

text: ſaying, Vvhere is his promiſe or his comming? For ſince the time that the fathers ſlept, al things do ſo perſeuere from the beginning of creature.
label: 2 Peter

text: for they are vvilfully ignorant of this, that the heauens vvere before, & the earth, out of vvater, and through vvater, conſiſting by the vvord of God:
label: 2 Peter

text: by the vvhich, that vvorld then, being ouerflovved vvith vvater periſhed.
label: 2 Peter

text: But the heauens vvhich novv are, & the earth, are by the ſame word kept in ſtore, reſerued to fire vnto the day of iudgement & of the perdition of the impious men.
label: 2 Peter

text: But this one thing be not ignorant of, my deereſt, that one day with our Lord is as a thouſand yeres, & a thouſand yeres as one day.
label: 2 Peter

text: Our Lord ſlacketh not his promis, as ſome do eſteeme it: but he doth patiently for you, not vvilling that any periſh, but that al returne to penance.
label: 2 Peter

text: And the day of our Lord ſhal come as a theefe in the vvhich the heauens ſhal paſſe vvith great violence, but the elementes ſhal be reſolued vvith heate, and the earth and the vvorkes vvhich are in it, ſhal be burnt.
label: 2 Peter

text: Therfore vvhereas al theſe thinges are to be diſſolued: vvhat maner of men ought you to be in holy conuerſations and godlineſſe,
label: 2 Peter

text: expecting and haſting vnto the comming of the day of our Lord, by vvhich the heauens burning ſhal be reſolued, and the elementes ſhal melt vvith the heate of fire?
label: 2 Peter

text: But vve expect nevv heauens and a nevv earth according to his promiſes, in vvhich iuſtice inhabiteth.
label: 2 Peter

text: For the vvhich cauſe my deereſt, expecting theſe things, labour earneſtly to be found immaculate and vnſpotted to him in peace:
label: 2 Peter

text: and the longanimitie of our Lord, do ye account ſaluation, as alſo our moſt deere brother Paul according to the vviſedom giuen him hath vvritten to you:
label: 2 Peter

text: as alſo in al epiſtles, ſpeaking in them of theſe things, in the vvhich are certaine things hard to be vnderſtoode, vvhich the vnlearned and vnſtable depraue, as alſo the reſt of the Scriptures, to their ovvne perdition.
label: 2 Peter

text: You therefore brethren, foreknovving, take heede leſt ledde aſide by the errour of the vnwiſe you fal away from your owne ſtedfaſtnes.
label: 2 Peter

text: but grovv in grace and in knovvledge of our Lord and ſauiour IESVS Chriſt. To him be glorie both novv and vnto the day of eternitie. Amen.
label: 2 Peter

text: THAT vvhich vvas from the beginning, vvhich vve haue heard, vvhich vve haue ſeen vvith our eies, vvhich vve haue looked vpon, and our handes haue handled of the vvord of life:
label: 1 John

text: ( and the life vvas manifeſted: and vve haue ſeen, and do teſtifie, and declare vnto you the life eternal vvhich vvas vvith the Father, and hath appeared to vs)
label: 1 John

text: that vvhich vve haue ſeen and haue heard, vve declare vnto you, that you alſo may haue ſocietie vvith vs, and our ſocietie may be vvith the Father and vvith his Sonne IESVS Chriſt.
label: 1 John

text: And theſe things vve vvrite to you, that you may reioyce, and your ioy may be ful.
label: 1 John

text: And this is the annuntiation vvhich vve haue heard of him, and declare vnto you, That God is light, and in him there is no darkeneſſe.
label: 1 John

text: If vve ſhal ſay that we haue ſocietie vvith him, and vvalke in darkeneſſe: vve lie, and do not the truth.
label: 1 John

text: But if we vvalke in the light, as he alſo is in the light: vve haue ſocietie one tovvard an other, and the bloud of IESVS Chriſt his ſonne cleanſeth vs from al ſinne.
label: 1 John

text: If vve ſhal ſay that vve haue no ſinne, vve ſeduce our ſelues, and the truth is not in vs.
label: 1 John

text: If vve confeſſe our ſinnes: he is faithful & iuſt, for to forgiue vs our ſinnes, and to cleanſe vs from al iniquitie.
label: 1 John

text: If we ſhal ſay that vve haue not ſinned: vve make him a lier, and his word is not in vs.
label: 1 John

text: MY litle children, theſe things I vvrite to you, that you ſinne not. But & if any man ſhal ſinne, vve haue an caduocate vvith the Father, IESVS Chriſt the iuſt:
label: 1 John

text: and he is the propitiation for our ſinnes: and not for ours only, but alſo for the vvhole vvorldes.
label: 1 John

text: And in this vve know that vve haue knovven him, if vve obſerue his commaundements.
label: 1 John

text: He that ſaith he knovveth him, and keepeth not his commaundements: is a lier and the truth is not in him:
label: 1 John

text: But he that keepeth his vvord, in him in very deede the charitie of God is perfited: in this vve know that vve be in him.
label: 1 John

text: He that ſaith he abideth in him: ought euen as he walked, him ſelf alſo to vvalke.
label: 1 John

text: My deereſt, I vvrite not a nevv commaundement to you, but an old commaundement which you had from the beginning. The old commaundement is the vvord vvhich you haue heard.
label: 1 John

text: Againe a nevv commaundement vvrite I to you, vvhich thing is true both in him and in you: becauſe the darkeneſſe is paſſed, and the true light novv ſhineth.
label: 1 John

text: He that ſaith he is in the light, and hateth his brother: is in the darkeneſſe euen vntil novv.
label: 1 John

text: He that loueth his brother, abideth in the light, and ſcandal is not in him.
label: 1 John

text: But he that hateth his brother: is in the darkeneſſe, and vvalketh in the darkeneſſe, and knovveth not vvhither he goeth, becauſe the darkenes hath blinded his eies.
label: 1 John

text: I write vnto you litle children, becauſe your ſinnes are forgiuen you for his name.
label: 1 John

text: I vvrite vnto you fathers, becauſe you haue knovven him vvhich is from the beginning. I vvrite vnto you yong men, becauſe you haue ouercome the vvicked one.
label: 1 John

text: I vvrite to you infantes, becauſe you haue knovven the Father. I write vnto you yong men, becauſe you are ſtrong, and the vvord of God abideth in you, & you haue ouercome the vvicked one.
label: 1 John

text: Loue not the vvorld, nor thoſe things vvhich are in the vvorld. If any man loue the vvorld, the charitie of the Father is not in him.
label: 1 John

text: becauſe al that is in the vvorld, is the concupiſcence of the fleſh, & the concupiſcence of the eies, and the pride of life, vvhich is not of the Father, but is of the vvorld.
label: 1 John

text: And the vvorld paſſeth and the concupiſcence thereof. But he that doeth the vvil of God, abideth for euer.
label: 1 John

text: Litle children, it is the laſt houre, & as you haue heard, that Antichriſt commeth: now there are become many antichriſtes: vvhereby vve knovv, that it is the laſt houre.
label: 1 John

text: They vvent out from vs: but they vvere not of vs. for if they had been of vs, they vvould ſurely haue remained with vs: but that they may be manifeſt that they are not al of vs.
label: 1 John

text: But you haue the cvnction from the Holy one, and knovv al things.
label: 1 John

text: I haue not written to you as to them that knovv not the truth, but as to them that knovv it: and that no lie is of the truth.
label: 1 John

text: VVho is a lier, but he vvhich denieth that IESVS is not Chriſt? This is Antichriſt vvhich denieth the Father and the Sonne.
label: 1 John

text: Euery one that denieth the Sonne, neither hath he the Father. He that confeſſeth the Sonne, hath the Father alſo.
label: 1 John

text: You, that vvhich you haue heard from the beginning, let it abide in you. If that abide in you vvhich you haue heard from the beginning, you alſo ſhal abide in the Sonne & the Father.
label: 1 John

text: And this is the promis vvhich he promiſed vs, life euerlaſting.
label: 1 John

text: Theſe things haue I vvritten to you concerning them that ſeduce you.
label: 1 John

text: And you, the vnction vvhich you haue receiued from him, let it abide in you. And you haue no neede that any man teache you: but as his vnction teacheth you of al things, and it is true, and it is no lie. And as it hath taught you, abide in him.
label: 1 John

text: And now litle children abide in him: that vvhen he ſhal appeare, vve may haue confidence, and not be confounded of him in his comming.
label: 1 John

text: If you know that he is iuſt, knovv ye that euery one alſo vvhich doeth iuſtice, is borne of him.
label: 1 John

text: SEE vvhat maner of charitie the Father hath giuen vs, that vve ſhould be named and be the ſonnes of God. For this cauſe the world doth not knovv vs, becauſe it hath not knovven him.
label: 1 John

text: My deereſt, novv we are the ſonnes of God: & it hath not yet appeared vvhat we ſhal be. VVe know that when he ſhal appeare, we ſhal be like to him: becauſe vve ſhal ſee him as he is.
label: 1 John

text: And euery one that hath this hope in him, ſanctifieth him ſelf, as he alſo is holy.
label: 1 John

text: Euery one that committeth ſinne, committeth alſo iniquitie: and ſinne is iniquitie.
label: 1 John

text: And you knovv that he appeared to take away our ſinnes: and ſinne in him there is none.
label: 1 John

text: Euery one that abideth in him, ſinneth not: and euery one that ſinneth, hath not ſeen him, nor knowen him.
label: 1 John

text: Litle children, let no man ſeduce you. He that doeth iuſtice, is iuſt: euen as he alſo is iuſt.
label: 1 John

text: He that committeth ſinne, is of the deuil: becauſe the deuil ſinneth from the beginning. For this, appeared the Sonne of God, that he might diſſolue the vvorkes of the deuil.
label: 1 John

text: Euery one that is borne of God, committeth not ſinne: becauſe his ſeede abideth in him, and he can not ſinne becauſe he is borne of God.
label: 1 John

text: In this are the children of God manifeſt, and the children of the deuil. Euery one that is not iuſt, is not of God, and he that loueth not his brother.
label: 1 John

text: becauſe this is the annuntiation, vvhich you haue heard from the beginning, That you loue one an other.
label: 1 John

text: Not as Cain, vvho was of the vvicked, and killed his brother. And for vvhat cauſe killed he him? Becauſe his vvorkes vvere vvicked: but his brothers, iuſt.
label: 1 John

text: Maruel not brethren, if the vvorld hate you.
label: 1 John

text: Vve knovv that we are tranſlated from death to life, becauſe vve loue the brethren. He that loueth not, abideth in death.
label: 1 John

text: VVhoſoeuer hateth his brother: is a murderer. And you knovv that no murderer hath life euerlaſting abiding in him ſelf.
label: 1 John

text: In this vve haue knovven the charitie of God, becauſe he hath yelded his life for vs: and vve ought to yeld our liues for the brethren. ⊢
label: 1 John

text: He that ſhal haue the ſubſtance of the vvorld, and ſhal ſee his brother haue neede, and ſhal ſhut his bovvels from him: hovv doth the charitie of God abide in him?
label: 1 John

text: My litle children, let vs not loue in word, nor in tongue, but in deede and truth. ⊢
label: 1 John

text: In this vve knovv that vve are of the truth: and in his ſight vve ſhal perſuade our hartes.
label: 1 John

text: For if our hart do reprehend vs: God is greater then our hart, and knovveth al thinges.
label: 1 John

text: My deereſt, if our hart do not reprehend vs, vve haue confidence tovvard God.
label: 1 John

text: And vvhatſoeuer vve ſhal aſke, vve ſhal receiue of him: becauſe vve keepe his commaundementes, and doe thoſe thinges vvhich are pleaſing before him.
label: 1 John

text: And this is his commaundement, that vve beleeue in the name of his Sonne IESVS Chriſt: and loue one an other, as he hath giuen commaundement vnto vs.
label: 1 John

text: And he that keepeth his commaundementes, abideth in him, and he in him. And in this vve knovv that he abideth in vs, by the Spirit vvhich he hath giuen vs.
label: 1 John

text: MY deereſt, beleeue not euery ſpirit, but proue the ſpirites if they be of God: becauſe many falſe prophetes are gone out into the vvorld.
label: 1 John

text: In this is the ſpirit of God knovven. euery ſpirit that confeſſeth IESVS Chriſt to haue come in fleſh, is of God:
label: 1 John

text: and euery ſpirit that diſſolueth IESVS, is not of God: and this is cantichriſt, of vvhom you haue heard that he commeth, and novv he is in the vvorld.
label: 1 John

text: You are of God, litle children, and haue ouercome him. becauſe greater is he that is in you, then he that is in the world.
label: 1 John

text: They are of the vvorld: therfore of the vvorld they ſpeake, and the vvorld heareth them.
label: 1 John

text: VVe are of God. He that knovveth God, heareth vs. he that is not of God, heareth vs not. in this vve know the ſpirit of truth, and the ſpirit of errour.
label: 1 John

text: My deereſt, let vs loue one an other: becauſe charitie is of God. And euery one that loueth, is borne of God, & knovveth God.
label: 1 John

text: He that loueth not, knovveth not God: becauſe God is charitie.
label: 1 John

text: In this hath the charitie of God appeared in vs, becauſe God hath ſent his only-begotten ſonne into the vvorld, that vve may liue by him.
label: 1 John

text: In this is charitie: not as though vve haue loued him, but becauſe he hath loued vs, and ſent his ſonne a propitiation for our ſinnes.
label: 1 John

text: My deereſt, if God hath ſo loued vs: vve alſo ought to loue one an other.
label: 1 John

text: God no man hath ſeen at any time. If vve loue one an other, God abideth in vs, and his charitie in vs is perfited.
label: 1 John

text: In this vve knovv that vve abide in him, and he in vs: becauſe he of his Spirit hath giuen to vs.
label: 1 John

text: And vve haue ſeen, and doe teſtifie, that the Father hath ſent his Sonne the Sauiour of the vvorld.
label: 1 John

text: VVhoſoeuer ſhal confeſſe that IESVS is the Sonne of God, God abideth in him, and he in God.
label: 1 John

text: And vve haue knovven and haue beleeued the charitie, vvhich God hath in vs. God is charitie: and he that abideth in charitie, abideth in God, and God in him.
label: 1 John

text: In this is charitie perfited vvith vs, that vve may haue confidence in the day of iudgement: becauſe as he is, vve alſo are in the vvorld.
label: 1 John

text: Feare is not in charitie: but perfect charitie caſteth out feare, becauſe feare hath painefulnes. and he that feareth, is not perfect in charitie.
label: 1 John

text: Let vs therfore loue God, becauſe God firſt hath loued vs.
label: 1 John

text: If any man ſhal ſay, that I loue God: and hateth his brother, he is a lier. For he that loueth not his brother vvhom he ſeeth: God vvhom he ſeeth not, hovv can he loue?
label: 1 John

text: And this commaundement vve haue from God: that he vvhich loueth God, loue alſo his brother. ⊢
label: 1 John

text: WHOSOEVER beleeueth that IESVS is Chriſt, is borne of God. And euery one that loueth him vvhich begat: loueth him alſo vvhich vvas borne of him.
label: 1 John

text: In this vve knovv that vve loue the children of God: vvhen as we loue God, and keepe his commaundementes.
label: 1 John

text: For this is the charitie of God, that vve keepe his commaundementes: and his commaundementes are not heauy.
label: 1 John

text: Becauſe al that is borne of God, ouercommeth the vvorld. and this is the victorie vvhich ouercommeth the vvorld, our faith.
label: 1 John

text: VVho is he that ouercommeth the vvorld, but he that beleeueth that IESVS is the ſonne of God?
label: 1 John

text: This is he that came by vvater and bloud IESVS Chriſt: not in vvater only, but in vvater and bloud. And it is the Spirit vvhich teſtifieth, that Chriſt is the truth.
label: 1 John

text: For there be three vvhich giue teſtimonie in heauen, the Father, the VVord, and the Holy Ghoſt. and theſe three be one.
label: 1 John

text: And there be three vvhich giue teſtimonie in earth: the ſpirit, vvater, and bloud. `and theſe three be one'.
label: 1 John

text: If vve receiue the teſtimonie of men, the teſtimonie of God is greater. becauſe this is the teſtimonie of God vvhich is greater, that he hath teſtified of his ſonne.
label: 1 John

text: He that beleeueth in the ſonne of God, hath the teſtimonie of God in him ſelf. ⊢ He that beleeueth not the Sonne, maketh him a lier: becauſe he beleeueth not in the teſtimonie vvhich God hath teſtified of his ſonne.
label: 1 John

text: And this is the teſtimonie, that God hath giuen vs life euerlaſting. And this life is in his ſonne.
label: 1 John

text: He that hath the Sonne, hath life. he that hath not the ſonne of God, hath not life.
label: 1 John

text: Theſe thinges I vvrite to you, that you may knovv that you haue eternal life which beleeue in the name of the ſonne of God.
label: 1 John

text: And this is the confidence which vve haue toward him: that, vvhatſoeuer vve ſhal aſke according to his vvill, he heareth vs.
label: 1 John

text: And vve knovv that he heareth vs whatſoeuer vve ſhal aſke: vve knovv that vve haue the petitions vvhich vve requeſt of him.
label: 1 John

text: He that knoweth his brother to ſinne a ſinne not to death, let him aſke, and life ſhal be giuen him, ſinning not to death. There is a ſinne to death: for that I ſay not that any man aſke.
label: 1 John

text: Al iniquitie, is ſinne. And there is a ſinne `to death'.
label: 1 John

text: VVe know that euery one vvhich is borne of God, ſinneth not: But the generation of God preſerueth him, and the vvicked one toucheth him not.
label: 1 John

text: VVe knovv that vve are of God, and the vvhole vvorld is ſet in vvickedneſſe.
label: 1 John

text: And vve know that the ſonne of God commeth: and he hath giuen vs vnderſtanding, that vve may knovv the true God, & may be in his true ſonne. This is the true God, & life euerlaſting.
label: 1 John

text: My litle children, keepe your ſelues from Idols. Amen.
label: 1 John

text: THE Senior to the lady Elect and her children, vvhom I loue in truth, and not I onely, but alſo al that haue knowen the truth,
label: 2 John

text: for the truth vvhich abideth in vs, and ſhal be vvith vs for euer.
label: 2 John

text: Grace be vvith you, mercie, peace from God the Father, and from Chriſt IESVS the ſonne of the Father in truth, and charitie.
label: 2 John

text: I vvas exceding glad, becauſe I haue found of thy children vvalking in truth, as vve haue receiued commaundement of the Father.
label: 2 John

text: And novv I beſeeche thee Lady, not as vvriting a nevv commaundement to thee, but that vvhich vve haue had from the beginning, that vve loue one an other.
label: 2 John

text: And this is charitie, that vve vvalke according to his commaundements. For this is the commaundement, that as you haue heard from the beginning, you walke in the ſame:
label: 2 John

text: becauſe many ſeducers are gone out into the vvorld, vvhich do not confeſſe IESVS Chriſt to haue come into fleſh: this is a ſeducer and an antichriſt.
label: 2 John

text: Looke to your ſelues, that you loſe not the thinges vvhich you haue vvrought: but that you may receiue a ful revvard.
label: 2 John

text: Euery one that c reuolteth, and perſiſteth not in in the doctrine of Chriſt: hath not God. He that perſiſteth in the doctrine: the ſame hath both the Father, and the Sonne.
label: 2 John

text: If any man come to you, and bring not this doctrine: receiue him not into the houſe, nor ſay, God ſaue you, vnto him.
label: 2 John

text: For he that ſaith vnto him, God ſaue you, communicateth vvith his vvicked vvorkes.
label: 2 John

text: Hauing moe thinges to vvrite vnto you: I vvould not by paper and inke: for I hope that I ſhal be vvith you, and ſpeake mouth to mouth: that your ioy may be ful.
label: 2 John

text: The children of thy ſiſter electe ſalute thee.
label: 2 John

text: THE Seniour to Gaius the deereſt, whom I loue in truth.
label: 3 John

text: My deereſt, concerning al thinges I make my praier that thou proceede proſperouſly, and fare vvel, as thy ſoule doth proſperouſly.
label: 3 John

text: I vvas exceding glad vvhen the brethren came, and gaue teſtimonie to thy truth, euen as thou vvalkeſt in truth.
label: 3 John

text: Greater 'thanke' haue I not of them, then that I may heare my children do vvalke in truth.
label: 3 John

text: My deereſt, thou doeſt faithfully vvhatſoeuer thou vvorkeſt on the brethren, and that vpon ſtrangers.
label: 3 John

text: they haue rendred teſtimonie to thy charitie in the ſight of the Church: whom, thou ſhalt doe vvel, bringing on their vvay in maner vvorthie of God.
label: 3 John

text: For, for his name did they depart, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
label: 3 John

text: Vve therfore ought to receiue ſuch: that vve may be coadiutors of the truth.
label: 3 John

text: I had vvritten perhaps to the Church: but he that loueth to beare bprimacie among them, Diótrepes, doth not receiue vs.
label: 3 John

text: For this cauſe, if I come, I vvil aduertiſe his vvorkes vvhich he doeth: vvith malicious vvordes chatting againſt vs. and as though theſe thinges ſuffiſe him not: neither him ſelf doth receiue the brethren, and them that do receiue, he prohibiteth, and caſteth out of the Church.
label: 3 John

text: My deereſt, do not imitate euil, but that vvhich is good. He that doeth vvel, is of God: he that doeth il, hath not ſeen God.
label: 3 John

text: To Demetrius teſtimonie is giuen of al, and of the truth it ſelf, yea and vve giue teſtimonie: and thou knovveſt that our teſtimonie is true.
label: 3 John

text: I had many thinges to vvrite vnto thee: but I vvould not by inke and penne vvrite to thee.
label: 3 John

text: But I hope forthvvith to ſee thee, and vve vvil ſpeake mouth to mouth. Peace be to thee. The freendes ſalute thee. Salute the freendes by name.
label: 3 John

text: IVDE the ſeruant of IESVS Chriſt, and brother of Iames: to them that are in God the Father beloued, and in IESVS Chriſt preſerued, and called.
label: Jude

text: Mercie to you, and peace and charitie be accompliſhed.
label: Jude

text: My deereſt, taking al care to vvrite vnto you of your common ſaluation, I thought it neceſſarie to vvrite vnto you: beſeeching you to contend for the faith once deliuered to the ſainctes.
label: Jude

text: For there are certaine men ſecretely entred in (vvhich vvere long ago preſcribed vnto this iudgement) impious, transferring the grace of our God into riotouſnes, and denying the onely Dominator, and our Lord IESVS Chriſt.
label: Jude

text: But I vvil admoniſh you, that once knovv al things, that cIESVS, ſauing the people out of the land of Ægipt, ſecondly deſtroied them vvhich beleeued not.
label: Jude

text: But the Angels vvhich kept not their principalitie, but forſooke their owne habitation, he hath reſerued vnder darkeneſſe in eternal bondes vnto the iudgment of the great day.
label: Jude

text: As Sodom and Gomorrhe, and the cities adioyning in like maner hauing fornicated, and going after other fleſh, vvere made an example, ſuſtaining the paine of eternal fire.
label: Jude

text: In like maner theſe alſo defile the fleſh, and deſpiſe dominion, & blaſpheme maieſtie.
label: Jude

text: VVhen Michael the Archangel, diſputing vvith the Diuel, made altercation for the body of Moyſes: he durſt not inferre iudgment of blaſphemie, but ſaid, Our Lord commaund thee.
label: Jude

text: But theſe, vvhat things ſo euer certes they are ignorant of, they blaſpheme: and vvhat things ſo euer naturally, as dumme beaſtes, they knovv, in thoſe they are corrupted.
label: Jude
