text: VVo vnto them, vvhich haue gone in the way of Cain: and vvith the errour of Balaam, haue for revvard povvred out them ſelues, and haue periſhed in the contradiction of Corè.
label: Jude

text: Theſe are in their bankets, ſpottes, feaſting together vvithout feare, feeding them ſelues, cloudes vvithout vvater vvhich are caried about of vvindes, trees of autumne, vnfruiteful, tvviſe dead, plucked vp by the rootes,
label: Jude

text: raging vvaues of the ſea, foming out their ovvne confuſions, vvandering ſtarres: to vvhom the ſtorme of darkeneſſe is reſerued for euer.
label: Jude

text: And of theſe prophecied Enoch, the ſeuenth from Adam, ſaying, Behold our Lord is come in his holy thouſandes,
label: Jude

text: to doe iudgement againſt al, and to reproue al the impious, of al the vvorkes of their impietie vvherby they haue done impiouſly, and of al the hard thinges vvhich impious ſinners haue ſpoken againſt him.
label: Jude

text: Theſe are murmurers, ful of complaintes, vvalking according to their ovvne deſires, and their mouth ſpeaketh pride, admiring perſons for gaine ſake.
label: Jude

text: But you my deereſt, be mindeful of the vvordes vvhich haue been ſpoken before by the Apoſtles of our Lord IESVS Chriſt,
label: Jude

text: vvho told you, that in the laſt time ſhal come mockers, according to their ovvne deſires vvalking in impieties.
label: Jude

text: Theſe are they vvhich ſegregate them ſelues, ſenſual, hauing not the Spirit.
label: Jude

text: But you my deereſt, building your ſelues vpon our moſt holy faith, in the holy Ghoſt, praying,
label: Jude

text: keepe your ſelues in the loue of God, expecting the mercie of our Lord IESVS Chriſt vnto life euerlaſting.
label: Jude

text: And theſe certes reproue being iudged:
label: Jude

text: but them ſaue, pulling out of the fire. And on other haue mercie in feare: hating alſo that vvhich is carnal, the ſpotted cote.
label: Jude

text: And to him that is able to preſerue you vvithout ſinne, and to ſette you immaculate before the ſight of his glorie in exultation in the comming of our Lord IESVS Chriſt,
label: Jude

text: to the onely God our Sauiour by IESVS Chriſt our Lord be glorie and magnificence, empire and power before al worldes, and now and for al vvorldes euermore. Amen.
label: Jude

text: THE Apocalypſe of IESVS Chriſt, vvhich God gaue him, to make manifeſt to his ſeruants the things vvhich muſt be done quickly: and ſignified, ſending by his Angel to his ſeruant Iohn,
label: Apocalypse

text: who hath giuen teſtimonie to the word of God, and the teſtimonie of IESVS Chriſt, what things ſoeuer he hath ſeen.
label: Apocalypse

text: Bleſſed is he that readeth and heareth the wordes of this prophecie: and keepeth thoſe thinges which be vvritten in it. for the time is nigh.
label: Apocalypse

text: Iohn to the ſeuen churches vvhich are in Aſia. Grace to you and peace from him that is, and that vvas, and that ſhal come, and from the ſeuen ſpirites vvhich are in the ſight of his throne,
label: Apocalypse

text: and from IESVS Chriſt vvho is the faithful vvitnes, the firſt-borne of the dead, & the prince of the kings of the earth, vvho hath loued vs, and vvaſhed vs from our ſinnes in his bloud, ⊢
label: Apocalypse

text: and hath made vs a kingdom and prieſtes to God and his father, to him be glorie and empire for euer and euer. Amen.
label: Apocalypse

text: Behold he commeth with the cloudes, and euery eie ſhal ſee him, and they that pricked him. And al the tribes of the earth ſhal bevvaile them ſelues vpon him. yea, Amen.
label: Apocalypse

text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and end, ſaith our Lord God, vvhich is, and vvhich vvas, and vvhich ſhal come, the omnipotent.
label: Apocalypse

text: I Iohn your brother and partaker in tribulation, and the kingdom, and patience in Chriſt IESVS, vvas in the Iland, vvhich is called Patmos, for the vvord of God and the teſtimonie of IESVS.
label: Apocalypse

text: I vvas in ſpirit on the Dominical day, and heard behind me a great voice as it vvere of a trompet
label: Apocalypse

text: ſaying, That vvhich thou ſeeſt, write in a booke: and ſend to the ſeuen churches vvhich are in Aſia, to Epheſus, and Smyrna, and Pergamus, and Thiatira, and Sardis, and Philadelphia, and Laodicia.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I turned, to ſee the voice that ſpake vvith me. And being turned I ſavv ſeuen candleſtickes of gold:
label: Apocalypse

text: & in the middes of the ſeuen candleſtickes of gold, one like to the Sonne of man, veſted in a cprieſtly garment to the foote, and girded about neere to the pappes vvith a girdle of gold.
label: Apocalypse

text: and his head and heares vvere vvhite, as vvhite vvool, & as ſnow, and his eies as the flame of fire.
label: Apocalypse

text: and his feete like to latten, as in a burning fornace. and his voice as the voice of many vvaters:
label: Apocalypse

text: and he had in his right hand ſeuen ſtarres. and from his mouth proceded a ſharpe two edged ſvvord: and his face, as the ſunne ſhineth in his vertue.
label: Apocalypse

text: And vvhen I had ſeene him, I fel at his feete as dead. And he put his right hand vpon me, ſaying, Feare not. I am the firſt and the laſt,
label: Apocalypse

text: and aliue, and vvas dead, and behold I am liuing for euer and euer, and haue the keies of death and of hel.
label: Apocalypse

text: Vvrite therefore the thinges vvhich thou haſt ſeene, and that are, and that muſt be done after theſe.
label: Apocalypse

text: The ſacrament of the ſeuen ſtarres, vvhich thou haſt ſeene in my right hand, and the ſeuen candleſtickes of Gold. the ſeuen ſtarres, are the angels of the ſeuen churches. and the ſeuen candleſtickes, are the ſeuen churches.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND to the Angel of the Church of Epheſus vvrite, Thus ſaith he vvhich holdeth the ſeuen ſtarres in his right hand, vvhich vvalketh in the middes of the ſeuen candleſtickes of gold,
label: Apocalypse

text: I know thy vvorkes and labour, and thy patience: and that thou canſt not beare euil men, and haſt tried them which ſay them ſelues to be Apoſtles, and are not, and haſt found them liars:
label: Apocalypse

text: and thou haſt patience, and haſt borne for my name, and haſt not fainted.
label: Apocalypse

text: But I haue againſt thee a fevv thinges, bicauſe thou haſt left thy firſt charitie.
label: Apocalypse

text: Be mindeful therfore from vvhence thou art fallen: and doe penance, and doe the firſt vvorkes. But if not: I come to thee, and vvil moue thy candleſticke out of his place, vnleſſe thou doe penance.
label: Apocalypse

text: but this thou haſt, becauſe thou hateſt the factes of the Nicolaites, vvhich I alſo hate.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that hath an eare, let him heare vvhat the Spirit ſaith to the Churches, To him that ouercommeth, I vvil giue to eate of the tree of life, which is in the Paradiſe of my God.
label: Apocalypse

text: And to the Angel of the Church of Smyrna write, Thus ſaith the firſt and the laſt, vvho vvas dead, and liueth,
label: Apocalypse

text: I knovv thy tribulation and thy pouertie, but thou art riche: and thou art blaſphemed of them that ſay them ſelues to be Iewes and are not, but are the ſynagogue of Satan.
label: Apocalypse

text: Feare none of theſe thinges vvhich thou ſhalt ſuffer. Behold the Deuil vvil ſend ſome of you into priſon that you may be tried: and you ſhal haue tribulation ten daies. Be thou faithful vntil death: and I vvil giue thee the crovvne of life.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that hath an eare, let him heare vvhat the Spirit ſaith to the Churches, He that ſhal ouercome, ſhal not be hurt of the ſecond death.
label: Apocalypse

text: And to the Angel of the Church of Pergamus write, Thus ſaith he that hath the ſharpe tvvo edged ſvvord,
label: Apocalypse

text: I know vvhere thou dvvelleſt, vvhere the ſeate of Satan is: and thou holdeſt my name, and haſt not denied my faith. And in thoſe daies Antipas my faithful witneſſe, vvho vvas ſlaine among you, vvhere Satan dvvelleth.
label: Apocalypse

text: But I haue againſt thee a fevv thinges: becauſe thou haſt there, them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, vvho taught Balac to caſt a ſcandal before the children of Iſrael, to eate and commit fornication:
label: Apocalypse

text: ſo haſt thou alſo them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaites.
label: Apocalypse

text: In like maner doe penance. if not: I wil come to thee quickly, and vvil fight againſt them vvith the ſword of my mouth.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that hath an eare, let him heare vvhat the Spirit ſaith to the Churches, To him that ouercommeth I vvil giue the hidden manna, and vvil giue him a vvhite ccounter: and in the counter, a nevv name Written, vvhich no man knoweth, but he that receiueth it.
label: Apocalypse

text: And to the Angel of the Church of Thyatira write, Thus ſaith the Sonne of God, which hath eies as a flame of fire, and his feete like to latten.
label: Apocalypse

text: I knovv thy vvorkes, and faith, and thy charitie, and miniſterie, and thy patience and thy laſt vvorkes moe then the former.
label: Apocalypse

text: But I haue againſt thee a fevv thinges: becauſe thou permitteſt the woman Iezabel, vvho calleth her ſelf a propheteſſe, to teache, and to ſeduce my ſeruantes, to fornicate, and to eate of thinges ſacrificed to idols.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I gaue her a time that ſhe might do penance: and ſhe vvil not repent from her fornication.
label: Apocalypse

text: Behold I vvil caſt her into a bedde: and they that commit aduoutrie vvith her, ſhal be in very great tribulation, vnleſſe they do penance from their workes:
label: Apocalypse

text: and her children I wil kil vnto death, and al the Churches ſhal knovv that I am he that ſearcheth the reines and hartes, and I vvil giue to euery one of you according to his vvorkes.
label: Apocalypse

text: But I ſay to you the reſt vvhich are at Thyatira, whoſoeuer haue not this doctrine, which haue not knowen the depth of Satan, as they ſay, I vvil not caſt vpon you an other weight.
label: Apocalypse

text: Yet that vvhich you haue, hold til I come.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he that ſhal ouercome and keepe my vvorkes vnto the end: I vvil giue him povver ouer the nations,
label: Apocalypse

text: and he ſhal rule them vvith a rod of yron, and as the veſſel of a potter ſhal they be broken,
label: Apocalypse

text: as I alſo haue receiued of my father: and I vvil giue him the morning ſtarre.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that hath an eare, let him heare vvhat the Spirit ſaith to the Churches.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND to the Angel of the Church of Sardis, write, Thus ſaith he that hath the ſeuen Spirites of God, and the ſeuen ſtarres, I know thy vvorkes, that thou haſt the name that thou liueſt, and thou art dead.
label: Apocalypse

text: Be vigilant, and confirme the reſt of the things vvhich vvere to die. For I finde not thy vvorkes ful before my God.
label: Apocalypse

text: Haue in minde therfore in vvhat maner thou haſt receiued and heard: and keepe, and doe penance. If therfore thou vvatch not, I wil come to thee as a theefe, & thou ſhalt not know what houre I wil come to thee.
label: Apocalypse

text: But thou haſt a fevv names in Sardis, vvhich haue not defiled their garments: and they ſhal vvalke vvith me in vvhites, becauſe they are vvorthy.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that ſhal ouercome, ſhal thus be veſted in vvhite garmentes, and I wil not put his name out of the booke of life, and I vvil confeſſe his name before my father, and before his Angels.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that hath an eare, let him heare vvhat the Spirit ſaith to the Churches.
label: Apocalypse

text: And to the Angel of the Church of Philadelphia vvrite, Thus ſaith the Holy one and the True one, he that hath the key of Dauid: he that openeth, and no man ſhutteth: ſhutteth, and no man openeth.
label: Apocalypse

text: I know thy vvorkes. Behold I haue giuen before thee a doore opened which no man can ſhut: becauſe thou haſt a litle povver, and haſt kept my vvord, and haſt not denied my name.
label: Apocalypse

text: Behold I vvil giue of the ſynagogue of Satan, vvhich ſay they be Ievves, and are not, but doe lie. Behold I wil make them come and adore before thy feete. and they ſhal knovv that I haue loued thee.
label: Apocalypse

text: becauſe thou haſt kept the vvord of my patience, and I vvil keepe thee from the houre of tentation, which ſhal come vpon the vvhole world to tempt the inhabitants on the earth.
label: Apocalypse

text: Behold I come quickely: hold that which thou haſt, that no man take thy crovvne.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that ſhal ouercome, I vvil make him a piller in the temple of my God: and he ſhal goe out no more: and I vvil vvrite vpon him the name of my God, and the name of the citie of my God, new Hieruſalem vvhich deſcendeth out of heauen from my God, and my nevv name.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that hath an eare, let him heare vvhat the Spirit ſaith to the Churches.
label: Apocalypse

text: And to the Angel of the Church of Laodicia write, Thus ſaith Amen, the faithful and true witneſſe, vvhich is the beginning of the creature of God.
label: Apocalypse

text: I know thy vvorkes, that thou art neither colde, nor hote. I vvould thou vvere colde, or hote.
label: Apocalypse

text: But becauſe thou art lukevvarme, and neither cold nor hote, I vvil begin to vomite thee out of my mouth.
label: Apocalypse

text: Becauſe thou ſaieſt, That I am riche, and enriched, and lacke nothing: and knovveſt not that thou art a miſer, and miſerable, and poore, and blinde, and naked.
label: Apocalypse

text: I counſel thee to bye of me gold fire-tried, that thou maieſt be made riche: and maieſt be clothed in vvhite garmentes, that the confuſion of thy nakednes appeare not: and vvith eie-ſalue anoint thine eies, that thou maieſt ſee.
label: Apocalypse

text: I, vvhom I loue, do rebuke and chaſtiſe. Be zelous therfore and doe penance.
label: Apocalypse

text: Behold I ſtand at the doore and knocke. if any man ſhal heare my voice, and open the gate, I vvil enter in to him, and vvil ſuppe vvith him, and he vvith me.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that ſhal ouercome, I vvil giue vnto him to ſitte vvith me in my throne: as I alſo haue ouercome, and haue ſitten vvith my father in his throne.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that hath an eare, let him heare what the Spirit ſaith to the Churches.
label: Apocalypse

text: AFTER theſe things I looked, and behold a doore open in heauen, and the firſt voice which I heard, vvas as it vvere of a trompet ſpeaking vvith me, ſaying, Come vp hither, and I vvil ſhevv thee the thinges vvhich muſt be done quickly after theſe.
label: Apocalypse

text: Immediatly I vvas in ſpirit: and behold there vvas a ſeate ſette in heauen, and vpon the ſeate one ſitting.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he that ſate, vvas like in ſight, to the Iaſper ſtone, and the Sardine: and there vvas a raine-bovv round about the ſeate, like to the ſight of an Emeraud.
label: Apocalypse

text: And round about the ſeate, foure and tvventie ſeates: and vpon the thrones, foure and twentie ſeniors ſitting, clothed about in vvhite garmentes, and on their heades crovvnes of gold.
label: Apocalypse

text: And from the throne proceeded lightenings, and voices, and thunders: and ſeuen lampes burning before the throne, vvhich are the ſeuen Spirites of God.
label: Apocalypse

text: And in the ſight of the ſeate, as it vvere a ſea of glaſſe like to cryſtall: and in the middes of the ſeate and round about the ſeate foure beaſtes ful of eies before and behind.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the firſt beaſt, like to a lion: and the ſecond beaſt, like to a calfe: and the third beaſt, hauing the face as it vvere of a man: and the fourth beaſt, like to an egle flying.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the foure beaſtes, euery one of them had ſixe vvinges round about: and vvithin they are ful of eies. and they had no reſt day and night, ſaying, Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God omnipotent, vvhich vvas, and vvhich is, and vvhich ſhal come.
label: Apocalypse

text: And vvhen thoſe beaſtes gaue glorie and honour and benediction to him that ſitteth vpon the throne, that liueth for euer and euer:
label: Apocalypse

text: the foure and tvventie ſeniors fel dovvne before him that ſitteth in the throne, and adored him that liueth for euer and euer, and caſt their crovvnes before the throne, ſaying,
label: Apocalypse

text: Thou art vvorthie O Lord our God to receiue glorie and honour and povver: becauſe thou haſt created al thinges, and for thy vvil they vvere and haue been created.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND I ſavv in the right hand of him that ſate vpon the throne, a booke vvritten vvithin and vvithout, ſealed vvith ſeuen ſeales.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv a ſtrong Angel, preaching vvith a loude voice, Vvho is vvorthie to open the booke, & to looſe the ſeales thereof?
label: Apocalypse

text: And no man vvas able neither in heauen nor in earth, nor vnder the earth, to open the booke, nor looke on it.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I vvept much becauſe no man vvas found vvorthie to open the booke, nor to ſee it.
label: Apocalypse

text: And one of the ſeniors ſaid to me, Vveepe not: behold the lion of the tribe of Iuda, the roote of Dauid, hath vvonne, to open the booke, and to looſe the ſeuen ſeales thereof.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv, and behold in the middes of the throne and of the foure beaſtes and in the middes of the ſeniors, a Lambe ſtanding as it were ſlaine, hauing ſeuen hornes & ſeuen eies: vvhich are the ſeuen ſpirites of God, ſent into al the earth.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he came, and receiued the booke out of the right hand of him that ſate in the throne.
label: Apocalypse

text: And vvhen he had opened the booke, the foure beaſtes and the foure and tvventie ſeniors fel before the Lambe, hauing euery one harpes, and golden vials ful of odours, which are the praiers of ſainctes:
label: Apocalypse

text: and they ſang a nevv canticle, ſaying, Thou art vvorthie o Lord to take the booke, and to open the ſeales thereof: becauſe thou vvaſt ſlaine, and haſt redeemed vs to God in thy bloud out of euery tribe and tonge and people and nation,
label: Apocalypse

text: and haſt made vs to our God a kingdom and prieſtes, and vve ſhal reigne vpon the earth.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I looked, and heard the voice of many Angels round about the throne, and of the beaſtes and of the ſeniors: and the number of them vvas thouſandes of thouſandes,
label: Apocalypse

text: ſaying vvith a loud voice, The Lambe that vvas ſlaine, is vvorthie to receiue povver, and diuinitie, and vviſedom, and ſtrength, and honour, and glorie, and benediction. ⊢
label: Apocalypse

text: And euery creature that is in heauen, and vpon the earth, and vnder the earth, and that are in the ſea, and that are therein: al did I heare ſaying, To him that ſitteth in the throne, & to the Lambe, benediction and honour and glorie and povver for euer and euer.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the foure beaſtes ſaid, Amen. And the foure and tvventie ſeniors fel on their faces: and adored him that liueth for euer and euer. ⊢
label: Apocalypse

text: AND I ſavv that the Lambe had opened one of the ſeuen ſeales, and I heard one of the foure beaſtes, ſaying, as it vvere the voice of thunder, Come, and ſee.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv: And behold a vvhite horſe, and he that ſate vpon him had a bovv, and there vvas a crovvne giuen him, and he vvent forth conquering that he might conquer.
label: Apocalypse

text: And vvhen he had opened the ſecond ſeale, I heard the ſecond beaſt, ſaying, Come, & ſee.
label: Apocalypse

text: And there vvent forth an other horſe, redde: and he that ſate thereon, to him it vvas giuen that he ſhould take peace from the earth, and that they ſhould kil one an other, and a great ſvvord vvas giuen to him.
label: Apocalypse

text: And vvhen he had opened the third ſeale, I heard the third beaſt, ſaying, Come, and ſee. And behold a blacke horſe, and he that ſate vpon him, had a balance in his hand.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I heard as it vvere a voice in the middes of the foure beaſtes ſaying: Tvvo poundes of vvheate for a penie, and thriſe tvvo poundes of barley for a penie, and vvine and oile hurt thou not.
label: Apocalypse

text: And vvhen he had opened the fourth ſeale, I heard a voice of the fourth beaſt, ſaying, Come, & ſee.
label: Apocalypse

text: And behold a pale horſe: and he that ſate vpon him, his name vvas death, and hel folovved him. and povver vvas giuen to him ouer the foure partes of the earth, to kil vvith ſvvord, vvith famine, and vvith death, and vvith beaſtes of the earth.
label: Apocalypse

text: And vvhen he had opened the fifth ſeale: I ſavv vnder the altar the ſoules of them that vvere ſlaine for the vvord of God, and for the teſtimonie vvhich they had.
label: Apocalypse

text: and they cried vvith a loude voice, ſaying, Hovv long Lord, holy & true, iudgeſt thou not and reuengeſt thou not our bloud of them that dvvel on the earth?
label: Apocalypse

text: And vvhite ſtoles vvere giuen, to euery one of them one: and it vvas ſaid to them, that they ſhould reſt yet a litle time, til their fellovv-ſeruantes be complete, and their brethren, that are to be ſlaine euen as they.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv, vvhen he had opened the ſixt ſeale, and behold there vvas made a great earth-quake, and the ſunne became blacke as it vvere ſacke cloth of heare: and the vvhole moone became as bloud:
label: Apocalypse

text: and the ſtarres from heauen fel vpon the earth, as the figge tree caſteth her greene figges when it is ſhaken of a great vvinde:
label: Apocalypse

text: and heauen departed as a booke folded together: and euery hil, and ilandes vvere moued out of their places.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the kinges of the earth, & princes, and tribunes, and the riche, and the ſtrong, and euery bond-man, and free-man hid them ſelues in the dennes and the rockes of mountaines.
label: Apocalypse

text: And they ſay to the mountaines and the rockes: Fall vpon vs, and hide vs from the face of him that ſitteth vpon the throne, and from the vvrath of the Lambe:
label: Apocalypse

text: becauſe the great day of their vvrath is come, and vvho ſhal be able to ſtand?
label: Apocalypse

text: AFTER theſe things I ſavv foure Angels ſtanding vpon the foure corners of the earth, holding the foure vvindes of the earth that they ſhould not blovv vpon the land, nor vpon the ſea, nor on any tree.
label: Apocalypse

text: b And I ſavv an other Angel aſcending from the riſing of the ſunne, hauing the ſigne of the liuing God: & he cried vvith a loud voice to the foure Angels, to vvhom it vvas giuen to hurt the earth and the ſea,
label: Apocalypse

text: ſaying, Hurt not the earth and the ſea, nor the trees, til vve ſigne the ſeruants of our God in their foreheades.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I heard the number of them that vvere ſigned, an hundred fourtie foure thouſand vvere ſigned, of euery tribe of the children of Iſraël.
label: Apocalypse

text: Of the tribe of Iuda, tvvelue thouſand ſigned. Of the tribe of Ruben, tvvelue thouſand ſigned. Of the tribe of Gad, tvvelue thouſand ſigned.
label: Apocalypse

text: Of the tribe of Aſer, tvvelue thouſand ſigned. Of the tribe of Nephthali, tvvelue thouſand ſigned. Of the tribe of Manaſſes, tvvelue thouſand ſigned.
label: Apocalypse

text: Of the tribe of Simeon, tvvelue thouſand ſigned. Of the tribe of Leui, tvvelue thouſand ſigned. Of the tribe of Iſſachar, tvvelue thouſand ſigned.
label: Apocalypse

text: Of the tribe of Zabulon, tvvelue thouſand ſigned. Of the tribe of Ioſeph, tvvelue thouſand ſigned. Of the tribe of Beniamin, tvvelue thouſand ſigned.
label: Apocalypse

text: After theſe things I ſavv a great multitude vvhich no man could number, of al nations, and tribes, and peoples, & tonges: ſtanding before the throne, and in the ſight of the Lambe, clothed in vvhite robes, and palmes in their hands:
label: Apocalypse

text: And they cried vvith a lovvd voice, ſaying, Saluation to our God vvhich ſitteth vpon the throne, and to the Lambe.
label: Apocalypse

text: and al the Angels ſtoode in the circuite of the throne and of the ſeniors and of the foure beaſtes: and they fel in the ſight of the throne vpon their faces, and adored God,
label: Apocalypse

text: ſaying, Amen. Benediction, and glorie, and vviſedom, & thankeſgiuing, honour and povver, and ſtrength to our God for euer and euer. Amen. ⊢
label: Apocalypse

text: And one of the ſeniors anſvvered, & ſaid to me, Theſe that are clothed in the vvhite robes, vvho be they? & vvhence came they?
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſaid to him, My Lord thou knovveſt. And he ſaid to me, Theſe are they vvhich are come out of great tribulation, and haue vvaſhed their robes, and made them vvhite in the bloud of the Lambe.
label: Apocalypse

text: therfore they are before the throne of God, and they ſerue him day and night in his temple: and he that ſitteth in the throne, ſhal dvvel ouer them.
label: Apocalypse

text: they ſhal no more hunger nor thirſt, neither ſhal the ſunne fall vpon them, nor any heate.
label: Apocalypse

text: becauſe the Lambe vvhich is in the middes of the throne, ſhal rule them, and ſhal conduct them to the liuing fountaines of vvaters, and God vvil vvipe avvay al teares from their eies. ⊢
label: Apocalypse

text: AND vvhen he had opened the ſeuenth ſeale, there vvas made ſilence in heauen, as it vvere halfe an houre.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv ſeuen Angels ſtanding in the ſight of God: and there vvere giuen to them ſeuen trompets.
label: Apocalypse

text: And an other Angel came, and ſtoode before the altar, hauing a golden cenſar: and there vvere giuen to him many incenſes, that he ſhould giue of the praiers of al ſainctes vpon the altar of gold, vvhich is before the throne of God.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the ſmoke of the incenſes of the praiers of the ſainctes aſcended from the hand of the Angel before God.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the Angel tooke the cenſar, and filled it of the fire of the altar, and caſt it on the earth, and there vvere made thunders & voices and lightenings, and a great earthquake.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the ſeuen Angels vvhich had the ſeuen trompets, prepared them ſelues to ſound vvith the trompet.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the firſt Angel ſounded vvith the trompet, and there vvas made haile and fire, mingled in bloud, and it vvas caſt on the earth, & the third part of the earth was burnt, & the third part of trees vvas burnt, and al greene graſſe vvas burnt.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the ſecond Angel ſounded vvith the trompet: and as it vvere a great mountaine burning vvith fire, vvas caſt into the ſea, and the third part of the ſea vvas made bloud:
label: Apocalypse

text: and the third part of thoſe creatures died, vvhich had liues in the ſea, and the third part of the ſhippes periſhed.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the third Angel ſounded vvith the trompet, and a great ſtarre fel from heauen, burning as it vvere a torche, and it fel on the third part of the floudes, and on the fountaines of vvaters:
label: Apocalypse

text: and the name of the ſtarre is called vvormevvod. and the third part of the vvaters was made into Worme Wod: and many men died of the vvaters, becauſe they vvere made bitter.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the fourth Angel ſounded vvith the trompet, and the third part of the ſunne vvas ſmitten, and the third part of the moone, and the third part of the ſtarres, ſo that the third part of them vvas darkened, and of the day there ſhined not the third part, and of the night in like maner.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I looked, and heard the voice of one egle flying through the middes of heauen, ſaying vvith a loud voice, Vvo, vvo, vvo to the inhabiters on the earth: becauſe of the reſt of the voices of the three Angels vvhich vvere to ſound vvith the trompet.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND the fifth Angel ſounded vvith the trompet, and I ſavv a ſtarre to haue fallen from heauen vpon the earth, and there vvas giuen to him the key of the pitte of bottomles depth.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he opened the pitte of the bottomles depth: and the ſmoke of the pitte aſcended, as the ſmoke of a great fornace: and the ſunne vvas darkened & the aier vvith the ſmoke of the pitte.
label: Apocalypse

text: And from the ſmoke of the pitte there iſſued forth clocuſtes into the earth. and povver vvas giuen to them, as the ſcorpions of the earth haue povver:
label: Apocalypse

text: and it vvas commaunded them that they ſhould not hurt the graſſe of the earth nor any greene thing, nor any tree: but onely men vvhich haue not the ſigne of God in their foreheads.
label: Apocalypse

text: and it vvas giuen vnto them that they ſhould not kil them: but that they ſhould be tormented fiue monethes: and their tormentes as the tormentes of a ſcorpion vvhen he ſtriketh a man.
label: Apocalypse

text: And in thoſe daies men ſhal ſeeke for death, and ſhal not finde it: and they ſhal deſire to die, & death ſhal flee from them.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the ſimilitudes of the locuſtes, like to horſes prepared into battel: and vpon their heades as it vvere crovvnes like to gold: & their faces as the faces of men.
label: Apocalypse

text: And they had heare as the heare of vvomen: & their teeth vvere as of lions.
label: Apocalypse

text: And they had habbergions as habbergions of yron, and the voice of their vvinges as the voice of the chariotes of many horſes running into battel.
label: Apocalypse

text: and they had tailes like to ſcorpions, and ſtinges vvere in their tailes: and their povver vvas to hurt men fiue monethes.
label: Apocalypse

text: and they had ouer them a king, the Angel of the bottomles depth, vvhoſe name in Hebrevv is Abaddon, and in Greeke Apollyon: in Latin hauing the name Exterminans.
label: Apocalypse

text: One vvoe is gone, & behold two vvoes come yet after theſe.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the ſixt Angel ſounded vvith the trompet: and I heard one voice from the foure hornes of the golden altar, vvhich is before the eies of God,
label: Apocalypse

text: ſaying to the ſixt Angel which had the trompet, Looſe the foure Angels which are bound in the great riuer Euphrates.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the foure Angels vvere looſed, vvho vvere prepared for an houre, and a day and a moneth and a yere: that they might kil the third part of men.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the number of the armie of horſemen vvas tvventie thouſand times ten thouſand. And I heard the number of them.
label: Apocalypse

text: And ſo I ſavv the horſes in the viſion: & they that ſate vpon them, had habbergions of fire and of hyacinth and brimſtone. & the heades of the horſes were as it were the heads of lions: & from their mouth procedeth fire, & ſmoke, and brimſtone.
label: Apocalypse

text: And by theſe three plagues vvas ſlaine the third part of men,, of the fire and of the ſmoke and of the brimſtone, vvhich proceded from their mouth.
label: Apocalypse

text: For the povver of the horſes is in their mouth, and in their tailes. for, their tailes be like to ſerpents, hauing heads: and in theſe they hurt.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the reſt of men vvhich vvere not ſlaine vvith theſe plagues, neither haue done penance from the vvorkes of their hands, not to adore Deuils and Idols of gold and ſiluer and braſſe and ſtone and vvood, vvhich neither can ſee, nor heare, nor vvalke,
label: Apocalypse

text: & haue not done penance from their murders, nor from their ſorceries, nor from their fornication, nor from their theftes.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND I ſavv an other Angel, ſtrong, deſcending from heauen, clothed vvith a cloude, and a raine-bovv on his head, and his face vvas as the ſunne, and his feete as `a piller' of fire.
label: Apocalypse

text: and he had in his hand a litle booke opened: and he put his right foote vpon the ſea, and his left vpon the land.
label: Apocalypse

text: and he cried vvith a loude voice, as vvhen a lion roareth. And vvhen he had cried, the ſeuen thunders ſpake their voices.
label: Apocalypse

text: And vvhen the ſeuen thunders had ſpoken their voices, I vvas about to vvrite: and I heard a voice from heauen ſaying to me: Signe the things vvhich the ſeuen thunders haue ſpoken: and vvrite them not.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the Angel vvhich I ſavv ſtanding vpon the ſea and vpon the land, lifted vp his hand to heauen,
label: Apocalypse

text: and he ſvvare by him that liueth for euer and euer, that created heauen and thoſe things vvhich are in it: and the earth, and thoſe things vvhich are in it: and the ſea, and thoſe things vvhich are in it: That there ſhal be time no more:
label: Apocalypse

text: but in the daies of the voice of the ſeuenth Angel, vvhen the trompet ſhal beginne to ſound, the myſterie of God ſhal be conſummate, as he hath euangelized by his ſeruantes the Prophetes.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I heard a voice from heauen againe ſpeaking with me, and ſaying: Goe, and take the booke that is opened, of the hand of the Angel ſtanding vpon the ſea and vpon the land.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I vvent to the Angel, ſaying vnto him, that he ſhould giue me the booke. And he ſaid to me, Take the booke, and deuoure it: and it ſhal make thy belly to be bitter, but in thy mouth it ſhal be ſvveete as it vvere honie.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I tooke the booke of the hand of the Angel, and deuoured it: & it vvas in my mouth as it vvere honie, ſvveete. and vvhen I had deuoured it, my bellie vvas made bitter,
label: Apocalypse

text: and he ſaid to me, Thou muſt againe prophecie to Nations, and peoples, and tonges, and many kinges.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND there vvas giuen me a reede like vnto a rodde: and it vvas ſaid to me, Ariſe, and meaſure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that adore in it.
label: Apocalypse

text: but the court vvhich is vvithout the temple, caſt forth, & meaſure not that: becauſe it is giuen to the Gentiles, & they ſhal treade vnder foote the holy citie two and fourtie monethes:
label: Apocalypse

text: and I vvil giue to my tvvo vvitneſſes, and they ſhal prophecie a thouſand tvvo hundred ſixtie daies, clothed vvith ſacke-clothes.
label: Apocalypse

text: Theſe are the two oliue trees and the tvvo candleſtickes that ſtand in the ſight of the Lord of the earth.
label: Apocalypse

text: And if any man vvil hurt them, fire ſhal come forth out of their mouthes, and ſhal deuoure their enemies. and if any man vvil hurt them: ſo muſt he be ſlaine.
label: Apocalypse

text: Theſe haue power to ſhut heauen, that it raine not in the daies of their prophecie: and they haue povver ouer the vvaters to turne them into bloud, and to ſtrike the earth vvith al plague as often as they vvil.
label: Apocalypse

text: And vvhen they ſhal haue finiſhed their teſtimonie: the beaſt vvhich aſcended from the depth, ſhal make vvarre againſt them, and ſhal ouercome them, and kil them.
label: Apocalypse

text: And their bodies ſhal lie in the ſtreates of the great citie, vvhich is called ſpiritually Sodom and Ægypt, vvhere their Lord alſo vvas crucified.
label: Apocalypse

text: And there ſhal of tribes, and peoples, and tonges, and Gentiles, ſee their bodies for three daies and a halfe: and they ſhal not ſuffer their bodies to be laid in monuments.
label: Apocalypse

text: and the inhabitants of the earth ſhal be glad vpon them, and make merie: and ſhal ſend giftes one to an other, becauſe theſe tvvo prophets tormented them that dvvelt vpon the earth.
label: Apocalypse

text: And after three daies and a halfe, the ſpirit of life from God entred into them. And they ſtoode vpon their feete, and great feare fel vpon them that ſavv them.
label: Apocalypse

text: And they heard a loud voice from heauen ſaying to them, Come vp hither. And they vvent vp into heauen in a cloude: and their enemies ſavv them.
label: Apocalypse

text: And in that houre there vvas made a great earthquake: and the tenth part of the citie fel: and there vvere ſlaine in the earthquake names of men ſeuen thouſand: and the reſt vvere caſt into a feare, and gaue glorie to the God of heauen.
label: Apocalypse

text: The ſecond vvoe is gone: and behold the third vvoe vvil come quickly.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the ſeuenth Angel ſounded with a trompet: and there vvere made loude voices in heauen ſaying, The kingdom of this vvorld is made our Lords & his Chriſts, and he ſhal reigne for euer and euer. Amen.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the foure and tvventie ſeniours vvhich ſitte on their ſeates in the ſight of God, fel on their faces, and adored God,
label: Apocalypse

text: ſaying: Vve thanke thee Lord God omnipotent, vvhich art, and vvhich vvaſt, and vvhich ſhalt come: becauſe thou haſt receiued thy great povver, and haſt reigned.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the Gentiles vvere angrie, and thy vvrath is come, and the time of the dead, to be iudged, and to render revvard to thy ſeruants the prophets and ſainctes, and to them that feare thy name, litle and great, and to deſtroy them that haue corrupted the earth.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the temple of God vvas opened in heauen: and the arke of his teſtament vvas ſeen in his temple, and there vvere made lightenings, and voices, and an earthquake and greate haile.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND a great ſigne appeared in heauen: a vvoman clothed vvith the ſunne, and the moone vnder her feete, & on her head a crovvne of tvvelue ſtarres:
label: Apocalypse

text: & being with childe, ſhe cried alſo traueling, and is in anguiſh to be deliuered.
label: Apocalypse

text: And there vvas ſeen an other ſigne in heauen, and behold a great red dragon hauing ſeuē heades, & ten hornes: and on his heades ſeuen diademes,
label: Apocalypse

text: & his taile drevv the third part of the ſtarres of heauen, and caſt them to the earth, and the dragon ſtoode before the vvoman which vvas ready to be deliuered: that vvhen ſhe ſhould be deliuered, he might deuoure her ſonne.
label: Apocalypse

text: And ſhe brought forth a man childe, vvho vvas to gouerne al nations in an yron rodde: & her ſonne vvas taken vp to God and to his throne,
label: Apocalypse

text: & the vvoman fled into the vvilderneſſe where ſhe had a place prepared of God, that there they might feede her a thouſand tvvo hundred ſixtie daies.
label: Apocalypse

text: And there vvas made a great battel in heauen, Michael and his Angels fought vvith the dragon, and the dragon fought and his Angels:
label: Apocalypse

text: and they preuailed not, neither vvas their place found any more in heauen.
label: Apocalypse

text: And that great dragon vvas caſt forth, the old ſerpent, vvhich is called the Deuil and Satan, vvhich ſeduceth the vvhole vvorld: and he vvas caſt into the earth, & his Angels vvere throvven downe vvith him.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I heard a great voice in heauen ſaying: Novv is there made ſaluation and force, and the kingdom of our God, and the povver of his Chriſt: becauſe the accuſer of our brethren is caſt forth, vvho accuſed them before the ſight of our God day and night.
label: Apocalypse

text: And they ouercame him by the bloud of the Lambe, and by the vvord of their teſtimonie, and they loued not their liues euen vnto death.
label: Apocalypse

text: Therfore reioyce ô heauens, and you that dvvel therein. Vvo to the earth and to the ſea, becauſe the Diuel is deſcended to you, hauing great vvrath, knovving that he hath a litle time.
label: Apocalypse

text: And after the dragon ſavv that he vvas throvven into the earth, he perſecuted the vvoman vvhich brought forth the man-childe:
label: Apocalypse

text: and there vvere giuen to the vvoman tvvo vvinges of a great egle, that ſhee might flie into the deſert vnto her place, vvhere ſhe is nouriſhed for a time & times, & halfe a time, from the face of the ſerpent.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the ſerpent caſt out of his mouth after the vvoman, vvater as it vvere a floud: that he might make her to be caried avvay vvith the floud.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the earth holpe the vvoman, and the earth opened her mouth, and ſvvallovved vp the floud vvhich the dragon caſt out of his mouth.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the dragon vvas angrie againſt the vvoman: and vvent to make battel vvith the reſt of her ſeede, vvhich keepe the commaundements of God, and haue the teſtimonie of IESVS Chriſt.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he ſtood vpon the ſand of the ſea.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND I ſavv a beaſt comming vp from the ſea, hauing ſeuen heades, and ten hornes, & vpon his hornes ten diademes, and vpon his heades names of blaſphemie.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the beaſt vvhich I ſavv, vvas like to a libarde, and his feete as of a beare, and his mouth, as the mouth of a lion. And the dragon gaue him his ovvne force and great povver.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv one of his heades as it vvere ſlaine to death: and the vvound of his death vvas cured. And al the earth vvas in admiration after the beaſt.
label: Apocalypse

text: And they adored the dragon vvhich gaue povver to the beaſt: and they adored the beaſt, ſaying, Vvho is like to the beaſt? and vvho ſhal be able to fight vvith it?
label: Apocalypse

text: And there was giuen to it a mouth ſpeaking great things and blaſphemies: and povver vvas giuen to it to vvorke tvvo and fourtie monethes.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he opened his mouth vnto blaſphemies tovvard God, to blaſpheme his name, and his tabernacle, and thoſe that dvvel in heauen.
label: Apocalypse

text: And it vvas giuē vnto him to make battail vvith the ſainctes, & to ouercome them. And povver vvas giuen him vpon euery tribe and people, and tongue, and nation,
label: Apocalypse

text: and al that inhabite the earth, adored it, vvhoſe names be not written in the booke of life of the Lambe, vvhich vvas ſlaine from the beginning of the vvorld.
label: Apocalypse

text: If any man haue an eare, let him heare.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that ſhal leade into captiuitie, goeth into captiuitie: he that ſhal kil in the ſvvord, he muſt be killed vvith the ſvvord. here is the patience and the faith of ſainctes.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv an other beaſt comming vp from the earth: and he had tvvo hornes, like to a lambe, & he ſpake aſ a dragon.
label: Apocalypse

text: And al the povver of the former beaſt he did in his ſight: and he made the earth and the inhabitants therein, to adore the firſt beaſt, vvhoſe vvound of death vvas cured.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he did many ſignes, ſo that he made alſo fire to come dovvne from heauen vnto the earth in the ſight of men.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he ſeduceth the inhabitants on the earth through the ſignes vvhich vvere giuē him to doe in the ſight of the beaſt, ſaying to them that dwel on the earth, that they ſhould make the image of the beaſt vvhich hath the ſtroke of the ſvvord, and liued.
label: Apocalypse

text: And it vvas giuen him to giue ſpirit to the image of the beaſt, and that the image of the beaſt ſhould ſpeake: and ſhould make, that vvhoſoeuer ſhal not adore the image of the beaſt, be ſlaine.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he ſhal make al, litle & great, and rich, and poore, and free-men, and bond-men, to haue a character in their right hand, or in their foreheads.
label: Apocalypse

text: and that no man may bie or ſel, but he that hath the character, or the name of the beaſt, or the number of his name.
label: Apocalypse

text: Here is vviſdom. He that hath vnderſtanding, let him count the number of the beaſt. For it is the number of a man: & the number of him is ſixe hundred ſixtie ſixe.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND I looked, & behold a Lambe ſtoode vpon mount Sion, and vvith him an hundred fourtie foure thouſand hauing his name, and the name of his Father vvritten in their foreheads.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I heard a voice from heauen, as the voice of many vvaters, and as the voice of great thunder: and the voice vvhich I heard, as of harpers harping on their harpes.
label: Apocalypse

text: And they ſang as it vvere a nevv ſong before the ſeate and before the foure beaſtes, and the ſeniors, and no man could ſay the ſong, but thoſe hundred fourtie foure thouſand, that vvere bought from the earth.
label: Apocalypse

text: Theſe are they vvhich were not defiled vvith vvomen. For they are virgins. Theſe folovv the Lambe vvhitherſoeuer he ſhal goe. Theſe vvere bought from among men, the firſt fruites to God and the Lambe:
label: Apocalypse

text: and in their mouth there vvas found no lie. for they are vvithout ſpot before the throne of God. ⊢
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv an other Angel flying through the middes of heauen, hauing the eternal Goſpel, to euangelize vnto them that ſit vpon the earth, and vpon euery nation, and tribe, & tōge, & people:
label: Apocalypse

text: ſaying vvith a loud voice, Feare our Lord, and giue him honour, becauſe the houre of his iudgement is come: and adore ye him that made heauen and earth, the ſea and al things that are in them, and the fountaines of vvaters.
label: Apocalypse

text: And an other Angel folovved, ſaying, Fallen fallen is that great Babylon, vvhich of the vvine of the vvrath of her fornication made al nations to drinke.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the third Angel folovved them, ſaying vvith a loud voice, If any man adore the beaſt and his image, and receiue the character in his forehead, or in his hand:
label: Apocalypse

text: he alſo ſhal drinke of the vvine of the vvrath of God, vvhich is mingled vvith pure vvine in the cuppe of his vvrath, and ſhal be tormented vvith fire & brimſtone in the ſight of the holy Angels and before the ſight of the Lambe.
label: Apocalypse

text: and the ſmoke of their tormentes ſhal aſcend for euer & euer: neither haue they reſt day and night, vvhich haue adored the beaſt, and his image, and if any man take the character of his name.
label: Apocalypse

text: Here is the patience of ſainctes, vvhich keepe the commaundementes of God and the faith of IESVS.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I heard a voice from heauen, ſaying to me, Vvrite, Bleſſed are the dead which die in our Lord. from hence forth novv, ſaith the Spirit, that they reſt from their labours. for their vvorkes folow them.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv, and behold a vvhite cloude: and vpon the cloude one ſitting like to the Sonne of man, hauing on his head a crovvne of gold, and in his hand a ſharpe ſickle.
label: Apocalypse

text: And an other Angel came forth from the temple, crying vvith a loud voice to him that ſate vpon the cloude, Thruſt in thy ſickle, and reape, becauſe the houre is come to reape, for the harueſt of the earth is drie.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he that ſate vpon the cloude, thruſt his ſickle into the earth, and the earth vvas reaped.
label: Apocalypse

text: And an other Angel came forth from the temple vvhich is in heauen, him ſelf alſo hauing a ſharpe ſickle.
label: Apocalypse

text: And an other Angel came forth from the altar, vvhich had povver ouer the fite: and he cried vvith a loud voice to him that had the ſharpe ſickle, ſaying, Thruſt in thy ſharpe ſickle, and gather the cluſters of the vineyard of the earth: becauſe the grapes thereof be ripe.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the Angel thruſt his ſharpe ſickle into the earth, and gathered the vineyard of the earth, & caſt it into the great preſſe of the vvrath of God:
label: Apocalypse

text: and the preſſe vvas troden vvithout the citie, and bloud came forth out of the preſſe, vp to the horſe bridles, for a thouſand ſixe hundred furlongs.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND I ſavv an other ſigne in heauen great and maruelous: ſeuen Angels hauing the ſeuen laſt plagues. Becauſe in them the wrath of God is conſummate.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv as it vvere a ſea of glaſſe mingled vvith fire, and them that ouercame the beaſt and his image and the number of his name, ſtanding vpon the ſea of glaſſe, hauing the harpes of God:
label: Apocalypse

text: and ſinging the ſong of Moyſes the ſeruant of God, and the ſong of the Lambe, ſaying, Great and maruelous are thy vvorkes Lord God omnipotent: iuſt and true are thy vvaies King of the vvorldes.
label: Apocalypse

text: Vvho ſhal not feare thee o Lord, and magnifie thy name? becauſe thou only art holy, becauſe al nations ſhal come, & adore in thy ſight, becauſe thy iudgements be manifeſt.
label: Apocalypse

text: And after theſe things I looked, and behold the temple of the tabernacle of teſtimonie was opened in heauen:
label: Apocalypse

text: and there iſſued forth the ſeuen Angels, hauing the ſeuen plagues, from the temple: reueſted vvith cleane and vvhite ſtone, & girded about the breaſtes vvith girdles of gold.
label: Apocalypse

text: And one of the foure beaſtes, gaue to the ſeuen Angels ſeuen vials of gold ful of the vvrath of the God that liueth for euer and euer.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the temple vvas filled vvith ſmoke at the maieſtie of God, and at his povver: and no man could enter into the temple, til the ſeuen plagues of the ſeuen Angels vvere conſummate.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND I heard a great voice out of the temple, ſaying to the ſeuen Angels: Goe, and poure out the ſeuen vials of the vvrath of God vpon the earth.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the firſt vvent, and poured out his vial vpon the earth, and there vvas made a cruel and very ſore vvound vpon men that had the character of the beaſt: and vpon them that adored the image thereof.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the ſecond Angel poured out his vial vpon the ſea, and there vvas made bloud as it vvere of one dead: and euery liuing ſoul died in the ſea.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the third poured out his vial vpon the riuers & the fountaines of vvaters: and there vvas made bloud.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I heard the Angel of the vvaters, ſaying: Thou art iuſt ô Lord, vvhich art, and vvhich vvaſt, the holy one, becauſe thou haſt iudged theſe things:
label: Apocalypse

text: becauſe they haue ſhed the bloud of the Sainctes and Prophets, & thou haſt giuen them bloud to drinke. for they are vvorthie.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I heard an other, ſaying: Yea Lord God omnipotent, true and iuſt are thy iudgements.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the fourth Angel poured out his vial vpon the ſunne, and it vvas giuen vnto him to afflict men vvith heate and fire:
label: Apocalypse

text: and men boiled vvith great heate, and blaſphemed the name of God hauing povver ouer theſe plagues, neither did they penance to giue him glorie.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the fift Angel poured out his vial vpon the ſeate of the beaſt: and his kingdom vvas made darke, and they together did eate their tonges for paine:
label: Apocalypse

text: & they blaſphemed the God of heauen becauſe of their paines and vvoundes, & did not penance from their vvorkes.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the ſixt Angel poured out his vial vpon that great riuer Euphrâtes: and dried vp the vvater thereof that a vvay might be prepared to the kings from the riſing of the ſunne.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv from the mouth of the dragon, and from the mouth of the beaſt, and from the mouth of the falſe-prophet three vncleane ſpirites in maner of frogges.
label: Apocalypse

text: For they are the ſpirites of Diuels vvorking ſignes, and they goe forth to the kings of the vvhole earth to gather them into battel at the great day of the omnipotent God.
label: Apocalypse

text: Behold I come as a theefe: Bleſſed is he that vvatcheth, & keepeth his garments, that he vvalke not naked, and they ſee his turpitude.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he ſhal gather them into a place vvhich in Hebrevv is called Armagedon.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the ſeuenth Angel poured out his vial vpon the aire, and there came forth a loud voice out of the temple from the throne, ſaying: It is done.
label: Apocalypse

text: And there vvere made lighteninges, and voices, and thunders, and a great earthquake vvas made, ſuch an one as neuer hath been ſince men vvere vpon the earth, ſuch an earthquake, ſo great.
label: Apocalypse

text: and the great citie vvas made into three partes: and the cities of the Gentiles fel. And Babylon the great came into memorie before God, to giue her the cuppe of vvine of the indignation of his vvrath.
label: Apocalypse

text: And euery Iland fled, and mountaines vvere not found.
label: Apocalypse

text: And great haile like a talent came downe from heauen vpon men: and men blaſphemed God for the plague of the haile: becauſe it vvas made exceeding great.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND there came one of the ſeuen Angels which had the ſeuen vials, & ſpake vvith me, ſaying, Come, I vvil ſhevv thee the damnation of the great harlot, vvhich ſitteth vpon many vvaters,
label: Apocalypse

text: vvith vvhom the kings of the earth haue fornicated, and they vvhich inhabite the earth haue been drunke of the vvine of her vvhoredom.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he tooke me avvay in ſpirit into the deſert. And I ſavv a vvoman ſitting vpon a ſcarlet coloured beaſt, ful of names of blaſphemie, hauing ſeuen heades, and ten hornes.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the vvoman vvas clothed round about vvith purple and ſcarlet, and gilted vvith gold, and pretious ſtone, and pearles, hauing a golden cup in her hand, ful of the abomination & filthines of her fornication.
label: Apocalypse

text: And in her forehead a name vvritten, Myſterie: Babylon the great, mother of the fornications and the abominations of the earth.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv the vvoman drunken of the bloud of the Sainctes, and of the bloud of the martyrs of IESVS. And I marueled vvhen I had ſeen her, vvith great admiration.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the Angel ſaid to me, Vvhy doeſt thou maruel? I vvil tel thee the myſterie of the woman, and of the beaſt that carieth her, which hath the ſeuen heades and the ten hornes.
label: Apocalypse

text: The beaſt vvhich thou ſavveſt, vvas, and is not, and ſhal come vp out of the bottomeles depth, and goe into deſtruction: and the inhabitants on the earth (vvhoſe names are not vvritten in the booke of life from the making of the vvorld) ſhal maruel, ſeeing the beaſt that vvas, and is not.
label: Apocalypse

text: And here is vnderſtanding, that hath vviſedom. The ſeuen heades: are ſeuen hilles, vpon vvhich the vvoman ſitteth, and they are ſeuen kings.
label: Apocalypse

text: Fiue are fallen, one is, and an other is not yet come: & vvhen he ſhal come, he muſt tarie a ſhort time.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the beaſt vvhich vvas, & is not: the ſame alſo is the eight, and is of the ſeuen, & goeth into deſtruction.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the ten hornes vvhich thou ſaweſt: are ten kings, vvhich haue not yet receiued kingdom, but ſhal receiue povver as kings one houre after the beaſt.
label: Apocalypse

text: Theſe haue one counſel and force: and their povver they ſhal deliuer to the beaſt.
label: Apocalypse

text: Theſe ſhal fight vvith the Lambe, and the Lambe ſhal ouercome them, becauſe he is Lord of lordes, and King of kinges, and they that are vvith him, called, and elect, and faithful.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he ſaid to me, The vvaters vvhich thou ſavveſt vvhere the harlot ſitteth: are peoples, and nations, and tonges.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the ten hornes vvhich thou ſavveſt in the beaſt: theſe ſhal hate the harlot, and ſhal make her deſolate and naked, and ſhal eate her fleſh, and her they ſhal burne vvith fire.
label: Apocalypse

text: for God hath giuen into their hartes, to doe that vvhich pleaſeth him: that they giue their kingdom to the beaſt, til the vvordes of God be cōſummate.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the vvoman vvhich thou ſavveſt: is the great citie, vvhich hath kingdom ouer the kinges of the earth.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND after theſe things I ſavv an other Angel coming dovvne from heauen, hauing great povver: & the earth vvas illuminated of his glorie.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he cried out in force, ſaying, Fallen fallen is Babylon the great: and it is become the habitation of Deuils, and the cuſtodie of euery vncleane ſpirit, and the cuſtodie of euery vncleane and hateful bird:
label: Apocalypse

text: becauſe al nations haue drunke of the vvine of the vvrath of her fornication: and the kings of the earth haue fornicated vvith her: and the marchants of the earth vvere made riche by the vertue of her delicacies.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I heard an other voice from heauen, ſaying, Goe out from her my people: that you be not partakers of her ſinnes, and receiue not of her plagues.
label: Apocalypse

text: Becauſe her ſinnes are come euen to heauen, and God hath remembred her iniquities.
label: Apocalypse

text: Render to her as ſhe alſo hath rendred to you: & double ye double according to her vvorkes: In the cuppe vvherin ſhe hath mingled, mingle ye double vnto her.
label: Apocalypse

text: As much as ſhe hath glorified her ſelf, & hath been in delicacies, ſo much giue her torment and mourning: becauſe ſhe ſaith in her hart, I ſit a queene, & Widow I am not, and mourning I ſhal not ſee.
label: Apocalypse

text: Therfore in one day ſhal her plagues come, death, and mourning, and famine, and vvith fire ſhe ſhal be burnt: becauſe God is ſtrong that ſhal iudge her.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the kings of the earth, vvhich haue fornicated vvith her, & haue liued in delicacies, ſhal vveepe, & bevvaile them ſelues vpon her, vvhen they ſhal ſee the ſmoke of her burning:
label: Apocalypse

text: ſtanding farre of for the feare of her tormentes, ſaying, Vvo, vvo, that great citie Babylon, that ſtrong citie: becauſe in one houre is thy iudgement come.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the marchantes of the earth ſhall vveepe, & mourne vpon her: becauſe no man ſhal bye their merchandiſe any more,
label: Apocalypse

text: merchandiſe of gold and ſiluer and precious ſtone, and of pearle, and fine linnen, and purple, and ſilke, & ſcarlet, and al Thyne vvood, and al veſſels of yuorie, and al veſſels of precious ſtone and of braſſe and yron and marble,
label: Apocalypse

text: and cynamon, and of odours, and ointement, and frankeincenſe, and vvine, and oile, and floure, & vvheate, and beaſtes, & ſheepe, and horſes, and chariotes, & ſlaues, and ſoules of men.
label: Apocalypse

text: The apples of the deſire of thy ſoul are departed from thee, & al fat and goodly thinges are periſhed from thee, and they ſhal no more finde them.
label: Apocalypse

text: The marchantes of theſe things vvhich are made riche, ſhal ſtand farre from her for feare of her tormentes, vveeping and mourning,
label: Apocalypse

text: ſaying, Wo, vvo, that great citie, vvhich vvas clothed vvith ſilke, and purple, and ſcarlet, and vvas gilted vvith gold, and pretious ſtone, and pearles:
label: Apocalypse

text: becauſe in one houre are ſo great riches made deſolate: and euery gouernour, and euery one that ſaileth into the lake, and the ſhipmen, and they that vvorke in the ſea, ſtoode a farre of,
label: Apocalypse

text: and cried ſeeing the place of her burning, ſaying, Vvhat other is like to this great citie?
label: Apocalypse

text: And they threvv duſt vpon their heades, and cried vveeping and mourning, ſaying: Vvo, vvo, that great citie, in the vvhich al vvere made riche that had ſhippes in the ſea, of her prices: becauſe in one houre ſhe is deſolate.
label: Apocalypse

text: Reioyce ouer her, heauen, and ye holy Apoſtles and Prophetes: becauſe God hath iudged your iudgement of her.
label: Apocalypse

text: And one ſtrong Angel tooke vp as it vvere a great milſtone, and threvv it into the ſea, ſaying, Vvith this violence ſhal Babylon that great citie be throwen, and ſhal novv be found no more.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the voice of harpers, & of Muſicians, and of them that ſing on ſhalme and trompet, ſhal no more be heard in thee, & euery artificer of euery art ſhal be found no more in thee, and the noiſe of the mill ſhal no more be heard in thee,
label: Apocalypse

text: and the light of the lampe ſhal no more ſhine in thee, and the voice of the bridegrome and the bride ſhal no more be heard in thee: becauſe thy marchantes were the princes of the earth, becauſe al nations haue erred in thine inchauntments.
label: Apocalypse

text: And in her is found the bloud of the Prophets and Sainctes, and of al that vvere ſlaine in the earth.
label: Apocalypse

text: AFTER theſes things I heard as it vvere the voice of many multitudes in heauen ſaying, Allelu-ia. Praiſe, and glorie, and povver is to our God:
label: Apocalypse

text: becauſe true & iuſt are his iudgementes which hath iudged of the great harlot, that hath corrupted the earth in her vvhoredom, and hath reuenged the bloud of his ſeruants, of her handes.
label: Apocalypse

text: And againe they ſaid, Allelu-ia. And her ſmoke aſcendeth for euer and euer.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the foure and tvventie ſeniors fel downe, and the foure beaſtes, & adored God ſitting vpon the throne, ſaying: Amen, Allelu-ia.
label: Apocalypse

text: And a voice came out from the throne, ſaying: Say praiſe to our God al ye his ſeruantes: and you that feare him, litle and great.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I heard as it vvere the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many vvaters, & as the voice of great thunders, ſaying, Allelu-ia: becauſe our Lord God the omnipotent hath reigned.
label: Apocalypse

text: Let vs be glad and reioyce, and giue glorie to him: becauſe the mariage of the Lambe is come, and his vvife hath prepared her ſelf.
label: Apocalypse

text: And it vvas giuen to her that ſhe clothe her ſelf vvith ſilke glittering and vvhite. For the ſilke are the iuſtifications of Sainctes.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he ſaid to me, Vvrite, Bleſſed be they that are called to the ſupper of the mariage of the Lambe. ⊢ And he ſaid to me, Theſe vvordes of God, be true.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I fel before his feete, to adore him. And he ſaith to me, See thou doe not: I am thy fellovv-ſeruant, and of thy brethren that haue the teſtimonie of IESVS. Adore God. For the teſtimonie of IESVS, is the ſpirit of prophecie.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv heauen opened, and behold a vvhite horſe: and he that ſate vpon him, vvas called Faithful and True, and vvith iuſtice he iudgeth & fighteth.
label: Apocalypse

text: And his eies as a flame of fire, and on his head many diademes. hauing a name written, vvhich no man knovveth but him ſelf.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he vvas clothed vvith a garment ſprinkled vvith bloud: & his name is called, THE VVORD OF GOD.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the hoſtes that are in heauen folovved him on vvhite horſes clothed in vvhite and pure ſilke.
label: Apocalypse

text: And out of his mouth procedeth a ſharpe ſvvord: that in it he may ſtrike the Gentiles. And he ſhal rule them in a rod of yron: and he treadeth the vvine preſſe of the furie of the vvrath of God omnipotent.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he hath in his garment and in his thigh vvritten, KING OF KINGES AND LORD OF LORDES.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv one Angel ſtanding in the ſunne, & he cried vvith a loud voice ſaying to al the birdes that did flie by the middes of heauen, Come and aſſemble together to the great ſupper of God:
label: Apocalypse

text: that you may eate the fleſh of kings, and the fleſh of tribunes, and the fleſh of valiants, and the fleſh of horſes & of them that ſit on them, & the fleſh of al freemen and bondmen, and of litle and great.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv the beaſt and the kings of the earth, & their armies gathered to make vvarre vvith him that ſate vpon the horſe and vvith his armie.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the beaſt vvas apprehended, and vvith him the falſe-prophet: vvhich vvrought ſignes before him, vvherevvith he ſeduced them that tooke the character of the beaſt, and that adored his image. Theſe tvvo were caſt aliue into the poole of fire burning alſo with brimſtone.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the reſt vvere ſlaine by the ſvvord of him that ſitteth vpon the horſe, vvhich procedeth out of his mouth: and al the birdes vvere filled vvith their fleſh.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND I ſavv an Angel deſcending from heauen, hauing the key of the bottomles depth, and a great chaine in his hand.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he apprehended the dragon the old ſerpent, vvhich is the Deuil and Satan, and bound him for a thouſand yeres.
label: Apocalypse

text: and he threvv him into the depth, and ſhut him vp, and ſealed ouer him, that he ſeduce no more the nations, til the thouſand yeres be conſummate. and after theſe thinges he muſt be looſed a litle time.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv ſeates: and they ſate vpon them, & iudgement vvas giuen them, and the ſoules of the beheaded for the teſtimonie of IESVS, and for the vvord of God, and that adored not the beaſt, nor his image, nor receiued his character in their foreheads or in their handes, and haue liued, and reigned vvith Chriſt a thouſand yeres.
label: Apocalypse

text: The reſt of the dead liued not, til the thouſand yeres be conſummate. This is the firſt reſurrection.
label: Apocalypse

text: Bleſſed and holy is he that hath part in the firſt reſurrection. in theſe the ſecond death hath not povver: but they ſhal be prieſtes of God and of Chriſt: and ſhal reigne vvith him a thouſand yeres.
label: Apocalypse

text: And vvhen the thouſand yeres ſhal be conſummate, Satan ſhal be looſed out of his priſon, and ſhal goe forth, and ſeduce the nations that are vpon the foure corners of the earth, Gog, and Magog, and ſhal gather them into battel, the number of vvhom is as the ſand of the ſea.
label: Apocalypse

text: And they aſcended vpon the bredth of the earth, and compaſſed the campe of the Sainctes, and the beloued citie.
label: Apocalypse

text: And there came dovvne fire from God out of heauen, and deuoured them:
label: Apocalypse

text: and the Deuil vvhich ſeduced them, vvas caſt into the poole of fire and brimſtone, vvhere both the beaſt and the falſe-prophet ſhal be tormented day and night for euer and euer.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv a great vvhite throne, and one ſitting vpon it, from vvhoſe ſight earth and heauen fled, and there vvas no place found for them.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I ſavv the dead, great and litle, ſtanding in the ſight of the throne, and bookes vvere opened: and an other booke vvas opened, vvhich is of life: and the dead vvere iudged of thoſe thinges vvhich were vvritten in the bookes according to their vvorkes.
label: Apocalypse

text: and the ſea gaue the dead that vvere in it, and death and hel gaue their dead that vvere in them, and it vvas iudged of euery one according to their vvorkes.
label: Apocalypse

text: And hel and death vvere caſt into the poole of fire. This is the ſecond death.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he that vvas not found vvritten in the booke of life, vvas caſt into the poole of fire.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND I ſavv a nevv heauen and a nevv earth. for the firſt heauen, and the firſt earth vvas gone, & the ſea novv is not.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I Iohn ſavv the holy citie Hieruſalem nevv deſcending from heauen, prepared of God, as a bride adorned for her huſband.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I heard a loud voice from the throne ſaying: Behold the tabernacle of God vvith men, and he vvil dvvel vvith them. And they ſhal be his people: and he God vvith them ſhal be their God.
label: Apocalypse

text: and God ſhal vvipe avvay al teares from their eies: and death ſhal be no more. nor mourning, nor crying, neither ſhal there be ſorovv any more, vvhich firſt thinges are gone.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he that ſate in the throne, ſaid: Behold I make al thinges nevv. ⊢ And he ſaid to me: Vvrite, becauſe theſe vvordes be moſt faithful and true.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he ſaid to me: It is done, I am Alpha and O mega: the beginning and the end. To him that thirſteth I vvil giue of the fountaine of the vvater of life, gratis.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that ſhal ouercome, ſhal poſſeſſe theſe thinges, and I vvil be his God: and he ſhal be my ſonne.
label: Apocalypse

text: But to the feareful, and incredulous, and execrable, and murderers, and fornicators, and ſorcerers, and Idolaters, and al liers, their part ſhal be in the poole burning vvith fire and brimſtone, vvhich is the ſecond death.
label: Apocalypse

text: And there came one of the ſeuen Angels that had the vials ful of the ſeuen laſt plagues, and ſpake vvith me, ſaying: Come, & I vvil ſhevv thee the bride, the vvife of the Lambe.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he tooke me vp in ſpirit vnto a mountaine great and high: and he ſhevved me the holy citie Hieruſalem deſcending out of heauen from God, hauing the glorie of God.
label: Apocalypse

text: and the light thereof like to a pretious ſtone, as it vvere to the iaſper ſtone, euen as cryſtal.
label: Apocalypse

text: And it had a vvall great and high, hauing tvvelue gates, and in the gates tvvelue Angels, & names written thereon, vvhich are the names of the tvvelue tribes of the children of Iſrael.
label: Apocalypse

text: On the Eaſt, three gates: and on the North, three gates: and on the South, three gates: and on the Vveſt, three gates.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the vvall of the citie hauing tvvelue foundations: and in them, tvvelue names, of the tvvelue Apoſtles of the Lambe.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he that ſpake vvith me, had a meaſure of a reede, of gold, to meaſure the citie and the gates thereof, and the vvall.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the citie is ſituated quadrangle-vviſe, and the length thereof is as great as alſo the bredth: and he meaſured the citie vvith the reede for tvvelue thouſand furlonges, & the length and height and bredth thereof be equal.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he meaſured the vvall thereof of an hundred fourtie foure cubites, the meaſure of a man vvhich is of an Angel.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the building of the vvall therof vvas of iaſper ſtone: but the citie it ſelf pure gold, like to pure glaſſe.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the foundations of the vvall of the citie, vvere adorned vvith al pretious ſtone. The firſt foundation, the iaſper: the ſecond, the ſaphire: the third, the calcedonius: the fourth, the emerauld:
label: Apocalypse

text: the fifth, the ſardonix: the ſixt, the ſardius: the ſeuenth, the chryſolithus: the eight, the beryllus: the ninthe, the topazius: the tenth, the chryſopraſus: the eleuenth, the hyacinthe: the tvvelfth, the amethyſte.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the twelue gates: there are tvvelue pearles, one to euery one: & euery gate vvas of one ſeueral pearle. & the ſtreate of the citie pure gold, as it vvere tranſparent glaſſe.
label: Apocalypse

text: And temple I ſavv not therein. for our Lord the God omnipotent is the temple thereof, and the Lambe.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the citie needeth not ſunne nor moone, to ſhine in it. for the glorie of God hath illuminated it, and the Lambe is the lampe thereof.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the Gentiles ſhal vvalke in the light of it: and the kinges of the earth ſhal bring their glorie and honour into it.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the gates thereof ſhal not be ſhut by day: for there ſhal be no night there.
label: Apocalypse

text: And they ſhal bring the glorie and honour of nations into it.
label: Apocalypse

text: There ſhal not enter into it any polluted thing, nor that doeth abomination and maketh lie, but they that are vvritten in the booke of life of the Lambe.
label: Apocalypse

text: AND he ſhevved me a riuer of liuing water, cleere as cryſtal, proceding from the ſeate of God and of the Lambe.
label: Apocalypse

text: In the middes of the ſtreate thereof, and on both ſides of the riuer, the tree of life, yelding tvvelue fruites, rendring his fruite euery moneth, and the leaues of the tree for the curing of the Gentiles.
label: Apocalypse

text: And no curſe ſhal be any more: and the ſeate of God and of the Lambe ſhal be in it, and his ſeruantes ſhal ſerue him.
label: Apocalypse

text: And they ſhal ſee his face: and his name in their foreheads.
label: Apocalypse

text: And night ſhal be no more: and they ſhal not neede the light of lampe, nor the light of the ſunne, becauſe our Lord God doth illuminate them, and they ſhal reigne for euer and euer.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he ſaid to me, Theſe vvordes are moſt faithful and true. And our Lord the God of the ſpirites of the prophetes, ſent his Angel to ſhevv his ſeruantes thoſe thinges vvhich muſt be done quickly.
label: Apocalypse

text: And behold I come quickly. Bleſſed is he that keepeth the vvordes of the prophecie of this booke.
label: Apocalypse

text: And I Iohn vvhich haue heard, and ſeen theſe thinges. And after I had heard and ſeen, I fel dovvne to adore before the feete of the Angel vvhich ſhevved me theſe thinges:
label: Apocalypse

text: and he ſaid to me, See thou doe not, for I am thy fellow-ſeruant, and of thy brethren the prophetes, and of them that keepe the vvordes of this booke. Adore God.
label: Apocalypse

text: And he ſaith to me, Seale not the vvordes of the prophecie of this booke. for the time is neere.
label: Apocalypse

text: He that hurteth, let him hurt yet: and he that is in filth, let him be filthie yet: and he that is iuſt, let him be iuſtified yet: and let the holy be ſanctified yet.
label: Apocalypse

text: Behold I come quickly. and my revvard is vvith me, to render to euery man according to his vvorkes,
label: Apocalypse

text: I am Alpha and O mega, the firſt and the laſt, the beginning and the end.
label: Apocalypse

text: Bleſſed are they that vvaſh their ſtoles: that their povver may be in the tree of life, and they may enter by the gates into the citie.
label: Apocalypse

text: Vvithout are dogges and ſorcerers, and the vnchaſt, and murderers, and ſeruers of Idols, & euery one that loueth and maketh a lie.
label: Apocalypse

text: I IESVS haue ſent mine Angel, to teſtifie to you theſe thinges in the Churches. I am the roote and ſtocke of Dauid, the bright and morning ſtarre.
label: Apocalypse

text: And the Spirit & the bride ſay, Come. And he that heareth, let him ſay, Come. And he that thirſteth, let him come: and he that vvil, let him take the vvater of life gratis.
label: Apocalypse

text: For I teſtifie to euery one hearing the vvordes of the prophecie of this booke, If any man ſhal adde to theſe things, God ſhal adde vpon him the plagues vvritten in this booke.
label: Apocalypse

text: And if any man ſhal diminiſh of the wordes of the booke of this prophecie: God ſhal take avvay his part out of the booke of life, and out of the holy citie, and of theſe thinges that be vvritten in this booke.
label: Apocalypse

text: ſaith he that giueth teſtimonie of theſe things. Yea I come quickely: Amen. Come Lord IESVS.
label: Apocalypse

text: The grace of our Lord IESVS Chriſt be vvith you al. Amen.
label: Apocalypse
